Khalilahs place was actually more beautiful than I anticipated. The home was decorated beautifully. Very comfy and homey. She was a very communicative host and answer any questions we had quickly. Quiet neighborhood, clean and esthetically pleasing. I would come back and stay again.
Great host. Place was also very nice!
Great location. Especially for McCormick Place. Also easy access to entire city and some good bars and restaurants nearby. Would do it again.
Great place! Perfect location near Wrigley Field and the brown line.

full stars, highly recommend!

Great place, with everything you need for a comfortable stay!

Very clean, neat, safe and secure. A very well appointed apartment with everything you need for a week long stay. The host is super responsive and helpful. A home away from home.

Very nice interior home with a shared kitchen and three bathrooms. The room is next to the kitchen and backyard which is convenient since I can’t walk up staircase. The room itself is very stylish and clean and the host is super responsive and helpful. Two blocks away to train and public transit. I would book again in the future!
DJ was a wonderful person and host. Would recommend anytime

This location was exactly like what the pictures showed. They had very clear instructions including videos and pictures that showed exactly where to go and how to access the unit. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again.

Laura's place was perfect for us. Very spacious for a studio. Had everything we needed. The on-site laundry huge for us as we traveled with backpacks. We're big pub transit people so having those services very close by big plus. One minor issue upon check-in was resolved  promptly. Hospital & firehouse in close proximity-- so very active street during daylight. Laura thoughtfully makes note of this in the listing. I would stay there again.

John is an amazing host! Very responsive and even meets you to give you the keys and a tour of the place. Phenomenal host, cannot recommend him more. Space is clean, roomy, and feels like a home. Cool neighborhood, lots of good restaurants and bars in walking distance. Had a fantastic stay, will be staying again!
Great place! Easy walk to Wrigley for baseball game. Great communication with Richard. Highly recommended! We will be back.
Kirsten was a very communicative host. And the 70-inch TV & the coffee machine made our 5-day stay a lot more enjoyable.
Diana was fantastic! She made us feel right at home and answered all of our questions!

Great place to stay and the hosts were friendly and responsive.  Super easy to get to and the space and location worked perfectly - bus so convenient or just a short walk to the L.  Also several cool places just nearby.  Beds were really comfortable and loved the sauna feature.  Would definitely stay again.

Robert's place was amazing. It reminded me of the early day of AirBnb when you could sleep in someone's spare bedroom. This time though with all the comfort and privacy of an entire place for yourself.
The place was very clean and tidy, and it literally felt like being at home. You will have every comfort you can imagine and the apartment is incredibly relaxing. I particularly enjoyed the back patio.
The only negative part of the stay was the location. It's not a particularly safe part of town, and multiple locals recommended me to be careful at night. During the day it's chill. The neighborood itself felt very safe though and there's a school right in front of the house, so I never felt unsafe around the house.
Either way, a great stay and I 100% would do it again.
Thank you for hosting me!

We were here on a stressful mission to take our son to Northwestern Hospital.  Long before our arrival Danny was very helpful.  The location was perfect for our purposes.  Every time I contacted Danny he was quick to respond & immensely helpful.  We will be back & we hope to stay here again.  Next time we hope to visit the zoo, not just the hospital, and include our grandsons too.  Danny’s lovely place was the stress free environment we needed after long days at the hospital.

Home was exactly as described.  Beautifully decorated but comfortable.  Totally walkable to restaurants and the Red Line.  Beautiful and safe neighborhood.  Streets can be a tight squeeze sometimes and you MUST be comfortable parallel parking but we didn't really have any problems finding a place to park.  Beds were extremely comfortable as well!  Would highly recommend!
Great hospitality. Would stay here again!
Great place to stay for the weekend

We had a great stay! Place was very tidy and easy to locate and check in. When we ran into minor issues (e.g. we couldn't find the parking pass right away), Michael was prompt to fix it. Very walkable and near public transport (10-15 min walk from L train stop). Checkout was also easy and straightforward.

We really enjoyed Mimi's place. Our son lives in the neighborhood but doesn't have room for all of us to visit so the location was perfect for us. Everything was clean and felt at home with extra touches of coffee, extra amenities in the bathroom, and soft throw blankets for the sofa.
Overall it was a great stay in a great location.
We loved the convenience of the unit to excellent restaurants and vintage shops. It was a comfy place with a large communal hangout area.
Very nice quiet place to stay when visiting Chicago

Vachetta was very accommodating and responsive. The first two nights were very quiet. The third night I heard music all night (not loud) into the morning and couldn't figure where it was coming from. It was in the heart of Hyde Park, minutes from new Obama Museum (reason for my trip to Chicago), AND walking distance (15 minutes) from where Obama lived (HIS HOUSE).
I was able to make this trip affordable, safe, and convenient!
Thank you so much for being patient with me, Andy!

Tarek was communicative and quick to problem solve.  The house was secure, quiet, and comfortable. The back patio was a peaceful spot to hang out. Beds were comfortable, great linens and towels, bathrooms were clean and welcoming. A great spot for your Hyde Park adventures.

This is perfect for solo travelers. The spot is just a few minutes from the blue line to get to downtown/the airport, and there are tons of restaurants nearby! My one thing is that it is not made super clear from the description that this is a shared space. The other couple that stayed with me however were quiet and respectable, so if you’re ok with a shared space this is great for solo travelers!

I had a great experience here. The listing description is very accurate. Represented a huge value for me, who just needed a bed at night at a good price. Walkable to the McCormick center, and close to China town with good food. I would stay again!!

I had a great stay at Michael’s place! The location was incredibly convenient, especially with public transportation just a short walk away, which made getting around really easy.
The private loft was comfortable, cozy, and gave me a great space to relax after being out for the day. Michael was also a fantastic host; super cool, chill, and accommodating. He made everything easy and was very welcoming without ever being intrusive.
Overall, it was a great experience, and I’d definitely stay here again. Highly recommend Michael’s place if you’re looking for a comfortable stay in a convenient location with a great host!
We enjoyed our stay! Such a comfortable and thoughtfully stocked home. Johanna is an amazing host!

Great stay at Can’s place. It was clean, well-maintained, and accurate to the description. Super convenient location near the Blue Line for easy downtown access. Can was very communicative and helpful. Highly recommended!
Stunning and comfortable apartment where felt right at home. Easy to get to all that Chicago has to offer. Highly recommend.
Great place, great host!

I had a great stay while I was in Chicago for work. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what I needed after long days on the job. It felt welcoming and had everything I needed to relax and feel at home. Ivy was a great host, and everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out. I would definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago for work. Highly recommend!

Great Stay!

I need 1,000 words to say how much we enjoyed Georgina’s brownstone. Wonderful walkability, beautiful interior, delightful host. Highly recommend.
I strongly suggest this lovely residence for the welcoming atmosphere, and the convenient location.

The place was clean and nice. It was close to the metro station, and it was easy to get to downtown using the Pink Line. The self check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow. The host also responded quickly. I recommend this place.

Nilka was one of the best hosts I’ve ever dealt with traveling alone or with friends. She was extremely responsive, very helpful, and went out of her way to make sure I had what I needed to make my stay comfortable! The home is beautiful, and in a great location, quick easy access to the highway, on a quiet not too busy street! I will most certainly be staying here again if I make it back to Chicago, and will recommend anyone I know that comes here book with Nilka!

Absolutely loved the house.
Communication with the host is outstanding.
Great place with updated amenities. If you are a light sleeper, beware of the foot traffic on the above floor..they are up early! Otherwise, I would recommend Susan and her place
I had a wonderful stay at Cathern ‘s. Felt right at home. The location is great. Transport is easily accessible. Great eateries in the neighborhood. I would definitely love to be back here !
Place was clean, and exactly how it looked online. Check in/check out was super easy.  Perfect spot for our stay!
Todo muy bien.

We stayed here for 3 days during our trip to Chicago, and the house was exactly as shown in the photos. The location was great, very close to the Blue Line’s California station, which made it easy to get around the city. There was also a small garden, and the bed was very comfortable. The kitchen was well equipped, and there were some snacks provided as well. :) Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place. Thank you!

We felt right at home here. It was such a great place to stay. The neighborhood is fun and safe with lots of cafes and restaurants to walk to. The hosts were wonderful, open and inviting. We really enjoyed meeting them and sharing a coffee to get some local color. The place was perfect in every way!
Great place to stay if the goal is to use it as a homebase for sleeping. Everything needed is nearby at convenience.
Excellent place in a super walkable/bike-able area!

As soon as I booked the reservation Genesys was always communicating. Whether it was restaurants what to do around town and more. House was just like the pictures, rain forest like house and boy was it amazing. Would book again in a heartbeat!
My second time here and would come again!
Highly recommend staying here!
My daughter and I truly enjoyed our stay! This was the perfect size for us! Would definitely  book this for another visit!
This is a great place, would come back again. Thank you!

Having a private enclosed garage was great, but please know it’ll only fit smaller vehicles (we had a Toyota Corolla cross). Clean, very walkable to CTA stops, and safe. Khong was very responsive and gave tons of local recommendations!
This is a great place just out of downtown.  It is by the L, but the noise was not an issue.  Great restaurants within walking distance.  Nice to have parking too.
David's space was beautifully decorated, and great attention was paid to its cleanliness.  David communicated frequently and answered all of our questions.

The best accommodations: fresh muffin made from the host’s daughter, extra toothbrush and toiletries if you need. Coffee and tea. These small things made the Airbnb stand out!! I would recommend to anyone staying in the Logan Square area :)
They put a lot of thought into furnishings to satisfy their guests needs. Much more than we would have ever expected. They are obviously professionals at this and it was very much appreciated.
Great host!

Great stay, very clean. I would stay there again.

Uno de los mejores lugares en los que me alojado....súper limpio y seguro ...Anna y su esposo definitivamente los mejores anfitriones....la casa y el barrio super seguros y bonitos ....recomendable 100%.
Edward was an excellent host and I loved his place. I will most definitely be back when I visit Chicago!
A really great host!! We felt right at home and would come back anytime
It was great! We stayed there with our dogs for about 3 months and it was perfect. Easy to find street parking. Great space in unit with storage and living. Very pleased with our stay

Had a great stay in Chicago. Our Airbnb was close to our son’s apartment which is what we wanted. We were also close to many amenities and it was very walkable as well as close to public transportation. The Airbnb was clean and had everything we needed. Host was very responsive and friendly. All in all, great location and we would definitely come back.

Lois and Eduardo were so lovely. They are thoughtful, kind, and it’s clear they truly enjoy being hosts. They were supportive at every turn and we were very comfortable in their home. Communication was wonderful and directions and expectations were very clear. They are genuine and warm people and we hope to connect with them again!
Very clean, nice shower.

Very comfortable beds and great lighting everywhere, including natural and electric. I appreciated the full length mirror in the master bedroom that was artful and practical. People previously mentioned outside train noise but it was negligible. Didn’t bother me or my sister at all. Overall, nice way to spend a few days in Chicago!

We had a very good stay overall. The apartment was clean, comfortable, nicely renovated, and had everything we needed. The location in Rogers Park is excellent, with easy access to transportation, restaurants, the lakefront, and nearby areas like Evanston.
The host was very responsive and attentive throughout our stay and was quick to help whenever we had a question or needed something.
The one thing future guests should be aware of is the noise. You can definitely hear the Red Line trains as well as movement from the upstairs neighbors, particularly at night and early in the morning. If you’re a light sleeper, this is something to consider.
Aside from the noise, we enjoyed the apartment and appreciated the host’s hospitality and responsiveness.
Great place to stay for a conference downtown. Only complaint would be street noise in the bedroom. But, otherwise, everything was great!
Good place very close to cta

Very good host, very friendly and responded to our questions
Location was great, close to city and lots of pubs and restaurants around
Felt very safe there
Noise comes from upstairs apartment though
Great experience. The property was exactly as presented. Great location.

A great location close to Grant and Mlenium park, a short walk to the cultural mile, as well as the field museum and aquarium, and steps from the metro train red, orange and green lines. Quiet and secure. A great location for exploring downtown Chicago!
Had a great stay, the game room is over the top with probably 10 or more different arcade games plus a bunch of other stuff like air, hockey, basketball pool, etc. etc.
Great location, clean and quite.
Paula’s place was wonderful!  Really close to public transport, really cute and peaceful neighborhood, comfortable and clean, overall a fantastic place to stay! I would absolutely stay again!
Excelente lugar. Limpio, cómodo y seguro.

I loved my stay at Jeff's home, it was in a great location within a 20-minute drive of downtown, and 45-minute train ride. Jeff was communicative, proactive, and kind. Parking was surprisingly easy to find within a block of the apartment even fairly late at night. I look forward to staying with Jeff again.
Great apartment in a great neighborhood

Frank & Jessica have curated such an amazing, cozy space for their guests. You couldn’t ask for more friendly hosts who genuinely care about your stay. All the comforts of home, in a newly renovated, upstairs apartment.. with beautiful furnishings, and high end appliances.
Super comfy linens, bed and pillows, although the Roscoe Village is so cute, you won’t want to sleep for long!
Walkable bars, restaurants & coffee shops in a safe & very friendly neighborhood.
It honestly doesn’t get much better than this.
Such a bonus for us to arrive, seeing a Bears flag out front.. the perfect greeting for us Az. Bears fans.
Seriously already want to book our stay for next year.
Don’t just take our word for it!

We had a great time. Fantastic to be next to public transportation. Walked to the Salt Shed. Really clean. Comfy bed.
Very clean space, the neighbor was peaceful and location was perfect for our stay! The garage was an extra perk to not have to worry about finding parking.
Great house and great place. Totally recommendable
Stayed here for 5 days. Great host, clean place, and very safe and nice residential area. Would come back!
Great location.  The bedrooms were comfortable and the space was perfect for our needs.  There was some natural wear and tear from being an air bnb, but nothing that took away from the stay.
Host is very responsive. Place is very clean, beds are very comfy. Area is quiet at night.

The place was exactly as described and within walking distance of the metro, which made getting around very convenient. Communication with the host was amazing throughout my stay, and everything was smooth and easy. I would definitely recommend this place!
Everything was perfect for our girls trip! Wrigley is only a 10 min drive and it was 20 minutes to downtown Chicago. We had a blast.
Spacious, well equipped, comfortable apartment.  Quiet area but very convenient to public transportation.  Thanks Adam
Beth was an incredible host. Highly recommend and will definitely search for her property next time in Chicago. 10/5 5 stars!

Oriane’s unit was so perfect for our stay in Chicago. It looked exactly like the photos and was very clean! The bed was extremely comfy and the unit overall was quiet and cozy. Oriane was a great host and I would definitely stay here again!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Nancy’s place near Wrigley Field! The location was amazing and could not have been more perfect, especially for enjoying everything the area has to offer. The home itself was beautiful, comfortable, spotless, and had everything we needed. Nancy was an incredible host and made the entire experience so easy and enjoyable. We truly could not have asked for a better place to stay or a better host. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!
Fue un lugar muy limpio, muy ordenado, muy cómodo.  Nos sentimos como en casa, lo único difícil fue lidiar por las noches con el sonido del tren, aunque uno se va acostumbrando

We rented this entire building because we had a number of employees in town for a tradeshow.  It really worked perfectly for our needs.  Each room was very much like a hotel room with the ability to lock each door.  There were several of us that had our own bathrooms, but some of the rooms required a shared bathroom.  This was clear to us before we rented and it worked well for us, but it is different from a hotel in that respect.  There is a large shared area on the lower level an our whole group was able to relax and enjoy the evenings watching TV (huge smart TV) or just have some drinks and discuss the day.  The kitchen was nice for us for breakfasts etc.  The spaces outside (rear) were very nice as well.  We will be back.  Thank you.

Great place and a great location. Quiet and charming neighborhood with just enough good restaurants, bars, and shops to keep you busy. And still close enough to Chicago to get into real trouble. The place itself was quiet and clean, and the beds were super comfortable.

This stay was a tremendously enjoyable experience thanks to host Darsh. From the minute we booked, he went out of his way to ensure that we had all the information necessary to make our stay a good one.
His space was clean and well-stocked with amenities. The location was amazing, well within walking distance of Fulton Market and downtown Chicago.
Darsh was flexible and accommodating. Would 100% stay here again.
Rockstar host with excellent communication!  Place is in a great neighborhood and an easy walk to Wrigley and local train station.

Charles and his wife (plus their dog!) were engaging, thoughtful, and kind. There was plenty of space and when I needed to be alone to write or recharge, the upstairs of the house was quiet.
A good place to stay if you’re coming to North Park or the area!
Great stay! Thank you

Amazing host, had a wonderful experience of staying at the place, the place was easy to find, check-in was simple and effortless. Room and all shared spaces were neat and clean (even though I checked-in early). The host was very accommodating and very responsive.
Kitchen was nicely stacked and there are many small convenience to use, I really like the Iron and the Iron Board :-) .
5 stars from me. Keep up the good work.

We really enjoyed our stay at Danny’s place. The place was clean, well located with adequate street-side parking and large enough for the three of us and our dog. The beds were very comfortable. Debbie, their labradoodle was a welcome friend for Cooper our Golden Doodle. The backyard was certainly a big plus and we enjoyed sitting in the patio behind. All in all it was a very enjoyable stay and we would certainly come back.

Ell was an incredible host! His home was exactly as pictured, and I felt at home the moment I walked in. The beds were comfortable, the bathroom was spacious (love the bidet touch!), and the kitchen was fully stocked with everything I needed. The location is fantastic too — about 10 minutes from downtown Chicago.
My only minor gripe: the shower pressure could be better, and hot water takes a couple minutes to kick in. Beyond that, everything was perfect — highly recommend!

The apartment really is wonderful, and Joe was a lovely host. He was incredibly responsive and extremely thoughtful. The place is beautifully designed and comfortable and well appointed. It is a basement apartment and the entrance is in the back but the apartment is large and very well lit and the entry is well-lit and through a lovely garden. We would definitely stay here again!
Loved the space! Would definitely stay again/plan to!
Great little stay while our home was undergoing renovation. Very responsive hosts.

Perfect for a Cubs game. Just a short walk and two stops away on the Red Line. Lincoln Park is a unique Chicago neighborhood. We enjoyed the zoo, Chicago History Museum, restaurants, and shopping. The place was fantastic and spacious.

Great place, clean, nice area, would stay again!
Excellent host, beautiful place…
Had a great stay, awesome neighborhood easily accessible to the whole city via train. 2 stops from Wrigley!

Amazing stay! Place was very walkable and was huge. Would definitely recommend to all! Great experience.
