We had an absolutely wonderful stay in Chicago and were completely satisfied with everything. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great for exploring the city, and we felt very comfortable throughout our entire stay.
Communication with the host was friendly, easy, and reliable, and everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out.
We would happily stay here again on our next trip to Chicago. 5 out of 5 stars and highly recommended!
Great host

Wir hatten die Unterkunft von James für unseren Start unseres Roadtrip gebucht gehabt. Wir waren für drei Nächte in der Unterkunft und haben uns direkt wohlgefühlt.
Eine wunderbare und mit Liebe eingerichtete Wohnung (man merkt das James gerne Gastgeber ist), in der es an nichts fehlte.
James ist unfassbar nett und hilfsbereit. Wir konnten uns mehrfach immer mal wieder angenehm unterhalten.
Nicht weit weg von der Unterkunft befindet sich ein richtig gut sortierter Supermarkt (Pete‘s Market) wo man alles (und das zu wirklich guten Preisen; selbst die Selbstbedienungstheke für frisch zubereitete Gerichte war super) erhält.
Die Bahnverbindung von der Unterkunft in die Innenstadt war auch topp. Wir sind direkt von der Haltestelle an der Unterkunft (keine 3 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt) innerhalb von knapp 20 Minuten direkt am „Millennium Park“ gewesen. Wir haben uns hierzu eine Tageskarte für 6€, direkt an der Haltestelle gekauft.
Wir würden jederzeit wieder dieses Airbnb buchen.

There is no question that you “get what you pay for”. This listing is designed for those of us on a budget, and so we knew we’d be dealing with shared spaces and you don’t get to choose who you share with. The room lets in light at night, and the doors are loud when they close. You can hear other guests arriving late. We had ear plugs for that. However, the state of the bathrooms (disrepair, hair in drains, one missing a mirror, shared hand towel) is unacceptable. So was whatever is biting at night in the beds, which are probably bed bugs. Sorely disappointed with this listing. It’s only positive is the proximity to the subway system, which is excellent and affordable in Chicago. I wouldn’t recommend.
Our stay was great. We were near the city and with a few steps to Wrigley field. This city is awesome and I look forward to coming back again.
We enjoyed our stay here. Great location and very walkable to great restaurants, shopping and the Damen Blue Line stop.
Great place to stay to catch a game at wrigley! Host was very responsive with any questions or needs we had!
Great location!

Patrizia has a beautiful home that is very clean, comfortable and nicely decorated with some Italian charm.  The bedroom is elegant and overlooks a peaceful yard and garden.  Patrizia was a friendly and gracious host.  I look forward to staying there again when I am in the area.
Great location, comfy bed, and responsive host! The pool and deck were an added bonus!
Had a great time in Wrigleyville. So much to do. Alan our host made things easy. We will definitely be back again!
Thanks for the hospitality

El alojamiento es tal cual como se describe, la zona es tranquila y de fácil acceso. No recomendable para tiempo de calor porque es un sótano y no hay aire acondicionado. Techos un bajos y sin suficientes ventanas. Está limpio y dos cuartos limpios.

El hospedaje fue excelente, el apartamento totalmente nuevo y con artículos de calidad como las sábanas, toallas etc. el baño tenía, shampoo, jabón y acondicionador. La cocina completa con algunas cosas que no es común encontrar como sal, azúcar, café aceite etc
Había jabón de ropa pero no se puede usar la secadora así que igual no se puede lavar. Todo el apartamento con aire acondicionado que funciona perfectamente. La ducha perfecta.
A 5 min de la línea roja, y al tomar el tren a 7 min de centro. Una ubicación muy buena. El edifico super tranquilo. La calle hermosa.
Apartment is beautiful. Beautifully laid out. 10 minute walk to Whole Foods, and close by to lakeview. I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

We had a most enjoyable five night stay in this lovely condo unit.  The condo is elegantly decorated and equipped while also being comfortable.  It has beautiful light from large windows, with a great view from second and third floors of building above its peaceful residential street.  The location is great, close to a pleasant major street with many restaurants, shops, and a nearby transit (elevated) station. We also appreciated Diane's responsiveness with respect to questions, timely check-in information, and flexible early check in.

Very happy with our entire experience- from easy booking, great communication, and a meticulously well kept space. We loved walking everywhere, and being able to come back to a relaxing space at the end of the day. Would recommend time and again!

Overall, we enjoyed our stay with a group of 4. Super close to the green line to get around the city. The apartment did have a slight smell mostly in the entry way of the building and you do hear noise easily being in an older place. Overall, definitely enjoyed our stay.

Mr. Zheng is a really nice person.
He recommended a variety of places to eat.
It was great that the bus stop and Red Line station were nearby.
The room was thoroughly cleaned and very comfortable.
I’d like to stay there again the next time I visit Chicago.
Beautiful airbnb, very convenient location. Ewa could not have been kinder. Very clean and tidy. Only complaint is wifi was spotty—fine for quick searches though.
Beautiful place to stay, really friendly host, and beyond helpful

Super nice host, nice space for us 3 and overall great experience. Walkable to a diner, around 10 minutes and also 20 minute walk to the cubs stadium. One thing is that it had a huge spider at the entrance and can hear baby crying upstairs (though faintly) in the morning but other than that, great! Definitely would come again.
Heidi is a great host!
This was a very nice stay. Great location with many restaurants and stores within walking distance.
The stay was great and the location was fantastic. Antonio was very helpful and responsive.

Photos don't do this place justice. It is SO cute. Diane was so communicative and friendly. It was clear that the hosts go out of their way to make their guests feel welcome with all of the little personal touches that make you feel right at home. I've never had such thoughtful hosts before and I will 100% keep this as my first choice of rental if I find myself back in town.

My husband and I really enjoyed our stay at Humboldt Park loft! The space was clean and peaceful and overall super cute and cozy! We especially enjoyed using the VHS player! (They have a great selection of movies!) Was close enough to the parts of town we wanted to explore but if you’re looking to do things downtown it is a bit of a hike! Otherwise a perfect stay for a quick weekend away!

I had a great stay at Rida’s place. The location was walking distance from restaurants, a few bars and stores to grab small supplies and food. It was an authentic feel of the city so be prepared for the noise of the city, interactive neighborhood and historic feel of the building. Ear plugs were provided but not needed. The bed was so comfortable and the unit was fully equipped with towels and extra blankets if needed. I’d definitely stay again, this was a great visit to Chicago.
Very clean and great location.  Excellent communication!

This is a great place to stay. It has garage parking so that gives peace of mind. The place was very clean, incredibly well stocked, and roomy. Alfredo was easy to reach when needed. I give this place 5 stars.
Nancy

Sheldon was a very kind and accommodating host. I had originally booked the condo for a three-night stay, but upon arrival, I realized that the two flights of stairs would be difficult for my elderly parents. I reached out to Sheldon to ask whether the reservation could be shortened to one night, and he was very understanding and graciously accommodated our request.
The condo itself was beautiful, exceptionally clean, and very well maintained. I truly appreciated Sheldon’s flexibility, responsiveness, and hospitality. I would highly recommend this property to friends and families looking for a comfortable and pleasant stay.
Great host!  Great stay!  Thank you!
Great apartment in excellent location - would recommend
Nice apartment near U of Chicago at a reasonable price. Bed was comfy and the kitchen was well stocked with dishes and cookware. Great instructions and clear communication. Thanks Kim!
Great location - for walking around Logan Square area.  Had everything you might need in the kitchen area. Cute little apartment. Clear instructions and comms - very responsive and accommodating!
The location was about a 15 minute uber ride from everything we wanted to see and do. Nice 3 story building and checking in was easy.
Lage ist Top und wir haben das bekommen was wir erwartet haben. Vielen Dank für die schönen Tage.

Martha’s Airbnb was great. Looked exactly like the pictures.  Martha and her husband walked me through the location and answered all of my questions.  Very quiet neighborhood. Bed and linens were great.  Couldn’t have been happier. Thanks Martha.

Jennifer y Dan.
Gracias por todo. Seguro regresaría a quedarme con ustedes. La zona súper fácil la movilidad en transporte público. Zona segura y buenos restaurantes cercas.
Gracias por todo

Nice vintage building in a very walkable and green neighborhood, staff at front desk super friendly and helpful, close to train and bus stations. However I found the apartment to be not very well maintained and there was mold in the bathroom ceiling and walls. Other than that we had comfortable nights and nice breakfast cooked in the kitchen. So honestly for the price we paid it was a good place to stay. Host was nice and responsive.
Nice place and loved the location next to the lake.
Kavin provided a great and comfortable place to stay. He was available and flexible and communicated all instructions well. Couldn’t have been happier.

Sarah is such a lovely host! She’s so friendly and kind, and exceptionally responsive. (And the chance to meet Bruno was an incredible added bonus! He’s such a gentle sweetie!)
This is absolutely our favorite Airbnb in Chicago. The neighborhood is quiet enough that our reactive dogs remain relatively calm and can go on walks with plenty of space. But it’s close enough to everything we need and want, that it’s super accessible and convenient.
The apartment itself is perfect. Easy access, comfy furniture, and a ton of care and intentionality put into the place.
Of you’re travelling with pets, you will not find a better option. It simply does not exist.
Very walkable with clear instructions for check in! Very clean as well!

Steve was a great host! He was able to accommodate an early check-in and was very responsive  during our stay. Would definitely stay again! I will say, you will need to be mindful of cooking supplies (oil, spices, etc) if you plan to do that.

We had a wonderful time at Kristine’s Airbnb. The house is beautiful, spacious, clean, and had everything we needed for a stay with our toddler. Kristine was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We would love to stay there again!

We had such a great stay at this location. The neighborhood is perfect, very walkable and lots of restaurants and shops. The unit was impeccably clean, well decorated, and much larger than the photos portray! Our hosts were very responsive and very friendly. We would definitely book here again.
A really comfortable, clean and pleasant room in a quiet area, perfect for taking the blue line, I would stay here again

* Read before booking
Evgenii was accommodating and helpful. If you have any questions or requests, Evgenii responded quickly. We appreciate the amazing hospitality. The places matches the description and the pictures.
The location is close to the L (light rail) train if you plan to visit Chicago with public transport.
We were allowed to drop off our luggages since our flight into Chicago was early, and flight out of Chicago was late.
* However I’d like to mention that it’s important to be vigilant around the neighborhood, especially when it’s dark.
I had a great stay here!! Hosts were kind and welcoming. The area was very convenient as well. The apartment was clean and homely, we especially loved all the artwork done by the hosts!
This place was a great location. Easy to walk around the neighborhood.  The beds are comfortable and the rooms have a lot space. We'd definitely stay again.
Appartement fonctionnel pour notre semaine a chicago, la station de métro la plus proche est a une dizaine de minutes à pied. Le quartier est paisible. Je recommande

The place was much more spacious and nicer than we expected. The kitchen was well-equipped, which made it very convenient and comfortable for our family of four. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back again!
Friendly, responsive, place as described, private parking was always available *****, everything you needed for a comfortable stay was provided.
Very spacious, good location, excellent communication and instructions

We had a great stay at Dan’s place. It was easy to get in, very clean and a comfortable stay! It is also a very spacious space. We were in town for a wedding and it was near by our family member’s home so we would definitely select this place to stay again!

El apartamento es tal cual las fotos, Auroom estuvo al pendiente y contestaba muy rápido, tiene las amenidades que indica y todo el proceso es muy bueno y claro, desde antes de la llegada fueron muy precisos en los tiempos. Tiene acceso a dos líneas del metro la azul y la verde, la cual es muy accesible para llegar al centro, no hay ruido por las noches, y el descanso es bueno. Lo único por lo que no lo califico con 5 es por qué la zona no cuenta con centros comerciales para adquirir comida o agua, ni locales de comida o similares, así mismo, tuvimos una mala experiencia y unas vecinas nos orientaron para poder cuidarnos ya que la zona de un lado es insegura, así que debes saber a dónde ir, cabe aclarar que es una parte de la colonia, y el camino al metro es más seguro, en eso también nos orientó Auroom

I highly recommend!! Excellent Communication!! Our host was very responsive and proactive prior to our arrival and during are entire stay. All the necessary information was provided well ahead of time to make our check in as seamless as possible!  Everything was provided to make our stay comfortable and enjoyable!  We have a trip planned next year for Chicago and plan to stay here during our visit!!
Great spot for one! Clean place. Area is very walkable, and central if you know about Chicago you know you want to be in or around Hyde Park for the real city feel.

Solid value for a shared space. I was here for a wedding and long extended wedding. Everything was as described - beautiful common areas and kitchen and location is great close to transit & local neighborhood spots while being a peaceful quiet street. Recommend this place and host was great.

We had a great stay! The room was spacious and comfortable, and towels were provided. The location was also very convenient: it’s not too far from downtown, and both the Green Line and the CTA Blue Line, which takes you directly to the airport, are very close by. The price was also very affordable, especially considering the prices in Chicago.
Adriana and Alex were incredibly kind and welcoming throughout our stay. They were always willing to help and give us great recommendations about places to visit and things to do. We really appreciated their hospitality and would definitely recommend staying here!🥰

We were visiting our old neighborhood and Gerrit’s place was a perfect location. We could easily walk to restaurants in Andersonville and little Vietnam. We were warned that parking was difficult but only a problem with that once. Gerrit allowed us to park in his spot that one time. The apartment was spacious but we would have liked the lighting to be brighter, a small complaint to be sure.
We really like the area, close to the bus stop and shops. The place was very clean and nice.
Enjoyable stay.

La casa de Jane fue, sin duda, uno de los grandes aciertos de nuestra visita a Chicago. Está ubicada en una zona preciosa, tranquila y muy agradable, rodeada de excelentes restaurantes, tiendas y todo lo necesario para disfrutar de la ciudad.
El apartamento es encantador, acogedor y está cuidadosamente equipado para hacer de la estancia una experiencia realmente cómoda. La cama es maravillosa y la ducha, perfecta para relajarse después de un día explorando Chicago.
Queremos agradecer especialmente a Jane por sus encantadores detalles de bienvenida: un delicioso brownie orgánico, vino y cerveza. Nos hubiera encantado tener un poco más de tiempo para disfrutarlos, pero tendremos una buena excusa para volver. 😊
Jane, también dejamos unos quesos con berries en la nevera. Esperamos que los disfrutes como un pequeño detalle de nuestra parte. ❤️
Ha sido una experiencia maravillosa de principio a fin. Un lugar que recomendamos sin dudar y al que esperamos regresar. 10/10.

Steve’s penthouse was perfect for my brother and me. We were in town for a concert and a couple of Cubs games, and the location couldn’t have been better. It’s close to DePaul and within walking distance of Wrigley Field. The location and the view from the rooftop patio were definitely the highlights.
Steve and Mary were incredibly kind and welcoming hosts. The penthouse was the peaceful retreat we needed after spending the day exploring the city. We really enjoyed our stay and would happily stay here again!
We would most likely stay again!

Isabel's place is just as described and shown in the pictures. There were no surprises...well, except for the above average amenities! :-) The location, just a block from the Blue Line "L" (and bus stop), was very handy for getting into downtown. The instructions and communication were super. When the TV remote batteries died she got the issue resolved super quick. The place itself was clean and comfortable with every amenity one could ask for (except maybe a pair of scissors). Having the ALDI nearby was awesome too.
I got to meet Isabel in person and we had such a lovely chat. Lovely place, lovely host. Thank you Isabel!

It was my first time renting an Airbnb, so I was a little nervous about what might happen. However, Laura's place felt like home; it was really comfortable and had all the amenities I needed. Laura is definitely an excellent host.
Good stay, clean flat and room in a very walkable location also near loads of public transportation too
Great location!
Heel mooi hotel op super locatie.ol voor ons verblijf alleen wat prijzig ivm grote beurs in Chicago waardoor de prijzen hoger waren die week (voor alle hotels)

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour chez Anjali ! Le logement est propre, joliement décoré et très bien équipé. Le quartier nous a beaucoup plu et il est facile d’utiliser le transport en commun ou le vélo pour se déplacer. Je recommande fortement l’appartement d’Anjali ☺️.
First time at Chicago and was wonderful. The place was perfect because it’s close to public transport. A lot of space and clean

The neighborhood was nice and quiet . Parking was the only me and my family had due to limited parking space on the property and street. Sarah is an amazing host , she checked- in and made sure we were doing well after check -in .
Great space, excellent value, friendly and responsive hosts. I had a great experience and hope to stay here again. Five stars!
A great place to stay for the area and price!
Very nice place to stay for visiting Chicago. Convenient to Wrigley field and downtown Chicago. the unit we stayed in was very nice and clean.
A PERFECT spot for attending Cubs games!
Charles was very quick to respond and informative. His Airbnb is as depicted in his pictures. It was an enjoyable experience and I do not have any feedback or concerns. Thanks Charles.

Central location to 2 main bus lines and a ten minute walk to the Orange Line. Bang for your buck if you aren't spending much time indoors. If you're frequenting Pilsen or other areas of the South Side, a great alternative to a hotel!

Great location for a quick weekend away. Good restaurants and bars nearby. Wet safe area.
I will stay here again.

Alma’s place was perfect for our time in Chicago visiting our daughter. It is in a great location with restaurants and public transportation close by ! Only a mile walk to the lake. We will definitely stay there again!

Great unit, spacious and well furnished with comfortable and aesthetic living spaces. Bed is comfy and the office room has a great set up if you're planning to work. Noel is a fantastic host -- very communicative and was quick to answer any questions or requests we had. If you want to be in Pilsen, this is a great spot.
Stay was great!!
I had an excellent time during my stay. A lovely location. Clean apartment. Responsive hosts. I would certainly come back again.
David was a great host, always responsive and gave fantastic recommendations for local eats and for ways to navigate the city!

Wir waren sehr zufrieden und buchen jederzeit gerne wieder. Gute, ruhige Wohngegend.
Gastgebern zuvorkommend und jederzeit erreichbar.

What a find! The coach house was absolutely perfect. Two blocks to the train and quick ride right to downtown. The decor inside was perfect and a really cool mid century theme. Very comfortable beds! The hosts even provided bottled water and snacks! Very private location and very secure. Can't recommend the Polk St Coach house enough.
Great location, great host, comfy beds, plenty of space.  We would definitely stay again!

This is one of the best Bnb experiences we've ever had; we were there for eight days and honestly our stay couldn't have been much better. Victoria was an incredibly thoughtful host, and extremely accommodating to our specific questions and requests. The whole space, from bed to living room, was extremely comfortable to be in. We also tend to cook a lot and the kitchen was set up perfectly.
And we absolutely loved the neighborhood! Pilsen is utterly charming, good local groceries and restaurants. Next time we're in Chicago, this is absolutely where we want to come back to. Thanks so much for having us.

Darryl’s apartment is spacious, very well decorated and very comfortable. He was an extremely responsive host. The location is perfect for visiting the Obama Center and the University of Chicago, and is also easily accessible to downtown Chicago.
We enjoyed our stay and look forward to return visits.
The apartment was beautiful & in a convenient location, just beware of street noise. I would book here again!
It was perfect for what we needed and a great location!
Muy buen lugar muy cerca de la U de Chicago
Great place to stay, we had everything we needed, it was calm and quiet at night and really close to public transport.
Great stay. Just what we were looking for!
Good place to stay for a short trip . Parking becomes a problem but can be manageable
Beautiful property in an energetic neighborhood with easy access to public transportation. Absolutely perfect for our family reunion for ages 3-70.

I stayed at Warwick Allerton Hotel for my first trip to Chicago and I was not disappointed. I loved the room we got, all the employees were so nice and helpful and the location was perfect. I would definitely book this place again. 10/10 totally recommend 👌🏼
Great value with excellent access to downtown

Great location, our son lives a couple blocks away. Very convenient for the brown line and walking to wrigley stadium. Comfortable bed and pillows, very room interior for 2. Window air conditioning was a nice plus. Our only issue was a slow(very slow) draining shower drain.
Place was very pristine. The layout was great.  Was right next to a great coffee shop.
Nice place to stay!
Victor was very responsive
We had a great stay. Host’s communication was excellent, the location was clean and had ample space.
Really great place to stay! Conveniently located with lots of shops, restaurants, and bus stops nearby. Nicole was great and very helpful with all of our questions. We had a great time!

Ben's place was accurate to the listing description and extremely clean. The beds were comfortable and we all slept really well. Having a kitchen and also in unit washer/dryer was very convenient. The view was also beautiful. You can hear the sound of the metro going by but that didn't bother us. We would stay here again if we visit chicago again in the future!

Beware! This hotel is on Michigan Ave. The noise at night from cars was horrible, even from the 8th floor. It can go well past midnight on some evenings. With that said, you are in the middle of everything! Easy access to shopping, sightseeing, restaurants, and more!
The front desk staff were very personable and friendly. We did have a few problems with housekeeping. The empty tissue box was not replaced, the faulty lotion dispenser was not replaced, our room and towels were not refreshed on two days of our stay. We told the front desk of these issues when they first occurred and sometimes they had to remind housekeeping.
Our first night there, we noticed the telephone in the room did not work as well as a bed lamp. They immediately sent a maintenance person to the room, which we appreciated.
Overall, the stay was good. The location makes touring very convenient and walkable.

My husband and I attended the University of Chicago and our daughter is also an alum, so we are very familiar with Hyde Park and its older apartment buildings. This is a very comfortable studio on a quiet street, conveniently located near restaurants, shopping and transportation downtown. We stayed here for our daughter’s wedding and were very comfortable. One evening, the upstairs neighbor had a plumbing issue and water began dripping into our bathroom through the light fixture. Iris was incredibly responsive and had maintenance there within an hour, even though it was 9:30 at night. One watchout for those unfamiliar with Hyde Park: many of the buildings are charming but old. The lobby and stairwell here are quite worn, with chipped paint and scuffs, and don’t make the best first impression. However, once we reached our floor, everything was clean and well kept, and the apartment itself was clean, comfortable and welcoming, but not elegant.  I would stay here again.

Easy to get in with clear instructions. Street was quiet and the house was easy to find. Bed was pretty comfortable and the owner provided 2 towels for me.
I was told that there was a full size mirror in the bedroom but there was not. The room he upgraded for free was big and decent. However, the bathroom was pretty dirty and the kitchen was kind of dirty as well. I did not want to put down any of my stuff in the shower or bathroom sink. In general, the house was not clean at all. On the first day, I found that there was no hand soap in the bathroom, so I had to message the owner, and the cleaner filled it in the next day afternoon.
I am not sure if I will stay again because of the cleanliness issue.
Great place and loved the neighborhood! Brad was helpful and very responsive. Definitely check out the local restaurants.  Would stay here again.

The Airbnb was exactly as advertised and in a perfect location to walk to Wrigley. Tony was an incredible host, and questions before and during our stay were answered promptly. Overall a truly great experience and I will rebook if I ever go to a Cubs game again with a larger group.
Todo excelente!!
Super Location, schöne Terrasse mit guten Boxen und mit Gas Feuerstelle. Großzügige Badezimmer und gute Schlafräume. Immer wieder gerne. Danke Shawn für die coole Zeit.
It was a nice place, located on the second floor. The host responded in a reasonable amount of time. I would rent it again.

If you are looking for a pet-friendly place close to Wrigley Field, you can't go wrong with Kimberly's place! We came into town for a Cubs game and brought our two dogs with us. There were home games every night we were there and we never struggled to find appropriate parking, but if you aren't familiar with the area, be aware of the restrictions during games/events at Wrigley.
It is extremely walkable with great coffee shops nearby. We didn't take public transit but it would have been very accessible to use. The apartment itself was cozy and we had all the amenities we needed. It is an apartment building so there is some ambient noise from the neighbors but it was never an issue during our stay. We absolutely plan to stay again!

We had a great stay! The host was very responsive and checked in with us a few times throughout our stay, which we really appreciated. The Airbnb was clean and comfortable, with great air conditioning, good water pressure, and plenty of extra towels.
The location was also a major plus, it was very convenient to public transportation and close to everything we had planned during our stay. The surrounding neighborhood was also nice and felt very comfortable.
Overall, we had a very positive experience and would definitely recommend staying here.

We enjoyed our stay at Jeff's place while in Chicago as the first leg of our cross country road trip. Parking is on the street and we found convenient parking near the house each day. The space was very clean with all basic necessities.  The bed was super comfortable. We were very comfortable during our stay and would stay again in the future.
Great location near public transit. Close to the Fulton Market District with some of the best restaurants in Chicago.
Excelente lugar para dormir cada vez que vengas a Chicago, la anfitrión fue muy amable y atenta, sin duda volvería.

Great location for exploring the city!! Paul was an excellent host, very accommodating for an early check in and late check out. There were some necessities missing from the place but Paul got us what we needed when we reached out.
Jasmine was responsive and a great host. It was a perfect place to stay and catch a few games with the boys at wrigley field. Just a short walk to the station. The parking spot was a big perk also.
I had a very nice time during my stay here! Both Ming and Fiona were very nice! Will probably return soon!!
Alina's place is a short easy walk to Old Town, the brown line, and multiple bus routes. The neighbourhood is beautiful too and great for a quiet stroll at any time of day.
We had a great time and we were well accommodated!! Thankful for our stay in this beautiful neighborhood!
Great place to stay that is close to downtown without paying for downtown!
Ari’s place is wonderful and well located! Everything was clean and well kept. Beds were comfy and we felt like we had a great home base during our trip to chicago. Would come stay again!

This Gold Coast unit is in an excellent location and is excellently appointed. The kitchen was massive and had everything you would need to cook. The bedrooms had comfortable mattresses, and the internet speed was good. The original brickwork matched with the modern renovated feel made me feel very at home. The spiral staircase gave a nice accent and helped transition the space to the second bedroom area and included laundry. There were plenty of large TVs throughout and the place was spotless. You were a few short blocks from restaurants like Pizano’s and Kerryman, and there were many more to explore! I was able to walk to a nearby pharmacy. The sites and places you want to visit as a tourist were all nearby. Highly recommend!

Nous remercions Sergio pour ses services. Il a été extrêmement réactif et nous a permis de passer un excellent séjour à Chicago.
Nous recommandons si l'intêret des voyageurs et de profiter en ville et d'économiser de l'argent sur le logement!

This was our first trip to Chicago. We were there for some business meetings. It was so nice to come back to Nicole and Matt's home after a long day of meetings and be able to relax. The home is super cozy and comfortable. The beds are amazing. Honestly, I've stayed at some 4-5 star hotels that were not even half as organized, clean, and cozy as this home. We will definitely stay here again.

My dad and I had an excellent 7 night and day trip to Chicago, and we both were very comfortable in this beautiful accommodation!
Super-clean & cozy space; walkable, safe and convenient neighborhood.
Would recommend highly to anyone visiting Chicago.
Thank you!

We had a great stay and really enjoyed the space and it was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The home was spacious, well-equipped, and the little thoughtful touches made the stay even better. The location was convenient for getting around Chicago, and having garage parking was a huge plus. Noemi was a wonderful and responsive host, and we would definitely stay here again!

Jose's place was as advertised.  It was clean and comfortable.  The back patio was very nice to sit and enjoy the Chicago fall weather.  If you looking for a clean, nice place to stay I suggest renting his place.
We enjoyed our stay at Joe’s. Nice location. Clean and comfortable. He was very responsive and helpful. Thanks!
Great place! Clean and comfortable, awesome location!

The main door lock stopped working at 9PM and the back door lock was out of battery. They had to call the locksmith since they don't own a physical key and tried to get me to pay for the locksmith. When I indicated being frustrated because we were locked out of the airbnb till 11. Nico told me "it's okay, I'm frustrated too"
Also the bedding smelled moldy and weird and the fan didn't work. The Airbnb was good for the price but the management was very unprofessional and the lock issue was very bad.
War ein toller Aufenthalt. Die Kommunikation mit Jevaux war perfekt. Die Lage ins Zentrum ist gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zur erreichen. Ich empfehle die Ventra  App zu benutzen.

This place is really special. You can tell that there was a lot of thoughtfulness when decorating and making this space a true experience.
We travelled with our 2 year old and it was easy to take the train from ORD to the bus to the house. Easy getting to Wrigley and around the city.
Beds were comfortable and the bathroom was luxurious. The fridge was stocked with beverages which was so nice. Also, the candy machine was like the highlight for a 2 year old. He nicknamed the house, “the candy house.”
My one mention is that if you are a light sleeper this might not be the spot for you as you’re sharing a building with multiple families so you can hear footsteps, especially on the Murphy bed at night. They do provide sound machines by both beds so that does help.
All in all, this is a really great spot.

Our stay here was lovely! We loved being able to walk to see many restaurants and the neighborhood was super peaceful. Very clean and decorated so cute! Will definitely put this in our stay again list in Chicago!!
Super communicative; all amenities; easy check-in and check-out. Clean apartment and clean building overall.
Everything was perfect. Steve was super responsive, gave local recommendations, and was flexible with our travel plans.
The place was beautiful and comfortable, and it was in a great spot to be able to just walk out the door and explore the city.
This is an amazing Airbnb and location. Reed was a wonderful host and we would be honored to stay again on our return to Wrigleyville.

Thank you Emily for a great stay!  We booked this condo for family visiting Chicago for the first time and they really loved it.  They said it felt "very Chicago."  The kitchen was one of the best equipped of anywhere we have stayed.  Emily was so responsive.  Highly recommend for family who want that "Chicago" feel with a bit more peace and quiet of the neighborhood.
Excelente

Beautiful apartment with an amazing city view! The space was clean, comfortable, and looked just like the photos. Waking up and seeing the skyline was definitely one of the highlights of the stay. Great location, easy check-in, and overall a really enjoyable experience. Would definitely stay here again! 10/10!
The place was nice and host communicated well.

Jevaux was a great host and the place is super nice for a short stay! It looked exactly like the photos and it was really clean. Jevaux is very communicative and kind, and responded quickly every time. We really enjoyed staying here!

Gogo was very friendly and responsive throughout our stay. The apartment is a beautiful space with a modern kitchen and a lovely bathroom. It was easy to find and access, and the location was excellent.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would certainly consider staying here again!
Love the place very clean quite Close two everything host was amazing person
Very pleasant stay.  Clean, organized.  It was nice to walk to the Pullman visitor center.  Easy uber ride to Obama Presidential Center.
The location is everything.
I had a great time, the neighborhood is beautiful.
Amazing location, easy to get to places as well. Host was super responsive and always helpful, thank you for the lovely time!
Clean and spacious unit in a good area, not too far from downtown. Would stay again!
Beautiful room, house, and neighborhood. Eduardo and Lois are exceptionally welcoming and kind hosts. I strongly recommend staying here!

The condo was as described, clean with a beautiful kitchen and eclectic decor that went well together. The bathrooms were clean and the bedroom was comfortable and convenient…one positive was I needed to put eyelashes on and she had a lighted magnifying mirror! What luck.
What made us take pause was the surrounding area the neighborhood seemed worn down in some spots. To make things feel safe the condo had a security system that we could use and we did utilize that service.
We were close to the Obama Presidential Museum and that was one of the highlights and important part of our trip.
Diane was kind and definitely went out of her way to make the experience good. No complaints at all about the condo or our host. I appreciated her hospitality.

Great location, especially for convention visitors. It’s within easy walking distance of the convention center, with plenty of restaurants and food options nearby. It’s also very convenient for getting to downtown. Overall, a great place to stay.

Fantastic location for spending a night, a long weekend, or more in Chi-Town! Neighborhood was delightfully walkable, with cafes and shops just around the block, and a short walk north to even more businesses alongside the DePaul University campus. Brown, purple, and red lines stop within blocks, giving you easy, direct access to O'Hare (1 transfer) and most of the favorite sights of the city. Unit is garden (basement) level, so not ideal for folks who need easy access. Beds were firm, but comfortable.
Furnishings were weary and grubby, and we discovered that the mattress covers were stained and damaged upon clearing bed linens for checkout. Bathroom has no exhaust fan, so moisture doesn't clear well, with condensation starting to damage walls and fixtures. Shower head is beneath a sofiftted area of the shower, with clearance just around 6', so tall folks will have to stoop or lean to shower.
Love the location, would love the interior with a thoughtful refresh.

This property was very clean. Host was very friendly and made me and my fiancée feel right at home. This property was a 10/10. The host had everything we needed in the home. We will be renting this property again.

We really enjoyed our stay  at Tracee's condo in the Ukrainian Village. The place was very clean, the beds were comfortable, great air conditioning and a kitchen with everything you need to make a meal if you so desire. The location was great, walkable to a lot of good restaurants and a just a quick Uber to downtown. Communication with the host was excellent.

Dean's place was beautiful. Very clean, and perfect for my lil family of 3. We made home cooked meals, and enjoyed the ambiance. Would suggest bringing an air mattress if you plan to sleep on the day bed in the living room, because that day bed is really firm and not all that long. All in all, great place and would definitely return!

Last minute booking and very happy.  The home was just a pictures show. Smelled clean and fresh. The bed was comfortable, hot shower /water and the neighborhood was great. Had hamburgers across the street at The Region were very delicious. Stopped at Four Moon Tavern was a chill local bar and pizza at Bartoli’s was very good but a further walk. We walked to Wrigley for a game and would definitely stay here again.

My husband and I went to Chicago from STL to see Bikini Kill play at the Salt Shed. The PPIM museum was on a short list to do and I'm grateful we decided to stay af the apartment! We had such a great time listening to records, enjoying the QR code Youtube stories, art, and artifacts. Leave a note on the typewriter - like how we accidentally broke into the museum - oops! We had a wonderful time at the museum downstairs meeting Martin and his staff. He is one hell of a story teller!
You absolutely must go to Shinya Ramen House for a late night snack. Overall, the PPIM apartment is a must stay for the music enthusiast. It's hard not to geek out about all of the musicians who have stayed there! We look forward to coming back again!

Mia’s home is beautiful, comfortable, clean and very well appointed. She quickly responded to our same day request for a stay. She is extremely timely, kind and thoughtful in her responses.  We felt safe here and it was very quiet.   Extremely clean and uncluttered.   We would definitely stay in this property again.   Mia is an exemplary host!
Great location really nice and comfortable.
Walking distance from McCormick clean rooms any questions answered quickly

Such a great place to stay! Parking was super easy and nice and the rooms were huge!!!!! I would definitely stay here again! The host is also super nice and helpful and responds so quickly to all questions!!!
Cómodo, limpio y bonito. Experiencia agradable.
We stayed here to go see at concert at the salt shed. It was a great spot in a great neighborhood. Would stay here again.
was a beautiful and spacious unit! The host was extremely helpful and responsive. Will be recommending to anyone visiting chicago!
Жилье приятно удивило! Все соответствует описанию. Очень чисто и современно. Заселились легко, хозяева всегда были на связи. Очень рекомендую!

We really enjoyed our stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and had really pretty wall decor. We especially loved the layout of the second room with the gaming chair and two mirrors. The neighborhood was nice and peaceful, and the location was PERFECT, literally less than 10 minutes away from pretty much everything food wise. The only downsides were some dirt under the bed, a few stained towels, and the outdoor area. There were sooo many bugs outside, but with all the trees around, that’s probably expected . The outside could use a little improvement & the door could use some adjusting, but the inside definitely makes up for it. Overall, we really enjoyed the stay and would recommend it!
Great location and property already booked a second trip!
Really convenient and efficient!
Great location! Walking distance to Wrigley.
Roomy and clean apartment in a great location near the Loyola campus, Red Line, and West Devon restaurants. Marijes was very responsive and helpful. Would return if possible next time I visit.

Clean and cozy place. 2 minutes walk to the train station, but no train noise at all. Walkable distance for cafes and restaurants. Have all 'home' essentials. Parking is a bit of a hassle if you have a car with you. Finding a spot that let you park for a longer time can be tricky. Next block has more spots for parking, but read the signs, there are 'street cleaning' fine of $60 if you have your car parked there on the designated cleaning time. Otherwise, it is perfect area.

Came in town to DJ a wedding and Stephen’s place was perfect for my friend and I. We loved the location, great neighborhood, very quiet and walkable. The place itself was very clean and Stephen is very accommodating. I would and will definitely stay here again when I’m back in town. 🙌🏽

The place was just as pictured - A great space for 4 people! Beds were comfy, pillows were nice! The only issue is the noise of those above. They do provide ear plugs, which is nice, it just didn’t help. Sadly the upstairs neighbors start early and go late. However, if this doesn’t bother you, then I’d recommend this Airbnb

Very pleased with the location and the host was extremely communicative and helpful. Street noise was not too disruptive during weeknights. Space was clean, neat, and a perfect location for bars and baseball games.
The beds were super comfy.  had a great night sleep, they had dark curtains which was nice, blocking the sun light.  Kitchen was fine, would be nice if they had some cups for tea or coffee.
Bianca was very attentive and she asking all my questions. Thank you for hosting us.
Great location and accessibility to the city and airport via bus and train. Marissa was also very friendly and helpful with all of our questions.

Norma’s place was wonderful . Clean, comfortable and close to everything we needed. It was a short train ride downtown and tons of local food options close by. The chicken downstairs was fantastic too! As others noted the front bedroom does face a busy street so it had quite a bit of noise but there was a sound machine provided on the night stand which helped and I wasn’t bothered by it much, however, someone more sensitive to that type of thing might be. Overall  we really enjoyed our stay and would  book again on our next trip to Chicago.
Very comfortable house. Loved the outdoor areas. Plenty of spaces to relax.
Beautiful,  well kept and well appointed lodging. We enjoyed our stay very much.

We had a lovely stay at A’isha’s place. A beautiful, quiet stay that was also very walkable to shops, restaurants and also Wrigley Field. The unit had everything you could think of and was wonderful to relax in the evening after a long day of sight seeing. Parking was a breeze, the neighborhood was very safe and family friendly. We cannot wait to stay again in this charming home away from home.

Loved our stay. Everything was easy to get to and walkable. Recommend paying extra for the garage so you don’t need to drive around and can just leave your car there. Place was clean, everything we needed was supplied, really felt like a Chicago vibe.
The apartment was very clean and quiet. Good location, not far from Logan Square. I would stay here again!

Everything was great here. Short walk to train, restaurants, cafes, and bars. Access to washer/dryer was ideal. Coffee maker and coffee provided was very nice. We felt safe and secure. We were a little surprised it was a basement unit, but that goes along with the very affordable price.

The place is fantastic on the inside. Everything was there for a comfortable stay and the water was a nice welcoming touch at the beginning. Responses were very quick between myself and the host. Check in and out are really flexible, as long as the person communicates with the host.
Thanks it was great!

I have nothing to complaint about. Maybe the wifi problems we had some days. But everything was as described and the location is something you don't find in other options.
I really liked the view from the balcony and don't pay attention to the bad reviews, the team was responsive and accommodating if you are a reasonable person
airbnb was spacious and had everything you needed. it’s very close to the bus and metro stations but will take 30-40 minutes to get downtown.

This was my best experience in Chicago so far and Taher was an EXCELLENT host. Not only was he very accommodating and responsive to any questions or concerns that I had, but he offered assistance above and beyond what I would've expected. I came with my mom and two family friends and we had a ton of fun and a HUGE part of it was staying at Taher's property. PERFECT LOCATION, close to everything, very clean and comfortable. Highly recommend staying at Taher's place and highly recommend Taher as a host.

Jacob, our host, was slow in responding to us, which was frustrating. The house was not well-maintained, with many corners needing attention. Additionally, we were alarmed to see a random person entering the garage in the early morning without prior notice. However, Jacob was friendly and cheerful throughout our visit, promptly answering our questions and greeting us warmly. The property was spacious and well-equipped, and there was easy parking available, which was convenient for travelers with vehicles. Overall, while the host’s friendliness and the spacious indoor area were positives, there were significant issues that need improvement.

Afsha’s place was immaculate!! Close enough to some great bars and restaurants, and public transportation right out the front door . The place was clean and cool and I’d most definitely stay here again .
Ian’s place was a cozy stay on a quiet street, a nice getaway from touring the city during the day. Beds were comfy and the house was very clean. About a 10 min walk to the train station.

Great spacious apartment for a family of 4.  Friendly & responsive hosts. Perfect location for exploring downtown Chicago on foot. Comfy beds and all the amenities we needed. Thanks - we would stay again!
Will definitely stay here again!!
The place was spacious, clean and had tons of light. It was perfect. The hosts were so kind and accommodating. Would definitely stay here again!

Great place to stay! Parking was a little hard to find, lots of ‘one way’ streets so depending on what directions you’re coming from turn right on N Whipple St, left on W Cullom Ave, then left on N Mozart St and you’ll see the white building to turn left in for the parking space behind the building. The place looked just like the photos and was nice and clean. Air conditioner worked great. Good location!

El alojamiento es tal cual se describe en las fotos, podría decir incluso que las prestaciones son mejores de lo que se ve en ellas. El baño está adentro de la misma habitación, y yo había entendido que era un baño privado para la habitación, pero que estaba afuera de ella, así que eso fue una gran ventaja. Teníamos todo lo necesario para nuestra estadía: en la cocina hasta teníamos para calentar agua para el mate (excelente punto si sos argentino o uruguayo).
El alojamiento está bien conectado a todo Chicago por buses y metros, y caminando, y en la zona hay a un par de cuadras un supermercado en el que nos podíamos abastecer de lo necesario.
Todo estaba limpio, ordenado.
El self check in un lujo, en nuestro caso entramos a la madrugada por nuestro vuelo y pudimos acceder en segundos, todas las instrucciones claras. Además, Denise siempre estuvo atenta a si habíamos llegado bien y demás.
Sin duda alguna, de volver a Chicago, volveríamos a alojarnos aquí.
Very very nice home! The host is very kind, responsive and accommodating. The house is probably one of the coolest I’ve stayed in so far. So many amazing amenities throughout the home!

La unica pega que le pongo al alojamiento es que no tiene mesa ni sillas, tuvimos que desayunar sentados en el suelo todos los dias.
Por lo demas todo bastante correcto.
A great space.  Great restaurants and bars around.  Very close to wrigley and fell in love with the scooters around!  Would stay here again when I come back to Chicago!

Had a wonderful stay.  Nice neighborhood, easy walk to Lincoln Square and train.   It is eclectic as described which was fun. Main room very comfortable and spacious.  The gifts Tara left were much appreciated.

What a wonderful find! I am a former AirBnb host and my standards are high when it comes to space design, comfort, hospitality and cleanliness. I also know how much work it is to create a great guest experience. So having said that, this was a perfect place to stay while spending time with my daughters in Chicago. It is a charming suite with thoughtful decor. It had everything you might need or want in the kitchen. The furniture and bed were perfectly comfortable. The space is spotless and smells very pleasant with no overwhelming cleaning products or air fresheners. It is conveniently located near the train, a great coffee shop (Backlot) and more. I was especially pleased by the inclusion of a Tesla charger — which made getting around Chicago and checking out in the morning so much more convenient. Just being able to charge and go is wonderful. Hosts were extremely responsive, friendly and helpful. We will definitely be back soon!

Wir haben zu zweit 4 Nächte in der Wohnung verbracht. Die Lage ist perfekt, wenn man ohne Auto Chicago besucht. Die Wohnung ist sehr gemütlich und die Betten bequem. Es ist ein altes Haus mit viel Charme und man fühlt sich sofort angekommen. Die Küchenausstattung ist allumfassend. Ich empfehle diese Unterkunft weiter. Romana war die ganzen Tage jederzeit ansprechbar.
Vielen lieben Dank dafür.
Awesome place! Would stay again
We really enjoyed our stay. The space was clean and comfortable and felt safe. Jorge was responsive and friendly. We would recommend this place to others.
Sarah was incredibly accommodating and responsive. The stay was clean and comfortable. Very private and easy access to downtown. Would definitely stay here again.
Very clean and some neat places nearby!
Pretty good place if you’re okay with sharing space with strangers
Love the place it was beautiful and homey highly recommend
We enjoyed our stay at Brendan’s place.  Good food at the Wolfhound and not too far to Wrigley Field.

I booked Rafael’s place for my parents, and it was fantastic. The location is ideal and very close to the 'L' train, making it easy to explore Chicago, and surrounded by great restaurants and supermarkets. The area is quiet and safe, the facilities are in great shape, and Rafael's communication was prompt and helpful throughout. Highly recommended!

Honestly an amazing stay. Melany was super responsive right off the bat and accommodated our early arrival. She had answers when we had questions and the apartment is exactly as described.  Thank you so much!!
Good place overall, clean and comfortable. The main issue was the sound insulation, as noise from outside the room could be heard quite clearly. Better soundproofing would improve the stay a lot.
Good price for a great location. The hospitality was amazing, the bread was very kind.
Beautiful place in an amazing location with anything you want within a very short walk!!!

Jhon was amazing and responds fast. I had an issue with the bathtub and it was fixed the next day. The place is in a nice, walkable location. The only thing I would say that made it a bit difficult was the stairs, there’s no elevator so we had to carry all of our luggage for the 2 flights of stairs. Also, with me being from New York, the train noise didn’t bother me as much.
Great location and amazing amenities. Unit was perfect for our group of seven.
Great location for a Cubs game!

Extremely friendly and hospitable.  Parking in the area is pretty accessible, and with plenty of rapid transit options in the Chicago area,  you can pretty much park it and leave it.   We'd definitely stay again.

Staying here made my time in Chicago truly wonderful.
The room was very clean, the bed was incredibly spacious, and everything I needed was provided. It was such a comfortable and cozy place to stay.
The host was incredibly kind and helpful. I needed to ask about adjusting the check-in and check-out times to accommodate my flight schedule, and they were so understanding and accommodating.
I would definitely stay here again the next time I visit Chicago!
La estancia estuvo muy bien, estaba cerca de la zona turística de Chicago, sin duda volvería ☺️
Nice place and nice people, close to public transportation, plenty of food options nearby.  Would stay here again for sure

This was our first trip to America, and staying here made our experience even more special! The Airbnb was exactly what we had imagined a typical American home to be like, and we absolutely loved it.
We felt comfortable from the very beginning and truly felt at home during our stay. Everything was wonderful, and we were genuinely sad to leave.
We would absolutely stay here again and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. It was the perfect home away from home for our first American adventure! 🇺🇸❤️
Thank you so much for having us!

This was a wonderful stay! The place had plenty of space for a large group and was very family friendly (including a full basement and play areas). We had all the amenities we needed. The furnishings were very comfortable, and the beds were some of the best. Dan was very responsiveness throughout the whole process. It was very close to the O’Hare airport, and parking was easy. We would definitely stay here again!
Good value, cheap airbnb. Close to blue line

What a great place to stay that exceed all of our expectations! Lots of space, super comfortable, and very homey feeling! The outside space was spacious, very private, and charming!
Yakini, our host, was incredibly friendly and greeted us with a little tour of the house and the beautiful art that fills the space.
We had an absolutely wonderful stay and can’t wait to come back!
Great place easy access!

Cute spot! It was very clean, all the basics for a quick trip. Great location, easy to get around Chicago from there and Julian gave very easy clear instructions for getting in. The only thing to be aware of was the noise. Because this is a basement unit on the street corner & right by the front gate, you can hear everything going on outside and neighbors. It does quiet down by bedtime though! Overall would recommend if you don’t mind a little noise during the day time.
Estadia perfeita; recepção impecável. Nos sentimos em um hotel, tamanho cuidado e conforto proporcionado pelos anfitriões

The place was quiet, and the parking was very convenient. The room itself was clean, and the photos looked very bright, so I didn’t realize beforehand that it was a semi-basement unit. On the first day, two of the lights were not working. There was also no body wash provided. Another issue was that the bedding seemed to shed a lot of lint/fibers, and the bath towels did as well. Overall, the stay was fine, but I think it would be helpful to mention clearly in the listing that the unit is semi-basement and to improve some of the amenities and linens.

I recommend this place to anyone looking for a great neighborhood and comfortable place as home base. The size was perfect for us; myself and son & daughter-in-law. It was a 10 minute walk to the EL which made it easy to get anywhere in the city. Including to and from the airport. The neighborhood is full of fantastic restaurants and bars, also all walkable. Monteverde is right next door and a fantastic restaurant. We didn’t find the unit too noisy and were able to settle in quite nicely.
The hosts were responsive to all our questions and provide a stylish, comfortable option for a place to stay.

Great location, if you are driving then you are close by to all the common tourist places. Parking was easy to find within a reasonable proximity even at late hours. Felt safe in this area to walk even at night. Accommodations were great, very updated and has all the things you would want such as extra towels which is always a plus. Great place and price, would recommend to anyone.
Do keep in mind that ac/heating unit is managed by the owner so that is something to be considered when staying here if you happen to prefer to manage your temp. Host is very open to that communication.

For the price, it’s worth it. Looked like the photos. The unit is in a basement and the family upstairs made a lot of noise and played music at night during my stay so be aware. The owner was responsive though with requests. The furniture was a bit dirty but overall was comfortable stay.

The view is fenomenal, the glass windows are amazing. The kitchen is full equipped with what you need. Plenty of towels for the whole stay. Super sheek living room and the balcony is adorable for a morning coffee or cold beer night. The city at night was breath taking from the master bed room! Would definitely stay over and over again.
This spot was perfect for a Cubbies weekend with friends. The house is super cute, well designed, and an epic walk to the park location. We will definitely stay here again!

I had a brief and peaceful stay at Rebecca's air bnb. It was very clean, spacious, and walking distance from food and nature. It's a straight bus ride away from the Obama Presidential Center. She was welcoming and responsive. I would highly recommend this air bnb!

This was the third time I've stayed at this apt. It's conveniently close to public transportation, shopping, restaurants and it feels safe. I have no complaints about Demitri or the apt. I plan to stay there again on my next trip to Chicago.

Had a great visit to Logan for 5 nights. This apartment had easy and free parking on both weekdays and weekends. The bed was comfy and plenty of hot water in a good shower.  Only a few steps to get inside - most places we stay are 2 or 3 flights up, so this was a great bonus. Kitchen had everything we needed.  Would definitely stay again when visiting Chicago.
Would 100% stay again!
Wonderfully comfortable beds and much larger space than expected!

This Chicago apartment is a truly great AirBnB experience. It feels like there is a lot of pride and care for the space.
Jay is a proactive communicator and excellent host. The place is well-stocked with generous, thoughtful provisions. It was very clean and the beds were comfy. Having lived in Chicago in the past, I really wanted to stay in a neighborhood for our visit. The block is lovely and Logan Square has so many great spots. I would definitely recommend and return.

Great location walkable to many shops. Walkable to L train (but it is a little far with a toddler). Spacious clean. We were happy for the AC but it was a couple of standalone AC units. Coming from a non-basement state I didn’t realize how humid it is in the basement and you could definitely see some moisture damage to the paint/drywall. If you have crazy allergies or sensitivity to that kind of thing you may be better off elsewhere but for us for a long weekend it was no problem. Kitchen was equipped enough that we could cook simple stuff like eggs. Check in simple.
We had a fantastic stay! Everything was so salable and right in between two L stops on the blue line! Mark was a great host and always available to answer questions, would stay again!
Great stay! Recommend if you’re in the Chicago area.

This is a wonderful home to stay in! The only issue is the lack of amenities. No real coffee station, only a small pot with no creamers, sugar etc. There are no spices to cook with and the cabinet is filled with empty, for show, spice bottles. The owner should have a true coffee area, maybe K-Cups etc. Some form of welcome package would be nice too; with some snacks, water etc. There is also no shower products. Please concider upgrading these offerings.
The house was very comfortable to come back to and chill after being out all day and night.
Wonderful location and very nice accomodations  in a beautiful setting.  Would highly recommend.
Good place

The house is very well equipped with kitchen and bathroom items. We enjoyed the backyard and the front seating area. Instructions and recommendations left by the owner were clear and helpful. The interior is so well designed, artistic and homey.

Place exactly as pictured and described. Check in was easy as there is a 24/7 concierge. It's very private because it requires a fob to get in. Easy walking distance to lots of food and drink and easy walk to a metro stop. As noted by some others, due to its proximity to the train, it is kind of loud when it passes by and it passes frequently. I had a white noise machine at night and the train didn't wake me. It was well stocked with linens and shampoo/conditioner//body wash. Communicative. We had a nice stay.
Liz and Martin are clear communicators and quick to respond. Best of all, their charming space is thoughtfully furnished. I found it a dream to use during my stay!

Marty and Rob were amazing. The house is so beautiful, clean, artistic and homey. We loved staying and also getting to know them as well. Ming, their pup, was an added bonus. What a sweetie! All of the people in the area were nice, food and service was top notch everywhere we went and it was super easy with walking. Also public transit super accessible if you want to go downtown!! We are already planning on coming back again. We loved every minute of our stay!
An adorable Airbnb in an unbeatable location! We will be back!

Great loft on a quiet street.    Furniture was comfortable and well appointed.    Bed was comfortable.  The space is very spacious and seems to be newly renovated.   Host was very detailed and responded quickly to messages.   Would definitely stay here again
We were in town for a music festival at Dawes Park. The location and house were just what we needed! Host was very communicative.
Great place to stay. Great street and area of town. Nicole was responsive. House was very nice. Beds are super comfortable and plenty of space. Loved the outdoor porch. Would stay again!
The spot was awesome my grandson loved it he called it the hotel house…… Will definitely book again

Manny was a great host! The place was beautiful and a great location for us. Manny was so helpful and accommodating with all of our needs! We would recommend Manny's place for anyone traveling to Chicago.

Cassandra was a great host. Very proactive with instructions. The neighborhood was walkable and cute. Street parking was easy to find around the corner.
Our only serious complaint was the cleanliness. The apartment had clean sheets and towels (most important) but it was very obvious that the apartment hadn’t been deep cleaned in several months. The floors and walls were covered in various old spills and smudges in every room - including a full black handprint smudged on a white wall and doorframe. For the $1200 we spent for 3 nights, we expected the standard level of cleaning we’ve seen in nearly every Airbnb or motel we’ve stayed in.

The Location was good, for our little group we were very comfortable. Ultimately we were looking for somewhere relatively close to downtown and this was one of the better deals found. Only a $30 Uber to the city, to enjoy a stress free night without having to worry about getting our vehicle towed for night parking. So happened to see multiple cars getting towed at the same spot we were celebrating our weekend. Definitely worth the uber !

My best friends and I enjoyed staying in this apartment! Was well decorated, had good parking and there was a nice little shop in close range. Everywhere we wanted to go was about 15-20 min drive! Nice place, would stay again

We had a wonderful stay and would definitely come back!
The check-in instructions were extremely clear, access was very easy, and the hosts were amazing.
They were organized, responsive, and provided all the information we needed before arriving.
The apartment was extremely clean, spacious, and comfortable. The bedrooms felt great, the linens were spotless, and the window A/C units worked very well.

•Great AC/free of clutter.
•Tons of free street parking.

Cons:.
