Had a great stay and really enjoyed their beautiful gardens! And their sweet little dog is so cute! It was close to everything and very walkable but felt very private and peaceful. Having a parking spot was so nice and it was really easy to find and get in with the keypad. The place was very cozy and clean and had everything we needed. Having a coffee and espresso machine plus snacks was so nice. We will definitely be staying here again when we're in the area!

We had a very good stay at Ian’s place. The location is definitely the highlight an easy 10/10. The metro station is only about a 10-minute walk away, and it takes approximately 30 minutes to reach downtown. It is very easy to get around and visit the main attractions using public transportation.
There are also several convenient options nearby, including Target, restaurants, and other shops. Walmart is approximately 45 minutes away, so we had easy access to everything we needed during our stay. The neighborhood felt convenient and well connected.
The only area that could be improved is the sleeping arrangement for groups of more than four people. The additional mattress is very thin and uncomfortable, which makes it difficult to get a good night’s rest. A thicker mattress or a more comfortable sofa bed would make a big difference for larger groups.
Other than that, everything was excellent. The place is a great option for anyone who wants a convenient location with easy access to d
I would say this place is ideal for going to a few baseball games, you’re close to the stadium and all the surrounding restaurants in the area. Definitely worth it and nice area as well.
Her place is adorable and perfect for our 3 night stay with our grandson! Kitchen was amazing and everything felt very clean and new/updated!
The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, and it made our trip so much easier. We really appreciated how easy the check-in was and the responsiveness of the host.
Jide’s apartment was exactly as described clean and equipped with everything you need. Jide is a great host and answered all the questions we had. I highly recommend this place.

We really enjoyed our stay! The apartment was bigger than expected, smelled nice, felt private, and was very quiet. The location was great as well. The main issue was the lockboxes, which were difficult to get the keys out of for both the building and apartment. The directions to the apartment could also have been clearer, as we were directed to the stairs on the left when the stairs on the right were much quicker. We even saw another couple having trouble with the building entry. There was some wear and tear on the walls, and the shower was a little difficult to figure out. Brad was a great host, though—very responsive, easy to communicate with, and helpful. Parking was limited in front, but we always found a spot nearby, and the SpotHero recommendation was helpful. I’m not sure I’d rent this property again, but I’d definitely rent from Brad again!

I really enjoyed my stay at Justin's place.  It is in a very nice, quiet part of the city, but close to lots of restaurants and bus stops / train lines.  The house was private, clean, and well stocked.  I would definitely recommend to others visiting the area and will book next time I have a trip to Chicago.

Je eigen "huis" met alles erop en eraan op loopafstand van restaurants en bars in FultonMarktDistrict (op de hoek van de straat zit al een leuke zaak). Het huis is zéér schoon, heeft een absoluut mega comfortabel bed, uitgebreide keuken, vaatwasser, was/droogcombinatie, twee toiletten en tja, wat is er eigenlijk niet...Voor ons echt een toplocatie! We maakten gebruik van de stadsfietsen die je om de hoek kunt pakken en terugplaatsen. Binnen tien minuten ben je bij de Riverwalk.
De host gaf heel duidelijke instructies dus bij aankomst was het 1, 2, 3 en geregeld. Totaal geen last van medebewoners in het pand. Dus voor ons absoluut vijf sterren!

First, it must be said that Demitri was super responsive and super accommodating. We arrived 2 hours ahead of schedule and Demitri was perfectly fine allowing us to access the space early. He also offered for us to just drop off our bags in the event the unit wasn’t ready. I really appreciated that!
However, the location was a little questionable. The unit felt like it was on the line of perfectly safe and slightly questionable. The reviews that note excessive noise and weed smells are not wrong. It’s true that this is NOT Demitri’s fault, but it is still worth noting. Otherwise, the apartment was as described. There were some signs of wear and tear throughout the space, but it was livable.
I realize the price was comparable to similar units in the area, but if I were to stay in the area again, I would need to seriously consider spending a little more money for an ungraded space. I think the unit would be absolutely fine for some people, but I’m not sure it was the best fit for me.
We had a lovely stay- very clean and comfortable, with lots of charm! Would happily stay again and recommend to friends.
They rescued us from A previous horrible rental. They gave us a cor ner room and everything. I appreciate this hotel for the hospitality!

Accurate listing, great location! Not super close to the Metra or CTA lines, but walkable in nice weather. Great little neighborhood with restaurants and shops in walking distance. We loved our short but sweet stay

Rich’s place was amazing, even more beautiful in person. It was spacious, very clean, and well designed. There were plenty of amenities and lots of towels provided. The building was attractive and secure, there is free street parking right in front of the door. The neighborhood is perfect, with restaurants and a great cafe right across the street. Rich was extremely responsive, usually within 2 minutes, the few times I had a question. He was very welcoming and wished me a happy birthday when I told him the occasion for my stay. 10/10 would highly recommend his place!
Great! recommend!
Great place to stay for  a Chicago visit.  Third floor walk up but well worth it. The place was clean and well appointed. We would stay again.
Victor was an amazing host. One of the best stays and hosts I’ve had. I had everything I needed for my start to finish, which I so appreciate. Would love to book this place again for future stays.
Great location!
Had a great time staying in this beautiful home and loved how quiet and private the area was. Eva is a great host and super sweet! Would definitely come back again.
Great views of the lake and city. Very clean place and good sound insulation. We could not hear the city's noise unless we opened a window or balcony door.
Beautiful place!! Comfortable and tastefully decorated. Had everything we needed.

Amazing stay for the price in a convenient and safe location. Don’t let the other reviews fool you about the train sound you only really hear it in the bathroom and was never an issue. Water pressure is a bit light but for an older building on a higher floor is expected. Thank you for everything!
Great location, everything went super smooth.
Thoroughly pleased with this rental! Would stay again for sure.
Great place and peaceful surroundings
I enjoyed my stay!!!
Good
Perfect for U Chicago visit/move in. Appreciated all the amenities (especially the coffee!) and the unit was VERY clean and very nicely decorated. We would stay again.
Cozy place next to the park was perfect for me and my pup!
Absolutely loved staying here! Would recommend for anyone looking for an affordable and sweet home!
Condo was lovely.    Location provided easy walk to lakefront and restaurants.    Home was well appointed for basic needs.

This was the best location. Surrounded by all the high end stores and walkable to all restaurants and shops downtown. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. They were very responsive. The unit was very comfortable and extremely clean. I loved that the AC worked very well and the unit was fairly quiet considering it was downtown and close to Michigan avenue. We would definitely stay there again without a doubt.
Lourdes was very responsive and accommodating to our requests and needs.

A nice and tranquil stay for my first visit to Chicago! The area was modest but I never felt unsafe. Good access to the train station. Would definitely recommend as an affordable home base for visiting the big city!

Really wonderful stay at Anna‘s place. All of the instructions were so very clear, the place is both gorgeous and immaculate! Anna was proactive in communication, responsive throughout our stay, answered all my various questions. And if I didn’t mention it, this place is GORGEOUS! Came here on a father/son/grandson weekend taking in the Eric Clapton concert and a Cubs game! The location is PERFECT! Can’t recommend this place enough!
Loved my stay here!

This is a small but very cute space in a great location.  We were within walking distance of the water, restaurants, coffee shops and the Cubs Game. When our keyless entry didn’t work, Iris immediately had an alternate plan and got it corrected for the rest of the trip. Enjoyed our stay.
We had a short and sweet stay at Gabriel’s place. He was prompt to reply to our questions. We had fun wandering the area.
Great place, loved the easy entry and the designated parking spot.  Easy to walk to coffee, church and the lake.  The host was very responsive when we had a question.  We'll be back.
10/10 would stay again

Really enjoyed the area. It was my first visit and Melissa was very nice and helpful. I enjoyed walking around the neighborhood and it was very close to Division St. where I was working for the weekend.
Amazing stay! Craig was absolutely an amazing host, highly communicative.
Great renovated apartment close to bars and restaurants. Walking distance to blue line downtown. Would stay again!
Thank you Joe
Prime location in Wrigleyville.

Overall, the place was a great fit for what we needed. Its location is perfect to be close to boystown and many other attractions. It does need some updating; holes in the floor, beds squeak but nothing that we couldn’t navigate through. The communication was excellent and appreciate Rida being attentive. Parking can be a challenge. Instead of doing endless, searching for open spots, I just reserved a spot down the street off SpotHero. Granted it was an extra expenditure, but had a secure spot for my entire stay.

Our group loved Garrett & Kaylin's place. We got to town 40 min before check-in and were able to get in a little early (thanks again!). The house was clean and is a 15ish min walk to Logan Square. We found the neighborhood to be quiet. We would stay here again!

Safe walkable neighborhood. This place seems like it has been completely redone recently and it was very clean, especially the bathrooms. Extra toilet paper and garbage bags were a nice touch. Fresh sealed bag of ground coffee and nice coffeemaker was appreciated. Nice selection of games and books too. We had no problem parking on the street, but you need to hit it right.  I appreciated the warning not to park in the next street over which needed a permit. We were never bothered by any noise in the floor above us. We would stay here again!
Great place to stay as we explored Chicago. Host allowed us to leave our bags while the cleaners cleaned which was super helpful. Host was highly responsive.
Wonderful flat in the middle of a diverse neighborhood. Terrific restaurants and an impressive Catholic Church a block away.  Easy access to public transportation and a place to park in the back.
Tim was great in coms and his beautiful home was a lovely place to stay .. he made us very welcome !

Leah’s place was a comfortable stay for two people. Location was great. It was super close to the bus and an easy to walk to Target. The main door of the Airbnb does open into an alley. Luckily, the alley is wide and the neighborhood felt quiet and safe. You may hear people walking above, but I didn’t find it too bad. Leah was nice and responsive whenever I needed anything. Having access to the washing machine and dryer was awesome for an extended stay. I would stay here again.

I had a wonderful stay at Tippi’s place! The accommodation was nicely decorated, very clean, and exactly as described. It’s conveniently located quite close to the subway, with an easy connection straight into the city center.
Tippi was really kind, welcoming, and helpful, and I immediately felt comfortable and at home. I would definitely recommend staying here and would happily come back anytime. Thank you for a lovely stay, Tippi!

We had a great stay. The neighborhood was safe and walkable and the home was very clean and spacious. Everything you could ever need was available and the welcome information book was top notch. Just moved our daughter to Chicago and would love to stay here again!

We loved staying at Josh's place. The place was perfect and as artists really enjoyed being there. The area is fantastic with so much walkable restaurants in the area. Josh is super sweet and was so quiet we didn't even realize he was home. We wouid definitely recommend and stay again!

Great deal and great spot!
Bus stops were nearby and the area felt safe enough to walk around, even when it got a little late. We stayed in Room 2, and only ever heard some noise from the stairs when people would leave or arrive to their rooms. We didnt ever hear much noise from the street. We liked staying in Room 2 because there wasn’t another room to the side of us.
The main areas were well kept. The place is a bit older, so the rooms and bathrooms have a dated feel, and there are some lingering older-building smells. However, I believe it was clean enough and comfortable for what we needed. If you’re in Chicago mostly to explore and just want a basic, comfortable place to stay, this is a perfect option. It has all the basic necessities with a good amount of space! The bed was a good size for my friend and I to sleep comfortably.
The place itself was very easy to access with the instructions provided. The hosts were very kind and understanding.
We would definitely return!
I felt very much at home… very comfortable and easy to get around. Would definitely stay there again and will recommend it to others traveling to Chicago.

Jaime was very welcoming and provided a lot of information, even checked on us if we needed anything.
Was responsive when we did need something and has a beautiful home. You can see the time, care and love she put into the space.
Will visit again 100000%
We really enjoyed our stay. Terrific views, close to everything, and a beautiful condo. Very responsive hosts who gave recommendations on the area. Thanks for a very nice weekend stay!

Michelle went above and beyond for our stay. It was an excellent experience. Will definitely try to book here again for our next Renegade festival. They were super communicative and when we needed a battery changed on the thermostat, Brendan was there within 30 minutes replacing it. 10/10 stay!
Dan was very attentive to our needs and more. The home was spacious and comfortable. The neighborhood was a bit rundown but the inside made up for it!
Great place very comfy and peaceful great choice if your coming for a weekend to Chicago
Great apartment and host. Would highly recommend this accommodation if you are staying in Chicago
It was wonderful PS left dirty towels in washer and clean dishes in dishwasher.  Next time we come we will look you up

Great place! Lot's of space for a crowded city. Short walk to the beach and great night life spots. We have a toddler and all the amenirites were available (pack+play, high chair). Hosts are responsive and place is well equipped. Would go again if it's available during our next visit.
the space was great. it has everything you need and is very spacious and comfy. Marco was super helpful and responsive! we'll be back!

We enjoyed our stay. This is more like a high end student housing building which was fine but we weren't expecting that. We were 4 60 year old adults in town. It was very quiet. The staff was extremely helpful. The only thing we would comment on is the living room furniture is not designed for older adults. It is on the small end and there is only seating for 3. We had to move the desk chair from a bedroom so we could all be together. Just something to be aware of if your older like us.
That said, the unit met our needs, the location was fantastic and it was extremely clean.
Nice place, great neighborhood, overall really good vacation

The home was nice, clean, and comfortable during my stay. The host was very helpful and responsive, and the instructions were clear and easy to follow. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely stay here again.
Great stay! Location was very clean and convenient. I would recommend this Airbnb to others wanting to be near the field museum + shedd aquarium while also looking for an economical option
Comfortable, cute chickens, yummy tomatoes, nice hot tub, good parking.

It was exactly as expected! The host was very accommodating and helpful. When we had any concern he came to help. The space was perfect. We loveddddd the decor and the movie theater vibe. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay again!

Great host, everything was great. Very good at communicating rules specifically. Overall great experience for my first visit. Only concern would be the overall location, But everything else was to my expectation. Thank you again.

The stay in Sydney's room was great — it's about 20 minutes from downtown Chicago, and the room and house are clean with all the amenities listed in the description. She responds quickly, and the instructions for arriving and staying at the house are very clearly described.
Great place with amazing theming and fun little touches! Would definitely recommend for anyone looking to stay in the area!

Beautiful home in a great location. Only issue was we got a parking ticket first night. Parking passes weren't mentioned anywhere except the binder in the kitchen, and the passes weren't where it stated they would be.
Great stay!
He was very nice and the place was wonderful felt like home. He also provided many cooking supplies which was nice 👍
We had so much fun. It is just a 10 min walk to the blue line and there are cute shops along the way. My bed was so comfortable and we had everything we needed for our stay.
Amazing stay, views and location! Recommend if you were to visit Chicago for a weekend!
This was such a nice cozy apartment. Everything was so clean. It was a great visit.
A clean, quiet and comfortable place in a great location. Will stay again.

Donna has a pristine quaint property located in low stress neighborhood with walkable restaurants which are really good and she’s an excellent host very responsive, friendly proactive. anyone thatt stays at her property that they would be pleased. Thanks for the opportunity..
Spacious, very clean, and modern.

We had a great stay at Jason’s place! The location was perfect! Within easy walking distance of plenty of food, bars, and the stadium, while still being in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood just a block away from the strip.
The rooftop was definitely a highlight. It was a great hangout spot, especially with the fireplace, and made the stay even more enjoyable. The place was a perfect spot to relax after being out exploring Wrigleyville.
Jason was also an excellent host. His communication was amazing, and he responded within minutes whenever we had a question. For example, we needed some help getting the fireplace started, and Jason got back to us in less than five minutes with a clear breakdown of exactly what we needed to do.
Overall, we had an awesome weekend and would definitely stay at Jason’s place again. Highly recommend!
Everything provided, very clean!
Charissa's place is great! Very clean, easy check-in, helpful instructions and loved her book collection! :)

The unit is spacious with a nice kitchen and bathrooms.  Curiously, there is not a dresser in any bedroom, even though there is space for one, so you have to live out of your suitcase (luggage racks provided) or use the overhead shelf at the top of the closet.  Two of the bedrooms front Devon Avenue, which is the neighborhood's primary east-west route, so there is some street noise.  On the other hand, Devon's shops and restaurants are close, including a nice coffee shop just steps from the building entrance.  The lockbox contains a single key ring with three unmarked keys.  It turns out that two of the keys unlock the unit door, and one is to the building's trash room, off the back alley; you'll need to de-ring one of the unit keys unless your party always travels in unison.
Everything went smooth and location was close to where we wanted to go

We had an excellent stay and would absolutely recommend this Airbnb
The home was very clean, comfortable, and well equipped with everything we needed for a pleasant stay
The neighborhood is quiet, safe, and in a great location, with public transportation very close by, which made getting around Chicago very convenient
The host was wonderful very attentive, kind, and quick to respond
He was always willing to help with anything within his reach
For example, we needed an iron during our stay, and he provided one right away
Overall, an excellent host and a great place to stay
When I return to the wonderful city of Chicago, I would definitely stay here again
Highly recommended 10/10

Matt's home was beautiful and perfectly placed in Logan Square - close to the train station and walking distance to many amazing things in the area. Matt was extremely communicative and accommodating to our larger group size, and gave good recommendations as far as how to get to the airbnb/public transportation options in the area. The house even has a garage which is rare and valuable in Chicago. Thank you again Matt for hosting us, I would definitely stay here again!

Das Airbnb ist schön und sauber eingerichtet und hat alles was macht braucht. Jhon antwortet schnell und ist immer erreichbar bei Fragen. Man ist schnell im Zentrum von Chicago mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Das Treppenhaus und der Check-in waren am einfach ein bisschen verwirrend und unübersichtlich.
Great walkable location.  Assel was very responsive and the roof deck and view were awesome!

Beatrice was incredibly responsive, which I greatly appreciated! I had a mild allergic reaction, and her husband came downstairs immediately to show me where the Benadryl was. The response time was almost immediately, and that alone makes them worth five stars as hosts.
Check in was easy with a pin pad. They had an ash tray outside for me, at my request, which was really nice.
The place was exactly as pictured, extremely clean, with plenty of amenities. Beatrice left some breakfast items, coffee, milk, half and half, orange juice, extra bedding. There's also a bunch of "in case you forgot" items in the drawers in the bathroom, which I found to be a great feature. I've stayed at a lot of airbnbs, and this is the first time I've seen that.
Neighborhood is good. It's on the north side, and people walk through the neighborhood day and night.
I would stay again!

Loved everything about our stay here. Bars and restaurants nearby. A quick walk to the L. We all agreed that the rental was even more spacious than we imagined. It was decorated and furnished well with a lot of little touches and details that we appreciated. It was about a 40 minute ride for us into the city by train- quicker to uber/drive obviously. Walk up only, no elevator so plan to carry bags upstairs. City noise at night- loved that sound machines were included, none of us were kept up by the traffic below. If you’re looking for a great spot just outside of the heart of the city this is it.
Fortino was a great host. He was very responsive and friendly. We would recommend his Airbnb to others traveling to Chicago.

This is a first class accommodation for a large group. The interior is beautiful, comfortable, and very clean. We particularly appreciated how quiet the neighborhood was how spacious the apartment was, and how well everything worked in it. It’s an easy walk to grocery shopping and restaurants as well as public transportation. Climate controls worked very well.
Sue is a very kind and friendly host. Would definitely stay here again!
It made my last night feel warm

Great property that matched the impressive description and photos in a beautiful peaceful location in Lincoln Park with loads to do close by and hosted by wonderful hosts. Thank you Nicole and Matt. Recommend staying here 100%!

We had a great weekend stay! It was nice to stay a little out of the city in a quiet laid back area. 7 min walk to the train which made it so convenient. 5 min drive to watch the best sunrise at Roger’s park beach. Such a clean and artistic bnb. Def stay again!
Nice place, looks like the pictures. Not actually in Hyde Park, but south of it. Hosts were very accommodating and communicative.
Excelente hospedaje
The hosts were very responsive and the house was perfect for 7 guests. We walked everywhere and never needed a car.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay in Assel's home! Was walking distance to a few places on our itinerary which was nice. Comfortable for our party of 9 guests. Rooftop was a plus! Would stay here again.
We had a great stay at the Tea Studio. The space is large and comfortable, we felt right at home.

This place was easy to find and super accessible to mass transit.
Interior was exactly as described and super clean. Host was always prompt and polite in responding to any questions we had. I highly recommend.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! The location is perfect - the neighborhood is very walkable and there are a lot of great restaurants/shops nearby (Jason and the family left a good list of recommendations). We ended up grabbing some pastries from Lutz Bakery a couple minutes away, and dinner at Green Leaf Thai one night.
The accommodations themselves were pleasant too! The rooms looked just like in the pictures, and everything was very clean and organized. This was probably one of the cleanest airbnbs we've ever stayed in. The bed was really comfortable, and we enjoyed the ceiling fan in the bedroom for some of the warmer nights. Jason was accommodating with our late check-in, and responsive if we needed anything.
Overall, this was a great place to stay and we'd definitely like to stay here again whenever we're back in Chicago.

Amazing location with easy walking distance to the lake shore, restaurants, shops, and wriggly field. Easy access to the tram for anyone that wanted to go back into the versus driving or getting a taxi. Highly recommend👍🏻
amazing host and apartment. very communicative. extremely clear check in instructions

Great stay!
The house was perfect for me, my bestie and aunt. I was worried about parking, but it was never a problem. The neighborhood was quiet and it was about a mile from the Obama museum. You could actually walk to it with some sneakers and a bottle of water.
The house was clean and we felt right at home. Daniel was always responsive to my messages. Quiet and comfortable.
Highly recommend Jason’s space if you’re looking to stay in Chicago. Great neighborhood spot and walkable to Wrigley. Super clean space and also a very friendly and responsive host!
Great place to stay, Host is responsive and helpful, would definitely stay again!

My party of seven really enjoyed our stay. The house was roomy, clean,  and in a very nice neighborhood. Tasha responded quickly to any concern we had. We will definitely stay in Tasha’s house on our next visit to Chicago.
My first time in Chicago will definitely recommend to stay here anytime I visit again
Great location and fit our girl group comfortably!
Had a great time staying here for my sisters wedding. Would definitely stay again—Francisco is great!!
Had a great stay, would highly recommend!

Beautiful unit close walking distance to all of the bars and restaurants on Halsted. The Hosts were extremely friendly and communicative any time we needed anything. Would recommend to anyone looking to stay in the boystown/north halsted area.

The neighborhood is filled with friendly people. Safe to walk even after dark. There are numerous restaurants just a couple blocks away. Very easy to get on the train to go anywhere in the city. The accommodations were fantastic. I would definitely recommend it to anyone.
Great place! Communicative host. Great location and comfortable for a quick weekend getaway. Highly recommend.
Great place to stay in if you’re coming to visit! Really great location, clean, accessible, homey and chic. Will definitely stay again next time I come visit.
Great location, as advertised, would stay again

I stayed at Kevin’s place for 4 nights. The apartment was very clean. It’s located close to cafes, restaurants and the bus stop. The neighborhood felt safe to walk at night and not a lot of noise, so we were able to sleep well at night. It was nice to have coffee included and the laundry machine.

I had a really great stay here on a weekend trip with my family! David provided clear instructions and was a great host. The apartment is spacious and comfortable, and is within walking distance of a lot of great restaurants and shops. I really enjoyed my time here and would stay here again.

素敵なお部屋にお世話になり、ありがとうございました。
赤ちゃん連れでの滞在でしたが、ベビーベッドをご用意いただき、とても助かりました。ベビーバスも快く準備してくださって本当に感謝しています。おかげで安心して過ごすことができました。
滞在中にトイレットペーパーが切れてしまった際も、すぐに持ってきてくださり、丁寧なご対応に感謝しております。
great stay, responsive host

Nice neighborhood, lots to do. Apartment is well furnished and supplied, but shows its age. Building and hallways need a refresh, though that's not the host's responsibility. Demitri responded quickly when we had questions.
We had a lovely time. It was set up with everything we needed to make our stay enjoyable and comfortable! Thank you so much Todd.
Great stay in Andersonville! Very close to all of the shops and restaurants on Clark. Bryce was really responsive and friendly. We enjoyed our visit!
Peaceful and well equipped to meet all your needs for a comfortable stay.

This was a beautiful place and perfect for our family trip to Chicago.  The area is walkable and close to metros to take you into the Loop and downtown.  The balcony was great!  We loved it and would definitely stay here again.
Everything was awesome, just had to run out and get Toilet paper.
Nice place. Very convenient location for my purposes, a 15 minute walk to McCormick Place. I would stay there again.
Charming place!
Don's place was fantastic! Great location with several food, bar, shopping options.

The location is premiere and within walking distance (less than 2 miles) of restaurants, Obama Presidential Center, Science and Industry museum and the Green Line Depot. We used Green Line Cottage Grove depot and changed to red at Roosevelt- very easy and costs very little.  It is a basement (lower level) apartment and we didn't hear the neighbors above us, well.. maybe once.  It's quiet and private. We stayed 5 days and it was a good location for the things we wanted to do. The Univ of Chicago is basically right across the street and that campus is gorgeous.
Great location for Jefferson Park! Clean, clear instructions, and friendly. I had a wedding near there and it my needs perfectly!

Jacques’s place is one of the nicest Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed at! First of all, Jacques was an extremely responsive host and super accommodating. We had a last minute change of plans and ended up arriving much earlier than anticipated. Jacques kindly let us check in super early so that we could get settled. The space is gorgeous — it looks like a place that would be featured in Dwell magazine! Jacques thought of every detail from coffees and teas to an iron + ironing board. The home was clean, quiet, and situated in a beautiful neighborhood with easy access to restaurants and coffee shops nearby. All in all, we had an amazing stay, and I will definitely be back for future Chicago trips!

We had a wonderful stay at Natalia's beautiful apartment. We were pleasantly surprised by the size- much more spacious than it appears in the photos. Great neighborhood and fantastic place to stay overall. Thanks Natalia!
The perfect stay for a solo traveler - I booked this accommodation for my mother who was visiting. Thank you for being such wonderful hosts!
Very nice and large place. They even had complementary snacks on the counter for us. Would stay here again!

Charlie was a responsive host, the apartment was exactly as described and it’s in a beautiful area of Chicago with lots to do. There was a coffee machine and some bags of coffee but there wasn’t any water or anything to drink but you can buy things at the local stores about a 10 min walk away. She messaged a lot, asking about arrival, check in times, etc. i know it’s not mandatory for airbnbs to have complimentary water or snacks but it would’ve been a nice touch. There was a full body mirror which i enjoyed.
Joes place was wonderful. We had a great time. Very clean. Easy and free parking!! And all of the amenities you could need including multiple ways to make coffee

What a fun way to spend a weekend in Chicago.  I was there with my father and brother. It is a much a better deal for three rooms than a hotel would have been. The beds are doubles so they may be uncomfortable for married couples, but they were fine for us. The location is an easy walk to the orange line, which made it very convenient since I flew into Midway. The view is beautiful.  The hosts were very helpful. I was especially appreciative that they let me in early to leave my luggage so that I did not have to carry it around while waiting for check-in.
Excelente opción. Muy recomendable. Muy buena atención del anfitrión.

Beds were comfortable, but the sofas were very uncomfortable for relaxing. The location is great if you’re not planning on spending a lot of time at the unit. The neighbor upstairs kept us up with the constant walking in shoes back and forth and moving of furniture.

This unit is a basement unit in a row house in a terrific area. The apartment itself is beautifully refinished, spacious and clean.
The location is wonderful in a walkable area with easy access to the Lincoln Park area and the train lines needed to access the other areas of the city. Host communication and hospitality were outstanding!
This space was amazing, the riverwalk is at your fingertips and once you walk in the door you feel right at home clean and spacious! We had great view of the riverwalk from our window!!
Tenía lo necesario para nuestra breve estancia!!

This place was as good as it gets! Clean, very comfortable bed, spotless, and all the amenities we needed for our stay in Chicago. It’s obvious Luis takes great pride in providing a wonderful place to stay. He was very responsive and proactive, checked in with us a few times to see if we needed anything and responded back quickly! He Also shared some insight into the city and things going on. Our stay at the neighborhood hotel was mostly perfect! Great space and an ideal location. There was ample public parking available nearby. We had tickets to a show at the United Center and stayed based on proximity. Blessedly quiet and private after a loud concert! Also the cafe a few blocks away, Froth, was a highlight! Thank you so much David! Highly recommend for one or two people looking for a place to stay while exploring Chicago.
Nice place to stay.

This was my second time staying at Victor’s place and I would absolutely stay again. I came to Chicago to vend at an art market in Wicker Park and it was only 15 minutes from the location. Quiet, clean, and convenient. I’ll book it again once I’m back in the Windy City!

Excelente para hospedarse, el lugar impecable, me hospede con mis niños, ni papá y mi esposo....piensan en todo lo que  podriamos necesitar, Freddy excelente anfitrión, contestaba de manera muy rápida a todas mis inquietudes, que realmente no fueron muchas porque todo esta clarisimo en la descripción del alojamiento...

My first ever AirB&B and it was a flawless experience. Great location walkable to Wrigley Field, Trader Joes, Coffee shops, eateries and transit. The apt had all the amenities I needed for the stay. Thank you, Milen!
Of all my travels, my favorite stay to date!

We had a lovely stay! The home is clean and beautiful and the location is amazing, literal seconds away from Wrigley Field! Grateful for the onsite parking. Nicole was attentive and quick to answer any questions we had throughout our stay.

What a great place!  One of the best spots I've ever stayed.  Very homey, great location for Cubs games, convenient to grocery stores, restaurants, and bars.  Very nice apartment, perfect for two couples.  A lot of very nice touches throughout the apartment - two king beds are extremely nice.  Very quiet for its location next to the Metro.  Would definitely stay there again.  We really enjoyed our time there.  Thanks for everything Brian!!
Great views and location.

Amazing location right on the river walk. Great city views from the hotel. Loved my room and the bathtub with hot water. A bit pricey but worth it if you find a good deal or for special occasions  Food at the bar was OK but service was great. Keep in mind the security deposit that is due at check in which is $125/night and there is also a resort fee that they will take out of your security deposit later.
Looked even better than the pictures. Decorated with love and attention . The place is well maintained, kept very clean and stocked with everything guests could need. Thank you !
Spacious, clean, pictures accurate. Would stay again.

Very good location. Close to everything. Easy check in & out. To my standards, it wasn’t super clean but I am an overly clean person. It was still fine and doable. When new guests came on my last day, there was 2 people so I heard them making noise a lot in the morning when I was trying to sleep ,  but it wasn’t a big deal. I enjoyed this stay overall and would recommend  to anyone visiting and exploring Chicago. The fact that it’s a whole house and common areas is a plus.
Had a great stay! Ledys was awesome and can’t wait to be back. I highly recommend

Jaime es un gran anfitrión.
Estuve muy cómoda en la habitación y siempre se mostró atento a lo que yo necesité.

Stayed here with a few friends for a wedding. We had a great time and Vladimir was an excellent host! We felt right at home :) Would definitely recommend

I loved this place! There’s a few places to walk to and is close to an arena venue. Surprisingly parking was not free but not horrific. I really enjoyed the location. It was 15-20 minutes from literally everything.

My stay at Sarah’s place (Lux Logan) was memorable. Everything you’d hope for when a place’s listing description and photos look so beautiful. This place was in a very convenient location for everything I had planned in Chicago. Arantza and the team were very helpful in messaging and meeting all questions or needs that I had.
Great Place

Josh’s place was exactly what my group was looking for when we booked a friend reunion in Chicago. Location-wise, staying at Josh’s place had us feeling like locals every time we stepped outside. The beds were comfortable, the showers had great water pressure, and the unit was effectively air conditioned during a hot day. Check out was also a breeze. Would love to stay here again!
Ari's place was a great location to stay at, and it was very comfortable. Thank you for a great trip!
Hi I enjoyed my stay we are getting ourselves together to check out by 11 thank you
Found it easy to get to West Loop, Logan Square and downtown. Good pizza place nearby too!

For my first solo travel, Alma was an amazing host. Always helpful and super responsive. I told everyone I knew how perfect this place was location wise and overall just the perfect place for my weekend trip. Thank you so much!
Todo muy agusto, muy completo, buena zona
Nice, affordable place to stay! Would happily stay here again.

Super host and fantastic apartment. The location is great with a Divvy bike stand just around the corner which we used every day. Chicago was amazing, we enjoyed every second. Brett was a superb host, very quick to respond to messages and very helpful!
This is my third stay at one of David’s Airbnb listings. Each apartment has been wonderful. Clean, comfortable - hard to leave! Wouldn’t dream of coming to Chicago and staying anywhere else

Beautiful apartment in a great location. The space was spotless and very well cared for. Furniture was comfortable and the sophisticated vintage style was a great break from the usual IKEA showroom look of many AirBnB spaces. Parking was effortless--Ashley left us permits for the length of our stay and a spot was always open directly in front of the building. Ashley's place is going on my list of Chicago rentals I'll return to for future visits.

Doris was a great host. Her home is so cute and cozy, smells amazing, and the beds are really comfy. Great place to rest your head. Not so much to go out and about for food and such but we felt safe and would recommend.

This condo was a great location for our Chicago Cubs weekend! It was well appointed, perfect location, and Richard was an awesome host! We highly recommend this for anyone wanting to experience Wrigleyville and all it has to offer!

Marks place was perfect!  A very nice apartment with newly remodeled touches, large walk in shower, comfy beds and all the amenities of home. Place was very clean, easy to access and walkable to several great neighborhoods. Was able to find free street parking right in front of the place and had no issues during our stay. Highly recommend!!
great host
First time in Chicago. Easy access to downtown. Nice room with Lake Michigan views. Gave us an early check in at an affordable rate. Would book again.

We had a wonderful 4-day stay at Laura’s lovely apartment. It was spotlessly clean, bright and cheerful, and very comfortable. The neighborhood is quiet and safe with lots of little shops and eateries to explore. We would love to stay there again when we return to Bridgeport.
pretty great space clear instructions in a peaceful neighborhood!
Great place in a nice neighborhood! Susan is very responsive and helpful.

Beautiful and looked just like the pictures, Veronica was extremely easy to talk to with questions and needs. The place was a perfect home away from home for a long weekend with my friend, next time I’m in Chicago I will book again!

It was great stay the location is great and shortwalk to Belmont train station a lot fo food options close by in walking distance and also a luggagedrop  storage rental  place near by to if you arrive early before check I would stay again if I travel through again
The place was great and a comfortable place to stay.

The apartment served a purpose for us. We spent most of our time out in Chicago, with the apartment in walking distance of a red line CTA stop for easy access to Wrigley Field, downtown Chicago etc.
Beds were comfortable and the kitchen and bathroom facilities were good.

Nice place to stay

Loved our stay in Chicago!  Steven was a wonderful host, very responsive and hospitable.  Location - easy access to L train, Wrigley and downtown.  Apartment was very clean and in a nice neighborhood near North Park University.
Perfect place for a Cubs game!  Go cubs Go!

Great hosts, incredible space that’s easy to find, centrally located, and absolutely beautiful! Just as advertised.
The hosts were communicative and accommodating throughout the stay. Would book again.
We will definitely stay here again as we come to the area often. Best place in the neighborhood.

We enjoyed our stay at Erica’s place. Easy drives to downtown Chicago to the northeast and to the Obama Center and surroundings south. We would stay with Erica again!
A very nice place clean, and located in a great neighborhood. I would definitely stay there again and recommended to friends
Beautiful historic home, thoughtfully decorated. All necessary amenities. Exactly as described. Enjoyed our time there.
Had a great stay. Milan is very helpful and responsive.  Will recommend this property for anyone. Will stay again in the future.
Such a quaint, relaxing home. Good neighborhood. Would stay here again!

Stop what you're doing and book this place! A truly perfect spot ace for our family of 4 - clean, convenient, well appointed, thoughtful (with snacks, a welcome note and coffee!), and in a great spot. We lived in Chicago 2013-2016 and this is the best neighborhood by Armitage and Webster - tree-lined streets, shops and restaurants but still quiet, easy access to the train, only a mile from the lake. Nancy was very proactive and a great host as well. Can't wait to come back!
Had a great stay, very nice Airbnb in a really convenient area with many great food places around
Arthur was always quick to answer and flexible with our needs. The place was a nice size and had everything we needed.

I booked this place very last minute but the host was so helpful in getting me set up with such little notice. The space was perfect for my friends and I to celebrate the bachelorette and get around the city for the celebration events! Would absolutely stay there again!
It was a great experience for me and my family,
Walking distance to a lot, including two L stops and on a quiet street. Recommend staying here if you don’t mind stairs and being in a garden unit/basement that doesn’t get a lot of natural light.
Great location and spacious room. Would definitely stay again.
Clean, great location with stunning view!
The stay was amazing, Olivia was very responsive and helpful. The apartments itself is very nice providing plenty or towels, blankets, ac units and fans.
Thank you for your hospitality and your kindness Juanita!
It was a nice hotel, great location. Walking distance from river walk an so much more.
Had a quick weekend trip with some girlfriends the air Bnb was great appreciated the air conditioning in each room and the local record

We were a group of 6 women and we felt safe and secure. The home is lovely with beds for everyone. We also enjoyed watching tv on the couch in the living room. It was easy to walk or call uber from the place. We would stay again and highly recommend.

Very safe and comfortable!  Truly enjoyed our time in Chicago.

Comfortable and clean spot.

We loved our stay at Kyle’s apartment. Everything was as described in the listing and Kyle, along with Ryder, were great hosts.
The location was perfect, especially if you’re in town for a cubs game. Just a quick walk to Southport Corridor and Wrigley Field.
We will definitely try and stay here again next time we come back to Chicago.

It was such a unique and memorable place for our family to stay while visiting Chicago. Thank you, Troy and your wife, for sharing your beautiful home with us!
Fantastic stay. Great hosts!! Will definitely return!
Great location to walk to anything you could need. Clean and comfortable. Would stay again!

Location is great if you want Lakeview. Around the corner from good food and shops. Decor very attractive and interesting, and it looks great when you arrive. Overall, very happy with the unit and would stay here or in another until by this host again.

I came into town for a 10K run and this was the perfect, safe, and comfortable place to rest. The property is located in a quiet neighborhood, which made for a peaceful stay. Valerie was very responsive, communicative, and easy to work with. I would definitely stay here again!
She’s very friendly the communication was great and clear she even let me check in early because I got down there early she was just very nice all around and I would recommend!!!

We stayed with our extended family and had a wonderful time, everyone was very comfortable and happy. So fun with kids because of the pool and basketball court, and close to everything in the loop and public transportation.
The place was super accessible and easy to access. The place was very clean and cute.
I absolutely recommend this house. It was lovely.
Nice and quiet location. Definitely not a huge space but good for what we needed. It is on the 3rd floor in case you have trouble navigating stairs!
Great home, thoughtfully put together!

Beautiful little apartment with a fantastic host. Dean offered their personal bikes for our use. The accommodations are top notch and the house and gardens were beautiful. First time in Chicago and Jesse made me feel extremely welcomed, the house wasn’t far from the nearest train and all instructions given were very clear and understandable. If you are looking to book you most definitely should.
Excellent
Perfect pet friendly bnb in a great neighborhood! Loved all of the amenities and access to the fenced in backyard. Mike and his wife were amazing hosts. Thank you so much again for having us.
Always a good time staying here. Conveniently located by the red line station. Plenty to do in the area as well.
Would recommend a stay

Great stay. Host very accessible. In fact, called me promptly as we left an item and made arrangements with us to retrieve it.

Could not have been better place for our group of guys. Comfy beds, clean bathrooms, great living room space for us all to hang out. Super convenient everything in walking distance & Uber’s were always very easy to get. Great host!

David’s place is literally a few blocks to Wrigley Field and all the surrounding excitement of going to the game. It’s also a quick walk to restaurants, bars, shopping, and the grocery store away from Wrigley Field. We used Uber to see a bit more of the city.
Anthony was an amazing host! The cleanedt airbnb I have stayed in thus far! Less than a 5 min walk to the train and bus stop. Thank you all again!
Just steps from Wrigley Field! But quiet enough down the street from the field that you didn't hear any noise. We loved our stay. Would definitely stay with Dennis again!
Great hosts! Metro was within walking distance. Listing was as described. Highly recommend!
Super professional and great location to get every where we wanted to go!
The apartment was very nice.  The location was wonderful for catching the bus to visit other neighborhoods as well.  Definitely would recommend this place to others.
perfect for when you want to be around downtown night life

Everything was great and exactly as expected! The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described in the listing. We had a wonderful stay and everything went smoothly. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The place was even better than the pictures! In a cute and quiet neighborhood. Walkable to restaurant and shops and the bus stop. It was so clean and quaint, and a great place to spend time with friends.

Had a lovely stay with friends in Chicago and this place was a great location. Quiet street and lots of great restaurants and shops close by. Space was bigger than I thought based on photos and everything was nice, clean, and easy.

This is my family’s first visit to Chicago and we thoroughly enjoy our stay at Brian’s Airbnb. Brian went above and beyond to make our stay memorable! We will definitely be booking his place again in the very near future!!!!!!! Thank you!!

Very cool spot! We hosted a medium sized bachelorette party here where each floor felt private when we needed it to, while still having plenty of space to come together (multiple sitting areas, patios, large living room couch, etc.)
A clean and tidy apartment. Great place to stay north of Chicago.  Easy access to public transportation. Host is very responsive. Plan ahead if you're driving and need to park your car.
It’s warming and hits home and chill to stay in Cotys place. Me and my friends had great time within our 2 nights of stay.
We stayed here for an extended weekend trip to Chicago. Brendan was super responsive and helpful. The location was good also in terms of getting around Chicago. I’d recommend this place to anyone
Had a great stay. There were 10 of us who stayed there. Plenty of room and lots to do. The basement is awesome! Really enjoyed it

¡Disfruté mucho mi estancia! El lugar era bonito y estaba muy limpio, y el vecindario era tranquilo. La ubicación era excelente por el precio. Los anfitriones fueron amables y facilitaron todo, además de dejar las instrucciones muy claras.

Such a cute place and an absolutely great value! I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely stay here again. My only issue was the building’s front door lock, which was very finicky and sometimes took several attempts to get it to work. Bella was very responsive even at late hours at night. The house habe all amenities as advertised.
We loved our stay! It was a great location, free street parking, and felt very safe walking around at night. We went to many of the places recommended and we enjoyed it all!

Awesome house for our group of 7 guys. Perfect location with lots to do in walking distance. Great outdoor decks and comfortable family room for just relaxing and hanging out. Movie room is really cool. Would recommend staying here to others. Thanks for a great stay!

Everything was as pictured. The place was clean and spacious. Vince even had his cleaning crew to leave us parking passes because of our my large group. My family enjoyed staying at Patricia’s house! It was a great space for adults and small children. Loved the walkability to restaurants, stores and the lake.

We loved our stay at Rebecca’s place! Parking was super convenient, with street parking right outside on the street and there seemed to always be at least a few spots available. It’s very clear that Rebecca cares a lot about ensuring guests have a wonderful stay, and ours couldn’t have been better! It was my fault for not checking multiple times, did not see that there wasn’t AC. Got hot and stayed hot until morning.
Decent if you will not spend much time in the unit. Doesn’t really look like the photos. No hot water really for showers in the morning. Ok stay

Ours was a great family stay. The house was great for the three of us. It was squeaky clean in all aspects. The kitchen had it all - cutlery, grocery, snacks, coffee, all equipment. The convenience store is about 15 min walk.

Cyan is very friendly, cheerful and helpful. She stays on the floor above.
All in all, Cyan’s house is worth staying at.

Hi, Anita’s place was beautiful. It was very clean, spacious, and looked just as pictured. Me and my 6 bridesmaids had a blast and had plenty of room. I will say it was in a very rough neighborhood, I knew it wasn’t the best neighborhood, but I didn’t realize the immediate surroundings would be so run down around. However, as a large group it was okay we felt safe with the cameras and being all together. I would definitely stay here again with a group.

This place was perfect for a long weekend in Chicago with some friends. It's in a great location just a short walk to Logan Square, the backyard patio and garage are great perks, and the hosts were very helpful and communicative. Would stay here again!
My stayed was so good experience. She’s friendly, respectful and enjoyable person. The place is exactly how looks it in the pics. Thank you for everything.

Its location makes most things walkable or very short Uber rides.

This is a uniquely large apartment for Chicago and suited our needs perfectly. As a group of 8, having so many bedrooms and restrooms was a huge plus. The building had just one elevator during our stay (one was down), but the occasional waits didn't have a noticeable impact on our stay.

Heads Up on this place.
Note 1: Even though it says Free Cancellations, once you book, you only have 24 hours to cancel. After 24 hours, you lose over 1/2 of the rental. 10 days before our stay, our event got moved to WI. When asked what the refund would be, Belle said she didn’t know Airbnb had my money
Note 2: No parking offered. It is meter parking at $2.50/hour. The catch is that from 8:05am until 10pm, you must pay every 2 hours. It will not allow you to pay for the day. If you miss that 2 hour window you will get ticket. We used ParkWhiz to find daily parking which was almost 1/2 mile away.
Note 3: They do have a rat problem in the area. Bella’s place did NOT have any but walking back and forth to car every night, we seen 12+. None during day, but after 8:30pm they are out
Note 4: This place is more for a single traveler. You have a bed, kitchen, bathroom and one bar stool. No table to work at or have meals at. One of us sat on bed, while the other had the stool.

Apartment was spacious, clean, and good set up for a girls weekend. Big kitchen, comfortable living room to hang out in. Josh was extremely responsive and our entire stay was quite nice.
Comfortable beds, clean room, good location.
Great location, views and loved the outside rooftop.

I genuinely loved everything about this stay and this place. This was a solo trip to get outta town and I will DEFINITELY be bringing my partner back next time we go to Chicago. I have extreme germaphobia and this place was spick and span. You could smell the freshness of the laundering.
This place has an excellent location, felt safe, and the property had a great bedroom, bathroom, and conversation area setup for our group. Enjoyed it!

Melissa and Marcelo's place had an exceptionally chill vibe! Easy to find, comfortable and clean. They were very responsive to any questions we had. It was the perfect place for our stay in Chicago, close to events we were attending in Jefferson Park and Logan Square areas. We definitely recommend their place!

Very nice modern room and private bathroom. Spotless and very tidy. Everything worked perfectly. Host is fabulous - very responsive and helpful.

I was uncertain about this, but it worked well since the place was very quiet and I didn’t feel like I was intruding on someone’s home. The bathroom is outside the room, but the door is adjacent to the room.
The place was great and Mike made it easy!
Great location, wonderful property, and appreciate the owner’s timely and detailed communication.  Would definitely stay here again.

We had a great stay. lots of bedrooms and bathrooms. very clean. responsive host
would definitely stay again!
Perfect spot very nice working with Ana and everything was just as explained
Spacious, easy check in, great host communication. Would recommend!
Great place to stay. So many great restaurants in the area. Host was very friendly and responsive. Accommodated our early check in request which helped so much with friends flying in early.
the place was great, nice and clean. john is a very responsive host

Thoroughly enjoyed a weekend in this neighborhood of Chicago, which was equidistant between destinations and also offered plenty within walking distance. The guest parking permits were extra appreciated.

Very well equipped and super clean. Great decorating, too. The communication from start to finish was thorough, clear and so gracious. Would definitely stay again and will encourage other family members to do so, as well!  Thank you!

Stayed here while in town for a family wedding. Hosts were super responsive and kind, and the apartment was a great home base! We enjoyed the space itself, and the location was very convenient for exploring the city and attending wedding related events.

Unbelievable house and the host was amazing. Extremely responsive and accounting. The area is peaceful it had a very “true American neighborhood” feel. We will definitely be coming back next time we’re in Chicago.

My friends and I went to this location for my batchlor party and it was one of the greatest trips I’ve even done!! The place was beautiful, there was so much to walk around and see, and the host was very helpful with anything we needed. If I’m ever able to I would go back in a heart beat!
This little spot was perfect for my husband and I for the weekend! Very walkable and close the Wrigley Field. Maurizio was very helpful and responsive. Would stay here again in the future!
Great location, left to see and do. Nice being close to the lake and Loyola. Great apartment for a family. Will come back again.
Great stay, convenient to the brown line and a very walkable neighborhood!
Pleasant stay. Convenient location. Comfortable and clean. Easy in and out. Great option for our needs.
Everything was easy to find with the videos he sent and right downtown so easy to get everywhere we were trying to go.

We had a fabulous stay here for 7 nights. The space was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed. The neighborhood is peaceful and walkable. The hosts, Jude and Al, were so friendly and provided many helpful recommendations for us. We would love to stay here again next time we’re in town.
Great stay! Location was easy and walkable, the bed was very comfortable and the place was clean
The place was nice, super clean, with readily available items in the home to cook and clean with! Patio is for relaxing and enjoying the chicago breeze!

Great location for a Cubs game and being in Wrigleyville. Couldn't get closer to the action if you tried. The place was great and made it very easy to get around with a large group when most everything was a short walking distance away.

We had the best weekend in Bucktown. This apartment is beautiful, just as shown in the pictures. We loved all the design features and amenities.
The location was so walkable to great shopping, coffee spots and restaurants. We enjoyed our time together and said yes to a wedding dress for my daughter. Would love to come stay again.
Everything was as expected. Check in/check out was easy, conveniently located and clean.

The place was clean and comfortable, the outside deck was private and peaceful, had a real good vibe. The Co-Host Sebastian is hella kool when he’s there, bring good vibes 🤙🏾. Plus the place is close to downtown and Chinatown. Definitely will recommend
Amazing location! Highly recommend it!

Can's place was great. Very clean, and being a neat freak and a germ phobe that I am, it is not often I am comfortable sleeping places. Absolutely. I’d keep it positive but mention the bed issue clearly so it’s fair to both the host and future guests:

Had a wonderful stay! I highly recommend it.

Brad was very strange to communicate with. He never answered questions directly and half the time I thought I was speaking with a bot. I probably was. Amazing place and just what we needed for our time in Chicago. Location was great for walking around Andersonville, but just far enough off the main strip to be quiet and peaceful. This place is amazing, everything was as described in the photos. They make everything to make our stay better. You can walk around the place without concern.

Christopher's apartment delivered  as promised. Close to restaurants and a short walk or even shorter bike ride to Wrigley, it was the perfect setup for my son and I. The apartment was super clean, modern, with a full kitchen. Although we didn't do any cooking per se, you could whip up a meal and eat at the granite counter top. A little office space with chargers was also in the unit but I preferred to work from the counter. The bed was comfortable and my son slept on the large sectional sofa which he said provided a good night's sleep. The standing shower head was strong (not lo-flow:), and overall the bathroom had thoughtful supplies as did the rest of the apt. Christopher's check-in info was clear and he was super responsive throughout our stay—we'd certainly stay again for our next trip to Wrigleyville. Go Cubs!

Love the location which is what you pay for!! It’s close to Wrigley Field and that is exactly what we wanted.  The building had older and unique feel.  The garden apartment was neat. The check in directions and really anything related to our stay, was given great attention/detail to. David was very helpful. I’d stay here again!!

We were in Chicago for a wedding. Michael was the host with the most! The space has everything you might need and feels very posh.

Michael is also very kind and helpful. We really appreciated him going above and beyond to accommodate us!
I really enjoyed staying at the place, it felt secure and very clean.

Beautiful apartment in an amazing location! Quiet street that is easily walkable to all the local shops and restaurants. Super comfortable king size bed! Thoughtful amenities and snacks made it even more enjoyable. Very friendly host that responds immediately!

I could probably go too long, but this was one, if not the best Airbnb we've ever stayed in. The kitchen and bathroom were all nicely updated. Truly 5 Star worthy!

The front desk staff, specifically Dontrell in the mng & the dark skinned gentleman with the big afro in the evening, displayed exceptional service and attempted to make my stay as enjoyable as possible for my girl & I. I would stay there again right nw
Place was clean and an easy commute around the city. Host is very responsive and helpful.

Honestly, great location. I hadn’t really planned my trip out too well, but it was near the millennium park, and the museum district, which you can easily take the water taxi to the pier, and in turn walk along the river and up to Lincoln park.
Cozy place.
We really enjoyed our stay, and the location is perfect for walking.
Excellent place! I loved it. My favorite part was the location and the affordable price. I would definitely come back!!!
Loved it!  Great hotel with clean/modern rooms and everyone was friendly.

Spotless place in a walkable neighborhood. Easy access to the train station and good restaurants nearby. Exactly what we needed for exploring the city.

I cannot say enough good things about this host and his perfect place to stay in Chicago. Great location. Plenty of dining choices nearby. Close to the L. Nate has thought of everything. Super clean and comfortable. My wife and I can’t wait to stay here again. Book with confidence.
This is our second time staying here for a girls trip. It’s a gem!
Great stay, comfy beds and great AC!

Emerald Oasis is indeed a jewel! Kari's home is beautifully appointed, cozy, and welcoming. We enjoyed the 3-season porch and the well-stocked kitchen, in particular. Traveling with our nephew & niece, we were looking for a safe and quiet place to land after busy sight-seeing days. Kari's place was perfect for us. Highly recommended.

My family and I had a great time staying at this Airbnb! The location was amazing and so close to some of the best restaurants in the city. The apartment was spacious, clean, and had all the amenities we needed. Drew was a great host and responded to all our questions immediately!
Very kind and understanding people. Great hosts who respond promptly

Great place to stay for the weekend in the city! Neighbourhood feels safe and quiet.

One treat is West Ridge Nature Park, about a mile northwest, a piece of the wild with a pond and nice trails.  No dedicated parking, but street parking is available. We had a great trip.
Very kind and helpful host! Great spot and clean apartment.
Had a really great stay and the view of Lake Michigan was gorgeous. I would highly recommend and would definitely book again.
Great place to stay, especially if you’re in town to go to Wrigley field. Very responsive host and place had everything we needed. Highly recommend.

The apartment was identical to the pictures.  I did find 1 dirty glass, and there was a beverage left behind in the fridge. I expected to find instructions to connect to the wifi, but they were quickly provided when requested. Would definitely stay there again.

Freddy was very responsive and helpful! We had a great time staying here.

the home was very nice and perfect for me and my friends trip. would definitely rebook in the future

A nice hotel that I was happy to find on here. It was clean and in a great location, they provided a food voucher, and it was less expensive than a lot of similar hotels in the area.

Hotel was easy to find and room was clean. Walls a little thin so i occasionally heard my neighbors but it wasn’t too disruptive

Perfect place for a bunch of chemical engineers (15 of us) in our late 50s to have a reunion after 35 years! Alex was always very prompt in replying to my messages and a good host. I would highly recommend this property to anyone with a large group.
It was a really peaceful and nice i recommend 100%

The apartment was centrally located with many places walkable. Also very close to public transportation. The front door receptionists were friendly and courteous.  A real plus having a coffee shop right downstairs and the lake only a block away.  We also enjoyed the rooftop lounge.
Nice newer location. Convenient to transportation , market and the loop. I would recommend.

This place was everything I needed for a good weekend in chicago! I would certainly stay here again!

Lovely, historical place with character. The hosts are welcoming, kind, and generous. Domino the dog is a very good boy.
This is how Airbnb was meant to be. Next time I need a place in Chicago, this will be the first place where I'll check availability.

Such a gem! Sweet, peaceful neighborhood just a couple blocks from Clark. Morning coffee on the front porch was such a lovely way to start each day. Lots of space and pristinely clean inside. 10/10 would stay again.
Nice apartment.  Accurate pictures.  Convenient location.

Very well located and had what was needed for a weekend visit to Chicago.

This garden apartment is amazing! My wife, child, two dogs, and I spent an entire month here and felt right at home. Bob has really thought of everything, and the location is great for going into the city for sightseeing, a show, dinner, or a game.
Really enjoyed my stay Quinton was very responsive. Air bnb very nice and clean. Would come again ❤️

Our trip was exactly what we expected, the area is very walkable and a perfect location for the time spent. Host was very friendly and responsive for anything we needed! Highly recommend for a weekend trip to Chicago!
Excellent location, next to a Blue Line stop, grocery store, and close to Fulton Market.  Very spacious and clean.  As good as it looks in the photos, if not better!
Amazing stay and Dorothy is friendly and welcoming! Felt at home!

Spacious place with more than enough room for myself & my 5 adult family members. The location was very convenient as there are plenty of restaurants/bars/fast food options in walking distance. It's close enough to downtown to where Ubers are reasonably priced. I would stay here again

Clean, kind, cute, and affordable.

My family and I rented this unit this past weekend, and it was a fantastic stay! It was spotless, had plenty of linen, comfortable beds, quiet. We especially loved the location. Walkable to many nearby restaurants. I recommend.

Loved our stay at this home! The home is beautiful and so spacious. The living room/kitchen/dining room has so much space and seating to where we can all be comfortable together but then able to spread out to our separate bedrooms to relax as well. The beds were all so comfortable. Would love to stay here again in the future!

Fantastic stay! Very responsive, friendly,  and accommodating host. Beautiful space that was well cared for and nicely appointed. A wonderfully Chicago apartment in a great neighborhood. Would definitely come back.
incredible stay! great location!

Great location in Old Town. Everything about the place matched the listing. The walkability was a huge plus: coffee shops, patios, and restaurants were all just a short walk away, so we never had to think twice about getting around. Perfect base for exploring the neighborhood.

Overall a solid choice for anyone wanting to be in the middle of Old Town.
Great location and perfect amenities if you are looking for a place to stay in Chicago. We would definitely stay here again!
My stay was great! The host communicated great with me, the pictures are actually how the place looks. Very clean and nice neighborhood, peaceful.

Truly the best Airbnb I’ve stayed at. Feels like it is actually someone’s home (but nice and lacking clutter haha) rather than a sterile Airbnb which was a plus. Perfect for our girls trip, close to a street with shops, coffee, restaurants etc but also on a cute tree lined safe residential street. Not too far from anything. Everyone got a comfortable bed and was a lot more spacious than we imagined. Everything went perfectly and am grateful we found this place.
Absolutely recommend! Thanks for the great stay.
We were happy with our stay. The apartment was very large and in a walkable location.

Great place, bigger than we anticipated. Very nice host the only thing is it might not be the best for a light sleeper being close to the street even if the rooms are deep into the appartment, you can hear the street pretty well. Other than that everything was perfect

There aren't enough words to describe how great Michael and his place are. Our first time to Chicago and I had tons of questions before we arrived. Michael was so helpful answering all my questions. His airbnb was beautiful, extremely clean and very comfortable. The location is in a perfect location for anything in Wrigleyville,  on a  beautiful street. We walked to everything in the area and felt safe doing so. Micheal was the perfect airbnb host and we would definitely stay in his rental again. Have already recommended him to others.
Loved the placed good location to get to the cubs game on foot
