Best Airbnb I have ever stayed at. Una genia, como decimos en mi país. Love it. Thank you!
An amazing and spacious space in one of the best areas of Chicago!
Great communication even with us arriving hrs late and having trouble getting in Troy assisted us right away with great communication. Lovely home as well really enjoyed the space!
Came over for a cubs game. Had an awesome trip!
They were responsive, helpful, and the unit was in an amazing location!

5-star experience! It was everything we needed for our 3-person long weekend in Chicago. Our only complaint is that the bedrooms are on a busy street and the noise at night can be disruptive. Next time we'll just bring earplugs, because everything else was great!

Apartment was as advertised re space, light, decor. Spacious and in an excellent location.
Our issues had to do with the cleanliness. For what we paid for this place, I expected it to be clean. Our baby is crawling, we splurged for a fancy place. And some things were very clean - the kitchen, the linens. But the floors seemed like they hadn’t been swept or mopped in months. The HVAC filter was so caked in hair the system was spraying dust. Our feet were covered in dust and hair every time we walked barefoot and we all got stuffy noses from all the dust.
They did try to make it right. Offered to come fix it (but always during times I said we had to be in the unit with the baby napping). Eventually they dropped off a vacuum and mop and changed the filter, but our trip was almost over.
Hopefully they get it together for future guests. Our trip was made way less fun by the filthiness of this apartment. And I’m mad I wasted so much money, and time communicating with them about it.
This is the perfect Airbnb for your Chicago trip! Our host was very responsive and friendly. The place was cozy, clean , and a convenient location. Would definitely stay here again

Mimi and Paul's place was a great location. We found it easy to get around and a lot to do in the neighborhood. The place was well stocked, as described - including extra TP blankets. The washer/dryer was nice to have (be prepared to Google instructions!). Communication was excellent.
Future renters should be aware that the AC is pretty loud and the place is truly in the host's backyard - I didn't realize that from the listing, so we didn't feel comfortable opening the windows for airflow. The building is now white, not raw brick like the listing photo. It was clean enough, but could benefit from a deep clean. One set of stairs is missing a hand railing - it has a wall you can grab, but just noting in case that's something you rely on.
It was good enough and this all would be fine for a lower price point - comparing to other Chicago airbnbs, I would have expected more.
Great stay! Clean and good location.
We came to see a game at Wrigley field  and this location was very convenient.  We found it very convenient to all our needs.  Very clean and comfortable.

Lovely, spacious apartment with comfortable beds, a fully stocked kitchen, and terrific A/C. We also appreciated the great communication from the hosts and the snacks, and the amenity kits. Overall--highly recommend.

Enjoyed having a ground floor entry in this clean and comfortable accommodation in a nice neighborhood in Chicago. Seemingly a safe and relatively chill neighborhood with lots of options around for food drink and necessities. Would certainly go back.

This was the perfect place to stay! The home itself was gorgeous - the set-up, the design, the cleanliness, the coziness, it was all so comfortable for our weekend getaway. It was also in such a great location and we enjoyed walking around the neighborhood. Amazing hosts too with great communication and friendliness - absolutely would stay here again!
Definitely a gorgeous townhouse! We loved our stay and so much was within walking distance would highly recommend!
We enjoyed our stay here. It was easy to park, the neighborhood was charming and comfortable, and the host was easy to reach.

This unit was everything described and a great stay.  We were there with our twin 8 year olds and 2 year old and the  place is very well stocked for a family, has the bonus of a king bed in one bedroom and a large enough second bedroom for the crib (which was provided and was amazing).  The crib is a smaller size though, fyi.  The kitchen has everything we needed and even a high chair.  The space was an easy walk to the zoo but nice to be one street away from busy Clarke. Some of our favorite Lincoln Park restaurants were right up the street. The closet space was impressive for the city and there were plenty of blankets and non- crappy towels (so appreciated that!). We will absolutely stay here again.
Came here for a weekend getaway. Neighborhood felt very safe. The apartment was clean and supplied. Jevaux gives clear instructions about check in and check out. Would stay here again!
Host was incredibly responsive and everything was as advertised. Easy 5 Star!

The place was amazing!! I had booked for a birthday trip for my friends and I and it was honestly a great experience all around. I was nervous at first as this was the first Airbnb I had booked by myself but it met all my expectations. The home was so spacious and felt like a home away from home for all of us! The instructions for check in and check out were very clear and didn’t have any issues with getting in. I loved that the home although was on a busy road felt very private overall and the backyard with the fence allowed us to have our own private space. The Garages were a huge plus and came in handy. Only thing I’d suggest is maybe some throw blankets to have in the living room. Thank you so much for letting us stay😊

Mixed experience Fri-Sun. Pros: Great location, spacious, near transit, felt safe, easy entry, comfy beds, hot water, and awesome rooftop & 2-car garage. Host was responsive, waived early check-in fee, and reimbursed for extra face towels. Cons: Not enough supplies (linens, dishes, silverware) for the guest count. Basic kitchen tools missing (had to buy a spatula), only 2 small frying pans, and large pan missing handle. Maintenance is lacking: heavy dust on rafters, unpainted wall patches, raggedy blinds, sticky dishes we had to rewash, and a bathtub marked "do not use" with debris inside. Cleanliness remains an issue despite past reviews. Strict rules: 10:30 PM quiet hours policed by noise monitors ($750 fine), kitchen is next to neighbor's mstr bdrm. Late checkout is $25/10 mins amongst other possible fees. We felt like we were walking on eggshells. Decent space and transit, but needs updates and better quality control considering large portfolio they have. Note: There are 4 floors.

The nicest airbnb I have stayed in and Ewaz was a phenomenal host! The airbnb had everything we needed and more, from snacks to toiletries. Ewaz offered great recommendations, offered to help with anything we needed, and had the cutest fur baby!
I had a very comfortable stay. Bed was comfortable, bathroom very clean. Great location close to the Damen stop on the blue line, which goes directly to the Loop or O'Hare in the opposite direction.
Wonderful stay!
Great location, the rooms are well appointed, access and communication from the hosts were great. Room looks like pictures, would stay again

The A/C was LOUD & could benefit from some sound proofing. Lots of steps but completely manageable. Close to Second City & the El. Would recommend to any group.

This is the third time we have stayed here for a month+. We feel incredibly at home. The place has everything we need and is super convenient to the Brown Line, restaurants, and interesting neighborhoods. Karen is incredibly friendly and communicative. We will be back next year.
Tian was great.

It was our second time staying at this location and it was perfect again. Very walkable. Lots of stuff to do in the neighborhood. Home is very comfortable and had all the listed amenities and fast WiFi. Host is very responsive. Would highly recommend!
Highly rated for a reason… An excellent house in a great location. Idyllic and convenient and solid. Communicative host
Marcos was very welcoming and had a beautifully decorated apartment! It felt very homey. Great place to stay when you’re mostly out and about and looking for a simple room & cozy bed to come back to.

What a wonderful little getaway steps from Lincoln Park Zoo and the beautiful waterfront of Chicago. Nestled in the vibrate Lincoln Ave corridor, David’s place is an incredible location steps away from great restaurants, coffee shops and walking trails. If you have little kiddos this is the perfect spot for you. Just the right amount of space for you kids to wiggle around, a nice kitchenette (refrigerator, microwave and sink), everything you need! The host was even gracious enough to provide, toys, books, pack&play, highchair for our little one during the stay. Can’t say good enough things about this place and a perfect weekend getaway in the city.
Cozy place and proactive hosts. Had all amenities I needed in a peaceful spot of town too. Hosts went the extra mile to make sure everything was up to standards which I appreciate.
Great place and location. Would stay again
Great spot, tons to do in the area in walking distance, and fantastic kitchen.
We had a wonderful stay!

James was very thorough with his instructions. This made it easy to enter the rental unit.  The place is very comfortable with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. 4 of us stayed for 6 nights and found we were very well located in the city for all activities. A big bonus was having parking right outside our door.  Thank you James.

My family and I celebrated my birthday in Chicago. Odi’s property hosted us with all the latest appliances, an extremely clean atmosphere, and beautiful details throughout the home.
We were given the check in information prior to check in time and Odi offered flexibility if we needed early accommodations.
I had a question after business hours and Odi responded with clear instructions within a matter of minutes.
What I really appreciate the most is, the house looks exactly as advertised. The neighbor is not a luxury resort however it was very peaceful and no one bothered us.
Ten of my family members slept comfortably in the home and created key memories. We didn’t party however had movie nights after a days of exploring Chicago.
Every thing about this property and host was absolutely amazing
Overall the experience was good. However there was a party upstairs on the second day so it was a little noisy for sleeping.
Great location for our quick weekend trip.

We had a great stay this unit. Was close to everything. Everything was very comfortable and homey feeling. The beds was amazing  & the shower felt wonderful. It was very clean and check in was simple. It was easy to find. Parking was a small challenge but we barely needed our car with how close we were to everything. Plus easy uber/lyft drop off and pick up. We had an amazing time and stay. We will be booking this unit more often for our weekend getaways.

This location is exactly what we wanted. Being in the heart of River North and exactly a half mile from the Gold Coast and a 10 minute walk to the beach, we took advantage of it all. So many great restaurants close by in all directions.
This condo was really clean and organized with a kitchen that had everything we needed, all easy from making coffee in the morning to cooking some of our meals for dinner.
THE VIEWS were the highlight. Being on a corner unit, we had on one side the best Southern view looking at the best architectural buildings in Chicago. On the other was a Western view
Coming home was like looking at a painting of the best of Chicago.
Randy was a spectacular host and always accessible for any questions. Check in and check out was easy with Randy’s
instructions.
Thank you Randy for a great summer here.

We had a pleasant stay at this Airbnb. The place was clean and comfortable, and the host was friendly and helpful. The neighbors were also calm, which made our stay relaxing and peaceful.
One thing to note is that responses from the host sometimes took a little longer when we needed something, but he always eventually got back to us. Also, there aren’t many grocery stores nearby, so it’s best to plan ahead if you need groceries.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the cleanliness, peaceful environment, and friendly host. Thank you for having us!
A perfect spot to get to everything we needed to in the city for a friend’s wedding. Soraya was very responsive to our questions during our stay.

Can’t say enough good things about Dede’s place! It was perfect for our weekend in Chicago. Immediately we felt right at home and the little details she spent time on were so thoughtful! Would definitely recommend and we will be back!!

Colin and Courtney’s place was tastefully decorated and in a peaceful area. The walk to the Blue Line was convenient and allowed us easy access to downtown and other train stations for outer parts of the city. They checked in on us a couple times throughout the stay which I thought was very kind and they had great recommendations (latte from Four Letter Word was 10/10!) There were times where we heard footsteps but was mostly tolerable. Didn’t use the backyard much because of mosquitos. Be mindful of the minimal closet space if you don’t like living out of a suitcase. Overall, loved my stay!
Host was very responsive and helpful. Directions were very clear and made the check in and out easy. We enjoy the location

Wow, truly enjoyed Celeste’s place! It was way bigger than we thought and had every amenity we needed (paper towels, body wash, shampoo, etc). Not only was her place lovely and the building was quiet, but we also got a sweet treat by seeing the neighbors 2 kitties each day. love love love

Great place! It's in a quiet location but walking distance to bars, restaurants, coffee shops and more. The private rooftop is spacious and great to take advantage of on a nice day. The unit itself is super clean with all the amenities you'd need. I'd reserve this spot again.

Angela’s apartment is so charming and stylish! It has lots of beautiful historical details along with modern touches. The apartment was very spacious and clean, and even though it’s on a quiet block it’s close to lots of great bars and restaurants. Angela was very proactive with communication and friendly. We’re glad we had the chance to stay at her Airbnb!

We really enjoyed our stay! The home was beautiful and historic. The location was great! A quiet street in Chicago, about a 30 minute walk to Wrigley Field. Also within walking distance to several restaurants. We had plenty of space for four adults and two kids. The dedicated parking space was also super helpful! We would definitely stay here again!

This place is a real gem. Super comfortable, great location, excellent hosts. The apartment is lovely, with great decoration, superb attention to detail - everything intentional and designed to make your stay memorable. Highly recommend!

Loved my stay here and the space was a little larger than expected so that was a plus ! The place was clean and modern with a beautiful view and everything was in walking distance. If felt very safe even out at night. Also The parking deck connected to the building was closed for construction but there are other options very close by. This was an amazing experience for my first time in Chicago and I will most definitely stay here again!

Exactly like advertised!! Beautiful place, wonderful yard for dogs, very clean and cozy. Conveniently located only a 10-15 minute drive to downtown attractions, right around the corner from the tram. Host was very proactive and checked in to make sure we had everything we needed!

It was a million dollar view.  My wife spent much of our time in the unit just looking out the window. The many windows may have contributed to the A/C struggling to keep up. We were comfortable with the temp in the upper 70s, but if you like a really cool room (upper 60s - lower 70s)  you may want to be cautious when staying in the summer months. We would stay here again. Loved it!

This place in the south loop of Chicago is perfect for a friends trip or a little family get away. Me and my friends had a great weekend here. The apartment was well described and clean. Thank again Milan for the great hospitality.

This is one of the best places I’ve ever stayed. It was clean, quiet and felt like home. The owners were very responsive and ensured we had a great stay. You cannot beat the location, it is truly one of a kind. I will be coming back!
Gran lugar para quedarse y visitar la ciudad de Chicago, muy accesible al transporte público y cerca de un supermercado. Éramos un grupo de 7 personas y nos acomodamos muy bien.

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for our Chicago trip. Geo was very responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout the entire process. The space was peaceful, and having parking was definitely a plus since we drove to Chicago. My friends and I really enjoyed our stay and had a wonderful time. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you for hosting us! 😊
The place was so well appointed and had all the amenities you’d hope for in a stay. We loved it!
Great location! Plenty of restaurants and shops within walking distance.

This was my first ever booking through AirBNB and I felt so lucky to have found this listing! Fantastic location and a cozy and comfortable place with plenty of space and great features. Highly recommend! :)
Great location with plenty of space for a group!! We were able to walk to places and was a quick Uber to everything else.

Excellent place and facilities. Very clean, crisp sheets and nice bed. Though its a student like place, it would be perfect for a family too. Safe and comfortable, zero smells. Lots of places are simple walking distance saving lot of time driving and parking. The morning views are spectacular if youre an early riser. Pricing is reasonable.
The checkin and walkin-walkout protocols are a bit painful, but I guess its needed as its in dntn. The walkway carpets could need a replacement. There is some noise of the trains, but then youre in Chicago.
Would definitely stay here again!
The place was great! It had so much space to hang out and enjoy your group in a comfortable space

We had a great weekend staying here! We came for the Cubs’ game and it was a 15 minute walk to Wrigley. The apartment is within walking distance of tons of restaurants and places to shop. We were provided a pack in play for our baby, which made things tight in the bedroom due to limited space but we made it work. There are several steps to check-in; however, if you follow check-in instructions it’s really straight forward and easy. I’d recommend booking a parking spot ahead of time through SpotHero as parking is not provided. Iris is a very responsive, accommodating host and we would love to stay again when we come back to the city!

We enjoyed our stay very much. The only issue we found was with parking when it got later at night. However the space itself was great! Very nice and very clean. It looked just like the pictures and we felt very comfortable there. Overall we were very pleased with our stay and would definitely recommend.
Lovely place and rooftop. We had so much space for all of us. We loved the area.
Host kept me well informed from the start through my last night.  No issues except parking can be an issue at times.  I was lucky mist days / evenings ti get a parking spot right in front of place.

My friends and I had an amazing experience. We had our annual guys trip (7 of us) and the place had everything we needed and more. Great and safe location, plenty of space and perfect for larger gatherings.
We were in town for the Cubs game and a Notre Dame bus trip. Wrigley Field plus the bars and restaurants are all within walking distance. Also was able to take multiple morning runs along Lake Michigan!
Highly recommend
Thanks love

We paid 3,300$ for this Airbnb for 2 nights specifically for the private patio and grill. When we arrived, there was no propane tank, so we couldn’t use the grill. We also had problems with the water, and neither of the two ice makers pictured in the listing inside and outside IN UNIT worked.
I’ve traveled all over the world and stayed in many Airbnbs, and I’ve never paid this much for so little. I live down the street and have access to a pool and grilling area at home. I booked this place for my birthday weekend because I wanted its private amenities for my friends and me. Had I known they weren’t usable, I would never have booked it.
When I called about the issues, I was laughed at and told that an ice machine wasn’t listed as an amenity. Both ice makers were shown in the listing photos; guests should be able to expect pictured appliances to work. I’m still waiting for a refund. For the price we paid, this stay and the way our concerns were handled were unacceptable and disgusting

The location was great—very walkable, with lots to do nearby and plenty of restaurants, shops, and activities within easy reach. The owner was also very responsive throughout our stay!
The only downside was that the apartment had a noticeable smell of mildew/mold, which unfortunately made the stay unpleasant at times. That said, the owner was very respectful when we brought the issue to their attention and tried to find a solution to the matter.
A perfect place to stay with a large group! Very communicative and friendly. Would 100% recommend!!!
Perfect stay for our small family to be close to a friends wedding! Lots of cute shops and restaurants near-by and it was a quick walk to the zoo for an early morning activity with our toddler!
Valentina’s place was amazing.  Great location, great communication!
Tolle Unterkunft

Gary’s place is located in a great neighborhood with plenty to do! The Airbnb itself is very spacious, comfortable, and clean. He was also very responsive and kind/flexible throughout our stay.  We would definitely recommend staying here if you’re looking for a nice getaway!

Stayed here with 2 friends while visiting the Obama Presidential Center. This Airbnb is located right nearby and is clean, well taken care of, and stocked with so many amenities to make your travel lighter, easier, and comfortable. I would absolutely rebook here for future visits to Chicago! And as many reviews highlight, Fredrick is an excellent and communicative host. Check in and check out instructions were crystal clear and pain free and he responded to all my messages so quickly. Thanks again!

We really enjoyed our stay! This was honestly one of the cleanest Airbnbs I’ve stayed in. Everything was very clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The host was also super friendly and responsive.
The only things I’d mention for future guests are that one night we heard some very loud noises that sounded like gunshots. I reached out to the host that night, and she thought they may have been related to the Mexican Independence Day celebrations. There were also occasionally some noises from the tenants upstairs at night, so light sleepers may want to keep that in mind.
The only other thing I found a little confusing was having one key for the main door and another for the second door. It took a little figuring out which key was for what, so I think a keypad entry would make check-in a lot easier.
Overall, we had a great experience and really liked the Airbnb. I’d definitely stay here again!
Great host, great stay. Quiet, convenient, and well-appointed— definitely a nice spot to call home for a few days!
Great spot, tons of room!
Nice spot in a beautiful neighborhood! We stayed here in town for a show at the United Center, and the walk to and from the venue was ideal

Steve was a very responsive host, answered all our questions in a timely manner.  The accommodations were exactly as described and very entertaining for our grandson.  We went to a Cubs game and it was great to be so close to the ball park and great restaurants all within walking distance. We would definitely stay there again.  Had a great, stress-free weekend!
Beautifully clean! Well decorated. It has everything we needed and was so quiet and peaceful in the city. Great stay for three friends celebrating their birthday.
Awesome place to stay!

Great location near so many food and coffee shops! Near train and bus stop.
We had left items and the host was very helpful in getting items back!
Thanks!
The hosts were extremely responsive and friendly. The apartment was attractive and comfortable with AC during the warm September days and nights.
Great location!  Host was super communicative.
Great stay

We enjoyed our stay at Margaret’s. It is centrally located close to many restaurants, but still felt private and quiet. The place is clean and has all the amenities we needed. Loved the large tub for relaxing (didn’t mess not having a shower at all), and the small kitchen area with a machine for cold water, kettle for tea, and mini fridge. Would recommend for anyone visiting Chicago.

The space was well-decorated, centrally located, and surprisingly large. We had a pleasant stay, and Andrei was very responsive to our needs throughout. We would definitely stay here again next time we visit Chicago!
Margaret’s place was perfect for our family including our 4 and 2 year old. Great walkable neighborhood with so many restaurants and a great playground in the park across the street.

Tamiz was amazing. He was responsive, laid back, and had amazing hospitality. He made sure I was comfortable and enjoying my stay the entire time. I highly recommend. Remi and Rupa are adorable as well!!
Beautiful and clean place! Was close to the CTA train station, which was very nice! Restaurants and grocery were within walking distance! Would highly recommend this place!!
Super responsive and friendly host! Apartment was clean and had everything needed. Check in went super smoothly. Would recommend!
Great place to stay on the north side. Close to the train station, with plenty to do in the neighborhood as well. Very quiet and friendly surroundings.

My dad and I took a father-daughter trip to Chicago to watch our home town team play the white Sox and cubs back to back! This Airbnb was exactly what we needed and an amazing location! Free street parking made it so I parked my car right outside and did not have to use my car again until we left! The neighborhood was very safe and charming. Sebastian was quick to respond and gave recommendations about the local area! Will definitely book again if I return to Chicago!
Great place and host.  Was worried about the permit parking limitations on Albany, but easily found street parking close by.
Great stay
Love this place .Book it !!! It’s in the middle of everything.

Lois and Eduardo's place was perfect for a weekend in Roger's Park for a family wedding.  It was spotless, the hosts were friendly, and the room with the king-sized bed was super comfy!  The street is quiet too but close to the subway if you want to go elsewhere in Chicago.  There is plenty to walk to as well.  We were happy with everything and the price was reasonable as well.
All good
Good place to stay!  Reinovated and clean

The place is exactly what you need for a quick staying: comfortable and clean room, clean and spacious place to eat your meals, and a clean bathroom. The thing that I liked the most about this experience was Juanita; she’s one of the nicest people I’ve ever had the pleasure to meet. She doesn’t hesitate to help you if you need something during your stay and she cares for keeping the house clean and comfortable.
I’ll be staying there again if I have the pleasure, no doubt about it.

This was a great stay! Exactly as advertised, very clean, with easy check in and check out. There's a bus stop outside that takes you directly to the main area with the Bean, parks, etc.
I'd definitely stay here again.

Heidi’s place was very clean, safe, and spacious. The room had a comfy and clean bed, fresh linens, a desk and an area for hanging clothes. She was very helpful and knowledgeable about getting around. I appreciated her hospitality.
The bathroom is shared, since this is a home with different rooms for booking, but everything was quiet, clean and I enjoyed my time. Thank you.
Thank you Sheena for an amazing stay! You are an awesome host! Everything was wonderful. You didn’t miss a thing! I’ll book with you every time I visit Chicago!

Great location for the riverwalk and loop area, max 15 minute walk to the red, blue and brown lines. Well stocked with amenities and the rooftop area was a really nice bonus.
The only downsides are the beds and lounge area are not super comfortable, perfectly fine but I wouldn’t say it’s a cozy place.
Great access to public transit, great place for the price!
The home is maintained beautifully. The hosts are responsive too. They provide timely responses. They had plenty of games, books  and so much to do together

Billy was a great host and very responsive. He let my friends check in a little earlier, which was very nice of him. This place was awesome! The neighborhood is perfect. It’s so cute, charming, fun lots of places to walk to including shops, restaurants, and bars. The space was great. It’s actually bigger than I thought it was gonna be. It looks really nice on the inside and was clean and had everything we needed. The washer and dryer was awesome to be able to use as well.  My only complaint, which I think is mentioned in other reviews, is that the walls and ceiling are very thin. You can hear every move of the people upstairs. This is obviously out of the owner’s control, so it is nothing against them. But if you are a light sleeper, they will wake you up early in the morning. Just something to think about.
Guys weekend - great space and location!

This place is absolutely beautiful, with such a unique vibe! We loved the private outside balcony space! Our host was absolutely amazing and we felt so thought of with the snacks, wonderful coffee, and anything we could have needed, which was in the home. She provided ample opportunity for me to ask questions and for her to offer suggestions for things to do in the area. I was able to secure street parking in front of the stay, and took the train and used a car service to get around. We sincerely enjoyed our stay!
Great location!  Close to many restaurants and entertainment.
We enjoyed our stay at James’s place! The apartment was very clean and nice. The location was great. Close to restaurants and shops, and convenient to the Blue Line to go downtown.
Apartment was comfortable and close to L which made for easy travel south to Wrigley Field and north to Evanston for the folk festival. Comfy beds and clean al around.

Great hosts, but unfortunately, we probably wouldn’t stay here again.
Like many others, we chose this place because of the price and location, which were both great. However, having all five bedrooms booked with only one bathroom for eight people was difficult and made things pretty inconvenient.
The beds were also not very comfortable and felt more like sleeping on a futon than a typical bed.
That being said, the hosts were excellent. They were very responsive, quick to answer any questions, and easy to communicate with. We really appreciated that
Great stay easy to get to and great location
Quiet neighborhood with free street safe parking. Target walking distance. Cozy apartment. Loved the stay!
Great place to stay !

Could not have asked for a better experience! My friends and I met up for a long weekend in Chicago. Cheryl was very flexible with our check-in and check-out which saved us on needing to store our luggage. Getting in was super easy and check-out instructions were easy and clear. Cheryl was also quick to respond to any questions we had. Place was exactly as advertised. Beds were plenty comfortable and kitchen had plenty of dishes and utensils. Most bath towels I have ever seen available at any Airbnb and all thicck, high quality. The location was unbeatable. Five minute walk to the Brown and Purple lines for quick and affordable access to downtown. And only 10 minutes to another stop for Red line access to Wrigley. Lincoln Park is also a great area. Plenty of good restaurants and bars nearby. Would absolutely book this place again!
Cynthia was a wonderful host! The home is cozy and quiet and had everything we needed!
The place was clean, cozy, and perfect as a little retreat while spending time in the city.

Excellent place to stay! Fun location in the city that’s walkable to plenty of shops, restaurants, and bars. The apt was exactly as described the host was very helpful and responsive! Easy check in/check out.

A perfect location and a perfect host! Exceeded all my expectations. Truly it was the best part of my trip to Chicago. Rebecca knew about a live jazz concert at Harpers Square over the lunch hour and we enjoyed a meal of jerk chicken al fresco. Easy walking in the Hyde Park neighborhood and you couldn't possibly find anything closer to the Obama Center than out the front door and across Midway Pl. The second floor apartment is clean and classy. Slept extremely well, comfortable bed. Quiet and peaceful. I'll be recommending it to friends when they visit Chicago because it showcases the best of Hyde Park.
Michelle’s place was just as described before booking. The street was peaceful and easy to access the major highways. It was clean and spacious. We enjoyed our stay with no issues.
The space was very comfortable and had nice artistic touches. We particularly enjoyed petting the super friendly orange kitty who met us by the front yard.

Loved staying at this Air BnB. We were in town for a Cubs game walked to the field and back very peaceful. Great pizza place around the corner. No issues with parking! Very close to bus and train stops we were able to use also! We will definitely be back!
Great, responsive host.  Spacious interior, 3 BR.  Nice bathroom/shower, comfy beds/bedding.  One BR is on Fullerton, may want to bring earplugs/sound machine for sleeping in that room.
Love this place so much!! Great location, close to L, and beautifully done interior. Would love to stay here again!
So great to stay here with family, highly recommend for a group and would stay again!

Great place! Easy access to the United Center as well as Wicker Park, Logan Square, and beyond. Garage parking was easy and a nice perk. We would definitely stay here again!

Absolutely amazing stay from beginning to end! Everything about this place was excellent. The home was very clean, comfortable, spacious, and had everything we needed for a great stay.
The neighborhood was very safe, quiet, and peaceful, which was especially important to us. We felt comfortable the entire time. The location was also great and made getting around very convenient.
The host was wonderful, communication was easy, and everything was exactly as described. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience.
I would 100% stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. Truly a 5-star experience in every way! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Great space in Lakeview, very walkable including a nice, easy stroll to Wrigley.
Excellent stay. Would recommend

It’s not the best area of Chicago (South loop) but my friends and I (all former Chicago residents) wanted to stay close by to the venue of a wedding we were attending so it worked for our purposes! We just wish the apartment had a full length mirror - it was hard to dress for the event without that.
Denzilt was very responsive and check-in was super easy. The place is easy to find and the price is pretty good. Lots of room for the 5 of us
Very good location; met our needs for a weekend trip with multiple family members.

This was my first time staying in an Airbnb with kids (ages 4 and 7), and Caleb's place was perfect! It was spacious -- the bedrooms and living spaces were large and comfortable -- and we had everything we needed. The play room was a really nice touch, and the giant giraffe and tiny tea set were a hug hit. Caleb was also friendly and accommodating throughout. We chose the location to be near family, but we love this part of town -- it's filled with quiet, tree-line streets and walkable to Anne Sather.
Everything was perfect and Carla was very responsive we came from Ohio and will be coming back on the 23rd for a postponed concert i will look into this one if available Thankyou

Ken’s space was the optimal respite during a recent weekend trip to Chicago for a friend’s wedding. Fun and musical decor helped energize us while getting ready to go out, and it was far enough removed from the city noise to let us chill out and relax between events. Its proximity to the 606 allowed for some lovely morning walks!
Lissette’s place was great! Very clean and included all the needed amenities. It’s in a convenient location, walking distance to great bars and restaurants and incredibly close to the blue line.

This place is a gem. It had everything we needed and then some, it was clean and comfortable, the hosts were responsive and even left us snacks and champagne and local ground coffee. Great walkable neighborhood, lots to do, close enough to the train station to catch the brown line downtown. Would totally stay again.
Excelente lugar para quedarse en Chicago unos dias
Amazing location and comfortable home. Rasheed was always responsive and helpful. Highly recommended

Truly a wonderful place. Great location if you wanna be close to downtown. Easily accessible CTA and Bus tops. Aside from excessive amounts of motorcycles going a good portion of day and night the place was quiet. And honestly assuming that’s because the weather was so nice. All the windows let in tons of light. If I need to stay so far into downtown again I’ll definitely be looking for Milan’s properties again.

This was simply the best for our annual Cubs weekend get together. The neighborhood is fantastic and quiet. Lots of restaurants and markets right around the corner. The brown line metro station is just two blocks away. Right into Wrigley just a few minutes away.
And the back patio is a total highlight of the property. Fresh flowers, an outdoor living room with couches, a gazebo, and even a big screen tv! We got back from the game and were still able to lounge and watch some football in the evening. Honestly leaving the property felt like a chore as it was so inviting and comfortable.
We are looking forward to coming back next year. Immaculately clean and spacious, wonderfully welcoming host. I can't imagine anybody not being thrilled with this space. What a treat in a great neighborhood. Thanks again Paul for your hospitality!
Great space, great location. No complaints

Space was clean, smelled nice and was cute like the pictures on the inside. The only small issue, which we never even brought up because it was so small, was it was quite warm in the bedroom even with the ac set low in the living room. Wish we had asked for a fan. The doors are heavy in the place so there is often banging but we are used to noise. It is worth noting this place does share a door with another apartment through the kitchen. No issue for us but worth mentioning. There was so much in walking distance. Midori was our favorite by far. All in all, wonderful stay and would 100% stay here again.

host was super kind, communicative, and helpful. and the apartment was fairly clean and comfortable.
with that being said the overall experience was not very good. due to a horrible smell of weed and cigarettes in the apartment, i could tell it was coming from the unit below but the smell filled the apartment. saturday after being gone all day we got back and i opened the door and there was like a haze in the apartment because of the apartment below. i hate to write a review like this because it was a nice place and seemed fairly well taken care of but the smell was overwhelming. i got home and now have a sinus infection because of the smell and haze across the apartment. i would not recommend to anyone who’s not use to being around a weed and cigarette filled environment. and one last thing if you park i suggest you uber around because if you move your spot will get taken i had to park down the street saturday night because my spot was taken and had to walk in the dark to the bnb.

Loved the location of the apartment! It was very simple to navigate landing at ohare, taking the blue line and then walking to the apartment. It was super clean and I appreciated how many a/c units there were (and a fan) for someone who is typically always hot. There are two reasons this apartment is more of a 4/5 stars- having to worry about house keys on vacation while most airbnbs have keyless/ code entry is a bit of an annoyance. Also the “couch” is very uncomfortable lol it’s basically metal bars with little to no cushion. I understand airbnbs aren’t decked out in quality furniture but having somewhere a little more comfortable to sit  would be recommended. All that being said I would definitely book again!
Great place. The location was wonderful. Check in was easy. Very very responsive. Allowed for early check-in for our group.

This Airbnb is amazing. Probably the best I’ve stayed in. Really homely feel to the place and the owners are so friendly and nice.

There are  plenty of restaurants within walking distance. The apartment was clean and uncluttered and has upgraded appliances , gas for cooking .  The kitchen , living/dining  area and bedroom are large with plenty of closet space , and a small bathroom .  It does have central air rather than window units which is a big plus in these older buildings .  The  drawbacks in the old buildings are the squeaky hardwood floors and lack of an elevator .

The location was very convenient, with a direct bus to downtown. The room was very clean and comfortable, and I had a great stay overall. The only thing was that it felt a little warm while sleeping at night.

Tere was very responsive and confirmed my reservation within only a few moments after me having to book very last minute.
Very responsive on any questions I had, and gives you a really in-depth document describing how to get inside, wifi, ext.
Would definitely stay here again.

Very responsive host. Check In and check out was simple. No drama and the house was setup and ready to go. The wifi was very good. Fast, stable and could handle all of our devices (it was 6 of us). They even provided olive oil and salt and pepper. That was a nice surprise. The TVs were smart TVs and easy to operate. Also they had some laundry detergent and dryer sheets so we could wash a few items while we were there. The showers and bathrooms were good as well. I'm 6' 2" so I was pleased when I saw they had the shower heads placed high enough to comfortably wash my hair. The beds were comfortable with high quality firm mattresses, which were good for my back.
If I ever visit Chicago in the future, I will look for this place. A really nice stay.

This spacious apartment is in an ideal location for guests that enjoy walking the city. It is an airy well lit interior. The great room is wonderful for relaxing. Bedrooms are spacious and the beds are very comfortable.
Great location; vibrant neighborhood with lots of restaurant choices.  This was the perfect place to use as base to explore Chicago.
I had a pleasant experience at Nelson’s place and will definitely recommend it to anyone interested in getting around Chicago.

Me and my family stayed here, 4 adults and 2 kids. It was the best location, next to wrigley field and the train. Couldn’t have found a better spot. TJ was extremely proactive with his communication, the best host I’ve ever had when booking an Airbnb. Great location 10/10 would recommend to anyone with families or large groups. We hope to stay here again when we visit Chicago!
Really nice place, would stay there again! Great for large groups!

Aitor is such a warm and kind person! He was very friendly, welcoming, and always willing to help with anything I needed. I really enjoyed staying here and truly appreciate all his help and kindness. Thank you so much for everything🥹🫶🏻🥰
Amazing place, awesome host, has everything you need and more—highly recommend!
I had a really comfortable stay in Kim’s apartment. It was just what I was looking for, and I would definitely recommend it to everyone looking for a stay in the area!
This is our second stay at Barry and Charlene's. It is convenient to Logan Square with lots to do. A very comfortable house on a quiet street.

hubbard holdings was a great stay! the area was wonderful and close to everything. we loved how easy it was to walk to restaurants around us and all of the other main attractions of chicago. the private terrace is worth the stay alone! communication was on point and quick- couldn’t ask for anything more. thanks for the great stay!

My husband and I definitely enjoyed our stay here! The home was very clean and orderly. Ruby communicated directions and instructions ahead of time, which was very helpful. She also sat out a playpen for our little one to use during our stay! 🤍
The kitchen was a big plus since there was every thing you would need. Thank you Ruby for a wonderful stay.
Loved my stay here. The place was clean and as expected. The area is nice with a great park not too far. Very walkable area and easy to get transportation.

Great place to stay. The unit itself has everything you need and makes the most of the space. Small (but big) things like powerful A/C, good shower, and comfortable bed with a wireless phone charger made the experience that much more enjoyable.
As far as location, there is the Southshore CTA line a few minutes walking distance from the unit, and there was a good amount of street parking along Barry Ave (paid and unpaid, might need to circle the block a couple of times to find it). Nice and quiet neighborhood with cool restaurants nearby. Overall I would love to stay here again!
Amazing space! They have so many cool amenities and a bar/rooftop literally right next to/attached to the building. Host was super nice and always responsive! Would love to stay again
Great location right next to the blue line, responsive host. Would recommend.
a cute apartment that is within walking distance of so many great things in the city
I really enjoy Laura place , A lot of space for a family , parking is a little crazy because you do have to walk thru a alley to get there .. the kitchen was big , the bed was comfortable…
Had a great stay at Marije’s place! Just know the train is very audible but earbuds are provided. I lived right above the brown line when I was in Chicago so it wasn’t a major issue for me.
Very spacious and affordable with great amenities. It was perfect for our stay. Thanks!
great stay!
Great location in the heart of downtown Chicago.
The place was super clean and in a very cozy neighborhood! Would definitely stay again (:
She was quickly to respond she was very nice she made sure the house was clean and extra towels the apartment is very cozy and worth vibing in

We enjoyed our stay! The apartment was spacious, bright, and filled with beautiful plants. The beds were comfortable, the location was convenient, and the neighborhood was surprisingly quiet. Nikkole was incredibly kind and accommodating. Thank you!
Amazing property in the heart of Wicker Park. Exceeded expectations!
Spotlessly clean, very comfy bed and sofa, good shower,  very well equipped kitchen. We had everything we could possibly need. Very good neighbourhood and very quiet. Highly recommended.
I enjoyed my stay at this location. The host was very responsive and my stay was enjoyable!

Julio has a beautiful home in Chicago. Walkable to some great restaurants and bars. Easy access to the express to go to downtown or walkable distance to the train. Would absolutely recommend this spot to family and friends
Such a great spot for me. Needed something central and affordable to crash between travel. Place was quiet, comfortable, and clean. Thank you!
Very kind and responsive hosts. We stayed with a toddler and enjoyed our time. Great transit options and everything you need a short walk away.
ありがとうございました！
I would 1000% stay here again. they accommodated me be letting me drop my bags off before check in so i didn’t have to carry them around all day.
Simple and efficient room.

We absolutely loved our stay at Karen’s apartment. It was beautifully decorated, very clean and had everything you would need provided.
The location was ideal, right by the beach and multiple bus stops and ‘L’ train stop. The neighbourhood felt very safe and other residents of the apartment were very friendly.
We started our stay in Chicago downtown to do all the main sightseeing, and then moved to Karen’s apartment for a more relaxing beach vacation, however, the public transport was so good that you could get into the centre of Chicago in ~30 mins very cheaply. My only regret for our stay is not spending the whole time here.
Karen was a lovely host, very responsive and accommodating. She gave us great recommendations for local restaurants and bars, and was very flexible with check in/out times to best suit us.
I would 100% recommend this apartment, and would be keen to stay in it again if I ever return to Chicago.
Thank you!

Great place to stay in the city! Walking distance to lots of fun stuff! Great bars and restaurants, Oak St., Beach and the pier are just around the corner. For downtown Chicago the rooms are actually a decent size!
The St. Clair was great. We look forward to our next trip to Chicago and the St. Clair.
The St. Clair was a great location for our Chicago trip. Everything was great!
Lincoln square was a great place to call home for a week. Host was super responsive and the space was comfortable and clean!!
This location and LIVN are becoming my go to destination to stay when I visit Chicago. And I visit a lot. They are top notch!
Très joli appartement où nous pouvons que nous sentir bien et à l’aise, il ne manque rien et est bien situé.
Extremely convenient and quiet/private location close to the Brown line. We loved this unit and wouldn't hesitate to stay here again!

This was a great place to stay for our quick trip to Chicago.

Before you go, would definitely check out their website on how to locate and get in just to avoid any confusion. Was very helpful before we arrived.
Host communicates quickly and would certainly stay here again.
Great location, clean, modern. Great communication with owner. Professional. This will be my “go to” when visiting Chicago!

This place was perfect for our family.  Beautiful home and very clean. The beds are very comfortable as well. It's a peaceful area about thirty minutes from downtown. Overall we really enjoyed our stay!
We really enjoyed our stay! The apartment was very nice and the location was great! Lots to do in the area and walkable. We would definitely stay here again ☺️
Todo excelente, el Departamento muy bueno.

It was everything I needed with a gorgeous view

Older building but the people who live there are all very welcoming and happy, I had an amazing experience and would stay again

Abels place was very clean and in a great location.  Plenty of restaurants and shops nearby. Abel communicated effectively  and very friendly, before arrival and was available and responsive upon arrival .

My favorite Chicago Airbnb! Sue is a delightful host that I would happily recommend every time. Her home is so comfortable, with every need carefully considered. Located on a beautiful walkable street with ample parking, you’d be hard pressed to find better.
It’s really awesome to live this place. Laura is very nice and patient! They provide great service for us.
Will probably book another stay in the future. Very calm place.

Nuestra experiencia fue muy buena. La casa estaba muy limpia, organizada y tenía todo lo necesario: toallas, jabones, plancha, utensilios, etc. Todo estaba muy bien preparado y cuidado. The bed is comfortable, communication is quick, my needs were fulfilled. At the same time, there are quite a few rules to navigate, and there are potentially a number of different airbnb customers staying at once, giving it a hostel-like feeling.
Cool place well designed, good location would definitely stay again

My stay in Chicago was great, the apartment was perfect & the location just what I needed.

Highly recommended!

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was incredibly clean and in such a great location. We loved how walkable the area was, with so much nearby to explore. The directions and check-in instructions were very clear and made everything easy from the moment we arrived.
Mera was fantastic with communication—very responsive, helpful, and made sure we had everything we needed. The space was comfortable, well kept, and a great home base for our time in Chicago. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!

Danielle's place was amazing and we'll definitely be coming back when we visit Chicago again! Super convenient location in a quiet street but steps away from coffee shops and restaurants. The apartment itself had everything we could have asked for and was clean and comfortable. Danielle went above and beyond, providing a basket of toys for our toddler and allowing us to drop our bags off hours before the reservation started. She always responded super quickly as well!
This airbnb was really beautiful, the shared kitchen was nice, the room was really clean and the whole place smelled amazing. 10/10 id definitely come back. Looks just like the picture.
Alojamiento en una zona ideal. Demitri estuvo siempre pendiente para ayudarnos y responder a nuestras preguntas. Volveremos!! Muchas gracias por todo!!

We asked the host directly whether it was safe to park on the street near the unit around 9pm. The host assured us in writing that the neighborhood was "safe" and that street parking was "generally available in our safe neighborhood." Based on that direct assurance, we parked on the street as instructed.
During our stay, our car's catalytic converter was stolen while parked exactly where the host told us it would be safe to do so. We filed a police report and are out of pocket for the huge repair.
The unit itself was okay, but be aware that the host's assurances about street safety did not hold up, and there is no private or secured parking option at this property.
Great place in lakeview walking distance to a ton of grocery stores and restaurants!

This place was very great to us during our stay. Beautiful home with a great location in wicker park. Everything felt very walkable and safe. On-site parking if needed, but be careful as it is a bit tight if you have a bigger car (it wasn't a problem with our SUV). The train is lightly audible in the distance. I only noticed it while I was trying to sleep and only lasts a few seconds, but overall it didnt bother us. Hien was very friendly, helpful, and responsive.

This place was an absolute pleasure and I loved my stay. The apt is super cozy and charming. Also very safe/accessible with lots of restaurants in walking distance. Multiple transit options literally just around the corner.
Was a cute clean place
Great location, responsive host, and a nice stay while in Chicago.
This stay is located in a very convenient location. Matt has thought of everything that's needed for the guest to be comfortable.
Great responsive host !

We’ve stayed at this apartment a few times now and consider it perfect for our needs. The location in Lincoln Square is excellent; a brief jaunt past Welles Park to the square proper, and within feet of two excellent diners and a great dinner spot.
The unit is spacious and I’d particularly recommend it to families. Decor is quite artistic; the living room integration of the wall paint and decorative paintings is quite inspired. Two beds in shared space on top floor; good privacy for master bedroom and another small bedroom on main floor.
Kitchen is well-appointed with another island that is nice for family meals.
Wifi fast and reliable with at least two good surfaces for laptop work, plus the kitchen. The one upstairs gets good natural light, which I find is a plus in Chicago for working during e.g. winter.
Billy is a great host with good communication. We would happily stay here again should life bring us back.
Very responsive, and place is in a great location right near busses!
It was spacious and comfortable.  It was very easy for the 4 of us to be together in the space.  I loved the location so close to so many amenities.
Very responsive. Great location.

We loved our stay! Reed’s apartment was the perfect size for myself and toddler. It was extremely clean, organized, and comfortable. There were fresh towels, filtered water in the refrigerator, amazing shower products (I actually tried the shampoo and plan on adding it to my hair routine), and a fully stocked kitchen for cooking and dining. Lovely neighborhood as well!

The sloth apartment is stunning. The pictures are exactly what you will find when you arrive. It smells amazing when you walk in and there’s so much light and lots of lovely, thoughtful details. to take in.  Everything is immaculate and beautiful, but it’s not just a pretty face. The well appointed kitchen and bath, large screen tv, comfy sofa, bed & pillows  all make the space comfortable as well. We felt very safe and very private in our apartment. We are two small town kids and staying in the city can sometimes feel a little daunting. But we felt safe and even enjoyed the soft woosh of the train going by.  Everything was just perfect, and we will definitely want to stay with Andris again!
Great place and location. Plus the beds were very comfortable!
Great host and space. It worked well for my needs. I work from home and had no problems with internet and the space was mostly quiet.

Perfect for our needs! We traveled to Chicago to move our daughter so she could start her new job. This location was perfect for our needs. We had a pickup truck full of items to move. Unfortunately, the Chevy Silverado was too long to fit in the garage, but the garage was still super handy for storing items until we could take them to our daughter's apartment. I don't know what we would have done if we didn't have access to the garage!
We were all comfortable in the space and it was nice to feel like we were "home" after a long day of moving and setting up a new apartment.

Thank you, Nicole and Matt, for a beautiful, comfortable place to stay.
Beautiful place. not to far from city, hosts were lovely and quick to help
Home was beautiful and very well appointed. Walls don’t reach ceiling so a little loud with 3 people but overall, lived our stay. Thank you!!

The hosts were very helpful and communication was exceptional. It’s in a great location, walkable to restaurants, the train station and bus, the food co-op and a quick trip on the train from O’Hare. There were thoughtful details that made it easy to relax and start our vacation right away. I would definitely stay here again, very comfortable place to stay.

We had a great overall stay. The place is in the middle of a popular shopping area and adjacent to lots of public transit. The hosts were very responsive and flexible. As mentioned, the place sits directly next to a train line, but the train noise did not bother us at all at night.

This lovely apartment is near public transportation that will get you anywhere in the city. Jefferson Park offers much entertainment and some excellent restaurants. I would definitely come back to this apartment.
Amazing stay!!! The host is wonderful to work with ❤️
They were very nice hosts, and the place is very close to restaurants, transportation, stores.
Tim's place was recommended to me by a relative who had stayed a couple of years ago as it was ideally located for my purposes and reasonably priced. The garden room was private and quiet.

This was an incredibly beautiful and centrally located apartment in River North. We stayed on the highest floor and had amazing views on both sides of the building. The apartment was luxurious, spacious, and very clean.
The host was easy to reach and highly communicative. We had a small issue during check-in, but the host handled it very quickly, so we didn’t have to wait long.
The location is excellent, with everything easily accessible. If you’re coming from the airport, public transportation is a great option: from the Clark/Lake station, it’s only about a 10-minute walk to the apartment and much cheaper than taking a rideshare.
We absolutely recommend this place and would happily stay here again!
Everything was great

I stayed at Evelyn's place for about a month. I was pleased with my stay in every way. The apartment was probably one of the cleanest I've ever stayed at; Evelyn is super friendly and helpful. The apartment, with all of it's amazing artwork is really fun to be in. The neighborhood is lively and easy to get around - I had no car and public transport is super easy from this location. Thank you Evelyn!

Trove was very quick to respond to any queries we had.
Would highly recommend this appartment.
clean space in a good location
Great place to stay! Rebecca is very responsive

The great thing is that the place is very well conected with metro, you can arrive at the touristic places in the Red Line. Lewis was pending every time and solved all our doubts.
Perfect stay!

We stayed at this Airbnb for a show at the United Center. Excellent location, spacious, clean and comfortable! We had a great time walking around, shopping and eating out. Andriy gave lists of recommendations prior to our stay, which was helpful! The garage parking was a huge bonus. Highly recommend!
loved this house me and my family enjoyed it, the host were very friendly and accommodating definitely would book again

Thank you so much for an amazing stay. I would definitely come back so that I can enjoy the place in the neighborhood a little more.

We enjoyed our stay at this airbnb. It is bigger than it looks and it provides everything a big group needs. This is a great place to stay and would defitnely recommend.

The location could not be beaten, the host was responsive with the stupid questions I asked, and the free parking in downtown Chicago was an incredible perk.  Enjoyed our stay and would recommend this place to others.
We loved our stay - Samuel was also very responsive and helpful during our stay. Thank you!

Great place in a quiet neighborhood. Very close to the Blue Line and many grocery stores and restaurants nearby. The ping pong board at the basement and the basketball hoop at the backyard kept our kids busy. The hosts Tamara and Carlos are very responsive and accommodating. We would definitely recommend it.

Excellent place. Very, very clean. Everything spotless. Easy to get in. Host/Owner very nice and thorough and responsive. A plus! Stay there without worry. Also great parking and location. A+++++++++++++++
Marissa was a wonderful, helpful, and responsive host! Very kind and gracious. Would absolutely book again!

Loved Laura’s place. Close to a lot of places to eat, shops and bars that are walkable as well as everything we wanted to do within minutes drive! Neighborhood is quiet and loved the free street parking that was also available along with the assigned parking spot. The sunlight that comes through the windows in the evening is very beautiful and worth opening the drapes.

Very comfortable and well appointed garden apartment. The kitchen had a nice variety of dishes and utensils, and everything necessary to start the morning off with tea or coffee. Super comfy bed with ample pillows and blankets, other bedding for colder nights. The bathroom was well stocked with toiletries and towels.  Walkable to shopping, dining, groceries and multiple modes of transportation. This is an Airbnb I will gladly return to for future Chicago visits
Booked a last minute trip for business. This is exactly what we needed and worked well to be near the airport and downtown:
Everything was excellent. Beautiful space, spotlessly clean, great instructions and pics to help find it and check in, easy check out process. The location is phenomenal. Pretty perfect.
The plane was perfect.   Felt at home.   Some road noise at front of house but very quiet in the bedrooms.   Slept like a baby.   Highly recommend.   Will rent again.
very quiet inside..I never heard any other tenants and a bathroom was always available

This unit is small but very eclectic and funky in all the right ways.
The location is great with easy access to all Roscoe Village has to offer. The hosts were very accommodating and responsive.
We picked this particular Airbnb because of the location and style. It looked like very interesting space and well decorated, which it was. You can tell the furnishings and decor were curated by someone who knows interior design and style.
The disappointing part was that the unit is “tired” and needs some attention to details. Fresh paint and a few repairs would go a long way. That said, we still really enjoyed our two nights. Location is perfect and hosts were great!

It is located within walking distance to the subway, plus it has good amenities in the kitchen. However, it is a little bit noisy in the night due to traffic, and we would have appreciated it if shampoo and soap had been provided.
We couldn’t have asked for a better location! Perfect stay for our group

“My cousin and I stayed for about 10 days and had a fantastic experience. The place was spotlessly clean, and the location worked perfectly for both of us. Honestly, we felt right at home! Would definitely recommend and return.”
The host was very friendly, helpful, and easy to communicate with. Thank you for the stay!
We had a very comfortable stay. Their home is cozy, clean, and has everything for a family including video games. The neighborhood is quiet. I felt very safe. I highly recommend this home.
I had a great time at Sean's place! Cozy and clean! About 5 mins walk to pink line. Sean is very kind and responsive. I'd love to stay here again!

Great little place to stay. Nothing crazy in terms of things right in neighborhood to do but close to local transportation to head into the heart of Chicago. Very clean place. Can definitely hear the upstairs people but wasn’t at insane hours. Would stay again.
TA I M S is always accommodating with their spaces. I highly recommend if you want a good downtown location with great service, comfortability , and a luxe homey feel.

Inga’s flat was spotless and she thought of everything. Although small, she provided all possible amenities from extra towels and blankets to coffee maker with coffee and filters, a very comfortable bed, comfortable couch and even left waters and soft drinks in the refrigerator. It has a huge closet, shelves and a dresser to use. It was very comfortable and locoated in a perfect spot in Lincoln Park. Highly recommend!
Really enjoyed my stay.  close proximity to downtown.  Will definitely rent again.

Damien really went above and beyond for our stay here. The unit was clean and well-kept, and we appreciated the snacks and refreshments. Check-in and check-out was a breeze, and Damien was super responsive when we had questions or in the event of any updates. The location is nice, too - tucked away and quiet, but still walking distance from the L. We had a great time staying here!

We had a wonderful time staying at Michael's place in Chicago. The neighborhood was perfect, with so many shops and restaurants within walking distance and very easy to get to public transit. Michael's place had everything we needed for our stay. Lovely view from the third floor, very quiet, and clean. We'd love to stay again for our next visit.
An incredible stay with an incredible host!

I travel a lot for work and pleasure and stay at many different locations. I hardly take the time to review simply because most places are nice, but nothing to take time out of my day to dive into.
This is not that. Isaac's place was SO nice. It surpassed what we were expecting and was a really lovely home. It felt curated to be warm and welcoming, without feeling sterile or impersonal. I was in town for business but brought the family along and everyone loved it.
In addition to the house being wonderful, the neighborhood was super walkable and fun. We ate close to the home several times and it is so accessible to public transportation. We frequently took either the train or the bus back to homebase. Isaac gave us some recommendations and was very responsive any time I had a question. He also didn't have weird check out times and allowed us to leave our bags there until our flight.
I strongly recommend this gem and if I ever go back to Chicago this will be the place I return to!

For the location and price, it’s fine. The kitchen is nice, spacious, and clean. Everything else is just okay. The bed is not that comfortable and the water pressure in the shower is not great. No issues with WiFi. Hyde Park is a really nice and walkable area.
La descripción es acorde con el departamento, está céntrico ya que el metro está muy cerca y los autobuses también.
We had a great stay here in Chicago and hope to stay again in the future

The location is great, you can walk to all the tourist spots around, everything is about a 20 minute walk.  The staff is friendly and helpful, the room spacious a big enough for two people. My one complaint was the mattress (extremely soft) had a hard time sleeping, also could not figure out the shower handle, didn’t work properly. Our room was next to the elevator and you could hear the elevator going up and down throughout the night.
This is a very nice place to stay, everything we wanted to do was close and walkable. Would definitely recommend!

I rarely write bad reviews but Kasa’s customer service was absolutely awful!
I booked 3 nights which cost around $1,000.
It was HOT in Chicago and the A/C was completely inoperable for 2 of the 3 days.
They offered me $70 in compensation then reduced that to $67 the following day with no explanation. The dish washer was also completely broken.
In the end I gave up. I said I’d file a report with air bnb. I’m an 8 year super host with multiple Airbnbs. This is NOT how you treat people.
Waste of money…awaiting the intervention of air bnb..
Kasa stop using AI to respond to real people!!
Great spot! We appreciated the keyless entry, the AC, and parking passes. The apartment is a ~20 min walk from the blue line, but there's nice cafes and breweries much closer, too.

We had a fantastic stay and would highly recommend this accommodation. The apartment was extremely clean, comfortable and very well equipped. As international travellers, we were travelling light, so having everything we needed in the apartment made a big difference and was especially appreciated.
The neighbourhood felt very safe, and we really enjoyed the walk to Belmont CTA station, which made getting into downtown Chicago easy and convenient.
Wilma was a wonderful host, very responsive, helpful and easy to communicate with. Communication was excellent throughout the booking process and during our stay.
Overall, a great apartment in a great neighbourhood with a fantastic host. We would happily stay here again!

I’ve searched for and stayed at many dog-friendly places while traveling, but this hotel truly stood out. Beyond the wonderful facilities, what made our stay so special was the incredibly warm and welcoming staff. From the moment we arrived, they made us—and our dog—feel genuinely welcome, and their kindness turned our trip into such a memorable and enjoyable experience.
We were also extremely happy with the location, which made exploring the area so convenient and enjoyable. Everything about our stay exceeded our expectations, and we left with nothing but wonderful memories.
This is definitely a place we would love to return to again and again whenever we visit Chicago in the future. Thank you so much to the entire team for making our stay so special. We truly look forward to seeing you again!
Location and room were excellent.

The stay was amazing! Felt just like home, which I loved. Bathrooms are obvious they have been renovated which is a huge plus, love the ambiance! Quiet neighborhood, overall great home! —One this I wasn’t sure of is that it was a shared home when I first arrived, upstairs & downstairs level individuals were staying, not sure if it had that in the description or unless I missed it lol, but other than that everything was great definitely would return! 😁

We had an excellent stay. Nicole and Matt were very responsive, and their home was quiet, clean, and comfortable. The location was perfect. Walking distance to Michigan Ave and Lakeshore Drive. My family and I could walk down Michigan Avenue to shop, stroll along the Riverwalk, explore the Magnificent Mile. We would definitely stay here again.

This was a great and economical stay. Stayed here for a month. The room was on the smaller side but just what I needed and at a good cost. Some of the rooms have private separate bathrooms. Mine was shared but it was clean and never an issue. It was walking distance from shops and restaurants, and very close to the blue line. Variety of visitors so the neighborhood felt safe and the building was secure. Host had excellent communication and always got back to me right away. Really appreciated being here as I got a foothold in Chicago.
I been there a couple of months, over a year now.   It’s easy to get around on transportation.   Fabulous.
If you need a clean bed a shower and some peace and quiet in the evening, this is a good choice. In my opinion, great value for money 👍

A great place for those seeking walkable options near a lot of great Chicago restaurants, entertainment and parks. Right across the street from a playground/school!
Hosts were responsive, friendly and ready to help.

great location!

The place was nice and clean 10/10 I would come again and recommend to other that come from out of town or wants a nice place to stay in town .

Jason’s place was great! He was very responsive to all my questions. Our first trip to Chicago was wonderful and staying here made it even more special.
This place is lovely spacious and clean. We really enjoyed our stay and recommended it to others.

Great location. Whole Foods is conveniently located across the street. There was access to easy transportation. We walked to several nearby areas. The apartment was clean and comfortable. Our host had great communication skills. We enjoyed our stay.
