For what my husband and I had in mind, the Hyde Park area was perfect.  The homes in the surrounding area are classic architecture and we loved walking through the tree lined streets.  We love public transport in big cities.  There is a bus station directly in front of the building the Airbnb is located in and the Metra was a 5 minute walk, which takes you to downtown Chicago within 10 minutes.  The best part of this Airbnb was its location. There is a CVS and Target within a few blocks and 53rd Street, a couple of blocks away, had some great restaurants. The apartment itself was comfortable and thank goodness it had air conditioning since the first few days were very hot.  Brad was a responsive host and had very detailed instructions which were helpful.   If we were to return to Chicago we would book again with Brad.
Place was very clean and easy to find. Milan is very responsive and will make sure you have everything you need. Overall great place.
Great simple clean place for a reset and not far from bus and train commutes

The Oasis- such an apt name for this wonderful place. From the moment we entered, we felt at home. The kitchen was amazingly well stocked with coffee, creamer, drinks, snacks, and even a cupboard with meal fixings. As if that wasn’t enough, Karina and Brian invited us to pick fresh veggies from their beautiful garden. One evening, we had pasta primavera with some of their bounty and another evening a pasta with red sauce. We also spent mornings and evenings, relaxing in their beautiful backyard, having coffee and simply recuperating before and after busy days. We were here a week and saw some wonderful sights, including the new Obama Presidential Center,  the Museum of science and industry the NationalMuseum of Mexican Art, the Art Institute, and did an architectural boat tour among other things. We have stayed at Airbnbs all over Europe and the US and I count the Oasis as one of the very best. Karina and Brian definitely are experts at what they are doing and we are grateful.
Perfect two-night stay at the property. Everything was clean and well maintained. Will definitely come back here.

Marco is an amazing host. Very active on replying and continued to make sure everything was okay on our end. The home was clean, exactly how described. It was easy to get in, instructions were very clear. Overall beautiful stay. Highly recommend!
Had a wonderful experience! Would definitely recommend.
Great location

the freehand was magical, liminal, moody, thoughtful, and the staff was present and had really good energy. Blessing was a BLESSING as she was who I saw when I arrived and when I left.
Jade was intentional, present, and sweet in the café. & the baddie at the hotel bar I don't know their name but also great energy.
so grateful to have found the Freehand to hold me in my absolutely transformational week in Chicago that I had. Slept so so so well and it was just an entire VIBE. thank you! thank you! thank you!

My sister and I had a great stay! It's conveniently located near the Pink line, making the commute to the city very easy. The only thing is how many people were staying at once because it makes the bathroom situation a little bit inconvenient.

I would stay here again. It's in student housing, so the room is a bit basic, but it's nice overall (I'm fine with basic, as it is more clean). Great location - beautiful view.
Pros/Cons that I think will be helpful for others. Obviously I still rated this a 5, so these didn't move the needle for me this visit, but might for someone else.
Cons:
-First two bedrooms and bathroom get a little warm (it was high 70s out during our stay, so not too hot outside). There is central air and a portable unit, but both don't really help the first two bedrooms. I wouldn't stay here in Jun-August, as a result.
-The two warm bedrooms are on the side of the L, so you hear the L. It's not horrible, but is noticeable. Fyi if you are a light sleeper.
-no filtered water from the front of the fridge (a refillable water pitcher is provided but it didn't work well)
Pros
-great water pressure in shower and other faucets
-great water temperatures
-great location and safe feeling location
-free parking

Loved the Pink House and had an amazing time in Chicago! Niki and Sean are the best hosts, super friendly and responsive and always happy to answer questions and make your stay as comfortable as possible. They really made me feel welcome and at home and I felt very safe there as a solo female traveler.
The house has bucketloads of vintage charm and the bed is so comfortable that I slept better than I do at home. Perfect location on a quiet block in a vibrant, walkable neighborhood full of great restaurants, small unique shops, cool street art, and easy connections to public transit so you can get anywhere in the city without a car. I would stay there again in a heartbeat!
The stay was good and overall it was what we expected.

Taha was a great host, responded immediately to any needs and checked in often to ensure satisfaction. The place was well kept and felt very comfortable. Great location close to many restaurants and shops and connections to all Chicago amenities. We had a great stay!
Great location and good size for a couple.  We had everything we needed.  Appreciated the coffee, accessories, pantry items, and good air conditioning.

For the price, amenities, and convenient location, I’d stay here again.
Amazing place to relax in Chicago. The location is great and peaceful

The only thing that was a tad tricky was the digital key that's used to access the building and the apartment itself -- it can be a bit finicky. Cozy little place a few minutes walk from Wrigley. It's tucked back in the neighborhood so it was nice and quiet at night. The bed was super comfy and the place was very clean. We loved Robert’s place.  Walkable to Second City, Lincoln Park and close to the brown line el.  Also found some good restaurants within about half a mile. Robert also responded to questions quickly.  We highly recommend!

Thank you for a great stay. This made my weekend in Chicago so much better! 🙏

Excellent location, clean with a responsive host. Will definitely be coming back!
Areeba was so responsive and clear! Great apartment and location!

We had a wonderful stay and couldn’t have asked for a better host! jaye was incredibly kind, helpful, and super easy to reach whenever we needed anything. He even welcomed us with a complimentary bottle of wine, which was such a thoughtful touch. 🍷

We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again.

Highly recommend for a couple of adults or a family with children who can walk up and down stairs. Tip: Hien's home is very popular now (rightfully), so book early and don't assume check in or check out times can be modified.

Carlo was super responsive and helpful when needed. Instructions to get in were perfect. We loved Chicago and we would definitely stay with Carlo again when we return.
Host was nothing but amazing, perfect location, provided everything we needed and extremely accommodating! If you’re looking for a place to stay, I’d recommend staying here!

My friends and I LOVED the home! It’s so spacious so beautiful. Neighborhood is quiet. Corinne was always super responsive. Probably the most beautiful home we’ve stayed in. We will stay here again whenever we visit Chicago again.

Jordan was great! Really helpful, and made sure to provide great instructions allowing us to feel welcome and enjoy our stay!
Great nice place. Very nice peaceful neighborhood. Lots of things nearby that you can walk to. Close to Downtown.

I wish I had let Daniel make up the trundle bed before he left for the weekend as I ended up pulling it out a couple feet and sleeping on it with extra blankets.  That bed might be fine for just one person, but it didn't work for the two of us.

A nicely rehabbed and well-furnished studio apartment. It's small but everything is new, functional, and the kitchen is well supplied. Kyriako was great.
The unit is excellent, but be aware this is a 'garden apartment', partly below street level. It is along the side of the building and very quiet, but very dark and only 1 of 3 window opens a bit. A huge TV in front of the windows made it even darker. We found it too gloomy for a 2-week stay. At this time, Fall '26, the building has issues and the building's management (not Kyriako's!) is in flux. While we were there construction left an emergency exit mostly blocked with stacks of sheetrock and tools against the walls and the hallway full of dust. Construction caused a pipe break on an upper floor and flooded several apartments, causing the water to be turned off and the corridor outside our unit to collect water. The unit is great, but the dark might be depressing for you and the building may be problematic. Not Kyriako's fault.

It was okay could’ve been better because you share a kitchen & you have to put in the code to enter bathroom and bedroom every time you enter & the space it too small for the price but it is clean …kinda wanted a refund but host wouldn’t accept overall experience I would rate this a 3 star .
Great place! Very comfortable and convenient location.

Louis made our entire booking and stay very easy.  He was very easy to communicate with and always answered any questions we had before and after booking.  Louis's place was very clean and all the basic necessities were provided, including plenty of coffee which I always love.  The location was top notch, close to almost anything you want to do in the city and Ubers were affordable.  Street parking was easy and had plenty of space for our 2 cars the entire time.  All of the beds were comfortable and the rooms had really great storage with large closets.  The living room had plenty of room for all of us and we loved the oversized bean bag chair.  Overall I would stay again without question and recommend Louis's place to anyone looking to stay in Chicago.  Thank you again Louis!
Amazing stay!

We stayed as a family of 4 including my 8 month old. The place is exactly as pictured - very clean and tastefully decorated with lots of natural light in the living room area. We appreciated all the provided kitchenware, great for eating in. Quiet neighborhood with easy parking and walkability to 606. Highly recommend for families or larger group. We will stay again when visiting Chicago!

I had a lovely stay in Chicago, Juanita is great in Terms of communication, and her place  is conveniently situated regarding public transport. Dont expect a five star appartment, just expect a clean room/bed and good place in terms of  price-quality
Amy’s place was beautiful and spacious. She was super friendly and very responsive to any questions I had. The beds were comfortable and the place was clean. I had no issues during my stay!

Tommy’s place was very comfortable and had everything we needed. Tommy was a great host and met us for check-in and walkthrough. Great communication throughout our stay. The location was perfect for games at Wrigley, to Southport restaurants and shopping, and to the CTA Brown and Red Lines. Would definitely recommend.
I can’t wait to be back! This will be our go to chicago place!!
Alanas place had excellent proximity to everything I needed and she provided excellent check in and parking instructions

I had an amazing experience at this place, both because of the hotel itself and the staff. From check-in to check-out, the service was excellent. Everyone was very attentive and helpful.
The location is great, with public transportation nearby and just a short walk from some of the city’s most iconic places.
The only thing I think could be improved is the cleanliness of the room. Other than that, I’m very satisfied with my experience and really enjoyed my stay.

No me gustó para nada ! No explica que tiene que convivir con 10 apartamentos y con personas hay , tienes que compartir la cosina , la ubicación estaba buena pero no me gustó el lugar para nada .. no volvería a ir .. muy malo
The place is very clean and modern. The neighbor is very quiet and safe. The bed and pillow were very comfortable. The washer and dryer was a plus. I would recommend to other to stay.

We enjoyed our stay at Romana’s place! She had everything we needed, and we felt right at home. The place was comfortable, welcoming, and had such a great Chicago feel to it. It was a perfect home base for our trip, and we really enjoyed coming back and relaxing after exploring the city. We would definitely stay here again!
Thank you for hosting us! Loved the location and the studio was so comfy. One of my favorite airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in

Amazing stay! This was our second time in Chicago, celebrating our birthdays, location was great, easy to get downtown and walk to certain areas. Neighborhood felt peaceful and quiet. Old town is very special area. Sean was very responsive since the start and end! Will definitely be looking to book again if we ever make our way back to Chicago!
Perfect location and beautiful place. I will definitely stay here again. It was a perfect stay.

Janet was the most incredible host I have had the pleasure of staying with. She was the most attentive host anyone could ask for and really excelled our experience. Not only as a responsive host but as a host who was prepared for every opportunity in the accommodation whether it was recommendations or even needing an additional service. The place was absolutely gorgeous, annd you can tell Janet poured her soul into the location.  It was located in the heart of a beautiful community which has so much to offer and ease of being able to walk through. Would definitely stay here again and am so grateful to have booked this stay on our stop in Chicago !! :)
Good for solo traveller or Couple who want to  get out and explore a cool neighborhood and Chicago in general.

Andy was a wonderful host, very kind, responsive, and helpful whenever I needed anything during my stay. She provided clear instructions, and the room was clean, tidy, comfortable, and spacious enough for a solo traveler. Public transportation is only about a 5-minute walk away, and getting to Michigan Avenue and the main downtown attractions takes around an hour. I really appreciated how accommodating Andy was throughout my stay. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend her place!

Leonide’s house was perfect for my group of 3. He allowed us to check in early with no hesitation! We had an issue with the blinds in the living room and it was resolved that same hour. This was legit the best bnb we’ve ever stayed in. There were a couple bars within walking distance and the neighborhood felt completely safe. Please book this house. You will not regret it. The host went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable. We really appreciated it. The house was also very clean and looked just like the pictures. The details from the games to the bathroom was immaculate. Even the towels were VERY soft. For a group of women, that meant a lot lol!! Please treat this house with love and care when you book. Zero issues and can’t wait to stay here my next visit to Chi town :)
Really nice place with easy access to public transportation

Fue una muy agradable estadía. El lugar estuvo limpio y pulcro, era amplio y cómodo de habitar. El barrio fue tranquilo y la ubicación era ideal para movilizarse. La estación del metro estaba bastante cerca, lo que nos permitió llegar a donde siempre queríamos ir con rapidez y comodidad.
Adicional, Shovany fue un excelente host; siempre amable, atento y dispuesto a ayudar en caso de que necesitemos algo.
Quedé muy agradecido con nuestra cómo estancia y definitivamente volvería.

A very interesting and fun place to stay. Great neighborhood with a broad selection of restaurants.
Philip provided baby supplies which were a necessity for our family visit. Overall, a great stay.
Great stay. We had everything we needed

Close to my son’s apartment. Easy walk to the Brown line. Loved the variety of restaurants and shopping. Very comfortable. Trove and David made it all easy. Will definitely consider staying there again on our next trip out.
Clean space, clear expectations set, and overall had a smooth stay.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The place was clean, spacious, and had everything we needed. The host was also great with communication. They gave us clear instructions, checked in on us during our stay, and always made sure we had everything we needed.
The only thing I wish was that there were more shops and places to eat nearby. But there was a train station close by, which made it easy to get around and find food and shopping in other areas.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!

It was a great experience. Atlas was great with responding back to us about any questions we had. It was clean and provided all we needed for the long weekend. Thank you again for working with our early check in/late check out requests.

Jonathan's place was great. We lived in chicago for around 30 years before moving to Colorado. We were a little concerned that it would be a bit noisy considering it was right next to Weiner Circle but it was blissfully quite. I will absolutely be staying here again.
Great area, beautiful space, convenient location!
Loved our time here, close to a red line stop and so nice and cozy!
Yard and garage were really a nice addition to this home!

This place is a walking distance from a couple of grocery stores and many restaurants. It is in between Pilsen and Little Village so there was a lot of Hispanic people and culture, it made our stay even though we were out for most of the day. It can be hard to find parking nearby if you’re in and out throughout the day, but it is free to park.
Great air bnb with art deco and furniture pieces! Will stay here again !
We enjoyed our stay. The neighborhood was nice and quiet lots of options walking distance. We would definitely recommend.

Great, conveniently located place.
Very friendly hosts and on-site which is great if we had needed anything. A friendly furry friend occasionally in the yard was a great perk too. Would definitely stay again 😊
Excellent home, great amenities, would definitely stay again

We had a wonderful stay! The home looked exactly like the pictures, was very kid-friendly, and was in a great location. The hosts were friendly, responsive, and easy to communicate with. We would definitely stay here again!

Vickie’s Airbnb is the most clean and thoughtfully decorated airbnb that I’ve ever stayed at. She thought of every detail which ensured we had everything we needed during our stat Wonderful communication and an amazing visit. I would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Loved the place and definitely coming back. I highly recommend
Had a great time staying at Ian’s. Lots of grocery and food options within walking distance. Unit was clean and spacious. We will definitely consider booking here again in the future!
Easy to walk to touristy hot spots!

We liked the place. It was clean and comfortable. We didn’t like two flights of stairs. We are seniors and were not made aware of the stairs. The window acs worked well but we had to turn off to hear tv. Living room was nice but needed an extra comfortable chair or two.
Veronika is a great host. We had a good time staying at her place. I highly recommend it.

Staying at the Solar Lodge was an absolute treat! From the moment you walk up to the building, you can feel the care and love that has gone into this space. Every single item feels meticulously curated and intentional. We cherished our time spent reading and listening to music while cuddled up in cozy leather chairs in the parlor. The hosts are some of the best we’ve ever had—incredibly accommodating, kind, thoughtful, and proactive to ensure every aspect of our stay was lovely. Everything is labeled for ease of use, lighting throughout the space is customizable, and it smells absolutely heavenly thanks to the robust collection of artisan candles. A variety of snacks, coffee, tea, and toiletries are provided. Board games! Weird stuff! Industrial music! Books about art, death, magick, and aliens! You’ll love this space no matter what, but if you’re freaks (like us), you’ll be over the moon. Can’t recommend the Solar Lodge enough, and we hope to stay here again next time we’re in town!!
Iris was great!! Would definitely book again for my next trip over to chi!!!

I loved staying at Jessica’s loft it was so cute and cozy, super accommodating, she had everything I needed and I felt right at home, the area has access to a lot of food and things to do, very walkable. Definitely recommend staying here it’s honestly the best Airbnb I’ve stayed at so far 🤷🏻‍♀️. Would love to be a guest again.

Great price for the location we received on a Labor Day weekend. The baloneys were a great unspoken features of the house. Make sure you review the rules before you book. It’s hard to remember all of them.

Laura’s Airbnb was absolutely amazing and worked perfectly for our group of six! The bedrooms were spacious and comfortable, and the open-concept kitchen and living room were perfect for all of us to hang out, relax, and get ready before heading out to explore Chicago.
Laura was incredibly responsive and helpful with any questions we had. We also really appreciated all the thoughtful details, especially the recommendations for food, sightseeing, places to visit, and what to expect during our stay.
It was all of our first time in Chicago, and we truly couldn’t have been happier with the Airbnb or its location. Being within walking distance of so many of the places we wanted to explore made everything so convenient.
We absolutely loved our stay and would definitely recommend Laura’s Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago!
Comfortable and clean! Kim was very responsive and for the price I would definitely stay again.

We loved staying at Carrie’s place! It was absolutely perfect for us and our toddler. It was well stocked for our kiddo and very comfortable. The neighborhood is great as well, very walkable. We would definitely stay again next time we are in Chicago!
10/10 would recommend to a friend.
Great stay I really felt like a native.
I loved this for my Labor Day weekend stay in Chicago! It was a great home and the host were very accommodating and friendly. I couldn’t have asked for much more.
Great place, Great host and great area

The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient—easy access to public transit and walking distance to plenty of restaurants and shops. Check-in was smooth and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The space had everything we needed and was a great home base for exploring the city. Would happily stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

The room was clean and the bed was very very comfortable . The staff were responsive and kind . Perfect for our jazz fest vacation .
Just wish they had a fridge and microwave and a better coffee/ tea set up . The most important things were great . Thank you .
Everything was great. Great location, easy access and friendly staff

This spot was PERFECT and the hosts not only communicated clearly, they were super helpful last minute when a family friend had to stay with me when their other hosing was cancelled on them.  Truly truly appreciate James and I would absolutely stay at their home again.  Clean, close to public transportation, all the amenities needed.

This place was perfect. The skyline views of the city were amazing. The place was clean and easy to get into. Very responsive host. Lots of recommendations. Comfortable beds. The area was perfect walkable to so many things. Highly recommended.

Marijes is a wonderful host and her apartment was comfortable and perfect for our travel needs. All the amenities that were listed were there in working order. The building located just around the corner from the brown line and several bus routes so if you are without a vehicle you can still get around the city fast and easy. The neighborhood is quiet, peaceful and safe to walk through at all times of the day. There was an instance where the power went out because we were running too many appliances but it was an easy fix.
We would definitely love to stay here again in the future.
Thanks Marijes!

Very nice place, modern, clean, good vanity space, comfy bed, nice art, good for one to two people. Quiet at night and mostly during the day.
Hearing other guests is only real drawback but not a big deal.
Great stay

Nichole's place was spacious and clean. The beds and pillows were comfy and clean. She provided both soft and (slightly) hard pillows. All manner of appliances you could desire was in the kitchen. Lighting is amazing in every room.
There are 5 or 6 steps down to the front door. My sister and I are both in our 70's and had to navigate them very carefully. Luckily, my daughter was there to help and to schlep our suitcases.
You won't regret booking this place. We enjoyed it!

Enjoyed our stay with Dan, great communication and easy check in. We had no issues when it came to the trying to sleep with the train stop nearby! Parking was easy to find considering how Chicago parking can be.
This place is amazing, clean and great location / space! Would definitely come back!
Amazing stay and outstanding service

We loved this stay! We got to Chicago a bit earlier than expected and Gogo was kind enough to let us check in early! He was super responsive and even dropped off some coffee pods! The stay was comfy, quiet, and super cute! If we’re ever back in Chicago I hope this stay is available!!
Great place :)

We stayed at Jonathan’s place for 5 nights and it was a beautiful place. Immediately upon check in things went smoothly and everything was exactly as the listing. The Views were fantastic! We had one issue with a noise problem next door and when we messaged Jonathan and his crew, they acted straight away to get the problem fixed. Would recommend and hope to be back in the future!

Fantastic location! Getting to the lake shore, zoo, gardens was so easy. Neighborhood is great, shops near by are great. Michelin restaurant at the corner. The place is cozy and had everything we needed. We were all comfortable and the house felt like home. Would definitely stay here again.
Thank you so much!
Jane was quick to respond to my questions, terrific walkable neighborhood, very comfortable townhouse. Thoughtful extras. Would stay there again. Thank you
Our stay was great! The room was peaceful and at a great location. The check-in process was easy and felt secure. The bed was comfortable. I would highly recommend it.

Beautiful place very well decorated and secure.
Very close to the L train.
It fit our needs !

Great location with amazing views and excellent walkability, smooth process from start to finish, and an easy check-in. The place was well appointed, clean, and exactly as pictured, with a nice touch of good toiletries and cleaning supplies on hand. One surprise was how much outside noise came through even on the 17th floor, but the host had thoughtfully provided noise-cancelling earplugs and eye masks in each room, which made it a non-issue.  Very comfortable and roomy, will definitely look to staying here again whenever I'm in Chicago!
Love the Nest.
Amazing stay and location!!
We had a great stay! The apartment was very clean. Wing and Lily were both great at communicating.
Buena ubicación de acuerdo a costo, lugar impecable cómodo y tenía lo necesario. Muy recomendable
Shaun’s was so fantastic! We felt like we were at home. Would definitely recommend.

This "Nook" was exactly as described, a creative renovation of a garden unit in an established apartment building. The furnishings, especially the bed and sofa, were comfy. The full kitchen with range and dishwasher is welcome. Check-in was complicated, but the directions were clear. The Trove management team communicated well. Check-out super easy. The location was perfect for our needs. Lakeview is a vibrant, youthful, hip neighborhood. There is a big Osco-Jewel supermarket around the corner, lots of boutique restaurants and coffee shops, some upscale shopping.  Plenty of pizza opportunities--and bagels! (Steingolds). The Southport Metra station is a six minute walk away (Brown line).  We had a good visit and hope to return.

We last minute found this place for our group trip, and we loved everything it offered!! The location was just perfect, it’s on such a quiet street but with many things just walking distance (cvs, wing stop, Dunkin, etc.) Definitely recommended this spot for any groups looking for a comfortable stay, the 2 full bathrooms came in handy for our group. The host was very super responsive and very accommodating! 10/10 experience, already saving this spot for our next Chicago trip :)

Bernard was a clear and kind host. This location was phenomenal to stay at and we felt right at home. If you are here for more than 2-3 days, absolutely recommend if you want to take your time and feel like a local. Will definitely be back in the neighborhood!! :)
Nice, clean and perfect for a small family. Little far from the downtown but worth it compared to price.
Quinton’s place is beautiful and he is a great communicator and very responsive.
Хорошое жилье, рядом с метро
Everything so good, Jennifer was very kind and all the time they ask if everything it’s good. The place it’s clean, just the location it’s not the best, but they say to you before you book.
The apartment is perfect, the neighborhood is great, and Leo and Alex were wonderful hosts. Highly recommend!

Stayed in the Celestial Room at Ryan’s beautiful home in East Garfield Park. Stayed for 6 nights as I was attending the local Arc Music Festival. I had zero issues with my stay and found it wasn’t that hard or too bad to access the home from Union Park via the L trains…just had to walk 10 mins to and from the station from the home. I was able to come and go as I please and overall felt safe during my stay with Ryan. He was very responsive and informative of the home and of your needs and questions. Definitely will be booking again with Ryan during my next visit to Chicago.
Room good for a quick stay, the apartment itself was good.

I had a wonderful six-night stay and would happily stay here again. The location is fantastic, especially for the CTA. The Wilson Red Line stop is literally less than a block away, and I commuted downtown to the Magnificent Mile in about 25 minutes door to door. I never waited more than five minutes for a train.
The studio had everything I needed, including plenty of Keurig coffee. Aldi was three blocks away and Target was across the street, making it easy to stock the kitchen. The donut and coffee shop downstairs was a nice bonus, and Andersonville and the lake were both easy walks.
The shower is definitely small, but the handheld shower head helped a lot. I was also pleasantly surprised by the noise level. I could feel the bar's music for about an hour on Saturday, but barely hear it. The white noise machine helped, and the other residents were extremely quiet.
Nala, Owen, and the cleaning team were responsive and communicative. Check-in and checkout were seamless.
The space was great.  Amazing view.  The neighborhood is awesome, so many great places to walk to.

So cute and convenient! I never use the train in Chicago do to never being close enough to rationalize it but this go around made it super simple for me to navigate the city without a car. The neighborhood is cute and conveniently located for the majority of my plans. It was nice to have a full kitchen and a washer/ dryer as well. 10/10 would stay again.
Great location, clean space, 5 stars
Place was perfect for what we needed
Cool unit in a good location. We liked the loft feel.

I was asked several times by people in the building if the apartment I was staying in was an Airbnb which made me feel a little uneasy and Demetri left their apartment lease on the table which was super strange to me I didn’t mind the space but I did get a sense that I wasn’t supposed to be there

Good location near Logan Square, with easy access to trains via a short Uber. The AC worked very well, hot water was consistent, the unit felt secure, and check-in/out was easy once we figured it out.
Unfortunately, there were several issues. I asked about parking before arriving but didn’t receive a response. I sent another message the following day and eventually received a response. I also never received any check-in instructions, so I had to message the host more than an hour after check-in time to figure out how to get into the unit.
There were nails sticking out of the floor near the bathroom, no hand soap, incorrect WiFi passwords on the signage in the unit, a TV remote that barely worked, no coffee in the canister, a broken desk lamp, and only one washcloth for two guests. The bed was unstable and dipped on one side. Some flatware was dirty, the sponge was very old, and the microwave handle was sticky.
Overall, the unit needs better maintenance and cleaning.
Nice large space in a great neighborhood. Parking was a bit of a hassle.  It's worth buying the parking passes if you plan on having a car.
The apartment is gorgeous!  We were very comfortable for four days.  The neighborhood is nice.  The train was two blocks away , so very convenient.   We really enjoyed our time.

Tanya’s place was impeccable. Every single detail was incredibly luxurious and considered. It was honestly more impressive than the 5 star hotels in the area. She was a super friendly and helpful host as well. Couldn’t recommend more highly!
Amazing stay, very walkable and quiet neighborhood. Host was very responsive and understanding. Very highly recommend if you visit.

Hena was very responsive! The place is exactly as described. Pilsen is such a cute and walkable area, and the unit is right in the mix. I had such a great stay at Hena's place and would highly recommend!
Rida was great. Place was old and needs more physical attention then a good cleaning. Blinds especially. Clean, good locale. So overall a good stay!
These two were so kind, accommodating, and I’m so grateful we found them! The place was beautiful and we loved our time spent on the patio. We’ll definitely be back!

Great location, walking distance to a good number of restaurants, bars, coffeeshops, etc. Quiet and safe.
However, coordination was sorely lacking. We were given the wrong check-in key & code and when I inquired to confirm (the unit we entered was different from the pictures), we were told everything was fine. Until 2 days later, when they realized they did indeed give us the wrong unit, and we had to do a mid-stay switch with another unit. The cleaners arrived late to clean the units for the switch (we were out of the apartment so this didn’t affect us, not sure about the other unit’s experience), and even after the cleaners left, one of the bathrooms had some crazy dirt/debris that was not cleaned.

Alex’s place was perfect for our trip to help our son move in at DePaul University. We especially valued having a garage to park our fully packed car in the first night. The apartment was clean and cozy and matched Alex’s description. The temperature inside was very comfortable despite the heat wave, and we didn’t feel like we needed to run the A/C constantly. We did bring an air mattress for our son, which he chose to sleep on over the pull out couch… because at 6’1”, he didn’t fit comfortably on the couch mattress. We loved Roscoe Village!! We ate at several amazing restaurants and enjoyed the easy 10 minute walk to the Paulina station for easy access to DePaul’s Lincoln Park campus and the rest of Chicago. We’ll definitely stay here again!
Wonderful location but the floors were very greasy and slippery and the bathroom ceiling has black mold. Shampoo and conditioner and a blow dryer would be nice

This is a nice value in an amazing location. It’s basically the size of a basic hotel room but with better amenities such as a washing machine and kitchen and you’ll feel more “at home.” It was all very easy to do and such a nice clean and well designed space. Kyriako is an amazing host. And again, you really can’t beat this location in Lincoln Park. Very walkable to the zoo or park or beach or any number of world class restaurants. And not at all far from downtown either. I plan to stay again.

First time being in Chicago and Ari’s home was in the perfect location for us! Not too far from downtown and close to cute local shops. It’s a cute little cozy place and would definitely stay again if I come back to Chi ☺️.
Amazing spot! Super central, surrounded by bars and food. Highly recommend!

Joe made me feel very welcome and comfortable. Joe was proactive and easy to communicate with. The space was clean, easy to access, and in a quiet lovely neighborhood near bus routes. I appreciated the amount of space in the bedroom and kitchen. I was in town for a work event and the suite was a great respite between events.
Perfect location to walk to Wrigley. Three bedrooms are perfect for 2 or 3 couples. Area and building felt safe. 711 super close for any convenience store needs.

Our group enjoyed our stay. The beds are extremely comfortable and the place was very clean when we arrived. The parking garage was very convenient and a nice amenity. The hosts were very responsive and helpful.
Good place to stay.  Loved the parking

What a beautiful neighborhood and convenient location. We were very comfortable.  We had one question and Kimberly responded so quickly and all was well.  100% recommend and would love to stay again. Linda
Great price, had everything we needed!

Staying at Jennifer's was perfect for my needs. Easy access to the L. Nice neighborhood. DePaul and a family friendly community area is right there. Good restaurants nearby, too. Excellent with communication as well as kind and helpful. Warns folks that there will be noise from the L right up front. For me, that is a part of being in Chicago. No complaints from me. Feel fortunate to have landed with Jennifer and Dan and their location when you don't know exactly where it will be until after you reserve. I will certainly check to see if they have availability when I return to Chicago.
Very helpful, communicated well, overall enjoyed staying with them.
Jhon was the ideal host. Very responsive and assisted us with every request. His space was clean and ready for all of our needs. I plan to rebook when traveling with friends!
Amazing place

The place was exactly as described, the train is just 1 block away, host was very responsive and accommodating . The area is a little sketchy but my husband and I walked to the train and from daily and we had no issues , there is homeless around the streets but they don’t really mess with you. Thank you so much!

We really enjoyed our stay with Norma! She was so sweet, welcoming, and made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. She was always quick to respond!! We’re really grateful for how kind and accommodating she was, and we would absolutely stay here again. Thank you so much, Norma! ❤️

We really enjoyed our stay! The Airbnb was nice, calm, and had everything we needed for our 3-day stay. The host was also great, very helpful, and easy to communicate with.

One other thing we noticed was the smell inside the Airbnb. It was a little uncomfortable and noticeable, especially the first night, but after that we started getting used to it.
Other than those things, everything was great and we had a really nice stay! Thank you for hosting us! 😊
I would recommend this property to anyone staying in Chicago, musa’s an amazing host, he always responded quick and he was very helpful with anything I needed
great & convenient location that’s super walkable

We had a wonderful stay. Host was very kind and responsive. This is one of the best places we have ever stayed.
The only thing was that the beds are firm, memory foam mattresses which was not our preference.

We had such a great stay for Labor Day weekend! The place was clean, clear instructions to find/get in, great location and street parking! Alejandro was very responsive and helpful for us, and we had all the amenities we needed. Would love to come back when we visit again!

Great location, very nice place, responsive host and all around a great stay! Only complaint is because there aren’t staff, we didn’t get new towels like I would have liked normally but we were able to wash them in an all-in-one.

Jaime was a wonderful host, friendly and responsive! Place was great for my stay and walkable. The street can be a bit noisy but nothing earplugs can fix. I had no issues and would stay here again. Thank you again! :)
My friends and I had an amazing stay. Place was just the right the space and located in a nice quiet area with many great restaurants and cafes to walk to. Would definitely stay here again!

The hosts were very hospitable and attentive to our needs. They would check in periodically to make sure we had all we needed for the stay. The location was also great. The neighborhood was calm, the home was very comfortable and had quite few walkable bars / restaurants near by. Overall this was a great stay!

It was Great ! Caroline and Brett are really nice and flexible. The room was nice and comfortable and the bathroom was beautiful and well equipped. The bathroom, kitchen and living room are shared with the hosts and a dog (but we didn’t use the living room/kitchen)
Great location close to most things you would need during your stay!

El lugar es tal cual la descripción, Nala estuvo muy pendiente de nosotros en todo momento. El lugar está aprox a 20 minutos de la zona de los museos,acuario y demás zonas turisticas.

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and the host was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and relaxing stay. We’d happily stay here again! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

we had such a wonderful stay! the place was absolutely beautiful, clean, cozy, and even better than we expected. you can truly tell how much thought and care was put into making the space comfortable and welcoming. everything we needed was provided, and the home had such a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere.
the location was perfect, and the entire experience was seamless from check-in to check-out. our host was incredibly kind, responsive, and accommodating, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
we’re so grateful we chose this place and would absolutely stay here again. it genuinely felt like a home away from home. 🤍✨

Great location, street parking is convenient. The central air conditioning did not work so we had to sleep in 80+ degree apartment. The toilet barely flushed and microwave only worked part of the time.
Perfect space and location for my group’s visit!

El alojamiento es excelente, muy limpio, ordenado y confortable, tenía todo lo necesario para que mi estancia fuera agradable, sin dudarlo me volvería a quedar ahí, un lugar muy bonito, muy limpio y mi anfitrión siempre respondía, fue la mejor opción que pude elegir

We all had a very relaxing stay at Laura T's apartment.  The location and space matched the description and was comfortable for the four of us. The location was great for our activities in the Pilsen neighborhood and it was well connected with the public transportation. The check-in instructions were easy to follow and Laura's communication was clear and quick. Would recommend to friends and family.
This was our second stay at Casa Newport. No need to say more! Love the location.

We enjoyed our stay, and were able to easily follow the instructions given by Louis. We were appreciative of his flexibility and willingness to accommodate an extra guest for one night. Public transport was available within walking distance of the airbnb allowing for easy accessibility to the Chicago area.

Looked just like the description, host was super responsive, check in & check out was seamless. Thank you so much for an easy stay and a great vacation! Loved the place and close to literally anything & everything.
Greta place to stay for the weekend. Walkable to the train to get to places. Neighbor was good. George was clear on his communication

Overall, great location.
Alina's space was about a 10 ish minute walk to most main transit stations. It's nestled in a quiet residential area which made the walk very pleasant.
The space was well furnished with the right amount of amenities one would expect.
We would stay here again!
The house has great space and is close to the train for easy commutes!

I had a wonderful stay at Joelle’s place! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Joelle was a friendly, responsive host and made everything easy from check-in to checkout. I had a great experience in Chicago and would happily stay here again. Highly recommend!
So happy to be there , will definitely check the availability next time i visit Chicago
good place

I’m so glad I decided to book this Airbnb. I was a little hesitant at first because it was a new listing with no reviews, but honestly, it ended up being one of the best decisions I’ve ever made.
The house is incredibly cozy and beautifully decorated with unique farmhouse touches and vintage pieces. The telephone chair, the secretary desk and all the little nostalgic details instantly took me back to my grandmother’s era. There’s something so warm and special about the space.
It’s rare to find something this beautiful and charming decor right in the city.
Thank you so much for hosting us, and especially for the lovely welcome wine. it was such a sweet touch. We truly appreciated it.
I’ll definitely be coming back. If I could give this place 7 stars, I would. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The house is always clean and very cozy, close to the train station, with easy access to anywhere in Chicago.
I liked it !
Super cozy apartment and great helpful host!
We had a clean and comfortable 4 day stay. Highly recommend staying at Jose's for a weekend trip in Chicago.
Cozy room with communicative hosts. The rooms each feel like a nicer version of a hotel room. The common area was clean and quiet, although we did not use it much personality.
Great hosts and home!
i had an incredible time staying at the Hot Tub Haven!! Steven’s home was so homey and extremely nice. I wish my home looked like this
Lovely room and location; would absolutely stay again!
This home was nice, clean, and as described. Kenny was very accommodating and communicative. We had a great stay!

We had a really great stay at David's place — it truly felt like a home away from home. The living room was super comfortable, and I loved being able to get some work done at the desk right there. The bedroom stayed at a perfect temperature, which says a lot since we visited during a heatwave!
My fiancée made us some delicious dinners in the well-equipped kitchen, and the shower had great water pressure. The whole apartment was easy and comfortable to move around in.
The neighborhood is beautiful and felt super safe to walk around, even at night. Getting around was easy too — we could hop on the bus, grab a bike, or walk to the Brown Line, which connects to the rest of the city.
David was an amazing host — he recommended some really fun things for us to check out, and he and his team were friendly and responsive the whole time. We would absolutely stay here again!
Location was well located for using the train and bus.
Great location for a large group of people. Home was comfortable and met all of our needs. Would definitely book again!

Very convenient and walkable location right next to the red line! Unit was as described and perfect for what we were looking for. The only issue was the WiFi but I had a hotspot so it became a non-issue!

Very sweet host, beautiful house, cozy and comfortable.
Great for family or friends trip.

Stayed here on a quick trip to Chicago. Beautiful building and area. Easy check in/detailed instructions. The apartment was spacious, clean, and well stocked. Public trans. very close to building and downtown area was only a 20 min ride away. Would absolutely stay here again, 10/10.

This is a gem find! One of the nicest Airbnb's I've ever stayed in. It was perfectly located for our needs, had some of the nicest amenities I've ever had in a rental - that kitchen was chef's kiss - and we loved the little extra touches like the makeup wash rags and basket of treats. Truly had a splendid stay. The host was also very responsive and gracious with us. We'd certainly stay here again in the future!

Michele was a grand host! She made me feel welcomed and safe, which was perfect for my first solo trip into the city!! Her place is quiet and comfortable and I’m grateful to have found her for my adventure! Thank you again for all the recommendations and encouragement throughout the trip!! 💜🙂‍↔️🙏

Often when you travel, you miss the comfort of a home. Staying here I felt so cozy and warm. Great interior lighting, great layout, full beautiful kitchen, was even better than the photos.
Perfect location, easy street parking or walk ability to all the great uptown spots. Very happy I was able to stay and hope to stay again in the future. 10/10!
Very spacious for our big group. Host was responsive to our needs. Had a great stay!

Tamiz was a gracious host with a beautifully eclectic home. The first night, he shared local recommendations with us over a drink which set a lovely tone for the rest of our stay. His place was very close to a metro stop and several bus stops that took us directly into Downtown. So happy to have met Tamiz and to have shared space with him, Remy, and Rupa.
Super nice and quiet! Not too far from places! Had an amazing time!

Erich and Kristina were incredible hosts that went absolutely above and beyond to provide the best experience possible for us!! An absolutely gorgeous unit in an incredible area, one of the best airbnbs you can ever book, recommend to the highest degree!!
Good place to stay and close to the city center
Nice place to stay in Chicago. Easy to access to public transportation. Peaceful and safe area. Great host.

We had an okay stay at Brad’s place. The location is convenient, Brad was responsive, and the kitchen was clean. However, the bed was uncomfortable, accessing the room was a bit tricky, and we found mold in the bathroom and on the AC unit. Addressing these issues could really enhance the experience for future guests.
Beautifully remodeled and very comfortable!

The place of really nice. Felt like home. The neighborhood is safe and it has good commute options. You can also do a lot of things on foot. The owner answers fast and solve problems quickly also. Recommend it.

My husband and I stayed with our three children (ages 4, 6 and 8).   The house had lots of space for everyone.  The building felt extremely safe and secure.  We cooked breakfast there most mornings and the kitchen had everything we needed.  There are a couple grocery stores (Potash and Whole Foods) a short walk away.  The concierge was always helpful pointing us in the right direction for things we needed.  Our favorite dinner was at Alpana which was a short walk away.  We took the L to Wrigley, the stop to go north is close and worked well for us.  The walk into downtown is about a mile and we felt comfortable doing this with our young kids.
Great spot in Chicago, across from blue line and close to whatever you need/wherever you’re going. Comfortable bed and full kitchen! Building feels very safe

Great view and location, lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance. We took the red line most places which was an easy walk to the nearest station. The rooftop pool was very nice and never too busy, I'd definitely stay here again for another trip to Chicago.
Super convenient location to so many things in the city, quiet and safe, and super communicative host. A must stay.

Good place in a nice central location. 4 bathrooms for the big group we had was perfect and very useful. Communication from the hosts was quick and they were helpful. Would definitely stay here again with a big group next time.
Miguel was very attentive and a great host! 10/10
Joe was extremely good at communicating with us and welcoming. The home was comforting.
Excellent place, convenient.

1 block away from the California Blue Line station. Was perfect as we used the train a lot during our stay. Tons to do and see on Milwaukee Ave as well. Unit was clean. Everything worked well. No complaints!

Reed's place was exactly as advertised.  Clean, comfortable, and an easy walk to good restaurants and transportation.  Reed responded quickly when we had a minor issue and got it resolved.  We'll certainly be back.

It's a decent place, the neighborhood is quiet and safe. We thought the hosts were welcoming and easy to talk to. The place is about the size we expected given the photos, and we did use the dining room which was not part of the room we rented. Bed is comfy.
They have a little dog that barks a lot when it sees us, but it's very small and not always around.

Brian and Gloriann are amazing hosts! Their place was exactly what they described. It was perfect for our group during the Labor Day weekend. They were responsive and accommodating to our needs. Clean and very spacious, it felt like home away from home. A friend left their boots and they worked with me to get it shipped back. We really enjoyed our stay and we would love to book it again next time we are in Chicago!
Great place! Would definitely stay again we had absolutely no issues!

Loved staying at Carissa’s, it was easy to find & super cute if that matters to you lol both the Metra & the L were super neat by and walkable making it super convenient. There’s lots of restaurants near by as well! Had all the amenities, more towels than we even needed lol overall a great experience & we appreciate it! Thanks (:

Charles is a great host! Very accommodating. He helped us with a couple things prior to arrival and even after departure. The place is nice and cozy for 2 people. Lots to do within walking distance. 10/10 recommend this place and Charles as a host.
Thanks, Charles. 🙏

We had a fabulous experience staying at the Cardinal. The unit was clean and comfy, and the neighborhood was safe and quiet with really nice neighbors. A great location with walkable restaurants, cafes & stores. Mindy & Tony were responsive and kind. I look forward to staying here again!

We stayed at the place for 8 days. Initially, it was a bit difficult to find. But, the instruction was clear. The place is new, clean and tidy. It truly felt like home away from home. The place has a smart temperature control, and felt comfortable despite the summer heat. The Manager is proactive and always checking in on us. Overall, I am giving it a 5-star rating.

Our group had such a great stay in Wicker Park. The location was fantastic, both for local finds and access to the rest of Chicago. The space was bright, welcoming, very quiet, and private. It was the perfect space to rest and relax in between activities around Chicago. Having multiple bathrooms and an in-unit washer/dryer were two major perks. My favorite part was the private patio overlooking the Blue Line. We enjoyed some yoga in the sunshine and many late-night chats with the train passing by.
El lugar estuvo muy bien, la atención increíble y fueron muy claros con las instrucciones, la zona me pareció bien pero no excelente! Recomendado si quieres un espacio acogedor y buena atención
Host was responsive

We had a wonderful stay and would certainly recommend place to others. The location was perfect - very walkable neighborhood, close to Red Line, close to beaches, close to CVS and Target, close to Art District and we enjoyed a wonderful Farmer's Market. Initially we were going to rent a car, but are glad we decided against it. The Red Line is so convenient and we could see that parking could be a challenge. People park very close together in Chicago! The house is lovely. It is older and so it has its little quirks. We thought it was charming! As mentioned in other reviews, the floors are squeaky. But it has 3 good-sized bedrooms with closets, 2 bathrooms (we didn't have any water problems), a roomy front room and separate dining area, and sufficient kitchen/pantry. There were a number of TV's but we never used them. There is not a washer/dryer on-site so we packed a little heavier (we didn't want to waste time in the near-by laundromat). We thought great-value and would stay again.
This place was fantastic. So clean and well decorated. Close to great coffee shops and food.

Karolina was very responsive and very helpful. Answered questions quickly. Made us feel welcomed. Place was very clean and walking distance to Wrigley Field. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend staying here.
Stayed with a group of 15 friends. Place was spacious and had a great location! Definitely would stay again.
The best Airbnb I’ve stayed at in Chicago. Beautiful and spacious place, steps away from Wrigley and close distance to the CTA Red Line which will can take you into downtown.
Perfect stay for my friends and I!

This place was everything I was hoping and more, but the best part is the area, everything is within few blocks, perfect location with a lot to do
Can’t wait to be back!!!

Le logement a été parfait pour la durée du séjour. Il est très bien équipé que ce soit dans la salle de bain, la cuisine ou même le salon/chambre et dispose d’une vue très agréable.
L’emplacement est idéal, on est extrêmement bien placé par rapport à tout ce qui est incontournable à voir ou à visiter et est également proche des transports en commun.
Par contre si comme moi vous avez le sommeil léger, Chicago est une ville bien vivante donc on entend bien tout ce qu’il se passe plus bas.
À part ce petit détail personnel, je le recommande les yeux fermés. Il est top sur tous les points.

The apartment is located in a very nice walkable neighborhood a few blocks from our son, who we were visiting.
We were surprised by the unkempt condition of the exterior. It had a summer’s worth of tall weeds and construction materials (tarps and cement blocks) which stood out in the meticulously maintained neighborhood.
Any fears we had, however, were allayed once we went inside. The space was clean and looked like the photos.
It was very hot and humid while we were there but the two window air conditioners kept the apartment cool.
Demitri is a friendly host and responds quickly to messages.
Great location, very easy to get around. Place was very clean and just as described. Would start there again
Great location and a nice space!
Place was great and great location but we have a few issues that I’m sure will be improved.  I think it is because it was brand new

Excellent urban location, with easy access to a cafe, groceries, the beach, and red line train to downtown. There is a small bookstore on the main street. If you walk down to the train line and make a right, there is a narrow alley with really cool places. There is even a store that sells witchcrafting supplies, which many be helpful to some. Thursday and Friday are street cleaning days in this area, so watch out for the signs when parking.
The apartment is compact, but neat. It has all the kitchen and bathroom essentials. There is a coin laundry, but the laundromat two blocks down (on W Pratt) was much more convenient.
The building itself requires some maintenance (especially the stairway leading to the apartment), but once you get inside the unit, things are good.
This was a great home to stay in for my trip to Chicago. Very clean and nicely decorated house that made us feel right at home. Matthew was very responsive and helpful. Would stay here again!

Ashley was very responsive to our messages.   The apartment was very clean with plenty of linens, towels, internet connections and coffee. I would stay here again. Bathroom is big. Thanks again Ashley.

Alma was a great host! Her home was beautiful, clean, and smelled great! I also LOVED how the building was secure and locked from the public! When we come back to Chicago, we will definitely book again!

Rob's loft was a spacious,  safe and comfortable place to stay during our latest trip to Chicago. Before and during our time in CHI, Rob was incredibly effective in meeting our needs and answering any questions. We highly recommend this spot if you are looking for a unique spot in the city to spend with family or friends. Thanks, Rob!
Location was fantastic and the unit was a nice size.  Just be ready for the loud train though we managed just fine
Beautiful place! Located near bus and train stations. Lots of cute shops and eats nearby and a very peaceful neighborhood. Hosts were very responsive & helpful. Would definitely book again

Emily is very responsive and consistently answering our questions. The space was great - tucked away from the strip but only a few minutes walking to get to the hustle and bustle of the main street with shops, restaurants and bars. Rooms each have fans + the AC made it very comfortable. We’d stay here again. 5/5 thanks for your hospitality Emily!

I've stayed in a ton of Airbnbs, and never had a stay that pissed me off at much as this one. If you're considering booking this place, I highly recommend against.
The unit initially appeared fine, looked like the pictures, etc. but the issues never ended...
The couch collapsed the moment I sat on it (mind you, I'm not a heavy person).
They had an EXTREMELY loud, hardwired smoke detector that errored at random intervals and was unreachable on the tall ceiling. I had to drag a chair over to stand on and jab at the reset button with scissors in the middle of the night. The hosts were dismissive of this problem, clearly didn't know their own property well, and were frankly disrespectful.
There was already a musty smell in the hallway when I arrived, but a few days in the ceiling collapsed in several of the upstairs units, pouring water and mold all over their apartments. The water was shutoff for several hours.
Enjoyed a long weekend stay at this great, cozy home. Marco was of great help. Communication was clear and friendly. Place was clean and as shown in pictures. Great location to stay!

The place was very spacious and easy to locate. The apartment was pretty clean, and close to the festival we were attending.
Would stay here again.
Host was very communicative and would definitely recommend staying here!
Great location, Lourdes was very accommodating and responsive!
We had a great stay in Chicago! The place was clean and comfortable. Blad was a great host and very responsive. Would definitely stay again!

Staying at this Airbnb was great! Iris was really prompt with communicating and happy to provide recommendations for stuff to do. The location was really lovely. A short walk from some good restaurants and from the lake shore trail. We rented some bikes and biked up to the city proper. Really overwhelmingly a lovely stay!
Place was great! Beds were more comfortable than hotels. Good location and everything was accessible either via bus or CTA. I will definitely be back.

The Airbnb was exactly what was expected. We were a group of friends meeting up to spend some time in the city. The place offered a spacious layout and many sleeping arrangements and all the other amenities we needed.
Good location and close to the metro!

This place was great! The condo is in very walkable neighborhood and close to public transit, restaurants, night life, and Wrigley Field. Highly recommend it to those looking for a place to stay in Chicago

We had a great stay at Andre’s place. The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was easy, and Andre was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. We really enjoyed our time here. Would happily stay again and recommend it to others!

The location is convenient and the unit was accurately represented in the listing.
Unfortunately, communicating with Mera was not ideal. Before our stay, she asked us to accommodate a scheduled pest control appointment that would have prevented us from accessing the unit for several hours after our scheduled check-in time. We were willing to be flexible and work around the appointment. However, when we asked if we could simply drop off our luggage early so the pest control could take place, we were told we would need to pay an early check-in fee. Given that we were accommodating the host’s scheduled appointment, we felt this was unreasonable.
The unit is also directly in front of the train tracks, and the noise is noticeable. I would not recommend this property for light sleepers or anyone looking for a quiet stay.
Overall, the location and accuracy of the listing were positives, but the communication and handling of the pest control situation negatively impacted our experience.
Bridget was so helpful and responsive. Her place is in a great area with lots to do.

Owners were very responsive, and apartment was clean and well-maintained. There were three bedrooms, two with a queen bed each and 1 with two twin beds. There was an air mattress in the closet of one of the bedrooms, but we didn't use it.

Pristine, chic hotel, spacious bathroom and modern amenities. In the heart of the loop was able to get to most festivities and activities within 10-15 min walk or 5-10 minute drive and L was close by. Highly recommend and will stay here again. It is a little pricey but you do get what you pay for!

This place was close to where our son lives. It was close to public transport and lots of restaurants and shops nearby. The apt was on a quiet street and was very comfortable. The towels were much nicer than a typical Airbnb. We would stay here again!

Stay at Jose’s place for 5 nights. Had a great experience. Place was clean and as described. I never felt any issues about the neighborhood. Convenient location to public transportation (train and bus) and food spots. Would highly consider staying here again during another visit to Chicago.

I don’t even know where to start. Overall, the best experience i’ve ever had with Airbnb staying at Thomas’ place. The location, which was a 10 minute walk to the festival i attended all weekend was to die for. As a host, the responsiveness and friendliness was A++. The check in manual? Flawless. I’ll be saving this listing for anytime I am back in Chicago. 12/10 recommend staying here!
Host was very quick to communicate. I was there for 4 days and I had no complaints. Will book again.

We had an amazing stay! Whether you know Chicago really well or visiting for the first time, you will probably agree that it’s one of THE BEST locations in the city! Close to everything but unit itself is quiet and cozy. Rush/State triangle and Oak beach minutes away as well as many many great cafe’s, restaurants, shopping and exploring. The host was great to work with and made our stay very comfortable. Highly recommend this place. We’d definitely stay again!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This was our group’s second time staying at Jaime’s coach house in Wicker Park. Everything was as expected: clean, free of clutter and a spacious main floor for the 4 of us to hang out when not out & about. We came during a heat wave and the AC worked extremely well. Location and privacy makes this one of our favorite Airbnb’s and the reason why we choose to come back here when in Chicago. Thank you!
Host was super communicative, great place in a great location! Went out and came home at night and felt safe!
Great place to stay. Lots of restaurants nearby. Able to walk to the train station and go downtown quickly. Clean and comfortable place, would stay here next time I’m in Chicago!
Wonderful apartment?
Muy linda casa y excelentes amenidades
Great location! Clean place with comfortable beds. Easy parking. A lot of bars and restaurants nearby. Would stay here again!
AMAZING location, fantastic host, clean and spacious! The perfect place to stay in Chicago with friends - eight off the train and easy to get to everything, this place is perfect!

This was the perfect place to stay! We walked to multiple restaurants and coffee shops! Only about a 20 minute drive to all of the downtown Chicago monuments. Host was super kind. This is a first floor unit so you could hear everything happening above you but we’d stay here again!
The locationis great! Tons of restaurants, coffee shops and cute buotiques. The Airbnb was exceptionally clean and well-maintained.

Great location and very easy to find. Apartment was very clean and had plenty of wood for my husband and me. She left some snacks which were great! We have stayed here before and are booked for our next trip to Chicago in December!
The best in this area! Thanks James.

We stayed here for about 5 days, the host was responsive to all messages. The home was exactly as pictured and the area around the home was easily walkable with food and grocery options. Our group enjoyed our stay and was enough space for 6 people to stay comfortably.

Denzilt's place was beautiful. Fully accommodated my family and I's stay for the weekend. Although the train was close, it didn't bother us for the most part, kind of makes the place unique. I appreciated having use of the garage, as my car felt safe (no towing worries). And Denzilt and hosts were very helpful and responsive! Would definitely recommend!

We had a great stay at Ingo’s place in Andersonville. This classic Chicago condo was just as described and pictured. The unit is on a quiet, tree lined street but within easy walking distance of all the great restaurants, bars and shopping on Clark. The one bedroom was perfect for 2 of us. Note the unit is on the second floor and up a flight of stairs. No problem for us but worth mentioning for others. Highly recommend and hope to return soon!

We had a great stay while we were in Chicago! The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for our trip. The location was perfect and very close to the venue we were attending, which made everything so much easier for us. The hosts were also incredibly nice, welcoming, and easy to communicate with. They were a pleasure to deal with from beginning to end and made the entire experience smooth and stress-free.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again the next time we’re in Chicago. Highly recommend!
We had an amazing time, the airbnb was perfect for our trip
Great location.  Centralized to many of Chicago’s attractions.  You are able to walk to many attractions and restaurants.
Great spot for a bigger group! Not a lot of restaurants nearby, but a few delicious options. Clean and comfortable.

I definitely recommend Oriane's lovely space for a stay in Chicago- the apartment is really spacious and cozy,  the neighborhood is really nice and very quiet, but it is still within easy walk of a lot of shopping/coffee shops and cute restaurants. Oriane and Chris were great hosts; super nice and responded quickly to questions/requests. Very comfy bed also! Awesome stay all in all :)
Marcos place was in a great location and he was very responsive, very spacious and beautiful kitchen!

Nice, spacious, and clean. We felt right at home during our stay. Inez was always communicative, helpful, and quick to respond whenever we had a question. The place had everything we needed and was in a great location. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!

Amazing view and great location. The view alone made it worth the stay! The unit was clean and comfortable, with a full kitchen and great property amenities - super bonus to have a full grocery store on the same block. Getting in and out was easy, and the door attendant was very helpful. Note: the immediate area outside the building entrance felt a little unsettling late at night, and I wouldn’t have felt comfortable alone. Overall, a great stay close to Chicago attractions and the metro. Would recommend!
Very friendly and flexible host!

Me and my friends stay was great! Very nice neighborhood and a nice cozy home, it had a great kitchen with plenty of pots, plates and silverware and good couch area for relaxing and watching TV, would definitely stay here again !

We had a great stay! The location was perfect and our host was super accommodating. She let us check in early and check out late which we really appreciated! It is above a bar so there is some noise, but we expected that and honestly it didn’t bother us. She also provided ear plugs if needed which was nice!
Just something to keep in mind, the apartment is on the second floor and you do have to take stairs. There’s also no washer or dryer, but there’s a laundromat literally like a 5 minute walk away, basically right down the street. Other than that everything was great and we really enjoyed our stay! Would definitely stay here again :)

We enjoyed our 5 night stay at Brandon’s place during our visit to Chicago. It was a great value and location to the music festival we attended. He was very kind and easy to communicate with and flexible with check in/check out based on our flight schedule. We were always able to find street parking in front of the house and felt safe. It was only about a 12 minute drive to Chinatown and the west loop Randolph street area for good eats. The green and blue line are fairly close to the house as well. I would definitely stay with Brandon again when visiting Chicago!

Great stay in Wrigleyville - very close walk to Southport Corridor that has a ton of great food and restaurant options. Great yard for pets and parking space is a huge plus. I’d recommend staying here!
Great stay in Chicago 😁
It was a nice home! Had a few hiccups, but the host responded promptly.
Great place in a great location. Very walkable. Great hosts. Quiet neighborhood and the place had everything you need for a vacation stay.

This is a great to stay! We loved the space itself with the well-stocked kitchen, comfy beds, updated bathrooms and cozy feel and sweet backyard patio. The neighborhood is also very peaceful and easy, we walked around and visited with some neighbors and felt completely at home here. It was delightful and anything you could want for a weekend stay was provided. We wish we’d had more time!

The stay was good and comfortable, te location may feel a bit unsafe in the evening through night but it’s specified clearly before you do a reservation so all good with it too, the place is nace and very clean, a bit cold for what I’m used too but that’s just me, the kitchen is fully equipped and clean so it makes the stay easier for travelers that don’t want to spend a lot in restaurants.
Nice clean place and very close to downtown.

Matt was a great host and we had a great time. We came from Nebraska to watch our girls play volleyball.  It was easy to walk to Wrigley Field. Matt greeted us and helped us navigate through a small issue out of his control. We love the place. We love sitting on the front porch drinking coffee every morning. Everything you could ask for was there if we come to Chicago again to go to Wrigley we would definitely consider coming back to his place. Would highly recommend it to any other visitor thank you Matt for all your hospitality, all your recommendations and always being responsive.

We loved this AirBnb! The home was beautiful and had all the amenities we needed. It was also very walkable and right next to the CTA stop. We def felt right at home and look forward to staying here again in the future! 🤩
Wonderful place, clean and cozy, walkable area
Great experience!

Great stay! The place was super clean, nicely decorated, and you could tell a lot of thought went into putting everything together. The private theater was definitely the highlight. Such a cool setup for watching movies or playing video games. Makes the place unique. Really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend!

Ryan’s place was overall a great stay! He was very helpful with all instructions and providing good service. It was quite hot inside the house as there was no central AC from what I could tell but inside the room there was an AC unit and that helped a lot. Overall I think it was worth the $ and would be a place I recommend!

Barbara's place was great for my stay in Chicago. It's new so everything was clean and well thought of. She did a great job equipping the place with everything you would need and there's lots of space for a solo traveler or couple. The neighborhood isn't anything special but felt safe and is near a main road if u need some quick supplies or quick snack. It's mostly lower end latin American food and small mom and pop restaurants. Nicer restaurants all require leaving that area.
Something I feel other travelers would want to know is this is a basement style apartment with small windows. Limited natural light, which I didn't mind for deeper sleeps, but with it being under a house it's easy to hear what's going on upstairs. You can't hear them talking but footsteps and furniture moving can be heard. It wasn't an issue for me.
All in all for the price, cleanliness, comfort, and value it was a great stay for me.
It was very clean and easy to get in! Had a great time in Chicago for labor day weekend

The home was clean and spacious. It was awesome that you get your own parking spot. My only issues were that the bed sunk and was very uncomfortable. It would also be nice if there was black out curtains. The tv in the bedroom did not work.
The neighborhood is noisy at night, if you need a very quiet place this isn’t it.
It’s in a nice neighborhood but it is a basement apartment and could often hear the people above me. Overall I enjoyed my stay.
Just as described and was able to use the baggage storage before and after the stay

Ana was a great host, friendly and always responsive. The room was great, peaceful/quiet, clean and in a great and safe neighborhood which was safe to walk around but also close to and easily accessible to other transportation. There were also  stores/shops, food places, restaurants, bars and so on easily accessible by car, public transportation or Uber/Lyft. The ambiance of the room made me feel right at home. The room was exactly as described and clean with a smart TV including streaming apps to enjoy. The bed was very comfortable. The shared bathroom was always clean. The place was equipped with everything I needed and I had a mini fridge in the room as well as access to a microwave and so on. I highly recommend this place and if I could give it more than 5 stars I would. I would also definitely stay again in the future when needed.

Would recommend Matthew’s place for anyone visiting Chicago for the first, honestly wish we stayed here 2 years ago. The condo is beautiful with a great view of River West, L station is less than a block away and from there you can take the train to pretty much any part of Chicago. 10/10 would stay here when we return!!!
Very clean house and everything is perfect . Nice place to spend time with family
sara’s airbnb in wicker park blew my friends and i out of the water! it wa so spacious, had ac for the really hot days, and walkable to so many yumm restaurants. very very happy we stayed here!

Finding the place and checking in went smoothly! Seemed like a good location, we felt safe in the area. The patio and fenced yard was a nice touch for our Boston terrier that travelled with us!
