Erica was very responsive and helpful with her instructions for checking in and out. The place was clean, felt cozy and was enough for our short Chicago trip. There’s street parking, which we always had luck finding a spot but I could see where it may be difficult on certain days or times.
There were some local spots close by that were easy to walk to. We loved the Jackalope Coffee and Tea House for our morning caffeine. We had some drinks and good conversation at Bernice’s Tavern and then headed to Shinya Ramen House after for some delicious food.
Jeff’s place was amazing especially for a last-minute weekend trip with the family easy to find. We will definitely utilize this place again.

The price was expensive for that property because it wasn’t maintained well.
1. There was smashed, filthy and smelly garbage bag in the garage.
2. Garage door wouldn’t open.
3. Kitchen ventilator doesn’t work.
4. Most if not all towel hangers in bathrooms come out loose since they weren’t fixed properly.
Such a cozy space. We felt right at home, had everything we needed supplied, and fell in love with the comfy bed! Host was super responsive with any questions we had. I’d definitely recommend :)
We had such a great time staying at Matthew’s place! So close to a lot of restaurants and coffee shops, and will stay again!

Best place is an absolute gem. Conveniently located between boys, town and regularville, on a beautiful street fabulous bakery, restaurant, breakfast diner, directly below the Airbnb, very walkable, lots and night life, great little shops and boutiques. And conveniently located near downtown, I would definitely stay here again
Very clear instructions and easily accessible. Train station was across the street. Everything was left cleaned a stocked in the house, if something ran out.
thx

We had a great stay at Sarah’s. The apartment is really comfortable, and has a lot of extra amenities- games, exercise equipment, desk, makeup vanity. The proximity to the pink line was super convenient for us. This is a wonderful place for a short or long stay, we felt right at home and Sarah was really sweet and accommodating. We would definitely stay again!

We completely enjoyed our stay here. It was a beautifully designed space with everything we needed. Martin, our primary host, renovated the space himself, and you could feel the passion and love he put into it. The shared backyard courtyard was likewise gorgeous and a nice place to have breakfast. Even though it was a shared space, we always had it to ourselves. And as a final touch, Martin was always quick to respond to us, kind, and flexible. We highly recommend this space. You won't be disappointed.

Great and large house. Love the individual bathrooms for each bedroom. Responsive and helpful hosts. Wes and Darius were very communicative and thoughtful. I’d definitely recommend to anyone visiting Chicago and wanting to be in the South Side (near University of Chicago, Obama Center, Griffin Museum and the Lake) .

I can't recommend Eugene's place enough! They were responsive and helpful leading up to our stay and once we where there it was easy to follow the instructions they provided. The photos are extremely accurate to how wonderful the space is and we found ourselves in awe of how great it was -- specifically the beds were sooooo comfortable! Eugene's Airbnb was really the cherry on top of our stay in Chicago and we will definitely be staying again if we're in Chicago!
Our stay was cozy and great! Super walkable area with many delicious food places nearby. You could faintly hear the music from the bars downstairs but it wasn’t a problem (if you’re a heavy sleeper)

The location is definitely the best part of this Airbnb. It’s very central, close to the train and bus stops, and convenient for getting around Chicago. The hosts were also very responsive and always replied to my messages quickly.
That being said, the room was extremely small and the overall condition was a little below what I expected. There was quite a bit of dust, the bathroom could have been cleaner, and the shower curtain had a very unpleasant smell. The mattress, sheets, and blankets were very basic as well.
The neighborhood felt a little unusual, and you see all kinds of people around, so it may not be for everyone.
Overall, if you have the option to spend a little more, I would recommend doing so. The location and the responsive hosts are definitely what make this place worth considering, but the accommodations themselves are quite basic.

Such an amazing place!
Anita is the GOAT!🐐

I really enjoyed my time at LIVN in Chicago. The building is close enough to downtown without being submerged it in, which is what I prefer. The building is secure and there are several food options within a minute or two of walking. They had everything I needed and it was very clean. They were also very quick to respond to any inquires I had (I didn’t have many since they communicated so well!) Overall I really enjoyed my stay and felt safe and cozy while I was here.

had an amazing stay at Soon Hocks  unit. It was last minute booking for two nights, and wish i could of stayed multiple nights and checked out the surrounding areas. it was one of the nicest airbnbs i've ever stayed in and can't thank the host enough for the awesome accommodations. Hope to stay there again next time i'm in Chicago. Thank you so much Soon Hock!
Great Place. From my experience with other places, they often don’t live up to the pictures but this place out did them. Everything was super clean.
Nice place!

Darío, Alicia and Zully were amazing hosts. They had the best recommendations for food, tourist attractions and night life activities. They were all super communicative/house was very cute, simple and very Chicago. We love this city and would definitely love to more.
Was nice! And the hosts were insanely accommodating!
Loved the location, so many places walking distance, accurate photos, lots of local suggestions, and plenty of room. Loved the king beds in every room along with the roof access and back deck

Just recently stayed here and the place is amazing I just love how vintage the house looks like. Im from LA and I just loved everything about this Airbnb and I have to give an amazing shout out to Darin and the hosts they really helped me a with a certain situation and I’m really grateful for them to help me out. I definitely recommend this place. The restaurants around here were amazing especially for a quick meal.
Amazing home and an amazing host.

Gabriel was a great host! He was very responsive in the weeks leading up to my stay. He provided excellent local recommendations that I used during my trip. He was also very helpful and provided quality service when I needed it. Highly recommend this place if you need somewhere to stay near Pilsen!
It was perfect location to Arc Music Festival. We had a great time, it fit everyone comfortably and had everything we needed. We would love to stay again next year!
Nice

Natalia and her rental were both fantastic. She brought us homegrown cucumbers and homemade pickles that were both fantastic. The home has quick and easy access to public transport, is close enough to downtown to make travel easy,  but far enough away to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city, and has a corner store very close by. We will definitely try booking this place again if it’s available!
Super helpful & communicative. Loved the area close to a lot of cafes. Laundry is a bonus too

Great if you’re looking for a deal and a cheap place to stay. Bed was comfortable and room wasn’t too hot temperature wise. Easy access to get in and host was available if things were needed. You get exactly what you pay for which in this economy is a steal
Clean and spacious apartment located conveniently near the red line.

The stay was perfect! There were so many places to eat within walking distance, which was super convenient. Jose was very responsive and accommodating, and the place was just as pictured. Everything was great from start to finish. 10/10 would recommend!

Friendly, helpful staff. Room size was fine for 1-2 people… the bathroom sink is tiny. Nice shower and comfortable bed + pillows.
The furniture and bathroom were very clean but I was surprised at some things that likely fall beyond a cleaner’s job; a few stains on the curtains/sheers, walls, and ceiling made me wonder how long they let a room go without replacing/repainting.
Otherwise, it was a decent place and convenient location for my weekend events (plus a bit of shopping!).
Awesome place to stay. Leah is a great host, everything A+ will stay here again, thank you!

Surprisingly quiet for being just 3 houses off of a main artery. Very comfortable and private, well appointed kitchen, excellent security, and close to everything including bus stops, restaurants, groceries and nightlife.
I will happily stay here again for a future Chicago stay! So much to do, and at the same time, a very welcoming home for cozy days and nights in

I had to book last minute when my original booking had a power outage. The place was super clean and convenient to the Brown line. If you like Middle Eastern food, there are several great options walking distance.  Would definitely stay here again.
Would stay here again! Host is great thanks

Stylish, spacious apartment in great location around the corner from the California el station (direct from/to O’Hare) & easy walking distance to yummy restaurants & Logan Square. Laura is a communicative and helpful host!

Afsha was a great host. Very friendly experience and easy to communicate with. She responded to messages promptly. The apartment was beautiful just like the photos and very clean. 10 out of 10 experience and highly recommend her listing.

We had a great experience staying at Milan’s place. He was extremely responsive throughout our stay, provided great recommendations, and made the entire experience feel very fluid and easy from start to finish. The place itself was very nice, clean, and exactly what we were looking for. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend Milan as a host!
A beautiful property with lots of beds in a great location with great hosts, what else can you ask for? Thanks again, Thomas and Cynthia, we had a wonderful experience!

Lawrence was very helpful when we questions. He was very knowledgeable and attentive. I also appreciate him fixing anything out of place at short notice. Thanks to him, my friend was able to get a great night's sleep.
Great price for the space and location. Host is very responsive and stay felt effortless. Thank you Auroom! Would definitely stay again.
Laura’s place was awesome perfect for 4 of us and right in the middle of everything!
Lovely place!
The place was a pleasure to stay at. We came with a large group, and it never once felt like it was too cramped or overcrowded.

Zoe’s place was incredible. The stairs are a little tough, but that being said the neighborhood is nice with plenty of good restaurants in walking distance.
I was happy and I’d totally stay here again
The host and her family is so kind!!

It was a great location, quiet and well appointed. Could have used some basic amenities like coffee and there is some maintenance that needs to be done but overall very minor. Would book it again for sure!
Highly Recommended! Comfortable and Cozy 😊
A retreat

Felt right at home!
The neighborhood was really quiet and the space overall was very cozy and comfortable 🤗 Definitely will come back for more staycations
We had a great stay, the place was clean and organized, exactly as described. Close to public transportation and in a safe neighborhood. I recommend it!
The place is spotless clean. The area it is located is great so peaceful! My family had a great time and just loved the place!

The best thing about the place was the location! Loved being close to the lake and public transportation to restaurants and museums. My favorite activity was the Architectural tour on the river!
Master bedroom was very large, second bedroom was very small with no closet. But the shower in the second bathroom was excellent. Kitchen was well-appointed, including ground coffee.
First time staying at an ABNB. Very satisfied.
We had a lovely stay in Michelle’s airbnb. 10/10 recommend!

Joe was super responsive. Logan’s Cozy Inn. was within walking distance to a lot of restaurants, markets, and coffee shops. The Logan’s Cozy Inn was also close to the blue line which helped maneuver across the city. The place was really cozy and private, the pool table was a great addition.

Price is below the market due to the location, preferably don’t walk there during the night. Host advises multiple times of that aspect and does not confirm booking until acknowledged, which is a mature approach. If you just need a place to sleep in and go do your thing (mine was going to a festival) - this is the perfect place to stay at. Host is responsive and helpful

Booked Lesley’s stay for my trip to Chicago. As a solo traveler this place was perfect. It’s nice and private. A good place to back to after exploring the city. Lots of cool restaurants, bars and shops close by and within walking distance. Bus stops nearby made getting around extremely easy and Lesley was very friendly and a great host. Will definitely be staying here again next time I’m in Chi Town!
We enjoyed our stay. Comfortable beds, quiet and peaceful as described. Easy checking in and out. Will come back again. Parking on the back is a plus.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. It was also very easy to find and convenient for Uber and Lyft, which made getting around super easy.
The host was absolutely amazing very communicative, responsive, and helpful throughout our entire stay. Any questions we had were answered quickly, and we felt well taken care of. We would definitely stay here again.
Thank you.

The location of the apartment is fantastic, right beside the Grant park with beautiful views of the bay. The apartment was very clean and we didn’t have to worry about our toddler playing on the floor. The hosts are responsive and answered all our questions within a short amount of time. There was some noise from the nearby trains but that didn’t bother us much. I would definitely stay here again.
Thank for hosting. Very convenient near the CTA pink line train. Felt right at home to sleep, shower, and refresh to go about my day downtown. Very peaceful and safe too.
This is an amazing location and space. I absolutely loved my stay. Vin is super easy to communicate with too. 12/10
I really enjoyed and appreciated Jane’s place! I would come back for sure. Had everything we needed and the host was very friendly.

The accommodation was fantastic. Very spacious and felt like we were a part of the community. The location is about 4 blocks from the blue line so that was great if you’re not renting a car. We ran into a little bit of a snag when it came to checking in, but it was an issue that had never happened to any of their guests before. They were able to handle the issue with grace and prompt responsiveness. Travis from the main office is amazing, as he was proactive in finding solutions so the issue never happened again. I’d love to stay here again if given the opportunity!
Our stay was perfect! Barry and Charlene were super helpful and accommodating! We would book again in a heartbeat

We stayed here for a few nights with a group of 7 while attending a festival. The location and price were good for our needs, and the space itself is modern and recently renovated.
Unfortunately, cleanliness fell short. Our socks turned completely black soon after arriving and we realized the floors hadn't been properly cleaned or mopped. The downstairs bathroom had shaving residue and hair, and the counters/sinks weren't wiped down properly. We also noticed hair on the bedsheets, which made us unsure whether linens were clean.
This property shares a building with neighbours, and during our stay their fire alarm constantly went off early one morning, and they played loud music into the night on multiple occasions. Not the host's fault, but after long festival days we were hoping for more peace and quiet, so future guests should be aware you're not fully isolated from other units.
Overall, not a bad stay for a short trip, but real room for improvement on cleaning standards.

Great place with fantastic communication from host. Really great spot in the city of Chicago, the only reason I'm giving it four stars is when we booked it, the street map showing the location was about a 1.5 miles west of where we actually stayed. We booked the location based on that specific location, so we ended up taking more Ubers/walking more to get where we needed to go. Otherwise, overall great stay and would stay there again.

We had an amazing stay in this BEAUTIFUL space! Everything looked exactly like the photos, and was as described. We loved using of the well-stocked kitchen, enjoyed the living and dining room spaces, and there was ample space for everyone on our trip to have their own room. The location is walkable, with lovely paths and great local shops to explore. It couldn't have been the more perfect place to enjoy a weekend getaway!

Pilsen Garden is a wonderful place, very comfortable, cozy, and full of authentic character. Communication was excellent throughout our stay, always friendly and attentive. We really enjoyed our time there and would definitely recommend it.

This property was quite expensive for what it is. There were large parties at the pool, the windows were so dirty we could barely see outside and the check in was extremely prolonged. We had to fill out a bunch of paperwork and do a background check when we arrived. There were also sooo many dogs so beware if you have allergies or are afraid.
Great place to stay in Chicago. A safe place within walking distance of many restaurants.
Great AirBnb experience. The house was beautiful and perfect for large groups (we were very comfortable with 11 people.).  Hosts were very communicative and great to work with.
Overall it was an amazing place and clean! Iris was very helpful and overall great.
Weihong was very kind and we had a great experience. Would stay here again for sure.

We had an amazing stay! The condo was clean, comfortable, and in a convenient location. Diane was very responsive and provided clear, detailed instructions that made check-in and parking easy. Everything was as described, and we really enjoyed our time here. Would definitely stay again!

Bella upgraded us upon arrival to a larger room for our two day stay. She was very responsive to our questions and we had many! Her place was perfect. Parking was a block away (it is public parking so you do need to pay). Coffee shop and excellent deli was just a couple blocks down Broadway. It is super convenient to our daughter's apartment which was a big bonus! Our only complaint is WiFi was spotty so we could t watch the football game Sunday night but honestly that really was nothing to complain about.

Sarah's home was absolutely incredible! I had a girls' retreat stay there for the holiday weekend and it was even better than the photos. Everyone was in pristine condition and so clean. All of the instructions for check-in and check-out were clear and easy. It looked like a Pinterest board come to life! Many of the girls said that they would be happy to book and stay there again in the future.

This is a great place.  I'd stay here again.  Comfortable and clean for a holiday weekend wedding for five of us.  The parking in the back was  convenient.  Having a nearby market  was a bonus and a few blocks away is the main area for restaurants for Wicker Park.   Thanks John!
Great place super close to Wrigley!!
Very enjoyable stay. Wonderfully welcoming hosts with great dogs. Excellent neighborhood. Close to lakeshore and running/cycling track.
We enjoyed our stay at Max’s place. Good neighborhood and the place is spacious. Felt right at home. Thanks again.

Walton residence was exactly as described, the concierge was extraordinarily helpful with Bags and checking in / out. Our only issue was the half bathroom wasn’t working, a minor inconvenience. If staying downtown, would definitely recommend.

Matricia went out of her way to welcome us to her place. She made sure we had what we needed and was always quick to respond no matter what the time. There were a few hiccups a long the way (not her fault) but Matricia was quick to get them resolved.  Recommend!

Muchas gracias por todas sus atenciones y calidez. Nuestra estancia fue muy agradable y realmente nos sentimos como en casa. La ubicación del Airbnb es óptima, puedes conocer Pilsen y llegar al metro fácilmente para moverte a otras zonas.

I had such a wonderful stay at Bianca and Jason's studio! The color and layout of the place was excellent + they provided everything we could have asked for. The studio was spacious and the decor gave it a very comfortable, homely feel. It was also lovely to be greeted by their extremely chill and friendly dog Nanook each day. They have a great view of The Loop from the studio and the surrounding neighborhood was super vibrant. Bianca gave us a great list of recommendations for food and local activities to do. She was also very responsive and helpful with any questions. I truly had an amazing time!

This was the perfect place for my group of 9 to stay right next to Wrigley! With 6 adults, and 3 kids (2 of them being toddlers), we couldn’t ask for a more walkable place for everyone. So much to do, easy access, and a quick walk to and from Wrigley field if you’re going to a game or event there especially with small kids. The space fit our needs well and was very comfortable! The only unfortunate issue we had was that the cleaner had not come before check in. However, Dennis was very responsive and made it right, right away, which we all really appreciated. This is absolutely a must stay if you’re going to Wrigley!
Nice place and a pretty good area to get around. Only downside is noise does travel kinda easily. Didn’t bother me much though so I would still recommend.

We had a great stay at Laurie’s place while visiting Chicago. The house was comfortable, clean, and worked really well for our trip. Laurie was a great host and communication was easy throughout our stay. We also really appreciated having a place that worked for us while traveling with our dog. We enjoyed our time in Chicago and would definitely stay here again. Thanks for having us, Laurie!
Great location with a friendly host!
Good place to stay. Can hear the neighbors through the doors in the hallway—not the end of the world, something to be aware of.  Right next to a train station and clean. Would stay again.
Love the place and it was in a good location

Nice place. David is very responsive - our Keurig coffee maker didn't work and his manager made arrangements to have a new one delivered same day.
Great location - easily walkable to Wrigley and Lakeview restaurants, shops, and pubs.

This was such a wonderful spot for our weekend trip to Chicago. Being able to walk to the beach but also take the train to downtown was so convenient! The neighborhood was nice and quiet but had lots of food near by.
Over all everything was exactly what we needed. I'll definitely stay again on my next trip to chicago!
Loved our stay here. Had a group of 12 and gave everyone the space they needed. Appreciated the multiple bathrooms and the kitchen on each floor! Would stay again!
Great host.
Great place for big groups , perfect location if you don’t want to be in the city. Enrique responded super fast to any questions
Roberto and Carlos were wonderful hosts and very accommodating during our stay. Would definitely stay with them again and would recommend to others.
La’Zeric was a great host and had wonderful communication. If you are looking for a good Airbnb this is the place to go!
Wonderful comfortable stay! Felt so relaxed and cozy! Would 10/10 recommend
Edgar was a great host! We appreciated his responsiveness and willingness to help and make sure our stay was as good as possible.
We had a great stay, highly recommend! The games were perfect for a group and the neighborhood had amazing food and things to do.
It was a great stay! Even though we had to share a bathroom, it wasn’t too bad! Nice and clean! walking distance from the stores, food, and bus stop/train!
We were very happy with our stay! We absolutely loved the neighborhood and how flexible and easy the check-in and check-out process was.

Loved our stay ! Came to a music festival in Chicago for the weekend with a couple buddies. It was nice to have a quiet safe space to stay afterwards and wind down. The place looked exactly like our pictures with the little bonus patio. Love that. Our hosts were friendly and helpful even checking in with me mid stay.  Definitely love the Neighbourhood and the parking was a breeze. First year having a full kitchen with a coffee bar was amazing. Didn’t even miss the continental breakfast that we usually do at hotels. We’ll definitely stay again.
Clean, friendly, just what I needed.

Loved our stay with Emanuel! It was on a quiet street — a great spot for our group. Plenty of room for everyone and comfortable beds, we all slept really well. He had snacks waiting for us too, which was so thoughtful! I would recommend Emanuel's place if you're traveling with a group

Our family of 5 stayed for a week and had a great time. Vraj was very responsive when anything came up and the place was exactly as described and pictured. One of the sliding doors was missing a lock dowel and he had one ordered and delivered by end of the day, excellent and prompt communication. The neighborhood is wonderful, lots of walkable restaurants and very near the Red line. We would definitely stay here again.
Good place

Marco's place was great - quiet neighborhood, easy access in a walkable neighborhood. He met us at the rental on arrival and showed us around the place, going over all the details of the space. The weather was steamy during our stay and he added a fan to the 3rd level bedroom in case we needed it, to supplement the air conditioning and the ceiling fan (heat rises!). The area is very accessible, with Trader Joe's nearby as well as other retail stores.
Marco was easy to communicate with and responsive in a timely manner - a great host!
We really enjoyed our stay! The hosts were friendly and responsive. This space was perfect for our trip, and we had a great time!

Dave was extremely quick to respond in communication and made a huge effort to be as accommodating as possible. He also sent extremely detailed instructions including photos that made everything super easy. Dave made us feel valued, important, and prioritized. The space was also beautiful and comfortable. I come to Chicago every year and will definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
great place, looks like the photos, location is central when drivable

This was such a great place to stay in Chicago! It was perfect for our group of friends to all gather and experience the city. The beds were comfortable, the place was clean and so spacious, and it was in a great neighborhood. The area was very quiet, but with lots to do around it within walking distance. We felt safe walking the entire time. The place itself was about a 10 minute walk to the nearest train station which easily connected you to the downtown area.
Overall, we would definitely stay here again and it would be a great fit for any larger groups looking to stay in one of the unique neighborhoods of Chicago while still having easy access to the downtown area.
Great host! We enjoyed the stay! Thank you again having us :’)

Place was better than I could have hoped for! Beautiful neighborhood withs tons of things to do. Countless cafes, bars, and restaurants in the area. This will definitely be my go to place when I’m in Chicago!

We stayed here over Labor Day weekend during hot Chicago weather, and the inadequate AC made the apartment unbearable. Although the listing says it has AC, we didn’t realize the second bedroom had none and would not have booked had we known. The two existing units were not sufficient for an apartment this size, and the second bedroom was often over 80°. This was especially concerning with my 70-year-old mother staying there.
We contacted the owner and maintenance adjusted the units, but it didn’t help. After repeated requests, the owner provided a portable unit, but it still didn’t adequately cool the room. The owner noted that cool air was coming from the units, but the issue was that they could not sufficiently cool the space.
We paid over $2,600, so having an unbearably hot apartment for much of our stay was unacceptable. My request for a partial refund was declined.
There were also cleanliness issues, including stained carpets and visible mold/mildew in the AC units.
Great place and location. Ryan was very responsive

My stay was great! It was exactly what I was looking for for my trip to Chicago. The decor was so cute and had lots of character. The neighborhood was very safe and quiet, and having a garage was a huge plus for us. Perry was super responsive and instructions and resources were provided for us for a smooth check in and check out.
Was an amazing place to stay. Comfortable and exceptional hosts!
Good location if you’re attending a game, Kelly was very responsive!
great place, great location, comfortable beds. will be back:)
Felt like Chicago locals staying at this spacious spot in Bucktown!

I was a bit nervous to stay here based on the lack of pictures, fairly minimal information, and shared space. I was very surprised to see it was better than expected. I had my own bathroom and didn’t encounter any other people while I was staying there. I heard some people coming/going but never actually ran into anyone. I felt safe as a solo female traveler. The shower also had 2 shower heads which was unexpected but nice. The place was also very clean.
To access the room you unlock the front door, go up 2 flights of stairs in the dark to another door that gets unlocked, and then to your room with a lock. All 3 doors have different types of locks and no explanation on how they work. The second door was frequently left unlocked and it look me a while to figure out how to lock it. The dark hallways are a little creepy but it’s fine.
The listing didn’t mention anything about the parking but it was free and always available in the front of the building.

This place is very conveniently located just off the main Andersonville strip on Clark. The backyard is very nice.
Kitchen was well equipped but the living room was a bit tight. 5 people can’t comfortably lounge around in that living room.
Bathrooms look nice but the showers drain slow and water spills out of the shower area.
I couldn’t tell from the photos that this was the bottom unit of a three-flat. When it says condo in the description, it makes me think of a larger unit.
Otherwise, everything was great!
Thanks for hosting us Jihad!
Let us check in early and check out a couple hours late. Great neighborhood, very quiet. Everything was as expected.
The home was walking distance from every thing we needed and in a great neighborhood! Would 1000% stay again!

Pros: good hot water and very close to a bus stop.
Cons: this place is extremely run down and it's not a great neighborhood. Carl's "office" is in the kitchen, so you never have privacy. Towels and sheets were extremely cheap and not very comfortable. Mattress is very bouncy.
Summary: if you have to be in the area over a holiday weekend like me and hotels are crazy expensive, this is a soft maybe. Otherwise, I would definitely avoid it.

Super nice place with ample room for activities and entertaining. House was organized and very straight forward. Sarah even allowed a later check out to give us more time to wrap up everything. Location was in a beautiful neighborhood.
Great location and hosts were easy to communicate with. The place was ok overall, nothing fantastic. Everything is very basic and not necessarily worth the price we paid for the weekend.
Cozy home, place and great place to stay in! There is one parking spot which is very helpful. Bernadette is very helpful and responsive.

My hosts were lovely and very responsive.  I stayed > 6months and would love to stay again.  They helped arrange parking and were very responsive to my questions and requests.  I tried to be a good renter, and we had a great working relationship.  I found the apartment very convenient to walk to work, the theaters, restaurants, etc.  It was also comfortable - both bed and couch and nicely stocked with kitchen and bathroom supplies.  Thank you for a great stay!
A gem in the midst of Logan square.   Make sure to set aside time to enjoy the garden and relax.
Great location and had everything we needed for our stay. Bathroom was very spacious and there were very nice mirrors including in each bedroom.
The apartment was very nice and very clean. The house was very responsive when I reached out. I would definitely stay again.

I enjoyed staying at this home! It was exactly what I needed for my trip. I enjoyed the home but the stairs were definitely a workout and felt like nuisance when dealing with our luggage so be prepared for that! But overall we enjoyed our stay and Cynthia was super accommodating and friendly!

Great spot with parking which is a great bonus.
Sleeps lots of guests comfortably with good access to the city.

We really enjoyed our stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and well stocked. Check-in and check-out were easy, and parking was just around the corner. The location was great—walking distance to Millennium Park, the Art Institute, Riverwalk, shops, and lots of restaurants. We’d definitely stay here again!

I was very impressed with this Airbnb. It was spacious for me and my party and had all the amenities I needed for my stay, cooking and washing clothes. This is a pretty close stay from Chinatown has well which was super convenient for my stay.

Mike's place was perfect for our Logan Square stay. Very neat, clean, and spacious with a cool, eclectic vibe. Mike was extremely helpful and communicative and did so much to make our stay comfortable and easy! Mike's place is very conveniently located, as it was a quick walk to the blue line and all the great bars and restaurants on Milwaukee. Would 100% recommend!
Very friendly and accommodating! Would recommend anyone and will for sure come back to stay here!

Abacus's place was clean, comfortable, and had all the needed amenities. The neighborhood felt safe and was convenient to publicl transportation. Quick to get downtown. There's some great restaurants nearby. The upstairs neighbors are a bit noisy but we didn't find it too disturbing. The neighborhood was quiet and clean. It was super convenient to have access to the private garage so we didn't have to worry about finding a place to park or keeping our vehicle safe. Abacus was very responsive and gave us all the information we needed to enjoy our stay.
Great place and not to far from anything we were doing while in the city!
Amazing location, as advertised, minimal amenities.

We had a great stay! The location was perfect, and the unit was very clean and exactly as pictured and described in the listing. Everything felt comfortable and well maintained, and we were very happy with the space. Great communication too.
The building itself could use some updating, but that did not take away from our experience with the unit. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay.

I had an exceptional stay! The host was very responsive and assisted very promptly, and the home was super clean and exactly as described. I was given very clear instructions on how to access the home and parking. No complaints at all!
Great host !
Greta area to saty very close everything
Went here with family/friends and it was an amazing experience. The place was very clean, safe, and felt right at home. My next visit to Chicago I am most definitely booking Leonard’s place again.

Such a perfect, quaint, charming little treasure in an established neighborhood. Erin was super friendly and had wonderful recommendations for shops, restaurants, and knowledge on the train lines for us. Would definitely visit again, it made us love Chicago!
The placed looked exactly like the photos and was the perfect amount of space for me and my friends when visiting Chicago.

We had an amazing stay! First of all, Anthony and Kaitlyn were incredibly friendly, communicative, and attentive throughout our stay. They made sure everything was going well and that we felt comfortable.
The check-in process was super easy, and the instructions they provided were clear and helpful. The place itself was beautiful, extremely clean, cozy, and comfortable. Everything was exactly what we needed and made our stay even more enjoyable.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Good location and it was very quiet
Watch out for dirty floors. You'll need extra pairs of socks to either throw away or bring your own slippers. Neighborhood is also unsafe and expect loud noises from the neighbors and dogs.
Communication was fantastic,  location was great and safe!  Would definitely stay here again!
Great host!  Thank you!
Great location & easy check in

Reggie’s place is the best.  This is my second year staying there and I love everything about it.  The rooftop patio is a massive bonus to the beautiful space and the bed is so comfortable.  I’ll be back next year for sure!
Ron was friendly and kind! Very responsive and kept the stay tidy and clean.
Jim’s place was as expected! I love the location, it was extremely close to China Town.

Milton was such a great and responsive host with a super spacious place. It was easy to get around and find quick bites around the stay and city thanks to Milton! I would for sure recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago!

Unfortunately, I forgot to take photos before we checked out so I don't have pics to back up my review. Our stay was just okay. The toilet seat in the bathroom was cracked and constantly moving, there was a good amount of either mold or dirt caked into the corner of the bathroom (not to mention suspicious mold-looking marks on the ceiling), and the bed sheets were so shallow, they kept coming off the mattress even after my partner and I fully remade the bed. Also, some people were loud past midnight.
I understand this is a budget stay, but this feels like basic maintenance/hosting considering how many rooms are in the overall unit. I'll take responsibility for not telling the host, but we were out from morning to late night during our stay and we frankly shouldn't have to tell the host about issues that were there from arrival. Lastly, I find it odd to tell us in a message that if we leave a review of 4 stars or less, we will contribute to Airbnb blocking the listing. Oh well.

Milagros was very friendly and had quick communication.
Our stay was great! Thank you!
Paul was a great host, very responsive and accommodating. The location was awesome for Wrigley/Cubs fans! We loved being able to walk to Wrigley and the neighborhood felt very safe.

We loved our stay! The host was incredibly kind and accommodating, always quick to help and full of great local tips, like nearby festivals we wouldn’t have found otherwise. The apartment was spotless, well-stocked, and felt very safe. The location was perfect, just two minutes from the bus stop and super easy to get around to places like Navy Pier. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a convenient and comfortable stay

Wow! Exceeded my expectations. The neighborhood is beautiful with restaurants and train stop close by.
Check-in was the easiest I’ve had so far, and Mark was super responsive and nice when I had to contact him (due to my own error using the lock pad).
The place had a ton of character and felt very private. Backyard was a nice added bonus.
Highly recommend.

I’m more of a hotel person but I’d book here again simply because there wasn’t a list of a million things I needed to do before leaving. It actually looked like the pictures and was clean. The neighborhood is quite charming. Parking is not designated spots and was a bit of a hunt at times - but it is Chicago.

We had a wonderful time staying here!! This is such a great find at a very reasonable price.
The house is so beautifully decorated and very clean. I absolutely love the disco ball, it really sold it for us. The private rooftop is such a nice touch as well. The host was super friendly and responsive and provided us with recommendations around the area.
Thanks so much for having us!!
Beautiful place 😍
We absolutely loved our stay with Ihor! If in the area again, I would definitely book another stay.

This place is great and the location, location, location. Had a game weekend and was only 2 blocks from Wrigley Field. Plenty of shopping, eating and drinking places surround the property and Josh was always ready to answer any questions.
Great communication, fast, and clear.
Muy bien todo, cumple con la descripción.
We had an incredible stay here!  Beautiful place and perfect location!
Fantastic experience in Chicago!

This is a great spot! Very clean with everything you need.  Walkable to restaurants, stores etc. If you have a car, side street parking is available. Dorothy is a very thorough Host and very responsive and attentive.
We had a big group going to Chicago and Vince was very helpful and amazing host. We will be back for sure!

Jhon was a great host. Very responsive to all questions in a timely manner. Instructions were very clear and easy to follow. Great location with restaurants, good wine bar and Orangetheory fitness just down the street. The train station nearby. Walkable. We would stay here again. The apartment is very comfortable.

Terrible price and absolutely not worth the 4k we paid for this for a 5 day vacation. It was extremely loud with thin walls. The neighbors having parties while we are trying to put our kids to be at 11pm…. The smell of urine in the hall ways, and the lack of privacy. Definitely not worth it at all.

LIVIN building was perfect for a weekend getaway in Chicago. Easy to get in and out of the building and is centrally located making it easy to uber around town because nothing was more than 15 mins away. BUT there were a couple sketchy people hanging around downstairs outside at nighttime and the bed was NOT a queen as advertised but my partner and I fit in the smaller full sized bed. Otherwise it was very clean and accommodating.
Clean , great location responsive hosts

It was a beautiful place with lots of room very comfortable to stay at and felt very secure about leaving our belongs in the home as the place has great security, there is alot of free street parking so great for anyone looking to drive there car in to the city, overall had a great experience and since the host is in the unit right above any immediate concerns can easily be sorted .
Great location, easy instructions, would stay again
Besides the loud music I think everything else was perfect.
Great spot to rest !
Great place, super clean and was perfectly spacious. Hosts are great aswell and communicate very well, definitely recommend.
this place was so great!! clean, easy to access, really great, fast communication! reviews said it could be loud but we didn’t feel that at all!!
Great stay and would recommend
Convince me to walk in beautiful places—easy, flexible check-in process. I am supposed to check in at 4, but they gave me an earlier time.

The place was clean and as shown in the photos. The location was really convenient, since is it within walking distance of various public transport options into center city. Nicole was also great and very responsive to our messages! It was an overall enjoyable stay :)
Had a great stay at Hotel St. Clair! Nice cozy location right off Michigan Ave. Host and hotel staff were very responsive. Room was clean, comfortable, and provided everything we needed.

Arthur’s place was cozy and cute! It was clean and well-equipped and had snacks for us as well. The neighborhood is beautiful and Arthur’s place is walkable to many shops, great restaurants, cute cafes, a great park with a pond and Lake Michigan. Truly excellent location!
Very nice location
Kimberly's place was in a great location and was just as advertised.  Our family had everything we needed for a short trip to Chicago.
Great place to stay!

Great place! The street parking was challenging as that was the only option besides metered parking. One room had a window unit and the other didn't have one, the living room had to keep both the bedroom and the living room cool which was tricky. The unit was super spacious! The building gorgeous! Also the host is super responsive and helpful!

Erica’s place is charming and perfect for visiting Chicago when you want to be close to downtown, but also avoid the night time noise.
She was responsive and friendly and would definitely stay there again.
Very easy process and clean space for our quick stay!

It was my first time visiting Chicago for a few days and I enjoyed my stay. Definitely recommend! However please note for future travelers not renting/using a car … it is a bit of a lengthy commute using public transportation into the city - just fyi. Thank you for hosting !

Vanessa’s place is exactly as described. We had our fantasy draft weekend there with 5 people and had more than enough space. Each person essentially had their own room with a television. The house was clean and Vanessa was wonderfully responsive and accommodating, providing recommendations and answering questions leading up to the reservation. The house ended up being great for just lounging in with its pool table and arcade machine. Wonderful stay that I would gladly return to
Beautiful apartment in a bustling neighborhood! Lots of restaurants and shopping within a short walk. Host was very responsive. All in all a great stay!
Space was clean and host was helpful and responsive
Good place to stay. Walking distance from Wrigley and Redline entrance. Good places to eat. Amazing experience.
It was a good listing very close to everything my friends and I wanted to do! Lovely house
Great stay. Parking was easy. Place was very clean and updated! Would stay again!

Great place to say! The place was very spacious and had great views and lighting! Very clean and a super responsive host. The couch in the living room however wasn’t the most comfortable to lounge in but other than that I would highly recommend!
Great place for our family to stay for our weekend trip. Host was very responsive and had some good recommendations in the area. The place was clean and easy to find. Street parking was easy.

Beautiful, spacious, clean, and comfortable home! Matt and Pam were excellent hosts—always quick to respond and provided clear, helpful instructions throughout our stay. They even went above and beyond to return an item we accidentally left behind after checking out. We had a wonderful experience and would absolutely recommend both the home and the location!
Great location.  A little dark inside, but that is what we expected.
It was such a nice place to stay, there’s a lot of amazing food spot nearby. I would recommend staying at this place
Nice!

This was a perfect place to be able to relax after spending time in the city! Very spacious and comfortable setting!! Initially had trouble getting into the apartment, but Frank was responsive and was able to help us out! 10/10 recommend!

Alex and Sam clearly put a lot of thought into make the space as comfortable and welcoming as possible. Lovely neighborhood and great waypoint for a few days spent in Chicago. Easy check-in/check-out. Highly recommend!
Super nice and spacious! Joel was so helpful and responded quickly. Highly recommend staying here!

Just spent Labor Day weekend in Mary’s place It’s great - furniture, etc is very nice - no cutting of corners! Kitchen was also very nice. One item I’ve experienced in many Air BnBs is there is literally cutlery & plates , etc for just two people - not this place - literally 8–10 of everything
Mattress/bed was very comfortable and we slept like babies.
Location was fine
There were no issues & Mary did reach out in case there were queries
Would strongly recommend Mary’s place how ever long your stay is in Chicago

We had a seamless stay and everything was exactly as described. Darina’s place was clean, comfortable, and everything we needed for our trip. We especially loved the thoughtful selection of teas and snacks that were provided. The location was also super convenient and close to the airport, which made traveling so much easier. Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend!

Robert’s Airbnb had everything we needed. We took responsibility for not leaving by 11 due to our flight delaying twice & sorting out travel arrangements. We left before 1130am, apologized to the property manager who came into the house, and we apologized again as she was scolding us from her car. As we left Airbnb, she still argued with us from her car.  There was 1 stain left on 1 pillow and our group offered a solution (pay for replacement). The property manager used insulting language toward us degrading us, intimidating us, belittling us claiming that something is wrong with us when we were trying to only come up with a solution.

Our group of 7 had a great time at this place. There was enough space for everyone. It took about an hour and a half to arrive from ORD using public transport. There’s a few stores and restaurants close by and good access to public transport to get around the city. The lake front and a beach is only a 10 min walk away as well. The bathrooms and kitchen were very nice and modern.

Amazing stay, the home was so cozy! I would definitely book again. There was an AC and a fan unit in every room which was amazing, it got hot at night. I would just recommend bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper as the AC unit is a bit loud. Besides that excellent and well worth the price. The machine for the water was great, it was really needed since we didn't want to carry a pack of water up the stairs. While we didn't use it, the office was very nice and neat.

Beautiful, charming place with lots of character.  Easy walking to restaurants and quick Uber to Rate Field for a Sox game.  We were even able to bring our small dog with us which was really nice and saved us boarding fees.  Kelsey was very responsive and helpful as a host.  My birthday weekend was so much fun with family and friends and this place made it so convenient for us!  I would definitely recommend it and stay again.
Jerry was a great host and the place was very close to great restaurants/things to do. Highly recommend Jerry for his attentiveness and ease of access of his place. The driveway is a nice touch 👌
Very nice place! very spacious and clean. Host is very friendly and responds fast!
Thanks so much, Ken! Your place was fantastic and we had a great time.
Great location. Spacious and bright. Rooftop deck and view is amazing. Convenient to coffee shop and bodega. Parking spot is a bonus. Would recommend and stay here again.
The place was so pretty and looked exactly like the photos! The host was so nice and always quick to respond! Gave us great tips on how to get to the city, would definitely rent again! 10/10 :D
Really enjoyed  my stay clean and close to everything.
Great stay! Friendly host
convenient and clean stay!!
Super clean and nice spot. Just as advertised and great communication from the host.
Very comfortable beds and pillows! Love it, so close to the beach!!
Heidi is a really kind house owner and offered me the parking with good price. Her cats are super cute too!!
Excellent location & gorgeous views. Lots of restaurants & things to do. Very clean & spacious. Responsive host. We had a fabulous time.

We enjoyed our stay it was very comfortable and I love the set up it was very nice and the folder helped on more ideas to check out as well. The people were friendly too and i loved how everything is close and the drive was perfect just 20 mins away from everything. We would definitely come back to this spot.

Another great stay here! So convenient to DePaul’s campus. This was my third or fourth time staying at this property. A great home base for my visit. Washer/dryer in the basement is so nice to have. Walk to campus, train station, lots of restaurants close by. I’ll be back!
Diana is fantastic! It was an amazing stay!

This is a great place to stay and is in a great location as the distance to popular places are short. Though it’s a studio, it’s very spacious and doesn’t feel confined at all. It has lots of essentials and you really don’t need to worry about forgetting something. It’s easy to find and easy to get inside, the host of very responsive so you could always reach out if anything. I would recommend this Airbnb and would definitely stay here again when visiting Chicago!
Great stay for the price.

Great location, off street parking was always easily accessible, if any issues,  all were resolved in a timely manner and most of all, appreciated the cleanliness. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely return for another visit!
He was wonderful and the place was so incredibly cozy!
This place was just as described! We found lots to do within walking distance! The space and neighborhood is so cute! Would definitely stay again!
Amazing place to stay and close to chinatown

Absolutely LOVED our stay! The Muse is beautifully decorated & perfect for photo ops! Very peaceful area, responsive host, and the home had everything we needed. Flexible check in & host even shipped back items left in the home. Highly recommended for a visit to Chicago! We loved everything about the place!

Jackpaul was a great host and was always responsive and quick to answer any questions that I had. Jackpaul provided clear instructions on how to check in and check out and the property is in great shape and affordable.

Our stay was perfect. It was super easy to get in and out and the instructions are very clear. Also, no duties when we left was extremely nice. The host was super responsive, and although we didn’t need much help, it was clear that they were ready to assist if needed. We will definitely be staying here again if it’s available 10/10 A++.
A convenient location close to buses toward Wrigley and CTA Blue line, there is a Jewel for groceries and a Spin it up laundry close. A fan in the room helped on hot days.
No complaints. Really nice place off the main road but walking distance to everything. Austin was incredibly helpful and answered questions immediately. Great experience for weekend trip.
Nice house. Lovely hosts. Bad location. The street itself seems fine being next to Obama center. But surrounding areas super bad. Lots of violent crime in area

I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and everything we needed was available. The host was friendly, helpful, and easy to communicate with. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. I would happily stay here again!
Staying at this air bnb, encourages me to come back and visit again. Absolutely loved it. Can’t wait to come back.

Alina’s Airbnb was a wonderful experience! The neighborhood is quiet, and the cozy space has everything we needed. The hosts are very responsive, and they provided so many recommendations around the neighborhood. Thank you for an incredible stay especially during ARC weekend!

The place was fine. Charie was helpful and responsive.
Two things didn’t go well:
Before the stay, we were informed that one of the bathrooms was unavailable for maintenance. They gave us a discount, so that was nice, but that was a bummer. We selected this place because it has two bathrooms.
Also, when we first arrived, the smoke detectors were beeping. Instead of waiting, I replaced the batteries. Later that day, the other smoke detectors started beeping. I guess that’s no one’s “fault” per se, but it was weird and annoying.
The place was clean and generally nice. Good location for sure.

The place is pretty much exactly as pictured. Clean and nicely done. Very hot when I got there, would have been great if someone  could have pre turned on AC. Also I do not prefer the smell of the plug in air freshener. I thought it was very quiet despite being next to train tracks.
Overall great stay with a great location, but had minor issues checking in/out with cleaners delaying their job (had to wait extra 30 mins before checking in) and bothering us during the checkout.

My family and I enjoyed our stay here. Location is great, you get the entire house which is huge, and the back patio was wonderful.
The reason I can't give it 5 stars is because the place is pretty run down and definitely not worth the price. The couch is covered in stains, the floors were dirty and ruined our socks, the linens could not be cheaper (towels were not full sized, were incredibly old/used and paper thin, had bleach stains on them), walls were all scuffed up, carpets were dirty and curing at the edges, etc.
The place is nice but not worth the price tag. I've stayed at much nicer places for much less. They charge luxury prices but this is not a luxury stay.
Beautiful home to stay in for several days. High quality finishes
Great place to stay. Close to Wrigley. Easy to find.
Apartment was clean, nicely decorated, beds were comfortable and it was a great location.

We are so happy we stayed at Beth’s place for my friend and I’s first trip to Chicago. The apartment was in the perfect location to easily get around using public transportation. The neighborhood is gorgeous, and the apartment itself had great AC, a comfortable bed, and was the perfect size for two people to stay. Everything was very clean and there were snacks and candy. Beth was so responsive and kind. We definitely want to stay here again when we come back!

We absolutely loved this place. First, the apartment was clean and the location was incredible. Loved the neighborhood and the proximity to the L. Beyond that, the space was incredibly stylish and well furnished. We really liked having the record player, AC during the heat wave, and plenty of space. When we needed some help Michael was responsive and kind. I would recommend this place to anyone. Thank you for letting us stay!

Tram’s place was very comfortable and clean. Tram was always very quick to respond to any questions or concerns. It was so nice to return to this lovely home after spending time in the hustle and bustle of the city! Would definitely stay here again.
Beautiful house! Stocked with the essentials and great location to the lake, Old Town, and Lincoln Park. Very walkable with lots of beds and updated kitchen! Beautiful outside spaces
Great stay, perfect location! Train is definitely loud but would stay again.
Great location. Close to the lake & to Soldier Field. 🫡 Would stay here again!

We had a great experience in Tamara's place. The place was immaculate, and the description was on-point. It was hot over the Labor Day weekend, but the two window AC units in the living room and bedroom cooled the apartment well. She had a nice welcome snack basket and a couple of bottles of water for us. In the bathroom, she had a basket of toiletries in case we forgot something. We were visiting our daughter in Logan Square (she lives in a small studio) so this was a nice location. It is about a 15-20 minute walk to the Blue Line. We will definitely consider staying here again when we visit our daughter.
Great place to stay! Clean, comfortable and great communication with Leo & Alex, if needed. Thank you!
Great place, would recommend
Fabulous place, and a great host! Perfect place for a couple. Super clean and cozy. Host was super responsive and helpful while we stayed. Would stay again!

Darwuins place was fantastic; cozy, clean and exactly how he advertised it. His communication was great especially upon arrival which made it easier for me and my mate to not only find the place but also get in. Highly recommend!

Unfortunately, this was the worst Airbnb experience I’ve had. The property did not match the condition shown in the listing. We encountered numerous maintenance and cleanliness issues: loose shower handles, a hot-water handle that became extremely hot with water leaking from behind it, a bedroom door that wouldn’t close securely due to loose/misaligned latch hardware, a loose hinge pin, loose outlets, a flickering kitchen light, apparent heat damage to the microwave, stained pillows, dusty vents, dirty/marked walls, and a sharp wooden bathroom frame coming apart.
Individually, some items may sound minor, but collectively they made the home feel poorly maintained and significantly different from the impression given by the listing. I documented these issues with photos/videos and sent them directly to the hosts before leaving this review. They said they would inspect the property. I hope these concerns are addressed for future guests, but from my experience, I would not stay here again

The location can’t be beat. If you’re hoping to explore Wrigleyville and/or go to an event at Wrigley Stadium, you could not ask for a closer place to stay. Walking distance to the stadium, restaurants, bars, and everything else. The place was very clean and Josh was always quick to respond to my messages.

The place was very clean, quiet, and peaceful, with such a beautifully curated feel. I had a wonderful time in Chicago, and after a long day of exploring, I genuinely looked forward to coming back and sleeping in such a clean, comfortable, and peaceful room. It made the whole experience even more enjoyable!
Great, convenient location! Just as described bedroom and bathroom that made our stay comfortable and easy. Daniel, our host, was very kind and responsive. Would recommend.

Michael’s place was perfect and he was a fantastic host. We were in town for the BIG10-SEC volleyball challenge at Wrigley. The location could not have been more perfect. We arrived early and he let us drop our stuff off while we explored Chicago ahead of the game. Michael was kind and inviting and gave us some great local restaurant recommendations. It was a fantastic stay. I highly recommend.

This house is everything you see and more! Rashad was very communicative and prompt with responses.  Check in/check out was a breeze. There’s plenty of parking on the parking pad out back or on in the front of the house. The location was close to everything and it was super clean! Oh, and the kitchen had plenty of spices and dishes/utensils.  I especially liked the artwork - so unique! Will definitely stay again!

Hands down the best Airbnb host I’ve ever had. Eduardo was nothing short of amazing and truly did everything to make our stay memorable. The house was spotless and came with everything we needed. He provided us with local recommendations and was helpful whenever we needed something. Even the neighbors nextdoor were welcoming and friendly! I would 100% book this place again in the future.
Fantastic apt in a great location - the quiet neighborhood and accommodations were perfect for our family getaway!
Really loved it !! It was like a 15 min walk to California train station and from there it was easy to get anywhere in the city. Lots of great food and drink options around. His place was great!!
Nice bnb that looked exactly like the photos! The area was just a little noisy
It was relaxing and comfortable.  We felt at home. Nice central location, walk to bus or brown line.

We very much enjoyed our stay at Kim's place! My husband and I booked this space so that we could have a fun weekend together exploring Chicago with a "babymoon" trip before #4 arrives! We had so much fun. We loved the location of this stay. The area was very residential and felt safe. We walked to the train station every morning which was so convenient! Along our walk we always saw couples pushing strollers, soccer games at the park, etc. It felt VERY family friendly which we loved! Kim's space was cozy and clean. The shower was especially fancy and nice. I loved that even though we did not have a kitchen space, we still had access to a fridge and microwave, and coffee maker. We will definitely consider this space if we are ever back visiting!

We flew in to Midway after a long day of work. Made our way over to their spot after some delays and was personally greeted by the host Harvey! He gave us the rundown on entering, exiting and even some history on the cedar wood that was used in building the house. We felt very comfortable. In the morning as we were preparing to leave out for the day, we noticed some camp chairs had been set out. Not wanting to be presumptuous we didn’t have long to wonder because Elizabeth introduced herself and assured us that the chairs were for our use!! She even provided cooler, beverages and snacks for our outing at the Chicago Jazz Fest and gave some saged advice and recommendations for parking locations. Talk about blown away!!! We felt so spoiled.  She shared tips and pointers for the African Festival of the Arts we went to and correctly noted that we probably would buy things while there. Of course I was in denial but it was a good time had and really good buys were made!! Our stay was terrifi
Great time in Chicago, would stay here anytime again

All things that I found everything I expected. The owners are very kind, and the place is always clean. The location was perfect: close to the subway station, supermarkets, restaurants, a pharmacy, etc. If you are looking for the perfect place in Chicago, this is it. Thank you, Luke and Ligia. God bless you!

Kristie was fantastic, warm, responsive and welcoming. The property was clean and had everything we needed…including some thoughtful complimentary snacks and wine. The location is quite convenient. Great restaurants, bars things to do/see all within walking distance. And secured private reserved parking right onsite. Very happy with the stay.
Beautiful place in great neighborhood.

We had a wonderful time in Chicago
Location is amazing & host was great about letting us arrive early & check out late
Perfect affordable option for me to stay during a conference at the McCormick Convention Center

Finding a decent Airbnb for a big group can be hard in Chicago but this was perfect for our family of 10. Kitchen was stocked, check in is easy, can walk to the lake, walk to coffee and walk to Wrigley. We recommend.
really amazing deal for the area- host was very thorough but i also felt i got the private retreat i was looking for.
Amazing stay. Cynthia was easy to communicate with. Her Airbnb was also cozy and clean (so cozy that I didn’t want to leave!) Will definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago.
Great place to stay. Easy to get to, fun neighborhood, comfortable house.
Very good stay - everything was as advertised!

Place was very nice, clean, comfortable bed. The apartment is very close to the CTA station, we didn’t even need a rental car all weekend and was able to get right into downtown. Felt safe at all times walking around the neighborhood.

The place was great! We had a few bugs we couldn’t find where they were coming from in the bathroom. But overall was a nice stay with plenty of outdoor activity’s! Beautiful neighborhood and friendly people!
John is a very attentive host! The bedroom was cozy, bathroom was very nice, and the backyard space was lovely!!! The Hyde Park neighborhood is a great location, too!
This is by far the best apartment we rented in Chicago. It is perfect in every way possible. The city views are priceless.

Our host was fantastic! Super communicative and friendly, and quick to respond whenever we reached out. The place itself was really cute, with lovely decor that made it feel charming and welcoming. We felt safe during our stay, though our Lyft driver mentioned the area isn’t the safest, so that’s worth keeping in mind. Our only feedback would be on cleanliness. We noticed some sticky spots on the counters and cabinets, dirty microwave/fridge, and a few stains on the bedding that we’d love to see addressed for future guests. The kitchen was also missing a few basics like a pizza cutter. However, there was water and alcohol available to purchase. Overall, a decent stay thanks to a great host, and just a bit more attention to cleaning would make it even better!
This was in a home where carol lives but we had no issues living with them when we visited chicago
Great Airbnb to stay at and was within a good distance of everything we wanted to do!
thank you so much for the stay!! very nice and cozy
Great place, match description

Solid and clean. Close to the festival I was attending and easy to follow instructions. Bed was comfortable and private enough for sleeping soundly. I only wish the bathroom was larger or could accommodate for more people.
Brett is one of the best host I’ve ever had. He is very helpful and quick to respond if you ever have any concerns or questions. The home is also  comfortable with plenty of space
10/10 host! Extremely responsive and helpful, thank you!
Very accommodating with quick response time. Would stay again.

Great apartment in the heart of Chicago. It was easy walking distance to many hot spots and comfortable for our family. The nearby nightclub was not disruptive at all and the beds are comfortable. A relaxing place to land after exploring the city and museums, etc. We would stay here again!
Great place and host was super responsive!! Would definitely stay here again

Spacious yet cozy home, perfect for a weekend friend getaway. House has lots of nice touches (kitchen with all the cooking supplies, kids toys & games, extra blankets). Neighborhood is quiet and was easy to get downtown or to nearby restaurants.
Exceptional ! All the details were perfect plus Smarties! Not a better Airbnb host exists and I should know.

My son and I had a wonderful stay. Lynette and Efrain were very accommodating and responded quickly when asked about transit and local restaurants. The house was very clean, recently updated, and comfortable. Lynette and Efrain were even kind enough to have cold waters in the fridge waiting us due to the 100 degree heat wave the day we arrived. The outdoor area was also a plus. It felt private and relaxing. Thank you for letting us stay!

This was one of the nicest Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed in!!! Liliana’s home was incredibly clean, comfortable and beautiful. Our group of 6 women had plenty of space. We loved the location and the included parking spot. I can’t say enough good things about this home, and Liliana was very responsive and lovely.
In a part of town close to lots of points of interest. It’s easy to get around on public transit as well, not too far from the location. I’d book here again, a good space, fortunately very quiet.
The place was super clean when we came in and the owner was responsive and accommodating for any of our needs! I highly recommend and it is a walk away from Chinatown as well :D

Everything was exactly as shown in the pictures! In a nice quiet neighborhood, it’s a great place to come back and relax after spending the day exploring the city. We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the city!

Great location and accommodating. Near Obama Museum and Science Museum which is highly recommended. Spacious living room and dining area. Parking a little challenge getting use to the signage. Overall highly recommend and great city to visit. Blessings.
Great location and matched the description perfectly…spacious and was ideal for entertaining our large group over a long weekend.
Great place, great location, host was responsive, would definitely stay here again

The place was easy to find, great description and photos to know how to enter.  Very clean, comfortable and Rocío was very welcoming and provided great food recommendations. Loved meeting her beautiful huskies but did not hear any barking, etc while staying.  We spent the days sightseeing, it was nice to return to a quiet, comfortable space.  I would highly recommend.
Great stay! Communicative, friendly and as expected. Perfect location. Would stay here again!

Great location. Great communication. Clean place. Very easy and accommodating. Overall a great decision. The only concern was a moldy/mildew smell, seeing as how it was a basement apartment, just a heads up. By no means did it damper our trip, but we’re pretty easy going!

The apartment was largely as advertised, though numerous small factors add up to me not recommending this airbnb.
- Almost certainly an AI bot “host”, decreases trust that a real human is involved were help needed (takes same 1.5 min to respond to every message, no matter the time of day, with very chat-GPT esque writing. Why are you pretending to be a nurse??
- Very cheap furniture and doors - doors struggle to fit in the doorways, one bathroom without a lock, lots of outside noise and light gets in the blinds
- Just 1 key for a 3BR apartment is very inconvenient.
- stained carpets and musty odor in bathrooms
- in general the most soulless Airbnb I’ve been in; I understand I’m not renting a place ever lived in by a human owner, but why is there a sign saying “please flush” above the toilet?
- Thinnest toilet paper I’ve ever seen. Worse than the stuff you’d usually find in a public bathroom
The place works. Three couples stayed for 3 nights and it was ok. But many things add up.

Amanda was nice and made our honeymoon easy to enjoy being so close to all the destinations we wanted to go see.  Just know it’s 3 flights of stairs lol, to get to Airbnb. We did have one night that we had to park streets away from the Airbnb. Other than that. She is great at communicating, amazing at finding quick solutions, and very knowledgeable about the city, her recommendations 1000% on point. When me and my husband come back, we’ll book with her.
The place was good for our group, good location.

I had a great stay here with a group of 13. The location is fantastic and it was easy to get around. The unit was spacious and comfortable enough for everyone and looks like it does in the pictures. Parking was a little difficult but we were able to find a lot not too far.

Overall, we had a great stay! The home was perfect for our group of 6 with tons of space and a great location. Having a stand alone home was also a huge plus, especially with a large family. Would definitely recommend for families or groups!
Very responsive hosts and super accommodating! We flew in pretty early and they were great about letting us drop our bags off so we didn’t have to carry them around the city until check in.

Exactly as described, host was very responsive and nice, super close to the Brown Line which made it easy to get everywhere. Street parking was easy as well with lots of restaurants and shops in the area!

Clean and comfortable! You get the entire bottom basement floor of the house to yourself with a living room, bedroom, bathroom, and washer/dryer included. Quiet and walkable neighborhood with lots of great restaurants and public transport close by.
We enjoyed our stay, host was very responsive and helpful. Place was just as described.

We had a comfortable stay here. The private place to park was extremely helpful! We enjoyed walking through the neighborhood to Moonwalker Cafe (great donuts), and the apartment had everything we needed. Be mindful after dark, but overall we had a nice stay and would stay there again.
Clean area would definitely come back
Great place would come here again

Edgar’s place was perfect for our stay during Labor Day weekend! It’s a shared area which you can hardly tell but the time I did get to meet the people next door we had great conversations! Definitely recommend for a weekend trip!

Great place to stay for north coast music festival if you don’t want to be super in the city. was about 30 min from the venue. only if you can behave yourself and be respectful and quiet of course because it’s an upstairs bnb. beds comfortable, pillows extremely comfortable!! lots of air conditioning which was great because Friday was HOT HOT, and i was not feeling good at all, so that was fantastic. clear instructions to get in, quiet location, parking in front. didn’t get to use the backyard because we were super late when we got back each night. but did utilize the little smoking room.
i think adding a couple card games or cheep board games in that room would be fun! but not necessary it didn’t take away from the stay. i enjoyed myself, and would stay again.

What a great place to stay!  Clean and great location!  Kristine checked all the boxes as a great host with great upfront communication and good local recommendations. We would definitely stay here again!
Great stay, and beautiful apartment!

Don’t stay here it’s a storefront! There is a strong mildew and animal urine smell in the condo! It’s in the middle of a bad neighborhood.  It was not safe for kids and someone propped the back door open at night without our permission.  Let me just tell you we couldn’t even stay here it smelled so bad.  We had to rent a hotel.  It was gross and misleading.  It was a storefront.
Lisa's place is great! It was easy to find and access, and parking was no problem at all. The space was comfortable and full of thoughtful amenities. I hope to stay there again sometime!

This was a very beautiful Home. It was just as described. The neighbors were friendly. The neighborhood was quiet. There were plenty things to do in the surrounding area. The House was equipped with everything anyone would need. They had all the cable stations hooked up. You didn’t have to log into your own, he had that taken care of everything. I love the fact that the kitchen was well stocked with great seasonings. You didn’t really have to buy a lot of extra stuff because it was well stocked. The bathrooms were well stocked I couldn’t have asked for a better vacation. Thanks, Jessie
Was a good place and had what we needed!

our group of three girlies stayed here for a long weekend! we loved this airbnb, super close to the train and bus stops which made it easy to get around chicago. also loved the art around the space + personalized chalkboard welcoming us. would definitely stay here again!!

Carl was great!
I felt comfortable staying here
Jessica’s place was lovely! Even better than described / pictured. Great neighborhood and a super friendly host - would absolutely stay here again.
Great location and nice yard. Can hear upstairs sometimes and owner upstairs has a nice dog too, which you share the yard with.
Was conveniently located for our traveling in Chicago.  The home was easy to get to do with the direction the host provided.  Recommended to others!
The place is pretty huge, could easily fit an air mattress or two in the basement. The 3 full bathrooms are clutch!
Victor’s place was great! Clean and exactly like the pictures.

We had a really nice stay! The place was clean and nice, and an excellent deal! Neighbors were very friendly and the location was really nice for taking the metros and busses. We will look for this place next time we visit!

As a family of 6, we enjoyed the days.
Pros: Beds were comfortable and the space was clean. Fully stocked kitchen with nice glasses, including wine glasses, beer mugs, and coffee mugs. Dining was spacious.
