Cons: A few mishaps and one of the bedrooms ran hot due to lack of central AC. Though the bottom window in the bathroom was frosted, our guest weren’t as comfortable taking showers.
Overall, a decent stay. We felt safe in the home.
Everything was fine.
Very clean and comfortable place, great location, nice neighborhood. Host was very responsive.

Elida's home was amazing! We loved the movie themes for each room! The home was clean and spacious enough for my group of 12 to stay comfortably. Elida provided fast and clear communication whenever we had any questions. Overall, I would love to stay here again, although the location is a lil further away from the city.

What a great host Lois was!!  She was in constant communication with us the week of our arrival and when our expected check in time got delayed she was so accomodating!  There were 8 of us (with 4 20 somethings) so we were worried about being too loud, but she told us not to worry and we had an absolutely amazing time!  Her place was as described and easily slept all 8 of us!  She gave a rundown of what to do (and where not to do) and if we ever get the chance to get back to Chicago we will stay there again!!

Had a short stay at Derek's place. It was very clean, safe, welcoming.  Derek's was very friendly and had great recommendations.  Next time I come back I will definitely check a few of the things he mentioned.  Thanks for having a safe place for my 13yr old  daughter and I. Definitely recommend staying at Derek's.
Great place

Our stay was great, the train was only a short walk away and the coffee shop next door was amazing! The neighborhood was very safe and walkable. The space was clean and felt comfortable, Kim was very nice and helpful.
Great place! Really nice apartment with lots of stuff in walking distance. This was a great base for my trip and would recommend it to friends.
It was a nice place to stay me and my family enjoyed the stay.
Clean and nice Airbnb! A little far from everything but house was beautiful!

Great location for neighborhood restaurants in Old Town, 15 min walk to Lincoln Park zoo and lots of park.  This was a great location for our 2-year old with easy parking. Hosts are very responsive and pro-active.
This unit was perfect for a group of 5. Neighborhood was quiet. Would stay there again!

Wonderful location. Everything was a great experience. Home was comfortable and had everything we needed. Neighborhood is safe and quiet with plenty of parking. Appreciate that the location had coffee and extra tooth brushes. Great location to be able to go downtown. Would highly recommend for families. Would book again.

Nice condo with all the comforts and amenities of home. With two floors and plenty of space, there’s lots of room to spread out and relax. Two beds and two bathrooms, just1.5 miles to Wrigley (we walked to it). Would stay here again.
Lida’s apartment felt very much like home. I will definitely be staying there again next time I visit Chicago.

Enjoyed my stay. Neighborhood is very peaceful and quiet. Was not difficult to find, it’s about 30-35 mins from the airport/O’Hare. Upon arrival to the place, Check-in was smooth, you do need to take your shoes off at the door and wear a replacement sandles to change into, unless you have your own house slippers.
Other guests were there when I stayed, who were also quiet and respectful which was a plus. I Did hear a few steps/ creaking from above/ ceiling, but nothing overly disturbing, no stomping or someone running around. I stayed in the lower level. Room was very clean, neat, organized, had a chic classic white yet modern look/feel to it. Location is about 15-20 from downtown which was great and convenient. I would highly recommend this place, location if you’re traveling solo and/or with a partner.

Jaqueline’s place was amazing and we really felt right at home. She checked in on us and made sure we were comfortable which is a great sign of a good host! The terrace area is beautiful and stunning to say the least. Good neighborhood and friendly neighbors as well! Overall an excellent experience!

Ran across issues with opening and closing doors. At one point, those who slept in the downstairs room were almost stuck at one point because the door would not open and it was hard to close for privacy. Other than that, had a great time with our large group. Convenient location and walkable to many stores/restaurants.
Great place to stay. I wouldn't suggest using valet for your car.

Wonderful place, stocked well, comfortable, and in a great location. I would recommend for anyone traveling to Chicago and wanting a place near Wrigley.
Greatly appreciate the extra pillows, fan, coffee, and easy check in and out.
I didn't rate the price because I'm not familiar with Airbnb pricing to make comparisons,but I'm absolutely/completely/definitely satisfied with my stay here!💯
Adam's property was even better in person than in the pictures! It was the perfect place to celebrate my best friends 30th birthday! Everyone loved it & had an amazing time. Thank you Adam!
Loved our stay here! The host was very responsive and had everything we could have needed!
Great place to stay! House was private and peaceful definitely felt at home, definitely made our getaway one to remember!

The property was well kept and also close to the blue line, which was helpful for our Chicago trip. Lisette was responsive when we needed to find items such as extra bedding. We would come back for another trip
Excelente aparamento, tudo maravilhoso!
Great quiet spot on north side of Chicago. Amenities in the house were very nice. Parking was spot on. I’ll be back 10/10 times
Very walkable, comfy, clean, good ac. Would stay again
It was very clean and matched the description. Quiet neighborhood. Would book again.
Josh was great to work with. He was always responsive and helpful! The proximity to Wrigley Field was wonderful and we were very happy with the location
My friends and I enjoyed it stay. Chad was amazingly responsive when questions came up. Would stay here again.
Nice place and location

Decent stay. Walkable. Very close proximity to China Town. A train runs very close to the property and there is a gym nearby that causes disturbances. It would be great to have a full body mirror in the unit.
The location is great; short walk to the beach and restaurants.  Train is close too.  The apartment has plenty of space with a great layout.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for our trip. The location was convenient and made it easy for us to get around Chicago and enjoy everything we had planned.
The host was responsive and helpful, and the check-in process was easy. We especially appreciated having a comfortable place to come back to after long days of exploring the city.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the Chicago area. Thank you for a great stay! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had a great stay here! The perfect spot for a trip to Chicago! This air bnb had everything we needed for a comfortable stay and the room was extremely comfortable! The common areas were super clean and made us feel right at home. The place is in a quiet neighbourhood but there are bus stops / the subway near by which was convenient to get around. Would recommend this place to anybody coming to Chicago :)

Location made this property work. It is walkable, area felt safe and easy to get to and from. The public train tracks are a few feet away so you hear the noise of that at night. The building itself while it seems like it should be new, it seemed very worn from frequent use and either residents or guest not taking care of it.
The apartment itself was ok although on the smaller side. It has 4bedrooms but the rooms are very small and tight to maneuver around with luggage. The space was clean in-general and had the basic needs however, the furniture was a little worn. The couch while vacuumed had some stains and took up a huge chunk of the space in the shared living room, dinning area. The wood table in the space that was meant to serve as an eating area was covered in stains from drinks. The space didn’t really have room from a group to hang out and seemed to suite more as just a place for basic living but not so much for connecting.
Nesha was very responsive and was able to help me whenever i need it!! Will be back :)
We had a girls college reunion. The place was perfect for us! Clean and comfortable.  Was close to so much! We had a great weekend!
The perfect location for a last-minute stay in Chicago. Wonderful host!

This place was simply beautiful, I can confidently say it is the best airbnb i. Chicago area, great host, really flexible and gave us an extra 2 hours for check out, THANK YOU AUROOM! You guys are the best!

We had a great stay here with 4 people. The condo is spacious and very clean. The backyard deck was our favorite part and it felt very private at all times. They had a ton of k-cups and tea, water and alcohol in the fridge, good amount of towels, makeup remover, and other toiletries like shampoo, etc. We felt very safe and welcomed, the condo was very quiet despite being a 5 min walk to Wrigley Field. Peter was very responsive before and during our stay. We would absolutely stay here again!

Here’s a version under 1,000 characters:
Check-in was smooth, though there was a noticeable odor in the secondary bedroom and some cleanliness issues we chose to overlook. Saturday was otherwise fine—we cooked, grilled, talked, and went to bed. Early the next morning, we woke to significant flooding affecting the bathroom, kitchen, and basement. We contacted the host immediately and followed instructions while trying to contain the water. We were without a usable toilet for much of the day, and the kitchen ceiling eventually collapsed, forcing us to leave early. The host never came to check on us or the property while we were there, never asked if we were okay, and did not offer relocation assistance. Communication after we reported the emergency became accusatory rather than supportive. We had stayed here before without issue, which made this especially disappointing. I would not stay here again.
Nice place to stay in Chicago

This was a 10/10 stay! I will be recommending this location to friends and family. Everything was as described and the area felt safe. We really enjoyed our time in Chicago and this home is a big reason why!

This place was perfect for a peaceful weekend in Chicago. Everything was as listed; the neighborhood was adorable, safe, and had walkable restaurants/grocery stores; and getting downtown on the L was quick and easy.
Sean was very responsive and friendly. Great stay!
Loved it here!
Richard was extremely helpful and knowledgeable about the area. He had many recommendations for activities in the area.  Very pleasant and relaxing stay. Recommend staying!!
Great location and value. Host was responsive and friendly.
We had a great weekend. The place was quite large and easy to get to many of the things to do!
Very nice host, easy to contact, beautiful & spacious apartment!  Clean, bright & the neighborhood/location was great! I’ll definitely stay here again!

Would not recommend due to the location and the lack of comfortability in this Airbnb. It wasn't my preferred choice to stay, however if I would have known the room was going to be extremely small, the place would have roaches, and the neighborhood was even worse than described in the listing, I would have looked elsewhere.
Cristina was a very responsive host and provided a great space for us to stay for a long weekend.

Overall, the host was very nice, responsive, and easy to communicate with. I also appreciated how accommodating they were during my stay.
That said, the cleanliness could definitely be improved. I understand that this is a shared Airbnb, and I wasn’t expecting a hotel-like experience, but there was noticeable dirt on the walls and baseboards, as well as hair on the sink and toilet. Those details made the space feel less clean and comfortable than I expected.
Overall, the host was great, but I would recommend paying more attention to the cleaning details between guests.

Excellent location and it fit our needs very well. Super close to the train station but the train itself wasn’t loud at all. It did have a very musty/damp smell that made it feel less clean. Hopefully that could be addressed for future guests
Very beautiful home, Rida is very responsive any issue we had she responded almost instantly.

Nicoll was an awesome host; she made us feel welcomed and made sure the place was clean and ready for us! The instructions to get into the Airbnb were clear and easy to understand. The house was awesome and I strongly recommend the home to anyone looking to stay in Chicago!
Amazing location, 5 minutes walk to Wrigley!
Great location and cleanliness. Highly recommend!

The stay was okay. I expected a little bit more from the apartment its self. I also think it’s important to mention it’s right next to the rail road tracks so if you are a light sleeper you’d likely wake up from the trains going by. There was some damage present which looking at past reviews were from a previous guest, this did not affect my stay. On the bright side the water was always HOT. Although the place could have been cleaner, and have clean sponges to wash the dishes. I did reach out to the host and he said there were some under the sick which I made it aware to him they were gross. I did end up buying my own to wash the dishes. Over all it was decent however I expected it to be better.

Mimi and Paul's home had everything you need for a comfortable stay. Their concierge team was responsive and proactive, the listing was clean and pristine when we checked in, and included everything as listed. I visited from NY so I'm well familiar with living in small spaces but the photo angles made me expect the place to be bigger. It's well sized for two, however, it may feel a bit tight if there are 3 people staying here (in my opinion).
For future renters who are considering, this home is not on Google Maps so it may be a bit tricky to find with the instructions provided. It was for me at least. Once you find the place, it's easy to navigate afterwards and you can order an Uber at the nearby cafe. This is my first Airbnb rental behind the actual host's home so I wasn't expecting the logistics when booking this place, which I think should be disclosed for those who want complete privacy.
I still highly recommend this home and appreciated Mimi and Paul's hospitality!
We were in town to drop our daughter off at DePaul. Could not have chosen a more perfect location. Exactly as presented, excellent restaurant/bar options. We loved it!
Very comfy apartment, everything is as described
Great spot for my girlfriend and I to stay. Had everything we needed for a long weekend. It was cozy, clean, and quiet. The restaurants in the area were delicious, too!
Thank you for the comfortable stay!

Great place to stay close to everything. The one bedroom is very large and appreciated the extra space with a baby. It's a little on the small side in the living space but was perfect for a small group.

The neighborhood was beautiful,safe and peaceful! We could walk to everything we wanted to do. The L is one block away (you can’t hear it inside the house ) so convenient if you want to go to the navy pier. The beds were very comfortable. There was a lot of room to hang out too . Great place will stay again when we come back to Chicago
Tracy was so nice and very responsive, and the home was lovely and spacious! Such a great stay

I would stay in Cheryl’s place again in a heartbeat. It was perfectly located in the heart of Lincoln Park. Parking was never a problem. The house itself was darling and comfortable for my family of 5. Cheryl was lovely and easy to communicate with.

We had a great stay here! The location was super convenient and we felt very safe. There are two separate locks you have to get through before even entering the building, which gave us extra peace of mind.
Street parking was surprisingly easy to find, and the space comfortably fit our party of nine. The location was also perfect for getting around. Chinatown was super close, and it was easy to hop on the highway to get downtown.
We booked this place for North Coast Music Festival and it worked out perfectly for our group. Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!

Nikka was a great host, no complaints about her. My only issues were with the nonexistent “hot tub/ jacuzzi” and the broken bathroom lock. The place was also a bit smaller than I expected, however everything else was good and in an extremely peaceful and accessible neighborhood which is why I gave the 4 star.

I don’t normally write a lot during reviews, but I was just here with a couple friends and this place was fantastic. They have a really thoughtful guide book, the location is very convenient, and we really appreciated no extra hoops when checking out. We would definitely stay here again.

Our stay was absolutely seamless. The place is so thoughtfully curated preserving its classic old Chicago style with modern amenities. We wanted to move in! Our hosts notified us when the place was available a few hours early and check out was simple. Given this place is located near some loved ones, we hope we get the chance to stay here again!!

This apartment is in a quiet area just across the street from a school and park area.  Easy to find street parking.  It is over a mile to the nearest Metra station (Kedzie/ Brown Line), but there is a bus stop close.  However, I would advise being familiar with the system or leaving plenty of time to get around if using the CTA system.  The apartment is well furnished, and it all worked out well.  Enjoyed our stay.

Paul is a wonderful host that has clearly cared deeply about this property for MANY years. Logan Square is an excellent Chicago neighborhood and just about everything you could want to do is within walking distance and if it isn’t, the train is a short walk away. A spectacular experience!

We had such a wonderful stay! Our hosts were incredibly kind, welcoming, and accommodating throughout our entire visit. They were so generous in allowing us to check in early and have a late checkout, which made our trip so much easier and more enjoyable. Their hospitality truly stood out, and we felt very well taken care of during our stay. We really appreciated everything they did to make our experience so comfortable and would absolutely recommend staying here. Thank you again for being such amazing hosts!

We loved our stay here! The location is amazing with so many restaurants, shops, etc to walk to and an easy walk to Wrigley field. Diane’s place is 5 star with high quality amenities and everything we needed. We would love to come back!

The place was cute & clean and the host was very responsive!
They were doing some painting so the stairs to the unit were all taped and wrapped in plastic. Not a huge deal but a heads up would have been cool.
May want to update their check in YouTube video as the instructions seemed different.
All in all a solid rental and recommend for others!

Loved staying here! The home was very clean and had so many games and activities that we truly appreciated. The kitchen was pretty stocked with all essentials and the host even left basic toiletries in each bathroom which was so kind.
My only feedback is the neighbors upstairs were extremely loud, you could hear literally everything and kept us up a couple of the nights.
But otherwise, would stay here again!
Great place to stay for the weekend!

Won't stay here again. The location was great, though. Felt very much like a hotel and not a typical Airbnb experience. I've never been to an Airbnb that didn't have a basic coffee maker...
Check-in was super slow. They wanted names, emails and phone numbers of everyone staying which seemed excessive.
Stained rugs in both bedrooms.
3 coffee cups and just a small espresso maker with 4 pods. Pool was not working.
No fan in bathroom or it didn't work, not sure which. Shower water pressure was poor.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was spotless, easily accommodated our whole family, had every amenity we needed, and was in a great location, very close to the Blue line. We’d definitely stay there again!
Great place and location, thank you Danielle!
Great place to stay. Well kept and very convenient

It was comforting and the room we stayed in was very spacious. There is 3 other rooms but you don’t have to worry much. Bathroom was clean and the kitchen was clean as well. We didn’t use the kitchen but it is good that other visitors are able to cook meals if they are wanting too. The neighborhood wasn’t too bad or anything. Everybody sorta just minds their own business. Easy walk to the train station which helps if you aren’t planing to drive into the city. If you plan on staying and like to sleep in a cold room, I suggest bringing a fan. There isn’t a tv which isn’t an issue but that’s another heads up to remember. Overall me and my friends had a good stay, Beds were real comfortable. We still had a good time being our first time ton Chicago.

Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed. We loved all the Chicago art and books. They gave the home so much character. Nice neighborhood, easy instructions, and Sarah was very accommodating. Would definitely recommend!
The place was 10/10 nearby places to try different foods and activities.
Very responsive and helpful. Nice place to stay at
Exactly as described. Nothing more, nothing less. No complaints.

Really well located. Clean space and all was as described. Some street noise in the front bedroom but there is a white noise machine and noise is expected in this area so it was no problem. Thanks for a great stay!
Wonderful home!
Overall, the place was decent. There were some hiccups like no paper towels, no trash bags, or enough eating ware to house the max of 6 people that the description said it could
Easy check in, clean, convenient location. Would recommend.

Very well-stocked and comfortable. A/C works very well to keep it cool even on 90+ degree days. Very quiet neighborhood. If you have heavy bags or mobility issues, keep in mind it is quite a climb up a few sets of steep stairs. The hose conveniently provided two sets of keys and allowed us to check in 1.5 hours early.

The place was in a great location and walkable to restaurants and the L station. Neighborhood was pretty quiet for being in the city only downside was the neighbors downstairs played loud music at night.

Great little basement apartment in a nice area of Chicago. Very clean. Walk to the bus stop and took 2 buses to get downtown but is very straightforward. On street parking - you just need to hunt around a bit for a space
Great and safe spot to stay in the southside of Chicago

This place was great it had plenty of room for the six of us and having 2 bathrooms was awesome.  It was a very safe neighborhood and walkable to lots of places including Wrigley Field.  I would highly recommend!

Great location and responsive host. :)

With three people (one couple and one single) it was good to be able to have a suite and the couch was comfortable for sleeping. The location is very good and a 7-11 and Starbucks were on the corner. The cooling kept resetting to 75, even when we set it lower and pushed the button to hold the temp. There should be some towel racks in the bathroom to hang towels. We had three people and had to hang towels in the closet.
The “gym” is an empty room with mirrors.
AirBnB kept referring to Kasa as a person, which was a bit amusing because it’s a company. It looks like this is a very popular place for people to stay.
Very beautiful place and a convenient space for us! Our hosts were very helpful when we had some internet problems! We really enjoyed our stay and hope to be able to visit Chicago again! :)
Emily’s place is perfect for a short stay with a friend! Lots of space, clean & comfy.

Don't book on Airbnb! Your room is picked by the hotel. They will put you in a room the size of a closet!! No matter if you did pay King Suite Rate! It's automatically chosen by the hotel! The rooftop bar isn't on the rooftop! It's kn the 4 floor marked conference rooms. 🤔🤔

The place was exactly as described, and it was in a great location. There were lots of restaurants and bar options that were located within walking distance. It was also very convenient to be able to jump on the highway and explore other parts of the city during our stay.

Iris was very responsive to our questions and was happy to answer them before our stay as well as during our stay.

Excellent option if you're looking to stay in the rodgers park area! You can tell the building itself is on the older side (as are many other houses in the area), but it has all the modern amenities you'd want for a comfortable stay, plenty of room, and kept very clean.
Jennifer and Ben were great hosts as well, both were very responsive and flexible in working with our schedule. Their communication was very appriciated during our stay. Would strongly reccomend!

The location was perfect for us, and coming back to such a comfortable place at the end of each day made the weekend even better. The host was wonderful, responsive, and made everything so easy from start to finish.
The place was great I will definitely book again!
My friend and I stayed here during the weekend for a nearby concert and it was great! Our host, Nate, was very friendly and accomodating, and the apartment itself was very comfortable.

The place was exactly like the photos. Appreciated the little details like filtered water in the fridge, a couple snacks and chargers that were 3 in 1 (Iphone, Air Pods and Apple Watch). The beds were comfy with quality sheets.  One thing to note - the 2nd bedroom's door is frosted glass/sliding barn door versus a closing door. We thought it was a cool feature but it does let in a lot of light (nothing an eye mask doesn't solve). The shower pressure was ok but that is not the fault of the host. Street parking was not an issue at all. The neighborhood felt quiet and safe. Discovered the Fat Peach Bakery which was AMAZING. We did not use the kitchen to cook so I can't comment on that. We will definitely be staying here again.
Perfect location and super spacious and unique space
Host was very kind, helpful, and respectful! The beds were so comfy and the space had such good and welcoming vibes!
Was a very nice place and very easy to communicate, definitely recommend the stay

Loved her place!  Clean, bright and inviting inside, and nicely landscaped outside.  Had everything I needed and was the perfect walking distance to my classes and some fun breweries and restaurants.  Would love to stay again.
It was good besides my friend getting locked in the bathroom and being stuck for like 5 minutes
Very responsive and great property. Fun stay and would recommend to others.

A great place to stay ! Very spacious and looks like the pictures. Host was very responsive and came back to the home to fix the hot water the same night we arrived because it was broken. Very accommodating space that can comfortably fit larger groups. He had cameras that faced the property that we could watch from outside so we always felt safe! The only down side to the air bnb is the location. It’s further north so it takes 30+ min to get into the city and the airport. Other than that I would definitely recommend again !!

A perfect place to stay for our visit to Chicago! We had three couples in town for a few days to enjoy the Chicago Jazz fest and this 16th floor apartment was so convenient to be able to walk to millennial Park, restaurants, bars, and shopping all nearby. And a nice common area to hang out and relax. We especially liked the speakeasy and karaoke bar down on the first floor! Would definitely stay here again!
A great place to stay. Close to the train station and with restaurants nearby. With most of the amenities you need for a few days in Chicago.
safe and reliable spot!
It was a great time  but the Neighbors upstairs arguing at about 3:am and were Dragging Funiture across the floor

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was in a quiet residential area, which made our stay very relaxing. Marco and Sarah were responsive, helpful, and welcoming throughout our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend it to others!

Great time staying at Josh’s place. Felt relaxing and he was very kind and offered to help with a lot. Would recommend to anyone who is trying to figure out an affordable, enjoyable option in this area of Chicago.
Amazing stay super close to everything in the loop. Perfect for visiting soldier field and all the sites in town!

Tim's place has a great homely feel - the living and kitchen area specifically are really nice and cosy, with games, comfy sofa and armchairs, good range of kitchen appliances with fantastic Aircon all round (which was vital during the early September Chicago heatwave).
As other reviews mention, there is the sound of the L very frequently but after the first day and nights sleep I got completely used to it. There's also only one bathroom to share between 3-5 guests which can sometimes be a bit problematic but wasn't a huge issue for my stay. There's a sign outside the bathroom you can use to book time if you need.
The neighbourhood is also 10/10 - feels very safe and tons to do.
The only thing that could be improved was the mattress in my room. It's clearly pretty old and sags quite significantly and uncomfortably in the middle and I ended up with quite a sore back because of it. With a new mattress this would absolutely be a 5 star stay for the price.

Such a cute Airbnb! The Pilsen location was a little different from where we usually stay, but Ubers were convenient and we felt very safe. Parking was also super easy. Everything we needed was there!

Brad’s place in Hyde Park was a great place to stay for my extended weekend trip. Brad himself was responsive, and the apartment was exactly as seen in the photos. Located in a very walkable area near the Lakeside Trail. Recommended stay 👍🏼

Lartasha was a great host, friendly, and told us about a great restaurant not far the Airbnb. Place was decorated beautifully, smelled amazing, and squeaky clean! We enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay again.
Great stay, easy check in and out. Cleaned and well kept, fits 7 people comfortably as listed.
We had a fantastic time in Chicago! The place was beautiful and Julian was extremely responsive and helpful!
Place was nice and host was very nice.
Cool place, nice vibes , ac had me sleep peacefully lol. Definitely will book again.

Suzanne’s home was perfect for a quick weekend trip. It smelled very clean as soon as we walked in and it was a quiet neighborhood. Check in instructions were very easy to understand. Overall it was a great place to stay in and I would definitely recommend and book again !

We had a great stay at Kyriako’s place! As first-time visitors to Chicago, the location worked really well for us. We got there from O’Hare by taking the Blue Line, transferring to the Red Line, and walking a short distance to the property. The train ride was a fun introduction to the city, and we enjoyed the neighborhood and all the large, mature trees, which we do not get much of back home in Arizona.
Check-in was easy, the instructions were clear, and the unit was very clean. The A/C worked great too.
The location was especially convenient because the Red Line and Target were both nearby. We used the train to head downtown for sightseeing, and Target was perfect for grabbing breakfast ingredients, drinks, and even a last-minute carry-on before heading home.
Kyriako’s communication was excellent, and we were even offered early check-in when the unit was ready ahead of schedule. Overall, great place, great location, and a great stay. We would gladly stay here again!
Our stay was beautiful and everything I had hoped for! I felt safe and comfortable in the space! Peter was a great host that was very helpful throughout my entire stay!
Definitely enjoyed our stay at The Nest! Amy was very friendly and helpful. Also the neighborhood is quiet and very safe. Definitely would book again!!
Excellent host excellent stay
Definitely Recommend💯 All The Spots are close by, walking/biking Distance. Will Definitely Be Coming Back Here again. ❤️
Great location. Close to good brunch spots and Chinatown.
Great Central location easy checkout
Marissa was very responsive even late at night. We had forgotten our keys, but luckily she had an extra pair.

I loved this Airbnb really well designed, every piece of furniture had a practical use. Check-in was simple and easy, and the instructions were very clear and transparent. When asked about parking, Gogo was instantly responsive and provided a parking permit to make it a more comfortable stay. Overall, a beautiful place and an amazing host.
I had a great stay and the family was pleasant and an awesome vibe!!! I would definitely book again
Cozy space in a great neighborhood. We loved our stay!
Great last minute stay
Spacious and clean place with an excellent host. Vladimir is the man.
Great stay!
The host had fantastic communication and the unit was exactly as expected. Location was great to attend an event at soldier field. I would definitely stay here again.
Great apartment, wonderful for smaller to medium groups, and very responsive host. Close enough to everything we could walk. Very clean and well kept space. Would definitely stay again.
This is the second time we’ve stayed in this building. Walkable to just about anything. Nice private balcony. Easy check In/check out. There is a parking garage that is right next to this building.

Our group loved this spot. Super spacious, clean, and unique. The rooftop was very cool and a nice place to unwind after a long day. The design flourishes make it feel intentional and cared for. The couches in the living room are so comfortable. Would definitely visit again!
Great stay! Highly recommend for a comfortable stay in Chicago !
Was in town for my son’s engagement party and this was the perfect place to stay! Plenty of room to spread out and very conveniently located will definitely stay again!

Kristy and Kim were awesome and so was their place, we drove from Delaware for the first time to Chicago and they made us feel at home. Gave local recommendations for things to do/eat. Dogs were very friendly and didn’t notice them much while we were there. Would definitely use location again if we were to return to Chicago!
Great and safe neighborhood right near the L and with plenty to eat and do

Relaxing, quiet and beautiful place to stay. Everything you need. Just take note you will need a rental or be fine with ubering to get to major attractions.
I would 100% consider staying here if I ever end up visiting Chicago again.

Tory was an excellent host, my girlfriend and I had a great time. She had great recommendations and responded very fast. The house was clean and comfortable, we felt right at home. When we are back in the Chicago area we will definitely come to here again.

Fantastic space in a great walkable Chicago neighborhood. Host was very accommodating and easy to communicate with. Would recommend this for any group looking for a large classic well done remodel and awesome location.
El lugar estaba como se describió, todo limpio y arreglado.

Taher’s apartment is mostly very quiet and comfortable - listing doesn’t mention that the red line is directly outside your window, but for anyone who is used to city noise it’s no big deal.
Neighborhood feels calm and safe, and the apartment itself was clean and had all the essentials. Taher is a VERY communicative host, and was definitely available if I had had any questions.
Overall, a good minimalist spot in the north end of the city.
Enjoyed my 2 night stay. Room was cozy and clean. Would definitely stay here again!

This spot is ADORABLE! The space is fun, clean, and in a great location for restaurants, coffee shops, and anything else you might need. It's across from one of my favorite Chicago coffee shops, Wormhole. Milwaukee Ave can be pretty noisy on weekends, but the way this apartment is situated within the building is perfect because it blocks out any noise from the street. I would highly highly recommend it! Hosts were great too!

Me and my partner had a good stay at Kim's place. The area felt safe and was close to public transportation. The place itself was nice, with air-conditioning units that kept the living area and bedroom cool. Kim was very responsive and helpful.
I will note there appears to be a Minut noise decibel and occupancy detecting device plugged in behind the couch that monitors the sound levels and the mobile devices with the unit. Technically its within the Airbnb policies since it's not supposed to log this information, but I'd prefer if Kim was upfront and let guests know about it in the listing description rather than burying in it the amenities section. Also, the photos of the listing do not match the unit and seem AI generated. They're very close, something like 80% accurate, but some things are different like the shower (which shows a non-existent cubby for the shower gel), the couch, and don't exactly match.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay, but we just want other travelers to be aware

Justin was incredibly helpful for my family and I. He was very communicative and was flexible with our times. He was very kind in accomodating an early check in, due to our very early arrival in Chicago. Thank you so much for your Hospitality!
It was very good place to stay!!!
Beautiful house and very walkable distance to the subway!

I stayed at Iris place for a mini getaway with a friend. The place was conveniently located, quiet and clean. The hallways of the building smells like smoke but the unit itself smelled fresh. The bed was a little firm for my liking but I appreciated the clean linen. Overall, I would recommend staying here!! FYI, the Obama family home is only a few blocks away, which I thought was super cool.
Very responsive host. Close to everything you need. Perfect place for our stay.  Priced right for the area.
Very nice place with a lot of space in a convenient location. Host was very helpful and responded immediately when we had a question.
Great and comfortable stay! No complaints at all.

This was genuinely one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had! The home is located in a beautiful neighborhood where I felt completely comfortable walking around, even by myself in the evening. When I arrived, there were freshly baked cookies and a thoughtful welcome note wishing my friends and me a wonderful birthday weekend—it was such a sweet, personal touch.
The home itself was absolutely beautiful, with so much historic charm and gorgeous antique-style details, while still having a completely updated kitchen and bathroom. Everything was exceptionally clean, the towels were soft, the bedding was comfortable, and the entire space felt warm and inviting.
The hosts were incredibly kind, responsive, and accommodating throughout my stay. I truly loved everything about this home and would stay here again! I cannot recommend it enough.

We had such a great stay at Jennifer’s place! The location was perfect with lots of shops and restaurants nearby. Jennifer was extremely communicative and friendly. The apartment was super comfortable and cozy - perfect for a weekend in Chicago!

The photos are accurate, but are not reflective of how peaceful the property is; my first night, I parked on the crowded street...however, the second night I parked next to the structure itself inside the gate/alley access [which made me feel extra safe]. The street was lined with many many houses [with some mild traffic], but the property itself is set back beyond the front gate [and backs directly to a quiet alley]. The space also would have slept a family, as a daybed with trundle was in the living space on the first floor, and two bedrooms with larger beds on the second floor (and the second bedroom had a trundle as well). Each room has their own Roku TV, full eat-in kitchen, and laundry. Livingroom had option to watch blu ray/dvd's available on-site. It is truly a 2br 1.5 bath home with private parking capability. Loved my stay!
Everything was great! The host was so nice and very accommodating. The place looked great too. Thank you for hosting.

Amy’s place is even better than the pictures! It felt so homey and we absolutely loved how everything there was environmentally friendly. Amy is so kind and one of the best Airbnb hosts I’ve ever had. I would highly recommend staying here!
Great place to stay — plenty of space for 7 people, and the neighborhood is nice and quiet
Staff was super friendly. Hotel is in a great area, walking distance to restaurants, bars and stores!
Very nice place, with a perfect location for the university. Being only 10min always from the lake was a super nice bonus.
Perfect location, beautiful building - apartment, gym, rooftop pool, highly responsive host, and sparkling clean - thank you for making my 1st time in Chicago so perfect!

Honestly a really good deal, we got to stay in pilsen during their parade weekend, visited the mexican museum, and had brunch all within walking distance and it was close to the pink line! home does use physical keys so it was a bit harder to manage with our group going separate ways and we did need a locksmith when we forgot the keys inside and sean was very helpful!
Alfonso's place was welcoming, and worked well for a group of four staying for a trip. Having off street parking was nice as well!
We had a fabulous time! The space is clean and well stocked. The location can’t be beat. We would absolutely stay here again
This place was so clean and very close to the red and green lines. Which made it very easy to get around Chicago. There are plenty of restaurants around as well
We loved staying here! Laura was a very accommodating host. I would absolutely stay here again!
Great spot for a great price!

This was a wonderful place to stay. It was really nice they left a parking permit for us! With that permit there is a lot of parking nearby. The beds were comfortable and we had everything we needed. Lots to do in the neighborhood! Highly recommend.

Fabulous stay, close to restaurants and shopping. Having a garage space was perfect way to end a day out and not scramble for parking. Super secure and safe, we enjoyed our stay and hope to return in the not too distant future.
Great spot

It was a very comfortable stay! Bed was quite comfortable and there was easy access to a bus nearby to get to downtown. Very clean there. The shared bathroom was kept quite clean.
There were also fast food restaurants nearby so you can grab a quick bite nearby.
I didn't use it but very convenient there's a washer & dryer you can use there as well.
Great location and easy access to the building. Instructions for building access were clear and the neighborhood was quiet.

We had a really nice stay overall! The location was fantastic & so convenient to everything- great restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, and more were all close by. The space itself was beautifully decorated and looked like the photos.
The hosts were wonderful & very communicative throughout our stay. They were always quick to respond and checked in to make sure we had everything we needed, which we really appreciated.
The only thing worth mentioning is that some of the furniture was showing a little wear, including a stain on the couch and some water marks on the chairs. The beds also felt a bit smaller than expected, more like full-size than queens. We did hear some noise from the nearby bars on Sat night, but otherwise the apartment was nice and quiet. For the price, we expected the furnishings to be in a little better condition, but the location and hosts were highlights, and it made our time in Chicago memorable. Overall it was a great experience & we really enjoyed our stay!
Good location, train/bus stop very close and good communication with the hosts👍
Nice place with location near Soldier Field!  Great communication with no issues.  Thanks!!
Clean and quiet place, 5 mins from the train station and 20ish mins from downtown by train
Very nice stay, great location. Kim was very responsive with any questions.
Leonid was very responsive and communicative. Area was a bit rougher, but location was conveniently near a blue line stop.
Karen was so accommodating & very responsive, very catering as well, the house was beautiful and clean. Will try to book again on my next visit! Thank you Karen!

This is a little jewel in a beautiful neighborhood. The apartment is perfectly appointed, impeccably clean and very comfortable. Great coffee and pastries and fun shops a short walk away. We found parking right in front of the apt each night we stayed. The Blue Line is not far away, so access to downtown Chicago takes just minutes, or an easy shot in the opposite direction to O’Hare.  Tomasz and Ewa were perfectly responsive. Looking forward to staying there in the future when possible.
Get location, beautiful views a lot to do in walking distance
Amazing stay! The home was beautiful, just as described. Location not the best, people walking around, not so safe. Other than that, great place.
Nice, basic place to sleep and shower. Great location to explore Bucktown, Wicker Park, and the city.
As described. Surprisingly really calm area. Would def book again

This listing was great, I loved the location and how everything was walking distance. For us we had trouble with getting inside, you get two key fobs to unlock the doors but only have so long to get inside 2 doors before they lock again, with a stroller and bags I personally did struggle a bit. As we walked into the air bnb the building was having electrical issues, so the hallway lights when you first walk into the loft did not work. Other random things I feel are important to me personally were; the beds were stiff, shower water pressure wasn’t great and the couch was stiff and small. Now for parking it was good, it was a bit of a walk but not long maybe like 3 minutes. It was easy to get in and out, although we brought 2 vehicles we were told only one could park there but once we arrived you could pay there with a barcode for extra cars and very safe and private. Overall a good visit and home. I would totally come back again I would just hope for no electrical problems.
Great convenient stay

Nancy's place was the perfect base of operations for our friend group during a Wrigleyville wedding weekend.  We loved the location, the space, and especially Nancy's hospitality and responsiveness.  She accommodated both an early check in and late check out for our group, both of which were helpful for us. We were steps away from Wrigley, but far enough that I don't think it would have been a nuisance either.  We'd definitely consider another stay in the future!
Great apartment. We had a wonderful stay’
Lovely spot with a bunch of antiques.

Responsive and accommodating.
While the neighbors can be a little rowdy with nonestop music and partying, we enjoyed the space for the work that we had in Chicago.

2/1 condo was as advertised. Great walking distance to Target - you will likely want to opt for an uber for some parts of town (but it'll be a quick uber). Comfortable beds and clean. Washer and dryer is definitely a plus. The space was generally quiet, but by nature of the building, you will likely hear people above you. We would rebook - Meera is an attentive and helpful post & the check in/out instructions give you everything you need.
Great stay
Nice area, and felt it was a good value.

I had a wonderful stay! The room and bathroom were exceptionally clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Everything was just as described, and communication with Tammy and Nabil was easy and helpful. I would definitely recommend staying here!

Lake was extremely communicative and responsive to our needs. There is ample parking and  it's walking distance to the "L" and corner stores, etc. for your essential needs. It was a short ride to the Obama Center and nearby Hyde Park with tons of eating and shopping options.

Loved the location, very accessible and walkable to Andersonville and public transportation. The place was nice, I liked the ac units able to make it comfortable to the temperature you want. We didn’t need the kitchen but it had everything you’d need and a nice living room and rooms.
It’s definitely an interesting location with some interesting characters outside. I never felt at danger and had some nice conversations with some people outside.
Absolutely wonderful place. Glenda is also very warm and helpful. The house is cozy and sufficiently big. Our stay was very comfortable.
Great host and place to stay. Walkable distance to Chinatown. Highly recommend!

This was a gorgeous, central stay in a lovely, safe and quiet neighborhood. About 12-15 minutes from river north and a 20 min walk to Milwaukee Ave. The inside was clean and accessible and easy to get into. I would highly recommend staying at this gem of a property! We spent the weekend celebrating a bachelorette and this accommodation fit all 11 of us and could have fit probably 3 more!
Also read the reviews! They were super helpful because extra trash bags are under the trash bags that’s already in the trash can.
Exactly as expected.
Great stay

The only problem is that it was an abnormally hot week for Chicago and the fan couldn't keep up. Orher than that the location is good, 3-4 minute walk from Chinatown, good restraunts nearby. In walkable distance - 40 minutes from Soldier Field and Field Museum; 50 minutes from Downtown. The stay was overall good. There were towels and hangers, coffee and kitchen appliances. Good communication and very friendly service.

The hosts are incredibely responsive and helpful which is great! The place was very neat, spacious, and comfortable! It is located in a very good central spot which makes walking to local attractions very easy, just pick a any direction and you're headed to a noteworthy Chicago spot. The views from place are also amazing! The whole unit is practically windows, which makes for phenomenal views all around. While that does also make it harder to regulate temperature, the hosts have provided multiple individual standing units to assist! Everything was very easy and all our questions were always answered. I would recommend this place and stay here again!
Great
Great location, Connie was super friendly and easy going. This place was everything we needed it to be.

The Airbnb was just as described and was very accommodating to where I wanted to be in the city. It was very clean, quiet, and comfortable. I definitely recommend staying here! There are also a lot of bars in the area, which was pretty cool and made it easy to enjoy the nightlife. I had a great stay and would definitely come back again!
Jeff is great at communicating, provided clear instructions and replied quickly. Had a wonderful stay and would recommend.

We have stayed with Molly several times now and have always found her place to be super clean and comfortable. Her location is convenient for what we need a room in Chicago for. The only drawback this time was the television. The only channels that were available were Netflix and PBS. We tried to watch Netflix, but there was constant buffering, so overall it was unwatchable. For us, it was just a minor nuisance as we were usually out of the room and it certainly would not be an obstacle for us to book again
Great weekend stay with friends! Great location! We enjoyed our stay!
Great accommodation for what me and my group were looking for.
Really great place in the heart of downtown Chicago!

Place is supper newly renovated. All furniture and appliances are new. Host is super responsive. Nice coffee set up. I recommend uber in and out. Second bedroom has  low ceiling, watch your head. This is a basement unit, don’t expect many windows also no living room. But it was comfortable and no smells. Neighbour is safe to walk as well.
Comfortable apartment, no complaints. I really appreciated the option for luggage storage and the host offered early check-in without me asking

Great stay! Our room was clean and it was super easy to get in and out of the area. The host was very friendly and the instructions given were extremely helpful. The other guests staying were respectful too and we didn't run into any issues. I would definitely stay here again!

As a solo traveler, this home felt super safe and the neighborhood was peaceful and quiet. The drive to downtown was 20-30 mins which was not a problem at all! Very friendly and just what I needed. Awesome shower and towels smelled amazing! Would love to stay again!

The studio apartment matched the description and was ideal for my weekend trip. It’s a block from Lincoln Park and right next to shops, cafés, and restaurants, making the location very convenient. I recommend comunicating arrival time before check-in so that one of the host’s staff members can provide the key upon arrival. I’d happily stay here again.
A great place to stay with parking included.
This place was great! Easy access to transportation and everything was in walking distance. The host was super friendly and responsive. 10/10 I would recommend staying here.

Fantastic location! We were in town to visit the Obama Center (15-min walk) & the Griffin Museum (5-min walk), to eat good food (Dawn restaurant on the 1st floor of the building, and 14 Parish — Caribbean food a 10-min walk away), and to enjoy the parks and the lake (Promontory Park was just a 5-10 min walk). This place could not be more convenient to all that Hyde Park has to offer!! The unit, in a beautiful historic building, is great. It was everything we needed for our stay. Kitchen is adorable, window shades are nice and dark at night, TV swivels so you can watch in the bed or on the couch, AC is cold. (Just a quick note about the bed — the host was responsive when I messaged them about this, so I’m hopeful it will get fixed — the mattress had an issue on the left side that made it uncomfortable to sleep on, but we managed. Hopefully it gets addressed soon!) We found easy parking just around the corner and didn’t have any issues leaving the car there. Hope to stay again!!
The stay was great. I recommend this location, as it is central to everything.  The host was very responsive to any needs we had.
This was a great, clean Airbnb!

Review:
This was a really great place— fully equipped. It was the perfect spot to truly relax for two days. David was very responsive with all my questions which I appreciated very much.
Lovely place to stay. Thank you David!
Great stay in a nice neighborhood with lots to do even with little children. Very comfortable stay. We would definitely stay again!
Wonderful place on the near north side. We enjiyed our stay.

This place is perfect. The location was convenient to the L, shopping, dining, coffee, and more. The kitchen was the most well-stocked of any Airbnb I've ever stayed in. The beds were incredibly comfortable. The outdoor space was our favorite among many great things. I can't recommend this one highly enough, and I'd love to stay here again soon.
Dave was an outstanding host and our experience there was great. Thanks again Dave!
Debra was a great host! Would definitely stay here again!

The pilot and crew retreat was exactly what we were looking for in Chicago. My Family and I needed a home away from home for a  month, close to Loyola University Medical Center, while my wife recovered from Surgery. The host, Agata provided exactly that. Very clean, organized and comfortable home, in a quiet neighborhood. A perfect place for her to recover and rest. Agata was great at communicating and making sure our stay was exactly what we needed. Thank you! We would definitely stay again.

The place is good for the cheap price but the bed was extremely uncomfortable and bedroom has little pieces of food from the previous guest on the floor. Decently close to downtown. Conveniently very close to a Family Dollar. Not too bad of a place for the price.
Carla was a great host!! Very kind, communicative, and personable. The home was quiet, lots of amenities, right next to the Pink line, and the chickens were the best part!
Great location and clean. But this is a basement apartment and like many basement apartments it can be musty and very humid.

Airbnb Host was responsive and helpful throughout the trip. Beautiful home and peaceful. You aren’t in downtown so late night walking in the area can be sketchy but other than that it was a great time and would book here again.
Great host and place to stay. I will be back

We had a great stay at Jorge’s place in Chicago! The location was very convenient, with local supermarkets, coffee shops, and gyms nearby. The neighborhood itself was really cute and felt like a great area to stay in.
The home was comfortable and a good size for two people. Everything went smoothly, and Jorge was responsive whenever we needed to reach him. The only suggestion I would make would be to provide a few more towels for guests. Other than that, everything was good and we enjoyed our stay. I would definitely recommend Jorge’s place to anyone visiting Chicago!
This place was easy to find, easy to access, and clean. Patt was very friendly, always responsive, and very helpful. I would definitely stay again!
Beautiful home in great location. My friends and I (3 men, mid 30s) had plenty of space. Home is filled with gorgeous art and has a pre-war charm. Recommend for any groups.
Great stay! Will come back.

This was a great place and we were glad to find that the description matched what we got. The bedroom was decently spacious and the furniture was good.
The only issue we ran into was parking; the "included" parking is a sticker to street park that needs to be updated every 24 hours. The available stickers were out of date but we did not get ticketed.
Other than the parking, the place was great!
She was amazing and super helpful when needed, I definitely recommend staying here☺️
Cutest little place walking distance to DePaul and restaurants.
Awesome place!

We booked this stay for my sisters bachelorette weekend and had a great time. The parking was a super helpful feature and made it easy for us to carpool together. The location is on a busy street so you can hear sirens passing but that’s just about it. There was an EDM concert a block away that we couldn’t hear through the door.
