The hosts are great, so helpful and very responsive. I hope to go back to this beautiful home again

We made a short trip out to Chicago. We were looking for something affordable, safe and in a central area. The place was exactly what we needed. It was close to everything and seemed to be super safe at night. The staff was super friendly and even gave us recommendations for places to eat near by. Would stay there again!

Very nice apartment in a great location. The building is very nice and the terrace, common areas etc are well maintained and an additional plus. The apartment itself had everything we needed. Host was very responsive and quick to respond to emails before and during our stay. We had some trouble with the air-conditioning and it was promptly resolved. We really enjoyed our stay.
Very good communication and super clean inside

落ち着いた雰囲気の住宅街の中にあり、快適に過ごせた。オレンジラインの駅からは少し離れているが、62番のバスでダウンタウンやレッドラインのチャイナタウン駅に出れるので問題ない。
入口のドアの空け方が慣れるまで戸惑った。
また泊まりたい！
Great place for easy downtown access, honestly more spacious than the photos show! Would definitely stay again. Host's are very helpful and communicative.
Great stay, the host was super nice and communicative, the place was nice and clean and in a nice neighborhood

We had a great stay! The place was very clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully set up. The hosts provided lots of snacks and drinks, which was such a nice touch—and my kids absolutely loved it!
The owners were also incredibly responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. Everything was well taken care of, and we really appreciated all the little details that made the stay more comfortable.
I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a clean, welcoming, and well-equipped place to stay. We would happily stay here again!
Great place to book if your on a budget the place was really nice and clean
Very good
Great stay!

Tere’s place was great on the Gold Coast of Chicago. Very easy to get to as it’s a 5 minute walk from the Clark/Division stop on the red line. Would definitely recommend for others to book when coming to visit Chicago.
Enjoyed our stay! Wonderful hosts!

We had a wonderful stay at Nini’s place! The home was very clean, modern, comfortable, and had everything we needed for our family. Nini did a great job communicating throughout our stay and made everything incredibly easy.
The location was fantastic — we were able to walk to the beach and Lincoln Park Zoo, and there was so much to do nearby. It was the perfect stay for our family, and we would absolutely recommend Nini’s place to anyone visiting Chicago!
The best !
Great place to stay, close to the brown line.  Nice shops around, and surprisingly quiet inside the airbnb
Overall great
Nala and Owen were wonderful hosts! I felt safe in the area and it was close to downtown.
Location was wonderful. Space was very clean and host was incredibly communicative throughout the entire stay. Would definitely recommend to anyone interested in staying in Chicago.
Above average hotel with very nice staff and things to do inside the hotel itself.

Great base if you’re flying in or out of O’Hare — the airport is minutes away and getting downtown was easy. Victor was easy to communicate with, check-in was smooth, and the room was clean and quiet. The shared bathroom was never a problem. Good value for the price. Would stay again.

Ed & Hillary have a nice set up including a very nicely curated garden. We were able to relax and enjoy our stay. The hosts are attentive and communicative. The space is large and clean. We wouldn’t hesitate to return.
Thank you for letting us stay at your home, it was close to the concert we were seeing, and other areas we wanted to visit. Had a great stay!

Overall a fine stay. I was turned off by the completely unexplained fee that was sent to me prior to check in that I had to ask what it was even for. Only other downside is the train noise, fine to sleep through since it's like white noise but not so fun when trying to watch a movie.

This was me and my friend’s first time in Chicago and Jevaux helped make this a seamless experience. The unit was beautiful in a great area with lots of culture. Jevaux was very helpful in the check in and check out process and gave clear instructions.
Great view and location. Host was great. Easy to check in. Group of 5 of us, we all fit well (4 shared the 2 beds one got the couch bed) would stay here again in a heart beat.

Khong was very friendly, responsive and helpful. The place was clean, cute and secure. There was a garage in the back alley for our small rental car. We were in Chicago to visit colleges, so we wanted to stay in close proximity to the campus. The neighborhood is a little rough, but we felt safe and it was nothing that concerned us to any extent. It was a great value, and we'll definitely stay there again.
Great location, fabulous neighborhood. This worked very well for us (2 grown ups and a teen) and we will be back in the future! Excellent place.

John's place was again great. This was my second time staying here and it was just fabulous. Well located, affordable, and a great spot. John always answered questions quickly and thoroughly and allowed us some flexibility to check in early. The street is quiet and the people friendly. It was a GREAT place and would stay again!  Many Blessings
This was a great stay!! I highly recommend!!
Really enjoyed it!! Would definitely recommend staying here!!
Place was great, and Nancy was a wonderful host. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay here! The apartment was clean, spacious, and the views from the 29th floor were amazing, especially from the balcony. The location was perfect and made it really easy to get around downtown Chicago. Everything was comfortable and exactly what we needed for our trip. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again!
Perfect for solo travel. The hosts were lovely and kind!
Good simple place, good neighborhood and responsive host

We had a wonderful stay, apartment was clean, comfortable, matched the photo and description. Equipped with everything we needed for are 2 days trip. Check in was smooth with clear instructions. Would book again in future.
Great place
We had a nice stay here. The place was clean, comfortable, and private. The location is convenient and walkable to the blue line and everything in Logan Square and Avondale. We would stay here again.
Lovely and comfortable stay as a solo traveler. Clean rooms, communicative host and cozy space. Cold Ac and kitchen beverages were much appreciated :)
Great all around
Great service
Plenty of room for our family to spend time and reconnect. Great air conditioning!

It's a fine place to stay if you have a full itinerary. It's a very accessible area, you can get to a bus stop, a grocery store, and a drug store in a few minutes walk. Very safe area for solo travelers.
My only gripe was the bathroom, which could definitely use some work and wasn't clean due to other tenants using it. However, Victor was incredibly hospitable and responsive. Any questions or issues I had, he immediately fixed to the best of his ability.

My friends and I attended a concert, and we had an incredible time! Terry’s recommendation of what to do was instrumental in making the experience even better. We’ll definitely be returning in the future.
Great convenient location. Jennifer and her partner were very kind. Highly recommend.

Beautiful stay! The place was amazing. I stayed for two weeks and had a blast. It’s conveniently located near the Blue Line and several bus stops, making it easy to get around the city. There are tons of great local restaurants, a beautiful neighborhood to explore, and even a nearby Jewel-Osco for quick grocery runs. As someone visiting from Texas, this was a wonderful introduction to Chicago. I would highly recommend staying here, and I’ll definitely be back!

The stay was not as we expected. There was only one window ac in the kitchen, nothing in the bedrooms except for a fan which was a little inconvenient since our stay was during very humid and hot temperatures. Tried to communicate with the host and got no response at all for the entire duration of our stay. Also quite a few centipedes were found in the house.
The location was in a great place, safe and not far from downtown, surrounded by lots of restaurants.
Thank you Amber for having us at you home it was a pleasure.
Dans place was nice but finding a parking spot was always difficult.

Very beautiful home, host was lovely, and in a great location! Only complaint was the thermostat. We would put it on a lower temperature and then wake up to it being 72-75 degrees early in the morning. I don’t know if the host was changing it on the thermostat app or if it is a thermostat issue, but considering it was 90 degrees including humidity, it was very inconvenient. Other than that everything was well kept and a beautiful home!

The perfect spot for a multi-day stay. Super convenient location for exploring south side or north side; easy access to bus, L red line and Metra. Highlights included the pool after a hot day exploring, watching the sun come up over Lake Michigan, lightning strikes on cloudy evenings and just watching the bustle of the city.
Terrific location, safe and secure and great lobby.
Amazing stay with responsive helpful hosts

I enjoy staying 5 week at Steve Airbnb I will definetly be back and highly recommed anyone who want to do a long stay to stay at Steve Airbnb really close to Belmont red line and boystown area I felt safe walking the area at 2pm and at 3am supper nice and safe area. I will be back next year for sure.
Was good, easy to find, good location with free parking right in front of it, didn’t really see other guests so there was no conflict with noise or bathroom and overall a good stay
We appreciated our stay. We enjoyed the Airbnb, and found the neighborhood to be very walkable. It was also close to the red line train, which was of great use to us.

We loved the house! It was super clean, cozy, and had everything we needed. The location was great, and check-in was really easy. The host was kind, helpful, and fast to reply. We would definitely stay here again!
Great location to explore north Chicago

My first time ever booking an air bnb and this one did not disappoint! The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful as well as beautiful. My friends and I enjoyed this place and would definitely come back to book it again!

Alma’s place looks and feels exactly the same way it does in the pictures. Very clean, simple, and relaxing. The location is near the river walk and also ~ 25 min walk from downtown. This is a great place if you want to be in a calm area and also get the opportunity to explore the city. Alma is also very responsive and available to address any needs or concerns. Will definitely stay here on my next trip to Chicago!

Unfortunately, I would not recommend this Airbnb. During our three-day stay, the power went out twice while using the microwave, shutting off the lights and AC as well during a 90 degree weekend. We were never informed beforehand that this was an issue. The host sent a YouTube video instructing me to go into the unfinished basement and flip the breaker myself. I did not feel comfortable doing this, so we had to wait for staff. One incident happened at night, leaving us without power until the following morning. This was especially inconvenient while traveling with my six-year-old daughter, as I couldn’t even warm up food for her. Had we been informed beforehand about the issue and advised not to use the microwave while the AC was running, the situation could have at least been avoided. Guests also should not be expected to go into an unfinished basement to reset a breaker in order to have functioning electricity. Unfortunately, this significantly impacted our stay.

In a beautiful part of town, close by to the red line and a half hour from downtown. For a really good price, this place is definitely one of the best deals on airbnb for Chicago. Would definitely stay again
This space was perfect. My boyfriend and I came for the week and we couldn’t be happier. The space was super clean, stocked kitchen, and we loved the balcony. Location was great & parking was easy!

The place was beautiful. Open kitchen and living area were great after a day in the city to unwind and hang with friends. So many bedrooms and the 3 full bathrooms were great. Check in was easy, front desk staff was awesome. Got to the air b&b early with bags and they let us store them for a few hours before check in so we could go roam the city. If I come back to Chicago id stay again.
Super nice place embedded into the historical neighborhoods of Chicago city. Very nice and neat, comfortable beds and furniture and great a/c. Thanks so much!
Great stay ! Would recommend again !

I had a wonderful time at Emily & Roya’s place. The neighborhood is beautiful and quiet 🤫 with great restaurants in the area. Whoever stays there make sure you visit Urban Vegan on N Ashland and get the vegan smoothie. Overall my wife and I had a wonderful time in Chicago for Labor Day weekend. Thank you 🙏 Emily and Roya, I’ll most certainly be back .
Todo bien

Comfortable and clean place to stay away from the hustle and bustle of the inner city. Steps away from a couple great spots to eat/drink. The AC was a lifesaver here while we visited Chicago during a heatwave!

Meget fin oplevelse. Dog forholdsvis langt væk fra byen, og man skal derfor forventer at bruge 45 minutter til 1 time for at komme ind til selve byen eller bruge 30-50 dollars på uber.
Parkering var okay, men føles en smule utrygt på gaden.

Super bien todo, muy atentos y metro a 10 minutos andando, buen sitio para visitar chicago. La linea azul es una pasada, no hemos usado otra, va del aeropuerto a la ciudad y pasa por la casa. Todo perfecto.
Great stay! The entire house was incredibly clean and well maintained, including all of the shared spaces. Everything felt fresh, comfortable, and welcoming. I would definitely stay here again!
Good place for the price.  Close to U. Chicago.
Very good price, flexible, responsive and overall worth the money. Would stay here again 100%.

Possibly the best Airbnb I’ve stayed in. Very clean. Super chill and comfortable. Lots of space. Amazing shower. Close to the lake, with its parks and beach. Great area with lots of things to do. Had a great time there.
Host is responsive and place was clean but that’s about it.

Great host. Very accommodating. Property is close to the bus stop. Quiet neighborhood.  Plenty of room so we weren’t on top of each other during our stay.  The next time we plan to visit Chicago, The DuSable International House, will be our first choice for accommodations!

I would say this place is fine for a short term stay but would perhaps caution for longer term stays. You don’t know who your neighbors are going to be and their sleep schedules and that can be disruptive. Also the owners sometimes had dinner parties at the house, which would go on into the night and be disruptive. I remember a particularly disruptive time was when I had an exam the next day and the dinner party did not end till midnight.

Barbara's place was lovely.  Loved the neighborhood, the coziness, the cleanliness. Close to many restaurants, including only a 15 minute walk to Kasama. Only bummer is, if you're a light sleeper like me, the tenants making noise above might wake you--they weren't super loud, it's just the fact of being in the basement. If you're 6ft  you'll have to duck under parts of the ceiling. Wasn't a problem for me but my 5 ft'10" was super close.
Super beautiful and convenient location, the home was amazing

This is an absolutely fabulous apartment. It’s our second stay and we really love it. The location is marvellous, its a lovely 20 minute walk to town by parks and landmarks. The building where the apartment is, is excellent with plenty of really nice restaurants around. We couldn’t rave anymore about this apartment as it’s absolutely superb and we hope come back in future years. Stephanie is also and excellent host, we would recommend this apartment to anybody
Very quick responses, and easy to work with in general. Place was very well kept and had good amenities.
This is probably our 3rd or 4th stay here.  Location is perfect and the rental is very nicely appointed and comfortable.  Hosts are responsive.

Overall, me and my friends really enjoyed the Airbnb! The only downside was the location. It was a little scary but nothing ever happened and we were safe! It also helped that they had a disclaimer detailing the location! It was a good place to book!
Wow! Amazing place and especially location. Loved it way better than expected!!!! Thank you so much. Also very kind host left snacks for us! Amazing thank you so much!!
Didn’t realize how close everything was to the location. It was also very quiet, even with lack of parking there was an easy answer to everything and the host was extremely responsive and helpful!

Place was very clean and peaceful. Other guests followed directions well and it felt like no one else was there. Bathroom is beautiful, bed is comfortable, mini fridge and microwave were very useful additions.

Anthony and team are great hosts; due to an error out of our control, we ended up with the wrong unit and Anthony made sure to rectify the situation. Communication is at a level you expect from a host that cares! Even with the issue, the unit we ended up in was spotless, luxurious, and the views were amazing.
Overly recommend anyone to consider booking with Anthony when traveling to Chicago!

Excellent in every way. Perfect for my husband and two adult kiddos (one slept in the large couch). More together time than two hotel rooms. Close to everything going on Labor Day weekend in Chicago. Thank you for hosting us!
Host was a great communicator and accommodated our group very well!

Great location, was able to walk to Soilder Field and to the Bean. Lots of great restaurants near by, and even some gyms and grocery stores.
Communication was responsive and friendly, much appreciated.
Great stay and very responsive host.

We had such a great stay at Matthew’s Just Like Honey listing! It was exactly what we needed for our trip. The home is located near Logan Square in such a cute, quiet, and peaceful neighborhood, which we really appreciated after spending busy days exploring the city.
The location was also super convenient. close to public transportation and just a short walk from local shops and spots in the neighborhood. Matthew’s place had everything we needed to feel comfortable during our stay, and he was very communicative and helpful throughout the entire process.
I would absolutely stay here again! I highly recommend Just Like Honey and Matthew as a fantastic host.

dawn is an incredible host! my friends and i stayed in chicago for a concert recently, and we decided on her place because it was a good price and looked very clean. as soon as i requested the booking, dawn instantly messaged me and asked a couple of questions. she then approved the booking and sent a very long and detailed list about parking and how to enter the residence, etc… we found this extremely helpful and we were able to navigate solely based off of her instructions which was a huge help! the place is very secure and extremely beautiful!! the bathrooms were stocked with everything you could ever need and the freezer and fridge had food for us to eat! dawn genuinely went above and beyond for us and she is an incredible host!! 10/10 would recommend!!
excellent location, clean and safe

This place was not worth the high price. We’re killing bugs the whole time we were there, and the place is not clean at all. There were stains on furniture/bedding, floor and carpets need a deep clean, shower curtain was so dirty it made the bathroom smell stale and musty. We found hair everywhere on everything. The couch was broken and again covered in stains. The stove and coffee kettle do not work. And we got locked out late at night and got VERY lucky the upstairs person had someone to let us in. When addressed to host, they did absolutely nothing and ignored us. It is unfortunate cus the place could be so nice and the location isn’t bad at all. The host was very responsive at first until situation about the place was addressed.
The only time we would stay here again is if they literally DEEP cleaned the place and updated everything to work and look presentable as a place this expensive should be.

We loved our stay! The space inside was so cozy with games & books available too, and the neighborhood was so lovely to walk around in, pop in to the market & restaurants, and enjoy the nearby parks. Paula and Adrian were so responsive and helpful when we had a snag getting in, with smooth and prompt communication thru the trip. Would def stay here again on our next Chicago visit :)
Great place for a great price right near Wrigley Field, cannot ask for much more !!
Very clean and comfortable!

Tye's place was so clean and the AC was lovely during our late summer stay. Having a private bathroom right across the hall form our room was amazing as well. Check in was very easy, no problems with the front gate or door code.
The train station is ~5 mins walk away and there are many bus stations on surrounding streets to get wherever we needed to go. It made the travel into downtown and other neighborhoods of Chicago very easy. Tye was communicative and we felt comfortable to hang out in the kitchen and living room of the apartment if we wanted to. Everything was very clean and welcoming. We had a lovely time :)
Great place. Not as easy a walk as hoped to reach Soldier Field, but not listings fault. Just sharing for others knowledge. Driving around was easy as was Uber/Lyft. Would stay again!
The host was unclear about instructions for parking (garage in alley) spiders were throughout the house, mold in both bathrooms, both refrigerators empty not even WATER, rats running around outside
Overall it was a decent BnB. It was right next to the brown line so it was super easy to travel. BnB was also in a good area. Restaurants near by wasn’t bad. Overall not a bad place to book

The place was exactly as described and the photos were accurate. Anne was very kind and detailed about check in and check out instructions, great location on the border of Wrigleyville and Lincoln park.

Dedique horas viendo distintas opciones para alojarnos unos días en Chicago. Me decidí por este lugar por su ubicación, cerca de la Línea Azul del Metro. Para ir al centro y al aeropuerto. Pero una vez entrando a la casa me emcontre con un bello lugar, acogedor, con todos los servicios. Nos tocó una semana con mucho calor en Chicago y el aire acondicionado de la casa funcionó perfecto y en silencio. La cocina completamente equipada. Y resaltar la gran comunicacion con Lacey, siempre al pendiente. Fue una grata experiencia y ampliamente la recomiendo.

Really enjoyed staying here. Check-in was easy, the house was clean and comfortable, and I appreciated how simple the space was. Everything we needed was there without a lot of clutter or unnecessary decoration.
The neighborhood was a big plus. Plenty of local places to eat, easy grocery shopping, and convenient to get around the city by car. I liked staying in a local neighborhood instead of downtown, and it was a great location for our concert at Soldier Field.
I was a little concerned about parking after reading some of the reviews, but coming from New Jersey and having traveled to plenty of cities, I found it easy to navigate and never had a problem.
A comfortable place to call home for a few days in Chicago. Communication from the host was proactive, friendly and attentive. I’d stay here again. Thank you.
We really enjoyed our stay the home had a lot of thoughtful personal touches and unique art! The area is really nice, walkable and there’s a lot to do nearby.

Mariusz was great to work with. He was quick to respond to questions but even better was how proactive he was with information. The apartment was in good condition and fairly clean. Parking and laundry were very convenient. There are grocery stores and parks nearby. My one critic is that the kitchen is lacking on cooking equipment like sharp knives and baking sheets. Overall though, it was a comfortable stay. We really enjoyed the flowers out front of the building and how well maintained the building is.

We had a wonderful trip to Bridgeport and really enjoyed our stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed to feel right at home. The location was convenient for exploring the area, and the whole experience was smooth and relaxing from start to finish. We really appreciated the hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Derek's place is in a great neighborhood, peaceful and quiet. It was about a 12 min walk from the Brown line train and felt safe the whole time walking to and from the train. Derek is very personable and had great local recommendations around the neighborhood. Me and my brother met up in Chicago for a quick weekend getaway. We booked a 2 night stay and it was great for us with two separate bedrooms and a shared bathroom.
The house is an older brownstone, and the place could use a few upgrades, but the beds were comfy and was a great home base for a quick weekend getaway.

we spent two nights. We have stayed at numerous Airbnb's , which most have been very nice. I have to say, that Beatrice's place is one of the nicest we have stayed in. It was cozy, quiet, and nice touches, such as breakfast items, tea & coffee. We did not want for a thing. We would absolutely stay here again if we make it back to Chicago for another visit and would recommend it to anyone. Thanks, Beatrice for a lovely stay.
Linda & Mike
Would stay again! Nick was super helpful and responded in fair time. No complaints about the airbnb or area around it!
Bel's house has a great location for exploring Chicago and cycling on the Lakeshore trail. She is very nice and responsive to questions.
Gran ubicación, Pilsen es hermoso y acogedor.
Jason is an excelent host.
Impecable departamento. Super seguro y centrico.
Nice place to stay. spacious and easy to go around.
Beautiful location, well kept and great layout of rooms. We will definitely be coming back.
Overall great place, it was just me and the room was perfect. Everything was set up right and it worked out perfectly for my trip.

Overall, we had a great stay! The Airbnb was super nice on the inside, clean, and comfortable. The location was okay for us since we were mostly there to sleep, although the surrounding area wasn’t the safest.
The only funny thing was that we somehow had a whole little beetle convention happening inside 😂 There were quite a few beetles throughout the stay, but honestly it didn’t bother us too much and we just laughed about it and got rid of them!
Overall, it was a nice place and worked perfectly for what we needed. We had a good experience and would give it 4 stars!

Perfect location! Close to all the action, but far enough away to enjoy some peace and quiet. Easily walkable to the downtown core, with plenty to do nearby. Having 3 rooms with queen-size beds was a huge plus. Overall, a great place to stay in Chicago—I would definitely recommend it!

Larry’s place was great and as advertised. Beautiful throughout each and every room of the home. WiFi was strong. The views around and inside were stunning. The place was close to downtown roughly 7-13 even with traffic. Larry was responsive and his instructions were clear.

Convenient location to restaurants and street parking was easy. Clean and comfortable 2 bedroom. Loved the coffee and tea ready to go for the morning! Enjoyed the modern design of the apartment. Would stay here again!
Great stay
Both the unit and the neighborhood were lovely. Kiva was a fantastic host he was communicative and helpful at all times. Highly recommend
Awesome stay would come back with events like that again
Weihong was very kind and communicative throughout the whole trip. Place was very clean would stay again.
Coty and Adrienne were great hosts. Communicative and understanding. The location was just great, and could easily walk to Chinatown and Pilsen! Would recommend.
Host was very attentive during our stay and had recommended near by places to try. The place was spot less and enjoyed our stay here.
Great place in a great location and an awesome Hoast!
Fantastic, kind, and caring hosts. Felt very comfortable and right at home.
Great location and excellent host. Would definitely recommend to others
Very nice place.
Perfect place for a couple or solo traveler ! Not too far from the subway system with bars and restaurants close by as well !

We had a great stay at Brad’s place! It had everything listed, was very clean, and in a safe area. Lots of great restaurants and shops within a walkable distance. Street parking was not terrible either. Overall very satisfied with our stay and would definitely stay again!
Well kept property
Close enough to downtown. Good restaurants in walking distance. Beds are comfortable. Very responsive host.
Tim and Daniel were very friendly. Great location. Recommended for a short stay.
Great place to stay!!!

The space was really nice, I’m local but had a guest coming in for a few days.  The location was two stops from wrigley and very easy to get in and out, walkable as well. Alma was very responsive and very kind. Would definitely stay again.
Great place to stay, had all the essentials nearby. Also great staff, Ben was super responsive. Would stay again.
Nice and peaceful stay

We really liked staying at this apartment. We were close to the train line so it was easy to get to downtown Chicago. We walked to the Obama Presidential Library, Trader Joes, and to local restaurants. There is even a fun restaurant right next door.
The apartment is vintage, but it was very clean and spacious. The AC unit was rather loud, but we were grateful for it as the temps were in the 90s. We would stay here again.

The apartment was very comfortable and located in a very safe and quiet area. The hygiene and cleanliness were excellent, and everything was well maintained. We felt comfortable throughout our stay, and it truly felt like home. We really enjoyed our time here and would be happy to stay again!
Loved the home and decor! Location was also pretty convenient to the train and a local store with everything you’ll ever need!

Bill and Susan are very warm and welcoming and their place is very clean and thoughtfully decorated. Loved the Trader Joe’s chocolates they left for the guests. The bathroom door doesn’t close all the way, so check with your partner/travel partner their level of comfort as far as privacy goes. Other than that a great place and a wonderful location.
Really great apartment in a great location
Good location near UChicago, bathroom did not match the pictures.
Todo perfecto

We had a wonderful time at Victor's place.  Had a large family group in town for a Cubs game.  We were steps from Wrigley Field, Addison redline train station, and numerous restaurants.  Beds were comfortable and had plenty of space.  Highly recommended.
This fit all our needs. We stayed here for a few weeks while our son settled into college and this had ever We needed to work and live comfortably.
Wonderful stay with a communicative host! We had a lovely time in Chicago
Adam was a great host, always responded to questions and reached out throughout our stay to check in on us. The place was well kept and had all the needed amenities.
Very nice building, nice neighborhood, close to restaurants and shopping.

Everything was great overall. The home was clean, comfortable, and located in a quiet, clean neighborhood. The only downsides were that the pet had to be taken off the property to use the restroom, which wasn’t clearly explained before booking, and there were quite a few flies in the bathroom. Other than that, we had a great stay and would definitely recommend it.
Lin and Peter were very friendly and welcoming. Room is very comfortable and the place is only a 3 minute walk from the blue line
Our stay was safe and welcoming.  It was perfect for my family and I. Clean spacious and in a good area .We were able to walk or Uber to all places of interest
Very clean and easy access in and out with a private garage

We really loved Charlotte's place for our 4 night stay in Chicago. It was set in a lovely quiet area but close enough to transportation to get to everywhere we wanted. The place was lovely. Exactly as described, if not better. The bed was very comfortable and the kitchen was a perfect space to cook and eat if you wanted. Would definitely try to book again if in Chicago.

This Airbnb was awesome.  Great location and close to a lot of things to experience.  My wife and I stay in the area when we come back to Chicago for Cubs games. Dennis had all the instructions written out nicely for easy check in. His apartment was clean and had extra towels. The kitchen was stocked with coffee and enough housewares to cook your own meals. The bed was comfortable.  The pillows could use an upgrade though.  Enough street parking right next to the place. Also very walkable to public transportation.  We loved this place and can't wait to come back.
We enjoyed staying at Aysin's place for the weekend.  It's clean, cozy and comfortable in a very walkable spot in Lincoln Park. Aysin is a proactive and friendly host.
Great location! The host was great. I would stay again

My Husband and I had an awesome time at Tripp and Todd’s home! It is Beautiful, filled with Music, and so much awesome art!! I especially loved that! Their garden area is gorgeous filled with plants and flowers and even a pond! If you get a chance to play frisbee with Eddie we definitely recommend, such a smart dog! We hope Eddie enjoys his cactus! We will definitely look to stay here again next time we come through Chicago!
Thank you so much guys we felt the love!!❤️

I had a little issue with parking when I got there after purchasing a parking space through their site, there wasn't any info about the stall. after awhile  he let me know which one and everything turned out great! beautiful place and great location. our family enjoyed it.
Had a great time  in nice  environment

This is a great place.  The unit was clean, comfortable, and all of the extra touches were appreciated.  Cody is a great host.  he is friendly, responsive, easy going.  We loved the Lincoln Square neighborhood. It is so cute, and vey walkable.  There are great restaurants and coffee places nearby.  The farmers' market on Thursday was a nice treat for local goods. The place had wear and tear that is noticeable as you stay but the location was clean. If you dont plan to stay inside all day then this won't be a dealbreaker.  The surrounding area is walkable and its easy to find the place.  Great fit for us with a small group of four.

Everything was great, it’s next to the train station and bus station so it’s easier to go wherever you would like to go. Noise from downstairs isn’t bad at all unless you’re a really light sleeper. If you turn the AC on, you won’t hear the noise downstairs.

Bob was easily available by text and had some great recommendations for us—even though we used to live in Chicago, it’s always great to find some new favorites! We would definitely stay here again.
We spent just a few days in Chicago and really enjoyed this spot. Appreciate everything that was provided to us. We would recommend this spot to anyone looking to stay in Chicago for a few days!
Nice condo in the heart of Lincoln Park. Everything you will want to do is within walking distance - and you will want to walk because driving in this area is a pain in the arse.

No complaints about staying at Kevin’s place. It’s a close enough drive to downtown and a good deal with the parking space compared to other airbnbs. Milan was an excellent host and his apartment was a great central location for the things that we decided to do during our time in Chicago. We will certainly stay at his place again the next time we are there if it is available.

Almost a great spot. Just missing a little maintenance and finish a couple projects. A little overpriced for mediocre digs. I would do it again but should be a little less money given the experience.

Very disappointing experience. We booked this stay on July 29 for a September 4 check-in, and immediately inquired about a pest issue. Despite having over a month to address the problem, our host canceled our reservation just two hours before check-in because the pest issue remained unresolved.

The surrounding neighborhood can feel a little rough, and there are often people outside, so I would recommend staying aware of your surroundings, especially at night. Overall, it was an affordable, peaceful stay, the room matched the description, and the hosts were responsive whenever I needed anything.

We would happily stay here again and would definitely recommend it to others!

Fantastic stay!!! Really clear instructions, recommendations and fast communication. Beautiful place in a great location. Lovely stay!!

The AC vents were also filthy and rusted and the smoke detector was hanging and not on. The shower being in that condition and not mentioned is a health issue and very upset it was not mentioned in the listing. We got a full refund but then had to overpay for hotel (well worth it to not have to shower in mold). Would only recommend to anyone who is ok with showering in black mold to save a few bucks.

In summary, I think the unit is fine for a short stay, but will require uber to get downtown quickly.
Very great deal for someone looking to stay in Chicago for cheap and still be close enough to everything around. Definitely gonna be the first listing I check anytime I’m in the city!
Thank you for the great place! Perfect for me and just what I was looking for. Great shower and comfortable bed. Nice array of coffee selections. Loved the chickens!

Had an incredible 3 months in Chicago staying at Level. Amenities, pool, coworking spaces were top notch.  Neighborhood is excellent, nice wide streets for loading and unloading. We plan to be back!

Perfect stay for our Cubs games! Alan’s place was absolutely perfect for our group of six (three couples). The walk to Wrigley Field was incredibly quick and convenient. The space was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. We really appreciated the complimentary snacks, and Alan was highly responsive whenever we had a question. We would definitely stay here again!

Great location, very clean, but smells like cat pee, communicates through a bot. Too sterile for my taste, no tea or good coffee, cooking oil, etc.
Can't close blinds all the way and is a basement unit.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. It was very spacious, and everything was clean. The view was amazing as well. I communicated with the host frequently, and they were very helpful and responsive. It was well-stocked with what we needed too. The area was quiet and had many public transportation options within a very short walking distance. A convenience store was also around the corner. The building has security as well, and they were very helpful. All in all, the location, the host, and the apartment were perfect for our needs. We would stay with this host again!
Very nice and clean apartment host was always super responsive and welcoming. The neighborhood was very peaceful and quiet. 10/10 would recommend

Location 10/10! No car needed. The apartment is located in the Hyde Park neighborhood and is safe, extremely walkable, and accessible via public transit. I flew into the Chicago Midway Airport and took the #55 bus directly from the airport to a stop two blocks away from the apartment. Additionally, the bus access directly in front of the building takes you to many of Chicago's most popular attractions. I rode the #6 bus downtown, to Millennium Park, the Riverwalk, Michigan Ave, and Navy Pier. Additionally, the neighborhood itself is within walking distance of the Museum of Science and Industry, 57th Street Beach and the Obama Presidential Center, as well as shopping, bars, and restaurants. The apartment itself was pretty basic/no frills, but very clean. The kitchen was well-equipped. The host was responsive and check in/out was easy and straightforward. If you want a safe, clean, and affordable stay, in a great location, this is it! Would definitely stay again!

Great place to stay, Mary always answered our questions and very kindly let us leave our luggage before the check in time. The two girls that helped Mary were great too.
The only thing is that is a little far from the Harlem L Station, about 20 minutes walking but in a very safe neighborhood.
Beautiful room, well equipped kitchen, and a comfy bed. Really no complaints!

Super convenient as I’ve come up a few times this year and this Air BnB is always clean and easy to get to right off the highway. Not in a congested area by any means but still very close to the city and just a short drive or uber if you need to get downtown, etc

Buena habitación, con lo justo y suficiente para estar en Chicago y no pagando precios desorbitantes. Tiene un CTA a la salida (62) y a 15 min caminando la línea naranja del metro, que conecta con el aeropuerto de Midway y el Loop en el centro. Volvería sin dudas.
Best airbnb in chicago that i stayed in! Everything was stated, smooth check in & clean rooms & areas! Great A/C, great bed as well.
Brad was really helpful! He responds very quickly which is a plus. The place was overall pretty, it matched the pictures and the description. My partner and I enjoyed our stay!
Stay was in a reflect spot, next to the public transport/trains. Easy to jump on the blue line and find my way back to the apartment.
This place was a good place to stay for a few nights within walking distance to Wrigley Field and other amenities in the area.
I love Jennifer place,  I know where I can crash at, when things get overwhelming.
Simply put, Gloria was engaged and everything was exactly as described and all I needed. I will be back, and that will happen very soon.
The garden the pool was such a nice area. Relaxing and peaceful

I picked Abbey’s place because it was walking distance from my family in Chicago.  It was the perfect spot for myself and my son, close to transportation to the city, and a lovely place to return to after a day of sightseeing in the heat! Abbey kept the apartment cool and we had everything we needed for our stay. We will definitely stay again!
Awesome place to stay with budget friendly
Great stay

It was a perfect place to work from for a few days for my wife and me. The two floors meant we could take calls without disturbing each other. The location was fantastic with many restaurants nearby and also just a few minutes away from downtown.

Absolutely adored Ewaz’s place!! Had all the amenities I needed for my stay and even provided bottled water and a variety of small snacks which was very much appreciated! I didn’t have a car with me which was not a problem at all as everything was close together - a variety of shops, restaurants, a small target, and a train station just a couple of blocks away. I felt very safe as I was traveling solo. Ewaz was such a lovely host, even recommending me places I might enjoy as a first timer around the neighborhood. Highly recommend :)

Great stay at this convenient location. The apartment is well lit, perfectly located near bus stops etc. Host was responsive.
Was there for 5 days and the only thing I would add as feedback is finding just 1 set of towels for 5nights. Other than that the stay was pleasant.
Such a beautiful place to stay great pricing and a wonderful host

This has been my fourth stay in Chicago and my favorite so far. The place is in a great location, close to everything with parking available nearby. The place is well decorated and very clean. The bed was comfortable and the kitchen is stocked with the essentials. I absolutely loved everything about this stay. I would stay again and highly recommend!

Our host Alfredo was so helpful and responsive! They had originally offered the garage because of construction on the street. By the time we arrived the construction was completed but they graciously allowed us to use the garage anyway(we had just brought a new car).
The home was perfect ! We were visiting my daughter who lives in Chicago and we wanted to stay somewhere close by. I love the Edgewater/Andersonville area! Tree lined streets, close to restaurants and shops and very safe. My only complaint is that we couldn't stay longer!
Very kind and reactive host. Good location and fits the pictures perfectly

Cloud9 truly delivered with this property. Everything was pristine, fully stocked with extras, and the views are stunning. Really helped make my girlfriend’s bday week amazing, would highly recommend.
Just a great place to stay and professionally managed all the way down to the unreal guidebook with info on Chicago. Absolutely worth the price and would 100% stay here again
It was kind of ok

Stayed with my husband and our 2yr old daughter. Location was amazing and walkable with a toddler. Felt safe day and night. Easy to find street parking but free private garage spot was perfect. The place was super clean and had everything we needed, including a high chair, stroller and pack n play. Kitchen was stocked with the essentials which made cooking easy. The decorations were a great balance of decorative and functional meaning I didn’t have to stress about my toddler breaking anything. Georgina gave great recommendations and was a great host. Looking forward to visiting again soon!
Apartamento muy completo y en una zona con mucha oferta. Te facilitan mucha información muy útil para poder pasar unos días tranquilos.
Thank you very much we had a great time in this manoir. Ryan was a great host! Everything was beautiful and amazing!

Hey this person is a SCAMMER. Photos AND description didn’t match the unit AT ALL. We contacted “Alma” who by the way, was clearly messaging us as different people from the app vs text, and they immediately admitted that they have photos of different apts and randomly assigned us one. It was uncomfortable, stained, no parking, noisy noisy NOISY and yeah, raaaadically different from the pictures.
She made up a random “policy” not to refund us (we had never seen, sign or consented to in advanced) and we waited about 50 mins (est. was 2-5mins) for calls from Airbnb to resolve before vacating because the situation was so bad.
This host is a SCAMMER!!!! Airbnb did nothing to help us. We’re now in the process of escalating privately. BAD BAD BAD.
Excellent stay for my work trip.  I’ll stay again if I can!
Great location, convenient, clean and easy to access. Perfect for our needs.
Very luxurious building, great location, well decorated, and spacious. It was much less expensive than hotels in the area with much more space and privacy. Would absolutely stay here again!

I needed a space that could do double duty - sleep and also where we would be able to create some educational content. The living space was perfect for this. The entire space was super clean and they had all the necessities that we needed to prepare meals. Danny - the host was super responsive, provided all the information that we needed. And checked in to see if we needed anything during the stay. I would DEFINITELY stay in this space again - 5 stars all around. NOTE - it is across the street from a school, so be prepared for the joyous sounds of kiddos when school gets out.
Great location in the city. Condo is well cared for and enjoyable. Good sleeping!   Great location for food and quick walk to brown line. Delight hosts!!

Probably the worst experience I’ve ever dealt with in regards to Air bnb. Host informed me 24 hours before check in that they would not be able to accommodate me during Labor Day weekend in Chicago! Everything has already been booked. This trip has been in the plans for months and he almost completely ruined  all this for me traveling from Texas. And to top it all off the host was trying to get me to cancel the request to keep part of my refund. Insisting that I cancel and that he couldn’t do it on his end. I know someone tryna hit a lick when they can. Should be ashamed.

The location was the best! Walkable distance 30-40min to all the attractions. The restaurants are around the corner. The apartment was very spacious and cool urban style. The only minus was the noise from the above apartment. You could hear the steps like somebody was walking next to you. But it didn't bother us much. Great stay! Thank you!
The views were everything advertised and the amenities were beyond exceptional

We had a wonderful stay at Paula & Adrian's home.   It has every thing you need for a comfortable stay.  It is very well equipped,  and in a great location close to shopping, restaurants, public transportation. Paula and Adrian are excellent hosts, very friendly, and are excellent communicators.  We will definitely be back!
Host was amazing, very responsive and helpful, the location was also great as it was close to downtown and the pier, great place for families with a nice cozy home feel. Would recommend!!
David was great and even helped us find out the type of pillows! Pillows were great

The location is fantastic. The staff is extremely helpful and friendly. They really helped us and made us feel welcome.
We’ll probably make Arlo our “home” when we’re in Chicago.

Sweet micro apartment equidistant to Wicker Park and Ukrainian Village. Close to many transit options too.  Very peaceful and quiet space with intentional bohemian decor, ac and everything needed for a pleasant stay. I felt right at home. I didn’t meet Sarah however she was easy to communicate with and gave lots of local recommendations.
Great place in a great location! Lots of space and Ian was very responsive!
Nicholas was very responsive and helpful during my stay. Also, the place exceeded my expectations. It can be a bit chilly, but the host provided very thick and comfortable linens so it was great!
The place was nice! The beds were unorthodox, fine for one person but two might be a squeeze. Overall, it was nice!

Held my company retreat here and we absolutely loved it. Great space to hold meetings, lots of bedrooms and really central location for the team to get out and walk around the city. Very happy we booked here and would absolutely return!

Karl’s place was perfect for our visit. We were moving a family member to Chicago into an apartment within walking distance from his place.  The beds were comfortable and his place provided a perfect retreat to rest comfortably with AC and additional fans to during an extreme heat wave with temperatures in the mid 90s.  It was nice to be able to walk to nearby restaurants most days, but also appreciated easy walk to the train to explore some other neighborhoods on our last day.  Have saved it as a favorite for when we visit family in the future. It doesn’t have a kitchen which we knew from his accurate description of the place and that was no issue for us. With so many great restaurants in easy walking distance we didn’t miss one bit.  Tre Kronor on the corner was the perfect breakfast spot each morning. The nearby Thai restaurant was a favorite too for takeout.

Overall the place was clean and check in was easy. Street noise was a bit loud since it's right off Western and not tucked into a neighborhood. Parking place was convenient. The check in at 5 pm is later than other places we've stayed and I did mention that to the owner.
The place was good although check in process times can be improved instead of 11am checkout it shall be 12pm.

It’s not very often that an Airbnb is better in person than it is in the photos, but Brian’s place was just that. We were excited to stay here and are even more excited to come back next time.
We stayed with a toddler, baby, and dog and Brian’s place was a great fit. He was very responsive and accommodating. This was the perfect place to explore Chicago and have the comforts of home away from home.

We had a great stay! The place was clean, cozy, and in a great location. Check-in and check-out were both incredibly easy, and the host was friendly and responsive. We would definitely stay here again!
We had a wonderful stay! Although the couch wasn’t so comfy and there were random noises. It was upscale and clean, which we greatly appreciated :)
Great place— just a few doors down from Best Intentions bar. Easy parking. Would stay here again for sure.
We loved this stay. It is a Very clean & intimate stay. Would book again WITH a CLOSE partner!
Great place to stay. Very walkable for everything we wanted to do.
The location is 1 block parallel to a busy street. It looks out to a large field giving the street it's quietness. The garage parking spot is a great perk in a city that has ongoing congestion.
We're often here for work, so we've stayed at a fair few places in the area. Philip's place has been by far the best of them. 10/10 on all fronts, thank you!
The apartment was very nice and clean, exactly as shown in the pictures. The host was easy to communicate with and always replied quickly. We had a great stay and would definitely recommend it!
An easy stay in a good location

Had a fantastic stay! Location was great for kids, two local parks and easy access to the 606. Blue Line was a 8 minute walk! The space was great, and we hope to stay again as it is extremely close to our family who live in neighborhood. Thank you for having us.

My first ever poor experience on Airbnb.
This place is not locally ran - it’s managed by some corporate management company which hugely affects the service and overall home quality.
The house rules are a bit extreme and made me very anxious that we would be charged for something during our stay.
The location was indeed very noisy at night due to the club/bar next door.
There was hair found in multiple spots in the unit.
The doors to the bedrooms are swollen wood and extremely difficult to close properly.
They charge $25 extra per additional guest who stays there.
There is a camera located right outside of the door entrance to the unit.
The pillows are extremely bulky and uncomfortable.
The late checkout fee is very expensive at $30/hour. They justify it by saying their keepers charge that much which is a laughable. Just wanted to check out 1 hour late.
Checkout was complicated because I didn’t know where to put the keys and was worried I would be charged for that.
Perfect place to live the city and to quietly rest

This neighborhood, building, and apartment is absolutely charming. Classic Lincoln Park vibe. Walking distance to Lincoln Park, the many beaches of the Chicago shoreline. A plethora of restaurants and nightlife. I stayed 3 nights. Parked my SUV then either walked or bicycled everywhere! Charming place.
fantastic place. couldn't say anything less. thanks for a great stay
Great host, clean and tidy place. Floors were very clean, felt right at home. Thanks! Looking forward to booking again.
Hena was extremely responsive and friendly! I’d highly recommend staying at her place. Thank you for everything :)
Highly recommend, it was a great stay. Will be using again when we go to visit daughter and granddaughter. The live plant was a nice touch.

Very tidy and clear very spacious
Love all the details in the rooms they provided
Cozy place
Very nice location and would definitely recommend
Nice place to drop off your things and get some sleep while exploring chicago. No complaints from me would definitely rebook if I return.
Nice studio very close to Loyola

We really enjoyed our stay at Laura’s place! It was just like the listing. It was conveniently located and we were close to shops and restaurants as well as public transportation.We will definitely book here again!

We enjoyed a terrific 2 night stay at Tripp and Todd's cozy and comfortable home. They were by far the most welcoming hosts we have ever had. They treat their guests like family.
The neighborhood is walkable (and in our case, bike-able) with tons to explore and the beach is just a few blocks away. This will be the place we'll return to when visiting Chicago.
Great place would stay again.

BAD! Place has serious insect infestation. Unit covered in cobwebs. Spiders crawling everywhere. Flies & full grown flying cockroaches flying in common areas. Drawers had spiders & cobwebs. Every corner of unit in bathroom kitchen bedroom etc had many types of living spiders crawling thru dust. No way unit was "just cleaned". A guest also staying there said it was worse before i came but she called to complain about dirty bathroom and a cleaner came to only clean the bathtub so she could shower. Was odd to see a dirty bathroom w/ clean bathtub amongst filth & unsanitary conditions throughout rest of unit. The rest of place was so filthy a clean bathtub looked out of place. Spiders constantly making new webs. Every night I had to kill 20 spiders. No exaggeration 20! Some were pregnant spiders. Then wake up in morning with new spiders to kill. Bugs crawled on my things. Webs of dust hang from ceiling. Bedsheets had other ppls hair on it etc. Owner did not refund me had to get airbnb help

The place and room were very clean and spacious. Love the private bathroom so convenient that. Great area near many pubs, shops, places to eat and public transportation if needed. The area is very walkable also in my opinion. Would definitely book again

The stay was pleasantly surprising. You can hear movements around you but everyone settles down and as a light sleeper, I fell asleep well. The refrigerator had an ice maker and water dispenser which was great that I could fill my work cup with ice cold water every day. The bed was super comfortable, the comforter was amazing. Thank you for the wonderful stay.

The decor was cozy and comfy.
The kitchen was well stocked for anything that we needed.
If the situation should arise again, we would definitely book Danny's place again.
It was in a great spot  literally can drive anywhere within a 15-20 drive and yes there is a part there is shady on the street but as long as u don't stop and mingle ur alright
Tamara’s unit is exactly as advertised and is located close to the heart of the Logan Square neighborhood. Tamara is also a super responsive and kind host. Would recommend.

A great place to stay in one of the coolest areas of Chicago! There are many amazing restaurants, pubs, coffee shops around, just couple minutes away by walking. It is also very close to downtown. Ryan was a super helpful and responsive host. His place was very clean and had everything you needed for a comfortable stay.

This is one of the best Airbnbs we have ever stayed in. It was stunningly beautiful, bright, and comfortable, with everything we could possibly need for our family of four. The neighborhood was a highlight: great restaurants and coffee shops, friendly neighbors, beautiful homes, little free libraries abound. Because we have two little kids, we are essentially trapped at the Airbnb once they go to bed each night - but in this case, we found ourselves looking forward to the end of the day so we could relax in this lovely home.

I have to say it was one of the best places I’ve ever stayed. It had everything I needed and more. All the details to make the guest feel right at home and the neighborhood is just perfect, you can find everything close by.

Coming from Australia I absolutely loved this Airbnb. It was in a gorgeous safe neighbourhood with great eateries and the beach was so close. Within minutes you’re on the Mag Mile. The apartment had everything you need with a huge comfy bed and a large tv you can turn to face the bed!! It was great to be close to everything yet feel like a local. I highly recommend, it was a perfect choice for my Chicago stay!

I really enjoyed this space and I’d definitely book again. The bnb was nice and clean, spacious, had a washer and dryer, and in a great position to visit downtown. A bonus for the free available parking just out back! My spot was never taken cause it was specific if you have your own vehicle. You have to walk up the stairs but that doesn’t bother me at all. And he’s really nice and responsive, met him in person as well while he was doing work outside. And they have roku!

Great A/C. High end appliances including the laundry. Well supplied. I loved the outdoor space. If they had a grill and toaster it would be 5 star. It was a great fit for me. I would stay there again.
We had a great family time at Marco’s place. He was a great host, very proactive in communicating in time. His property was just right for us. I recommend for others too

We had a great stay here - super clean and amazing location as well as functional layout with open kitchen + living room. Note that the 3rd bedroom is very small - good for small kids but not adults. The building is very modern, patio is great, and rooftop is perfect for groups and grilling.
A couple things to note:
- Check-in requires elaborate paperwork and downloading a special app for the key. We had to wait 24 hours after our checkin to get a digital key since one of our guests didn't submit the paperwork by the deadline, which is 2 days before checkin
- Air conditioning was spotty and it was very hot in the unit (80F) on a hot day with the AC on
Still a 5-star stay for our group though and we would come again.
Great location and perfect for what we wanted and needed. Looking at making an annual trip to Chicago and hope to stay with Tariq EVERYTIME!!
Nice place to stay- good location. Very good communication

We were very happy with this Airbnb in the Pilsner neighborhood of Chicago. The place had everything we needed. It was very clean and spacious, had a dedicated parking spot, was in a safe neighborhood and we felt right at home. What we really liked was  the CTA  Pink Line 18th street station was not that far away, we could walk there in about 20 minutes or find free on street parking a couple blocks away from the station. I would definitely recommend this place and would definitely consider it for a future stay in Chicago.

This place it is in a very cute neighborhood with a park really close to it. I enjoyed walking around the neighborhood and running in the park. At first I was a worried about having to take a bus to the CTA blue line, however, buses are very frequent and the house is not far from the station.
Victor is very helpful and always answered my questions

The garden apartment was perfect, close to where we wanted to be with all the things that make a stay excellent. It is on a quiet street, close to all amenities and Daniel is a great host. We will be back.

So clean and well appointed. Truly one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in. Would return anytime I need a place. Relay communicative host and fast responses to inquiries. The furnishings were exceptional and really comfortable bed. bathroom is very clean and has everything you need. House rules laid out very clearly and super easy to follow. Parking was easy and the provided passes. Helped do much. Safe area surrounded by great transportation and dining options. One of the best stays I’ve ever had on Airbnb. Thank you again.

Great place :)
Easy access to things - but just note that if you have the windows open, it is quite noisy with all the traffic and the subway passing by often.

The apartment was lovely and clean and in a fantastic location. Lewis was so generous; he offered us early check-in simply because his place was ready early! We greatly appreciated his proactive communication and hospitality.

It's a nice, clean, mostly-quiet basement apartment in a lovely quiet neighborhood.  It had everything we needed for our work retreat.  The beds were comfortable, bathrooms clean, kitchen had everything we needed, and living and dining areas were comfortable as well.
We loved staying at Kevin’s house .A large family out of state we fitted very well .Near downtown and access to CTA .l would stay here again .

STAY HERE! and make time to read all signage and the guestbook (cover to cover). David's personality comes through in such a fun way!
The place was just perfect... quirky details kept us chuckling... lots of thought (and wit) went into everything. Perfectly equipped without being overwhelming or complicated. Plenty of room and comfortable seating/sleeping.
Appreciated the lax check-out so we could quickly move on with our day.

The location in Hyde Park couldn't have been better - walkable to restaurants, shopping, Nichols Park, and the U of C campus. We thought the apartment was actually nicer and larger in person than the photos showed. A note for coffee drinkers - there is no drip coffee maker, but there is a french press and you'll find plenty of coffee shops in the neighborhood. Gerry was quick and friendly with responses to questions, and was a great host. We would definitely stay again!
Was very kind with allowing us to check in early. Thank you

Great place to stay in Chicago for exploring the city. Walking distance to all main sights and lots of restaurant options. Truly central.
The apartment was exactly as described, very clean, and it has everything you need.
The team also communicated super well with us. They were flexible with early check in, had very well and easy instructions for everything, and was super responsive every time we reached out.
The only thing I would suggest is to have some blackout shades around the apartment. With all the windows (and amazing views), it gets light very early, but the current shades do not block much.
Otherwise, great apartment and stay! Definitely recommend and would come back.

My dog and I needed a place to stay for a couple of nights while we transitioned to our new apartment. Very thankful that Rida was able to host us on quick notice and could accept pets. The apartment was clean and perfect for our needs. Rida was lovely to communicate with and responded to messages quickly. Thanks again!
I’ve really enjoyed my stay here. Helen is incredibly kind and hospitable. I had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again.
Super helpful host and the space was way better than expected.
Great place to stay, they really know how to treat there guest. I would highly recommend!

Perfect for our short stay while we were in Chicago for work. Everything was as it should be. Perfectly described in the listing. The only two negatives for us was that the parking space reserved for this location was a bit too small for our abnormally large pick up truck and the water pressure in the shower wasnt very good.

Everything were above my expectations, walking distance to many major attractions, beautiful view of Michigan lake, would be perfect if AC in the living room works, just little too hot @ around 86 degrees through out the day.

Jeff's place was an amazing find! It's a bit south but very walkable and safe. I had several late nights walking due to my business and had no issues. As a woman, safety for me is paramount. Beyond the location, the space itself is truly private. Private entrance and amenities. Jeff's was thoughtful to include a few bottles of water, things to charge your phone, coffee and tea bags etc. He was responsive and proactive even left cough drops avaliable for me when he heard my cough.
He isn't just an Airbnb host. He is hospitable. Clearly not just in it for the $$
I highly recommend and the value for what you pay is excellent.
Best host I've had in a long while
Amazing person
Very communicative and perfect space for my group
Awesome and unique, walkable was a plus! Thank you for the stay, Erik :)

A great location and well set-up unit. We weren’t told about the pool not working until we arrived at the condo, and given that was a significant part of why we booked it, we were very disappointed to not be able to use the pool. Aside from that, a very good spot to stay.

It was a nice stay for what we paid for! Just a few small things like the fridge didn't feel cleaned out properly with some stains a grime. We were glad we brought our own bath towels as there were only two available in the main bedroom and none in the bathroom. There was some confusion because instructions weren't given as much in advance as would have been helpful, such as when asking to be able to have a late check out, we were not told until several hours later after approval that there would still be an additional charge if we stayed past 11am despite that not having been stated in the original discussion about a late check out. I do very much appreciate Fabio's willingness to help us retrieve a left behind item. Overall, it was a good experience! Just some small things that could be tweaked for a better stay.

Great location, close to everything in Logan Square. Clean, comfortable, well maintained. Super easy check-in and check out. No laundry list of tasks to do before check out. It’s an actual apartment, not somebodies basement. Would recommend.
We had a great time.   Easy walk to Wrigley.  Great neighborhood.  Very comfortable bed.

This was one of our favorite Airbnb's. It was clean, quiet, spacious, and close to restaurants and bars. It was also within walking distance of a great grocery store (Tony's), which we've frequented before.
Joe communicated quickly and answered questions within minutes of me asking.
We'd love to book here again when we return to Chicago. Highly recommend!

We had a great stay at Eric's apartment. The place was tidy, clean and had everything we needed. The location was perfect. Very close to the shops and restaurants on Division. We were only a 15 minute walk to our son's apartment. The dog park at Wicker Park was an easy walk and a great place for our dog to burn off some excess energy. We will definitely try to stay here again when we come back to Chicago.

Joseph was very friendly and made it an easy choice to book with him. The communication and responsiveness was great, they made it very easy and welcoming especially with a pet. Check in was a breeze, the place was clean and exactly as expected. We would definitely book here again!

The place was extremely convenient due to it being so close to Chinatown. There were lots of food locations to choose from. The garage is definitely a plus for those who plan on visiting Chicago via driving.

I had a very pleasant stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and air conditioned during some really hot days. The location is great. Easy to find coffee and food nearby, short walk to the train, etc.

Thank you again for being such a great host. We really enjoyed our stay and appreciated all the thought and care you put into making everything comfortable and welcoming.
Thanks again for having us, and we hope to stay with you again in the future!
Take care,
Eric
This was a great & quiet stay. We will definitely be back.
Great location, Jeff communicated well and I would stay again.

I really enjoyed this hostel! The other person sharing the space with me was very messy but when I messaged Celia about it, things were taken care of. I did a private room and it was more than worth it based on the price, amenities, and location. Highly recommend if you are on a budget.
great for a few nights stay
It is a hotel, not like a condo or anything. Would have rather just booked a room through the hotel, but it was a good stay—probably just more expensive than it had to be.

Came there for our 25th anniversary get away along with watch 2 back to back Brewer games. Only 10 minutes away from Wrigley Field 💞 along with restaurants and metro. Reed was so responsive along with giving us recommendations to foods and places.
I highly recommend this Airbnb!
I’d definitely return again!

We stayed here with 3month old baby and we loved it. The apartment looks brand new and everything is modern and clean. It’s very close to the beach, so we chose here to take a walk, spend time on the beach and feel urban but peaceful vibe. It’s right next to the subway and even I can see it through the window but its noise level is like toilet flushing.  The only annoying thing is the AC sound. It’s very loud. Looks like the cool air comes from the central ac and the thermostat only turns on/off. It cools very quickly with very loud sound. Our baby woke up whenever AC is ON

Aisha’s Air B n B was fantastic. She was a diligent, communicative, and empathetic host.
On my last day, I came down with a highly debilitating illness and she was willing to accommodate my needs to extend my stay in order to get back to full health, when she did not have to.
I will recommended her air b n b to my friends and family visiting Chicago for the foreseeable future.

This does not seem like someone’s home, it seems like a short term rental. The address for this listing was not correct, I was sent check in information through a text message link. Adam was an incredible host—responsive, polite, and welcoming throughout our stay. The space itself was absolutely gorgeous and filled with thoughtful details that gave it so much character. We especially loved the real hardwood floors, beautiful oak trim around the doorways, and solid oak doors. These details made the home feel warm, timeless, and exceptionally well cared for.
Everything was also incredibly clean and thoughtfully maintained. The bathtub was spotless, the tile work was flawless, and the entire space felt fresh and inviting. The décor and furnishings were comfortable, calming, and relaxing, making it easy to settle in and truly feel at home.
The appliances were newer, worked perfectly, and were thoughtfully placed to maximize efficiency and convenience. We also really loved the layout—it made excellent use of the space while still feeling cozy, comfortable, and spacious enough for everything we needed.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience.

Overall, the location and view are excellent, but the pool closure, cleanliness, and lack of basic supplies made the stay disappointing compared with what was advertised.

Marisa is a nice, clean, and responsive host, but this space just isn't set up for long-term stays, despite her 32-day minimum. The lofted space is smaller than it looks in the photos, and the bed is a daybed, not a full-size. Also, the listing says there is no lock on the bedroom door, but that's because the space doesn't have a door at all. You access it by walking up stairs that lead directly into the open lofted room, which feels more like a rec space and has minimal privacy. I don't think that was clear.
Finally, the home has 2 bathrooms for your use: a shower in the host's bedroom (shared) and a toilet on the main level. If the host is in her room, you can’t access her bathroom. So, if you need to pee in the middle of the night, you need to go down 3 flights of stairs. I often had to wait hours for her to wake up so I could shower if I came home in the evenings or early mornings, which was hard as someone working in the ER.
I just wanted future bookers to know this in advance!
