We have stayed at Melissa’s place a couple of times and enjoyed it each time.  Very clean, great location and parking is very easy.  Melissa is very responsive.  She does require a 3 night minimum, which doesn’t always work for us,  a 2 night minimum would be perfect.
Absolutely perfect place and very gracious host. Will return 😊
I felt really comfortable in Abby’s house. She is very helpful! I highly recommend her house! Great location!
호스트는 응답이 매우 빨랐고, 친절했으며, 직접 응답할 수 없는 상황에서도 대신할 사람을 구해서 소통하려고 했습니다. 숙소는 매우 넓었고, 청결했고, 큰 TV가 있습니다. 방음 또한 매우 잘 되었고, 큰 불편함 없이 한 달을 지낼 수 있었습니다.

Very neat and clean! Very good location. Comfortable vibe.
We enjoy cooking, kitchen was very streamlined could have used a peeler and large pot for cooking. :)
Great stay. Has everything you need to be honest. Getting in and out if the city was perfect! There were zero disappointments with my stay!
Nice quiet place it’s very private and I like that it’s accessible to the bus line and train
Great stay! Would stay again in a heartbeat.

Very easy check in and exactly what we needed for our stay. There was some confusion about expected guests on both ends but J was more than responsive and accommodated us. Thank you for allowing us to stay at your place!

Leider kam ich nicht in das Airbnb rein, da das Türschloss defekt war oder der code den rashad mir gegeben hat fehlerhaft war. Nach ca. 4 stunden Wartezeit und keinerlei Antwort von rashad konnte ich die Buchung mit der hilfe vom Support stornieren. Anschließend musste ich in ein hotel, welches teuerer war.

La casa estuvo excelente, completa y con todos los implementos necesarios.
Lo único malo es que el barrio se siente desolado.
I had a nice stay, awesome place!

Our stay in Ben’s place was awesome. The space was just as described - clean, spacious, comfortable, and safe. The location was so convenient to the red line and buses and made it so easy to explore all the great areas of the city. We would 100% stay here again next time we are in town!
Great location within steps of bars, restaurants, and shops, but on a quiet street.  The place was very comfortable and clean.

Had a great stay at this clean and quiet place. Extremely well-equipped kitchen, comfortable bed, good shower, and quality linens and towels. Spiral staircase might be challenging if older or unsteady. Hosts are very responsive and helpful. Price is a little higher than comparables in the neighborhood.

Excelente departamento, todo limpio y en orden, tiene todo, tal cual como se ve en fotos, nos encantó. Solo que para entrar fue un tema ya que las personas que están en concierge no te ayudan a nada, ojalá puedan arreglar eso se que es independiente pero si estaría bien dejar un poco más claro en el lobby las intrucciones. Sin embargo, si regresaría esta increíble!!

Jose's place is great! I think if you only prepare for 1 person you shouldn't charge extra for 2 people to sleep in the same room on the same bed. We only got one towel and one pillow for the two of us. The place was great though and we would definitely go back if they will clean the bathroom next time. It was quite a mess when we got there and we didn't feel comfortable showering. Don't let this deter you from coming though there are several people staying throughout and the room we actually stayed in was very clean.
Very spacious and clean. Really easy to get around from the location, and the host was super communicative! Would absolutely stay here again!
wonderful place for family with kids and/or sharing with multi friends. Many games, pool table, other table games along with a very comfortable deck outside on top of garage
Great location, space, and host.

This was just a perfect combination of accommodations and location. As a solo traveler, having the single room with bathroom down the hall worked nicely. The home is very close to Dark Matter, a great cafe, and Wolf & Co, a trendy market. Just minutes to the L station.
Great communication from the host! Beautiful views from the unit and very convenient to have a garage space!

The location can't be beat for a trip to Wrigley Field.  House was as described, and parking easily fit a truck and SUV.  Grace was very responsive with the few questions we had, and also very accommodating.

Absolute gem of a building, built in 1896, great back story. Having the L station right outside is a huge plus. Only drawback: Even 12 stories up,  it can be loud at night, but also, that's Chicago. The host helps mitigate with ear plugs and white noise devices.
Host was very responsive and tidy! I appreciated my stay there.

We had a wonderful stay with David. Perfect place for a quick getaway to Chicago to catch a Cubs game. Love the location- quick walk to Southport shopping and Wrigley field.
Loved all the little “extras”- fridge with drinks, bathroom well stocked and super comfortable bed.
Will definitely stay with David again!
Thanks for the stay, it was great to have it as a base to visit Hyde park and take the train to downtown too

We really enjoyed our stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. It was easy to walk to so many places, and the nearby train made it convenient to get anywhere else we wanted to go. Having on-site free parking was a big plus. We would definitely stay here again!
Great location and friendly host. Will visit again when in the city.

This was the perfect place to stay for a long weekend to catch a couple Cubs games! The condo had everything we needed and was so conveniently located to so many things to do and amazing restaurants. Tere was great to work with and I would definitely recommend the condo!
Great apartment with great view of the lake and downtown.  Easy access to public transportation.
Todo estuvo excelente, me sentí realmente cómoda. Y el anfitrión súper al pendiente.

Absolutely loved it! I'm an anxious planner and need all sorts of creature comforts: privacy,  walkable to restaurants, really comfortable beds, cold temps, multi bathrooms, garage etc. This place has it all! I'm also neurotic about safety, especially since it was just my best friend and I, so two girls alone in the city. Super safe. Everyone is friendly! Having that garage spot is key too to save $$$. The hosts are extremely responsive! The apartment is on the top floor and is super quiet. I will 100% book again!
very safe, clear instructions to get in, helpful, perfect on a budget

This stay was amazing! It’s a little west of Andersonville in Bowmanville, but as like as you like to walk, this place is perfect!
Regarding the allotment itself, it’s cozy, has two beds, and is laid out comfortably. I highly recommend it!

Jarvis Gardens apartment is lovely, well thought out decor & amenities, comfortable & secure, & a great place to stay when visiting Chicago. Its walking distance to the red line & bus routes make it very handy. A short walk away, Charmers Coffee was fantastic for us coffee snobs & Taste Wines was very good for a glass or bottle with tasty food & entertaining staff. Everything was great, however, we found the mattress very firm. All else was 5-star!
Very amazing place. Love the location. The building is perfect: coworking spots, gym, patios, perfect skyline view. You really can't beat this place.
Second time staying and loved it! Air conditioning was great during the last hot days of Chi summer. Great communication great proximity to Fulton Market. Looking forward to returning.
Felice has a very beautiful home! It's very quiet and peaceful, perfect for a little retreat. Thank you!!

Erik made everything seamless! Not only were the accommodations exactly as described but he went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable, even offering to pick me up from the train station so I didn’t need to drag my bags. Very friendly host and clean space, with a comfy bed and no nonsense room. Everything I needed for a short stay.

Close to Belmont train station (5 minutes) & Wrigley field (10 minutes), bedrooms set back from street so only noise was from other residents above us, but nominal. Great bagel shop across the street.
The location hosted by Ben was wonderful! It was clean and in a nice area with a beautiful view. Ben was very responsive and helpful at all times.

Our stay was wonderful! We accidentally walked out with the keys! I feel really bad about that! Make sure you leave them upon checkout. I should have set a reminder for myself to check before I left. Nestor was so understanding though and our stay was incredible. Great area and easily accessible to everything in Chicago. I highly recommend!

We have just come back from an amazing stay here with our family, 2 young kids and grandparents.
It was super easy to check in and the hosts were great at responding to any messages.
The location was great for us as a family, lots of local coffee shops/restaurants etc. Walkable to the local stations to get into downtown.
We got a lot of Ubers to places as had younger kids with us which was easy to get to the zoo/beach/pier.
The apartment was lovely and clean, clear instructions in the folder with great recommendations. We tried a few recommendations which were amazing.
Quick and fast response via app if we had any questions whilst there. We requested late check out which was handy as we had a later flight.
Lovely and clean, comfy beds and everything you need.
Thanks so much, our stay in Chicago was lovely and would definitely recommend:)

Arrived to find the room hadn't been cleaned since the last guest. Bed sheets had food remnants and weren't changed, only dirty towels were left out, and the sink was full of dishes because the dishwasher didn't work. The waste disposal was clogged, wifi showed connected but had no internet, and the dryer just spun for over 3 hours without heating when I tried washing sheets myself.
I told the host and asked to be moved to another unit. He apologized and said maintenance would come that day, but nothing was actually resolved in time, so I had to cancel through Airbnb support and find somewhere else to stay.
Too many basic things were broken at once, and fixing them took way longer than it should have. Can't recommend this listing as is.
Steps from Wrigley make this the perfect place to stay with a group. Thanks so much can’t wait to come back next year!

We really enjoyed our stay! The home was comfortable, clean, and provided everything we needed for a great trip. The location was convenient for exploring Chicago, and the host was friendly, responsive, and easy to communicate with. We had a wonderful time and would definitely consider staying here again!

Perfect for solo travelers, especially anyone on the quieter/more introverted side, as it's pretty much a studio apartment with all of the basic amenities that you need to be self-sufficient.
Very clean and pretty tucked away/quiet. There was only one night where I heard any street traffic or even saw other guests — the easiest walk ever to the Blue Line (literally 1 min), so you have fantastic access to the rest of the city.
Any "issues" I had were really just personal taste things, such as having to sleep on a twin sized bed (there was definitely comfortable space for at least a full), as well as me buying my own laundry detergent, as I found the complimentary detergent provided to be a bit funky, and the tap water took a bit long to come up to temp — but again, total non-issues to any other regular person.
For what you get, it was a little pricey in my opinion when compared to hotel prices, but for summertime in Chicago, I'd be more than happy to stay at 747 Lofts again! :-)
Walkable location and a good place to stay with friends since each bedroom has a private bathroom.
Victoria was a great host. My family enjoyed the stay and was very comfortable.
Enjoyed my time here- perfect for what I needed as a solo traveller! Loved how close this place is to the 606 and blue line

A MUST stay if you’re going to Chicago for Cubs games!  Location, location, location!  Southport and all its shops in one direction and just a few blocks from Wrigley (super easy walk) and all the Clark St pre & post-game hang outs in the other direction!  We felt right at home in the garden apt.  Such a cute and quirky little apt!  Added fun for kids of all ages with the pool table, darts, Mrs PacMan and pinball machine!  Super easy access with street parking and your own private entrance.  Amazing finishes throughout the apt with all the bells and whistles.  Even my kids said “10/10 would stay here again” lol.  Great communication with the hosts and felt right at home the entire stay!  Thank you guys for your hospitality ;)

We had so much fun staying here! Everything was clean and well put together. We took an uber to the field museum, Wrigley, and millennium park, all were about 20-30 min drive. Parking was also very easy to figure out.
Great place! This was our second time to book it.
The place was amazing! I enjoyed myself. Everything was clean, the host was responsive & nice place overall.

Wow!! What an amazing gem! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Heather’s home was absolutely beautiful and exceeded our expectations. From the moment we walked in, we felt right at home. The house was gorgeous, clean, modern, and beautifully updated. The bathroom was stunning, and having a laundry room was such a huge plus!
We also really appreciated all the thoughtful touches—coffee, water, tea, and sodas were provided and very much appreciated.
Heather was a wonderful host, and you can truly tell she puts a lot of thought into making her guests feel welcome. We had such a great stay and will DEFINITELY be staying here again in the future! Highly recommend! ❤️🏡

I enjoyed staying at Genova's listing. The only think I think potential boarders should take into consideration is that there is only one bathroom available for everyone staying on the property. Thankfully, I only encountered someone who needed to shower at the same time as me once. Otherwise, this listing is great for anyone who is planning to explore Chicago, especially the Pilsen neighborhood.

Enjoyed my weekend trip in Chicago at James place very nice and cozy home !
Had everything we needed (:
Would love to be a guest again if i visit Chicago again (::::
Had some issues with WiFi and it was a good stay! The noise did not bother us!

Antonio’s place served as a great home base for my wife and I to move our son into his dorm for his freshman year at DePaul University.  It was conveniently located to DePaul and all the essential stores needed to help set up his dorm.  The neighborhood was a great place to relax after a long day of moving.  We enjoyed the local bars and coffee shop next door.  We will definitely stay again!
Brandon was very responsive and accommodating to our requests. The property was clean, well appointed and in a great location. The space was great for our group.
Great views,  plenty of space, my family and I really enjoyed our stay. If ever back in Chicago I'd definitely choose this place again. Thanks for sharing your beautiful home.

My stay with Carlo (and Kim!) was excellent. You can tell the hosts put a lot of thought and detail into making the space comfortable and functional. The bed, blanket, and pillows were very comfortable!! Both hosts were highly responsive and extremely accommodating. What you see on the listing is what you get. I felt the area was close to public transit and food options. Importantly, it was quiet at night!!
I would recommend this listing to any solo traveler!!
The window air conditioner was grossly dirty,  response was slow, remedy unsatisfactory. There was no hot water in the shower.

The Airbnb is located in a calm and quiet area and was very easy to find. Check in was simple and flexible thanks to the code lock, which was very convenient.
At first glance, the building and the interior can look a little rough and minimalistic, but overall it was completely fine for the price. The bathroom could have been cleaner when I arrived, although this may also have been due to other guests using it. A few basic things such as kitchen towels or paper towels were also missing.
My initial room did not have any windows, which I had not understood from the Airbnb description. However, the host responded very quickly and immediately offered me the option to move into a larger room with a window, so this was resolved without any problem.
Overall, considering the price and what you get, I think it offers very good value for money. It may look a little rough around the edges, but the easy check in, quiet location, and responsive host made the stay a positive experience.

Fantastic little place in the walkable distance to a bus stop. Made it easy to use public transportation our entire trip. Area was as described. One thing to note is the A/C is not controllable by guests so if adjustment is needed, reach out to the host. Host was friendly and quick to respond if we needed anything. Comfy beds and host-provided amenities made the stay extra nice.

This was our second stay at Matt’s place. The building is old, but has so much character—which I love—it is very roomy and is extremely clean. So very clean. The bedding and towels and beds are comfy. Matt is super responsive. The location is great—steps away from Fullerton with the coffee shops, restaurants, and the Walgreens on the corner is very convenient. Just a few blocks north to Logan Square and all it has to offer. I recommend the farmer’s market. Having a parking garage was very helpful. There is some road noise from Kimball, but I put on my sound machine on my phone and it blocked it. Thanks for another great stay, Matt.
Very clean property with comfortable furniture and a comfortable bed. Was a great stay, would definitely stay there again. Restaurants and coffee within walking distance.

Paul’s place was the perfect spot for my family to stay with PLENTY of space for multiple families. Just a 15 minute uber ride to Wrigley if you want to catch a game. We ended up leaving stuff behind and Paul had it shipped within the same day! I’d recommend this place to anyone wanting to stay in the city.
Our family of 6 thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Such a cute neighborhood and wonderful! Would definitely stay again!
Had my best friend and her husband come out to Chicago, we absolutely loved the space and Perry was very responsive and kind :)

Our family of 6 (including children age 5 and 7) had a great stay here for our time in Chicago. The beds were very comfortable (though they were smaller than we expected) and we appreciated the room air conditioners and sound machines. Bathrooms were great. The whole apartment was smaller than we expected. The photos in the listing are not actually of this apartment—the windows and some furnishings were different. We liked the building and the building staff very much. The fitness center was great.
The location was perfect for visiting museums and parks. Easy access to CTA buses and the El. We bought 3 day passes and used them a lot. The children’s library at the Harold Washington Public Library 1 block away was amazing.
Instructions from Staywell were clear and comprehensive. The price seemed high.
Excellent homey place to stay for 4 nights with my family.  The dynamic area is bustling, but the street is quiet.  Hosts were quickly responsive, as well.    Love Wicker Park/Bucktown neighborhoods!
Alma’s place was great ! Having a parking was a total blessing . It’s very conveniently located .

We loved Kory’s place! The place was very cute and decorated so nice. We enjoyed staying there while visiting our daughter and also catching a Cubs game. It was very easy and safe to walk to restaurants, grocery stores and shops. We definitely want to stay here again.
Thank you Kory!!!!!!

The location was in the South Loop, but the immediate area and overall building environment were not what I expected. The building was quite noisy, with people running through the hallways, and there were unpleasant odors in both the hallways and elevators. I wouldn’t necessarily say that I felt unsafe, but based on the overall environment, this is definitely not a property I would choose to stay at again.
The unit itself was very average and, unfortunately, not particularly comfortable. The beds were small, there was limited space around and between the beds, and the overall setup just didn’t feel comfortable or inviting. Nothing was necessarily terrible about the unit itself—it was simply okay and did not meet my expectations.
Overall, the stay was manageable, but between the noise, odors, surrounding environment, and lack of comfort inside the unit, I would not personally stay here again.
Great value overall. Only drawback is fairly tight parallel street parking.
Very comfy stay, I really enjoyed walking around the area and the staff was very friendly.

The place was perfect for a two-person stay! I wasn’t aware that the unit was located in the backyard of a home, but it was so peaceful and quiet that I completely forgot about it. Everything was clean and fully stocked with everything we needed throughout our stay. I would definitely recommend this unit!

We had a lovely stay in this very clean and super comfy apartment. Beds were very comfortable, and the kitchen had every amenity we needed. With plenty of towels and an in-unit washer/dryer, we felt very much at home.
Also, the neighborhood is wonderful. It's very quiet, safe, and offers plenty of nearby delis and shops, good bakeries, excellent restaurants, and enjoyable bars with character.
We can't say enough about Imran and his team! They were proactive and clear in all communications, and quick to respond to our messages. Very easy to work with!
We'll definitely be staying here again.
Kim is a great host. The place is amazing and recommend it to anyone wanting to stay in the center of Lakeview with public transit easy to use.
Very clear check-in instructions, responsive host, great accommodation, and an amazing location.

Allotjament tal qual surt a l’anunci. Lloc tranquil i ambient familiar. Ideal per a famílies.

It was a cute place to stay. Pretty easy access to the buses and trains. Would stay here again!

Listing was just as described and better . As a big fan of older homes , the updates & artful decor were nicely done while preserving the style of the building . Not only was it just the space we needed , there were so many extra positives we discovered through out our stay . We were able to explore the vibrant and yet quaint Lake View neighborhood by foot , walk to both our night games at Wrigley , and travel back and forth downtown with both Brown & Red line .
I also can't say thank you enough To David & team for accommodating our change of party size .
Would highly recommend this or other properties for future visits:)
Great place. Very clean very nice basically brand new

My son and I spent a weekend to go to Cubs games.  The location is fantastic to get to Wrigley and just a 5-minute walk to the brown line which makes it simple to get practically anywhere.  We love Lakeview and this spot is right in the middle of it.

This is a wonderful place in the heart of old town. Super walkable and fun neighborhood. Great hosts who go out of their way with instructions and responsiveness to make visiting a really great experience.
Great place
Staying at Evgenii’s was decent! It’s clean, peaceful, quiet, and private. I’d definitely recommend this Airbnb to others. Thank you so much for hosting me Evgenii!
This place is in a great location and a fun rental! Highly recommend!
cozy place, neighborhood is vibrant and full of culture! everything is within a short walk. the kitchen is great! Brad was super responsive and kind.

The place was lovely, the decor and everything else was clean and organized, our hosts were very responsive and friendly. If you’re someone who enjoys a good swing this place comes with a swing chair that was really fun to sit in! Our hosts were also kind enough to list a few restaurant suggestions definitely try the food in the area ☺️
Over all me and my partner had a lovely experience 💕
Excelente alojamiento. 100% recomendable
Amazing cozy stay in a quiet neighborhood!!

Le informazioni dell’host sono state chiare per accedere all’alloggio. La posizione è molto tranquilla seppur non centrale. Il problema principale è che il Wi-Fi non funziona e in generale basterebbe davvero poco per renderlo più pulito e confortevole.

Loved our stay! Felt very safe with the area, neighbors, parking and home. Inside was clean and comfortable. We were able to fit 2 pack and plays in one of the rooms. Couch was comfortable to sleep on. Shower nice size. Only difficulty was maneuvering into the backyard parking spot but likely user error since we’re not use to parking in more narrow areas.

Couldn’t ask for a better place to spent the weekend for a family wedding! Great for kids couldn’t get them out of the house plenty of games for them! Only a short drive to downtown! Parking wasn’t too bad just had to make a couple of rounds around the block little patience and a spot will open up! All in all 10/10 stay definitely recommend booking with Freddy!!!

I highly recommend staying at Naga & Grace’s apartment. It’s a basement apartment but has plenty of light coming in thru the front windows. The hosts are communicative and super friendly. There were lots of small amenities throughout the apartment. Mattresses were extremely comfortable. We were so impressed with how clean everything was throughout the space. Extra pillows and blankets if you need them. Short walk in a safe neighborhood to Bridgeport Coffee - we went every morning. Highly recommend if you want to stay in a lovely and quiet neighborhood. Thank you Naga and Grace - we thoroughly enjoyed our stay!
Great spot and great host

El apartamento está muy bien. En pleno barrio chino y muy cerca del metro. El único problema es que es muy ruidoso, da a las calles principales y no deja de haber ruido.
El anfitrión super atento

The apartment was great, close to the city sights and right next door to the popular restaurant Brulee! While the apartment was enjoyable, I have a few minor notes. There was no full-length mirror in the apartment, which is important when travelling with women to ensure everything is in order. The building itself had an odd smell in the hallway that was off-putting, though it wasn't related to the apartment, it was unpleasant to smell every time we stepped out. The gym was in poor condition and needs regular cleaning. The elevator was also unclean; it had a carpet with vomit stains, and all weekend, we had to ride it with the smell of Pine-Sol and vomit.
Lastly, it would be helpful to have staff present regularly, some overnight and some during the day, to address any concerns.
Overall, a great place to stay if you want to be near the heart of the city, but the building's exterior and common areas need attention.
Thank you for having us
Thanks for a great stay!

Place is as described in pictures, listings and other reviews. Note that you enter from a side alley way that's lined with garbage and recycling bins so it does not feel very welcoming. But once inside it is a very pleasant and comfortable space for us to wind down. Host Evolve is also AI chat bot through air bnb so did not feel as welcoming when asking on the day of if the place was available for early check in, but once connected to Patty who was locally in charge it had a much more personal connection. The place was clean and comfortable, hot water for shower and basic amenities. Also clean as would be hoped.
Great place to stay for the Wrigleyville experience!

We had a great stay at Carol's place. It is a lovely unit in a beautiful neighborhood. It was close to transit so our trips into the loop and other parts of the city were easy. There is a great grocery store nearby where we were able to stock up on essentials. Carol was super helpful and friendly.
Alles war wie beschrieben. Die Unterkunft hatte alles was wir brauchten. Es war nur eine 15 minütige Autofahrt bis in die Innenstadt. Großer Vorteil ist der Parkplatz.
We loved our stay! The place was clean, comfortable and conveniently located close to everything. We would definitely recommend it.
Thank you so much! The stay was spectacular and the location was perfect! 100% recommend and would stay here again :)

Absolutely loved the stay, the home was spacious and cozy, lots of options for public transit so it’s easy to get around and endless food options in any direction with a 3 block radius! Highly recommend!
Nice spot, very close to public transport which made getting around really easy!
I’ll definitely book this place again someday!

Linh and Solomon's place is absolutely as described, a beautifully decorated and well-appointed gem in the Old Town neighborhood. As hosts, they were proactive, making sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed during our stay. This home is not only spotless, but stylish and comfortable as well. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

This is the second time we have stayed at Katherine and Dimi’s place and it hopefully won’t be our last. It’s a perfect location for DePaul parents, but will totally work for anyone who wants to stay in a beautiful and vibrant neighborhood when they visit Chicago.
It’s was such an amazing place to stay!!!

An excellent place to stay! Perfect for our weekend trip. Kathleen accommodated our early check in request and was very responsive. Plenty of towels, blankets and a super comfortable bed with pillows to choose from.
Great location and rooms. Lobby and main floor are behind in the renovation, but the staff was excellent.

I loved my stay at the castle, it's a very cozy place, and Ryan was always very attentive and communicative. He offered me options in various situations, even when I had an emergency. I'll never forget my stay here, I highly recommend it! It's very well-equipped and comfortable!

Honestly one of the finest Airbnbs I’ve stayed at. The attention to detail was incredible, from the comfortable furniture, well stocked kitchen, the books, the PLAYLIST recs!! And that bathroom was just amazing. Plus, I really enjoyed the book documenting the renovation. I would definitely return. 5 stars.
Large, comfortable apartment in great neighborhood.

If I could rate more than five stars I would!
I enjoyed the space very much! Host was very responsive. Only thing which is beyond the host control is there are a ton of spiders on the outside patio. Due to me being SUPER terrified I didn’t enjoy it as much but the space is still very nice.
I WILL BE BACK AS LONG AS THE HOST ALLOWS!!!!

My family stayed at Michael’s place while we were moving our daughter into the dorm at DePaul. The parking space, spaciousness, and proximity to DePaul were perfect for our purposes. The apartment was quiet, comfortable, and well appointed. Highly recommend Michael’s place!

Great place to stay if you're looking for a spot that's quiet but easily walkable to Division! Michael was one of the most communicative and responsive hosts I've interacted with, and the whole process from check in to check out was very smooth. Highly recommend!
Muy buen alojamiento, sin ningun problema. La unica pega fue subir las maletas sin ascensor. Por lo demas perfecto.
Like it overall
amazing and reliable place

El dpto esta ubicado en una zona muy practica, cerca del transporte público, lugares turisticos, tiendas, etc. El tren es cierto que pasa ahí, debajo de la ventana pero, con las maquinas de ruido blanco (más el cansancio de haber disfrutado un dia a pleno), se descansa de 10! Está equipado con todo lo necesario para pasar unos días como si estuvieras en casa. Todo está muy limpio. El anfitrion es muy atento y siempre responde a las consultas rápida y amablemente. Se los recomiendo si quieren ir unos días a Chicago. Hermosa experiencia en nuestra primera visita a la ciudad del viento.
Great host and accommodative
Nice place to stay, very clean, modern, secure.
This is a whole apartment in a peaceful neighborhood. Had a great time staying in one night and having deep dish pizza with my fiancée. Would definitely recommend.
Clean, tidy, easily accessible and has a great place for breakfast next door. Would recommend!

I was looking for a unicorn - a place that could fit all 5 (adults) in our family with ideally 3 separate beds, with no flights of stairs (my elderly mother was with us), where we could park 2 vehicles at no cost (Chicago parking fees are outrageous), close enough to the loop where all our activities were planned for, and that it wouldn’t break the bank. Found it all in this unit, it was perfect for our needs. The neighborhood is quiet, sparse street traffic, 10-15 min from the main Chicago attractions, a covered parking garage where we could safely stow out of public sight the vehicle packed with my daughter’s move to college without having to unload all her belongings, and free street parking for our other vehicle that we were using to drive to our activities. The basement unit itself was very clean and well-decorated, the kitchen was great for cooking breakfasts every day and store dinner leftovers in the fridge. The floor was uneven from foundation issues, but it didn’t bother us.

Nice, roomy place to stay a few days.  Clear instructions on getting in and out.  Quick responses to questions.  Didn't spend a lot of time in the immediate area since I was visiting someone a couple stops away on the L, but that still made the location great for me.  A bit crowded and noisy around start / finish times of shows at nearby Aragon Ballroom, but that's a small thing

We had a wonderful stay here in Chicago! There was easy access to the Blue Line and it felt safe walking there both day and night. The apartment was well maintained and there were no issues with any of the appliances or amenities. I would definitely stay here again!
The room was small but worth the amount I paid for the room. We felt welcomed and peaceful.
great!
Beautiful home, quiet neighborhood, easy to get to. Would recommend.
Place was great! Host was also very responsive and helpful. Only tricky thing is parking but other than that it’s a comfortable place to stay at!
Disgusting and the front attendant tried to scam my card of 1000$
Excellent place to stay in a nice neighborhood that is convenient to downtown. I would stay here again every time I visit Chicago.

We loved staying here and felt right at home! Loved all the decorations and comfort. A great place to come home to after a long day. Everything was clean and location was ideal. Close to shops, restaurants and transit. Would recommend and stay here again!
Great place in a great location.  We loved our stay here.
The place was overall good. FYI there is noise from the street but I didn’t mind it. The biggest issue was the ac was making noise but other than everything else was great
Very nice place. 10 mins from downtown Chicago. Will definitely book here again.
Great place & location!
She was very prompt and responsive, very helpful and kind!

My main complaint about my stay here was the lack of cleaning in the apartment. The windows and blinds were coated in dust. The slipcovers on two living room chairs were so filthy. We ended up washing them. One bedroom did not have an AC unit. It's August in Chicago so the room was like a small sauna. Also, no coffee was provided as stated in the listing. The key to the front door and apartment is in a lockbox around the corner, hung on a gate door.  Seems like a sketchy way to check in. They will not let you check in early due to housekeeping, which is ironic. One room had a broken ceiling fan.  There's no on-premises parking, which was listed on the site. The neighborhood was nice, safe, and walkable. Definitely felt I didn't get my money's worth here.
The room was very nice and clean. The building manager was very nice and helpful.
Brad’s place was great! Felt safe, was clean, and in a very walkable area. Easy to get to Wrigley Field. Would definitely recommend!
Great and tidy spot! Tim was super easy to communicate with and responsive. A great location, safe, and fun area to stay in. Would absolutely stay here again!
Great location!  Clean accommodations. We had such a great time.

Joe’s apartment is in a beautiful, green neighborhood. The apartment is quiet and walkable to Harvest Foods, a great international grocery store, pubs, Michoacana Ice Cream and a delightful riverside walk on a park with public tennis courts and outdoor pool. It was a perfect 2 month stay in Chicago with our dog. I highly recommend it!

We had a wonderful stay at Joe’s place! The home was exactly as pictured, very comfortable, and had all the amenities we needed. We especially appreciated how well-equipped the kitchen was—it had everything we needed during our stay.
The location was great as well. We were about 20 minutes from most of the places we wanted to visit around Chicago, which made getting around very convenient. We also really enjoyed exploring Andersonville and checking out some of the great local coffee shops in the neighborhood.
Joe’s place was a great home base for our Chicago trip, and we would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting the city!
Awesome place for an awesome price.

We LOVED Julia's apartment! The neighborhood was quiet and we were always able to find a parking space in front of the building. The apartment was decorated very nicely, the temperature was comfortable and the bathrooms were clean and modern. We would absolutely stay here again!
Our trip to Chicago was wonderful. The stadium was a 10 minute walk on flat terrain. The apartment was beautiful and matched the photos. We would definitely recommend this place.

Fantastic location, a block from the blue line station, within walking distance of restaurants, stores, markets, etc. The apartment is spotless and very private. There can be some noise from the neighbors above.
Stayed there over the weekend.  Communication was great and everything was very easy. Would definitely recommend.

The stay had some merits based on the excellent communication from the host, and neighborhood location and price.
The place was situated across the street from the building with the blue spire shown prominently on the listing, which we found misleading.
The area described as bedroom 1 did not have a door and was open to the kitchen and living area.
The furnishings left us all with back pain, giga uncomfortable.
The neighborhood was lively and parking was extra difficult even though we got a useful map from Alek.
Ultimately, we had a beautiful stay in a great city.

This was such a lovely stay! The place was so cozy and the outside was beautiful as well! It was a perfect location, the pink line was a 5 minute walk so it was super easy to get places! We had a great trip thanks to a wonderful stay!
Vic was an amazing host, very responsive and eager to help out when we had questions. I’d recommend this stay to anyone.

Great location. Lincoln Park is always a convenient neighborhood in the city. The apartment was clean and accurate to the listing.
I had a minor hiccup during my stay, and Clare was quick to respond when I reached out! We found a solution quickly!
When I’m visiting the city again, I would stay here in the future.

The place was amazing and cozy! My daughter was moving into DePaul and was looking for something close. Although, the walk was much further than I had expected. I enjoyed my time here and will be returning for future visits. Thank you for a wonderful stay.

This apartment was perfect! Everything was exactly as described and it was in a great location! The beds and pillows were comfy. The apartment is super close to the L station to go into downtown and if you aren’t into using the L, the Uber ride was only 10-15 minutes. I would definitely stay here again if I came back to Chicago! There are a TON of stairs getting up to the apartment but you get used to it :)
Great location! Neighborhood was nice and easy walk to Wrigley which was why we were in town. Very clean and comfortable. We will look for this spot to stay again!

We really enjoyed our stay at Phebian’s place! Everything looked just like the photos, and the space was roomy, comfortable, and really made us feel at home. The neighborhood was quiet and residential, and we felt very safe staying here. The location was also perfect for us since we have family nearby, and having parking made everything so much easier. Overall, it was such a comfortable and convenient stay, especially for our family. We’d definitely stay here again next time we’re in the area!
Nice place to stay in Chicago!

Great Airbnb. The unit was clean and the doormen were all friendly. Easy check in progress too.
The airbnb is in a great location with the bus and close by. I loved that there was a Trader Joe’s nearby.
The area is very walkable and I felt safe even walking late at night.
Will definitely be returning when I get sent back to Chicago for work.
Everything was clean and easy! Convenient location next to the L
Had a great time

Our family absolutely loved staying at this beautiful home. David was responsive, kind, and attentive throughout our stay. It was clear that he genuinely cared about making our experience as smooth and enjoyable as possible, and made our comfort a priority. He and his wife made everyone feel welcome, including the youngest members of our group, providing a stroller, Pack ’n Play, and high chair.
The home is beautiful, spacious, and well-equipped. The kitchen had everything we needed to enjoy meals together, and we loved using the barbecue in the lovely backyard.
Our favorite gathering place was the living room with its cozy couch and large windows. It quickly became the heart of the home for our family. We spent so much time there playing, laughing, relaxing, and enjoying each other’s company. On rainy days, we loved watching the rain through the windows, while on sunny days, the natural light made the space feel warm and inviting.
We truly felt at home and can’t wait to return!
The Airbnb was very nice. I would definitely stay here again

This is a wonderful place to stay -- spacious, comfortable, and pleasant. The area is basically on the edge of redevelopment/gentrification of the East Garfield neighborhood, which has a lot of empty lots. There's not a lot nearby, but there is a very good grocery store a short walk away, and easy access to the green line and #20 bus line.  It felt safe walking in the neighborhood with a buddy. Parking on the street is easy, and J is a lovely and responsive host.

I really enjoyed my stay here. The communication with my host was phenomenal. They addressed all of my questions within a minute. The place was very well appointed.  There was a kitchen with microwave, refrigerator,  sink, silverware and plates. An assortment of tea and coffee was on counter. The bathroom was decorated with the highest quality of soaps and the shower had great water pressure. The bed was the most comfortable AirBnB bed I've ever slept in. The pillows were plush and plentiful.  The room reached my desired temperature extremely fast. There was a well stocked vending machine with an array of drinks and snacks in the lobby. I felt safe and secure due to entry with a secure code. The location was just a 2 minute walk from Union Station.  The blue subway line is around the corner. Food options are right outside the entry. I cannot recommend this place enough. I will definitely stay here again when I'm in Chicago.

My brother and I stayed at Casa Newport for a weekend to watch three Cubs baseball games. Perfect location, easy walking distance to the stadium and to bars and restaurants. I really appreciate David's proactive communication and all of the little touches that made our stay feel like home.
Peaceful, perfect to relax and see bits of Chicago
We had a perfect stay and love the location.

3 day stay at 1/2 of stay we were inflicted with rodents and rats. Wish we’d sent photos earlier for some sort of refund. But unfortunately it was hard to be comfortable in an environment where family members witnessed rats and felt the sensation of being bitten in bed z
Great place to stay!  The inside is cute and cozy. We had 3 people and were comfortable. I was surprised by how little outside noise we could hear.  I would stay here again!
Had a pretty good stay
Had a great stay! Everything was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host was friendly and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay here again!
Great place! everything was clean, instructions were clear, loved how the metro station was near by to be able to get to places :) definitely booking again when i go back !
We had an amazing time in Chicago.  People in the neighborhood were very nice.  We never had any problems getting anything delivered, or getting picked up or dropped off by Uber.

We had a wonderful stay! Communication from beginning to end was prompt, clear, and right on point. The host was very accommodating and made the entire experience easy and comfortable.
Five stars all the way around. I would definitely stay here again and would absolutely recommend this place to others. Thank you for a great Chicago stay!

My stay in Chicago was bittersweet. My girlfriend and I had a great time exploring the city, enjoying the food, festivities, and attractions. Our Airbnb, hosted by Bobbie, was highly rated, and we chose it because of its 5-star reviews. We were welcomed with a thoughtful mini basket and card, and the place was spacious and clean upon arrival. Unfortunately, the second night changed everything. While preparing to DoorDash dinner and relax, I noticed an ant crawling on my hand. We quickly discovered an abundance of ants around the door, kitchen, and throughout different areas of the house. I contacted the host, who came the next morning to place traps. Unfortunately, this felt more like a long-term solution than an immediate fix. We became cautious about where we could sit and enjoy the home. Toward the end of our four-day, three-night stay, we even noticed ants in the bedroom and bathroom. Sadly, the stay did not end well. I would visit Chicago again, but unfortunately would not use her

Alana's place was beautiful, clean, affordable, quiet, modern and stylish. I would definitely stay there again. Near transportation and local stores.
Alana was always responsive and helpful.

I enjoyed my stay here. It’s in a beautiful, safe area. It’s close to the new Obama Center as well. The space is larger than pictured. I’d definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful time. The pool was a great feature, heated with noodles and floaties. We enjoyed an afternoon relaxing in the pool before spending the next few days around the area - plenty to do around. Walkable area, family friendly. Easy commute/travel to downtown to do some activities. The hosts were wonderful and responsive. The guidebook was super helpful. The house was extremely clean and well maintained. We would stay again in a heartbeat!

Overall, the space was good. Some minor things I’d suggest to fix would be the broken couch in the living room, upstairs window needing a shade where the bed is, water pressure was low in the upstairs room, and the oven did not heat up very well.
Great location for our stay.

First time in Chicago with a family of 7 - Masooma's house is exactly what we needed.  It was spacious and clean and had everything we needed.  Masooma was quick to respond to any questions I had. Highly recommend!

The place was as described and the host was helpful. Enjoyed the open space. Neighborhood is walkable. Because it’s a corner unit, you will hear alot of the traffic late at night and early in the morning. Streets are tight but manageable. Overall enjoyed the space.
Great spot for 1 person!
房东非常友好，我们感受到了家一样的温暖。真心希望更多的人能来感受一下这个美好的房子。

We had a good stay at Louis's place. The biggest win for us was the location: it sits close to I-290, which made getting in and out of the city simple, and parking was never an issue — something you can't take for granted in Chicago.
The space itself is straightforward and comfortable, just right for a short vacation where you're out most of the day.
Thanks Louis — happy to recommend this one to anyone looking for a practical, well-located base in the city.
Great location that has so much nearby to walk to! Also comfortable beds.

Very handy location convenient to both the train and bus service.  Walkable friendly neighborhood. While unit is older, appliances are new and modern and everything was clean and functional.  Bedrooms are on the smaller side, but quiet and beds are comfortable. Ample closet space. Pet friendly. Garage is secured and very helpful.  Overall as advertised and a good stay!
The place was as described and very spacious. Checkin-checkout was as convenient as possible. Vin was very responsive. Nice, safe neighborhood with lots of food options. Overall a nice stay!

The room is perfect for a quick visit.
The bed is comfortable.

The place was nice, and the host was super supportive. When we couldn't find the parking lot, they were willing to call and helping us out. That's why I want to give them 5 stars.

Although the host gave us a clear instructions on how to find the airbnb, it's still hard to locate the destination. I was lost and need helped from my dad.

Great place for family and friends visiting DePaul students! Quite and super convenient:)
This is a nice place, professionally cleaned, great location.

This Airbnb was absolutely lovely! The area is very nice, the apartment is spacious and has everything you need and the host was perfectly communicative !
Went here for a girls trip and had such a nice time. The place was very clean and spacious. We would definitely stay here again !

Our stay at Hanna & Mark’s was fabulous. They were amazing hosts. The place was exactly as shown. Beautiful & clean. Hanna & Mark were great hosts, very quick to respond & super accommodating. Great hosts, clean property, and very responsive. Would stay with them again!

This unit was everything we hoped it’ll be! Studebecker was a great host, as he would check in daily to make sure everything was going well, as well as a fast responder. The location was perfect for our trip and if we’re ever in the area again, we would definitely reserve this unit again!

Beware. It’s not what it looks like in the pictures. If you want a Temu Airbnb, this is it. The shades are disposable paper throwaway shades. Sewage dripping from the ceiling out of a pipe. Always a pleasure to stay at Kenneth’s.
Awesome stay and a wonderful host. I would recommend 10/10.
Great place!

We had a wonderful stay! The place is gorgeous and the neighborhood was fantastic. There was one small hiccup with the parking, but Jennifer was EXTREMELY responsive and able to get things sorted quickly. I would recommend this place a hundred times over and will definitely try to stay here next time I’m back in town!
Felt like home with great views

Overall this is a solid place to crash on a budget. It is clean, walkable to transit, and Phoebe + team are excellent communicators and went above and beyond to provide local recommendations. The AC is strong and we were comfortable. The noise from the street is less than expected and a non-factor. There are PLENTY of linens and towels, which was much appreciated. They also had several fans available for use. The single bathroom has a very strong exhaust fan which can be crucial when sharing with 4 other guys..
There is room to improve the beds. They are, to be blunt, terrible. The bunk-bed frame is low quality and squeaks loudly with minor movements, the mattresses have child bed-wetting plastic covers, and one of the beds has widely spaced vertical slats supporting the mattress, which was super uncomfy. The pull-out is good as far as pull-outs go. The kitchen has basic plate settings and cooking utensils but nothing as far as a pantry that we could find (no oil, salt, pepper).

My wife and I had a wonderful stay here.  The location is excellent for walking to everything Chicago has to offer from restaurants, the park, the lake, downtown, grocery/convenient stores, etc.  We always look for a place that is walkable and this place delivered!  Anyone looking for a simple place that will allow you to easily spend your time walking to all the best neighborhoods will love this place!

Great location near a lot of unique shops, restaurants, and cafes! Super comfortable beds! The host and his team were super responsive and checked in with us to be sure we had what we needed. If you’re picky, know that the photos present a bit nicer/newer than the unit itself. But overall we were satisfied with our stay.
Great location and stay!

It was very clean and about a 10 min walk from the green line. I would stay there again

Stayed for an entire weekend and had a lovely time. Alma was quite responsive and accommodating. The place was clean and felt cozy. It’s also right next to the train station which made it very accessible to the main attractions. Would definitely be coming again!

Great very quaint place with multiple air conditioners to keep you cool during some of the hottest days in Chicago.  Excellent location with tons of walk ability and easy to get around with public transit.
The listing is just as described and Blad has been a pleasure to work with.

We loved our stay here.  Great to be able to walk into Old Town, the Chicago Museum and Lincoln Park which were all close by.  Lots of great restaurants, people and dog watching!  Bed was very comfortable.  Would stay again for sure!

Amazing stay! The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything was well organized, and I felt right at home from the moment I arrived. I would absolutely stay here again!
Alex was a great host and his property was exactly as described. I would definitely stay here again as it was so affordable for a walkable area
I greatly enjoyed my stay. The home craftsmanship, design and finishes are irreplaceable.

Simple and has the very basics, but lacked more accurate description. We stayed in the Queen bedroom and although it notes that there is AC in the unit, the room did not have any vents, and was very stuffy. There is a ceiling fan, but was so noisy that it disturbed our sleep. The space was clean and neat, but unfortunately the guests who stayed in the space at the same time as us were not very cleanly, which is no fault to the hosts, but a part of staying in a shared space, I guess. Hosts were very responsive and kind. Strict about check-out time.

Three of us stayed at Pratik's place for eleven days and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Pratik was exceptionally helpful and communicative throughout. The place suffered a plumbing emergency just before our arrival, but Pratik handled the situation beautifully by putting us up temporarily at an even more spacious AirBnB in Wrigleyville and offering us a partial refund for those days. Emergencies happen but the way Pratik handled this one was exemplary.
Pratik's place is as described and we found it very comfortable. We loved its location on a peaceful, tree-lined street and its proximity to public transit. Lots of cafes and restaurants are within walking distance; we particularly enjoyed Del Seoul restaurant, Aura Roastery and Ludlow Charlington's. It's also less than a mile and a half walk to Wrigley Field from here; we walked to a Cubs game on our last day in Chicago and PCA obliged by hitting a pair of homers! It was the perfect end to a wonderful time in a great city.

Nice area. Friendly neighbors. Nice central location in relation to either end of the city. Smaller than expected. Wish the bathrooms had updated shower doors vs shower curtains. Nice being able to wash the towels and other Irina as needed.

Amazing apartment, even better than the pictures! The wifi was a little slow and we had trouble hosting a zoom call. Otherwise, everything was perfect. Thomas was very helpful and checked in throughout the weekend. The location was great and the rooftop was stunning. Would highly recommend!

This was by far the worst Airbnb experience I have ever had. The place was not clean and smelled awful. The bedding did not seem be getting washed in between guests and there was a cockroach in the fridge and bugs throughout the house.

Nick was the best Airbnb host we ever had. He drove us to the cubs game and my husband forgot his diabetic supplies at the house and he brought them back to us! Over the top host in a great location! 10 star review!
A little outdated but the host is very communicative and kind.

Loved our stay here.  Clean, super comfortable, quiet.  We were in Chicago to participate in an art fair and this was a perfect place to return to each day.  Location was central to many other areas of the city too and we enjoyed that too.  Would definitely stay here again.
We had a wonderful weekend in Chicago. Anne’s condo is beautiful, stylish and very comfortable.

This place was gorgeous and was in a very walkable area. It was perfect for getting around downtown and there were plenty of businesses nearby. Geo was very helpful and responsive throughout the stay. Would definitely stay here again.
value for the money
Great location near the train and restaurants/bars that were walkable. Space was comfortable and perfect for relaxing between excursions.

This was my first time staying here and I thought the location was great. Just right outside the west loop but also close to the train station and river north. It is very walkable, convenient and the apartment itself was very cozy and felt like an elevated hotel experience.

Fabiana was an excellent, flexible host who made me and my partner feel right at home. Check-in and checkout were smooth and painless. The neighborhood around the unit is beautiful, comfy and full of great food and fun businesses. Would absolutely recommend.

Great location for a show at Old Town School of Folk - walkable to a variety of decent restaurants and coffee shops, easy to get around the neighborhood, Lyft pickups almost immediately.  Clean apartment, washer and dryer are a nice touch.  Perfect for our family of four with two teens.

What an amazing place in Wrigleyville. We loved staying here and had such an easy walk to the Cubs game, great restaurants, and coffee shops. All walkable.
The host was a great communicator and made the whole process super easy!
I would definitely book this place again for my next Cubs game.
We fell in love with Chicago while staying here! The area is perfect- close to everything but very quiet and private. Would return in a heartbeat

The plastic vertical slat blinds throughout were dirty, damaged, or missing, giving the surrounding building unobstructed views into bedrooms. This is off putting as the high rise across the street is a federal prison, and we often observed inmates looking down at and trying to signal to us with their room and cell phone lights. I raised this to Cyndi who replied that maintenance can’t fix the blinds on Sundays. The broken blinds stand out and it’s hard to imagine why these haven’t been fixed. Please note that the prison building has been airbrushed out of some of the pictures showing the city view—bizarre and borderline deceptive. Carpets are becoming threadbare and need replacement, walls and ceilings are scuffed and dented throughout. Building and neighborhood are fine and walkable, and the interior is truly unique. However for nearly $500 a night this was a big disappointment. I would not return nor recommend it without a major revamp.

Alma’s place was comfortable and just as described. The amenities were listed and, though we only ate breakfast in, all the necessities utensils are available to cook meals.
It was a perfect location for those we wanted to see and what we had to do. The neighborhood is lively and friendly with a nearby grocery store and pharmacy. Many restaurants, bars and shops were within a few minutes walk. If you need to go downtown or elsewhere, there’s a train station nearby and multiple bus routes.

Love the atmosphere, the location, and the cleanliness. Everything was all there just like in the description. It's  a nice place too. The only thing I would've changed was the flights of stairs we had to go up 😅

nice stay on the north side pretty peaceful matched the description but what u will say is if im paying good money i should be able to get tissue, towels , ect when i need it im paying you so next time meet your guest accommodations thanks
Very comfortable, clean stay! Ben was very responsive. Would definitely stay again!

Fun stay! Great walkable area and coach house all to myself.   Loved to sit outside on porch.  Felt very safe as a single female.  Neighbors were very sweet and inclusive.  Was invited to block party!  Will be staying again 👍

Incredibly clean, beautifully renovated and well supplied apartment.  We really felt at home here!  The neighbors were very friendly and helpful and the location was perfect for hoping on the red line and going downtown or staying local and walking to Andersonville.  We were able to park our class B van on the street for the week with no issues!  We would definitely stay here again!

The home was spacious, central, and was perfect for our stay. Nabil was super communicative and gave us clear instructions. He was also very responsive to any questions we had. The location itself is very central and walkable. Would certainly recommend!

David’s place was exactly as depicted in the listing, well appointed with really cool interior design. Comfortable furniture and bed, very clean throughout. Easy check-in and check out. We would def stay here again when in the area.

Loved my stay here! Chic, clean, cozy, and perfect location in the city. Thought I would want the larger bedroom, but the natural light in the smaller room was too cozy. The thoughtful recommendations in the guidebook were the cherry on top. Highly recommend!

Best air bnb that I have ever been to. Overall everything was taken care of for us if we needed anything while staying in Simon's beautiful home. Simon is a wonderful host. I hope to book here everything I go to Chicago.

Location was perfect in proximity to Wrigley! The AC units were amazing and we were also delighted to find the unit had a fan as well (we are avid fan users for sleeping). The space fit all of our needs and was quieter than anticipated, which we really appreciated. Thank you for the great stay!

This place was great in all respects. Spacious, pretty decorations, nice kitchen and fantastic location in West Town/Ukrainian Village. Christina was really flexible about check-in and very quick to respond. Would definitely stay there again when visiting Chicago!

They were aware of how many people were in our party, but didn’t have pull out ready. Stains on rug were gross. Cooking essentials not provided as advertised and “gym” room was empty. Construction noise extreme. Offered 10% off next stay, then ghosted.
Great local spot. The host was responsive and welcoming. The loft was super cute and comfy. Definitely will be booking again 😊
Great place to stay!

Geo was a wonderful host! He gave clear instructions on how to find the apartment and communicated very effectively whenever needed. The Airbnb was very clean and located in a great area of Chicago. I had a great experience and would definitely recommend staying here!

I’m super happy that my first AirBnB rental was such a success. Was easy & straight forward from the beginning. The host was nice and communicated quickly.
Their home is so cute and cozy! We especially liked the high ceiling. The rooftop was very nice to just sit out and enjoy the view of the lake.

Thank you again for such a memorable experience!

I went to Chicago to help my daughter move and Rida’s apartment was the perfect place to land! It was comfortable, clean, and bright. Was able to make meals in the very accessible kitchen. And the bed and pillows were very comfy!

Nice place to stay, no complaints
The apartment was exactly as described.   It’s in a great location and provided a perfect spot to stay when moving our daughter to Chicago.

We had a great time, it was a great location and the host was very responsive as well gave us very thorough detailed instructions which were super helpful. Absolutely loved the area, close to a drug store and grocery store as well as several places to eat and the most beautiful liquor store I’ve ever been in. Walkable to Chinatown and the orange line.
Nice private room and bathroom. Olga was lovely to deal with and very responsive. Private parking was a nice addition too.
Excellent response time, I felt right at home here. Easy to check in and just a short distance from restaurants and the downtown area. I would definitely check in here again, highly recommend.
Great place with lots of food and things nearby !
Excellent location. Lots of thoughtful touches. Will definitely stay again.
I had a great time staying at Marissa’s place. Very responsive and easy to reach.

The place was very clean and it was well decorated. Kitchen was well equipped.

She is an awesome host. I was veey blessed to find a great place like this one.

I would highly recommend this beautiful property.  Peter was a fantastic host and the house was perfect.  It was clean, perfect location to Wrigley and never needed to use our car the entire weekend.  Thanks again Peter

nice place and neighborhood but place was musty and needs a dehumidfier.

Loved that there are two separate bathrooms. The location was excellent, super close to the redline which was great because I had luggage and it was a hot weekend. AC/Fan worked fast and loved that I was able to change it based to which room I wanted it in.
Great apartment, very clean and comfortable. Good location and a beautiful rooftop. We really enjoyed our stay!
Great place! Wouldn’t mind staying here again

Don’t even think twice, just book it! This place is fantastic. Great location, plenty of free parking if you need it, and the shower pressure alone is reason enough for me to come back. The beds were super comfy, and the pull-out couch had everything needed. The kitchen was stocked with filtered water and all the amenities you could want. The owners were quick to respond, and check-in/check-out was a breeze.
This is an absolutely beautiful, clean, updated space. The bed was incredibly comfortable. The bathroom was updated and perfectly clean. The AC worked incredibly well in the entire space.
Felt really peaceful staying here! Really comfortable space in a cute neighborhood!
Really enjoyed the location, and the nice layout/ features/ decor. Kate was helpful and friendly. Zero issues. Would definitely consider staying again with Kate.  Thank you so much!!
Had a wonderful stay in this stunning apartment.
Was a great stay, worth the price, good location for exploring Chicago.
Great place in Bucktown! Just as described, comfortable and close to everything! We had a great stay would highly recommend.

Place was great. As advertised

Such a wonderful stay! The host was incredibly warm and welcoming, the place was beautifully and stylishly decorated, and everything was spotless and very clean. We felt comfortable from the moment we arrived and would definitely stay here again!
It was fun to stay in a b&b in Cago

The location is excellent and the unit was basically as described and in spotless condition. For the price, I agree with other previous reviews that cons are: 1) you can hear everything loudly in the hall just outside and feels like a loud dormitory, 2) the really bright light coming in around the doorframe during the night while trying to sleep is really unfortunate and easy to fix, and 3) it was more of an “efficiency” type of unit with not much actual useable space. The host company uses the Virtual Assistant feature which didn’t really work well when two different issues came up that needed resolution. I had to repeat things in the chat a few times and call Airbnb support during my stay to get a real person to check the chat. Kind of a repetitive disruption. Excellent location! Great walkable to many places, easy to get to major Chicago sights! Perfect space for 2, would stay here again!
I'll recommend this place

This spot is excellent for someone looking for a quiet, private space. There are two bedrooms with plenty of room, and everything is kept clean. The host is super responsive as well!
If you’re trying to explore Chicago there is a bus stop right next to the Airbnb and it’s not a bad walk to the L train station either.
Becas Place was Perfect We stayed for the BTS Concert and was definitely easy to get to Soldier Field from the Airbnb using CTA, Really enjoyed our short stay 👍

I really enjoyed our stay here. I found the the unit to be very comfortable, and the building was conveniently located somewhere within 15-20 mins from everything we wanted to see. There were some mild issues with parking but ultimately we always managed to find a spot within a minute or two from the main entrance. Noticed what seemed to notice a couple of cars that had a shattered window on two different dates but honestly it didn’t deter my experience or make me feel unsafe just because you really never the why. Also many restaurants and cafes are nearby as well and the neighborhood was quite quaint.

My four friends and I had an outstanding experience at Monica’s home! It was clean, spacious, very well appointed and the roof deck was spectacular, with a view of downtown to boot. Monica, if you’re reading this, please let us know what brand the mattresses in the bedrooms are as everyone in our party made a point of saying they were outstanding!
Whether you’re searching for a place to host a large group, cook good meals, or otherwise relax and have a great night’s sleep this place is hard to beat! We will definitely be back next time we’re in Chicago.

It was just a wonderful experience. The place was very beautiful. The floors spotless. Minh was very helpful and responsive. He really made us feel at home.
This is the first time using an Airbnb and the experience has been beautiful. My wife wants to use the place as yearly getaway because she fell in love right away with the place.
It was truly an experience and we thank Minh for that.
Thank you for making our family happy and feel at home.

Cool building in a beautiful neighborhood with a short walk to the lake. Pretty well supplied for an airbnb. Beds were pretty solid, too. The layout's a bit awkward if you're using all three beds but it's doable
It was just as advertised and in a nice safe location near Loyola’s campus. Will definitely stay again!

Lots of walkable places, Stacie was great with our accommodations. Very quick with responding and friendly. Loved the neighborhood feel and walkable distance to the train. Would definitely book again.
Ro’s place is awesome, super easy to get to, very walkable, quiet, and great for families!

Our first time in Chicago and preferred to not be cramped in a hotel room. Our stay in Hien’s place was amazing! Great area, accessible to restaurants, metro, good vibes neighborhood. He was very accommodating and responsive. Place was clean, cozy and well maintained. Would stay here again in the future!

Once we figured out which lockbox belonged to our unit, everything went smoothly. The host was very responsive and quickly helped us sort it out.
The apartment was as described, in a great location, and overall we had a very good stay. A couple of things to be aware of:
The bathroom setup isn’t quite what I would consider two full bathrooms plus a half bath:
Bathroom 1: toilet, sink, and shower
Bathroom 2: toilet and sink
Bathroom 3: sink and shower
Also, the apartment is on the 4th floor with no elevator.
Overall, I would highly recommend this place if the bathroom configuration and stairs aren’t an issue for you. Great location and a responsive host.

Loved Ryans condo. Stayed for 30 days in August and could not have asked for a better place. Clean, quiet, comfortable and well equipped with everything needed for a great stay. Neighborhood is safe and walkable to gym, shopping, restaurants and brown line to downtown Chicago. Will definitely stay here again.

Classic Chicago walk-up apartment! Was very clean & bed was super comfortable. The host was very attentive in making sure I was comfortable . parking was somewhat limited in front , but there was a spot hero lot at a church only a block away & the neighborhood was very walkable.  I didn’t have time to use the kitchen , but it had nice appliances & also very clean . I was in town to visit family, but it seemed like there were a lot of local places nearby.. All in all, I had a very pleasant stay & would definitely stay there again next time I’m in town!

I stayed at John’s place for a series of concerts at Soldier’s Field and it was the perfect location for walking back and forth! Easy access to transit, restaurants, and grocery stores as well. The apartment was as described and was super cozy. It was pretty hot and muggy outside during my stay but there was central AC along with a window AC unit in the bedroom and a powerful fan in the living area, so I was never uncomfortable. John was super quick to respond to messages and very friendly. Easy check-out instructions. Overall a great stay, I would visit again!

If you are planning on going to a Cubs game, this is the place for you. Two blocks and you are in the stadium. Don is a very accommodating and communicative host that had set up a beautiful home for the stay. We had everything we needed and would absolutely stay again.

A Novel Situation is simply a really terrific place to stay. It's quite evident that David put a lot of thoughtful care into making it comfortable and at the same time very functional. His communication was very clear and thorough. The flat was spotless upon check-in. The kitchen was fully supplied and included nice, unexpected touches like coffee/sweetener/creamer, as well as Brita-filtered water and sodas in the fridge. The bed is comfortable, and, unlike many one-bedroom rentals, the bedroom itself is sufficiently large such that it allowed us to move around and keep track of our stuff without feeling cramped. An easy walk will get you to all there is to do right there in Wrigleyville/Lakeview (including the Lakeshore) as well as to the L and buses if you're looking to get to the Loop or the museums.
All in all, a Novel Situation was an ideal place for our needs. And, if you forgot that book you wanted to chill with, peruse the bookcase as you'll have plenty of options!

A group a friend's  and I visited Chicago for a BTS concert.  Everything was lovely in the home, central air worked great,  cozy clean beds and a nice size kitchen for cookng.  We will definitely will stay here again.

If you’re looking for a nice, quiet place to stay while in Chicago, definitely book Emily’s place. My friends and I really enjoyed the home and it felt like home.

Axel's place was clean and comfortable.  Kitchen was immaculate compared to some others we have stayed in.  Easy  to get to grocery, Brown Line, or Lincoln Square proper.  Definitely would stay there again.
Loved this airbnb! Super clean & quiet! Very peaceful environment, easy FREE parking, & very sweet people.
The place is spacious and not too far from downtown. Brandi was gracious enough to accommodate a late checkout. All and all we had a great stay.
Great place and location. Very response as well! Thank you

Easy to find. Just like the listing. Very close to the subway station for easy getting around.
