Good place to stay for the weekends. Quiet and looks safe. It’s pretty convenient the train station about two blocks from the place.
Loved the place. It was perfect for a few days in Chicago and there is so much to do nearby. Would stay again!

If you are intown to see the Cubs, book this place. We spent 3 days watching games and hanging out in bars/restaurants in Wrigleyville, and it was AMAZING to be able to quickly walk home to change or put down bags so we didn't need to carry them everywhere. I cannot recommend this location enough for access to Wrigley Field.
Great place to stay at Chicago. The place is very comfortable and well designed. Parking can be difficult, specially at night.

Sue was a fantastic host, and the place was absolutely wonderful! Street parking was never an issue, which was a huge plus. Sue definitely had her guests in mind when setting up her Airbnb. I brought my toothbrush but forgot toothpaste—and she had it! Forgot lotion, shampoo, or soap? No problem, it was all there!
The linens were top-of-the-line, and even the little extras, like grab-and-go snacks and cereal with milk for breakfast, were such a thoughtful touch. You can really tell that Sue put a lot of thought into making her guests feel comfortable and at home.
I will definitely be staying here again and highly recommend this Airbnb!

Nice place in a great location.  Parking is convenient.  Stocked with plenty of coffee choices.  Nice sized bedrooms and beds.  Overall it's a very nice and clean apartment. It was very loud. But the owner does warn you of this in the listing, so I was aware before renting.  I would definitely suggest they put TVs in the bedrooms. People like me find it easier to sleep with TV noise than train and traffic noise. So it would help mask that.  Plus I think all vacation rental should have TVs in the bedroom.

Jamie was a delightful host! It's so rare to be met at the door when you arrive these days, and Jamie not only did that, but also have us a tour and explained some features, along with some great historical facts about the assets and restaurant recommendations. She even turned the AC on for us every day before we returned from our outings. I would love to stay here again!

Barbara’s place is in a perfect location. You are right across the street from Wicker Park and the fantastic Sunday market. So close to great coffee shops, restaurants, and shopping. If catching the train to and from the airport or anywhere on the blue line the train station is about a 5 min walk. Barbara checks in on you, very responsive to any questions you may have and has great recommendations. When I come back to Chicago I will stay here again. All the best and thank you for everything. Great trip!
Great location. Friendly and helpful staff. Comfortable bed!
Merci à bientôt
We had a really great stay. The location was amazing. Everything was so nice and the host is amazing. Thank you for having us!

Convenient location but not the best area. Once inside, it was nice and cozy. Only complaint: cookwares (pots/pans) were very old and scratched up and need updating. Brad was very responsive, friendly and polite in our communications.
Great stay beautiful home

Although the space felt a bit smaller than I was expecting for 2, it worked well. Location is fantastic (within the loop and by ALL L lines) and it truly has everything you need and it’s clean! Check in is easy as can be and the listing was accurate (the listed amenities were actually accessible like gym and rooftop!). The security guard for the bldg was an added plus. Very helpful and friendly.

We enjoyed our stay and highly recommend it for its convenient location to public transit,  walkability to local businesses, comfort, and cleanliness. The parking spot was a huge plus as well. The space had everything we needed and more such as water bottles and snacks. We hope to stay here again in the future!
Rida’s instructions made it easy to check-in and check out. It was quiet and extremely clean making it an enjoyable place to come back to each evening.

We stayed to enjoy Chicago, including the Obama Center, which was only a couple of miles away. The property was centrally located to everywhere we wanted to go. It was clean, peaceful, and perfect for the four of us. In addition, everything we needed was provided; water toothpaste, snacks, plenty of towels, washer and dryer.
We will be booking this place whenever we visit Chicago. This host comes highly recommended!
Very nicely put together, thoughtful and tasteful.
Beautiful and interesting home, quiet, helpful instructions from Ryan. Thank you!
Great for the price especially for one person passing through. Bed was comfortable and the box fan available made the temperature perfect.
Great Place, Great Location

This multi-apartment building is great for large groups, however, I wouldn’t recommend toddlers with all the open stairwells. Rooms and amenities are as described. I would strongly caution visitors about the area the building is in. I had 4 of my guests leave and get hotel rooms because they simply did not feel comfortable with some of the things that were happening on the street, and in the abandoned lot right next door. It was not a relaxing environment. Property was very clean except for the floors.  Don’t go barefoot or even with socks.  The wood floors were very dirty and jagged in a lot of spots and under beds had not been swept.  We found a hat and socks (not ours) and large food crumbs under some beds.
Loved our stay here!
Great place and location. Easy access and clean.

We had a great stay! The host was super responsive and quick to answer any questions. The beds were so comfy, and the place was clean, cozy, and welcoming. We also really enjoyed the backyard. It was such a nice space to hang out and relax. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would definitely recommend staying here!

My family and I had an amazing stay! The hosts were wonderful, extremely accommodating, and always responded in a timely manner. The location was great, and the space was clean, comfortable, and very spacious. I had absolutely no issues during my stay and truly enjoyed my experience from start to finish. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a great place to stay and extremely close to the downtown area!

We planned on staying for a month at Kasa, and when we arrived our room had the furniture still in boxes waiting to be built. The front desk person downstairs tried her best, but the customer service hotline employees were rude and unhelpful. We ended up getting sent to a different Kasa location for the night until they could resolve our room troubles and when we arrived to the alternate location, our room was under someone else’s name and no one was at the check in desk.
A few days after finally being back at the location we booked, our electricity for just our unit went out, not the whole building and maintenance couldn’t fix it that day, and wanted to come back the next day. The only reason I’m giving them 2 stars instead of 1 is because they did end up refunding the remainder of our month stay (3 weeks). The onsite staff is very kind, but the company doesn’t seem to be set up enough to be renting out their space. Fair warning…
Great location and a reasonable price 😆
Second time we have stayed here while visiting family in Chicago. Every amenity in place, every comfort considered!
The stay was excellent, the apartment was all nice and clean, we were happy With this great place.

We had a great stay at Marco’s place. He was responsive and communicative throughout our stay. The apartment is well-stocked, roomy and clean. It’s in a good location, walking distance to a park and just a short drive to a few stores and restaurants. Would recommend staying here!
Good stay, clean and tidy place check in was easy check out was easier overall 5 stars.
Very nice community comfortable bed hotel type pillows. Many walkable choices of restaurants & shops.

I stayed here with my girls for my bachelorette trip and it was absolutely lovely! Garrett surprised us with snacks and drinks during our stay and they were a hit! The space is beautiful and the house came with everything you would need- dishes, towels, soap, steamer, etc. Plenty of pillows and blankets provided and fit all 10 of us comfortably. I used to live in Logan Square, so I knew the area already, but Garrett provided us with a list of all the nearby recommendations. Logan Square is a great neighborhood for families and friends who want to be out of the downtown busy area. Additionally, the garage was spacious for our group to fit both of our cars. Self check in was quick & easy! I would absolutely stay here again!

Honestly the Airbnb isn’t too bad, everything as listed. We personally decided to take the loss and book somewhere else since we ain’t feel comfortable in the area. Walls are thin, so you can hear people upstairs moving around and crying. Entrance was a little spooky but once you get into the Airbnb actually door it isn’t that bad. Born and raised in the suburbs and never been in a unkept community, with abandoned buildings and overgrown grass and no driveway/ private parking, thus our fear factor might have been slightly higher, didn’t want our car broken into so we just booked into a hotel downtown. The host was very nice and quick to respond. Even though it didn’t work for us it might work for you. 🤷‍♂️
Great stay

The rental is very well kept and well located. It’s definitely as advertised: clean and nicely furnished. There are lots of shopping and food options on the same street as the rental. Conveniently located between two major train lines and only a few blocks from one you can take to and from the Midway airport (with one easy transfer). Though the street the building is on is very active, the room itself was quiet and felt private. The rental agency has an automated system that sends timely messages which worked just fine. The instructions on how to get into the unit were easy to follow, especially given there were quite a few steps. The only thing I’d hazard to nitpick is a lack of natural light, not really a big deal, but something to keep in mind if you’re worried at all about sleeping in by accident.
Beautiful clean home with great amenities and extra toiletries if you forgot yours . I would stay there again!

Mike's place was perfect for our visit to Chicago! The location was nice and only a short walk from the blue line into the city. The space was clean, comfortable and there were even games and a dart board! Would definitely recommend!

I’ve stayed in several AirBnB’s in the last year but this one was not what I quite expected. The floors and corners of the room were dirty/dusty with some hair around, trash bags for bathroom/bedrooms were not provided. There were no toiletries provided, just towels (4 to be exact). Unclear instructions on where to park and where to toss the trash at the end of our stay. The upstairs neighbor was noisy, especially at night. Was definitely expecting more for the value of the AirBnB.

Perfect location! Only a 3 minute walk from the train and there were many food options in the area. Only a 30 minute train ride to the loop and other touristy spots. The host was also very kind and responsive. Would definitely love to come back and stay here.

Cute and cozy place! Loved walking around the area - so many nearby cute cafes and restaurants. It's also near the blue line so getting there from the airport was a breeze and it's very easy to get into downtown!

If I could give 6 stars I would.  Jennifer’s apartment was everything we hoped for. It was a great place for us to stay while visiting some friends in Chicago. It was about a 5-7 min walk off the red line, lake access is at the end of the street, the building apartment was quiet.  The area felt very safe and quiet. It was not difficult for us to get into the apartment with keys/keypads. The apartment is on the 3rd floor with no elevator access which didn’t bother us. The apartment was beautifully decorated, she provided a Brita for water, welcome snacks and personal slippers.  Jennifer was very accommodating and responsive to any questions. Would highly recommend.
Nice new showers. The space was great and close to a lot of things..

We loved our stay at Kyriako's place.  Everything was cozy and comfortable and exactly as described.  Easy to access the unit and great location convenient to Old Town.  Thank you!  Would stay again.  Definitely better than any hotel in the immediate area.

My partner and I had a great stay at Cihan’s, especially coming from an emergency relocation. The host was friendly, clear and responsive, the answer to our questions always at our fingertips. While we may have been exhausted and frazzled upon entering, we arrived to a tidy unit with all the necessities — Not to mention, prime location with quick access to public transit and a beautiful residential surroundings for our evening walks! The Jewel-Osco across the street is open 24 hours so anything we needed was just a simple outing away. See, this trip was a huge milestone for myself and my partner to celebrate 10 years of long distance dating. Cihan saved the day when things went awry with our previous booking so we’ll certainly consider staying here again next time we’re in Chicago.

We stayed at Kati's condo for the month of August, our daughter had her first baby, and she lives just a 5 min walk from Kati's. Very convenient for us. The time we were at Kati's was very enjoyable! Very light and bright, comfortable beds and very well stocked. We felt very fortunate to have been able to stay at her wonderful property and wouldn't hesitate to stay again! Thank You Kati!

This apartment was perfect for our family visit - three comfortable bedrooms, a great kitchen and living area, super close to lots of activities and restaurants and great directions from our host. Marco was super responsive and flexible when we arrived early by mistake and a very prompt communicator.  We'll definitely book again.

We loved this location! Carlos was easy to work with. The unit was the perfect size for my family of 4. It was clean, bedding was comfortable, extra towels. And the best location in Wrigleyville. We will definitely rebook when we come back next season for another Cubs game!

The location of this apartment is completely unbeatable. Super fun neighborhood, with unreal amounts of diverse restaurants around the corner, down the block, 5 minutes away...the food options are truly amazing. Great shopping nearby too. Tremendous value for this terrific neighborhood. The host was communicative, the place was very clean and quiet. I would happily stay here again, wish we could have stayed longer.

We really enjoyed our stay! When booking, we were a little concerned about the proximity to the train, but any noise just sort of folded into the regular hum of the city. Didn’t bother any of us, even at night when sleeping.
The location is great! A short walk to Wrigley Field and lots of other fun stuff. Would definitely stay again.
Great place to stay.
Perfect location. Everything is walkable, would- and probably will stay again!

This was the perfect location for the weekend activities I was attending at the Epiphany Center for the Arts.  Easy walk to restaurants, bookstores and fun shops.  Highly recommend this little treasure in the Ukrainian Village.
Brad was a great host made sure I was comfortable and if I needed anything.

Literally door to door on the Blue line from O’Hare.  2 blocks to the riverfront and easily walkable to a lot of sights.  L is a bit noisy if that’s not your thing.  The amenities at Cloud9 were great. Pool, hot tub, workout room, and nice outdoor seating on the top floor.  A great place if you want to be close to all the downtown riverfront has to offer.
Cute place in a cute residential neighborhood near Loyola. Clean and comfortable.

There’s place was great. Easy to navigate. Target and Walgreens walkable.
The street out front can get a little busy at times so if you order an uber walk down to the light or Walgreens so you don’t get caught. Other than that we had a great stay

My friends and I had a very enjoyable stay here. It’s a beautiful place, tastefully done. It also feels very safe and secure. The included garage parking is a big plus. I just parked the car and we Ubered it everywhere after that. Door to door service is my personal preference vs having to drive, find and pay for parking every time. Just an FYI though, the other car in the two car garage is a big pick-up truck and I drive a full size SUV so it was a real challenge squeezing in, especially because of how narrow the back alley is.
Communication was most excellent. I really liked how they checked in to see how things were going. I had one small request which they were so good to take care of. I really appreciated it because it made my stay so much more comfortable.
All in all I highly recommend this “Breathtaking & Bright Designer 2bd with Garage” for your stay in Chicago. I would definitely stay here again myself.

If you want a real taste of Chicago.  We parked in the space provided and didn't go to our car until it was time to check out.   We walked,  took the L Train and took Uber.   Food was plentiful. Corner for Excellent Breakfast.   Tacos just under us.  Patio for outside vibe great!!!!   Stairs are plentiful as shown in photos.   Didn't have to go to the gym🤣😅  just go up and down the stairs.    Loved this place.  We will return again!  We'll worth the amount!     Thank you Seth!!!

We had a great stay! The space was perfect for me and my two daughters. The beds & linens were extremely comfortable!
The location was perfect for getting to all of our planned activities and had lots of great spots within walking distance

Regina is great, easy Check in and really great spot. Quiet area walking distance to restaurants, and short bike ride or scooter ride to Wrigley for baseball game.
The couch and chairs in living room seem older and much more used than what is shown in photos. Furniture could use upgrade.
Otherwise wonderful spot to stay to visit city.

Great host, neat and clean place with everything in it and the price is a great deal. The only comment I have is about the area not safe enough to rely public transportation. You should either have a car or take uber. The train is close and that created a bit of noise but tolerated. You can still sleep peacefully
In a great neighborhood! Super comfy spot - would book again!

Our group of three had a lovely time at Susan’s garden unit. The location was perfect to visit a friend in Lincoln Square, which was easily within walking distance. Everything was very walkable, green and calming. We had no issues driving our rental car to and from Soldier Field for a concert. Even with packed parking along the neighborhood streets, we always managed to find a spot within a few blocks. There were plenty of amenities, everything was spotless, and the beds were really comfortable! Susan was also very friendly and kind. We had a great stay and would recommend it to anyone.

This place was exactly what My Wife and I needed. The room isn’t that big but it’s all we needed. Nice bathroom and a TV. We were able to drop off our bags before the check-in time. They did get us checked in a couple hours early which was nice. The host was very attentive with request for places to eat, etc. Perfect location within walking distance from tons of really nice shopping and restaurants. We had a great time and we will definitely be back.
Such an iconic property! Very vintage and curated!
Had a great stay !

The place is in a very quiet neighborhood.  It is also close to places to eat and public transportation, bus #66.  The bed needs to be more comfortable and the t. In the bedroom needs to function.  Besides that it's a cozy place and definitely quiet.

Our second time staying here and hopefully won’t be the last. Just a great little place - so comfortable, clean and in a great location. Close to Wrigley and the great vibe around the area. Easy to busses/trains. Easy walk to shopping in Southport. Just a cool spot to stay for awhile.

We have lived in the neighborhood and we were back visiting family and friends! The location was perfect, easy on the brown line, walk to Cubs game, easy trip to the lake front and so many restaurants and stores. The place is very big but comfortable and has everything you need!! Thank you!

The space was smaller than expected, so my husband, our large dog, and myself were pretty cramped, but if you’re traveling solo or just with a small dog then the space would be acceptable. There was a very bad cat urine odor when coming into the building and it can also be smelled in the unit. There were only super basic amenities provided, ex: single ply toilet paper, very thin old pillows, no coffee. The A/C unit was very loud and its near the bed so it made sleeping very difficult. We mainly needed the backyard space for our dog and that was good. The property management team was responsive when we needed them though which I appreciated since our trip dates did have to change last minute due to a medical issue. Overall the space provided wasn’t worth the money spent for us.
Lovely home with all the amenities one needs to be comfortable. Nice neighborhood and responsive, helpful hosts. Thank you!
Bon rapport qualité prix

This was a beautiful stay in a beautiful neighborhood with my family. Perfect for my parents, husband, me and our 16 year old daughter. My parents were able to stay on the 1st floor and had their own full bathroom and we stayed on the 2nd floor with 2 bedrooms and full bathroom as well. Full kitchen amenities, nice living room and even a recreational area in the basement  if you want another place to hang out. Bridget was responsive at check in when we had questions. The location is ideal and you can travel very easily to the different neighborhoods in Chicago and downtown fairly quickly. Lots of restaurants and markets nearby. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others!

My group had a fantastic time here. The space itself was roomy and comfortable. The central A/C and heating were a life saver. The beds were comfortable and the kitchen had everything you would need.
The location itself was also fantastic. Right down the middle with a little bit of bougie and a little bit of edgy as well, so you had something for whatever mood you were in. The area is very walkable and you will have no trouble finding restaurants, bars, bookstores, coffee shops, thrift stores and a nearby grocery store.
It was also close to the blue line which got us into downtown and the airport very easily.
Hosts left local recommendations which were very nice as well. They had some great picks like Wormhole coffee.
It was just overall a great location and if you’re in Chicago for a few days, this is a great home base
Very convenient place and comfortable place. Two families, party of nine, enjoyed their stay.
Karen was helpful and super responsive during my stay. Within walking distance to a bus and train station. Near montrose beach which was really nice for sightseeing. Overall enjoyed my stay.

Great place to stay at with so much to do! About a 10 min walk to Milwaukee Ave which has tons of shopping, food, and bars. Place was very spacious and private, we all loved it! Will definitely try booking this again whenever we’re back in Chicago. The hosts were also very responsive which made the experience even better. Thanks for hosting us!
Top
Great location.  Place was very clean.
This place is exactly as described. Great location in West Loop. Clean. Beautiful. Nice touches. Would absolutely stay here again.
We had a great stay. Location was perfect and the apartment was clean. They also have security. Rooms are quite small but good for a short stay

A comfortable, cozy and quiet apartment in a walkable neighborhood with great restaurants and bars. The entrance isn’t far down the alley so it felt safe. Nice big shower too (turn the knob to “11” to warm it up). Only suggestion is a little bit brighter light for the bathroom sink.
The place was as described. Easy check in and very clean! It is right next to the train but didn’t bother me one bit! The neighborhood is very walkable and close to many things to do! Thank you!!
This place was really nice. We enjoyed our stay and the directions were super clear. We even got locked out, and the hosts were really helpful to get us back inside quickly.

We had a great long weekend and Kimberly's place is in a perfect location.  We really enjoyed exploring Ravenswood and Malt Row.  The apartment was clean and comfortable and we would definitely rent again.

The place was fine overall, but the cleanliness fell short. There’s no fan in the bathroom, so we had to open the window, and when we did, we found dead bugs everywhere along with a lot of dust. The ceiling above the bathtub has mold, which was a real problem since my husband is highly allergic. That needs to be fixed. We also couldn’t use the coffee machine because it was too dirty. The unit could use much better airflow.
On the positive side, the rest of the place was neat and the location is lovely, right by the water and close to coffee shops. Still, for what we got, the price felt high.
Demitri is a lovely host.
Anny’s place was great and in a very convenient area. We loved the common area and it was amazing for entertaining. Anny was great at communication and she was an amazing host.

We had a great stay here! Very clean and quiet. I will say it’s not super ideal for young girls to walk outside or to the bus stop, but no fault of the host at all! If you’re coming with a man or with a group, you’d be set!
Nicholas communicated with us VERY well, he’s great!
We overall enjoyed our stay and will keep it in mind for future trips here!

I stayed here for 3 months for an Internship. Would stay again. (Room #3)
I orginally was looking for something affordable. I found this spot. I saw a lot of bad reviews, but honestly given the price, I thought id just suck it up and deal with it.
To my surprise, none of the issues listed in the reviews were here. There are no mice. There are no fleas. Any question or request I had for Pamela was answered. No pets to be seen. My room had AC. Very comfortable.
I see a lot of reviews regarding cleanliness. Its clean. At least to me. If you are an OCD clean freak. You probably wont like it. But thats a you problem. The state of the house is overall acceptable and I wouldn't call it dirty at all.
The water pressure is a bit low in the shower, but gets the job done.
If you're a normal person just trying to get by, this place is perfect.
I just graduated college. It pretty much a college dorm but cleaner.
Overall for its price and what you get. Its a great deal!
Easy check-in. Host communicates well. Excellent location. Well appointed room with the combo washer/ dryer a great convenience.
Great walkable location. Staff were helpful and attentive throughout our stay.

The stay here is nice enough, didn’t have any issues with other guests staying in this building, the bed was comfortable and the space was clean. The parking situation is a nightmare however. The listing says free street parking but the check-in instructions don’t mention how to go about getting the free street parking. Turns out you have to leave Airbnb and go to their website to find any information. They have a parking pass for you in the room but for whatever reason don’t mention it in the check-in instructions. We couldn’t find any free spots so we ended up forking over a lot of money to park in a nearby lot just to walk in and find the parking pass in the room. So if you stay here make sure to find a loading zone to go into the unit and get the pass before searching for parking in the area.

Beautiful quiet neighborhood so close to everything. Shower wonderful water pressure and heat. Linens luxurious. Beds firm and comfortable. So to be honest it's about location, good beds, and a hot shower. Davids place has all of that and more. Would stay again.

This place is within a few blocks of Wrigley Stadium. Plenty of eateries near. Compared to the hotels in the same area this place represents good value. The host was very very good at communicating which is always a plus.
Very nice place, furnished with taste and care. ❤️

Mark was communicated and proactively! He provided recommendations. The kitchen and its appliances were so clean, the whole apartment has been maintained beautifully. Walking in the neighborhood was so beautiful, peaceful and full of garden beds and beautiful landscaping. Parking while very limited wasn’t as much of a hassle as it could’ve been. We absolutely loved our stay!

I wasn’t aware I had to give a security deposit until I was trying to check in, it took me a minute to be able to contact the host. But she did go ahead and answer when I called and let me know what I needed to do. If you are looking for a place with easy access to public transportation this is the place we were able to do many things because the bus stop was close by. The only thing that I would say was the leveling of the floor was kinda off and the water from fridge didn’t work, but other than that I might come back

The place was really nice.  Everything was clean.  Serg was very responsive and an overall great host.  Serg gave easy-to-follow instructions, but it was a little confusing trying to find the garage on the first night of our stay.  The neighborhood felt safe but could get noisy because of the nearby fire station.
I highly recommend David’s place to anyone wanting a comfortable place to use as a home base for coming and going. Great location, great property and great host.

Matthew was an amazing host! He was extreme flexible with our group’s check-in times and was always communicative and quick to respond! Location was perfect! I’d recommend this to anyone who is visiting the city
Eine tolle und sehr saubere Unterkunft. Tracy und ihre Familie waren sehr freundlich.

As someone who has been in many airbnbs I feel like this has been a disappointing experience. For an Airbnb with so many rules and fees you would expect that the room is well managed and prepped upon arrival. Check in time is 4 pm, you would think that its enough time to get the room cleaned and situated.
When we went into the rooms the ventilation inside wasnt great it was very warm while its 86 degrees outside. When given instructions by the host it still wasnt working but my friend and I figured out it the vent was locked and was able to open it.
There was piling on the bed sheets where it made it felt itchy to sleep on. The bed sheets might need to be replaced.
Not as bad but then came the worst problem. The towels were STILL WET! Rolled up and wet! When we asked the host about this we expected a sorry and they will replace it... instead they said Oh we washed it 100 percent, you can still use it. They did end up giving us new towels but a very bad impression of the place for us
Good value for the stay.

Bonito apartamento. Una zona tranquila.
Cómodo. Todo funcionaba bien. La habitación del escritorio muy buena. Todo bien

This was one of the best airbnbs we have ever stayed in! Great tree lined block. About 20 minute walk to Wrigley.
So many great small touches inside. Having a closet full of kids toys was amazing !

Cathy and Jeff were perfect hosts.  Beautiful home.  Great location.  This is what all Airbnb experiences should be measured against.  And the topper for me was that they use unscented laundry detergent and didn’t have any perfume blasters!

Lina our Host communicated one  week before the trip to ensure our arrival. She was very attentive and responded to request within minutes. She provided suggestions of what's popular to do in Chicago with additional links. The home was nice and clean and accommodated our girls trip of 12. I would definitely choose this Host again! 5 Stars.
Nice stay in safe neighborhood. It has all essential things needed for a short stay.
Great spot for a big group, let us drop our bags off early so we could start vacation ahead of schedule. Super responsive, would absolutely bring our big crew back

El lunes está bien, es un departamento en segundo piso con varios cuartos, baño y cocina compartida, cada cuarto es privado, tiene llave, una mesa, ventilador y todo lo necesario.
La ubicación está un poco lejos de downtown, me hacía 1 hr 15 min aprox en llegar downtown así que hay que tomarlo en cuenta.
La anfitriona contestaba rapidísimo y las instrucciones siempre fueron claras.
Great Stay !!! Will be back
It was a very nice place to stay clean and welcoming and the location was perfect for what I was doing. Ledys was very responsive.

Absolut empfehlenswert!
Vielen Dank, dass wir hier wohnen durften!
Lage und Ausstattung waren perfekt.
Falls wir wieder nach Chicago fahren sollten, würden wir definitiv wieder hier übernachten!
❤️

We needed two bedrooms so we could host guests while in Chicago.  This place fit our needs perfectly.  The immediate neighborhood is not scenic, but the 56 bus line is immediately outside - straight shot transit to O'Hare in one direction and downtown in the other.  (We had tickets to a show at the Chopin Theatre and were delighted to find that it, too, is right on the 56 line.).  Also, Logan Square is an easy stroll away -- or, if you're tired, a quick ride on the 56 line! -- for plentiful restaurant selection.  All in all, we were very pleased!
Cozy Airbnb! Anjali had great recommendations for local spots and also thought of everything you could have at an Airbnb.

Khong was a kind and responsive host, and his place was clean and comfortable. Our family really enjoyed being close to Chicago while still having the opportunity to stay outside of the hustle and bustle of downtown. We had a wonderful stay and look forward to returning on our next visit!

We really enjoyed our stay at Kasa. Host was very responsive and helpful from the moment we did the booking until we checked out. The place looks just like the pictures. The space is very cozy and we loved the view of the city from our windows. There is a USPs close by to check your bags before check in time if you need to. We enjoyed the rooftop lounge which had sunbathing chairs, an indoor pool table, and other games. There is a Target and Walgreens close by as well. It was also nice that there was not a long list of things that had to be done at check out, we left things tidy but it was not required. Overall, it was a great experience!
Thank you for the stay!

Great location and super peaceful spot!!! Really can’t get a better location in my opinion. Older building, so plumbing was very slow (a lot of buildings in chicago are just like that) but still worked enough. We definitely enjoyed our stay there very much! It is nice that the kitchen has cooking utensils and things in case you want to make food while staying. The only slight inconvenience was definitely the plumbing. It was slow upon arrival, and the sink was leaking pretty badly, but we informed them and they let maintenance know, so that shouldn’t be something to prevent anyone from staying here since that would be on maintenance and should be fixed now. Great hosts and would stay again! The outside door is a bit tricky to open, but once you get it, it will make sense! Thanks for a lovely location!
Lovely home with everything you could need!

Incredible place to stay!
The house has everything you need to be comfortable in your stay, you’ll feel at home.
Neighborhood was really nice, blue line was 8-10 minute walk away, so it’s very easy to move around the city.
George was super nice and attentive, he responded quickly and offered to give us recommendations.
If I come back to Chicago I will definitely stay again at George’s.
Nice

Our family felt right at home. Anthony’s condo was very clean, exactly as pictured and described.  The check-in instructions were crystal clear. Anthony was easy to reach, but he checked on us before we needed anything. He even provided some extras. We would gladly stay again!

Daniel truly embodies what it means to be a Superhost. He is exceptionally responsive, responsible, and detail-oriented—qualities that came through in both his communication and his thoughtful problem-solving throughout my stay. I stayed for nearly two months and quickly felt at home in this modern, cozy, and beautifully furnished space. The apartment is well designed, comfortable, and equipped for a longer stay. The building felt safe, and the location was incredibly convenient: easily walkable to both the West Loop and River North, with quick access to much of the city and the highway less than half a mile away. I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend Daniel’s place.
Great and convenient place. Would definitely recommend!
Super easy check-in and great communication. The apartment is beautifully decorated and the host provided lots of convenient amenities. Would definitely stay there again.

Great place to stay in Chicago! It’s conveniently located right next to a bus stop, which made getting into the city really easy. The beds were comfortable, and the space easily accommodated our group of five. We also really enjoyed the selection of card games, including poker. The host was very responsive and offered flexible options for early check-in or dropping off bags ahead of time. I would definitely stay here again!

Jason was a pleasure to work with. Communication with him was fast and easy.
Excellent location if you are planning to spend time at Wrigley Field, it was a 5 minute walk. Also close to all the great bars in Wrigleyville. We would absolutely stay there again.
Loved his place, and would stay again.
A comfortable and convenient stay. It was perfect for our group of 6. Would definitely stay here again.

Saurin was an incredibly accommodating host. I arrived unexpectedly several hours before check-in. Saurin invited me into the common space to rest. He reset the room rather than wait for cleaners so I would have somewhere to rest. Thank you for going above and beyond, Saurin!
Adriana's place worked great for my stay in Chicago. Despite being close to the United Center, I did not experience any noise issues. It is exactly how it is represented in the listing.
Great location--in the center of it all.  Thank you.

Perfect for our short weekend in Chicago visiting friends and family. We love this neighborhood because it’s beautiful, historically rich, and has so much to do! Robert’s place was clean, cozy, updated, and just perfect for our family of 4. We would definitely stay here again on future Chicago trips!

I chose this Airbnb because I moved back to the Chicago area after being gone for 20 plus years. I needed somewhere close to family and affordable during my transition back and I found that here! My stay was amazing. I always felt safe and comfortable. I literally felt right at home! 😊 I enjoyed every minute. There are several restaurants and stores and bars nearby that are within walking distance. Laura was a stellar top tier host! Her house is so cute with very lovely decor pieces everywhere. I also got well acquainted with her cats. I’m a cat person so I loved them so much. I definitely recommend this Airbnb to other women looking for a safe space to lay their head and relax. It will feel like a home away from home! 💗
Great place to stay in Chicago. There are several restaurants and bars nearby. Convenient going to Wintrust Arena and Soldier Field. Easy to get ride share. We live that it’s close to Chinatown.
It was such a charming place!  We loved the cute yard, the Chicago-themed artwork, great books about Chicago, great neighborhood - lots of friendly people out and about with their dogs.   Thank you!

We stayed for a 5 day visit to Chicago. The location is great! Lots of places to eat, get coffee, and shop in the immediate area. Thanks to easy public transit access, we were able to leave our car in the driveway the whole time. The unit was very elegant, clean, and comfortable - highly recommended!

Aaron’s place was great for our trip to Chicago! It was close to the blue line and we were easily able to take public transportation. It was incredibly clean and it was a cute, homey space with everything we needed. Would definitely stay again!

Wonderful place in a beautiful and lively neighborhood. The streets are quiet but if you walk 3 blocks, there is tons to do. Humboldt Park is a beautiful walk and very close as well. We loved staying here!

Perfect for our needs. We were there for a baby shower but in the three days did so much more. Whole food is conveniently located nearby as was the bus system. Bar down the street was a hoot. Everything was great.

The host was incredible. He worked with our redeye schedule and let us store bags in the garage around 6am and gave us an early checkin. The place is minimalistic and beautiful. We all loved it. It was perfect for me, my 21 yr old son and 17 yr old daughter. Thank you!!

Great location to be able to walk around the down town area. Not his fault but the other people staying were in and out constantly hearing the door slam. Also a baby crying non stop early in the morning.

We had a wonderful stay at Nicole and Matt's property. Beds were very comfortable, kitchen and living spaces were roomy and just as described. Location was perfect -we walked all along Magnificent Mile (5 min walk) and to Navy Pier (25 min walk). Parking space was a huge bonus. Definitely recommend.

Muy amables y contestaban muy rápido, lo único malo que no resguardaban equipaje antes de la hora de entrada que considero ya era muy tarde, eso nos generó un gasto extra. Igual le faltó un poco de limpieza, ya que había muchos insectos muertos y el colchón ya es un poco viejo, se sumía demasiado.

Jevaux was very communicative and gracious. I am super grateful to have been able to stay at this location as it allowed us to enter the core of Chicago (15 minute drive) while still feeling like when the city was enough we could break from it. The place was pristine, and well kept, sheets were fresh, it was a wonderful experience!

Silvia and her husband Derek were always available for whatever we needed and questions. We stayed for a month to be near our daughter and her family and it was the time of our lives. To be able to spend the time with our children and grandchildren was priceless and worth every minute we were able to be with them.
Great location and great value! The place was convenient, comfortable, and perfect for our stay in Chicago. Would definitely stay here again. Thank you!
The place was perfect for us, we were there to move a student into DePaul and the location was perfect. Beds were comfy and everything was great.

I recently stayed there because my son lives in Albany Park. I would highly recommend this place, even though it may make it harder for me to get a reservation in the future. Really clean, very nice neighborhood and great communication with hosts

Nala and Owen were very kind, their space was beautiful. I loved the private room, and the description was very accurate! Their response time was extremely fast and very helpful to us. The location of the space was very close to everything we had planned to do which was very convenient for us! Glad to say we enjoyed our stay, Thank you Nala and Owen!
It was perfect for what I was needing a place to sleep and shower

Het pand is erg mooi. Het is antiek en de bovenverdieping is mooi ingericht. Wij sliepen in de kelder en schijnbaar had wel een stinkdier naast ons raam wat gedaan dus onze hele kamer stonk.
De kamer (the egypt room)was ook niet schoon.
Heel veel stof en slecht matras.
Er zaten ook haren in de koelkast die op onze kamer stond.
De leidingen die boven ons hoofd hingen maakten ook snachts herrie.
Wij hebben omgeboekt en zijn ergens anders naartoe gegaan.
De host was wel heel aardig en wist veel over de geschiedenis van het pand wat erg interessant was.
Fantastic location, comfortable basement apartment. Well-furnished. Climate control was excellent.
We had a wonderful time :) Would stay there again! Tysm!
Excellent host. Great instructions. Easy to checkin
We had a great time and everything was as advertised. I can’t wait to book this place again!
Great stay and location! Highly recommend.
Stayed here for a second time and it was great I felt safe and the place was clean!

Logan Square is a lovely spot in the heart of Chicago and if you want to truly experience the neighborhood, this is the place you want to stay. So many things within walking distance, a lovely lodging, and a responsive, helpful host. Parking options can be a bit tricky but still solvable. Hard to go wrong here.
Good place to stay. Comfortable for maximum 6 people. Good neighborhood and distance from the centre of the city.
Excellent host, place was clean, well located & safe location

We loved our stay! The apartment was spacious, clean, and was super conveniently located. It was easy to access public transportation as well as just a short walk to the beach. Christopher was responsive and flexible, even letting us check in early!

Nice place in a nice neighborhood.   Diana was very friendly and responsive to the few questions we had during our month stay, even though she was out of the country.   A tree limb blew down in the backyard during a storm, and Diana had it removed the next day. The beds and sofas were very comfortable. The fenced backyard with deck and seating was ideal for  playing with our dog who traveled with us.  The area is very walkable and convenient for nearby parks, restaurants, coffee shops, etc.  The beautiful 606 was just a block away. Parking was not an issue.  The place is designed well, has some MCM furniture and interesting art. It was clean and there were some items in the pantry for guest use.  The place is on the 2nd and 3rd levels, so steps are involved. We enjoyed our stay at Diana's.
Amazing well designed spot.  Great location.
We enjoyed the space, very clean and had exactly what we needed
Jeff did a great job in communicating about our stay, and the Coach House was very clean, neat and well organized. We had a great stay, and highly recommend this Airbnb.
10/10, would definitely stay again
Great place to stay in Chicago. Close to everything!
A lovely place in a nice quiet spot in Rogers Park.

Jevaux's BnB is a true gem! From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home. The place was impeccably clean and cozy, making our stay incredibly comfortable. Its fantastic location made exploring super easy, and Jevaux himself was an outstanding host—so kind and helpful throughout our entire visit. Highly recommend!
The place and location were great! Kasa is super helpful and responsive when you need them. No complaints.

My stay here was overall good!
Pros:
- Kasa was very responsive the entire time. They were even proactive when letting us know that our water would be out for a few hours 1 day in advanced.
- The location is top tier. You are within walking distance of many restaurants, coffee shops, grocery stores, and the CTA station. You are not further than 5-10 mins walking from any of these places. The view is lovely.
- Wifi was strong for work laptops to operate on
Cons:
- There was someone who walked in through the front door as I was unpacking and in bed. There was some kind of miss communication between Kasa I suppose. The man did not identify himself or apologize, rather he just walked back out once he realized I was there.
- Be aware that its noisy here. You can hear everything, but its an apartment in the city so that's to be expected.
- I noticed there were some small spots on the bathroom floor that could've been cleaner.
This was a perfect space and location for the 3 of us. Exceptionally clean. Comfortable. The right location for us.

nice clean and quiet stay
thank you CJ
Live the area wicker park is a great place to stay if you love getting out and exploring

Our stay was really great- clean unit, nice location, and Ola was always responsive! Comfortable bed too. I was a bit worried there’d be street noise but it wasn’t an issue at all. Great location in Lakeview area. Clean and spacious bathroom, ample towels, and spotless kitchen. Would stay again!

Amazing place in a great location of Chicago for a large group. Our group had a wonderful stay here and honestly the pictures make the place look smaller than it is. It was very spacious and the back door patio was a hit with our group!

The hosts were great, very responsive, friendly, and easy to communicate with. However, the room was unfortunately very disappointing. It was not clean, with a dusty ceiling fan and very dusty blinds. The room was also much smaller than it appears in the photos, and two people could barely fit comfortably. It felt more like a closet than a proper room. It’s especially disappointing considering we paid an extra $500 for this stay. The hosts were great, but the cleanliness, size, and value for money were not worth it.
Parfait

Great place to stay if you are wanting to experience City life!  We stayed there for a whole month and never ran out of things to do - only ran out of money (lol).  Great location and easy access to the Blue line and the busses you want to use, as well as the 606 if you are into biking.  Everything was clean, updated and ready to use.  I would definitely book again!
Dave was friendly and the place was about a hour walk from the solider field stadium. Lots of beautiful scenery and close to the bus stop as well.

The location is great for commute and safety. Ashley responded in a timely fashion and the pictures are accurate. I would stay again.
Thank you for hosting us!

Solid place. Its a bit older but it was spacious and fit our group size as advertised.
Nice neighborhood. Local people and amenities were friendly

Chi's place was great.  Very clean and comfortable and in a great neighborhood - walking distance to DePaul University.  Per the description, the train runs right outside the master bedroom.  But it did not bother us and we slept great.  Would definitely recommend.

Nicholas was very responsive, super nice. Decent place. Beds were comfortable. Easy check in and check out. Guest should know you have to walk up two flights of stairs, something to consider if you have a lot of luggage or elderly people in your party. Also, the hallway leading to the apartment can use a new rug and some cleaning. Inside of the apartment is decent for the most part. Nice neighborhood, close to restaurants and stores.

I so enjoyed my stay at Jill’s place. It was exactly what I needed and it felt right at home. Nala was the best greeter too. Jill was so kind and friendly. The neighborhood has fantastic restaurants within walking distance.

The loft and neighborhood are fantastic! Love the old fashioned building and high ceilings. So much to do right outside the front door and then there’s the “L” stop right around the corner. Everything was very clean and easy to find.

Overall, we had a good stay. The place was comfortable and served its purpose well. However, there were a few basic amenities we expected that were missing, such as extra blankets and pillows, laundry detergent, extra towels, and some extra shower essentials. Having these items available would have made the stay more convenient and comfortable. Other than that, everything was fine and we appreciated the stay.

Great place for an affordable place very near to the downtown area. Quiet neighborhood, cozy apartment, and everything we needed at our fingertips. The host was especially helpful with timely questions and support about the parking and was also a joy to chat with a bit. Definitely would recommend this stay!
Great views and walking distance from millennium Park . Host was responsive. The building and apartment had wear and tear. Carpet was soaking wet in the master bedroom from the A/C unit leaking.
Great location.  Very friendly and helpful.  Would stay again.
Owners were responsive and kind. Quiet calm area. Beds were comfortable. 2 beds and 1 pull out. The home was clean.

We had a great experience staying at this Airbnb. The place had all the amenities we needed, and the host was very responsive and quick to address any questions or requests. The location was also good and convenient for getting around by public transportation. Overall, it was a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Highly recommended!

All I can say is that I felt right at home. The apt was clean, beautiful, and "homey". Little things like cooking supplies (salt, pepper, coffee, olive oil, etc) were all there.
This is how an Airbnb should feel

Had an AMAZING time staying here! Scott and Audrey are so incredibly nice and welcoming and the space truly felt like home. So many amenities provided that we were so grateful for too.
Street parking was also much easier than I anticipated. Love how close it is to Chinatown too. If we come back to Chicago in the future, we definitely want to try and stay here again!
This hostel is in such a cool area of Chicago. We walked to public transit, yummy restaurants, and even to the Lincoln Park zoo!
Very convenient location for going to games at Wrigley field. Clear instructions and easy to check in and check out. Would definitely stay again!

This is in my top all time favorite Airbnb stays. The location steps from the L was key. And there is so much within walking distance to do, see and eat. We could not have enjoyed the place more.    Loved being close enough to walk to get coffee and a pastry, several great places for lunch and dinner. We had a great stay in this beautiful penthouse! My husband and I were in town for a family wedding with our toddler, my parents, and brother and we all slept very comfortably. The spacious living area and balcony space had fantastic views. And our two year old loved the shared pool! The apartment is within walking distance to groceries, the West Loop and Fulton Market, and we enjoyed all the nearby dining.  We would definitely book again for another visit to Chicago!

I enjoyed my stay at Jeff's Airbnb. It was perfect for me and quiet. It was in a good neighborhood, and the location was very convenient for me. My host, Jeff, was very nice, kind, polite, and quick with his responses. I will definitely book with him again in the future.

I had some issues with the YALE lock at check in, and Edwin answered the phone quickly & was able to help me get in! Very responsive host who hosts a nice place to stay! The only downfall is that you can hear the people upstairs moving around. Other than that I have no complaints!

We enjoyed exploring the area and discovered several good restaurants and neighborhood bars. Loyola University campus and Lake Michigan beaches are only a few blocks away.
There is a Target just around the corner and another block beyond that is the Red Line train stop. We took the Red Line to Wrigley Field and downtown Chicago.
Christi responded quickly to all our questions, and we had no issues in relation to our stay.

This was a cozy bedroom and bathroom within the host’s home. It was a short walking distance to public transportation. The area was nice and felt safe being out and about in the community.
The posting is for a private room and the host shares the communal areas with you. If you prefer a completely private space for yourself, this may not be for you.
The room and bathroom were clean. We were provided with clean towels for our use. The bathroom is quite tight. Kept most of my hygiene stuff in the bedroom as there is no counter space in the bathroom. The bathroom is just enough for your needs.
One gripe I had was that back entrance where you enter and remove your shoes always had shoes/slippers in the path of the door or stairs. I found this to be a tripping hazard and potential for injury.
Overall, the place was great for our needs this trip. It was convenient and comfortable. It was just what we needed for the weekend.

Matt was an amazing host, extremely responsive to all my inquiries, and super helpful along the way; he made it much easier. It’s truly an incredible host with a great place to stay and visit in Chicago.

We love Chicago and River North is close to the lake, the river walk and tons of restaurants and bars.

Great spot! We had 4 adults and 1 infant, plenty of space for us for 3 nights. A fun and convenient part of Chicago to stay in for a family. The whole house was super clean and had everything we needed.

The biggest problem I had is that after the first night, my friend said he had bug bites on his legs. After looking at these, it seems like they’re bed bug bites. This is something I can’t look passed and I really hope Steven can get corrected because we really did have a great time in Chicago and the location of the Airbnb was perfect.

Comfortable home in a great neighborhood. The number of rooms and bathrooms made it very comfortable for our large group to hang out together and also have some personal space. There are plenty of cute shops and delicious restaurant options within walking distance.

Latrice was a wonderful host! She was very kind, showed us around the space upon arrival, and gave great local recommendations. The place was just as described and we had a great stay. Would definitely recommend!
Amazing stay! Won’t find a better spot for a Cubs game weekend. Lake Michigan 10 minute walk. Foosball table is awesome .

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago! Finding a space that comfortably fits a large group can be tough, but this unit was incredibly spacious and accommodating for all of us.
