This was exactly what we needed for our stay in Chicago. It was a cozy oasis to sleep and recuperate from our busy days in Chicago. Beautiful neighborhood, extremely safe and walkable!

The unit was perfect. Very clean, well-decorated, and stocked. The beds were comfortable and the sleeping arrangements made it ideal for a small group ready for baseball. Wrigley Field is just a couple of blocks down. Scott was accommodating and answered any question we had immediately. The street parking permits are perfect if you need them. Game day parking can be a struggle if you’re not used to it but just be patient and you will find a spot. Otherwise take advantage of public transportation. I will keep this place in mind for the frequent trips to Wrigley for sure.
Beautiful home, wonderful host and extremely comfortable stay. Very close to boardwalk and easy commute to and from Soldier field.
Great location. It was a quiet street and the place was very clean.

Overall good for the price! I must have misread that there would be other guests in the same space sharing a bathroom. That was surprising. Wasn’t the most clean place but overal it was quiet, bed was comfy, and location was near every location we needed to writhing 15 minutes.

Dominique are amazing and super best Host.
The place is super clean and the best.
Thanks a lot Dominique.
We only had one hiccup, but Nicole fixed it the next day. Overall great stay, and enjoyed my time! Would definitely book again.
Great location with parking. The view from the living room is lovely. Beds are very comfortable and Isa was very responsive to any questions.
It was as advertised. Good value
The place was in a perfect location for shopping, dinner, and going to a Cubs game. We had a great time!

My stay at Flora's accommodation was great overall! She was super helpful and answered all of my questions. She was proactive and addressed any concerns I had quickly as well. The area around the hotel got a bit loud at times but that's to be expected since it's next to an intersection. The area is super walkable and there's a lot to do! It's 5 mins walk from the 606 which is a lovely running/walking/biking trail. As a solo woman staying there, I felt quite safe in the hotel and walking around the neighborhoods nearby. I would definitely recommend this for anyone looking for a short-term or long-term stay.

I loved the centralized location. Everything was walkable for us. Even the train was close by. Loved the environment. The neighborhood can get lively on the weekend, but that is what we were there for and enjoyed all of it. I can’t wait to go back to Chicago and stay at this same location in the future. Nicholas was super responsive and helpful. Would definitely recommend.
Excellent space and location

Excellent loaction for those who enjoy the city. Nice neighborhood, right in the middle of the southside. I thoroughly enjoyed it being back in my native city!!! Home was really roomy and my family and I , overall, enjoyed this home very much!!!
I had a smooth check in and checkout. The place was just as described and matched the pictures provided. I throughly enjoyed my stayed and will definitely rebook with Andrei.
Great stay as usual. Peaceful and quit. Close to my volunteering.

Michael's place went beyond our expectations. It was very spacious privacy and places to gather. We appreciated the well stocked kitchen supplies and new appliances.
Michael was very responsuve, addressing our needs with expediency. His communication was friendly and easy.

We had a pleasant stay at J.'s property, it is more like a hotel formula than a house but with the added value of having a kitchen and a living room so to me it was simply perfect! Cleanliness was spot on and the area where Bohemian is located it is top notch, we also had "our neighbour" ( little Italy, we are Italian) very close like 15 minutes walk. But above all these aspects and what makes the difference it has been the kindness, the honesty and the accuracy from the host. J. is very kind, helpful, clear in giving instructions and very responsive like no matter what time I have written the host has come to me within few minutes. I definitely recommend Bohemian Lodge! Thank you so much for everything ✨
place was awesome!

From beginning to end, our stay was wonderful! My group of six and I all appreciated how well the AC worked, especially considering how hot it was during the days we were there. Getting inside was very easy and efficient, and whenever we had questions, it was easy to get a quick response. The only downside was that the neighborhood could get a bit noisy at night, but of course, that is not the owner’s fault. Overall, I would definitely recommend this place for larger groups. Thank you for having us!

Jane and her husband were very welcoming and were able to accommodate my additional request quickly without issue.
Common areas were cleaned daily.
My room was in the basement so did hear some of the upstairs movements, but it was fine. Transportation was very easy. Perfect spot for games at Wrigley, a short bus ride away.
Great place. Parking is super clutch. Pretty ridiculous they tell you take out the trash when I'm paying a cleaning fee. The cleaners do that.

A lot bigger than expected. Had to go up flight of stairs but it’s only on the second floor. I loved this apartment. Floors were creaky and there was a dog next door that would bark but other than that this place was amazing and spacious. Would definitely stay again. The neighborhood is quiet.
Great location near my family's apartment. Centrally located for the weekend's wedding activities around Chicago.

The hosts were nice and easygoing about letting us come up early to drop bags and get changed. We chose this place primarily to save money and feel the current pricing is appropriate, but the place could be cleaned up a bit.

Perfect stay in Andersonville. . Both bedrooms have AC window units, as does the living room. The location is unbeatable if you want to stay in this area (I can say this as a former local!) Nicholas was so kind and responsive. We’d stay again for sure!

We had such a great time at Margret’s place! I can’t stress enough how great the surrounding areas were. Tons of food shopping and bars! Great things to see. Her place was beautiful inside and out and she was an absolute sweetheart! Highly recommend
Great
Pictures lived up to expectations. Great host, definitely recommend !

Pippa's place is beautiful and comfortable. The ceilings are high, and there is lots of light, even on cloudy days. The bed we used was comfortable (the other one looked identical, but we didn't use it). The shower was good. The linens were nice. We only cooked breakfast there because we were visiting our daughter who recently had a baby, so we cooked lunch and dinner at her apartment. But the kitchen seemed very well equipped. We only stayed four nights, but Pippa's place would also be great for a longer stay. I highly recommend it, and I hope to stay there when I visit Chicago again.

Absolutely awesome stay! Great location with plenty to do around the area! Extremely comfortable and homey spot with great hosts. All of the guests for my bachelor party were blown away with everything!

Perfect location and comfortable living quarters with all the in-house amenities you need. The hosts were very communicative and proactive about making sure everything went well. Would recommend the neighborhood for everyone, and this listing for a smaller group of 2-4 people.

Airbnb was very nice and clean! Had so much space for the 5 of us. Close to the bus and train station, had food options right across the street. Hosts were very flexible with us and were very kind. Would definitely recommend and we will be coming back!!!
Lovely home easy instructions to get in

This was a a sweet little place. Spacious and easy to feel at home. The double master bedrooms was a game changer. Perfect for two couples! Plus the bed was super comfy!
Yes, the building lobby and hallways themselves can use some work but this isn't Brad's responsibility and his place itself is top notch. Thanks Brad!⭐
Great place!
Great place and super friendly host just wished it was closer than a 20minute walk to the train. Regardless I’d stay here again!

Evan was a great host and the stay was easy and comfortable from start to finish. The place was clean, well kept, and had everything I needed. Communication was straightforward and Evan was responsive whenever I had any questions. 10/10. Would highly recommend staying here.
We enjoyed our stay in this cute little apartment. Views are beautiful.
Great stay

This apartment was in a very good location to walk around, close to Michigan Ave, the riverwalk and parks.  The apartment itself was very clean.  There was a train that went by the windows about every 10-15 minutes which was quite loud.  I did read other reviews about it and thought it would be okay.  Unfortunately for us, it was a bit louder than anticipated and did interfere with our sleep.  Plenty of great restaurants close by and close to the metro.
A perfect spot to stay for seeing a game at Wrigley.
It was a wonderful place!!

Really cute and clean place in a quiet neighborhood, looked exactly as pictured. Lots of good food at walking distance. It's a bit removed from downtown but not terrible as long as you don't mind a little drive!

I have never left a negative review even when unsatisfied, but I am appalled by the host’s false accusations. Based solely on the upstairs tenant's word, she claimed we left the property in a "horrible condition" without verifying it herself or providing proof. In reality, we exceeded check-out requirements.
My past reviews prove we are excellent, tidy guests. The tenant’s behavior was unsettling. Our blinds were closed, meaning they had to peep inside to see a “mess”.
The host acknowledged but didn’t resolve issues: Wi-Fi stopped after night one, and the fridge leaked.
Property maintenance matches a pattern of neglect in older reviews. The microwave handle is taped, the sink was clogged, the bath mat smelled of mildew, an outlet had exposed wires, and the dryer took 4 hours of a single normal load.
Great location, but I absolutely do not recommend this property due to the accusatory host and an invasive, peeping tenant, not worth it.
Beautiful historic building with lots of character. Everything was clean and functional. We would stay again.

Great location within walking distance to Wrigley as well as local transportation. Neighborhood is quiet and I felt safe walking to and from my destinations with/without my luggage. My private room was safe and secure, as well as my bathroom. Host was very quick to respond when I had questions.  10/10

We enjoyed our stayed . Rooms were very clean and it looked exactly like the pictures . We were just there for a couple of days and it was a perfect location since we were there for a concert at soldier field .  Yasmin was very helpful and she would respond very quickly if we needed something.

Brandon was great. The locations was safe. We found some good options for food and groceries. Not too far of a walk to the train. If you plan to drive, two spots are private, anything beyond that is anyone's guess if you can get a spot on the street. The condo could use a good maintenance run thru. Guests feedback -bedding not comfortable, ac resets making it very warm, very loud AC unit outside bedroom window, one room with a lumpy bed has French glass doors with sheers on it so not very private accomodations for two adults, nor quiet. Three bedrooms are entered from the kitchen, just for next renters better visual and understanding of the layout, lights and switches not active or non working-everywhere, the pictures make it seem very bright, the air intact were very thick with dirt, micro door hardly opens, lack of utensils for eight people, only three chairs at dining table, dirty laundry and garbage in the private parking stall. Overall we give the condo three stars.

Great spot. Had everything we needed. Easily walkable to lots of things. Walked to the Cubs game while there.
Safe and quiet neighborhood

While the place was perfectly fine, the address was in accurate, and we were not given the details of where to find it until check-in time which sent our group on a wild goose chase to find out if it’s one address or the other.

We had a great stay! The home was perfect for our larger group—very spacious, comfortable, and very clean. The location was great and made it easy to get around and enjoy the area. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it to others!

Aisha was a great host. The apartment was clean. The beds were very comfy and so were the chairs. If you do have multiple people and someone will have to sleep on the couch it is just a futon so it can be a little uncomfortable so I would bring extra padding or blankets. I like the location because the apartment is right outside of a bus stop and while it is a bit of a commute from the city, the bus ride to the train ride is very easy to do. The floors are very squeaky, but honestly that just comes with an old apartment and wasn’t a big deal. She was very responsive and the AC kept the apartment nice and cool for the most part. I saw some reviews saying it was noisy out, but we really didn’t have any problem with the noise. The apartment also seems very secure. It is nice to know that you have to go through a door that locks every time you close it and then also lock your apartment. Great stay.

Honestly, one of the best hosts I’ve had. We came with 6 guys and the place was spotless, with clear, straightforward check-in instructions. The little touches stood out: two cases of water waiting for us and a custom welcome sign. Mia was incredibly responsive throughout our stay, and when we ran into one small issue, she resolved it right away and even sent over an extra case of water. She even gave us an extra 3 hours for check-out, which was a huge help. Above and beyond service. Would absolutely stay again, 6 stars if I could give them!
Great place to stay, was there for a concert and the Airbnb was just as described, no problems whatsoever
Small and affordable

The host was very quick to respond, which was very helpful.
However, the room was quite dark, and it was inconvenient that there was only one bath towel.
Also, the accommodation was about a 20-minute walk from the nearest station, so I felt that the location was a little far from the station.

Had a nice time in Chicago and in this Airbnb! There were a few troubles with getting down the stairs especially with a lot of bags. We did like how secluded the Airbnb was from other parts of the house.

This was our second stay at Paul’s delightful historic apartment. The space was clean, cozy, and comfortable, situated in the wonderful Andersonville neighborhood. Getting around was seamless, the CTA Red Line is just a 15-minute walk down the street, which made traveling to and from downtown Chicago for the BTS concerts at Soldier Field incredibly easy and saved us a ton of money that would have been spent on ride shares!
We also loved how walkable Andersonville is; catching the farmers market at the end of the street when we arrived made the trip even more memorable. Tons of great coffee shops, restaurants, and boutiques are right down the road on Clark Street. Paul is a thoughtful host who provided all the essentials (fans, cold water in the fridge, plenty of K-Cups and towels) and even checked in to ensure the central A/C was at a comfortable temperature. From the moment we left the airport, we couldn't wait to get back to “Paul’s place” 😊. Highly recommend!

Such a beautiful home! Very open and super clean. I love that it was so close to downtown so did not need to be in traffic. Walkable to good food and the home is very secure! Enjoyed our stay very much.
Eugene’s place was exactly as listed! Nice and cozy and felt right at home! Very responsive also, and easy check-in which is always great! Thanks so much! :)
Matthew’s place is super clean, organized, and lovely! We enjoyed our stay at his place. Matthew is also very communicative. Would definitely recommend!
Good place for a group that can share beds
We had the best time ever! This is a great Airbnb

Eric was super responsive and friendly! I felt comfortable and easily navigated myself around. I didn’t take public transportation and relied on Ubers or my own car. It worked well for a quick weekend get away that was affordable. Her place was clean and easy to get and out of. I would definitely stay again.
The place was as described. The location was great. Will definitely recommend for group stays.

Janet's place was as described.  Key word is cozy.  It would be perfect for one person who is on budget.  Pretty small for two people.  My wife and I were bumping in to each other quite often in the space provided.  Janet was an absolute champ at communication and made sure we had everything we needed.

Kareem was truly such a wonderful host! From the moment we arrived, he was incredibly welcoming, attentive, responsive, and genuinely kind. He was also an absolute joy to talk to, which made the stay feel even more warm and personal. My friend Arshia and I felt very comfortable and well taken care of throughout our stay.
And the cleanliness! ✨ The house was extremely clean, and our bedroom was absolutely spotless. You could comfortably walk around barefoot. The bathroom genuinely felt like walking into a brand-new hotel room. I don’t think I’ve ever seen towels that white in my life! Everything felt incredibly fresh and meticulously cared for.
Kareem also thought of so many little details that made the stay especially comfortable. The room was spacious and had a mini fridge, food and snacks, tea and coffee, toiletries and shampoos, a large wastebasket, a fan, and AC. It really felt like he had anticipated everything a guest might need rather than simply providing the basics.
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean and modern. The location was also great. We would definitely stay here again.
Great studio apartment just right for our weekend stay. Very walkable neighborhood. A/C worked well.

Locating this location was easy, and the process of finalizing it was also easy. The area is near many places of interest. There was ton of rooms and space for the 6 of us. The back way to park was a little hard to at times to get to, since other cars were parked in the way to enter the alley.
The details and instructions given for this Air bnb were very clear, overly detailed, and very thorough. We had no questions regarding what the place offered, and what was available to us while we stayed here. It was a little hotter during this stay, the A/C wasn’t working at the time, so they set us up with individual A/C units connected to the window. At first it was hot for quite sometime, but when we returned at night it was perfect. The blow up mattress is a twin size, but there was two in the closet.

Great place. Melissa is very responsive and helped us immensely through the check in process. Parking is behind the building (turn right at the 711) and made it very easy to get in and out. Good home base for driving into the city or exploring the area. Very clean and comfortable would recommend.

We had the best time here to spend with family! Most perfect location to get almost everything in Chicago. We would for sure stay here again! My daughter was so happy to sleep in an actual crib instead of a tiny pack and play! Major plus! And the toys for kids and books was lovely. Very kid friendly place!
It was the most perfect location and parking was nearby and the apartment itself was just right for what I needed. Would 100% recommend

Best Airbnb I’ve stayed at ever! So sad they’re booked during my next trip back to Chicago! They had everything you could think of and was in walking distance of metro. Space was huge, clean, and the host was super nice. I hope to be back soon!

Good stay overall. Tidy place. Great communication. Close to downtown. Restaurants to eat only steps away.
Area was OK… we were coming in late and parking was difficult to find. One of the rooms is underneath some stairs and we could hear the upstairs neighbor going up and down until midnight.

We had a great stay at Michael’s home. The house is as described and comfortably hosted a group of 12. Michael was welcoming and responsive throughout our stay. I would happily recommend this Airbnb to others and certainly consider returning in the future.
Very cozy, space. Updated and sleek. An older building so the age shows but the host was wonderful, kind, responsive and  accommodating.
Lovely place. Safe neighborhood.  Ran a 10k in it and all the people were friendly. Great location
I had a great time in the room! It came as advertised in the listing. Ana was very responsive and cooperative.

We had such a great stay! The space was very clean, comfortable, and full of natural light — we especially loved all of the windows. The rooftop area was adorable and such a nice little bonus. Our host was wonderful and very responsive whenever we had a question. The location worked really well for everything we wanted to do, and we felt right at home during our stay. We’d happily stay here again!
Incredible spot tucked into a cozy corner of a great neighborhood! Would highly recommend :)

Absolutely would stay again. Seriously the pictures don't do this place justice one bit! No joke I cried when I walked in because I was having a hard day, and to be blown away in expectations and the sheer amount of hospitality Ken The Host provides is incredible and unlike any experience I've had before. Anything you need and he's got you. If I could do 6 out of 5 stars I Absolutely would

Its a nice place next to beach and whole foods walking distance. However, when I came in at night with my family, the living area had a mild sewage smell. The next morning it got worse and so I called the rental company and they said a maintaince person would come take care of it. Several hours later they called back asking me to flush water into the laundry room drain and that did fix it. However, the next day there was a strong detergent smell coming from the laundry room drain which continued for the rest of my stay. Other minor issues added up like one of the washroom towel hanger was broken, there was no kitchen soap, only 1 blow dryer, no extra toilet paper etc. The cleaning person came in a little early and so I got a surprise when I went back to do a final sweep before moving out (did apologize). For a price close to $450 a night (inc tax) I felt somewhat disappointed. I am giving it a 4 and not 3 stars because the issues are fixable and I hope the company will improve things.

We had an amazing four-night stay at Meighan’s home! The apartment is beautiful with lots of charm and fun decor. It is thoughtfully stocked with useful amenities. You can tell that Meighan has put a lot of love into this place and enjoys hosting guests.
The porch and garden are truly magical and provided such a peaceful space in the morning or to return to after long days exploring Chicago. Meighan is a wonderful host! Her bulletin board was fun to read and filled with many helpful local recommendations.
Logan Square is a fantastic, lively neighborhood, and there were too many coffee shops and restaurants to try in just four days! We loved it so much that we ended up having dinner right in the neighborhood every evening, instead of downtown. The blue line and buses run frequently and are easy to navigate. The blue line is a quick walk from the rental. We couldn't have asked for a better stay and hope to be back!
This place was great for me and my family. Awesome location, would book again!

What a great stay! Perfect for a gathering of old friends. Plenty of room to spread out. Great gathering spaces. Easy access to everything we wanted - we could pretty much walk everywhere we wanted to go or hop the El. I'd definitely stay there again!
Very clean place  and had good amenities. Host communicated well. Would recommend
Great location walkable to Wrigley and close to a train station. The unit accommodated our group of 10 nicely, and the host was responsive.
It was a comfortable stay in a quiet neighborhood!

Katty is an amazing host. Super responsive and very friendly. Every time I had a question or concern she would always get back to me so quick. The place was clean and cozy it made me feel like I was at home away from home.
Nice house. Parking is terrible depending on what time you get in you might have to park blocks away and walk to Airbnb. But other than that it was an ok stay.

Absolutely fantastic place to stay for our weekend in Chicago. This was my first time in Chicago so the nights were a little noisy but Katty even left earplugs for us, so kind and thoughtful. We loved everything about this place especially Lord Frog-quad in the bedroom, iykyk.

Highly recommend if you are attending a game/event at Wrigley Field given how short of a walk it is to the stadium, bars, stores, etc.
Even if you’re not going to Wrigley, still an incredible place to stay with an awesome roof top deck overlooking the city.
Excelente ubicación,, el personal amable y ayuda.
Super comfy beds, great location, friendly staff

This was the perfect home base. Train station and bus stop short walk away making travel to city easy. Apartment was clean and well equipped the beds were super comfortable. There was a little noise from upstairs neighbor but nothing excessive. Overall very peaceful place to stay. Would definitely stay again.

The space was exceptionally clean and thoughtfully appointed throughout. The kitchen had high-end appliances and everything we needed to easily prepare any meal. The bathroom was also well stocked with thoughtful extras in case we had forgotten anything.
The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the quiet neighborhood made for a relaxing stay. We also enjoyed exploring the interesting surrounding area and spending time on the outdoor patio.
We interacted briefly with the hosts, and they were very friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend!

Such a great apartment and beautiful area! The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. And the toilet is very ✨fancy✨
So many great restaurants nearby (Tortello was SOO good). Blue line was a short walk away, making it a convenient home base. Brett was a kind and responsive host — definitely want to stay here again next time we’re in Chicago!

This place was exactly as described and spacious, nice big beds. Well maintained, great location for what we were doing all over the city. Nice to have a parking spot and would definitely stay here again.  Host very responsive to questions.

Wonderful stay in Chicago!!! The location is walkable to convenience stores and some great Mexican restaurants.
The neighborhood can feel a little dark and quiet at night, especially if you’re traveling alone, but during the day it’s very peaceful.
Another plus: it’s super easy for Uber to pick you up and drop you off!
The house was great. The location is accurately described. The room was smaller than I expected.
Absolutely loved Susan’s property. Had everything I needed and was comfortable. Great neighborhood. Parking was easily available during my stay. Thanks, I will be visiting again!

I wanted to give a higher rating but unfortunately there were too many issues that I encountered during my stay. The majority of the apartment was clean, including the toilet and bathtub. However, the floor and walls of the bathroom were dirty. When I arrived the two rolls of toilet paper provided were wet. The host was communicative and made effort to resolve the issues but it took up too much time during the stay and took too long to resolve each issue. When the bathroom was finally clean near the end of the stay, the cleaner left behind damp/wet bath towels for me to use. All of this was documented with the host. There was also broken lamp in the living room and broken closet door, which I said they could fix after I left.
A/C in living room was functioning but weak (bedroom a/c was better) if you're sensitive to heat. Host did not include dishwashing in manual but requested it the day before check out. Was told I could not request early check out 24 hours in advance as in manual.
Sean was super communicative and the apartment was perfect for our group!
Awesome place to stay very clean and the host was great

We came to Chicago for a BTS concert and to visit Shedd Aquarium and the Field Museum. Edward's place was super convenient to all of those locations. The bus stop is a 2 minute walk up the street and there was plenty of accessible on-street parking if you drive. It is also a convenient walk to the Pilsen neighborhood (we recommend Cafe Jumping Bean!).  The place was very clean and comfortable with extra towels and blankets and a well-stocked kitchen. The shower had good water pressure and plenty of hot water. There was a minor water leak when we arrived, but Edward was very responsive about it. This unit is on the first floor with a private entrance, which was also nice, and it was pretty quiet - we didn't really hear the upstairs neighbors at all. We really enjoyed our stay at 1226 S Blue Island Ave!

The location was good and convenient, but unfortunately, there were several issues that made our stay less comfortable than expected.
The building does not have an elevator, and this was not explicitly mentioned in the listing. We were traveling with elderly parents and children, and carrying luggage up four floors was quite inconvenient and difficult. We managed, but I feel this is important information that should be clearly called out in the listing so guests can plan accordingly.
We also experienced significant noise from the HVAC system in two of the rooms in the middle of the night, which woke our guests and disrupted their sleep.
Additionally, some of the doors were difficult to open and close properly.
We have stayed at many Airbnb properties, and unfortunately, this was our least favorite experience so far. The location was a positive, but the issues with accessibility, nighttime noise, and the doors had a noticeable impact on our overall stay.

This is such a beautiful home. It’s even prettier in person than it is in the pictures. It’s a really nice space. Well maintained very clean. Definitely will be coming back. It’s not super close to a bunch of touristy things, and it is pretty quiet for the most part. However, it is only  15-20 minutes out from the city if you have a car, I would definitely recommend. It’s also pretty close to the CTA. One of the more affordable Airbnb options where you can find an actual house and not just a one room.

It was a great place to stay! Plenty of space for three people and it was easy to find — the street parking out front was no problem at all. Paul was a great host and he was responsive in a very timely manner when I reached out to him. We would most definitely stay here again next time we’re in the Chicago area.

Mi familia y yo nos sentimos muy agusto en la casa, somos muchas personas y sin duda el lugar pudo adaptarse a nosotros.
Alec fue muy amable en todo momento, pudimos tener una llegada rápida debido a las instrucciones que nos dejó y contestaba a lo que necesitaramos de forma pronta.
Disfrutamos mucho nuestra estancia, un lugar muy acogedor en una zona tranquila y con todo cerca, lo que nos permitió tener mayor organización en nuestros tiempos para explorar completamente la ciudad.
Tuvimos que hacer unas modificaciones a la reserva y Alec estuvo todo el tiempo con la disposición de ayudar y hacer nuestra visita más amena.
Agradecemos mucho su hospitalidad y amabilidad.
Great place for a group stay. Michael was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout the stay making the whole process easy and seamless.
Very walkable location to shops and restaurants. Nice and friendly host. Easy to find parking. Felt super safe
Great location.  Very cute space.    As described.   Would stay here again.

Everything was great, Milan was very responsive and answered quick so I never had to worry about that. They also sent me messages throughout the day to make sure everything was still going well and if I needed anything which I really appreciated. It was also a 10 minute walk to Chinatown and subway so it was very accessible. Overall I had an amazing experience and would definitely book again!

Thank you to Cathy and David for hosting us! For starters, they were so flexible with check in as our flight got more and more delayed into the late evening until it ultimately got canceled and we had to rebook for early the following morning. The stress of that was relieved by how accomodating they were with the expected arrival times.  Cathy also greeted us before giving us the room key which helped us feel right at home! The space itself was also so comfy and so private. The room has its own bathroom, entryway, and patio! We were worried about making too much noise walking around with the creaky floorboards but that's the charm of an old house! Also, don't get spooked if you hear loud banging if you get back to the room late at night-- that's the dog banging on the door downstairs! (we learned that the hard way lol). The location was also a 6 min walk to the Red/Purple line and a 15 min walk to Brown line which made transport so feasible! Overall, really enjoyed our stay!

We had a nice stay at Hakim’s place. It met our basic needs at a decent price point and for a good location. Guests should be aware about potentially having to park along neighborhood streets that may be permit-only (we had to walk a bit to find a non-permit spot). If there is parking on premises, guests should ask well ahead of time about instructions, as we did not receive instructions. Other than that one minor aspect, we had a safe and comfortable stay in a clean-enough home that the host so generously opened to us. Thank you Hakim!

Amazing host, unit and location.  Demitri is a super responsive and helpful host and made the overall stay incredibly pleasant and smooth.  Unit itself was super cozy and the location itself was great.  Parking can be a little tricky sometimes especially on weekends, but overall amazing stay.

This was a great place for our extended family to stay for a wedding, as there was plenty of space for 13 of us, and it was super convenient to walk to area shops, the Lincoln Zoo and venues. Plus, Drew was super responsive when we had questions leading up to our trip.

Had a great stay at Ikechi's place! Easy walk to public transport and chinatown. Quiet neighborhood.
Be wary when street parking as we got a ticket for street cleaning!
Terrific find, hope to stay again!
easy and commuter friendly
We really enjoyed our stay! Amazing location and the house was very nice. The only thing we struggled with was the coffee maker as it seemed to be broken when we stayed there.
We enjoyed this property!
Great
Phyllis was a great host and was so friendly! If you ask her a question, she’ll respond quickly in a few hours. She let us know what’s around the area and where we were allowed to park.
Great place to stay. Lovely neighborhood and good host. Recommend!
Great place in a great neighborhood. Would stay again.

This was a really great stay. Very clean and calm atmosphere. The accommodation was very easy to find. Melissa was very accommodating and understanding.
Also major plus (for me) was a Dunkin being less than a 5 min walk from the house.
I will say parking was sort of difficult but gave some good advice on where to go to find the closest parking to the accommodation.
John’s Airbnb was very clean, and John was very communicative. We really liked his manual of his favorite things to do in the area.

Came to Chicago for a concert & this was perfect for our weekend stay! Very convenient location, great sized rooms. Couch was slightly uncomfortable so we did not spend much time in the living area but each bedroom had its own AC which was nice & the beds were comfortable! Would definitely book again!

I had a great stay at Kasa Magnificent Mile. The one-bedroom apartment was very clean, spacious, and completely free of clutter, which made it feel comfortable and relaxing. I especially appreciated having a washer and dryer in the unit, as well as a private balcony.
The building felt very safe and secure, and having concierge service was an added convenience. The location is excellent and extremely walkable, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, shopping, and attractions nearby. It was easy to explore the area without needing a car.
Overall, a clean, comfortable, and well-located apartment in a great part of Chicago. I would definitely recommend it and would happily stay again.

This was the perfect stay for me and my husband with my parents. All of the patios and decks on the provide the ideal location to enjoy your coffee in the morning, or watch the world go by.
There’s plenty of space, and all of the amenities you could ask for.
This is a fabulous location to enjoy all of the restaurants and nightlife in the area; everything is walkable. If you’re going vintage shopping, all of the stores are within a 10 minute walk (which was dangerous for us😂).
Nicole and Matt are excellent hosts. They’re incredibly responsive, and we’re flexible with us getting in a bit early for our check in.
I would absolutely recommend, and would stay here again!
Amazing location, very spacious, great hosts!
Perfect getaway space for a small family. Sarah was very responsive when needed something answered.

We had an amazing stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very welcoming and made sure we were okay throughout our stay. He was friendly, responsive, and made sure we had everything we needed. We truly appreciated the great hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Host was very good at communicating, we had no problem entering the property. Only little detail is that the place has a smell and not very clean, but we knew this because it was listed in the description and we were aware of it, so not really a complaint.
It was the perfect place for the price we paid!

We absolutely loved our stay here. Our little family stayed for 7 weeks, and the apartment truly felt like a home away from home.
The space was very comfortable, spacious, and thoughtfully set up, and we immediately felt at ease. Everything we needed was there, and the apartment was just as inviting and comfortable throughout our entire stay. We especially appreciated having so much space for the three of us and being able to really settle in and feel at home.
The location was very convenient for getting around Chicago and the suburbs. Having dedicated garage parking was a huge plus. The private balcony was also a great touch and made the place feel even more relaxing.
The host was also fantastic! Very kind, welcoming, and responsive whenever we needed anything. That made the whole experience even better.
Overall, we couldn't have asked for a better stay. We genuinely loved the apartment, felt very comfortable there, and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!
Cute studio, perfect for extended weekend in Chicago! Great location by the red line and check in/out was easy.

We had a great time. It was very comfy and easy to find the neighborhood was nice and calm. We weren’t very far from everywhere we needed to go, which was really nice. We did get parking tickets because there was street cleaning. We didn’t know about that, but maybe we didn’t read the instructions clearly enough so that may have been our fault. There was lots of street parking with the permits they supplied the whole time we were there though, which was nice. Overall great place and we would stay again.
Great location and clean space! Perfect for our weekend stay in Chicago.
As expected, everything was great. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with. No complaints at all, would definitely stay again.
We loved our stay! Great location, easy to access the L and buses, and the view from the rooftop was wonderful
The place was great overall. The walls are paper thin and could hear the upstairs neighbors a lot. The place is a good location but in a busy road. Sometimes hard to find parking near the apartment.

Hospedarnos con Elliot, es una maravillosa experiencia, se ha convertido es nuestra opción #1 cuando visitamos Chicago, es una casa con muchas comodidades. Son unos Excelentes anfitriones.  Esperamos seguir visitándoles

Emilia was a great host that communicated very well unlike any other host me and my siblings have had. The only real complaint we had was that we wish it would have been a tad bit cleaner when we first arrived. We also happened to have a somewhat odd interaction with her next door neighbor which has nothing to do with her or her Airbnb but it was just something I wanted everyone to beware of.
Loved being in a quiet suburban neighborhood outside the city. We felt very safe during our stay there.

My friends and I stayed here for a weekend trip for a concert at Soldier Field and we were overall very happy with the location/amenities of this space. The apartment was very clean and comfortable, with a nice living room area, dining room, kitchen, nice bathroom with plenty of clean towels, and pretty nice bedrooms. The second bedroom was a bit small, but perfect for one person, and my friends were comfortable in the master bedroom. The only con that we felt when we arrived was the scent of weed we think may have come in through the vents from one of the host’s other tenants. We were able to run the air conditioning to air it out, but there were a couple times where the smell was more noticeable. Aside from that, the rest of the apartment was perfect for what we needed! It’s located an easy walking distance to public transport and there were lots of nice restaurants/coffee shops nearby. There was street parking nearby and they provided parking day passes as well.

Everything looked exactly how the pictures described but even more lovely in person, the hosts were SUPER sweet and always ready to help with recommendations and very personable! Beautiful home and surrounding area, I could not recommend this stay enough 🤩 10/10 Thank you so much Christiane and Patrick so very much for making our first trip to Chicago so memorable ✨💕
Great place parking was a little challenging.
The place was clean and matched the pictures. One of the beds was a little uncomfy, but other than that the amenities were fine.
Very good as mentioned. Easy to find and there’s both bus and train stop nearby, house was always clean and the AC was very nice which is good in summer time.

Book with confidence. I had an incredible stay here that was comfortable and cozy. From the moment I stepped inside I instantly sighed with relief, as if I was entering my own home (but far more well decorated). Anne is kind, communicative, and proactive. If you need a quiet stay, home away from home type feeling, or simply just can't do another hotel, this is the place.

Had a great stay in this lovely loft! The bed was comfortable and it had enormous windows, lovely art in the dining area. Within easy walking distance of numerous attractions and transportation. Would definitely stay there again.

Me and my friends had an amazing stay! Also Fay and Desiree respond really fast which I love and are very helpful!! We enjoyed our stay and I highly recommend one to stay here if they’re looking for places to stay in Chicago!:)

I had a great stay overall and found this place to be good value for the price. It was exactly as described in the listing. While it's not in downtown, public transportation is very convenient, with the train about a three-minute walk and buses within one to two blocks. Downtown is around 25 minutes by train or 40 by bus. Just note that buses/subway run on set schedules and are less frequent in the evenings and at night, so planning ahead helps. The neighborhood may feel unfamiliar at first, but I always felt safe, even when returning around 10 p.m. to midnight. The room was spacious, and the shared bathroom and common areas were well maintained, though it's smart to plan ahead since these spaces are shared with other guests. The hosts were responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I recommend this place for travelers looking for good value for the price and convenient access to public transportation.

My husband and our best friend had an AMAZING week in Chicago! The location worked perfectly for what we needed and we were able to walk almost everywhere the entire trip! Stephanie was so kind and responsive and check in and check out were extremely easy!
place was beautiful! host was SO amazing! responds immediately! will definitely book again!
This Airbnb was perfect for our weekend getaway! We didn’t have any troubles at all and it felt very cozy and welcoming.
Great location!  Victor was very responsive.  Only one thing  kept us from all 5 stars which had to do with some areas not being as clean as expected.

When staying with family or additional members it’s always great to have 2+ bathrooms and this one had two full bathrooms, gorgeous
I’m going to ask where they got the tile it’s so nice

The apartment was easy to find and ia located on a quiet and quaint residential street. It was large and very clean with any amenity you need for a few days stay. The bed and couch were both comfy.
Bus stops were available on the area today get us anywhere in the city we wanted to go. Get a pass and plan to use the train and buses for your stay. We even accidentally walked to Chinatown in about 30 mins (we figured we'd walk until we saw the bus but we got there first 🤣). The neighborhood was phenomenal - we loved the culture and vibrancy. The Mexican Heritage Museum was a great place to visit, we learned some very cool things there! Now we know why 18th Street has the wonderful reputation that it has, there were so many food options and decent shipping as well.

The place is cute, conveniently located, and met our needs. Charla was very communicative and kind. The wifi wasn’t working properly, and the bathroom didn’t quite have all of the necessities, but otherwise, the place was great. I definitely recommend staying here if you are visiting Chicago!
It is a lovely and comfortable small apartment.

Such a nice, cute place to stay! It was perfect for 4 girls. The neighborhood was quiet & next to a park so it was cool seeing people walking & taking their dogs. Parking on the block was easy (easier during the daytime). It’s a 20 minute walk to soldier field & close to Chinatown & 88 marketplace (if you like Asian cuisine 😊). We would definitely stay here again!

My husband and I stayed at the Walton property with our 4 adult daughters.  The property was absolutely spotless. We were able to get around easily whether on foot or the train.  I love Chicago and I would most definitely stay at the Walton residence again.
Knowledgeable host in a quiet neighborhood. Location is great for dropping off a car and using public transit as long as you are willing to walk 10-20 minutes.
Had a great time here at Kyles! Was nervous about parallel parking but there was always a spot nearby at different times of the day. Worked out great for what we were in Chicago for!

Wir hatten einen kurzen Aufenthalt bei Jefferson, um Chicago anzuschauen und über unseren Jetlag hinwegzukommen. Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben und in einer schönen und sicheren Gegend. Die Innenstadt war mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut zu erreichen. Jefferson hat uns nach unserem Flug spät am Abend empfangen und die Kommunikation mit ihm war gut. Wir können die Unterkunft wärmstens weiterempfehlen.

We had a good stay at Aisha's place. It was clean and we slept well in the comfortable bed. It was not far from the Brown line, which was great, and the neighborhood was charming! The only snag was that parking was a bit of a challenge, especially at night.
Shomari’s place was very clean and spacious. So relaxing as if you were at home. We loved our stay.
The location was great and the place was very nice!
Really cool spot!
Had a wonderful stay!

Great Airbnb near Chicago’s Gold Coast neighborhood. The location was excellent and very close to the L, making it easy to get around the city. The place was exactly as advertised, and communication with the host was great throughout our stay. Would definitely stay here again!

The place was exactly what we were looking for. Super close to the L and very easy to get into downtown. The place was super clean and very welcoming. Definitely recommend to anyone planning a trip to Chicago.

The Airbnb was just as listed. The house was clean and felt pretty homey. Don't let the outside fool you, the house is more spacious than the exterior let on. They had everything we needed in the kitchen, bathrooms and laundry. We didn't spend much time there because we were out exploring a lot but the time we were there was pleasant. Having a private, gated parking area was great, as street parking was very hard. The only downside to the rental is getting there. It's in a local neighborhood so there's a lot of smaller, crowded streets with many stop signs and stop and go traffic. Overall, the home was nice, very spacious and clean. We weren't in communication with the host at all because we had everything we needed in the house but, Junni was very attentive, sending a welcome message and ensuring us that they were only a few minutes away if we had questions or needed assistance.
We had a wonderful stay. Alex was a great host.
It was a cute place in a nice neighborhood. Loved that they had drinks and snacks set out for us. They were also great at communicating with any questions I had. I would stay again for future trips!

We had a great stay! The apartment looked exactly like it did in the pictures. The location was also very convenient and close to the stadium we needed to get to.
The only issue we experienced was that the water heater stopped working during our stay. However, the host was very responsive and was able to get it fixed pretty quickly, which we appreciated.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!
We had a great time staying here. Very nice place. It was a good location close  drive to downtown. It was a quiet area. Free parking.
Great place, it’s nice to have the whole basement to yourself. Quick walk or bus ride to blue line and in a calm residential neighborhood.
Would absolutely stay here again if we were to go back to Chicago!
This airbnb felt comfortable and safe. Area was nice too and we felt well accommodated. Would recommend!

No complaints.
Excellent communication by DanielZ

This was a beautiful home perfect for our group of 5. The host was very responsive and flexible with check in time which was so nice! The house had plenty of cleaning supplies, towels in the bathrooms, and was easy keypad entry and exit. We couldn’t have asked for a better stay!
Beautiful little place to stay in the city but it feel like a quant neighborhood. Easy to follow instructions and great recommendations!

Neighbor was slightly rude about the parking before we were informed on how things work. No harm, no foul.
Tameka was great. Great communication. Very warm and friendly. Responded in a timely manner.
Great host and even better place! Highly recommend!

Had as a last minute Airbnb (seeing as my first one had some cleanliness issues I couldn’t believe). Even with such a short notice they were very responsive and helped through checking in and getting accommodated. Would definitely recommend. Cozy place too
Great place for a bachelorette trip. Super walkable and great views of the lake.
Nice place to stay! 10 min taxi to soldier fields, also a train station 10 min walk away that took you on the ride line right into the city. Really clean and spacious.
We had a great time here! Location was easily accessible to local train and there were multiple restaurants within walking distance. The 3 units were perfect for our group!

Overall the 5-day stay in Chicago was good. Though me and my friends enjoyed our time in town, we do have some mixed reviews about the place and do not plan to book here again in the future.
Communication with the host is wonderful. He’s very kind and responds in a timely manner.
Love love looove the location of the space since it’s easy walking distance to stores, coffee shops, and public transportation such as the red line train into downtown.
Now onto the not so great stuff…
I’m still new to booking Airbnbs, so I was not aware (nor informed) of an upcharge when increasing the number of people in the space. He just charged me and didn’t say anything else.
Initial walk in to the space was very humid so the AC needed to be cranked the entire trip. Hot weekend in Chicago, no big deal.
Mold was found in the bathroom and that was forwarded to the host. He said the bathroom will get a deep clean once we left.
Almost no hot water at all. It was either cool or lukewarm.
No hostility🫶
Great place to stay. The team is very accommodating and communicates everything perfectly. Would highly recommend!

My stay at this BnB was okay, the place was good but the kitchen utensils were dirty, old. There was no toaster, the location was not good at all. There was always yelling and shouting at the street. Me and my family didn’t feel comfortable and safe. Overall stay was okay. The place needs to be updated more to look even better.
Yolanda’s place was great! Very clean and property is well taken care of. The place has everything you need. She was very attentive and communication was smooth.
Caryl was a responsive and helpful host. Her home is beautiful, clean, and as shown in the pictures. The room and bathroom were spacious and exactly what was needed for my stay!
David’s place hosted four friends and I for a weekend in Chicago. Beautiful Air Bnb, very unique. Easy to access location and David was responsive. Would stay here again

We had a comfortable and convenient stay at this spacious and well appointed home! Close enough to so many landmarks and things to do and see but tucked away enough to feel like we could rest easy in the evenings. Plenty of places to gather with a large number of people!
Thank you fof great communications.
The place was great! Conveniently located and the communication was swift
This was in a super convenient location and very easy to find/get into. Super nice place!

We had a little hiccup getting into the apartment during our late-night check-in, but once in, Alma's place matched the pictures perfectly and was very conveniently located next to public transportation.
Very private and not too far from the metro and bus stop. It felt safe and clean.

We are Chicago locals but needed an Airbnb could accommodate around 9 to 12 guests for my sister’s bachelorette party. All in all everybody slept comfortably. I will say the kitchen sink had a noticeable smell as did the refrigerator and I would definitely recommend something like baking soda to get rid of that. Additionally, a door was off the hinges, and we left for a couple hours and came back with it on the hinges. I wasn’t notified of that and it would’ve been nice as we had plenty of valuables in the space and somebody could have been there. With pets being allowed I think there’s an extra level of cleaning you have to do (I have two dogs!) and we didn’t feel like the shared spaces were cleaned. Additionally, it felt like the sheets on the pullout couch were not washed as there were crumbs and stickers from other parties on it. I was shocked to pull it out and even find sheets on it!
However, the price of the Airbnb is pretty hard to beat. It’s good for big groups.
Great location in a super cool neighborhood! Had everything we needed.
Nice quiet neighbor close to public transit and beach.  Also had a garage so had reliable parking if you chose to drive.

100% recommend this place! The place is clean with organize furnitures. It's also close to a lot of restaurants, cute gift shops and near to the train station too. It's a bit far from the city, but the train doesn't take that long. Kohen is also very responsive and help me with the check out process, and I appreciated it!

Great location in a very walkable neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and bars. Walking distance from Wrigley.
The apartment matched the listing description perfectly.
Everything was super clean and organized.
Great place to stay!
Great stay and close to the riverwalk and metro. Felt safe walking around the building
My entire family loved this place. Great location. Quick Uber ride to the City,

This was a great apartment for a family vacation. The location is fantastic - we were able to walk to the lake as well as Wrigley Field to catch a Cubs game. The apartment itself was comfortable and clean. And the hosts were very responsive to any inquiry or issue that arose. I especially liked the simplicity of the checkin/out process. I would highly recommend Thomas's apartment for anyone visiting Chicago.

We had a wonderful stay at Sean’s Airbnb! The location was fantastic—above a local bagel shop, next door to an old-time movie theater, and just two blocks from Wrigley Field. We loved exploring the surrounding neighborhoods, admiring the beautiful architecture, and discovering so many great local restaurants, boutiques, and coffee shops.
The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and inviting. Being in the heart of the city does mean you may hear some nightlife from time to time, so earplugs might be helpful for light sleepers!
Overall, we had a wonderful experience and made so many happy memories in Chicago. We would definitely recommend Sean’s place! ❤️
awesome place to live at
This place was excellent. We drove to downtown but even the neighborhood was awesome. It definitely was an awesome location for any and everything you need. I would recommend and book again.

The place in person was way better in person than the photos! Kyrylo is an amazing host, great responses, very accommodating and also very nice. The kitchen was even full of foods n goods to make it feel like you’re right at home. The beds were comfortable and bathrooms was also full of everything you need. The neighborhood is more on the diverse side but very respectful. Would totally recommend <3
had a wonderful stay here! very clean, and nice neighborhood. Everything was very clean and easy to get into. I loved all the beautiful flowers in the garden.
This was the best location I have ever stayed at in Chicago. It was super easy to get into the building, and the amenities of the building were great. Love it here!
Very clean, walkable, great restaurants, private little area kind of, felt safe. Needs better bedding quality and more consideration in “quiet hours”.
Nice quiet place. Enjoyed our stay
Great stay!

This was the perfect stay for a long weekend in town - the house is charming and cozy, and we had everything we needed! Mercedes kindly offered a flexible check-in to accommodate our flight schedule. Everything in the house was comfortable, and we loved seeing all the art! If you’re looking for a sweet place right on the green line, with plenty of space for 5+ people, this is delightful.

My friends and I loved this Airbnb!
The location was great, we were right next to so many cool shops and yummy restaurants. And the walk to the Red Line was only 7 minutes!
The hosts were super communicable and helpful! Check in was made easy due to the instructions and step by step pictures provided. The place was clean and smelled nice! Everything was as pictured! The neighbors were also respectful, and we never noticed them.
Check out was also super easy!

This Airbnb was one of the nicest I have ever stayed in. It is even nicer than in the pictures. Was an amazing space for our group of 7 for the weekend - lots of space to hangout and an amazing location very central for getting around. Will stay again!
Everything was as described and communication was great! Would definitely recommend.
Excellent place to stay. Has everything you need, close and convenient to everything.

The perfect place to stay if you don't have a car. It is near a lot of restaurants, shops and the train that takes you downtown. If you do have a car, you might struggle to find parking. Besides that, the apartment was very clean and specious, and the hostess was very helpful and responsive.

This is a great spot to host friends that are looking to spend a weekend in Chicago. The rental sits in a quiet neighborhood and is in a simple location to get around Chicago.
The host is extremely responsive with any questions leading up to the stay but also while we were there.
The home was beautiful and the walkability to Wrigley Field was great!
Safe and quiet neighborhood.
James was great! Very helpful before I got there, sent detailed instructions and made things nice and smooth! Great views and location!

After lots of trips staying in the loop, I wanted a long weekend in Hyde Park to explore that neighborhood and I’m so glad I did.  I love the people & friendliness of the area, Vin included. The space was just as pictured, cooking amenities to make food from local grocery stores (TJs and Whole Foods close by), and just a peaceful spot to work and also enjoy the city. So close to bus Metra lines too.
Amazing location to catch a cubs game! Justin was great and if I had any problems I knew I could message and he’d get right back to me. Would recommend

We had a great stay! We were there for a mini weekend trip and loved how close it was to restaurants etc. Parth was a great host. The airbnb had garage parking which was very nice but it was a tight squeeze so just be mindful of that!
Great stay

From start to finish we felt right at home. The place was cozy and comfortable.
We brought our bikes and used his bike rack which was located in an enclosed space behind the main house:) It was great to not have to leave them on the car.
There was parking on the street and we always found a place in front of the house so that was great.
We biked around town, which was super easy because of all of the bike lanes:)
His place is also not far (4 miles) from the Lakeshore Trail so we biked there and then biked along it.
Also the train station (brown) was a quick walk away and we used it a few times to go into Chicago…way better than driving in!
You can hear the train from the apartment, but even for us country folks, it wasn’t that loud, it sounded more like wind blowing honestly?
Wed definitely stay again!
House was very nice. Enough space for everyone to feel comfortable.
Amazing place and trip. The host couldn’t have been better! Highly recommend!
The place was clean and products were provided.  The price was also very fair for the size of the place, Overall I would book here again.
This was a great spot, the location is awesome and the hosts were very helpful.  Would definitely come back and highly recommend
Great stay! No issues.

Loved our long weekend here. The home was spacious, clean, great area and well taken care.  Troy was very responsive with any questions or assistance we needed. If going to Chicago area would highly recommend checking this one out. Definitely would stay here again.
This our second time at Thomas’s place and we like it because of the nice place and location.  Everything needed for a stay away from home. Will absolutely stay here again!
Great host!

We had a great stay with Hubbard Holdings in downtown Chicago! The location in River North was perfect — close to tons of great restaurants, bars, shopping, and everything we wanted to do while we were in the city. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for a weekend in Chicago.
The check-in process was easy, communication was great, and we had no issues throughout our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would absolutely stay with Hubbard Holdings again. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a convenient and comfortable place to stay in River North!

Our stay at Bojan's place was wonderful. Jefferson Park is a lovely, quiet neighborhood. Just a short bus ride away from the blue line, which is great for getting downtown. The place was clean, cozy, and felt like home. Both the couch and the bed are extremely comfortable (both my boyfriend and I probably had the best sleeps of our life!) Bojan was responsive and helpful. I couldn't recommend this place more. Before this, we have never stayed at an AirBnB, and lets just say, Bojan has given us some high standards!

We had a great stay! Cristina was very friendly and helpful. We did have one small hiccup during our stay, but we talked to her about it and she responded quickly and handled the situation really well. Everything worked out perfectly in the end, and we really appreciated how it was handled. Overall, they were great hosts and we enjoyed our stay!
Had a great stay
Subway was a little loud at times as well as the sirens but it’s not too bad when the AC is running or a fan is going. Also plenty of ear plugs just in case. Lovely, clean home and very walkable.
Lovely easy to access location with central location to all the downtown activities.
10 outta 10 would stay again!!!
It was very quite for the most part, and very affordable.

Fantastic location, and despite being next to a bar I never heard anything. Small things added up (broken blinds, lower water pressure in shower, slowly draining tub that forced you to shower in standing water, kitchen light bulb being burned out) to make the stay less than stellar.
If those were fixed I’d consider staying again
Loved Jason’s place! Great place to stay. Very clean and right by so much to do. Jason is so responsive and friendly. Also very accommodating!
Great place to stay.  Lots of room , convenient to downtown.

We enjoyed our stay at Lia’s place. It’s in a very walkable area, close to the metro, and lots of nearby restaurants and shops. Great location for exploring Chicago. All instructions were clear and helpful. We will stay here again next time we come back.

The place was exactly what we were looking for - conveniently located near a train station, had street parking, and comfortably fit 4 people. The host was kind, responsive, and made checking in and out incredibly easy. The neighborhood was cute and well located to get downtown fairly quickly. Would recommend :)

It was my girlfriend and I's first time in Chicago. We originally wanted to book a hotel but found Nnamdi's place for cheaper! Everything in the photos looked exactly how it did in person and Nnamdi was able to accommodate our trip check-in time since we were travelling from out of state. There was a small crack in the floorboards in the bedroom that wasn't in the photos but other than that, Nnamdi was truly friendly and very welcoming and gave us recommendations and told us a little bit about the area. We look forward to booking again with Nnamdi and Lana.

Cindy and Mike are so kind! Their place is very nice and its more spacious than the pictures! Its very easy to get into, and the surrounding area is quiet and peaceful. The drive into the cities isnt bad at all either from their home. Would reccomend!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was gorgeous, very comfortable, and had plenty of space for the three of us. Check-in was simple and seamless, and Dean was extremely responsive and accommodating throughout our stay. I hope to stay here again the next time I'm in Chicago!

Talie was a great host. Just had a hiccup reaching him for lockbox code as we got there at mid night but after that it was a seamless stay. The home was perfect size, one thing I didn't know was that it was a basement unit, which wasn't a big deal. Only thing is the kitchen was not very stocked but aside from that the home was perfect.
Elise was stellar! Extremely friendly and accommodating! I'd gladly rent from her again! I'd be willing to share my suggestions if I'm contacted. Thanks Elise!

Had a good time staying here! It is right by a bus stop which was so convenient. Because of that, I also felt safe coming back late knowing I won’t have a long walk alone at night. Neighborhood seemed nice and quiet as well. Had all the essentials and more

We had a great 5 star weekend trip in Chicago at Fortino’s place. The apartment had everything we needed for a two night stay. It was very reasonably priced for the events that were going on at the time. I slept great both nights and so did my family. The neighborhood also seemed great and I enjoyed the convenience of being on Archer Ave.
Fortino is a great host and very friendly. He made the whole process very simple and our trip more enjoyable. I would stay here again if I ever come back !

I would easily recommend staying at this unit hosted by Tara.. most airbnbs around here only have one bathroom but for a group of five guys two bathrooms are awesome.. The neighborhood actually closed down the street on Saturday for a street party offering up free drinks to us... Very friendly neighbors
Great location and very close to all the key downtown spots. The units themselves were spacious. Responsive host.

This was a great find in Logan Square,  and we really appreciated being able to have our dogs with us. The listing was accurate, there was plenty of space for us,  and the area was safe and walkable. Lots of great food options nearby and the 606 was easily accessed for jogging / dog walking. Would stay again if in the area!
very clean and neat, the area wasn't too bad Craig was very responsive overall 10/10 will stay again

The space was great. Very clean and plenty of space for 7 guests to sleep and hang out comfortably. Sam was very responsive and helpful during our stay. Would highly recommend Sam’s place for a weekend trip to the city!
Wonderful location,  Sharon was very responsive and accommodating! Would stay again!
Ilyas place was perfect!!
Great location!  Apartment was clean, modern and uncluttered.  Kitchen was well-equipped. Beds were comfortable. We would definitely stay here again on our next visit to Chicago!
This was such a wonderful place to stay! Colby was the sweetest host and the Pilsen neighborhood had so much love and art to offer. Would stay here again for sure!!
Clean and spacious for our work group
Very nice location

I booked Kyriako’s Airbnb for my parents to stay at for a wedding that I was in! They loved it! It’s was a 7 minute walk to the venue which was very convenient. It was great

Super AC which we enjoyed on our end of August stay. Hosts were very helpful and responsive. Five stars across the board. Will stay again next time in Chicago.
I would definitely recommend it. Everything was amazing I have no complaints

As a former Chicagoan who lived in Andersonville . This place was beyond impressive . So cute , thoughtful and spacious . I loved everything about it . Location was amazing !!! 11 out of 10 experience !!!
Amazing host! Very responsive and kind. We are so so happy and would most definitely choose to stay there again. Spacious place and had everything we needed.
Great host! We appreciate their hospitality!

Our family of 4 had a wonderful stay at Elizabeth’s place.

The house had the perfect amount of amenities to make our stay easy and comfortable (coffee pods, shampoo, conditioner, laundry detergent, etc)
We would certainly return to this property on our next trip to Chicago if it’s available!

To state some positives, if you don't mind all of that, the place itself is fine and there's a nice food spot across the street with about 30 kitchens that was very convenient and always good.

This site is a gem! We had  Everything we could desire in food, fun and transport. We easily accessed the Red Line and extended that Everything. Our host was supportive and responsive. We will ask to stay here again.
Great space for me & the girls!

We had a wonderful stay! Everything was exactly as described, and the place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. We especially loved how close it was to Chinatown—it made getting around and enjoying the area so convenient. Overall, a great stay and we would definitely recommend it!
Cozy place! would visit again :)

My wife and I had a lovely stay at Martha’s place. Everything we needed was there including coffee for the morning. My wife loved sitting out with a glass of wine in the English garden, location was great, in a beautiful neighborhood and steps to nice restaurants and the park
Thanks Martha for everything- we hope to come back again soon to visit your amazing city! Michelle and Jamie
Great host! He was very communicative!
Great location, comfortable beds well, equipped kitchen and very clean. Would highly recommend if you are looking for a good spot where you can get to everything. The L is right outside the door..
Naomi was very friendly, and accommodating. The air bnb is in the perfect location. Everything is in walking distance. Literally less than a 10 minute walk to Wrigley. Would definitely re-book.
Great place to visit if you’re in town to see a game at Wrigley! Tara was very responsive to all of our questions. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in Wrigleyville!

Ron is very welcoming and kind

The home was perfect for sharing with friends. A short walk to the train station although a lady was concerned about our safety and stopped to let us know that we did not need to hang around in the area. We did not encounter any issues.

James is such a wonderful host! He was extremely responsive and helpful. The place itself was gorgeous!
Comfortable stay in a great location! Jessica was proactive and responsive in her communications. Lots of great restaurants nearby and close to multiple bus lines.
I had a great stay at Eric’s beautiful home. He was extremely accommodating and very responsive! Highly recommend a stay here
Good play to stay if youre a solo traveler and mainly just need a place to lay your head at night! Its very close to public transport and walking distance from a lot of great food options

We had a weekend  of Cubs games planned and you can’t get any better than this location. Right across the street with plenty of restaurants and bars close by.  The house was clean and spacious and came with anything you would need to enjoy the weekend.

Jim and Roberto are excellent hosts! The space was well located and pristine. We stayed for a month and felt right at home. Jim and Roberto were super accommodating, kind and caring. Highly recommend booking with them in the future. We will be back!
Great place! Awesome location!!
Very high-quality and would recommend to anyone. Nouri is very generous and will make you feel at home.
Great place to stay at to visit the city! Felt like a safe neighborhood to be around. Friendly host! And description is exactly what you expected to see when staying there! Would recommend!
Great place for a relaxed stay. Good location and amenities. Very friendly and responsive host.

We had a great stay! The house was perfect for our group and exactly what we needed for the weekend. The hosts were super responsive when I needed to contact them upon arrival, which I really appreciated. Everything was easy and straightforward, including checkout- the instructions were simple and reasonable, with none of the excessive checkout requirements you sometimes run into. We felt very comfortable during our stay and had a wonderful experience overall. We would absolutely stay here again!
We had a wonderful weekend staying here. Very clean place and cozy. Great communication from host!

Place was surprisingly quiet for being so close to the tracks. It sounded more like a very strong wind blowing by. Everything was very clean and comfortable. The linens smelled so fresh! The location was easy to get to with lots of public transportation right there. Cyndi kindly checked in to make sure we settled in and if we needed anything. Thank you for having us and we hope to come back to Chicago one day with the kids!
This was a good stay for us. We were in town for a wedding and it worked out perfect. Place was nice and fairly spacious. Noe was a good and prompt communicator.

Everything was very nice, i will say if your on the taller side this place is not it the ceilings are very low. Works well if you short, so it worked for use. Very clean, temperature was nice, enough space for us. Would definitely stay again.

Emily’s place was beautiful and perfect for my first trip to Chicago — not to mention, she was a fabulous host and made sure I had everything I needed! Looking forward to returning here next time I visit Chicago.

Airbnb was great and exactly what we needed! The place was clean, the beds were extremely comfortable and honestly the living spaces were bigger than we expected from the pictures. Venu was extremely responsive and was very accomadating with some last minute requests. Would book again!

Thank you Brad and Matt for a wonderful stay!  I appreciate the easy & timely communication and instructions.  You're home is beautifully decorated (love the hardwood floors), and has everything you could need.  The kitchen was fully equipped. Place is neat and accessible points of interest.

We had such a great stay! The location was perfect and close to so many great local spots, which really gave our group the opportunity to explore a different side of Chicago. Nuestra estadía fue excelente. El departamento tiene una ubicación inmejorable y está increíblemente bien equipado; sin dudas, es el departamento de Airbnb mejor equipado en el que me he hospedado. Todo estaba impecablemente limpio y cuidado.

Gracias por recibirnos tan amablemente!!!

Excellent stay! The apartment was spotless: cleanliness was top-notch, with sheets, towels, and the shower perfectly clean and well organized. Highly recommended—I would definitely stay here again!
We have a nice stay and marijes was very helpful and responsive with any questions we had

One of my favorite air bnbs I’ve been to! It was so cozy and the host was so helpful and communicated very well. Neighborhood very nice, plenty of street parking! Very squeaky clean!

Wonderful place! Perfect for a couple visiting Chicago. A’isha is a great host. Check in and check out were a breeze! Roscoe Village is a lovely, quiet, and walkable neighborhood. We would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Everything worked exactly as described. The apartment was clean, the check-in and check-out instructions and house rules were clear, and the beds were very comfortable. The neighbors were loud at times (which we know can’t be controlled), but other than that it was a still a very good stay!

It was the perfect place for my mom and I. Felt very spacious and we could have stayed even longer. The area is peaceful, felt safe  and was in a lovely neighborhood. And though it’s further from the busy/tourist spots,  it was still easy to get to places.
Great stay! The place was clean and comfortable, and the host was very nice and responsive. Thank you! 😊

Das Zimmer hat sehr viele Vorteile. Great Stay

We had an amazing stay as a group of 9! Had plenty of space and the hosts were very kind & responsive! They gave us great recommendations.
