Highly recommend and would love to stay again!

Beautiful and cozy space, perfect to feel right at home in the area! Plenty of places to visit and shop from, and easily accessible to local transit to get to farther places in Chicago! Would 100% recommend and come back again :)!!
Good spot

This was a fantastic stay. Sarah was incredible responsive and accommodating. The home is spacious, spotless and really comfortable with great beds and a lot of comfortable seating including a really nice rooftop balcony. Parking garage was convenient as well. Well worth it, great experience!

Really enjoyed our stay here. The place is conveniently located and easy to get to many places in downtown. The place itself was clean and nicely put together. Peter was so responsive and helpful anytime we reached out.

Dave’s unit was clean, well decorated, and homey. I was sick while I was in town so I requested an extra set of sheets for my husband to sleep on the couch, and they were super quick to get us set up. The location is perfect, with tons of cafes and restaurants just outside your doorstep.

Me and my guest arrived at different times and the host and staff was very friendly gave thorough instructions for everything!!! This was the best air bnb experience I’ve ever had! I would defiently try my best to stay here again we all loved it
Great little place to stay with a large group with kids! Very cozy!
I would recommend Rashmi’s home to rent ! The home was exceptionally, clean and prepared for us on day one.

Overall, it was good. The apartment was spacious and clean. The host was responsive when we reached out and helped us get an extra key when we got locked out. However, there were some issues with check-in and entering. The door to the apartment is very tricky to open with the key, which resulted in a lot of back and forth for us to be able to enter the building. We were instructed to go through the back door that was unlocked, which is a little worrying. We made sure to bolt it during our stay. Also, we weren't aware that photo IDs were required for all guests in order to receive the check-in instructions. It said guests must be registered, so we thought giving the names/origins/ages was sufficient (which is all they asked for at first). We were surprised when they followed up (after we had given the requested info) and required photo IDs from everyone. I wish the need for IDs had been more clear and had been asked for in the first message they sent that requested everyone's names.

Robert's place is just as described. It is located in Lake View on a beautiful street. Everything is a walkable distance (Wrigley Field, the lake, restaurants, bars). Very clean and huge! We had 6 people and there was plenty of space for all of us. Would definitely stay here again when I need another AirBnB in Chicago. Thanks Robert!
Great time

Stayed at Christina’s place while in town for my daughter’s wedding. Her place was perfect for my out of town family and I to stay together and was within 10 minutes of everywhere we needed to be! She responded to all of my messages in less than an hour, mostly in less than 30 min and her place is just as it’s described. There were 8 of us and we had plenty of room.  A big thank you to Christina for making the “lodging” part of our wedding weekend stress free!
Great affordable option for a place to sleep. Easy location to walk to blue line & local places. Minimal for the room itself, but that reflects in the price.

Although a few unexpected things came up during the stay, Sarah and Drew were understanding and proactive, especially in communicating about how to resolve these specific hiccups. Other than that, it was great to have a space near Soldier Field and explore popular spots in Chicago. Instructions were straightforward and provided in-depth details for the stay.
Great place in a fantastic location! Was a perfect place to stay for myself and my two friends over a long weekend.

Could’ve used another full length mirror or any mirror in 2nd bedroom. A 2nd key or keyless entry would’ve also been nice. Many outlets did not work & were pretty spaced out so we had to unplug things in order to charge all of our devices. Additionally the air flow was minimal in the bedrooms so it got a bit stuffy (even with the doors cracked/open to allow air in from the window unit in the kitchen) so we had to keep the air on ‘high’ most of the time to feel comfortable (common areas cooled fine though). I’d assume the latter 2 are due to the age of the home. The neighborhood was quaint & fairly quiet and was walkable to some restaurants/shops but required a 15-30min uber to other popular neighborhoods (i.e. wicker park, pier, west loop, etc). Overall, we enjoyed our stay here in Chicago!!

The apartment was beautiful and spacious but the location was not perfect for us because we like to use the bus and although we had no issues our Chicago family were concerned and insisted we travel between 7am and 6pm for safety reasons. There would be no issue if we had a car.
Lorenzo the agent was super friendly and helpful. He insisted on carrying my large suitcase up the 3 flights of stairs!

My friends and I really enjoyed staying at Alma’s home, it was truly a great middle ground to go and explore Chicago! The floors did creek  and you could hear the neighbors walking from time to time but our group did not find that to be an issue. Overall, we truly enjoyed staying here as we explored the city!
Location was very convenient and the apartment was very nice for my family and I!

Andy was super super responsive and a wonderful and kind host! The room was great and very convenient close to the Metra. Overall awesome stay!
Lovely space for my and my family.

Ute's place was very unique in an amazing location. I will say the selling point for us was the location. If you're looking for a traditional Airbnb/hotel stay, Ute's home felt more like visiting family. Her house is full of knick knacks and art. The backyard space was something we were wanting since we traveled with our dog but this would be more ideal for a very small dog. The furniture and linens were very clean and comfortable!
Great place to stay for a weekend trip to the city.

Friendly of course!  The neighborhood was peaceful.  Had a great stay and starting to sound repetitive.  Just book it.
Great place to stay! Loved all the little touches in the room!

Very clean and cute inside! Matched pictures exactly. Always helpful with our questions, fast at responding! Would definitely book again!

Everything was great. We had a great time. Loved the room. The only thing that I didnt like is that a safety bar in the shower fell and almost hit my wife. We managed to get it put back on how it was and now im seeing two $20 charges on my account.
We loved our stay here!! Emily was super responsive and a great host. The place is very cute and perfect for our 3 person group! Would definitely recommend!!

I really enjoyed my stay in this adorable garden apartment! Andy was a wonderful host...very responsive and easy to communicate with throughout my stay. The apartment is located on a quiet block with convenient access to the Obama Presidential Center, Hyde Park, and Lake Shore Drive.
The space felt secure, cozy, and comfortable, which made it a great place to relax after being out and about in Chicago. I had a lovely stay and would definitely stay here again when visiting the city.
The place was very nice and well stocked. Everything was clean and appliances were up to date. The host was very helpful and responsive before, during, and after. Would highly recommend.
Jasa was a great host with great response times. Home was cozy and just a short walk to public transportation. Would definitely stay again!

Home interior is nice: clean beds, nice bathroom with good water pressure, lot of tools in the kitchen. Bugs can easily enter the basement though so be careful with crickets and spiders entering as they please. Home owner is quick to respond, which is appreciated. Can get noisy due to the people living upstairs and planes flying overhead.
It’s a great space. Great restaurants nearby three blocks to Wrigley! Having a parking spot is fantastic.
If you’re looking to go to a game, great place to stay! Great communication and easy commute anywhere you want to go.

the listing is clear that the unit has limited amenities, but you should really prepare since it is truly limited! during our 3 night stay we had to do grocery trips for things like toilet paper, soap, scissors, pans, etc., which was expensive and not convenient. the back bedroom smells of an odor so we had to buy air freshener & our own pillow cases. keep this in mind before your stay! it was pretty clean w no dirt or hair (though we found an eye lens contact in one of the beds which was unnerving). know that there are quiet hours for the unit that require lowered voices after 10:30. it was a good stay overall and we made special memories in chicago :)

Is my first time using airbnb as Ive preferred the certainty of hotels but this is a great spot if you plan to be out all day exploring and simply need a safe and clean space to sleep. The host is responsive!

I strongly warn others: DO NOT BOOK either property. I requested accommodations for six guests, but the requests repeatedly came back reduced to two or four. This is my first time in Chicago and this place made me feel like home. It’s very close to CTA. Cute place to stay. Next time I will book it again.

Tysheena and her husband were quick to respond to any questions I had. The house was beautiful inside, spacious living room and kitchen. Bedrooms and beds were comfortable. We Ubered everywhere and had groceries delivered, address was easy to find. Neighborhood was nice and quiet. We enjoyed our stay!
Rooms for a group with 2.5 bathrooms was very helpful. Comfortable & stylish home
Loved the apartment. Excellent location. Good communication with the host.
Great place to stay for a quick weekend trip in Chicago! The hosts went above and beyond with the extra snacks and water which we appreciated so much after a long day of traveling.

Our stay was great! The home was clean, welcoming and safe. Sarah was an excellent host. One of the most responsive and thoughtful I’ve encountered. Perfect home for a girls getaway. We will definitely return. Thanks again Sarah!
Responsive host. Lots of rooms which is great for the price. Airbnb had a few issues I wish we learned about in advance. Some of the rooms had some disturbing poems and art hung up on the doors.

Some friends and I stayed in Milan's place for a concert. There was plenty of room in the apartment for all of us, large closets and bathrooms. We could also walk easily to the stadium so that was convenient. I would definitely stay here again.
Good location with access to Chicagos transit system.
I loved this home! It had ultra luxurious amenities and a lot of high-tech amenities as well and the roof rooftop deck was the icing on a cake! Will definitely stay here again
The place was nice and tidy. We had an impromptu guest join us but Leah agreed the request which eased my mind a lot more. I loved the recs she gave as well places to eat and hang out for our stay!
Great location.  Was under 30 mins to everything we wanted to do.  Nice location next to a great park with cool food trucks
Was a great area! Really close to Chinatown and the Greenline.
Nice and clean place. Walking distance to a lot of well known places in Chicago and close to a public transit station.

Mera’s place was perfect for our trip to Chicago. Plenty of local restaurant, bar, and shopping options available within walking distance. Record shops, book stores, cafe’s, and interesting bar options were nice to have as conveniences.
The apartment was located in a quiet neighborhood, was tastefully furnished, well decorated, clean, and comfortable. Mera communicated all the necessary details and was very responsive when we had any questions. It would have been nice to have had maybe some beverage or snack options available in the apartment aside from the coffee provided, but not expected.
Highly recommend this place and would revisit with no hesitation.

The Airbnb was just as described! It is located in a safe neighborhood and convenient location to go anywhere. The hosts were very communicative and helpful! We enjoyed every bit of our stay. Thank you so much  for hosting us with such a clean and wonderful place!

Amazing team! They respond so fast and were so helpful, friendly, and accommodating. The location is crazy for the price! The views from the windows are amazing too. The place was spotless and even the front desk staff of the complex were really helpful as well. 10/10 would recommend and would rebook again.
Great place to stay with easy access to trains and downtown, perfect for a weekend trip.
The host was very responsive and allowed us an early check in when we asked for a place to stage our luggage. Thanks Cody!!!!

We had a lovely stay at Zee’s house. Zee is a very nice and responsive host. The home is exactly as described, clean, comfortable beds and roomy enough for our family of 7. One of the best Airbnb’s we have stayed in. Highly recommend!

Enjoyed a long weekend staying at Carissa’s place. Easy to locate based on provided instructions. Had some trouble with gaining initial access but the hosts were so responsive and helpful, we sorted it out right away! The space was clean and so nicely located. Would definitely recommend.
Our stay was exceptional. The location was excellent, and Assel proved to be a remarkable host.
Great Stay … highly recommended
This home is perfect for a family/group who wants to stay near the Wrigleyville neighborhood. Peacefull, quiet, and very comfortable home.
Love the place! Great for family

The entire place was so beautiful and a great stay! The place was clean and a great space to host 5 people total. It is a little bit of a trek upstairs but it isn’t too terrible, the instructions to get inside were clear. It was also very helpful that there was parking on the premise, especially in this bush neighborhood. My only complaint is that the AC kept changing to a warmer temperature by itself and we had to keep changing it every night.
Loved it!

Victor was a great host. Extremely communicative, friendly, and helpful. You can’t beat the location, but know space is limited. What else would you expect when being able to sleep 14!! Space being limited was not a downfall for our group at all. Plenty to do in the area and close to the lake. Would absolutely stay again.
Beautiful place with an excellent location, spotless cleanliness, and awesome amenities. Only minor downfall is some train noise, but it's totally bearable. Would definitely stay again!
Great place. Really walkable, great view and tons of food/activities around. Also really appreciated the roller beds
Everything was exactly as advertised!

We stayed at Tom’s place so my husband and I with 3 of our 4 children, their spouses and our grandkids could all be together to attend the 4th child’s wedding   It’s actually 3 units and we rented both. The house was situated well to walk for coffee and breakfast and grocery stores. It was easy to get to activities during the day to entertain the grands and evening events for the wedding. We all fit nicely, having plenty of space for all 7 adults 3 children and an infant. We all agreed we’d stay here again in the future

I picked this place based on the pictures. And since it was my first time in Chicago to visit my son in college, I needed a place within a reasonable distance but still comfortable and relaxing.
It met our basic needs of a place to lay our heads, the air conditioning worked great and the shower water pressure and heat were also very good. Mattresses were comfortable. Still was responsive overall (if it was too late we would get a response early next morning).
Check in & out instructions were clear but difficult for us to find at night since there wasn’t much lighting at the side entrance door and there’s a lot of foliage around the place.

We really enjoyed our stay! The apartment looked just like the pictures and was in a great location, very close to everything we wanted to experience in Chicago. Most downtown areas were only about 10 minutes or less away, which was super convenient.
The kitchen was one of my favorite parts of the apartment. It was well stocked with everything we needed to make breakfast and cook during our stay.
Parking is street parking, so it could be a little challenging at times but we were always able to find a spot. Our host was very kind, respectful, and communicative. She checked in with us and made sure we arrived safely, which I really appreciated.
Overall, we had a great experience and I would definitely stay here again. I’d recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago!
Disappointed. I will gladly provide insights and photos to Bella.

This was a perfect place to stay at for a girls weekend. The place was very clean and had everything we needed. The location was perfect to enjoy shopping, food, and nightlife in the Fulton Market/West Loop area. Thomas was friendly, flexible, and responsive. He was proactive in giving specific directions to get into the unit, which made a seamless arrival. We hope to stay here again in the future!

Katty’s place met our needs for a wonderful summer weekend in Chicago. Easy access to the building and we felt very safe in our surroundings. The place was ready for everything we needed plus extra stock of essentials. I would love to book again in the future!

great place to stay!!! spacious, minus the bathroom. Clean!! Quiet neighborhood. Responsive host :)! It is a bit far from places that you may want to commute to, we had a rental and host provided parking passes.

My family and I really enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb! The host was very responsive, accommodating, and easy to communicate with. The house was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. We also loved how close it was to so many tourist attractions and convenient spots. We had a wonderful stay and would definitely book again when we’re back in Chicago!
Really enjoyed my stay!  I would book her every time I come to Chicago.  Great location!

This property is located directly next to a train track, a fact that was not disclosed in the listing. We booked it for three nights so we could spend time with our son, who lives in the neighborhood. However, as soon as we checked in, we realized that the train noise was unbearable.We were unable to sleep the entire night and decided to check out the following morning and move to a hotel. We attempted to contact Ryan, but unfortunately did not receive a timely response.We reported the issue to Airbnb and provided video and audio evidences. To Airbnb’s credit, they reviewed the situation and refunded one night of our stay.What made the experience even more disappointing was the value for money. We paid approximately 30% more than the rate of a five-star hotel in downtown, yet the accommodation was extremely small and felt more comparable to a one-star hotel in terms of quality and amenities. Had the proximity to the train tracks been disclosed in the listing, we would not have booked.
This was a great place to stay with a large group! Adam was super responsive and we had a great time. Checkout was a breeze!

We wad a great stay at Abe’s place. The house was very comfortable for a large group and had great gathering spaces for hanging out. Abe was proactive in checking in with us and was very welcoming. Would recommend staying here with a large group!

Awesome place!  Great location, very nice inside, perfect setup for a big group.  Close to bars and restaurants, very nice part of the city.  Also a short walk to beach.  Alexandra was very helpful as well and very easy to communicate with before, during, and after stay.  Highly recommend!
The place was absolutely amazing! Felt like I was right at home. Close to the stores and there’s a gorgeous park across the street to relax in.
Friendly host and location was great. House was spacious and having an extra full bathroom was great for getting ready in the mornings. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

My mom and I had a great time and experience staying here. It was easy to access, the place was very clean and secure. We made friends with the other family staying there for the concert. Overall a very pleasant experience and would recommend anyone who wants to stay here in the future. :)
It was a cute place, the area is a bit sketch but nothing terrible. The instructions on check out and wifi password on the fridge is a bit outdated but isn’t an issue or anything

We had a wonderful stay in this charming apartment! We were in town for a Cubs game, and the location is incredible -- only about 1.8 miles from Wrigley and in a quiet and friendly neighborhood with lots of places nearby, all a short walk away. Our host Joe was incredibly proactive and responsive with anything we needed to know. Free coffee was a bonus. We'd definitely rent here again in the future.

this was my first time staying at a shared house and it was honestly not a bad experience. the host is respectful and responsive whenever you have a question. the home is clean and cozy. it’s a little warm in the other areas of the home but at least the bedroom i stayed in had a little ac in it. the neighborhood is super cute (in my opinion) the neighbors minded their business and it was pretty easy to park close to the home. walking to nearest train station was easy too. one thing negative i will say, be aware of surroundings if you are going to be walking outside of the neighborhood because a friend and i got catcalled a bunch of times and people driving tried to stop us on our way to the train. happy travels and be safe everyone!!

We were in Chicago for a wedding and stayed the weekend with four of us.  The location in Bucktown was perfect with the wedding and reception being nearby.  The unit was very clean with two main bedrooms and two bathrooms.  We especially liked the one stall garage that came with the rental.  All in all we were very please with the rental and would do it again.

I don’t even know where to start! This place is absolutely spectacular. It’s humongous and historic and luxurious! We felt like royalty! And it was a block from the most spectacular beach!
And there’s a fun surprise treasure hunt for every guest!
Sean is super nice and responsive. He was so helpful and accommodating. I hated to leave!
Thank you again for being one of the top air bnb hosts of all time!

We loved our stay here! We were in town for a concert so it was a short stay but the location was great in a very safe neighborhood. Ed was very helpful and checked in with us a lot, even making sure he was available for check in. There was plenty of parking, and going in and out of the unit was easy you don’t mind a few stairs. We would definitely stay again!

We had a great time, the location was fantastic and very walkable to restaurants and local amenities . Naomi's place was perfect for five old friends annual reunion. Naomi was very gracious and allowed us an earlier check time which we appreciated.
We would definitely stay there again.
Great place to stay. Thank you so much!
I loved this place! Clean and homey, everything was as described  and I felt safe there.
I recommend this as a great option in Logan Square. It’s a large space with comfortable accommodations and easy access to the CTA.

I read reviews and some folks noted that there was sound from the street outside but we personally found it quiet, and Kim kindly provided disposable earplugs just in case! Excellent location, not hard to get where we needed to go downtown but also plenty within walking distance of Kim’s place.
Good spot!
I really liked that the host was very responsive and good with communication, and checked in to know if needs were met and that I was comfortable during my stay. They’re amazing hosts.

We had a great time, nice clean and spacious apartment, cute views, and so close to Chinatown. Plenty of things to do in walking distance and a short drive for more. Street parking was always available nearby (paid 9am-10pm m-sat). Felt good and private. We'd stay there again!
We personally had no problem as we're all heavy sleepers, but it should be noted it is RIGHT next to/above the train line and is a little loud even with windows closed. We got used to it pretty quickly though and in general its a bonus to be so close to the public transit station for getting around!

We had an amazing stay!! I can’t say enough good things. The place was so nice and spacious, the beds were super comfy, and the host had very clear instructions. Great place to stay after seeing BTS :)

House was very nice. Everything was as described. Great location very close to downtown area. Rooms were really nice. TV’s in three of the rooms. Back patio is a nice sitting area but bring bug spray. We had a great stay! FYI: If you don’t like super think fat pillows I suggest you bring your own because they were not comfortable. Beds are memory foam and form to your body. There are a lot of no smoking signs posted everywhere so if you are a smoker and you smoke outside, there is no smoking on the premises. So prepare to smoke in your car or the sidewalk if you do. Overall very nice place!
Stay was good

Se encuentra en una zona bastante tranquila, algo alejada del Downtown pero con fáciles accesos. Considerar que no hay muchas tiendas o restaurantes cercanos. La amenidades son tal como se describen en las fotos
Great stay in walking distance to several restaurants and local parks for my dog. Hosts were very quick to respond to any needs. Would definitely recommend!

The place was really cute, clean, and comfortable. The air conditioner worked great that’s something that’s important to me. The bed is comfortable. My boys slept on the pull out sofa. They said that was not to comfortable but pull out sofas never are. The kitchen has everything you need and then some available. There’s a little store right next to it on the corner that you can buy just about everything. The prices in the store were cheap compared to any other little store that we had visited in Chicago. I felt safe taking my dog around the corner. There’s a little grass area. Lots of people walking dogs lots of people walking around. I felt safe. It’s a little noisy it is on the main road and there are sirens and different city sounds. That did not bother us. We are from Dayton Ohio so there’s lots of that anyways used to it. I would definitely book this place again if we come back to Chicago.

The place is very cozy and is definitely the most stocked up Airbnb I have ever stayed it, we had 7 people and could’ve used the supplies/amenities for way longer than we stayed. The location is also great with stores, food spots , and the public transit all within very easy walking distance.
The airbnb was in the perfect place for what we wanted to do. There were also many hidden gems in walking distance. I would go again in a heartbeat.

We really enjoyed Adam’s place! The location was close to public transport so it was easy to get to and from. Close to many great restaurants. The place itself was comfortable and quiet. Had everything we needed. We definitely would come back and stay here again!

I loved this space, very spacious and clean! Only thing for me is it was a bit stuffy/humid in the room and we could not figure out the AC without messaging but never got a response but eventually figured it out. Very clean space, living room is big, shower is nice. Thank you for a great stay!
Very clean building, almost felt sterile which was fantastic. Comfortable bedroom, cute kitchen space.
We had an amazing stay! The unit was spacious and clean. The views were some of the best in the city and it's in a great area. I would 100% stay here again!
This is a good place to stay if you need a place ASAP and don’t have the means for a downtown hotel. Hosts are responsive and it was easy to locate during check in!
Nice place, walkable to places and quiet neighborhood.
Awesome, unique, pristine, cool! Great location too!

Great communication , check in was easy and apartment was extremely clean.  Loved the location! Within walking distance to many restaurants and public transportation. We had a wonderful stay. Thank you Brian!

We stayed here to attend the BTS concert in Chicago. Due to the event, my friends and I were on a bit of a time crunch and Joseph was kind enough to accommodate an early check in for us! Greatly appreciated as it helped the rest of the day go smoothly! The place itself was clean and super comfy. We used public transportation to get around for most of our stay, and the location was close enough for convenience, but far enough that we felt safe and comfortable in a more peaceful and private area. We walked around a lot during our stay and discovered many local gems! I’d stay here again!

This was our second time staying over at Fernando's airbnb and he truly is an amazing host. He provides everything a guest could need and is fast at responding to any questions or small issues that come up. Would definitely recommend staying here.

We had a great stay in Chicago at Heather's place. She was a very responsive and helpful host, and provided good local recommendations. The apartment was as described and very convenient. The neighborhood was very cute with lots of great restaurants. We were able to walk or easily take the bus to get around. Highly recommend!

Surrounding area is not good, but home interior is fair enough. Plenty of space, more than 6 people can accommodate.
It's good have another bathroom.

Definitely go for the location. Apartment itself is very basic, toilet and shower could use an upgrade, but the bed was comfortable. So if you’re just looking for a central spot to clean, it’s pretty good.
Great location! Extremely walkable to shops and restaurants. The one shower for our group of four adults was challenging but we made it work.

Super close to Chinatown, Train, Buses. Parking can be a little tricky. We opted to leave our car and Uber to Chinatown every day (approx 12 dlls). We took the water taxi and train where we needed. The place is small and cozy, perfect for someone prioritizing experiences over luxury stays. This was perfect for my mom and I. Amelia was kind and flexible, she allowed us to check in early as we arrived in Chicago earlier than expected.

Excellent location with easy access to trains and restaurants. The hosts were responsive and communicative, and the spacious apartment was sunny and relatively quiet.
Unfortunately, there were unexpected issues that affected the stay. A secondary set of host policies and ID requirements felt intrusive and an app-based entry cumbersome. The “skyline views” in the description were skylights and windows facing an internal patio. The apartment also felt somewhat unfinished, with some nonfunctional outlets, poor lighting fixtures and very limited hot water.
Overall, we appreciated the location, space in general, and the accessibility of the hosts, but the combination of these issues made the experience less comfortable than expected, particularly considering the final cost of a three-night stay.

We loved this place! The interior is super modern with a cute brick exterior. Check‑in was super easy. The living room, kitchen, basement, and bathrooms were all beautifully updated. Each bedroom had a TV, a small table, and a closet. The host provided blankets, pillows, towels, shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. The kitchen was fully stocked with utensils, pots, pans, and other essentials.
Street parking was easy, and we felt secure with the door locks and alarm system. The basement had games, plus a washer and dryer. If you’re sensitive to noise, we’d recommend an upstairs bedroom, the A/C makes a loud sound in the basement room, but otherwise the house and neighborhood were very quiet.
Checkout was smooth. We did accidentally miss the outdoor trash bin because we were rushing out, but the instructions were clear — that was on us.
Location is super close to a smaller but lovely beach and about 15–20 minutes from downtown.
Danisha was incredibly responsive and helpful!

We had an amazing time staying at this apartment. The place was spotless, views were gorgeous during day and magical at night time. Just a short subway ride to downtown, close to so many groceries, Wholefoods, Trader Joe's, and shopping and great restaurants. The roof top pool and hot tubs are amazing if you have kids. Can't recommend this place more. One of the best Airbnbs we've ever stayed at.

This is my first Airbnb stay ever and I can say that this was the perfect place for my mom and I. Everything was super beautiful, thank you! The only thing that was difficult is no space to park at night.

Functional, no frills accommodation at a good price in the northern end of the city of Chicago. Neighborhood is nice and lively although a bit displaced from Chicago's mainstream tourist attractions. if you are interested in this, it's best exploited if you have a car (easy parking in front of the place helps). Apartment is fairly big, although it does not invite much to spend much time in it as the furniture and decor are at the minimum. Room is certainly good to crash for the night - quiet and with comfy bed. In general the space is clean although it would benefit from a renovation. Host is cool, communicates efficiently and made check-in easy. Since my priority when I am in the city is to keep a budget I will certainly keep this in mind for future stays
My friend and I had a great stay here! The room was very nice, clean, and spacious. The stairs to get to the room were a bit difficult but the room was definitely worth it!
Great place super comfortable and easy to walk around, also the restaurant right in front of the place was a plus for us! Would recommend and definitely would book again! :)
This place was very comfortable.  My family and I enjoyed it. The host was great at communicating.  Parking was easy.I would go back again

The location was super convenient—the train station to downtown was just a short walk away. It’s in a great neighborhood, too. Kavin was so responsive and made sure our stay went off without a hitch. Everything was just as described!

Very near orange line which was convenient. Bus 62 was quite a walk though if you go to chinatown… I was lucky enough to have polite and nice housemates.
Only thing I didn’t like was the stairs to the second floor. I wish there was a hallway light when you come home late, had to use my phone flashlight as light.
Overall, worth what I paid for. Thanks!
Great place in a great location. Responsive host.
This was a fun place to stay for my family of 4. Great location.
Josh was a great host and the house is great. We enjoyed our stay and Josh was very helpful and communicated well. I would stay here again.

David was an excellent host. He met my group and I at the location to ensure we had a smooth experience checking-in. He was very proactive in communicating with us, and the space had everything we could ask for. We would definitely consider staying at David's place the next time we're in the area and will be recommending him to my friends and family.

We stayed here as two girls, and felt safe and comfortable as if it were our own home! We didn’t have a car, but utilized the train and uber. Easy pick up and drop off with uber. With the train, the airport is a short ride! The amenities were above and beyond with towels, dishes, paper towels, and TV with Netflix 😁 It is an extremely spacious Airbnb. Rita was also friendly and a fast responder! If I were to move to Chicago, I would want to live somewhere like this. When I visit again, I would love to stay here at this Airbnb again. Thank you Rita!
Good neighborhood and clear instructions. Good communication and was just as pictured.

Great location and the layout was ideal for an Airbnb. Smooth stay other than being asked to pay for early check-in the day of, when I requested from booking 6 months prior. They did end up waiving it but good thing to communicate for future renters.
Great place to stay and not too far from downtown where we explored Chicago.

Great stay! The location was convenient, with a quick walk to the Belmont station, making it easy to get around Chicago. The check-in and house instructions were clear and easy to follow. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend this Airbnb!

I really enjoyed my stay. The unit was clean and looked just like the pictures. The neighborhood is quiet, and I felt safe during my entire safe. The hosts are friendly and respond quickly to messages. I would stay here again!
We loved staying at Matt’s place! It was lovely and the neighborhood had so many great restaurants and shops to look around. We would definitely love to come again!

It was just as described! Very safe neighborhood, enought to walk around at night. Street parking was a bit iffy but doable. Near the city and walkable to a fun science museum. Overall it was a nice stay.

I stayed at Jakob's apartment for a long weekend with my daughter, my sister, and two of my nephews. We were there for BTS concerts at Soldier Field and the hotels were pretty much all booked or crazy overpriced. All of that aside, I absolutely loved this apartment. It was spotless, probably the cleanest place I have ever stayed at. There were plenty of towels and having a washer and dryer there helped so much. There were also board games which the kids really enjoyed. We were five people and had plenty of space. The bus stop is only about a 3 minute walk away and takes you straight downtown. The neighborhood felt safe and peaceful. Thank you Jakob!
nice place like 25 minutes from downtown
Wonderful from start to finish.  Beautifully designed and decorated apartment.  Would stay again and recommend!
Our stay at this listing was absolutely wonderful. The original charm and warm neighborhood vibe were as advertised. It was very spacious and accommodating for our large party of 10.
It was very great price for the area. Will recommend it to any and everyone
Great host and great space, it was clean and easy to find and the instructions left by the host were easy to follow. Would definitely stay with this host again next time I am in Chicago
Had an amazing stay at this Airbnb - Jennifer and Ben were very accommodating hosts and we would stay at a listing of theirs again any time!
Clean, great location, flexible arrival time. Exactly as described!
Emily was friendly and the place was clean

Stayed here for a couple days with my friend to attend the BTS concerts in soldier field! It was super cute and close to the train station so getting around the city was easy. Will definitely be staying here again if I’m ever in Chicago.

Gabriel and Theresa both have been really great and proactive with their communication, and very responsive to any questions we had. We booked their place to attend BTS at Soldier Field. We rented a car to help us get around and didn't have any trouble finding free parking around the house. Booked this place for 6 but one of friends couldn't make it at the last minute. Good amount of space for our party.
24 hr Taco restaurant next door was fantastic! Would definitely book again if we are to return to Chicago.
Thank you Brad from letting me stay at your Airbnb! He responds fast, very friendly and nice . Will definitely book again with him !
The air bnb matched the description and had a good view. It was very peaceful, no loud noises happening late at night.

I loved the location we were at, we had a concert at soldier field so being so close really helped with needing to get there on a good time. Having an assigned parking spot is very accommodating and convenient. The place was very big and cozy I would definitely stay again!

Jose and Sela were responsive and helpful, they were also very open minded about some changes and their rules. The neighborhood was quiet and nice, but since we were at the bottom floor we were able to hear about everything the upstairs neighbors did when we stayed home.
Very nice!

When we first booked with Armando, we had questions about the neighborhood, he never got back to us or answered our questions. This is a 'basic' airbnb, toilet paper was provided and towels, but there were used shampoo, body wash, & used bar of soap laying around on the sink. When we went to sleep, we saw a few curly hair on our pillows. The 2nd day in, his son came over to pick veggies from the garden - without notification.
Before we left, there was an unexpected incident involving one of the couch seat. We cleaned and addressed the area as thoroughly as we could before leaving, b4 check out time. Armando asked us how the situation would be handled, as there were no specific fee or charge for incidents like these, there was a brief disagreement regarding the matter. I asked him to provide documentation of the expense before reimbursing him, as of today - he has yet responded back to my messages.

The place was nice and clean, all of the amenities were amazing. Ervin was a great host and easy to talk too. Street parking is a little hard to find but there is a garage that is able to fit one car.

We were looking for a place that was walkable to Soldier Field and this was perfect! It was about a 20 minute walk.
The Mexican restaurant downstairs is excellent and we found two great places for breakfast nearby.
The apartment was quiet and very clean. The beds are comfortable and the bathrooms are spacious and clean. An amazing amount of storage space for an airbnb. Closets and dressers in each room. Would definitely stay again!

Overall nice place to stay for my trip of 8 people (including 2 kids). Made use of the items included in the kitchen which was stocked with utensils, cups, knives and pots/pans. Bathrooms were clean and spacious. The mattress and pillows for some of the rooms were well used and could use replacement. Linens often came undone through the night. Reached out to the host on a couple items that needed some care after our stay and hopefully they acted on them. For example, flickering lights in the basement, wobbly and leaking toilet in the downstairs bathroom, and a broken wifi cable. A decent location away from the craziness of downtown but not too far out. Quiet neighboorhood and we felt safe.

The surrounding area was really great and there are many things nearby, so the location was perfect. The only issue we had was with the cleanliness: most things were dirty, the bed had a yellow stain, there was mold on the bathroom curtains, and there was dust under the bed. The chairs and the fridge were dirty, and it smelled a bit off. Additionally, the microwave didn't heat up that well, there wasn't much gas left in the stove just one of them worked, and the lobby smelled terrible. But other than that, it's in a very convenient location.
A great stay!

My stay was exactly as expected in the listing. I came in late from the airport and had no trouble getting to the place. Alfredo messaged with lock instructions and all in all, I am very satisfied with my stay. Thank you very much!
Really liked Asiyat’s place. Asiyat was very helpful and accommodating. I will definitely consider staying there again the next time I’m in Chicago.
This was the perfect spot for our group. Highly recommend if you’re going to check out Wrigleyville.

Jay’s place was a solid stay with a great location. Pretty easy access to Hyde Park and downtown. Parking on‑site and being on the bottom floor were huge perks. The kitchen had all the utensils/cookware plus a variety of spices but we couldn’t find a scrubber or brush to scrub the stainless steel pans. The smoke detector was sensitive (we heard the upstairs neighbor’s also go off, so I think that’s just a builder’s choice issue) , and the door lock took me a bit to get used to, but nothing that ruined the stay. Only suggestion: more toilet paper for larger groups. Overall, a nice spot and  convenient.

Excellent location for access to Soldier Field. Sometimes Michigan Ave is a little noisy at night but the bedrooms we had were far enough from the windows so we didn’t hear the street noise. We were upgraded to a more spacious unit which was very appreciated. There are several decent dining options in the neighborhood.
Enjoyed our stay!

Marrianne and Jeff are amazing hosts. I would totally stay at their place again if I need to stay nearby Chicago Downtown area. Its close enough to drive less than 10min to Downtown but far enough to escape the crazy traffic!
Had a great weekend stay!

Charming little apartment in a quiet section of Logan Square, very close to some local parks/playgrounds and about a 15-20 minute walk to the Logan Square L stop. Ryan and Josie were great communicators and very proactive and accommodating.

Great location for our visit with family in the Lakeview area.  We were a bit hesitant before arrival about the address, but very pleased with the building itself.  The gated entrance faces a busy street, but the apartment building looks onto a nicely landscaped courtyard.  The interior was as described.  We had some very hot days and the two window AC units with the overhead fan were able to keep up.  The proximity to Whole Foods, Target/CVS and LA Fitness gym was clutch.  I would recommend Alma’s place to anyone with a short to medium stay.  We were there for 10 nights.  One set of sheets and towels without a washing machine for much longer would have been a challenge.
Great stay host was wonderful and gave us some amenities I would definitely book again nice neighborhood.

Great location, like 2 blocks from redline and 2 blocks to beach and the neighborhood felt safe and friendly! Host checked in on us (via message) to confirm things were well, which was nice.
Get a bleu burger at Moody's, great local burger spot!
Bed was comfy and the A/c and fans kept the place cool on a hot August weekend.
Only downsides were: the water pressure/temperature was real finicky and there were minimal cooking supplies for use. Wasn't a big deal to us and made it work, just figured others might want to know in case they're not planning on eating out as much or staying longer. All in all place was clean, comfy and was what we needed and expected!

This home is in a great location. Lots of necessities were close by and it was easy if you’re planning on going to downtown Chicago. Charming neighborhood with good local restaurants.  Home was very clean and had everything we needed in it. If we go back to Chicago, we will absolutely stay here again!

It was amazinggggggg me and my cousin had such a blast 💓 Stephen and Beatrice where amazing hosts and the Airbnb was such a relaxing place to go back to after our adventures. The Horse was soo cute 😍 and chickens had so much personality. Thank you both so much for a great stay!

Place was as advertised and matched the pics. Responsive and friendly host. Very walkable, which was key. Was tough to find street parking but we figured that would be the case. Would stay here again.

The accommodation of the place was accurate.  Both host were very attentive to our needs. We have no complaints at all. I even asked the host to call me because I was a little confused about where to place the recycling and garbage and he stayed on the phone with me the whole time.  Thank you for being great host.

We had a great time staying at the place! It had everything we needed, and whenever we had a question or needed anything, Arantza was very responsive and made sure we were comfortable throughout our stay. Having parking available was also a great convenience. We truly felt right at home and would definitely recommend this place to others!
This place was beyond amazing, right away it felt like home away from home, the bathroom was beautiful! And the host was amazing and very easy to talk to, thank you for the amazing experence!!
Bridget was a great host and her apartment was amazing! Very spacious - our party was of 4 but 6 would fit easily! Clean and fully functional! Right next to the bus stop.
Host was very friendly and always responsive to our questions. The place was very spacious and provided a lot of privacy. The neighborhood also felt very safe for any solo travelers
Solid spot . Perfect for our bachelor party weekend with a large group .
Great stay made easy by Shaun

It was so lovely to stay at Kimberly's home. Actually,  when I checked in I knew it was going to be wonderful because there were butterflies and a hummingbird fluttering around in her front garden. Our stay was perfect and would definitely book again!

Perfect for a cubs game. Bus stop is located right across the street from the house. Restaurants are walking distance. Great place to stay. Great furnishings !  We would definitely stay again. Thank you for sharing your home with us.
We had a great stay, beds were big and comfortable and it was in a great location super close to bars and food.

This place accommodated our party perfectly! We each had our own space and were able to rest comfortably. The host was EXCELLENT!! We were upgraded at no cost, accommodated our last minute changes with ease, and was very attentive to our needs! Truly made our experience here great!
I would totally recommend this place to anybody who wants to come visit this beautiful city!
It was a comfortable place to stay.  All the instructions were clear and Mimi communicated with us promptly. We would like to stay there again!
Had an amazing time at David's place! Area is very welcoming and the host gave me plenty of quality recommendations. Nearby to Wrigley Field and easy to get around.
Amir’s place was a great stay for myself and my guests! His place was exactly as described and he was great with offering instructions as well as support with any questions or concerns!
We had a fun time and great location

Didn't have any trouble with my stay, easy parking in the front. Really no issues. I will say the inside of the building is kind of old but for the price you overlook those things. This isn't anything fancy and overall other guests in the airbnb staying were respectful. There's no noise. ONLY minor issue was that the water in the shower was kind of cold even when I was running the water for a few minutes. Other guests staying with me had the same issue. First time it was warm, then the other times even when I waited it was luke-warm cold at best. I didn't care so much for the summer, but just something to consider. I'm not sure how long you have to run the water for to get it warmed up but I gave it a good 5 minutes. Other than that, you get what you pay for. About a 20min commute by car to downtown...maybe an hour by train for those not familiar with the Chicago area. Thanks again for the stay.
Great location for what we needed. Host was also very responsive.

As everyone said the train is right outside you can literally look down out your window watching it from above. So be aware if you are a light sleeper its consistent. We had music playing over it at night so rarely noticed. Loved that there were so many places in walking distance. The apartment was very clean the bed nice and comfy and the kitchen had the basic utensils and even some extras that we were able to use to make meals during our stay.
Host is good at communicating (quick responses).
Perfect location for a couple of Cubs gms. Will def use again.
This was an absolutely beautiful and cozy place to stay for my trip to Chicago! Had some cute and good restaurants nearby! Definitely recommend booking this home for your trip!!

Anna’s place was in a great location, super clean, and felt like home.  She was very responsive.   The rooftop hangout was gorgeous.  Super close to Fulton Market area and downtown conveniently in Westtown. We will be back and would highly recommend Anna’s place!
Beautiful apartment, even more space than it seemed from the photos and an awesome location! Hosts were responsive and attentive. Would stay again.

A group of us stayed here for a few days and really liked the space. It was clean, comfy and in a nice, walkable area. There were lots of food and shopping options right around the corner. It was also super easy for us to catch a rideshare when we exploring other parts of the city. I would definitely stay here again!
A nice place to stay
We enjoyed our stay at Maya’s place! She communicated very well and was always available for anything we needed. The location could be a bit uneasy at first but overall safe.

Our group absolutely loved staying here!! We came to Chicago for a BTS concert, but made a big trip out of it with the intentions of exploring around the city. We adored being in the Pullman area, especially taking walks in the mornings to the Pullman welcome center with the coffee shop! The house itself was very pretty, and we also enjoyed sitting on the back porch at night after getting home from our outings! Everything was clean and tidy, parking was NEVER a problem. We would definitely stay here again.

I would definitely stay at this airbnb again! It was in such a great neighborhood and really close to public transportation.  It was very spacious for my booking of 8 and we didn't have any noise issues with neighbors or outside.
Cozy as can be ! Perfect weekend getaway spot. Great location to explore.
absolute no, a very unsafe location and the host was very unresponsive

This was a lovely place to stay in for our trip to Chicago! The place was as described; very clean and spacious. It was really easy to locate parking, the building, and the front door.
Some things to note:
- As mentioned by others, there is a Zumba class within the building, and can be heard while in the kitchen. However, despite the class being at 8:30am, it did not bother us one bit!
- Also, a very convenient location for public transportation to the city.
All in all, a very peaceful and beautiful place. Jesus was amazing at communicating. Definitely would stay here again!
Everything was amazing. Prompt! Attentive ! Excellent communication! Hands down we will be back! Thank you !
Great place for the price paid, public transportation isn’t too far away, the decor was also very cute. We really enjoyed and appreciate staying there.

Amazing stay here, Muzzamil was always helping me in every single thing that I asked for, and gave us clear instructions, his place was bigger than we expected, everything was so clean, we loved the bedrooms, their closets were so bigger, and the beds and linens were so perfect, the living room’s couch was so cozy, we had amazing days here. Was easy to find parking even when it’s a busy street, only one night we struggled to find parking, but at the end we found a space, Muzzamil helped us a lot with the parking permit.
The recommended cafeteria was just perfect too, lovely neighborhood and close to Chicago’s downtown and all the places that we needed and wanted to visit. My husband was really happy with the place, also we met the building landlord and he was so polite and friendly.
Definitely we recommend this place for long and shorts stays.

Great time and convenient location with plenty of parking in the area. Only wish we had an additional fob to access the elevator - which made some logistics complicated as we had people coming and going.
Beautiful space, very clear instructions on check in. Short walking distance to train station. Would definitely stay here again.

Wonderful stay - Min was extremely responsive and helpful at check-in. The apartment was just as it was pictured - spotless, and had very nice amenities such as coffee, water, microwave popcorn, etc. And the location is great - quiet, tree-lined neighborhood.

Jean’s place was exactly as pictured with sufficient space to accommodate our group of 10 adults and 2 toddlers. Enough room to comfortably spread out and comfy enough for all to sit down and enjoy meals together. The surrounding location is under rejuvenation and that was good to see as I am originally from Chicago and the proximity of this area. Our family felt totally save and comfortable. The kids room was a win for my grandchildren, their space (including back yard) was a welcome gift to active toddlers. The 2-car garage was a plus, but on-street parking was available and Jean provides parking permits. Check-in/check-out were both effortlessly.
Would recommend Jean’s place and plan to utilize it again if available for our annual Chicago family trip.
Great stay! Perfect location! We go to Chicago every year and this is the best BNB we have stayed in!!

John's place was incredible to stay in.  It was exactly as described in the listing and had plenty of room to relax while in town.  Convenient parking was available which was greatly appreciated.  This location was also perfect as it was in walkable distance from all kinds of activities and businesses.  I would most certainly stay at John's place again in the future.
this place was the perfect stay for the bts tour! beatrice was extremely helpful and communicative, and was accommodating. spacious, clean, and great air conditioning. would book again!
Gorgeous location, gorgeous space!  Loved the view from the window. The location was perfect, nature and shops. Highly recommend.
We would stay here again anytime! Beautiful home in a great location and Nick was super responsive and helpful!

This was the perfect weekend spot in Chicago! The location was perfect. Close to Red line for transportation, parking included, and just very cozy place to stay. Perfect for a couples trip and exploreing Chicago. The host was amazing and very responsive. Definitely would stay here every time.
It was a nice place to stay at and very close to Chinatown.
Great stay, very clean, central location, with all you need!

We had a great stay in Chicago and the house worked perfectly for our group. Everyone had a comfortable place to sleep. The location was fantastic - walking distance to Wrigley Field and everything going on in the area. The pool was a great amenity and really made the house feel like an experience rather than just a place to sleep. I recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago with a group!

James was a communicative and accommodating host. His place was perfect for our group; comfortable and plenty of space for everyone. Lots of interesting shops and restaurants nearby and very convenient access to public transit. Would absolutely stay again!

The two-bedroom, three-bed apartment was a perfect set up for our family-two parents, two grown kids, one with a partner. Really nice to have a comfortable living room and open kitchen for hanging out in the morning and in between outings. A real highlight was the rooftop with comfortable furniture and great views of the lake, and only one flight up from the 19th Floor. The location is unbeatable--Red Line literally right outside the door and a short walk to Oak Street Beach and easy access to Near North and the Magnificent Mile. We had a great time.

As a Cubs fan who has never lived in Chicago, this place was like a dream. I never thought I could stay so close to my favorite place on earth! Even with only 1 bathroom, my friends and I made this space work. The neighborhood is amazing, and we all had a great time using this as our home base. Thanks for a great stay!
Nice place

The customer service is remarkable. The host went above and beyond to ensure that we were happy and had a great experience. The house was perfect for my bachelorette party. The beds were so comfortable the pillows as well. Everything was so clean. The house was completely beautiful match the descriptions of the photos to a T. The  Host does a great job at making sure if there was anything we needed They were there to help, they very great at communication. I can’t wait to stay at this home again with my family and friends. I recommend highly 10 out of 10 for sure.
Great neighborhood close to the train and bus system. Felt very safe! The house was beautiful and cozy.

Nice place, close enough to the city to go back and forth, but far away enough to get away from the traffic and noise. The apartment itself is nice, the building it is in is in rougher shape. There is a very distinct odor to the building that seeps into the unit. I was bothered by it but the person I travelled with was not. I would avoid this listing if you are sensitive to smells. The bed could use an upgrade- frame is squeaky and mattress is uncomfortable. Other than that- nice stay for the price.
Our stay here was great! It’s very close to the bus line which makes it easy to get into the city. Check in and out were very easy.

Thomas’s place was wonderful. Immaculate quiet and had everything you needed. Area is wonderful, walkable and many great restaurants.
Host was awesome and helped us with things in the area. Any questions he answered very quickly. A must stay for all!!!

Very nice and affordable place to stay! Came from Ohio to see BTS and every other place was $500-1500 a night. About an 8 minute walk to the ME train station that takes you to soldier field, field museum, shedd aquarium, millennium park and the planetarium! Bathroom is a little small but it worked. Definitely would stay again!
Great place, a 10 minute walk away from the CTA red line which heads into downtown Chicago so it was nice to have that option instead of Ubering everywhere.

Absolutely loved this place. By far my best stay I’ve had in Chicago. It wasn’t too far from anything especially Chinatown and soldier field. The place was very nice and cozy as soon as you walked in. Had everything you could think of from the kitchen to the bathroom. This was definitely a 10/10
El anuncio es fiel al alojamiento. Destaca la limpieza de cada área. Respecto a la ubicación, a unas cuadras está ubicada la Green Line del CTA que hace fáciles los traslados.
Very beautiful home. Comfortable beds, clean bathrooms and kitchen. Loved sitting on the deck. Overall área was amazing. Great host and co host. Response time was amazing.
Great location, beautiful place! We will definitely be staying there again when we go to Chicago.
We enjoyed our stay and Destine was very responsive. Thank you!
We loved every bit of the Airbnb and everyone who stayed has a great time! Met the owners and they were super cool people! Would recommend to a friend

We had a great time! The place was big enough for our party and had plenty of activities for the kids. The house was in a nice quiet neighborhood and everything was clean and well kept. I totally recommend this place for anyone with a large family and kids.
The house was clean, comfortable, and easy to access.
Great stay!
Was a comfortable stay. Enjoyed the space amd its cleanliness
Great spot
great place to stay! Peaceful and quiet, easy to get in and out. Victoria was a very responsive host and her place was perfect and definitely looks like the photos.
Great location! Would stay here again.

This property was easily accessible. Initially I took an uber. Eventually I realized it was a nice shirt walk to the subway. The entire house was spotless, the beds were nice & comfortable & Anna left us snacks & an espresso machine that saved our lives. A lot of windows for natural lighting in the morning & evening. I’d absolutely stay at the property again. Great for group settings .
Anna & Coty kept in communication & answered all my questions. It was very smooth & easy.
The place was great for our group of friends. Lots of beds, and comfortable space.

Nice location and easy to get around. Layout is unusual with it basically being a laid out as a kitchen and single hallway with one bedroom really being the living room with a futon that is exposed without doors and pictures didn’t make that super clear but it was fine for our needs.

What was only booked to be a place to crash between activities on a full tourist weekend in Chicago ended up a place of calm and oasis! Kris and Daniel's home was absolutely beautiful, we still were not over the landscaping in the front and back yard by the time we left. The house was clean, upgraded, and homey (which feels rare for many Airbnb stays these days!). They were responsive on multiple questions I messaged them with before and during our stay and were flexible when we needed to leave our bags outside of our booking window. I wish I was back on one of their backyard loungers reading a book right now!
Great location, clean, and overall great place for our trip to Chicago!
Awesome place! Super communicative and helpful. Solid location. Highly recommend!

Vladimir is a great host and we had an awesome stay. We were a last-second booking and you’d have thought Vladimir was ready for weeks. He went over and above to make us feel welcome and enhance our trip. The unit itself is warm, spacious, and very well-kept - we were very comfortable throughout our stay. Backyard and rooftop were unique and charming. Would stay again!!
Beautiful space in a nice part of town. Quiet at night, even on the weekend. Would definitely stay here again!
I had a great stay at Nicholas's air bnb. He was always super responsive whenever I reached out which made the ehole experience a lot more smoother.
Super convenient spot, great communication! Thanks for having us!

Cotys place is small, but comfortable. Walking distance to chinatown and everything is nearby.
The basement did get a little got but we messaged and got a response immediately. Would recommend a stay
Great location and very well communicative host. Clean and what we needed for our stay.
This was an incredible stay! Would recommend this home to anyone!
Great location and host!
We had a very nice stay! The location was great and super walkable to Fulton Market and public transit.

My husband and I were visiting for the first time and Zen made us feel like we were at home. Everything was spotless and clean. Instructions were easy to follow. Would definitely stay again in the future.
Cute apartment and good location. Beds were comfortable. Oven doesn’t function properly. Kitchen chairs were broken on arrival. Cleanliness could use improvement

I booked this place for my younger sister and her friend so they could go to a concert before she leaves for London. They had a blast! Bella is super responsive and always gets back in a timely manner. Thank you!
The place is great and location is good. Would stay again
Everything was as described! Great location, clean.

First off, I totally fell in love with the ceiling fan in the master bedroom and am now on a hunt for something similar.  We loved this place - the townhouse was spacious and beautiful, very quiet, tons of space, clean, safe, all the good things.  Especially loved having a two car garage.  Made a huge difference as parking in Chicago is an adventure.  Would definitely recommend and stay here again.  Thanks!

We we out and about most of our stay but this was the perfect home-base for our trip.  Restaurants and diners very close.  Very walkable and safe.  Loved that the CTA brown line was a 5 minute walk away.
The place was amazing and beautiful once inside! It felt like home for me! Andy is an amazing host and so nice and kind! Will most definitely book again! Thank you!

We wanted a place with three bedrooms and two bathrooms for our family of five. It was what we needed. We us d the train buss from the airport for one arrival. Took about an hour for $5. We drove back to airport and it was about 45 min on Sunday morning.  The bus is very close so we took to the Field Museum. Chinatown is about 18 mm minutes walking. Pilsen has some good coffee places and Latin food that we tried. Place was good sleeping and had good showers and hot water. We did not cook but it seemed pretty well set up.
Great place to stay :) Thanks
great and affordable, next to chinatown which had a lot of fun activities

Yakini and Coffy are so welcoming and gracious, we felt at home right off the bat. The house is wonderfully decorated and spacious. The neighborhood is beautiful with lots of things within a short walking distance and only about a 10-15 minute drive to the heart of Chicago. Plenty of street parking for a vehicle or two. Both Yakini and Coffy make this place an absolute gem to stay. This will be the first place I look to stay on my return trip to Chicago, thank you both again!

Super cute place, its right next to the red line and the beach so it was perfect for traveling and relaxing. The whole neighborhood was very friendly and I got a lot of recommendations from multiple people. Would love to stay again!

Wood’s place was very nice and we felt right at home. The furnishings were very nice and the bed was incredibly comfortable. The only thing to note is that the train is a 17min walk from the Airbnb and so made it a little tough to get around without uber unless you wanted to walk back late at night which might make people a little worrisome. There was plenty of free street parking for the rental car and usually could find a spot close to the door. Overall it was a nice stay. Thanks for your hospitality.
Fue muy agradable. La realidad es que está muy bien ubicado y un plus el desayuno del restaurante contigo al edificio.

Great location, close to the millennium park and river. A lot of restaurants in walking distance. Very convenient that parking garage was close by and included in the price. It was a little loud with the train, but that was communicated in the post and expected. The room was clean, there were extra pillows and blankets. We came after 12 to drop off our luggage as was communicated, but had to wait 25 minutes at the front desk because they were not aware and had to check with the host. There was an oven, but nothing was oven safe to use.
Wonderful home. communication with Bich was great from beginning to end. love the location. 4 miles  to Wrigley field. Highly recommend and will definitely stay here again.

This was an incredible place to stay. Zero complaints. We arrived early and the hosts were kind enough to let us leave our bags with them until check in time. Place was clean. There were tons of towels. A washer and dryer which was super nice. The pink line was so close. Bus stops were super close. The neighborhood is really great. It didn't take too long to get to the city. I would very happily stay here again.
Nice responsive host. Clear instructions. While the neighborhood is quiet, the house backs right up to the expressway and there is road noise all night long depending on how light you sleep.

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was very clean, and Dave was super responsive and helpful throughout our trip. He was also kind enough to offer us a late check-in, which we really appreciated. The area was nice, very walkable, and had lots of great Asian restaurants and shops nearby. Would definitely recommend!
Nice studio style apartment in a good neighborhood with plenty of things to do that’s walking distance.
Loved our stay here! It was so spacious and homey. We got in around 10pm so the parking was hard to find but we were able to move our car in the morning to get right in front!
So cute ! Right next to a bus stop and local restaurants . Was always responsive and very clean

Hannah & Mark were excellent hosts for our stay in Chicago. Our original reservation was canceled w/o reason 48 hours before we were supposed to check in & we had to scramble to find a new spot.
Here's what was so great about this home: AC worked well, the beds were comfy w/ soft comforters, hot water was always available & water pressure was good, towels were plentiful, loved having an in-unit washer/dryer, check in & out was easy.
The location is great, near the Western Blue line stop, Western and Armitage bus lines & near all the best neighborhoods: Logan Square, Bucktown, Wicker Park, Ukrainian Village, Humboldt Park, Avondale, and a short trip downtown.
The only issue was streaming shows on the apps - we had a difficult time watching shows one night no matter the service. But when I needed to do work on my laptop I didn't have an issue.
Hannah and Mark checked in to see if we needed anything but were not intrusive. Overall this is a great place to stay when in Chicago.

This listing was excellent for a group of friends who I recently had in town. The place was very roomy and check in and out was super easy. Eugenio was very communicative and great host. Would definitely recommend it to others!

We enjoyed our stay! The place was tidy and had everything we need. Parking was a challenge at first but we eventually found a spot and Gogo was very helpful with it. The host was very responsive and friendly. We enjoyed our trip in Chicago and this place was a big part of it!

Overall a very lovely stay at this location. The space looked exactly like the pictures and was SO clean and very stylish. I was a little hesitant about it being street parking only, but the neighborhood was so quiet and overall felt very safe. I was able to find parking all throughout the day until late night. I was happy with how many stores and restaurants were within a reasonable walkable distance (~10mins). The hosts were so friendly and the access to the space was very private. The only thing I will mention is I am 5'4 and I had a few times where I brushed my head or face on the ceiling from it being low especially near the toilet and bath area (its an attic space after all, it was expected to be slanted). Would choose to stay again if I am ever in town!
We had a great stay here, checkin was very easy, perfect instructions, and pictures/descriptions are accurate. Great location for walking around Chicago.

We really enjoyed our stay here. It was very clean and the host was very helpful and responsive. The townhome is an easy 20 min walk to Soldier Field which was so convenient as we made the trip to Chicago to see a concert there. Would definitely recommend especially if you are visiting Chicago to attend an event at Soldier Field.
We were happy ro stay at Roberto's.  It was furnished to be comfortable.
Ubicado en un lugar muy tranquilo, se puede llegar en tren o en metro con transbordo en bus. Muy limpio. ubicado a 30 min del centro de la ciudad.

The location was wonderful. The restaurants and shops by the unit were so convenient, walkable, and helpful when in need of food or specific items. The park across the street gave us a great place to relax and walk around to recharge after traveling. You could see the city perfectly, especially beautiful during golden hour! The unit itself was safe, clean, and spacious.  The unit has its own parking spot off the street which was great. I would definitely stay here again. Thank you, Yuyi for letting us stay at your place!

Host was amazing! The space was better than anticipated and there was so much walk ability to other restaurants, stores, etc. The only slight negative was the family that lives upstairs was a little loud but that's to be expected when you have neighbors but that didn't deter us from the amazing, clean space we stayed at. Host was very attentive to our needs and frequently checked in with us. 5 minute walk to the train and we would definitely stay here in the future! Thank you so much!
The place was good
The space was very clean and true to the pictures. Brad was very responsive at a rapid manner, very respectful and checked in during the stay! overall I would book again!
We loved our stay here! Fantastic space and neighborhood ♥️

Great place. A definite recommend to anyone touring Chicago. It was within easy distance for all the trains and a short what to Millennium Park. One of my biggest concerns coming into Chicago was being in a safe neighborhood. Being so close to what I would consider the touristy part of Chicago this place definitely met the criteria in spades.  Definitely recommend this place to someone wanting a nice safe place to stay close to many of the attractions. The washer and dryer was an added bonus.

Rene absolutely saved my family’s trip. Despite planning and booking months in advance, our previous reservation with another host was cancelled on the day of our flight into Chicago. Thankfully, Rene allowed us to book same day and was such an amazing, friendly host. The home was gorgeous and spacious, perfect for hosting a big family. The neighborhood is beautiful and I would definitely stay here again!
We loved our stay! The house is beautiful and such a convenient location in the arts district and only 3 blocks from the train.

Dennis's place was right in the heart of Roscoe Village. Easy walk to nearby restaurants & shops, lots of free street parking, perfect amount of space for a long weekend just outside of the hustle & bustle of downtown.

Michael’s place is fantastic and in an amazing location. The entire space is well done, clean, and comfortable. The location is literally steps from Wrigley Field and countless restaurants. Even better than the space and the location is Michael himself. Michael is kind, thoughtful, responsive, and willing to help with anything you could possibly need. We look forward to staying with Michael again in the future!

We booked this stay last minute while helping family in Chicago, and the host was exceptionally responsive, kind, and accommodating. I accidentally reserved the wrong date, and he worked with me to adjust the reservation and refund the extra day. He answered every message promptly, and I truly appreciated his flexibility.
As a native Chicagoan, basement apartments do not bother me. This one felt like a fun little adventure that took me back to my college days. The apartment is very spacious and could comfortably accommodate a family. It is in a safe, walkable neighborhood near Loyola University and has the distinctive charm of an older Chicago building.
Future guests should know that this basement apartment is naturally darker and has a more lived-in feel, with older, eclectic furnishings. It met our needs well for the night.
Overall, the host’s exceptional hospitality, spacious layout, and convenient location made this a worthwhile stay. If you are comforta
had a great stay! place was clean, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. would definitely stay here again
Dennis was a great host. He checked in with me after first night, which was above and beyond. His place was clean and perfect for a one bedroom.  We were able to walk to Wicker Park easily.
Great place and location. Host was wonderful!
Rida's place was great.  Only challenge was parking which we knew about.

We loved staying here! The location is fantastic, easily walkable to the Lincoln Square shops and the Brown Line. The building itself is charming, historic, spacious, and beautifully decorated. We were a group of 5 women, and there was plenty of room for us. We especially loved all of the seating and natural light in the sitting room. Highly recommend Jodee's place!
Great, comfortable space in an awesome part of the city.
Great stay! The area was great and I felt safe the entire stay. Sheets and towels were clean and smelled great which I really appreciated.
Perfect place for our family!
Beautiful and cozy home in a peaceful neighborhood
A great place to stay! The only gripe I could have was that it wasn’t fully stocked with towels, but other than that it was perfect. Would stay again.

Host was very accommodating. Check-in process was easy. Host provided great communication. Located in a great location. Easy access to transportation. Perfect places to stay. I would recommend this property to others.
