Loved my stay here. Very communicative hosts & very helpful. Would stay there again!
The hotel was good! The room itself was great, very spacious and plenty of room for the party. It was definitely on the pricey end for what we got, but overall I’d recommend a stay here.
Great place, lovely staying here with family.
Our stay was great! I came with a friend and we were comfortable the whole time. Hosts were nice and responsive.
Close to transit, comfortable and plenty to do nearby. Host was very helpful and responsive, and it was nice to have a little piece of home away from home.
The place was exactly as advertised. Great location near Wrigley Field. Would definitely recommend!

We had a great time staying here! The hosts were incredibly responsive throughout our stay and provided a great guide book for us!
Everything looked like the photos and nothing surprised us.
The parking was nice and private, though a little narrow.
Great place to say!

Cody's apartment was impeccably clean with a very comfortable bed, convenient to public transportation and located within a quick walk to Lincoln Square. It was also surprisingly quiet given the area. Other than the WiFi being a little spotty there's nothing to really complain about! Hopefully, it'll be available the next time we're in town!
We had a great stay! It was a great location, super walkable, the place was stocked and had everything we needed. Hosts are friendly and responsive.

We had a wonderful stay at Kelly’s apartment.
We were visiting Chicago for a week and worked remotely from the apartment—there was a great work set up with desk and monitors.
The apartment has all the amenities you’ll need—we cooked in the kitchen and enjoyed the relaxing well-decorated space.
The location is great, close to lots of restaurants and shops on Milwaukee as well as in Avondale. We would love to stay at Kelly’s again the next time we are in Chicago.

Lage ist sehr Zentral mit genügend Parkplätzen an der Straße. Mera hat immer direkt geantwortet sobald man geschrieben hat.
Bilder wurden leider mit Ai verfeinert und der Strom ist einige Male ausgefallen, aber den konnte man ganz einfach wieder einschalten. Für eine ganze Woche hatten wir 2 große Handtücher nur :/
Excellent place and really centric, you can walk anywhere and it's really close to several CTA stations.
This space was in a great location.  One of the reasons we booked it was because it has an assigned parking spot with it.

The location was great and it was easily accessible. There wasn’t a ton of common areas to hangout but we made due. It says sleeps up to 10 which is what we had, but 10 people in the small living area they had was pretty tight. It says quiet hours are 10p-8a and there is an alarm that goes off if you’re “too loud”. The alarm went off around 7:30p when we weren’t being very loud. I assume it’s because everyone was crowded in the small living area and that’s where the alarm is on the wall. I got a message from the host about the alarm notifying them, but again it was not during quiet hours.
Hard to accommodate 10 people when the noise control is that sensitive. It’d be a great spot if you’re not spending much time in the air bnb or at least that common area.
The bathrooms and bedrooms were nice and comfortable!
Great place
Would recommend to anyone finding an affordable place in Chicago for their time
We had a guys baseball weekend (9 of us) and the inn delivered.  A great weekend with great friends.  We barely left and are already discussing coming back next year.

We had an amazing stay at this luxury high-rise. The place was beautiful and the staff was so kind (both online and in-person). The building felt very safe and even had security on-site. Around the area were lots of restaurants and there was a Target just a block away for any last minute travel items as well.
Overall, it was 10/10!
Pubic hairs all over the guest bathroom and the staircase in the back had webs on all floors.
Very clean and quiet location. Perfect location if you're wanting to walk around the city or ride the L train

I was in town for a conference and decided to stay here instead of a hotel by the convention center. I'm so glad I did because the community is beautiful. The place is a cute basement apartment with all the necessary amenities. I decided last minute to get a car and parking on the street was easy. I was able to walk to restaurants and  grocery stores and the shoreline is just about a mile east so great for running. Overall a great place and location. I would definitely stay again.

We loved our stay here! I love this city and had an amazing time for my bachelorette trip. This house is adorable and so comfortable. The hosts were incredibly responsive, helpful, and flexible. I would definitely stay here again. The only thing I think future guests should be aware of before booking is the neighborhood: it is not the safest. I wouldn’t recommend walking on the street. However, the security of the house is great, and we felt safe as long as we stayed inside and parked in the garage instead of the street. I would still stay here again!
Such a nice place! Matt was a wonderful host and the ravenwood area was amazing. Would recommend!

Was actually a really nice Airbnb! Very clean, had the basic necessities needed, and very spacious. Parking was free and had a spot nearby majority of time. The host were lovely people, and very responsive if you needed something or had questions. We were satisfied with our stay.
It does have a lot of stairs going into the Airbnb, which we didn’t mind at all. For those who don’t do well with stairs, I would reconsider. The Airbnb isn’t too far from a few major tourist areas, which was great, but for those who are unfamiliar with the area, I would be cautious is all.
But, the Airbnb is still nice overall. We had no issues with parking nor our actual stay.

Amazing place and would stay again next time we’re in Chicago! The place was super clean and it was a beautiful apartment. The view was amazing and didn’t need to go to 360 since we had the view at the apt already!
Cloud9 was super quick to respond. They were able to let us stay past check-in as our flight was delayed due to the weather. My family had a great time staying here.
We did walk to the city center a bit and it’s around a 10 min walk which was a nice stroll through the neighborhood. Philz coffee and wholefoods were around when we needed to pick up something up
Perfect for our stay, everything was exactly as expected and extremely clean. Brad was an very communicative host and answered all of our questions before arrival.

Absolutely loved our experience staying here! Place was clean, organized, cozy, and spacious. Dede has thought of everything that you might need during your stay. Felt right at home and Dede was super responsive and welcoming. The area was also really peaceful and walkable. Will definitely stay here again next time we’re back in Chicago!!
Nice place, good location, great hosts
We thought it was three bedrooms other than that my mom enjoyed herself there for her bday weekend
Great location. Could use comfier lounging furniture for guests and the upstairs neighbors were loud. Sheets were not on the beds but we later found them in closets. Art had solid communication.

I really enjoyed staying at Millie’s place. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed, including water, toilet paper, and other essentials. I could tell that they really care about their guests from the little details, like the hallway lighting and the toiletries provided in the bathroom.
I didn’t have a car during my stay, but getting around was very easy because there were several bus stops nearby. Overall, I had a great stay and would definitely recommend Millie’s place!
Hector’s place was clean and organized. Perfect for a long weekend getaway. Hector left snacks and a few water bottles for us, which was a nice surprise. Would recommend this place!!

Great neighborhood, great value, great communication, and just a great experience overall. Close to the airport, which helped a lot. Walking distance to grocery store, which also helped a lot. Would definitely stay here again.
Great place, great location! perfect for a little weekend getaway!!

Such great host and now friends.
We sat had coffee in the garden both days with conversations that continued for a couple hours. They both were so great shared history about the area we talked music and just life. Even if we never stay in this spot (which we probably will) id make sure to stop and say hi when in chicago. Thanks for everything
Fair price, and plenty to do around the area.

Dan was a great host. We stayed in Chicago for 4 days and had no issues getting in touch with him day or night. The home is mere miles from downtown, but expect major traffic going anywhere. We spent our trip in downtown so I can't speak much on the surrounding amenities, but we passed lots of shops and restaurants (it is minutes from the United Center). The home was spotless and deceptively spacious. We had plenty of space for our group and nobody complained of discomfort. Thanks again for hosting us.

If you are just looking for basic place to sleep, this place will work. It was a bit confusing to get in, and we had trouble with the two keys and the locks (wish they were labeled).
Could’ve been better stocked with some amenities, we were out of body wash and there was coffee machine with no coffee provided. Lots of great coffee shops in the area, though! And the shower didn’t drain well.
We thought it was weird that there were bed bug traps under the bed, but when we reached out he said they said they were just precautionary.
Overall, a bit expensive for what it was, probably just due to it being a high demand/busy weekend.

This is a very cute garden apartment in a really nice, safe neighborhood.  There was plenty of free street parking right in front of the house each day that we were there, which was great.  Adrienne is easy to reach and responds quickly to texts.  I would stay here again! One thing to note though, you are staying underneath a normal active family  with pets.  So some noises through the ceiling are to be expected.
Clean place perfect for sleeping. Very good location!

We loved our stay at Mary’s place. The house felt lived-in and loved in a way many AirBnBs do not.
Our group was getting together from around the country for a yearly trip. Mary helped us start off the trip right with drinks in the fridge waiting for us and some shots of Malort (we loved the Malort cocktail recs!)
The rooms were all very functional and the kitchen came fully stocked. While we didn’t cook as there was so much good food around, we had everything we needed and more.
Location wise, if you’re staying in Bucktown, this is hard to beat. You’re a block from the train (but far enough away to not hear it) and there’s tons of food in the immediate vicinity. Specifically, we enjoyed Dark Matter, El Bagelero, Jomon, and (a bit further away but still close) Bird Bird Bakery.
I’m actually bummed we didn’t stay longer - with all we had to do, we never got to fully enjoy the super cute patio out back!
Highly recommend if you’re looking for a great spot to stay!
Such a lovely place.  A great location, immaculately clean,  modern and stylish,  and very cozy and comfortable.  We will be back!

This was the perfect spot for my family to stay while my niece got married in Lincoln Park. Slept 6 of us comfortably and there was a nice amount of space! Even wonderful to accommodate bridesmaids meeting up there in the morning to get ready before the trolley arrived! Gorgeous too !

I wish I could give more than 5 stars - there is a reason this property is so well reviewed.  Petra has done a wonderful job providing a clean and comfortable AirBnB for the community.  In addition to the great property, she has proactive, clear instructions for arrival (including pictures to help find the way) and checkout. It is clear why you need to book this property early - great location; great home; great overall visit. Thank you!
Very cute and spacious apartment— had a great time here for a few days. Very easy to find and close to several bus stops. Host was responsive and friendly. Would definitely book again in the future!

This place was such a great deal.  5 ladies stayed here comfortably.  2 bathrooms with showers made it easy for us all to get ready. It's in a beautiful neighborhood.  There's a few stairs if that matters to you.  It's really secure with a lock to the building and then to the apartment.   We changed plans a couple of times. The host was very accommodating and helpful.  They were very responsive to our questions.  We never needed anything while we were there because the place is well stocked.    We really enjoyed this place.  2 of us slept on the couch.  There is an air mattress but the couch is super comfy.  It felt very safe.  We would have spent as much or more on a hotel and we had lots of room here instead of a cramped hotel.  Thanks for a great stay!
Great place. Exactly what you need for a weekend trip for a Cubs game. Would recommend to anyone that wants a clean, comfortable place in a great location.

The apartment is spacious and beautiful and the location is fun and walkable. However, word to the wise, do not book this listing if you are a light sleeper or want to go to bed before 2am! For each of the three nights we stayed at this AirBnB (Thurs-Sat), we heard loud music from a bar downstairs from 10pm-2am. While there are sound machines in the bedrooms, they are not effective at cutting the vibrations from the bass. The sound was so bad that I booked a hotel for the last night of my stay because I couldn’t sleep. My friend wasn’t quite as bothered so she toughed it out.

Bucktown location was very convenient, but cleanliness was severely lacking.
Front stairwell was shockingly filthy with a DISGUSTING amount of dust, hair, and dirt.
Apartment was tidy, but clearly not cleaned fully. Dust/hair throughout the entire floor. Artificial plants full of dust/webs. Bathroom towels looked unwashed with toothpaste stain. Only one, stained, bathroom hand towel. No washcloths. Body hair/crumbs in the bathroom floor mat. Not enough toilet paper. No tissues at all.
Kitchen stool chairs were badly stained.
Bedroom sheets and linens were very poor polyester quality, and mis-matched, leaving us questioning their cleanliness as well.
Furnace/laundry room door was missing.
Apartment above was very loud one night, sounded like scraping across floor for 3 hours at 3am. Luckily it didnt bother us but was strange and should be noted for other guests.
You're on your own for parking, so research free options.
If it was cleaned/supplied properly, it would be great!!
Overall great place — good location, very clean, plenty of room, etc. We were in Chicago for a wedding & this ABB was perfect!  Isaac & his wife were wonderful hosts!  Highly recommend!
Sam has a beautiful apartment in a great location. We were in town for a cubs game and the walk to the park was very convenient. I will stay here again next time I’m in town.
Very nice and comfortable place to stay! Felt right at home and really appreciated his promptness. Thank you for being an amazing host!

The place was very spacious and the decor was really cool, the balcony was a nice touch as well. Some things to note, the bedrooms do not get any sunlight at all ( I tend to wake up when the sun starts rising, which made me sleep in wayy longer than I wanted 😅). The entry doors also required you to push a bit harder to get it to open. Overall it was a good location with cool restaurants and places to explore.
There is absolutely no on site parking which is why I selected this one. Very steep, narrow stair with limited lightning and no handrail at the top. Also no emergency kit in unit.
Friends and I stayed here for a few days great location and beautiful spacious home.

Do not hesitate... Book it! This is the best AirBnB I have every stayed by checking all boxes. Maurizio was amazing to deal with.  Very responsive and helpful every step of the way. The apartment is secure via 3 doors on the 2nd floor. Super clean with a nook/office area to work that is tucked away from the bedroom which is a nice touch. The bathroom is amazing. It is amazing the use of the square footage.  There were snacks, coffee and a refrigerator. It is nestled in a GREAT neighborhood - I mean great!  Very short walk to Addison and Clark streets, Red and brown lines, bus stops.  You are less than 1/2 a mile from Wrigley Field. Wrigleyville)is a nut house (fun) during cubs games.  There are soooo many food and drink options so do your research. There is an Al's Beef in that area though I prefer the one on Taylor.  Take a short walk to Southport ave - great shops, cafes, etc. I am going to make an excuse to go to Chicago again and I will be planning ahead to book at Maurizio's pad.

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment was exceptionally clean, beautifully appointed, and had everything we needed for a wonderful Chicago River North experience. The location was perfect—close to everything- the river, the museums, the cafes, the Bean! --with many of Chicago’s main attractions within easy walking distance. It was also conveniently close to the train station, making it easy to explore the city’s other great neighborhoods. We loved our stay and would happily return!
Lacey's place was very nice - extremely clean and organized. The house was cool (when the weather was muggy and humid).  The kitchen is well-stocked with good tools for cooking.

Sydney and the other co hosts are amazing! The place was so nice it felt like we were staying in a hotel!! The only thing is that the location is not the best, as it is not completely safe at night but personally we had no problems driving back late after a concert! Just don’t linger around in the neighborhood and you’ll be fine!
Great, cozy stay. Clear instructions and communication.

My friends and I had a great time staying at Nicholas’s place for a girls weekend. It was even cuter than in the pictures, and very comfortable. It’s in a great location and Nicholas was very responsive and helpful. I would absolutely stay here again!

Perfect location for a family get together! 5 minute walk to the beaches of Lake Michigan, walkable to restaurants, parks. The home is beautiful with a large living room,  separate family room and two levels of patio/decks to enjoy.  Large backyard for children to romp!
Enjoyed a week-long stay at the Airbnb; Pete was very communicative and the apartment was as described / same as the photos. Thank you, Pete!

We had a wonderful stay at Mark and Collette’s place! It was perfect for two couples and had everything we could’ve needed. We all loved the location! Walkable to the Montrose Brown line and surrounded by local shops and food (Teddy’s ice cream is amazing). We would definitely stay again!

Location is great and somewhat near transit and Logan Square, making it a great home base. However, the unit was subpar at best. Much of the furniture was old, peeling or broken. There was a broken mirror (although small, felt dangerous). To use the extendable bed, we needed to move a larger dresser and parts were broken (reservation was clear about the number of people staying there, so using that bed was likely). There were many little flies, mosquitoes, and centipedes that made our stay uncomfortable. It also didn’t seem cleaned thoroughly as we found lots of dust behind the TV and dirt (including full crackers) pushed under the couch/to the edge of the bathroom. It was other things-iron but no board, an unlocked dirty cabinet, and the light switch in the hall being so sharp that one of us got cut-that made it clear that the reoccurring concerns raised in other reviews have not been addressed between listings, and should be addressed before I would book again.

The security bedroom was a small closet with no air vents. The room was tight and not comfortable for two people!
The parking was not convenient no elevators in the garage, tight spaces! The front desk clerk had to let you in garage, there should be keypad for tenants to use for more convenience
Checkin process is terrible and slow, and any paperwork should be sent prior to check-in to speed up process!
We had a great time!

Great spot with walking access to all the fun things in Wicker Park and Bucktown. My group went to some great restaurants and bars. Sleeping arrangements were great, possibly the best beds I’ve stayed in at an air bnb! Hosts were quick to respond and helpful throughout.
Great place to stay if you are exploring Chicago. Would recommend to anyone traveling. Great communication as well.

Thank you Steve!  We had such a pleasant stay - the penthouse is so calming and has such a great vibe.  The outside deck is the cherry on top and the seats were so comfortable.  We loved all the small thoughtful items in the kitchenette and the books laying around were so helpful to us newbies to the area.  The natural lighting is the BEST!!  Thank you!  Leigh Ann & Kevin
Great downtown location close to restaurants, parks, and the L for access to many other parts of the city. Appreciated the building security (Donald was very friendly) and rooftop amenities.
Host provided clear instructions.
gogo has curated a beautiful space. i have been to many an airbnb in chicago and none have scratched the surface of this one. i would definitely stay again.

We had a great time on our girls trip to Chicago this weekend. It was easy to find street parking and the location was walkable to coffee shops and about 15 minutes from the 606 trail. The space was perfect for 9 ladies with plenty of bathrooms. Some of the beds were soft and others were harder, so there was variety based on preference. We made the majority of our meals at the home. Ubers were easy to request and we felt safe walking through the neighborhood. We drove several places and had no trouble finding parking on our return. It was a beautiful weekend and our stay was awesome!
We really enjoyed our stay here in Chicago with Kyriako. It was a very nice experience, he was really accommodating and welcoming. Perfect place for our needs and we appreciate his responsiveness!
Great place to stay. Great neighborhood and close enough to the subway.
Great experience all around.

I did not stay at this property. I repeatedly requested accommodations for six guests, but each time the request came back, it showed only two or four guests. Because the reservation did not accommodate my full group, I never accepted the host’s invitation and booked somewhere else. Despite never staying at or entering the property, I was still charged. This booking experience was extremely confusing and disappointing, and I am now disputing the charge directly with Airbnb.

The stay at Nichole’s place was great! It had great amenities like a full kitchen with cooking tools and supplies, a well lit bathroom, plenty of space, comfortable beds, A/C, and laundry room. Any issues we had were quickly addressed and fixed in a timely manner. The market around the corner was also a highlight! Overall it was a nice stay and the host was very accommodating and friendly!

Very responsive host. Check in was easy and attendants were helpful and very friendly. When the internet password wasn’t working and I couldn’t log on to the air bnb app, I called the number provided and they gave me a new password right away. We had an ant issue in the kitchen, though not ideal, and only mild, host was very responsive and sent staff to wipe down the ants with vinegar immediately.
The location of the building is central to cloud gate, walking distance to river walk. Excellent location to explore the city. The view from the penthouse apt is a nice touch and as described.
Just a note, all guests staying have to present photo ID at check-in. Not a hassle at all, just something to prepare for. Instructions from the host were straight forward, simple and accurate.
All in all very pleased with the unit, location, responsiveness of the team. Thank you!
A quiet and peaceful place to stay. Close to the Red Line so that you can easily explore Chicago.
Claudia was very great throughout our stay! She continuously offered assistance if we ever needed it. The place was super clean and looked exactly like the photos. I would definitely stay here again!

This was a great location. The beds were very comfortable. The only issue I really had was we asked about the parking and was not told that even though she provides parking passes you can't park in front. We did and received a $100.00 ticket and was 5 min away from having our car towed. So please pay attention the parking is around the corner on the streets.
Nice place, in a great spot for walking around city.
Todo bien. Buena comunicación con el anfitrión.
Loved the apartment and the area. Great location. Easy street parking. Marc is accessible and responsive.
Nice quiet area! Very spacious as well. Definitely recommended for a group of 6. Only downside was 6 people sharing one bathroom but we coordinated well!
the host was very accommodating we arrived a little early and were able to check in before the check in time. house was very spacious, exactly as described and would stay again in the future
2nd time staying herd and still loved it! Kimberly was very helpful
Our stay was wonderful!We could not have picked a better place for our weekend. I will definitely come back.  Thank you JHON

This was our second stay at this property, and we loved it! It's in the terrific Edgewater neighborhood, set between the thriving commercial districts on Broadway and Clark, and a short distance from the beach and lake. Within a mile are enough good restaurants to keep you busy for weeks. Highly recommended.
It was a great, clean place to stay. Very good communication.
We love this neighborhood. It is such a good location for any downtown activities.

We absolutely loved the AirBnB. It was in a great location, clean, and I have to say we loved the view of the city from the back stairs. David was super nice and we'd for sure stay again next time we're in the area!
had a wonderful stay
Wonderful place and a great location for our Chicago stay.  Easy parking, safe area.

This was our second time staying at Melissa’s and it was just as good as remembered! There were two very minor issues but Melissa responded with solutions quicker than any host I’ve experienced and really went above and beyond. We can’t wait to go back again!

Overall, a very nice place to stay in the area for the price. The free street parking worked out perfectly for me, and I loved walking to get coffee in the mornings. There was a bit of an issue with the room not being clean upon arrival, but Marije responded and got it solved quickly. The bed was also very comfortable.
This is a great spot in Logan square, very close to the train station and very quiet and peaceful, I recommend and would stay again.

Very spacious, more than enough for two people. The location is very accessible too with easy street parking and walkable to the red line. Plenty to do nearby as well. It was very clean and well stocked with toiletries and extra linens perfect for a longer stay!

This place was a beautiful home that was both clean and comfortable. The area felt very safe and there are lots of walkable restaurants nearby. The apartment is a 40 minute walk to the soldier field stadium and about a 48 minute walk to the field museum. The walk is flat and very easy. The amenities were perfect and the beds and bath were clean. The place is exactly as pictured.  I would definitely stay here again and recommend for anyone looking for a clean/comfortable space near soldier field stadium.

A delightful lovely stay! I came in with a huge party but the amount space, along with the multiple bathrooms, was more than accommodating! The place was also quite clean with modern minimalist decor that is
comfortable to wake up to!
The location is convenient with easy to find parking and not too far from downtown Chicago, along with access to the train that isn’t actually too noisy.
Would definitely recommend for big parties and stay here again!!

Great place to stay in the Loop. Perfect location in walking distance to metro station, Millennium Park, bus routes, etc. Two bedrooms, kitchen, and in unit laundry is insanely convenient.
It is quite loud with the trains but they provide a white noise machine that allowed us to sleep. My kids absolutely loved watching the trains so it was totally worth it.
There's even a view of the Willis/Sears tower.

My partner and I loved our stay at this Airbnb. We were very close to public transportation and in an extremely walkable location. The neighborhood was peaceful, serene, and full of shade even on the sunniest days. Our host was very communicative and friendly. Check-in and checkout was a breeze.

Great spot in a cute area! Julian was very  helpful whenever we had an issue. The only downside is the noise from the upstairs neighbors. If you aren’t used to it, I’d suggest bringing earplugs.  Other than that, great experience!
Overall had a great experience! Very responsive host and had very easy low-lift check-in and check-out responses.

The place was very nice and looked like the pictures.  We had 7 adults staying there and there was plenty of room and beds for everyone.  It was in a great location for us, near our family and near to the wedding venue we were going to.  It was also very close to everything that we wanted to do.  The check-in and check-out were very easy and the host responded quickly when we had a question.  Would definitely stay there again and recommend this place to friends.
very spacious place that can sleep 6 people and a good walking distance to chinatown and solider field.

Robert’s place was amazing. Very spacious for a chicago rental.  Super clean and cute and quiet neighborhood.  Close to public transportation as well.  The communication from Robert was amazing.  Highly recommend.  I would definitely stay again.
Great location. Responsive host. No issues. Had a great stay.
Had a great stay with some friends here. Geo handled everything! Thanks again.

My friends and I stayed here when we went to see BTS last week! It was in a nice area and the place itself is cute! Parking was a little tricky late at night but during the day it’s fine! We had a wonderful stay!

Everything was amazing! Place was exactly how described! We got lucky with parking on the street but very limited!  Sleeping at night can be hard for some people heavy walking on the unit on top and alot of city noise. Other than that i would recommend theres alot of restaurants walking distance for a quick grab and go!  Definitely would stay here again, host was very helpful and responsive!
Loved our stay!

What a treat to stay at such a lovely place. Loved the decor, the coziness and extra amenities. Very clean and lovely. Hosts were kind and informative.
5 stars all the way around!!!🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
The apartment was spacious and clean. Easy access to public transit. Chicago is so big that it took time to get to most attractions, but the neighborhood was nice with several excellent restaurants.

The best part of this place was the location, close to the beach, downtown Chicago and public transportation.  Having a parking spot was also a nice benefit.  Unfortunately, the property itself was less than desirable,  Issues experienced included (i) poorly maintained interior, including very dirty rugs and what was likely black mold on the ceiling on one of the bedrooms on the third floor; (ii) aged kitchen appliances and bathroom fixtures and significant mold on certain shower curtains; (iii) insufficient housewares, such as plates and silverware as well as towels (and we indicated 8 people would be staying); (iv) toilets that did not flush easily and; (v) door locks, lockbox and keypad that were difficult to use and required multiple attempts to open.  Don’t be fooled by the pictures or the descriptions of “Luxury comfort, modern, fully-equipped and elegant” – the place is definitely not that nice.  No doubt the host will say we never let him know of the issues.  Since we only stay
The neighborhood was great, very walkable, the house was large and roomy

Great place for a bach trip! Exactly as described. Definitely a loud location due to the street being a very popular bar hot spot. However, blackout curtains in the main bedroom and white noise machine made it non noticeable. Very fun space.
We were in town for a wedding and place was perfect for our group of 8. Location was amazing. Walking distance to beach, shops and restaurants. Would definitely stay again!

Es un alojamiento muy recomendable, la atención de los dueños, que viven ahí, es excelente. La ubicación es ideal, barrio lindo y seguro, a dos cuadras de la línea de metro red line. Las comodidades de la habitación y resto de la casa son tal cual lo describen ellos.

Great place to stay for our weekend in Chicago! Both hosts were very responsive when we were unable to locate the parking pass. The bed, pillows and comforters were an extra plus - super comfy! We would definitely stay here again. Thanks for hosting us.

Excellent location. Walking distance from many restaurants and cafes and a 10-15 minute ride to downtown.
The house was very clean and comfortable and had everything we needed. Highly recommend!
Everything was great and as advertised.  Thank you get much!  I enjoyed my stay
Great place to stay! Easy to get to and nice that it was close to the train! Would stay here again!

We had a wonderful 5 days stay at Andrew’s Airbnb. He was an attentive host, always responsive to my questions and needs, making my visit smooth and enjoyable.
The property was comfortable and well-kept, but adding more mirrors, especially a full-length one, would enhance convenience for guests.
Despite this minor issue, my stay was excellent, and I’d happily return. I give Andrew’s Airbnb a strong 4.5 out of 5 stars for its welcoming host and great experience.
Holly was very helpful and responsive.
Our stay at Catherine’s place was a perfect location for us and we felt very safe walking during the day and night.  The condo had everything we needed and was clean and comfortable!
El lugar está como se describen. Las Fotografías está muy limpio fácil de encontrar y muy accesible para tiendas y restaurantes. Me gustó mucho el lugar y la locación sin duda lo volvería a rentar
Great host and a great space!

My boyfriend and I stayed here for several days while visiting Chicago for the recent BTS concert and it was perfect! It was the perfect size for what we needed in terms of a nice place to rest and relax between walking around the city. The apartment wasn’t too noisy in terms of outside noise or other visitors, and easy to access. We ended up parking in a structure nearby since we were there for a bit and preferred to use city transit but we found no issues parking on nearby streets when needed. It’s right between two red line stops which we frequently used to go in and out of downtown and to solider field, which was super easy! Great restaurants within the area and walking distance to several grocery stores which we appreciated. Would definitely recommend staying here, and we can see ourselves coming back next time we’re in town!

The AirBnB was great for our stay in Chicago! It's about a 15 minute walk to the nearest train station so you can get anywhere in the city, has great food options nearby, and free street parking.
The AirBnB itself is a little warmer than we're used to, but they have A/C units in the living room and bedroom that works just fine. Also, the bedroom is small - just enough room for a queen-sized bed, a dresser, and a nightstand - but that didn't bother us, considering we were only in there to sleep. Not a lot of storage or movement available in there, just a heads up!
People in past reviews say it's cluttered, but honestly I would say it's more "lived-in." Feels like a real home. Nothing was in our way; it was a clean space, and they even offered extras like toothpaste, towels, dishware and silverware, and they even have a washer and dryer unit with laundry detergent, softener, and dryer sheets available.
Overall, it was great stay for us gals who came into the city to see BTS!
This place was comfortable and clean. We loved the parking in the rear of the property. We felt safe and went for evening walks in the neighborhood. Absolutely loved it. Thank you!!!
Easy check in and check out. Responded promptly with any questions or concerns regarding the stay. Overall a very friendly host.
We had everything we needed at the place! Eva was very helpful with the checkin / checkout as we checked in pretty late and checked out very early.
We had a great stay. The place matched the description exactly. The host was incredibly friendly and proactive with communication. We'd definitely stay here again.

There were a few hiccups to our stay and the host handled all of them in a timely manner so that our stay was not impacted in the least!  Very responsive and attentive.  Extremely communicative and committed to making the stay as described!  Would stay again based on the host's care, attention to detail, communication and hustle before our arrival!
She was quick  to answer. Very helpful. We enjoyed our stay.

Great host! We had an 8 person stay and place was more than big enough for us all! Angela was super responsive and proactive with checking in and making sure we had directions for checking in and out!
Great stay for a large group! Really helpful when another host had canceled on us last minute, very communicative.

Steve was an excellent host, always quick to respond to any questions. Place was super close to the metro station and lots to do walking distance. The place was clean and really nice, felt safe and had good rest every day!  Would definitely recommend!
David is a great host, we will always try to find an Airbnb that he owns.
Geo was a very responsive and helpful host during our trip to Chicago. The location was a good spot because everything was located relatively close without having to be in the heart of the city.

Weekend Stay
Celebration of a milestone, (75th Birthday). There was 15 family members on this trip.
The home was exactly as pictured and an idea location within minutes away from the strip malls, grocery stores, coffee shop, and restaurants, so it was very convenient.
Matricia was welcoming, reachable, extremely accommodating, knowledgeable, and responsive. If we ever return to Chicago, this is the place my family and I would stay.
Thank you, Matricia for being a wonderful host and being just who You Are!!!
Great location. Clean and as described.

Location was an easy walk to restaurants, bars, pharmacy, grocery  stores and Wrigley Field .  If we had chose to there were CTA buses.  The condo was beautiful. It was very clean and welcoming. I lived all the exposed brick!  The beds were comfortable.   Both TVs were easy to operate.  Would definitely try to stay again !
Very communicative and helpful as a host. Thank you.

The place was great. Had a group of college friends visiting Chicago and this place was the perfect home base to explore the city. Comfortably slept 9 of us, super clean, and amenities were exactly as advertised. Kate's communication was outstanding, accommodating an early check-in, and even offering a late check-out.  Highly recommend for anyone needing a centrally located spot that can fit a good sized group. Thank you Kate!
Only stayed for a few days but it was enjoyable. Super clean place, easy instructions, and a mostly quiet neighborhood! Had all kinds of necessities available for use as well. Definitely recommend!
Great location with a spacious apartment.  It was particularly good to have an outdoor space.  Elizabeth was very responsive and helpful.

Tom was a gracious host! He was very responsive and even gave us some recommendations near by. He really made our stay comfortable and easy. I would stay here any time I come to Chicago. There is a lot of walkable food options around. There are also a few nice parks near by. The check-in and check-out was simple and easy. I appreciate the hospitality we received during our stay.
Location was great, and David was very responsive!

Our stay was amazing!! Laura was always very responsive and kept up with how we were doing with our stay! She was also super understanding with a couple of hiccups we had on our end! The home was so beautiful just like the pictures on the listing and was very stocked up with everything that we needed! The neighborhood was very peaceful even at night, with lots of restaurants and stores around the area which we only needed to walk to. It’s super close to downtown, only took us 25 minutes with traffic to get there. Will definitely recommend everyone to stay here and we will definitely be back!

Very comfortable place with really nice touches to make your stay comfortable. The host is very professional and responsive. Building is secure and everyone there was nice and helpful. I was traveling with a small child so I was worried about noise while napping and sleeping. I brought a sound machine and the trains were no problem. The restaurant next door is loud on a Saturday night but the outdoor music (and the trains) seemed to stop at 10pm. Not so relaxing if you’re in for a weekend evening but I doubt that’s how most visitors spend their time in such a fun city. It’s very walkable and a great neighborhood. I recommend, even with little ones.
Loved it! Peaceful, especially beautiful with the green trees and amazing plants. Will definitely book again.
Nice people great time in the city

It was a great space, and so well-located for things we wanted to do in Logan Square, Wicker Park, and Bucktown. Easy to get to and from the airport too. When we first arrived, the smoke alarm was beeping from low battery. Jen and McDonald had it fixed within minutes of informing them, which was amazing. Overall amazing stay.
Clean and safe place to stay. Only headache was the free street parking.

What a great place! Perfect location for going to a cubs game or heading down to the loop. The home was spotless and kitchen had coffee pods. Danny was always responsive.
