Our only trouble was the small lip up into one of the bedrooms that tripped each of us up a time or two. Also, the fact that Lyle makes K-cups available as an amenity is really convenient and kind IMO. We had a great stay and would definitely consider Lyle’s place for our future Chicago trips.

Had a great stay, as advertised, in a quiet street in Bucktown, but short walk's distance away from amazing restaurants like Mirra and Le Bouchon!
Place was so cute, loved the real green plants in the living area, there were two large bedrooms perfect for groups of 2-4.
Reiss was the best host and checked in with us every step of the way. Would recommend!

My friend and I had a girl's weekend for a concert. The airbnb was in a quiet.l pretty area that had a bus and train w/ walking distance. Everything looked exactly like the pictures and we had such a smooth checking in and checking out experience.
Great place! Very clean and spacious. The only downfall is that it is a bit far from downtown but there is plenty of bus stops around to get in.

We were in town just for 2 nights and 1 day and the place was just what we needed. Very clean. Per the description it is noisy until about 3am and then it was quiet for a few hours. Nala was very helpful with instructions, recommendations and answered all the questions I had. We enjoyed our stay!
This was a great place and Edwin was kind and responsive!
When I come back to Chicago this is the place that I would love to come back too.
Great place to stay! Twelve minute walk to nearest train station and buses even closer. The only thing to note is the air mattress is designed for children under 4 feet tall.
Great host! She was very friendly and helpful. The space was the perfect accommodations and distance from different places around the city. The neighborhood was so peaceful.
This is one of the nicest Airbnb’s that I’ve stayed at. It was very quiet and clean. I would stay here again if I’m ever in the area!
perfect stay if you want to be close to the city but not in the city
Geo was a great host! Incredibly quick responses and very helpful & friendly. The space was great and had super clear check-in instructions and even videos to help explain.
The place was great! Had an amazing stay.

Awesome awesome awesome host! Amy was super responsive to all of my questions, gave personal recommendations for places in the neighborhood/city, and was overall super friendly. She made my fiancée and  I tea for the morning we left and also had a sweet little gift for us too. Fantastic host, clean home, and great experience. :)
The location was great, and the place was very clean!

Second time staying with Karina and she doesn’t disappoint! She’s super responsive and friendly. I love staying with her as she always has everything — even the things I forget about
Plus the cats are super cute!

Carolyn and Latrell are incredibly responsive, helpful, and kind! The AirBnb is beautiful and spacious. The amenities are perfect. The Red Line is just a 5 minute walk down and road and there was always parking available. 10/10 definitely recommend and would stay again!

Harry was a great host. Upgraded us to the floor with the balcony. The unit was large for Chicago. 3 bedrooms and a great couch. Harry was onsite when we arrived and was super friendly. Do not book this if you do not want to be in the middle of Wrigleyville!

Great location and layout for our group of girls! Walking distance from several restaurants, coffee shops, etc and really easy to get ubers to/from. Host was really responsive any time we had questions.

We had a wonderful stay at Ryan’s. The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful. The place was perfect for the 3 of us travelers. We each had our own bedroom and bath. The downstairs bedroom was a pleasant surprise with its own living room and bath. The kitchen and dining room was spacious and had all the utensils we needed to cook breakfast each morning. The entry to the unit was easy. Due to security doors in the front you have to enter from back where the parking is and it’s gated. McDonald’s and gas station 5 minutes walking distance. We walked to the Obama Center which was about 20 minutes and felt completely safe. About 15-20 minute ride to downtown. I will be back in Chicago for Summer 2027 and we will back at Ryan’s.
Great location!

Shakerah's place was exactly as described in the listing and as seen in the photos. The place was within minutes walk of a train station with plenty of street parking if you are wanting to leave your car and stick with public transportation. The area isn't the best, but I was traveling in a group so I had safety in numbers. We felt perfectly safe inside the property the entire time. Shakerah was very responsive to any concerns we had and gave crystal clear instructions for check-in and where to find the door.
Absolutely wonderful place to stay in Chicago! Very walkable and clean! The host is very friendly and super responsive!
Can't beat this location!! We had a small issue with the key opening the outside door initially, but Brad and the neighbors were so helpful! The place was very cozy. Perfect for our needs.
Great stay and was close to the CTA which was great! Very walkable.
Great stay. In a perfect location for Wrigleyville exploration
Condo was nice. Location was very good for us. The only negative was parking.
Very well decorated and responsive friendly host. Area wasnt exactly what i expected. All in All, very much loved the place and would be comfortable staying again.
Charles fue super amable! Muy facil en la comunicación! La casa está genial, con todo tipo de comodidades como cafetera, tostadora,lavadora y secadora…! Sin duda repetiría :) 100x100 recomendable

Wonderful home in a wonderful neighborhood! Bed in the master was incredibly comfy! So many appliances and cleaning supplies, which was super helpful. Perfect for a big group. Would absolutely stay again.
A nice stay in a sweet neighborhood.

Fue mi primera vez en estados unidos
Estaba nerviosa por los desplazamientos pero el lugar está muy cerca de la estación Addison muy tranquilo se puede caminar de noche sin problema, hay un supermercado de un dólar cerca , restaurantes , el
Lugar es limpio es bueno
Me gusto mucho
nice place. good location (next to a whole foods).

We were close enough to downtown that it made the stay super easy. The space was clean and comfortable and our host was very responsive.
The cars can be a bit loud if you’re not used to living in a city and the blinds don’t block all the light coming in at night so bring an eye mask.
Incredible Airbnb with such cool decor, nice bathrooms and kitchen, very clean, so many balconies to hang out on as well!!
Great place to stay and very affordable.
Very spacious, exactly as described. The location is ideal, with lots to do and see nearby. Hosts were very responsive and helpful.
Very small apartment. Perfect location on up north - quiet neighborhood but close to lots and close to the L.

Had a wonderful stay at Brad and Carrie's home!
Had some other inconveniences aside from the home and they were super accommodating and empathetic, The room was spacious, clean, comfy and very cool ! Felt like I was at home! They also were very flexible with early check in and made my first chicago experience memorable ! Would definitely book here on my own next time again if opportunity given thank you Brad and Carrie!! 😊✨👏
Harvey and Elizabeth were very nice and responsive! Everything was exactly how we imagined and perfect for our stay! Couldn't have picked a better place!
Their instruction were very clear for check-in and the space was exactly as described. They were also very responsive when we had  asked a few question so overall great experience!
Lisa was such a great host! very friendly, kind and helpful. Her place was also really clean, cute and spacious. Would absolutely recommend.
They were both so responsive and accommodating! Their dog is so cute and friendly! We greatly appreciate them letting us stay at their place and the hospitality!
Place was great! Was in a good area. Everything was a quick uber.
Perfect area if you’re staying in Chinatown! The space was beautiful :)
Perfect little spot! Extremely walkable and L train friendly. The stop for the CTA train was only 5 minutes walk. Which was perfect for me! Jane was a friendly host and gave clear directions :)
We had a wonderful stay - even better & more space than the photos. Highly recommend!

Problem with pests repeatedly. Was told this was close to UChicago hospital a 5 minutes walk only for it to be an uber or 25-30 minute walk each way. Friendly and responsive but not worth the price and the repeated pests and roaches were never resolved. The kitchen dishes were dirty and never cleaned that I had to myself. Also strict no smoking which is a good rule but always reeked of smoking near or in the apartment. Overpriced stay too for unit and area.
It was a beautiful place to stay and very close to public transportation which made the exploring the city that much easier. Scott was very communicative and helpful!
I believe this was our fourth stay here. That’s says all you need to know  love the location, love the place , love the hosts.
Loved it!!

Great place and I truly enjoyed my stay. Everything was clean, comfortable and well taken care of and exactly as they appeared in the photographs. A'isha was wonderful. She reached out to me on several occasions to make sure that all was going well and that there was nothing that I needed. And the parking was easy . I never had an problem  obtaining a spot in front of the home .Great location, great amenities and great host .I will definitely be looking to stay there on my next trip to Chicago.

Alma was a wonderful host. She was responsive to messages and requests. The toilet did have an issue when we arrived and it was fixed within the day. The apartment is clean and matched the photos. The location was great for walking to restaurants and coffee shops in West Loop and the subway for easy access to Millennium Park or other Chicago neighborhoods.
Everything was nice and clean. Host communicated really well and was quick with his responses. Great value for the price
Overall good

Aurora’s place was a great spot for four of us staying in town for a show at soldier field. Great local recommendations from Aurora! It was so easy to access museum campus and the loop via public transportation and the neighborhood is peaceful. The apt is very cute and we would stay again. Thanks Aurora!

Emrah was friendly and quick to respond. The space was so beautiful and comforting, it had just about everything you could need. After a weekend of stomping around the city, my family and I looked forward to going back to the bnb to rest and relax.

Laura's place was perfect for what we needed. It was close to everything we wanted to do. Even though the area seemed busy the home was quiet and we felt comfortable with the neighborhood. Loved having 2 bedrooms and 2 baths. Great for 4 women staying together. Would stay here again !
Biggest issue: none of the tvs worked. Wasn’t a huge deal since we weren’t in the room alit but still.
Amazing place and responsive hosts!!

Thank you, Sean, for hosting us! We had such a great stay at your Airbnb. The place was exactly as described in the listing, and Sean and his team were wonderful about reaching out to make sure everything was going smoothly and checking in on us throughout our stay.
The place is super cute and cozy! We had a charcuterie night, and the glassware and kitchen items were so cute and perfect for it. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!
Thank you again, Sean! 😊

The place was truly stunning. It is beautifully designed, packed with thoughtful amenities, and the views are absolutely breathtaking, the kind that make you pause and soak in every moment. Everything was spotless, comfortable, and clearly cared for with intention. From sunrise to sunset, this place delivers peace, beauty, and a sense of escape. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a memorable and relaxing getaway yet close to everything.
Great location! Easy to walk to all of the downtown areas. The host were very responsive and helpful with issues we encountered during our stay.
Fantastic experience with a gracious host. Would absolutely return!

We really enjoyed our stay at James’ place! We had 4 kiddos with us so taking them all up and down 3 flights of stairs was a little tricky, but the apartment fit our needs very well. Street parking can also be spotty if you have extra cars so plan for that! Overall, very clean and walkable to the heart of Chinatown with all the good eats and treats. Will stay again!

We had a wonderful stay! Florencio was super fast at responding to any questions we had...
We realized that we had forgotten a steamer and before we could head out the door to get one, Florencio had one delivered to us!
Loved the kitchen! We had dinner plans, but the full family table and gas stove just called for us to cook and have a chill game night (Florencio has games on deck too!)...
The morning of our checkout, we woke us to a message of well wishes for the road and Florencio had arranged us to be treated to pastries and coffee from a beautiful coffee shop in the area!
We definitely look forward to booking again! ❤️

Marcos was a fabulous host and very communicative/proactive about check-in when I checked in late. His space is beautifully decorated and absolutely spotless. Really enjoyed chatting with him and some friends before leaving for my night out. Marcos was full of recommendations and provided everything I needed for a wonderful stay in Chicago.

This apartment is located in the famous, high-end Gold Coast location of Chicago - just steps from the beach and also Michigan Ave. - a wonderful location for exploring on foot. This reservation afforded us exclusive access to the members only Metrpolitan Club in Willis Tower, that we took advantage of in our first evening taking in amazing views. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom is large. For a studio apartment, it was spacious and we felt comfortable.

This AirBNB was awesome!! The hosts are extremely helpful & responsive, kept the placed very well-stocked, and just have a great place overall. The proximity to the Brown Line made it super easy for me & my travel buddy to get to and from the AirBNB, but it was also far enough away from the touristy areas to feel quiet and peaceful. Greatly enjoyed the stay here & would recommend to anyone visiting the area :)

This was a last minute booking for me after my prior airbnb canceled due to flooding. It was a quite pricey because of that. Had I found it earlier, I would have booked it! Great airbnb in a historic neighborhood, host was responsive & offered flexible check-in for us. Co-host helped us enter when we had some issue getting in. No complaints, overall. Place matched the description. Will definitely comeback!! Thanks for hosting us.

Great little apartment that is close to the river walk, restaurants, Millennium Park, and other great attractions. I paid to park in the lot across the street (used SpotHero per host’s recommendation) because street parking is hard to find. It is right next to subway but noise did not bother us. Perfect space for two people. Would have been crowded for any more than that

Great experience. Awesome host
Extremely clean with ample space.

The place is newly furnished and very clean. It is very spacious and have all the amenities we need. We did not expect the bathroom to be in the middle between the bedroom and entrance but that's ok. We were also confused about the entrance as it is at the backside, but overall, the place was a good value and accessible to chinatown and downtown
The apartment was great for our stay. Cute apartment with tons of space to relax and hang out. Would absolutely stay here again!

Nancy was friendly, kind, and an attentive host. She provided us with water bottles as well as sparkling water in the fridge, truly hospitable! Not to mention she wrote us a birthday card and surprised us with sweet treats! Overall, we had a wonderful stay and will be sure to come back in the future! Thank you! :)

We really enjoyed our stay with Milan! The space was super cute and very walkable, also super safe! Milan was responsive and understanding, he even made accommodations for last minute parking for us. Im excited to stay at his place again in the future!
Stay was great!
Such a great neighborhood!

Cute place to stay in a peaceful, yet busy area. Lots of restaurants to walk to. Only a few blocks away from the lake. Parking was a little rough, but it’s also right by the red “L” line so it’s very easy to get to on public transit. Iris was really responsive with any questions I had. I would definitely stay here again!

This was a lovely spot to stay for a girls weekend trip in Andersonville/Chicago. The location is a short walk from the main drag of Andersonville. The decor was fun and cute, the home was cozy and the balcony porch was an excellent spot to relax. Johanna was very clear with instructions and provided lots of information and recommendations. Thanks for a lovely stay!
Amazing. Beautiful place especially with a place to park without having to worry about it. I would definitely stay here again.
Great location, enough space for a solo traveller.  It was quiet with a snappy internet connection so I could work.  Overall, I’d stay again if I were back in the area.
Very clean place to stay
Amazing location, very responsive, clean. Would stay here again.
Beautiful view and perfect location right off the blue line. Would definitely return!
Thanks Ben great stay!

Easy to find and easy to check in. Had a minor issue with bed linen, but Darsh was super responsive and corrected it at OUR earliest convenience. Quiet, safe feeling neighborhood. We also rented the garage space, tight fit, but very convenient and great directions on how to access. Would stay here again.
Very communicative host! Everything was very nice and set up properly. We loved the area and how nice the neighborhood was. It felt safe.

Juan’s place was clean, really cozy, and very well decorated. It’s a small place but it didn’t feel like it was too small. It was a little hard getting inside the door with our larger luggages so just keep that in mind when packing! Since it’s a basement unit, there is quite a bit of noise from upstairs. Every morning there was very loud noises and stomping directly above the bedroom so just a heads up. Besides that, we really enjoyed our stay!

Stephanie is kind and responsive. The apartment is in a great location and walkable. The only uncontrollable drawback is the street noise throughout the night, which made it difficult for me and my little one to sleep (even with a sound machine). Otherwise, it’s a great place!

This was a great place for our family of 3. The location was fantastic - we walked or took the bus everywhere. It had everything we needed and no onerous checkout requirements. If you’re sensitive to light when you sleep, bring an eye mask because the curtains allow the morning sun in (especially during the summer). Overall a great place to stay if you want to explore the surrounding neighborhoods.

This was a great stay! It was perfect for everything that we needed. It was walkable to cute cafes and the surrounding area felt safe and very peaceful to be in! Demitri was always responsive and very helpful. He made the check-in/check-out process super easy! I would definitely recommend his place to others! Thank you for everything!
Nice big space that was well maintained and clean. Location was convenient to a few local coffee, shops, and restaurants and the water as well.

Great place! It was very clean and in such a convenient location close to downtown, the beach, and the Obama Presidential Center. It’s also only about 6 minutes from Soldier Field, which was perfect for us since we were there for a concert. Highly recommend, especially if you’re attending an event at Soldier Field or want to be close to some of Chicago’s main attractions!

I had a disappointing stay at this property. The location had potential, but a few areas need attention to improve the guest experience. The mattress was quite firm, which made for uncomfortable sleep, and sound travels easily between units, so light sleepers should be aware. I could hear virtually every conversation the neighbors were having. Cleanliness could also be improved, the appliances needed a thorough dusting, and the sofa would benefit from a deep clean or refresh. The couch looked and felt dingy. Overall, it did not live up to expectations but with some maintenance updates, it could be a great place to stay.
This has been one of our favorite AirBnB places we have stayed. When we go back to Chicago, we will plan to stay here! The space was peaceful and welcoming!
Had a great experience, Dave was very responsive and the place had more than enough room for our group of 12.
Really thoughtful and cozy stay!
Good stay and affordable only annoying bit was the TV doesn’t work which also appears in other reviews.

We had a lovely stay! The place was great in a nice area. No issues with Check-In and Check-Out - Louis was clear about this process and gave recommendations of places around Chicago. Thank you for hosting us! Would book again! 😄😄😄
This is an old apartment that needs a lot of repairs and a better air conditioner.
Some areas where bigger than I expected and it’s a really good location. Parking is pretty tricky sometimes but it’s Chicago so what else do I expect? I would stay there again.

The place was even more beautiful in person! We absolutely loved our stay. The host was incredibly kind, patient, and responsive, always getting back to us immediately whenever we needed anything. He even helped us with our suitcases, which was so thoughtful and appreciated. We had such a wonderful experience and felt very well taken care of. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

Isabel’s place was perfect. Right next to public transit and provided parking passes. The whole place was spotless and perfect for our group. She is a wonderful host. Literally one of the best places I have stayed in. Would stay again next time I’m in Chicago!

Charles's space was exactly as described in the listing. Super clean and well kept. Also always appreciate a well equipped kitchen! The back porch was a sweet little added bonus on top of the homey setting. The beds were comfortable and we really appreciated the ceiling fans on top of central AC. The neighborhood was quiet and easy to walk around, super close to the 606 walking trail -- highly recommend following it to Wicker Park for a meal. Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

This we perfect location. It felt very suburbs and safe, but had TONS of food options minutes away. Free parking on street, and within 15 min to trains made for a great trip! Hosts were so friendly and responsive, added little treats that are always appreciated. Matched description perfectly and was great for a long weekend in Chicago 😊

We were very pleased with this place. The room was a good size, with bathroom right across the hall. Very well appointed, wth many accessories provided for bathroom and kitchen use. Quiet and comfortable. Just a 3 minute walk to our son’s home, so perfect for us to visit our grandchildren!
Truly felt so welcomed, she was a very pleasant host. Definitely going to be staying with her again whenever I come back to Chicago!!

Richard’s place was such a great, convenient, and affordable place to stay. He was very responsive. It was private, quiet, and clean. It was the absolute perfect place  for our weekend in Chicago. Can’t wait to stay here again.
Great spot near many restaurants and shops. Quiet front porch to sit and read - we would stay here again

My boyfriend and I came down to Chicago for a weekend for the BTS concert. It was an amazing experience and Joe made it even better and easier on us. He was super responsive and had such an interesting place. Lots of books, dvds, and coffee! The place was so cozy and I would recommend it!!

Nice big space with a very fun vibe!  Loved the video games and the fantastic mural on the walls.  The hosts were super responsive and helpful.  Very quiet inside.  Comfortable beds and peaceful neighborhood.  Would definitely stay here again!!

This is a perfect apartment for a stay in Chicago with family or a group of friends, well equipped, located in a quiet neighborhood, yet close to downtown and other lovely neighborhoods by train or bus. Easily accessible entry doors make it easy so be with multiple people and be out and about without worrying about a key. We really enjoyed the stay there!
The only downside for us during warm summer days was that the windows couldn’t be opened, and were closed with plastic foil.
Dana’s place was a great little home base, clean, in a good area, and public transport was doable as long as you’re cool using the bus (we had no issues). Thank you!
Our stay was really busy and Jessica place was great. Very clean and updated. Will revisit it again

Second time staying at Ketan's place with a group of friends and we once again had a great stay! The space is comfortable and clean, providing an opportunity to relax when not out exploring the city. Location is fantastic -  a quick walk to the L station or any of the many restaurants and Chicago sights in the area. The on-site parking is safe and secure.

Exactly as advertised. There are indeed a lot of stairs - and I was warned before booking. Place was very clean and bed was comfy. Spacious living room and kitchen. Exactly what I needed for my stay. The only issue is the outside noise - many loud cars. Earplugs were provided by the host so no need to bring your own. Would stay here again!

Needed a larger place to accommodate a big group and options were limited but this listing advertised just enough beds.
Pros:
Very close to the brown line train and available street parking.
It did have enough beds to accommodate 16 (10 adults, 6 kids).
Had some issues with the door codes and host was responsive.
Cons:
Linens are very cheap. There were not enough towels for all guests, no extra blankets, no sheets for the pullout sofa.
Next door neighbors had parties in their courtyard both weekend nights we stayed and the noise was loud in two back bedrooms.
A few bedrooms have skylights in them and are very bright.
Living room chairs are dirty.
Overall- if you aren’t planning on spending much time in the unit and just need a bunch of beds, it’s manageable for a few nights. Maybe pack your own towel.

The property was everything we needed it to be. We were hosting a bachelor party and needed space enough for 12 guests, which it provided. The location is great too, which made it easy to get where we needed to go/be. However, two instances stood out during our stay which made me and my guests uncomfortable:
The first involved two men who tried to get into the unit and did not provide ANY explanation on why they were there or what they were trying to do. This was odd but perhaps there was some miscommunication by the host on when they were allowed to be there? No clue.
The second was worse - the host (or he claimed to be the host) entered our unit unannounced to fix a chair…We did not break the chair or do anything else to warrant him entering the unit. In addition, he made a few off-color comments to us and showed us his gun. He then demanded to know what we were doing for our stay/why we were there. It was awkward to say the least. The host provided no notice he would be there.

I highly recommend this property, especially if you’re going to visit the Obama presidential museum. It is a 10 minute walk. There were street markets within walking distance. The home was beautifully decorated. Everything was clean. All the appliances were updated. The water temperature and pressure was good. We felt safe in the neighborhood and can’t wait to stay there again.
Great location! It was very clean and very easy to get around using the train and bus! Would stay again.

Really enjoyed my stay, the place is just as it was described and matches the photos. I saw previous reviews regarding noise level. Didn’t really bother me. Maybe because I’m from a similar city with similar surroundings. Would highly recommend and would definitely revisit. Both host were very accommodating.

Our stay was great overall. We had a large group of 11 people stay at this AirBnB. The location was excellent for walking to all of bars and restaurants and shopping in Wicker Park. The hosts were very communicative and instructions were clear. The AirBnB itself was clean and as described online. The beds layout was slightly different from the photos however it actually had more beds than advertised, so no big issue. The patio space was lovely. I did find it challenging to cook in the kitchen just because there were no measuring cups, so if you book and plan to cook, expect only the more basic cooking instruments. While there were plenty of plates, we also found cutlery a challenge for our large group as I think there were only about 7-8 forks. Other than that, an excellent stay!

The place was so cute and clean when we got there, the hosts were so nice to us and provided us with everything we could need. The location was great as well, we parked our car and didn’t need it again until we left! Felt safe and it was very quiet!
Wonderful place to stay at and very responsive and cared about our trip. Wonderful people to work with!
Very good location, nice to wake up and walk to Wrigley

It was a cozy little place, very centrally located. Walking distance to many great attractions. A very convenient store right next door. Only downside we had was elevator from 11 floor and up generally not working. Only had to walk one flight of stairs down, which normally isn’t bad but when you have luggage it can be inconvenient. But otherwise, awesome stay.
Ben was responsive host. He was helpful and made us feel at home. We had a great stay!!
感謝Ho Eun的接待，我和兒子有一個愉快的旅程。

Peter’s place was a great location. Quick access to the highway was convenient.  While you could hear traffic noise in the backyard, it did feel secluded in the backyard and you couldn’t hear traffic in the house. Having garage access was a big plus. The backyard was secure and worked well for our two dogs to go out in. The bed was comfy and we would definitely rent again.
Excellent location and easy to work with.

Process was very easy and straightforward from booking to check out, probably one of the smoothest I’ve experienced. The place was even better than the photos, very clean and perfect for what we needed. I was very comfortable during my stay. Whole Foods being across the street came in handy for essentials and snacks. Everything else was really close by, or just a short walk to public transport to get around. Such a great area in general. If I’m ever in Chicago again, I would definitely stay here again!!
I enjoyed my stay here because she made sure to welcome us into her home in a kind way and had everything clean and ready for us to arrive and everything was well organized.
This place was a perfect get away! We were walking distance from the beach and park. The place was clean and just like the pictures.

The house was spacious and had enough beds for our group. We were able to sleep comfortably. Being able to use the garage was a plus even though there was plenty of street parking. The green line was three blocks away and easy to use to go downtown.
Perfect for the cheap price! 30 mins by bus to Downtown Chicago, so still conveniently close to everything.
No frills, exactly as described. Suitable if youre on a budget. Train stop not too far away but expect to uber into the city and back. Ubers were not expensive.
Our stay was great and host was very helpful and communicative.
Great place!
love it !
Amazing place to stay with a big group! Eduardo and his team were very responsive if we need anything!

It had nice decorations and was very organized, bathrooms were very clean, the entrance always had someone at attendance, the next door over night valet was worth the price. Would recommend as many things were nearby and you could walk to wherever you needed.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Envitae. The apartment was clean and matched the description completely making our party of five very comfortable. It's quiet on a nice residential street within walking distance of shopping and a couple of restaurants.
The Envitae team was very responsive answering questions quickly and helpful and accommodating when we ran into an issues. We will be back!

Our group was in Chicago for a few days and very much enjoyed our stay at Ben's place. The four king sized beds and three full bathrooms were great for our group of 5. The space was clean and comfortable.
The building was located in a quiet neighborhood in a nice building. It was an easy commute from O'Hare and close to the Red Line, which was great. We used it to get downtown, to Wrigley, and to the museums. All within 20-30 minutes by the L. We were also able to walk to some near-by restaurants on Goose Island.
Ben was also very communicative. He arranged a slightly earlier check-in and a slightly later check-out for us, which was really helpful. And while they could not hold our bags for us post-checkout, Ben did send me some options for nearby places.
Overall, we'd definitely consider staying again on our next trip to Chicago!

Such a beautiful stay! The space was absolutely amazing, clean, comfortable, and had the cutest aesthetic. Everything looked just like the pictures and the rooms were really nice. Check-in was super easy, and the host was very kind and had great communication throughout the stay. I really enjoyed my time here and would definitely book again!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was sparkling clean, quiet, and featured incredibly comfortable beds. The kitchen was well-equipped, and the provided basic toiletries were a fantastic plus. Check-in was easy, and communication with the host was lightning-fast. We would definitely stay again!
Apartment was beautifully curated with unique pieces and lighting all throughout. Rob was a great host and would happily stay here again and recommend to others!

Amanda & Marcos’ Airbnb was located in a peaceful neighborhood with a good location just a couple blocks from food, drink, and public transport options. The space itself was nice and the listing description was accurate. The couch & bed were not the most comfortable and there was some overhead noise from foot traffic in the mornings that made sleeping in a challenge, but the hosts were communicative & helpful - we would be happy to stay here again!
Great place to stay in Chicago!
Communicated well and proactively got the second bed ready
Unit matched the description and photos. Great, walkable neighborhood.

We booked Margo’s place as overflow space for visiting friends and family, and it was absolutely perfect. Everyone had a fantastic time and couldn't stop raving about how nice, well-thought-out, and spotlessly clean the space was. The location is incredibly convenient and in a wonderful, highly walkable neighborhood. It’s close to tons of local restaurants and stores, and having a Trader Joe's right around the corner made it so easy to grab breakfast and dinner items. Plus, being just a short walk to the Paulina Brown Line stop made getting around the city seamless. I highly recommend staying here if you are visiting the area!
Quiet place, close to CTA stops.
We found this spot and it was perfect for my group of 8! Close to the city, easily taking CTA buses or their train. Also pretty walkable to chinatown and even soldier field if need!

We had an amazing stay. Everything was clean and the host was so accommodating and helpful. The Appartment itself is so quiet and we felt at home. We would definitely book again whenever we’re in Chicago. Thank you again for the hospitality.

Great stay! Central located, modern and comfortable. 4 of us came to  Chicago to take in some sights and a game at Wrigley. The apartment is close to downtown; somewhat further to Wrigley, but worth the extra distance for the space and amenities. Don’t be deterred by the alleyway entrance. If you’re looking for a 3 bedroom space, this is a great choice.
I stayed at Noel’s place while in Chicago for BTS and found Noel to be a very friendly and responsive host who was great at answering any questions I had!

Really nice place with a great group of hosts! They were very responsive, helpful, and provided clear instructions and lots of useful information about the property and the surrounding area. I would definitely recommend staying here and would happily stay again! (:
We loved our stay! The place was so clean and such a great location! Would recommend to a friend!

I had a amazing time at Michael’s place while I was in Chicago for a few days, I wish I could’ve stayed longer! He’s a friendly guy, he recommend me places/restaurants to give a try! And, he has an adorable dog too! I would definitely recommend him as a host!

A group of 5 of us rented this house to explore Chicago and attend a concert at Soldier Field. The location of the house was helpful in avoiding concert traffic since most people come from the opposite direction of downtown. The home looked just like the pictures and is located in a nice, quiet neighborhood. We had some confusion with the door locks and ended up locked out! Thankfully, Dan, the house manager, was able to personally come to the house and let us in. He is friendly and very understanding. The house was clean and had extra supplies of everything. It was easy to park on the street, and we had no issues with parking right in front of the house. Also, having 3 bathrooms was great with 5 woman being in the house. I particularly enjoyed the basement's calming decor and privacy. Overall, we had a great stay!
Great location and very clean spacious space.

A very nice stay for a big group of guys. It was clean and perfect for what we needed. Tons of room to sleep and the theater room was nice. The arcade was fun but a few of the machines need some maintenance.
Ray was very easy to work with.

This was an amazing place to stay in an incredibly walkable area! The location was perfect for a weekend trip. The layout of the space was huge and there was plenty of space for our group of seven. The home was spotless, functional, and had every amenity you could need! Would highly recommend!

Perfect location to check out the plentiful and fun Fulton Market district. We also spent time walking around downtown and along the Riverwalk - all easy to get to.
The shared space is great and the individual rooms are perfectly quiet from each other if you need time apart.
Owen was super responsive before, during and after our visit. And super flexible - allowing us a little extra time at the end to keep our luggage in the unit so we didn't have to drag it with us all day.
Highly recommend if you are on a visit to Chicago.
Justin was very proactive, friendly, and communicative.  The house was nice, clean, and within walking distance of lots of restaurants.
This was a great stay! Very clean Airbnb, close to the train station, and Shaun was very helpful! Would stay again!
The Airbnb was very nice and clean upon arrival!
Comfy and cozy apartment! Quiet area! Walking distant from Wrigley field. Would definitely rebook in the future!
We stayed here for a reunion and the place was fantastic! The outdoor area is such a great amenity!
Our stay was wonderful! The place looks like the photos. It’s super walkable to everything you need, and the host was amazingly responsive whenever we reached out. Highly recommend!
We enjoyed our stay. Had a lockout situation but the host quickly resolved it
amazing hotel with a great location! walking distance to the bean and everything was clean and comfortable. would stay again!
Wonderful place and great location.  Great for a first Chicago experience.

Neighborhood felt safe. Check-in was easy with instructions. The unit is a basement unit so it was expected for it to be dark and a bit muggy. There’s close to no natural sun that comes in. The place was a lot smaller than expected. Other than that, the place did its job. The host was responsive, polite, and very accommodating.
The stay was great
My friends and I had a great reunion weekend in this lovely space. Easy to get to from airport and downtown and great space for relaxing. Highly recommend!
Amazing space and hosts. Felt right at home :)
Exactly what we needed. It was clean, and the host communicated well.
Very clean and practical!
We had a great stay here, great location in Chicago.
Very clean, quiet, and comfortable. We needed more towels and they took care of it in a timely manner. Within walking distance to Union Station. Easy access to public transportation and stores.

Very nice little spot. Just the right size for 4 ppl willing to share a bed. Everything was comfy and clean. The host are very helpful and responsive.  Location was close and easy to get to for our activities.  Will definitely stay again.
Alle’s Team was very responsive. There is street parking available and the listing is close to the train station/ bus stops. Good location if you are driving to Chicago.

This was a great place to stay, very clean, and enough space for 5-6 people. The driveway in the back yard was fantastic, no need to search for street parking. Also loved the security features like the exterior cameras and the code locks on the doors, we felt very secure. Eduardo was very quick to respond when we had questions and the whole process was very smooth. Would highly recommend this place.
had a wonderful stay

Friendly host. The details of check-in were very detailed and well written out. Free street parking available. Very convenient enough location to travel and explore the city. The apartment itself was okay. Beds weren't the most comfortable, noise from the upstairs unit was very audible, and the whole place smelled vaguely of dog urine. The kitchen was well stocked and overall the place was clean (with a few ants).

The place was great and the host was kind, respectful, and responsive. The Airbnb wasn’t too far from downtown Chicago and it was easy to get around the city. Overall, great experience and beautiful place. Will recommend 👌🏼
Great host. Very friendly. 10/10 would recommend to anyone visiting the area!
Perfect location for a weekend near Wrigley field highly recommend to anyone at the ballpark for a weekend!
Loved it, would book again

This listing worked great for our group. There was plenty of space for all of us to spread out as well as gather together comfortably. We felt right at home. The beds were comfortable. Plenty of blankets, pillows, towels, etc. were provided. We were close to both the bus and trains making travel easy. This fit our needs perfectly! Thanks for a great stay!
Lovely stay in a lovely neighborhood!
Wonderful host and location!
It was very pretty and clean, I would recommend if your on a budget. Other people were really respectful!!
Just as described, great location….wonderful host. Would not hesitate to stay here again.

We loved this place in Andersonville! We stayed with our two small children, and Steve was extremely accommodating. Great location and easy to explore the neighborhood on foot. Would definitely stay here again!
The beds were very comfortable and my friends and I enjoyed the luxe apartment. As a group of 4 women we felt we had the privacy and security we paid for.
Easy location to get to & great value

Bianca was super responsive and helpful with any questions we had. Great host! There are some cool local places to eat and it is close to the subway if you are willing to walk ~15min. Parking is scarce but we always got a spot after some patience.

Gorgeous interior design, you really feel right at home. For not quite being downtown it is relatively easy to get to where you need to go with the subway so close. Area didn't look great at first glance but we came to appreciate it and you can't beat the free parking.
Great location, had all the necessities, felt cozy!
I had a great stay. It was everything I needed to rest my head at night after exploring the local area. 👍

This place slept 11 grown men comfortably! 3 king beds, 3 queen beds, and 3 couches! 2.5 bathrooms worked perfectly. The place was very clean, in a great part of town, and check-in/check-out was an easy process. The kitchen allowed us to cook meals and had plenty of dishes, utensils, and cookware. There are also two refrigerators, one downstairs and one upstairs. Overall, we were thrilled with our stay and it made our trip a great time! Thank you, Junni!!
Updated and clean interior, nicely decorated. Enjoyed using the outdoor space and walks to great restaurants.

Great place to stay at if you’re in Chicago and want to be closeish to downtown. Romana was very responsive and helpful throughout the trip. They even provided snacks, a souvenir, water and garage space for 1 car. The stairs leading to the unit are steep and narrow — something to consider when booking. We had no problems and would highly recommend this place to others! :)

I had a lovely stay here. The space is easy to find and the instructions the host provides makes it easy to get in. The room was very nice with a bathroom, small kitchenette and large and comfy bed with a flatscreen tv. The shower was super nice with good water pressure and very hot. It was supremely clean and very quiet at night even tho there are other people staying in the house we didn’t hear them at all. The location is a tiny bit out there if you are trying to get to places downtown but it’s easy for ubers to find and close to a bus stop. Overall great place and I would stay here again.

Great, family friendly apartment. Had everything we needed and was perfectly located on a quiet street within walking distance to restaurants, coffee shops, wicker park, and the train to downtown. Ewa was also super responsive and accommodating. She provided a high chair when asked and allowed us to check in early. Would absolutely stay here again.
Great place!

Very disappointing stay. We requested a 30 min early arrival and were told no, so we arrived at the scheduled 4pm time. We were then told by the cleaner we couldn’t enter until 4:30and had to contact the renter before getting in.  The place was extremely dirty. Greasy countertops, dirty stove and coffee pot, and dishes, silverware and utensils in the cabinets were  all dirty. The dishwasher was broken. There were no kitchen towels, bathroom hand towels, garbage bags, or enough linens/blankets. The shower had visible mold and mildew, the light switches were filthy, and bed linens and the dingy towels smelled. I messaged the renter multiple times with no response and eventually had to involve Airbnb support. Nothing was done until Saturday about 4-5pm, nearly 24 hours after our arrival. Although the space was a good size for our needs, the cleanliness and customer service were unacceptable. We left the place cleaner than we found it and would not stay here again.

Such a charming place!  Looked just like the photos. Loved the treelined street. Super quiet and peaceful. Safe & friendly neighborhood, with plenty of places to eat and shop within walking distance. Would definitely stay here again!

My host Tippi was great, she took great care in setting up her house for ABnB use. not cluttered but I still got a sense of home. It was a good neighborhood just 5-10 minutes from the metro subway.  The only minus was that the resturants are kind of spread out and many close at 9:00 pm
Perfect for events at Wintrust Arena or Soldier Field, walkable to Chinatown, great vibe!

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and everything we needed was provided. Amy was friendly, responsive, and made the whole experience easy and enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again!
Very appreciative for making my bachelor weekend one to remember

I may be naive, but my expectations were higher for something costing over $250/night. This unit harkened back when I lived in various student ghettos some 50 years ago in Boston. While the posting says four people can be accommodated, I think it would be CROWDED inside. Some of this I would have learned about if I had studied the photos.
The location was OK and the neighborhood felt safe. Random people encountered while walking seemed friendly. Finding street parking was mostly not a problem, except on Saturday night.

For the owner, Norma handled our calls & texts very amiably, and was easy to contact.
Great location! Great place! Beds were super comfortable and the place was really clean!
El lugar está acogedor y es muy tranquila la zona. Todo estaba limpio y sin olores me gustó mucho. Muchas gracias

Had an awesome weekend at Emily’s! She graciously allowed an early check in so that I could get settled before a wedding — absolutely saved the day! It was a great location to so much yet also very quiet. Emily was so fast to communicate. Thank you again for everything!

Everything was amazing. He is supper communicative. Even went out of his way to make an extra key so we could have better access. Super nice host. Will definitely book with him again when I go back to Chicago.
This place was perfect for something private but still close to where we needed to go! Lots of space my group of 4. Host was very sweet and responsive!

On overall, it was a nice place to stay. Just little things could have been better like a bit cleaner the floor. As a recommendation, try not to come back past 9 PM because the neighbors don't look so friendly.
What I liked the most was that the communication with Kevin was always fast and he was willing to solve anything that popped up. I'm pretty satisfied with the service and would go back again.

Jane and her husband were great hosts! They were accommodating with us when our flight landed earlier than anticipated and were more than willing to be helpful. Definitely would love to stay with them again!
Located really close to the Blue line so pretty easy to get around from this location. Host was very responsive and quick.

I appreciated having a safe space that filled all of my needs. Im 69 so not as tech savy following self check in, but I managed thankfully. I loved the mattress, great on my back. Nice n firm, thank you.
The place and space was wonderful!  Spacious, restful and cozy. No true complaints. Will be back. 🤍⚡️✨
Super clean with tons of places to walk to. Very comfortable to stay in
Tina’s place was absolutely perfect for a long weekend in Chicago. Lots of great coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance. Not a far walk to Wrigley too!

Clean and comfortable place that met our needs. The host was responsive and flexible, and the neighbourhood was great. A few things to note: it’s an above-ground basement with limited sunlight and sidewalk-level windows, so there’s less privacy. We could also hear the upstairs neighbours walking around, and our bedroom was difficult to cool despite the fans and A/C. Overall, it was a functional stay that suited our needs.
Awesome place to stay. It was close to a lot of entertainment and in within walking distance of the Blue line, making it really easy to get to and from downtown.
Perfect place for group of 5-6. Close to things and public transport.
Nice

Stayed here to drop off our daughter at DePaul University, which was a couple of blocks away. Ideal location and had space to help us get organized for drop off. It was a good place! It is close to the stadium and chinatown. Had a good time the weekend of BTS.

Emily was such a great host. The house was so clean and had so many amenities that made everything feel like home. Emily was super responsive and the checkout procedure was simple. We appreciated all the local recommendations and loved that we could walk to many of them.
My review says it all.

The property was really nice in the area was great. The problem that we ran into is that the TV didn’t work from our initial arrival. The place was exactly as described. Location has a lot of restaurants and shopping in the area less than a 10 minute drive. Only 20 minutes from the airport without traffic which I loved. The host was very nice and accommodating. I really enjoyed my stay!

The train was not an issue AT ALL! It was actually extremely convenient having the Francisco stop on the brown line literally right across the street! Didn’t need to uber at all. The apartment was extremely clean and smelled great as well. A lot of local restaurants and coffee spots well within walking distance in a nice quiet neighborhood

We had such an incredible time in Chicago. This listing was conveniently located, just a short walk to the train station or bus stop. Amenities were very nice and Candace was a great host! We would certainly stay again.
The property is attractive and comfortable, Peaceful and quiet. Easy to get to every where I wanted to go!

Place was exactly as described.  Great location right off the main strip in Roscoe village, and also right next to an e-bike charging station which was a great way to get around!  Apartment is all the way in the back so no street noise to speak of.  Instructions were all clear and easy to follow.  Perfect location for our quick weekend getaway!
Great location! Very clean and perfect for the weekend and a small group. Absolutely perfect for a cubs weekend!
Nice quiet safe place to stay near old town
Great stay!

I had a great stay! The place was very nice, clean, and convenient for what I needed. I mostly spent my time out exploring the city, so I really just needed a comfortable, clean place to sleep, and this was perfect for that. Everything was as expected, and I would definitely stay here again!
Great place to stay while visiting for a concert! Lots of great food paces nearby and a coffee shop around the corner.
Place was great for a couples weekend away! Very clean and welcoming
Jhons place was a perfect fit for us and our plans in Chicago. Had 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. Spacious and well designed. Close walk to the red line to get around too!

Very walkable to Chinatown and still was fairly quiet at night. Ray was very accommodating with letting us store our luggage prior to checking in. Everything went smoothly and would definitely stay here again next visit!
Amazing place! Perfect location close to so many great Andersonville spots. Huge yard for breathing room. Great hosts. Would definitely recommend!
The place was huge! Plenty of space for big families. Ian was easy to contact and was very helpful. I would stay again and recommended to others!
Great location in a nice big space for larger groups. Very pretty views. Extremely walkable location. The host was very responsive in a timely manner.

The location was nice and quiet.  My husband and I stayed in the room in the front while our daughter stayed in the room across from the bathroom.   I would stay here again if we ever decided to visit Chicago again.  The house is a bit ways from downtown, so best thing was to either Uber to downtown and back. It made it so easy to enjoy ourself without having to bother  with driving and having to pay for parking.
Awesome stay. Not sure you can find a better location!

I loved staying here! Only here for about 2 nights and Mary made it all so easy! Told us where to park, let us check in late, gave us specifics, etc. the communication was great! We really hope to stay again, it was a pleasure

Had a great stay in Chicago. We were in walking distance to bus that took us downtown / subway and to Amtrak train station so we didn’t have to spend much on Ubers around town. Close to a 24 hour dining option which was also great after long day out.
Beautiful place.

Fantastic location - insanely clean from the moment you walk up the stairs into the apartment. You are in the best location - we didn’t move  our car the whole time during our stay, with ample free parking on the street.  Luisa was very responsive and attentive to everything we needed! We would absolutely stay here again!
Greatly appreciated getting to check-in early. Nice place to recover after full days exploring Chicago. Walkable area with easy access to L.

Had a great stay here at Monica’s! The apartment was very clean and very roomy. I will say the only hint was the location. The streets were very busy and had to park a bit far to get a spot. Aside from that the apartment was great!
Great stay
Safety area, really clean, have everything I need, I went there for concert and wanted to check in early. Joey and Monica tried their best to have my place already asap.

The place was cozy and has a very comfortable living space. The bathrooms both have bathtubs with jets for relaxation. Bryan was a great host sharing his peaceful garden. Logan Square is a vibrant eclectic community with great eats and walking access to many things. I’d definitely stay here again.
Excellent place and location was great

LOVED staying here, Host was very kind and attentive; always respond very fast whenever we had issues and or questions; only issues we came about was very limited outlets and the ones there seem to be short circuit; including the very strong smell of smoke due to the surrounding area; however I definitely recommend; was a very convenient and well taken care of place !!!

We went for my dad’s birthday weekend to watch the cubs play. It was a 30 minute walk to wrigleyville and a few cute shopping areas along the way. Multiple coffee shops and fun pubs near the condo and even a churro place right downstairs! We enjoyed the location and our stay.
Kim is very communicative and fast to respond. The location is excellent and the price is hard to beat. I recommend this place for sure
Great space and a perfect location. Jhon made everything easy from start to finish, would absolutely stay here again.
Owen's place was great to stay at! Very comforting, peaceful and seemed like a decent neighborhood. Owen also made the place and instructions very easy to navigate and find.
The location is excellent, only a short drive from the Loop. There's not much going on in the area, but we wanted somewhere quiet so it was perfect.

Nika’s place was a very comfortable place, she was very responsive when I had a question and made sure my stay was peaceful. Her place is also a good walking distance to the subway! I saved out on Chicagos uber prices so much because of it! Thank you for hosting me and my friend!

We found this Airbnb to be exactly what we needed on our Chicago trip! Our hosts David and Andrea immediately welcomed us warmly when we arrived and gave us some tips for navigating to our venue at Soldier Field. Perfect place to stay for those taking a trip to Chicago!

This is a fantastic place to stay in Chicago for a group.  The local area has lots of great bars and the commutes into the city are manageable with rideshare. The rental has plenty of space and all of the bedrooms were comfortable.  The hosts were responsive and helpful.
Great stay and location. Walking distance from train, bus and stores all around. Will be booking  again if I ever come back and visit.

Wonderful place to stay at. This is a very convenient and safe location with many delicious restaurants nearby, a Target, H-Mart, and other stores. There's a park a block over. The place smells nice and was very clean. The beds were comfortable. Easy check in and out process. The hosts were very quick with responses and were very accommodating.
stayed here with my friend for the BTS concert. we ran out of toilet paper and paper towel and the owner brought more down for us. appreciated the swift communication. thank you!
This was such a cool place to stay, a really pretty exterior and very homey interior and matched the Chicago vibe very well
Amazing place with lots of amenities. Great location and plenty of space!

Olgi and Paul provided great and timely communication about check-in and check-out. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed for an enjoyable stay. Clean space, very fast responses
Great place to stay. Would recommend
Great host! Great home! Place was about twenty minutes for downtown in a nice quiet neighborhood.

Alina was very helpful and kind! The place was very clean and easy to access, both with parking and walking. She had so many recommendations and things to do in the Airbnb! We loved our stay and would recommend booking with her.
Good Location. Easy Parking. Nice clean place.
Great place to stay. Would stay again

This was my 2nd time staying here in Wynter’s place and it was just as good as last time! She’s a great host, super nice and respectful of your visiting/vacation time! Even left a couple goodies and a thank you note for me!!
The place was clean, tidy, and stocked with all the essentials one would need!
The location is perfect in a nice quiet neighborhood, not too long of a drive to downtown and the bus runs at all times of the day to get to/from downtown in about 35mins. Love the Bronzeville area, would love to stay here again! Definitely 100% recommend!!
Amazing place , amazing host , very accommodating and friendly always able to answer any questions I had didn’t have a problem staying here at all will come back again
Great experience!
Nice place. Nice neighborhood
Great stay in Chicago! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a convenient location. Everything was as described, and the host was responsive and helpful. I’d happily stay here again!

We absolutely loved our stay here! The place was super clean, comfortable, and in such a great location. We felt completely safe the entire time, and the area was so quiet and peaceful, which was really nice after long days of exploring.
The host was wonderful and always quick to respond whenever we needed anything. They were so helpful throughout our stay and really made everything easy for us. We had such a great experience and would 100% stay here again next time we’re in the area! 🤍

Overall it was a good stay. The place was as described and we had a good time in Chicago. We brought our own towels and pillows since I have colored hair and a fees for a stained towel is a bit ridiculous. Parking was a struggle.
Overall really great stay and good location for where we were going.

Had a pleasant stay, perfect for going to the stadium venues for a couple days! The neighborhood is a bit iffy, so careful going out at night, but the location itself is secure with it's entrance, and is fairly sound canceling as well.

The unit was gorgeous. Very clean, comfortable, and cozy. Eric had great communication throughout our stay as well - check-in/check-out was smooth. Minus the noise from the fire station nearby, we had a pleasant stay overall.
Our stay was excellent. Home was immaculately clean and prepared for us. Effina  was quick to respond to any questions. We'll definitely look into booking again when we return.
Charles was an awesome host, very kind & responsive. The apartment was super cute & clean! Location was great for Solider Field.
Safe area and clean accommodations

Loved staying at Dan’s place! It was a great value for everything the home provided, especially the location. The place was very clean, and Dan did a fantastic job communicating and responding quickly. I would definitely recommend staying here and would love to come back again! :)

Gorgeous and lived in home. You can feel Roxanna’s family history in this space and it is such a beautiful thing for her to share. She is absolutely delightful,, this airbnb feels less like a place to rest but more like a home that immediately welcomes you in. Would recommend 1000% to anyone wanting a charming place to stay.

The location and bnb were so beautiful. It was a great place to stay for me and my sisters for the couple days we were visiting Chicago. The hosts described it accurately and communicated well. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Good place to stay. Studio is spacious and clean. Would stay again.

Lovely place, few steps from the bus stop so is easy to get around, one parking spot guaranteed, great communication with the host very friendly. If I ever go back to Chicago I'll definitely book this again.

The space was beautifully kept and clean, it was easy to find and it was easy to get around from the location. Street parking could be hard to find and the entry way to get up into the unit was cluttered with boxes. Other than that we had a wonderful stay.

We loved our time here! Within walking distance to lots of cute and tasty restaurants, and never had any issues with street parking. John was super communicative about check-in, too. Definitely would recommend!

It was a nice place! It was by a bad neighborhood which was a little bit scary but the place itself was nice.
Very nice host! Helpful instructions, check in was easy, it was a quiet place. I’d recommend!
This was a great location for out trip! Er had more than enough room for all of us and the host was really friendly and helpful!

Honestly greater than I had imagined and it was really clean and enjoyable. I would definitely rebook my Airbnb here again!

Great place to stay and close to public transit.

The place looked exactly like the pictures. Very beautiful and clean.
