It was great, we had a great time!

This is probably one of the best Airbnb’s that I’ve stayed in. Everything was exactly as listed and it was in such a cute neighborhood! Humma also replied so quickly and was extremely nice whenever we needed help with anything. I highly recommend this stay!
We had a fantastic stay! We felt very safe. The apartment was clean, and having two bathrooms was a big must for our group! Would definitely stay again!

We had an amazing stay at Patrick’s place! Our original Airbnb fell through on the day of our arrival due to a plumbing issue, leaving us scrambling to find a last-minute spot for our trip to the BTS concert. Luckily, Patrick’s place was available and turned out to be a fantastic backup.
The home is located in a very nice, safe neighborhood, and the local neighbors were so friendly—they greeted us right away and made us feel so welcomed. Public transport made traveling to the concert effortless, and taking a simple 20-minute walk into Chinatown was super convenient. While parking is on the street, it was completely doable to find a spot.
We had a great time and will definitely book Patrick’s place again the next time we're in town!

We had a wonderful stay! Our host was incredibly kind, helpful, and accommodating throughout our trip, and we really appreciated how easy Heidi made everything for us. The room was perfect for what we needed—comfortable, welcoming, and in a great location. We had such a positive experience and would absolutely recommend staying here!
Had a great time. Nice and quiet even when close to Wrigley field and a game going on. Lots to do in the area.  Near the train station.

Beautiful place, looks just like the pictures! Nice area and has a lot of restaurants within a good walking distance. Very spacious and comfortable beds. Host was very responsive and friendly! Instructions were clear and helpful during check in and out. Would love to stay here again if I ever come back to Chicago :)

This is one of the best bang for your buck Air BNBs in Chicago. Especially if you’re planning on being out and about. It’s a shared kitchen,  two bathrooms and living room but the other guests were very polite noise wise. I will stay here again

The place was clean when I got there, pretty nice and perfect for just a couple nights! I spent most of my time in town, but I was comfortable for the time I was in the home. The bed is CRAZY comfortable, too!!!
very nice neighborhood  and .place

We had a great stay at Jeffrey’s place in Chicago. The apartment was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed for our stay.
The location was one of the biggest highlights. It’s in a quiet and safe residential neighborhood, while still being very convenient for getting around Chicago, especially with the Blue Line nearby. We relied heavily on public transportation during our stay and found it very easy to explore the city from there.
We stayed for quite a while and felt very comfortable there. I would definitely recommend Jeffrey’s place to anyone looking for a peaceful place to stay with good access to the rest of Chicago.

This was a great stay in a convenient location. Right by the train, and surrounded by grocery stores, restaurants, and bars. Easy to commute into the downtown Chicago area too. They were missing a few small household items (no refill toilet paper, paper towels, and no trash bags) but overall a great stay.
they were amazing hosts!! very responsive and kind, they let me check in early and had the room ready immediately when i asked! would 100% stay again if i return to chicago!!
This place is beautiful. Love the interior design. We felt very safe and welcome. There are lots of places to eat within walking distance. Thank you, Liz and Martin, for a great stay!
Very responsive, beautiful home, easy 10 minute drive into the city

I knew it was going to be a noisy room, so that's not the problem. It was a decent location near Soldier Field and Chinatown as well.
When you first walk in, it smells like a dog lives there. The floors look like it's never been properly cleaned.
The curtains didn't come down the window all the way in bedroom 2, so there was a pretty wide gap that people can see through from the street, so I had to put the mirror in front of the window or get dressed in the dark.
The locks on the bedroom doors were very flimsy and easy to open.
When the amount of people changed on my reservation, they refused to let me change it, so I had to pay extra for someone that wasn't going to be there. They said I'd just have an extra towel, but never received it. Then they tried to extend my reservation for $160.
Finally, we saw a mouse in the kitchen and woke up with bug bites on our legs. We decided to leave early.
Good location, incredibly inconsiderate hosts, and questionable cleanliness.

My friends and I had a great stay The Welcome Spot! It was a convenient & walkable location to the plethora of good eats around the Chinatown area & also relatively close (~20 mins or so away from Soldier Field/Field Museum), which was nice! Getting ubers to and from the airbnb was easy and affordable as well. The airbnb itself was exactly as described in the photos and was perfect for our group of 5. The 3 rooms & 2 bathrooms were very clean, the modern stainless appliances in the kitchen area were aesthetically pleasing and easy to use and the living room area was very inviting as well. Additionally, the price was affordable and the hosts were very responsive. All in all, a great place to stay especially for larger groups of friends wanting to stay together and away from the downtown area (but also close enough to get to by car about 10 mins away) but also at a great price as well. Thank you!
Great place

Very convenient green line nearby when our group split up to do different things. Spacious bedrooms. Lots of street parking but do be careful of days the city sweeps. We came in very late at night and didn’t read the signs so got fined which was on us cause we were tired from long drive. There’s garage parking in back for extra but we actually didn’t need it at all due to ample street parking. We definitely would rent here again due to location, size and cleanliness. Responsive host. Thank you

I had a great stay! The place was just like the pictures, very clean, organized, and comfortable. The location was convenient, with a Metra station about a 20-minute walk away and several bus stops nearby. There’s also a Target about a 10-minute walk away, although it’s a small one. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely stay here again! 💜

One of the best places I’ve stayed at. The neighborhood was clean and quiet. The location was perfect for what we planned on doing during our two nights stay. Tonya had a list of recommendations that I found very helpful.

We loved staying in this spot in Lincoln Park- 2 moms and 4 boys for an end of summer visit.  The space was beautiful and comfortable for our group and the location was perfect.   We definitely recommend checking out the local food so close too!

Cons: Maintenance needed in the premise tub peeling significantly, noise in the flushing toilet. And AC not operating consistently making it hot in the unit. I wouldn’t have chosen the unit had I know of these issues.
Pros: proximity to what I was there for
The hosts were kind and very helpful.
Walkable and peaceful area, comfortable beds.
We had a wonderful stay. Jeannette is so responsive and lovely! We felt safe and at home. Would absolutely stay again!

This is the perfect place to stay in Chicago. It's close to bus lines, and it's so cute. The amenities that are available in this home made it feel so comfortable and cozy. You can tell a lot of care and consideration is put into this home.

I’m from the Chicagoland area so to have an apartment this nice for this price was really awesome!! It was homey, clean, and made us feel so comfortable while in the city. The area feels safe and Jorge was super helpful in answering any questions we had!!
10/10 recommend you stay here if you’re visiting!!

I can't say enough good things about this property.  Incredible location, spacious and clean.  Perfect accommodations for a foursome that want to fully experience Wrigleyville but also each want their own bedroom.
Jeanette and this home are amazing! I’ll be booking with her every time I come to Chicago and you should too!

Three of us stayed here and absolutely loved it! More spacious than expected. Amazing view!!! Extremely accessible parking and train station—it was less than a 5 minute walk to our car and the train. Everything was very easy to access and use. The couch pulls out into a bed and the main living area is plenty big enough for an air mattress as well. Super clean and cute.
There’s so much food and many things to do within a 10 minute walk radius. This is an amazing and safe location, but bring ear plugs if you can’t sleep through street noise and the fire station across the street. It didn’t bother us too much.
The only things to note is the 3 flights of stairs (no elevator) and spotty WiFi if that is important it to.
We felt very safe and at home here. Would 100% stay here again!
Heidi was so nice and friendly. She made me feel very welcome and her cats are the cutest!

Wonderful stay with Gina and José! The AirBNB was on the bottom floor of a cute house in a peaceful neighborhood. The night we arrived, there was a relaxing backyard event happening next door, with parents and their children enjoying the beautiful summer weather. It was wonderful to see families walking their dogs, kids riding their bikes, and couples strolling through the neighborhood over the weekend. It made us feel safe and comfortable!
The room was clean, tidy, and neat. I slept in the bed closest to the front door, and it was sooooo comfortable. The sheets were speck-free and felt like new. There were curtains to separate the beds, which we appreciated. The bathroom was spotless, with fresh towels and shower supplies provided. The kitchen also had free coffee and tea! Check in and check out was easy, responses to messages were quick, and the price was very reasonable.
Thank you to Gina and José for the lovely stay!
Un apartamento espacioso, muy bien equipado en una ubicación muy buena.
Great place to stay, well-written instructions on how to get in, spacious for a family of 6. Lucien was super responsive and quick to answer all my questions!

Overall, this space was very nice! Very easy to locate and access with the help of the host. Only thing I have to say is the parking space. It was listed that there was a free parking space in the parking garage, however, the parking space provided was outside the parking garage. It was pretty hard to get in and out because of the pole that happened to be right in the middle of the space itself. If you’re not good at parking in tight spaces or have a larger vehicle, I would probably advise to park on the street or in a different garage. Otherwise, everything else was great! Clean space and the hosts were very easy to communicate with!

Beautiful neighborhood with cafes and restaurants close by. A 10 min walk to the train for easy access to everything. Check in is very clear, however, quite a few steps that involve using actual keys that seemed to magically shape shift and make you question if you even know how to use a key! Make sure the A/C is set to “cool” and not “fan”, otherwise it’s quite warm in there! WiFi was spotty, however, fine unless you’re working. Very clean and well maintained. Mattress is very firm.
Great place and amazing hosts. Cant wait to stay again
Enjoyed our time there! Everything was super easy access and hosts were super responsive and helpful. It was great the city transport was nearby too! Made everything easier and we had a great time.
Great spot!
Great place in a great neighborhood! Bed was very comfortable!

My friend and I loved Kari's emerald oasis. We ended up staying indoors for most of our time there, and were able to keep everyday novel with the amenities provided. The unit was aesthetically pleasing, spacious, and so very comfortable. Most importantly, Blueberry was very grateful to have access to the backyard and the many treats Kari had prepared. Thank you for making our first trip to Chicago memorable!
Excellent place to stay, close to subway, restaurants and other amenities.
Cute little place and good neighborhood! The hosts were super sweet and couldn’t have asked for a better stay! Thank you!

Tye was a great host! He was friendly and helped us feel right at home. The bed was comfy and the room looked  just like the photos. His apartment is very cute; nicely decorated & clean. Entrance access/self check in was easy.
Great stay. No issues. Communicative host
Great location! We had a lot of fun and will definitely be back. Thanks again.

Absolutely loved our stay here. It’s a smaller place but it worked out perfectly for two of us. Clean and just as described. Very easy to get inside. Host was very good at communicating and giving instructions for everything. It’s within walking distance of a lot of good restaurants and places to go. Thanks so much for an amazing stay!

We enjoyed our stay. This place had everything we needed, and was pretty clean! We had wished there would have been some hooks to hang things on (jackets, bags, etc.) Location was good, and it was easy to find.

Oscar was an amazing host! Super friendly , clear instructions. Would check in throughout our stay. The place was spotless , had drinks, snacks and coffee available once we got there. Really appreciated how flexible Oscar was with check in as we were running behind due to traffic. Neighbors were respectful also. We will definitely be back. Financially doable, doesn’t charge an arm and a leg unlike past bnb’s I’ve had experience. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! 🤗
Very clean and comfortable space for our weekend stay! Loved that there was garage parking for our car. Would stay again!
Stay is very safe and perfect and peaceful. But it's not safe to travel in night time by public transport. In day time it's not even a problem.

Tarek's place was great! Beautiful renovation of a historic house, walkable and easy access to the bus line 6 for getting to the different museums. Amazingly large home with convenient laundry on the second floor.

Great location, great space, surprisingly quiet inside (easy to sleep, even for young kids with early bedtimes), and fantastic hosts who’re very responsive and proactive.
10/10 would stay here again!

Matt & Nicole's home was very spacious, stylish and convenient to many restaurants and shops, etc.  The neighborhood was pretty quiet, walkable and convenient to many area attractions.  We appreciated Matt & Nicole being very responsive when contacted.

The place was exactly how it was listed! Everything was nice and organized when we arrived. Walking was our main way of transportation since everything was nearby. We’d definitely stay here again if we ever came back to Chicago!
My stay was okay.
Cristina is always responsive when answering questions. Nice place to stay for a short trip.

Absolutely loved our stay at The Nest! The unit was even better than the pictures, it was just gorgeous! Prince and Victoria really went out of their way to make us feel welcomed during our stay and were very responsive when we had to reach out. The little details of the place were what really stood out to me, right down to the bird's nest keychain on the keys. Would definitely recommend to others and stay again!

Hi, thank you again for the stay. The Airbnb itself was very nice, comfortable, and welcoming, and we overall enjoyed our time there. The instructions were very clear compared to other places I’ve stayed at. We really did enjoy our stay and I plan on leaving a 5-star review. Whenever I come back to Chicago I will plan on trying to book this place!

I have some pros and cons to list.
Pros: very responsive when we asked a question.
Easy to find. Near public transportation. Very clean. Fell in love with their two dogs. Very accommodating with early check in. We thought we needed to leave luggage longer than check out and they were very accommodating with that.
Nice appliances and was able to use the laundry.
Cons:
Near a very busy street with loud traffic.
Temp controls not in unit but controlled by the landlord that lives upstairs. Seemed argumentative at first about turning the air down but ultimately did. I don’t think the air was on the last night as it did get warm but it was our last night so we didn’t bother asking,

a strong 4/5! besides minor hiccups, the stay was worth it! the GOATS were very descriptive with instructions & things were very thoroughly explained. just like any airbnb, there isn't a perfect experience, but this was a lovely, very convenient stay. it was located in a quiet neighborhood with quite a few convenient shops/eateries within walking distance, even an aldi within about 10 minutes. the photos of the bathroom (at least for the master) weren't given enough justice, she was huge! my only heads up for future visitors would be:
- be prepared for a parking mess lol! we searched for spots anywhere from 5-30 minutes if that!
- (unless i misread in advance) the tv is a bit confusing to work at first but after reaching out to the host it worked just fine!
- the lock situation is also a bit tedious, but after reconfirming with entry instructions was also made easy!
i would definitely stay here again in the future, thanks for a great stay! <3.

Our stay was amazing! The home is like nothing I have seen before and after 2 days I was nowhere near finding all the incredible treasures.
James and Colin were wonderful hosts. Always there when I called and so extremely helpful. Excellent hosts! 10/10 recommend!
It will be better if the equipment and supplies get improved.
This location is close to everything just a few minutes walking to downtown and destination. Highly recommend for people who loves to walk to places.
Worth it for the price, responsive hosts and safe area.
Joe, Alex and their team hospitality is great!

The place was easy to find and clean inside. Prefect room for my family of three for a quick 2 day vacation. Street parking was full at night time so being able to park in the garage was a plus. Would definitely book again is we are back in town.
Muy bueno para quedarse pues todo está cerca!
10/10 would stay here again. Gina was the perfect host! The location was great and the apartment was perfect!
Ginneh’s place was everything we needed for the trip, location is perfect not too far from southloop but far enough from the traffic, it was a quiet beautiful neighborhood, we had a great time there

No issues at all during my stay. The studio was exactly as the pictures had shown. Very nice neighborhood and I appreciate it how close it is to the train.  I’m actually very glad we stayed in this area versus downtown.

Super nice place to stay that is very walkable to the Riverwalk and restaurants. Parking is available, which is a plus. This was our second time staying here, so that tells you how much we enjoyed our stay.
Only stayed for 2 nights for a concert, but it matched the photos. There was art everywhere and music playing when I entered. It’s not far from the bus stop and there’s plenty of street parking.
Great place to stay if you have a big group! Had four bathrooms which really helped a lot. Location was great.

Excellent stay! The apartment was clean, spacious, and the parking spot is an incredible perk for Chicago. The host was highly responsive.  Fantastic neighborhood.  My only critique is regarding the checkout instructions. The listed chores asked guests to strip the beds, start a load of towels in the wash, and take the trash to the alley dumpsters. I referenced a NY Times 5/30/26 article with Brian Chesky AirBnB founder. "How much is too much for a host to ask of a guest? It’s hard to say. We basically said, for example, you should put away trash in a bin — even though maybe at a hotel you don’t have to. But you shouldn’t have to take the trash bag out to the backyard.  No one should have to put the towels in the washer and start it. It’s reasonable to ask people to put dishes in the dishwasher but, with rare exceptions, they shouldn’t have to turn it on. These people are on vacation and they’re on vacation from their chores."  The host clarified these tasks are optional.

Max’s place was perfect for our stay! We stayed for BTS at soldier field and the location was PERFECT. Close enough to the location where uber was super cheap and far enough from the chaos. The place was clean, just as described. No issues with getting in or checking out and was able to get great communication from our host. Parking was SO EASY. So much free open space. I would definitely stay again.
Great location & space!

I absolutely loved the accommodations! I especially appreciated the early check-in. I personally made the mistake of booking an earlier flight and was worried that I would have to walk around the city for hours with my luggage before being able to check in. Thankfully, the host was very accommodating and made the whole experience so much easier. He was also very attentive, friendly, and helpful throughout our stay. The Airbnb itself is beautiful, and I loved how spacious and comfortable the layout was. Overall, we had a great experience and really appreciated the hospitality.
Nice place in a quiet neighboorhood.

The location of this AirBnB made traveling easy because the Blue Line is within a block of this apartment.  The apartment was also within walking distance of some great restaurants in Fulton Market.  That being said, we did not care for the apartment because of the constant traffic noise that disturbed our sleep, and because the apartment was not particularly clean. The outside had knee high weeds and trash strewn about.  The entry hallway had not been vacuumed, and the carpet was coming up off the floor.  First impressions were scary.  We were not given keys to the inside door so we could only lock this when we were inside the apartment.  In fact, the host’s notebook mentioned the need to kick the bottom of that door as it stuck so badly.  Inside, the apartment was decorated nicely in the living area, the kitchen was well stocked, and the beds were comfortable but the linens were not clean. The bathroom’s shower was dirty, as was floor; the rest of the apartment was dusty.

The Airbnb was nice and clean. I enjoyed my stay. The neighborhood was quiet and the host was friendly.
I enjoyed staying at the place.

The space was a basement apartment which we were told up front that it was so that was fine. It was an 8 minute walk from the train, so that was also great. All of the things we needed were there. Everything was clean. The mattresses in both bedrooms are very comfortable.  Although we did not bring  a vehicle, there was a gated parking lot in the back. So I think if you were driving, it would also be very convenient
Great place! I love the location, and the beach was so close. Will definitely stay here again!

This was the perfect place to stay for our visit to Chicago! Parking was stress free and we felt safe in the area. The house was exactly our vibe and Dave gave us some great recommendations. We highly recommend staying here!!

Check in was 3. We got in at 5:30 and host had not completed cleaning and asked me (who walked to the stay with no vehicle) to go find something else to do. Linen on the bed was wet and we had to do two loads of laundry just to have enough linens for the party. Bathroom was as not cleaned at all, hair in the drain and dirty washcloths in the shower. Mirror and futons were dirty on arrival, clearly had not been cleaned by just before we arrived. When asking the host for compensation after describing the state of the place, was refused.
This area is LOVELY and walkable and close to public transport. I would absolutely recommend staying in the area but I would not stay here.
Great stay for my weekend trip

So the place and location are great.  I received conflicting check-in instructions - was told to download a keyless entry app - which I did.   Then asked to txt for the code 30 min prior to check in.   Then received a call saying to use a lock box - got in ok but too much back and forth.   Same on check out.  I asked what to do with keys and never heard back.

This was the first time I booked an airbnb so I was skeptical but I gotta say, if everyone else is as helpful and descriptive as this was, then airbnbing is great. I had a great time in this place and I love the city life outside. The bus was a mere walking distance, there's plenty of coffee shops around, groceries were also walkable to get to. The actual place was really nice and exactly how it's described. I would definitely book here again if I had to be in the city for a long period of time. Also loved how easy it was for parking at the building, and it felt very safe and secure.

Overall, we had a good stay and Moudi was a very responsive and accommodating host. He gave us excellent recommendations for things to do and places to eat in Chicago and was quick to respond when we raised concerns. He also came by to replace towels and address some kitchen items, which we appreciated. That said, several issues kept the stay from being 5-star. The biggest was a recurring unpleasant odor noticeable throughout the day, including during meals, and strong enough to wake both of us at night. There were also some cleanliness/maintenance concerns, including shower staining, mildew-smelling towels and sponge, buildup around the kitchen faucet, and several millipedes. The apartment was reasonably comfortable with both fans and the dehumidifier running continuously. With those going, we weren't uncomfortably hot, although it wasn't particularly cool either. We enjoyed Chicago and appreciated Moudi's efforts to address our concerns.
My family and I travel a lot and found this stay to be a great fit from location to size. Our host was great as well. I recommend this stay!
The location is great and the host was awesome. We had a problem with the power going out upstairs and they came within the hour to fix it. Definitely recommend.
Nicholas was very responsive! There was an WiFi issue and he was able to help in asap!
The space was very well kept and had everything we needed. Laura is very friendly and helpful as well! We look forward to visiting Chicago again and booking with her.
i really enjoyed my stay, my sister came to see BTS & the apartment is right by the train we needed to get everywhere so it was perfect for us!

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago! The place was clean, well-organized, and very comfortable. The hosts were always available to answer our questions and responded very quickly whenever we needed anything.
We had a great week there. The neighborhood was quiet and convenient, with a train station and bus stops nearby, which made getting around the city very easy. We also had no issues with entering or leaving the building.
Overall, it was a great place to stay, relax, and enjoy our week in Chicago. We would definitely recommend it!

Exactly as described. Beautiful and spacious apartment in a great location! It is tucked a little off Michigan Ave, so the street itself isn't super busy, but you are minutes away from anything you need. Location couldn't be better. Building is super secure and the staff is beyond friendly. The train can be loud at times during the night, but they are upfront about that and provide ear plugs (but I didn't need them, it wasn't that loud). Laundry unit came in clutch for our group! Amazing value, especially for the location!

This home is beautiful, clean, and very comfortable. Feven provided clear instructions for the house and she is always responsive to our questions. We were a total 14 adults and a teenager, staying at the house with us and there was plenty of room and plenty of bathrooms. The garage was an added plus. And the neighborhood was peaceful - we walked to a nearby restaurant for breakfast, Ray’s BBQ, which was fantastic, help support this family owned business! I would highly recommend this home; we had a fantastic time.
Lovely spot in Wicker Park. Lots to do and great places to eat.
Great place to stay for the price! Location is awesome and great communication!
Enjoyed the stay! Everything was great and host was super helpful!
Beautiful home with every amenity (except for a microwave). Very quiet neighborhood and close to public transportation. I would stay here again.
Alma’s place is clean and nice in a good location, parking was an especially nice perk about this stay.
Great stay. Not too far of a walk to the public transit system. Quiet neighborhood and her place was clean and easy to get in and out of.
The Airbnb was very comfortable and wonderful to stay in. Also the location was great was close to lots of restaurants. Overall great place to stay.
This was one of the cleanest properties I’ve stayed at. Everything was easy and the home was beautiful

Amazing stay in Chicago, close to all the things to do in downtown and walkable distance to restaurants and bars. Place was clean and super cute. I will definitely come back on my next trip to Chicago.

Chandas airbnb was so comfy! My friends and I were visiting Chicago for the BTS concert and it was nice coming back and relaxing after trying to cram everything chicago had to offer in only a few days 😅 ! The beds and couch were comfortable and eating in the dining area with my friends felt like we were right at home!
A great stay for a small group for 2 days. Spacious, clean, older building but slightly updated/modern apartment.
Great place and super clean! 10/10!
It was such a cute house, me and my friends very much enjoyed our stay. We loved how cozy the house was it felt like our home for the short time we were there!
Very hospitable and a central spot for any Chicago journey. If you love dogs it’s also an added plus in our book
Easy

We loved staying here, we were in Chicago to drop our kid off at college and it was a great location for us; close to two different train stops, a good shopping street, and restaurants. It's also incredibly close to Wrigley Field so if you're looking for a convienent spot, this one is great. There were two games during our stay and despite being so close it was quiet and relatively calm; you'd really never know there were thousands of people just a couple of blocks away. The apartment is very well appointed with a good selection of kitchen items, lots of storage in the bathroom and a massive bedroom closet. The host is very available and communicative.
This is one of the best apartments I've stayed in through Airbnb.
Good location. Good place. 👍🏻

Yolanda is a kind, generous and responsive host. Her place is the best Airbnb I have ever stayed at by a mile. The area is safe, quiet and walkable. I walked my dogs three times a day and was able to put in a 3 mile hike daily. The house was squeeky clean and upscale. She went over board in the design, cleanliness and amenities provided. My dogs and I felt like kings and queens. I highly recommend Yolanda's place to anyone visiting Chicago, myself I will definetely return!
My sister and I traveled down for a concert, stayed for 2 nights. We had a great stay! Worth the price, place was clean, and we really felt at home! 10/10 would recommend and stay there again.
Great space

Milan was easy to talk to and always responded even at inconvenient times. His property was at a very location for a concert we were going to. Provided an abundance of amenities and if I am ever staying in Chicago for an extended amount of time I would love to stay at one of Milans properties.
Place was very neat and well decorated with modern furniture and accommodating rooms
很棒的住宿體驗！

Great location and very close proximity to the train station. Lots of walkable things to do. Could definitely hear the train, but got used to it by the second day. Very safe neighborhood! My only feedback would be the shower pressure was very low. Would recommend this location!
Good stay! The place was beautiful and close to the concert venue!

Very SPACIOUS living room and hangout area for a big group. All amenities worked well (washer dryers, dishwasher). We were six girls and thoroughly enjoyed the place.

Walking distance to a red and green line. Walking distance to Chinatown.
Walking distance to a fantastic local bar.
Just word of caution, didn’t realize it’s second floor and no elevator. So be prepared to climb stairs with your luggage. It’s not super long but also not super short. We just had a lot of luggages and heavy. But honestly, after the initial shock the place made it totally worthwhile.
Will definitely book again! Probably our first choice if we travel in group again!
Excellent! One of the best places we’ve been happy to call home for a few days. Squeaky clean! Great location, walkable to cafes. Friendly, modern vibe.
Great location and very comfortable. The AC wasn’t very consistent in the house.

Julio was very kind and super easy to get in contact with. He was very accommodating and for that I am extremely grateful. The room matched the listing to a tee and the bed was hotel level comfortable. One big thing to take note of is that there is no full length mirror! Only one small one above the sink in the bathroom :( Other than that I highly enjoyed my stay!! For the price and location it really can’t be beat.

The location of the unit was extremely convenient and made life so much easier being able to hop on the green line. It looks exactly like the pictures and the backyard areas were nice and cozy! We were extremely grateful for the cool AC after spending our days in the city, overall it was convenient and is exactly as pictured, Azam was also friendly and extremely understanding to accommodations we needed ! I highly recommend booking here
The house was very nice and spacious. We found the house at a good distance from downtown Chicago and it was close to the lake. We would stay here again!

We had such a lovely stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and affordable. Everything was just as we hoped, and we really appreciated how welcoming and well cared for the space was.
Nate was incredibly friendly, responsive, and accommodating, which made the whole experience feel easy and enjoyable. We truly felt welcomed and appreciated throughout our stay. We’d definitely recommend this place to others and would be very happy to stay here again!
nice place to stay if you are going out and about in chicago!

Great location! As a group of women we felt safe in and around the house, and we were able to conveniently walk to good local restaurants. Plus, it was a quick drive to Millennium Park.
The house itself was very spacious and mostly clean (saying mostly because the showers could use a deep cleaning). The mattresses and sheets were extremely comfortable and we enjoyed the extra pillows. The only concern we had with the bedroom furniture was that the top bunk bed felt a bit unsafe. The mattress is level with the safety railing, so if someone moves in their sleep they could easily fall off. We would not recommend a child sleep up there.
Overall, we had a pleasant stay and appreciated the location. The owner's were very responsive and offered clear instructions.
Excelente lugar para hospedarse, volveríamos sin duda. La zona nos agradó al ser segura y confiable, sus instrucciones siempre claras y precisas y su nivel de comunicación excepcional. Gracias!!

Rafael’s place was great! The train was about 7 minutes away walking there are a few restaurants. The place was as described. Couldn’t have asked for better! Rafael’s team did message me throughout our stay to ask if we needed anything and to not hesitate to ask. Thank you!!

Stay was otherwise fine until I found a bottle of lube in the living room on my second to the last day there. I messaged the host about it and the cleaning crew that came around never cleaned it up. It was still there after I checked out.
We absolutely loved our stay here! Easy to find, lots of walkable places, would recommend or rebook in the future!
Convenient place to stay in Chicago!

Spacious apartment located in a great neighborhood. Lots of restaurants within walking distance, and the closest train is about a 10 minute walk away. Only thing to note about the place itself is a faint smell coming from the air vents. We were mostly out of the apartment and got used to it after a day so it wasn't too much of a bother, but we did notice it when we walked in.

Ben’s place was wonderful! It was fully stocked with everything we needed for our stay. It was within walking distance (8 mins.) to the train and some restaurants. Ben was also amazing with his communication. He responded quickly to any questions we had. I liked that we had garage parking and the option for street parking as well. The beds were comfortable and the area was quiet. Whenever my family comes back to Chicago, this will definitely be a place we hope is available while we’re here!
This was a good place to stay that was pretty close to downtown Chicago. The space was clean and had a good view of the Chicago skyline

Glenn and Laura were very accommodating and lovely hosts! Eager to answer any questions and their home is truly a serene oasis in the midst of the city, while also being very convenient to commute from via car or public transit. Laura was a very attentive host and her fur babies were a bonus we loved. We can tell the house has been loved and cared for and we hope to book again soon!
Great, really loved the anime pictures.

Me and my bf went to a bts concert and we enjoyed our time in Chicago because of this Airbnb. We mostly walked around the city and came in the room to sleep; clean and quiet space for us to rest. The neighborhood was quiet and chill, it was easy to drive to downtown or the soldier field👍🏻
Very prompt on communication would recommend will stay again in future
Great location, clean, safe, had everything that I needed in the kitchenette and bathroom was really roomy. Will stay again when going to Chicago!

The place was as described and worked great for what we needed. We were attending a concert at Soldier Field at this was a great place to come back to. Took the blue line from the airport and only had a couple of blocks to walk from the station.

The place matched the description and photos.  Great location!  Easy to get to CTA because there's a stop at the building.  Parking is easier then most places in the city but I did see a few vehicles with broken windows so I made sure to get on the park side of the building for the lights.

My friend and I stay here for BTS concert
And it's close to the venue when u take the bus to soldier field and its walkable and there's a nearby h mart and dunkin donuts and other restaurants just right outside.
We have fun staying here and everything is clean there's no issues at all and we have no problem checking in and checking out its very easy and they even have lockers to put ur luggage or bags when your early or late departure but its first come first serve.
I would suggest staying here if you want to be closer to the city or if you have concert to go at soldier field this would be great to stay for few days!.
This place had everything my friend and I were looking for and Joe was very responsive. The home was nicely kept and exactly as expected. I would recommend!
素晴らしいロケーションでした。ミレニアムパークも近く、ダウンタウンで用事があればとても都合がいいです。またシカゴに用事がある時は利用したいです。

Hotel Versey is okay, but not great. Especially for the price. Our room was right above a bar, and we could hear loud music all night that made it difficult to sleep. Our room also faced the street directly and we could hear people talking constantly. It would have been nice for the hotel to communicate and ask about noise level but they didn't.
We also booked the hotel specifically for gym access, and the gym was closed for renovations the whole time we were there. It feels like that should have come with a discount.
My family and I had a great time staying here. It was quiet and super clean. We love that each room had its own bathroom. Also you can’t beat free parking specially in the city !
Great little spot for enjoying Chicago! Loved it.

The communication from the host felt excessive at times. There were frequent follow-ups through both Airbnb and SMS including text messages when I had already responded on Airbnb. The repeated check-in and checkout reminders felt more like micromanaging than hosting.
A little more trust and a little less follow-up would have made for a much more relaxed guest experience.
Some maintenance issues that should be addressed, particularly the broken chairs and the air conditioning, which did not work properly at night.
Overall, we enjoyed the property and the neighborhood, but I would hope these points can be addressed for future guests.

The hosts were very friendly and responsive! Instructions were super clear and gave us peace of mind. It was super close to all of the things we wanted to do. We loved the space and felt right at home during our trip :)

Great stay! Nearby restaurants and cafes. Nicholas was very helpful and responsive. Easy for uber/lyft, train/metro. Bus stop right in front of building. Would definitely stay again on my next visit to Chicago!

Jesus was incredibly flexible and very responsive. He provided very clear instructions for checking in and for the home. Home was very clean and provided fun things to do during your stay. The security system was easy to understand, and it provided us relief for when we were away from the home to explore Chicago. The surrounding neighborhood does look a little sketchy, but the home has a security system and gates to help you feel safe during your time in the home or out.

When we arrived at the property neither the stove or hot water worked. We stayed for four nights and the host kept promising that the water would be fixed that day our the next. They did not reach put with updates, we had to keep asking. And when we did receive updates they were frequently wrong. I did receive a partial refund but in my opinion not having hot water or a stove for the entirity of our stay made the air bnb almost unlivable.

Great place and location! Had great communication with the host. A short Uber ride to Riverwalk and Cloud Gate(The Bean). The train does run right outside the room at all times but it was no issue for us. If you’re a light sleeper it might be an issue but they had ear plugs in the room. The place was tidy and perfect for two people. My sister and I would definitely recommend and stay again!

My friend and I stayed in this cute little apartment for back to back BTS concerts and it was a very easy walk to the buses. There is a Taco Bell right next door that is open late as well as a BP across the street and a CVS around the corner. There is a security guard at night, so we always felt safe. The apartment itself had everything we needed although we really didn’t spend much time there.
Posizione al Top. Appartamento ammodernato al risparmio. Ottima dotazione. Istruzioni non precise per l'ingresso. Nessuna flessibilità oraria

The location was great and very central. The price point was definitely for the location rather than the apartment which was fine. It was good for having somewhere to sleep. The bunk bed was wobbly and felt unsafe at times. Also, it would be hard to fit 8 adults comfortably. But overall, it was a great trip and I would book again.
I had a great stay. All of my needs were met and had great communication. I would stay again.

We really enjoyed our stay! The home was comfortable and cozy, and the quiet neighborhood made it a nice place to come back to after being out for the day. The fenced-in backyard was such a cute setup, and the beds were firm but still very comfortable.
There were 11 of us, and the house accommodated our group comfortably. There was plenty of space for everyone to spread out, with a dining room table, kitchen table, living room, and den, so even with a larger group, we never felt crowded. I also personally loved the full-body mirror in the kitchen area—it was such a nice little bonus when getting ready!
The full kitchen was really convenient. We ate most of our meals out, but it was great having everything we needed to make breakfast in the mornings and prepare late-night snacks when we got back to the house. The host was also very responsive whenever we reached out, which we really appreciated.
Overall, it was a comfortable and welcoming, especially for our larger group, we loved it

This place was great. It’s in a new building and centrally located in beautiful Edgewater. It’s a 2 block walk to the Redline that made the whole city accessible. It’s also adjacent to the redline tracks so there was some associated noise, but I knew that going in. The sound proofing of the building made a passing train sound like the buzz of a window air conditioner. No big deal. The cheap couch they have in the living room made for deeply uncomfortable backaches. It’s time to switch that out.

Pros: Anthony is kind and very responsive before and during check in! I appreciated his text of information the day of the check-in. I also appreciated being given a parking permit. I appreciated all the locks on doors and double locks on windows for extra safety.
Cons: I am a light sleeper so hearing the 'door open' alarm would wake me up through the night, it's a good thing to have due to the neighborhood but it would have been nice knowing beforehand. I appreciate the space being pet friendly but I could smell the previous pets who have been on the couch or bed. Sadly, my sister and I would sniffle and sneeze throughout our weekend stay. There also was no hand soap in the bathroom.
Overall, the stay was decent. A 6.5/10
Todo fue agradable , Lukas siempre  se portó muy atento y dispuesto a colaborar muchas gracias

We were running late to arrive and crunched for time to get to a show downtown. Kimberly went above and beyond with her recommendations for dinner and transportation while we were en route, and she made our arrival check in even easier to give us more time to check in and clean up before heading out. She was a really kind and gracious host, and we had a very comfortable stay. Lovely use of space and great attention to detail!

Loved this place. It was right next to a bus stop so going downtown was super easy. getting into the apartment was super clean and beautifully decorated. Communication with Katty was super easy. You won’t regret staying here!

Great place to stay with my 2 daughters and 2 dogs. We attended a concert at soldier field and the CTA was right down the street and we took it downtown. The CTA is how we got around and saved a lot of money and time from having to drive and park.
Also McKinley park was at the other end of the street and it was a perfect place to walk our dogs in the morning and evenings.
The host was very responsive and very nice. All expectations were met.

It was extremely easy to communicate and they are really fast to answer!
The loft was amazing, we were sad we weren’t staying longer haha
Thank you for your hospitality! If we’re back in town, we’ll definitely come back 🫶🏻

This place was exactly as described, super clean, and all with a great view. The location made it walkable almost everywhere and it was super convenient. We attended a concert at Soldier Field, and again the location was perfect. The area is relatively safe, one person in our group stayed alone during the concert and she had a great time. This place has all the amenities you can possibly need. I will say, remodeling work (never bothered us) was being done which made following the instructions a bit confusing when checking in, but after that, going in and out the building was super easy! It’s a quiet building once inside and super duper comfortable. Nothing to complain about on our end! :) If life takes us back to Chicago, we will definitely choose to stay here again!

Booked two rooms in this bldg for 10 people going to a concert at soldier field.  Easy 35 min walk to solder field, convenient and clean.  Instructions to check in are thru a link vs straight in Airbnb messaging which took me a little time to figure out but otherwise fine.  Clean.  One of the rooms smelled like smoke/pot but I’m guessing that was from prior guests. Otherwise room was great

She’s place was fantastic for our quick trip to Chicago. The space was homey and close to several restaurants and shops. A 20 minute drive put us in downtown, allowing us to do all our activities without actually staying downtown. This was one of the best stays I’ve ever had and highly recommend!
We had a great time. The place is extremely spacious and delightfully decorated. The kitchen had everything you can think of. Location is excellent. We would definitely go back again.

Perfect place to stay when in town. If you’re big on Asian foods I recommend staying here.
The place is amazing and close to the train.
Mandy was very responsive and helpful.
Would stay here again in the future
Loved the place, was able to meet the host before I left , lovely lady !! Definitely will be back again soon thank you again ❤️
We had a wonderful stay. The location was very close to downtown and easy to navigate. Space was clean and updated and perfect for our family visit to Chicago. Would definitely stay here again!
Spacious and enjoyable. A great location for exploring the Lincoln Park area. The host is very proactive and made the whole experience easy.

The place was beautiful and it was at a perfect spot in Chicago. The only thing is that you will hear steps from the top floor. Also, if you have excess trash, that you need to throw away. You will have to walk around the block to the dumpster right beside the garage.
It’s a lovely place to stay at.

This was an absolutely wonderful stay. The location is perfect, very close to the red line if you like to go downtown. The beach that is just across the street has perfect blue water and soft sand. The neighborhood is very quaint and safe.
Cynthia was a wonderful host, the place was clean and spacious, and had great communication with us as needed!
The place was a great location so much around to do and not to far from downtown. Iris was very helpful and was quick to respond if we needed anything!

Vladimir is a great host. Proactive and responsive. Thoughtful in the extra touches he adds to your stay. Easy checkin and checkout. The Airbnb is roomy and comfortable. It was very clean but it could use some TLC (paint refresh and touch ups, for example) especially in the kitchen. Sticky paper used to cover the cabinets was peeling and there were spots on the cabinets around the stove. The wicker top on the balcony table was falling apart. It took away from the luxury feel the Airbnb was striving for. The kitchen appeared to be nicely stocked if one wanted to cook. The back bedroom was quiet from street noise. But if someone is staying next door you will hear them. The stairs going up to the apartment are a bit steep if that would be a concern for you. The location is near Humboldt park with a bus stop and divvy bikes nearby. However there weren’t restaurants, cafes, stores within a close walking distance. But once on the east side of the park, there were plenty.

This is a great place to stay for a visit to Chicago. The neighborhood is walkable with several places to eat and easy access to the L via the blue line. We were able to fit our SUV in the assigned parking in the back. The bed was very comfortable and showers were nice. There is wifi but streaming didn't always work. We enjoyed our stay at Christain's place!

Ewaz is a great host and the room we stayed at was pretty and clean. Room was spacious and cozy, had many toiletries and options for coffee and tea, besides water. It was an excellent stay and whenever we come back to Chicago, we would definitely stay here again!
Had a great stay here-the host was very communicative and responsive. The place is walklabe to the UC campus/hospitals. Would stay when in Chicago again!
I really enjoyed this booking! It’s right near Chinatown which made it so convenient for me as I had a lot of events to do around here. I’d definitely rebook here!
Great location! Clean and new apartment. Only downside was the lack of cell service. But a beautiful home!
It was easy to find, great things nearby, and close to the red line. I went for the BTS concert and was able to get there quick because I was so nearby.
Absolutely amazing! So responsive, very helpful, and such an amazing place to stay! Would highly recommend!
Easy and fast walk way to some great food places around. Nice and quiet. Would definitely stay here again
So great!! Eric was extremely responsive to requests and the place was exactly as described. Would love to stay again!!
A great stay! Our Host was spot on on service and recommendations
Very good place to stay in Chicago

Tian’s place worked well for what our group needed during a Chicago concert trip. With 6 women getting ready, having multiple full bathrooms was a huge plus. The house is spacious, comfortable, and covers the basics: beds were comfy, sheets were clean, towels were plentiful, and the coffee provided was a nice touch.
A couple of things to note: the block is okay, but locals advised against walking around at night, so plan accordingly. Also, the house could use a deeper clean. We noticed stains on the walls, carpet, and some utensils that weren’t great to look at.
Overall, it’s a solid choice if you need a comfortable place to crash and rest, but not if you’re looking to explore the immediate area.
Around sketch area (near OBlock) but stay was good. Not walkable at all

Joshua's place is a great option for staying in Chicago. It is 40-60 minutes it's by train from "main" tourist area. I stayed here for a concert at soldier field, it meant being ready/leaving earlier than friends at a downtown hotel, but easy to plan for. The house is SUPER close to the L station which is very convenient. As a solo female traveler I felt safe walking to/from the local restaurants and the public transit stops. Quiet area and no issues with noise.
Loved it!! We will definitely book this place again when we come to Chicago
Stayed for a concert at Soldier Field. Clean, great location, walkable.
The neighborhood was GREAT as was the lighting on the street at night  The price was so good, I was worried about the neighgborhood, but it was a great price for a great place to sleep.
Great stay. Everything was perfect!
Everything about our stay was great, would recommend

I had a wonderful stay at Janet’s Airbnb! She was an excellent host and very communicative throughout our stay. It truly felt like a home away from home. The neighborhood was also beautiful and very quiet, which made the stay even more relaxing. There was beautiful artwork throughout the house, which added such a lovely touch, and everything we needed for our stay was provided. Check-in was also very easy, with clear and straightforward instructions.
Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend Janet’s place to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, peaceful, and welcoming place to stay.

This place has an incredible location for going to Wrigley Field! We had a great time without a doubt. The amenities were well spelt out in the rules. But it did feel a little frat houseish. If it was just me and the boys it would have been perfect! But it was me and my family and we wished there would have been a little more accomodation for that. But that's my bad for assuming I suppose. Otherwise we had a blast the place was great for getting to and from the ballpark and it was centrally located to all kinds of restaurants and bars! Worth the value for sure.
Nancy’s place was comfy and close to all the spots we wanted to visit. The neighborhood is very beautiful, lots of walkable places and easy to find.

Great place to stay! The kitchen has everything you need, and we loved the living room. The AC works very well. It’s about a 10-minute walk from the light rail station, which takes you directly to downtown. The host provided clear and easy-to-follow instructions and responded quickly to our messages. We had a great time staying here with our family in Chicago!
Very clean and cozy space! Not too far from the city. Felt like home :)

The place itself was nice, clean, and as described. Unfortunately, the check-in experience was very stressful and disorganized. Check-in was at 3 PM, and I specifically needed to drop off my luggage at that time because I had to be at Soldier Field for a 4 PM soundcheck. When I arrived at the front desk, the keys were not available because the unit was still being cleaned. The staff tried to accommodate me by allowing me to leave my luggage in the unit while it was being cleaned, which I appreciated. However, when I went upstairs, no one was there. I ended up running back and forth through the hallways and elevators trying to figure out where to go, and the unit was on a very high floor (30+). I ultimately wasn't able to drop off my luggage until around 3:45 PM. This caused a lot of unnecessary stress and put my time-sensitive plans at risk. The accommodation itself was good, but the check-in process needs significant improvement.

The Walton Residences are a perfect home base for a visit to the great city of Chicago.  Professional and polite staff, a well maintained, well appointed apartment, and a terrific Gold Coast location.  Highly recommended.

Had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Roxy was very kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. Check-in and check-out were easy, and we really enjoyed our time here. Would definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful stay! The host was very kind and welcoming, and the place was clean, comfortable, and conveniently located. We had a really enjoyable trip and would definitely recommend staying here!
Carlos was very responsive and helpful. The place was exactly as it was in the pictures. Thanks for making it a great stay.
Beautiful place to stay with responsive host. Loved the area and the building with spacious rooms.
Super easy check-in and check-out process. Place was cozy and walking distance from lots of great places!

The place was great, it was spacious and comfortable. Everything needed was provided and the complimentary water was appreciated. The games were a fun touch and the bathrooms were thoughtful with the necessities. Although the coffee maker did not work but that could've been user error, it did not mitigate our experience in any way. I would definitely book again and recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.

The place was excellent.  Very clean, nicely decorated, and stocked with everything to make you feel at home.  Very close to great restaurants and night life but still peaceful at night.   Bed was very comfortable.   The hosts were super nice through the entire experience.  Definitely worth a stay.

We had a great time! My husband and I had our first husband and wife only vacation in over twenty years. The home is within walking distance to great restaurants. My husband and I walked  along Lake Shore  Drive, which was not far from the apartment. Overall we had a great time! The home was beautiful, the view from the patio was amazing! Everything was really nice! We look forward to staying here again.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay, which made everything easy and pleasant. We really appreciated the hospitality and would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!
Great stay!
Super clean and comfortable, very secure with two locking doors between you and the outside. All the amenities listed, comfortable space for four people. Easy to check in and out.

This place was perfect for two people!!! It was an amazing location, so close to everything driving wise but also so many other things in walkable distance. We really enjoyed the area and would stay here again if we came to Chicago!

We stayed at Aysin’s apartment for a week as a family of four with two young children. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and Aisin was a very responsive and accommodating host.

There also seemed to have been some recent water damage in one bedroom, although we didn’t notice any mold or other issues during our stay.
It was a little cozy for four of us for a full week, but overall we had a comfortable stay and really appreciated Aisin’s responsiveness and hospitality.
Very nice place. Close to public transport, grocery stores, and more. Host was very quick to respond.

Beautiful view and great location!

Demitri‘s place is nice and clean and in a lovely neighborhood in walking-distance to the lake.

Great place to stay! Josh was very responsive and a lovely host. The place was clean and comfortable. The area is also very lively and lots of places to eat and shop with thin walking distance! Would definitely stay there again!
I’m glad I picked this place thank you it was perfect.
I felt safe in the apartment even though it was a shared space. Juanita was great and super sweet.

Great location, close to some good restaurants! The room was perfect for what we needed for a quick weekend trip. Only saw one other guest in passing when we were there. Really quiet stay. Would recommend & I would stay there again.

This was a last minute booking after a hist canceled and my expectations were not high. However I was pleasantly surprised at the size, amenities and the apartment overall. Such wonderful location, very cozy, would definitely recommend it to anyone!
Was an easy stay! In walking distance of many food places, shops etc. a Park right across the street, very convenient. Will most definitely have to stay again!

The place in Lincoln Park is fantastic, and Bozena is a great responsive host. Was very clean and very quiet. Easy to check in and check out. Finding parking can be challenging but TIBO was extremely helpful with reccomendations. And we were able to park just a few min away. We enjoyed our stay. Although it did come out a bit on the pricier side it's not a bad place to stay.

Nice space that is in a walkable area like you can easily walk to Wrigley field or at the bars/restaurants in that area. Near a metro stop too to get right into the city. Fridge is filled with sticky notes from past guests which was so cute.

I would  honestly love to stay here again if I came back to Chicago, it was a great location for a short stay! Thank you for a great stay and all the accommodations Michael!

Instructions were very clear and any updates or issues (if any) were sent to us in advance. The host was proactive about having parking passes available, and did their best to ensure that we would not get a parking ticket during the stay. The check-in time is flexible as well. The surrounding neighborhood is clearly safe. Parking can be limited but there are various options that the host detailed. Overall an amazing experience and an equally amazing host!

Steven's place was great, he had everything I needed and I was able to check in as soon as I got in from my flight.  He was very helpful and his home is the perfect funky, quirky home base for exploring Chicago.   I wish I could have explored the neighborhood a little more but the places I did get to check out were great and easily walkable.  The hot tub was perfect for relaxing after walking around the city all day.

This is an awesome spot! Beautiful and in a great area. Ravenswood has its own charm plus the L station is barely two blocks away for getting downtown easily and cheaply. Even with five guests, we all had privacy enough. The kitchen was great and we even cooked dinner together! Definitely worth checking out ☺️ Thanks for having us!
My only complaint (shared by my companions) was that the beds weren't very comfortable and we had a hard time getting the bedrooms to a good temperature as once the door was closed it got super stuffy;

This place was so clean and wonderful! This is the easy 5 star rating. Phil and Coty are some really great host. Anytime I had a question or needed help with something they were always there to help me. Never took long to hear back from them. If I you are looking for a great place to stay and great host then this is the best place for you. I'll absolutely will be back!

We had a fantastic stay in Chicago!   Everything was as described and perfect for our family of four.  It was a great neighborhood for us with lots of coffee shops, groceries and restaurants - a perfect area to come back to after exploring the city.

la zona está bastante bien, es fácil llegar al centro. si tuviese que decir algún inconveniente es la habitación que reservamos ya que no había mucho espacio y pensábamos que iba a ser un poco más grande pero en general todo genial

We loved staying at Norma's place. The apartment sits right above Art of the Chicken, a popular restaurant with excellent vibes, and the location couldn't be more convenient — a safe neighborhood with great food options all around. The space itself was spotless, comfortable, and more spacious than we expected. Norma even treated us to a meal from Art of the Chicken, which was delicious. A charming apartment and a wonderful host — highly recommend.
Great place for a quick trip. Beautiful and quiet neighborhood. Parking was easy, which is a plus. Will definitely be booking again on my next trip.

We had a great stay with Jordan in Chicago! Jordan was very friendly, welcoming, and easy to communicate with. Everything was comfortable and as expected, and we had a great experience overall. Would definitely stay here again!

El lugar fue bien, estaba limpio y muy bien decorado. En unos momentos tuvimos inconvenientes con el internet y los hosts se tomaron algo de tiempo para responder. Todo el mundo nos preguntaba porque nos hospedamos en esa zona si es peligrosa, pero en ningún momento sentimos ningún peligro, Sin embargo, el lugar fue agradable.
Host, responded very fast, you felt safe at the location, as a little get away it was very nice would recommend for anyone

Abbiamo soggiornato in questo appartamento in due famiglie con bambini. L’appartamento è favoloso, pieno di ogni tipo di confort ed accessori. Ci siamo sentiti come a casa nostra. La pulizia era impeccabile e l’appartamento bellissimo, ben arredato e in zona tranquillissima. Siamo riusciti a parcheggiare le auto in strada gratuitamente non troppo distante dall’appartamento. Abbiamo sempre raggiunto il centro di Chicago con una sola linea di autobus, della durata di circa 45 minuti. Come da descrizione abbiamo trovato 4 spaziose camere doppie e due bagni. L’area del soggiorno/sala da pranzo molto ampia. La cucina comodissima e piena di accessori. Grazie davvero, questo appartamento ha fatto davvero la differenza nel nostro soggiorno a Chicago.

Stayed here for a couple days, the room was a bit smaller than what from the images showed, but we made it work. The living space was clean and liked that there were local stores/ restaurants to get last minute items or a quick snack. The location was near bus stops to take either the Red line or Orange line. Edgar and his co-hosts communicated with us everyday till check out to see if there was anything we needed to feel comfortable. Would recommend to others if they were to visit Chicago!
Great stay! Pictures don’t match the unit’s furnishings, but it worked out fine for me. Close to Metra and blue line. Donna was helpful whenever I had issues.
Great stay, thank you!

Had a great stay! Emily and Roya were super responsive and always got back to us quickly whenever we had a question. The place was really clean, comfortable, and honestly so cozy. It felt very homey and had everything we needed after the BTS concert which was super hectic staying here helped us wind down really well. Overall, it was a great experience and I’d definitely stay here again. Thanks, Emily and Roya!

Great stay.
The stay was peaceful and the house is beautiful! The host was responsive and everyone else staying was very polite and pleasant.
I had a wonderful stay i was able to relax and enjoy my time in Chicago

Great location with easy access to transit. Being just off of Clark is so convenient for having access to restaurants and shopping.
I had a large group of friends visiting me from other states and being able to find a place that could accommodate them as well as being easy to get to the plans we had was so great. I would absolutely recommend to anyone else visiting with 4-6 person group!

Logement parfait extrêmement propre, très bien aménagé. Stationnement facile devant la maison, bus proche.
Je ne peux que recommander

My stayed was perfect! Wasn’t hard too find for me and my guests. Everything went smoothly, and well. Jorge is very good at communicating, being helpful and respectful. Many things are near by where you can walk to especially if you don’t mind walking. The metra is near by also. The AC was my favorite part honestly because i dislike being hot. Definitely will stayed here or any listings Jorge has.

This place was absolutely amazing! First off great location. It’s a quick walk to the beach, great restaurants around, short walk to the train station and the neighborhood itself is quiet. This place is so adorable and has so much charm. It has beautiful architecture and details inside. We enjoyed the decorations, the bed is comfortable and large, and the place has plenty of room for two people. We stayed for about a week and were able to utilize the storage and hanging our clothes. There’s plenty of space in the bathroom for makeup and hair products and comes with a vanity area if you need it. Shower is large and has no problems. Bathroom seems updated and clean! Location location location for this place. We walked or took the train everywhere and enjoyed running on the beach. Best place I’ve stayed in so far! The kitchen is just big enough and has all the essentials.  Loved our stay and couldn’t recommend enough!

We stayed here during a concert weekend when hotel and ental prices in the area were surging, and this place was a fantastic deal compared to everything else nearby. Loved our stay overall — Gabriel was super responsive and the place was well kept.

It was my first time coming to Chicago to visit. I was very unsure about where to stay since I would be traveling by myself but when I saw Evgeniia’s listing, I became immediately convinced that I was choosing the right spot. The price was great for one person, the neighborhood was very quiet, and the room was very clean and secure. I really enjoyed my stay with Evgeniia and Christina was very helpful and communicative for me as well. I hope that the next time I come to Chicago I can book with them again!

This was by far the best Air B&B we've stayed in! Loved the modern, minimal/unfussy decor, the super comfy beds and the well equipped kitchen. The apartment was super clean, and we really appreciated the no-shoes policy being a no-shoes household ourselves. The location is also fantastic, with several restaurants and a terrific little ice-cream parlor within walking distance. The garage parking spot was perfect for our needs and fit our minivan with no trouble. Being able to park without worrying about car break-ins or parking restrictions was so nice! We had a little trouble with the WiFi when we first arrived but Michelle was very responsive and solved the issue quickly. Thank you so much for a lovely stay, we will definitely be back!

Tory is such a wonderful host. She is very responsive and helpful all throughout our stay. Her place is clean and she gives a list of good recommendations.
Will definitely book again on my next visit.

Rachel was a responsive host and felt like I could reach out if I had any issues, which I didn't. Her place was nice, clean & not too far a drive from downtown. I do have to mention the neighborhood made me and my guest cautious. The sidewalks were lined with trash and empty liquor bottles, smell of MJ, and a lady outside just yelling at people across the street not to mention the men sitting outside watching my friend and I unpack so made us feel anxious. This is not the fault of the host as it wasn't the house, just posting my honest review overall. We definitely felt the need to make sure the car and house were fully secured before turning in. As for the inside of the place, it had everything we needed. I noticed it was pretty humid throughout the stay even with the AC on. I'm from down south and believe me I absolutely loved the cooler 70-80 degree weather outside, but still pretty humid/wet feeling in the house. Host was great. Location was good. Neighborhood had me on caution.
Place was easy to find and so cute! Walkable - wasn’t too far from the train and tons of restaurants.
Stay here was really nice and close to everything! Looks just like the pictures and very spacious! Loved staying here Jim and his team are excellent hosts. I really recommend this place!

We made a no notice reservation after finding out that our extended stay hotel was a horror story. Darius came to the rescue - early check-in, super friendly and responsive, just wonderful to work with. The apartment is massive, comfortable, and quiet. Abundant on street parking was a huge plus for us. And Bronzeville - the Black Metropolis - amazing, historic, important commumity full of friendly people. 15 minutes to downtown by car. Close to U. Chicago. Mariano’s is 5 minutes away on MLK Drive - fantastic for all of your food needs. Thank you, Darius, you are a great host!
Great place, great location. Would definitely stay here again.
Comfortable beds and fully equipped kitchen. Worked very well for an extended stay for a family.
