The space was accurately described, good place to sleep if you’re busy all day, which we were. There was hosts or supporters coming in and out a few times. Were let know that if we needed anything to communicate. Was a bit hot in the rooms.

Very clean and stylish place. Considering it's located in a busy neighborhood, it was very quiet and peaceful inside. Great location for walking to the beach, zoo, restaurants, and viewing beautiful historic architecture. Being a block away from Second City made it easy to enjoy an excellent show!
This place is very well kept and beautiful. It was in a great location and very close to Soldier Field, which is exactly what we wanted. We will definitely be back!
Great place in a solid neighborhood!

Loved our stay here! VIN was AMAZING! Quick to respond, helpful, and always so pleasant to communicate with. Great location and everything as described.
The only suggestion I’d have is softer beds, as they were uncomfortable. I try not to complain, as I know everything else was great, but this is truly the only ‘negative’. I would still stay here again, though!
Thank you, Vin! I wish all hosts and homes were as wonderful as yours!

Absolutely loved Viviana’s place!!! It was nearby a starbies & dunkin yay. The beds were comfortable and so was the couch! Viviana is a very sweet host! I would definitely stay here again given the opportunity. I would also recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago! About a 10 minute walk to blue line 👍👍👍
A great stay and a friendly host!
Stayed here for a concert at solider field! Train station is a 6 minute walk which made it perfect! When I come back to Chicago I will definitely stay here again!

We had a nice stay, and Leo and Alex were good hosts. The neighborhood was quiet, and we really appreciated having a private driveway for parking, although it was a little tight.
A few things to note: there was quite a bit of noise from the upstairs guests, specifically at 2 am. The kitchen was also lacking some basic items like silverware, knives, a spatula, and kitchen towels. There also weren’t quite enough towels for the number of guests.
Overall, it was a pleasant stay, but I’d recommend reading the previous reviews to know what to expect.

Exactly as listed in the photos, if not better. We loved this space because it allowed us to bring our doggo and there’s also a dog park a few blocks away. The building itself felt super safe as was the surrounding area. We never saw anything of concern and was close to a Starbucks & 7/11. The lakefront trail and magnificent mile were walkable. A long walk, but doable.
In our group there was 4 adults, 1 baby and a dog and honestly we didn’t feel cramped. The only thing I’d point out is at the time of this review, the garage is closed due to construction. The check in instructions said parking may be limited but it’s totally closed. We weren’t too bothered by it but something to know.
Also something that I always like to know & appreciate in Airbnb reviews, they did not have a long laundry list of chores to do before checking out.
Overall 10/10 experience. A straightforward great stay. We have no complaints and would definitely stay here again in the future.

We loved staying at this beautiful, well-maintained loft. Everything was very clean and the space was very quiet. We really enjoyed Andersonville and walking on Clark St. for shopping and food options. It was nice being in this wonderful pocket of people who seemed to really enjoy living in this area. We would visit again.
I had a great stay and this location is close to a bus stop which takes you directly to the blue line.
Sedo was so responsive and accommodating during our entire stay! The place is beautiful and getting to and from soldier field was so easy.
If you’re coming to Chicago for a show at Aragon ballroom show this is perfect
Great location and super roomy space. Kitchen had what you needed and everything was very clean. The inside was somewhat run down with lamps that didn’t work and worn out furniture.

Loved our stay at Tickled Pink. Great space, all the mod cons meets vintage charm and coolness.  Great location in a fabulous neighborhood, couldn’t be better. Easiest check in/out and great communication. Highly recommended!

As a family looking to explore Chicago, this had calm feeling, access to beach and public transportation, and place to relax after busy days. The more suburban feel was nice for my kids who are not "city kids." We would definitely recommend this cute little spot for those staying for Chicago or Loyola.

Very nice location loved walking around the area! Very clean as well. Host was responsive and friendly. The only thing is the beds are super firm and no friends can come visit during the day. Other than that I would say this was a 10/10.
Very fun place to stay in.

There was a hiccup when checking in and felt that there was poor communication. Eventually got resolved but we couldn’t check in until after more than an hour. Overall the stay was fine and happy with the amount of space.
Fue muy amable en todo momento y el lugar estaba a unos minutos del metro.
I LOVED this place! Very clean, comfortable and inviting. Good value and James is great! I will stay again.

Vilma & Arthur are one of the kindest hosts I’ve ever met, and I’d happily come back to Chicago & stay here again! I went for the BTS concert, but became extremely ill from heat exhaustion, and they were very attentive with allowing nurses to come to the house, took out the trash for me when I needed to, and even let us check out late to try and catch up on sleep & be able to lay dow before our later flight. The home was perfect for our travel needs, and it’s a great quick location to the stadium and Chinatown (which I prefer because of the incredible food). I can’t recommend this place enough!
Geo was kind and responsive. I ended up not going to Chicago with my sisters and daughters for a concert but they said the home was nice and comfy.
Perfect space for our weekend getaway! The apartment was clean and comfortable with plenty of amenities. Host was very friendly and accommodating, with excellent instruction

Very convenient to travel from O’Hare to this place at Belmont station and to Downtown. All with the blue line. The two bedroom apartment is spacious and nicely decorated with all needed accessories. Great place to stay and explore Chicago

We enjoyed our stay at Kevin’s Wrigleyville Airbnb.  Loved the off-street parking for two cars, the tranquil neighborhood, the easy walk to Wrigley Field, the cleanliness of the Airbnb, the space in the Airbnb, comfy beds, and the easy communication with Kevin.   The train does go right by the Airbnb, but out of four adults in the Airbnb, we did not hear the train after going to sleep.  We were out most of the day time, but when the train went by while we were there, we did not mind it and actually found it somewhat comforting!  Kevin is a great host, this location and space is a gem, and I highly recommend it for anyone who can manage stairs up to and down from the apartment!

They’re were other ppl in the rooms, but everyone was quiet and minded our own business. Rooms/place was spotless and very comfortable. Mini fridge in the room was stocked with a few water bottles, which was convenient. The neighborhood was pretty and directly in front of public transit.when I did have a question and contacted hosts, I got a reply very quick. I enjoyed my stay. I would stay here again!
Everything was incredible, I will indeed return in the future!

Michael’s place was just as described. Everything we needed and more. It was tucked into a cozy accessible spot. Parking and directions was a perfect as it gets. Great communication and top notch host just as implied by others.

The place was so nice, clean and cozy! We had a great time staying here. It is peaceful, quiet and family friendly. This place if great especially when you are a big group. The rooms are spacious and clean! The host was accommodating, helpful and kind! It was one of the nicest place we stayed in.

The room was pretty cozy and it had all the amenities. Clean towels, clean bathroom, clean room. The location is amazing. It is close to the train station, bus stops and most importantly amazing restaurants. Heidi responded pretty quickly to all my messages. She's a very good host.

Nicholas was great! Very prompt when it came to responding any messages, place was clean and well kept. Only thing is beware of parking since my vehicle got broken into one night while staying here. Try to stay close to the apartment itself and don’t venture too far off. Other than that it was a good location not too far from all the main attractions in Chicago and really enjoyed riding the bikes on the nearby paths as well.
I had a wonderful stay with my brothers at this lovely place - it was spotless and very nice. We really enjoyed our time there, and Seuns was super responsive.
Very quiet neighborhood
Place was perfect. We were just in town for a concert and hardly spent any time here other than to sleep and what not. It was great across the board.

Highly recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in Chicago on a budget. The host was extremely nice and responsive and the place was very clean. Everything you’d need, this place has. Would definitely book again!

Wir hatten eine super schöne Zeit in dem Airbnb von Jose in Chicago. Es war alles vor Ort was man benötigt hat und die Wohnung war leicht durch öffentliche Verkehrsmittel erreichbar. Jose war immer gut erreichbar und hat sich sogar regelmäßig erkundigt, ob er uns unterstützen kann. Wir empfehlen seine Unterkunft auf jeden Fall weiter!

Great place to stay for a short weekend! Struggled to find parking on the side streets a few times, but we managed. Personally felt like the bed was a little hard for our liking, but everything else was great!

This place was great. Lots of walkable places to visit and short trips to those that aren’t. Easy to get to the city and plenty of room for multiple guests. Cooking supplies were well supplied and Johnie was very friendly and responsive. Bathrooms were nice and clean, lots of towels but bring your own wash cloths though as we couldn’t find any. No big deal though! The property does have tenants on the lower floors so if you want an entire house worth of privacy be mindful of this. Regardless of the downstairs neighbors it was still very private I think we just overlooked that when we booked. Lots of Chicago homes are this way! We had a great time and definitely recommend the property for anyone wanting to visit the city in a peaceful neighborhood.

Milan’s place was a great place to stay for the BTS concert and was easily walkable to Soldier Field and Chinatown. My friends and I enjoyed the view from the window. It made the place feel very roomie and comforting. Milan was very responsive and would check in each day to see if we needed anything. I would love to stay again next time I’m in town!
Jason was a great host, responsive & friendly! The place and location are awesome & exactly what we were looking for.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as described and shown in the pictures. The bed and pillows were very comfortable, and the apartment had everything we needed. The location was fantastic, with great restaurants, shops, and a train station nearby. There was some city noise, but after a full day of exploring, it didn’t bother us at all. We’d happily stay again!

Our overall stay was good! The penthouse is clean and quiet.  Our host was overall communicative and welcomed feedback. We stayed here for a concert at solider field and the drive to and from was smooth!
Can’t say enough good things about this place! Clean, nicely stocked with everything we needed and very comfy beds! Host was incredibly responsive and helpful. We would stay here again for sure!
Super responsive and always checked in to make sure everything was going great! Place was clean and they had someone come in to make sure it stayed that way.

The place was cozy and very comfortable. Perfect place to rest after a tiring day out in Chicago.
The hosts Roberto and Carlos were amazing and kind people. They felt more like family than anything.
Thank You for the opportunity of being hosted at your home.

For the short time we were there it felt like home. It was quiet, the home itself was beautiful, and Jamal was responsive. Everything was supper easy for check in and check out. It’s a shame we couldn’t stay longer.
Great location. Quiet, beautiful neighborhood with great restaurants, bars, parks, etc.
Alex was very responsive whenever we had questions.  The place was very nice and the area was beautiful.

This place was great! It looked exactly like the photos shown. Very cozy,  clean, and has a lot of space. We had everything we needed for the few days we stayed. The hosts were very nice and communicative. The neighborhood is quiet and parking is easy to find. I would definitely recommend this place to others!

We had such a cozy and relaxing stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and had such a nice atmosphere. And the puzzles were TOP TIER! They were such a fun touch and definitely kept us entertained. Would absolutely stay here again!

TRULY located in the heart of Chinatown, just as the listing claims. There were many things to do, tons of food options, & an endless amount of cute/convenient/affordable shops; all within walking distance (2-10 min).
The CTA redline station was only a 3-min walk, too!
Apartment itself was lovely, for the most part! :)
Extremely well-stocked; plenty of dishes (matching sets), in-unit laundry, spare bedding sets, shower essentials, etc. … even free house slippers!
Fantastic A/C, very roomy, comfy beds, spotless & fully functional kitchen, etc…
There’s some faint noise due to the subway’s short distance, but not too bad! :)
My only few concerns:
1) Mild scum buildup in shower.
2) In a bedroom closet: a space heater that seemed to be covered in a sticky, brown goo with a mild unpleasant odor.
3) The upstairs tenants were OBNOXIOUSLY loud. Extremely heavy stomping, shouting, thumping… ALL day, EVERY day. 🫩
—
Jake was VERY helpful & friendly! :)
8.5/10 stay overall. I highly recommend!
this was such a great place to stay for the price. andy was amazing and very responsive our whole trip. i would definitely stay there again!!

The place was peaceful and quiet, comfortable and homey. Bed was amazingly comfortable. Host lives upstairs, but only heard them maybe once for a second and then it was total silence. The area was nice and quiet and easy to navigate. Would 100% stay here again.

Todo excelente!
Daniel se comunico con instrucciones claras.
La casa es hermosa, me encantó la decoración!
Really cute basement unit! Amanda’s instructions for getting in were clear and the unit was super clean.
Very clean and homey. Would stay again.

This was my first time booking an Airbnb and this place blew my expectations. The place was beautiful, it matched the description/pictures, had plenty of amenities and was spotless. The host is professional, kind, communicates well and answered all of my questions. They gave us recommendations for nearby places such as a pizza place which was delicious. There are many tourist attractions and activities to do nearby. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone planning on staying at Chicago!

The place was great. The neighborhood was a bit sketchy and busy but the stores were only a walk away. 3 flights of stairs were brutal with my luggage but the host was amazing! He let me check out at my preferred time and was very accommodating with my arrival. Even offered some places to go since I was traveling solo!
This Airbnb was so close to a lot and the neighborhood was walkable and safe! It had lots of room and was super clean!

Brian's rental is in a great location near DePaul University.  It's on quiet, lovely street with a beautiful backyard.  The flat was  spotless and well equipped. The area feels very safe and is walkable to restaurants.  The included garage parking space is a real advantage over most rentals in the area.

The location of the place was wonderful , there was so much to do and see in walking distance, it was very safe even at night, and the size of the space was great it was perfect for a group of 3. We did have an issue with a huge roach but we took care of it. Regina was very responsive and did a lot to make sure we were enjoying our stay. Would stay again!

Function, clean, no frills space in a quiet building walkable to Soldier Field, Wintrust Arena, and Chinatown. Wasn’t a luxurious stay (bedding, linens, furniture were pretty standard) but it’s a good home base for activities.
Pros: easy check in and check out, security in building, clean unit, responsive host.
Know before you book: couch is hard and thinly padded and don’t recommend sleeping on it, blinds are not light blocking and not in great shape, second room has a window into living room and no way to close it off to light. Also, host is strict about no guests and no parties.
Wasn’t fancy but did the job. Not a good unit for sensitive sleepers or people who want to use it to host friends.
Our group had a great time here. Loved the free parking. Quiet and peaceful neighborhood. Assel was also great at communicating and checking in. Would stay here again!

We enjoyed our time at this airbnb. The neighborhood is gorgeous and had great restaurants, easy walkability and had lots of street parking. The airbnb itself had nice amenities and we loved the big windows and fire escape. We did notice a significant damp musty smell the first night and also found previous guests hair on most of the furniture. The bathroom had a molding air freshener and the shower also did not drain and had underwhelming water pressure. I appreciated how responsive Nikka was, and the location is hard to beat, but some cleanliness issues were apparent during our stay.

Super clean! Had a little trouble navigating the smart lock since I've never used one, also that you can go through the front door. The check in message only mentioned the storm door, also had trouble un-latching the gate to where I thought I would damage it trying to open it. But overall good! 👌

I feel that Tammy’s place is even more beautiful than the photo posted on airbnb. Very good design and comfortable place to stay in. They were very welcoming as well, Scott and Tammy helped me a lot whenever I have questions. Very memorable stay!
Family and I booked for a last minute trip and host was very helpful! Our stay was amazing, family felt comfortable there
Had a great stay

Great neighborhood. Safe, leafy, right by the red line Fullerton stop.
The room had every amenity and convenience. The hosts truly try to address every need a guest may have.
Jennifer and partner were responsive and helpful.
The AC and air purifier worked nicely. I think the room would be quieter in non-AC times of year, being more enclosed from the outdoors. Several nice cats live in the home; your stay will be better if you’re okay with that. I have a minor cat allergy and, with allergy pills, I was good for most of the stay

Nabil was a very responsive and friendly host.
Very clean and comfortable place in a great location near many of Chicago’s main attractions. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others.
Great host and house
Good place to stay
Great local Chicago place

Adrian’s place was an incredible stay for us and our friends! His home is beautiful and very comfortable and is in a great location, with several local restaurants and cafes/bakeries nearby that are a short and easy walk away.
Overall, we were very happy with everything and we look forward to staying here again in the future!

Super cute and awesome duplex! The home is very spacious, with TVs throughout, which was a great touch. We especially loved the patio setup in the backyard, although we unfortunately didn’t get a chance to hang out back there during our stay.
The only downside was that street parking can definitely be a challenge, so just be prepared for that. Overall, we had a great experience and would highly recommend staying here!
My stay was very pleasant, everything was very comfortable and the host was very good about checking in with you during the stay
Me and my guest had a great time at Jonathan's home. There was plenty of rooms and enough space for us all. Jonathan was also responsive and always willing to respond if we needed anything.

Very clean and comfortable space! The place looked exactly like the photos, and the area was nice with gas stations conveniently located across the street and several bars nearby. Parking was a little difficult at first, but everything ended up working out. Overall, we were very satisfied with our stay!
One small suggestion would be to have fans available, especially during warmer weather. Fans weren’t listed as an amenity, so it wasn’t something we expected, but they would have been a nice addition for extra comfort. Other than that, we had a great stay!

We had a great and comfortable stay here! The apartment had everything you need in terms of cooking, the bathrooms, and was very comfortable and private. A little bit of noise from upstairs, but not bothersome. In fact as visitors, it was comforting! Parking on the street was a bit challenging if coming back to the area late at night, but not a big deal! This is a clean, private space that is perfect for a short stay!
The Airbnb was very clean and close to a subway station. Its also in a very walkable area making it easy for us to find restaurants and shops to visit.
Brett's place was great! I'll definitely stay again next time I'm in Chicago.
Great stay! Very spacious!

We had a great stay! The house was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Tom was very nice, helpful, and always checked in to make sure we were doing okay. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back again. Highly recommend this place!

The place itself was located close enough to downtown Chicago without having to worry about the madness of the city. That couch was the star of the place! So comfy and cozy and a perfect spot to binge watch tv!
Overall, we enjoyed our stay, but the cleanliness could have been a little better. We noticed some hair in the bathroom, the fans provided were quite dusty, and there was leftover food in the refrigerator. I understand this is Leroy’s home, but when guests are staying, it may be helpful to clear out items like half-eaten food to make the space feel more welcoming.
Other than those minor concerns, we had a great stay and truly appreciated Leroy's hospitality. He genuinely cared about making sure we had a good experience!

We’ve enjoyed the place, very spacious for 10 people, host is really helpful and responsive. She even put air conditioner in all 3 rooms that same day we’ve had an issue. The only issue we have in the house is the couches are stained and carpet needs to be cleaned, not a lot silverware available for 10 people. The location is very noisy at night because of the train and people are always having a party at the park nearby. Take extra caution especially at night.
Erik and his family were welcoming and so lovely!  Had no issues whatsoever and would absolutely stay again!  TYVM!! 💜

It’s a beautiful place, quite and private..👌🏻
We love it 🥰

Was perfect for 7 people and the amenities were great. Area is quiet but has EVERYTHING within walking distance. The quick and easy access  to the Blue Line train to O’hare was extremely convenient along with the dedicated garage unit if you’re driving your own car. It was my first time visiting Chicago and this airbnb made the experience 10x better.

Great room and apartment, no issues checking in; place was clean and well taken care of. Before booking, be forewarned that the downstairs is a private event space, and the walls are quite  thin. Our last night was on a Friday night, and the music was vibrating the floor, you could hear not just the music, but also the people talking and banging on the walls. This lasted past 1am. If you’re sensitive to noise at night, I would suggest to either bring earplugs or book another place.
super nice place! it was really spacious for a group of 4-5 and the kitchen was really nice!
It was close to restaurants and walkable to places.

Brandy was very responsive and accommodated our party for early check in and was quick to send us a welcome message. The space itself is perfect for large parties with plenty of sleeping accommodations & bathrooms which was perfect for us. Easy access to downtown where everything is & many options for delivery. I would recommend having more bath towels available. We were going to wash our towels to reuse, but the washer wasn’t working properly like maybe the bearings are off & it kept stopping mid cycle. There is a plumbing issue in one of the bathrooms where the carpet got wet & I messaged her & she got right back to me & said they already had someone scheduled after our weekend to fix it. The only other thing I would mention is that while nothing happened that made us feel unsafe (there are multiple security measures in place), literally every Uber driver or food delivery person told us to be very careful and not be outside late or alone because it is a “dangerous” neighborhood.
Ashley was very helpful and responsive. We felt very comfortable during our stay. Thank you again for allowing us to use your space.
great place, great location, would book again!

This apartment was much bigger than we initially anticipated! A great plus! Great amenities, great hosts and great location! The reserved parking spot in the back was such a life saver. Our hosts were super responsive and always answered our questions quickly! :)

Our stay was wonderful! Very clear instructions on arrival and parking location. Also, the photos to go along with them were very helpful! Great response time and very friendly host. Location is great if ever going to Soldier field, the Riverwalk, the Aquarium etc. Bathrooms are very spacious and Bedrooms very tidy. Would book again!

We absolutely loved staying here!! Everything was so clean, comfortable, and welcoming, and the place was even better than we expected. The location was perfect for our trip and made everything so much easier.
Sean and Raquel were such great hosts and were so nice and helpful throughout our stay. We really appreciated all the recommendations they gave us too! It honestly felt like they really cared about making sure we had a good experience.
We had such an amazing time in Chicago and I’m so glad we chose to stay here. I would 100% recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago, and we would definitely stay here again! Thank you so much for hosting us!!
Awesome location! Great Host! Awesome neighbors had a wonderful time and would stay here again! Best Airbnb Host ever hands down

From the start, the communication had been immediately responsive and upon arriving directions made very plain and easy for entry. I’m grateful for how clean the entire area was. All the necessary amenities were available as well. Thank you so much for hosting us!

We had an absolutely wonderful 4-day stay in Chicago, and Gerry was the ultimate host! Great communication from the host and quick to respond to every question we had. He went completely above and beyond by bringing our grocery delivery inside that we ordered for our toddler. He was also extremely accommodating when we requested a 1-hour late checkout. The apartment matched the description, overall it was a great stay!

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The home was exactly as described, brand new, and equipped with great amenities. The location was perfect and the free parking made everything even more convenient. The host was welcoming, responsive, and made us feel truly cared for throughout our stay.
We were a mixed group of kids, parents, and young adults, and everyone genuinely enjoyed the space. It was comfortable, clean, and well worth the price. We’re grateful for the hospitality and would happily stay here again.
Great place to stay

The space was pretty basic - it could use some comfort like rugs, pillows on the couch, and better bedding. The stairs to the second floor entry were steep, twisty, and uneven. I lost my balance a couple of times, especially carrying our bags or groceries. The location and free parking spot was convenient. Nice natural light.
Nice place!
We had a great stay at Ayla‘s inspired sanctuary. Felt right at home in Andersonville.
The place was exactly as described and I felt at home while visiting for 4 days. Bennett was a wonderful host who was very responsive and allowed me to check in early.  I would definitely stay again.

Zheng was very welcoming. He gave very clear instructions on how to get to the apartment and allowed me to check-in early just to drop my bags off. The place is small and the room I stayed in didnt have a window but it was in a good location for what I was there for.

My family and I had a wonderful stay here, the place was amazing and exactly how it was described. We were able to experience so much due to it being so close to our surroundings areas. Would gladly stay here again!

Place was as listed. We had an incredible time during our girls trip and being right next to the CTA was a huge bonus. Overall, we had a great time and felt comfortable. I would not say some of the things we encountered hindered our overall stay, but did cause very minor blimps. For example, we had issues with the microwave. While it worked, it only worked using the +30 sec button. The washer front cover was rusted and completed broken off the entire appliance, which left us hesitant to use, especially since the in unit washer/dryer was a key factor in why we chose this unit. The washer did in fact work, however be cautious to only start SMALL loads, as one denim jean and shorts would cause it to off balance during the rinse and spin cycle. The only other thing worth noting was the neighbors. While this is not in the hosts control, they could get loud and argued a lot during the night/early morning. Did not hinder our stay since we were out exploring 90% of our time. Would stay again😊

We really enjoyed staying in Karen’s place. It’s clear Karen puts so much intention and care into the space. The place has comfy beds, some food to welcome you, and a lot of the things you need when traveling with a young child. Plus there are a bunch of cool knick knacks to peak your curiosity. Very warm and homey space!
Super comfy, cozy space. Definitely worth its price!
great place! great communication! parking can be a bit of a hassle but manageable
very accurate to description! the location was convenient as well

We had a very nice stay. It is right across the street from china town square, great location for walking around. The unit was very clean and spacious, and the host was very responsive and helpful the entire stay. Nothing but good things to say. Would recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay in Chinatown.

Had a great stay! We got very clear instructions and everything went very smoothly. (I especially appreciated the hosts for very reasonable cleaning expectations! Thank you!)

The unit had a great amount of space and everything was very comfortable and decorated really well. The natural lighting in the morning was amazing.
The neighborhood is nice and quiet. It was a little less walkable than I would normally like and the nearby bus line wasn't very reliable for us, so expect long walks, ride share, or driving.
We were only there for two days, but I think it would also be a great place for a longer stay. Definitely recommend!
It was a very nice place to stay. It was a bit confusing at first when you get there but we figured it out eventually.

The stay was fantastic. Angie was very responsive and even left a few snacks and waters. The place was clean and the beds were super comfortable. It was a nice neighborhood with a bunch of local restaurants nearby, and within walking distance from the train and buses.

We had a fantastic stay here! The space is beautifully designed, spotlessly clean, and felt very welcoming from the moment we arrived.The location is excellent, making it incredibly easy to commute and get around. On top of that, the host was extremely responsive and helpful throughout our entire stay.
Great hosts!! Very peaceful!
Barry was a great host! The flexible check-in time was greatly appreciated and his place made us feel right at home. Highly recommend!

We had such a great stay here! The location is amazing — right in the heart of Roscoe Village with tons of great restaurants, coffee shops, workout classes and shops within walking distance. Our favorites were Le Sud, Same Same, Commonwealth and Volvo Wine Bar. Getting both to downtown and to Wrigley Field was really convenient and quick, as well. The unit and neighborhood felt incredibly safe.
The apartment is brand new and beautifully designed. Everything feels very modern and high-end, but still really comfortable and welcoming. The bathroom was stunning. It had everything we needed for our stay, including super fast wifi & desk for working, washer/dryer and Nespresso machine.
The hosts were also wonderful. They were super responsive, helpful, and made the whole process really easy from check-in to check-out.
Beautiful space, amazing location, really comfortable, brand new, and wonderful hosts. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

I really enjoyed staying at this Airbnb. It was within 15 minutes of everywhere that I need to go. It looks just like the pictures parking was relatively easy. Perfect place for solo traveling would definitely recommend and I would stay again if I’m ever back in Chicago.

We had an absolutely amazing stay! We stayed for our 3 year anniversary and it was absolutely perfect! Theres a trader joes about a 10 minute walk from the place, it was absolutely gorgeous, very peaceful and relaxing!! Everything was clean and nice, and parking was fairly easy! Thank you for the amazing stay!
Great stay for a concert I attended. Loved the ease of parking and the local bookstore and restaurants.
Great location for our visit. Easy walk to restaurants and transportation. The apartment was accurately described and very comfortable accommodations.
Made my stay in Chicago super comfortable. The neighborhood is calm, and it has plenty to do within walking distance!

We had a great time staying at Julian’s place! The apartment is super cute and has everything you need to have a nice stay. It was very cozy and well-decorated. The aesthetic is artsy and eclectic, and you can tell some personality/character was put into it. Julian was also an amazing host, super attentive and responsive and willing to help out with whatever you need. 10/10 as far as hosts go. His place was also in a lovely location - a quiet neighborhood with the train nearby, and there were lots of shops, restaurants, a gym, and a yoga studio all within walking distance. Very convenient to have the brown line within walking distance as well. There were always people walking around with their families and pets during the day, which was wonderful to see as well. Definitely a very vibrant and lively neighborhood. Would recommend for anyone visiting Chicago, we were sad to leave!

Everything was very nice and the place had a lot of charm.  Amazing location!   Walking distance to many shops and restaurants.  One suggestion I had was to replace the bedroom mattress with a traditional mattress and box spring instead of a memory foam mattress.  Outside of that this place is fantastic!!
We had a great time and everything was as advertised
Extremely accommodating host, lovely space, great location. Not much more you can ask for.
I would definitely recommend this place! It was so easy to check in and Ecem was very communicative. I had a great time!!

I really enjoyed my stay here! The place has a cute, cozy setup. The room is a little small, but having my own private bathroom was a must for me, so I really appreciated that. The only shared spaces are the kitchen and the dining area.
The Asian in me also loved the no shoes in the house rule, and they provided indoor slippers. They also provided 4 bottles of purified drinking water, which was the number of days of my stay. I thought that was a thoughtful touch. The room I stayed in had good lighting, and the kitchen was well equipped. The bus stop was only a 7-9 min walk away, and the neighborhood felt safe. I also saw Chicago police car patrolling the area, which made me feel more at ease. Both check-in and check-out were smooth. Overall, I had a comfortable and pleasant stay!

I am a girl who was solo traveling for a concert and the location didn’t feel safe at all. When I got there, check in instructions were not really clear. I was supposed to check in at 3 pm but then they made me wait for no reason until I was finally able to get an answer from the host and get into the room and bathroom.
Locals described the area as “ghetto”, and they told me to uber everywhere and not be by myself, so it didn’t feel safe at all. I DO NOT recommend this place if you are traveling by yourself, men or women.
The apartment is very nice and comfortable, and I found everything clean. Ecem was nice and very accomplished, despite what happened during the check in, which was a problem of miscommunication. The only reason I won’t come back is the area, which is unfortunate, but I feel that you should have that into consideration and do a proper research before booking.
Great experience! Great neighborhood
Really enjoyed our stay! Perfect spot . Andy was very nice & responsive. Condo was just as described. Will stay again next year!!

great location, near a lot of iconic tourist attractions and accessible trains lines. location is downtown which is a little noisy with the cars on the street and during the day for 2 hours there was a person advocating/on strike(?) right in front of a hotel but overall great stay. our room had a leaking pipe with very slow drain in the sink but maintenance was quick and fixed the leak. great hotel.

Muy buena experiencia en general. El lugar estaba limpio, cómodo y tal como se mostraba en las fotos. La estadía fue tranquila y todo estuvo en orden. La comunicación fue buena y no tuvimos ningún inconveniente. Definitivamente lo recomendaría y volvería a hospedarme aquí.
It was a great stay at Bella’s. In town for a concert but stayed an extra night just to hang out. It was perfect for what we needed. Would recommend it 😊

We had an absolutely amazing stay with Tammy! She was such a wonderful and welcoming host, and my 16-year-old daughter and I felt right at home. The place was very nice, clean, and comfortable, and the bed was so comfortable—we slept incredibly well! We also loved meeting her adorable dogs; they were such a sweet bonus to our stay. 🐶❤️
Tammy was kind and accommodating, and everything about our stay was wonderful. We truly enjoyed our time here and would absolutely stay with Tammy again. Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Would stay again!
Simple place right outside downtown Chicago! The hosts were very responsive and friendly as well! I recommend!! :)

Kimberly place was beautifully decorated and comfortable.
I was able to find parking easily and Kimberly was fast at communicating with any questions I had.
I would definitely stay again 😊
Great stay as a remote worker
No problems with this place, host was responsive, it was clean and looked like the photos
I loved staying here! Luis was very responsive and answered any questions I had!
Lisa was an amazing host! Her home was so beautiful and made us feel right at home!

Milan was a wonderful host - always checking in to make sure we were comfortable!
The place was perfect for us and just as described.

This Airbnb was perfect for attending shows at Soldier Field. Close enough to walk to the stadium with lots of food options nearby — especially some tasty options in Chinatown. The apartment was exactly as described and communication from the host was always prompt. We appreciated the option to check in early/late based on availability for a small upcharge. The beds were comfortable and it was great to have so many steaming options on the TVs in each room.
It is located on the second floor with no elevator but it wasn’t a problem for us since we had small carryons. While the location is convenient, there are homeless people around the train stops if you’re walking east. We never felt threatened but just be cautious. Also, noise from the street can be heard during the weekday so you may want to bring ear plugs if you’re a light sleeper.
Thank you for an amazing stay. Exceeded expectations we will be back

Wonderful place to stay
Will be back
Great last minute booking with fair prices.
Super nice stay if you’re there for a short stay especially if your touring the city. You can always ask jenny if you need anything and there’s instructions around the house to help with anything.

Although listed as "an entire place to yourself", it was actually a basement unit. The unit has a weird egg smell and the water pressur in the bathroom was really poor. Field crickets, gnats, daddy long legs, and dead roaches all seen during our stay. We cut the trip short due to ants ending up in our food THAT WAS SITTING ON THE TABLE LESS THAN 10 MINUTES. Hands down one of the worst Airbnb experiences I've ever had and will definitely be hotels from here on out. The host took a long time to respond to our concerns and whoever was upstairs had a really big dog that tried to get in when we went to take the trash out upon leaving. My travel companion is terrified of dogs and it would have been nice to be notified of dogs on the premises.

Stunning city views and great amenities, this place was quieter than the hustle and bustle of being right on the river. Numerous great restaurants were within a 10-minute walk. We enjoyed feeling like locals. Building was secure, and the rooftop pool and game room were a bonus after a long day of touring.
Definitely would stay again.

Me and my friend had a great time staying here for our BTS concert. There were lots of walkable places for eating or grabbing coffee. The space looked exactly as described. Anytime I had an issue The hosts responded very quickly. The only reason why I’m giving this a four star review is the parking. It’s really hard to maneuver in and out of. But other than that, I would highly recommend staying here.

I love my stay in Chicago.
The neighborhood has local restaurants, bars etc that are enjoyable. It was also perfect that everything was walking distance!
Clean house!

I stayed with two friends for a concert in Soldier Field. This place is very close by and worth it if you are going to be out and about all day. I felt very secure and safe despite that not being the case for much of the area around us.

Daniel was very friendly and helpful. The place was in a great location with easy access to both public bus and train. The place was super clean and quiet. Daniel provides all the necessities and it was very pleasant visit. Thank you.

I stayed for about 3 weeks and was comfortable with the room. Location is great walking distance to a supermarket, Walgreens, several restaurants, and the Pulse Milwaukee bus line that takes you to the Blue line go get around. Thankfully the other 2 roommates were quiet and respectful. The only con was the place wasn't as clean as it could have been, but Victor clearly stated in the description that there's light cleaning in between guests and one deep clean a month so no fault to him. Victor was an incredible host always fast communications and helpful. Norwood Park is a beautiful area! I enjoyed the park close by and walking around the neighborhood admiring the large houses. If you're looking for a chill, safe, temporary stay this is definitely a viable option.
Great place and good location. Felt at home and will be back again.
Very beautiful apartment, and Hanna is so nice
Great stay, clean, close to everything.
Good place to Spend Night
great stay!
Very clean and comfortable. Quiet. The only thing I wish they had disclosed that is a shared kitchen area. The ad made it look like the room had its own kitchen. Aside from that, it was great.

We had a great stay here! The apartment is cozy, clean, and had everything we needed for our trip. The area felt super safe and it was easy to walk around. It is really close to the red line to get to downtown Chicago and there are lots of good restaurants and cute coffee shops nearby. Overall, it was perfect for us and we really enjoyed our stay!
Such a fantastic location to visit my son at U Chicago!
Great apartment available for a long stay. We (2 adults & 1 cat) were comfortable here for 2 months. Most appreciated was the well-stocked kitchen, private entrance, amd laundry access.
A very cute space and roomy! I liked how stylish it was and appreciated the quick responses from the hosts.
Great place and amazing neighborhood. Street parking was easy to find.

Excellent Stay.
I was worried about the street parking component of the lodging but like many have said before it was readily available throughout the visit. One item I need to mention, however, is the license plate on the rental car got stolen overnight. That caused angst and about two hours to correct. Otherwise, highly recommended.
The place was awesome to stay at. It was both safe and clean. I loved the stay. Thanks.

We had a wonderful stay at Natasha's place and would absolutely recommend this Airbnb! The location was fantastic - close to so many of the things we wanted to see and do, including The Bean, which was just a short distance away. It made exploring the city incredibly convenient and we loved being able to walk to many nearby attractions.
The space was very clean, comfortable, and welcoming. The beds were especially comfortable which made it easy to relax and get a good night’s sleep after busy days exploring the city. Everything was just as described and made for a very enjoyable stay. We loved the check-in/out staff, too - they were great!
Our host was also incredibly helpful and responsive. We especially appreciated the parking recommendations which made arriving and getting settled much less stressful. It was clear that the host genuinely cared about making our stay a good one.
Overall, we had a great experience and would happily stay here again the next time we’re in the area!

I really enjoyed my stay here! The Airbnb was in a quiet neighborhood that felt very safe and was also really walkable. Getting around Chicago was easy using public transportation. I was able to get to Soldier Field for a concert just by taking the Green Line and a city bus!
The team was also very proactive and communicative throughout my stay. They followed up regularly and made sure everything was going well, which I really appreciated. Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend staying here!
We enjoyed our stay, the place was just as described and Kelly was very helpful! The neighborhood was very quaint and walkable.
Quiet and clean. Less than a 10 minute walk to soldier field and close to great bars and restaurants.

The place was clean. But there has to be a hole somewhere with all the flies I killed in that place. I would kill five flies and more kept popping up. I would leave for hours and come back to having to kill more flies before I went to sleep. I wish I was exaggerating. The decorations were nice, if you are into sports. But I was there to see BTS and I wasn’t trying to spend anymore than I already did. So it was affordable. But it made me consider getting a hotel next time I’m in Chicago. Anyways, it’s the neighborhood that I liked the most. Since I’ve stayed at an Airbnb in that neighborhood before a year and some months prior to see Ateez. It was situated by a lot of stores/restaurants to shop/eat at that was a walkable distance away.
Florin was. Very responsive. Great location and seamless process for checking in

We had an amazing time in chicago and Phill's place was a great place to come back to every day after adventuring in downtown. The house is really well taken care of. It was a wonderful place to stay. Thank you for having us.

We enjoyed our 7-night stay. The location was great, with plenty of restaurants and bars nearby, and it was also convenient to Wrigley.
The bed was a bit firmer than we prefer, but overall we had a nice stay.

Cute place with very open space! My friends and i stayed 2 nights and felt very comfortable and safe. Rooms were clean and neat, kitchen and bathroom were great! The host was always responsive and offered any assistance at any time! Highly recommend if you are staying in chicago, area is also walkable to a train station as well!

Lovely apartment, with a really sweet walkway out the back door. Walking distance to the brown line, convenience store, lots of shops, restaurants, attractions. About an hour via CTA to Solider Field but the transit was very smooth. Honestly perfect location, really enjoyed our time!
Great place to stay. Located between two stations that are walkable.
Great Airbnb to stay at, easy to communicate with. Be warned no elevator so is not accessible friendly. Good location, designated parking. Would recommend

We had a wonderful stay here! The host was very kind and welcoming, she personally greeted us and showed us around the home and gave us some local recommendations! The house is very clean and homey, street parking was very easy to find and the neighborhood was lovely. We would definitely love to stay here again !
Nice, clean place. Easy to get in and out of. Fantastic location.

Russell's place was easy to find and could accommodate our group of three. Unfortunately, there was only street parking, which was mentioned, that was a little hard to find. We had to go several streets over to find spots and then walk late at night back. The  first night we had an issue with a blown fuse that messed up our dinner. We had food in the oven that wasn't cooked and the issue wasn't addressed in time. The fuse turned off the oven, TV, A/C, and bedroom lights. The street was also noisier than we had expected. Loud cars and music starting at 7 am. We also had a small bug issue, maybe due to window seals? Little bugs all around, but all harmless. Overall it was as advertised. A little expensive for the area (a little scary), issues with the fuses for three people at once, loud street, and some bug problems. Not the worst we've stayed in, and Russel was reasonably responsive to our concerns.

Everything was good and we enjoyed our stay.  It is in a basement and the steps down are steep and a little difficult for old people like us.  The kitchen was well equipped for cooking.  Justin quickly attended to any issue we had.  One bedroom has a nice couch but no TV.  The 2nd bedroom is large with just a chair but a very small TV.
Great, cozy place to stay for a short trip!

The room was a bit smaller than expected and it had a marijuana scent upon entering. The ceiling of the bedroom was peeling off and the bathroom wasn't super clean regarding to the ceiling and floor. The unit had a very spacious kitchen. Overall it was a good stay.

The property was overall okay and good distance from SoFi Stadium. However, I found the host difficult to work with. I booked this place in January with 4 people and followed up that the party had increased to 6 (ended up being 5 in the end) and she charged me $400 more on the reservation, something I had to take the loss on because I had already collected money from the people in my party. Nothing in her listing stated that more people would mean more money (as some listings do), and the property fits 8, so I am not sure why suddenly the price had to change. She stated that her cleaning costs were high, and that she was barely making any money off my reservation. She needs to be more upfront and transparent on her pricing on her page, then. She also charges for parking, and my party had to wait till late in the evening to get the parking passes from her. It was hard to communicate with her in general. There are also large spiders + spider webs in the walkway to the property.

Tracee and her team were extremely responsive despite our many questions from the get go.
Though there were a couple of hiccups (incorrect PIN code initially given for the main door, smoke detector low battery beeping all night), the host was prompt to respond/receptive to feedback with a friendly/professional demeanor which we greatly appreciated.
The location of the Airbnb was ideal for our travel purposes despite some sketchy activity outside both nights we stayed. Aside from that, it was quiet and chill.
Inside the Airbnb, it was clean, quiet, cozy and perfect for the 5 of us plus 2 dogs with a spacious master bedroom (loved the roomy shower).
Upon request in advance, one parking spot in a garage is available (unless you have a super compact car, we suggest you park on the street in front of the Airbnb - there were ample amount of parking spots).
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and the stellar hospitality from Tracee and her team. Thank you!
Convenient location, looks like the photos, friendly host
This place had great views and was in very good location to start walking around the city.  The rooms and amenities definitely made me feel relaxed and comfortable during the duration of our stay.
It’s is a great location at the west loop, the train is not so loud, I slept great and the place was lovely! The only inconvenience I had was that the WiFi was very slow and bad
Absolutely great location! We really enjoyed our stay and had great view of the city! Can’t wait to come back!
"A fantastic stay! Communication with  Anthony’s was excellent from booking to checkout. The apartment was spotless, exactly as pictured, and in a great location, We would gladly stay here again!"
The place was just as the pictures. Quiet neighborhood with great location. Really Confortable beds, would definitely book if we get the chance to come back to Chicago.

I loved it! Discovering Edgewater while here was amazing:) easily walkable neighborhood and right by the subway station! A lot of local shops and restaurants to check out as well. The Airbnb itself is also nice, it’s clean and accurate to the description. Quick tip: parking is very difficult (but free) so make sure you prepare for that!
厨房设施齐全，社区安全，步行几分钟就有超市可以购物，非常方便。社区安静。

We truly enjoyed our stay! Marissa was very responsive whenever we contacted her, which we really appreciated. The space was very clean and comfortable overall.
There was some noise from the bar downstairs, but it wasn’t too bad and didn’t prevent us from sleeping. One thing to be aware of is that the bathroom is not located inside the room; it is down the hall. The bathroom itself was very clean, but the toilet was quite small and not very accommodating for adults. That was really the only downside to our stay.
Overall, we had a very enjoyable experience and appreciated Marissa’s responsiveness and hospitality!
Great location and a nice place to stay! Everything was convenient and we enjoyed our time here.

Muy amoblado limpio, todo lo que necesitas los tienes serca, ejemplo restaurantes farmacia.
Muy tranquilo la zona,la verdad la pasé muy bien en mi estancia.
