The place did not match the photos and it was not as clean as mentioned above. For the price, we were expecting a much cleaner more accurate at home.. we ended up leaving after 1 night. She was very responsive and apologized for the way the house looked.
Matched the description.
Very responsive, place was very clean and tidy.
Great view from the rooftop. Wonderful view from the large windows in the living room. Easy in and out. Supplied with all the necessities and more.

Very lovely place to stay for a week in Chicago. There are several bus stops nearby, including transfers to the L. The place was spotless, the neighborhood peaceful, and there are lots of good restaurants in the area too.

I had an awesome stay! The place was clean, cozy, and perfect for all the adventuring we did. The train does get noisy, but it isn’t too loud in the bedroom, especially if you use the earplugs provided, so it wasn’t an issue at all.
Great communication, great location, great building!

Reminded us of the golden old days of Airbnb where the host is actually a real, kind human who goes out of his way to make your stay lovely. The house is *stunning* and equipped with everything, from kitchen items (spices, oil, ziplocks, etc.) to bathrobes and games. There were special touches like butter, different beers, and champagne. We stayed with two little kids and Isaac let them play with Hubbard (world's cutest puppy) and even looked for an amp so one of them could play the decorative electric guitar. Super easy walking to busses and the blue line, plus two blocks from Lula. This was the perfect place to enjoy being "home" after big days in the city. Truly, one of the best Airbnb stays we've had in years.
They were great and super responsive !
The place was convenient, quiet, walking distance to take out. Beds were comfortable, shower had great pressure. It had parking which is always a plus.

We had a wonderful stay! The photos don't even do the house justice—it’s clean, beautiful, and located in a great neighborhood. Jeff was a fantastic host who responded instantly whenever we had questions. I was a bit worried about finding street parking late at night, but we had no trouble finding a spot every single time we returned. Highly recommend!

Eric’s place is perfectly located in Lincoln Park. Quaint shops and restaurants, super walkable! We were moving our son into DePaul, and campus was only a couple of blocks away. The neighborhood is really great.
The interior of the apartment matched the pictures, was clean and well appointed. We loved starting our day in front window sitting area.
Highly recommend!
Great stay! Location is phenomenal. Everything was within walking distance. Parking was easy to find. Danny also was very friendly and responsive.

Our family stayed and the place was comfortable and a great base to explore from. Transport links are easy with the Blue Line an 8 minute walk away and lots of buses.
All amenities are to a high standard.
Outside space to sit and relax would be nice but not the end of the world. It does exactly what it claims to do. I'd recommend.

It was suprisingly quiet for being right next to the L! A very walkable area and felt safe! Had a cute little donut shop right downstairs that I got coffee at! Place was cute and cozy and looked just like the photos! Would definitely stay here again!

We had a family trip (parents and two school aged children) to Lincoln Square. We couldn’t have asked for a better spot than this apartment; it is a few doors down from Alexander’s, a great classic diner, and the park. Another few thoroughly doable blocks to Lincoln Square proper, which has many great food options. There are also supermarkets and a convenience store and pharmacy within a short walk.
The unit itself is great. The third floor loft area is capacious, well-lit during the day, and great for kids; there is adequate privacy between it and the main floor bedroom. (Plus a bonus second bedroom on that floor, on the small side.)
Decor is modern and artistic without trying too hard. They did a wonderful flourish in living room integrating a green wall and some art hanging on it.
Kitchen is nice, well-appointed, and island/eating area is nicely spacious.
Host comms were great; stay was very easy. Will happily return again.

Sehr enttäuschender Aufenthalt. Die Unterkunft war bei unserer Ankunft extrem dreckig und wir haben uns dort überhaupt nicht wohlgefühlt. Besonders hinter dem Sofa und dem Bett war viel Schmutz, sodass wir den Eindruck hatten, dass die Wohnung nicht gründlich gereinigt worden war.
Als wir den Gastgeber auf die Situation angesprochen und versucht haben, eine Lösung zu finden, wurden wir leider nicht ernst genommen. Der Gastgeber ist uns überhaupt nicht entgegengekommen und hat sich nicht bemüht, das Problem zu lösen.
Für uns war die Unterkunft aufgrund der mangelnden Sauberkeit und der schlechten Kommunikation eine große Enttäuschung. Wir können die Unterkunft leider nicht weiterempfehlen und würden dort nicht noch einmal übernachten.

I liked the place! it was good, the “free street parking” is one small street that maybe fits 15-20 cars but was not specified in the listing, we had to ask where it was
very convenient being right next to the red line, and a lot of food options nearby!
washer and dryer lowkey did suck, the washing cycle takes forever and it was leaking oil and it stained my friends brand new concert shirt she just bought, and you can only dry half of the load that you just washed. so don’t do laundry unless you wanna be there for forever
the bar downstairs wasn’t loud either at all until like after midnight but it was extremely muffled, but i had the ac going and it muted the sound of the music enough to where i could go to bed easily
would come back and visit again if i needed to stay in that area again!

Everything about this place was perfect. The floors do squeak but it’s nothing bad! The only issue we had but we knew might be a problem was finding parking. During the day it was easy to deal with but later at night parking was an issue. I had asked our host about it before hand so I knew what to expect but it something to keep in mind!

The place was fantastic. It was the cleanest place I’ve ever rented. I mean it, you could eat off the floors.  It was exactly what I was hoping for, and my family had nothing but good things to say about it.  In addition, Danny, our host, was responsive and attentive, and very concerned about us having a good stay.  I can’t say enough good things about the place, and Danny.  I will rent again, if the chance comes up.

It was a great stay for us. The apartment was clean and as described.
The hosts were responsive.
Overall, nice place to stay after a long day. The only complaints were the mold in the shower, as mentioned by previous guests, and I also had to unclog the shower drain.
Location is perfect! Everything is walkable
Stayed here with a couple friends for a couple nights and it suited all of our needs. It was only a 10 minute walk from a metro station, and the space itself was clean and had everything we needed.
Room and house was very clean and tidy, exactly the same as described. Host responses quick and friendly. Had a very comfortable stay!

Great location by Wrigley Field! Within walking distance of Wrigley, bars and restaurants. It's a bit noisy because of all the bars though, even late at night. The house has a BNB feel. Our room's bathroom was in the hall and I'm not sure if we were sharing with others. They could really use a shower upgrade. It's a small tub with a curtain surrounding it. The curtain sticks to you and is pretty low. I'm 5'8" and my head was well over the top. The bed felt like it was on a slope, though it was soft. The portable A/C unit kept the room nice and cold. Breakfast was appreciated and other guests were enjoyable to mingle with.
After a bad experience in our last stay at another Airbnb, this was refreshing and the Frida painting was tasteful! Nothing but 5 stars across the board! Will stay again!

I stayed here for about 2 1/2 weeks. The house was clean when I arrived and, from what I could tell, there weren’t any sanitary issues.
However, as the days passed, I began to notice that there was a serious pest/rodent issue in the home, the main cause being the gaps between the windows and especially the gaps between the doors.
I notified the host right away and he worked to find a resolution immediately. The host was respectful of my time and schedule and coordinated a visit from pest control within hours of me notifying him.
Aside from the pest/rodent issue that was addressed, the home was clean, spacious, beautifully furnished, and stocked up with toiletries, cleaners, cookware, and other guest essentials. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful, and the host is communicative, responsive, and respectful.
Great views, beautiful space, excellent layout. I would buy this apartment if I could!
Good location
Awesome place to stay. Can't wait to return.
Comfy and cozy small place, in a Fabolous location, clean, safe. I only wish the bad was a bit updated (the mattress) but overall it was a great stay
Good location and walkable to everything we needed during our stay. Space accommodated two couples and a baby very comfortably.

Place was extremely nice, better than what we expected. I saw reviews on noise complaints but it wasn’t bad at all for us. Everything was nice and clean as well as convenient. Area was perfect. Although, the dishes seemed a bit dirty for immediate use, thankfully they had dish soap and sponges (the dish soap had some gunk on it) so I would recommend washing dishes before use. Other than that our stay was perfect!! Would definitely recommend.
Great place for complete experience for families
We stayed for the BTS concert and it was the perfect distance to get to and from the venue and downtown. And the amount of towels and linens were much appreciated for us 4 girls staying there!

Definitely would recommend this accommodation to others & would stay there again myself. Very clean. Plenty of room. Great location. A short walk to several restaurants, pubs, shops. Safe & walkable residential area.
Nice little apartment by the lake with private parking available. Enjoyed the location.

Nice, clean apartment in a decent part of town. Well-stocked apartment; when we couldn’t find paper towels they were very responsive and helpful to remedy it. We were able to find parking whenever we need it. The listing matched the description in person.

I cannot express how happy I was with this house! Every floor had its own vibe, and the entire house was so big and beautiful. I would 100% recommend it, especially for big groups! There were only seven guests, including myself, and we still had one room that we didn’t even get to use.
The layout of the entire house was absolutely beautiful. The only sad part was that I was only able to book it for two nights since it was already reserved for the weekend.
I came to Chicago for the BTS concert, and while the location was a little far from Soldier Field and some of the other places I wanted to visit, the train station was within walking distance, and the area felt safe! It was so much fun exploring Chicago and having such a nice place to come back to at the end of the day. I would definitely stay here again!

Andy is good host, there were a few bumps in the road as there was a booking mishap, so I cannot comment specifically on this rental. However Andy was super accommodative and had an alternate rental for me to stay.
Location was near McCormick place, fairly neutral point, very organized and communicative. Bed was comfy, I had a few concerns that I communicated to Andy and he was pretty receptive and looking to have a solution. The room came with a private bath and a good kitchen.

Laura was extremely pleasant and responsive. She went above and beyond to answer any questions I had and to share her recommendations for restaurants. Her home was neat and clean and super modern chic feeling. I will definitely contact her again next time I travel to the Chicago area!
Easy and simple location, but parking is an issue

Can’t beat the location. Very close to train station and pink line. Getting to downtown is easy and less than an hour. Felt pretty safe in the neighborhood as well. House itself was clean and all appliances were great quality. Room was comfortable, and I especially liked the standing shower!
Host was responsive and kind!

Very nice stay at Andrea’s place ! As said in other comments, the neighborhood is a bit sketchy. We never felt unsecured though! (Even with a 4 years old kid!) The apartment is very nice, very close from the subway! We had an amazing stay, the apartment is peaceful, very quiet! We recommend 100% !

This place was wonderful. Super spacious and comfortable. Everything you'd need. The location is excellent with lots to do around and easy access to other parts of the city. We stayed here for a few days and it's great for an extended stay!
Muy agradable y tranquilo. Además necesite una hora mas para hacer el checkout y porscha no tuvo ningún problema y me ayudo rapidísimo. Sin duda volvería a alejarme ahi

Sick views. Best I’ve ever had in an Airbnb. Great building amenities. Amazing location for downtown touring. On top of the L red line and attached to a parking garage. Apartment was clean and had everything we needed for the short stay. Very communicative host. Very clear directions.
Unit can be bright and a bit loud, but that’s to be expected with the massive windows and downtown location. Some homelessness in the area…also to be expected in the big city. We always felt safe, though.

We truly enjoyed our stay here while in Chicago.  The proximity to the Red CTA line was very convenient and there were some great breakfast spots within walking distance.  Mark was very accomodating when we asked aboout an earlier check-in and his directions were clear and concise.  My daughter and her friend were able to walk to and from a concert at the Aragon and felt safe doing so.  I would highly recommend Mark's place for comfort and value.

The place was very nice. The neighborhood was just a little sketchy but not bad at all. Their instructions made it easy to get in. No problems with anything and easy for ride shares to find. Would use again if im ever in chicago.
Great place and very sweet host
Ron was a great host, he helped me to figure out the map and transportation. The neighborhood was very safe as well.

숙소는 깨끗하고 모든 것들이 다 잘 갖춰져 있었습니다! 여러 오브제들과 장식들이 숙소를 더욱 감성적으로 돋보이게 해주었고 침구도 깨끗했습니다. 일주일 정도 머물렀는데 호스트 분께서 중간중간 필요한 건 없는지 연락주시며 신경써주셨고 수건도 항상 넉넉하게 챙겨주셨습니다. 짐 관련해서 요청드린것도 흔쾌히 받아주시고 빠른 답장으로 인해 의사소통도 원환했습니다! 시카고에서 첫 여행이었는데 좋은 추억 쌓을 수 있어서 감사했습니다~
I had a great stay

Steve’s place was wonderful! Steve and his wife were very welcoming and helped us with every need. We appreciated their hospitality, and their place was perfect. Great neighborhood, lovely coffee place a block away, and easy to get to transportation. Would highly recommend!!

We had a wonderful experience with this listing! The place was very comfortable, clear, and in great shape. The included garage space was the biggest perk of this location! We were able to easily get to the Museum Campus. The hosts were friendly and quick to communicate and respond, and they were incredibly flexible with our dog as well! The neighborhood felt safe for walking the dog at all hours. Food delivery was very easy, and we enjoyed a delicious deep-dish from the restaurant across the street. Thank you for a great experience!

My family and I had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was very clean, comfortable, and had such a fun, cozy atmosphere. After spending all day exploring Chicago, it was the perfect place to come back to, relax, and unwind together.
One of my favorite memories will definitely be all of us climbing to the top with our luggage to get to the Bluebird unit. It was quite the adventure, and something we’ll laugh about and remember fondly as part of our Chicago trip.
Jason also went above and beyond with the videos he sent before our stay. The parking video especially was incredibly thoughtful and helped us so much. Parking in Chicago can be a little overwhelming, so having him take the time to show us exactly where to go made our arrival so much easier and less stressful.
You can really tell Jason puts a lot of thought into making his guests feel comfortable and prepared. We truly appreciated everything and would definitely stay here again!
Would definitely go back
Great place, host was responsive. The place is nice and exactly described as pictures.

Excelente lugar para hospedarse en grupo grande. Excelente ubicación para moverse hacia el downtown por transporte público. Muchas rutas de acceso y barrio tranquilo. Buen sistema de aire acondicionado y agua caliente. Si quieres no tener complicaciones, este lugar es ideal.

The host was extremely communicative. The building staff were super friendly. The location was convenient and walkable. The apartment was spacious and stylish. I loved the benefit of the pool deck. I felt safe staying there by myself. The only feedback I have, was an issue with the elevator. However, when reported the host and building staff were prompt to respond and ready to help.
It was great
Wonderful place to stay! Finding a spot for street parking was a little difficult, but that’s typical for Chicago. Highly recommend!

This was a very nice hotel room.  Clean, comfortable, and large enough.  The hotel location was great once we learned the metro system.  It should work really well for people coming from Ohare with the blue line stop right across the parking lot.

First time using Airbnb so I was extremely anxious about how everything works and once some of my plans fell through making our check in time later than anticipated the host had no problem with it and had assured me everything would be fine and I could get in regardless. With all the questions I had they were helpful and responded in a timely manor. The neighbors and people around the area were friendly and helpful when we had questions about other places in the area. For my first time experience I think this Airbnd was well worth it and in a decent area. When I come back to Chicago I’ll try and book this again to really get the full experience since the one day we were there was only for a concert which didn’t leave us much time to do much else.
Good with communication, helpful with my confusion. All around nice people
Beautiful apartment in one of Chicago’s best neighborhoods. Comfortable clean convenient. Minutes to EL. Our host was quick to respond and delightful. Highly recommended!

Overall a good place to stay. It is clean and easy to get in and around. The only issue we had was that the wifi was not showing or giving any option to connect and the hosts did not respond when contacted, I could t call as I do t have a us number.
Amazing host! Great location, super easy access to the pink line
Host was incredibly nice and responsive. Loved the location and  the backyard garden!

Super comfortable place in a great location! Walking distance to Millenium park, Lake Michigan, great restaurants, and multiple metro lines. Check in was straightforward and Cyndi was attentative in making sure we were comfortable. 10/10 would stay again!
My dog and I had another great stay here. Love the flat and the location. We’ll be back!
Second stay here. Great place and location!
Great place very spacious, very calm neighborhood overall. Everything worked fine and a very easy check in. Host is very responsive and accommodating.
We had a lovely time at Carolyn’s place. It’s a great location on a beautiful street and close to the beach, zoo and other fun activities.  Highly recommend.

Good location. 5 min walk to the blue line, bus stop is also just around the corner.
A little delay with checking in but it was sorted out with a phone call.
We loved the common room. The space was clean. Parking was also a plus.

Very cute, clean place to stay. Neighborhood feels safe. Easy check-in instructions and very friendly, communicative host.
Thank you!
Had a wonderful stay in this Airbnb! Would absolutely return and stay here for another trip if I’m ever planned to be in the area again!

Very nice place and super convenient if you’re visiting to watch the cubs. Super close to train stations as well and plenty of stores and things to do around the area. Would 100% come back if we ever visit Chicago again!!

The room was really nice and the bathroom was beautiful.  The only thing that made me make this a four star is the room was a little hot.  The AC controller was in the hall and it didn't seem to cool like it should.  But I would stay again.  The fans in the apartment really helped.  Thanks
The Airbnb is so pretty and comfortable! Everything is so close to the location of it too! We loved staying here and would recommend to others!
Delia’s place was great! I would recommend and stay there again.
It was nice a clean very easy to get to. The host communicated very well and timely told us everything we needed to know it was great experience and we would do it again thank you 😊

We really enjoyed our stay here. We were traveling with our 3.5-year-old son, and the place had pretty much everything we needed, which made things so much easier for us. The apartment was clean, comfortable and very well maintained.
The location worked really well too—groceries were just a quick stop away, and getting to South Loop and downtown Chicago was easy. What we liked most was how quiet and private the place felt. It was nice to come back to a calm space after spending the day exploring the city.
Jennifer and Paul were the perfect warm hosts , had left us a warm welcome note with chocolates . Also we just loved the coffee pods which they left us. There were many small details which was taken care in the house .
If we visit Chicago again , we would definitely choose this house again .
Overall, a very comfortable and convenient stay for our family. We’d definitely be happy to stay here again!

This was a very nice Airbnb. The unit itself was homey and clean. The host was wonderful and very responsive with any questions we had. The location was perfect for us. Parking was not a problem at all. The Lakefront Trail was only a few blocks and a couple of minutes from our door. The Metra station was right at the end of the street, which made getting into Chicago and surrounding areas for museums, shopping, and restaurants very convenient and stress free. We thoroughly enjoyed our visit to Chicago!
Great location especially if you plan to attend a Cub’s game. The place was very clean. Be sure to bring your own coffee & shampoo.

Kristen was a wonderful host!! She was so sweet and gave us lot of recommendations for food around the area. The place was super cute and close to downtown Chicago!! Definitely recommend if you’re going to Chicago!! 😊💗
Great stay, great location

Jevaux's place was wonderful! Clean, and spacious for an apartment smack dab in the middle of the city. A little quiet oasis! Near public transportation in an artistic area of the city. Great cafe around the corner (Dayglow), and you are right next to the 606 (think NYC Highline) which is this wonderful transformed elevated train line just perfect for walks, especially with a child. Highly recommend!

Keith was an amazing host! Excellent communication and great service from beginning to end. The house was beautiful, super clean, comfortable, and everything felt fresh and very well taken care of. We had a great stay and felt right at home. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend Kate’s place. Thank you so much, Kate!
Truly an amazing host was super helpful and understanding with guest amount changes!! Would visit again!
Great location and walkable to trains and busses.

Pros: Valeriy (Host) was kind, responsive and gave clear instructions for the stay.
Room was clean.
Conveniently located near Kedzie (Pink Line Station)
Cons: In my 7+ years of using AirBnB, this was the ONLY bad experience I have had. The description fails to mention that this accommodation is not a house shared with only the host but much more like a hostel with several rooms and guests there. We stayed in Room 4 which was directly above and next to the two guest bathrooms in the house and both were like revolving doors from 10PM-6AM the 2 nights - meaning we barely slept while we were staying. The nearby train was quieter. Every time someone would use the shower the hot water heater would squeak & shake the walls. The other guests had no consideration for the instructed quiet hours past 10PM or cleaning instructions.
We messaged the host and there were no other options so we were stuck with our room.
Not to mention, the area feels a bit unsafe and run down.

We were so pleased with this home, we couldn't have asked for a nicer stay!! Loved the deck and loved having the option of being able to smoke outside. Thank you Odi for accommodating us, and helping us with an early check-in.

We stayed at Robin’s place with our toddler and it was perfect. Super clean, comfortable beds, nicely decorated with thoughtful touches everywhere. We thought we’d miss having a TV but we didn’t! The place is located in a quiet residential area but still walkable and close to restaurants and cafes. Blue line was also a short walk away which made going downtown super easy. Robin was also kind, friendly, and very responsive whenever we needed anything. Definitely saving this place for whenever we’re back in Chicago!
Phenomenal location, great amenities, amazing city. Will be returning
The stay was very enjoyable, I would check in again if I ever come through again.
Very spacious, and the location was excellent for the conference center.

Girl’s trip to Chicago. We loved the location and the spaciousness of the apartment.
We loved walking to different restaurants and bars.
We would definitely want to stay at Heather’s place again.
The place was very nice. Parking was definitely a plus. We didn’t face any issues. I will recommend this place to others who are coming with big families.
We needed this place to take our daughter and friend to the BTS concert.   It was in a great location and we could walk easily to a lot of places to eat.   Great view as well.
Very enjoyable experience in this piece of art

The apartment is well situated in Roger's Park. There is the Morse L train stop a short walk away and numerous bus lines all around. You can shop near by at Morse Market, which has about anything you would need.
The apartment is comfortable and very clean, although it is clearly only for Airbnb rental purposes. There are laundry machines in the basement (make sure to bring enough quarters!), and the neighbourhood is safe.
Cozy Nest is quick to respond to any questions and checks up on guests via the message center. It was a great springboard for me to relocate to Chicago and find my own place. I would recommend staying there.

The host kindly adjusted the check-in time for me since I arrived early, and also let me leave my luggage until the afternoon on the day of checkout. He even helped me carry my heavy luggage up to the second floor!
He is incredibly responsive and genuinely kind throughout my stay. The place felt just like home, and I also felt safe in the neighborhood. Overall, it was such a comfortable and pleasant stay.
One thing to note is that the room is somewhat susceptible to outside noise, so light sleepers or those who are sensitive to noise may want to keep this in mind.
Thank you so much!

I had a wonderful stay! The location was exceptionally accessible, making it effortless to get around. The space itself was spotless, perfectly clean, and wonderfully organized. To top it off, the host was fantastic super responsive and quick to answer any questions. Highly recommend!
In a great area, very tidy, flexible check in. Would definitely book again!
Second time staying and it was great. The location has all the things you'd need for a quick stay, and very close to the brownline.

The Airbnb is in a beautiful spot of Chicago. Next to amazing restaurants, walkable scenery, and next to the train and bus routes to make travel easy along with a convenience/grocery store down the street open late.

By and large this place is solid. However the profile says the word luxury and this place was not that. The images on the site were retouched and even though the profile says the images are not up to date they still are not accurate. I would say if you are on a budget and need to fit a-lot of people in one space and are looking for “solid” accommodations and a good location this is for you.

This home is well decorated and in such a cute neighborhood. I stayed for the BTS concert and was about a 15-20 minute drive from Soldier Field. The hosts are so kind and respond within a timely manner. Also, the street parking was easy to park in and always had available spaces. If anyone is staying in Chicago I recommend this home in Old Town🩷

Beautiful home and neighborhood. This place absolutely elevated our trip experience. Great restaurants down the street, as well as a Target. For our trip we decided to go car-less and this location could not be more convenient. Walkable neighborhood, bus routes, and most importantly the blue line for the subway less then a mile away. Underrated nightlife scenes. Google Maps doesn’t not do justice to the area.
Thank you Mark, we will be back.

Richard’s place was just as described. Very clean and the fridge was even stocked with some items for us to use. The made the extra bed for us in advance which was really nice. The only negative is parking on the street is really tight and limited. I had to park a few block away and walk at night which I didn’t really love
Awesome stay, great place and location
Would highly recommend great host

This apt was the perfect stay to visit Chicago. Katty was very responsive and answered all questions we had in the lead up to the trip. The apt had everything we needed for our stay, and was clean and bright. Heads up there is no wifi which did surprise me, but we made it work. The surrounding area has plenty of parking garages if you’re coming by car, including one in the building. Very dog friendly area— my dog enjoyed meeting all the neighborhood pups. Would definitely stay here again!
Great spot right next to the train station. It is loud at night but they provide ear plugs. Other than that it’s a quiet complex
Geo was a great host. The apartment was much bigger than I thought, pleasant surprise. Clean and well taken care of. Will stay here again for sure!
Good location which was incredibly accessible by bus and the red line.
Host very responsive. Nice space.
Thank you for the prompt communication and chic lodging!

We had a wonderful stay at Bridget's home! The house is a fantastic single-family property that is close to downtown Chicago, making it so convenient to get around. It was clean and equipped with everything we could possibly ask for or need during our trip. Bridget was an absolute pleasure to work with—polite, responsive, and a SUPER host all around. We had a great time spending our family vacation here with the kids, and we would love to book with her again next time we are in the area. Highly recommend!
Great stay in Chicago! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Everything was as described, and communication with the host was easy. We would definitely stay here again!
Great location and walked to several places. Easy access to public transport. Loved the eccentric decor!
Loved it
Nice place to stay, easy check-in, and great communication with the host!! Thank you

LIVIN Chicago is conveniently located  near Union Station. Checking in and out were easy. They were very prompt and responsive with communications. The apartment was clean, organized, and comfortable. I stayed a few days, and had everything I needed, like dishes, soap, paper towels. Definitely would book this place again.
The place was nice! Although the shower had trouble draining, and there was a silverfish in there. Other than that everything was nice
Was really wonderful, would’ve have liked it if the keurig and grill worked but otherwise had a great time.
Loved the place. Everything was clean and in order. I cannot recommend it enough!
Good

this was a beautiful spot and easy access to the red line. kate was very responsive when we asked questions and the place was perfect for just two of us! quiet and peaceful. would definitely recommend and would come back when i come visit chicago again!

This is the place to be in the uptown area … easy to both drive and walk and astonishingly we always found a parking spot right in front of the lovely home. It was quiet, peaceful and full of great breakfast places, all kinds of food and so many nice people. We enjoyed our stay here thoroughly!
Great Stay! Easy Check in and was perfect for our two day vacay.

This place was perfect for what we needed. Super friendly and in a great location. Just outside of the city. Made staying here easy. Parking was no issue. They also were considerate with our allergies which meant alot to us! If I ever make it back to Chicago, I know where I will stay!
I had a great stay! The most accommodating hosts!
Muy lindo todo
Enjoyed the cozy studio, nice for a mom and daughter trip
Great place for 1 or 2 people to stay in Lincoln Park! The location and decor are excellent and Martha is a wonderful host, taking care of every need.

This was my second time staying with Kathleen and I will definitely be staying with her again in the future. The location makes it so easy to get around. Kathleen is so kind and so willing to try to answer any questions you might have. The place was exactly as it was described and shown in the pictures.

The rooms are for two but I asked if we could add a person for an extra cost, which he accepted and was nice. The day we arrived I asked if we could leave our luggage there a bit before the check in the morning, but he did not reply til past 1pm so my friend had to wait a couple of hours because of that. My friend and I had a concert, so my friend stayed and told me there were other guests who were making noise at night, and the shower smelled like pee. Which I agree cause the smell lasted til morning. I would not book it again, but it is affordable, the area is okay and the room is nice.

Our stay with Frank and Susanne was wonderful! The location was perfect for accessing public transit and steps away from many restaurants (local and chain) while being hidden on a quiet street away from road noise. They loved his space and said it was beautiful and very very clean and modern.  They felt safe in the neighborhood and very comfortable in Jaye's space!  We all will definitely look to use Jaye anytime we travel to Chicago in the future!  I highly recommend!  His location is in a great area with easy access to many things!  THANK YOU JAYE for everything!

We had a good stay overall. The home itself was clean, comfortable, and matched the photos perfectly. However, the listing's location details were inaccurate: Hard Rock Cafe listed within walking distance is permanently closed, and the local attractions were a longer walk than stated. I would still highly recommend!

Family of 3 coming from UK & Germany and first time in Chicago. We’re really glad we had our base at Vanessa & Charlie’s place. Easy walk from Damen “L” station to their street, there was a cool vibe in the neighbourhood - and a bloc party on when we arrived. Great food and bars around (Piece Pizza, Mindy’s bakery, tacos), fantastic playgrounds, parks, the 606, and farmers market on Sunday. Great to have cooking and washing facilities in the property, and a travel cot for our little one. Hosts were really responsive and quick to help with our small requests. We didn’t have the streamer subscriptions required to use the TV. Only small downsides were no bedside tables in the bedrooms, no recycling bin (?) and a empty can of energy drink left under the bed.
Nice little place to stay.
The place was great, clean and I enjoyed my stay.

Fantastic stay for our trip to Chicago!! Wonderful location with lots to do and easy access to transportation. Tyler was an exceptional host that made our trip extra special. Extremely friendly and accommodating. Went above and beyond during our stay and it was greatly appreciated. The house was exactly as described, very clean and inviting. Would 100% recommend and stay again!
Comfortable stay in a beautiful neighborhood! Ariel was a very responsive and helpful host.
Enjoyed staying at Felice's! The house is very clean and comfortable, highly recommended!
Had a great time! Easy access. I recommend it.

My only issue with this place was the bathroom. My primary issue being black mold! There was significant black mold on the walls and ceiling around the shower and in other damp areas of the bathroom. I understand that the building is old, but black mold is unacceptable for an airbnb. Additionally the shower curtains did not close all the way on either side, so that was slightly inconvenient, due to water getting on the floor outside of the tub that I had to wipe up. Aside from that, everything was wonderful. Beautiful location, the cats were so cute and sweet, breakfast was lovely, and the whole place has a lot of character. It's also very close to a lot of key locations and is extremely walkable! If a few adjustments were made to the bathroom, this would've been the perfect stay! Overall very enjoyable, the bathroom is my only critique. Thanks Ashley for making such a beautiful place available on airbnb!
Lovely place would return
Comfort stay

My family and I had a wonderful stay at Kyriako’s place! It was very convenient for everything that we wanted to do and they were very organized with check in and check out instructions, which made the stay easy. Would love to stay here again if we ever visit Chicago another time!
Small, clean space in a beautiful location. Easy to find, and walking distance to plenty of shopping and public transit.

This home is in the perfect location for walking to fantastic restaurants around Ukrainian village, with only a little hike to Wicker Park for even more. The transit is close enough to make the trip to downtown a non-issue. And after walking around town, you can still save some money by bringing back groceries and taking advantage of the fully stocked kitchen to cook meals. The room was well arranged to work remotely from, making this listing a great well-rounded choice for a work & play stay in Chicago! I would definitely book again. I will recommend the host and home to my friends & family when they need a place to stay here in Chicago.

This stay was great! This place was only a 10 minute walk to the train station and near a whole bunch of food places. We were also about a 5 minute walk from walgreens and trader joe’s. The building itself is old and the hallways do have a smell to them, but the room itself was beautiful! My only complaints would be the water pressure (very little to nothing while showering) and how loud the street is during early morning. The bed is right under the ac unit which allows the noise to come in. Overall definitely worth the money and would stay here again

We enjoyed our stay in the city. Our only concern was parking. I was unaware that we wouldn’t have a parking space on site,  we were visiting from out of state. It turned out to be just fine, there was plenty of free street parking that felt very safe for my family of 6.
Accommodations were great It was easy to park and also had public transportation within a very easy walking distance.
The home was in a very convenient location, and very easy to access. The building is beautiful and had lots of amenities for our stay!
Exactly what I expected! Perfect for a solo traveler. Safe location, easy check-in!

Great stay! The bed was a little uncomfortable and the room a little small. But it was a great stay and the others staying there were really nice. The surrounding area was very peaceful and nice, and there were places close by to walk to. Definitely recommend!
Very good stay, comfortable place similar to an apartment, very good hotel, excellent location
Location was great and it had easy accessibility for bus/trains. It was a private room that was clean and had very nice amenities. It was perfect for our 3 day stay.
Great neighborhood, great spot, perfect for what we needed: a comfy bed and a bathroom. Thank you for hosting us!

This was a super nice stay! 4 of my friends & i had a great time & plenty of space for all of us. the a/c was amazing, high ceilings made the place feel that much bigger, the living room was perfect for was the way together & chit chat. I’d say my only complaint is that they didn’t supply enough toilet paper & paper towel. All rolls provided were not full, more than half way almost out, so we ran low pretty quick and refills weren’t provided.
Every lyft driver that dropped us off warned about not going out at night & to be careful bc the area supposedly wasn’t knows to be safe among the locals. The door locks & brought my friends & I relief in safety.
Excelente
Mark, was quick to respond to questions the home was beautiful and cozy and close to restaurants, corner store and a lovely coffee shop, will stay again if ever in town great location!
Very responsive host and goes above and beyond

My sister and I enjoyed our stay at Sean’s place.  The bed was very comfortable. The shower worked very well and everything was clean and very functional. We were able to walk to local restaurants and enjoy great food. A great location in a very safe neighbourhood. Lincoln Park Zoo and Spoko restaurant were a couple of our favourites. Thank you Sean.

This apartment was overall good. It’s in a cute neighborhood with lots of good things in walking distance, including an L stop one block away. Proximity to the train stop is double edged, however, because you hear the trains running all night. It was kinda like the scene in the blues brothers movie (also set in Chicago) where someone says the trains running outside the window so often, eventually you don’t even notice it.
The apartment itself had an updated kitchen which was nice, but felt a little run down elsewhere like in the bathroom and bedroom.
The bedsheets were not sufficiently clean when I checked in. I noticed a yellow crusty stain on the underside of the comforter when I checked in which was very unwelcome!

I had a great stay! The place was very clean and looked just like the pictures. Iris responded very quickly whenever we had questions and was very helpful throughout our stay. We had everything we needed and really enjoyed our time here!

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Check-in was easy and the location worked perfectly for our trip. Everything was just as expected and we had no issues during our stay. Would definitely recommend!

The place was very nice and clean. We initially booked this place for the the private parking because of a different experience we had, but later realized that the street parking required a permit, which they provide, so we didn't even need to private park in the back. We had a great stay.

Ragan’s place was exactly as described and was the perfect place for us to stay while visiting Chicago for a concert. Very cozy, cute neighborhood with food, coffee, and the train in walking distance!

Parking spot narrow to use, hard to get in, elected to park in the additional parking area, apt was nice, clean and useful for our purposes, had an overall good experience, no complaints to the owners
Extremely nice host! I enjoyed my stay.
Great host

This place was an absolute gem! I was visiting Chicago for a few days and it checked all the boxes for me. My main concern going into my trip my trip was my safety traveling solo as a female, but I felt 100% safe walking around the area at all given times of day! The building itself was less than 5 minutes walking distance to the Brown Line which was super convenient and made it super easy to get around the city. The space itself was lovely!!! The bed was insanely comfy, the shower products were high quality, and there was even a little luggage stand in the closet which was SUPER helpful. It was perfect, thank you Aaron!
I had a wonderful time stay here. Everything was so clean and comfortable.
It was a great stay! It’s the perfect location downtown to get around Chicago and the place was clean and easy to find!

The rooftop lounge area is super nice as well has a pool table, arcade games, bar and views of the city perfect for photos perfect to lounge.
Had a wonderful stay here!  Great location!

Aesthetic was nice. You have to go through 1 bedroom to get to the second. The biggest complaint is the smell. It smells like a moldy mildew basement which I am allergic. It was hard to breathe and made my nose run. I communicated this and was told a cleaner could come. Which I replied that won’t fix the smell. I was very displeased considering the price and had to spend minimum time there. I would have never booked if basement was in the description.

The host was friendly, courteous, and always responded quickly whenever we had questions, which we appreciated. Unfortunately, the property itself did not meet our expectations, especially considering the price. Based on the listing and cost, we expected a much higher standard of quality and maintenance.
There were several issues throughout our stay. All of the bedrooms had a strong sewer/bathroom odor that never went away. One bedroom door would not close properly, and the master bedroom had significant outside noise that made it difficult to sleep.
The listing also did not accurately show or mention the number of steps required to access the property, which would have been important to know in advance for guests with mobility concerns or heavy luggage.
The bathroom sink was clogged and drained very slowly. The kitchen was not equipped with enough utensils for a family, and the dishwasher was dirty upon arrival with dirty dishes still inside. There were also no dishwasher pods prov

Loved the place! Very good location: peaceful and safe. I stayed there with 6 other girls and didn't feel unsafe for a single moment. Very spacious and clean! Will definitely stay here next time I am in Chicago!

Marcelo definitely was a quick responder would not have any trouble communicating with the Host the instructions were very clear upon check in and checking out and you house is in a very nice location I would definitely comeback to this Airbnb when we visit Chicago again and I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for an Airbnb that makes you feel at home.
Wonderful host
Toy’s place was beautiful and so well appointed. Had the whole top floor to our selves with a jacuzzi tub and the most comfortable bed!

Lovely basement unit, ceilings are a bit low but I'm 5"3 so it wasnt a problem for me! Accessible to the train, gestation, walgreens, tjx and more. Very relaxing stay and I would recommend the place again.

Wonderful place, located in safe neighborhood within short walking distance to train station. You can hear the train passing, which was clearly advertised in the listing. It wasn’t a problem for me though as Tim provides earplugs.
Great spot in terms of location & confort! Also a plus that it’s pet friendly :) would definitely return!

Great place to stay

Great location, just as described. Would stay again.
One caveat: This is a lower floor in an old building. Unit above was rented while we were there. Anyone walking above resulted in the floors creaking. This did wake us up at night.
There is a total of 3 locks which is a bit of a hassle but the security is appreciated. Very clean, and it is very close to the blue line station.

Our experience with this Airbnb was exceptionally poor. Upon arrival for our group of twelve attending a concert in Chicago, we found the house was not ready and completely uncleaned. The bedding, including sheets and comforters, was missing entirely. Although the host admitted fault and offered a cleaning crew and credit, the condition of the property made it impossible for our group to stay. Furthermore, the alternative stays offered by Airbnb customer service were too far away to be practical, forcing us to book a hotel in Chicago at a significantly higher cost.
Great place with so much to do, and ofc not too far away! The neighborhood was decent and very easy to commute out of. Great stay!

wonderful stay and couldn’t have asked for a better host! The communication was excellent, the place was clean and comfortable, and everything was just as described. truly felt welcomed and would happily stay here again. Highly recommend!
Loved this place! The pictures dont do it justice....its even better than the photos. Super easy to get to public transportation. We were in town for a concert and I would definitely stay here again!

This place was bigger than we expected it to be and was a wonderful experience. It’s walkable to all kinds of restaurants and not far from the loop. I would definitely recommend staying here and will come back again in the future when I’m back in Chicago!

The apologetic demeanor for lack of following up with info on early check in as well as luggage storage never led to action in the slightest.
When official check in time came it was as if we walked into a prank. We couldn’t believe our eyes. Bed completely undone, trash filled and odorous, noticeably used bathroom towels throughout. No ounce of consideration or preparation for kind hearted paying guests in the slightest.
In addition to the cleanliness hazards, the overall use unfulfilled promises - being told that an onsite team would follow up - left us no choice but to leave.
Huge thank you to Airbnb Support staff in rectifying this nightmare.

Mera was great! Always very responsive and provided extremely clear instructions for entry and for how to leave at the end of our stay, as well. Could not recommend this place more. It was beautifully kept, with extremely comfortable beds and super cold A/C (if you want it nice and cool). We prefer to stay in a Chicago neighborhood and walk to local, independent restaurants and shops, and that’s exactly what we did here. We loved it! And did I say the beds were comfortable? They really were…..and king size beds. Can’t wait to stay here again!

This is a great place to stay in Wicker Park. It's close to everything on Milwaukee Ave including access to the blue line. The residential parking pass is a huge plus. Lia was a great host with clear instructions and helpful when it came to answering any questions I had. Would definitely stay here again if I came back to Chicago!

The beginning of our stay was definitely a little rocky. There was some confusion about the unit we were supposed to stay in, and when we arrived, it hadn't finished being cleaned and wasn’t ready for us. We were also unfortunately locked out of the unit on our first night due to the mix-up.
That being said, the hostess was very kind, and the entire team was responsive and helpful throughout the situation. What happened in the beginning was unfortunate, but mistakes can happen, and we appreciated how the team handled the issues and compensated us for the check-in inconveniences.
After the first day, everything was great! The place was exactly as described, and the location was very walkable and convenient. Overall, I would recommend staying here. I think better communication and organization during the check-in process would make the experience even better, but aside from the rough start, we had a great stay.
Exactly as advertised, very nice neighborhood

The hosts communicated a lot and were very clear and kind. The only complaints I have is that the walls are thin and I could not sleep well even with earplugs in. And that the bed/room smelled like a teenage boy’s room and the pillows smelled of strong BO. But other than that, I basically got what I paid for.
It was an overall good experience! The beds were nice and cozy. The place was secure so we felt safe at our stay.
The stay was great. We were only there for a couple of nights, but it was a good little location.

I really enjoyed my stay here! The place was exactly as described, very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. I stayed for two months and had a great experience throughout my entire stay.
The host was incredibly kind, respectful, and welcoming. He was always willing to help whenever I needed anything, and the instructions for everything were very clear and easy to follow. One of the highlights was the delicious chocolate he makes as a hobby, it was such a thoughtful and tasty treat!
The neighborhood was friendly, quiet, and peaceful, and parking was very easy to find. Overall, I had a wonderful experience and would 100% recommend staying here. I would definitely come back again in the future!
The Airbnb was in a nice area and was comfortable! No problems here at all

My friends and I stayed here for a few nights for a concert and absolutely loved our stay! Instructions for check in were very clear and host was very quick to respond whenever we had questions. We also loved the neighborhood. We walked to Jackalope coffee every morning. There were so many restaurants and stores to walk to. For four young ladies, we felt safe and comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!

This was the perfect location to stay for a couple of nights in Chicago. Great walkable area with lots of stores and restaurants, but amazingly quiet in the apartment. Abel was super responsive and helped us out by having an air mattress ready for us as a third bed.

Great stay at Felixa’s listing. Very centrally located and the private garage was fabulous. The home was immaculate-white baseboards were white!! We only used the gourmet kitchen to boil the kettle but on another stay I would enjoy cooking in the well appointed kitchen. Everything we needed for a pleasant stay was provided and easy to locate. I appreciate the washer and dryer as we are light packers and prefer to launder our few articles. Felixa responded within minutes to the inquiry I had during our stay. I appreciate the investment our host placed in ensuring we had a remarkable stay! We absolutely did.
We had a great stay, we arrived at night and the area felt safe and easy to move around. Good place to enjoy the city.
Very nice and clean! Tere was very helpful and responsive! Lots of places to go to around!
Perfect location to walkable cute restaurants and shops + access to the brown line. Really great, clean space including an outdoor balcony. Loved our stay here
Amazing!
Amazing stay for a group trip. The view was amazing and everything was well-thought out. Would definitely stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay. The placer served our purpose. Just need to check the shampoo and body soap because these could be the cause of some skin hypersensitivity reaction on one of us. Other than than, all's great.
We were in town for the BTS concert, it was less expensive than a hotel and was perfect for what we needed!

I stayed here because it's pretty close to soldier field. Looks exactly like the pictures. The place looks really well taken care of and everything was nice and clean. This place and the area it’s located in, is nice! I traveled to Chicago, with my partner, for a concert. As two young adult females, we felt safe at this location. There’s also a “corner store” a little bit outside of the building. Which was good when we needed something quick to drink / snack on. Grateful that this stay helped make our first trip to Chicago wonderful!!
Great place and close to everything. Will definitely be staying here again. Thank you!!

Host and home was great! No complaints there! Very roomy and cozy. Upstairs doesn’t cool as quickly as downstairs but it wasn’t too bad. Location is the only reason my group didn’t give it the full 5 stars. Even though the train is close, it takes awhile to get anywhere, and there wasn’t much to do near the house.

Leelach's place is one of the nicest Airbnbs we've stayed in. It's a two-bedroom and we only need one but it looked great so we splurged. We were not disappointed.  Leelach lives upstairs so she takes care of this unit. It's perfect. It's spotless. The central AC is great. Water pressure in the shower is great. Full size W/D was very nice, as we were there 10 days. Comfortable bed and pillows. WIFI great. Quiet yet just in the first block off Clark. Andersonville is a great neighborhood with lots of shops and restaurants and a very nice Wednesday farmer's market. Leelach is a great host who answered our questions promptly when we arrived early and just wanted a nearby coffee shop before check-in. We would stay here anytime it's available when visiting family in Evansville. It's one of those places so nice it makes you want to live there.
A great stay for the price. Allowed us to be close to the city without paying hotel prices.

What was somewhat surprising, however, was the building is a student housing building for local colleges. This wasn’t mentioned in the description, and while it’s fine, it was not the high end condo building I had imagined, and the common areas (lobby, elevators, hallways), were pretty rundown. The biggest problem, though, was we were only given one set of working keycards. I was there with my adult son and we had planned on doing quite a few things separately, and not having two working keycards made that a pretty major logistical difficulty. I reported it, and was told they’d look into it, but never got a second card. So, because of this, my review is mixed.

really nice place

Lovely space with tons of room. Exactly matched the photos and description; it was even larger in person! I’ll be hoping to stay here again next time we are in Chicago. Very walkable area with lots of restaurants and coffee shops nearby.

Better than I expected. Everything is accurately mentioned in the description. The only thing to be wary of, of course, which was already mentioned, is noise from upstairs because of thin walls, but when sleeping, it shouldn't be a problem. I liked the location.

Chicago was great, Alma’s place was great and will definitely be back again sometime.

Nice apartment in wicker park. Clean and cozy. Instructions were perfect. Parking being included was great. Responsive host. Thank you!

Easy parking. Easy walk to the train. Great spot to call yours for your visit to Chicago!
Had a lovely place to stay for our time in Chicago. The house was really cozy and comfortable, and Charley was always nice and helpful, giving recommendations.

Check in was a breeze. The room was cute and clean with a great view, especially at night. Victor was very responsive to messages and quickly resolved an issue we had. Definitely a nice space.
It is a nice place. Floor surface could be cleaner. On the other hand, everything is okay.

We really loved staying here. Tim was an excellent host, as well as incredibly accommodating and friendly. The only downside was the noise of the metro, but other than that, everything was perfect. Thank you Tim!
Great place

Wow! Words are not enough to describe how wonderful this place was.  Maria was a great host; she was very responsive and super sweet. The place is super cute, cozy and clean. The neighborhood is very pretty and is a walking distance to so many great restaurants, along with train and bus lines.
Geo’s spot was great. The location was perfect with a quick walk to all public transportation. I’d definitely recommend during your next stay in the city!

The condo itself was clean and comfortable. Brad provided the amenities we appreciate and the neighborhood was safe. It was a delight to walk around and explore the restaurants, stores and beauty of the area.

This is one of our favorite places to stay in Chicago,  our daughter lives about a mile away, its easy to access and theres all our favorite bars and restaurants close by. Amazing stay very clean responsive top host!!!!

The apartment was beautiful, spotlessly clean, and fully equipped with everything we needed.Great neighborhood as well.
Enjoyed our stay. Felt at home and found it easy to settle in.

We had a great stay! The description of the unit was very helpful. There are a lot of stairs to consider if you have luggage. The location was fantastic and super close to the Red Line. Oliver was an exceptional host. He was very accommodating, flexible and responded very quickly to any question or need we had. His place was exactly as pictured, everything worked and everything was clean.
I highly recommend Oliver and his Airbnb. You won’t be disappointed.
Great apartment in a fantastic Old Town location. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a great stay in Chicago. Would definitely stay here again!
I love Katty place this my second time coming here I always enjoy my stay . Very comfortable,
The place was easy to reach and close the Metro and bus. The communication with GoatStays was easy and they responded right away.

Nice location. Lobby, corridors and unit all look spacious and bright but, up close, all show wear and tear. Living room and kitchen are nice but the dressing room looks frayed. Thank-you so much for having us Paul and definitely cant wait to come back!

My first Airbnb and it was a great experience. Host is super responsive and flexible. Let us drop off our bags early.

Olga and her Airbnb has everything you need. So close to everything to get to the city. She was so welcoming and helpful. Adiós amiga!
We enjoyed our stay there! It feels safe and surrounded by walkable neighborhood restaurants and cafe

Carla was a wonderful host for our week-long stay in Chicago! Traveling in from the Nashville area, our trip was especially meaningful—we were visiting a family member who has been unwell, and spending that time together was incredibly important to us. Carla’s home gave us the comfortable, welcoming space to do just that, which made the visit even more special.
Her place was spacious, cozy, and spotlessly clean—truly a home away from home. It’s conveniently located near the interstate, making it easy to get around to everywhere we needed to go. The home was well-equipped with everything we needed, making the trip even more comfortable.
Carla was consistently responsive and shared great local eatery recommendations, a nice bonus. In fact, after a couple of days there, we decided we wanted to extend our stay, but those extra days were already booked.
I wouldn’t change a thing and would love to book with Carla again next time I’m back in my hometown.

The condo is very tight. While updated and modern it was uncomfortably small for 6 people. The bedrooms have barely 1.5’ around the bed, no place for the suitcases unless in the closet. The garage pass provided is a couple blocks away we ended up in a closet lot for our oversized vehicle since the garage is only 6’-3” tall. The host was responsive but as an old Sonder location it was obviously built for short stays so don’t plan to stay more than 2-3 nights.
2nd time with Taims they are always professional and have clean places! There's always multiple people ready to respond if you need anything!

More towels and washcloths would also have been helpful. Overall, we would consider staying again with some improvements to cleanliness and upkeep.
Rida left me helpful instructions, which made my check-in smooth. The place has an incredible location, walking distance from cafes, restaurant and the lake!

zen’s place was exactly as described, an oasis. the accommodations were very thoughtful and zen was very attentive. the neighborhood is beautiful and quiet. was a great space to retreat after enjoying the city.
Great place to stay while in Chicago. Close to major train lines, it was very easy to get everywhere we needed to go. Place is spacious and clean, and hosts are very communicative.

Un apartamento limpio, lindo y cómodo. Justo lo que se necesita para la estadía en Chicago y cerca del Downtown. Los anfitriones se comunican rápido y te dan toda la información necesaria. 100% recomendado.

Convenient access and amenities and worth the price

Unfortunately, this stay wasn’t as smooth as our first. The garage had a power issue, so the garage door and lights were not working properly during our stay. We also found that the towels were clean but still slightly damp.
Azam was responsive, apologized for the inconvenience, and provided compensation for the issues, which we appreciated. Despite these issues, we still enjoyed the house and hope they are resolved for future guests. Overall, it remains a lovely and comfortable place to stay.
Great place to stay for conferences at McCormick place. Easy to check in, and the host was very responsive and communicative. Would stay here again.

In a great location, this big house was wonderful for our party of 8. Host was responsive and helpful! Neighborhood is very walkable with lots of food places nearby. Magdalena was extremely friendly and responsive the entire time we stayed here. The space was great for our larger group, and we'll definitely be staying here again on any future trips to the Chicago area.

Thank you Matt for everything - a great stay!  We will be back!

Second stay with Josh was just as good as the first.

Second time staying, loved it! Very spacious and great location!

All in all a wonderful stay and we'd love to be back.

It was a great stay, everything was nice and clean and everything looked just like it did in the photos. Great neighborhood peaceful, and quiet.

Excellent house, just like the pictures, Sarah responded very quickly to all my questions. We were a party of 12 and all of us enjoyed the place! Garage was such a bonus in Chicago

I had a great time and I loved that It was so Central to a lot of things. It was a short walk to things like whole foods or to the gym if you want to work out around the corner and it was safe and quiet and the house itself was very roomy and spacious. I loved every part of it. Thank you!

Perfect little place for an Andersonville escape. Everything was super easy - check in, coffee supplies, location, communication. I highly recommend!

We would definitely stay here again!

Anastasia was very helpful throughout our stay and clear with her instructions. The airbnb was very clean and organized. Close to the pink line to get into Chicago, though public transportation did take quite a while every time.
Sergio was a great host reactif all the time
This is our second time staying at this property. We felt right at home. We appreciated all the amenities and convenient location. The host was quick to respond to communication.
Appreciate the free breakfast. Its in a quiet part of the neighbourhood. People are great.
Beautiful place. Creative and inspiring. Great energy.  Would stay again!

Overall, an amazing stay!

Lyft and Uber rides were easy to get, and downtown was a fairly quick trip. The apartment is on the second floor, and the stairs were somewhat challenging for me, so guests with mobility concerns should keep that in mind.
George communicated clearly and responded quickly whenever we needed him. Overall, it was a comfortable, convenient home base for our Chicago trip, and we would gladly book it again.

Amazing view and location. Great amenities for all the family. Spotless, easy access, equipped kitchen. Very comfortable beds. Would definitely recommend!
Gabriela was a great host, being flexible and very responsive with any questions that we had before we stayed and during our stay. Definitely recommend to stay especially when visiting Chicago!
Fantastic place. Amazing location, incredible views of the lake, and thoughtful touches inside. Would definitely stay here again.
A beautiful and welcoming place to stay that truly felt like home, with plenty of activities to enjoy.

Great, clean place! Super comfortable furniture, including the bed. Well stocked, modern kitchen. Nice bathroom with good water pressure in the shower. Yes, it’s on the third floor but that means you have nobody above you, so no creaking floors.  Only issues is the noise from the street on the weekends when everyone is out partying late. Because of the window air conditioning units, it’s like having holes in your walls, so you can hear everything. Was OK during the week.

The apartment is 95% as photos except some woodenfloor is old with warping or collapsing.  The owner response very quickly. The indoor parking is very convinient. Only one issue, If owner can notify us in advance that there is constrcutuons on 3rd floor( same owner), that will be better.  There are too many dust in the air maybe because the constrcution,  it makes us a bit allergy.  Others are all good.
Incredibly communicative and helpful host with a lovely home a few minutes walk from a number of restaurants and the train. Easy to get anywhere else in the city.

For the price this is a amazing find she gave good instructions how to check in. They have a parking spot which is a plus. It was bigger than expected and she had everything you could need. Donna was very responsive I would stay again. Downtown was a 20/30 minute drive from here traffic will make it around 45 minutes.

Once you manage to climb the narrow and squeaky staircase, the apartment is really nice and comfortable. Dedicated parking spot alone is worth the climb :) Very comfortable king bed in the main bedroom and a cool rooftop view from the balcony.

Room is great for a few day stay, very clean, quiet and comfortable. Attached bathroom w/shower with all the essentials. You get access to amazing rooftop patio, which we enjoyed during our summer trip. Close to the Blue CTA line, about 7-10 min walk.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Chicago Stay!
We had a fantastic stay! The Airbnb had everything we needed—the hosts truly thought of all the details, and all the amenities were covered.
The location was excellent! We were close to the Blue Line, which made getting around Chicago easy, and there were plenty of great bars, restaurants, and entertainment nearby.
The space was comfortable, convenient, and well-equipped. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

Excellent location just a short walk to the Blue Line, making public transit super easy. The apartment was great, but the host made the stay extra special. She went above and beyond when our flight was rescheduled by being flexible with our dates. She was also super responsive and immediately replaced a broken hairdryer for us. Would definitely stay here again!
Emily was super communicative and helpful!
Great place to stay in uptown Chicago, red line station just across the street makes it very easy to get into the city. Would recommend to anyone wanting to stay in the Chicago area.

Darryl’s place is amazing. It’s even better than the pictures. The living area is more roomy & very comfortable seating. The bedrooms were great! We found everything we needed. I have stayed in a number of AirBNB’s and this is one of the best!!

It's a really good place for a solo traveler because of the price compared with the busy areas.
The room space is enough to stay and shared space is clean.
Clean room with bare essentials. Wasn't really a studio though. Friendly host!

No complaints about the place , Anna is super friendly and the place looked exactly like it did in the photos . Very responsive with any questions we had . Had an amazing stay, will definitely look for Anna in the future .

My stay was exactly what I needed. Everything was clean, bed was very comfortable and exactly as the pictures showed. Even staying there 2 nights, the bathrooms had been cleaned and shampoo and body wash refilled in the shower. Anastasia was very responsive and accommodating. I would definitely stay here again!
This is a great location, especially if you’re visiting all the museums. We felt safe walking around, and there are good restaurants within walking distance.
Saurin really made my girlfriend and I feel welcome and at home. He’s very nice and has a beautiful home! 10/10 would come back
Lots of extras, loved the added fans (didn’t need for a heat issue just love a good fan white noise at night and always forget one)

Great for the price! There are a few issues (loud neighbors, limited windows with none you can open, musty smell, no mattress cover and cheap bedding). Despite those issues it is well worth the price and will stay again!

Really great host. Very communicative constantly from very first part of checking in to checking out prior check-in. Post checkout cannot say enough great things about Adam. Thank you so much for having us at your place

A beautiful cul-de-sac near the Lake Michigan waterfront, just off Sheridan Road. Despite the proximity to a busy thoroughfare this is a quiet, walkable, safe neighborhood. Restaurants and public transportation are within easy walking distance.
My one-bedroom space on the top floor was neat, bright, and private. Photos in the listing are accurate and include both private & shared spaces. I don't use Airb&b very often so the concept of sharing a home is potentially awkward. Tammy made me feel very welcome, promptly answered my questions, and was the perfect host, combining respect for one's privacy yet available when needed. I can highly recommend the property, location, and host as Excellent!
We love to sit with nature, oudoors, and loved that there was a garden to view. I felt so at home. Loved her style! Would love to visit again!
Loved this cozy stay! Bus and train stations were nearby. Check in and out were seamless. Would stay here again.
很棒的住宿、我們在此度過快樂的假期

Nice, cozy spot for quick stays. However, this apartment is not in the South loop, more so Bridgeport, which is still pretty close to places. Only issue: I was a bit thrown off by the host, Jose', initial introduction, which was cold and off-putting.  After a friend helped me check-in, find the place/help with my many bags waited for me to use the restroom before we both were leaving back out, Jose asked me to step out of the bathroom to speak privately about the house rules, which were no one else was allowed in the space due to strict insurance policies. While I understood this,  I told him this was simply someone who wanted to make sure I was safely checked in before we both left back out—she was there for no more than 4 minutes.. Knowing the host was also staying in the airbnb during my stay, this being our first interaction made me feel a bit apprehensive.  It was not friendly, warm or welcoming. Otherwise, the spot is exactly as listed.
I liked the place a lot - once I figured out the street parking and how to get in and out of the building! Great value!

The location is central to several restaurants within walking distance. The unit was clean and had all the essentials. The parking was a must for us and it came in so handy. We needed some extra towels and the host was right on it.
I would definitely stay here again or any other properties that the host may have in the area.
Marzena is a very responsive host. Had no trouble locating the place or checking-in

I had a pleasant stay at Josh’s place. The location was excellent and it was easy to get places. The apartment was quiet and spacious. Everything was clean and it was fairly easy to figure out how to operate the appliances, tv and connect to the WiFi.  I would probably not stay again only due to the bed & pillows. The mattress was very firm and the pillows would go flat as a pancake as soon as I put my head on them.  I personally prefer a pillow soft mattress and fluffy pillows.  That’s just me though. I know a lot of people who like firm mattresses.
easy location from the city, big enough space and friendly hosts!
La chambre n’est pas si petite et très confortable. La description peut faire un peu peur, mais la réalité est meilleure. J’y reviendrai avec plaisir

I would only book this place at a discounted price. It’s a very basic place, furniture (sofa, bed, tv, mattress) is cheap or worn down. The highlight of the apartment is the kitchen. Is newly remodeled and very well equipped.  There was a problem with the WiFi on the first day (modem is in a different apartment so it took one day to fix it) but once that was fixed, WiFi wired just fine and fast.  Location is great.  The apartment itself was clean enough though the stairs leading up to the apartment and the hallway to the building could use some serious cleaning. Like I mentioned, I would stay here again but I wouldn’t pay a lot for it.

Soggiorno splendido, host reattiva e disponibile! Tutto come da descrizione e foto dell’annuncio. Comodissimo per la vicinanza alla stazione di Montrose che ci ha permesso di raggiungere downtown Chicago facilmente! Zona tranquilla e sicura.
Adelina’s apartment was wonderful! It was clean, well put together, and very comfortable. It was so close to the brown line which was great for quick travels into the loop.
Really nice place to walk around. And really friendly host.
Clean, comfortable, well stocked apartment. Host was very responsive to any questions or requests.

Amazing place to stay, Ebony and Ean are great hosts.
Very convenient location close to the university and the L system.
Amazing people, thank you so much!

The place is very clean, spacious and equipped very well with supplies. Street parking is easy to find and it is close to everywhere we wanted to visit. The management team is very responsive to our questions.
There is room for improvement for scheduled messages and check-in procedures. Additional identity verification and security deposit are required before check-in. The scheduled message is confusing due to mismatched unit numbers between assigned unit and pre-scheduled messages.
I would stay at this place again if I visit Chicago but expect clear communication before check in and don’t want to check-in in midnight in case additional support is needed.

Ev temizdi ancak birazcık ışık alma sorunu vardı gün içerisinde gezip gece kalacaksanız uygun bir yer olabilir penceresi havalandırmaya bakıyordu onun dışında fırın çalıştırdığımızda tavandaki alarm çalıştı bu bizi biraz korkuttu ancak ev sahibi problemi çözdü. It was such a delight having accommodations that gave us great views of the city.  The views are especially  amazing at night.  Loved the balcony. The location was quiet and peaceful. Stephaine was very detailed in her instructions, places nearby to eat and entertainment venues'. Our stay was enjoyable and memorable.
The description is very accurate, you'll find a comfy and very clean place to rest, i liked how close it is to a metro station. And for the price i would absolutely recommend this place.
We had a great stay!
Quiet clean place! No real complaints , thanks for the stay!!!
The apartment was remodeled nicely, clean, adequate kitchen, bathroom supplies, area quiet.  Communication with host responsive, concern addressed. I would rent again.

This was an amazing stay and WF was extremely helpful and responsive with all my questions. All rooms including beds were very clean and comfortable. I felt right at home! Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a peaceful, clean, spacious and quiet stay.
Stayed here for about 2 weeks. It was great. The minor issues I had were resolved quickly by Bella and her team.
Airbnb is way bigger in person, which as awesome. It was fun to spend a few nights in the area I used to hang around at often. A/c works really well which is a plus for Chicago summers.
