Ashley put a great deal of effort into creating a smooth process for her guests. from check-in to check-out the processes were documented in such great detail there was never any ambiguity and by the time I was following the steps to get into the property it felt like I had done it before. the room was immaculate to the point of incredulity on my part. I'm pretty sure it would have passed the white glove test above the door frame. I don't think I've ever looked at that kind if thing before but the room was so spotless as to provoke me.
I haven't really stayed at too many places like this so I don't have much for comparison but I really was so impressed by the care put into every detail and the effort it must have taken to make my stay care free.
I plan to go back sometime to experience some of the common areas I missed this time and will update this review accordingly.
this place is in a great area with tons to do and is an incredible value.
thank you ashley!

We had a great stay at Andy's place! The bedroom, bathroom & kitchen were well-stocked & spotless, the entry instructions were easy to understand, & he even had the place ready for us two hours before check-in since our flight got in so early. He communicated well throughout, even checking to make sure we had everything we needed. The place was quiet, the other guests were polite & kept to themselves to the point that we barely felt like we were sharing the place. Beautiful neighborhood & amazing value for the price. Thanks again!

We loved our stay! Our family of 4 was extremely happy here. Quiet location but walkable to great restaurants, easy uber/lyft to downtown. The beds were so comfortable, everything was super clean, kitchen was well equipped. We appreciated having laundry right in the unit and were always able to find a parking spot with some patience! Michael was responsive to any questions we had. Overall we loved it and would return!
Great spot and can’t the beat location!
Todo muy bien, conseguimos un precio accesible en Chicago y nuestra estancia fue cómoda, Anastacia siempre respondió muy amable y de forma rápida.

I would leave 6 stars if I could.
Listen, we've all had our troubles with AirBNBs, right? The bathroom is microscopic, or the air conditioning only works in the living room, or the 3rd bedroom is actually a closet.
Not this place.
Troy & Lynette's beautiful home in Chicago actually felt like I could have lived there.
The house was immaculately clean.
I asked for breakfast recommendations and they replied in about 10 seconds with places to eat that we loved.
It was a very short drive into the heart of Chicago.
They didn't miss a trick in this house. Right down to the tissue boxes in the bedrooms (Why is that so rare?)
Great place, we felt right at home, will certainly come back next time we’re in San Antonio. Location was optimal, lots of active throughout the day.

Pros:
- Very spacious
- Walkable to bus and train stops
- Good interior design
Cons:
- Older construction condo/apartment
- Bathroom felt very old, and would reek of sewage at night
- Lots of bugs

We had a great stay here! It’s in a very nice neighborhood, extremely walkable, lots of close by restaurants, coffee shops, grocery stores, and other amenities. The apartment itself is extremely clean and comfortable, not a huge living room, but comfortable enough for our 3 person party without ever feeling cramped. The main bedroom is large and has tons of closet space and a cute little sitting nook. The beds were comfortable and we got great nights’ sleep. Great hot shower with good pressure. The central ac was a lifesaver. We loved having laundry and dishwasher in unit. The check in/out instructions were super clear and helpful. The stairs from the lobby to the unit are a bit narrow and steep (and carpeted) so a little tough for luggage and a stroller, but doable. And there were nice neighbors who actually helped carry our suitcase upstairs when we checked in! The hosts were super nice and communicative. It was close to everything we needed, and I would absolutely stay here again!
very helpful and accommodating. stay was super pleasant and community was too. highly recommended!

Our stay was amazing. The place was very spacious and well kept. I would definitely recommend for a family. They had board games to play. They had plenty of dishes to cook and eat with. There is plenty of different spots to eat near by. The beds were comfy. My favorite part was the hot tub bath.
The parking is a bit tight but all of Chicago parking seemed to be. I am thankful they had a designated space to park.
It was okay I just was a lil bit uncomfortable with someone coming with the code without me knowing  last minute and the noise with the ac was a bit scary but it was 7.5/10 for me.
Chill spot, just as described, cheap and straight to the point
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was super responsive. Would definitely stay here again!

The place was lovely and beautiful. Felt like home away from home. The only issue I had was that there was no dedicated parking  and looking for a spot to park was an issue but I still give a 5star review of the place. It was squeaky clean and has lots of amenities from coffee, to kitchen spices etc. Thank you for hosting us, Troy.

Noe was a great host and very responsive, We had a very nice welcoming from Bella!
Parking was exceptional and the parking passes helped out a lot. Overall we had a great stay!
Nice, well priced, and easy stay. Communicative host :) would come back again

Had such a wonderful stay. I came to the place straight from the airport and the place felt so nice and peaceful. I felt right at home for a whole week here and its safe to call this my first home in Chicago after moving to the US. This house has everything one could ever need, just bring your clothes and you're all sorted for your stay here. House is in a great location, close enough to the downtown to reach in a few minutes, far enough to be away from the noise and close to residential suburb.
Anny is an incredible host, very responsive, friendly and helpful. Would absolutely love to stay here everytime and recommend to everyone.
Amazing location above great restaurants and easy to walk everywhere. Rida was a very responsive host. Would stay again
Matthew is a great host. He communicated proactively and clearly. The suite’s location is excellent; close to transit.
Comfortable stay, the place was so clean! Chris was a friendly, flexible host. The neighborhood is quiet and convenient. I'd definitely stay here again!
We really enjoyed this place and this part of West Town.  Tracee was a great host.

This was a perfect place for our weekend birthday getaway ! Our host was very responsive and open to accommodating! 10/10 would recommend, beautiful place and in a great ,safe , central location of Chicago!

Wr enjoy the atmosphere and the vibes the place gave off!  It was the home we needed for our stay! The only little note I would put on is the place run a little hot for us in the bedrooms,  even with the a/c unit being on in the living room. The air just never really travel to it. Other than that, we had no issues at any point with the place.

This stay was exactly what I needed, as I needed a place to stay while waiting for my apartment to be ready to move into. Wonderful was extremely responsive and the attached garage was a huge plus considering a had a fair amount of stuff to take in due to the longer stay. My only complaint is that the upstairs neighbors are excessively loud at all times, but particularly in the middle of the night. It sounds like they’re constantly moving furniture, but obviously that is out of the host’s control. Overall, I had a great stay!
Great overall experience and convenient location for us!

The condo was great, and overall we really enjoyed our stay. We have stayed in this complex several times while visiting Rush University, and we love this area because of how convenient it is.
I would rate our stay 5/5, with the exception of one issue we were not provided with a garage door opener. This was extremely inconvenient because each time we needed to park in the garage, someone had to get out of the car, enter the building, walk into the garage, and manually push the button to open the garage door.
The manager was very quick to respond to our messages, which we really appreciated. Unfortunately, we never received a garage door opener during our stay. Other than that inconvenience, the condo was great and we enjoyed our stay.

Absolutely lovely! Victoria and Prince were wonderful throughout our entire stay - the kind of hosts who clearly have a genuine sense of style and hospitality.
The home was beautifully decorated and spotless. VERY comfortable beds, although the second we sat down on the big, cozy couch, we almost fell asleep there. The fully equipped kitchen was a godsend, especially the coffee bar area which was a must for us coffee drinkers.
You can really tell they have put a lot of time and love into the property. Even the check-in instructions were crystal clear with step-by-step pictures.
We also loved how easy it was to get downtown by local transit which saved us all the stress of having to find parking in the city.
Our stay truly couldn’t have been more perfect and would absolutely stay here again. Thank you Victoria and Prince!!

I was visiting family in Beverly, which I do at least yearly but this was the best Airbnb I’ve tried recently. I could walk to my sons house easily. It was on a quiet tree lined street; parking was not in any way a hassle! The hosts are peaceful, friendly people. They were
very responsive and helpful. I can’t think of anything I couldn’t find in the unit. I hope to go again soon!
Matt’s place was absolutely perfect. The location and place was exactly what i was looking for for a getaway. Would stay again !

I appreciated that I was able to check in extra late because my Amtrak train was delayed. I let Erica know beforehand and it wasn't an issue. It was pretty easy to find and well lit when I arrived, so I felt good getting checked in after a long day. The place was pretty close to public transit, so very effective for my needs and I was able to get everywhere I wanted with relative ease. I would definitely stay here again on any future visits to the city.

Excellent location, close to everything + public transportation.
Train noise may bother light sleepers but was not an issue for us. Would book again
Great place, close to major points in the city.

Andres place was great! It was easy to find and there were several stores close by! We’re happy with our stay however there are a few details worth mentioning. We were notified AFTER booking our stay that they were going to be working on the back porch. The beds were a bit uncomfortable but the pillows were great ! Communication was great ! Overall 8/10😊😊

I enjoyed my stay at Kyriako’s place. It was clean and looked just like the pictures. It was perfect for my two day trip. There are local restaurants and shops near by. I’d definitely stay here again.

Great place to stay! The host was very responsive and accommodating. Check-in was flexible, the unit was spotless, and the neighborhood was quiet and peaceful. I had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend it!
Great location and comfy place! Pretty neighborhood and very walkable. Close to restaurants and not far from downtown.

Overall great location/neighborhood. The apartment was bare-bones. We did not have hot water the first night (this was a building issue-not just our unit). Patricia was responsive with any concerns we had.

Florin’s place was perfect for our group of 6. We felt right at home and the kitchen had everything we needed. We weren’t able to fit our car in the garage (grand wagoneer) but we were able to park directly in front of the townhouse with no problem. Florin was attentive and responsive and even accommodated an early check in, which was so great considering we landed in Chicago at 6 am. My family and I value cleanliness in all of our stays and this place exceeded our expectations. Overall, my family and I would stay here again!
decent place to stay, close to chinatown square! unfortunately bad wifi connection tho 😔
Great host. The Airbnb is in a great location
Really liked the home itself and the host! Only inconvenience is the location of the home though close to station, didn't always feel the safest. Beautiful home though once again!

The apartment is in a great location.  If you are considering this place you should know there are bars that are open until 4am and they are very loud in the bedroom with 2 king beds.  The room with one bed is significantly quieter - not sure if it is due to having a window unit AC that drowns out the noise or its location.  It was even hard to watch TV when the bars were open.  Our stay was a Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.  Unable to sleep Friday and Saturday in the double bedroom due to the music/bass.  Super quiet on Sunday and slept great.  It’s an apartment to stay in if you want to be in the middle of the action.  Easy check in and good communication.

Brendan was super helpful and friendly. He gave a lot of great recommendations of things to do. The place was great! Super peaceful, and wonderful to rest, and well connected to explore a lot of Chicago and suburbs.
Marissa was very responsive. The place was clean and free of clutter. The location was in a great neighborhood that was walkable and had several nearby restaurants.
We had a fantastic stay in Chicago and plan to return! The apartment is beautiful and the location is the best in Chicago!  Nicole and Matt were very helpful and made us feel at home.

very clean and nice bnb don’t have any complaints about the bnb itself just the neighborhood didn’t know it was “little village” nothing wrong with it my boyfriend and I jus happened to feel a little out of place and had to go to our area but other than that great host we would definitely stay again and enjoyed our time
Great stay,  and responsive host.

Exactamente igual a la descripción del anuncio, está cerca de la estación del tren por lo que es fácil llegar a cualquier parte de la ciudad, la casa estaba limpia y silenciosa, solo llegaba a bañarme y dormir pero era agradable y el baño y cocina limpios, las áreas comunes con un encanto diferente y en general descansaba bastante bien, Ryan en todo momento estuvo enviando mensajes con instrucciones útiles, definitivamente volvería a hospedarme ahí en una siguiente visita a Chicago
The was really well and the host was very active on instructions and if I needed anything responded
Great, and helpful front desk staff

Overall sufficient space located in Mag Mile. Very accessible to area via walking, public transportation and uber. Felt secure and quiet, with minor property cosmetic issues. Would stay again for overall convenience in Chicago
The weight limit on the furniture made the stay a bit uncomfortable. Overall house was very clean, spacious and close to the train.
Nice unit. Nice area with lots of local shops and cafes. Clean and spacious.
Beautiful, spacious place (we had a group of 7 and had tons of extra room). Host was responsive and accommodating when we had some difficulties getting inside. Highly recommend!

Very nice apartment. Checking in was easy and the stay was super comfortable. Some issues with the hot water in the building came up but it was out of the hosts control. Regardless the host was very helpful and informative about the situation. The bedroom and kitchen were very clean, however upon arrival the bathtub and bathroom sink had around a dozen small live bugs in them and one small live roach on the bathroom floor. The location was very nice as it was only a couple minutes of walking to a train station or the beach. I didn't use the kitchen a ton but it seemed nice. The bed was comfy and having the ac next to the bed was amazing. Tons of room in the closet as well, but I didn't have a need for it. I would definitely stay here again in the future.
Very clean comfortable unit and would definitely return again in the future.

The appartement is very comfortable and super clean. I enjoyed my stay there.
Keep in mind though that the train line is very close and you hear it a lot. I could also hear well the neighbours above which can be an issue.
Most enjoyable Airbnb I’ve stayed at, relaxing and laid back would come again.
We really enjoyed out stay
Great stay! Very comfortable, clean and welcoming.  I will definitely be coming back.

This was a perfect location for doing the Chicago triathlon. Walkable distance to Grant Park. Being on the eighth floor was nice and quiet so we could get a great night sleep before the race.  Our host communicated well and was very responsive and friendly.

We had such a great stay. 5 adults were able to comfortably stay with plenty of room to spread out. The house is very well appointed and actually felt like a real home. We would definitely stay here again!

The location of this Airbnb was excellent. You come downstairs and you’re suddenly in the heart of Bucktown right on Milwaukee, surrounded by coffee shops, amazing food, and nice vintage stores.
The listing stated the apartment was on the second floor, but ours was actually a fourth floor walk up, so be prepared for that just in case they put you on the upper floor.
The photos show a studio apartment with the kitchen and bed divided by a wall, but it was actually a single studio room with the bed and the kitchen together. We didn’t mind because they seemed to be about the same size. We assumed they had other apartments in the building with multiple layouts. The space is small but great for people that plan on being out and about all day and just looking for a place to sleep and get cleaned up for city adventures. The bathroom was nice and clean.
The host was very helpful and solved any issues we had during our stay. If you have any problems they are very friendly and accommodating.

Matthew’s place was a great experience during our time in Chicago! Luis and I stayed for just under a month and really enjoyed making the space feel like home. We loved the unique theme, amenities, and location, especially being within walking distance of great restaurants and the 606 Trail.
A few areas could use some improvement, particularly having access to the AC, cleaner floors, and better upkeep of the garden. We could also hear footsteps and children yelling from upstairs, which was sometimes disruptive. That said, Matthew and his team were responsive when issues came up. They promptly addressed a leak after a rainstorm and fixed the dryer during our stay.
Overall, we appreciated our stay and hospitality and hope this feedback is helpful in making the space even better for future guests!
Solid option if you’re visiting Chicago.
Lovely stay in a wonderful part of Chicago.
Me encanto muy atenta  muy bien atendidos. Hermoso el apartamento me sentí muy bien

At first, I was skeptical about the location since you have to walk down these stairs, and it's like a long pathway once at the bottom (a little scary at night), but honestly, I felt so secure every day/night I was there. It's in a little community; other people are walking by, a lot of places to eat nearby, etc. Was a little concerned about space, as a group of 3 girls, but this place was definitely doable. Never felt crowded or anything.  Overall, had no major issues while there. Anything I may have needed help with, all the co-hosts were more than helpful with! I would definitely come back.
Hermoso lugar muy privado y tranquilo, volveré en cuanto me sea posible
Lovely home and perfect for our family! Beds are super comfortable. Kitchen well equipped. A good stay!
Our stay here was lovely! Our host was super responsive and helpful. The place itself was perfect, it had plenty of space for our party of 5. I would definitely stay here again next time I’m in town!
loved my stay here would come back

The location is walkable after the show at Soldier Field we actually walked back to the Airbnb (13 min walk).
However, the place could’ve been cleaned better, shower is small and lobby reeked of dried urine and a foul odor ALL WEEKEND! The building is severely outdated and has old furniture, boxes and spider webs in the lobby. No a/c in the lobby. First impression matters and looking at the lobby I would’ve turned around. Doesn’t appear sanitary especially with the smell.
The actual apartment is a 7/10, shower small, carpet needs cleaned, decor isn’t great, beds slept nice and it’s a bit smaller than the pictures lead. Small Appliances weren’t clean (toasted/coffee maker)
Host was responsive. The kitchen was stocked with plates, cups and cutlery. One of my guests left something of value and the host was extremely responsive. It’s an ok deal but the price we paid seemed wayyyyyy overcharged.
Nice comfortable spot, clean, main bedroom would get hot at night and WiFi didn’t work that great. Safe location
We had a great stay at this air BNB!!! Felt very safe and was nice and cool since it was basement unit. Right next to ICO campus for those visiting students that stay there :)

The AirBnb was really nice! Very clean and fit the aesthetic I was looking for! A few things that would’ve been a deal breaker before booking, parking! Parking was so frustrating! On certain days they have street cleaning and you are not allowed to park between 9am- 2pm, so waking up early to move my car and having to walk 10- 20 mins back was not in my first visit to Chicago bucket list. Other than that it was quiet and comfy. I wouldn’t mind booking a different AirBnb by the host again they gave us great recommendations in the area to try. Great hospitality!

Sacamos habitación con baño privado y nos sentimos muy cómodos, la habitación es amplia, el colchón cómodo. Estaba limpio. No hubo ruidos por parte de los demás huéspedes, pero la habitación da a la calle, así que si alguien tiene problemas de sueño, quizás le cueste dormir porque pasan muchos autos, no fue nuestro caso.
La temperatura del aire acondicionado es igual en todas las habitaciones y ahí es difícil coincidir con los demás, asi que pedí una frazada más y muy rápido me contestó para decirme de dónde podíamos sacar. El metro esta super cerca! Sin duda volveriamos. Gracias por todo

We had a great stay at Bradford’s  place.  He was very responsive and accommodating. The location was great. The decor was chic and pleasing but also homey with comfortable furnishings. Great kitchen with everything you’d need. The shower head was wonderful, best showers I’ve ever had! It was great that he had some staples and toiletries available since we were flying. We would highly recommend Bradford’s place.

Had a triathlon over our stay. So convenient for the race, food, millennium park, the L, etc. Recommend sound machine if you have kids napping during the day, as the L of course is noisy. Wonderful stay. Location can’t be beat
Nice place and host

Our stay was a family trip and we had a blast.  Everything from check in to check out was great.  Host was very responsive and kind.  Only concern would be if you had a large SUV, parking would be difficult.  I would stay here again.
Super cute decorations!
Superbe expérience chez Kristin et d’une extrême gentillesse

The host was responsive and the place was clean. The only issue we had was that the apartment was in the basement and it wasn’t mentioned in the listing. This means thin ceilings with loud upstairs neighbors (could clearly hear every time they flushed their toilet) and a slight sewage smell. But host provides earplugs! The stairs down from the front entrance were narrow and would be tricky with large luggage. Place is fine if just looking for a quick place to rest!

Great location, easy to find, very clean, and the host was responsive! I loved my stay here, my one and only complaint would just be the noise. The walls are thin, so I could hear everything from next door and outside. This didn’t really bother me, but I could see it being a problem for light sleepers.
Nice place with a super responsive host.
Great stay! Was perfect for a weekend in Chicago with a couple of friends. Close to Wrigley and downtown. We loved each having a king bed!!!
Estuvo genial, me sentí bien, muy tranquilo, la única recomendación necesita ventiladores un poco más grandes, ya que en tiempo de verano hace bastante calor

I’ve spent 4 days in Chicago at Danielle’s place ! The location is really practical as it’s few steps away from the Metro and 20 minutes from the Loop ! This inside is really clean, well decorated and a lovely Bunny to meet.
The only default is according to me the sunlight crossing the bedroom early in the morning ..
Thank you Danielle for hosting me
Great location near our daughter.  Having a parking spot is super!
Great location, beautiful home and great host. Very nice neighborhood and the house was spacious.
A great location near a lot of great bars and restaurants! Would definitely stay again

This home was absolutely lovely & so comfy with lots greenery in the neighborhood.
Since the beginning through the end, Tom was such a friendly & attentive host! He gave lots of great local recommendation & made the overall stay so welcoming!
Good and reliable place to stay very quite area.only down thing is no Tvs in either Room but overall Good place to stay.

Love this place, which right near everything, and super walkable, a hot dog spot and a pizza spot that was open late around around the corner, as well as a Walgreens and another 7-Eleven that was open up late.
Down the street from millennium Park. Looking forward to coming back and staying there again. 💯❤️
Great experience. Place was very quiet. Only small complaint was that the terrace wasn't open when we were there. But otherwise would wonderful. Would come back or recommend to a friend.

I had no problems getting into the BnB and it is in a great location. Everything was super clean and instructions for getting in were easy to follow. Not to mention the host is hilarious, I loved his anecdotes about smoking inside of the apartment. A great place to stay
Great stay great area! Will definitely be back!!

Muchas gracias por la
Estadía! Mi familia y yo estamos felices

The garden apt is spotless and Logan Square is one of my favorite areas of Chicago.
Maria was very friendly and attentive. The apartment offers great amenities - snacks and basic toiletries which was helpful.
Sound from the adjacent apartment does come through quite a bit, but wasn’t a problem for me. The neighbors weren’t particularly loud or making a lot of noise late at night during my stay.
Would definitely stay again!
Nice place! In a great location
The place was easy to find and was very clean! The hosts were communicative and friendly. It’s easy to walk to the L from the home. I would recommend this place if you’re visiting Chicago!
Great location to walk around to shop and eat, wish the rooms had microwaves because when I asked for one they said they were all still in use from the previous night.
Great Location! Walking distance to a lot of great restaurants and bars. Super helpful instructions to get in. Host responded fast to questions and needs.

It was a great place to stay! Host was helpful with check-in instructions. It was a short drive to downtown and had several good breakfast/lunch places that were only a few minutes away. It was also about 45 minutes from the airport. It was a great place to say while exploring Chicago!

Molly is an excellent host, who immediately had me feeling at home. The room was spacious, clean, and had a marvelous balcony for relaxing, eating, and doing morning exercise. Her son, the doggies, and kitty were nice company also.
Be careful when you stay here because Molly may bake something delicious.
The neighborhood was relaxing, and a wonderful place to walk.
I would not hesitate staying with Molly, and the crew in the future.
The room and bathroom were very comfortable and clean, and the hosts were very nice.
Todo ok

Chanita was very responsive. Described place as listed. Very clean.  Night time was a bit noisy but to be expected staying in Chicago. For my next trip to Chicago, I would definitely stay again. Planning again in October and maybe in the winter to visit my daughter at the art institute!! Will reach back out to check on availability. Thanks for a great stay for our first time in Chicago with our family!

I had a great stay at Tory’s home. I needed somewhere to lay my head at night after 2 eventful days of exploring Chicago and her place did exactly just that! Everything was clean, Tory was very responsive had I had any questions and I was given the privacy and space that I needed. Definitely would stay again!

We had such a great stay at this Airbnb!! The hosts, Long and May, are the sweetest. They checked in on us, gave us recommendations, and chatted with us in the mornings before we’d head out. The neighborhood is so cute, and we felt very safe there as two young women. It’s only a 10 minute walk from the orange line, and from there you can get pretty much anywhere! We felt safe walking to the train station during daylight, but took a Lyft back after sundown just to be on the safer side! The room is exactly as pictured, perfect for the price. The bathroom is shared with 2 other rooms but we never had an issue with waiting to use it! Overall, the perfect budget stay in Chicago, we would definitely come back!!

We had a fantastic stay! The Airbnb was clean, (looks exactly like the pictures) comfortable beds, welcoming, smelled great, and in a great location. However, move in day was this weekend for the dorms so the elevator took some time but overall we truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again! Thanks!

Downtown location and proximity to the CTA station made for a very convenient stay to explore the museum campus. Plenty of stuff to do and places to eat nearby, right in the center of the action! The building and neighborhood are a little unassuming but hosts Zhenhui and Ping are very welcoming, responsive, and have clearly made the best of the space with which to host others. The trains are a bit loud but it’s a tradeoff for being so close to the station and therefore basically the rest of Chicago!
We had an amazing time. We were in walking distance of everything.  Cyndi was great. We will definitely be back next year.

Firstly, the room is located in a very accessible and walkable part of Chi, Bucktown, which was great. Close to Margie’s Candies, Brasil Legal Cafe, etc.
Also the hosts are friendly and helpful, which I appreciated.
The space however felt VERY claustrophobic, with virtually no ventilation, other than the constant noisy AC. The bathroom really needs a deep cleaning and the whole casa has this orange air freshener odor, to cover up odors. It’s a good place to stay if you’re just sleeping there for the night, but I wouldn’t recommend if you’d like some quiet time in the space.

Great stay overall! The home was exactly as pictured, clean, in a quiet and safe area, and close to downtown. Parking was easy, and communication before arrival was great. I did mention that the couch was worn/torn and some closet racks were broken. These issues didn't affect our stay, but an acknowledgment would have been appreciated just so we knew that he was aware it was like that before we got there We'd stay again. Thank you for hosting us!
Love the location! Next to Chinatown and walking distance to a lot of places. Would stay again when visiting  Chicago!
Amazing Stay

The inside of the place was nice. However, it was not mentioned that this home is located behind the main apartment buildings and next to an abandoned building. I would not stay here due to safety reasons.

Great location and really cute house! Host is very responsive. Easy street parking and close to public transit. Furniture and set up is super comfy and nice, beds are a little on the firm side if you like a soft bed.
Nicole and Matt's place is at a good location.  It is in the old town but very quiet.  The hosts are very kind.  It is a good place for a family vocation.
Great find in a great neighborhood! We’ll DEFINITELY be back!!
A very beautiful one of a kinda place. My daughter loved the shower. I enjoyed the space and location. It felt very private and homey.
Good
Great time with the family!!!
Clean place in a very nice neighborhood. Walk to the blue line wasn’t too long either.

Great place in great location. Easy to get around. Only issue was with the toilet not flushing. We contacted the host and they sent someone over quickly but seems it was just the water was turned off. They turned the water on and it flushed but unfortunately it ran constantly so we had to keep turning it off and on. Other than that, it was a great stay.

Marissa was a great host. She’s very helpful with getting you set up. The place was great. The location was ideal and walking distance to a lot of sights and the train to the airport. 10/10 would recommend to anyone

First of all i want to thank Patricia for communicating really good with me.
This place is in a really nice location. Cant beat it! Its so eays to check in.
This building got also a nie vibe and very luxurious.
Let me tell you! Its a huge 2 bedroom with balcony. Plenty of towels and sheets, toiletries, washer and dryer, everything that you need is here.
I hope to come back again here soon.

Great stay in the Rogers Park neighborhood. Plenty of cool art murals right outside the door if you are out on a scenic walk. Super close to Loyola, but even better is a prime location to the waterfront. Neighborhood feels safe and during these summer nights we spent, you often saw many people )even women with children) out walking, running or riding, even with headphones in during the late night which provided reassurance about the safety of the neighborhood. We enjoyed our stay. The remodeled kitchen is a nice layout and design. We appreciated the supplied playpen for the baby also. Nice hot showers and a FREE parking that can hold even 2 SUVs right behind the unit was Amazing.
Great place great location had an amazing time there
An amazing place to stay! I stayed here for a solo trip and felt safe at all times. Michael is such a great host! Made my solo birthday trip one to remember. I highly recommend this airbnb!

As others have said, this is truly the nicest Airbnb I have ever experienced. The apartment is spacious and bright, and tastefully decorated with both high-end and vintage pieces. So many neat finds around every corner. The apartment is also very thoughtfully equipped with everything you may need for a comfortable stay, from coffee pods, to dryer sheets, to a-tips! The neighborhood is fabulous and walkable and street parking easy. Isaac is a warm and friendly host (with a super cute puppy) who has truly thought of every detail and created a magical and memorable Airbnb experience!
Der Aufenthalt in Davids Apartment war super. Wir haben uns wohl gefühlt und die Kommunikation war super schnell und das Apartment sauber.
Great place and very helpful host
Excelente lugar, fácil acceso, recomendable
Amazing stay! The home was just as described, filled with great custom art, and our host Elisabeth was extremely communicative, attentive, and offered great suggestions on things to do in the area!
I enjoyed my stay with Kasa. Great location with walkable restaurants and other things to do. I also loved the scenery. Will definitely be back.
Wonderful spot. Great location, nice little patio and attentive hosts! Thanks for letting us stay in your home.

Convenient location for our needs, visiting family in the area. Many places to eat, close to supermarket. Close to public transportation but neighborhood is quiet and peaceful. Kitchen was very well equipped.

We had a wonderful stay at this delightful property!  Shaun is a great host. We had no problems whatsoever and everything was sparkling clean and just as advertised. We hope to snag this one again for our next visit to Chicago!
Highly recommend!!

Great place to stay. Exactly as pictured. Building was beautiful, neighbors were friendly, beds were comfortable and showers were great. Host was very responsive. Can't wait to stay again for future travels to Chicago.

Very responsive hosts. Great location. Comfortable beds. Clean, though carpets are a bit stained. Getting in and out is a little depressing—you take the service elevator which is dirty and there was trash piled up in the elevator entry area throughout our visit.
Hallways in the building have stained carpets. The “penthouse” consists of about 5 apartments off a pretty beat up hallway. The space itself is cut but has very small rooms. The lovely living room photo shows the full living room area. The washer/dryer is in the living area—but it was handy. The public outdoor space is nice and we watched free fireworks from there on a couple nights. I probably wouldn’t stay here again but it was perfectly fine. Expect practical and not high end and you won’t be disappointed.

This was our second time staying at one of Caleb's properties. We had a great stay and will surely be back. We love Andersonville and this home is 1/2 block to the shops and restaurants. We also enjoyed the easy access to the lake and the train. Caleb was easy to communicate with and accommodating. Overall we had an excellent stay. Thanks Caleb!
Great place to stay in Chicago with a larger group! Hosts were very responsive and helped with any questions I had. House was clean, spacious and the neighborhood was quiet.

The place was exactly as it appeared in the listing. The back patio was awesome. And you only have to walk one block until you're in the action. Lots of restaurants and bars, etc. Plus Dawn was a great host and super helpful!

Just an amazing stay for our first trip to Chicago. Cathy’s accommodations exceeded the already great expectations of this Airbnb. She was responsive, attentive to our asks, and made Chicago feel like home to us over the long weekend. 10/10, would stay again!
It was a nice, comfortable place in a good part of the city. You could hear the crickets at night, and a breeze in the morning. Very peaceful.
Très bon hôte réactif et flexible !

We enjoyed staying at Isabel's place. It was a bright, spacious, and sparkling clean apartment in a quiet neighborhood. Parking was easy on the street on weekend and within a couple minutes walk to the Blue line. Isabel was very responsive. She was flexible and allowed us to drop off our luggage before check-in. Highly recommend.
Will stay here again, in the future.  Loved the neighborhood!  John & Griffin were great hosts.

First time visiting Chicago & I loved it. The bnb was located perfectly to navigate to the riverwalk , downtown Chicago, millennium park & etc. Absolutely stunning views from inside the bnb. Parking was quite easy to find & greatly located. The house was clean & neat upon arrival. Highly recommend booking with Jorge !
Great place. Conveniently located with pleasant walks all around. A couple breweries round the corner doesn’t hurt, either.
Good location. Just checked in often and responded quickly.
It is a nice spot, beach not too far away and a few local places it eat. Not a far Uber or train from center of the city, about an hour.
Great location to variety of restaurants & walkable neighborhood. Nice perk to get parking passes for our stay
This apartment was lovely! Had more than enough space for our group of 3, and had everything we needed for a long weekend stay. Would definitely book again!

This place is a good stay. Is located on a city street and around a few club areas. It is great value for what it is and very comfortable. The host sends all communication via cellphone number, but the instructions and information a very helpful. My recommendation is to take 10 mins to stop and read everything on their website, and it will all make more sense. We really appreciate the lock security and private room.

Karen was very helpful and responsive. Depending on who lives here at the time it can be a good experience. I personally had someone take some of my food so it wasn’t the best because of that. It’s a clean space. I did notice a lot of knats from time to time but otherwise it was okay. It’s convenient to be near a grocery store.
Great clean place to stay, with the pink line a five minute walk away we were able to go into the city everyday no problem.

I had a great stay at Shaun’s place! The house was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Shaun was a fantastic host—super responsive, friendly, and easy to communicate with throughout our entire stay. Check-in was smooth, and everything matched the listing description perfectly. Highly recommended, and we would definitely stay here again!

Rob's place was great place for us 2 families to stay at. We booked it for our daughters wedding.  It is very very spacious just like the reviews are saying, even more than the pictures show.  When u walk in u realize that right away more important than that its very clean with modern furnishings. We had other family staying at other places, but we used this as the main base, hosted few dinners and it was great for us because of this properties layout over 2 floors. The main floor u have 2 huge areas to sit eat & enjoy the living room and kitchen combined with 2 decks right outside off the main floor for sitting outside a great layout, and the ground floor is where all the 3 bedrooms are is also very spacious with bonus den tv movie room, and Rob is a responsive host...

Great property in a better location! If you love authentic Mexican/Hispanic food you’re literally 3 blocks away from great food and culture! Definitely will pick this location for future Chicago trips. Thanks again Jasmine! : )

We had a great time in Chicago! I traveled with my elderly parents and my grown kids (one's in college, the other's working). We all enjoyed the stay a lot.Dave is the best host - always so responsive, friendly, patient, and ready to offer help. He also feels like a very warm person and tries to make us feel at home while staying at his place. The place is so clean and has everything you'd need away from home! Convenient location - Morgan station is right downstairs, with lots of restaurants in the neighborhood. So safe and lively. Definitely will book again with him!
We loved our stay! The place was perfect for our family of 5, and there were a lot of nice touches to make things extra comfortable: sound machines, fans, coffee. We will certainlycome back!

This space was great. Walking distance to the grocery and a restaurant or two. The beds were comfortable and the apartment was very clean. Perfect for a group trip! Naomi was responsive and gave great directions and suggestions. The patio was nice to relax on and have a cup of coffee. The laundry was a nice amenity to wash before returning home. We will book again. Thank you.
great location and loved the unit, would definitely return!
Todo muy bien y buena ubicación para llegar al centro de Chicago, recomendado.
The space is lovely, spacious, and very well-located. Colleen and William are excellent hosts. It was a very peaceful stay.
We enjoyed our stay with Janelle! I would highly recommend her!
Clean and spacious. Really good neighborhood. And Mira was really helpful with any questions we had
Great stay super spacious perfect location

VERY clean bathroom and room. Extremely comfy pillows and comfortable bed as well. Super easy check in. I loved the early bag drop off option. Several walkable places to eat and grab a drink…or two. Outdoor sitting area is gorgeous! Kitchen is stocked and has multiple breakfast options that are free from 6am-10am, which is such a kind and thoughtful offering! I 100/10 recommend this stay. You will not be disappointed! I’m definitely will rebook the next time I’m in Chicago. Thank you for such an amazing stay!
Good place
Our second stay here. We love it and we will be back again!
찰스는 아주 친절합니다~ 숙소도 아늑하고 좋습니다~
Cozy place in a great location!

The house was perfect for my guests and I. It was in a nice quiet neighborhood, very spacious. The pics online do not do it justice. If you book and need an uber or lyft,  note there will be two locations that pop up with the same address, make sure you choose the one closet to the lake. That was the only issue that we had. Other than the uber fiascos...yes plural, everything was perfect!! I will definitely rebook!

Such a beautiful home! Looks bigger in person, photos do not make this home justice. Very centrical to everything, we came with no car so I was grateful grocery stores and a load of restaurants were walking distance and open till late! I do want to say that we are literally under a train that passes through so if you get bothered with noises I would keep it in mind, other then that I would 1000% stay again!
Great location, and really nice place.

This place was perfect for what we needed! We were central to everything we wanted to see and if you enjoy walking, we could walk anywhere within 30 mins and we loved walking through the city! Check in was easy! My only issue was the walls were very thin and the unit above us, we could hear yelling and conversations very clearly. Especially in the front bedroom. One night it went until 3:30am. But didn't hear it every night. Other than that it was a great place for the price for three people and would recommend if potential noise isn't an issues!

Great location for the beach and proximity to the Red Line. Priced well. Older building Elevator was stuck  briefly while I was there, and the unit is on the 5th floor. Luckily I never had to walk up, only down. Easy budget friendly quick stay.

Steve's place was great and had all the amenities you would want for a weekend stay in the city. It was also walkable to lots of great coffee shops and restaurants. It's a great neighborhood. Steve was responsive and friendly.

This is a cute, quaint space tucked away in a fairly safe neighborhood. There is street parking right out front. It can be a little easy to miss at first and then it becomes easier. I enjoyed my stay.
We had a good stay! The host was very responsive and easy to communicate with, which we really appreciated.

Great little find and good value. If you’re looking for a more hotel experience, this doesn’t quite fit. It feels more like staying in a friend’s basement but it worked great for us. Comfortable bed, clean towels, warm shower, easy access and awesome location. The neighborhood is very peaceful, residential and eclectic but easy to drive to or walk half a block to the Halsted bus and get to any train in minutes. I 10/10 recommend for anyone on a budget. The only fresh water source is from the bathroom sink which seemed ok for boiling water and making coffee but we opted to buy drinking water at the grocery store. A minor inconvenience but something to consider. The dog also barked a lot when we arrived and left but completely stops once we got into the room. The blinds also don’t block the morning light so recommend an eye mask. Also there was a bit of a musty smell in the entrance hallway but it disappears in the room and I’m very sensitive to smell and found it to be completely fine.

It provided a place to sleep and get around. We were busy and all over Chicago. Close to train and Ubers always close by. Owner was transparent about noise. We did hear some noise from the apt above us but it’s an apartment and to be expected. Over all the time we were there it was not an issue. We did not use the kitchen just the bathroom and bed and it worked fine for our visit to Chicago.
Great condo located exactly where’d you’d want to be in Lincoln Park. We loved our stay.
Kimberly's place was very cozy. The bed, linens, and pillows were super comfortable. Kim was very friendly and welcoming. Great stay!

My stay with Jeff was great! Everything was as described and as the pictures showed. It was 100% private. Safety was never a concern of mine. Jeff was very communicative and nice from start to finish. He was even able to accommodate an earlier check in for me which I really appreciated!! Overall a great experience, would stay here again!
This was a really nice last minute find.   Would definitely book again.  Very roomy and spacious and great location.  Clean and the host is very engaging and helpful.
The host was very accommodating, the place itself was amazing and looked just as described. The area was also a quiet neighborhood. Would definitely recommend to others!

While the place matched the description, the bathroom was old and had significant wear and tear. Upon arrival, the intercom code did not work. Host was notified but took almost an hour to respond back. Door to the main building did not work on numerous occasions. The residents at the building had to help us get inside. The appliances were old and took longer than normal to cook. Parking was a hassle with limited street parking availability. Overall, would only recommend if you need to be around the Hyde Park area.

Cyan’s place was exactly like the pictures. The neighborhood was quiet and felt safe enough to walk to dinner after dark. It’s about 35mins from O’hare and 15/20mins from downtown near Chicago Theater depending on traffic. Cyan’s communication was top notch . I would definitely recommend her place to family & friends!

What a charming and beautiful home away from home. The  space is private, inviting and thoughtfully appointed. Jennifer is a gracious host, both friendly and respects privacy. Fresh eggs from the chickens was a very welcome surprise. And she was so also so welcoming to our dog! I highly recommend this apartment when traveling to the Chicago area!
Lovely place, great location!

Scott’s place was a perfect base for my weekend in Chicago. Close to the Blue Line to get downtown, two grocery stores and a Chick-fil-a nearby for food.
The space was clean and spacious and in perfect condition
Incredible location with plenty of bedroom space, and a large beautiful living area to share meals and quality time with friends and family.
Lauren was very responsive and easy to work with. Location was great and in  a nice and safe area.

I will start by saying the space they give you for a review here isn't enough space to describe how amazing Tim's place is. This was my second stay at this Airbnb and I plan on being a regular here. First off, the neighborhood is one of the most beautiful urban neighborhoods I've ever seen. It is very walkable day and night. I walked back from the Wrigleyville area (20 minutes) several nights well after dark and never felt uneasy. There are so many bars and restaurants just a short walk away, not to mention the Red Line is a 10 minute walk. The space is clean, well kept and provides everything you need for a stay. Tim is a great host. Both my visits he accommodated my request to drop off my luggage before my check-in time. He was very proactive and gave clear instructions on entering the house. This is a true gem and one of my favorite places to stay anywhere!

I enjoyed staying here a week in Chicago for my birthday. I appreciate Ewa for letting me stay. She was very welcoming and comforting. The mattress in the bedroom is honestly my favorite thing throughout the whole unit! Whenever I come back, I wouldn’t mind staying with Bruno and Ewa !😊

lovely location, clean efficient apartment, good communication. Historic building, across street from museum. Good transit up to the Loop. Bed is comfortable. Only 2 challenges:  1) A/C is definitely a problem: very noisy and only cools the living room, not the bedroom. 2) they won't store your bag before/after checkin, and the nearest bag drop is at least 1/2 mile away (a long walk, dragging a suitcase).

We had such a lovely stay this past weekend. Andersonville is beautiful and nearby! Super walkable and a great stay away from the busyness of the city.
Both hosts were super friendly, accommodating, and understanding. We would absolutely stay here again!
Definitely will book again!!
Place was great! Very cozy. AMAZING restaurants within walking distance. Pizz'Amici was probably one of the best pizzas I have ever had.
Great Place to stay!!
The Hotel Staff were extremely helpful and accommodating as I dealt with unexpected car trouble. Thanks to them for all the support and generous conduct!
Great hosts!  Great location!
Nicholas was highly communicative and quick to respond.

The house is very well designed and constructed. From structure to the facade and the interior materials used, very well done. Built with durability. The master bathroom is extraordinary.
The house is wired with high-tech, a bit overwhelming to figure out.
We appreciated the automatic shades.
The theatre room was great and very enjoyable.
Upon entry the house was very clean (much appreciated). Clean towels provided.
The beds were very comfortable.
We enjoyed the balconies, and the view to Chicago. Nights were lovely, we were fortunate to have great weather the entire stay.
Street parking was fine, most times spots were open right out front.
Neighborhood is nice.
Property manager checked in a few times and was very responsive to us.
The only downside is the walk up, lots of stairs.
Amazing suite , and very clean. Ed was extremely helpful the whole trip.

The place was as it looked in the pictures with the views and all. But I must say the water pressure can be better. I really do think the room needs a tv and more lights to make it more comfortable. The windows was bolted shut which it did get pretty stuffy in there so that was a down side. The room was also hot buttttt to be fair I’d do it again just better prepared.

Perfect Airbnb with 2 bedrooms and 2 full baths, Keurig w/coffee, on a pretty Lincoln Park street, a very easy walk to DePaul’s campus. This is our second stay here while visiting our daughter, and would love to stay here again!
Great stay overall! I enjoyed the balcony view and kitchen. Green line is an 8 min walk that can take you downtown Chicago so that was a huge plus.
Disfrutamos mucho la estancia, mis hijas estaban felices!! 100% recomendado

My stay at Jorge’s Airbnb apartment was
wonderful from start to finish. The apartment itself was spotless and thoughtfully put together, making it feel like a true home away from home. The location couldn’t have been better — I was able to walk through Hyde Park and stroll along Lake Michigan, catching both sunrise and sunset along the way. Jorge’s check-in instructions and the accompanying YouTube video made accessing the apartment effortless. I’ll definitely be booking this location again on my next visit.

This place is just off of Clark but the building was quiet and the newer windows kept out any street noise, which was less than I expected. Handy to so many great places throughout Lincoln Park and having a dedicated parking space is really nice in that parking constrained neighborhood.
We cooked a few meals there and the kitchen was modern and well stocked.
Would stay here again.

This is a beautiful, comfortable, and clean home with a nice deck and landscaping. It was a great place to stay for exploring Chicago, and it's very close to the western end of the 606/Bloomingdale trail, a great place to walk, run, or bike. I would definitely stay here again!
We had an awesome time at Matt’s place. Great neighborhood. Close to the train. Super responsive host and an easy check in. Will definitely be back!
This Airbnb was so beautiful . It perfectly matched the pictures with a great view! It was very spacious for my amount of guest . Will def book again!
Ich war äußerst zufrieden mit der Unterkunft bei Tim in Chicago

Brad was an awesome host!!! I told him why I was in town, and he was kind enough to recommend several things to do in the area. The Airbnb is in a great location, within easy walking distance of Trader Joe’s and Whole Foods. It’s also about a 25–30 minute walk from the Obama Presidential Center. Brad was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Great spot. Not too far from the beach. Cozy space.
Great historical place. Will definitely come back next time I travel to Chicago
A beautiful unit in a terrific location. Good hang-out space, cozy bedrooms, hotel-level clean bathroom and kitchen.  Very easy access to transportation to explore Chicago. I recommend very highly!
This place is in a great location. It’s a little outdated but was set up comfortably. We did not have hot water for the first 24 hours but the host was very responsive and it did get fixed.
This is a great place for couples or a single person to stay. It’s got a beautiful view, very walkable to many great spots, amazing in many ways.

Such a great stay! The place was charming, clean, had everything we needed, and the location was great and convenient.
Jackson was very hospitable!. He was super responsive, kind, and patient with all my questions and back-and-forth. He went out of his way to help, even suggesting solutions when I was navigating an early check-in. Polite and friendly from the start. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again!
Such a lovely apartment in a beautiful neighborhood!
Communicative and apartment was clean and nice!
Sharon was awesome and the place was great. Good location and very nicely appointed. No problems getting in and parking was a breeze. I would choose this place again when I come back to Chicago
Beautiful space near my favorite places in the city!  Angelo’s and Templestowe!
Great stay!

Excellent stay! This home is spacious and laid out perfectly for a larger family or group of friends. Clean, clean, clean and stocked with everything you need. Parking was a breeze! We will seek out this home when we return to Chicago!

Johanna and Erick were incredible hosts! Communication was fast, warm, and genuinely caring, and they were flexible with both check-in and check-out, which made traveling with our family so much easier.
The house itself was gorgeous and spotless, with beautiful decor throughout. It was incredibly well-stocked, from a fully equipped kitchen to thoughtful extras for anything you might have forgotten. The library had interesting books and games, perfect for family time together, and they included helpful info about the city along with great recommendations.
When packing up our family for a trip to Italy ran long on our last morning, Johanna generously worked with us on a late check-out. On top of all that, the prepared individual beach bags were such a genius, thoughtful touch that made a huge difference for our beach outing! This was hospitality at its best: attentive, kind, and flexible when it counted. We'd stay again in a heartbeat and recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago.
Spacious basement apartment. Mobile AC was sufficient for our needs. Great location. Peaceful neighborhood.

Regina was an excellent host with proactive communication and genuine offers to assist/make my stay better.
Area is the star, with solid walkability to multiple interesting neighborhoods.
Building is a classic Chicago apartment complex, and unit was largely as described. As an older apartment, expect some wear and tear. If I were to focus on one major need, it would be a new mattress in the bedroom (completely scooped/deformed) and better quality bedding (sheets, pillows, duvet, etc.).

Me and my friend stayed with jen for 4 night and couldn’t have been more comfortable! The loop is only a train ride away and there was lots of nice restaurants and sights to see close by the accommodation too! Plus some very cute cats that will always say hello! I would easily stay here again!

Overall our stay was great. Love the neighborhood.  It was very quiet and peaceful. The house was clean and comfortable. 2 things that weren't so great. There were 2 small dogs that were a bit disturbing at times with barking and howling early in the morning. On the morning of checkout, there was no hot water preventing us from being able to shower.

It was a very nice and peaceful stay for us. The stay is comfortable and there is a lot of parking available. The host was very responsive and made sure that we reached safely. Would recommend it to everyone.
Place was great for a quick weekend stop in Chicago. Host was quick to respond, helpful and reached out proactively letting me know i could check out a bit later which was great.
Everything was perfect

This was an amazing Air BNB! It fit my family perfectly!! The master bedroom is beautiful!! The garage is spacious and fit both of our Full size SUVs ! The kids really enjoyed the activities in the basement, and my mom was over joyed at the special touch of the pac man game!
The neighborhood was safe, my sisters even walked to the store without any issues. The neighbors were really nice and welcoming as well. Everyone’s front lawn was well kept.
I would for sure book again!!
Kyriako listings has never missed for my family and I.  We usually search for Kyriako’s listings due to their well kept listings and appropriate pricing.

The stay here was overall pleasant. Neighborhood is definitely walkable and had food options close! Only thing to note is the nearest train (The Metra) only comes about once per hour which was a bit annoying but of course had nothing to do with the host! Cleanliness could have been a bit better (some hair around and the throw rugs in the bedrooms were old/worn and in desperate need of a good cleaning/replacement.

It’s a beautiful house with convenient and modern amenities.  The beds are super comfortable!  The furnishings of the house are very sensible and worked perfectly for our family of eight people. Amit was excellent at communicating with our questions and very accommodating with our requests. We definitely recommend this place.

Loved how clean, well furnished, organized and comfortable the apartment was. Dorothy was so friendly and helpful, and provided us with assistance parking when we needed it. She stocked the kitchen with coffee, bagels, and biscotti and provided filtered water via the refrigerator,. We very much enjoyed our stay!
Great stay, love the communication and cleanliness

Had a great time at Esminas place…as a solo traveler ended up having the whole unit to myself because no one booked the other room. While the location might seem a little remote, it’s right on the Pink line and it’s also not far to walk to Little Village
This location is perfect! I could hop on the red line and be where I needed in less than five minutes. A true gem!
Great place and area. Definitely will be returning!
Shawn was a sweetheart and we absolutely enjoyed her letting us stay at such a beautiful place thank you so much Shawn!

The space was wonderful and clean  and a great layout. My only critique is that it was sparse in some ways - like no kitchen towels, lots of knives and spatulas etc but no drain pad for under the dish drainer. Also not enough lamps- the overhead lighting was harsh - would have been cozier and more comfortable with more lighting options in the living room, dining area and kitchen

Staying at Milan’s place was wonderful! Location wise - This was the perfect space, close enough to Downtown Chicago that traveling anywhere didn’t take more than 10-15 minutes. The space was clean, exactly as pictured and Milan was a great host, consistently checking in to make sure we had everything we could potentially need. Would stay here again!
Everything was fine. Parking was a little tough but overall, good place for a good price.
Adrian was very responsive and helpful. Loved the space, great location and felt safe and homey in a quietly luxurious way. 10/10 would stay again.
If you want to be in The heart of Chicago this is the place! It served well for our needs and had plenty of things to do. Great views and great location. I would definitely recommend this place.
This place was good!!
The place was good and in a great location. There are restaurants and coffee shops close by walking distance. Recommended if looking for a place in Chicago!
My friend and I enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb. Very clean and close to everything you need! Ben was very responses and helpful.

My friends and i had the pleasure of staying at this property for a weekend and it did not disappoint. This house was spacious, quiet, and beyond accommodating for a large group. Brian was very support with check in/out and responding in a timely manner. Thanks again Brian

A fantastic place to stay in a great neighborhood. Nice to have a dedicated parking spot when needed my car, but for the most part everything was walkable. I couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay while on the North side. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in the area.
Greats hosts, perfect place for 1 or 2 people, right next to multiple bus stops and a train station
Beautiful unit, centrally located, will definitely book again.

AVOID!!! Do not plan on being able to use the bunkbed! It was incredibly squeaky and unstable for 4 people. We had to move the mattresses to the floor for safety concerns and because the squeaking was that disruptive. Hardwood floors were visibly dirty and need scrubbing. Pretzels from a past guest left on the ground - place wasn’t thoroughly cleaned. Towels were too small to wrap around our bodies and pillows were lumpy and uncomfortable. Host didn’t remediate our issues and was a poor communicator. Ottoman was broken - which the host knew about per a past review. They had simply propped it up and when I sat on it I fell. We had a pregnant woman in our group and this easily could have been her. All furniture was warn or damaged including the pullout couch. Our group of 6 couldn’t comfortably sit anywhere in the space.
Only thing the place has going for it is the price and location but you are truly better off elsewhere. Wouldn’t recommend to anyone.
I had an excellent stay and Mark is a great host! Thank you!

My review on this stay with nae the bnb was nice no weird smells or anything like that it was as described communication was good was checking in from time to time to make sure we needed anything of the sorts and when i reported that the lights in the kitchen and the queen bedroom had a slight flickering she resolved the issue with no hassle which i appreciated only slight problem that i had was with the towels which i’ve made attention to the issue about and it was probably just needed more drying time in the dryer overall it’s a nice place especially being on the south side of chicago which is surprising i would recommend other ppl here and i would be booking again future wise so thank you for your nice hospitality
Great stay Overall, Multiple shops in walking distance didn’t have any issues with the unit, Ac worked well, Water was hot

Everything was great! The space was very budget-friendly, and the room was comfortable and well equipped. Md was incredibly kind, supportive, and thoughtful—he really thinks of everything. All the amenities we needed were provided, which made our stay easy and enjoyable. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend this place.

Great stay for me and my family of 4.
I will book again!!
Thanks Lois

It's a lovely older place, very homey for the area as far as we could tell.  His welcome books are very thorough and thoughtful! We were there for a sad occasion but it was helpful to come back to a cheerful and relaxing abode.  Thank you Steven!

Ariel’s place was perfect for us. We were visiting our daughter and her family. They live a block away so it was super convenient. I can’t say enough about the apartment . It was everything we needed and more.
Would recommend!

Milan’s place was exactly as pictured and Milan is a great host. I will say bring your own towels and wash cloths if you have a large group. Other than that, the place was nice and Milan responds quick if needed.

Location was fantastic, space for our group was great. There was unavoidable noise from street traffic at night, but all together relaxing place to land after the days adventures to have dinner, and unwind. Hosts were very responsive and provided clear answers. I would book again for future Chicago trips.
Location was central to a lot of things!  Room was great!

James’s place was awesome and very accommodating! There was an issue with the check-in time listed at booking, but James was extremely helpful and worked with us to make sure everything went smoothly. He even checked in with us during our stay to make sure we were good.
The place was clean, well-kept, and comfortable. We come to Chicago often, and the whole group agreed that we would definitely come back if the unit is available. Great host and great stay!
My stay was perfect! Super easy to find and check in! Centrally located for restaurants or shopping too! Would stay again!
Lovely spot in a great part of town!

Nick is an incredible host! His place is private and in a great location. The space was comfortable and had just what we needed - private entrance with keypad lock, bedroom, private bathroom, fridge and freezer, coffee makers, snacks, drinks, and a nice outdoor patio area. We loved that it is within walking distance to Wrigley Field, train stations, restaurants, and coffee shops. We were easily able to get around the city while staying here. The neighborhood is beautiful and it was easy to find street parking out front. Nick was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We would love to stay here again next time we are in town!
Amazing stay, would stay again. Great neighborhood, comfortable and thoughtful touches

If you are planning to visit Chicago this place is a must, centrally located in the middle of everything.  You could walk and get to anything you needed.  I love how people was walking their dogs, jogging and it was just a beautiful vibe.  I would most definitely stay at Kim’s place again.  Last thing Kim’s communication was navy level, thanks you helping make my wife’s birthday a special occasion.

I absolutely loved staying with Lucero! She is super kind and her Airbnb is very nice, clean, and stocked with everything you need! It’s nice and quiet and there’s also a beautiful deck attached in the back to enjoy the sun. I will definitely be staying here again in the future! I would recommend Lucero’s Airbnb to everyone!
I would definitely stay here again.
Not very responsive when returning messages, but overall the stay was nice.
Everything was perfect as usual! 3x visitor!

Truly excellent location with a spacious apartment. Brad was a respectful and responsive host, and he was able to take care of an issue early one with great communication. I really appreciated his efforts.

James place is great for 2 people. We fit very comfortable. The apartment is very vintage and fits old classic chicago vibes. The bed was EXTREMELY COMFORTABLE!. The pressure in the shower was a bit slow (but manageable) This has to do with it being on the highest level i want to assume. James let us check in a bit earlier which we are very grateful for!!! James home was very homey and had a great location by many walkable restaurants and target. It was also a HUGEEE plus that the access to the trains were about a 3 min walk with access to the Red , Purple and Brown stations! Overall a 10/10 experience!!!
Great place close to downtown, price was great and living space was clean would recommend to anyone to stay here
Mi estadía en el apartamento fue buena y Brad respondió a mis comunicaciones con rapidez. Lo recomiendo.

What an awesome place to stay!!! Quiet neighborhood and very relaxing. We didn’t realize how far it was from downtown Chicago but Chicago traffic sucks. We will definitely search this one out again! Thank you T !!!
Great find in the South Loop! Had the pool to ourselves most of the weekend! Spectacular city views everywhere you look. Super clean and spacious! Would definitely stay again!

Celeste’s place has everything you need to have a peaceful and enjoyable stay! The location is so close to so many great things to do, and the property felt really safe and well-cared for. I’d stay there again.

We were in town for our daughter‘s wedding, and Nicholas‘s place was just what we needed for getting ready and central to our activities. It was quite comfortable and we would definitely stay there again.
The space was perfect for me.  Fabulous location, too!  Inga was very responsive.  I highly recommend this cute one bedroom and would stay here again in a heartbeat!

I had a great stay! The place was very clean, comfortable, and in a great location with everything nearby. The host was very friendly, responsive, and communication was smooth throughout the stay. Everything was easy and convenient. I really appreciated the hospitality and would definitely recommend this place!

I would highly recommend this spot for a visit to Chicago. The neighborhood was beautiful and it is close enough to walk to local shops and restaurants. The location is also close to main roads to get all over the place if you habe a car with you. The spot also has a nice parking spot away from other cars. I am very happy I went with Eric's place for our first time to Chicago!
Great place!

Great place to stay!
They were super responsive and everything worked out as planned. We would rent this place again. Thank you for everything.

Place was accomodating for me and my dogs. The fenced in yard and hot tub were nice! It wasn't ready until exactly check in, cleaners left as I arrived.
Upon arrival the rugs, especially the living room, smelled like urine. The host gave permission to remove it. Understandable with a place that allowed dogs but does seem like an oversight.
My dog did get sprayed by a skunk in the back yard late at night. I tried everything to remedy the situation and informed the host and asked what other action I should take. Bought box fans at home depot, set out a bucket of vinegar to absorb the smell, kept my 5x treated dog off the furniture. The host later asked if the skunk got in the house and blamed it being in the yard on me bagging and tossing my dogs poop in the bin. It was an overwhelming situation, first time for me, and no one's fault so I didn't appreciate being blamed for it. Esp with the hosts dogs poop being around the yard.
Overall it was a good stay

Tomasz and Ewa’s place in Bucktown is an absolute gem! The apartment itself is beautiful, modern, and impeccably clean, equipped with every single amenity you could possibly need for a seamless and comfortable stay.
The location couldn't be better. Bucktown is a safe, gorgeous neighborhood with fantastic local restaurants, pubs, and activities just steps from the front door. It’s also an easy, short walk over to Wicker Park, putting an endless variety of booming shops, lounges, bars, and entertainment right at your fingertips.
What truly elevated the experience was Tomasz and Ewa. They are unbelievable hosts—proactive, incredibly helpful, and lightning-fast when responding to messages or queries. They went out of their way to make sure we felt right at home from the moment we arrived.
I cannot recommend this spot enough for anyone visiting Chicago. We would love to stay here again!
Uriel’s place was great! I felt very safe and very cozy! It was very clean and just like the photos. I would highly recommend this hidden gem!

We had a very nice stay here! The place was clean and furnished with everything we would need for our stay. We chose this place for the spacious gathering areas in the living room for our group of 5 to spend time together and play board games and it worked beautifully! The couch was big enough for us all to sit around the coffee table and there was a second table in the kitchen aside from the dining table for someone to work remotely on their laptop if they had to get some work done instead of socializing. Or at the desk by the front window equipped with a printer. The bathroom was clean with a nice huge mirror for getting ready and another mirror in the dining area. The place felt very homey, I liked the welcome map at the entry where you could sign the guestbook by leaving a message on the map. It was great the front guest room was separated into two beds so we could sleep two people comfortably in there without getting in each other’s personal space. Conveniently located too!

This was a great stay in a peaceful location. The home was as described and offered plenty of space for all guest! Easy access into the home, and parking available so you did not have to find street parking! Friendly neighbors as well!

Really enjoyed the home. The neighborhood was so amazing, that I took a walk every night to see  and enjoy the sunset. We met Lynette on our last day and she so nice and the encounter with her was refreshing. Would 100% stay there again. Also, all of the real plants were 10/10!

We were unable to stay at Josh’s place as the lockbox was not put out with the keys and the keypad was malfunctioning. This doesn’t appear to be a well run Airbnb but more of a cash grab. We had to contact Airbnb support at 11pm and stay at a hotel last minute. Terrible experience.

Really enjoyed our time at Stephanie's. The location is excellent and there is everything you might need in the apartment. She was very responsive when texted. The train is right outside making transportation convenient.
The only downside is the bed isn't the most comfortable, and the shower door opens inwards, so would be hard for someone living in a larger body to get into the shower.
Had a great time staying here! Had everything we needed. Would stay here again for sure.

Amy was such a lovely host and made our stay in Chicago even more memorable! She gave the best recommendations and told the best stories—we really felt like locals. Every morning she offered to make us coffee and it was always delicious. The place itself felt very welcoming and was very beautiful. I’d highly recommend staying here if you want your Chicago experience to have a personal touch.

Chris was great!  Very friendly and responded immediately when had questions. The place was very homey and clean!  Its convenient to walk, or take the train to the city and Lakeview trail.  Would definitely stay again when visiting Chicago
Very cozy apartment! Worked perfectly for my husband, 11 month old daughter and I for a weekend away. Great amount of free parking out front and easy to get to the bus system!
This place was very clean, and beautiful.  The beds were so comfy.  The area was great too.  I would definitely recommend.

Very nice neighborhood. Artsy (there was a mini literary festival of some sort going on in the Logan Square Park just a five minute walk from the premises). Variety of dining choices within a short walk. Quiet. Can’t say enough about the awesome location of this property!

El lugar fue muy bueno para estar unos cuantos días
Está perfecto que la ubicación este a 2 cuadras de la estación del autobús y a 20 minutos caminando del metro
En cuanto a la limpieza y ruido depende mucho la gente con la que convivas pero en nuestro caso todo estuvo muy bien
Loved this apartment! Great location near many restaurants, a public transit stop, and a cute park on the water. The apartment was lovely and very well stocked with amenities. Highly recommend!
Thank you!

Caitlyn’s place was perfect for our volleyball tournament at Montrose Beach!
