We had to book very last minute as our other accommodations canceled and Caitlyn was so quick, so helpful, and remained flexible with our fast trip - we definitely recommend this place for anyone wanting to check out out Uptown or a few of the beaches/volleyball!! I’m sure we will be up again:)
Robert and Sue’s house is spacious and comfortable. The decks off the upper bedroom and kitchen are nice for morning coffee or an evening cocktail. Robert was communicative and helpful.

Christiane and Patrick were unbelievably lovely, even decorating our room and providing cupcakes for my son's birthday! They were absolutely lovely, going above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and supported, generously stocking the fridge with breakfast goodies for us (unfortunately, we were both so hyped up we could barely eat anything that early in the day) and even providing a Ventra card to use on public transit. The bedroom and private bathroom were fully stocked as well, with tons of space to unpack and organize our stuff.
My son and I were sorry to go when our time was up, and we wouldn't even consider staying anywhere else for our next Chicago trip!

The stay was okay overall, but there were several areas that needed attention. The biggest concern was the bedroom window being boarded up, which resulted in very little natural light. I understand that unexpected repairs happen, but we were not given any advance notice. Had we known beforehand, we could have made an informed decision about the stay.
The patio area also needed work, including broken furniture and cleanliness. Inside, the couch was ripped, and the divider between the hallway and kitchen/living room appeared to be raising up, which created a potential tripping hazard and was concerning from a safety standpoint.
The host was responsive after we brought these concerns to his attention and said the window was being replaced and the patio would be addressed. I appreciate the response, but better communication beforehand and some acknowledgment of the inconvenience would have made the experience feel more fair. Hopefully these issues are resolved for future guests.

Katty's place was awesome! Exactly as described and a perfect location near lots of great attractions. We were especially taken with the roof deck, which we had mostly to ourselves throughout the stay and was such a lovely space to unwind at sunset.
Very nice apartment… very accommodating !.. thank you
Jose was kind and considerate. His response time to messages within the app was a bit slow but he always came through in the end.
Great location. My family and I celebrated my mother's 78th birthday. We had a ball! Very close to a lot of things!
The Best air bnb we have stayed at before !!!
Had a great stay with friends at the Witch Castle. Would definitely come back again!
such a fun experience!
Lake was an awesome host very helpful

Nice place to stay! Host sent check in information the day of check in. Easy to follow instructions. No issues finding parking. Would have liked a more secure pickup system for keys, but we didn’t have any issues. The front yard was fenced in which was nice for our dog. Overall a great place to stay and not far from the wedding venue we were in town for!

This Airbnb was beautiful and conveniently located right by the public train. I also got some of the best sleep I’ve ever had on that bed! Chicago was amazing and when I return, this Airbnb will be on my radar
Great location. Very clean. Very responsive hosts. For two guests, the bedroom is a little tight. For one guest, it would be perfect.
Great accommodations with 3 bathrooms. Good location. Would definitely stay here again.

We loved our quick stay here!  You can't beat a 10 minute walk to the beach. The flat is large and the rooms are a good size.  Comfortable beds and everything you could ever need in the kitchen and bathroom.  Very comfortable and cozy!
Amazing location! AC can be loud if you sleep in the living room but if you bring ear plugs it will work fine.
Milan was so responsive and accommodating. The place was very clean and perfect for what we needed. Highly recommend.
We had a lovely stay over a long weekend! Ryan is very helpful and proactive in communicating everything you need to know before and during your stay.

We enjoyed our stay, a couple of problems preventing a five star review. First the good, nice neighborhood, getting in was a breeze and the house was clean. Kitchen appliances and accessories were plentiful. The ice maker was not working, there was a large bag of ice in freezer. Nice set up in living room, was easily able to hook iPad up to tv and stream all our shows via the iPad and also the APPS on the tv. Bedrooms were very comfortable and spacious. Bathrooms very clean. Plenty of linens.
Now for some minor disappointments. The backyard furniture was a bit worn and dated. A lot of flies, mosquitoes and bees.
Layout, A LOT of stairs. No bedrooms on main level, 16 stairs up to 3 bedrooms, almost as many down. With older dog one of us slept on couch next to dog on main level. For those less mobile this is a problem.
Last but not least, received two parking tickets for not moving vehicles for street washing. Had no clue about this. Wasn’t mentioned anywhere.

I really enjoyed my stay here with my friends. The only downside was during the day surprisingly the downstairs neighbors were very noisy as they have young children. However, this was never an issue at night and we spent several days out during the day.
Great location near UofC and the Green Line for ease of transportation. There was also a grocery store walking distance.
Great place!

I had a great stay at Claire and Jonas place!
Yes it's across the street from a bar and yes it's in a busy street but these are things that they clarify before the reservation .
I found the studio to be nice, clean, spacious very comfy bed and nice big bathroom
Lots to do in the area for/bars and there's a cvs within 10 mins walking distance if you're ok with that !
Look forward to the next stay!

The apartment was clean and cozy! The beds were comfortable. The stairs are steep/narrow toward the bottom, therefore you have to be very careful and watch your step going down them from the 2nd or 3rd level. The host was very responsive and communicated well. Overall, it was a good stay!
Really enjoyed the location, tons of amazing food within walking distance. Thank you!

Majed’s home is in a great location with lots of fun restaurants and easy access to the Loop area. When we arrived, the A/C was broken. Shantionna and Majed were very responsive about the issue and had a tech come the next day, Saturday, to fix the system. These things happen and we appreciated their quick response. As other reviewers mentioned, the main bedroom is very loud overnight due to street noise, even with the fan on, though noise wasn’t an issue for our guest in the secondary bedroom. My only other comment is that the included shower supplies were a bit lacking. We needed to buy bars of soap since the bathrooms only had remnants of shampoo or shampoo/conditioner. I do recommend Majed’s home to anyone looking to stay in River North and would happily stay here again, just want to be transparent about the few issues we had.

A very good place, as described. Very close to the amenities.
Though, too many chores, more than typical airbnbs

From the very beginning, John was super helpful. He met us outside the unit to avoid us having issues trying to find the entrance. He walked us into the unit and gave us some helpful tips. He was very responsive throughout our stay and checked in with us to see if he could be of any assistance. The unit was small, but it was perfect for 2 people to clean up and relax after a few busy days in the city. I would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Chicago.
Apartment was beautiful and spacious. Outside area was wonderful for morning coffee. We always enjoyed getting back to the place to recharge.

The Rectory was one of coolest stops across our significant Airbnb universe to date. The small house literally is a former parsonage for the church next door which is now converted into a beautiful single-family home. David is an excellent communicator both before and during the stay. Well-appointed, beautiful space, immaculately clean with everything one needs. We are two adult couples and stayed comfortably with our own private sleeping space and bathrooms. The neighborhood, renowned Lincoln Park, is grand with easy walks to many restaurants, shops and cafes, not to mention easy access to mass transit. Small children should stay downstairs but definitely a kid-friendly place. Just choose it, you won't be sorry!
10/10 highly recommended
I had a great stay, I especially appreciated how our Host offered to let us keep our luggage stored after checkout.
cozy, easy to find, easy to get in and out, spacious

Mark was extremely responsive and helpful throughout the stay.
Great host. Will definitely stay there again on my next trip to Chicago.

I really enjoyed my stay at iris's place. It was very clean and she communicated very well. i would definitely book again

Historical building in extremely safe area (across the street from Federal court building). Comfortable queen beds, great water pressure, very clean, plenty of towels and blankets, working a/c. The L noise is surprisingly loud 15 floors up and it never gets truly dark, but hosts have provided earplugs and white noise machines. The kitchen has lots of equipment but is otherwise bare - no perishables like coffee. Luckily, Dunkin is just downstairs. Easy walk to the art institute and the bean, kitty corner to the library and winter garden. A block to the elevator entrance to the blue line, $2.50 ride to the airport. Overall a great value for our 4 person + 1 dog group.
Great stay always feel welcoming friendly host this is my second stay since I come to Chicago often
Very responsive and everything needed was there at the home.  Thanks Rashad.
amazing host and great accommodation! quick responses and very proactive to helping resolve any issues. thank you for the great stay :)
Great place, great location, great communication
Cute apartment in an awesome neighborhood!

Anna and Daniel are such amazing hosts, very kind and sweet. I really recommend them, the neighborhood is really quiet, the space really comfortable, everything clean, everything was amazing. Honestly I can’t wait to come back. 🥰🤍
A lovely stay in a familiar neighborhood after living in Humboldt for 10 years this spot was perfect for my family and I.

Amazing place for a couple visiting Chi town. There is a lot of grocery stores around, easy travel from the train to the city. The host was amazing and responsive to us. The one downside is the outside area has a lot of mosquitoes so just bring bug spray and you will be ok. But I will recommend this spot to others

Our stay at Keenan’s place was everything!! I really loved his home so cozy and a really nice neighborhood. The check in process was a little confusing at first but neitherless we managed to get used to it!! Definitely would book again might even have to buy that space from Keenan lol!!!

Très bel endroit bien situé et très bon rapport qualité prix. Nous recommandons!

Great amazing place. I and my girlfriend stayed there for 2 nights and it was like we basically lived there; everything was perfect and well managed. Even thought their wasn’t a TV in the bedroom you could still see it from the living room which was perfect for us. If I could rate this 10 stars I would, 100% recommended for at least 2 guest. Plus walkable place to get groceries and go to the beach.
The place was nice and quiet, even though it’s in the middle of a very populated and busy neighborhood. Clean and totally what we needed.

The bathroom is located inside the bedroom, which is not ideal for multiple guests or having company. ¶Additionally, the "couch" is a low futon about 6 inches off the floor, which may be difficult for older guests. ¶ It also lacked basic starter amenities like paper towels, garbage bags, and Nespresso coffee pods (Hard to find in stores!). ¶ Regarding communication: the host called us the night before arrival to report an inoperable oven/stove. They offered cancellation, but alternative lodging was unavailable in the neighborhood/price range. When we requested a discount, the host initially refused. I had to involve Airbnb to reach a satisfactory resolution. The host should have handled this better from the start instead of forcing me to mediate through support. ¶ The Airbnb wasn't terrible, but it definitely could have been better.
Very nice attention, very clean and comfortable! Recommended ;)
Great Airbnb!

Great hosts, and I am afraid to say too many good things about this place, like the nicely warmed pool, the great coffee maker, the neighborhood, lest, I get too much competition next time we need to stay. Really nice location, great amenities, overall what you'd expect from a good premium airbnb.
The location worked really well for us. The place was clean and comfortable. I would have given 5 stars all the around except I like lots of windows and natural light. Aside from that it was great.
Amazing stay would definitely reccomend!

Not a bad place at all. Was an older building with some things re done. A couple of things were, the microwave handle was broken on the bottom when I went to heat up food my last night there, and the shower head rusting quite a bit. Other than that, a good place and not too shabby price.
Calm place along the blue line
Excellent location, lake views, no complaints

We loved our stay at the Sassy Sanctuary! Even more spacious than the pictures show, right in Wrigleyville but on a quiet tree-lined street. Great location and walkable to lots of restaurants, the train and Wrigley.
David’s instructions for checking in and out were clear and easy, he left great tips for things to do in the area. Apt was clean and included all the amenities listed.
Would stay here again next time we’re visiting Chicago! Thanks for a great stay!
10 out of 10 would stay at Sue's again and again!
Great place and excellent location
Mary was very responsive when anything arose that needed help with and the location matched the post very well.
This is a comfortable place with a beautiful garden.  So many thoughtful necesities were supplied, we really felt at home. The host is great and very responsive.
We had a great stay! Our group of 10 fit comfortably in the townhome, and Parth was very responsive and quick to answer any questions. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again.

Overall, a great stay with no issues. The host was very responsive to questions, and check‑in was easy. The location is on a safe, quiet residential street. The apartment itself was clean, the bed was comfortable, and the unit had all the necessary appliances.

The street has on‑street parking. It was generally fine, though finding a spot can be a bit challenging later in the evening.
Would stay again!
Brain place was very nice we had everything we needed and then some I’ll definitely book again

Kim was friendly and super responsive. Booked this place for my parents for the weekend and it was perfect. Super close to all the good spots in Andersonville. Easy check in and check out. Would highly recommend this place!
Amazing host! Great locations. Great bathroom!! Responsive host. Pictures dont do it enough justice. Great location and neighborhood
Great stay no complaints

This unit was exactly as described & host was very responsive and friendly would definitely recommend to any travelers to area to book with Laura! We will definitely will be back, Thanks for a wonderful stay
Nice place. Beautiful, quiet neighborhood. Short walk to the Brown Line.
Staying with Beca was good, the place is spacious and Beca was accommodating with adding an extra bed and with early check in/ late check out.

I had a wonderful stay. The apartment is situated on a very quiet, safe side street in Andersonville/Edgewater. It was modern, clean, and private.
There are several bus routes right outside the door, making it very easy to get around. You’re also about a 10-15 min walk from both Whole Foods and Target.
You can hear some very minor noise from the apartment above and the shared laundry room, which is connected to the bedroom, but it was never too disruptive.
I would absolutely stay here again!
Very nice!
I love the location of this apartment. It is clean and safe, and Rob had great communication before and during my stay. I would stay here again.
Enjoyed our stay in the penthouse. Easily accessible, safe, and great views of the city. 10/10 location and easy to navigate around. Would stay here again.

My family of 5 had a great stay at Amir's house! He was very responsive to all of my questions. The house was clean and in a great walkable location. The foosball table was so fun for my kids! Highly recommended!

The hosts were fantastic. Very responsive to any needs. Greeted us on arrival with any helpful info we asked them about. Had suggestions on fun things to do. They had snacks/ drinks available - so we didn’t have to rush to the grocery store.(which was convenient-right around the corner).Location was great for train/ buses/ restaurants/ lakeshore trail/ Wrigley field. Even though you r close to everything- the space was so quiet. The space was well appointed with comfortable seating and beds, kitchen items, towels,linens . Thanks so much for a fantastic stay at your beautiful home. We would definitely stay here again.

The place was just like the pictures! Very clean , stocked and safe as it had two double doors that needed a key. We came for a girls weekend and it was under 15min from downtown where we attended a concert. Extra towels and linens I would say great for a family they had extra air mattresses and a graco! Overall 10/10 would definitely stay here again and free parking was easy to find! She was also very responsive under 10 min every time.
It was very quiet and easy to find. The neighborhood felt comfortable. They left pizza recommendations and was near dollar general and stuff. The bed was comfy with plenty of pillows.
Great little place to stay in a tucked in and quiet corner of Chicago!

Was a pretty place, however we were not informed of the dog that lives next door who was out most of the time and made it very hard for us to let our dogs out as there is not much separation in the fence between neighbors. Also no central AC and the window AC’s were loud.
Loved this airbnb for our trip, very convenient to walk to coffeeshops, restaurants, etc. and our local friends (the main reason we chose this space).      Small, clean, great for what we needed.

The apartment is great; it's super cozy. Everything was clean and well organized, and there were plenty of supplies in the kitchen and bathroom, which I really appreciated. If I come back to the city, I am 100% sure I will look forward to staying here again. The neighborhood was equally nice and safe, with tons of good restaurants within walking distance.

Andy was a very responsive host. The instructions to enter the house were detailed and easy to follow. My room was just as described and clean. The bathroom was also clean and had shampoo and soap.
The train station to get to downtown is walkable (about 15-20 min). I read in some comments that the area did not feel very safe for a female solo traveler, I did not make that experience. I was a solo female traveler and felt safe. But I had been told not to walk alone back at night and used ubers instead. All in all I'd recommend this place.
Loved this place, quite comfortable and beautiful will stay here every time I come to Chicago

I loooovvveeeddd staying here! The house was in a quiet neighborhood, lots of bars & restaurants near by, Gatis was a great host! It was also so beautiful inside the home. I would definitely stay here again!
Great stay, will definitely revisit if I’m ever in town!
Excellent stay!

This place is fun, clean, beautiful, and included clear instructions as well. Full of amazing content, rare media, and a QR code scavenger hunt inside with links to recordings, artifacts and entertainment! Rooms and furniture are all comfortable and decorated wonderfully. Perfect place for industrial fans and rivetheads to further immerse themselves in the culture.

Brett’s place was perfect for my stay! It’s in a great location in Roscoe Village and extremely walkable to stores, restaurants, and Southport shops. It was very clean and comfy. I appreciated the access to the outdoor porch and patio in the backyard. I will definitely be back to stay again in the future!

A very cozy space and the host was very responsive and helpful!  Although it’s a shared space, other guests kept to themselves and were very quiet. I did like how safe the place was! Would highly recommend for a weekend in Chicago!

This location was very nice, next to the blue line allowed for easy travel throughout Chicago and a very nice plaza that was easily walkable. Plenty of community events held nearby.
A few things to note for both the hosts and anyone looking to book:
This Airbnb is part of a split building (duplex or triplex), and quiet hours are at 10pm. I only note this because Airbnb doesn't specify and we were worried about talking or laughing too loudly. - the neighbors were nice and didn't say anything about noise when asked, so we were likely fine, but wanted to mention it. Additionally there is a request for no shoes inside. Not a problem for our group, but could be worth noting. The beds are split between 2 floors which made the shoe situation a little odd, but not that big of a deal. Downstairs beds are next to the water heater which is loud when anyone uses water and the 3rd bed downstairs isnt in its own room, just split by a curtain.
Overall the experience was great and I would recommend
Great location, definitely in the middle of everything but the caveat is it’s really loud because of the bars surrounding it ! The hosts were really accommodating they let us have a late check out!
Mary was a great host, with great communication. The house is clean, well organized, quiet, and very conveniently located near the airport.
This is a wonderful place to stay.
Great location and stay, the apartment is right near the California blue line stop which made hopping around the city super easy!
Home was beautiful and just as described.  Several really close eating places within walkable distance with excellent food.

Great location and very convenient and walkable to everything in Logan Square. Parking on the side streets was never an issue. The host was flexible and responsive to our requests. The apartment itself is a bit of an odd layout but true to the photos and description - it was well stocked and comfortable for a multi-day stay. Note the central AC, while it was quite effective, is on the loud side and that could be an issue for some folks.
It was a nicely furnished place and I will definitely stay there again. Nice use of space!
Great house and had everything we needed. He was a wonderful host!
This place was really beautiful and i know im definitely booking again! They were really nice and easy to talk to and gave us some really good instructions for getting into the place
Very nice place, check in was easy and the host was very kind and gave us recommendations on places in the area. The rooms were stocked with anything you’d need and overall it was a great experience.
Great location; clean place with a lovely kitchen. Close to the lake, the zoo, parks, and public transport. Great part of town, excellent communication and  hosting!

Amazing place to stay for my Chicago weekend trip!! One of the coziest places I've stayed, the host provides everything with clear instructions, even with board games and card games. The space has a beautiful large window pane and good location relative to the city too.
Our stay was good Quinton was Avery great amazing host his Airbnb was magnificent very clean very spacious. If we are in Chicago we will definitely book again

10 out of 10 I would recommend Bronzeville Hidden Oasis. There was plenty of space to accommodate everyone. The space was very clean. Sherry our host gave great recommendations on restaurants and sights to see. She was responsive whenever I had questions. I would definitely stay again. Thank you Sherry, for providing a beautiful space to add to the wonderful experience of celebrating a milestone birthday.

My friends and I really enjoyed our stay at Phong’s place! The hosts were very responsive and helpful when needed. The space was exactly as pictured. Very convenient for parking to be included as well!
Amazing stay!! We had so much fun and it was easy to find. Great place and very walkable to everything you need. Would recommend to anyone!!!

The Airbnb was nice, just like the pictures. The instructions were very clear. The walls are very thin though. When I say thin you can hear everything the neighbors will know your name lol. It is a multi unit building so there are people who resides there. The area is not the best area but everything was within 15-20 minutes from every location I was goin to. If you’re thinking about booking go for it.

We had a great stay at Alex’s place. Check in/out was super easy and there was a hand written note with cookies when we arrived. We had a big group and there was plenty of space and bathrooms to accommodate us. The guest house was also very nice and comfortable. Location was great! We were able to walk to a bunch of restaurants and bars and the street the property was on is super nice! Would 100% stay here again!
Lovely spot. Nice space!

Valerie is definitely a Super host. 3 days before we were to check in she sent several recommendations for my family to do and see. Her home is beautiful so much history and Character the neighbor was quiet and beautiful as well. Sunday morning before we checked out she came over introduced herself we talked for a while she talked about the neighborhood and the history of the house and surrounding areas. We would definitely stay in her home again in Chicago. Thanks again Valerie for your kindness and hospitality and allowing us to stay in your home.
Sincerely
Goans Casey Family

Good location as it is close to downtown Chicago with easy access to a lot of the tourist attractions.
Alicia was so easy to deal with and flexible- she allowed us to extend our stay without asking for any additional payment.
Great place- clean and spacious
You won’t leave disappointed!

We enjoyed our stay with Sue & Bill. We had everything we needed at our fingertips. We were grateful for our parking spot that led us through the garden and into our room.
Sue & Bill & Theo (cute dog) were very welcoming and friendly
Amazing Home.

Jean’s place was a great place for a large group! It was comfy, we all had our own beds, and it had everything we needed. Convenient to local food and the blue line, with a great little local bar at the corner and beautiful park on the other end of the block.

We had a great time staying at Carina's unit! This was my first time using Airbnb AND staying in Chicago, and her unit helped quell any/all concerns that I had. Will definitely be reserving her unit again on the next family trip to Chicago!
Great location, great place and we especially enjoyed the outdoor space. Thanks, Paul, for a wonderful stay!

We had 10 guys. The place was perfect for us. Comfortable beds, cold AC, plenty of towels, and nice spaces for hanging out. The roof top deck was a bit worn out but it was perfect for hanging out in the evening. Florin was an excellent host.
Excellent location. Exceptionally clean.
Place was clean and in a nice area

Just fabulous! We had a girls trip to Chicago for the weekend and loved Hector’s home, we had the best trip. The bathrooms and kitchen are amazing, we loved the upstairs shower, so fancy. We loved sitting up on the balcony with our morning coffee, there’s a lot close by, coffee and food spots, and it’s very safe. Great value for money. Thanks Hector!
Stephanie's was a great host beautiful home very clean and perfect location if I'm back in Chicago I would definitely go back to her home
The place was great, lots of room, amenities, and the host was very responsive. We needed extra linen and they came by and dropped some off! The rooms are cute and the place is in a nice area.

Muy lindo lugar, buena atención. El anfitrión, muy atento respondió nuestras inquietudes y nos ayudó con lo que necesitábamos. Si vuelvo a Chicago, lo volvería a elegir. El barrio es muy lindo y tranquilo con mucho verde y cerca de avenida que permiten el acceso.

We had a great time at this Airbnb.  We stayed for a long weekend with our college age kids.  It was spacious for 5 of us.  The condo was very comfortable and clean and fully stocked.  The location was perfect and walkable.  The hosts were so responsive.  I highly recommend this condo.  We will definitely be back!
The house was perfect for a family of 6, great vibes and amazing backyard. The one and only problem we had was parking but at the end of the day it got figured out !! Perfect stay!!
Great host and enjoyed my stay. Very close to the “L” train, and many great activities and food.

We had a great stay! The host was very communicative, the home was spotless, and the kitchen was well stocked with everything we needed. It was an easy walk to restaurants, the record player was a fun touch, and we really enjoyed the outdoor fire pit. We’d happily stay here again!
Thank you for hosting us as guests
This was my first time in Chicago and I'm glad I was able to stay here. The apartment itself was very comfortable, clean, and had what we needed for our multi-day stay. I'd happily stay here again.
Overall great place! Could not ask for a better location with tons of options within minutes. Very quiet unit, super comfortable and unbeatable views! Highly recommend

Amber’s place was exactly as described and looked just like the photos on the app. The home was beautiful, spacious, and perfect for me and my group. We were able to relax, enjoy the space, and truly make ourselves at home.
Amber was also very responsive and answered any questions I had quickly, which I really appreciated.
The house itself was a surprise for my friends and family, so seeing everyone’s reactions when they arrived made it even more special! Thank you, Amber and your team, for helping make my 35th birthday celebration such a success. We had an absolute ball and created some amazing memories here. I would definitely recommend this stay!
Great space. Angelo’s place was well furnished, clean, and beautifully decorated. The neighborhood is very nice with welcoming people. Would stay here again.
Enjoyed our stay, would definitely book again in the future!

We enjoyed our stay. The house looks exactly like the pictures and did not disappoint. The host was very responsive and always answered right away. I can see myself booking again when I return to Chicago.

This place was clean, easy to find, and had very detailed instructions on how to access the apartment. Located relatively close to downtown.
I did have an issue with wifi but Jorge was very responsive, and actively helped to fix the issue.
Great place to stay.

Denise’s place was probably my best AirBnb experience ever! Her place is beautiful, it’s in Wicker Park, which has ALOT of retail stores and restaurants. It’s an artsy area. Great location. Close to everything and price was right. Only thing missing was the wash cloths.
Was great location and great space for a trip to Chicago or the area.
Nice peaceful neighborhood.  Very clean and well kept apartment.  Fit our needs perfectly.

Sky’s place was amazing! Any amenity or convenience imaginable was intentionally thought out. Sky was friendly in communication & and gave great clear instructions. Would 100% stay here again if in the area! Thanks again!

We enjoyed our stay at the duplex.  Location was great as it was at walking distance to main points of interest.  The place was impeccable and had everything as described.   We had an issue with the coffee maker but they were very responsive and offered a solution right away.  We will come back to this place next time we are in Chicago!
Awesome location and beautiful home. Very walkable
This was a cute place close to the city and train. Fun for a friends weekend and in a neighborhood that felt safe
Brad was very responsive and helpful with check in, home was as advertised

We had a good stay. It's a perfect location with lots to do in the area and the train nearby. The train isn't too loud at night, which was one of our concerns.
Communication was very slow through the Airbnb app. I would definitely call Jay if you need something. They had a new AC unit with no instructions. Hopefully that gets fixed for future guests. It had a schedule set that we had to learn how to override without any assistance from Jay.
Amazing stay, very responsive host
We had a great stay here! Very nice room, great location, would stay again
Beautiful home in a great location!

This location was perfect! The hosts were very responsive and kind.
The units were good, but to share details to help guests here was my experience. We booked the penthouse, which I thought would be a large connected space. The rooms are a little small. With the listing you would think you have access to a rooftop from 502, you do not. The space is clean and comfortable I just wish it was next to one another and bigger for what we paid! I would stay in 507 again.

Everything was exactly as described. Communication with the host was fast, the apartment was clean and matched the photos, and check-in was completely smooth. Wonderful location and incredible value. Would happily book again!

Finding the place was easy as well as checking in once we received the keys! The apartment was perfectly sized for 2 people, centrally located to where we wanted to be, and very clean and organized on arrival. We loved the AC by the head board after some long walks in the summer heat! Mo & Ganna were very responsive when messaged and were always willing to provide anything we might have asked. Would definitely stay here again, and most likely will due to the perfect location!

The house was very cozy, clean, well organized, and had all the essentials - even coffee. the layout was perfect for a two bedroom. The hosts were very responsive. Quiet neighborhood near my venue. Short walk was great
We had a great stay - the place is surprisingly big and very comfortably fits a group of 8!

Great location and easy parking! It was very spacious and the balcony/rooftop area was great. Was a perfect type of stay for what we needed during our trip! Hosts and contacts were also very friendly!

We enjoyed our stay at Marissa’s place. It was super cute and cozy and close walking distance to many places to eat, shop, etc. Would definitely consider booking again, as we love the Logan area and visit often.
Had a great stay!
The home is beautiful and feels safe. The neighborhood is gorgeous and amazing to stay especially for my trip with my mom.
Can’t beat location. Responsive host. Would stay again no doubt.

Definitely would have been nice since we paid to stay if there was free parking for guests only that are using the air bnb. But instead I thought I parked in a safe parking spot and of course my car was towed. Wasn’t pleased to come to check out and now I have an arm and a leg payment. Overall stay wasn’t terrible just not being able to access to front door as we pleased. Also need to take pics of what you’re actually getting definitely wasn’t as pictured last but not least we did have a run in with a couple roaches but we killed them right away but it was kind of to be expected for city buildings.

Kristine's home is on one floor of a charming brownstone. The apartment is beautiful and very well appointed, with interesting artwork and unique touches. It definitely feels like you're staying in a home rather than a "generic Airbnb." There's a lot of space to hang out, and all three bedrooms are real bedrooms. We had no complaints about the beds. The apartment was very clean, and Kristine was very generous with amenities.
One thing to note: I have three rambunctious kids, and at one point we unintentionally disturbed the neighbors above and below with our noise. It's an old house, so the floors are creaky and sound travels easily. Kristine was very gracious in how she raised the concern, and we did our best to keep the kids quiet — though that's easier said than done with four- and five-year-olds. I'd just caution that this beautiful home may be best suited for a quieter crew.
It's a beautiful and special home, and I fully recommend it!
Nice and spacious and responsive host.
Great stay. Had a great time and host was very informative. Felt safe.

Dasha was very helpful and responsive. Even when we were missing a blanket or a coffee cup, she was able to get that to our room in a timely manner. This Airbnb was old fashion with a modern twist. It was warm and cozy for an anniversary weekend. And having a balcony in the building was nice to get some fresh air and have a drink as well. Take advantage of the kitchen, very manageable to use. I would definitely recommend this place. Overall, I will be back at this Airbnb for the next occasion.
Thanks!

Tamara’s home was great! It was very cozy and in a great location, very easy to find and close to public transit, major streets, and the highway! There was also plenty of public parking right in front of the home just in case you’re thinking about renting a car! Tamara was readily available and her home had everything we needed and even things we didn’t know we needed! When I come back to Chicago I will definitely choose this listing again if it is available!

My husband and I really loved Alma’s studio apartment. Like other reviewers mentioned, it is on the smaller size but we felt really comfortable there and never like we didn’t have space for everything we needed. The bed was comfy and it was quiet through the nights, we didn’t have to use the provided earplugs. Very nice bathroom and shower. The neighborhood is cool with some great coffee shops and close to the beach and public transit. Instructions to access the building and our unit were easy to follow. We would definitely stay again if in the area!
The home is beautiful and super fun! Jesus was always responsive when we had a question. The area is a bit sketchy but we were unbothered during our stay.

We stayed here for 2 weeks and had a great experience! The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The location is within walking distance of an area with lots of great restaurants, while still being a quiet place.
Melissa was also very responsive and helpful whenever we had any questions. Overall, we had a wonderful stay!
Excellent location. Near to the L and CTA stops. Walkable to cafes nearby.

Thank you so much for allowing us to stay in your beautiful home. The place was spacious clean and overall meet our accommodations that we needed for our trip to Chicago. Can’t wait to stay with you again. The next time I come five stars all around.

Ryan is very responsive and communicative. There was not any flexibility with early check in or late check out, even with asking about early check in well in advance. But other than that it was a great stay! Wonderful space for a large group of friends visiting Chicago. Many restaurants in walkable distance, in a safe area. Would definitely recommend staying here with a large group!
Nice room, good host, communicated well. Would recommend for any White Sox fan.

I had a fabulous stay at Omni’s place! I come to Chicago often and this has now become my favorite AirBnB in the Chi. The home is immaculately cleaned, large, comfortable with great amenities - and the jet tub was so relaxing! The outside of the home had such beautiful architecture and landscaping and  the neighborhood is great! Close to a lot of great restaurants and cultural centers on the South Side. Communication with the host was excellent - super responsive. Thank you again for a great stay!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was extremely clean, comfortable, and very well equipped. It had everything we needed and more, from a fully stocked kitchen to plenty of bathroom and household essentials, including great hair products, paper products, laundry pods, and many thoughtful touches. Sarah and Brandon were extremely responsive, helpful, and supportive throughout our stay.
The location in Lincoln Park was fantastic. The street and area are quiet, walkable, and very enjoyable. The unit is a half-basement, so there isn't much natural light, but this wasn't an issue for us. You can also hear some noise from upstairs when there are people there, though nothing terrible.
The only thing that didn't work as well for us was the mattress, which was extremely soft. We're used to a much firmer one, so we found it uncomfortable, but that's very much personal preference.
Overall, an excellent stay and we would happily recommend it!
The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and nicely decorated. Having a dedicated parking spot in a big city was a huge plus! Check-in was clear and easy. Overall, we had a good stay and would stay again.
The space accommodated our group with ease - plenty of room, lots of extra pillows. The location was great, the neighborhood is walkable and pretty. No complaints!
We loved the apartment. Great accommodations, wonderful neighborhood with lots to do and great food in walking distance. I’d happy stay again!
This place was amazing! Very clean and had everything you could need. Not too far from the city and has lots of things in the area to walk to. Will definitely stay here again!
Alle's Team was very helpful and the room was very clean
Beautifully decorated space and incredibly accommodating host.

Johana’s place is nestled perfectly in a beautiful, safe, and walkable neighborhood right near downtown Andersonville. We loved all of the decorations, amenities, and aesthetic of the place. We spent most of our time walking to Andersonville for shops and restaurants. We would most definitely rebook here again and recommend to anyone!

Alejandro made check in and check out very easy, and was very accommodating with allowing us to arrive early! The neighborhood is very removed from the busy parts of Chicago and well connected to public transit to get around. Walkable to many parks and restaurants. The space was very open and provided a well prepared kitchen if we needed. The bathroom had great water pressure however there was a strong mildew smell coming from vanity. Furniture was basic essentials but exactly what we needed. We did notice dog hair on the rug and the couch. Thank you Alejandro for the accommodations!
Clean, well maintained, in a nice walkable neighborhood with easy public transit access. Lots of space and central air -- much appreciated in Chicago in the summer.
Great location in a quiet neighborhood. Host was extremely helpful and visited many times when we had an issue or need.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Edwin’s place! The neighborhood is great and the property is right by the L stop. The place is super cozy and comfortable. The bed was great too. Honestly, the train running behind the room didn’t bother me at all. Edwin was also flexible with my check-out time. I didn’t end up needing a later checkout, but he was willing to be flexible nonetheless! Highly recommend Edwin’s place!
Great spot and good host!
Great stay—many thoughtful touches like lots of plug in options for phones, night lights etc
Kymi was great, the apartment was perfect to retreat to after a full day of exploring Chicago.

Our family really enjoyed staying at Stacy’s place. We were visiting friends in the neighborhood and it was the perfect place for us - easy to come and go, lots within walking distance, and thoughtful care taken of the home. Thanks for having us, and thanks for the great coffee set up!
Awesome place with a nice backyard and parking

I was on a staycation. Perfect spot near the best neighborhood in my opinion. Both trains, cta and metra. Loved the 24hour access. The extra fee for amenities was worth it. Will be back just to get away. It was me and a friend who shared a large bed. No touching lol. No negative fee back from us. Ty

I had to find an Airbnb that could accommodate 8 friends for a 16 year friend reunion. Beautiful scenic view of the best skyline in the world and plenty of space to lounge around. Some of my friends didn’t want to share the same room, but that’s okay — there was a portable bed and a roomy sofa that worked! I was also pleasantly surprised at how big the rooftop terrace was. There was plenty of room to do multiple things. I would definitely stay again!

Location was great. Lots of places to walk to and eat. Neighborhood was safe. Graces restaurant was great we ate there twice! Sunshine Cafe- right down the street. Truman bar and pub had great cocktails and for a Ukrainian meal there is a restaurant a few doors down. Anna's bakery fantastic also! The only reason I didn't give a 5 star was that the apartment is very dated. It was clean though no problem there! Enjoyed our stay!!

We had a great stay! It was a perfect spot to celebrate my bachelorette party. So much room with beautiful furniture and interior design. You can tell they put a lot of thought into this place. The location was perfect with great bars and restaurants just a few walking minutes away. Such a fun town! Not to mention the host was super responsive with any questions we had and helped quickly with any requests. I absolutely recommend this 10/10 stay! Thanks!

Brad’s place was great! It was very clean and quaint. I loved the neighborhood and it was very convenient to Uber and Lyft to nearby destinations! I definitely enjoyed my stay. My only feedback is to make the keypad instructions for the apartment entrance a little clearer but otherwise I had an amazing time and Brad was very nice and communicated well!

I loved staying here. The location is fantastic, the home is beautiful and high end and incredibly well take care of, and having so much space in the middle of the city was such a gift. I hope to book this place again with my family.
Perfect location
Very helpful, communicate well and place was wonderful as described.  Looking forward to another visit.
Great unit and excellent location!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Very clean and comfortable apartment. The location is convenient and Nate is an excellent host. The coffee maker, coffee variety and snacks were the perfect touch. We will definitely stay again if we return to Chicago.

Just what we needed for our weekend trip. The space was clean, quiet and comfortable. Also had no problem looking for parking even after coming in late at night. Thank u so much! Will book again in the future
A great place to stay for a weekend or more in Chicago. Great neighborhood. Spacious, roomy.
We stayed at the Neighborhood in Little Italy while we moved our son into UIC. The location was perfect, clean, and easy to navigate. I will be staying here again!

This is an exceptionally nice, clean place that exceeded our expectations. It’s beautifully decorated with lots of conveniences and amenities.
We felt safe walking around the neighborhood and coming in late (ish). The farthest we had to park from the front door (once) was 3-4 cars away; there was usually a spot right in front.
There are all kinds of dining/delivery options nearby, but the kitchen is well equipped for preparing meals at home if you prefer.
The TV has multiple streaming options, and the large sofa reclines! Instructions (for anything you might wonder about) are clear and easy.
The bed is comfy, the AC is robust, and the neighbors are QUIET. We didn’t hear a peep.
Nice, well stocked bathroom.
We can’t think of a bad word to say. Thank you for a lovely visit!

Could not recommend this place more! It was better than the photos! The best location for walking and public transport - there was so much around the area! It felt like home, our group truly had the best time!

My friends and I loved this place! We came to town for an event at Old Town School of Folk Music and it was an easy walk, great neighborhood, clean, and comfortable. Can’t wait to stay here again on future trips!
Such a nice stay with our toddler, teenager and two pups! Home was beautiful and very clean! Matthew was extremely responsive and a great host!
Second time staying here as great experience the first time. Place is very clean and Pauline is extremely responsive and helpful. Excellent location as close to many restaurants and the train.

The home was as pictured and comfortable for 6 adults. The check in instructions was very clear and smooth. One hang up was finding the parking area. I found it by accident driving down an alley. It was a little snug for a larger SUV but we only had one vehicle so it worked for us. We were concerned about the bar downstairs but the owner provided ear plugs and face masks which was very thoughtful, but we didnt need any of it. The bar downstairs didnt disturb any of us. Overall good space and location

We had a great weekend at this Airbnb and will deformed stay there again when visiting our son in Chicago.
And, you must try the chicken restaurant downstairs from the airbnb. It was delicious!
The apartment was very cozy.
Perfect location! We had a wonderful stay and the parking spot was a huge plus! Samuel was very responsive and helpful!
We had a wonderful stay at Atlas's place. It's cozy, comfortable, and exactly as described. Next time we're in town, we'll check here first!
Love this place & it’s amazing host! I look forward to my next stay at Jocy’s place.

Nice place, lots of space, lots to do right outside the door, 8 min walk to the redline, bus stop almost right outside of the front door. Host is very responsive! I couldn’t find extra toilet paper when I was there. I reached out to the host and she quickly had some delivered to the door plus 4 bottle of Gatorade for us to enjoy! It is located in a relatively busy area so if you’re not use to the sounds of a city around you at night then you might think it’s “noisy”. I live in a city so I put on my sleep sounds like I do every night and I couldn’t hear anything (people, trains, cars, etc) from outside. Bed was super comfortable too!

The apartment itself was nice and had a lot of potential, but unfortunately, several things did not live up to the pictures or expectations. The balcony area looked very different from the photos, and the pillows were dirty and laying on the floor. The carpeting looked like multiple rugs layered on top of each other. The snacks provided appeared old, and one of the granola bars was extremely stale. I also had to clean the Keurig because there was a film inside that made it look like it had not been properly cleaned. I wasn't sure about the coffee because I couldn't find an expiration date. Overall, it was clear the apartment could use a deep cleaning and some upgrades. The bedding, bath towels, and back bedroom rug especially need attention. I hate leaving a negative review because the apartment itself is actually nice, but the cleanliness and upkeep really took away from the experience. With some attention to these details, it could be a great place to stay.

Everything went smoothly and was the perfect place to stay for our visit to Chicago. It’s an easy, safe 20 minute walk to the pink line, allowing quick access to and from downtown. The bed is very comfortable and the AC unit in the bedroom was amazing. Would stay again!

Fantastic place for families and couples. Extremely clean and well kep. A beautifu,l retro-modern finish in a great neighborhood. The hosts are highly proactive and very friendly. Highly recommend! We'll be booking this place every time we visit Chicago.

I hate to give 4 stars because we did love our stay, but the train noise is significant so wanted to give heads up. I lived in NYC and am used to noise but the train is so close to the bedroom window that it shakes the room and hurts ears. Ear plugs were provided and appreciated. Overall, close to cool shops and restaurants, comfy bed, and easy to get to.
Thank you ! Perfect location! Comfy beds!
Very clean and friendly host, great location and adorable cats!
Near Southport brown line. Was fully livable for long term stay.

Unfortunately, this was a very disappointing stay. When I arrived, the front door was left completely open, & the neighbor informed me it had been left open all day. We were unable to access the lockbox for the key. Eventually she gave me the code to the back up lockbox. One bathroom sink did not have hot water, and one of the showers was too dirty to use and even had a bug inside. There was also food left in the kitchen sink drain, and the home felt very stuffy with a strange smell. She said someone would come Friday morning to address the problems, but no one ever came. She later offered to send someone Saturday evening, but since we were checking out Sunday morning, we felt it was too late to be useful.
The host initially offered to discount one night of our stay but said she could no longer do that at check out and then never responded when I asked why. The bnb was not far from many locations which was ideal however, I would not recommend staying here.

Marco's place was a great choice for our weekend trip to Chicago. The location is in walking distance to many restaurants, shops, etc. and is only a short ride from downtown. We were very comfortable inside and the space was well thought out with many amenities to help make our stay better. Would definitely recommend.

Really great place in a wonderful area. Close to the great Southport area, Southport train station, walkable to the Belmont CTA stop. Lots of restaurants, shops etc. Whole foods and Walgreens right there. Busy area but the apartment is far in enough that it's super quiet. Cute, very Chicago place.
Awesome stay!

We had a great stay! The space was small but comfortably spacious enough for two people and was perfect for a weekend getaway as a couple. Everything was clean, cozy, and well maintained. The location near Hyde Park was great and made it easy to get around and enjoy the area. Street parking was available. We had options in walking distance and about a 20-35 minute drive to downtown depending on traffic. Our host was also very responsive and had great communication throughout our stay. Overall, we really enjoyed our visit and would definitely stay here again!
Matt was a great host. The apartment was exactly as described. The neighborhood is beautiful and very walkable.

Certainly one of my top Airbnb experiences to date. Philip and Diego put a lot of care into hosting guests in their home and in their neighborhood, and it makes such a difference. Their home is decorated beautifully and has gorgeous light. Every room is comfortable, homey, clean, well-stocked and full of amenities and curated details that stand out.  They were also super responsive and accommodating to our changing travel plans. I also can't say enough about their local recommendations in the area, which they provided in both a guide book and a map in the kitchen. After a very delayed arrival, it was such a relief to wake up to a short list of breakfast options. My only regret was not spending more time in the actual home itself.  11/10 would recommend. I hope to come again!
We had a nice stay

Excellent location. Walkable to Hyde park, science museum, Obama centre, lake shore etc. easy access downtown. Easy parking.
Good value!
Our stay was awesome and easy to find. We were walking distance to a lot of things. Nat was great at checking and making sure we had everything we needed.

Although the smell and smoke alarm issue that we experienced the first day left over from the previous renters left a bad initial impression, the owners communicated with maintenance crews immediately and kept us in the loop on the changes during our stay.
Great host, wonderful unit inside. Matched all descriptions.
The unit was very clean and everything was as described. Clear instructions for check-in and check-out and everything was labeled inside.
Awesome stay
Perfect for our girls trip! Beautiful home and had no issues. Would definitely recommend!
Steve was great and the place was exactly what he said it was. Great spot if you’re staying in chicago.

Jerob, we would like to say thank you for an amazing stay! Your house was absolutely beautiful, and I have to say, this is one of the best Airbnbs we have ever stayed in.
We were there celebrating my husband’s 60th birthday, and we had an amazing time! The house was beautiful, the layout was perfect, and we truly enjoyed every part of it. The neighborhood was quiet, peaceful, and very welcoming. The patio was also beautiful, relaxing, and a great place to sit and enjoy the surroundings.
We didn’t need for anything during our stay. Everything was provided, and whenever we had a question, Jerob was very prompt with his responses.
If you’re looking for an amazing Airbnb, I highly recommend booking with Jerob! You will not be disappointed.
Thank you again, Jerob, for helping make my husband’s 60th birthday celebration so special! ❤️
Great, responsive host with a beautiful home!

I had a wonderful stay!  The neighborhood is beautiful and the hosts were very responsive and accommodating. The place is kept in excellent condition and I would definitely stay there again next time I visit Chicago.
10/10 experience, the host was VERY accommodating and communicative!

Abigail’s place was great for our needs. It was clean and well stocked. Place was as described and felt comfortable and homey. For how steep the price was, I would have appreciated a bit more hospitality, but overall it seemed Abigail attempted to accommodate us where she could.

We went to Chicago for a concert and did not want to stay in the busy downtown area. This house was in a quiet neighborhood away from the hustle bustle of the city, with stores and shopping nearby. The driveway was convenient, as we rented a car to navigate the city. The host sent very detailed instructions as to what to do upon arrival, and everything went very smoothly. The accommodations were just what we needed and the home was very inviting. I did not have to contact the host for anything. But when I sent messages, the response was very prompt. I would definitely stay here again if I make my way back to Chicago.

We came for a weekend getaway/short stay at Laura's place. She was very friendly and forward with communicating and getting/staying in touch with us before and during our visit. The apartment is located in a safe feeling part of town close to a lot of restaurants. You are also right down the street from the pink line access which came in handy for us. The apartment was nicely decorated and welcoming and had many amenities available and extras of things for us if needed. A few things that were not our favorites of the trip were the noise level of outside being able to be easily heard on the inside of the apartment as well as the inside having no ceilings to the bedroom areas so noise and voices travel easily. Also the assigned parking spot for our particular unit was very awkwardly placed and hard to get into and out of easily with our SUV being that we had 4 guests. Overall it was a good stay and we were appreciative of Laura and her responsiveness.

Our host was friendly. However, we felt confined to the bedroom. A male was in the kitchen in pj's when we arrived. She spent a lot of her time in the living room which made us stay in our bedrooms sitting on each other's beds to talk. We also didn't have access to the kitchen. One night they had a family party outside and inside. Again, we were stuck in the bedrooms while the family entertained.
Our stay was a 10/10!!!! Very clean, great area, and communication was super fast!!!!

Our stay was absolutely amazing! The house was extremely clean, beautifully decorated, and had everything we could possibly need. You can tell a lot of thought and care went into making the space comfortable and welcoming. Sheena was a wonderful host kind, helpful, and attentive throughout our stay. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a beautiful, spotless place. 10/10 experience!
They were very responsive prior to our stay and during our stay. Easy to get a hold of.
This was the perfect place for what we needed. Clean and comfy.  The location was convenient to what we needed with plenty of space for my group.
The apartment was exactly as pictured. Clean quiet building. Easy walking to lots of restaurants, bus stops & the train. Would definitely stay there again.
Very nice place!
A gorgeous home in a very quiet neighborhood and close to public transportation, I highly recommend this home for anyone who wants peace and quiet, it was a pleasure to stay at Martha's place!
Loved this place made me feel like i was at a home away from home. Definitely recommend!

It was a great visit. Andrew was a very kind attentive host. He came through a couple times when we had a hiccup on our part which made him so caring. His furnishings were very stylish. Bees confy as heck. We felt home their & safe in the neighborhood. It was close to stores, restaurants & the highway so overall it was a good location & more then served us well. Thank you for hosting us.
Very clean, looks exactly like the pictures, plenty of extra amenities, and very close to O’Hare. Extremely kind and responsive host. Definitely would stay again.
Bien, y cerca del united 🥇

We had a great stay at this beautiful, well furnished apartment.  The flamingo theme was fun and made the place feel more like a home.  Great location in Wicker Park next to a blue line station but still quiet at night.  Highly recommended!!
Great location and great place to stay

This place was perfect for a long weekend in Chicago! We found it to be an easy walking distance to CTA transit, Argyle, Andersonville, and more. The apartment was very cute and Lewis provided everything our group needed.

We had an great stay. The neighborhood was nice and quiet. There was a slight issue with the door lock. But the hosts were very responsive and quick to resolve. We appreciated the quick response and fix. Would definitely stay again!

Melvin is by far such a great host! he is very attentive to his guests. If there is a problem he will fix it, if you want good food, he has the recommendations. Not to mention he tops your visit off with wine.

Unfortunately, our stay was disappointing because the air conditioning was not working properly. This was especially difficult because we were traveling with two elderly women, and keeping the home cool and comfortable was very important.
The heat made it difficult to sleep comfortably and even made getting dressed and ready each day unpleasant. We ultimately had to spend our own money purchasing fans just to make the situation more bearable.
We reached out to the host about the issue and were told that maintenance would come out to address it. However, we never received any follow-up or confirmation as to whether maintenance actually came by or if the issue was resolved.
We expected the basic amenities, especially air conditioning, to be functional during our stay. Better communication, follow-up, and a working AC would have made a significant difference in our experience.

We had such an amazing trip as first-timers in Chicago. This Airbnb was in an ideal location and a short walk to all the amenities you would need (def recommend waterfront cafe for lunch!!!). Linens were fresh and the beds were so cozy! I really appreciate the provided coffee/creamer and loved sipping on it while on the back porch. The place was so clean which I really appreciate. Would definitely stay here again if I ever come back to Chicago. Thanks Elizabeth!!
Was nice wasn’t too far from things would book again

This is a one room efficiency, decorated very tastefully in a great location in Uptown.  It was perfect for my visit.  I didn't cook or do laundry doing my stay, but it was great that I could of, had I wanted to.  Have already recommended this place to others.
Thank you Nicole, you are a good host and the place was very comfortable.
Loved the place!!! Really good for a girls trip or family trip. The extra amenities and outside area is a plus too!
Good clean place with good amenities and kitchen supplies. Great coffee too
great stay
Everything was great will definitely return !!!

What a cool place!  It was perfect for our needs and walking distance to Logan Square and Avondale, where my daughter lives. Comfy beds, high-end amenities, absolutely no complaints.  Russ was very quick to respond to all messages.  Would happily stay again.
This was a great stay for our family- it had all of the amenities that we needed. Great location!

We were in town with 7 family members to celebrate a PA School graduation for our daughter. This home was a great place for us to land and spend time together. As noted in the listing, there is free street parking but, like any city, parking spots can be hard to find. I would recommend taking the train system. There is a stop about a ten minute walk from the home. It was easy to figure out and it was how we did a lot of our transportation while we were there. The home was as advertised and there was plenty of room for all of us. It was in a nice neighborhood and within walking distance of a grocery store and a handful of restaurants. We had a great time and would stay here again.

Helen was absolutely wonderful—so sweet, attentive, and responsive! The Airbnb was in a great location, close to Soldier Field and Chinatown. It was perfect for our couple-day stay. We felt safe the entire time, and the place was peaceful with no outside noise. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back! ❤️

Carrie is an excellent host and the apartment was comfortable, clean, and easy to access what you needed in it. Comfortable beds, and A/C and fans kept the temperature comfortable too. For guests with a dog, like us, it was a perfect set-up and location.
A free clean suite and spacious

We loved our stay here! The space was very clean, everything was in great shape, well decorated, plenty of space for our family of 5, and had everything we needed. We have 3 kids, and there were several thoughtful touches in the space that made it feel like home. It was in a great location with lots to do and on a very accessible street. Troy was very hospitable and responsive. We wished we could have stayed longer!
Beautiful home, would definitely revisit.

We had such a great time here. The location is awesome, and walkable to some great restaurants. The neighborhood was safe, and the houses were beautiful. The drive to and from downtown Chicago wasn’t bad at all - and the location is right by O’Hare airport! We would definitely stay again. Great place!
Nice stay
We enjoyed staying here. There is plenty to do close by in the neighborhood, and downtown isn't too far. Parking was also easy.

Saurin's place was just as described and pictured in the listing. The shared living room, dining area and kitchen are all beautiful open concept spaces with lots of natural light. We had a private locked bedroom with a comfortable bed and a large closet to hang our clothes and keep our belongings orderly. The bathroom was shared but we had no issues with the other guest that was staying there. We were so happy to find such an affordable option close to the city center.
We would highly recommend Saurin's condo to others and would gladly return again.

L'appartamento è bellissimo e le foto sull'annuncio non le rendono giustizia! Il garage è stato un plus per noi e la vicinanza al centro (10 minuti di auto) ma allo stesso tempo la riservatezza di esserne fuori è stato da noi molto apprezzato! L'unica cosa è che accedendo dal garage l'accesso non è stato proprio comodo con le valigie. Per il resto abbiamo comunicato all'host (sempre super reattivo) che la pulizia non è stata a 5 stelle quindi confidiamo potrà migliorarla! il nostro soggiorno nel complesso però è stato bellissimo e porteremo con noi un meraviglioso ricordo!

Our stay was great! We were in town for a concert at the United center and this was in the perfect spot. Close to the west loop too, which we loved. We never felt unsafe or uncomfortable. The host was always prompt with responses and even reached out unsolicited to check in, great hospitality!

We traveled from the DC Baltimore area to do our fantasy draft with a coworker who moved out to Chicago. The process was seamless, and the place was perfect. The area felt very safe and many bars and restaurants in the area. The dugout bar below was a fun stop in the evening. I would highly recommend this place for large groups.

We had a lovely time. It was quite dusty- we could not even turn on the fans for fear clumps would fall on us. But the location was great and the space was wonderful for our large group. We would definitely stay again.

Stayed here with 7 of my friends and the house was in great condition. The location was in good proximity to lots of touristy spots (20-30 mins). Only thing is we arrived earlier than expected and wanted to check in 30 minutes early but couldn’t without being charged quite a hefty fee but aside from that, we truly did enjoy our stay. The host was very communicative, space was clean, they had suggestions for things to do in the area, etc. Would definitely stay here again on another trip to Illinois!
Thank you for the perfect and pleasant stay. Place was everything I needed it to be for my trip to Chicago.
Wonderful place to stay for a trip in a great neighborhood of Chicago. Ingo and Lynn were gracious and responsive hosts!

Overall a great experience.  Milan was great at communicating. Only issue we had when we arrived is for whatever reason it was hard to see the street number on the door and drove past a few times trying to figure out where it was. But the instructions that were sent were very clear and he didn’t leave anything out. We needed to ask for some more bed linens because there wasn’t enough for the air mattress, but he contacted the front desk who was able to bring something to us almost immediately. There wasn’t enough some kind of food wrapper left behind on the bedroom floor, which made us question how thoroughly the cleaning crew went through. The rooftop seating area was a nice place to go in the evening. We were able to walk to the field museum no problem. It was about a 1.5 mile walk which was fine for us.  There were 3 kinds under 13 and we didn’t feel unsafe at all walking from this location. Parking was gated/locked and easily accessed from directly across the street.
Aibiike was very responsive and helpful throughout the trip! Location was perfect! The house was in a beautiful location! We will definitely be back!

Had a wonderful 22 days stay , this is the longest time I’ve ever stayed at an air bnb .
There was a slight glitch with the door but Ken got it fixed and it was fine. The apartment had everything that I needed , Hanna checked me in and also left cofeee pods and coconut water , much appreciated.
It’s about 40 -45 mins on the red line to downtown , the train station is about a 5 min walk .
The host was very helpful and friendly. Thank you

Great stay! The space was cozy, comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed. It was perfect for our stay and we felt right at home. Everything was easy and convenient, and we had a great overall experience. I truly appreciate the hospitality and would definitely book again. Thank you for having us!

The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. Check-in was easy, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout. The location was convenient with plenty to do nearby. Everything we needed was provided, and the space felt welcoming from the moment we arrived. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend to anyone visiting the area
would definitely book again

Very peaceful apartments that match the description of the photos presented on the ad as far as size and space. We did have issues with it being a lower level unit with spiders and thousand legs throughout the night. Some sealant could help that. Hair all over the shower. Some extra wash clothes would have been nice, for we only had one between two people. It worked out for our short stay but, would question if I would book again. Other than that easy check-in and definitely was responsive!
This was the perfect place centrally located to get ready for my wedding at with my bridesmaids. The natural light and roof deck upstairs were amazing!
Not a bad spot with good amenities

Foi maravilhosa , a casa é um charme , cozinha e banheiro muito bem equipados , a anfitriã Millie é uma simpatia , prestativa e eficiente e me fez sentir em casa .
