Great place to stay! Andrea was very helpful and kind. The home itself was very cozy and clean and looked really cool. The backyard and garden were very pretty as well!

The place was great, it fit everyone with beds to spare!! The layout was cool, the kids loved it! I would stay here again! Lots of things to do within walking distance with the best tamales ever just 2 blocks away!! Great weekend!!

This was a stressful trip for me as I was moving my youngest into college. The beautiful tree lined street and comfortable home made it so much better. Mary was always receptive to any questions I had. I was able to focus on my daughter and come back to a quiet and peaceful home after the chaos of moving her in. Thank you so much, Mary. Will definitely stay again.
Nice place to stay for the weekend and close to downtown
Reliable when needed, relaxing, good for family travel, first time in chicago was a great experience
Great Stay
Really cool space, great location

Great stay! Easy to locate. Struggled with parking and Ubers as a few streets were closed off for fairs and festivals. Check in process was mostly easy other than a missing passcode for the front door entry? Apartment/kitchen/bathroom were all very clean and welcoming. Marijes responded promptly to help sort out any questions we had and the booking process was relatively quick and easy.

Nice apartment in a building full of rental flats. The neighborhood is really nice, feels safe, and offers free street parking. It’s a good apartment — well-equipped, sunny, and spacious for two. The furniture and appliances were solid, though the only issue is that they were probably bought a while ago, everything is somewhat used or stained. It was generally clean, but there was dust on the ceiling and higher cupboards in the kitchen and bathroom. The iron was broken. One thing to mention is that the AC was quite loud. Considering prices in Chicago and other options, this was definitely worth it, and we would recommend staying here. It would be great if the owners did a major clean-up and replaced some items with new ones.
Don’t hesitate to book this place. Perfect location for this part of the city near Lincoln Square, easy walking to many restaurants and cafes. Our hosts were easy and responsive. Place was great!
I plan to return and will recommend to friends and family!!
We had a great stay. Thanks Jevaux for being a fantastic host. Everything was fabulous!

The apartment was clean and pleasant to stay in. Several lightbulbs were burned out, but when I contacted Regina about this she responded immediately and supplied new ones. The tabletop TV was arranged against a wall that had no electrical outlet, which was odd to say the least. In the bathroom there was a notice about the water pressure in the shower being weak, but in my opinion it was acceptable. Overall, the unit was as advertised and we had an enjoyable stay.

Heather’s place was perfect for our family gathering for a wedding in Chicago! So comfortable and welcoming. Heather was an amazing host. She was flexible, accommodating and responsive! This was among the beat airbnb experiences we have ever had!

Very nice place. Any hiccups they accommodated us right away!
We had a great weekend:)
This apartment was stunning! It somehow looked even better than the pictures. The hosts were also very helpful and proactive. I’d recommend this to anyone looking for a place to stay in Chicago :)
Had two very minor situations and the host was very understanding and generous. More than anything I appreciate the the the patience

Amazing Stay
Absolutely loved our stay! The Airbnb was beautiful, clean, comfortable, and had everything we could have possibly needed. The space was even better than expected, and you could tell the hosts really put thought into making their guests feel welcome.
The location was great, the home was exactly as described, and communication with the host was quick and easy. We felt comfortable the entire time and honestly didn’t want to leave!
I would 100% recommend staying here and would definitely book again. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A great stay. Host was very responsive and helpful. Exactly as described would definitely recommend

Andrew and Lauren were incredibly accommodating and very responsive to every question we had. Their place was decorated beautifully and the beds were very comfortable. The location is excellent and very walkable to restaurants while also being on a quiet street. We highly recommend staying at their place.
Great location and quiet. Perfect for my weekend stay in Chicago. Catherine was very responsive and a great host!

Such a nice place to stay! Place was clean and comfortable and good for 8 of us who stayed here. Our only recommendation would be for more mirrors. I will also say that this place wasnt super close to any subway lines but nonetheless in a great neighborhood and we loved staying in Logan Square!
Our group loved the stay here, Andy was extremely communicative and accommodating! The area is extremely walkable with lots to do!
Really great place in a nice neighborhood!

After driving all day, I arrived at the Airbnb late in the evening, checked the app and messages for check-in instructions, and there weren’t any. I messaged and called Bella and it took 45 minutes for a response. She said she had emailed instructions, which didn’t make sense because I’d never provided my email address and I’ve never communicated with a host via email before. Nevertheless I checked, including spam folders, and didn’t have anything.
The studio is very cute and actually seemed larger than the photos. The only thing lacking is knives. If you’re planning to cook, bring your own.
Do not pay for the parking spot offered unless you have a very small car. I have a midsize SUV and couldn’t use the spot. Also there are rats in the back alley where the spot is located. It is a large city so not too surprising. Parking on the street is challenging, as most of the streets close by require permits for parking. Be prepared to walk a ways.

The host was very communicative and welcoming. He reached out before our arrival and came by to introduce himself when we got there, which I appreciated. The location was also nice and convenient.
Unfortunately, the accommodations themselves did not meet my expectations based on the listing. The listing describes a “patio,” but what is actually provided is more of a small stoop with no chairs or sitting area. The apartment is also located down a set of stairs and felt very much like a basement apartment. There was very little natural sunlight, which contributed to that feeling.
I was also disappointed with the kitchen setup. There were no drinking glasses or cups available, and the host ultimately had his son bring me Solo cups to use for wine. Part of the Airbnb experience, in my opinion, is having the basic comforts of a home—being able to cook, use dishes, have a proper cup or glass, etc. The dishes and kitchenware also appeared quite old, with only one coffee cup and two spoons a

Sarah’s place was a perfect destination for my family’s visits to Chicago’s Rogers Park neighborhood. Exactly as pictured and described, the space was sparkling clean. Our weather was perfect so we were out in Rogers Park, Andersonville and other Chicago neighborhoods but we loved the back deck for morning coffee and a rainy day would have offered a pleasant chance to gather in the living and dining room. Perfect location for walking to restaurants on Broadway and Clark or enjoying the lake! The apartment was very clean and quiet. It was a little tricky getting into the building and the unit since there are several locks to try but once you get a hang of it it's fine.
Very clean , nice A/C in both rooms and living room .. I will definitely book again !!!

We enjoyed our stay and didn't hvae any issues! We would come back again
Thanks

My sister and I stayed here for the Usher and Chris Brown concert and a Sox game. Being within walking distance of McCormick Place, Wintrust Arena and other attractions was great.
It was a quiet stay super easy to get in and out off

Emily’s apartment was so cute and perfect. I felt right at home with her eclectic decor and comfortable furnishings! Beds were SO COMFY. The A/C worked great and I love that there was a timer on it so that it didn’t run while we were out of the house.
Emily was also a really kind and responsive host. She has a local shop we were able to walk to and it had so many cute trinkets, jewelry, and souvenirs!
The location do the apt is also pristine. It’s in an area of Wicker where there is still a lot to see, but not the heart of Wicker where it’s over crowded and super loud. Although, we could walk to Wicker Proper easily! Absolutely loved our stay and would love to come back!
Great place to stay! The place is super clean and well taken care of. Lots of room for lots of guests. 10/10, would definitely stay here again.
Great uptown location with easy access to buses and trains. Clean, quiet, and a helpful host. Thanks for a perfect stay.
Great location would stay again
Clean place, really cute vibe, great location - we had a wonderful stay here!! And a lovely time in Chicago!
Great place in a great location. Great communication from host.

Great location and unit set up! Very responsive host. Only downside was that there was not sufficient keys/ fobs for the group to get into the unit (only 2 for a group of 10) so some coordination was needed.
Amy was great, I had a great stay.  Perfect trip.  Thanks!

This place is great — excellent location, clean, and well-stocked.  The air mattress and pack-n-play were especially helpful for our baby.  Nicole and Matt were excellent and responsive hosts.  Highly recommend.
Thank you for the stay!
Apartment was very nice and convenient to the festivities that was happening. Enjoyed the stay.

Danny's place was great and had a very convenient location with lots of nearby cafes, restaurants, parks and playgrounds. It is also very suitable to stay with children/toddlers as it had a large crib, fun toys and children's books. He had plenty of towels and pillows ready, and we found everything we needed. It was very helpful that Danny provided us a safe place to store our luggages before check-in or after check-out. We'd be happy to come back.
Kyriako was very responsive during my entire stay , very professional I’ll definitely visit again i highly recommend.

This unit was a great location for our wknd plans. It was just enough space for us to have a few friends over before and after our eventful wknd. I would definitely rent this space again although I was able to tell that the unit was lived in right up until we rented. (1st posting) There were items left behind. (Including a pile of clutter w/underwear left on the side of a dresser) Yesinia was very responsive when needed. It was a fairly quiet neighborhood . With a little more TLC this unit would be perfect for ANYONE's Chicago stay. Yesinia, when you see this review, please reach out. I had plans to gift your unit a few items but time didn't permit. I'd still like to be a blessing to your space. Thanks for the stay!
Good neighborhood, nice place very roomy. No complaints.

We had such a wonderful 3-day stay in Chicago! The place was exactly as described and looked just like the photos. It was cozy, comfortable, and truly felt like a home away from home—I honestly felt like I lived there for a few days! The bed was incredibly comfortable, which made it even harder to leave. I also loved being so close to my childhood neighborhood, which made the trip extra special and nostalgic for me. I would definitely stay here again! Jordan was amazing and super responsive! I’d love to comeback and stay again!
Great location and views. Very comfortable for our group of 5
Amazing stay, thank you!

David was a great host. The check in process wasn’t the easiest. Yet David was very accommodating once I was able to speak with him. The place was nice, just as expected. I would definitely recommend and stay here again!

The house was nice, and it was fairly clean. Besides the top bunk which had some kind of solidified liquid stuck on the cover. We were out late enjoying the city and we came home late, took our showers and when I got in the bed that was what I found. Gerry did in fact call his cleaning guys to quickly clean the mess (in the morning), and apologized for the miss hap. I payed a lot of money to be able to sleep comfortably, I had to grab 2 couches and put them together. We had to purchase an air mattress bc there weren’t actually 5 beds. We had 8 guest, 6 of which were a couple, who would like to sleep in the same bed with their partner.  I guess the fine print that he wrote in order to make it add up to the bnb having 5 beds was the inclusion of the “couch and a cot” which aren’t beds. I asked him if he could provide us with an air mattress but he was insistent on us using the cot and the couch. He later got us an air mattress the (last night). As a way to apologize for the miss hap.

Overall, this property is in an awesome neighborhood and that makes up for some shortcoming in other areas. The living room was a nice space with relatively new furniture. The bathroom was compact but recently renovated and the shower was nice.
My biggest issue with this unit is the bedding. First, there is a queen bed - no problem there. Then, there is a double bed that has a cheap, foam mattress that is probably 5 inches thick and it sags to one side. In the last room there is a short futon that is too small for anyone larger than a child and an air mattress which deflates throughout the night. Lastly, the pillows throughout the unit are super cheap and thin - a little better than balling up a t-shirt and using it as a pillow. All of these issues can be remedied with a little investment.
Overall, this place has potential but for the price we paid we were underwhelmed. We were out exploring the city a lot so realistically all we needed was a good place to sleep, which it was not.
We had a wonderful weekend at Bel’s place! Everything was clean, the beds were comfy, and it was easy to access public transport to get into the city.
James’s place was great - excellent location and incredible views. The decor is definitely outdated but it didn’t impact our stay. Pool area was amazing. Wish there was patio furniture on the patio.
This place was everything and more!

We really enjoyed our stay! The Airbnb was super cute, clean, comfortable, and nicely decorated, and we had a great time overall.
One thing I would mention for future guests is the visitor policy. The listing stated that additional guests could not stay overnight, but we did not see anything saying that visitors were not allowed at all. We even went back and reread the rules after the host messaged us when two friends who live locally stopped by for a short visit, and we still couldn’t find where it clearly stated that no visitors were permitted. I completely respect the host’s rules, but I think this would be helpful to make very clear in the listing so guests know what to expect before booking. Also, the host lives right next to the property, so guests should be aware that there is a fairly close on-site presence and the property is monitored pretty closely. This wasn’t a problem for us, but it’s something I think future guests would appreciate knowing beforehand. Very cute + clean!

Allen was very responsive and helpful. We were in town for a family event and the location was great. There were a few things  that caught us by surprise. The two larger bedrooms were in a converted attic space and were good size. However the walls did not go completely to the ceiling. This means that conversations in one room were clearly heard in the other. If using the bathroom at night the light woke up everyone. It does say in the description to be mindful you are staying in someone's home. I unfortunately did not take that literally. The refrigerator was full of food and cabinets had zip ties on them. I understand but this made us uncomfortable.
Great & beautiful home .. would definitely stay again

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Our stay in Chicago was absolutely PERFECT! The house was beautiful, clean, and decorated so nicely—the pictures honestly do not do it justice. It was even more beautiful in person, and we felt comfortable from the moment we arrived.
Our host was AMAZING! He was very attentive, checked in on us throughout our stay, and genuinely made sure we were comfortable and safe. That extra level of care really stood out and made our experience even better.
Everything about this stay exceeded our expectations. If you’re looking for a beautiful place in Chicago with a wonderful host, I HIGHLY recommend booking here. We had an amazing girls’ trip and would definitely stay again! ❤️✨ 10/10 experience!
Great stay, would recommend it!

Manuel’s place was the perfect location for our weekend in Chicago. It is a quick walk to the red line and Wrigley Field. The street is lively at night due to nightclubs but that didn’t bother us. Manuel had ear plugs in each room upon arrival in case we needed them. The home itself is very clean and cozy.
Great location!
Communication was prompt and responsive, location was great, parking spot a big plus and unit had everything we needed.

We had a wonderful stay at Kari’s place! The home is beautiful, the kitchen has everything you could possibly need, and the sunroom was the perfect place to enjoy our morning coffee. We’d love to stay again!
The space made my family feel right at home loved it

Great location, clean,  looked as shown. Responsive host - he quickly Amazon primed us trash bags when there was none left. Toilet paper was not stocked as well but other than these two easily fixable things, the spot was great and I’d definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone !
Easy way in and out, close to public transport.
Phenomenal. Place was better than the pictures and Natalie was amazing. They even mailed a jacket we left behind. One of my best Airbnb experiences ever.
Relatively decent location that is very close to the rail.  Noisy due to nature of location as noted from other reviews.   The space itself is good for a weekend trip.

Tim’s place was perfect for my stay! Great location, and a nice option while traveling alone. There was train noise if you’re a light sleeper, but didn’t bother me and the proximity to the red line was a plus ):

We used this apartment for a long weekend with a group of friends, it was very comfortable for seven people. The beds are all kings with comfortable mattresses and linens. Bathrooms were extremely clean. The kitchen has basic items but not what you’d need for any involved cooking. The location is great, quick few minute walk to a Whole Foods, brewery, coffee etc and felt very safe at night.
The common space is small and not very comfortable for more than 3-4 ppl at a time.
Overall, a very functional and comfortable base for our group!
Great stay! If you’re super sensitive to noise (train), it might not be the right place for you. But the house is great and the location is hard to beat! Would definitely stay again!

Our group had a wonderful stay in Wrigleyville at Jason’s property. The location was conveniently located to great restaurants and bars, while being easily accessible to Chicago’s downtown. The property itself was clean, comfortable, and had more than enough space for our group of 8 guests. Would highly recommend staying here!
Danny was responsive, warm and helpful. The place was great. Beautiful vacation.

The organization of everything in this small space made me so happy! As said by others, it is cozy. The bed was comfy. Everything was clean. The sofa wasn’t great for sitting and watching a movie, but if there is just one or two of you, this space has everything you need. In addition, there were complimentary snacks and drinks and all kinds of extra things organized neatly in the bathroom. We were lucky and had beautiful weather and sitting in the patio swing reading while waiting for time for our train was glorious. I may have taken a short nap! Gloria was very responsive and helpful while providing the privacy we prefer. We chose the space because it is three blocks from our son we were visiting and so happy we found it. Anytime we visit, we will be back.
A wonderful spot in a great location!

Our weekend stay in Chicago was absolutely wonderful! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, beautifully located, and had everything we needed for a relaxing getaway. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in and check-out incredibly easy. We loved being close to Chicago’s amazing restaurants, attractions, and downtown sights. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

Our host was very pleasant, responsive, and thorough. The place was really clean and tidy upon arrival, and overall it was very cozy and comfortable.
My only “complaints” would be that the rooms were pretty small and the shower didn’t have any shelving or a place to put personal items while bathing. Neither was a major issue, just something to note.
The neighborhood was super quiet and clean, and we felt safe the entire time. There were even little bunnies in the backyard here and there, which was so cute!
I also didn’t realize before booking that there were other units on the property, but we had absolutely no problems with that during our stay. Everything was peaceful, we had our privacy, and overall we really enjoyed our stay.
The property was perfect! We enjoyed our stay❤️
Perfect location, peaceful would definitely return if I visit Chicago again
Zheng is an excellent host and always down for a chat about local Chicago recommendations. It was a great short stay and location is excellent (close to red line train which takes you downtown)

This stay is great when it comes to location and responsive hosts. The place was booked last minute and was a smooth process overall. Our only concern was having a deeper cleaning done to the property. Other than that, great hosts and location.
This airbnb was a fine place to stay. Location was good - it’s a central location with short uber rides to everywhere. It was clean. Comfort wise it was okay.
The place was as described in their listing, and Song and Dillon were both exceptionally responsive and helpful.

Had a great short stay in this apt. It was very easy to check into with clear instructions. The place was incredibly clean. The neighborhood is great and it’s a close walk to the red CTA line and Wrigley Field. Host was very responsive and quick to communicate. I would definitely stay here again!

Great place.  Clean.  Beds had multiple pillows. Bathrooms had multiple towels.  So well done.  Many places have 2 pillows on beds and lack of towels and supplies.  Well done.  Clean.  Well decorated.  Exactly as described.   Love the fire pit.  Thank You for hosting my family.  We had a great time.  Highly recommend place.
Enjoyed our stay! Felt like I was in a cabin somewhere in a forest and not in Chicago. Host was responsive to questions and the space fit our needs. It was definitely spacious for two people.
Great place to stay! Host was very communicative and place is exactly as described. Good area.

The house was absolutely beautiful inside. Train station was a 3 minute walk so we were able to go to the city with zero hassle. Junni was a phenomenal host. I received a response within 5 minutes of reaching out every single time. Junni was extremely kind and helpful throughout the booking process. One of the best experiences I’ve had at an air bnb. I would HIGHLY recommend staying at Junnis place!
This is a nice place- quiet, clean and clean. Rachel was very responsive and we had a nice stay. Would use it again.

My stay was wonderful. We enjoyed the comfortable atmosphere. I felt as if I was at home. He was very responsive and went beyond to make sure we were comfortable and to help with any issues, concerns or problems. I would stay here any time when I’m in the Chicago area and would recommend him to anyone I know!!

The stay here was very nice, and it was within walking distance of an event I attended. The room was on the third floor and smelled very clean when I arrived. I was lucky to get there just in time to grab a free parking spot that was suggested. There were a lot of shops and restaurants nearby. The neighborhood felt really safe.

We were in town for a concert and had a great stay at Elizabeth’s place. It was clean and cute just like the photos! The bed was huge and amazing, so comfy! The neighborhood is great and quiet and close to many things in the city. Elizabeth is a great host and responds quickly. She even helped us when we needed our car battery jumped!

Loved Brett’s place! Very clean, loved that there was ramen available as well for a midnight snack. The speakeasy was fun, and we loved the Bluetooth speaker as well so we could listen to some tunes. That really was the best toilet ever! Bed was comfortable and the whole place was just great! Would stay here again. It was easily walkable and lots of great places nearby! A few recommendations: Candor for coffee, Kasama for the most delicious breakfast, Taxim for delicious Greek food!
Clean, comfortable place.

I can't say enough good things about Lesley's place.  Whenever I come to Chicago, I look for her place first.  It's exactly the right location for me, it's private, well thought-out and has everything I need and nothing I don't.  There's even parking always available for my pickup truck.  Sometimes I have to go around the block a few times, but a parking spot always seems to open up and it's free.  And Lesley herself is just the sweetest person.
The place was amazing and so was the host! Made for a perfect girls weekend destination!!
We had a wonderful visit here and hope to come back soon. Very nice!

This place was everything we needed it to be! Cozy, clean, within walking distance of many restaurants and attractions right in the heart of downtown Chicago. Ping's communication was top tier! Just be aware that you have to pay for parking. It's reasonable unless there's a special event happening where it's higher. Nonetheless,  it wouldn't deter me from booking this place again. It really was in the perfect location if you're wanting to stay downtown. When I visit again I hope this place will be available!
Great location! Close to everything! Provided wonderful snacks.
Great stay, home is definitely advertised how it is online which was good…No complaints definitely recommend especially if you’re visiting with a big group.

Great location, clean & comfortable. Parking was available in front of the unit & it was an easy Uber ride to downtown.  Brittney was friendly & checked in with us during our stay.  Perfect spot for a weekend trip to Chicago!

Our stay here was great! The place was not only as described but the host was extremely helpful with all the necessary details and questions we had. The place is in a perfect walking location to pretty much everything and we traveled on the train so it was perfectly located next to the train station with luggage storage for us to explore without needing to lug everything around. It was super convenient! Would 100% stay here again!
Wunderschöne Unterkunft mit toller Lage. Tippi war sehr freundlich. Würde ich definitiv weiterempfehlen.
Great location. Comfortable. Shower didn't work which was a bit of a problem.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this amazing space. The location is unbeatable for a walkable stay in Chicago. The view is unparalleled...from Northeastern Navy Pier...due South to the White Sox Stadium...and Southwestern sunsets... Amazing!
If you’re going to an event at the United Center it’s a great location proximity-wise. The property is also spacious. Jorge’s communication was clear and timely during the stay.
Nice place. Very close to downtown. Had a great time. No complaints.

Clean and comfortable place
Our group really enjoyed it
Dave was kind enough to let us check in early
Thank you Dave !!

It was my first time in Chicago and solo traveling. I absolutely love the location. A ten minute walk to the blue line, great restaurants nearby and of course beautiful Wicker Park itself. The trek down the stairs to the unit is a little daunting, the smell of the bathroom is a little off, and the bed is a little uncomfortable but other than that it’s the perfect spot. The hosts were quick to respond and allowed me to store my bags for a bit before I needed to leave. The rooftop deck was gorgeous I wish I had more time to hang out there. I think an additional lock on the unit door would be nice for female solo travelers like me! Would stay again.

It’s a beautiful place that’s definitely worth the money. It’s conveniently located near the train station, so you’ll be in downtown Chicago in just a few minutes. Plus, it’s close to Chinatown, which is a great place to eat and learn about the history of the area. I highly recommend this place!
Great location and space
Beautiful views, great parking option, and walking distance to do many things. Would absolutely stay again.
Really great space in a fun neighborhood. Super clean, well appointed and the owners were very responsive.
It’s exactly what you pay for. A spacious stay in a wonderful neighborhood just no frills. Loved the balcony at night.
Matthew was responsive and very helpful throughout my stay.
Pretty convenient place to stay. Place is very comfortable. 15 min walk to the blue line, and there is a bus stop at the door.
I would gladly stay here again!
David was awesome, and helped a lot. Even when it was a late he went out of his way to make sure we had no issues.

Y’all. This place is amazing! Walking distance to Chinatown and all its’ restaurants and shops. It’s close to the red line making getting around easy if we wanted to get downtown quickly. It was clean. It had all the items we needed for eating, showering, and an entire stand for tea. The beds and bed linens were comfy and clean. The host did mention train noise, but it wasn’t as loud as I thought it would be and didn’t disturb my sleep. There was a bowl of mints by the door! The two in one washer/dryer was loaded with detergent and was easy to use as well. All in all, I would stay here again. Thank you all for hosting such a great space!

This was the perfect stay for our family of four - with two young kiddos. Always felt safe in the area and walking about. It’s a bit of a walk to the train but very doable. Would recommend!! Jean was friendly and even said hi to us! I liked the double locked doors.
Communicates well! Responsive

Just book it! These guys already have so many good reviews that there’s really not much to add :) I completely agree with all the positive things people have written. If you stay with them, it’ll be more than just an ordinary stay — it’ll be an experience, because even just chatting with Ronaldo and Carla is so much fun! They’re both so positive and friendly, and they make you feel welcome from the start. And they have some really cool neighbors too :) I didn’t hesitate to book it, and you shouldn’t either, especially if you’re a solo traveler. The apartment looks exactly as shown in the pictures. The bedroom is small, but who cares when the hosts, the whole apartment, and the whole neighborhood are so nice! That was the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at, and I’ll be happy to come back! Muchas gracias, amigos! :)

As always, she is an amazing host! She is the only host I choose because she is incredibly accommodating, professional, and always responds so quickly. I truly appreciate her excellent communication and consistently wonderful hospitality.
The location, environement and views were spot on!
great place to stay, walking distance from so many restaurants. 10 min drive from downtown chicago. great price for 4 beds

Rubi was a great host! Very responsive and welcoming. The description of the home was accurate, like many state the stairs are pretty steep. Overall a great location, a little far out from downtown. No complaints overall about our stay!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. We especially appreciated the thoughtful extras and attention to detail, which made us feel truly welcome. You can tell the host really cares about creating a comfortable experience for guests. We would definitely stay here again!

The location is amazing if you’re wanting quick access to public transportation. Easy walk to the L. Other reviews wrote about creaky floors. They are creaky but it’s an old building so not much can be done about that. Front Door was hard to open but finally got it. Living room furniture is incredibly uncomfortable. Beds were okay but nothing fabulous. Owner lives on the premises too just fyi. No access to outside backyard or anything. Worked okay for us since we were exploring most of the time we were there but may not for others. Shower was nice and place was clean. It was acceptable for what we needed it for but nothing special.

My husband stayed at this Airbnb to attend the Fretboard Summit near Lincoln Square and he said it was very clean, nice amenities and a great location.  He had no complaints and would stay there again!

Came in town for a family reunion, I literally booked the same day I checked in and the place was beautiful, the pictures did no justice , very clean, very cozy  and modern !! I’m born and raised in Chicago been gone 10 years and glad I can come back home to such a Gem in my old neighborhood, the block was clean and quiet and near plenty of great fast food restaurants, the host was very proactive and didn’t hassles us everything was just pleasant and I look forward to booking again in the near future . Thank you so much guy my stay was a pleasure ❤️

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this Airbnb on the South Side of Chicago! The space was exceptionally clean, beautifully updated, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The thoughtful touches really made the experience special—from the toiletries and snacks provided to the bottle of rosé waiting for the birthday girl! 🥂💕
The host provided amazing service and was incredibly quick and easy to communicate with. You can truly tell that they care about their guests and go above and beyond to make sure you have a great stay.
We had such a great experience and would absolutely stay here again. 10/10—definitely will be back! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The host house is located in a cosy and relaxing area. I really enjoyed the stay.

We had a wonderful stay at this lovely two-bedroom apartment! It was exceptionally clean, quiet, and comfortable, with every amenity you could possibly need for a relaxing stay. The hosts were responsive and quick to answer any questions. We also appreciated the easy street parking, which made things especially convenient. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

Caroline's place was the best. A great location in Chicago around a lot of places to walk to. Whether its dining, a Cubs game, or local shops - so many options to choose from. The place was very cozy and relaxing. Caroline's response to any questions we had were prompt and very informative.
Enjoyed the weekend in wicker park. Very nice place at a reasonable price point.
Great space. Neighbors were friendly. Garage is definitely convenient

We truly enjoyed our stay at Charissa’s place. She welcomed us at the door and gave us a quick tour of the place.  Everything was pristine and beautiful. The mattress was great and the bedding high quality. We enjoyed walking around the neighborhood admiring the architecture and finding places to eat. We also took the bus to the Loop - very convenient! We would definitely stay at Charissa’s place again!
Great location, walking distance to heart of Gold Coast
Excellent location and a perfect, cozy spot for a group of us friends getting together.

Place is easy to find and very walkable.
I was really appreciative of the $215 refund given to me as I ended up not bringing my dog.
Overall it is a great stay! Thanks…

Jhon's place was clean, spacious, and in a great location. The neighborhood and building felt very safe and there was plenty to do within walking distance.
There's an Indian restaurant called Essence of India a couple of doors down that I loved, if you're looking for a food recommendation.
Lisa home is wonderful! She’s very attentive and responsive. The property is well located and there’s parking which is a must in the city.
Tian was great with communication, the home felt cozy. I loved that she had good products not the cheap stuff. Highly recommend!

We stayed over the weekend and it was perfect for our weekend getaway. Very close to inner city which made it even better! You do share the house with others but each door is securely locked with its own unique code. All the guest that stayed were to themselves and it was pretty quiet and chill.
Recommend for the price! Really good deal all around!

Great place— very clean and spacious. Only notes were that the property sits directly on top of a train track, so there is some noise from that when the train passes through (manageable, but noticeable).
Toole’s place in Wicker Park was perfect for our family visit. It was clean, convenient and nicely appointed.  We would come again!
Beautiful and comfortable carriage house. Enjoyed our weekend stay in Wicker Park!

We had a wonderful experience at Janet's.  The space is beautifully styled with top notch amenities.  We love the Lincoln Square/Ravenswood area, full of tree lined streets, families, restaurants and boutique shopping.  We even enjoyed an evening glass of wine with our host and neighbors in their serene yard setting.  Would definitely book again!
Great experience!  The Air BnB is delightful and centrally located.  The hosts were responsive and gave clear instructions.  I heartily recommend!

This place is really lovely and Carla is an excellent host. The unit is quirky and the front yard is wild (loved saying good morning to the ladies (chickens) every day). There were fresh eggs in the fridge and she was responsive and friendly. This place is a great location to hop on a bus or catch the L to downtown or anywhere else (strongly recommend the ventra unlimited ride pass to save $).
Fantastic spot! Right next to a bus stop for easy transportation and the place itself was perfect! We would happily stay here again and recommend it to others.

Everything was wonderful! The apartment was beautiful, comfortable, spotless, well-organized, and had everything we needed. The location was excellent and very convenient.
Justin was an amazing host—always attentive, helpful, and willing to assist with anything we needed. We had a truly wonderful experience from start to finish and would absolutely stay here again. We highly recommend it!

Ross's place is great. Clean, very spacious, comfortable, great location. The only thing to mention is if you are relying on using the elevator, it isn't always available due to maintenance. We would book Ross's place again!

I cant say enough about how great the place was.  There was a lot of room.  There were so many restaurants and bars around but there was very little street noise in the apartment.  There was a little noise from the residents above but that is to be expected.  It was well stocked.  We will be back for sure!
Cozy place to stay at with friends. Plenty of places nearby to walk to. Near the L train. Very nice overall.

Place was great. It was exactly what we were expecting. Host was responsive. Place was easy to find and walkable to lot of restaurants, breweries and short walk to beach and zoo. Only thing is bedrooms upstairs can get extremely bright early in the morning because of the windows. We would stay here again in the future.
Beautiful home that was perfect as a home base for a guy's trip. Was only 4 of, but there was plenty of room for many others if needed. Clear instructions and a very easy and enjoyable experience.
Super clean and well kept! Simply lovely.
Clean and very quiet
Great place close to restaurants, coffee shops, and easy access to Blue Line train to downtown and other neighborhoods.
Enjoyed our time in Chicago! Laura, thank you for hosting us:)

Was it the cutest, most aesthetic Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in? No. Was the shower kind of hard to figure out? Yes. Were there cleaners and trash from the previous occupant still there when I arrived after check-in? Also yes. But Marijes was also a very responsive host to my concerns and also apologetic and gave me a small refund. The instructions to get in were clear and the apartment itself is in a great neighborhood with easy access to the beach and the subway. Compared to some other Airbnbs I’ve been in I wouldn’t say it was worthy of an “excellent” rating, but it’s a perfectly decent place for someone looking for a private and convenient spot to stay in just outside downtown Chicago.

Me and my family enjoyed our 2 night stay at Robert’s place! The condo was very nice- clean and cozy! There was ample space and plenty of towels, sheets, and pillows for use! A tv in every room was a nice addition as well- also, there was plenty of cleaning supplies in the kitchen and bathroom. Any concerns or questions I had, Robert answered in a matter of minutes. We didn’t have any issues within the neighborhood during our stay as well. Well worth the price paid ❤️

This Airbnb was very spacious and very comforting! Our host's name was Radu and he was very accommodating and very welcoming! We received a welcome gift from the host which made our day a whole lot better after being stuck in a part of Chicago's chaotic traffic. My friends and I (group of 10) booked a stay here for 5 days. The bathrooms were very clean and the kitchen had everything we pretty much needed. The bedrooms were very comfortable and made us feel right at home. The living areas were very comforting as well!
If you are new to Chicago, it may be a bit overwhelming to find the parking area in the back as we did. The parking is tight, but it is still manageable. You are able to get out of your cars, but with only some space between the vehicle and the buildings in the parking area. There were some street parking available, but it was mostly taken and we preferred parking both of our cars in the back instead.
Overall, for the price, it was very much worth it!
The best place we have stayed at in Chicago for the past four years.  Neighborhood was really nice and the place was perfect for us.
Great apartment, great location!

We had a great stay in Chicago! Check in instructions were clear and host was communicative. Beds and rooms were clean. The neighborhood is nice and pretty!  Overall good stay and the place was as expected based on the listing

Ben’s place was amazing. The area is close to Loyola so it is very safe and secure. From day one, he was responsive. We had a minor issue with the restroom and he fixed it immediately. Amazing host and amazing place. You are next to college students so be mindful of that. If you are looking for a place that’s squeaky clean , comfortable, and has a garage definitely book. This will be our go to place for our visits to the Chi moving forward!

Place was nice. Easy directions to get in. The front door to the building did not lock, but the door to the place did. Everything was clean and tidy. Bathroom had no hand soap however, and area was a bit rough.
Great stay

We had a fantastic stay at Matthew’s place. The house is beautiful and wonderfully stocked. We appreciated the decor and the little things like supplies. The house is in a beautiful neighborhood that is walkable to restaurants, bars and the train. The patio is a super nice feature. We appreciated how communicative and helpful!

Thomas was very friendly and communicative. Very detailed instructions on how to get in the parking garage and to the apartment. Very convenient location for public transit. Would definitely stay again!
The place was well cared for, clean and a good amount of space. Location was great and walkable to coffee shops and restaurants.

The hosts were great at responding in a timely manner and offered lots of information. They were kind and the listing was accurate regarding the room's description. I appreciated that all the doors had codes and the main entrance though shared was easy to access and safe.
Adam was a great host & the place was beautiful. All guests had nothing but compliments especially for the outdoor space. Very glad I booked this Airbnb.
Great place! Very clean and the host communicated well. I would stay again
We had such a lovely stay! Apartment is bright and airy and in a great location. Host was super responsive and friendly. Would stay here again!

The Annex was a convenient location and huge space, perfect for my trip to Chicago for the weekend. The living room space was really spacious and comfortable for us to hang out. Matt was really responsive and flexible when traffic delayed our arrival to check in.
Great communication and very helpful.

Brandon’s place was great for a larger group of people visiting.  Lots of bedrooms with nice common areas.  The location is very nice and also close to public transit. Brandon was also very responsive and provided clear instructions for check-in, etc.

Great location and a nice cozy apartment! The bed was very comfortable and the location was generally quiet and peaceful. Parking on the street was easy. I could recommend staying here to anyone looking for a place near Lincoln square or Ravenswood.
Jane & Joe were both extremely friendly and welcoming. Our stay was a very pleasant experience and we’d gladly stay again in the future!
This place was a hidden gem, I will definitely be back.

We loved our stay! Alfredo was an amazing host with great communication and easy & flexible check-in and check-out process. The beds were very comfortable and clean. The space looked just like the photos and I felt like it was a great price for what we got. Location was awesome, AC was pumping, and we felt safe in the neighborhood with the keypad. Would definitely stay there again!
We loved this neighborhood and had a great stay. The Airbnb was great and we would stay there again!
Clean room, convenient location, friendly host!

Sharon was absolutely AMAZING!!!!! She is so friendly and a wonderful host, very helpful and just a delight to talk to!!! Her cats are just so adorable and they will greet you every time you walk in!
Super highly recommended place to stay and I will be back!!!!!!
Thank you Sharon !
Fantastic location, the place was just as I expected. Lincoln Square is a great neighborhood!

Chris place was clean and well equipped in a great location. We had a wonderful time in Chicago thanks in part to the no hassle accommodation that was quiet and restful yet still in the middle of all of the Wrigleyville action.

Suzanne listing was perfect!!! This was one of the best places I’ve stayed at lately! It was super clean smelled wonderful and stocked with anything possible I may need or for got to pack. She was super responsive with anything I needed. I had even forgot the code once and she helped me out and did not judge haha she had great recommendation !
Very nice and patient

Lovely place in a great part of town! Really enjoyed our stay. Thanks for the Prosecco! What a great touch.
Overall, this place was great. Easy to find and easy to check in. Plenty of space for the 4 of us. Gigantic TV! We had some challenges communicating with James via the Airbnb app, but he was much more responsive via text (and helpful in asking another tenant to move their car over). Cleaning was subpar, unfortunately- dust was noticeable. All in all, though, it was a great stay in a fun and safe neighborhood. Thanks, James!
Host was bomb!!! The Airbnb is comfy and cozy … best Airbnb I’ve stayed in… thank you Tarsha..
It was a great stay! Especially it being a historical neighborhood! The brownstone was beautiful

We were in town for a weekend getaway with friends. The location was just as described. Easy to find and get in and out of following Milan’s directions. One of the most proactive, thorough stays I’ve ever had. Thank you! We can’t wait to come back 😊
Nice space, very spacious and quiet!

El alojamiento es cómodo para 4 personas, puede ser un poco complicado subir las maletas ya que debes usar las escaler
escaleras, a media hora del centro en Metra, la estación se encuentra muy cerca. Mirsada contestaba todas nuestras inquietudes amablemente.
It was a really nice place, everything was really close 4 min walk to take the bus that moves you to the jefferson park cta, me and my family enjoyed abby’s place
Had a great stay!
Very responsive. Place was a bit farther west than anticipated but overall good accommodations.
Apartment was clean well maintained.   The only negative was the building elevator was out of service during our stay
The place is beautiful, the host was super responsive and kind. The surrounding area is not the safest. The air bnb has good security system, but it was an unsafe area!
We enjoyed our stay!
Great stay! Well kept. Close enough to downtown & attractions

I stayed here with friends for my birthday weekend in Chicago. I was really excited about this property based on the photos, number of bedrooms, and proximity to downtown. Having five bedrooms was a major selling point because it allowed each of us to have our own space. The home was also very clean, which we appreciated, and each bedroom had a TV in addition to the TV in the main living area.
The location was convenient, although I would not consider it walkable to most of the main downtown attractions. We were able to walk to Soldier Field fairly easily, and Brulee, a popular brunch and happy hour spot, was just steps away, which was a definite plus.
My biggest disappointment was that the actual condition and appearance of the property did not quite match what I expected from the listing photos or the price. The photos make the space appear much more modern and updated than it felt in person. The walls, ceilings, bedding, furnishings, and overall decor showed noticeable age and wea
Nice location! Thank you Charla for hosting me.
Great space in a wonderful part of town that had lots of space for our crew of 14. Very clean and walking distance to fun spots of town and the lake. Would highly recommend.
Hot tub is shared not privet, was a amazing place to stay tho for location! Kinda annoyed the toilet was leaking and they’re super strict on check out times!

Really enjoyed the stay here! It was close to many attractions of Chicago like the downtown area, arenas, and Chinatown. Plethora of food options all around of us. The only drawback we found for us is the manual opening of the gate.
Olga was very nice and responsive and was a great host. She was very detailed in her messaging and always responded quickly.
Nice and cozy home. Very safe area. The hosts were very accommodating and tentative. Would recommend to others and would stay here again.
Excellent stay with responsive hosts. I would recommend.
Had a great experience staying here.
It was 6 of us and more than enough space for everyone. Enough bathrooms that no one had to wait. Overall great place to stay would return

Great space. Clean and cozy. I would stay here again. Take pictures of property before you leave because cleaning crew made up fake damages and left things to make us pay a fee when I know how clean we left it!!

Loved the view of the lake from this apartment - it was mesmerizing. Apartment was spotless and furniture was comfy. Had a great time using the pool and gym. Location was convenient to mass transit. Only downside was that the host could only provide one key+fob for the unit and since you need the fob for the elevator, building entry at night and gym/pool we had to be very careful with our scheduling or stick together. It would have been fine for a short trip but was challenging for our 9 night stay.
Def would choose this place again for my next visit to Chicago. Amazing experience.
We had a very pleasant stay!  Great location, responsive host and easy in and out.  Strongly recommend.

Excellent location!!!
We loved having separate suites. Worked well with our large group

We had a great stay! The Airbnb had everything we needed to be comfortable, and we especially appreciated that they had a Pack ’n Play available for our toddler.
Ola was incredibly communicative and responsive throughout our stay. She was also able to accommodate an early 1:00 PM check-in for a very small fee, which went a long way for us since it allowed our toddler to get a much-needed nap after traveling.
The location is fantastic, right in the heart of Chicago with tons of restaurants, bars, and dining options within easy walking distance. Everything was convenient and easy to get to.
We really enjoyed our stay and would absolutely stay here again!
Great stay and host was very communicative! Really easy to get to and from downtown
Everything was great, great location, hosts, etc would recommend to anyone
Great place, walkable safe area, reserved parking. Recommended!

The location of the apartment was great. Close to things to do and to the train. The apartment building is older but clean and comfortable. Parking can be tricky late in the evening but that’s expected with the location. During the day it was not an issue at all. Our host was super helpful and responsive.
Great location. Right in the middle of everything!
Excellent place, clean and offers various personal hygiene products.

Perfect place for our family get together of 9 adults.  Very spacious and plenty of comfortable beds.  Good location to base out of, took the water taxi into downtown Chicago for a day.  On site parking was a huge plus.  Used the large kitchen for dinner one night plus breakfasts.  Also a nice bakery around the corner for coffee or breakfast sandwiches.
Super clean and VERY roomy, the pictures do not do it justice! Hosts are super nice and attentive. Love love love staying here!
Very nice place!
Great spot in old town!

The location and value for the price are amazing. Reception folks were great and we were very pleased with the views that matched the description (our son loves trains so this worked out very well). I appreciated how roomy the apartment was and the white noise machine in the bedroom as it helped with the noise outside.
There are fantastic restaurants nearby, transport is easily accessible (including coming from and going to the airport) and we felt safe at all times despite locals telling us the neighborhood can get sketchy when empty.
There are minor things that can be improved that I'll message to the host to help them and the next guests but in general we're very happy with the stay and would definitely return if the host would have us. Thank you!

They were very communicative and helpful. Gave great local recommendations, and the location was easy to get around to and from Chicago's downtown area.
Walls are thin, and a few neighbors are a bit niosy but they do provide a sound machine to help.
I lovedddddd it! It was so close to everything, literally a 3 minute walk to millennium park and right in front of the cta.

Writing
Aisha was a wonderful host! She checked in with us several times throughout our stay to make sure everything was going well, which we really appreciated. She also provided amazing, easy-to-follow instructions for getting into the place, which made check-in completely seamless.
The place was quiet, comfortable, and located in a peaceful North Side Chicago neighborhood. The North Side is our favorite area to stay when we visit Chicago, and this location was perfect for us.
We had a great stay and will definitely stay at Aisha’s place again. Highly recommend!
Perfect location, easy check in, and very clean/comfortable spot! Definitely will book here again on our next trip to Chicago
Wonderful apartment

Amazing place!  It is beautiful and spacious. You can definitely hear the train, but we got used to it. Even our 8 month old slept through it on the lower level. Noise machines helped. Very well equipped and nice to have so many bathrooms.
It was joyful and nice. It was everything that I expected
Coty was very helpful.
Rahaf was awesome, incredibly proactive and always responded to my messages right away whenever we needed to communicate. Everything was exactly as described. :)

My friends and I absolutely loved our stay! We were in the city for a concert &’ we couldn’t have picked a better place to stay! The couple was so nice, welcoming, and made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. Communication was great throughout our stay. They responded within a reasonable amount of time whenever we had questions and were very helpful and accommodating. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, and the location was perfect. You could really tell they cared about making sure we had a great experience. We had such a good time and would definitely stay here again! 🥰🏡✨
Nice residential street. Close to public transportation and great restaurants.
Moving in was smooth. Thanks again!
10/10 wonderful location just a short walk away from some amazing shops and restaurants on Clark Street! Highly recommend.

Just like the photos, it was a great place to stay. I was in town with seven other friends, and we had plenty of room. We could easily walk to restaurants, corner stores, and coffee shops. It was also convenient to walk to the concert at Soldier Field.
Overall, I would recommend this place to larger groups.

We used the house for a reunion of college friends; it was ideal for our purposes. Because several people backed out at the last minute, we wanted to decrease our stay by one day, and Aj accommodated this with no question, which was so greatly appreciated. The living room and dining room were perfect for socializing and the beds were comfortable. Also, Aj was very responsive when we contacted him about the air conditioning. We were very happy with our stay and would stay there again!

Nice renovated historical building, with free gym. The flat is also fresh renovated, with friendly interior.
Kitchen fully equipped, beds were comfortable.
I recommend the place even for longer stays. The bus station is very near, parking is also easy.
Using the wifi would have been good, the router is there, only the password is missing, BUT, you can use the wifi of the caffe below (in the kitchen is the signal the strongest), just go and be a customer to get the password.
Good stay, the host was communicative and helpful throughout stay
Great place to stay! Clean, good location for walking to bars / restaurants, lots of space, etc
Spacious home. Great for our baseball weekend.

Our stay was amazing! The place was very clean, comfortable, and conveniently located close to the train station, which made getting around so easy. The host was wonderful and always checked in to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting!

Great, clean 2 bedroom basement apartment in Pilsen with comfortable full beds, nice linens & plenty of bath towels. One bedroom has a window with afternoon light. The other has none, but has a desk if you need to set up and work. Also there is a full size refridgerator and stove top/oven so you could grocery shop & cook a whole meal if you wanted to. Nicely decorated too!

Incredibly spacious home with all the amenities you need and well-equipped kitchen. Downstairs lounge was a particular highlight! Neighbourhood felt safe and great stadium access if you want to catch a baseball game.
Potentially worth mentioning that a couple of the rooms lack doors and blinds so they're not fully private, but not an issue if you are comfortable with everyone you stay with.

Oliver's house was the perfect place for our large group to stay at for a weekend trip. The two separate units gave us a lot of space and privacy. The house was comfortable and clean. Oliver was a great host who sent clear instructions and responded very quickly to our messages. The neighborhood was safe yet lively with restaurants and shops. Highly recommend staying here!

The Grey Stone was a good place to stay, the beds were clean, the home is very cute. This is an old building and with that comes old building stuff. The walls are very thin, I had to grab ear plugs because our upstairs neighbors were also enjoying their Friday night. The futons were not the most comfortable but we made it work for the two nights we were there. This house is in a great neighborhood and has tons of restaurants  near by. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Great location and space, thank you!

Host was so sweet. We had WiFi problems and she was so proactive about it. This place is in a great area to walk around and explore. Also super comfy and the AC was great. All around an amazing place to stay.

Great location! Grocery stores, the train, and everything else you need are very convenient. The apartment itself was quiet, and we had no noise complaints. You can hear the trains from the back bedrooms, but it wasn’t unbearable and we were still able to sleep comfortably. A few areas could use some improvement. It would be helpful to have more pots and pans, and the cleaning could have been a little more thorough. We found a couple of things left behind by the previous guest, including wrappers and some hair in the tub drain. There is only one AC unit in the apartment, but box fans were provided in each room, so the temperature was comfortable during our stay. The host also provided very clear and easy to follow check-in and check-out instructions. Overall, we would stay here again. It does the job, and nothing beats the location!

This place is in a great location, great vibe, restaurants, a brewery, and walkable to many places.  The room was very comfortable and had everything we needed.  The couch is a bit old but everything else was upgraded nicely.  The alleyway lockbox worked fine with the instructions.  The door to the room needs work or to be replaced.  It was difficult to get it open and took several tries. All in all this place is perfect for a touchdown location while exploring Chicago!

A great place nestled in the heart of the city. The loft provides an interesting layout that promotes socialization. Things can get a little loud in the mornings with cars but overall a very enjoyable space
The host and his team were very responsive. They gave us clear instructions and made sure they told us what was happening in the home.
Great location

Our experience was unfortunately mixed. Russell and Christine were nice and responsive, and the location is relatively close to a lot of restaurants, attractions, and downtown.
However, there were several issues during our stay that significantly affected our comfort. The hot water was initially not working, and we had to take cold showers. After that was addressed, the shower still had extremely low water pressure and took several minutes of running before water would properly come through the shower head. Unfortunately, these issues were never fully resolved during our stay, so we were not able to have a comfortable shower throughout the trip.
We also encountered some bugs inside the home that we had to take care of ourselves. There is only one TV, located in the living room, with no TVs in the bedrooms, and there was only one full-length mirror in the entire house, which was inconvenient for a group getting ready.
We also did not feel particularly comfortable with the surrounding
It was a peaceful and quiet stay! Definitely enjoyed my time here and would rebook again!
Cesar and Maria were great! I got engaged this weekend and couldn’t have picked a better spot for us to stay during our time in Chicago
I stayed here with my two children for the Chicago Triathlon. It was a great spot, quiet area very private and perfect for what we needed.

Thanks Alpha & Barry for being SuperHost to our Chicago trip. AirB was conveniently accessible to the events we attended, very clean throughout- the bathrooms were beautiful & spacious and beds comfy. Most important we all felt safe in the area. I'll definitely stay again on next visit to the Chi. Thanks again Your AirB felt like home.
Brandon’s place was overall a good place to stay minor things could be fixed but I would stay again
wonderful time in chicago, and most importantly the neighborhood hotel!
Had a great stay. Perfect location to see all of Chicago

Apartment looks just as pictured & described. Located in Hyde Park area surrounded by notable attractions & plenty of nearby restaurants & conveniences. Very reasonable distance from downtown, the Loop, museums, & stadiums; travel to them was less than 20 minutes & rideshare fares were reasonable. Space is minimalist & clutter-free & ideal for 4 individuals or a family.
One of the best places I’ve ever booked!! Everything was perfect from the location to the view from those large windows! Thank you Hanna and Mark for your hospitality! Definitely will be back again!!
Everything was fantastic!

We were in town for a Fire Fighter event from Texas.  We enjoyed the space, the local environment, and the bar downstairs! Great location to see some of the best parts of Chicago.  Will definitely be back for the next event.

Great stay! The place was spotless, exactly as described, and in an excellent location. was friendly, responsive, and easy to communicate with. Everything was smooth from check-in to check-out, and I had everything I needed!
Great location! The building felt very safe and the amenities are nice. The unit is clean and the city views are beautiful. The beds were comfortable and I appreciated having plenty of linens/towels.
Great location and very responsive host,  She was very kind, welcoming. Everything was smooth and easy from check-in to check-out. I would definitely stay here again
Very clean good spot in Chicago not far from anything.
We had a wonderful stay in a nice clean space! Very quiet in the area! Space was exactly as described! We loved it.

My friends and I traveled to Chicago for a concert and a girls weekend! The apartment was so cute, so spacious for 5 of us, we even made the 1 bathroom work. However, there was absolutely no warm water or hot water throughout our entire stay. I reached out to the host to see if there was something that could be done, and they provided us with instructions that did not make a difference. No matter the time of day, the water was ice cold, and was not enjoyable whatsoever. I hope it’s something that can be fixed in the future because the apt was really beautiful & in a great location.

Hola, muy cerca del centro y el lugar muy tranquilo, lo único que en la madrugada mucho ruido posiblemente fue por el alquiler del Airbnb que estaba abajo de nosotros, golpeaban mucho las puertas y gritaban demasiado, pero de lo demás puedo decir que muy bonito y limpio, muchas gracias!

We really enjoyed our stay at Tara’s. The place was clean and well maintained. Something else that was a bonus was the sheets weren’t washed in heavily scented laundry soap. We are both very allergic to scents so this was such a relief. The linens and place smelled clean without being so heavily perfumed. Tara was very helpful and we were so comfortable.
Demitri’s place was a good value in a good location with good amenities and comfort. I stayed 4 nights for an event at The Old Town School of Folk Music, and found it convenient and well-appointed.
Great, private spot in a lovely N. Chicago neighborhood.  Very comfortable,  good walking area with great public transportation nearby.

Easy access to unit, close to parks and restaurants. Public transportation easily available. Street parking is ok … there are many multi family units near that put pressure on parking. Unit was clean and the furniture was adequate.
Love this stay! Always so cozy and clean
10/10 hoping to come back and stay again!

In my opinion, the most important factors when choosing a place to stay are 1) safety and 2) cleanliness. Cleanliness is where Mary’s place failed. The sheets on my bed had several strands of hair throughout and were stained. Mary said that she washed them, and I trust that she did, but she (as the person who cleans the property and made the bed) should’ve seen the hairs. In fact, the stained bedsheets should have been thrown out - along with the stained towels! There was hair on the shower wall and a used hair tie and a razor head cover in the shower. The sides of the toilet were dirty. The fridge was dirty. There was hair and dust on the floor. The lack of attention to detail and refusal to throw away stained linens says a lot about a host. Mary apologized, gave a refund, and changed the bed sheets, but this should’ve never been missed. I say this as someone who owned a cleaning company and cleaned my own rental! The cleanliness was unacceptable.
Great location in a walkable neighborhood. Brad communicated with us well and all the instructions made checking in and out easy. Would definitely stay again.

Nice space in good location. Plan ahead for parking as it's very difficult to find free parking.
Bathroom sink slow to drain but overall nice place for the location. Would book again.

Hatice’s apartment is great value and in a very walkable area. We booked on short notice and she was very accommodating and easy to communicate with! We enjoyed the space and appreciated the updated kitchen and bathroom, especially the strong water pressure in the shower. We would  definitely book this again!
We really enjoyed our stay! The property was beautiful and exactly as listed. Super convenient location!
great place, 10 out of 10, no issues, friendly host, would stay here again!

Jasna made the stay very special! Thought we were gonna have to order playing cards and she ended up having some on site! Great townhouse but the rooftop was our absolute fav! I would stay here again and again😊
Good location and clean place
The place is located on a peaceful neighborhood, the space is exactly to the photos. Easy transport, good response of the host. I really love the space and the surrounders.
Danielle was an excellent host. Communication was phenomenal, unit very comfortable, and location ideal. Would recommend and would stay again!
A Walker's Paradise is true statement ✨️ . Coffee, food, and fun!

Mike is a super kind and welcoming host and I loved spending time with his sweet senior dog Piper! The bed is very comfortable (firm) and the apartment is only 1/2 mile from great Wicker Park cafes, bakeries, restaurants. If you're a light sleeper bring ear plugs, the room faces a main road and I got woken up several times a night by buses, engines revving and people's voices, so I think the building probably has single pane windows that don't dampen sound. The shower/sink could be kept cleaner, but for the price, walkable location and proximity to bus stops it is a great deal and Mike is a wonderful host!
Great place to stay with lot of space for large family.
No complaints from the guests
Great place
The home was easy to find, centrally located, spacious, and Lilly responded promptly, addressing any issues or questions. We would highly recommend the property.
Unit was nice and spacious, plenty of space for a big group. House was clean and was close to a lot of activities and food.
We had a nice time and the location was ideal for our trip! Plenty of space and a nice quiet neighborhood.

Great place for a weekend getaway. Clean and comfortable. Three bedrooms were perfect for me and my adult sons. Aurora was a terrific host. Always responsive, easy instructions, and lots of great ideas in the neighborhood.
Great great great location. Especially if you go to Boystown or Wrigley. Near a lot of great restaurants. And the beds were really comfortable. Slept like logs. Would stay again!
We had a great stay at Matt and Chris's place. The "cabin" was clean and comfortable and Matt and Chris were responsive and friendly hosts. We really enjoyed the neighborhood too.
The renting was exactly as pictured! It was super easy to get in and out of and we truly had a great time. Would definitely rent again!

Milan’s place made our trip to Chicago feel like a home away from home. It was spacious and had a great location. Milan was responsive and checked in on us throughout the stay which I appreciated. I would definitely stay here again.
Great spot, in a great neighborhood.
Really great place and great value if you’re doing a group with many people

The unit was comfortable, cozy, clean, very quiet, and located in an area of Chicago with lots of restaurants and attractions in the immediate area as well as within a 10 minute walk to a train station connected to three train lines. The host was friendly and super responsive to all of my questions. A great experience. Would definitely stay again or recommend to a friend.
Our group of 3 felt very comfortable staying here. The place was spacious and inviting. We stayed two nights and it was the perfect place to unwind after a busy day of sightseeing in the city.
So sad I won’t be able to stay here again! It’s a great home with an amazing host 10/10 stay. And the home is always so clean. Love it!

The location was a bit further from downtown than I thought, but that said getting downtown was very easy - two bus lines less than two blocks away that whisk you down to the Loop.  Meanwhile, set up for us (three people) was perfect because there are three-shut-door bedrooms each with a full bed.  The place was super clean and Alex is very good communicator clearly taking good care of the place for visitors.
This place was everything! Great location. The amount space was incredible. The steps were easy to navigate. We had everything we needed.

The garage wasn’t available the weekend we stayed, which was a little disappointing, but it wasn’t a huge deal. We got lucky and found a parking spot fairly close to the Airbnb, but just keep in mind that you may have to park a street or two over.
The five flights of stairs are mentioned in the description, so there were no surprises there. However, if you have any mobility issues, I would definitely recommend considering that before booking. They were a little challenging even for us in our 30s 😂, but again, the host was very upfront about the stairs in the listing.
We also had some difficulty getting in because the key wouldn’t fully insert into the lock. We called the host, and she responded immediately and sent someone over to help us. You definitely have to jiggle the key a little to get it in, but we were able to figure it out.
The water pressure was also a little low, but that was mentioned in the description as well. Otherwise, the Airbnb was clean, conveniently located.

Ivy's place was great! The home was modern, bright, clean, spacious and well equipped. The neighborhood is awesome — out of the madness, but still close to many restaurants, parks, cafes, etc and highly walkable. With the office sofa setup as a bed it worked well for our family of 4 for a weekend in Chicago.
Great hotel bartender was the highlight of the hotel
Affordable place to stay but far from everything in Chicago. Not the safest area as well.
The place was amazing! Great location 15 min from everything. Super great communication would definitely stay again!!

Great location in Old Town, walkable to great restaurants, Jeni's ice cream and even Second City! My girlfriends and I had plenty of space during our stay. We were grateful for the .5 bath so we could still get ready while someone else was showering. Quiet area, off a main street. Would definitely return!
Loved the stay, felt safe in the neighborhood and loved that there was a neighborhood coffee shop within walking distance.

The home was immaculately clean, and every room matched the photos. The host was incredibly welcoming and easy to converse with. Upon arrival, we were treated to complimentary wine. The entire property was breathtaking, and the wall art was particularly impressive. The home had a pleasant aroma. However, there were a couple of minor issues. One bedroom lacked a remote control, but the homeowner promptly replaced it for us without any problems. Additionally, the recliner on the couch wasn’t working, but overall, it was an amazing stay. The neighborhood was peaceful and pleasant.
Great location and a very nice comfortable interior! We really enjoyed our stay.
Lovely stay at Regina’s place. Would come back again!
Confortable and clean minimalist place right next to the train station. Paid parking nearby was $2.50 every 2 hours between 8am and 10am. Plenty of things to do in the area.

Our stay here was great! Location was excellent, close to the red line metro and just a few stops away from the main downtown attractions.
