Floor to ceiling bookcases: very stylish! Large very comfortable sectional sofa: luxurious! Thoroughly supplied and outfitted. Right now, Lakeview might just be the best neighborhood for a stay in Chicago: vibrant, sophisticated, easy to get anywhere. Gary is a responsive and friendly host!
Oba place was just as described communication was excellent I would definitely book again

Location was great, loved the street parking and easy walk to trains.  The condo was clean and comfortable.  Gerry was very responsive to all of our questions.  Would stay there again when in the area.
We had such a great stay at Dan’s place! Amazing location in Lincoln park walking distance to so much! Great size with very nice bedrooms and living space!

My stay overall was great. This was a first floor unit which was really nice. The host was very responsive. There was a misunderstanding with dropping our luggage off for storage when we arrived. My partner left his work bag outside the unit at that time, and they placed it in a closet for us. There is noise monitoring, which I completely understand having in place as other tenants live in the building. However, at one point, only the tv was on and there was no one else talking in the unit, and the noise monitor was going off, so it seemed very sensitive. As we spent most of our time outside of the unit, this wasn’t a big concern. Lastly, the location was great. We were there for a concert and it was a reasonable walk to the stadium. I would stay at other properties owned by this host if I’m back in the area!
It was beautiful from the moment we entered until we left, it exceeded our expectations and was friendly with very good space, it exceeded recommended.

Thank you for being a wonderful host. Your property is both peaceful and beautiful;
we will be repeat visitors whenever we visit Chicago.
Places decorated really well. beds and pillows extremely comfortable.

The penthouse was beautiful! Views amazing! Our group loved the stay there! Only issue was on arrival there was an issue with the water in the building (no fault of host). Would stay here again for the views alone! Also easily walkable to restaurants, coffee shops etc.

Great place to stay when visiting Chicago.  The home is very spacious and clean, a great place for a big group or family.  You can easily walk to so many restaurants and other places.  Matricia was super communicative and very welcoming. GREAT HOST!  10/10.
iris was a great host! had a lovely time in chicago and her apartment was clean. she communicated quickly and efficiently and was very helpful.

My husband and I came into town for a weekend concert and Nnamdi’s place was the perfect spot for us! It was located right outside the busy city and had everything we could have needed. We were immediately greeted with a personal welcome sign. The space was decorated beautifully and everything was so clean! One of the highlights for me was the LED mirror in the bathroom!
My husband was worried about the A/C unit being shared but said afterwards that this was the most comfortable temperature he ever experienced in an air bnb. The fan provided was just an added bonus!
We definitely would love to come back when visiting the city again!

Host was extremely responsive. Helped me navigate the parking situation very kindly. I was given an incorrect lockbox code and spent about 30 minutes trying to open it and feverishly messaging host upon arrival, with two young kids in tow. That was unfortunate, and upon entry the hallway smelled awful (mostly marijuana, but possibly something else). The unit itself did not smell bad, was spacious, and was mostly clean but the wear and tear (floor, radiators, etc) was evident and made things feel anything but immaculate. Would give high rating for responsiveness and friendliness of host and for convenience of location.

Joanna's private basement apartment was great for my family. Plenty of amenities available (shampoo, body wash, wash cloths, large comfy bed) which is always a plus when traveling with a child.
Also there was plenty of street parking and it was super easy to get to downtown Chicago.
Thank you so much for hosting us!
Great location and check in was a breeze. Very comfortable living space.

Host was very helpful and gave clear instructions for checking in and out. They were always available if we had any questions or needed anything. Plenty of space and amenities, would definitely stay again.

One of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in - SO clean! Any questions were answered swiftly. Instructions were straightforward and very helpful.  5 stars 10 out of 10 - highly recommend.  The design choices are thoughtful and we were inspired, refreshed and relaxed by the stay.  We’ll be back! Thanks Serg!!

Great location for our purpose. The host (Billy) was very friendly, accomodating and communicated very well. The space was just as described in the listing and met all of our needs. All in all, a great stay!

Our stay at Lincoln Park with family and friends was great. The location of the Airbnb was nearby. Many restaurants, local bars, establishments.
We would definitely stay there again

Nice place
Several restaurants within walking distance
Safe and secure
The place was in a nice neighborhood. The host communicated efficiently.
The unit was very clean and a comfortable place to relax after a day of sightseeing!
Nice cozy place to stay, clean and in a nice quiet neighborhood! Fantastic hosts and great deal!
Had a great stay for the weekend. Beautiful home and had everything we needed. Close to Soldier Field for a concert we attended.
We had another great stay at Bryan’s place.  I highly recommend staying here if you are visiting Chicago.

We very much enjoyed our stay, we we were overstimulated Friday and needed a relaxing day Saturday so had fun watching TV, playing pool, and playing board games. Its conveniently located to downtown and all the attractions. It is clean and well maintained and the neighborhood ia quiet with great parking and Jasmine is great host.
Great stay, very respectful and communicative. Would sleep there again
Had a great weekend staying here. Very spacious and cozy. Felt right at home. Highly recommend!
Excelente y cómodo apartamento para los 3 adultos que éramos, muy accesible para llegar al centro de la ciudad y las principales atracciones. Shay es muy amable y servicial. Es muy recomendable.
The apartment was just as described, clean and very convenient to where we needed to be. Plenty of on street parking. Just make sure not to park in the permitted parking areas. Very responsive host.
Jorge is a great host and the place was exactly as described. Very clean and well kept. Will stay again

Let me start off by saying that Jermaill is such an incredible host!! Me and my wife booked it stay for a short weekend getaway. He was nothing but understanding and helpful about aiding us get around moving into the space and overall ensuring that we not only felt welcomed in his home but that we were well acquainted with everything this hosting had to offer and the surrounding area. From great food recommendations, outing experiences and sharing the history of the town . Jermaill and his artistic yet cozy home deserves more recognition and praise than the pictures and descriptions portray. If you are ever considering staying in Chicago this is the Airbnb hosting and host you want to book with .
The apartment was exactly as described. Jonathan very helpful in deciding if this location would work for us. Easy to find parking. Large area to relax and get ready.

I’d like to mention that the review takes the fact into consideration that this place was one of the more affordable options during our stay in Chicago. Our expectations were not incredibly high, but we expected the place to be a bit nicer. The interiors are all quite old and there was a strange smell in the apartment throughout our stay. Nikkole is very responsive and came by once late at night to help us get into the place as we accidentally locked ourselves out. All in all a decent option close to many places (by car) one wants to visit in Chicago as a tourist

Really enjoyed staying at this airbnb. Perfect location - everything we needed was in walking distance! The apt was very clean and comfortable, and great hosts. I would definitely stay here again when I’m back in Chicago!!

Peter’s condo was a wonderful place to stay for our Chicago visit. It was clean and well appointed. We enjoyed the area a great deal. After a day at Montrose Beach, six of us showered and all had hot water 😊We also enjoyed the patio a great deal. Again, a wonderful place to stay.
Great place host very nice

Great host! I had an issue the first day but the host proposed a resolution which I felt was fair, so I definitely appreciated that! Shower water pressure is very low & bed could be comfier. Other wise though, the space was nice and clean & parking was always available. Will come back next time I’m in Chicago!
Love  the place really clean and well kept.  Karina and Brian were excellent hosts. The back yard is amazing
Great location, although the building is (and honestly always has been if memory serves) under construction. Definitely worth it anyway
Maria’s place was absolutely perfect for our couple’s trip! We absolutely loved staying here and will most definitely be back!

The place was perfect for our group and Angela was an incredible host. The location is very close to lots of great places in the neighborhood and to the train for easy access to the rest of the city. We would absolutely stay here again on a future visit!
The place was super clean and felt secure. Building access was good. The host thought of everything needed for a visit (from kitchen supplies to earplugs).
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The place was comfy and cozy. Ingrid was a great host who communicated well and gave wonderful recommendations. Checking in and checking out were very easy.

A group of seven old friends got together for a long girls weekend .  The house had plenty of space for all of us.  We loved the location of the house with so much to do in walking distance.  Elizabeth was prompt with her responses to our questions and even let us get in early so we could catch a Cubs game.  We enjoyed every minute of the weekend.  Thank you Elizabeth for sharing your beautiful house with us!

Maria's place was beautiful. We enjoyed all the amenities and the flowers. The place was clean and easy to find. The park up the street was great for the kids. The only issue we had was the water in the tubs took a raspy long time to drain out.  Other than that we really enjoyed our stay and recommend Maria to anyone visiting Chicago.
We loved the location and decor but the bathroom door wouldn’t shut or lock and the AC didn’t work very well. But if those two things were fixed we would definitely stay there again.
It was amazing!!! The place looked great and she sends you a link with an how to on everything so it made everything so much easier! Definitely will be booking with her again!
Thanks Tamiz for a great stay. Your apartment was lovely and it was fun hanging out with the kitties :) The apartment was super clean and had great amenities.

This is a great place to stay, especially if you are going to spend any time at U Chicago or the Obama Center. It is also very close to the L green line. Check in was very easy, and the AC is kept at the temperature of a meat locker so we slept like rocks. Overall it was great!

The Airbnb was quite nice. The host was proactive, communicative, and clear with instructions. The building is in a very convenient spot with lots to do in the surrounding area. The amenities were great and the place is well taken care of. This spot hosted 6 people with no problems!

I would have given 5 star reviews across the board except for two significant problems. . . the air conditioner would blow a fuse even without any other appliances on. Instructions were provided on how to reset the fuse and it was easy to do but. . . it was a hassle to walk two flights to reset it every time. Eventually we just stopped using it. The shower also had issues. The shower valve just needs to be replaced. The hot/cold valve just spins in a circle so you can't tell where hot and cold is. The result was a lot of cold showers. Also, there's a cracked electrical cover plate in the bathroom with a big piece of it missing. That's a quick, inexpensive fix that would be easy to do. Long story short. . . everything was fantastic except the A/C and the shower.
Perfect stay for my birthday, thank you!
The place was clean and looked exactly like the pictures. Vin was responsive and very helpful!
Great space, great location, great price, great host. If you are looking for a home base in this part of Chicago, this is your spot.

Oyindamola was very gracious and communicative. We had an unfortunate issue with our previous booking, and she was very understanding and accommodating. It was only about a 20-30 minute ride to the downtown area, and the neighborhood was walkable with a lot of culturally diverse food options!

Great place to stay. Milan was extremely helpful. Gave clear and precise instructions with pictures and videos to assist with getting there. Walked from Soldier Field after our event! Not too far from N Michigan downtown where everything is! Will visit again
Very communicative! We were checked on daily, and our request for a late check-out was accommodated. Great stay!
Loved the place! Very easy to get to and very walkable around the city! Would recommend!!
Beautiful, spacious apartment in a perfect location.

The place is exactly as described and perfect for what we were looking for.
It was mentioned that there is city noise but it should be clear that there is a pumping bar and night club that continue until 4am after the night club close they then clear all the bottles that is also extremely noisy…Friday and Saturday being noisier. My parents are half deaf and even they couldn’t sleep. I sleep through anything and everything and I struggled to reach deep sleep.
For the money we paid for two nights I was happy with the distance it was from surrounding areas and that we had parking. We also liked the historic building that made us feel like true tourists in this special town.
Jose was very responsive and the pace was as described.  The upstairs tenants can noisy at odd hours, but the stay was still great.

Super great location, free street parking and not hard to find a spot, great deal. Super cheap to drive to the city and back / uber. Great and clean space, responsive and amazing host! Will definitely stay here next time I come to chicago.

Recently had to come back to Chicago for a family funeral. It being last minute many hotels were booked or super pricey and same with Airbnbs but this Airbnb came up and though a little outside of downtown it was perfect. It was easy to find, clear instructions, spotless and the perfect space for 3 adults and 2 kids. Ari was also a great host. Like always we always try to leave each place the way we found it and we’re super thankful for being hosted here. A plus is this area is walkable- food and grocery store close by and street parking is available.
The bedrooms need tv especially when couples are renting out your properties .The hallway area stink front and back .
Very beautiful place, cozy up to date home, highly recommend for a Chicago trip !
Very cool place with a lot of room hangout. Bob was a gracious host. I would definitely make a trip back to this spot in Chicago with a large group of friends.
We had a great stay here! Location is PERFECT

I had a wonderfully comfortable stay in this spacious apartment.
It’s well situated in a quieter neighborhood, with easy access to the city whether by car or public transportation.
The host is friendly and the apartment is clean and cozy, with all the amenities needed to make it a great stay. A great, relaxing experience from beginning to end.
Superb apartment and facilities and Stephanie was really helpful! We will come again, thanks 😊
Lovely place in the city. Not super far away from downtown. FYI, there are ALOT of stairs to climb whether you park in the front or back!

This was an absolute amazing stay. My lady and I were talking and saying every BNB should be like this.
From the snacks and drinks being left in the fridge.
From the welcoming card as soon as we stepped in. Everything felt at home during our stay.
Even when we needed to do a late checkout , he was nice about it . And allowed the late checkout !
Really enjoyed and will definitely come back
Julia’s place was very comfortable and spacious. An easy walk from the Belmont stop with quick access to the city, the airport, and interesting neighborhoods.
Great neighborhood, great apartment, great host! Fantastic experience overall.
Nice place! Definitely recommend getting parking to save money.

Wow! This place was amazing! Super clean and great location. John was an amazing host. Super responsive and helpful. I definitely recommend this stay. Great price as well. Thank you John with intrusting us with your home.

Beautiful location, very walkable and everything felt very clean. We had a wonderful time! The host was very responsive and great to work with. The beds could use an upgrade they were pretty uncomfortable. Other than that, we really enjoyed our stay!
Nice place, modern and comfy feel. The place had everything we needed.

I had a great experience staying here. The room was clean, comfortable, cozy, and had everything I needed for a pleasant stay. The bed was very comfortable, and the room was quiet and peaceful, which made it easy to relax and get a good night’s sleep. Overall, it was a wonderful stay, and I would definitely recommend it and stay here again.🌙
Mi experiencia fue muy buena. El cuarto estuvo limpio, cómodo y acogedor. La cama era muy confortable y el espacio tenía todo lo necesario para una estancia agradable. Sin duda, volvería a hospedarme aquí y lo recomendaría.🌙
Great location and clean accommodations
Waist of money and they are very rude and inconsiderate

Dan himself was AMAZING. Customer service would have me book again, however our only downfall was the cleanliness of the home. The refrigerator was dirty inside with hairs and other debris. One bed had stains on the sheets and lastly the living room furniture was stained as well. Overall we had a decent stay. I would suggest a thorough cleaning of it though
Amazing location, super clean, beautiful, and beds were so comfy! Only complaint was there was a very loud party below us, but that’s just life!
Great location, very close to CTA red line for public transportation, and communicated well throughout my stay!! Highly recommend upon your travels and stay in Chicago.
One of the nicest Airbnb stays in a neighborhood that’s walkable to so many different places: restaurants, parks, shops, and theaters

my wife and I had a great weekend stay! the host and his girlfriend were friendly,communicative, and helpful. the house was beautiful, clean, and although our room was not huge, it was perfect for 2. check in and check out was smooth, the other guests were kind and kept to themselves, and the location was close to everything we needed to access (soldier field,restaurants,the highway). some parts of the neighborhood were “run down” but I would not say that effected our stay at all… the neighbors were all friendly and even welcomed us to enjoy cookout food during a  block party they were having! 10/10 recommended a stay here for your chi-town trip, we will be back!

I really enjoyed this place! We came to town for a concert and were able to walk home from solider field no issue! The host was so responsive and kind. We loved the big windows in the living space. Some cons were - the main bathroom’s shower didn’t get hot it was actually pretty cool, the fridge did not really keep things cold, again it was cool at best. Lastly the shower doors were hard to work with lol. Outside of those small things I loved the location loved the host loved the space overall. Thanks so much for having us Milan ❤️
Great accommodations! Very cute, perfect location and nice and clean.

We couldn’t have asked for anything better. Loved the whole vibe of the space!! Was very clean, beds were super comfortable and she had everything there to make for a convenient stay. Would definitely book here again in a heartbeat!

This space is incredible. There are three bedrooms which are very well furnished very clean throughout the entire apartment all types of art which was beautiful to see and additionally two areas one of which was a business kind of desk working area and the other area was a sunroom on the other end of the apartment I truly enjoyed the space the cleanliness of it the feel of it the character of it and I appreciate The Help From The Host so very much. She was quick to reply and always had the solution that I needed. I highly recommend booking this place the next time you're in Chicago you will love it and it's close to a lot of different things you'd want to see. I definitely will Reserve this location again when I come to Chicago for business or to visit family. I especially liked that there was so many things that were just automatically happening such as lights going on as I walk past the room and even down to the soap dispenser in the bathroom that was touchless. Thank you so much

It was a very basics only place, sheets and a bed. Austere kind of like a hostel, not particularly welcoming or cozy. No amenities in the bedroom or bathroom. The kitchen seemed like it would've been good for am extended stay. There was a strange smell when I came back most evenings. About the bare minimum to expect from a room rental
Good spot to check out. Spacious. Bathrooms a little small. But rooms were nice and spacious.

Level Chicago was very walkable but not in the full mix of things if you are looking for something more in the loop. Responsive host and the room was just as pictured. Very clean and spacious. Would definitely return!
I had a great stay at this location. The host is really good at responding to requests
Great location across from park area, easy access to downtown and lake shore drive and Southloop
Great response time. Very clean and efficient.
Enjoyed our stay and would definitely book here again. Very clean, safe and comfortable! And the free parking was a huge bonus!
Charlotte’s place was comfortable and clean. Great neighborhood and walkable to a lot of places. My fiancé and I had a great weekend at her place.
Great location, and very comfortable and inviting space.  The hosts were very responsive when I had any questions.  Would definitely stay here again.  Thank you!

The property was somewhat clean, spacious and conveniently located near the airport. The hosts were responsive when we had any queries.
However, there were a few downsides. The host came across as quite accusatory when the power went out, assuming we had blown the fuse by using the AC. Also, she said we shouldn’t be using the AC too much as ‘it was barely 80F today’.
The floorboards are also very creaky, and noise from the neighbours upstairs is easily heard, this disturbed my sleep in several occasions. The shower had low water pressure, took a while to heat u and the tub pushed was a little grimey.
The bed and duvet could definitely be better quality. Also, having a picture of the outside of the property would help locating the exact flat.
Overall, it was an okay stay, but there are a few areas that could be improved.

It was a ver nice apartment.
Richard gave us very good instructions and even a tour around the neighborhood. I would very much recomend staying with him

Everything was going great until we saw a roach :( they were very responsive and came and sprayed. After they sprayed we saw another one. I was hoping we wouldn’t take any home. The apartment was fairly clean well. Overall the apartment is big, great view of lake and close to the city.

My best friend and I stayed at the beautiful brownstone while in town for a concert at Soldier Field. This is now my 4th time visiting Chicago and to stay is the historic district without all the hustle and bustle of downtown yet being only a 10 min drive away was perfect. We loved the speed and people of Bronzeville. The space was very clean and true to description. The hosts do a great job at adding amenities and small things that will/can come in handy. As they detail they have small children and you can hear their precious feet running around at certain hours. As mothers ourselves, it never bothered us. There is some amazing food, coffee and stores in walking distance. I hands down will stay at this location, the next time I visit Chicago.
Great host and very friendly. Amazing bnb if you’re in town for a few days. Highly recommended! No issues with communication at all and it’s a cozy and private bnb

I really enjoyed my stay at this Airbnb in Chicago! The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The location was convenient, and the host was friendly and easy to communicate with. I would definitely stay here again when I’m back in Chicago! 🏙️❤️
Thomas place so was beautiful! Any questions I had Thomas made sure to respond in a timely manner.

This studio was bright and comfortable. It served as a great home base for our visit to Chicago. The location is unbeatable and I especially enjoyed access to the back porch. Overall, it was a great experience and I’d happily stay here again in the future especially for quick trips.
We had a great stay at Thomas's place. It was clean and comfortable for the four of us. The parking spot was tight, but we were very thankful to have a spot to park! We would stay here again!

This was a great spot based on location for sure. Very close to the L train and right in the middle of the Gold Coast. Only downside was the back yard where the garden was ugly to look at. Other than that, I highly recommend this place.
This was such a great find. The location was perfect. You can definitely walk and the neighborhoods are pretty. The unit was very clean and the bed was comfortable. It's worth the price!
Gloria's place wasa 20/10--Highly recommend staying here. Gloria was so nice and her place was beautiful. We cannot wait to return to Chicago and will most definitely book with Gloria again.
This home was located in a quiet area. Super nice and remodeled/updated on the inside. Good size beds and great showers. Would recommend to others!

Location can’t be beat. Great neighborhood, easy train access, walkable food, shops and more.
The unit itself was totally suitable. Nothing too nice or fancy but did the trick. Could use some TLC for things such as broken light switches, broken blinds, wobbly furniture legs but again it did the trick and didn’t expect a luxury spot.
Biggest issue was the building key, it took a few minutes to unlock the building every time we got back. Sometimes 1 min Soemtimes 5 min of just constant wiggling and turning the key until it would work.
Loved staying at Richard's unique place! Nice, quiet neighborhood with walkable restaurants, easy access to downtown, and ample street parking. Great base for a relaxing Chicago visit.
Great place. Quiet. Clean. Will definitely return next time I'm in Chicago. Thanks again, Angelica.
The house was amazing and the Lizbeth was always responsive we plan on coming back again!
Hector went above and beyond for our stay. We would definitely stay there again.

My family had a great time staying here. The home was so nice, comfy and clean. Would def recommend to anyone staying in Chicago!!
It would’ve been nice if they provided the garage remote so we didn’t have to manually open/close the garage but it wasn’t a big deal for us.

Ewa's apartment is conveniently located in Wicker Park, walkable to the blue line and everything the neighborhood has to offer. The apartment was clean and Ewa checked on us a couple times to make sure we had everything we needed.
Unfortunately, we all (two adults, two kids) found the mattresses were hard and uncomfortable, especially for a week+. The living room is more form than function and the seating options were worn out (sofa) or awkward to sit in (chairs). With more comfortable furniture and a few more kitchen items (utensils for grilling, larger mixing bowls, etc) this place could be a total gem!

This was our second stay here - we have an annual event in the neighborhood and plan to make it an annual stay! Pippa is extremely responsive - took at most two minutes to get a call back when I had  trouble getting into the space. The apartment is gorgeous and could not possibly be in a better location! Thank you once again, Pippa!
This Airbnb was very nice, cozy and clean. Our host was great too.

We had a great stay at the bungalow! It was so easy to walk to restaurants and shops as well as access the red line a couple steps down the road! Wrigley field is just around the corner as well. 10/10 would come back if we are ever in the area!

Such a unique place to stay! With my Asian heritage, I really loved all of the different cultural pieces and furniture. Brett is a great and responsive host. We’ve been eyeing this place to stay for a few years and we were super excited to finally be able to stay. The area is very walkable and we found some great places to eat, get a drink, and browse some local shops. It exceeded all expectations and the photos do not do the place justice. We hope to come back!!

Ich war sehr zufrieden mit meinem Aufenthalt bei Jane. Alles sauber und Jane war stets schnell erreichbar. Die Unterkunft ist nur wenige Gehminuten von der Blue Line entfernt und man erreicht das Stadtzentrum so in etwa 20 Minuten.

The place was a nice stay, location is walkable to a nearby grocery store and other stores and within a good drivable distance for going out to eat. Kim was quick to respond when we had a small issue with the fire alarm and was helpful. Would definitely recommend.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the whole experience easy and enjoyable. We truly appreciated the hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Great cafe place and surrounding. Would come again

Very responsive, and proactive with instructions. Very courteous, and a general all around pleasure to work with. I would stay again as the description was spot on accurate, and a pleasant/comfortable place to be.
Great place to stay. Really enjoyed it. Thank you
Enjoyed our stay, very clean and easy to access with Keys. Also nice it was on main level so did note need to go up stairs with suitcases.
Great for a family with plenty of room and a chefs kitchen

Our stay was perfect! Wonderful location, and the most charming vibe! It was the perfect stay for a groovy weekend celebration!
Alek communicated so quickly, and we appreciated the hospitality!
Great location, walkable distance to bars and restaurants, paid parking spot available, pretty clean, great stay.

I was very skeptical about staying in a home that’s also inhabited by the owners, but I’m so glad I took the leap! Gabrielle made me feel right at home from the moment I arrived. The private entrance, impeccable homey decor, and thoughtful amenities made the stay incredibly comfortable. It truly feels like an apartment !
The biggest standouts were the cleanliness and location! It’s just steps away from the Blue Line, making it incredibly convenient to get around.
Absolutely loved my stay . 10/10 would recommend!

I don't think there isn't enough space to list how wonderful Simon's place was, but I can promise you it is better than any hotel you will find close to it. On arrival, he personally greeted us and told us a little about the area. His house was like visiting a relative. Fully stocked with food (fruit, snacks, bread, eggs, soda, beer) and any travel things you may need like tooth brushes and soap and the amenities like a washer/dryer (with detergent provided). The bed was comfortable, the parking free, and it's close to both the bus stop and blue line in the heart of Wicker Park on Damen. I didn't really try to check, but the tv's didn't have access to any apps (antenna only), which wasn't an issue for us, but may be for someone with children or planning on staying in. It will definitely be my go-to place if available in future trips. 5 stars all the way.

Beautiful home, comfortable stay.
The hosts were very accommodating to our needs.

Great location near Albany Park where there are the best restaurants in Chicago. Love the park across the street. Clean house. Friendly and helpful host. We will definitely stay here again. Great place for our family who lives out of town.

Amazing place within 2 minutes from the Blue Line. Easy access, great restaurnts a block away ans super convenient.
Jeannette was very friendly and helpful in all regards. Great place and a great value in a city where hotel prices are skyrocketing.
Very nice clean and spacious home. We felt right at home. Most definitely will use again and will recommend to anyone as long as they’ll take care of it. It’s a beautiful home.
Excelente lugar, Erick es genial, no tuve problemas, me ayudó en cada pregunta, me volvería a quedar aquí
Overall the stay was great Adam was  punctual when responding and giving directions as far as where things were and what was needed to be done.

Roxy did an excellent job with communication! Very responsive and replied within the hour anytime we had a question. The air bnb was as pictured. It was also clean! She pretty much provided us with everything we needed even a few snacks. The only thing that I could say is that there seems to be a plumbing issue. It is a basement unit, it seemed like everytime someone took a shower or used the restroom the sewage starts to smell in the hallway. It could also be from the upstairs unit. Regardless it smells bad and could be off putting.

Our stay here was good, but not perfect. The noise from upstairs was substantial. Even during the listed quiet hours, the noise continued… heavy footsteps, doors closing, and what I’m guessing was a small animal running up and down the hallways. It made it difficult to enjoy a quiet morning while on vacation.
However, the bed and the couch were very comfortable! Soft pillows & cozy blankets!
The bathroom was nice and clean, plenty of towels & nice soaps to use.
The location of this home is the true selling point, it’s easy to find, and there are so many shops and restaurants that are within a walkable distance.
Thanks for the stay!

The apartment was clean and in order when we arrived. The apartment lacked a few basic items that we had to request; however, the host was quick to respond and provide them. There is a portable a/c unit provided, and the window seal for the a/c unit could be enclosed more securely, so there aren't any gaps. The location is excellent and situated in a walkable area with a beautiful park located across the street. Overall, I would recommend this apartment to anyone who is staying in the area.

We really enjoyed our stay at Khang’s. The it’s a private room, Khang and his partner have taken many steps to make it feel as private as possible. The place was meticulously clean, and well stocked with towels and other things you might possibly need on a trip. Khang also responded right away to my messages.
Their apartment is walking distance to the lake and great coffee shops and bars. You can’t go wrong staying here, and we look forward to staying with them again some day.
Great location, easy access to public transit

The stay was great, the place was very clean and we really liked the neighborhood. There were some communication issues (lack of response regarding early check-in, not responding to amenity issues until after the stay was over etc). Overall would stay here again with the expectation that there will be no communication other than check in/out details.

Mika’s place was a great place to call home while we were in Chicago for a family event. Great location, amenities were great and the house was very spacious and clean. Mila let us know anything we needed to know well in advance. On the day we checked out, Mila let us know that we left behind an iPad and helped us get it asap. What an angel! Highly recommend Mila’s place when headed to Chicago!
Loved our stay. Great place, perfect for our group. Appreciated the stocked kitchenware and coffee!!

Great place to stay. Josey was a very friendly and helpful host! She even recommended a party to attend and it was very nice!
I’d highly recommend!

Vin's place was clean and clutter free. The bathroom was quite small and it does not have central AC but the window units are located in each room which was great. This is a third floor walkup, and I do feel this was priced quite high. The building itself it very old but the neighbors are quite and we had no issues.

Beautiful loft apartment.  Everything you could need is included - snack basket, games, all kitchen tools, huge TV, comfortable sofa, coffee options with k-cups included.  Excellent communication from the host.    We are retuning in 8 weeks!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was beautiful, very comfortable, and looked just as pictured. Our host was also extremely responsive from the time we booked, throughout the planning leading up to our trip, and during our stay. Any questions we had were answered quickly, which made everything so easy and stress-free. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend this home to anyone visiting Chicago!
Sofia and Brendan were great hosts. The unit was extremely clean, and the beds were so comfy! It had plenty of room for 5 of us.  Would recommend 100%.

Our group of 10 couldn’t be happier with our stay at Thomas and Cynthia’s place. From the walkability to downtown Andersonville to the roomy accommodations and stylish decor it was a 10/10 across the board. We highly recommend this place for your next trip!
Good stay, host was very responsive and clean apartment

Really enjoyed our stay at this property! Cool places within walking distance, short cab rides around town, quick walk to the train and to e-bike rentals. The host was extremely responsive, helpful, and friendly. The apartment itself was comfortable and just as advertised. Would recommend with no hesitation!
House was in a prime location to me honestly. I was able to walk a couple blocks and be by a variety of diff places. I would recommend people to check this spot out.

Such a beautiful home in a fantastic location! Stayed for my sister’s bachelorette party and it was the perfect place. Great location with easy access to public transportation and walkable restaurants/coffee shops. Looked just like the pictures and had a great backyard space as well as 3 car parking space, and free street parking in front. There were initially some cleanliness concerns however, once communicated to Spencer he was able to provide a quick and helpful solution. Any questions our group had Spencer was very quick to respond! If you’re looking for a spacious and comfortable home in Chicago for a larger sized group I would recommend staying here!

Fantastic location, easily found parking right out front. The area is safe and clean, this first floor apt. provides easy access to lots of fun neighborhoods and attractions. The building is older but the place has good AC and a nice shower. Great stay overall!
Amazing, delicious breakfasts and beautiful back deck!
Great location that is easily accessible by foot and train!

We had a bit of trouble getting into the accommodation as the cleaners had the key and were still cleaning upon check-in. That wasn't fun but other than that, there were two AC units and a nice bed, very nice area. The location was walkable and quiet. My only issue is the shower. The water pressure was low and no hot water. It's an older building, so if that bothers you I would avoid. Overall okay stay.
Clean and well decorated space, more spacious than expected. Check in and check out was easy.

If you're looking for the best accommodation to stay for a few days in Chicago, you found it. The location is really good, well-connected to public transport, and it's even within walking distance of the city center.

From the moment we walked up the stairs, we were very pleasantly surprised by how large Anne’s place is. It has high ceilings with beams and feels spacious but cozy. Marble floors in the bathroom, wood floors throughout, wonderful artwork, books, desk, luxurious bed, W/D, easy parking in front, and a nicely stocked refrigerator made this the chef’s kiss of vacation rentals. It’s in a very nice neighborhood and feels safe. We hope to stay here again-I wouldn’t waste my time looking for another place!

Honestly, this place exceeded my expectations! It was clean, cozy, and way more spacious than we thought. It was very updated, modern and in pristine condition. It felt like we were in a hotel, but also right at home cozy at the same time. We had absolutely no problems at all. Roxy was also very responsive, communicative and sweet. She answered all of my questions and addressed all of my concerns. If I could give it 10 stars, I would. Overall, I had an amazing experience with the host and her home. I would definitely recommend to anyone and would stay here again! This was one of the best experiences I had with Airbnb.

Very easy to find. Location was great for what we were doing. It is near Hyde park and we were doing things all on the south side.  We walked to a diner for late lunch and felt very safe (as two women).  We ubered everywhere else.  Description and pictures matched and met our expectations.   Very good communication from host.

Great location, close to Old Town and Lincoln Park! Nice to be so close to a Whole Foods too. Everything was clean and it was pretty quiet (some noise from other units and especially the hallway). Mattresses and linens felt really cheap for the price, and all of the beds are full beds making it a bit tight for multiple couples.
Fantastic stay and attentive hosts!!
Lovely place! Very easy to communicate with Ben. Excellent location.
Would book again

Pros:
- The host was very responsive and provided recommendations for the area
- comfortable beds
However, there are some observations that I think are helpful for others to be aware.
Cons:
- The pictures are accurate, but misleading. They do not sure show the dings or scuff marks on the walls, chipped paint on the kitchen cabinets or broken blinds
- Description text doesn’t mention that there’s no central AC; required to scroll to the bottom of the amenities list to see what’s excluded
- Personal preference, but no top sheet on the primary bed
- The corner of the primary bedroom was covered in dust; the apartment overall needs a deep cleaning
Pretty chill place, very different and unique but has a very nice cozy vibe.
We had a group of 7 for the weekend and the space was a perfect size to feel relaxed.

Beautiful airbnb in peaceful, walkable neighborhood close to shops, restaurants & public transit. Stayed here as a family of 5 and loved the dining, bath & kitchen facilities. Host was responsive and helpful. Great location to visit downtown Chicago if you prefer a quieter place to rest at night.

This place is very comfortable, beautiful and really clean. Exact as photos, spacious. Beautiful and well decorated rooms and bathrooms. Provides everything you will need for your stay. The neighborhood was very clean, quiet and near public transportation. The host responds when needed. I would definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a nice, clean spacious air bnb that’s not too far from downtown but in a safe and quiet neighborhood. There’s a swing chair outback for you to sit outside. Give this place a try. You will love it

Jen’s place was wonderful! I stayed with my toddler, and we had plenty of space and felt very safe in the area. We enjoyed walking around and exploring the neighborhood. Jen was super communicative and accommodating. Would highly recommend!

We loved our stay! Mera was so friendly and responsive, and everything was explained very well. It’s in a great part of town, and easy to get to public transportation. There’s a Whole Foods across the street, so it was an easy walk to grab whatever you need. The unit was clean, and had everything we needed. We would definitely stay here again. Thanks for a great stay, Mera!

We had a great stay! The place is really lovely. We especially enjoyed using the back porch. There were lots of nice touches - a Brita pitcher of water in the fridge, extra toiletries in the bathroom in case one forgot their toothbrush, nice shampoo and conditioner. The beds were comfortable. The location was great. Olesya reached out to let me know it would be ready sooner than the normal check in time, which I really appreciated. It was one of the nicest places I've stayed.

I live in Chicago and booked this home for my brother and two friends for his bachelor weekend. I booked for five, but only three stayed; I stopped by occasionally, and there were never more than four people there. They do not party and used the home to sleep, change, and relax.
Communication was normal until check-in. The owner had multiple packages delivered, several requiring signatures, including one large/heavy item. We brought everything inside. She messaged late at night asking us to move packages to the garage, then the next morning about a house binder.
While we were all out, someone entered the home without notice; we know because the packages had been moved. Later, after another delivery, the owner arrived unannounced about 10 minutes after we returned to retrieve it. Another package arrived the next day.
The repeated deliveries, unannounced entry, and unexpected visit made everyone uncomfortable and raised serious privacy concerns. I would not recommend staying here.
A
Great location and rental unit. They were responsive and helpful during our stay.
This place is nice, recommend you guys stay here!!
Overall great stay

I’m honestly jealous that this is an Airbnb and not an actual apartment listing because I would move to Chicago in a heartbeat! From the thoughtful decor to the amazing views of downtown, this place was such a cozy little nook that I really didn’t want to leave.
I also loved the location. Pilsen is such a fun neighborhood, with museums, art galleries, coffee shops, and plenty of great restaurants to explore. One of my favorite finds was Novel Pizza, definitely a must-try if you stay here!
Overall, this home made my trip extra special and memorable. I absolutely loved my stay and hope I get the chance to come back!
Thank you Phil and Coty!
The place was very comfortable and accessible to a lot of restaurants nearby!

The place is affordable. Location is good, nearby bus stop, and directly go to downtown and tourist attractions. Amanda is so nice and easy to communicate with. Also the place is nearby a lot of restos and grocery stores. highly recommended place and host.

Sb and Drew were such lovely hosts and staying at their place was perfect! I was there for a longer, multiple month stay and it was great. Sb and Drew were super responsive and answered all of my questions, gave great recommendations and were just super sweet overall. There was plenty of space for me and my guests and easy access to buses, just generally a great space~ Would highly recommend to literally anyone and would stay there again in a heartbeat :]

Overall the place was really nice and comfy! The host pays attention to detail and does a great job with communicating and assisting with any issues. The emergency team was always responsive. The location was describe perfectly and was very inviting. Clean! Nice decor! Easy to use appliances.
Things that could have been better:
1. Trash outside the condo door was piled up....5-10 bags so the inside of the condo smelled horrible upon arriving, not a good way to start the stay.
2. Picking up the garage door opener from another building several blocks away
3. Train outside the bedrooms window
4. Rooftop had a few furniture pieces that were visibly damaged and unpleasing to the eye.
Things that were a bonus:
1. Great small gym
2. Cool hang out spot
3. A cart to help bring in items
4. A gorgeous rooftop view and plenty of space
All and all I would stay here again...it does feel like home and the host is awesome!

Great weekend in Chicago! About a 15 min walk to the closest L stop to get you to tourist spots in the loop. Lovely landing place for exploring west town, ukrainian village, and wicker park. Comfortable accommodations and great communication from the hosts.
David a été super et très réactif sur les messages. Logement sécurisé, bien placé, propre.
Loved it! Cheers!!

We had a wonderful stay! The house was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The location was great and very convenient for getting around. Jamisyn was an excellent host—friendly, responsive, and extremely accommodating throughout our stay. Check-in and check-out were easy and seamless. We really appreciated the hospitality and would happily stay here again. Highly recommend!
Very easy check-in and check out. Good location easy to walk to multiple different areas of the city.
Thank you
It was very neat, clean & comfortable. It was enjoyable.
It was perfect! For a weekend trip to Chicago with family!

Bridget is an amazing and wonderful host! Extremely responsive and helpful! What stands out is the kitchen and bathrooms are well stocked. This is extremely helpful at an Airbnb so we deeply appreciate it. The beds were super comfortable and no heavily scented linens so thank you! The fenced backyard is perfect for kids and is so well maintained! Note there are a lot of stairs without handrails in this unit so not ideal for people with little mobility or very small children. Having three levels was great to have options to manage a group. The basement has great eating area. The neighborhood was amazing - big trees and plenty of places to walk to like parks and the library and convenience and dollar stores. The neighborhood felt very safe. Thank you Bridge for hosting us in your beautiful home!
We would stay there again
Very cozy and spacious. Had everything needed for a good stay.
Overall a good experience, the window unit AC kept the place comfortable. It is an old building so expect issues with water pressure, floor/ceiling noise, etc. Cool vibe though
The home was clean and mostly as described, I do think it’s worth while to mention there is no central AC. There home window units and they were able to keep the horn cool though

Great place for 6 guys who gathered to do a live fantasy football draft. Living room was fun and spacious, complete with a pool/ping pong table. Bedrooms did the job and easily slept 6 of us. Location was perfect, less than 5 minute walk to Wicker Park and dozens of great restaurants. Communication with host was immediate and very friendly. Overall value of the apartment was excellent!

Me and my friends needed a nice place to stay near Chicago, and this place was just what we were looking for. Downtown was around 15 minutes away and had easy access to the expressway. The neighborhood was very quiet and felt safe. Although we didn’t spend too much time at this house, we definitely enjoyed staying here and we would stay here again.

The place was awesome with plenty of beds for everyone. Everything was exactly as it was described. The host was nice, respectful, and responsive as well.
I will make sure to stay at it again if we have a group 10+ people. Recommend 10/10. Thank you!
The apartment was good. The neighborhood is very nice and a great area. There are many restaurants nearby and good transit connections. The home is coz,  & the neighborhood is really great.

Owen's place is in the perfect location, within walking distance to so many good restaurants, as well as the L train stations.  It was very clean, comfortable, and convenient.  Owen was incredibly accommodating and communicative.  Definitely went above and beyond most airbnb hosts!

Place was clean, the air-conditioning worked great and the refrigerator was stocked with a variety of drinks. The building seemed quiet but we weren't there much. We were able to park right out front and you can see your car from the window of the apartment It is a 3rd floor apartment with only stairs. Place looked liked the pictures in the listing it was just missing the grill on the balcony. We would stay here again.

I stayed here for my bf’s 21st birthday with our friends. We had a lovely time and Mimi was a great host! She responded to our questions and texts quickly, and gave us toilet paper within 5 minutes of us asking! The places we wanted to go to were only 15-20 minutes via driving, and they also had nice dive bars that were walkable as well. The place itself was very spacious and well kept, and we would most likely come back next year. W host 🙈

Exceptional place with character. Photos matched the exact vibe/ aesthetic as the photos. Felt so much more premium than a standard airbnb. Beds / towels / linens all luxe. Great sound system and set up.
Very nice and very clean!  Loved the coffee beans and the grinder.

Wonderful place in a great location! The home was spacious, clean and had everything we needed. Natalia was very responsive and we have zero complaints. She even brought us produce from her garden! The location was also perfect and in a very nice neighborhood. Would recommend!
We enjoyed staying here, close to everything we needed and plenty of space! We loved the wall where they had canvas’ placed to sign and leave our mark.
Amazing, easy find, just amazing beautiful house everything you need in a place also, beautiful showered and bathroom
Great place to meet up with old friends!
Greg was a very helpful host. The place is in the perfect location for walking and very convenient.

Super nice apartment with all the amenities you need for a weekend. Added bonus if you are sensitive to strong smells or want to minimize harsh chemical products whenever possible, this place checks the boxes. It is also very centrally located to restaurants, Navy Pier, and major bus lines.

We had a amazing time, the place felt like home from the start with amazing host.
Everything you can imagine from shopping to meals are just walking distance.
Excellent place to stay for our team retreat! Lots of great amenities and great neighborhood and walking distance to restaurants.
Excellent space. Excellent location.
Great spot to stay in Lincoln Square

I was born and raised in Chicago. With that said, I've visited Chinatown several times since my youth. However, for the weekend, it was perfect for the concert at Soldier Field. For someone out of town, it's solid for the cultural experience and as a hub for getting around the city.

The stay was nice. The guest house is in the back so it makes the feel a little more private. My only quarrels were that the water pressure in the shower was very low, but I’m not sure if that’s a common thing in Chicago with it being an older city. The only other awkward thing was that I had a local friend meet up with us at the Airbnb before we went to a white Sox game but I was immediately messaged asking how many people were staying at the Airbnb. Just felt a little odd to be watched so intensely for our stay but overall the stay was good.

Victor’s place was the perfect location and size for our group of 4. Only a 10-12 minute walk from the Orange line to get to downtown Chicago. And we loved going out on the deck for quiet late night chats. I would definitely stay here again for my next trip to Chicago. Thank you Sebastian and Victor for a great stay!

Amazing Penthouse! This unit was absolutely beautiful and very clean. The view from both balconies was stunning. The kitchen and bathrooms were well stocked with necessities. The bedrooms included ear buds, I'm assuming because of the highway but the noise didn't both us at all. I was concerned about such a high amount for a security deposit but the hold was lifted on my card within 48 hours. The beds were very firm (I like softer beds) but the pillows were like sleeping on a cloud. The host was always responsive. I'm not sure if it's an AI host but they always responded. Will definitely be staying here every time we visit Chicago.

We loved our stay at Debra’s. The location is fantastic and the apartment is very clean and comfortable.  The hosts are responsive and helpful. And we especially loved watching the neighborhood go by from the front porch.

The stay at Janice’s was comfortable, and convenient. The space was very clean, all instructions were very clear for check in & out. Janice was a great communicator & was very responsive to any inquires we had.

Michael was a wonderful host! The place was spotless and was the perfect location for my low key bachelorette party. Instructions were very simple and Michael was very responsive to questions and gave great recommendations. Will definitely be booking again when needing the perfect Chicago location 😊
This was a great place to stay while visiting Chicago.   The neighborhood was beautiful and in easy walking distance to great restaurants.  The drive into the city is an easy one!

We stayed for a weekend in Chicago and had a great experience. We weren’t able to get an early check-in because they had guests right before us, but they still allowed us to drop off our bags 4 hours before check-in, which was nice because our flight landed early. The apartment was exactly like it looked in pictures and was very clean when we arrived. The Dream Rentals team was quick to answer calls and messages and was always helpful. The check-in and check-out process was easy as well. An added bonus was the local coffee shop called Muse right next door.
Enjoyed my stay at Jane’s place this week in Chicago.  Restful.  Clean.  Affordable.  Very close to the CTS Blue Line.
quiet neighborhood away from the city. Enjoyed my stay!

Having Stacie as a host was amazing. She's very friendly, welcoming and responsive! Very good neighborhood everything you need is close by! Clean house space makes you feel like home away from home. I'll definitely book again!

Our stay was very nice and when we asked for more towels and a late checkout the owners were very quick to help/respond. The place is perfect for a large group, we were celebrating a bachelorette with 16 people. We had a great time!!

Stephanie's place is fantastic. It has plenty of space and is in a nice location in the South Loop of Chicago. We were able to walk to the aquarium. The outdoor pool is very nice as well. We did not have much difficulty finding street parking close to the building.

We enjoyed the fun/funky vibe the unit has.  The space was quite comfortable for the two of us.  Loved the kitchen and bathroom setup,. Location was very convenient for our needs (visiting family who live  near by) and offered a variety of dining options (Starbucks to ethnic to fine dining) which we loved. We would definitely stay again given the opportunity!
By far one of my favorite places. Thanks so much, it was great.

We loved this place! Great location for our activities… close to our niece’s apartment, her wedding venue, and restaurants we went to over the weekend.  Chiara was very responsive to all our questions.  And her place is perfect for two couples because it’s 2 bedrooms/2 baths. Mattresses and showers are awesome and the place is immaculate.

Al and his partner were extremely accommodating. They made sure that we knew exactly what we needed to do to create a peaceful and safe stay. They were available and communicative when we needed them but were great about not being overly present. Convenient location. Great stay.
Excellent location. Family friendly. Clean place. Easy parking. Loved the stay.

Staying at Assel’s place for a bachelorette weekend was great! Very communicative which was nice when we had issues with the rooftop. The only complaint was that the towels were thin and a couple of the mattresses had concaves in the middle or on the sides. Overall a great stay.

The stay was nice very clean,, well equipped with items,um bathroom could use a little upgrade bathtub,just a little hit and miss things,but I have nothing bad to say at all would stay again if in Chicago
Blad was great host and very responsive. I would definitely stay here again.
We had a grest time!
We loved staying in Billy’s apartment. Pleasantly surprised with the walkability while also feeling secluded.   Clean, comfortable, looked like the photos. 10/10 would stay again!
Great place and great location! Mary Casey was easy to get a hold of and very accommodating.

Stopped in for a couple days with friends. Place was great walked to many different things.
Pet friendly, always a plus with the fur babies. Very easy to communicate with. Would stay again in the future!

We had an excellent stay here. The street is quiet yet walkable to the best of Wicker Park and the blue line for easy access to the rest of the city. No dedicated parking but we never had issues finding free street parking at all times of day. Highly recommend.
We had a great stay
We absolutely loved the place! I would highly recommend it. So walkable of a location. Cute place. Cute location. It was absolutely perfect for our family of five!
Seriously great place - the high ceilings make the place seem bigger than it is and just tons of storage.

Nicole and Matt's apartment was perfect for our family. The place looked exactly like the photos and was in a great location - walkable to so much. We had all the amenities of a nice hotel with the conveniences of our own apartment. Nicole and Matt were helpful and communicative. I would definitely stay in this apartment again.

I absolutely loved this Air b'nb. The noise from the street does not come in which was amazing to have. It gives a city experience without the noise and a lot of privacy. The beds and bathrooms were clean, and the extra living room was amazing to have on the top floor in case you just wanted to relax without the hassle of all the stairs. This place is a lot bigger than the pictures. Which was a huge bonus. Also a lot of the shops are walking distance. The target was great to have as a 5 minute walk down the road because we definitely forgot things. I would definitely come back!
We had a very wonderful time at your place and we will definitely stay there again

We absolutely loved our stay here! Such a big, beautiful space. They provided everything but body wash haha! I haven’t been at a home that accommodating before! The home was clean, with only a couple game under construction. Lastly, Ray’s communications was efficient and greatly appreciated! Overall, 10/10
experience!

Super lovely location! It was perfect for a trip where we were planning to be out and about all night. We loved having our own separate rooms but still big enough living room and kitchen to share. There was a miscommunication between a later check out time and the cleaners being notified but other than that it went very smoothly
Beautiful high rise! Building is quiet and peaceful. So much to do in the area.
The place was lovely and worked so well for all 7 of us who needed a place to stay in Chicago. He was so responsive and friendly which made the booking and stay very easy and convenient.

Alain has a beautiful apartment. Very modern and updated. His neighborhood is up and coming. Book now! In 5 years the cost will triple! Everything was great and was extremely helpful and responsive. My group of ladies will gladly stay again
Everything you need in a great location.
The inside is very nice and clean but I wish they put how the outside looks in the pictures

We stayed here for 3 nights to attend a family wedding held in Logan Square
* Place is clean and comfortable. Close to restaurants. Safe/walkable neighborhood.
* Romana is very responsive and answered messages within 5mins. This was great when we had an issue with the lock keypad and couldn’t get in.
* There were several snacks and water bottles left for us which was nice.
* Bed/pillows comfortable.
* Nice to have garage parking option.
Things to note
* Dogs allowed no breed restriction but there is a $100 fee (did not see this mentioned) but did not bring my dog so no issue.
* Many stairs that are steep and narrow which could be a challenge for some. (Stairs like this are common in Chicago.)
* No recycling option. We recycled items ourselves at home.
* 3 sets of unlabeled keys to keep track of - i hooked them together.
Overall, We drive and visit family in Chicago often and enjoyed our stay in this apt!

This apartment was a great place to stay with my family for a weekend in Chicago. It is spacious, across two floors (ground floor and basement), and in a walkable location in Rogers Park, close to many amazing Mexican restaurants just a few blocks away. It has a high chair, which was great for our baby.
The hosts were very responsive and helpful, including offering a flexible schedule for us.
The apartment is comfortable but pretty spare, especially the kitchen. We did have a few issues the hosts helped with or responded to, like one of the inside lights does not turn off (it's motion sensor), and one of the beds turned out to be Sleep Number with half hard and half soft (there weren't instructions, we had to download an app and adjust). Water pressure in the downstairs bathroom is pretty low.
Otherwise it's a good base, good location, large amount of space, and helpful and friendly hosts.
Great location and place was as described! Thanks for letting us stay!

I have stayed in many cities with Airbnb, this had to be the worst when it came to cleanliness. The bathroom was disgusting with dirty and molded grout, dirty floors, cut toenails on the carpet in the living room, kitchen sink was slow to drain and clogged, tea cabinet was broken. It is a shame that this apartment was not kept cleaner and attended to maintenance. The Gym amenity was wonderful and the location was convenient to hwys and buses.
It was perfect for what I needed

My stay was wonderful at Chicago Hospitality Club. The location is great for food, walking, sight seeing, and more. The rooftop area is very nice and the view from the room is a great view of some of the large buildings in Chicago. I recommend taking an architecture tour by boat if it’s your first time visiting Chicago, that was the highlight of our trip!
Very centrally located for what we needed.  Squeaky clean. Some noise from upstairs neighbors late at night, but not enough to deter another stay in John’s place.

I've stayed at many Air B'n'bs over the years, usually opting for a private space, but my few nights' stay in Lois and Eduardo's beautiful home was one of the best! On a gorgeous leafy street in Roger's Park, this 1890's Victorian has so much charm and the room so luxuriously appointed (the bed is positively swoon-worthy!), I did not even mind sharing the bathroom with other guests or venturing downstairs for coffee/kitchen items. But really what put the stay top o' my list was Lois and Eduardo themselves. They were so welcoming and kind and relaxed—open to chat and make sure you feel at home, but also organized—all instructions and expectations were clear. I would 100% stay at their place again. It was a delight, start to finish.
Great location!
Loved the space, and loved the neighborhood. Easy access to the busses and nice restaurants around. Would definitely come back!

The apartment is well equipped for short to medium length stays. Location is good for expressway, el train access, Aldi supermarket. Safe neighborhood. Isabel was super host, very responsive and friendly. Would definitely stay again.

Spacious and comfortable apartment in a classic historic building. Location was great for our Hyde park activities. We found nearby street parking every day, though this might be harder when schools are in session.
Overall an excellent visit!

It was a great place to stay.  Easy to get to, good places to eat within walking distance.  Easy walk to public transportation.  The apartment had lots of space. Kitchen was great and user friendly.  Everything was clean and it smelled wonderful inside.  Rida was a great host, very responsive to all my questions.  I highly recommend this place!

So far the best place we’ve stayed at in Chicago. Very clean & loved the neighborhood the airbnb was in. Parking was great and the area is walkable. The space has everything you would need to be comfortable for a couple days & the layout and remodeling of the space is so cute & very well thought of. The host is very friendly & responsive & does an amazing job at communicating expectations & instructions.
Good host. Easy to get in touch with. Very nice home. Spacious. Convenient location
Merci pour l’accueil et la très bonne communication, tout c’est très bien passé
Afsha has a wonderful home to call your's for a few days! the Bodega next door and market walking distance was extremely nice
ロケーションが最高でした。ホストも親切で、たまたまお会いした時に何でも言ってねと気にかけてくださいました。お部屋にイスがあるといいなと思いました。

Great Chicago stay. The kids enjoyed the pool table and ping pong set up. We spent most of our time on the town so the place was perfect for sleeping and preparing a few meals. Simbarashe is a great host that really takes care of his guests and genuinely cares about their experience. Would stay there again.

This has been one of my favorite places I’ve stayed in Chicago! Ewaz is an incredible host, and her sweet puppy Simba was such a lovely addition to the experience. great stay, very central location too

Nice, clean and spacious. The parking spot is absolutely necessary and a fantastic feature.
Such the perfect place for a weekend in Chicago. Spacious area, quiet community, close to some great restaurants and not too far away to other areas we wanted to visit.
Lili’s place was amazing. Felt so comfy and had everything we could possibly need. Would 100% stay here again 😊

Very enjoyable stay!
Great stay!

Great place, my group had a lovely time.

After driving 5+ hrs we arrived to a dirty space w/ dirty wet towels on the floor & dirty sheets piled on the bed. We messaged host & about 45 minutes later we received a message saying he was sorry & was sending a cleaning lady. He didn't offer any discount. He messaged us hours later saying she was done and that he left us a "little something", which was 2 bottled waters & 2 chocolate bars.

Quirky old building. Great view, endless things to walk to right down the street in any direction. Very exciting area to stay in.
The Good:
- Bright living room, right in the thick of it in one of the most walkable neighborhoods I've visited.
- Easy walk to the train or the lake
- Good place to host with multiple tables to sit at
Things to keep in mind if staying here:
- Parking is pretty much impossible in this area. There is the spot hero app, but it was >$100 for a 24 hour period the day we arrived. There is permit only parking right on the street outside, but this would be dependent on the host providing these per day (not always possible).
- It's an old building, so its not exactly quiet all time, but you don't have a ton of near by neighbors.
- None of the doors are plumb, so opening and closing them can require some effort, and they are not the most private.
- DOGS. The spot was dog friendly, but even finding grass in the area was a challenge at first.

This place is Amazing!! Excellent location. Plenty of street parking. Mario is an wonderful host! Very responsive and helpful! We’ll definitely book it again.

We truly couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. It made our trip that much more enjoyable, and we would happily stay here again. I wholeheartedly recommend this home to anyone looking for a comfortable, welcoming, and memorable stay. Thank you so much for having us!

Worth the money. Beautiful, super clean, quiet and spacious listing. Host provided everything and was swift with communication.

Comfortable home.  Nice kitchen. Walkable to the train and nearby shops/restaurants like Van Leeuwens. The picture of the back of the building in the instructions was outdated which drew some confusion but other than that, great stay/experience overall.

Location was perfect. Close to red line for train and also bus communications too. The host responded to my concern promptly and took action quickly. Responded to my queries quickly and efficiently. Overall a good place.

I’m extremely disappointed with how this was handled. Within 10 minutes of booking, I received news of a death in the family. I immediately contacted Connie, explained the situation, and acknowledged that the booking was non-refundable. Instead of saying no refund, Connie told me to cancel and request one through Airbnb. Based on her guidance, I canceled, believing she would cooperate with the request.
Airbnb then informed me the refund required Connie’s approval, which she did not provide 3 days later. Within an hour, we realized we couldn’t get flights back to Florida and still needed a place to stay. I even tried to rebook with Connie so she could still receive our business, but she declined. l
I lost $390 and had to spend another $450 elsewhere. Had Connie simply told me there would be no refund, I would have kept my reservation. My issue isn’t the non-refundable policy—it’s being told to cancel and request a refund, then being left without the reservation or my money
Nice place at a good price.

Outstanding hosts, very friendly and communicative people, everything was very clean. You got everything you needed. I would really recommend you to stay there. They made me feel like home.

Overall, my experience at this AirBnB was positive, though there were significant WiFi issues that hopefully will be resolved for future guests.
Pros:
- Good and quiet location, about a 10 minute walk to the Orange line train
- The space was private
- Relatively good value for the privacy and location
Cons
- The WiFi speed was inconsistent, and often was frustratingly slow (e.g, sometimes it was fast enough, but other times it took ~10+ seconds to fully load relatively basic webpages). As a result, I couldn't depend on it for basic Zoom meetings for work and had to hotspot a connection from my phone.
When I let Ying know about the issue, she was quick to respond and sent the house manager over to look into it. He couldn't find anything wrong with the system, but she said that she would look into it more, and would perhaps upgrade to a new WiFi plan.
If and when the internet issue is resolved, I would recommend this AirBnB because my experience otherwise was good.

Thank you for a wonderful stay! The location was excellent, and the team was incredibly helpful and supportive. Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. We had a great experience. 10/10 — highly recommended!

Great value place to stay near the train. Aaron Emisael shared very clear instructions and set expectations. The room had a slight Marijuana smell, but besides for that the place was super clean. The surrounding area was nice and felt safe.

Was exactly as described and very nice. You can walk to the train station from the house or take a car and park at the train stations. If you want a nice trip to Chicago and you’re on a budget I would definitely recommend this place. It’s in a very nice area and good neighborhood.

I really loved the studio apartment it was clean had everything I needed, spacious, everything worked correctly in the room, it’s just the getting in part. Entrance to the building was a hassle due to the fact that the intercom code I was given didn’t work, and there were no updates on a new intercom code before I left to get into the building, I had to put numbers into the lockbox and next to that was a little lever that you pull down and as you pull down, you pull open the lockbox which has the key in it to unlock the door so that was a little much, and then with the room door, there is a lock/unlock button above the numbers you push that first then you press in your code and then you push that again. Wait for it to make the sound and then open your door it all just takes too long. Also when taking out the trash you go downstairs to ground level. Host told me that the doors would be unlocked so I can get back in after, door locked right behind me, had to walk all the way around..

José was a wonderful host. He was extremely communicative and helpful. The apartment is a really cute space in a wonderful neighborhood. I met a couple of the neighbors downstairs, who were all so sweet. One of them even helped me get in through the main door when I arrived, since it initially wasn’t clear how to enter from the street level. Once we figured that out, though, everything was great. I really enjoyed my stay!

I had a wonderful stay! The accommodations were lovely, extremely clean, comfortable, and very well maintained. The location was also incredibly convenient and close to everything I needed during my time in Chicago, which made my stay that much easier.
The hosts were absolutely lovely—warm, welcoming, and thoughtful—and truly made me feel at home. And I can’t leave out Blaze, their amazing dog, who was definitely an added highlight of my stay! 🐾❤️
I really appreciated the hospitality and care that went into making this such a comfortable experience. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a welcoming, clean, south side place to stay in Chicago. Thank you for a wonderful experience!
A great place in a wonderful neighborhood which is worth exploring while exploring the wider Chicago area.
Great Apartment, host was responsive and friendly. Check in was stress free and very easy, the apartment also had great views of the city. If I was in the city I would stay here again without a doubt

Buen precio, olía raro por el clima y con ubicación rápida a la red line y justo lo que se especifica 😁
