The apartment is mostly as described. A bit difficult to "park & check-in" given you can't utilize the parking until after you check-in.
But the beds are comfortable, the place is clean, and the amenoties (tea, coffee, filters, toothbrushes, toothpaste, cotton balls & swabs) are all fabulous touches!
Walking to McCormick place is easy, and the arena is nearby, too. Restaurants are plentiful.
The city is loud, and you will hear it. Welcome to Chicago! Lol
Overall, a good place to stay, and ours was fantastic.
They were so kind! If i return I would book again!

My partner and I enjoyed our stay here. It’s a small space but we fit comfortably with our 2 carry-ons and 2 personal items. Good for solo or couples looking for a place to rest after a day of exploring the city.
I can’t say enough about this space. It’s sunny, peaceful, and beautiful. I am sad to leave and I can’t wait to come back.

The Taj Ma Small was the perfect place for a traveling couple, as my boyfriend & I love planning baseball trips. It was very quiet, private and close to everything we needed. The neighborhood was quiet & friendly & the bars/nightlife was only a couple blocks away. The sodas, coffee & oatmeal was a sweet gesture. The hosts are very thoughtful and quirky with their guide book. We definitely would stay here again! Thank you for the kind thoughtful stay, as I was out there for my bday & it was my first time in Chicago!
Exactly as described and in the photos. Dan was an amazing host. The place was clean and private. The location to downtown was fantastic.
Thanks for hosting! Spacious apartment, great location, and clear check-in / checkout instructions.

Well-maintained garden apartment in Bridgeport, comfy beds and pillows, excellent WiFi, thirsty towels, great water pressure in the shower. We absolutely loved the neighborhood. Everyone takes advantage of the two parks: tai chi in the morning, basketball, football, tennis, a great playground. It's a short drive to outstanding restaurants. Milton was very responsive and friendly. I would stay here again.

Fantastic spot in a great location, responsive host. It's not super sound proof, but a great spot and I loved the stay. It was great to be so close to the blue line. Perfect for our adventures in Chicago!

Great spot that’s close to wonderful restaurants. The walk to red line and the lake are about 15-20 minutes depending on how fast you walk! Overall great location, and the dedicated parking spot was great!

The host gave a small refund due to several difficulties, which was appreciated. Location is great for being close to U of Chicago, but those thinking about staying here should be aware of some challenges. The address on the Airbnb app was slightly different from the actual address, which was sent in a SMS message. We were able to find it but it was confusing at first. The code for the door to the apartment building didn't work and the host didn't verify it before we arrived. So we were stranded outside the building late at night. Luckily another resident let us in, but if they hadn't been there, we would have been shut out because the only workaround the host has is a physical key, which is located inside the building. The AC is a small window unit. There is no elevator up to the floor where the apartment is located, so a flight of stairs must be used. The laundry is shared and requires at least $10 paid via app (the host didn't know what app, so luckily a resident told us).

Man, this spot was absolutely on point! Spotless, modern, clean, impeccable and pristine. We got this home for my mother who was visiting for our son’s 2nd birthday party and it could not have been more perfect - she loved the place! Would definitely recommend to anyone interested in staying in this area, which  by the way, is walking distance from Fulton Market (home of many of the Reataurant in the city)!
Love the little apartment you can hear your neighbors but it wasn’t anything crazy or unbearable also there are so may walkable places the beach is less than 10 minutes away I loved it !
Great location and responsive host. Would return!

Definitely read other people’s reviews before booking. We sadly did not. As soon as we walked in there was a strong smell Coming from the washer and dryer. Obvious water damage from the washer. Needs repairs. Stains on the bedding and bench at the end of the bed, hair in the shower. Old, outdated towels. She didn’t  put much effort into decorating the place, or using comfortable bedding for guests. Too bad this place does potential to be great.

Great location and close to public transit. Beds were comfortable, apartment was clean and noise level was at a minimum. Location was safe and comfortable. Restaurants within walking. Would be helpful to have a better stocked kitchen, ie cutting board, seasonings, salt pepper oil. Better seating around the table. Overall 100% would stay here again.

This apartment is in a great location - it's between the Red and Brown lines, which makes it easy to get around. There are good restaurants in very walkable distances, with a variety of price points and cuisines. The hosts were super responsive to the issues that arose (linens and lockbox dead battery). The photos may be a bit out of date regarding amenities. I wouldn't hesitate to return!

Borja's 2 BD+2Bath apartment with four beds was ideal for our family of four. The location is perfect, just about two minutes walk from Cloud Gate/ Bean. Everything else is also a short walk. Host is very responsive and we had everything available for us. Thanks Borja for hosting us
such a warm and artistic style, i like the art and window ceiling design, thank you to Janet! will come back next time for sure!
Great place great stay

Once we accessed our booked unit, our stay was great. The space was clean, amenities were as listed, and the location is very convenient to UChicago and nearby stores/restaurants. The host was responsive; however, self check-in was difficult. We arrived around 12:30am to a dead keypad that was used for entry. The backup battery the host expected to be in a lockbox was missing, and we were asked if we could purchase one from a store, which was frustrating given the late hour. After an hour, we were given an alternative unit, but its kitchen sink and washer/dryer did not work. We were told cleaners would arrive by 11am the next day so we could transition back, but they did not arrive and we received no update until I reached out. The hosts approved our request to get a refund for our first night, which we appreciated. I would book again, but since our late arrival was communicated  and we were assured the unit was ready, I recommend confirming access is fully functional before arrival.
Jorge was great. Very responsive and quick. The place was really nice. I enjoyed my time there. Would definitely book again.

We really enjoyed our stay. We were there for a short visit and this was perfect. Laura T was great as she checked on us prior, during and after the stay. The home was just as described and upon checkin we smelled the aroma of cleanliness and freshness in the home. The area was nice and there was plenty to do within walking distance. I highly recommend this host! I look forward to booking again soon in the future!
The place was nice. Good neighborhood with restaurants close by.

Gorgeous, perfect location and extraordinarily kind and helpful staff. I would highly recommend. Only negative is that I would suggest to the owner that the AC unit outside of the smaller bedroom be moved. It does make an obnoxious noise like you are on an airplane and it is directly outside the window near the headboard to the smaller bed. I would guess it could be moved and that would greatly improve the experience for the guests staying in that bedroom.
Probably one of my favorites she was very accommodating especially since are originally Airbnb we got was not what was expected definitely will book again in future if available
Have stayed here before, and would definitely do so again in the future.

I had a great couple days at Viviana’s Air BnB. I parked on the street just a few second walk from the apartment, instructions for entering were clear and entering was easy. Plenty of space for at least 2 people. Near multiple good restaurants, especially taquerias. Buses a couple minute walk to multiple subway lines. Overall, I had a great stay!
The flat was absolutely perfect! I felt very comfortable and I absolutely loved the location. I will absolutely stay here the next time I’m in Chicago!!
Great location with easy access to restaurants, shops, L stations!
Christina was very responsive. Great location - very clean! A wonderful place to stay’
Great place to stay in, spacious
Place was clean. Quiet most nights for Chicago. Easy walk to McCormick place. Would stay again

The 3 bedroom apartment worked really well for our family of 5 to have plenty of space. Our children ages 5-11 were glad to swim at the pool (it’s a little tricky to get to) but SO cute. The front desk staff were so kind at 11pm to show us all the way up to the room on the 23rd floor. They also had discounts for the Wabash Parking ramp so it only cost $20 a day!

We enjoyed our stay! The home was clean and beautiful as described. P.S. If you are wary of the deposit, Airbnb helpline did explain that some listings are able to charge an offsite deposit (and that this one in particular has a positive record) but that it is your choice whether you choose to book or not. After clearing that up everything was great.
Great stay close to the lake in Chicago.  Private off street parking for a small car.  Beautiful second floor 2 bedroom unit
Milan's place was great. Felt comfy and homey. The views from the rooftop lounge were awesome and all the amenities you can find are within walking distance.
Great place, hosts go above and beyond!!

We had a wonderful stay at Alma's place! The property was exactly as described... clean, comfortable, and we really enjoyed the time we spent in the unit.
There is absolutely nothing wrong with the property itself, and Alma was a very communicative and understanding host. Everything inside our control was perfect. Thank you for having us!

We had a wonderful stay! Everything was seamless from start to finish, and Kevin was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We were travelling with three little ones, and the place was perfect for our family. The location was also great—close to the city and very convenient for getting around. We would happily stay here again!

We had a great stay here! We drove our Hyundai Palisade from CT, and there was ample street parking even with a larger vehicle. The home itself feels exactly like that - home. There were small comforts -snacks, easy access to WiFi, bathroom amenities like extra tissue, q-tips, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, etc along with cutely displayed hand and bath towels. The beds were comfortable, there were enough pillows to make a nest, lol, and the linens were clean and satisfyingly heavy (not hot). Thermostat was easily accessible, low temp was 68℉, which was perfect for our stay. My little artists enjoyed the desk in the second bedroom, and our whole family enjoyed the comfort of the living room. The kitchen is clean and efficient, with a bar height table for two. We mostly ate in the living room so we could gather all four of us together. The decor was balanced and tasteful, and I loved the beautiful bench in the larger bedroom. Lots of closet space too. I would absolutely stay again!

We had such an amazing stay! Anthony and kaitlyn we're great host, very helpful and had great recommendations, the area was also very lovely and calm and the airbnb itself was so cute and comfortable. Hope to be able to come back again.
Very nice stay we enjoyed our time there

We really enjoyed staying at Justin’s airBNB! The location was perfect, close to restaurants and the L train. Quiet neighborhood and a very peaceful courtyard that was perfect for pets. I would and will definitely stay here again!

Had a really nice stay at Matthew’s place! Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Matthew was a great host and made the whole stay smooth and easy. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend his place!
Great small little apartment perfect for what I needed. Comfortable and clean
Amazing hospitality, great guy, very clean environment!

Our first AirBnB in Chicago and it was perfect! Lovely, clean apartment with a beautiful garden/patio below. Felt very private and safe. Thoughtfully furnished and organized. Daran regularly checked to see how we were doing - so appreciated that! All
Around great experience and hope we can stay there again!

This accommodation was great and we would definitely stay again and recommend this to anyone. We had a couple of issues arise (none of which were Andrei’s fault) and he was extremely responsive and had someone at the property very quickly to deal with those matters.

Marco & Sarah place was a home away from home. If it was comfortable, peaceful and in a great environment. I enjoyed my stay after a long drive. Everything was wonderful! I’d definitely would stay again when I’m in the area. Definitely 5 Stars!!
This place met our beers perfectly.

Can't beat that location. Waking up and just a block from wrigley for a day game. The surrounding neighbourhood in summer is amazing as well!
Yes it's a basement unit, and you will hear upstairs / laundry unit now and again, but it's nothing outrageous.
Was surprised at how comfortable of a bed, and couch came with the unit as well.
Will do again when in town for baseball.
Very nice stay
We had a little setback, but it was great. Mike was a wonderful host and we thank him so much.  fast response, communication was great. Thanks roof will book again
Helen was very nice—a great host!
A fantastic stay! The host was very welcoming and responsive, ensuring I had a great stay the entire time.

This was a fantastic place to stay during our few days in Chicago. I would definitely recommend and would stay there again! It was very clean, not cluttered but homey at the same time, and it had everything we needed for a few days.

Very good stay, very clean spacious  room, clean place as a whole.  The location is near loads of shops including a large supermarket and many places to eat. Near public transportation and quite walkable in my opinion. Definitely recommend booking a stay at this location
Jorge is very kind and was very accommodating! Nice place for the price, thanks so much.
The suite is quiet, cozy and exactly as described. It’s the perfect place to unwind after exploring the city all day.
Perfect location, and an easy comfortable stay! Hope to stay again next time I go to Wrigley for a game.
Great spot

Great place to stay—very comfortable and welcoming. It was my first time in the US, and they were very helpful with local recommendations, which made the stay even better. I would definitely recommend staying here!

Our team stayed here together for a work trip and we could not have been happier! The place was beautiful, very spacious, and made it a very comfortable stay in Chicago for our team. We loved the huge kitchen and dining table, so we could cook and eat together. It was important that everyone had their own room, so the many bedrooms made it possible for us to stay in one place, which was a big benefit for us.
The host was very responsive and helpful in the lead up to our trip, and we were able to arrange for an earlier check-in, which was helpful for members of our team who arrived earlier in the day.
The only thing I would note is that some of the bathrooms are within a bedroom, so we had to do some planning to coordinate which bathrooms people would use. But the bedrooms and bathrooms were all beautiful, and this didn't cause any issues for us.
Overall, our team would definitely book this place again, and if our next trip is somewhere else, it will be hard to match it!
Bradley's place was just as described and he was a helpful host.
location is incredible, apartment is great! thanks again Patricia, you’ve been a great host!
Alma was very reliable and the space was very visually pleasing
good host, checking in to make sure we checked in okay and  if we needed anything. was open to hearing improvements which was nice.
Great staff, quirky chic and perfect location.

Steve and Mary were such a delight, and their penthouse was a pleasure to stay at. We needed to work remotely from their place, while also moving our daughter into her apartment close by. Their patio was such a nice sanctuary to retreat to after a full day of working. It was a nice relaxing moment to drink some wine and plan out our dinner plans. Steve and Mary felt like family, and gave us so many helpful recommendations and suggestions. We would absolutely book again next time we’re in the area!

Our family of four had a wonderful time in Chicago, and much of that was because of the proximity of Stephanie's appointment to everything. The views from the apartment are spectacular and the rooftop at night was gorgeous. Our 10 year old son enjoyed the pool while our 17 year old daughter soaked up some sun in the huge sun bathing area. Bonus for the Target next door. We where disappointed to find there was no seating on the balcony though as that was a highlight for our family. And no shelving  in the shower to place items or washcloths. None of which where a deal breaker for us and we would definitely stay again.
great amenities and helpful staff too!
This is a wonderful property in an outstanding location in the city. Super-spacious and comfortable. We will be back!

Fantastic spot just minutes from Wrigley.  We weren't there for a game, but had we been it would have been perfect.  Great neighbourhood.  Safe and quiet.  We were nervous about the train noise, but it really wasn't an issue.  I would (will) definitely stay here again.  Coffee shop right down the street on the corner.  A convenience store around the corner for essentialls.  Bars and restaurants within easy walking distance.

logement propre, calme, transports en commun à proximité. Erica repond rapidement sux questions.
une remarque pour les français: climatisation du logement et fenetres qui ne souvrent pas ; normal pour les américains, mais inconvénient pour les français! 😉

This was a wonderful apartment for our first ever trip to Chicago.  The neighborhood was very close to several great restaurants, and only 1 block from a bus stop.  The apartment itself was very comfortable, clean, spacious, and had everything we needed for our week-long stay.  I would definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to be close to downtown Chicago, while still enjoying quiet nights away from the city noise and lights
The apartment was fine and had everything we needed plus it is close to public transportation. Communication felt robotic and lacking in that personal attention I expect from an Airbnb.
Awesome host, great location and property. If you need a great place to stay in Chicago, this is your place!

This was one of the best AirBnBs we’ve stayed at in Chicago. The proximity to the beach, playgrounds, and public transportation were great. It’s a VERY cute flat with lots of space. It felt like Caitlyn thought of everything, with linens, toiletries, laundry, board games, and more!! It would be a privilege to stay here again!!
Amazing place to stay. Safe, centrally located, and perfect accommodation for what I needed.
Thank you, good host.

His kitties, Wolf and Apricot, were truly the absolute highlight of my trip. I had a free day on the Tuesday I was there and I legit just spent the day with those goofballs. They are literally the reason I stayed and I’m so glad I did! I love them both so much.
The bedroom was lovely and clean with no strong smells. I hate it when places use strong fragrances for detergents or air fresheners. It didn’t have any of that, which I loved. The bed was rather creaky, but it was comfortable.
The only thing I will note is that if you’re expecting hotel level clean, stay in a hotel. It felt like I was crashing at a friend’s place. Definitely could’ve used a tidy in the bathroom and kitchen, but nothing crazy.
He does have a pet cam in the living room, which is perfectly fine and acceptable.
As my own personal opinion, if you don’t like cats, don’t stay. They deserve all the love and affection, so please don’t ignore them if you do. :)
Great space for our family! Well designed and clean.
gorgeous place in a lovely part of town, super clean!!
Lovely place and location
Great stay at Michael’s, he was very responsive and helpful for our family. The airbnb itself was very nice, clean, and in an exceptional location
Great spot, close to Chinatown.

We had a great time staying at Jevaux's place. It was tidy and spotless, well placed to get the 6 bus straight into the city and placed next to a park we enjoyed walking through. Another great thing was the approximately 20 minute walk to the nearest beach for Lake Michigan.
This stay was most excellent. I felt right at home with Amanda’s decor, and with her demeanor. She was friendly and very helpful; I would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Great place to stay in the city. Easy walk to the train, tons of restaurants, close to beach! We enjoyed our time with two kiddos.
Great location and excellent neighborhood.

The original place we booked wasn't ready but thankfully the host allowed us to stay at another residence without additional costs. He was very responsive and answered all my questions. The stay was nice.

Milan was very responsive and easy to communicate with. The place itself was very nice, clean, and in a great location close to everything.
A few things could be improved. The third-floor patio was very dirty and had a lot of spider webs, and the rocking chair was broken. I almost fell over when I tried to use it, so we weren't able to use the BBQ area as planned. There was also a strange smell in the hallway leading to the room. On my first day, while I was bringing my things to the room, the electricity suddenly went out.
The kitchen could also use a few more cooking items, such as a pizza pan and a larger pan.
Overall, we enjoyed the stay, but addressing these issues would make the experience much better for future guests. I would have included pictures to show these issues, but unfortunately, there wasn't an option to add them.
Literally at the center of everything. Perfect location and stay.
Great stay!!

Nous avons passé 3 nuits dans cet appartement. Pas tout a fait au centrze de Chicago mais bien desseevi par les bus et métros. 3 chambres et 2 salles de bain qui nous permis d'être plus à l'aise que dans une chambre d'hôtel à 2 grands lits. Appartement propre et bien équipé. L'hôte répond à nos questions et nous a fourni de bonnes recommandations pour manger alors que nous arrivions tard.

Stayed 11 days for work at Andy’s place in the room (orange) next to the kitchen. House is located about a mile south of Obama center in an okay neighborhood. Check in instructions were clear. Room was fine; bed was good; AC worked. The room had lack of lighting, and too small to have a work desk. The shared living space does have sofa and ding table to work if needed. Free street parking out front; only bothered once by a neighbor sweeping the street asking for money. House has quite a few rooms, and only one shower and two toilets with time usage rule of 10 minutes. If there are a lot of guests, then there may be a wait. I’m usually up early, so there was not much of a wait. The cleanliness was fair to good. Noise level was good as all the guests were fairly quiet and respectful. The front door needs a stopper as it is quite loud on closing and seems to shake the whole house. Overall, it was a great place if you just need a bed to rest and don’t mind sharing space.
Great walkable location and spacious, comfortable place to stay!  The bed was really comfortable and felt like home.  Thanks for having me!
We stayed one night here. Loved the fun  Chicago graphics! Fun look. Beds were comfortable Thanks

I had a great time here! It was very clean and I felt very safe, especially with the secure lock on the doors. Everything was very nice! I’d definitely recommend to anyone looking for a place in the area to stay here.

Charie’s place was perfect for enjoying the South Side of Chicago. It is easy to walk to stores, restaurants, Obama Library, U of Chicago, Museum of Science and Industry. If you are driving in, street parking is challenging, however you can secure a parking spot using apps. We had trouble getting in the building occasionally due to the code malfunction, however Charie got back quickly to solve the problem. We recommend the place highly.

Pros:
Location is excellent.
Lots of natural light.
Neighbors were pleasant people.
Cons:
Sort of the definition of low effort Airbnb -- cheap ikea beds without headboards. The mattresses had a crinkly plastic cover underneath, that is just cheap and unacceptable. Obviously a place with a lot of turnover that screamed "investment property".
Very little storage space -- this place is OK for a couple, but have fun sharing a closet with whoever is sleeping in the second bedroom. My wife had to store her to things in the second bedroom closet, and I could fit a small amount in a couple drawers in the very small dresser in the master.
- no side tables in the guest room, no side lamps, no shelves or storage in the bedroom.
- broken chandelier
- gross carpet on the stairs
It goes on...
Works fine for weekend stays, not good for an entire month.
Great place to stay and easy to check in. Price is good as well. If you need a place near midway, stay here.
Had a terrific stay. Everything was wonderful and exactly as described.  Very clean. Would definitely stay again.
Thank you for a great stay! Very nice room, comfortable bed, and solid gym! Also good location.
This second floor apartment worked well for our short stay.  It’s in a good location on a quiet street.  The pool table is a rare surprise!

I loved this property! Very clean and cozy, and the perfect location. Geo was very responsive and helpful- their checkin and checkout instructions were thorough and easy to follow. I definitely recommend this unit for folks looking to stay in the area!

I haven't been to wicker park since before covid and MAN what a great location. Three friends fit comfortably, we didn't even use the second living room. Three balconies?! yes plz. Would def stay again.

I had a great week-long stay at Jason's. The apartment is clean, spacious, and comfortable (comfy bed & couch). It had everything I needed for the week. The location can't be beat (and I lived in the area for many years!). A quick walk to the Brown line and several bus lines gets you where you need to go, but there's lots to do in easy walking distance as well. I'd stay again!

This stay had every opportunity to be 5 stars. It was very comfortable, nicely furnished, spacious and clean. It's in close proximity to the train, a grocery store, coffee shop and beach. The downfall is that it had no working refrigerator and freezer, which was a known issue for weeks prior to our arrival (as seen in past reviews) yet was not addressed. When I inquired about its' working order prior to our arrival, I was told that her team would look at it and get back to me. She never did. She did, however, reimburse part of my stay for the inconvenience. Other maintenance needs to be done as well, as the shower and bathroom sink got backed up. Iris did offer a handyman to come in but we declined. Had I been the first guest to notice the fridge it still may have been 5 stars, but not after it was clearly not addressed. I would absolutely love to stay here again if the issues are cleared up!
Great room in a good area, that is a nice 10 min walk to public transportation. Lovely host, would stay again!

Great place in a great Chicago location. The space was very clean and comfortable, and we especially appreciated having a good setup to work from during our five-day stay. Brian was extremely responsive and easy to work with throughout. We would absolutely stay here again.

This was my first time using Airbnb, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience! The host was incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout my stay. He responded quickly whenever I had a question and made sure everything was taken care of. His kindness really made my first Airbnb experience even more special. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend him as a host! 🤍

Brandon’s house is awesome! A super nice, thoughtful, and accommodating build. We stayed in the top floor “penthouse” unit and enjoyed our two night stay. Accommodations were thoughtful, inclusive of floor fan and heater dependent upon weather. Access to two balconies was clutch. Showers were peaceful. Easy in and out. As a solo woman the location is maybe not the most ideal or comfortable, but once my partner joined me, the walk to the Blue Line was fine. Bring Felix Pokemon cards to pay homage.

What beautiful apartment
A real Chicago home exactly as shown in the pictures
Very well equipped & the little things you might expect to provide yourself
Would definitely like to stay here again
Patt's space was lovely. Comfortable, welcoming and a great value! Patt was a very responsive host as well and I would suggest her spaces to any guests visiting the area!

Overall the apartment was clean, clean linen,  the only downside is the location and  one of the bedrooms had a cardboard  box on the window and there was no l sunlight coming in the room. One other thing was the couch that is torn. Otherwise it was a great stay!
Its an extremely dangerous area, and she is absolutely inconsiderate and fraudulent

It was a nice stay. The intercom code didn't work to get into the building but I was able to call someone to get alternative instructions right away.

Had a great time in this charming heritage building that houses a US House of Representatives member's office.
It's near the Obama Presidential Library, right next to a bus line to get you into the loop quickly, an hour from Wrigley on Transit. Near Chicago university. Would recommend.
It does have AC, but not centralized, so the bedroom can be warmer, but just sleep with less on.
Would totally recommend and stay again

WONDERFUL place to stay!! As pictured, beautiful room, kitchen and living area with your own bathroom (shower). I searched a lot of places in the area and it's not so easy to find all the amenities, features and privacy this place has. As the pictures show it's clean, tidy and also homey, comfortable and beautiful. Easy check in with clear instructions. Wonderfully quiet and honestly it felt like having my own home. I needed a place near Humboldt Park / Logan Square, this place was a perfect location on a quiet and beautiful tree lined street, with a parking pass for each day. Not only would I return to stay again I would look forward to it! EXCELLENT place and host, thank you so much!
Peter's place was fantastic.  He could not have done a nicer job designing the space.  With three bedrooms and two full baths, it is perfect for a family of four.
Mimi’s place worked out perfectly for our needs! Conveniently located to downtown and close to restaurants. The neighborhood felt very safe, plus had a great outdoor shared space.
Best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at

I feel so fortunate to have found this Airbnb, it is a gem!  We stayed there while getting my daughter situated for her first year of college. Tracy and her family are wonderful, warm and welcoming. The room was pristine, with a very comfortable bed, lovely linens and a beautiful bathroom. Tracy was very responsive and helpful.

Yasmin as a host is incredibly nice! She communicates very clearly and I like her quite a bit. In terms of the place nothing about it was outright bad or unbearable. If I could've given 3.5 I would have. The check in process for us was rough, the cleaning lady had to come retrieve us an hour after check in time and then stayed an extra 30 minutes past that. Yasmin was VERY apologetic though and brought us a bottle of wine which was very nice but the listing mentions that you get a complimentary bottle just for staying which was not there when we arrived it was only given after the check in inconvenience. The blow dryer does not work which was frustrating as I left mine at home because it was mentioned in the listing. One of the outlets next to the bed does not work. When we arrived we found 2 burn marks in the couch, Yazmin contacted us saying she would be filing a claim against us BUT after a very friendly conversation this was resolved! I'm not sure I'd return but Yazmin is lovely

I loved the vibe of Marc’s place! The apartment was as pictured. The wall mural is beautiful! I felt safe and comfortable in the space. We walked to 3 restaurants within a 1.5 mile radius during our stay. The area was safe and quiet.
Marc was a great host! Responded quickly. Would definitely stay again.

We had a great stay at Kyriako's place! Location, location, location - lots to do and close to Lincoln Park, but on a quiet, tree-lined street. Accessibility to other areas of Chicago was easy either via driving or public transit. The parking space in the back and the pet-friendliness were clutch! The unit was comfortable and quiet all day and night. Highly recommend if you're looking for a stay near Lincoln Park!
The condo was great - the view was amazing and the condo itself had great amenities. We loved the area and everything we wanted to do was within walking distance.
Good location for my needs. Grocery store and restaurant close
Very roomy place. Host was exceptionally nice and responsive. Nice side yard patio. I would stay again.
Fantastic place for the West Loop

This apartment felt right at home. It was nice and cozy, felt right at home. It’s surrounded by beautiful parks, restaurants, and coffee shops. There is an Aldi a block away if you need to do some shopping. Host was phenomenal and quick to respond. I highly recommend this place!

I can’t say enough about our stay here. The place was perfect, location was top notch for our cubs weekend- just far enough away to be peaceful but a 5 min walk to the action. There were a few times we needed something and Scott was quick to respond, immediately took care of our request and made everything seamless. We will definitely try to book again for our next trip up here!
Place as described, very close to downtown, easy to find, free parking in the back and can find a spot out front.
House is very beautiful and spacious great host
The towels are similar to rags for toilet cleaning instead.  Disappointed 😞.

Stylishly designed flat with everything I needed. Immaculately clean. Quirky artwork, a bit macabre, makes it truly unique.
Very walkable & lovely neighborhood with every amenity available.
A great place for my 3 day work trip.

Sue is a great, friendly very welcoming host. The guest areas are spacious,  charmingly decorated, spotlessly clean and feel very private. The area was exactly what I was hoping, close to the 606 and bike rental, walking distance to restaurants easy public transportation. I felt safe walking back to the house alone at night from the bus stop. I will stay again next time.
Had a great stay.
Room was like the listing and it was a short walk to the pink line also the water got hot super fast
Great spot to explore Chicago from. Highly recommended.

We had a good stay overall. The area is very nice and well connected to downtown Chicago via the Brown and Purple Lines, which made getting around really convenient.
The only downside is that the trains can be quite noisy, especially since they pass nearby. However, they stop running at a certain time at night, so it wasn’t much of an issue while sleeping.
Overall, a good place to stay with a great location and easy access to the city.
Very cute house  and Ivy was the best!

Derek’s place is very beautiful, clean, and in a good location that it only takes a few minutes away from the CTA station. Also the view there is just insane, Derek took us to his secret spot that can see the whole city of Chicago, that was so beautiful. Last but not least, Derek is such a nice guy that always makes sure we get everything we need. I will definitely stay here again when next time my family and me visit Chicago.

Sibani by Taims was wonderful!   The place was just as described and the location was great.   We walked to fun restaurants and ice cream shops in the evenings.   The neighborhood was quiet and safe for early morning jogs.  The place was fully furnished with everything we needed from the kitchen to the bathrooms, and the mattresses were super comfortable.   Check in was easy and it was nice to have a parking pass since we had our personal car with us.   The host was very responsive to any questions and we would definitely stay here again!
Alma was very great hosting our stay. Perfect mini home outside of the city!
房間乾淨，但是浴室的熱水稍嫌不足，且水無法順利流掉，但是地點非常好，房東回覆也很即時，只是進入房源較為麻煩

The Village-inn was an ideal location in the Lincoln Park neighborhood of Chicago. Right next to our son at DePaul university. It was walkable to so many great shops and restaurants as well as a 5 minute walk to the train.
The house was comfortable and clean. All the amenities were included and Julie Ann was always responsive and helpful. Street parking was very easy to navigate with a parking pass included with the house.
We will be renting again when we go back to Chicago.

Great spot in a great neighborhood!  Tons of restaurants and things to do nearby. Short walk to the train station.  Short walk to Wrigley Field.  Clean, nice apartment and responsive, friendly host.  Comfy bed!  We enjoyed our stay

Stephanie’s place was an amazing high rise my family (6 and 11 yo kids plus husband) loved it! The appliances worked great. There’s a full size iron and board, hair dryer in both bathrooms and even flat iron! My daughter loved the tub shower combo and the walk in is very spacious! The fixtures are top of the line (grohe) so pressure and functionality were perfect. The view and balcony is incredible. We visit the city at least annually and hope to stay at one of Stephanie’s places again! The pool and hot tub and sauna were a huge hit as well. Quiet and very well maintained.

We really enjoyed our stay at the Lakeview Luxury Condo in the beautiful city of Chicago. The place actually looks even better in person! It was clean, spacious, and very comfortable. The building felt secure and quiet, and the neighborhood was lovely. We especially enjoyed being able to walk to Wrigley Field every day during our stay. We would definitely stay here again!
Everything it’s so clean, and peaceful, I really loved to stay there

Samantha was a great host. From the start, she was clear and quick with her communication. She was friendly. She checked in to make sure everything was going ok. She lived in the apartment upstairs, but she was not intrusive. However, she was super friendly and informative whenever we ran into her. And she has adorable kids and a chill, happy dog.
The apartment was comfortable. We had three adults, and the place was more than big enough. It was spotless when we arrived. Samantha provided plenty of linens as well as a sweet array of snacks. Getting in and out was easy. We didn't take full advantage of everything, but it was nice that it had a big kitchen and a TV.
The location is great. Logan Square is a good neighborhood with a lot to offer. It's also central so it is easy to get to most places in the city. We rented a car and always found street parking within a block of the apartment.
I visit Chicago often, and I definitely would stay here again.

Really enjoyed our stay here while moving my daughter into her apartment in the area. We needed a car so having a parking spot was key since most of the streets are permit only. The apartment is below ground but gets plenty of light and we enjoyed having the patio and the rooftop with a great view. I hope we can stay here again when we visit our daughter!

Ewaz was wonderful! We booked with her very last minute and she was very helpful. When we arrived she was extremely friendly and let us know about many recommendations for things to see in the local area and around Chicago (as it was our first time visiting the city). The condo was clean and was exactly what we needed for a few day stay. It is also well located, being right next to a bus line and within walking distance to the metro line. We are highly interested in coming back and booking with Ewaz again!

This was a quiet and private place to stay, which is surprising because it is close to the inner city area. The place was bigger than expected, and fit my family of 4 quite nicely. The host is very responsive and communicated well. Aside from the the twin beds being a bit squeaky and one sensitive family member having allergic reactions (possibly from the HVAC), we have no complaints at all. Overall, the stay was very pleasant.

Patricia’s place was a great spot to stay to drop our kid off at Loyola! A quick walk to the campus and tons of great restaurants and coffee shops. Parking was surprisingly easy on the street and she provides passes! Patricia was always very responsive as well. The place is beautiful and charming with a lot of character! My only note would be to bring earplugs if you move in bed because the gorgeous wood bed frames can be squeaky. (The neighborhood itself is peaceful and quiet)
Nice quaint stay.

We needed a place to stay in Chicago on short notice and this was perfect. Joseph responded quickly, was able to extend the stay when we needed more time , and were understanding when we made a mistake in checking in. Totally our fault. Their instructions were very clear. Highly recommend as super hosts.

This apartment was perfect for my long-term work trip! The neighborhood was cozy and the community energy was wonderful. The train station was just a 10 minute walk. If you're looking for a place that is more residential rather than steeped in crowded tourist attractions, this place is perfect for those who want a more laidback and real Chicago experience (and you can easily get to the tourist attractions from the train station). Kurtis was super responsive and friendly, and overall terrific host. The place has everything you need and things you don't always think about (bottle openers, hangers, scissors, ice cube trays, extra chargers). Would love to stay here again for Chicago visits! :D

This property is perfectly located for a Cubs game. It's only a 5min walk to the ballpark, and shorter to multiple restaurants. The offerings in the neighborhood are easily above par for what to expect around a stadium and make it worth staying even if you're not there for a game.
Iris was proactive providing details for our visit and responded within minutes when I did have a concern (which ended up being me not reading her instructions).
I will definitely shortlist this location for future trips to the area.
Perfect place with lots of things to do nearby, would definitely recommend!

Katty was an excellent host who was very responsive and helpful. The apartment was perfect for our family and she has thought of everything you would need in a stay. Would love to stay again. Parking in the area is hit or miss but it is easily walkable in a great area.

Michael was a great host. Location was in close proximity to everything we needed. Space was spotless and just as described. Check in and check out was easy. Michael was a very responsive host. We would definitely stay again.
Really cute little place in a beautiful street in Chicago. Hosts left us many suggestions and some beverages/snacks. Would highly suggest
great host! very responsive and helpful. the home was very clean and stocked with everything we needed. it made our stay in Chicago more enjoyable

Zoë’s place was great, just like in the pictures and Zoë was very helpful and always responsive with clear check in and check out instructions. The apartment has all the amenities except a washer and a dryer. The only downsides are two very narrow stairs that you need to climb and the highly uncomfortable sofa-bed. Low ceilings, including the shower area might be a problem for tall people.

We stayed here for almost 6 weeks so we got to experience everything the brownstone had to offer plus all the restaurants and other attractions.  This was the perfect place to stay if you are looking for a rental that is in a great location and is quiet, peaceful, clean, comfortable, light and airy.  Danny has thought of everything for your comfort.  He is an exceptional host and this is a great property.  This will be our home away from home every time we are in town visiting family.  Thank you!

Mark and Carmen are thoughtful and supportive hosts. They respond to inquiries very fast and helped my daughter and I get all our bulky luggage in the apartment.
The apartment is very well equipped with all you need to cook meals and the bed was super comfy.
Location is super convenient. Close to grocery stores , restaurant,
and public transportation to downtown. Is also the place to be if you are visiting someone at Loyola University.
They also have a beautiful, whimsical garden
We loved staying there and will definitely be back. Thanks Carmen and Mark!

Over the past few years I have rented all three of Jason‘s units in this building. The location is perfect, parking is easy to find, each unit is exactly as described and always clean. Jason is very polite and always helpful with anything you need. The units also are stocked with even the little extras that you don’t usually see at an Airbnb.

Great place to stay! Location of was very nice and quiet neighborhood and had many great shops or restaurants nearby.
No issues with Airbnb everything was as expected, plus more. Very great communication from Donald and team as well. Would stay here again if I come back to Chicago again!

Luke's place was very comfortable and in a great location. We were visiting a family member at UChicago Medicine and it was very convenient to the hospital. We enjoyed dinner at nearby BAR DAVID. It was great to be close to Promontory Point and the lake as well.
Excellent!

We had a great stay.  Loved having the detached garage parking and it fit our tacoma perfectly.  The video games were a plus for us and Freddy was a great host.  He lead us with instructions or information through the stay.  He was very responsive.  We went to a Cubs game.  It was a little over a 1 mile walk to Wrigley field.  After a rain delayed game, we walked it at 1am with no issues.  All in all, a great location that we would definitely stay at again.

Iris was a lovely and communicate host with a very comfortable space. It was perfect for myself and my daughter (4.5 yo) to rest and spend time in Chicago. We walked to the dog beach, were able to walk to Target, Jewel, and anything else we needed. We would 100% stay there again. The in unit laundry was great!
Leonid has great communication and his home was lovely and clean!!
Good location and a beautiful place

This was a fantastic stay and I would recommend Anna's place to anyone coming to Chicago without hesitation.  The apartment is beautiful and absolutely matches the photos.  Anna was a wonderful and kind host who stayed in touch with us the entire time and was completely committed to making sure our visit to Chicago and stay in the home was great.  Thank you Anna for making our trip great.
Great studio to stay in for a visit to Chicago! Clean space, easy check in, convenient parking spot.

Perfect pied a terre for our visit to Chicago w/6 of us - 3 generations all happy with the place. So close to the lake and parks and trails and nearby food and coffee in walking distance.  Great location for exploring.  Very clean and comfortable.  Hosts were very responsive and helped us with navigating the parking in the Windy City.  Parking was a challenge due to construction (which improved as they freed up space on the street later in the week) and street cleaning - don't ignore the signs strung up on the trees BUT there was nearby street parking and garage parking and we always somehow managed to find a spot on the street even with the construction.
環境真的很乾淨很漂亮，有住在飯店的感覺，床也很令人舒適，還有超大電視可以看，很貼心的提供卸妝巾供女生們使用，房東真的很貼心，還有機會會回訪！
Great area, wonderful place to spend time in Chicago.
Elizabeth was a great host. The location was great. There was a plumbing issue during our stay. I would recommend this place when the plumbing issue is fixed.
Everything was clean and just like the listing
Great deal for a place that’s still close to everything downtown. Others may complain about noise, but it’s nothing unexpected with being in a large city.

It was a good stay. There was a minor issue with the code but I was able to contact someone who let me in.
The room was pretty good. This is a nice sized room for exactly 2 people. I think 3 would be a stretch. Ultimately, it’s a decent room for the price point and the location is sublime. Steps away from public transport and there are many good restaurant options within walking distance.
Amazing stay highly recommend

We had a wonderful five-day stay with our family of three. After a 16-hour flight and missing our connecting flight, arriving at this calm, beautifully maintained home was exactly what we needed.
The location is superb—peaceful, yet only minutes from W Division Street, restaurants, cafés, and shops. Target and the Division subway station are also about a five-minute walk away.
Ishin kept the unit spotless and exactly as described. Every detail was thoughtfully considered, from the carefully chosen décor and quality furniture to the elegant piano in the hall. The kitchen was fully equipped, and the spacious back patio was perfect for relaxing in the evenings.
Ishin was prompt, responsive, clear in instructions and went above and beyond by letting us store extra luggage at her place with easy access whenever needed. We would definitely stay again and highly recommend this home to anyone visiting Chicago!

The place was perfectly lovely and clean. Check-in instructions were clear, and communication was great. There was a laundromat nearby too (although they only spoke Spanish, but the staff were kind and helpful nonetheless). However, the location is a bit on the inaccessible side and there aren't many great food options nearby. Overall, a perfectly fine place for a few days' stay!

10/10 air bnb!
Super nice hosts, the place was so cute and cozy!!
They have a lil book for air bnb guests to sign like a “we were here!” Kinda thing, so cute!!

We had a wonderful stay at Rich’s AirBnb.  Many of our favorite locations are walkable.  His place was very clean.  Rich was very responsive and flexible with our early arrival.  Also, free public street parking nearby.  Highly recommend staying here.
Great location, had everything I needed. Shay was extremely responsive whenever I had any questions.

The furnishing is very nice. It is also convenient to have a private bathroom. The shared living space has a large refrigerator, and there’s also a mini fridge in the private bedroom. Overall a very nice stay. Would recommend to friends.

Host was friendly and responsive. Location of Airbnb was great. The Airbnb itself was not great. Front door doesn’t lock so that felt a bit unsafe. The entire Airbnb was dirty, whoever cleaned it definitely rushed. Backyard/patio was completely unusable, couldn’t sit anywhere because the patio was very dirty or broken, not to mention there were insects everywhere due to the apple tree which is not maintained (apples and leaves absolutely everywhere) it looked NOTHING like the pictures.

This almost felt like staying in a bed and breakfast. We really enjoyed working by the gardens. Rob was so warm and welcoming. The neighborhood is lovely, walkable and close to public transit.
I really look forward to coming back and staying here again.

My partner and I stayed at this Airbnb and absolutely loved it! We had an impromptu trip to Chicago to check out the city. Jennifer's Airbnb was close to metro/bus lines, which we used a bunch during our stay. The place was comfortable and quiet. The neighborhood is very peaceful during the day and at night. It felt very safe. Jennifer and Rachel were very communicative and checked in on us throughout our stay. It was affordable and fit exactly what we were looking for during our stay. 10/10 would recommend staying here, and we probably will rebook if we visit again.
p.s. The rainfall showerhead was super nice, and it honestly made our whole day.
Great place! Comfy beds. Clean and cozy linens. Pretty quiet given its location. I’m a light sleeper so I really appreciate these things! Would definitely stay here again.
Everything were perfect

Phenomenal location and hospitality. Only about two blocks to Wrigley Field and the Red Line train. Two blocks in any direction and you could find dozens of restaurants, shops, coffee, bars, or whatever you want. Tree-lined roads in a completely safe-feeling neighborhood with many families walking around, everywhere.
On Cubs game days, expect excessive honking (but that's generally just part of Chicago), and it can be loud. However, when there are no games, it is very quiet, and the window AC unit takes care of the rest. The Wifi worked great, as I had two business meetings I did from the apartment. Water pressure was great in the bathroom.
This was one of the best-managed properties I've ever stayed at, and the owners are very organized and responsive.
Good for transportation. Hosts are very responsive.
We had a great time.
Great place to stay at . Quiet , clean , and a safe neighbourhood. The host is very helpful and friendly . 10/10 would recommend if you’re in town for a few days and need a place to rest your head
I’m glad we stayed at Miriam’s. Home away from home.

Amazing Host! I had a amazing stay! I would recommend this place to almost anyone who ask’s. Host are amazing at communicating. Let me
Check in early and we’re very patient with me.❤️💋

Great home base for Chicago for our family of four with two kids 14 and 10. Owners extremely responsive and went out of their way to help when we had trouble getting into the house. Lincoln Park is a great neighborhood and quick “L” train ride or car trip to all local attractions. Some noise from surroundings but nothing terrible and earplugs provided. Great TV/family room in basement and desk with lamp. Three bathrooms and three showers. Extremely nice and comfortable stay. Will book again next time we’re in town. Owners on top of everything and extremely responsive even while they were traveling.  Highly recommend.
Great neighborhood, lots of space with two bedrooms downstairs and two bedrooms upstairs. Washer and dryer are nice to have when traveling.
Nice place to stay.

This is a lovely two-bedroom apartment in a quiet and well-located neighborhood. It felt like a home away from home. Traci and Justin were very responsive when we ran into a small issue.  They're the perfect hosts. I highly recommended their place for a peaceful and comfortable stay.
Good place

A very nice unit with stunning views of Lake Michigan. The place was easy to find with clear instructions to get in. Host was always available for any inquiries. The building was well maintained and had plenty of amenities as well as location was very easy to walk to downtown and Lakeshore.
Pro Tip: Book parking with SpotHero in the same building for cheaper rates.
We loved the quiet, family neighborhood and getting away from the crowds for evenings. Easy walk to the train. We didn’t have a car so we had groceries delivered.
Perfect places. Nice and clean and the host was perfect also. 10/10 definitely recommend
Great hosts.   Good communication.   Nice place.
Exactly what I was looking for & more! Abel was a great host and look forward to returning sometime in the future.
We had a really nice stay here, earplugs were appreciated as the train passes by very closely. Samad was really responsive and we really enjoyed the space!

Awesome place to stay! We only stayed a few days but would have been great for a longer trip as well. Location was great - near so many things!! Very walkable/runnable. Really enjoyed the stay there - happy I was able to reserve this gem of a spot!

Enjoyable experience for a few days stay in Chicago. Walkable area (that felt safe) & super easy parking. Host responded quickly & place was as seen in photos. A bit confusing getting in the first time but that may have been user error (the addresses were conflicting but only 1 building apart). All in all, I would certainly recommend this place & have no complaints

Staying with Jeff on the first part of my trip in Chicago was amazing . He was friendly and responsive in a timely manner . The space looked just like the pictures and the area was quiet. Will be booking again
We absolutely loved it and would stay here again. We were very comfortable and had everything we needed. The neighborhood is great and parking is easy.
Overall good place to crash. Convenient to public transit to get to downtown and museums. Has the basic amenities, but we weren't provided enough towels.
Nice, comfy Chicago condo in a great location.

Good stay overall! The building was old and thus the elevator etc. caught me by surprise I wish info was included about that part of the stay when booking the place. The room was kept in a good condition when I arrived. Good communication by Jevaux. The area was safe.
This is a great location with incredible views. The parking spot is great to have as well.
Erik is an excellent host and is very accommodating. The house is in a peaceful neighborhood that felt safe to walk around.

The house was in a silent neighborhood and suitable to stay with kids. Darina was a very welcoming host with all the needed explanations prior and during our stay. Everything in the home was as expected as shown, clean and ready to use. Many Thanks!
Absolutely fantastic. Would stay again
Everything look good , work out perfectly, will recommend the place

We felt at home here while visiting nearby family. The bed was comfortable for us and the apartment was clean. We only used the kitchen for coffee and simple breakfast. Will stay again on our next visit if available!

This is a very basic place but overall a great deal since is cheaper than other places in the area. The furniture (sofa, bed, mattress, tv) are on the cheaper side and low quality but gets the job done.  If you need a place just to crash, shower and maybe make breakfast this is your place. The place is very quiet and despite it’s on the third floor you can barely hear the neighbors. Also almost no street noise.  I hope this place keeps getting fully booked so they can invest a little on a better bed and mattress and a bigger TV. Internet was fast and stable. The area was fantastic and safe. I was able to find free street parking just a couple blocks away. Over all I do recommend this place and I would definitely stay here again.
Great location, easy access to red line - lots to do around.
Great location! Close to bars and restaurants. No grass on site for pets but found some close by.
Everything was great! Clean and a great location!

Great location, right next to bus stop and close to commuter rail and subway, which takes you directly to downtown. Groceries and restaurants were present around which is a good thing. The house was a big studio with a private kitchen and bathroom. The host responded fairly well. However, the place needs slight more of a maintenance. There was a issue with the wifi connection, due to loose electrical socket boards. There were cracks in some places on the wooden walls. Also, there was a lot of confusion in the middle of the stay due to the entry code to the main building not working. It was finally solved but the situation was very confusing when the door code was not working, leaving us standing outside the building for quite some time until help arrived. Other than that, everything was fine. Great stay for a few days in a peaceful Hyde Park area.

The Fisher Building is one of Chicago’s oldest buildings and it's charm is beyond amazing! I highly recommend a stay here and before you do, research the history of the building and the location, printers row. It's close to everything you need, including the redline and blue.

Marissa is a great person. The apartment complex is under construction so it was very hard to find the entrance. The parking was ok in the afternoon but almost impossible at night. The place is outdated but the view is spectacular. The A/C is a little noisy but Marissa left earplugs. One thing marissa needs to improve is the bathroom shower and provide more towels, i asked for more but she refused.  Also the floor were the apartment is located smells horrible.

The house was spacious and comfortable and matched the pictures and descriptions. Although some of the furniture is well worn such as the dining table and chairs, everything was functional.  It is very convenient to the Blue line and to bus lines, and there are many restaurants, bars, and shops within walking distance. We would stay again!

It was a lovely place that met my requirements. I was visiting one of my sons who lives in Logan Square. I had my other son fly in from SF for a little reunion. The home was cozy, comfortable, and convenient. Russ is a great host, who is very responsive and flexible. I would definitely go back again.
Owners stay upstairs and help with any needs you have. Super nice couple. There's a park right across the street and many places to eat in the neighborhood or close surrounding areas.
Excellent stay, space was incredibly cool, homey, and owners are very responsive to anything you may need.
A very peaceful and cost-effective stay for a low-key introduction to Chicago or downtime before leaving!

This was my very first experience using Air BnB. After doing a lot of research, I found Just spot to be the best fit for or stay. I was not wrong, the place was absolutely incredible. Everything that is stated in the description and pictures is spot on and clean. There are helpful reminders through the house for proper use that really helped. I was even able to do a load of laundry! It's very close to the downtown area, which was super convenient. My son said the bed was the most comfy he's slept in, which I really appreciate. He loved the game area as well. The spot is very calm and private. Overall this was a pleasant stay with no complaints. A very huge thank you to J and her team!

We had a wonderful stay! The space was clean, comfortable, and perfect for our family of seven. Our host was friendly and welcoming, and the Andersonville location was amazing—such a great neighborhood with so much nearby. Everyone in our family was happy and comfortable. For our first family vacation together, this Airbnb was everything we needed it to be and more. We’d absolutely stay here again!

Cheryl was very communicative and explained my concerns when needed. The apartment has everything you need for a short stay like ours. The neighborhood was chill and quiet during our stay. Only a few blocks away from the bus station that took us to Navy Pier and typical tourist places.
On the listing and some comments, it says something about a wine and bottles of water, but we didn’t received any (maybe it’s an old thing). It would’d been nice to set this place apart from the others.

This place was a great place for a few nights stay. Checking in was smooth and very clear. Vin was very responsive and answered all my questions. The place was clean and as described, it wasn’t anything super fancy but it was homey and comfortable. I’m very happy with my stay.
This apartment was perfect for our family of 5!!! Very clean and comfy!! Will definitely come back again!!! Charie was always helpful and quick to respond!!
My family and I had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean and exceeded our expectations!!
This was our first time staying in Airbnb… me and my husband enjoyed a lot and if we get the opportunity again we will stay here again.. the host katty is very friendly.

Logement avec une chambre et un canapé lit. Il y a suffisamment pour deux mais pas pour trois (2 chaises, 2 fourchettes, frigo qui fait un bruit d'avion donc difficile de dormir dans le canapé). La communication est très bonne et l'hôte est très arrangeant. La literie est bonne et tout est propre. Je recommande pour deux et quelques nuits mais pas pour trois.
Ottima casa a 5 minuti dalla metropolitana.

Very amazing stay! The hosts communicated very well consistently and their place was clean and well set up! Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in the area or wanting a closer stay towards downtown Chicago!
Great location , great place , enough room . Would stay again. The tenant let us leave our luggage before check-in and that helped us out so much .
Great space, centrally located to lots of great restaurants and nightlife. It was perfect for a friend reunion, but would absolutely come back with my entire family of four.

Such a great location walking distance to the Fulton market neighborhood and right on the train. The apartment is spotless and spacious! I felt right at home while deciding whether to move to Chicago from this launch pad
