A couple hours before we showed up we were told people may be inside taking measurements. Luckily we were running late and didn’t deal with that. Parking is extremely tight but there is a designated spot that’s pretty well lit. The person below listens to tv extremely loud. You can literally hear and feel the volume all the time. The area was really peaceful for being so close to the city. Some guys randomly showed up early one morning. They began working on the roof then began tearing apart the porch and completely blocked the front door off. The host never mentioned anything about this happening. They worked into the evening blocking the front door off that entire day. The WiFi is not very good and could not connect to my Xbox. The remote to the tv in the bigger bedroom doesn’t work. Everything was clean and neat. Check in and check out were very easy. There are lots of bus stops and train stations around. You don’t need to drive if you’re here. The price is a bit high for the value.

This cute little condo is located in a neighborhood across from a park, bike path, and Trader Joe's. The line 6 bus is an express that stops almost right outside the building and takes you to downtown Chicago in 20 minutes. It's excellent value for the price.
Our hosts were spot on communicating with us. Comforting knowing we would get any questions answered in a timely fashion. Just a very comfortable stay in Chicago!

Great place, great host, and an even better city! I had an amazing stay and truly enjoyed my time in Chicago. The space was exactly what we needed, and the host was wonderful. I would definitely stay here again!
Bien

Fantastic host and a good space. The only major quirk is that there's a gas stove, and I could kinda smell the gas when using it since the space is kind of closed off. If it was an electric stove I would have felt more comfortable actually cooking. Regardless, a really solid spot in a great neighborhood.

The apartment is at great loaction but few issues we found is that the water pressure is really low in kitchen and both the bathrooms. Many times, it's so low that  there is no water while you are taking bath. We found that the bathing space in the attached bathroom is small is size.
Absolutely loved our stay!  If you go to Chicago you must stay here!  Mike was amazing and the place was perfect!
Amazing place

everything was perfect! place looks just like the photos, i stayed for 6 nights at an amazing price. host ALWAYS responds quickly. check in and out was simple. Place was super clean. had everything you needed except dish soap i think. i saw other reviews complaining of a hot water issue…i did not have that ! everything worked perfectly!! would definitely recommend

The apartment is exactly as described.   If you don't know the neighborhood, the apartment is perfectly situated to enjoy the surroundings.   Quiet building and the windows face away from the street.  Recommended.

We really enjoyed our almost 2 month stay at Vas' place. The layout of the unit and the (3) bedrooms were perfect for our family of 4. Tons of windows so there was a lot of light. I liked having our own separate entrance. The kitchen was well-equipped/stocked. The back deck was a nice place to relax and read a book. Located within walking distance to Logan Square- shopping, coffee shops,  restaurants, parks and the el. Free street parking was a bonus! We were there during the summer months so not sure if parking will become challenging with school year starting and the school directly across the street. Neighbors above and below the unit were very nice. Floors were a little thin so something to consider if you are sensitive to a noise but nothing too bad. Vas was always quick to respond. We are considering staying again this winter. Highly recommend!!
We stayed here when we were moving our daughter into her dorm at Loyola. It was very convenient to the campus. Space was amazing and cozy. We also appreciated how accommodating the hosts were.
Host is awesome and the home is more like a luxury home. So elegant and spacious. Location is great.
Great

Merci Michael de nous avoir accueilli dans votre magnifique appartement ! Nous avons adoré notre séjour !
Le charme, l’authenticité et la propreté de l’appartement étaient fidèles à l’annonce !
We had an excellent stay at Freddy’s Airbnb!
Perfect place to stay on the north side of Chicago. Check in was super easy, the host was very responsive, and everything was as advertised. Would stay again next time I'm in Chicago!

We stayed at Dean’s place for two months this summer and although we had to leave early, Dean was extremely accommodating and understanding!  The place is immaculate and the pictures do not do it justice! We also received weekly cleaning services with linen changes, as well.  The yard is beautiful and having a space in the garage was very convenient.  Dean and his place are an excellent find and we hope to return on future trips to Chicago! One of the very best Airbnb’s we have ever stayed in!

A great location for Wrigleyville, tucked away in nice residential neighborhoods yet still close and convenient to the stadium and good food/beverage. This unit is on the ground floor, so we experienced a few days of very loud noise from the unit above, with kids running around all morning. Not the most peaceful, but a chance you take staying in a larger apartment building.

This was an amazing stay! Was in a perfect location near everything. The owner gave very clear and simple directions. The air bnb was quite nice nothing too fancy, but very comfortable and clean! Parking is a little difficult, but the owner recommended downloading spot hero and it worked perfectly!! This was genuinely such a great deal and we loved our stay here!!

We came to Chicago to drop my stepdaughter off at Loyola University, and the location was perfect for us, just a few blocks away! We were able to walk back and forth between Loyola and the apartment easily, and we also enjoyed walking to the lake. There are lots of restaurants and places to explore nearby.
The apartment is small, but comfortable for two people. We honestly didn’t spend much time inside because we were out walking around Chicago and spending time at Loyola. The apartment felt very secure, and we also felt very safe walking around the neighborhood.
Regina was easy to communicate with, and her check-in instructions and directions were clear and easy to follow.
The bathroom could use a little attention, and the water pressure is quite low, but it’s an older building and neither issue interfered with stay.
Overall, this was a very convenient place to stay, especially if you’re visiting Loyola. We really appreciated being able to walk everywhere! We would stay there again.

We LOVED our stay at Phillip’s place. This Airbnb was perfectly located near our daughter’s new home and very walkable to Andersonville!
The home was clean comfortable and cozy. We loved it. Can’t wait to visit again. Thanks Airbnb for another amazing vacation.

This was a great place to stay to visit our Loyola student - loved the walkable neighborhood, all of the nearby restaurants and other amenities, and the apartment was very clean and comfortable. I would highly recommend for visits to this part of Chicago!

Alexandra was an excellent host who responded to our needs immediately and proactively sought to make sure our stay was perfect. The property is lovely and there are no surprises in terms of fees or location. My family and I recommend it wholeheartedly!

Very good building in a historic area, with culture that shows the best traditions and values of America including Lorraine Hansberry’s home nearby - recommend visiting, respecting and learning from this great neighborhood of Woodlawn.
Great place to stay and great hosts!
It's a nice but more a functional apartment, so don't expect much more, but also no less. It was pretty clean. The neighborhood didn't seem this nice and safe, but the bus stops right at the corner.
Highly recommend.

This place needs some major cleaning and tending to. On top of that there is a strong smell of Indian food is present. I decided to basically stay out all three days I was there just to avoid being there. The bathroom was gross and was not stocked. The entire Airbnb was not stocked with basics. I actually went a whole half day without toilet paper and ended up having to buy my own toilet paper and items that usually are provided by the host. It was not a good situation. The bed is more of a cot and it absolutely killed my back. I guess you could say it was pretty quiet area, but obviously not enjoyable with the state of the Airbnb.

I had a wonderful 3 night's stay at Beth's place. It was charming and so well-appointed! Snacks and abundant coffee and tea for the Keurig! It was quiet and private. The neighborhood is safe and there is an Aldi's less than a five-minute walk away. Plus, great restaurants within 10-15 minutes. The living room furniture and the bed were also very comfortable.
Would recommend stay. Good neighborhood.

Last minute, I was coming into town for work and needed a place to stay, and I’m so glad I found this Airbnb! The instructions were very clear and easy to follow, and my room was exactly what I expected and very clean.
The highway is pretty loud, but my workdays were very long, so I had no trouble sleeping. It’s a shared space, but the other guests were very friendly, and the host was extremely communicative and helpful.
I would stay here again!

Great, clean, spacious place to stay for when you want to visit Chicago but want to get to be a little bit away from the touristy areas. The a surrounding area is walkable, peaceful, and has plenty of restaurants to try. The hosts are responsive and kind.

Lovely location, lovely people to communicate with and a lovely green kettle.
I would recommend to anyone wanting to experience Wicker Park!
The apartment was as described. Very clean and walkable to many different spots in the area. Easy check-in and clear instructions for both arrival and departure. I would definitely stay there again!
Very nice
Benny is a great host. Throughout our trip Benny checked via email or phone call to see if we needed anything. Very responsive

My wife and I had a wonderful stay at Ian's place.  It's in a quiet neighborhood only a couple of minute walk to the heart of Lincoln Square, as well as many restaurants and a nearby brown line stop.  Ian's place is comfortable with a fully stocked kitchen with everything needed in terms of preparing meals.  I recommend it highly for anyone looking to stay in north Chicago.
great space, beautiful neighborhood, a lot of train noise but very muted inside, it reminded me of thunder.

Great apartment in a beautiful neighborhood. I love staying in Andersonville when in Chicago, and Brett's apartment was on a quiet block and still walkable to all the good stuff on Clark. I would love to stay there again.
The good: Excellent host communication, super clean, good value. The bad: Bed pillows suck, fridge needs a water filter, AC is loud.
Nala and Owen’s place is amazing,very clean and quiet ,the place is easily accessible by bus or train from downtown Chicago ,it’s was worth the stay.

This place is exactly like the photos and how it's described, the rooms are private, I had no problem with noise from below or other guests. It's very clean through out my stay.
The location is great as long as you are okay with using public transit, its well connected.
Buen lugar para hospedarse
Great location close to public transport and walkable. The mini apartment was very clean and the perfect amount of space!
We loved our stay here!! We are able to reach downtown Chicago by 15 mins. Very close to Chinatown. Lots of restaurants around. The place was clean and has all the amenities listed.

I have never been happier with the totality of an Airbnb experience than I was with this one. Dr. Helen is a great person hosting a fabulous Airbnb. I stayed there with my mom who is almost 90 and wanted to visit her hometown of Chicago. Dr. Helen's place is just perfectly placed, right at the start of the Southside -- so it was ten minutes north to the Science & Industry and Field Museum and Shedd, and ten minutes south to the new Obama center and Hyde Park. It was amazing to be situated right there. It was quiet with really nice neighbors. And Dr. Helen greeted us and was always ready to help. She is a tourism professional and it showed in how well she had prepared the space and anticipated guest needs. My mom and I only stayed a couple nights and that was the only misstep -- I need to come back and spend a week or more in  this Airbnb.
Home was very near to Blue line CTA train. We got parking outside home and used train to roam around for all 3 days.

Perfect place for our needs! 2nd floor, bright and spacious apartment that was a perfect location where we could park on the street for free. Thanks to host Daniel for proactively communicating before we arrived, providing all the info we needed for a tranquil arrival, stay and departure. Will stay again!

The location was great, the place was perfect for vacationing.  It was 2 blocks from Michigan Ave, but still in a neighborhood.  Great restaurants within 3 blocks, close to the Red Line, walking distance to shopping.  Clemente was very responsive and helpful.  I would stay there again.

Beautiful apartment! Great walkable location, clear instructions, and answered right away when I had a question. Loved the high rise feel and place was beautiful, clean, and had everything I needed. I’d definitely stay again!

Great place, although the pictures look different from the actual unit in terms of structure, It’s a great unit close to the city at a rather fair price, considering how last minute the trip was for me.

The location is excellent and an easy walk to University of Chicago, Hyde Park restaurants and sites. It is an easy drive to McCormick center, Chicago loop, northside attractions. We had an entire floor with cozy beds, a generous living space and plenty of room to relax. The host was very responsive and make it great stay.

We really enjoyed our stay at Geo’s place. The apartment was spacious and clean. The neighborhood had a lot of restaurants and was easy to explore the city from. We’d stay there again on our next trip to Chicago.

I was in town for business, it was close to transit so that made it very easy to catch the bus/train to get to where i needed to go. The room was spacious, so I didn't feel cramped. Good communication as well.
Great location
Comfortable and accessible.

El lugar es excelente muy acogedor y completo para vacacionar unos días, además la zona queda en un excelente lugar, quedan restaurantes deliciosos cerca, además que esta cerca de la ciudad es un lugar al que volvería ir
The place was very neat with a great location in Little Village. Lots of great restaurants in a walkable distance.
The place was great- it had everything we needed for our stay. Close to food and shopping. Check in and Checking out was very simple. Would stay here again.

‘Brad’ is either not real or outsourcing management to a shady company.
On my first day, I received voicemails and spam messages from an unknown number, some containing religious proselytizing. The number was associated with the company ‘Guesty Lite.’
There are multiple Airbnbs at this address, all sharing one front-door key. This isn’t disclosed. When someone else took the key, I couldn’t get in.
My unit’s keypad also malfunctioned, leaving me locked out for about two hours without my belongings. The host only responded every 10–15 minutes. I was unsure whether I’d have somewhere to stay or whether someone was inside my unit.
Eventually they sent an “emergency code”, accidentally including: “this is for our management do not share with guest.”
The host told me to call the same number that had been spamming me, confirming the connection. The woman who answered resolved the keypad issue, but the combination of the fake host, missing key, and spam made me feel unsafe.

Ottimo posto per soggiornare a Chicago 3/4 giorni
Lo consiglierei
Host super disponibile
Really lovely studio in a great area with lots to do. Thank you so much for being so accommodating and helpful!!!
Great host, everything was perfect & clean.

This is my second time staying with Bella. Fabulous and cozy place, perfect for a week in the city. Close to Lyft bikes and transit. 24 hour convieniece store across the street. Great kitchen. Plenty of AC or heat. A favorite spot for me in Chicago.

The Codfather was as advertised.  The descriptions were spot on.  Even the parking challenges but we needed a car and were accurately warned. But, the L train is only a ten minute walk away. Great location with easy walking access to Wrigley and Southport.  Have to point out that this was really one of the cleanest places we have ever rented.  Would absolutely stay here again.

Generally not a smooth and warm
experience.
The apartment stairs are super dark and narrow. It was super hard for travelers with big suitcases to carry them on to the floors.
Soundproof system was extremely bad, you could hear everything your neighbors do including them talking, the tv, and even footsteps from upstairs. The floor also makes cracky sounds when stepping on, you could absolutely hear everything going on outside on the pavements as well.
Host Kim was polite but not responsive sometimes. When I asked him about issues with luggage storage he didn’t reply. He was also not responsive with my refund request. The assistant was helpful with picking up phone calls and answering questions.
Good spot, good location, nice building

Brad‘s place was very unique a place I’d never experienced before and I’ve done a lot of traveling with over 43 reviews which have all been very great. Meaning the owners thought very well of me. I used to clean houses for a living so the main issue for me was cleanliness. It seemed as though the cleaners did absolutely nothing. I wouldn’t put this on Brad, but the reluctancy I received from him to address, the issue was not appreciated.
There were some repair issues as well, and if these things were to be addressed then I would recommend his place. As of now I would not stay at this particular Airbnb again.
If Brad leaves a bad review about me. It truly would be because he’s upset with my review, but I must tell the truth and when I have to go to a place and take the sheets off the bed and wash them myself that is not good.
Great location, great apartment, great host.
Rida place was beautiful and clean and the only issue was with the upstair neighbor making noise all night and the water pressure was low. But me and my family enjoyed Rida beautiful home.

The location was great as it was easy to walk to the train and around town. The unit was nice but two of the bedrooms had walls that did not reach the ceiling. Those rooms also did not have windows. The furnishings were nice. We were surprised they did not have coffee filters. The rooftop deck was a nice place to relax.
Wonderful communicators, hospitality, and space. So easy, welcoming, and a beautiful garden/backyard. Appreciate all the extra touches and details.

Good place, didn't like the stairs through the front door to get to 3rd floor. Called it the "stairs of death " lol.
There was alot of cracks that I wasn't aware about, maybe I forgot to ask. John was a great communicator.
Location was perfect, enjoyed the space and we will come back another time.
Spacious townhouse right next to Loyola university. Very well appointed in every way. We will definitely stay again when we visit our student!
Great place.
This apartment was clean and comfortable and within a 20 min walk to Loyola.
great stay! pictures don’t do it justice.

Pros: Very close to the pink line making taking public transit very easy, friendly neighbors, ample space for a large group, modern appliances, easy check in, friendly host, excellent air conditioning, no disturbances at night, clean linens.
Cons: We saw three large roaches during our six-night stay. I notified the host after the third sighting, and she tried to arrange same-day pest control, but they were unavailable. Some furnishings and fixtures are also showing their age.. the couches were heavily stained and repairs are needed in some areas (wall, bathroom fixtures, etc).

This was the perfect Airbnb for our family of six. We wanted somewhere within walking distance to Wrigley Field, and this location delivered! It was clean and beautifully renovated. Really appreciated the free bagels from downstairs each morning and the use of the washer/dryer. The lack of a parking spot is our only complaint, and that was only stressful/expensive when the Cubs were home and street cleaning coincided. Thank you for a lovely stay!
You need to clean the apartment

This place is absolutely lovely, with incredibly friendly and welcoming hosts. The charming and inviting neighborhood makes it a great place to explore. We also enjoyed stopping by the kids’ food stand down the street for late-night snacks. Conveniently located near the green line, it’s easy to get around, and parking is a breeze. Overall, we loved it and highly recommend it. Thank you so much for hosting our stay. 🫶

Our stay was Glorious :)
She is a fabulous host, we had a really great time just chatting with her. Lots of good restaurants in the neighborhood and close to the subway. She helped us out with advice and some connections. The house is lovely and we always felt at home. Can’t recommend enough.

This place is so cute and literally down the street from the Sears Tower. I refuse to call it the Willis Tower lol. Very cute place with extra blankets, a hairdryer, an ironing board and iron, a rack to hold your luggage, and a VERY comfortable mattress and pillows.  Very walkable and safe neighborhood. Highly recommend.

This was my second time visiting and it was just as wonderful as the first time. Clean, quiet, and cozy. Beautiful neighborhood. Very walkable with great restaurants, coffee and shopping nearby. Megan and Saf are great hosts - highly recommend!

Lovely place and situated only 15 mins to downtown on an Uber.  Lovely restaurants and shops , walkable  in the area ! Very clean and quiet community! Pet friendly most of all !! Josh is very attentive ! I highly recommend this accommodation !!

We had a wonderful stay at Damien’s place! He was an excellent host—very responsive, helpful, and kind. The home was beautiful, exceptionally clean, and thoughtfully stocked with plenty of extra linens and towels. The snacks and drinks he left for us were such a nice surprise and really made us feel welcomed.
The parking in the back was an added bonus and very convenient. There was someone staying upstairs during our visit, but we honestly couldn’t hear them at all, which was great.
Damien clearly takes excellent care of his childhood home and was full of great recommendations for the area. We truly enjoyed our stay and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Thank you for the wonderful stay!

Le logement était conforme à la description, cela faisait longtemps que je n'avais pas dormi dans un lit aussi confortable ! Ce logement est magnifique pour ceux qui aiment cette architecture. :)
Enfin, il est accessible facilement depuis le centre de Chicago grâce à la ligne de métro qui passe à côté.
Je recommande !
Great place and location. The host fixed an issue within an hour. Very responsive.
Wonderful place to stay. Clean and comfortable and excellent all around.
Great price for location, parking, and such a beautiful and welcoming home. We would stay here over and over again.
Great location, house was perfectly fine if not a bit dusty.

Wonderful stay! You can easily walk to many locations. Alma was a great host, suggesting local activities that matched our goals for the trip, being responsive, and providing clear and helpful directions. Our small dog joined us on the trip and there were many dog friendly accessible options for activities and eating. Our pup took a little time to settle as you can hear doors open and close from others in the building; however, despite many others in the building the space was quiet. We enjoyed our trip!

Christina’s place was fantastic! Whether for a night or a month like I was there, it’s a Chicago gem! Walkable to everything, amazing neighborhood, parking always available and the place was perfect. Plus she left me honey from her bees and a toy for my dog. What a delight!

Geo was very kind and very informative when it came to the check in instructions (because i was very confused 🤣) but most helpful!! The place itself was very beautiful, well kept and clean. Very convenient stay especially with it being so close to the main attractions downtown. 10/10 and would stay again!!

Such a cute and spacious place! Caleb is very responsive and friendly! Stayed to move my cousin into her first year of college at Loyola and it was very nice to only be a 10 minute drive away for move in day:)

We were very pleased with our stay at 2428 N. Lincoln.  It is perfect if you have a larger party; 6 bedrooms and 4 baths is hard to find.  The location is perfect - one can walk or short Uber ride and enjoy everything Lincoln Park has to offer.  The space was clean,  bright, and laid out well for sharing meals and conversations.  I was surprised at how quiet it was even in the bedroom that faced Lincoln Avenue.  The deck in the back with festive lights is super cute.  Hubbards Holdings were very responsive during our stay.  Would definitely book again.

Overall great and clean, but the only thing is that bathroom is attached to one of the bedroom and there is not any other entrance of that. It is inconvenient for me and my friend. We chose here because privacy is important for us, entering bathroom through my friend's room was a bit embarrassing.
No
Amanda is a really really nice host! And the place is very private and quiet, which is really important for a traveler like me to get adequate rest.
Spacious and well equipped for a family of 5 while we were visiting Chicago for a few days. It was in a quiet, safe and peaceful location. Was very happy with the stay.

What a wonderful stay. David went above and beyond. we enjoyed the Popsicles soda pops and oatmeal. You appreciated that there was a television in both the room and the bedroom. The space was clean, and perfectly curated.

Wonderful cozy apartment in a nice location. Place had everything to make your stay pleasant including a well stocked kitchen. While it’s next to a busy road, you could hardly hear the traffic. Good restaurants nearby, especially some authentic Mexican restaurants. An easy walk to the blue line made getting in and out of downtown a breeze. Truly enjoyed the comfy couch after a long day walking/cycling exploring the city. Loved Chicago and Moudi’s place made it special.

We loved this place! The location was perfect, everything was clean and comfortable, and we even got to use the BBQ. We also scored a great last-minute rate, which made it an excellent value. We’d definitely stay here again.

This airbnb is part of a large building full of other airbnb rentals. It isn't the quietest spot you can stay, but it was okay for my trip. The bathrooms were not that clean, the floors of the airbnb were rather sticky and the picture windows looking out at the Chicago skyline were very greasy and smudged with hand prints. When I arrived there were no towels of any kind. I messaged the host and withing 20 minutes wash clothes and towels were hung on my door, but no bathmats or hand towels. Overall it was an okay stay and for the price a decent deal, but if you are particular about quiet and clean I'd keep looking.
Great bargain if you're looking to house as many people as possible in the outer Chicago area!
Location is great!!! The doorman was very helpful and hilarious. Parking was easy to find. It's directly across the street in the open lot.
Great location and place! Looking forward to staying again soon!

The location is impossible to beat. You are right outside Grant Park, near Millennium Park where the “bean” is. You are about a mile from the main city center. There are so many restaurants right THERE that you are spoiled for choice. What you can’t walk to, you can take the trains - which are clean and regular and easy to understand. If you have a car, the apartment includes a spot in the nearest parking garage. This is a huge deal!  Finally, the view is absolute perfection. If you manage to have a clear morning, you can watch the sun rise over Lake Michigan. If you are there on a Sunday or Wednesday night in the summer, you can watch the Navy Pier fireworks from your living room. Just the best. The showers have pretty hard water, so it was hard to wash your hair, but that wasn’t a huge deal. The hosts are very responsive and responded to any questions right away - within 30 minutes, at most. I hope we will be in Chicago again sometime so we can stay with them!

The stay had some positives, including a comfortable bed, hot water, a good location, and fantastic communication with Ming. However, the cleanliness of the shared areas was disappointing. The bathroom and kitchen were not very clean as the house gets a lot of traffic, and the cleaning overall felt mediocre. I understand this is a shared space and guests should clean up after themselves and keep things tidy, but I don’t think the deep cleaning should depend on guests. That is something the person overseeing the property should ensure is done regularly. I expressed this to Ming and sent pictures. I didn’t end up cooking in the kitchen because of lack of cleanliness and had to pay more to eat out more, something I wanted to avoid doing as I like to try and eat similar to how I eat at home for personal reasons.
Overall, Ming was communicative and extremely helpful. There were some good aspects to the stay, but the cleanliness of the shared spaces significantly affected my experience.
Beautiful house. Great location. There is a train right next to it that you will be able to hear, however she did list that in description so no complaints. Overall great experience!
Thanks Joe! Lovely place, location and amenities.
What a great place to stay while dropping our daughter off at Loyola. Walked to waterfront cafes, campus and other restaurants. Clean and private apartment. Will stay again for sure!
Wynter’s place provided exactly what I needed. Thank you and I look forward to my next stay.😊

Fabulous stay in this amazing city. Matthew’s place was super well located and spacious. We loved staying there. Matthew was really helpful throughout the stay, answering the questions we had. Thanks Matthew!
A lovely space, maintained very well! Demitri responds quickly, is super friendly and easy to deal with.

We were happy with our stay and appreciated the cleanliness, friendly staff, and close proximity to public transit (bus, CTA train and Metra) to easily get to any location we wanted for museums, theatre, sightseeing, shopping and restaurants. Would gladly stay again!

We purposely chose this location for a game at Wrigley, and it was perfect. The neighborhood is lovely with tree-lined streets and great restaurants/bars nearby. There was no disturbance or noise from stadium crowds. We were a little confused about opening the garage door, but Jason responded within seconds to give instruction and remotely let us in. The cleaner was leaving as we arrived and it was spotless. There were minor items "missing" but nothing which impacted us enough to contact Jason (who I'm sure would have remedied quickly). For example: a toilet tissue holder was empty but we found some under the sink, no Keurig pods but we used the espresso machine instead, no towel in powder room so we used a kitchen towel, etc. All 5 of us slept well, loved the outdoor balconies, the walkability, the record player, and gaming table (had never seen one of those!). I would definitely stay again!

This apartment was clean and comfortable with everything needed for our stay. The building itself is a little shabby, but quiet and there is a coin laundry onsite which was useful to us. I was pleased to find basics for cooking - oil, salt and pepper. I was glad for the good AC as it was hot while we were there - it is a window unit and was rather loud. The apartment is in a quiet and attractive neighborhood with a great little market a couple of blocks away, close to a train station. I rented a car for two days of the trip and finding parking was very difficult in this area.

Rhonda was kind and responsive throughout my stay, and the home was generally clean and as described. My main concern was the number of bugs, including centipedes and spiders, both around the entrance and inside the unit. I think this was partly due to the apartment being below ground level. While it is listed as a garden unit, it felt more like a basement apartment, with an entrance that requires walking around the house and downstairs. I think this distinction is helpful for future guests to know when booking. Overall, Rhonda was a responsive and accommodating host.
Best view ever and the location is walkable distance to river walk and Michigan Avenue .. best part is garage is in the same building .. no parking problems .. will sure visit again

Communication was great, easy check-in, spectacular views, and a spotless, well-appointed kitchen. The “L” train does pass right below the apartment, so it is something to take into consideration. We are big train people and enjoyed the city sounds so it did not bother us and the host provides white noise machines for their guests.

I absolutely loved my stay here. It felt like my own little haven in the city and was the perfect home base, especially traveling with my road bike. The space was incredibly spacious, quiet, and comfortable, with everything I needed for my stay. I always felt safe, and getting around the city from here was so easy. The amenities were great, and it was such a nice place to come back to and unwind at the end of the day. I’d absolutely stay here again!
We stayed in this Airbnb two times already and we LOVED it! Awesome location and awesome flat. Our kids loved it too. Thank you for having us!

My stay at Mindy + Tony's place went without a hitch. The instructions were thorough, and the space was charmingly private (loved all the curtains and lighting options). It's a 3rd-floor walk-up with a view of most of the neighborhood. Overall, it felt secure, stocked, and comfortable. The neighborhood was cute and walkable with plenty of cafes nearby, and it was no trouble at all to find a nearby scooter/bike to explore the area.
The apartment was cozy, lived-in, and full of all the necessities. It is an older space (felt vintage), but nothing egregiously unclean. The linens were fresh, and the surfaces seemed well-maintained. Excellent value for the price, and I would stay here again!
Thank you for the wonderful stay!

Amazing Chicago stay! Great location for our family to get to experience the city. It’s a busy area (in a good way)  and close to everything downtown, which is exactly what we wanted. Beautiful building with friendly front desk staff! Kids also loved the pool and pool table on the top floor. Would stay here again!

Very easy check in and check out! Close to Chicago downtown! It came with a parking which was a plus for our car rental and it was safe parking.
Overall it was a quiet unit, clean and it had all the basic kitchen appliances, and basic kitchen needs like plates, utensils, cups , etc. it came coffee, tea , creamer and sugar!
The host was very responsive on some questions and on a personal request we had. I would stay with Adresa in the future Chicago visit again for sure!
Great stay! Enjoyed every minute!
Paul was a great host. I really enjoyed my stay

I made my booking last minute as I was having my condo painted and it was easier for me to stay elsewhere.  The unit was clean, quiet and decorated well.  Great location in a great neighborhood!  The host was responsive and helpful.

The team loved the space. Was described just as it was in was in real life. Ample space, great location, and very communicable hosts! will definitely keep this place in our back pocket when we return!
Great place, great host, great location.

A great spot to feel a little more private and free than a hotel, with roof top views.
Good location to walk to Soldier Field
Milan was responsive and helpful to solve queries.

Our family of four had an amazing stay in this lovely third-story unit. The street-dead ends into St. Michael’s so it it is quiet but still very walkable. We were also able to park our car when we needed one last minute. The kitchen is great, with a lovely outside patio and thoughtful touches like tea and plenty of dishware. We hope to come back and stay again for a future trip!
Attentivene host, instructons were clear, good room just doesn’t get much light. Bathroom could use better cleaning and doesn’t flush well. Other than that it was a good experience.
perfect place， feel like home

Great stay! Steps from Wrigley Field! House was perfect for what we were after! Clean, accommodating, great master bedroom! Perfect amount of Chicago charm mixed with upgraded amenities! Highly recommend for a Cubs game!

This High Rise apartment has got many good qualities but worth mentioning some not so good. Stayed for 3 nights. It has GREAT views in both directions. One looking straight at Lake Michigan and the other North towards Downtown and the magnificent skyline. It has two large bedrooms and plenty of bathroom areas for a large family. Large king beds. It was nice and cool in there on a really warm and humid day! Each room had a flat screen in it, so youngsters could watch what they wanted and adults could have the main room. Parking was tricky at first but we figured out an APP called Spothero and got excellent prices for overnight parking in the main garage.
One thing that could've improved in the listing the owner never mentioned the constant day and night EL Train that passes directly below your balcony. You do kinda get used to it but if your a light sleeper...you might wanna think about that. Has a dishwasher but it only really cleans the bottom rack. Overall well worth the money.

Great place to stay in Chicago! If you want to do shopping it is a bit far out from the shops but a 15-20 minutes uber gets you to the right streets! The place was really clean and matched the pictures perfectly. The host is really responsive and will help you with your needs!

I came to Chicago for a concert and my boyfriend and I wanted to stay in a centralized area. This place was perfect location. The apartment was super clean and had so much space. If I had any questions or concerns, Joan responded very quickly. Would happily stay here again!
Freddy’s place was great to stay in!

Clean, basic accommodation with the bare minimum amenities. The bed wasn’t the most comfortable, but it worked fine for a couple of nights. The host was very kind, responsive, and communicative, which made the stay easy and pleasant.

This was a great place to be me and my girlfriend loved it.This place felt homey and we realized one of our family members lived next door.Jorge handled our needs with a quickness.The beds were very comfortable and the apartment was easy to find.Thank you for your hospitality and readiness to make sure we were settled♥️
Great stay.  Nice host.

I can’t say enough about how amazing this place was or how great Sky was as a host. There were amenities that you don’t get at fancy hotels. Really appreciated the fancy espresso machine and the coffee pods provided. All the cabinets were labeled and the signage made the place easy to navigate. The location was great close to most attractions. The parking was tight as previously mentioned. I drive a midsized SUV and was able to manage with minimal difficulty. I used street parking when it was available close.
It wasn’t a flawless experience. His cleaners had a problem that they didn’t resolve before check in. I contacted Sky and we worked together to get it resolved. He was very responsive and helpful. Things happen but no doubt he rose to the occasion in finding resolutions and making us whole.

Tracee is a great host. The apartment was as described in a great location. Bed was very comfortable and all of the linens were in great shape. Would definitely stay here again. We had some car trouble the morning we were leaving and Tracee let us stay longer to get it figured out. 5stars!!

This stay is in the perfect location. It’s off a side road so it’s quiet, but just a short walk away) and I mean really short) and you’re in Lincoln Square! Lots of things to do around the area. Check in is easy, the space was very clean and had all we needed for a couple night stay.

Stay’s place was as described - good for a place to sleep while you do your own thing in the city. The other guests in the shared dorm were all considerate and respectful. The space downstairs was also nice to set up and do work on your personal devices.

Beautiful place. Great location. Be prepared for lots of stairs and hauling your bags. That was unexpected. Also one of the bedrooms ceilings has a sky light so you can forget about sleeping in or feeling like you have privacy, the building next door looks directly down on the bedroom.

Multiple issues that were resolved promptly and with respect.
First room we stayed in had a mildew and moldy wall. This 100% should not happen as the cleaning crew should have taken notice of this and reported before we came in.
We also had a small hiccup were our codes reset and didn't work. BUT. we got the codes fixed in literally 5 minutes or less as the host was super responsive.
Another issue we had was with our food we left in the fridge. We asked and were able to get some extra time to leave our luggage (4pm.) We left our box of deep dish (full) in the fridge during this time and the clean up crew threw it away. We assumed being able to leave our luggage in shared spaces meant we could leave some perishable food in the fridge. Nope.
But even with all of that all of the issue we were treated extremely well. We got a refund for the 2 days we had to stay in the room with mold in it, Moved to a bigger room, got free bag storage, and was given 20 dollar towards our pizza!
The space was perfect for our needs. The A/C units worked great, and the bed and sofa were super comfortable. Everything was clean and nicely decorated.
Really cool building and great views. The sandwich shop across the street is the best.
Nice location good price communicative host. Daily cleaner but the floors were not addressed.

The L was right outside! We did not expect it to be so noisy and echoey. Drapes and fluffy rugs would help mitigate some of the noise. The unit was SMALLER than advertised. The portable air conditioner was noisy and took up valuable space. The instructions told us to go to the 4th floor, but our unit was on the 3rd floor. We were confused at first. The bathroom faucet was broken. Our last night, the front building door was ajar (accidental or because a guest/tenant wanted friends easy access?). I was messaged to send $30 for a maintenance fee, but responded that the unit had a broken bathroom faucet and I did not feel it fair for us to pay for someone else's damage. I also would recommend that basics such as salt and pepper shakers and pot holders/kitchen towels be provided. That said, the bed was comfortable, the water pressure in the shower exceptional, the smart tv easy to use, and the location extraordinarily convenient. Would we stay again? Hmmm...
Amazing place. Everything was spotless and well maintained. The host was always responsive and accommodating. The location was perfect and it felt like home!
Listing as described. Good location with easy access to red line

This Airbnb was a great place! It was in great distance of everything we wanted to go to. It was a little difficult to find, but once I found it, everything clicked! I will be going back there to this place next time I go back to Chicago!! It’s a great place to stay!

Me gustó que la parada del camión esta cercana a cinco minutos caminando y el metro a diez, muy fácil de llegar.
Hay varios centros comerciales cercanos. El anfitrión muy amable y atento a mis dudas. Apoyaba en lo que necesitamos.
Y fue una estancia muy agradable. Muy buena experiencia

The place is just as Jose describes it: small, but perfect for a couple. We stayed for a week and it was more than perfect for us. It’s only one block away from the subway and several bus stops that take you to Chicago’s most iconic tourist spots, so the location is definitely ideal.
There was a bit of street noise at night, especially over the weekend, but they thoughtfully provide earplugs, which worked perfectly for us.
Our only small issue was when we first arrived, as we didn’t fully understand the check-in instructions and it took a little while to get a response. However, it was nothing major and everything was sorted out in the end.
I would definitely stay at Jose’s place again and would absolutely recommend it. 10/10!

This was a very nice stay! Our party of four had no issues with the unit. The building is a bit older, but the unit itself looked just as described. Best part was undoubtedly the big windows and view of the city from the living room.
What a lovely space!
Great !

O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos, estava muito limpo e cheroso. Cozinha totalmente equipada, camas confortável e roupas de cama e banho em bons estados. Um mistura de modernidade em um prédio rústico. O local é maravilhoso, perto de mercado e restaurantes e é possível chegar ao centro caminhando.
A casa tem ar condicionado central que manteve todos os ambientes frescos em pleno verão americano.
Apenas 1 dos quartos que fica com a janela para a rua é possível ouvir o som das buzinas, mas nada que comprometa a boa estadia.
O anfitrião pensou nos mínimos detalhes para receber com conforto!
Definitivamente, voltaria para este local!
Nice place!
Wonderful experience at Leonids place .

From initial contact through to our final day, our hosts were communicative and very accommodating. The unit was excellent, very comfortable, very clean and by virtue of being in River North, so close to many attractions in Chicago.  Definitely recommend.
Very nice place, well equipped and decorated, has everything needed, quiet and walkable neighborhood, parking is convenient, 20 minute drive to downtown.

Great location for dropping our daughter off at Loyola! Very walkable to campus, the lake, and the L, with plenty of coffee shops and restaurants nearby. It was so convenient for move-in and made exploring the area easy.
Fantastic location in the heart of the West Loop.  Nice quiet space, very nicely furnished and super clean and comfortable.  Great shower.  Will definitely stay here again.
We had a great stay! Everything was as expected, and the host was very responsive and always replied in a timely manner.
Ah gee it was swell

The place was very nice, however there was a lot of banging noise in the very early mornings. Two of the three nights we were there, I was able to sleep less than three hours. The host was responsive, but there wasn't much they could do. They apologized, but I am now boarding the first of two flights before a four hour drive and work in the morning with almost no sleep. I need a vacation from my vacation.
Todo perfecto
Amazing location, apartment was perfect and just as described. Angela was so responsive and had such nice details. Chicago is our favorite city and will sure return.

Our family stayed for a few nights. The location is in a great neighborhood. Coffee shops, restaurants, and shops are within walking distance. The CTA train station and bus lines are a quick walk too!
Justin was responsive and helpful with any questions that I had. I would definitely stay again.

This is a place we will return. It was very livable, well designed and charming. The kitchen is spotless and well equipped for actual meal preparation or just hanging out and eating leftovers from one of the great restaurants in the area. Eduardo recommended The Honey Bear Cafe which was excellent, and if you go, you WILL have leftovers. Beds were very comfortable, and after long days in the city that is so important.

This is the third or fourth time we’ve rented from Demitri in as many years. All different places.
He’s always helpful and responsive. If he can help he will.
Thanks for another great stay at the Square.

Had a great stay in this cute condo! Everything was walkable and safe for our nine month old and my parents and I! A lot of great food restaurants and Puerto Rican culture. Parking passes were easy to use. Condo very friendly and spacious for 4 adults and a baby and has alot of amenities for travelers with little ones! (Pack n play, stroller, toys, etc)
Nice place, two minute walk from the train lines, very convenient.
Such a perfect location and very family friendly apartment! Loved our stay and would definitely come back!

Great place in a good location. Our kids loved the homely feel. All the equipment you might need for a comfortable stay. Would definitely recommend.
Only point of attention is the loud sirenes on the streets, even on the forth floor. (easily fixed it you use earplugs)
The perfect place to hang with my son while setting him up at Loyola University. I hope to stay again on return visits!
The location was perfect. I love Sarah's place and the communication was on spot. Hope it's available on our next getaway to Chicago.

Loved my month stay in Mark's Wrigley area condo.  The place was spacious and had every amenity I needed.  The location was perfect for me in the middle of the city action but also had a neighborhood feel with green space for my dog.  I can't rave enough about how much i enjoyed it and hopefully will come back next summer.
Was amazing would stay here time and time again, great staff and great communication
Our family enjoyed our stay, great location, and well appointed home. Responsive host.
Exelente lugar para ir de vacaciones
The place was perfect, but I didn't love the neighborhood. It felt a bit like an abandoned town and gave off a shady vibe. I personally didn't have any bad experiences there.

El departamento esta super confortable, limpio y accesible. Es tranquilo y David siempre respondió rápidamente. El barrio es precioso, muy cómodo para trasladarte a distintas zonas. Estamos felices de habernos alojado allí y será una recomendación segura para nuestros amigos viajeros y para volver sin duda a alojarnos!

Overall great location to stay at whenever visiting Chicago, just a block and a half away from the CTA Green Line and the bus stop is right outside the building, which provides easy access to downtown. Great host to work with, always checking in to see if everything is okay. Will definitely return here!

This listing checked alot of our boxes, it looks  just as it does in the photos, light and airy! The bed was quite comfortable.  The location is lovely and has access to quiet streets that were great for dog walks.  Katherine and Dimi were responsive when we had questions. Overall it was a great stay!
It was great stay and China town train station is easily accessible.

I really enjoyed my stay! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described in the listing. Everything I needed was there, and the host was very kind, helpful, and responsive. The location was also great and convenient. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

Great experience, easy check in, safe neighborhood, clean space
If I stay here again Im bringing a white noise machine because i could hear the other guests throughout the night

Loved our stay. The apartment was cozy, beautiful, and in the perfect location. Everything was clean and comfortable, and the host was wonderful. I’d definitely stay here again when I’m back in Chicago! ❤️
Great, comfortable, responsive, and friendly

The place was spacious but it was missing a lot of common amenities and the comfort of the beds and couch is a zero star.
Full bed in back is broken. They put a cinder block under to ‘hold’ but the whole bed caved in. It also doesn’t have a box spring so between the headboard and mattress the $3.00 pillows fall through as well.
The bunk bed feels like it’s going to fall apart when climbing up. The couch is broken on one side and you sink way down.
There are no extra pillows or blankets at all.
There are only 4 forks, a few spoons, no butter knife and one tiny knife. No cutting board, very few pots/pans - only 1 in normal size the rest could fit in an easy bake oven.
I had to go buy plastic forks to feed 6 of us.
There is a dishwasher but no soap for it. There was shampoo but the conditioner was filled with body soap. No blow dryer is provided, which is fine but some of the basics I prefer not to travel with. The location is great but outside of that the comfort level was a 1 star.
I had another great stay at Rafael’s. I highly recommend staying here when visiting Chicago.
We had a great stay here, beautiful unit in perfect location.

Three well traveled friends with high standards and we could not have been happier. Or more comfortable. Leonard met us when we arrived. Gave a quick tour, had every amenity we could wish, was always responsive when we needed local advice. The beds and pillows were comfy, the kitchen easy to navigate, the furnishings serene and pretty and the place immaculate. Parking was free and easy. His guide to the neighborhood was helpful, his how-to’s clear and easy to follow. Would rave about this place and host to anybody

My friends and I had a great stay at Erin’s place! Very cozy apartment with all of the necessities for our trip. We have absolutely no complaints! Everything was clean and well maintained, and Erin was very accommodating and communicative throughout. Thank you Erin for a wonderful stay!

Après quelques difficultés à accéder au logement notamment à cause de la serure, celui ci correspondait bien aux photos de l’annonce. Cependant, pas suffisamment équipé pour les personnes souhaitant cuisiner et manger sur place. Mais idéal si vous souhaitez rester 1 ou 2 nuits selon moi. Le quartier est très calme et se situe à 10minutes à pied des transports en commun.

One thing I do is take reviews seriously…
The Air BNB was exactly as described and about 25 minutes outside of downtown Chicago. Perfect little area which was very quiet and I never felt unsafe. The house itself was absolutely perfect for our stay and not only was it sparkling clean but Ari provided some of the basics that are usually not provided when renting a place. The beds were super comfortable and I slept so well after a long day in the city. Ari was very quick in responding to any messages we sent. If your looking for a perfect sized home where you can cook, shower, lounge and sleep while in Chicago this is definitely a 5⭐️ and I highly recommend!! Thank you for allowing us to enjoy your space and look forward to our next trip to the Windy City.

The apartment was as described, clean and most importantly bed was comfortable. Instructions were clear and host was communicative and helpful. My only complaint is noise from neighbors above, since the building is very old and floors are noisy. Otherwise a great stay-  thank you.

Do not book this host. I was asked to pay 93.57 dollars on top of the booking rate after booking. The host deliberately did not inform me before my cancellation deadline because any sane person would cancel their booking if the host asks for undisclosed fees outside of the advertised rate. When I reached the hotel, the front desk actually asked me to pay 142 dollars because the host has bought some sort of club membership for me which I was neither informed of, not had I asked for. There were three other groups at the hotel lobby who were experiencing the exact same thing with one family having a fee of 575 dollars which they were not told until their cancellation deadline had passed. This is a scam.
Chanda's apartment was great!  I spent a few days there working remote and the setup and wifi was perfect for what I needed.  Would definitely recommend!
We enjoyed our stay, close to downtown. Highly recommend!

Host was very helpful and worked with our schedule. The place was clean and presentable. We enjoyed going to 2 games at Wrigley and the close proximity. Would definitely recommend to others. Thank you!

Ce logement se trouve dans un quartier calme, à proximité de la ligne de métro, très bien situé pour découvrir la ville de Chicago.
Le logement est spacieux, propre, bien équipé, la literie est de qualité.
Martha, l'hôte est disponible, réactive, très arrangeante et met tout en oeuvre pour nous faciliter le séjour avec des indications claires.
Je recommande vivement le Cozy et je n'hésiterai pas à y revenir.
Merci Martha
Cute and homey with the sweetest cats
Great host! Perfect location to enjoy Chicago city life near Lake Michigan ! I will defiantly return for my next trip !

The apartment was very clean and nice - well worth the price!  We appreciated the Keurig coffee.  The neighborhood was quiet and felt safe.  Jeff was a great communicator and responsive.  We had a great visit.
Had a great stay!! Would definitely go back! Great location, clean, quiet, felt safe!
There was no fragrance on the linens which was really important to us.
Great spot!

We loved the location and it had plenty of room. They were great at letting us check in a bit early with all my daughters bags to move into college. The front door was a little sticky but I think that was humidity and a basement.  There were extra blankets and they were easy to connect with. Definitely reccomend.

Had a great two night stay in Chicago! Geo was a fantastic host. Very communicative, welcoming, and made the check in process completely seamless. The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great spot for getting around the city. Would definitely stay here again next time I’m in town!
We enjoyed our stay at Regina’s. The place was clean and equipped with everything we needed, and she was very responsive.

We loved the location, value and communication. House could use more furnishings and linens in communal areas. Bring flip flops for walking around inside.  While there is a daily cleaner, it doesn’t seem he cleans the floors.

Our stay was great.  Simple check in process and excellent communication.  The dwelling was very clean and organized.  Our host was responsive to our needs.  Excellent and safe location.  We would stay again.  Thanks!

I had a great stay at Marijes’s place! The unit was very clean, modern, quiet, and comfortable. Marijes was also very responsive and supportive throughout the stay! I had no issues with the building and the neighborhood was very peaceful and walkable. I would love to stay here again when I visit in the future!

Good place, spacious room, comfortable beds. The only thing not good is the shower, it’s not attached with the wall, so you have to figure out your own way to keep it, but I think it’s should be a very easy thing to fix, hopefully Jorge will get that done soon, other than that, it’s great

Perfect spot for what we needed: a comfortable home base for a multiple night friends trip to Chicago. We loved the neighborhood with access to scenic bike paths, bus routes, and not too far of a walk to the Paulina station and surrounding neighborhood. We enjoyed walking to Hexe coffee, Bonci pizza, Cody's pub, and many other spots on our way to and fro city adventures. When we weren't out and about, the unit had everything we needed in terms of a great kitchen, deck, living area, dining room table, 2 showers/bathrooms and 3 comfortable beds in their own rooms. John was responsive to questions and even let us check in early which was so helpful. Thank you!

We stayed here for a couple of weeks while our apartment was having work done. The place was clean and quiet, just what we needed for working from home. The hosts were extremely responsive and helpful when we had questions. Pet friendly was a huge plus for us. Everything was clean and just as described. The perfect home away from home for our needs. Thank you!

A lovely apartment, definitely well-loved. It was very clean, with everything you could need in the kitchen. The train is definitely a part of the apartment, but it honestly didn't bother me at all; maybe because it was hot and we had the aircon unit on, so we couldn't hear it over that. No blackout blinds; an eye mask is essential. The sitting room is really comfy. The door locks can be difficult to open, but you get used to it. The train is really handy because the station is literally beside the front door. Lincoln Square was a great place for a bite to eat and only 2 train stops away, with a 7/11 & Walgreens for any essentials needed.
The area itself is very residential, with a sweet cafe across the road that does nice cakes and sambos. It is about 45 mins to central Chicago but so very easy to get to. We also went to Wrigley Field, the beach & Chinatown really easily. The airport was a bit more of a challenge. I would definitely stay again. The hosts were very fast to respond.

Dennis was quick to respond and went out of their way to accommodate our requests. When we accidentally locked ourselves out, Dennis helped us get inside within a couple minutes of me sending a message.
Being able to sit and work outside in the front yard was a pleasant addition. We enjoyed that the street is peaceful and lots of the neighbours walk their dogs here.
Nice roomy basement suite, easy to access, perfectly located near the square, with good AC.

We had a great stay. This is a beautiful, old, renovated flat in a great neighborhood in Chicago. The neighborhood itself is walkable, and it is a quick drive to all sorts of attractions and downtown. The flat had tons of character and you could tell it had been lovingly restored. Beautiful, and would definitely stay again.
Great place, amazing views and walking distance to Fulton Mkt and Randolph St. I would stay here again!
Amazing stay thank u
Excellent location in Lincoln park. The place was clean and well kept. Plenty of space with a large kitchen, office area, multiple bedrooms, etc.
Lovely home. Me and my family enjoyed our stay!

Jennifer’s place was fantastic! The location was super central and made getting around Chicago effortless. The space was spotless, matched the listing description perfectly, and having a dedicated parking spot in the city was an amazing bonus. Jennifer was a proactive, highly responsive, and overall excellent host. I would definitely stay here again!
The stay was very good; the apartment was very clean, and the area was safe and quiet. Thank you.
Pefect location for enjoying all Chicago has to offer!  Super spacious - and every amenity imaginable in the kitchen!
Wonderful accommodations! Very clean and comfortable! Loved the neighborhood and the close walk to the lake!

Una casa preciosa y cómoda para conocer Chicago. Tras el bullicio de la gran ciudad, es muy agradabla descansar en Logan Square, en una casa con todas las comodidades para estar bien. Elísabeth fue muy comunicativa y contribuyó a que todo transcurriese de maravilla.

Cloud9 was perfect! Clean, safe, with a gorgeous view of the city! Walkable to great restaurants and downtown to see attractions. The train was noticeable but not super loud or annoying!
We would definitely stay again!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement le logement était propre confortable et conforme à la description. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié le calme, l’emplacement et l’accueil de notre hôte. Tous s’est bien passé et nous recommandons vivement ce logement. Nous y reviendrions avec plaisir
Great location , cozy

***BEWARE***listed as free parking but will charge you extra on game days…place needs a good cleaning and a group of 4 guys outside your front window hanging out all day and night drinking and smoking
The place was amazing! The host was very responsive and we had a wonderful time.
Increíble el lugar todo limpio muy amable el señor freddy.

Hosts are super responsive and friendly. I liked being near Morse Market and the red line, plus a few fun cafes and restaurants. Having a window AC meant you could hear street noise - found it was overall still good value. And a really comfy bed!
Airbnb was clean. Milan was super responsive and checked in periodically to make sure everything was going well. Location was conveniently located to the el and getting to the loop was quick.
Very nice place, would definitely stay there again.
El alojamiento está bien , pero la tapa del inodoro estuvo desajustado y siempre está uno sentado y bailando en la tasa del baño , adicional estuvo colgado un cepillo de pelo colgado en el baño .

The view is incredible.
The building felt safe and secure.
The older door gentleman was absolutely a gem, but the whole staff was lovely.
Will rent facilities again.

We arrived at 4PM Sunday to a Disco Event downstairs at Logan11 bar. We needed to crash into bed, but the endless powerful bass beats where even making the water quake in the toilet! This place can be Really loud. Had to buy noise-canceling headphones at the nearby Target to make fitful sleep possible. Can't imagine what Fridays & Saturdays are like; sirens, big music, trains & packs of party women.
We had invited two Chicago friends over but had to change plans last minute when we saw the steep 24 steps up to the unit.
Wednesday morning at 3AM a blaring alarm went off outside our front door and Allyson came within 10 minutes, with the police, and found a way to silence it; thank you Allyson.

READ THIS BEFORE YOU BOOK ANYWHERE! This home was PERFECT! Beautiful, comfortable, spacious, ideally located, spotlessly cleaned, easy in and out, lovely host. Girl's trip to Chicago - we had the best time and so much of that was due to where we stayed!
The host was very communicative and hospitable, and the apartment was lovely. Overall a very good stay and would stay with TAIMS again. 😊

It was my daughter's boyfriend's first trip to the US so we started with downtown Chicago. We couldn't have been happier with the apartment. For the price of 2 hotel rooms, we could stay together as a family.  The rooms are on opposite sides of the living area so we had comfortable privacy.  One room is smaller but has a great view of Lake Michigan. The apartment had modern, neutral decor, was in excellent repair and pristine clean. Everything was exactly as described. The host communication was great including a suggestion for reasonable parking nearby. We wouldn't  hesitate to recommend this location to others.
Loved the place. Hope to stay there again in the future

All good for our stay in Brad's place for our son's wedding in Chicago. The wedding was in Garfield Park Conservatory so a short drive away. The Conservatory is a great place to visit of itself with plants from all over the world, real rainforest areas etc.
We had a group of 6 people and had planned for the possibility of 8 or 10. Brad's two units easily covered for that. Sometimes we had other people visiting as well.
Beds were comfortable and everything was made up as expected. Also lots of towels etc and quite a few coat hangers which is always appreciated. Two nice common areas with sofas, TVs etc.
For parking, one spot is always available in the garage at the back and I was usually able to find street parking right outside as well.
Pete's Fresh Market at Madison and Western was a great find. It is only a few minutes away in the car and about a 15 minute walk. They have a great buffet spread of ready made meals of every kind and all the regular supermarket stuff as well.
Thank you so much for hosting us — the place was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. We had a wonderful stay and would happily book again!

Venu's place was great and he was always immediately available for any issue. I had his phone number and he also proactively checked in from time to time.
The place was great, especially for our large group. Spacious and the three floors including the basement area really allowed the guests to spread out. I really liked the large "great room" area spanning from the kitchn through the dining are through the sitting room. That is all the way from the back to the front of the house.
Beds were really nice with lots of storage space as well.
Garage at the back was great. Also on street parking was always available but usually not right outside.
Also I really liked the Pilsen area and Venu had provide lots of good suggestions. Would have liked more time to check it all out.
Would really recommend the place. I don't know that we will be back in Chicago with a large group but if we are this will be the place.
