Noelle and Rob are special hosts.  Their home is a mix between beautiful and comfortable.  It has everything that you have at home and perhaps more.  Do not book this home if you want to have loud parties.   We wanted a nice place to stay and that is exactly what we got.  It's in a quiet residential neighborhood closed to many neighborhoods with entertainment, restaurants and don't forget Wrigley field and the Cubs! great experience all around.
Great place and location! Clean, safe and has a nice pool!
Easy checkin process and very clean! Exactly as pictured and overall a good experience.
Adorable place in one of the best neighborhoods!! Cozy, cute, and central to many great spots. Highly recommend.
Awesome experience will rent again
if you’re looking for something affordable and cozy this is a perfect fit for you, Olga is super helpful, friendly and respectful.
Ensavi gave clear Check-In instructions, no issues. Very responsive and friendly. Great location.

Admittedly, we didn't spend much time inside because we were out enjoying the city. But, the location of the Plymouth was perfect for us. A short walk from Union Station and another short walk to most of our planned destinations. We had a great weekend!

David is a fabulous host, there was great communication and everything was super easy for both check in and check out. The space was super clean and really well thought out. My only qualm was the wall decor in the bedroom but thats only because i’m spooked easily! Ha! I wouldn’t let it deter you from staying in the space. It’s close to public transit and some great bars/restaurants. Everything you’d want for an airbnb! Would absolutely stay again and/or recommend to a friend,
Great stay the place was nice in clean & the Airbnb was by everything you needed , I will stay here again
This space was perfect for us on our trip. Easy to walk places and plenty of options nearby.

Andy's place was worth every penny. It matched the pictures and was clean which I really appreciated. He also checked on me consistently to see if I needed anything I would recommend his place to anyone visiting chicago

Had a blast. Was basically 10 minutes away from everything. Listing was clean and secure. Walked outside the first day and saw a big parking lot cookout the community was having to give away free school supplies to kids for back to school. Love Southside man. ❤️
Olga was proactive friendly, and offered to be there when we needed. Check in was smooth, the room as listed & clean, place was private and felt safe. Great stay, close to L 35/Archer

Tracy’s place was amazing.! She is a great host and she kept in contact with us just to check in and make sure all of our needs were met or if we needed help. From the moment we walked in the place looks amazing and pictures can’t capture how beautiful the place actually is. Tracy greeted us with a printed list of items of places to go, food to try and even transport to said places. Very first trip out of Florida and very thankful for being able to experience her home. She’s an amazing host
I'm a pretty simple guy so it doesn't take much to please me lol. The place I'd quaint and rustic... just minutes from the Obama Center. I walked in 10min. However, downtown is about a 20min drive.
Location location location.  Couldn’t beat it.
Josey is a excellent host! Everything was as stated, walkable are to to beach, park and Obama center! We will be back!

Ravenwood's a beautiful, tree-lined neighborhood with good restaurants nearby, and the building is just a few blocks from the Montrose Avenue train station (brown line). The apartment itself is small but clean, quiet, and comfortable, older but with a modern kitchen and updated shower. (Note that it's a fourth-floor walkup, so it might not be ideal for people who have trouble climbing stairs.) Rida is available and responsive, and even checked in with me via text while I was still en route from the airport. This was a great base of operations for me during a nine-night stay in Chicago, a chance to experience apartment living in a real neighborhood instead of a colorless motel. My only caveat is that there was no deadbolt on the front door,  something Rida's promised to look into. But I really enjoyed my stay here.

My host was absolutely great! From the moment we arrived, everything was exactly as described. The home looked just like the pictures, and you could immediately tell that the host pays close attention to the little details and that made tha stay feel special.
Check-in was smooth and exactly as explained, and the host was even kind enough to allow us to check in a little early, which we really appreciated. The neighborhood felt safe, and having McDonald’s and Dollar Tree within walking distance was super convenient.
I also have to mention all the goodies and thoughtful extras the host had waiting for us in the home. Snacks, water, and all those little touches made such a difference. It honestly felt like being at home while we were in Chicago!
And Chicago doesn’t owe me a thing! 😂 We showed up, we ate GOOD, did the tourist stuff, explored the city, and enjoyed some amazing restaurants.
This was a wonderful stay from beginning to end, and I would absolutely recommend Marteki and her.

Great apartment in a quiet area of Boystown. Rahaf was gracious when answering a question I had during the booking process. The apartment was clean, trendy and comfortable. I didn’t experience any of the issues some other reviews mention, thoroughly enjoyed the stay and would book again!
The location was ideal for our family with  Whole Foods near by and downtown Chicago a short metro stop away. It was spacious and clean.
This was the perfect stay for a short weekend, great neighborhood, cozy little unit, it was the perfect place to rest my head at the end of the day.
Good spot to stay in Chicago and super close to all transit plus it’s a walkable area. Cute and cozy

A great place in a beautiful location. I was also there during the Little Italy street festival which was a pleasant surprise. If you ever want to go, this would be the place to stay. A great touch with all Malin + Goetz products - highly recommend - thanks Jonathan!
The pictures make it appear more spacious, but it was actually quite small. However, I must give it extra points for its excellent location, cleanliness, and easy access to public transportation.

Excellent experience! Michelle’s place is cute, spacious, and comfy. Loved the decor and book collection. Slept like a rock in the king size bed. A/C worked GREAT. Michelle is a friendly, responsive, and helpful host. Will definitely book again!

Although the house has some updates, the listing is highly inaccurate. The area is not safe. The photos are misleading, the backyard is completely overgrown, and the downstairs area was entirely unusable. Amenities are extremely limited with only one bedroom TV and just a single AC window unit in the living room. We also encountered cleanliness issues like a dirty shower liner and writing on a bedroom wall. Furthermore, my aunt is allergic to dogs and their dog barked constantly and roamed freely until I addressed it and asked them to keep it away. To make matters worse, our safety felt compromised after a murder occurred just around the corner at on our very first night. I would not recommend this property at all.
The host Shabbir was super responsive during our stay! The location of the house provided easy access to downtown and other parts of Chicago. Plenty of room for the big group we had.

Unfortunately emphasis were made only 2 of 3 of the most important factors in an airbnb. #1 is location and they were on point with that. #2 is security and they were on point with that as well. But after having an enjoyable evening it is an absolute MUST that your guests have a comfortable place to sleep. That was a problem at this location. I don’t know directly who dropped the ball concerning this but this is where the host catches the bullet. The master bedroom, which is usually where the key person sleeps, had a tv that didn’t work but that’s not the kicker. When I attempted to lay down in the deceptively beautiful king size bed, I literally fell right through the middle of it into a giant hole because all of the supports underneath were broken. So I had to sleep on the living room couch. After contacting the host, they apologized and instructed me to take pictures that’s it that’s all. No compensation or anything slightly resembling one. Had she offered $5 I would feel better. 👎

Right in the heart of the city. Far Southside quick access to the Interstate. Quite neighborhood, easy street parallel parking. The place was very clean, towels and toiletries were provided. Small microwave and fridge inside. Alexis responded quickly to any messages that we sent. Overall experience was GREAT. We would definitely remember her place for future visits if needed. Also would have no problem recommending her to others as well. This is a basement apartment pretty much. If you are ever 6 feet tall this may not work for you because of the ceilings. I'm 5'10" so it worked out good for me. And my wife is a few inches shorter. Again, Overall it was GREAT
Thanks again Alexis for being such a good host.
The only problem we had was this statement:   About not putting toilet paper in the toilet.
House is nice.

I lived in Roger’s Park all my young adult life and it’s very much HOME to me. If you’ve never been, it’s one of Chicago’s most interesting neighborhoods- extremely diverse in every sense with an overarching feel of acceptance, all under densely packed mature trees and on the lake! This little flat is low frill and streamlined and comfortable where it really counts (very good bed and comfortable clean bedding, comfy couch and a huge TV). The parking spot is a HUGE plus too since it’s a densely populated neighborhood. Kyriako was extremely available and responsive throughout my stay. I hope to stay here again next time I need to sleep in my old neighborhood.
Good place.

10/10 Stay
Had a really good stay here. The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. Everything went smoothly, and I had no issues during my stay. I’d definitely stay here again and would recommend it to others. Overall, 10/10 experience! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Place was lovely, And instructions were straight forward. It was very hot outside so having the AC was a nice touch. Kitchen and bathrooms were clean as well. Would recommend if you are low maintenance and just need a place to stay! Henry is awesome and gave clear instructions.

Great location. We stayed here to visit the Obama Presidential Center, which was about 20 minutes away. My friends & I enjoyed the place, it was very convenient for all of us to get around. Everything was within a decent mileage for us to sightsee and eat. This is a great place to stay!!
- Convenient onsite parking.
- Spacious living space and bedrooms.
- Well-equipped for a large group
- TVs in each room a plus

I stayed here as a woman traveling alone, and Jonathan was always thoughtful about making sure I was comfortable. I had a pleasant stay.
I especially liked the neighborhood, with its strong Puerto Rican community and many Puerto Rican and Mexican restaurants. I highly recommend visiting the nearby Puerto Rican museum. Learning about the community's culture and history of resistance made me appreciate the neighborhood even more.
The #70 bus runs frequently and gets you to Wicker Park in about 10 minutes, with the Blue Line, supermarkets, and many great shops. I never felt unsafe, although I avoided walking around at night and used Uber when returning late.
There is a clean laundromat nearby and a small local Latino grocery store with great fresh salsa.
And above all, the greatest attraction is George the cat! Within five minutes of my arrival, he was on my lap purring. He is incredibly affectionate and very good at making you believe you are his special favorite. I already miss him!
The house was exactly as described. It was very clean with plenty of indoor and outdoor space. The first AirBnB where I have stayed that had more than enough towels!  Thanks Jonathon!

Marijes is a very kind, thoughtful, and responsive host. The place was tidy and decorated nicely.
Parking, as many have mentioned, is quite tricky. (This is typical for the neighborhood). Allow extra time to find parking. It took me several hours, and I had to park quite far away the first night.
I enjoyed the walkable factor to the restaurants and beach.
We would definitely come back, very accommodating, clean, great parking and close to anything you would need.
Nice place, close to a lot of things we did! Responsive host with clear instructions. Parking spot available in the back made me feel more secure when traveling with my car.
Excellent location if you’re looking for a nice neighborhood off the tourist path. Great library - well equipped kitchen.
Great location in heart of Andersonville. Lots of restaurants, unique boutique shops, and taverns. Will stay there again.
Gabriel was an excellent host! We all appreciated how clean the space was, and enjoyed his recommendations he provided. The check in/out processes were easy and straightforward. Thank you!
It was a great last minute booking with amazing communication.
Great clean and spacious place
Our family loved staying here and will definitely be back for future family reunions!
Accurately described.  Good location, near coffee shops and adequate street parking.  Only gripe is 3 of 4 beds were extremely uncomfortable.  One of which was unoccupiable.

This was the perfect spot to spend a long weekend in Chicago! The space had everything you could possibly need and was very clean and homey. It was also close to restaurants and public transit (bus and train), making it easy to get to downtown and to the airport. Beatrice made sure we had all the information we needed and that our stay was wonderful.
We greatly appreciate being able to stay here we had a amazing time Thanks and look forward to stay here again thanks for everything 🙏

Great place! I would recommend.
James was very responsive
Nice location and cute apartment. Coffee and oatmeal was provided, which was a nice touch.
We had a good stay at The Plymouth. Excellent location as walkable to the key Chicago attractions. Rooms are on a bit smaller side but worked for us as we were mostly out.
Andy was an attentive host and the airbnb felt comfortable and safe as a female solo traveler. I would recommend Andy's airbnb to others looking for a place to stay in Chicago!

My positives: Easy to get inside and find your space. Lots of outlets, no bugs/insects. Floors are swept clean. Labeled shelf in the fridge for each resident. Large room. Good neighborhood--close to supermarkets and gas station.
Negatives: No insulation to diffuse noise. You can hear everything; what everyone is doing especially in the bathroom. The bathroom needs maintenance. Period. The door is difficult to open. I had to shove it to get it to close and brace myself to yank it open. The door catches on the uneven floor and I almost fell the first time I used the bathroom. Two out of the three vanity lights in the bathroom were not working or burnt out. Pee residue splashed/pooled all around the toilet, toilet seat, and on the floor. Kitchen trash can was overflowing when I arrived and was still that way days later when I left. The 'clean up after yourself' conduct code only works if everyone does it, and I was not going to pick up other people's messes. 5/10 experience for me.
Good communication, house very nice and clean

Worth what I paid for. Great area. Walkable. Near the Blue line so our entire trip was able to be by train or foot. There are great restaurants and bars in walking distance which is nice. The neighbors did have a party one night though! So it was kind of loud. It’s a shared space so the bathrooms weren’t to the standard I’d prefer due to that, but not much the hosts could do about that. I can tell they stayed on top of tidying things up. For a budget friendly trip, this was a great choice for us. However, bring shower shoes if you are a germaphobe! Jane was really nice and responsive as well.

Absolutely loved this Airbnb! It was in a fantastic location and was very walkable to Wrigleyville for the game. The front doors are a little tricky to get in but the building itself felt secure and safe! We all loved the apartment and the pillows are SO comfortable. Thank you for allowing us to stay in your Airbnb for the Cubs and Cards game!
Thank you for your hospitality. I thoroughly enjoyed myself
I loved staying here! Will definitely come back
We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean and bed was super comfy. In a great spot in Chicago! Thanks so much for hosting us!
Great location, very clean and very chill spot. Walking distance from shops and The Bean! Highly recommend this spot for your Chicago stay. The lobby and rooftop are great too.

The apartment is great and had everything we needed for our brief stay with our 2 year old. With it being VERY humid, the powerful AC had been set up perfectly for us to cool down after a long day travelling. The bedroom was plenty quiet despite the place being on a relatively busy street. It was also well located for downtown public transport and the host’s communication was clear and proactive.
Everything checked out pretty nice. Not too far from transit and pretty quiet area. Thanks!
We enjoyed a very comfortable stay. Great place to return to each day and would highly recommend. I'd book again given the opportunity.

Very very cute and cozy place! It was right in the middle of a bustling and walkable neighborhood with plenty to do. The apartment was spotless and felt really safe and secure. Despite being in a busy neighborhood, the space was very quiet once inside and was perfect to retire to and relax in the evening. Would absolutely stay here again!
Place was effortless to stay at and a perfect spot. Will definitely try to book for every visit to Loyola we make.
Lovely space in a lovely place. A large a cozy living space. And did not need a car the whole trip, could walk to everything, the redline and the beach(s).
We had such a great time here. Everything was perfect. Only slightly annoying thing was all the codes we had to type in but easy to overlook because we had so much fun this weekend!

Kyle's Airbnb was terrific.  It was extremely walkable to restaurants and to Wrigley field.  At the same time, the space was private, quiet and very comfortable.  Kyle also gave us detailed suggestions for restaurants.  Very hospitable!  I would stay here again.
I do not want to write a review.

You won’t believe how spacious this place is! Definitely a bargain for Chicago. Very elegant and comfortable; private and quiet. And my kids loved meeting the tortoises that live outside. Highly recommended!
Mi sono trovato molto bene!
Great location. Perfect for a weekend of games!
This was a great place to come back to after exploring the city. Am very glad we decided to stay here and would again if I’m ever back in Chicago!!
Great host and property! Highly recommend.
Great spot in Andersonville. Large 2 bedroom with lots of space. Great neighborhood, responsive host and comfy accommodations.
Good appartment close to the pink line, easy to get access to the city that way.
Easy access to bus stop and the red line!  clean and comfy!
The house was so nice and clean. I really enjoyed staying there. Quiet and peaceful.
Great location - very safe & close to lake! Many great restaurants within 1-2 mile radius. Easy walk to Wrigley!

Dede was an amazing host! Her place was beautiful, clean, and so welcoming. She personalized the space with our names and my daughter loved seeing her name all around. She was very communicative and kind and we felt at home. We will use Dede’s home again when we are in the city for sure!
A cozy home away from home! It was a great place to stay made even better with its convenient location. Highly recommend!
I use this place to get away from the hustle and bustle for peace. And that's what I got.
Decent place!

Honestly was a good stay and especially my first time booking an Airbnb I was not disappointed!! Definitely had a lot of local eats and was not too far from downtown. It might be noisy for some outside but once you get in you don’t really notice it especially if you’re not a light sleeper. Recommend staying !!
The space was great. Booked the place for a family trip to Chicago and everyone loved it.
Such a beautiful and well kept place. Enjoyed our stay very much :)!

Jamie is a very friendly and supportive host. He was there when I needed help, which made it much easier to deal with some of the challenges I experienced during my stay.
The house is in a quiet and welcoming neighbourhood, with convenient connections to the airport. It is quite far from the city centre, but Chicago is a huge city. Fortunately, the CTA Brown Line station is nearby, providing an easy journey downtown. There are also several friendly local shops and cafés where you can have breakfast.

Nothing to complain about. Walking distance to public transport and great restaurants, clean and accurate to the description, and at a good price. I would return for another stay if I ever end up in the area again.
Great stay!  Well equipped, responsive host, great location!  We will be back
The unit was as advertised and a great location.  The lobby of the building was not the cleanest, but it was quiet.

One of my best Airbnb stays. The host was great, very fast and  responsive and helpful with parking. The place was so close to Wrigley Field it was amazing. Very comfortable stay and would definitely stay here again!

Keenan’s place was just as described and super comfortable. We were in town for a funeral which was in the neighborhood so it was the perfect location. He is a super host and very responsive. I highly recommend it and would love to stay there again.

Great stay! The room was comfortable and had everything I needed, and the location was good for exploring, with several cool neighbourhoods nearby. The host was very communicative and helpful throughout the stay. Overall, a great option and good value for money. I’d happily stay here again

This was one of the best Airbnbs that me and my husband have stayed in thus far. The location was great. The neighborhood was very peaceful. Juan left great restaurant suggestions that were in walking distance. The listing was everything that was described. The only con was the neighbors upstairs were a little noisy, but over all a great experience!
We had a wonderful stay in the pink house. The host was very responsive. The decor was very Chicago. We found easy street parking. My family very much enjoyed their stay!

I'd give it a 4.9 just because few places are perfect, but I don't think the little things that stood out were enough to drop it to a 4/5 stars. The place was really clean when we came in, very homey, all needs supplied, and just comfortable. It's a very cute and well-decorated space. The only thing that personally stood out was the A/C. When it turns on, it is really loud. I don't know if that has to do with the fact that it's in a basement as we're not used to that in Florida. You can hear the people moving around upstairs as well, though that didn't bother me much.
This happened to be the only place available for my family and I on this weekend because it was move-in weekend for Loyola. We were dropping off my youngest niece, and that's a major transition for us. This place was perfect to make us feel comfortable and at home during an overwhelming time. Diana was also super nice and responsive. No issues here at all. Thank you!
Tres belle residnece , quartier top proche de tous les centres d interets, merci  a nos hotes
Great space and location. Perfect location for our family with little kids. Easy to walk to playgrounds, restaurants, zoo and other attractions, or hop on transportation to other areas.
Great communication, clean place

The apartment is very clean and Jhon’s communication and responsiveness was excellent. I was disappointed that the bedroom did not have curtains that cover the entire window. A light shined in at night and the morning was too light for me. Jhon offered to fix the issue during our stay, but our stay was very short and I didn’t think it was necessary. I hope he fixes it for the next person.
The plumbing in the tub drained poorly. He is also planning to fix this before the next guest. The location is excellent and in walking distance to many, many restaurants and shops.
Al and Jude provided a welcoming, comfortable place to crash after long days of exploring the beautiful Chicago. We especially loved their local recommendations.
Great location, near transit and all the amenities of the north side.

I would like to thank the hosts for a beautiful location as well as affordable. Everything my family needed while we were in the Airbnb was there. I would definitely stay here again thanks a lot guys.

It was a nice place! The bed wasn’t the most comfortable, but I was only there to sleep, so it did the job. It was also within walking distance of the red line train and bus stops, plus some really nice restaurants—literally only a 2–5 minute walk away.
Thanks Jen
Great place.  Comfortable, convenient, and as advertised.  Roberto was very helpful throughout our stay too!

There was a miscommunication at first arrival and the Airbnb wasn’t cleaned. Since I was solo traveling this was pretty nerve wracking because I had assumed that there was a double booking somehow. Thankfully Phil and Coty were able to get the cleaners over within 30 min. While I had the option to stay while she cleaned, I didn’t want to make her uncomfortable or rushed so I tried to step out during the duration of the cleaning. Despite this, the clothes from the previous guest were still left behind and some of the bedding still smelled used. I ended up rewashing a blanket and pillow case myself and only used those.
Otherwise, the place is beautiful and comfortable. While there are neighbors in the same building everyone is quiet and respectful. Though the listing mentions that the unit is on the 3rd floor, I do think that solo travelers with large luggages might want to reconsider. The stairs are pretty narrow.

Veníamos de un apto en Windsor (frente Detroit) con Booking, dónde las fotos describían un super apto q fue muy decepcionante y sucio. En cambio, el de Alana fue magnífico, x fotos no esperábanos nada y es un full equip: camas cómodas, cocina pequeña pero super equipada y muy limpio. Yo sólo quitaría las alfombras/moqueta, pero creo q en EUA es típico. La distancia al centro de Chicago difícilmente se cumplen los 15’; hay mucho tráfico y tanto en bus como en coche casi siempre tardábamos 45’ y x la noche 15-20’…

Marcos is very friendly and has a lovely space. The neighborhood is walkable and perfect for quick public transport. Generally a good place to stay for folks looking for a room to crash at in between city activities.
Important Note: He does frequently have guests over at night and the noise carries into the guest room. This makes the space feel less private and offers little opportunity for down time after a busy day in the city. Also, the bathroom is near the kitchen where many of his gatherings are, so you’re going to have be comfortable being visible to a group of people drinking wine and hanging out. This isn’t an issue for most folks given his high ratings, but if you are looking for a more private, quiet shared space during your stay, this isn’t it. I have stayed at many Airbnbs with hosts who live there and never heard a peep or had a stranger walk in on me while I’m brushing my teeth in the bathroom. Sharing for general awareness!

What a wonderful place to stay at. Lots to do within walking distance. The restaurant recommendations were right on. Friendly neighbors. Nice park one block away. The on site parking was well accommodating. I would advise anyone who will be staying in Chicago to book this location. Very nice place.
Very responsive hosts! Slept all 9 of us comfortably. A short walk to the train which made the city easily accessible.

We had a great time at this house. Very close to Wrigley Field. We walked to restaurants, coffee shops, and around the area.  The house is spacious, and it’s as described. Beds. We’re comfortable to sleep in as well.  Only thing I’d add is floor mats in the bathroom outside of the showers.  Other than that it was great.
Beautiful views !
Would stay here again! Very comfortable and clean. Surrounded by great food and easy access to public transportation. Our child loved the video game feature!
Jhon was super communicative and great. The pics are exactly what the space looked like. The red line was two blocks away. My wife and I will happily come back to stay at Jhon’s perfect location.
Great location in a quiet Chicago neighborhood, with everything you could want or need just around the corner.
This space was comfortable, clean and the host was very helpful and gave very direct instructions. This was a perfect place to stay to visit Chicago!
Muy limpio, bien equipado y todo super claro y específico, tranquilo y ameno.

We had so much fun here. Nice little bar right next door. It’s a quiet neighborhood with little traffic and close to the airport. The house was very clean. Walls are pretty thin so you can hear everything that goes on in the house, but it wasn’t a huge issue for us, just something we noticed!

The experience at Geo’s place in River West was absolutely incredible. The apartment was very clean with plenty of space and amenities.  A comfortable bed and great kitchen space made everything so easy. The surrounding area is walkable, friendly, and quiet while still having plenty of wonderful places to eat and socialize. Access to public transit is plentiful for trips downtown! We will certainly come back to the apartment the next time we are in town!

Michael was a great host. He was responsive to all correspondence. The location was great and the perfect size for 3 people. The only thing that I would change is the furnishings in the living/dining rooms could use a deep clean.

Tim was a great host. His home is beautiful and the private bedroom and bathroom were very comfortable. The bathroom had plenty of towels and plenty of places to hang them (solving one of my frequent AirBNB and hotel frustrations).
One thing to note: the private bedroom does not lock from the outside. I was not concerned about the safety of my belongings, but this was something I did not realize from the listing and would have liked to be aware of.
I would happily stay at Tim’s again in the future!

Absolutely perfect! Being so close to a train station and bus stops made getting around super easy, plus the surrounding neighborhood was lovely and easily walkable. The space itself was also amazing, spotlessly clean and the bed was incredibly comfortable. Jeanette was so kind and responsive, and the cute chickens were the cherry on top. Honestly, a flawless Airbnb experience!
Our stay was peaceful. Located on a quiet tree lined street. Walkable to cafes. Free street parking. Would stay again while in Chicago.

Nabil's place was clean, brand new and comfortable. Had all the requirements for a stay in central city. He was proactive in communication and accomodated our requests, such as an earlier check in. Attentive and responsive, he made our stay easy and relaxing.
Great spot, quiet, and walkable.

As far as the place, it was well kept and clean. The host was very helpful and direct with check in process. Only con I would say and it has nothing to do with the host, but because of the location of the apartment we did notice at night time rodents come out around the trash area outside and near the parking lot next to building so be aware of that at night, we ended up just parking on the street. The city needs to handle that infestation.

Soraya is an amazing host. She made us feel right at home and accommodated our schedules for check in and checkout. Beautiful place and great area to be in Chicago. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Will definitely stay here again. Thank you Soraya.

Nice apartment and the location was near where I wanted to be. The host was super quick to communicate. I did not realize it was a smoking apartment - my own fault for not reading the description better. I also did not anticipate the cameras by the doorways- I suppose this is necessary in this business today. There was a lot of activity in the building and hallways- but we could not hear it inside the apartment. It was a useful place to base our trip out of- but not to really “hang out” in as the living room furniture was  not really cozy and the apartment had a smokey smell. There were beautiful high ceilings- but oddly, 2 of the bedrooms did not have windows to the outside unless you count a sky light in one.
Apartment was great.

Alguns detalhes precisam ser olhados com mais cuidado. Paredes estão necessitando pintura. Banheiro da suíte master precisa de reparo na torneira que está solta. Nada que tenha atrapalhado nossa estadia.

Wanda was a very responsive and helpful host! The space was easily accessible, safe and clean. Loved having on site laundry and a private space to stay. Wrigley field was easily accessible by bus from this location and there were plenty of restaurants nearby! The only thing is that the upstairs neighbors could be a little loud at random times of the day (this is to be expected in Chicago) and the unit was slightly loud. Everything else was great!

Great stay — the host was wonderful, helping with pillows, the ceiling fan, and the air conditioner, and checking in to make sure I had everything I needed. Comfortable, well-equipped, and hosted with real care. Would definitely stay again.
Geo was wonderful! Very helpful and communicative. The place was perfectly clean and exactly as described.

Gio was an excellent host for our Chicago trip! He was extremely communicative and flexible, which helped make our stay really comfortable. The space had everything we needed and is in a great location, central to so many great spots in the city. We loved being able to walk to the nearby coffee shop each morning, and the free parking was a huge plus. It was just what we needed for our stay in Chicago!

Very responsive host, very clean and comfortable, walkable neighborhood!  Would definitely stay again!

We had a wonderful stay at Kristine’s place.  It’s a lovely home in a a beautiful Chicago neighborhood.   The house is spotless and there were many amenities.  We loved having coffee on the front porch in the morning before walking a block or two to nearby El or bus to get around town.   Plus, many local restaurants, pubs, etc around the corner.  It’s a great spot.

We loved this Airbnb… it is so nice! A great find for any parents visiting their college kids!! Location is perfect, beds were super comfortable, the place is clean and looks just like the pictures! Kim is super nice and helpful as well!! We will book again!

Nice clean place. Lots of indoor space.  Close to west loop restaurants which was very nice. Very responsive host. Knocked off one star as the ceiling is very thin, and you can hear the upstairs neighbours.

MILAN a été très accueillant, à l’écoute, conseillait et réactif . Logement bien situé, facilement accessible par transports, même en transports en commun. Bel appartement avec 2 belles salles de douches. Je recommande
Emily's apartment is located in a lovely neighborhood, it is very safe and quiet. We loved that the location was walkable and near so many fun local spots. We would most definitely book another stay.
Jean's space was incredible! We loved the decor, how clean the space was, and it was central to our activities. Thank you for the kindness and hospitality! We would love to stay again.

Absolutely loved this space! Very luxurious and the floor to ceiling windows can’t be beat. Underrated note too - there were SO many hangers in the closets and it was the perfect touch. So many airbnbs miss this but Cloud9 thought of everything!
Loved staying here! Tuan was a great host.

Richard was a fantastic host. Location was super convenient for traveling back and forth for the baseball game. The bedroom and bathroom were extremely well kept and tidy. Zero issues or concerns from my husband and I’s stay and would definitely use again.
Plus a cute pup 🐶

We had an amazing stay! The place was absolutely spotless, comfortable, and looked exactly like the listing photos. Checking in was super easy thanks to the clear instructions, and the host was incredibly responsive whenever we reached out. The location was also perfect—highly recommend!

Appartamento a due minuti dal bus 8, quindi comodo per raggiungere il centro. A 10 minuti a piedi o due di bus c’è un supermercato ben fornito. Alloggio accogliente e hosts molto disponibili e rapide nella risposta.
Abbiamo apprezzato molto che ci abbiamo fornito utensili di base per poter cucinare.
Lo consigliamo.

Nice clean apartment with a very responsive and communicative host! Love that it has two bathrooms! We had 5 people in our group. Would definitely recommend this place!
It’s a little noisy inside from the street outside but not enough to prevent sleep and they provide earplugs if needed. Parking can be a little challenging but we found parking a couple of blocks over fairly easily. The streets around the apartment require a permit. Great stay!!

My stay was wonderful! The home was very nice and spacious, which was perfect for our group. We were so impressed by the thoughtful details, everything from Q-tips to toothpaste and toothbrushes was provided, making our stay incredibly convenient. The location was also fantastic. Highly recommended!
Lovely neighborhood and nicely organized place! The basement was just a little cold and I think the sheets might've been too small for the bed because they kept coming off. Otherwise it was good!
This place was very clean and spotless! The location was very safe and absolutely perfect. Great for walking around too. Everything was worth it and worth the price!!
Fantastic walk up in Lincoln Park with all the amenities you’d want either in the unit or within a 5 min walk.  Great host; hope to be back for a future stay!
Victor’s place is nice, clean and cozy, and the price is just perfect for me as a student. Definitely recommend and would stay again!
Great place, Nilka was very nice and attentive if we needed anything.
Wonderful stay with everything I needed plus more! Tons of space for loads of guests to sleep. Beds and mattresses are all brand new! Great decor. Great vibe. Loved it

Milan was a fantastic host and attended to our requests very quickly and efficiently. Upon arrival, we were short on towels, but they were promptly delivered within an hour after our request. After our first day, we also reported a bit of stuffiness and humidity in our unit. Milan arranged for someone to check the thermostat, and the issue was resolved by the time we returned for the night.
Generally our stay was comfortable, despite some minor inconveniences. The occasional nighttime noise from outside activities and the elevator were manageable, and we did experience a brief hot water shortage when both showers were in use simultaneously.
Overall, for the location and the reasonable price, I would recommend this stay to other to travellers attending events at Wintrust Arena.
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was super responsive and accommodating, and check-in was easy. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay at Todd’s place! The location is excellent. The neighborhood has a great selection of restaurants and the house is close to the blue line train station. The kitchen is small but well equipped. Just watch your head on the corner cabinet when loading the dishwasher. :)
Just like in the pictures. Loved that the train/metro station was super close.  Would def book again if I need to find a place near Chinatown. Mattress was super soft and comfy.

The unit is as described.  It was clean and tastefully furnished, with modern bathrooms.  It was perfect for my family's needs.  The reserved parking was a useful bonus.  The neighborhood is friendly and walkable and under an urban canopy of mature street trees.  Elizabeth was a friendly host.  The only down side was the squeakiness of the unit's hardwood floors.
Space was great and super helpful with check-in. towels + check-out time mixup was annoying but otherwise 10/10

We stayed here to attend Fan Expo at the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center, and had a great experience. The condo was exactly as described, spacious, and comfortable.  The condo is within walking distance of the convention center using a nearby trail that runs through the park - it was a beautiful 20-minute walk and we even got to see some wildlife on the way.  The street parking was slightly challenging to figure out as we had a wheelchair ramp to contend with, but we were able to unload in the condo parking lot and get a spot on the street alright.  Doku and his co-hosts were extremely responsive and helpful.  We had an issue with our daughter's wheelchair dying on our last walk back from the convention, stranding her halfway back, and I had to get back to the condo to grab some parts - I left the key fob with my husband on the trail by mistake and the team was incredibly kind, helpful and quick to buzz me in to the building. Overall, would recommend and would stay again!

We had another enjoyable stay at Marla & James’ place. Love the location on a quiet tree-lined street with easy street parking while being within walking distance of Lincoln Square and public transit. Thanks for another wonderful stay!

We felt safe in the unit and walking to restaurants in the area; I would have had some concerns if we needed to rely on the L for transportation because the Howard street stop for the L did not instill confidence about safety at that stop.
The place was exactly as described. There were a lot of nice touches, like coffee pods and games.
Great location. Quiet unit. Clean and comfy bed. I stayed there alone as a female in early 30s and felt very safe!
Inga’s space is exactly as described and even more cozy than the pictures lead you to believe! The location can’t be beat and would absolutely recommend staying here.

We had a great stay! The place was clean and tidy, and we loved the patio space in the back. Valerie communicated clearly once we booked the Airbnb, the neighborhood was quiet and we felt right at home.
A repeat customer, and it was just as lovely as the first time! A perfect place for somebody who needs a spot close to UChicago and Loop train lines in a pinch.

I had a great stay and felt very comfortable. Everything was spotless, including the bathroom, and the room had everything I needed. The listing was 100% accurate.
It was also very quiet. I barely heard the other guests, and there was never any noise during quiet hours. All the instructions were super clear, and the location made it easy to get around. I had no trouble finding parking and was able to leave my car outside on the street. The neighborhood felt quiet and safe as well. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. Thank you, Zen! 😊
Perfect for visiting Chicago. Close to the highway and lots of good food and bars within walking distance.
Great! Super responsive host and nice place, walkable to public transport and additional parking. Clear instructions and expectations.
Nice place, very clean, and at a great location. Perfect to relax after being out all day, feels very private and peaceful.

Great landing spot for a few days. Heads up that the stairs to upstairs are steep and carpeted - I nearly slipped heading down - use the handrails! Comfortable bed, nice quiet spot. Breakfast at nearby Nick’s Hi-Ho diner was a real treat.

My friends and I had such a great time staying here! This was probably the cleanest home we’ve stayed in - every area of the apartment was spotless and cozy, which helped us immediately feel at home. The bathroom and kitchen were also both stocked with all the helpful basics and we were especially grateful to have coffee, a Brita filter, and lots of fresh towels. The neighborhood was quiet during our stay and we had a couple of very cool neighborhoods nearby to explore. I would love to stay here again next time I’m in Chicago!
Great place

I was a little worried about the location being close to the train tracks after reading some reviews about the train noise, but honestly, it was not a big deal at all. I slept perfectly fine and didn’t even need the noise-canceling earbuds I brought just in case!
The area itself was absolutely beautiful, peaceful, and very convenient. It was close to everything I wanted to do around Boystown, which made the location perfect for me.
The place was beautiful, the area was beautiful, and the host was incredibly kind and welcoming. I would absolutely stay here again and would definitely rebook.
If you’re reading the other reviews and are worried about the train noise, don’t be, it really isn’t a big deal. You’ll be just fine! Highly recommend this beautiful place and wonderful host.
Great staying with Michelle. Nice,quiet and clean place. Plenty of parking on the street. You need special stickers but she has them and walks you through the process. Would definitely stay again!
Apartment was clean and exactly as expected.  Location was a quick walk to mag mile.  Clemente’s communication and check in instructions were clear.  We would stay here again.
Great host and great place to stay within a 2-3 minute walk to Wrigley Field!!
Fantastic neighborhood. Cute space.
We live next door and use this air b and b when family stays with us. Responsive, convenient and clean.
Really nice place, very clean, host was super accommodating.

Muy buen lugar para hospedarte
Nos quedamos con mi esposa y mi hijo y todo estuvo bien
This place is very nice clean space easy to communicate with owner and easy to locate.  Walkable to bar and coffee shop one black away.
Muy recomendado el lugar, área tranquila, habitacion agradable y limpia !!! Atención de Guillermo buena, si llego a ir otra vez a Chicago con gusto me hospedaria  de nuevo en ese lugar !!!
good place to stay

A proper spot. Everything I needed was there, and the place looked exactly like the photos. Very clean. Super walkable with great local restaurants and easy public transit. Close to downtown but far enough away to feel quiet. Great spot overall.

Had an excellent stay with Joe and Alex in Chicago, beautiful calm and peaceful community. Clean house which makes me feel like home, Good breakfast, space for luggage, great washroom with Japanese style Bidets. Walkable distance to Red and purple line of L train which connects to all major attractions in the city. The hosts helped me with the must visit spots in town. Enjoyed the American hospitality by both of them, I wish these two people should be in charge of the best 5 star hotels in Chicago because they know how to maintain the place well and how to treat the guests perfectly and get all the awards of hospitality/ Hotel/ resort industry. I would definitely recommend every of my friends and family visiting Chicago to stay in Alex and Joe’s cute house. Thanks a lot for your wonderful service. I slept well and enjoyed the Best big City Chicago 💯😍😇.
Lugar estaba bien, bonito.

The place was good overall. The location is great for getting to different attractions, and the staff was friendly. The only issue was that there was a little dust on the wooden bed frames in the room.
Great place and great host
Communicative and helpful
Wonderful stay in Chicago. Probably the cleanest airbnb I have ever stayed at!

This was the perfect place for us. The unit itself was everything we expected and a great value compared to local hotels.  Host was very communicative and helpful. Great residential neighborhood.   The only, minimal, negative observation was that while the unit was excellent and the building was solid and nice, the common areas, entry-way, hallway, etc were a bit dilapidated and in need of sprucing up. But to be fair, you spend all of maybe 2 minutes walking through those areas your entire long weekend so no reason not to book here!

Mei was super friendly! She often complimented my daughter and said she was so cute, she let us put some leftover pizza that we had in the freezer. When we came into our room it was super clean! The bed was also so cozy and it was so easy to get a good nights sleep. Overall this place is a 10/10 and I would 100% recommend!
Great stay
Fantastic stay in a great neighborhood.
Disfruté mucho la estadía, el host responde rápidamente y es muy cordial. Es muy fácil transportarse, ubicación centrada y con acceso a tiendas de conveniencia.
Nice for the price, great location, fun rooftop

I had a great stay at 747 lofts! The loft was as described. Spacious, bed was comfortable, and loft was clean! All of the amenities were present and worked well. The location was very convenient with the Blue Line station being a few feet away. Check-in was easy and communication was precise and prompt. I would definitely stay here again!

Everything is perfect no problem with host or house one thing to keep in mind is the area, it isn’t safe but if you mind your business and don’t go out at night your fine the host was nice and inside the house was really clean and modern it was a nice stay.

Maggie is a responsive and helpful host. The house is cozy. Kitchen has beautiful cabinets and appliances. Has anything you could want. The game room is perfect for young and old. Beds comfy too!!  Eight women loved staying in this home.

Was in Chicago for the weekend to see friends. William's home is in a quiet residential neighborhood but close to many restuarants and other places of interest. (I recommend the Misericordia Hearts and Flours Bakery, not too far away). William's house was a great deal. Plenty of space and very clean. I really enjoyed chatting with William, too, about Colombia and Chicago. Highly recommend.

Le logement de Carlos était parfait 👌 !
Il était très propre et ne manquait de rien, le quartier quant à lui est paisible et calme.
De plus, Carlos est très gentil et serviable !
Je reviendrais sans problème 😊

Me and my guest loved our stay here! The decorations were very whimsical and unique. Everything was clean and stocked up well. We stayed during a weekend and didn't realize the concert venue was right under us. It was a pleasant surprised to hear the music as the band rehearsed. If you plan to stay here just be aware that the noise of the band can be quite loud. Personally felt like we were given a special pass to experience the live music and we loved it! Thanks for sharing your home with us. We'd come back again.

Had a great trip in Chicago staying at Christiane and Patrick's place. They are so warm and hospitable - it felt like home away from home. Their home is characterful with charming decor. Everything is carefully thought-about to make your stay a smooth one. Lovely continental breakfast provided (including great coffee). I loved the area as close to some very interesting neighbourhood spots, as well as handy for the city centre.
I would stay again in a heartbeat - highly recommend.

Small, simple room and a good deal for a great location-easy access to trains/transit, great restaurants and a peaceful, walkable neighborhood. Easy to check-in and Charlie was quick to respond and helpful!
I had a nice quiet stay at this Airbnb, did not interact with the host much but everything was easy to find and accessible :)
Wonderful place in a great location! Kitchen had all the extras!!

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. The location cannot be beat, and we appreciated the flexible check-in. The apartment itself was spacious, with lofted ceilings and a ground-level view of the metra that made it feel very homey. The train noise never bothered us. The large open-concept kitchen and in-unit washer/dryer were also fantastic.
There were a few downsides. The apartment could use a deep clean, as we found quite a bit of miscellaneous junk tucked into drawers and corners (old lights, broken mirrors, etc.). We also found other guests’ toiletries and medications, as well as spoiled food in the pantry, which made it seem like some items had simply been overlooked by the cleaner.
The host was responsive and helpful. Overall, we would recommend the apartment, especially given the excellent location and reasonable price point. Thank you!

Stayed at The Godfrey for my birthday weekend. I’m originally from Chicago, but wanted to experience the city like a tourist for once, and The Godfrey was the perfect home base.
I really enjoyed the entire experience—from the rooftop and downstairs bar to the gym, location, and overall atmosphere. The views were incredible, especially through the large windows in the room and from the rooftop.
The only minor drawback was some slight wear and tear in the room. A few pieces of furniture showed their age with some minor chipped paint, but nothing that took away from the overall stay.
All in all, a phenomenal experience! Great location, amazing city views, and exactly what I was looking for during my birthday weekend. I’d definitely stay again!
James is an amazing host, the apartment is in an amazing location.
Un excellent rapport qualité prix pour visiter quelques jours Chicago. Et très facilement accessible des lignes de train jusqu’à l’aéroport
Chill host, great communication he was super understanding about alot of check-in so I appreciate that!!! Would probably book again next time I'm in the city
Was a great stay.

Very nice apartment with 3 large bathrooms and the king size mattesses were incredibly comfortable. Great location in Lincoln Park - close to the North/Clybourn train stop and the Wild Mile garden walk along the river is  2 mins away. The host, Ben, was very responsive and we would definitely stay here again!
Such a gem, a beautiful clean space that felt super comfortable and close enough to all the activities we had planned, without being smack dab in the middle of the busy part of the city.
Sarah and the home were great! Our group had a fantastic weekend and staying here was excellent.
It was a cute little place, i enjoyed it very nice. The owner was very kind and responsive.
Great place! Spacious and clean! Very cool building with great outdoor spaces
Very clean…lots of space…would stay here again
Good place to stay in a quiet and pretty neighborhood.

Les points positifs :
• Les hôtes sont réactifs et l’annonce est très détaillée, ce qui permet de savoir à quoi s’attendre avant l’arrivée.
• La chambre et l’ensemble des pièces communes étaient propres.
• L’emplacement est pratique : à 30 min du centre-ville, avec un arrêt de bus juste au pied de l’immeuble et une station de métro à 10 min à pied.
Les points à améliorer :
• La communication peut parfois manquer de bienveillance lorsque les choses ne vont pas dans le sens de l’hôte.
• La cuisine manque clairement d’ustensiles. Nous avons dû privilégier les repas à emporter ou préparer pouvant être cuits au micro-ondes.
• L’expérience dépendra des personnes avec qui vous partagez le logement. Malheureusement, nous avons eu des colocataires très bruyants (réveillé à 3h du matin par le claquement de la porte d’entrée et des appels téléphoniques à haute voix…) + la voix de la caméra à chaque passant.
Dans l’ensemble, nous avons passé un séjour correct. Je recommande ce logement : ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐
Enjoyed our stay! Great hosts - responsive and helpful. Place is small but as advertised.  Location is very good. Time for a new mattress. Everything else was like home.

Overall, this place was perfect for my Bachelorette weekend! Plenty of bedrooms and couch space to pretty comfortably fit us all. Having four bathrooms (two with showers) was much needed for how many of us there were. It made getting ready much quicker!
The only real negatives are just location based - it's right next to the Pink Line which can be pretty noisy as it goes past and it's in an area where you just want to be careful (and avoid if you can) walking around alone as a woman.
These didn't end up being true negatives for us though. We always traveled in large groups together so no one bothered us and we loved being a block from the train because we used it multiple times throughout the weekend.
Great value for the amount of space the place provides! We really enjoyed our stay.
Perfect place, close to everything we wanted. Instructions were top notch! So easy, thanks for a great experience.

This was a great place in a great location! It was so easy to walk to the L to get to Wrigley for a game, and we also enjoyed walking around Lincoln Square. It was easy to find a free parking spot in the street, and we left our car there and walked everywhere. We can’t wait to come back!
The place is bigger than we expected and was really nice. The location was perfect for us and the restaurant downstairs was great!

Highly recommend! Booked this unit for a bachelor's trip to Wrigley Field. The unit itself was super nice: roomy, clean, well-furnished and comfortable. It was very close to both Wrigley and Boy's Town, but the street itself was peaceful and quiet. Peter was also communicative and easy to work with.
great place.
Safe neighborhood and I loved the modern feel of the place. Nice and Clean and really close to everything. Beds are also really comfortable! I thoroughly enjoyed my stay

The location of this place is great and street parking was easy to find. There are several great restaurants within walking distance. The host let us know right away when we left an item behind so we could pick it up before leaving town.
However, this apartment felt like many mass-managed AirBnB units and did not live up to the listing. Clean towels in the bathroom were the only towels of any kind provided - no paper towels, no dish towels. We used toilet paper for napkins the first night. The dishes were not very clean. There are food residues in the fridge and freezer. The coffee station was stocked only with a gross sugar container and some crumbs of old coffee grounds - the listing says coffee provided. The mattresses were very cheap and hard. There were no accessible outlets in the bedroom, preventing one of us from using our CPAP at night. It was a fine place to crash, but far from the 5 stars that the host insisted on multiple times. This place needs some TLC.

We booked this place cause our crew was in Indiana and Illinois helping with the storm/tornado that had happened, it looked like a nice place and it was, but if your a contractor that has trucks I highly don’t recommend this place at all. Another thing I want to point out is list the correctly amount of guests there’s going to be, caused we had an issue we put 4 guest but in total we were 8 guest and the host made us made pay $394.28 for the remaining guest. Also the place is said to be quiet, it is not! You could hear everything and  every time you walk you could hear every step( the floor is very squeaky).
Very good all around, would definitely recommend.

Parking passes weren't available. I was told to use a parking website. and find it myself. It wasn't cheap. The last night there someone put used passes in the lockbox. The response I got didn't make sense. Maybe the host sold them. The whole thing was weird. For next time- try being honest, apologize, reimburse my Parking since you failed to provide. This is my only negative review. Ever. Location is great if you're going to Wrigley.
Great location and very smooth experience! Thank you Brett!

The place was very clean and quite neighborhood.  The  only bad thing was how you charge so much and not have proper towels and cooking items for your residents. You have big towels but no small face towels shouldn't have had to go purchase towels or cookies sheets to cook on but i left The ones I brought for the next family.  But overall I enjoy my stay
Great place to stay with a group of friends and we were able to walk to the restaurants we had reservations at!

Always the best. Have stayed with Marty and Rob many times before and it never disappoints. Friendly, accommodating hosts. Lovely home and gardens with beautiful artwork and furnishings. Excellent location that’s quiet and serene but a short walk to all of Andersonville and Chicago just a train ride or Uber away.

Shonte’s place was great! We appreciate her accommodating us. We felt safe and were close to the things we wanted to do. We decided to utilize rideshares and left our vehicle in front of the home. Next time Im in Chicago we will definitely be booking this home again!
Amazing host will book in the future again!
The place was clean and just like the pictures. Plenty of space to sleep. It is very close to the train and local restaurants! Alicia was very responsive and helpful.

Good location on quiet street. House is a little dated and could use some cosmetic upgrades, especially the bathroom. Beds were comfortable and everything was clean. It’s great that it comes with a parking spot

Very clean and comfortable apartment in a great location with easy access to transit. Fully stocked with thoughtful details and plenty of extra towels. Hosts were very responsive and accommodating. We loved being able to see the Chicago skyline from the living room. We would not hesitate to come back again or to stay in any of the host’s other properties.

Chris and John were wonderful hosts - responsive, flexible, kind, and unobtrusive. The garden unit is super well-appointed and nicely decorated, more spacious and even nicer than the photos. We really appreciated the (hidden) dishwasher in the kitchen! If you want to enjoy the city, the location is awesome. This is a high-end, pedestrian friendly neighborhood with everything you can think of within walking/biking/scooting distance (including public transit and Cubs games). Walking to early dinner at the bar at Sal's Trattoria was a highlight. You're just far enough off the main drags to avoid noise and craziness. We travel to Chicago often, and will definitely book again!

Richard was the kindest host. We really enjoyed staying in this location.  If we needed anything he was to right on top of it. Location, location, location. Walk out the door and in every direction there is something to do.  Located in very quiet and very green Chicago neighborhood full of charm and the El is a quick walk away.  I would stay here again even if had been here on business. Thank you Richard, we had a blast.
Everything was great and they were very helpful and great at communicating!!
Muy bueno todo, excelente. Lo único un poco ruidoso cuando pasaba el tren
Anthony’s place was perfect for our needs.  Great location!!
Highly recommended
Great place! Great communication! I would definitely stay here again
Very clean and nice apartment. Conveniently close to a train station with just a 2 minute walk.

Brett and Caroline were wonderful hosts, and Moose was an absolute delight! The space was quiet, comfortable, and convenient. They were very flexible with check-in, communicated clearly, and were incredibly responsive throughout our stay.
The parking space was especially helpful for us since it was an enclosed garage and made our stay even more convenient. I highly recommend their place and would definitely stay here again!
Great place! Very clean, comfy beds, and an easy walk to Wrigley Field. Highly recommend.
Everything was wonderful!

Overall a very solid place but not having an actual shower and no AC in the summer wasn’t ideal. Bed was comfy and location is nice. Host lived above us and could hear things being dragged above us each morning at 7-8am.

She was very nice. It was first time staying in the owners home with the owner. So it was a different experience. Not wanting us to spray cologne/perfume was a bit much but overall it was a ok experience. We enjoyed Chicago so that’s all that really mattered I guess.
Great place to stay in chicago

Tripp, Todd & Eddie(their dog haha) were amazing! They were so kind and hospitable. Some of the BEST recommendations and made our weekend girls trip SO much fun. We will definitely book again when we visit in the future. Would absolutely recommend booking with them!
Wonderful place to stay. Leafy and walkable neighborhood, very safe.
Beautiful design and location. Wish we had more time there to explore the neighborhood. Make sure to use the provided sound machine. Street traffic can be loud

Very nicely furnished, kitchen and dining areas. All very comfortable.
Master bedroom is particularly well designed with an extra large bathroom and a generous outside deck.
Luggage racks and lots of outlets were a plus,

We had a great stay here! The location was perfect - walking distance to all the amenities in Roscoe Village as well as Wrigley and Southport. It was clean, comfy beds, and little extras that made it easier to feel comfortable away from home. The communication was spot on and helped ensure things ran smoothly with our stay. Highly recommend!
Great location and value. I was traveling with my parents and my newborn and it was the perfect space with the add on room.
Would definitely book again! It was a good area to stay at and the inside of the room was neat and clean

We had a great time at our stay! The location was nice and calm, only complaint would be the slow elevators in the building and we weren’t super close to a train station but other than that it was a great time!

This apartment was a great place for a mini-family reunion.  We had 7 adults in our group. The apartment is comfortable, clean, and in a good location with the lake and the L in easy walking distance.

Great place with everything you need I. The heart of Chicago. The best neighborhood with restaurants galore convenient, central, but also quiet at the end of a long day exploring. Super comfy and thoughtful design of apartment. Love the outdoor spaces. Would love to return!
Great condo in a perfect location for exploring Wrigleyville!  Spacious and clean - everything we needed and we would definitely return!  Go Cubs, go!

David was very responsive. Swiftly handled any situation or questions that arose.
Would definitely recommend David for your stay!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay with Lesley! The space is clean and comfortable and we had a great time exploring the neighborhood. Would stay here again!

This place was exactly what we were looking for when we planned a quick Chicago weekend. The place was exactly as described, very clean and the host was very responsive and accommodating. There were several places to walk within a few blocks for food and drinks, and also not far from the train station. We had a great time and will definitely try to stay here again in the future.

This place was very clean and also walkable to the pink line which was helpful during my stay. Valeriy was quick to respond when I had questions. Other guests were respectful during quiet hours. The listing is a bit misleading but it was a good stay overall. This is similar to a hostel.
Very clean and comfortable home in a great location. Would stay here again.

I would like to provide an honest and transparent review of Anthony’s property. The property is located on the South Side of Chicago in a neighborhood where my family and I did not feel completely comfortable. Street parking is available, but it becomes crowded in the evening, so you may have to park some distance away.
The rental is a lower-level, basement-style unit. Upon arrival, we noticed a strong mildew odor. The furniture appeared old, worn, and stained, and we also observed bugs and damage to some of the walls and doors. In my opinion, the unit would benefit from major updates, repairs, new furniture, and a thorough cleaning.
Unfortunately, the accommodations did not provide a comfortable experience for my family, so we requested to end our stay early. On a positive note, Anthony was responsive, understanding, and willing to shorten our reservation after I shared my concerns. I genuinely appreciated his cooperation.
Very nice house in the middle of Wicker Park.  House was very clean and the neighborhood was super fun and close to transportation.

My friend and I absolutely loved our stay! Janice is very kind and responsive, and was able to help us with anything that we needed. The apartment is absolutely pristine, very spacious, and comfortable. The location was also perfect for a weekend exploring Chicago. When I am back in town, I will definitely stay here again. Thank you!
Host was very responsive when we needed anything!
Visiting our son in the area and the place was a few blocks away. The place worked out great for us and enjoyed our stay

Everything was pretty good. There was just trash under the bed and the tv in the bedroom could’ve had an outlet to plug that tv in. That was difficult and annoying. Tissue wasn’t placed on a rack. Other than that they were really good to us. They communicated perfectly with us and pretty fast. They checked on us the entire experience. This little issues are baby lil nothing issues that can fixed for the next set of visitors.

Great place for our stay in Chicago!  Walkable to Wrigley, and as many restaurants that you can want.  Also very close to the lakefront trail for running/walking.  Tawney was super responsive and helpful! Would come back and stay again
Very easy to communicate with the host, they were always responsive. The check in was easy to follow and the Airbnb was in a very nice area. A lot to do and see in walking distance.
Amazing and affordable place to stay, will be back.
Great host, super responsive and a great place for a long weekend.

Good location and response time. Unit was fine for everything in it but it was student housing with a bunch of college kids which was not mentioned. And we had 4 bedrooms with multiple guests and was only given 1 fab for the whole stay. This fab had to be used in the elevator so you could not just leave the fab in the mailbox for other guests to use so it was very inconvenient.
En general el depa es cómodo, amplio y limpio tiene todo lo necesario.

We had a great stay. The apartment was perfect for our stay and there were some great restaurants and bars within walking distance. Having the two parking spots was also very convenient. Lourdes was very helpful and responsive.
Nice stay, near plenty of stores. Guest services were great!

We had a great stay at Abel’s place! The location is fantastic - walking distance to most everything we wanted to do during our Chicago stay and close to the train. The space itself was very comfortable, clean, and had most everything we needed for our stay. Abel was friendly and very responsive.  Highly recommend this AirBnb for a Chicago visit!
We had a great time, we had some confusion about the number of beds per person but that was on us for not reading the details. It’s a great place, would definitely recommend for future visitors.
Great experience, would stay there again!

Wow! This apartment is gorgeous! We loved the balconies in the front and the back. It’s also huge giving all of us privacy. My son and his fiancé stayed in the master bedroom with a gorgeous connecting bathroom. It is in the back down a long hallway. This separated them from my bedroom up front which is right next to the second bathroom. My daughter slept in the living room on the couch which again is a distance from my bedroom, so if you want space between your guests, this is the place. It’s also in an excellent location in Wicker Park near all of the restaurants & activities. It’s right near the Blue Line, which was perfect for us because I like public transportation. This is a very safe wonderful neighborhood. The restaurants & coffee shops are literally right outside the door. In fact, my son who’s been to Chicago many times said to me, “Mom how did you find this place?” So it’s fabulous and if it’s available I would grab it. Plus the hosts are responsive & easy to work with!

The Airbnb served its purpose - gave myself and my two friends solid accommodation for our weekend visit to Chicago. The location was favorable and easy to get into downtown Chicago / the loop without being too much in the "crowd" if you catch my drift. The apartment was also very spacious for 3 people (could very easily and comfortable fit a few more in the apartment if you needed too) .
The apartment building is a renovated warehouse/factory so there are some elements of "ruggedness" if your into that. I will note it felt damp in the apartment with somewhat of moldy smell.
All in all it was a solid Airbnb, but I will say for what we paid more could be desired.
Love the decor & very clean! Host was very sweet and attentive. I would book this location again for Chicago

Our party of 3 in town to visit a friend.  Suzanne's place is just what we needed.  Easy access to the green line to get downtown.  Detailed instructions on how everything works.  Friendly and responsive host.  Everything was as advertised.  We enjoyed our stay.
Great stay! The location was perfect and very walkable to Wrigley Field and the surrounding area. Everything was convenient, and we had a great experience overall. Highly recommend!

I loved this place; the location is very convenient—it has everything you need, including nearby restaurants to suit every taste, pharmacies, and plenty of other amenities. dawntown is aroud the corner. The place is very cozy but, above all, very safe. Tony is very kind and made sure the entry process was secure for us. If you visit Chicago, I recommend it 100%.
was great place for a bachelorette, could have used more towels but other than that it was perfect!
Wonderful host, huge rooms, great location. Would 100% recommend
Very convenient for attending Cubs game.
Can’t beat it when 2 parking spots are included!
Amazing location and Assel is a great host.

the apartment is in a great location and the space is nice and comfortable but the air conditioner wasn’t working well and they had an additional portable unit in there to try and help keep it cool but it wasn’t able to keep up.   the unit was constantly on and very loud which made being in the main area of the apartment nearly impossible for conversation. I was quite hot at night and the living room/tv area was very warm. thankfully the weather wasn’t that hot or it would have been bad
Good location. Easy to get to public transportation. Very clean and neat.

Robert’s place was amazing. It’s was very spacious and comfortable. I felt just like home in Virginia. We were able to check in early with an extra fee. Had questions and he answered it right away. Never had an issue at that house. Everything was excellent. Highly recommended place. I had nine people with me and we were comfortable. I would stay again here.

This rental exceeded our expectations. Alex and Sean were super communicative and helpful throughout our stay! A Comfortable bed is all we needed. Not to mention that the kitchen came fully stocked for our needs. A wonderful neighborhood as well! We love forward to booking our future stay here!

Joshua’s place was a great crash pad for a conference as a solo traveller! He provided towels and sufficient amenities for my stay. Check in was fast and convenient—even when he wasn’t home. If you like maximalist, kitschy decoration with an adorable senior dog barking at you (she’s blind and deaf, and doesn’t mean any harm—but obviously stranger danger) who only likes you when Joshua is around: this is the place. Loved that it was so close to the Blue Line and lots of restaurants—was an easy place to commute in out of. Joshua, when available, was always friendly, even when we had similar schedules and needed to use the bathroom at the same time. I’d recommend this place for solo travelers since you share a bathroom with Joshua too

Aminata is so friendly and accommodating thanks!
Had trouble checking in because there were two locks that I had to hold my luggage for one door so that I could return the key to the hidden spot. Everything else was a breeze!
I really loved seeing the beautiful huge black owned brownstones that line the block, the transportation of both the train and bus were less than 3 minutes to get to but got me everywhere I need to go. The transportation was also sparse most times, it's like a quieter NYC.
The fan was needed throughout the night because without it, it would feel stuffy. Suggestion: A floor length mirror would be amazing addition in the hallway so that guest can check their fits before they head out.
Other guests: someone left moldy raspberries in the fridge. Some folks feet was stomping in the middle of the night lol. This couple in the room next to me left their toiletries in the shared bathroom, then stomped down the hallway to look at me lol it was all peaceful tho 🙏<3 :)
The unit itself was nice, modern design. It’s a shared space with 5 other bedrooms for guests. All guests were quiet and respectful.

Amit was a fantastic host. The house was conveniently located walking distance from lively restaurants and bars in a quiet neighborhood. Instructions and expectations were clear and everything we needed was available at the house. Accommodated our group perfectly and would book again!

The home was excellent for our guest list. Comfortably accommodating all 5 of us with cleanliness, a well-equipped kitchen, comfortable beds, and adequate bathroom space in a peaceful neighborhood! James was an excellent host, offering to assist with any and all needs in a timely manner. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

This was a great spot to stay with a very family friendly neighborhood. Charles provided a safe and comfortable space for us to stay. The bathroom had hotel like robes and towels which made it feel extra luxurious. So many thoughtful touches such as coffee, microwave, mini fridge, smart TV, iron, etc. Charles even knew we were celebrating birthdays and brought us some birthday treats. Would highly recommend.
Great place close to everything! Easy train ride from O'Hare. Easy walk to Magnificent Mile and all in between! They also have luggage storage which helps a lot. Would definitely stay here again!
Everything was as described. The host was super friendly when we communicated, and the house was very clean, spacious, and easy to find.
Atención, acceso seguro y práctico, todo bien.
Great place to stay in Chicago for the weekend with a larger group! Plenty of space and close to downtown wrigleyville!

Jakob was an absolutely fantastic host! He was incredibly welcoming, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, and his hospitality made our first trip to Chicago even more enjoyable. We really appreciated the smooth check-in, great communication, and even the late checkout. Thank you, Jakob, for being such an amazing host. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend your place to anyone visiting Chicago!
Great location, and comfortable stay.  Shared resources across the floor at which your room is located.
We really enjoyed our stay.  Matt is an excellent and friendly host and the apartment was very clean, comfortable and charming.  The neighborhood is calm with lots of good restaurants and shops.

Lovely art and a pretty room. The towels provided were musty like they sat in the washer for too long before drying. No closets available, clothing racks or drawer space.
