Bulbs in light fixtures were out in a couple of lamps. This space is not suitable for individuals with mobility issues. In our guest room, the tub was very deep so we had to be extra careful entering and exiting the tub. The patio door has a broken lock and a bar that didn’t quite fit is used to secure it. This balcony has access to a fire escape that is used as a primary exit for the unit above it, so lots of foot traffic during the night. Kitchen was dirty. There was another guest in another room and the sink was left with dirty food covered dishes. No guest manual available with points of interest. It’s a good spot for younger guests, but not elderly or small kids. I gave it a four because of the art and it is a nice home.
Thank you for a great stay and for being so responsive/communicative!  We loved it.
Beautiful and super clean place...really nice,  100% recomended
The place was perfect for being close enough to the city to hop on the green line to take you right there. The street is very safe with police officers
This was a great spot for our weekend trip!

Definitivamente para mi fue genial hospedarme con Adresa Stay, porque el sector es tranquilo y ademas me quedaba super cerca de la universidad de mi hija, asi que iba y volvia caminando. Fueron muy atentos siempre, su respuesta es inmediata, sus especificaciones fueron muy claras para el ingreso y la salida. Es un hospedaje al que volveria sin dudarlo.
This place is great! The house itself was beautiful and full of anything you could have needed. It’s right near the blue line and with a great rooftop space that was highly utilized.
Really great spot for Logan Square. Parking was a breeze and within walking distance of so many great spots.

We had a wonderful stay! The location was great, the home was comfortable and welcoming, and everything was just as expected. It was a nice place to relax and enjoy our family time together.
We would definitely stay here again!

The room is very cute and clean. It is clear that the host is keeping a careful maintenance of the house. I appreciate the clear instruction of how to get inside the house and Silvia is very responsive to my inquiries. The neighborhood feels a bit uneasy to walk around so I stayed mostly inside my room.
Great spot for our family for a weekend trip. Hosts were very responsive and helpful with all communication. Thank you so much!
Zee was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The place was very clean and it felt like home. The mattresses were a huge plus. I would stay here again
Very nice home. We had 6 people and had plenty of room. Nice king beds. Walk to grocery store and a few restaurants.  Even though it’s on a busy street it was very quiet.
Nice place for a large group to stay visiting Chicago. Comfortable and close to Blue Line.

I stayed at this Airbnb for a guys weekend and it was great. Natalie called me before our stay so that I had her direct phone number for better communication. Her check in instructions were clear and helped us access the condo easily. The space is amazing. The projector was easy to setup outside, the garage door that connects the living room to the outside deck is truly unique. The space was modern and spacious with plenty of beds. We have zero complaints from our stay and I would book this airbnb again if I ever come back to Chicago.
Very cozy and convenient!

Lovely little studio in a great location.  Walls are paper thin - you can hear everything going on, so bring a sound machine or ear plugs if you are sensitive to that - but it didn't bother us.  We spent most of our time out and about in the city, so this place served it's purpose for us - comfy bed to crash in, good air conditioning, centrally located, easy to access, etc.  No complaints at all.
Great place and Joe was easy to get ahold of!
Very nice hosts and great place to stay!

The location was great and within close walking distance of many restaurants.  We were also within walking distance of the lake which was an added perk.  Nicholas was very responsive and typically responded within 15 minutes.  I would recommend.
Great location.
Exactly what we needed in Chicago. Everyone had a great time.
We stayed here for a bachelorette trip & had such a great time! It was so nice that the 4 bedrooms had each an own bathroom!! We would definitely stay here again!
Very nice place to stay when in Chicago. Martha is very responsive and having parking available right at the Airbnb was a major plus.
Wonderful place! Even larger than it looks in the photos. We exclaimed WOW! When we walked in. Extremely clean, great location, and the instructions were very clear. We would definitely stay again!
David was a very responsive and attentive host. Check in was really easy & it was so fun to have so many arcade games in the living room!

I cannot get over how perfect the location of this home is, it was super close to everything we planned for our vacation. The place was also super clean and definitely felt like home away from home. Chicago was amazing and will be back soon, hopefully this place is available when we do because it’s so worth the money.

Thomas’s place was great! It was perfect for a comfortable stay for 6 of us. It was located centrally for where we needed to go and had everything we needed. Luggage drop off was so helpful so we could get to the cubs game on time without all our stuff and check in was a breeze! Sadly we were unable to figure out how to get our truck in the garage spot (something to thing about if you have choices in what you drive here) but that would have been an awesome perk if so! Best of all was the communication from Thomas and his team. They were always so quick to answer our questions.  That makes a stay even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this place.
John has a great place. Clean and easy to get to. John does a good job communicating and responsive to questions.

Great street and overall location. Clean fresh and pretty interiors and unusual to find a duplex arrangement to suit a family. Bathrooms and kitchen and bed linens all new and comfortable. Host was very friendly and available and responded to our questions quickly.
The view from both bedrooms was fantastic. The building was very safe and secure, we had everything we needed. parking was in a good spot. We definitely would book again!
Hosts were very accommodating and helpful with any of our asks! Overall made the experience super enjoyable and easy! Would recommend to anyone!

Gabriela was a wonderful host. She communicated great, responding timely and accommodating requests. Her place is in a quiet neighborhood surrounded by places to eat. Getting around the city was easy using public transit, with a bus stop a block away and the train line a 15 minute walk from her place.

We had our sister’s bachelorette party in Chicago and this house had everything we needed to have a successful weekend! It was clean and accommodated our large group. The host was very accommodating and helpful with our questions. I would highly recommend this house for your next stay in Chicago!
Great apartment in a PERFECT location in west loop.
Jon was a great host and we really liked the space and location. Would definitely stay again.

Jason was an awesome host. Super easy to communicate with. We needed some more trash bags and he Amazon primed it immediately and it was there within the hour. Place was great, perfect for our group. Wrigley is literally a 5 min walk away. Not to mention bars and restaurants even closer. The place also included a rooftop where we usually ended our nights enjoying the place with a great view of Wrigley. 10/10 would recommend.
Robert is an amazing host very flexible and recommend us activities to do in Chicago.
Great location, very walkable. Comfortable bed. Kind and responsive hosts.
Very nice host

Ben’s place was perfect for our Chicago weekend. Plenty of rooms and comfy beds for everyone. The building is beautiful and felt very safe. Well located close to public transportation. Would stay here again!

This place was amazing!!! We stayed here for my bachelorette party and it worked out perfectly for the size of our group. The place was so clean and exactly like the photos. Great neighborhood too!! Thanks for a wonderful stay, Mary!
Lots of comfortable beds. Easy process and great host to work with.
Thanks for everything! They have thought of every detail and I can’t thing of anything that was missed. We love the friendly, quiet neighborhood.
Very nice accommodation, easy to access. Would recommend!

Highly recommend Ella’s House! Pristine and comfortable, this two bedroom was the perfect base for our family. Jeff was a very responsive host. Nice touches throughout, beautiful kitchen, comfortable beds, lots of towels and extra amenities (they even left us water bottles in the refrigerator), and very quiet neighborhood. We needed a parking spot as they were doing road  work out front one of the days  and they let us use garage. We would definitely stay again.
This was our second time staying here. I love this place. Super comfy and a perfect area. We love the vibe and Matt goes out of his way to make you have a special stay.

Great view and well appointed apartment. Both a great home base for exploring Chicago (centrally located, next to public transportation) and a nice place to hang out when not exploring. Thanks for hosting us!
Great place, easy to get to, very clean! Note that the daycare above can be very noisy during daytime hours, but otherwise the upstairs neighbors are very quiet!

The photos for this Airbnb have never been updated. I hope the $600 we wasted on this is used to repair the multiple holes in the drywall, replace a curtain rod that was missing curtains and not even hanging properly on the wall, blinds that aren’t broken and general updates. This location is worth $39 a night MAX.
My boyfriend and I considered leaving and wasting the money multiple times, but just decided to tough it out. Everyone deserves a better place to stay than this.
VIBRANT was a lie. Once you enter the building it’s immediately dark and depressing. The view from the room is the building next door.
The air conditioner is rotted out around it and smells like mildew. It doesn’t keep even the smallest space livable cold.
Free street parking may have been the only benefit to this location. The host said she couldn’t confirm based on the street, however we asked someone walking.
Also I wouldn’t say this is a safe area two blocks away we were offered blow.
This is the perfect place if you have a large group traveling together. The home offers plenty of indoor and outdoor space, multiple gathering areas, and beds.
Lovely home in a nice, safe neighborhood.  Lots of restaurants, shops and bars within walking distance. Would rent again.

Abia was attentive and quick with her responses. The home was spacious and comfortable. You can hear some of the traffic from the interstate as it is located right next to it however it wasn't  overbearing or too loud. Parking is a little tight but manageable. The neighborhoods is peaceful and felt very safe even late at night. The beds were soft comfortable as well.  It was a very pleasant stay and I would book again.
Squeaky clean basement unit. Only 2 towels for 4 guests

This was my second stay with Ecem. This time around for a short two night stay. The Airbnb itself is clean and well kept. The host/hostess are very responsive. The building is a newer 3 flat build. From my experience it’s a good option for a short little 2-3 night stay. The regular rooms are on the small side but comfortable and clean. The master bedrooms they have available are really expensive. They do have a washer and dryer on both floors, which is very helpful. I will say that it was very loud upon check-in the first evening. This can be very frustrating when you’ve had a long day and just want some peace. I’d recommend that you ask for a room on the first floor as the top floor individuals really make things hard for guests on the second floor. Things did get better the second evening after reaching out to the host about the noise issue. All in all, it’s a decent Airbnb and worth the stay. I’d stay here again but no longer than 2-3 nights. Thank you for having me again Ecem!

I joyed our stay! Host was attentive and supportive. We had issues with the lock and not having trash bags after we went through what was in the can so clean up was difficult but we managed a solution. Any issue with the place we had he acknowledged quickly. Overall a good stay and because of location to my sister I would consider staying here again. The beds were more comfortable than the hotel I stayed in last weekend!!
Exactly what we needed for our stay, with a proactively helpful host!

My partner and I spontaneously booked this trip to Chicago and we’re so glad we did. The location of the Airbnb was super convenient to all of the places we wanted to try. Subway is a 2 minute walk & the bus stop is right across the street. As for the Airbnb, super nice & clean and I have no complaints. Would definitely book again next time I’m in Chicago 😊

My group absolutely loved our stay here. Josh and Gloria were excellent hosts and always super responsive, even late at night. We had to change our weekend travel plans last minute due to storms near our original airb&b and Josh and Gloria helped make sure we were set up for an equally great weekend right away. The apartment itself was exactly like the listing and the beds were very comfortable. I would definitely recommend the place for anyone visiting Chicago with a mid-size group, especially if you’re wanting to spend time in Wicker Park or Ukrainian Village.
The host was very responsive. The first day we have realized that one of the bathrooms was low on soap, and the host immediately dropped off New soap
Convenient, comfortable, and clean space.
Christopher was a great host! His place matched the pictures and description and was in a quiet area.
Great location, host was very responsive and friendly. Would definitely recommend.
We had a great stay! It’s close enough to Chicago that we didn’t have to drive far, but far enough to stay away from traffic noise. Overall great place, it’s clean, comfortable, and organized.

We had an excellent stay at Mera's place! We spent three nights and went to a few Cubs games.
Pros: Lovely neighborhood that is 100% walkable. We love to walk and it is only a 20-30 minute jaunt to Wrigley Field. You can stop and shop, eat, drink along the way.
Parking is actually quite easy. Just find a nearby spot using SpotHero. Then download the ParkChicago app (they might even have an update map one) to park on the streets by the hour if you want to drive around instead of walking.
Cons: The check-in instructions were a tad bit confusing at first, but then we realized that some of the steps seemed out of order and after that, it was a breeze. Minor, really.
We love the location and the host was very responsive. We'll be back to cheer on the Cubs!
Very nice place!  Host was easy to work with.
Jose is a great host and is very mindful of people's needs. We encountered a problem during our stay and Jose stepped in to resolve it for us.
Not worth price

We stayed here for a girls weekend and it was perfect for the 6 of us! The apartment was clean, spacious, and city-vibe. We especially loved the views and the location. The building is connected by bridge to a grocery store, which was really convenient. The host was also very responsive and helpful. We would definitely stay here again!

Great home base for exploring Chicago. Easy access to all the Loop has to offer, including parks, restaurants, etc.
The unit is as described and worked great for us.
The place for what’s it’s worth, it works.

Had an excellent stay for a long weekend with friends. Alex’s home is located on a  quiet street, just a quick drive away from everywhere we wanted to see in the city. The setup of the home itself was very nice, and had everything we needed. Would absolutely recommend!

Great location, great hosts. Great amenities. Close to many attractions and restaurants. Close to public transportation. The train nose takes getting used to but I knew that going in. Thanks for a memorable stay!
Fine budget stay if the price is right but very noisy building and pocket door to the bathroom that did not fully close.
The apartment was pristine, exactly as described and location was perfect - super walkable to bars and restaurants but on a really cute, quiet street.

This was our second time renting Daniel’s place as overflow for guests visiting from out of town (we live down the street). It’s a really nice spot, super convenient, and I’m sure this won’t be our last time as a guest.

I can’t say enough great things about this place and the neighborhood! 10/10. Our hosts were so great- even leaving us a little surprise for our anniversary. The apartment is gorgeous and we loved how walkable and friendly the community was. You won’t regret this stay!
The place was great. The only issue we had was the parking.
Our stay was the best very secured, peacefully
Would stay again
This is an excellent place to stay, and the host was very accommodating and provided excellent recommendations for food and enjoyable activities.
Mary was great! Really helpful with directions and kind when we messed up the parking situation.

Very beautiful home. Wonderfully decorated. She had helpful itineraries for things to do in Chicago. She even had extra supplies for any occasion and anything you may need for you stay. Will recommend for anyone coming to the city

We had a lovely stay at Hanna and Mark’s apartment. The garage parking was easy, location was great -close to public transportation- and the kitchen had everything we needed for our family of five.  We’d stay there again.
You get what you pay for had a great stay though
Great location, would pick that spot again in the future
This place was perfect for the two of us! You can walk to all the downtown attractions in a matter of minutes. Place was quiet and very comfortable!
Great location and apartment.

The location was great. The main reason why I would not rate five stars is because the elevator was an absolute cluster. There are only two for the entire hotel including staff that only fit four people max. At peak times you should budget an extra 15min if the elevator is needed.
Great location and a nice building!  The pictures of the unit were accurate. Enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend it. Chicago is a great city! I agree with all of the other reviews.
Clean place.  Steep stairs.

We had a wonderful stay at Christi’s place. You could tell  that they have taken great care to make you feel comfortable, with nice linen, power points in rooms, anything you could need during your stay in the kitchen. It was a peaceful place to relax after our long work days, a great neighbourhood with lots of options of food and groceries. Thank you!

I was in town for work for a few days.
I was pretty much gone from 7am until 9pm each day.
I had no issues with the shared spaces,or the bathroom.
There was plenty of space in the fridge for my prepacked meals.
The upstairs bedroom was small but for me,thats all I needed. The AC unit in my room was perfect for me.
It is about a 15 minute drive to tge Rosemont,which was great
I would stay here again.
Great stay and location was very convenient .

Melany’s place is beautiful on the inside. My only complaint is the king side bed is very, very firm. The location leaves a bit to be desired. It’s on a busy street with businesses lining both sides. No choices for dining out except fast food. I didn’t think it would take me 25 minutes to go 4 miles by car, But it did.
We really enjoyed the apartment, it’s was cozy and comfortable, I just wish it was in a different location.
Had everything we needed. Safe area, quiet,  and comfortable

This Airbnb is in a cute little neighborhood and close enough to the city via uber. The space is extremely spacious and clean! Was in awe with all the space we had! We absolutely loved the shower!
Also, Mirna was fantastic! She was responsive and extremely flexible. We would stay here again!

A group of 5 women and myself just stayed at the Bronzeville 42 for my bachelorette trip. Leading up, any questions were handled by Rashad with punctuality and clarity!
The home was very accommodating for all 6 of us.
Very clean, well decorated, and overall beautiful!
I would 100% stay here again, and recommend to anyone!
Me and my girlfriends stayed here for the weekend. It was a great stay close to Chicago and exactly what we needed.
Overall a good stay. There were some issues but they were resolved in a fair amount of time. I was not a fan of the virtual front desk they use.

Adorable little home! It was the perfect size for our family and we appreciated the family friendly amenities. The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful. It was quite easy to drive to the city. Street parking was always available. Bathrooms were spotless. I will say I agree with a previous review that the master bed was not comfortable as you sunk right in. Maybe a personal preference but the room itself was absolutely lovely! Perfect stay for a family!

Great spot only minutes from the Howard L stop, not a ton to do in the immediate area but with the train so close we had no trouble getting around. The check in was super easy and convenient and the place was clean and if anything ended up being bigger than the pictures made it look. Great value for the price and would definitely stay again
Great stay

Ben did a great job of communicating before, during, and after. Check-in was a breeze and the place was better than even the photos show. Would certainly recommend to friends/family traveling to Chicago.
We had a great time staying here - the location was absolutely perfect.  You don't hear the neighbors. There was plenty of room for the 8 of us. We would definitely come stay again!
We stayed here for 3 months and loved it! Such great location and Airbnb. Adelina was very responsive and helpful! Hope to stay here again.

Great place in Wrigleyville! Everything is close and the neighborhood was very peaceful. Only issue was the smaller bed was very creaky every time you turned over making it difficult to sleep. We had a great stay though!!
great place, a little loud with planes at night but overall enjoyed the stay.
Great stay
We enjoyed our stay a lot, the Airbnb has good access to public transportation and the host was really friendly and would respond really fast

Went for my bachelor party with 6 friends. Ivan’s home was great for a home base with walkable spots nearby and easy to access public transportation to go places around the city. Ivan has great hospitality, was very friendly responsive and attentive!
Excellent location. Walking distance to local amenities and shopping. Larger than anticipated apartment which was a very pleasant experience.
Perfect location
Host was accommodating for an early check in and very responsive to questions. Home is located within a 15 minute walk to restaurants, bars and shopping. 100% recommend.
Everything was great
place was absolutely amazing! host was so attentive and allowed us early check in and worked with our flights! 10/10 would recommend!!!
This is a great place to stay if you are exploring the city on a budget or traveling solo. We greatly appreciated the private bathroom and bedroom as well as the other amenities.
I e enjoyed ourselves waking up to the amazing views! 180 view of the city! Walking distance to just about everything!!
Thank-you for the clean, convenient location and great views.
We had a great time, the amenities were great for hanging out at the house and it was in a good location to get anywhere quickly!

This was one of the best Airbnbs I've stayed in. It was clean, had more than enough amenities, and in a quiet area. The host was responsive. When I return to Chicago, I definitely would love to stay here again.

Alma's place had all the necessities and felt like a cozy getaway while exploring the South Side of Chicago. It was so accommodating for our large group and we would recommend this stay to other traveling groups as well!
Jorge was a great host. The place was in a great location and in a pretty calm and nice area.
Thank you to Nikkole for her responsiveness and flexibility! Low-key neighborhood was perfect for our family. Thank you!

Beautiful place to stay, really quiet and clean in a wonderful and lively area - I absolutely loved it! Having a washer and dryer in the apartment was super helpful and I loved the upstairs bedroom. Only thing if light bothers you when you sleep, be ready with a sleep mask. The curtains definitely do not block out the light.

We had a great stay! The host was responsive and proactive, with clear instructions that made everything easy. The home was a great value for four bedrooms and three bathrooms. We felt safe throughout our stay and had no issues with  street parking. The location was convenient, with easy access to the L and Chinatown within walking distance. We would definitely stay here again!

The hosts are responsive and proactive with many great recommendations. The space is light filled, great linens, comfy bed, great art and live plants. Once you get to the unit you are rewarded with great views of the city. Would highly recommend.
Clean, walkable and private, perfect for a weekend trip with a group!

Esmirna was a fantastic host. She responded fairly quickly everytime my girlfriend or I had a question for her. She always replied with much empathy and did well timed check ups on us. The unit itself was adorable, the decor was on a whole other level. The cats were lovely to be around and were not shy to say hello. However my girlfriend and I did notice have a few issues. After a couple days multiple flies started appearing throughout the unit which was tolerable at first, but by the end of our week long stay there were maybe 10 total flies buzzing around; It was raining heavily throughout the week to be fair. On one day some very loud music was playing through one of the adjacent units in the building  and continued for a little over a day time-length wise which caused my girlfriend and I to get very little sleep that night. There was strong kitty litter smell, however after a day I was completely adjusted to it.

Unfortunately, this stay was very disappointing. When we arrived around 5:30 PM, someone was parked in our designated parking space, which made check-in confusing.
Our first night, we woke up to a puddle of water on the floor and water behind the bed. I immediately contacted the host at 10:24 AM and was told to put towels down and that someone would come around 2 PM.
This was a top-floor/attic unit, and the temperature remained over 86°F despite multiple industrial fans. It was extremely uncomfortable and made sleeping difficult. The fans also created significant noise throughout the night, and the cots were uncomfortable. The Wi-Fi was also extremely slow and eventually stopped working.
Overall, the water leak, excessive heat, uncomfortable sleeping conditions, noise, host and Wi-Fi problems made for a bad trip.

We had a fantastic stay from start to finish. The property was exactly as described, check-in was incredibly smooth and the space was sparkling clean. The host was highly organized, welcoming, and easy to reach whenever we had a question. We would absolutely recommend staying here and would happily return!
Great location, great host 10/10 recommend

Jenn thought of almost everything with her place! She was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. While not docking stars for this, just a heads up that this is not a great place for remote workers given the train noise and WiFi speed. They are also is not desks in the unit itself. Other than that, very walkable and a great neighborhood!
We stayed here with two people for around a month and a half during the summer. The space was a little tight for two people that long, but given it being summer - access to the rooftop was really awesome. There is a cardio room on the top floor, as well as a weight room in the basement.

John’s place was just as advertised, very nice, lots of room for 5-6 adults. We don’t usually have 2 vehicles, but we did this time and the gated carport with space for both vehicles was very convenient and secure.

Leonid is a great host and very responsive however we felt very uncomfortable with the mattress and couldn’t sleep at all and the size of the room is so small for 2 people. I wish he can also place bathroom mats

We had a fabulous trip to Chicago and loved our stay here! The location was perfect for us- we visited the museum campus, did an architectural boat tour, saw the Sears tower - basically all the tourist stuff - and were able to walk to all of it. We ubered once due to rain and it picks up right in front of the building. Restaurants nearby were fantastic and we were able to find allergy friendly locations that worked great for dietary restrictions in our group. We rented bikes and bikes along the lakeshore - and saw a free concert in Grant Park. The apartment worked well for our party of 5 and the view is amazing. We had a great time!

Honestly the place was ideal aesthetically and fiscally. Our issues initiated on arrival with the keypads. The main gate entry was without issue as it’s an older keypad with actual buttons, the second two were difficult due to uncertainty with the button being pressed and received by the keypad as you cannot hear it and the surface of flat. They eventually stopped functioning due to dead batteries which left us totally locked out TWICE in the evening. While the host did answer night one, we were literally left in the dark the second night and didn’t receive a response for 7-hours. This wouldn’t be such a big deal had we not explained to the host the locks were informing us on night one their batteries were dying to which she failed to act on. Otherwise, I lowkey loved the place. Crazy how something so trivial changes things.
Great place to stay! Easily walkable to the concrete beach and many restaurants. We found parking at a parking garage just a few blocks away. The place itself is great and we had no issues.
Amazing spot in the heart of Lincoln Park. Apartment was perfect space for us! I would most certainly come back!
Great host and great place to stay! Super responsive to our additional inquiries as well. We had 9 people total and it was plenty of space for our whole group!
Really enjoyed staying there.
Great place for my group to experience the city over the weekend!

We enjoyed  our stay! The apartment is a walkable distance to several museums and restaurants. Ping was very responsive and we were able to secure our luggage  in locked storage cabinet prior to check-in.

This place was incredible and we would absolutely stay again.
It was gorgeous and great location.
The only thing I would critique is the price was a bit steep. But other than that, it was a pleasure and they were extremely responsive and helpful.
Very friendly hosts who made sure we were comfortable. The unit was very clean and appealing. The parking instructions were very clear. Easy check in and out.

We had a great stay here! Nini was super responsive and flexible with our arrival. She gave great instructions for the home and made it super easy for us. Highly recommend staying here - was super comfortable and exactly as pictured.
Great place very clean… Comfortable beds. Small but very efficient kitchen.

We loved our stay here! The host was very nice and allowed us to drop off of our luggage early so we could make the cubs vs. cardinals game after getting in on the train. Clear instructions for checking in. We loved the area and enjoyed walking through the park nearby to get to the L! The back porch was a nice bonus area to hang out. The only thing this place was missing was fluffier pillows. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. We would definitely stay here again! Thank you 💗

Viviana's garden apartment is cozy and cute.  I love the Italian touches.  The bed was comfortable and all linens were clean.  The kitchen had many thoughtful additions, coffee, ramen noodles, ice in the freezer.  Because it is a garden apartment having the homedics noise canceling sound speaker was really useful and I was able to ignore upstairs and outside noises.  Thank you again for a lovely stay.
Great place for a good price.
Great visit!
Nicely decorated and welcoming rooms with everything we needed.  The backyard garden was beautiful with lots of flowers.  Very clean.
Steve was a wonderful host. The space was exactly as described. Location was ideal. We would highly recommend it.

I booked Omni’s place and was wowed with the experience from timely responses to recommendations for local restaurants and things to do! I would definitely recommend this place to friends and family and would definitely book again! The hosts were friendly and even messaged to ensure we had everything we needed throughout the stay. 10/10 would recommend!
Great host!

Jesus was a great host. The house was exactly how it looked in the photos and it was the perfect location for our stay. The home was beautiful and had everything we needed for the weekend. I would stay again and would recommend it to anyone visiting the Chicago area.

We really enjoyed our weekend. Stay at the dugout to enjoy a Cubs Cardinals game. It was an amazing location, everything was walkable and easy check-in and check out. We appreciate Samuel contacting us throughout the weekend to make sure we had everything we needed would highly recommend this Airbnb!!!  You ‘re definitely in the right spot for Wrigley field- we’ve stayed in other neighborhoods, Gold Coast/ Mich Ave and this was by far the easiest getting in and out of Wrigley!!

This Airbnb was very cute, clean, and organized! The hosts were awesome as they were very responsive with any questions and would check in frequently. Neighborhood was a little noisy late at night, but only for short periods.
Would stay again if we’re in the area again!
We enjoyed our stay here
Well-appointed and beautifully decorated place on a tree lined street near the L. Quick walks to restaurants and late night drinks and food. Everything you want and a great host.

Great experience - unit is beautiful, in a great location, and hosts were easy to reach and helpful when an issue arose (window was misaligned and then had a tech come and fix it).
Looking forward to staying at another one of their properties, soon !_!

Michael's Penthouse is lovely, full of character, and a total gem. The listing is highly accurate; clean, cozy, just as pictured. The bed is comfy too with great pillows!
The off-street parking — right up the driveway and right into a little unattached garage — is a massive plus. After half a day in the area, I found that street parking in this part of Chicago is a serious challenge and that's understating the fact of it, so this off-street parking amenity is priceless if you've got a car, rented or otherwise.
Michael is the best too! So friendly, responsive, and respectful. My one complaint was that my time in town was too short to get to know him better.
Check in and check out is a breeze. I had to confirm the checkout instructions were accurate in basically just being "kill the lights and lock up on the way out." No cleaning tasks or chores, no extra fees for cleaning, etc. Just easy and straightforward.
Ten out of ten stay!
Great place. It was cute place to stay with 6 of my friends the communication was great. Location was pretty decent close to the train station. I would definitely come back here.
Great location!  So much close by!  Was very clean and well cared for.  Hosts were very responsive and accommodating!
Very responsive. Close to a bus stop. 20min from the city.
Bella’s place is beautiful and located in an unbeatable area. I think the price is a little overpriced, but that’s what you pay to stay in such a nice and convenient area. Highly recommend it!

Great place. Matches or even exceeds the pictures. And the neighborhood is perfect, walkable to the heart of Wrigleyville as well as Uptown, close to restaurants, bars, grocery stores, and the lake. We look forward to staying here again.
We had such a lovely stay! Bryan was kind, knowledgeable of the area, and very responsive. The home was so nice, spacious and clean. We felt very comfortable and at home. Can’t recommend enough!

We will definitely be staying here again next time we go to a cubs game!!  The location was perfect and safe. I felt very secure in our room. It was very well decorated and very clean. Communication was fast and easy, too!!
Great stay , great hosts , very responsive , I’d stay again , great for trying to get into city

Jefferson was very hospitable, had a solid diner recommendation nearby, and his place was perfect! Very comfortable and clean. The neighborhood was pleasant to walk around also. No complaints - would stay again!

Great place to stay for cubs games.
Recommend more seating.
Daniel was a great host. Loved the place, great location wise and had recommendations for me if I needed it. Would definitely stay again or recommend to someone else

This was a beautiful place…
Clean, beautifully decorated, spacious
Definitely recommend
10/10

This Airbnb was pristine!  It’s in a very central location in Lakeview, a fun Chicago neighborhood with great restaurants and stores. Mera was incredibly responsive to questions. We found a very cute coffee shop, Doppio Coffee, 5 minutes away and Whole Foods is 1/2 block from rental. The only issue we had was that the instructions were somewhat confusing to get into the apartment (I.e. gate and lock box instructions), but other than that, it was a great stay!
Great space for a weekend getaway! Danielle was very welcoming and Lemonade was a sweetie.

Joe is a very good host — he gave great food recommendations as well as suggestions for stops along our route to Chicago. The space was exactly what we needed for our stay and was very affordable. Parking was a bit of a challenge.

We had a wonderful stay! I rented this home for my 80-year-old parents, and they absolutely loved it. The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful and very safe, and the home was clean and very tastefully decorated. The pictures are very representative of the listing and there was a lot of natural light flowing in which made the rental seem even more spacious.
Anne was a welcoming host - it is clear she puts a lot of thought into her property. There were snacks, drinks, and many other little touches that made my parents feel comfortable. Truly, the rental felt more like a home rather than just a rental.
The next time we have family visit, we will definitely rent from Anne again.

We had a great stay. The location is convenient. We always found street parking nearby. Everything looked exactly like the pictures. Nice neighborhood with sidewalks. Would definitely love to stay again sometime.
Great place to stay! Great location!

The host was responsive and friendly, and the place was clean, cozy, and comfortable. The bus stop was right there, so public transportation was easy to access. Several delicious restaurants, including Giordano’s and Gwacamole, were within walking distance. A really cute coffee shop called Perkolator was also within walking distance. The neighborhood was peaceful, and we enjoyed our stay there.
Excelente ubicación, orden y aseo, cerca a restaurantes supermercados y estación del metro. Sin duda alguna lo recomiendo al 100%
Very nice, safe accommodations for a stay in Chicago. Easy access to the L.  Apartment was clean with all necessary amenities.
Great location, great spot. Yolie was a great host!

We had a great week at Marco’s place. Fantastic location within walking distance to shops and some fabulous restaurants. We really enjoyed our stay. Would definitely recommend Marco’s place.
Thank you for being a great host and very responsive.
Natalie

Lakeia’s home was in a decent area was pretty convenient to get to the plans we had planned for our girls trip. She was very responsive and fixed the minor issue with the linens I will definitely book again if I ever decide to come back to Chicago. Thank you for the stay
We had a few issues other than when it came to communicating with him about the problems, he was very easy to get ahold of !
Recommend this location (QUIET)
Nice place, convenient location.

This was the second time we stayed at Mary’s for 2+ months. We love staying at her Airbnb and look forward to our next stay. She’s a great host and the location is perfect. Highly recommend staying with Mary!

Alex was a wonderful host.   He was friendly and responsive.  The kitchen floor needed major repair and they did knock off a small amount of the cost.  It should have been more of a discount in my opinion.  The place itself served its function because I needed the location.  It was a little dirty and did not get cool enough.

Reseña Airbnb en Chicago
Quedé muy feliz con mi estadía en este lugar. El alojamiento estaba impecablemente aseado, la decoración es hermosa y la cama muy cómoda, perfecta para descansar después de un día recorriendo Chicago.
La ubicación también es excelente: está a unos 10 minutos de la línea azul del tren, que funciona las 24 horas, por lo que el transporte es muy fácil y conveniente. La cocina está muy bien equipada y cuenta con todo lo necesario. El baño estaba muy limpio y completo, y el alojamiento también dispone de aire acondicionado, calefacción y ducha con agua caliente.
Sin duda, fue una excelente experiencia. Me volvería a hospedar aquí sin pensarlo y lo recomiendo totalmente para quienes quieran visitar Chicago. ¡Me encantó mi estadía! Atte: Maria Camila 😊
This was the perfect place for my wife and I. It was very clean and cozy, and quiet. The air conditioning was on point also.

The perfect private space for our long weekend away. So many small touches that made the space feel cozy and probably the most beautiful kitchen and bathroom I’ve ever had the joy of using while staying in Chicago. If you’re looking for a functional place to rest your head while enjoying the city, this is perfect for you. Also, the dogs were so sweet and playful!
Great host, place and location
Really enjoyed our stay here and Bianca was a great host and easy to work with

We had a wonderful 3 day girls trip in Chicago and The Plymouth was a great home base. When we arrived at 7pm our unit was not cleaned - quite the surprise. We communicated with Brian through the app and then by phone. It seems the cleaners had simply missed the unit. They were not able to come back that evening but fortunately another unit was available. While annoying to have to move after one night m, and it took some time to sort out, Brian was very responsive and helpful. Don the security guess was also very helpful.
Both units we stayed in were very clean and comfortable. The first unit had AC issues and there were portable AC units set up that worked well. Several of the beds in both units were low to the ground - fine for us but would be hard for some people to get in and out of.
Lobby has pool table and darts. Rooftop is great! Nice seating and great space.

The stay was fantastic.   The apartment was in the perfect location with ample street parking.  Walkable to Wrigle's FIield and many great restaurants.  Chris was quick to respond to any inquires.  Definitely would stay again.
Great house! Three generations stayed there and we had plenty of room. Everything was clean and just as described. Will definitely rebook when I visit Chicago again.
Kenneth was great, he made sure we felt right at home, very honest and attentive, I will definitely book this property again when I'm back to Chicago!

Location can’t be beat, street parking was easy to navigate, and the temp inside wasn’t nearly as bad as I expected with no central AC in mid August (plenty of fans to keep a nice breeze). Kitchen is well stocked and the welcome gifts were a nice surprise. Would stay here again!!

Lovely place and well located by the expressway for easy access to downtown Chicago. I recommend that you bring a small / midsize vehicle to stay there - the parking garage is secure and private and very tight with foundation poles between spaces, and was challenging but do-able to park our Suburban there.

An easy choice if you want to stay near Lincoln Square, but not on Lincoln Ave. We were able to walk to all the restaurants and shops without a problem. Easy access to transportation by train, bus, and car. The place itself is in an older Chicago U shaped building, so it has some quirks. The floors are creaky, you can hear the upstairs neighbors when they’re home, the hot water is temperamental, and the bed is a little soft, but the place is clean, and the air conditioning is comfortable. In my opinion, the location is really what you’re paying for here. It is just super convenient whether you’re staying in the neighborhood or trying to get elsewhere.

Although we couldn’t do early check in, we were allowed to drop off our stuff which was more than accommodating especially with how much there was around the location. Perfect for my group of friends for the weekend
Very comfy, apartment comes loaded with necessaries, you’ll feel right at home.
Great location within walking distance of Wrigley, which is why we were there. Bed was comfy and AC worked well. Would stay here again!
Had a great stay at this listing, great for a weekend to discover River North!

We loved staying at this Airbnb! The neighborhood is very cute with tons of shops and restaurants nearby but it was also quiet and didn’t feel like you were in the middle of the city. The train was a short walk away and there was a nice playground/park at the end of the street. The condo was very clean and the beds were comfortable. We also enjoyed sitting outside on the deck. Will look to stay here again the next time we are in Chicago.
Suzanne, was very helpful and responded quickly to all my questions/concerns. The home was just as pictured and was comfortable and spacious enough for 5 ladies.

Auroom's place was EVERYTHING!! My family and I came to visit Chicago and the unit looked like we were apart of the TV show "Friends", Lol! The neighbors were soooo nice and welcoming! They hung out with us all night on the rooftop! The place was really spacious and had everything we needed for our family's cookout! It was such a serene area and the deck allowed us to have early morning coffees and chats to catch up while watching the sunrise! Auroom was also very responsive and made us feel right at home! It was just a beautiful experience altogether and I highly recommend!
Thank you so much, Auroom for catering to me and my family for my little brother's first NFL game!
Very good location, easy to get in and out of, matches the description well. Jose was very responsive when i had questiond

Great place to stay & had everything our family needed. Host was very responsive & friendly. Close enough to downtown to enjoy sightseeing & activities without paying downtown prices. Highly recommend.
Great place for a large group to stay for a cubs game

We chose this location because of how close it was to Wrigley! Loved being able to walk everywhere. I’d say it comfortably slept 6 adults. Finding the parking space was a little difficult due to the worn out sign but luckily Josh always responded quickly! Definitely a great place to crash if attending any events in Wrigleyville!

Nicole and Matt's place was very convenient to stay in Chicago. The hosts were very responsive and attentive to all details when they gave us the guide to check in to the house. Highly recommend this place, everything was clean and spacious and comfortable.
Thank you!
Great house, Josh was great to work with.
Troy is awesome! Place is great! Go Cubs!
Good location but not comfortable for large groups.

We had a great stay at Dennis's apartment! The location is perfect for anyone that is going to be watching a game at Wrigley Field! There is so much around the area that's within walking distance so you don't have to bother with taking your vehicle out then having to find a different parking spot. Would definitely recommend to anyone that's looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Chicago, especially Cubs fans.
Beautiful Airbnb in a great neighborhood. Our stay was here was perfect!
Great layout, beautiful yard, and great shower.  Its all very beautiful and well cared for!

This place was not too far from the city, it was a good mix of city and suburbs. The unit was very cool through the hot, humid days. There was also a ceiling fan and extra fan in the closet which is very nice if you like to stay extra cold. Street noises wasn’t really an issue for me but they do provide ear plugs if needed! The only issue was parking, spaces were quite limited and it took me about 20 minutes to find a spot close enough to the building (5 min walk) but overall fine. Brad was also very responsive and friendly and I enjoyed my stay here!
It was great. Rida was great too!
Really lovely spot, great location with plenty of spots nearby to eat and drink. Also a short walk to the blue line to go explore greater Chicago.

The location was excellent—close to many restaurants, cafes, shops, and a quick walk to the ballpark. The host was responsive & attentive, although the communication was more frequent than preferred. There were multiple check-in messages, including one that came through around 4 AM local time.
For those traveling with children or others with a sensitive sleep schedule, the floors within the unit & floors above were creaky, and footsteps could be heard.
The unit did not quite match the photos in the listing and could benefit from some additional deep cleaning.
Overall, the location was a definite highlight, but a few improvements to the unit & guest experience would make the stay more comfortable.

If you read the reviews and look at the photos, you know what you’re getting yourself into: a cheap place to store your luggage and sleep at night. Unfortunately, you can’t do either of those things particularly well. There was a very strong mildew smell. Others have mentioned the noise. It’s an apartment with paper thin walls and loud neighbors, even at night. The AC unit is also very loud. There is also 0 storage space. The bed is too low to fit a suitcase underneath, and due to the small space, our only option was either zip and store our luggage upright, or trip over it on the way to the fridge. This could be easily fixed by raising the bed, or removing the rod at the bottom of the entryway table to store luggage there.
There are some pros. The place is within walking distance to shopping, the L and dining. The neighborhood is *relatively* safe, but be mindful of the… pharmaceutical sales under the bridge by the L.
While we appreciated the low price, I don’t think we will return.
This stay was a beautiful and quiet place to rest our heads after being out in the city all day. It’s also located in a very nice neighborhood. The host was very responsive and kind.

Great home for a Chicago weekend! Pleasant neighborhood that was easily accessible. Close to some great restaurants and shops. Close enough to the city to enjoy but far enough away for a peaceful stay.
Had a great experience here! Lovely home in a nice area. Would highly recommend!
Great place to stay not too far from downtown but far enough away.
Great stay thanks Evan
Would totally stay again!

I am disatisfied with the booking since the master bath shower was out of order and there was a sign indicating this on the shower, but the owners did NOT indicate the issue with shower in the booking.
I asked Robert for a refund of some of my bookng cost and Robert refused. I am not a happy guest and feel that there should be some compensation for the lack of a working shower in the master bath. Yes, I was able to use another shower in another bathroom, but it was NOT the luxurious and glamorous space that is advertised.

Charming little spot in a great location for a visit to Wrigley. I put up my father at the Taj Ma Small for a birthday/Cubs weekend. He is 86 years old, not a city dweller, and has rather limited mobility (cane/walker). This garden level unit had only three steps down --a MUCH better option than most of the walk-up rentals in the area. Also being ~1100 feet from the ballpark meant that we could walk the distance together and we didn't have to deal with handicap parking, shuttles, and other such truck.
The place has great decor/design. Very comfortable! My Dad loved it, it was the perfect bachelor pad for the older gentleman and I felt safe leaving him on his own in the neighborhood.
It's pricier than I usually pay, but worth it for our special needs and the special occasion. Location, location, location!

As advertised except regarding parking - (previous) listing stated "parking on premises" plus "street parking." There is NO parking on the premises, didn't find this out until I received check-in instructions and had a conversation with the host. To their credit, the listing was updated following our exchange. Also regarding parking, the check-in exchange also included instructions to "park further down the street, away from the house as far as possible" and also to park "not in front of the house" because the neighbors do not like them running a AirBnB. This was quite unnerving, not knowing the history or what all to worry about as a result.
Great location and the host is very communicative
Good location!
The stay was very nice. Parking was very easy at the location.
We had a great time at Steve's place and the location was perfect to enjoy a beautiful weekend in a great city!
Wendy’s place was clean, safe and well kept. The bed was comfortable and the shower was amazing. Would definitely stay there again!

We enjoyed our recent stay at the house! It being an upstairs unit was a big plus. The street it’s on is pretty quiet and it’s right on a bus line as well. The nearest L stop is about a 20 min walk and there’s a Metra line to the West as well.
I would say 6 people is probably the max that can sleep here comfortably, mainly because there is one restroom. We brought one air mattress and there was also one graciously provided in the unit. We had one guest in each of the 3 bedrooms, one on the couch, and two on air mattresses.
Kitchen was nice. There were also waters in the fridge which we really appreciated.
Had a very comfortable stay here. Accommodations were nice and clean, and I liked how it was within walking distance to public transportation.

I had a wonderful experience staying here! The host was incredibly welcoming, personable, and easy to communicate with. He gave great recommendations and made me feel comfortable from the moment I booked!. He was also very responsive and accommodating throughout my stay. I truly appreciated his hospitality and would definitely recommend staying here! Would def come back again!

Incredible location, exactly what my friend and I needed for a weekend trip to Chicago. Close to pink/green line trains, and many SpotHero spots nearby if you have a car. Really easy walk into the Loop or to the Lake, with a TON of awesome places to eat nearby as well, from fancy to hole in the wall to bodega. Apartment having laundry was also extremely convenient for a warm and muggy weekend (no detergent provided though).
Good location and nice place
Great apartment with everything you need for a good price. Serg was helpful and always available.

We enjoyed our stay. It was nice to be able to walk to Wrigley from here. And the train station was close. Fun to have the arcade machines for any down time.
Note: We tried entering from the back door on arrival but you have to go around to the front. Park in the garage and then walk around to the front of the house.

We stayed here as a family with young children. Everything we needed was close by and the kids loved the pool! Pictures matched the unit and the host was responsive to a question we had. Chicago downtown is pricey but we felt this was a better value than a hotel to get the space, kitchen, and two bathrooms. One elevator is out right now- anticipated to be fixed by the end of the month- which slowed us down on a weekday morning but otherwise wasn't an issue. We just knew to allow extra time to leave. The host did communicate this after we asked based on other recent reviews. Unit has great views and was well-appointed.

An awesome deal in the Chicago area. Just a few minutes from the train station by foot and close to all the bus lines you could need. The home was spotless and the beds were comfy after a long day. For much less than many other options in the city we thought it was an awesome value and would stay again in a heart beat
Great place to stay!
Veronica was very accommodating and the place was perfect. Great neighborhood with ample parking.
It was great for our chill Ladies group, would stay there agin!

Cathern and her husband were so kind and pleasant. They really made me feel at home! The house is beautiful and in a great part of Chicago. Also really appreciated having available water bottles and coffee in the room!
When I go back to Chicago hopefully this place is available. I would absolutely go back. Highly recommend
Great area located near the L-line for easy access to downtown. Host was very response. We had a wonderful stay!
It was a great location and a great place to stay!
Es un lugar súper cerca a unos metros de la línea rosa que lleva directo al loop. Hay 4 opciones para comer muy buenas, el Costco también está muy cerca para llenar de provisiones iniciales.
Great place to stay host was great!
Directly by the Red line! Perfect little studio for a quick weekend in Chicago! What you see is what you get! A perfect stay to get out and enjoy the city.

We shared the house with three other couples.  Very spacious and we had everything we needed to enjoy most of our meals there.  Easy to get around Chicago from this location whether driving or using public transportation.  We introduced two of the couples to the Chicago El trains as we took blue line to downtown and then red line to Wrigley Field.  Saw an historic game as Joshua Baez became first person to hit a home run in first three times at bat in the majors.  5 of the 6 of us were thrilled.  Cubs fan not so much.
I had a great weekend trip & Kyriako was an excellent host!
Nice and comfortable place to stay
Great location to explore Chicago.
Easy to find and clean. Hosts were responsive to any questions we had.
An all-round excellent experience.

Good place to stay for the night. This is someone's apartment that they are currently living in so keep that in mind. If you're visiting the city and will be out of the apartment most of the time it's a good spot
Tom’s place is amazing! Super close to dining, a beautiful park, and shopping. Tom is a great communicator and offered early check in and late check out! Great stay.

We really enjoyed staying at Judy's. She was very friendly and attentive. Her home and neighborhood was absolutely beautiful. Her flowers in her garden smelled so good walking in. We had plenty of towels available and her home was super clean. Would highly recommend!
Great space with everything you would need and very clean. Close to a lot of things to do. Great communication throughout stay.
Great stay very clean and comfortable

Overall, you get what you pay for. The room is very simple, and I think having a little more storage space would make the stay more comfortable. I booked the two-bedroom option, and the door connecting the two rooms was difficult to open and close. The windows are paper thin, so you can hear everything happening outside. I also had the blue fuzzy blanket on my bed, which shed quite a bit and left fuzz all over my clothes. Lastly, the bathroom could use a more thorough, deep cleaning. Overall, it was an okay stay for the price, but there are a few areas that could be improved.

Would not recommend at all. When I arrived, there was a man in my room. I killed two roaches my first day. The smell is so bad that I couldn’t even stay my second day. The entire place needs a full thorough cleaning. It was absolutely disgusting.

El alojamiento estaba limpio y organizado. Está en un tercer nivel con escaleras. Las camas son cómodas, la cocina está bien dotada. Tiene una terraza agradable, nosotros hicimos un asado. Tiene una estación de metro a 12 minutos caminando.  Si llevas carro es importante pedir el permiso para poder estacionar en la calle. De resto muy agradable y recomendable.
It was alright overall
Excelente hospedaje
Clean, perfect location for our visit and a good value
Really helpful and quick at replying to questions. Good size, light and airy. Incredibly comfortable bed in main bedroom. Would stay again next time we visit Chicago.

Very nice location, walkable to restaurants, coffee shops, wrigley, shopping!  Beautiful house with plenty of room for the 7 of us with 3 full bathrooms!  Alan always responded to any questions quickly and was very flexible with requests.
Would stay again! Great space for 3 couples!

Super cute, small one bedroom perfect for a single person or a couple looking for a base in Roscoe Village or thereabouts. Responsive, kind hosts, nice neighborhood, not accessible for anyone who can't do stairs but otherwise it's a great find if you want to be away from downtown while in Chicago.

We had a great stay! The place was very clean and comfortable, and the beds were especially comfy. The space really fits three people comfortably and had everything we needed for our stay. Overall, a nice, clean, and comfortable Airbnb that we would recommend!
My stay here was great, very walkable and beautiful surrounding area. Tim was great and very helpful!

I go to Chicago often and this was the best stay that I've had.  Khong was a great host, and I will absolutely look for his property for my next stay.  Also, Khong communicated with me very well and even provided locations for nearby breakfast and dinner.  Enjoyable stay.
Great place for a group!

We were happy with our stay. It was described well and communication was excellent.
There were a couple of problems (relatively minor)
1. Mold in the bathroom
2. The quality of the towels was bad.
3. The last step going down to the garden apartment blends in to the concrete after going down the wooden steps. One of our party fell the first night and has some nasty scrapes. I would recommend painting it yellow so it stands out to avoid lawsuits.
4. No throw blankets for the sofa.
Overall, it met our needs for a good price in a good location for us.
We had a great stay. Big house was great for 10 people. Thanks, Hector

L’appartement est bien situé dans un quartier calme avec une station de vélo à proximité et des transports à 15 minimum à pied
Appartement lumineux propre et très bien équipé
Un vrai souci avec les lits : à chaque mouvement les ressorts métalliques font un bruit insupportable - Literie à revoir
Communication difficile avec l’hôte - réponses générées par une IA donc questions posées plusieurs fois incompréhension des demandes et surtout aucune souplesse sur l’arrivée et le départ : à chaque fois la réponse c’est 50 dollars par heure .. question sens du service il faudra repasser !

I'm not sure why previous reviews mentioned the temperature. I went during a hot weekend and we felt perfectly cool inside. The location was nice just a 30 minute walk to the West Loop and the parking space was nice
The size was good.

Terrific apartment right next to Logan Square. Super close / easy access to blue line - 1/2 hr to Ohare on train.
Apt is clean and well appointed. There are some stairs to get to it. Three comfortable bedrooms w luggage racks, closet space and hangers.
Location can’t be beat. Quiet location but oh-so-walkable to the best of Logan Square around the corner. Garage parking a huge bonus!
Would definitely stay here again.

A gorgeous space and beautiful neighborhood. Quiet neighborhood for those of us who aren't necessarily looking for a busy nightlife. Sarah is an excellent host and thought of all the little details to make us feel at home. I hope to have the opportunity to stay with her again someday.

I don’t use Airbnb often, but my kids do—and all 10 of us were blown away by the quality of this home and the extraordinary care our host showed us. The house was even better than we expected. It is spacious, comfortable, beautifully designed, and filled with interesting rooms and thoughtful details that everyone loved exploring. Even with 10 people, no one felt crowded, and there were plenty of inviting indoor and outdoor spaces where we could gather or find a little privacy. The kitchen was beautiful, the multiple patios were wonderful, and the home had so much creative personality. What truly made the stay exceptional, though, was our host. Every detail seemed to have been anticipated, including several unexpected touches that made our arrival and entire weekend easier and more enjoyable. When one person needed a fan to sleep more comfortably, our host brought one over. Then, when my daughter called to ask if they might have a Cubs shirt they offered to bring her one! Unbelievable
Great place to stay! Angelica was super responsive, good location near the metro and bus. Great AC
Great stay, wonderful location!
Location was great and the host was very communicative and friendly.  Would stay there again.

Very beautiful home the rooms were gorgeous and comfortable beds. The bathrooms nice and clean with a gorgeous bathtub. Kitchen had everything need to cook ,make tea,and coffee. Would coke back and recommend
Good Stay
Great spot. Very responsive. Everything you’re looking for in an Airbnb and host. Would stay again
Great location and easy access to restaurants and public transportation.
Had a great stay! Perfect neighborhood near a lot of great bars and restaurants! Drew was very responsive and helpful with check in and check out. Would definitely stay again!
Recommended

Timothy was very responsive and his instructions were very helpful and spot on. This location was PERFECT for a small group attending a few Cubs games for the weekend! Condo had everything we needed and could’ve wanted. The garage parking was a little tight with there already being 2 other cars parked in the garage. I had to climb through the back of the car to get in/out of the car. There were a lot of steps up to the 3rd floor condo but this was communicated ahead of time, and both the stairs and garage situation were out of Timothy’s control. We would absolutely stay here again when in town for some Cubs games!
Everything was great. Good location. James gave excellent instructions and pictures of where and how to enter. We had a great stay.
Un lugar hermoso 💚 para descansar,callado ,limpio y los anfitriones siempre al pendiente cuando tenía dudas
Marks place was a perfect stay for a short walk to Wrigley field. He was quick to reply and his home was lovely. Would stay again!

El departamento esta super bien ubicado, cerca de restaurantes y tiendas y del lago. La cama es cómoda y no escuchas ruido en las noches. Tiene varios puntos que mejorar como los siguientes:
- le falta mejorar la iluminación, esta muy obscuro.
- no tiene suficientes cubiertos de cocina, solo había como 3 cucharas y 3 tenedores y no habia cuchillos. Eso estaba complicado.
- solo 3 almohadas y están duras e incomodas.
- las toallas de baño muy delgaditas y como que viejas y solo 3.
Creo que pudieran mejoras esos aspectos y estaría mucho mejor.

Great apartment in a very cool neighborhood. This was a perfect setup for our annual baseball trip as it was very easy to walk, bike, or Uber to the ballpark and surrounding restaurants. David was also super responsive and happy to help whenever we had questions. Definitely a great find if you’re visiting!

We had an incredible weekend at Courtney and Garrett’s place. The location is unbeatable in the heart of Wrigleyville and the house was clean with a nice layout and inviting feel to it. Highly recommend.

Thankful for such a nice place that accommodated so many guests! Eahc person had a comfortable sleep, the washrooms were clean and the kitchens provided many amenities.  We were able to have a smooth check-in and check-out , shout out to such a responsive and understanding host! The dedicated parking spot was such a relief and it is secluded at the back so we felt our rental car was safe. Easy access to metro and driving into major city areas. Would definitely save for future large group trips to Chicago!

This place offered more than I expected to find in Chicago! The close proximity to wrigley made it an easy and fun walk to and from a cubs game, the neighborhood itself was safe with plenty of food, bars, and other attractions to offer like a catfe! This place gave us our small town feel being a bit off the street with the beautiful outside area while being seconds from the fun Chicago has to offer! The bed was super comfy, good breakfast cereal options and a waffle maker! Beautiful decor, furniture that is kept nice and clean.

Great place - the apartment was beautiful, clean, as advertised plus a little more. Really thoughtfully and usefully designed. Location was quiet and peaceful and really close to the train, to Pilsen and within good range of a ton of other great spots in Chicago. The communication was great and everything was made easy and accessible.
If you're looking for hotel-level comfortability from the bed, it wasn't quite that - might've bothered us for a longer stay, but was fine and not enough to deter from 5 stars across the board. Would happily stay again!
Its was walkable,  it takes about 30 minutes to get to the Obama Presidental center.  I wish I had rented a car. But we made due between the bues, train and lyft.  I truly enjoyed my stay in Chicago
We enjoyed our stay.
Mia’s home was great! She’s incredibly responsive and willing to make the stay as best as possible!

An amazing spot for a large group! The location was perfect central to everything with great walkability to any necessities. Having a bathroom for each room was perfect for our group. Highly recommended!
A good deal for what we paid. A little farther from Chinatown’s main stretch than anticipated because buses were unreliable. Overall, would book again
Great location
Quiet place! Clean and cozy

Honestly, the property was beautiful. It was a bit confusing at first because the lock to get into the house is odd if you’ve never used it before but after Leroy helped us, we were smooth sailing. This airbnb was clean and offered many amenities. Clean towels, dish-wares, a big tv in the living room and one/both of the bedrooms. I read some of the other reviews talking about the lack of central air conditioning but honestly it wasn’t as bad as it seemed. There are two big window ac units in the lounge/living room and a fan in one of the rooms. Maybe if another fan was added to the other room that could improve it but it seriously was fine. I stayed with three people, and this is what one of them had to say: “Bed was okay, couch was good, i enjoyed our stay!”
Mykia was so kind and answered very fast, really good communication and the house was so near to the metro station

Place was great and very comfortable! Lots of amenities such as pillows, blankets, parking and toiletries. Next to the train, which was very convenient. Basement area was a great little place to hang.
Hosts were super helpful, looks as listed
Wonderful Airbnb. Cozy bed and pillows. It was spotless. Hosts very responsive.
This was a very nice Airbnb! Lots of space for a large group and very neatly organized and clean.
We had a wonderful stay at Laura’s place! It was a short distance to good food and activities, and we had everything we needed inside the home.

Great place in proximity to many amenities and site seeing opportunities; most of them within walking distance or a short Uber.  Although it wasn’t an issue for us, the apartment is right next to the L (above ground transit railway), so if you’re a light sleeper, this may not be a good fit for you.

The unit was exactly as described. When we had an issue the host was responsive. It is in a convenient location. When we arrived we did almost walk into the upstairs neighbor’s unit but that was due to our misunderstanding. The unit is the bottom garden floor unit.

The location was great and very convenient, and overall we had a very good stay. Everything else was comfortable and as expected.
Parking was the only minor inconvenience. The available parking is on the next street, in front of a high school, less than a 2-minute walk from the property. On the evening we arrived, there happened to be an event at the school, so parking was quite full and we had to wait until the event ended for a spot to become available. However, there was no event the next day and parking was completely fine, so this seems to have just been a timing issue.
Overall, a great location and a very pleasant stay!
This home worked very well for our group! We especially enjoyed the private backyard space
We had the most amazing time here! SUCH a great location and felt very safe in the apartment building - very close to grocery, local restaurants and subway!

We loved this apartment! It was beautifully decorated, and it was so nice to have a bathroom for each bedroom. It was also so convenient to the bars, restaurants, and shops on Clark Street. It was a great neighborhood to stay in and explore beyond downtown Chicago. We will definitely come back!
Very nice place. Many accommodations inside. Bed was very comfy! Large tv in living room and was able to roll round which I thought was very cool. Would definitely stay again.

The location was absolutely perfect and I felt safe throughout my entire stay. I loved how conveniently the hotel was located near so many of Chicago’s top attractions. Navy Pier, The Bean, Millennium Park, and the Riverwalk were all just minutes away by walking, which made exploring the city so easy and enjoyable.
The hotel itself was clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully set up. Being able to walk to so many attractions, restaurants, and things to do made my trip even better. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago, especially if you want a convenient location where you can easily explore downtown on foot!

We were grateful for our stay at Phill’s. The home was very clean, exactly as described, and we appreciated the thoughtful touches like stocked coffee and bottled water. We used the two beds in the back portion of the house, and both were comfortable.
A couple of things are worth noting for future guests. I misunderstood the layout when booking and thought access to the second floor was completely external, but the spaces actually share the interior of the home.
Our biggest issue was that we did not have access to the AC controls. One night the temperature made sleeping very uncomfortable, and it was difficult not being able to adjust it ourselves.
Also, for groups larger than two, the common area is fairly limited. There is no couch or other relaxed seating, just two chairs in the living area, so there isn’t really a comfortable space for a larger group to sit together.
The hosts are fantastic - the place is kept very clean and they are willing to help out with any needs. The location is also convenient and being close to the lake is a nice bonus.
Pristine privacy, thank you!

We had a great stay at Sebastian’s place near Lincoln Park! Check-in was easy and straightforward, and the place was great. Plenty of street parking nearby and the neighborhood itself is very quiet. Lots of restaurants, shops, and entertainment within walking distance. We’d definitely stay again!

Enjoyed my time in Chicago using this Airbnb as my base. Liked being away from the noise of downtown. Trains easily accessible but did not use this visit. Some street noise audible (sirens/subway) but can't be helped. Place is immaculate, well cared for, and clean. Obvious Brian takes pride in maintaining high standards and enjoys deploying technology (automated home system and multiple TV/gaming system, excellent Wifi). Did not use kitchen much but has just about every gadget you could need (including a Ninja slushi). Very responsive to issues that developed during our stay and both items resolved quickly with minimal fuss. Within walking distance of Obama Center/Univ of Chicago and I suspect this area will see a lot foot traffic as the years go by.

We had a good stay overall and the house was a good fit for what we needed. The neighborhood was cool, with some good restaurants nearby, and it was easy to walk to restaurants and bus stops. The house was mostly clean and comfortable.
We appreciated the little touches, like a few condiments in the fridge and shampoo in the bathrooms. We didn’t personally use them, but it was nice to have those things available for guests who might need them.
Parking was a little difficult, but we were able to figure it out by reading through previous guests’ reviews, which was very helpful.
Overall, it was a good stay and worked well for our needs.
Great Location but, was dirty.
Quiet neighborhood and good location right off the interstate. Was close to many good spots.
Comfortable space in a fantastic location. Host was a great, proactive communicator. Will definitely stay again!
We had a great stay in Chicago. The space was perfect, very clean,  & had ever needed. Convenient location. We’d definitely stay here again!
Will was a great host and very responsive!
Right on the lake and easy walk to the train.
Wonderful place but no coffee pot and no tissues. Other than that it was great!
Great stay! Close to the metro and bus. Roseanne was super quick and friendly in her responses :)
Gabriel’s place was perfect for our weekend in Chicago. Highly recommend!

The stay was great, the only flaw was that parking was extra and that when we showed up the dining room table was missing a leg. That was communicated and fixed within the day. But then the next day table collapsed on us while eating breakfast, that was also communicated and they said it would be fixed again but no one ever showed up to fix the table. Outside of that it was good.

My friends and I stayed at Aly’s Airbnb for my bachelor party. The home was a perfect fit for us - plenty of comfortable beds, very clean and close to our planned destinations. Overall, a great part of a great weekend! Thank you Aly!

Had a great stay! Great central location for anything downtown, walkable to grocery stores, shopping, restaurants. Clean and comfortable space. Traveled with kids and the pack and play and high chair were really nice to have onsite. Would recommend to anyone!

My stay here was delightful! The host was SUPER responsive and helpful with anything I needed. The area was awesome. It's a block from a great bar and restaurant that has half priced appetizers after 9pm. It's SO GOOD! Get the nachos!
This place was also one block from the Brown line, which is essential for commuting around the city. Loved it!

We had a great stay in Chicago for a guy's trip. The location was perfect, situated right between downtown Chicago and Wrigley Field, making it easy to explore the city and catch a game. The North/Clybourn train station was within walking distance, and it was only a short ride to Wrigley. There were also a lot of different shops and food spots right around the Airbnb as well.
