Ben was an excellent host who responded very quickly whenever we had questions. The building felt very safe, with a security guard stationed at the front desk. The apartment was exactly as described in the listing, and the rooms were spacious and comfortably accommodated our group.
Overall, I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago, especially for larger groups looking for a convenient location and a responsive host.

Located in a quiet neighborhood with great local restaurants to eat.  Beautiful inside and great backyard with landscaping.  They were very responsive to our needs and have great feedback on local restaurants. Thank you both.
Justin's place was clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location.  He was easy to communicate with and very accommodating.  Highly recommend and would stay here again!
Spacious and clean apartment with a responsive host.
Very nice.
I can’t say enough good things about this place. Centrally located, walkable, beautiful…my family and I will be back again.

Mera’s place was very cozy and really nice to stay in. Everything was clean and well organized. There are modern features such as push draws and nice amenities. There was a nice-sized closet and an overall perfect stay for 2-3 people. The location was really good, not far from downtown Chicago. The only thing I would say was parking was a bit challenging, but I expected that. Other than that, everything went smoothly. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone!

We had a great stay here! Looks as advertised, bedrooms are a little cramped but totally suitable just for sleeping. Nice spacious living area, kitchen, bathroom. Roberto was communicative & instructions were clear. Good location with nearby restaurants. Only slight complaint was there was no bath products in the shower (soap, shampoo, etc.). But other than that we would recommend!

Great place to stay and it fit
all my friends and I comfortably. Very close to downtown , stores gas stations and food . Every room was spacious,clean and slept great! Parking was convenient and easy getting in and out of the building. Great Stay and can’t wait to come back
Lovely apartment.  Well furnished. Nice amenities - Keurig coffee pods and creamer, snacks, bathroom amenities. Very well don.
Good place to stay, was worried neighborhood was a rough area but we have no issues and never felt unsafe.

Everything within Amy's control was amazing. It is a beautiful apartment that is obviously extremely well managed, in a terrific location and Amy was a great communicator. However, sleep is a huge thing for me. Despite sleeping with noise cancelling earbuds playing white noise (my normal custom--not something I did only during this stay) I was awakened at 5:30am on one of the days by the footsteps of children in the apartment above. It was like a drum beat.  Perhaps it would be fine for deep sleepers.  Perhaps the neighbors left town the other day of our stay because it did not happen the second day and we heard no activity up there.  I hate to mark down for something that is outside of the owner's control, but I think it would be good to go in to new bookings with one's eyes open (no pun intended!)

This was a very nice, comfortable apartment in a great location. T A I M S was very helpful and quick in response to questions. Was able to help me and my family drop our bags before check-in, which made our first day much easier. Would definitely recommend!
Beautiful place, very friendly staff, private place very well kept apartment everything was walking distance 10/10 recommend

This location is awesome and for a 3 bedroom, priced very well.
I was concerned about the noise because of this location, and surprisingly it was very quiet.
I plan on booking this place in the future.
This spot is in a really great location, it’s very walkable and convenient. Brett was an accommodating host.

Brett’s place was just as described and more. We are pretty new to staying at Air B&B - always worried about cleanliness- but his home was spotless! TV’s in every bedroom, a desktop computer, well equipped kitchen including some staples like cooking spray, coffee, tea, sweetener, creamer. The highlight of my kids’ stay was the bidet LOL. We loved having the garage and it fit our Honda Pilot with Brett’s SUV perfectly! He was also able to accommodate a late checkout as the home was not booked on our departure day which we greatly appreciated. We will definitely return to this lovely home!

Overall the place was clean and we had everything we needed (towels, kitchenware, etc.). My only issue is that there is a pretty bad smell throughout the unit that made the stay extremely uncomfortable for me and my family. Please get this addressed.
The neighborhood was decent. Most of my people in the city vouched for it being safe and I'm in agreement after the stay. We did not have any issues and it was a quiet block.

Just as described, and just was flexible and super communicative. I never had to ask for a thing as he gives you everything you need to know in a timely fashion. Beautiful home, lovely common areas. Solid walls kept noise from other guests down while in the room.

The space was accurate to the posted picture description.
There were ample towels, bedding, even water in the fridge and a luggage rack
It was unusual warm in the space and host indicated that they were working on getting an AC for the space.

We originally were staying in another AirBB.  Upon check in, it was filthy so we needed to find a replacement ASAP.  We requested to reserve this location and Veronika responded immediately.  Could not have been happier with the unit and the location.  The unit has excellent amenities.  I highly recommend this AirBB and Veronika.
We had a great stay. Very comfortable and clean. Slept great. Very walkable area. Would definitely stay here again.

We loved staying here! Everything was very clean and the host sent plenty of information. No crazy check out requirements. The only small issue we had was with the app used to unlock the door - it was not super convenient to use and I wasn’t eager to download another app that would track me. But it didn’t give us any major issues during our stay
Thomas was wonderful to work with and VERY accommodating!  Thanks for a wonderful family weekend!
It was great. Instructions were easy to understand and the place was very clean. The pictures were exactly what it looked liked in person. I am very pleased.
Nice place for a visit very clean and up to date. The complimentary popcorn was so good! The area was nice I felt at home friendly neighbors.
This was such a great location. Short walk to the Roosevelt station. Gorgeous views of the city. Parking garage was very convenient. Place was spacious and clean

Joan was extremely responsive and kind. A great host to work with! The Airbnb itself was so fun and unique. It was huge both inside and outside with a great yard we used to play games. For how big the place was, I was very impressed with how clean it was. Our group of 12 girls really enjoyed staying here and would recommend to anyone!
Jason’s place was amazing! It was honestly bigger than I was anticipating which was great. Loved having the deck. The space was perfect for our girls weekend!
Very cute place and an amazing value for the nightly rate and number of guests you can comfortably fit
Great location and very cool place!

This home was a perfect spot to visit our son in Chicago.  It is extremely clean and had everything that we could need or want.  It was within close walking distance to our son’s place and restaurants.  The bed and pillows were very comfortable and we are very picky about our bed and the living space was very generous. All communication with Andrei was very quick and helpful.  We will stay here again if ever in the area.
Very clean and convenient spot. Bus stop to connect quickly to the blue line is at the same building. Hosts are responsive and helpful. Hassle free checkout. I would stay again for sure.
Perfect location for our Cubs game weekend!  Great neighborhood!

Had a great stay with some of my friends. Overall, the place was clean and there was soap in the bathroom. There's parking available behind the building, which I didn't see but that's on me. Really nice kitchen too. Will stay again in the future.
Great stay, Mera was super responsive!

Super livable place in great location!  The three bedrooms were perfect for our family coming for DePaul Orientation. 20 minute walking distance to DePaul, super close to tons of restaurants and grocery stores and 20 minutes to Wrigley, not to mention a 15 minute walk to Lincoln Park. Heather was very responsive and helpful. Would highly recommend!
Great place in a great location.
It was great stay for our bachelorette group of 6! The Airbnb was very clean and spacious with all the amenities we needed. Thank you to our gracious hosts!

If you want to be in the heart of Wicker Park/Bucktown, this is it! Great loft style apartment for our two couples who used to live in Chicago and were making a trip back. The beds were comfortable, the kitchen has everything you need, easy access in and out of the building. Conveniently located next to the blue line - which is very loud, but to be expected. They have everything you need for sleeping, sound machines and ear plugs, etc. The place has huge windows but great shades. We loved it! Everything we needed!

Megan was extremely proactive in providing nearby recommendations- we went to her breakfast recommendation two days in a row!
The stay was perfect for us and our pets - located in a walkable residential area we found everything we needed nearby.
The apartment was clean and fit 4 of us comfortably- we enjoyed the evenings together playing games in the living room, watching movies, and sitting out to enjoy the summer weather on comfortable balcony.
I would highly recommend this stay to anyone trying to get a feel for the locals side of the city.
Lovely place great restaurant downstairs and neat OPC
We had a great stay here! The Airbnb was exactly as pictured and very easy to get into. Would recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!

We absolutely loved our stay at this beautiful Chicago home! The location was fantastic—just minutes from Lake Shore Drive and conveniently close to Chicago’s amazing museums and attractions. Getting around the city was incredibly easy.
The home is beautifully decorated, thoughtfully designed, and incredibly comfortable. The amenities were excellent, and everything we needed was provided. And the beds deserve a special mention—they were AMAZING! We had an exceptionally restful night’s sleep, which made our stay even better.
We also loved the fully fenced-in yard, which was a huge bonus for traveling with pets. It gave them a safe and convenient place to enjoy some time outside.
Overall, this was an outstanding Airbnb experience. Beautiful home, perfect location, excellent amenities, incredibly comfortable beds, and a wonderful pet-friendly yard. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

Perfect location right next to the “L” for easy transportation. The host was friendly and responsive to any questions we had. There was a bit of music at night with it being above the bar - but it was nowhere near loud enough to keep us up. Kitchen/bathroom was a stocked with everything we needed. Would stay here again!
Great location with lots to do within walking distance! Highly recommend for anyone looking to stay in the area!

Emily’s space was very clean and cozy! Loved the local recommendations they left for us. She was very quick to respond if we had any questions. House is easy to find and we had no problem finding parking out front of the house. It is a short walk to the train that takes you directly to union station downtown Chicago. Very easy to navigate! Thanks again for a great stay
House was very clean and had plenty of spaces to socialize and hang out. Our group of 12 was all able to find places to sleep, whether that was on beds or couches. Outdoor space was nice.

Great location in the city. Safety and pet friendly was important for our family and Inez was very helpful and answered all my questions. We would 100% refer this property and host. Thank you for a great weekend.

This is an awesome place to stay in old town. The beds are very comfortable and Robert is a fantastic host. Extremely responsive and helpful. I had to work one of the days I was there and had no problem working from the kitchen table, it was a nice space and certainly worth the price. Thanks Robert.
Kelly was great! We thought that the refrigerator was out one evening and she responded immediately and said that she would have a new one on the way! We loved her place

Check-in was easy and the place was clean and comfortable. All of the drawers and cabinets in the kitchen were labeled which was super helpful. Plus there was a coffee maker AND a Nespresso machine. All of the check-in and check-out instructions were very clear. There is a great coffee shop across the street (Bridgeport Coffee) if you want even more coffee or a sandwich. There is also a grocery store, Cermak, within walking distance that has everything else you might need. Overall a great weekend!
Great easy stay!
Beautiful apartment in a fantastic walkable neighborhood. Super close to the blue line which made it easy to get downtown and by the lake.

this was our second stay at the Coach House! we are visiting a Chicago family member in Ravenswood and this is a comfortable spot that is walkable to her home as well as the trendy and fun Lincoln Square
This place was perfect for the 6 of us.  Target is just up the block for groceries. Easy access to all of Chicago
Our group really enjoyed staying here!
You have one of the best places in the Airbnb world

The house was beautiful and perfect for our big group. There were plenty of thoughtful details and supplies. But what stood out the most was Vince's responsiveness - he went above and beyond in responding to a question that I had and I truly appreciated how thoughtful he was and how quickly he responded.
We had a great time at Lydia's place. The place was a stones throw away from the local L train station, the neighbourhood was quiet and the house itself was easy to access

Anna was a wonderful host, very responsive and helped with any questions or concerns we had when booking. The unit itself was very clean, well decorated and organized. Everything had clear directions on what was expected and there were extra amenities like a blow dryer and straightener in the bathroom among other extras. The area is quiet and walkable, public transport is readily available and close by. Not a far drive from downtown Chicago by bus or car. I will always look for if Anna is available for any stay in the area and would recommend her anytime :)
We loved staying at Keith’s place with our two goldendoodles. The location and easily accessible street parking were the highlights!
Fantastic spot with a great host! We'll be staying here every trip to Chicago.
Great apartment, roomy and clean. The location was fantastic, and it is right next to Damen train stop- very easy to get around Chicago.
Great communication. Great flexibility. Clean house.
Good place, very helpful host, but the areas does not feel safe, need to take a taxi around.
Good location not far from coffee shops and train station. Parking is included, which was helpful. Comfortable beds.
We had a great time. Convienent location
We had a great stay in Chicago. The accommodations were perfect and the host was warm and responsive. We'd stay here again.

Great area and amazing views, good setup for a group!
Walking distance to the lake, tons of restaurants, Lincoln Park & more.
Great stay, location was perfect for a Cubs game and for hanging out.
Such a great neighborhood! The house is safe and secure
Very nice room and very clean. The host was very very nice and all instructions were clear and easy. Def would go again.
Great place and hosts.
This space is so cute! Exactly as described and super cozy. Easy check in and the host was very responsive.
It was a wonderful stay.would love to visit again
Really cute spot for a girls’ trip. Great views and pool and hot tub.

Tim’s place is a beautiful home in a gorgeous neighborhood. It is a short walk to Wrigley Field and several excellent restaurants. We highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago and wanting to experience a great neighborhood!

Our stay at Maison Winona was perfect in every way! This was our second stay at the house, this time for an entire week after our weekend stay last year felt too rushed to fully enjoy the home and surrounding neighborhood! I'll defer to other reviewers to discuss how beautifully decorated and well appointed the unit is and focus instead on our cooking and dining experience. The kitchen is so well-equipped that I was able to fetch some groceries on the very first day and start cooking fairly elaborate meals immediately. In fact, we enjoyed almost all of our meals in either the elegant dining room or around the coffee table on the balcony! The knives are sharp, there are plenty of pots and pans, and there's an excellent international grocery store across the street. I've stayed at many AirBnB's around the world, and never have I encountered one that so perfectly afforded the thing that I love most of all: cooking and enjoying meals with family and friends.
Excellent Chicago rental that is very close to the L train pink line.
I recommend staying here. Good restaurants near by. Clean space. Worth the $$!
We felt right at home, the space was roomy and lovely, perfect location to walk all over Andersonville. Very communicative host, clear instructions, and great vibes all around. Highly recommend!
Nice place definitely would come again !
Great location if you’re looking to be in Wrigleyville. The Airbnb was perfect for the couple of nights. It was clean and had everything we needed.

It was legit the best location for downtown activities! If you are planning a visit to Wrigley field... there is no better option! It out did our expectations and was so neat talking and interacting with the other guests. Food, drinks & activities were just blocks away! Definitely recommend

I absolutely loved my stay in Chicago! Katty was incredibly kind, thoughtful, and responsive throughout our entire stay, making everything feel so easy and welcoming. I truly loved my time here and are so grateful for such a wonderful experience. I’d happily stay again!

The location was amazing and the building itself very nice.  The bathroom was clean.  If you are looking for a small quick little place to hang-out while enjoying Chicago and getting a sense of Lincoln Park, go for it.  For anything more than one person it is really tight.  Also, for short stays - awesome.  With no laundry facilities and limited kitchen facility, longer than a couple of days is tough.

We loved our stay in Roscoe Village. There were plenty of restaurants, coffee shops and walkable things to do. It was also easy to get downtown by train or bus. We were also able to walk to Wrigley Field, which was fun.
The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Aijana was very responsive when we checked in and made sure we had everything we needed for our stay. Would definitely stay here again!
Price and location were great. Host was very responsive. Only issue we had was we thought it was 1 unit but it was 2 units next to each other with 4 bedrooms in each unit instead of 8 all together.
Thanks for letting us stay! It was a fun weekend
Jennifer’s place was just what we needed for our stay in Chicago. It was affordable and close to our daughter’s place.

Jamaal was a very helpful host he recommended nearby bars and restaurants... dropped off some popcorn and cookies... whatever question i had he answered in a timely manner... I'm appreciative for him... the property is also centrally located so it only about 25 min or less to get most places
Great apartment, very clean and cozy. Sean was very communicative and helpful. Would stay there again.
The hosts were extremely communicative and appreciated how quickly they responded to questions. Will definitely be back.

We want to thank Simbarashe for welcoming us to this beautiful place. Our group had an amazing time, and we would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an apartment with ample space and a great location. The pool table and ping pong table were the highlights of this home.
It was quiet, clean, and comfortable. Thank you! We enjoyed our stay.

Wonderful accommodations. Neat, tidy and extremely comfortable. Perfect and walkable location for nearby attractions, restaurants, shopping, etc. Was even able to find street parking close to place during our stay. Jhon was highly communicative, responsive and helpful during our stay.  Would highly recommend and return on future trips to Chicago. Thanks for being a great host!!!

Lots of room to spread out and plenty of beds and bathrooms. We loved that each bedroom had its own bathroom. Tastefully decorated with lots of seating, the place is great for a large gathering of friends or family. Short walk to Fulton Market which has tons of dining and fun things to do. Great penthouse unit!

My partner and I stayed at Brad’s property for a mini-vacation. Apartment is in a great location within Hyde Park—it’s very walkable! Brad was a great host—proactive and communicative. My partner and I had no issues going through the booking, check in and check out process. The apartment worked well for our needs; we’d definitely recommend it to anyone that needs a place to stay for a few days that has easy access to shops. The only downside we experienced was the lack of a fan in the bathroom. Since there was no fan, our shower towels never dried completely; we ended up reusing them while damp.

Assel was lovely- very responsive when we had to reach out. Unfortunately on arrival the back door was unlocked. The oven did not work. There were no blinds or curtains on the main big window, so everyone could see in especially at night. Home is not decorated as seen in the photos. Very bare bones inside. Check in was easy and the parking spot was a huge plus.
Cozy room, quiet house

Brian's place looks like the pictures. It's in a nice neighborhood. The neighborhood has so much history I wanted to stay longer and explore. Brian was very helpful and allowed us to check-in early with no issues and his checkout was super easy.
The stay was amazing! The house was very clean nice and had everything we needed!! Wondering nice quiet backyard!! Jamie was very helpfully on things also

My husband and I had a wonderful stay.  The place is conveniently located to public transportation and there are several wonderful restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance.  Becky was very responsive and attentive, and gave us fantastic recommendations.  I would recommend the place if you are in the area!

Great stay. It was a busy weekend in Chicago with the Air Show and Cubs baseball. Lissette’s place is great. Clean, comfortable and close to El and bus stop. Parking was easy on the street. Apartment is better than the pictures and Lissette is a wonderful host. Responsive and helpful!
Me and my friends had a wonderful time!  Definitely one of my new go-to places when I visit Chicago.

Great stay! David was extremely responsive, attentive, and easy to communicate with throughout the entire stay. The place was comfortable, spacious, and perfect for our group. Would definitely stay again.
A beautiful cabin get away in the midst of Andersonville. We couldn’t have enjoyed it more.

Maria has been such a kind gracious host from the minute we sent the booking request! she responded quickly and kindly to our questions and went out of her way to accommodate our group! her home is BEAUTIFUL and very well decorated
we couldn’t have enjoyed our stay more! we especially loved the giant wooden dining table! thank you for everything! i would leave 6 stars if i could! 💐

We had a wonderful stay at Rasheed’s Gold Coast Pristine. He was very responsive when I messaged him and even willing to come to change a light fixture. The place was very clean and beautiful!  It’s easily walkable to many attractions and restaurants. Definitely recommend.
Had a great stay. Afsha was very communicative and helpful. Would recommend and would stay there again for my next Chicago visit.
Great stay with Vin.  He is extremely helpful and responsive.  Airbnb was clean and exactly matched the description.

Good location, easy access, responsive host.
But, hair clippings in the sink and shower, a shower that barely drained, and several times walking in to an unflushed toilet. Cleaning only happens between checkouts, so it sits like that while people are staying.
Walls are thin. We brought a noise machine and could still hear the other guests.
We spent most of the trip away from the place. Fine if you just need somewhere to sleep in a good spot, but worth knowing what shared means here before you book.
A clean, comfy place and quick and clear communication. Thanks for a great stay.

We stayed the weekend at Ryan’s place and it was great! The house itself was beautiful and had everything that we needed. The self check-in process was easy and smooth, and there was always street parking available. Would recommend!!

Clean, renovated apartment in a perfect location for UChicago visit. Everything you need, from groceries to restaurants, is within 1-2 miles, and it’s a walkable area if the weather is nice. Parking was never an issue, right in front of the building. It felt peaceful and safe. Easy drive to the lake and downtown. The host was super detailed with check-in instructions and quick to respond. Would absolutely come back.
it was small but that's fine cuz i spent most of my time outside anyway, close to the redline and right by a bus stop which made transportation very easy. good deal.

The location and views from this place are truly hard to beat. There are multiple balconies with amazing city views that were perfect for sitting outside, people watching, and just taking everything in. We happened to stay during the Air and Water Show and could actually watch the planes flying by from the house, which was such a cool bonus.
The space is also huge and comfortably accommodated our group without ever feeling crowded. There are plenty of areas for everyone to hang out together while still having room to spread out. The phone booth entrance is such a fun touch and definitely added to the experience.
We did have a few issues during our stay, and I really appreciated how Kevin handled everything. He personally reached out, listened to our concerns, and worked with us to make things right. That level of communication and accountability goes a long way.
Overall, an incredibly unique space in a fantastic location with some of the best views of the city and a host who genuine
Absolutely beautiful home in an amazing neighborhood! Thanks for everything!

Abigail is a very friendly and her space is so welcoming, clean and nice. We were able to
enjoy our stay in a beautiful neighborhood! Abigail was so kind to us, even offering her umbrella during the rain and let us know that we could get any recommendations from her or if we needed any help she reassured us that it was always available! Would stay again

Emily’s place was lovely! The kitchen was great, the first floor open plan was beautiful and the outside was quiet and relaxing. Emily was great and fast at communicating and also very very accommodating. My only notes are for some first time travelers. The street itself is very nice, however if you’re traveling alone, it might not be a great idea to be walking around late at night (which we weren’t and felt perfectly safe!) My only other info to share is that as in all beautiful old homes, the stairs and floors are really creaky. Again, not an issue for us, but just a heads up if you’re a light sleeper.
We had a great stay!
Laura was a great host and I felt very comfortable communicating with her. Place was clean and exactly as described. It was a comfortable stay.
Nice & comfy !
Sarah was very friendly and helpful with check in & check out. The house was beautiful and clean. The brewery next door was an awesome place to hang out. I would stay here again! Thank you
Great spot for a weekend stay! Host is very responsive and friendly.
Kayode was the perfect host. Communicative, yet respectful of space. Kayode helped us out with travel snafu early in our trip and we are grateful.
Their place was amazing, it was very cozy and we had a wonderful time. The host is very responsive. I would definitely stay here again.
Great deal for a peaceful room with a great bed. Nice location. Victor communicated very well and clearly. Would stay again!
We had a great stay here.
Good stay! Held my family and comfortable bedding. We ate out a lot so we didn’t use the kitchen. Definitely recommend for big families
Nice clean spaces

We had a very pleasant stay! The home was much more spacious than it appeared in the photos, and the location was very convenient—only about 15–20 minutes from downtown. The host was very responsive and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. The only downside was that the TV was only in the living room, as none of the bedrooms had a TV. Overall, though, the stay was comfortable and enjoyable, and we had a great experience.

Great spot. Super clean and had everything.
Easy walking to two different train lines and to Lincoln park
The free on street parking is a huge help. It was easy to find a spot and the guide was clear on where we could or could not park.
There are stairs but only one flight and easy
Place is quiet, clean and great for a visit!
The house was terrific! Very nice place to stay.
Had an amazing stay.

The place was very nice and clean. It looks just like the pictures. The only downsides were the lock on the front door was a pain to open. Also the maintenance guy showed up unannounced and let himself in while we were inside with no notice. But the house itself is very nice

Great little stay in Chicago for a group of 7! We enjoyed the location and cozy, yet simple vibe of the Good Ole Greystone. Everything was clean, working, and as described. I will say that cooking/kitchen equipment such as absence of oven mitts, drinking glassware, and dish towels, were not conducive for cooking for a larger group so just be prepared to bring those things if needed. Otherwise great!
This is a great spot for a group visit in Chicago! Adam was extremely communicative throughout the process and all was exactly what was shown

Richard and his host provided a beautiful  and pristine home. The vibe of the home is warm and the decorations and plants made you feel right at home. The bathrooms also have shampoo, conditioner, and body wash which is a nice addition.  Each of the bedrooms has its own vibe with beautiful decor and linens. We certainly want to book this property again when we return to Chicago!
Place was as described. Great neighborhood. Quick responding host.
We love this place! Perfect for a Cubs weekend! Location is awesome! Carlos and Laura are great with the communication and very flexible. We will definitely be back next year.

We enjoyed our time! The host was thoughtful and placed a pack and play and highchair out for our family. We did not request it during our reservation, but the host paid attention to the age of the guests and was proactively accommodating. The space was great!

I had a great experience at Karina’s place! Very spacious and clean. She was also super proactive and responsive about check-in and check-out. Absolutely worry-free experience and would stay here again!

We were 3 adults reuniting and stayed at Elliot and Deena's place for 9 nights. We loved it. The host was super responsive and accommodating. The place was spacious, super clean, in a quiet and safe neighborhood, with our own porch entry. There is a large kitchen, immaculate and loaded, host supplied coffee, plenty of clean towels and hot water, free parking, and a  beautiful backyard. The CTA Blue line is a few steps away and the host left us a generous giftcard which he enjoyed on our last day. We felt at home with everything needed around.  We recommend this place to anyone. Thank you Elliot and Deena for all your kindness and hospitality
We we're even given a bottle of champagne in the fridge to celebrate our bachelorette! Host was extremely responsive and helpful ❤️
David’s place was exactly as described. Easy to check-in, clean, and in a great walkable neighborhood. He was proactive with his communication and responsive to questions. Great stay!
Enjoyed staying at Milan’s place. It was clean and the host was very responsive and helpful. I’d enjoy staying again
Excellent
Excellent price for a place to stay in Chicago. Convenient location and comfortably accommodated our group of 5. Host was very responsive throughout the trip and everything worked as expected.

Great place for a peaceful romantic stay for 2. The bed is the most comfortable I’ve ever experienced, so much that I will be shopping for a new one when I get home. The kitchen had everything we needed. The decor is beautiful. My only critique is that I wish there were more towels (I needed a second one for my hair) but I loved it here and would recommend it to anyone
Great location. Only a 30 minute easy walk to Wrigley Field.
Great stay
Super easy check in and check out. Great location and would highly recommend Hubbard Holdings processes. Everything was very clear and they checked in when needed.
Perfect location. As described. Safe. Quiet.

We stayed as a couple at Brandon's, if you are looking for great value and a no frills simple stay with unique rooftop, this would be the spot for you. You can't beat it anywhere else in Chicago imo, the bus is right down the block and blue line train is very convenient to take to airport. It seems like he had upgraded the room too with a real bed which I thought was comfy, and the sofa couch was still there as well for resting spot. Good ventilation and temperature when we went during 70/80 degree summer weather, there was also a fan as well.
As a host Brandon was very responsive, flexible with helping us figure out bag storage, and we got to meet his cat (super chill kitty). Heads up the sliding door doesn't lock but that didn't bother us, we felt like we had privacy since it's on the top level. And for check in, it was an in person key handoff meetup process with option for lockbox if that helps other guests on what to expect.

All in all, the place was quite nice. Clean and spacious. Nicely decorated. Location is great.
Parking is tight, even with a dedicated spot. We were in an Explorer and getting parked took skill. Retrieving the key was a challenge as there is a van that parks right in front of the lockbox and we had to shimmy in sideways to get to it.
Had a great stay here! Kim is very easy to communicate with. Good area with lots to do. Very walkable area
No complaints!

Wonderful place! Quick response with communication!  Had an emergency situation and the management were extremely concerned and flexible when we had to check out late! Extremely pleased will definitely stay again!

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay in Chicago! My Dad and I stayed at Eric’s suite before. The place was comfortable, and everything was great for the most part. The only issues we experienced were that the air conditioning wasn’t working properly. Eric was very responsive and came out to check it out, which I really appreciated.
The day before we left, the Wi-Fi also stopped working. It was raining that day, so it’s possible the weather affected the service. Despite those minor issues, we still had a great stay and enjoyed our time in Chicago. Eric’s communication and responsiveness definitely made a difference. I would stay here again!

I would like to preface this by saying that it was a very raining weekend. The steps are very steep  leading from the garage to the back entrance. They are very slick with alge. The hands rails has splits and will give you splinters if not careful. The garage is a shared space with the downstairs tenet. He parks on the left. Look at the space between the ally road the warehouse wall as there are tree stumps hidden in the weeds. We didn't have street parking the first day of our arrival. The glass business across the street had taken several street spots for the apartment. If you can, use the front of the house it has better flight of stairs. The apartment is nicely decorated. The mattress are pillow tops. The pillows are squishy 😍.  There are some cosmetic aspects that need touch-up. The toliet is low so if you need a squatty potty this will work for you. The freezer sounds like a jet engine when running so be prepared for white noise you can hear it in the living room. Very clean.
Favorite place to stay in Chi! Clean, great location, close to the airport. Can’t wait to come back!

A nice little stay near Lincoln Square.  The house was near several restaurants, coffe shops, and and convenience stores.   It served as a nice location - clean and comfortable.   I will advise there are train tracks very close, but the noise inside the home wasn't overwhelming.
Clean place. Comfy beds. Noise from area and train was not as noticeable as others made it sound. Best part was the location. 12/10.
We had a great experience here! The location was great, apartment was clean and had everything we needed.
We had a wonderful weekend in Chicago! Ronda’s place was amazing and the beds were extremely comfortable! I also loved making our meals in her beautiful kitchen! We would definitely stay here again!
Great location!
Quiet neighborhood in the Windy City.  Very clean and comfortable.
Great host, great location, great space for large, responsible groups.

This is probably one of the best Airbnb’s I have stayed in Chicago. It was immaculately decorated with beautiful art, designer touches, lush bedding, and still maintained a cozy feel…though very open and spacious. The unit was very well equipped with spices, S+P, EVOO, condiments and household supplies. There were also SO many generous and thoughtful touches - bathrobes, slippers, bathroom toiletries, etc. There was even a private outdoor courtyard space with a gas grill!
We also took full advantage of the incredible location. The building is located next to an expansive free public pool (Holstein Park Pool) in addition to a playground. It also was walking distance to so many great restaurants/cafes and cute places to grab a drink (Leavitt St Inn and Tavern, Coast Sushi, Truce cocktail bar, etc). We also never had any issues with parking on the street.
A 5 star experience! I couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay while visiting family in Chicago. Thank you Ivy and Rob!
Great place to stay if you are in town for a Cubs game. Clear instructions. Clean & comfortable accommodations. Walkable to many restaurants & bars as well as the stadium.
Overall this was a great stay. You can’t beat the location! Rich was extremely responsive and the apartment was very nice.

Naga and Grace were very helpful and accommodating. Replied + delivered what we needed quickly. The actual property was extremely clean and well maintained. Neighborhood is also very cute and fun to explore the local shops nearby. I would stay again 🧡
I had a wonderful stay here, the place was perfect and Jennifer was very responsive and kind during my stay. Definitely recommend, beautiful place and a great location!

Keith was exceptional with his response times ! He has been very transparent with us, also took extra time to suggest us places to see and helped with public transport guides.
Place was clean as described, absolute no issues. Had everything in the home that we need for a quite stay. Neighborhood was fine.
Keith also offered us late checkout without even us requesting for it, thanks for that !

I highly recommend!  Clear and easy check in details, excellent communication and responses to questions.  We found the property was even better in person.  Very spacious, comfortable and beautiful.  We did experience one night of a “teen takeover”.  While it was very alarming, I never felt unsafe.  The police must monitor the area well at night because there were 5 cop cars within 10 min which ran them off with no return.  Everything was a short and affordable uber ride.  We plan to return in January and hope this is available to re visit.  10/10 book this flat!

Amazing place to stay, loved the location. It was a good space for 5-6 people- and we were able to get groceries delivered easily. Beds are super comfortable, pretty spacious. A/C worked perfectly, and the host was responsive and kind. Would stay again.
This place was perfect for a girls weekend! Great location and lots of space for all of us.
Awesome location if you want to go to Wrigley!

Fantastic stay. Very clean and had everything we needed, very easy to find and get in, very responsive and accommodating host, close to public transit and safe-feeling area, AC worked amazing on a hot Chicago weekend, would absolutely recommend and stay again.

4th floor, no elevator, windows ac so loud could not sleep with ear plugs in.
Never again.

Khadija was an amazing host! She was super communicative and accommodating to any of my request, I had also let her know that I will be traveling in for my birthday and she left me a surprise gift when I checked in! The house was clean and filled stocked with anything that I needed. The check in and check out process was super easy to follow. Will call out that, if you're sensitive to noise that the upstairs folks footsteps maybe quite loud to some. Other than that, highly recommend Khadija!
Great place

We went to a cubs game with another couple and spent a weekend here. We had no issue last finding street parking right outside. Easy walk to coffee shops, bars, and restaurants. It’s a cozy apartment but the layout made each bedroom/bathroom feel private. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.
Bojan’s place was lovely and exactly as described in the listing. The area was nice and it was close to everywhere we planned to go. We also loved the fish!

Good space and great value for our group of 6. The house has been updated and was clean overall. One bed was very comfortable, but the other mattress was quite worn with a foam topper on it, and the pull-out couch was small and uncomfortable for 2 adults. Some finishes are a bit dated once you settle in, but it worked well for our stay and we would consider it again for the value

A beautiful home! Clean, spacious, everything you could need. I would recommend to everyone. Quiet neighborhood. Restaurants within walking distance. A two car garage for parking. A great stay!
Thank you Barry,
We hope to visit again soon.
Muy buena ubicación, la cama estaba cómoda, todo muy limpio. Excelente servicio.
There is a good barbeque restaurant a short walk away and easy access to busses makes this place a great stay for a quick work trip or anyone trying to explore the town on a budget.

I enjoyed my stay at Teeny Tiny Bohemian Lodge. It was exactly as described. Felt safe around the neighborhood.
The nearest bus stop is less than 5 minute walk and an average of 20 minutes bus ride to Roosevelt station. I would recommend if you need a quiet and safe area to rest.
Everything was perfect, great host and beautiful home!
Perfect for a out of town group attending a cubs game!
Great stay. Very cozy and warm place. Also near many great restaurants, stores, and parks. Walking around was fun. Would recommend if you want to explore this area of Chicago.
Me and my family enjoyed our stay. The home was very clean and spacious, and the house was very communicative.

A wonderful, little man-cave on the South side of Chicago. Rate Field is just over a mile away, and the train station is a short walk away. Plenty of street parking, too, so you have your options to get around the city. Host is friendly and responsive.
Had a great time and the description matched. Plenty of room for a big group and the rooftop rocks!
Chill, old charm apartment building. Walkable to coffee and food and stores. Great communication.

Would have been an okay place if the dining room chairs weren’t broken and unusable and if there was more then one chair to sit in to watch tv instead of in the bed … also found 3 big roaches so that’s kinda disgusting imo . They can get in your bag and then you can bring them home and that’s awful tbh
This was the quietest Airbnb that I’ve had. Brad was super friendly and available for any questions or concerns. I’ll definitely be booking with him again.
Great location!!! Very spacious, slept 10 very comfortably. Walkable and easy to get around. Safe and cute area. 10/10!!

This was an amazing place for me, my two teenagers, and my husband’s trip. Can confirm that there is free street parking in front of the house. About 15 minute walk to the blue line L train with easy transfer to bus lines. Nearby gas station and 7 Eleven for snacks, drinks, and anything you forgot. Tons of nearby restaurants, cheaper options and expensive if you want a nice night out. The neighborhood felt safe and we walked in most all directions at night for a stroll to end the evening. When we arrived we struggled with the lock box, total user error as we were using the wrong code, and Luis called me within 30 seconds of sending him a message to assist. Tons of towels and supplies. There are no closets, but two bedrooms have dressers and the third has corner shelves that accommodated all of our stuff. Shower had shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. Everything was very clean. Comfy beds, lots of pillows, and soft blankets. Thank you Luis for a great stay!

Lisa was amazing, responsive, and a graceful host. She was there to greet me upon my arrival and showed me around the unit. She was also accommodating to my changing schedule as well. The place is wonderful and in a great neighborhood. I would recommend going to Cleos up the street for carry out dinner. (The cat fish was wonderful) The place was awesome, with plenty of room, neat and everything that you would need.
I have recommended this place to a colleague that also travels to Chicago and I am sure he will be renting this unit in the near future as well.
Was a good place to stay at the end of a long day in Chicago. The hosts are good responsive and the space is accommodating

I would  m say it was a nice place and it was clean everywhere now I say the fridge could of been cleaner and everyday we got up it was hot as hell the thermometer kept going to 71 and the WiFi is not great but beside that I would say it a okay spot if your trying to just sleep and go
It was great
Enjoyed our stay. Very clean!

Heidi was super kind and informative. She was so flexible with us since our train came in early. We were able to drop off luggage, and come back after check in! Had a wonderful time, place was so clean, and I loved her cat Jerry.

We had so many problems with the management of this apartment.  They gave us the wrong address, and the door for the apartment is quite a challenge to find.  Although dirty, and a broken doorknob on the entry door, (we got locked inside) the apartment was very well done.  Although we were promised a second bedroom, (there are no photos in the listing) when we arrived we  discovered the bed in the second bedroom had no bedding was turned up on its side with a mop bucket on the floor because of a leak in the ceiling.  We were not notified of this problem, so my daughter ended up sleeping on the floor.  The host was unresponsive for the most part in helping us resolve the many issues we had and offered us a meager partial refund after our persistent 10 days of phone calls and messages to get this resolved.  The apartment,  neighborhood, and neighbors were great but the management gets an F for how they handled this.  Be aware that there is no free parking available for this place.

A really great Airbnb apartment. Location was perfect for catching local trains and walking to the museum area.
The front desk personnel were helpful and 100% ok with us being short term renters, which was a great perk.
If you want to be in this part of Chicago, this place is a no-regret rental.
Great location. Song was super responsive, helpful and flexible. The place was spotless and we comfortably fit 7 people for my bachelor party.
The space was very clean. I didn’t like the fact that I had to take my shoes off every time I entered in and out. Was also not very spacious. Overall a great place to stay for one traveling alone.
It was clean and convenient

We enjoyed our stay in the East Lakeview area on Broadway.  The unit was spotless.  The bathroom was huge.  Our host, Rida responded immediately to my messages.  We found the location to be central to the areas we visited.  The only negative we experienced was a very loud Nextdoor neighbor which made sleeping difficult the first night.  Overall this is a very nice Airbnb in a very nice location!
Pleasant home, and the free parking on the street was helpful and convenient. Instructions and getting in went well.
Great place !
Bhavish’s place was a great home base for our trip to Chicago. Clean, big enough for a large group and was a quiet place to retreat to after the City.

We had a great stay at this Airbnb in Chicago! The views were fantastic, and the location was excellent, with plenty of great restaurants within easy walking distance. The place was just as described, and it made exploring the city very convenient. The only issue we had was parking, but that’s to be expected when staying in the city. Beautiful and spacious little basement in a quiet part of Hyde Park. Emily and Roya were gracious and responsive hosts. Thanks for the great accommodations!

Great stay!

Great stay, very clean, had no issues checking in. Highly recommended!!

Great host! Very helpful and fast to respond.

**Pros:** The location is excellent There are plenty of places you can walk to if you’re comfortable with walking. The apartment was very clean, and the bed was very comfortable. Although the A/C temperature cannot be adjusted, the apartment stayed at a very pleasant temperature throughout our entire stay. The refrigerator, stove, and microwave were all working properly.
**Cons:** We never had hot water during our stay. However, it wasn’t a major issue for us, as the cold water was not a problem. As a woman, I personally would have liked to have a desk with a mirror for doing my makeup, or a full-length mirror to check my outfit before going out. The only mirror is the one above the bathroom sink. Also, the apartment is on the fourth floor and there is no elevator, so I would not recommend it for anyone who has difficulty with stairs.
The cons I mentioned were not important enough to affect our stay, and I would definitely rent this place again. I highly recommend this apartment!

The description of the rooms are above a bar and you may hear some noise, is incredibly deceptive of the actual intensity of the experience.
