Easy to get downtown (aside from traffic which isnt their fault-that's Chicago) but also cute places nearby.  Highly recommend dinner at Void. :)  We loved our stay and will be back!

This place is really a gem. The roof top was incredible and the rooms were spacious and comfortable. It is conveniently located to so much of what Wicker Park has to offer AND as an added bonus a Jewel-Osco grocery store is across the street for times when you’d like to take advantage of the indoor OR outdoor kitchens.
James was very helpful and quick to respond.
I absolutely plan on coming back to lounge in the hot tub and take in the beautiful Chicago Skyline.
5 Stars!
It was a clean, comfortable, friendly home base for our Chicago trip. Convenient and safe access system. Transit and great food are always nearby.
Awesome stay in Wrigleyville, highly recommend!
I needed a place to stay for a nearby event and this was perfect.  Comfortable, clean, and the location is great.

We had a great stay, unfortunately inly 2 of us were able to come instead of 4 but the apartment was super spacious, clean and had the amenities I would need. I would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a place to stay in Chicago. Although the matress was sinking but overall still comfy and homey!
Debra was so friendly, helpful, and responsive. The place was exactly as described. I would definitely stay here again!

This Airbnb is fantastic. It’s located on a cute, quiet, tree-lined street that’s also close to coffee shops, restaurants, playgrounds, etc. You can tell these hosts love hosting and put lots of attention into the details of the home - nice new code lock system for the door, parking permit stickers easily accessible, fully stocked coffee station, a big bowl of various snacks, even water bottles for us in the fridge which were a Godsend after a long day of travel. There is fun Chicago-themed art all over. I want to thank them also for being particularly family friendly! With two very young kids, we appreciated the pack and play and toys. I’ve never stayed in an Airbnb that provided an umbrella stroller as well! There was a tornado warning in the area while we were here and Kelly messaged me to make sure we were okay and offered for us to shelter in their basement if needed (everything ended up being fine). This place is really a gem and we’d love to stay here again!

The space was excellent, a perfect base for working remotely and exploring the city. So close to some excellent restaurants, bars, and 1 block away from the grocery store. Claire was really responsive with any questions or concerns that we had as well.

It was a great stay! She has a binder with locals spots and lots of take out options. I would stay here again if she lets me 😭 unfortunately my friends threw up but the host was really kind about it and I really appreciate it!
This place was as advertised. It was nice and private and the host was very responsive.

We were disappointed with the apt and it affected our stay. Great location, but the apt is run down and not well maintained, not as clean as expected, and we paid $3500+ for 3 nights.
Ie : The a/c vents were full of black dirt. I cleaned them myself so as to not blow dust all over the room. One of the 3 bedroom's only overhead lightbulb was burned-out and no replacements found-so the room was just dark. Kitchen faucet was broken (water came out but spiquet hanging). 2 of the a/c's had the “check filter” alert light on.
An odd and major inconvenience - you need a fob to enter the building + access the elevator, but they only give you ONE fob/key. There's a lockbox outside the building to leave the key/fob when you go out. But once inside, you can't go back out to leave key for the next person (or you’d be locked out). If everyone is not together this is a problem- you have to wait for other guests to come/go/access elevator. Unpleasantly surprised, esp given the photos and reviews.
Un lugar increíble, Rashad es un excelente anfitrión, el lugar tal cual se describe, fácil de acceder, un ambiente acogedor, seguro regresaremos.

Laura was very responsive leading up to the trip with providing details for an easy check in. We were able to drop off our luggage early which was great. Walkable distance from both bus and train stops.

Michael was an excellent host. He greeted us and helps us with our parking and luggage … not that he needed to because he was very informative before we got there, but it was very nice of him to do that. He was very friendly and easy to talk to. We enjoyed talking with him after we first got there, and he gave us recommendations on places to eat, how far a walk and how to get there . I would definitely recommend, and we will definitely return to his place the next time we visit Chicago.
Ruby was a wonderful host. Anyone would be lucky to stay in her home.

Nice place to stay in Edgewater! Location was as described/pictured. Dorothy was helpful with the check-in process and provided a walkthrough along with being highly responsive throughout the entire stay.
clean, spacious, central location to interstate, nice furniture, bright lights, good size kitchen

Mera was a great host. She was very responsive and answered our questions in a quick manner. The place was cozy and very clean. The only thing that was a little confusing is finding the right lockbox where the key was. Mera did send a check in video, that showed the location/door, however it only depicted 1 lockbox. There are 3 there now so it took us a moment to find the right one.
The apartment is right on the road and next to the train tracks, so you can hear a lot of noise there. However Mera provides some ear plugs which helped.
Overall it was a very nice stay, exactly what we’re looking for. It was super easy to get places since the train station was so close.

This was the perfect home for our weekend in Chicago to see our friends get married! Location is perfect to great food spots and public transportation. The walking trail close by is a plus as well!
Mary & Andrew were so responsive and friendly through our check in process and we will definitely be booking again!
Angela and Nick are great hosts. Always welcoming, flexible, and respectful of privacy. This place is a great place to stay for students or young professionals looking for a place in the city.

Overall, I had a good stay. The place was nice, the location was decent, and everything was as pictured. The unit itself was clean upon arrival, however, there was a very strong chemical smell from the cleaning products that was a bit overpowering. I tried opening the windows for a while to air the space out.
My main concerns were the living room carpet and couch. The carpet very dirty, and the light-colored couch had several noticeable stains and could definitely use a deep cleaning.
I also wasn't completely comfortable with the key-entry system. I personally would have preferred a keypad with a code that could be changed between guests, as that would have made me feel a lot more secure.
On the positive side, having a washer and dryer was extremely convenient, especially since I like to wash my clothes before traveling home. Overall, the stay was ok, and with a deep cleaning of the carpet and couch and possibly an updated entry system, it could been more comfortable.
Excelente lugar muy recomendable

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and in a nice, quiet location. We didn’t have any issues during our stay, and everything went smoothly. The couch could have been a little cleaner-looking, but overall it was a comfortable place to stay and we really enjoyed our visit. We would definitely stay here again! Great place to stay if you like Indian food.

What a great place. Easy in, easy out—the place was clean, beautiful and the hosts were extremely welcoming and responsive. It is on a main thoroughfare with bars and restaurants yet we didn’t hear any noise at all and stayed there with my eight year old son. Would highly recommend.
Nice, clean place.  Communication was quick and always helpful
Everything went good. The Wifi is a bit unstable.

David and his team are very responsive to everything and I do mean everything!  Super accommodating. David’s home is decorated nicely, super clean and organized. The A/C is very cold to come back to after a warm day to relax after lots of walking and visiting many local establishments. Wrigley Field is literally minutes away. Walking was easy with great sidewalks, (maybe a couple city blocks) as David gives great directions. Very safe and friendly area too!  Lots of great food in the area. I have to say the guest book was brilliantly created with a lot of thought and humor too!  Make sure you read it!  The tram lines are close too and can take you anywhere in the city along with ride shares readily available. We would definitely stay again!  Loved the location.
The space was very clean and organized and it was a very peaceful. I would recommend it to anyone 100 times over.
Nice place, close to public transportation and the interstate.

Great spot to stay while taking on Chicago. Space was accurate to the listing and had enough room for 4 adults and 2 little ones. Close to a lot of restaurants and had thoughtful touches most wouldn’t think of adding.  We had the pleasure of meeting Ken who was friendly and gave us some advice regarding the city. He was also easy to contact if we needed anything. Would greatly consider staying again!

We really liked our stay at Mark's place. It's in a quiet neighbourhood, fun restaurant near the place and easy access to the CTA blue line that goes to the airport and downtown.
Mark responded quickly when we had question and was always willing to help.

Would love to stay here again. Sergio was very responsive to messages. Easy to get in to the building house. Parking spots near by which is a plus. Some people would be hamging out by the corner of the building but i felt very safe walking back to my car Or any other place aroud there. Thanks
The place was absolutely stunning, way bigger and more beautiful than I could’ve imagined! A great place for an intimate gathering :) the entire process was also so seamless!
Amazing stay!

This was a great home for a large group of people. We were in town for a wedding and it worked perfect for all of the out-of-town family members. My mom uses a walker, and the unit was accessible to her. She didn't need to climb any stairs to get in, and there is a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen/ dining room,  and living room all on the main floor of the unit. Street parking was not a problem, and we felt safe walking around outside.
Jessica was great to work with. Instructions were accurate and easy to follow. Great place.
Sandra was very responsive! The apartment was very clean, and it was conveniently located. I would definitely recommend the garage parking !!

This place was just what me and my friends needed for a weekend trip sarah the host was very responsive and helpful through text, she even let us know ahead of time when a gardener was stopping by , the Airbnb itself was in great condition, the landscaping in the front and back yard is beautiful and the neighborhood this house is located in felt very safe even at night time. I would definitely stay here again.
Responsive host

Five stars to Maisons de Promettre, despite some difficult circumstances during the stay. The location and the space were both exactly what we were looking for and we had a great long weekend here. The guests before us, who checked out on the same day that we checked in, destroyed the living room rug and damaged the oven - MDP communicated this to us before check-in to make sure we had adequate expectations, and assured us they would help in securing a partial refund for us. The next day, there was a situation where the previous guests had left an important bag in the apartment and the cleaners locked it inside the apartment's supply closet. I appreciated that MDP asked me to get the bag and leave it in the building's mailroom, rather than have someone enter the apartment when we were not there (but our dog was). Difficult circumstances during the stay for sure, but MDP handled them appropriately and with professionalism, and our stay was great regardless.

We had a wonderful stay at Paul’s place! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as pictured. Paul was a great communicator and gave us clear check-in instructions. The house was super close to Wrigley and lots of great restaurants. We would love to stay here again!

This was the perfect spot for our family of three! We loved the place; from the video games, the big screen TV, all of the coffee and amenities, great set up and I will definitely favorite this location. Leonides was ALWAYS responsive and took care of any questions we had. We even had a bad Keurig the first morning and he had it replaced within an hour. Great host and great place!
Great area and great place! No complaints at all!

We loved our stay at Kyriako's townhome in Lincoln Park.  Kyriako was an excellent communicator; always responded to my questions and offered helpful information for our stay.  Made us feel very welcome!  The townhome is conveniently located within a short walk to the red line, short drive to the Lincoln Park Zoo and to Salt Shed, and easy walking distance to many restaurants, grocery stores, and coffee shops in this lovely neighborhood.   Lots of space to hang out together in the kitchen, dining, and livingroom on the 2nd floor, while also having privacy with the bedrooms on the 1st and 3rd floors.   We will definitely stay again!
Wonderful. I enjoyed it

We had a wonderful stay! The host was very flexible with check-in, which was extremely helpful. The property was super clean, organized, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for our stay in Chicago. Everything was well taken care of, and we really enjoyed our time there. We would definitely stay here again!
The apartment was clean, well-appointed, and comfortable. Would stay again!
Nick & Melesa were great hosts— super responsive and the house was beautiful. Great location, walkable, and felt very safe!
We had a good stay overall. The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described in the listing. It had everything we needed and worked well for our trip.

We had a wonderful stay here! The place was clean, spacious, and in a great location. I was worried about parking but we had no issues finding a spot right outside the apartment every night. Thomas was exceptionally communicative and accommodating with early check-in and check-out which made our trip much easier. I would definitely recommend his place and it's already on our list for future stays.
Our stay at Marco & Sarah's place was definitely one of our best places to stay, I would without a shadow of a doubt, recommend this place.

The stay was just what I needed for me and the wife we enjoyed the timeless views of the city and the warm welcoming of guests that surrounds the air in that place !!! Overall I would book again everything as peaceful and private you guys are awesome!!

Very basic, no-frills accommodations on the ground floor and basement of an older wood frame home in a residential neighborhood. It feels like staying with a friend or relative. This was fine for a last-minute accommodation. Jane was super responsive. Though it's a place where everything was shared (except the room itself), I only ever encountered other people briefly in passing. There were no issues with the bathroom, but wouldn't expect hotel-level service.
My challenges were all situational: There was a construction throughout the neighborhood that made the street partially inaccessible for cars and the utility company shut-off the water for most of the day one of the days I was there. While the hosts control neither of these things, it would have been nice if they had oriented me to either of these issues so I could prepare. Instead, I had to navigate both of these challenges suddenly while in a new city. Just a simple heads-up would have been nice.

We absolutely loved our stay. The place was impeccable. Walking distance to the lake, the L train, and many restaurants. The hosts were very kind, responsive, and super helpful. Zero complaints! I highly recommend it.

Perfect place to stay with my family! We utilized the baby gear provided by Darsh and it made traveling much easier.
Very appreciative of Darsh’s prompt and helpful communication. Would definitely stay here again
Lovely place exactly as listed definitely worth the stay and would again
Hosts communicated well. My stay was great
This is our 3rd stay. Perfect location for us!
Great stay and responsive host. Thanks!
Thank you team! We had such a great time. Great spot and would highly recommend to anyone else w/ a big group in Chicago.
I don’t think I’ve ever been to an Airbnb as stocked as this one was with amenities. The coffee bar is awesome.  Highly recommend for Chicago visitors!

Amazing location when in Chicago. Access to everything. CTA stop outside the front door. Very clean place and everything was just as described. Great price for the location. I would highly recommend this loaction.
Nice location. Furniture is showing it's age but it's like any hotel. Would definitely stay again.
We enjoyed our stay here. Shaun and Christina were very quick in helping us with any questions we had and the place was very clean.
Milan communicated clearly and often. Check in was easy and the apartment was comfortable.

We had the absolute BEST stay at Adrian’s Airbnb for my bachelorette weekend! 🤍🥂 The house was everything and more—truly exactly as pictured, if not even better in person! It was beautiful, clean, spacious, and the perfect place for our group to celebrate such a special weekend together.
Everything about our stay was fabulous, and we couldn’t have asked for a better home base for all of our bachelorette festivities. Thank you so much, Adrian, for helping make this weekend so memorable! We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We stayed with our family and it felt a bit run down, needs general maintenance such as fresh paint (many stains on the walls). Also a noticeable amount of bugs inside. Beds were clean.

We are longtime Superhosts with properties in DC and Provincetown, and I am an interior designer, so we may notice details others overlook. This is a great option for a short stay centered on Boystown: the location is phenomenal, public transit is convenient, the host was communicative, the kitchen was well stocked, storage was ample, and the TV’s guest mode was useful.
However, it was not ideal for our 10-day stay or remote work. The inconsistent internet made Zoom calls difficult. The apartment had bathroom mildew, a filthy windowsill and duvet, stained bedding, dirty light fixtures, missing art, and damaged walls. The dresser did not function, the sofa was uncomfortable, and the loud, creaking bed appeared broken. Window A/C units admitted street noise, and trash collection woke us at 7 a.m. several mornings. Towels were insufficient, and the coin laundry took our money without drying. Outlets were limited, there was no microwave or dishwasher, and two guests received only one key.

we stayed here the worst possible weekend, there was an Italian festival going on that closed the whole block, loud music, fumes from the generator right under our bedroom window and we found out about it after booking. we don’t think they can control these issues, but wish we got a discount with all this inconvenience.
on what they can control, the building looks newly remodeled, the elevator not so much. glad nothing serious happened while we were there. parking is tough in this neighborhood.
otherwise, we felt safe, our rooms were clean, tidy and spacious for 2. nice coffee maker with coffee too!

Overall, the home was great! Everything was clean and nice decorated. Chicago had a storm and we lost hot water each day BUT they didn’t hesitate to get it fixed & she also offered to refund us for it! I love the unit.
I liked it, Dominique was prompt, the Airbnb is great, just neighborhood is a little issue, but not bad for the price!

I'd recommend this charming spot in the heart of Old Town! The location could not have been better, super walkable and close to the L. Loved the neighborhood, very quiet but also close to North Ave and Wells if you wanted access to coffee shops, restaurants, and bars. The house itself was very cool! It's an old house, so there are some quirks that come with that but it didn't impact our stay. There's not central air, although there are window units. Luckily we didn't have super hot weather, but something to consider it was not the coolest. Overall, we wanted a homey spot in a great location and that's exactly what we got. And Elizabeth was super responsive, great host. Do it!
A very nice stay and the hosts were very quick with their replies!

We would definitely stay here again. Great space for our whole family. The theatre room was a hit for unwinding. Nice big bedrooms for us all with huge bathrooms. Lots of stairs to climb to get into the unit but worth it for a nice view and the private entrance is convenient.  We love walking the neighborhood and it’s easy to hop on the Blue Line to go to our other favorite spots.
Great place with wonderful access to the United Center, and also a great place for getting access to downtown via the Green Line CTA. Super convenient!

We enjoyed our stay at Loft 8 - vibrant location in heart of Wicker Park. The loft is spacious and comfortable - very close to the Damen el stop but no one in our group was bothered by the noise and we all slept great. The loft is up 3 flights of stairs, which is clear in the description but worth being aware of if you have mobility issues. The upstairs loft area is very pretty with nice views but a low ceiling so if you are tall it might be uncomfortable. The loft was also a little warm but there was a fan.
The loft is well appointed, with a full kitchen and comfortable living area. We enjoyed spending time there as an extended family and would stay here again.
Great location, walkable to Wrigley and having A/C in the unit was needed for a humid weekend.
We had a great stay here, was close enough to our son in Lincoln Park, enjoyed walking to get coffee in the morning. Very clean and roomy place.
The place was spacious and had everything we needed for the weekend. Checking in and out was a breeze.

Location was great. Aiyana was responsive to questions and the unit was just what we needed. Parking was a bit of a challenge because of things going on in the city but we were able to find spots with patience. Our only complaint was that the bedroom could use curtains to be darker. We’d definitely stay again, especially if we’re headed to Soldier Field or one of the museums around there.

Great location with lots of restaurants nearby to choose from. CVS and grocery store close by for any necessities for your stay. Easy walk to the lake. Great amenities like coffee, tea, soft drinks and oatmeal if you need something quick. David was responsive to questions. Instructions to get in were clear and checkout was simple without a thousand tasks.
Great stay
We had a wonderful stay here. The apartment was as described, super cute, and Joanna and Michael were responsive and thoughtful hosts! The neighborhood is quiet and beautiful. 5 stars!
Thank you Marijes!

The listing is as advertised. Mark provided clear instructions was available as much or as little as we wanted. It was clean and well equipped. The 3 bedrooms were very comfortable and even though it is on a busier street, noise was never an issue. The only negative is that you do have to navigate a steep flight of stairs. Wrigley is a 1.1 mile walk. or a $15 Uber.

Nicholas was great. Delivered me my keys when I got there and answered every question I had within an hour (which I don’t expect) and gave me clear directions on what to do to check in and check out. Had shampoo, conditioner, body wash, pots and pans, dishwasher detergent, everything! I recommend to anyone staying in Chicago!

My partner and I came into town for my sister’s wedding and this Airbnb met all of our needs. We were centrally located in Lincoln Park, in a very walkable location, with nearby access to bus lines. The space itself was small but cozy, perfect for our busy weekend. We had an issue with a leak during the stay, and host Maureen was incredibly responsive and the issue was fixed promptly. Great communication, great location, and an Airbnb that met all our needs.
nice place with lots of access to surroundings.
Excellent location and comfortable stay for a long weekend near Wrigley.

The pictures do not do this house justice! Great space & lots of it. Kitchen is well equipped. Beds are super comfy. Excellent location—coffee shop about 15min walk, UChicago about 25min walk, Obama Center about 30min walk. No problem finding street parking. Loved the space for a group and would stay again!

Adam was incredibly kind and attentive. I had several questions before and during the stay and he was informative and very quick to respond. This place was beautiful and perfect for our bachelorette party crew. Highly recommend!
Amazing host.

Angela and Ryan were exceptional hosts—warm, responsive, and thoughtful throughout my stay. The space was spotless, comfortable, accurately described, and in a great location. Check-in was seamless, and everything felt easy from start to finish. I would happily stay here again and recommend Angela’s place without hesitation!

We really enjoyed our stay! The space was very clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and very quick to respond whenever we had a question. The neighborhood was also quiet, which made our stay even more relaxing. We had a great experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Stayed here for about 4 days. The place was very clean and comfortable. We were in walking distance to great restaurants, bus lines, and a short uber to main attractions.
Milan was also very responsive.
The unit was clean and updated. Neighborhood was nice
Geo has a nice place in a great location. Was perfect to relax at the end of a long day. Working with Geo was fantastic and they were always super responsive and helpful. Would recommend this place!

J’ai beaucoup apprécié le logement. Il était bien situé et les instructions étaient simples et claires. L’endroit est spacieux et convient amplement pour visiter la ville lors d’une fin de semaine. La caserne de pompier est à proximité donc il est préférable d’emmener des bouchons pour dormir. Beaucoup de restaurants dans les environs. L’hôte répond rapidement et est là en cas de besoin. Je reviendrait sans hésiter!
Semi far from city but I also come from a place where 30 min is a far drive. Great area and safe unlike how some spots are nice but in a sketch area this one was solid and safe
We had a great stay, nice and clean space!
Thank you Latasha for a lovely stay. Your home is beautiful and clean and very spacious.

We had a great stay at Johana's. Her place was as described and the neighborhood is quiet, walkable, and close to restaurants. The ride from O'Hare isn't the nicest so you might question your decision in the middle of the ride but rest assured, it's a great place and location.

Nice cozy spot in a quiet part of town. The place was clean and the beds were cozier than we expected. Antonio was friendly and communicative throughout our stay and we had no issues. I would recommend this spot 👍
It was great!
Great location for our workshop at iO theater. Clean and modern. Would only be better if building had a pool. :)

Bryce’s place was perfect for my stay in Chicago.  Great neighborhood and location near the main drag of Andersonville with all the shops and restaurants. Bryce was an excellent and responsive host. The place was clean and tidy and very cozy with modern touches. I would definitely stay again on future visits.

This stay was exactly what we were looking for!  The home was clean and well taken care of with plenty of space for our family of 6 adults. We found it to be just as described. The location was ideal-walkable to many restaurants, neighborhoods and Chicago attractions but also separate from the high tourist areas.  Florin was very responsive. We highly recommend!
Great location. Very comfortable!
Lovely space and location, very comfortable, beautiful neighborhood easy to walk wherever you need to go.

Best Airbnb we have stayed in. Good value. Great location and the condo itself was wonderful. Host was very responsive and professional. Super helpful with parking for our large vehicle offsite. Would definitely stay here again 100% five stars plus!

The location of Jane’s place is fantastic.  We were there for 12 days and could walk everywhere.  The place was quiet and comfortable and perfect for 2 people.  Jane is a responsive host.  Would definitely stay there again.
Great
Very cozy place, looked exactly as it is described and just like the pictures. Everything was very clean, and the hosts were very helpful and responsive. Would definitely stay here again!
Patricia was always very available and helpful, and the place was exactly as described and in very good shape.
Great alternative to hotel stay, comfortable neighborhood, and easy to access metro.

Kind and responsive! The smoke detector started beeping and they took care of it right away. Dogs were a little barky but were too cute for me to be bothered by it. Super simple check in and out :)
Location was a bit further away than I anticipated but that's my fault not the host's, they were very clear in their notes of where transit is available

We had a great stay and the home was perfect and cozy for a family of four. The garage was a huge plus as street parking was limited at night, and getting in and out was very easy.
The host was great, communication was easy, and the location made it convenient to get around the city. We also loved being able to walk to a coffee shop, with a local park right down the street. Overall, a great place to stay when visiting Chicago!

The condo was immaculately clean and free of clutter. It served as an excellent home base for our guys trip to a Cubs game. The proximity to Wrigley Field, L station, and countless restaurants and shops was ideal.

We had such a comfortable and welcoming stay at Steve’s place, and truly, location, location, location! We chose it because it was within easy walking distance of DePaul University, which made it an especially convenient home base for our campus activities.
We had the pleasure of meeting Steve and Mary briefly, and their warmth and gracious hospitality immediately made us feel welcome in their home. There was also something wonderfully inviting about being surrounded by Steve’s collection of books, it gave the space a thoughtful, lived-in character, the kind of atmosphere that makes you want to linger with a good book and feel at home. As the old literary sentiment goes, a room full of books has a way of becoming a room full of possibilities.
We’re very grateful for the comfortable stay and the warm welcome, and we would absolutely consider Steve’s place again for our next round of DePaul campus activities. We’d be delighted to return!
Great place to stay
Great host

Check-in easy & as described.  Front lobby coverage 24 hours+restricted entry to residents.  Location-L is noisy, but convenient to pub transit, walk to museums, parks, river walk, restaurants.  we2 friends traveling together with opposite fitness level, varying interests.  Stephanie responsive to req for 2nd set of keys, also quickly&diligently responsive to larger issues.  Shabby bldg, hallways smell of mildew and fried onions, grimy gym; shabby pool area w/ torn furniture pads & dangerous trip hzrd @grey shade base. ONE working elevator for 23 floors of apts-safety hazard.  Elevator out for an entire day, leaving 1 w/ mobility issues trapped in apt. & other dragging groceries up 17 floors@90 degrees. Stephanie did generously $ compensate for EL outage.  Apt: Roach issue-Stephanie immed addressed; broken vertical blinds-cannot close; steady leak@tub faucet (ongoing-brown stain), marked-up walls. I would rent from Stephanie again in another building, would not return to this one.
No wifi. No coffee pot for the coffee maker. No water in the refrigerator.

The neighborhood looks well gentrified. Which is good. However, the back alley way which you have free parking is very sketchy. The gate takes forever to close and open, so make sure you watch your surroundings carefully when opening and closing the gate. I had a very odd encounter with a few young teenagers that stood near the gate wearing ski masks and backpacks until I went inside of the property. Otherwise the property and neighborhood was amazing, just make sure your socially aware of your surroundings and know when to disperse.
Aun mejor de lo que esperábamos,  el apartamento es un 10. Impecable, super equipado, limpio, muy agradable,  cómodo,  la verdad muy recomendable
Awesome space, great location. Perfect for families.

We arrived in our Airbnb only for it to be dirty and used. We were so exhausted from driving that we almost cleaned the place ourselves. Mindy seemed frantic and repeatedly said she “didn’t know what we wanted” her to do, and offered a refund on the spot and suggested we find another place to stay. Obviously it is unrealistic to find a place the same night of when this trip had been planned months in advance. As we grabbed cleaning supplies in her basement, she called and offered up an empty room in the building that we could hang out in until ours was clean. We had to wait 3 1/2 hours until we could access our unit. She offered us $25 dollars for the inconvenience, which we found a bit unserious. We requested a full nifhrs refund given the fact that our plans for our stay had to be rescheduled and we entered a dirty home that was over $700 for 3 nights. She was very combative and said that we were “acting” nice over the phone. What alternative is there in a situation like this?
I've stayed here several times now. It's great to find an affordable room downtown with easy parking.
Great place for our family to stay during our visit to Chicago!
Good stay over all. Great location and noise from bar was no issue for us, after exploring the city we were so tired it was not even noticed. Was exactly what I expected.

I loved this place! The host was extremely kind and responded above and beyond to an accommodation question I had by providing an aid I wasn’t expecting them to purchase. We enjoyed the cute little patio.  If you have never been to wicker park this is a very desirable place to be while visiting. I loved all the extras! Would stay again & highly recommend.
10/10 would come back!

My first night there wasn’t enough soap, I had to wait until the middle of the next day to have access to that. The next day I spotted the first insect , the second night I spotted the second insect. The tv (I never understood how to use the tv with connectivity issues). Then the last night this apartment is connected via a door to another apartment, the walls are paper thin, and I heard their entire conversation while trying to get to sleep. It is not worth the money. It’s overpriced, and the host is slow to provide legitimate solutions . They will respond, but it was hard to get actual updates, like “you will have soap at this time tomorrow”, or “someone will come and check out this Airbnb for bugs, at this time today”. Instead I had to keep asking for updates over and over. So it did not seem like this Airbnb was a priority from the host. I would not come here again. The utilities in the shower are also out of date. (Including the heater), and shower head.

Absolutely beautiful! Parking was a little difficult to find around the back alleys and side roads but once you got a grasp of where it’s located it was no issue! The host was the absolute best though! Answered all my questions even my silly ones and was quick, the apartment itself was absolutely pristine! Whoever her interior designer was needs a raise 😂! Great host and great room!
Clean and comfortable
We had a nice stay at Cristina’s place. It was spacious and clean for our group of five. The backyard was great for our puppy dog. Thank you!!
Great stay!
Enjoyed staying there, it’s in a nice quiet area. Good amenities .

We absolutely loved staying in Marty & Rob’s gorgeous house. The highlight was definitely the garden—sitting by the pond watching the fish, butterflies and hummingbirds made for very relaxing mornings. Super cool neighbourhood,  lovely hosts and a very cute dog - couldn’t ask for more!
Great space for a family. We travelled with our toddler - having the kitchen and high chair was extremely helpful. Darina was very responsive and hospitable.
Great spot

Valeria was a wonderful host! I visited Chicago to see the Obama Presidential Center, and she made my stay even more enjoyable. She was warm, welcoming, and very responsive throughout my visit.
What stood out most was her willingness to go above and beyond—she even came downstairs late one evening to personally assist, showing true care and attentiveness.
Her recommendations were also excellent, especially Batter & Berries, which was a highlight of my trip.
Overall, everything was comfortable, well organized, and stress-free. I truly appreciated Valeria’s hospitality and attention to detail.
I would highly recommend her to anyone visiting Chicago and would gladly stay again!

Overall experience was fantastic. Owner was super responsive every time we had questions. Axis was so easy as it was a keypad and we did not need to carry a key with us every time we went out. The apartment was very well furnished and everything we needed for a day was there including the kitchen in the bathroom. Bedroom were comfortable with lots of super clean bedlinen. Location was great and we could walk everywhere. Across the street from Starbucks. It quickly became home!
Amazing host! Felt right at home

I stayed here with two friends for 3 nights and we loved it! We felt so comfortable and right at home! Everything was so beautiful and inviting, it was the best location for us as it’s right by multiple restaurants, a Walgreens and a bus stop! We’ve stayed out pretty late and the area never once felt unsafe, the bus stop is just across the street and we went pretty much everywhere with it! The Airbnb was clean, spacious and had all the amenities listed. Francisco’s a great host, he communicated promptly and was flexible! I believe this is a great place to stay, I miss it already!

What a charming home and lovely stay with Sue. Despite being a "shared space" we hardly interacted outside of breakfast time, and I thoroughly enjoyed her peaceful patio after a long day of city trekking. 2 blocks up from the 606 elevated trail - such a wonderful resource. The bed was SO comfortable, and our suite felt spacious and comfy. Sue gave great recommendations and there's so much to explore between Logan Square and armitage nearby!

Great place to stay, large kitchen and living room, master bedroom was great.  Heard reviews about loud trains, I barely noticed the noise.  Great location close to the aquarium and soldier field.  Located in an up and coming neighborhood.  Would definitely stay there again.
It is a good place

Everything was as described. We loved being so close to the Green Line, which took us to where we wanted to go! We booked the Teal room. It was spacious, had a lounge area with a couch/TV, and had a view of the street parking if you ever needed to check on your vehicle. The window unit kept us cooled off. We never heard other guests while in our room. Only suggestion I’d make is to have a safe in the room since there aren’t locks on the doors (for added peace of mind). The house is huge so we rarely ran into the other guests, but when we did everyone was respectful. We had access to all amenities listed and the host did a great job of supplying the guests with what they would need, especially coffee! Overall, the house was unique, a great experience, the host was communicative and we would love to stay again if we visit Chicago in the future.
Rashmi was very friendly and responded quickly.  Our stay in Chicago was great and a lot of that had to do with the house.  It was perfect for our needs.  I would recommend it to anyone.
Great location. We could see people walking or running on the trail.
It is a very nice place

Great location - very nice property.   The washer and dryer are located in a central location in the building, not actually inside the unit.   Overall, the location mattered most and it's very close to many restaurants and tourist attractions.  Some updates are needed but very functional for our needs. Thanks for renting to us.
This airbnb worked well for a trip with my family.
Host had great communication and was very helpful!

Super easy access to public transportation and a great location. The beds were comfortable, and the space was clean and comfortable. It is a walk-up, which we overlooked when booking, but it wasn’t too bad. Overall, a great place to stay! Neighborhood was awesome.
very cozy. very good. nice ac! ari likes it very much. ari's favorite airbnb
Andrew was a very kind and responsive host. Loved being able to get to the Pink Line so quickly!

George was wonderful, the place was perfect and exactly what we were looking for: the blue line is super close by, it’s in a quiet enough area and right off of the Main Street, a super close by grocery store with sweet workers, and lots of shopping and dining within a 10 min walk!
The airbnb itself was squeaky clean and had all the amenities we needed, it was super sunny and had enough seating and tables and the kitchen was beautiful, and bathroom was great too.
We had a small problem with the window and the host immediately jumped on fixing it and making sure we were comfortable.
Thank you George, hope to stay here again!
A good spot for larger groups at a convenient location to hop on the freeway.
The Airbnb was fine! The only issue was the noise from the other guests. Overall, it was very clean and also well located.

My family stayed here for a week of sightseeing in Chicago.  The apartment was perfect for us.  The location is fantastic with easy access to bike paths and the train so getting to downtown was extremely easy.  The Hyde Park area offered a ton of restaurants, parks, beach access, and the Griffin Museum.  The views from the apartment were incredible and the building itself was architecturally impressive.  The place was clean and quiet.  Jevaux was extremely responsive.  The small issue that we had was very promptly taken care of.  If we ever come back to Chicago, we would stay here again.
The location has a bus station at the corner and blue line train 15 minutes from location. Really convenient for public transport into the city!
Great house, good location!

Wynter’s place was a really nice place to stay for my first time in Chicago. It has everything you need right inside, and everywhere you might need/want to go is within a reasonable distance. Wynter was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay and I would not hesitate to book again!
Great place Nicholas was a wonderful host. The place was squeaky clean every day

The unit was exactly as described and as seen in the photos.  Very clean with all the desribed amenities. Marijes was extremely responsive, and provided very clear check-in and entry instructions, which made entry easy, even at night. If you are staying here, you know you are staying in an urban neighborhood setting, so expect a bit of street noise - the provided earplugs were a nice touch, although probably not needed for most.
Solid, straightforward spot. Simple, clean, and the El tracks are honestly not too loud from this location. Brad is super responsive and overall no complaints here. Thanks for a smooth experience.

Great little 2 bedroom spot in Logan Square. The home has everything needed to make a memorable stay and the location is perfect to walk around and explore. Sarah was an excellent, friendly and communicative host. 10/10, would recommend!
We had a great stay! The host was very nice, and the place felt cozy. My family and I enjoyed our time here and highly recommend it, especially for small groups or families.
The apartment was wonderful, roomy, and well kept. The only issue was the lack of parking. Also, while it's only 8 miles from downtown, it was still 45-60 minute drive sure to traffic.

The place was great! It was clean and well organized. The living area was very comfortable. Plenty of space for us and our teen; he appreciated having his own room and bathroom! The master room and bathroom were spacious and very nice.
The host was very responsive and reached out during our stay to make sure we had everything we needed.
The area is great; a 10 minute walk to all the restaurants you would ever want, and you can even walk to the Lincoln Park Zoo in about 15 minutes (free every day!).
Would highly recommend!
Placed matched the description; communication was great; parking spot was so helpful and easy.

10-15 minute walk to the blue line, which is very convenient. Quiet neighborhood other than the sound of planes going overhead, but they aren't too loud. Counter space is a bit tight, but the dining table provides plenty of room for cooking on. My one major issue was with the AC - while there was a window unit and central AC, there is only one window in the apartment capable of mounting it, and even combined with the central AC it struggled to cool the apartment down during hotter afternoons.
Great stay. Walkable to all city attractions. Hosts were very communicative and helpful with suggestions on where to go and places to eat. Would definitely stay there again.

Matt and Nicole are awesome ! Great place, truly one of the best air Bnb I’ve stayed at !
Clean, fully equipped and a great location!
Truly great ! 👍🏻

We loved the location! Beds comfortable and kitchen had everything we needed! The bathroom needed some work (loose tiles under toilet, toilet seat hinge broken, sink did not drain well) but all fixable and did not take away from our stay. Guests will want to use the dehumidifier and drain it regularly.

The home exceeded my expectations. Note: it is a duplex (1st floor). The upstairs unit was empty until my last day, but I could here them talking and walking around. Still, I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. Lots of sleeping areas if needed. Very clean and tidy all around. Since its located in Chinatown there is an abundance of restaurants and oriental shops to visit. It was a quick drive or Uber to all of the downtown locations I needed to visit. Definitely my favorite place to lodge in Chi-town.
Great amenities

Just as it looked in the photos, this was a bright and clean place to stay. The check-in process was explained in detail beforehand, so it was very easy, and whenever I had a question and reached out, they responded immediately, which made my stay very stress-free.  What I liked best was that there was a private parking space, making it convenient to leave the car behind and head into the city by bus or subway. I would recommend this place to anyone planning to visit Chicago, and we’d love to stay here again if we ever get the chance.

Justin’s coach house was very clean. Easy to find and access. No problems with WiFi or tv. There is a Whole Foods about two block away to buy anything you need for your stay. Parking passes are worth the cost because street parking is very limited. This is a great location for a Cubs game.
Perfect location with a everything in distance

The price matched the location but the residence is need of extreme maintenance on stairs to enter the residence, recess lightings were missing bulbs and caps, sofa was sulky, dryer stacked too high to safely reach, and neighborhood could be a little seedy.  Furnishings doesn't equate to the price of the Airbnb.  WIFI was absolutely horrible during the entire stay but Latrice was nice and responsive and did try to fix it but to no avail.  Good location, not so good accommodation.

a super cozy stay! jeremiah has a great setup and vibe. we felt right at home. the airbnb was easy to get to/from the airport and downtown via public transportation. it's right by the park and was very peaceful.

Exceptional and friendly host! Julio was accommodating and helpful throughout my stay. His place was exactly as described and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. He even took the time to give me a tour of the neighborhood and recommend places to check out while I was in town. I would 100% recommend Julio to anyone looking for a welcoming and thoughtful host!

I really enjoyed my stay at this cozy and cute two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment in Chicago! The space was clean, comfortable, and welcoming, and the neighbors were very friendly. Communication with the host was great, and I really appreciated being able to make arrangements for an early check-in for an additional fee, which was very convenient for my schedule.
Parking was a little different than what I’m used to, but once I got the hang of it, it was manageable. Overall, I had a pleasant stay and would definitely consider staying here again!
Terry was a great host! Good location and a nice place. Would stay there again!
Nice place, convenient location for my itinerary. Iris was attentive and a good communicator. Good stay!
Thank you again! Five star hosts, loved the space and neighborhood.  Very convenient for all we needed and extremely quick follow up to all of our questions!

This is the best place we've ever rented in the United States. Absolutely gorgeous and a fun location. Just a few blocks north of here Clark Street is a very vibrant, active area but this unit is two blocks into the quieter section, where the action slows down and you can get a good nights sleep without worrying about noise. Turn the fan on in the bedroom and you wouldn't even know you're in the city. We have never been so comfortable and relaxed in a rental. Our favorite restaurants nearby were Green Tea and Riccardo Trattoria. Big Apple grocery store and Lincoln Park Liquors are a short stroll away. Del Seoul, China Wok and Pasta Bowl are solid choices for take out. Loved this apartment, would recommend it to everyone!
As advertised.. very nice and clean space. Very well located.
Amazing 10/10 would stay again
Cute place
Great place to stay! Neighbors were extremely loud which was the only downside but enjoyed staying here!
Rida was very quick to respond and the apartment had plenty of room for 4 people to be very comfortable.
Great place!
Shovany was super accommodating, responsive, and helpful with any inquiries. Great host!

The space is lovely and clean with a genuinely comfortable beds for sleeping.
On the downside, Parking is a significantly inconvenience. Street parking is mostly full with virtually no available spaces, making it stressful to find a spot. The kitchen is under-equipped with minimal utensils, making it nearly impossible to prepare your own meals comfortably.

This was a great space for us to stay with our two young kids. Having a garage space attached to the backyard was a huge plus! The inside was clean and large! My only complaints are that it was very hard to close/lock some windows that weren’t locked when we arrived, but that really isn’t a huge deal. We made it work!
This is a great location to explore all of the things Chicago has to offer! So close to everything and public transit.

The place was very clean and felt very homey. We really liked the little office space as an additional perk. We encountered some technical difficulties at one point but host was very quick and helpful to respond and remedy the situation.
It was a great apartment for our family of three. The neighborhood is excellent and walk-able to many nearby restaurants. Would definitely stay here again!

Really loved my stay , the place is soo cozy and clean
Communication was also super straight forward
I’m definitely coming back there sometime soon
Great location. It’s a smaller area, but enough space for what is needed. The bathroom could use some updating. I would stay again. The price and location is hard to beat.
Excelente alojamiento!!!
The location was great and neighbors were very welcoming. Great place to stay to explore Lincoln Square!
Hakim was very kind and straightforward. Place was great!
Perfectly located. Clean and cozy. Lots of parking. Pleasant and responsive hosts.

We’ve stayed at Anna’s apartment several times over the years, often for long stretches, and it truly feels like our home away from home. Her place is comfortable, well‑equipped, and perfect for working and spending time with family. Anna is incredibly thoughtful and always quick to address anything that comes up. We’re so grateful for her hospitality and look forward to returning again next year.
Todo excelente. Gran experiencia en una casa hermosa con todo lo necesario y más!!

My group and I enjoyed our stay. The place was located in a good area, approximately 16 minutes from downtown, 20 with traffic. The hosts responded promptly and made us feel comfortable. The place itself was just as described and pictured. Check in & out was the easy. Overall this place was a nice addition to our Chicago trip!

Perfect home base (no pun intended) for a father-son baseball trip.  Beautiful house, amazing host, quiet neighborhood within walking distance of Wrigley Field. Couldn't imagine a more ideal setting.  Highly recommend!  Thank you Karen!

This place was great for our guys trip with 5 people. The neighborhood was cool, with plenty of restaurants, bars, shops within walking distance. It was easy to catch an Uber to branch out farther (downtown, wrigleyville, etc). The host was responsive and accommodating. The price was on par with other houses this size in the city. We enjoyed our stay.
Great stay.  Very clean and well appointed apartment and they left us some starter groceries which was a nice touch - that is Cloud9!
Great location. Well equipped for a 5 night stay.  Functional kitchen. Walkable neighborhood with restaurants and groceries.
Great place to stay for business purposes

The location is convenient and a short walk to the train to get to downtown. The room was clean and the other guests were quiet and respectful. Evgenii was very responsive and easy to reach. Had a great stay!

Lovely apartment in a beautiful and very walkable neighborhood.  Spacious, well laid out and furnished common areas including separate living room, dining room and kitchen, large bathroom and three comfy bedrooms with great beds. Just perfect for our family! And very responsive, helpful and kind hosts!

The place was amazing. Very kid friendly, location makes you feel like a local in Chicago and it's peaceful and safe. Ewa was super responsive to my doubts and questions and very kind to me and my kids. Great host!

This was our second stay at Cody's place. It was just as great as last time. It's so comfortable and in a terrific location - safe, walkable, great restaurants (his recommendation of Il Milanese was spot on - a new favorite for us!) The apartment is decorated beautifully - it's so nice when Airbnb hosts trust their guests with "nice things." So comfortable and he's so easy to reach if you need something (we didn't need anything, but he was proactive about letting us know about things like construction in the neighborhood.) We love staying there!
Very clean, perfect for in amd out trips. Host was easy to communicate with. Would stay here again
Awesome location, great place. Really enjoyed it. Would come back anytime.

This is such a perfect little place!  It is small but Sue and Bill have made excellent use of it.  Its super clean and has everything you need.  The bed is so comfy and I loved being able to adjust it.    The location is prime being only .2 miles from the Logan Square blue line.  That whole area is full of great restaurants, all in easy walking distance.  I didn't get to have coffee with them as invited but I met Sue and she is very accommodating to your every need.  I will definitely try to stay here again.
Cool place, Terrence is a nice guy.  Good price and good neighborhood
Great stay. Close to the city.
Great communication and privacy. It is great for a couple or small group of friends. Would recommend!

I wish I had payed better attention to the listing and realized there were no exterior photos. The location is convenient there’s two gas stations nearby and a food place, as well as the highway but, it was in a somewhat sketchy area we say many homeless people wandering around we didn’t have any problems with them but just a noticeable thing. Outside the house we kept smelling something and there was a used tampon on the ground maybe left by one of the homeless people which really grossed us out. The interior was pretty much spot on with the listing the only thing was in the upstairs one of the bedrooms was dusty on the walls near the ceilings and the stickers down stairs were bubbling up. Also there is a camera inside the house pointed at the entrance to the door. We also need ice multiple times but there’s no ice trays or ice maker. The pull out couch was boarded up and we could not open it for one of the guest. Served its purpose, just not up to par with my typical standards.

The place is really quite and in a good neighborhood. Train station is not far away walking and you can find restaurants too.
Pros: The apartment was remodel and really clean. Our host was really responsive with any issue we have.
Cons: the air conditioner is REALLY loud, every time turn on we couldn't even hear the tv.
The worst part of our stay was the beds. The only think I ask for when I travel its a good bed where to sleep.
They were really noisy and uncomfortable. We had 2 kids, I slept with the baby and every time I moved, the bed sunk and the baby end on top of me. Our backs hurt a lot every morning and we eneded not resting at all.
The apartment really need a little bit investment on that side.

This apartment is convenient, with lovely high ceilings, a balcony, and generally hip feel. The location was great. The size was perfect for our crew of a couple, young child, ans grandparents. I recommend the owner invest in a new couch and chairs (since those were in bad repair),  purchase larger sized towels, and provide toilet paper (or bring some when a guest notes it is gone).

Our stay went smoothly and was fine for the short time we were there. It's in a great location for sure and is walkable to basically anything you'd want to do in Logan Square/Avondale! The bed was comfortable. We were disappointed with the air conditioning effectiveness, as it was pretty warm in there even with the unit on, and the unit is pretty loud. Very bright in the morning from the sunlights and no curtains. We also were looking forward to the bookshelf that is pictured in the listing with books and games on it since we were planning on being in there a lot, as well as it adding to the ambiance of the space, but it was not in there anymore which was pretty disappointing too since it's pictured in the listing. We are pretty short girls but the ceiling slant did pose an issue even for us, but we were aware from reviews. The yard was not maintained and pretty overgrown. Overall, a great location but pretty underwhelming space for the price.

The location was good, the parking situation was a bit more difficult to figure out and even if you opt for street parking there is rarely a spot available. Other than that, it was in a walkable location to shops, restaurants, cafes, etc.
For the place itself, it was fine for what it cost. The bathroom is pretty nice. I did not notice until near the end of my stay, but the floor under the bed was extremely dirty with wrappers and food so it would’ve been nice if that was cleaned before I moved in. It should be noted I didn’t bring that up to the host since I was moving out in a couple of days.
Host was pretty responsive otherwise for anything I did bring up and overall my stay over the summer was fine. If you stay in the summer though, beware of centipedes.
Afsha was a lovely host. She was really friendly and responsive to all questions. The apartmnet was spotless. Washer and dryer provided which was very convenient.

Prettig verblijf gehad. Nette kamer. Eigen badkamer naast de kamer. Toegankelijk met een eigen code. Er zijn meer kamers in het pand. We hoorden de andere huurders heel soms, maar het was niet storend. Buurt is veilig en ligt achter een villawijk waar Obama gewoond heeft. Buslijnen in de buurt maar hou rekening met 30 tot 50 minuten reizen naar bezienswaardigheden. Het is een grote stad. Wij voelden ons veilig.

We really loved our stay at this lovely garden apartment in Ravenswood. I was in town for a writing workshop at StoryStudio just around the corner and this was the perfect home base. Great restaurants that are walkable (BienMeSabe, Spacca Napoli, and Margie’s Candy were all favorites). The apartment was really beautifully decorated in an eclectic style with lots of stained glass and lots of room to spread out with the living/communal spaces. Highly recommend!
Perfect location, easy walking distance to lots of sites. L and bus lines within a couple of blocks as well as shopping and restaurants.
Great place in a cool neighborhood! The apartment was very spacious, bright, and clean. We loved it and will be back!
Clean, spacious, and beautiful home! Thank you, Matthew!
Good location, good place to stay
It was great, metro is close so going to the city is really easy. The place was nice😇
really good location and close to the 606

**Would stay again!**
We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and accommodating for our small group. Having **three separate bedrooms** was a huge plus and gave everyone their own space.
I had a friend from Chicago help me navigate the area, especially with knowing which areas to be more cautious in/around the airbnb.
For public transportation, we had about a **10-minute walk (roughly half a mile)** to the Green Line station down Cottage Grove which is a Main Street and I would recommend that walk during the daytime but not necessarily at night if you are not familiar with the area.
Overall, the accommodations worked very well for our group, and we enjoyed our stay. I would definitely consider staying here again!
Great place to stay

This was our first time in Chicago and we really enjoyed the location and the house. We had a vehicle but also took transit one day and both were easy to navigate. We felt right at home. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The host was very responsive and the place was well stocked. Thank you! We would definitely stay again.

Nice place, nothing fancy, perfect for our needs. The staff at check in and check out were so friendly and nice. We appreciate kindness! The actual living space was a little worn but clean and comfortable and perfect for our needs. The downstairs, common area was kinda cool and fancy. There is a restaurant connected to the downstairs, "Dawn". it opens at 8, they require....or prefer reservations. They're a little "snooty", not the friendliest or quickest either.
Otoniel was an excellent host—welcoming, responsive, and incredibly helpful throughout my stay. The unit was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, and I would happily stay here again!

We absolutely loved our stay here! The home is absolutely gorgeous, beautifully decorated, comfortable, and clean. It was convenient to get to other parts of the city and was a peaceful place to come back to at the end of the day. It was also a quick walk to lots of great restaurants and shops in Logan Square. Isaac was super welcoming and checked in with us during our stay to make sure we had everything we needed. Would love to return one day!
Good spot and spacious. Not beat neighborhood, bit sketchy. But has parking and is a close walk to a blue line stop. Said it fit up to 6. but was a tight fit with myself and 3 other guys
Dusanka was a great host. The Airbnb is at a perfect spot to really get a feel for real Chicago living.

Very good location for museums. The LAZ parking had space each night. 23rd floor was very quiet and since there are not tall buildings all around to echo street noise, it’s quieter than other spots in Chicago we’ve stayed. Also powerful AC in the unit!
great stay and great location

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was great and communication was seamless. My only minor suggestion would be having an extra set of towels provided for a week-long stay, but otherwise, everything was fantastic. Would definitely recommend!
We enjoyed our stay. Very clean and a nice spacious place.  Loved the outdoor spaces as well and that we could walk to everything we needed.

Dasha and Owen’s place was delightful. We were in Chicago for a   3-day visit, the accommodation was perfect & matched the photos exactly! Lots of great restaurant choices nearby. I would definitely recommend it & would love to stay here again. Our host was so responsive & helpful with any questions we had, we really appreciated that! Great find in Chicago!
Great place. Really clean and quiet. Easy in and out. Would stay here again!

Emily and Rita were excellent hosts. They were responsive and helpful when I needed them. Their place was nice, clean, and cozy!! I would recommend them to anyone who needed a place to stay and would definitely stay with them again.

Great neighborhood, awesome location for a family of four that wanted to avoid the downtown hotels and rates!! We loved how easy it was to grab a bus or the L and yet still feel like we were in a quiet part of town.

Ryan was a very communicative host. As he says on the booking, the neighborhood is a little bit out of the way of usual sites to explore in Chicago but the public transportation connections were super helpful (and almost always consistent). The house is beautiful.
Great communication thank you for allowing us to stay here.
Perfect stay! Becky is very friendly and helpful.
Very clean, nice place!
Great location, as described!

Location was incredible! Parking is expensive around there on weeks that the Cubs are in town but we found a SpotHero lot about 10-15 minute walk away that was a little cheaper and an easy walk. Quick with communication and fairly easy check in/out! Thanks!

We had a wonderful stay and absolutely loved the apartment! It was beautiful, very clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. We felt at home right away and really enjoyed our time there. The host was also very kind and helpful, and communication was always easy. We would definitely recommend this place!
Very good experience! The place is very close to Damen station, making it very easy to get to downtown. There's so much to do in the neighborhood, from coffee shops to taquerias to a free museum.

I stayed Mon-Sat. I had treatments in downtown Chicago. It was very easy to get from downtown to the house about 23 mins. Free street parking which is nice in Chicago.
Nicholas was very responsive. We had 80 mph winds one day and the sirens were going off. He responded to me within mins.
The place was very clean, kitchen had lots of condiments, dishes, pans, etc. also had a Britta filter water in fridge. Important to me as I drink a lot of water.
Bathroom shower was nice and towels were nice and fluffy and big.
Can’t say enough about this place. If you are staying in Chicago and need a safe and clean space this is where I would go.
I didn’t get a chance to go but the Obama Presidential Library is within a few miles. That’s on my bucket list.
The only discrepancy was that it said the bedroom did not have a lock on the door. It does.
It does have a very tall stairway which Nicholas made sure I knew about, was no issue for me but there are about 40 total steps.
Great spot! Highly recommend!
Great place to stay, first time visiting Chicago met all our needs. She was flexible with some of our needs, and very friendly.

We recently stayed here for a concert at the United Center and honestly couldn’t have found a better location. We were close enough to walk to the venue, which was such a plus! The home itself was cute, quaint, and the perfect size for two people. Everything was exactly as described, check-in and check-out were easy, and we never had trouble finding street parking. It’s tucked away enough to feel quiet and removed from the hustle and bustle, while still being close to all the action. We really enjoyed our stay and would absolutely recommend it!

I had a great stay.  The apartment was very clean. The location was right where I wanted to be and restaurants, stores and public transit were very close.  Uptown is a fantastic neighborhood.  Nala and Owen provided clear instructions and had quick responses when I had questions. I can't comment on the noise level.  I wear hearing aides so I knew I would be fine.  I slept great every night.  I would stay again.
Great location! Josh was very responsive.
Very nice spot. Liliana was a responsive, flexible, and friendly host. The unit served as a fine place with all the necessary things I needed during my summer stay.

Unfortunately, we were very disappointed with our stay. The accommodation was not clean, especially the bathrooms. The bathrooms were stained and looked very worn and neglected. There was also hair in the shower, which was very unpleasant.

Great and spacious place! Good location to red line train. Will book again. Christi made sure we were all taken care of in their place and reached out to make sure.
This place was just what I needed for my short trip for my pilot conference. No face towels please bring your own. If you are out late parking can a hassle.
We had a good stay overall. The space was nice and had everything we needed for our trip. Everything went smoothly, and we didn’t have any major issues during our stay. Thanks for hosting us!
Good communication, quiet and comfy place, safe and convenient neighborhood.Thank you Cindy.
The stay was for my mother-in-law, who does not speak any english. Nevertheless Onelia made the stay as easy as possible for her.

We couldn’t have been more happy with our stay for a trip to Chicago! Mimi was so responsive, kind and helpful. We were close to amazing things and beautiful sights. We felt safe, cozy and right at home. I highly recommend for anyone looking for a place to stay in Chicago. Thank you!
Very clean, spacious, comfortable beds. The area seemed safe and was very walkable.

Bed was soft and comfortable. The view of the city is nice albeit its mostly highway. The sunrise was great tho. And its only like 15 minutes from everything on the city pass. Will book again next time im in chicago if the dates line up.

The place was so nice,clean. The location was great, easy to walk to hot place in downtown chicago.
I would love to visit again when I come back to Chicago.

A very pleasant stay in a spacious, well-lit and equipped apartment in a good area. Loved it! Could have used a couple more pillows and cushions, but other than that excellent experience!
Great place! As advertised.

Nicole and Matt's house was a dream vacation experience. This place was very clean and affordable. Amber was very responsive and helpful and answered any questions I had diligenty.

Highly recommend this studio apartment for solo or couple travelers to Chicago. This might be the first air bnb I’ve stayed in that was actually nicer than the photos. Very clean, comfortable bed, great AC, and had a washer and dryer. Excellent location that was less than a 10 minute walk to the blue line station (easy access to ohare and downtown Chicago), and all of the Bucktown/Wicker Park restaurants and bars, but was also super quiet at night.
Very responsive and accommodating host

Great place good for semi long stays!
Good
Amazing place and beautiful room! This will definitely be my first choice stay anytime I visit Chicago!

The house was easy to find and impeccably clean upon entry. The neighborhood is working class and friendly. People were very polite when I passed them on the street. Three easy blocks from the Cottage Grove L station, and the 4 or X4 make for a very quick bus ride to UChicago. I’ll definitely be staying here again when I return to the area!
Great place to stay during our trip to Chicago. All the amenities made it a comfortable stay for a family!

This was truly a fantastic stay! The house was absolutely gorgeous, the neighborhood felt safe, and our host was incredibly friendly, responsive, and welcoming. Tim even allowed us to check in a little early which was so nice. He also gave us great recommendations for activities/restaurants.

It genuinely felt like a home away from home—but better. We couldn’t have asked for a nicer experience and would highly recommend staying here!

We can’t say enough about Vlad, Hannah and the apartment! Great location in a lovely neighborhood. Walking distance to many restaurants and amenities. The apartment was very clean and comfortable with all the creature comforts and necessities. It’s very stylishly decorated as well with lots of sunlight. Also dog friendly with an ample fenced yard. We would definitely stay here again and are grateful for such wonderful hosts!

A very safe and secured place in a fun and thriving nightlife area. Buses and trains are within walking distance, great cafes and lots to do. Close to downtown without feeling like you’re in downtown. I’d definitely try and book this place again for next time. The room is on the top level of a secured building, so safety was great and if you’re okay with a few levels of stairs this is the place for you.

My family and I really enjoyed staying at Seth’s beautiful loft for a couple of nights! Everything was squeaky clean and we immediately felt at home. Location is great - right in the middle of a ton of good restaurants and things to do.

Amazing place, right by the train, so transportation from either airport was so simple! If I visit Chicago again, highly considering coming here again!!
Innesa is also a great host, and her communication from the start was perfect; couldn't ask for more!
This place was exactly what my friends and I needed.
The place was great. Easy access to the apartment. The host checked in on me to make sure everything was ok. Made my trip very accommodating
Everything was listed accurately, the host was responsive, and my stay went very smoothly! The neighborhood is incredibly walkable, with so much to do nearby. Would stay here again.

It's a nice, comfortable place. There is some traffic noise so if you are a light sleeper you may be bothered. There were some items that could be improved upon. I recommend this apartment. The neighborhood is nice with a great grocery store that is an easy walk.
Great
Pretty solid stay. There was a few issues with locating the building at first bur overall pretty simple stay. Good for short stays.

This place exceeded our expectations. The apartment was perfectly clean and well appointed. The location is great for local shops and restaurants, and near enough to bus stops and a subway station. Highly recommended.
Great location - close to Wrigley Field, the L and bus line to travel toward downtown or airport. Also walking distance to other neighborhoods that were also fun to explore.

I stayed with my 2 grandkids at Lisa's place. Clean, roomy, safe and very convenient. I loved sitting on the porch morning and evenings. The two bedrooms were perfect as my grandaughter had her own room. 5 minute walk to the CTA Damen station.
We had a great time! Really comfortable place in a lovely location

Character abounds with this property!  For anyone that has stayed in corporate housing while traveling, this property offers comfort mixed with a bit of eclectic feel (without the Beetlejuice effect. Street parking is a great addition as well, but like any downtown space is a premium so visitors will want to find a spot before nightfall.  If there were a frequent traveler program e.g., similar to some hotel brands, I’d probably come to the area more often.
This place was as advertised! Clean and in the perfect location that I needed. Milan is very attentive and communicates well! I will return here if I have to come back to Chicago

We truly lucked out finding such a comfortable place to stay for 3 nights at the last minute and at a great price compared to other (very limited) options!Clean, bright, and great air conditioning, plus hot water and high water pressure - important for someone who likes to boil like a lobster in the shower. The TV was easy to use, and the sofa is comfortable and clean. There is plenty of space for two people to work effectively from the apartment. Ample free street parking, provided you arrive before 5 p.m. or so. (We went straight to a concert so we didn't check in until around 11 p.m., and we had to park a few blocks away. No big deal and not surprising, but worth mentioning for folks who don't visit Chicago often. We had no issue finding parking right out front the following afternoon!) We highly recommend Big Bird for great cocktails and Thai food (10 minute walk) and Sugar Moon (15 minute walk) for all kinds of baked goods.
Great host!

The apartment was well maintained and in a very central location.  Parking was easily found in a lot across the street for a reduced guest rate.  Host was extremely responsive with messages answered within a few minutes.

No issues. A great place to stay in Chicago.

Our quick getaway to Chicago was great with this AirBnb! Super simple little spot within walking distance of so much! But, our stay was great and communication was always respectful and helpful all the time! Will look to stay again if we are in town for events downtown!
The place was awesome! Shay was super helpful! I would stay again.
Easy routes to downtown. Very helpful!
Excellent apartment and wonderful host. Recommend!

Our stay at Soraya’s place was short, but I highly recommend it.
The location is excellent, only 10 min by Uber from downtown.
The place was super clean, and Soraya was always available if we needed anything.

The bathroom was quite neglected—rusty and corroded—and had a broken window that couldn't be closed. Worst of all, we couldn't sleep one night because a neighbor next door was partying, and the next night same because neighbors on the other side of the street held a disco until 5 a.m. When we asked the host to intervene or call the police, he simply replied that it wasn't him making the noise and that he didn't intend to do anything about it. Great stay! We initially had some trouble with the code not working, but the hosts were very responsive and helped us resolve the issue right away. The space was clean and comfortable.
