Nice place but especially worth it because of the perfect walkability to everything we needed, food fun and the lake!

Fantastic location if you’re looking to go to the Obama center. It’s a beautiful 25 min walk through a college. Also if you use the “Our Neighborhood” page of the presidential center everything listed is 15 min drive away. We stayed 5 days and had a wonderful time exploring just the south side.
Mary was an incredible host my long term internship stay. The place was exactly as described, great location for an easy commute into the loop, and clean and homely.

My son stayed here during his summer internship in Chicago, and we were very pleased with the experience. The place was very clean, exactly as advertised, and conveniently located with easy access to downtown. The host was very responsive and helpful, and the regular cleaning service was an added bonus. Zheng was a fantastic host. The instructions for entry were clear, the room was exactly as described, and he was extremely understanding when my flight got delayed. Overall, a wonderful and very friendly host, plus only a 20-minute walk from the nearby conference center.

Hoping this place is available for my next trip to Chicago!

My son enjoyed the turntable and jazz record collection and my granddaughter loved having the keyboard available to play at this property. It was an enjoyable perk to our stay!

An excellent location if you’re looking to stay in Chicago, very close to downtown. You can find parking just a few blocks away. Shomari was very friendly and always attentive to our needs during our stay.
Had a great stay! Matthew was an amazing host!

Nice, new kitchen items. Very hot water!

Clean and comfortable -- a great base for getting out and about and as a recharging respite in between outings.

Awesome place to stay, very comfortable the surroundings are amazing, overall it was a great experience.

MD was an excellent host. Super responsive and proactive, even offered us a ride because of the rain. Space was exactly as described. We will definitely stay again. Thank you so much for a great stay!

Host very responsive and friendly. The neighborhood felt safe and homely. I felt comfortable walking, traveling in and out of unit no matter the time of day. Unit was clean and met my expectations for what I needed for a comfortable stay.

Loved this place. It was immaculate and spacious enough for my son and me!! I loved the building. We didn’t rent a car because I didn’t want to deal with parking but public transportation was very close and the location was Uber friendly! All in all, it was a great stay and experience in Chicago.

Great place a short distance from Wrigley. Convenient parking pad off the street to park my Motorcycle as I was on a cross country trip and didn't want to leave on the street. Very reapo side with my questions as well!
Very clean and neat. Close to a lot of small restaurants and coffee shops. Would stay again. Thank you so much!
We had a great stay. Great hospitality and quick responsiveness made everything very stress free.

This was perfect for two people reasonably priced restaurants and cafes in the area lots of things within walking distance and also near the train station just overall very convenient definitely recommend staying here.
Nice place and great location. Outdoor grills on 7th  and Trader Joe’s around the corner are great for quick meals. Only downside is pool was not in service. Apartment was spacious and  very clean.

We had access to the third floor and the fourth floor. It wasn’t as bad as I expected it to be, and once we were in the apartment with our family members, things felt very spacious. The place was clean, the host was very responsive and helpful.

A good budget friendly option within a very walkable distance to different public transportation, the host was friendly and quick to respond to questions we had and an overall great place to stay when traveling!
This was the best Airbnb I've stayed at in Chicago. The location and accommodations were perfect, and it felt like home. I really appreciated Donald's communication.
Very nice place! Clean and amazing view to the city!

great restaurants and walkability with access to transit! it was the perfect little airbnb for a couple on a short stay :)

No hair anywhere, the couch was spotless, the bathroom was super clean, the bed was comfy, linens were fresh, and there were plenty of towels.
Ruth and her family are incredibly friendly and make sure you have everything you need while still giving you plenty of privacy. The neighborhood is cute and quiet with nice sidewalks for walking your dog, and street parking was easy. It’s close enough to enjoy downtown but far enough away to relax after a busy day.
As someone who LOVES winter, I can’t wait to come back! It has such a cute, cottagey feel and I can already picture watching the snow fall through the front windows. 10/10! ❤️

Claude’s place was perfect
For my first visit to Chicago. The flat is more than spacious enough.
Everything is provided for your stay from fresh linens/Towels
And plenty of Stuff for laundry loads.
Someone mentioned that they damaged clothes here. I can assure you folks that the machine works fine and one should simply be mindful of what settings they use for washing.
A nice kitchen sits in the center with top of the line equipment.
Good tv with streaming. Big windows to see outside into the city.
Powerful AC unit that actually drowned out the noise which was great. I still recommend ear plugs for sleeping just in case though.
Shower was roomy and ultra water pressure was fantastic.
Check in was smooth. I know some people were worried about finding the lock box behind the building. It’s really not that bad. The apartment is surrounded by businesses and it takes two seconds to get it and enter the place.
Most of all, Claude was a gracious host. Communicated almost in

This is a great place to stay in Chicago! Central to everything you'd need in the city. Host was very proactive in communication, and check-in was made very clear and easy! The bar down the street was a great spot for some late night drinks and food.
Lovely place! We love to stay here next time!
Everything about this location was excellent! Great location, great spot, and wonderful host!

We brought our two dogs with us and enjoyed our stay! The neighborhood was nice, and we were able to walk our dogs every day without issue. Michelle also provided several dog-friendly recommendations nearby, and she was quick to respond. We would stay here again!

This was a great spot for my boyfriend and I for a short vacation. The neighborhood was quite and comfortable. Very walkable and accessible by bus. There was plenty of street parking and great restaurants/coffee in the vicinity. The apartment was comfortable with such cute decorations and a nice kitchen area. There were a few mosquitos in the room but otherwise, it was a perfect destination.
she was amazing everyone was super nice the free food items was a bonus but still super sweet!! i definitely recommended here!!
Great home and host! Perfect place for a Chicago stay.

A fantastic stay at this apartment. It is actually so much bigger than it seems in photos.
Abel was attentive and extremely helpful. Everything was clean and welcoming.
The apartment is less than a 20 minute walk from Lincoln Zoo and the surrounding neighbourhood felt safe and is beautiful. We would love to come back one day.
Great location! Loved the house!! Great host! Thank you!
Great place in Old Town with lots of character. The roof deck was amazing. Matt is a terrific host.
We had a lovely stay in Chicago and the rental unit is well located, clean, and very comfortable!
Great spot to stay, very clean and had everything needed!
Perfect stay for big families, close to everything. Very nice modern apartment, clean and with everything we need. Thank you
Very nice place
Everything was good
Rachel's place gave us plenty of room for my son and I for our stay in Chicago. It was clean and budget friendly compared to hotels downtown. I would stay here again.
Great spot to stay in! Definitely recommend it!

Great central location in Logan Square/Avondale and the whole check in/out process was seamless. We all very much enjoyed our stay! The place was super clean and convenient to all of the city's public transit. Thanks again!

It was a great stay, and the location was perfect.
Great place to stay in West Loop!

The accommodations were trendy and comfortable. We liked having a full kitchen and a separate entrance with both gate and door codes for added security. I didn’t pay attention to the early check-in policy and didn’t end up needing it, the fee is not refunded if you don’t end up arriving early.

A hidden gem in Chicago! Marco and Sarah were very attentive to details to enhance our stay. Our train arrived very early coming into Chicago and very late leaving-- Marco and Sarah were accommodating and allowed us an earlier check in and late check out. The home was cozy and the neighborhood was peaceful. After a long day of sightseeing, it was nice to head back to a comfortable place to relax. If given the opportunity, we would defintely stay at this home again.
It was a great stay

The apartment was very affordable compared to local hotels - great value! It was central to public transportation and everything was very clean. It was just as described. We enjoyed making breakfast in the kitchen.
I definitely recommend this air bnb! The location is perfect and near all the tourist attractions, great area! The Airbnb is spotless, and Assel is very friendly and responsive.

This was a great place for our family while we were unexpectedly delayed in Chicago for a couple of days. Host was super responsive and helpful. The place was very clean and clearly recently remodeled very nicely. Would definitely stay here again. There isn't a lot to do right in the neighborhood (that we found) but it is right next to two bus lines so between that an Uber/Lyft (Divvy bikes right across the street too) you can get to all the Chicago places super easily. The place was secure, clean, nice and a great fit for our family.

I really liked the house! It has three floors plus a basement, a huge number of rooms and bathrooms, and convenient parking. It is very comfortable and beautiful, and features skylights. Excelente estadia en la casa de Saurin, el departamento es hermoso, nos quedamos en la habitacion principal que es muy espaciosa, muy cómoda y un baño increible. Great place to stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and quiet. Check-in was easy, and everything we needed was well prepared. We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend it!

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and everything we needed was available. Wonderful place to stay, would stay again.

Great Location for our visit.
Response fro Bianca was very efficient.

Danny’s Airbnb was a 5/5 during our stay in Chicago. Great location, lots of restaurants, very walkable. My husband and I stayed here with our 4 month old and my parents. Enough space for all of us.
Danny was an amazing communicator, constantly checked in, responded to all messages within minutes.

If you need a quiet, comfortable, safe place to stay in Jefferson Park,  this is a great choice.   Easy walking to the grocery and drugstore.  Quiet apartment, plenty of parking.   The kitchen is well equipped.   We stay here frequently when visiting our daughter and her family.

My overall experience was average after staying here for a day despite my 2 days booking. Zhih was responsive to call.
The place has an old-fashioned atmosphere. The floor felt quite sticky, which made the accommodation feel less clean and comfortable. The overall setting also has an old house feel. The bathroom did not have basic toiletries such as hand wash, body wash, or lotion. The linens were clean, but they looked quite old.
Due to these issues, I decided to leave a day earlier than planned and moved to another accommodation.
The location was relatively convenient, only about 5–6 miles from the city center. However, there were only a few food options nearby.
Overall, it was an average stay and reasonably priced for the accommodation.
Good location. Clean. Exactly as described.

Gorgeous house and plenty of space. Loved all the different places to hang out and the extra amenities. Wish weather would've cooperated to enjoy the nice roof terraces.
Seating in living room was a little low for older adults, but was comfy.
Great stay at Cheryl’s place. Fantastic location, quiet, and close to many amazing spots to eat. Near several buses and a 15 minute walk to the blue line. Highly recommend a stay!
Loved it!

The view is absolutely gorgeous - truly one of the highlights of the stay.
There was plenty of furniture, and everything was comfortable, including the bed and pillows. The bathrooms were spacious, and we really enjoyed the pool.
Building access was easy and felt very secure, and the entire building was clean and smelled amazing throughout.
And did I mention the view? 😍 Absolutely incredible.
I enjoyed my stay. Everything was clean and peaceful. The area was quiet and beautiful, and the place looked exactly like the photos. I would definitely stay here again.

Stayed for a weekend at Sharon's place even though i never saw her. Management done by Hank (ex marine).
Location was excellent.
Checkin - entrancebehind the building - you have to unlock 3 doors to get in apartment.
NO keylock option -- in case you arrive late
Room was nice; too warm even with ceiling fan - NO AC.
Bed has good mattress; room has a midsize fridge which was convenient; with adequate hangers in the closet.
Shared bathroom was very clean; not allowed to have bath after 9PM.
Enjoyed chatting with Hank who has been through a lot, being a Marines and Vietnam veteran. The house is a shrine to the Vietnam war with murals and gigantic memorials everywhere. There is also a thin blue line flag (black travelers beware).
Hank was friendly but constantly around in the house monitoring your activity - whether you are walking around in apartment.
Overall, a great place to stay when in town.
The apartment was in an amazing location. We loved getting up and walking to grab coffee. It’s not fancy by any means, but it’s clean and comfortable. We would come back again!
地段和房间都很好，房间也很宽敞，只是停车比较困难
Great stay. Clean and close to the theater!

had a great stay here! house was super clean, AC unit in room, and very quiet for it being a shared space! neighborhood isn’t the greatest for solo female traveling, wouldn’t go anywhere around here at night, but walking to the blue line during the day i felt okay 😁! host was super communicative, thorough, and kind! would definitely stay again!
Awesome stay! Walkable neighborhood, great service and responsive host. Would definitely stay here again.
It was very lovely great location thank you for answering all of our questions!

We really appreciated Kitty’s hospitality. Our stay was enjoyable overall, though we encountered a few minor issues—the ice machine didn’t work, WiFi was spotty, and the front door knob kept coming loose (which became a running joke after a couple weeks). We managed fine, and honestly it didn’t detract much from the experience. Kitty was extremely responsive, and her place is beautifully located—walkable and convenient whether you need a car or not.

Location was great and the area felt safe as well as being clean. The only issue was getting in and out of main entrance as the lock was difficult so had to primarily walk around the block to enter through the back door.
Will definitely return
Cozy garden level place with easy walk to Wrigleyville and restaurants. Strongly recommend and will visit again!
Love this Airbnb! Great location, good for walking, feels safe, and right near Output (wings, yum)! It has everything you need including parking. The host is awesome, very responsive.

Place was exactly as it seems. Was welcomed with great hospitality and treats + drinks. Pillows were so soft and comfy it had me asking myself I I wanted to buy one of them too. Was much more worth it than a hotel, and I got it for a great deal. Loved the spacious kitchen as well. All in all, if I were to do another trip in Chicago I’ll definitely book this place again.

Always a pleasure staying here !!!! I love how walkable the area is and the train station is less than 5 minutes away. Comfy , cozy , and quiet. Can’t ask for much more !!! Parking is tight but doable
Great host, super communicative and accommodating
Really nice and comfortable place

Cute home. Check in process was good, but the keypad door is to the side of the house where you do entry exit. it would’ve been lovely if it was in the front door. Front door is accessible but needs to be locked from inside first. House is great, renovated clean and peaceful but appliances are aging up. Some appliances like the fridge, bathroom shower, iron etc needs to be upgraded. The bathroom door gets stuck at times to the vanity which is a minor issue.
We had an AC not working issue to which the owner fixed the very next day, and gave us 3 fans the night before which was very kind.
Also I requested for a late check out, and the owner very kindly agreed.
Would love to come back.

Great stay, house was clean and exactly as was described and pictured, the instructions were easy to get in and out.   Jamie even accommodated my need to have something sent to the house.  Perfect location, in the middle of everything and easy walk to blue line.  Would stay there again with my family when I visit Chicago, we had a lovely time.

Lyle was a great host and very detail, the place had everything you need for a group of 4 , Perfect place if your going to the United Center for any event or getting to the train station which was very useful. Kitchen has everything you need. Living room was perfect , Rooms are slightly small mainly due to the positions of the bed , however the beds themselves were great and it beats getting a hotel…..10/10
Great stay!

We loved this AirBNB! We stayed for a few days with our two daughters, and had plenty of space and privacy, and everything was spotless and well-maintained. We definitely appreciated the convenience of the washer dryer.
We had an issue that required maintenance, and James quickly put in a ticket and followed up to make sure it was complete (in the end, someone had touched an a/c setting—one of my kids?—and it was an easy fix). The neighborhood was very walkable—we were within a 20 minute walk of most of what we wanted to see, and it was great to see the neighborhoods changing. There’s a grocery downstairs and a Whole Foods (and Eataly!) close by.
Really great home base for your family trip!

We had an excellent time staying here. When we walked in we were so impressed by the furnishings and cleanliness. And for the price, it was extremely impressive. We also really enjoyed the restaurants in the area and the ones recommended to us. If we are ever in the Chicago area again, we will be sure to see if this place is available!

Pros: very close to Belmont blue line station, Aldi grocery, cute neighborhood with shops, mostly quiet in general and I didn’t feel unsafe at all. There were plenty of dishes, snacks, and soap in the kitchen and bath. Motion lights were helpful.
Cons: the stairs to the apartment were very steep and have a 180 turn. It was hard to get our luggage up and down safely. There was clutter on both front and back stairs in the way. The back door keypad didn’t work. Cleanliness wasn’t great, but not the worst. A more thorough vacuuming was needed as the person before us clearly had a pet with them. Hair in the bathroom and a makeup sponge left under a desk.
The bigger concerns were that the listing was under host “Romana” and all of the info in the apartment (including emergency contact) was “Krystian.” There was no cohost listed, so that made me uncomfortable as to who I was communicating with. Street parking is very crowded. We had a storage topper on our car so we couldn’t use the garage.

El alojamiento de Erik sin duda vale la pena: es muy cómodo, acogedor y está ubicado estratégicamente para desplazarse con facilidad. Erik y su familia son personas muy amables, serviciales y atentos en todo momento. Nos sentimos muy bien durante nuestra estadía. Lo recomiendo totalmente y sin duda volvería a hospedarme aquí!

We had an amazing stay here, it is 5 minutes away from all the restaurants, a big grocery store and bakeries. It is spacious and since you are on the top floor there is access to the gym and a huge rooftop terrasse where you can see the whole downtown view of Chicago.
10/10, very responsive host, would absolutely book this place our next time in Chicago if available.

We loved our visit to Chicago and the Bucktown location was a great place to stay.  The apartment is as described.  It was super clean, had good kitchen amenities, plenty of towels, and very comfortable beds.  We liked the quirky elements of an older property (original door knobs, squeaky wood floors).  We enjoyed the local shopping and a few meals at the Royal Grocery.  We would stay here again!  Jean was easy to communicate with  a great host.
Great place to stay for our four night stay. Easy transportation from the bus to the city, neighborhood was very peaceful and very close to the back. Would definitely choose this option again
Overall just amazing.
The condo is beautiful. Very clean. Felt like home. A lot of room.

Really enjoyed the stay, the place was super clean. Great layout, 3 nice bedrooms. Charie was also super responsive and helpful. would defo stay again and recommend for others!
Iris place was great. Easy check in and great communication. Would stay here again.
We had a great stay. The Airbnb was close to some great spots to ride the bus or the L to the city: great location and super easy process.
got to stay at Kim's place for market days 2026 and had a great experience. They are very responsive and want to be of help when needed.
Great stay

Great stay in a really convenient location. The train was close by, and having onsite parking was definitely worth it. The space looked just like the pictures and had everything we needed. Overall, a great value for the money and we’d definitely stay here again.
Candace was a wonderful and accommodating host. The space was clean and comfortable and a great location - we loved our stay and would certainly book again in a heartbeat!!

The actual condition and appearance of the property do not match the photos in the listing. Great stay!

Overall I’d like to say that this was a comfortable stay. The space was clean and pristine as I got in there and check in was very easy based on the instructions mentioned. I only had one issue with the stay and that was just a brief issue with one of the bathrooms in the Airbnb, and that was handled in such a quick fashion that it left me impressed as not alot of hosts respond to issues of any kind as fast as this one was.
Overall this is a location I’d recommend if possible to anyone that is looking to stay in the area. I thank the host for their hospitality and responsiveness and look to stay at any of their properties in the future.
It was a amazing and beautiful home a great place to stay

This was a small vacation from our annual visit with family (we live in Texas but from Chicago) and it was wonderful. The space is barely off the beaten path which made it quieter than expected but close enough to walk to the bustle of the city. Sean was a very accessible host, quick with responding with any questions we had. The space was exactly what we expected from the pics and description. We’d definitely come back if Sean’s space is available to us again in the future!
We had the best time in Chicago. This location was absolutely perfect and the air bnb had everything we needed.
Very well presented house with clear instruction.  We had a good time.  thanks

The home was lovely and had a beautiful, cozy vibe. Would strongly recommend to anyone looking for a slice of authentic Chicago life in a  medium density area. Easy access to the city and great local stores make this an ideal location to relax and get away. Beware there are low ceilings running through the unit that would be problematic for anyone over 6ft tall.
Great location to public transportation - right next to the El and subway. Was a nice, quiet building.  Host left detailed instructions that made it easy to check in. We had a great time!

We loved the place.
Comfortable spacious house. With a lot of street.parking around.
Very close to city center.
We'd gladly come back on our next visit to chicago
Great place to stay!

This place was exactly as described. Pool on the roof, nice gym available also. The unit is clean, minimalist, and modern, mostly comfortable. Great windows with a view. I like that it includes laundry, also. Parking included, off-site, several blocks. Host was responsive and aided w/grocery delivery.
But, a few things stood out to me.
There aren’t blackout drapes in the bedrooms. Light filters in at all times, particularly when the sun comes up. The toilet seat in the black bedroom can’t be put all of the way up, due to the shelving over the toilet. The same bedroom closet door and bathroom door can’t be open at the same time - which happened a lot. The living room furniture is very small and basic. No room to stretch out, only a very small love seat that seats two and a single swiveling chair that seats one. So, for four or more people, just not a comfortable place to watch TV.
The kitchen is stocked w/basic dishes and pans and a Keurig and coffee/creamer.
Clean place all around. Definitely get what you pay for, not super high quality but is just fine for a couple nights.
위치는 나쁘지 않음. 다운타운까지 20~30분. 화이트삭스 경기장이 걸어서 갈 수 있는 거리에 있음. 다만 객실 바닥에 머리카락 , 특히 화장실 욕조에 머리카락이 너무 많음. 전반적으로 깨끗하다는 느낌이 드는 숙소는 아니었음
Beautiful building and great and safe location. Easily walkable to restaurants, movie theater, grocery store and gas station. Nice linens and towels, love the tree lined streets in the neighborhood.

We had a wonderful few nights here. The accommodation is very spacious and comfortable and free parking is a bonus! Laura made check in simple and was extremely communicative throughout our stay. Highly recommend, would book again!

Staying here was an excellent decision on our part. The location allowed us to walk to all the main attractions downtown, and overall it was a fantastic stay.
It is very close to the train, which you can hear, but it was never so disruptive that we lost sleep or anything like that.
The one problem we had is there’s clearly some hot water issues with the building, resulting in a lot of trial and error and time wasted (and water) trying to figure out how to get a hot shower going. One of the showers doesn’t get hot unless the other one is going, which leads to a logistical discussion every night that takes up more brain power than you should have to worry about when paying for a stay at this level. Depending on your party size this may be a non issue.

The hosts were very accommodating; I messed up the dates of our arrival in Chicago and they really went out of their way to help us out. The place is very clean and well decorated, and probably has the easiest parking in Chicago.

House was easy to find from the detailed instructions provided to us by the host.  The home was smaller than expected, but did the job.  Quiet neighborhood close to good food and great for White Sox games.  The house needs new blinds, some are broken.  There is a flood light outside that is clearly malfunctioning throughout the night, it goes off every 5 minutes and shines through the left bedroom, even with the blinds closed.  This caused sleeping issues.  Everything else was fine.  It wasn’t the nicest Air BnB experience we have had,  but it wasn’t the worst.

The place was exactly what I needed for my trip to Chicago. It’s old, but the price reflects that and Jevaux does not take the location nor demand for granted. I loved it. It was suitable for my simple needs, but the kitchen is tiny as is the bathroom. But everything works great and there’s nothing wrong with a place lacking “frills”. I messaged Jevaux a couple of times with questions and he was very helpful and responded quickly. I’ll definitely stay there again!

Very good stay, comfortable clean room and place as a whole. Very convenient location with many shops, pubs, places to eat. Just about anything ya need/want is in walking distance or near public transportation. Neat and quiet area where the property is also

I rated this place 4 Stars, but it could/should be a 5. The apartment is spacious and Jonathan is a great host, responsive and accommodating. There have been a lot of upgrades and remodeling - bathroom, kitchen, large TV, good air conditioning. The beds are very comfortable. Great neighborhood, easy parking, access to restaurants, parks, mass transit to downtown, and shopping in the neighborhood and in near suburbs, and 10 minutes from O'Hare.
On the downside, there were a number of quirks and annoyances that detract from what should be an excellent rental. LR and DR furniture is feeling a bit tired, sinky. The L-Shaped sectional sofa is overly large/deep - 3 to 4 feet deep to the back cushions. Not ideal for sitting up. One door is missing from the shower, and the wand has a major leak. Very few outlets. Bring extension cords. Good AC, but none in bedroom if doors are closed. Needs some TLC - artwork/mirror to be hung, scuffs and nail holes, maybe a deep clean.

Great Location!! Alex was awesome on recommendations to eat in the area and above and beyond to help with any other questions that I had. Place was exactly as described. I would definitely book with Alex again when back in Chicago!!! 10/10
It's a great Hostel! I would stay here again. Because it's a shared space, the bathroom and the kitchen were not always clean, but nothing that would keep me from coming again. I recommend!

Great airbnb, exactly as described and with full accommodations, even an extra umbrella when we needed it! Alfredo is a great communicator and that helped us feel comfortable during our time in the Big City.  Downstairs neighbors were very pleasant and friendly. We felt safe and comfortable. Don't miss out on the tacos and matcha at the bodega: their barbacoa is unmatched!

Excellent location, beautiful, quiet,  and had everything we needed for a few days in our favorite city. Perfect spot for local activities and easy access to transit. Benjamin was a great host and would absolutely stay here again.

This was my first time using Airbnb and I’d say over it was good experience and I would stay here again. The decor was nice it’s kinda small but it was fine for 3 people! The only downfall was the parking we had to park a few blocks away every night we stayed.

Right on the edge of McKinley Park.  There was a coffee truck parked outside the window almost every morning.  You can get a coffee and walk the park.  Great!

Milan was an exceptional host. Any questions I had, the response was instant and very helpful. Videos and pictures were provided for check in for entering the apartment and building. I would 100% book with Milan again!
Amazing views and space! Host was very responsive.

We had an awesome stay. The neighborhood is amazing. It’s on a relatively quiet residential street in the middle of Lincoln Park. We walked to the zoo and there is a fun playground at Oz park. One day we biked to downtown and the other day we took the red line. Both days were neat adventures. The apartment was great, a modest space in a neat old house. We had a great trip.
We all really enjoyed our stay!!

Our stay was great! The place was a bit smaller than we expected but it wasn’t an issue by any means. Very convenient location on top of being very peaceful, especially with the covered patio. Overall we had a great time and we’re thankful for the recommendations given by the host! Would for sure stay again!
Slow to communicate and only downside was that it didn’t have any public detergent to do laundry but great service from housekeeping would come again

We stayed at Laura's place for a long weekend vacation in Chicago with our two kids.  The house was nicely appointed.  The neighborhood was great.  Plenty of free parking, nice and quiet, and close to plenty of transit options.  Laura was a great host, communicative and provided plenty of information.  I'd stay again.

Kevin was very responsive and helpful, and the place was very cozy and in a great neighborhood! This was my first time in Chicago and Kevin’s place was very close to everything my boyfriend and I came out to see and do!
