Great location! Very quiet neighborhood with shopping and great restaurants right around the corner. The house is perfect for traveling with kids. Plenty of space for everyone. Very nice accommodations!
The stay was amazing we loved the place and its amenities like the board and card games and the snacks and water was an amazing surprise. Next time we come down we will be staying again.
Dave was great at communicating. Lovely American house, good location and plenty of rooms and has a great bbq.
Beautiful home, spacious rooms. Love that there was a garage and all doors are coded. Primary bedroom is super bright in the morning if you like to sleep in, bring am eye mask.

Ruimte is nog groter dan op de foto. Erg schoon. Goede locatie om vlot en snel in het centrum van Chicago te geraken. Alles in de airbnb zelf werkte goed. Alles wat je nodig hebt voor een verblijf was aanwezig. Matthew was erg responsief en bezorgde ons duidelijke instructies. Zeker een aanrader!
Fantastic unit that is in a good location — close to everything you will need. Communicative host!

We loved staying at Nicole and Matt’s place with our young kids and friends! The game room was a huge hit, and we loved the open layout of the kitchen and living room. The back patio was amazing! We ended up having dinner out there the first night. It was also super close to buses and the L, which made getting around really easy.
Beautiful place. Awesome skyline view. Lincoln park shopping walkable. Transit easy walk to red line. Will stay again. Thanks
Great place great host I will be back again

A breath taking view through massive windows uplifted us every time we walked in.
Location: wonderful. The apartment is located on a low key residential street, but is just a few short blocks from the excitement of downtown.
Quiet: the neighborhood is peaceful, the building activity is very serene, the apartment construction blocked out sounds extremely well. There is a train depot nearby but it was not an issue at all.
Gym: astonishing! It's spotless, sprawling, luxurious, and filled with new equipment.
Clean/style: the apartment is very clean and supplied with everything we needed. The furniture is in fine shape and we had lots of seating. Modern and minimalist with warmth.
Our host was responsive and made an effort to fulfill our special request, which was truly helpful. We felt welcomed.
My suggestion would be to ask the cleaners to be more observant of details that need attention and relay them back to the owner to give her a chance to attend to them.
Overall: wonderful!
Great place.   Have stayed here before

We had a wonderful stay with a party of four couples, totally eight people. The only thing we wished we had were more pillows on the last two beds at least if not, all four beds need just some additional pillows and the icemaker in the refrigerator freezer did not work. But with those small items that state was beautiful the penthouse was beautiful. The deck on the top floor was beautiful. You're close enough to the water probably about four blocks away and so many stores and eateries of clubs are within walking distance. Great place I would return it again.
Honestly everything was great. Great host, great location in respects to soldier field
Right in the center of the loop and easy to get anywhere.  El stop on the block.  Home is clean and easy to use.
Nicely decorated apartment, and very clean.  Great location- many restaurants and shops within walking distance.

We had a nice stay in the South Loop for a few days. Easy access to the museum campus to get to the Shedd or the Field museum. Also close by lakeshore drive to get access to the north neighborhoods (we were visiting a few college campuses). Lots of public parking nearby. (Used spot hero for a great rate). There was street noise and frequent trains passing, but this was expected for the city living location. Used uber to get to shopping destinations. We didn’t explore too many nearby restaurants but had a delicious dinner at Lou Malnati’s one night and drove to Little Italy (easy to get to by car) another night. Great accommodations! Open, spacious, plenty of room. Great stay.

Great neighborhood location with fun shops nearby and very convenient access to the L. The train noise takes a moment to get used to, but quickly became background noise and our kids' sleep right through it. It’s my understanding that updates to finishes and furniture are in the works, which will make the space even better. Overall, a great budget friendly base for exploring the city!

Great spot for my short stay! Very clean, and quiet. The bathroom isn't attached to the room but it is directly opposite and close by. Less than 15 minute walk to united center which was super convenient for me. Tye was also very responsive! Ultimately I would stay here again!
Amazing host , would recommend 100 percent
I definitely will be back @ this listening; the views, amenities, staff, and overall home ambiance was truly appreciated

I booked this place hoping my 2 friends would have more room, space and freedom than if they were to squeeze into my little studio downtown
1) They were put into a room the size of a closet with very uncomfortable bunk beds. There’s no airflow in the room, the 1 fan in the closet was broken and covered in dust. The guests aren’t allowed in the backyard and there are quiet hours between 9pm and 8am. 9PM quiet hours? Are we in a retirement home?
2) Jane failed to notify any of the guests staying this week that the water was shut off from 9am until 1pm on August 9th. I’m not sure how many people were staying at the same time, but between the large amount of people sharing 1 bathroom and having no water? Incredibly irresponsible to host and not tell anyone.
I actually wound up cancelling the trip halfway and thankfully got a partial refund.
Jane, I wish you well, but this whole place feels like a scam. I will never book with you again and I hope others read this as a warning.

A really great apartment in a fun and walkable neighborhood. The layout of the apartment is spacious and it receives lots of natural light from windows. The kitchen is by far the most stocked of all the AB&B s we've stayed at.
It is a 3rd floor walk up with an older staircase, but well worth it if you are able to climb stairs.
We will definitely stay again if it's open the next time we come to Chicago.
Overall, the stay was okay. The place was fine, but there were no towels provided, which was inconvenient. Other than that, everything was decent.
Nous avons séjourné 3 nuits dans le logement de Laura. À 20mn à pied de la ligne de métro donc facile d’accès. Quartier sûr. Appartement spacieux pour nous 4. Merci !
The play was great! And very clean. Host was very great with communication! Will stay again next Vacation.

I stayed in Chicago for 4 days and 3 nights under Assel's bookings, and it was perfect!! The place was clean, had everything you needed for a stay,  and the host responded quickly with detailed information. I would recommend this place!!
Bryan was great!

We had a great stay at Olga’s place. It was a convenient location, clean, and plenty of space for us and our two kids. Olga was very responsive and accommodating to my requests/questions. We’ll definitely be back to stay here when visiting our friends.
Great location. Easy to get to transit. Clean and comfy place to stay. Great to have a full kitchen and fridge.

Absolutely loved my stay here. Scott was so kind and friendly- we ended up chatting a lot. Very attentive, hospitable and great recommendations. The property is so peaceful with a beautiful garden. The apartment is very private, tidy and clean. Great neighborhood too with lots of restaurants in walking distance. I will definitely stay here again if I’m back in Chicago and highly suggest it to others as well!

I had a wonderful stay at Kim’s property and really enjoyed my time in Hyde Park. The apartment was comfortable, well located, and a great setup for working remotely. Check-in was easy, communication was excellent, and I had everything I needed throughout my stay.
Hyde Park itself was one of my favorite parts of the experience. The neighborhood feels incredibly lively right now, especially with all of the energy surrounding the new Obama Presidential Center. There were plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, beautiful architecture, and things to explore nearby, and I was excited that I even had the opportunity to visit the Obama Presidential Center while I was in town.
The only small issue I encountered was seeing some ants and a few spiders coming from the drain, which I’d recommend having treated. It didn’t take away from the overall experience, though, and I genuinely enjoyed my stay. I’d absolutely consider staying here again when I’m back in Chicago.
It was very convenient with small kids to go and see Chicago hall marks. The private parking was a plus.

This is an excellent place for a family, especially if you prefer staying in one of Chicago’s best neighborhoods rather than in the busy downtown area.
The property was very clean, well maintained, and had great facilities. Our only reservation was that the beds were smaller than standard and not as comfortable as we would have expected.
Overall, we had a very enjoyable stay and would definitely recommend it.
Really nice place. Easy to go to downtown through the bus or metro. I would definitely comeback and stay here!
Very calm and smooth stay. All needed amenities were there to make this feel like a home. Very responsive and helpful. Would definitely visit again. 10/10.
Would stay again!

We had a great stay with Hubbard Holdings! The hosts were super friendly and proactive with sending us check in and check out information. They were very responsive with any questions and we felt right at home. They accommodated us for an early check in and we really appreciated the flexibility.
The location is SO convenient- entrance to train station is just steps away and a grocery store with everything we needed was right around the corner.
I would definitely recommend, it’s perfect for families!
We stayed here to celebrate my birthday and it was a perfect location to access public transportation and local spots. Comfortable and clean, quiet and safe!
Was responsive when messaged and an amazing area to stay

La ubicación nos ayudó demasiado al ser un punto medio entre el aeropuerto y el downtown, tiene la estación de metro muy cerca lo que facilita la logística. El espacio es tal cual se muestra en la fotografía, además hay un bar que sería bueno incluir en las recomendaciones se llama Panamericana liquor, lo conocimos mientras esperábamos la hora para poder hacer check in. La única observación que haría es que tiene unos pequeños escalones que pueden ser un poco peligrosos, pero mientras se tenga precaución no representan un peligro, todo bien, seguramente regresaremos.

Karen was very responsive during my whole stay and was pleasantly accommodating. Check-in was super easy and the front lobby staff are kind and helpful. The amenities are worth it and you can’t beat the view!
This place is great! Right next to the stadium, red line and Clark bus. Loved the decor! 😁
great airbnb, very roomy, beds were comfortable, very clean, only con was the smell, i bought a spray and it went away. something easy to fix, besides that everything was nice and how was efficient.

everything was set up beautifully and everything was clean. the overall guest house looked nice and everything was organized. no complaints never been in a room airbnb but an amazing choice for a night experience.
Nice, convenient and calm place to stay to attend a conference.
Great! Spacious and comfortable.

Loved my 3-night stay here! Marijes is a very responsive and helpful host. The location is superb, in a safe neighborhood, located very close to the UChicago campus. The interior is very clean, tidy, organized, with a window AC that cools the summer heat.

Amazing stay! I loved the space and it was great for my wife and I. Very clear check-in instructions + easy to get to and from public transportation stops/stations. About 50-60 minutes from the Loop/downtown Chicago and pretty much a straight shot on the blue line. Stayed nice and cool throughout the place and had a very comfy couch + bed after a long day of exploring. Appreciated the amenities and (feminine) hygiene products they had the courtesy of providing :)
Spacious house and all the mod cons you need

We loved our time here! I’ll be honest, I didn’t do much research on the area but went based off all of the other positive reviews. We arrived late in the evening so it was dark. The GPS will take you to the back of the building but the street parking is in the front. I absolutely loved the parking options that were available. Plus it’s free! You can tell it’s a nice neighborhood because I saw plenty of people walking their dogs and pushing strollers. It’s very walkable and peaceful.  The house is down the street from a bus stop. We used the bus and subway system to go downtown and it was pretty easy to navigate. The room had everything we needed for our time. The kitchen was an added bonus. We’d definitely stay again!
Patrick was very quick to communicate.
Great Stay! Would stay again!

The unit was clean and was accurate to the description, very comfortable and clean. The water pressure was kinda low but it’s an old historic building, and the shower could use a little help.  But otherwise very good
Amazing stay! Enjoyed it all!

Kenneth is very professional and a great host. He has a very nice place that is spacious and in a safe Neighbourhood. Despite the challenges with the toilet, he was able to help and guide. Kenneth guided us on how to get what we needed and we thank him for that. All in all, it was a value for money experience despite the challenge with the toilet.
This stay felt like home and very peaceful area great family vacation I loved it.
Very comfortable stay post were lovely and the house was an amazing!!
Great apartment and location. Right near a ton of great restaurants and the train.
Great place!
Great spot to stay a couple days in Chicago. Close to the train that takes you downtown and other areas, in a family oriented neighborhood, and the hosts really go above and beyond.

Hermoso departamento el South loop, amplio, moderno y todo está impecable!
Lo super recomiendo!!
Great place, exactly as described. Plenty of room for a family of four. Excellent host.
A terrific place to land while visiting Chicago. Easy and beautiful.

The place was great, the neighborhood was great, and everything went smoothly. It was also great having a parking spot for my car in the garage, along with plenty of space to relax. The space was clean, well-kept, and was a lovely place to spend some time while visiting Chicago again. I would absolutely book this space again.
The place is awesome, next to the blue line. The house is really good, the only problem was a dripping in some of my friends bed. But the rest was really great!!! Me and my group enjoyed so much!
We loved our stay here! The views were amazing of Lake Michigan, and so many big windows. Great location and very nice place.

We spent two days in this place. It's a very unique apartment and experience in general, since the metro trains are going above your bedroom and it feels like this building was part of this metro station before. But the description clearly states this, so just read it, before you decide. Thomas and his team are great hosts, they provide white noise machine and earplugs if needed, the check in was easy and communication was friendly and prompt. There are plenty of restaurants and cafes, 20 minutes to downtown or O'Hare airport. There is also a free parking spot, which is a rare find in Chicago. If you don't mind noise and not planning to go outside during the night, definitely a good place to stay.

We came into town to visit family, this apartment fit our needs perfectly. It was close to public transit and easy to get onto the expressway. The space itself was very lovely, had all basics of what you need. Also beautiful neighborhood to walk around in.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!
Highlights include:
-pristine bathroom and kitchen
-the bed was very comfortable
-premium quality sheets and towels
-showerhead with strong water pressure
-premium products, i.e., body wash, etc.
-Quiet, peaceful sleeping space
-walkable neighborhood with interesting architecture
-good restaurants nearby
We highly recommend this space and location!
Other than some miscommunication at the end of our stay, we had a delightful stay at Daniel’s place.
Amazing place. Everything was perfect. Parking was a little stressful just because it was hard to find parking. Other than that. Everything was amazing.
If you are in Chicago then this is the place to stay. Perfect location and a great apartment. Very well maintained and Brad does everything to make sure that you have a great stay.

Wonderful location, wonderful apartment. Comfortable, clean, quiet and close to everything. A great place to relax after long days of exploring Wicker Park. Andy was extremely responsive and answered all questions right away! Would definitely stay again.
Super place. Very nice apartment surrounded by beautiful gardens. We like the fact that the metro station (Blue Line) was only about a 7 minute walk. We also appreciated the garage space for our car.

This Airbnb was fantastic, and all of our guests were completely impressed from the moment we walked in. The host has truly thought of everything to make your stay comfortable and seamless.
The attention to detail is unmatched:
Fully Stocked & Thoughtful: The kitchen drawers had every single tool we needed (wine opener, lighters, pie server, can opener, etc.). There were extra towels right by the hot tub, cozy blankets in the movie theater room, and a dedicated closet with baby gear (pack 'n play, high chair, and a baby gate for the stairs).
Clear & Easy: Everything throughout the house is well-labeled (including helpful signs for things like the pull-out couch), making it super easy to find what you need without guessing. Parking was also a breeze.
Great Amenities & Communication: The hot tub was spotlessly clean and worked great. On top of that, the host was incredibly friendly and super quick to respond to every question we had.
We would love to stay here again and highly recomme
Thx Michael- would definitely return!
房子干净整洁，整体和图片描述基本一致。居家设施齐全，厨房、卫浴使用方便，很适合我们自驾家庭出行。地理位置优越，出行加油、觅食都很便利。房东沟通及时，回复高效，入住指引清晰。不同于标准化酒店，民宿充满当地生活气息，奔波旅途归来，在这里得到充分休整。整体体验非常满意，下次再来会优先选择，强烈推荐！
Couldn't have asked for a better stay. If you dont book this place, I will : ) .
I had zero hassles during my stay. The group was very responsive and addressed all of my concerns.

I was fortunate enough to book Abe’s place for my 30th birthday celebration. Abe is responsive , kind and his home was even better in person. He accommodated all of our ask - which he didn’t have to do! We are deeply appreciative for the comfortable stay, the personal tour we received at check in and the welcome snacks he left for us . Abe really goes above and beyond and I will be booking him for future group events!
Great place and perfect location.  Would definitely stay there again.

Cozy, comfortable place good for two adults. I liked that the coach house was separate and sort of secluded. The closet was great for setting out luggage. Sofa was very comfortable, more so than the bed to me. The neighborhood seemed very walkable, but I did not get to explore much because there was a storm. My cons would be that I did encounter a few bugs, and the bathroom sink drains a little slow. As another reviewer noted, there is just the one small ac wall unit. The place was a bit warm when I checked in. It took a bit, but the ac unit was able to cool the whole place down. Overall, I had a good stay and would book again.

me and my girlfriend Katelyn feel incredibly welcomed and appreciated by Saurin. He is an amazing host and will communicate with you well if you have any questions or concerns. He is extremely flexible and did not give us any grief when our plans extended a few hours into the evening (on our last day). Saurin is a kind soft spoken man who definitely has a great decor taste. You will love the inside of his place!!!

This loft was stylish and roomy and allowed us to spread out comfortably. It had everything we needed and we especially enjoyed the large walk-in closets to stow away luggage and shopping bags during our stay. We were able to park the car and enjoy Wicker Park on foot due to the convenient location. As mentioned, it does get noisy as expected due to the busy location, but we always travel with a sound machine which helped. The building itself was quiet. Overall it was a lovely stay and we will keep it on our favorites!

Such a lovely airbnb! Very clean and easy to get in and out of. Nick was super welcoming and our stay was such a memorable part of our trip that we hope to stay again. Don’t hesitate to stay here!! Thank you for everything Nick :))

Bridget’s home is one of the Best Airbnb places we have stayed. Her house is a Beautiful Home to live in. We spent 10 days and it was wonderful experience. My parents and the kid with us were so happy. The Location is great. Quite and peaceful location away from the hustle and bustle of the city but all local cabs including Uber and Lyft cabs are easily accessible by the apps. I wish Bridget lots of Happiness and Success always. Our stay has been Memorable

The property itself was beautiful, and the host was responsive once we reported an issue. Unfortunately, our first night was very disappointing. The bedding in the guest rooms appeared to have stains or residue that looked like bodily fluids. One room had spots that appeared to be blood, while another had a smeared substance with a hair in it. We also found a spot of a similar substance on a bedroom wall.
We immediately contacted the host and documented everything. Since clean bedding wasn't immediately available, we had to wash the sheets ourselves and were up until after 1 AM. We were traveling with an 18-month-old, which made this especially concerning.
The host apologized, arranged cleaning for the following day, offered an and additional stay. Since our schedule wouldn't allow us to stay another night the host provided a $100 refund. We appreciate their response, but the condition of the bedding at check-in was a significant cleanliness issue that negatively affected our stay.
Really cute place. Don’t hesitate to stay here.
Everything was great, location was great, apartment very cozy and clean, loved my trip

We had a wonderful stay at Saravanan and Mitesh's place, they were quick to respond and helpful. The place was spacious and clean, lots of TVs and utensils.
Only thing is that parking (in the street) is a bit of a hassle, had to hunt for parking if it was late at night and most parking requires parallel parking so I'd practice beforehand haha.
But overall our stay was great, safe place close enough to Chicago that we can drive/Uber.

Loved staying here with our dog! The location is unbeatable. Katherine’s place is super clean and beautiful. It rained for a couple days of our one week trip. We loved the rainy days reading books in the apartment.
Tawney was very accommodating with a last-minute reservation. Her space was very clean, with new appliances in the kitchen. The laundry room in the unit was wonderful, and the beds were comfortable.
Great place right of the CTA Blue line, clean and spacious apartment for the city. Exactly as described in photos and had a couple of extra touches to make the space feel welcoming
Nice stay   Very small room w/ no ac    Window had a nice breeze though

Great in terms of the bar, and it's close to everything! Airbnb gives a good rate compared to booking on their own site, yet it's still not worth this much per night. Mainly due to the quality of the rooms and some let down of the other amenities.

This unit was an excellent value for money. It’s a small unit perfect for a couple. The layout is excellent with excellent use of space. A very decent size closet for unit this small. Wall paint is pleasing to the eyes. Very comfortable bed. Only thing that needs fixing is the curtain rod and I think blinds are nearing their end of life. But overall I will give 5 stars for the value for money.

Joe was very responsive from beginning to end.  As described, very private and secure.  Very comfortable and quiet. Had all the amenities we could have asked for.  Great shower and the beds were comfortable. Would stay there again. Thanks Joe for sharing your home with us.

We had a wonderful long stay at The Beach House Chicago on the 3rd floor. The apartment is spacious, beautifully laid out, and has everything you need for a comfortable stay.
The real highlight is the view absolutely stunning! Every morning felt like being in a little ocean movie, watching the waves roll in over breakfast.
Highly recommend, and we’ll definitely be back next time we’re in Chicago!

The Airbnb was very nice and very clean. I found that the air conditioner was very loud and in the bathroom each time my sister and I would go in to use it or to take a shower we would have to wash away the ants that we would find around the sink, toilet, shower and inside the shower. We also found that the bathroom door had a bit of an issue closing and staying closed when we needed it to. Other than that the place was very nice and fit my sister and I just fine for our stay, so than you very much.
Have a wonderful day!

I had a great stay at this lovely home. I visited Chicago with my 4 siblings and partner and there was plenty of space for everyone. Also, everyone getting to have their own bathroom was a cherry on top. Plus Dove soap was provided, which seems like a minor thing but it made the stay more homey. Next time we are in Chicago, we will likely be staying here again.
Very Comfortable, Nice Location Host was Great!

The place was very clean, easy to find, and the host communicated well. The neighborhood also seemed okay for Chicago. However, there were a few issues. The place appears to have been a store or commercial space that was converted into an apartment. The bedroom walls don’t extend all the way to the ceiling, so there is very little sound privacy—even whispers can be heard from the other bedrooms. There are also skylights, and one bedroom is directly underneath one, making it quite bright in the morning. Another bedroom has a door that opens directly to the outside/street.
We also had trouble with the ACs. Initially, none of the three units worked, so we contacted the host and eventually got them working by resetting the switches in the electrical panel. The host was responsive and genuinely tried their best to make us comfortable, which we appreciated.
We had a great time at the pope night for the White Sox. I’d come here again to go to another game, great place.
Very responsive and helpful host! Great location!

The rental and location was great. Lots of good walkable restaurants. There was also a market within walking distance. Parking was not bad and most days I found a spot within 1-2 houses. This rental is not for the tall, low ceilings and doorways but worked out perfect for me.
Owner was responsive and proactive with any questions or issues. Don't be impatient, you will get a response. Most were within 30 minutes.
Tip- have your phone flashlight ready if entering at night. The first couple doors/rooms can be hard to see in the dark.
Amazing Airbnb in Logan Square. The space was very spacious and clean, and the location was excellent. Would definitely stay here again!

Unfortunately, our stay was very disappointing. Upon arrival, neither of the two showers had running water, and the kitchen sink only trickled and never became hot. We immediately notified the host, and maintenance came the next day and had the issue repaired by around noon.
Although we appreciated the eventual repair, we were unable to shower upon arrival and had to delay our plans the following day. We couldn’t leave the Airbnb until approximately 12:30 p.m., causing us to lose a significant portion of our day. In the meantime, I had to boil a pot of water and use the sink to take a “bird bath.”
What made the situation more frustrating was the host’s response. Rather than acknowledging the inconvenience, we were told they had a video showing everything was working before we arrived. Regardless, the showers did not work when we arrived, and the sink had no usable hot water.
The lack of basic running water significantly impacted our stay. I would not recommend this AirBnB.

We loved Mindy + Tony's house and would absolutely stay again. It's walkable with great food nearby. Really clean, and the kitchen is equipped for making meals at home. We had a tornado warning and the hosts responded promptly and let us take shelter in their basement for a little bit, which was much appreciated. 10/10.

First time in Chicago and I'm glad I stayed at Bernard's. Easy access, love the area, very walkable and the bus takes you downtown. Bernard's place is beautifully curated. I felt like I was living in a museum. Great host and great food/places recommendations.

Dimitri was a great host. Very responsive throughout the stay. The place was as described
Close to great restaurants and public transportation. I was worried about parking. Street parking was available at all times.

The apartment was just like the pictures to a T! Lots of natural light and space. Parking was difficult at night as we got in late but the next morning and afternoon was easy to get parking right next to the building.

This space is way bigger than the pictures can capture! Great, walkable location in proximity to public transport. While we did have a little hiccup one night with the initial lockbox code not working, the hosts responded and resolved the issue within about 15 minutes of inquiry. Would definitely recommend this space for medium to large size groups visiting Chicago.
Was absolutely wonderful stay. Good location!
Simiao's home was a great place to stay at during our short visit to Chicago — we were obsessed with the Chicago neighborhood guide + Chicago-inspired decorations! Everything was lovely :)

Josh's place was great! It was just as advertised and even though it was on a somewhat busy street, it was very quiet and peaceful. It was also a short (less than 10 minutes) walk to the Brown Line so it was very easy to get downtown. The place was also beautiful and very classic Chicago. We will stay here again for sure!

I stayed in the upstairs bedroom with a ceiling fan and working AC unit that made it comfortable.  Abby was a great host and her place provided everything needed for a few days sightseeing in the city.  She was very accommodating and I was able to arrive earlier and leave later and stored my luggage, while getting extra time in and around the city.  The place is 10 minutes walk to the "L", 18th street station.  Along the way, some wonderful local Mexican taco places,  bakery, and lots of local wall arts!  All and all, a lovely place and lovely host!

We had a great stay at this loft in Fulton Market. The location was excellent (close to everything!) and the apartment itself was very clean, spacious, and exactly as described. Check-in and other instructions were clear and easy to follow, and communication throughout the stay was excellent. Everything was smooth from start to finish. Definitely a five-star stay and we’d happily stay here again.

Truly clean and very homey!  Barry and Charlene were very kind, responsive hosts, and their apartment was excellent. The entire place was actually clean and filled with thoughtful touches like books, games, a fully-stocked kitchen, extra bathroom supplies, extra blankets, and convenient and comfortable furniture. The AC units and fans kept the place cool and comfortable, and the nicely painted walls and fun decor provided a relaxing, homey feel. We would definitely stay again!
Thank you for being a great host! Truly a hidden beauty! Close to downtown and convenient having a grocery store and restaurants right across the street. Would definitely stay again!

We LOVED the place and our stay.   Truly 5 Stars in every way.  The train is super close it was a piece of cake jumping on trains. Easy walk to the iconic river and Michigan Ave.  everything was new and clean. She thought of everything.  The train sound was soothing to us.  Like just the soft sounds were great to fall asleep to.  We’d love to go back and stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay at Ryan's place.  It is well positioned in the heart of Wicker Park, with close proximity to great restaurants and shops.  It was clean and had all the amenities that we needed.  Great value for the money!  We'd stay there again!

I stayed for a month. Overall its really good. Was clean and had everything I needed for the stay. Just that its close to train. And had trouble sleeping initially as I could hear the train late night as well. Host is responsive and super helpful. Would definitely recommend this place.

Jason & Ana were truly wonderful and extremely responsive. They went out of their way to accommodate me and I really appreciated their kindness. I recommend their apt for solo travelers!
Pros:
Flexible & accommodating hosts
Great & safe location!
Easy lock box
Clean & modern
Soft bedding & sheets
Great full length mirror! (Can I get an Amen ladies?!)
Lots of towels & wash cloths (grey!)
Shampoo, body wash and conditioner provided
Things to be aware of:
Lots of narrow steps to get up to unit
Full bed (good for solo travelers!)
Very noisy city street
Very bright bedroom with sheer curtains (no black out option)
Thank you!

I will definitely book this place again,  the location is amazing. The unit is perfect, spacious, well equipped for our needs. It is so close to absolutely everything we wanted. Roscoe Village is one of the best neighborhoods I'd want to stay close by.

We had an amazing stay in Chicago visiting family who live nearby. Mark's place was beautiful, had everything we needed and was in an excellent location - very walkable to many local restaurants and shops! Even in this great location it was still a lovely quiet street. We definitely hope to stay again next time we visit!
Great location, comfortable apartment, good communication with the hosts.  Highly recommend for short or longer stays.  Beds were comfortable and the kitchen exceptionally well stocked.
Great place to stay. Close to parking garage, the L, and bus. Great neighborhood felt safe.
Olga was very kind and welcoming. The apartment is comfortable, clean, and in a lovely walkable neighborhood. Hope to stay again next time I’m in Chicago!
We loved the location and walking to shopping and restaurants.  Parking was fairly convenient.  The view from the condo was great and we enjoyed hanging out of the roof top.

We enjoyed our stay at Sebastian’s! The area was good, a lot of food options are within walking distance.
Just as a heads up, the wifi was a little bit funky. One was provided during the check-in and would periodically disconnect. The other unsecured option was requiring entry of the email, phone number and other personal information for access.

Wonderful stay perfect location. Had a concert at United center was about a 5-7 minute walk to and from the concert much better than having to drive in all the traffic. Host was very responsive and the place was very cute and easily accessible.

Phoebe gave great instructions and description of home.  Best thing is free street parking! Close to expressway and all the neighborhoods we wanted to visit.  Not as noisy as she described but maybe if you’ve never lived in a city.
Great place. Will come back again
Great location for a stay in Chicago.

I would not stay here again. My stay ended with an interaction with the host that made me feel unsafe enough to leave without many of my belongings. During the interaction, the host was aggressive, crowded my personal space, repeatedly demanded answers from me, and handled/threw my belongings around. I ultimately left with only what I could carry because I did not feel safe remaining there or continuing the confrontation. I left significant property behind, including my computer, prescription medications, clothing, handmade artwork, and art supplies with substantial monetary value. I am now pursuing the appropriate processes regarding my property and losses. Whatever disagreement may arise during a reservation, no guest should feel physically intimidated by a host or feel that leaving their belongings behind is safer than remaining at the property. Based on my experience with the host’s conduct, I cannot recommend this listing.

Very affordable place to crash for a short stay. As advertised, it did not seem like their was any Air Conditioning so just be aware of that. He did include a rotating fan in the room which was much needed for sure. Other than that it was everything you could need for a barebones stay and the bed was comfy and he provided plenty of pillows. Great location too.

Fantastic condos for a large group. We were traveling with our grown children and young grandchildren. Everyone enjoyed having their own private bedrooms with large kitchen/living areas to congregate. The kids loved the rooftop pool and the awesome views from the windows. Conveniently located just 5 short blocks to the Red Line station.
Great comfortable stay!
Location was great. Apt was spacious and clean but did lack a few things that would have made for a better stay. Towels need replacing for sure.
Great stay for my significant other and I. Close enough to walk to many places if you want to adventure or an even quicker ride. Clean, secure, easy check in/out process.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay in Chicago! The home was very clean, comfortable, and conveniently located just a 10-minute walk from Chinatown. We felt very safe during our stay and really appreciated how responsive and helpful the hosts were. We would happily stay here again!
Good price

The place is okay. It was not as clean as it should have been, and the host advertises “non-smoking, no pets” but then writes the opposite in the additional notes which is very conflicting. Everything smelled like marijuana and cat litter and the only reason we were okay with that was because we spent the majority of our stay away from the apartment. The shower floor in one bathroom was gross, and the bathtub in the other bathroom didn’t drain properly, but again, we tolerated that because we used it only once a day. The host responded quickly, and the location was pretty convenient, about 10-15 minutes from downtown. I wouldn’t stay here again though.

We loved staying in David’s place. It was our first time in Chicago and we had an amazing time. The location was excellent. We could walk to the L and many restaurant options. We would highly recommend his apartment to others.

Had no issues running into people for the bathroom. Most of the other guest kept to themselves, but when in shared places everyone is super nice. It was walking distance for public transportation, both bus lines and the green line. Appreciated Michael letting us stay in the living room after checkout because of a tornado warning.
No complaints!
Great place and location. Friendly and responsive host
great place, just make sure to have extension cords for the bedrooms

We had an excellent time while we stayed at Isa’s. She was extremely responsive throughout the entire stay. The house was in excellent conditions & the VIEW - it was so beautiful! We enjoyed waking up & walking down to the outside area to hear the water. Overall, we would go back & we definitely recommend staying there!!

As listed before, the experience was great and it is near Hispanic based area so everything you do is local and has a lot of Hispanic people which is a plus however the issue came with the price being as expensive as it was for one night and the check-in and checkout time. Other than that, I don’t have anything else to say besides great experience.
Very nice and spacious home!
James was an amazing host with clear check-in instructions and the place was amazing! Would definitely book this place again!
We had such a great time at Diana’s abode super nice!

Saurin was an incredibly communicative and accommodating host! He was very flexible with luggage storage both before and after checkout, and helped us with some lock issues (caused by my own user error) in a very timely manner. Other guests were quiet and respectful for the most part; however, some left their toiletries, towels and garments in one of the bathrooms for the duration of our stay, which cluttered up the space. On the whole, this was a great value for the space and location.
Great place

Room 4 was quiet and very comfy!
Easy to park the car around for free.
My stay went perfectly good!
Thank you for having me!

I’m particular when it comes to where I’m staying for travel. This air bnb was Very comfortable and great location. Host paid attention to detail when it came to cleanliness and comfort. Bed was very comfortable with nice cozy sheets and lights to help with sleep and a fan! I had great sleep and hardly would have known it was a shared space. Very convenient location and amenities for the price you can’t beat it. will definitely be staying again next time I come to Chicago
Not only is it in a safe neighbourhood in the city… it’s also of beautiful design. Garage was a teeny small for us to fit our car in, but I understand it’s built more for the city-sized cars.
This place was great - we really loved it. Great location and the host was very responsive and helpful during our stay.

I chose this place based on the pictures and positive reviews. When we arrived we found the place not very clean and not matching the photos. The living room furniture was all different. There was a huge stain on the mattress right under the fitted sheet I discovered when trying to install a bed rail. Some of the sheets had stains and debris and there was a dried contact on the comforter. There were clean dishes left in the dishwasher instead of put away and laundry left in the dryer. The mop pad used to wash the floors was washed with the bedding. There was no rail up the steep stairs which was unsafe with my young children. There was a huge stain on the couch and the rug was also stained. The water dispenser in the fridge was filthy. Many things need some attention as far as maintenance/details. Ann was initially very responsive but then failed to do anything to make it right in regard to the state of things. The stain on the mattress was enough to not want my child sleeping there.
The Airbnb was very nice and clean. The host was nice too and understanding.
La casa es preciosa y cómoda, tal como en las fotos. En un barrio residencial, tranquilo pero cerca de buenas cafeterías, restaurantes y tienditas. Recomendado!!

I would highly recommend this airbnb. It's central and close to a train station. The host was quick to respond and very accommodating. My only gripe was the small bathroom but that's common for these row house BnBs.
Neal is a great host.  I would happily stay at his place again.

The place was cool, and the host was friendly and responsive to all messages. However, I couldn’t access the gym with the door code. It didn’t seem to be clearly mentioned in the instructions or maybe I missed it. The place was quite dark, even with four windows, and it was dirty. It needed some deeper cleaning between guests. Overall, it was the cheapest place I found at the time, and the price reflected that. The place was okay, but I would pay a bit more to try something different the next time I’m in Chicago.  Place got the job done. Over all no strong feelings about the place.
Great place for the price

Great hosts house was clean ,host gave me great recommendations for local spots,there are a lot of places nearby within walking distance, great neighborhood and the private parking spot was definitely a plus and easy check in!

It was great, close to tge bus staion but a bit far into tge city. Marko was awesome and made everything easy and smooth, he responded fast to questions and was nice. Super clean and pretty place, felt safe.

We enjoyed Lisa's well-designed and comfortable space in a quiet, easy to access Chicago neighborhood that is conveniently located to points north or south as we needed.  The apartment was sparkling clean and fully equipped and the beds were comfortable, checking all the boxes for a highly rated AirBnB.
We've stayed here before and loved it. Our dog loves the huge front yard. The area is quiet. The house is very clean and having 2 full bathrooms is a huge plus. We will be staying here again.

I had a man amazing stay!  The apartment was clean, well thought out , and exactly as described. It was in a great location . Dave was a great, responsive host . I wouldn’t hesitate to stay there again.

Simply put: a beautiful and convenient 2 level apartment. We were even able to make use of the bonus office space for those of us that still needed to work remotely on Monday morning. Parking out front was never an issue, even for a full sized SUV.
The stay was very pleasant. I recommend it 100%. Thank you very much for everything.

This place was great! Location was a bit further out of the city than I had realized, but only a ~25 min drive in. Other than that this place had everything I needed for a short weekend stay. Fully stocked kitchen with all you need for cooking (including spices), great air conditioning, shower with essential soaps, and great wifi.

We absolutely loved staying here! Super clean, spacious rooms, comfy beds, and central air was key during August's hot and humid weather. The location cannot be beat when it comes to public transportation and amazing bars and restaurants. Super easy to get to both downtown and O'hare. Even with the train so close, it never interrupted our sleep or TV time. Really great spot in the heart of the city. Proactive and responsive communication from our host. Even my son didn't want to leave - said it felt like home :)

When you see photos of spaces on Airbnb they often look bigger than they really are.  Not so with this place.  The rooms are huge and amazing.  Tall ceilings and massive windows made this place really stand out.  And the heated toilet seat!  I never knew I needed one!  We would definitely book again.

We had a great time staying here. It was very peaceful and close to the city. We enjoyed some of the local shops and enjoyed our stay. It was quiet and we never saw the neighbors. Our last night it was a little noisy upstairs but it wasn’t anything we couldn’t sleep through once we went to bed. Honestly that was the only sign someone else lived there, so it wasn’t so bad. We had a great time and if you're looking for a place to stay, be sure you’re under 6'2, or you may get a few bumps along the way. Great atmosphere and lovely host.

Appreciated the option to park the car in the gated backyard area. Experience was very smooth. Would recommend this to anyone who will most likely be exploring Chicago by day and just need a cozy spot to rest away from the city life. Neighborhood of the property itself is pretty quiet. Also appreciated the fridge having its own ice machine and water dispenser.
Great apartment in a really cute part of town!

Overall we enjoyed our stay. It's a beautiful apartment in a good location. We paid extra for the parking garage, which made parking so much easier. We didn't see much street parking during our time there. I would definitely recommend that if you have a car.
The downstairs neighbor was a bit of an issue. I did not see him face to face, but he was very unhappy with us walking on the hallway floor, which is quite long to get from the living room to the kitchen. He banged on his ceiling many times to tell us to be quiet even though we were walking normally and not making excessive noise. As others have noted, he seemed to be high all the time. The smell of pot was very strong in the shared entryway. A couple times, you could smell it in the airbnb unit as well. None of this is the fault of the airbnb host. There's not much they can do about that.
The washer and dryer are shared among 4 or 5 apartments and cost $2-$3 to operate per load.
Super friendly host and nice place, perfect for our stay!
Great spot nestled in Roscoe Village. Highly recommend!
Host was very responsive and able to let us in early.
Affordable stay. Close to transit. Very cute house.
4/10 as a girl traveling alone i definitely wouldn’t stay there by myself
Great Location for the price!
This was a wonderful stay! The host is very communicative and the home sits in a neighborhood with great local restaurants as well as easy access to public transit
Great place! Great communication.
Very nice place.
Loved it

Juan was so amazingly proactive and responsive.  If something was needed, he was right on it.  With grace.  And true warmth.  While a bit away from downtown, it's an easy Uber ride to anything, and an easy ride on the Blue Line to the airport.  The park across the street is sweet and has a lovely neighborhood vibe.  My wife, son, and two teammates (we were there for a tournament on Montrose Beach) all felt safe, cared for and at ease in this sweet Airbnb.  In large part, thanks to our hosts.

Very reasonable price

This apartment was in the perfect location for us. So many great restaurants and bars around the area. The apartment was quiet and very nicely decorated. The bed was extremely comfortable. Best sleep I have had in a long time. Highly recommend this apartment. It has everything we needed and more.

The apartment was clean, well-maintained and equipped with a stocked kitchen and convenient rear parking but several issues ruined the experience. The unit is entirely on the second floor accessible only via a very steep narrow staircase that made hauling luggage difficult and the front entrance is too narrow for vehicles. There were multiple pests, including centipedes in the passageway, living room and bathtub. Climate control was disappointing the living room cooled fine one bedroom had its own unit but other two bedrooms stayed warm due to high ceilings and the host warned us we’d pay extra electricity charges if we lowered the temperature a policy that would make summer months very uncomfortable. Finally while its location directly opposite the University of Chicago is great for campus visits it is situated on the South Side rather than downtown. Our cab driver warned us it isn't a safe area for unfamiliar visitors so tourists should carefully research the neighborhood beforehand.
We had an amazing stay at Gloria! She was very accommodating and we felt very welcomed. Her dog, Zoe, was a delight to our stay as well. Highly recommend!

Overall, we had a good stay. The area was nice and the hosts were responsive. The place could use a little more attention to cleaning, including the closets and bed linens, and some maintenance (the bathroom door which tends to get jammed). Otherwise, we had a comfortable stay and appreciated the hosts.
loved the place great location especially within relation to depaul! brad was a lovely host very responsive and helpful

We really enjoyed staying at Carol’s place! The apartment has two bedrooms with a dining room, living room and deck.
Carol was very responsive and helpful. She met us when we arrived, and really engaged with us. She is a kind, sweet person.
Local restaurants are good, and you can walk to the blue line from the apartment. O’Hare is on the blue line, so you don’t need a car if you’re flying to/ from there.

I loved staying here. Before checking in, Ryan gave very clear instructions with pictures and everything that you need to know about your stay. He responded very quickly and was very reliable. The room was spotless, as well as the shared bathroom. The location was also very convenient, about a 7 minute walk from the nearest train station straight into Chicago within 20 minutes. Would always recommend and come back!

Great location. Many restaurants, shops in walking distance. Super accessible.  Area seemed quite and safe. Super easy walk to public transport. Apt and bed were spacious and comfortable.  The only negative feedback to this airbnb is that the bedroom door does not have a lock, the bathroom door doesn't lock and the apartment entrance door does not have a  physical lock besides the keypad.

Very good stay. The kitchen is well-equipped, from to the available seasoning to the furnished utensils.
Bedroom, living room and bathroom are all clean and convenient.
The neighborhood is peaceful and walkable, with a Tony’s Fresh Market at less than 10min by feet.
The closest metro station is Irving Park with the Blue line, 10min by feet to walk there, and 25-30min to go to Clark / Lake station which is right in Downtown Chicago
Tippi is very friendly, respectful and ready to help if needed
Great stay, super clean. Host was responsive and helpful! I will book here again!
This place was a gem! Super comfy and clean, and had great accommodations for us with our 10 month old. It was close to everything we wanted, and had plenty of space. Would definitely recommend!
Excellent stay! Very peaceful and close to downtown! Very spacious vacation rental!Parking and check in was easy. Definitely will rent again!

Amazing location! Space was very large and well accommodating for our large group. The house was fully stocked, with plenty of extra towels, linens, etc.,  which is hard to come across these days. We will definitely be back to this location for our next trip to Chicago.

L'edificio è un edificio storico molto bello, la zona eccezionale. Purtoppo tutte le serrature delle porte hanno problemi. La porta principale di casa l'aveva proprio rotta, in modo che non era possibile chiudere la porta  una volta dentro, per evitare di non poter uscire. Le porte delle stanze erano aperte e non potevano essere chiuse a chiave. La casa era pulita solo che le lenzuola e le federe erano vecchie e macchiate. Abbiamo richiesto di cambiarle ma sono arrivate (nuove per fortuna) solo il giorno dopo. Inoltre le stanze non avevano nessun ripiano / mobile per riporre vestiti, solo una cabina armadio con un bastone, senza stampelle. Per fortuna la casa ha abbondanza di sedie (da ufficio) che abbiamo potuto usare come "armadio". Inoltre non c'era un phon.
Great location for the price! Bigger than we expected and happy to see shampoo etc provided.

Extremely Disappointing Experience
This is the first Airbnb experience we’ve had. My husband, son, and I checked in by 5 PM expecting to enjoy our planned vacation, but the condition of this property was so disgusting and disappointing that we decided to leave and abandon our vacation plans. The place was extremely dirty, with dead bugs, leftover guest hair, and black, filthy air vents. There were broken locks, no curtain on a window, numerous scratches, and noticeable holes in the walls and ceiling. None of these issues were disclosed in the listing or shown in the photos, which felt extremely misleading and deceptive. We weren’t expecting perfection, but we did expect basic cleanliness, safety, and an honest representation of the property. Instead, we were so uncomfortable that we could not stay. Having our vacation ruined because of the condition of this rental was incredibly frustrating and upsetting.
Great location very idle for family and friends gatherings. Very private and comfortable. I will definitely be booking again on the future.
The apartment was extremely clean and felt just like home. Directions provided were clear and helpful. Neighborhood was peaceful and walkable. Definitely would stay here again.

This place was lovely!  The neighborhood was like a trip back in time… to the Guilded Age… fantastic restaurants super close… subway was a close enough walk…. The building that the unit is in is really well maintained… a special stay for sure for me and my 10 year old.

Michael was an excellent host and his apartment was perfect for our visit. Beautiful, central to so many fantastic activities, and with every amenity you could need. I would recommend it to anyone planning a trip to Chicago!
My friends and I really enjoyed our stay! We hope to come back!
Great spot!

Location is all right . Maintain need to catch up as weeds everywhere in the front and backyard . We need to pull the weeds in order to sit in the backyard . Sofa bedsheets were not clean when we pull the sofa bed out . Michael is responsive and helpful . Location is all right.
The biggest concern of our group is the very very loud air conditioning in the central of the house make it hard to sleep during the night . This need to be solved as people travel long way to get a good sleep at air B&B . Good sleeping environment is a must ! Need to be a priority .
My place to stay in Chicago. Cozy and great location by blue line

Glenda and her family are incredibly kind and Glenda was responsive to our concerns. “Cozy” first floor unit at the south end of Humboldt Park. Close to Logan Square, Wicker Park, and downtown by bus, bike, or car.
Glenda moves upstairs during rentals, so she is close by if needed. She was moving out ahead of us as we moved in. Very friendly family and neighbors give a neighborhood feel to the block.
Closet and cabinet space were mostly unavailable but Glenda did move some items after we requested their removal. Internet speeds can vary, though there are two options to switch between.

Zhi Guang möchte eine 5 * Bewertung haben, die ich aber nicht geben kann. das Zimmer hat kein Fenster wurde im Inserat nicht geschrieben.

Ich würde dort nicht mehr buchen, da die Vermieterin meine Reklamation nicht interessiert hat
Für das Zimmer Nr. 3 war der Preis zu hoch.

The hosts are very welcoming and responsive!
We had a wonderful time

This was a great place to stay. It was clean quiet they had security in the evenings. It was a locked building so had to use a code to get in. It was in a great location right down the street from the police station a couple blocks from Chinatown great area. I will definitely be staying here again.
Had a great stay, the Airbnb was conveniently located and nicely setup. Hosts were super responsive and provided all the basic necessities at the property to make a convenient and comfortable stay.

Great location and quiet area!

Very responsive and friendly. We were in Chicago for an appt and asked how traffic was in the morning and they were quick to answer. They recommended parking for the area, which is an open lot across the street. While we didn’t use it and opted for the covered garage a block or so away. It was still nice that there was an option. The security at the building was nice to have, he was very friendly. The building is very quiet. The unit was very clean and had everything we needed.
Great location by the train stop.

Wowzer, this place is a score. Spent a weekend here and it was ready to go on time. Matt allowed for us to drop by early to leave luggage. Having the washing machine available to guests is a huge win. Location is great, but still quiet.
Thanks for a great stay!
Great place if your coming to experience downtown Chicago everything is walking walking distance the navy pier, the bean, multiple shopping areas and restaurants.
Great place, matching description, really good for solo traveler. Sean was nice and friendly.
Great place to stay while checking our daughter into college. Bed's were super comfortable and the kitchen had everything we needed to prepare meals. Thank you 🙏
Awesome stay. Super comfy beds. Responsive host. Plenty to do. Safe neighborhood & lots of entertainment/shopping.

Overall, I had a very good stay. The Airbnb appears to have been recently renovated and was clean, comfortable, and nicely appointed. I also found the location fairly walkable, with convenient access to Divvy bikes, which made getting around Chicago easy.
The only issues during my stay were that the hot water heater repeatedly needed to be reset, and I could occasionally hear a child running in the unit above. The host was responsive to the hot water issue and worked to resolve it, which I appreciated.
Despite those issues, I enjoyed the space and would consider staying here again.

We enjoyed the location of this air bnb it was close to the train station and nearby to shops. Host was also great at communicating with us. However we had problems with the wifi the whole stay and also didn’t have running hot water the entire stay. Although host was accommodating to these issues it still partly ruined our stay.

Clean, functional, and gets the job done if you're an on-the-go traveler. The location is close to Chinatown, you can walk out and hit the Red Line without any hassle. We appreciated how quiet and respectful everyone was. We were barely there except to sleep, and it felt like a safe, lowkey, peaceful nest to come back to after logging 20k steps around the city. Communication with the host was smooth and easy.

This basement apartment was very comfortable and beautifully furnished! Maggie was a wonderful responsive host, and had some yummy treats and bottled water for us when we arrived (5 hours late!)! Those in the twin bedroom might hear water running through the pipes, but otherwise the nights were very quiet. With any basement units you should expect to hear a little activity upstairs during the day. Thanks for a great stay in our charming old neighborhood!

If you’re looking for a spot, that’s close to downtown Chicago, but not in the thick of it. With still great access through all the amenities quickly by the L train this is it it’s super clean and easy to find would stay again.

Staying with Giovanni was great! He was super helpful and responsive! The apartment was clean, welcoming, and is exactly what is shown in the photos. Giovanni has stocked the apartment to be very livable!
Easy access to Lake Shore, close to CTA easy access to Obama Center, nice building, park across the street and Lake Michigan. No car needed uber is best. The host was quick to respond to questions.

We had a great stay here! Very comfortable beds, nice decor, and it was very clean. Host was great to communicate with. You do back up right to the train which can be heard but it didn’t keep my kids up at night luckily!

This place was perfect for our group of 5! Comfy beds, great space for hanging out after doing Chicago activities all day. The place had everything we needed, including a first-aid kit, which came in very handy. The location was absolutely lovely and so convenient to the Blue Line and many fun shops and restaurants. Ian was very responsive and easy to get in touch with. A great value—would definitely stay again!

Our family had a wonderful stay at Heather's unit. We appreciate how quick and communicative our host was. Great location and recommendations for nearby activities and restaurants! We would absolutely stay again.
The place was great - just as promised!

I stayed at Jane‘s bungalow for a couple days and it was the perfect location on the north side of Chicago. Close to trains and buses as well as restaurants and shops. A very Chicago feel and very friendly hosts!
Was as expected.
Had a great time with my family and her friends was a little further from the downtown area than I thought but definitely had a great time

I very much appreciate Lesley and her hospitality as host. Her place was every bit as accurate as described. Clean, quiet and especially safe!!
She is very friendly and quite helpful. Many coffee shops, cafes and watering holes conveniently located within walking distance. Her place is close to bus stops, the “L” and many wonderful restaurants. Walking the neighborhood and general area was enjoyable and once again, safe!!
If the Dodgers play the Cubs next season again, in a warm weather month, I’d hope that Lesley’s place is available. I’d love to return!! Thanks Lesley!!
Great stay, beautiful home, wonderful neighborhood!

When my family and I arrived at the room, we noticed unpleasant odors. The rug under the bed was dirty, with several stains, and I have pictures of them. The description said there were three beds, but there were only two, with the third being a mattress on a trundle, which should have been specified in the description. The mattress on the trundle blocked the limited space we had to walk. A part of the ceiling in the L room was too low and curved, causing my brother and me to bump our heads on it a few times. There was a knee-wall access door next to the bed where my mom was sleeping, which made her uncomfortable because she felt an insect might crawl out. We barely got any sleep, and my dad was also uncomfortable because he has heart problems and couldn’t breathe properly due to the air. We had to get a different Airbnb after our first night here.
Was definitely a great little spot with good walkability to a lot of spots. Was also very clean and had pretty mich everything I needed. Would definitely stay again.
Great place.   We drove everywhere and it was close to most of the places we wanted to go.

The place was awesome. Huge clean open floorplan. The area was quite and people were constantly walking their dogs and with their kids. Ive been to the area a few times and was very pleased with my stay. Having a garage was a huge bonus. I highly recommend Denzilt and his BnB.
Awesome place!! One of the best place I have stayed in Chicago. Looking forward for my next stay at this place. Exceptionally beautiful home and very comfy. Love it

Place was great, quiet neighbourhood but easy to get downtown and close to Fulton Market. Hosts were very responsive and provided very clear instructions.
It was a good shared place, bathrooms on all floors and my room was super nice! Kitchen was good too. The location was just okay but the train station being so close was definitely a plus!
Great place to stay in Chicago, right next to DePaul University! Very walkable area and close to the train station!

We had a great stay. Loved the house, lots of space. The jacuzzi tub was much appreciated! Also being able to park my van in the garage until it was time to leave was a huge plus. Nice neighborhood. Great host, very responsive. Would definitely book again.

This is the great place.

the location was perfect for me and my boyfriend. it is in a safe surrounding community. the place is so clean and i love that they have slippers for u wear in the home. i would 100% book the same place again next time i come to chicago💓
Excellent location.  Nothing fancy but all we needed for a couple days.
The place was very clean. Brad was always very friendly and the house was spotless. I would definitely stay here again.
Great location, very clean and very responsive staff. Thank you for everything.

Was a good place to stay. Quiet neighborhood. Quick responses from Brad. Place was clean. Close to metro/buses (really convenient!). A/C went off by itself but Brad was able to get it fixed. Blinds were broken but not an issue.
Enjoyed my stay very much! Everything as described and Near by restaurants and public transportation which made my stay 100x better.✨
I enjoyed my stay here, local to all the convenient stops including the pink line. Would come back whenever I am in town in my third home, Chicago 💜
Great location, would stay here again

Bozena had so many extra little touches including robes and slippers. The kitchen was well stocked and had snacks and beverages on arrival. The neighborhood is very private and quiet and close to CTA bus stops to easily get around the city. You are only a 5 minute walk to the Lincoln Park Zoo and ten minutes to Lake Michigan. We stayed for a week and had the experience of our year. This apartment may have influenced us to move to Chicago in the near future! 10/10 experience
Great location. Loved the parking spot. Home was clean and comfortable. Will definitely be back!

I really enjoyed my stay here. The house has tons of character and feels very Rogers Park — creative, casual, comfortable and just the right amount of quirky. Anne and her husband Marty are artists and musicians, and their personalities come through in the art and travel remembrances throughout the house. There’s even a moose head over the working fireplace, which somehow fits perfectly.
This was genuinely a five-star stay: very comfortable bed, well-stocked full kitchen, generous living and dining space, and the unusual bonus of two full bathrooms for a one-bedroom, with fantastic water pressure and plenty of hot water.
The lush, shaded backyard with its huge mature trees is a little oasis in the city. Anne was extremely responsive and helpful while also casual and easygoing. The Metra is a five-minute walk away and the weekly farmers market is right across the street.
Comfortable, unpretentious and wonderfully individual. I was genuinely sad to leave and would love to return.

Beautiful place

I had a wonderful stay with John and Görkem. They were warm, friendly, and full of recommendations - not just for Chicago but for my next destination as well. The location is great, very close to the red and purple lines with easy access to Evanston to the north and downtown to the south. Room was beautiful and clean, and the cats were adorable! Highly recommend.
We completely enjoyed our stay. The staff were great. Convenient location and space for everyone including card game night! We definitely will be back.
Fantastic accomodation. Really close to convent travel links and nearby restaurants. Looked even better than the pictures. Would reccomend

Overall pretty good deal. The floor was pretty dirty and there were some scuffs on the walls but other than that it was clean. The door to the building did malfunction at one point but we were able to call Owen and he walked us through a solution to get in. We ended up having some inclement weather at our checkout time and we were able to stay for a bit longer to avoid driving in the storm.
This place was perfect for my stay. Very easy walk to Berwyn station.  There is a grocery store right there also.

Martin was a fantastic host. Didn't get a chance to meet his wife Liz, but I imagine she's just as great as well. The home is beautiful, built in 1904 so it has that classic turn-of-the-century look, but with modern amenities. They've done wonderful with this home. It's also SUPER close to the blue line and walking distance from TONS of fantastic bars and restaurants. I honestly had a blast and Martin is a genuinely friendly and hospitable host. Whenever I return to Chicago, I'm certainly planning on staying here again. 10/10
Brad is the bomb. Love this place, second time staying here. Close to lotsa cool neighborhoods.
Victor’s place was wonderful and he always promptly answered my questions. Thank you so much!

A beautiful and clean place just like in the pictures. Our family really enjoyed the stay and felt safe in the neighborhood. We found it quite challenging to park in the garage space provided since it is quite narrow. We ended up parking on the streets and had no trouble finding a spot in front or close by. The living room area is quite spacious and nice, but we felt it was just enough for 4-5 adults to sleep comfortably.

We had the best time in Chicago! This place was absolutely perfect! Our daughter was dancing at an intensive and we were able to walk to the studio! You are close to everything, but you don’t have to leave your place once you get there! The little extras were so great and there were no worries once we got there! My daughter was very happy about the snacks sitting on our kitchen counter! Definitely recommend and hope to stay here again soon!

I was very happy to find this place.  I had made a bad choice a few years ago in the same neighborhood so I was a bit nervous but this property was as nice as the photos and description suggested and we were thorough happy.  Especially with the coffee, microwave, hot water pressure and comfortable pillows.

We loved our stay! Super easy to find, super easy pin-pad entry, comfy beds and responsive host. The floors were a little dusty but it is sealed concrete so it is what you expect and there are house slippers available by the door. There is a dunkin coffee/gas station a few blocks down as well as a few family owned restaurants. We did not have a car but if we did there was a lot of street parking available at our time of renting. We had an early flight (4am boarding) and the airport was only a 15-20 min uber. About a 10-15 min uber from train station. The bedrooms are a little tight so our bigger luggage stayed downstairs but there is plenty of room downstairs to keep it out of the living space and could still enjoy. I would book this again! Thanks Rob!

Great place, totally met expectations, clean and cozy. Clear and thorough instructions for arrival and departure. Amenities were stocked as described, with plenty of linens for us to use. Was nice to have washer and dryer available along with washing supplies. Took advantage of garage parking and EV charging, which was a reasonable extra charge.
Very walk-able neighborhood with plenty of good restaurants a short walk to the north. The blue line station is just a couple of blocks away for easy access to downtown.
Got to meet and chat with Darsh who was busy doing maintenance in the building. Very friendly and gracious host. He allowed us to stay a bit longer on checkout day to wait out a bad thunderstorm. Much appreciated!

Daisy is a thoughtful and helpful host. She responded quickly to messages and gave helpful information about parking, public transportation, etc. Instructions about the house were clear. There were no surprises - everything was as the photos and information had described. Location is great for visiting many areas of Chicago. Would love to stay there again.

Overall we had a great stay and the location is incredible. So close to everything, steps from restaurants, bars, the blue line, just really well located. The place was great as well, especially the two outdoor spaces which are quite large. The front bed definitely needs some love and repair as the frame kept giving us issue even with gentle sitting/laying. The kitchen could also use some more basic things like drinking glasses and such. But apart from that we had a lovely time and would stay again!
Ideal location for visiting family and access to public transportation. Very quiet building.

The Old Town home was an amazing stay! Close to everything I needed including the train with an added workspace downstairs if I needed wifi. Super clean, cozy,  great amenities. Would stay agin! Katty was so helpful, understanding and kind.

Overall good place to stay. Location was right near the orange line which made getting into town super easy. Lots of space for many people. Note that the couch does not pull out to a bed - there was only 3 of us so this wasn’t a huge issue.
Did have issues with cleanliness - it seems the place was not cleaned throughly before we arrived.
Cute place, great host and next to the rail

We really enjoyed our stay! Great location and easy to walk anywhere! The house was clean and I would highly recommend for a family!!’
All the amenities a nice hotel would offer but at a better price and more privacy!!

Matthew’s place is fantastic. It is comfortable and well decorated with all the amenities as described. The location is great - very walkable in a cute neighborhood. Matt was a great host and communicator. I’d 100% stay here again.
Place very private & peaceful,
Wonderful place. Clean and comfy. Close to a lot of restaurants and coffee places.

first issue was the smell. second issue was when i flushed the toilet the bathroom flooded . when i reached out to her she stated that i could have used too much tissue which is ridicules.  there was a smell inside of the apartment and when i looked under the sink there was trash from the previous guest. unfortunately i couldn’t take the smell and the uncleanliness so my trip got cut short due to this. i was not accommodated with anything. nor did i receive any money back i would not recommend staying here.
Good location, very near metro station to get into downtown. Exactly like the pictures, everything works fine.
Love how central Nat’s place was, easy access to the train station, walkable west loop, wicker park, and great Mexican food around. Charming apartment with great AC for humid hot days/nights to rest.
It’s nice decor and clean. Little far from downtown. Friendly neighborhood. The host always responded quickly when we had questions

We enjoyed our stay here! The condo was quiet and we loved the balcony. It was a great location for us and easy to get to other parts of the city via uber or public transportation. Host was helpful and attentive!

We had a wonderful long weekend in Chicago staying at Nicole and Todd’s place. Everything was as described, and communication with them was easy and prompt. The location was convenient with easy access to everything we needed.
We had a great stay and would happily recommend their place to others. Thank you, Nicole and Todd!
Beautiful room. Would stay here again in the future.
Donna’s place is great! It was very clean and much more spacious than I had expected. We will be back!
