Sehr schöne und zentrale Unterkunft. Perfekt für ein paar Tage in Chicago.

Beth and her place were fantastic!! She was very responsive to every message that was sent. Check out was a breeze. Usually there is a list of things to do prior to leaving and all Beth had us do was make sure that the dishes were done. I plan to be back and bring my husband to see the city and will definitely be looking at Beth's place first! Thank you so much again Beth!
Host was super friendly and communicated very well!
Host very responsive! Will definitely stay here again

It was a great place to stay! It was very clean, which is a big deal to me, and I felt safe and secure throughout my stay. The location was also great. It’s close to the Obama Presidential Center, downtown Hyde Park, and several great food spots. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend it.
Fue extremadamente bueno, lo recomiendo 100%

Great location and price! Visiting our son who lives nearby so made it very convenient to visit with him without crowding his space.
Has a great 17 mile walking path to beaches, tennis courts, golf course and runs along Lake Michigan.
The bus stop is right outside the building which makes public transportation very accessible.
Very nice place.

What immediately sold me was literally next to the red line CTA transit and how crazy convenient it was to connect to the city. The neighborhood was quiet and beautiful and an easy walk to the beaches. The apartment itself was clean and well maintained with everything you see in the photos.

We really enjoyed our stay at Reggie’s place! The apartment is incredibly spacious, well decorated and incredibly comfortable. We hosted several get togethers as we haven’t been back to Chicago in a few years and all of our guests loved the outdoor space either the incredible views of the Chicago skyline. My personal favorite feature of the apartment is the loft area with comfy crunches and gigantic screen!!!We got to enjoy so many movies with friends. All in all it made our stay one of our favorite times in Chicago!

Hi Regina, I really appreciate how kind and helpful you were during our stay. Unfortunately, I have to be honest and say that the place did not meet my expectations, especially considering the price.
The bed was a major issue for me, as I was not able to sleep well during any of the four nights. I believe having a comfortable bed is essential, especially when you are on vacation and need to rest.
I also feel that the photos do not fully reflect the current condition of the place. In the pictures, it looks newer and more updated than it actually is, while some of the furniture and furnishings are quite old.
Again, this is not a reflection of you personally, because you were very kind and helpful. I just don’t feel that the condition and comfort of the place were consistent with the price, and unfortunately, it did not meet my expectations.

We felt right at home in Shuang's place with our family of four. The location in Old Town was amazing for it's proximity to the L and Lincoln Park. We can't wait to come back to Chicago and would definitely stay here again!

I said here with my friend Sam, and we both had a great time!
The bnb was mainly a crash pad for our trip but we found ourselves spending a few nights in watching movies. This is a great spot and right down the street from the metro!

Honestly, I had a beautiful stay !! I’m always in the city for work or events and this is the first time I stayed in Wicker! You’re close to coffee shops, stores and honestly not a lot of noise! If you’re here for a short trip, this is the perfect stay!! Not to mention, I got a thunderstorm last night, it was cozy and perfect!!
Great location near the beach and a lot of Chicago sites. If available with def book again

Overall, a great stay in the Chicago area, and excellent host! The apartment was perfect, clean, and very comfortable. The beds were super comfortable, and the apartment had plenty of AC units and fans. The kitchen was stocked, even tried hand drip coffee making for the first time! The apartment was small but was the perfect size for us as we only needed a place to crash when we weren't exploring Chicago. We felt safe in the neighborhood, but it was hard to find street parking. Our host Anjali was super reliable, gave great directions, and has amazing taste!
Great spot. Would be perfect for a Cubs game. Easy walk to Halstead.

The place was spacious and very clean. Innesa was always responsive which was very helpful. Unfortunately someone broke into my car over night (I was advised not to park outside). If you’re staying here, I would definitely recommend paying for their indoor garage parking spot.
Street parking was a little bit of a worry for us, but overall the place its self was nice and worth it!
This listing is excellent; everytime I am in Chicago I will stay here. Truly enjoyed my stay
Great stay at a great location - conveniently located near really good restaurants and walking distance to the loop.

We enjoyed our stay! The place was nice, it was comfortable, the neighborhood was enjoyable! We even got to see and walk through an event that was going on in the neighborhood during our stay! Conveniently located by the green line too! And Jasmine was great about communicating. I’d stay again!

Overall, this place is great. The location is right at the corner or redline. It’s close enough to a bunch for restaurants and even grocery stores. They were also very responsive to our questions and ask. We had a minor confusion with towels but it got resolved right away. I think the only down side is the rooms does not have direct AC so you need to keep the door open. I would suggest an extra fan or so cus it gets hot. The ceiling fans weren’t strong enough.
We had a great stay!  Nice, clean, and modern space.  Awesome views of the Chicago skyline with floor-to-ceiling windows.  Enjoyed the location in the West Loop.

The location was excellent! There are a lot of restaurants, shops, bars, grocery stores, etc all within walking distance. The place is spacious and met all of our needs. A great location and space to call home while exploring Chicago. Heather was very responsive and sent a lot of great recommendations as well. Highly recommend!
It was a good shared space. Each bedroom had its own lock.  Roommates were considerate.

We stayed at the home for three days. I had a question regarding the property and Phill responded immediately. The place was emaculate and the location was prefect .

I spent a month at Joe and Ruth's place. There, I found a HOME in a city I had never been to before. I take amazing memories with me. The place is beautiful and tastefully quirky. I am thankful for such an amazing time there.

This location was ideal for our purposes. It was close to my son's apartment in the delightful Lincoln Park and Lakeville areas of Chicago. The space offered a lovely place to stay.
Chicago is an expensive city to my small town sensibilities. So while I felt the price was high, clearly it is favorably in line with other Chicago offerings.
The proprietor, John was kind and made efforts to accommodate our needs.
Great Location!  Beautiful place to stay!
Very responsive! Instructions were clear! Very helpful! No problems with communication or property. Appreciate the stay!
Another great stay!

The host was extremely responsive and action-oriented throughout our stay. The main living space is comfortable and clean with a dedicated AC unit. And there are AC units in each bedroom.
However, the bathroom was a noticeable drawback—it felt outdated and fell short on cleanliness compared to the rest of the unit. With some updates and deeper cleaning in the bathroom, this would be a great stay."

Nicole’s place was absolutely amazing to stay in, the train actually wasn’t that loud to us, however if you are a light sleeper it might bother you. The smell in the hallway is pretty bad but I know it’s not her fault by any means! Very walkable area and easy to get around to wherever you need to go with the red line being right there. Highly recommend to stay here!
Jackpaul was great, very friendly and helpful
Amazing place !!
Amazing space with and amazing host. Definitely gonna return.

Great stay; comfortable beds, strong A/C, and easy to navigate. It's a coach house so it's behind the regular house, and up on the top floor, but it was well equipped and was great for a long weekend.
leo and alex were great hosts!! the space felt just at home and it was right next to the bus stop and about a 15 minute walk to the nearest train station. i definitely recommend their place!!
Amazing place! Super clean and exactly like the photos. Plus, the bus and metro get you downtown in just 20 minutes. Highly recommend!

Great place, lots to do the minute you step outsd

will be back !

We would definitely stay again in the future.

Very nice place in Lincoln Park. Right near Clark so lots of places to eat and around a 10 min walk to the Fullerton/diversy train lines. Very easy to communicate with as well. Would recommend considering this place!

We really enjoyed our stay! We had a little trouble getting into the apartment when we arrived because the smart lock battery was dead, but our host was very responsive and accommodating. They even bought bananas, peaches, orange juice, and black cherry juice to make up for the inconvenience, which we really appreciated.
The two-bedroom apartment was wonderful. The 85-inch TV was definitely a highlight, and we enjoyed playing Ms. Pac-Man and Galaga in the evenings. The bathroom and kitchen were exceptional too. That stove was calling my name! 😂 Unfortunately, we ate out every day and never bought groceries, so I didn’t get to use it.
We spent most of our days exploring Chicago, so we probably needed a longer stay just to enjoy everything the apartment had to offer. We’d absolutely stay here again!
Easy to find and use, great condition,  clear instructions from host

walkable to many restaurants and shops! Well located!
Thank you for a great stay. Beautiful home with everything you could ask for. great restaurant recs, super responsive, would return in the future.
Great location! Very walkable to surrounding neighborhoods, had some good late-night spots open & was close to the train!

It was a perfect space for my family vacation to Chicago. We throughly enjoyed the space to relax between excursions and covienently close to allot of good food, shopping, water taxi, train station and more.
Very nice stay for a large group of people!
Perfect quiet retreat in Cle Elum!

The apartment was absolutely amazing and centrally located to everything both walkable and drivable. Parking was a breeze as well. Even though it’s in the basement the unit felt spacious and did receive a ton of light. The central a/c stayed cold and the hot water stayed hot. I highly recommend this place and would 1000% stay here again.
Great place for a quick visit to Chicago.

Great area and very nice apartment with easy check in and check out. We did reach out to the host during the beginning of our stay as we were not given enough towels for the group that we were staying with and we never heard back from the host. That would be my only complaint. Overall great spot, would stay again.
Great area, super easy to get around to everything we did during our weekend in Chicago!

The house was huge and very clean. Eclectic is a great word to describe.

We had a good stay at Irma's property.  It was spacious and clean and had everything we needed.  It was good to have the shower separate from the toilet since we had 3 people getting ready in the morning.  And it was super convenient to have Irma's restaurant right below.  The only drawback was being right on North Ave., which was noisy with the traffic.  But overall we enjoyed our visit and found it to be good value.
Excelente ubicación, a solo 100 metros de la Blue Line. Departamento muy hermoso con todas las comodidades. Habían café en cápsulas y agua de cortesía. Inmejorable!!!

We loved staying at this lovely space! House was clean, and very welcoming. Host gave clear instructions and was very friendly. Best part for me was the back patio area. Peaceful moments and mimosas in the morning, while the sun comes up.
Would definitely stay again if the need arises!
We loved the space it was perfect for our group of 8. Very spacious. Very clean. Walking distance from the train and the beach. We loved staying here absolutely would recommend!
Accommodating and helpful!
Lovely and spacious spot in Rogers Park. Enjoyed my time here! Thank you!
Great long weekend with my son watching baseball and going to museums.  Walking distance to the baseball park.  Perfect for what we were looking for.

The home was perfect for our family (three couples) in town for a wedding. Plenty of space to spread out and be comfortable. The neighborhood was accessible to shopping and services. Junni was very responsive about checking in early and anything that we needed. Parking in back of the home was a huge plus. I would highly recommend her home!
Great place, surroundings were iffy but Airbnb itself was great
Extremely nice and very professional host.  Shamari made our group feel at home from start to finish.  We enjoyed our selves.

Enjoyed the cozy accommodations and the area was safe/walkable with lots of restaurants and stores.

I highly recommend this beautiful bed and breakfast. Caryl was a lovely host and her croissants (she offered a choice of a few varieties) were melt-in-your-mouth delicious! She also recommended some helpful activity ideas for current and future stays in Hyde Park and surrounding areas. It’s also worth noting the spacious bathroom in the orange room was spotless.

We were in town for a week for our daughter's wedding, and Enrique's place met our needs perfectly. Plenty of space for 6 adults, thanks to 4 bedrooms, a large, well-stocked kitchen, big comfy couch and 2 full bathrooms. Always free street parking available right in front of the house for my minivan, which was a definite bonus in Chicago! We were close enough to everywhere we needed to go in the West Loop neighborhood.  The front porch and large yard surrounding the house were added bonuses, and Enrique was great about responding helpfully to any questions I had. Wonderful stay!
A great stay for a group or larger party. Host was very accommodating. The layout and room were fantastic. Pool table & kitchen equipment were excellent.
Very easy to find and check-in. Will was very responsive. Apartment was clean and in a great location. Very happy and would stay again.
Loved our stay here - would definitely book again!
Karen's place is a gem. She takes great pride in providing great amenities for her guests. Her attention to details is impeccable I will 100% rebook her Airbnb if I ever visit the area again.
10s across the board!  Jose and Phillip's place will not disappoint...location, location, location, comfy, roomy, quiet, every amenity you could think of and they were proactive and responsive!

Bernadette’s place was clean and neat. Was easy to find and get into. We were going to an event on the south side so it was close to where we needed to go, however it’s not an area that is full of restaurants and bars if that’s what you are looking for.
We loved the kitschy feel but perhaps Bernadette or the cleaning crew should do a better sweep of the “amenities” before guests arrive. There was only one coffee filter and only two wash cloths in the bathroom. There were four people. So… when traveling keep that in mind when reserving to check with Bernadette what is actually stocked in the apartment.

It was wonderful having a quiet place to stay in an actual Chicago neighborhood and room to hang out outside on the shady back patio. We enjoyed walking to the Chess Club Coffee place daily for breakfast and easily found street parking in the neighborhood.
Al was very welcoming and offered us multiple picnic mats for our outing to Grant Park that were super helpful. It was also convenient to have access to a full size refrigerator. Thanks for having us!
Jade's place was perfect for our few days in town, plenty of space, great spots around just in walking distance, right by convenient CTA and bus stops, we had a great time!

Phoebe's place was perfect for our group trip! They were extremely helpful with any questions we had. The amenities were exactly as listed and met our needs. The game theme was super fun and the space was spacious and comfortable. The location was great, close to transit, groceries, and food. Would recommend to other visitors!

My stay with Joan was great. The space was spotless, cozy, and in a perfect location, and Joan made everything easy from check‑in to checkout. She was kind, communicative, and clearly committed to providing a top‑tier guest experience. I’d absolutely return the next time I’m in Chicago.

Stayed here for a long, hot, stormy summer weekend, so appreciated the good AC and nearby grocery store. I chose it in part for the good public transportation, though we didn't end up using it. The place is very spacious with comfortable furniture and a dining table big enough for puzzles and board games. Keurig coffee maker. Lucien was very responsive to my questions, and check-in and check-out were easy.
The stay was good.

We had a fantastic month long stay. The apartment is in the perfect location to explore West Town and Wicker Park and it’s really easy to access downtown. The unit had everything you would need, with all the essentials and plenty of utensils and tools to cook. The bed was comfy, and the furnishings were all modern, well designed and clean. The hosts could not have been more helpful, they were super responsive during our stay - even when we locked ourselves out and my partner left her hair iron behind. Would highly recommend staying and we would definitely come back. Thanks so much Andrew and Elizabeth!
Great stay!

Had a lovely and smooth stay here. The location can’t be beat—it is right in the middle of a vibrant neighbourhood with many cafes and places to eat and shop. I appreciated the spacious space, which had wifi and AC, as well as everything I needed amenities wise. Would definitely return!

Know that internet is intermittent and that parking is not available (you can pay to have it at another spot).
There were a few annoying things that I was ok ignoring like only two plugs worked in the power strip, no tissues were there, pulled out towel bar, and no holder for toilet paper. Also, although we made do and did not complain about it, there weren't enough towels. The stairs are very steep which could be a problem for older people (especially with luggage), but they did not bother us.
My biggest issue, however, was the internet. I got lip service and there was nothing done about it.
We liked the location and used the close Blue Line station extensively. I would have given a five-star review had it not been for the internet and the towels. If the internet is not important to you and the towels are enough, your experience would be good.

The space was clean and well-maintained, which I appreciated. However, I found the 38 stairs leading to the apartment to be a significant inconvenience. Although I liked the place overall, the number of steps required to reach and access the apartment was a drawback. While I enjoyed my stay, the stairs made me reluctant to go in and out freely. Cleanliness was excellent, meeting my standards, but the stairs were a clear obstacle that affected my experience.
Good location in Avondale on a quiet street. Walkable to Logan square and restaurants in the area. Clean and had lots of spare towels/linens. Would stay here again.
Tamiz’s place is very nice. The cats are so cute and the space is clean and has everything I needed!
Great option if you’re looking for convenience. The keyless entry made it one less thing to worry about. Comfortable stay and great communication with host. Highly recommend

This was the best place that I ever stayed at on Airbnb. From the host Peter giving detailed instructions on check-in/out so it was smooth and seamless, the location was nice and quiet and the pictures of the place accurately described the Airbnb. It felt like a home away from home. Would most definitely book again when I come back to Chicago!
Great location and very spacious! It was a great rental for a large group.  Hayk was easy and quick to communicate with.  Would stay here again.

Great location, but the place was in pretty poor shape. There were holes in the wall, lights that didn’t work, damaged blinds, dirty washing machine, hair in the bathroom, and overall needed some major maintenance.
Marissa was responsive. We truly enjoyed our stay. Great location. Next time we’re in Chicago we’ll definitely stay here again!!

There were some concerns upon arrival, including used linens in the washer and guest bedroom, mold in one shower and the other shower door did not close which led to water all over the bathroom floor. The bedroom nightstand lights did not work, and the front window leaked when it rained. The bedrooms are small and were difficult to navigate, however the surrounding area was nice with activities to do. Ultimately the largest concern came as we had messaged the owner with the above concerns and never got any response.
Peter was an incredible host! Great communication! Loved this apartment, incredibly clean, well furnished, and incredible location. Highly recommend!

Great location for getting around in the city. Nice place looks like the photos, well kept. Had 2 kitchens as the “down” was actually its own unit.
We had a private chef come in for a birthday dinner for family and Sean was gracious enough to allow us to host in the home. Worked out great.
Only negative, parking can be very tough especially if you get back home after about 9 or 10 pm. Not an issue with the owners, just a fact of being in a neighborhood in Chicago. So, if you don’t really need a car would recommend to use uber or taxis (or even walk). If you do have a car, it is parking in a city neighborhood and part of the experience, be prepared. Really just a heads up. Otherwise place worked out great. Seamless arrival.
Great spot and great value!
Thank you for a wonderful stay! Great location!
Shonte, thank you for allowing me and my friends to stay in your beautiful home. I will definitely be booking with you again!
The location was conveniently close to the pink line, which conveniently connects you to the loop. You get what you pay for, which is great.

In short: This was our 2nd stay at Austin's place and already booked a 3rd. Listing accurately describes the place and even more spacious for 3 adults than photos may show. Great AC keeps you cool even in summer heatwave. Austin is very quick to respond to messages and proactive in letting you know about check-in and other info. Large grocery store around the corner and all variety of cuisine walkable restaurants on Belmont. Very quiet street and comfortable beds, helps you reset each night out in Chicago.

the place was a wonderful stay for my trip, i had an amazing time at patrick’s. the instructions for check in and check out were thorough and east to follow. patrick was very responsive to any questions i had and accommodated to me checking a early from my flight, allowed me to drop off my bags before everything was set for me to officially check in.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The location was great, lots of cool shops and restaurants nearby and convenient to CTA stop. Marissa was super friendly and responsive, and instructions were clear and helpful. Would recommend to anyone visiting Chicago :)

Paula was a great host.   I lost my access code to get in and I messaged her in the evening.  She responded immediately and I had the code immediately.  She was persistent to let me know that I could contact her at anytime if there were issues or concerns.  There weren't any strict checkout instruction and I would definitely stay there again.
The home was perfect for our weekend getaway! We enjoyed all that was offered to us. Perfect distance from everywhere we needed to go, home was very clean and spacious! Would stay again!

The apartment is very nice and well taken care of. I really liked the features, and the bathrooms are spacious. The location is excellent, close to everything and with a metro station just a few steps away. Ben was very attentive and responded quickly to our questions. There is only one aspect which I disliked about this booking, and that is the extra guest fee policy. Although the apartment is listed for a maximum of 10 guests, the price increases quite a bit if you book for more than four. Also, even short visits of non-guests had to be reported to the host, which seemed unnecessarily restrictive. Overall, it was a good stay because of the place and location, but I’d recommend future guests to carefully review the occupancy and visitor policies before booking.
Felt right at home!

Great location. Very big space, clean and comfortable.
Will definitely book again.
Communication was excellent.
I had such a great experience I will rebook.
Very nice place and quiet area, we fit 6 people for a week long trip and it was a perfect fit.
Thank you so much we had a great stay!

This recently renovated lovely second floor flat, was very comfortable. The bed was nice. I loved the desk that went up and down. Nice AC and fan. Well stocked kitchen. Easy to park on the street. Felt secure with three keys, one to the outside of the building, one to the door to the flat, and one to my bedroom.
My favorite part of the house was the sunroom on the front. It had really nice lighting and a comfortable couch. I enjoyed working out there or at the desk in my room.
This flat is on the north west edge of the Woodlawn neighborhood in South Chicago, but literally a Stonesthrow from Hyde Park, which features the gorgeous university of Chicago, and the newly opened Obama presidential library. The university is a 10 minute walk away and the Obama library is only 1 mile. There is also a very nice Jewel Osco two blocks away.
I enjoyed the Metra electric train to downtown. For 10 bucks you can get a weekend pass, or a little more to be able to use all chicago public transportation.

We loved our stay! The location was fabulous and the house itself is perfect for a large group of couples. Very easy to get around and convenient to downtown, Lincoln Park, Hollywood Beach, Lakeview and all else. Thomas and Cynthia were extremely responsive and check in/out was very easy.

The apartment was super comfortable and lovely.  Just the perfect size for us and our pup.  As said before in other reviews, Horner Park across the street was incredible.  We walked it every day and took our pup to the dog park several times.  There was even music for a couple of nights.  Our daughter lives very close, which is why we picked the spot and were pleasantly surprised by how walkable and also how easy it was to take the bus.  Would highly recommend and will stay there again.
Great place to stay in Chicago with a group. Close by a subway station to easily get around.

Steve was a wonderful host. Pleasant and very helpful. His place is beautiful. The location is near so many things and even parking is a breeze. We really enjoyed hanging out on the deck with our dog. It is very peaceful and safe. I would definitely stay again!

Sam was such an amazing host … by far the best experience I’ve had. Chicago is an amazing city and Sam was a great part of that for my family. She took great care of us and made sure we were comfortable and enjoying our time. I couldn’t recommend a better host, will 100% be back!
Hosts were very responsive and the location to Wrigley, Southport, the Lake, the Red Line is unbeatable.
The host never responded to our Constant plea for services
Great place. Peaceful location that is still very accessible to Wrigley and Boystown and everywhere we wanted to be. Easy instructions and checkout. Would stay here again!
The Sono Chicago is just the cutest! Loved our room, rooftop deck, and the provided breakfast and snacks. Everything was perfect. Will definitely stay again next time I am in the area!

Enjoyed our stay! It was easy to find & access. Brittany was very responsive as well! My only suggestion would be to have more towels available on site. For example: if there are 3 people staying for 2 days, I would provide 6 towels & 6 washcloths minimum…& probably store a couple more under the sink or something just to ensure guests have them available. Also, not going to lie, I’ve stayed in several airbnb’s & maybe I’m probably just used to a cleaning fee associated with booking, but I’m assuming there isn’t one with this specific one, so be prepared for requests to help the host out. If you’re a clean person/people, it won’t be an issue though…so, it wasn’t for us, but it’s to be noted.
David was very responsive and the stay was in good condition when we arrived. The stay was pretty close to the downtown. One feedback would be to add a picture of the pullout sofa.
This was a great Airbnb for a weekend with friends. Ben was very communicative and easy to get ahold of. We had a great weekend.

After a disappointing stay in Upstate New York, C+C's place restored my faith in AirBnB. It is very thoughtfully stocked and decorated--we truly had everything we needed during our stay and the whole place is super clean. The neighborhood is quiet, beautiful, and has a bunch of great restaurants and shops within walking distance. Courtney was friendly and responsive. I love Chicago and I hope to stay at their place again!!
Great Place.  We were in town for a wedding and this place was located close to where we needed to be.  Clean, beautiful and perfect for our needs.  Thanks!
Great place. Large and clean and perfect location!
Regina was a very responsive host.  The location was in a very safe, walkable area.

Shaun’s place was perfect for our Chicago weekend with our adult children. The apartment was so comfortable and had everything we needed. The parking space was great too! The location was nice and we enjoyed exploring the local area.
Will be here again if I need to get to the attractions I missed out on

We had such a wonderful stay here! We'd definitely recommend it and stay here again. The condo was so clean and beautifully appointed. Hands down though, my favorite thing was the SUPER COMFY couch! The only hiccup we had was that there was no garage door opener and one wasn't provided during our 5 day stay, which made coming & going a bit of a challenge as we had to coordinate getting the garage door open manually (and that garage was TIGHT for our mid-size SUV).

The place was nice and very spacious and the rules and expectations felt reasonable to me. From my experience, the airbnb itself was even better than what I expected with ample amenities and hosts who were extremely responsive and accommodating. The only thing I would have wanted to know before booking is the fact that it is close to some known dangerous areas, which I’d learned from a local uber driver when they dropped me off.
Despite that, the Airbnb itself is somewhat tucked away and feels safe, I didn’t feel unsafe whatsoever while being here and for its price and the level of hospitality, space, and cleanliness it’s worth staying here and I would definitely book again. Thank you to the hosts for the great visit!
Loved how close the park was to the home and easy access to it!
Not only was it a great place to stay but the host was friendly and responded to any inquiries quickly.
Beautiful place! We felt right at home and Mario was a great host.
Great location perfect for large groups!
Super sweet host! Very responsive when needed. Would definitely stay here again. Love that it has everything I needed. Cozy little apartment style airbnb! :)
Good, low frills place to stay in Evanston

The photos for the listing don’t do it justice! The apartment is very spacious and open. I have a family of 8, and it’s somewhat difficult to find an equally nice and large enough space for us so we don’t feel on top of each other. My family and I truly enjoyed our stay here in Chicago, and look forward to checking out other listings in different cities the host has to offer! Very walkable location to Chinatown and it’s conveniently next to the L!
Evelyn’s there to be more than a host—she’s there to build a connection with any resident staying with her. Nothing short of kind. Super responsive also!
We had an amazing time and really felt comfortable in the home.  It was clean and organized. Alice was very prompt with her responses and very accommodating.
Great location
Clean, quiet, just as described in the listing! Highly recommended!

Overall, this was a decent stay. I enjoyed the location. The neighborhood seemed very friendly. The room and amenities matched the description! One thing to make note of is our room would have a random puddle in it when someone showered. It wasn’t anything crazy, but it was an inconvenience when the space is already packed tightly. My belongings also got wet. Hosts are great. Very responsive! Very informative! If you’re looking for just a place to stay and do not plan on being in the room a whole lot, this is the place to book!
Great Host! All my needs were met.
Nice space, great location, responsive host!

Great stay in this Uptown Chicago spot! The unit was clean, comfortable, and really nicely put together. The hosts were fantastic — responsive, welcoming, and made the whole stay easy.
Yes, it's above a bar, but don't let that scare you off — it honestly wasn't loud at all, and the location more than makes up for it. You're right in the heart of a fun, walkable neighborhood. Bonus: there's a fantastic doughnut shop right next door, which made for the perfect morning routine.
Would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Charlotte’s place looks amazing! Very responsive host! Definitely staying here again in the future
Had a great weekend stay. Cute place, convenient location.
i enjoyed the stay i wish it was a tv in the room and we don’t have to share 1 bathroom but besides that everything was nice i had fun i loved it.
Great host

I had a wonderful time staying at Alma’s apartment. Check in was quick and easy, Alma answered all of questions promptly and thoroughly, the apartment was very clean and well maintained, and it was nearby the areas I had planned to spend the most time at.
I highly recommend this location. You won’t be disappointed.
Definitely my most comfortable stay. Kind and accommodating host. Very clean and comfortable.
Excelente ubicación y apartamento. Laura estuvo siempre pendiente y recomendaría 100%
It was as described by the host and as the other reviews said.  It's all accurate.
Great area to stay to walk around chicago
My brother and I had a cozy stay! After an entire day in the busy city, it was always nice to come back to this peaceful place to unwind. Definitely recommend to everyone!

I’d recommend this place as a crash pad or a quick stop. It had all the necessities but lacked charm and coziness. Pros are neighborhood, clean kitchen, nice fridge, Roku tv and a balcony sitting area. Cons would be the very squeaky bed, bathtub would back up while showering, and the sticky floor. As other reviewed mentioned this seems to be a building of Airbnb units. Hosts were proactive communicators.

good location, and neighborhood perfectly fine. the space was a very clean simple unit with good bones. the kitchen is very minimally furnished at this point, however, so don’t plan to use it for much of anything. host was communicative and direct.
The owner is very helpful and it was a very cozy stay for our trip. Parking was difficult at times but besides that it’s a delightful little place in Pilsen.
Amazing! The weekend was so fun
This is a beautiful, clean apartment in a lovely neighborhood.
Wonderful experience!

Milan is an exceptional host who kept us all up to date with instructions and organizing all of our early parking requests. Milan responded to all questions immediately which we truly appreciated. Condo was well suited for 6 people and in a prime location for baseball games and concerts at Soldier Field. Access to L train was a simple 5min walk which we used instead of Uber. Highly recommend this Condo and hope to visit again one day! Thank you Milan for everything!

This studio was perfect for our short stay! Everything we needed was within walking distance and the check in/out was so easy. Brad was very responsive and incredibly helpful. We will definitely be staying here again!
Great spot, quiet and as described!
Fun stay

Our extended family came together in Chicago to attend a wedding and sharing this house where there were enough bedrooms for everyone was a good value for us. The exterior and neighborhood were lovely and convenient, and the 2-car garage was a big plus because we drove from Pennsylvania. Inside was as pictured - very roomy, clean and bright. The kitchen had all the appliances we needed to prepare light meals.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend this property to others.
Had a great stay!
This was a perfect place to use as a base to see Chicago.  It is close to the Red line station and the parking space was great.
Place was exactly as expected. Parking was questionable at first but had no issues after talking to the renter
The house was beautiful, spacious and well curated. It had everything we needed and more. We also received a warm welcome from David and Andrea! We would definitely stay here again!
Very nice stay in Argelia's comfortable and clean home.

Perfect location. Loved the Hollywood grill underneath for late night food.
Be aware you will hear the city

Our stay was 5 days, 4 guests. Check in/locating the rental was straightforward and everything was clean. There wasn’t enough pillows or blankets (only 3, very flat, 1 comforter, 1 throw) for 4 people to sleep. There are extra towels provided, and the washer and dryer are available to use but are extremely loud when on. There is no brita or water dispenser so be prepared to bring your own water. The wifi wasn’t working the first 3 days, the host communicated well to get the wifi fixed but the connection was fairly poor (went in and out) even when working. The location was on a very quiet street, pretty safe neighborhood from what we could see.
Jorge is an amazing host! This space was absolutely perfect for my girls weekend getaway! Will definitely be back!
The stay was amazing beautifully remodeled. Very clean and  spacious . Most definitely recommend.
Location was great for our needs

Amazing experience. Would definitely recommend to others. Had a modern and freshly renovated sort of atmosphere. I really liked the plethora of amenities which made our stay very comfortable, including a nespresso machine with pods, washer + dryer w/detergent, full kitchen, beach towels + reusable bags, hair dryer, full bathroom, A/C, and more. Upstairs unit and building neighbors were quiet and we were able to sleep peacefully every night. Whole Foods and restaurants within walking distance made our trip much more convenient. Host checked in on us to see if we needed anything which was appreciated. Highly recommend!!
Great host for a great stay in a really great convenient location! I would definitely rent this space again and have no reservations about recommending it others. Thanks for a lovely stay Alma!!
Great to work with!!!
It was a very nice apartment. Check-in and check-out were both quick and easy. Overall, we had a great stay and would definitely recommend it.

We arrived and pulled into the lot across the street to park as it says there is a discount there, there was no attendant so it was very confusing note If you don’t see one there just wait eventually one will come. Ot also doesn’t mention the location is directly across from a federal prison.
Our air conditioning wasn’t working and I had my 2 year old grandson with. At midnight it was still 80 degrees and unbearable to where we couldn’t sleep. When I told the host they offered fans as a fix and a 10% discount even though we already had fans and jt was still that uncomfortable. So much that we opted to check-out a day early because the next day was an even hotter day temperature wise. I told the host we didnt feel jt was safe in that heat to have especially the little one stay there. They only offered a 29% discount and I paid over $900 to stay there one night. It also reeked of weed when we arrived and had ashes all over so it clearly hadn’t been cleaned from the person prior to us

My partner and I had a wonderful time staying here for the weekend. Everything was so beautiful and Vicki made us feel right at home. I’d definitely recommend staying here if you’re visiting Chicago and want somewhere private to stay.
Incredible space and super responsive host- couldn’t ask for more!
מילן, היה זמין לבקשה שלי וגמיש, המיקום נח ואפשר להתנייד ממנו לכל חלקי העיר, תודה רבה
Bella was kind enough to help me check in despite my arriving at a very late hour. Place was well-appointed and clean, great location. Highly recommend!

Great stay in Chicago! The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The location was convenient, and communication with the host was easy. I had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!

Place was clean and as described.   A bit loud outside on the street with cars jamming to their music way too loud and loud hot rodding cars driving by every now and then between 11pm and 3am on the weekend.    Windows could probably use a little more sound insulation to aid in this.   But understand building is old so only so much one can do and he did provide white noise machines in both bedrooms so my bad for not trying them out.   Great location and great ac.   Beds are memory foam mattresses which can run a bit hot even when the ac is set to 67 at night but with the down comforter being the only bedding and it being summer, I did find myself sweating at times during sleep.  Might recommend a lighter blanket option for summer stays.   Oh, and minor but worth mentioning, the complimentary coffee grounds provided for very weak tea like brew.   Had a hard time getting it to brew bold and strong. Went to target close by and bought dunkin donut grounds and it was way better.   ;-)

Was thoroughly surprised with our stay. Great location. Logan Square is just a block away and theres a lot of wonderful restaurants and shops in the area. Place was clean and made us feel like we lived in the area. Be mindful that the unit is on the third floor and stairs are outside. But the view up there is pretty.

Great location and a very responsive host. The room was exactly as described, which made check-in and the overall stay easy and comfortable. The TVs were not working during our visit, and there was a slight paint smell from recent updates, but it was manageable. It’s clear the property is being improved, and once everything is finished, it will be an even better place to stay.
Very walkable location also a few minutes walk to the red line, which is very useful to get around the city.

Location, location, location! This place is walking distance to all the touristic places I wanted to go. It has tons of restaurants and bars around. The apartment was a perfect size for our party of 5, having enough room for both alone time and also cool living rooms for hanging out.
The balcony was our favorite part of the apartment.
Everything was very clean, only positive things to say about this place.
I would stay again in a heartbeat.

Great location in Wicker Park that is very walkable! The accommodation needs a good cleaning and refresh. Additionally, we were looking for some flexibility on checkout and weren’t given any despite no booking for the next day and house rules posted inside stating that was an option for a fee.

To say I loved Tracy's space would be an understatement. You feel right as home as you walk in, as its an extremely comfortable environment. It has everything you need, and the additional waters and snack basket that she has was very welcoming!
Tracy herself was amazing to work with as well. Answered any and all questions I had for her, overall was extremely communicable. I had talked with her awhile before booking(right as she posted her listing), and just speaking with her made me extremely excited to be choosing her as my host. Any small hiccups I may have had she acknowledged and handled efficiently.
For the Bnb stayers - its on street parking for both sides of the street, I definitely recommend looking at Google maps before arriving to familiarize yourself with it. It may seem difficult to find parking in the evening, but is rather easy and simple enough once you have an understanding of the lay out!
I absolutely would/will stay here at the Pullman again, Thank you Tracy!❣️
Mary is a great host and her place was perfect to stay at for over two months!
Easy to find and access. Clean, friendly neighbors. Will stay again.

Our stay at Marco’s listing was AMAZING!!! The sweetest little place in the cutest area of Chicago! Marco was very fast responding to questions if we had any worries! The place is such an adorable place to stay! We had an amazing time on our trip!
I can’t recommend this place enough!! ❤️
The area was quiet and close to everything we wanted to do. The space was a good but the floors were dirty. Overall a good stay.

Good spot to stay at while visiting Hyde Park. Very walkable location with access to great food, shops, and cultural destinations. The unit was a bit smaller than expected but ok for up to 2 people. Also, the unit I stayed in didn’t match the picture. Similar but definitely a bit older. There was some confusion with the address as the one listed on Airbnb was different from the one shared in the check-in docs. All-in-all a decent stay and the host was fairly communicative.
Lovely private location, close to everything I had planned and responded quickly with any questions

Did not look like the pictures.  One of the beds was broke in the center,  the majority of the blinds were either broken or falling apart, the bathroom was disgusting with a broken towel rack/stained shower/ moldy shower curtain, only one small mirror for what was listed as a 7 person unit, the stairway was dirty, the unit was lopsided so you leaned when you walked through it, the trumble bed pullouts were not big enough for an adult and very uncomforable...too many things to list.  The pictures and description were misleading and should not be listed as a 7 person unit, rather a 4 person at best.  We had 5 people and it was terrible.  It was not worth the $1850 we paid.  It was a rip off.  The only good thing was street parking availability, probably only because of the area being lame.  Had to uber anywhere exciting.  I feel like we deserve a refund.

This is my second stay at the neighborhood hotel. It is always clean and easy to get into. Jonathan is very responsive and attentive! The only thing is there were technical difficulties this year and last year with my stays involving the elevators and power.

I absolutely loved the place, checking in was easy, the view was actually really nice, everything we needed was here, and it was only about a 15 minute drive from downtown, aside from all that the only con was the WiFi wasn’t working but it wasn’t the end of the world, great deal would definitely stay here again!
Great host! Great location to visit the city!
Great location - walking distance to lakefront and beach , easy to communicate- they even lent us beach chairs and umbrella

We had a wonderful stay in this modern, beautifully designed home. It was exactly as described - clean, comfortable, and a perfect fit for our visit. We’re grateful to Paul for making such a great place available and would absolutely stay here again!
Tere was very communicative and responsive. I appreciated that.
Property looked just like the photos. Beds were very comfortable.

Fantastic location. Super quick and easy access to Fullerton, Milwaukee and California busses, along with the blue line. Sit-down restaurants along with Wendy's and Dunkin' Donuts all within a 5-minute walk, making breakfast/lunch/dinner decisions easy and plentiful.
Had a great and comfortable stay! The location was convenient and close to plenty of places to explore nearby. Everything made for an easy and enjoyable visit. I would definitely stay here again!

Terry and John were amazing hosts and very welcoming! John gave us helpful recommendations for the area, and was happy to answer any questions about the city. The Airbnb is in a wonderful walkable area, close to restaurants, a Whole Foods, a metro station, and only a 10-15 minutes walk to the beach!

This apartment has the most incredible views!  Just breathtaking.  While it is expensive, the views are amazing.  Very clean and reasonably well stocked.  I would stay again.  I wish that Cloud Nine would remove the security deposit requirement.
What a fantastic stay. This is one of the best bnb’s I have ever stayed at. It’s a calming atmosphere, and the furniture is comfortable.
Nice area. Train is about 10-13 minute walk. There’s a food store 9 minutes out that has plenty of selection of food. The apartment is very spacious and comfortable. Very much enjoyed the stay
Great apartment in a lovely neighborhood. Easy walks to restaurants close by and the train. Perfect place for the weekend 😊 also met their doodle dog who was precious and friendly
Had a great stay at Aaron’s place. Easy parking, nice upgraded kitchen and bathroom, and comfortable living area. Everything you could think of was supplied. Will stay there again.
This space is NOT located in hyde park. Please be aware it is not safe to walk around this neighborhood.
Agradable, super limpio, buena ubicación, buen atención por parte de Andy
A lovely stay in a beautiful neighborhood.
This neighborhood and home were perfect for a trip to the city to see a concert at Soldier Field.
We were looking for a place to sleep, we knew we would be out all day. Getting a simple, clean room was exactly all we needed. Tracye was very responsive and helpful

This spot was great and William and Ross the hosts were great. Check in instructions were clear, they were responsive when we were coming in, and the location itself was gorgeous. It was private and cozy.

The listing was accurate and cozy. Full kitchen and a good living room with a nice, big TV. The apartment was very close to a few bus lines and was about a 10-15 minute bus ride to the Blue Line. Would stay here again.

The home is beautiful from the outside and on the inside! We didn't spend much time there as we explored the Chicago area, but were comfortable while there. Sean did a great job communicating leading up to and after the rental period. Thank you!
Perfect for what we needed for the weekend. About a 25 minute drive to the city with many local bunch places and restaurants to try.
Great location and space. Loved how the bedroom was separate from living area. Very cool artifacts and decor. Felt very homey. Nice location close to the park and a coffee shop.

Super cute studio! Private entrance and the host was very responsive and suggested some local restaurants. Our only issues was that it was pretty warm in there and the sink was very small. The small window unit was covered by the curtains, so you couldn’t have privacy unless the AC was covered up. It was also almost impossible to wash your face or brush your teeth over the mini sink since the medicine cabinet was right above it. Other than that, everything else was exactly as described and we had a great stay!
An absolutely lovely stay all around.
Great stay. Walkable location with plenty around. The accommodations were wonderful and the host was great. Would recommend.

Great location, lots of space, really well equipped, very responsive hosts.
My only issue is the sofas in the living room. Both were uncomfortable both as a place to sit as well as a place to sleep. We often choose AirBnBs instead of hotel rooms because we want to have a common room to hang out as a family. This place has a large room, but the two sofas were both quite uncomfortable. Despite all of the plusses, I wouldn't rent again unless I knew they had been replaced.
We had a great time at this Airbnb! The host was very friendly and helpful with any questions we had. Overall such a great experience and very close/walkable to explore the area.

Overall a very nice airbnb experience. Other reviews mentioned noisy upstairs neighbors. We only heard them for about 5 minutes around the time we were waking up. It was a great location, close to an amazing park that hosted lots of activities (farmers market, vendors, soccer games, etc). Lots of food within walking distance. Quiet street that felt really safe. The unit was clean and comfortable.

This beautiful place was tucked in the Medical District of Chicago, and had everything we needed. The home was very clean, and spacious, and quiet- we didn't have a single complaint about it. In fact, Thomas was such a great host who offered us flexible check-in & check out options and who was incredibly responsive to whatever questions we had. This place is close to public transportation and has enough street parking should you decide to drive. I definitely recommend a stay here. 5 stars all the way.
Nat was such a responsive host. The place was exactly as the pictures. There is plenty of street parking available.
It was amazing and very clean. The location was convenient, we were able to walk many places!
The apartment was comfortable and in an excellent location. Ola was excellent communicating. I would absolutely stay here again!

Had a great stay at Johnnie’s! He was very responsive throughout the stay, and the place was clean and comfortable. The bathrooms were nicely updated, too. It was especially great to find a place with four bedrooms, which can be tough to come by at a reasonable price during a big event weekend in Chicago. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay!
The space was nice and as described. The location was everything! Easy access to restaurants, shops, coffee, etc. Would definitely stay again.

The Airbnb was very well equipped. Plenty of hot water. The air conditioning was easy to operate and worked well. The neighborhood has lots of great restaurants, coffee shops etc. The Brown line CTA is very close, so there is easy access to the loop and all of Chicago. Demitri was quick to respond to emails. We would stay here again.
Clean, neat, and convenient for our stay. Communication with Abby was great!
Had a great stay. Perfect for a weekend trip.
We really enjoyed our stay, and would be happy to stay here again!  We appreciated how Tara was quick to respond and the neighborhood was lovely.

This place was great,
It was in the perfect location for what we were doing.

I had a wonderful stay! The place actually looks even nicer and more spacious in person than in the pictures. It has everything you need for a short stay and is very comfortable and convenient.
The private entrance made it easy to come and go, and the location felt safe and private. The check-in instructions were very clear and simple, making the whole process easy and stress-free.
The host was great—straight to the point, clear, and easy to communicate with. He didn’t ask unnecessary questions and made everything simple and convenient.
Overall, I really enjoyed the stay and would definitely recommend this place. I couldn’t recommend it enough!

The location couldn’t have been better close to the Red Line and perfect for Market Days. The host was very friendly and quick to respond. The building is older, so the hot water took a bit to heat up and I didn’t see recycling available, but aside from those small things, the stay was comfortable and convenient.

Jihad’s place was perfect for our stay. The apartment is very nice and clean, with two full bathrooms and a nice back yard. The neighborhood is great. Very walkable and restaurants and stores are very close.
Jennifer’s place was wonderful! Super convenient spot and the place itself was very comfy.

Justin’s place was amazing. It’s exactly as it looks. Justin was an excellent host and flexible.
I stayed about 4 days. The place is about a 4 minute walk from the pink line so public transit was a breeze. I walked to and from the place daily with no issues. At night there are no major street lights on the way there but the block is very well lit.
I definitely recommend and would not hesitate to stay there again!
Thanks Karen!We had a great time ant your place!Great area and clean Home.

This air bnb was super spacious, great location in Chicago, whether driving or walking. I wish we stayed longer because the few nights weren’t enough! Definitely recommend this space to stay if you want to feel comfortable and have a nice little private space. Only thing that is a pain is parking and maybe neighbors above, the footsteps are easier to hear, but it isn’t a dealbreaker and we made it work, would stay again :)
Great location, clean and met all my needs. Great hosts.
Great place for my market days stay
Great place and very spacious, multiple beds and a full kitchen. Has everything you need to make dinner or eggs and bacon in the morning. Great stay and quiet area!

The location close to Chicago ave and Milwaukee ave was great! Easy walkability for shops, coffee stops, and restaurants nearby. Walk around the neighborhood to see cool brick houses and cat spotting. Having the garage parking was very convenient.
Group of friends flew and met in town! The home was lovely! During a thunderstorm , we watched scary movies in the living area until it passed! Felt so homey! Thanks ✨

Richard & Cathy were the loveliest hosts! Their communication, kindness and hospitality exceeded my expectations.
Where they went the extra mile:
• Offering us an early check-in!
This was so nice after being on an early flight where we’d have had luggage to haul and time to kill before the average check in time elsewhere.
• Some starter groceries to have a snack and first breakfast covered after getting settled in. This was a huge help and rare to receive with other hosts.
• Helping provide local suggestions and travel tips for the area and Chicago.
Their space was just the home away from home we needed, with all the thoughtful amenities, comfortable air conditioning and the most cozy queen bed + linens.
15/10, would stay here again. :)

The apartment was perfect for four couples. Everything was in good working order and seamed to have been recently renovated. It was well priced compared to other rentals we looked at. Studebecker was a great host, responded quickly with any questions we had. The neighborhood is awesome. Lots of Mex restaurants and cool places to check out right up the street. La Luna cafe is fabulous. We would stay here again for sure
Wonderful space in an amazing neighborhood. Highly recommend.
Very nice place

Stayed with family, ample space and the half bath is super useful. Great location, near restaurants and the train and many buses. I was surprised how close the train was because I did not hear it! Layout inside gives plenty of places to sit and to gather. Had quiet coffee every morning in chairs facing outside to the little garden area. The stairs up to the bedrooms may not be for all travelers. Very well appointed, the kind of place that has plenty of towels or hangers or coffee mugs! Loved it.

Mark was quick to respond and accommodating. Property is within walking distance to Logan Square (to left) and Diversey (to right).
Very clean and comfy bed. Great neighborhood. Always felt safe.
Tip: Street parking is mostly permit so was drove around for some time looking for a spot. Eventually found spot at end of Sacramento and Diversey. Open every time.
Would recommend and stay again.
Enjoyed a long weekend in Chicago and this spot was great! Very walkable and close to the Belmont Red line station and all the restaurants and shops.

Kim was very communicative throughout the whole process. The place was very nice and as described. The internet was not working and while that was definitely an inconvenience for us whilst being there on business, Kim was great and fair and provided us a credit to resolve the matter! Very much appreciated!
A little noisy from above neighbors. Parking was sometimes a street or two away. Master shower was great, beds were comfortable

If you want to be in a great location for bars, restaurants and walkability in Lincoln Park, this is a good choice.  If you want quiet, I suggest booking something that is not on Clark. This is a very old building that has been remodeled in a nice way.  The unit is well decorated and had all of the basics we needed.  Unfortunately, the air conditioners were not working for all 3 nights of our stay and the issue could not be resolved while we were there.  The host communicated well and provided us a partial refund.  Due to our experience and the noise, we will book something in a quieter area next time we travel to Chicago.

Can’t say enough!
This was my first time to stay in a room with Airbnb vs. a full home.
It was lovely, quiet, great AC, and incredible bathroom extras!
Chicago is a tight town for finding a place to stay that is close to your friends that’s not all the way downtown.
This was perfect, and a free garage to use… that’s worth every penny in this city!
I absolutely recommend this host!
I’ll be back for certain.
(Fyi, he makes a great pot of coffee) ♥️

Had a wonderful stay with Alma. The place was extremely clean and server it’s purpose for our group. The neighborhood is extremely walkable and filled with restaurants and bars. You’re also close to the train & highway if you’re interested in exploring more of the city. 10/10 experience!
Regina was a great host, and the place was cute, clean, and comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay overall and would definitely stay there again.

The place was very nice, and the hosts provided great instructions and were very responsive. I only have a few Cons:
1. The location wasn’t as walkable as I expected. Before booking, I asked how close it was to areas I’d be visiting frequently (including Boystown for Market Days) and was told it was a short walk. Unfortunately, it was more like a 10-minute Uber ride. I took about 15 Ubers during my stay, which added up quickly. The location itself is beautiful, but it’s not very walkable to many places.
2. We were only provided 2 bath towels for 5 days. A few extras would have been appreciated, especially since we went to the beach one day and didn’t have a towel to bring.
3. The bathroom is VERY small, with virtually no space for toiletries. Some shelves or a medicine cabinet would help tremendously.
We rented both units. Ample space for our group of 18 to sleep. For dining we had to bring chairs and stools over from the other unit. We hired Gmarket Chef for a private, catered meal.

Super nice place. Clean, cosy, comfy and roomy. Nicely decorated and furnished. Great location with plenty of parking options. I would stay here again when returning to the area. Host was extremely kind, friendly and accessible.
Lake was an amazing host, was very responsive, home was clean and location was very convenient!
Great little apartment.

What a perfect spot for a stay in Chicago!!
The location was in beautiful Lincoln Park, on a quiet street close to many restaurants, the zoo & the lake. The flat was very nice, clean, spacious and was well equipped with everything we needed. Danny was very responsive with answers to any questions we had and helpful with extra parking for our guests. We highly recommend this property.!
Host was very transparent about the listing which I appreciated. Not the most luxurious place but the place is well kept and very worth the price point.
Miya, is a great host! She was always available for any questions.  It’s a beautiful place for a family to stay in fantastic location. Would absolutely stay here again

Below are our thoughts regarding our stay in Chicago:
1) Building is great
2) Door People are very nice and helpful
3) Building is right in front of the Blue line (O'Hare airport). Don't need a car if you want to use public transportation. 
4) Parking garage on Federal street (one block from Building- safe, covered, we paid $35 per 24 hour period with in and out privileges)
5) They have recycling on each floor - ask the door person to show you where the trash and recycling are.
6) For us, this area is more the "real" Chicago, than staying North of the river (more tourists, expensive shops, etc.).
7) There are great coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance of the building. 
8) There is only one TV, so have your kids bring their devices so they can watch their shows in the PM
9) Cyndi was responsive when we had questions
Very at-home feeling. Would rent again.
Great locations.
I had a fantastic stay! Highly recommend for anyone who needs a 1 month+ accommodation in Chicago

Marissa's place was cute and quaint, within walking distance from Boystown and Wrigleyville. She was very responsive to communications and her instructions were easy to follow. I would definitely stay there again, and highly recommend it to others. It helped make my first trip to Chicago a great one!

This is my second time staying at Joe’s place and I highly recommend for those solo traveler’s. The breakfast options (available from 0600-1200) are plentiful with cold cereal/milk, fresh fruit, OJ, eggs and bacon if you prefer to cook a hot breakfast). The bed was very comfortable with ample storage for clothes and luggage. Easy entry from outside with code. Bathroom was good with a bidet toilet. Towel provided and shower has body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Price was fabulous for Chicago Area. Please give this place a try if you are ever in the north Chicago area. It’s terrific and Joe communicates with you in a timely manner.

The place looked like the description and Brad was responsive. We had issues with the tv constantly disconnecting from the wifi. Brad responded quickly to troubleshoot, but we didn’t follow up because I didn’t want to deal with the hassle. It was just a bummer that was the case. It would’ve been nice to have more than 1 thin towel per person for 6 days, any kind of spare blanket or throw, and toilet paper more than what seemed like a half ply. Some of those details just seemed cheap especially for the price. Overall it was a nice stay and no major problems, but some small upgrades would make a difference
Another great stay at the Nook. Easy check in and great communication from the hosts. Perfectly located and stocked with everything you need for 1-2 travelers. Highly recommend.
Beautiful place, well kept, thoughtful amenities. More suitable for five guests, not six - sleeper sofa is child size. Hosts are very responsive.

We had a great stay at Tara’s place! The location was perfect and within walking distance of tons of restaurants, bars, and things to do. The place was also a great fit for our group of six and everyone was comfortable. Tara was super responsive and easy to communicate with throughout the whole stay. Definitely would recommend this place!
This is in a great location. The hosts were very responsive and friendly.  Would definitely recommend a stay.

Accommodations were excellent. 2 nice bedrooms, tv area and nice kitchen. VERY clean. Street parking a little tough, but not impossible. First 2 nights of loud, barking dogs, but host must have made a call, and it stopped in about 20-30 minutes. We would stay there again assuming the dog problem isn't a constant issue. Our last 2 nights were quiet.

The accommodation is very clean and tidy, true to the photos, and the host is really kind. The instructions are very clear, and the other guests were very respectful. However, regarding the downsides: I wouldn't stay here again, simply because the neighborhood is extremely dangerous. There are drug users everywhere, people staring us up and down, and an atmosphere and energy that made us feel anything but safe; there is also a lot of noise at night. An Uber driver who dropped us off even advised us to move elsewhere for our final night, telling us, "Money can be replaced, but your life can't. Think of your family, be careful here." If you are passing through for work and don't plan on going out, it might suffice, but if you are a tourist visiting the area, you might want to look elsewhere.
Very nice neighborhood very quiet. minutes away from downtown I had no issue getting around.

Great apartment! Pristine, cool vibe, close to everything. Very walkable neighborhood. Super owner. And the best toilet ever! Will definitely come back if available next time I’m in Chicago. Thanks Brett!
Adam’s place was perfect for a weekend in Boystown. Great location. Cute and clean. Would def stay again.

Sulaiman was a great host. The space was clean and comfortable, with plenty of fresh towels and all of the listed amenities. We had to book very last minute, and Sulaiman was incredibly responsive—often replying within minutes or even seconds. They were friendly and helpful throughout our stay, and all of the instructions were very clear. Would definitely stay again.
Great place to stay for our family of five. The hosts were super responsive and flexible.  Would definitely stay here again.

Our stay was absolutely phenomenal. Our host was incredible helpful and quick to respond with any questions we had throughout our stay. We couldn’t have imagined a better stay for our weekend trip to Chicago!
Maria was very responsive about any questions we had! The location was perfect- very close to everything in logan! space was very large and clean and easy to find!
We came all the way from Texas and had a great stay. House was amazing and so warming would definitely stay here again. Area was also perfect.
Sidi is great host，and the apartment is just the one a traveler need. Great location, mins to CTA.
Great location, great host and great place to stay!

Great Value for location, one block from ‘Osterman Beach. Very clean throughout, nice bath towels.
Quiet Studio, typical city sounds, and did not hear neighbors at all. I could walk to most places I wanted to go, and/or quick access to uber or divvy bike/scooter. Early check-in was no problem and a huge help. As one person staying here, I highly recommend.

We were really only at the BnB to sleep but it was a beautiful place, quiet, and easy place to drive to destinations around the city. The hosts were wonderful and communicated well. I have not complaints only praise.
This place was lovely and in a lovely part of the city. It was great for our family of 7. Only wish we could have stayed longer!
The stay was great, very comfortable and in a nice area. The beds were comfortable and clean, the kitchen was clean and spacious, and the dinning room was so nice.
Everything was perfect staying there & close to downtown not a long ride!
Great stay w Justin!
Très confortable , beau et propre. Merci Nicholas
Mera place was amazing! It was in walking distance to where I had to get too and very convenient with the stores around. 10/10 would recommend!
It was a great place in a great location
Good
very comfortable, easy stay for two couples. We were attending a wedding in the neighborhood and this was a wonderful spot to return to each night.
Great place! Great location! Walking distance to Wrigley Field, the Red Line and all the local establishments.
Fantastic location in a beautiful building. We all had an amazing stay!
This place was so pretty and intimate. Easy to find and was so accessible for me and my partner. Will book again.
Great host great place would definitely recommend it for anyone coming for either long or short stay…

We loved our stay at Sky and Steel.  Brad was an incredible host.  The space was so cool and amazing!!  We loved it.  The place is far larger than the pictures imply.  The bedrooms are large and comfortable with plenty of room for our family of 4 (2 teenagers) and my brother and sister-in-law.  Also, the kitchen is beautiful and great for a home cooked meal.  The surrounding neighborhood is quaint and quiet and the neighbors very friendly.  It is a few blocks from groceries, pharmacy, restaurants and shopping.  It is also very ride-share accessible to every aspect of the city, usually within 20 minutes.  Overall, a wonderful place to stay and we would definitely stay again when in Chicago.  It was one of the highlights of this incredible city!

The accommodations were comfortable and clean. And the location was exceptional. However, there were issues with the accommodations that made us stay more difficult than it needed to be. The lockbox outside was missing a key when we tried to check in and we were forced to wait outside with our bags until a third-party who lived in the building, let us in.
This issue persisted throughout the first day and night with us getting stranded outside the property multiple times. A key was finally provided during the second day.
There was also the issue of the Wi-Fi, which was painfully slow and often dropped out. We even tried resetting the router in the living room, to no avail.
There was also very low water pressure in both showers. But that wasn’t as significant of an issue once we got used to it.
As I said, overall the place was very nice to stay in. Clean, comfortable, well furnished, and host was very responsive. We would stay here again if these minor issues are addressed.
Great place and communicative host!
My friends and I were able to fly in from different states and reconnect in this comfy space. Great location. Would stay again

Chanita's place was wonderful. The checkin process was easy and she accommodated an earlier check-in time. The place felt just like home and spotless. She was also extremely responsive to any questions we had during our stay.

James is a very responsive host and quickly addressed any concerns we had during our stay. Great location in the city walkable to good food and coffee and multiple playgrounds for our toddler. Very comfortable beds, great AC, and the parking permits were very convenient. Would stay again!

This home was a wonderful place to stay for our family for a special wedding weekend in Chicago. We have a large family with several small children....and having the separate garden apartment was especially helpful. We also loved the porch as a place to let the kids have a space to play and for all of us to sit outside in the evening.
Tom was a great host and very responsive to questions.
Thank you for your hospitality!
Great little spot just off the main blocks of Wicker Park. Private deck in the back and a very quiet building. AC worked great and the pillows were abundant. Would stay again!

I enjoyed my stay for several nights. It is a large apartment. Vin was a helpful and responsive host. The apartment has the essentials.
The area is walkable and there are many restaurants and multi-cultural markets nearby. If you are into Indian or Middle Eastern cuisine, you’ll especially enjoy the area.
There was masonry work going on next door as of August 2026, so you may need ear plugs or headphones if you are a light sleeper and want to sleep while they are working.

The house was absolutely amazing. I could only dream to have such a sanctuary of a home.  The area is so beautiful and peaceful. Easy to get to using public transportation or uber. Honestly if you are looking for a get away with friends and family then this space is calling to you to book now. Emily was so responsive and kind. If I haven't got an apartement or house next year in Chicago would return in a heartbeat.
Good, affordable place if needing somewhere to stay for a night or two. Very walkable and close by to the Brown Line and bus stops

This place was truly amazing and such a gem to find! I’ve never met a host like Auntie Yakini. She genuinely wants you to have the best time in Chicago and you can tell how much she loves her city and community. She made us feel like we were visiting our own auntie’s house and had us laughing and smiling every time we crossed paths. She added something special to our trip that we didn’t even know we needed. It was a true honor to stay here.
The location was great, only about a 7 minute walk to the train station, making it easy to get downtown. The neighborhood was peaceful, welcoming and friendly. Everyone we came across was so kind and we felt very comfortable.
The Airbnb had everything we needed and the pictures matched the place perfectly. There were plenty of nearby options for food and groceries. Auntie Yakini even gave us a large picture of water with fresh mint from her garden, which was such a thoughtful touch.
We can’t wait to come back to Chicago and visit auntie again! ☺️
Thank you Hanna and Mark for your hospitality. Everything was perfect as I expected.
Newly remodeled kitchen appliances and bathroom sink. Two blocks from major bus stops and within walking distance to two subways.

The space was comfortable and as described. It was also in an historically interesting area of Chicago.  The beds are comfortable and the air conditioning kept us nice and cool during our hot summer visit.
The place is clean and spacious and the host is responsive.

Vin’s place is very quiet and clean. Lots of space and a very nice kitchen and bathroom. Bed very comfortable and air conditioners in every room (important in August!). She responded immediately to my texts. Front door lock of building a little tricky but that’s nothing to do with the apartment itself. Albany neighborhood full of great restaurants and green spaces and is safe and clean. Took train from airport to Montrose bus stop, went about 12 stops and only 2 block walk to apartment. We were a little early but there was a great Mexican restaurant/bar on Montrose to relax in.
Great location. Easy access to train stations.

The apartment is better than advertised. Lisa did a phenomenal job at making sure I had a great stay. She was very proactive and helpful throughout my stay. The apartment was well put together; I enjoyed the decor. I will not hesitate to stay here again!
Already booked for next year !! Amazing location !!!

Spacious bedrooms and bathroom. It was just right for the 3 couples that shared the unit. Everything was as described and recognizable from the photos.
The location was perfect for the activities we had planned.
We would stay there again if the opportunity arises.

Stay was overall great! Both our room and kitchen/bathroom were clean upon arrival and hosts gave clear instructions on how to check in. Throughout our stay, the hosts were also super responsive and helpful. The room is walking distance from a few restaurants and is also right next to bus stops, which made going into the city super easy. Overall, it was very worth it for the price.

The host was very responsive and helpful. We had an issue with the bathtub not properly draining and he offered to have somebody come by and fix it the very next morning. Host was also helpful in getting us inside the building as the door was stuck. The Airbnb was clean and comfortable. I would recommend this place to others!

GREAT location. We had the entire upper floor apartment. Nicely decorated. Not cluttered. Very tasteful. Kitchen had all needed amenities. Very clean. Door locks worked easily. Would definitely stay again and recommend.
Could have been more accurate to the picture and the back porch was a bit uneven and safe
