I had a very comfortable stay here for a month! The room is small but cozy and has everything you need. Towels, shampoo, and a hairdryer were all provided, which was very convenient. I felt very comfortable throughout my stay and really enjoyed spending the month here. I would definitely recommend this place!
This was an amazing place to stay, i was a little worried about street parking but i always found a spot with no issues!

Olesya’s place is wonderful. The location can’t be beat; so many great restaurants, bars, and accessible public transportation!  Right next to the red line and you can get to downtown Chicago in about 15 minutes! The place is super easy to access, love the digital lock. Very clean and felt right at home. I would absolutely stay here again!
Cute place, simple, with everything we needed. Would definitely recommend.
This Airbnb was clean and in a very central part of Wicker Park. Lots of great restaurants and shops within a walkable distance. John was very kind and responsive. Highly recommend this Airbnb!
Great location close to Halstead
Loved staying here! The place is just as described. Andy is a great and very responsive host, and was proactive about expectations they wanted us to follow ahead of time. Can't wait to come back!
Abacus was a great host who communicates quickly and in a friendly way. The apartment looked exactly like the pictures and was so easy to get in and out of.

Easy to get Lyfts to restaurants and sites in the inner city. Parking was a concern of ours, but we always found a spot near the entrance to our place on the street, so it was easier than expected. Comfortable and great place to stay!
I always enjoy staying here; excellent location!
We had a wonderful time in Chicago! Terry was very friendly, helpful, and responsive. The place was very inviting and spacious. We would love to visit again sometime.
Great place and very clean. Would stay here again
I had a lovely stay at Tim’s place. Tim’s friend Barbara was very responsive and gave detailed unambiguous instructions regarding check in and check out. The place was clean and easy to get into.
Great place to stay and having the garage was convenient

The place was a great, economical choice for a quick weekend trip. I enjoyed the quick access the train and convenience stores within walking distance. The room (vintage airline) was as advertised but maybe a bit smaller than I’d thought based on the photos. I often only reserve spaces where I am the only occupant but I rarely heard my neighbors and the shared spaces were large enough for multiple groups to congregate at once. The bathroom needed a little TLC during my stay but everyone cleaned up after themselves and I never waited too long for a restroom. Ryan was also great in accommodating me and communicating with me. I would definitely stay again for another weekend trip.

Host is great with communication. Only problem we faced was the air conditioning was not what we expected. It has 2 window units in the bedrooms, no central AC, so if the bedroom doors were closed there was no cooling in the main areas.
Great place, so easy to walk to the different areas of Lakeview.

Clean and comfortable space underneath the main house with its own gate and your personal door key code, felt more much roomier in person than it looked in the photos. Cute neighborhood walking distance from nearby busier areas. Arlene was proactive with her communication and brought us an extra umbrella when a sudden storm hit. Thank you very much for offering your home to us!
Great place to make a home base for exploring Chicago. Close to mass transit and places to eat.

What a great find! Excellent location in a wonderful neighborhood, close to Lincoln Park, Steppenwolf Theater, super restaurants! The bed was comfortable and the decor very fun! Loved the guitar theme!  The owners were responsive and thoughtful! Can’t wait to return!
Great place! Nice quiet neighborhood. 5 min walk to bus stops and 13min walk to the blue line. Uber or Lyft to the loop range from $20-$35. Great host, very responsive
Wonderful place to stay and really enjoyed the area. Amenities were nice as well (used pool table, pool, workout room).
La casa era bella. Il quartiere pessimo e la pulizia lasciava a desiderare
The place was great and in a perfect location. The doormen and women were very friendly and helpful. We will definitely stay here next time we visit Chicago!

This is easily the best Airbnb I’ve stayed at. Everything was clean and the space was absolutely beautiful. The little illustrations taped on the wall were a wonderful touch and I appreciated the little gnome placed in the plant next to the TV! It stormed pretty intensely during our stay, so the VHS collection was a highlight. The lighting in the loft felt so cozy, we couldn’t have asked for a better stay. The neighborhood was so peaceful, and we thoroughly enjoyed exploring the area. We can’t wait to book this place again in the future! Thank you Chris and Preeti!

Pictures don’t really match the place. The place is super dirty and smelly. The building is too old. Shower curtain was filthy. The smell was really bad. I don’t recommend staying here. Not worth the money.
The only good thing was the location.
Overall m, great place to stay. However, the noise above is a little disturbing and makes it hard to rest at night.

A really wonderful, peaceful stay with myself and my kids for my birthday weekend!  It was so easy to find yummy places to eat nearby, so much to walk to and easy to get to the trains.  I am used to Chicago so that definitely helped me out but I loved the charming neighborhood and it is the perfect spot for a family.  I drank my coffee on the back deck every morning while the kiddos slept in and it was just overall a very nice visit.

We stayed a week at Melissa's place and had a great time. It was very affordable for the Chicago area, in a quiet neighborhood with easy access to train and bus lines.
The unit was clean and well-equipped, no kitchen but a mini-fridge and microwave for limited food prep. Some noise from the people upstairs but nothing too disruptive. As stated in the listing, some areas of the ceiling are low. If you are six feet or over, I predict you will bump your head at least once during your stay here.
Nothing fancy, but worked as a comfortable and affordable home base for our long weekend in Chicago. Would definitely stay again!

Brian was a great host. Probably one of the best Airbnb experiences I have had. Everything worked. There were thoughtful touches like filters for the coffee machine. The appliances we spotless. The toilets are wild (heatesr seats and bidet and stuff like that). The location can not be beat (right next to red line).  The bed was also very comfortable. Would definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay at Wrigley’s Rooftop! The host was incredibly responsive and made the entire Airbnb experience easy and enjoyable. The space itself was fantastic—spacious, well-organized, and had plenty of room for everyone to feel comfortable.
The property was thoughtfully set up and made for a great stay. The only small improvement I would suggest would be providing a quick-reference booklet or guide for the property, with helpful information such as waste removal instructions, a list of supplies available, and other common questions guests might have.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would absolutely recommend Wrigley’s Rooftop to others!
Great host and great location. Beautiful place. Thx!

Rida was an excellent host and would definitely stay at her place again. It was easy to get in, the place was so clean, and Rida herself was a pleasure to deal with. She was responsive and extremely helpful in planning my stay and while we were there.
I would definitely stay at this location again!
Great host in a great area !!
Great space in a wonderfully quiet block in Andersonville. Host recommendations were spot on and the stay couldn’t have been better. I would book this again for my next visit.

Fantastic stay! The space was beautiful, just like the photos, and very easily accessible! Cassandra was very responsive and helpful during our stay. Would definitely recommend anyone looking for a weekend getaway to consider this spot. All around a great experience!

Perfect Airbnb for a group trip, just off the blue line in wicker park neighborhood. Super convenient location. Large rooms with updated bathrooms and large comfy beds. Would definitely come back again if opportunity came up! Great value and we appreciated early check in and late check out. Thanks again!!

It is a beautiful space - new and beautifully designed.  Perfect weekend for our family.  We loved the outdoor space.  Nicole was very responsive and friendly.  Great area- right by Wrigley.   We highly recommend.
Good location by the beach with plenty of space.

Our stay was five stars from the moment of booking! Jay answered all our questions quickly. the home was clean, neat, stylish and comfortable.   We were in town for Baseball game at Rate field and could have taken train as the stop was across the street.   We ended up driving and it was a breeze! Would not hesitate to stay again!  Thank you again Jay for being g a perfect host & making our family feel comfortable!
Great place would definitely stay there again.
No complaints everything looked like the pictures and I enjoyed a great birthday weekend staying here
Thanks!

This is a great place to stay in Chicago! Close to a lot of restaurants, shops, bars, and nightlife. Everything is in walking distance, and in a beautiful neighborhood. Ron’s place was incredibly comfortable, and he was a very responsive host that gave lots of recommendations on things to do around the city!
Great location. Clean. Chic.

This was our best airbnb stay yet! The space was exactly as pictured. Comfortable beds and couch space. Our host included local eating spots and activities as well as instructions for check in, check out, and how to use the appliances. There were board games available as well as a record player. Very clean and comfy! Lokesh was amazing. 10/10 recommend.

Caitlyn’s place was perfect for us! The size of the unit and the proximity to restaurants, bars, and public transit was perfect! She was very helpful if we had any questions! Would definitely stay here again!

Luis Adrian y su esposa nos recibieron muy amables, nos consiguieron estacionamiento, la comunicación e instrucciones claras, departamento accesible al metro y con todo lo necesario, lo recomendamos ampliamente

Place was exactly as described and very easy to access downtown area. Zee was also very good with communications. I accidentally forgot to grab the keys on my way out and he acted quickly to ensure we were able to get back in the airbnb. Would recommend especially if you have a family!

We stayed for a weekend and really enjoyed the condo and the building’s amenities and location.  Great communication with and instructions from the host.  We used the roof-top deck, the spacious and well equipped gym, and the pool (in the basement, but cool).  Loved the adjoining breakfast and lunch spot, as well as the coffee shop in the lobby.  All in all a great stay, location, and condo!

We had a wonderful stay! Our host was professional, friendly, and super responsive, always quick to answer. The location was great too, with lots of neighborhood activities nearby. The space was spotlessly clean and really comfortable. The AC worked perfectly and kept us cool the whole time, and the towels were bright white and fresh. Everything was just as described, with no surprises at all. We’d happily book again and highly recommend this place!
Wonderful Stay, Amazing Host 10/10 Highly recommend!

We had a great stay at Theodora’s apartment! It was great for a group of 3, and it was in a residential neighborhood with many restaurants, bars, and cafes. The walk to the Blue Line station was around 15min, but we did a mix of train and ubers so this wasn’t an issue. We had an issue with one of the locks but Theodora was very responsive and got it fixed quickly.

We had a great stay!  The location was walkable and close to a lot of great restaurants and bars.  6 of us fit very comfortably here.  There were hair dryers, a new iron & ironing board, body wash, shampoo and conditioner.  Some previous reviews mentioned they were missing, but the host replaced everything.
Recomendado al 100 %. Definitivamente volvería a hospedarme con el !

Meta was very responsive! She was helpful and made sure everything went smoothly! We had a wonderful time and felt at ease in her spot!
Thank you so much!
Easy to get to. Kitchen was well stocked and the bathroom had plenty of towels. Very nice to have access to a washer and dryer

Great location with plenty of restaurants and bars nearby and easy access to downtown Chicago. The accessible free parking nearby is a huge plus. The stairs leading to the room are no joke but it’s definitely worth it. Would highly recommend to individuals or couples looking for short stays to see the city.
Had a lovely stay, would come back.
Caryl's place was an awesome stay, for my Daughters White coat ceremony weekend! Convenient and quiet. Caryl was very helpful. Will be back for sure!
We loved staying at Jose’s place. It was exactly as described and very comfortable. I would definitely stay again. The parking was a huge bonus. Thanks for having us, Jose!
Great place in the heart of Wrigleyville and a short walk to Northalsted.

This was the perfect place for a long weekend with our two dogs. The bed is very comfortable and the space felt open. Very walkable area and we felt safe even at night. Reed provided great parking recommendations since nearby streets are permit only overnight. We would definitely stay here again!

This was a great place to stay to be close to all the local bars in Boystown, and the space was clean with responsive hosts. Have stayed here twice, and has been a great experience both times. Definitely recommend booking here.
Great. Would book again

This place is not a good Airbnb. Drugs were found on the sidewalk right outside the door. The Airbnb itself was extremely dirty, bugs and spiders throughout. Our son got spider bites within the first nights stay. There were construction tools in a basket next to the laundry accessible to kids. The day before check in, we had to get Airbnb to get the host to respond and confirm we were all set for check-in. Surrounding area of the Airbnb is an unsafe area. Much smaller than shown in photos. Sofa and rooms were beaten up and small. Electronics didn’t work. Some air vents didn’t even have covers. There is also a back door on the unit that goes to a staircase of another unit - causing safety concerns of someone being able to access our unit at night or when we are out. Would not recommend to anyone with kids and concerned about safety, cleanliness and value. This was way overpriced for what it was and EXTREMELY dirty. Guests be warned.

The space itself was nice, clean, and had all of the amenities and the location was also excellent. Being in Chinatown made it easy to walk to restaurants and other nearby attractions. The train was conveniently located if we wanted to use public transportation.
CONS: The entrance to the building was not very inviting, and when we first arrived, I honestly wondered if we were at the right place. The common entrance area could have been cleaner, with shoes left throughout the hallway, including near the entrance to our unit.
The biggest concern was the key pickup. The keys had to be picked up at a location about two blocks away from the unit. While two blocks may not sound far, it was an inconvenience when traveling with luggage. I also would not have felt comfortable making that walk alone at night. This is something the host should consider revisiting, perhaps by providing a more convenient or secure key-access option. Overall, we enjoyed the space.
Place was good right in spot..
Had an amazing stay here! Easy check in process. Location was in the perfect location and walkable to many things to do. Kimberly was a great host and very responsive.

Nice apartment in a great location. We were in town for a wedding and happy to find a place to stay near all the festivities. I especially enjoyed the artwork decorating the unit. Everything about our stay was great.

Chris was a great host and did a wonderful job of communicating. I would definitely stay at one of his rentals again.
This specific rental was very nice. The downstairs is cozy but our group was comfortable. The upstairs has huge! It had two queen size beds side by side felt like another apartment.

Demitri's place was a great location for us as we spent time in the city and in Evanston. The beds were very comfortable, and the AC units kept the place cool during hot weather. The parking garage was convenient. I will definitely stay there again!

Lovely place in Lincoln Park. The neighborhood is so lovely and I enjoyed my entire stay. This was my first visit to Chicago and I’ll definitely be back! Would also love to visit this Airbnb again. The host was responsive, the room was super clean and cute, and the location is close to a train stop but not close enough where the train is too noisy. I’d recommend this place to my family and friends for sure.

The unit was clean and the location is excellent, right in the heart of Wrigleyville and easy to get around from. We appreciated the thoughtful touches, like the treats left on the guest beds.
Communication was the weak point. Responses to direct questions were slow, and we received several automated messages asking for a five-star review while our actual question about checkout went unanswered. Late checkout was discussed weeks in advance and again the week of our stay with no mention of a fee; the fee structure was only shared the night before checkout. The hosts did clarify it clearly once we asked, and were accommodating about letting us store bags. A little more upfront detail on the paid options would have made the stay smoother.
Fabulous location and beautiful spot! Definitely recommend
Great place to stay in Chicago! The location was very convenient and easy to reach the city center. The place was comfortable.
Nice and clean place.
Blake's apartment is on a great street in Bronzeville with lots of parking and brownstones. It was super easy to get to the lake, downtown and to the Obama Center. Would def stay here again!

First of all, Eva was an amazing host and I felt very comfortable communicating to her. The place was one of the best places that can fit a good amount of people. The place is one of the clear stays I’ve had, and the bathrooms and bedrooms were pristine and perfect. She was very accommodating, responsive, and made the stay stress free. If you’re trying to stay in Chicago that can host a good amount of people, this is the place to be. I’m very impressed, and all of us were very comfortable. Thank you again!
We had an amazing stay! Nice neighborhood and great space!

Great location and property. The building did have elevator issues while we stayed but the host kept us updated on maintenance and let us know right when they were resolved. Overall great stay and would book again!
Communication was amazing ! The apartment was very clean and organized. Host was very friendly and willing to help with whatever we needed. Somewhere I’d definitely stay again!
it is relatively close to  CTA station. The neighborhood is very peaceful and nice.

Darryl was kind and helpful, and the house was really clean. My family and I had a great time. The house looked better and bigger than the pictures. My only 2 recommendations are getting better shades/blinds for the living room, and cleaning the couches.
Thanks Darryl!

The place was great for me and my best friend! We stayed 5 days 4 nights! We had a blast and Nick was so kind and helpful! He made his home safe and cozy! It was super clean and the redline was just a short bus ride away! We loved this place and will come back soon! We didn’t walk around at night cause we didn’t know the area well but other than that it was 10/10 all around! 🥳

Fantastic location in Old Town, many restaurants, bars, and shops within a few steps. Easy walk to Lincoln Park and North Ave Beach which was great for the kids. There are lots of stairs to get in and around the space, something to keep in mind if traveling with older/younger guests. The private rooftop was awesome. Great hosts that were very communicative. Overall I would recommend and stay again.
Such a cute place - the pictures don't even capture it. It is super close to the blue line and plenty of things nearby.
Place was affordable and around a lot of food places that are walking distance, very quiet neighborhood definitely would book again
Amazing stay in a good area of Chicago no issues whatsoever any definitely would book again

Amazing stay in Chicago, close to the center by 2 lines of busses., just a 3 minute walk to the stop. Very clean , air condition was working perfectly and had a pleasant temperature all day long. Very helpful host, kind and reachable all day long. Thank you for everything !
Brad’s place was nice and in a good spot for a short Chicago trip. Everything was clean and smelled good inside the unit. Parking wasn’t bad as well! Definitely would stay here again.

Worst experience. The AC was sit on a timer, home would get extremely hot in the middle of the night. We had to Youtube to try to get the AC to work. I reached out to owner and he acted as he didnt know. Its listed as 3brm. NONE of the rooms have closets and one room dont even have a dresser so literally had to use kitchen table to unpack as we was there for 5 nights and no where to even put our things. We couldnt use the oven to cook because owner uses it for storage. The tv would disconnect from wifi repeatedly. Ive been using AirB&B for about 8/9yrs and paid over $1300 for this stay and was completely uncomfortable the whole time. I wish we would have picked someone else or even a motel. After this experience i may stop using AirB&B and go back to motels. This was a big ripoff. The owner gave us 1 roll of toilet paper and 2 trash bags for 3 adults and 5nights, had to ask for more. Good thing we had our own because there wasnt even wash clothes provided. We was not pleased at all!

Perfect place to stay while visiting family in Beverly! Very clean, comfortable beds, fully stocked bathrooms and kitchen. Robert was very responsive and welcoming. Looking forward to staying there again!

We were very comfortable at Phong’s place. The parking was easy and convenient and we had no issues at all with getting into the building or the condo.  It was nice to have two full bathrooms available. We stayed there with two couples and two young children, 7 and 10.

Host was a great communicator and always responded promptly. Beds were comfortable and bathrooms were great for our group. A few things that did damper the experience was that the space itself was a bit smaller than expected, especially if you do end up with a way bigger group than us. And the most disappointing and frustrating part was the washer issue that we had that unfortunately stained a few pieces of clothing from the dirt that came from the spin cycle.
Great stay! Would definitely stay here again in the future

Good location, clean, and reasonable price for what you get. It’s definitely an Airbnb mill—clearly flipped and furnished as cheaply as possible to maximize profit with an anonymous AI-like host. It definitely would not sleep more than 3 adults comfortably, as the beds are small and there is only one bathroom.  Also awful internet connection throughout the space. We could not even get content to stream on the TV the connection was so bad.
We stayed here for 3 nights and had a peaceful and comfortable stay
Excellent and spacious apartment in the heart of Chicago. Close to red line! Easy keyless access. Very comfortable beds and pillows!

I had a wonderful time staying at their place in Andersonville. The unit was exactly what I needed and very well maintained. Thanks to the hosts for great communication and help with local recommendations. They made it very easy to check in and check out and answered all my questions quickly during the stay. Highly recommended!
Again, a huge thank you!
We really enjoyed this space. Was larger than we needed but was nice to have the space. Ed and Hillary are really nice and we helpful when needed.
The house was perfect for what my family needed. It was in the heart of Roscoe Village and walkable to many shops
Great clean 2 bedrooms apartment, very safe area , great communication with the host , super clean we love it

Nuestra estancia en el alojamiento de Afsha ha sido muy agradable.
La casa es muy amplia, con un gran salón. Todo muy limpio y con todas las comodidades. Lo que nos hizo decantarnos por esta casa fue la plaza de aparcamiento ya que ahorras tiempo en buscar aparcamiento y la zona de lavado de ropa ya que te posibilita a llevar poco equipaje y tener que desplazarte a una lavandería.
El letrero de "Cool" no funciona como ella indica, pero gracias a la IA puedes hacerlo funcionar en tus fotos!!
Al ser la casa de madera es normal escuchar a los vecinos desplazarse por la casa, pero es algo que en nuestro caso no ha sido molestia, además de que Afsha lo advierte en la descripción del apartamento.
La zona es tranquila, sin ruidos ni trafico por las noches. No podemos opinar del barrio porque como hemos venido a visitar a un familiar no hemos paseado por él.
El apartamento de Afsha es sin duda nuestra prioridad para la próxima vez que visitemos Chicago.
Rhonda was attentive. The place is perfect if you are looking for a central location.
Clean.  Great location to Wrigley Field and Boystown

My traveling companion and I had a wonderful stay in this comfortable, quiet, and safe apartment. We were delighted with this upstairs three bedroom gem on a lovely tree lined street. Everything matched the description and photos, including the vast collection of art work. There's so much Chicago history in these older buildings and we appreciated the original (creaky) hardwood floors, high ceilings (there are ceiling fans in most rooms), crown molding, built-ins, and back porch. The updated kitchen is perfect for coffee in the morning and late night leftovers. The hosts, Joseph and William, are attentive and respond quickly to questions. The house is easily accessible to all public transportation (buses, "L", and Metra train) and Clark Street offers many great dining choices all within walking distance. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.
Great location proximity for everything we wanted to do over our visit in Chicago. Walkable to public transit. Would stay again!
Great stay!

A large group and I stayed at Brian’s place to attend an event at UIC. It was within walking distance of the event and walking distance from a grocery store and CVS which was super convenient! The place itself was super spacious, comfortable, had great amenities, and had everything you could need. Hosts were super friendly and communicative and I’d highly recommend!!

I’ve stayed in AirBnBs all over the US and the world. Joe’s is among the best I’ve ever stayed in. He has created a true “home” with amenities and touches to make your stay as comfortable as possible. It never feels like an AirBnB, more like a friend’s home!
He is a responsive host and a mind reader in many ways, as he often had answers before you can ask a question.
The home itself is large with great AC and space to relax. It’s in a great location walkable to coffee and cafes with an Aldi less than a five minute walk for groceries.
Loved the place. Super private and quiet. Close to everything

My family really enjoyed the stay at Lily’s place. We were visiting Chicago before taking my son to college in Wisconsin.
The neighborhood was walkable with lots to do/see in the area., was also centrally located and easy to get to other tourist attractions like Millennium Park, Navy Pier etc. Next time I’d consider using public transportation (weather permitting) because the parking garages downtown were crowded, expensive, and a tight fit during our time of travel.
The garage was useful because we were traveling with a small U-Haul trailer. We were able to detach and leave in the shared garage while visiting around the city.
The home had pots and pans to cook with, body soap in the bathroom, and an air mattress. I didn’t see the downstairs tenant, but my son mentioned he was friendly. All in all the house was as mentioned and a great stay. I’d just recommend bringing your own spices to cook with and additional toiletries like lotion and shampoo. I’d definitely stay again!
I would definitely stay here again the next time we are in Chicago.  It was fabulous in every way.

We had an amazing weekend in Chicago. Lois was a pleasure and very informative. She has everything you need to get up to speed on Chicago entertainment, history, transportation and more. Her place was comfy and spacious enough for my 2 brothers and mom, it was  accurately described, clean, and a 20-30 minute drive to downtown Chicago.
Immediately felt safe, comfortable, & welcome.  Zheng is a kind and pleasant host, and the place was exactly what I needed & wanted it to be.
Great place in walking distance to everything. We enjoyed staying here.

This place was great! The location was amazing, close to the blue line and a ton of great restaurants and bars. It was easy to find and get in and quiet. The only issue was the bed was very uncomfortable, it was two twin mattresses in a bigger frame so if you slept in the middle of the bed you would fall between them. Other than that it was fantastic.

Great location!  Clear instructions. Loved having a parking space available to us with no issues finding parking for our second vehicle. A/C in living room wasn’t able to keep up with high temps. So living room, dining area and bedrooms were a bit warm. Space was also not as clean as we’d like. Stains on bed sheets and towels, lots of hair in bathroom, place just didn’t feel clean.

Great space located walking distance from some awesome food, bars and shows. Our hosts not only gave us some amazing recommendations and the space was so modern and comfy. The shower is spacious with a rain shower head. If you come to Chicago give Dover St a try!
Great location! Very responsive hosts! Definitely will stay here again !

Shanna's place is perfect! It's clean, comfortable and located close enough to all of the attractions, yet nestled in a very quiet, tree-lined area. Shanna was very responsive to any questions and always checking in to make sure the stay was comfortable. Highly recommended!
Excellent stay, noise was not an issue at all. Very comfortable for 6 people, all transit is right at your doorstep. Highly recommended!

Based on our experience
Pros:
-Quiet Neighborhood
-Large space for groups
-As described on post
-Games provided for entertainment
-Beautiful home design
-beautiful neighborhood
-no smoking
-professional cleaners after guest stays
- Room with the queen bed has a A/C unit and ceiling fan so the room stays cold.
-living room has an a/c unit that makes it cold and hot
-unit is very well kept and taken care of
