The building was super easy to access, the neighborhood was safe. It looks just like the pictures. I love that they have a washer and dryer. The bed was super comfortable, which is not what you get in most Airbnb’s. I would definitely stay here again.

Very nice and clean unit. Southside of Chicago, bad area, with violence. No so quiet tenants,  but tolerable. Bed extra firm, couldn't sleep good, too hard for me. Latarsha was nice and friendly and did good with the unit. The neighborhood and lack of rest was my problem.
This was a great unit and Naomi was very responsive. Would 100% rebook.

Clean and cozy stay that had everything we needed! Location was perfect for us staying for a weekend and visiting friends nearby. Appreciated that it’s a residential area but also had good public transit access and food/drink options within walking distance.
We enjoyed our stay and were comfortable the entire time.  The unit was clean and the location was safe and convenient.  We would definitely stay again.

Fantastic location just steps away from Chinatown. Easy access to the L. The hosts are fantastic and communicated really well. The apartment was spotless and had all the amenities one could ask for. We would definitely stay again!

TJ's place was perfect for a long weekend getaway with our friends. It was spacious, clean and felt like new. I'd absolutely stay here again in the future. TJ was so easy to communicate with and was flexible with timing.

I had a great stay! The location is perfect for exploring Pilsen—there is so much to do nearby. Security is top-notch, making me feel very safe.
The hosts are incredibly sweet. They let me check in early at 8:00 AM after a red-eye flight, which was a lifesaver! Upon arrival, the hostess sat me down to walk me through a neighborhood map.
The hosts are very warm and highly conversational. I had a packed schedule and couldn't chat as much, but their friendliness was genuine. Highly recommend this spot to experience Pilsen!

Best thing about Charlie's place is the location, being just a block away from Asia on Argyle. Super convenient location next to the Red Line and all the Asian restaurants, plus it's only a 10 minute walk to Aragon Ballroom if you're going to be there. I also appreciated the hassle-free entry with just two door codes. Unfortunately my stay coincided with a Wi-Fi issue, but Charlie was very responsive to messages and eventually got it resolved so I won't hold it against him. I'd definitely recommend this place for solo or duo travelers who just need a quiet place to stay, especially those who love Asian food!
Everything was great!

Great neighbourhood, safe easy walking, great local shops and cafes. Good local transport. The apartment was quiet, spotless and all very efficient with every amenity for a travelling guest.
We had a peaceful vibe returning to this temporary home after a weekend family wedding full of events and celebration. Thank you so much.

Le logement de Mirsada est très agréable. Nous y avons passé un bon moment en famille. Un supermarché et une laverie sont tout proche et accessible à pied. Le quartier est très mignon et calme.
Nous recommandons chaudement.
Excellent place very well kept.  Has everything you need.  Rules and expectations straight forward.

Beautiful loft in a great location, close to shopping, restaurants, nightlife, and everything downtown Chicago has to offer. The space was stylish, comfortable, and enjoyable overall. Anthony was a great host!
We enjoyed our stay. The place acomidated our needs. The host was easy to work with.

The apartment is one of four, on the first floor with another apartment above it. The location is excellent and the neighborhood is very walkable with easy access to the Red line. The apartment was very clean and a good value for us, especially coming for a busy weekend like Market Days. A few things could have made our stay even better.
1. It is listed as a three bedroom but you have to walk through one bedroom to reach a second bedroom so not much privacy for folks in those bedrooms.
2. There is only one set of keys for the apartment and some doors close on their own and lock automatically behind you. We were three adults staying in the apartment and juggling keys was a hassle.
3, the key box is across the parking lot behind a large van so not the easiest to get to
4. The towels are adequate but thin
Lovely stay for a weekend getaway! Close enough to all the fun parts of town. Jason was a great host.

We had a lovely time at Rida’s apartment. It was very large and exactly as described. We felt right at home as soon as we got in. The apartment is in a wonderful location and we could walk to several cafés and restaurants and we were very centrally located to everything we wanted to do. I would definitely stay there again.
Apartment was great for a markets days!
Clean and in a great area, everything we needed was available and Joanna was accommodating
Great spot with friendly hosts!

Overall, I was pleased with the ambiance of the Airbnb. The space had an inviting atmosphere, and the décor created a comfortable and visually appealing environment. The property had a nice overall feel, and I appreciated the effort that went into its presentation.

I really enjoyed my stay! I was in town for a last minute work trip. The apartment was very cute. Stacy made sure to take care of any needs to make sure that I had a very comfortable stay. He was super responsive and very helpful when I needed a last minute extension of my trip. The apartment was beautiful and absolutely worth the stay!
Heather’s spacious home was perfect for my annual get together with my group of friends. It was walkable to the places we enjoy

I had a great stay at this Airbnb! The location is excellent—just a short walk from the beach and very convenient for getting around. There is easy access to public transportation, as well as plenty of restaurants, markets, and bars nearby.
The private bedroom was comfortable and provided everything I needed for a pleasant stay. The owner was very attentive, friendly, and responsive, always answering my questions quickly and making sure everything was going well.
Overall, I had a wonderful experience!
Great stay. Great host. And had all of the extra touches. Even was understanding when I needed a late checkout.

We appreciated Nicole's attentiveness and kindness. We also appreciated the small details Nicole attends to which are not listed on Airbnb such as excellent quality mattress and feather pillows, steam free mirrors in the bathrooms, gourmet coffee, cordless charging stations, awesome televisions. It's a great space for both single travelers or a family.
Our day was excellent. The location was perfect for our weekend trip. The studio was very comfortable. Extremely clean. Would stay here again.

Telly was a proactive & communicative host who provided clear instructions for check-in & checkout. He was friendly without being intrusive. His home is neat, elegant, & very functional, great for longer stays plus it comes with a Nespresso machine, courtesy coffee pods, & in-unit washer-dryer. Beds & linens were clean & luxurious. The house is also located in a peaceful, treelined street with easy access to a CTA train station (Diverse). Our only surprise was that the unit shared an entrance with the rest of the house; per the space description, we understood this was a lower unit with a separate entrance (sort of a duplex) but in fact is it the first floor of the entire house. Overall, Telly is a super-host with a beautiful, functional home & his gem of a home was a great deal for our stay in Chicago. Strongly recommend.

Ultimately, Kirsten's place was fine (clean, functional, and nicely decorated), but you should be aware that it's a garden unit with low ceilings. It would not be a good fit for anyone big (as a medium size guy, I struggled in the shower, and bumped my head on one of the low ceilings). Also, the entrance involves walking through an unfinished basement entryway which my girlfriend did not like.
Great location and surrounding, responsive host.
They were very accommodating and the spot is really nice. It’s about 30 mins from down town but you can find plenty of food and things to do around the area!
We had a great weekend here celebrating two of our friends’ birthdays.  We would definitely stay here again.

I picked this listing because it seemed the be the best of the ones that were available for my dates. The place was clean (except for a black spot growing on the cabinet in the bathroom near the shower). I did not see any insects of rodents, which was great.
However, I was supplied with the incorrect access code for the building. Vin did reply quickly with the correct code.
The elevator could only fit two people maximum with luggage, but I was nervous to ride with a second person because it sounded like it would give out at any second.
The hallway to the listing smelled so bad (mixture between perfume/room spray and weed?) that it unnerved me. And it just felt weird to be able to hear people's tv in the hallway on the walk to the listing.
The listing was bigger than expected. The walls were very beat up and were not at all as shown in the listing photos.
Great location. Nice open floor plan. Easy parking. Love a cold bedroom to sleep in so crazy fast ceiling fan was amazing.

Katty's studio is beautifully decorated, clean, and comfortable. I had a slight issue with the intercom code not working, but I reached out to Katty and she immediately resolved it. I felt very comfortable in the studio, like I was in my own apartment. It is also in a great location, right across the street from a beautiful park and not far from the lakefront. I would definitely stay here again.
Our was incredibly flexible with us. The home was very nice and comfortable. We loved the location.
Stayed here with a big group and loved every second of it was able to have a stress free time josh was very accommodating to everything we needed thank you!
Lovely unit, exactly as described. Great neighborhood, easy walk to art center and restaurants. Parking on street was always available.
Ron’s apartment was perfect for a small group visiting for the weekend. Very comfortable apartment in a great location. Would absolutely stay again!
It is exactly what you pay for, a great deal and felt safe.
Derek was a great host. Very knowledgeable of the city and has great recommendations. Easy to reach and very responsive. Definitely would stay there again.
Ivy and Robert are perfect hosts. The home was inviting, convenient, exceptionally well-appointed, and beautifully decorated. We cannot wait to come back!

The Biddle was perfect for my daughter and me. The decor was lovely and beds super comfortable. We had a car so the parking permit was a huge bonus and no issue finding a spot. Convenient to train and bus and walkable to everything. Neighborhood is very safe and quiet. Elizabeth was a wonderful host. Very professional with a personal tone and very responsive. I will definitely stay here again!!
Nick was an amazing host! Very friendly and easy to communicate with. Beautiful location as well.
Our family enjoyed the condo and spending time together. The condo was clean and had lots for us to do, board games and played lots of pool. Within minutes of shopping and dining
This place was fantastic.  The hosts were a pleasure to work with and I would recommend the place to anybody. Thanks for a great stay!

Great location! Much cheaper than staying downtown, but there's multiple train and bus stops very close by that made travel to and from the city very easy. And there's even cafes and food nearby if needed, which helped. Place was nice, host was very communicative as well
The unit was exactly as described and was very clean. Check-in was easy, the AC worked very well, and the free dedicated parking space is convenient for those driving in. Neighborhood was quiet too.
Thank you so much for a fabulous stay!! I loved the space and it was easy to get around!
Great place to stay! This is our second time, and will book again next time in Chicago.
Great location and property! I'd rebook!
Loved the decorations and the space! Great Host! Wonderful stay!
Well appointed and comfortable apartment in a lovely neighborhood.
This is a great find in the Andersonville area. Quiet neighborhood, and peaceful setting with a gorgeous view of the backyard. The loft was open, clean, and very private. Would definitely return!
10/10 would recommend. Thomas was a great host!
Great service

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Una experiencia auténtica y muy especial en Chicago
Nuestra estancia en esta casa ha sido realmente maravillosa. Si buscáis una experiencia auténtica, alejada de los alojamientos impersonales de las zonas más turísticas, recomendamos este lugar sin ninguna duda.
La casa es preciosa, con muchísima personalidad e historia, y está muy bien mantenida. Es cómoda, agradable y se nota el cuidado y el cariño que se ha puesto en conservar su identidad. El propio edificio y el barrio permiten conocer una parte de Chicago mucho más auténtica y diferente de la que se suele descubrir como turista.
Además, la comunicación con nuestro anfitrión ha sido excelente. Nos proporcionó con bastante antelación todas las indicaciones e información que necesitábamos, explicándolo todo con muchísimo detalle. Esto nos hizo sentir muy seguros y tranquilos incluso antes de llegar. Durante nuestra estancia no tuvimos ningún inconveniente y todo funcionó perfectamente.
La ubicación también nos resultó
Everything was great…we will be back again!
The space was in a great quiet location. Apartment was also clean and well kept.
Great place to stay that is easily accessible. Clean and cozy. 100% recommended if you're staying in the area.
Great place!

This was our first time traveling with both little children and this was the perfect location for us. Spacious and very cute rooms for the kids. Location was great for us — can walk anywhere, easy access the L if desired, parks nearby and of course all the food and shops you want. Street parking was always available even if we had to walk, it was not much at all.  Easy instructions to get in and out, and felt safe always.
Comodo ed ottimo alloggio per una breve visita a Chicago

We had a great stay for our first time in Chicago.  We had 4 adults and 5 children and didn’t even use the sofa bed.  The place was modern, spotless, with great pillows and mattresses.  Kitchen was fully stocked.  It was very convenient being so close to the Blue Line, and we loved being able to walk across the street for breakfast and dinner with a Walgreens next door for anything we needed.  Skyline views from the living room were great.  Hanna and Mark were extremely responsive to anything we needed.  Highly recommend!!!!!
Perfect spot for a Chicago city weekend!  We loved the proximity to the park and great food.  Quiet and clean space, hosts were good communicators.
Great location and great stay. Would definitely stay again. Walking distance from transportation, restaurants and amenities. Safe and clean. Easy correspondence with host.

Great place. Walkable to so many local food spots and shopping spots. Very close to public transportation that can get you anywhere. Place was clean and had everything needed. Bed was very comfy. Check in was easy ans convenient. Shower pressure wasn’t ideal, but not a huge deal at all.

Such a cute apartment that’s a short bus ride from downtown and walking distance from beautiful parks. Brad was a very friendly host and the apartment was very clean and safe! We would definitely stay here again!

Joyce's place is super nice and spacious and Joyce communicates really well and quickly responds to your needs if you have them. It was perfect for our girls' Chicago trip to watch a WNBA game at the United Center and attend Market Days. The Blue line was only an 11 minute walk and there are bus stops really close by as well to get you wherever you want to be in the city. When you first arrive into the neighborhood you might be a little apprehensive but the neighbors are super nice. They were having a block party and we were invited to join them for a drink if we wanted. It was a little loud on Friday night, but I am not sure if that is true for every Friday or if it was just the Friday we were there. We would stay again!

It was easy to check-in, it was clean and comfortable. I enjoyed my time there. Those thinking of booking the place keep in mind that you will need a car or pay for rides to go anywhere. I still recommend it.
We loved our stay -the neighborhood was so peaceful and beautiful. We walked everywhere. We came to play beach ultimate, the location was close to the beach, we would come back for the neighborhood.
Great location and very nice and responsive host! When back in Chicago will definitely look to stay here again!
We stayed at Dwellish’s place for Market Days weekend. It’s a perfect location and the place is very cozy, clean and well stocked. Highly recommend!
Fantastic location to walk or bike everywhere. Highly recommend for anyone working remotely and/or looking for a great mix of peace and nice restaurants nearby.
The place was really nice
I really enjoyed my stay most of all the location I'd definitely come back
The place was beautiful, a little outside of Hyde Park and close to many attractions like the Obama center and University of Chicago
It’s an okay stay. Some things could be better but for the most part you have what you need to sleep and a place to stay. People follow the rules well for the most part.
great place to stay!

If I were still living in Chicago, this is exactly the kind of place I would live. Great restaurants, variety of foods, walkable distances, and the traffic wasn't too crazy! It's near CTA too. I would definitely stay here again!
Esta muy bonito tu apartamento, bien equipado. Regresaremos
Great service, great value, nice place! If you’re really, really sensitive to noise, the train isn’t great, but it’s funny how quickly you do adjust. The hosts are wonderful. So responsive!

Like other reviews noted you will really hear people walking above you.  Note the couch is not actually a "sofa bed" that pulls out, but still comfortable enough.  Actual bed mattress was great.  Host is very good communicator, place is clean, location is good, entry was easy, water pressure was good, kitchen well equipped.  Would book again for sure.
Alma was the best the host, super easy access and the place was great🤗🤗

First time visiting Chicago and so glad I chose this Airbnb. The location is close to many shops and great restaurants. It is also near public transit such as the red line and bus. Owner provided clear instructions on how to navigate stay from both airports which was very helpful. Apartment was very clean just keep in mind it is located on the third floor with no elevator. If you are looking for a super quiet stay this  may not be the best option but my guest and I didn’t mind!
Great place!

My family and I stayed here and loved it. Quiet neighborhood, easy street parking, and only a 5 minute walk from a metro station. Very simple check-in/check-out and very clean. You can hear the train coming by which we liked but if you’re a light sleeper it could be a potential issue. The WiFi was a little spotty in some areas of the place as well as cell service. But overall a great stay for our family of 4.
Good place to stay for Chicago Market Days

Cambria Hotel is cute. The bed was comfortable, the room was clean, and the gym was decent with dumbbells up to 50lbs. One of the treadmills didn’t work though and the cables had missing handles. For the price I paid, I was disappointed with the level of service. I called the front desk to ask for additional glasses, and instead of sending some up to the room, they said I could go get some at the bar. Housekeeping also didn’t stop once during my four night stay, even though I asked the front desk for it twice. We had to leave our trash out by the hallway to get picked up. Overall, the hotel meets minimal standards of comfort, but there’s definitely room for improvement on staff services.
Great location.     Spacious.   Easy to get around

While the room was clean and comfy the hotel itself is overdue for an upgrade. Nonetheless  it was centrally located, directly on the bus line and decent walking distance from the nearby hot spots.  The staff were friendly and helpful which added to the charm the Midwest is known for. Decent value overall.
Walking distance to University of Chicago and close to public transportation are the biggest plus for me. The host is very responsive when I had questions. The place  is very clean and quiet.

We stayed here, house was great.
There can be rats in the yard, but we had a lovely time in the house and a great stay!
Sarah was a great host! This place was perfect for our long weekend get away.

The place looked like the pictures and is only about 20 minutes from downtown, which is where I spent most of my time during my stay. If you plan on cooking, just know there is little to no counter space. My only complaint would be the side gain way access (I was scared initially), and the AC was just not cool enough. I'd suggest maybe another indoor unit for the bedroom. Overall, for the price, the space met expectations.

My stay at John’s place is one for the history books. The bathroom is remodeled and beautifully designed. Guests have access to a common entertainment area right outside your bedroom and a plush garden with an umbrella covered patio table; and most amazingly of all, a full desk, ironing board, travel and scholarly books, mini-kitchen, and soft bed linens. Highest recommendation. Would stay here again!
Beautiful, spacious apartment with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Great location near Museum Campus and many attractions—we had a wonderful time and would definitely return!

It was a great place that was nicely upgraded.
We loved the location.

We had an amazing stay! Fabiana was extremely communicative. She always responded quickly and was very helpful. The apartment was clean, well designed and carefully set up. The location is convenient for anyone visiting Lincoln Square (which you should!). I highly recommend using this or any other AirBnb of Fabiana.

We had a great stay in Humboldt Park! The apartment was super clean with comfortable beds and linens, a well-stocked kitchen, and extra touches like shampoo and lotion in the bathrooms. Dubbs Mgmt was very responsive when we had questions. The neighborhood is safe and quiet and we enjoyed having coffee on the balcony in the mornings. There are lots of great restaurants nearby and a grocery store within walking distance. The bus stops at the corner so getting around is easy!

Patricia and Charlie were quick to respond to questions. The neighborhood and apartment were both very nice.  The apartment was spacious and clean and close to restaurants, Walgreens and the grocery store.  The beds were soft and very comfortable.  The train station (blue line) was just a few minutes walk in either direction which is convenient.  We would definitely stay here again.
I loved this place. It’s a very convenient walk to many restaurants and stores at Lincoln Square. The gardens on this street and in the backyard are absolutely beautiful!

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Andersonville! The space was exactly as described—comfortable, and incredibly clean. It immediately felt welcoming and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. The location is fantastic. Andersonville is such a charming neighborhood, with great restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and local shops all within easy walking distance, while still feeling peaceful and residential. It was also convenient for getting around Chicago and exploring other neighborhoods.
The host was excellent—responsive, friendly, and proactive throughout the entire stay. Check-in and check-out were seamless. We appreciated having such a comfortable place to come back to after long days exploring the city. I would absolutely stay here again and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and well-located home base in Chicago.
Great place with AC, super cute and in a great park of town close to the bus stop

Overall, this Airbnb was really nice but I wouldn’t recommend it for anyone with dogs, kids, or who is nervous about big dogs.
We were very grateful to find this place as we found out our planned Airbnb cancelled after we had already left. The space was very nice and cute. We were the first guests and there were a couple things not finished, but we also booked with three hours notice so I get it!
The only problem with the stay was the noise and the host’s dogs. There was not a lot of sound separation and we got woken up by furniture noises during quiet hours and by outdoor projects early Saturday. The hosts dogs made our stay stressful. There were quite a few times when we tried to come up the steps of the garden level apartment and were greeted by large dogs running toward the deck fence and barking pretty aggressively at face level. The host always did come to pull them away, but we still had to set up a system where someone went out first to check for those dogs before we left.
Owner was very responsive and property was just as described. 10/10 experience.

A great spot in a quiet neighborhood. Kory's place offered just what we needed for our trip to Chicago. It is within walking distance to buses or an Uber/Lyft can take you where you need to go. We enjoyed out time there. Thank you.

I or past friends have booked with Will for now three years in a row. He’s an excellent host. The property is better than advertised, the amenities are plentiful, and you couldn’t ask for a better location.
Throughout I never felt like a burden and I could reach out about anything, anytime of day.

This was the second time we stayed at Tim’s beautiful house, and it was just as lovely as the first! The location is so convenient and safe with plenty of activities within walking distance. Rooms were clean and tidy with plenty of essentials. You can feel truly at home staying here. We will likely stay again if the opportunity arises!

I had a fantastic stay at Rita's Airbnb! The space was super clean. The apt did not face the busy street, so it was very quiet, and made for a super comfortable stay during my time in Chicago. Check-in and check-out were super easy. There was a quick video tutorial in the directions which made it easy to find everything when checking in.
The location is in a vibrant neighborhood with lots of restaurants and bars. You are within easy walking distance to pretty much everything you need - a grocery store is less than a block as well - express busses to the loop only a couple blocks away. Having close access to the lakefront where you can go for a swim if you are visiting in the summer was awesome bonus. 5/5 overall Highly recommend!
This was a a perfect place to stay and get a couple nights of good sleep. I would absolutely book again.
Terry was very responsive and presented any necessary information before I needed to ask. Terry also provided parking passes which was being helpful for parking in Chicago.
Unit was beautiful and clean! All instructions were super clear, and James was really friendly and responsive. It's also super close to transit which made heading downtown really really easy.
Everything was wonderful.
It was a great location and right next to the red & purple lines. The bed was comfortable and wasn't loud.
Nice place, great location and very responsive host

Christiana and Patrick made us feel right at home from booking, they gave us local food recommendations and were friendly and welcoming.
The area was exactly what we needed in terms of getting around with local transit. Would recommend to anyone!
Had a good stay at Alle's place. Convenient location. If you're looking to stay in Chicago for 1-2 days, then this is a good option.
Thank you Ivan for a wonderful visit! Wonderful residence with everything we needed to have a fun visit in Chicago. Very clean home and lots of well thought out details. High recommend!

The location is 1 block from the beach and easily walkable to two metro stations, a Whole Foods, and multiple restaurants. I stayed at a hotel over the weekend with an early checkout and asked to drop my bags off before check-in, which was approved. All of the communication with the host was helpful and understanding. The apartment itself, while described as minimal, was bigger than I expected and had plenty of amenities (kitchen appliances, dishes, pots, pans; bathroom hair dryer; Roku in the living room, plenty of plugs). There was a lot of light due to all of the windows. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay at Kenan’s apt again.

Agradable lugar. Las reglas son muy claras y parecen estrictas pero eso ayuda a que todos los huéspedes se sientan cómodos.
Los demás huéspedes fueron respetuoso con la hora de dormir, pude dormir bien sin ruido.

Old apartment in great neighborhood but expensive for family weekend- would be fine for college kids who need a place to crash in the city. Must enter thru trash filled alley and stairway. No face cloths or dishcloth, threadbare towels. Moldy shower and dirty fan, no soap for shower. Bedroom window AC works but rest of apartment is hot. These things communicated to host. Beds very old and uncomfortable, pillows are thin and flat. Some furniture stained.
Great stay. Great host. Fantastic trip. Thanks Alma
We loved our stay in this cute & cozy ‘home away from home’. So many amenities & the location is unbeatable! We will definitely stay here again if we are in the area.
Great location. Walkable to go eat or grab groceries. Very easy to communicate with host and enjoyed being here. Would book again.
Enjoyed our stay! Thank you!
A great place for emergencies and need a quick affordable place to stay for a few nights. It has a very comfortable bed and a clean shower.

One of the best Airbnb stays I’ve ever experienced. Spacious, clean, beautiful interior. I usually bring a spare bed sheet with me in case the bed sheets are cheap/make me sweaty but didn’t have any issues with the linens. I was curious to see if the dogs downstairs made any noise but they only barked a little bit each time we entered the building (understandably), and that was it. Otherwise super quiet. Loved the local restaurants, especially Andros Taverna. The best part by far though is the host, Nikkole, is extremely communicative and trustworthy. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.
This place was peaceful and clean. I’d come back and stay here again.
What a cute spot close to Boystown. Freddy was quick to respond and the place was cozy and exactly as described. I would definitely recommend!
Great entire apartment with lots of space!

I was delighted with this sweet apartment close to everything I wanted to do in Andersonville. The photos well represent the unit and I loved the prewar architecture details and sun-filled living room. Lynn and Ingo were easy to communicate with and I appreciated the thoughtful host's guide to the apartment. I'll most certainly be back for a future stay. Thank you!
Great place to stay! Very close to everything you want to see.
Conveniently located(walkable and safe) near grocery stores, shops, etc. It was very clean and had basic amenities. Geo was quick and responsive to our needs.
Very comfy and quiet place! Convenient routes to the city!

Home is very cozy and comfortable!
Leroy was extremely helpful and accommodating!
Great host!

Fabulous place for family gather.  Everyone was able to be together, but also have time apart, all in the same place. Beautiful place. It was set up for all to be entertained. Wonderful kitchen. With the kitchen  set up for entertaining, I would note if you are a serious kitchen food cook or baker, that while you have cooking items at your disposal to use, they are not professional standard cookware. This does not take from the stay as we had baking and cooking items we needed and weren’t there to bake or cook. The kitchen set up for mornings as you woke up and as everyone slowly reunited. Also, I was confused upon check-in, and they responded immediately.  The set up was truly fantastic for a group. Everyone had their own individual space as well as gathering space. It made for a perfect environment.  Easy walk to coffee places in the morning. Neighbors were nice.
Amazing apartment, location was great and easy to get around to all location within Hyde Park.
Very quiet neighborhood. I had a great stay!
Like that it was close to the venue for the concert and close to the places we wanted to check out!!

This apartment is in a great location on a quite side street near the Damen blue line CTA station. Easy to get around, lots of great restaurants nearby. The apartment itself was very clean and well equipped. The beds were comfortable. However, the bedrooms rooms were very narrow with no night tables next to the beds and pretty much required crawling into the beds. Since it was below grade, it was a bit darker than we would have liked.
For peace of mind, we would also have liked to receive instructions for access to the apartment at 24-48 hours before arriving.

the space is just like in the photos— spacious, clean, and location was perfect to travel downtown and to china town. It’s located in a quiet neighborhood and felt very safe and secure during our stay. We will definitely rebook here again. Host is responsive, attentive, and provided all the info we needed for our stay.

Excellent location for Wrigley or Boystown. Very walkable to both. The apartment is an older building with some great character. The listing discloses that the Metro theatre behind can be loud at night. If you want a perfectly quiet location, this may not be for you. We were enyoing the nightlife so didn't mind at all. Having a safe spot to park was a huge bonus.
It was great! Would stay again.

Karen is a responsive host and was very helpful the couple of times we needed help. The space was big enough to accommodate my group and the blankets were very comfortable. The only issue we had was that there was not much body wash/ shampoo / conditioner for us to use and also there was not only a couple rolls of toilet paper for our group for the 4 nights so we had to buy our own amenities to make up for it. Overall it was still more affordable than going to a hotel for our group but it was not convenient to have to buy our own products. Overall it was still a good experience and I would recommend any traveler on a budget and big group to stay here.

Very nice tree lined neighborhood, easily walkable with CTA access and provisions within walking distance. We felt very safe here while traveling with our 2 dogs. Street is heavily traveled at times but you won’t even notice unless you are out front. Was very quiet otherwise and we slept very well. The space is large and accommodated all of our needs. Will definitely stay again next time we come to Chicago. Paul is went out of his way to ensue we had a pleasurable experience.
The building was great and the location was perfect for all types of visits. It is a quick walking distance to public transportations. Great stay overall!

Great stay in Chicago. The host was accommodating and even let us check in a bit early. Place was spotless. Thoughtful touches everywhere. A fridge stocked with drinks, and a super helpful info booklet. Felt very cared for and would gladly stay again.
This place was super convenient to everything we wanted to do. The west facing bedrooms were a bit noisy from the El track right outside the building, but the unit was perfect otherwise.
Rafal’s house was perfect for our trip. It is very spacious and clean, with a lot of amenities and in a great location. We all really enjoyed the house and would book it again.
Clean , nice , a little nosy above but communication was amazing and home was clean.
Very quiet and safe neighborhood, close to bus stops to transfer to Downtown, and close to ChinaTown. Beds were very comfortable and the communication was excellent. Thank you!

Stayed for Market Days weekend. Decent rental right in Boystown, just steps off Northalsted and close to to all the gay bars and Wrigleyville amenities. Sleeping arrangements are a bit unclear on the listing: there's a king bed, a bunk bed with a full bed below and a twin bed above, two potentially sleepable couches, and one airbed. Note that there's little privacy between sleeping areas. This rental worked well for our group of 7. No free street parking available, but host offers onsite parking for $75/day and third-party sites offer cheaper alternatives.
It was very nice
Awesome stay. Place was a quick 5 block to the beach and is 2 blocks from the red line train station. Very good communication. Would definitely stay again.
A great stay for a great weekend. Thank you.

We enjoyed staying at Russell J’s. The home was clean and comfortable. The host was very responsive and gave us a lot of local options to look into for our visit. We will definitely would want to stay again when coming back to Chicago.
Great location and very clean!
Great space in a great location. Close to the train station, beach and restaurants. Space was just what I needed for a weekend visit.
Comfortable bed, super clean, cats really friendly, right by the red line, great place would recommend.
We really enjoyed our stay, the place was super clean and felt like home
Place is SPECTACULAR! Great location, extremely beautiful space, incredible bathrooms and beds and lovely host. Parking is a huge plus! And the space itself is impeccable. Highly recommend!!

Great location close to a lot of things in Wicker Park, which is a neighborhood that I really love! It’s not fancy, but a good value and clean. Note that there is only a window unit and fans so in the peak of summer it is a bit warm, but I imagine that’s not an issue other times in Chicago.

Cathern and Jeff were the most amazing hosts. They are so friendly and very helpful.
I really enjoyed chatting with them.
Thank you to both

Very cute place for a medium to large group that was well-kept and had everything we needed. Nearby grocery stores and restaurants were great.
The best part was definitely the hosts. Carolina is one of the kindest hosts I’ve come across and I would book again based on that alone. Couldn’t ask for a better trip and place to stay.
They were quick to respond to any questions. the place was great. I highly recommend them
Clean, convenient location.

I’ll start out by saying I would stay here again. Joe has created a space easy to use, easy to access and respectful to all guests in a hostel-style setting. The price is fair and the location is pretty good. Nice neighborhood, though not necessarily close to what I was visiting. The place is a little rundown, but Joe seems to be revamping things a little at a time.

Helen made it very easy to find her place.  I felt very safe and comfortable. It was within walking distance to the shore and a few restaurants. The parking spot was big enough to just fit our Ford F-150 so that was great. The space was a perfect size for my husband, dog, and myself. Lots of places to walk a pet if you bring one. There are plenty of plates and glasses and I love how the space is decorated. We did not cook. The shelf along the hallway made it great for putting extra belongings.  We also had the benefit of the being there during the Bud Billiken Parade. Helen warned us the road would be shut down but it didn't matter, we went to see the parade.
5 stars, phenomenal location
Troy was a great host! He was very responsive, checked in with us through out the stay. The place was safe,  super clean, and an overall a  great location.

We absolutely loved our stay! The place was very clean, warm, cozy, and welcoming. We felt comfortable the entire time, and communication with the host was amazing—very responsive and helpful. We had such a great experience and would definitely stay here again whenever we’re back in town. Highly recommend! ❤️
Cute little place to stay during our trip. Only issue was the upstairs neighbors are extremely loud at odd hours of the morning and night but the bnb itself was great.
We really enjoyed staying at Angela's place. Super close to DePaul University and the L. We walked to Kingston Mines. Great location for everything!
Tim was a great host. If I ever needed anything he responded promptly and always wanted to make sure I had everything I needed for my stay. Great space, great location, great host!
This was overall a great experience and would book with them again! Very friendly and clear instructions throughout the whole entire stay!
Such a cozy spot! Definitely gonna keep this in mind for future visits!
Arturo offers his whole home. The location is great. Made for an easy, memorable trip

We had a lovely stay In Kyriako’s place.  It was very easy to find and fits the description.  Despite there being reviews of the noise, we found it bearable and it did not affect our stay nor sleep.  The loft was very spacious and comfortable.  Kyriako was very responsive when I had questions.  I 100% recommend this Air BnB to all future guests!
We love this apartment!  Comfortable and quiet.  Close to great restaurants on Clark St in Andersonville.  Great hosts!
Great spacious house in the prefect location.
Convenient location. Fancy shower. The pac man game has more than just Pac-Man. Sadly with all the free practice I am still bad at arcade games
Sleeps 14 not 8. Updated & clean. Owners communicate & respond well.

Amazing stay at the Roscoe House! The hosts were very helpful and the location was absolutely ideal for attending the market days festival. The space itself was very cozy and well decorated. Would definitely stay again.

The host’s communication was fast and easy, which I appreciated. However, the overall condition of the shared house was disappointing and felt unsanitary.
The house was dirty, and despite the house rules stating quiet hours from 9 PM–9 AM, it was still loud during those hours. The towels provided smelled strongly of mildew, which made them uncomfortable to use.
The refrigerator had a lot of leftover food inside and smelled so bad that the odor would spread throughout the entire kitchen whenever it was opened. There also wasn’t proper dishwashing liquid available when I needed to wash dishes—the bottle contained what appeared to be heavily diluted soap mixed with water.
The bed was also very uncomfortable and seemed uneven. I constantly felt like I was sliding toward the edge of the bed from the middle. The sheet provided was too small for the mattress and repeatedly popped off. Overall it’s decent if you need a place to stay for a night.
This was my 3rd time staying at this property. I absolutely love the location. Close to the train and walking distance to many restaurants,  shops, etc.

I had a good stay in Chicago. The place was very clean, spacious, and comfortable, and the neighbourhood was nice. There were shops and restaurants nearby, which was very convenient.
The location was also good, with easy access to downtown as well as trains and buses. It was easy to get around the city from there.
Cicelia was very kind and responsive during my stay. She was helpful whenever I had a question. Overall, I enjoyed my stay and would be happy to recommend the place.
Thank you so much for a wonderful stay! Communication was fast and easy. We would gladly stay here again!

Had a great stay in this Airbnb. Enjoyed walking around the neighborhood, enjoyed incredible Roman pizza, and the room itself had everything we needed with high ceilings that makes it feel incredibly spacious. The hosts were very proactive and responsive and kind and we had no trouble with anything during our stay. Thanks again!
Wonderful time with them!  Beautiful home - excellent location!

We enjoyed our stay here! We had a group of 8 adults and the house was spacious enough with enough bathrooms for us to all be comfortable. The furnishings were nicer than pictured, so that was a pleasant surprise. One downside that wasn't clear from the listing was that the room with the twin beds has glass french doors with no curtains, so it was not private, which may not be an issue for young children, but definitely not ideal for adults. Otherwise, the house had everything we needed and was located in a lovely, walkable neighborhood conveniently located near the train station.

We enjoyed the home, it was very comfortable, especially the main level was spacious and perfect for our family. The Hosts were very accommodating with our requests. We like to cook and share meals and the space allowed for great family time.  Our granddaughter loved the tub!! We created some great family memories during our stay!
Definitely recommend! Only a ten minute walk from the nearest subway station which made it easy to use public transportation. Excellent host and good value for the space and separate bedrooms!!
The space was perfect! It is a very convenient location to the train and lots of restaurants and shops. Would book again and again.

This home got the job done, but has some areas for improvement. The check-in instructions were a bit confusing. I called the phone number on the listing several times for help checking in. My call was ignored several times, and when someone did pick up the phone, I just heard a bunch of background noise and then they hung up on me. I eventually made it inside and my room was well prepared, but the kitchen was dirty, smelled pretty bad, and featured an overflowing trash bin. I was woken up by fire crackers going off directly outside the window of my room. It wasn't terrible, but I would not stay again.

Wilma's place in Avondale is perfect for walking that neighborhood, as well as Logan Square. You are close to the blue stops and can access the entire city easily. There are great restaurants in the area...we loved Loaf Lounge. If you're into vintage shops, there are some great spots along Milwaukee Ave heading into Logan Square. Great items with good value. Have fun eating your way through Chicago like we did. The apartment was the perfect place to crash out after walking the city about 7 miles everyday. The neighborhood is quiet as well. Thanks Wilma! We loved it!
Amazing place, clean, and Cihan was a great host!
Milan was very responsive and frequently checked in with us to make sure our stay was going well. The place was as described and comfortable for all of us.

This was my second stay at Mark's greystone and we had a great time! The living room and dining room areas are spacious and comfortable to hang in and the backyard with the koi pond was a nice place to detach for a bit. The house is fully stocked with everything you need. The just installed a new washer and dryer that automatically dispense soap and are available to guests which were quite useful. The location is very convenient, close to a lot of restaurants and boys town.
Mark and Eric live closeby and are incredibly responsive - every question answered within minutes, and were happy to accommodate our needs, even non-trivial ones. They know the neighborhood and the scene, so ask them for tips! Would absolutely stay again.
Amazing stay! David was responsive when needed and the place was clean and in a great location!

First off Stephanie was very responsive to text and questions which was quite helpful, we got to the Airbnb and we’re very pleased with our stay, the location was fabulous right across the street from the old Marshall Field department store ! The Accommodation matched the description, was very clean, it was nice to have a small kitchen, washer, and dryer and a pool ! Especially for downtown Chicago ! Very pleased,
the only semi- negative which has nothing to do with Stephanie’s listing, was the condition of the outside pool area was really in worn condition, building a refresher !

It was my second time staying with Ryan. Decided to take my partner with me and try one of the lower level rooms in the house this  time around (Cottage Crafts). Needless to say  I was just as pleased as my first visit as well as my partner. As with my initial stay, everything matched the description in Ryan's listing. Per usual, Ryan provided very detailed and helpful instructions that made checking in and checking out a breeze. Getting around the City was a breeze thanks to the close proximity of Kedzie Green Line Station and abundance of bus options nearby.  Overall surrounding area is very quiet and peaceful. Highly recommend Ryan as a Host and his place if you're looking for something off the beaten path and historic. Will definitely be booking with him again to try out some of the other rooms he has available.
Everything you need in the best place to stay in Chicago! Thanks for a great stay!
Andy was very accommodating and communicative.

Nice place, up stairs neighbor was little loud one morning… above the master bedroom, being very… energetic, let’s say. Other than that, decent place. Little too far from the red line to walk to and parking can be annoying but it is always possible to park for free.
Cozy, comfy & clean.

Location!  We were able to walk to everything we wanted to see and do.  Nicole and Matt’s apartment is in a safe, beautiful area just a few minutes walk to the lake with amazing restaurants and shopping very close by.  Walkable to the riverfront as well as the Navy Pier.  The apartment is clean and spacious.  Thank you Nicole and Matt for sharing this beautiful space with us!

My friend and I stayed the weekend for Market Days and we had the opportunity to stay at one of Brad’s properties. Check-in was easy, the apartment was clean, and it had what we needed for our stay. The only complaints we had were the broken blinds in the windows let in a lot of light, and the HVAC unit  (in the closet) was so loud that my friend and I were literally yelling at each other from across the room. I would still recommend staying here if you need a place to stay that’s walkable and close to good restaurants and cafes.
Great hosts, beautiful spaces and very walkable.
Diane’s place was exactly how she described it. The unit was extremely clean & stylish. The area was relatively quiet.

Thank you so much for hosting our group again! We always love staying here because of the great location, clean and spotless accommodations, and friendly hosts. Hope to be back next year.
Thanks again!
It was an amazing place and Tracy was the best host!

Nicholas the host was great, friendly and communicative throughout my stay. The house was exactly like the photos. I picked this house due to the short distance from downtown and other surrounding areas, the neighborhood is a bit interesting but overall we had a great stay and a good deal.
A lovely stay in a lovely neighborhood.   Space was clean and comfortable and next to a street of fantastic food.
Great location and staff

The AC worked well. It’s a nice neighborhood close to the beach and the redline. I would recommend.

You get exactly what is described in the listing. It was just right for our weekend trip. If you are over 6’0 then you will have to bend down at times and the ceiling will be super close to your head. Other than that, it’s a decent spot!!

Lea was such a lovely host, adding a personal note to welcome us to our stay. The unit was just as pictured and a perfect size for our small family. It was great to have a private entrance and we felt very safe in the neighborhood!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ We absolutely loved our stay! From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home. The hosts were incredibly caring, attentive, and professional. They checked in with us throughout our stay to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed, and they were always quick to help with anything we asked for. Their hospitality truly made a difference and made us feel very well taken care of.
The home itself was comfortable, welcoming, and very well equipped. We especially loved having a fully stocked kitchen where we could cook and enjoy homemade meals together as a family. This Airbnb was absolutely beautiful and so spacious! The host was incredibly responsive and made everything so easy. The secure parking spot was a huge plus, and there was also plenty of street parking available.
The neighborhood felt safe and was in a great location, with lots of markets, restaurants, and other places within walking distance. Overall, it was a wonderful stay, and I would definitely stay here again! Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

A lovely stay in one of Chicago’s best neighborhoods!  Well appointed and cozy apartment close to Damen and North Avenue.  Walkable to tons of restaurants (Club Lucky, a personal fave, is just up the street), shops and cafes.  Beautiful tree lined street and an easy hop on the 606 walking trail.  10 minutes to the Blue Line for direct trains into downtown Chicago.  Would stay again in a heartbeat!

Our stay in the coach house was fantastic. The backyard and patio were lovely, and the space itself was light and airy. Check-in was simple and straightforward, free parking in the neighborhood was a huge plus! We quickly felt at home and cozy. It was walkable to transit stops, bus and train, which made it a great home base as we explored the city. Even without leaving the neighborhood, there were several great shops and restaurants (Smack Dab and Alexander’s on North Clark were particular favorites for breakfast!) The neighborhood itself had an incredible ambience, warm, friendly with lush, well-loved yards, gardens and trees, which made for some pretty and pleasant walks in the mornings and evenings.
Scott was a friendly and responsive host, made great conversation at check-in and made sure we were comfortable. Overall, we had a wonderful stay, and we definitely boom this space again!
Awesome apartment! Clean ! No issues. Back room ac was not the best but overall still great experience
We loved staying in Barbara’s place. The location was great and the rooms were comfortable and clean.

One of the worst experience on Airbnb, extreme noise from train that is literraly 8 meters parallel to the unit and at the same level. No soundproof windows and the train runs every 20 mins for 21 consecutive hours. I reported this to the host and he couldn’t care less and said that is was disclosed that the unit is in the heart of the city. I had to wear earplugs and even with that couldn’t sleep at all and had worst headache in the morning. I informed the host that I decided to depart early (two nights ahead of time). I requested a partial refund which he declined.
Also submitted a claim to customer support and they didn’t care either. So in summary I lost over 2k USD, and realize that these people are just trying to make money and they don’t care about customers. I don’t usually leave reviews but this one is well deserved.

Minus the endless flights of stairs, it was all amazing. You could always look at it as a positive however and get a little cardio in each day. Fantastic hosts, thankful for the communication and ease of process.
Our trip was wonderful from the moment we got there. We would definitely stay again!

Hectors place fit my group of 8 perfectly, the Airbnb is far more worth it than it looks. The front is gorgeous and has fruits growing, there is plenty of parking and our host was very responsive. Our only complaint is that the dishes lacked proper cleaning, some spots in the Airbnb like the bottom stove drawer need deep cleaning. Regardless we were beyond satisfied, the home is very spacious.
I would recommend that guest take into account that the bedrooms are on the top two floors.
The place was almost perfect. It was clean, the people were nice and the neighborhood was safe. It was spacious and comfortable for 5. I just think the price was too much.
Clear communication and everything is exactly as described.
Amazing listing & location! Not too far from the airport & cozy ambiance :) Alexis was super responsive and I’d highly recommend this place!
This was the perfect home for a wonderul time in Chicago. Each room in the house had so much character and we felt cozy and right at home! Would absolutely stay here again!
Great place, convenient to lots of stores and  restaurants. The place was very clean. Floor are very squeaky but otherwise a great place.
Ronaldo’s place was great! It was easy to find, we had parking and it was very close to coffee shops and restaurants. We had a great stay!
Shaun was a very good host, he was able to accommodate adding a person to our trip and early check in. The place was clean and there was parking easily available on the street.

Afsha’s place was exactly as described and even more spacious than we expected. All bedrooms were comfortable and the bathroom was well stocked. The apartment is well located to explore Chicago and comes with a parking space which we found indispensable for our day trip to Springfield. Afsha herself is very communicative and accommodating and we would not hesitate to stay again next time we’re in the area!
Good communication and cozy room.

This is a good deal for the price. The location is great for Wrigley or Boystown. Very safe and easily walkable to many restaurants and stores. The pictures are accurate - there is a lot of sleeping space. The kitchen and full bathroom are also pretty big. The a/c works great. Enough hot water for 5 gays. Very quiet - we heard no neighbors downstairs or outside. Plenty of street parking on a non-Cubs weekend and there are Spothero spaces directly behind the building across the alley. Dennis was easy to work with and we had no issues.
Great place.
The property was well maintained and great for our group of 10 for a bachelorette trip. The downstairs was a great spot to hang out and watch movies. Good location to walk to restaurants and train.
Great stay. Nice house for the price
Jaime's place was a chill spot, reasonable house rules, and good home base for a weekend in the Northside.

Location:

Place:
Great place that seems newly renovated with modern appliances. Enjoyed my stay.

I met Daniel briefly while he and his partner were tending to the backyard. Very nice guy and accommodating. Responded promptly.

Great stay in a nice neighborhood. Unique decorations, tasty baked goods, adequate space for a couple, friendly hosts. Place as described (basement level, stairs to unit) with natural light from windows. Tv was small but worked well. Grateful for the AC unit in summer.
Great place.
This is one of the best Airbnbs my family has stayed at. It was very homey, well decorated, clean, extra amenities. Overall a 5 plus home. We would definitely book again.

You get the whole basement to yourself (bedroom, bathroom, sitting area) as well as access to his kitchen, a refrigerator & back deck which was lovely. Couldn't have asked for a better space to stay in. As far as Mriganav, he is friendly, warm & inviting. Communicative through the app & his response time is quick. My partner and I never once felt uncomfortable staying with him. If anything, it felt like staying with a friend you don't see often but know you always have a place to stay with them. Would definitely and will definitely be staying here again. My partner and I are so grateful for our stay!
Great place in a great location, will stop by again when I’m in town!

Stayed with Weihong in this building last year to attend an event in Millennium Park and was more than happy to stay here again! Other than that, highly recommend Weihong for single travelers or couples who keep to themselves!
Great location and hosts. Highly recommend!

Great location, responsive host - all around excellent Airbnb experience!
Wonderful location and space. Perfect for a trip into the city with friends or family.
Everything you could ask for in a place to stay in chicago! easy transit access both into town and to the airport.

We had a great stay here! The host was very helpful, and all the instructions were clear and easy to follow, which made check-in super convenient. The place was actually more spacious than it looked in the photos, very clean, and had everything we needed for our stay.

Overall, it was a very comfortable and easy stay, and I would definitely recommend this place!
Great spot in Southport and easy to get to the Red Line for transportation into downtown.
Air BnB was in a great spot and hosts were communicative.

Such an amazing stay! My friends and I had the time of our lives and felt so comfortable and safe within the space. Freddy is a great host and responded super quickly as well as was always helpful. Would definitely recommend!

We were concerned about the nearby train, but it really wasn’t an issue. It sounded more like a soft airplane passing and didn’t affect our sleep, especially with the provided sound machines. The rooftop deck and upstairs office were great bonuses. The upstairs bedrooms could definitely use blackout curtains, as they get bright early. Our only inconvenience was the 10 AM checkout. I asked about 11 and was told it might be possible if the house didn’t book and to check back. When I did, it still wasn’t showing as booked on Airbnb, but the request was declined. An 11 AM checkout, which is more typical at hotels, would have made departure easier. Overall, a very nice and comfortable stay!

Place was amazing and exactly what my friends and I needed for Market Days. We had one small hiccup, but Carlos was quick and sent someone to repair it immediately. The grill was great to cook on, and the bathrooms were very relaxing.  All the other fixtures and such were modern and very  cozy for the unit. Would recommend for anyone with an activity in the Wrigleville, Uptown, or Boystown area.  With the Red Line a 5 min walk getting to anywhere in the city is super easy.

I thought the place was clean, comfortable, and located in a quaint, pleasant area. My only complaint was the noise. The apartment has very thin walls, and there was a family with small children and pets upstairs who were quite noisy and up early every morning during my stay.
Other than that, I had no complaints and found the stay enjoyable overall.

The lock to get into the house was difficult to use, and required you to hold the door tight to open it but there were no instructions to do that. They provided instructions to open the garage door from the inside, which was useless to guests because you can’t use the door inside the garage and you have to go around to get inside. It would have been more helpful to have a video of the garage door from the outside.

I was very satisfied of the room. Even better than advertised.

Very clean with just the right amount of decor and the main bed is really comfortable.   Definitely recommend.   Close to a lot so we didn’t have to worry about renting a car or parking.
They had everything we needed for our stay in Chicago.

Great location, beautiful and clean.

This apartment was perfect for our annual guys trip here in Chicago. Tons of great food and bars and almost everything is walkable. TAIMS responded so fast to any questions we had. Thank you for a great trip!

Very nice unit with amazing check in instructions. It was easy to get to the unit and it was clean.

This is a nice garden-level unit located on a peaceful street just off the Southport Corridor. It is nicely decorated and very welcoming. Well equipped, clean and comfortable. Check in was easy and communication from the host was great.
Great spot! Cozy and comfortable and had everything you need for a quick weekend. He was always responsive and helpful!
This place was pretty good. Big room, tall ceilings and windows! Nice kitchen and bathroom. Bed was pretty comfy.

Great location if you’re in the area for a Sox game. It’s walkable if you’re up for a few miles, we walked back in the dark and never felt unsafe. Kate’s place matched the description perfectly. Would absolutely stay again if ever in the area!

We had a wonderful stay at David’s place! It’s a great location, walkable to restaurants and shops. David was very responsive and provided clear instructions for checking in.  I will definitely stay there again!

Glad to have stayed here. The place was clean, comfortable, and a peaceful place to return to after long days out.
