The apartment was perfect for our stay. It was clean and had everything we needed. The location was ideal for the events we were doing, walkable and a short Lyft ride to the river walk area. Parking at the apartment was not great, however in the check-in instructions, Jhon recommended SpotHero. I would encourage using this app. It was easy to use and Guaranteed parking close by.

I was just in Chicago for a quick weekend for a wedding and Brad’s place was perfect for what I needed! The space was comfy and had A/C. Bathroom was a little cramped compared to the photos (especially the shower). Check-in instructions were easy to follow. Lots of food options in the area and close to a Metra stop. All in all a great stay. Thank you!
Stayed there to be close to Soldier Field for a concert. It was a perfect location!

A localização é excelente, poucos minutos a pé da estação Division da Blue Line, com poucas paradas até o loop, onde há integração com outras linhas, facilitando muito o transporte pela cidade. Nas proximidades, há supermercado grande, lojas, restaurantes, lanchonetes.
O espaço da Lina é lindo, exatamente como nas fotos, com uma decoração maravilhosa de todos os cômodos do apartamento.
Apenas tive problema para dormir nas duas últimas noites, devido ao clube localizado ao lado do apartamento. Lina oferece tampões para os ouvidos, mas que não são suficientes para mim. Foi difícil dormir, e, além disso, acordei por causa da vibração da música alta.
Quanto ao espaço da Lina em si, ele é altamente recomendável!

Rated highly because it was as advertised and perfect for what we needed. Not necessarily because it's the fanciest place. Some notes:
Parking. Not bad for Chicago. It's on a busier road so parking right near the unit wasn't guaranteed but we had good luck. Side streets would have been a fine back-up plan, just a short walk.
Be ready to climb stairs. They were solid stairs but several flights up.
It's really an attic. Walls were slanted, which really only was a bit of an issue near the toilet, where guys would have to tilt there head. Shower was a bit short too. Anyone over 6' 2" or so would have to duck. Not a big deal and had little impact on our comfort.
Air conditioning. We were there in August and it was pretty warm. There's a floor A/C unit in the kitchen and a window unit in the bedroom. Did a good job keeping the place cool. We had no issues and we love air conditioning.
Short drive from the freeway, so once you've survived that, it's only a couple more minutes.
nice place to stay in a great location. the space wasn’t super clean and we had a hard time locking the doors but overall a good stay.

Positivo: posizione, accoglienza, precisione, affidabilità.
Negativi: e' un basemant, finestre molto piccole, soffitto basso (2mt), termostato controllato dalla padrona di casa, rumoroso (sala caldaia ), cattivo odore di aglio all'arrivo
Great host great place

Great location, walkable to so much! We appreciated the extra a/c in the top floor bedrooms. Lots of equipment for babies: gates, pack n play, etc.  make sure you’re ready to climb stairs though. This is an older row house on four floors. It was fine for us, but could be a challenge for some people

The house was very accommodating for ten people. Very spacious and two different sitting areas on the main floor. Each of the 5 bedrooms were comfortable with chest of drawers to use, nice closet space. Nice kitchen, bathrooms were decent, clean. All n all my family enjoyed our time in the home.
We had such a great stay! Joanne gave good recommendations for the area. The place was well kept and very comfortable, even in the heat of summer. Would absolutely stay again!
This place was great!
Great!
We enjoyed our stay! It was big enough for four adults and four babies/toddlers with minimal safety worries. Easy to get to things around the city.

This house was amazing and everything the listing said that it was. Ronda was very communicative and I appreciated her flexibility to allow an early check in. The location was conveniently located and the house comfortably fit us with 8 guests with room for more. The only issue was with the HVAC leaving the upper level hot, however it was communicated to us prior to arrival, was fixed during the stay and appropriately remedied. Otherwise, this is probably the best Air BnB house I’ve stayed in and would again!
The airbnb was nice and had everything we needed. The street parking was a bit difficult if you came back late at night.

The apartment was very comfortable and clean and the neighborhood was quiet. We  mostly explored the area by walking and found many options for restaurants and cafés. We never had a problem parking near  the apartment. Would definitely stay here again.
Convenient location. Exactly as advertised.

Overall, we had a pleasant stay, but there are a few less than ideal things to mention. The pillows were uncomfortable and the shower head needs to be replaced. While the apartment was surface-level clean, it could definitely use a thorough cleaning. There was a significant amount of dust in several areas, and the bathrooms had a noticeable “wet” smell. On the positive side, the apartment is spacious for Chicago. It’s conveniently located near a train station and in a great neighborhood. Dean and Suzi were very responsive to messages.

6 bedrooms across 3 floors: This is not clearly communicated in the listing and can be very inconvenient for families with young children or seniors.
Common areas across multiple floors: Spaces are small and congested, making it difficult for larger groups to comfortably gather.
No AC on the middle floor:
Games/equipment incomplete: Several of the games provided were missing pieces or equipment, making some of them unusable—especially disappointing for a property marketed toward families.
Constant nickel-and-diming: Additional charges for early check-in, late check-out, parking, pets, etc. significantly adds to the cost.
Heavy monitoring: Cameras are installed in hallways and other common areas, which made us feel uncomfortable and constantly monitored.
Overly intrusive property management company.

We had a wonderful stay! The GPS had us a little confused at first because the property was a little farther down the road than where the map showed, but once we found it, it was absolutely gorgeous.
We did have a little trouble getting in the door a couple of times, but once we were inside, everything was amazing. The décor was beautiful, the couch and living area were comfortable, and the bedrooms were set up perfectly. You could really tell that a lot of thought was put into the decorations and even the pictures on the walls. Everything came together beautifully and made the place feel very welcoming.
The only small downside was that with six people staying there, the hot water took a little while to warm back up between showers. Other than that, everything was 100% great, and we truly enjoyed our stay. The property was just as beautiful as we hoped it would be!
It was a nice stay we have enjoyed it
Would definitely stay again! Jerome was a wonderful host!
Everything was great!

Great spot in a great area. Super walkable. The alleyway parking was a great amenity. Keep in mind the building is a little older so some things aren’t perfect but everything is mentioned in the listing and other reviews. Overall would stay here again and would definitely recommend others to stay here!

My stay was amazing! Everything from the convenient location, clean space, amenities, and clear instructions with check in and check out made my stay feel very welcoming. Abia was very responsive and was always willing to help with any questions or concerns I had. I came with a group of friends and we all had the best time!

Very nice clean place. In walking distance of beach and family. Near places wanted to visit. Only recommended that put corner shelf in small shower to put soap and shampoo on. Otherwise a very nice apartment

I was very comfortable in Ewa’s apt and she was very helpful with any question I had. She also was friendly and polite :) the area is very exciting and full of local character, and it’s very easy to get around or to the downtown area. The apartment and bedroom were clean and quiet, and the bedroom itself was fabulous, with lots of space to leave my items and a comfortable bed. I would absolutely recommend her place for your Chicago visit !

This location worked out great for our family of four. We had plenty of space to relax after spending the day sightseeing. I really enjoyed sitting outside with my morning coffee. There was plenty to see within walking distance. The train is right there also. We really enjoyed our stay, and would stay here again.

Dentro de todo la ubicación no es mala, en solo 30 minutos estas en el centro.
Creo que se debería mejorar la limpieza, especialmente el baño.
Great location! Would stay again

We really enjoyed our stay at Billy’s place. He was super helpful with pre-trip planning and accommodated our early check in request so we had somewhere to drop our luggage.
The apartment was more spacious than we expected based on the photos. The living room and kitchen were both thoughtfully designed, with plenty of mugs, cups, plates, bowls, etc.

The beds are quite comfortable and the linens are good quality. Both bedrooms have spacious closets to store luggage which was great for us given we were 4 people.
The showers have great water pressure and they had shampoo, conditioner and body wash available.
There was some noise from the neighbors above, but that’s to be expected in any apartment building. I’d recommend bringing a sound machine for sleeping if you’re sensitive to noise.
Great home. Impressed with the cleanliness. Location was exactly what I wanted in terms of wanting to see/visit the bronzeville area.
Very nice house, good location

Great place to stay having security codes.
Easyly available parking at roadside.
Excellent location.  Nice and big.  Had to wait just a bit for check in even though we got there after the check in time.  Clean and comfortable.
Myrtle and Jacob took excellent care of me and I felt blessed under their roof

Great stay at David's place. Super walkable, great restaurants everywhere, and the El train directly outside (though the noise was not at all disruptive!).
He also left some fruit and snacks which our toddler very much appreciated!
Would definitely rent again if coming with a group of 4-6 people.
Nice place with very responsive hosts.
Fun art, great location, good for kids, responsive host!
Place was big enough for all of us and didn’t feel like we were on top of each other.  Everything was comfortable and clean.
Beautiful place, inside and out
The parking situation was top tier. We came for a dance convention and it was only 7 minutes away. Super clean and clear instructions all around. Hope to stay here again next year.
had a nice time here and would stay again
We had a great time. Rob’s communication was solid. No complaints!

Pros: Beautiful neighborhood that felt safe
Plenty of restaurants nearby
Easy walk to the L - day passes are $5
Looks exactly like the picture
Beautiful wood floors and large window to looks down to street level
Easy check in with number lock
Nice late check out of 11am - Love!
Cons the owner can fix:
Beds are uncomfortable - there were five of us and we agreed this is the only large con of the place.
Shower head only moves up and down and no handheld shower head
Cons owner cannot fix:
The stairs to the apartment are fairly steep
No off street parking and knowing how to parallel park is essential

We really enjoyed our stay! It was perfect for six people and the location was perfect for our needs. It is also a block or two from many restaurants, which made meals very easy, especially given that we were traveling with someone who currently has limited mobility. We also really appreciated the fact that this property is dog friendly and has a fantastic parking situation. Thanks for a great stay!!
Beautiful place and great location.  Miriam was extremely responsive.

Overall great place, home has everything you need and it is very spacious. The WiFi mostly works in the kitchen so be mindful if you are working from home that is where the best connection is. Imran was very responsive and helpful, also location can be quiet active at night and a lot of sound but I felt very safe in the area, would recommend!
This spot blew us away. The backyard was incredible and the location was walkable. The kitchen was huge and the hang out space was perfect for a group of 8.

Cristina is a wonderful and very responsive host! The listing and reality matched and it was exactly as expected. The neighborhood is quiet and very walkable for food and drink options and not too far from the train. Would stay here again next time we're in Chicago.

Hate hate to leave a bad review. My first one. The place was ok. But not worth anywhere near $2000 a night. For that price I was expecting to be in the heart of downtown. Its above a train station so you can hear that every 10 min. No dark blinds so they give face masks to make up for it. Again the place was ok. But I could have stayed in the Trump tower for 2000 a night so was expecting alot more.
Enjoyed my stay! This was my second time booking this Airbnb and I had a great experience.
Great stay

Our stay was very enjoyable.  The house was exactly as described.  The neighborhood was very quiet, and we felt safe.  Diep was very prompt in responding to our questions.  I highly recommend this home if you’re planning to visit Chicago.

This was just what I needed for the weekend - clean, comfy, great location. AC & internet worked great along with being surprisingly quiet made this a great place to rest and relax in between weekend activities.  Bed and pillows were comfy so slept well too.  Really enjoyed having this spot for my visit.

Our second stay at this very comfortable and convenient spot in Lincoln Park.  Martha communicates very well, the house is clean with many amenities.  We hope to stay here on our future trips to Chicago.
This place was the perfect location for me and my guest. Conveniently close to many places to visit in Chicago. Our host was very helpful. Highly recommend if your a big group and looking for space.

Tracy was friendly, responsive and the stay was great! Convenient walking distance from train stations and easy to travel to and from the city. Would recommend staying here anytime when visiting Chicago.

Mira was a very responsive host and communicative very well. The Airbnb was very, very spacious, clean and tidy. Public Transportation was within walking distance. Me and my friend had a very good stay there. I would definitely stay here again if I visit this area in the future.

Great neighborhood. Easy street parking. Quick and responsive communication. We had an issue that was addressed quickly. Good for early risers in the summer, as there are skylights in most of the bedrooms that let in lots of light in the morning.
Caleb’s place was wonderful!! Just what we were needing and such a beautiful home. Caleb was incredibly friendly and responsive and an incredible host.
Nice place with 3 small bedrooms which was great.
Nice apartment in a very good location for our needs. Communication was always prompt and professional ~ well run place.

J’s place was the perfect spot for my weekend trip to Chicago. There are plenty of restaurants in the nearby area along with access to public transportation. The shared areas were clean and had everything we needed. The walls are thin if you’re a light sleeper, but earplugs are provided in the shared space and I was able to sleep fine.
Love the place, it’s so cute and would definitely recommend to anyone who’s solo traveling, I love that downtown was so close and wasn’t hard to drive around the city.

We loved our stay here, it was clean and just looked like the pictures! At night, it was a little loud from the street, but there’s earplugs and sound machines so you don’t hear it when you use the earplugs. Highly recommend, it’s in the best location and easy to get around!
Michael’s was so clean, well stocked and extremely comfortable.  We were out everyday, all day enjoying Chicago but this beautiful apartment was a relaxing place to return to every evening.

I booked this Airbnb with my partner for the weekend to attend a concert at The House of Blues. I choose locations to stay based on proximity to the venue and free parking for my vehicle.  The Airbnb was easy to locate, walking distance to Chinatown, the neighborhood area was quiet and there was available street parking. We left our vehicle parked all weekend with no issue and took rideshare/walked. We arrived late so I appreciated the self check in process. The space itself was clean and mostly as pictured. Actual curtains, a solid bed frame, boxspring, better quality bedding, and a pair of nightstands would do wonders to elevate the quality of the bedroom/sleeping experience. The bathroom was clean and towels were provided but the water pressure in the shower was lackluster. There were internet issues the entirety of the full day of our stay so we weren't really able to utilize the smart TV for streaming Netflix. Outside of storing beverages in the fridge, we did not use the kitchen.
Great location and place. Felt like a cozy hotel room.

The property was very clean and the location was convenient, which were definite positives.
There were a few issues that impacted our stay. The hot water was particularly problematic. It took approximately 15–20 minutes for the shower to get hot (every time you turned it on), and when we contacted the host, they responded quickly but advised us to simply let the water run for that amount of time. In the second shower near the entrance, the water was only warm when the other shower was running.
Since we stayed during the summer, we also found that while the living room was comfortably cool, the bedrooms were quite warm at night.
Light sleeper be aware, there is significant train noise late into the night
Communication started out very well and the host was responsive when we reached out. However, we did not receive the promised check-in instructions the day before arrival. We had to reach out to berequest the information late the night before and eventually received the information.
El llegar está perfecto silencioso seguro para caminar y tienes muchas cosas muy cercas
Very accommodating! The beds were comfy. But the downstairs was freezing while the upstairs was hot & the lighting in the kitchen not ideal for cooking. PARKING INCLUDED. Close to the farmers market.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Russell is a great host.
Loved staying here! The attention to details was unlike anything I have experienced with other airbnb stays. Would come back!
Great location, private, has just what you need, and we were very comfortable as a group of 6!
Good location, little noisy but modern amenities and clean. Patricia was responsive and helpful. Recommend for a big family or group.
Highly recommend this place.
My friend and I stayed here for a concert at Soldier field! It was a great stay, clean facilities & nearby to local areas
I enjoyed my stay. Bus line and red line being close made going places on the northside easy. Place was nice - if sunshine wakes you up bring an eye mask.
This was the perfect location in the city. Apartment was clean and very comfortable! Will definitely stay here in the future.
Great place would stay again for sure
Enjoyed our stay at Laura’s. I would stay here again due to the location being a close walk to many restaurants, bars, venues.

Lovely and comfortable stay in a private apartment. Shomari was a great and friendly host, responsive and helpful to resolving small issues we encountered. Space was private and comfortable, right off both bus and the Metra - perfect for our weekend in Chicago. Street parking in the neighborhood was easy and effortless. Neighborhood was welcoming.

Beautiful and clean place to stay in. Everything was spotless clean! Nice & friendly neighborhood and neighbors. Would definitely recommend others to stay. Instructions were clear and Yadi is very responsive.
Great and very large apartment. Great location. Kind host. Recommend!
I had an amazing day, would definitely book again if i’m ever in the area!

we really enjoyed our stay in the Cloud9's apartment. It is a super clean, high-end and spacious 2b2b, perfectly suitable for 3 of us because we were traveling with our son. the location is very good,  walkable for almost everything in beautiful downtown Chicago. also the roof top and parking are quite a plus (parking at $50 per day is fare enough). the host also provided some thoughtful foods/snacks in the fridge so we decided to cook our breakfast on the day before we checked out. It was a luxury trip for us, but I think it worths its price.  if we chose to book a nice hotel for 2 rooms, it could cost the same but may not be able to have such big space. in short, strongly recommend!
Nice location, close to some nice restaurants and bars. We saw some roaches inside tho, and the building overall was older.

We had a great stay! The host was very responsive and quick to answer any questions we had. The space was comfortable, spacious, and worked perfectly for our family of five adults and two young children. We also felt very comfortable in the neighborhood. We would definitely consider staying here again!

Alexs place was exactly as pictured. Clean, spacious and well maintained.  The airbnb was easy to locate and access and the location was easily walkable to tons of bars, restaurants and coffee shops. Communicative and friendly host, would recommend.
It was great! Very peaceful and chill.
This home was welcoming and fun to be staying at. The communication was clear and the hospitality was amazing. I would recommend anyone to stay here. One of the best hosts I have had.
Hanna and Mark’s place did not disappoint! The location made it easy to navigate the city and the unit was great!
We had a great time!
This space was perfect for what was needed on this trip! It was easily accessible and very clean! Great place to stay close to so many neighborhoods.

Very spacious loft that was beautifully decorated and truly encompassed Chicago life. Location is perfect for someone looking for a place close enough to downtown, but quiet and away from the chaos of the city.

We loved our stay in Pilsen! We were within walking distance from great bars, restaurants, and Thalia Hall music venue.
The beds were comfy and the place was spotless.
We wish we would’ve had free nights to spend on the back deck. It looked so nice 😊
We enjoyed the location. Perfect for easy access to the beach where we rented bikes and hit the lakefront trail all day. Great spot!
Grateful for AJ’s hospitality. We had 8 guests and everyone slept comfortably in this huge house. The game room kept us entertained.
As described, close to the CTA

Rasheed was very responsive from the beginning and no question was a bother. Our unit was perfect for a family trip, (5 adults and 1 infant) and it was nice to have a full size crib available for our grandson. The rooms are a good size with the master being surprisingly large. Our unit did have a balcony which we used for coffee and drinks. The location was really perfect. We were in the middle of some great shopping and great restaurants were only a 5 min walk away. The neighborhood is quite vibrant, but not noisy. We would have no reservations about staying here again.
Sharon was very responsive to all my inquiries and was proactive in communicating to me regarding our stay. This was a great base of operations to explore this area of Chicago!
El lugar es muy agradable y tranquilo. Si buscan un lugar para hospedarse, es un lugar perfecto ✨

The apartment itself was aesthetically beautiful, and the furniture and decor had a lot of thoughtful details, which is something I really appreciated. It was also close enough to many things, and I did not necessarily feel unsafe, but the immediate location could feel a little uncomfortable at night. There were often neighbors outside smoking and watching as I walked in and out, so I was more aware of my surroundings.
My biggest issues were the temperature and cleanliness. Guests do not control the AC, and the unit would randomly become very hot or very cold. There was also a pest issue during my stay — I saw multiple ants as well as two roaches, and I sent photos to the host. Dimitri was very responsive whenever I contacted him, which I genuinely appreciated, but I did not receive any compensation regarding the pest situation.
Personally, I would not stay here again mainly because of the insects and the lack of control over the AC. I would also be hesitant to stay during the winter

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had a wonderful stay! The home was beautiful, very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great and made it easy for us to enjoy everything Chicago has to offer. The host was welcoming, helpful, and easy to communicate with. We truly felt at home and had a great experience. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you for everything!
This space was perfect!!! It was really beautiful inside and was a great space. I would recommend to anyone!! I’d love to come back. The location was great.
Very nice home!
Wonderful house to stay in for a girls weekend! All the amenities were excellent.
Great host, was very responsive when we needed help and was quick to fix things. House was comfortable, clean, and very spacious.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! It’s a great location- you can easily grab a bus or walk to many fun things in the area. And the roof top was our favorite place to wind down after a long day. The house was fully stocked with whatever you need. We had a mustard incident and there was even stain remover. If you can think of it, he had it. We would definitely stay again!

Armando’s house was just as described, and the check-in process was very easy. He was also very responsive and came over as soon as possible when we had an issue with the sink, which we really appreciated. The only downside was that there weren’t any extra essentials available, such as toilet paper, towels, or pillows. Having a few extras of these items would have made the stay more comfortable. Overall, we had a good experience.

Charlie’s place was very clean ! Spotless!
The private bathroom is definitely a plus and the shower was great! I guess there’s a bathroom above the room being that you can hear water running and a few loud bumps here and there but other than that it was a great stay.
The house was perfect and we had a great time!

Leo and Alex were responsive from the moment I booked with questions I had. They were reasonable and clear about their expectations for guests. Their place was as described and spotless. We basically just slept and showered here in-between our full Chicago itinerary. Everyone was happy with the space.
Things we loved about this Airbnb:
-It was walkable to local food and restaurants and our daughter and niece's apartment ;). When we didn't walk, Ubers, lime scooters, buses, and trains were an easy option.
-The beds were very comfortable! We slept very well.
-It was very clean!
-We did not end up cooking, but if we had wanted to everything we needed was there.
-Our hosts were incredibly communicative and responsive.
-The parking spot! It's the Logan Square area of Chicago. My daughter lives here and sometimes has to park three or four blocks away from her apartment. A parking space is gold!
Thank you Leo & Alex! My daughter just renewed her lease so I'm sure we'll be back! :)
Our stay was comfortable
This location was great! The loft was very spacious! It had everything we need it. There are also a lot of restaurants within walking distance. 10/10

This was a great place to spend our week in Chicago! Any questions or qualms we had were resolved quickly by Ariel and she even provided us with her own personal suggestions for entertainment/food/nightlife/etc :)) Great host, super conveniently placed and really cozy!
Everything went off fantastic, they had an issues with the wifi, but thankfully they didn’t spend too much time there for it to be impactful.
Loved this place !!
Everything was just as wonderful as we had hoped.

If you are planning on visiting Chicago and want a place where it is easy to come and go Matthew's place would be great. We went to downtown Chicago, Chinatown, Brookfield, and many other places during our stay and I never felt like we were "too" far away. We even went to Gary, IN during our stay and it was only an hour commute. The place was very up to date and modern and had everything you would need for a pleasant stay.
Great communication and nice place to stay

The location was wonderful in the state was marvelous, however, for a person with mobility issue, climbing two flights of stairs, and having to carry luggage, presented a struggle for me and my wife . My only suggestion for people with mobility issues you might want to have them on the first floor and consider trying to comply with some ADA standards to make possible that individuals with mobility issues will not have a great strain. But time was great and the room was wonderful.  I would stay again with a few improvements
Place it’s not up to the price at all
Excellent stay!

Places is spacious, which was great for our family thanks to its three good-sized rooms and prime location right in the heart of Chinatown. However, the kitchen was a bit under-equipped—no glassware, only cups and teapots, and limited cooking utensils. Also, note that the stairs up are narrow, so keep that in mind. Parking had an extra fee, and unfortunately, the lock code didn’t work, so we had to walk around the building each time. On the positive side, the place was very clean and well-located overall.
Comfy beds and great location!

El alojamiento es igual al de las fotos. Buena ubicación. Mi familia y yo lo sentimos muy cómodo para 9 personas, sin embargo las puertas eran muy ruidosas. Faltan más platos, vasos, tasas y cucharas.  Éramos un grupo de 9 personas por lo que no eran suficientes.  En general todo bien pero necesita más limpieza, había cabellos en uno de los baños y algunos utensilios de la cocina estaban sucios.
Adam was great and the Airbnb was fantastic.
Incredible Airbnb experience. Great, friendly host. Beautiful home. Amazing neighborhood. Everything was easy. Will stay again when visiting Chicago.

This is a really nice place to be if you want a little space, close to the blue line, and easy access to the city without being in the middle of it. It’s a nice distance from the airport as well. The place is really nice and made to feel cozy for the guest.
Naomi’s place was great for our 3 day weekend in Chicago.  It had a lot of space, the parking spot, and all the amenities we needed. Definitely recommend!

Tia was very accommodating and relatively quick to respond whenever we had any questions or concerns. The location was great, with plenty to do nearby, and the neighborhood has beautiful homes if you enjoy walking around and exploring. Free on-site parking was also a great plus.
A few things to note: if you are sensitive to cigarette smoke or strong odors, this may not be the place for you. There was a distinct cigarette smell throughout the apartment, including on some of the furniture. The apartment itself was generally clean, although the bathroom floors could have been cleaner.
Overall, it’s a cute and comfortable apartment with a GREAT large couch, and having a washer and dryer was very convenient. The kitchen was also spacious, organized, and well laid out, which was a definite plus.
One other consideration is that the neighbors were fairly loud at night, so light sleepers may want to keep that in mind.

Absolutely wonderful place! Ryan's place was extremely clean and comfortable. The location was excellent as there are many restaurants and shops nearby within walkable distance. The Blue Line CTA train is only a few steps away which made traveling into downtown and beyond, easier for us. Overall, wonderful stay and made my first time in Chicago that much more enjoyable.
Super walkable neighborhood and located between two L train stops which helped depending on if we were out picking up Starbucks or leaving the house.

Great location with lots around. The coffee shop next door is amazing  and the perfect way to wake up. The space was nice and as described. It was a bit dusty and didn’t look like it was really professionally cleaned, but it wasn’t too bad. Shaun was a good host who was very kind and responsive, would stay here again next time I come to Chicago. Was a nice place to rest after having fun in the city.
We loved staying here! Plenty of room for all six of us and it was unbelievably quiet for how close it is to Wrigley Field and Northalsted.

This Airbnb will be in our most happiest of memories for my partner and I. What was originally our anniversary get away turned into the place of our engagement 🤍 My partner saw this beautiful space and knew that it was the perfect intimate place to ask for my hand! Hopefully this place will be available so that we can visit again!
Also getting greeted by their puppy dog was definitely a plus 🐶

This home was extremely clean. Every time we left and reentered the home, it was the same feeling as the first time. The area was nice and there were plenty of walkable places nearby. Harry would check in regularly to make sure if we had any questions he could be of help.

The apartment is as described. The location is fairly new and clean. We had an issue when we arrived with the bedding, but the host took care of it immediately. Responsive in the app, with replies that they would look into an issue or make the building management aware. Excellent location - located close to the train and Whole Foods. The location is the biggest selling point. Negatives were the air conditioning - super loud and came on full force. When it would turn off, the apartment got very stagnant. Highly suggest that you bring in fans for the living and bedrooms. Not sure if it was newer construction, but we found several bugs (and some dead ones in the windows). The host advised that there was bug spray, but we never found it in the kitchen.
Solid place.
This is a lovely place with a reserved parking spot and an EV charger, both of which are very much appreciated amenities.  Carissa was great to work with.
Had a great/comfortable experience
Great spot clear instructions. Hosts made things simple.
I really enjoyed this place. It’s just down the block from Hollywood beach. It’s clean and comfortable.

We really enjoyed our stay here. It was SO convenient, just a block from the Red Line. We had one small hiccup with the unit (the toilet seat was loose) but it was addressed immediately. Great communication from the host all around! It's a several-step process to access the unit but we felt very safe as a result.

I love a funky Airbnb. I completely love the vibe. The place looks dark, but there’s tons of sunlight coming in. Be patient on the hot water, it is there. I felt secure in a quiet neighborhood even though the street is right out front. I never heard the neighbors one time. The Wi-Fi worked well. And it was very spacious. Alana was very responsive.
Comfortable, great location.
Amazing stay for my family.

The space is extremely clean and comfortable. It is beautifully decorated, and has more ammenities than you would expect!
I'd highly recommend this location to anyone looking for a comfortable accessable homebase when visiting Chicago!
Very responsive and helpful. We enjoyed the stay and would come back.
Responsive host, central location, overall a nice place
The house looks just like the photos. Every room was decorated beautifully and the house was cozy.
Had an amazing time! Host is very friendly and understanding; would book her again.

The place was easy to locate and get into initially. Then we had an issue with the number lock on the front of the door. I tried to reach out and do what was asked but the lock was never repaired. They wanted me to film what i was doing with this lock. They had a back door that also had a pad and we used that. We came in the next night and accidentally locked the bottom lock and that was an issue because now we couldn't get in either door. I messed with the front lock and  got in after 5 mins. The other issue with that back door is there is another door with just a standard doorhandle lock between the laundry room and this unit. We were startled because someone came in the back door with no notice. I brought this up and they don't see an issue because a door is there. Not if it's open and it was. Scared us pretty bad. Their response was it's a shared laundry room. No mat in the tub, toilet roll dispenser came off the wall glued on. Couch was uncomfortable, no coffee table, no pictures.
Incredible unit with an even better location! Would definitely come back next time we’re in town!
Jose is a great host. We had a very good time and he was super responsive. Public transportation was also very accessible. Thank you!!

Great place to stay! Beautiful accommodations and nice backyard area. We took Uber’s everywhere so didn’t get a feel for the neighborhood and wish we had more time to explore.
Only suggestions would be creamer in the unit and I was not able to get on Netflix even with my own account. I’d still go back!
Beautiful view. Very walkable neighborhood. The train is louder than expected.

We arrived in the early hours of the morning, and Gabriela gave us great suggestions for what we might find open in the neighborhood.
We loved our stay, especially the host’s generosity and the excellent condition of the house.
Highly recommend!

Estuvimos muy contentos en casa de Brad. Siempre muy atento y la casa tenía todos los servicios que publicaba.
La ubicación tiene cerca autobuses y tren, por lo que se comunica fácilmente con la ciudad en 20 min.

Es war sauber und schön, super Option für ein kleineres Budget. Mir war zu Beginn nicht bewusst dass es ein Haus mit vielen seperat vermieteten Zimmern ist, die sich 2 Bäder und die Küche teilen aber das war vielleicht mein Fehler und am Ende überhaupt kein Problem. Wahnsinnig nette Kommunikation, schnell erreichbar und sehr freundlich. Würde wieder hier wohnen.
Great stay
It was a great stay and very accommodating. He was very available and checked in to make sure we didn't have any issues. We would definitely book again!

Amir was very friendly and proactive in his messages to make sure we had all the information and services we needed. Nice quiet neighbourhood. Usually around a 25-30minute Uber to downtown areas. Cozy spot!
We had a great stay at this Airbnb. We were in town for a wedding so the location was perfect. The apartment was clean and spacious.
We had an amazing stay and it felt like home away from home..We'll definitely visit again
This place was perfect for our weekend stay in Chicago. The location was fantastic and the unit itself was very cute and clean and had a great view.

Awesome location and really responsive team! Really accommodating when one of us had our wallet stolen and needed his passport delivered to the hotel.
Also awesome complementary drinks and arcade games + pool table on the 26th floor rooftop bar
Free drinks Saturdays 3-7 during our stay, can’t beat that!!

Great location and a very convenient stay in Chicago! There was so much to see and do around the hotel, with plenty of attractions, restaurants, and shops within easy reach. The host was also very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Overall, we had a comfortable and enjoyable experience.
Nice place, great location!

This has become my new go-to for solo trips to Chicago. I wanted to live in the Beverly neighborhood when I was a kid—now with Chelsey & Gillian's comfortable and cozy listing I can do just that (for a few days at a time) when I come to the city.
Wonderful hosts and a lovely space (+ you can't beat the natural light pouring through the windows).

This 3 bedroom apt was perfect for my stay. The host was responsive and provided excellent directions for check in and check out. The area didn’t bother me however please understand the location is in the south side of Chicago which may be a downside to others . The home in itself was fairly clean outside of some rugs in the bedroom and some additional cleaning that could be done to the bathroom around the tub area and shelving. 4 stars for the above and the fact that the upstairs neighborhood did not respect quiet hours. It was constant yelling, arguing, screaming, running, and loud talking all morning, through out the day, and at night.

Do not hesitate to book Tatiana & Roupen’s beautiful apartment in Chicago! Their place is the perfect place to launch all of your Chicago adventures from. They will take great care of you: from excellent parking to recommendations to quick response times. Their instructions are clear and their listing is extremely accurate. The home is clean and safe. As a family of four we would not hesitate to book this home again!
Una estadía espectacular, la recomiendo de 100 de 10 Muy buen lugar y muy buena atención

The place needed a few repairs, but was very well taken care of otherwise and very clean. Getting in was confusing, and the only way in seemed to be from the back. Which required an alley that was away from parking. You can drive back to the parking lot, take your stuff in, then go park however. You may be able to pay to park in the rear lot, which would be convenient, but I didn't look into that. I got in late. You would probably be towed if you did not contact someone about paying. There were no cars parked there. Marjorie was very friendly and responsive.

Ewa was helpful and friendly. The room was clean and comfortable. The neighbourhood was quiet with a few good cafes and restaurants. Good bus access to busier districts and Chicago central. Great for my first trip to Chicago.
It was a really good stay. Thanks Mr. Bentley.

Great stay in Chicago! The Airbnb was conveniently located and within walking distance of plenty of restaurants, bars, and coffee shops. It was also a quick Uber ride to the West Loop, and having easy access to the train made getting around the city simple. The hosts were very responsive and provided helpful, detailed information that made check-in and our stay easy. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a convenient home base to explore Chicago!

There’s only a few photos for a reason. Home is outdated with outdated appliances. Lobby door does not lock and for the neighborhood it is in, that’s severely unsafe. There’s only one ac unit in the bedroom so beware of summer months. My husband and I checked out 5 minutes after checking in and was inappropriately compensated.

Great location, clean apartment, comfy bed. Cozy little place for one or two people for a couple days in a very walkable area near the brownline. Some people seemed bothered by the sound of the L; it was nice that the host provided earplugs. But I found the sound a peaceful whooshing sound and nothing compared to the blaring trains that come through my Ohio town.
One thing to note: The bathroom is in need of some TLC. Tub is clean but old and the drain is slow. The medicine cabinet/woodwork all has 80 coats of paint on it. And if you want more than dollar store shampoo and body wash, pack it or head down the street in search of better. No exhaust fan.
I would stay again if the tub drain issue was fixed.
Beautiful place, loved how it was in the middle of everywhere
Extremely fun place to stay, as long as you love the noise and are there to explore the music venue below

The place was exactly as shown in the photos. Our host was very responsive and provided all the instructions we needed to make our stay easy and comfortable. The bathroom, kitchen, and bedrooms were clean. The neighborhood felt safe and was not far from the city.
The only issue was parking. We usually got back home late at night, and it could take us some time to find a parking spot. Sometimes, we had to drive around and wait for someone to leave so we could occupy the space. Other than that, we had a great stay.
Location was amazing. With a great park and beach within walking distance, this place is a gem.
The rooms are comfortable. Bathroom and kitchen are spacious. Very convenient location for getting around.

Great host very responsive. As far as the overall location appearance & cleanliness, the place is great. When you get down to the actual experience, at least in the summer, that's where things take a turn. The bed was horrible, slept terrible every night. The place stayed humid constantly, despite the dehumidifier, always being on. There was no AC, just 2 fans, and they really didn't make a difference during the day. It wasn't until nighttime that the place began to cool down. But even that was short-lived.

Our stay here was great! Perfect location to get to coming right off the interstate. For the weekend, it was very simple using public transportation to get from place to place! The air bnb itself was very clean, and Hanna & Mark were very responsive. Highly recommend!
Great stay, perfect place to be. Close to the train making it easy to get around without a car. Would recommend.

Geo’s unit was fantastic, and he was such a friendly, responsive, and accommodating host. The space was great, and the location was perfect. I’d definitely recommend staying here if you’re looking for a comfortable place in a great location!

Great Place. Area was really nice. Great little cafe a couple of blocks away.  It was a nice quiet spot away from the hustle and bustle of the city, but close enough that a quick ride on the subway will take you right to the middle of it.

This was a great place for our weekend stay in Chicago. Check-in was easy and seamless. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Location was great - easy to get to everything. And when we checked out, the lockers were very convenient to store our bags while we took the architecture cruise the morning of departure.  Overall, we were very pleased with the property, the location, and the rental experience.
Great place, clean, near public transportation, and Leonid was helpful and friendly. Would return!

Was as described in description. Clean, easy to find, simple check in. Hosts were very responsive. Things to keep in mind if you’re not familiar with the location: a bit noisy especially on the weekend, and not much to do in the area. There are metal stairs outdoors leading to this apt which is located on the second floor; this wasn’t an issue for us but could be for others. Overall the place was very clean, affordable, and cozy! Would stay again!

Great brownstone apartment in the Roscoe Village mention Chicago. Very walkable to groceries, restaurants, multiple bus lines and the Brown Line. I was there 4 days and spent less than $20 on transportation on a Ventra card. If you are coming to town for a Cubs game, Wrigley isn’t far.
The apartment was clean and cozy. Was nice to have a full kitchen for cooking. A’isha was very communicative and gave great instructions on retrieving the key and opening the door (if you’ve ever lived in an old house/building, you know the doors can have quirks).
Very good place with a lot complementary items in the house. Highly recommended

The place was absolutely beautiful and very clean! The host was extremely nice, communicative, and accommodating throughout our entire stay. Checking in and out was super easy, and we didn’t have any issues at all.
The area was nice and quiet, which made the stay even more enjoyable. I also want to mention that we had no issues with flies or any unpleasant smells, despite seeing those concerns mentioned in a previous guest’s review. Everything was clean, fresh, and comfortable during our stay.
The host was very kind and appreciative and did everything possible to accommodate our needs and wants. Overall, we had a great experience and felt very welcomed.
10/10 — I would absolutely recommend this place and would definitely book again! 💜
This was perfect for our Chicago weekend.
Always a pleasure to stay at Lois and Eduardo’s lovely home. Extremely comfortable bed, easy access and impeccably clean and well appointed. Will definately return!! Thank you to our wonderful hosts.
Un lugar muy agradable y muy cómodo, venimos con mi familia y todos nos acomodamos muy bien.
Good launching pad for a stay in Chicago!
Great location. The unit felt spacious enough to comfortably fit four of us. Perfect for me weekend trip.
Very nice place and hosts
Milan was communicative and easy to work with.  We had a couple of minor issues and Milan addresses quickly and professionally.  Overall, a nice stay in a nice location just south of downtown.
It was an absolute delight to stay here. Really beautiful apartment and a super responsive host.
It was great stay and great location! We would definitely stay there again!

The apartment was exactly as described and looked just like the photos. The apartment is very walkable as well, with only a 10-minute walk to the Red Line. Bella was super responsive and helpful even when there were questions about little things.
Great place. Exactly as described, very clean and new. Can’t beat location in west loop.
Place is great and affordable. Would use accommodations again
We had a great stay! It was the perfect spot for a girls trip

Peters place was amazing. We had a wonderful stay. The place was just what we needed. The location was perfect and there was always parking available on the street. It’s also right around the corner from Cleo’s which everyone should try while you’re there. I will definitely check here first for my next Chicago trip.

Loved Nico's place: cute, clean, good beds, amazing location. Communication was great - lots of checking in on things and provided excellent food recommendations. Super each check-in and check-out. I definitely recommend and would stay there again!

A casually furnished, roomy studio. Easy to access and convenient location for our WestSide stay.
1st floor corner location does include all the typical street and neighbor activities expected in an urban apartment.
Great location for what we needed. Very clean and well appointed. Luisa was fantastic with communication.

I enjoyed my stay in wicker park! The neighborhood is very cute and walkable. My only complaint was how long it took to get to other parts of the city using public transit, which isn’t a reflection on Kyriako at all. Just something to keep in mind overall would definitely book this air bnb again!!
Patt is a great host!

Josh’s place was great to stay at, it’s a great location if you’re going for a cubs game. The place was very walkable, clean and accurately described. The place is located within steps to late bars and restaurants, but it was surprisingly quiet and we didn’t hear much and there was a game every night we stayed there. I would book again.
Highly recommend great location and beautiful interiors.

1.楼下是火车🚄必经之路、怕噪音的不建议入住
2. 在我完全不知情的情况下，我的一个访客被前台冷眼对待后发生了一些争执，导致我一小时内被无故赶出公寓。我觉得非常莫名其妙。房东对于此事的处理非常不给力，他完全没有保护租客，只听物业管理单面之词就把我这个不知情且无任何责任的租客在一小时内驱赶了出去。
3. 我们的所有快递都会被强拆，甚至于丢件。问询大楼管理员说是被房东的保洁员工拿走，至今未得到任何赔偿！
