Katie was a fantastic host. This Airbnb was in a great neighborhood. It was very walkable and close to all the things we wanted to do! The location was actually the perfect balance of a quiet and peaceful neighborhood only minutes from all the actions. We had everything we needed inside the Airbnb and it was wonderfully decorated. The beds were very comfortable and everything was clean and functional. 10/10 would recommend!l

Well stocked. Easily accessible to the sport complex. No troubles with parking. It is in the basement of a home, but that didn’t bother us. Minimal noise from upstairs. Neighborhood felt safe. I’d stay here again.

The stove leaked gas and we had to evacuate for the fire dept to come. Then, we had to wait for the gas co, who determined the stove could not be used as-is, disconnected it from the gas line and capped the gas line in the kitchen. We were without a stove for the majority of our stay. We needed to prepare foods for a family party and could not. It was stressful, inconvenient and expensive. Rosa was insensitive to the problem it posed and did not compensate us to our satisfaction. I would not stay in one of her units again.

Reception desk was EXTREMELY helpful, friendly and courteous. The hotel is currently going through renovations, which I was warned about ahead of time. What I didn’t know was that the passenger elevator was not in service. They said that it’s going to take a long time for that to be repaired. They did offer to make the service elevator available, and I took advantage of that for when I had to bring my luggage up and down from the fourth floor..
Great stay and a good location, lots of walkable places nearby.

Very nice place, clean and spacious.
The host was very responsive, helpful and laid out everything in a very timely manner.
Thanks for making the visit easy for us
We had a great time! I would def recommend :)
Safe,clean,and nice location definitely recommend!

Brad was a great host! He was extremely fast at responding to any of my messages and gave great food suggestions as well that we tried! The place was just as he described and very very clean. Will defiantly stay with him next time we are in Chicago!
My mom and I enjoyed our stay. The place was as described and Charlie was a great host!

Great place! The house was very clean and had tons of room for the 9 people we had. Very walkable area with several nearby restaurants and such. No issues with parking, there was always a spot open right in front. Would definitely come back if/when we do another Chicago trip!

Great stay that felt very comfortable and safe for us on our vacation. It had everything we needed for a group of 5 and we particularly loved the beds (super comfy). A little south of everything we wanted to see,.but nothing too far using Uber or public transit. Would definitely recommend to others!

We really enjoyed entering the vestibule before entering the home to writings on the walls. In fact we read for minutes before even entering the home. The home was very welcoming. Very clean.
We loved the walkable surrounding bars, restaurants, coffee shops and convenience stores. Not once were we concerned of the neighborhood even while walking late and night and into the early morning. We met some very cool people and they treated us with kindness.
We were in town for a concert and using ride share transportation made getting around easy.
We will come back and we plan to stay at this home again.
We enjoyed our visit and this place was a great location.  We managed to lock ourselves out one day.  There bought a key for entry within 10 minutes.  Very responsive hosts.
The place was spacious and bigger than the pictures revealed. It was cleaned and located in a great area.
Great value.  Emily's home is exactly what we needed for our stay in Chicago.

Blanca was a great host, very friendly and always responded in a timely matter. The apartment is perfect for a small group. The train is kind of noisy if you’re not used to it and very proximity to neighbors.
Loved our stay here! Very timely, responsive, and accommodating host who made us feel welcome. Would love to stay here again!

We were celebrating 50th birthday of our friends. We stayed in 2 units for our group of 8. It was perfect. Great location, walkable. Unit comes with a parking spot, which is awesome in the city. Very responsive host.
I would happily stay here again! Def. a recommendation!!
This place was a great, clean, budget option in an excellent location. I was a little nervous about safety in Chicago, but overall I felt safe here. I had a wonderful stay!

My wife and I enjoyed staying at this place. Spacious and warm and felt safe. We really didnt utilize all that there was to offer since our friend lived within walking distance which was great! We felt comfortable and all the amenities were on point. Great neighborhood and coffee shops within walking distance!
Only suggestion I would make is for a larger fan in the bedroom during the warmer months. The new split AC/Heater in the living room is great for the whole space but it got warm at night in the bedroom. Overall, would highly recommend anyone to this place. This would be on our shortlist of return AirBnb.

Great to have reserved indoor parking.
Nice place with plenty of room!
Responsive, helpful host.
In the heart of a vibrant neighborhood with many restaurant, bar, and shop choices. In the middle of Summer, the neighborhood stays up late, and the enjoyment is audible in the apartment.
Natalia’s place was very charming and extremely clean.  The thoughtful touches were noticed.  Natalia communicated well and was always available if needed.

What a beautiful Chicago apartment. I wish I could move in; I felt so at home - did not want to leave. The decor is perfect; the place is immaculate. It will be my go-to place when I am visiting the area!
Great week in a great location! Very comfortable, lots of space, and unbeatable access to public transit.
Clean, comfortable spot in a great neighborhood. Would definitely stay again!
Great place to stay.

It is an ok ish place which is not quite ready yet. The bed in the second bedroom is so high and my parents couldn’t get in. Jamaal was friendly enough to provide a step ladder to get into the bed, I will give him a credit for that for being responsive and understanding.

asked to possibly check in as early as possible, was told no. i assumed to make sure cleaners had proper time to clean room...still booked room despite the request denied cuz room looked great.
got to room after 9hrs roaming down town, and room was dirty: hairs on dresser, in shower, short curlies on top of dresser, hairs & stains on beds, no bedding on the beds.
contacted hosts, took 2hrs to get cleaners to the room, would randomly check in to see of any progress and communication would take longer.
the last night there was a guy yelling from the balcony in the bldg around 11p
next time id rather spend $50/night xtra and stay in a nice hotel
Couldn't have picked a better spot to stay! Thank you for making us feel welcome!
We had a great stay and they were very helpful!

This location is great for any stay in Chicago, whether it is a Cubs game or just visiting for a weekend of fun.  Scott is an absolutely amazing host wanting to make sure our trip was perfect and is very knowledgeable about Chicago.  This place is perfect for a family or group of friends, was extraordinarily clean, and is conveniently located around tons of bars, restaurants, and Cubs games.  Getting to the L is super easy so really going anywhere in Chicago is convenient.  Will definitely remember this place and will be staying again.  Thank you Scott!
Lovely place

We had a great time staying at Ross' place! The location is perfect: walkable and hip and easy distance to the blue line. The space is large and comfortable with lots of natural light. We didn't end up spending that much time on the roof but the view is great at night. They did a good job with supplies and amenities - lots of clean towels, shampoo and conditioner in the showers, etc. If you're coming to Chicago and have a group of 4 or 5 guests, I recommend staying here.
Very clean, super sweet and great response time
Sleeping arrangements were good. Unit was very clean. Some train noise. Quiet location. Was a great space for our family and conveniently close location to the train.

Ken's place was absolutely amazing and exceeded our expectations based on photos! You can tell they take pride in this home and the decor is so fun and interesting!!
Overall, we had an amazing stay and experience in Chicago! The neighborhood was great with lots to do. I will say it is a bit of a drive to downtown, which we didn't mind but it can add up in Ubers if you're traveling closer to downtown often!
Our entire group would definitely stay at Ken's place if we were visiting Chicago in the future!
Simple easy check in street parking was good.
Fun weekend excursion in Chicago- great host and location to see the city!

Leslie’s place was perfect for our family. Comfortable and clean with super nice touches to make it fun. The neighborhood was quiet and so easy to park in. We also could easily get downtown or anywhere we needed. Leslie was responsive and kind to us. I liked that the home wasn’t sterile but was actually decorated too. Made it much more comfortable.

Sergio was very responsive. He made everything very clear from the area to the rules. If you are concerned about safety, reconsider. But if you're needing quick sleep and not going to be in, it's fine. I was there for a concert at United Center so it was perfect for me.

Nice place.   Easy walk to a market, a couple different restaurants, the liquor store, a coffee shop, the Gym, and a drug store.   Adding the parking space is recommended.   Host was quick to respond to a couple questions that came up.   Enjoyed my stay!!!

We had a great stay!  We were in town for a concert at Solder Field & the location was perfect!   Place was clean & quiet.  I just want to mention the a/c is a shared unit.  Which I was worried about.  But the host was fabulous at working w/ me & ensured our stay was comfortable.  Def recommend.
We had a wonderful stay and the Staywell team was incredibly responsive and proactive with accommodations the entirety of our trip.
Great place!
I had a great time at this spot. Just needed somewhere to sleep close to the city and it fit the bill Jeannette was very responsive and the place was very clean.
This was a beautiful home to stay at. We had a lot of space and it wasn’t too hard to find. The neighbors were also very friendly.
great place to stay a few nights!
The place was great! Excellent location and really helpful host!

I had a great time in Bernard’s beautifully-decorated space. The home and suite looked lovely in pictures, but they were even better in person.
This suite was more affordable for me than almost any other option with a private bathroom, and the walk to public transit wasn’t bad at all (very close to the 47 bus, which takes you to the L and Midway—otherwise, about a 10/15 min walk to the green line). Additionally, I was nervous to share a common space, but the privacy and my ability to come and go as I pleased were both great!
I would highly recommend staying here!
Overall, we were happy with our stay. The house was updated nicely and as described. Rich was responsive when we reached out.

Très bien situé, à proximité des transports en commun.
En revanche, l’expérience a été très mauvaise. L’appartement est très mal isolé et on entend le métro comme s’il passait littéralement à l’intérieur de l’appartement. De plus, le logement était sale et, surtout, il n’y avait pas d’eau chaude. Malgré avoir contacté le propriétaire et malgré le fait qu’il était censé avoir réglé le problème, nous n’avons jamais eu d’eau chaude.
Il y avait également beaucoup de bruit et les ventilateurs étaient très bruyants.
Je ne reviendrai jamais dans cet endroit.

We had a great stay here! It was large with plenty of space to sprawl out. My kids loved looking at all the little Knick knacks and the kitchen was fully stocked with things you’d need for cooking. We loved the large couch!

Very nice and peaceful place close to several nice neighborhoods including wicker park. Price was great for the space and location! only thing was that the door was unlocked when we arrived which seemed kind of strange and there was some trash that forgot to be thrown away, but was overall very clean. parking situation was also easy peasy. would totally stay again!!!

The apartment was perfect for our family to stay in while visiting. Everything is clean,  the space is beautiful and spacious, and the views incredible.  It’s a relaxing oasis after a long day. You’re within walking distance to many areas and can use trains, buses or Ubers for the rest. There are many amenities included with the building to take advantage of  like the washer/dryer, huge private patio, and the 5th floor gym and courtyard.  The surrounding neighborhood is cute too. There are a couple things that could be fixed, but it would never dissuade me from staying again. (The banister was loose in one spot and the living room tv had a crack in the corner- we’re not a tv family so we didn’t even turn it on, so not a bother for us.)   (Plus, there were TVs in every bedroom as well.) This place is fabulous and I would highly recommend.
Perfect location and host will be back next year

Such an amazing stay in Chicago. The condo and building were exactly as described. So close to everything downtown.  Lester was an amazing host . Very responsive and friendly.  If you are looking for a great stay in Chicago this is the spot!  Thank you again Lester for everything !
We had a great stay! Great amenities, clean and we loved the themed rooms and theater!

We had an absolutely lovely time! Worked for us! Loved being able to walk to the metra station to get into chicago! Everything was nice and clean, and lots of extra towels and blankets. I would 100% book with her again!

We had a wonderful stay at Fabio and Nancy’s Airbnb! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Fabio and Nancy were great hosts—friendly, responsive, and made the entire experience easy from check-in to check-out. We felt very welcomed and had everything we needed during our stay. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend their place to anyone visiting the area. Thank you, Fabio and Nancy, for a great stay! ❤️

Dream stay - home was pristine and Drea was extremely responsive. Everything was amazing: the keypad always worked, parking was easy, jacuzzi was divine, fresh eggs, strong coffee, and home-grown tomatoes. Drea was kind and helpful. Outdoor space was also beautiful. I would highly recommend staying here.
Easy check in and super responsive host
This place was clean and nice as described. Also, there are lots of stores and restaurants to visit nearby. The host was responsive to request and followed up during my stay.
It was good overall

A no frills, cost effective option close to downtown. The room was small but delivered exactly what was advertised. I had an issue checking in but Genova was communicative and took care of it as soon as she was made aware. A solid choice if you're looking for a convenient, budget friendly spot and don't need much space.
Really great spot

Nico's place was great. We were 5 adults, a child, and an infant. We were very comfy in the unit. We didn't use the kitchen but it was well equipped for cooking during a longer stay. Having two bathrooms made morning routines quick and easy. The beds were comfy and warm. This clean and sunny apartment will be a nice place to stay for future visits.
A great spot for our girls weekend. Great location and very clean!

We had a great stay at Emily’s Airbnb! It was exactly as pictured and very comfortable for our group of 5 girls. The area is perfect, less than a block away from a ton of restaurants, coffee shops, etc and offers easy accessibility to explore other Chicago neighborhoods. Would definitely recommend this place!

Great spot directly across Millennium Park. Every outdoor excursion within the vicinity has delicious restaurants, cafes, and metro stations within walking distance. Highly recommend for anyone seeking an urban, metropolitan experience amongst Chicago residents. The roof top terrace is also a grand vista along the Lake Michigan and surrounding high rises 🌅🏙️🎡
Nice stay overall
The area is very busy but the apt was peaceful and very nice.  Stacey very responsive .

Things to note:
You do not have control over the thermastat so if youre sleeping with someone that runs hot, you will sweat staying here in the summer. We even brought an extra fan.
If youre over a certain height you will bonk your head at least once inside of the apartment but the listing does warn you of short ceilings.
The path from gate to door will have dog poop that you will need to look out for each time you come and go.
There is no brita for water so bring your own.
There are also no wash clothes provided.
Place is exactly how it appears in photos, it was clean, and parking was easy! Host was responsive and we would absolutwly come back knowing what we know now to be more prepared.

Everything was perfect about this stay. The host communicated well, she was very sweet and everything was exactly as she described. The neighborhood was cute and everyone was very friendly. The place is located near many stores, shops and markets which made getting the supplies we needed, very easy.
It’s a 5/10 minute walk from the Pink Line and there were many bus stops around so we were able to get anywhere we needed to go, quickly and easily.
This was a perfect place for a girls trip with my best friend. I would definitely stay here again if it’s available for my future Chicago visits.

The Cloud9 team made renting and staying in this home very enjoyable.
They team is always avialble to answer questions at any time of the day.
Check-in was effortless: Show ID, get keys, headstone the apartment unit.
The unit was in a very nice area of Gold Coast. It was neat, beautiful and welcoming!
Check out was easily as effortless.
Despite having a very good reason to withhold part of my security deposit, Cloud9 extended me some grace and refunded my full deposit within 48 hours. Wow.. In today's world where everyone is trying to squeeze more out of customers, I wasn't expecting this level of kindness and integrity from a business. However, I welcome it!
Thank you team Cloud 9! I will choose you again if I am ever in Chicago.
Perfect accommodations for a short stay!  Woods was very responsive and allowed us to ship some packages here.  House was beautiful as described!
i enjoyed my stay so much! clear instructions for everything and friendly communication. would recommend!

The place looks exactly like the pictures. However, there are a few things that should be pointed out. First, two of the bedrooms upstairs are fairly warm, even with the AC running. There are ceiling fans, but we found it to be hot. Second, I spotted roaches in the kitchen. When I shared a picture and video with the host, he denied it as if what I sent wasn't real. I would have expected him to apologize and say that he would send out an exterminator. Instead, he was rude and combative. Third, you have to play around with the shower handles to get hot water. In short, hot means cold, and cold means hot. Not a big deal, but it would have been nice to know this ahead of time instead of having to figure out the issue. Finally, you must access the place through the alley, which feels unsafe in Chicago.
The worst part was simply the communication and the way we were treated. The host wasn't kind at all, which was frustrating at times. I wouldn't recommend simply because of his attitude.
Great spot, convenient location next to Soldier field and the L train. Would definitely recommend!

We had an amazing stay in Chicago. We were close to public transit, which made all the local attractions very accessible. The living space was very comfortable and we appreciated how attentive Laura was to ensure we had what we needed. We would definitely stay here again!
Host was very responsive and place was close to all the spots.
Great place across from Wrigley. Clean with all amenities listed and 1 parking spot. Easily walkable to great restaurants nearby. Would definitely stay again!

While we had an overall unproblematic stay, unfortunately, we were not completely in love with the condo. Troy was such a great host, I hate leaving negative feedback, but also want to provide an honest review. The condo looked like the photos, but in person, it felt different. The photos may have been enhanced, as the space appeared a bit more updated and polished online than in person. The living room rug was noticeably dirty, and the floors were sticky and extremely squeaky—even when walking lightly, it was loud enough to wake everyone when needing the bathroom during the night. Bedding also wasn’t ideal, as there were no flat sheets on the beds. Older home also overshadowed nicer touches. While we did not experience any issues in the neighborhood, there was quite a bit of noise throughout the night, including cars playing loud music and other noises. I honestly feel that with a newer property and more desirable neighborhood, Troy would be phenomenal host. Hope he continues hosting!
Beautiful Airbnb and in a perfect location in west loop. Walkable to Fulton market and all the restaurants/bars in the area. 24/7 door staff. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay in Chicago!
Excellent unit! Very clean! Walkable to restaurants and Whole Foods! Would definitely stay again!
We had a great stay in a safe and quiet Chicago neighborhood!

My group and I really enjoyed our stay in the Florence Room. Ryan sent us very clear instructions on check-in and it was very easy to get in for the first time. He was accommodating when we told him of our unexpected early arrival and luckily we were able to check in early and relax in the room. The inside of the house had a lot of character and was well-kept in our room and in common spaces. I liked how close we were to bus stops and train stations. It made it very easy for us to travel to Chicago and enjoy the sights. The room was well air conditioned and there was plenty of space for us to leave our belongings. I felt safe there. I would stay here again if I plan to be in the area!
Great experience and host

We had such a great stay! It was the perfect size for our large group to both spread out and enjoy the large gathering spaces. We loved the kitchen in particular, which was well equipped to cook meals.

This was my 1st experience staying at an AirB. But, Daniel was so genuinely cool and laid back he made us feel welcomed!!!
Make sure you read " leave shoes outside door" . My apologies, Daniel after we came back in after our outing , I went over the agreement again, I immediately jumped up and put our shoes outside the door, the floors are freaking beautiful!
Thank you, again

Sandy and Shama, were the most incredible host and the place was beautiful to stay in. The location was not. Street violence, a four person gang of men going through the neighborhood checking car doors, and finally robbing a vehicle parked next to the Airbnb. Violent street fight two of three nights, and the next door neighbor and neighbor across the street played loud music all Saturday night until 6 am Sunday morning. It appeared intentional, and they may have issues with the Airbnb being next to their property. Called 911 about the car theft and 311 about the noise, but little response from the Chicago PD. The Neighborhood is undergoing a transformation, and Sandy will have an incredible Airbnb once the full transformation occurs. As former member of law enforcement, I did not feel safe for my family, nor for my vehicle, which could not fit in the garage. Again, incredibly beautiful place, but please way the numerous risks, which are out of the control of the owners.

Atlas’s place was exactly as pictures are showing. The house was clean. The linens were clean and they had clean towels in each room. It was well equipped with everything we needed. More importantly for me was that he was so hospitable, accommodating and responsive. I liked that he didn’t force any insurance or deposit or any of these kind of new trends I see some hosts are requiring. The neighborhood was quiet and safe which was another important factor for me. Overall, I would go back if I was in Chicago again and would recommend this place!

This is most definitely a great Airbnb! The Airbnb looked just like the photos. The space was very clean and has easy access to the train station to go downtown Chicago. Beds are very spacious and soft also. There are two bathrooms at the property which was really helpful for when my friends and I were getting ready. My only thing is maybe adding some more counter space in the bathroom areas, that did make it a little challenging to get ready.

The apartment is conveniently located within walking distance of the Belmont Blue Line station, with easy access to O’Hare. The unit itself was clean and spacious.
However, I had a significant concern regarding privacy and communication during my stay. The host did not disclose that the property was currently listed for sale and that potential buyers might be scheduled to view the unit during my stay.
I only became aware of this when the property owner unexpectedly knocked on my door several times while I was on a conference call. I had to interrupt my meeting to answer the door and was then asked to allow a prospective buyer to view my room while I was still on the call.
I found this situation unprofessional and intrusive, particularly because there had been no prior communication or notice about property viewings. It also raised concerns about whether prospective buyers or others might have been allowed into the room while I was away, with my personal belongings inside.
Great home in the perfect location.

Apartment was nice, everything was clean and the AC already running when we arrived was appreciated.  We were also grateful for the coffee and creamers that were there for our early morning starts.  Only warning, which is nothing the host can do anything about, is the apartment is on 4th floor and the elevator was broken the entire time we were there. Stairwell was wide with decent size landings if a break is needed going up or down.

The place was in a great walkable location to several popular restaurants and bars, very comfortable and felt extremely safe. Our hostess was highly communicative and the space was perfect for our stay!

Matthew's space was exactly what we were looking for to celebrate our friend getting married. Location was ideal for getting around and just minutes away from the Logan Square Blue Line.
We had the greatest time!
Excellent location, major plus for the rooftop patio! Clean space and great communication from the hosts.
Right next to the train. Very noisy.
Kate is very responsive and helpful. The place is clean and spacious. Plenty of recommendations and guides to help plan and find things to do.  Location is great, plenty of cute shops and cafes.

Excellent stay for 3 of us at Russ’s place. Beautifully and thoughtfully decorated, even better than the pictures. Chilled wine, lit candle, and snacks waiting for us. Russ was very responsive and the neighborhood was perfect situated 15 minutes from the Blue Line to the airport or downtown, with many great recommendations for coffee, cocktails, food and to do’s. Place was quiet and ideally located between Avondale and Logan Square.
I’ve stayed here before and it’s very close to a lot cool places.   I will stay again!!

If you're comfortable walking it's a great location and a nice convenience store just around the corner with lots of drinks and grocery necessities. The gameroom is disappointing and not as nice as the pictures. That and the rooftop patio are  inconvenient to get to.  The couch isn't ideal to sleep on but worked fine for teenagers. Good communication, very quick replies. The fridge leaked on the floor but worked well. The dishwasher leaked a lot and was unusable. They did offer to have someone come look at them. We declined, but hopefully they were fixed after our stay.  Overall, nice place.
Great communication, I recommend the place. Clean and orderly
Great air bnb!
Amazing stay overall! Very responsive host and everything was as listed.
It was amazing!

Location was good and was about a 7 minute walk to the train(easy transportation access). Had to park on the street but didn’t have any problems. Brand new everything and very nice and clean. Only complaint is we shared the same wall with others that showed up at 3am and they were very upset so we heard them yelling for hours.

Jacob was very responsive and answered all our questions quickly. We had one small maintaince issue, no fault of the host at all, and it was resolved quickly.
The home was spacious and had all the amenities we needed for our trip. The two full living areas were perfect to spread out in and enjoy the trip.
We went with two other couples and one child and had no issues finding the home, or walking to the pink line or surrounding bus stops to visit other locations.
Had convenient free parking behind the home, big enough for 2 cars. We would definitely stay here again the next time we go to Chicago.
我認為這間房源整體來說非常的好、乾淨且漂亮。距離地鐵站非常靠近因此交通很方便。最讓人感動的是他們團隊非常及時的讓我在離開芝加哥前拿到我遺忘在房間的耳機，這幫了我大忙，由衷感謝他們的協助！

Staying with Carole was an absolute pleasure. The space was excellent and was exactly as described. The location and views from the room were also spectacular. She was extremely responsive and very thorough with her communications and was a pleasure to work with when we had to adjust the reservation. I would highly recommend staying anywhere with Carole and her team! Thanks for a great experience!
This was a great stay! It was cozy and super clean. The host was very communicative and quick to respond. Loved it!

Unfortunately, we were very disappointed with this stay. The overall cleanliness of the unit was not acceptable. The bathroom was dirty, the shower curtain had visible mould on it, and most concerning, we found cockroaches inside the unit during our stay. We have photos documenting what we found. We were also extremely concerned about our luggage, belongings and personal vehicle and the possibility of bringing pests back to three separate homes.
When we reported the pest issue to the host, it took almost 12 hours to receive a response. The host did acknowledge the cockroach problem and refunded a portion of our stay, which we appreciated. However, we did not feel the amount was sufficient considering three adults had stayed in the unit with cockroaches and then had to take precautions with everything we brought home.
I do want to mention one positive: the neighbourhood itself was safe and friendly. We felt comfortable in the area and had no concerns about the location.
Great place. Loved our stay.
Our family enjoyed the stay.
Top tier
This place was absolutely spotless! It’s the perfect size for a solo traveler or a couple. Everything felt brand new, pristine, and well-cared-for. Super comfortable stay—I’d definitely book again!
We really enjoyed our stay.  Eduardo was a great host

I like that the bedrooms are on opposite ends of the unit. Location was pretty great -less than a block from Wrigley and we didn’t have an issue with noise. This is a basement dwelling so if you’re sensitive to damp, stale scent, this might not work for you despite the air filter machines they have set up. Also check-out is earlier than other places. They were flexible with us but we had to pay an extra $50. The hosts are super responsive. I would consider staying again but the overall rate would have to significantly drop.
Very nice!
Will be back!
Definitely recommend!

I am not exaggerating when I say this place is absolute perfection! 8 of us stayed here for a bachelor party and it was the best place our friend group has ever stayed in. Location is awesome. You’re walkable to everything but you feel like you’re in your own little, quiet neighborhood. The space was massive with so many great amenities , games , beds and little touches that went above and beyond. Katie was so proactive , responsive and delightful. If we ever go back to Chicago , this is the place we’re staying.

Quinton’s place was perfect for the four of us. It was super clean and comfy. Quinton was very responsive…. He even helped us out when we locked ourselves out 😂.  I would stay here time and time again
The space was very clean and comfortable and was everything we needed. Tamara provided us with all the information we needed and was very responsive. I would stay here again!

The listing says the whole entire house, well surprise it’s not the house your renting it’s a small small basement. They live in the house above and if you like dogs barking throughout the night and loud walking above as they put you in a ver small u to below them. My co worker left early as she couldn’t stand the noise and couldn’t sleep. I left a day early as well. $1000 for three nights and it was not worth it as again you see the pictures and it’s mostly the house you think you’re get.
Toilet had urine and toilet paper in it. They kept walking into the area of my front door so there was no privacy whatsoever.
It’s by a really loud intersection too.
They also have a camera in the laundry room in the house where my door is. Not listed and no privacy at all.
One night I was outside and the owner came out with only boxer shorts on, then went back in. So strange. That’s when I decided to leave the next day and call Airbnb who is now investigating.

Isabel’s place was as pictured and described.  As mentioned in other reviews, you can hear the upstairs tenant which wasn’t a problem for me but it was for my friend who is a light sleeper. Upstairs noise is mostly over the first bedroom. Other than that, the apartment was incredibly clean. We spent most of our time in the living room. Beds were comfortable and the little signs/directions throughout the house were a nice touch/reminder of things to do before check out. Would stay again.
Close to transportation, host was very responsive and everything was clean. Thank you!

Super convenient location, with bus stops right down the street that easily get you to the blue line. Feven was flexible on early check in, and the house was extremely clean. I would happily stay here again with a large group. There was plenty of room for our group of 8.
Nice clean apartment and neighborhood. We went for the weekend for a foo fighters concert and it was as advertised.

I had a great stay here and would absolutely recommend it for anyone looking for an affordable place in a prime location near Wrigley Field. It’s definitely not fancy, but the photos are very accurate to what you get, so there were no surprises.
You have your own private bedroom with a lock, and there are three rental bedrooms total that share the common living space and one bathroom. It has a little bit of a hostel-style feel because of the shared spaces, but with the added privacy of having your own locked bedroom.
The host was very friendly, responsive, and easy to communicate with. I was really only looking for a safe, quiet place to sleep and shower since I was out exploring Chicago all day, and I didn’t want to spend a lot of money on accommodations I wasn’t going to use. For that, this place was perfect.
It was surprisingly quiet, I felt completely safe, and you really can’t beat the location for the price. I would definitely stay here again.

Tel bel appartement proposé par Kristin.
Avec nos enfants, nous avons passé un agréable séjour.
À 5-7 minutes à pied du métro et dans un quartier très calme

This place worked out great as our little hub in the city for a weekend family wedding. Convenient location, plenty of sleeping. Everything seemed to work fine. Clear instructions for entry and felt safe.
Great location and perfect place for two to stay! We also loved getting to see Bella the dog.

Very responsive host and willing to help quickly and efficiently if you have any questions. Very clean!!
Beautiful, urban, safe area. Very walkable and lots of shops nearby!

This was a great stay. The photos are accurate, host responsive, lots of stuff to do. We felt safe, welcomed, and well-serviced. Recommendations for local places were great and easy to walk to. Highly recommend.
Super sweet people and great communication! Perfect blend of privacy and availability when you need them!
Julian was awesome! He was super helpful and when one of the smoke detectors started going off because the batteries were dead he brought us replacements!

Honestly one of the best places I've stayed at!
Petra was so helpful from the moment I booked.
Everything was clean, comfortable, and packed with great amenities/fresh towels, clean sheets, coffee, microwave, mini fridge, and even a washer and dryer.
The location is super convenient with plenty of options nearby. There's a neighborhood tavern right nearby, along with Dunkin and a shopping strip just a couple of blocks down all super easy to get to on foot or by scooter.
You can hear some footsteps from upstairs since it's a lower-level space, but it didn't bother me at all, just worth noting if you're an ultra-sensitive sleeper. I will definitely stay here again anytime I'm back in Chicago!

Dawn’s home was very clean and comfortable with more than enough towels, blankets, space for my friends and I. The location is safe and walking distance to so many things. They included personal touches like coffee/tea, water, etc. everything was well thought out and was the perfect place for our girls trip!

Charley's place is in a good location. It was very convenient from the airport (red line to a bus) and a 15 minute walk from the brown line.  The AC worked well. Charley was a gracious host and had lots of local recommendations.  An issue arose during our stay and Charley dealt with it perfectly.  I would recommend this host and listing.

We really enjoyed staying at Dasha and Owen's place. It was very clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We also appreciated how proactive they were with communication throughout our stay.
The only thing to consider is the location if you're a first-time visitor hoping to be close to the main attractions. You'll need to take at least one bus to reach the nearest train, and from there it's about 30-45 minutes downtown. This was clearly noted in the listing description, so no surprises, but it's worth planning for if you're trying to pack a lot into a short trip.
That said, we'd absolutely stay here again, just with the extra travel time factored in.

The house was easy to find, safe, clean, and cute.
The neighborhood was very cute with lots of places within walking distance.
Our stay was everything we expected and more. The host was very proactive and responsive. We had everything we needed when we arrived and checkout instructions were easy to follow
Great place and close to everything in the city.
Was here for Market Days and Mary’s place was a beautiful place to stay it felt like home. the beds were so cozy and I loved how everything was walkable. 10/10 would definitely book again.
Definitely going to come  back loved the area ! Super clean place everything was perfect!
The host was accommodating with updating our reservation guest count. The Airbnb was clean, in a good location and very easy to access. Would 100% recommend staying here for groups!

This is a remarkable space. Comfortable and private yet clear there would be support as needed.
The furnishings and amenities are first rate and well stocked. Everything is clean and operable.
Parking is easy and near.

We had a great birthday trip weekend because of our stay! TJ and Hannah were extremely responsive to us and answered any questions we had quickly and confidently both before during and after the trip. They let us know we would have towels to use and answered all our questions about parking. Check-in was easy once you found the right place to enter! The place was exactly as advertised and perfect for our group of 6. When we first got to the Airbnb there was a smell of cigarette smoke- we let the hosts know and they quickly responded letting us know it was the neighbors and told us they would talk to them about it. They did so immediately and we had no other issues the entire time! In general it was very clean, enjoyable and we really enjoyed how nice the space was set up, how communicative the hosts were, and especially how well the AC worked and the surrounding area. Would definitely come back and recommend!!!
The location was incredible! The place was neat and well laid out. There were a few hiccups but the owner’s were responsive to every problem.

Great stay! The room is very clean and cozy; Carlton is very friendly and approachable, and also very responsive to messages!
If you have any question just ask her!
Really nice spot and a cozy apartment, I would recommend using the pullout couch over the bed but all in all an amazing stay!!
All as expected. Clear instructions. Nice space.
We had a great stay. Loved the location!
Great place and great neighborhood for a great price. We enjoyed the location—easily walkable to get to the L and downtown.
Cory’s place was great! It was very clean and cute. The neighborhood was very walkable with great bars and restaurants. Cory was responsive and kind. Highly recommend his place!

Wynter was nothing short of amazing! By far, one of the best hosts I’ve had on Airbnb. From the moment I made my reservation, we started communicating right away, and she was consistently quick and responsive throughout my entire stay.
I requested an early check-in, and she went above and beyond to make it happen. When I arrived, the instructions were clear and easy to follow. I also asked if she could provide some extra blankets for the guest staying with me, and she showed up with a brand-new comforter!
The unit itself was cozy, clean, and exactly as described. The location was great—I felt safe, the neighborhood was quiet, and it was conveniently close to downtown.
Wynter was incredibly accommodating, thoughtful, and attentive. The next time I’m back in town, I will definitely be staying here again! Highly recommend!

The location is absolutely amazing! Which is why I booked it to begin with. Josh was very very responsive.
Buried in the rules is the rooftop is $100 extra per day which I totally missed. Weird since that’s the main photo.
Check in with and parking our car was a mess. I misunderstood how to park and the game situation having all the roads closed off. But that was my fault but still super difficult situation to navigate.
The unit is OLD! I knew it was old but hard to explain how old with areas of hardwoods I seriously thought I would fell through. Rust in bathroom and peeling paint in bath. Kitchen does not have any cooking frying pans. Makes simple things like eggs hard. No wine glasses. No spachela etc. but had tons of cooking pots and random dishes. We tried our best to make it work.
Also very loud because the location is epic. And the building is old. So the windows are thin and you can hear every conversation on the street all night.
Parking spot is a great benefit in the area. Everything was as described and Mike was very helpful.

There were 5 of us in our party and the house was perfect! The home was spacious and clean. The location was accessible and close to local neighborhood restaurants but far enough away so it was quiet. A good time was had by all!

The location was great!! The apartment was very clean and comfortable. The host was very responsive and gave us all the detailed instructions to find the building. I’d definitely stay here next time I visit Chicago.  :)

Liz and Martin's place was perfect for a couple on a week long getaway. They were very responsive to requests we had and the location was incredible. Just a few minutes of walking and you have a plethora of great restaurants and cafes, plus the blue line and bus stops are just as close. We went all over the city with no need for a car from the museums to a Cubs game to restaurants in West loop and more. The place is quiet and feels private with a beautiful, serene back yard. My wife and I both agreed that the next time we go to Chicago, this will be the first place we check for availability.
Jacqueline’s apartment was great for our group of 5. Very walkable to tons of restaurants and bars, and conveniently off the Blue Line. Would stay again!
Super convenient location, a 5 minute walk to the L. Just like the pics, pristine & clean. Jake was super responsive & helpful, lots of great restaurants close by. Definitely would stay there again!

This place was comfortable and quirky with a 70s vibe.  We were able to spread out and relax when we weren't out and about with our family.  Regarding value for the price, it was more than we wanted to spend, but it was competitive with other places within the part of town we wanted to stay.  There was a little glitch with the keyless entry, but Alma responded quickly and helped us get in right away.  Overall, a good place that we would use again.
Had a lovely stay here while in town for a good friend’s wedding. The room was clean, very comfortable, and had everything we needed. Caryl was a kind host who ensured the whole stay was seamless.
Weihong’s place was just as described and perfect for a quick trip to Chicago for a concert at Soldier Field.
Location is bland with nothing around, mostly 40 mins from downtown with constant traffic, and a little smaller than expected.
I would definitely stay here again.

Stop scrolling! This place is SO cute and great for a variety of traveler combos. The split floor plan is the perfect layout and we felt right at home in the modern, stylish unit. Loved having the patio! The neighborhood is lovely and very walkable. We will absolutely stay again!

This was an overall good experience for our short trip to Chicago. Although the parking wasn’t necessarily as advertised and it would’ve been great to have been given a heads up about the Saturday event, we would recommend this stay to others. I would caution anyone with a bad back that the main bedroom bed is not great.

We had a great stay in Unit 205. It was very well located to bus stops, walkable to Soldier Field, a great little coffee shop was walkable. We were missing bedding for the provided air mattress and towels for 2 of our guests. We messaged Milan and even though it was later at night she was very responsive and we had bedding and towels delivered to our door within 15-20 minutes. The kitchen is well stocked and loved the effortless checkout. Would recommend to someone needing a place in Chicago.

Our weekend here was the same price as one night in a suite at a hotel downtown would have been, and we are so glad that we stayed here! Comfortable, spacious, awesome amenities - perfect spot for our group!
nice and peaceful area if you’re visiting chicago for a few days… wifi was kind of bad.
What a great place! It’s spacious, clean, and a great location! The host was great, responsive, and extremely friendly. Bonus, had some frequent hens visitors outside the kitchen window. Too cute!
Great place

This was the perfect place to stay for my girls trip! The location is great and convenient to walk to many things in Logan Square. I wish the beds were bigger as they seemed more like full size than queen, but we still fit 2 people in a bed and made it work. Matt's communication was excellent and made it very simple to find and access the unit, and the garage parking spot is a HUGE plus in the city. Would definitely stay again!

Our large family stayed for a wedding. Uber transportation into the city was very convenient and reasonable. We were able to walk to Duncan for coffee -quick 10 min walk. Overall felt safe and was quiet.
The fire pit was also a nice addition .
Best stocked air bnb I have been in! Even had multiple fans!
Would stay again and highly recommend.
It was a bit tiny as bed felt cramped between walls, but overall was great, amazing for walking, most of our points of interest were within 15 min walking distance

We had a great stay for my bachelorette weekend in Chicago!! We especially loved hanging out on the rooftop—such a great feature for the summer months. It's worth noting that some of the beds are bunk beds even though the listing pictures don't show that
Perfect place to stay when going to concert at Soldier Stadium.

Cesar and Maria were phenomenal hosts. They were extremely accommodating from allowing us and early check in to a complementary late checkout. Their home has everything you’d need.We had a group of 7 for a Bachelor party and we had plenty of space. We were easily able to walk to some restaurants and stores near the Airbnb. If you’re looking for a spot outside of the hustle and bustle of downtown but still within a reasonable commute, look no further. I would recommend this to anyone staying in the area. Looking forward to the next we come back to Chicago, we will be staying with Cesar and Maria.
Great apartment in the heart of Wicker park. Great location!

Overall, a solid place to stay! It’s about a 10-minute walk to the Brown Line, with lots of great restaurants and places to check out nearby. There is only street parking available, and after 5 p.m. it can be extremely difficult to find a spot. I had to park a few streets over the first night, then moved my car the next morning and didn’t move it again for the rest of my stay. Room was great and as described. The shared kitchen space was very nice and well-kept, but the bathroom could use some maintenance and updating.
Beautiful, well appointed space with friendly and communicative hosts.  Will stay with them again when in the area.

Très beau logement, propre.
Hôtes disponibles et réactifs.
Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour.
It was nice home in a quiet neighborhood, close to grocery store.
Nice house and very responsive host

It’s was a friendly neighborhood with families outside walking their dogs, letting their kids ride bikes etc..
The place was spacious & comfortable.
There was a table for 8 & a sofa that everyone could sit on.
The rooms weren’t on the main floor so if someone wanted to watch TV the people sleeping were not disturbed.
We love being so close to a great coffee house, restaurants, gyms & art.
Truly perfect place.
Very nice accommodations. Mera is an attentive and very pleasant host. Thank you!
Place was absolutely amazing some friends and I came to visit and we appreciate the cleanliness and vibe in the home. If we come back to visit will definitely look into this again.
Enjoyed our stay.  Everything was as expected.
Host was amazing, house will beautiful and clean. Thank you so much.

The apartment was clean, modern, and lovely. The building was secure and nice. There was unfortunately a security issue with the unit door where the lock only engaged some of the time - so the unit was unsecured and anyone could open the door from the outside, with no way to secure it including when I was inside. Great place in a great neighbourhood with lots of great bars, coffee shops and vintage stores . Pristine clean with everything we needed. Jen is very responsive and helpful. Will definitely be back next time I am in Chicago.

Location was great, close to Clark St. with tons of shops, bars, and restaurants. Red line to downtown is a 15-20 min walk. Place was incredibly clean and cute. Bed, bedding, and towels were superb. Maximo also helped us out when our friend's bike lock was jammed. Would stay again!!!
Great location for the weekend!

Really nice apartment and plenty of space for my family of 5. Perfect location as I was close to my family and was able to walk to watch the Bud Billiken Parade. Great hosts overall and I had no reason to reach out for assistance. Instructions were clear and everything we needed inside was provided. Would absolutely book again.
Cool place just outside of downtown.  Had everything we needed for a comfortable weekend stay
Great location with good restaurants and quick to downtown. Easy check in with a very well stocked kitchin.
Highly recommend staying here! The host was extremely easy to get ahold of and the place was perfect for our stay! It’s located within walking distance of everything as well!
I loved staying there. Very close to bus stations and pretty quiet area. The host was very respectful and responsive. Workers were very nice and the pizza around the corner was gooddd!!

Very cute historic home, feels very secluded/private while still being in a busy, walkable area and not too far from downtown Chicago. Street parking was easy to find and train station was only about 10 a minute walk. Very pretty surrounding area with murals. Highly recommend!
Nice place to say you have to see in person
It was exactly what was expected and described. A bed and a shower only things we really needed. The AC was cold and the shower was hot:)
Great location! Incredibly convenient to Wrigley and boystown. Could use a deep clean to take care of grime buildup but overall clean.

We had a great stay at David’s place! The home is clean and comfortable for a large group. We loved hanging out in the backyard. It was easy to get to bus stops or take Ubers around. David was very responsive to all our questions. Thank you, David!
Great spot!
El lugar es como en la imagen o mejor, definitivamente volveríamos a hospedarnos, además de que Francisco es muy atento y un gran anfitrión, todo lo que pedimos lo resolvía.

My family and I really enjoyed staying here, the location is just incredibly accessible to transportation making your stay in Chicago absolutely amazing . The apartment was pretty clean and accurate to the pictures and descriptions. Great place to get back to rest after a good day of walking across the city. Would stay again here in the future for sure!
Michael was very nice and the place was perfect for our quick weekend trip away! Would recommend and stay again.
Host was very responsive and helpful. It is very much as advertised and doesn't upscale anything in pictures. 100% recommend.
Great location, very clean and easy check in and checkout.
Excellent. Wonderful location. Very clean and well maintained.
Great hosts and the area is beautiful, with lots of cool restaurants and bars around too. Would recommend !

Kate’s coach house is far superior!  Very quiet, nestled back in the back of the property. The architecture of the Airbnb is magnificent. The room was extra, clean with all amenities provided.  We have stayed at many Airbnb’s but this one is top. Thank you so much for your hospitality and your generosity of letting us stay there. We were able to find street parking which is a big plus.  We would definitely stay here again!
Felt like home i loved it there
Fantastic home with lots of amenities. The host has gone above and beyond to make sure her guests are comfortable.
Great location, great price, and everything was excellent when it came to cleanliness and organization. She was also super nice and welcoming. Highly recommended!
Excellent location!
Very nice place, good amenities
Top notch place to stay convenient to everything.

Overall I had a great stay. The apartment was well equipped for long stays and the host was responsive. The apartment is steps away from the L, which was convenient. The amenities, in particular the pool and gym, were top notch. The check-in process was a bit cumbersome, but overall I enjoyed my stay at The Lydian.
Makana was a great host!  The space matched the description perfectly and was able to accommodate our group.  Makana was quick to respond to any questions that I had and was very nice.
Muy buen lugar rápido para llegar al centro de chicago

The apartment was very beautiful. Laura immediately responded to all our messages and had nice recommendations for places we could eat around. Also she had very detailed information on how to find the house and that was super helpful.
Great stay! Small group of friends, all very different and some hard to please lol - with that being said, we each were comfortable and enjoyed this stay very much!

Responsive & nice host. Place looks like the pictures, although the beds seem smaller than Queen beds. Bathroom could really use a deep clean.
Great neighborhood. Walkable distance to Blue line train, 10-15 min. Overall happy with the stay.
Excelente servicio nos encantó el apartamento lo recomiendo al 100%

Great airbnb with a quiet neighborhood location but near the metro, plenty of restaurants, and the beach. Friendly and responsive hosts. Comfortable beds. Perfect living and kitchen area for a group trip. Would book here again.

We had a fantastic stay with no issues whatsoever. The room was exactly as described and completely suited our needs for a 2 night stay in Chicago. Location offered peace and quiet but was close enough to Wrigley Field to be in the all the action. Would definitely stay here again!

First off, this house is a GREAT neighborhood. Feels very chill and safe. The space was comfortable and quiet. Beds were cozy. Lots of kids toys and family-friendly games available, though we didn’t need them. If you have kids, it’s the perfect place to stay. I will be definitely be back in the future!

Melvin was very welcoming and attentive. He gave us a tour on arrival and made us feel very comfortable. The place was clean and felt inviting. Melvin was amazing and made himself available at any time. Cannot recommend this b&b enough!

Great location and excellent host.  Well appointed unit and amazing amenities on site.  In unit laundry is fantastic for longer term stays.  Victor was extremely responsive, communicated thoroughly and in advance.  If you are looking for a safe and convenient location, look no further.  Close to offices downtown, shopping, transportation and attractions.  On site parking is a plus as well if you have a vehicle.  Building management is professional and on site.  Should we have occasion to be in Chicago again, this would be our #1 choice where to stay.

Mi estancia fue genial. Henry fue súper atento, resolviendo mis dudas rapidísimo y de manera muy clara. El lugar estaba exactamente como se veía en las fotos, con amenidades extras en una zona tranquila y de fácil acceso en auto o transporte. Lo único que noté fueron unos insectos en el sótano, pero nada que molestara.
Nice cozy place with lots of nice touches and personality. Host was responsive and helpful.

Stayed here for a bachelorette of 13 people and will be looking for excuses to get that many people together in Chicago again, just to stay here! It was in a great location, was exactly as advertised, and perfect for our group. The host was absolutely amazing and very responsive to the questions we had. They were also very responsive, proactive, and communicative with everything we needed to know about the Airbnb and recommendations in the area. I absolutely recommend this Airbnb and host!!
Great location near trains. Walkable neighborhood. Spacious place
The hosts are really nice! The place is very clean, new, and safe

Todo estaba justo como se anunció. Llegada fácil, ubicación muy buena en un vecindario tranquilo, todo limpio y en orden, los anfitriones siempre estaban atentos y me dieron una lista de recomendaciones muy buenas para disfrutar mi instancia. Sin duda, volvería a quedarme en esta propiedad.
great place! very accessible and accommodating

We enjoyed staying at Slayvana’s
in Old Town. The well-equipped home is surprisingly quiet on a busy street full of restaurants. The Sedgwick stop
on the brown line train is very close as well. The home itself was comfortable and we loved the outdoor space.
Miranda was nice, understanding, and communicative! The place was excellent for what we needed.

The art in the condo was interesting and fun, but the largest bedroom's art didn't match the photos.  That was a minor disappointment.  Clean and comfortable. Beds and linens so comfy.  I liked all the big windows in the living room/dining room/kitchen.  The view was lovely.  The area at night wasn't welcoming and our rental car was broken into the night before we left.  Matthew was wonderful and helpful getting the car keys from the cafe and mailing them to Budget.  We had a good time and our "home base" was very nice.
È stato emozionante soggiornare in questa casa
Overall great place with easy access to lots of stores and restaurants. The host was always responsive and helpful.
Un excelente hospedaje, volvería a hospedarme ahí
Excelente ubicación y Michael siempre está atento.

Overall the place was quiet, tidy and friendly but what did it for us was the missing tile in the floor we didn’t know about my sister tripped and fell had we known about it we could have avoided it. Our towels were not cleaned well they had a smell of mildew and we were not given wash cloths with our towels and we were not given a broom or dust pan nor a mop to clean a mess as well we also could not replace trash bags because their weren’t any but the stay was nice .
Very nice place. A lot of room with the 6 bedrooms. Very clean and nicely decorated. We had a great stay.
Place was perfect for what we needed. Clean, quiet and perfect location!
The location was perfect for us.  Everything we planned to do was walkable.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Absolutely wonderful stay from start to finish! The Airbnb was exactly as described and honestly exceeded my expectations. Everything was incredibly clean, comfortable, and well cared for, and you could tell that a lot of thought went into making the space feel welcoming and relaxing.
The check-in process was easy and seamless, communication was great, and everything I needed during my stay was readily available. The space felt comfortable and inviting, which made it easy to settle in and truly enjoy my time there. I especially appreciated the attention to detail and how well maintained everything was.
Overall, this was an excellent experience and exactly what you hope for when booking an Airbnb. I would absolutely stay here again and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and welcoming place to stay. Thank you for the amazing hospitality and for helping make my trip such a great one! Definitely a 5-star experience!

Alexis's place was perfect for our trip to Chicago. It was outside the hustle and bustle, close enough to the highways to get where we needed to go and in a quiet location. Her place was even nicer looking than the photos!
With it being 420 friendly, I was prepared for it to have a strong smell, but it didnt AT ALL which surprised me. My partner was able to enjoy his product and I didn't have to feel suffocated by it. If you like a firm bed, you'll be happy with that. Bathroom was very nice, minus the one ply toilet paper, but I appreciated how clean everuthing was. Alexis was responsive throughout our stay. Would definitely stay here again when we come to Chicago.
Great spot to call our home base, with a fantastic BBQ restaurant right down the street
Lawanda was very responsive to communicating with us which was very appreciative. The house had everything plus some and was very clean.
Good space, great location. Coffee shop is close in the event the wifi does not work.

This was a lovely home! Spacious and perfect for a group to hang out in. Kim was also a very responsive and communicative host. We had some issues with the fridge and she was very responsive and willing to have someone come out asap to look at it. The beds and rooms were all comfortable and generally had everything we needed. Parking was also super easy. It’s a bit far from downtown Chicago so keep that in mind but a lovely peaceful neighborhood otherwise.
Very clean my family loved it!!

This place was perfect for what we needed for a quick weekend in Chicago. Easy walk to the riverwalk, cute restaurant right outside the condo. Mosmi was great to work with through the check-in /check-out process. Would definitely recommend!!

This set up worked great for the extended family to be able to stay together while attending my daughter's wedding in Chicago.
Thanks Junni, for a great stay that went off without a hitch.

Nathan and Jake were excellent hosts. The apartment was exactly as described and maintained well. They communicated early and often between booking and the stay and were very responsive when we had any questions during our time in Chicago. I would absolutely recommend them, and this apartment, for anyone looking for a home away from home in the city.
Dwellish was very responsive when it came to booking. The place was very clean, decorated well, and fit the needs of my group. Would recommend to others and would stay again. Thanks!
Rodica has been a great, friendly and helpful host. The house is beautiful with a calm neighborhood. Little far without a car but it’s definitely manageable. Would stay again if chances are there!

This was such a score! My first experience staying in just a room that the host also is on sight. Oddly enough it actually made the stay more fun, we chatted a couple of times; felt right at home. The metro station is right there and made my trip so easy, didn’t pay for a single air bnb!

Good proximity to everything you want to do in Chicago. The unit was very clean and had several nice amenities. David is an awesome host and was very communicative, helpful, and kind. Highly recommend.
Cozy stay. They respond quickly if you have any issues. Small hideaway in a great neighborhood! Public transportation is easy to get to with a short walk to catch the bus or the train.

Extremely helpful hosts throughout the entire process. Great location and very easy to walk to many eateries and minor errands. Apartment was very well decorated and the pictures are accurate. Rooftop space is beautiful and should be used by all guests.
Worth the value, given the central location

I think my stay was really great! The space was nice, there was tons of room, it was easy to get inside as well as access all of the house rules and amenities from an external website. The only problem was really the air conditioning as its really hot In chicago now a days but I feel as tho this wouldnt happen again if I were to rent the space another time.
Great place to stay!

Overall good and a little pricey
can be maintained better and will need to fix the clogs
Beautiful apartment was just the right size for eight people

We really enjoyed our stay.  The place was clean, easy to access, and we were able to park on the street with parking passes.  It is a nice neighborhood.  We needed the airbnb for an event, and it could not have been a more perfect location for it.  We had a great time.

Great location. Easy to check in. Pharmacy, shops, park, and restaurants all within walking distance. Yes there is noise from the CTA but it’s white noise for me so I didn’t mind. Overall great experience.
Easily accessible to anywhere in Chicago

This was an amazing place for my family to stay in as they visited me in Chicago! Great location, clean place, and super easy to check in. The private rooftop was a huge plus! I’d highly recommend staying here and will definitely be booking again for my family for next time.
The place was pretty clean and served the exact purpose that I needed in terms of why I went to Chicago. A nice place to comeback to after a long day of exploring Chicago.

Michael & Elena, were amazing hosts.
They went above and beyond to make our stay the most comfortable and welcoming.
Very quaint home with comfortable amenities.
Great place to explore Lincoln Square from. Checkout was a breeze.

Open and clean space with all amenities in working order. Relatively easy to enter and exit the building with restaurants and nightlife within walking distance. Neighbors were loud in the early evening but quiet as the night went on. Parking is a couple blocks away and easy to find. The QR code didn’t work when leaving but it was figured out quickly via the parking garage company. All in all, would stay again. 9.5/10.

This was a great location to stay, as I was on a trip to visit the Obama Presidential Center (OPC).  It was roughly a 10-15 minute walk to get to the OPC.  Everything was great, yet the bedroom does not get much cool air from the AC unit, which is in the living room.  Overall though, Jevaux is very responsive and friendly with communication, and he offers neighborhood recommendations if you want them!

Very nice place with all the amenities describe. Great hosts. They were very responsive. We had a couple of small  issues. I messaged and they responded quickly with a fix. Would recommend. Thank you.

I loved it! I was staying there for a wedding at the Layola chapel and happened to be there with two other guests from the wedding, too! Tammy and her husband were extremely hospitable, and I didn’t feel like I was a guest in someone else’s home but rather felt welcomed and nourished with the yummy tea and coffees for breakfast, and the lovely lakeside room!

This is our second time staying here and this time brought our son. This has become his favorite Airbnb as well as ours.  I can’t imagine staying anywhere else when we visit Chicago. It’s a cheap Lyft anywhere you want to go but the neighborhood is worth exploring as well.  Very walkable. I can’t wait to come back.

One of, if not, the best Airbnbs in Chicago. And same with Anne and the level of host she is. Love staying up north away from downtown so the location is perfect. Walkable to Ravenswood and Andersonville. Super spacious, comfortable, and quiet. Anne doesn’t go short on amenities and all the small touches make it feel like a home vs a rental. Second time staying there and will always try to get it when we’re back in Chicago.
Everything was great! We found a parking garage that wasn’t far and easy to walk to.
A wonderful stay for a week in a private and peaceful setting! Pete, Jen and L are very responsive and helpful. Couldn’t recommend enough!
Nice place inaide. But parking is not comfortable. We need to park backside and not convenient. Front side  parking ia not allocated. other than  that itis good.
Gabrielle was a great host with a beautiful apartment! She was so quick to respond to our questions and very helpful and accommodating.

The house was great. It accommodated our large group size last minute at a reasonable price. We felt safe in the neighborhood. Any questions or concerns were addressed in a timely manner. And our host Jade was amazing. She checked in on us during and post trip. Would definitely rent and recommend. Thanks for having us!!
Excelente comunicación y servicio. La locación muy estratégica para poderse mover a la ciudad o alrededores.

This was an amazing stay with the perfect location and plenty to do within walking distance. I would definitely recommend others staying here when they’re in Chicago, especially if you want to be in close proximity to the United center with a very homey stay.
We loved the space and area! Conveniently close to the metro, drug stores, and an asian market! Plenty of places to eat around the area too. We had a great time!

Clean, uncluttered, with a few repairs/maintenance items/needed upgrades to be addressed. For example the door to the unit is a flimsy hollow core door with a simple push button lock (no deadbolt). Does not feel secure. The window shades are not wide enough to cover the windows, leaving gaps for people to see in.
Overall a nice property in a nice neighborhood. I would stay again, but only for the right price.

We had the most wonderful stay at Stephanie’s place. The location was excellent, and it was great to stay in a neighborhood I used to live in 8 years later, there’s even more to do! We love the view, pool, common spaces to enjoy with our family as well as close proximity to all the wonderful Chicago south loop and museum campus has to offer, along with close access to grocery stores and public transportation . We would definitely stay again and highly recommend!

Daniel has a great home. It was very clean, well stocked, and was within walking distance of a number of parks, as well as the Obama Presidential Center. My husband and son thoroughly enjoyed having ping pong battles in the basement! If we find ourselves in Chicago again, we will definitely book Daniel’s home again.

Great location if you like to eat, be on the beach or explore chicago nightlife. The space is small and comfortable. Its a 100+ year old vuidling like most in the area and has an interesting old elevator system. Dont let it scare you, its kinda cool.
Great place. As described

Jamisyn was a wonderful host, and the space was beautiful! You can tell she has put so much thought and care into making it feel welcoming, comfortable, and special. Jamisyn was kind, thoughtful, and a fantastic host. We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend her place!
It’s a great small space for a small family. The host is very friendly and responsive. I believe the space was kind of small for the price. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Very spacious place to stay.
Thanks you were awesome

Overall, we had a good stay. The home was clean and comfortable.
Everything was good and we enjoyed our stay.

My friends & I loved staying here. We felt the care and thought that had gone into preparing a comfortable, welcoming, and beautiful home. We also really enjoyed exploring the neighborhood. Would happily stay again!

We visited Chicago to see some sites and some baseball...unfortunately our team lost :( but our stay at Mr. Bentley's made the trip very comfortable and enjoyable.  The apartment was well laid out and has all the room and amenities we needed for our stay. He even fills the fridge with a variety of beverages for you to enjoy during your stay.
This is a great place, close to the Michigan lake and the south beaches, good to stay a couple of days
Qiqi and co were very responsive and accommodating hosts. They were able to facilitate an earlier check in which was really helpful. The house and amenities were perfect.

Let’s start with the positive. Great location and communicative host. We booked this AirBnb for my partner and I plus our friend who stayed in the 2nd bedroom. We were disappointed there was only one set of keys as it had us trying to coordinate schedules. Additionally, the photos from the listing are not the same as the property. While similar, the bathroom and main bedroom were not the same. The main bedroom appeared larger in the photos showing space between the bed and the wall however, the bed was against the wall and with the end table there was not enough room to open the closet door. Next the bathroom, the toilet is very close to the wall unlike the photo in the listing as well as there being a clawfoot tub which if you’re over 5’6” you’ll need to bend over to shower. Other AI generated photos included the overall condition as the flooring was not as pictured and there were AC Window Units which are also not pictured. For what we paid I was left wanting more.
Highly recommend. My second time staying here and I’ll be back again soon
Tammy and Scott were great hosts! They were super kind and communicative, and their home is beautiful and cozy. Thanks for a great stay!
Very clean nice space enjoyed the stay very much
Property recommended.  I will consider staying again on my next trip to Chicago.
Cyndi was a great host and made sure we had everything we needed!  The apartment was great, and conveniently located

This apartment is in the perfect location in a terrific building with all of the amenities inside or a short walk away that you could possibly need. The apartment itself was well-furnished and well-kept, it made it so easy to show up, settle in, and then use the space for the summer for a two-month work stint. The team at Suite Home was easy to deal with and transparent from the initial inquiry to booking to arrival. I would definitely use them and stay in this building/unit again.

Nate’s place was clean and super spacious. He had tons of amenities and way more than the essentials in the kitchen and bathroom. The street was quiet and the bed was comfortable. We slept very well! He even has an office with a monitor that my wife was able to use when she had to do some work. Free parking was easy right out on the street. L stop was only a short walk away. Would recommend!
Economical, good location. Walls are a bit thin, apart from that, easy communication.
Great place, very close to the Blue Line and cute neighborhood.

Me quede por dos días, la habitación y el alojamiento eran exactamente lo que estaba publicado.

Great place to stay, very clean and roomy with a responsive host.
Such a nice and welcoming space! Clear instructions online and throughout the home which made it easier to fit right in. Such a beautiful area, close to a campus which makes it feel safe and quiet!
Clean and great place to stay

1 block from our daughter’s place. It’s was clean. No body wash filled up and empty bottle body wash and an old towel behind the bathroom door.
