You can’t have the ceiling fan on at night because it’s paired with the ceiling light.. it’s an a “both or nothing” situation. I reached out to the host, if they could unscrew the lightbulb for us…”No, just use the AC, that’s enough “. My husband slept with the lights on the first night, the second night, we brought a black plastic garbage bag to put over it. My bedroom had no AC or fan- pretty uncomfortable. The beds are a whole other level- the queen mattress had a dip in the middle- super soft and worn out. So was the single, I used. Worst beds, we slept on in years.
Gracious, quiet, and friendly
Had the best stay. Beautiful home, awesome character and charm. Perfect location in Gold Coast. Walkable to tons of restaurants and public transit. Will stay here again
Will stay again. The condo was nice and clean.

Cristina was very responsive and helpful. I did not mind sharing the space with someone else because I was usually out exploring the city. The bed was super comfy and the shared space was really nice.

The home is very quaint and was perfect for our family get together. It’s located in a great location that allows you to walk to many restaurants and close enough to get to other places in the city. The owner was very responsive to anything we needed and was very flexible with our check out time, which we greatly appreciated.
Great stay for a short trip! Much more affordable than hotels!
Bob and Alex were so helpful before, during and after our stay. This property is is spectacular and our group is already planning our next group trip!

2人で泊まるのにぴったりな場所でした。Tereさんは、さまざまな問い合わせにいつでもすぐに回答してくれて助かりました！
すべてのスペースがキレイでした。エアコンがあるので、暑い日も快適でした。電車やバスにも簡単にアクセスできます。リグレー球場には歩いて行けます。買い物や食事も選択肢が豊富で、楽しめました。近隣の街は綺麗で安全で、初めてのシカゴ滞在を満喫できました。
Roberto’s listing is a great spot, clean and in a good neighborhood.

Derek was very accommodating from pre booking thru duration of our stay. The unit was just the space we needed to clear our heads and meet up to travel to the 97th Bud Billiken parade, in which my deceased 17yr old son was being honored. We had no issues with the unit itself nor the owner.  however a neighbor called the police on us as the kids gathered to load the bus to perform that morning and again after the parade as about 8 adults were relaxing in the backyard reminiscing about the days event. I would recommend this space but caution you to be super quiet.

Toy's luxury suite was a true oasis on our weekend trip to Chicago! The king bed was very comfortable, the attached bathroom was amazing, and the shared spaces were so clean and inviting! Toy was very helpful and communicative, and the Bridgeport neighborhood was walkable and felt safe. I don't often repeat AirBnb stays, but we will plan to stay here any time we're in town. The deep jetted tub and multi-head shower were nicer than hotel bathroom features, and access to the rooftop balcony down the hall included a great skyline view. These amenities really elevated our stay!
Great Airbnb, one of the best ones I’ve stayed at.
Easy check in/check out and very comfortable accommodations!
Lovely and clean! Thank you Ben!
The kitchen was fully equipped to cook for a family. The neighborhood was quite and close to the downtown. The rooms were very spacious. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely book again!

The place was great. and within walking distance of many restaurants and parks along with the beach.
the neighborhood seemed super safe and clean
Parking is awful but thats just Chicago

Sometimes it can be hard to find a reasonably priced place with street parking that’s a fairly close walking distance from public transportation. If we experienced any issues during our stay at our host was quick and responsive to resolve them. Overall, the listing was a good stay and I would consider staying here again if we were looking for a similar Airbnb that accommodated 4-5 people.
This was a beautiful home in quiet area of town, conviently just outside of downtown Chicago. I thoroughly enjoyed staying here. I loved the decor and the beds were really comfortable!
We loved staying in Wicker Park with 4 adults and 2 kids. The space is beautiful and we were able to walk to so many great places. It was easy to hop on the el to get to the heart of the city.
Had a great timr!
Great space! Very clean! Host was extremely responsive!
We had a rather large group - including children. Cheryl was very accommodating.

This is a very nice apartment and location. We loved sitting out on the back deck listening to the waves lapping and watching the birds. We also enjoyed walking the neighborhood along the lake. Overall, the apartment is comfortable and well furnished.
This has nothing to do with Isa, the host, but with the owners of this short-term rental complex: some basic repairs are needed. The towel rack in the bathroom in the master bedroom is coming off the wall and cannot be used. The back door onto the deck needs to be repaired or replaced. The handle is barely functional and the slat at the bottom of the door is coming off. Lastly, as hot as it is now, some kind of cooling unit needs to be installed in the main sitting/eating area; the two AC units in the bedroom don't do the job.

We had a great weekend here. The kitchen and living room were perfect gathering spaces. The beds were super comfortable with incredibly soft bedding. My only feedback is that the pull out couch felt smaller than a queen and was not really comfortable to sleep two people. Overall great stay and perfect location in the city.
Even better than the pictures! Loved the one floor set up and how spacious it was. Would definitely stay here again

This reminded me of how Air Bnb used to be - it is an apartment above a home and felt well loved and cared for. We were warmly greeted and shown around by Enrique, who provided everything we could possibly need! Though we didn’t spend a lot of time there other than sleeping, we would have been very comfortable hunkering down and cooking, watching TV or just hanging out on the comfy furniture. The beds were to our liking - a queen and a full. It was the ideal spot for a couple and another person - either a friend or a child. Though parking was on the street, it was always easy to find a spot right out front at any time of day or night, and we felt very safe in the neighborhood. We hope to stay again next time we are in Chicago!

I don’t use Airbnb often, but this place truly deserves five stars. What stood out most wasn’t just the place, but the genuine care behind the experience. They went out of their way to make sure I was comfortable and had everything I needed. Friendly, thoughtful, and truly caring ,,,,, the kind of hospitality you remember.
Conveniently located and beautifully decorated home.
Extremely cool house, lots of amenities and a great spot for a group.

Great place to stay for a short trip. Fun decor, large dining area, and beautiful outdoor patio and yard made the stay very comfortable. The hosts are generous and friendly. The apartment is close to the blue line, so transportation from the airport and into the city are easy. The area is quiet but also close to restaurants and shops.
Comfortable stay, nice kitchen
Nice cozy space. Not far from the subway and had everything we needed. Bathroom was great and the unit was very spacious. Had a blast celebrating me and my girlfriend’s anniversary here!
Great place
Had a very good stay at Erik’s place ! I really felt comfortable, and its dogs were so nice !!

We had a great girls trip at Justin's place for a weekend trip! Super walkable between Logan Square and Wicker Park and very close to the El for easy access to other parts of the city. Justin was a great host and we felt very at home!
Overall pleasant stay. Got warm inside every now and then. There were some expired coffee creamer cups when we tried to use them but otherwise good
Amazing spot! Well-decorated and the hosts are very responsive.
A very nice place to stay in Chicago! We loved exploring the neighborhood and taking the train, all of which was possible because of the great location!

We were told to use the back entrance, it was more then dirty it was cruddy. Alot of stickiness on the inside too. There was no living room, it was used for another sleep area, it had a day bed in it. So there was no where comfortable to sit (There was 7 of us), to watch tv. If they had one. Said it was broken, from the last renters. The beds and comforter (blanket) were old and smelly and very, very uncomfortable, could not sleep at all. No complimentary's for guest in the kitchen. No coffee, salt, pepper ect. This was by far, the worse Airbnb I've ever been at.
Great spot , great views, everything is walking distance and they were very attentive staying again forsure

This place was very well located for our stay. We attended a game at the Untied Center so our commute was very short. We were also able to walk to several places to eat. Parking was a bit tricky, but that appears to just be how it is in Chicago. We were able to find a place to park within a few blocks of our place.  The neighborhood was quiet. We enjoyed our stay in Chicago.

Everything was as per the description. We enjoyed our stay.  One bathroom may not be enough for a larger group. Large kitchen, nice outside backyard area, plenty of parking available a huge plus. Great location.
Great property
Overall a wonderful experience!

This spot is in a great location. However,
I was a bit underwhelmed with the space. It was small, and only two towels were provided. Additionally, there were some visible signs of wear (a broken cabinet door and a dent in the wall) that probably should have been fixed prior to anyone staying here.
One of the bowls that I wanted to use to eat takeout that I ordered was dirty and I had to clean it myself.
For the price, it wasn’t a great deal. The location is convenient and safe, though.

Perfect home base for our friend reunion weekend in Chicago! Very comfortable apartment with good hangout space. We loved the deck and well-stocked kitchen. Plenty of good restaurants and coffee shops to walk to. We loved it!
Lois and Eduardo were extremely responsive to any questions or requests I had, making my stay even more enjoyable!
Awesome location. It was perfect for 5 people but any more (especially adults) would have been quite cramped.
Very nice B&B in convenient location. Jennifer is very accommodating. Enjoy our stay.
Nice location and home,  lacked some social seating, and a little but dated  otherwise it was great!
Had a great time! I thought the neighborhood was beautiful. Short walk from the blue line. Perfect spot if ur from out of town and visiting someone from the neighborhood.

This was a really nice place to stay for a weekend while I was attending a shuffleboard tournament nearby!! The place was clean and comfy. It was quiet, and Kimberly gave very clear directions for getting in! Kimberly was very communicative and kind as well!
The area is really nice to walk around and it’s nearby a ton of things to do and check out.
Would definitely stay again.

Beautiful home in a very charming neighborhood! We came to Chicago for a bachelorette party and loved staying here. 11 total people and we had plenty of room. Within walking distance to many restaurants, cafes, and shopping centers. Parking was difficult sometimes but that was expected. Ann was super friendly and helpful! Would definitely recommend staying here :)

The place was great and initially we had no problem getting into the place.  Unfortunately we could not easily get into the apartment on the second day.  We were not told in the instructions to take the key and figured the code given to us would work again.  It didn’t work at all the next day.  Even when we tried reaching out it took several hours to get a response.  We tried again later that night with again no access.  Thankfully one of the neighbors was leaving and we could get into the first door.  If it hadn’t been for those people who knows how long we would have waited outside.    Since there was no direct way to reach the owners even though I asked for a number when we waited for over 30 minutes the first time with no luck we were never given a way to contact them directly.
We had a fantastic stay at the place. The room was very clean and private bathroom was also very nice. Tye was warm and very responsive. I would definitely stay here again when I visit Chicago later.
Great spot. Cool neighborhood. Was exactly what I was looking for.
Very nice location and very spacious!  We needed a pet friendly solution that also had room for our larger group and this was a good choice.
Such a cozy, clean  retreat in an amazing neighborhood!  Thank you Eileen!

This place was awesome.  Joseph was a great host and very responsive.  Bridgeport is a great neighborhood, nice and quiet.  Easy to take the train into Chicago to visit tourist sites, and then get back to the relaxed neighborhood vibe.  We loved it.
Great location and clean place!
Had an amazing stay. Jose was a wonderful host and was very helpful with everything.
Worth every penny! I highly recommend it! Accurate information, safe and friendly host and neighborhood.
Love this place I’ll be back soon
Great location. Comfortable stay. Nikki was helpful and responsive.
Great stay in Chicago! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Everything was as described, and communication with the host was easy and quick. Would definitely stay here again!
A beautiful large townhouse very close to Wrigley Field and Boystown. We had a large group in for Market Days and this place was perfect.
This is a great place in a fun Chicago neighborhood walking distance to lots of great spots to eat and drink. Highly recommend!
Para el precio no es recomendable, zona peligrosa y está muy sucio, habían moscas y manchas en todos lados
This was a great place to stay for our trip. Everything was exactly how described. Although we didn’t need any assistance, communication was A+. Thank you!

Great space for a group to stay
Simple clean and just what we needed for our 2 night stay in Chicago
Had a great time.   Wonderful host.

What a great stay!   This house is in a great neighborhood.  It’s safe and quiet with beautiful homes and quaint parks tucked away to enjoy.   St. Michael’s Catholic Church is steps away and if you enjoy architecture, you should pop over and take a peak.   It’s beautiful.  Robert’s home is thoughtfully appointed with the essentials and his communication is top notch.  From check-in to check-out the process was easy peasy.  Our family enjoyed being able to spread out over the three floors allowing quiet time for all when needed and enough space to gather downstairs and enjoy each other together as well.  It’s an easy Uber to the airport which is awesome.  5-Stars all the way from our family.  We would book again for sure!
amazing stay! :)

Had a great time at this place! Well located, just a few minutes away from the station. Juanita was proactive and helped me get inside and asked if I needed anything additional during my stay.
Overall very pleasant

An amazing property in the heart of Lincoln Park! The rooftop patio with unobstructed views of Chicago skyline with high quality outdoor kitchen appliances is in an elite class of its own. The natural gas grill will make any serious cook happy as will the mini fridge for staging the food to be grilled and chilling beverages. The unit itself has extra high ceilings with lots of natural light. The location can’t be beat and recommend those with a car to park in garage @ 1933 N Halsted using SpotHero (very close!). Highly recommended
SETE was great in the sense that they communicated very well. We had a blast being there and felt very welcomed.
Great cozy little studio! In a really nice area. Walkable to a decent amount of restaurants and stores, also a very close and easy walk to the subway. Would definitely stay again!
Claire was always available and proactive when it came to meeting our needs as a family with two children. Always felt very welcome
Very helpful and quick with communication
Place was clean and comfortable.
Exceptionally clean, great location, great host.  Will be staying again. Highly recommended!!
A perfect location for a trip to downtown Chicago.

My stay was good. No major issues. The place is as advertised and seen in the pictures. You get what you pay for. If you need a place to sleep, this is the place. Minimal foot traffic. You have other people on the premises during your stay. You rarely see them. The host is sociable; he never really introduced himself.

Heather's place made for the perfect home-base while my friends and I were exploring Chicago for a long weekend. The neighborhood was adorable and Heather gave us ample local recommendations for food and drink. It was also in a great location to get ubers/lyfts to other areas of the city. The house was beautiful, and the soaking tub was a perfect amenity to come home to after a long day of walking around the city. I only wish we had more time to stay so we could have used the perfectly appointed kitchen to make a home-cooked meal...maybe next time!

Really enjoyed the neighborhood. Very close to the Blue line making it very convenient when using Chicago's public transit. Do read the details as the unit is located on the 4th floor with stair access only. AC worked very well, a must during the humid summers. Very clean space, albeit very sterile (was not even able to find a pen), minimal supplies in the kitchen.

Had a lovely time staying at Omar’s place. It was right in River north which is a great neighborhood for restaurants, nightlife, shopping, and tourist attractions. There was ample space for all of my guests. The beds were comfortable, the bathrooms were nice as well. Plenty of room for 10 girls to get ready to go out. Check in and out was easy. I would definitely stay here again if I got the chance!
Super close to everything to downtown and has food places near by that open late. Night life close by also.
Great place
Staying at Ken’s is like a home away from home. He’s an awesome host, v helpful and responsive. We loved the thoughtful touches in Airbnb and walkable distance to U Chicago.
A beautiful home in a great location!
Shaun was a wonderful host! Very communicative, laid-back, and easy to contact. Everything was ready for us when we arrived for check-in, and the duration of our stay was comfortable and clean.
This location is great for access to West Town, Wicker Park, and other bustling neighborhoods. We loved having a quiet home in the city for our stay in Chicago.
Great place, very clean and host is kind
Mary and Andrew’s place was fantastic! The space was very clean, spacious, and thoughtfully set up!
I couldn’t have asked for anything more! The perfect size if you’re traveling solo. I was here for a wedding and the garment steamer was unexpected and made this place a 10/10 automatically ;)
Great place and host very responsive. Highly recommend thank you!
We had so much fun at Tom’s  house. Perfect for two couples.  He was very attentive and responsive. Easy train ride to downtown Chicago!

Great stay overall, the location was perfect for touring Chicago, easy access to everything we wanted to see on our bachelor trip. The house itself was exactly as described and comfortable for the whole group. What really made it stand out was the host's communication, quick to respond, easy to reach, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the stay. Would definitely book again.

We come to Chicago several times a year and this was our favorite place we’ve stayed. Good neighborhood, parking, very close to all the places we wanted to go to and the best part for me - incredibly clean/nice space. I am a clean freak and typically will clean when we get somewhere but this is the first time ever I didn’t even feel like I had to. We truly loved our stay here and hope we can again in the future!
Great stay! The space was comfortable and in a convenient location. The host was friendly and responsive, and I really enjoyed my time in Chicago. Would definitely recommend!
This home is so cozy, and Lin and Peter were very welcoming. The best part was definitely the easy access to the subway. I’d love to stay here again next time I’m in Chicago!!

10/10 everything was amazing from the location to everything the house has to offer. The house looks just like the pictures and everything described in the description. Easy check in and check out process. Will definitely stay here again and recommend to anybody traveling to Chicago!
This was a great location, enjoyed our stay. Was central to everything and close to the train stop. We would stay here again!

Had a great stay in Noel’s place!  The unit was clean and well stocked with cookware, spices, coffee, and everything else we needed for our stay.  Noel was very responsive and was kind enough to upgrade us to a larger unit in the same location when he identified a maintenance issue in the place we had scheduled.  Everything was smooth and easy.  Highly recommend!
Just a wonderful spot, in an area that has developed a lot over the last 20 years. Super hosts - so helpful and kind. We look forward to coming back.

Damien was amazing! He was very responsive when I reached out to him and reached out quickle. He also gave us recommendations for restaurants and activities in the area. The house was amazing and each floor had it's own kitchen, washer and dryer. Each floor was set up as it's own apartment, which was perfect for we used it for. The neighborhood was amazing and very walkable!
Neomi was very responsive. Communication was very clear and I hope every Airbnb host is like her. Thank you
Kyle's place worked great our family group in town for a party.
Great place to stay for a great rate!

We unfortunately had to leave this Airbnb early and find a hotel after an uncomfortable situation outside the ground-level apartment.
The apartment is located directly at street level, with the living room windows facing the sidewalk. When we returned to the property on Saturday, a man was standing outside the windows, pacing back and forth and repeatedly looking directly into the apartment. He watched us enter with our 11-month-old baby and continued looking through the living room window while we were inside. As a family traveling with an infant, we did not feel comfortable remaining in the apartment and decided to leave.
There were also several cleanliness concerns as well as the location being next to a fire station.
I would encourage future guests, particularly families with young children, to carefully consider the ground-level location and surroundings before booking.
Beautiful place. Well appointed and quiet. Christian was very responsive. We definitely recommend.
Comfortable space. Historic building. Great location. I found free parking on the street each time I needed it. Host was responsive, pleasant, and helpful.

Really great place. Probably the quietest area of Chicago I’ve ever stayed, but there are still plenty of walkable restaurants/shops. Super clean, awesome deck area. Everything looked great. Would definitely stay here again. Communication was awesome.

My friend and I stayed here to go to a concert at Soldier Field.  The location is perfect and you're able to walk to so many of Chicago's attractions.  The place was great.   Very clean and we had everything we needed.  And the host was so responsive and friendly.  I would 100% book again.

We absolutely loved Jody’s place and her incredible hospitality! Her home was sparkling clean and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed, from extra bedding to coffee, tea, and so much more. The entire floor was beautifully set up and felt incredibly welcoming.
We were especially surprised and thrilled to find a basket filled with a variety of complimentary snacks, along with kids’ activity supplies like coloring materials and balloons, waiting for us when we arrived. These thoughtful touches made such a huge difference, especially since we were traveling with two young kids. Jody even had the crib set up and ready for us when we arrived. She is truly an incredibly thoughtful and kind host!
The location was also very convenient, with plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, and other amenities nearby. It took us about 25–45 minutes to drive to downtown Chicago, which was very reasonable for us.
We highly recommend Jody’s place to anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming
Would stay here again if I come to Chicago. It’s a safe place to stay. It was clean and Dominique was quick to respond.

Fredrick was a fantastic host! What you see in the photos is exactly what you see in person. He literally has everything you can think of, from essentials, bottled water, all sorts of seasonings and things you would need to cook and even a first  aid kit! We loved the Bluetooth speaker that was installed in the showers. There is so much more to say about how well and thought out his place is! He also, checked in just to make sure we were doing okay. The neighborhood was so quiet and peaceful. Whenever I come back to Chicago I’ll definitely check his availability to book with him again.
Great for a laid back girls weekend in Chicago.  Very walkable and close to transit and restaurants.  Place was as described

This place is in a good location for in and out travel, if you are not staying at the Airbnb for long stretches (and plan to spend most time out in the city). The place is of lower quality / amenities, not well maintained, not very homey or overly comfortable. Beds, sheets, blankets and furniture was not the best quality. Air conditioner units are loud, do work to a certain degree for hot days though if you leave running continuously. It worked fine for 3 people to stay as a launch pad, as a cheaper stay in a good neighborhood.
Quiet neighborhood, convenient access to buses and light rails. It's a basement unit, so it's naturally cool in the summer. The bathroom is really spacious. We enjoyed our stay.
Everything was very simple fast without any complications very friendly staff clean facilities and very good location I would surely return
Great location, definitely enjoyed our stay! Only downside was how warm the room got at times even with the ac unit.
Our host was attentive, caring, and personable. If you would like an accommodation that resembles being a welcomed guest in someone's home, then look no further

The house was in a great location, and the host was incredibly responsive. The house was clean, well-maintained, and everything was exactly as listed. He even accommodated us with an early check-in, which was greatly appreciated. Overall, we had a wonderful stay!
Thank you for allowing my family to use your home to reconnect with other family members!!!!  It was magical
Great place, felt super clean and loved the bathrooms. Host was super nice.

The condo was in a great location- super walkable and really nice to have a parking spot included. The street just outside is very loud and the walls/windows were not thick so it was quite loud at night. Would be helpful to bring or have a sound machine. The blinds also let significant light through at night so would be helpful to bring an eye mask for better sleep.

Long was very accommodating to our needs. The apartment was clean and exactly what we needed. We thought it was a little warm for our liking. The AC didn’t go down much which was a minor concern, but we were able to work around it. My suggestions would be having some extra hand towels, a lighter layer sheet for the bed, and possibly a fan to get some airflow in the bedroom. Overall, a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend to anyone. A fantastic budget place ☺️
Heidi is super welcoming person. Place was extremely clean and well maintained. Cherry on top is her cute cat.

I chose this property because the listing presented it as an upscale experience, and I was willing to pay accordingly. Unfortunately, the stay did not meet those expectations. After going through the screening process, providing guest names, agreeing to numerous rules, and even paying an early check-in fee, we arrived to find the cleaners still there. I understand delays happen, but with the level of expectations placed on guests, I expected to walk into a pristine unit. Instead, there were crumbs in the bedroom and living room carpets, toilets that did not appear thoroughly cleaned, and extremely dirty windows. The repeated nightly messages about quiet hours, smoking, and being “close with the neighbors” also felt excessive and almost threatening rather than welcoming. I fully respect house rules and neighbors, but the constant reminders made it difficult to relax. For the rate charged and the extensive screening and rules, I expected a much higher standard of cleanliness, hospitality

This was a perfect home for our family gathering to see Chicago, and provided spaces to chill at the end of the day. The amenities of three bedrooms with king sized beds, three full bathrooms, and a well stocked kitchen made cooking, baking and clean up easier.
The neighborhood noise wasn’t a problem, and the kids loved a backyard convenience store!
I highly recommend this home!

I had a wonderful stay at Tracy’s place! Tracy, Andy, and their daughter were incredibly kind and welcoming and made me feel at home from the moment I arrived, nice people, great manners, and energy. They gave me great recommendations for places to visit, shop, and even explained how to use the CTA, which was very helpful.
The neighborhood felt safe and was conveniently located within walking distance of the beach, the CTA, and a grocery store. Uber rides to most attractions were usually around $15–$25.
The room was spacious, bright, very clean, and comfortable, and the bathroom was spotless. Having a fridge, microwave, and jacuzzi made my stay even better. Exactly as shown in the pictures.
I parked on the street in front of the house. Andy and their daughter kindly helped me carry everything in, which was such a thoughtful gesture. I really appreciated their help.
I truly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend Tracy’s place.

Overall great stay
Neighborhood is not in the heat of the action. But easy to get to busses

Easy check in/out process and plenty of parking right up front. It was one of the cleanest airbnbs I have been to (even the floors were clean!) This place was also nicer than the actual pictures, which was a great surprise. Shonte’s place had plenty of supplies, like soaps, trash bags, and more; and was very responsive when we had questions. Thanks for having us!

Geo was a very responsive, attentive host, and the location of this unit is fantastic—extremely close to a supermarket, pharmacy, restaurants, and public transportation.
Unfortunately, we experienced several major maintenance issues during our 5-night stay (Monday to Saturday). The parking garage code did not work, requiring someone to remain inside the unit to open the garage door manually. The main internet was down, though Geo did provide a working alternative connection for most of our stay.
The biggest issue was that there was no gas for the duration of our stay, meaning no stove for cooking and no hot water. Going 5 nights without hot water was very uncomfortable. Geo did issue a partial refund for the trouble, which I appreciated, but I was disappointed the gas issue wasn’t resolved before we checked out.
This listing has great potential if these maintenance and utility issues are permanently fixed.

This place was great! After a few bad experiences with airbnbs, I was a little nervous, but this airbnb was clean, easy to check in to, and in a great location. There were a list of recommended restaurants/places to go and we loved them! Would definitely stay again.
Great place to stay
had a great and very easy stay here! Host was very communicative the whole trip and the apartment was clean and cute when we arrived
Right in the heart of Wicker Park! Surprisingly quiet, especially being so close to the L and the night life. Clean, cute, the perfect size for us.
Angelika and Zibi’s place was amazing! It was very nice and the neighborhood felt safe to stay in. They were responsive, extremely helpful, and understanding whenever we needed anything from them.
Easy access to public transportation! We were able to do a multitude of adventures on public transit from our air bnb!

We really enjoyed our stay. Having three king bedrooms is incredibly hard to find, and it worked perfectly for our group (one bedroom is thru the other bedroom not a big deal for us but for some groups that might be important to know)
The home is in an older building, but it’s been nicely updated, and the furnishings all felt new, clean, and comfortable. There was plenty of room for everyone to spread out, which made it a great fit for our group.
The dedicated parking space was definitely a nice amenity. Just be aware that it’s a fairly tight spot, especially if you’re not used to city parking. We were able to fit our minivan, but getting in and out took some maneuvering, so we ended up leaving it parked for most of the week and using other transportation instead.
Iris provided clear instructions, but we didn’t get in until after dark and didn’t really go through her instructions until we got to property (would recommend going through at earlier)
Overall, we had a great experience
The place was so nice and the location was perfect for walking to restaurants. Would stay there again!
The Airbnb was nice, it is far from downtown. But the area was very private which was nice.

I loved the area and the airbnb itself; beautiful and in a great neighborhood. Everything was clean and exactly how it had been described. My only issue and what stops me from giving 5 stars is that the host had asked if someone could come in the unit for maintenance, but I didn’t see the message until a few minutes after and by then there were random maintenance men in the unit when I walked out of the bedroom. As a woman it made me really uncomfortable. After that, the host came down and knocked to reset a breaker, which is completely fine, but when I went back to our messages, the ones asking if someone could come down for maintenance were deleted, which threw me off a bit. I just don’t feel safe with men I don’t know walking into the unit I’m staying in without me knowing about it ahead of time.
Also I think it’s worth mentioning for if you bring a reactive dog that the host’s dog does sit at the entrance to the basement unit sometimes and bark/growl at you (I didn’t know before)
Awesome location with a peaceful vibe in the city. Felt safe and loved how easy parking was! Super close to two L stops so easy to navigate getting around without a car as well!
Loved the place.
Location was wonderful for attending a concert at the united center. Bedrooms/bathroom a little small, no counter space in bathroom. Overall, nice place. Very chill, relaxed and an adorable space.

We loved our stay and when we go back will be requesting to stay here again. We had a couple of pups with us and the house was inviting for them to have a private yard to let them exercise. Elba was an amazing host.

We really enjoyed our visit at Clemente’s place. It’s such a great location within easy walking distance to so many shops and great restaurants and cafés.  The place itself was clean, spacious and had many unexpected amenities including many products in the bathroom that are commonly forgotten when traveling. This was a really nice touch
This studio is a beautiful place to stay and is located in a beautiful neighborhood. Enjoyed my stay immensely.

Overall we had a great time. Only things that would’ve made it better was extra trash bags as there was only 1 extra, curtains in the bedrooms for better sleep, and the codes we were given for specific entry points didn’t match up. We got it figured out eventually. The staff and other residents were extremely kind. Lots of amenities to utilize too between downtime. Great location for transportation.
Le logement est bien placé par rapport au métro et dans un environnement calme et résidentiel. Nous avons passé un moment agréable.
Overall a decent stay! Parking was a bit tough, but we were alerted to that prior to booking.

Worked well for our family group for four nights. Nice fixtures/materials. Plenty of space/beds, and showers/bath worked fine. One block to great old school Italian joint and three blocks to coffee and breakfast

Matt’s place was beautiful and clean! We loved the tasteful upgrades, especially the luggage stands/ full closets in each room. There were amazing amenities for things you might forget like bathroom toiletries and the umbrellas are a nice touch. Matt also was very helpful for some items we left behind. Highly recommend staying here and in the amazing Andersonville/ Uptown/ Argyle area

El alojamiento esta muy limpio ordenado, solamente la 3er recamara no tiene un closet o mueble para guardar articulos, adicional que para accesar tienes que pasar por la segunda recamara, por lo tanto carecen ambas recamaras de privacidad y lo mas desafortunado fue que no tuvimos internet durante la estancia.

Daniel & Johnny were exceptional hosts! They are caring and geniune individuals who went out of their way to make us feel at home. We loved staying in their place and the area was terrific. Wr give them a 5+ star review!
Tough to beat the location.  Place was as described.  Would stay again
It was really lovely.

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment truly felt like a home away from home—comfortable, well-maintained, and thoughtfully set up.
The hosts were extremely accommodating and made sure we were comfortable throughout our stay. Everything we needed was provided, including a well-equipped kitchen and even a bassinet, which made traveling with our child so much easier.
The location was also very convenient. There’s a train station just a 5-minute walk away, making it easy to travel to downtown Chicago and commute in and out of the city.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. We would definitely stay here again!

We absolutely loved our stay here. It was even better than what we expected. Easy check in and great location within walking distance to the blue line which brought you straight into Downtown Chicago. The space was very clean and despite the shared bathroom and kitchen we had no problems with it. Other tenants were a pleasure as was Sezgin who sorted anything we needed. Would definitely book again :))
I had a great stay here!

The place was wonderful and looked exactly like the photos! Everything was clean and we had no problems with anything. The host was super accommodating throughout the entire process and gave complete instructions which is so helpful.
The apartment is a couple minutes walk to buses or the Addison blue line and has a lot of restaurants nearby and a park so it was nice to enjoy some of those places as well.

The apartment is cute and clean with fun details and an updated look. The location can't be beat and is on a lovely, leafy, street with lots of great places within walking distance. However, the unit really lacks adequate sound-proofing which makes everything happening above you incredibly loud. This was a major issue for us since we could hear every step the upstairs tenants took at all hours. Further, the AC (while effective) was incredibly loud.  All in all, this is a nice place to stay if you can manage to sleep through the noise.
Logement bien situé, spacieux, agréable. Idéal pour découvrir Chicago en famille

Beautiful home
Excellent location
Very clean
Loved the front porch for our morning coffee
We will be back for another visit

Buyer beware. The dirtiest property I have ever seen. We left early because it was so bad. Host blamed the condition on his guests and referred to the property as a "hostel." Air bnb mediated and gave us a full refund. I wanted to see how much the cleaning fee was...there wasn't one. And it shows.
They made the process very easy, and their place was beautiful!
Clean place, easy to check in and check out, host communicated well, and the locations worked great for our trip. Would stay again!
It was a very nice place for the weekend! Very peaceful but still close to the city to enjoy!!

David and his home were fantastic. It was very clean when we arrived and David is incredibly responsive.
The home was as described and the neighborhood was fantastic. A very nice and welcoming neighborhood.
Nothing, but good things to say.

It was a great stay, At the beginning was afraid of the reviews saying the smell and the units, but actually was really god, I've never experienced bad smell at all, the shared bathroom was clean all the time, a lovely staff lady was cleaning multiple times a day, and the shared spaces were also great, there was coffee and a coffee maker, also the fridge, my food was safe lol, I really enjoined my stay I felt really well, also the neighborhood was awesome, you don't need uber from the airpot the blue line is 10 mins walking and the neighborhood had many cafes, brunch places. In general, it was easy to move through Chicago from here.
Things were great. Close to our conference at Loyola University.
Very comfortable room in apartment. Loved the neighborhood. Easy commute to work. Mary was very helpful and responsive. Recommend this highly for long term people!
Place was great and matched what was advertised. Train is very loud though

I stayed here for a summer internship and it was a great stay! Definitely a bit small but the location made up for it. Super close to the blue line, bus stops right outside, and such a short walk to amazing restaurants and things to do. It was more of a dorm feel than a hotel so it was a good longer term place to stay. It was also clean when i got there and during the duration of the stay!
Fantastic location! Great coffee place right below. Walkable to almost everything and good public transport!
Great stay

The neighborhood is quiet, and I felt safe. The apartment is just one block from the train and bus stations, and there’s a supermarket right across the street. The apartment is clean and the kitchen and laundry facilities are well-equipped. I would definitely recommend this place!
It was great! Would stay again.

Jeannette was very welcoming and the apartment is just darling and most definitely met our needs. If you have time to explore the area it has lots of things to do and places to eat. We unfortunately were there for a 3 day wedding event so we weren’t able to do much else but would love to return!
Jeannette was extremely helpful with our move in and so gracious. She’s a Superhost for a reason!
Also you will feel very secure in her place. It’s gated and there’s another door to go through before you get to your particular apartment.
We highly recommend staying here!
This was convenient to everything I visited for. Thank you so much for hosting my family and I on short notice!

Perfect location for our six friends to gather and enjoy Chicago. Quiet neighborhood- we each had our own room. Easy hosts to work with! They even ran over one morning with another parking sticker for us.

The place was exactly as expected and the neighborhood was a great place to stay, with Lincoln Park only a few blocks away, not to mention museums and restaurants and two farmers markets short walks away.

Viviana and her place was amazing! I flew in from Cairo and checkin was super easy. She was also so understanding with my friends visiting for dinner. I will definitely stay with her again when in Chicago. 10/10
Great location and the space was comfortable for our party of 7! Michael offered clear instructions and was friendly when communicating.

Nice place for a solo traveler! Location is great for the blue line so it makes it really easy to get around that way! I will say the walls are very thin but it was easy to sleep at night since everyone was quiet. Would stay again!

Great stay! Clean place that was as described, and friendly responsive hosts. Would definitely recommend if you’re trying to spend some time in Chicago, super walkable to the United center if you’re attending an event as well!

This place is definitely a great deal. It was very clean, quiet, cozy and in a good location on the north side. This is my first Airbnb experience and it set a great standard for cleanliness, comfort,  affordability, value, and comfort. The host was friendly, and I would definitely book it again.
Great place to stay
Andy was super responsive, thanks!!!
It was ok. There were a number of gnats and flies in the house, including in the room in which I stayed.

We stayed at Vladlena's appartment for more than 2 months! It was one of our best stays in airbnb. Vladlena is an excellent host always responsive and helpful. Our communication with her was quick, very smooth and easy. I highly recommend this place if you are visiting Chicago! Thank you Vladlena!

Dorian’s place was exactly what we needed! Great location as it’s tucked in a quiet neighborhood that wasn’t far from amazing Chinatown. Dorian provided some stuff that I had forgot to bring so that was very convenient. We would 100% stay here again if we come back to Chicago😊

Great stay! Lots of space for me and my boyfriend and the kitchen and eating area was great. Everything we needed was there and worked fine and we pretty much had no issues. The home is beautiful, was spacious for us to hang out with our family in the evenings for dinner and play games, the linens and beds were beautiful and comfortable and Brett was a great host.  He was quick to respond if we needed anything and thought of everything we needed.  The location is perfect, safe and quiet.  We loved it so much, we booked our next return already!

I would recommend this Airbnb to anyone with 6-8 people!! It’s in a good location and has a private parking lot/ space! It was an easy check in! We were a party of 7 traveling from VA in a 12 passenger van for our family reunion!! The only problem I had was the cleanliness of the bathtub ( there were some long strands of hair left behind. Other than that everything was clean and comfortable.

Yes the alley is a bit neglected but the parking spot couldn’t be any more perfect. The neighborhood is quiet and so is the train. We drove into downtown everyday and it typically took us 20 minutes or so to the loop even during peek hours. Public transit surrounds the area shooting off in all different directions along with the pink line a few blocks away. The space is exactly as shown. We spent 5 weeks here and never really had to buy anything other than personal items. The owners were responsive and “real” people in the city who responded to a couple of surprise issues that they rectified in a reasonable time. The price is right for an extended stay in the city…we longed for a bit more excitement in the neighborhood, but that also made us venture out in all the random directions that public transit will take you within a short walk from the apartment. The space won’t disappoint! Thanks for a nice summer to you both E&E!
Loved the home and the peaceful neighborhood. Martha was very friendly.
Our stay was perfect! Amazing location, we were able to see all the famous tourist attractions which were all within walking distance. would definitely recommend!
It was a great stay

This place was perfect! In a great location with lots of places within walking distance! The only downside was the parking but that is as expected in Chicago. Very clean space that was perfect for two!
Near to downtown but noise in ac machine  and surroundings has few noise , bathroom shower also has noise.
Joe was very accommodating and welcoming despite it being a last minute booking. Everything was clean and the instructions provided very clear and helpful. I definitely enjoyed my time in Chicago!
Checkin and checkout were so easy. Neighborhood is beautiful and walking around was nice!

Irena was awesome! She was very responsive and helpful when we had questions about the place. The place itself was beautiful, full of character, and very updated and nice. I couldn't recommend this place enough!
Really enjoyed our stay here! Super comfortable bed, nice amenities, and loved the bathroom. Also great location near restaurants and a short walk to the CTA

We had an excellent stay! It was perfect for our family of five. The place matched the description and pictures exactly. Very walkable and lots of resturants. The views of the city were amazing. Brett was very responsive. Highly recommend!

Great location, not too far from the loop. Fulton market is just a 15 minute walk and there’s bus stops at all ends of the neighborhood which is good. The owner was very responsive and nice. I didn’t pay much attention at times,  just put your earbuds in and you’ll be chillin. Would book this place again!! Hopefully I get to come back; it’s an amazing city!

Jay's place made our birthday weekend feel like a true home away from home!
We stayed here for my birthday weekend, and even though we live only 7 minutes away, it truly felt like we'd escaped to somewhere special. Jay was an amazing host. He was responsive, attentive, and quick to help when a situation came up during our stay. It's clear he genuinely cares about his guests' experience.
We'd absolutely stay again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable, well equipped getaway. Thank you, Jay, for making our birthday weekend so special!

The host sent clear instructions for easy check in and the place was better than expected. It was very clean, spacious for our group, and a convenient back exit to parking. Have to be grateful for these listings that allow people to stay at a reduced rate in a good neighborhood at a great price point. Had not the accommodation been so affordable I don't think I would have made the trip.
It was a very nice place to stay, very cozy and clean. Hosts were very friendly and communicative. Definitely recommend a stay here if you are visiting Chicago.
Great and clean place, washer and dryer always a plus! Rolando and Co-host friendly and responsive.

Spotless, quiet, clear instructions and do's/don'ts that make the fact that this is a shared space much more appealing than not.
For the price paid, the private bathroom, kitchen and conveniences, I'd stay again if I needed a Chicago spot in a pinch.
As long as you're okay with a brief scooter jump/bus to get to the train, this one is for you 👍🏼

Marco’s place worked great for a weekend in the city. The location was excellent, the space was clean and well-maintained, and Marco was super responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Would definitely recommend!

David’s place was the perfect location for our first trip to Chicago! The location was ideal, right next to a train stop and nestled in a very walkable neighborhood filled with great restaurants. David was amazingly responsive, and helped us with accommodations for our luggage on our departure day. We will definitely return to Chicago to stay here, and would recommend this place to anyone visiting the city!
Nice and clean place. The area was good and I definitely will stay again if it’s available when I come back to Chicago.

Casa confortevole, pulita, con un bel patio all’esterno.
Darius sempre presente per ogni richiesta e ospitale (ci ha lasciato snack dolci e salati) e acqua

You should stay here! I was looking for a quiet place to stay near lots of things to do without any trouble getting to the airport or downtown and that’s exactly what I found here. Darren was a great host and gave very clear instructions for check in and check out. Should I find myself back in Chicago I will definitely check to see if this place is available.
The location for us was extremely convenient as close to our office/warehouse and convenient for O'Hare airport. The kitchen was well equipped and the bed very comfortable.
It was nice. Very family oriented neighborhood
Great stay!
Nice and quiet, in an ok-area. But not far from the united center. Everything was great! Thank you!
The place is exactly as described: very clean, cozy, quiet, and great location.

Great spot to be outside of downtown Chicago but still being close to everything. Quiet neighborhood, always found parking and walkable restaurants nearby. They were super responsive and helpful when asked, going above and beyond to help.
Adrian’s place was a great location for our stay. Easy check in/out. I highly recommend!!!!

Yagoda provided a great condo to accommodate my family visiting Chicago. The highlights was the great condition and location of the condo, the free parking, and the very responsive messaging with the host. My family had a great time and I’m sure you will too!
Incredibly charming room and beautiful neighborhood. Very retro and fits the aesthitic of Chicago.
We stayed in this beautiful place with 2 other couples. The house was spacious and in a nice neighborhood. Street parking was easy. We would stay here again. It was very nice and close to the city.
Place was great! Beds very comfy! Walkable and felt safe. Very clean would definitely stay again!
No problems at all very reliable.

Very Straight, check-in and out are phenomenal.

everything was beautiful, a few things, there is no silverware, and there was a left over bar of soap in the shower when we checked into the Airbnb, other then that everything was clean and looked as the pictures did!
A wonderful stay for 5 weeks in Chicago! A beautiful home with all the amenities I needed. Great area, peaceful, safe, walkable to shops and good transport links. I’d stay again.
The hosts were very kind and friendly! I felt very comfortable in this space. Would definitely book this place again!
Cathy’s place was clean and comfortable and is in a perfect location to walk to Wrigley Field. She was very responsive to messages, and she let us park early so we could walk to the game.

Very good place, location was very convenient.

This was such a great experience. I really appreciate the accommodations I received throughout my whole stay.  I would highly recommend booking here if you have a concert to go to or want to just explore Chicago, but be a little further away from the hustle and bustle of downtown.
Unusually clean kitchen and bath for a shared stay at this price point. Would do it again

Two minute walk to Wrigley Field & the Redline. Perfect location for a Cub game and the whole dang city! Spotless, warm, cozy! Will stay again.

Once again, thank you,  Olivia, for having us

Super close to United Center, so it was perfect location for us to stay when we had a concert there! Walkable, and street parking! We enjoyed it, the team was communicative and kind. Thank you so much!

Amazing location and beautiful apartment!
Great experience
Great space, in a good location. Urban Pantry was a good market and First Draft was a great local bar.

The location of the house is really good, with lots of great restaurants and vintage shops. We were comfortable walking around in the night as well, neighborhood seemed very safe and friendly.

Perfect location to work at the university. The apartment is surprisingly well equipped for an Airbnb and the hosts are ideal. Thanks for everything 😁

Family and enjoyed the stay will be back with future visits

This is one of the best rental we had! When your wife is happy with your decision, it is definitely a great place to rent! We had a great time! I wish we stayed for longer. My kids are missing it! Highly recommend this property!

Great place to get to after a long day of exploring! Very comforting and a place to relax.

great down town loaction.. Can walk to theater district and Millenniam Park. Close to train and loop
