Edita was very easy to communicate with and always responded promptly.

This was my family’s second stay at the property. We would definitely stay again and recommend this beautiful home! It is spacious, the neighborhood is great, we walked to get food and coffee each day. We had everything we needed for a comfortable home away from home!
A great stay!
A nice clean place to stay. Conveniently right next to bus stop. I enjoyed my stay.
What a great spot in a fantastic location. Thank you so much.
The stairs are killer but it’s a cute little place to stay!

Marco and Sarah’s place was excellent. My friends and I really enjoyed our stay here. It’s walking distance to a few stores, and restaurants. We definitely took advantage of that. The neighborhood is really calm, quiet and friendly. I saw many friendly people walking their happy dogs and such. A nice sight. The beds were very comfortable, and so was the couch. We had everything we needed. I appreciated the hosts prompt responses to any of my questions. Beautiful place and great neighborhood. I would stay here again and highly recommend.

The place itself was fine but as soon as you walk in the place smells extremely mildewy (most likely due to a faulty ac) so if you are sensitive to strong smells this is not the place for you. The parking situation was a bit of a hassle too but once i asked the host for parking passes they left more for us.

Uriel was an amazing host. I stayed in the apartment for 2 months and it was always a great stay. The place is equipped with everything you need. It’s also in safe neighborhood with good access to public transportation.

It’s a nice apartment and a beautiful neighborhood. Great restaurant, the park and beach is just 10-15 min walking distance. Perfect connections to the Chicago Loop by Bus or Brown line.
Different utilities in the apartment are a bit old and did not function properly (freezer, TV). We were told that the team looks into it after our stay.
If you want to wash bring quarters (2x8 for washing machine and dryer; would be great if this could change to pay by card).
Keep in mind that the bed length is only ~1.85 meter which is rather short.
Good neighborhood. Host has good house instructions. Would recommend to any family coming by to visit the Chicago area.

First of all, I can say that cloud nine and this property are absolutely amazingly perfect perfectly Managed. I cannot even begin to describe how well furnished how thoughtful and impressive the cloud nine team is.
I’ll give you a few points that really stood out.
1. Never ever have I seen a ticked fridge with yogurts, cheese, milk, tortillas, eggs. Wow wow! It was so nice to cook up a breakfast with what they had.
2. They included sleep masks and ear plugs bed side.
The only downside, warning to light sleepers or workers from home. The train next to the apt is loud, very loud and can disrupt sleep. I didn’t wear the earplugs because they can hurt my ears but just a heads up of surrounding noise. Also, the location itself has some serious sound issues with hearing EVERYTHING going on in the corridor and doors opening and closing.
But, this is not indicative of the value. I loved the place. Location perfect for restaurant galore. Really amazing views. Will go with cloud9 again!

The place was solid and a great value for the price. The host was awesome with communication, and check-in was very smooth and easy.
The house itself was clean and comfortable. Having two bathrooms is super convenient, and the kitchen is spacious with a great fridge. The only small thing was that there wasn't a drying rack for wet dishes, so I wasn’t sure where to leave them after washing.
For the location, being right next to the Blue Line is really convenient to get downtown or move around the city. However, I didn't feel completely safe in the neighborhood at night. It is fine during the day, but after dark, I would definitely recommend taking an Uber or taxi rather than walking around.
Overall, it is an affordable stay and a good deal, especially if you plan to use rideshares in the evening!
We had a great time! Thank you!

The room was immaculately clean and well furnished. The bed was very comfortable and there was a desk and a chair. The temperature was very comfortable, though there was a fan in the room if I needed it. The bathroom was also very clean and convenient to the room. The house was built in the 1950s, but has obviously been recently updated to be very bright and open.
The house is located in a very nice and safe neighborhood with well kept houses, sidewalks, and street lamps. I parked my car on the street and had no worries about doing so. There was a very good deli and some convenience stores about a .5 mile walk from the house, which was perfect in nice weather, but might be a bit far if it's cold or stormy.

The airbnb was in a great area and parking was easy. There is a bus stop 5 minutes away that made transportation to the L easy. The host also continuously sent check up messages and provided suggestions on what we can do in Chicago!
He was very responsive and came out when we had an issue. Awesome guy and great place to stay.
Loved the location! Would love to return! Just be mindful to bring extra blankets and detergent for the washer
Karina was a great host! She left very clear instructions for the place and even gave us a bunch of helpful recommendations. Definitely the best Airbnb host I have had thus far.

Matt’s place was perfect. Very cozy and comfortable. It is in a great neighborhood location. We walked to coffee each morning. Great shops and restaurants. Would definitely stay again!  Matt is very responsive and accommodating

Felicia’s place was exactly what we needed! It was immaculately clean and organized, close to the train and ICO, safe, comfortable, and quiet. The shower was indulgent! The coffee was so good (sorry Felicia we almost used it all🤭). Communication was immediate! We heard 0 sounds from upstairs. I highly recommend this Airbnb. We were a husband and wife dropping our baby off at ICO and having this welcoming and convenient stay made our trip wonderful. Felicia even left me an iron upon my request so that I could iron all of his shirts ❤️. We look forward to visiting him asap because we fell in love with Chicago! I’ll be heartbroken if Felicia’s place is unavailable so I shouldn’t give it such raving reviews, but I’d be lying if I said it was anything less than perfect.
Laura T’s place was good! Clean and accurate to the description

Kevin's place is very clean and spacious. The combination of a parking spot and proximity to the 'L' station makes it easy to get anywhere you would want in the city. The street is quiet and close to old town restaurants.
Great place to stay with plenty of parking and a short walk to the blue line. Our family had a great visit to Chicago and would stay here again!

Great place to stay at while visiting Chicago for a few days! Close to a bus stop that takes you to the Brown Line to get into the city, which is about an hour and a half all together. After turning on the AC unit once we arrived, the place cooled down pretty fast + we appreciated the box fan. The unit was clean and spotless when we got there, too. The area around the place was also quiet enough to get a good night’s sleep (we didn’t use the earbuds but we appreciated it!) Vin was extremely responsive and nice when communicating with him.
Would definitely consider booking again!
Nice area and place! There was some laundry left over in the machine and the soap was running out in the bathroom but minor grievances for an otherwise nice spot!

I enjoyed staying at Carlos place! The host was very accommodating and very quick with responses prior to the trip and even at the end! The place was very clean and walkable to restaurants and public transportation
Great stay, was so glad I chose Jennifer’s place.
We really enjoyed our two month stay. Bozena responded almost immediately to every question and request. We hope to return when we visit our family next year.

The place was exactly as described. It felt safe and the neighborhood felt safe as well. We easily got to the redline and could walk the mile or so to the Bean.
The only draw backs were me not reading everything well. I couldn’t find the entrance but it was late and my kids were tired. If I would have watched the video I would have known where to do.
I also didn’t read the reviews that the loft had railings that young ones (my 3 year old) could easily fall down to the lower level. I just had to be aware and keep her on the main floor. Bottom line everything was great and a perfect place to land after a big day. The hosts were very responsive and concerned about our well being. I would stay here in the future.
Perfect location to sightsee. My teens loved the gym and basketball court. Clean apartment with comfy beds. Would stay again!
Great location. Tiny claustrophobic bedroom, so we slept on the couch.
Thank you for the great stay! Perfect location and it had everything we needed.
Great place, great host -- worked mostly with Jeff. Very responsive and friendly. The space was spacious and pristine.
Great location and comfortable space. Hosts were very responsive to any questions/needs we had. The location is an easy walk to Millenium Park and there are delicious restaurants steps away.
Muchas gracias Marissa excelente todo
Ryan was such a friendly and attentive host. We didn’t have any questions throughout our stay as he was very informative. We also loved the history and character of the home!
Kim's place is in an excellent location. It's cozy, comfortable, and a great find in Irving Park.
Good location 10min walk to the united center walk, same distance to the blue line which takes you all around Chicago and can transfer to the red line.
Todo bien, ubicación excelente y muy limpio el lugar, muy amables en todo tiempo
A solid Airbnb in a good location. The room was comfortable although a nice chair would be appreciated. All in all I had a good stay

One of the best airBnBs we stayed. A quick drive from the Chicago downtown and tourist spots, dedicated parking, peaceful neighborhood. The apartment is at the 4th floor and you will need a main door entry key and the apartment entry key. The main entrance is at the other side of the parking (We had some confusion about the entry). But other than that, the apartment is perfect with all amenities, consumables. There is a Target store, and a gas station nearby for your quick run.

My husband and I came to Chicago for my birthday and absolutely enjoyed our time! The home was very clean and looks exactly like the pictures listed. The host is friendly and responsive. From most areas of Chicago like West Loop, Downtown and South Loop it’s a 15-20 minute drive to the city. There are some places a bit further that take 25 minutes like Oak Park. We could’ve taken advantage of the public transit since it was close by as well. The area is very chill and quiet. We would stay here again when coming back!

Nice place to stay. An hour away from the downtown chicago by transit.
A bus station is right outside the door. You get to train station in 5 min. On that bus.

This garden apartment was exactly as described.  You enter through Raymond’s house and you have the entire downstairs to yourself.  Perfectly quiet and the hosts were more than helpful with local surroundings and suggestions. Would book again without a pause.!!
Karla was the best host! She catered to all our needs with genuine care. The Airbnb quickly felt like a home and the neighborhood is great for a stroll. Thoroughly enjoyed my stay 👏🏽

I had forgotten something 8 hours away and had to have an Amazon package delivered. She was very flexible, open, and understanding and said she would watch for the package! She’s also very responsive! We absolutely loved this space and would stay there again!
Super walkable, near public transportation. Comfortable beds and linens. The host was super helpful and responsive! They gave really clear instructions. Great stay!!

Enjoyed our stay and were able to get in and out easily with Milan’s clear instructions. The apartment was very cozy and clean with great views, including views of Rate field. Thank you for your wonderful hospitality!

We enjoyed our stay at the Bee’s Knees for our trip to Chicago to celebrate my parent’s 50th anniversary. Our group of 10 found it to be comfortable and convenient. We especially liked how well maintained the home was and that the garage was large enough to fit our two minivans with ease. Adam’s communication was excellent and he even helped us find a place to get some great pizza!
We would recommend staying here.
Room is great. Did encountered a house centipede at 5am though.
The apartment was perfect for our visit to Uptown Chicago where our son lives. The space was clean and calming amidst a busy city.
The apartment was clean and equipped with everything what we needed. Marisa as a host was really helpful and responsive. We enjoyed the time spent in Chicago
This is a room for everyone!
Place was easy to find it’s a small place but it has everything you could want there is a couple of ants that we saw in the bathroom

The apartment was cute and clean. We were able to drive or uber to the sites we wanted to see with ease. A note to future guests: plan to park in the designated spot behind the building. There is street cleaning on one side of the street on Thursday and the other Friday, we did not have any success locating a spot on the street. Also, in relation to accessibility, you need to be able to navigate stairs: There are 10 steps to get into the front of the  building. Once inside you have 18 steps to climb. There is a handrail inside but there is a gap in the railing about halfway up. We had  an issue with noise within the apartment building in the middle of the night which was resolved promptly.

この度は素晴らしい宿泊施設を提供頂きありがとうございました。
リグレーフィールドで数試合観戦した我々にとってはこの上ないロケーションでした。
ナイトゲーム後でも安心して帰路につくことができることは、我々のような小さい子供のいる家族にとってはとても重要なファクターです。
また、ダウンタウンへのアクセスも比較的良く、初めてのシカゴ旅行を満喫させて頂きました。
宿泊施設自体についての評価です。
良い点は、電子レンジや冷蔵庫、ランドリーといった設備が充実していたため、長期滞在する上で毎日助かりました。またベッドが広く快適でした。
悪い点は、あえて言うならボディーソープがなかったくらいです。
総じて大変良かったです。
滞在中の最も残念だったことは、チェックイントラブルです。
ホスト様より事前に午後4時以降のチェックインで通達されていたため午後4時に訪室するも、宿泊施設内は清掃されていませんでした。すぐにホスト様へ連絡しましたが1時間以上返信がなく、最終的に清掃遅延でチェックインを午後6時に変更する旨の内容の返信が届きました。長旅で子供もかなり疲れていたため、ホスト様へ許可を得た上で清掃業者が来る前に宿泊施設へ入らせて頂きました。なお、清掃業者の方は子供たちが休めるように最初にベッドメイキングして頂き、その気遣いにとても感謝しています。
宿泊初日のチェックイントラブルは、長旅で疲れ切ったゲストの心証に大きな影響を与えます。
今回の原因は清掃業者の緊急事態による清掃遅延でしたが、ホスト側で事前に確認できていれば、少なくともチェックイン前にゲストへ通知できたはずです。ホストが午後4時以降のチェックインを指定したのであれば、午後4時にチェックインできる状態か確認することは、ホストとして最も重要な仕事の一つです。これを怠らなければ、事前に清掃遅延を通知でき、我々の心証を損なうこともなかったでしょう。
さらに、午後4時に送信したゲストからの連絡を1時間以上返信できないのは論外です。チェックイン当日は、トラブル時にゲストと迅速に連絡が取れる体制を整えておくことが重要です。
以上から、本来総合5点のところ4点に減点しました。
今後も運営される上でお役立ていただければ幸いです。
しかしながら、とても素晴らしい宿泊施設を提供頂きありがとうございました。
シカゴが大好きな街になりました。

We chose Mirnas place because it made a good impression on us in a safe neighborhood. When we stayed there, Mirnas friendliness and responsiveness especially stood out to us, making us feel right at home. The place is connected well to public transport and the neighborhood is very walkable, with parks, bus stops, small shops and a grocery store nearby. The whole place was clean and prepared for us, and if we needed anything (like a A/C Temperature change) Mirna was able to help right away. Since the place is owner occupied, we did occasionally hear the tapping of their dog above, and people walking, but very normal and expected noises. The couch bed mattress was a bit wonky, but again nothing out of the ordinary and I slept great.
Great stay. Awesome host and place was exactly as described. Comfortable and cozy.

The location was perfect for what we needed, with easy access to everything nearby. Every detail felt thoughtfully considered, from the cozy furnishings to the little welcome touches that made it feel like home right away.
If you’re looking for a budget friendly place to stay in Chicago, i recommend. We used free street parking and then used public transport to get around.

The Airbnb was beautiful. It was in a great location had plenty of space great size rooms a relaxing area in the basement a nice open kitchen area two bathrooms was one of the best Airbnb‘s. I’ve seen other than parking but I think that’s just a Chicago thing but me and my family enjoyed ourselves we had great hosts

Haben uns sehr wohl und zuhause gefühlt.
Jederzeit wieder

We were here for Ariana at the United Center! When i tell you this location was perfect it was so easy to get to the venue and not having to worry about parking and transportation around. Definitely would stay again! The listing is indeed true to is description but would love to stay again for sure! Great area!
One thing i will note is Chicago parking is crazy.. that is not her doing obviously she can’t control that. just a side note for future.
Very good had a good stay

Perfect location if you love Lincoln Park and the Zoo. Bus stops to take you north/south and east/west are only a block away. Noise is minimal and the apt had everything we needed for a week’s stay to work, explore and eat.
The apt worked perfect for our family of 3. The kitchen had the basic amenities so we were able to cook simple meals.
Towels and sheets were clean.

I had a lovely stay!  Amelia helped us out upon arrival to get into the house. The house had great amenities and our stay here was very comfortable. Highly recommend and would definitely stay here again!
Great spot!

Samuel was a great host. The location was perfect for walking. Parking passes for street parking was easy and there was plenty of open spaces. It was very clean. Will definitely come back and recommend to others.
We loved our stay here.  Easy to locate, walkable.
thank you for letting us stay!

Great location in a fun neighborhood with easy “L” access to downtown and O’Hare. We needed to shorten our stay last minute but found the apartment was well-equipped for cooking and hanging out. We did enjoy the private patio and the rooftop patio. The night-time views were gorgeous.
Paul was a great host, would recommend for anyone looking to stay in Lincoln park. Great location!

Alisar and Eric, thank you for a lovely stay. We appreciate how thoughtfully you've streamlined the rental experience and how well you care for your historic home. Staying at your property gave us peace of mind that our fur babies were safe while we were out enjoying the city. Your neighborhood is the perfect peaceful setting for walking and quality rest. We will absolutely consider your property for future visits to Chicago. Thanks again.
Mrig was the best AirBnB host I have ever had!! I will be coming back here the next time I visit.
Felt right at home, the space was immaculately clean, cozy environment, comfy beds! The only thing to mention is that there is no A/C, however there was fans and a dehumidifier. We had a great stay!
Had a great time. Nice place with a wonderful view. Right next to the Red Line, so it was a perfect place to explore the city. Karen was responsive and super friendly.

This basement/garden apartment is in a peaceful neighborhood that is very close to the city. The furniture, kitchen, bathroom, and overall unit were exceptionally clean and well-maintained. The backyard is also beautiful and very green. However, future guests should know that this basement/garden apartment is with limited natural light. We also had a minor issue with the bathroom sink tap, but the host resolved it quickly and professionally. It is a nice place for 2-3 days of stay.
Great place in a great location! Host was very kind and responsive to any question. The place looked just like the photos! Would stay here again!!

Silvia's place was amazing. I honestly enjoyed how close it was to the bus line to the airport and to Obama's Presidential Center. I stayed here because of how close it is to the bus line, the grocery store, UChicago, and even the Green train line. It was quite convenient having the place close to the train station, as it was easy to get to the United Center and all. I also appreciated how thorough Silvia was about instructions. Everything was clear and specified within all the materials.

My best friend and I stayed 3 nights here and it was great! The place looked just like the pictures and was very clean. The shower was nice, the beds were soft and the patio was relaxing. The apartment was perfect for the 2 of us, any more people would’ve felt cramped.
The one small complaint I have is the parking situation. It’s street parking, and if you get there after 7-8, it’s very hard to find a spot on that street. We could always find a spot on a nearby side street though, and the walk wasn’t bad. I would recommend this place to others and stay here again!

nice place, it seems far from the city but if you take bus from Devon station to Jefferson park you can ride the blue train ( aka CTA) which directly connect you to the city or the airport! Nice area. It’s apparently one of the safest area in Chicago as well.
Great location and host was very communicative.

Loved our stay at David's place!  Spacious and lovely and a short commute via public transportation (VERY short via Lyft!) to all the destinations we wanted to see as first time visitors to Chicago. Highly recommend!
Enjoyed staying here. Joan was really nice and fast to respond. The place was super clean and cute. Would definitely stay again
Great stay but location isn’t the best. Aiste was always responsive and kind

We had a very nice stay. The unit was clean and in a great location, with easy access to the train line, plenty of restaurants nearby, and beautiful parks within walking distance. It was a convenient and enjoyable area to explore.
The unit is on the second floor with no elevator, so guests should be comfortable with the stairs. The bathroom could also use some updating, but overall, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the cleanliness and excellent location.

Large bedroom and very comfortable bed. I appreciated the lock on the bedroom door. I realized that I left something in my room after checkout and the host was very responsive and helped me get it back promptly.

Awesome location and was very clean with high quality painting/bedding. Had thick walls and great air conditioning, and our host was very responsive and friendly. Was a bit smaller than expected, however, had everything that we needed!

Jeff was an outstanding host that was responsive and eager to make sure I had everything I needed during my stay. Absolutely 5 star host. Great space that made my time in Chicago very easy. Parking was extremely easy, and the space felt private and secure. Bed was comfortable and everything very clean. I would absolutely stay here again.

Dave is a great host. Great communicator and the place is very clean. Accurately described and perfectly comfortable. Great proximity to the train and Andersonville. Thank you!!
Also loved the whole bean coffee and grinder - fresh!

We had an amazing stay thanks to our host! Communication was excellent. Ninoc was always responsive and had great recommendations for our visit. The location felt very safe and made it easy to get around to many different areas. The apartment was clean, exactly as described, and had everything we needed. Can’t recommend this place/host enough!
Great communication and everything we needed was available.

A really cute stay. Responsive host and accomodating. Within walking distance to CTA buses that take you right into Chicago’s CBD. There are plenty groceries and restaurants close by and a family friendly neighbourhood with a public park around the corner. Did not mind sharing the living space as we were out most of the day anyways and only bumped into each other in the evenings. Overall great first experience in the USA 👌
El mejor lugar para conocer Chicago, barrio seguro y cerca de todo. El departamento precioso, limpio, comodo.

Great place to stay- nice rooms, excellent location, and the cherry on top is the rooftop. Depending on the schedule, late afternoons and evening the rooftop is available with an open bar, games, and outdoor seating to enjoy the views. Would stay here again!
Solid place to land if you’re bopping around north side

We had a nice stay overall! The apartment was older but very clean and smelled nice when we arrived. The location was convenient and within walking distance of stores and restaurants.
The apartment could use a few updates to the furniture and bathroom, but everything was clean and we had what we needed.
Our host was truly wonderful. She was very kind, responsive, and quick to answer any questions we had. We also had a delay with our ticket and she kindly allowed us to stay an extra hour at no additional cost. She was very understanding and accommodating throughout our stay.
Thank you for being such a great host! ❤️

Loved staying at Sheena’s. It was so clean and my daughter kept commenting about how good it smelled! Sheena provided nice amenities and we really appreciated some of the basics until we could get some groceries: eggs, milk, butter, granola bars, coffee, and a multitude of teas amongst other snacks. My daughter and I enjoyed the Korean face masks, popcorn, and a movie using the projector for a couple of nights we were there. Someone else described this place as a “Diamond in the rough”, and I agree with that assessment. Overall the neighborhood was mostly quiet. The place felt very secure with three locked doors on the front and two locked doors on the back. I enjoyed sitting on the back porch with some coffee in the morning and seeing the random stray cats, and one evening a family of raccoons! Sheena’s place was spacious including two very nice bathrooms, both with showers, and a washer and dryer for use. I would book here again and recommended to friends.
We had a really great experience! Laura was a great host and checked in to make sure everything was going well. 100% will book with her again next time we are in town!
Nice stay, great for a quick trip for a concert or a weekend stay. Host uses third party platform for security deposit and ID verification.
Todd was great to work with! Would definitely stay here again if we are back in the Chicago area!
Great stay in Chicago! Super helpful host, and the space was very clean and comfortable. A great stay!
It was in a good location near bus and train stations. The Airbnb was spacious
Really great stay and we used public transit to the fullest and had an amazing time
The apartment was in a perfect location, always easy to find parking, and very cozy and nice inside.  We were so comfortable and had everything we needed!

We went to a wedding at Thalia Hall and this location was perfect! We got in a day early to explore Pilsen and we loved the neighborhood and the food. You can’t park right in front of the house without a permit, but we found parking on the same street down a block, so that worked out.
Great location, clean room and nice host. A very recomendable place to stay in Chicago
Great place, great host
Great location, super clean, easy to check in and check out. Loved it 🙏🏻

Laura’s place was perfect for our weekend getaway. The place was exactly as described and had all the basic amenities as outlined. The decor and furniture selection was really well thought through and laid out perfectly. Laura was also very flexible with the checkout time and was able to accommodate a late checkout for us. I would highly recommend her place to anyone visiting Chicago.

Located in a great walkable area, near restaurants & bars + vintage shopping. Ideal for a shorter-term stay. For a longer term stay/work from home space, note it’s an internal unit without a lot of natural light, but there are plenty of cool coffee shops nearby to work from.
The place was beautiful, easy to find, I would highly recommend to anyone needing a place to stay, the bed was extremely comfortable and me and my friend enjoyed our sleep there!
Bad order other people shared in Airbnb had access to my room code terrible terrible experience and still haven’t gotten a refund
The place is nice and cozy. It’s spotless and organized. I definitely recommend the place if you rent a car because street parking is never guaranteed. Especially, if you come back late.

We had a wonderful stay. It was just as described, and stocked with anything you might need. We also received a list of recommended restaurants and activities in the area. Would definitely stay there again!

Abacus was an amazing host!  He was very responsive and informative. He provided in-depth information and responded promptly whenever questions arose. The house looked just like the pictures, was clean, and very comfortable!  We felt at home during our stay.

Great place to stay. Felice is very responsive and makes check in and check out a breeze. She has lots of recommendations for fun things to do that are a bit more off the beaten path and loves talking travels with like-minded folks! Her place is very nice and at a very good price. The 10-minute walk to the red line is very convenient and it is also easy to walk to the lake. I would happily stay here again.

I loved staying at your airbnb! I had a very relaxing, stress free stay! Everything was awesome and I was well taken care of. Would love to stay here again if the opportunity arose. I just want to thank you for having me and the great hospitality!

Byron

We had a wonderful stay at Omar‘s house.  Everything is so convenient and clean and the space was really what we needed.  It is huge.   We had a serious medical emergency on this trip to Chicago and we really needed flexibility and kindness.  Omar was so so kind and supportive. We would love to stay again under better circumstances.   We highly recommend this place.

Check in was easy the location was perfect walking to Ohio street beach, river walk and the Navy Pier all 10 to 15 walk. Restaurants all close. The room is exact the photos super clean nice staff.  I needed a late check out due to a late flight, I paid $50 extra and was no problem til 3 pm.  I had an excellent stay.
Room was nice . Located on Randolph street in walking distance to restaurant row, riverwalk, and the bridges. Will definitely stay again.
The kids and I felt very at home all week 😊
big rooms. great neighbor hood. great for a big group. easy to find

dan’s place was perfect and felt safe for our girls trip. a short drive to the city but was also its own private, quiet area with locks and fences in the front and back of the house. the water pressure was great, the rooms were cozy, and we were all in agreement that we would definitely consider staying here again next time we come out to chi!
dan is an excellent, communicative, responsive host who clearly demonstrates hospitality and understanding. dan has clear expectations, house rules, and directions, and is happy to provide local recommendations. dan is the kind of host that truly makes you feel welcome!
Loved my stay I will  be booking again !

Cute space to stay at! Check in was flexible with coming in a bit late, Olga was very polite and explained the common areas thoroughly. Location is walking distance from public transportation, stores, and food spots. The room #1 is separated from other rooms, has good storage for luggage, a mini fridge and the private bathroom is a huge plus! I would definitely come back and I recommend for people to go check it out!
Cozy place! Very clean. Perfect for one person or a couple. Kindve not too far from everything
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. The host was incredibly welcoming and made me feel right at home. We were warmly welcomed and treated with generosity.
Check in was easy, the place was clean, the street/neighborhood was super nice!

Was an amazing stay! Got home where people were getting picked up from the concert at United Center. So walkable & accessible to transit for the rest of Chicago exploring. Will definitely try to book this place again!

Highly recommend!  We had everything we needed, the location is amazing, and the place is super cute. Good towels - which is a huge plus for me.  The unit is located directly above the Hollywood Grill, which was incredibly convenient. Walkable to great restaurants. The parking space is a huge plus!

Had a great experience! The condo was well kept, in an excellent location, and Abhineyt was a very responsive and proactive host. Would recommend for anyone seeking an extended stay on the west side of downtown Chicago.
Great place safe walk to many places

The room, linens, bathroom, and even common spaces were all very clean. Other guests were quiet and respectful. The location in Pilsen is charming and convenient, about a 5 minute walk to the Pink Line. Great for solo travel
Perfect spot and absolutely cozy!

The 5th floor unit where we stayed is a 2 block walk to Roosevelt station on the CTA.
Trader Joe’s is a short walk.
The 3rd. floor outdoor seating area was a nice amenity.
Giordanos and Chicago Firehouse Restaurant is an easy 1- 2 block walk.
Really enjoyed my stay! Michael was very easy to reach out to and very helpful. Great location which made for a great time in Chicago.

The home was delightful, everything as described and better. Beds were comfortable. It was nice to have an office space, very usable kitchen and living room area. Communication was easy and quick. I highly recommend this home . Thanks for a lovely stay.

The place was great! We really loved it and had a great time, the only problem was that there was no parking on premises as stated on the description so you have to park on the street and there are certain days and hours where you can’t park, so we got a ticket the first day just beware about that and the fact that the pipes and the AC are really noisy at times, but other than that everything was great and the place was beautiful

Marteki's place is as described -  a comfortable, well-designed and well-equipped space in a historic building in Bronzeville.  We much appreciated the excellent AC for our summer visit and the thoughtful little details such as  the snacks.  Some characteristics, that have been mentioned by others, and may been more relevant when choosing a place for some than others - the upstairs neighbors' kids are early risers, access up stairs to reach the unit,  and scented products used.  Marteki is a super-hostess.
Maria is an excellent host. Would stay again
Very walkable area and access to the CTA and the public transportation in general.

Sky was quick to respond, accommodating, and clearly put a lot of thought into making the place comfortable for guests. The place was clean, neat, and very well organized. Everything was labeled, which made it incredibly easy to find what we needed.
We really appreciated the thoughtful extras, like toothbrushes, feminine products, plenty of towels, cooking condiments, pillows, blankets, and even phone chargers. Those little touches made the stay feel especially welcoming and convenient.
The location was near, grocery stores, pharmacies, restaurants, coffee shops, and bars. It was also just a short drive from downtown Chicago.
Overall, our stay was pleasant, comfortable, and we would stay there again.

I want to preface by saying I believe I had a very unique experience. Inconveniences that did not affect my review are the “freezer” shelf not working, the fridge leaking, the bright hallway lights in the middle of the night, the shared iron/vacuum that were missing 50% of the time, having to bring your own rug, detergent, bath rug, etc, the dusty tables in the basement and the loud construction. My room also had a cigarette/paint smell but once I let Flora know she immediately addressed it. Her communication was pretty good overall. My issues were the fact that my window was about a foot away from a wall - meaning I had no idea if the sun was out as there was no sunlight, and most importantly, a homeless person living under the stairs. As a young woman in her 20s this made me feel extremely unsafe, and I would not have remained in the airbnb if I could have found other accommodation. Overall I see how some people could have enjoyed their stay, but I got quite unlucky.

This was one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed in. It was personal, rather than being run by a large management company. Communication was great, location was fabulous and it was clean and well stocked. Will definitely stay again!

It was wonderful to stay at this place . Location was perfect as we were visiting Chicago down town and commute back and forth was very easy . Parking garage being available was Cherry on the top.  The place was well maintained and it absolutely felt home . Host was very quick in responding to my questions even though we checked in a little late in the night after a long drive . This will be our first option to stay if we visit Chicago again .

This cute little apartment met all of our (family of 4) needs for a four-night-stay in Chicago. Convenient 10-minute walk to the CTA blue line station and a two block walk to the bus stop to go downtown. Very quiet considering it’s in the middle of a city, we didn’t need to use the complimentary ear plugs. A/C was strong and reliable plus ceiling fans were great. Kitchen was well-equipped, and we were grateful for the shelf stable items and condiments left by previous guests. Water filter pitcher in the fridge was also great to have. Check-in and check-out were easy.
super friendly and responded quickly to any questions or concerns, great host!
Great economical location. Right by the station.
Convenient location for a nearby conference I was attending at UChicago. Erica was super helpful and very prompt in responding to queries.
Russell place was clean and easy to find. A good neighborhood. In the center of everything so it was to drive or uber.
Extremely welcoming and great value. Location is very nice and historic well-maintained house.
I had a great time. The hosts were great. The neighborhood was fantastic.
Rida's place was clean, the host was attentive, and the location was further away from restaurants etc but close to the blue line so easy to get into the city.

Our first time in Chicago and hands down! Fulton Market District is the best area to stay in. Trove's place is in a perfect spot! We were so comfortable and enjoyed how close we were to a lot of great places. Can't wait to return soon! Hoping we can stay again!
A great choice for the price.

Steven’s home is absolutely spectacular. I’m normally a “private home” kinda gal but I knew from the listing this would be an incredible experience. His home is full of whimsy, care, thoughtfulness and an impeccable attention to design detail. From start to finish he was an absolutely lovely and gracious host even when I asked dumb questions. It’s too facile to say this is a DIY heaven because the level of craftsmanship for the custom builds throughout his home is so impressive. Big shout out to the hair drying / glam station. Definitely book if you can.

From the moment we arrived, William helped us feel right at home! He gave us very clear instructions on how to use the door during our stay, walked us through where we could find whatever we needed in his home, and both him and his wife were incredibly kind and welcoming during our stay with them.
William’s place is very accessible and easy to find in addition to being in a very beautiful neighborhood! We found that our drive to and from the city was quite easy, even with the Chicago traffic throughout the day.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay with William and Yolanda very much. We travel to Chicago often and we’re looking forward to staying here again in the future!
Great place for the family to have a quick Chicago Vacation!!

Our stay was very comfortable and enjoyable. The place is very well stocked and beautiful decor. One of the best Airbnb I have stayed at. Very kind sweet family that took great care to make our experience great. Thank you.
Great host and places was clean!
Please work on the lobby. There was small pieces of trash in the entrance. The exercise room photos were deceiving. This room was not cleaned & looks like no one managed it.

I had a great 3 months stay here! The place was clean & felt like home. Even though it was punctuated by some freak weather incidents knocking the power out, Caroline was super responsive & on top of getting everything restored to working order as soon as possible. You will feel at rest here!

This place is everything I needed. It’s a quiet and lovely place to stay, with little details that make you feel truly welcome. I definitely recommend it, even for a longer stay. You have everything you need to feel at home.
It’s very close to the Red Line, and there are some really good restaurants nearby. If you haven’t visited Chicago before, you can easily take advantage of the location and explore the whole area. You can also take the water taxi all the way to downtown for a different experience.
I don’t have any complaints. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely come back!
Cute apartment in a great location. Lots of things to do and eat within walking distance.

We are so grateful Lisa offered her home to us. We had a wonderful stay. There is clearly so much love and effort that Lisa has put into curating this space and we enjoyed being welcomed to it!
Lisa was very communicative and so friendly to talk to. We even got to meet her sweet little dog Tober (whom we’ll miss very much!)
Worth every penny and had such a relaxing and convenient stay. Thanks so much Lisa for hosting us!

I cannot say enough good things about Vanessa and her team
They did a great job, accommodating us in short notice and she was super kind and communicative
The house was great Had a nice pool table and some great arcade games

Ignacio's place was convenient, clean and very comfortable. If you arrive late at night parking on the street maybe a little hassle but manageable overall. It was the best value place we found close to where our family is located. Strongly recommend.
Great location with affordable price for short solo trip!
Convenient for those attending U of C events, very straightforward to stay at. Just know what you’re getting into on southside and it works out. Close to train to go downtown too.

I stayed for 5 weeks in the apartment and had a great time!
I felt nice at home as the apartment is well equipped!
The place is perfectly located in the heart of Wicker Park and everything you need (groceries, bars, restaurants) is within short walking distance.
The communication with the host was easy, fast and convenient
I would definitely recommend it further:)

The stay was fantastic. Clear instructions on how to get in the building. The place was amazing, to me it’s what I wish I had. Fair warning, if you’re staying here and have a car, make sure it’s small. My 15 Ford Taurus was just at the edge of making it down small alley and getting turned around  took sometime but doesn’t take away from how great of a place it was to stay at. It felt like home being there.

Apartment was great, a 10 minute walk from an accessible L-train and more wonderful restaurants than you could try in a normal stay.  Place was modern but homey.  Even the front desk staff were super friendly.  The whole thing was great!
I felt comfortable and enjoyed my stay. I would book again.
Great location! Easy to communicate with hosts and very easy to find and access the location. Would book again!
Thank you for a great stay!! Would definitely stay again. Only a 25-30 minute uber drive to downtown.
Épicerie à 5 min de marche, la station de train est a 1 min  très beau cartier et très sécuritaire !!

We had a fantastic stay at the Brown Line Lounge! Justin was an amazing host and an absolute pleasure to work with throughout our entire trip—super communicative, accommodating, and helpful.
The apartment itself is thoughtfully curated, comfortable, and beautifully designed. The space is well-equipped with everything you need, including two full bathrooms and in-unit laundry.
As noted in the description, the apartment sits adjacent to the "L," but the Brown Line noise was absolutely not an issue for us—it really just adds to the authentic Chicago charm!
The North Center location is wonderful, close to local breweries and neighborhood spots, and there’s SpotHero parking available directly across the street. We couldn't have asked for a better stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable Chicago experience!

Everything was excellent; the location is very close to bus 126 and the metro. The hosts were very kind, attentive to our requests, and ready to help at any time. The accommodation was spacious and clean, with a comfortable bed and excellent kitchen and bathroom amenities.
There were nice welcome touches, a welcoming atmosphere, and a quiet environment. I highly recommend it, and if I ever return to Chicago, this would be my first choice for accommodation.
Thank you for everything—Chicago was extraordinary, thanks in part to you!

Really nice place in a great location with a great view.  Reception staff in the lobby were really helpful and friendly.  AC did not keep up but luckily the temperatures were very moderate during our stay.
Tara’s place was awesome and as described. The location can’t be beat if you want to be near Wrigley field. Tara was also very responsive. We would stay here again!

This was our second stay here, and we’d happily come back! We were only in town Thursday and Friday nights this time, and the apartment was exactly what we remembered.
The space is definitely a bit of a time capsule—the living room, dining area, and kitchen are unapologetically 1970s—but that’s honestly part of the charm. It’s comfortable, has plenty of Chicago character, and we love it! The bathroom has been nicely updated, while the rest retains its wonderfully retro feel. What you see in the listing is what you get.
Ben and Karen are also great hosts and very communicative and responsive if anything comes up—though, in our experience, there typically isn’t anything that needs attention!
This was our second visit for a reason. We really enjoy this place and would gladly stay again!
Our host was kind, professional, and respectful through  our stay, whenever we had a question, they answered almost immediately.  Very understanding and professional host.
Thanks for hosting us.  All was great and easy to navigate with the reservation.
Had an amazing stay, very close to public transit and very well kept.
Very clean place and very secure, would 10/10 recommend
Céntrica y con diferentes opciones de líneas de camiones urbanos.
Awesome location, and good sized place that was very clean. The toys for the kids were a big hit. Parking spaces were very key and easy to access. I would stay here again.
Zed was a great host, location was perfect for easy walk to the United Center. Definitely recommend!!!

Location worked out great for my son's internship at Northwestern Feinberg School of Medicine. Beautiful neighborhood. Nice comfortable space with a kitchen allowing you to amenities food at home and enjoy the nearby restaurants and bars. We were a family of four and felt it was just the right amount of space to live comfortably for our 2 month stay. A little bit of preventative maintenance would help but no big issues.
Great place, beautiful views, everything was clean.  It is much better than what is shown in the pictures.
Enjoyed the place and visit
Jason was such a gracious host. We felt right at home, and the space was walkable to Wrigley Field and great neighborhood spots.

We came out to Chicago for my birthday which was yesterday and had an absolute blast. Other than there not being many parking spaces we found a spot and were able to maintain our parking spot the entire week maybe by luck. But the apartment was exactly as described. Definitely would recommend great location!

Overall, we had a good stay. The apartment is located in a very quiet and peaceful area, and the host was kind and easy to communicate with. We especially appreciated his help when we accidentally locked ourselves out: he was very responsive and quickly helped us get back inside.
There were just a couple of things that could be improved. We noticed some ants in the kitchen and in one of the bedrooms, and the laundry area could have been cleaner and had a slightly unpleasant smell. These issues did not significantly affect our stay, but they are worth mentioning.
Overall, it was a positive experience, and we really appreciated the host’s kindness and helpfulness.
10 minute walk to bus and train stations. Clean house and inexpensive.

Ari’s place was great. Very clean and had all the essentials we needed. Great location and lots of places to eat at or order in.
We enjoyed our stay and would love to book again next time.
It was a great and safe stay for family.

I had a good time staying here. It’s a quick walk to grant park and millennium park. It was a lot smaller than I imagined but I didn’t mind it, if you’re a solo traveler or with a friend/partner this is the perfect place to stay . I messaged Ping and she responded quickly and was very helpful. The bnb is right next to L and it is very loud you can hear it night and day , if you’re a light sleeper I suggest
bringing earplugs. The elevator wasn’t working but it wasn’t horrible going up with a suitcase. I will definitely book again next time i’m in the area!
Had such an amazing stay! The condo was very clean and spacious.
Great apartment for a short stay in a great location.

Maximo, was an amazing host. Right from start when I messaged him, we knew it was the perfect place. If we are in the Chicago area again, we would rent again with Maximo at the same property. The property is beautiful and quiet and so well maintained. Exactly as described and pictured. Thank you Maximo!

Had a great stay here! My two friends and I were glad to find something so affordable as we are college students roadtripping on a budget. It’s small, but that’s as described and we really didn’t mind. The couch was surprisingly comfy, and we never had any issues. Would stay again if we’re ever in the area.

The bed was clean, while the bathroom was not. Many hairs on shower drain. Restroom should have been more frequently cleaned as it seems that the cleaner was not professional and it was soft cleaning!
Not much amenities in the kitchen, while at least an electrical kettle is expected to be.

Beautiful high rise complex, incredible amenities, luxury rooftop pool and grill areas, gym, pool table, garage easy to access. City views are amazing. Host is. Try responsive, well worth the cost. My three boys and I had a great time, thanks!

By far one of the most beautiful spaces I’ve ever seen! So gorgeously curated, unique, and full of character.
In addition to the aesthetics, there were countless thoughtful amenities provided, and Johanna was extremely generous and communicative. 10/10 across the board! Highly recommend.
Walking distance to shops and restaurants! Great area. The parking permit was a great help. Thanks. We enjoyed our stay. the lakeview area is  one of our favorite places in chicago.

This was a great Airbnb. Very clean, comfortable and location was great. Close to great shopping and restaurants as well as Wrigleyville.
I would definitely stay again.

We had a great stay here! The location is fantastic, a quiet, tree-lined residential neighborhood with excellent access to public transportation and a great walk score. We used Divvy bikes and rode the El throughout our stay, and everything felt easy to get to.
The unit had a few minor quirks. It’s a bit dark inside with limited natural light, and one bedroom window didn’t stay open. But overall it was totally suitable for our needs and a great value for the location.
Wonderful host. Spacious and comfy house.

We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend this property! The location was fantastic—convenient to everything we wanted to do in Chicago—and we really appreciated how safe and secure the building felt throughout our stay.
The amenities were excellent, and the pool was definitely a highlight for our family. The unit itself was comfortable, well-equipped, and a great home base for our time in the city. We stayed for over a week and truly felt at home. We would happily stay here again on our next trip to Chicago!

My family and I spent a week at this apartment, and it was wonderful. The pool kept the kids happy, the gym kept my husband happy, and the shops right nearby kept me happy. We can’t wait to be back next summer.
Definitely will book again. Thank you for the experience.

Lawrence and KatieJoy's unit was perfect for our needs. I was in town working for 5 weeks, and my wife and kids joined me for 2 of those weeks. The unit is cozy, perfect if you're spending a lot of time out visiting with friends or going on adventures. Beds are comfy, kitchen supports basic cooking, wifi worked just fine, and we were able to log into our own streaming accounts on the provided TV.
The neighborhood has a handful of restaurants and bars within walking distance. Take your kids to the playground at nearby Brands Park. Groceries are a longer walk or quick ride (Aldi, Marianos, Jewel). Easy access to bus service on Belmont or California can get you to Lakeview, Logan Square, and Humboldt Park quickly, plus connections to El trains. Borrow a bike and make use of Chicago's growing network of protected bike lanes.
The hosts are friendly, responsive, and live upstairs with their 4 young children. Early morning noise when the kids get up didn't bother me as a working parent.
Great host, Amazing location. Plenty of street parking. Beautifully renovated and decorated.

The neighborhood and street it is off is amazing. And the hosts gave me an extremely early check in which was very appreciated. The place was clean too.
There were a few minor maintenance things that would get more bothersome if I stayed for more than a couple of days. Curtain shades not rolling up, oven had grease build up that made smoke in the unit, dryer took 2 cycles to dry small load, faucet knobs being backwards.
In general could work around the minor issues in my short stay, and left feeling good it all things considered.

We experienced very minor issues during our stay and the difference between a 3 or 4-star stay is the host’s willingness to help right away. This host gets 5 big stars because while our issues were very minor; they were responsive and attentive almost immediately. Also, kindness nowadays goes a lot farther than it used to and the host was also very nice, remembered aspects of my trip from when we chatted when I originally booked the trip, and was all-around very easy to talk to from planning the trip, to arriving, and throughout to checkout. I will be back in Chicago in a couple of months and am currently looking to book with them again!
The place was nice and Jif made an effort to make it feel comfortable. It is perfect for single travelers.
Great location, easy to access a variety of food and activities in a beautiful neighborhood. Loved my stay!

Tremendous stay. We enjoyed the flat immensely. The location was great to walk over to Wrigley Field, or grab a bite at a million walkable restaurants. Grocery store a block away made it easy to grab any needed items. Easy street parking if needed. Sean is very responsive, we would recommend this stay for sure.
Warmly decorated with lots of charm! Felt at ease in a wonderful location. Would recommend and hope to book again! Thank you Jacqueline.

William's place was at the perfect place for exploring - right next to the red line and several bus stops and easy walking distance to Lincoln Park hot spots. Overall the place had everything we needed and served us well for our month-long stay.
The only complaints I had were that while the place overall was clean, the rug was very dirty, and we did have an issue with the dishwasher breaking and leaking a lot while there, though that was resolved within 2 days.
I would still recommend the place overall!
This place exceeded expectations.   This was our first trip to Chicago, and everything was great.  Having this amazing place to call home for a few days really helped!

I heard noise every night and my grandkids have gotten bitten by something that was on the furniture I think it was bed bugs. I seen 4 roaches. When we checked in it wasn’t any bath towels there so we had to buy some . And the beds were uncomfortable.
Loved our stay!! Around lots of great food options and the park. Would stay again!
Me and my family stayed at Wanda’s place for 4 nights. It’s close to grocery shopping , and restaurants. It very clean and looks like the pictures .

Notre séjour chez Rajeev était parfait. Logement très propre et spacieux. Bien aménagé. Rajeev répond rapidement aux messages et donne de bons conseils. Merci pour les gentilles attentions: bouteilles d'eau, chips, café et thé.
Nous recommandons ce logement qui se situe à 45 mns du loop en métro. Cela fait du bien de se retrouver au calme après l'activité de la ville de Chicago. La quartier de Lincoln Square est aussi très agréable.
Michael was a very good host. He responded very quickly to all of our needs. We would recommend staying here.
The place felt very safe and secure. It was clean and affordable. Geo was quick to respond. Very nice apartment space for what we needed. To no fault of Geo’s, parking was a bit of a challenge.
Great location in River North and plenty of space! Omar was responsive and made getting in and out easy.  Highly recommend

The place worked very well for our needs! David was very responsive and was eager to answer any questions we had. A few nightstands and some of the blinds were a little dusty, but the listing is just as described. There was some struggle in adjusting the thermostat, as the touch screen is not very responsive but David was able to adjust the temperature remotely. The place is also close to bus stops which helped tremendously.
I had a lovely stay. The location is convenient, safe neighborhood and Matthew was a great and very helpful host.

If your traveling with a car, it’s a great place because there is a parking lot across the street with 24/7 security. Fairly priced too.
Great host
First and foremost, Geo was extremely nice and very helpful! The place was beautiful and comfy! Can’t wait to come back to Chicago and stay here!
Kevin’s listing was great! Neighborhood is very walkable and our stay was very relaxing. Definitely recommend!

This was one of the best airbnb’s we had ever stayed in! The house was extremely comfortable and beautifully furnished, the location was impeccable with how close it was to Logan Square and the blue line, and the host was so kind and communicative. As someone who’s picky with their lodging choices, I cannot recommend this home enough for your travels!!! Do yourself a favor and BOOK THIS HOME!
Everything was great especially the location is good because it’s in downtown
The location was perfect for our needs.
Great host, very responsive and accommodating. The unit was very nice and conveniently located. The offsite parking was worth the extra cost, made everything easier.

La ubicación del lugar es perfecta.
No me gustó que comparte baño con todas las habitaciones, estaba sucio todo el tiempo, poco higiénico.
Great place to stay! Very quiet and safe neighborhood! Would defintely recommend to anyone!
The apartment was very nice and bigger than we expected. It fit our large family well and the proximity to the city was closer than we thought. Overall, it was a great place.

The space was comfortable and clean, in a leafy, walkable neighborhood near transit and restaurants.
Downsides included that the toilet paper role, towel ring, and towel bars were all broken / not attached.
The place is excellent and clean, and the location is close to absolutely everything.

We really enjoyed staying at Karen’s place. It was close enough to walk to Wrigley Field, but also very quiet. There were great breweries nearby, and amazing used bookstore, and wonderful ice cream. We loved being in a non-touristy neighbourhood that was still very accessible. Also, lots of wonderful books to peruse in the house! We felt very at home.

Kody's rental was in a quiet neighborhood. We felt safe walking at dusk when it was cooler outside. The AC worked great. The space was clean and free of clutter. The bathroom was stocked with shampoo and conditioner and the shower was large with good water pressure. We appreciated the off street parking, but wish there was a sign to watch the step going through the gate (I twisted my ankle not knowing there was step down). The back alley is VERY well lit at night, which is good for safety, but do bring an eye mask for sleeping in the back bedroom because there are four bright spot lights shining in all night. For the price point the kitchen felt sparse without butter knives, hand towels, or pans to cook/bake with and only one small spoon. Two of the bedroom doors don't close properly, and none of the bedrooms have ceiling fans, so having free standing fans would be nice for circulation. We would stay here again for the location and in hopes of some of these items being added.
Adorable and squeaky clean unit in a fantastic neighborhood. Marijes was super responsive and kind with any questions, and this will be my new go-to spot when visiting family in Chicago!
A great place to stay, as always

This was a wonderful stay and experience! My second time being in Chicago for a concert. I wasn’t planning on being in the city for too long. I came across Brent‘s place. Not only was instructions clear on how to gain access and where to go, the room was immaculate as well.  This is my first time sharing a space and it couldn’t have gone any better. Brett’s guide, kindness, and place really made this trip nice and a breeze! Not to mention the garage for parking was great since I mostly Lyft/walk around the city. I even got the pleasure of meeting Moose! I’d be happy to book this place again!

Loved staying here would 100% stay again! So many bars around so that was fun! Only thing that was difficult was finding parking but it always works out! Everything was clean, beds were so comfortable! This house is so cute as well as the patio. I missed the breakfast which I regret. Lovely stay 10/10 recommend!
Great place to stay nice neighborhood.  Easy access to bus stop not pricy to take Uber's downtown. The only thing is no pizza cutter in Chicago for order in pizza  lol!
Great place to stay
Vince’s place was as he described it. It was clean and a good location. It was a little dated, but fine for how we used it. Vin communicated well.

This was a great location, and place, for our family of 5. There was plenty to do within walking distance of the home, and anything that we wanted to do outside of the area was easily accessible with the Blue Line just a few minutes away.
Naomi was extremely helpful and very responsive to any and all needs that we had. There was some brief confusion on the code to enter, but we talked on the phone in the moment and she fixed it very quickly.
Would definitely recommend this place to a family or a couple looking to explore all that Chicago has to offer. It was the perfect size and the home was immaculate.
Only slight negative is with the Blue Line out back, the park out front, and the local bars nearby, there is a lot of surrounding noises. Naomi did mention this and she does provide some help with mitigation of the noise. The outside noise fades away with some time, but it is noticeable.

We spent a weeklong family vacation at Junni’s house, and it was a great experience.  It was easily accessible, walkable to local restaurants, and we had no issues.  Each kid got their own room, and everyone was happy.  The kitchen was well-stocked with utensils and appliances.  We were surprised with what was supplied - detergent, paper towels, body wash, coffee and creamer, spices, and more.  They definitely care for this property.  The washer and dryer were a valuable add-on.  Street parking on a side street was easy. One side is a two-way street, but we were surprised how quiet it was inside, just a very small amount of typical city noise at night.  Note:  the main bedroom bathroom is the half bath with a full bath across the hall. Beds have fitted sheet and comforter, so bring your own flat sheet if that’s important to you. Overall, it was a great stay, and Junni was a great host - very responsive and helpful. The home was more comfortable than most AirBNB’s we have stayed at.
Loved the apartment.  Easy to access activities in Chicago and quiet location despite a busy street.
This was a great place to stay, close to the United Center! Perfect!

Tamara and Tony have created a literal oasis in a great neighborhood in Chicago. The kids and the adults all had a blast. These are some of the most thoughtful hosts you can hope for in an AirBnB. Everything we needed was conveniently provided. We definitely plan to be back.

The Apartment it's self was
up to date very clean The beds were comfortable to sleep in. Very convenient walk to chinatown. As well as a easy walk to the train to see all the attractions on the loop. Our family will definitely stay again.
Great location in Lincoln Park, close to red line and restaurants.
Charie’s place is in an excellent location- close to bars, restaurants and public transit and far enough from Wrigley field to avoid the craziness if you want.

First off I was so grateful Nick let us check in early! The space is beautiful and very comfortable, only issue we had during our stay is due to being in the basement you can hear any amount of movement from the floor above and with the dogs it can be very noisy at all hours of the evening.
Overall a good stay and definitely recommend.

Loved this place. The pictures barely do it justice as it looks even better in person. It's bigger in person than it appears. Instructions were clear. Area was lively yet peaceful. Would love to stay again!
Great location with convenient walk to a dog park and urban walking trail.

We loved this quiet, clean, comfortable space, so close to the EL and to restaurants, bars, and shopping.  We very much hope to be able to stay in this apartment again.  So, so convenient to so much activity and yet private and peaceful!
Loved the neighborhood! Quiet and peaceful. The home was beautiful. Upstair neighbors are slightly noisy throughout the day and night but it didnt bother me
Nice place
Rida’s apartment was absolutely wonderful. a clean, comfortable, and cozy place. it was just what i needed and i would definitely stay here again!

I was mostly away from the property during my stay but it was pretty pleasant! Great location and within walking distance to Wrigley!

Such a cute space! It’s not easy to find a room in a home where you have your own bathroom and kitchen area so that was a plus! Would definitely stay again :)

One of the most spotless and clean Airbnb's I've ever stayed in; absolutely sparkles. Yolanda was an amazing host. She's responsive and helpful. The place is super comfy and way bigger than expected--
Great place to stay! Area was very walkable and the train was super close, for downtown access. Would recommend!
Kimberlys place was a great stay very comfortable and convenient area ,easy access to every where you need to go in Chicago , I definitely recommend the stay! Thank you Kimberly!
Everything was perfect, we’d stay again for our next trip for sure

My family and I enjoyed our stay at Adam's place! The check-in instructions were clear and the house was very clean. Having access to a 2 car garage was great, especially in this part of Chicago where street parking is tight. We were able to fit a compact and a mid-size SUV. From a parent standpoint, it was great having blackout shades and quiet doors (a lot of older Chicago houses are usually very creaky and squeaky!). A pack-n-play is also available. It was also nice to have shampoo/conditioner/body wash, which seems to be rare in Airbnb's nowadays. The kitchen is fully stocked and the refrigerator has it's own built-in water filter and dispenser. The house is also walkable to a drug store, grocery store, and even a play place for kids. The only downside (but not against Adam) is that the only bathroom is on the first floor. This might be difficult for elderly guests who may need to use the bathroom in the middle of the night. Would stay again!
Great apartment! Pictures are completely accurate. Very clean and the team was very responsive. Would definitely stay again!
