we had a great time at this airbnb!!! we were a little worried staying in a shared space as we had never done it before, but it was quiet the whole time and we would have never known other people were there. super clean and comfortable.
Place was perfect for the two of us. Everything was super clean and tidy.
Exactly as described. The parking spot alone made it worth it! Quick train or water taxi ride to all the places we wanted to go and close to chinatown. Safe area!

Nice place. Well located in pilsen next to a metro stop and also few bus lines that are convenient (for example to go to chinatown). The parking spot is convenient if you have a car. Inside it's very well equipped and kitchen has everything you need. Beds are comfortable. Everything is clean and host is responsive. Only thing to mention is that it's noisy from outside and there is not a full wall between the 2 bedrooms => if there are snoring person in your group, everyone may enjoy it. I would consider to us either again if coming back to chicago
Lovely place, parking was easy on the street, bus to downtown is right outside the door.  Train is a short walk away.  Everything was very clean and looked like the photos.

Was great to have a three bedroom place with two full baths for myself and two young adult sons. The apartment was walkable and close to public transportation. And for those who might be wondering—yes, the wait at Kasama’s for breakfast is worth the time.

Spent 2 nights here while catching a Cubs game - worked really well for 2 couples and location is great.  Would recommend to folks looking to experience this neighborhood while visiting Chicago.  Very much appreciated the parking passes!

Couldn't think of a better place to spend four weeks in the summer! Danny, Chris, and Debbie were super welcoming to us and our two dogs. Their place had everything we needed -- it was clean and fully stocked for a month-long stay. Super close to public transportation, very walkable to everything in Logan, and tucked into a quiet street that doesn't get much road/train noise. Danny & Chris were super proactive and communicative and have such a beautiful yard and garden in the back for some calm time after an energetic day in the city. We'll definitely be back!

We had a great stay! Very clean, comfortable, quiet, and cozy! Host was very responsive and helpful for all our inquiries and very flexible with an early check in! The location was great! 2 min walk to grocery store, bus stops right around the corner and a short bus ride to the CTA L train which gets you anywhere in the city! Our main purpose for trip was seeing games at Wrigley Field..it was a quick trip on bus and L train to the park. Thanks again for a great stay!
I had a great stay, it was clean. I definitely feel like thoroughly researching the neighborhood as a young woman. other than that everything else was good.

This home is in an excellent location.  We fell in love with the neighborhood for the two months we stayed.  We recently moved to Chicago and rented this home as a temporary space while we found a permanent home.  Upon arrival, we discovered that our Host's cleaning crew had really let him down.  Luckily, our Host was able to secure another crew the next day and we also cleaned.   The sofa needs some care as do some of the accoutrements.   All that said, we make the home our own for our stay.
Gavino was very responsive and helpful with our visit. Plenty of restaurants and stores within walking distance. Also, close to public transportation to get around the city.
We very much enjoyed our stay and would stay here again. Very responsive host, clean space, and great neighborhood.
Sehr saubere Wohnung, mit allem was man braucht ausgestattet. Netter Kontakt und Troy hat immer schnell reagiert.

The place was very comfortable for me and my daughter.  We had plenty of room for our needs.  There was plenty of drinks and water available for coffee and tea and even some fruit was left for snacking.  We felt very safe walking to and from the United Center.  We will be back!!!  Thank you!
The house and setup was nice, but parking was an issue and the floor for a baby aren't good because they where really dirty.
Perfect
easy to find, stores around and close to the airport

Overall, the place is in a great location directly next to the red line so easily accessible to get downtown. Also, the place is cute. It’s more of a college apartment vibe than it is an Airbnb but again, the location is the biggest sell on this.
As for the unit itself, host was not communicating very well leading up to the stay. The host asked for an ETA in which I gave one and asked about parking. I didn’t receive any response about the parking situation.
Arrived at the unit and the instructions from the host regarding the code for the lockbox was incorrect. I understand things happen, but not replying about parking and then being given an incorrect lockbox code was unfortunate.
The unit also has one window AC unit at the back of the space that’s pretty far from the bedrooms. It was cool in the unit, but still very warm at night. Also in the kitchen, there were food items left in the refrigerator and cabinets from the previous stays.

Our family of 6 thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The location was so convenient to the “L” green line and to city buses, which we used daily to get downtown and around the city. We enjoyed walking in Washington Park (right across the street) in the evenings. Parking was easy. The home itself is as beautiful and clean as the pictures look. The mattresses and linens were sooo comfortable, and the bathrooms were spacious and well-supplied. We cooked every day and had everything we needed for preparing meals. This really was like staying in someone’s (pristine) home! Leo welcomed us at the house on arrival to make sure we got in ok and had everything we needed. He is an excellent host! Highly recommend Leo and the Garfield Greystone. I hope we get to stay here anytime we come to Chicago!

Our stay in Darina's unit was great. Our family of five - with three teen boys, had enough space to sleep and spread out comfortably in the bedrooms and living room. The kitchen and bathroom were clean and stocked, and thankfully, the AC units were extremely handy as it was pretty hot in Chicago during our stay.
Amazing hosts. They did everything f they could to accommodate our flight schedules. Couldn’t be happier. Thank you for letting us stay in your property.
Bob and Rachel's place was clean, comfortable, and easy to find. It had everything I needed. I would definitely stay here again.

This was a wonderful Airbnb! Look just like the listing the host was super helpful and very detailed with check-in and check out instructions. The location was good close to lots of little bars and places to eat.
Nice place just wasn't too convenient with regular tenants living upstairs.

Vraj's place was perfect! I brought my 3 kids and felt safe and at home. I would recommend this place to anyone traveling to Chicago. It was a great location. Vraj was an excellent host and our experience was seamless. Thank you, Vraj!
Place was as described!

This was a great spot to stay especially if you are attending an event at United Center - nothing beats a 7 min walk home after the show (we were on the couch eating leftover pizza while everyone else was still beating traffic to get out of the lots). Close to a train stop and very quick drives into the city/West Loop areas. Would stay here again!

Beautiful restoration, comfortable, and with a great layout. The neighborhood is walkable and safe. We enjoyed the arcade (hello duck hunt). It took me back to my childhood years! Stacy is an excellent host!
The train does pass right by the building, but it made for a more unique Chicago experience!
J's places is clean, well-appointed and as pictured.  The ease of a simple and clean room to Airbnb is appreciated. Communication is clear and timely.
Great host ! We had a blast!
Wish the location was closer to walkable things/to downtown

I really hope to stay here again in the future!!! Incredible spot!!! The Addison Redline Train is really close.  Lots of restaurants around Wrigley Field and on Southpoint Ave…everything you could imagine is walkable, even some great neighborhood coffee shops!  The apartment is really cool!  A very spacious one bedroom…the bed was comfortable and the living was massive, including the couch which is perfect for a nap or even to sleep for the evening.  The table in the kitchen is huge and  great for dining or just to spread out if you have to get work done.  Fully function kitchen with a full size fridge, stove, microwave, tea kettle and keurig coffee maker.  David leaves you an assortment of drinks in the fridge, keurig pods, teas and instant oatmeal!  If you’re in town for a baseball game, you are a block away from the action!

Stayed for a few nights, any problems the host had great communication, apologised and sorted anything pretty quickly. Room and facilities good and can’t complain for the price. Everything well worth the stay here highly recommend it for traveling.

We were so impressed with how beautiful, clean and stocked up the Airbnb was! They had anything and everything you’d need. It made our trip to Chicago so much more amazing! Private and safe entry, quiet neighborhood. We would definitely stay here again and we highly recommend it!
Really wonderful host and cozy home!

My daughter and I really enjoyed staying in Cheryl’s place. It was quiet, it was clean, and I really appreciated the coffee. Plenty of towels of good quality, comfortable beds, air-conditioning worked well. I also loved the shower. Would stay there again as long as it’s available.
We really appreciated having a quiet space to come back to after busy days. Cheryl was so responsive and made us aware of everything we needed to know!
Great location and super easy to access. Space was clean and very spacious. 10 minute walk to Wrigley and so close to so many great restaurants!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Our room was ready a few hours early which was a nice surprise. We booked it to come to town for a concert at the United Center and it was a very short walk to the station - very conveniently located! The door staff was very friendly and parking was a breeze. I would definitely stay here again!
They were very accommodating and responsive to my inquiries. I will be staying with them in the future!
Very nice place and communicative host, very accommodating
Lovely space in a great location
I would definitely stay here again. Great location for everything. The space was lovely, and felt very comfortable.

We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely stay here again! The host truly went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Not only was the Airbnb dog-friendly, but they even left treats for our dog, Ghost, which was such a thoughtful touch. There was also a welcome gift bag waiting for us, bottled water in the fridge, and plenty of little extras that showed how much care went into preparing the space.
One of the best amenities was the free parking. Having a dedicated parking space made coming and going incredibly easy, and we never had to worry about finding a spot. In a city like Chicago, that was a huge bonus and something we really appreciated.

Dee was very friendly when I met him and very easy to talk to. He shared with me some things around the area and how to get to the the local public transportation. The other guests were friendly as well and helped me when I was having some issues with opening the door. There was some issues with communication for check in which Dee informed me the system was down, but I did have to ask a few times for check in instructions to be sent to me. The room was as described, nothing fancy but it was good for a couple nights to crash! The area seemed fine, but one of the guests did warn me to not leave anything 'out in the open in your car just in case'. I mean it is Chicago, so I expected that. Overall, it was a fine stay.
La ubicación es buena, el unico problema es la falta de limpieza
The apartment was spacious, the bed was comfortable. The parking garage across the street was very handy.
Went for a music concert — close to  United Center but great neighborhood.

Beth’s place is one of my favorite Airbnb stays to date. The studio was just as pictured & well positioned. It was a cozy and welcoming stay; simple layout, clean everything, comfortable bed. - 10/10! The area is right by Lincoln Park with tons of fun restaurants, coffee shops, and beautiful homes for you to enjoy on a morning stroll or evening tea gazing out the bi big windows.
I didn’t need much but Beth was friendly, provided clear instructions & yummy welcome cookies. I’m going to bookmark this place for future visits to Chicago!

This place was an OK deal. Pictures and descriptions were accurate. If you are traveling by car, I would not recommend booking at this place, parking is tricky. The place was dusty and stains were observed under the toilet seat. The title of the listing states being 10 minutes away from downtown, but it is double the amount of time, if not more. The amenities included washer and dryer, but there was nothing provided to use the washer. When we messaged to ask if there was any detergent we could use, we received no response. We did find that the kitchen was well stocked with utensils but all the coffee that is advertised was empty. There is a mattress topper on the bed which kind of sinks in, some people might like that. The bathroom had extra towels, nice shower head, and a speaker to connect to. Overall, this space is great for basic needs but could use an extra clean. Hosts seemed to be unresponsive and we only received automated messages.
It was a great place. Anytime we would have a question the host answered really quick. The space was really clean an it was easy to move around the city.
Overall great easy spot close to the heart of Logan. Great spot
Great place — hot tub was a highlight. Cool neighborhood.

The room was very clean and comfortable, and has been well-maintained. The private bathroom was nice and clean as well. The place is in a quiet and convenient location, close to the Pink line and stores/restaurants. The hosts were responsive and friendly. Highly recommend this place!
Indeed a rare find !

This is a wonderful place in the heart of a vibrant neighborhood. There are plenty of walkable restaurants and coffee shops. We found street parking nearby as well. The view of the city was incredible and the bed was extremely comfortable. We are definitely planning a return visit!
Very convenient location, perfect for a group of 5 (or 6 with baby), public transportation at 10min walk in a very quiet neighborhood. We enjoyed staying there to discover Chicago !

Had a great stay in Chicago! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient and made it easy to get around the city. Check in was simple and Joanna was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Everything we needed was provided, parking was easy and convenient. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago and would stay here again!
Such a great location!

Tere’s place was spacious and homey. The beds are very comfortable. The location could not be beat! 100% walking score! There are a multitude of restaurants, shops and grocery stores steps away. It’s also walking distance to the beach and close to the University of Chicago, the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry, Osaka Japanese Gardens and the Obama Presidential Center. Tere is very responsive and accommodating. I would definitely stay here again!
This is a clean quiet nest in a perfect location. You are minutes away from train stops, a quick walk to the park. The host is very responsive and kind. Would stay here again.

시카고를 다시 방문하게 된다면 주저 없이 다시 선택하고 싶은 숙소입니다.
숙소의 위치와 안전성, 주변 환경 모두 매우 만족스러웠습니다. 특히 편리한 위치와 쾌적한 주변 환경 덕분에 머무는 동안 정말 편안하고 즐거운 시간을 보낼 수 있었습니다. 시카고를 방문하시는 분들께 적극적으로 추천하고 싶은 숙소입니다.
다만, 두 가지 아쉬웠던 점이 있었습니다.
첫째, 욕조 커튼의 길이가 많이 짧아서 샤워할 때 욕조 밖으로 물이 많이 흘러 불편함이 있었습니다.
둘째, 주방에 있는 냄비들이 다소 오래되어 보여 사용하기에 조금 불편했습니다.
이 두 가지 부분만 개선된다면 더욱 만족도가 높은 숙소가 될 것 같습니다. 전반적으로는 매우 만족스러운 숙박이었고, 다시 시카고를 방문한다면 꼭 다시 찾고 싶은 곳입니다. 감사합니다!

Theodora’s place is wonderful. It is newly renovated and very comfortable. Our family of four looked forward to coming home to it after long days sightseeing.
The kitchen eating area is handy and well-designed. The rain showerhead was a treat! We especially enjoyed time on the awesome back deck in the warm summer evenings.
Oh, and parking! Being able to park in the garage made coming and going super convenient!

Even though I’m very familiar with the area, staying here gave me an entirely different experience of the neighborhood. Betsy and her husband are kind, smart, interesting, and genuinely friendly.
Between conversations with them and the guides and information in the room, I went to restaurants I’d never tried, took walks and bike rides I’d never done, and discovered parts of the neighborhood I’d overlooked.
Day or night, it was a lovely place to stay. I felt a little like I was backpacking through Europe—wandering, exploring, and discovering things—even though I was right in the city and could easily go do everything I needed to do for work.
They made a familiar part of Chicago feel new.

Beautiful property
Extremely comfortable beds
Very clean and organized space.

Excellent location ! A great place to stay if you are visiting downtown Chicago- few minutes walk to the blue line and the EL. Rooms were clean. Ideal for a large group of people or a family. Would highly recommend.
Overall not good.  Not helpful in a crisis.  More interested in next client. Used canned phrases.  Husband fell while crossing threshold b/c no light.
We loved this home felt right at home very spacious. And the property was secured
Great host!

This was a perfect location for my trip to Chicago, short drive into downtown but also far enough out for it to be peaceful. LOVED the garden in the backyard, I could have stayed there for hours. Overall, I would recommend staying here and will be returning in the future.

Lovely apartment, very easy check in and out.  Able to hold our luggage during the day after check out while we continued to explore the city.  Gracious and attentive staff in lobby.  Very affluent neighborhood.  Belgian bakery next door with breakfast and lunch.  Would definitely stay again.

Overall, amazing location. We were within walking distance to so many great restaurants. It is a very large space. I love the openness of the kitchen, dinette, and living area.
It seems like the place could use some freshening up though. Fresh paint on baseboards/trim.
Overall, it was a great stay. I can't say enough about the location. It was so nice to walk to everything we needed.

Thoroughly  enjoyed our stay.  Very comfortable, cozy, roomy, well appointed home offered by a friendly host.  Harwood floors throughout and   exceptionally clean. Had no problem parking 2 cars right in front of home on the street.  One bedroom downstairs with a half bath and 2 bedrooms upstairs with a full bathroom.  About 10 minutes to O'Hare,  30 minutes to Lake Michigan beach,  nearby walking trails in forest preserves,  the wonderful King Spa, and plenty of restaurants, in a quiet (didn't notice the jets overhead when inside)  well cared for neighborhood.  We would not hesitate to stay there again.

Penthouse picturesque
Peaceful
Pristine…
I fell asleep while looking at Chicago skyline!!! #dreamy
This was a good stay, Maria was very communicative and flexible to requests, the check-in instructions were clear. The place is very cozy and clean and just felt right at home!
Un accueil très chaleureux un appartement très propre et très calme merci pour votre sourire et votre gentillesse très bon rapport qualité prix
Justin was great to communicate with! The house was a perfect location for us wanting to be close to Wrigley Field. It worked well for our family trip.
It’s a pretty nice room to stay at for a couple of days .

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was easy, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The location was convenient for getting around Chicago and exploring the city. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend this place to others. Thank you for hosting us!
We had a great stay in Chicago. The Dodgers could have won one game at least out of three but oh well. There’s no better place to see them lose than Wrigley. We shall return. Cheers and thank you.

Really GREAT place to stay! Wonderful neighborhood, near and walking distance to so many amazing parts of Chicago and the Lincoln Park area.
Clean. A/C!!! Comfy. Nice front porch!
Amazing communication. Brandon helped trouble shoot getting my clothes out of the washer/dryer unit when the door was unfortunately locked for over 45 minutes.
Highly recommend!
Very home-y. The perfect place to plant yourself after running around Chicago all day. Clean, equipped, and Fortino is so kind.
Great experience overall, very convenient if you plan to watch a game at the Wrigley Field.

This was such a pleasant experience. Emma's place is located in a quiet part of the city, but there was still so much to do and see. The home is beautiful, clean, and so comfortable. We had everything we needed and then some, including plenty of towels,  wash cloths, extra blankets, and even toiletries. I'm an anxious traveler and usually have a hard time relaxing and feeling at home away from my own home, but I felt so comfortable and at ease here. I would definitely stay here again. Thank you so much!
Check-in was super easy, the location was fantastic and overall a beautiful space. Communication was great as well.

The unit was spacious and very well maintained.  The entire unit was air conditioned, with units in every room.  They were a bit noisy, but they worked well and kept the unit cool and comfortable.  We thought that there was more than one tv, but we were in and out, so it wasn’t a problem.  We appreciated that there were a few things we could have for breakfast and the coffee maker was very good too.  Overall, it made our stay even better than we thought it would be.
5-star location for Wrigley.  Condo ha everything you need and very clean .

This apartment is very convenient in an area that doesn't have a lot of hotels. It's easy to find, very quiet, and very spacious. Plenty of room to move around and if you need it, plenty of closet space. Very large eat-in kitchen.

Very good stay, clean room and place. The host and co hosts are kind and communicate quick. Great convenient location, with loads of shops and places to eat within walking distance. Also near public transportation if needed. Also a few pubs in the area too
Short stay but a good stay! Close to wrigley field! My kids had a blast!!!!

Everything was perfect, the stay could not have been better! I felt very at home and well taken care of. The establishment could not have been better, truly exceeded any expectations I had! The location was wonderful and very peaceful, parking was very convenient with it being free street parking. Gladys made sure to have extra backups of any and  everything in case you forgot something. She also was very responsive and instructions were very clear. Would recommend this to everyone and I hope im able to book again! :-) thank you Gladys!!!

We stayed 3 days and 2 nights with our 3 children- 14, 3, and 2 months old. We appreciated the many steps to enter the apartment i.e. the keypad entry to building, needing a key fob for elevator access, and keypad entry to the apartment, it made us feel very safe. The beds were comfortable, everything was very clean, and all the little details were on point. We appreciated parking being included, the short walk from the garage to the apartment made up for how much we saved paying for parking. The kids loved the arcade game and large couch. The only minor thing to address is that the blinds for the balcony door are broken and based on reviews have been for a while, which didn’t affect us at all. Overall, we were extremely satisfied with our stay and would definitely return and highly recommend this apartment to others!
It was pleasure to stay, thank you!!
Great location, clean and comfortable, had everything we needed.

Daran’s place was in such a great neighborhood location- it is an easy walk to the CTA Brown Line and there are tons of great restaurants and bars all around the property. It allowed us to feel part of the neighborhood, which was ideal for us. The fact that it’s on the second floor in the back overlooking a lovely garden and seating area felt wonderfully private. Daran was very responsive, friendly and helpful, introducing us to the family dog and giving us great restaurant recommendations. He suggested we try Bitter Pop for coffee and we ended up going there almost every day. All in all we had a blast in Chicago, thanks in large part to our lovely accommodations in Roscoe Village.
Would definitely stay there again!
Shay’s place was a beautiful place to stay in the heart of Chicago. Shay was responsive and helpful throughout my stay and always provided anything necessary.
Great place
My Kasa experience was great, as usual.  Great that there's a full time doorman and a gym.  The building overall was a bit dirty and run down.
Hôte très réactive. Bon séjour.

Tasha was a wonderful host! The Airbnb was very nice, clean, and located in a beautiful, peaceful neighborhood. She was incredibly kind, warm, and welcoming, and responded quickly whenever we needed anything. We had a wonderful experience and truly enjoyed our stay. We definitely plan to return in the near future when we come back to visit family. This stay was a 10 out of 10! We highly recommend Tasha and her beautiful home! ❤️
Great stay and great location near public transportation so it was super easy to get around

It's so easy to highly recommend this stay!
First off, Calvin went above and beyond to help us with a a smooth check-in. Much appreciated after being on the road for the past 2 days.
Communication was great. NOT intrusive or overbearing.
In fact, the times that he did reach out, it was just to let us know that the place was cleaned up and ready for check-in ahead of schedule. Or, to ask if we needed the water dispenser refilled or other accommodations. And even after we checked out, he did a final sweep through and reached out to see if we left anything behind!!
Why does this stay rock?
It's quiet, private, accessible and a quick walk to the blue line or bus.
You'll get to major POI's and downtown in 30 minutes or less by bus or subway. (Tip: Buy the 3 day unlimited transit pass.)
There's a private spot so just leave your car and hit the public transit.
What to see: Dark Knight filming spots, Field Museum, Buckingham Fountain, Cloud Gate, Van Gogh, American Gothic, Sky deck, etc...
Richard’s place was clean and comfortable.  A perfect place for ball game fans.
stunning apartment, exactly as described thank you brad! would definitely book again :)

El mejor lugar para quedarte si vas por conciertos, lugar tranquilo, cómodo, tienes privacidad y a la vez calidez. Si vuelvo a Chicago, sin duda sería mi primera opción.
Excelente relación calidad-precio.
Great place for the budget!

Fantastic place. Right next to the United Center so the walk was quick and easy. Felt great going there after the concert while everyone else was stuck in traffic. The place itself is nice and comfortable. The parking spot was a little tight but gated and private and overall very easy. I will likely try to book this place again next time I go to Chicago!

Overall would recommend and definitely come back. Place is nice and very clean. Listing said there would be shampoo, but couldn’t find it. Good location to be a short drive to wherever you need to go.

Ericka’s place is so lovely. Just as advertised, the location is incredible. Walking distance to all things and set back enough from the train to be quiet. The bed is very comfortable and the kitchen is well stocked. The bathroom is lovely with a deep, powerful shower/tub. The wooden floors are squeaky but are the epitome of a charming Chicago apartment. I’d definitely book this place again!

Overall, a lovely experience!
Location/vib: On the corner of a busy street and a quiet, residential one, you have the option of strolling a quiet street (mostly hipster tenants) or being able to grab something from a restaurant/market just down the street. A 20 minute walk from a Lake Michigan beach means you can skip the expensive parking and just take a stroll to the beach which is pretty awesome!
Parking: We were only at the airbnb at night and were able to find free parking about half a block down one night and parked on the main street (a minute walk) in metered spots overnight (free between 8pm-8am).
Check-in: The apartment complex is large and requires three separate keys/doors just to get in, but check-in was easy with very well-communicated instructions & a video on the check in process.
Space: Cute, quiet, and clean with comfortable beds. Air conditioning is only in the bedrooms via window units but never got hot. Outside light comes thru the bedroom windows easily tho.
Beautiful Roman Catholic Parish of Saint Jerome nearby. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay! Very peaceful.
The place was exactly as described. Plenty of space to spread out, comfortable beds, cute front and back yard space. Convenient location for the Obama Library.
Michelle was an amazing host! Very responsive and accommodated us with our check in process. The place was clean and organized and well maintained. Thank you so much for hosting us! It was great!
Great place quicker to reach downtown. Responsive host.

Sharon is a very friendly and lovely host and was always responsive. The only feedback I would provide is their is current construction at front of place making it not ideal when bringing luggage on loose rocks, did not know where the lockbox was as we do not use them in my country so would be ideal to make it more obvious, their are stairs at front of house and having heavy luggage and being petite was difficult going up the stairs. House is fairly clean with visible dust, several flies in the room and neighbours cutting their lawn at 7am was not ideal. Otherwise it was a nice neighbourhood, easy access to public transport and Sharon was a lovely and helpful host.
Jhon’s place was beautiful and in a great area! Check in was easy however one door code was not provided and I did have to ask but he responded very quickly and at the end of the day not a huge issue
Nice apartment, clean, well furnished, exactly as pictured, in a nice and quiet neighborhood. Would book again
Had an excellent stay at this lovely Airbnb will be looking forward to my next stay the next time we are in Chicago!!!

The property was colorful and showed that the owners cared about the place. The AirBnB was comfortable and relaxing. The location of the place was in a great spot to where everything in chicago wasn’t too far away.

Great home inside. Stairs to get in. The outside of the home could use some sprucing up as well as the back yard area. There was quite a bit of trash outside and on the street that we picked up. Easy access to bus lines. Beds were comfortable. Only complaint is the size of the tv. It is very small!
Amazing place! Clean, safe, and a great host!
Transparent communication. The House and room is clean and tidy. The room is cooled and was nice to comeback to after a hot summerday.

I was looking for an affordable place close to Wrigley Field. This was the perfect location! it is literally 3 minutes from Gallagher Way and 7 minutes from the Addison Red Line station. The apartment isn't fancy, and that's ok with me. I loved having a locked room and a locked private bathroom. The bottom bunk bed isn't the greatest, so if you are sensitive sleeper, it might not be for you. It wasn't a problem for me though. I used to live in Boston, and this reminded me a lot of my time there. highly recommend for budget-friendly, active people!

Dave was an excellent host! Very responsive and accommodating. The space was great for what I was there for. Quiet house and clean room, shared spaces were nice and the water and umbrella provided were nice touches. The AC unit was much appreciated as well. The area was quiet and felt safe and close to a lot of things. Ran into Dave once and he was very kind. Overall enjoyed my stay and would stay here again!

Anthony was great to communicate with.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  The complimentary amenities were a nice touch and appreciated.  We were thankful for the recommendation of a local coffee shop around the corner.  Everything was clean and tidy.  The beds were decently comfortable.  Super close to public transit and the neighborhood felt very safe and peaceful.
This place was so comforting and felt right at home. It had everything we needed for sure. Super friendly host. It was not far from United center. Only stayed 2 nights but it was worth it!
Very cozy space and amazing host. Loved every bit of our stay. Stephanie is a great host and very responsive.
Great house! I recommend it! Do not hesitate.
Right outside of the blue line stop- extremely convenient. So easy to check in and loved that the unit was keyless.

Stephanie's place was perfect for our visit; great location provided easy, walkable/short rideshare access to all the city has to offer. The space is welcoming and nicely appointed, with comfortable beds, a great kitchen, and showers with great water pressure. The onsite amenities (gym and rooftop pool area) were incredible and really made our stay special. Highly recommend Stephanie's place for your Chicago getaway!
Very recommended would definitely be back!

Just book this one! This place was a Wrigleyville dream. Super clean, inviting, and great energy. The location was perfect from the moment we walked in. Our plan was to catch a Cubs game and explore Chicago.  We arrived completely frazzled after wildfire evacuations in Washington state. This place felt like a home! The steam shower and laundry supplies helped us to reset and relax after a crazy 72 hours. The kitchen provided ANYTHING we would need to create any meal. We sat around the table as a family, enjoyed a meal, and set out to see Chicago. The beds were comfortable, even the pull out sofa. We built lifelong memories on this trip, and this space was at the center. It will be the first place we try to book next time.

Loved our stay!! It was exactly like the photos, very clean, and just an overall beautiful space. Very close to bus stops for us to use throughout our time here which was very convenient. Host. Responds very quickly and is very kind. 100% would book again!

We had a great stay with Aaron!  The place was clean and modern!  It was located in a great location right near the brown line.  We were able to use the train as opposed to driving and paying for parking! Aaron provided adequate parking for our two vehicles, in garage and street parking with a permit.  We had trouble with the refrigerator but Aaron jumped on it right away and took care of it the same day. Towels and linen were clean and fresh!  Also had a very nice washer and dryer that came in handy!  If I need an airbnb again in Chicago I would definitely stay again!

Pros:
Place was clean, good location, easy to check in and out.
Cons:
WiFi provided didn’t work, was given alternate WiFi with 1 bar of signal that wasn’t even strong enough for the small Ruku TV, that was about 20 inches to even pickup.
Bed was way too soft and I sagged into it a lot, woke up with a sore/tight back every morning.
I had to fly out for a funeral during my stay and asked for 1/4 nights to possibly be refunded or credited for an extenuating circumstance. Offered to send my flight confirmation to them as well. I understand the agreement but this was very unexpected and I thought they might have a little empathy and credit back 1 night.
Place was fine and worked, but I expected a lot better and nicer paying $1190 for 3 nights. Wouldn’t stay here again.

Jorge was an amazing host! I stayed there with my bf and both him and I felt so comfortable during our stay. No complains! Such an easy check in process, very clear instructions for parking, check in, and check out, making it all so easy for guest! Jorge is very attentive and has pretty fast replies! I definitely recommend if you’re planning a trip to Chicago soon! The area of the airbnb is nice and pretty quiet, it’s not too far from all the popular attractions, I would say maximum a good 25 minutes but mostly 15-20 which isn’t bad at all! Again my partner and I had such a good stay here!
Great location that is walking distance to everything! The apartment itself was super clean and comfortable. We would definitely stay here again.

Location location location. This is located in the heart of Wicker Park. Walk everywhere. Delivery from everywhere. The place is pristine and beautifully appointed. Would stay here everytime we visit Chicago.

Our stay was amazing! We had a fee chats with Olga during our stay and she made us feel right at ease. Whenever we needed something she would help us straight away. Location wise was perfect for us since we had a car!
What a beautiful home! We had a great stay.
Very spacious and good looking condo in the South Loop with everything you need for a short term stay. Would happily come back.
Great place to stay.  Enjoyed the space!  Alma was very responsive and helpful!
We stayed here for a team retreat and it was great. Amazing location, very cute house, and great hosts.
Very nice location

Extremely private,  cozy, and clean. We felt safe, and secure. Happy that our car was secured inside the garage. Location was accessible to everything. Thank you for making our visit a memorable experience.

Tara's rental is situated in the highly desirable Lakeview Central pocket, just a short walk south of Wrigleyville. It is a surprisingly calm and low key area, given its proximity to the ballpark. It's the perfect choice if catching a game or two is part of your vacation plans. Little cafes and restaurants all around. We heard the trains but were not bothered by them and were, instead, grateful for the nearby train station that made the whole of Chicago so very accessible. Tara was extremely responsive anytime we reached out, before or during our trip. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Bianca's Wicker Park retreat is welcoming, cozy, and peaceful. From the front gates to the sun-soaked kitchen to the private back patio, the entire property oozes charm and whimsy. I wish I could have stayed twice as long to appreciate all the spaces Bianca has, clearly, so intentionally created.
Getting there was super easy. Finding parking was a breeze. The tucked-in, private vibes of the whole property with easy access to a plethora of things to experience was a total dream. Bianca was a fabulous host. I truly HOPE I have the opportunity to stay here again!

Aaron’s place was perfect for my stay. He communicated everything I needed to know in advance and I didn’t have any complaints throughout. Location was perfect both to explore the city and easily get to Cubs games - it’s halfway between Addison (Red Line) and Southport (Brown Line) L stops, with several bus lines on the same block and easily less than a 5 minute walk to Wrigley Field. I would absolutely book Sunnyside Up again.
Wonderful place to stay when visit Chicago and great host.
Solo female traveler verified! Derek is kind and the location is great. Free parking very easy to find

Great location and space! Lots of walkable restaurants, coffee shops, and parks. Nice large space, everyone was very comfortable in their own spaces. We stayed for a week, but household items like paper towels and trash bags were not stocked for a week stay. Messaged the host, who were very responsive and had both items sent over the next day. For the price the place was beautiful, spacious, and in a great location which made it worth it. Would definitely stay again and would recommend this spot for families and/or large groups!
Easy access to the train is great! Short ceiling was a bit of an issue though. Recommend for people under 6ft tall

We enjoyed our stay. The location was incredible, right next to the river walk. Great restaurants and bars. The building itself is a little run down with elevators not always working. But the apartment was just as described.
Place was easy to access. Good location to be close to things without having to be right in the mix of everything. Found some really good food spots near by.
El depa está muy lindo y limpio, es muy acogedor y la zona es bonita y tranquila, si recomiendo

I had a wonderful stay at Stephanie’s apartment in Chicago! The location was fantastic and made it so easy to get around and enjoy the city. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly what I needed for my stay. Stephanie was also a very responsive and helpful host, which made everything smooth and stress-free. Staying here made me feel like a true Chicago native.
I really enjoyed my time here and would definitely love to stay again in the near future. Highly recommended!

We had a wonderful stay in Jason’s beautiful top floor apartment.  It was as delightfully decorated and comfortable. He was always responsive and had a wonderful guide to the neighbourhood which we found very helpful.  The apartment is located on a moderately busy street so if traffic noise bothers you it’s something to think about (Jason does provide ear plugs).  I would not hesitate to stay here again.  Thanks Jason!!
Second year in a row us staying here! well book everytime its available. the back deck is really nice, we didnt use it last year

It was a great price and overall a great stay. I don’t have any negatives, the location was as close as u can get to the city without being directly in it. It was easily accessible by bike or scooter. It is shared housing so you will hear noises from other guests but that is expected in shared housing. It’s a great place if your mainly looking for somewhere to sleep while your in Chicago. It’s definitely one of the better shared spaces ive been. There aren’t to many rooms so you typically only have a couple other people who need to access the bathroom and showers so it’s usually easy to access
Kath’s place was incredible! Great location, extremely clean, and Kath let us check in a little early! Would stay again when coming back to Chicago 10/10
Place as described. Quiet neighborhood. Would recommend.

We enjoyed our stay while taking in a Cubs game and visiting the sights! The home was in a beautiful neighborhood and walkable to great restaurants and the train! We would definitely stay again when back in the area!
Thanks again,

Location cannot be beat! 10 out of 5 stars for location! Many restaurants and shopping within walking distance. Close to the L and bus stop (also walking distance). Was a little surprised that one of the bedrooms didn't have a door, but we found a black partition that worked fine.
This was a wonderful place to stay, and I appreciate Romana being so communicative, checking in to make sure we were comfortable and responding immediately when we asked for help. Would definitely stay again.

I stayed there to attend concerts at the United Center so it was very convenient. Easy access to public transportation and overall is a peaceful place, I didn’t hear much noise. The bathroom can get crowded sometimes, as well as the kitchen, but if you are willing to share this is a perfect place for you.

My family of 4 (2 teens) had an amazing stay! The apartment was clean and comfortable. It is in the perfect location, close to Lake Michigan and only about a 12 minute walk to the Fullerton L stop. We will definitely stay here again!
Parfait. Transport de l’aéroport à la maison et de la maison vers la ville vraiment facile par la ligne bleu du CTA. Super beau quartier tranquille et sécuritaire avec de bons restos et café.

We had a concert at the United Center and this place was the perfect place to stay at. Only a 6 minute drive! This was also a great area to stay in, lots of restaurants and things to do. The place itself was very nice, clean, and well decorated. Will definitely stay here again!
Very very nice place to stay. He responded quick to messages I sent. Super friendly and nice area to stay.
Wonderful place to stay if you plan to be on the go! There’s so much to do surrounding
Booked this place for my mother and she was truly amazed on how clean and beautiful the place was. Highly recommend.
Perfect cozy place for any trip to Chicago. It made us feel right at home and was just such a nice location and atmosphere altogether. Everything about it was perfect!
Estancia tranquila, agradable
Loved this spot. Would live here if I could.

Classic Chicago apartment with that has been restored very well.  Very usable kitchen and dining room, with a large, very comfy living room space as well. Ein toller Aufenthalt in Chicago.

We stayed here with our kids and had a very comfortable stay. The place was clean, quiet, and cozy. Eric was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend it.

The place was comfortable and clean. The host was responsive right away and was really respectful to us with all our questions. The area was beautiful and quiet! Very close to Wrigleyville which made finding things to do and getting food easy.
Even though there were neighbors we felt peace and quiet while on our vacation!
Would definitely use this place again
Best affordable Airbnb I have stayed at in Chicago. Reminded me of an elevated hostel experience. Private and secure. Would stay again.
Apartment was clean and exactly how described. Peaceful complex and great location for our business trip.

We had a great stay! The location was excellent—very convenient and close to everything we wanted to do. The unit was extremely clean, comfortable, and well cared for. We would definitely recommend staying here and would happily stay again!

We were told kind of last minute about the parking situation and had to park on the street. I ended up getting a ticket from the city for parking where I was told to park since it wasn’t included in the Airbnb. Everything else was great.
This place met all of our needs and was centrally located to all the things we wanted to see.
I really did enjoy staying here for my first time visiting chicago. Would definitely book again if I’m ever back in the city, thank you for having us:)
You get a nice private retreat in a beautiful neighborhood of Chicago. The host, Leslie was extremely helpful and accommodating. The place was spotless. I enjoyed my stay.
Ryan was very responsive and gave clear instructions that made getting to the house incredibly easy after we landed. Great stay!

This place was perfect for exactly what we needed! We felt right at home from the moment we arrived. The host was incredibly responsive, helpful, and accommodating, especially with our flexible check in. I really appreciated all the help and how easy everything was. Thank you so much for a great stay!

Absolutely loved our stay here! It was a very beautiful, comfortable and homely stay. The host was very responsive & helpful and gave early check-in & extra blanket as I fell very sick. The host was very empathetic and made sure we have everything we need. Would love to stay here again :)

if you’re coming to chicago for any events at united center this is a great option. you will literally hit NO traffic leaving the venue and less than a 20 minutes drive. very great location! parking kinda sucks but that’s anywhere in a city like environment. just be careful not to park in certain areas because i got a ticket lol. but overall, nice place and great location! would definitely stay again!
Maureen was a great host and her space was as advertised. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a cool place to stay in Chicago.
very clean, nicely air conditioned, in a very good spot!!

We were a four person crew in the city for a weeklong project. It was so nice to stay in a clean convenient condo versus hotel rooms. The property is well stocked. And very nice. Actually better than the pictures.

We stayed here for a concert at the United Center. Great value for what we paid! Adriana was very upfront about what to expect/not expect and everything matched our expectations. The bathroom was also kept pretty clean routinely and we had no issues sharing with other guests in the suite! The room was air conditioned and had large windows for natural light.
We would totally recommend staying here, especially if you’re planning to attend any events at the United Center! It was a 5-minute walk (even on crutches).
Alles perfekt! Äußerst hilfsbereiter und netter Vermieter!

Place was clean and very easy to get into the building as well as the apartment. Quiet building and very convenient to get everywhere.  Beds were comfortable and they left plenty of towels. Central air conditioning was adequate but there is a portable air conditioner and portable fan if wanted. I would absolutely stay there again.
Friendly and very helpful! Convenient quiet neighborhood!!

The place was amazing! It was worth every dime spent! Next time we go to Chicago I will be staying here again. The hot tub was my personal favorite and everyone really enjoyed the outside seating area outside!!
I really enjoyed my short stay here. It was very walkable to local spots and I used the nearby train my entire trip. Highly recommend!

Staying at Heidi’s place was such a lovely experience. The location is absolutely perfect. Its an easy walk to the Red Line and Chinatown. The room itself is so warm and cozy.

If you’re looking for a convenient, clean, and welcoming stay with a wonderful host, this is the place for you. Would book again if I am back to Chicago!
Sorry we could not stay longer.  Good launching pad for a visit to Chicago.  Very friendly hosts, animals included.

Sin dudas fue uno de los mejores alejamientos que visite en todos estos años cómo usuaria de Airbnb,Mary fue una excelente anfitriona desde el momento que realice la reserva,viaje sola y me sentí como en mi propio hogar,la casa está en un barrio hermoso tranquilo a dos cuadras de la estación de Blue line que te conecta con todo,la habitación es muy cómoda ,la cocina super completa y Mary está en todos los detalles,facilitándote toda la información para explorar al máximo esta hermosa ciudad y con todos los elementos que una necesita para pasar una estadía inolvidable…sin dudas voy a volver ,pero la próxima en plan familiar!Gracias Mary y Fiorella por estos días maravillosos!

Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed. Emily and Roya were very responsive, professional, and understanding throughout our stay. Communication was easy from check-in to checkout. I really appreciated their hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

Sarah’s place was perfect for our little adventure to Chicago. Everything we needed was close and the unit was perfect for our needs. Quiet and safe neighborhood and lovely space for us! If we make our way back to Chicago, we would definitely stay again! Sarah was very quick to respond to questions and provided many local recommendations! Thank you!
Was in town to see Ariana Grande. Location was perfect. Place was clean and easy to walk anywhere.
This was a great place to stay, and Brittany was an incredible host!! She gave us all of the information we needed and was very proactive and welcoming. The apartment was beautiful!

I really enjoyed our time at Caitlyn's place, and the location was wonderful. There is clean, and then there is this place! It was absolutely spotless and just felt really good. Everything was comfortable - from the beds to the couch and even the sofa bench for the dining table. I also really appreciated how each room included a fan. The bathrooms were great, and the shower pressure and hot water was wonderful. Finally, Caitlyn was extremely friendly, helpful, responsive, and proactive. She went above and beyond to meet all our needs. Highly recommend!

This was one of the best places I’ve had to pleasure to stay. Beautiful layout, nice amenities, magnificent view! Worth the price and the location was absolutely perfect! I will definitely attempt to stay here on my next visit. Highly recommend!
Great place, would come back again. Close to a lot of restaurants and you can walk right out to the rooftop and enjoy some fresh air whenever you’d like. Highly recommend!
The host, the location,  the place, and the experience were excellent 👌
The host was prompt in responding.   We left an item and the host arranged to return it to us promptly.  The gym and rooftop swimming pool were very nice.

Our stay was extremely disappointing, and unfortunately we had to leave after only two days.
When we arrived, the left refrigerator door was broken, and there was food from previous guests still left in the freezer. There were no comforters or blankets provided in the unit, and only one of the three bathrooms had toilet paper. We also had to search throughout the property just to find enough towels.
The biggest issue was the lack of communication from the host. We reached out about these problems but received no response, leaving us to deal with everything on our own.
Overall, this was a very poor experience and not what we expected from an Airbnb stay. We would not recommend this property.

We loved staying at Elizabeth's place! Our young family (2 kids, 2 adults) had a great time--it was close to a playground and the train! Groceries were a little farther than I had anticipated, but all in all it was great.

Clean, modern, walkable flat with a large balcony looking towards north Chicago city center. Lots to do, see, eat and drink nearby. Close to downtown, within 1-2 miles of everything one would want to do while visiting. Highly recommend!
We had a great stay! Eileen was very kind and helpful.
Nice and spacious. Great location for our needs.

it was such a beautiful place perfect location for me and my best friends first trip together! thank you!

This place was nice and comfortable.  Parking was available right outside of where we were stayed.  Saravanan was kind and quick to respond to all messages.  One of the most comfortable places we have stayed at. Neighborhood was nice and we really enjoyed our stay.
Great response time! Beautiful place!
Rasheed’s place was comfortable, spacious and clean. Great location. Within walking distance to many restaurants and stores. Would definitely recommend to anyone coming to Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay! Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The place was very cozy and peaceful. We didn’t even feel like we had neighbors — it was so quiet and private. Everything was perfect for a comfortable stay, and we really enjoyed our time here. We would definitely stay again! Highly recommend!

We had a great stay with our 3 young children. The place was very child friendly, clean and we felt very safe in the area. The person at the desk was always super helpful and friendly. It was walkable to the museums and many great restaurants. The host was very communicative and helpful.

Overall, we had a pleasant stay. The home was accurately represented in the listing and had everything we needed. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. The home was  comfortable, and had everything we needed. Brian  was kind, welcoming, and always quick to respond. We felt right at home and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. We would definitely stay here again .

We enjoyed our stay.  Everything was as advertised.  Clear, easy to follow instructions and directions  were provided.  The rental was clean and comfortable.  We would not hesitate to book again with Naga and Grace!

Wicker Park is a wonderful neighborhood. It is lively and busy but feels safe 😀 We were able to walk everywhere- shops, restaurants, the 606 and the Chopin Theatre.

A few things were a bit crazy like the fridge stopped cooling - but Kevin is right next door and took care of us almost immediately.
I would stay here again!

My daughter and I enjoyed staying and would choose again next time in the area. It was very comfortable and Nick had drinks  and snacks available for these worn out travelers.  Parking was not an issue and was convenient to walk to the train or take a bus.
Emplacement près des transports en commun et sécuritaire.

The apartment was super clean. We really enjoyed staying there.
I would definitely consider this place next time I visit Chicago.

Andrew and Laura were responsive whenever needed and we really enjoyed our stay at their place. The apartment was clean, quiet, and thoughtfully set up. It felt comfortable to spend time there, not just sleep, and the whole process was easy and well explained.

It is overpriced for the amount of space in the apartment.

We had such a wonderful stay! This Airbnb was the perfect place for two people wanting to explore the city. Everything we wanted to do was nearby, and it made getting around Chicago so easy. Kaleb has provided everything one might ever need. The house is well ventilated and comfortable. The bathrooms and kitchen are fully stocked with all appliances and things to make it easy for anyone to just walk in and feel at home immediately. There was good space both inside and outside for my dog to run around and play.There were plenty of books and games to keep one engaged in their down time.
It is exactly as described. Had a pleasant stay.

We had a great stay overall! Emily was a wonderful host, very responsive, and let us check in early. The neighborhood is safe, quiet, walkable, and parking was a breeze no matter the time. Rameez's was a great host and the place was amazing, we will book again for sure

This is a lovely apartment in an area that was perfect for us. Public transportation is close-by as were two beaches on Lake Michigan. The apartment is so clean. The bed was very comfortable. Aaron was easy to contact and extremely helpful and kind. I will stay again.

My siblings and I stayed here while attending three concerts at the United Center. This Airbnb is a great walkable location with lots to do nearby. Overall I highly recommend this place and would stay again!
Very clean and exactly like the description stated. Peaceful area and great accommodations for what I needed in the matter of a days notice
The apartment was on the 53rd floor with an amazing view. So many restaurants and grocery stores were within blocks of the apartment. We totally enjoyed our stay!
Wonderful place! I can’t wait to stay again.

The place isn’t worth the amount we paid. They gave us wrong and misleading parking information that ended up costing us time and money to fix. At that point they didn’t pick up the phone or try any real solution for the problem. They continued providing bad information that lead no where.

Great place!  We’ll certainly look to book again, here!
Perfect! I will return definitely
