Very kind & hospitable family to stay with for a short period of time. I would definitely stay here again if I'm ever in the area.

Me and my significant other had an amazing time at Netonia and Jeff’s place. Their home was extremely clean & beautiful. 10/10!! Our favorite part of our stay was the jacuzzi of course lol I also  got one of their decoration packages and they did a great surprise set up for my woman’s birthday. I highly recommend getting their decoration packages for any occasion as they made our experience extremely memorable! One of the best Airbnb host we ever had! We will definitely be booking again when we visit Chicago.
Can’t beat the location. The space is ideal with three bedrooms and a spacious kitchen. Everything we needed. Jason was a likeable, trustworthy, and attentive host. We would stay again.

We were a family of four and the place is spacious and comfy. If we had a question, Julio was quick to respond!! I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone who wants to be in Chicago, but not in the thick of the traffic. Everything we wanted to do was a short drive or uber away!!!
We loved Beth’s place!  It was very cozy and comfortable. Lovely neighborhood. A great home base for our exploration of Chicago.

Daniel will welcome you at his house like a good old friend, he would tell you where to eat around the house, where to go and what you have to try in Chicago.
From the check in to check out, it was a easy and pleasant experience. There's a gas station in really close if you need anything, the neighborhood is peaceful and walkable even at night to get late night food, the Red line is like 10 minutes away walking and will get you fast to all the touristic spots in Chicago.
Perfect place to stay for a couple and check Chicago for the first time.
Great deal for the location close to Chinatown, a nice room with your own bathroom and a great host.

It worked great for us. We attended a concert at United center and the place was perfect for it… also close enough to Chicago downtown, they offer parking at a reasonable rate (which is super rare in Chicago)… place was super clean, specially the bathrooms.
Great place to stay.
Thank you.

Let me start off by saying, Kelsey is a great host. Very kind, and responsive!
However, I was not impressed with the cleanliness of the unit. There were a lot of hairs in the shower, which really grossed out me and my son. I looked for cleaning supplies to clean the tub but there was nothing available, except old sponges and windex 🤷🏽‍♀️
Every rug seemed unvacummed, and the floor seemed dirty and unmopped. Overall, the unit was very dusty and there was musty smell upon entering that never went away.
The couch was incredibly uncomfortable; very hard. Not to offend the host, but I was honestly afraid to use the blankets judging by the cleanliness of the place as a whole.
Aside from the cleanliness, I enjoyed the historical aspect of the airbnb and the location is fine. Overall, the listing price was pretty steep for the condition of the unit.
Excelente lugar, muy conveniente si vas a la ciudad unos días y no quieres estar en el mismo centro.

Very nice neighborhood! Was my first time in Chicago, so I didn’t know what to expect, but it was much quieter and safer than I thought. Very clean, tidy space with amenities as described. Hosts were very kind and accommodating, as well as responsive.
Very happy with Larry. Amazing host with a great house would definitely stay again if I ever went back to Chicago!!
This was me and my friends’ first time in Chicago and this space plus the experience made it truly special. A true 10/10.
Julio was very responsive. The mattresses were great, the shower amazing and the air conditioning exactly what we needed with the hot days. The deck was extra special too.
Gorgeous apartment. Wanted to move in. Quiet, peaceful, good vibes. Awesome neighborhood. Clean. Would stay here again.

We were so happy to have such a peaceful, beautiful place to be. The beds were comfy, the AC was *much* appreciated, and the neighborhood was beautiful. (We saw rabbits wandering about the neighborhood!?!?) Emily was super communicative and her mom even can to check we were all settled in. It was just what we needed.
Everything looks like the picture. nice and safe neighborhood, 5 minutes walk to the train. There’s coffee machine in the lobby. Will revisit again. Thank you
Great apartment and location in Hyde Park. Honestly more spacious than I had imagined. And Jhon was very communicative.

Cleanliness and location ( access to public transport, museums and lake front, University neighborhood with restaurants, shops and super markets) are its best aspects. Lack of microwave, non functioning elevator and a few details needing attention have been mentioned to owner.
Great vlue, good  communication
Joseph was great, and very attentive, he responded quickly.

The apartment is small but good space for one or 2 people and was very clean.  Building felt safe and was an easy walk to the red line or bus and close to some restaurants and shopping.   Katty was easy to communicate with and very responsive.  I would recommend this place as it was easy to get to downtown or to any spots up north.
Great place!
Very cute little place with everything you need for your stay. Very easy check-in and helpful instructions.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, well organized, and had everything we needed. The location was convenient, and check-in was easy and smooth.
After spending long days exploring, it was so nice to come back to a comfortable and relaxing place. The host was responsive, helpful, and made us feel very welcome.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to other travelers. We would happily stay here again!
Would book again

This home was spectacular. Very comfortable, clean and appropriate for me family's needs. We enjoyed the saty and looked forward to coming to rest in this beautiful home each day. The host were very helpful with providing places to eat and very timely and attentive to our needs. Will definitely stay here again.
Very spacious rental. Plenty of space for 3 adults. Very quiet. Comfortable beds & spacious bathroom.

The owners here were very courteous of my presence. They gave me a lot of space to come and go. They weren’t disruptive in any way. Their four sweet kitties were very cute and made me feel less lonely since I left my kitty at home.  Most importantly, I felt safe being here alone as a woman on my solo trip in a big city and that is priceless.

Pros: the apartment was very clean. Katty was very responsive. Check in was very easy, instructions were detailed and clear. Beds were very comfy. The AC’s in multiple rooms were amazing. The kitchen was fully stocked with silverware, plates, and cooking utensils. The apartment is also close to multiple bus stops and a Metra train station.
Cons: the hot water pressure is low. There is no wifi, which IS correctly listed in the listing, but was odd because there is also a “dedicated work space” and smart TV. The listing also includes “steaming services,” but none of those worked without wifi. I saw a few ants on the rug in the living room. The floors are very creaky (the building is old, not a fault of the owner), and the upstairs neighbor was very loud.
很安静的区域，停车位好找，房间设备齐全，一切用品都很干净、无异味，如图描述，一切都很好。到千禧公园开车只需要18分钟，很喜欢这个地方。
We loved staying here! Very convenient location, quiet neighborhood, very comfortable beds, and the ac made the temp perfect.
Place was amazing as always. I enjoyed my stay. Will be back again!

The house was so spacious and clean, and we loved having it for a couple of days. The instructions were clear and easy to follow, and our host was super responsive to all of our questions. We’ll definitely consider staying here again next time we’re in the city!
Very small and cozy place to stay. Highly recommend
Nice place — great access to the lakefront, a fun neighbourhood, and mass transit. Quiet, clean, cozy, cute. We were able to drop our bags a couple hours before check-in, which was super helpful.
Loved staying here , at first I was a little confused by the outside appearance but the inside is a 100% 10/10. I would def recommend and stay again.
다좋은데 차파킹할공간을 찾기가 너무 어려워요

We had a wonderful 2 night stay here. Mark was friendly and responsive. He allowed us to drop our bags off an hour prior to our scheduled check-in since we had an event to attend, which we very much appreciated. The unit was nice and clean and matched the description/pictures. The area is very walkable with restaurants and bars nearby and there is also a Target a short walk a way as well. The area felt safe even when walking back from the bar at midnight. Street parking was pretty easy to find as well.

A nice place to stay especially for the price, had some trouble with the keypad automatically locking the door but other than that I didn't have any problems with the house. LeRoy is a very responsive host and very kind. I got blisters on my foot from walking around and within 30 minutes he was at the door with bandaids and antibiotics.
Great stay. Clean and welcoming. Marc was very responsive.
Great place

Our stay at Woods place was amazing! Very cozy and just what we needed for our little vacation! Wood was super sweet with us and understanding which we really appreciated! We will definitely remember Woods listing whenever going to Chicago again :)
Amazing place and great location, clean, great communication. I would definitely stay here again. Thanks Shay!
I was in town for a few days, and this place was perfect! It was easy to get wherever I wanted to go and it was nice to unwind at the end of the day very quiet neighborhood zero complaints

This Airbnb was a solid deal for the discounted price we paid. Unfortunately, due to the hosts' behavior, I cannot score it any higher.
I notified our hosts of our arrival time 5+ hours before our check-in. Instructions to enter the property were NOT included. Instead, they planned to have a host meet us there. We NEVER received a message from our hosts. Not once during our stay.
Eventually, after tracking down a phone number, a very rude gentleman gave me a lockbox code to access the property. We had to wait outside for about an hour. Why could this not have been given in the initial welcome message?
The spot is in a nice location. The Loop is easily accessible, and the neighborhood is peaceful.
I certainly have questions about the cleanliness of the place. There were a bunch of expired snacks (over 1 year old) in the kitchen. It does not inspire confidence that no one has checked them for that long.
STREET PARKING ONLY, but this was not hard for us to find.
Such a great spot on a great street. Lots of places to walk to and Yolie was super responsive.

Perfect place for my needs. Was able to get cheap rides into downtown and to the venue of the concert I was seeing because the location was perfect. The host was very helpful and made sure I knew everything i needed to know about the stay, and the price was unbeatable! 10/10 absolutely recommend if you are looking for a place to rest your head at night while you enjoy the city during the day!
Great place in a great location.
Great view, great location, beautiful apartment. Walking distance to Wrigley and to restaurants and bars in every direction. My new favorite location for Chicago visits. Can’t wait to return.
Great stay, near public transportation for easy access to all of Chicago.
This place was amazing! Stayed here with our family friends including children and the place we all enjoyed the stay.  Would definitely come back when we visit Chicago again!

My group and I enjoyed our stay here! Host responded quickly and recommended great local restaurants. The house itself is only a 7 minute walk from the bus stop that takes you to the metro that takes you to downtown Chicago. We really appreciated the in unit washer and dryer- it was a life saver! Host was accommodating to our needs and provided a lot of towels for my group. Would recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago and would definitely rebook again in the future!
Don’s place is our favorite we’ve stayed at in Chicago to date. Phenomenal place. Couldn’t recommend more.
Nice and quiet place. Definitely recommend

客廳、房間應該是有重新擺設，擺設不與照片完全相符，但都有提供對應的床、桌椅、衣架等
房間提供密碼鎖
浴室乾淨，但看得出來有很多東西壞掉就沒修繕了，所以個人物品都只能放在洗手台
浴室跟房間門縫偏大，外面走廊看得出來是否有人在內
Perfect spot to get to games at Wrigley!

Victoria's place was a great landing spot for my stay.  The space was clearly cared for with attention and a peaceful place to come back to after the hustle and bustle of the city.  The backyard is a sweet space, equally cared for with love.  The neighborhood was colorful and enjoyable with the variety of shops, people, whimsical details and felt safe.  Public transportation was easy to access, a 2 min walk and a short bus ride connects you with city in no time.  Victoria is a lovely host!

Tara was great to me and my friends/family. The number of guests changed last minute multiple times but it was not an issue for her as she accepted the change quickly. She responded quickly to my questions and supplied us with what we needed asap.

In my experience, considering the city traffic and the hassle of finding parking, it doesn't make much sense for a traveler in Chicago to use a car to get around. This is especially true since the city has a great subway system, with the Red Line being the best. I think one of the biggest perks of this apartment is its incredibly close proximity to the Red Line station, along with the ability to find free street parking on this block and nearby streets. The apartment itself was perfectly suited for two people. It was clean and had all the right amenities for a few days' stay. I recommend this place to others.
Was very nice exactly as described and extremely clean. Amazing location great to go anywhere in the city. The host was great and easy to communicate. Would stay there again!
This place was absolutely a perfect location from Wrigley Field! The bed was super comfortable and the place was super clean. I would definitely stay here again!

Alan's place is a perfect Wrigleyville stay if you are in town for Cubs games! The house has lots of space, it's a short walk to the stadium,
there is an outdoor cozy space, a private parking spot and street parking and so many fun places to eat and drink. Thank you for your hospitality - we will be back!

Great location for this apartment. I liked how clean the place was -- the bedding felt fresh and the place was spotless.
The location is great -- really close to the redline train and accessible to nearby shopping and restaurants.
The only correction I'd make to the listing is that I didn't consider it to be "luxury", but other than that I would recommend staying here again.
The property managers were very communicative and responsive.

First of all, Quinton as a host was friendly, responsive and easy to reach out to. He gave me a list of local recommendations that were great. The Airbnb itself was as described and more. It was clean, quiet, and had all the amenities listed. Location was within close proximity to a lot of touristy things to do in Chicago. Public transportation is close by if you don't drive. The space was more than what I expected and the photos don't do it justice. I wish I could've stayed longer but I had to leave to go back to reality aka work. Highly recommended.

The location is great. Close enough to the L to here Brown Line trains going by.
The place was clean, and check in was easy. One room for improvement: No facial tissues or coffee filters that we saw. Only one chair on the back balcony, but a nice space back there with potential.
Perfect location and owners were extremely communicative! Awesome place to stay!

Absolutely a 5 Star ⭐️ Stay… The beds felt like sleeping on a cloud, and the space included thoughtful amenities. Zen provided fantastic recommendations for awesome local activities, great restaurants and hidden gems in south shore!!! Awesome vacation and value. Thank you for making my stay very memorable Zen.
This was a great place to stay!  The hosts were fabulous and very responsive!  All is as pictured. Super cute and great location!!  We will be staying here every time we are in Chicago!!  Thanks!!

Stephanie was an amazing host, and our stay was absolutely wonderful. The apartment is beautiful—exactly as pictured, if not even better. It was spacious, spotless, and had every amenity we could have needed, making it the perfect place for our family.
The location was great, with several excellent restaurants nearby. If you’re driving, I highly recommend downloading the Chicago Parking app before you arrive—it made parking easy and convenient.
Overall, this was a 10/10 experience. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you, Stephanie, for a fantastic stay!
Nana and Owen were great hosts! The place matched the description & photos perfectly. Though it was near a bar, the noise wasn’t loud enough to disturb our sleep!
El lugar es muy lindo, nuestro cuarto estaba muy limpio y decorado tal como en las fotos. El acceso es mediante clave por lo que es sencillo acceder en cualquier momento. Todo muy bien!
Train was quiet and place was just what we needed

the cleaning ladies did a fanatsic job clean from the group before. It surprizes me how some groups leave and mis use other peoples property. Great location, wish parking was better but it is located in the city.

Nice location that's easy to get around, and you don't necessarily need a car. If you have any issues with noise in the building, such as from someone living above you, let Miss Weihong know. She responds very quickly and addresses the issue promptly.
Would stay again. Very nice apartment in a very nice building. Easy walk to Wrigley.
Great place. Accommodations were spacious and the house is in a peaceful and walkable neighborhood. Would recommend

The apartment itself was as described and Milan was great. BUT the building has some serious issues imo, with peeling floors, leaking roofs and cracks in the walls. Many of the doors in the apartment dont shut properly because the door jams have moved. The BBQ terrace is a disheveled smoking area with a big hole ready to take someone's ankle out.
We had the apartment for our team to stay for a convention. I dont think it is ready for corporate use because...
No towels for kitchen drying
Poor ironing facilities
No drawers in some rooms
Very few coat hangers
No plug in sink for washing up
No casserole dishes or anything to cook in the oven
No spray detergent or cloths to wipe surfaces
Poor kitchen accessories, e.g. no scissors, not enough glasses for 6 let alone 12
Its also pretty noisy from all the other groups staying.
And theres a funky smell throughout the whole building.
Is it a good space for a bunch of people to stay 1 night. But for 6 nights at nearly £5k poor value imo.
We loved staying here!! The place was beautiful and extremely comfortable. The host was friendly and helpful, couldn’t recommend more!
Check-in was smooth, place was clean and as shown in the pictures! Marc's communication made everything super easy and would definitely stay again!

今回のシカゴ滞在において、リグレーフィールドまで歩いて5分くらいの近さの宿に宿泊できたことはラッキーでした。
建物は周りの住宅地に馴染んだおしゃれな建物でした。建物内に他の居住者がいるので、静かに過ごす必要がありましたが大した問題ではありませんでした。
スーツケースを持って3階まで階段で上がることは、宿を選ぶ際に知っておかなければいけませんでした。
室内の設備は充分でした。冷蔵庫にはコーラやソーダが入っており氷も用意されていました。コンロも簡単に使えそうでした。電子ケトルや電子レンジもあるので、簡単な調理ができました。
ベッドルームも清潔でした。リビングには大きいソファがあるのでそれも便利でした。
お風呂とトイレも清潔でした。シャワーの湯量と温度の調整が難しかったです。
滞在中、カーテンが外れてしまったり氷のトレーを壊してしまうというトラブルがありましたが、オーナーへ連絡するとすぐに返信があり対応してくれました。
リグレーフィールドに訪れる場合は、こちらへの宿泊をおすすめします。

very clean and nice place to stay. neighbors were a bit noisy at times but overall it was a nice place to stay at.
the area was not what we had expected though.

Great location and a very fun place. We weren’t there long by enough to take advantage of all of the amenities. The “help yourself” kitchen was lovely, the decor beautiful, the beds comfortable. It’s nice to stay in a neighborhood rather than the Loop. Nice!

We LOVED our stay at Norma’s! It was exactly what we needed for our stay. We were able to work from her place during the day and were close to everything in the evenings. Also, the restaurant downstairs was delicious!!!
Fantastic location! Super clear instructions given make check in relatively easy even downtown. I do wish checkout was a little later than 10, but overall fantastic place to stay downtown Chicago.

What a gem this place is! Close to public transport, great neighborhood with plenty of shops around, and clean inside. Everything was as described. The hosts were also responsive when needed. I would def recommend staying here if you're in the area!

As a new DePaul parent this was the perfect place.  Parked the car and walked everywhere.  Was a great place to have a sip of wine on the deck and look out over Chicago at the end of the day.  I will book again!

Unfortunately WiFi didn’t work, with 3 network options. Shower had a lot of hair on the floor and walls, it did not look clean and I was unable to shower during my stay. The host asked for permission to enter the unit, I granted it from 9-5 and still no maintenance visited to help with the climate control, the WiFi, or the cleanliness. I was so so so disappointed and under satisfied with my stay here. Despite communicating with the host, I was not helped.
Was a good stay! We didn’t  really stay in the room over night because of a concert, but overall it was pretty accurate. Kitchen was very modern and clean. Bathroom was also big and clean.

We had a great stay! The accommodations were clean, well-stocked & located in a peaceful, walkable area. Lots & lots of communication from the helpful host with clear expectations. We really just needed a place to sleep in between seeing the sights & visiting friends, but it would be comfortable enough even if you were planning on spending some real time there. Being in a basement apartment, there was a bit of noise from the plumbing upstairs (not a problem for us at all, but just something to be aware of if you're sensitive to that kind of thing). All in all, would definitely stay here again! Thank you, Catherine!
Great stay!

first, it started with the complimentary whiskey aging in the front office. Then it was all the bathroom toiletries, and drinking water in the fridge. It really just set the tone for our entire stay. The host (and co-host) went out of their way to help me with a situation. And they were both just a treat to communicate with. The home decor is nothing short of fun. There is always something new to look at. My only real complaint, if I am to be nitpicky, is the projector thing. It seemed to not function correctly the entirety of our stay, but it wasn't a big deal because we had so many other things to do.
All in all, it was a fantastic stay with a lovely host.

The place was nice, clean, and exactly as described. The views were amazing—the city skyline from the balcony was beautiful, and the view from inside the home overlooking the train and the river was just as impressive. There were great views all around. The rooftop was also a perfect spot to relax and hang out. I would definitely stay here again!

Our stay at Hugh's place was short but sweet. Check-in was easy and straightforward, and the apartment itself was clean, spacious, and perfect for a quick getaway. It's in a quiet, pleasant neighborhood with easy train access to The Loop and other parts of Chicago, and it's surrounded by several cute bars and local spots.

The place was in a very convenient location, and was quite spacious. Brad was super responsive and easy to deal with. The only negative (which I had seen mentioned before I booked) was that the train line ran right across the bedroom window and was quite loud. I'm normally not a light sleeper but I found it quite noisy even with earplugs.

This apartment was perfect for our stay in Chicago. It was located within 2 blocks of a subway stop (others had mentioned issues with noise from the trains, I didn’t experience any of that). The place was furnished and decorated really well. I had just stayed in a shoebox in Boston for a week, so this was quite a nice upgrade. The communication with the host was easy and they were very responsive. I will certainly look to stay here again on my next visit.
The airbnb was clean and cozy. It is located in a good area, very close to the redline. Regina responds very quickly to messages.
Great place to stay for a short stay, but parking is hard to find. Restaurants are on the street which is a plus.
Wonderful place. Near for everything.
Jennifer was very responsive and the place was perfect for what needed to be!

I had a comfortable stay in Lincoln Park. The train was a little loud but I honestly enjoyed it and didn’t mind it at all. The apartment was nice and clean, and the area was very peaceful. The hosts were also helpful, responsive, and easy to communicate with.
Really cool house in a beautiful historic neighborhood. Comfy beds, lots of space and easy parking.

Very comfy carriage house. The beds were comfortable and the kitchen was well stocked. The parking was only street parking, not included designated parking space. Luckily it wasn’t an issue even coming back late.

The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed during our four-day trip to Chicago. The host was kind, responsive, and made the check-in process easy. The location was also convenient for exploring the city. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago.

Teddy and Amy were fantastic hosts. Very responsive and took great pride in their property. When a booking conflict arose with our original location, they quickly took action to ensure we were placed in another high quality property which was even closer to Wrigley Field. Would definitely recommend them as great hosts!

This place is absolutely beautiful and the pictures don’t do it justice. It’s pretty spacious and easy to get around and find things. Parking in the rear made it easy to get in and out and we got a visit from a friendly neighborhood cat named nemo. Definitely recommend!
A beautiful place to stay and an amazing host!! bery responsive and always checked on my friends and i!! highly recommend!!

LITERALLY A TWO MINUTE WALK TO WRIGLEY! And super close to the Redline to catch the train into downtown. It’s the perfect location! A very cute spot to stay on a quiet tree lined street—I’d stay here every time! Biggest plus inside the apartment is the washer/dryer unit! So helpful!
Very nice house with lots of space. Big living areas & kitchen with all you need for a comfortable stay. House is close to Belmont Station for an easy walk to the blue line. Enjoyed my time here!

This was a great stay, here for work and needed a space where I could have down time and make my own food. It was clean and furnished well. The kitchen was fairly stocked but lacked some basics like salt or oil (I bought a cooking spray and salt and left it there for the next folks).
Workout room is great and the rooftop view is stunning-- a great place to have a coffee and read taking in the view.
Shower was a little old and worn, but not dirty but certainly used. Water pressure was okay not great for someone with a lost of hair to wash!
This definitely going on my list for the future!
Great location! Clean and convenient.
I would stay here again. It was cheaper than the going rate for hotels on the north side and just as nice.
Beautiful place and exactly like the pictures.  I highly recommend.

Perfect 2 bedroom apartment for visiting Chicago and getting a unique neighborhood feel of the city. The area is peaceful and safe and connects easily to the rest of the city via a Metro stop just 2 blocks away. Also in an area with easy access to numerous restaurants and other services, although the nearest proper supermarkets require a bit of a walk. Linda was awesome at keeping in touch throughout our stay and responded to all our inquiries within 10-15 minutes. Always clear instructions and helpful tips given with enthusiasm. A real pleasure staying in this apartment with my wife and two children. We all enjoyed the city thoroughly, thanks in part to our positive housing situation.

Lovely apartment to stay in! It fit two of us comfortably, had a well-supplied kitchen, and was close to a lot of restaurants, shopping, and transit. I really appreciated the local recommendations as well! This is the perfect place to stay if you know you'll be out exploring Chicago for most of the day, but want a comfortable place to come back to at night.

My family really enjoyed our time at Paul’s apartment! The space offers room to spread out and the balcony was great. We did not cook any of our meals in the apartment but instead went out to eat or got carry out so I can’t speak to the kitchen supplies. We were traveling with a one year old and definitely appreciated that Paul offered a pack and play and a high chair!
Parking was the toughest part of this stay; street parking was somewhat difficult to find depending on time of day, but we did always find a spot after a few loops around and occasionally paid for a spot further up the street.
Paul was always very responsive when I reached out with a question! Thank you!!
Great place if you wanna stay for a bit. Spacious enough apartment in an incredible location.
David was very proactive and attentive. The area is amazing and very walkable to many restaurants, cafes and the brown line.

Great place to stay for our family. The space was actually much bigger than expected. The downstairs had the extra sitting room and the bedroom with 2 single beds, which meant my kids basically had their own floor which they very much enjoyed. Location was very convenient to Old Town's restaurants and shops and a short walk to public transit. Robert was also a great host - very attentive and communicative. Would stay here again.
Exactly what I needed. I was raised in Chicago and was visiting. This place was in the neighborhood I grew up in. Comfy and cozy.

Great central location for our Cubs game visit! Beautiful neighborhood with lots of restaurant options and great walkability to Wrigley Field. The apartment was clean, comfy and quieter than expected for an urban neighborhood. The only tricky part is parking, as it’s street parking with a lot of permit-only zones- would be much easier using public transportation!

An incredible spot! Easy to get anywhere in the city via CTA (blue line just down the street). Tons of restaurants and shops within walking. The balcony was great and roof deck was phenomenal. Cozy inside with stylish, cool decor and art. Safe and comfortable.
Very pleased with the location, made getting around very easy. Good access to public transportation and fairly easy parking! Would happily stay here again!
Great place! Don’t miss the roof terrace, amazing views!
Amazing apartment right next to Michelin star Filipino restaurant. Only 10 min ride to the United Center too! Great responsive host, beautiful clean space. Will definitely be back!
Perfect stay for our family of 5.  Clean, well kept building.  a short uber to anywhere you would want to go in the city.  great value - would def recommend

Tippi’s place was PERFECT! Such a beautiful and clean home inside and out. Got to briefly meet Tippi while she was baking something that smelled super yummy, and she was very sweet and inviting. Felt like I was talking to one of my aunties for a second there lol 🫶🏼 10000/10 would recommend and I would def come back to Tippi’s! 🤎

Well appointed 4th floor apartment, in a quiet neighborhood and easy for my commute to Fulton Market area. Comfortable bed and furniture. Of note, the building has construction as other units get renovated during the day but I was only there in the evenings and it was quiet.

This was a beautiful, honestly absolute steal of a deal airbnb I would recommend to anyone in a heartbeat. I truly do not think you will find a place more worth your money than this. Only about a 20 minute drive to downtown Chicago, it was perfect for what we were here for which was the Eternal Sunshine tour. Not only was the home itself incredible, but Vickie made everything seamless and was so respectful and kind the entire time! You can tell shes a good person and that made everything so much more smooth and enjoyable. Overall this is a 5 star place and beautiful with a gorgeous design, and overall our stay was 10/10!
Stayed at Demitri's two nights mid-week for work; it was a great, easy location close to the brown line (surprisingly quiet for how close).
SÚPER clean! listing matched the desceiption! Need a peaceful private getaway? choose this listing!
Mindy & Tony were great, any questions/concerns I had they answered right away! Thank you for sharing your home with me. It was clean, private, and I liked the location.

Very responsive hosts. Great location as right by trains and buses!! Felt safe to walk around and good restaurants around too.
Bed was comfy and room was spacious.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Great little apartment full of charm. We were visiting with our kids (6 and 8) and loved being able to play on the playground and soccer field across the street in the evenings. Easy walk to the brown line, plenty of street parking if you drive. The only thing worth mentioning is that one of the beds is very noisy/squeaky. Otherwise wonderful stay!

Had an awesome stay here for a month+! The layout is unique and worked really well for working from home. Very clean too!
The neighbors were all really friendly and kind. There’s a Divvy station nearby, which makes it easy to get to the train, plus a grocery store and coffee shop within walking distance. It’s also only about 20 min walk from the popular Logan Square area.
There is coin laundry and there’s plenty of free street parking… I never had an issue finding a spot. The hosts were also great and always responded quickly whenever I had a question or needed anything.
Would definitely recommend this spot!
Our family loved this place! Amazing kitchen, comfortable beds, close to public transit. Neighborhood had good amenities but was also very quiet which was nice.
Great place close to Wrigley.  It was perfect for our baseball trip

We had a wonderful experience here! Mimi's apartment is beautiful, full of natural light, and extremely clean. The high-quality mattresses and bedding made for a great night's sleep. It’s in a convenient, quiet neighborhood right next to transit options and great local bars and cafes. Mimi was an outstanding, responsive host and we appreciated all the small touches which made are stay comfortable. Highly recommend this spot to anyone visiting Chicago and the lovely Logan Park neighborhood!

Práctico, cómodo, muy amigable y útil para estadías cortas. Anastasia se mostró siempre muy amigable, proactiva y profesional. El vecindario es muy tranquilo y agradable. Es lejos del centro pero la línea rosa tiene mucha fluidez de tránsito. Precio calidad excelente.
This place was great. Easy to find parking. The host is very responsive it had everything you need for a stay. A comfortable place and a safe and quiet neighborhood. Would stay there again.
For price you got a lot of house, nice kitchen, pool table and tvs provide entertainment.
Location was perfect and having parking spot was very convenient!
I didn’t know if beforehand, but the location ended up being perfect! Would love to return!

The home was nice was a little confusing on getting In as I was told there was a key in a lock box but didn’t get the code just to find out I didn’t even need that at all . Also I didn’t know about the opposite water temperatures so I had too take a cold shower but got that figured out other wise it was a nice home thank you.
Great hotel located in a great and lively part of the city. Staff was friendly.  Love that they allow dogs.  Clean and modern hotel.
Place is definitely worth booking!

Great location in a safe area with lots close by. I was disappointed to not get the room in the pictures, I liked the layout in the pictures. Room was missing a few things, took multiple calls from the front desk to get the missing items. Overall the room did the job
Clean space in a great location with everything we needed!

Perfect location for walking to the attractions we were interested in visiting with our grandchildren. Loads of restaurants nearby. Loved Beatrix for breakfast- went twice during our stay. Though the sirens, and trains were loud, we were not bothered by these sounds of the city.  The use of white noise machines in each bedroom was a nice distraction. And though earplugs were provided, we found they were not needed.

We had an amazing stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The host was incredibly kind, responsive, and always checked in to make sure we were doing well, which made us feel very welcome. The location was great, and the entire experience exceeded our expectations. My daughter and I truly enjoyed our time here, and we made wonderful memories. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable stay. Thank you so much for your outstanding hospitality!

I can’t say enough about how wonderful our stay was! It was exactly as pictured, picturesque in every room. Very comfortable for our family reunion of 12. If you’re wanting to catch a Cubs game, this is such a walkable location and close to the L. It’s a beautiful quiet location and the house was spotless and comfortable, even during our hot, humid summer. Moumita was a great host making check in and check out easy. This is truly a gem for a Chicago vacation.

It was great, no issues. Just a heads up - the master bath with the nice tub is on the other side of the privacy glass visible from the kitchen. Not an issue but it made everyone in the trip a bit shy about using it.
Rooftop deck was wonderful.
The place was great. Exactly what we were hoping for!

Very cozy and clean air b&b. Beds were comfortable, nice kitchen and bathroom space. Close to restaurants and local grocery store. Michelle checked in to make sure we were all set, which we appreciated. Our family had a great experience!
Beautiful area with lots to do, space was clean and felt very comfortable.

Mary fue muy atenta en todo momento, la ubicación genial ya que está a una cuadra de la estación del metro que te lleva hasta el centro, el lugar es igual que en las fotos y el costo es accesible a comparación con otros lugares. Solo mejoraría la limpieza, todo lo demás estuvo genial.

Great hosts! They were very responsive and accommodating throughout our stay. The place was spotless, comfortable, and conveniently located close to downtown, with plenty of restaurants and things to do nearby. We had a great stay and would definitely book again!
Thank you for providing us with a wonderful place to stay! I would recommend this place to friends and family.

Had a nice stay - great location in Andersonville, a fun neighborhood with lots of shops and restaurants, tree lined streets, walkable to public transportation (L, Metra, buses) and beach (0.8 mi). Consistently found street parking right in front of the apt. One bed was a bit firm for us and AC is very effective (appreciated during hot days!) but a bit loud. Hosts are great - very responsive and friendly. Recommend La Baguette bakery/panadería, Taqueria Uptown, and The Coffee Studio.

I’ve been staying in Chicago a lot lately for work. Russ’s place sits near the top of the list. Extremely comfortable, clean, quiet and well appointed unit. Had everything I needed and more. Russ was very responsive with a WiFi issue which we resolved quickly. The neighborhood is a bit funky but the unit is fantastic.

Loved staying at Josh’s place for a little staycation! The home was very cozy and steps away from Clark street so there was always something to do. Josh was very nice and proactive. Would definitely stay here again!!

The apartment was just as described and truly beautiful. A wonderful walkable neighborhood. Definitely check out the elevated rail line that has now been turned into a walking trail and park. The hosts were responsive and very friendly. Highly recommend.
Great stay!

Really enjoyed our stay.  Great location where you can walk all around the city, while not being on an overly busy street.  Easy to park and unload luggage into the condo.  Very clean.  Open area is great for larger groups.  The balcony is wonderful with nice furniture and grilling amenities.  We had a great time and would recommend this place to anyone.

Where do I even begin?! Angela was a dream host!!! She was so kind, generous, communicative, and helpful. Angela and Ryan stayed up late to welcome us and helped bring our bags up to the apt. Which we did not expect at all but that’s who they are! So hospitable! We felt like longtime friends and right at home! We brought along our dog and they welcomed him with open arms and even offered to check on him while we explored the city. We feel really lucky to have stumbled upon this space—it was charming, full of character, cozy, very clean and very safe. It was stocked with everything we could have needed. We wish we could’ve stayed longer! Cannot recommend it enough!!! Thank you so much for everything, Angela and Ryan! We hope to see you again!
We had a great time at J’s house, she is very helpful and kind, and the price is affordable,very lovely place!
Great location close to lake and walkable to Wrigley.  House was clean and had plenty of space.  Would definitely stay here again.

Place is as described. Shared bathroom. In a quiet neighborhood. 10-15 mins walk from the center of U Chicago campus. The only issue I faced was with the wifi. It kept dropping so often that it was essentially useless. I had to tether to my phone (I got great reception on T-Mobile).
Great spot!
one of the best airbnb’s i’ve stayed at in awhile! had every amenity you would need and more. loved the location, and would highly recommend this place!

This is a must-stay! Located near the CTA (L train) station making it easy to access downtown Chicago. Darsh is an amazing host, who was responsive and made the check-in and out flawless. The space is very clean and well managed. I would highly recommend this Air BNB to anyone visiting Chicago! My wife and I will definitely be back!
Amazing location. My friends and I really enjoyed our stay. Everything was very clean, and the hosts are friendly and helpful
Solid spot, quiet area but stuff to do nearby and really easy to get to the lake or take the train into downtown
Great home.

Very good place to stay a block away from Old Town with shops, restaurants, and bars just within walking distance. The train system is accessible within a couple of blocks. Walking distance to Lincoln Park.
Fantastic place!! Great coffee. Tons of space for being in the city!!

Great location, great views and spacious!
Host very attentive!
Will definitely rent again!
The place was great. Very easy to get downtown but lots of places to visit in the local area as well. Also, great interaction with the host! Definitely worth the trip.

Fabulous location, easy check-in and check-out, quiet bedrooms, safe building, and a very responsive host.  Please note- the bedroom with two beds is only accessible by walking through the bedroom with one bed.  We knew this ahead of time by reading a review and asking the host. It should be added to the listing.  It works great if you have kids sleeping in the second bedroom, but may be a problem for others. The bathrooms are dated, but the beds are comfortable and the apartment is decorated nicely. It is a lovely neighborhood and close to transportation, shops, restaurants, grocery stores, and the beach.

It was good stay for our visit!
Pros:

-places was as pictured, just slightly worn as normal
