Overall still very easy maintainable stay and easy for a place for a short stay and for the mornings and evenings while you explore the city!

Great place to stay. Evan was an excellent host. Friendly, responsive, and very helpful throughout my stay. The place was safe, clean, and had all the basic amenities I needed. Having grocery stores right across the street was incredibly convenient. I had a comfortable and enjoyable experience and would definitely recommend staying here.

I was so impressed with this ABnB. John was amazing! He was helpful with directions to the flat. He also helped us with a parking space for a few extra dollars which was great place of mind for our trip. We felt safe and with lots of privacy. The bed was comfortable and the kitchen was perfect for a short stay. Midway through our stay, John checked in with us to see how things were going and to make sure we didn't need anything like towel and such.
The unit was clean and had everything one would need for a stay in Chicago even great restaurants close by.
For anyone who has health issues or walking issues know there are about 15 steps of stairs to climb up to the room.
I can't say enough about how wonderful and hospitable John was! Thank you for everything!
What a beautiful area. It felt just right for our trip. We would definitely stay here again! Thank you!!
The house was clean and very convenient location.
A very nice stay in a convenient location for the Jefferson Park station. Well-kept and clean place.

There were 8 of us from different families visiting Chicago for 2+ days. we rented 1R and 2R. It was cheaper than staying in a hotel, and really close yo everything. Having 3 showers for 8 adults helped with our morning program, and we each had some personal space. We needed to check in early, and Assel made it oosdibleEach apartment is a nice size. We enjoyed the apartment a lot!
i've stayed in chicago a few times, and this airbnb & the pilsen neighborhood has been the most rewarding! jason and bianca are communicative and caring hosts that have great local recommendations!
Great stay!  Quick walk to Wrigley.  Plenty of bars and restaurants within a couple of blocks. Been to Wrigley many times and this has been my favorite place to stay.
Had everything I needed for my stay and was in a great location that allowed me to travel to Northbrook and downtown for work
Great place!
Comfortable spot in a nice neighborhood with plenty of space for us to spread out.
Great place to stay! Host Martha was very nice and communicative. She was quick to respond to any questions! 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Everything about our stay was great and as expected. Perfect location if you’re wanting a place close to downtown.
Comfortable and accessible
Great location & easy commute to downtown! Perfect for a quick weekend in the city, will book again the next time we’re in town!
Really just a wonderful place to put your feet up after walking around the city and going to baseball games. Go Cubs Go!
Fantastic host and great place to stay. Great price and so much fun. I loved the location and how beautiful the house was. Very much worth it!
We stayed 2 nights, great communication with Josh, the apartment was clean, good location.
Cathy et Jeff ont été très accueillants et disponibles. Ils sont d une grande gentillesse. La chambre est très bien et conforme aux photos. Nous recommandons sans réserve !
Loved staying at this Airbnb! So cute and cozy! Was very clean no complaints! Anytime I messaged I got a very quick response. Would recommend to anyone coming to Chicago 🩵
Home was exactly as described and pictured. Nice quiet street in Roscoe Village perfect for a visit to Chicago

We loved this space! It is a shared home but I never once felt awkward or unsafe with other guests or the neighborhood. The train is literally a 2 min train walk. We were only in town for 48 hrs, exploring, perfect stay, I’d do it again!

This stay was amazing.  The directions on where to park and how to get in were so clear and easy to follow. Being so close to a blue line stop made getting around so easy. The place was just as described and it was perfect for what we needed. It was quiet and it was so nice having a place to park my car. Would definitely book here again!
Excelent location and super roomy, Nabil is always atent to any need you have! Great Chicago option!

Was difficult getting in because we kept got different code in morning of check in and a different in afternoon and neither worked so had to message.
They had inspections on Thursday the day of our check out which we were aware of. However a maintenance man knocked and came in daily to fix stuff. We felt rushed out daily because of this. Made us uncomfortable that someone kept coming in. If she had repairs to do before an inspection, she shouldn’t have rented this week.
Also, it says lots of street parking available. It was very difficult to find a spot because a majority of streets say no parking 6 PM to 6 AM without a permit. So unless you got lucky when you were coming and going, you usually had to park blocks or streets away to and walk. That was fine for me as a younger person however, it was not convenient for my Mom who’s 66. Nor is it convenient to hall in luggage.
Place was spacious and had plenty of room.

It’s a shared environment with others also renting rooms - shared bathroom. Quiet times were perfect and i genuinely have not slept better in a very long time. The room was the perfect place to relax and be alone. Great security for each individual room. Such a nice and lovely neighborhood that it’s located in, about a 15 minute walk from the blue line to the house. People were respectful and helpful. Felt very safe as a female solo traveler. Shared kitchen and i was mostly out doing my own thing. Mary gave me all the info I ever could’ve asked for, I’m so glad for my first air bnb stay ever - I chose her place. Was exactly what I needed. Thank you!

Mark was a great and communicative host. The home was nicely kept, and the neighborhood is quiet. Transit is also good and not too far away. Overall, I found the unit and location to be a nice stay and a great reprieve to come to after exploring the busy side of chicago.

My sister and I stayed in Rafal and Evonna’s beautiful home and it was our first time in Chicago. They were great with communication and very welcoming. Their place had everything we needed and they even gave us extra toilet paper when we ran out one time. It was very comfortable and we appreciated the cute little kitchen. Evonna gave us suggestions on using the train system which was super helpful. Checking in and out was very easy and convenient for us too. We loved our stay here and hope to stay there again the next time we’re in town. Thank you!

Absolutely LOVED our stay! Amazing host and she was always responsive and super quick with communication. The location was incredible, the room is so clean and easy to check in. We had everything we needed plus more. The location is amazing as it is walking distance to many shops, markets, restaurants and a chase bank. It is also walking distance to the red line which we took several times to go downtown and to Wrigley Field. The rides were smooth and very fast and only took at max about 15 minutes depending on where you were going. I would absolutely love to stay here again and have nothing but good things to say. Thank you!!

Nicholas was a great host, we have a 9 month old and it was super kid friendly. Also, close to several playgrounds, the Lincoln park zoo and the lake. Walkable to so many wonderful places and close to drive for many others.

We really enjoyed our stay, at James place. It was clean, quiet and the location was perfect.
Had numerous restaurants in the area, bus stop was right there on the corner, and it was a 10 minute walk to the ‘L’.
We came back late several nights, and if the bus was running late, we just walked from the train.
We’d stay there again, for sure!!

The apartment was clean and comfortable. The location was very convenient for access to Grant and Millennium Park, as well as lots of restaurants in River North. Access to the building was straight forward. Would recommend!
Millennium Park 10 was the perfect accommodation for our stay in Chicago.  Clean, bright, comfortable , walkable to the Ariana Grande Concert!!!  Serg is a superb host.
cozy place in the mid of the town. Clean and quiet. The host is very responsive and helpful

Excellent experience!
Host was great and very helpful. The apartment is much bigger than expected from the pictures.
Highly recommended!

Jorge’s place was a perfect stay. He was very communicative and responsive. His place was clean and exactly as advertised. He took the time to make sure everything was great and asked questions along the way to help make sure my stay was enjoyable. I appreciate the care he put into making me feel welcomed. I would recommend staying at any of his places on Airbnb

This was a great place to stay. Having a little outdoor area was a bonus. Parking was not too difficult at all. Great coffee place on the corner. One random thing we noticed is that the couch in the pictures is comfier looking than what was there—really not a pic deal but if someone was thinking they’d sleep on the couch, it’s not the same one, the one there is pretty basic and not too comfortable. Otherwise, this was a great place to stay. You can hear the neighbors upstairs, but honestly if you live in an apartment, it’s no different than that!
amazing!

Really nice place in a great location to visit Chicago. Building felt very safe. Walking distance to the Field Museum and downtown. Right on the train line.  Some good food options very close by with a bodega right on the corner. Place is well kept and communication was very quick. Price is probably in line with the area but hard for me to give 5 stars for a rental over $500/night. I would highly recommend this rental however for anyone visiting Chicago.
Sam’s place was perfect, in a great lively neighborhood. I loved the windows that let in so much light & how cozy everything felt!
Great place to stay on a group trip! Tons of games and activities to do inside and CTA transportation is right outside of the door

The building is extremely easy to check in/out. The apartment is close to everything, walking distance. The bed was very comfortable and the products/toiletries were top notch. Ceilings were also super high, which is an extra plus!
The only con was the train line (loop) that passes right by the apartment. If you are planning to take conference calls from the living room, it will be a bit hard. From the bedroom, the noise is not as bad. If you are a light sleeper, this place might not work for you. That is only my personal opinion. The host was extremely responsive and accommodating.
Thank you for accepting our stay.
You get what you paid for. When I was there the bathtubs were dirty and there was hair everywhere in the floor.
For the value it was a good stay. Thanks Eric!

Our stay was wonderful! The place was clean, comfortable, and felt very safe. The girls and I had a great experience, and our host was lovely and welcoming. We would definitely recommend staying here and would happily come back

I had a wonderful stay here! The room was quiet, clean, and private, and the rest of the home was clean and had everything I needed. Anastasia was always quick to respond, and was extremely friendly. I was able to take the train easily and got everywhere I needed without using any rideshare apps, which was a plus!
Smooth check-in/out and public transportation was very accessible.
Fabulous location, amazing vibes in the neighborhood on Cubs game days. Couldn’t have been better, everything was exactly as advertised. Highly recommend.

Was very accommodating as i was in between places and was great for work. Beats paying 3x more for a hotel room. Only non 5 star was the code for the building didnt work and the company that manages it for the owner holds a $500 deposit. Not a big deal but a 3 night stay at a hotel holds between $50-$100 a night for incidentals.
Another great stay here! We are always happy to be able to stay with Angelika & Zibi

La habitación era espaciosa y todo muy limpio. La cama era muy cómoda y baño bien equipado y nuevo. Tuvimos un pequeño problema con un grifo y se ofrecieron para repararlo sobre la marcha; Nala fue muy atenta y resolutiva. El barrio no era bonito pero estaba muy bien comunicado, con parada de autobús al lado, directo al centro. La cocina muy limpia, espaciosa y equipada (todo muy nuevo). Había un ruidito de motor en la habitación que sonaba a veces (suponemos que de la ventilación), no nos supuso un problema. En definitiva, muy recomendable, me volvería a quedar aquí.

Regina was a lovely host and was responsive to our every need! The area was peaceful and lovely. It is close the subway which is a plus and was only two blocks from the beach. The home was clean and homey. Definitely would recommend to stay at this beautiful place.🤩
Very responsive host, very clean space and great location.
john’s place is a great place with great location! everything is walking distance! very clean and a very nice apartment! would definitely recommend!

El lugar esta muy limpio , es muy cómodo para llevar y descansar después de un día turisteando.
La anfitriona siempre atenta y dando instrucciones claras para entrar sin problema
Excelente lugar 100% recomendable

Great location, walkable to things you may need. Many restaurants and groceries nearby. Spacious home
Friendly hosts with great communication. They helped us with a late booking.

My main reason for the stay in Chicago was to go to Wrigley Field and to see a show at Second City. Jane's place is perfectly located to the airport, Wrigley and to both Zanies and Second City.   Jane was incredibly responsive to all my inquiries, especially those pertaining to taking public transportation.   And I must say I saved over $85 in taking Ubers around!   This place is perfectly located to both the bus AND the blue line!  It cost me $5 to get to her place from the airport!!!  This is the perfect location for making great memories in Chicago!
This was a great place to stay & Lincoln Park seems safe & it was an easy to get to other places in Chicago.
Very nice host - very clean house.   The neighborhood was a bit challenging, but overall great experience

My sister's and I had a great time in the city and we're so relieved when we had gone back to Milan's place. We felt so relaxed there and safe. It was easy to find and easy to get in. The balcony was a great bonus it was a nice space just to hangout. :)

We had such a wonderful stay! The home was incredibly clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The hosts were extremely responsive, thoughtful, and helpful throughout our visit, which made everything feel so easy and seamless. We truly felt at home and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. We would absolutely stay here again and hope to be back!

Overall our stay of two nights was very good. Only two issues - no shower curtain and the tub did not drain. Both of which were fixed the next day at our convenience. Mera is a very proactive and responsive host. The location was perfect. We would stay here again.
Amazing guy

Our stay was wonderful! Everything was exactly as described in the listing, and the photos accurately reflected the property. The home was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for an enjoyable stay. Communication with the host was easy, and the entire experience was seamless. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to others.
It was awesome very quaint if I could change anything it would just be about the parking issue
An amazing home in a stunning neighborhood. Train didn’t bother us at all. Easy to grab the bus or L to get anywhere in the city. Would love to return. Thanks for a great visit!
We had a great time at Liz’s!
This unit was the perfect place for our stay and walking distance to Wrigley Field! I would highly recommend to others and will stay again on next trip to Chicago!
Is the first time my friends stay at an Airbnb  and were skeptical but they really liked the practically of it. I’ve stayed at other Airbnb’s but this one definitely stood out.

There were several issues with the unit which we told Rida about (no pots or pans, dishwasher didn’t work, shower didn’t drain fully). We declined to have someone come check on the issues during our stay but I expect Rida will resolve them before another guest comes considering how communicative and on top of things she was. Another thing to note is that parking was impossible.

It was alright, the host was responsiveness during the last day. The only issues were that we came early but were not able to check in early. Rooms had good ac and were clean but there were some minor bugs here and there.
Beautiful place as described ! Excellent location to everything !
It was a nice spot to get around Chicago, simple, and had everything you needed.

Coming back as soon as I can. I would stay here tomorrow and the next day too if it wasn’t booked already and I didn’t need to travel to another midwestern city. This place is a gem. Exactly as described and a wonderful neighborhood.
My family loved this space for a quick trip to Chicago to watch a Cubs game! Amazing home and very short walk to Wrigley.

This was a nice clean apartment. The location was easy to find. It was easy access to all the places we visited in Chicago. The one main issue that I had with this apartment is that it had a skylight above one of the bedrooms, so it was never dark in that bedroom especially early in the morning. There were no ceilings in both bedrooms so you could hear everything especially if someone was watching TV. They did supply earplugs on the nightstands in both bedrooms, which was nice. To be honest, I would not recommend this place if you have multiple people staying.
Very beautiful place and was clean and spotless . I felt right at home and very safe to walk during the day
Avery's place was wonderful in a quiet and nice neighborhood. We had a great time. We'd definitely recommend it.

The apartment is ok. Kitchen and bathroom were clean and nice. The toaster has a loose contact, but it is still usable. The adress was not correct. The person who lives @ the given address has frequently AirBnB people fumbling at his door lock... And I found the amount of email traffic a bit annoying. The best about the apartment is the location so close to the beach. I went swimming in Lake Michigan every morning. The worst about this apartment is the loud noise of the air conditioning,  even though earplugs are provided.

We were supposed to check-in at 4pm but the room wasn’t ready till 4:35pm. That was okay but two ACs didn’t work for the whole stay which made our stay not so much pleasant! The host provided a small portable AC that you need to sit directly in front of it to feel the cool air.
Location was great and apartment was clean.

Took the family to Wrigley and this was an absolutely great place to stay! It’s a quick 7-minute walk to Wrigley Field, with a great breakfast spot just steps away and the Red Line right in the backyard. That being said the redline is in your backyard lol having the train that close does mean it can be very noisy throughout the night. I’m a heavy sleeper, so I personally had no issues, even staying in the room closest to the train also the host does provide white noise machine in every room. Unfortunately, the bed in that room wasn’t the most comfortable, but it was manageable. Trash pickup also seemed to happen 6am everyday during the week, which added some early morning noise. A HUGE plus is the included parking spot, which is extremely valuable in Chicago and saved us from having to find parking every night. Overall, my family and I had a great stay. The pros easily outweigh the cons, and if I’m ever back in Chicago with a big group, this would absolutely be one of my top choices.
Jevaux was a very responsive host and always answered our questions fast! The place looked exactly like the photos and was in a great location!

Had a great stay. Quiet and private space. In the middle of a great neighborhood. Real home type feeling. Hosts were communicative, responsive and really polite. Close to transit lines in every way. Easy to get to downtown. Super easy to get to the stadium. Great neighborhood diners. Worked perfect for us.

The location was awesome and the unit was exactly what I needed - no more no less. There was a little bit of a hiccup when it came to checking in but other than that the space and location is unbeatable!

Me and my friends did a last minute trip to Chicago and this place was perfect! She was so accommodating and very responsive. The place was so clean and was just enough to hang out and be at home. Definitely book!
The apartment was clean and comfortable and everything went smoothly from booking to check out! Thanks so much!

El sitio es tal como se menciona en la publicación. Un barrio agradable para caminar y muy seguro. Usar el transporte público es muy fácil, lo que permite gran movilidad y ahorro en los traslados. Marco fue muy flexible para hacer un early check in, lo cual agradecimos mucho.

Gabrielle’s place is a true gem! Quiet neighborhood, easy walk to train and bus stops, local shops and more. And her recommendations for food and things to do were on point! Will definitely book again next time we plan to visit Chicago :)
Easy to locate, easy to get in and out. The building is nice and quiet and the pictures were spot on. Would definitely book again
Great location and conveniently close to the CTA bus stops. Makes a great place to stay if you’re going to a Cubs game.
It was a perfect location for our trip!

The space was clean, quiet, and comfortable! Little bit of a commute to downtown if you’re using public transit, but close to bus stops and a Metra station. Philip was also a wonderful host. He was responsive, flexible, and very kind!
Friendly hosts, spacious apartment that was clean and well maintained.  The garage parking was especially useful as street parking is difficult at night.  Great stay.

This Airbnb was not only a great value for the price, but it was exactly what I was looking for. It beats staying in a hotel room hands down. The room was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed.
The best part, though, was the host. Communication was excellent from start to finish. I ran into him a few times while coming and going, and he was always friendly and made sure to ask if I needed anything. That level of hospitality really made the stay even better. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay.

Loved the space. Had a bit of an issue with the air conditioning units in some of the rooms, but they were actively being worked on and they even went out of their way to bring portable units into the room to make us comfortable. The building is old, so there were elevator issues, but would still highly recommend this place. Loved the rooftop space and the central location.
Very clean and well stocked apartment. Great location and an excellent host. I would highly recommend this place.

Charming & Cozy Stay in Chicago!
We had a wonderful stay at this charming home! The property is quaint, beautifully maintained, and incredibly cozy, making it the perfect home base for a trip to the city. Having two comfortable bedrooms with three total beds gave our group plenty of space to stretch out and relax, and the whole house felt welcoming from the moment we walked in.
The location was fantastic—nestled in a great neighborhood with quick, easy access to everything Chicago has to offer. The space was spotless, full of character, and equipped with all the essentials to make our stay completely hassle-free.
The host was exceptionally warm, responsive, and attentive, ensuring we had everything we needed for a seamless visit. I couldn't have asked for a better experience and would definitely stay here again next time I'm in town. Highly recommended!

This is one of my favorite places to book. The room is always clean and the house smells good. He doesn’t bother you and responds fast whenever you have questions. Very accommodating I will continue to book here again

Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The hosts were friendly, responsive, and made everything easy. The location was convenient, and I had a wonderful time. Highly recommend!

Peter was a great host and I can’t say enough about the home we stayed in. It was everything that was pictured to be. Beautifully restored and a historic neighborhood that looks right out of a postcard. This is my new go to place when I come to Chicago! ❤️
Die Wohnung war super sauber und entsprach den Bildern, die Ausstattung der Küche war landesüblich. Die Kommunikation mit Falon war schnell jnd sehr angenehm!
Great space and location!  Thanks.

The location is so awesome, in the center of everything with so many restaurants to choose from. It’s really close to the train so can be loud but the host provided ear plugs in the room. We enjoyed our stay and will recommend this place to anyone who want to live near west loop.
We had a great stay! Such a cute place in a nice area, and just a short drive to all the fun things :)
The host Doko was super proactive with anything I needed,location was perfect, and place was super clean,with a ton of little extras in kitchen,to the bathroom, can't wait to book again

We enjoyed our stay! It is a very cute apartment. Enjoyed the TV, foosball, couches and bedroom. Overall we enjoyed our stay and used a spot hero parking spot conveniently right across the street in the alley.

Alexandra was very helpful when we arrived so it was easy to get inside. She gave us recommendations and got me a birthday treat since it was my bday when I arrived. She is so sweet. Her home was very clean and had a lot of natural light and plants. She is right next to a 7/11 so that was a convenient perk.

We adored this apartment! Our whole family immediately felt at home. There were so many little touches that made it especially welcoming - memorable art pieces, goodies in the kitchen, lovely toiletrees, and a really nice hair dryer, for example. You can tell the host were thoughtful about things like plenty of light, extra storage, and super comfy pillows, as well.
The location is amazing and it is easy to get anywhere via public transportation (just don't try to take the Red Line toward Wrigley before a game or out after one!) There are tons of great shops, restaurants, and cafes within walking distance, as well. The neighbors in and around the building were kind and respectful, too. What more could you ask for?
10/10 highly recommend!

Our annual family road trip to visit family was very suitably accommodated during this stay! The home is just off a main road so navigating the surrounding area either by vehicle or by foot were both made easier by this! Traveling with 4 small kiddos is often a challenge to have adequate space in any capacity (sleeping arrangements, space to store and serve large meals, and a space to move around freely outdoors), but this property met all of our needs! Our only ‘complaint’ of any sort is that IF we did not adhere to the directions surrounding the HCAC systems, inside would get a tad humid and sticky - nonetheless, the property’s provided units, fans, etc were able to do a good job of keeping things comfortable! All in all - a great stay and we would definitely welcome another opportunity to utilize this property for future trips!

I can’t say enough about the friendliness, hospitality and open arms welcome I got from Donald and Colby. They are a delightful and fascinating pair. The level of care and attention to my comfort and positive experience was unmatched in my travels. I would return again and again.

We loved our stay in the heart of Wrigleyville! What a fabulous two floor apartment in a cool brownstone with the most amazing deck! One night we sat outside and listened to the entire Cubs game. It was so fun! Super easy access to the El, lots of fun, restaurants, and things to do around and a quick jog to the lake as well! Kimberly was super responsive. We loved everything about our stay and can’t wait to go back!
The only thing I will advise people looking at this apartment is our son is 6 foot 4 so the beds in the guest bedroom were a little short for him! FYI, if you also have tall children! He was totally fine but wanted to share! Thank you for sharing your amazing home with us!

This place was perfect for visiting UoC. Can't beat the price. Neighborhood was quiet w/ grocery nearby. Space was very clean. The bedroom walls are thin, so you'll hear your neighbors. Luckily we didn't get anyone crazy and they respected the quiet hours.

This Airbnb was in the perfect location. Everything was organized, clean, amd easy to find. Carlos was very responsive, and also made sure to check in to see if we needed anything. Highly recommend his rentals!

Marc’s place was very clean, well designed and decorated, and made for a delightful stay. The layout was cozy with plenty of space in both the bedrooms and common area. Would very much recommend staying here.
I enjoyed my stay I ended up not being able to stay the full stay but it was worthwhile I did hear it was strict non refundable policy but overall 10/10
Beatrice’s place was very well equipped, set up was great and was perfect for us. The backyard was gorgeous!

Stayed here for a few nights while attending a concert, and it was a wonderful experience. The location was quiet and peaceful, and the home was very comfortable with so much historic charm. Check-in and check-out were easy, and Charles was quick to communicate throughout our stay. He was friendly and gave us great local recommendations. Everything listed in the amenities was provided, and the home was exactly as described. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you for a great stay!

Loved everything about our stay! Perfectly accommodated our extended family from 2 - 70 years old. Location was amazing, close to anything you could possibly need as well as public transportation. Josh was a great host and very communicative. Now that we’ve been spoiled being so close to Wrigley - we will happily stay here again next time we’re in town for a game. :)
My stay was excellent. The place was nice and quiet and very close to a park. Super easy to get to. Nice shower and bathroom. 10 out of 10 I would stay again if ever in the area.

Kevin & Adele were proactive about getting us information on our stay and very responsive when we had questions. The space was larger than it looked online and really a perfect spot, secure, comfortable, and inviting gem, hidden in plain sight in one of my favorite neighborhoods in Chicago.
The kids loved the foosball table and awesome, fun decorations. We used the place as home base to easily walk to the Brown Line for a few trips to Wrigley, for some excellent food and a few other Chicago adventures.
Overall, fair price, clean, safe, and open space that fit our crew of four perfectly.
Thank you to Kevin & Adele for a great place and easy stay!

We had an amazing stay! The host's communication was excellent from start to finish, making everything easy and stress-free. The property was exactly what we were looking for and matched the description perfectly. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a great stay. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fantastic Airbnb experience.

Beautiful home, quiet neighborhood, with a peaceful sense of security while walking the area as the sun goes down. Approx 15min walk from blue line with plenty of diverse shops nearby and a Starbucks conveniently across the street. Loved that part! Uber/Lyft drivers always minutes away with a quick drive into the city. ORD approx 30mins on the blue line.
The house was beautiful, spacious, accommodating, and well kept. Cute style!
Argelia was a wonderful host and easy to communicate with.
Will def be looking to book again next time I plan to visit Chicago! Thank you for the stay ❤️

We stayed for 7 nights - family with 2 teenagers. Great place, all as described, super friendly and very responsive host. Comfortable apartment, has all you need and the location to explore Chicago on foot is phenomenal. Definitely worth recommending
Great small area for a short stay. The area was a nice, quiet, and diverse. And public transportation was very nearby which is a great plus
Great location short drive to everything!
The place was great to accommodate our large group! Very clean and perfectly located near many local attractions.

My dad and I came to Chicago to watch baseball at Wrigley, the location is close to bus stations and the brown line train. So, getting downtown and to Wrigley is very easy. The apartment was exactly what we needed and clean. Mark was responsive and helpful. I’d stay here again.

Sehr schöne Unterkunft mit ziemlich guter Lage um Chicago zu erkunden. Sauber und großzügig.
Vielen Dank
Great stay and great location!

Linh and Solomon were incredibly responsive with all communication!  The home was beautiful and provided all the amenities for our family. It’s the personal touches, like the basket of goodies and snacks, that made this stay memorable. We will definitely be back if we’re ever in Chicago again!

We had a lovely stay. The neighborhood is very nice and clean. The home is exactly as described. The host was very accommodating and communicated well. Having little experience with the greater Chicago area we were surprised how long it took to get places that were not a very far distance (10-20 miles).

Great place to stay, lots of nightlife nearby and never once did we feel unsafe or unwelcome. the airbnb had all the amenities we needed and the bathrooms felt super modern and clean. the balcony was also a huge plus. the views from the huge windows were pretty awesome too. overall a fantastic stay, would definitely stay again given the opportunity!
Host was amazing!   Loved the place, really close to Wrigley Field!  Would love to go again.

Our family of four are beyond pleased with our experience at this air bnb! It was so nice having three queen size incredibly comfy beds. The place was so clean and the shower was spacious! The location was the best part - located on a quiet street so close to Wrigley, the train and many restaurants.  It was located on the second floor but we never heard anyone above us. You can hear the train but it never bothered us (and ear plugs are provided for those that are sensitive to it). Nicholas was so responsive and replied to our inquiries within minutes. We would stay here again in a heartbeat and cant recommend this air bnb enough!

Great stay! Nothing beats the 360 view from the roof! The condo was very comfortable. It was equipped with everything you need, while still leaving open drawers to leave your clothes. The hosts were very responsive. We also very much appreciated the location- walking or uber to tons of cafes and restaurants while being quiet at night. Quick Uber to the touristy things in downtown too.

Everything was clean, instructions to enter were clear even though it was a bit difficult to get to.  Our trip was smooth sailing until the morning of checkout, where a “maintenance”  man entered the apartment without permission, even though the door was locked, and then once we were finally leaving - there was a van blocking the garage and we were unable to get out. The host was very responsive, but only had to offer an apology unfortunately. It was very frightening for younger people in a city like Chicago!!
This location was absolutely ideal for our trip - an easy 15-20 minute bus ride up to Wrigley and an easy 15-20 minute bus ride down to downtown. We enjoyed our stay very much!

Only stayed for 2 nights and I felt right at home. It felt like a very luxurious stay, I stayed for the Ariana Grande concert and the desk/vanity was perfect for me getting ready. It's a very beautiful place and looked better than the pictures.
Came for the baseball, great area with lots of bars and restaurants walkable.

Location, location, location!  This is a great spot to stay for a Cubs game. My husband and 3 boys loved popping back and forth to the ballpark for autographs, etc. we loved the free parking space!  The unit was basic but very spacious and clean. We would definitely stay again!
Very fast to reply and was able to accommodate us well. Everything was good, no complaints. Well set up kitchen, pretty spacious over all well stocked with everything you need
Perfect home base for our Chicago adventures. Would definitely recommend and come back for another stay.

David was a great host! He checked in on us and made sure all was good, which it was! We were in town for a cubs game so the location was perfect! great place to stay for couple days, next to the subway super convinient!
Amazing location in a safe neighborhood. Host is very responsive. Everything was as advertised. Will definitely stay again on our next trip. Highly recommended.

Alex’s place was very clean and cozy. We loved how walkable the neighborhood was, and how close it is to the metra. His directions were clear, and it was super easy to get into. 房源非常有特色，也很舒适，值得再次入住。房东回复及时，介绍清晰。

Since the AC units were not working and the shower unsafe to use we requested and was granted a cancellation after one night. However we were not fully refunded for the three days that we didn’t stay in the unit.
We will not be staying at this location again.

So cozy and such a nice place to stay, plenty of walkable stores and restaurants not far from the place. Had a slight issue getting into the Airbnb that wasn’t anyone’s fault, however they responded very quickly and helped us get in and were very clear about what we needed to do. Loved the hosts and loved the place. Thanks!!

Very spacious, private, and peaceful.
Located very close to the L Brown Line.
Would absolutely stay at this location again.
Nice clean place in a great location. Responsive host and easy to check in and check out.  Will stay again on visits to the area in the future.

The place is bigger than expected! Very clean place. The two large beds were very comfortable. Ear plugs were provided but we never needed them. It’s right around the corner from a lot of nice places to eat! Highly recommend!
Great area with many walkable locations and easy transportation options for further afield. The home was charming and comfortable.

Hanna and Marks place was absolutely amazing! It was in such a perfect location, and a very safe area! We could walk to local hot dog stands, coffee shops, pizzerias and so much more! They even have one of the oldest candy shops right across the street, Margie’s Candies! I was in town for a 2 night show at the United Center and it was only 10 minutes from the venue! I will absolutely be back next time I am in Chicago!

Kevin was a great host - super communicative and left easy instructions so that we could navigate the locks on the front/rear and home doors. The cozy apartment was clean the beds were comfortable. Quiet neighborhood and easy street parking plus a space in the back of the building.
Good place to stay for a quick stay while exploring around Chicago. The train station is very close by and has 2 awesome coffee shops nearby. Enjoyed my stay while it lasted.

The placed looked great but once I looked around I noticed a lot of stains on furniture & walls the light fixtures in the ceiling was hanging down made me feel like I was being watched the kids above us ran all through the night & kept us up & when we arrived at night we seen a lot of rats running around which made us scared to walk back into the apartment good apartment just not for the price
I thoroughly enjoyed staying at the rock and roll apt.  The decorations were wonderful.  The apt is close to everything.   Wonderful place to stay and explore Chicago.
The apartment is very nice.   Having a place to park your car was the cherry on top.  Target and cvs are super close.  Also an Aldi and whole goods within walking distance.
Good place to stay.

Katty’s place is great to make it your home base in Chicago while you are exploring the city most of the day. It’s conveniently located, in a wonderful neighborhood, and in a safe neighborhood. I found the checking-in instructions a tad complicated, but Katty was very responsive.

Great place!

It’s a really beautiful three bedroom house. Very tasteful. Clean. Had all the amenities including washer and dryer. From a design perspective, house was very well lit and bathrooms well placed. Great location and there was parking. I’d definitely come back.

Clean, safe, peaceful. Loved it!!
The place was the  perfect location for our needs.  We had a wonderful stay.  Serg was great.  Thank you!!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in and check-out easy. The location was convenient, and we had everything we needed for a relaxing trip.
One thing to know is that if you're someone who likes to go to bed early or is looking for complete peace and quiet at night, this may not be the best spot for you. The nearby Dugout has music that can be heard in the evening, but it didn't bother us at all. We even had a child on the spectrum with us, and she loved listening to the music from the Dugout. It added to the fun atmosphere of our stay.
Overall, we truly felt at home, had a great experience, and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend this Airbnb!

Amazing place to stay in Chicago.  Close to train stations and Lincoln square.  The house is stocked with everything you would need to cook, relax and work.  One of the nicest Airbnb’s I have stayed in.

This apartment was the perfect location near the train to zip into the city, and in an excellent neighborhood with plenty of options for grocery stores and restaurants. Spacious and comfortable, with all the necessary amenities!

We had an amazing stay! We were a group of 5 adults and 1 child, and the place was perfect for all of us. Everything was exceptionally clean and well-maintained, which made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived.
The dedicated parking spot was a huge bonus and made getting around so much easier. The neighborhood was very safe, quiet, and peaceful, allowing us to relax after exploring the city.
We were staying on the third floor, and even though our child is very playful and active, we never received any complaints from the neighbors below, which we really appreciated.
The location was also excellent—about a 15-minute drive to downtown Chicago without traffic, making it very convenient for sightseeing.
The bedrooms, kitchen, dining area, and bathrooms were all spacious, clean, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. We would definitely stay here again!

The place was very clean, comfortable, and quiet. It’s also very close to the metro, which made getting around Chicago very easy. Lydia was friendly, helpful, and always quick to respond.
The only thing I would mention is that the surrounding neighborhood felt a little uncomfortable to me, especially at night. However, I personally did not experience any problems or unsafe situations during my stay.
Overall, I had a comfortable stay and really appreciated Lydia’s hospitality.

Diep’s place was one of the cleanest air bnbs we have ever stayed in!!! The amenities were top tier! The neighborhood was quiet and very safe. The well maintained space made our trip to Chicago breezy!

The apartment was good for a short stay.
Milan was helpful when we asked for more towels because they provided less towels than there were guests.
The apartment smelled like sewage off and on which was unpleasant. The kitchen sinks also backed up multiple times with dirty water. Milan was quick to reply and notify maintenance thankfully.
Two of the beds are very very soft while the other is quite firm, okay, but not everyone's cup of tea.
The apartment was as described and looked like the images. Easy to get in and find - Milan provided very detailed check in instructions.

The place was very cozy and well put together. We were very close to the city, and luckily there were many different convenience stores nearby. The car ride to the city was hit or miss depending on the traffic but overall a great location and place to stay!
Great stay, close to coffee shops. Nice neighborhood. Place was clean and comfortable.

We stayed here with 9 guests (2 children) and there was plenty of room for all of us. It is in a nice neighborhood with plenty of places to walk to and very close to blue line. The floors in certain areas of the house were dusty/dirty. Overall, it was a pretty good value for the price. Host was very responsive to any questions I had.

This place is pretty close to downtown (7 minute walk to train and you can be at the museum campus in less than 10 minutes), but there isn’t really anything close for necessities so we had to Uber Eats the basics we needed, like milk and butter.  The beds were comfy, but the pillows were subpar (pancakes) so maybe bring your own. The water pressure in the shower was great, with plenty of hot water.  Plus the ac worked very well for our summer trip.  All in all, it was a convenient location and good home base for our vacation.
Great location!
Good economical room.

We will most definitely stay here again. The house was clean, spacious & very well kept. It was just what we were needing. Chris was the best host! I had even mentioned the trip was for my birthday & he had a birthday balloon there at check-in.
When we travel to Chicago this is where we'll stay. Neighborhood stay in a big city.
Beautiful, clean and well worth the money. I highly recommend. I walked in the neighborhood and felt very safe! Thank you!!

Nice place that I was able to arrive when I needed to. Parking was a little difficult with large cargo van, but that’s Chicago for you. Host gave me info on nearby pay lot that worked out and always had spots open.

A lovely spot in a really nice building! The place has a lot of character, better than the pictures show! Our unit was more a room than a full apartment- perfect studio for a couple with good separation of space! The interior choices were fun and added to stay! (It’s cuter than it looks!)

Absolutely perfect spot in the city. We stayed for about 6 weeks and Katy's place had everything to make us feel at home. She was also very responsive with any questions we had. Would definitely stay again! thank you!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. It was perfect for our family of 6. We were comfortable and it was a great launching place for the things we wanted to do. Easy walk to the red line for easy access to everything. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!
Great location.

We had a great stay at Josh’s place for a couple of nights while in Chicago to watch the Cubs sweep the Dodgers! The location was perfect for our trip. Wrigley Field was an easy walk, and being able to walk back to the house after the games was incredibly convenient.
The place had that classic Chicago brick-home feel, and the upstairs space was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Having a garage with parking included was also a huge plus, especially in Chicago. We parked the car and really didn’t have to worry about it during our stay.
Josh was a great host, the location was excellent, and everything was exactly what we needed. We’d absolutely stay here again, especially for another trip to Wrigley. Highly recommend!

I would recommend this place to others and book again. I liked the neighborhood and location, which was ideal for drive time and transit routes. The bus stop right out the front door takes you to Wrigley Field. Great for a family vacation or group trip to Chicago.

The unit was very nice, clean and modern, and the location was convenient with easy access to the train. The host was also responsive.
There were some issues with the amenity information. I asked before arrival about an iron and ironing board and was initially told there was an iron but no ironing board. The host clarified this was a mistake and provided an ironing board, which I appreciated.
The bigger issue was Wi-Fi. I asked if it was available and was initially told that it was and that the information was in the check-in instructions. When I couldn't find it, I was told the unit did not have Wi-Fi yet. The host provided another nearby network, but it did not work. I had to rely on cellular data, which was difficult because I had poor reception.
I later noticed Wi-Fi was crossed out in the amenities, but I think the lack of Wi-Fi should be clearly stated in the listing.
Overall, I liked the space and location, but the conflicting amenity information was frustrating.

This air bnb was a great temporary home very safe very comfortable and it was very clean throughout the whole experience. The parking space is a bit narrow but you have enough room to park but the owners are very nice people and i would definitely stay here again.

I enjoyed my stay and brought my dog, a 14 pound Cavapoo, with me. My dog and the hosts’ dogs played together in the fenced backyard. I would highly recommend this host for anyone traveling with a dog. 🐾
I loved this place! I'm so glad I was able to book it.
Worked out.
Perfect place - location was convenient, comfortable bed, and great hosts. Book this place regret-free next time you're visiting Chicago!

Sarah’s place was SO lovely, and she was so responsive the whole time (even weeks before my trip lol). I went to DePaul so being in Lincoln Park was ideal for me, and this location was perfect. Right in LP without the hustle and bustle of campus. Plus the in-unit laundry was a game changer!! Would 100% come back!
Honestly the only feedback I have is that I wish there was more yellow lighting as opposed to fluorescent!

Fantastic place with very good hosts, gave clear instructions and were extremely helpful if there were any questions and had all the ammedities. Place was absolutely beautiful and in a good location from the bus stops and the train station. Will be planning to come back!

Excelente lugar para ir a Chicago y estar unos días de vacaciones.

Definitivamente volvería a este Airbnb en un futuro.
The place had everything that I needed for my stay and was easy to get into. I locked myself out on accident and Regina was able to help me out only a couple of minutes after I reached out to her.
Muy buen lugar para descansar

We picked this guest house based on proximity to Babe’s Sports bar, since we came to Chicago to visit the bar that’s getting so much hype! Neither the house or the bar disappointed - it was a great home base for our trip. Close to blue line, great coffee/restaurants nearby. Justin was a very kind host. The place was the right size for the two of us. It was quiet and clean. The only challenge for some folks may be the steep stairs, but they were fine for us. The house had everything we needed, and the A/C was great given the Chicago heat.
Great host, good area for Chicago’s top hits

Great location for United Center!
Jacob was very responsive and helpful. Had everything we needed for two night stay :)
Great place! Recommend!

Great place!  3 king beds nice.  Not as close to train as I had thought but still good location! Had a small issue with the breaker blowing in part of apt but they responded and told us what to do quickly.  Very helpful!  Great place highly recommend

Great place! I really liked the open floor plan, & the beds were really comfortable.
Right by the red/brown/purple line & 77 bus. Very close to the 22,36, & 8 bus.
My only complaint is that the week I was there went by too fast!

Great stay. I booked it last minute around 930 and the host was able to accommodate me for 10:30 PM check-in. I did not expect to receive a response so quick Airbnb every day. We had a great time. Good location, and the space was perfect for our needs.

Great place

Perfect and clean one bedroom apartment with everything you need. Host was very communicative and helpful and I was extremely happy with my stay.

Cozy, Comfortable, and Perfect for Our Family Stay
We traveled from Los Angeles as a family of four and spent five wonderful days in Brett’s apartment in Chicago. The location was incredibly convenient — close to grocery stores, shops, and set in a very nice, quiet neighborhood that made us feel right at home.

The couch was comfortable, and all the bedrooms were similar in size and equally cozy, which was perfect for our family.
Brett was very responsive and provided an ironing board and iron upon request, which we really appreciated. Overall, the space was clean, welcoming, and thoughtfully prepared for guests.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely return. Highly recommend!!

Sean is a 100% Superhost. The apartment was so beautifully designed and stylish that I wished I could have stayed longer, but unfortunately all the other dates were already booked.
I slept like a baby in the quiet room and incredibly comfortable bed. Everything was spotless, cozy, and welcoming. Sean even went the extra mile by providing disposable slippers, a hair dryer, and thoughtful little essentials for women’s needs. Every detail was carefully planned with so much care, warmth, and great taste.
The location was perfect—everything you could need in Chicago was nearby. I’m so grateful that I chose this place to stay, and I will definitely be coming back!

Shari and Frantz were great hosts and this Airbnb was gorgeous! They were super nice, clear with instructions,  and responded to messages quickly! We booked for a family trip. We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and everything we needed was provided. We felt right at home from the moment we walked in the door. Bel's place was exactly as described and her communication/response time was very good. We were able to explore the downtown architecture via boat ride and catch a ball game at Wrigley  field on the same day. Great place to stay and walkable to so many wonderful places in the West Loop / Fulton Market.  Easy check in process.  Plenty of space for a family of four.  Will definitely consider this place again.

Apartament fet amb molt estil i personalitat. Molt acollidor i molt agradable per viure-hi.

Friendly Host!

Loved the stay at Danny’s apartment. The space is as described, with many amenities to make your stay convenient, and the simplest checkout I’ve experienced in a while (more hosts should be like this.)

Tim made this visit easy.  Was able to park on the street for free and do most things on foot, including a Cubs game at Wrigley.

Dave and Joy were so welcoming!  The Coachhouse was super adorable, pristinely clean (and I have high standards!), and so many thoughtful touches with fresh flowers throughout, beverages, and a cute sign-in book! Great location. Less than a mile walk to downtown. Great shopping area and Lake Michigan is walkable.

We had a wonderful stay and really enjoyed the property. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location, making it easy to explore Chicago.
Matt and Wendy were very responsive, friendly, and provided clear instructions throughout our stay, which made everything seamless.
The location was excellent, with great restaurants and luxury stores just a short walk away, making it easy to enjoy the best of the city.
The attached garage was very convenient, and we appreciated how well-equipped the apartment was. It truly felt like a home away from home.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Perfect stay! I was really impressed with the unit, super clean and comfortable. Bedroom bed was really cozy! Will stay here everytime I’m in town. Host was also super responsive and kind enough to accommodate a late check out.

Great place and enjoyed the area. The location is amazing and it was easy to get around. Everything else was easy as pie.    Don’t run to many electrical  items in the home at once the power will go out so have to trip the breaker.  We learned that too.The host  was awesome in explaining the why as it is an older building. We did appreciate the person cleaning the floor while we were there he was fast and it looked great when he was done.  An awesome place and I would stay again.  Highly recommend.

Perfect description of the space and activities nearby.  We stayed here for some Cubs games and the walk was manageable.  The walk was more enjoyable than waiting for the train honestly.  Chris was super responsive and helpful.  We will definitely be staying here again.

Great communication. Wonderful place, private atmosphere! Andrea place was a life saver. Top notch host ! Truly blessed and appreciative! Wish I could’ve stay longer, definitely will try this place again!

This airbnb was cute, clean, and comfy.  It was the perfect size for two people. The shower was very spacious. It was a nice spot- close to the city, but far enough away from the crowds!  If you are a baseball fan, it’s only a few stops away from Wrigley field on the redline train.
We loved the area. Once we parked the car, we never had to drive. Great location.

We enjoyed our stay. The space is clean, roomy and located in a great neighborhood within walking distance of many restaurants, bars and shops. We enjoyed the area as there were many people out walking the neighborhood throughout the day and evening. Would recommend.

The apartment was spacious and very comfortably fit a larger group. Excellent location too!

Very comfortable, beautifully set up and supplied. Very close to Whole Foods and restaurants and shops on Broadway.

Kyriako’s place in Hyde park was great. It was very clean because of its location you don’t need a car or need to Uber anywhere unless you’re trying to go downtown. Will definitely stay there again oh my next visit to Chicago.

The bedroom with two beds has two windows--one high up to the living room/kitchen, and one that looks into the master bedroom through a courtyard--neither had blinds or curtains, which made it challenging for restricting light and achieving privacy once the kids went to bed.  Additionally, the dedicated parking behind the unit required that we park behind a guest from another unit, and I was asked by the host to leave a note with my phone number to move my car if requested by the other guest--obviously not ideal, particularly staying with young children.  There is limited street parking, though overnight street parking is restricted to those with a parking permit only.  Overall it was a good stay, though not the perfect fit for our family.

Great place to stay. Host was extremely responsive and the place was comfortable and clean.
There is alot to do around the area and its vibe is amazing. Thanks for letting me be a tourist in my hometown!

Joseph’s apartment had everything we needed for our stay , every thing was clean and organized and was a very safe stay , easy access too a lot of stores around him would definitely recommend him

We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay.

The included parking is only a couple of blocks away and proved convenient with easy in and out. All in all, a great stay and we’d come back again.

Nicole and Matt are fabulous hosts as they are responsive and welcoming. The apartment is just lovely- we especially liked the way the bedrooms are separated from the living area by a hallway. Ryan is an exceptional host. The house is absolutely beautiful and well-taken care of! He gave my fiancée and I all of the information that was needed, and made sure everything was taken care of. Superb stay!

Had a great time at Juan’s…second stay and nice place to stay if you are in Bridgeport

Close to the metro. Very nice place to spend some days in Chicago!

I absolutely loved my stay here! It’s cozy, the bed is unbelievably comfortable, and the amenities cover all the bases. Maria was helpful with every enquiry. The surrounding area and nearby Wicker Park have phenomenal restaurants and bars. I just couldn’t have loved my stay more!
We enjoyed our stay, it’s spacious and met all requirements for our family of 6,  safe neighborhood and easy access to local transport, grocery and pharmacy. Caleb is very responsive.

Only challenge we experienced was when the code didn't work for the common exterior door to the building, but the hosts were accessible within a few minutes and resolved the issue. We really liked the house. There was no toaster and some things were not easily accessible, but worth the price and enjoyable.

Nice place to stay. Easy instructions to follow. A front desk person was there and also helpful. 2 beds, 2 baths, and a large couch. Overall safe area, it’s on a main road that’s well lit. Would maybe be a little weary walking around late at night but that’s kind of true for many parts of Chicago. Overall very nice and I would stay again!

Great stay! Had a great time!
