Julio was very helpful and responsive! The location was a quick 10-15 min walk from a lot of great bars and restaurants. Perfect for a solo trip and stay!

Wonderful location!  Loved the easy parking and adorable surrounding neighborhood.  We were able to easily stroll down to the beach and very nearby ice cream shop etc with our kids.  Only issue we had was the AC was quite loud in the living room as has been noted.  Overall very comfortable place to stay, would love to return.

The host was very proactive in their communications. They left clear instructions for checking in and out. The apartment was in a great location with lots of restaurants and places to visit that were all within walking distance. I would highly recommend Chicago Hospitality Club and consider returning.

This was a near perfect place for us.  Close to where we needed to be.  Clean.  Great for a family.  They communicated great before, during and after!  Thank you for a great stay.  Just wish we could have had more time there!

A perfect place to have as your base in Chicago! They’ve created a great space in their home, which is full of fantastic art, tucked away in a little paradise. They even have  a fantastic book of recommendations for the area!

Great place to stay in Wrigleyville within walking distance to the ballpark. Lots of restaurants and bars within walking distance too.  The townhome is situated in a very nice residential area lined with trees.  The only recommendation is to plan for parking near by beforehand, especially if there is a baseball game being played.

this place was fantastic. I love the layout of the place. it was way more space than I was anticipating. the kitchen was great. I wish I had someone else to enjoy with as I was a solo traveler but the in-unit washer and dryer and everything really worked out for me. The neighborhood is a beautiful neighborhood near where I used to live when I was there in Chicago. there is an element of homelessness in the area that you should be aware of and also three flights of stairs with no elevator. if you're an older couple hauling bags might be a bit of a challenge but worth the unit.
Great time

We selected this location to be close to Wrigley Field. It was perfect! It is an easy walk to the stadium, neighborhood restaurants and bars, and the metro if you want to avoid traffic from the airport or getting downtown.

This place was amazing and I really enjoyed my stay. Everything was clean, well kept, and the location was perfect for getting around. Parking was also easy to find nearby, which I really appreciated since that's not always the case at other places I've stayed.
Communication with the host was great and everything went smoothly. I also want to mention that the train noise didn't bother me at all. Overall, it was a great experience and I would definitely stay here again.
good

The farm was a great little launchpad for moving our daughter back to school. Lots of personality in the grounds and space. Loved being greeted by sunflowers and seven pretty hens. They also made some delicious eggs! Well stocked kitchen and great communication. Promptly helped us reunite with a sweatshirt left behind! The expansive Ana and Frederick Douglass Park is just across the street. There's a lot of trash, unfortunately, but there's lots of beauty there. Caught a crane resting in one of the ponds.

Oh my heck Tim and his place and his coffee shop was actually so amazing! His home was so comfortable and we felt right at home. It’s decorated so beautifully and it’s for cozy. Tim is so kind and helpful with everything we needed! This spot is such an amazing spot to stay at. Would definitely recommend and will definitely be coming back! Thank you!

We loved staying at Susie’s place. We quickly felt like we were part of the neighbourhood and all the locals were so friendly. We loved sitting on the front porch in the morning and chatting to the people walking by. Will definitely stay again when we come back to Chicago one day!
Close to everything. Pool, hot tub, sauna, and gym were great. Target, CVS, and restaurants all super close. Grant Park only a few blocks away.

Josh and Jordan were amazing hosts and very responsive.  The place was beautiful, extremely clean and exactly as pictured.  The location was awesome too.  I would highly recommend to anyone visiting the area.

Loved the stay! I honestly had no major complaints, other than the rooms didn’t cool as much as the living room area but it wasn’t terrible. If I had to recommend something it would be to have a full sized mirror for us girls to check our outfits lol but overall great place and I would definitely stay again! And it was so convenient having the bar downstairs especially because their food was so good.
We had a great time! There were little amenities that were thoughtfully curated, alongside a very private stay. The train was literally only about a three- or four-minute walk. Great experience!

I don’t even know where to begin- our stay at Kyrylo’s place was phenomenal! The home was beautifully and thoughtfully designed, and you could tell the hosts put so much care into every detail, from the stunning tile work in the bathroom, in the kitchen to the high-quality finishes throughout. It was spacious, incredibly comfortable, and stocked with everything we needed, including games and delicious snacks. Cleanliness is one of my top priorities when choosing an Airbnb, and this was one of the cleanest places I’ve ever stayed. The location was another huge bonus—close to downtown Chicago and the University of Chicago, where I attend conferences regularly. It truly felt like a home away from home. Thank you for creating such a wonderful experience. We can’t wait to come back and will gladly stay here again. Highly recommend!
Brad was incredible! Clean place, and the vibes were great. He was also a respectful and responsive host.
Stay was great! Location was perfect for Wrigley, and access to the train was easy for anywhere else we wanted to go.

We absolutely loved this airbnb! When we arrived, it was very clean and prepared for us. It also came supplied with more than we thought we’d need. The space itself had plenty of room for 5 guests. Additionally, Ben was very communicative and helpful. We are so glad we stayed here during our time in Chicago.
Amazing location right on Belmont.  The apartment also spacious so was able to get my small family in it no problem.  Recommended if you want to be in that part of town.
The place was pretty good because it’s close to all the main attractions of the city. It was a bit hit cause we couldn’t change the AC temperature.
Nice place
Great location, clean and in good location. Recommended!

Everything about our stay was fantastic. The space was sparkling clean, beautifully decorated, and had all the thoughtful touches we could have asked for. The host was incredibly responsive, polite, and made check-in a breeze. The location was super convenient as well. We would absolutely love to stay here again!

One of the best AirBNB properties where we have stayed. Beautiful does not even begin to describe the home and the surrounding front and back gardens. We enjoyed every minute and would definitely like to come back in the future.

Great location, lovely neighborhood, short walk to grocery stores, cute shops/restaurants, and the CTA station. It was the perfect amount of space for our family trip. Kitchen was well equipped. Barbara was very welcoming and responsive!
It was a very nice and comfortable apartment, located right next to the river in a lively neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and a beautiful promenade. It was an ideal place to stay.

Would I stay again? Most likely. Great location, outside balcony was such a plus and very walkable area.  The downside - Jorge or whoever the host is, is an AI chatbot.  We had numerous issues and sent messages.  I had specifically asked whether the elevator was working and was assured it was.  It was NOT. Check in instructions were very clear - even a YouTube video, however, the sensor outside the door is very tricky and it was difficult to get the fob to work.  We did run into the Wizard (from behind the curtains) who I suspect was the owner and he gave us the pin number to get in.  The patio doors are unlike any I have ever seen and there were absolutely no instructions for the unit.  We spent about 30 mins trying to figure out how to open the patio door and one night almost got locked out on the patio.  There is NO outside door handle.  We spent another 30 trying to get back in and finally had to lift the door.  The air vent in the BR is stuck closed and was hot.
Great place!

Seth’s place was great for our group!  Perfect location. Had such a memorable visit with our group of 8. Celebrated our sons with their moms before they left for college. Everyone loved the place and truly something for everyone in the neighborhood. Loved the balcony with the fire pit. Made such great memories. Seth was very responsive and his place was very clean. Parking onsite is also a plus.  We will definitely try to stay again!  Would highly recommend.

Having been to Chicago multiple times I thought Regina's was a great deal for the price. Close to Andersonville and Uptown so shops and Restaurants were walkable. Check in and check out was easy and Regina was great with directions about the entire process. The furniture was a little worn and did not match the pictures and the blinds were broken,  but since we did not spend much time there the price and location made up for that. Overall a great value!
We absolutely loved this airbnb! It was so so cozy and in a great area!! We would 100% stay here again. Everything was as stated in the description:)
We enjoyed our stay. We had everything we needed and loved being pedestrian close to everything. I think the location is perfect for a stay in the city.
Very comfortable great location living room was great place to chill and an outside space that was really relaxing
Great stay! Place was spacious and clean. Laura was very responsive. Would definitely stay here again in the future!
Leo and Alex home was as listed and was easy to navigate to and from downtown and the airport. Great place to stay.

The doors were left open multiple times and when we asked someone working in the building about it he said it was because someone’s code wasn’t working but that it was “very safe”. He then accused my mother of smoking inside even though she has gone downstairs to smoke every time.
The WiFi was out almost our entire visit and the ceiling was missing in part of the hallway. The other guests in our room told us they were told to leave the door deadbolts since their code for the door wasn’t working, even though using the deadbolt to keep the door unlocked is a safety concern.
非常好的一次入住，感謝
This is such a lovely place and we felt right at home. If we needed anything David and Andrea were quick to help. We will definitely stay here again.
Alice is an incredible host! She was super helpful for us traveling with multiple kids. Highly recommend!
Chicago is great and Ann is a great and responsive host!!!
Really clean place. Great communication from the hosts. Would definitely recommend
Great place with lots of great decorations.  It's an easy uber distance from Downtown, Wrigley field, and other local spots.

I am not usually one to gush but we loved staying at Terri’s property in Lakeview. The location - quiet neighborhood street with easy walking access to restaurants, entertainment, and mass transit. The apartment - hardwood floors, high ceilings, and large bay windows that brought back memories of my grandmother’s home but well maintained and appointed with the modern decor & conveniences you’d expect. The host - Terri was responsive, thorough, and easy to communicate with. This property is absolutely on my list for a repeat stay the next time we’re in Chicago.
Could not beat the location and the place was also exceptional.
Chanda was an exceptional host. The Airbnb was conveniently located. The Airbnb itself was immaculate, spacious, and equipped with numerous amenities. An unforgettable stay!

Erica was a great host! She was super responsive and helped us when we had an issue with the shower drain, and again when we needed more toilet paper lol. She even offered to store our luggage after checkout.
The space was clean and beautiful, albeit more cramped than expected. I really appreciated the comfortable bed with quality linen bedding. It is a very narrow space between the bed and the wall, and the bedframe has sharp corners, which made it a bit uncomfortable to get in and out of bed on that side. Also, the clear chairs are cute but they are not comfortable whatsoever. Wifi was decent but would stop working sometimes. We didn’t drive, but took ubers and bus/trains to and from the city pretty easily. Aside from these notes, it was a great stay and I would recommend booking with Erica!
Great place to stay, and very responsive hosts

I live in Chicago but booked Erin’s apartment for a short writing retreat to work on a project for my college tenure process. Everything about the apartment was perfect for staying in and feeling focused. Erin was able to offer late check out to give me more daytime to work. The space was comfortable, had great AC, was sunny & bright, and had all necessary amenities & a few extras like charging cords & a Brita pitcher. The house is on a busy street, but the traffic noise is standard for city living. I plan to book the place again for another writing retreat as I get closer to finishing my project.

We absolutely loved our stay at Laura’s place! The home looked exactly like the photos. It was very private (bottom level of building) , spacious, and comfortable, with plenty of room for our family. The beds were super comfortable, and everything we needed was easy to find. Kitchen is full equipped with cookware, dishes, seasonings etc.
Check-in was a breeze with very clear instructions for accessing the home. We also loved having private parking in the rear, which was such a convenient bonus, especially with a five year old. We didn't have to walk far or find street parking (although that looked plentiful as well).
The location was great—easily accessible to the downtown area while the neighborhood itself was quiet and peaceful. There also seemed to be plenty of dining options nearby. We rented a car so we zipped and zapped all over Chi-town.
Overall, it was a lovely stay and felt very comfortable for a family or small group. We would absolutely stay here again!
Incredibly clean and comfortable place in a great area!
Great host. Awesome stay. Wonderful location.
Great stay :)

Jorge was very responsive and kind. Unfortunately the place had several issues that make it so I cannot rate this higher. The cleanliness of the place was concerning. It had a very strong smell of animal urine. The floors, especially in the bathroom and bedroom were dirty, with trash and crumbs left over from previous guests. There was no WiFi and there was no hot water. The parking is very very limited, especially at night.
Based on the other reviews it seems like these issues are reoccurring.
The beds are comfortable, the apartment is spacious, the kitchen has updated appliances. The host provides ear plugs which was great considering the busy street.

This is our second time to stay at this property. We love staying here - my kids literally count the steps between the front door and the gates at Wrigley! It is so fun to stay there for a wrinkly series, and we hope to come back for years to come!

Myself and 3 friends stayed at Josh’s place for almost 3 months. Throughout the entire stay Josh was extremely responsive and always made a huge effort to make sure our stay was as enjoyable as possible. The apartment is located in a very safe and friendly neighbourhood and is just a 10 minute walk to the train. The apartment was always clean and Josh provided us with a mid stay clean free of charge. We were working as J1 students for the summer and this apartment was perfect for us. It is located so close to Chicago but remains peaceful and free of noise or traffic. Josh as a host was so kind and attentive. We could not recommend this place enough!
Nice place, good area

I would give is 100 stars if I could. Very clean, close to the beach, 2 blocks from the train station. Great noodles place close bye..
Go to Flaco Tacos and Ann Sather for breakfast amazing biscuits
Just as described. Beautiful place to stay.
Easy Check in. Parking available right in front of apartment. Walkable to restaurants and grocery
Great location on a quiet street with easy access to public transportation.
Our family enjoyed staying at Abel’s place so much! Lots to do, lovely neighborhood, and comfortable home. We will definitely stay here again! Thank you!
Great place to stay highly recommend! Appreciate the amenities, walkable area with short walk to the red line, and host is friendly and welcoming.
Una ubicación muy céntrica y cerca de la playa , hay transporte público justo en la esquina y muy fácil llegar a cualquier lugar. La casa es muy tranquila

Our stay here was amazing! The Chicago coach house was perfect for our Windy City get away. The artwork is beautiful and the bed was so comfortable. I would recommend this air bnb to anyone. Thank you.

Glenn and Laura were great hosts and their place fit our needs perfectly. We stayed three nights and were very comfortable. We loved the convenient location near the Blue Line. We have relatives in the area and would certainly look at staying here when visiting in the future. Thanks for sharing your place with us!
Pretty well with communication and place looked exactly like the photos. Clean environment as well.

The place was great for the cost. There were small things here and there like any other place would have, but overall it was perfect for our short trip. Had everything we needed and the host was verrryyyy responsive and attentive.

The room matches its description: it is small but functional. It is located in a house that has everything needed for a comfortable stay
The house is less than a 10 minute walk from the train station and is also close to several bus stops, making it convenient to reach the city center Trains run approximately every 15/20 minutes
During my stay(1 week), I noticed ants on the second floor of the house. They did not personally bother me, but some guests may find them inconvenient,especially in the kitchen and bathroom
The neighborhood did not feel particularly reassuring to me and may make feel a little uncomfortable, especially if they are unfamiliar with the area
The host was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay, which I greatly appreciated. Thank you

The place more than met our needs. We stayed for two nights. Parking was very easy. Having a washing machine to use was a huge plus, as we had been traveling. The place was also very clean. Quite possibly one of the cleanest spaces I have stayed in. Would definitely stay here again if in the area. This is what Airbnb should be.
The place looked as advertised, but had not been cleaned properly. The room is also across from a very loud AC vent, which made substantial noise at night.
Our stay was short but we enjoyed the great location and especially the  lovely shady garden in the front of the home.
Localização otima e perfeito anfitrião
The location in Lincoln Park is great.  The condo is pleasant and comfortable and provided all that we needed for our stay.

This apartment was in a great location, with very convenient parking, very clean, comfortable, and with wonderful hospitality with snacks and more waiting for us in the kitchen. Kristie made sure to address any questions we had. We highly recommend to stay here!

Excellent North Chicago location.  Super easy lake(just walk 3-4 blocks) and subway access. Restaurants, coffee shops, and grocery stores all within walking distance. Unit could use a little freshing up though. Smelled a bit musty/moldy. Parking space was definitely a big plus, as on street parking is in short supply. Had one night in our week stay when someone took our reserved parking spot, but, that's par for the course in a big city. Overall roomy and had just about everything we needed. Our host was always available and super nice.
Good safe spot with parking. Easy to get around. Could use darker window coverings but other than that great spot for our first time in Chicago.

This unit felt like home walking in the first time! It was clean, peacefully decorated, and spacious. It was near everything we needed, and lots more that we weren't able to do in the time and task list we had. Next time, Cubbies game! I would stay here again--it is reasonably priced for the size (1250 sq ft!) and location, not to mention the beauty and comfort of it. The host is responsive and friendly, and was open to earlier check in if our schedule had allowed. I highly recommend this location and host!
Had a good stay! Clean place in downtown!
David was awesome! Super friendly and helpful. I loved the spot and enjoyed our conversations.

Tal lo cual describe. Es un alojamiento muy cómodo para 4 personas. Las habitaciones son un poco pequeñas pero se compensa con la comidas de la casa, ubicación a 1 calle del metro y zona muy tranquila. Matt muy buen anfitrión. La casa cuenta con todo lo necesario en cocina. Baño. Juegos de mesa. Sin duda regresaría.

Tuan was a great host his home was clean and comfy … the kitchen was fully equipped with list of tasty seasonings to use while cooking you a home cooked meal….the tvs are smart tv so you are able to watch Netflix amongst other movie apps to enjoy your stay and make it feel like your at home…. The bathroom was amazingly clean…Taun was overall a sweet host…
Plus The rules weren’t strict at all … I will definitely book here again..

The apartment was very clean and in a good location with lots to do and easy to get to things with the train near by. The downside was only two elevators and only one was working. The stairs went out the back and had no access to the lobby so if you forgot something it could take 20 mins to get to the 2nd floor and back. The AC in the unit went out and  let the host know and they just said sorry. It was very hot and all they dis was say sorry and bring a small fan. We had 3 bedrooms so it wasnt much help. I would look elsewhere because if you have a problem nothing will be done except a sorry.

I just spent 5 days in Chicago and really enjoyed my stay at the Sloth Apartment (once you get there, this will make perfect sense!).
The hosts were super communicative, both proactively and reactively. Very friendly and even got to do a stop and chat with one of them in the building hallway. Super nice guy!
The apartment itself is one of the cleanest and most nicely decorated AirBnB's I have stayed in. A lot of nice decorating touches. Very comfy bed and pillows.
I usually stay a little closer to Wrigley Field, but for the price, this was a great option. I will definitely stay here again!

I loved staying in this apartment!  The team behind it is great.    The check-in instructions were incredibly clear and easy to follow.  There are so many thoughtful touches to make your stay easier and they make great use of a historic layout.  It's in a great location between Wrigley (Baseball! Night life!) and Southport (Shopping! Fun restaurants!).  It's got easy access to both the Red Line and the Brown Line trains, so if you want to avoid Wrigley foot traffic, you can head to the Southport Brown Line stop.  It's clear the team behind this AirBNB puts a lot of effort into their properties.  There was even a fun guidebook that was ACTUALLY worth reading!  I would stay at this location again, or another one of their spots, without hesitation.

Such a wonderful place for my work cation!
Had a great time with an amazing rooftop, and tons of places that I could walk to in the evenings. 10 / 10 - would highly recommend this unique place
Fantastic place. Amazing location in Chicago and has everything you need to have a great time. Highly recommend!

It was right beside the L, 2 stops from Wrigley, perfect spot. The noise from the bar honestly never bothered us, I could hear some mild conversation one night, but nothing that would steer me from staying here again! The donuts right next door are an added bonus

As expected; not a luxury hotel experience but perfect for the price to explore Chicago for a few days without a car. The shower was a bit hard to figure out, but that's my biggest issue, so all in all, a good experience.
Had a great stay , everything was as described ❤️

It was a fine stay. Wish there had been more in the kitchen for cooking with and the furniture could use an upgrade.
Luckily we did not need to use the pullout sofa, I don’t know that I would actually count that as a bed. The mattress on it was maybe 3” thick and the fold-out supports were so squeaky; not a good nights sleep by any means on that thing.

Came to town for a couple Cubs games and the stay was overall great. The apartment was exactly as advertised and easy to access. While not reflected in the overall rating because I understand things happen, the cleaning personnel didn’t show up until after my 4pm check-in and when settling in noticed towels & washcloths still in the bathroom floor and the bedsheets rumpled from the prior occupant. The hosts were quick to inform of the situation and it all worked out, although slightly inconvenient since I couldn’t access the room for about an hour. The area is peaceful and many great attractions and restaurants are within walking distance, with Wrigley Field being the furthest walk made during the stay at about a 20-30 minute walk. Would absolutely stay here again.

Please mind the part of the listing that says that the host may be in the spaces occasionally—this was something we missed when booking, and although the host was very friendly and incredibly helpful, this might make some uncomfortable. That said, the location of the rental is absolutely fantastic and cannot be beat for those wanting to take the train around the area. The room we stayed in was very clean, and common areas were quite clean as well. Host was super quick to respond when we had an issue with the gate being locked.
Great location. Patricia was helpful and very responsive.   Apartment clean and quiet.
Everything was great. Perfect for access to Lincoln Park and a Cubs game!

Overall great place to stay! Apt was clean, beds were comfy, no outside noise. Great location, walkable to Wrigley Field which is where we spent most of our time. Only downside was parking. I asked Vin in a private message a few days after booking if we’d have a spot to park 1 car. He basically said that would be doable (not telling us there would be fees). There was no parking on the street outside unless you had a permit & the closest lot was 2.5 blocks away & ended up costing $138 for not even 48 hours. Just keep parking fees in mind when booking!

Phenomenal location, quiet, walkable to many local restaurants and of course the park. Nice large space. No criticisms other than parking can be tricky to find.
Would definitely stay again.

We had such an amazing stay ! There was a little mishap the day of check in, check in got delayed to their cleaning lady having to cancel on them for a personal emergency ( not their fault at all) , the host was very responsive keeping us informed on the situation and finding a cleaning service to come get the apartment ready for us instead of canceling! Check in was from 3-5 and we got checked in around 5:45. She also allowed us to check out an hour later which was very considerate. Once we did get in the unit it was absolutely beautiful so spacious and looked exactly like the photos ! The shower was so nice and clean great water pressure and heat , although there is no fan so def gets steamy in there ! The beds were comfy and the office space was a nice touch and fully stocked ! We appreciated the Xbox and Alexa, also all the board games in the coffee table were so cute ! Quick 15 min drive into the city ! Can’t say enough good about this stay ! Will definitely be back ! Thanks again

Staying at Toby’s house felt more like borrowing a friend’s home for a few days than a typical AirBnB property. It was clean, quiet, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. It was extra nice to have a garage spot. A few thoughts with my own personal preferences - the beds were not the coziest (i.e. only a throw pillow on one of the twin beds at arrival and thinner quilts), the living room layout is a bit awkward with the couch blocking some of the back door, and a bedroom window without a curtain at the back. We appreciated this solid home base!
Great

Rida was extremely helpful and responsive to any of our needs.  Her response was very quick whenever I sent her a message before we left for our trip.  She communicated very well and we felt as if she wanted our stay to be perfect, which it was.  I would definitely stay here again while in the area.  Thank you for being such a great host!
John, Terry, and their dog Kaylee (I might be spelling her name wrong) let me stay at their place and made me feel right at home.

Nicholas was a great host. He answered every and all questions quickly. He even helped us with parking and saved us money using the app he recommended. The bed was comfortable and there was a get ready station away from the bathroom which I loved!!
Beautiful place right in the middle of downtown, walkable to great restaurants and sightseeing.
Very easy check in and check out.  I appreciated that there weren’t a million chores that needed to be done before we left.  Great location, street parking was easy, plenty of spots.

With the exception of heavy footed upstairs neighbors, our stay was perfect. Super convenient location, with easy access to public transportation, wonderful restaurants, and shopping right outside the door.

My family and I enjoyed our stay here. The place was very clean and tidy. The host provided lots of everyday necessities and there were lots of games my daughter and brother enjoyed playing.The bathroom was so nice. The bathroom lighting was amazing and my sister loved doing makeup there. The beds were very comfortable and we had nice sleep. There was so much space to sleep. The place was very close to all the main tourist attractions. We highly recommend this place.
Really enjoyed the stay and was a very easy walk to Wrigley. Plenty of bars, coffee shops and restaurants nearby as well.
Fantastic location for a large group looking for a room for a few days in Chicago
Extremely satisfied with my stay. House was nice and clean, host was nice and responsive.
Perfect location for those visiting or dropping their children off at Loyola.

Great value but be warned that the train noise is quite substantial. Tim provides earplugs and I got used to it after the first night but it's definitely something to consider if you're sensitive to noise. Otherwise, I would definitely consider booking here again. The shared spaces including the bathroom were always clean and well maintained, and the bedroom was also very clean and cozy. The proximity to the train and a diverse range of eateries and coffee shops also helps outweigh the train noise. I also happened to bump into Tim at his coffee shop (shoutout Pedestrian Coffee!) and he was a super warm person; excellent communication throughout as well. Altogether, even factoring in the noise, I had a great stay and would recommend staying with Tim.
Beautiful area felt like a fairy tale. We took a walk at night and seen several bunnies hopping around. The location was near most things. Great host, and very clean AirBnB.
Great location with a responsive host.

We stayed at Alma's place when we had a trade show in the Mart. In summer that is ok since it is walkable but in winter one would definitely need a taxi. The place is nice and clean. We enjoyed our stay there.
We had a great stay!

Nice place with good communication from the host. Easy to walk to a bunch of different restaurants. We liked the ice cream place around the corner and went to Giordanos pizza one night. We walked to the cubs games too.

Our family attended a couple of baseball games while we were there and this location was perfect! The traffic in Chicago is crazy so it was nice to be able to have things in walking distance! We would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed staying at this place! We felt right at home. The place was clean, and had everything we needed. We should note that this is a half-below-ground unit so the ventilation is no so good, but there are ceiling fans.  We did not mind so much. Patricia and Charlie are excellent hosts, super-responsive and very helpful. When we had a problem Patricia and Charlie immediately took care of it.  Wicker Park is a nice upbeat neighborhood and connection to the neighborhoods I excellent via 72, 56  buses and blue line.  Highly recommended.

Very nice suite, clean and bright. Lots of natural light. Excellent location across from bus stop that goes straight to the Loop. Darsh was friendly and sounded quickly to our needs. We would definitely stay here again.

Derek was a great host, friendly and helpful with lots of great recommendations. Location was quiet and plenty of parking was available. Anytime I had a question he responded quickly, next time I’m in the area will definitely book again.
Wohnung ist wie beschrieben, wir haben uns sehr wohl und sicher gefühlt.

This is my second time staying at this home and I would love to say that it’s absolutely perfect. Everything smelled freshly washed, perfect distance from Chicago, and the host is extremely nice and welcoming. Can’t wait to come back again in a few years!

Enjoyable accommodations! Apartment was as described most important was safety of location and cleanliness. Found the beds to be comfortable and HVAC worked flawlessly. Accommodations were pricey however it was lollapalooza weekend and all accommodations were pricey.
Attended four Cubs games, utilizing CTA buses #49 and #152 to Wrigley, 20-25 mins.
Overall a great weekend and I would recommend this unit to other travelers.

Joseph’s place was just as described. Joseph proactively communicated ahead of my trip to make it a seamless check-in experience. Kitchen, bathrooms,  bedrooms were all great. The surrounding neighborhood had tons of great food.
Jennifer was a wonderful host and extremely responsive to all questions. This was a great stay and worth the money.
Fast response times, clean apartment, great deal!
Great place to stay and an excellent communicative host!

We felt right at home here. This was our first Airbnb and it was definitely totally worth it! The place was spotless and so welcoming! Fredrick was a great host and so attentive and fast on being responsive! I would definitely stay here again! Thank you for the great experience.

Our stay had both wonderful highlights and a few frustrating inconveniences.
The apartment itself was beautiful, very clean, and had one of the most spectacular views of the city we’ve ever experienced. The amenities were great, and the view alone made the stay memorable.
Unfortunately, when we arrived, the bathroom sink wasn’t working. We had to send several reminders before it was addressed, and it wasn’t repaired until the following day. We also weren’t informed that our floor was undergoing construction. There was loud drilling from the morning until late afternoon, which made it difficult to relax or enjoy spending time in the unit during the day.
Despite those issues, the property itself is lovely. If the maintenance concerns had been addressed before our arrival and we had been notified about the construction, this would have easily been a five-star stay.
Great location. Lots of indoor space. Responsive host.

We had a great stay! Our host (Ping) was available and extremely responsive throughout and very accommodating, especially when we requested an early check-in, which we really appreciated. The place was exactly as advertised - clean, comfortable, and we felt safe during our stay.
The only thing to note is that the street gets rather quiet later at night (past 9.30pm), which may feel a little isolated, but we still felt relatively safe overall. Everything else was smooth and as expected. The sounds of the trains passing actually felt like white noise to us and didn't really bother us at all. Would happily recommend to anyone considering a brief stay!

Wonderful stay here! Walkable and transportation is right in front of the building. I understand want people said about a smell but I never smelt it in the apartment and it never lingered on me. Overall a great experience and Iris was an amazing host!

It was restful and relaxing. The king bed was comfortable. The appliances were all standard sized not mini. There were spices , coffees, teas, and everything we needed. The off street parking place was a rare find inside the city limits.

The house is truly stunning and looks exactly like the pictures. We loved all the beautiful details and really enjoyed our stay.
We did have a few issues. We arrived about 1.5 hours after the 4 PM check-in time, but the house was still being cleaned. The cleaners apologized and simply asked us to wait until they finished, which was a little frustrating. Because of this, some areas were not as clean as expected. We also noticed a few maintenance issues, including some lights and outlets not working, and only one side of the oven working.
On the positive side, communication was excellent. They always responded quickly and were proactive whenever we reached out. Overall, despite these issues, we really enjoyed our stay and felt the house was worth it.
Had a great time.  Wonderful get away, Cubs, Magnificent Mile, and great restaurants.   The location and vibe were spot on.

Had a great stay at Ewa’s! She is super personable and warm, I felt right at home.
The room and bathroom were both stunning and spotless! Would stay again!

I especially enjoyed the books about the history of the Pullman area, they were such a thoughtful touch. Overall, they were great hosts: very communicative, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. I would definitely stay here again!
Good location close to public transport, safe area and apartment was cute and well kept!

We loved the place. A lot of great places around to walk to.  Host was very responsive and kind!  Highly recommend!
Kohen’s place was perfect for our couple of days in Chicago! Very clean and comfortable space, with close access to public transportation!
The apartment is super comfortable and also the treatment of the host!!
We couldn’t beat the price for our short trip to Chicago. Your place was truly spotless and had everything we needed, thanks!

I've stayed in a few of this teams apartments and man do they know how to.up their game! Probably third best one yet, thanks for letting me enjoy this amazing haven you created Dave and team!

Lovely apartment in a beautiful area with great restaurants.

Would stay here again.

The space was great, central, perfect to get to meetings nearby. Clean, organized.
Amazing place and the location was perfect. Area was beautiful and the place was comfortable, clean, and convenient. We will definitely stay again!!

Great place and location. Just my sister and I traveled together and we felt very safe in the neighborhood , even at night. The parking spot behind the house was perfect since I drove into town. We had a great stay at Ewa’s apartment! It was clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location. Communication was easy, check-in was seamless, and Ewa was a wonderful host. Ryan was a great host and extremely communicative, accommodating, and made our stay in Chicago a great one. Thanks so much!

If you seek for great value/price accomodation in Chicago, this one is definitely for you. Great stay! Great host!
Jodee was great—very responsive and kind.  The apartment was wonderful and in a great location, very walkable and close to lots of restaurants and shopping.  Would definitely stay there again.

Great spot close to Wrigley. Small, as pictured and described, but perfect for our short stay watching a couple of cubs games. Easy check in and out. Had earplugs but noise from train was not bad at all. Good food, cafes and bars nearby.

Being mostly unfamiliar with Chicago, I was just hoping that the location of this apartment was reasonably convenient for a three-day trip with my 8-year-old son. We were just a few yards from an L station (brown line)—not even a five-minute walk. It's true that you can hear the train at all hours of the day and night, but I loved the ambiance of it. The Lakeview neighborhood is dreamy and instantly gave me a real-estate crush. The apartment is clean, comfortable, charming, and has great natural light. It is older, the bathroom needs an update, and it seemed odd to offer just two towels; but those are very minor gripes given this place's many advantages. Brad was a warm, responsive host, and I'd book this place again in a heartbeat.

Spent a couple nights with my son for a short Chicago trip. The main draw to this Airbnb is its location by wrigley field, as we were planning on seeing a baseball game. Would definitely come back in the future.
Host was a great communicator, extremely responsive. We also enjoyed the convenient location as we’re grateful for the comfortable beds!

Easy and good access. Was in town with my adult children for a cubs game and to enjoy the city.

Me and two girlfriends stayed for lollapalooza weekend and a couple extra days to enjoy Chicago. We loved this Airbnb, it was in a quiet walkable part of the city, there was a Starbucks, Jimmy John’s, and pizza place all within walking distance. The Airbnb was very clean and I was able to cook. They even left water bottles in the fridge. That was really nice.
Very inviting and cozy place. Incredibly spacious and was a very nice area with a lot of walkable fun locations

We had a good stay at Mark's place! Admittedly we would not have chosen a stay with bunk beds (as a married couple) if we hadn't delayed booking too long, but regardless the airbnb suited our needs well and has a great location. Check in is at 4pm and we had a hard time finding a place to store our luggage for the first 4-5 hours of our trip, but that is clearly stated in the listing – just more of a heads up, especially if you pack heavy!
I would say it is not well suited for longer-term stays where you might want to cook, but we didn't need that this time around. We partook in all the great food Chicago has to offer!
All-in-all, I would recommend this airbnb.

Absolutely loved this place. From the house itself, it was so clean and neat and new. So spacious. So quiet. Felt at home while also felt luxurious! The location was amazing. Could walk to so many places. And felt safe. Would definitely stay here again if we come back to Chicago. And the friendliness and communication from the host was top notch. Thank you!
Clean, cozy, quiet, available parking! Good find

Bianca was a great host! Very responsive and flexible to our travel plans and needs. Would absolutely stay again. The location is a short walk to lots of great restaurants and the train to get to the city, it was surprisingly quiet, and very clean.
Great stay
loved the place, host was very nice, super easy check in would stay again!
It was a great stay - in center of Boystown and easily walkable to coffee shops, bars, solidcore, etc. Checkin instructions were easy and the room and bathroom were clean.

Amazing stay! Very clean space, and I enjoyed that it was a private guesthouse with no shared spaces! Jeff was very helpful and communicative. Overall, would recommend staying here and would love to stay here again myself in the future! :)
Nice place, easy to find and move around the city. Quiet neighborhood, felt safe! Very responsive host!

Great spot. Within walking distance to the train station and amazing diners and coffee shops  Close to Wrigley Field. The only issue was the laundry unit wasn't IN the actual unit we stayed in and you have to load a 10 dollar app to do it in the shared laundry room but that wasn't the host's fault. Just saying though in case anyone needs to do laundry when staying. The host was accommodating and ensured I was able to check in early when I needed it.  The fridge was stocked with waters. There were plenty of tvs and places to sleep. The shower had plenty of super hot water. There was coffee and snacks.

Stacey was responsive from booking all the way through to our check out.  The place was such a perfect space for our family and in a convenient as well as safe neighborhood.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  It was easy to get to downtown and perfect to get to Wrigley to watch a couple games.  Made our trip so memorable.  Don’t hesitate if the place is available for the time you’re there (as it is seemingly very popular and booked).  All very worth it in every way.

Everything was great. The place was clean and comfortable. It was about a minute from Wrigley Field was a major plus. The balcony was great and we got to see the players going to their cars after the game. It was our second time there and there will be a third.
Great stay!

This room in a shared home was exactly what I needed for a place to crash before an early flight out of O'Hare. Directions were straightforward and helpful, signage in house was great to find where the bedroom was, and the room itself was spacious and clean. Thank you!

Loved my stay here!! The area is so safe and walking distance to so many good restaurants, coffee shops and bars. Quick uber downtown as well! Nicholas was very responsive and accommodating. I would definitely go back next time I visit Chicago.

Really enjoyed our stay! Very nice, walkable to so many things. Apartment was very clean with fluffy towels :)
Beds were comfortable and plenty of space for our crew.

Nice place to stay.  If you are going to the museums or Navy Pier, it is easy to get there.  We did not have any issues on the stay.  If you are going to be out in the city most of the time, it is definitely perfect for that.  I met the host when we were leaving.  He was very friendly and recommended some places to eat before we left.
Responsive and accommodating host! Would 100% stay here again. Thanks for having us!
It was just as described! Place was clean and no concerns :)
This place was a great stay. It was clean and as described in description! Would stay again:)
This place is very nice, clean, and close to the city. I had a great stay and would recommend it!
Good location and home is well maintained.  Easy commute to places we planned to visit.  Parking was a challenge.

It’s our first time in Chicago to attend Lollapalooza and we had an overall great stay!
Everything you need to know is clearly written in the listing, so make sure to read it carefully to set your expectations. It’s a shared space, but Christina maintains it very well. She was very friendly and readily offered any help or information we needed.
The area felt safe, and if you’re commuting, there’s no problem taking the bus or train during the day. Since the area can get quite dark at night, taking an Uber is recommended.
The bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, and laundry area are well-equipped and have everything you’ll need.
It would have been even better if there were a locker or storage area where we could leave our things when arriving early or leaving late. However, Christina explained this beforehand and informed us that there are luggage storages in Downtown Chicago via Bounce.
Other than that, all the details in the listing were accurate and clearly communicated.
The place was clean and as described. Host was very accommodating and made sure we felt at home!

An absolutely amazing stay, Judy is a wonderful host and the home is lovely. The location is close to a lot of tourism attractions and always tons to do in the city.
Very cleanly, all amenities provided, and so homey and inviting. Definitely beats a hotel stay with that alone, but the price throws it out of the park. It’s great to give back to local communities when you can, so I highly recommend with that in mind!
We booked the Queen for Lollapalooza and it was so easy to walk to the bus stops or take an uber to get and fro, while also taking advantage of all the city has to offer in the meantime.
Great place, easy to get downtown and catch buses. Super clean and very quiet. Would 100% recommend.

This place was perfect for our visit to Chicago. It was very close to the train station which was fantastic, and there’s a couple restaurants and stores located walking distance which was wonderful. The place is perfect, everything was clean and very spacious! Jose was very responsive and let us check in early which was very helpful. The only downside is the upstairs neighbors can be a little loud later into the night, however, we didn’t mind at all and understood that it is a three story apartment and this can happen occasionally. Overall, I would highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a place in Chicago!!!
Mark was very responsive and accommodating. The location was perfect for what we needed and would absolutely stay here again when we come into town for another Cubs game
Came to town from California. Lovely place, Karen was a great host. Great walk to Wrigley Field ubered to tourist locations.
Host was very responsive to questions.  Extremely clean and walking distance to great restaurants and United Center.

Excellent location. The apartment is pretty good and works well. The building is disappointing though. One elevator for the whole building adds a lot of waiting time to your day. Rooftop closed (not disclosed at time of booking) was disappointing in the summer and not priced in. I think you can do better for the price in the area

The is one of our best Airnbnb stays ever. The apartment has a lot of details that other bnbs miss - plenty of coffee, sugar & cream, washer/dryer & laundry soap, fans in every room, and actually nice shampoo & conditioner. The location is amazing - it's an easy walk to the blue line and restaurants. The elevated walking trail is so nice and is right down the street. It was a perfect stay for my older teenagers since there was so much to do. And, Mario was so helpful - he answered all of my questions quickly. Perfect stay!!

Really great location - walkable to so many restaurants and coffee shops! Cute balcony off the living room and great size bedrooms. Only issue was the ‘reserved’ parking spot was taken when we arrived - host was responsive and helped with an alternative option outside for the first day/night but hopefully that was a one-off and not a usual occurrence
Absolutely loved our stay and location, train was close by,  wrigley field with walking distance. Felt right at home.

This was my second time staying with Evelyn and definitely not the last! She was so helpful with anything I needed and made me feel right at home again. Her place was perfectly located nearby surrounding restaurants, the beach, and the metra! Her space was also very neat and clean with plenty of privacy was given. I would recommend this Airbnb to anyone nervous about staying with a “stranger” because she will make you feel welcomed right away and greet you with open arms.

Great location for visiting Wrigley! It was a pleasant walk to the park and the neighborhood is nice.
The parking was tight at the building so I wouldn’t recommend bringing a larger vehicle unless you’re fabulous at parallel parking. This unit is also up a few floors from where you park so if stairs aren’t your thing, this might not be for you. We had 6 people in our party and it slept everyone just fine, although a few of my relatives said the beds were a little uncomfortable. Specifically the pull out couch, they said they could feel the bars through the mattress.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay. There were some small hiccups along the way but it’s a perfect location, very cute inside and the hosts were very nice and communicative.
Loved staying at Katie’s! There’s plenty of free parking on the street, room in the house, and gorgeous surroundings. I have no complaints!!

Rob was a great host and he was very responsive to any requests or questions we had! The place was exactly as described and perfect for any short stays. The location was beautiful as it was a block away from the Red line and a couple blocks from a beautiful Edgewater park/beach. It was great value compared to any other hotels and listings out there.
Awesome place and location! Friendly and helpful, easy instructions for check in and check out. Thank you for a great stay!

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I felt like I was living in an episode of Friends. Check-in was easy, communication was excellent, and everything we needed was provided. Lots to do nearby, easy access to downtown, walking distance to Wrigley. We’d happily stay here again and would recommend it to others.

Unfortunately, our experience was disappointing. The property was not in the condition we expected. Several interior doors were broken or damaged, some of the kitchen chairs were broken and didn’t feel safe to use, and the TVs were poorly mounted/placed, making them difficult to use comfortably. Overall, the home appeared to have maintenance issues that should have been addressed before guests arrived.
While we were able to complete our stay, I believe future guests should be aware of these issues. I hope the host takes the time to repair and properly maintain the property so future visitors have a better experience.
We had a great time!

Great place, I am originally from Chicago and was suprised to see everything about the neighborhood change after 7 years. Great location for Chicago bars, near the Metra on Western, and near a bus to get to downtown. I worked remote and had a great stay. Internet had some slowdowns in the beginning, but Matthew responded fast. Thanks for having lots of stuff available for my 1 month stay 👍🏽
The in-and-out car privileges is why I chose this place and it was fantastic! The rooftop is gorgeous!
Thanks for hosting us! We loved the location. It was a really comfortable stay for our family of 4.
I’m stayed for how convenient the walk around to the union center. Very nice and clean.

We stayed for a work trip and we had a great stay! It's close to downtown, great airport access, and very cozy neighborhood with really good Italian restaurant, bakery, and great deli options nearby. Would recommend as a hub for Chicago on vacation or work.

We loved staying at Mike’s place! The neighborhood was quiet and we felt very safe, we walked a short distance to the train every day with no problems at all. The apartment was spacious with more than enough room for our family of 5. Thank you!!
Wonderful stay here! Location was great and place was exactly as described! Thank you!
Attentive hosts, lovely listing as specified. Happy to recommend

We enjoyed our first time in Chicago and had a nice stay here at Claire and Jonas' place. It's a good location near bus stops and great food spots. It was easy to check-in, check out and they were always in great communication with us. They were also so sweet to give us so many great local recommendations. The AC and nice bed/bedding helped us rested well in the summer heat. Thanks for everything!

location is in Cicero which seems unusual but the pink line runs 1 minute away from the room and I loved how easy it was to get access quickly to downtown chicago! OVERALL I would def stay here again! The house was extremely clean and comfortable!!!! 100/10

We had a group of 7 people and this place didn’t disappoint. The host was very kind and responds very quickly to any questions you might have - and clearly lists directions and check-in/check-out instructions. The location is great for visitors looking for a local bite with great restaurants, walkable locations, and a convenient grocery store nearby. Driving distance to the main parts of the city are no more than 10-20 minutes away. Parking was very easy (our group brought 2 cars); there’s a garage where one car can park and safe street parking with no additional charge for all other cars with a parking pass. Would definitely stay here again!
We had a great stay
As described and convenient for walking to local events. Good responsiveness from hosts!

We had a great stay at Lou's place. The location worked well for us, as it was easy to get to downtown Chicago. The apartment was spacious, clean, and exactly as shown in the photos and description.
The kitchen was very well equipped, and we were able to cook dinner comfortably during our stay. The place was also quiet, which made it easy to get a good night's sleep after a day of exploring the city.
Overall, everything met our expectations, and we would gladly stay here again.

Our family just made our first trip to Chicago and loved staying here!!
We felt very welcome and had plenty of space. Hosts communicated clearly and responded quickly to questions. They provided all the regular toiletry needs that a hotel would but added lots of thoughtful considerations that made us feel like we were being hosted by good friends: fantastic coffee options, drinks, snacks, etc. 10 out of 10 🤩

We had a fantastic stay at Alma's place! The location was ideal, standard check-in was seamless, and the property was spotlessly clean and accurately described. Alma was extremely responsive and gave great local recommendations. We would definitely stay here again!
Great stay enough space for 7 of us!

This apartment was the perfect location for us. It is right by several CTA lines, making it easy to get just about anywhere.
It was exactly as the description and pictures described. I'd definitely book here again on our next trip.
Cute apartment in an adorable neighborhood! The host was friendly and responsive and let us check in early when we arrived earlier than expected. I would definitely book this bnb again
It was great

Just checked out after a wonderful stay at the Velvet Manor!  The location was perfect…so close to great food and walking distance to the lake.  The design of the property inside was such a luxurious / stylish vibe….very memorable and a great use of space!  AC worked well which was nice since it was hot and humid.  Everything seemed new and in great condition.  Wouldn’t mind staying here again if I needed to stay up in this area again!  Thanks !

Everything about this place was great except for the street noise. It's next to an active fire station and a busy intersection frequented by dirt bikes and motorcycles at all hours of the night. Other than that, it was great. The host was clear, helpful, and friendly, and the unit was very clean. It is located right next to the Red Line Train, too.

Nice place. Free street (parallel) parking and easy to get in.
Downstairs neighbors are very polite, only heard them once during our 3 night stay. Sofa bed was surprisingly comfortable. Neighborhood felt safe. There are some motorcycles and/or sports cars that drove by at night but that didn’t bother us.

Alloggio situato in una zona residenziale tranquilla e silenziosa a qualunque ora del giorno e della notte. Con una sola linea metropolitana si può raggiungere facilmente sia l'aeroporto sia il centro città. L'alloggio è pulito e dotato di tutti i comfort descritti e l'host è gentile e sempre disponibile. Tuttavia l'alloggio si trova al secondo piano e la scala in legno avrebbe bisogno di una ristrutturazione.

Nicole was an awesome host and super responsive! We appreciate the last minute booking and enjoyed the home very much! The neighbourhood was very cute and quiet but still close to lots of restaurants and shops. We especially enjoyed the quiet mornings on the front balcony! Would stay here again!

Victoria was a great host! She was very helpful and friendly. She even let us use her ponchos and umbrella because she knew we were going to be out in the rain. We had no issues during our stay. She was aware that we would be attending a festival and was not mean or rude or upset about our coming and going hours. She was so helpful and very sweet!

This listing, was just as described. This location is prime for walking to get morning coffee and having dinner. Not too far from the city but just enough for a quiet morning. Would definitely recommend to any friends visiting.

I did a long term rental here while I was in Chicago for work over the summer. Doug was friendly, responsive, and very easy to communicate with!  The location was also great for commuting to/from work — it is a quick walk to the train (Brown/Purple lines) and there are lots of buses in the area. I would absolutely recommend this rental to others.
Rob’s apartment was super clean, modern, and in a great area! Would love to stay again!
This was a great place!  Very Clean, great location, and the owner was super responsive! Amazing stay

C'etait parfait, appartement super ! Tous le monde etait content. Le seul point negatif est l'isolation : on peut entendre les voisins facilement mais c'est un point dérisoir comparer à la qualité du logement. Top ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Our stay was amazing ! Exactly how described ! Shaun was very helpful and responsive with any questions, definitely felt right at home , great kitcken, bathroom , living room situation and bedroom! The location was about 30 min from the main city with traffic so very worth it! The location felt very homey with a nice park across the street, and a really good coffee shop right next door!

We had a fabulous stay at the Hygge Hideaway when in town for a family reunion.
We lived in this neighborhood about 15 years ago and this was a wonderful place to stay. Location was great - just a short walk to the center of Lincoln Square and very convenient to transportation (busses & the L). The grocery store literally across the street and the coffee shop/bakery a few doors away could not be more convenient.
But even more than the location, this home was beautifully decorated and well-stocked. You can tell that the hosts have paid a lot of attention to making this space warm and welcoming, plus ensuring you have everything you need for your stay. The kitchen has everything needed to make a meal, all very well organized and labeled. There were plenty of towels, extra bedding and supplies as well. We were especially grateful for the dual coffee makers, washer/dryer and air conditioning on a warm weekend. We will absolutely stay here again!

Crisp clean. A beautiful 2 story flat. A lot of place. And beautiful interior.
Highly recommended.
Great location and a great unit. Would stay here again

I had a great stay. Neighborhood is super quiet, and peaceful. Easy route to public transportation. Close to city. The host was super informative. Not a 5 star hotel, but worth what you pay for. Would stay again!

Fantastic location with lots to do and a very short walk to the train station. It was perfect for our group of 8. The staff was really nice and let us drop our luggage off before check-in. Would definitely recommend!

A great place to stay in Chinatown! Had lots of easy access to public transit (with only a little bit of walking involved), and super close to the Chinatown square with tons to do and great food.
There was both a fan and a space heater provided, as well as lots of clean towels and extra shower toiletries. The kitchen and little living space w/ a couch was a nice area to hang out too, as well as the backyard/patio! The wifi was a little finicky at times and service can be spotty in this area depending on your provider (I had no service, but my partner did!). Something to note if you’re needing to use wifi a lot, but otherwise was no problem for us!
Overall a lovely place to stay with very responsive and friendly hosts! Would definitely recommend if you’re wanting to stay close to Chinatown.

Location was good, in Chinatown and the area was charming. The room itself was clean, but the main bathroom could use some work and renovating. Despite this, I felt comfortable showering with shower shoes and using the toilet. There is also another toilet in the unit that was clean. Biggest feedback I'd give is the response time of the owner, especially in cases where someone might get locked out of their room. Regardless, always take your phone with you when you exit the room just in case.
Very quick and easy walk to the United Center! Would recommend for anyone coming into the city for an event at the arena.

I can’t praise brittany enough. She made our first airbnb experience incredibly simple and comfortable. She’s the friendliest and most understanding person, she always responded promptly to any concern we had, we really felt at home staying here.
The apartment was clean and cozy, it even came with a cute personalized sign which made me so happy!
The neighborhood was quiet and private, I’d definitely book with Brittany again!
The hosts were responsive and had helpful instructions.

Stayed here for Lollapalooza and it was absolutely perfect! Countless food/coffee options within walking distance, a park across the street to decompress, a convenience store at the corner for any last minute needs, you name it. The area was quiet and peaceful, and very conveniently located to the pink line. Less than a 15 minute walk to the station. Would recommend and would absolutely stay again!

The stay for Lollapalooza was good, a good location in the sense of walking back after the festival and staying close to the river. But the hotel itself was not great. We had mold in our comforters which grossed us out for the rest of the trip. This place does not have housekeeping, and while the response rate was fast for items, the delivery was slow and sometimes incorrect. It was not worth what we paid at all.

Frank’s home was very nice! The outdoor area was very beautiful with a lot of greenery and pretty lights at night. It was also a very close walk to the Blue line, very convenient location and safe. We noticed that the door to the bathroom did not fully close, so we used a can to keep it shut! The door to the space also does not lock from the outside. Overall, we enjoyed the place and felt safe the entire time! We were very appreciative of the amenities and facilities that Frank offered!

The location was great! Very walkable and in a pretty area and the place itself was nice enough. It did feel a bit like a property designed specifically to be an Airbnb, from how it was furnished/stocked to the host interactions, but not a huge deal. The main downsides were that the water pressure was quite poor, and both the shower and sink drained poorly, which just made the stay less comfortable.

I brought my husband to Chicago for his 27th surprise birthday trip. My goal was to be far enough outside of downtown for a peaceful stay, yet close enough for the commute to activities to be decent. Our host was very responsive and extremely clear with arrival and departure instructions. This was a great stay!
Nice safe place, walkable to subway!
Great distance from Wrigley.  Made getting back easy with a short walk!
Very quick to respond and accommodating!

We had a wonderful stay at Betsy’s place. It was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. There was plenty of street parking directly in front of the property, so we parked our car there and walked to Berwyn station, which was within easy walking distance. From there, it was very convenient to take the subway and get around the city. Betsy was kind, welcoming, and easy to communicate with. We really enjoyed our stay and would gladly recommend her place to others.

Lovely little place, only critique is it is not tall people friendly. Had to duck down to shower and to look at myself in the mirror. I’m only 5’11 so if you’re even taller than me you’ll be touching the ceiling.
We had a great stay at Alex’s! Loved the place and the proximity to all the restaurants nearby.

Nice and simple unit, layout was homey and easy to settle into. Water pressure was a bit weak with a handheld showerhead, other than that the bathroom was fine. Living room and kitchen were clean and stocked with essentials. You will have to buy your own water as there isn't a Brita or any filtered water, so plan ahead for that. Bedrooms were really comfortable and gave you plenty of space to relax. We didn't hear any neighbors or eachother through the walls unless you were out in the hallway. Some of the doors are misaligned and let out air/sound, but it didn't really pose any major issues. The area is beautiful with a nice park nearby, Trader Joe's, Target, local restaurants. I really recommend it if you don't want to be in a buzzing area of Chicago.
Great family home, easy access all around. Great family  back yard to just relax in the evening. Great location for public transportation.
This is a very nice place. The building is secure, and being near the red line was extremely convenient.

I think the place is a good house and has alot of potential due to the location overall. I think we could do better on the communication and also on the bed, the beds weren't super comfy honestly and the price wasn't worth what I was getting. Also when I had issues with the lock I legit had almost zero response from the owner and was like okay if something bad happened we would be screwed. But aside from that I liked the location and I liked the convenience of that.

Pros: Great location with a lively neighbourhood, plenty of stores and restaurants, and well-connected to the train system. Host is responsive.
Cons: The basement smelled damp, the walls had very little insulation, and noise from neighboring guests packing 3-6am made it difficult to sleep (which is no fault of host). The bathroom was poorly maintained, with some towels with stains, moldy shower curtains, dirty bathtub, dust throughout. It could have used a deep cleaning. Check-in is not automated so should schedule arrival to meet with host. Although listed as a hostel, there is not communal spaces for socialisation.
The overall impression is that owner puts very little effort in hosting guests.
Serg was a great host! This was perfect for what we were looking for to be close to United Center. Very spacious, clean, and homey apartment.

Todd & Tripp’s home was a lovely base for us as we hung around in Andersonville and hopped on the red line to get downtown. They were lovely and knew a lot about the area. The location was perfect with a lot of restaurant options and the beach within walking distance.
We had a great time. We were in town for a couple of Cubs games and it was a great location with plenty of space and was walkable to everything. Would highly recommend to anyone else!
Very clean and smelt good! I enjoyed my stay.

the area was so cute and walkable, lots of shops and food spots nearby. the living area and kitchen were clean and welcoming. i enjoyed having a brita in the fridge for water! the room itself was small but still enough space for two people. it's right near a bus stop so we didn't have to walk far before getting on a bus!
It was a quieter neighborhood, easy paths to train stations, and nice cleaning lady
We had a great stay especially since it was right next to Blue Line. Looking forward to the future we would definitely stay again if there location is available. Thanks again
Very awesome bnb. I will book this one again.

We traveled as a family of 5 for Lollapalooza and James’ place accommodated us comfortably. It  is in an awesome Chicago neighborhood. Lots of places to eat, drink and shop that are easy to walk to. The apartment was nice, clean and easy to get to. James was a responsive and proactive host. Would recommend!

enjoyed this place! it was clean, very nice host, and honestly had no issues. the bed was so comfortable too! i slept so well here! would definitely stay again and recommend! it was also a nice bonus that the host offered recommendations to local places!

Great place for our weekend of Cubs games.
The kitchen is amazing! The rest of the house is beautiful. Very walkable to Wrigleyville and Southport. Close to the L. We paid for the private parking and it was very convenient.
Carlos was very responsive. I would 100% stay here again.

Non andate in questo posto a meno che non siate disperati!
Sono arrivato dopo 12 ore di viaggio dall'Italia per soggiornare 3 notti, apro la prima porta ma la seconda non si apre e non ci sono istruzioni per aprirla. Mi apre un altro ospite e riesco ad entrare nella sala comune, ma una volta dentro non ci sono indicazioni per la camera, scrivo e sai cosa mi risponde? Che non ci sono camere disponibili! Dopo settimane dalla prenotazione, ho dovuto trovare altro alloggio! Ho avuto modo di vedere alcuni spazi disgustosi all'interno dell'edificio sporchi e maleodoranti. Uno schifo!
Great place, great value, great location, great host! Only complaint was that the advertised bathtub was not usable
Great & safe location
Hospitable, friendly and great bang for buck. Would definitely choose to room here again.

This space was very open and cozy at the same time. Amazing open kitchen and overall layout. Relatively close to the stadium and not a horrible 30 minute walk back, as I discovered.  Sam was great and communicated well. Definitely would book again.
Would stay here again
Truly such a unique place with a very responsive host. Great place to spend my trip at and comfortably fit all 4 of us. Will definitely be staying here again on trips to Chicago.

Larry says the apartment was "amazingly comfortable."  We truly appreciated Sharon's communication and understanding (about a visiting dog).  I didn't expect a garden apartment so the "basement" feel took a little getting used to.  However the furnishings were beautiful and had lots of nice touches.  And I felt this was a very safe neighborhood.   I wasn't expecting extra $ due to tax (ignorance) so the bill was higher than I expected.  Not the fault of the host.  Thanks, Sharon!
The place was really nice  Andy was very responsive when I asked him for anything and overall had a great stay
Stayed here while being up in the city for a concert. Space was so lovely, and very clean! Neighborhood was real quaint and cute. It was a wonderful stay :)
Great stay! Very kind and responsive host. Clean, free of clutter, and has everything you need .  Definitely recommend.

Saurin's place was truly a gem! I needed to stay somewhere safe, clean, affordable, and within walking distance to the United Center; Saurin's place met all of the criteria. His communication is excellent; he is very responsive and polite. The check in process was easy to follow. I thought it was neat that his place is decorated with souvenirs he purchased from his travels around the world. Saurin's place truly felt comfortable and like home!
Nicholas was very responsive and quick to answer our questions

Olivia was a great host,  she gave me simple directions to the property and advice for the train lines and great recommendations for food. She was very quick to respond and checked in on my every morning. Had a great trip and the lodging helped with the experience.

OMG!!! what can I even say about this stay! Ed and Hillary are the BEST hosts i’ve ever experienced. This home is a hidden gem with such a great atmosphere. Ed and Hillary were extremely receptive to us and incredibly understanding of us. They made sure to personally introduce themself and were so respectful to our space. The home itself was clean organized and provided any essential you needed and more. The beds were incredibly comfortable (7 nights of restful sleep), when i come to chicago again i hope to stay in this home again. Super accessible to public transportation and such a quiet and peaceful area. 10/10 Ed and Hillary deserve their flowers!

Great place to stay! It’s only about three blocks from the train station, making it easy to get around. The city is just a short Uber ride away, and the neighborhood is very quiet. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone.
Wonderful area! We enjoyed walking the neighborhood. It's walkable to many places. Beds are very comfortable.
Beautiful place and location

Amazing location, extremely clean, comfortable, and spacious,

Great location, fantastic host. Uber XL was only around $20 to take us to museums and boat tours. Well worth the money to stay out of the city hotel district. Great host and nice place. Definitely recommend.

Jorge was a great host for our trip to Chicago! He was proactively ensuring we got settled in and was very responsive to any messages. This is an absolutely beautiful apartment in a great location! I wish we had had more time to stay and enjoy!

Firstly, I would like to start off with saying that Mirsada’s home is beautiful, her garden was a delight to walk by when leaving and entering the home. I enjoyed my stay there to the best of my ability but I also have to be honest about my time there for future potential guests and hope there is improvement in the future.
Certain amenities were listed but not provided— body wash, washcloths, luggage drop off. I would double check with Mirsada about her amenities in relation to your specific situation before booking.
Replies were delayed or no reply at all. Especially when we asked for the entry code, which we did not receive until the uber there. Or when we asked for more toilet paper. So we ended up buying some.
Public transit is close but a hassle if venturing until later in the day.
All in all, I enjoyed my stay but there are still points of concern. I would have an elaborate conversation with Mirsada before booking!

Vin’s place was an affordable spot! Vin was extremely responsive and we didn’t have to wait long for him to help us with a few challenges that arose. The process to accessing the key was a tad bit tricky, however, it was nice to know that we were safe as the many doors that led to the apartment closed and locked behind us. During the weekend, the road behind the house was a tad but noisy, but Vin was kind enough to leave behind ear plugs and due to being so tired from long days the noise wasn’t that big of an issue! Finally, due to the place being located where it is, we wouldn’t recommend securing this spot if you’re looking to spend a lot of time downtown or anywhere that’s not near the apartment as the Ubers are pretty pricey. At one point we did experience cold water, but the problem was solved by allowing the water to run a bit before hoping in. I would recommend this place if you’re looking for an affordable spot in Chicago for a short period of time.
Stayed here multiple nights and had a great experience. Feels very safe and peaceful. James was very responsive and flexible to our needs!
