10/10 would recommend and definitely would book with them again.

Consider this review before booking. The unit was clean, well-kept and as pictured, but I would not stay here again. Days prior to our stay the host asked if maintenance could enter during our 2 night trip. As two young women staying alone we explicitly said no and asked that it be rescheduled and were told they would be made aware of that. Our first morning, we woke to 5 maintenance men banging on the door then entering with the code when we didn't answer. They told us they weren't even aware guests were staying there. We contacted the host but no solution was offered. The next morning maintenance was again banging at 9am asking to enter. We also weren't told until 24 hours prior to check-in that there's NO legal parking nearby. Again the host offered no solution so we had to pay to park elsewhere and Uber back and forth. Had we known this before booking, we wouldn't have stayed here. Between the lack of privacy, communication and parking and much more,I cannot recommend this Airbnb.

A mixed bag. The host was kind, helpful, and responsive. They comped me a night due to a family emergency, which was very appreciated.
I had to buy trash bags and toilet paper. There were no kitchen bags (not even one in the trash can) and 2 partial rolls of toilet paper. One roll had clearly been wet—dropped in the toilet??—at some point! The host did offer to reimburse me, but no one was available to unlock the cabinet for toilet paper.
The AC failed early on, which was in issue due to extreme heat. They did have it repaired within 24 hours—but that was an uncomfortable night with little sleep.
Finally, the parking is TIGHT! Getting my SUV in the spot was tricky! I defy you to put 2 cars in there. I parked on the street all week. Then, on the last night, I was able to use the space and got completely blocked in by the other guest. I had to wake him at 2 am to leave. This unit should advertise “one spot, first come, first served” so no one feels entitled to park like that.

The hosts did an amazing job making sure we had everything that we needed. I absolutely loved the space it was very roomy and just beautiful. Me and my girls had a great girls trip experience staying here.

I booked a mini get away from home , I enjoyed my stay . It was convenient, clean and cozy. Kyriako was very professional, helpful and quick with responses. I will book again soon . Thank you for letting me rent your home : )
Great hosts and great house!!!
Un alojamiento precioso y muy bien cuidado. Lea ha sido una anfitriona perfecta, siempre atenta y ayudándonos en lo que necesitáramos. Sin duda, si vuelvo a Chicago, repetiremos!

We were happy with our stay here! It is clean and updated! Communication and directions were clear. The location was great; it is a 20 minute drive to Willis Tower (depending on traffic). There is a gas station nearby and a coffee place down the road. We were able to easily park in front of the building when we stayed Sunday-Tuesday. The beds were spacious and comfortable! (The couch isn't comfortable, but that is very minor.) We would recommend this place to others!

We have stayed at Stuart's place many times and are looking at booking another stay.
There is plenty of beautiful space to enjoy both indoors and out. The kitchen is nicely outfitted with all the basics. The beds are comfortable with storage in the bedrooms.
Several bus lines and the "L" are within walking distance as is Andersonville with shops and restaurants.
Stuart has always responded quickly to any questions I have posed.
I highly recommend a stay at Stuart's.
GREAT spot for our family to explore Chicago! Quiet, tree-lined streets, easy walk to the Lake, restaurants, Target is one block away! We stayed with a family of four, and had more than enough room.

We were a group of four visiting Chicago for two days. We enjoyed staying in Daniel's place. Very nice neighborhood with some historical architecture. People are very friendly and this area is not full of tourists which is a delight.
We had a great time staying here. The location is perfect for a cubs game
I come with my family to visit Chicago city and family and the place is perfect and feels like home have everything needed. I’m recommending that place and for sure I come back
A decent apartment, close to University of Chicago and Washingtom Park
Perfect for Cubs games… walking from the living room to your seat in 12 minutes. Cool Chicago / wrigleyville vibes.
We really enjoyed the unit; it fit our whole family comfortably. We had a fantastic time and I would definitely recommend staying there. I would love to stay there again.

Great apartment in a safe location. Minutes walk from the redline that directly goes downtown and to Wrigley Field. If staying here, make sure you have accurate check in instructions because the ones listed are old and don’t apply. Had to wait more than 30 minutes to finally get accurate instructions.
New location. Very clean. More than I expected which is fantastic. Felt safe and secure when visiting a new city. Near so many restaurants and activities

Brian and Maria were extremely accommodating to us during our stay and very proactive. They offered new towels, laundry, to change the temperature, even their discount card to their local grocery store. Excellent and comfortable stay. Very close to the 3 bus which made getting to downtown Chicago and other neighborhoods easy. We particularly enjoyed the nearby coffee shop.

I loved staying here! The apartment is just as described—clean, with fresh linens and, great appliances. Plus, the neighborhood is easily one of the best in Chicago. If you have the chance to book, do it!
A few helpful notes for future guests:
-The Front Door Lock: Sean gives instructions on the trick to open it, but it still took me a bit to get the hang of. If it helps, try pushing the key down and turning it toward the side you want, rather than pulling it toward you as explained.
-The Bathroom: As another reviewer mentioned, the bathroom could benefit from a deep clean.
-Temperature: The apartment gets quite warm on hot days, but there's a fantastic AC unit in the bedroom that keeps you nice and cool.
Other than that, Sean was an amazing host—super accommodating with kitchen use, great check-in instructions and flexible at checkout. He even let me borrow a few books from his incredible collection! Great stay overall.
Great house and great location

Nice quiet neighborhood. Demitri’s place was great. It is spacious & well equipped with everything we needed.
Demitri’s instructions were excellent. He sent pictures, so we knew exactly what to look for & how to get in.

Demitri was an excellent host! Words cannot describe how responsive and helpful he was throughout my stay. The neighborhood is nice and quiet. The place was comfortable, welcoming, and truly felt like home. I would definitely stay here again!
Great location, thanks for all the help
Great place A++
good host
Will always want to stay here when we visit Chicago! This was such a wonderful stay near so many bus stops and a train station. Anastasia was a wonderful host, thank you so much
We had a great stay! Was about a mile walk to Wrigley and felt safe walking back after a night game. Very clean and had everything we needed. Looking forward to staying again in the future!
Great place with an amazing view. Building has a lot to offer with amenities and is walkable to anything you may need. Will definitely recommend.

The place is in a very quiet residential neighborhood and is well connected, making it easy to get around the city. It’s also close to the shopping areas on Michigan Avenue and other attractions. The apartment looks exactly like the photos. Mera was attentive throughout our stay, making sure everything was going well and answering all of our questions. We didn’t have any issues during our stay, and I felt safe in the surrounding area. I would definitely recommend staying here.
Sarah was a lovely host and helped us when we needed it! Would definitely recommend for a peaceful stay at Chicago :)

We stayed at James’ place while we were in town for Lollapalooza and had a great stay. You can’t beat the location, and even with nearby nightlife, it’s quiet at night. It was a great place to come back and unwind at the end of the night. Would definitely stay here again!

Rob was very communicative and friendly, but I have to note that there was an issue with cleanliness. The sofa was so dirty and stained we had to cover it with a sheet in order to sit on it. The rug was also covered with stains. He offered to have both cleaned while we stayed there, but we didn't want to schedule our activities around a cleaning service. Also that should've been taken care of prior to arrival.
The location was ok, but not as close to downtown as we expected.
It states in the description that the apartment is street level, but it's important to know that you enter the living room directly from the street, which doesn't feel very private.
Home was great, the air conditioning worked so good!! It was a great stay.

Wow! What a nice place to stay if you are visiting Wrigley.  A very short walk to see the Cubs play. We hung out at the nearby corner and got many Cubs autographs.  Just a short walk to restaraunts.  Truly an amazing location. The hosts were very responsive and helpful.  Looking forward to staying there again for our next Wrigley visit.

We loved staying here.
The neighborhood was quiet and the place was super clean. Having a dedicated parking space to come back to each day was amazing.
Highly recommend!

This was an ideal set up for our family including two teenage boys. Charming yet high tech. Walkable to Wrigley. Easy to get day passes for the L which we used to go downtown for shopping and eating. Overall a great experience!
Such a good stay and right next to public transit!! So many good restaurants around and the place was clean and the way the layout is is perfect to have your own spaces!
Nice location close to public transit, responsive host, clean and private, would rent again.

The apartment is great.  Location is perfect.  Very clean and comfortable.  Unfortunately, the bathroom is a disaster waiting to happen.  The shower inside the bear claw tub is hard to climb into.  Once the curtain is pulled around the tub, the space becomes small.  If someone were to slip, the only thing to grab would be the curtain.   The pedestal sink leaves no space for toiletries.  The toilet was the lowest I have ever seen.  Hard to get up from and the mechanism needs to be improved.  A complete overall of the bathroom is needed.  I am not saying “state of the art expensive” just a Home Depot or Lowe’s update, mainly for safety reasons.  Get rid of the tub, put in a shower stall and you will have more room for a vanity.  Upgrade the toilet too.   The place is old and I get that you are trying to keep a certain atmosphere but safety comes first.  Turn this great place into fabulous!
This place is very amazing. Clean and same like pictures everything there.

Very spacious condo with comfortable furnishings and a full kitchen. The location was great for us to walk a couple of blocks to the Merchandise Mart and to lots of restaurants, and to Target and Wholefoods. We would definitely stay here again.
Awesome place to stay. very clean, comfortable beds, private balcony was awesome. Close proximity to many places.
Great house, great stay.  Hosts were helpful and responsive.

This was our 2nd time staying in one of Pings studios and it was great! We were in town for lollapalooza. The building is super close to grant and millennium park. There are great restaurants nearby. Check out Devil dawgs. The red and orange lines are super close too. The full size fridge and the stove top helped us make breakfast everyday and save some money too. We will be back!

E' stato bello passare i nostri giorni a Chicago a casa di Al & Jude, ci hanno accolto splendidamente nella loro casa e abbiamo ricevuto diversi consigli utili su come muoverci in città e dove mangiare, inoltre con Al abbiamo in comune la passione per la musica ed è stato bello parlare con lui.
Inoltre considero davvero ottima la zona di Irving Park, tranquilla e vicina a Wrigley Field.
Consiglio a tutti di soggiornare da Al & Jude persone meravigliose.

Fantastic spot. Close to L, half hour at most from Wrigley depending on traffic. Walking distance from many bars, restaurants, target, and convenience stores. Next to a tattoo shop. Great hub area. Shower was amazing and hot! Kitchen clean, plenty of closet space, and comfy couches.

Milan was kind and responsive, but there are a lot of issues with this place. The two biggest ones are roaches and the smell. The building is also party central. We were woken by loud groups of intoxicated guests two of our three nights. Other problems-microwave is broken, poorly stocked kitchen, the WiFi is not secure, there are no end tables in the master, one load of laundry requires procuring 20 quarters. These are very bare bones accommodations.

It was a great day really appreciate Maria’s communication. Location was fine. Parking was just not ideal, but I found a spot every night in the parking passes work good stay overall I recommended for the price.
Great place. Great location! I would stay there again!

Our stay was simply beautiful and amazing! Everything was true to the description, conveniently located and an all around peaceful environment, beautifully decorated might I add. I highly recommend choosing this home for your next vacation. We look forward to our next family vacation to Chicago, and we sincerely thank and appreciate the owners for their attention to details and making our stay hospitable.

Jake's place was great! It was well-located and very clean. It was really convenient!
My only complaint would be that there is very little flexibility in terms of early check in and late check out with fees of $25/hour.

Marcos place was incredible!!!! Perfect location, perfect size for 6 people, and Marco could not have been nicer or more helpful!! What a gem of a place! He was so incredibly helpful and responded right away - he really took time to be sure we felt supported. Highly recommend, 5 stars!

Overall the place was great! The rooms were nice and both had smart tv's. It was smaller than expected but it worked for what I needed! It was a quiet residential area which is nice. About a mile to Wicker Park with pretty residential streets to walk down to get there.

Stayed there for 6 days and my friends and I really enjoyed it. Walkable area with lots of stores and places to eat at. Location is right next to a beach so we had a great view to look at. Hotel was great. Only thing bad thing was that the sofa bed was not cleaned nor changed before we came so we didn’t use it during the stay.
We really enjoyed our time at Stephen’s place. Great place for the family and in an amazing neighborhood with easy access to public transit, food, and parks.
Incredible location! In walking distance to many bars and restaurants. Highly recommend!!

Gina’s place was exactly as described. It was quiet, clean, and very comfortable. Gina was incredibly responsive and even left us some thoughtful treats, which was such a nice touch. We truly enjoyed our stay and appreciated her kindness and hospitality. I would definitely stay here again!

The place is nice and matches the description. It was clean and in a nice location near lots of restaurants and shops. The host was very upfront about the noise from the train since you can hear every train passes by and provided ear plugs for sleeping.

We loved this home for a family getaway! Lovely neighborhood and everything we needed as a family of 5! All our questions were answered immediately, help with codes was especially appreciated. We loved our stay! I will be recommending to friends who are planning trips to the Obama Presidental Library!! Thank you Kyriako for an outstanding experience! 💜
Awesome apartment right by the train. Has everything you need and host is very kind (and has the cutest dog!)

Great place to stay with friends, it looks exactly like the pictures. The patio was very cute, great restaurants near by, and the space was spectacular! Check in and check out were easy to follow, would highly recommend!

Room was cool for the most part. Good location. We did have to wait more than an hour for our room which after a long travel day really suck. The room also smelled like an old mop and the front desk associates were not very helpful
Drea was very helpful and easy to work with.  The listing had everything we needed and inquired about.  Very clean and home like feeling. Felt like the area was great and safe.

Great location to get into the city also some fabulous coffee and breakfast places in walking distance great for a trip to the city would highly recommend especially for a group/ families. Wonderful stay thanks so much.
Had a great time! Ian was very responsive to messages and accommodating when we needed a later checkout. Location was perfect! Space was perfect! Really helped make the weekend special

great space, definitely accommodated my whole group. only complaint would be how hard the beds are. definitely should not be sleeping on the box spring in 2 different rooms. a bit of a walk from the orange line as well, 10-15 minutes give or take

LOCATION! This place is very close the bus and train stations. Ubers were always $12-18 anywhere around the city. Stayed here for Lollapalooza weekend and this place was perfect. For being a shared space, this place exceeded our expectations. Bathrooms were always clean which was my most concern. Kitchen and fridge were clean. Everyone respected their belongings in the shared fridge. Absolutely no complaints and I would stay here again!
Place was perfect for our traveling family in a great neighborhood that was safe to walk and explore. Thank you!

4 minute walk to the CTA Brown Line where you are 10-14 minutes to downtown. Place is really well kept,  wry clean. The beds and couches are very comfortable, loved the apartment. Easy walk to Wrigley Field.

Truly enjoyed our stay and this space! So much attention to detail and love poured into your space, Gloria. From the kitchen and hygiene amenities to the interior decor to the outdoor space and greenery. THANK YOU for welcoming us to Pilson!

Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a peaceful stay right outside of downtown Chicago. Ag and Krista are extremely friendly and communicative hosts, and the place looks even better in person than in the pictures. It was very clean and check-in was very simple. The location was amazing with lots of great restaurants and grocery stores within walking distance. The train was about a 4-5 minute walk from the Airbnb, so transportation was very convenient as well. Usually I try to include a downside in my reviews for the sake of transparency, but I honestly did not have a single problem with anything regarding this place, the location, or the hosts. I would absolutely stay here again if given the chance!
Our stay was great! Adorable apartment and great location.
Nice stay! Would stay here again and recommend!
It was a pretty cool place close to everything it is a really old building but I really enjoyed my stay you can walk almost anywhere

Ho Eun was a great host, extremely responsive and gave us excellent local restaurant recommendations! We enjoyed coming back to the spacious, relaxing house at the end of each day. Very charming character and tucked away in a quiet neighborhood!
Clean and conveniently surrounded by restaurants and shops. Very safe to walk late at night
Very responsive and accommodating
Great place to stay! Perfect location for us, within walking distance to everything. We enjoyed the amenities. Nancy was very responsive, proactive and friendly. Thank you for everything!
Great stay me and my friends had a great time

We had a wonderful stay at Bianca’s place! The location was perfect—everything we wanted to see was within walking distance or a short uber ride. The Airbnb was beautiful, spacious, spotless, and had great amenities that made us feel right at home. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

Brett was a wonderful and responsive host.  The apartment had what we needed and the location was perfect for walking to local spots as well as taking public transportation, both buses and elevated train to downtown.  Lots of local eateries and places to shop.  Street parking was easy with the provided permit.  Safe neighborhood.    Thank you, Brett!
A great stay visiting family in Chicago with my 2 kids and husband! Made us miss the city ♥️
Very clean and comfortable. Clear communication with the host. Affordable and close to the train station, making it easy to get anywhere in Chicago.

Honestly in a huge city like Chicago, this was the best place we could’ve chosen.
We stayed for a week to explore Chicago. It felt right at home, we got our own kitchen and bathroom big enough for us to get ready and relax. The blue line was a little walk but we had no trouble getting Ubers. And the pizza right across the street was AMAZING. I will use if I’m ever back in town!
Everything was perfect! Location was great. Responsive host on questions we had. The red line was super close as well to get into the city.
Good neighborhood, didn’t feel unsafe
Wonderful place
Great location and just enough space for our little group.

Yasmin place was fantastic and she is an amazing host. Throughout my stay, the communication was great, and she was super accommodating and flexible. We had no problem finding the place; she gave us great instructions and check-in and check-out were very smooth. The area is very central, 10 minutes walk to the cta red line and close to bus stops. The neighborhood felt super safe and walkable; we were a 35-minute easy walk to the Field Museum, Soldier Stadium and the Aquarium. There are a lot of food options within walking distance and a couple of bars. You can do street parking or easily find a location where to park for a fee. The apartment has everything you need, including umbrellas for a rainy day :). Everything was exactly as the listing, and we were super happy it felt right like home. I will definitely come back on my next visit to Chicago
Everything you see is terrible and it doesn't look like what they offer

Connor was very responsive, courteous & helpful. The area was very nice and even though the restaurants were not really within walking distance, there were several not far at all.
Also, Connor’s recommendations were spot on & very much appreciated.
We had our 22 month old granddaughter with us, and there were so many things that were available for the baby that we did not have to bring.
The place was very well stocked with toilet tissue, paper, towel, etc. and we really appreciated the waters that were in the fridge when we arrived after a long day.
Great location, great hospitality. Would stay again.
good location, host was communicative.

We had a wonderful stay here as a family of three! The place was very clean, spacious, and comfortable. The bed was super comfortable and even had a massage feature, which was such a nice surprise after long days exploring Chicago! Having two restrooms was also very much appreciated.
The kitchen had everything we needed, and having a washer and dryer was incredibly convenient, especially when traveling with a child. We also really appreciated the free parking right in front of the house — such a huge plus in Chicago!
The neighborhood felt fine and convenient. It’s not a fancy touristy area, but we felt comfortable staying there and had easy access to transportation, with a bus stop just around the corner. The location made it easy to get around and explore the city.
Overall, the place had everything we needed for a comfortable family stay, and we really enjoyed our time here. We would definitely stay again when we’re back in Chicago!

Stayed a week, nice neighborhood. Grocery, target and restaurant near by. Very friendly host, Edwin was very helpful and understanding. Perfect space for 2, space may seem a little small at first but has everything you need and is very cozy space. Would 100% stay again.

El departamento es tal cual en las fotos. Tuvimos un inconveniente con la bañadera tapada la primera noche y el anfitrión respondió rápidamente para poder solucionarlo. La zona está un poco alejada pero el entorno es seguro y con un colectivo te acercas al centro. Recomendable.
One of the best airbnb stays I’ve had :)

The location could not be better if you are visiting for a Cubs game. A quick walk down the street to get to the field and all that Wrigleyville has to offer. We were early and appreciated being able to drop our bags off early so we could explore the area.

We loved staying in this house! It’s a beautiful space, and Dave and Joy were very accommodating and responsive hosts.  You can tell they really care about the house and making sure guests feel comfortable. Great location as well - right next to a park, quiet and peaceful area yet still just a short drive away from downtown Chicago. Would definitely return!
Beautiful home, we loved staying here!!

Our family of was in town to catch two Cubs games and this was the absolute perfect spot. Jessica was a great host, with a lot of "extras" to make our stay even better. The apartment was very clean. The neighborhood was quite noisy at night, but we expected it would be. The host provided fans, noise machines and ear plugs to help with the noise factor. We would absolutely stay here again.
This condo was perfect!  Everything we wanted was in walking distance, the place was VERY secure and the area was safe.  Don’t miss this location!!

Beautiful home. So clean and exactly what we needed for a long weekend. Great location and really cute neighborhood. Margaret was responsive and kind! We will definitely be coming back. Thank you for letting us use your space!

The enclosed parking garage was a great asset for me. I could get my full size truck inside.
The kitchen was very nice and we had everything we needed to cook several meals.
Even though it's a crowded neighborhood, we heard no disturbances while sleeping. Street sounds were minimal.
The entire area was a very good neighborhood.
The bed we used was very comfortable. The hot water was hot and plentiful.
The shower was great with good pressure.
We would certainly return and stay again. And we may do so when we return to Chicago in a few months.
Great place to stay in a lovely neighborhood!

We so very pleased with this place. We had a large group and it was absolutely perfect. 9 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms!  The Air BnB was very clean and decorated nicely. There were two kitchens and two gatherings areas which worked well for our big group. Most of all, Jordan and Josh were really great to work with.  They responded quickly to any question before we got there and during our stay. The house was perfect for walking over to the Cubs stadium, not even a mile away.   It was a lovely experience. I totally recommend this site.
Great place!

Wow! What a great location. Right in the heart of the downtown loop. So much to see and explore right around the apartment. 24 hour doorman was very friendly and helpful. And the views are amazing. No need to go to the observation deck at Willis Tower or the Hancock building. You’ll get an equally awesome view here. Parking is available right next door. It’s expensive, but you’re right in the middle of Chicago, so it is what it is. It’s an easy way to keep your car off the streets. Well stocked kitchen and bathrooms. Would definitely stay here again.

This apartement and my room were simply perfect for me. Everything was exactly how it was discribed, well maintained.
With the train going downtown from this place is really easy.
Thank you for being my so friendly hosts!
The building is beautiful and the location is wonderful.  Aside from some issues with the lock box and some parking issues it was nice!

Convenient location with lots of stuff to do nearby! Initially I was worried that there would be too much noise given the location, but there were no noise issues at all.  I did have some trouble entering the unit as getting the lock from the keypad and the old door to sync up was tricky.  Also, hot is cold and cold is hot on the shower faucet.  Either way, I enjoyed my stay and would definitely consider staying here again in the future.
Wonderful was a very thoughtful host, the place was stocked with more than enough supplies for our stay and the location was great!
Great spot for a quick work trip.
Just what we needed! Thank you :)
Had a great stay. Very close to Wrigley field and places to eat. Would stay again.
A very unique stay. Great location. Be prepared to climb up some stairs.
Me encantó la estancia, todo perfecto! Lo único es que si está retirado del centro de Chicago y en las noches es un poco peligrosa la zona

As a solo female traveler, I felt completely comfortable staying at Josh’s place. All spaces were kept clean. The bed was very comfortable. The location was ideal - about a 3 minute walk to the Blue line. The neighborhood was quiet and safe. Instructions were very clear, check in was simple, and the place was easy to find. Josh was a great host - I would stay here again!

The pros about this place:
The location is amazing! You are 2 blocks from Michigan Ave and Lake Michigan. You can see the lake from the unit and there is a gorgeous rooftop with 360 degree views. The living room, kitchen, and bedroom were nice.
The cons about this place:
The lockbox was difficult to locate and open. Also the lock on the door and the doorknob are wonky and took some getting used to.
The carpeting in the hallway is DISGUSTING…borderline Section 8 vibes.
This building and unit were probably really nice 30+ years ago, but it is time for renovations.
There were noticeable stains on the bedroom carpets.
The bathtub was severely chipped.
General dirtiness everywhere in the unit. The filter in the AC unit was so dusty and furry!
The light switch in the one bedroom was caked in dirt.
With tax and fees we paid 2,800 for 4 nights here and expected a 5 star experience. There are MANY other options in this same neighborhood that would have been better at that price.

We had a great time here!! Carlo was very responsive and flexible with our arrival times. The place was nice and cozy and was walkable to a bunch of nice restaurants and cafes! We can’t recommend this place enough!

I had a small quick trip to Chicago for a concert and was able to stay here for a couple of days. Although,  I didn’t get to interact a lot with Brandon,  since I was in and out a lot, I can say I had an amazing stay! Brandon has great communication and he was super nice! It was an easy check in, room was great, public transportation wasn’t far from the place so that was SUPER convenient. I literally have no complaints! It was everything I need for a quick trip!
Stayed here for a Concert Weekend and had a lovely time staying here.

Solid location, right next to Metro stop (Blue Line) 10-15 minute walk from greek town which had lots of great restaurant options. Just a few metro stops away from downtown chicago. Also close to United Center (2 or 3 stops on metro). Front desk concierge Salvador was very nice and friendly!

Host was very clear and helpful. The place is 10-12 min walk distance from subway and is easy to get to downtown and other areas.
Place as described. Everything was great
Thanks a lot.
Awesome neighborhood (safe, quite, and close to public transport), very responsive hosts, hostel style environment. Would recommend!
A great “home away from home” during our trip to Chicago. Would stay here again.

If you’re looking to stay somewhere and you have a smaller budget I would definitely suggest staying here. The neighborhood is a little questionable but for most of our stay we felt pretty safe and no one bothered us. I would definitely stay here again if I was ever back in Chicago.

We had a great time exploring Chicago from this very central location. Easy to get to the l train or walk to local tourist spots. The hosts were super responsive and helpful and the building staff very friendly. Would definitely recommend!
Love this Place ..

We had a great stay here whilst in Chicago. Very close to transport links into the City which was very useful for us. The accommodation was fantastic - spacious, clean and modern. Would recommend this place for anyone wanting a good place to stay in Chicago. The hosts were responsive and helpful throughout our stay.

I booked for my wife and teenage son, and they had such a wonderful time, it was such a great experience and the host was so accommodating and great.  Thanks so much, cannot recommend this place enough!!

Michaels place was beautiful inside, looks just like the pictures. The back patio was also nice which we utilized and the darts were a nice addition! Parking in the gated section is easy, (the gate is slightly heavy), and it felt secure for the car instead of street parking. Thank you!

Dave was such a gracious host and always answered all my questions nearly immediately. The place is such a cute, cozy place and we had plenty of room to work and stay.
Great stay in a great place. Will was very responsive and helpful. Would definitely stay again.

this place was super cute! mike responded pretty quickly every time. the place is clean and the bed is super comfy. just make sure you know how to enter the house, and don't make the same mistake i did and walk to the wrong house!
very nice and friendly host, airbnb was clean and cozy as well, close to a lot of good restaurants

Joseph is an amazing host—quick to respond and extremely helpful throughout our trip. The apartment is very clean, and the bathroom is great with impressive water pressure and hot water. Convenient transport to downtown and great value for the price. Would definitely stay again!
Thank you for the stay! Will definitely be back

Valeriy was a great host! This was my first time staying in an Airbnb that was a shared house, and I was impressed with how well everything went! I would absolutely stay here again. A little bonus for any fans of the TV show Shameless: the iconic Gallagher house is only a 4 min walk away! So cool!
Great place very spacious
Great stay. Lots of space in the living room to hang out. On a busy street and the floors are very creeky and loud, but we had a great stay.

The stay at Ingrid’s place went beyond expectations. It was my first time in Chicago and she gave me a list of walkable restaurants and resources in the area, and different restaurants to check out in town. The place was clean and smelled good, it was decorated well and had a special charm to it. She had all amenities plus some- included snacks, a water jug with filter, drinks in cooler, tooth brush, eye masks, coffee and a few other things. There are great restaurants and coffee shops a walking distance. There was also a 24 hr CVS 2-3 blocks away. Ingrid was thoughtful and timely with her responses. I would definitely book again next time I’m in town.
Enjoyed staying with Molly!  It was a busy weekend in Chicago and we needed a location that allowed us to travel in and around the city.  It was lovely and easy to get to mass transit!

I have stayed here twice now and I will continue to everytime I visit Chicago. The first place we booked was bigger than the second time around, and that's only because we booked last minute. But I will not make that mistake again. The studio was still enough room for 3 of us, and with a full kitchen, it was a great deal either way. The apartment is about a 30 minute walk from downtown with all the attractions and museums, and it's a couple blocks from Chinatown. There are a ton of places to eat in the area, and there are places to get groceries within a couple miles also. The host was VERY responsive and helpful and was flexible when I made any requests or had questions. As a young woman, I did not feel unsafe throughout the neighborhood either, and at one point was walking around at 9:30 at night. I maybe wouldn't recommend doing that every night, but it still was not a bad neighborhood. All in all, I will always book here and recommend it to others when I get the chance.

The place was great everything we were looking for. Samoane was awesome responding quickly anytime I had a question.
Much appreciated.

One of the best places I’ve stayed using Airbnb!
We stayed here for Lollapalooza and Hazel was super accommodating and friendly! She even bought by us ponchos for the festival because it was raining which was very kind of her to do.
I would highly recommend this place to stay if you’re in the area!!
great place for our lolla days , we enjoyed , thank you jennifer
Everything in the place was great and as advertised.  Location is awesome particularly for Cubs games.
Our stay was great! Our only complaint was about toliet paper. We were staying for almost a week and there were only two or three rolls in the bathroom for five guests.

We enjoyed our stay! Everything was extremely clean (which we appreciate). It was pretty easy to locate and not too far from most attractions. They have a lovely garden out back with plenty of seating. They were lovely hosts that were easy to work with. They also had coffee and creamer there which was a nice touch especially when it’s a short stay. We needed a few extra washcloths and they brought them quickly.

We had an excellent stay at Rosa’s Airbnb.  The apartment was very comfortable and spacious and very clean.  All the amenities were available.  This location in Bridgeport is excellent if you want a very quiet and walkable city setting.  The area is very residential but close to several good restaurants and bars.  We recommend Franco’s for excellent and well priced Italian, Maria’s for a local bar experience, The Listening Room for a hip music experience, and Potsticker House for awesome Chinese.  The location is only about 15 minutes from downtown Chicago, and other excellent neighborhoods worthy of exploring (Pilsen, West Town, Ukrainian Village, Little Italy, Hyde Park).  Highly recommend this Airbnb!
had a wonderful time staying here. checking in was super easy and the bed was super comfortable after a long day of activities and walking
Great area!

The Airbnb was very nice and just as described! Perfect for coming back to rest after a long days of walking around Chicago. Had all of the kitchen appliances we needed, and nice bedrooms with air conditioning. I feel like the only downside was the location because parking was very difficult, and the surrounding area was run down. But the apartment itself was well kept, and we felt safe staying there!
Perfect for people going to Wrigley. Short walk from almost anything you think you may need or want. Private space was far better than expected.
Super location, beautiful spot. Worth the stay.
Nice, clean, quiet.

The home was beautiful, the neighborhood was perfectly fine. The host, though, doesn’t seem to actually want to be in the hospitality business. No towels or washcloths, no dish detergent, no ice or ice maker, long messages of rules and warnings ahead of time that threaten those rules are enforced by cameras, semi-hostile signage EVERYWHERE in the Airbnb. The thinnest toilet paper I have ever seen.
The cleaning was just okay, the sheets had stains and the basement box spring has obvious water damage, and there was gum or something ground into the mat. The house hadn’t fully been reset when we arrived; the outdoor cushions were piled up not on the chairs and there was a mat hanging on the side of the back porch.
The 1st floor only has a tiny bathroom we jokingly called the prison bathroom during our stay because of its tiny size and all caps signage about what to flush.
All in all, this was an unwelcoming experience that was not particularly more affordable than other stays.
Good overall. Good location. ~8 minutes walking to Kedzie CTA Pink Line station.

We spent the Lollapalooza, Ariana Grande long weekend at this condo in the heart of Chicago. I was pleasantly surprised at the neighborhood. Traveling with teenage girls can be a challenge but we felt safe in this pretty, family friendly neighborhood. Of course, at night we heard the usual city noises but that’s to be expected. The kitchen was appropriately stocked, beds were comfy-even the pull out bed. I will highly recommend this location to friends and family and stay there again next time I’m in Chicago.
Great location!!! The place is very comfortable and you have all you need for a short or longer stay.
Lovely space in Chinatown. Green and Red line stations nearby allow for easy navigation in and out of neighborhood. Lots of good entertainment within a few blocks of space. Overall, great stay!

Michelle was a great host—always responsive, quick to address any concerns, and very accommodating, including generously allowing us a later checkout. My group and I really enjoyed our stay. The Airbnb was clean, beautiful, and felt very secure.
Our only complaints were the noise from ongoing construction next door and the upstairs neighbors, which made for some restless mornings. The neighborhood can also feel a little sketchy at night, though we never had any issues. Overall, we had a great stay and really enjoyed the property!

This Airbnb is great for groups that want a large space and a quiet neighborhood surrounding Chicago. We stayed for a total of four nights and had a few ups and downs throughout this trip.
Pros: big enough for groups, reasonably affordable, in walking distance to grocery store and public transit, great food in the area, in unit washer/dryer, renovated and actually looks like the pictures, cute rooftop area.
Cons: 45-60 minute commute one way into the heart of Chicago, not enough furniture like nightstands or dressers to store anything, very bare bones as to what’s included (we had to buy our own paper towels/salt/etc.)
Overall we enjoyed our stay, but it was definitely farther from the city than we thought. The host was very responsive and helped with any issues throughout the trip immediately.

Beautiful place! I felt like I was in a Paris flat ! The decoration is esthetically pleasing and calming. Very spacious ! Great area, close to many things. Neighborhood is easily walkable with a grocery store nearby. Loved our stay. Stop scrolling and book it now, you won’t regret it !

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago! The host was very responsive and helpful. The neighborhood was quiet and felt safe, which made coming back after a busy day even better. Great location with shopping and restaurants. Close to the blue line. Rental had great character. Nice view of the city. We really enjoyed our stay!

Overall, the Airbnb looked nice and was located in a great neighborhood. The space was generally comfortable, and the location made it easy to get around and enjoy the area.
However, there were a few cleanliness and maintenance issues that affected our stay. The shower curtain in the bathroom had a noticeable moldy smell, some of the drinking glasses in the kitchen still had lipstick stains on them, and the microwave was missing its glass turntable plate, making it less convenient to use.
One additional suggestion would be to add a TV in the bedroom, as I think it would make the space feel even more comfortable for guests.
With a bit more attention to cleaning, replacing the missing microwave plate, and considering a TV in the bedroom, this could be an even better place to stay.
We enjoyed our stay. The location is highly accessible by transit (especially by bus). Alana was very responsive and helpful.

Cozy Nest provided a wonderful place away from the downtown hustle and bustle while still being just a CTA ride away from the city. The close proximity to the Red Line really was super convenient. Wonderful host. A++++. Really cool place in a great neighborhood.

Guillermo’s place was just as pictured. We had a great and comfortable stay. We were hesitant at first given the bathroom was shared but it was available at all times. We ran into the hosts quite a few times and they were so friendly. Would definitely recommend this place!

Unfortunately, our experience did not meet expectations. Upon arrival, the property did not have enough towels for our group, although the host did send additional towels after we notified them. Parking was also much more limited than we anticipated.
In addition, the cleaning staff arrived one day before our scheduled checkout, which was unexpected and disruptive.
The most significant issue occurred on our final night. An alarm repeatedly went off for short periods throughout the night. We contacted the host through Airbnb while it was happening but did not receive a response until the following morning. Because the cause of the alarm was unknown, the remaining guests no longer felt comfortable staying at the property and had to book a hotel for the night. The host later informed us they did not know what caused the alarm.
While the host was courteous in some interactions, the overall experience was disappointing, and we cannot recommend this property based on our stay.

Sheena’s place was cute and very clean. It had everything we needed and more. The neighborhood wasn’t amazing, but it was very close to public transit. No driveway but many options for street parking. The house is very secure with many keypads, but locking the place from the outside can be quite difficult. I would recommend Sheena’s place and would stay again.
Great place, we had a lovely stay. The garage parking especially was nice as were the well stocked snacks. Thanks for being a great host!
Very kind host and loved our stay, also very pretty place with easy transit!!
Really large place with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms (and a pull out couch bed) and a great kitchen. Was an easy and fun stay!

The location of this stay is fantastic and convenient, but the experience was disappointing. We dealt with a water outage for half a day, early morning construction noise, and broken elevators. Inside, the unit had safety hazards like exposed nails on a broken coffee table, an extremely tiny bathroom, and toilet paper holders that broke off the wall. Great area, but the property requires urgent repairs and better upkeep.
Great location near Logan square. The listing was as advertised and the hosts were super communicative. Highly recommend!
Very home like feel. Would recomend for future stays in chicago

We enjoyed our stay at Brittany’s. She was very responsive and kind. Her home was very clean and it was a nice space. We loved how close it in proximity to the blue line to easily take public transportation around Chicago.
Ebony had such a lovely home and peaceful getaway from the wild festival. Definitely made me wanna come back to this great city with rich history and wonderful people.

Shay was amazing at the front desk! Had a great time when I stayed here for Lollapalooza. They had
Planned activities all week with complimentary happy hour and was overallsucb avreat experience. Location is also amazing!

I stayed here for lollapalooza weekend and I absolutely loved the area. I loved walking back and forth from Grant park and restaurants and other places we went to. The staff were always super nice and helped me and my friends out a lot durning our stay. We had a great view from our window, I almost didn’t want to leave 😭 I will definitely be booking back there again! 😊
We had a great time staying here with a large party. Habib was very communicative and the home accommodated us very well!
Amazing location! Enough room for four people comfortably

A quirky and eclectic DIY house turned into an income property. It provided exactly what was described in the listing -- no more, no less. Was a short walk from the Chicago Mass Transit System (pink line) and had lots of good hispanic restaurants in the area. It served our purpose though I feel it was a bit overpriced, but maybe that was due to the other events occurring in Chicago that weekend.
Milan was super responsive and friendly for everything we needed. Highly recommend booking with him.

Thank you Ecme for having me. I really appreciate everything! I hope you have a great rest of your summer!
Best Wishes,
Byron
Good stay in the Sports Illustrated Resort. They had extra things for us to do in hotel. Complementary IV’s and oxygen bar.  Rooftop bar was nice.
Very nice place to stay and super close to downtown! Would stay again thank you!!

We had a great experience at this property. Very central location especially for those attending Lolla. Extremely clean and minimalist decor, comfortable beds and great amenities (rooftop pool and gym on site). Hosts were very responsive at all hours.
Only note for future visitors is that there are no cooking basics like some other Airbnb properties have (oil, salt, pepper, Tupperware, etc) so just ensure you pick up some of the essentials if you plan to cook and save any food for leftovers. Also no ice maker or ice trays so bring your own if you want ice!
walkable area and super chill but the sheets on the pull out were dirty and there was a bit of an ant problem otherwise the stay was perfect.

The host was amazing - they were very responsive and helpful when I was staying with them. However, the actual apartment was not super clean. We found stains on the sheets and couch, the door for the closet was broken off the track, the counters were sticky, and the floors made our socks black (also crumbs and hair). In addition, after taking a shower, a roach unexpectedly said hi to me. Thankfully I only saw the one, but it freaked me out a bit the rest of the time. The shower also needs some maintenance, as the water pressure is super low and there’s molding on the caulk in the shower. Both times I left to go grab breakfast and run errands, I came back to the housekeeper continuously parking in our assigned stall.
great place to stay! very convenient

We had a fantastic stay and would highly recommend this host! She was incredibly flexible with our schedule and went out of her way to make sure we had the best accommodations possible.
The place itself was spotless and beautifully maintained. It honestly felt like it had just been renovated, with everything looking brand new and never used before.
She was also very proactive throughout our stay, regularly checking in to see how we were doing and whether we needed anything. She was always quick to respond to questions and extremely helpful.
To top it all off, we accidentally left an item behind, and she went above and beyond to help return it to us. Her kindness, responsiveness, and attention to her guests truly made this one of our best Airbnb experiences. We'd gladly stay here again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Qiqi’s place was perfect for our party of 10. The home was clean and roomy. Kitchen had everything we needed and the laundry room was a big plus.
Qiqi was a friendly and responsive host.
Great place to stay for a weekend getaway in the city. Had everything we needed, and the neighborhood is very chill with a lot of local spots to go to.
Wonderful location for our stay.  Appreciated the thoughtful touches in the house and the proximity to the l station.
Great host, spotless place, we felt right at home. Easy access to the highway making super easy to get around. 18th st local shops are right down the street. Would definitely stay here again.

We had such a fantastic stay for our first trip to Chicago! The property was wonderful and Afsha made everything so easy with great communication and quick responses. Highly recommend! We'd stay again in a heartbeat!

The place was very spacious and nicely decorated. It was very close to multiple bus stops which made public transportation very easy. It was a straight bus ride into downtown which was super convenient for us. The layout of the rooms were great and was very homey. Would definitely stay here again next time we visit chicago!
Great place in a quiet location. Responsive host. Super clean

Overall, the stay was simply fine. However, paying the same price as a basic hotel, you’d expect at least some of the same hospitality. There weren’t even any hand towels in the bathroom. No trash cans in the room so you’d have to walk through shared spaces just to throw away a wrapper. We also did find bugs in the room if we were gone the whole day. The host also doesn’t mention having to share the bathroom with upwards of 10 other guests. So it’s not exactly “easy” to go. It also didn’t feel the safest. When you’re sharing a house with 10 strangers and all there is between you and them is a simple doorknob lock, it doesn’t feel great.

Perfect Garden apartment in Logan Square for my wife and I, we wanted to stay in the area since my wife used to live in Logan Square years ago.  The Garden outback was nice to sit in the evenings too!
amazing place! about a 20-30 min drive to downtown (depending on traffic) responded quickly! easily accessible, had all the amenities we needed and very clean!
Had a great stay at Osiris place! Guest house was as described and easy to check in. Being so close to the bus station was also a plus.
Super responsive, easy parking, super great location being so close to the metra.

We absolutely loved our stay at Matthew’s place! We flew to Chicago for Lollapalooza, and the location in Wicker Park was perfect. It was an easy walk to the train station, making it convenient to get around the city, and there were so many great restaurants, coffee shops, and stores nearby.
The unit itself was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, and it truly felt like a home away from home. Matthew was a wonderful host, and check-in and check-out were both seamless.
We would definitely stay here again the next time we’re in Chicago and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable place in an amazing neighborhood!

This place was perfect for our trip! There was enough bedrooms and space and it was within walking distance of a grocery store and restaurants if you don’t have access to a car! Everything was organized and the host was very responsive!
We had another great stay! Great space, close to everything we wanted to do, clean and the beds are super comfortable! Can’t wait til next year! Thank you!!!

Brittany’s place was perfect for our weekend stay in Chicago. The area was quiet and felt safe.
Brittany is an amazing host and very responsive. For example, we were missing one towel and she had one dropped off immediately.
For the price, this place is a gem!! We will definitely be back :)

What a lovely apartment to stay in! It was extremely spacious and check-in was super easy as well. Compared to the photos, the apartment is a bit more dated looking in real life but it really wasn’t an issue for me.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was absolutely lovely—beautifully maintained, exceptionally clean, and very comfortable. The host was incredibly hospitable, generous, and kind throughout our stay. Communication was excellent, with prompt and efficient responses to every question we had, making everything seamless from check-in to check-out.
The home itself felt like a peaceful retreat. We truly appreciated the care and attention the host put into ensuring we had a great experience. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend this home to anyone looking for a clean, welcoming, and well-managed place to stay. Conveniently located.

Stayed here for Lollapalooza this year and it was exactly what we needed - a reasonably priced place to sleep for the festival. Location is very convenient and close to public transportation. Everything was clean and we noticed the bathrooms were cleaned and trash was taken out multiple times during our stay. The host was very responsive for any questions we had leading up to the stay. Overall recommend!
Perfect house for large group! Neighborhood was quaint and peaceful. Absolutely loved our stay and highly recommend!!

I'll keep it simple.
1) garage door was locked and had no way to access until middle of day 2 when one of his staff had to come unlock the door
2) host described unit as having central air, it was cooled by 3 window units. Which, they worked well, but was still false information.
3) We were greeted by a notice on the second day that the gas was at risk of being shut off because the owner of the property did not get the gas inspected. Upon speaking to the gas utility worker that came to the door, they had been trying to contact the owner for weeks and couldn't. Gas was shut off. So, with a gas stove and gas heated water, we did not have hot water past the first night. We were given a plug-in burner, but that doesn't make up for this even a little.
Even if he is nice, Vin is a terrible communicator and will send the same "help" steps 5 times over before actually sending someone to fix the issue that was caused by him/his staff.
Great location, but I'd try your luck with another bnb.

Ryan was a great host! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and looked exactly like the pictures. I really enjoyed my stay and had a great experience. I would definitely book this Airbnb again and highly recommend staying here!
We had a great stay and an amazing time! Super close to Wrigley!!

Its a shared space. The bathroom sink had hair all over. The bed had stains. The blanket was dirty. The chair was dirty. The room was smaller than shown. There was no wooden area with tv. It was a rack which i liked but still it was very small.
Nice place, safe and quiet, good beds, comfortable lounge
good location for lollapalooza! nice size and nice host.

I would highly recommend staying here. Leelach went above and beyond as a host and made our stay in Chicago easy. The apartment is in a great location in walking distance of many restaurants and the red line. 10/10 thank you!
very nice place !!

Excellent for a weekend stay! Perfect little upstairs apartment unit. Please note stairs are a bit steep! But overall a great place with nice amenities, walkable neighborhood, close to lots of public transit and Midway airport.

I really enjoyed my stay! The location was peaceful and convenient and everything we needed was within walking distance, which made getting around so easy. The space was comfortable and made for a great stay. The host was also very quick to respond, accommodating and helpful throughout our visit. I really appreciated how easy and enjoyable the whole experience was. I would definitely stay here again!

I had a great time during my stay. The home was clean, quiet, and proximate to public transportation. It is in a non luxurious area, but I never had any issues even coming home late at night as a solo traveling woman.

Great place to stay, area was perfect for cubs and sox games. Lots of nightlife and places to walk to and eat. Train station about 4 minute walk to go anywhere. Parking is good but if there’s a cubs game don’t lose your spot or you won’t find one until  a couple hours after game is over. Would stay again.

The instructions to access the unit were very clear. Being from NYC, transportation to downtown area was very walkable. The unit itself was very clean with updated amenities and central AC which was refreshing to walk back into with the heat. The hosts are very responsive, checked in on me to ensure everything was well, and redirected me to nearby businesses if I needed something. The neighborhood itself is very quiet and not once did I question my safety. Overall a great stay and would definitely book again if I have another opportunity to visit Chicago! 😊

We had a great time staying at Austin's place! It was really conveniently located next to Chinatown and tons of great restaurants, as well as public transportation. Beds were comfortable and large, and the living area was very spacious as well, making it a great place for our group of 6.
The only thing to note is that due to proximity to trains, the train horns can be a bit disruptive at night or early morning. Still, we had a wonderful stay!
Good neighborhood & quick response from the owner.
Andrew was great me and 7 friends stayed for Lolla and LOVED IT! beds are comfortable, big kitchen space, awesome welcome platter with snacks and water. Would highly recommend coming again!

We went to Chicago for the Lollapalooza festival so this place was perfect, near to downtown so the transport was easy and good food nearby.
Salvador was very helpful and friendly. The only thing is that you can hear very clear what all the neighbors are doing, not a big deal, just a note.
Thank you for having us!

We had an amazing stay! The place was very spacious, clean, comfortable, and well maintained. It had everything we needed. The location was right outside the city, but not too far of a commute so it felt more homey.
The host was friendly, very responsive, and made the entire check-in and check-out process seamless. Even checked up on us everyday to make sure we are having a pleasant stay!
I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a great place to stay. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!
Perfect place to stay!!

Daniel's place was exactly what I was looking for. Close to the train that can take me to and from the airport as well as downtown and the other lines. Very quiet and walkable neighborhood with local bars and restaurants. The space itself is exactly as pictured. Clean and comfortable overall. Would definitely stay here again.

The place was clean, and the hosts were very responsive throughout our stay. The main thing to be aware of is the sleeping arrangement. The listing says it sleeps 8, but the couch is not a pull-out sofa bed, it’s a sectional with movable pieces. In our experience, the space comfortably sleeps 6. To accommodate 8, you’d likely need three people to share one of the king beds.
One other thing to keep in mind is that late checkout couldn’t be confirmed until the morning of departure. While we understand that availability can change, it made it difficult to plan our last day.
Overall, it’s a good place to stay and the hosts were great.

Tuan was very kind and helpful when we ended up asking to cancel our stay and get a refund- so this review is about the space, not the host.
The unit was too dirty. Aside from the overall grime, there was mold in the shower, strands of other people’s hair in the soap and the sheets, sticky surfaces, and stains on the bed headboard.
This is a basement unit under their home so it is noisy.
It’s also not a convenient location if you don’t have a car. It’s a walk, bus ride, then a long train ride (averaging 45+ mins in total) to get to downtown Chicago.

It’s very accommodating and close to public transportation.  We enjoyed being able to walk to the grocery store and cook meals in the kitchen.  The metro was super close and took us where we needed to go.  There is a great restaurant by the green line, highly recommend eating breakfast or lunch there.
Great spot great neighborhood.

It was a beautiful place, bigger than I expected for an Airbnb. Bobbie was a wonderful host that included anything I could have possibly needed for my stay. Comfortable beds and very comfortable furniture all around. Would recommend it for anyways Chicago getaway!

Enjoyed our stay, we were in town for a festival so having the train station at a walking distance was important to us. The shared space was constantly maintained/cleaned. Would definitely recommend this listing and would stay here again. Thanks to Alle & her team for checking in and being so understanding!
Great

Functional, nothing fancy. The bedroom without a window was comfortable, but the other bed was basic, it got very bright in the morning, and I had to wear earplugs because there were some trucks working right outside the window starting around 6AM. The kitchen was nice and well stocked but there wasn’t comfortable seating to hang out in the main area. Location was the biggest perk of this listing as the Blue Line is a 5 min walk away and there are lots of nearby restaurants and coffee shops. Not a lot of late night tho.
My friends and I had an amazing stay at Taylor’s place. I’d highly recommend anyone stay here that is new to Chicago, easy access to transport in to the city. Good quiet neighbourhood.
Great location, right by the blue line. Tons of places to eat and drink. Place is good for the price and as described.
Owner communicated everything and we had no problems with our stay. Place was exactly what we were expecting with no surprises.
Great place to stay!
Caroline was a fantastic host. Great communication and clear instructions for everything. Would stay here again!
Dan’s home was warm and cozy, had lots included in the home. It felt clean and kept upright, Dan was a great host and was so lenient. It made our stay and trip to Chicago easy.

I had a great stay with my friend! The host was very responsive and helpful, even when the downstairs toilet stopped working for part of our stay. It was also located conveniently close to the exact train we needed to take to the music festival we were attending! If I ever visit Chicago again, I will be considering staying with Saurin again.

We stayed with Tippi while in town for Lollapalooza! It was a great stay. The neighborhood is very cute and it’s a short walk over to the blue line. The bed was very comfortable and it was great having a stocked kitchen!
We had a great time staying here! Thanks to Bryan for allowing us to keep our bags in the hall before check in so we did not have to walk around with them all day following our flight in!
Rida was so kind and quick to respond during our trip. She also helped us when we needed it! I definitely will return if I’m given the chance.
Accurate listing and exactly as described. The host was communicative, responsive, and made the stay easy from start to finish. I would definitely book again and recommend this place to others.

we loved our stay here! it was such a great place to come and rest and recover after a long day out at a festival, and the shower downstairs is divine. the home is beautiful and looked even more breathtaking in person than the pictures. only note for future guests is that if you are a young woman, i would not recommend walking home from the CTA station at night, other guests and i were catcalled on multiple occasions on our walks home and even followed once. naturally this is out of the host’s control, but something worth noting for safety reasons! a great place to stay for the price nonetheless ☺️
