Excelente atención y disponibilidad por parte de los anfitriones, el lugar se encuentra tal cual las fotografías y en una buena ubicación para desplazarte a varios puntos de la ciudad, muchas gracias por su hospitalidad :)
Great experience! Very welcoming! So close to Wrigley!
Great location. Host was easy to communicate with and helped us with any questions we had promptly!
Great stay. Enjoyed Crawford food and spirits…. Good eats and drinks….. Clean and comfortable… Will stay again…

L'appartement situé dans un semi sous-sol d'une maison est très fonctionnel et lumineux malgré tout. Il semble avoir été rénové récemment. Très propre et très bien entretenu, c'est un pied à terre idéal. La maison est dans un quartier résidentiel et très calme. Le seul point un peu moins positif est sa situation par rapport au centre ville. Il faut compter 1 heure de transport pour s'y rendre. Nous avons loué des vélos et en 50 minutes vous êtes dans le centre, beaucoup de pistes cyclables.
Enfin les hôtes sont très réactifs et à l'écoute.

Our stay here was absolutely wonderful! The place was spotless, beautifully decorated, and incredibly comfortable. You can tell the host has put so much thought into every detail to make guests feel welcome.
We were greeted with a thoughtful welcome card, a bowl of snacks, and a well-stocked coffee station complete with creamers in the refrigerator - such a nice touch! The amenities throughout the home were impressive and made our stay feel effortless.
One of our favorite features was the dry erase board with recommendations for nearby grocery stores, train stations, restaurants, and other attractions, along with their distances. It was helpful and made exploring the area much easier.
Overall, this was a beautiful place to stay, and we truly enjoyed every minute of our visit. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully appointed Airbnb!

Lots of space. We felt at home in the apartment. Great amenities and transport is a short walk away. Loved the location because it had most of the staple Chicago food spots nearby but also was quiet and peaceful. Would stay here again!
Stayed for Lollapalooza and it was wonderful! Very convenient and close to bus stops and the CTA Green Line.

Denisha was amazing. Me and my friends wanted to check in earlier and she allowed us to check in as early as noon. She kept us up to date and she communicated quickly when we sent her messages leading up! The getting into the home was super easy. The space was extremely spacious and perfect for me and my friends. The two bathrooms were perfect and the lighting was great, too! Had everything we needed in the kitchen and it was only a 20 minute uber to downtown! We all felt super safe and happy with this stay and would totally stay here again!

Well you get what you pay for. If you can handle a place that needs a deep clean and a VERY stiff bed in room C3, then this place works. Mile walk from red and orange line stations. Safe neighborhood. 2 bathrooms and plenty of fridge space.
Host was very nice and helpful! Look up on Google Maps/ Earth before staying so you are familiar with area and know where to go. Great deal as well 😊
Junaid’s was very easy to talk to and understanding the place was very beautiful and could have 10 people stay there everything work fine and felt very homie
Space was clean and spacious. Host was also responsive and accommodating. Would recommend staying here for anyone visiting Chicago as it is conveniently close to the downtown area (by car and metro)!

We had a great stay! The host was extremely responsive, kind, and genuinely cared about making sure we had a good experience. They checked in with us multiple times throughout our stay, and anytime we needed something, they took care of it incredibly quickly—usually within a day. For example, we asked about adding curtains to the bedroom and having the bathroom cleaned once more, and both requests were handled promptly and graciously.
You can really tell that the hosts care about their Airbnb and want their guests to feel comfortable and well taken care of. The space is newly renovated, very nice, and made for a comfortable stay. The location in Rogers Park was great for us, and compared to other options we looked at in Chicago, we felt it was very reasonably priced as well.
Overall, we had a very positive experience and really appreciated how attentive and accommodating the hosts were. We would definitely recommend staying here!
Amazing location and the host made the stay as easy as possible. Definitely recommend for a stay in Chicago!
Kind host and great space. Best parking situation I’ve had in Chicago!

The room was exactly as described, and the host was honest about its condition. It wasn't nearly as small as I expected and was perfectly fine for a solo traveler. It is quite noisy, so definitely bring earplugs and an eye mask regardless you're a light sleeper or not.
The location is excellent, especially during Lollapalooza. It's close to Chinatown with lots of great Chinese restaurants within walking distance, and it's easy to get to the festival via the Red Line.
The only downside for me was the communication with the host. They seemed very focused on repeatedly emphasizing the house rules, which came across as a bit harsh. I understand they may have had difficult experiences with past guests, but I prefer not to feel those experiences carried over into our interaction. That said, this may simply be a difference in communication style, and other guests may not feel the same way.
Overall, the accommodation matched the listing accurately, offered value for the price
Such a wonderful stay! Easy check in and out, the place was exactly like the photos and spotless when I checked in. Would definitely stay here again!
Great apartment in a brilliant location! Would recommend to anyone looking for a weekend getaway in Chicago.
Had a great time at this lovely spot :). Host was great!!
This is a fantastic spot with a super responsive host! The access to the apartment is very convenient, and you're close to all the famous places. Overall, it makes for a really great stay!
Perfect location and responsive host
Great spot and a lovely neighborhood in Chicago. Just a 10 minute drive to Grant Park and a three minute drive to great restaurants would definitely stay here again.
Perfect location to train n Lyft bike rental was right on corner. Apartment was as described and amenities were great
Good place and nice host

My friend and I stayed here for a festival. The place matched the photos. The neighborhood was quiet. I loved seeing the decor and how at home it felt. It’s easy to walk to transit, stores, and restaurants. The host made sure to be very detailed with us on how to get to the place and how to check in, also asked us if we needed anything or had questions. I’d stay here again!
N/a

Location was easy to find, close to public transportation, and incredibly clean/quiet.
Be sure to read the check in instructions carefully. The only thing (minor) that could’ve improved our stay was AC in the middle bedroom but the Chicago wind was sufficient enough.
Kimberly was a great host, very responsive and we would stay here again. She left us rain boots to use for the weekend, offered to wash our towels, and overall great!

Nicole and Matt's place is full of fun decor and art. It's vibrant and inviting, which matches the neighborhood. There's so much to do nearby, and it was the perfect location for us. They were proactive and responsive and gave really clear instructions for check in and check out, along with some great recommendations for the neighborhood. Highly recommend!

If you’re wondering if you should book Kim’s spot, don’t even question it! This place is better than the pictures can even describe. First, Kim did us such a solid by allowing us to early check in which was such a big help. Her place was SPOTLESS! So clean and free of clutter! The first bedroom has an amazing two head shower that’s spectacular, the second bedroom has a closet that is top tier plus another bathroom just outside the room, but the best parts where the sky lights everywhere!! So cool when it rained but also the big projector on the wall really was a nice touch especially for music! There’s a GIANT mirror wall in the living room that’s awesome for group pics or selfies. Lastly the outside space is such a vibe especially with the hammock. As a side note, Kim is an absolute gem of a human. I lost my AirPods at the Airbnb, let her know and she took so much time looking around & when she found them she shipped them to me right away! So grateful for her & this wonderful stay! ❤️

We had a great experience here for a girls’ trip! About a mile walk to Wrigley and tons of restaurants, bars, coffee, public transport, etc easily accessible and walkable. The instructions for the house were clear and everything was accurate per the listing. Would definitely recommend!

Larry was an incredible host - really appreciated his thoughtfulness and flexibility with early check-in, parking, etc. His place was also lovely and perfect for a weekender to Chicago. My friends and I would love to stay at Larry's the next time we're in town!
Very clean place in a very nice area!

Simply a great place! Comfortable bed. Close to anything you need. Quiet neighborhood. One minute walk to public transport. On the blue line in 10-15 minutes. Great breakfast/brunch spot very close called 5800 North Cafe!

This place was a perfect getaway for my friends and I! We were in town for Lolla and to see Chicago sites but we actually spent more time hanging out in this place than we anticipated because of how cozy it was. Ivan was extremely communicative and responsive. We couldn’t have asked for a better host and place for our weekend!

This was a great place to stay. It was clean, well-appointed and had cool decor and overall vibe. A couple fun amenities were the turntable/records and board games. It's just a couple minutes to walk to the el station, which is an awesome feature as it makes it easy to get around the city. The neighborhood was very walkable and there are many cool bars, coffee shops and restaurants to experience. The hosts were very nice and proactive in their communication. They offered a lot of suggestions and all the directions were clear. Overall it was a top-notch stay!

We had a wonderful stay at Derek’s place. The house was spotless, well‑kept, and fully stocked with everything we needed throughout our trip. Derek was an incredibly responsive and thoughtful host — always ready to help if anything came up — and we genuinely enjoyed the great conversations we had with him. The neighborhood felt extremely safe, and there were plenty of public transportation options nearby, which made getting around very easy. Overall, Derek’s hospitality and the comfort of the home made our stay truly enjoyable.
Beautiful place in a beautiful area and right next to the pink line train which will take you anywhere!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! Cyan was extremely helpful and always responded quickly, and she really seemed to think of everything for the house. It's in a nice area with easy access to buses and is about a 20 minute walk away from the train station. The house itself was very clean, welcoming, and served our group well!

Mera is very responsive and friendly.  We really enjoyed our stay. Wrigley is about a 20 minute walk and everything else we needed was close by within walking distance.  Upon our arrival' we did have to report that the toilet seat was broken and the coffee pot was missing its lid.  This did not cause us any issues so we agreed to let her fix it after our stay. Would stay here again.
It was a great place to stay not too far from the city. Ed was super helpful and was a great host! Definitely felt super homey and safe and would stay here again!
Loved this place! Perfect for lollapalooza & Paul was so responsive and kind!
A very charming housing. Very close access to public transportation and it’s bang for your buck!
Literally couldn’t have loved our stay more. If this place is available, BOOK IT!!! We are already planning our next return to the city and this beautiful studio will be our top choice!
Just some spiders/spiderwebs which makes sense because it is in a basement. Otherwise, very cozy and clean. Comfortable, lots of space. Had all the supplies we needed and communicated well.
overall the stay i had was very nice! nothing went bad and nothing was out of the ordinary. would definitely recommend if you need a place in chicago!

We loved our stay at Bradford’s place. We were surprised at how big and inviting it was and we felt right at home. We enjoyed walking the neighborhood and had no problem walking to the train station about a 15 min walk away. The hot tub was an additional perk!

We visit Chicago all the time to visit family! Gabriel and Tina’s location was so convenient and close to everything we needed. They had wonderful recommendations it made it nice and easy for food selections.

Our stay with Sarah was so wonderful! The place was clean, comfortable and full of amenities. Sarah was very kind, communicative, and helpful during our stay. She gave us a ton of personalized recommendations for things to do and see in the area and provided a box of snacks to enjoy during our stay. She even held our luggage for us on our last day after check out. Overall, we 100% recommend staying here and would absolutely book it again!
Very responsive and clear instructions.

My friend and I needed a last minute place for Lollapalooza. While it was not right by Grant park, the location was great overall- near good food and very walkable.
The home is gorgeous and very artsy with eye catching pieces and cozy at the same time. We loved how massive and homey our room was with a smart TV, small heater for chilly nights which easily warmed up the room, and huge area rug to lounge on and relax. Such a beautiful home at a great price compared to hotels in the area. Thank you for a lovely stay!

excellent location! just around the corner from the blue line and many bus stops, but the apartment itself was quiet and we were unaffected by any traffic noise.
communication was clear and prompt during the whole process from booking to checkout. the host was very accommodating and allowed us to keep our bags at the apartment before and after checkout so we could enjoy maximize our outdoor time around our travel plans.
there were a few cosmetic and minor details that were a touch underwhelming, but my group booked this place for the location (great!!!) and sleeping accommodations. overall the place was clean, spacious, quiet, and safe. we spent most of our time exploring the city and we were more than happy with our stay.
Great location and great unit. Has everything you need and is near great spots in the city.

Really great guy, the best communication you can hope for to be honest.
The house is solid, there are three couches that are comfy and great tv. I can't speak for the bedrooms, I did not sleep in them.
The shower is good. The kitchen is okay, I think it's spacious. This is more about a comfort thing, it's comfort, it's not luxury and that's also why it's not expensive.
If you need somewhere to stay, this is good. If you get anxious, do not come here alone. There are occasional noises but nothing that will wake you up.
I do not trust walking out of this neighborhood, especially if you are alone. Please be careful taking the red line that's close.
I just Uber'd after trying the red line. But I also am an anxious person and unfortunately someone wanted to press me.
If you must, go in the daylight with somebody. But honestly the location is very cheap for Uber. $18-30 to get into town beats walking to the train and paying $5.
Brilliant location and great host. Would highly recommend.

To start with the positives, Darsh as a host is absolutely great. So friendly, replies really quick, and was quite helpful for our group. So that is a major plus.
Overall, the place is fine. The location was easy to get to downtown Chicago, so that was nice. And it’s on a quiet street, which was a bonus. We came for Lollapalooza and it was a convenient home base for that.
But I do think the space itself is somewhat lacking in person compared to pictures. It’s a bit basic and I think needs some updates to make it feel a little more high-end and comfortable. Had we spent more time in the space instead of out, it might have been less comfortable for our group
Nothing that isn’t fixable, so overall probably would stay here again for Lolla/non-vacation reasons.
Darius’s home is spacious and beautiful!

We had a great stay here for the weekend! The place was easy to find and close by the train so that made going into the city very convenient and quick. The room came exactly as described and was a comfortable place to stay. Also, Alle’s team was easy to reach out to and always responded to questions quickly.

Angela is an excellent host and pays very close attention to detail in terms of cleanliness and truly keeping a space neat and tidy. Very easy check in and a great location - next to excellent restaurants and very close to the red line station. Parking was a great bonus and we appreciated Angela checking in throughout our stay. The neighborhood is very quiet and peaceful. Recommend to anyone!

Although this is a vintage house—showing clear signs of its age—the interior is clean and tidy.
The host is incredibly responsible, replying to messages promptly and thoroughly. They also thoughtfully provided a generous assortment of fruit and snacks, making us feel right at home.
The location is excellent, offering convenient access whether traveling by public transport or car.
It is an ideal place to stay for a short visit to Chicago.

This place was well kept had a good shower and a comfortable bed there was enough space to workout and some weights were provided and I enjoyed that .The backyard was peaceful and big with nice morning sun and the neighbours were friendly and said hello . The neighbourhood was  on a quiet street and about a 20 min drive to downtown and the more happening areas of town . You Definitely need a car if you stay here and want to explore the trendy parts of town . Not much to do in this particular neighborhood but we got used to travelling into downtown and other neighborhoods for fun . The cost comparison to staying in the more desirable part of town is reflected in the price as this is a much more affordable option . Overall , if I had my car with me I’d definitely stay here again .

Great stay! Very safe. AMAZING Host!
Quick walk to the 55th Street Lake Front which gives direct access to beaches and walk/bike trails. Parking wasn’t too bad! I found spots rather quickly, even in front of the door. Front desk staff was welcoming and very nice, as were the other residents in the building.
The primary room can get a little warm. Just turn on the fan and close the bathroom door and turn on the AC in the guest room and then the primary bedroom will cool off. Very cool & comfy!
Beware of the tub! If you don’t put the mat down, you may slip and fall. I laid a hand towel in the tub because I’m allergic to rubber. Just hold on when getting in and out of the tub and lay something under your feet as you shower.
I plan to stay at Nicholas’ property when I return for work this fall.
Great, safe times with so much to do in walking distance!
Enjoy!

overall, this place is good to have if you just need a space to sleep on your trip.
it is similar to a hostel - one building with multiple rooms for multiple groups of people. host kept shared spaces clean every day (bathroom & kitchen). location was great - in a college town and very walkable to nearby stores/restaurants. it was about 1hr into the city/loop by the red line.
my only complaint is the loud squeaky floors. i had the room right by the front door and could hear every one go in, out, and around the floor. this will be rough for any one trying to sleep in as the cleaner comes early in the morning.
Clean spot in great location! Very responsive and clear instructions
Stephanie’s Airbnb was exactly as advertised and all went smoothly. Clean space, good views, good natural light. All good!
Everything was well done! Very ideal location, communication was clear and the apartment had everything I needed!
We loved our stay. The apartment had everything we needed and was very clean. Location was close to the subway station, which made travel in and around the city easy.

Scott’s couch house is the perfect little peaceful, homey, but spacious place to stay for a long weekend trip to chicago! Check in and check out were very easy due to the hosts friendliness. Very safe and walkable neighborhood close to public transport of all types and great parking situation. A friend and I stayed here for Lollapalooza and it was a great price for all of our needs! Would recommend staying here! 👍
First time in Chicago to attend a festival; the location was perfect! The amenities provided along with the free parking were great. Luke was super responsive and even offered a late checkout.
Lovely spot. Very quiet and cossy
Place is good, it's a hostel so it's a shared space but it's well kept it's good value for what you're paying. Carl is respectful and responsive, would definitely stay again
The place was nice and cozy, not far from the city and near the train if you wanted to leave or go into the city

Great location, plenty of space for our larger party of 8. Porch and patio spaces were awesome for hanging out.
The one thing worth noting is that the furnishing are somewhat spartan. Everything in the house was functional - we slept, ate, watched TV, got ready, showered, hung out - we were able to do everything we wanted, and the location was perfect for accessing two different train lines, getting downtown easily, and having some quiet and space when we needed it.
But the decor is nearly absent, and the furniture is far from luxe. If you're looking for a reasonably priced place in a great location to crash at night and handle your basic needs, this is the spot. If you're looking for a place to spend a lot of time, you might find other spots more comfortable and inviting.

Very cool, clean and comfortable apartment in a funky old building, right in the thick of Wicker Park. It’s a five-minute walk to the Damen Blue Line which goes to O’hare…a real benefit.
Despite being on Milwaukee Avenue, and above a pretty noisy bar, the apartment was quiet because it’s on the top floor in the rear of the building.
The mattress was a bit soft for my taste but I think most people would find it comfortable.
Overall, an excellent experience.

The description was extremely accurate and the private bedroom I had was pretty nice. Yes, the highway nearby is noisy but just bring earplugs & maybe melatonin and you’ll be fine. Will definitely be staying here again!
great location! definitely recommend!

Marcos was the perfect host. We had a last minute change and he was extremely accommodating.  I cannot recommend him enough. Very helpful and respectful. His place is in a very nice area. Everything was exactly as described. Would love to return.
Great place for exploring chicago!!!
Very friendly host, great communication, instructions were crystal clear and room and house were perfectly described in listing. Comfortable, quiet room to stay while I was in Chicago.

This was the perfect place for us to stay as we explored the city. Great proximity to the zoo, beach, farmers market, and east public transportation.  We appreciated all the kid-friendly features, which made being away from home with our toddler a breeze. Thank you!

Place was clean, bathroom could use some work. Bedrooms extremely small. Very difficult to find our first night and a nightmare to find parking. Had to move my car twice to make sure it didnt get towed. On the plus side it was a great neighborhood and convenient to the L to get around!!

The apartment was fantastic for my family of 4. Plenty of sleeping space, kitchen was well stocked, and bathroom was luxe. The location could not be beat, in the 5 nights we stayed there, we ate at a different delicious restaurant in the neighborhood each night, each with a kids menu and great grown up options too.
The blue “L” is only 5 minutes walk, but on that walk we had our choice of coffee shops, window shopping, and breakfast spots. If we turned right or left down any street there was vintage shopping, book stores, and restaurant choices galore.
Also, the Bloomingdale trail was about a 5 minute walk, perfect for a morning run or an easy afternoon stroll.
Highly recommend this location!

Demitri was very responsive and friendly any issues i had he was able to take care of quickly. The place looks just like the pictures and was walkable from any place i needed to go. Would definitely stay again!

Sholom’s place was perfect for our group! We would stay here again next time we visit Chicago! It’s fairly easy to get to the red line into the city which was huge for us. He also was very quick to answer our questions and communicate anything that came up regarding WiFi troubles that happened during our stay after a large storm.

Jorge was a great host, with a very fast response time. The place is nicely located; there is a bus pickup area within walking distance, and a small supermarket right in front of the building. The building itself is a bit smelly, but the room was clean and had a pleasant smell. Unfortunately, there is no AC in the main room...

Victor’s place was amazing for my Lolla trip, the location was great, a quick drive to anything I needed target, etc. and the Blue line. Space was great, there were others but they were cool. I would definitely recommend and stay here again for my next trip to Chicago. 💯
Patt was super helpful with a last minute stay and the room was great!
Amazing location for lollapalooza with my kids! The secure entry was easy to navigate. Plenty of space for our whole group! Definitely will be staying here again!
Nice place and nice area!
good place to stay if you will be out a lot, fit the description & good price.
Great distance to downtown! Very spacious and had everything we needed. We loved having available and secure parking for our car and Abacus was very responsive during the entire trip!
Great place
This was a great location! Great place to stay in when visiting Chicago!
Overall a great stay and everything listed was accurate. Host was attentive and ready to help with anything needed. Would recommend

David's place is amazing. It has easy bus stop and city access. The place is spacious and comfortable. Furniture is comfy. David was a great host: very responsive and clear with instructions. It was the perfect place for me and my friends to stay.
Super beautiful house!!
Fantastic location with a fantastic host. What more can you ask for?

The place was exactly what we needed it for! My boyfriend and I were in for the weekend and needed something near the rail/subway. The area is very walkable and has lots of shops nearby.
My only complaints would be getting the key from the main office was much more of a hassle than expected. It was not super clear that the key pick is and where the apartment is located are blocks away from each other.
The bed is also very uncomfortable. The mattress is very very thin that you can feel the bars underneath you. It really needs either a box spring or a higher quality mattress (ideally both.
Otherwise the place as great and communication was awesome! If the mattress got replaced we would totally stay again! Thanks so much :)
Andrew had a beautiful home in a great location. We really appreciated the patio in the back and all the board games and consoles he had to pass time with.

Great convenient location with easy parking. However, the property is an ADU accessed via an alleyway, which wasn't clear from the listing photos. We found a mess in the kitchen and while the host was quick to respond once we reported it, we also noticed several unaddressed maintenance issues. Considering the premium rate we paid during Lollapalooza week, the overall stay fell short of expectations for the price.
Good location and easy to get in. Never a problem with parking.
Would stay here again!! Patricia was very sweet and helpful, and not only was her place beautiful but so was the surrounding areas.

Jaime was a fantastic host, super responsive and helpful for any questions we had. As for the space whether you’re going around the city or for lolla this space is very comfortable and a perfect spot between O’hare and the city. Really close to transit and several metro lines(3-10 min). The Neighborhood is really pretty to walk around as well. Few restaurants that are walkable distance (6-10 min). Would come back again if we find ourselves in Chicago another time.

It’s a decent place but the location of it is horrible. High crime rate and our Uber’s were even telling us to be careful, and to not walk around. The power went out as well multiple times with even just the tv and shower on. There is a paper on the fridge saying not to use 3 amenities as the same time so we were being very mindful of that but the power still went out. The fridge, stove, and microwave didn’t work. If you reach out for any type of help, it’s a company so you have to wait for someone to reply. The beds were decent and if you don’t care about where you’re gonna stay then book here.

The listing photos reflected exactly what we got, and we appreciated Rafael’s and his team timely response to every question we had and also the recommendations given regarding plans and restaurants nearby. We visited for just a couple of days but felt right at home!
Stayed for Lolla weekend and couldn’t be more thankful for the space that Jay has provided. Clean, comfortable, safe, and in a great location. Will look to book again when we return.

This place was neat and cozy, and the area is quiet. Bernard is very friendly and responsive and answers questions as best as possible. I also felt safe in the neighborhood as it is a peaceful suburban area.
We loved our stay here! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Great location, easy check‑in, and a perfect home base for exploring Chicago. Would definitely stay again!

Tracy was an amazing host. The place was clean when we checked in, and she also left us some extra snacks and recommended various activities during our stay. She was also incredibly responsive and communicative. We accidentally got ourselves locked out during our stay and she came and helped us out. We thought the place was very accurate to its description and would definitely stay here again for a second visit.
Excellent location! Close to the train and walkable to a grocery store and local restaurants. Very flexible check in time and very responsive when we had questions about getting into the place.
Chill neighborhood, walkable, close walk to subway,  lots of natural lighting; bring an eye mask if sensitive.
Lovely neighborhood, felt very safe and comfortable walking around both day and night. Many great restaurants nearby. Enjoyed our stay!
We enjoyed our stay and Geo was a great host! Thank you.
Beautiful place in a beautiful neighborhood. We would stay again!
best place for lolla weekend!
Place was great! Erick is very nice and responsive, helped us with parking and gave us some great recommendations! Thank you again!

Milan was such an amazing host for our weekend in Chicago! He’s very attentive and responsive whenever I had questions or concerns. The Airbnb was exactly as pictured and was close to many food spots and train stations. I enjoyed my stay!
Spacious place, neighborhood was good - close to 606. Very friendly, communicative host!

I thought this was a great place! It was a good price and in a good location for Lollapalooza. My only complaint would be that there’s only one bathroom so sometimes it was hard to go when there’s other rooms also using it. Overall very happy with this place and would absolutely stay here again!
great stay!

Truly amazing weekend stay! The rooms are amazing with comfy beds and AC, with good space for luggage and clothes. The kitchen area is a great size with amenities. The location is amazing, just about a 3-4 minute walk to the train station to catch transit into different parts of town. This was a delightful stay for a great price that allowed me and my friends to come together and have an amazing trip. Highly recommend staying here when you visit Chicago!

Comfortable and welcoming home with endless amenities. Check in and check out directions are clear. Safe and beautiful neighborhood with easy access to CTA. Stayed with a couple other friends and didn’t feel kramped and were able to enjoy meals and free time in the unit. 10/10 all around.

I had a lovely time staying here! I stayed for Lolla, and was walking to and from the metra station at night and felt completely safe! The neighborhood was very nice, and the home itself was great as well!! The room was very spacious with great storage for extended stays, but worked just great for my short stay! I would definitely stay here again! 🫶
Wonderful place and neighborhood to stay! Dave is a great host and makes sure your stay is simple and easy!

Came for Lollapalooza— a naturally hectic week. Only a 10 minute walk to the CTA trains which were incredibly easy, Ubers and food delivery services found the location fairly easily too. The hosts were incredibly communicative, and while I did not really see anyone during my time there, I believe the host came by every day to help take out the trash so that the shared space was never cluttered.
The main shared space did not have functioning air conditioning, but it was no matter since my room had its own dedicated AC unit that really helped keep my room cool. The room was spacious enough for me to have two carry-ons open. Solid stay for someone who just needed a place to rest while being out majority of the day. Felt relatively safe for a woman traveling alone. :)
Great host, proactive, and had great recommendations for nearby. Had everything we needed and felt safe.
great place to stay in a great location. was perfect for our group and we were able to easily get anywhere we needed!
Great location, great space to stay for a few night. The host was great and it was a nice quiet area. We appreciate how close of a walk it was to the train station to get downtown. Thank you! A+

Stayed the weekend for Lollapalooza. Due to the convenience of the CTA transit, this was a fantastic stay! Easy to get around and safe area! Roberto was also a fantastic host, providing help and recommendations along the way! Would book again!!

Fantastic place to stay near Wrigley Field.  Very comfortable and clean.  Walking distance to fun restaurants, Lake Michigan (about 30 mins walk).  East access to public transportation to get all over the City.  Highly recommend and look forward to staying there again.  Very responsive hosts.
The place was clean and had everything stocked. Good location too!

This was a wonderful place to stay in Wicker Park! Easy walk to the blue line, and a lovely neighborhood too! The airbnb itself was gorgeous and had everything we needed! Beautiful place and we would stay here again!
We had a great stay here! The place accommodated our group well and we really enjoyed the short walks to nearby restaurants.

Tamara and Tony made my and my friend’s first trip to Chicago very memorable! The airbnb was exactly as pictured. Super cute and safe area to with lots of fun things to do nearby. We would highly recommend staying here!

No complaints whatsoever. Kenneth was such a kind and attentive host, even if we had additional questions he was always very helpful and quick to respond. The home was as described,  clean, and  very comfortable. We had a great time and hope to book again!
Solid option if you want something near transit. Fit our group nicely and had no issues.
Great location in a nice building.    Host  was super responsive, and it fit our needs perfectly!

Odi was such a great host and the house was exactly as described. The house was decorated beautifully and was very comfortable.
We had a wonderful stay and loved our visit to Chicago!
We had a great stay! The location was perfect & the apartment was nice & clean. Milan was very nice & responsive!

Really spacious house and a lovely, safe neighbourhood.
Very close to the blue line - great location.
Ron was super friendly and helpful !
I’d definitely recommend staying here as a group or family
Was a great place to stay!

Toy was a friendly host! We got to meet her and had a small chat! She was friendly and nice. The place and the washroom were very clean! Our four nights stay was really relaxing. Toy was also understandable to accommodate our needs. Overall, I will certainly choose the place to stay in Chicago again.
Amazing place for the price! The bathroom was great. Great place for lolla
Great location! Would definitely recommend and stay again!

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb. The location was excellent—right in downtown Chicago with easy access to restaurants, attractions, and public transportation. The apartment was very clean, well maintained, and exactly as described. The host was also incredibly responsive, answering our questions quickly and making the entire experience smooth from check-in to check-out. We would happily stay here again on a future trip to Chicago.
Good communication with host, bus stop nearby is very convenient

I stayed  here before  my sister and I.  Adam was very nice and very accommodating. The place is nice and clean. He offered snacks tea and coffee. The  location is safe. This place will be my go to every time, if it’s available….
The location was very convenient and made it easy to get around.
friendly & responsive host! Home was clean and looked just like the photos! Will definitely think about booking here again!😊

What an amazing stay! Gabriela was super friendly and accommodating for our needs! Our flight got in earlier than expected and she let us check in early! Checked in with us asking if we needed anything a few days into our stay as well! The unit was relatively clean and super cozy, and a great place to unwind after the days out exploring.
Great location and very comfortable accommodation. Hosts were responsive and everything went well from start to finish.

Was in town for Lollapalooza and loved this location. Easy to get to the festival grounds via car or train. Great area, nice restaurants, cute shops. Would stay here again. Easy communication. Thanks!

Marije’s place was exactly as described, she communicated efficiently with us when we needed to reach out, and the location was great, especially if you’re looking to get to wrigley or hop on the train.

Angie, is a nice Host always responds messages quickly.
Pros:
**Beds are very comfortable.
**Safe neighborhood.
**20 minutes from Grant Park
**Accessible price in comparison with other
Cons:
** Find parking available can take a bit
** Small to fit more than 3 people, if using only to go to sleep is ok. We were 5
Overall a good balance between value and amenities

For the extremely high cost we paid we expected more - the noise issues kept everyone awake most nights (neighbour noise, squeaky floorboards, no insulation). Otherwise the place was clean and spacious and has everything you could need.
amazing stay during lollapalooza. shay answered any questions we had and made sure we enjoyed our stay
Amazing place to stay loved location of this Airbnb would 100% Stay again !!
Todo estupendo 100% recomendable

My group and I loved staying here. It was so spacious, clean, and had everything we needed! The bedrooms were big, the living room space was perfect for our movie nights, and I loved all the snacks that Roxy left for us! I LOVED that the main bedroom had its own bathroom. The space felt like home but luxurious at the same time! My only slight concern (I promise it wasn’t THAT big of a deal, I grew up in NYC so I was able to adjust lol) was the neighborhood at nighttime. We heavily relied on public transportation for 80% of our time in Chicago, but we didn’t feel safe taking it during the night. Other than that, I still LOVED staying here, I felt safe inside the space and we ubered when necessary. Roxy, thank you for your kindness, hospitality, recommendations, and all your help. You were so kind and we are so thankful you gave us your space for our trip! ❤️

5 stars very deserved!
Very safe neighborhood, short walk to the Metra station and great responsive hosts. Will def come back in the future!

Very satisfied with my stay, came for Lollapalooza and it was perfect to take the 126 bus the way there and back (only a 3 min walk to the stop), we had our own room with shared bathrooms but they where almost never both taken, almost everyone there also was going to Lollapalooza and was very nice and friendly, Jennifer the amazing woman staying at the house as a staff was so incredibly kind, making sure all shared spaces where clean and comfortable, she even put up a extra curtain in my room for more comfort. Overall would come here again for my stay!
Super organized and easy to follow instructions. The hosts respond quickly to messages and are warm and friendly.
The location is very nice and the perfect distance from everything you need in Chicago. The neighborhood is friendly and the house is beautiful on the inside. Couldn’t ask for anything more!
Raghu’s place was great! We had a large group and it was so spacious and a lot of bathrooms. We would definitely recommend staying there and enjoyed our stay!

Iris' apartment is beautiful, clean, spacious, and a quick walk or bike ride away from Buck Town. The beds are super comfy to crash on. The area was quiet and private-feeling while still having places to eat nearby.
Although instructions to get in were a little confusing, Iris was very responsive and always available. She was able to resolve questions very quickly. Would definitely love to stay with her again!
I really enjoyed my stay, Sujata and Brian were absolutely wonderful host! I would 100% stay here again. The location was very walk able for restaurants,coffee shops, and the bus/train stations.
Nice location and very responsive host!
She was a great host and it was a very clean place to stay.

Stayed for Lollapalooza - although near the Red Line it still took about 20 minutes to walk and with luggage even more.
NOT MANY AMENITIES IN THE AREA - it was a dead zone for coffee shops, grocery stores, bars and the like. A couple italian / chinese restaurants in walking distance but took about 20 minutes still.
Place was good - but if you go for Lolla, so is everyone else and you may be waiting a while for the one restroom in a place with four room with potentially up to 8 guests.
Also very quiet inside you can hear other people. Small room too, although we didn’t stay in it much. Great host though, very responsive. Clean rooms and restroom. Wish there were paper towels in the kitchen or more than one towel for the bathroom.
Would likely find somewhere closer for lollapalooza but it was one of the cheaper places and got the job done.

Felt really comfortable here, felt like a cozy small home for the weekend. Whenever there was any issue or anything I needed, she helped me within the hour, clean beds, bathroom, and kitchen. Would recommend to anyone

Great location, reasonably close to Grant Park so rideshare options were affordable to our event. Spacious and clean house. Host was very responsive and even helped us locate a package that was delivered a week prior. When arriving, we found that one of the beds was broken, the towels were still damp and the upstairs sink was clogged. The hot water was also limited and ran out but we did have a large group. We feel these issues are minor and very fixable. Therefore, overall, we enjoyed our stay and would book again!

Milen's place was a great spot for our visit! It's located in a great spot near plenty of activities. The living space was very clean overall. It's also in a very quiet location - we didn't hear anybody else during our stay and felt like we kept our privacy

My friends and I overall enjoyed our stay. While a little cramped for 4 people, it got the job done! Our stay could have been better with a blanket/comforter for the pull out couch, more utensils or kitchen pots/pans, or more reliable AC. The property itself is very well maintained and in a very quiet neighborhood.

Matt and Nicole‘s is a great location for visiting Chicago
So many things to do,
so close to everything,
And such lovely accommodations.
You will enjoy your trip
Thank you, Matt and Nicole
We had a nice stay here.
The listing was exactly as described. Amazing location and walkable to many things. Super responsive and great communication. I would definitely book again!
Stayed there as a group of 12 for lollapalooza! So much space for all of us and such a great host! Would stay again next year

We loved our stay here! We were out for the majority of each day and their spare room was all we needed to accommodate our trip. Sleeping was comfortable and the bathroom was spacious, and we loved seeing their cats greet us on our returns in the evenings! Very close to the metro and great restaurants nearby (Homeslice and Foxtrot were favorites). Definitely recommend their place if you need something simple and easy. Jennifer was a great host and very communicative as well - overall great experience!

Super helpful and responsive. The keypads on the restroom and bedroom made me feel like my belongings were safe when I wasn’t there. Never saw any of the other guests that were staying there. Would definitely recommend as a solo woman traveling.
Great location, and very clean!

My friend and I stayed for Lolla which left the city very overpriced with little options. Jeffrey's place was affordable and still in a great location accessible to train/bus lines and easy ride-shares to get to the festival or anywhere else in the city. Always felt safe and very close to great restaurants.
While simplistic, Jeffrey's place had everything you needed for a great stay where you plan to be out in the city anyways. Everything was very clean, heat and air kept the place at a comfortable temperature, and then bathroom and kitchen had everything you needed for a general stay.
Jeffrey was very communicative throughout our entire stay and helped navigate luggage storage for us.
The ceilings can be a little low if you are over 6ft and there's not a lot of natural light, but again a perfect place when you plan to be adventuring out.

Location is great! You can reach a major train line within a 10-minute walk. The neighborhood feels safe, even late at night. There are also plenty of restaurants and places to eat nearby. The place is exactly as described, and even though there are shared spaces, they were always clean. Aaron and his team were very responsive and regularly checked in to make sure everything was okay.

Great place overall! Host was very responsive. Upon arrival, we were missing some towels and blankets but they quickly accommodated. Great place to stay, near the city and great food options. My group enjoyed our stay here, other than the mishap with the missing towels/blankets - but again, host was very responsive and quick to accommodate.
Ming is amazing. She’s very accommodating and the place is amazing. It’s a very close walk to the train station (pink line) I would recommend this place
Cozy home 25 minutes from downtown chicago! Ryan was very friendly and responsive when we had any issues.
Place was amazing,awesome views
在这里的这三天我很开心，因为我得到了充足的睡眠，这里提供的设施和服务也特别好，让我有种在家的感觉！室友也特别赞。总而言之这是一次很完美的入住体验，希望明年我还可以在这里度过一段开心的夏日时光！最后感谢你们给予的支持与帮助！
Great place to stay for a weekend. Easy access to the train. Very accessible to the city.
Really cozy and welcoming apartment in a great location

This place is not as advertised. It was dirty upon arrival there was a leftover drink in the fridge that spilled and was on the floor causing it to be sticky. The couch, closet door and bed were broken. The shower had one door which caused water to flood the bathroom when someone would shower, so we had to buy our own towels to soak up the water. The water also went in and out at times which made us have no water. There were stains on the sheets and it was overall not worth the money at all. I didn’t feel safe the first door you enter is broken and the handle was falling off. Paid for parking but our vehicle was not safe from neighbors.

Incredible place with a very nice and responsive host, in a great area and for a great price given the location and the time of year! Only critique is that we weren’t told which specific apartment to go to inside the building and had to figure that out ourselves, but otherwise it was a perfect stay!

We had a fantastic stay at Anthony's place. Great base for seeing the whole city, only one block from the blue line and Logan Square is a short walk. The space is cozy and private on a well trafficked but quiet residential street. I traveled with my daughter who took the bedroom but the couch is comfortable as a second bed. I would certainly return.
Lovely host who was very accommodating and had such a cute place for us to stay in !
A nice play to stay and it looked exactly the pictures
Great value and really an unbeatable location in a quiet section of Bucktown. Paul was also kind enough to accommodate a very early check in.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I had an absolutely amazing stay! Everything exceeded my expectations from start to finish. Carl was an incredible host—very friendly, extremely responsive, and always quick to answer any questions, which made the entire experience so easy and stress-free.
The location was perfect, with supermarkets, and everything else you might need just minutes away. It couldn’t have been more convenient.
The Airbnb itself was beautiful, modern, and felt very luxurious. The bedrooms were spacious and comfortable, the bathrooms were spotless, and the kitchen had everything we needed. Everything worked perfectly, and the entire place was quiet, peaceful, and incredibly well maintained.
This trip was extra special because I came for Lollapalooza, and staying here made the whole weekend even more unforgettable. I truly had an incredible time, and I’ll always remember this experience.
I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area, and I would absolutely love to come back next

We had a great time here. The space is clean, quiet and beautiful. Great location, just a short walk from the blue line making it easy to get to/from downtown and the airport. It was also equipped with everything we could have needed during our stay. Highly recommend!
This was the perfect place to stay for our weekend trip in Chicago! It was beautiful and clean! Mary answered any questions we had and was very accommodating.
we greatly enjoyed our stay here—the airbnb was a perfect location for enjoying lollapalooza
Very nice and clean place.
Wonderful place. Beds were comfortable, very clean, easy access to Logan Square.

Great stay - very responsive host and unit is well appointed with everything you would need. Private balcony is great, easy to get in the unit and garage parking was super convenient. The location is also nice as you’re close to the highway but also close to local neighborhood spots. Would highly recommend and stay again any time.
Craig was an amazing host! We were somewhat of a needy group, and he was more than accommodating. He was the most responsive host I have ever had
Ervin was an awesome host! Any issues that came up were addressed quickly and we had a great stay!

Darren's place was nice, basically as advertised. He was quite responsive, the trickiest thing was figuring out street parking which he did have permit stickers for, but would have been nice to know beforehand. The location is amazing with the subway being so close!

Absolute best stay I’ve ever had!!! Tom was the most amazing host with fantastic hospitality. The place was spotless when we arrived and Tom made us feel extra at home. Area is beautiful with food and activities close. I would absolutely recommend Tom’s place to whoever is visiting the city. We hope to be back again ❤️

I liked the price of the place especially during festival season. The room was very comfortable and clean. I liked that it was only one block away from the train, so I had no transportation issues. Whenever I had questions, she was very quick to respond.
Jane’s place was fantastic. The location was perfect, and I would absolutely stay there again the next time I’m in Chicago if it’s available.

Very good stay overall. The location is very close to public transportation so travel is very easy from here. It is walking distance to Grant Park. The elevator and door have unique passwords so I felt my stuff was very secure while we were out. Something to note is that the window overlooks a busy street and subway track, so you'll probably want to lower the blinds to the bedroom if you change in there. It was a noisy location in the city, but there was a sound machine provided which was nice. The bathroom door did not lock though, but I stayed with someone trusted so it wasn't an issue. It was a bit odd though.

Wow, our new favorite place. Super clean, super comfortable. We stayed here for Lollapalooza, and it was a haven to come home to at night. Such a peaceful neighborhood, great restaurants. And, Ashley was a fabulous host. We felt right at home.
Although I do believe it was extremely pricey, the place was very well kept and very nice! Would stay again.
Helen was a wonderful and friendly host. All amenities listed were provided. I had an amazing stay here

Talie was incredibly helpful and proactive during the booking process. During our stay, he was quick to respond to questions and requests. The place was clean and worked perfect for our large group’s stay. Being close to public transportation and the green line was really helpful when traveling into the city. Seamless experience overall!

I cannot express enough how terrible this trip was for my family and I. We felt incredibly unsafe every single night, hearing gunshots at the house next door, and when we go to check that all the doors and windows are closed, we find out that the windows in the living room don’t even close. The house looks nothing like the photos. There is dust everywhere, spiders in virtually every corner, towels in the bathroom not even cleaned properly from prior guest, lint left in the washer and dryer. The host had to explain to us how to fix the breaker, which every time we would plug in the hair dryer and a phone charger in the rooms, the power would go out in a floor of the house. And lastly, the bathrooms are inoperable. The upstairs bathtub floods, the middle floor shower is slippery and the downstairs bathroom flooded entirely. I would not recommend anyone to bring their family here.
This place was perfect for a quick trip to see a concert in Chicago!

My group and I absolutely loved our stay at the oasis! Very welcoming home and environment, we felt truly right at place. Located in a great distance to many attractions, parks, and overall easy access to the city. Above all Sherry was very welcoming to us, great communication and accommodation. A trip to remember!
Thank you kindly for all of your assistance!! Loved the space :)

⭐⭐⭐⭐ ⭐️ We had a wonderful stay! The hosts were incredibly kind, welcoming, and responsive throughout our trip. The room was exactly as described, very clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Even though it was a shared space, it was quiet, respectful, and we felt completely comfortable the entire time.
Check-in and check-out were both smooth and easy, and the communication was excellent from start to finish. The location was also great for getting to Lollapalooza and exploring Chicago.
We had absolutely no issues during our stay and would definitely book here again if we come back for Lollapalooza next year. Thank you again for your hospitality, we truly appreciated it! 😊
Beautiful home in a great location for our family.  Nice updates along with the private backyard. Would definitely stay again.
It was a great experience!!! Very close to brown line and there are some food places which opens 24 hrs.
Erin’s place was spacious, clean, and in a great location. It had everything we needed for our short stay, and Erin was very communicative and friendly.

The place was really nice and clean!
Had a bathroom on every level which was nice when someone else was in the bathroom. Kitchen had things to cook with and the area was really nice!
Great place to stay. Looked exactly like the photos and there were plenty of stores to walk to.  Wasn’t noisy and had towels, pots, pans, blankets and everything you could need. Definitely recommend

Zoë was a super responsive and pleasant host! The space was very clean and had pretty much everything we needed. It was also very close to a grocery store and a few restaurants! The only downside was that some of the ceilings are a little low so I did bump my head a few times, but it nonetheless accommodated our stay for Lollapalooza!

My stay here was magnificent, I really enjoyed that I was able to walk to do the things I wanted/needed. It was a comfortable home and photos matched. The neighborhood felt safe and If I ever come back, I would stay here again.
Great place and Jevaux was very responsive and friendly. Would book again.

Great location, really enjoyed our stay! Check-in instructions were very clear and helpful, and the unit was just as described. Close to public transit, so it’s really easy to get pretty much anywhere you want to go. Parking can be a challenge as described in the listing, but the neighborhood is very walkable (easy walk to the lake!), and there are usually spots where you can park temporarily to unload luggage. Highly recommend this place.

Our stay here was fabulous! The hosts were very responsive and helpful. Check in and out process was super easy. Only difficulty was locating the correct discounted parking lot. The location is great and there are many local restaurants in walkable distance. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. Two of the bedrooms were smaller than expected but not a big deal since we weren’t in the rooms most of the time. Overall an amazing stay!!

Great space to stay and get things in order good atmosphere to to continue to have a great time while there and after the other guest were great quiet and respectful really would book again lol I tried it was already booked so it goes pretty fast

We had a great time at Kenya’s place. The pictures don’t do it justice, a lot more house than expected. Everything went swimmingly from checkin to checkout. Would definitely recommend and look forward to returning!
A great place and easy access to the amazing train system in Chicago

Amazing! Amazing! It was well decorated, super clean. Kyrylo was very communicative throughout our stay. Everything was thoughtful. Location is great 20 mins drive to downtown. Quiet neighborhood. Definitely will stay again in my next week.

Bridget was lovely, very accommodating in our stay and always very responsive and went out her way for us, we appreciated the place and it was adorable, location is great with the station just about a 10 min walk with a CVS & Gangnam Market just there too, lovely pizza joint across the street, all in all we came for Lollapalooza but probably will be back to stay here again 🤟
Ideal location, and safe and secure home. Nice, modern, and very clean and ideal home
Vin was very friendly and hosted us in a cozy apartment for our Chicago stay. Would stay here again
Amazing place to stay at when visiting chicago
Nice place to stay in Chicago!
Perfect location for our weekend in Chicago! Close to everything and was everything we needed
The place was great!
Very happy with our stay!

Felice was a terrific host, very friendly and easy to communicate with. The space is really nice too, it spans the entire floor and feels very spacious, located on a quiet street within a 5-10min walk to grocery stores or L stops. Would highly recommend!
Nora was extremely helpful with getting an early check-in for my stay. The home is exactly what we needed, just down the street from the brown line. A great place and a very helpful host!

We had such a wonderful stay here! The Airbnb is in such a walkable area, about an 8ish minute walk to the Belmont train station, lots of restaurants and cute cafés! The Airbnb itself was super accessible, clean, and the perfect space for two people. I would not recommend if you are over 5’4” because the room is a renovated attic space so the ceilings are slanted. We are both 5’4 & under and we definitely bumped our heads a couple times. We stayed in the middle of summer and can definitely say the AC works very well, it’s right next to the bed so we stayed cool all night. The bed is so incredibly comfortable and the space was exactly what we needed. The host was also very accommodating, our flight landed early and we were able to drop off our luggage which was super appreciated. The price point was also perfectly reasonable for the space and location. Would definitely stay again!
cute and felt safe. Doors were kind of hard to open, but overall it was fine. close to a lot of things! (:

This was an excellent place to stay for a weekend trip! The apartment was very clean, decorated nicely, and we had no issues! We would often come back late and could always find parking within 2-3 blocks and a quick walking distance. The host was very kind and responsive.
10/10! Hanna was able to accommodate me last minute! Stores and food within walking distance! Quiet neighborhood! Easy check in! Thank you again so much!
Fantastic host and everything was perfect definitely booking again

Loved staying here! The place was clean, cozy, and had such a cute aesthetic. The location in Wicker Park was perfect too! lots of great food, coffee, and things to do nearby. Would definitely stay here again!

great place to have a private parking in Chicago although the spot is tiny for my minivan and it is adjacent to the wall which makes it challenging to park. Place is spacious. Stairs to the unit on 3rd floor are steep. Jay is helpful and responsive.

I had an amazing stay at Ashley's airbnb! She is a highly responsive and accommodating host! The suite was exactly as pictured and described, very clean, close to public transit, & is in a quiet neighborhood 🏡. 10/10, highly recommend!
In a quiet neighborhood. Newly updated
I really enjoyed my stay at Rida’s place ! I felt right at home and the check-in/checkout process was seamless! The bus stop was right outside the building which made commuting so easy!
We enjoyed our stay. Everything we needed was really close to us. We didnt have any issues with anything and overall had a great time while staying here.
We stayed here for Lolla 2026. Amazing stay for groups of 4-5. Host was extremely helpful and responsive.

We had a great stay in Chicago. The Airbnb was very spacious. It was in a very walkable location and close to public transit, restaurants, and grocery stores. Host was very helpful and prompt in responding.
The house was clean! It had ac, a must. There was plenty of street parking available, and it had extra towels!
Incredible location, beautiful space, and would definition book this again for a large group visiting Chicago.

We had a great stay. There is plenty to do nearby and the blue line is a short walk away. We stayed for Lollapalooza so we didn’t get to explore the neighborhood a ton but we saw lots of cute shops, bars, and restaurants. The rooms looked exactly like the pictures. I was worried about it being warm since previous comments mentioned that but there were fans in a closet and a dehumidifier provided if needed. The stairs are only blocked off by sheets and a divider but we had no issues. Just adding in case anyone was curious.
Had a great stay! The place was clean and very close to downtown. Would stay here again!

We had an amazing stay! Everything was beautifully decorated, well-maintained, and, most importantly, spotlessly clean. As someone who is very particular about cleanliness, that immediately stood out to me and made me feel comfortable from the moment we arrived.
The host was also incredibly proactive, checking in to make sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay. That level of hospitality did not go unnoticed and truly made the experience even better.
I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, affordable, and welcoming place to stay. Thank you again for your wonderful hospitality Nae! We would absolutely stay here again!
Great stay.
Was a nice stay.
Mary is an excellent host and communicates exceptionally fast and well. I felt comfortable in my space. The walkability of the area wasn’t the best, but doable. Overall enjoyed my stay!

Owner/mgr was responsive and friendly. Place was clean and exactly as described. Beds are comfortable and the area is QUIET for being so close to everything may want to do in chicago. We took the blue line everyday to the city- so easy. We walked to the local grocery store and coffee shops. I will definitely stay here again. Thanks for a great stay!

We absolutely loved the location of this apartment. It was walkable to almost everything we wanted to do, and the neighborhood felt very safe. We had some trouble getting into the building because the check in instructions didn’t mention that you needed to hit # after inputting the door code. The host sent us a different code (which ended up not working - even with the # sign), but we eventually figured it out. The other issue was that the bathroom floor hadn’t been cleaned. There were long black hairs on the floor and a pair of dirty socks under the radiator. Otherwise, we had a good stay. The apartment had everything we needed and the bed was comfortable. The building was old and charming and we loved the vintage elevators!

Gosh I loved everything about our stay! I would definitely stay again! It was a daily dopamine boost! Everything was so bright and fun & great for pictures. The bed was so comfortable, a little high if you are a shorty like me. There was GOOD shampoo and body wash there. Any supply I could have needed, they already had.
I loved that you could take a public bus 2 blocks away and the public transportation could take you anywhere in the city. There’s so much to do in Chicago.
Only a few blocks from the White Sox stadium.
Street parking, but they did give me a ticket during the white Sox game. There was a parking pass inside a book, but I didn’t realize I needed to put it in my car. I thought it was a souvenir or part of decor. I wish that was included in check in instructions.
If you don’t like pets or the sound of them upstairs then this isn’t the place for you. Sometimes they woke us up between 6-7am. But we love animals and this home was perfect for us & I wish we brought ours.
Tara's place was great! Would highly recommend.
This was an amazing stay

8 of us stay here, plenty of room for everybody, maybe a little tight on bathrooms but it all worked out. The area is a little tough but we felt very safe once on the property and the train station is right across the street which made it very easy to get to downtown and Wrigley! The outdoor area was very nice, clean and useful. Would definitely book again!

Great newly renovated walk-up 3rd floor apartment in a mostly residential neighborhood with some restaurants a relatively close walk away. The location is a bit far from downtown (roughly just under an hour drive and an hour and a half on public transit after walking 20min or taking a bus to the train station). The neighborhood is very peaceful though.
Had a wonderful stay here. Everything was as described and communication couldn’t be better. Thank you!
Very kind hosts! They let us drop our bags off a little before check-in which was very helpful.
What a great experience! The host was so helpful and accommodating! Thoughtful and super responsive! Lovely space (bed is so comfy) & easily walkable to great spots!
Great stay, the host was very friendly and was quick to respond! Highly recommend if you’re visiting Chicago, would definitely come again.
All went well. Host was very responsive

Such a great find!
My girlfriend and I highly recommend Dorian’s listing. He was very kind and helpful. We have never been to Chicago before and he had lots of recommendations of what to do and where to go. Very safe walk from and to the train station, and very short ride to Grant Park. We will for sure be returning to Dorian’s place when we come back!

Gina’s place was spacious and comfortable! So close to public transportation and lots of restaurants & shops close by. I definitely recommend and would like to come back to stay here for a future trip!
Convenient to CTA rail just a 5 minute walk. Place was clean, felt safe and everything worked out smoothly.

GREAT spot! The apartment was gorgeous and very functionally laid out for our reunion - big enough to share meals and down time together, and also close to all of the Chicago highlights we wanted to hit. The host was responsive and flexible. Highly recommend!

First of all, the check-in time was supposed to be 3:30 PM, but the host messaged me at the last minute saying it would be delayed by 30 minutes due to cleaning. When I asked if I could at least drop off my luggage because I already had other plans, I was told that I couldn’t. As a result, I had to spend an additional $100 in total on Uber rides and luggage storage, which was extremely frustrating and inconvenient.The apartment is also located on the 4th floor with NO ELEVATOR, which was not ideal, especially when carrying luggage. In addition, the building reeks of cigarette smoke, even though it clearly states that smoking is prohibited. It appears that this rule is not being enforced at all.I also have to mention that the LISTING PHOTO appear to have been heavily EDITED or enhanced with AI. The apartment looks much older and less appealing in person than it does in the photos, which made the listing feel misleading.
Overall, this stay was NOT WORTH the amount I paid.
Good stay
We enjoyed our stay and definitely felt it was worth the price.
Great place to stay! Train is super close, quiet neighborhood and super spacious apartment!

Great location and clean place to sleep!
My friends and I came to Chicago for lollapalooza and Jody’s place was the perfect place for us!!
Very nice and spacious place! Amir was very kind and accommodating.
Wonderful stay, Vin was on top of everything and responded quickly! Everything was in walking distance from our stay along with bus and train stations within close proximity of our stay!

fairly priced and super close to the bus that takes you directly to downtown chicago which was perfect for our group that visited for lollapalooza. the host was incredibly friendly and responsive — it was raining hard in chicago so there was a leak from the roof, but thankfully freddy promptly took action and was kind as to deliver us a bucket & mop. main reason for the 4 stars was because the bathroom (especially the shower/tub) was not as clean as shown in the pictures and the tub does not drain water well. otherwise the house is kept tidy and had everything we needed! :)

The place was extremely clean, and the location was excellent for both getting to and returning from Grant Park. In addition, Alle was incredibly attentive and responded very quickly at all times, which was a huge help. The place also had all the amenities we needed, making our stay comfortable and enjoyable.

We had such a good time with Alexandra! She was so sweet and gave us recommendations. We were there for the festival and she gave us tons of things like fans and electrolytes which was so sweet! The place was very comfortable and a good distance away from the city. Parking is a bit sparse but for the duration of our stay, we were able to find easy parking around!
Fantastic location and a lovely room in a quaint art gallery. Super host.

Sara’s place was clean and roomy. Both beds were very comfy. The location was good, it is very close to the red line. Felt safe. However, there is only one mirror in the suite which was hard with three girls haha, other than that it was a great place to stay!
Great host, and flexible to change of plans!
Milan was a great host
We stayed for the August long weekend and Noemi’s Airbnb had everything we needed! The area is also very quiet and felt safe.
Very nice and comfortable place to stay, nearly close to the CTA walking
It was a great stay

Host was very communicative. AC worked great. Back deck was nice. Beds were very comfy.
Neighborhood was a bit sketchy at night, lots of people on sidewalk, police activity, but walking in a group or during the day was fine. Kitchen supplies looked like they were picked up from a yard sale. Only 1 large pan made cooking breakfast for our group difficult. Only 8 forks and 8 spoons so you have to wash them after every meal.

Great location for a large group in Logan Square. This place was perfect for our group who came in for a wedding and offered plenty of space. Despite being more of a condo/apartment, we never felt on top of each other or lacking in space. The amenities were exactly as listed and the beds were so comfy! Would definitely recommend for large groups wanting to be in the city!

Loved our stay at this Airbnb! Alexis was very friendly, responsive, and flexible to early check ins and later check outs. All amenities listed were provided and the drive to downtown was not far at all!  Would stay again!
Clean, spacious, and convenient — just steps away from the train. It was the perfect place while we enjoyed the music festival.
It was easy to follow and host was responsive!

We stayed here for lolla and it was a great location because we were right next to the train station and can take blue line to downtown for very cheap. Apartment was clean and spacious. The beds were comfy and location was safe. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone!

Our stay here for five nights was really nice and everything went well. The view was amazing, and both the couch and bed were very comfortable. It was a bit hard and confusing to find parking, but we were able to find one after driving around for a few minutes which we had to pay for.
Just like other reviews mentioned, there are a lot of stairs which we expected but underestimated. Climbing up those stairs everyday was no easy feet.
The only issue we had was the lack of a room divider when we checked in. I believe the host should have let us know ahead of time that it had been damaged rather than waiting for us to reach out about it and ask for a replacement. We do appreciate that he quickly took care of it the next day and even provided us with shampoo and other necessities that he usually doesn’t provide as amenities.
All in all, it was a great stay and we enjoyed our time here!

We really enjoyed our long weekend at Steve’s place. He is an awesome host, so friendly and willing to share good ideas on what to do while in Chicago. The neighbourhood is outstanding. Lincoln Park is such a beautiful and fun place to stay while visiting the city. Safe neighbourhood with easy access to the train for getting to Wrigley Park or to the Loop. Highly recommend.

We could not have picked a better place for our Lollapalooza weekend. The location was literally just a few blocks away, it was located on the red line which made getting everywhere very convenient, and there were places to grab food located very close. The train passing by does take some getting used to, but it really isn’t that bad. We would definitely rent this again in the future.
Mary’s place was perfect for what we needed during our visit to Chicago. She was very responsive and helpful, and the place was great value.
The space was beautiful and perfect for our stay. The location was the best part , super walkable to anything you might need and a 15-20min drive to pretty much any other major areas of the city.

To start: Tessa was a wonderful host! She responded quickly, and was active in helping us even at times where she had no reason to (midnight & later).
The place is also a cute, spacious apartment that I could easily find myself staying for longer if given the chance. The rooms were filled with all listed amenities and more, and it felt like we were free to use the place as we wished.
However, there are a few things I want to note. There were a few structural issues (creaky floors, inconsistent door frames that made closing bedroom doors difficult, and a strange toilet placement) that are in no way the host’s fault, just things I feel are important to know.
Lastly, the main entrance has a keypad that requires a code, which worked fine the first night, but had issues the following nights we stayed. Again, these issues are not entirely the host’s fault, especially since she fixed it by the tail-end of the trip. It simply made some parts of a group trip a little harder.
4/5 Stars!

A very beautiful home, very clean and put together. Decorated well and in a great location. Was worried about there being no a/c but the a/c unit in the windows was just enough. Only downside was we weren’t able to use the two showers at the same time so that was a let down but other than that our stay was great!
Natalie was an awesome host. We have never had a host as involved as she is! She bought vinyls for us to listen to from our favorite Lollapalooza artists! You should stay here. It’s amazing.

If you are going to Wrigley Field this is the best location ever!  Practically next door!  And about 1.5 miles from Lake Michigan. If you’re a Cubs fan the space is super charming,  all decked out with Cubs decorations.  Nice and clean, plenty spacious for four and a great host - a pleasure to chat with and responsive.  We would definitely stay here again for a Cubs game!
Fit all our needs. I would stay again.

Yolie's place in Wicker Park was the perfect spot for our family of four while visiting Chicago. The space is much larger than the photos imply and the layout is great. Location couldn't be much better; shopping, restaurants, parks, the train, it's all right outside the door. Beds were comfortable and made with nice linens, bathrooms were clean and stocked with toiletries, the kitchen was stocked with ample coffee and supplies so you could eat in if you wanted to. Some folks mention the noise. Yes, you're on the main street of a busy neighborhood and it is full of city sounds, but as a light sleeper, I found my earplugs and an eye mask did the trick. The primary bedroom is the only one right off the street, the other two rooms were a bit removed from the sounds and streetlights. The train, while literally out the back door, wasn't as loud as I thought it would be and you can't feel it at all. Yolie was awesome at communication and so friendly. We would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay and will be back! Nice to have a doorman and elevator direct to our unit.  Lots of space and the outdoor terrace was an added bonus.  Able to walk to many attractions and Target / groceries very close. 10/10 recommend!
