We very much enjoyed staying at Terry’s! For us it was perfect, right in the middle River North near many bars and restaurants. The place was clean, spacious, and had everything we needed. Be aware that you are booking in a social district, it is loud late at night:)
Okay- we had some problems but the location was great.
Great place & great location! It was a great home base for lollapalooza! Super spacious for 4 people!

This was a good place to stay! Very close to the CTA, which made it easy to get around. It was also near an Aldi, which was convenient. The only thing wrong is that it needs a little touching up and maintenance, other than that it was a good time.

Great apartment in a great location! Very clean and walkable part in Hyde Park - Trader Joe’s & Walgreens 1 block away. Jhon was very accommodating and friendly. Would definitely recommend and stay again.

We loved our stay at Nicole and Matt’s place! The location is amazing - It’s a quick walk away from the subway station which was such a plus for us. Their space is very clean and we loved having in unit washer dryer during this rainy Chicago weekend.
Pat’s place was perfectly located for our needs. Lovely neighborhood and walkable to where we needed to be. Pat was very accommodating to our schedule and the communication was excellent. Thank you.
Didn't like the threat of all the extra fees, it felt a little scammy, but the airbnb itself was very clean and the neighborhood was nice.

This was a great stay in a great neighborhood in Chicago! Everything was as described and was walkable to some great bars and restaurants (we went to Lotties almost everyday!). Thanks for a great time!

This location is perfect if you’re looking for a quiet stay, want to save a ton compared to downtown prices, and don’t mind taking transit! It’s super close to Logan Square, which has such a great vibe—extremely walkable with awesome restaurants and coffee shops nearby.
The apartment was neat, clean, and really well kept. We shared the space with two other couples who were all friendly, quiet, and respectful.
Benjamin was a fantastic host! He made communication so easy and quickly cleared up any questions we had. Parking was a bit tight, but we always managed to land a spot—and you can't beat free parking! All in all, this place was 100% worth it 😊
Good location and easy instructions. Great stay!
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Everything you need in the unit. Absolutely clean and very stylish.
The place was clean and the hosts are nice.
We enjoyed our time in Chicago, and Benny was an exceptional host who was very helpful and communicative throughout our stay.

Amy was so kind and thoughtful!! She made us feel so welcome and at home while we were with her, and her coffee was amazing! It was wonderful getting to talk with her in the morning before we went out into the city. Me and my boyfriend were worried staying in a room in someone's place would feel intrusive or odd, but Amy is absolutely delightful and made us both feel at home throughout our entire stay!
Great location, can walk to a lot of places, clean comfortable space

Tim was a fantastic host and the recommendations that I tried in his guidebook were all great. The house was immaculate, with beautiful gardens in a quiet neighborhood. This was the perfect place to return to each night.

Such a cute place in a very walkable neighborhood. There was lots of street parking and we were only 10 minutes from the blue line. Argelia was super friendly and responsive. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Absolutely stunning, stayed for Lollapalooza and felt right at home

I had a very good experience at Myrtle's home.  The home is a mile and a half from the Kimball Brown Line.  There is a bus stop right outside the home.  Also, it is close to some fast food restaurants.  Myrtle provides free wifi, some refrigerator space, a microwave, and toaster.  There was a great air conditioner in the room, and the room was right next to the bathroom.  The bathroom was clean, and there is a shower / tub. The home is in a quiet neighborhood.  I felt safe at the home.  I would recommend the home.  I was by myself.  The bedrooms are upstairs.  You are given a key to lock the door when you come and go.  You are asked to take off your shoes when you enter the home.  This space worked out well for me.  I am sure it will be fine for you too.  Have a good trip!

Had an enjoyable stay at Nate and Tys place. We booked because we were going to lollapalooza and had everything we needed, the area was perfect and parking was always available. I would keep in mind that people do live upstairs, but it didn’t bother us one bit. Thank you once again!

Loved this bnb! Good for a larger group and it was fun to chill on the porch for breakfast. Rooms were spacious and beds were comfy. The neighborhood was very walkable and lots of bars/restaurants nearby. Only a 10min walk to the L
Vachetta had the perfect place for my weekend in Chicago and was extremely communicative with requests, questions, and suggestions.

Anna was a fantastic host! Very responsive to any needs and answered any questions and concerns that I had in a timely manner! The neighborhood area was great and quiet and i really enjoyed my time there! The place itself was very clean and looked exactly like the pictures. I would definitely recommend this place to any of my friends when visiting Chicago😊!

Code didn’t work at first to get in and someone in the unit downstairs had to let us in after a few minutes of waiting. Toilet also began to not flush unless we manually did it. Despite that, the host was mostly responsive with the issues and the listing was exactly as expected. It was a good neighborhood and was walkable to many different convenience stores and train stations. We enjoyed our stay
had a great trip and nice stay
Great distance from everything. Very communicative host. Great stay over all

Joanna’s place was perfect for our quick stay! Great place in the city just a ten minute walk from the train station. Perfect little apartment for two people. Ceilings on the shorter side, but was described in the listing and was not a problem. Definitely would stay again!

The perfect place for our reunion of sisters and nieces. Great location. Very responsive and helpful hosts. Thank you for a beautiful place to stay. Thanks for extra advice about parking and the daily parking passes.
Great place to stay with a group of people. Would definitely book again!

Overall the place was good and location was great, love Pilsen district. I felt the bedroom lack character and was plain. I did see walls dirty in bathroom and patched holes. Recommend these two rooms need a refresh. The place worked for us for what needed.

I was falsely advertised about my air bnb reservation. It was meant to be a cozy and luscious stay but when I showed up, the curtain rods were falling off and not even put in the correct spots. The bed had pee stains all over them. The bed was not nearly the same as the images, the bathroom shower had no door, there was a mildew smell from entry. The ceiling light wasn’t properly working and would flicker at times. Unfortunately, we had no where else to stay last minute so we had to stay here but it ruined our experience. Hosts should present accurate imaging of the place that they’re offering but in hindsight, I’m realizing that these photos are all AI-generated!

Wonderful cozy and super clean home! Felt very safe inside, had a fully stocked kitchen and bathroom for all our needs. Check in and checkout instructions were communicated very clearly as well. Only tip for other guests is to be aware at night and to not explore the area past dark.
Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay for our Lolla trip. Steven’s great and super accommodating and his house is amazing!
Perfect little place to stay in a wonderful neighborhood. Highly recommend.
Great stay! Easy to find and exactly as described.
Perfect location, easy walk or train to all hot spots.
Staying here was amazing! We loved it!

We truly enjoyed our stay, the space is beautiful and spacious and truly accommodated our group well. The host was responsive and detailed with instructions and to questions. Also really appreciated the location: it was quiet, walkable to things and close to transit.

One of the best AirBnB’s I’ve stayed in! The house was spacious, clean, good vibes, and was in a perfect and walkable location in Wicker Park. Tom was an excellent host , he gave us clear instructions for check-in/check-out, and made us feel very at home.
Would absolutely stay here again , it was perfect for our big group!
We had a great stay at Alexandre’s place. It was as described and very clean. We immediately felt at home and would stay again.

Would definitely book with Michael again! Went into town for lollapalooza, easy and cheap uber to the city. Very quiet and peaceful (very reassuring for my first time in chicago). Shower is a bit tricky to get down and wish the bath worked, but other than that i would give it 6 out of 5 stars if i could!
Great apartment! It was comfortable for our family of 6 adults. Proximity to train station and great restaurants was exactly what we needed. Thanks, Jie!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was friendly and made the check-in process easy. The location was convenient, and we had everything we needed for a relaxing visit. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay in the Chicago area!
Edgar was very helpful and the place was clean and quiet 👍

Naomi was very responsive and easy to communicate. My group enjoyed our stay in Chicago. Movie night was a core memory for us in the living room and kitchen comes with full appliances and easy to cook in for breakfast.

It is a small room, but the three of my friends managed, and had a lot of fun. All of the spaces were always cleaned, smelled fine, and noise level was not that bad. I just wish the floors were not as dirty. I would consider getting them professionally cleaned.
Enjoyed our stay- a great location and space. The trains are nearby but the sound didn’t bother us or my child. Jhon was extremely responsive and Lincoln Square is a great spot for families.

6’s if I could.
Gem of an Airbnb and a great place to come back and relax to. Great for a first time visit of Chicago with peaceful, walkable neighborhoods, and public transport close by.
Plenty to do nearby if downtown doesn’t call to you. Enjoyed good grub and great thrifting.
Didn’t have any issues but was at home knowing Imran would be responsive should anything arise.
If I’m back in Chicago I’m looking out for Imran’s spot!

Loved our stay. Super walkable to local coffee shops and restaurants. Train is a short walk down the street as well. Felt very safe and had everything we needed for our lollapalooza weekend! I appreciated the snack basket waiting for us when we arrived & the fast responsiveness with any questions we had. Wifi is a bit spotty, but other than that no complaints.
Good and clean environment

The home was livable and nicely decorated, but many major issues including plumbing and leaking water. The hallway bathroom’s door didn’t securely close or lock, and there was a slight smell within the home. Overall it did fit our needs for the stay, but our expectations were a bit higher for what we paid.

We had such a wonderful stay at 747 Lofts during our trip to Chicago for Lollapalooza! As two young women traveling together, feeling safe was a huge priority for us, and we felt completely comfortable throughout our stay. The location was fantastic—being right next to the train station made getting to and from the festival incredibly easy, and there were plenty of nearby places to grab groceries, coffee, or anything else we needed. The loft was the perfect size for the two of us and comfortably accommodated us, though I would say it would be a bit tight for more than two people. The kitchen was functional and had everything we needed, and the bathroom was spotless with beautiful lighting, which made getting ready each day so enjoyable. The entire space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as advertised. On top of that, our host was incredibly kind, responsive, and hospitable, making the entire experience seamless from start to finish. We absolutely loved our time in Chi-Town, and stayi

Charlie was very responsive, provided some of the best check in instructions I've ever seen on Airbnb. The place had everything we needed. My only suggestion might be to add a couple lamps or other lighting options as the main living area just had the overhead light which felt a little serial. Overall though great spot and enjoyed our stay!
Super peaceful area, amazing friendly host. Very accomodating!
A+ stay. The place is spacious and very comfortable. Ideal location for a visit to Chicago. David was an extremely gracious host. Very highly recommend.
Stayed here for a trip to Chicago and it was great! Lots of space, loved the porch. Host was very kind and asked if there was anything that could have been improved for next time. :)
Great stay with the family for a Cubs va Yankees weekend series. Rafal was very attentive and always available. Kids had a great time with pool table and air hockey.
Very nice stay!
Unfortunately, I felt unsafe. Also, only one bathroom for five rooms.

Our group loved staying at Laura’s place. It was clean, quiet, and plenty of space for the 4 of us. It was also easy to get around the neighborhood and find great restaurants and coffee. Laura was very responsive and so kind and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.
Friendly and welcoming place! Room was great and appreciate the closet and drawers. Great place to stay I recommend, it’s a short walk from the green line. Host is very kind.
Great place to stay! Easy to get to the train and get downtown
Great Place, great neighborhood, great host.

Good area close to a train station, markets, and food places. Most necessities including bathroom products were provided in the house. The only complication we had was the oven and stove setting off the fire alarm. After contacting Carlos we were informed to open a ventilation fan on the wall. We also couldn't figure out how to work the microwave as it kept stopping in the middle of use. There are a lot of stairs to get in the Airbnb as well. Overall Carlos is a good host and we would recommend.

Eric’s place was fun to be at! It was walkable to public transit, peaceful and quiet, and had comfortable beds. It was a little tough having only one bathroom with four people, but that was clearly communicated beforehand. The only thing I will say is checkout is not flexible in our experience (we asked the day before if we could extend our checkout as our flight was delayed last minute till 11 pm) but we didn’t hear any response. Overall, it was a great price and stay. We would recommend!
Very cute place and nice room and she was very friendly in helping me as a first time Chicago visitor

We came a long way and Marjorie was very understanding about our varied arrival time. Place was in great condition and had everything we needed for our stay. Host was very communicative when messages were sent and everything went very smoothly. We knew it was a walk up and were prepared to walk up the many flights of stairs to get to the room. Area can be a little nerve racking for someone who isn’t used to a city but there were many stores and modes of transportation nearby that made the stay that much more convenient. Would definitely recommend this place!
Abe communicated great and help with a few things that unexpectedly came up from severe weather. Everything was clean and ready for our stay. We appreciated the hospitality.

This place is really beautiful and vintage! Loved the glass stained window. Super convenient with the green line just a few blocks down. The room we stayed in was really nice and comfy. You have an ac in the room that you can adjust to your liking. There is also a mini fridge in the room which was super convenient. The kitchen area was cozy as well and we often ate in the kitchen. This place was really nice and Ryan is super friendly and helpful and always looking to accommodate you.

The main door (entry to building) did not lock or close completely. Definitely a safety issue. I communicated this to Demitri right away and he responded right away that he'd contact landlord. However, at check out 3 days later, still not fixed. Hallway is dark with dark grey carpeting and this is a two-floor walk up. Furniture piece and some deco pillows are well worn.
Great location! And as I mentioned, Demitri was very responsive.
This was an excellent location and choice. Surrounded by lots of amenities. The apartment was clean. Marco is a great host.
Anne’s place was truly one of the nicest Airbnb’s I have stayed in! The BNB was taken great care of and I truly appreciated how spacious it was. I would totally stay here again.
Great location and neighborhood

Great long weekend stay at Lida’s home. We were in town for Cubs games. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Great beds and well stocked kitchen. Easy to park on the street right outside the front door. Great restaurants and bars within an easy walk. I highly recommend staying here.

Spent about 5 nights at Demitri's place. Right off the bat -- you can smell the cleaners had been through from the door. Just like fresh linen and the air felt clean. That being said, it is an older apartment in Lincoln Square, so it's got its quirks. Apartment has everything you could need if you're planning on cooking, but otherwise, a good basic apartment. When he says it's a 3rd floor walk up-- it's truly a 3rd floor walk up. Be warned. A/C was great, keep the bedroom doors closed and they stay nice and cool.
Demitri communicates-- directions are clear, he responds quickly and is always helpful. Only thing I'll say and others have mentioned, the locks on the doors in the building's front are broken/do not have locks. Other than that, it was a fine apartment. Thank you!

We had a wonderful stay at Garett and Kaylin’s place. There was plenty of space for a group of 8 to sleep comfortably. They even provided snacks and drinks for us for our stay- such kind hospitality!
We had a minor issue with the toilet and Garett promptly sent over a plumber who took care of it quickly. We would happily book again :) Thanks again for a great stay!
John was an amazing host! Everything was as pictured, and it was in an amazing location. Definitely recommend staying here!
Our group enjoyed staying at Dustin’s place for our long weekend. The neighborhood was quiet and we took advantage of walking to several of the nearby restaurants and bars.

Overall, we had a pleasant stay. The home is very spacious, which made it comfortable for our group. The location and overall experience were enjoyable. While the property is a bit older and could benefit from some updates, particularly in the bathroom, we think a few renovations would make it worth and more comfortable for future guests.
It was a wonderful place to stay! Very respectful and everything was as written. I had no issues or problems! I'd love to stay here again!
Perfect stay!
Our stay was wonderful, the unit was cozy and all of us enjoyed our stay there! Communication was great and Ms. LaKesha gave us great instructions and recommendations for the area.

The place was clean and exactly as described and in the PERFECT location! I can’t imagine staying anywhere else when coming to visit Chicago!
Thank you again!!!

Good base camp for Lollapalooza - 10 minute walk to the brown line, bus stop right outside, and the neighborhood felt safe getting home late. The unit is spacious with all the basics. Rida was a great communicator and promptly answered all our questions.
Great stay!!

We were in town for Lollapalooza and usually stay north part of town so Chinatown was a new experience for us. The train station was super convenient whether coming from the airport or going to and from the downtown area.
The apt was very clean with lots of little amenities provided.
As someone who has spent quite a bit of time in Asia we were spoiled for choice when it came to food in the neighborhood!
Would definitely rent again!

The place is in a great area, with all kinds of dining and entertainment options as well as close proximity to the blue line. The unit was clean and well maintained. Note it is a garden-view unit so you will hear the upstairs tenant moving around at times.

This place was greater than I expected. It was extremely clean and smelled very good. There were so many amenities included like a stove and fridge. It was very spacious. The surrounding area was great as well with lots of asian restaurants and cafes. Also, the red line was right outside the bnb which made it perfect to get to our destination conveniently. I would rate this place a 10/10 and highly recommend.

This was an enjoyable place to stay ! Stayed here for lolla and was able to meet the other people staying in the place who were also going and split an uber ! Walking around the neighborhood was sketchy at night so avoid that.
Beautiful home, kind hosts, and had everything we needed. Very nice neighborhood and plenty of street parking!

despite the after hours noise right outside the house every night and the inconvenient smell from the basement level due to the previous rain flood which impacted living arrangements, our stay at Prince's was good. linen/towels were not thoroughly clean but useable as many options were provided. bathroom and kitchen was provided with many amenities as well.
Very attentive, very nice space, we  were happy
really loved the place and it was very cozy! would definitely  stay here again!

Host was very interactive, wasn’t a bother, answered any questions that I had. I will say the transportation drivers made the area seem very unsafe, drivers cancelled due
To area but not the host fault. There was quiet hours listed for guest and the upstairs neighbors were extremely loud and very thin walls so beware when sharing personal information. Stairs are very narrow so careful if you arrive with a suitcase. Karron overall was 10/10- I do think the vents could’ve been dusted better and the side boards on the floors could’ve used some love. Stayed for almost a week, went to buy towels and some necessities. Would stay again with host but not maybe at this exact location.

Dave was exceptionally responsive and flexible. Our flight came in a bit early and he let us check in a few hours early due to no one staying there the night before. He said if someone had been staying he would have allowed us to leave our bags and come back at regular check in time.
The kitchen was very well stocked with everything imaginable. He had excellent coffee beans and a grinder etc for fresh quality coffee in the mornings; we don't cook. Lots of space, quiet at night, and I would definitely stay here again.
Dave is a very accommodating and helpful host
Had a great stay
Spacious apartment in walkable distance (5-10 minutes) to restaurants. Clean and well taken care of apartment in a quiet neighborhood. Not too far from Blue Line that takes you downtown.

Small place, perfect to have somewhere to crash if you are planning to spend most your time out in the city! Around a 15 minute walk to the blue line which is convenient for getting to/from o’hare and gets you to the loop in around 45 minutes
A+ Experience with our stay. Very convenient for our event we road tripped for with a bus stop within a 5 minute walk. Location felt so safe. Would recommend to anyone!!

My entire stay was easy and good. I did have a tiny issue with getting into the building but Devon was helpful and did resolve the issue pretty quickly but that my stay was smooth. The red line was just a 3 minute walk. The grocery store was behind the building so it was very convenient. Overall my stay was 5 stars
Great stay and close to Grant Park! Would stay again!

awesome spot to stay at! we stayed 4 nights for lollapalooza and it was a great location. quiet, safe, and lots of nearby cafes and shops to check out. Host was very responsive and helpful with everything! loved the cute decor as well :)
Great place and great host!

Edgar’s place was perfect for our Lollapalooza stay. It was very clean and no bugs. The listing is correct, room is very small, but we found it to be very cozy and got amazing sleep. You have access to change the temperature to your liking. Very easy to get downtown, one very close bus to the red line, takes around 40 minutes total. Neighborhood was lovely during the day, wouldn’t recommend walking alone at night as a young girl. Had an issue and Edgar was quick to fix it. A great place to stay at an affordable price if you don’t mind sharing commen spaces😊.

The apartment is spacious and in a nice location, only a short walk to the L. However, it was not the cleanest. We found fake eyelashes on the floor in two rooms, and the floors were pretty dirty. The hosts said initial supplies would be provided and guests were responsible for restocking. We understood this, but we were not provided an adequate amount to begin with. We had only half a roll of paper towels and two trash bags for 10 people staying for a week. For a space advertised for large groups, we expected more basic supplies. The washing machine is also broken/difficult to use. The start button is pressed so far into the machine that you cannot even press it with your finger. We contacted the hosts about our concerns. They offered to send a cleaning team, which was appreciated, but we had already arrived and unpacked, so having cleaners come at that point would have been an inconvenience. Considering the price we paid, we expected the home to be cleaner and adequately stocked.
Absolutely loved the place. It’s in a great location near coffee shops and restaurants. The place is very clean and has everything you could possibly need. Would gladly stay here again
Wynter was very sweet and had the place done up really nice for us!
Nice space and nice location!
Prime location if you want to be in the middle of the action!

Loved staying here.  We have been to Chicago many times and we knew we wanted to stay in this neighborhood.  It was a bonus how close it is to the train stop.  Very cute apartment and a very comfortable stay.  Everything was clean and we had everything we could need.  Being so close to the train, you will hear it but actually I think it helped me sleep.  Would stay here again and highly recommend.
Zen’s place was clean and well organized. You can really tell they put an effort on the quality of their place, we’d gladly go back!
A great place for my friends and I to stay for the weekend.  Only 20 minutes from Chicago and I felt very safe my whole stay. I would definitely come back :)

This was the absolute perfect stay for us! We came to Chicago for Lollapalooza! We took the Pink line to and from Grant Park several times a day! Within 4 blocks for groceries, local restaurants and laundromat!

Thank you for a nice stay - close to the redline - to get to Grant park and spacious layout. Very convenient for (divvy rental) biking around especially the lakeshore path and beach. The parking spot was a big plus but it was tight so we don’t move during our stay once parked. Overall a really great spot and place for our time in Chicago! Close to the city but also a nice oasis north by a beach!
Place was very put together and we enjoyed our stay!

Eduardo and Lois’ home was perfect for our family gathering. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook meals and the counter space was fantastic. We really felt at home and discovered a small farmers market just down the street on Sunday. The air conditioning and fans made it pleasant in the Chicago heat and humidity. It was a great stay!
Very nice place! Lincoln park is very walkable and this place is one of the most accessible places i’ve stayed!

Jean’s place is the perfect Chicago getaway spot that was such a lovely location and was perfect for our group. The beautiful garden courtyard was serene, the separate apartments on each floor in one carriage house made it perfect for two families to stay without feeling like you’re all squeezed into one house. The corner bar was a perfect nightcap spot for our group, the walk to the western blue line was a breeze, and the proximity to the interstate made it easy to travel around the city. Would definitely stay here again!
Todo estuvo perfecto!  Fue un alojamiento perfecto para nuestra visita a Chicago.  Gracias!!
Perfect location.  Great neighborhood with many food options nearby as well as a market.  Would stay again for sure.

I had an amazing time at this Airbnb and would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting the city. The host was incredibly friendly and responsive to any questions or concerns I had during my stay. The place was very clean and not too far from the train if you would rather walk around in the city. Again, it is a charming place to stay while you’re exploring the city.

Lovely space located conveniently to public transportation and many great restaurants and cafes. We arrived on Friday evening on a busy summer weekend, and street parking was easy to find. The space itself is clean, has everything needed for a stay, and has charming vintage features. Jhon was very communicative and made check in and check out easy. I would definitely stay again.
Great place to stay
super great place to stay at!!

Soon was an excellent host- the unit we stayed in was very clean and exactly what we were looking for with the TV, full kitchen, garage space for a vehicle and more. I would highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago.
we had a great stay! perfect location and easy to get anywhere you wanted !
The apartment was in a gorgeous area and the stay was really fun and easy!

I stayed here for a couple nights during Lollapalooza it was great, accessible to public transport through Chicago, only took me about an hour to get to grant park from the location using the bus and subway, felt safe, and nice area overall. Would recommend if you’re on a budget and need someplace affordable to spend the night.
Blake provided the perfect landing spot for a Lollapalooza weekend. Amenities were quality, host was responsive, home and neighborhood was beautiful.

This is the third year we have driven to Chicago for lollapalooza and this Airbnb has by far been in the best location and had the easiest train route. Not to mention all of the coffee and food spots within walking distance. We loved all the amenities and they were very helpful when it came to getting the nespresso machine to work! It was a very comfortable space that gave us everything we needed this far from home.

We had a lovely time staying at The Dream Rental’s place. We went to Chicago for Lollapalooza and it was perfect walking distance to Grant Park and very centrally located in the city — close to many restaurants, coffee shops, and the train. It was clean, had great amenities, and actually was bigger than the pictures led us to believe. The hosts were very responsive and super helpful for us. Would definitely recommend for anyone visiting Chicago!

Absolutely adored my stay with Harvey and Elizabeth. The space was comfortable and clean, communication easy, and the location is great with easy access to the Metra. Communication was also super easy, and both hosts are extremely friendly so don’t feel afraid to ask for recommendations! Will absolutely keep an eye out for future visits to stay here again :)
Great place, spacious
Super nice and close to everything! Def love the view of the city. 10/10 would recommend

This place is exactly as described. Claudia was very responsive and I appreciated the waters she left in the fridge given we arrived with nothing else. The location can be a little inconvenient if you are relying on public transportation, as it takes an hour to get downtown one way. There are several bus stops within 1-4 blocks. We always took 54 and it was very reliable. The neighborhood was quiet all day with nothing much going on. It can be a little intimidating at night because there aren’t many light posts but nothing alarming happened. As with any larger city, just take precautions and you will be good!
I had such a great time here at Cristina’s place! From the neighborhood, to the space, it was a perfect place to stay in every aspect!
Great place with clean bedrooms and bathrooms that worked great for my group of 5!

Host is extremely responsive, and the house is in a great walkable neighborhood with lots of dining options.  This is a great area of town to stay in if you plan on spending most of your time in the city, but want a neighborhood feel to where you stay.  The house had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
This was a great, convenient place to stay while my daughters attended Lollapalooza.  Will look at it again for next year.
Roberts place was great! Great location, clean apartment and plenty of space! Walking distance to public transportation and alot to do around the areas. Would definitely stay here again!

Ronaldo and Carla were by far one of the best air bnb hosts I’ve had. They were so welcoming into their beautiful home. Ronaldo gave us so many amazing recommendations on shopping, sightseeing, food, etc. We felt right at home and cannot recommend Ronaldo and Carla enough! Thank you for the amazing stay!

The studio apartment was perfect for my needs during Lollapalooza. The only downside was the elevator was not working. The apartment is on the second floor so the walk up was only tough while checking in and out with all of my bags and camera equipment. I am an older woman so that made it kind of tough for me but I took multiple trips and made it work. This is the second time I have stayed in this building and it is a great location for when I visit Chicago as it is near everything I need. I am a city girl at heart and don't mind the train or street noise. The apartment was clean and had a bed, bathroom, and air conditioning. That's all I need during these trips. Patricia was responsive whenever I had a question.

Solomon and Linh are great hosts.  They were very accommodating and responsive.  Their home was beautiful and had everything we needed…super comfortable and awesome location.  Would 100% recommend staying here.
Very cute place definitely recommend

Mary was a wonderful host. She was super welcoming and so helpful. We came to stay for Lollapalooza and we weren't aware of the bag policy. Mary not only made us aware of the bag policy, she also lent us a clear tote bag to use. She was very helpful and responded to any questions we had in a timely manor with no hostility. The place is in a great location with some good restaurants very close by. I will say that the listing is quite a bit more cluttered than the photos show, but it didn't interfere with our stay. Mary provides many free amenities to her guests which were very nice to have and helpful to use. Overall, I had a great trip coming to Chicago and will consider booking this listing in the future! Thank you so much for your hospitality.

We found the Airbnb to be perfect for us. We had 8 people so it was a bit tight but we made the best of it. Very walkable location. Milan was very responsive and made sure we had everything we needed.
Host absolutely amazing,

Such a perfect spot, with just the right amount of room for me and my friend. The kitchen was super useful and having access to a washer and dryer helped a ton. The convenience of the train and bus stop being not even a 2 minute walk made transportation easy for anywhere we wanted to go. Totally saving this for my next time in town!

This house was only well represented, but very well maintained. In a very opulent and aesthetically pleasing neighborhood, very safe and close to many many things to do that are all walkable. Every detail was thought of from squeaky clean bathrooms, and kitchen to a great comfortable layout of the living area, and the bedrooms were appointed with many extras, including multiple charging options for device, toothbrush, hearing aids, anything else you want to plug-in. The host Leigh was always very responsive immediately and hopeful with recommendations and anything we needed. We were assembling a Childs water table and did not have a couple of tools and he brought them right over. Just a wonderful experience and looking forward to returning on our next visit to Chicago.

Thanks for a great stay! The corner around the corner is fun to grab a nightcap any night. Place is super clean and organized with nice perks. Our hosts were responsive. I will book again for sure when I’m back in Chicago.

Tuan was a great host! Easy to access the apartment. It is a private entrance and space but just know the host does stay in the house as well and we did hear the family walking around at times. It didn’t bother us at all and they were lovely when we did speak to them. The apartment was clean and easy to access. I loved Chicago and hope to be back soon.
Great place!

We had a fantastic stay! Our adult kids joined us for a long weekend in Chicago, and this was the perfect home base. The house was comfortable, clean, and had plenty of space for everyone to relax after a day of exploring the city. The Bucktown location was outstanding—close to great restaurants, shops, and easy access to everything Chicago has to offer. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city.
great place to stay !
Great, accessible location. Very responsive and hospitable host!
Great location and most amazing host! Provided great check in instructions and support during our stay!

Michael was an amazing and responsive host. We had no issues with our stay besides a small hiccup with the lock box, which was resolved. We felt safe and secure sleeping in this unit and staying here during festival weekend. Michael provided us with coffee, snacks, and water which was super nice. The unit was spacious and clean. I would stay here again! Thanks for everything.
Awesome space, it was perfect for what we needed and is steps away from a bus that takes you directly to the Blue line.

Jim’s place was clean, the beds were comfortable and the kitchen was spotless. It is close to transit options.
Unfortunately there were some things that could be improved.
1. The train noise. I’ve lived in big cities for decades and this was the loudest “urban noise” I’ve experienced. The elevated train directly next to the building is very loud and the windows do a poor job blocking noise.
2. The check in process. Jim passed me off to their associate Sam who would check me in. Sam passed me off to the cleaner who I had to meet at the front door and get the fob from. Was unclear I was supposed to use a code as the main way to unlock the door since the cleaner gave me a physical key that didn’t fit anything.
3. Parking. Was initially told no parking so paid for our own. Then Sam called me when I checked in and said he could give me parking in the building if I promised to give a 5 star review, would be nice to know ahead of time.
4. Immediate surrounding neighborhood is meh.
Great location. Do not recommend to drive!
Dana was an amazing host. She was so responsive and kind. I stayed here to attend a single day of Lollapalooza and it was the perfect respite after walking miles all day.
Perfect spot for Chicago
Great stay! Very convenient location! Would stay again
This place was very clean. I had a nice stay

Stayed here with friends and had a great time! Hosts were always responsive and very flexible with our arrival times. The kitchenette was perfect and they had everything we needed! Would absolutely book again!

A perfect apartment for what me and my partner needed. Quiet, walkable neighborhood. Lots of restaurants nearby. Within a mile of Wrigley so easy to walk to a game if you wanted. No central AC, but the AC units work really well at keeping the apartment cool. Older building, but lots of charm and the unit itself has updated appliances. Iris is incredibly helpful and responsive when needed! A great introduction to Chicago.
Nice apt near the beach and L stops

We enjoyed staying here the weekend of Lollapalooza! Beautiful home within walking distance of the redline and groceries. The home was clean and comfortable. The tandem parking situation is less than ideal, however, it’s off the main roadway which is a plus. Lilian was responsive and professional when it came to resolving an issue during our stay, for which I have no hesitation in giving this location 5 stars.
Great stay, we stayed for Lollapalooza and it was about an hour or hour and a half to grant park using the cta. Plenty of rooms and beds thay can accommodate a group of friends

Awesome stay! We were here during Lollapalooza and it was a great location, only 10 minutes uber ride from the downtown area. Everything was clean. The bathroom lock wasn’t working at first so we messaged the host about it and they immediately sent a handyman to come fix it which was much appreciated. Only suggestion for improvement would be to have more mirrors, as it was a little challenging to only have the one in the bathroom. Overall, it was a lovely stay and we would definitely come back!

Kareem was an absolute joy to stay with! Me (25F) and my friend (25F) were in town for Lollapalooza so we were out a majority of the time and didn't get back until late, which he was very flexible with. Area is best safe and close to the CTA red line! While you are sharing a space with him, he had the perfect balance of friendliness and privacy! On one of the nights I got myself locked out at 11:30p and felt awful to bother him, but he was very friendly and responded promptly to my message outside of normal hours and took time to explain the door locks to me. Thank you so so much for being so kind and having the perfect space for my friend and I to relax after long hours outside in the hot weather at the festival! Would absolutely book again :)

We had a great stay at this airbnb! Stayed here for lollapalooza and it was easy to use the bus to get to and from the festival. Felt safe walking back in the dark from the bus stop. Street parking was super easy and there was always a spot near by
Great place to stay!
Great location!

Had a wonderful stay…very walkable.. super clean… great area…plenty of places to eat… walked to Wrigley…host left a bottle of wine, coffee, a few snacks plus bagels & cream cheese. Plus the price was great. Will return if available & will definitely recommend.

I would recommend this place to anyone and hope to stay here again next year! Astonishingly clean house, beautiful view, super kind and responsive hosts, literally the best air bnb stay I’ve ever had!

Absolutely amazing place! The layout is calming, and everything was spotless, clean, and well organized. It has such a peaceful, zen atmosphere in a fantastic neighborhood. There are countless great bars, restaurants, shops, gyms, and yoga studios within walking distance—everything you could possibly need. I would absolutely stay here again. If I could give it 10 stars, I would!

Overall a good place to stay, very clean, affordable, and accurately described, however there was a sulfur smell throughout the duration of our stay that we suspected was coming through the vents. Despite the smell, we enjoyed our stay!

Jared was responsive and accommodating. The space was beautiful and fit perfectly for what we needed. Ample, clean living and sleeping spaces were the highlight of the stay. Any issues we had were promptly resolved by the host.
Great stay and great location! Heidi was wonderful and I loved the cats. Thank you Heidi!

we came back again and we felt right at home. We knew the routine now unfortunately Michelle  was not feeling too great, but we still chose to have a great time and did our best to make sure she was still comfortable while we were staying at her house, even though she couldn’t be with us half the time we felt right at home and got through the weekend with ease.
Thank you for having us.
The place was great and was exactly what we booked. Would definitely stay here again.
Jenn was awesome- super nice and unbelievably responsive!!!! The place was so convenient to the blue line.  It was an easy walk, in a safe cute neighborhood.

Our stay was wonderful. The home was beautiful and clean on the inside. The location was perfect according to the purpose of our visit. Would definitely stay again.
Peggy
Stayed on a very busy weekend due to the festival. Great stay
Everything was great overall! The only issue was that there were kids running around quite loudly after midnight, which made it a little difficult to sleep. Other than that, we had a great stay.

I had such a wonderful time staying here! The place was much bigger than expected which was nice and the neighborhood was quiet with many great restaurants very close by. Melissa was extremely accommodating and made sure my stay was amazing. I would one thousand percent come back and stay here again. Thank you for everything!

Great location for Lollapalooza - lots of really nice restaurants nearby, good access to greenline and buses up to N Michigan Ave. Easy instructions, low maintenance stay, and friendly check-ins from Milan - would book again!

Feven's apartment was great for us. We were only 4 and easily could have slept at least 3 more people. Very spacious, across 2 floors, very clean, 4 full bathrooms. Feven was very communicative and responsive. The location is really good. A block from Division St. and about a 10-15 walk to the main drag on Division moving towards Wicker Park. Very easy to get rideshares, when needed.

Nice apartment with a rare 4 bedrooms/3 bathrooms.
The building the apartment is in was not impressive with the main floor being flooded and the halls/shared spaces were very dirty. But the apartment itself was clean with newer finishes, comfortable beds, and nice bathrooms. We were very comfortable and enjoyed our stay.
Everything was super! The apartment was very convenient, had everything needed for vacation lone stay, and location was great. It became a home away from home for the two months in Chicago.
great & clean place to stay if you are in chicago! oyindamola was easy to reach out to for questions as well.

It’s a nice stay at a nice neighborhood and the hosts are friendly. however, i wished the bathroom shower door didn’t have the crack on the corner that led the water out. it was difficult to keep the non shower area dry. the floor is also very squeaky and i would get waken up in the morning from outside conversations/activities as the door is not very sound proof.
Bathtub was clogged when we arrived but Marie was fast in responding with having maintenance arrive to fix it.
Jacqueline was so kind and helpful, the place was very clean and very spacious slept me and my 5 friends and we had a great time! Definitely will stay there again if I go back to Chicago!
great place! clean and spacious
One of the most thoughtful spaces we stayed in through Airbnb! Every detail was thought through and we never felt so comfortable at a stay. We’ll be booking again if we’re ever in Chicago. Cheers!

I really enjoyed my stay at Kash’s place. Kash recommended things to do and always answered my questions. If there was a time we didn’t chat Kash even checked in on me. It really felt like Kash wanted to make sure my stay was perfect and I appreciate that! I 100% would love to stay here again in the future!

My guest and I had an overall amazing stay! The location was beautiful and spacious, in general it felt like home! The check in and out process was easy and we had no complications whatsoever. Remember that there is a family above you, but in conclusion I would recommend this to anyone looking for a nice, clean, affordable stay!
The apartment was clean and private. Enjoyed staying here.
Stay was amazing! Claudia was so nice and helpful the entire trip
We had a fantastic stay here! The space was perfect t for our group of girls- plenty of space and comfy shared spaces. The location can’t be beat and made getting to all our events incredibly easy.
Had a great stay and the hosts were perfect in responding!
Phong was super kind, responsive, and always very helpful when we had questions. Wonderful experience and I heavily suggest their space :)

Angela’s place was a gem! My husband and I spent the weekend here in Chicago for Lollapaloozq and we loved the place and area! Angela was so great, even left us an anniversary surprise. We will definitely come back and stay at her place again.
the b&b was way bigger than I expected, and very cozy! i felt safe, and walked to the train daily. would stay again no doubt!

For about $3000 stay, I would hope it would have been cleaner, communication clearer between the air bnb and the host so I didn’t have to hear that my room was cancelled and they had to straighten it out upon my arrival. When I already had flight delay and cancelled flight but rebooked and communicated all of that to the host.
On top of that, the room I stayed in had really bad mold issues causing congestion and head aches. The curtain was broken so I had a lack of privacy when I needed it.
Also at night I had an encounter that someone off the street came into the lobby and the security was on his phone and did not realize and I had to give my food to the lady harassing me and pretending to talk to me and get close which made me uncomfortable and I moved closer to security although already next to me in order to feel safe. To fix this issue I think they should ask for key cards at entrance.
Other than that the staff was helpful and kind.
Place was nice clean. The garage was very convenient. Only downside was the extra charge for having extra guests even though it was under the maximum allowed.
Stayed at Mike and Channon’s for a weekend event at Grant Park and were satisfied with our stay. Beautiful home, the beds were comfy and great communication from the hosts.
The room was comfortable and the cats were fun to play with. Easy to walk to the red line or walk to the Chinatown water taxi stop to take that downtown. Overall I had a great time!
Mimi's place was as-advertised and fit our needs well for a great price! Mimi was very responsive as well.
keypad wasn’t working but the key made it easy to get in! had a lovely stay.
Great location. Near Wrigley Field and public transportation. Great local breakfast spots in easy walking distance. Quiet neighborhood

Paul's place is a gem in many ways - it's a lovely property in Andersonville on a quiet side street but close to Clark, so you're walkable to great shops, restaurants and bars. Only about a 20 minute walk to the shores of Lake Michigan if you're looking to have a beach day.
The property itself is clean and well-maintained, has both a front and a rear porch and the bedrooms were nice and comfortable.
While in good repair, it's an older Chicago two-flat that could use a bit of love - there's no hot water in the bathroom sink and the water pressure is low, and the shower water temp and pressure was a bit inconsistent.
All in all we had a lovely stay, and there aren't a lot of properties like it in this neighborhood, but the price point (perhaps because we were in town on the weekend of Lollapalooza) still felt high. Recommended if you can swing the price tag.

Great for a girls trip! 6 of my friends and I stayed here and loved it! Felt safe and was very walkable. Easy 10 minute walk to the train station and lots of food options near by, as well as a grocery store right next to the house!
Amazing home and very responsive and accommodating host! Will always look to stay with them again!

Location worked well and we really appreciated the opportunity to park two cars in a garage.  Home has been remodeled and has a lot of room.  New living area furniture would provide a more comfortable place to hang with friends.  We did enjoy the roof top.  A deep clean would also help with the home’s appeal.
Very affordable quiet place to stay. Host is very friendly and responsive. Right next to lots of public transportation

I had a great stay! The place was exactly as described, very clean, comfortable, and well organized. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. The location was convenient, and I felt safe and comfortable during my entire stay. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
Iris was extremely responsive and answered any questions I had very quickly. The space was nice and clean!
amazing stay
Great place!
Good place for an easy cheap visit. Bathroom is a little dirty but very affordable.

lesley was such a kind host, checking in on us during our vacay and extremely responsive. not toooo many coffee shops in walking distance but that’s my own personal problem lol. looked exactly like the photos, obsesseddd

Tosin was a fantastic host and the place had charm and was a great residence for 3 couples.
Went above and beyond to accommodate us a very smooth and pleasant checking in and out, was always communicative and responsive, and restocked kitchen necessities during our stay.
The dishwasher was out of service but Tosin offered to handle all washing after checkout. There were also some small leaks in the basement after a heavy day of rain, and Tosin offered to come and clean mid stay, though we already handled the cleanup ourselves.
Would gladly recommend and would gladly stay again.
We had a great stay! The house was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed.
Easy to work with and as advertised
Angelica was so kind such a great host!
Great location, very clean and super friendly hosts! Would definitely stay again!!!
Hana was very nice and accommodating and made the space feel welcoming and safe.  I'll definitely be coming back.
Great place to stay, right next to train station, easy to access and nice rooms!

My son and I had a great stay at Adam’s place for a trip to Chicago for Lollapalooza. The apartment is great and is in a wonderful neighborhood with tons of amenities. Also, great access to the lakefront straight down the street. Highly recommend!
This place was even better than pictures! Very clean, spacious, and quiet. We would definitely stay here again!
Angie was a great and welcoming host. The house was clean and is walking distance from the CTA and many restaurants. I would recommend this airbnb if you are visiting Chicago.
it was easy to find and comfortable for a little getaway

Debra was one of the best hosts that I have ever got to experience on AirBnb! The spot was clean, provided everything that we needed, and Debra was very thorough with the helping navigate the area. Next time I am in Chicago I will definitely come back to experience the great atmosphere that we did during our stay.
Cute place, great location

Karina and Brian were very welcoming and thoughtful hosts, offering small touches such as snacks, toiletries, and even rain ponchos that made such a big difference.  They made us feel comfortable and right at home. The house was very clean and well equipped with everything we needed for our stay. The backyard was a great space to hang out and relax, and the neighborhood was quiet and had a park at the end of the street. The location is very accessible to downtown with a train station about 6 minutes away and Chinatown was only a 10-15 min drive away. Would definitely stay here again the next time we are in Chicago and would 10/10 recommend booking!

Very nice place. Very clean and easy to get in and out. Only downside was there was 7 bedrooms we were unaware about and only 2 bathrooms. It did end up working well and everyone took the appropriate time in the bathrooms, just would've been nice to have been disclosed.
Clear, as described, great location, close to restaurants and the highway. We'll book again if in the area.

Cynthia was a great host! She was very kind, responsive, and accommodating. The space itself is beautiful and was the perfect location for our trip. The CVS next door is open 24/7, which was very convenient, and there are stores, coffee shops, and a cool bar within walking distance! All of that with easy parking and a beautiful back patio made this trip extra special. I would definitely stay here again. Thank you so much, Cynthia!

We had such a great stay! The house was beautiful and had plenty of room for everyone. The four bedrooms were spacious, and the beds were so comfortable. The decor was gorgeous and made the whole place feel cozy and welcoming.
The jacuzzi was definitely a highlight, and we were pleasantly surprised to find a third bathroom with a beautiful clawfoot tub—it was such a fun bonus! Everything was clean, well-kept, and just as described. We’d definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing place to stay!

We had a wonderful stay, very comfortable, beautiful setting. Private. My son loved seeing fireflies and frogs at night. We enjoyed relaxing in the cabin. The outdoor porch was nice to sit in when it was raining. The massage chair in the downstairs was a big draw for all of us! The walking trail next to the property was like being in a rainforest, so lush and green and full of life! The kitchen is well equipped. Having an air mattress and extra bedding and blankets was much appreciated!
Great location and amazing view of the city. Easy access to train and safe neighborhood.
Wonderful private room with lots of space and a nice area

Great location while we were in town for the Cubs/Yankees games. Very clean and comfortable. Peaceful street with no problems finding parking for 2 vehicles while we unloaded our belongings. We later moved one of the cars to the garage. We got our SUV in there with no problem. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you for having us!

The place was fantastic and very well kept!!! My friend and I had come and visit Chicago for lollapalooza this past weekend. Celia was a great host, I appreciate her answering any questions I had and checking up on us. I would definitely come back to stay here again and recommend to my friends about staying here as well!!!

Worst Airbnb I ever booked. It's a shadow hotel company with their own customer service outsourced somewhere. The photos didn't match the listing, and the building was far from secure. The outer building door handle fell off in my friends hand, and the lock itself would give about three inches. Anyone could get through that door, and it's not in a good area. There was a discarded mattress and trash in the lobby, and when we arrived at our apartment, the glass peephole of the door was removed and the hole had been stuffed with toilet paper to stop people from looking in. The host does not visit the property between guests, and was unaware that the building was in this state of disrepair. After politely requesting a refund from the host, two meetings were scheduled with the manager. She missed both of them. After finally calling me randomly she offered a $30 refund and failed to call me back. Very disrespectful host. It's bad business designed to cash you out and make you deal with it.
Loved staying at this airbnb! Such a cute neighborhood and space! Loveeeee the patio
Great spot -unbeatable value! It’s all you need for exploring the city, though is quite small so make sure to look at the photos. Highly recommended for a friend group looking to explore Chicago.
Great spot. Very clean and comfortable. Would stay again.

Zee was very accommodating for us during our stay and extremely responsive whenever something occurred. It was a 15-20 minute drive away from the major parts of Chicago and the Airbnb had a lot of amenities.
Cyndi’s place was so cute and clean and very walkable to everything downtown. She was very responsive and helpful.
Really great location overall a positive stay

Me and my boyfriend stayed here for Lollapalooza. Everything was as described and worth the price. The place is small, but had everything we needed for a short stay. The place was neat and clean, and the check-in and check-out instructions were clear and flexible. The host was very responsive and communicative. There's also plenty of great local restaurants to try, so I would definitely recommend staying here! Just be mindful of other guests and be respectful to the space and community, and you'll have a great time!
Great place, very responsive
Great spot for travels into Chicago very close to downtown. I would stay here again

My boyfriend and I had a great stay here! It was exactly how it was described and looked just like the photos. We really just needed a place to sleep at night as we were out and about during the day and this was perfect for that. Comfortable, clean and a pretty quiet street.
Convenient location to public transit with easy access to downtown. Laura's place worked well for our group. The house could use some additional upkeep to be guest ready.
Would definitely stay here again!
The place matched the description. Had what i needed for my stay. Was easy to get around using the bus and train.

Loved staying at Jhon’s place! We were in town for Lollapalooza and it was a breezy 30 minute ride to and fro. The apartment unit is spacious and plenty of room for our group to hang out in the living room. The neighborhood is pretty safe and quiet, and there are couple of great persian restaurants and cafes in the area.
Jhon was very responsive the entire time. The house rules were simple and straightforward to follow. Thanks Jhon for the great stay!

Although it is in a rougher area next to a homeless shelter the area is well lit and has surveillance cameras, Sergio’s team also made sure to let us know what to expect! My friend and I (two women in skimpy lollapalooza outfits) experienced no problems navigating the streets nearby. Whenever I reached out, Sergio’s team responded almost immediately!! Overall, I would stay here again in a pinch! Worked well as a last minute booking.
Perfect spot to stay in the city! super close walk to the CTA and lots to do in the area!
Great Neighborhood to stay in. Thank you Aurora for hosting our family!

Great place to stay for a group visiting Chicago. The place was very clean, on a relatively quiet street, and we had plenty of space despite it being a basement unit. Easy walk to the Blue Line and lots of good restaurants. Caitlin’s instructions for getting in/checking out were easy to follow.

Enjoyed our stay! Loved how close it was to Wrigley field, shopping and restaurants. A big plus for us was great water pressure and enough hot water for four adults to shower the mornings! The washer and dryer in the unit was super helpful. Loved the patio to sit outside on nice days!
Great location and very cozy place to stay!
Very cool place loved the black, also easy area to catch the metro !!

Absolute bang for the buck (considering we came in during Lollapalooza weekend too). The Pink line takes you to the Loop and smack in the middle of the action and there’s some stores nearby to avoid spending mad $$. Fit what we needed it to be.

Was a great place to stay for the duration of my work in the city. Really easy to access the blue line taking you straight to the loop. There’s a great park right behind the place and the location is quiet enough while still being close enough to the city. Brian was really responsive and a great host!

Adrian was a great host. Very communicative and responsive. The property was clean and spacious as in the pictures. The neighborhood is very quiet and peaceful, a 10 min drive from the west loop and about 15min drive from river north which both had more restaurants and places to go out.
great, Erica communicated very fast and was very helpful and checked in but i have no complaints!
quiet and clean space!
This place was great and the host was super helpful! Very clean home and they made sure we had everything we needed! Definitely recommend. The neighborhood feels very safe and it’s nice as well
Airbnb was very clean and nice. It was near everything that we needed. And the host was easy to communicate.

Rarely do such high ratings meet such high expectations, but Carole exceeded them! She was incredibly welcoming, patient, and a joy to speak with throughout our trip. If I ever come back to Chicago, there would be only one place I would even consider staying at, and it's here! 11/10 experience, location, price, and host!
Nice spot if you want to just have a quick getaway.
My friends and I stayed here while we attended lollapalooza together and was amazing! Ag always respected in less than an hour and offered us recommendations. I would totally stay here again!
Brad's place was unique and perfect for our Chicago stay. Linens & floors were squeaky clean. Bed & pillows were comfortable. The location is very walkable and great location.
Rachel and Brandon where amazing, their place was the perfect size for 5 people and was just a quarter mile walk from the Brown line. The neighborhood was peaceful and no issues at all.

had a wonderful stay here! home was clean, cozy, and in a quiet neighborhood! house was exactly as pictured. i had no issues, host was friendly and communicative with check-in/out rules! would stay here again!
Great place in a fantastic location.  Hosts are excellent communicators.
Super nice spot in a super convenient location! Would definitely stay again!

We had a great time during our stay! Everything was very clean and we loved finding all the little touches that made this place special. The location was quiet and peaceful while conveniently located just a few blocks from the blue line.
Erica's place was so nice and the perfect spot for my weekend trip. She is very kind and patient and helped me when needed. Would for sure stay here again :)
Very cozy!
Fantastic home, unique and beautiful. Location was incredible and allowed for easy access to public transport and walkable areas. Our host thought of everything.
Nette gastvrouw, snel antwoord, erg meedenkend en servicegericht. We hebben genoten van ons verblijf.
Greta place to stay for a quick trip
The Villa D’ Citta was wonderful to stay at! The shower was amazing even for having the smallest room in the home. It was perfect for me and my husband and close to a train station!
The apartment was a good size and very close to the redline which made it so easy to get around. Any questions I had were answered very quickly.
Perfect spot for 6 people. 20~ mins from downtown. Clean, modern, had all the essentials, host very responsive.
Great and cozy spot in a quiet neighborhood. Very accessible to the trains and quick 15 minute drive downtown.
Jamisyn was super nice and helpful! The place was perfect for the 5 of us and even had snacks and coffee! Such a lovely touch! We would come back here :)

Easily one of the best stays I've had in Chicago. Room was super comfy and the fan provided in the room was such a plus. Extremely safe neighborhood and all the amenities you could ask for. Hope I can stay again soon.

Finding a place to stay during Lollapalooza was no easy task, especially with accommodation prices soaring across Chicago. This ended up being a very last-minute booking, and without question, it was the best budget-friendly value we could have asked for. This place was helluva spacious, comfortable, and perfectly suited for all. It served as an excellent home base while also giving us the opportunity to discover some of the unique neighborhoods and spots beyond downtown Chicago. The host was truly exceptional a chief of command when it came to hospitality. Communication was prompt, thoughtful, and resourceful from beginning to end. While the property could certainly benefit from a bit of cosmetic maintenance and general upkeep to elevate the overall presentation, it did not take away from the value, comfort, or positive experience we had! Thank you Thaer!

Very clean space, and Nala was great at communicating during the trip! The music and noise from downstairs wasn’t bad, we were able to sleep through most of it. Do be mindful that other guests staying in the apartment may be loud and wake you up. Overall we were very happy with the space as well as how clean our room and the shared areas were. There’s also multiple bus stops in the area to get you where you need, so you can keep your car in the garage the whole trip if you want. We will 100% look to stay here again for future trips!
The room was very comfortable and works very well on a budget. Super clean and a very nice bathroom/common areas. Pretty close to public transport/ buses and easy to navigate into the city

I stayed here the week of Lollapalooza with four friends and the listing was exactly as described! Can't beat the price either! The host, Kendal, was very polite and responsive and left clear, concise instructions for check-in/out. The listing was very cute on the inside as well as spacious and extremely clean. The beds were extremely comfortable, as a bonus! The area was very nice and we felt secure at all times. It was an easy 15 minute drive to the heart of downtown and the Grant Park area. Would definitely recommend this place and we would absolutely book again!
This place was Amazing! Super clean and homey! Host was amazing!

We loved our stay. The AirBnB was one of the best we’ve ever stayed at. The neighborhood was great and everything we wanted to do was in walking distance.  The host was super responsive as well. We look forward to staying here again!
SUPERHOST!! Extremely responsive and very clean and spacious house. Everything went smoothly and we had a great and comfortable stay. The house was very nice for 8 friends to stay in.
Very nice and spacious! Bigger than expected from the pictures. Wynter was also very nice and communicative when she had to enter our space.
Had a great stay at this Airbnb! Looked exactly like the photos and was easy to access! Close to a CTA station which made traveling to downtown easy! Would recommend to anyone! Clean and safe!

Mykia's place worked out so perfectly for our girls' graduation Lolla Trip! The layout is so cute and we had all the space we needed. We cooked a lot since 2 of our girls are vegan & GL...great stove, very convenient. The couch is super comfy, too! The neighborhood is so friendly, which was a major highlight when I'm traveling with 5 young women in my care. Being across the street from the Green-Line train was an incredible plus! Cherry on top is what a thoughtful, responsive, helpful host Mykia is! It really meant so much to us! 💜 We loved our 5 day stay and can't wait to return!
This apartment was beautiful, in a perfect location, and exactly as described. Natasha was incredibly helpful and responsive every step of the way. We will definitely be returning!

Blanca was an excellent host. She was very responsive to all requests prior to our stay and very accommodating for us.
Blanca had listed all amenities for us and made us feel right at home. The place was very clean when we got there with ample towels, cooking supplies and cleaning supplies.
We had 8 people and were extremely satisfied with our stay.
For the price you cannot expect too much. Otherwise location is not that good, felt insecure in the zone where the airbnb is located. Restroom can not be closed and there was to much hair left behind
We had a bit of difficulty getting into the rental, but Phoebe was very responsive and arrived within the hour to help us in.
Great location close to Boystown and easy to get to Lolla, which was the purpose of our visit. Pretty comfy space for my group of 8.
We had a wonderful stay, very close to the L and the surrounding neighborhood is full of restaurants, shops and things to do.
Lester was so communicative when messaged about a concern we had during our stay. It was such a lovely place and in a beautiful part of the city!

I had no plans to make a complaint about the cleanliness of the place because it wasn’t that bad. There was trash left over and unfortunately molded in the coffee maker. I was just gonna let it slide and clean it myself. Until they messaged me after saying that I left feces behind from my Service dog. They sent me a picture of cat poop. My dog is 90 pounds there’s no possible way that it was his. So they requested $50 from me for compensation. They were very accusatory over this and even called my service dog a pet.
Confortable and very clean space with a friendly host.
Great spot reasonably priced! Host was responsive and it met our expectations.
Everything was wonderful and we were sufficiently accommodated!

Nothing less than amazing!! Meghan was so responsive when it came to before the stay and during. The location was great, a great little spot called Luella’s Southern Kitchen was right around the corner. Also, walking distance to the brown and blue line and a bus line. Would definitely stay here again.

As advertised, the Cub’s hangout was two blocks from the Waveland entrance to Wrigley Field! The location allowed us to just walk to the games and restaurants and even grocery store without having to get back in the car. 4th bedroom was a little awkward as its only access was through another bedroom.
Great communication and lovely home perfect for our visit.
Always a great time with Zen!
You get exactly what you paid for - small room, old building and shared space.

We had an amazing stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. And everything we needed was provided. Our host was incredibly kind, welcoming, and quick to respond whenever we had any questions, which made our stay even better. We truly enjoyed our experience and felt right at home. We would definitely come back and stay here again. Highly recommend!

Comfy, small-space living in an incredible location. Very comfortable bed and all the core necessities were provided.  The host was super responsive to us during our stay. Things we missed as we reviewed the listing - there's limited surface space and charging points (single nightstand/plugs, limited wall plugs), and no microwave save the shared one down two levels (stairs) in the lobby. There was also no TV in the living room, while there is a big TV in the bedroom. The TV was only a factor because we got rained in during part of our trip and wanted to watch TV/movie without being in bed or sitting at a distance at the kitchen table.  We cooked and did dishes every day, and noted space is extremely limited (counter space), but we managed by relocating/shuffling items while we used the kitchen. These weren't insurmountable issues - but be advised, as it's easy to miss during review of the listing.  Still a pleasant stay, and we loved visiting the area!

I stayed here to attend a festival and was pleasantly surprised by my stay! Shay was super responsive and accommodating to my arrival time and any questions I had. The Airbnb itself was clean and comfortable. The building is next to so many restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and more !! Getting in and out is easy just with a little guidance from Shay in the beginning. Super grateful to have stayed here for such a busy weekend! Thank you again and I highly recommend staying here :)
Nice space. Close to a bus stop. Host was quick to answer messages.
Leila was incredible communicative and the stay in her airbnb was very easy. All the instructions were clear and the place was very large.
Great stay, great hosts!
Such a good time!
Nice location in a good neighborhood and close to the train station.
We couldn't have asked for a nicer place for our weekend trip to Chicago. The location is very safe and within walking to public transportation, shops, and cool neighborhoods.

Had a lovely 2 nights stay. The place was very simple yet cozy and had everything we needed. Very accessible by bus or train. Closest bus stop is 5 mins away by and train is about 15 mins away. Thank you so much Carolina!
Katty's apartment was very clean, and in a great location close to the red line!

The location was very convenient for us. Both China town and downtown were very short Uber rides away. The house was very spacious and had enough room for all of us. Only one minor flaw for us was the front door tends to get stuck and the barn doors inside fall off easily. Overall, we would consider staying again
Perfect location, clean, great communication. Loved that it was walkable to Grant Park
Awesome place and a great neighborhood. Few min walk from blue line. Easy to get around and to from O'Hara. Highly recommend
It’s a great location if you want to go visit Wrigley Field! There were a lot of bars and restaurants to go to! Everything was right there! Would book again!

Jake’s Airbnb is the cleanest Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in! He’s super quick and responsive to any questions we had. His check-in and check-out instructions were super easy to follow. The location was great and easy access to the train. It’s also incredibly walkable and has a bunch of great food options nearby! Highly recommend staying with Jake!
This townhouse was so beautiful and clean! Emily was so responsive too and gave us an abundance of local recommendations!
She was great! Very responsive and the place was so clean!
The host was kind and helpful and the place was clean and perfect for our group!

Our stay at Stanley’s was great! They were super accommodating with our arrival and departure and the apartment’s location was extremely ideal. We loved our stay and would certainly return! Thank you both!
Great place to stay. Very clean and the area was very walkable and safe, even late at night!
Great entry instructions. Clean. As advertised. Would recommend. The price was right.
Loved staying here! The location is amazing and the room was very comfortable and welcoming, would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay at James’s property!  The rental is exactly as pictured.  The bathrooms appeared to be recently updated and were very clean.  The location was great for getting into downtown Chicago.  We felt safe to walk around the surrounding area. Would highly recommend this property!
Always love staying here! Lois and Eduardo are the best hosts ever!!
This airbnb was one of the best I’ve stayed at because its spotless clean, the host was so nice & it was so spacious! Its also pretty close to the train/subway which helped a lot.

This AirBnB was perfect for our large group in town for the music festival. It had everything we needed to be comfortable and room enough for everyone to have their own space. Another small point is that the beds/rooms are all the same size so there was no fighting over who got the better room! Check out was super easy too - basically we didn’t have to do anything - which was a super refreshing change from other places we’ve rented. We definitely recommend staying here!

The only real perk of this Airbnb was the location. While there wasn’t much around it, it was very close to the subway which we really appreciated.
However, we had many problems with this unit. To start, the hallways leading up to the unit smelled awful and the lobby looked old and worn out. Our bathroom ceiling was literally leaking water and they were slow to respond and fix the issue. They also did not notify us when the issue was fixed. When asked for compensation, our host did nothing to offer any remediation even though we were down a bathroom for over half our stay, leaving 7 people to 1 bathroom.
