Additionally, the bedroom walls were incredibly thin, we could hear noises from other units all night.
The bedding was incredibly thin, and felt very poor quality. We were missing towels and an air mattress, which I even confirmed with the host before hand would be there.
Host kept messaging us asking if we wanted all these extra upcharges which cheapened our stay as well.

The place was great!  Outstanding location and very walkable to food, shopping, and public transportation.  Easy check in and check out.  Hosts were responsive and knowledgeable.  I would definitely stay at their place again in the future.  Thank you!
Onelia was a gracious host and made us feel comfortable and at home. Clean space and very spacious had a great time. Overall I would recommend.

Sarah was such a welcoming host and so responsive to any questions we had. She was very flexible with check in and check out and had some snacks and such ready for us at arrival. The space itself was quite spacious and very private. The chickens and beautiful plants and such outside were a great added bonus! We were there to go into the city and I enjoyed that Logan Square is far enough out that it's quite quiet, but close enough to the main attractions of the city. Would definitely stay here again, thanks Sarah!
Our place got cancelled last minute for lollapalooza so this place was perfect for 3 people on a busy weekend!
Fantastic spot. I would stay there again.
Great place to stay for lollapalooza
Super easy check-in and the place was clean. The host kept us updated on any hotel maintenance that could impact or stay.

Great stay here in chicago! Nae was very responsive and accommodating to me and my friends for early check in and made sure we had everything we needed! Will definitely consider booking again when i’m in town!
Abia had a great space and was very accommodating for my group. Was in a great neighborhood and next to the train station which it made convenient to get to downtown Chicago!
We stayed here for a music festival and Nicholas was so helpful and friendly! Check in was seamless and we felt right at home

This place was a great place to stay while in town for lollapalooza. A great walking distance to the blue line. There were enough amenities to use for the five of us. The neighborhood felt safe and there’s an amazing cafe across the road. Would definitely stay again!

Had such a wonderful weekend staying here! We were in and out of the house a lot however so upset we missed Caryl’s famous breakfast!! Everything was clean and Caryl responds super fast and has lots of recommendations to help out since we were new to the city!

This Airbnb has everything you need for 2 people. We stayed here to attend Lolla and were able to get to and from under an hour using the red line. The private entrance and the bathroom inside the room made the stay super comfortable. They even accommodated an early check in which was super helpful on the first day! Thank you, we had a great stay.
AWESOME PLACE!! Great location, great access and super cozy!! Thank you  for everything! Highly recommend!
The host was kind, and the place was clean.
We loved our stay - the home was like a peaceful rainforest
Thanks for being a great host. Amazing, beautiful home!

Super comfy bed but challenging to get good sleep.
Pros: Comfy bed, comfy couch, near red line & grocery store, Sunday Farmer’s Market and Piano/Jazz club around the corner, 10 min walk to beach, Iris provided a great video to help make the check-in process easier, Iris responds quickly, strong AC in both bedroom & living room
Cons: Even with blackout curtain fluorescent light from grocery store lot shines into bedroom, grocery store gets deliveries at very early hours, on 2 out of the 4 nights the downstairs neighbor made a lot of noise that sounded like throwing boulders at the walls & screaming, so hard that we could feel the walls shake. One night this continued non-stop from 3am until 9am. When we peaked in the hallway other neighbors in the hallway indicated it was coming from downstairs and I got the impression from them that this wasn’t the first occurrence. Freezer seems to have issues as ice tray was full of water even on coldest setting (but refrigerator worked fine).

The location in Lincoln Park is fantastic! It’s a wonderful neighborhood for a morning walk, grabbing a cup of coffee, or going for a jog. Overall, it's very peaceful.
I was a bit taken aback by the steep stairs at first, but it wasn't a problem at all. As I stayed longer, I found it super convenient being close to public transit and not far from downtown either. The large table was also extremely useful!
If you stay here, I highly recommend having dinner at Summer House Santa Monica. It was our last dinner, and the atmosphere was wonderful. There are also local shops within walking distance, making it so much fun to explore!
Had a wonderful 5-night stay :)
Nice apartment in a nice area
Jim’s place is even bigger than the photos make it look! Very spacious & great for a stay with quite a few people. Would highly recommend!
Great location!
Amazing host, beautiful place!!
Antonios place was in the perfect spot ! Was walkable distance to wrigley field, food spots, and the train to go into the city.
This was a great place to stay! There are plenty of things to do near by and the location made it very easy to use the cta.

Auntie Yakini was super kind, caring, welcoming, and responsive!! She took really good care of us by providing us ponchos for the rain, brought our food in for us, and responded quickly when we had questions! The space was more homey and beautiful than the photos! We had an amazing stay here and would definitely come back to her beautiful home when we’re in Chicago! Auntie Yakini made our experience 100x better!
Robert’s place was amazing and he was very clear with instructions, which is always appreciated. Highly recommend!
Fine spot, didnt realize it’s an attic and bathroom in middle of living room

Very cute neighborhood, everyone keeps to themselves. Totally recommend this place for someone who needs a break. It really only does house 2 people so keep that in mind. Easy walk to and from the bus stops, which takes you directly to the 95th/Dan Ryan red line stop. Overall enjoyed my time here!!

It was very clean and easy to find! Definitely would book again. There’s shops a mile away and not that far from the public transport. The host was very responsive and the shared bathroom was clean! The stairs are steep to the upstairs so be aware of that.
Safe location and plenty of street parking available!

We had a very nice stay. Great location, close to downtown and walkable.
The apartment was clean and the rooms were spacious for 4 people.

Wonderful Airbnb! It’s a cozy spot. But it’s also large enough for 4 adults. The location is amazing. Cross the street and you have so many food and shopping options.  Michael as a host is incredible. Him and his team make sure everything is perfect. I could not recommend enough. So happy with my stay!
Thank you for the cozy space! Had a wonderful time.
Great stay
Easy check in and check out with a clean space
Great location and great communication from the host.  Good value for location
Would definitely stay here again!
Buena ubicación, acceso facil a las estaciones del tren y seguro.
Short walk to Wrigley and the red line. Felt exactly as described, like setting up a tent in the living room as a kid. We enjoyed our stay!
Great stay, in a great location. The Brown Line is insanely close.
Loved the place!

Maria was a great host. She communicated well and left clear instructions. The place is very quiet considering the location. Felt safe and comfortable. The location around it felt like being in the city. So everything was walkable. There is a near by target to get any supplies or groceries you may need. About a 12 min drive from downtown Chicago so Ubers were easy to get. Overall it was a good stay!
Amanda’s home was PERFECT for us. Very great area with a target in close proximity as well as being right there by the blue line. Very safe, very convenient, and very comfortable. Would book again!

Jorge’s place was great! Very clean and spacious. The bed was extremely comfortable and the ac units were greatly appreciated.
Jorge was an amazing host as well, very responsive and helpful with all of my questions.

I stayed here for 2 months during my summer internship as a college student coming from out of state! This area and building was beyond perfect and safe! The building has amazing amenities and came with about anything I needed. The apartment itself was perfect, clean, and had everything I needed stocked for me! If I didn’t have to go back to school I would have extended my stay! Joshua is the best… always very responsive and gave clear good instructions. Any time I had a slight issue it was fixed in the next hour. Would 110% recommend.

To be near Wrigley made the price doable for us. The unit was spotless and had all-new appliances and appointments. Hector could not have been more responsive and helpful. You will not be disappointed with this selection for your time in Chicago.

This was a decent place to stay, and the space was nicely decorated. We enjoyed our trip overall, but unfortunately experienced several issues during our stay. From difficulties getting into the property to trouble finding basic items we needed, the experience wasn’t as seamless as we had hoped. There were also some concerns with cleanliness, several standard Airbnb essentials seemed to be missing, and an aggressive dog at the neighboring property made us uncomfortable at times. While the space has potential and served its purpose for our trip, a few improvements in cleanliness, amenities, and overall guest preparedness would make for a much better stay.

My group and I booked this home for another year of Lollapalooza! We were very satisfied with the amount of bathrooms and space for getting ready, as well as spaces for relaxing after the festival. We had a really great time in Chicago again this year. However, the only problem for our group was that there was only two rolls of toilet paper, one roll of paper towel, and one trash bag for 5 people. For the long weekend we were there it didn’t work for us. We ended up having to DoorDash those necessities early on. Other than that, we had a great time. Thank you.

The host was very kind. There was a few things that were not clean some stains on the doors, and the 2nd bed room with the 2 full size bads the door doesn’t close not a big deal. The floor was not really that’s clean had to wear shoes the whole time but other than that it was a cozy home.

Colin’s place was great! We really enjoyed having access to the gated parking, it made it so easy to get in and out whenever we needed to without worrying about the hassle of finding a spot! The apartment its self was very spacious and had all the things you could possibly need/want! The neighborhood is very charming and there are many places within walking distance. I would definitely stay here again!
Such an amazing place to stay. Will definitely book again if I’m back in Chicago. It’s not at all far from downtown. The neighbors were super friendly. 10/10 would recommend.
Great host!! Had amazing communication and told us everything we needed to know.
This airbnb was beautiful and located in a great neighborhood! Rasheed was very clear with his instructions; we felt safe and right at home!
Great place and host! Instructions are clear and Brandon replies quickly. The location had easy access to public transit too.

This was an amazing stay for my group of 6 people. It was spacious, super clean and new, and had great amenities like laundry and full kitchen. SUPER comfy beds. Honestly the inside looks exactly like the pictures. The foosball table was also a hit! Surrounding neighborhood is not the cleanest but neighbors were friendly and it was easy to take transportation to Downtown Chicago. We thought it was a great deal and loved our stay. Azam was a great host too - very responsive when we needed anything.
Anna was great! Super nice and responsive. We would 100% stay again.

We had a great stay! Daniel was super helpful and very quick to respond when we had questions or issues! I agree with the past reviews, the upstairs neighbors are loud however it’s an older building so it could just be due to the make of the building! If you plan on ubering we did not have any issues getting one no matter the time! Close to the gas station also if you are in need of snacks ! Great experience overall !

The space was very clean, cozy, and well furnished! Also, we appreciated the good AC for the summer weather. The location is conveniently located for easy access to downtown Chicago either by rideshare or the CTA!
Really cool spot. Great rooftop patio, exactly as pictured. Close to public transit and walkable to Wicker Park shopping. I’d highly recommend. Julio is very accommodating and a wonderful host.

Vlad’s place is a 10/10.
You can tell this space was thoughtfully curated by Vlad and his family and isn’t just another generic bnb. The artwork was thoughtful, the space was well laid out, the couch was HUGE and extremely comfortable, the guidebook was a lovely touch, and Vlad was responsive and helpful when we had questions and some schedule changes.
It was also great getting to explore Bronzeville and learn about the rich history of the area.
Would recommend Vlad’s place to anyone looking for a place in Chicago and would happily come back!
房間舒適、乾淨、整潔、寬敞，廁所衛生，而且廚房方便使用。但房東人很好，我因為航班取消的關係需要預訂房東另外一間房間，房東協助我把我的行李移動到第二間房。
Great

Richard's place was amazing! It was very clean and easy to find. We felt safe and comfortable during our stay. Richard was a great host who went above and beyond. When we ordered delivery that arrived before we did, he helped us bring the food inside without asking.
Pluses- The fridge was spacious and had an icemaker. The AC was great and kept us cool even when it was hot and humid outside.
Cons- The walls/floors are thin, so we could hear tenants in the other units moving around, especially in the morning. It didn't keep us up at night because we were night owls, but be aware sleeping in could be difficult.
Rhonda was lovely and the space was great for our long weekend!
Great location & plenty of space for our group.

The space is very comfortable and the main room is spacious and nice. The second room was comfortable as well. The area isn’t recommended to walk around and this space is truly a good place just to sleep on your trip and come back to from a day of activities, I would just always be careful. Only con would be the smell of the hallway and kitchen area but we just used spray that was in the bathroom to keep it fresh. Thank you for this experience!

Great place to land in the more south side of Chicago, while still being close to grocery, public transit, and popular destinations.
(I get the loaded grits from Roux everytime I’m in the area!!)
The whole place was more no-frills but definitely kept spotless and ran smoothly.
Cyndi is an excellent host!
Beautiful, modern building with tall ceilings, amazing views and friendly people! Thanks very much!
Great place! Really enjoyed our stay! Had a minor issue during stay and Kohen immediately had someone come fix it! Quick responses and lovely unit 5 stars!
Super easy communication and clear instructions. We stay there for biz trip and the house had everything we need.
It was a great and easy stay!

Nice location if you want to be right in the heart of the city! Walkable to everything you would need and want. Train right out your window a lil noisy. Cute space but a lot smaller than expected. Pool was nice to have but not as nice as pictures, chairs were trashed from the weather I’m guessing, pool also sits right next to the dog pad on the roof and smells like dog piss so that is nice while laying by the pool. I’d say its fit more for 2 guest no way anymore can sleep comfortably.
Will be my go to place to stay when I’m in Chicago next.  The host was always prompt to respond to any questions.  No complaints.

one of the best places i’ve stayed!  the place is absolutely beautiful. i was worried about staying in a house with other people but it was actually a great experience. everyone was so kind and i even made some friends :). the space is very homey and there’s a cute little area to sit outside

The place is very cute, the beds are comfortable and it has a good kitchen and living room. Street parking was easy. It isn't super close to any of the train lines but it is just a 5 or 10 minute walk from multiple shopping areas with good restaurants.

Daniel’s place was amazing! It felt private and out of the city while also being so close to so many amenities. Trader Joe’s and a local coffee shop only a 5 minute walk, the train was only a 5 minute walk with a 10 minute ride into downtown. I felt very safe in the area with my group of 5 and nothing was “too far”. When we come back for Lollapalooza we will easily book here again! Thank you for having us!
Erica's place was awesome! Every time we come to Chicago we will be staying here!
Cute spot in a nice area and easy to get downtown. Would recommend overall!
Great place if you need a place to stay after landing from ORD. Easy to get to places in the city using buses/light rails. The place is clean and comfortable!
Great place, reasonably priced, would stay again!
Michael is an A+ host. House was clean and as advertised right in Wrigleyville. Go cubs!
Amazing. No notes. Would book here again!

Stayed here over Lollapalooza weekend and was well worth the money for the convenient location! We also had so much fun at the hotel with all their activations and freebies for guests. Lovely rooftop with gorgeous views of the Chicago architecture, and lots of places to see and dine nearby. Check in was little confusing because they were training new staff, but we were understanding and ultimately just grateful they were able to have a room ready early for us. Would stay here again and definitely recommend!

Milan was a wonderful host and we genuinely enjoyed every second of our stay!!  He was very responsive, thoughtful, and kind which made us feel welcome and at home in the space!! Would give him 6 stars if possible!!!!

Zheng was an amazing host! Extremely hospitable, helpful, communicative and a great guy to have a conversation with. The room was very clean, the bed was comfy and the bathroom was always clean. I definitely recommend staying at Zheng's place during your stay in Chicago.
Great location, spacious, large master bedroom, comfy beds.

Truly a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb! The host was incredibly responsive throughout my trip, which made everything easy from check-in to check-out.
The location in Logan Square was excellent. The neighborhood felt safe and lively, with lots of people out walking, jogging, and walking their dogs, which gave it a welcoming atmosphere.
The only thing worth noting is that the stairs leading up to the upstairs bed are quite steep. If you’re older or have mobility issues, this may not be the best fit. However, if you don’t have any mobility concerns and don’t mind climbing steep stairs, it’s perfectly manageable and wasn’t an issue personally.
Overall, I had a great experience and would absolutely stay here again!
Great location! Walkable to Wrigley and other great spots. Freddy was great and very responsive. Would definitely come back!
Room matched listing.  Roompicks is merely a middle man, taking a cut, like Ticketmaster. Prices are high enough due to event schedule. Next time I will book via direct site.
Carrie was very responsive and helpful in making her home feel like yours!
The host was accommodating for us and left a wonderful place to sleep in. We could not have asked more for anything else.
The host was very welcoming and responsive. We had a great stay and felt very private and comfortable the whole time. I would recommend this lovely coach house as a cozy stay in Chicago.
This was a great place to stay! Very walkable to many coffee shops and restaurants and also very close to the train. I would definitely stay again!

10/10 recommendation Stay one is so secure staff is very friendly and amazing makes you feel right at home and the room was nice and spacious traveled with 4 ladies everyone had space to stretch out and get dolled up! And sleep comfortably
Anthony has been a great host! Well worth the stay!!

C'était un super séjour,  on a créé un véritable lien, un grand merci, c'est l'une des meilleures expérience que j'ai eu, les animaux sont très attachants, vraiment je recommande, vous allez être avec des hôtes qui seront vous aidez si nécessaire !
A pretty nice stay and a clean home! Ray was super helpful and responsive. When we had a little situation getting in one night, he offered a solution quickly!

Great spot to stay!  Highly recommend this for anyone looking to explore the city without having to pay downtown prices. I wish the location was slightly closer to the blue line, but there are lots of busses that are very convenient to connect you to the L.
Nikka was a fabulous host!
Great job I love the house
Very responsive host. Clean house and everything you'll need is there for your stay. Would definitely book again for a bigger group.
Perfect spot, close to everything we wanted to do. Hotel is pretty standard, worth it for the price :)

Place was a short walk away from the train station and near a beautiful walking trail. There’s plenty of amazing local restaurants nearby and of course the arcade games adds a nice touch. Would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a place in Chicago. Matthew is also a very quick responder and offers a wonderful guidebook of places to check out in the area.
Host was fantastic at communicating.   Gave amazing local recommendations and was very responsive.
Quiet, conveniently located near Lincoln Park next door to a tasty breakfast lunch spot. Good late night pizza out the back alley or around the block.

Overall a fantastic experience and would recommend. The couch in the living room is very uncomfortable and recommended getting a newer one as its the only place to relax in that room. Dining chairs were a little rickety but probably needed screws tightened. Otherwise a great place to stay the weekend or longer if needed.

From start to finish, this penthouse was perfect for our party of 6!  It was exactly as advertised and had everything you could want and need.  The owners were proactive in communicating all details re check-in and out, and also provided so much additional information about the area and Chicago in general.  We really loved the neighborhood (River North) and its wonderful restaurants and attractions.  It was our first visit to Chicago and will not be our last.  We would definitely stay here again - thank you!

Alec’s Airbnb was one of the best we have stayed in! We’ve come to Chicago a few times and this was by far the most clean and spacious places we have stayed. The kitchen was well stocked and the outside area is very nice. The area seems quiet and safe and Alec was a great host.

Had a great stay! No full kitchen was a bummer but we made it work! It did rain majority of the time we were there and water did come up from the floor in a few places but nothing serious! Wish the couch was a little more comfortable but other than that no complaints!

This place was top notch and was even better than the photos. Very clean and set up perfect for our 5 night stay.  Work area was appreciated since I had to work a little while here. Washer and dryer are a definite bonus. Nicely equipped kitchen, great towels, bath supplies and water pressure. The linens were nice and beds very comfy. The beautiful and safe neighborhood location is just a couple of blocks to Lincoln Park Zoo which we walked to a few times and a great ice cream/yogurt place right across the street.  Easy pick up and drop off for Uber/Lyft. Highly recommended and the cost is definitely worth every penny.

First, Ryan was an excellent host. He was clear, responsive, and friendly. The house was BEAUTIFUL. If old houses are your thing, this is a great stay.
While it is mentioned in the description that the area is under an improvement project, it would be a disservice to not let other female travelers know that this is not a good area to travel alone, or even in pairs. Our first night, we met up with two other girls from the BNB to walk back from the train and we were harassed/catcalled on the street, then followed to the AirBNB by a group of men. This was a scary experience and while not Ryan's fault AT ALL, it would feel dishonest to not share this with anyone looking for accommodations. Be very aware of your surroundings and carry protection if you can. It is not a risk I would take again. We were catcalled again the following night, but not followed.
Inside the home we felt safe, even without locking bedroom doors. Thank you for your hospitality, Ryan!

The place was exactly like the description and Marijes was very responsive and helpful. The place was pretty clean and very comfortable to stay in. The location was also really peaceful and walkable to a lot of things.
Christian was a great host and extremely responsive! The property was perfect for what we needed for the weekend. Great Location and many walkable restaurants and shops. Thank You

We had a great stay in Hyde Park at Kyriako’s place. The neighborhood was peaceful. There are some coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance, as well as a CVS and Target for anything you might’ve forgotten to pack. It is around 15-20 mins (walk) from the train station as well, which is convenient for getting into the city.
The unit was clean and looked just like the pictures. The apartment building was quiet and felt secure. Kyriako was always responsive and gave excellent instructions! It was a perfect place to stay to spend the night and get out to explore the city.

Had an amazing stay at this airbnb, is a nice location close to coffee shops and a quick drive or scooter ride over to the blue line train station. Host was very responsive and the place was very well kept. Beautiful home with a lot of amazing character, would definitely recommend and stay again!
Claudia was an amazing host. The apartment was clean and accommodated our stay very well. I will definitely look into staying here if I go back to Chicago.
The place was in a great location!  The only issue we had was our initial outside door code wasn’t correct.  But he was very responsive to get us in!

위치도 좋고,청결하고 분위기도 좋고 너무 멋진 숙고였습니다.
근처에 큰 공원을 산책하면서 들에 핀 꽃들 보면서 걷는것도 너무 좋았습니다. 호스트의 답변도 매우 빠르고 머무는 동안 불편함 없이 편히 지냈습니다. 👍 최고.
Tone was a great host and the property was very large.  The girls loved their stay.
Great house, fit 12 comfortably, would highly recommend
Great place to stay with the family. Plenty of space, clean, and modern space. They really thought out all of their amenities and took time to make the Airbnb feel like a home away from home.

This place is a great stay if you are on a budget! The area is very peaceful even through it is close to Wrigley Field I never thought it was noisy. They responded to my messages within a hour typically and communicated very well for check in and check out instructions. The only downside I will say is that you have to share a bathroom with multiple people. This is fine if you are staying with 4 around people in total in the apartment but, during my stay I shared it with around 7 so that was a little difficult especially when someone was showering and I just need to use the bathroom or brush my teeth etc.But again for the price it was not a bad experience overall and I would book again if I needed another budget friendly place to stay in Chicago!

Greg’s place is a good option if you’re looking for an affordable, basic stay. The location is a short uber, or maybe a 25minute walk, from the train station that takes you right into the city. Be aware there is no outdoor jacuzzi (it is just a bath) and the place is stocked with the bare minimum. One towel each, no coffee or tea or any basic kitchen supplies, so bring your own.
We enjoyed our stay at the house! The house was spacious and clean. It was great to come back after our long days in the city to rest and recharge.
Excellent location. Get a trie feeling for the people of chicago,
Tara’s place is in the perfect location! Very quiet and short walk to great restaurants and the train. She was responsive and flexible with check-in. I would definitely stay here again!
We had a great time at this Airbnb! Close to everything in Andersonville, tons of space, great amenities. Four king-sized beds was also amazing! Thanks for a great stay!
Great place to stay
This is a great place! Excellent location and quiet area close to transits. We will keep this on our list and come back! Thank you!!
Milan was very responsive with all of our questions. There was a minor issue that he had resolved within minutes. Would recommend staying here again.
Our stay here was absolutely perfect.  The apartment is beautiful with amazing views.  The hosts were so helpful too!

We stayed here for Lollapalooza and, as none of us are from Illinois, we were not familiar with what areas were considered safe or unsafe. Since the festival ended late at night, we were coming home at a later hour than what would be “safe”. Although no issues were reported, I will say it may not be the safest place for non-locals (more so at night of course).
We encountered some issues such as the air mattresses not working/missing, the dust pan missing, the upstairs AC not working, and only 1/3 of the keys working. Russell was very responsive and ended up sending us new air mattresses to use during our stay.

Shuang’s place was amazing for our first time in town. Extremely accommodating host and the personal touches they left really made the difference in our trip. Very happy we were able to stay here, and hope to be back one day!

Bryan was great, responsible, and accommodating! The space was perfect, especially during Lollapalooza. We took the subway easily to and from the festival. Logan Square is a great location with lots to do. The Airbnb grants access with physical keys, but that wasn’t an issue…the keys stayed in its own short pockets when out. Very secure space! Would recommend Airbnb and location again.
Sandra’s place was great! Private, Clean and cool in the summer heat. Thank you Sandra!

My 2 sons and I stayed at Laura’s place for a long weekend for lollapalooza. It was the perfect getaway from the huge crowds in the middle of the city. And yet, it was easily accessible to the bus and orange train line.
We loved the neighborhood, the cozy and tidiness on the inside, the comfort of the beds , and the place was spotless and well appointed.
Laura was kind and responsive. She took care to check in with us. I really appreciate her receptive nature! We truly loved staying here and would love to return.

Excellent host, very helpful and responsive. Apartment is beautiful and so easy to access nearby neighbourhoods and the city itself. Vibrant location. Apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay.

WF was an amazing host! The apartment was extremely clean, cozy, and accommodated our group perfectly. It was conveniently located just a short walk from a bus stop, making it easy to head downtown and explore. The neighborhood was peaceful and quiet, which made our stay even more enjoyable. We had an amazing time and would definitely stay here again!
Very cozy, around a safe, quiet neighborhood. Very near to Chinatown and CTA red line! Will come back next time

Stayed here while in town for a music festival- great location it’s an easy bus ride to the metro. Beautiful and modern with lots of places to sleep. Matt was also very helpful when and responsive as well.
Host was incredibly kind and responsive. The accommodations were very clean and organized.
We absolutely loved our stay here! Looked exactly like the photos. Hosts super friendly and responsive! Great nightlife around, super close to train. Perfect for our stay in Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay! Nick was an incredibly friendly, welcoming, and responsive host from start to finish. Communication was always quick and helpful. When we accidentally locked ourselves out of the apartment, he responded immediately and helped us get back inside without any hassle. It was also my birthday during our stay, and Nick went out of his way to make it feel extra special, which was such a thoughtful gesture and truly appreciated. The apartment was exactly as described, and his hospitality made our trip even more memorable. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend staying with Nick!
Had a great stay!

Close to where I needed to be and the perfect size for a solo traveler. Clean and had all I needed to clean. The bathroom had all you needed regarding cleaning products. This is the place to get if you need to be downtown and in the middle of things!
Si buscas un lugar para dormir en Chicago bien conectado y fácil acceso el lugar de Michael es excelente
Erika was very thorough in providing detailed information about the stay!! Convenient location for Lollapalooza. We appreciate you Erika!

Weihong is a responsive and helpful host. The place is easily walkable from the nearest bus and train stations (~15min).
It was a great place to stay for our weekong stay on Chicago.
Great spot steps away from Lake Michigan. Safe, quiet location, a short walk to train station.

Very clean and looks just like the photos. My only complaint is that the smoke alarm is very sensitive and will go off when cooking on the stove even when the overhead fan is on. Other than that, great place and good location.
Super kind, responsive, and close to the train.

We had a great time staying here! It felt like I was staying with a friend. Emily got back to us quickly when we had questions and I appreciated with flexibility since our plans changed during the stay. I would be happy and lucky to stay here again the next time we are in town!

I can't say enough good things about this stay! The place itself was easy to locate, comfortable, and just about as close as you can get to the train station. My friend and I came for a festival, and Jeannette was very flexible with our needs and even stocked up the fridge full of waters for us. I would absolutely stay here again!
Augustine was great and very responsive. My group and I enjoyed our stay.
Loved our stay! Super cute space and perfect for a weekend getaway.
Lovely simple spot in a good location, appreciated having a garage for parking and bike storage!
Great location!
Lake was very attentive, responsive, and accommodating. Appreciate the AC working well since Chicago can be very humid.
Excelente lugar, recomendado ampliamente. El lugar coincide con lo descrito en el anuncio y la zona donde se encuentra es muy tranquila.

Lovely apartment right near bus and L transportation. Walkable to Wrigley and some fun bars across the street. It was a great home base during Lolla weekend, easy enough to get downtown but away from the chaos to get some quiet.

From the second, we walked in my family was so happy about the place. From the space that we had to the convenience of it everything was great. The hosts were extremely responsive and even called to make sure I had their phone number just in case we needed anything. The location is super convenient. About a five minute walk to target.  The patio is great.  So relaxing and private.  We enjoyed every part of our stay!

Had the most wonderful stay at Edgewater Place. The style of the interior is so charming, unique, and cozy. In pristine condition, too. I stayed here with my family as it was their first time in Chicago, and they fell in love with this Airbnb’s uniquely Chicago charm.

What a great place for a long Chicago weekend. Everything was great and as disrupted! Master bedroom had a steam room in the shower which was a fun surprise! The parking was easy and we had 3 cars there! Definitely will stay here again! Highly recommend ❤️
We really enjoyed staying at David’s place! It was perfect for our group, and we had plenty of room as a group of 8. The place was spotless and cozy. Highly recommend David’s place to anyone!

Ryan’s place was beautiful and comfortable! It was a great find while in town for lollapalooza!  The check in process was easy and flexible! The location was amazing as there was free street parking that was safe, and it was walkable distance to the train station! Ryan was also very responsive and helpful and provided amazing facts about his house! Would 100% recommend this place!
Had a great time staying here. Very convenient for people going to cubs games as well as staying close to the city but without having to stay inside the city. Overall would stay again.
Clean place, host is very responsive and willing to help!
Great spot! Would go back again!
I stayed at Gil’s place for a month and enjoyed our chats. Would definitely recommend!
Very thorough and responsive!

Thermostat was set to 77* so with that and my room receiving sunlight all day it was rather hot in my room and made it hard to sleep peacefully.  Kitchen counter wasn't very clean. Dropped some ice on it and wiped the water off and paper towel turn yellow with dirt. House is in a peaceful community within just a few minutes of everything you could need or want to do.

This place exceeded my expectations!  Beautiful, cozy, very clean, and a perfect location.  For being in the heart of trendy, vibrant Southport, you don’t hear anything from this unit.  I will book again and again when I’m in Chicago because it just felt like home!  Very happy with it!!!
The place was very nice and perfect for what we needed! The area was very quiet and close to public transportation!
Great experience, home, and top notch communication. Highly recommend.
Great place very clean and comfortable

Everyone that stayed with us had a great time. Ajay went above what we asked and was super responsive when we reported a small issue. We were able to walk to Wrigley, and had plenty of room for a party of our size. Multiple kitchens provided spaces for each floor, but were large enough that our whole party could entertain. Overall, fantastic stay. Thanks!

I would 100% recommend this place to anyone going to Chicago. It was a 15-20 mins drive to the city, which was very convenient. Everything in the Garden stay was clean, spacious and very updated. I had a great experience here and so did all of the guests.
Great place! Good food options very close, also easy to get around on public transit
Dominique and Marcus were very kind and attentive to detail. Thanks so much for everything!
Such a cute place in a great neighborhood in Chicago! Very comfortable with all the little things to make your stay away from home just perfect!
Great stay and great hosts!

Assel did well with communications and the apartment worked out great for a bunch of guys. Nice location with surrounding area being just average. Initial appearance of walking into the building was nasty. Dirty hallways and steps leading into the apartments was not clean at all. Once in the apartments, things were much better. Parking was tight, but could just fit two vehicles as described. Overall satisfaction was good, but the price for a two day rental was way too high for what we had in my opinion.

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb. The house was perfect for our large group, with plenty of space to relax and spend time together. The spacious living areas, pool table, hot tub, sauna, dart board, and other amenities kept everyone entertained throughout the trip. The only minor issue was that the parking situation was confusing at first, but after the first night we figured out the best arrangement and had no problems for the remainder of our stay. Great place in a quiet neighborhood!
Loved staying at Angie's! Perfect location and she was great and helpful!
Great location and a very responsive host. 10/10 would recommend

Great place to stay!
Great stay & excellent host!
Extremely clean, comfortable, and convenient!

Comfortable apartment in a good Lakeview location, easy check-in. Two things worth knowing: the noise sensor is very sensitive and sits near the front door—either A/C or a nearby white noise machine triggered repeated alerts overnight. And the property is managed by a company rather than the host; I got an unidentified after-midnight call about "reports of noise," which cost me a good deal of sleep and two Lyft rides to check on family in the unit. No response to my messages after the stay.

From the start, frank was very responsive and accommodating. Location is close to a lot of good food spots. It’s about a 45 min train to downtown and roughly 20 min drive. Space is very clean and put together and spacious as we had the entire top floor to ourselves. Only slight issue is that the wifi connection is a bit inconsistent, which he did tell us beforehand depending on where it’s used from but as long as you are in the kitchen area, you’ll be fine. Overall frank went above and beyond in making our stay enjoyable.
I was very happy with my stay.  The place was clean and I enjoyed walking to the near by businesses. I was also  greatful to be able to check in early. I would stay here again!
Nice budget place

This is a great place to stay if you are looking for a clean, well kept property in the heart of one of Chicago’s best neighborhoods. Vin was also an excellent host. Very responsive and gave clear instructions for accessing the apartment. Would 100% book this spot again.
Very friendly and resp. i felt connected to the host. place was as advertised. love the flexibility with checking in and out. great location
Great location outside of the city. For a Cubs weekend was still easy to commute to Wrigley.
Clean, quiet, great stay!

Amazing stay! Quaint apartment in the Hyde park area. Excellent service and apartment was very clean. Plenty of snacks. Quiet neighborhood and felt safe walking at night. Would definitely stay here again!
Great location. Lots of room for sleeping many people. This is a simple safe place to stay and hosts are very very nice. If you are looking for an affordable option, this is a good spot!

Great basement apartment & great location in Roscoe Village - close to the Addison Brown Line stop, coffee shops & restaurants.
We visited the city for the weekend & this place was perfect. Great stay for games at Wrigley. About a mile away - 20 minute walk.
The place was so cozy, clean & had cute Chicago themed decor.
Mark’s place was as described & yes at 7:30 AM we could hear his little kids (as he shares could happen) but wasn’t an issue for us.
Street parking is convenient & FREE! We were very busy during our short trip, & it was nice to be able to come back to a home vs. a cramped hotel room. Neighborhood was safe & quiet.
Mark is super responsive & friendly. Check in/out instructions were clear. Will stay here again when returning to Chicago. Thank you so much possibly see you in the fall if not next Spring!

This home was super comfortable and extremely spacious. Ideally perfect for 3+ people but worked perfectly fine for 3 people optimizing privacy and alone time. There are great nearby cafes, markets and restaurants and we especially enjoyed the 606 walk which is right down the block!
The property was comfortable, clean, and perfect for our needs. Parking was fairly easy to find every night after our touristy adventure.
Good location and place was quiet and comfortable for our stay. Would recommend.
Great stay and host, and great location!

Josh and Gloria were absolutely fantastic! They were great at communicating and came through when other Airbnb’s canceled at the last minute. The place is very nice and clean. Great for larger groups.
We enjoyed staying here on our trip and felt very secure and safe at all times.
Loved the place and location. Would definitely stay again!
This is an AMAZING location and Kate is a wonderful and really responsive host!
One of the nicest places we’ve ever stayed. Everything was perfectly clean and highest quality. From the dream kitchen to the cozy towels, this place was top notch
Beautiful home and a beautiful neighborhood. Near the train station so that helped so much. Lovely host and cute cats! We hope to be back next year :)

The unit is even better than it looks in the photos. It’s spacious, in a great location, and it’s easy to get around using public transportation.
The host has rules about not having parties in the apartment and observing quiet hours. However, when I arrived around 11:00 p.m., there was a party going on. The good thing is that the noise didn’t carry much into the apartment, so it wasn’t too disruptive.
This place was perfect for a relaxing weekend in Chicago! It was clean and spacious and within walking distance to the L and Garfield Park conservatory.

The property is spacious and beautiful.   The kitchen is amazing!  Walking to the stadium or all the local restaurants and pubs was easy and always felt safe.  Highly recommend if you are going to Chicago.

This place was in the perfect location for the wedding we were attending!
Paula was very quick responding to out early check in request, a question about door code to get in once we arrived & checking on something very important I left behind!

Exactly what we needed for a busy weekend! Great location, easy to get to Lu pic transport. A great host. Couldn’t ask for anything else!

Such a great place to stay in Chicago, close uber drives to downtown. Space was very peaceful and clean. Lara was extremely responsive with communication and kept in touch throughout our stay and made sure we got in okay.
Would stay here again and recommend to others.

Spencer was an amazing host our bachelor party had such a great time in this area with breweries close by and being able to walk to the Cubs game. I would recommend this Airbnb 10 out of 10 times. if ever back in Chicago will definitely be staying at this Airbnb. this host was an outstanding communicator answering questions months ahead of our stay and also checking in with us daily to see if we needed anything while in the home.

This place had an endless amount of space.  But all you need is that front porch, we spent all of our free time hanging out there.  This was a perfect location and bedrooms for two families and our adult kids.

Freddy is great. Very responsive and friendly. Our group of five adults stayed at Freddy’s place for three nights. We were able to walk to Wrigley Field for Cubs games and to the L to ride the train to the city. We also enjoyed walking to great bars and restaurants in the area.
We loved the place! It was close to where we were going, clean, and very roomy

My fiancée and I stayed at Wesley’s loft for a weekend trip to Chicago to catch a Cubs game, and it was the perfect place for our visit. The location couldn’t have been better. The neighborhood is very walkable with plenty of great restaurants, and Wrigley Field was an easy trip on the Red Line.
The loft itself was private, spotless, and very comfortable. We felt right at home from the moment we arrived. Wesley was an excellent host, providing clear check-in instructions and responding quickly to any questions we had.
We would absolutely recommend staying here if you’re visiting Chicago, especially if you’re planning to catch a Cubs game.

Stayed for 3 nights at Tracy’s home and had an amazing experience. Tracy was extremely proactive and communicative about all aspects of our stay. She provided early check-in to help accommodate our group traveling into town at different times.
The location is the perfect walking distance away for anyone wanting to enjoy Wrigleyville. I would highly recommend this place if you’re wanting to stay in a peaceful home, with plenty of places to go within 5 minutes of walking.
All rooms are exactly as described, and were extremely well-kept.
Thank you for making a bachelor party weekend an incredible experience!
Great home and location. I’ll definitely recommend
Great host, best location, clean rooms. Loved it

Kyriako is the most responsive host I have ever had! I did have a few questions, and she replied within minutes. It is quiet and private. The lake is a 5-minute walk from the studio, and getting around is very easy. Highly recommend it and will return when I visit Chicago again. Thank you!

We had a great stay at Mark and Hanna’s place in Buck Town. Big group of guys going to a Cubs game. Not far from the train and the Bagelero across the street was quite convenient for our group of guys.
Hanna was incredibly active in the messenger and was responsive when we needed her. Would stay again.
Jay did a beautiful job creating a welcoming, inviting, and thoroughly enjoyable place to stay. We would definitely stay here again!
Great for a weekend getaway!
My stay at lairbnb was wonderful! It was exactly what we needed and Iris and Niko were so accommodating and had quick response time! I would definitely stay again.

Laura's home was a perfect place to stay for our group visiting the city. The stay was cozy and the beds comfortable. It was a reasonable walk to the orange line and there were several resturants in the quiet neighborhood we enjoyed after a day in the city.

Perfect spot to celebrate our friends 30th birthday! Quiet neighborhood, away from the craziness of downtown and we could still easily uber to all the spots we wanted to visit. Jennifer responded immediately anytime we had questions and offered great suggestions for places nearby. Highly recommend!
Great spot!
Susie helped to make this a great stay!

Anthony was a wonderful host! He was very responsive and helpful. The unit is a bit out-dated and needs some TLC but Anthony was super accommodating in resolving the issues we experienced.  Thanks again, Anthony!
Very communicative and helpful. Calm, relaxing home!

Very nice home could’ve been a little cleaner and the location was hard to find but other than that it was a nice stay quiet neighborhood the host was very nice and responsive I will have no problem staying here again!!!!
Place was just as described. Very near UChicago.
Great location and host communicated well. Very clean and safe area! Highly recommend!

Great modern place, responsive host, good location to be anywhere quickly.
Perfect for larger groups exploring CHI-town!
Nice hotel, but far too high priced for a hotel stay. Also the restaurant was expensive as well.
This apartment is in a nice quiet neighborhood. I wish it was a little bit closer to the rest of Chicago, but it was a decent price for the location.
Great location! Easy to access public transportation. My friend and I had a lovely stay.

Check in was easy and everything looked like the pictures. Floors seemed to either be stained or dirty with yellow stuff on the bathroom floor. There was no toilet paper for the first day when I got there. There was a rain storm that caused the bathroom plumbing to back up and leave a mess throughout the place (no fault of the host) but they did not seem to have much urgency to resolve it as quick as possible and they were somewhat accusatory that I was the one that caused the problem. Plumber verified that the drains couldn’t handle the rain causing the back up nothing I had done. The location was nice with walkability to many places and public transit. It was very convenient that the neighborhood has free street parking as well.
Shay was incredibly accommodating through the duration of my stay.
Had a good stay at Jacob's place. He was very friendly and responsive.
Great place to stay!
Loved our stay. Loved our hosts. We had a wonderful time and recommend them to anyone and look forward to another stay in the future.
Cool area with plenty to do within walking distance
This was a perfect place to stay for our trip! Great location, super clean space and Tawney was very responsive and helpful!
Great place, beautiful back yard space.

Shaun was an excellent host and very responsive. He was very helpful in providing anything needed for the stay. The place is nice and close to public transit which was great for getting around the city. Would definitely recommend the Avondale Gem to others looking to visit Chicago.
The place and host were great! Stayed for 3 summer months and would highly recommend.
Clean and spacious Airbnb. Plenty of beds and extra linens. Well stocked kitchen with appliances and dishware. 20 minutes from downtown and in a quiet neighborhood.
Great host and stay. Would be happy to stay again
Perfect place to stay for a few nights! Exactly like the photos & host was very accommodating and responsive.

Roseanne’s place made it convenient to get in and out of downtown while staying in a quiet, safe neighborhood. There was plenty of space for our family of four. The beds and couches aren’t super comfortable, but the price is right for the location. The kitchen is well stocked (although we didn’t cook while we were there).

Super convenient and accessible by the orange line and 62 bus. Convenient if you’re out and about through most of the day. Henry provided a lot of the essentials and very efficient contactless check in.

We had an absolutely fantastic stay and couldn't have been happier with our experience. The host was outstanding from start to finish: incredibly responsive, welcoming, and genuinely committed to making sure we had everything we needed. Their attention to detail and hospitality truly set this property apart.
The home itself was perfect for our group. It was comfortable, beautifully maintained, and exactly as described. Every space was thoughtfully designed and well-equipped, making it easy for everyone to relax and enjoy their time together. We immediately felt at home.
What really stood out was how seamless and enjoyable the entire experience was. From check-in to check-out, everything exceeded our expectations. It is clear that the host takes great pride in providing an exceptional guest experience, and it shows in every aspect of the property.
We made wonderful memories during our stay and would return in a heartbeat. If you're considering booking this property, don't hesitate.
Saurin was a good host

Our group was 2 adults, 4 teens, and 1 ten year old. We are all family who flew in from the east and west coasts for a summer vacation meetup, including 1 day of Lollapalooza ‘26.
The place is fantastic and exactly as advertised. The location is great with tons to do in walking distance. The outside patio is so fun to spend time on and has a spectacular view of the city.
The entire place was spotless when we arrived and the hosts were very responsive. It was a dream stay - could not have asked for a better experience.

We had a great stay at this apartment. The apartment is in a great location in walking distance from restaurants and bars. The host was very responsive and provided clear instructions for check in. Would highly recommend.

The house was in a nice location with lots of places easily accessible either by foot or public transit. The house itself was in good condition and had everything needed to accommodate our group. We definitely had a great time.

We felt right at home in Justin’s place.
I would like to say it was one of the cleanest Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in. I would highly recommend Justin’s place.
Great stay for a baseball game!
Had a lovely stay at Megan’s place. The kitchen was very well equipped and the apartment was spacious. Would recommend this spot if your itinerary brings you to this area!

Stayed here with some friends for LOLLA weekend. Walkable to the Obama museum and or a quick hop on and off ride with the CTA.
Place was as described except one of the rooms (not pictured) was more a day bed and not an actual full size mattress. Everyone enjoyed their living quarters nevertheless.
There was a noise complaint given by someone during our stay but we honestly believed it was just nosy neighbors as we felt we were only ones inhabiting the building since it was oddly quiet at all hours of the day.
All in all a solid 8.5/10.

The good: Amazing location, easy walk to water and tons of cool things, esp Wrigley Field…. Slightly problematic on the way in because a game was ending & they block off lots of streets nearby. Just be conscious of your timing if there is a game going on. Host was super friendly & VERY responsive.
The bad: The sofas and the dining chairs pictured in the listing are NOT what is in the unit. What is there is cheap, old, & (most importantly) uncomfortable which was a big bummer for a rainy weekend girls trip when we just wanted to hang out and chat. The mattresses and pillows are also cheap & broken down and not very comfortable. Rust stains on thin white towels (though I believe they were clean). There is a music/entertainment venue across the street & the front bedroom was very loud until almost 2:30am. Place feels in disrepair - broken drawer handles, rusty bathtub drain, paper towel in fan light….
Good value but would not stay again unless some investment made in these things.

Our stay was unfortunately disappointing. Check-in was scheduled for 3:00 PM, but we weren’t able to access the Airbnb until about 50 minutes later because the cleaning crew was still there, so we had to wait on the street for that long! While the host apologized, the delay disrupted our plans and the schedule we had for the day, which was frustrating.
The cleanliness also did not meet our expectations. There were spider webs in the corners of the walls, some hair on the bedding, the blinds were noticeably dusty, the floors did not appear to have been vacuumed thoroughly, and the bathroom shower didn’t have a good drainage. Additionally, because the home is in an older building, it had a strong old-house smell that made the space feel less fresh than expected.
Overall, the host was apologetic, but the delayed check-in and cleanliness issues made for a less enjoyable experience.
Overall a wonderful place! Room was a little small but very cute! Only thing it was missing for me was a mini fridge! We brought a cooler and ended up being great!
Nice place in the heart of Chicago , perfect for a group trip to the city.

Julius was a fantastic host! He was very accommodating with our arrival time and always prompt and responsive whenever we had questions. The home is in a quiet, safe neighborhood and just a short walk to the Metro Blue Line, making airport access incredibly easy. It was the perfect place for our group of seven former high school classmates who hadn't seen each other in over 40 years. The living room and patio gave us wonderful spaces to gather, laugh, and catch up. The bedrooms were very comfortable with excellent mattresses, and although we were concerned about having just one bathroom for seven people, it was never an issue. We had a wonderful stay and highly recommend Julius's home to anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located place with an exceptional host. Thank you, Julius, for helping make our reunion so memorable!
It was a nice room! Host is super responsive and will answer any questions you may have! Thank you again!

Charles a été très accueillant et toujours prêt à nous conseiller. Le logement était très confortable et situé dans un quartier très agréable. Facilité d'accès en transports en communs (Brown line, bus etc). Nous avons passé un très bon séjour!

Marv was a fantastic host who was proactive and helpful throughout my stay. The apartment had everything I could want for a long term apartment. Lots of walkable options for food and groceries, a few blocks from the lake, and right next to the bus and red line which was convenient.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb and would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago. The home was exactly as described—very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. It had everything we needed for our stay, and it felt like a home away from home.
The location was one of the biggest highlights. It was in a quiet, safe neighborhood with easy access to public transportation, making it simple to get to Wrigley Field, downtown Chicago, the museums, and other attractions without needing a car. We also found several great coffee shops and restaurants nearby, which made the location even more convenient.
The host was excellent to work with. Communication was prompt, friendly, and helpful from the time we booked until checkout. Check-in and check-out were both easy and stress-free, and the host provided clear instructions and helpful local recommendations.
The beds were comfortable, the home was well stocked, and we appreciated the thoughtful touches that made our stay more e
Great spot for a weekend in Chicago, walkable to Wrigley and the Southport area. Clean well stocked and cozy would definitely stay again!
Mary and Andrew were very proactive and clear with all of their communications:  The home was well appointed and great for our group.  Thank you!  Would definitely stay again!

Jackson's place was exactly as described.  Easy check in with great detailed instructions.  Ate at 2 places he recommended in his guide book and they where both delicious. Definitely will stay there again when I come back to Chicago.  Thank you Jackson
Would stay again

This space was nice and in a great spot. However the management team was not helpful and did not provide access information to the space in a timely manner. Additionally had a male member of the management team access the space unannounced during our stay. He used his own key and came in without knocking. He did leave when asked but was not apologetic and this made us feel unsafe as a group of women staying in the space.

Great location, but some frustrating details.
The Airbnb is in a fantastic spot with easy access to restaurants, coffee, and the riverwalk. Check‑in required extra documentation, which slowed things down, and the unit felt under‑stocked: only four towels for our group, one trash bag, one dishwasher tablet, and one laundry detergent dose. There was also a noticeable stain on the sofa. Overall, we loved the location, but better stocking and maintenance would have made the stay much nicer.

We had a great stay at Josh’s AirBnB. Check-In process was very easy and the place was clean when we got there. They have a very nice game room with a pool table and some arcade games that we enjoyed during our stay. The rooms were spacious and plenty of bathrooms.
The location was great! We felt safe and there were plenty of amenities nearby to walk to like grocery stores, restaurants, bars, CVS, and other stores. Every morning we were able to walk and get breakfast and coffee, which were located very close. In addition, the subway was also very close making it easy to get to wriggly.
Would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a larger space that can accommodate 8+ people, in a great location with plenty to do!

Awful experience. The bedding was filthy: comforters had white residue all over, sheets/pillowcases were stained and appeared unlaundered, most white towels/washcloths were stained brown & yellow. Carpet was excessively stained, and basement chair was covered in hair, stains, and crusted residue.
The host responded quickly but was very defensive, insisting everything was clean and there was nothing to worry about. He sent the cleaner the next day, but only 1 of 4 beds received fresh bedding. Another person, who appeared to be the co-host, later dropped off extra linens and commented the photos we shared were “really bad”
Though the host presented himself as helpful, his responses were dismissive. He referred to the issues as “minor cosmetic imperfections on a few freshly laundered linens” and reminded us we booked a busy weekend at a premium price ($3k for two nights) as if that excused the condition. Read other negative reviews and the host’s defensive replies carefully before booking
Great host.
Great hosts. The apartment is well located uptown.
Loved this place and when my time allows coming back again.

Nice space. Great location. Very clean.
No extra towels or blankets. Train was very loud.

Beautiful large apartment that's close to everything. Clean and well decorated. Plenty of extra towels and linens. Well stocked kitchen. Quiet location with easy parking. Ginneh was friendly and everything went flawlessly. Perfect spot for our family of two adults and two teens.

Perfect weekend spot - The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect for exploring Lincoln Park, and our host gave us some great recommendations for the area. We’d definitely stay here again!
This was literally the most convenient and beautiful place I have been to in Chicago! Lots of space and had all you need. I will definitely be coming back next time around!

This was the perfect spot to stay on our family trip to Chicago. Close enough to downtown, but quiet and private. Check-in was super easy, and the place was as advertised. Lots of restaurants in the neighborhood. Would certainty stay again!
The place looks better than the photos! Super large and plenty enough space to house around 4 people.

We had an amazing time at James’s place! The floors were squeaky clean when we arrived which we loved and there was plenty of space for our big group. Amazing location, we loved being so close to chinatown since there was so much to do and it all felt incredibly safe! Everything was exactly as described and the shower was always hot. We mostly used the garage for entering/leaving which we are thankful for - we definitely made use of the garage parking. The front entrance was so pretty too!! James was incredibly responsive and so friendly to us - we really appreciated how communicative he was. Only thing is that there are no blinds in the kitchen windows - not terrible since it’s high up so people can’t really see in, but would’ve been nice to have. Would definitely recommend and would stay here again.
Quick walk to Wrigley Field.
Great house! Fun location. Italian place on the corner was amazing.
Beautiful place to stay with beautiful view of the city

Not worth it. I paid $4,200 for a 3-night stay (approximately $1,400/night), a premium rate inflated by Lollapalooza demand. However, the property doesn’t match that investment. The furnishings and finishes are budget-quality throughout (thin pillows, cheap towels, basic furniture), which doesn’t align with premium pricing. More importantly, the neighborhood is unsafe and sketchy at night, a safety concern that people should take notice. Additionally, despite paying a premium rate, I was charged an early check-in fee for a 2-hour early check even though the apartment was vacant, an unnecessary upcharge that felt like nickel-and-diming. Premium rates should come with premium quality and safe accommodations. I would not recommend this property at this price point.
Great rental but a little dark. Lots of supplies are offered, which was very helpful. Not the cleanest. Hosts were responsive and gave clear information
Algenoy was extremely responsive and helpful! Check in and check out were simple and easy. We would definitely come back and stay here again!
Serg was easy to communicate with and quickly addressed all of our questions.  Would definitely book again!
We had an amazing time staying here, the location was great and the home was above our expectations by far. Very spacious with a great layout, next time we are in Chicago we will be staying here!

Great location, safe and clean space. Would definitely stay here again! Highly
Recommend

This condo is located across from the Bean in Chicago and has so many restaurants nearby, and everything you can think to do in Chicago is within walking distance.
The beds are comfy, the place is small but has everything you need to stay with 4-6 people. We would stay here again because the location can not be beat!

The unit was clean, modern, and felt brand new. The building amenities truly pushed the stay over the top, especially the rooftop, pool, lounge areas, and beautiful city views. The location was also very convenient for exploring Chicago. Victor was an excellent host and communicated quickly and clearly for our stay. I would definitely recommend this property!

Had the pleasure of staying here for my Bachelorette! Traveled from Detroit and found the area very safe and accessible. Accommodations were as described and the backyard patio was amazing to hang out and enjoy the weather! Kyle and hosts were kind and communicative. Great for larger groups and lots of things to do! Thank you!

Wonderful hosts. Very responsive to messages. Washer and dryer huge bonus. Neighborhood felt safe. Hosts live upstairs. We could hear what felt like every single footstep they made. Did not bother us per se, but felt it should be noted for others. Might night be ideal for a couple’s getaway or older folks. Parking after 9pm was a little stressful but we did get lucky each time and found something relatively close. A minor inconvenience but thought it should be noted. Still a 5/5.

Lydia’s place is absolutely beautiful. Very clean and you feel very safe when you’re there. Living room especially in kitchen area are just amazing. And Lydia responds almost immediately if he needs something.

I could not recommend Marisa’s listing more for a nice trip to Chicago. I went with my partner for a wedding, and it was perfect since it was easily accessible to public transportation, plus the stores right next to the listing.
Deborah place was very nice comfortable and cozy, in a quiet neighborhood.I would definitely stay again

What a wonderful home and what a wonderful host!  A truly beautiful home and so comfortable. From the very first minute we arrived, Noelle made sure we had all we needed. Noelle gave us great tips on what to do and how to get there. My family was so impressed, they are already planning a return trip. Great memories were made!

We had a great stay! The Airbnb had everything we needed for a comfortable visit, and the location was perfect, within walking distance of plenty of great food and entertainment. Marijes was incredibly responsive and helpful, making the entire experience easy and enjoyable. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again!

Nothing to improve or complaint
Have a wonderful experience overall
Highly recommended
Great place to stay for Chicago weekend!
Leslee is such a great host.  Very responsive and helpful with anything we needed. This location was perfect for our family for the summer. Would love to return!

The apartment was great.  The location is only a couple blocks from the green line.  Parking on the street was easy, no issues. Gabriela was wonderful to work with and was so helpful and accommodating!  Overall it was a great experience and Gabriela was wonderful!

Steve's place was as advertised -  the loft apartment is, indeed, very cozy and convenient. Steve and Loong are gracious hosts and are quick to respond if there are any questions and/or concerns.  The CTA train line is only a block or so away which makes getting around Chicago very manageable.  If staying in a nice, walkable, uptown neighborhood is what you have in mind, go no further than this listing!
Our stay was wonderful. The host was very responsive and went the extra mile to make sure that we were having a great trip and comfortable stay.
Great location and the host was super responsive. I wish the room was cleaner. Good to just crash for the night.

My friend and I stayed with Melissa for one of the most popular and expensive weekends in Chicago, and her place was a phenomenal deal. The space was clean, easy to find, and had everything we needed. I would highly recommend Melissa to anyone looking to stay in Chicago and would happily stay again.

Troy was a terrific host. Super friendly, accommodating and flexible. Troy also responds to all questions and messages immediately. Great location as we felt very safe, especially at night. Would totally recommend.

We had a fantastic stay for my bachelorette party in Chicago! The beds were so comfy, clean, and the common area spaces were great to hang out in. The host was very friendly and allowed us both early check in and late check out. The train is a little loud if you’re a light sleeper. Good coffee shops and restaurants nearby. Would stay again!
Amazing place to stay and easy to get to and from.
Great place, extremely clean and safe!

Enjoyed the stay. The bed is super comfortable.  Just one thing to be aware of -- the front door is very heavy. An older person might have trouble opening it. Also, there are 2 short flights of steps. Otherwise, delightful place. Very convenient.
The place was clean and responsive when messaging. Also nice size rooms.
Atlas’ place was in a great location. He was very helpful and checked in on us.

Darsh’s place was the perfect location for us. Near a subway station but also only 20 mins for an uber ride. Great nightlife and shopping was only a short walk away and the nearby Target was perfectly convenient. Checkout was one of the easiest processes I’ve ever gone through. It worked out perfect on subway trains because our lines were never crowded coming from downtown. Everything was exactly as described! Only thing we wish we would have had were TVs in the bedrooms but we knew it wasn’t there when booking so it wasn’t a surprise. Darsh was always responsive. We will want to return!
Very clean. Easy check in. Close to restaurants and bars.
Loved the place! Can’t wait to come back!
A perfect spot to stay if you plan on attending Cubs games. Highly recommended.
Shonte was easy to communicate with and was very kind in letting us check out a little late when something came up.

Stephanie is a top tier host! This place was bang-on value for the area. We used it for our home-base while we were in for a friend’s wedding - 10/10 would recommend. Amenities, great AC system, and fully stocked with items you’d find in your own home.

This was a great place for my family to stay for a long weekend in Chicago. Walking distance to sightseeing, safe neighborhood with great restaurant choices. The apartment was clean and well kept. The host left detailed instructions and was promptly responsive to questions. Highly recommended!
Great place to stay! Felt very comfortable and safe.
Great place, great location and great host. Close to train....Wrigley...good restaurants.

Darsh was wonderful and responsive before and during our stay. His place was in great condition, very easy to access and felt safe. There’s a Target around the corner and a CTA station within easy walking distance. Would 100% stay there again!

Stephanie was a great host and offers a great space!  She was very attentive to our needs and responded promptly when needed.  I would definitely recommend her to others and will be considering this space again when we visit!
Nice place in a good location. Very good communication too
Great place! Good space for two couples! A simple mile walk from Wrigley! A short trip to downtown! Definitely recommend Doppio around the corner for breakfast! Host made everything very simple!
Hakim was very communicative and helpful throughout my stay, would highly recommend it to any solo travelers.

We really enjoyed many aspects of our stay at Phoebe’s. Everything was as listed, the bathroom was very clean, the location was great, parking was easy, and the apartment had everything we needed for a week-long stay.
Unfortunately, we experienced flash flooding during our stay, which caused the apartment to flood. While this was outside of the hosts’ control, it did create some disruption, including cleaning and flooring repairs during our stay. Tim and Phoebe were very responsive and helpful throughout, and they provided a one-night refund when we asked about alternate accommodations, which we appreciated.
Overall, we would stay here again. The flooding was an unfortunate circumstance, but the hosts handled it as well as they could. Future guests may want to keep the weather in mind when booking, particularly during periods of heavy rain or thunderstorms.

Great experience! The host was very responsive and the apartment was super clean. Considering the area the apartment was in, we felt very safe at the complex, as well as parking our car on the street. Would definitely recommend, especially for the great price!
Eric’s place was perfect for our weekend in Chicago. It was located just outside the downtown area which is exactly what we wanted. Beautiful neighborhood with lots of great local spots.
Thank you for a wonderful stay in Old Town! This property was everything we hoped for! We appreciate your communication, flexibility and professionalism!

Great neighborhood. Apartment was clean and exactly as described.
Amy was a fantastic host - clear communication and very responsive to questions.

Great Airbnb for our first time in Chicago! Jefferson and Judy were the kindest hosts from the beginning of my booking until check-out. They went above and beyond as hosts by providing robes and slippers for us and had more amenities than the usual Airbnb. The place is very clean and Jefferson and Judy were always responsive to anything we needed.
The location is extremely peaceful in the suburbs. About a 20 minute walk to the train. We stayed here for Lollapalooza which is a little bit out of the city (approximately 30 minute uber or 1 hour train) but I really enjoyed staying in their home.

We had a fantastic stay! Natasha and Guillermo were very responsive, friendly, and made the entire process easy from check-in to check-out. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect for attending Lollapalooza and made it easy to get around the city. They provided clear instructions and were always available if we had questions. We’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you both for a great experience!
Great place and would definitely stay again!
Kate & Ricks place was clean and spacious for our group of 10!

Yehoshua's place was perfect for my family vacation.  20-25 minutes for downtown Chicago, Wrigley, Lake Michigan.  It's a quite neighborhood which was great for relaxing after a long day of sightseeing.  We felt completely at home especially since the place was spotless and clean.

We really enjoyed our stay here! We didn't do much in the nearby area and traveled into Chicago during the days but thought the neighborhood was very quiet and nice. House was very clean, good amenities in kitchen, and bed was super comfortable. Thank you!

Chris's place was perfect for our family's trip to Chicago. It is a very short walk to Wrigley Field and numerous shops & restaurants! Chris was always very responsive to my messages. We originally turned down the offer for reserved parking, but quickly changed our minds after having difficulties finding a nearby parking spot. Chris promptly helped us secure a reserved spot in a garage next door. I highly recommend Chris's Airbnb! We hope to return again in the near future!
Great place. Host was very attentive.
This was a great stay for our large family. Very good location next to public transportation.

We had a great stay at Chris’s place. We only stayed two nights and had a busy few days so we honestly weren’t in the space very long. Everything was very clean and we had so much room to spread out as a group of four. I would definitely recommend and will return if we’re back in the area!
