Also the day we checked out, I realized I had left a jacket in the unit. Chris was quick to respond locate the jacket and work out a plan to get it back to me before we flew out a few days later.Thank you, Chris for a great stay!

Very cute place with everything you need! Public transport was easy to access and there are several great restaurants nearby. Be wary of street parking and tow zones - public transport is definitely the way to go.

Great location, easy to find, walkability score 10.
Apartment could use some updating and deep cleaning. Overall, would recommend especially if your planing on attending a cubs game, can’t get any closer.
Lovely place in a wonderful neighborhood.

Stayed here for 2 months. Very cute home, lots of natural light, looks just like the photos. Lovely neighborhood with incredible food and culture. Walkable to the park and Ukrainian Village, only a 20 minute drive to the loop. Very kind and welcoming neighbors. If you stay in June, you get to experience the Puerto Rican Festival which is so lively and fun. Plan for the street closures. There is a parking spot which is an amazing feature, but it is a tight fit. However, I never had trouble finding free street parking close by if I didn’t feel like parking in the spot. The issues were regarding cleanliness upon my arrival & few quirks that came up. Nothing totally unsurprising for a city walk up but it was just overwhelming when you want to settle in. Mary and her husband were extremely responsive throughout my stay and quick to come up with solutions. She hired a different cleaning service that came in again and it was much better after that. Thank you so much!

Loved Kyriako’s space! Everything was clean and we were very comfortable as a group of 7. Kyriako was very responsive with whatever questions I had and let us do around luggage drop off before checkin. The area is very nice and peaceful with a bunch of good restaurants nearby. I highly recommended staying if you are in the area.
Ivy’s place is beautiful. We loved the surrounding area. Very easy walk to the blue line to get downtown. Extremely clean and had a lot of amenities. Would recommend to anyone!
Would def stay again! Awesome movie theater

Really great flat in a smart apartment block with excellent local amenities on hand. Cloud9 are great to deal with and very proactive when you need help / communication. The flat was immaculately clean and in good condition, with lots of care taken in terms of equipment, toiletries and a well stocked fridge with essentials. The West Loop location is very convenient for transport and there are some great local cafes and restaurants. Highly recommended.

We had just a small issue with the air mattress and towels missing when we arrived, but Milan eventually had them delivered. Unfortunately the apartment’s walls/windows don’t do a very good job of blocking noise. The first night, there was music blasting outside the building that kept us awake until 3 AM. Also, we could hear our neighbors throwing a party. Make sure to bring earplugs.
Nat was a very detailed and responsive host who made our stay easy with good instructions and amenities. Their place was very clean and beyond our expectations!

We enjoyed our stay at Drapes of Wrath.  It was clean and conveniently located for our outings.   Communication before arrival date was helpful.  Instructions were clear.  Candy dish and sodas were a nice a touch.  I would definitely recommend.

I stayed for two weeks and had a great visit. The neighborhood and apartment were quiet and safe. Bus lines, the L, grocery stores, and great restaurants and coffee shops are only blocks away. Mark was really responsive and friendly. Chicago apartments can be stuffy in the summer, but the AC unit in the bedroom and dehumidifier in the living room kept the place comfortable.

Maria’s place was spacious and perfect for 4 guests. The location was great and it had free public parking and I was able to park my car right in front of the place for the full stay. It’s super easy to find too!
Great place to stay highly recommended host is great

This place exceeded every expectation. The apartment was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay from a well-stocked kitchen to a super comfy bed. The location is unbeatable, we could walk to great coffee shops, restaurants, and bars without ever needing a car or rideshare.

Very spacious and clean. Perfect for our family (5 ppl) staying. Most of the streets are one way so that was initially tricky but once figured out easy peasy. Close to Meijer and other stores. Close to he 79th Street Red line to run into the city. Andrew checked on us often, was kind and attentive!! Highly recommend
Clean and close to metro. Perfect for a solo traveler.

Thomas and Cynthia's place was great.  Very clean and quiet in a great area not far from the city with a great coffee shop around the corner and restaurants in walking distance.  We really enjoyed out stay!
Great spot 20 minutes into heart of downtown. Tons of room. Up and coming neighborhood but very safe and secure. We loved it for our family of 6!

Elizabeth's place was as advertised and more. It was a beautiful place in an amazing neighborhood near Lincoln Park and the lake. Elizabeth was very accommodating and responsive which we really appreciated.
I would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone.
The place was really clean, comfortable and really perfect. The host is really helpful with any questions you might have and really considerate with the guest.
Lois is great. She greeted us when we first got there and gave us helpful tips to help us navigate the city. The place was clean and quiet.

We had a wonderful stay! The unit is exactly as described! We were able to leave our bags prior to checkin and they were waiting in the unit when we checked in. The Walton Residence is in a fabulous location with lots of great restaurants and easy walk to great shopping. Great stay all around for our family. We will be back!  Thank you for your hospitality

This was a nice place, and everything was exactly described. There's lots of unique artwork in the apartment, and it's an older place, but generally well kept. It's close enough to Wrigley Field if you don't mind a 30 minute walk. There are some nice coffee shops and restaurants nearby as well.
What follows here is more of a rant about how opportunistic Airbnb hosts have made this platform a lot less attractive. I would have visited another weekend if I could have, as it was the weekend of Lollapalooza in Chicago. Predictably, hotels charged a fortune for rooms ("dynamic pricing"), and Airbnb hosts took advantage of the higher demand as well. Charging $460 per night (including taxes and fees) for this place is insane. I still rated it highly because it delivered everything it promised, and I booked it knowing the price. But I have to say that my memory of this stay will be that I was gouged. This isn't how Airbnb was intended to work.

The property is in a great location and offers fantastic views, but we had a major issue during our stay. A water leak started in the ceiling, which eventually caused part of the ceiling to collapse. Dealing with this was stressful, and the host was unfortunately not very helpful when it happened and basically gave me runaround answers. Other than this significant incident, the rest of the stay had no major issues, but given the safety hazard and slow communication, I wouldn’t fully recommend it until the leak and ceiling are properly repaired.
Definitely a great deal & looks just like the pictures.
Centrally located on the South Side making it easy to get around to all the sights.
Great place! Very clean, affordable and comfortable. The surrounding area is very nice and there is plenty to do in the area. Would book again!
Great little apartment. Was all we needed for a 2 night stay. Very clean. People above have a dog so was a bit noisy at times but as dog people it was ok.
Fantastic cozy spot that’s well kept and very clean in a convenient location.

Overall our stay with Tuan was great, we were very thankful to have a safe and reliable place to stay at during our music festival and it was very easy to get to the train station to get into the city for it. The first couple days went smoothly but on the third morning of our stay we got some pretty heavy rain overnight which resulted in water pooling into the kitchen and part of the living space near the futon. Luckily we were able to quickly move our stuff to avoid damage but was left mopping up and using towels to clean up the water mess ourselves. Tuan was responsive to the situation and brought extra towels but we were still left to handle the initial chaos of it. The futon wasn’t the same in the photo and unfortunately was very thin and uncomfortable to lay on which resulted in poor sleep. And if you are over 5’10” you will have to duck your head in the bedroom due to very low ceilings. But we really appreciated the area we were in, the affordability, and kindness of our host!

Great time at this property. However, it was very frustrating that we had such difficulty getting our keys out of the locks. Ended up having to leave the key there. Inside of the property was nice though. Neighborhood was great. Really enjoyed out time.
Awesome stay! Relatively close to transit, Wrigley and downtown. Very clean and specious. Hosts were very communicative throughout.
As described.
Great hospitality!

Excellent neighborhood (Gold Coast)  near the beach and only a few stops to downtown Chicago on red line (was 8 min walk for me to train station nearby). Great restaurants right up the block. Jewel grocery store within walking distance. Clean apartment and building. Responsive host. I enjoyed my stay. Thank you!
Great spot - highly recommend for a large group!
Laura’s place was clean, exactly as described, and in a great location. Laura was also a helpful, responsive, and welcoming host.
Good spot. Nice neighborhood with lots of food spots nearby. Thomas was accommodating and responsive. Laundry is a great amenity- nice to fly out with a suitcase of clean clothes. Would stay again.
We really enjoyed our stay!

I will start with the pros:
Fantastic location.
Clean and as advertised in the pictures posted.
Cons:
No thermostat to regulate the temperature in the apartment.
Apartment located in basement of an older brownstone building which allowed for all foot traffic to be heard in the apartments above.
Plumbing system totally failed 36 hours into our stay. Sewage backed up out of the tub drain, toilet and in the utility room leaving a foul smell. Owner was less than helpful in coordinating a resolution and all responses seemed to be from an AI chatbot with no voice call received. My guests and I were unable to shower or use the bathroom for a full day. Owner advised that the problem was fixed late in the evening but plumbing system again failed the next morning during our checkout, again precluding us from using the shower or toilet before departing.
I sincerely hope that this is fixed prior to the next time this property is rented out.

This spot is not for families or elderly.
First thing that we experienced was a phone call while the family was at dinner telling us to move our car immediately or they will tow it. I sent a message the day we were leaving to MAKE SURE that they can accommodate 2 cars. The property management stated “no issues” “We will have proper spots to accommodate your vehicles” then while at dinner I was called to be informed that if I didn’t move our second car a tow truck will remove it from the “ assigned” parking spot that THEY TOLD ME to park it in. So we had to park one car 5 blocks away in a paid lot.
This unit is on the 3rd floor so 4 flights of steps to get in the apartment. All TVs are the same brand of TV so each remote controls all tv. Switching channels on bedrooms tv. Changes all tvs to the same. So every room has to watch all the same program. Annoying. Water leaking from windows. And we found a cockroach and maybe bed bug(little black bug). 10/10 would NOT recommend for familys.
Pricey - but everything in Chicago was.

Wow we loved this stay. No fussy checkout instructions, just leave on time. Such an interesting space, well decorated and fun without feeling produced. The kind of place where you find new cool things you didn’t notice the first time you looked. Or the second. Extra amenities you didn’t even know you’d want. Excellent location. Very responsive service, we had extra towels in minutes. Now we want to try all of David’s properties.
Very comfortable, very clean and easy to access!! Definitely will stay again.

The house was very clean and had a lot of great restaurants around it. I would definitely use this house again in the future. Irma was a great host as well. She was very responsive and always came down to our apartment to help me and my friends out with anything.

Our stay was absolutely wonderful! From the moment we arrived, we felt welcomed and right at home. The Airbnb was incredibly clean, cozy, and thoughtfully put together, making it such a comfortable place to relax.
We also really appreciated the little touches, like the hygiene products provided in the bathroom—they made our stay even more convenient and showed how much care was put into hosting. One thing that stood out the most was how safe we felt. The security measures in place gave us so much peace of mind throughout our visit.
Overall, we truly enjoyed every part of our stay. This was an amazing place to stay, and we would absolutely book it again in the future. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a clean, welcoming, and secure Airbnb experience!
Great place.  Great location.

L'apartament és confortable i ampli tot i estar en una planta semisoterrani. En Kevin i la Jaquie han estat ambles i han respost amb rapidesa als nostres missatges i peticions.
L'apartament està ben situat a només 35 minuts de la parada Washington/Wabash de la línia verda, al centre de The Loop.
L'únic inconvenient, si no tens cotxe, és que no hi ha supermercats o restaurants propers a l'allotjament.
Hem estat molt a gust!
Loved the suite we stayed it, everything was perfect!

My husband had a great stay. Just as described and he felt very at home. Great guys, very easy to get along with and great conversations. Thanks for sharing your space. Very much appreciated and we recommend this Airbnb.

Alma was super responsive. The building has maintenance issues including cold water and an entrance area that floods when it rains. The unit looks as it does in pictures, and is generally clean but could be better. It is also a very noisy building with thin walls. You can hear everything! There could also be more towels. The unit was over priced in my opinion, but it was a very busy weekend so I assume the pricing was justified as it was likely based on supply/demand. If you need a spot for a large group and you do not need to spend too much time in the unit (small living room), this gets the job done as it’s in a central location.
Loved Weihong, was very responsive and her place was clean!
Had a great stay! Walkable and easy for rideshare to other parts of city. Perfect for our family of 4 weekend trip! Hosts were very quick to respond to any messages sent.
My wife and I had a wonderful time.  Condo is located right near Wrigley. Highly recommend.
Shanna was an amazing host and very responsive!

Thank you for a memorable weekend! The master bed is so comfy I had a hard time waking up lol Lots of space and a huge kitchen island where we played cards at night after being out all day. It’s hard to find a place with 3 bathrooms in chicago so that was a luxury for sure. Thank you Danielle!
If you were going to a Cubs game, there is no better location. There were tons of restaurants very walkable at breakfast places.

We were in Chicago for a Cubs game with our son and this property provided great access for that. This is a three-bedroom property on the middle floor of a larger three-level property. The neighborhood, located a few miles north of the Chicago Loop, is great and the property offers easy access to dining, shopping, and public transit. The property is sparse but clean and the kitchen has all of the amenities you would expect, including a washer and dryer. Parking on the street is tough to find, so the parking behind the property is extremely valuable. Arleth was highly communicative and responsive to queries. The only struggle we had was getting into the property; the lock codes we were given were incorrect and it took some back-and-forth with Arleth to get it figured out.
I would opt to park in the street if you stay here. Other than that, the place had everything we needed.

Tina and Jon are great hosts. The place is in a great location, very short walk to coffee, cafes, restaurants, trader Joe's etc. And a short walk to brown line stops at Addison or irving park. Easy parking. Perfect place to stay when visiting Chicago for any reason.

Perfect stay. All was as good as mentioned in the reviews before. We would return anytime.
For those undecided whether to stay here or downtown: There is an excellent bus service right outside taking you straight into town.
Our stay was a delight. Every amenity was thoughtfully at our fingertips. Wonderful, quiet neighborhood and very walkable. We’d love to book again!
A hidden gem in the middle of the city. Very spacious and peaceful high up on the top floor.

We had a great stay with Terry and John. This cozy home is in an excellent location, on a quiet street, close to a lot of major attractions downtown. The hosts were happy to share local recommendations. Check-in was easy and we had no issues with the Wi-Fi. There was another guest staying in the room across from us, so this is a shared space, but we had no issues. For those with mobility concerns, the rooms are located on the 3rd floor, so you will need to climb some stairs.
Great place, right next to Wrigley.  Everything was close and it was a nice space.  The cost was high for a small place but seemed to be the going rate in this area.
We had a great stay!
Amazing location next to Wrigley Field. Great rooftop deck!

I have so many great things to say about this experience. I will be booking this spot for all my future budget Chicago travels.
First off, Zheng is so kind and welcoming. I was a solo female traveler so I felt a little nervous, but upon meeting Zheng and being shown the place I wasn’t worried. The room I stayed in was the perfect size for myself. It had a small desk to sit and do my makeup at. Zheng even provided a small mirror, water, and paper towels. This room had one window that got great natural sunlight, but curtains that made the room nice and dark when it was time for bed. The bed and pillow were insanely comfortable which was a huge plus. Sheets were clean and towels too. The bathroom was small but spotless the entire time.
Zheng himself is a super nice host. He even helped me carry my huge bag up the flight of stairs plus poured me some green tea from his hometown. :)
Overall, this was a 10/10 stay and I am stoked to have found such an affordable gem to stay at!
We loved our stay in this beautiful home. It was easy to get to and from the train and plenty to do within walking distance. Jacki was quick to respond and extremely helpful.
Fabiana communicated very well with us to let us know when we could enter the unit as we arrived to Chicago early in the morning. Great location, clean, nice stay.
Nice place to stay. Not noisy or sketchy area either.
Great location and comfortable space. Would definitely stay again.
This 2-room apartment was immaculate and the bathroom and kitchen are up-to-date. Lively, young neighborhood with good restaurants, coffee shops and bars. Very convenient to public transportation.

Antonio’s place was absolutely lovely! It was very clean, cozy, and had everything I needed for my stay. The location is unbeatable, it’s less than a 2 minutes walk to the Blue Line station, which made getting around Chicago incredibly convenient. I really enjoyed my stay here, and I would definitely book this Airbnb again the next time I visit Chicago. Highly recommend!
The location was great for our visit with family in the area

Genova's place is a good value for the price. Decent-sized room with shared living, kitchen, and bathroom. A decently clean place (this depends on the other guests too, as it is a shared place). It was a pretty quiet place but with many things to do in the neighborhood (it is the Mexican quarter of the city) and easy access to downtown with regular buses.
Genova was very helpful, particularly with allowing me to drop-off and pick-up luggage before check-in/ after check-out
Place was awesome!
This is a great location - close to restaurants and shops. It was clean and just as stated in the listings. The balconies are nice. Owner is responsive.
We had a great time, Freddy was very responsive when we had questions.

Heidi's place is a perfect Chicago landing spot! The room is cozy with a comfortable bed, and the bedroom is just across the hall. The cats are an adorable bonus. The location and neighborhood couldn't be better--so many incredible restaurants within a 10 minute walk and easy access to the red line. We found free street parking just a few blocks away.

Collette and Mark are wonderful hosts! They were always responsive, the accommodations were just perfect; extremely clean, comfortable, and the location was just right! There are many great restaurants and coffee shops nearby, VERY close to public transportation and so walkable. This was our first visit to Chicago and we will be back! Couldn’t have found a better Airbnb! Thank you!

We arrived and walked inside. I was surprised that the main floor was spacious and wide open. Even more accommodating than the pictures lead on. Everything was very clean, great water pressure, and three comfortable beds. I didn’t even mention the backyard yet… Hot tub, fire pit and a trampoline. This is hands down the best Airbnb I have stayed at in the area and I have stayed at many. I will book this house any and every time I am here in the future.
Place is clean and beautifully renovated. Host is extremely responsive and friendly!
Very nice Airbnb, very responsive host. Would definitely stay again someday
We really enjoyed our stay with Hiraru in Andersonville. The apartment was clean and the location was fantastic to walk the area and bike the waterfront. We would highly recommend staying here!
David was a fantastic host and the place was clean and easy to get in and out of! Great food, great area, and great experience
Liliana was very communicative and responsive, and the space was clean and beautiful!
Good spot walking distance to Wrigley with free parking on street. A couple minor issues like dishwasher broken, unclear which lockbox to use, etc. But overall a good spot for quick weekend visit.

I have some many wonderful things to say about this spot! The location was excellent! Walkable to restaurants, grocery stores, the gym, and downtown. At the same time I felt very safe. The space itself was amazing! The small details throughout like high quality linens really made a difference. The host was incredibly responsive. I wouldn’t hesitate to book this spot for a long term stay.

Our family of four stayed for a month at Karen's place and it really felt like a home away from home! It's an older home with a few squeaky spots but we appreciated so many features, from the comfortable beds and well-stocked kitchen to the washer/dryer and high quality linens, towels, and toiletries.
The neighborhood is peaceful and lovely - close to transit and walkable to Wrigley, with very easy street parking. There are a ton of great spots to eat and drink nearby too, including Ravenswood's Malt Row.
We were there during a heat wave so didn't really get to enjoy the backyard, but it's also a great feature. Some reviews mention the pullout bed being an issue - we had our youngest sleep on it and added a foam topper to make it more comfortable.
Karen was a responsive and helpful host. Truly
a great spot for a long-term or short-term stay in Chicago!

We absolutely loved our stay at the Coach house! From the moment we got there, we could not stop expressing how much we would love to live there. It was such a peaceful, welcoming, and accommodating space. Shannon and Joe were incredibly helpful and responsive whenever we needed anything. We can’t wait to be back, and even recommended it to our family who lives nearby, so that more guests can enjoy the beauty of the Coach house like we did!
Anca does everything possible to mitigate the noise from the Elevated subway including soft noise machines in each bedroom.  We really did get used to it and would stay in her home again.
Great place!
Dominque was so wonderful and I would definitely stay again and recommend her to anyone needing a place to stay while in Chicago!
Amazing location, walking distance to wrigleyville. Would recommend to anyone!

My friend and I had a great experience staying here! Walkable to nearby buses and the train that were able to get us where we needed to in terms of tourism. Also a 30 min uber from the train. The space itself is very quirky, clean and private! I liked that there was the option to chill in the room or the living room. Also I appreciated Tim letting us check in a little bit earlier and being highly communicative about it.
We really enjoyed our stay and the location was perfect!
I was in town for a wedding and the house worked out perfectly.  When we arrived there were snacks, eggs, bread, and cereal.  Milk, juice, and creamer for our coffee- all the convenience of home.
Laura was excellent with communication and making sure we had what we needed!
Great place, intentionally designed. Had a great time.
Great place!!!

We absolutely loved staying here!
The house was spacious, spotless, and truly felt like a home away from home. Everything was thoughtfully prepared, and the check-in and check-out processes were seamless. The host was responsive, friendly, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. We had a wonderful trip and really enjoyed our time here. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!

This place was very clean and calming environment. The place does look like the photos but most areas had short ceilings. It was also close to some buses and the train station. But there was no control over the ac so I would say bring your own blankets but some were provided. The washer and dryer were also very nice!
I had a great stay with no problems at all. It was very easy to get checked it, the host was always responsive and helpful and the views from the rooftop pool were excellent.

Our stay was perfect, the apartment is ground level but it's a quiet street. The light in the mornings in the living room bed and the noise from the boiling room was the only negative thing we found. The rest was perfect, it has all the possible amenities, and everything worked fine, we had plenty of towels, kitchenware, hairdryers, washing machine and drier, soap, shampoo, oil... It is a good neighborhood, safe, close to a metro station...
Really good experience.
I appreciated the host responsiveness and helpfulness to help me get around the city, as I was new. Very good host very clean place will definitely want to book again.!!
We enjoyed our stay at this property! It was the perfect size for our large group, and we actually thought it looked better in person than it did on the listing. Highly recommend!
Easy parking
Appreciate the host and the home super convenient. Thanks again.

The Airbnb was very clean and accommodated the 5 guests nicely! We had lots of space and didn’t feel cramped. The upstairs neighbor is extremely loud, especially during the late night hours. We were constantly woken up at 1am, 2am, 3am with their loud walking and yelling. They also started loud yard work at 8am on Sunday. We had quiet hours to follow but apparently they did not. We stayed for lollapalooza weekend and if we didn’t have a car you would pay large fees for Ubers to get back to the Airbnb.
Excellent stay and service.....No issues whatsoever!!!

This place was perfect for our trip! Perfect distance to downtown Chicago, while being in the quiet suburbs as well. Easy and quick access to public transportation to get to and from all Chicago attractions. Also convenient to get to Wrigley Field. The host was amazing, so quick to respond and even helped when I needed an item I had forgotten! Would definitely recommend.
The house was a perfect size for my family and it was nice and clean. The check out was so helpful with a later checkout and easy instructions. Thank you!!

Nice place. Michael reached out ahead of time to explain everything. The house was clean and we enjoyed the surrounding restaurants that were just a short distance from the house. We would definitely stay again if we return to Chicago.

Perfect house and location for a long weekend to see a couple of ballgames. Tons of restaurants and bars around, short walk to the train, the lake, and Wrigley. Matt was a great host and very responsive. We had one minor little issue and they helped us sort it out in no time. Would definitely stay again if we were coming back to Chicago.

Perfect stay for our trip. Lynette and Efrain were very kind and helpful. Location is close to a lot of bus stops so getting around was easy. And the house isn’t far from the blue line so getting to and from O’Hare was a breeze.
Great location, very clean, and a wonderful place to stay for a long weekend while exploring Chicago!
This is the nicest Air bnb - it’s new, spacious, clean, & a great location.
Great place for a group looking for a place to stay in an awesome area of the city.
A wonderful perfect space

Amazing stay with Maria as an amazing host!! She was so sweet and accommodating! The place is super cute and super comfortable with very comfortable beds. As two women staying in Chicago we felt very safe in the area is super walkable! It was so nice to be able to walk down the street to a couple of bars and for dinner we would 100% stay again! Thanks so much, Maria 🙂

Place was very convenient and very clean inside but I wish that the hallway by the entrance of the apartment was cleaner. The only way to communicate with the host is by email so don’t bother to call for anything.
Cute little apt.  Nice stay!  Great location.
The host was amazing, and the place was kept clean and very handy!
Great place to stay! Would recommend to anyone looking

We had a nice stay. Not necessarily worth what we paid for in our opinion, but wasn’t much available in the area when we booked.
Pros: Home was spacious and in a quiet area. Felt safe walking around. Beds were comfortable. Lots of seating.
Cons: Had some issues with locating garage parking and then even more of an issue trying to make the tight turn to park! Had issues with dining room lights not working but my husband is an electrician and got them working-switch needs replacement. Host was quick to respond but said they would have to notify homeowner. Bedroom ceiling light did not work and that one we could not fix-had to use the lamps provided. Found a pile of dirty clothes in the closet and some leftover hairs in the showers so not super clean. Again, host was quick to apologize/respond but nothing offered in the way of “correcting” it. Not a lot to cook with given the amount of people it can sleep.
Overall, we would likely not stay again unless the nightly rate was lower.
Loved this place!  Perfect cute little place and loved the feel of it.  Updated, clean and comfortable.   Great host and communication was awesome.  Highly recommend and will definitely be back!

My stay here was everything I had hoped for and exceeded my expectations. Richard and his family keep a beautiful property that feels like a little oasis among the city. It is an easy walk to multiple bus and train lines. Our host was very communicative with instructions and quick to answer questions. The space was put together so thoughtfully with plenty of space (there were two of us but it could have comfortably slept 3-4) and a full kitchen to cook in house. It was perfect for a few days in the city and a very comfortable place to sleep at night. Next time I return to the city, I would check to see if this place is available first.
Great pick!! Came here for Lolla with my band!!! Glad we chose this space! Great communication and easy to work with! From start to finish this spot was super clutch!!!
Great house in a nice neighborhood. Felt right at home and very comfortable.
Thanks so much for a great stay! Definitely recommend parking at the Margate Field House - there was no street parking. Would return!
Very helpful and responsive! Nice place a bit outside of the city but conveniently close enough to go downtown.
This house was perfect for our Bach weekend. Its proximity to the train made it easy to travel into the city. The garage was nice to store our vehicles. Great place!

One of the best places we have ever stayed at!! It has lots of space, cute bedrooms, a nice private backyard, and a large kitchen stocked with everything you could possibly need. It was perfect for our two young kids - sound machines and kids cups provided. Emily even left us a special kids' book to take home! Best of all, Emily was an excellent host. She made things easy, was friendly and super responsive. Highly recommend!

Caryl was a lovely host! We had a wonderful stay; the neighborhood was peaceful and safe, right near the UChicago campus. Caryl was kind and checked in with us multiple times. I would definitely recommend this space for anyone looking to stay in Hyde Park.
Top Notch host. Highly recommend
Great place to stay.  Very clean, great location and great communication from the host.
Good stay!
It’s just expensive in Chicago, especially on certain weekends. Overall, a great place to stay.

We had a wonderful time during our stay here. The host was incredibly responsive and went above and beyond to ensure our comfort and satisfaction. However, we were a bit taken aback by the number of stairs and the absence of an elevator when we first arrived. Despite this minor inconvenience, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it to others! Thank you for a wonderful weekend :)

Had a great stay overall! The host was very honest and upfront about the fact that it’s a basement unit, so there may occasionally be some things you’d expect from a basement. During my stay, I did encounter a centipede, which I understand can happen in a basement. Aside from that, the place was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. Overall, I had a great stay and really appreciated the honesty and communication from the host.
Great stay and close to public transport. Perfect for lolla.

this place was so perfect for a quick trip up to Chicago. Only two of us stayed here could’ve slept three if possible, but no more. It was pretty clean and had everything we needed. The host was super responsive. The check-in process was smooth and it even came with the parking spot!!!!!

We had a great time at Terry’s Apartment. We took our 7 month old to his first Cubs game and the apartment was perfectly located to easily get to Wrigley. The apartment is on a quiet street and close to many restaurants.

This neighborhood is so cute and away from most busy streets which is nice at night time, but still close enough to walk to the cute Lincoln Park areas and Old Town.
The place is adorable! We loved having our own rooms and a cute outdoor patio to chill at in the mornings.
Fantastic great host!
stayed here for lollapolooza and although it was abt an hour commute via public transit, to downtown the price was reasonable for our stay!
Place was as advertised and  in a quiet neighborhood
Looks brand new on inside. Great location. In the middle of everything.
Nice place to stay, close to bus stop that make easy to go to downtown. We frequently go to Chicago, and next time maybe will stay there again.

Everything about our stay was great! The home was honestly so much nicer than expected, and we felt very comfortable. Derek was very kind and communicative, and I would not hesitate to book this home if you can!

Monica was a fantastic host. The listing was exactly as described, if not even better in-person! My friends and I were excited to explore Chicago and catch a few baseball games while in town. Monica's place was conveniently located and an ideal size for our group. Would definitely recommend this listing for any groups looking to visit Chicago! Thanks for hosting!
Very responsive host; about a minute to two minute, walk to the California green line train, which was super helpful to get down to the city in Grant Park.
Great stay and great hosts. Very responsive and flexible with check in and checkout. Perfect Airbnb for a larger group, location was nice with easy access through the city
Great place for Cubs games.   Hosts were flexible with allowing parking before and after checking in and out which was a really nice benefit.
Liz and Martin were perfect hosts, and their home is beautiful! We would absolutely stay again.

We were easily able to accommodate our whole group and the size of the airbnb allowed for us to chill between going out for various activities in Chicago. The guest experience for us was amazing and I would absolutely recommend this to any large group.

We had 10 people staying in this space over Lollapalooza weekend and it was the perfect landing spot for it. A couple blocks from the L and tons of places within walking distance. The apartment is exactly as pictured/described and Assel was very responsive. The instructions were very easy to follow - would recommend this space to those looking to book a group of this size.
We really enjoyed our stay and would come back next time we're in Chicago!
Had a nice birthday weekend there; the neighbors were very nice. The back patio was beautiful at night. Beds were comfortable, i would definitely book this house again
Such a beautiful place to stay! And Hunter is such a wonderful host. The space had everything we needed to enjoy our stay and it is in such a great location.
Great location to get around Chicago and very communicative host! Comfy bed and lofty ceilings with nice natural light.
Place was very nice- lots of room. The parking spot was an added bonus. The host were responsive with anything we needed

Everything was great and as described. We didn’t need a thing, a home away from home. There were even amenities we didn’t expect which were a nice added like toothbrushes and toothpaste- my daughter forgot hers at home and so we didn’t need to run somewhere and buy it. We had a wonderful stay and we were so close to a little market to get items we wanted and also very close to the L-train and subway systems which were very convenient and our main way of getting quickly around Chicago on a budget. Since we drove ourselves to Chicago the parking space option was great and we left our car the entire time until we went home with no issues. Public transportation rather than driving in that busyness was so nice as we are used to rural/very low traffic areas. Thanks again for the wonderful place to stay!

We had an absolutely incredible stay at Casa Wolfram for Lollapalooza 2026! I stayed here with my two daughters, and to quote my youngest, this place is "awesome and Insta-worthy!" Russ was a fantastic host and provided everything we needed and more. The bonus goodies left for us to enjoy during our stay were such a thoughtful and loved surprise. We also fell completely in love with the Logan Square neighborhood—the vibes are remarkable and the people are so wonderful. We would jump at the opportunity to stay here again. Thank you so much for having us, Russ!

Before even booking, the communication and accommodations this place had for my dad was perfect. This was our first time booking an airbnb, we had so many concerns because of that. But it all worked out. We were extremely happy with our stay.
Our stay was great and we had a wonderful stay for Lollapalooza weekend. The location was good distance and our host was very responsive and extremely kind. Would recommend!

This place was perfect for our girls trip for a Cubbies game. Quick Uber to Wrigleyville and plenty of places to walk for dinner, drinks, and brunch. We enjoyed our stay. Great price for the location.
Had a lovely 3 night stay here with some friends. it’s a great space, has a nice neighborhood, and was overall very nice!

Stayed here for a bachelorette party. The house was as gorgeous! Loved all of the bedrooms and common areas. It was designed perfectly for large groups.
Host was very responsive and answered questions we had quickly. The extra beds we needed were made up upon arrival with foam pads and sheets.
Great location with so many things in walking distance!

Great space and location for a group of 11 people. Very accessible area, walkable to all of the west loop. All beds were comfortable and our group had a great time. We weren’t able to use the converted garage room as a bedroom due to the heat in there. Otherwise the rest of the space was great. Both terraces were great to use as well.
nice room, the hallways kinda messy but clean room! bus stop was also super close
Great stay and location! The space was perfect for our group
Jen's place was exactly as described. Great location, clean, spacious, wonderful outdoor space and no problem finding parking. The unit was exactly what we needed for our family wedding weekend!
The stay was great and came with all we needed. Working distance from the CTA to get to wherever we needed in about 15 min!
Great place to stay, no complaints, place is a little hard to see if you are arriving in at night time.

Andrew and Kaylee were exactly what you would want from a host. Friendly and accommodating, responsive and available, and they made great recommendations. Their space is comfortable and homey, walking distance to the train, great restaurants, bars, Wrigley field, and other conveniences like coffee shops, grocery store, and a Target. The parking space behind the house is a huge plus as on street / public parking can be tricky and requires a permit during certain hours. The place was perfect for us especially since we are used to city residential living. I hope it's available when we come back next year!
It was such a great place. We loved all of it, clean, practical, beautiful, easy to get to where we wanted to be. Patricia is a great host, very responsive and proactive. We would come back.
We enjoyed our stay! Taher is very responsive and accommodating. The condo is lovely with updated utilities. Staying here made for a great weekend in Chicago.

Absolutely loved this Airbnb. The moment we walked in, it felt like we had stepped out of modern-day Chicago and straight into a hidden speakeasy from another era.
The attention to detail is incredible. The dark walls, antique portraits and mirrors, vintage lighting, rich leather and velvet furniture, old-school kitchen, beautiful tile work, and even the unexpected little details throughout the space all come together perfectly. Everything feels intentionally curated, almost like every piece has a story.
What I loved most was the entire space was a full experience, not just a place to stay. It was intimate, a little mysterious, and incredibly charming. You could spend an hour just walking around noticing things you missed the first time.
Beautifully done, memorable, and unlike anywhere I’ve stayed before. I would absolutely stay here again. Five stars without hesitation!!
We had a great stay here in Chicago! The space is huge and had plenty of amenities. We booked it mainly for proximity to transit, and it was easy to walk to multiple train lines from here.

Great place to stay! Very responsive host. Great stay for us, train track is right next to the apartment- so if you have anybody sensitive to loud trains throughout the day,  you should be aware of that. It didn't affect our stay at ALL! Thanks Justin
Excellent listing, the apartment is great. However, the metro is nearby and very loud every time it passes through. Despite that, the location is great and host is very accommodating and responsive
Perfect location for an evening Cubs game!  Five minute walk to stadium, but removed from the chaos on a quiet street.
House is super cool, Ryan is super friendly and responsive! had a great time.
Yuanuans house was everything we were looking for! They were very responsive when we had a question. Highly recommend staying here!

We had a great time in Chicago! Nicholas’s place is in a very safe neighborhood and was perfect for my husband and me. The place was immaculate, welcoming and had all the amenities. We walked to some great restaurants and the park. We highly recommend staying here!
It was very clean and comfortable. It has anything you could possibly need during your stay.
Great responsive host! Everything was as described, and was helpful when needed. I strongly recommend this place for anyone who needs a spot in Chicago!
Had a great time!

Perfect location for exploring Chicago, in a lovely area, close to beach, shops, restaurants and trains. Lots of space and storage, perfect for families, 2 bathrooms is really handy. Decor and furniture needs updating and doesn’t come with a toaster or grill. Assel was extremely helpful and quickly dealt with an issue out of anyone’s control due to weather and always responded quickly to any messages or queries. Would recommend for families or large groups wanting to explore Chicago.
We had a great stay for our group with no issues.  It was very pleasant and easy.  Kash checked in and was a great host.
Good for a short trip.
We chose this rental because of the location, and it was perfect for what we needed.  Description and photos matched the experience.  Clean, neatly appointed and just what we were looking for.

Nossa estadia no espaço da Sarah foi incrível! Ela é uma excelente anfitriã e o espaço dela perfeito! Exatamente como nas fotos! A vizinhança é bem tranquila e silenciosa. Fica há alguns quilômetros do centro, mas pagávamos cerca de 25-30 dólares pela corrida. Nos sentimos em casa e super recomendamos!

We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this Airbnb! The home was incredibly clean and spacious, making it a perfect fit for our family. The check-in and check-out instructions were clear and easy to follow, which made everything stress-free.
We also appreciated having a designated off-street parking space and the host was kind, responsive, and quick to answer any questions we had. It was so convenient to have a convenience store just around the corner, and the location was ideal - everything we wanted to visit was just a short drive away.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would absolutely come back again the next time we're in the area!
Demitri's place is absolutely amazing. It is close to the train, restaurants, and Wrigley. We enjoyed coming back after long days of baseball and exploring. Would definitely come back! Thank you!

This was my first Air B&B and it was great. Super clean, comfortable and exactly what was the description said. It is close enough to the subway and easy to get downtown.
I highly recommend this listing, the neighborhood is quiet and safe. We had a great time in Chicago.
The location was perfect, easy to walk around. The apartment was nice, quiet, and a great place to stay. Highly recommend!
Our stay was great. Would definitely stay here again.
Thankful for Paul opening his home. We had a large group but felt at home and enjoyed the amenities and space. The space was clean and welcoming!
The place was nice

Tia was a great host! Her place is small, but perfect for what we needed and the price is right. She was super easy to contact whenever we had issues and was extremely kind. I would definitely book with her again if I wanted to come back to Chicago! The one minor complaint I have is that the second bed is more of a futon and was not super comfortable, so keep that in mind. There was also a faint smell of cigarettes when we arrived. But otherwise great place to stay.
Awesome location, terrific hosts

Amazing! If you’re heading to Chicago for games at Wrigley and or Rate stop looking and just book this unit ASAP! Host is amazing. Unit is amazing. Location could not possibly be any better! Clean, safe, perfect layout and steps to the red line and few steps more and you’re at Wrigley.

This location was a great walkable site for seeing all of downtown Chicago. The Airbnb was clean and we enjoyed the time spent inside and outside of the apartment. Thank you so much for a wonderful stay in your city.
James Andrews
Great access location to uber everywhere we needed, great space & hosts were always in communication with us if we needed anything !

Such a great place to stay for two couples in Chicago! We loved our beautiful block and how walkable the place was to food and shopping. The place was super clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed!

The Landing was great, very communicative/responsive. Decorated/clean like as if a home away from home.
This property specifically had some issues but that was issues with the property.
I will definitely stay and use Landing again! Star 5 Rating for their services for sure!

my only con is the walls are thin so if you get neighbors that don't respect the quiet after ten rule you might be able hear them moving around and conversing. other than that, i love how walkable the distance was from everything i wanted to do. even if it wasn't, there's buses and trains you can take that's about a five min walk. i enjoyed my here and would definitely book again.
Really clean and smells so good. super clear communication!!! 10/10
Easy check in and check out!
Good place to stay for a few days. I had no issues and Victor is very responsive!
The space matched the description and Milan gave us very clear instructions that were easy to follow. Milan is very responsive and proactive in checking on his guests.

Like many other reviewers Julian was indeed a great communicator and very responsive. Had a great weekend—the neighborhood is great, the apartment is big, and the outdoor patio was awesome. The apartment had a couple of random rooms that were more like for storage. Perfect for a short term anchor for the great city of Chicago.

If you're looking to stay close to Wrigley, this is the perfect location with approximately a 5 minute walk. Plenty to do surrounding the apartment within walking distance. Quiet, clean, cozy. Was perfect for our weekend stay of 2!

Place was perfect for what we were looking for. Super close to Wrigley and very cozy.  Would definitely rent from this team again, they were responsive, helpful and communicative from booking to check out.
The place was the perfect size for my friends bachelor party group to stay

Milan was incredibly responsive throughout the entire stay and before hand. The location of this AirBnb was amazing in relation to the South Loop and all of the museums around Grant Park. Easy check in and check out. We had a slight issue regarding the lack of towels at the location when we arrived. We didn't get them until 11:30pm for our 2pm check-in but Milan was very communicative through out. Additionally, there was a small leak coming from a pipe due to heavy rain. This seemed like a larger building issue. Overall, the stay was great with a lot of room.
Great location to see a game at  Wrigley Field!  Place was spotless.  Host very responsive to any questions we had.
Was just as described!
The place is beautiful and although it’s on a major road it’s very peaceful and the outdoor patio in the back is beautiful and quiet!!

Beautiful place! We started out with a bit of trouble with lock box codes and getting the right keys, but Rida was always very responsive and helped us troubleshoot. It was walkable to loads of fun restaurants and shops, and we even walked to the Cubs game from there! Great spot, very clean, would stay again!
I have rented from this company every summer for 5 years now and they are very professional and always helpful.  I highly recommend them.

Nikkole was very communicative and I really appreciated that as a first-time bnb renter! We initially looked at a different location that she owns, but it didn’t quite work for our group and she was able to recommend another location that would suit our needs better. She made sure we had what we needed and also answered all of my many questions!
Great location and fantastic hosts! Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again. Had a phenomenal trip and loved this bnb.

We had a group of 8 (4 couples) staying here, and the layout was perfect. We enjoyed our stay, and the pictures represented the place pretty well. We found the location to work for us - just a close Uber ride to downtown. However, many parts of the apartment are showing wear (eg cabinets), the blinds and windows were pretty dirty, and the garbage chute was broken so the garbage room was pretty unpleasant. In addition, we found them to be very strict on check in time, even when we requested that they let us know when the cleaning was done (they never did). There’s also not very much within close (1-2 block) walking distance. Overall, we didn’t think this was worth the price, but we did enjoy our stay.
This was a very convenient place to stay. Walkable to downtown and there are plenty of restaurants and a grocery store close by.
Great location, very nice host. Would visit again.
Very nice place. Great location. Plenty of room. Easy access to wherever you want to go.
Muy lindo inmueble, con un hermoso balcón con buena vista a la ciudad de Chicago. El anfitrión estuvo muy atento y cualquier pedido fue solucionado rápidamente.

Great 2 BR apartment that gave us extra space and privacy with our adult son and his girlfriend. It was close to downtown and walkable to lots of things to do. We were just a few blocks from the Red line so getting to Wrigley was quick too!  The place was neat and clean and had some nice touches like coffee and shampoo/conditioner provided.

Seriously so kind and such fantastic hosts! Would 100% recommends also they’re just really cool people! Definitely one of those truly special Airbnbs where you actually are welcomed by the hosts! Thanks again for a fantastic stay! They also have a very cute dog!

Great location - convenient to restaurants and public transportation. The apartment was ok for our big group. We were disappointed to find the apartment was cooled by three small window air conditioners that do not fully cool the entire apartment.

We had a great stay! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was excellent—very close to the train and bus stops, making it easy to get around the city. It was also within walking distance of the lake and many great places to visit in Chicago. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the city.

This home was perfect for our stay! Pricing was worth it and getting around was so easy. CTA Pink line is 4 min walk from the place which helped us get around from either downtown, Chinatown or even Wrigley Field transfers. There’s a washer and dryer that can be used as well. There’s multiple options to sleep on if you’re a single guest. Single bed in living room, another room with a singular bunk bed, and a sofa bed in the living room. Everything was cleaned and as described. Luis was responsive and let us know if we needed anything he was there to help. Cleaning instructions are bare to none as well. One of the best hosts I’ve had at an Airbnb. Lots of bars and restaurants near by as well. I would definitely book this place again!
Better than described and very spacious!

I really enjoyed our stay at Ian's place. The whole place had a really cool Vibe very spacious. Definitely would go back. The only thing I would say and it's just me is Maybe some throw blankets on couches as an option and maybe just a few more towels available.  Everything was great and Ian was amaxing with communication.

The accommodation was exactly as promised, and the house was super clean and comfortable overall. While the host didn't explain how to use some of the appliances, she was very responsive via text. Keep in mind that check-in and stay management are completely virtual. Location-wise, it's close to the metro and a supermarket, great for anyone visiting UChicago!

As a female, safety is my number one concern when traveling anywhere. John and Görkem’s house was in a very safe and quiet street, and was also very easily accessible to the train station. Their house was honestly so charming and clean, and they had the sweetest cats (which is a plus for me haha). Both gentlemen were super nice and friendly to talk to, and I appreciate them for hosting my first visit to Chicago! If I come back, I will love to stay again if they will allow me :)
Clean place in a great location. Bozena is responsive in a timely manner and an excellent host.

Ikechi’s place served me and six of my friends very well! It’s very close to a train station which took about 10 minutes to get downtown. The place was very clean and comfortable. Ikechi responded quickly to any questions we had and I would definitely recommend!

I'm recommending this place for a stay! Nice and clean, with great contact with the owner, who was very helpful and responded quickly. She allowed us to leave the luggage before the check-in time, which I really appreciated.

We had a wonderful stay here with our family! The location was excellent and within easy walking distance of plenty of restaurants, shops, and other attractions, which made getting around Chicago incredibly convenient.
Check-in was simple and hassle-free, and the host communicated clearly throughout our stay, making the entire process smooth from start to finish. One of the biggest perks was the onsite parking—it was a huge bonus and made traveling with our family so much easier.
Overall, this was a great place to stay, and we'd definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!
房间很美，地段很好，虽然给了满分，但是我想说房东（或者管家）态度比较冷漠。

Location is great. Communicationg from the host was great as well. Unfortunately, there were many things broken or not working in the unit. The master toilet was not working. There was a broken window that we could not shut, and the train noise is extremely loud because of that. The door to the balcony would not latch. Overall it's a nice place, but for the price point there were too many things dysfunctional or not working.
Ewa’s place was very nice and clean.  There was plenty of space for all of us, a beautiful kitchen and very quiet neighbors.  We loved the area and would definitely stay here again.
Patricia was amazing host. Fast courteous replies to any issues we had during our stay.
Great location. Nice apartment. The communication was confusing at first because I felt like I was going back and forth with the airbnb app and the host's messaging system.
This place was spotless!! Everything that was described for this location was there. My wife appreciated all the little extras that you would need as if you were living in this space long-term!!

El alojamiento está en una zona residencial pero con buen acceso de transporte al centro. La habitación era justa para dos personas y tenía el baño enfrente. La disposición de las habitaciones es algo problemática si hay gente ruidosa porque se escucha bastante. La cocina está muy bien equipada y el living es amplio.
Amazing

The accommodation was lovely, and certainly appeared to be a recent renovation. The apartment suited 10 of us well. It was very clean and well appointed. I didn’t realize it was a basement apartment until we arrived but it made access easy. The neighborhood is amazing with great amenities nearby. I highly recommend.

We had a lovely stay at this East Pilsen gem.  This is one of Chicago's greatest neighborhoods, and this place was on a quiet sidestreet but close to all of the action.  Hena was helpful and responsive - would definitely recommend!

Great stay, Beautiful, clean, convenient. We were there for a family wedding.
No hassles whatsoever. Would rent again.

I had a great stay at Danielle’s. Everything was how described, it’s a wonderful apartment and a pretty and comfortable guestroom.
The neighborhood isn’t the greatest but bus is around the corner and the train 8 minute walking away, so it’s pretty easy to get somewhere else.
I’d def book again :)

The airbnb was not cleaned when we arrived, but the host responded quickly and they were able to send out cleaners as soon as possible. The kitchen and living room were spacious and we were able to find street parking nearby (as per the description, the parking space in the back is very narrow). Great location too.
Convenient location near good restaurants, and train stop.  Nice neighborhood too.

The apartment was comfortable enough. Beds were very comfy! Katty was responsive over email, but wasn't nearby/on-site. We needed extra blankets and because there was no staff on-site or nearby, it took a day to get them dropped off. The apartment lacks supplies (like extra pillows/blankets/towels, decent coffee for a late-night arrival with no time to shop). And the TV did not work at all. No reception. No channels and no instructions on how to use it. The location was not great. We loved the local nearby ethnic restaurants, but we were far from the city. We knew that would be the case, but it was really expensive, given the distance from downtown. Parking was also hard--sometimes there were spots. Other times we drove around 10-20 mins. scouting for a spot.  We always found one, but sometimes it was a 10 min. walk from the apartment.
Had a great stay at Jeffrey’s! Everything was clearly explained. Folks were all super kind! No notes! :)
Great place. Well located and clean.

Bradleys space is in a safe neighborhood. Plenty of places to eat all within Walking distance. Mexican restaurant, Cuban restaurant, taco restaurant, hot dog restaurant, bagel store, McDonald’s, candy/Ice cream shop, pizza and the Blue Line Subway all a short walk away. The space itself I felt right at home. Nice small apartment. I would stay again if I return to Chicago.

Great host. Beautiful home. One of the most beautiful streets in Lincoln Park -which has lots of beautiful streets! Home was even more beautiful than pictures. Host worked with us to ensure we could safely drop off our luggage- a lifesaver!

Great house!  The location couldn't have been better.  Lots of bars and restaurants in walking distance and it is a very safe neighborhood.  The house was clean and very nice.  Jamie was a pleasure to work with and communicated well.

I stayed with my brother, and we had a wonderful time. Weihong was incredibly responsive and helpful. The whole place was clean and we were able to settle in immediately. It was a pretty easy location to get to downtown, and the free parking was easy to find. Overall, if I come back to Chicago I would be very happy to stay here again, as there was simply nothing more I could’ve asked for!

John was very kind and responsive! He made sure I felt at home and was very accommodating when needed, the home was nice, peaceful, and the view was great from the room. I appreciate all they both did for me during my stay.

Bianca fue muy amable, el lugar estaba bien limpio, el equipamiento era suficiente pero limit ado, una heladera muy pequenia sin freezer ,sin lavarropas, las ventanas no tenian cortinas por lo que la luz desde temprano daba sobre la cama, el barrio basicamente tranquilo. La principal queja reside en que si bien se aclara que es un atico nunca se menciona que para llegar hay que subir 50 escalones
.Somos dos personas de mas de 70 anios y esto lo mencionamos en el intercambio previo .Subir y bajar 50 escalones con equipaje requiere un esfuerzo considerable que debia ser aclarado
Great place, easy to find and easy parking.
Gracias por todo

Great stay for my trip to chicago, close to CTA bus and train. He even helped me move into a new room as i hadn’t planned prior to stay an extra day and everything was nice and easy. Shared bathroom and kitchen space with other guests was not a problem!

Can’t say enough about the location. Walkable to many restaurants and shops, and especially to Wrigley field. Also, right on the bus line, which gives you access to all other areas of Chicago. Loved this place!!
We enjoyed this apartment.  It was in a convenient location for the weekend.  The back deck was very nice.
Loved this place! Wrigleyville is awesome and the house is about 150-200 yards away from Wrigley field! Niel was very responsive and helpful. Would definitely return!

I did not end up staying with Ingrid. The apartment was dirty, and my bedroom did not have a lock that allowed me to secure it while I was away. When I tried to discuss these concerns with Ingrid, she became defensive, incorrectly told me that Chicago does not allow keypad locks on bedroom doors, and refused to discuss the matter further. Airbnb ultimately stepped in and canceled my reservation.
Was very easy to get in, such a beautiful home felt very comfortable to sleep in!!

Loved our stay!! The apartment was a cozy, but still had plenty of room! Lived having a kitchen to save from eating out every meal. Host was very responsive and even provided snacks! Cannot recommend this place enough.
Great host. Good communication with host. Plenty of room and things to do!
A wonderful space, in a very accessible part of Chicago. Jennifer was responsive, helpful and professional. Definitely worth a repeat visit!
Super!
Nice bedroom, as described. Lots of fridge space.
The place is perfect for a short stay. It was clean and organized. The area is quiet and safe, I walked home alone late at night and there was no sketchy people around. I would recommend
Helpful hosts

Perfect apartment for our father/son weekend in Chicago.  Check in was smooth and instructions were very clear.  The apartment was clean and had all the amenities we needed.  Great local restaurants and very convenient to the “L”.

Based on the awesome reviews, I had high expectations of Lashonda's place and I was not at all disappointed. The place was spacious, very tastefully decorated, and had comfy couches and beds. The black history theme made us feel like we were living a bit of history without even leaving!
The neighborhood felt very safe - we went for a walk after dark feeling completely at ease. Although we didn't find many stores within walking distance, there were lots of options a short drive away. We wouldn't hesitate to stay at Lashonda's place again, and highly recommend it!!
The stay was wonderful, and the hosts were great. I would highly recommend this airbnb, especially for those wanting to experience Pilsen!
Stay was comfortable and well worth the deal. A short walk from the train and easy access to the entire city.

We had a wonderful stay! Tracy and Andy were incredibly kind, responsive, and always checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. The place was very clean, cozy, and comfortable, making it easy to relax after long days of exploring Chicago. One of the biggest perks was the location. It was just a short walk to the train station, so getting around the city was quick and convenient. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

A three king bedroom apartment is such a rare find and was perfect for our group of three couples! Spacious and clean, and the location was perfect - just a 5-10 minute walk to Wrigley! Nick, the host, was super communicative and very gracious. Would stay again!

A few days to a week before I arrived, Julio sent the wifi password and code for the lockbox. Julio was extremely communicative and assured me that while I stayed I should treat his place like home. Julio gave me a heads-up about the long line at a local restaurant and even gave me a ride to a nearby cafe after my checkout. When Julio stopped in during the day, he notified me and chatted with me about his experiences in Chicago and the area. During my solo trip to Chicago, I felt not only safe, but comfortable staying with Julio and on Ashland.
Really great spot. Matt was flexible during check in and quick to respond. Very good recommendations. 10/10
Friendly hosts in a beautiful home. We knew we would be a little out of the city but it was very easy to get the train to and from the airport and to the city centre. We enjoyed our stay.

My husband and I celebrated our anniversary with a trip to Chicago. Damien’s place was perfect for us, updated and comfortable in a lovely neighborhood. Damien was always great about responding when we had a question and even helped us navigate the bus line to get to Wrigley. If we come back to Chicago, I’ll check to see if his place is available again. A+ stay.
Great clean space! Saved our trip with some other last minute cancellations. Comfy, Cousy, and well out together.

Scott was an outstanding host from start to finish. Communication was prompt, clear, and incredibly helpful, making check-in and the entire stay completely seamless. The home was spotless, beautifully maintained, and exactly as described—if anything, it exceeded our expectations.
The location was fantastic, and Scott had thought of every detail to make guests feel comfortable, from thoughtful amenities to local recommendations. It was obvious that he genuinely cares about providing a first-class experience.
We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend Scott’s place to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and stress-free Airbnb experience. Thanks again for a wonderful stay!

Pros:
- Great location. We stayed here to visit the Obama Presidential Center, which was about 20 minutes away. Meijer and Sam’s Club were 15 mins, and downtown was maybe 30 mins. There’s a pretty decent jerk restaurant around the corner.
- Convenient onsite parking.
- Spacious living space and bedrooms.
- Well-equipped for a large group, with just about everything you need (except an air fryer)
Cons:
- The home could use a deep cleaning. There was noticeable dust/ dirt buildup behind the stair case railing and the sides/back of the toilet(s) and what appeared to be mold above the upstairs shower.
- There were no instructions for locking the back door. I was able to figure it out, but clear instructions would be helpful for future guests.
- Be sure to bring your own bath towels and washcloths. The listing notes that only hand towels are provided, so come prepared if you’re staying overnight.

Gerry's place was an excellent find!! This beautiful gem was spacious, well designed, peaceful, and a pleasant surprise! It was a great location for a quick weekend trip to Chicago.  It was quick and easy access to the Obama Presidential Center and many great restaurants around The University of Chicago. I would definitely rent again!!
Great hotel , would definitely stay there again.

Great location. Quiet neighborhood. Nice area. Good food spots which are walkable to Susan and Tim’s place.
25 minute walk to Wrigley Field/Red line. Nice and easy walk.
Only negative is we all didn’t sleep great due to lack of air flow into the apartment and lack of AC.

Stayed at this beautiful apartment for a girls weekend in Chicago! We absolutely loved the fully walkable location as well as the layout of this home for 5 girls. There was plenty of space, the decor was beautiful, and the unit had everything we needed for our stay. We will definitely be back!

This was the perfect place for a long weekend with three of us! Great place with plenty of space to hang out and unpack. Nice area and super easy to get to public transit and explore the city! Parking was also super easy nearby

Overall, it was a great place to stay for a busy weekend in Chicago. The train was a few min from apartment, making it easy to get around. The building is a three story walk up, so I suggest packing light. Also, not much in the kitchen to help with cooking food in terms of oil or seasoning etc. The bathroom is also very small, re and the shower water is hard to figure out and very low pressure. But overall it was clean, charming and comfortable for the price we paid :)
The place was excellent. Very clean and the people we spoke to that run the rental were great. We would definitely stay again.
Wonderful stay! Place was so clean. Karen was the perfect host and I think the place was the perfect distance from downtown! It was a great weekend!
Good spot close to the train and near some places that the locals go.  Very nice.
Loved staying there. They're very friendly and helpful. I would stay again if I ever can.

Overall, this was a great place to stay. It was very walkable, not too far from the L and in a great part of town (Fulton Market). Ben was an awesome host - always responding super quickly with an answer to a question.
I traveled with my one-year-old, and the listing said there would be a pack and play and a high chair. I checked with Ben before arriving that they would be there. Easily found the pack and play, but there was no high chair. I messaged Ben, and he had one over to us in less than 24 hours.
The only other comment is that I thought the place could be a little cleaner. There was quite a bit of dust buildup, and the floor could use a good mopping.
That said, I would absolutely recommend it and would stay here again!
Great value, felt safe. Would stay again.
Beautiful apartment in a quiet neighborhood within easy walking distance of the blue line for quick Fulton Market and downtown access. Perfect for our Lolla long-weekend stay!

Besty’s place is the perfect location to enjoy Andersonville and the surrounding neighborhoods. It was exactly as described and had everything I needed for a short stay in a place that offers so many good options for eating out. The sun room was the perfect place to relax between outings. Betsy met me in person to let me in and then left me to it. Would definitely stay here again.

Biggest downside was cost vs experience. It was almost 8k for 6 nights.  Neighbors are crazy have a camera pointed at the hot tub and will come outside and stare are you for being in the hot tub. You can not be in hot tub past 10pm, i’d say just get rid of it at that point.  The house was acceptable.  Everything was relatively clean, like you could tell the showers weren’t cleaned and on of the toilets seats was falling off.  A kitchen drawer was also falling off.  The flooring had like gaps in it.  One thing is the downstair couch is adveraised at a 2 queen bed, which its not.  The basement also flooded while we were there so that was not great.  You can tell the owner bought a old run down house slapped paint on it and bought fancey looking stuff to make it feel higher end.  The upstair couch is 4 pieces which made it hard to sit in they slid apart. , we said for 5 nights, and it just felt okay not like a home, would rather be in hotel. Also no salt.
Wonderful spot that was a few blocks away from public transportation. Easy walk to Wrigley and easy access downtown
Nice place
Really enjoyed staying at Kristen’s. Offered a chance to explore a less touristy neighborhood with access to public transportation to get to the main sights around town.

Abel's place was amazing! Great location and very clean and tidy. And Abel was both very responsive and accommodating, including working to help us check in early and drop of our bags. Would definitely stay here again!
A wonderful apartment with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The owner is super responsive and very helpful with any questions. I’d also like to mention how clean everything was.

My stay at this Airbnb was amazing. It was very clean and spacious. The master room was very nice and comfortable. Although I was not able to check into my room earlier than 3pm, they accommodated me by allowing me to safely leave my belongings in the house until I was able to check in. Parking passes are available which made it easy for me to bring my car. I would definitely stay again at this Airbnb.
Very responsive and kind! Enjoyed our weekend stay.
I loved my stay! Very communicative and helpful :) Cozy and perfect for what I needed!
Bret’s place was exactly as described. Being steps from Wrigley Field was super cool. He was responsive and the place was cozy, perfect for a long weekend as a home base to explore Chicago.
Easy to find and super clean. The host was very friendly and replied quickly to my responses.
Great place, very clean and felt like the perfect size for 5 of us. Could definitely accommodate a few more. Loved the location and pretty easy to get to the city. Would stay here again!

This was a very big house , the beds are comfortable, lots of space for whatever. The neighborhood was worrisome but proved to be a very quiet block within that area, never had an issue and rarely seen anyone outside on that street! Don’t let the location fool you away from it. House also has a full alarm/security system i felt 100% safe!

This is not just a place to stay, it’s an experience.  Such a lovely home.  Every space, every room is lovely.  We were able to host extended family coming to Chicago for our daughter’s wedding.  Everyone got their own room and there was beautiful space to sit and visit.  The location is incredibly convenient. We walked to the store multiple times for last minute supplies.  The parking was a great bonus. A guest favorite was the multiple window seats.  This space made a special family weekend extraordinary.
I always stay in this area even though I spend most of my time downtown! Best value and John’s Airbnb was not an exception. Great stay and accommodating host
Very solid AirBnB in a great location!

Perfect location for a trip to Wrigley! The house is just one block from Wrigley Field, and you can actually see the stadium from the living room. It couldn’t be more convenient for catching a game.
The place was clean, comfortable, and perfect for our three-night stay. The beds were very comfortable, and as a light sleeper, I was pleasantly surprised that the trains behind the house were a complete non-issue.
The hosts were also great with communication and made everything easy. You’re a two-minute walk from the Red Line, as well as plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, and a 7-Eleven.
I’ll 100% stay here again the next time I’m in Wrigleyville. Highly recommend!
Justin was super responsive.  We had a few minor issues that needed resolved and he tackled them immediately and without question.  I would book again knowing Justin would always have our back.

Intoxicating cigarettes scent indoors. Streams shows late into the night with little consideration.  Arrived with a wet floor and  bed sheets. I do not recommend this location. Only positive note is the neighborhood is nice overall.
Very spacious place that was everything my group needed! Loved how we had easy access to both the buses and trains.
Kelsey was an amazing host! Incredibly responsive and kind and the home was immaculate! Highly recommend
I enjoyed my stay at The Versey!
Absolutely loved this Airbnb. Perfect location above the Long Room within easy walking distance of Wrigley Field. Would absolutely stay again in the future.
