My friends and I had a great stay. It was easy to park and get in. Freddy gave great check in instructions.  The place was very clean. Freddy was very accommodating. We needed more towels at one point and it was resolved in a matter of minutes. We also had no problem getting Ubers to and from downtown Chicago.

Laurie’s home was perfect for us traveling in to attend Lollapalooza. Her home had everything we needed from ample towels, a cozy fire pit, and comfortable air units. She was extremely responsive and friendly to all of our questions. I would totally stay here again! 😊
Nice place. easy to get to cubs stadium from here
Lovely place
Very welcoming and very accommodating! I would stay again!

I’ve had many good travel experiences through Airbnb. Staying in this home was truly the best experience I’ve had yet. The space is beautiful, spacious, peaceful, and well-equipped. The primary bathroom and closet are luxurious. Our gracious host Charissa was kind, welcoming, and accommodating. Book this place, you’ll thank me later!
Buen lugar para alojarte

Great location. Great host. They were very nice to provide extra towels and blankets. Clean. I only give it 4 stars instead of 5 because it’s located right above a train and had some noise at night. Not interoperable but could be a problem for light sleepers

This was a great place to stay and I would definitely stay here again. It was easy to find and in a great neighborhood. We felt very safe. The Airbnb was very clean and very comfortable. The owner was also very friendly and easy to communicate with.  Like I said this was a great place to stay.

Place was just what we needed! We booked a pretty last minute trip and planned to be out the majority of our stay. This space was a great home base for quick stops throughout our trip. We had no issue with the bar downstairs, we could barely hear them even on a busy Saturday night. Communication before and during our stay was fantastic and helped us feel comfortable and prepared upon arrival. Definitely recommend for those looking to explore Chicago comfortably.
Great location, easy walk to Wrigley.  Love the charm here.

If your looking for a nice place to stay in Chicago this is your spot ! Very clean and has everything that you need for your trip . Luis was an amazing host and you can tell he takes pride in being a good host ! Highly recommend his place !

We had a great time staying at Naomi and JJ's place! It was perfect for a gals reunion for 6 of us. We enjoyed Wrigleyville, Southport, and more. Naomi was very responsive and accommodating. Highly recommend!
Nice and comfortable place.   Easy to get in and out of.  Has everything you need but is a decent walk to stores and shops.
Great stay! Very clean and comfortable. Had everything I needed and Bridget was a very responsive host.
Highly recommended
Good, communicative host! There were a few mosquitos in our room when we arrived.
Damani’s place was as advertised. Slept 12 people pool in the back great location in Chicago it was worth it.

Patrick’s place was just what we needed! Loved that there were enough rooms for 5 of us and lots of places to eat nearby. Quick and easy to get to central Chicago too! Would recommend this place to my friends!
Very practical unit stocked with many snacks. Would recommend.

Wonderful place to stay! We felt right at home. Our host was very responsive, home was very clean, neighborhood is peaceful and walking distance to shops etc. Bonus was the garage we could park the car. Our host made sure we had everything we needed. We highly recommend staying here!
This was a really nice place! The neighborhood was super fun, and Jedidiah provided really clear instructions ahead of time so that finding the airbnb was quite easy.

This was the perfect Airbnb for a weekend in Chicago with a larger group! It is in a great location and has everything you will need. Kelly is also a great host with a rapid fast response rate. We really enjoyed our stay!
Place was very clean at a great price

This was a great place to stay! You see a lot of people daily whether they're walking their pets or just going for a stroll. Parking, however, is a pain. I would not recommend driving if you are staying here. Luckily, there is public transit within a 5 minute walk! Overall, this was a great stay and I would do it again!
Great place. Will definitely stay again.
Very responsive

We had a wonderful stay at the house!  The hosts even provided last minute extra toys for our grandson.  The 6 bedrooms were very comfortable and there were extensive kitchen staples.  Lovely house w 10 minute walk to beach and running/biking trails.

The host responded quickly to issues, but the stay didn’t feel warm or hospitable. The space wasn’t well-stocked for 8 days — we ran out of toilet paper, only two towels per person and not enough blankets despite the very cold space. Things got fixed once we reached out, but it didn’t feel considered upfront.
I knew the washer/dryer wasn’t for guest use, but when a serious wildfire in WA was burning down my hometown while I was away, I asked politely if I could use it, I offered to pay extra, and said I understood if it wasn’t possible.
Her response felt cold and harsh: this would be a “major exception” and she was “taking my word” it was a real emergency- making sure I knew it was a huge inconvenience. When I sent a news article sharing how serious it was, she just replied with a thumbs-up.
I host on Airbnb — I know that things go wrong, that’s totally fine. But kind words during an emergency shouldn’t be a big ask. It definitely worsened stress. I do not recommend staying
here…
Clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Marc was a super helpful host and check-in was seamless. Would gladly stay here again!
It was exactly as advertised. Comfortable and located very close to train station.

We were a bit to loud our first night being a guys trip and flight getting in later.    The way it was handled was professional amd kind.   The space was clean and in a great location for what we wanted to do while visiting.      I would love to come back again and rent other units he has in this building with a larger group for the Sport Card National or even Cubs game. !     Had a blast!
The hosts went above and beyond to make things comfortable, easy, welcoming, and fun!

This was the perfect place for our Chicago stay. It was located in a convenient area of town making it easy to get to all of the places we wanted to go. The host was very responsive and communicated well. The place was very clean and spacious!
Clean, simple, good for one person stay
Good communication. Clean place. Very pleased.
Spacious apartment centrally located.
This was exactly what we were looking for and it’s also in a great neighborhood with plenty to do. Daniel was accommodating and flexible with getting us in early. Loved our stay here.

Overall the host was  communicative and check-in was very smooth. The unit is pretty close to a few bus stops and its around 40 min away from the airport (~1 hr downtown) if you take transit. One downside is that the floorboards were pretty creaky. There also seemed to be some mold near the drain of the bathtub. It was otherwise clean and accurate to the photos.
Good overall experience
My cousins and I were visiting for the weekend and felt right at home here. Very convenient location with lots of space inside.
The place was a nice size, clean, and comfortable.

Patricia is great and place is very clean. Location is noisy however being close to highway traffic and trains passing every few minutes. Also place is a bit smaller than expected (ex. can’t fully open a bedroom door as it would hit the bed, etc.)
But thanks overall…
Samuel’s place is super convenient to the train and restaurants/bars in Lakeview and Lincoln Park.  The place is very clean and cozy.  It was comfortable for 4 of us.  I would definitely recommend!

This Airbnb was perfect for a couple visiting Chicago for the first time! The unit was small but we were out for the majority of our stay, so we really just needed a safe, quiet place to sleep. It’s only a few minutes walk from one of the stops on the red line which made it really easy to get everywhere on our itinerary. Iris was very responsive for the few questions I had before/during our stay.
The house was wonderful! Thank you for sharing it with us.

Chris's property was adequate for our family of eight for a Cubs weekend but didn't overwhelm us with the litte extras we have enjoyed in other stays.  It was clean and had all the basics that we needed for an enjoyable weekend. Chris was atentive and helpful as needed,  and he even helped us with our tickets for the game.

My friends and I came from out of town for Lolapalooza this year and this rental saved us! We opted to stay a bit further from the city. The location of the Airbnb was perfect only a very short walk to the blue line and the connections to the CTA busses! The house was so spacious and an artsy midcentury modern dream! We were only 4 people but the space could accommodate another 3 people. The rooms we used had comfy beds, great lighting and the house came equipped with literally anything you might need. Logan square has so much to offer too many restaurants and things to do around. The hosts were so nice and communicative throughout. Would definitely stay again!
Amazing
This was a super cozy spot with a friendly host. It was super close to get to wherever we wanted to go in Chicago. I would definitely recommend!

There were a couple issues with our stay. First being the check in process. We did not receive specific check in instructions until reaching out to the host on the day of our stay. Host did not respond to my message requesting the check in information however they did answer immediately upon calling them. The host provided the wrong unit, which resulted in us opening the door only to realize someone was already staying there. We then had to call the host again in order to receive the correct unit number and access code. Second, we noticed dirty/used silverware, what appeared to be stains on the wall from previously smooshed bugs, some stains on one of the towels, and the tv remote was chewed up/had bite marks. Outside of these issues the rest of our stay was pleasant.
Great stay in the heart of Lakeview.  Amazing location! Place matched the description and would stay again. Heather was also a great host!
Everything was clean and apartment was in a accessible place to get into the city
Clean, spacious place in Wicker park. Great weekend to explore chicago!
It was a great stay! Everything was really nice and clean!

Great location.  The apartment was exactly as described and the pictures were accurate. Host communicated proactively, clear instructions, and very responsive. We will definitely consider this place for our future trips to Chicago.

We were very happy with our stay at the beautiful Walton Residence. We felt safe, and we were in walking distance to great restaurants, shopping and attractions. The condo was spacious, stocked with the musts (to include coffee!), nicely decorated, without being cluttered. Beds were comfy too.

Such a beautiful home! My family and I had a wonderful stay at Cristina's place. Everything was spotless and the home was comfortable and welcoming. We also loved the surrounding neighborhood it felt very safe and was easily walkable. We would absolutely recommend staying here.

We had a wonderful 2-night stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Andy was an excellent host, friendly, responsive, and made us feel very welcome throughout our stay. We really appreciated the hospitality. Thank you again!
We had a great stay! The place was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed. It worked out perfectly for our trip, and we’d happily stay here again.
Cute place to stay! Great host! Perfect for lollapalooza

Absolutely amazing! Beautiful location and super accommodating. We explored all around Chicago on our bike bikes and felt super at home and comfortable in this Airbnb!  The hosts of this Airbnb were amazing!! 10 out of 10 would recommend
Very hospitable and friendly.

Everything was exactly as it was described in the listing. Very spacious, neat, and clean. The beds are very comfortable. Extra parking fee is worth it as the free street parking hardly had spaces available from what I saw the during our stay. The neighborhood is very nice and I wished we could’ve explored the stores in walking distance but we were in and out due to festivities for our family reunion. Hopefully this unit is available when we return in December for the holidays.
Thank you Tony!
This was a great spot for my friend’s bachelorette trip! Great location and plenty of space for all of us!

WHAT A SPECIAL PLACE!!!!! From the moment we arrived, we were so impressed with the home.  Quiet street with plenty of parking.  The house was super clean and had the cutest backyard and a basement with games.    Close to grocery stores, restaurants, and the new Obama center.  Beds were super comfortable and we really really appreciated all of the extras in the home, from lotion to aluminum foil to towels, extra toothbrushes, so many extras.   The rooms were a nice size and everything worked great.  No issues at all with the place.  NONE!!!   I often visit Chicago (its my home town) and now have a space to come back to whenever I am in town.   Thank you for such a wonderful space.
She was an amazing host and the house was really nice!
Enjoyed our stay. Easy access. A bit cramped with 3 but we made it work. Would definitely return.

We had a wonderful stay with our family at this Wrigleyville apartment. The apartment was exactly as described—very clean, spacious, and comfortable. We especially enjoyed the patio, which was a great place to relax after a day of exploring the city.
The location was one of the biggest highlights. It was incredibly convenient, with easy access to both the bus and train, making it simple to get around Chicago. Although the train runs right next to the apartment, we didn't find it disruptive at all and had no trouble enjoying our stay.
Overall, this was a fantastic place to stay, and we would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and centrally located home base while visiting Chicago.
10/10 definitely recommend!!!!
Great place to stay if you ever in Chicago. Very comfortable,clean and well decorated. Host was very responsive! Thank you Kory!
Places was amazing and I can’t express enough how special it was. Highly recommend
Amazing stay! Great host! Would highly recommend
Love it ! very clean and cozy!

Felicia’s place was a great stay. It was about a 10 min walk to the green line. The place was very spacious for me and my fiance. It felt like a little comfy cozy home. The steam shower was  great addition and was very relaxing. I would stay here again!

The inside is great, very clean looking. The neighborhood is just slightly questionable, you have to be a little extra careful around the location. It feels very safe once you’re inside with the double doors being locked, though.
drew was very kind and the whole place was clean! good space to sleep!

Nicholas was a great host! Super quick to respond and friendly while doing so!
The house itself was amazing - spacious and modern. Very comfortable overall!
Robert was an excellent and communicative host. For a larger group this was a great Airbnb for us and in a great location close to everything in Chicago.

My stay with Adrienne was excellent. Her place is in a quiet neighborhood and not far from the city. There's also a bus stop a few blocks away. Adrienne greeted me upon my arrival and gave me a tour of the house. Her lovely, friendly German Shepherd greeted me as well, so if you love dogs you will LOVE Lou. The bedroom is in the attic and is very spacious, but if you're tall it might not be the most comfortable. I'm short and hit my head several times on the ceiling close to the bed, but not a big deal. The bathroom requires walking down the stairs and through the kitchen. Not ideal, but fine for me. Adrienne was super friendly and enjoys talking with her guests. This place is a great value if visiting Chicago for a short stay!
This is a great space for large groups/families! Beautiful and up to date. The beds were very comfy and we would definitely stay there again!

My group and I had a pleasant stay at this home. The outside porch and garage were great amenities, as was the spacious kitchen and ample rooms. I wish there had been 10 beds as described, but we were able to manage with the couch and an air mattress for the additional two.

This is a great value: a beautifully furnished, quiet apartment with a private entrance on a lovely street. There is even original art on the walls! Ewa was incredibly nice and helpful. It was also only a five minute walk to the metro and only a few stops from the center of town. And the neighborhood, Wicker Park, is fun to explore: interesting shops and restaurants and Victorian architecture.
Great place to call home while visiting Chicago. Very inclusive neighborhood with lots of shops and restaurants close by.
Tracee was very responsive and jumped at any issues (all minor and not related to host!) very quickly. The location was perfect for us and the price was good given it was Lolla weekend!
Nice clean place to stay and responsive host!
Fantastic place! Great location, wonderful host and overall a perfect place to stay when exploring Chicago. Also near amazing restaurants.
Great value for location in Downtown Chicago. Great amenities offered and included as well. Definitely my new go to spot for when I visit the city!!

I had a great stay! It was my first time in Chicago, and the staff were super friendly and helpful. The hotel is within walking distance to major landmarks, so it was very easy to get around. The front desk is open 24/7, and being able to text for room service was so convenient!

The space was well lit, thoughtfully decorated, and in the perfect location for my needs. I was attending an expo at McCormick Place, and the 7 minute drive made my life so much easier.
I really appreciated having a dedicated parking space. My only funny complaint (and it’s truly not Laura’s fault 😂) was getting my SUV out of the spot. Between the fence and the deep sewage drain nearby, backing out took a little maneuvering. If I had a smaller car, it probably wouldn’t have been an issue. Overall, this is me being ridiculous 😭. I would absolutely stay here again!

Kim’s place was great.. Secure, Clean and perfect for our needs. Kim was very responsive to any questions I had. Location was great only 25 mins to O’Hare and 15 into center city by Uber and 9 min walk to Red Line train .. close to Wrigley was walkable approx 15 mins and plenty of scooters which we did just for some fun and if we wanted to speed up the arrival. Whole Foods at the corner came in handy as well as a few later night food options. Totally recommend this property

Had a great visit in Chicago and Michelle’s place made it easy for that to happen! The apartment was very clean, easy to find everything, and Michelle was very gracious to let us check in an hour earlier. I would 10/10 recommend for her place and the neighborhood was very safe and felt easy to navigate.

Stayed here for a bachelor party with 8 other guys. Great location, big house (each floor has large living room and multiple bedrooms) and awesome backyard area!  15 minute easy walk to Wrigley.  Convenience store and Dunkin right across the street. Very responsive owners. Would stay again!
The host was very responsive and kind, we would definitely stay here again!

We enjoyed the neighborhood. Sarah was kind in her communication once we were able to reach her directly by text. However, several issues impacted our stay.
The kitchen lost power after using the microwave, leaving all of the kitchen outlets and appliances unusable on our second to last day. We initially reached out through Airbnb but did not receive a response until we contacted the host on her personal phone.
The unit was also missing several basic supplies, including dishwasher pods, coffee pods, paper towels, and sufficient toilet paper, so we had to make an unexpected trip to Target. In addition, two of the kitchen utensils were dirty when we arrived.
During our stay, it rained, and we discovered that a crack in the ceiling was leaking. We woke up to a puddle on the floor, which was concerning.
While the location was enjoyable but better communication, maintenance, cleanliness, and stocking of essential supplies would have made for a much better experience.
Plenty of room for 7 adults, spent a long weekend there, and it worked out perfectly.

Lovely stay at Tom's!
We appreciated the spacious common areas and plentiful sleeping space.
Very close to plenty of great spots for our group to eat and drink.
Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again in the future!
Perfect spot! Nesha is very friendly and super helpful. Great room and very private. Felt safe and comfortable and would definitely book again if I happen to be in the area.
Thank you for letting us stay at your wonderful spot in Chicago.  We had a great time exploring the city and attending the baseball games.  We would definetely come back again!
We had such a great stay! Super good location, quiet and quaint :)

Loved staying with Cesar and Maria! They were very responsive and flexible with our check in. The place has a cool design and it’s very spacious. The place was very clean and felt like we were right at home. Thanks for the coffee!

Location is perfect. Easy to get to many attractions and public transportation. Communication was great. There is quite a bit of outside noise from the street, and the couch is not a good place for someone to sleep other than small children. But unit was very clean with modern updates. Early check in and luggage storage is not an option however there is a convenient place to store bags near by at Enrich Market. Also a bonus is a great deli/breakfast spot directly across the street for quick eats as well as a Target less than a block away. Overall this stay was very good and I would certainly recommend for groups where two beds is enough.
For the price is was not worth it
Had an amazing stay
Great spot highly recommend
Booking details made checking in and out extremely easy and Patricia was very communicative whenever questions arose. The place was clean and perfect for the few days we spent in the area!

We had a wonderful stay at Sean’s place. He was very responsive, kind, and helpful with check in/check out, and the place was absolutely beautiful. We had plenty of space for all of us and it was easy to commute into the city. We loved being close to the water too! Would absolutely love to come back. If you book, the scavenger hunt was also lots of fun!!
Juan was extremely friendly and welcoming and we enjoyed our short stay here! Would definitely come back and stay again!

Wonderful stay, incredible location. Some amazing restaurants, bars and nightlife nearby. Easy access to red/brown lines were also clutch. The elevated train tracks do run right up to the building so there is constant train noise but you get used to it and did not affect our stay. All in all, great value and host — would definitely stay again.

This place is really wonderful. We stayed here to be close to Wrigley Field and it worked great. We really enjoyed the back porch area with games. And was able to walk around Wrigleyville shop and make easy quick stops back here to drop off things. We would definitely stay again. We had one small issue with hot water and they had it fixed super fast.  Place is decorated very nicely and loved all the small touches.
Wonderful place in a great setting. Scott and Mindy were very helpful and easy to communicate with.
Great location but too noisy.
Great place!!!! Well maintained and host answered all my questions.

We were in town for a wedding and the location was not only close to the venue but in the heart of everything we wanted…walk to the lakeshore, easy walk to the Magnificent Mile and shopping galore, a ton of good restaurants and 3 minutes from luggage storage! And an added bonus…a coffee shop in the lobby for quick breakfast. Numerous other breakfast places within minutes too.
The unit is nice. Some dishware if needed (we didn’t). Furniture is comfortable and newer. I would suggest, however, some thoughts for guest comfort. Mirrors in each bedroom for the ladies to do hair and makeup. The bathroom is small and if sharing with several adults, you need other spots to get ready. A bathroom remodel wouldn’t be tge worst thing either. It’s old!
We were barely in the place outside of sleeping, getting ready for the next function and brief hangs. Overall good..with a few needed suggestions.
Great space in a quiet neighborhood close to the red line

Super nice and exactly like the pictures. Easy walk to the trains and the fridge was pretty big so all 3 of us were able to comfortably store and reheat left overs. Would stay again for my next Chicago trip!

My family and I really enjoyed our stay.  The beds we’re comfortable and clean!  The couch was great to sleep on!  Its location was great for hopping on The L and traveling around the city.  My rural family felt very safe and comfortable during our stay.  We would definitely stay here again!
It was pretty great, they even upgraded us which was amazing, I loved the BnB, it had everything.
Beautiful home and very helpful host! Would stay here again

Elba’s fabulous house far exceeded our expectations.  It was beautifully decorated and wonderfully appointed, spotlessly, shining clean.  The house has high ceilings, which makes it feel so spacious.  No need to look any further.  Book it if you can.  We would go back there in a heartbeat.
Would stay again - Close to the Brown Line EL train and clean place, peaceful and great value

Here’s a polished review you can post:
We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The apartment is brand new, beautifully maintained, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. The location was excellent—close to everything we wanted to do in Chicago while still being in a quiet area. Parking was also very easy, which made our trip even more convenient.
Overall, it was a fantastic experience from start to finish. We would definitely stay here again and 100% recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

My friends and I had the best time celebrating our bachelor and bachelorette party at this wonderful home! It fit 8 people comfortably and Adam the host was amazing at communicating our needs and his expectations! We couldn’t have asked for a better spot! Thank you for having us!
The place was clean and convenient. We had a pleasant stay. For short stays, this is a recommended place.

The property is a bus and train ride away from the downtown tourist attractions or a $25 Uber. Plenty of great restaurants in the area. The property itself is very bare bones which I found surprising considering the price. The furniture was uncomfortable and not well cared for and the walls could use a coat of fresh paint. The property felt like a college dorm and not an apartment at the price point listed. James was very responsive.

this bnb is just like the pictures, place was clean and the host was responsive. area is walkable and near public transit.
but read carefully, we thought it was 2 queen beds but did not see that one is an air mattress. that’s our bad for not reading clearly but because of this, it felt like we definitely overpaid for not having a proper bed. also when we woke up saturday morning, there was heavy rain and it leaked (from the window?) onto the counter and it soaked my phone that was charging. 😭 not the owners fault but definitely a building flaw.
Great stay. Very easy to get around Chicago from the location. Nice and clean apartment.
Great stay! Great location.

Great option for a Chicago trip.
I was there for a week and loved the location, our host made the stay pleasurable, very attentive. Everything was clean and tidy, and we were asked several times if we needed anything, so very confortable. Kitchen was useful, found everything we needed to make quick breakfasts or dinners. Room had very confortable beds and since we were 5, we had an inflable mattress that was covered in new sheets and blankets.
One thing that I'd appreciate is receiving the check-in instructions at least 48hrs prior to the trip, because we were traveling when the host sent me the text that said that we should notify for a check in later than 10pm. Since our flights were delayed, we got there and the room wasn't ready for us, however, the host quickly responded and solved everything with her personal and us,

This place was amazing! From the quiet neighborhood to local coffee shops, it was definitely worth the price point. Many local city bikes and parks nearby! Just lacking in night life as someone new to the area. Cate was very responsive, and was very communicative. Overall good stay.
Fantastic stay.  Very comfortable and spacious.  Highly recommend.

We stayed here to go to Rate Field, Wrigley Field and explore the city. Rate field is walking distance but I probably wouldn’t do the walk at night. There is a grocery store within walking distance called Jewelosco which was convenient. Also a few fast food places like wingstop, Popeyes and McDonalds. We ubered anywhere we went which took like 15-20 minutes to get to the tourist spots like Navy Pier, the bean, Riverwalk, etc. This Airbnb worked well for us, and was reasonably priced. It resembled the listing exactly as pictured. Also, we experienced the footsteps of the neighbors above, but that’s the thing with shared walls.
Stunning Airbnb! Very communicative host. We felt right at home! We had everything we needed and more. Thank you so much!
We had a great time at Shivani and Riya’s place! The accommodations were great and the neighborhood was amazing.
Nice place in a pretty quiet neighborhood. Game room was awesome and everything was nice and clean.
Good place to stay for exploring Chicago with a larger group of people/family. Russell is very helpful and responsive. Recommended!

Rashad's place looks exactly like the pictures. It is clean, modern and we had plenty of room for a group of 6.  It is close to both the 3 and 4 buses (less than a 10 min walk), but the ride to downtown was about 30-40 minutes, so factor that in to your travels. The house is on a quiet street and there is a coffee shop nearby; it's a 5 min walk. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend it if you want a quiet place to rest and the conveniece of public transportation, but it is far away from the action.
A really cool place in a really cool location!

We enjoyed our stay at Roscoe! We chose this spot because of its location. It’s walkable to Wrigley, so if you’re in town for the game, this is the spot! It is also in walking distance to the train and restaurants. The train is louder than anticipated due to its proximity but we were well aware of a train nearby when booking. My family was very happy with the cleanliness of the house, too. Would highly recommend, especially if you’re in town for a Cubs game!

Good place to stay. Walk 5 min you’re at the train station. Bed very big and comfy, just like the picture. Very easy to check-in, clear instructions.
Had to share bathroom with other guests, there’s only one bathroom in the entire apt, so you have to walk downstairs to use it. Relatively close to the metro tracks, so you can hear and feel when the train pass by.
Great place.  Right in the heart of Chicago!!  Very nice place.   Parking is an adventure but that's the case with any place downtown Chicago.  Overall A+
The place was perfect for a weekend of baseball.  Everything worked out great.  Thank you!

We had a wonderful stay, the home is beautiful and located in a quiet neighborhood just outside the city. A great place to unwind after a day exploring down town. Host was very communicative and easy to get in touch with.
Excellent! We enjoyed a long weekend here and enjoyed the cleanliness of the place, proximity to shopping and restaurants, and the host was always responsive. Would definitely stay here again! A+

First, Aisha is an excellent communicator. Second, she’s an excellent problem solver. When we arrived we found that the pullout sofa had two broken slats. When we told her of about this she saw to it that two air mattresses - the kind that are really easy to inflate - showed up in a timely manner. As for the cost, the weekend we booked happened to be Lalapalooza in Chicago. So every place was more costly than usual. It happened that we needed a space for four for our granddaughter’s birthday party.
We all found the place comfortable and clean and just right.

The location of this apartment is great. The area is very walkable and neighbors are friendly. If you’re looking for a place to stay that is close to downtown without having to stay directly in the city, I’d recommend.
However, the apartment interior is older than I anticipated, and there is a smell that those with sensitive noses will not be able to ignore. Additionally, there is no central AC which can cause sensitivities for those who have asthma. If either of these issues apply to you in any way, I would not recommend this location because you’ll most likely leave with respiratory symptoms like I did.

Aminah's place was comfortable and well appointed in a busy and safe neighborhood. Easy walk to local eateries, convenience and groceries. Public transportation is available right outside your door.  Very responsive with clear instructions and suggestions. Easy check in. Highly recommended.
Great location and easy check-in process - recommend!
Great view, comfortable place, perfect locale for a weekend eating at fulton market! 10/10 would rent againt
The perfect place for a group of girls celebrating a bachelorette party! Great communication, very friendly hosts.
Great stay definitely will book again

the place itself was very nice and very well kept! the only small problem we had was a struggle with parking sometimes, and majority of the time the parking was to pay unless you wanted to walk a bit for free parking. But overall the airbnb itself was a great stay!

Great location and rental, super walkable neighborhood with nice access to buses and the train.
clean apartment, looks like the photos
Fabulous stay with Denisha, very close to where we were visiting while in the city and met our needs perfectly

We had a great stay! The only issue was with the washer—the door kept popping open during the wash cycle and we had to hold it closed to finish. Other than that, everything was great. Clean, walkable to the train station, and close to great breakfast spots!
Great host and good value.

Great visit to Chicago. The home was outstanding. We had 3 adults and 5 kids on our trip. The how was great. Lots of space, 3 levels, well stocked! Matricia was an outstanding host. We will definitely stay at her place when we visit Chicago again! Thanks Matricia!!!

This home was so cozy and inviting! It was a short drive from the airport (15-20 minutes) but a bit farther than expected to downtown (20-30 minutes). Jasmine and James were very understanding about checking in earlier than expected, and were very responsive throughout our stay. As a group of only girls, we were worried about safety since we would be out late at night, however we thankfully didn’t have any problems and felt safe! This home is perfect for a larger group or even a group that would like more space (there were four of us in total and we appreciate having our own beds but sharing the shower was the only tough part)! We also ended up renting a car and there was plenty of free street parking which is rare in Chicago.
Thank you again!!
safe, and easy to get around. The place was very clean, and the host was responsive and helpful with providing early check in. We'd definitely recommend it and would stay here again.
It was the perfect place for our short stay to watch the Cubs!

The property is clean and centrally located. The host was very responsive when I had access issues. The temperature inside was pleasant with climate control. I'd recommend reading through the instructions as the property is not street facing. There's no dish washer so wash dishes manually. We like our overall experience.
Location is everything and this place is perfect! You can get from the front door to your seats at Wrigley in 10 Minutes!
Lots of cool stuff provided by the hotel. Morning yoga on the rooftop, happy hour, and a nice coffee bar in the lobby. Easy train ride from the airport and walking distance to tons of attractions.
Great location, close to everything, walkable. Obviously noisy as its in the heart of downtown as could be expected. Very nice place.
Only wish was a television in the master bedroom.  Home was beautiful. Great layout. Nice beds and kitchen was stocked nicely.  We really enjoyed it!

Place was exactly as advertised. Location was perfect for our weekend activities and very convenient. Parth was highly responsive to all of my questions. Check-in / Check-out instructions were also very clear and helpful.

Perfect home base for Lollapalooza. The hotel had lots of themed extras. I saw other reviews with issues regarding the resort fee.
Given that there were things like rooftop yoga, smoothies, coffee or cookies and all complimentary, I’d rather pay a fee and get more than a bottle of water like other hotels. Well worth it!
Great location for a Cubs game and hopping around to different spots. You could hear the roar from the crowd!

Cannot understate how great the location is. Andersonville is incredible, and Alma's unit places you right where you want to be. Very spacious. There's an entryway, living room, first bedroom with bathroom, then after the living room a working desk, a second bathroom, a second bedroom, then the dining room, and the kitchen.
Great spacious place!
Great location and great communication!

Nice apartment, recently renovated and very clean. Good stay and easy access to train. A few very minor aspects of the apartment were not in peak condition - crumbling plaster around windows, wall AC units seemed to not work (but portable AC units kept it cool), and the screw holding the door hinge of the bathroom fell out. Other reviews noted issues with the elevator, but we had no problems and it worked fine. All of this being said, it was a nice place to stay and had everything we needed, but I would not say it is worth the price.
One additional thing to note: When booking I was confused by the verification required, which the hosts said was necessary to verify the booking. When I had Airbnb support reach out, the hosts said it was optional. The process required face scans and ID verification.
Great host, clean place and was very responsive!

Adored this place! The space was clean and neat, had more space than expected which was perfect for me and my friends. Host was an excellent communicator and provided us with plenty of information of what to do making the check in and out process very easy. Really near public transit making it easy to access downtown Chicago. Overall a wonderful stay!

Stayed here for Lollapalooza and it was perfect! Super walkable with easy access to many food options and very close to the blue line!! Apartment is so cute and bed was comfy. Also very private and in a safe area. Saw lots of families and kids walking around all weekend.

Adeoye’s place was great - super walkable to the train and exactly as pictured. Plenty of room for all of us and the beds were super comfortable. I’d highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a quiet and comfortable place in Chicago.
We really enjoyed our stay here! Nice place!

We stayed at Edwin's when we were visiting Chicago to help move our youngest into a new apartment. We only needed a place to shower and sleep as our days were busy and Edwin's place was perfect for what we needed. It looked exactly as the pictures described and Edwin was fantastic with communication and always responded to messages quickly. We were able to park behind the building which was a huge plus. Overnight parking at hotels can really add up so this was a huge bonus. As mentioned in the description, Edwin's place is right next to the L so you do get the noise from the trains running frequently but that did not bother us at all. If you are a light sleeper, take this into consideration. He provides ear plugs if you need them, you do get used to the sound, and we both slept soundly each night. I would recommend Edwin's airbnb to anyone looking for a small, reasonable place to stay in Chicago!
Jessica

The apartment was clean and very welcoming. Me and my friends stayed for Lollapalooza and it was the perfect place to stay since it was close to the city and also a quiet place to relax. Cheryl was very responsive and nice before and during our stay.
Great spot with great access! Comfortable for 5 adults and perfect for a long weekend

Steve's place was great place for our short weekend group trip to a Cubs game at Wrigley. Easy walk to the stadium and surrounding shops and restaurants. Steve was also very responsive and accommodating to our needs.
Amazing space! Great location and clean. Would 100% recommend!

We were pleasantly surprised with all the little notes around the house with instructions. The fridge with yogurts, string cheese, seltzers, fruits, English muffins, butter, cereals, milk, coffee and tea. It was lovely to see after getting in from a long flight with little ones.

Beautiful unit and great, safe location. As two couples this space was perfect— one of us stayed in one of the upstairs bedrooms (two rooms up there) and the other stayed downstairs on the “pullout couch” that felt just as comfortable as a bed (I would never have known the difference), giving us both access to our own bathrooms and some privacy.
Great stay- Michael accommodated us checking in a little early to drop off bags, and the place was great! Really nice quiet street. Thanks for a great stay

We had a wonderful stay. We were 7 people on this trip and this apartment was the perfect size. The apartment was walking distance to a very lively park and Mexican art museum which I would highly recommend to take advantage of. The location was also very close to downtown, Chinatown, little village, cermak, etc. I really appreciated goatstays customer service and helpfulness as well. The one time we had to reach out at the beginning of our stay they responded very quickly and got us the assistance we needed. My family and I would love to stay and one of their locations again.

The building and its amenities are beautiful.  Our family loved the pool and game room.  The unit is less than a 10 minute walk from the red line which made navigating the city very manageable.  Parking is expensive and not conveniently located.  Having only one key and elevator fob was a big inconvenience for our family of 5.
Very impressed with this spot, great location in walking distance to great bars and restaurants as well! The communicate with the host was on point as well.

Overall was a nice/fine stay. Hosts were friendly and communicative, helpful with area tips and recommendations. Apartment was comfortable and cozy, as described, with nicely updated amenities and finishes within. The building exists within a less desirable neighborhood with a fair but doable walk through it to the nearest L stations. Flexibility of early check-in/late check out isn’t an option but would’ve been nice as baggage storage options are limited nearby and questionably reputable. Those aspects and the travel time and cost for transport to and from really limits the value of the stay to “fair,” IMO.
Had a great stay!

Wonderful location to stay in Chicago! The home is a little older and has its quirks, but provides all the amenities you need during your stay. It is a great value for the location! Elizabeth was very responsive and we felt right at home during our 2 week stay this summer in Chicago. Would definitely book her location again.
A great spot for a weekend stay— clear instructions and fast responses to questions helped it feel like home. Beautiful neighborhood and unit!!
Very nice accommodations and great location. Easy check in. Quiet.
Great stay for a short trip - modern appliances and clean space
Great location. Nice, modern space. Easily walkable to the Zoo, the Lake, Lincoln Park and great restaurants. Would stay there again
Really enjoyed our stay, location was walkable and so many things to do within  a few blocks. The flat was pristine, loved the decor and hospitable touches.

Great stay in a clean, conveniently located place, with stores and restaurants and the beach close by. The hosts were great and answered questions with quick response times and checked in to make sure all was okay. I would definitely recommend this property.
Very nice area and little place for the week!
Perfect for a stay for Lolla! Everything organized, cleaned and the description was accurate. I personally appreciated the parking pass, suitcase holder and fan in the room!
Vickie was a great host and very communicative. The check-in was seamless and the place was very clean and organized. Overall an amazing stay!

I was surprised there weren't white noise machines or fans to help drown out the inevitable city noise - bring your own if you need that! The listing said the unit would fit 8 people if you use the sofa bed and the blow up air mattress (which doesn't hold air the whole night). However, there was only 1 extra set of bedding and 1 extra pillow. We did ask for more to be sent to the room. I had to follow up a few times, but they did eventually get delivered. Also only 3 bath towels were initially provided for our party of 7. I didn't want to take my shoes off in the unit. The floors in the unit were sticky and the rugs were severely stained. Everything felt damp - especially the hallways. The bed seemed to be breaking - and the couch arm also seemed to be falling off. These units seem to be managed from a distance and some regular visiting of the units would be helpful - or a freshen up of rugs and furniture.
Kimberlie was so kind and very helpful and her place was just as described!

We stayed for 2 nights and it was super great! Check in was smooth, and the studio looked just like the pictures. Everything was pretty clean and comfy! Kim was responsive to any and all questions and very helpful. Would 100% stay again!!

We had a fantastic stay at Lisa’s apartment in Chicago! The place was clean, comfortable, beautifully equipped, and immediately felt like a home away from home—it was also absolutely perfect for us as a family with two children. Lisa is an extraordinary host—warm, incredibly attentive, and always quick to respond. Communication was effortless from start to finish. We couldn't have asked for a better experience and would love to stay here again on our next trip. Highly recommended!
Great place to stay! Location is perfect and Steve is a great host.

Stephanie's place was lovely and exactly as described. There were no issues for our stay.
We loved the location as it was within walking distance to many attractions. Also accessible to public transportation when needed.
It was nice to relax by the pool after a long day spent out on the town!

Anthony and Paul’s listing was amazing! It was in a quiet part of the neighborhood and walkable to all trains and buses. They were both extremely friendly and made us feel right at home while traveling. We highly recommend this spot.
It was a great place

This place was perfect! Matt was a wonderful host and had everything organized and communicated in advance. The unit was so clean and comfortable. No issues with anything at all. It’s in a great location with lots of things to do nearby. Would recommend and plan on staying again if we’re in the area!
great space! staff was friendly and helpful as well! clean and had plenty of things nearby+transit

This stay was 10 out of 10! Perfect experience with lots of nice touches and extras- like snacks and cold drinks when we arrived. I would definitely recommend this place and definitely would stay again. Nancy and Brien are so accommodating and friendly. Great time!

If you are looking for a place to stay near Wrigley Field, look no further. This location made our trip to see the Cubs so easy. A very short walk brings you right to the center of all the action. The place was very comfortable for our group of six. It was clean and cozy. The drinks in the fridge were a nice touch. Thanks, Peter, for a great stay!
Our stay was great. Great place, located in a good neighborhood and it has a nice workspace since I had to work a few days there. I would definitely stay there again.

Great apartment in a great location!
Family had a wonderful time for 3 nights at the apartment. The location is perfect for getting around the city by walking or the L train.
The apartment is very nice and has all the amenities you need for your stay.
Jay was very responsive during the entire rental process.
This was a fabulous place to stay.  Our hosts were fantastic and responsive to all our questions.  I instantly got feedback as soon as I would message.  10/10.

Brand new construction, very nice! The neighborhood itself was not my favorite, but the place is clean, comfortable and quiet. Ecem was a phenomenal host. Great communication and very accommodating. I recommend this spot to other travelers!
Great host and Airbnb! Responded quickly when o had any questions and was very nice.
Alex was a wonderful host. The place was clean and welcoming and beautiful
I enjoyed my stay.

Loved the location and having a parking spot - there are so many things to easily walk to including Wrigley.  Cathy’s place had everything I needed and I would definitely stay again.  If you or your traveling companions are sensitive to sound - you can hear the upstairs residents but it was mostly just walking.  She does put in her notes to contact her if it’s excessive but they were respectful with quiet hours.  My dad loved the little snack box!
Lovely space, close to the lake and train, with restaurants, coffee shops, grocery store within walking distance. Hosts were very responsive.

I liked this place a lot. Would stay here again. Was in Chicago for a week to work.
Great location close to restaurants in Fulton Market and Randolph St. Morgan station for CTA Green and Pink lines is right there. Walkable to the loop.
Has a vintage industrial vibe as can be seen from the photos.
Shower is on the narrow side. Couldn’t figure out how to get rid of the Supergirl screensaver on the tv.
Hosts were responsive and professional.
Sylvia’s place is just like the pictures: very clean, kitchen fully stocked, great location. She does an amazing job communicating with guests. Highly recommend.

This place was perfect for us. Beautiful, friendly, safe neighborhood..  Excellent cafes, restaurants, pharmacies and even a Whole Foods Market within walking distance.  The place itself was clean and well furnished and has numerous thoughtful items of convenience available.  Rob was immediately responsive and responsible. True five star Airbnb without exaggeration.
Such a beautiful family home to make our own family memories in!  So much space!!

Location is peaceful & house is quiet. Love st Michael church & bells. Only building - in that area- to survive 1871 fire. Easy walk to lake & Lincoln park. Old town is cool. Nice fireplace & balcony to hang out. Living area seats 6 comfortably.  Needs a microwave to heat restaurant leftovers. 5 out of five!
The room was much smaller than I expected and I think it’s not good value for money compared to other hotels. Staff are very nice and helpful.

OUTSTANDING! From booking to checkout was seamless.   The place is beautiful,  clean, so accommodating!  Great restaurants & taverns all around.   Wrigley Field within a stone throw.  So awesome!  Victor was so professional,  we had a few requests & questions & he responded within minutes.  We all highly recommend this stay....you won't be disappointed 😊

The apartment was very cozy. They provided all the essentials that you would need, from snacks to extra toilet paper and everything  in between. When we arrived it was pouring down rain ( they live in the house above the apartment) and  they asked us if we needed any help with bringing in our bags. Which I thought was very thoughtful since we had our dog with us as well. This apartment provided us  a great place to stay  while we visited Chicago 😀
Todo súper!
Great location for foodies!  Perfect description, super clean, helpful guides

Our family enjoyed our stay.  The place felt like home.  Very well supplied and the hosts were very welcoming and accommodating.  We are looking forward to our next visit to Chicago and staying at our home away from home.
This place is amazing. This guy thinks of every detail. It’s a very thoughtful space. The hot tub was amazing of course, but mainly because he has it set up basically perfectly.

We had a great stay! It’s always nerve-wracking when staying in a shared space but it was very peaceful and our space felt like our own. Mariel was so sweet and accommodating during our stay, and there were many thoughtful amenities provided to us. Overall a great experience :)

Loved this home for our stay in town for the weekend! Beautiful interior and all the amenities we needed for our stay, Johanna was very communicative with us to make sure we had all we needed and we couldn’t have asked for a better host. Thankyou so much!
Great location and easy for public trasnsportation and walkable area.

La ubicación excelente, el cuarto muy pequeño, con manchas en las cortinas y en la cama, la alfombra y un cojín olían mal, nunca fueron a hacer el aseo hasta que yo se los pedí, no me cambiaron sábanas ni recogían mi basura.
This was a great stay! We loved every bit of our time there! My fiance is considering staying here again with his friends because it’s such a cool spacious spot.

The apartment itself was clean, spacious, and exactly what we needed for our group of four. Unfortunately, Larissa made this one of the most uncomfortable Airbnb experiences we’ve had. We briefly had friends upstairs before realizing it violated her rules, apologized immediately, and never did it again. Despite that, she repeatedly confronted us with an aggressive attitude, raised her voice, pointed her finger at us, made false and exaggerated claims that we were gathering with 10–22 people and attracting gangs, and even said, “I guess I won’t leave you a bad review.” On checkout morning, she pounded on our door, entered without permission before checkout time, yelled over an accidentally unplugged AC unit, interrogated us, and rushed us out despite us being packed, the apartment being clean, and checkout still nearly 40 minutes away. Great apartment, but an unnecessarily hostile, invasive, and unprofessional host.
Amazing!
Great stay awesome location. Would stay again !!

Jim was a great host! He and his team kept in contact with me from the booking until we departed. The apartment unit was spacious, well kept, and comfortable for 5 adults and a toddler, and a short drive from popular areas.  We enjoyed our stay!

We had a very comfortable stay in Alicia's cute 2nd floor unit.  The bedrooms were great with comfy beds and a TV in each room.  The space was perfect for our needs.  And Alicia was very responsive and helpful!
Great spacious apartment. Loved neighborhood too. Close to public transport. Comfy bed and very responsive owner. Checkout was super simple too. Highly recommend

The studio was gorgeous! Everything was clean. The rooftop was an amazing addition to the space, and definitely added to the review. The building was a bit hard to find and get into on the first try, but the security was amazing and helped us. Loved the gym, and the Oop up coffee in the morning from a local coffee shop. The price was a little steep for a studio in my opinion.
I love the area. It was for Lollapalooza event so it wasn’t too far from the bus or getting on a train. The Uber price to the house wasn’t bad at all. The rules were understandable too.

Nat was a great host, offering to answer questions about the area and things to do. We had a question about the accomodations and Nat replied within minutes. The space was clean and cozy. I would stay here again. Easy and clear arrival and departure instructions.
Great clean place! Super big and cute
Spacious comfortable place. Easy to get in and out. Good location between west loop and downtown. Well maintained. And modern looking furniture. We liked it.
Met my expectations and had good amenities
Bon moment chez Amnata et proche des transports
Sena reached out and made things very easy.  Booked for my son for his internship and felt like he would be looked after.  He had a great experience there.
Patt was a great host! Very respectful of our space, while also being there for anything we might need. The house was tidy and clean. Check in was straightforward and easy. Would stay again!
Very confortable place to stay in a peaceful neighborhood. Erica was a great host, she was very welcoming and always responsive.
Decent spot near McCormick place.

Learned that I could book this hotel room through AirBnB which worked well as it was Lallapalooza weekend in Chicago. Also, since this is a Hilton property, I was delighted that I received loyalty points for the stay.
Great place to stay, very friendly host. Excellent amenities.
Excellent stay. Super clean and flexible check in!

Thanks Pat for letting us stay in your beautiful and confortable  apartment.  I recommend this place to anyone looking for a peaceful North Side neighborhood. The space is very comfortable and very clean. Walking distance to Trader Joe’s and the Brown line Station that takes you to the Loop. The full kitchen was weary much appreciated, we fixed all our breakfast and a couple of meals. We are planning to return on our next visit to Chicago. Thanks a million.

It was great staying at the place
Andy was a great host

Amazing apartment, beautiful views, comfortable beds and quality furniture. The building is really great, there is a co work space, a gym, a hot tub and swimming pool on the roof with a number of BBQ’s.
I was a little frustrated that there was no parking available, but the public parking lot is close enough.
The only down side to this place is the location, there is very little in the immediate surroundings, so you have to travel out all the time.
But overall great stay!
Great place, great price, and great location. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone and would definitely stay here again!
The apartment was immaculate, spacious and modern. We loved it!  Was perfect for our group of 5 with room to spare. Rob was very responsive. Wish we could have stayed longer! Would definitely return.

El Airbnb es tal como lo describen: espacioso, limpio y cerca del transporte público. La comunicación con el anfitrión fue buena y siempre respondió con rapidez.
Lo único que considero es que quizás no sea la mejor opción para familias con niños pequeños. El apartamento está en un tercer piso y el piso de madera transmite mucho el ruido, por lo que cada paso se escucha en el apartamento de abajo. Si viajan con niños que corren o juegan mucho, esto podría ser un inconveniente.

Our stay was far worth the value it was set for. This was a very affordable find in the city and was flexible on the payment. The description of the space gave ample explanation as to what is included. The accommodations were located in a safe and gorgeous area that is walkable and located near to major transit lines. There’s lots of places to eat in the area and plenty of places to acquire any goods that may be needed during the stay. Upon arrival the accommodations were secure and there were clear instructions on how to enter. Inside you will find the space to include just about everything needed for a livable and functional stay. The space was very clean and all towels, blankets, and otherwise were found pristine and free of stains/odors. During my time there the host was very friendly, responsive, and accommodating. While the space may not be luxurious or feel like home it more than served its purpose and I would highly recommend staying there. Would love to come back & stay again.
Very pleasant house and kind host! Highly recommended
Would definitely stay again. Great location, very clean - exceeded our expectations.

This was a garden unit. Overall, a convenient, comfortable location close to bustling West Town activities. Bella and Ben were very responsive, which we appreciate. It's just a pity that the wi-fi at the place wasn't working and it seems like there's been difficulty having it fixed. Otherwise, a highly recommended stay!
Greta place, along with a great host would stay again.
Had a great stay!

Host: 1/5
While I have provided direct feedback to Pamela, her hosting ability is poor. Guests have to reach out to her multiple times in order for something to be addressed or in my case escalate to Airbnb Support. Note: please use Airbnb support team if needed (they are amazing!)
Property/studio space: 2/5
The property screams better care. The pictures posted are years old and the condition of the stay is not accurately reflected. Dirty walls, missing concrete step, cheap flooring, overgrown lawn, and painfully cold in the basement. Plus, the fruit flies and bugs - ugh.
Location: 3/5
Neighborhood is alright. Use your discretion. If you want to experience more of Chicago, you’ll find it cumbersome driving (as it is not close to the city).
Overall: 2/5
My wish for Pamela is to be more diligent. Take care of your guest and your guest will care for you. Seems to me, Pamela is more interested in making money rather than providing her guests the best experience in Chicago.

Oh my goodness. This home is awesome.  The ambience was fantastic. The fire house theme and history made the house unique with so much detail of the fire fighter community. The home is pristine. The beds are very comfortable. The kitchen has all you could need and more. The area is fun and the neighbors are kind. Thank you for a great stay.
We enjoyed our stay! Neighborhood felt safe and quiet. Wonderful spacious bedrooms. Host communications were speedy and informative which made everything easier. Highly recommend to stay here!

We had a wonderful stay! It truly felt like a home away from home. The beds were very comfortable, the bathroom was spotless and the place was clean and well cared for. The location was perfect, right in the heart of everything, making it easy to walk to restaurants, attractions and shops. It was incredibly convenient and we’d definitely stay here again!

What a quaint place. The "Chitown" Chicago vibe the place has is Very Kool! Don't Change it! The place was absolutely spotless! and in a nice neighborhood. Very quiet at all times! The parking was excellent & exactly what the host said it would be. There's a Mexican restaurant 2 doors down from the place and it's open 24 hours so if ya get in late NO WORRIES ABOUT A QUICK BITE!! All the food spots around the place were absolutely indescribable all minutes away & all were good eats! I would definitely recommend staying here! The location into the city is perfect. If I'm ever back to Chitown I'll hopefully stay with these wonderful hosts if the place is available! Chicago is a great town and it's definitely worth staying here. I can't thank our host enough for allowing me, my son and best friend to stay at his property. Thank you Chicago for showing a NYker & Los Angelenos a great 1st time experience of your great City! Come to NY anytime and we'll reciprocate the hospitality!

Would definitely stay here again!
Apartment is very nice. The bedrooms are big with comfortable beds and lots of pillows. Great for the 5 of us. The living room is not very big, however we spent most the time out of the apartment. We enjoyed the living conditions and the outside sitting area. Some outside noise due to being by the street. Nothing big. Great location!

There’s a Whole Foods (supermarket), Target, Subway Red Line, plenty of food options and Wrigley Field all within a short walk.

Parking can be difficult if you do not plan ahead. We used SpotHero and reserved a spot for 4 days for only $76 total. It was a 15 min walk and was the only location nearby that would accept a large vehicle. There are closer lots, which can be figured out in the app. There are permits inside that allow you to park in certain spots, which still require a fee. Best option is SpotHero.
We were very pleased with our selection and greatly enjoyed our stay.
Thank You!

We stayed at Stephanie's for a week for a family reunion and, of course, sightseeing in Chicago, which is beautiful in the summer. First off: the views are AMAZING. The exterior walls are practically all glass, which was so cool. Short walks to the L, breakfast at Yolk, and access to Target were only some of the highlights. The apartment was very clean and the building has a TON of amenities. We really enjoyed our stay!

Couldn’t ask for a better host!
Location was perfect and around 2.5 blocks from Wrigley Field and EVERYTHING that comes with it…train was near by and easy to navigate.
Mary recommend many great places and were spot on. Would most def stay here again when I’m back in Chicago!
Enjoyed our visit. Very close to CTA.
Great location! Easy walk to just about everything. Included parking spot was a huge plus!
The location was great for us. We could still get to the city easily and enjoyed the area around the air bnb. It was perfect for us. I loved the yard, beautifully maintained.
Aiste was great and was always helpful. Accommodations were perfect for what we needed. Short bus ride to the west loop and the bean.

Overall: This is a really great place to stay in Chicago. It's a great location, phenomenal view, and really great hosts that was really affordable for the location and amenities. Would book again in a heartbeat.
Location: It's a 5 min walk from a red line stop that'll get you to Wrigley, and <10min walk to the loop which will get you anywhere. I went on morning runs around Millenium parked and walked nearly everywhere while I stayed. Also the entry on a side road makes for easy pickup by rideshares. Nearby target to get groceries if staying longer.
Security: Very safe building, always someone at the front desk and need a fob to access the elevator bay and to use the elevator.
Amenities: On the 8th floor there's a great gym and pool, and really nice outdoor deck to sit and watch the boats go by on the river. There were also building events like movies, food trucks, that made it a great spot for the summer. In building parking is worth the money, so convenient.
We loved our stay. The house was comfortable, clean and nice and cool for us San Franciscans. We will be back! 🤍

This place was fantastic in terms of getting to where we needed to go with public transit or driving. This place also was very private and quaint in a nice neighborhood.
Cons: we stayed in late July when it was around 75 to 85° and it was very hot in the apartment with just the one window unit by the front door. It was very hot to sleep, and the fans weren’t the best to keep.
Unfortunately we had to email the host about the lack of toiletries and dirty towels left behind. Also had to wash our own towels. It was unfortunate that there wasn’t enough towels stocked for a four day visit with a family of three.
N/a
Ron is super sweet and responsive!
Clean accessible location for our family to visit Chicago.  Surrounded by incredible shopping and a convenient parking garage just steps away.

Was in town for a convention near O’Hare. This was a convenient and fairly priced place that gave quick access to that region while also not being terribly far from the main downtown attractions. Would stay there again in similar circumstances!

I had a great trip to Chicago, but unfortunately I can’t recommend this Airbnb. After my first night, I developed numerous extremely itchy bites around my ankles that continued throughout my stay. I documented them with photos and am still healing. Management said an inspection found no pests, which I acknowledge, but that doesn’t change my experience. My request for a partial refund was declined by management.
For the high price, I expected much more attention to detail and a warmer welcome. There was nothing upon arrival that made the stay feel particularly welcoming or special, and honestly, I’ve received more hospitality from hotels at this price point (I paid over 2k for the stay, fyi). The mattress under the protector was old and stained, and the checkout chores were disappointing considering the cost. While professionally managed as disclosed, the experience felt transactional and lacking hospitality. Chicago was wonderful, but I would stay elsewhere next time.
Enjoyed my stay!

We stayed here for Lollapalooza and it was the perfect place to get ready and get rest! Super cozy and idyllic, everything was clean and Alma was a great host and make sure we had all of the instructions and check-in details ahead of time. We will definitely like to come back next time we stay in Chicago-land for a weekend!
This was the perfect stay! The space was great and Jorge was very helpful,

SOLO female traveler: had a great stay here!
- Tonya was accommodating to my early arrival and let me check in early
- Felt at home and at peace with the Airbnb
- Check in / out was easy
- The location wasn’t bad at all, close to the buses to head to downtown chicago
Great host!

The room, itself, was neat and uncluttered. It offered the essential amenities needed (closer, bureau, desk, chair, and bed). There were 2 bathrooms, which helped with traffic. The main areas were also neat. The housemates were all respectful and kept to themselves. No noises after hours. It was pretty comfortable. My only complaints were that the shower was grimy and the bathrooms could use more consistent cleaning. It appears some tenants live there longer-term, so the cleaning schedules are few/far between. I purchased flip flops to feel comfortable using the shower. Depending on where on the cleaning cycle you come to stay, maybe you’d find the facilities cleaner. I also feel the neighborhood is just at the border of feeling safe. It was fine for 2 nights,  but not sure I’d choose to stay here again. Close to public transportation and local restaurants/shops (10 min bike ride).
Perfect location for access to the trains as well as Lake Shore Drive. Made getting around the city easy! Also loved being so close to Wrigley!
Great location to hyde park, easy commute to bus and red line. Great value for long term stay!

My brother and I stayed here on a trip to go to Rate Field and Wrigley Field. This was a great spot to get to both pretty easily, especially Wrigley. The host was also kind enough to offer some advice on traveling to stadiums which was much appreciated.
The apartment was clean and easy to let ourselves into; and any questions I had, the host was super responsive. The neighborhood has lots of restaurant options and is very walkable. It is also a quick ride to downtown.
I would absolutely stay here again and recommend!

Enrique was absolutely amazing! Hands down the best host we’ve ever had. The place was clean and had absolutely everything we needed for our stay. He was kind and gave us instructions on how to navigate the train system, as well as recommendations on food places nearby. 10/10.

The stay here at Sezgin's place was great - all was just as described and it was clean, well-put together, and spacey. Extra towels and washcloths were easily available to guests. The neighborhood is really cute as well and not far off from the Blue line. Would recommend
Exactly as described! Very clean, cozy, and a great location! Would definitely stay again.

Our family of five had such a wonderful time staying here. The home had room for everyone to have their own quiet space when needed and then a nice spot to binge movies together in the evenings while enjoying pizza. Neighborhood was quiet and peaceful. We highly recommend and would stay again if we make it back to Chicago. 🩷

Unit was just as portrayed in the description. Clean, comfortable with a spacious living area and kitchen…a very relaxing space. In a great location - peaceful residential area close to restaurants, shops and the train. There was a little noise from the upstairs unit, but not bad. Would definitely stay here again.

Very nice place, clean and had private bathroom attached to room. 3 different codes to enter to ensure safety aswell as cameras outside. Hosts were very nice and helpful when needed! Neighborhood was nice, surrounding areas were a bit sketchy but nothing bad at all and always felt safe! Would definitely recommend if you’re staying in chicago for a few days.
Nice place!
Great host and place!!

Jose is super responsive and helpful . Location is super close to the orange line for commuting into the city for any internships or work . The only issue I had was with the WiFi being inaccessible and very slow .

Jeanette was a great host and her place was a really nice place to stay! Enjoyed coming back to it after a long day out in Chicago! Jeanette was always quick to respond and made us feel at home. Definitely recommend!

This was our family vacation with our adult children and little grandson. It was the perfect spot! The playground across the street was perfect for the almost 2 yr old! Our first day we walked to Lincoln Park Zoo in about 15 minutes. We did dinner at Twin Anchors, which is just a few doors down. Great food!! There is a French bakery a few blocks away that was a fun breakfast spot.
The house had plenty of room for 6 adults to sleep. We cooked dinners a few times and found all the pots/pans/utensils needed in the fully stocked kitchen. For the coffee drinkers there are multiple ways to get your coffee…pot, Keurig, drip…
Two notes…1). Parking permits needed are inside the house. We never had trouble finding parking within just a few spots of the house. 2) When you unlock the door from the lockbox key, put it right back! We made the mistake of leaving it on the counter as we brought bags in…then we accidentally shut the door behind us and it locked, so we were locked out for an hour.

The home was fantastic and felt like home while we’re in Chicago. The host was very responsive and went above and beyond to take care of us while we were here. Walking to the sub was a breeze and allowed us to access the entire city. Would 100% stay here again!
The gym was nice surprise. Great location!
Muy cómodo, estuvimos muy agusto, la ubicación estuvo perfecta para las actividades que teníamos.

Dana's place is lovely and exactly as she describes it. It is so clean and the bathroom and kitchen are new and lovely!!!  It is spacious and perfect for two people. We easily found parking and it was a quick walk to get to the nearest CTA station.
Tammy and her home are wonderful! They have a beautiful garden and location. Walkable to the red line plus steps from Lake Michigan, I would definitely stay here again.

Bed was comfy. It is a compact older space. Had a funny smell and at one point the Marijuana smell was so strong it was like it was in the room with us. Decent experience overall but probably wouldn’t return. Especially at the price point.

Entering the courtyard, was beautiful and quiet, it did not feel like you were in the middle of a city.  The inside of the apartment was very unique, we loved the lead pane glass window.  The location cannot be beat. Very walkable.  Hosts were very responsive.

Absolutely beautiful home. .
Nicely decorated .
Bed was very comfortable and enjoyed the jetted tub/shower.
Close to the ballpark which was important to us when booking with air b n b.
Met Tim’s spouse, Barbara, who was extremely friendly and seemed very sweet as opposed to Tim who presented very “ business-like”.
Only con is that we don’t eat cereal as it was offered to us for breakfast along with sugar added yogurt. Easy enough to buy our own bagels and cream cheese and plain Greek yogurt.
Would not hesitate to stay again at this gorgeous home surrounded by beautiful plants and flowers.

Ewa was one of the kindest, sweetest and hospitable hosts that I have ever met. I love how her place is so unique and has a lot of art surrounding it. It’s also close to the blue line and is a five minute walk to the ‘Devision’ CTA. I would consider coming back.
Vince was a fantastic host. Easy check-in, great communication, and the property was spotless. Highly recommended to other guests traveling to Chicago.

I travel 1-2 times a month for work so I am often in hotel rooms and Airbnbs for a week at a time and this place is truly the only place that has felt like my home (and honestly better!). You can feel Gogo's love for hosting throughout the place because he wants his guests to feel at home. Everything is intentional and well curated from the decor to the snacks, drinks, board games, coffee station and emergency toiletries. It's also very easy to get around Chicago, there's amazing museums and restaurants nearby, and the neighborhood is very beautiful. This is my second stay with Gogo and I will definitely book again!

An amazing unit in a great Wrigleyville location. Very walkable area just a block from the stadium and close to buses, the red line, and lots of bike rentals. I appreciated all of the little touches (coke zero in the fridge waiting for me!) and the unit is so beautifully and artistically furnished. Loved my stay here and would definitely stay again!

Jeannette’s place in Wicker Park was perfect for our group of three. She even greeted us when we arrived! The unit was very clean, quiet, and comfortable. And what a location! We felt safe walking everywhere in the neighborhood - there was a blue line stop, a grocery store, and plenty of bars, cafes, boutiques, and restaurants just a stroll away. Would easily recommend to anyone looking to stay in Wicker Park!

Kim’ place is very convenient- just a short drive from downtown, on a tree lined street! It was clean and comfortable- we were a party of 4! The bathroom is a little bit small and the train runs every few minutes and is quite loud but Kim provided ear plugs which was very helpful!
Kim was a very responsive and kind host!

가격이 저렴해서 걱정했지만 가격대비 정말 훌륭한 숙소였습니다

Decent location, convenient parking spot, easy entry into apartment. Actual interior was very nice and exactly as described. Host was super quick to respond and helped us a lot.

I loved Jose’s place. It was very clean and had a welcoming atmosphere. Everything needed was provided and I loved that it was located in a calmer neighborhood and so close to transportation. I would definitely book again if I find myself in Chicago!
great place very peaceful! room was on the smaller side but it’s perfect for 1-2 people!
This is a perfect place to stay!  Walkable distance to the train, plenty of local restaurants nearby, and overall a great location!

Sam was amazing !! It really was a home away from home. Its not particularly close to any L but a bus that’s super close can take you. It’s a very quiet neighborhood with great restaurants super close.
