Tawney’s place was the perfect spot for a Chicago stay! About 20-25 from most things downtown and only about 10min to Wrigley field if you’re in town to catch the cubs! The thing that surprised me most was how beautiful the neighborhood was; peaceful and quiet it gives you the full Chicago feel! Had a wonderful time and would definitely stay at Tawney’s home again!
Really comfortable place. Clean and tidy. Excellent communication from the host. Highly recommended!

This is like your best friend has lent you their apartment for the week. Not only everything you need (and more) but filled with art and books, and with a beautiful tropical garden. The location is amazing - near the L, fantastic places to eat, organic supermarket a couple of blocks away. And then there’s Chicago itself with such a diversity of things to do and see (Obama library, architectural boat tours, walking the 606, entrance to which is near the house. Guides to everything are in the kitchen). The whole experience felt like Airbnb used to be where you are welcomed into the home of interesting and interested people.
Geo was an amazing host and his unit was just as amazing! The entire unit was so nicely decorated and we were by so many great shops and restaurants. I highly recommend staying here

The host was extremely friendly and very communicative from the get go. Allowed us to check in early due to early flight. Really loved how close it was to the Pink Line allowing for easy travel. Would definitely stay here again. Thanks!

The place was perfect for a girls trip! It was very clean and having 3 bathrooms was great for us getting ready. The booking process was extensive and annoying, but the host, Ben was responsive. Overall, we enjoyed our stay!

This was a beautiful place for a long stay! Immediately close to multiple grocery stores and with a decent amount of natural light coming in from a wall of windows! Support was very responsive and helpful in addressing issues.

Had a great week at Kenneth's place! Clean and spacious home base for our family of 4 to explore Chicago (and our teenagers enjoyed having their own rooms). Very close to the L red line, which made getting Downtown easy - and the place is surrounded by great restaurants. Definitely recommend!
They are very responsive and very kind. I enjoyed my stay
Surrounding was quiet. Nice to stay :) thank you very much

Our Airbnb was perfect for a cozy stay for two. Hosting five people might be a bit crowded. The place was spotless, and they offer 24-hour service with a live operator, which is reassuring. I genuinely recommend this Airbnb—it’s fresh, clean, and beautifully maintained. There's a gym and a lounge to unwind in, but the apartment itself is really comfortable. Plus, it's located in a quiet neighborhood, making it even more peaceful.
BONUS: GARAGE PARKING
Great location and very responsive and check in and check out. Good set up for our multi generational group.
Khang was the best host I've ever had. He was responsive to all questions and made us feel right at home. If we're in Chicago again, we'll definitely be looking to stay here again!

Two major concerns:
1) major sewer gas smell at the bottom of stairs/entry and bathroom. The host has put plug in air fresher in bedroom, bathroom, and THREE in the living room. Unfortunately it still doesn’t completely mask the smell, and in fact, the chemical smell of the air fresheners made me nauseous the first night.
2) not very comfortable all around. The bed is a very cheap frame and mattress, and they only provide a fitted sheet and very thin comforter. I had to ask for more linens which I received for my second night. The couch is the most uncomfortable thing I’ve ever sat on (felt like I was gonna fall through it), and furniture all around is the cheapest IKEA stuff.
Location is great though. For a very cheap price, this would be worth it for a solo traveler for a night or two. Not comfortable for more than one person or a lengthy stay by any means.
This is a great place, with an amazing view!  Milan was very responsive and very helpful.  Security was right on point and extremely helpful.

Highly recommend. The location can’t be beat. Matthew was a great host, sent recommendations for local restaurants and timely responded to questions. The unit was spacious and as described. It had everything we needed to cook breakfast. Loved having access to washer and dryer. Parking was challenging but not unexpected (this is Chicago!). Would definitely stay again
Beautiful apartment and perfect location. There was a problem with the apartment we rented and Suite Home upgraded us to a nicer apartment. So responsive. Truly no problems at all. Would recommend.

This apartment was nice and very clean. Freshly painted, nicely decorated and beautiful wood floors. The neighborhood is walkable and quiet. There are neighborhood bars and takeout food options nearby. However, there is a late check in fee for after the 5pm set check in time. Overall, Tay was very responsive to the questions I had and made the stay very enjoyable!
Very responsive host, def would stay again.
Great location, friendly staff, and easy check in and out!
Amazing
Great place, great neighborhood, well appointed. Highly recommended!

Loved the Old Town neighborhood location!  We walked everywhere from the house including the beach.  Our minivan was tight, but it did fit into the parking spot with just a couple of inches on either side.  The house was great for our group’s two families.  Everything was clean, and the hosts were super responsive.  We had a beautiful week in the Windy City!
I had a great stay. The unit was extremely well-located and communication with the host was smooth.

Heather’s place was even prettier in person than in the photos. The neighborhood felt very family friendly and walkable. Logan Square was just the vibe we were hoping for during our week in Chicago. There were many thoughtful details throughout to help make sure we were comfy. It was a lovely home and excellently hospitality.
Place was clean, beds were comfy, room was cute!
Perfect location, great space and any questions were responded to quickly. Great experience!

Our stay worked out perfectly for a Cubs tour and game the next day!  Wrigleyville provides so many activities in the summer and this home is right in the heart of it.  Carlos, Laura and all were so quick to reply and having their offices right in the neighborhood reassured us that if we needed anything, they would be prompt in helping us.  Beds were comfy and kitchen was fully stocked.
Perfect location for your stay in Wrigleyville!

Very convenient location! Walkable to everywhere on the North end. Access to great restaurants so close by. Quiet on the inside. Was some walking and moving noise from people above us but with my earplugs it was peaceful. AC unit function great!
We were a group of 9, we found the space to be very comfortable and accommodating for our bunch. It had enough room for all of us. It was clean and easily accessible to trains/buses.
Cozy and wonderful stay! Highly recommend

Incredible location: 5 minute walk to the Brown Line, 5 minutes to a Trader Joe's, 15-20 minutes from Southport and Wrigley so it was always easy to get to work or fun. Great neighborhood to walk around - very quiet for how close it is to Wrigley, and never felt unsafe. Suburban homey feel in the heart of Chicago!
Amazing kitchen - we had four people staying for two months, and it never felt too crowded. Rooms were a good size, could have a bit more clothes storage for long term stays but not a huge issue.
Also the host is AWESOME - incredibly responsive (usually texts back in < 5 minutes) and attentive to anything we needed/wanted. The building had some quirks (shower can run over the tub, and be careful with the door knobs), but we were never bothered by anything because the host would respond immediately and get things taken care of.
Overall 20/10, worth the price for being in such an incredible, historic neighborhood! As someone who's spent years in Chicago, this is hard to beat.
Cannot go wrong staying at one of David’s properties. Each has a unique appeal & comfort
Matched the description exactly! Ewa provides everything you need and is very friendly and helpful! The neighborhood is also peaceful and inviting.
Cute little house that felt super safe with space outside and great restaurant recommendations from our host!

Flora was very (very) generous in allowing me to bring my pet turtle. Everything posted about the space was on point. The building was easy to find, accessible, and in walking distance to the CTA and restaurants. Linens were clean. Flora was responsive and easy to communicate with throughout my time in the space. The laundry room was usually open and others in the building were polite. The only challenge was sharing a bathroom with a neighbor who never cleaned up after themselves and at one point completely wrecked the bathroom and made no attempt to clean. Flora was responsive and sometimes the cleaning staff would address the mess. However, even after writing a letter to encourage the two of us to work together to keep the space clean, the letter was ignored and I had to clean up their waste on a daily basis to ensure it was clean before use.
Always a great place to stay. Convenient enough your daughter in River North. Comfortable place. Easy to cook a dinner - adequate supplies.

The Dream Rentals adhered and fully deserved its status as a Superhost being always online, even in the morning during week-end! The apartment we stayed had a very slow-paced and comfortable location within walking distance to central touristic areas and many supermarkets and cafeteria nearby.

Todo estuvo bien.
La almohada de mi habitación estaba desgastada pero Mike lo resolvió rápidamente.
Tuve mala suerte con otro huésped que no era limpio, dejaba trastes sucios o mal lavados y el baño lo dejaba sucio siempre

Angelica was very welcoming and responsive if we needed anything. The location was great with the blue line only a 10-15 minute walk and a very peaceful neighbourhood. I would highly recommend this place.
Good place, amazing host. Would definitely stay again if I ever get to visit Chicago again

Nice place, perfect for a couple of my friends and I to stay at for a couple days while attending a festival downtown. Close to public transportation so we didn't need to walk far. Only thing was the ceilings were pretty low.
Jasa was an amazing host! Very attentive & always responded in a timely manner to any questions we had! Place was beautiful, Definitely will be booking with her again when back in the Chi 🙏🏽
Clean home with constant cleaning and responsive host. Very close to many public transit options.

The host’s communication was very disappointing. During our 3-night stay, we reached out regarding towels—asking if they were provided daily and requesting more after the second night—but we never received a response or the towels before checking out. Apart from automated check-in and check-out messages, there was virtually no two-way communication.

A perfect stay!  The extras were really appreciated…body wash, hair dryer, make-up remover pads, disposable cups!  We were originally going to stay downtown.  We couldn’t find a place.  Popular time to come to Chicago apparently!  Anyways, during our visit, my husband said he was enjoying staying outside of downtown, quieter, more peaceful.  If we ever venture back, we would stay here again!
Muy buen servicio. Grandes anfitriones.
We had a great stay! Perfect location for our weekend in Chicago.
Place was fun and quirky. Hosts were nice and helpful.

The Airbnb was super cute! Clean, well stocked, and the host was very communicative. They even provided a welcome gift for us! When the coffee pot wasn’t working they replaced it right away. For folks looking to stay in this part of town, this is a great spot!

The home was as described. For a multi family place, we still had privacy. The location is the best!!!!
Joshua was most helpful when we had an a/c issue and promptly resolved it.
I highly recommend his home and would love to return.
If this place is available, feel lucky and get it, you won’t be disappointed.

I’m so grateful we chose to stay here! Our hosts showed some of the best hospitality we’ve ever experienced. Everything was spotless and thoughtfully prepared—from makeup remover, fresh towels, and bath bombs to a delicious breakfast provided every morning.
They truly went above and beyond to make us feel at home. They checked in on us, asked about our adventures around the city, and genuinely cared about making our trip special. Patrick even kindly let us use his transit card to get around town (which we happily reimbursed him for), and that small gesture made exploring Chicago so much easier.
This trip was especially meaningful because I was celebrating my 30th birthday, and they surprised me with chocolate and a candle to celebrate. It was such a thoughtful touch that made my birthday even more memorable.
The conversations with our hosts were warm, welcoming, and genuinely enjoyable. I would stay here again!
Super walkable, a few busy stops nearby to get you to Howard about a mile away. Hosts were very responsive and the neighborhood was quiet. Would definitely book again.
Great stay! Great location for exploring the city via the train. Very clean space with all of the comforts of home. Secure entry. Would book again!

My daughter and I enjoyed our stay during a quick weekend trip to explore Chicago and visit Lollapalooza.  The location was a few miles from downtown but easy to access by train, only a few blocks away.  Our stay was easy and comfortable with all necessary amenities.  Would definitely come back to stay again!
the space was so cute and in a convenient place! we had such a good time both out in the city and back at the airbnb. thanks!
This place was clean and decorated tastefully. It was pricey for the location. My questions were answered in a timely manner. I would recommend this place.
Nice quiet stay
Great host and place.  Highly recommend

We absolutely loved our stay at Nicole and Matt's home in Wicker Park! We had a large group of 6 adults, 3 kids and an infant and we never felt cramped; the house is large and comfortable. Matt and Nicole went above and beyond for us; we had three cars and they were kind enough to secure parking for the third car even though it required a lot of work. The neighborhood is also super fun, lively and centrally located! We would highly recommend this airbnb for any large group traveling to Chicago!

Wonderful and cozy space in an amazing location. Very clean and well-maintained apartment. Walkable neighborhood with subway stations nearby. Wish we could have stayed longer. Will definitely look it up if we return to Chicago.
This was the perfect place for my first month in a new city! 10/10 would recommend!

Nice place and very walkable. The only issue we found was the shower sucked I think it was lowkey broken but we were still able to shower. Just half the buttons on the shower did not work. But overall cute little bnb

We had a wonderful stay at the Garden Apartment in Chicago! The apartment was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. When we had a small issue with the Keurig, our host responded quickly and took care of it right away, which we really appreciated.
The location was perfect and made it easy to get to all the places we wanted to visit around the Chicago area. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and we wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again. We will definitely book this apartment on our future trips to Chicago. Highly recommended!
这次入住体验十分满意！民宿地理位置优越，出门不远就有地铁站点，周边有超市，日常采购很方便。屋内采光充足、收拾得干净整洁。小区环境清幽，治安靠谱，居住安心舒适，整体性价比很高，下次出行还会优先考虑。

My wife and I had a wonderful stay in Lincoln Park! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location. The lovely garden was a highlight and a great place to start the day with a coffee. The neighborhood was charming, walkable, and full of great restaurants. We would happily stay here again!
My mom and I stayed here two nights and were very comfortable. No issues at all. Thank you!
Cozy place in a great walkable neighborhood with lots of shops and restaurants. Host was very responsive. Would stay here again.
Great place. Great location. Plenty of space for the whole family.  Appreciated the walkability and close proximity to the red line.
Easy check in, great location, very friendly and helpful host! We appreciated the provided drinks and having a nice place to rest after busy days in the city!
Super cute and cozy place to stay!! Amazing location with plenty to do. Thank you for a wonderful stay<3
Amazing host
Very convenient location and easy to access for everyone.

The location for a cubs game is tremendous. Having parking available was really helpful. Beds were comfortable and there was plenty of room for our group.
We had a great stay and would definitely stay here again.
Great stay, hospitable host!
Great area. Very responsive. Did not feel as though anything was missing from the place.
Great place to stay
Was a perfect place for my friends and I during Lollapalooza weekend!
Charie’s place was fantastic. Exactly what we needed. Her responsiveness was so very much appreciated. I highly recommend.

This Airbnb was perfect for us and so well-appointed, clean and really all around lovely. We gathered with our family in Chicago and this location was between two places we needed to be. Nathaniel was a great host, answering questions even when a big storm hit Chicago. The fact that this airbnb includes parking was a HUGE plus. We would definitely stay here again when we return to Chicago!
Apt was perfect for our stay,  everything was comfortable and clean. Parking garage access was very convenient!

I really enjoyed my stay at Brett’s place. I had reservations about the apartment style and really was more than satisfied with it. Brett is super kind and willing to work with your schedule! Also had great local suggestions for food and fun. The flat was clean and very nice. I would definitely come back.

Thank you so much for being such great hosts!
Love the place! Love Chicago!
Clean and very comfortable. Close to public transportation and restaurants. Would definitely stay here again.
I didn’t get to meet Amanda in person because I was out much of the time. But she still managed to make me feel at home.  Beautiful place, lovely neighborhood, so close to everything.  ❤️
My friends and I had an AMAZING stay at mannys! the place was easy to find and spotless when we walked in! The hosts had amazing communication with us! Zero complaints 🤍🤍🤍

DJ was super friendly and made sure I felt comfortable in his home. The bathroom and the bedroom were clean and private which was really nice. Overall, it was great and close enough to everywhere I wanted to go.

My sister and I stayed here for 2 nights. It was a really pleasant stay! We drove and we were able to use the garage, which was really nice. The only thing that was surprising were the stairs to get up to the room and the difficulty with the keys to open the door. Other than that, the AC was amazing, the space was spacious, and the kitchen was great! The bus stop was just around the corner and there are so many food and store options within walking distance. Because we checked in the same day as our event, the host was super flexible and communicative. I would for sure stay here again!
Would definitely book again. Amazing place!
Tripp and Todd are great hosts! So friendly and such a nice place!

My son insisted that we get 7 day public transportation passes and I was so glad he did.   We went everywhere on the trains and buses that surrounded the unit.  The neighborhood was friendly and walkable with everything you needed within walking distance.  The unit was very quiet and spacious for the two of us.  Angie was extremely responsive and left us snacks and plenty of water for the warm days.  AC worked great and we were always happy to get back to our cool oasis after our busy days.

Dede's place is something to admire! The space feels so private and welcoming. The attention was magnificent; from the personalized notes and instructions on the wall, to the little intricate welcome notes throughout the place, and all the little fixins in the kitchen and bathroom, made this stay so memorable. The neighborhood is amazing and so peaceful. The bed was super comfortable, and the place was exquisitely clean. We can't say enough about this place and would easily book here again the next time we were in Chicago.

Will’s place was extremely clean. He was friendly and accommodating.  He was able to give us an early check in. He was quick to answer any questions we had. We were in town for a Cubs game and were thrilled with the location. We enjoyed the area, walking over to the lake, eating at some local spots. El Mariachi was a great recommendation and right next door!  We would absolutely stay here again!
Great trip. Eric was very responsive and helpful. Unit was clean and comfortable

Jhon is a nice host and the Airbnb was okay however, the bathroom photos do not match at all.
When we arrived the ceiling was rotted and falling through causing a big leak, it was so bad I had to change airbnbs. As it rained and it leaked all over the sink, floor, my personal items and was a safety hazard. This was day 2 of my trip. When asking Jhon got a refund due to my messed up makeup he requested pictures even though I literally showed him the roof was collapsing and could fall on me any moment. He only gave partial refund and because it was during my day 2 of my trip at 8am it took a whole day to find another accommodation.
Jhon seems to be nice and a good host but the situation could be handled differently. Please also post full photos of the bathroom bc the moment I arrived I was worried it may leak but tried to hope it would not. It was very obvious it was a leak building up for some time that had not been attended to.

Excellent place, no problems. The neighborhood is a gem; I was here for a convention, wish I’d had more time to walk around and explore. Nice range of restaurants, from classy Italian food to authentic Chicago Mexican, and everything in between.

We had such a nice time staying here for 4 weeks!! This house is a perfect layout for a family or extended stay. The street is absolutely adorable; a park right at the end of the street (Coonley Elementary), 7 min walk to the brown line, CVS, Walgreens, Jewel, coffee shops and a restaurants in walking. The house was clean, had all the amenities and was very spacious. The property manager was SO helpful if we needed anything at any time of the day. We highly recommended staying at this beautiful house!!

House was clean and having 3 separate full baths was a BIG plus for us. The area felt safe and there are eateries and a couple of bars that’s walking distance. Parking can be challenging if you have a rental car but that’s the same for any big city. Overall, we had a pleasant stay and wouldn’t think twice of booking this place again.

This home was such a beautiful place to stay at. The space was very clean and had lots of room for my fiends and I staying for lollapalooza. It was an easy commute from downtown and a beautiful place to come back to and relax for the evening. Rooms and bathroom were very clean and the patio was beautiful for a nice cookout or dinner to have. Would definitely recommend or book again in the future!!!

The location of the apartment was absolutely perfect for visiting family in Ukrainian Village, and great for access to everything great about Chicago in the summer. Walkable to great spots to eat and drink. The unit was clean and comfortable.
Amazing hosts - kind considerate friendly and hospitable. Wonderful neighborhood and great experience overall. Safe clean much more to offer than the images ever can. Thank you Don and Mary🙏🙏🙏
Cozy place near Logan Square, Ali was attentive and ready to help if needed.
Really loved our stay at Jorge’s place. Everything was perfect
Stayed here for lollapalooza! Was in a great spot and super comfy!
Had a great stay here!

Great place, no complaints. It seems like it was likely student housing because of the four rooms, each with a bathroom. This made it very convenient for our large family and would be great for multiple couples. Good communication, checkin was easy if you follow the directions, all in all great.
Great apartment! Gennie is an awesome host.
Charlie’s place was great! It was just walking distance to the CTA and at a very friendly and calm neighborhood. I recommend it!
Conveniently located less than a 10 minute walk from the Blue Line!

We really enjoyed our stay here in Chicago! The location being right above a bus stop and a reasonable walk to the train made our trip much easier. The place was immaculate and cozy. We absolutely adored it! Thank you to the host for being so responsive and helpful! Would stay here again!!!
Beautiful home and lovely location! Shari was a great host.
Hieno paikka!
Natasha’s apartment was just wonderful! It is really well located, clean and the host’s communication was clear!
House was exactly as presented quiet and in a s a fer area of town...clean and communication was good...easy check in process n.  Thanks!

Five of us stayed at Kim’s place and it was a over great time. We were there for a very short time as we flew in the day before a concert and left the day after. The place was clean air conditioned and well furnished. The only potential issue I could say is the stairs leading up to the apartment are very squeaky. The reason this may be a concern is there is quiet hours and we did arrive at nearly one in the morning since concert ran late into the night. Other than that our stay was fantastic. We’d recommend the place to other to stay wholeheartedly. Thank you for a very pleasant stay Kim!

The location was excellent and the best part of our stay. Unfortunately, several maintenance issues significantly impacted our experience. The basement apartment had a persistent dank odor, chipped paint, and stained walls. When we arrived, the Wi-Fi did not work. We messaged the hosts, received an initial "Let me check" response, but no further updates, and the Wi-Fi wasn't restored until the next day.
Our first night, we returned to find the apartment filled with flies. There were none when we initially arrived at 2, no windows were open when we left at 4:45. Upon returning around 9:30 there were flies inside. We waited about 2 hours after contacting the host, even though he said one hour, before receiving a fly swatter. The host provided a $50 credit, which we appreciated. Later, an exposed bathroom ceiling pipe leaked directly over the toilet, making it unusable. Despite the great location, these issues made the stay feel overpriced. The property has potential but needs maintenance

This was my very first experience using Airbnb and I stayed for her a little over 2 months. As many of the others have said the neighborhood is a bit rough but it's the same with any big city, just pay attention and you'll be fine. Andy was always respectful and responsive when I had questions and overall I just enjoyed my stay here!

Cute spot, it was a very walkable area & we had no trouble finding lots to do nearby! The bed was comfy, everything was clean, and I felt it was the perfect amount of space for two people. The only minor thing to note was that the bathroom door does not fully close/lock, so keep that in mind if you’re sharing the room. Will definitely keep this spot in mind the next time we’re in Chicago!
Great location in a quiet building! Close to restaurants and bars. Quick walk to grab grocery or convenience items. Easy access to the L a couple blocks away. Walkable to Magnificent Mile!!

I felt truly at home at Genesys’s place! It was so cozy, and she and her wife were so friendly! They checked in on us but also gave us lots of privacy. Their pets are also so cute and sweet! I can’t wait to visit them again!

Val’s place was perfect for our road trip stop at Chicago. The biggest value to us was walking access to the red, purple, and brown line L stop. We were a short ride away from Northwestern and the loop. The carriage house neighborhood had plenty of restaurants for late night dinner.
If you plan to bring a car, give Val a heads up before you arrive to arrange the parking pass. We found a spot a block away and left our car parked for our visit.

We stayed in this condo for an entire month, so we had lots of time to notice everything about it.  The neighborhood is nice and is VERY convenient to Wrigley Field.  Mj was always responsive, although we didn't have to contact him often about anything. The place is spacious and clean, with lots of big windows and a skylight.  The dining area could serve 10!The decor is transitional with touches of modern glam.  The kitchen and bath are completely renovated. The range and refrigerator were newish and fairly high end. We did most of our own cooking, and the kitchen was a pleasure to use.  It had every piece of equipment we could have wanted.  We especially appreciated the sharp knives. We would have loved more storage in the bathroom, but I doubt many people come for a whole month. We would stay here again, especially if they put a washer/dryer in the unit.

The unit they gave us was not the unit in the pictures, which I guess is not a big deal, but we should have been warned. The shower had no water pressure. The water just dribbles out and down. The furniture is sparse and bare bones. There was nowhere to put your luggage, only a bed and two tiny nightstands, so luggage had to go on the floor. Also, no top sheets on the bed, just a fitted sheet and comforter.
I would not stay at this place. They are doing the absolute bare minimum. Location was great and would have been a good experience if they spent a few bucks on amenities.
Oh, the TV screen was all scratched up and you could open some of the blinds because the wands were missing.
Awesome space! Felt like home. Was in a quiet neighborhood so we felt very safe!

The place is clean and my room was a good size. It was easy to find/access and is very walkable to many restaurants, right in the heart of the medical district. Had a great stay and plan on coming back.
Es war ein sehr schönes Apartment mit allen was man braucht. Auch die Lage war super und die Nachbarschaft war zauberhaft. Wir kommen sehr gerne wieder.

We had a great stay at Milan’s Modern 2BR Near McCormick with Skyline View in Chicago. We stayed on the 5th floor, and the apartment was comfortable, clean, and exactly what we needed for our trip. The location was convenient, especially for getting around the city and being near McCormick Place.
The space was modern, spacious, and well suited for our stay. We especially enjoyed the skyline views, which added a nice touch to the Chicago experience. Milan was a great host, and everything went smoothly from check-in through checkout.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago, especially if you’re attending an event at McCormick Place. We would definitely consider staying here again!
Awesome, quaint, comfortable. Would repeat in a heartbeat.
Clear instructions and clean space!

This flat is truly a find! First Airbnb we’ve visited that was ACTUALLY fully stocked. Nicely furnished, fantastic neighborhood, safe and secure. I would stay there again in a heartbeat.  Sulaiman is responsive and truly helpful.
Mike did a wonderful job communicating and helping us get settled. Place was super clean and looked even nicer in person. Would pass this along to anyone visiting the area.
The room is clean, there are plenty of activities nearby, and the residents are quiet.
This place nests in a beautiful neighborhood fill with things to do all around. You don’t hear anything even if close to action. Very clean little apartment fully equipped.
Such a beautiful home. Great communication. Thank you so much.

My three daughters and three grandkids stayed at Arthur's place for a reunion.  There was plenty of room for all of us.  It was a comfortable place, located near where our activities were planned, walking distance to Rate Field ( 1 mile west) and Wintrust (1.5 miles north), also near public transit.    It is a lovely older Victorian home with huge rooms and windows.  The neighborhood felt safe, parking was right on the street in front of the unit.

Cassandra was a wonderful host - she was responsive, communicative, and provided clear, helpful information before and during our stay. She also checked in to make sure my guests and I were doing well and was quick to offer assistance if we needed anything, which we really appreciated.
Overall, we had a good stay. There were a few minor issues with the apartment, including the floors not feeling as clean as we had expected and finding a dead bug in the shower upon arrival. There was also a dog in the unit above that barked fairly often, which could be a bit noticeable at times.
None of these issues significantly impacted our trip, but they are worth noting for future guests. Aside from that, our experience with Cassandra as a host was excellent, and we appreciated her hospitality and attentiveness throughout our stay.
This place was super cute and walking distance to the L. It was exactly what we needed to explore Chicago.

Great stay. Walkable to Lollapalooza which was so amazing. Perfect space for my husband and I and our daughter and her good friend. Quick and solid communication from LIVN and the place was ready with anything we needed. Would stay here again.
Thanks :)

Herman is a wonderful host. He is incredibly friendly and always checked in to make sure we had everything we needed and were enjoying our stay. He was also very understanding of our lifestyle, which made our stay completely stress-free. We truly appreciated his kindness and thoughtfulness throughout our time there.
Thank you, Herman!
Very nice and convenient.

Michael went far and beyond to make our stay comfortable. He gave me a tour upon my arrival around the neighborhood, and he even gave me some medicine for my husband, who had a cold. The place was very clean, comfortable, and had everything needed. I loved his library with lots of art books and music. I recommend this place 100%, and if I come back to Chicago, I will book again. On the last day, his son offered to take us to the airport for a very convenient fee. Thanks Michael and family!

Very attentive and nice host, and the place was wonderful. Very clean and well stocked with anything you may need. Everything worked and the furniture was very comfortable. Neighborhood was very safe and quiet. We would love to stay again
It was a great place to stay for Lollapalooza!

The apartment itself was very nice, and Alex and Lauren were responsive and helpful. However, we were very disappointed that the listing gave no clear indication that reaching the unit required climbing several flights of a tall, open-air metal staircase. There were no photos showing the staircase or what guests would actually have to climb to reach the unit. Both my daughter and I have a significant fear of heights, so discovering this only after we arrived was extremely upsetting. Had we seen a photo or been clearly informed about the stairs, we would not have booked this property. To their credit, Alex and Lauren worked with us and allowed us to use an interior stairway. The accommodations were nice, but I strongly believe the exterior staircase and multiple flights of stairs should be clearly disclosed and pictured so guests can make an informed decision before booking.
Great stay! Monica was very nice

Beautiful apartment! We booked the stay to help my 20-ish daughter move apartments in Chicago - move out 1 day and in the next. This provided a great location for us to rest and relax after the move-out. We walked to a great restaurant with beautiful outdoor seating. Safe neighborhood. We walked to catch various public transportation to other activities. Hosts were very responsive. Beds are in the firm side - 2 of the rooms have a/c units, but the 3rd had doors that opened to the living room that also had an A/C unit.
Has a great dining room area that we didn’t use, but it would have been perfect for eating or playing games. Cozy couch - we did watch a Netflix show as we wound down. OH - one of my favorite parts….they had a throw blanket which just makes watching a show more enjoyable!
Highly recommend!!
This is a wonderful, quiet location in a very desirable and lively neighborhood. The king bed is fantastic. Carly responded to our questions and made us feel completely at home.
This place was great!! I would choose this place again and again.

This apartment was perfect for us! With 2 teenagers, they took over the basement space while we were upstairs. The neighborhood is perfect; loads of restaurants, grocery 2 blocks away, walk to the lake.
Andrew’s house manual offered great recommendations. He was also incredibly responsive and helpful.
It was a great clean place to stay while visiting Chicago.
Absolutely what you see and what you get.  And everything you need in a normal day to day household is there as well as bathroom necessities

Freddy was a great host and very responsive and helpful with very easy instructions for check in and check out. The place was exactly as depicted and very clean and peaceful. Helped make for a wonderful week in Chicago and I would stay again if I make another trip to the area.

We were very grateful to stay in a so beautiful house. You have everything we needed.
Thank you

The home is just as fabulous in person as it appears in the listing. Unique, clean, comfortable, welcoming. And the location is perfect! Great neighborhood,  walkable to lots of restaurants,  pubs, cafes, the "L" (elevated "subway") directly to downtown, and less than a mile from Wrigley Field. We were really so happy with it and would love to visit again!

Thank you Nicholas and family for the wonderful stay. Very cozy and clean place to live in. At the moment we stepped into the house, we felt welcomed and at ease.
Amenity supplies were available and plenty. First aid in kit was also available if needed. The rooms were very clean.
Highly recommend to anyone who is looking for a quiet and cozy place to stay in Chicago.
Easy access to public transport, good room if you need a cheap option
We had a great time at Todd’s Airbnb. Easily walkable to wrigley. Very clean and he was very responsive.
We really enjoyed our trip to Chicago and having a relaxing place to come back to was very nice.

I want to be fair. The location, amenities, responsiveness were all great. However, sometimes knowing when other guests would arrive and sometimes not/changing the booking from 12 months to 10/converting the house so that I have to go up and down 3 separate staircases to get to a shower I now share with an additional 3 people….not great. Out of 10 I would give it a 5-6 at most.
This was a wonderful apartment for our family and the location was unbeatable. Very clean and hotel-like amenities. I would definitely stay here again.

Fun stay at David's! We love quirky decor, and the place felt really comfortable for our week-long stay. Communication was polite and quick, and he even let us check in early - huge help after a long overnight train ride. The neighborhood is great, with beautiful streets and lots of restaurants nearby, yet the apartment sits on a quiet street that's perfect for resting. The listing also gave us a heads up about the 3-floor walk-up beforehand, so just know that going in!

A fantastic place in an unbeatable location! It was an easy walk to Wrigley Field, and the host was incredibly responsive and accommodating throughout our stay. The neighborhood was charming, quiet, and beautiful. We had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend staying here!
Perfect location with tons of things to do in walking distance. The apartment was nice and well-maintained. The kitchen had everything needed to cook
The bathroom situation can get awkward, but overall a great stay. The place was clean and inviting, and Tim is a considerate host

From the moment I arrived, I felt genuinely welcomed at Donald and Colby's home. Donald and Colby were incredibly warm, gracious, and welcoming from beginning to end. Their communication was always prompt, helpful, and attentive, making everything easy and stress-free. They also shared wonderful local recommendations, which helped me enjoy the neighborhood even more.
The home is beautifully designed, stylish, spotless, and incredibly comfortable. Every detail has been thoughtfully considered. I especially appreciated the high-quality organic fruit, the thoughtful amenities, and the wonderful scents of the shampoo, body wash, and hand soap. It truly felt like staying in my own home. The bed was exceptionally comfortable, and the spacious desk made studying and working an absolute pleasure.
Thank you both for your outstanding hospitality and for making my stay in Chicago so memorable. I wholeheartedly recommend this wonderful home to anyone visiting Chicago.
Had a nice stay . Nice clean place , good location.

Kath is a wonderful person - she managed to put up with my many questions over the stay & was always quick to reply - very patient of her & my family thanks her for making our stay so pleasant...
The apartment is located close to the public transport system, but not too close! - & the area is dotted with places to go out & eat, drink & listen to music - while also having the flexibility to go down town easily...
Kath went above & beyond for us - allowed us our privacy & topped it off at the end with an extremely helpful gesture, which brought our trip to Chicago to an end on a high!...
Thanks Kath!...
Great if you don’t mind sharing a living space. Bathroom and bedroom are private. Felt like a hotel or a cruise ship room vibe.

My friends and I were in town for lollapalooza. This quaint loft was exactly as described and pretty cozy! Gregory even brought us more towels and coffee that he left on the porch which was really nice!
This was the perfect place for our weekend getaway to Chicago! Within walking distance of the bus stop and exactly what we needed. Will definitely be back next time we are in town!
Clean and spacious apartment in a quiet south side neighborhood. The host was friendly and proactive and everything wad exactly as described. Would definitely recommend.

Ari’s place made us feel like we were home away from home! As a Chicagoan myself I felt such nostalgia staying in a traditional style Chicago apartment. The location of the apartment gives you access to Logan square, Hermosa and Humboldt Park neighborhoods and their hidden eateries! Very walkable and if need be, access to the CTA and L are near by. I would definitely recommend Ari’s place to anyone looking to explore Chicago’s northwest neighborhoods and their gems. Ari was also very responsive with providing us with a pack n play for our little one and check in was a breeze! Cozy place and clean!

I was in town for a meeting and a visit, and the apartment suited my needs and is accurately advertised and described. Check in was very easy, and even during the week/end of Lollapalooza this was a *very reasonably priced* option for a great deal of space and a very cool living area. I didn't have any problems or issues!

I really enjoyed my stay! Everything was as described and if not better! Super tidy and perfect room for my stay! Thank you so much for having me :) Will definitely consider booking again in the future.
Nice place. Nice host.

The apartment itself was lovely, clean, and exactly as pictured. Denzilt was responsive and easy to communicate with, and we felt comfortable and at home inside the space.
One thing to keep in mind is the location. The neighborhood didn’t feel like the safest area, especially after dark. We just didn’t research the area enough.
Overall, a nice stay in a nice space. Just do your homework on the location so you know what to expect.

Great location. Joe was extremely responsive and the place was exactly as described. It was very comfortable and very reasonably priced. The space was very warm and welcoming. There is a lot nearby and parking on Kimball Avenue, just be aware of street cleaning days. I am very glad we chose this location. Thank you Joe.

Amazing and thoughtful host. We were visiting for Lollapalooza and Shaun had rain ponchos waiting for us to use at the festival in case we forgot to pack ours! Thank you so much for hosting us Shaun <3333
Place was great!
we loved mary’s place!! It is perfect, close to the blue line and she is very responsive and friendly
Ashley's place was amazing.  A short walk to the red line that will take you anywhere in the city.
We stayed for 10 weeks with our daughter and two cats. Everything was great. The space was advertised. The hosts were super friendly and helpful. Could not have asked for a better experience.
Great host, but the building was older. The pool was closed everything needs to be renovated in the common areas. We had troubles with our air and our host took care of it. It for our needs.
Overall the place met our needs for the summer. David was always fast to resolve any and all issues.
Great and spacious apartment

This place was worth good money, but I was a bit put off by being asked for another fee on top of what I paid to book. This should have been disclosed prior to booking and should not be allowed.
The accommodations were beautiful, but you’re in the inner city, so it was LOUD. That said, everything is comfortable and well-appointed.
I also didn’t realize I’d be there during Lollapalooza weekend but every price was raised because of it — especially lodging.

Gorgeous little apartment in a lovely area. So close to local amenities yet it was so peaceful, it didn’t feel like you were near such a busy and bustling area! We had everything we needed and any questions we had, Andy was right on hand with answers!
The room was really clean and ready for us my only issue was that we were asked to lie to the front desk and the bathroom shower wasn’t all that clean but it was a fun stay for a night or two!!!
The room we stayed in was very nice, the shared bathroom is a little tough when there's a lot of people but it was a good experience with everything considered.

While Anthony himself was an excellent host, the Airbnb was slightly dingy. The first thing we noticed was the amount of bugs in the space, and several other issues - the bathroom door was off one of the hinges, and the door's knob did not lock. Again, Anthony was very responsive and provided recommendations for the area, but the space itself was not up to par with the price we paid for it.

While it was certainly adequate and comfortable, there was some wear and tear. The bath towels were a bit threadbare and the only other thing that stood out strongly to me was the shower curtain liner. Definitely needs to be replaced as it is stained and looks unsanitary.
Otherwise, I'd stay there again!
Had a pleasant stay during my month long rotation at the local hospital. The place was clean and the other guests were nice and quiet. Host was responsive. Would recommend staying.

Nice and quiet stay! Very nice and responsive hosts!!
We appreciated the tv-free zone - it allowed us to actually hold convos and play games with our teenagers (and they actually enjoyed it)!!

We were in town for two baseball games, one at the White Sox and one at the Cubs on the north side. This place is only a half mile walk from the White Sox stadium, and it’s very safe and walkable. Good restaurants within walking distance as well. Very easy to catch the L (train) to the north side as well. The house was very clean eh the plenty of space. Host was great with communications. This is where I’m looking for my next visit to the south side of Chicago. I’ve already recommended to a baseball-minded friend.
Alexis was very kind and welcoming. Fast responses and helpful in every way! Great host and great/cozy airbnb!

I had an amazing experience visiting Wrigley Field for the first time, and Reed's Lakeview home was the perfect location to walk and experience Wrigley and the surrounding neighborhood. As a baseball fan, it was the trip of a lifetime, enhanced by Reed's lovely home!
we enjoyed our stay here !
Great apartment right in the middle of Wrigleyville and close to the l which made getting around the city very easy
Leonid y su pareja son excelentes anfitriones. El interior del AirBnb es excelente. El problema es la ubicación, es muy peligrosa.
This was an excellent place to stay, and we’d surely look into it again on future trips

Grace is the true definition of a Super Host. She was incredibly communiative, kind, and willing to be accommodating. The house is a perfect location. Just steps away from the Red line Addison stop. The convenience of the location mixed with the parking was perfect! The house is an older house, but has been beautifully updated. It was incredibly clean! The main bedroom bed was SO comfortable and the sheets and pillows were to die for. I didn't want to leave the bed! The common area was so beautiful to have breakfast in the morning. Just as the posting and comments mention, you can hear the train, however, for a city lover like myself, it was not an issue at all. As other people mention in their reviews, there are a ton of ear plugs and some sound machines if you want, but if you enjoy ambient city sounds, it will not bother you at all. The check-in process is super easy. I definitely hope I will get to stay here again some day. Do NOT hesitate to book your stay here!

Yolanda was super responsive and wonderful. I told Yolanda that we were traveling with 3 kids and a baby and she provided a crib and a pack n play for us! it was so nice to not have to travel with those things. We had a family of 6 in this apartment and all agreed it was super spacious and we didn’t feel like we were on top of each other. The on-site laundry was super nice too. Traveling with a family our size, we try to pack light and do laundry when we travel and it was perfect! Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone

Charles war immer offen und hilfsbereit, und es wurde sich sofort um meine Anliegen gekümmert. Er hat sich immer vergewissert, dass es mir an nichts fehlt. Es gab stets klare Rückmeldungen innerhalb kürzester Zeit.

Had everything we needed! The closet was surprisingly big, and was a nice place to put all our luggage out of view. Laundry was available with detergent ready, clean bathroom and kitchen, central air and heat, the sofa bed really came in handy (perfect for one short person like myself or small children). Host was very responsive to all my questions, and no issues with getting to the unit. Walking distance from bus lines that took us to the Loop easily. Great place to stay!
Nice place but one bathroom and it is small! I cannot imagine sharing this bathroom with more than two people. Even for one person it is tiny.

Spent a week here with my adult kids and grandson and was a great spot for us to use as a home base for our tours in downtown and Lincoln park zoo.  Plenty of food and coffee within walking distance.  Wrigleyville is an easy walk as well.  2 full bathrooms were a must for us and the kitchen and living room areas were spacious.

Casa muito simpática. Quarto limpo e cama confortável.
Cozinha acessível.
Casa sempre calma e sem barulho.
Instruções claras.
Really Nice place enjoyed it tremendously.

Great spot close to so much. Great restaurants nearby, within walking distance. Great spot if you want to be walking distance to many attractions like the Museum of Science and Obama Presidential Center.

Carolina et Ray sont des hôtes accueillant et sympathique
Joli appartement on s’y sent bien
Très chouette quartier de Chicago
Nous avons passer un très beau séjour

Wir waren für zwei Nächte in dieser WG. Die Lage fanden wir super, das Auto haben wir kostenlos in der Seitenstraße abparken können und sind dann mit den Öffis in die Innenstadt für nur 5$ pro Tagesticket.
Hydepark hat ein beeindruckendes Uni-Gelände und auch das Obama Presidential Center ist sehenswert. In unmittelbarer Nähe zur Unterkunft ist außerdem Obamas Haus und sein Lieblingsdiner.
Der Zugang zur Wohnung und dem Zimmer erfolgt durch verschiedene Codes, die Tür von unserem Zimmer (2) hat gelegentlich etwas rumgezickt und ließ sich erst nach ein paar Anläufen öffen. Das Gemeinschaftsbad war ok und frei wenn wir es brauchten. Es gab auch eine zusätzliche Toilette.
Ansonsten war es für den Preis Ok und auf Fragen wurde immer zügig geantwortet.

Emily is a pleasant host, no complaints whatsoever. Had a cozy and comfortable stay!
Thank you!!

What an extremely lovely home with the most thoughtful design and wonderful, communicative host! Thank you Kim for all of your help and for designing such a beautiful place. We would love to come back one day!
Responsive host and home that provided what we needed for a short stay.
Awesome place! Awesome location! Can't wait to book it again next summer for my yearly trip home to Chicago! Thanks so much
Beautiful apartment in an excellent location! It was exactly as described/pictured, & Demitri's communication was very clear, friendly, and proactive.

Estuvimos ahí solo un día debido a que nos cancelaron un vuelo por lo que no pudimos disfrutar mucho del alojamiento. Sin embargo, el departamento es cómodo para dos personas, su ubicación es muy buena y en 30 minutos llegas caminando al downtown. Lo recomiendo.
Perfect stay , would definitely book again !
If you want to feel right at home away from home, then this is the place to stay. We plan on coming back here in the very near future.

Affordable price and walkable distance to the train to get around. Quiet at night and great breakfast near by. Place as clean and room was spacious with AC. Instructions along with photos on how to get inside made it much easier. Definitely would be booking again.
Clean, close to the subway station, spacious
We had a wonderful stay! Chanda was incredibly welcoming, responsive, and made us feel right at home. Everything was clean and exactly as described. We'd definitely stay here again!

Our stay was perfect and exactly what we needed for two moms with kids at a nearby camp. My boyfriend plans to book this for a family vacation he is taking and I will absolutely book for my next stay in Chicago.

Great location, minutes away from the Orange Line which gives you easy access to downtown and also good food at Chinatown. It’s close to an intersection so feels relatively safe, however earplugs are recommended to muffle out the traffic noise. Room was quite spacious and had other shared amenities like bathrooms and kitchens which is pretty neat. Overall a good bang for your buck if you’re traveling solo.
You can’t beat the location and it was practically brand new.
Great place for a large family we used this house as a meeting spot with adult kids plenty of space for everyone will book again

We really enjoyed our stay in River West at this gorgeous apartment with the amazing Chicago skyline view! We used the pool and gym almost every day, and we had plenty of room for the four adults and two young boys. We're already looking forward to our next visit!
Really lovely and responsive hosts! Their unit was amazing and well thought out.
El departamento cómodo y se encuentra en una zona segura y muy bonita de Chicago! La atención del host fue muy buena😊

Tim was a wonderful host. He was very responsive when I had questions about arrival and made the move in very efficient. The place itself was beautiful, not only the house but the area around it. Lots of shade, very little noise, and just a walkable area. I was out late most nights due to my schedule, so I arrived back to the place rather late. I never had any issues with the area, and I also found it pretty well lit for finding your way around.
Amazing location...Great place...excellent hosts!!!! Thank you very much!

We had a great stay
Thank you
Perfect location in our favorite neighborhood!  Thanks Chris!
Great, quiet apartment in a terrific location. The Host was extremely friendly and responsive. Thanks.
Sandra and Alondra were extremely responsive, and their home was very cozy.
Last minute booking. Very responsive. Great stay

Anfitrião extremamente atencioso e respondia muito rapidamente de forma bastante prestativa. Tivemos um pequeno problema no dia do check-in e rapidamente foi resolvido. Certamente, indico e ficaria novamente. Obrigada pela estadia.

Russell’s place was as described and felt like a home while we were visiting. I love the old home charm with modern bathrooms. It was clean, spacious and exactly what we needed. Russell communicated promptly and made sure we had everything we needed.
Enjoyed our stay and David was a great host! Great location and nice amentities!

L'appartement de Michael est totalement fidèle à sa description et aux photos. Il est fonctionnel et possède tout le nécessaire à un bon séjour. Il est situé dans un quartier calme et surtout proche d'un métro bien desservi (ligne verte). Le stationnement est un vrai atout supplémentaire. Quant à Michael, les informations fournies sont impeccables et il est très réactif aux demandes et interrogations, en plus de ses conseils. Merci pour ce beau séjour chez vous !
Everything was great. Property was private quiet great places to eat around me. The only thing I will complain about which is totally out of the hostess control is the limited parking

Definitely a gem, my wife and I stayed here for a week while moving my kids around Chicago. We worked remotely in Hien’s flat, very quiet, even with sliding door open. Close to Mindy’s and rest of Wicker Park. My wife has a high bar and this flat met our cleanliness and comfort standards. I would stay again.
Had a fantastic time

Takeisa is truly a superhost. From start to finish, she was on top of everything and truly made our stay delightful. Upon check-in, we were greeted by a welcome basket full of treats and a letter. She gave helpful tips and recommendations during our stay. She was very friendly and responsive. The  house was even stocked with a few things that were super helpful during our stay. I highly recommend and would stay again anytime!
We had the best time using Florin’s apartment as a home base for our chicago adventures. We were 6 adults and 3 young children and it worked out perfectly.

I’ve never stayed in such a dirty home. No attention to cleaning. Please note the posted pictures are not at all what you’ll find. Overgrown front yard, dirty front door and the vents covered with dirt and soot. The couch is nothing more than a frame with a 2 inch foam covered with a white dirty sheet and a bedspread.  I had to wash the spread before sitting on the couch.  Kitchen was fine, but no extras, marginally stocked, so we  didn’t cook.  NOW the bathroom, I wish I had brought shower shoes.  The grime and mold in the shower  was the final straw. NASTY!!!  Honestly I don’t know if it was poor cleaning or age, but the photos on the website are not what you’ll find. We spent very little time in the home. At one point the host did reach out with the possibility of a refund, but never heard back.  I don’t know the recourse when the booking is non refundable, so we stayed. I documented everything, hoping to hear back from Airbnb, never did.  Until she makes changes run away,don’t walk

I’ve had the pleasure of staying at Jeff’s Airbnb from May-August. I can’t stress enough how great this property is. It’s quite walkable to bars and great places to eat. (Sushi, empanadas.) The unit is clean and modern with a cozy touch with the decorations. It’s a quiet family neighborhood and a quick walk to the grocery store if you need anything. I travel for work and this is the second property of Jeff’s I’ve stayed at and they are both very nice and consistent which is important in my opinion when hosts have more than one property. Def perfect for short/long term stays. Laundry in unit is a huge bonus. The bed is comfortable and access is private get easily accessible. Would 100% recommend staying here.

Great place to stay in a convenient location. I didn’t think the city noise was too loud at all and I had no issue sleeping. Good AC, a full kitchen, and laundry in unit made my week staying Chicago much more enjoyable!
Very clean and the host gave us clear instructions and responded very quickly. Thank you!
Wonderful location. Communication was wonderful. Provided everything needed for a comfortable stay.  Highly recommend. Being so close to the Blue line made getting around Chicago very easy.

Very nice host and responsive. Other reviews say it, but the floors in the kitchen are warped and slightly uncomfortable to walk on. WiFi is fast, but to watch TV, you would need your own apps…no normal TV.
Nice kitchen, the beds were comfy, bathroom was fine.

Arron's place was tasteful, so well decorated with quality, imaginative items. There was everything you need for a comfortable stay. Mins from Wrigley and many other places. I highly recommend the stay!

Ruthie was the on site manager, and she was the best. There were no issues.
She went above and beyond. And then a little bit above that. When I couldn't find the measuring spoons, she actually knocked on the door with a brand new set!
The apartment was styled impeccably, and immaculately clean. Beds were comfortable, room enough for a large family.
Very walkable, lots to do for a family! Rainbow Beach between 76th and 78th has clear sand and attentive lifeguards, 7 minute walk. South Shore library (has events for all ages) 5 minutes. Golf course at the cultural center, 10 minute walk.
If you want to explore, the South Shore Metra stop is 10 minutes away. (Brew coffee shop is next door, great drinks) The train will take you downtown in 35. For driving, the apartment is near Lakeshore Drive and a straight shot downtown.
To wrap up, I can't praise Ruthie enough. She was supportive, responsive, and immensely helpful.
Loved the place, very comfortable. Julio was there if we needed anything and checked in to make sure we didn’t need anything.
The train and the A/C, which some reviews mentioned, did not bother us at all. We had a great time and would stay here again if we come back to Chicago!
Silvia is a great host!
The location was great to explore the area. The host was great. Great place for a large group.

We stayed here while waiting for our house to be completed. It’s very much a classic Chicago apartment. Jodee was very responsive and flexible. Our family with a toddler & two dogs had an amazing time! They have so many toys that delighted our toddler and the beds were super comfortable. The neighborhood is very cute and there’s a ton of accessible food. I highly recommend this stay for a family!!

Loved our five-night stay! The penthouse was as advertised, clean, and comfortable. Being able to see Lake Michigan from the window was a huge plus, and we walked everywhere for shopping and sightseeing. We had a wonderful time and would definitely return.

Our stay was wonderful! The place was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The space was comfortable, organized, and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. They were also responsive to our queries.
The place was great! Perfect location in Andersonville. Highly recommend

I enjoyed my stay here and at first was concerned about the train noise. It wasn’t as bad as some of the reviews attached to this unit.
The benefit of being close and having access to 3 main L train lines out ways the noise for me. The unit is on the ground floor and easy to get to. Lovely, safe neighborhood and the unit had nice furniture, well designed. Matches the photos.
I would definitely stay here again. Value is great and worth a try!
Wonderful host, wonderful apartment, great location, excellent communication. Thanks Terry!

Our stay was very nice. The location was in an area without many listings or hotels so it allowed for a very convenient and reliable option for us as we moved our son into his new apartment not too far away.  The owner was incredibly responsive and the unit was very clean and secure.
Very nice and cozy space in a good neighborhood. The wife and i had a wonderful stay, highly recommend!

We loved staying at Celiane’s place during our time in Chicago! It’s a really lovely neighbourhood where we enjoyed just walking around with our family. Felt very safe, with a lot to do within walking distance with our 4 year old. The place itself also has plenty of charm and everything you need for a stay with young family. Would definitely stay here again.
Great location and space!

Super nice location, has washer and dryer although they had no detergent for us. Pretty clean. You do have to keep in mind if you are staying over the weekend you can’t park in the front of the building you do have to pay an extra fee to park somewhere nearby. Other than that it was a very nice place and I would recommend if you are having a quick vacation!
We stayed five weeks in Tasha’s place and everything was great. We chose it because of close proximity to our family and it fit our needs perfectly.
Great place to stay. Thomas had great recommendations and the apartment was comfortable. Street parking was extremely easy even late at night.

Un logement très fonctionnel et spacieux Idéal pour un couple. Proche de Blue Line. Robert a été reactif pour répondre à nos messages avec beaucoup de gentillesse. Des gestes d'accueil comme des bouteilles d'eau dans le réfrigérateur et pleins de petits détails si importants. Nous recommandons chaleureusement Robert et son appartement. Corinne et Philippe from France
Great location and communication!
Very nice place to stay. Near subway station,. Clean and confortable. Had all that we needed and more. Felt safe to walk around the neighborhood. Overal recommended and we would definitely come back.
Great stay, very clear instructions on how to find the location and where to park!

Mario’s place is incredible! He was extremely friendly and accommodating. The apartment was amazing with high end furnishings, appliances and kitchenware. The neighborhood is family-friendly with many walkable restaurants and bodegas. 4-5 miles from all of Chicago’s top attractions. Stop scrolling and rent this place immediately! You won’t be disappointed!
We really enjoyed our stay in Chicago. Colin was a great host, very responsive and helpful. The place was just as described and had plenty of room for 3 adults!
Great stay I didn’t have to uber a lot because the train station was a walkable distance. Everything was clean and welcoming, and I felt right at home. Thanks for the amazing stay.

My family stayed here for a few days during our trip to Chicago. Jed was a great host - very communicative and friendly.  Location was perfect. Lots of fun family stuff to do! Apartment was a perfect fit for our trip.
Had an excellent stay, reception was always so helpful and had a lovely view. The room cleaners also did a very good job
Great location and price! Brian is a great host who is very friendly and communicative. I would definitely book again!
Always a great place to stay!

This place was close to Lake, restaurants, Wrigley field and Lakeshore Drive. No street parking but the place sits right on corner and easy to unload and unload luggage etc.   There is a parking garage about a 7 minute walk.

Staying here was perfect for us. The kitchen had pots and pans for cooking and plenty of linens. Stephanie was responsive when we ran into a few bumps and fixed everything as quickly as possible. The location is great and the view is incredible. We enjoyed the basketball courts and pool in the building. Overall, we would definitely stay here again.
Such a great place! Location was fantastic, hosts were super responsive. It was well stocked - we’ll be back soon!

Great location in a beautiful, walkable neighborhood. There are plenty of excellent restaurants, cafés, and things to do within walking distance, making it easy to explore the area. I really enjoyed my stay and would recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient and pleasant place to stay in Chicago.
Very quiet. Perfect for solo travelers. Felt safe

My experience was amazing. Check in and check out we’re both super simple. Fernando is amazing at communicating. The space was clean and spacious within a couple blocks of the blue line. Would definitely stay here again when I visit Chicago!

A little smaller than we anticipated, but still comfortable for the six of us. We cooked breakfast each morning and kitchen very adequate and easy to use. Good restaurants within walking distance. Furniture comfy. Would make a return visit.

Michael's place is quiet, comfortable and in a great neighborhood of Lincoln Park. It's very convenient and the street is a beautiful stroll. He's incredibly responsive to all our requests and questions and we love staying at his place - it's our third time!
The host is very responsive and helpful. The neighborhood is safe and super walkable - close to the bus and cute neighborhoods and only a 10 min walk to the train. Can’t beat the price!

David was an absolutely wonderful host! He went above and beyond, accommodating all of my needs and requests and was super responsive and lovely. I stayed for 4 weeks and had everything I needed for a comfy stay. Especially in the kitchen! I cooked the whole time I was there and the kitchen has everything you need. It’s a nice, quiet neighborhood with lots to walk to. And it’s conveniently located near both trains (the L & Metra). I appreciated all of the details and quirks of the apartment and the work that went into the local recommendations binder. The bed is extremely comfortable, which is rare nowadays. And a huge closet (also rare!). The smart TV’s have every streaming platform you need, and it was so nice to have a tv in the bedroom! I had a great stay.

The place was comfortable, clean and as per description. Rachel was a great host. Very attentive, cooperative and helpful. She bought us some groceries upon requesting in advance as we were coming late at night. Thanks for everything.
Worked out great!
Such a beautiful home! Neighborhood was quiet no disturbances. Will book again

Jhon was an amazing host. Extremely communicative, proactive, and helpful.
An apartment like this can normally be hard to find the keys, check in, etc but Jhon had a video with all the info sent before I could even ask. They were also very knowledgeable of the area and had great food & drink recommendations.
Thanks, Jose!
Nice home. 35 minute train ride to downtown. located in a calm and quiet neighborhood.

The place is well-kept and looks exactly like the pictures. The host is very helpful, responsive and easy to communicate with. Having parking available on the premises is a great convenience and the in-unit laundry is an added bonus.
The surroundings are safe and the location is convenient and peaceful. It’s about a 30–35 minute drive from the airport and approximately 30–40 minutes from downtown. The Red Line train station is also nearby, making transportation easy. Lake Michigan is just a 15-minute walk away, which is a wonderful advantage.
I would highly recommend this unit, especially for a long-term stay.

Es muy buena anfitriona, clara, rápida y amable. Explica muy bien y ayuda en todo lo necesario. El lugar está muy bien conectado con autobús a unos pasos y a metro muy cerca.
Muy limpio, todo muy bien acomodado y ordenado.
Estuvimos en habitación con baño igualmente todo súper bien. Tiene aire acondicionado el departamento por lo que en verano está súper fresco agradable. Hay que subir dos pisos, considerar si llevas maleta pero muy seguro todo y cálido. Todo limpio, bonito y ordenado. Me sentí segura y tranquila.

This sweet little spot was such a gem! Very clean with a functional and trendy design. The unit was quite walkable, with a number of yummy restaurants and cool shops within a .5 mile radius. We never had trouble finding street parking. The hot water got HOT, so a note to those traveling with young children to monitor handwashing. Overall, I’d happily stay here again.
Was a  cozy stay in Irving park. Very clean and had everything we need. Great accommodations for a great price

Great place! Beca and Robert were kind, responsive, and very attentive to our messages. Great location and walkable to restaurants, coffee shops, and the Fullerton stop for the L. Being right next to the train created an awesome vibe and noise wasn’t an issue at all. Would definitely recommend it and stay again!

The place looks just like the pictures.  The view is great.  Location is good with easy access to restaurants, grocery stores, lake, train to downtown, and close to UChicago. Jorge was, in general, very responsive. However, the place had a very strong cigarette/weed smell.  They tried to mask it with multiple air freshener plugins in the small space, but it resulted in an overwhelming cigarette plus potpourri smell. Opening the windows helped a little, but it was very hot and there were large spiders waiting to come inside. If it wasn't for the smell, the place would have been wonderful.

Great stay again at Austin’s. Comfortable, love the heated bathroom floors. Very walkable to public transportation and most important to us, our grandson. Austin responds quickly, very friendly. We enjoyed our stay.
We loved our time here! Beautiful, clean space with great art. Super conveniently located to shops, restaurants, parks, and the train. Would highly recommend!
Very nice and clean home.
Nice place convenient location.
Amazing location away of DT traffic!
Had a wonderful long-term stay here! Keep in mind that it's an old building, so it'll have some quirks to it, but I found these to be minor. Overall, I had a lovely time!
Our stay was wonderful, and the host was great. All around is was a great experience, and we cannot wait to come again!
Responsive host and this place has all that you need o feel at home

Great location , beautiful apartment , responsive hosting company but a gym directly below the apartment that’s open very early and all day. We heard and felt it any time a heavy free weight was dropped.

Jades place was amazing!
Right beside the blue line which brings you directly into the city.
The house fit the 5 of us perfectly.
All the amenities were super there was one of everything, the air fryer and hair dryer really saved us!
Jade was so kind and responsive to every single thing, I cannot recommend enough.
Comfortable space, with plenty of space for 4. Nice quiet location.
Looked exactly like the pictures and had everything that was expected. Way bigger than expected as well! Very clean with beautiful bathrooms and kitchen. A great stay in Chicago for the right price.

The place was very clean and nice, I was surprised when it looked better and more spacious then the photos. The location was also nice, not far from the metro and the downtown, the neighbourhood felt safe as well. A couple things that bothered me was that you get check in instructions a couple of minutes after the check in time and not even a minute before; also the host should look into the fire alarm system, because it went off every single time when you use the oven and open it, even though there is no smoke and you just want to put your food into the oven.
Overall, I was happy with the apartment and host.

Abel was a fantastic host! Very friendly and responsive. He answered all of my questions promptly and was very helpful. Super close to DePaul University with tons of restaurants and shops to walk to and easy to get to the Fullerton CTA stop. Plenty of towels and the washer & dryer was great after spending a week there. He included hand soap, shampoo and conditioner, and a hair dryer, which were helpful!

El alojamiento es muy amplio, bonito, cómodo y lo encontramos impecable. La ubicación es conveniente, en un barrio tranquilo y a solo 10 minutos caminando del metro. Los anfitriones fueron muy amables, accesibles y atentos en todo momento.
​Durante nuestra estancia tuvimos un inconveniente: hubo un problema de plomería en las habitaciones del sótano que provocó la salida de agua sucia con mal olor, lo cual tuvimos que limpiar nosotros.
Sin embargo, quiero destacar que en cuanto nos pusimos de acuerdo con los anfitriones, lo solucionaron rápidamente. A pesar de ese imprevisto, la atención fue excelente y el lugar vale la pena.
I loved this airbnb! The location was so convenient and a beautiful home!! Loved it so much would definitely come visit again!

Very clean and quiet neighborhood, great for a couple of days in town. It's a far walk from the Blue Line if you're looking for the subway; the bus is close if you need it.
It was very clean and comfortable, perfect for me to work and relax.
The hosts were both very friendly and accommodating. Felt like I was staying with family! Felt right at home and had a stress free experience!
Good place to stay 20 min from downtown and close to a CTA train line. We liked it.
Perfect apartment for a few days in Chicago
We enjoyed our stay and everything worked out well. Lots of living, dining, and cooking space. Good location for getting around.
Had a nice stay. Cute apartment and walkable location!

EXCELENTE LUGAR, MUY TRANQUILO Y BONITO, SE AJUSTÓ A LO QUE ESTABAMOS BUSCANDO, TENIA TODO LO QUE NECESITABAMOS, LA ZONA ES BASTANTE TRANQUILA, SE SIENTE MUY SEGURO, SIN DUDA MUY RECOMENDABLE. MUCHAS GRACIAS

The street entrance down the steps is a little sketchy but doable even for a 60 year old. Parking is not an easy task given that the free parking was generally full while we were there. The bed was comfortable and it was quiet at night. The bathroom was clean. The floors are somewhat rough concrete but not bad. If you want views there are not any to be seen from the apartment. For us this was a place to sleep and it was good for that.
The place was as advertised. The host was super responsive and proactive with everything would definitely stay here again.
studio located in a great location
Spacious and nice. Would recommend

Incredible place if ur a baseball fan
Walk out and Wrigleyville is right there
Parking and check in was super easy

This was a great place in a great location. The neighborhood is really nice, has a lot of character and is full of restaurants to explore. The blue line train station is also nearby, so it is very easy to get downtown quickly.
The only small disadvantage is that there is not much sound insulation between the apartments, so you may hear people in the neighboring unit if they are a little noisy. Apart from that, everything was nice and cozy, and I enjoyed my stay.
Apartment was as described and had an excellent location. Watch the videos they send for easy access to the apartment and building. Responsive hosts, highly recommend!

I stayed here for Lollapalooza and it was a convenient area for the trains to take me anywhere . Loved the box of tea bags available for drinking .
This is located right next to train tracks so you could hear the trains go by but it definitely was the full Chicago experience. I wouldn’t mind staying here again !
I stayed 10 nights and it was great! I have no complaints.
Jacques was a great host. This is a beautiful place in a fantastic neighborhood. Highly recommend!
Nice home, location and host. Would love to stay again!
