We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. We really enjoyed our time here and appreciated all the thoughtful touches. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area and would happily stay here again!

My wife, friends and I, loved staying here. Very convenient location with the nearest metro station only being a 5 minute walk. Tony’s home was spotless when we arrive, everything was nicely organized and there were even complimentary items. Washing machine is small but did a great job nonetheless. I would definitely stay here again. Felt extra safe with all the security. My review doesn’t do this place justice, I do really recommend staying here.
Great place and exactly what we needed!
Great place A++
Judy was a great host. She made me feel like home. Her house is beautiful and comfortable. She is so kind and nice! If I ever come back to Chicago I'll definitely stay at Judy's!

We were in town for our daughter’s graduation from Navy Bootcamp and it was a 5-star stay from start to finish. The home was beautiful, spacious, and thoughtfully decorated, with five bedrooms featuring king-size beds and large flatscreen TVs in every room, 3.5 bathrooms, gaming areas, PlayStation 5, a chess set, etc, high ceilings, beautiful chandelier over the table,, and great outdoor decks. The location was also very nice, and even the neighbor was kind enough to let us use the grill. Eduardo and Kevin were excellent hosts—responsive, accommodating, and very flexible throughout our stay. Our family had an amazing time, and we would absolutely stay here again. Thank you for giving our family a wonderful experience as we celebrated our daughter’s life changing accomplishment! We highly recommend this property and would stay again!
We all had an amazing time. Great access to transit and comfortable space couldn’t ask for more.

We very much enjoyed our stay! Having three full bathrooms was a huge plus for our group, as many Airbnb homes this size only have one or two. The home was very spacious, clean, and comfortable. The master bedroom was huge, with a walk-in closet and a wonderful soaking tub that we really enjoyed. Street parking was easy to find, and the neighborhood was very quiet. The location was excellent, with an easy walk to great pizza, ice cream, amazing coffee, and other nearby restaurants and shops. We didn’t spend much time inside because we were out exploring Chicago, but the home was beautiful and a wonderful place to come back to each day. Sharleen was very responsive, and I truly enjoyed our communication throughout our stay. She made you feel like you were talking with a friend. Thank you for your hospitality!

Very clean and instructions were on point.  There was a file folder that was very detailed and broke the city down into sections with things to do and places to see and food that they recommended.  All in all it was a great place to stay that met all of our needs.
Nice, clean, and quiet

Our stay was fantastic! The home was beautiful, clean, and had plenty of space for our entire family to relax comfortably. Everything was well maintained and made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived.
The amenities were excellent and very useful throughout our stay. It was clear that a lot of thought had gone into making guests feel comfortable.
The hosts were wonderful! Communication was quick, friendly, and incredibly helpful whenever we had a question. Their kindness and responsiveness made the experience even better.
We also loved the location! There were so many great restaurants, stores, and attractions within walking distance or just a quick drive or Uber ride away. We had an amazing time exploring Chicago.
There wasn’t a single thing we would change. If we could give this Airbnb 10 stars, we absolutely would! We highly recommend it and would gladly stay here again.
Great place to stay in! Close to bus shop and grocery store. The street is quiet and beautiful.

Gustavo’s perfect for my 3 teenage sons- my middle kid said it’s his favorite Airbnb thus far. Beautiful home with lots of amenities.
We loved the area. Lots of places to eat for the family- lots of shopping/thrifting for mom!
Mera was an amazing host and was very attentive to our every need! From the start, she was very friendly and helped us through every step of the process! The apartment itself was very nice and clean.

Perfecto ! Hermoso departamento cómodo y espacioso. Katty fue muy amable siempre y respondió en todo momento. En la cocina puedes encontrar de todo si planeas cocinar en casa! Es muy fácil el acceso al departamento y para estacionar en todo momento encontramos puesto disponible
Sólo que si sería buena idea que pusieran un wifi dentro del departamento, de resto todo funciona perfectamente!

Due to a flight cancellation, only stayed one of three nights but the apartment is excellent—super clean, spacious and comfortable. I used the upstairs bedroom which had a great firmer mattress.
Seemed to be a very good option for larger parties with the 3BR/3A.
The neighborhood, Ukrainian Village, has lots of charm and was quiet.
Wonderful area, lovely apartment!
No issues, great stay
Good location for our needs during this visit. Lots of space.
Great place to stay, it has everything you need and in a great location in the city but still peaceful
Good location, nice neighborhood with lots of restaurants and bars close. The unit is not ideal for persons over 6 feet tall.

Unit is very well equipped (hair dryer, iron, salt and pepper, etc).  Location is close to University of Chicago and there were restaurants and a Target close by. Neighborhood was quiet and felt safe. We found on street parking without a problem. Host responds very quickly to questions. Everything was clean and very comfortable. We had a great stay

This place is minimum one hour distance from the Illinois Medical District! Mostly, it takes more than an hour! Close to the U of Chicago, and Promontory point!
You need to take a bus for going to the grocery store!
I had some trouble to get inside first time after arrival as intructions was not clear go get inside! Additionally, they changed the access code for the front door and did not let me know!
Lucas is very responsive and friendly,I appreciate that so much, although I had some issues while living there. I needed to have had a communication with the maintenance however it was unable! So the response from them was very delayed and waiting for them was very stresfull!
Be aware that mailboxes are inside the building and if you wait for the important document you need your name to be displayed on the mailbox!
One more inconvenience, the conditioning system is very noisy and can cause some discomfort!
Otherwise, living in this apartment is nice experience!
So cute and homey. Pictures don’t serve this place justice. Check in was easy and street parking was easy to find. We will definitely be looking to stay here again when we come back to Chicago.

We enjoyed staying at Bart’s apartment during our trip to Chicago. The location was in a great neighborhood close to restaurants and stores as well as beautiful tree-lined streets. We had no problem parking our car on the street right outside. The apartment was spacious, clean, newly renovated, bright, and comfortable. We appreciated having three bathrooms. Check-in and check-out were very easy. I highly recommend it!

My family and I were in town for a few nights and this was an affordable, convenient location. Perfect size for the three of us, close to transit and very quiet. The guest house is small, but met our needs perfectly and we had no complaints. We were able to walk to a CTA station each morning (about 10 minutes), though a bus stop is just at the end of the block and we could have gotten there quicker had we just waited on a bus. Would highly recommend this place for couples or a small family who don’t mind using transit into Chicago. Would stay here again!
El apartamento está muy limpio y muy buena ubicación.
Great place with lots of space to stay! A perfect place to start exploring Chicago, or stay with a lot of friends.
The stay was very comfortable!
Super easy location close to train and near downtown . Loved the beautiful light inside the space . Host was super nice ! Will stay again !

Mia’s communication was effective, quick, and proactive. She was always responsive and proactively provided all of the necessary information we needed for our stay. The home is older so has that older home charm. The reason for docking two stars is that it was quite dirty when we arrived. The surfaces were mostly clean, but the walls and doors and likely years of grime and dirt on it. There was a noticeable odor that was hard to pinpoint. I tried to deal but she checked in and I messaged Mia. She offered many things to remedy this which is why I am giving 3 stars instead of 1. She had her cleaning crew come in 2 days into our stay. they washed walls and doors. The odor was much better after. It was hard to feel comfortable after the initial state. Flagging for those w young kids, there is a cut out in the wall at the landing near the stairs that could be hazardous and dangerous to young ones who don’t know their limitations. I appreciate all that Mia did to remedy the initial state.
Nice convenient stay to metro and Wrigley.
We loved our stay! Alma was very welcoming and helpful. The place was beautiful and we would definitely book again. Thanks!

The welcome sign hits right away. The boho styling and tasteful and efficiency of space utilization, tasteful art, says relax and enjoy your time.
It's hard to find a comfortable bed but it's here. Very clean and modern bedrooms and bathrooms. Great appliances and very adequate amenities that are identical to the ad.
Many gardens in the area. I started one on the terrace that flourished. And their clear communication and hospitality are so appreciated. I cook a lot. And the stove is perfect. French door fridge kept my produce through the recent 100°+ heat index that in spite of AC was too humid for fruit and bread.
I really loved my stay and hosts.

Great price, the host was amazing and had lots of recommendations. The neighborhood wasn’t sketchy, just old. It’s a super convenient location to see the best of Chicago, the host was responsive to all my questions as well.

Great location in Logan Square — an easy walk to the L and restaurants.  Reinaldo was responsive and offered tons of local recommendations, several of which we enjoyed. Got a kick out of the original Nintendo games.

Joe and his wife are an amazing host. They were very communicative and were really helpful. The place was really clean and quiet. The bed is really comfortable. The house is walking distance from the CTA line which made everything a lot easier. If you need food recommendations, Joe has a lot to offer and THEY ARE SOOOO GOOD.
Bien.
It’s spacious, quiet, and in an unbeatable location …you can literally see wrigley field from the front door. Great communication with the hosts. 5 stars all around.
This was a lovely place to stay for a couple months. Very comfortable and clean. Mona was very responsive. I definitely recommend!

The location of the Airbnb was perfect for what I needed.  I was able visit where I needed to and public transportation was close by for that. There is a gate into the courtyard that made it feel more safe.  I think the price might have been a little high because there was a big concert going on of which I was not a part.  It was very difficult entering the first time as not all of the locks worked. Fortunately Rida was available to help me get through via text conversations.  It was a nice, clean apt.

My partner and I really enjoyed staying at John's place. The neighborhood is peaceful and was right by a lot of great restaurants, shops, and easy access to the Red Line to go to and from downtown. The house was quiet and clean and our room was comfortable. Overall it was a great option for us.

This house is amazing! Very walkable even with a 5 year old (in a stroller) - we walked to the Lincoln Park Zoo and the beach at Lake Michigan. Public transportation is a just short walk and it was very easy to get downtown using Chicago's buses and trains. It was great to be able to park our car in a garage and leave it there for our stay. Street parking is very busy so having garage access was extremely convenient.
Pawan was very responsive to my family's questions. He was a fantastic host and the house was exactly as described. We would definitely stay here again and you should too!
Nice apartment in a good neighborhood with many restaurants nearby. There was plenty of parking on the street in front of the apartment. I would stay there again.

Frida’s Flat was one of the best Air BnB I have stayed in, hands down. The apartment was adorably furnished with games, records, and absolutely everything you might need when staying somewhere away from home. Everything was thoughtfully provided from toothbrushes if you forgot yours, to Tums If you had deep dish Chicago pizza and are over 40 lol. Erica was responsive and went the extra mile! I will definitely be coming back to stay next time we visit Chicago!
I would give Zen’s place 6 stars if available!  She is a very gracious and thoughtful hostess. Her home is beautiful and immaculate.  Bravo!!!
Really nice spot, close to everything. Felt at home.
Convenient location and very clean!
Overall our stay here was very good. It is a very practical place to stay. The location is great. The host is very responsive.

This place was truly so convenient! Margaret was very helpful. The place is so close to downtown, you could walk the neighborhood and we definitely took advantage of the large bathtub! The only downside was the number of spiders we noticed inside. It wasn’t a huge deal, but it did make parts of the stay a bit uncomfortable. Would definitely book again!

Great place. It’s bigger and spacious than it looks on picture. There is a playground a block away which was a plus with the kids. Having a parking place was helpful and we kept driving near place we wanted to visit using the SpotHero app.

Katherine was a great host— always super responsive, accommodating, and attempting to make our stay wonderful. Everything was clean and in great condition. My only complaint is the host does not explicitly mention that this rental unit is in the basement in her description. While there is some natural light, it is from windows that outlook between street level and slightly below street level. Given that it was in the basement, loud footsteps could be heard from up above that were disruptive at times. However, despite all of this, I would still book this place again and it was truly amazing, just wished the floor level was more transparent in the description.

This was first visit to Chicago, and this stay made my trip more memorable. Thr local area offered everything you need within walking distance and the space was just perfect. I wpuld definitely stay here again in the future.

Great hosts!  They were very responsive to any questions.  I unknowingly happened to visit during lollapalooza, and they were very proactive in reaching out about the added traffic and security regarding the event.  It's one thing to be responsive, but anticipating is a whole other level of hosting.  10/10 would recommend to anyone!
We had a great stay. There was enough room for everyone and all the bathrooms were well equipped, clean, and thoughtfully designed.
Great place with a lot of character. Adam was very easy to work with and very responsive. Would definitely stay here again.

My experience starting here was beautiful. Justin was such a great host as he was very responsive whenever I had questions. The Bnb being so close to the metro station really helped as well as everything was walkable and saved a lot of gas. Although the train was right next to the stay it was great! I have no bad words to say about this stay!
Great location & space- we enjoyed it!
Nice place!
Cute place great location

Hemos estado súper bien. Apartamento muy cómodo, fiel a las fotos, y la zona insuperable. Barrio bonito y tranquilo. No llegamos a usar el transporte público y lo hicimos con Uber con un precio muy asequible para desplazarte al centro de Chicago.
Todos los electrodomésticos y el aire acondicionado funcionan perfectamente.
Zona muy fácil para aparcar
Muchas gracias
Location was great. Very cute and would stay again!

Space: 10/10
Clean, comfortable (especially that couch), spacious, prime location, walkable, actually felt like a home unlike a lot of Airbnb properties.
Host: 10/10
Friendly, welcoming, kind, super cool, easy to reach and communicate with. He is also VERY accommodating. You can tell he takes great pride in his space.
The experience was seamless and made for a great trip to Chicago. Would recommend this place to anyone visiting and I’d for sure stay here again. Another thing I really appreciate is the fact that everything felt very chill and fair. Some hosts go way too far with what they expect from guests. Rules/expectations were very clear and outlined thoroughly without feeling too demanding.

I stayed at Raymond's  apartment in Old Town during my visit to Chicago. It was great. It was just as the listing, very charming, very clean and neat. The neighborhood is beautiful, and very walkable, this was a big plus for me. Old Town is nearby Lincoln Park neighborhood, which is also a very walkable area. Both areas offer a good selection of restaurants. During my stay, Raymond and or his wife would write and check in to see if everything was going well with my stay. Though everything was basically perfect for me, I really appreciated that they did this, they seemed genuinely concerned that all was going well with my stay. I'd definitely stay there again. If you prefer a warm neighborhood feeling, walkable, a nice selection of restaurants, yet not far very far from the downtown area and tourist attractions, Raymond's place is perfect for you, it was for me.

I have stayed in Chicago multiple times, but this particular visit stood out to me due to the amazing hospitality that was shown through the hosts, especially one in particular named Jaiva. Jaiva greeted my family upon arrival and did a quick walk-through of the place and made sure to answer any of our questions. The pictures do not do this place any justice because once you see it in person, it is absolutely stunning. Do not let being in the basement fool you. My family and I felt very safe with the many layers of security even before we got into our Airbnb. We did not cook during our stay, but the fridge was used to store our leftovers. There were plenty of towels for my family. Although we were present during one of the most busiest times due to an event happening in downtown, we were always able to reach downtown through Lyft in about 20 to 25 minutes while in heavy traffic. We are grateful for the accommodations that were made for us and we hope to visit again.
Place was great was definitely nicer then expected only downside is not having weekends but would definitely come here again for another trip
great stay!!

This is a great house for a family or friend group traveling together. In our case, my daughter, her husband, and my 4 GBabies stayed in the upstairs bedrooms. My husband and I stayed in the well lit basement family room on the large foldout coach with a bathroom. We had room to stretch out and the kids had room to play.
The location is great because within 15 minutes of walking there’s the beach, restaurants, grocery stores, drug store, train station, and there’s a playground right across the street. We didn’t need a car while staying here.
The kitchen is very functional, and the bathrooms are spotless. The bed linens are soft and cozy. The house is well furnished and comfortable without being shabby. There’s also small color and noise devices in each bedroom in case you need sound to fall asleep. Amazing location on a quiet street, but still close to so many things. Loved being able to take our dogs to Lincoln Park and our kiddos to the zoo. They also loved watching movies in the mini-theater basement.

Perfect! Clean, communicative, great location. Thank you!
Had everything we needed with easy check-in and check-out process. Thank you!

This condo was as described. Cool restaurants are within walking distance. About a 15 -20 minute Uber ride from a lot of attractions, like Navy Pier, Field Museum, and many others. It was quiet at night. My family enjoyed our experience.

Was great!!!

Absolutely loved this place. Jihad and Jenna definitely have a skill for decor and hospitality. Every “special” touch they could do - they did! Highly recommend staying here! Katty is an excellent host and would stay here again when we’re back. Thank you!!
A great stay in Rogers Park at a fantastic apartment on a lovely road. The apartment had all we needed to enjoy our time in Chicago. We’d highly recommend and would definitely stay again. Many thanks

We booked Melissa's place for a month for our newborn's grandparents to take turns staying at while they were in town to visit and help out.

Great spot!

Great place to stay, near the train and location is just beautiful! No problems for me the whole week I was there. Had everything I needed and more!

Family home with style. Good parking. Outside space a plus. Kitchen usable with staples provided.

Lucero's place was very clean, newly renovated and furnished decently. She herself was friendly and helpful in her tour, though in Spanish. The location is quiet and not centrally located, but fine if it fits your needs.
Nice local place to stay near University of Chicago. 5 miles from White Sox stadium.
This is our 5th time in 2yrs visiting Chicago and we always have made Thomas and Cynthia's place our primary place to stay. It always feels like a home away from home.
Outstanding hostess! Would give Beatrice 10 stars! Very comfortable and easy to feel right at home! Thank you for a great weekend!
Clean place with plenty of space for a small family. Walkable to some shops and restaurants as well as transit. Neighborhood felt safe and friendly and the garage parking was a great perk.

Really enjoyed my stay. Very clean and convenient location. Will definitely be looking for this place next time i visit the Chicago area!
nice host!

Nice area, and the host was super nice and helpful throughout our stay. only thing was the wifi was iffy but overall, I had a wonderful time

I would def recommend this place for a couple or a solo traveler . Location is great close to everything . As far as apt being on top of a bar . It didn’t bother me one bit . I slept great the bed is very comfortable.
Great place and location. Easy parking. Perfect spot for a Chicago visit

Très bel appartement, très bien situé au calme et en même temps très proche du centre et du métro. Chicago est une ville magnifique, je recommande les 2 !

Place was nice and fit our needs. Ann was very helpful and got us permits on the same day when we found out we had a car the whole stay. You can hear the people upstairs walking but it was fine to us. Overall, a very nice and enjoyable stay!
Another memorable stay at Ryans after 10 years. Feeling at home in such a place is a wonderful experience on itself.

The place was very likable. The place was nicely decorated and had a well equipped kitchen if you want to cook while staying there. The host was very responsive with any questions. I would recommend this place as long as you are able to manage the stairs.
Nice and clean place. Exactly how it is presented. Owner was nice as well. Checked in during stay to make sure I was accommodated.
Teresa’s place was perfect for our stay in Chicago. Close to everything and walkable to restaurants, etc. Would definitely stay again.

Great places to stay put us right where we needed to be

I enjoyed staying at Matthew's place. Great location, and plenty to do. And if you like video games, this is the place for you!

Super responsive and very helpful with making sure we had resources for storing our bikes.

The washing machine didn't work, and I later learned the cleaners had already reported it before our stay. The cleaners said it had not worked for well over a month. A broken appliance can happen, but renting a property with known issues, ignoring guests, and leaving safety hazards unaddressed is unacceptable and dishonest.

The area was peaceful and we enjoyed our stay.

Ryan is a great host! He is very responsive and accommodating. This is a great location for walking around the neighborhoods. Very convenient to the brown line train and also several nearby bus stops.

Great host, nice place!
Phenomenal place. Absolutely our favorite place we’ve ever stayed. Highly highly recommend!

Spacious for our group of 5.  Appreciate being able to bring our dog,  and for the garage parking.  Kitchen supplies were limited for those planning to cook,  but overall a comfortable stay.

Amazing location with easy access to the coast, public transportation, night life, and food. Really peaceful area. Iris was an amazing host and really really quick and responsive. Even went out of her way to make suggestions on where to visit in Chicago. Amazing experience.
Very responsive and sweet host! close to lots of great food options and within walking distance of a lot to do

The loft is in a nice and quiet neighborhood that is very close to public transit. It was very clean and private.

the place was great! it was a perfect area and very comfortable sleeping arrangements! if i’m ever in the area i’d love to stay again!

Thanks so much for the stay!

We now have a place to come back to on our next visit.

Would easily stay again.
We had a nice stay. Took the bus everywhere we wanted to go. Apartment’s was living area is spacious, bedrooms are cozy.
A very cozy and homely place to stay! Gladys place was clean and the bed was so comfy! We loved the extra finishing touches, like the coffee machine, board games, mouth wash, and more. Thank you!

O prédio é antigo, mas a revitalização havida o deixou com ar mais moderno. Tivemos apenas um senão que impede darmos 5 estrelas. Contávamos com 2 banheiros, mas o da suíte estava entupido e a água ficou paralisada. Eles foram rápidos no reparo (no dia seguinte ao solicitado) mas no último dia, o outro banheiro apresentou o mesmo problema. Fora isso, a água demorava demais para esquentar. De resto, tudo funcionou muitíssimo bem e eu e minha família, que estávamos em férias, conseguimos fazer um excelente uso da unidade, considerando que ficávamos muito pouco nela, já que passávamos a maior parte do dia passeando por Chicago. My only thing was the check in instructions were a little complicated. They need more clear direction as there were 3 different codes and it wasn’t clear which code was for what door.
Overall, I would book again!
As usual...the stay was fine. Eric was quick to respond to questions.

The home was clean and had everything that we needed stocked. Our family of 5 stayed for 7 days. Our flight arrived early so I asked the host if we could check in a little early and she was accommodating. She was responsive when we had questions. The neighborhood seemed safe. There is a fire hydrant right out front so sometimes street parking was hard to find. About a 30 minute drive to downtown. We walked to the train one day to go downtown, it wasn't too far. Easy checkout. Thanks!

I happened to visit during Chinatown’s Summer Fest, which was a great bonus. Friendly host to share the space with, great communication, and a cool apartment with great decoration. Great shared space for the price—would definitely stay again!
I will absolutely stay here again when in Chicago. It is peaceful, meticulously clean, walking distance to Lake Michigan and a short ride to downtown.

Maria is a wonderful host, very thoughtful and kind. The place was beautiful and the perfect size for our family of 4. I recommend paying to park your car in a garage….ours was broken into while parked on the street in front of the house.

As someone who frequents Chicago, this was one of my all time favorite accommodations. I felt right at home. Everything was clean and welcoming. Parking is a breeze with provided permits. The king bed is insanely comfortable. I loved the patio area for sitting, and never once needed something that wasn’t provided. I look forward to staying again!
Great last minute stay. The location was everything and the accommodations were clean and stocked with all you might need.
Great location and clean condo!

The house and room was spotless, safe, and really comfortable, with everything we needed. It was also really close to the Blue Line, which made getting around easy. The host was great to deal with and always quick to reply if we had any questions. Check-in and check-out were nice and easy, and the whole stay was hassle free. We’d be more than happy to stay again and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it.

Great place to stay! The private room with lock on the door and en-suite bathroom make you feel like you have your own space. Location was perfect with two major bus lines and the blue line only a few minutes walk away. Check in and out were easy enough and Anny seemed very responsive and receptive to feedback. Would definitely stay again.
Janet is the biggest sweetheart. My band and I were on tour when we stayed here and she helped accommodate all of our needs. Would love to come back again and hopefully hang out next time!! xoxo

No black out blinds so you wake up at 5:45am every day and can’t get back to sleep, floorboards are creaky, the water pressure is horrible.
It is a budget place but just a few changes could help a lot
This is the definition of a studio experience, tucked away in a historical corner of Chicago. Very clean, very quiet, very easily accessed and simple.
Spacious, comfortable, and clean room. Great location. I enjoyed my stay and I would highly recommend!
It was a beautiful spot in Chicago, the parking was convenient and it felt so safe for two women to stay at. Bryan is a super helpful host and we hope to be back soon!

Everything was great, I would definitely stay again. The location was ideal, easily walkable to the L so I could attend the concert I was there for. The space itself felt quite large, had great design, and was surprisingly quiet for being in the city.

It was my first time in Chicago & I really wanted to stay in a “home” instead of a sterile hotel. This place was beautifully decorated & a lot of interesting art & decor to look at. The neighborhood is beautiful & quiet, a nice respite from the chaotic city ! Would highly recommend this place, I felt right at home!
Clean place in a safe area. No complaints. Would stay here again.
Great spot right in the middle of everything. Place is wonderful, lots of room to spread out.

Great neighborhood—loved being so close to coffee shops, restaurants, etc. The Airbnb itself looked exactly like the photos and came with all the usual amenities. We had an issue with the dryer and Justin came out and fixed it that day, which was really kind!
The one big issue is just the train noise. To be fair, the listing does mention the proximity to the train (it is *right* next to it!) and the Airbnb comes with noise machines in the bedrooms... but I was amazed by how loud it really was. The trains do stop running for a few hours overnight and the frequency slows down in the late evening/early morning, but it is jarring when they go by! So, just something to keep in mind if you are sensitive to noise.

I enjoyed a great stay and Nicole and Matt’s. The location was super walkable. I loved having the lakefront trail, shopping, and food nearby so I could enjoy it all without having to travel far. Transit options were plentiful for my commutes to other neighborhoods. The bed was super comfortable, the unit was quiet, and the roof deck was a nice treat.
Great place to stay. Numerous restaurants, bakeries, and shops within easy walking distance. Close to the Red line that provided quick access to most parts of the city without many transfers
The location is great! Short walk  to great shops and cafes.

Great, affordable & central location in Chicago! As others have mentioned (and Tim does too) it is very much next to the train - so it's worth noting in terms of noise & also physical vibration from the train passing. I felt that it was still worth it for the lovely space & great price, but ymmv. Thanks, Tim!

Very cute and comfortable place. Other reviews capture all the key points. I’ll just add that the bed was much more comfortable than I was expecting from the pictures! Definitely a convenient pace to stay if you’re going to McCormick Center.
Great location, convenient amenities!
His attendance was wonderful, and we truly appreciate it. My family had a comfortable stay, and we definitely plan to book the same apartment in the future.
The place was perfect but kinda in a sketchy neighborhood. Overall is worth it, Thank you Ariel.
A gem in a busy city! Ver quiet and peaceful with nice grassy areas. Easy to catch a bus. Place was comfortable and private. Would definitely stay again!

It was easy instruction to get into the building , apartment .
The apartment was cleaning - I loved there was two bathrooms, especially traveling with children- I would highly recommend, will be back for my next stay
Comfortable apartment in a great area.

Tucked into a quiet neighborhood, we felt right at home in Patrick’s place. It was clean, and had everything we needed for cooking. The bathroom also had everything we needed and was a great place to bath after a long day. Definitely recommend for anyone looking to stay in the area!

I had an amazing stay in Chicago at Nick’s Airbnb :)
Thank you so much for everything!
I had a lot of questions and Nick always had answers, plus I had lots of fun! He even gave me a slice of homemade pie. There’s really no way to beat that. I can’t promise everyone will get homemade pie, but I can promise you’ll have a great stay here.
Everything is exactly how you’d expect from looking at the photos and the area is so cute and walkable. I took the train everywhere and it was very convenient. The area is safe too.

I spent 10 days here and didn’t want to leave! Seriously, everything was top notch. The place was in a super convenient location. The kitchen was well stocked and easy to use. The work space was very comfortable and the Internet worked great. I would absolutely stay here again.
Clean shared space. No issues. Safe neighborhood.
All as described! Great place, highly recommend
great hosts - good communication.  Very responsive.  Nice details in the apartment made us feel at home.  Will definitely be back when next in Chicago
Besides the lack of elevator I enjoyed my stay!

I'm so grateful this stay was available just a few blocks from my home during a power and internet outage!  While I happen to be local, I would have loved this apartment for a travel stay, too.  The location is great, the apartment super comfortable (AC was on point!), and had wifi that could support my son streaming TV while I was in remote meetings.  I could not have been happier and highly recommend!

Unfortunately, I did not have a good experience and had to leave the apartment the same evening. I paid $300 for 2 nights and host didn't give me a refund even tough I didn't stay a single night there.
Shortly after arriving, a man attempted to open the apartment door without knocking. As a young woman, this was extremely concerning and made me feel unsafe. I contacted the host immediately but I never received a clear explanation about what happened. I was just told that she was speaking with building management and to “stay alert.”
On top of the safety concern, the AC was not working properly during an extremely hot day in Chicago. The small apartment became very hot and humid, making it uncomfortable to stay. I also found bugs in the bed, which was the final issue for me.
By around 9 pm, I decided I could not stay overnight and left the apartment. I informed the host that same evening and explained all of these concerns but she refused to give me a fair refund.
Perfect place to stay. Very walkable. Loved the feeling of the community here.

We throughly enjoyed the space and amenities of this home! It was perfect for the 4 of us and the dedicated laundry room was excellent for weary travelers. It was well appointed and we never needed to purchase anything during our stay! We look forward to returning.

We had a wonderful stay this past weekend! The home was exactly as described clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location was great and made it easy to get around Chicago. The host was responsive and made the entire check-in and check-out process seamless. We truly enjoyed our stay and would absolutely book this Airbnb again the next time we're in Chicago. Highly recommended!

Excellent location, great host, and a great room.
We had our 7-month old and had no problems with noise from the L. The room was comfortable and noticeably clean. Checkout was nice and simple, and the whole stay felt like exactly what AirBNB should be - right in the city with access to everything you could need, everything looked exactly like the photos, responsive host in case of questions, and nice amenities.

Milan was extremely responsive and friendly. We got a free upgrade to a suite, which was extremely generous! The accommodations were beautiful, clean, and fully stocked with what we needed. It was very quiet and private, and we never heard our neighbors. We were all extremely impressed and would definitely recommend and will stay again! Thank you, Milan!!!

This was definitely one of my favorite stays out of anywhere I’ve been so far! I’m sad that I couldn’t stay longer. The space is gorgeous and so thoughtfully equipped with anything you could need. The hosts were extremely nice, the space was super clean, and the area is quiet without being too far from restaurants or necessities. The complimentary parking is huge as well! Would love to come back!
Very nice neighborhood, restaurant within walking distance.

Overall was a great stay. Very clean and spacious room for it to be a studio apartment. Was nice to have a kitchen area and the WiFi worked well for a couple of remote work things that needed to be done. I will note the building has extraordinarily thin walls, basically you can hear anything being said in the neighboring apartment. Something to be mindful of if you book. Also they don’t share that there are like 6 steps you’ll have to lug your luggage up to get to the elevators which was quite annoying. A heads up would’ve been preferred.

We absolutely loved our stay in Lincoln Park! The location was perfect for our small family. We brought a toddler blow-up mattress, which worked out great since a queen bed is a little snug for the 3 of us ;)
The home was clean, beautifully decorated, and exactly as pictured. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Host was very kind, responsive, and kept in touch. The neighborhood felt very safe and was incredibly walkable...we loved being able to stroll to the zoo, coffee shops, great restaurants, and even grocery stores. Downtown was also just a quick 10-minute Uber ride away, super easy.
The only thing to note is that there are quite a few stairs to get into the building and then another flight downstairs to the bedroom. It wasn’t a big deal for us, but with lots of luggage, it was definitely a workout! Just something to keep in mind, as there are no elevators.
Overall, we had such a wonderful experience and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Super cute, nicely renovated garden apartment in an amazing location. We brought our 2 year old and the place was super well set up for her, and just really nicely appointed and cozy. The neighborhood is really nice and cute and we didn’t touch the car during our stay, with nice restaurants around and easily walkable to Lincoln Park and the lake.
We loved our stay! 2nd time here. Close to public transit. Quite area. Highly recommend.
Nice place ❤️
We enjoyed a lot staying here, everything we need was provided. Parking is in the garage in the back alley that fits our mini van without any issue, highly recommended this place.
Perfect location for our needs
Great spot to explore the city without having to drive! Accommodations were very nice and allowed multiple families to stay altogether.

Wonderful home, immaculately clean. Our family enjoyed our stay!
Our host knew that we would be arriving super late at night. We were so happy to see the porch lights were left on for us. What a welcome sight in a dark, unfamiliar neighborhood. As soon as we walked in we sensed how fresh and clean the space was. We also appreciated the plentifulness of towels! It’s certainly not always like that..
Host remained helpful and communicative throughout. Thank you Amir

Great host, great rental

Mary was a great host.
I needed a place near the airport, and it worked out well for me.
It was a great place to stay for our quick trip! I really loved the neighborhood.

The place was fine, not great. We have lived in Chicago and so the part of town was known to us, but not a very exciting location. It was ‘as described’ but don’t stay here if you are unfamiliar with Chicago and think you are walkable to the cool parts of the north end.
Also, had a strange ocurance our last night where our door code did not give us access after working fine for 3 days and we were standing on the street at midnight without a way to get in. Yollie did respond about 20 minutes later but it was quite an anxious few minutes for my wife and kids when you realize all your traveling possessions are on the other side of a door and you aren’t sure what to do on a strange street in downtown Chicago at midnight. She did eventually respond and gave us a new door code, which was weird, but never gave any explanation or apology for the inconvenience. For that reason alone: reduce one star from 4.5 to 3.5.
We had a nice stay, thank you!

The property was very clean and private, but several aspects of the stay felt unnecessarily restrictive. The listing identifies the area as Hyde Park, but the rental is actually in Woodlawn. When we asked to check in only 30 minutes to one hour early, the co-host resent the posted instructions with the 3:00 p.m. check-in time circled in red, which felt dismissive.
Basic supplies were limited: our bathroom had only part of a toilet paper roll with no replacement, and when the kitchen ran out of paper towels, we were told more would come the next day.
Kitchen use also felt closely monitored. I received a cleanup reminder while still cooking, and staff knocked on our partially open door to remind us to watch a pot even though we were nearby and attentive. We also noticed a strong marijuana odor one day, though we could not identify the source. On our final day, guests were doing hair in the shared kitchen, creating unsanitary conditions in a food-preparation area.
Cute place, VERY stylish, beautiful kitchen, cozy rooms, beautiful front windows, a few hiccups - you have to crawl over a person if you sleep 2 to a bed, the air conditioning is loud when it runs.
Fun location! I love the little store on the corner.
Clean, comfy, and great location.

If you want to be in a place that is quiet, yet in the city; has amazing views; has great amenities; and reminds you how amazing Chicago is, this is your place! Great coffee shop attached to lobby, easy walkable access to parking (water tower place - SpotHero). We walked to the beach and navy pier with ease and were 1.5 blocks from Michigan Avenue. The apartment was great & we had 3 18 year old boys and a 10 year old. With 6 people it didnt feel crowded at all. We easily walked everywhere from here. It was everyone's first trip to Chicago except me and I just cant tell you how much everyone loved this place. We loved the rooftop, the pool table on the 2nd floor lounge, & the boys loved the gym and went almost every evening of our trip. The beds were comfy and there were plenty of towels and extra blankets. The bathroom is a little tiny but thats just Chicago & the 6 of us had no issue.
You can't go wrong with this place and I would definitely book this place again if I return to CHI.
Great place along the Loop. I would definitely stay again.
Great place

Felt like home away from home for a few days. Heidi is so kind, and the cats are so cute!!
I wanted an authentic Chicagoan experience while in town for a conference, and this place nailed it. Its a real, cozy home, like staying with your family members. Very safe and welcoming. Buses and trains are super close by, and even walking to/from Mccormick Place was super easy. Really enjoyed my stay, and will be back!

We had a wonderful stay! Jonathan was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from start to finish. The check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow, so getting into the Airbnb was completely hassle-free. The location was also excellent—just a short walk to the Kimball train station, making it convenient to get around the city. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Mark's place is incredible and highly recommended! Hands down, the best AirBnb experience I've had in years. We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was in a great location, close to restaurants, transportation, and easy to get to. I stayed with my toddler and family, and the space was comfortable, spacious, and perfect for our group. The hosts were amazing and very responsive throughout our stay. I highly recommend this Airbnb!

A great place for a large group to stay in downtown Chicago.

Our family (including tweens and grandparents) had a wonderful and very comfortable stay! We thoroughly enjoyed the view of Lake Michigan (and glimpses of the beach) from the dining table and kitchen across various parts of the day. Wish we had a chance to use the pool/gym but they looked to be in good condition overall too. We also enjoyed the convenient location where we could take long or shorter walks along Gold Coast area and the Magnificent Mile (and even to the Walgreens a block away or the Whole Foods ~8 minute walk). The directions and guidance was clear, and for any questions we had, the hosts were very responsive and considerate. We’d be happy to stay again in the future!

The room was exactly as stated. Absolutely beautiful, clean and a fantastic location.  It is a very noisy area as it is right by the train but honestly did not bother me my nephew had a hard time sleeping due to the noise level.  The pool was nice however the sitting areas have seen better days. This is not a direct reflection of the host rather the building. The only complaint I have is the response time from the host is very delayed. The unit is new and the tv was not set up. I reached out the first night to inquire if there was something I was missing. She did not reach back out until 330 in the morning and at the time only responded that I was correct it was an oversight upon setting up the unit. I then asked at 830 in the morning if there was a way to get it set up so we could enjoy a show in the evening and she NEVER responded after acknowledging the tv was not set up.  I am aware that oversights happen however no response was very disappointing.  We stayed 2 nights for reference

Lovely place, full of amenities (shampoo, conditioner, towels provided) and kitchen with the essentials. Host was great and gave easy to understand instructions. Parking is tricky since it is street parking so definitely important to find your spot early or risk paying for parking somewhere else. There’s a lot near the house that’s free also.
Great price for the place and location.

This Airbnb was absolutely adorable! We loved the decor—it was charming, welcoming, and had so much character. The home was very spacious, the beds were comfortable, and the neighborhood was fantastic.
We traveled with our 9-year-old son, and it was great to have three parks within walking distance. It made the location even more enjoyable for our family.
The trains can be fairly loud at night, but the host thoughtfully provides sound machines and earplugs, which definitely helped.
We shared a few suggestions with the host, and they were very receptive and are already taking them into consideration. The only other improvements we'd recommend would be adding more comfortable seating (especially the dining chairs) and having a larger dining table included rather than as an additional rental.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would happily stay here again!
Perfect place for our family vacation. Very safe location and the parking was a huge plus. Easy access to the metro station too. Highly recommended!

We had a quick trip to Chicago and really enjoyed our stay! The place was within walking distance of Fulton Market, with lots of great restaurants nearby and easy access to downtown. Bridget was always responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely stay here again!
It’s was perfect for our stay in the city! Thanks for having us!
Overall a great stay.!!! Would definitely recommend this place for other guest.!! Everything was exactly how it was described to us.

We had several issues during our stay. Check in instructions were incorrect and we were missing the key to get in the building. They are very responsive and helped us get inside in a timely matter. The front bedroom air conditioning unit wasn’t cooling. They came and repaired the second day. The photos didn’t show the window air conditioning units and look enhanced from what we actually got. Some cleanliness issues with the mirrors being really dirty in the bedroom and areas of peeling paint in the unit. Very spacious unit in an older dated building. The host was very accommodating to our issues and always responded when we needed assistance. Visited on weekdays during the summer. We were always able to find free street parking right outside the building. A few times we had to circle the block a few times but parking was not bad. While I had my personal issues with this unit, I think the price was reasonable for the area and for the amount of space you get.

Had a wonderful stay here! It was clean, comfortable, and perfectly located close to the arena. Darsh was great, he checked in to see if there was anything we needed. The price was also reasonable. Wish we could have stayed longer, would definitely stay here again!

Amazing stay at Stephanie's place in the very heart of downtown Chicago! Extremely close access to different lines on the L which makes for convenient access to anywhere in the city, and just a short walk from the River, Millenium Park, etc., etc. Would absolutely stay here again in a heartbeat when I'm back in Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, modern, and very well equipped. The location was excellent, making it easy to explore Chicago and get around the city.
The host was responsive, friendly, and provided clear instructions for check-in and throughout our stay. We were traveling as a family, and the space worked perfectly for our group.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again. We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago!

It was a great experience to live in Chicago downtown with family of 8 .  The place had amazing location , accessibility, Ben was very proactive and responsive . Overall we recommend this place for people coding Chicago !

It’s rare that an Airbnb is better than the photos and this home did not disappoint. It’s beautiful, spacious, clean and fully equipped with the necessary amenities. The location is excellent - walkable to great restaurants and a market. It was nice having all bedrooms on the same level. Liliana is an amazing host - proactive in her communications and responds quickly. Having a designated parking spot is a plus too. Five stars and more!
Loved the proximity to Millennium Park, check in easy, Natasha a wonderful host.
Séjour juste parfait dans l’appartement d Iris. Quartier calme, appartement confortable et propre, rien à dire on s’est régalé. On reviendra avec plaisir. Merci beaucoup.

We had such a great stay! The place was very clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Our kids loved having their own rooms and spaces to hang out, which made the trip so much easier for everyone.
We got rained out of our original outdoor plans, and the host was kind enough to accommodate an early check-in. We really appreciated the flexibility—it made a stressful day so much better.
The location was awesome, too. There were plenty of great restaurants and shops within walking distance, so we hardly had to drive once we got settled.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again the next time we’re in the area. Highly recommend!

Lydia and her cohost were communicative and flexible. The location is close to downtown Chicago and near public transit, and paying fraction of the cost for the stay. I appreciated the umbrella, slippers, and toiletries and the laundry machine made available. Even though it was shared bathroom/kitchen/living room, we did not bump into the other people staying at the Airbnb, which made it feel like we had the place to ourselves. Appreciate staying here!

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago visiting our adult daughter, the location was perfect and the condo met all of our needs. If you stay in this neighborhood you must eat at Spacca Napoli on Sunnyside Ave, what a wonderful meal!
Beautiful neighborhood with lots of good food options, easy access to brown line, plenty amenities, and everything you could need for your stay. Highly Recommend!
Rashad was a very good professional host. I would highly recommend his location.

Everything here exceeded my expectations.  Easy instructions and access inside.  It could not have been better.  I hope I can return next time I am in Chicago.  Wonderful home, neighborhood, amenities, and easy access.  Great host.  What more can this place offer?
One of my favorite places to stay!!! Always clean and easy to get settled!

The location for walking around was good and the beds were comfortable.
There were issues with noise from the nearby CTA train and inside from both A/C units. I contacted the host after sleeping very little the first night to please have someone come and check the A/C units to stop the loud, vibrating noise. In addition, the remote did not work as it needed new batteries and the bathroom door did not close properly. I was texted that batteries would be dropped off that day (Friday) and that maintenance would come by for the A/C and the bathroom door. The batteries never arrived and I was told to buy them and I would be reimbursed. I was there from Thursday afternoon until the following Wednesday morning and there was no follow-up on these issues. I again texted the night before we checked out to advise how disappointed I was that there was no follow-up. I was advised I would be given a nominal refund but the point is this has not been my experience with other hosts.
Great place

I have stayed in numerous Airbnbs across the US, Canada, Europe and Japan. This was the Four Seasons of stays. Truly exceptional space, curation, and comfort. Am already planning to stay again, not least because of the gracious hospitality of the hosts.

great stay, thanks!

Great place to say! Host was very well at communicating. Had no issues!

Perfect in every way! Beautiful house in a quiet yet totally walkable neighborhood. The room was bigger than it looked from the pictures yet felt super cozy and inviting. Close to the red line and lots of good places to eat. We would definitely stay here again.

This experience was very relaxing. Carissa was an amazing host, great communication.

We loved our stay. Check in was super easy and the apartment was adorable. Location is perfect, the red line is close but not loud at all inside. The apartment was very clean and had everything we needed. We would definitely stay here again!

Location was fantastic! Communication with host was fast and helpful. Would definitely recommend this place to others.

Wow! I have visited Chicago a lot of times but this was probably the best place I have stayed at yet. The neighbourhood is great, the apartment was so cute. The TV signal was a bit intermittent (possibly related to my laptop connection Issues).
The air conditioning was too good! I had to turn it way down so it wasn’t too cold for me.
There was a piece of floor molding between the kitchen and hallway that was missing and had some nail heads sticking up. It wasn't a problem once I knew it was there.
I know it sounds like a lot of complaints, but there were good points too. Notably the A/C. It worked really well and didn’t make too much noise. The bed and pillows were super comfortable. And the kitchen had everything I needed.
Additionally, the place was super clean and very quiet except when the “L” went by. But even that wasn’t an issue.
In total, I would say a good place & I would recommend it.

Perfect location to stay. Well kept and stocked place, can grab groceries and cook or walk to one of the many restaurants around. Good coffee across the street. We had a wonderful time in Chicago. If you’re a walker it’s a good place to start from and if not, the El is right outside the door. For architecture fans, the nearby financial district has many great, historic buildings to see.
Highly recommend. Entering the building things seem ‘meh’ but the apartment is great. Clean and spacious with some excellent air conditioning.

This place was absolutely adorable! I am a stickler for cleanliness and this place totally hit the mark! It's well furnished, cozy, great linens/towels, and wonderful kitchen. Amazing stay love the area and the place. 10/10 would recommend a stay.
Todo estuvo perfecto, desde la ubicación hasta lo necesario en casa. Está muy cerca de la estación de metro. Todo limpio.
we stayed one week...would have given 5 stars but the street parking pass was missing and was only available the day we left.  otherwise, I would recommend it

It was the w perfect home base for visiting around town! Kim was quick to respond and made sure our stay was enjoyable. Space was clean and had all we needed. The neighborhood area is walkable and has fun spots to enjoy as well!

Great little garden apartment in a nice neighborhood! This place was small but perfectly decorated and equipped for a family of 4. Host was extremely responsive before and during the stay. We thoroughly enjoyed our time!

We had a great stay at Charie’s place. The apartment was clean, well organized, and had everything we needed. The check-in and check-out instructions were clear and easy to follow. I stayed here with my family of 5. Nat was always accessible and it was a great location. We enjoyed our stay.

Place was perfect and hosts were awesome. We had a few things come up and they responded super quick and got it taken care of are of.
One of the best things that doesn’t pop out in the listing is how close the place is to the blue line subway and how quickly you can get into downtown and back home.

Great apartment, very unique settings. Anne was always responsive. Had some issues here and there with getting into the apartment but they were always responsive. If you're planning to work here and need internet, that could be an issue as it was very very slow. Only thing that could have been better was just add a TV. Probably don't need if you are just in town doing tourist things but if you have a longer stay or plan to spend more time there it would be a very cheap addition that would add a lot of value.

We stayed here for 25 days and overall had a great time — the space worked well for an extended stay. The neighborhood was lovely for walking, especially with our dog, and there was plenty of space to move around outside.
A couple of things worth noting: there's a restaurant below the unit, and on two occasions during our stay it was loud with music playing until around 11:30pm. Outside of those two nights, noise was never an issue. We let the host know, and they were quick to respond and said they'd speak with the restaurant owner about it. The oven handle also broke at one point, and again, the host handled it promptly.
One suggestion for anyone booking a longer stay like we did — there's no washer/dryer in the unit, so plan accordingly for laundry.
Overall, a comfortable stay in a great location, and the hosts were responsive and easy to work with whenever an issue came up.

Enjoyed my stay at Anny's place! Close to some nice coffee shops in Noble square and easy to get to the metro. Anny was very communicative and accomodating, and the house was very clean! Would gladly stay again.
Place and location are great! Super easy to get to the train station. We had a very comfortable stay.

Con’s:

Main areas were clean, but seems like unit has not been dusted for a few visits.
Great place to stay! The hosts were amazing! The amenities were great! And it’s a great location! Would definitely stay here again!

It is a great place to stay in that it is close to the blue line . I didn’t really find it loud as some other reviewers mentioned . I never had to use ear plugs. Also the walk up was  pretty  easy. It’s not like some of those older buildings . It had convenience of 2 bathrooms . My only con is that it could be better equipped if you were planning on cooking .it has bare minimum in that regard . The laundry was a plus. The air conditioning worked well and was quiet . The beds are very firm especially in the second bedroom . So that could be a problem for some sleepers .

We really enjoyed our stay at Lux in Rogers Park! The space was comfortable, charming, and nicely updated. The modern tile in the kitchen and bathrooms was especially nice, and everything felt clean and well cared for.
The washer and dryer were a huge convenience, especially during the hot summer weather while we were in town for our granddaughter’s tournament. Being able to wash her uniforms right at the apartment made our stay so much easier.
Lake Michigan was easy to access and provided a beautiful, relaxing place to unwind. We also loved having the balcony as a peaceful spot to enjoy our morning coffee. The neighborhood had a safe and comfortable feel, and we were able to find street parking easily.
We would definitely stay here again if we return to the Chicago area. A lovely place in a great location!

The apartment is in an excellent location, just a short walk from Millennium Park. It was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff at the front desk were exceptionally polite, friendly, and always willing to help. Having a bus stop right in front of the building made getting around the city very convenient. We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago.

Nice place, great location but it is a basement unit so there's a lot of stairs with a super weird layout. The lock entry can be tricky and we endured a sewage flood into the unit because it rained really bad our 2nd night.  We left and we're refunded partly since we stayed one of our two nights. The owner wanted a copy of our ID and no one was allowed to come visit us at the place. There was safe parking and it is a great location near many Chicago sights and downtown. My 2nd night experience was a 1 star but first night was 4 star.

I had a great extended weekend stay in this HUGE space. There was so much space for 4 of us. The host kindly greeted me upon check-in and gave me a tour of the place. It’s in a great area…walking distance from the new, beautiful Obama Presidential Center. And it’s pretty much a straight shot into the Loop from Lakeshore Drive.

Such a beautiful and unique place to stay! The art gallery atmosphere made the experience feel really special and different from a typical stay. The artwork was stunning and definitely added to the character of the space. I’d say it’s more enjoyable for adults, as some of the artwork is fairly explicit and may not be suitable for younger children. Overall, a memorable and beautiful stay in Chicago!

This was our second stay while visiting family and friends in the area. The space is clean and comfortable on a quiet street with ample parking. There are restaurants, parks, and grocery stores within walking distance. Conveniently located with easy access to the interstate, O'Hare, and L stations.
Solid spot for the price. Perfect area to based while in Chicago to hit everything since it was close to the Redline.

The space is pretty bare bones and smells very strongly of air freshener. And the building itself is in need of maintenance and deep cleaning in common areas. There are multiple units in the building and the place in general feels like there’s more attention given to volume over quality. It was overall just fine but for the price we paid I had hoped for a nicer stay.

It was very nice, apartment was clean and it was super comfortable I would definitely buy this apartment again in the future and I loved the stay, its about a 10 minute drive to the main city so it was effortless getting there overall the stay was very cozy, enjoyable, and I LOVED the 65 inch screen it was extremely nice to watch horror movies and shows on it had everything you need in a studio apartment and the its what made the most out of my experience there 10/10 would highly recommend
It was a great place to stay at. A lot to do inside the home especially having kids keeps them distracted playing games.

Great location close to restaurants and local convenience stores. The neighborhood was walkable, felt safe, and the host was very responsive. The unit was exactly as described. I would definitely stay at another property hosted by Kyriako the next time I’m in Chicago.

Anthony and Paul’s place in Chicago was fantastic! It was my husband’s and my first time visiting the city, so we chose this Airbnb based on the great reviews and description but it exceeded all of our expectations.

We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago!

Located about 5 minutes from the Division Blue Line station, this is a perfect spot to explore the city! The room was very clean and welcoming. For those who may be less mobile, be aware that you will need to climb the stairs to reach your room.

convenient garden level apartment! Very clean, well appointed, comfortable beds. Great home base for exploring Chicago. Would definitely stay again! Pack n play & high chairs available for those with kids.

Great place! It's an older building, but the apartment is well maintained. The beds were very comfy, and all the basics were covered. It's a nice quiet street with easy access to public transit and local restaurants.

Great location, walking distance to a Whole Foods, restaurants, and the Brown line. Overall, a very positive experience!
Good stay for the weekend. Spacious. Don’t let the outside look fool you.
