These maintenance and cleanliness issues took away from what could have been a much better experience.
Overall, the comfortable beds, convenient location, and responsive host were appreciated, but the condition of the property would keep me from choosing to stay here again.
Definitely a loud location but with the fan and/or provided earplugs, everything was good.

There was an issue with not having sheets, pillows, or extra blankets for the air mattress on the first night, however this was rectified the remainder of the stay. Eric was very communicative and was able to fix the situation.

We had a great time at Nnamdi’s place. Very clean with a great layout and location, it was perfect for our trip for my daughter’s basketball tourney. Located on south side, the area is urban but revitalized and very peaceful. I walked the block in the mornings and evenings and rarely saw other people on the street. We visited the Obama’s Library, Magnificent Mile and Convention Center multiple times during our stay and all were very close by. The unit is a basement so be prepared for lots of overhead movement, especially at night, but it wasn’t overly obtrusive. Overall would definitely recommend.
The home was very comfy and clean! The communication was great before check-in. Would book again.
It’s a perfect house, comfortable and super beautiful. The owner a kindly and nice. We have a good time in this house. The house near to highway and can visit all special places in Chicago.

I would highly recommend staying at this apartment and would stay here again. The area is super safe and the street is one way and chiller than the surrounding streets for easy taxi/Uber pickup and drop-off. The building is a few blocks to the Oak Street Beach and great shopping. It's also a 6 minute walk to the Red Line and the L train, 20 minute walk to the Riverwalk, 30 minute walk to the Bean, and 35 minute walk to the Art Institute. The apartment was very clean/spacious, has comfy beds, great water pressure and air conditioning, fast Wi-Fi,  plenty of outlets and towels, and the kitchen is stocked with new appliances and plenty of cookware/dishware. The washer/dryer worked great. The building staff are very friendly and the host is very responsive on the Airbnb app. You can store bags and they were able to accommodate a late checkout for us. Only criticism is that I requested early checkin in advance and the host said they could do it. When we showed up, they could not do it.
Great place to stay, super convenient. Street parking super easy to find and navigate.

Clemencia’s place met all needs for our short weekend in Chicago.
Great location, walking distance to Logan square, Blue line, and multiple restaurants. The farmer’s market was that Saturday and it was great seeing all the vendors from around the city.
Great stay! Super cute puppy and we ran into a summer festival right nearby. Super cute area with lots of food. Nice place to stay! Room has a cute view too :)
Awesome place, very clean, Great location and an awesome host! Would definitely come back
Great place! Close to everything! We loved it ❤️

It was a great place to stay in Chicago for a few days! Martha made us feel right at home. The ceiling was a bit short for me and I did hit my head a few times since it’s an attic, but the privacy and cleanliness made up for it! Would definitely stay here again
Had an issue with key not being in lock box but host was responsive and quick to resolve the problem! Would definitely come back and stay in the future! Everything was great.
We enjoyed our stay very much!

We had a wonderful stay here! The location is fantastic, making it very convenient to get around, and the space was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The hosts were also very responsive and kind throughout our stay. Highly recommended to anyone visiting the area!

Great place and excellent host ! Quite street but easy walk to great restaurants etc. ..oh. And it was hot humid week in Chicago so we especially enjoyed the central air conditioning that worked great!! Thank you.

Staying here was wonderful for an extended weekend! Nice neighborhood with accessible street parking. With a busy schedule, it was great coming back and having my own private room and bathroom but still having the chance for conversation and meeting the cute cats.

We really appreciated the serenity and peacefulness of this location, and it's right down from a couple really fabulous places to eat, very close to transportation and bus lines, made it so easy to get around. Pills and is not far so you're close to all kinds of fun stuff, art, books, food Etc. We will definitely stay here again, the hosts were really informative and responsive.
Loved the location. Danny was a great host. My mother and I enjoyed our time.
Amazing hosts and an amazing home thanks for having us!

Great spot, very walkable. Clean apartment, sunny and cute. Nice back porch. Some distant city noise with open windows, but very quiet with the windows closed. Queen beds in all 3 bedrooms with fresh clean linens. Loved our stay!

The place was cute and cozy. We were cooking late at night and needed salt and Karena was quick to get us some! We arrived early and were able to check in 3 hours early which was so great. I’d recommend this place to everyone!

The instructions for check-in were very clear.  The unit was great, the bed super comfortable and just a couple of blocks from the beach.  Parking can be a bit tricky but definitely plenty of options around.  Great walkable neighborhood on the north side of town.  Highly recommend.

If you are coming to Chicago, this is the place to get.  The place was super clean, in a quiet neighborhood located close to transportation, and was very inviting. It was the perfect location to start and end each day.  We didn't need much as everything was already provided and the clear instructions let us know where to find things, but the few times we reached out for something we received a quick and helpful response. We are saving this location for any future visits we may take to the area.
Great place to stay for our small family. Quirky and cute, close to great food and transit.
O apartamento é muito bom! Tem utensílios de alta qualidade. Chuveiro bom! Colchão e roupas de cama de boa qualidade. Um excelente espaço para explorar a cidade. Carlo deu ótimas dicas.

Super clean and exactly as listed. Very close to Wrigley (15 minute walk) which is what we were looking for. Also very easy to navigate to the L or buses to get to other areas in the city. Will was very responsive and able to answer any questions we had quickly. We really enjoyed our stay and helped ease the stress knowing we had a great place to come back to after long days of sight seeing and exploring the city. I would definitely return again 😊
Beautiful classic home in the heart of Andersonville. Short steps to great restaurants, bars, coffee and bakeries. Wonderful responsive hosts. Thank you both!
It was a very wonderful place to stay. Clean and comfortable and a very nice place and a very nice and approachable host.
Charlie was a helpful, quick responding host. The place is in a great neighborhood with easy access to CTA. It is clean, basic accommodations.

We felt very at home in Audrone's space. It was inviting and clean and had everything we needed to be comfortable.  Adrone was very accommodating for our early arrival. We would definitely recommend Audrone's space!

I enjoyed this home. It was exactly as described in the pictures, me and my company felt at home during this entire trip. My only concern was figuring out how to work the lockbox & shower lol, Brad’s communication was amazing. I stay in Chicago alot, I will definitely be booking this property again!
J was very nice and very responsive. She reached out to make sure our check-in was smooth and the day of check-out she reached out to ensure our stay was enjoyable and pleasant.
Great kitchen, great shower, easy parking,  comfortable beds. Very pleased.
Cozy and a perfect location to explore Andersonville, with the red line being easily accessible.
Great stay! Everything was very lovely and Iris was super kind and responsive. I’d stay there again.
Amazing place. Really enjoyed the stay here. Well thought out details, easy access, and lots of space. Highly recommend.
Great place and was clean.  Neighbors were a little noisy, but other than that perfect spot for our trip

Buena ubicación
Lugar tranquilo
Algo saturado la calle para estacionarse pero si encuentras, ten cuidado con los espacios reservados.
Está muy cómodo todo y bonito.

We had a great time! The house was clean and very spacious gave privacy within the guest! Had great services and the store was close by as well as public transportation. Ubers had no issue funding the place! Effina checked in with us on the first day then half way through our stay and on the last night! Never felt like she was intruding or overbearing as a host!

Perfect place especially if you are going to an event at United Center. Visited for WNBA All Star weekend and literally a 5 minute uber/lyft there. The neighborhood seemed a bit sketch and can be loud at times but we had no issues at all. This is a hidden gem. The place was very clean and looks just like the pictures presented. Lyle was very communicative and nice through the whole process. I would definitely stay here again.
This 3/2 home is very spacious with an open kitchen/dining concept. It’s in a quiet neighborhood. Would definitely rent again if ever in the area.

Our group of 4 really enjoyed staying at this Airbnb.  The property was well decorated with the latest technology and amenities.  There were ample of additional items provided to make our stay very comfortable.  Our host was very responsive and provided us with all the necessary information well ahead of time.  We would gladly return and look forward to our next stay!

Milan, was a terrific Host.  He periodically checked in with us to see if everything was going well or if we needed anything.  The space is unique but as described and advertised.  It worked very well for our group. We would definitely rent again from Milan when in Chicago.
Lovely place stay! Everything was clean when we arrived. Check in was very smooth.
I would highly consider booking a stay here the bnb was very clean and neat
Great place in the heart of Wrigley with great restaurants nearby! AirBnB has everything you need and more

Elliot and Deena's warm and cozy cottage was just that. It felt familiar and like home from the moment we arrived. There is enough shared and private space for all four of us. Every step of the way, E & D's communication was timely and thorough. Elliot and Deena made our first Airbnb experience easy and wonderful!
Extremely efficient, stress free environment.
Very clean and very nice place and nice host!

Julissa was very kind and attentive all the time. The place is clean and organized, it also has a very good location to get to know the city better, I highly recommend this apartment. Surely when I return to Chicago this will be my first choice :)
Abby was always checking with us to make sure our stay was perfect.
This is a great place in a great location with a great host. Very clean and very easy. Will stay again.

We really enjoyed our stay at Caroline’s place. It was a peaceful and safe neighbourhood. Caroline was very helpful and responsive. The accommodation was very clean and comfortable with good amenities.

Our group of 8 travelers felt very comfortable and enjoyed our stay. The location allowed us to enjoy Logan Square (Lula’s Cafe is a MUST!) and we could access Wrigley Field and the Loop easily as well for our city adventures.  The home is clean and easy to access and Reinaldo was very responsive throughout our booking process.

This location completely exceeded our expectations.
Great neighborhood, easy access to CTA, responsive host, would highly recommend.
Great stay for the weekend, would consider returning in the future
Good place for the price and it was near by the metro

We were in town for a basketball tournament at the McCormick Place.  It was a very easy 10 minute commute!  The place was exactly as described and super clean and modern.  We had plenty of space, and the outdoor deck was an added bonus!  The neighborhood felt extremely safe, and we walked downtown one of the evenings for dinner, and another morning for coffee.  We did have a very slight hiccup with parking, due to a festival going on that weekend, but Bel was extremely responsive and helpful with assisting us with this!  If you are looking for a quiet place, in a great area of Chicago with plenty of things to do, this is it!  Thank you Bel and Vic for a great weekend stay!
Great, easy access!

Thank you for a wonderful stay. We felt right at home. Tony was super helpful and welcoming. Definitely recommend his home and we will definitely be back.
Thank you again for everything
Very great place, very nice stay would definitely go back there!!
Good deal for the price! The host was friendly and responsive, only downside was figuring out parking. Otherwise, everything was great!

We spent the weekend here, and it was great. Super clean and quiet. They made sure we had a parking spot because we arrived late that night, which was very kind of them. Sometimes the wifi was unstable or disconnected a few times, but it was back again shortly. The communication with the owners was excellent; they answered right away when we had questions. Overall, a great stay, and we would come back.
Had a nice stay
Love staying on Halsted. So much fun! Nice place with good amenities.

Wow- incredible experience! From the warm welcome at check in to the impeccable decor and overall vibe of the space, it definitely felt like a home away from home. The host was extremely friendly and proactive, making the stay seamless. My most enjoyable stay at any AirBnB I’ve been to; you’d be lucky to experience staying here! Definitely will be back ❤️
Great Place and Location!  Victor was awesome on Communication, and we will definitely be back!

I had a really nice stay. Kitchen equipped with all necessities. Walking distance to the areas I needed to get to. I felt safe as a single woman staying here. Check-in instructions were detailed and easy to follow. Building needs some work but inside the apt was updated and modern. Will book again on my next visit.
Bart was super responsive to all my questions and super accommodating. Stay was easy , location was convenient !
Very nice place and nice host! Would recommend to anyone visiting

This place was in a perfect location.  Easy to get to the train and beach.  Was able to find street parking right out front of the apartment. The host was very responsive.  The apartment was a perfect size to accommodate 2 people for our 4-night stay.

Overall I enjoyed my stay. Mainly needed a place to sleep and relax after exploring Chicago and going to events. Danielle was very kind and helpful when needed. I had a flight cancellation and she let me stay an extra night which was extremely helpful.
The weather was great most of the time I was there but the last couple of days it was a bit warm. The AC was on but she does keep it around 78. It is okay during the day but at night I prefer to sleep in a cooler environment. It was explained that when the doors are closed it takes awhile for the air to circulate.

Molly was a very sweet and caring host, and lovely to talk to. Her pets were really cute and well mannered. The room was spacious and clean, and the balcony was beautiful. And not to mention, we got to enjoy some delicious home made banana bread! Her place is also in a convenient location, only a few minutes walk to the bus stop, with short routes to the most famous museums in Chicago. She has a lovely home and we’re very glad we had the opportunity to stay!
Everything was great, great location!
Only needed a place to sleep & shower & this was perfect with a view of the towers!
Loved it! Great stay!
Great place to stay for a weekend trip. Very clean space. However, the bathtub could have been cleaner. Nonetheless, the host was a great communicator and we enjoyed our stay. Thanks.

We stayed here last year and were happy to come back.
Just a short walk to visit family near by.
Very quiet and cozy....Love the decor!
The neighborhood is wonderful, the bathroom was spectacular, and Leslie responded quickly to my message. So quiet that we wondered if they were even home!

Great spot in Chicago for a great price! We really appreciated the local suggestions from Patrick and the kindness and consideration shown to our group. It was a lovely, peaceful stay - even with us traveling with a young child. The apartment had everything we needed, great space indoor and out, and local hot spots were walkable. We hope to be back in the future!

Pros:
-Maria was very responsive, respectful & a pleasure to speak to
-This place was secluded & in a very nice neighborhood. Offering privacy & space for me & my friends !!
-Beds slept comfortably
-LOVELY home! So beautiful & has so many antique/personal touches
-parking was a breeze. We had no issues with it at all
-Well stocked with towels, kitchen supplies & bathroom essentials & tissue/paper towels
-Plant wall is gorgeous
Cons:
-Some of the TVs weren’t working properly with the remotes
-There’s a noticeable & distinct smell in the house. We tried spraying & airing it out, but it was still pretty strong throughout our stay
-The house was fairly clean, but I would suggest to change the shower curtains & dust regularly. Cobwebs were visible inside & outside the house
Overall, we very much enjoyed our stay & were pleased with our experience. Thank you!
Great townhouse right in the heart of Lincoln Park area. Accommodations were lovely and the hosts were great

Beautiful brownstone in a lively, historic neighborhood. The layout and amenities of the apartment are NOT for everyone, but suited us well. Most of the negatives have been mentioned (stained comforter/furniture, cracked mirror, and not fixed); but most annoying for me was that 'house rules' allow 8 guests (we had 4), but there were only 2 washcloths to be found, and no response to a request for more over our 4 day stay.
Perfect stay! The place was spotless, comfortable, and in a great location. I’d happily stay here again.
Perfect

Love staying here! Was our 2nd time staying, now as a family of 5. Great layout for our family, and so convenient to be a short walk from a park with a water feature, a grocery store, a coffee shop, and the L. Homey place with all the supplies we could need. Hope to stay again next year!
Amazing stay. Everything worked out perfectly

Mi estadía fue excelente. Me hospedé del 24 al 27 y todo estuvo tal como aparecía en la publicación. El lugar estaba limpio, cómodo y bien cuidado, con todo lo necesario para una estancia agradable. La comunicación fue muy buena y el proceso de llegada fue sencillo. Sin duda volvería a hospedarme aquí y lo recomiendo a cualquier persona que esté buscando un lugar confiable y agradable para quedarse.

Our stay was very nice. The place was unique and spacious. Our host was very responsive. The neighbors were friendly. We were able to walk to a train station, and there was a corner store across the street.

We had a great stay! The place was very clean, cozy, and had everything we needed. We loved having access to the backyard with a bench and table. Parking was easy, and getting to downtown by Uber was quick and reasonably priced.
The house is great for both short and longer stays. There was plenty of storage, a washing machine, and a spacious upstairs with a nice kitchen, living area, dining table, and even a projector.
One of my favorite things was that shoes are not allowed inside, which made the place feel extra clean. The neighborhood is not the fanciest, but the street itself felt safe.
Thank you to the host for taking such good care of the place. My husband and I really enjoyed our stay. My husband especially absolutely loved it! We would definitely stay here again if we’re back in the area!

Vladimir was ah mazing!
The Airbnb was so cute, we loved it and it made our trip that much more memorable.

Creo que la experiencia fue muy buena ya que fue muy fácil llegar al lugar!
El área efectivamente es residencial pero en mi experiencia fue bueno por que encontramos fácil parqueadero y nunca escuché ningún ruido ni siquiera dentro del lugar donde me hospedé, todo es muy tranquilo!
El anfitrión tuvo un inconveniente de logística al momento de yo llegar al lugar pero lo que más me gustó fue su eficacia y como se solucionó todo para brindarnos la mejor experiencia!!
Volvería sin duda!
Beautiful home in a safe neighborhood. Host was communicative and helpful. House was clean and cozy.

Place was clean and smelt good, but my pregnant wife had to help me carry our luggage up 4 flights of stairs since the elevator wasn’t working . Quiet area to stay and close to lots of restaurants and grocery stores. Only thing that wasn’t really worth the price was the very tight squeeze bathroom, nonworking elevator, and hairdryer made the power go out. Good space for a couple.

Katie was easy to communicate with and their home was beautiful! The home is in a very walkable area and they gave recommendations for local spots. I would 100% recommend their listing for anyone looking to stay in Chicago !
Very homey! And clean , great location . Highly recommend
El apartamento está fenomenal para pasar unos días en la ciudad. Tiene una cocina completa que siempre viene bien. El metro estaba muy cerca y el autobús prácticamente a la puerta.

Kenneth was a very gracious host, quick to respond and made are stay as comfortable as possible. We came with kids for a basketball tournament and he had snacks available for the kids. He was very accommodating.

The size of this house was perfect for our group of 7 and could have easily fit more people comfortably. We were fine with being a little ways away from downtown in exchange for having plenty of shared space to hang out together when we were at the house.  We felt safe in the neighborhood and the upstairs neighbor was friendly and we didn’t have any issues.

We  cant recommend this appartment enough. Spacious, calm , clean and ideally situated. Lovely bed and John and Griffin think of all the little details. John replied swifly to any questions we had. Perfect  for a couple. If we return to Chicago we would most definetely consider it again.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Check-in was easy, the instructions were clear, and communication with the host was excellent throughout our stay.
The neighborhood was perfect for exploring Chicago, with plenty of restaurants, attractions, and public transportation nearby.
Thank you for your hospitality! We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago.

Laura was incredibly responsive and helpful as a host! The unit is a super cute and simple little 2br apartment set up with all the amenities you could want. The interior decoration was very nice and the whole unit felt very welcoming and clean. Truly enjoyed staying there!
Convenient location , easy access, good working AC units!
Super amables y cordiales

Great place to stay. My family came in town to celebrate my daughter's 21 birthday. The apartment was very nice and we felt right at home.  There was coffee and tea available for us and everything was very clean. The air conditioners cooled the place quickly. Cheryl was nice enough to recommend the Wicker Park Fest to us and provided instructions. The entire neighborhood is walkable and everyone was very friendly. I.will definitely stay with her again

Great hosts and wonderful location for our family of four. We came to go to a game at Wrigley and explore Chicago. Perfect location for both with easy access to both with the L around the corner as well as lots of walkable shops. We really loved their neighborhood!
I really enjoyed staying here. I love the Airbnb and how spacious and quiet it was. The neighborhood was really nice & the host was very responsive.

This place is exactly as listed and by far, the cleanest place we’ve ever stayed in to date.  We are super happy with the location and easy access to everything.  Fantastic host!  You won’t be disappointed!

We had a great stay at Flamingo Paradise. The location in the Southport Corridor was wonderful. The neighborhood was safe and extremely walkable. We were able to walk to Wrigley and to the Brown Line of the L. The apartment was comfortable.  The beds were comfortable. The host was responsive and very accommodating at check in. Great stay for our trip.

Excellent location and extremely comfortable apartment for my first visit to Chicago with a friend! Communication was outstanding with the owners. So many convenient amenities close by - food, coffee, shopping, entertainment and that gorgeous Chicago River!! I would absolutely stay in this apartment again!
Only issue was wifi didn't work and there was no cellular connection.
Greta place. Bring your own way to have and make coffee. And bringing your own towels would be smart. Best location ever and pleasant place
The stay was amazing. A really cozy spot and it’s near pretty much everything.

This was my worst Airbnb experience by far. The house had not been cleaned from the previous guest when we got there. They sent a cleaning crew, only for the bedsheets to be rearranged in one of the bedrooms - no new linens. The place was still considerably dirty: hair in the bathroom, chewed gum on the windowsill, full trash, greasy dining table. The next day they sent another cleaning crew only for the job to not be done and for them to send them back a 3rd time. Communication is either handled by a robot or an outsourced service, it was extremely challenging to get straightforward answers. The apartment is not well taken care of, doesn’t match the condition of the images. Main bedroom fairly loud from street noise. I would avoid at all costs. We did not even get a night’s refund.
Great spot to have as home-base when exploring Chicago
Thank you Bella for hosting and providing a wonderful, clean and spacious space to stay in Chicago!
Ebony and family were great! It’s a joy to see and feel FAMILY in these current times. This stay was definitely one of the best I’ve had on the platform! THANK YOU, THANK YOU & THANK YOU!

This place was perfect for our women's Chicago celebration weekend! I'm not a city person so I was very nervous about safety and parking. Dan and Abby provided parking permits and Abby was helpful with her instructions. The unit is very safe as there is a gate and an outdoor door before entering the unit itself. The area is quaint with easy walking to restaurants and shops.
Once inside, it is very charming! Perfect size for the 4 of us, decorated nicely and very clean. Everything was so comfortable!!! Dan provided everything what one would need - right down to toothbrushes. :-D We had such a great time and would definitely stay again.
Very nice and spacious Airbnb. Kimberlie was very responsive and was extremely accommodating.
Great stay for a great weekend. Would totally recommend. Thanks again Juan ✨
Rooms got a little warm due to a lack of circulation, but the location is very convenient and the place is kept clean.
The home was nice and quiet. The location was by everything you would need.
I loved this airbnb! Amy was so polite and very responsive and the place itself was so beautiful. The neighborhood is walkable with  much to do around it. Great place to stay!!
Great spot in Chicago.  Close to Wrigley and the Brown line train so getting around was easy!  Would stay again!
Excellent location! Excellent interior! First class building! I stayed here two months and it was great!
Very quiet neighborhood and super close to the train station to get to the city!! Would recommend

Matt's home in Ravenswood is a great place to stay in the area! Extremely walkable and public transit friendly. It was quite simple to get into and around the city from this area.
The apartment is spacious, quiet and has everything you would need to enjoy a nice stay in the city. The food recommendations helped, and it's clear there is extra effort put in to make the stay more comfortable.

The place was just as described, the location is amazing, really close to a very lively neighborhood and 20 to 30 minutes walking distance to the river walk and the rest of downtown Chicago. As few other people said, the place is super loud, the train is nearby and some of them operate 24h, earbuds and walking 30k steps helped with falling and staying asleep, since this wasn’t a relaxing vacation for me and my nephew it worked out for us, but if you’re planning for a restful night of sleep, know that’s not going to happen. The place was very clean and very try close to a train station to go to the places that are further away.
The neighborhood is quiet and felt safe. The home was clean. It is a bit far from downtown and the airport however that did not ruin my trip at all.
great stay

Very easy to find, wonderful home with everything we needed. Close to all the restaurants we wanted to visit. The neighborhood was so beautiful and safe. The host was very kind and friendly but pretty much left us alone. They let us checkout very late but even if they couldn’t, would have still given the 5 stars. We would definitely love to stay here again give the opportunity.

Such a great place!
John's home was the perfect spot for this homesick ex-Chicagoan. An older house filled with the city's texture, but updated and refreshed where it counts. Nice, quiet, tree-lined neighborhood with tons of parking, across the street from a school and half a block from a big park.
Great beds, linens and towels, and plenty of them. We didn't do any cooking beyond toasting a few bagels, but it's a great kitchen for it if you're so inclined. And there's a huge rear deck that's a great spot to sit around with coffee or a drink. It isn't a trees and fields kind of view, but rather a quintessentially urban Chicago view, and I love it :-D
And John himself is a super friendly and responsive fellow. We tried to meet up to say hello, but it didn't quite work out on this pass. Maybe next time.
Great spot. Highly recommended.

Everything about the Airbnb was great. Perfect location, super walkable ant far from downtown and the riverwalk. My only suggestion would be to stock the Airbnb better. It would her been nice to have water, also extra trash bags, etc…thats honestly my only minor complaint but directly out the window is a nice supermarket, so i guess it’s not that bad lol. Overall 4.8!!

This apt was the perfect location in Chicago. Basically 15 mins from everything we planned on doing. Very spacious, comfy beds, and awesome bathrooms. Check in/out was super easy. Wonderful stay! Would absolutely stay again.
Ed's place is a very convenient location and very competitively priced to hotels that would be 30 min drive away.
Host was very responsive and helpful.
I loved this stay! The home was very clean, smelt amazing, and I really appreciated the aesthetic. This listing is definitely worth the price. I would definitely recommend!
Beautiful place!

If you’re after a classic, artsy Chicago stay, this place is absolutely perfect.
The space is filled with original artwork, nothing like mass-produced decor from HomeGoods. The hallway lined with framed vintage newspapers makes you want to pause and read all those fascinating old news stories. There are plenty of handcrafted jars and plates that are lovely and practical to use.
The room is spotless, well-equipped, and the neighbors are friendly. David and the Trvare response fast, and have been very responsible host! We enjoyed the stay so much, and are definitely gonna come back again
My only suggestion to the host: stock more cleaning supplies and provide a vacuum. It would be really helpful for guests like us staying more than a week to tidy up ourselves.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience and highly recommend this listing!
This Apartment is in a great location. It was very clean and the bed is quite comfortable. Super quiet street. We will definitely stay here again.

The condo is in a very quiet neighborhood.  But the building is very old and outdated. It looked a little sketchy and not appealing when you pull up.  However,  the condo is nice inside. For the most part it was surface cleaned. But NOT deep cleaned. In the main bedroom there were crumbs in the sheets. Which told us the bedding had not been cleaned.  We had to take our  sheets to a family member home to wash them.  That's NOT ok. I will be traveling with my own sheets and pillow cases moving forward.  The twin bed pillow sham also had a smell, that didn't give clean. There were rose petals left under the bed in the primary room.  The toilet was not clean around the sides or behind it.  Very dusty, and gross.  If cleaning was better. The condo was ok. But thorough cleaning is a MUST. I shouldn't have to do that when I arrive to be comfortable.
Host is a great communicator, clean accommodation, easy check-in/check-out, was within walking distance to our desired locations.

Kristin was amazing. We had a girls weekend for my daughter’s sweet sixteen. Kristin had great recommendations that I would not have found myself.  We all had a great time. And extra points for the awesome spa shower! Great water pressure and temperature. Steam feature was great after a long day of walking in the city.  We would definitely stay here again. 💕

The space was fantastic brand new, exceptionally clean, and free of clutter. I would recommend bringing a white noise machine or using a white noise app if you're a light sleeper, as it's very quiet inside.
The neighborhood is a bit run-down, so it's worth being aware of your surroundings, but we never encountered any issues. The location is convenient, with the Green Line just a short walk away, and on-site parking is also available.
Quinton was an excellent host, providing great communication throughout our stay along with helpful recommendations for the area.
I would stay here again.

The space itself was decent, but I was extremely disappointed by the lack of transparency regarding visitors. The listing prohibited parties and excessive noise, which was completely reasonable, but it did NOT disclose that even one visitor had to be added to the reservation. This restriction was only communicated after booking. I immediately raised concerns and made clear we were not having a party just 2 family members and their infant visiting for 2–3 hours. We hadn’t seen them in 3 years. The communication made it seem like this could be worked out, but once the cancellation/payment window passed, there was no flexibility. Frankly, it felt like a scam because I would NEVER have booked had this been disclosed upfront, and by then my only option was to lose my money. The oven door was also broken and had to be held shut while cooking; although reported, no one came. This did not feel like a home away from home.
We had a great stay, excellent location, clean, great amenities, clear instructions for checkin and responsive host. Will come back !

The stay was okay overall. The first impression of the building wasn’t very inviting, as it looked quite messy and unorganized. The apartment itself was decent, but it could have been cleaner. The mirrors were smeared, and we found some hairs in the bathroom when we arrived. Other than that, the apartment had everything we needed and was fine for our stay.
Super friendly hosting guest & clean place for what you pay for. Super quiet as well.
Roomy, comfortable and bright apartment on a leafy, quiet street. Easy walk to shops and restaurants.

Enjoyed our stay! No complaints at all. The space was spotless, and the check-in and check-out instructions were simple and easy to follow. It was also much more spacious than it appeared in the photos. We had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!

This place was extremely spacious for a city apartment, clean, well kept and comfortable. It was within walking distance of everything in Wicker Park. Yes, just as the listing shows and states, it is on a main intersection so you hear the city noise. It wasn't anything that kept us up that much. We forgot our sound machine at home. If we had that we wouldn't have noticed anything at all. The place is a great find and value. The hosts are very responsive and nice. Having a designated parking spot in a lot not the street was also a huge bonus for us. We have a company vehicle and it was safe the whole time. The beds are comfortable with plenty of pillows. Nice couch and common space. The bedrooms were a great size as well. Having two bathrooms was a big bonus. One bathroom is in a bedroom and smaller, the other would be shared by the other two rooms and bigger. Would definitely stay here again.
Budget stay. Hosts keep things clean. They're pretty chill. One thing to note, my room was a basement unit but it wasn't clear in the posting at all :(
Accurate description, and great communication. Area had some great options.

We had an amazing time in Chicago staying at joes place. It was very clean, had a great kitchen with all the basics you need. Plenty of towels and even some extra night lights which my elderly father really appreciated.
The neighborhood is quiet but still close to whatever you need including a parking spot and an easy walk to public transportation. We would absolutely book this spot again.

This was a wonderful stay for my husband and myself! The inn is so fun…great mix of historical and modern. Staff was super friendly, helpful, and responsive before and during our stay. Glad we opted for parking! Room was spacious and comfortable with great amenities. Would definitely love to stay here again when in the Chicago area!
Great place. No issues at all
The place was great. It looked just like the pictures. Super clean, no issues checking in, neighborhood was safe! I would stay again in a heartbeat.
We had a great stay here. Very helpful, quick responses & will try to accommodate.
Stayed overnight and absolutely loved stayed here and will definitely be back next time we’re in town. It is perfectly located and we were able to walk all around town from here!

My stay at Ingrid’s was comfortable, peaceful, clean, aesthetically pleasing and definitely worth a 5 star review! My four days in Chicago were extremely busy, and being able to come back and relax in an intentionally designed and well thought out space was priceless! Would absolutely stay here again!

Good price, as described! Responsive host.
Property was missing some necessities (e.g. paper towels) but otherwise had a pleasant stay.

Not as nice as I'd hoped based on the photos, but still good enough for our family's basic needs while in Chicago. Walking distance to CVS, Dunkin, and other amenities. Seemed like a relatively safe area. Having a garage to park in was a real plus.

Paul's place is a fantastic place to stay if you are wanting a spot outside of downtown Chicago. Nearest metro is walkable from the apartment. Wicker Park is a great place to explore with lots of shops and restaurants. Paul left a big binder full of food recommendations. The apartment was great, it has everything you need. Would stay here again!

If 6 stars were available, I would leave them for Eva and this home. She was unbelievably accommodating and helpful. One of the best hosts of any Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. If you have a large group or team traveling, this is the perfect place to stay.

The apartment was clean, the beds were comfortable, and it matched the listing. Unfortunately, everything else ruined the stay.
Parking was a nightmare. I paid $120 ($30 per day) for a parking pass plus a $50 deposit through the host, followed all instructions, and parked in the assigned space. My car was still towed, costing me $520 to get it out of impound. The host was rude, unhelpful, blamed a third-party parking company, and refused to take any responsibility. They even offered me the same parking space afterward. However another car was parked there 😏
The apartment smelled from the nearby trash chute, and there was a significant ant problem in the bedroom. Lysol and Raid were provided, but that didn't solve the issues.
I contacted Airbnb multiple times regarding the towing expenses but never received a meaningful resolution. Overall, the lack of accountability and the parking disaster completely overshadowed what could have been a decent stay. I would not book here again.
The suite was cozy and the theming charming, located in a quiet neighborhood. An excellent place to spend a long weekend!

Tried several times before checking in to contact host who was unresponsive.  Originally assigned to one unit, moved to another before check in, then someone opened our door and said it was their unit.  They were told to check two other units , both of which were occupied, and all had same pass code for lock, which made me uncomfortable.
Overall great stay.
Cute space in the middle of a very happening neighborhood! Lots of shops and restaurants in walking distance! Enjoyable stay!
Gia was an amazing host! Super responsive and check in instructions were really clear.

It was nice definitely. Felt safe in the neighborhood and inside the home. It is not nowhere near the main attractions (except for garfield park conservatory) but it is indeed one block from the green line train so that was really helpful. There are stairs as soon as you walk in and there is one part at the top without a railing so if you’re looking for accessible not the place for you. Host was very responsive. While this is a shared Airbnb I only came across one guest one time besides that I just heard them didn’t see them.
Overall 10/10 would book again

We really loved this outstanding place. Close to everything you’d need, but still a nice, quiet street. Really appreciated the small, special things in the place, like great sheets, coffee and couch. Highly recommended!
The host was extremely responsive and kind!
Comfortable place, easy mobility, safe place
Great Place to stay at if you don’t mind sharing a bathroom and kitchen. I was only there for two nights but it was a good time.

We had an amazing stay! The host was incredibly friendly, responsive, and made the entire process easy from check-in to check-out. The Airbnb was exactly as described clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Everything we needed was provided, and the location was great. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend this host to anyone visiting the area!
Very nice stay in a safe neighborhood!
Excelente localización, el departamento muy limpio, con gusto regresaría el próximo verano, Chicago es una de mis ciudades favoritas
Cozy place in a nice area. Near public transportation and some nice local bars and coffee shops. Marissa was super friendly and responded to any questions quickly. Thanks!
mc
Very clean and beautiful space in a great location. It was perfect as a solo traveler for business but would work equally well for a couple.
Had a amazing time can’t wait to go back
Great stay.

Wir haben den Aufenthalt bei Charles und seiner Frau unheimlich genossen. Er ist ein charmanter Gastgeber, der proaktiv viele Tipps für die Umgebung hat. Das Haus ist wirklich ganz zauberhaft eingerichtet, so dass wir uns gleich wie Zuhause gefühlt haben. Es war wirklich alles perfekt.
Great neighborhood, really good restaurants nearby and grocery stores, private area, responsive host, airbnb was good for the location we needed to book!
We had a great stay. The location was perfect  for us. We have family in the neighborhood. It was a quick walk to their door while also giving us a place of our own.

I do not recommend booking this property until major renovations are made.
The main bathroom had a broken shower head that sprayed everywhere with poor water pressure, and the toilet always required multiple flushes. The second bathroom had no curtains or blinds despite facing a neighboring property's open window, leaving guests with no privacy.
The home also had extensive cosmetic damage: water damage in both bathrooms, stained chairs, peeling paint, creaky or misaligned doors, dents in the refrigerator and coffee table, broken closet handles, and open bags of food left in cabinets at check-in. While these issues weren't always functional, they made the stay unpleasant. It was cheaper than nearby listings (we paid about $2,400 for 6 guests), but would have chosen another property had we known about all of the preexisting issues.
Positives: the kitchen/living room were nice, location of public transit was convenient, and the hosts were friendly and responsive.

This truly is a gem! John is the nicest, most responsive host we have ever had, and Airbnb is our go to.  this location is so perfect. We had a 4-day event at the McCormack Center, bought a bus pass (on/off right around the corner!) and even walked one day. Cute place, small but perfect for our needs! Don’t hesitate, book it! We will be back next year!
Thank you!

Overall, the place was well located. There was noticeable water marks on the ceiling in the main bedroom, smelt like cigarettes, they forgot to drop the pack and play, also when arriving told me a maintenance person had to get in to fix the sink, the Disney which was listed on the ad was not logged in, hot water only stays hot when you leave it on, entrance has four stairs so when you enter you have to carry any luggage up stairs not kid friendly for a stroller.
Great place. Clean and comfortable. In a great location and very friendly hosts. Highly recommend.

A delightfully clean and comfortable 2 bedroom apartment in a nice walkable area with a backyard patio.    Gracious hosts.  Well appointed. Repeat visitors and will stay here again when traveling to Chicago.

Cihan was an outstanding host. Communication was excellent from start to finish, and he was always quick to respond whenever I had a question. The place was exactly as described—very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The location was convenient, and everything I needed for a relaxing stay was provided. Check-in and check-out were smooth and hassle-free. I truly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. Thank you again for your hospitality!
2 separate units which I wasn’t aware of but the space was more than sufficient for a group of 11. Best thing about this air bnb was the location. So close to Wrigley field and tons to do.

Hugh’s place wonderful and described accurately. The apartment has everything you may want or need during a vacation. We stayed there ten (10) days and found the kitchen to have everything we needed. The washer/dryer in the bathroom was very convenient and we used that. Hugh was also very responsive to several requests we made.
The only issue is street parking. Sometimes we had to hunt for a spot only to find one a block or two away.
The location is great. Tracee is a responsible host. We really enjoyed our stay.
The stairs were a serious issue. Especially with heavy suitcases. The dishwasher was not emptied.  Nothing to hand wash dishes. No washcloths provided. Had to buy something to wash our skin with.
Alexandra was such an amazing host! She is knowledgeable, friendly and very accommodating! Definitely go to the breakfast spot she recommends, it’s delicious :)
Stylish 2br unit in great River North neighborhood. Many excellent restaurants in walking distance. Met our family’s needs perfectly. Access was easy.
We loved staying here! We would definitely stay here again. The host was helpful and flexible.

We really enjoyed our stay in this unit, especially the location and how simple it was to walk to all nearby attractions! The host was super responsive, which was very helpful. The unit was very clean. There were limited full body towels (and very thin towels) and no extra bedding, but the unit was clean, comfortable, and in an epic location.

Nice space within walking distance of tons of excellent restaurants as well as local attractions.  Felt very safe walking around the area.  Would definitely consider using them again for return trips to Chicago.
Heart of Chinatown, 5 min walk to Redline

Its small but great!  It was exactly what I was looking for.  Only thing to note is I'm 6'2'' and I was a little cramped in the bed. But its usually like that for me.  I slept great regardless, but i was not "spead out" lol ! I'd stay again.

Host was very responsive, checking in on us periodically during our stay. Great value for what you get. Definitely more hostel vibes, but the bathrooms were kept clean throughout our stay.
VERY convenient location to the United Center, and I would definitely recommend if there’s an event you’re seeing there. Quick walk to the Blue Line made it easy to get into the city.
15 min to Ohare.  great location, newly renovated house, ample parking, very responsive host, house and amenities exactly as promised.
Great stay for our large family!
I had a wonderful time, clean, and very communicative
Great location, good value.

A no-frills stay very convenient to take the red line to anywhere in Chicago. The mattresses could be more comfortable, but it had everything we needed for our stay. Very historic Chicago second floor apartment.
Milan is a great and communicative host. Very professional. The space was very convenient and located close to a lot. Would definitely rent again
Very spacious and well maintained. T was a great host for me and my friends.
definitely recommend! host was very helpful and a great host!

Great location! The listing in Motor Row is perfect for activities at the Wintrust arena or McCormick Place and only a 15 min walk to the Metra for access to Hyde Park, the new Presidential Center, the Museum of Science and Industry and other South Chicago activities. The restaurant in the building, Brûlée, was amazing and has live blues on Sundays. The world famous Chess Records building is a block away and also features live blues in the courtyard and tours. Access to both the Red Line and Green Line makes getting to downtown and the United Center a breeze. Just be aware that, as with all major cities, this is not a quiet part of town at night, although the mornings were very peaceful for a run or walk along the Lakefront (only about 10 min away). Milan and the team are very accommodating and responsive and provided free luggage storage at arrival and departure so we could use every minute of our trip to explore the many sites Chicago has to offer. Would definitely stay here again.

Great place to stay little outside of downtown. Not walking distance, but an easy Uber or bus ride to downtown. Beth was great with recommendations, communication, and hospitality. Would definitely think of staying here again on another trip!

Truly enjoyed our stay here. I had 11 ppl and the place would comfortably fit 13 when the beds are shared. Definitely recommend this place.  Things to consider are the traffic in Chicago which is out of the control of the owner.

Lea's place is so cute and cozy. It's in a great neighborhood. Very close to the 606 so you can walk or bike to lots of things to do. We had everything we needed to make our stay comfortable. The bed is super comfortable, the kitchen is well stocked with utensils and pots and pans for cooking your own meals, the bathroom has a nice shower and the sitting area is great for watching tv or reading. Very thoughtful touches throughout the space. I forgot my slippers but Lea even had that covered - she had some disposable ones available!
The whole space is very clean and welcoming and it's a nice neighborhood. We will definitely book again . Highly recommend!!!
Great place, very clean, 10/10

Family members stayed in other local locations and ours was by far the most modern.  Nightclub downstairs and a short walk, China town a short walk, Metro a short walk, elevator for delivered groceries, easy check out, safe neighborhood.  You will have a great time at this location.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is incredibly spacious and perfect for a large family or group. With five bedrooms and three full bathrooms, everyone had plenty of space, and the multiple bathrooms made getting ready so much easier.
The location is excellent, with easy access to nearby attractions. Check-in was smooth, and parking was simple and convenient—we didn’t have to pay for parking, which was a great bonus.
The host was also very attentive and responsive throughout our stay. She provided great recommendations for things to do during the weekend, which made our trip even more enjoyable.
We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone traveling with a large group.

Bernard’s was an incredible host, his hospitality attributed to my great Chicago weekend !! his home was BEAUTIFUL, love the art and the history throughout the home, 10/10 would definitely stay again. Everything was clean and up to standards, bathroom, linens, and my fav was the kitchen lol !!
Clean place , and very easy instructions. Didn't even need to contact the agent.  Everything was good.  Very nice rooftop.

A spacious apartment that looked exactly as described. A short walk to the bus stop and pink line makes this a great location for those looking to use public transit. Michelle was very helpful and responsive as well!

The place is adequate as described. At best it is functional. The neighborhood has restaurants and amenities that are the strongest point. It is ethnically diverse which appeals to my family, and needs to meet the expectations of any future residents who understand this. With more work, it could be a better place to spend time.
Good access to metro- not too far from the loop and very close to museums.

My daughter and I stayed for a week and had a great time. We walked to lots of nearby places—such as parks, restaurants, and grocery stores—and took the bus and nearby blue line when wanting to go further away. The place felt like home, and we had everything we needed.

This location was perfect for our stay. Easy stroll to the Riverwalk (15 min) , Magnificent Mile (5 min), Navy Pier (20 min - way easier than driving or Lyft in traffic), coffee, restaurants, groceries. Felt safe and at home - doormen were wonderful. View of Lake Michigan on the 52nd floor breathtaking at all hours. Felt incredibly spoiled with laundry (including detergent), which made outfit planning so much easier.  City noise minimal given how high up it is. Did not get to use the pool but looked very nice in person - my son enjoyed the gym.
The place worked out perfect for us. We were going to Savannah Banana Games. It was close to “L” . The house was very comfortable.
It was a great place to stay. Thank you for the kindness and hospitality!

Terrific location in the South Loop, steps from the red line, and a short walk to Grant Park / Millennium Park. Charming historic building. A bus stop is right outside, which I kind of liked because there were often people standing there.
Comfortable and clean studio w great bed, large windows, and fully functioning kitchen and bathroom, including silverware, shampoo, etc.
You will be most comfortable if you are not bothered by external noise (the green line “el” train runs very close — with my earplugs, this was a non-issue) nor some cigarette smoke (it came through the vents from other units during my stay — the building is supposedly smoke-free, and there are other short-term rentals, so hopefully you’ll be luckier than I was).
Host Ping was responsive.
Overall a good value for downtown Chicago, and I’d stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay at Wanda’s Airbnb for a getaway weekend in Chicago. The place was nicely updated and was very clean and well maintained. It was walkable to nearby shops and local bars and restaurants. The sound machines in the bedrooms were a nice touch as well since it was something we are used to using at home. We would definitely recommend staying here if you are looking to stay in one of the northern neighborhoods of Chicago!
It has been a nice staying home. We like it it's not far from the city.
We had a great stay, very clean.

This place was great. In walking distance to McCormick place which is what we needed. Very clean & accommodating. Host was great with communication and responded every-time with 10 minutes.
Will definitely book again in the future!
Great place to stay. Just a quick walk to the beach. We loved it!

Simon est très amical et nous a accueilli comme si nous étions sa famille.
Nous avons apprécié le calme de la rue après l’agitation du centre-ville
Just right for what I needed!

Kyriako’s place was the perfect size for the two of us. It was clean, quiet, and conveniently located for our needs. Kyriako provided us with clear instructions and was very responsive. We look forward to our next stay there.

This is truly a phenomenal place. We had a lot of family to accommodate, and this was absolutely perfect. Great location, gorgeous interior, plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms, well-decorated, clean, everything we could possibly ask for.

A fantastic deal, and well worth the price.
Sure, it may be a little barebones, but it's safe, private, and shockingly quiet (I didn't need earplugs at night and I'm pretty sensitive to noise, it really was dead silent even with baseball games happening just a block away)
A very short walk to the train and to the bus, lots nearby within walking distance.
I didn't spend much time here (pretty much was only here to eat, sleep, and bathe) but the time I did spend was peaceful enough. Would definitely recommend to any traveler on a budget.
We had such a lovely stay!
Great stay! Fun area! Helpful and kind host. Would recommend and book again!
Great apartment in a fantastic location.  John was great to communicate with - highly recommended.

Matt’s place was great! It was super walkable to the train/ bus stations. It is in a safe neighborhood with great restaurants. Plenty of space with plenty of hot water. Matt was easy to communicate with and had fast responses. We loved the house and would stay here again.
Easy in and out. Clean, efficient. Nice walkable neighborhood not far from CTA stop.
Bella’s place was great! Wonderful location! We enjoyed our stay..

We really enjoyed our stay. We initially came for a White Sox game it was about a 15min walk very safe neighborhood to and from also about another 15mins to Chinatown walking. Plenty of parking and about 20mins driving to Riverwalk. Perfect place for 2 people everything was very clean and the towels and bed smelled fresh out the washer.

Had a lovely time! The place was spacious, great kitchen, comfy rooms, baby/kid friendly amenities, quiet neighborhood, and host was friendly and responsive. Main things to know is you have to take stairs to get to the place and go through 2 doors with codes, so be aware of if you have heavy luggage and/or young kids. Also note with traffic it can take around an hour to get into town by car or train.
A great place to stay!  Place was super clean,good condition and Mr Kwan was very helpful during our stay.  I would definitely book again!

The place was perfect for what I needed it for! Just needed a place to sleep this weekend, I was out early and not back in until late. The walls were rather thin but everyone else there was relatively quiet so it wasn’t really an issue. The room was cute for what it was and the bathroom was fine too. Jane was a great host! We checked in super late and had questions about parking and she responded very quickly considering the time of night.
Amazing stay
olga is a great host - very friendly and responsive! we needed some extra things and she has them delivered quickly, thank you :)!
Very nice place. Clean, spacious and comfortable.
Place was as advertised! Was a little warmer than expected in the basement but cooled down at night. Overall was great and would stay there again.
Enjoyed staying at Jevaux’s place, great location with lots of different things to do that are close. Inside the residence was perfect for my stay and was very clean and pleasant.

This was a perfect place to stay for my group of 7! Every detail was considered by Joan. The decor was just so, and anything anyone wanted was right at our fingertips or easy to acquire. It was in a lovely neighborhood not far from anything in Chicago. The train was close and we were very uncovered by the train noise. I'd love to stay here again!
Everything I needed for my trip! Great host, very accommodating, highly recommend when visiting Chicago on a solo venture.
Julie was great! The house was perfect for our stay and she was extremely helpful! Would highly recommend!

This is house is so well located and really beautifully restored. It is clean and spacious with room for at least 10 or so. The only issue we had was that some of the little things (no trash bags or dish soap, slow internet, no ice machine, empty propane tank). Not the end of the world and the host filled some of the requests, but at this price point, you expect these things to be more buttoned up.

My friends and I had a wonderful stay here. The unit is well maintained and equipped with everything you need. We LOVED the entertainment room and the home-theater set up.
PRIME location; multiple bus lines are close and the Blue Line (access to the airport) is close too. Easy access to the airport is big in my opinion. Finding unpermitted street parking wasn’t an issue for most of our trip; we only struggled once.
We didn’t realize how many stairs there are just to get to the main floor of the unit, so fair warning if you have heavy luggage or travel companions that may have mobility issues.
Cute, clean, and cozy! Had everything we needed in a convenient location. Super close to public transportation and the waterfront. Matthew was super responsive and a great host.
It was beautiful I loved the aesthetic and the area seemed safe.

This Old Town home is delightful! The modern updates have retained the beautiful character of this classic home. Everything is clean and comfortable. Our host communicates so nicely with clear and welcoming instructions, along with great suggestions for getting around. Plus, Old Town is full of eateries, shopping and entertainment.

I enjoyed stay and felt like home. The atmosphere of the stay is up to standard and the entire home is newly renovated. I also find that support person is easy to reach and help you anytime.
I find the booking is satisfactory, however the neighborhood is ghost town and easy to feel unsafe.

The location was the best part about this stay!
Walkable to many shops and restaurants, but it was honestly super small with not a lot of storage space. The lockbox was also very hard to open, had to ask someone for help. And the shower system is kind of a guessing game. Overall it was okay for 3 nights but wouldn't stay much longer than that.

We had a great stay at Susan’s place for our visit to Chicago!! The surrounding area is beautiful and super walkable. The place was super clean and just what our group of four needed for a nice home base after a day of exploring the city. We could hear the kid(s) upstairs at times, something to note if you’re a light sleeper. Hope to come back on our next visit!

Marty and Rob are excellent hosts. We felt comfortable in the shared spaces and very private in the upstairs loft. Marty and Rob's house is beautiful, filled with art, and placed a 20 minute walk from everything. We would definitely stay here again and look forward to it!
The space was very clean and neat and tidy, and check in/check out was super straightforward. My partner and I needed to be in the area for a wedding, so it worked out well for us!

This space was so well curated with a very farmhouse vibe. There was plenty of room and many things to interact with within the home. I would love to stay again and experience more of what the city has to offer.
The apartment is easy to access, the host was very responsive and clear on how to check in. Looked just like the pictures and was. Very comfortable stay!

Wonderful place and friendly hosts!! My kids loved the play kitchen and watching a momma bunny out the window.
Hosts gave us travel recommendations for Wrigley field, and lots of recommendations on local eats and places to check out. Would stay with them again! So friendly and responsive
10/10!!
James place is as described, great location for my event, great transit access. The AC was very welcome during the muggy Chicago summer.
Matched the description, very good place to stay
This place was very nice and I couldn’t hear the music from the bar downstairs.
The place was as expected, but the roosters next door woke everyone up way earlier than we had hoped.

The Air B&B was NOT in Hyde park but was in the Woodlawn neighborhood. Though the neighborhood may be subject to gentrification, it is not quite there yet. In fact, it was a bit sketchy. Some images were very misleading and amenities were exaggerated.
The inside space was very artistic, but the upstairs queen bedroom was overcrowded and lamps with non-working lightbulbs. The bathrooms were updated but lacked the listed amenities of botanical soaps and a hair dryer. The toiletries available were multi-use family bottles from a box store. The basement bathroom had millipedes in the shower. The towels appeared well used and unmatching. The icemaker was not working properly, the smart refrigerator screen was dark, and a lot of the chairs had loose hardware.
The outside spaces were unkept and overgrown and the firepit was rusted through.
Though I did not let this ruin my visit to Chicago, I will never stay here again. I feel I was a victim of false advertising
Had a great stay!
Great stay,  lots off room, clean
The place was great for our weekend at the White Sox’s. Kendal was very responsive and instructions were clear to get inside.

Such a beautiful Airbnb and amazing places all around. Walkable distance to pretty much everything you can think of. Tere was also very responsive when asking questions which made the trip 100x easier!
Great friendly staff. Comfy linens.
Great host and space, was very helpful and saved our trip last minute!!

Vlad’s home was an experience in itself. Every detail felt intentional, thoughtfully curated, and part of a larger story. From the art collection and vinyl records (including Coltrane and Michael Jackson), to the vintage liquor bottles repurposed as flower vases (c’mon, SirDavis!), to the handwritten welcome note from Vlad and the picture book created by his daughter, I felt genuinely connected to the space. That made it incredibly easy to feel right at home.
I’ve stayed in many Airbnbs over the years, but this was easily one of my favorites. Everything felt high-end and luxurious! From the rainfall shower, heated floors, and plush robes to the oversized, incredibly comfortable couch and the stunning marble kitchen island. Every shower felt like a spa experience.
The quality of the home made the price feel completely justified.
Great location
Wonderful stay at a lovely apartment - and a great host!

I loved Tammy‘s place. Both Tammy and her husband, Scott, were very helpful and friendly. Great recommendations and insights about Chicago.
What a hidden gem! I hope to be back soon.

The location worked well for us! We had a tournament at the McCormick center and this location was a quick drive with rare traffic. Parking wasn’t always easy but we did always end up finding a spot within 5 blocks. There is a bus stop nearby, we opted not to use. The restaurants nearby were great. We had a small issue and Victoria was responsive and made sure it was fixed. The house was clean and open. Would rent here again!
Great place for a weekend stay.
Perfect for what we needed. Would stay here again.

An overall awesome stay! The place was perfect for our group and had more than enough amenities to make it through our stay.
The WiFi was not cooperating the first day and Ivy was able to get it fixed quickly and even gave us a gift for the inconvenience which was super kind!
Would recommend this as a place to stay for the area and proximity to the city ◡̈
It was a wonderful niche space. A chill atmosphere and great walking distance to transportation. A nice weekend getaway for anyone interested.
La ubicación está excelente, tienes a pocas cuadras el tren, y el centro, excelente lugar, me volvería a hospedar aquí ☺️
Not worth staying there for the price.
Upstairs neighbors were extremely noisy, bed frame was cheap and breaking, big crack on hallway mirror when we entered, hole on bedroom door. Couch was comfy at least
Very friendly host, the place was great, comfy, clean, and convenient. Would definitely recommend.

Enjoyed the stay while my family, and two others were in town for a basketball tournament.  Great space, and great walkability to McCormick Place Convention Center and to the beach.  Would stay here again.
Incredibly accommodating and supportive host. Couldn’t have asked for more.

Dawn is a great host with a great place to stay. My group and I were blown away by the number of amenities provided.  Dawn was very friendly and responsive to my questions. I can tell the place was put together very thoughtfully from everything that was provided to us. I would 100% recommend staying here.
Great location walkable to major transportation hubs even easier than Uber from airport due to traffi.  Walkable to Wrigley Field and great restaurants and bars Boystown has to offer.
