Close to Chinatown and easy to take public transit to downtown and save on parking.
Check in was very simple with clear instructions. Space is large and as described. Host responded to messages and was very accommodating.
We had a great time staying in Chicago. Perfect location near McCormick place. Would stay here again.
Very responsive and very friendly! We will definitely be back!

Bella was well organized with clear instructions. The place was well equipped with needed items and close to the lake. Would highly recommend this place as it is central to all areas in Chicago. Thank you!

Absolutely loved Chicago, the apartment was perfect for all the activities we had planned. Everything was less than a 25 min drive. We really enjoyed Karlo g concert and the White Sock game. Food was amazing every where. The neighborhood was beautiful. Was able to check out a vintage shop a block down and an amazing breakfast spot next door to the store. The host was very helpful and quick to respond.

Great location.   Very walkable to all the restaurants.   Parking was easy.  Was able to fit my big SUV easily.    Walked to McCormick everyday about 20min easy walk.     Definitely will stay here again next time I’m visiting this area.

Die Wohnung entsprach voll und ganz der Beschreibung und den Fotos. Die Lage ist für Ausflüge in die Innenstadt perfekt, da die L-Station nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt ist. Die Küche war super ausgestattet, jedoch haben wir sie nie gebraucht. Die Unterkunft liegt an einer schönen Strasse. Einziger negativ Punkt ist, dass die weitere Gegend etwas heruntergekommen ist. David ist ein guter Gastgeber und hat sich zwischendurch über das Wohlbefinden erkundigt.

Cozy spot close enough to plenty of restaurants and cafes. Very clean and the patio/deck area is a nice addition. Overall, a great place for a long weekend and we were very appreciative that they set up and had a crib for us.
The place was great and so close to many bars and restaurants in walking distance.

We had an amazing stay here and would absolutely recommend it! The place was exactly as described clean, spacious, and very comfortable for our group. The location was fantastic, with easy access to everything we wanted to do in Chicago, and getting around was super convenient.
The host was wonderful and made the entire experience smooth from start to finish. Communication was quick and helpful, and check-in and check-out were both easy.
The home had everything we needed, and it was the perfect place to relax after long days exploring the city. We couldn’t have asked for a better stay and would definitely book here again the next time we’re in Chicago!
Great stay!
Great stay. Great value. easy communication
a walkable spot easy to get to/from via rideshare or public transit! chill, short walk to the pink line and the loop from there :)
Great location and great place to stay
Great location, right off the Blue Line and extremely walkable. Exceptionally convenient. Very responsive staff, thanks!
Very respectful and even left snacks for us to try! If we ever stop in Chicago again we would definitely book with Hoeun!

One of the bedrooms does not have walls that go to the ceiling. The doors are also sliding doors and have a two inch gap. The other bedroom doors also refused to close properly. You’d close them and then immediately one door would open again. As a result, this is not the place for you if you have a baby. The listing should be far more clear about this.
In addition to the doors to the bedroom, many parts of the apartment need maintenance. Chipped mirrors, matted rugs and moldy bathtub. The front door was also broken the entire time we were there and would not lock creating a security concern.
Great property & host was very accommodating! Would definitely go again!

Our family of five stayed here and we had a wonderful time. It’s in a really lovely neighborhood walkable to spots in Old Town and Lincoln Park. The free Lincoln Park Zoo is just a couple blocks away and our kids loved walking around there, the beaches are just beyond it. We didn’t need a car, public transit was easy to use with major bus lines a block away and an L line not far.
The place itself is quite big, plenty of space for all of us. The master bedroom is even larger than it looks in the photos. Both floors have great views out onto the street. The whole place was well cleaned for our arrival and very well stocked with everything we needed. James was quick to respond whenever we had a question.
Overall a wonderful place to stay in Chicago!
Hard to find a place in Chicago with a private in ground pool. Lots of fun. Great stay and responsive host. Would book with him again.
Nice clean place in a perfect location. Ping pong table was a nice touch too!
Marc was more than helpful. Went above and beyond.

This place was great for our long weekend in Chicago. The kitchen is well equipped to make meals for when you don’t want to eat out.
The bus stop is just a block and a half away that takes you to Museum Campus and into downtown.
The home is spacious and comfortable, and perfect for 2-3 people. I would definitely stay again. Chiaka was very responsive, and helpful when we had questions. We had a lovely time!

This Airbnb was perfect, one of the best we've enjoyed! The apartment was spacious, spotless, well-appointed, safe, and had a beautiful balcony with views of the Chicago skyline! Little Italy offered numerous food options and it was enjoyable just walking the neighborhood. Do take time to read through the detailed booklet they send when renting, as it's filled with great suggestions and tips, as well as the special history of Little Italy!
Great space for a group! Walking distance to our location. It was amazing. Highly recommend and will stay again

We had an amazing stay. The airbnb is in a good location. We walked to the blue line. James had a helpful walking guide to the neighborhood. We had everything we needed. The place was clean and entry was easy. Really just the best. Highly recommend it! Thank you, James.
Un excellent rapport qualité-prix sur Chicago. Cuisine très bien équipée. Chambre et environnement calmes. Extrêmement propre. Yingjian est très réactif et accommodant. Je recommande !
Great price, comfortable stay, and Michael was a very helpful host.  The neighborhood also was peaceful with nice shops in walking distances and accessible public transportation that ran frequently.

Luis' place is as phenomenal as he is a host! I was here just needing a place to stay, as a solo traveller. But this location is also perfect for more than one, and if you need some R&R away from home! Luis really puts the effort into his home and hospitality to make you as comfortable as possible. The bus stop leading to more public transit is just the icing on the cake! Would definitely stay here again next time i'm in town!
If we had known about the mold, as our host did, we would have look elsewhere. We only stayed 2 day and got a little congestion. Once this is fixed - it is a great place to stay.
Wonderful host! Home is in a great location.

Allende’s place was a great place and location to stay while visiting town for a concert at the United Center. Peaceful and quiet yet close enough to be downtown in minutes. Great communication and very responsive. Definitely would stay again!

Erika was very responsive.  She also communicated very well prior to our visit.  Location is great! Coffee and bagel shop is across the street and the L stop is just a block away. Lincoln Square is just a 10 minute walk through a quaint neighborhood.
Adoramos tudo no apartamento! Recomendo!
Loved this place! A short bus ride to the train station was one of the highlights for us. Erica was very responsive and friendly!

Do not hesitate to book Michael’s place!  It was super clean and comfortable and the location cannot be beat for Wrigleyville.  It was a family friendly space for my grade school age son and I.  We can’t wait for a reason to go back.  Thank you to Michael!
Clean, convenient, safe.

Esta casa es muy nueva, cómoda y perfecta para pasar una semana en Chicago con niños. Todo está impecable. El aireacondicionado funciona perfecto, Mil perchas y mucho lugar de guardado. Tiene un balcón muy agradable. Un poco alejado de mercados para hacer compras de alimentos, tuvimos que usar uber para volver con las compras y caminar unos 20' hasta el súper chino muy increíble que hay más cercano. Gracias a David y su equipo por la paciencia y todo los que nos brindaron en nuestra estadía en Chicago.

Host was incredibly responsive and easy to communicate with! She sent totally clear and explicit instructions for entering the unit and checked in throughout. With the provided parking stickers, we never had a problem finding parking on the street. There was noise from the upstairs tenant but when it was excessive, the host dealt with it. And it’s an apartment building in Chicago—you’re going to hear the people above you. Very nice, safe neighborhood and the unit was absolutely spotless.
This b&b was beautiful and clean! The hosts were always quick to respond and helpful.

We loved our stay in Dan’s apartment. It’s on a leafy street, calm and peaceful, yet only a short walk from Lincoln Square and its many shops and restaurants. The apartment itself was just as pictured—beautifully decorated, welcoming, and comfortable. The brown line is nearby, which makes it easy to get downtown. Dan was a great host. We would love to come back someday.
Thanks

It is cozy but spacious.  The perfect size and place for me.  Would be good for single traveler or a couple.  Had all the ammendies I needed.  Including sugar for my coffee was a nice touch!  Bed was soft but comfortable and had plenty of pillows.  Bathroom small but efficient.  Almost instant hot water which was surprising for an older building   Loved the neighborhood.   The L train is a couple blocks away. A couple of blocks further down is the lake which must be experienced.  If you want the Chicago neighborhood experience or just a nice cozy place to stay this is an excellent choice.  Will be the first place I will look for if I visit again.
Calvin was extremely accommodating and responsive. The patio was the star of this stay. It was private and having parking right there was a bonus.

Really not great. Police tower in the front yard. Bed felt like a sleeping bag. Very short ceilings. Host messaged me immediately upon booking as if I was trying to throw a party: “no other guests neither “to use quick the restroom” nor “to help you with your suitcases””

I'm not exactly sure where to start because this place really has it all: it's very clean, comfortable, and in a safe area. The furniture is fun, the kitchen is well-organized, and both the shower and toilet are spotless. The bedroom is also tidy, making it a perfect spot for a relaxing stay. I highly recommend it to anyone searching for a place to stay—families on vacation will especially love this wonderful spot!

Great stay.
Slightly noisy but there were several concerts going on that weekend. The upstairs loft is very neat but does get a smidge warm, but they provided fans to help with airflow! Overall great stay!

The space is very unique and clean. The host helped with anything I asked for, and response time was fast. It is in a very safe area, and close to a lot of things we wanted to do. I loooooved the shower!

Very nice neighborhood, close to the beach, parks, running trails, and you can even walk to nearby restaurants and grocery stores. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for the Chicago summer experience.

​We had a wonderful stay at Shawn's place! The home was exceptionally clean and stocked with everything we needed to feel right at home. One of the many things that we loved was the gorgeous backyard—it was peaceful and quiet surrounded by all the evergreen trees, my cousin and I could have spent hours out there relaxing drinking our coffee and wine.
​The location was excellent for exploring Chicago. It felt very safe, and we were able to walk to a nearby grocery store for snacks and drinks. Shawn was super responsive and incredibly accommodating to our needs. My family of 5 all thoroughly enjoyed our time here. We fell in love with Chicago, and we will definitely stay at Shawn's place again on our next visit. Highly recommend!
The neighborhood was wonderful to walk in.
My friend and I enjoyed our stay here. It was really spacious and organized. It’s close to 2 bus routes so that made getting around easy.

My stay was very home appealing and comfortable, I was able to sleep comfortably and peacefully, my only worries were leaving out and making sure I travelled in the right direction, wasn’t quite comfortable with the neighborhood, I was reminded several times to be careful especially at night. I only thing that bothered me, I liked joking and taking walks that’s one thing I felt uncomfortable about doing. But once I’ve made it in for the night. (Safe is what was important) Thankful to have Carla up above..
This place was perfect for our stay in Chicago. The information provided was clear. The place was clean. Check in and check out went smoothly. Would stay here again.
All was good we enjoyed our stay!

Darsh’s place in the West Loop was amazing! The apartment was spotless, in a fantastic location, and within walking distance of so many great restaurants. Ubers were also affordable and made it easy to get to the heart of Chicago.
Darsh was an excellent host and checked in to make sure we found everything easily and had everything we needed throughout our stay. I would absolutely stay here again. Thanks so much, Darsh!

This house is so cute and it’s perfect for a group of people! You will have everything you need, plenty of rooms, and in a nice quiet neighborhood. Not that far from the main city (about 30 min) and very drivable. Would highly recommend!
This is not our first stay. It will always our first choice for visiting  Chicago. Great location and amazing host! Don’t pass up this jewel!

We had a wonderful stay at this lovely apartment! The 3BR/3BA layout was perfect for our group, and we liked the quiet, central location that was close to several great restaurants and bakeries. The hosts were also very helpful and responsive! Can’t say enough good things about this place and the hosts, and we hope to stay there again on a future trip to Chicago. Thank you!!
Great place to stay. Great location, clean and comfortable. Will stay again!

Tracy was an amazing host! Her place is beautiful and in a great location. We had everything we needed for our stay. The neighborhood is walkable and very convenient for a visit to Wriggly Field. She was a wonderful communicator, very responsive, and provided lots of local suggestions. Our stay had a few changes on our arrival time, and she went out of her way to accommodate our needs. We will definitely be back!
amazing!!!
Host was very proactive and easy to reach. The space was as described and really clean! Easy instructions for check in and check out. Would absolutely rent again! Loved the place.
Great place to stay with a reasonable price.
Good place nice room

Overall, we had a good stay and the hosts were wonderful responsive, professional, and very accommodating. The home is spacious with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, making it a great option for a larger group, and everything looked just like the photos.
Our main issue was the upstairs A/C, which wasn’t cooling properly and made the upstairs bedrooms uncomfortable at night. The hosts provided fans, sent an HVAC technician, and refunded 30% of our stay, which we really appreciated.
The location was a little farther from downtown attractions than we expected, especially with traffic. Overall, we enjoyed the home and appreciated the hosts’ efforts, but at over $1,000 per night, we expected a bit more comfort for the price.

We had a wonderful stay at Michael's place.  It was immaculate, very spacious and beautifully decorated.  It is also incredibly well-equipped.  We enjoyed the air conditioning and also the access to a nice washer & dryer.  The beds were very comfortable with lovely linens.  The apartment is located in a lively area very close to the CTA blue line so it is easy to get to/from ORD and downtown.  There are numerous coffee shops, restaurants and shopping nearby.  There is also a weekly Farmer's Market just around the corner at Wicker Park.  We'd love to stay here again in the future.

Wonderful stay and upto date instructions.
Proximity to the city also helped :) would recommend the place

I want to start with the pros. The kitchen was well stocked with dishes and pots. No oven but that is common in basement apartments. The beds were comfortable and I love how you can control the exact temp in the shower. The hosts were very responsive and friendly And the place was super clean.
Cons: My froend and I had been travelling and we're tired and all we wanted to do was have dinner and drinks and sit on the couch to binge a show and catch up with each other. The couch is small and just awful. It droops in the middle and I had to keep myself from sliding into her. The TV didn't really work out for us. It look like a great big TV however the left side of the TV had a bar that would stay black so you couldn't see the left part of the screen. You are signed into Netflix but I was unable to cast anything from my device because the TV is signed into a different Wi-Fi than she gives us and I couldn't sign into any of my streaming services. This was a real bummer for us.
Great stay, with some great local venues and easy commute from Logan Square into downtown Chicago !
We enjoyed our stay at Christian's place. The location was very convenient!
Veronica’s Emerald Stay was perfect! Very clean, easy to find, great location, and so much attention to detail in the decoration. We will definitely be telling our friends about this place.

I absolutely loved staying at the townhouse! I was in Chicago for 10 weeks for work, and it was so nice staying in Wicker Park. The area is amazing - so many cool restaurants to try, shops nearby, and quite a few bus stops and Blue Line stops less than a 10-minute walk. I also really appreciated having an attached garage. Made it super easy and safe with my car. My family and friends were also easily able to park in the street out front every time. The entire townhouse was so well-equipped and comfortable, and all of the instructions provided were easy to follow. Steve was such an amazing host, always really responsive and proactive. Highly, highly recommend his place!

This air bnb was one of my favorites. The host was very nice and gave instructions and everything i need before i asked. The place smelt really good and was actually not in a bad area and parking wasn’t hard once you find a good spot on the side. It was a decent distance from everything you’d want to go see. There’s a family upstairs and they seemed so sweet and had a little family gathering when we got there and me and my friend felt very safe, no problems with anything and had a great time and would stay again. It’s in a garden apartment so it’ll be underground a little but it was actually so cozy and a really good price too.
Super great to work with! Space was exactly what we needed. She provided parking passes and check in went smoothly! Overall, super kind and helpful! Would stay again!
Very homey and comfy

The location is convenient and the Airbnb was generally clean. However, a few issues made our stay less enjoyable.
Parking was the biggest challenge. Coming back after 8pm often meant searching for street parking and walking several minutes through an unfamiliar neighborhood. I asked about a parking permit, but none was available. I also requested larger bath towels, but the host said only the ones provided were available.
When the power went out, the host sent instructions to restore it, but they were confusing. We ended up troubleshooting and resolving the issue ourselves, and it took over an hour before everything was working again.
Overall, the location and cleanliness were positives, but I don’t feel the experience matched the price we paid. Better essentials, clearer instructions, and improved parking would make for a much better stay.
Great place to stay in Chicago. The host was very kind and helpful.

We had a great time during our stay! The place was comfortable and just the right size for two people for the weekend. The host was very responsive and communicated how to get inside very well. We would definitely stay again!

It was a great stay for a very affordable price the train is super close and it’s close to restaurants and the lake. If I get an Airbnb again in Chicago I will definitely go back to this one. The host is very kind and responds to your messages quickly to help if anything is needed, Thank you
Easy access, clean and perfect for our family visit.
Great communication, great location, hope to stay there again.

Bugs!!Place was in a great spot and truly would have said this place was perfect but there was bugs and that wasn’t ideal staying at any place. Bugs were small roaches,  we all know small bugs can easily get into luggage and no one wants to take small roaches back to their own resident. One I maybe would have ignored but there was multiple cases and even old bugs dead in random corners that would have been overlooked by cleaning staff. It was such an easy check in and great area, smell In apartment was great but I saw too many bugs to not express that to future guest. I think about someone who is allergic to the things certain bugs carry and I know it’s an apartment in the city but truthfully for the price it’s not ok for me at all to see bugs in every room of the apartment. I still fear something may have gotten in my luggage. I explained  to someone I was texting  and they tried to blame the bugs on me, which wasn’t  ideal to read. Be realistic. Host validated my concern

stay was great. you will think the neighborhood might not be safe it's very diverse. very safe. Host very friendly and efficient. we had one small thing with a dish left which really was not issue but she was very accountable and accommodating. I would totally stay again. and it's right around the corner from where Obama raised his family and Muhammad Ali.
Awesome experience they were very responsive with every question. The home was very clean and easy to find. No issues whatsoever with anything. I’ll definitely be back

I definitely enjoyed and appreciated my stay! It was the perfect size for me as a solo traveler. I appreciated having the kitchen to cook meals. The steam shower was an unexpected perk that I enjoyed everyday! Nice, safe and quiet location. Free street parking!! Overall, a comfortable place that I will plan to utilize again when I’m back in Chicago!
Close to Wrigley Field, restaurants and CTA. Inside was roomy. Bathroom commode needs upgrade. Comfortable and clean. Thank you.
Had a great time here! Wonderfully maintained home with everything one needs for a cozy stay in Chicago. Stayed with one 2 year old and 4 of us and it worked out great.

There's a reason this gem receives good reviews: It deserves accolades!
We were impressed by the size, cleanliness of this lovely, fresh space. Marco was welcoming and very communicative. Great location, only 20 minutes from the United Center and many other places.
Good price for the value.
The only thing that took some getting used to was the hostel-type environment with other boarders present and sharing 2 bathrooms. But they were quiet and kept to themselves.
I recommend staying here when in the Chicago area!

Stay was perfect for what we needed. Mera was responsive throughout the weekend. Location is prime and parking isn’t too bad.
The one issue was the toilet handle didn’t work for the 3 days we stayed and no one came to fix it meaning we had to manually remove the back of the toilet to flush. Not the worst thing but needlessly annoying.
I would still recommend or stay at the unit in the future.

Wonderful stay, the house was immaculate and peaceful - smelled wonderful too. It is exactly as advertised and a little away from tourist spots but that was a selling point for me. 5/5 stars across the board
Great stay and a great price! Everyone was able to find the place easily and we had everything we needed while we were there.
We love the place and area it was perfect..
Great find, spacious well-lit and quiet unit (with easy nearby parking!) while only blocks away from tons of great shops and restaurants and convenient to public transit and lake shore drive.
had a great time and Vin's place had all the necessities and a flexible check in. would recommend would stay again :)

John and Lilly were excellent hosts. We had odds and ends requests during our stay and they were very communicative and helpful when I had a question.
The space was roomy and close to transportation lines and cool hangouts in the neighborhood. This was my first visit to Chicago and staying at John and Lilly’s place made our trekking through the town simple.
Excellent host, very attentive to requests and knows a lot about the area! Definitely recommend staying here :)

My first AirBnB and it was above expectation!  Enjoyed the location and privacy, the room was spacious enough and comfortable for my needs!  Grocery store literally around the corner to cook what I wanted to eat.  Only 25 min straight shot to the airport without getting on the busy interstates.  Appreciate Silvia's clear and concise instructions on both check in and check out!  Would EASILY use her place to again visiting Chicago.
We had a great stay! Very relaxed with lots to do within walking distance. Cute and cozy rental! Would definitely love to return!

We enjoyed our stay at Karen's home. We were in town for an event at McCormick Place and it was really convenient being in her home. We enjoyed visiting Chinatown (loved Mango Mango!) and Connie's Pizza across the street. When we had a question, Karen was very quick to help. The home also can host a large family well as it has many floors for space and lots of bedrooms and bathrooms.

What an amazing find! Hot tub, sauna, and this amazing steam shower! We couldn’t wait to come back at night to relax and play with all the cool stuff.  She even personalized it to our interests.  The best part is all the thoughtful personal touches.  If we needed anything we found it.  We ended up eating in most nights because we wanted to spend more time there.
The place is gorgeous. The neighborhood is fantastic. The hosts went above and beyond. I couldn’t recommend it more highly.

Lesley was always communicative with all questions and even agreed to a late checkout - everything was as described. The entrance is from an alley which can be a little strange when coming back later at night but then again it was all called out, so no complaints there. AC worked fabulous. Thanks for an awesome stay.
Great place to stay. Apartment was very clean. Within walking distance to explore the city. We would definitely book in the future.
Odi was very responsive and helpful with all questions and concerns. We recall enjoyed our stay.
Nice hotel in central Chicago.
Had a great stay. Very spacious and comfortable beds to sleep after a long day out. Close walking distance to train and bus station. Easy way to get convention center.

Very nice and cute space. It was great for my weekend trip and it was very easy to get around Chicago from the location. The hosts were very friendly and welcoming. More than enough room to fit my friends and I!
beautiful apartment!! stayed here for four nights with my boyfriend and it was amazingly quiet + cozy

This is a great location and place if you’re a solo traveller wanting an affordable place to stay. The location is near a the train station and multiple transits. The neighbourhood is walkable and nice. It’s also a great price to be near the Downtown area. The hosts were also very proactive and responsive with any issues.
It was a nice stay

We stayed at this house for 7 weeks and it felt like home by the end. The house was perfect- very spacious and clean.
The location is great and is a walkable distance from a lot of places, and the train station is very close. The hosts were very helpful and responsive.

we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this spacious two floor apt. We were four people,visiting family in Chicago. it was my second time visiting this city so last year we stayed downtown at the London House -lovely for first time visit. This year I wanted to be in a neighborhood. West town was perfect- about a 15 minute drive to wherever we wanted to go via uber. We all enjoyed the quiet area, having three bathrooms, very comfortable beds and a large living/dining space to hang out and have breakfast or watch tv. we were able to walk to coffee houses and a great breakfast spot - the breakfast house. A big beautiful supermarket was a 5 minute uber drive away. I would be happy to stay here again!

Good clean unit. The host communicated well and the unit itself was very nice and taken care of. My only comment would be the apartment entrance was a bit dirty and the highway outside was a bit noisy so we didn’t utilize the balconies as much as I thought. But, both of those aren’t in control of the host. We went to an event at united center so it was pretty close and Ubers weren’t expensive. I will say if you plan on visiting the city a lot this might not be the best fit because of how far it was and both train stations were over 15 min walk in a not super safe neighborhood.

My experience at Nae’s place was great. Beautiful home, very clean and well kept. The only thing I would suggest is to be a little more flexible on the no visitor policy. I am from Chicago and this was my first time back after a few years and I had family that wanted to come visit and they were not allowed to. I completely understand the no party policy, however, the visitors at all is a bit much. My mom wanted to come visit and I had to tell her she wasn’t allowed. Other than that, the experience was good. I had no problems locating the home, no problems with entry. Oh, lastly, for others looking to visit, the staircase entering into the home is a bit narrow, so be mindful of this when carrying luggage up and down. Though the no visitor policy is a bit much, I would stay at the home again.
Great location.
Great location close to downtown. Great view
Great location and responsive hosts who were super flexible and helpful.

Cute studio. Short walk from bus stop and CTA line. Though the shower would leak a little into the rest of the bathroom and we had some run ins with ants throughout the stay. Other than that, the hosts were responsive and friendly and the airbnb was cozy!

My friends and I loved our stay!! It was convenient and walkable to lots of great restaurants, coffee shops, and night life! The place had everything we could have needed and we loved the little backyard area.
I would definitely stay here again!!
Great place to stay and only about 15-20 mins from downtown. We will definitely book again when we come back to Chicago

David, our host, was very responsive and flexible on our arrival time. The house was clean and ready for us when we arrived. We really enjoyed the porch and back deck. The off street parking is really a plus as street parking fills up quickly. I would recommend this property especially for a large group.

Overall, this is a comfortable and convenient place for a short stay and offers good value for the price.
Pros:
-Great location. Beautiful parks and the lake are nearby, and the neighborhood felt safe. There is free street parking (not secured), and the Metra station is within walking distance, making it easy to get to downtown Chicago.
-Spacious apartment with a large living room and a good-sized bedroom.
-The host was very responsive, helpful, and polite.
-Fast and reliable Wi-Fi.
Cons:
-The air conditioning is only in the living room, so the airflow doesn't reach the bedroom evenly. The living room can get very cold while the bedroom still feels a bit warm.
-The shower/tub area is quite narrow, making it a little less comfortable to use.
-A small suggestion: adding a bit more furniture in the bedroom would provide more space for personal belongings.
Overall, the apartment offers good quality for the price, and we enjoyed our stay.
She's was very kind and pleasant to speak too very helpful and great location

We had a large group and this house was spacious and met our needs. The location was central and walking distance to many restaurants and transit options. The cleanliness was decent but could be improved—the floor and blinds were dirty and there was a little mold in the shower.

Sarah’s place was exactly as listed. A charming spot in a walkable neighbor that was easily accessible by bus or subway. We were in town for an event at the United Center and this was the perfect place. Sarah was very communicative, friendly, and flexible. Would stay here again if I come back!

The apartment was very nice, cozy, and made me feel right at home throughout the weekend. Since it was my first time visiting Chicago, staying here made the trip even more enjoyable. The apartment was definitely a memorable part of the experience. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the entire stay smooth from check-in to check-out. I would absolutely book this place again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
Great stay, easy for my daughter to get to her basketball tournament at McCormick Center. Host was responsive and nice with everything!

Daniel's home is very spacious, clean and comfortable. I love the water and snacks waiting for us when arrived, a nice compliment! He was very responsive and communicated with us throughout the stay. We were very grateful for all and if ever visit this way, would like to stay here again.
Great stay in a wonderful part of town, highly recommend!

This location was everything and more! It was our first time in Chicago and we had no idea how much we would fall in love with Wicker Park. The short walk to the blue line each day was so convenient. We traveled with another couple and appreciated the split layout of the home. We did experience some noise from the upstairs unit but I still feel like this property is a great value and you can’t beat the location!

Susan and Bill were great hosts, they truly go beyond to make you feel comfortable. Their place is pristine, it is small but everything is in its right place and is perfect for 2. It is a great place and just like other reviews mentioned  Bill and Susan are amazing hosts and truly care to make you feel at home. The garden is magical and even though we were only there for a night we really enjoyed their space, we had a chance to visit with them and really enjoyed our time.

I stayed in this apartment with my 18 year old son and his girlfriend on a weekend trip to attend a concert at United Center. I liked that we had 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and an assigned parking spot. The unit fully matched the pictures and was very clean and well kept. Our bedrooms were comfortable and had nice conveniences like a charger plug in the bedside table. Bathrooms had hand soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, extra toilet paper. Kitchen had dishes, pots and pans, knives, utensils. Our hosts were very responsive when we had questions or when a minor issue came up with the parking space. There is a grocery store, Target, Chipotle, other fast food nearby.  Not a walkable area, in my opinion. But the building and apartment were convenient for our needs.
Great neighborhood
Great place to stay! Very private and in a nice area. Easy to get where we needed to go. Really appreciate their patience with us!

The photos honestly don't do this home justice. The first thing we all said when we walked in was, "Wow, this place is HUGE!" Gustavo was an exceptional host. Communication was incredibly fast, he graciously accommodated our early check-in request, and he made the entire experience seamless from start to finish.
The bedrooms were spacious and comfortable, the heated toilet seats were a

Wow. We couldn't have found a more perfect place for my sister's bachelorette. Lots of rooms, beautiful space, everything you could possibly imagine needing for entertaining a large group. Karsten was super responsive as a host and check in and check out we're super easy. We had such a memorable time in this charming home. Thanks for having us!!

Our stay was lovely but parking could be a bit of an issue. We loved how close it was to walk to many shops and restaurants. Our favorite coffee place was A Cup of Joe. We went all three mornings we were there!
The host was very communicative and friendly. The place was cozy and walkable to most all the sites and the metro.
Great host!  Great location!  Great place to stay if you’re walking to Wrigley Field. Meeting other guests was a nice surprise.

The location was perfect. It felt very safe and secure. We were missing a chair at the dining room table and just thought it could have been a bit more “ready.” There was empty ice cube trays and one of the chairs had what looked like pet hair on it. The rooms were cute and the bathroom is beautiful. We loved the rooftop!

I highly recommend Heidi’s home. She is very welcoming and kind. Her place is very well kept and clean. Great location, everything is walking distance. I really enjoyed my stay, perfect for solo travelers like myself. I definitely see myself coming back soon!
The apartment was clean, the common areas were less than desirable but not too bad.  Very close to the Water Taxi spot in China Town.

I really enjoyed my stay. Ruth Isabelle was extremely responsive to any questions that I had ( which were few ). The place was well equipped in the kitchen. The bed was extremely comfortable. This was a great location as all local amenities close by & parks nearby.
A great stay.
Kai and jaiva were wonderful host! Super friendly and always just a message away! I would stay there again!
Miya was easy to get a hold of and responded quickly to messages.
Nice place and easy to get to the train to get where we needed to go!

This cozy apartment was a great place for my husband, kiddo, and I to stay during our long weekend in Lincoln Park. Beyond the basics (clean, comfortable), it's on a charming street that's incredibly close to the park, zoo, and lots of local attractions (e.g., Oz Park!). Bonus: only about half a mile to the Sedgewick L station. Maureen was so responsive and helpful -- our stay could not have been easier. Hope we have cause to return!

Me encantó la zona muy céntrico de los transportes públicos y la zona muy limpia y llena de ella lugares de todo tipo y el alojamiento en el departamento súper a gusto común muy bonita vista y todo súper limpio
cute place, very responsive host, and great location! we loved the large windows in the living room and the balcony especially- we were able to get a fantastic city view
Good location. near public transportation and walkable to our place of interest during our stay. Thank you!!

We stayed here for a girls weekend (six 40-something ladies) and it was the perfect spot! Fantastic location near all of River North’s restaurants & bars (plus a convenient Starbucks across the street). The apartment was just as described. I would absolutely stay here again. 5 stars all around!

My stay was very comfortable. The area was very quiet and felt safe. The hosts were very communicative.

We had a wonderful time staying at David’s place! It was exactly as pictured, had everything we needed, and very comfortable. David was a very responsive host and left clear instructions for getting in/out, what to do for checkout, etc. I would highly recommend & will be staying here again when we’re back in the area! Thanks David!

The owner location and price in Wrigleyville during the summer months is amazing. This is the second year we have been hosted by Brandon, but a didn’t property than last year. A++ host. Thank you for everything. It was an amazing weekend.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay. There was so much to do around the neighborhood. From shopping to nightlife as well as a cute Korean barbecue place down the street. Everything was wonderful, if you're looking to book definitely book your stay here.

Loved this convenient edgewater spot right on the red line, next to a whole foods and a couple of blocks from either Loyola or the lake. Perfect if you have some activities in this part of the city.
This is a brand new building and really well insulated from noise. Overall a quiet and enjoyable neighborhood and you cannot beat the included parking space, great working AC, and access to a workout space.
Dream rentals was very responsive to any questions, the apartment had everything you need for a week or weekend in town.

We had a wonderful stay at this Chicago Airbnb! It was the perfect space for our family of four—very clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The neighborhood felt safe and was a great location for getting around the city.
One of the standout features for us was the included garage parking, which made everything so much easier. The building itself was very secure and offered great amenities that added to the overall experience.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would absolutely book here again in the future!

This was a great place for two couples to share. We had a wonderful experience,  including bicycling the Lakefront Trail which is easily reached right from the apartment. Richard is a generous, thoughtful and thorough host. The breakfast items provided by Richard helped us make the most of our time each morning of our 3 day stay.
Very clean place in a wonderful neighborhood.

Great stay! This was very close to the United center for an event we were attending (about an 8 minute drive). Very easy to find and access via uber. Also bigger than the pictures it fit 3 people very comfortably. The host was very responsive and quick to answer any questions we had. Only con is that the water took a while to heat up in the shower.
The location was wonderful and walking distance to so many places, we enjoyed our stay alot. Would definitely recommend!!
The host was great and the space for 3 people was  perfect.  We spent a weekend and the location was very accessible via uber to Andersonville!

We had a great stay at Benny's home. We were a party of seven and fit comfortably in the house. We would definitely stay at this Airbnb again if we're ever back in the area.

This place was great. Had home like feeling. Very comfortable during my stay. You can tell that Blake put in effect and thought in to this place. I have not complaints. Great location for that I need. Street parking but plenty of parking. Overall a great stay.

The place was spacious for my family reunion group.  Lots of common areas, plenty of bedrooms.  James was very responsive to inquiries and checked in on us to make sure we were able to settle in. Excellent little apartment near so many wonderful Lincoln park gems

Darina's place was a nice stay for my family. I liked that she provided a pack-n-play, high chair, and toys for our littles. Wonderful Stay in Andersonville!

Communication with Emily was quick and helpful from start to finish. The instructions she provided were very clear, which made both the check-in and check-out process incredibly smooth and easy.
I highly recommend Emily’s place to anyone visiting Chicago and would love to stay here again!
Ramon

I do not recommend, I wish we had known the condition since the photos didn't do justice. Also would've love to know it was under construction.

I'm bummed we didn't have time to cook because the kitchen was incredible! This was a great stay with 3 generations of family. We would love to come back again.
We felt right at home here! The unit was beautiful and the staff were friendly and attentive!
The house was great for our girls trip! The host was great with communication and made check in/out a breeze.
Wonderful stay, exactly as described. Perfect location, safe and walkable area. Would definitely stay again!
The place was perfect for us for WNBA all star weekend. Clean, good location, comfortable.

Overall my stay was okay a 6.5/10 . The apartment was well equipped, clean and in a safe area. Perfect if you are attending an event at the McCormick Place. All good
Apartment was amazing! We were able to Uber into The city for a very reasonable price. Would definitely stay here again next time next time we're in Chicago!

5 stars! Nestled in the private and trendy West Town district of Chicago.  Spacious and well decorated unit.  Walking distance to local grocery stores and restaurants. Great spot.

Loved staying with Jefferson! The home is clean and cozy, and Jefferson was more than accommodating, even let me check in early. Would definitely stay here again. :-)
The place was perfect for our visit - clean, easy to get to, comfortable, and full of the amenities needed and as described. Most importantly, Sharleen was detailed, communicative, and accommodating.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and the host was very kind and helpful. We felt comfortable during our stay and would definitely recommend this place. Thank you for everything!

An unforgettable stay in Chicago! And a perfect getaway from the touristy areas. I prefer a more private, local experience and this was definitely right on point!

Nice spacious place, very clean and put together. Would recommend 100%!

Their response was refreshing and why I would stay at the property again.

The place worked for spending a weekend with some friends who are from out of town. We just used it for showers and getting ready and had most things you needed.

This Airbnb was immaculate, comfortable and the host had the best communication hands down. I’ve been doing Airbnb a long time.

Clean, safe location.

Nice place close to downtown. the host very responsive and helpful. overall very great experience, would stay at Duke's place again for sure.

I absolutely enjoyed my stay with Michele and Marsh! I can’t wait to come back to Chicago, and I wouldn’t hesitate to stay with them again.

The accommodations were everything I could have asked for. My room was spacious, the bed was extremely comfortable, and I had access to both bathrooms and the shared spaces. Everything was spotless, well-maintained, and truly felt like a home away from home.

Great place, good ac, comfy bed, easy check in/out. Would stay again!

We had a great time at Heidi’s accommodation. Location was convenient, lots to do and eat around Chinatown.

Amazing stay. The place had everything we needed. Very spacious and clean. Communication was excellent.
The location was perfect for us as we needed to visit the McCormick center. The apartment itself was great and clean and beds were Corey comfortable.

Very clean; beautiful home; walking distance to grocery store and restaurants; beach was walking distance about 5-6 city blocks away; host was very responsive to all questions I had. Highly recommend!
Great communication & Felt super homey!

The floors were very dirty, our socks/feet quickly turned black, and the upstairs sink leaked throughout our stay. The bathrooms were functional but showed noticeable wear and tear.
None of these issues ruined our trip, and overall we enjoyed the house. I just think for the price, having enough towels, cleaner floors, and addressing a few maintenance issues would make a big difference.

Peter's Airbnb is insanely clean! Immaculately clean! It is top notch clean! His customer service approach is commendable - guest toiletries kit in every room. Will definitely come back and hopefully it is available!
Loved the apartment and location and host was helpful. I do think that the housekeeping and towels and pillows could use an upgrade but happy overall.

Wonderful stay! Damien was an incredible - very hospitable and responsive. Genuinely wanted us to have a great stay.

Great stay, thanks for the host

Our family had such a wonderful stay! Everything Naomi described and showed in the photos was exactly as advertised, and we felt right at home from the moment we arrived. We truly enjoyed our time here and wouldn't hesitate to stay again. Thank you, Naomi, for helping make our family getaway so special!

Our stay was wonderful! The home was exceptionally clean from top to bottom—the cleanliness was the first thing we noticed when we walked in. It smelled fresh, was cozy, and felt very welcoming. Enjoyed my stay everything was very clean and peaceful.

Once we entered the apartment, it was a completely different experience. The unit was exactly as pictured—clean, comfortable, and stocked with everything we needed. Wing was a wonderful host.
We knew the apartment was beneath the train from previous reviews. Although trains pass frequently, the noise inside was surprisingly minimal, and we actually enjoyed watching them go by.
The views of the Chicago skyline were amazing! The location is excellent, with restaurants, shops, Chinatown, Wintrust Arena, and a dedicated parking space all adding to a great experience. We'd gladly stay here again. Thank you, Wing!
Loved it
Had a great stay and fun exploring the Avondale area. We were able to walk to everything.

The attic loft was perfect for my daughter and myself. It had everything we needed for a couple day stay in Chicago. Would definitely stay here again!
I loved the place! It was the perfect size for the 2 of us. It was very clean, and the bed was super comfortable! Great area that was quiet.

The next time I'm in Chicago, I would love staying at this South Side spot! My host communicated all details clearly and I found him to be a warm, caring person, very hospitable. To the east, you would find the University of Chicago and the Obama Presidential Center. I enjoyed my stay so I would happily stay with Carl again.

Throughly enjoyed this Airbnb. From the little details like the jewelry box, chargers, filtered water to the location and modern amenities. Most Airbnb’s look cheap and poorly taken care of. The only thing that could have made the Airbnb even better was a larger bathroom, however we understand the space limitations. Highly recommend this Airbnb and I will be back.
Excellent place in Wrigleyville.

My friends and I had a great time at this place. Nice location and easy to get into downtown. Sulaiman was helpful and very responsive when we had questions.
Great place to stay. Dan was very communicative and on top of things. I would stay with him again!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The beds were incredibly comfortable, the space was clean, and the high-quality sealings ensured a peaceful and relaxing environment. We truly enjoyed ourselves.

The location is unbeatable - super cute shopping, food, bars, and Blue Line stop within a few blocks! Having one dedicated parking spot was also incredible since we drove into the city.
Decor matches the pictures and is very cute, but I’d say the space itself definitely feels more worn than shown in the pictures.
Would also note that the kitchen is sparse so do an audit before you plan to cook anything here.
Overall, would stay here again since location is so ideal and it comfortably slept 6 of us!

The Airbnb was very spacious and comfortable for 3  of  us. Two nice bedrooms and two full baths.  Clean and tidy.  A full review guide online to review prior to stay and guidelines around the space written down.  Host was very responsive.

When we checked in, the toilet had been left dirty. I informed Bella and she offered to send someone to clean the bathroom again, but we'd already cleaned it up. Great neighborhood and the private parking was great to have.

Even bigger, even more beautifully decorated, and even more comfortable than the description implies. Plus a great host. This is the place you want to book.

Great location and an easy walk to McCormick Place, making it a convenient choice for events. The 2BR/2BA layout was also a plus.
We arrived after a 5+ hour drive from Michigan hoping to shower before an 8 a.m. event, but the unit had no towels. Only four towels were provided for four guests staying four nights, and despite requesting more, none arrived.
The furniture and mattresses were uncomfortable, and the walls were surprisingly thin. Overall, everything felt like it came from a playbook titled Just Enough to Get By as an Airbnb Host. It was serviceable, and I’d stay again if the price and location were right, but I wouldn’t recommend it over nearby alternatives.

Seans place was clean and  clutter free. It was easy to find and get checked in. Parking was luck of the draw but he provided parking stickers, which came in handy on a late night! Technically, Seans home *is* in a walkable neighborhood, there just wasnt anything we were interested in. It was still a nice, clean, and quiet place to land after a long day of exploring! The Karlov building is an older building (with gorgeous architecture and original woodwork!) so it was perfect for 2 people, but 1 or 2 more than that could feel tight. Overall, I'd stay here again!

This place was perfect! Better than the pictures show. The area is great, walkable to grocery stores, bars, restaurants, coffee shops. CTA close by if not right outside. The place was quiet, clean, super spacious. I loved the neighborhood, definitely recommend!

Bhavish’s place was incredible. We stayed here with a group of 8 for our best friend’s bachelor party, and it couldn’t have been a better fit. The house was spotless when we arrived, had plenty of space for everyone to hang out, and everything was exactly as described. The location was fantastic with tons to do nearby, making it easy to explore Chicago during the day and enjoy the nightlife. Bhavish was a great host and made the entire stay smooth from start to finish. We’d absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago, especially larger groups!

We really liked the place it was so much fun staying there when we got there the place was very clean the only complaint we had was it wasn’t that close to the city and we had to spend a bunch of money on uber rides but other than that we loved our stay and if we have the chance we would definitely stay there again if we just want to wind down and not do any activities.

We stayed at Alejandro’s place for two weeks. It was EXTREMELY well-located just west of downtown and near multiple public transit options (bus and train). Alejandro was also incredibly responsive to anything we needed. We would absolutely stay again!

Five stars. Looks can be deceiving: from the outside the building does not look like much, but once you are inside you can see how much time, effort and care the hosts have put into this apartment.
Everything was taken care of before we arrived. The crib was set up for our baby, the high chair was left out, snacks were available and the apartment was immaculately clean.
It is a wonderful two bedroom, central to a number of popular Chicago attractions. We walked everywhere, though there is also plenty of public transportation nearby if you would rather not. The hosts were attentive and responsive throughout.
A few things worth noting for future guests:
- The unit is a second floor wallop so just one flight of stairs.
- No obvious coffee shop right nearby, but Roost Biscuit Co. is amazing and only a three minute walk.
- On foot you are about thirty minutes from the Skydeck and The Bean, and about forty minutes from Navy Pier. Public transport available as well.
The apartment was quaint and just right for a weekend stay.

We enjoyed our stay at Theodora’s place! Everything was spotlessly clean and 8n GREAT  shape. Definitely will try and rebook for future visits to Chicago!

Couch is gorgeous but not incredibly comfy to sleep, but adequate. The beds are dreamy!

Great choice for Chicago stay!

I walked to a few great restaurants within 15 min walk and the space was beautiful, clean, huge furnished kitchen. Would definitely return! Thanks Nick!

Easy access to the CTA to get into downtown. The place had listed amenities to be able to spend a couple weeks WFH. Todd and Robert were very active in communication and assisted with anything I needed.
We had a great stay and would definitely come back!

Wonderful quiet place to stay in the city. Parking was surprisingly easy to find. Very clean, comfortable, and very nice to come back to after a long day walking around the city. We will definitely be staying here again when in the area.

Very responsive and clear communication. Very organized. Was close to the Red Line train which was very helpful to get into the City

This place has a real “home away from home” feel, much more personal than a typical rental. Connie was warm and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.

I highly recommend Charles’s place. If you travel by car, street parking is very easy to find, there are great restaurants, and everything is close. It’s my second time staying here and it’s the perfect spot for two people.

The room was very clean, everything matched the pictures. It was a perfect place to spend the weekend in Chicago, downtown was a short distance drive. Zen’s place was perfect, the bed was very comfortable, and the room had everything we needed.
Nice place, I didn’t realize about the parking spot but we were able to park down the street where we were able to park 24hrs free.
Coty’s place is great! Perfect for a weekend trip. They are very friendly and responsive.
Clean space! Would recommend and stay again.
Loved loved loved! Definitely would recommend to all of my friends and family!
Great place to stay at. Right by the train station that gets you downtown for events. The space was cleaned and it’s a good neighborhood plus the building is secured.
Overall, we had a good stay. The home was clean and matched the listing, and check-in was straightforward.
This apartment was immaculate, comfortable and nicely furnished. Rachel must have stayed here herself because every need was anticipated.

Fantastic stay! Ayla and Steven were extremely helpful and responsive. My wife and I stayed in Andersonville as we were visiting Lake Michigan with our infant, and they were very thoughtful in making sure we had everything we needed and felt comfortable bringing our baby. The house was well equipped, clean, and cozy. The surrounding area is lovely, it’s very walkable and there’s so much to do. We would absolutely stay here again if we are ever in the area!

This is the second time we have stayed in this unit.  It does not disappoint.  It’s as described and pictured.  Large rooms and very roomy.  Well appointed and very clean.  Perfect location to enjoy Wicker Park or take public transit to anywhere in the city.  Great view of the city skyline.

Roseanna’s place was very clean and in a great location. It was close to the subway, very walkable, and surrounded by plenty of good restaurants. Perfect for two small kids, they loved the apartment and the deck out back. Easy walk to Wrigley Field and the train.  The neighbor felt very safe and friendly :)

Charming apartment and a great value for the location! I unfortunately had to dock a star because one of the kitchen cabinet doors was off its hinges and maintenance showed up with no forewarning at like 8AM to fix it. Also I saw a roach in the building lobby.
very nice and clean apartment i enjoyed my stay for my birthday

We had the best stay at this Airbnb for a bachelorette weekend! The house was exactly as pictured—beautiful, clean, spacious, and perfect for a group. There was plenty of room for everyone to relax and get ready together, and the layout made it easy to hang out while still having enough privacy.

Definitely recommend this place as the location and value is hard to beat. Thanks to the host for a wonderful stay!
Wonderful place to stay for a quick work trip with colleagues!

During our stay for a family wedding weekend it was the perfect location. Walking distance to the CTA brown line and met our needs for space and relaxation. The patio was what really made our space enjoyable. Very clean.
Thanks for the stay and for being so accomodating

And EAR PLUGS for the thin walls. Other reviewers mentioned front desk concierge - no one at that desk during our stay. However, the online host was available and super responsive.
The cost was higher than I expected with added fee after booking. We also paid $50 to get in 2 hours early (never encountered that before).
I will definitely book LIVN in the future but will time my Chicago visits for less busy/pricey dates.
100% would come back every time I’m in Chicago. The location was perfect, the decor was great- and truly the best and nicest host!

We absolutely loved our stay at TJ’s place! The entire apartment was immaculate (very important to our group) and just as pictured/described in the listing. The supply of stocked beverages was a VERY nice bonus. We all agree we’d stay here again in a heartbeat! Thanks, TJ!

I absolutely loved my stay in Little Italy. It's right next to a super fun pub, but I never felt like it was loud in my apartment. It's very dog-friendly, and my dog loved living there. Hosts are kind and responsive. Would absolutely stay again.
El anfitrión fue muy rápido al contestar y solucionar problemas, pero el baño estaba sucio y el AC instalado en la habitación era muy ruidoso por la noche.

It was a great stay and I was very grateful to have a comfortable place to lay my head for a few nights. I learned afterwards that there was a couple extra events going on in the area which may have explained why it felt a little pricey for the experience, but it also could just be that is the cost of chicago. I appreciate that it was clean and comfortable, easy to get to easy to get in and out of and served my needs well.

Had a great stay at Will’s airbnb! All the beds were very comfortable and there was plenty of space for our party of 12. He went above and beyond accommodating our group, and we had a lovely time in chicago.

Our group of friends stayed at Grace’s home for the weekend. The space was very clean, the beds and linens were really nice and comfortable. You are in the heart of Wrigleyville! Grace was a great host—helpful, friendly, excellent communication. Nice spot!!

We’d definitely stay here again!

What a great place! It was quiet and comfortable. Such cute decor.

Loved it, had a great time and was ready to get to bars, restaurants, and other activities.

Hunter was an amazing host and so helpful making sure we had everything we needed!! The apartment was beautiful and we had a fantastic experience so I highly recommend staying here!!
