On July 9 I booked a room for three adults for July 27, as that is what I selected in the listing. Upon arrival there was only one full-sized bed. I reached out to the host to ask if there was a cot or any other sleeping arrangement available. Instead of offering a solution, the host sent a screenshot of the listing and stated that “3 guests” means 2 adults and 1 child, which was not stated in the listing and had not been communicated before we arrived. The host was rude and unhelpful throughout, and one person had to sleep on the floor. This experience reflects a clear lack of communication and courtesy from the host, and it left our group disappointed and uncomfortable. I’m seeking a fair resolution due to the mismatch between what was marketed and what was provided, and the poor handling of the situation by the host.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in and check-out were easy, and the host was kind, responsive, and made everything simple from start to finish.
We had a perfect stay at Robert’s place! The apartment was extremely cozy and an easy drive to so many activities. We will definitely be back next time we visit the beautiful city of Chicago!
It was grand
Great place! Vin is a Friendly host and helpful host!

My stay was within Beat Western River North. I have no complaints - other than a missing shower curtain, which was replaced promptly after I stopped at the front desk. If you’re looking for a stay in River North, this place does the trick! The bellhop was definitely the highlight. He was super friendly in passing and all the time!
Really great stay! Place was clean and instructions from the host were very clear.

We had a wonderful stay at Sandra’s place! The home was cute, cozy, and made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. As visitors unfamiliar with the area, we especially appreciated how safe we felt throughout our stay. Sandra was an excellent host, always responsive, friendly, and helpful whenever we had questions. We would absolutely stay here again and would happily recommend her home to anyone visiting Chicago.

The apartments was the perfect spot for our family when visiting Wrigley for a game. Super easy walk over. Todd was great and helped us figure out street parking even with the busy traffic from the game.
Nice place in good location.
Nice place to stay for a few days ! Comfortable and clean ! Not too far from downtown so we did a lot !
Mo & Ganna were very helpful with any questions.

Ryan was a great host! Communicative and gave lots of recommendations. The space was clean and inviting with everything we could need provided. Neighborhood felt safe. My stay was enjoyable, I will book Ryan’s place again.
Dennis was a great host! The place was exactly as described and exceeded our expectations. The outside balcony was the best!

The place was exactly as described, the host was very quick at responding and had clear instructions.
The place was clean and spacious enough for our group of 6.
I would definitely recommend!
Airbnb looks just like the pictures.  Avery is a great host, she replied in a timely manner and provided lots of information for anything we needed during our stay.

This is the perfect Wrigleyville property. It worked absolutely beautifully for going to a baseball game at Wrigley; it’s about a block away from the stadium and an easy walk. We loved the general walkability of the neighborhood. We were able to discover so many great local restaurants and coffee shops just around the house. The property itself is clean and charming. There were so many thoughtful details throughout, and the beds were the most comfortable I’ve ever slept in at an Airbnb. We will definitely be coming back whenever we’re in town for another game!

Great stay, Laura was a wonderful host and very responsive.
Apartment was clean, air conditioning worked well, comfortable beds

No exterior photos. Had we seen we likely would not have selected. It wasn't bad, it just wasn't for us. The lack of parking made unloading and loading challenging. At night it took 30+ minutes to find a parking spot. Taking the train to the city took an hour. The unit was older and could use some updating/refreshing especially for the price.

El alojamiento estuvo muy bien. Todo estaba limpio, cómodo y tal como se describía en el anuncio. La atención del anfitrión fue excelente y siempre estuvo al pendiente.
Como único detalle, se escuchaba bastante ruido proveniente del departamento de arriba. Sin embargo, entendemos que no es un problema del alojamiento en sí, sino de la construcción del edificio y de cómo se transmite el sonido entre departamentos.
Fuera de eso, tuvimos una muy buena experiencia. Muchas gracias por todas las atenciones.
I loved how clean & how consolidated everything was! Perfect for a small group & we felt safe.
Todo organizado lo único malo fue el olor al ingresar a la casa olía un poco raro pero ya luego el olor se fue todo fue amigable
James was an excellent host. Quick to respond and very helpful.
Stayed here for a summer internship. Host was very responsive, good location close to the blue line, and other guests were respectful.

The apartment was perfect. The host responded to us quickly and easily accommodated our early check in request. The host was super kind, friendly and attentive. There was also the cutest chicken coup, dining table and apple tree in the back yard that created the cutest environment for outdoor dining. 10/10 will recommend.

We had a great stay overall! The place was clean, and comfortable. The owners were very responsive and easy to communicate with, which made everything seamless. The location was fantastic and made it easy to get around and enjoy the area.
The only downside was that the upstairs neighbors were very loud, even late into the night and early morning, which made it difficult to sleep.

Rebecca is a most delightful person and a warm and relaxed host. She is so sweet, filling her home with many thoughtful and helpful touches for the out-of-towner. She shares her food and beverages generously and keeps a fully stocked fridge and pantry for a guest's random hunger and thirst. Her apartment is lovely, comfortable and inviting, and kept very clean. Though very personable and conversational, and fun to hang out with, she has an amazing knack for letting her guests have their space: Though sharing the bathroom, we never once crossed paths, somehow--it always was available when I needed it. The guest room is spacious and attractive, and has a great closet with nice wooden hangers. And a very comfortable bed! I feel lucky that I got to stay with this wonderful lady in Hyde Park!

Excellent place. Tucked in and accessible. Parking spot is great. Close to some cool places, including Sauce and Bread Kitchen.
About 20 minutes walk to Granville red line; definitely doable if you're used to walking.
Place felt comfortable and had plenty of space while not feeling too spacious. Well laid out.

Would definitely stay at Ag’s again. The neighborhood was lovely, quiet, and walkable. Nice coffee and restaurants around. Ag was quick to respond to all inquiries. The one drawback was coin laundry in the basement but I believe that’s typical for Chicago and all machines seemed to work well.
This house looked like it came straight out of architectural digest and was a wonderful place to stay for the weekend. 10/10 would recommend!

Very cute place. Excellent location, near to lots of stores and eating places all walkable or a very short Lyft ride. Safe environment with a lot of other pedestrians around. Went to Trader Joe's a couple of times, a stationery store, got Vietnamese food and bubble tea.
The loud train noise didn't bother me at all. It reminded me of the loud surf rolling in at home. Nice dark out curtains and north facing bedroom windows allowed me to sleep in. Huge space with lovely decor and high ceilings that I love a lot. Didn't need much but used the hot pot and mwave. Very enjoyable and relaxing stay. Wished I had a longer stay.

I had an amazing stay at Maurizio's place. The interior was beautiful and looked just like the photos. Everything was clean, the bed was comfortable, and I felt right at home. Maurizio was a great host and made sure I had everything I needed. The neighborhood was great and very walkable with lots of things to do. Would definitely stay here again!
We had a great stay!  We really enjoyed the neighborhood; it also was very easy to get the train to and from downtown.  Michelle was very helpful as we made our final plans for arrival.
The location was amazing if you want to be near the stadium.

This was the best place I have stayed at! Kelly was extremely helpful and even let us check in early! The place was exactly as shown and extremely clean. No complaints regarding the airbnb or host at all! Neighbors were a little rude but that was nothing against the airbnb.

The place was very comfortable, and The place was very comfortable, and the bathrooms were very clean. The only issues were that the bathtub/shower surround is too short, so water gets onto the floor when taking a shower.

We stayed as a family of six (kids range from 12-20), and the location was perfect. So much to do in the neighborhood and easy access to the train to visit other areas. We also had no problem parking our car on the street. The apartment was perfect to unwind and relax at night and for slow, laid back mornings. We would definitely stay again!
We had an amazing stay! The location was perfect and everything was accurately described and met our expectations. Would definitely stay again!
The unit was in a great location and the hosts were very responsive.

Great location in Ravenswood right on Lincoln Ave. Easy access, cute layout, spacious between main room, walk-in closet, dining and kitchen, and a *very* cool walk-out deck garden offering privacy and a small oasis within the building itself. Awesome hosts! Recommended for sure.
Our group enjoyed staying at Ian’s place. The location was convenient to everything and the apartment was just the right amount of space for what we needed. Would stay again in the future.
Excelente anfitrión,  todo honesto y claro !  Ambiente tranquilo a pesar de la zona
It was nice for the price. Not to far from everything you could ever want to do.

We had a great weekend visit in Chicago! The space was great for our family our four. Restaurant, shops, Lincoln Park Zoo, Green Farmers Market all walkable! The place was clean, comfortable and so inviting. Incredibly responsive hosts.

We had a great stay at Argelia's place. The Bucktown/Wicker Park neighborhood is lovely, and it was easy to get to anywhere we wanted to go. We especially appreciate that we were able to store our luggage while we explored on our last day. Thank you again!

Loved our stay!  Excellent location within walking distance from Wrigley and that area. Looked just like the photos and lived up to the listing.  Definitely will remember this spot for our next trip to Chicago!

We stayed here with a group of 6, and there was plenty of beds. Wish there was more seating but the living room isn't huge, so we made do with the kitchen table.
Where we had issue was the a/c just simply wasn't working, and could not keep up with 80 degree weather during our stay.
It was so hot inside the temperature barely went below 77 degrees, and it make it super uncomfortable to sleep and hangout during the day. Host suggested turning it down but it did absolutely nothing, it just ran nonstop and couldn't get cold inside.
We couldn't rebook anything else last minute with such a large group so we just dealt with it. I wouldn't recommend staying here during the summer if the a/c isn't working still.

The Airbnb was in a great location and was surprisingly spacious. Overall our stay here was good. The only downsides were that the host seemed to forget we were coming so we didn't get the door code until after our check-in time while we were waiting outside. Also, there were ants coming in through the front door (even though it remained closed) that unfortunately bit one of my friends in the main bedroom. With a good deep clean and a bit more responsiveness, I think the Airbnb would be a great fit for friends looking to explore Wicker Park and Chicago while also having their own space.

Adrian's place was exactly as listed. It was the perfect amount of space for me and my family who get together once a year in Chicago.  It was clean, had enough dishes, and comfortable. Taylor St is approx 4 blocks away and has everything you need, boba, mediterranean food, Mexican food, coffee, lashes, threading, etc.  I haven't been to this area in a long time and was worried but I felt very safe. I highly recommend it!
Todo increíble, solo me gustaría que fueran más flexibles con el clima frío, al ser latinos no soy acostumbrada al clima. Pero en general todo increíble. La cocina maravillosa y el baño increíble...
I enjoyed my time; Erica was an excellent host.
Everything was great. Caroline went above and beyond to make us feel at home and welcomed.
We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is just as it looks in pictures and very clean! Melissa was super responsive and very accommodating. The neighborhood is cute and walkable.
Nice, clean space to stay close to the city! Host was very responsive and helpful!

Ari was very friendly and responsive and available when we needed her. The unit is really modern and cleaner that was comfortable and we were able to cook breakfast in the kitchen. It was compact with everything we needed. We definitely recommend Ari and her unit.
Great location! The pool was perfect and the employees of the building were very helpful and kind.
This was a great stay. Very clean unit and Christine and Russell were very responsive to our questions. Parking was a breeze and abundant. We will definitely stay again when we come back.

Such a wonderful stay! Friendly and clear instructions from host, felt very safe and was located at just a short walk from the metro, pharmacy/restaurants etc. Would highly recommend and stay again. The only con I experienced is that the floors are a bit squeaky so you can hear the upstairs neighbors walking quite a bit at times (in the early morning/but no thin walls) but other than that, an amazing host/place!!
Great place, very quiet and peaceful area and was easy to travel to and from.

Russell's place was very nicely decorated, clean and with all amenities. As far as the location of the apartment at times it could feel a bit unsafe and transportation into the city via metro was a bit slow and coming back in the evenings felt a bit uneasy.
Nice clean apartment. Everything was as pictured/described. Did hear some footsteps/running on floor above us one morning but wasn't too bad.
Ben is a great host. Walkable neighborhood. Quiet street with parking.
Location was fun.  Street festival during our weekend stay so lots to do. Close to public transit so airport transportation was easy.
We had a wonderful stay! The apartment and location were perfect for us - comfortable, quiet, and in a lovely neighborhood. My daughter wants to add that she loved the smarties :-)
Excellent location. It had everything that we needed. It was very spacious except for the shower. We really enjoyed our stay.

What an Airbnb!!! The place was clean and had a lovely concierge with security to ensure safety and someone always there to answer any questions. We traveled with a toddler and this place was surprisingly kid friendly! Not a lot of things for my daughter to break, which, loved. The pool was lovely and the gym was clean and such a nice add on. Definitely worth the cost for the safety provided, cleanliness, and such a responsive and helpful host!! Our only hiccup was the last renter did not return the parking pass. We prepaid for a parking pass before arrival and without the parking pass for two days had to pay for parking in the meantime. Receipts were kept and the issue raised with Cloud9. They were extremely responsive and apologetic about the inconvenience and the refund for parking $$ was issued within a week. They were prompt, professional, and everything you could want with a host! Highly recommend. We will certainly be staying here again when we return to Chicago!!
Great for what we needed
It was easy to find and check in. As accommodating as possible and the place looked better than the pics posted. Super clean and comfortable. Would book over and over again with this host and brand.
I love the location is fine. Anything to eat
We loved our stay here! Convenient for a night in the city and cozy for a night in! Host were helpful and accommodating.

OMG!!  My boys loved it. I booked the place for a 21st birthday weekend and my son and his friends had a great time.  Mary, is dedicated to providing the best experience and her place is the great location for first time visitors. Their weekend was packed with lots to do in the Chicago Wrigley area.  Highly recommend a stay.  Thanks Mary!!
She answered every question that we had really good with communication,  very nice place and very nice area as well. Will definitely consider it as a option in the future!!

Amazing find for our large group! Everything was exactly as described and perfect for our weekend. Michael was so, so helpful and responsive! Very kind and was VERY FAST at answering questions before we arrived. The backyard outside area is such a lovely gem as well. Definitely one of my favorite airbnb hosts - 10/10 would recommend!!
Good location between the airport and Chicago's city center. Nice and quite surroundings. Great address for family of 4.
Great place to stay!
Loved the theme! Location was great, would 100% stay here again.

The Blue Abode was perfect for our 3 night stay in Chicago.
Walkable to many restaurants and a 10 minute walk to the Blue line.
The apartment is tastefully decorated and we instantly felt at home. .
The space has a very comfortable couch, and the bed is wonderful.
The kitchen is well equipped and perfectly organized.
We wouldn't hesitate choosing The Blue Abode on our next trip!
My stay at Jason’s apartment was perfect. The cleanliness and location were a 10 out of 10. I would definitely stay again my next time in Chicago

Affordable accommodations
This was exactly what we needed for our weekend plans, great location in a cute neighborhood.
Very clean place. It looks just like the photos and the host was very responsive throughout the entire stay if needed contact. Would absolutely stay here again.

Jared’s place was all that it said it was in the listing. Perfect for our group of girls. Good location and easy to get in and out. Only thing I could say that would need attention would be the bathroom cleaning.

We had a great stay here! It’s very cozy and in a good location. We were here for a weekend and parking was never an issue.

The only issue we had here was the internet. It is super spotty and stops working frequently. We were out most of the weekend so that wasn’t a big deal. If you’re not relying on internet I would definitely recommend the stay!

We had a very nice stay at Emily’s place. The neighborhood is really nice with a couple of casual breweries right down the street. Communicating with Emily leading up to arrival was a breeze and the apartment was comfortable. Thanks for everything!
great week stay. Walkable to lots of restaurants,  parks, and shops. we did not hear the upstairs neighbors.  The kitchen was sufficient for cooking. We easily walked to the train.
We stayed at Lakeia’s place for a few days and  it was excellent. Very peaceful and quiet and within driving distance of the city centre. Would definitely stay again if we are in Chicago again!
This was a beautiful, clean place in a great, quiet neighborhood. Great restaurants and shopping were in walking distance. Perfect for our girls weekend!
Solid spot. Nice area. Apartment isn’t quite as nice as the photos make it out to be but it’s more than worth the money and the host was responsive and very helpful. Would recommend.
The Neighborhood was a great spot for a work trip! A great hybrid of hotel and apartment living made me feel at home but with all the modern amenities of great hotel customer service.
Great host very responsive! Loved the air bnb itself great space for a group. Only thing I wish we could’ve changed was being closer to a train station and not just the bus stop.
I love the Airbnb one of the best I done had. Nice and friendly host.
We had a lovely time, we did have an issue with the bed. Jacob responded quickly to discuss the issue.
Entry was so easy, Valeriy was very communicative with instructions, rules, and check-ins. The place was very clean and quiet, a great place to come rest in after a long day roaming around Chicago.

Such a lovely and warm place. Anytime I'm in that area and need a place to stay, I will always request this place. Rochelle was a great host. The place was so clean and comfortable. She should really do a presentation on how to present an AirBnB stay and the things require in the place, for the guest stay. Keep up the good work Rochelle.

The rental is fine if you’re simply looking for a basic place to stay, but overall it felt pretty bare-bones. A few thoughtful additions would make a big difference, such as providing a complete set of bath towels for each guest—including bath towels, hand towels, and washcloths—as well as a full-length mirror.
The amenities provided also felt very budget/basic, which affected the overall experience. Upgrading some of the smaller details and amenities would go a long way toward making the space feel more comfortable, polished, and welcoming.
Gloria is an excellent hostess who provides a welcoming place and a comfortable room.

Hosted 10 guys in Chicago for my bachelor party and the place was great for us. Lots of space to lounge and ample beds. Great location that’s not too far of a walk to the Milwaukee Ave corridor and other places to eat. Very responsive host

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The hosts were incredibly kind and welcoming, making us feel at home from the moment we arrived. They also gave us several great recommendations for places to visit in Chicago, which made our trip even more enjoyable. We truly appreciated their hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Gracias Lois y Eduardo por hacernos sentir en casa y por todas las recomendaciones. También a Leo por ser un perrito muy lindo y súper amigable! ❤️
Mi familia y yo esperamos volver pronto!
A lovely and comfortable place always making sure we are well and comfortable… I love it
Was a lot but similar to other rentals we researched. We preferred the location of this rental.

This is by far the best Air Bnb experience I’ve had! Ewa was so kind, helpful, and knowledgable about everything in the area. Her photos really do not do the place justice, it’s so much more beautiful, unique, and cozy on the inside! Would recommend to anyone :)

We were very pleased with Justin’s place. Everything was exactly as described —- and very clean and had everything we needed.
Whenever I communicated with Justin he got back to me right away. And we loved the location —close to my daughter’s place, and also in a nice neighborhood for us to walk in and very quiet.

Had a great weekend! The place looked exactly like the pictures, the host responded to anything I needed or any questions within minutes, cute little studio apartment that was close to everything! Would defy stay again in the future! Thanks again for being great host!

We stayed at Charlotte’s Place with our two kids while we were in town to see the Savannah Bananas at Wrigley Field. The loft was very cute, comfortable, and had everything we needed for our stay. The walk to Wrigley Field was easy, and we loved the charming neighborhood. We’d definitely stay here again!

I've travelled the world and have stayed at many rental properties along the way. This location is hands down the best one we've ever experienced. The description of the property is a exact as it can get. The 45 second walk to Wrigley Field, the views, neighborhood, cleanliness and proximity to restaurants and bars is mind blowing. Within 15 minutes of being in the property, my wife tells me we are booking this location multiple times in the future. Whether you're there for a Cubs game, or the Savannah Bananas or just for fun, this is absolutely the biggest hidden gem around.

I had a great stay in Chicago! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and the host was friendly and responsive throughout my stay. I really enjoyed my visit and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to others.

Kash was such a good host! Super helpful and responsive. Check in/out process was super easy as well. The place was spacious, and the bed was comfortable! Soft comforter too! The bathroom was newly renovated and the 3 faucet options in the shower was cool. Neighborhood was quiet and felt safe when we walked to a diner called Sweet  Cafe (5 min walk from airbnb) Highly recommend!! Honestly the space was perfect for us  and we would definitely book again!!
we loved our stay here and would 100% book again!!

Great spot. Great location. Very clean.
Easy to find. Responsive host. Building concierge was very friendly. It also gave me the privacy I needed.

While Ann was very responsive and friendly, the house was not up to the standards you’d expect for a house at this price point and the pictures made it look much better than it was. Half of the bedrooms can only be accessed by going down the outdoor stairwell to a completely separate unit - and that bathroom has some drainage issues and smells bad. There are no locked gates in the front or back of the house so anyone can walk into the backyard/patio. The garage door and closet doors had no door handles. The couch, bed linens, and rugs all had significant stains and hairs. The outdoor furniture also had tears and stains. The kitchen and bathroom cabinets were messy and unorganized like leftover items from previous groups were shoved in them and forgotten. The AC broke on our last day and while that’s not the host’s fault we expected them to be of more help to provide fans or offer other solutions. While it’s a nice location, it definitely needs some attention to detail.
Friendly neighborhood location that was convenient to downtown Chicago. The bedrooms were nice and the couch and dining table fit our group. It was a great base for the long weekend.
Great place !

Great location, host was very helpful and promptly response.
Clear instruction from day one we booked the Airbnb. Very cozy loft and clean.

We were in Chicago for my birthday. We had such a wonderful time. The condo location is awesome. We walked to everything but Second City—we took an uber. The doorman was friendly and wonderful. The building is awesome. Sat by the pool one afternoon. The condo was clean, modern, modern kitchen and relaxing. The view was spectacular.  We discussed returning for my birthday next year

Great location and a great place to stay! Musa was helpful and quickly responded when we had minor issues. The neighborhood is extremely convenient to nearby restaurants and cafes, which is exactly what we were looking for. Would definitely recommend!
Great location near Wrigley and lots of great food options in walking distance.  Our family really enjoyed our stay there.
Katty was great and her place was pristine

We had a great time in Chicago, but this Airbnb was disappointing. The exterior stairs were extremely steep and not mentioned in the listing. Inside, we found several cleanliness and maintenance issues, including used tissues and medicine bottles left in drawers, peeling bathroom paint, a broken sink, dirt on the floors, a dirty shower curtain, mold in the coffee maker and washing machine, a missing comforter, and missing couch cushions.
The space itself was roomy, and the mattresses were comfortable. However, after reading previous reviews, we noticed many guests had reported the same issues, suggesting they haven't been addressed. Overall, I wouldn't stay here again or recommend it if you're looking for a clean, well-maintained place to stay.

The apartment was exactly as described - very clean, spacious and comfortable, good AC. The location was great for us - easy to get to the areas we needed to be in. It's a beautiful space and a friendly and safe feeling neighborhood. We appreciated the local recommendations for grocery shopping and it was an easy walk to Aldi. Although some areas of the Garfield area are known for being unsafe, we experienced no problems. The 3 bedrooms and large kitchen were a great value for Chicago and we'd be happy to rent this place for return trips to Chicago.

Loved staying at Nicholas' place!  Perfect location: conveniently located at the crossroads of Fulton Market and West Town, abundant public transit options nearby, quick trip to Downtown.  Nicholas is extremely responsive, usually within 15 minutes time at most!  Unit is a spacious, well lit garden-level - extremely clean and very inviting.  Would definitely recommend!
Clean, cozy in downtown Chicago. definitely recommend and will book again in any future travel.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great—we were able to walk to nearby restaurants and attractions, which made everything so convenient. It was also very dog-friendly. Kimberly  was easy to communicate with, and we would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Wonderful place to stay. The host was very communicative and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

I absolutely loved my stay at this apartment. It’s close to all of the main tourist attractions Chicago has to offer. Elena is an excellent host—she checked in with us throughout our stay to make sure everything was going well and to see if we needed anything. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.
Location was great. Assel was very easy to reach and ask questions too. This is a good, affordable spot if you’re in Chicago for a few days.
Mera's space was wonderful! It was clean and spacious and near plenty of excellent resturants! Mera is great and very responsive!
Our stay was great! The apartment was clean and communication ahead of time was great. We enjoyed the neighborhood and will be back!

Esmira is a kind host, but the apartment had many issues during our stay, including cat urine smells, dirty towels, trouble with the lock (we ended up getting locked out at night, which Esmira was very responsive to and helped us get back in, but still), many flies + fruit flies in the apartment, a cat pooped right in the doorway, motion-sensor lights in bedrooms that wouldn't turn off, dirty dishes left in dishwasher....especially not a good fit for those with environmental sensitivities or issues with pet odor.

Our family loved this place.  It felt like a home and was very clean. It had plenty of space for adult children. There was easy access to all Hyde park has to offer.  There are grocery stores and restaurants within walking distance.

The Cub House was a great getaway for my wife and I. It was a great location and Adam left super helpful instructions and had good amenities! We would definitely stay again when we come back to Chicago!

Our stay at Kimberly’s studio suite was lovely! The space has everything you could need and is so close to Wicker and many other great neighborhoods, if you’re looking for a stay a bit further from the busy streets of downtown Chicago.
I did not realize it’d be such a big fan of the heated bathroom floors! It’s perfect for those late-night restroom trips ;) And the two cozy robes were a great touch!
Her recommendations were great and she greeted us warmly on our first day as we were heading out to explore.
Thanks

The airbnb's location in the Ukrainian Village puts it in an area which is quieter while still only being a short drive away from downtown. The rooms were clean, and there are also good restaurants within walking distance.
Imran and his team were incredibly responsive, provided instructions which made our arrival easy, and we're incredibly kind checking in throughout our stay. Overall our trip to Chicago was a great experience and we're looking forward to returning in the future.
Super cute place! Jay was super responsive and attentive no matter the time.

Aaron's place was spotless and the layout was comfortable.  Great rain shower! Comfortable walk to dog beach and people beach.  Short walk to the "L". As others mentioned, the AC made noise, but Aaron was very amicable and assured me that it will be rectified. If you like ethnic foods, this is the neighborhood for you!  For older folks - the lobby is dim at night and the hallways are rather dark.

We had a great stay! The home was very clean, beautifully decorated, and in an excellent location—especially if you’re planning to visit the Obama Presidential Center area. It was comfortable and well maintained, and we enjoyed our time there.

Everything in the house was as described, lots of space for all my family. The only downside was the garage a bit small for two full size SUV’s, but we managed to make them fit. The place is in a good area not far from locations we visited.
I absolutely loved this Airbnb stay!! It felt like home.
My guests and I had a wonderful stay!

Erica’s place is cute and clean! It had amazing light. There’s not much to do in this area, and not a lot of restaurant options/coffee/etc, but as listed, it’s just a short Lyft from the city. The building is pretty noisy with neighbors but overall it was a great place to stay.
The host was great. The place felt like home. I recommend staying at this place and when I return I will rebook again
It was perfect, great location, great apartment, great style and decor and everything from sheets to towels to dishes, we loved it!
The house was perfect for myself and 8 friends visiting Chicago. House was very clean and the host  was very responsive

We have stayed at mini Airbnb’s. This by far was the cleanest and most amenable! Chip and Lido, you guys are amazing! Everything from the lighting and the unit to the landscaping outside to the beautiful back patio that you created truly made an oasis and a welcome break from reality! I can’t recommend this Airbnb enough. It’s minutes away from the red line, which is an easy 30 to 40 minute ride into the heart of Chicago. Truly enjoyed this space, thank you so so much for sharing your paradise with the rest of us!
Inside was exactly as depicted.  Keys were accessible upon arrival.  Property was secure having separate entry door.  I had a couple questions during my stay that were answered promptly.

Brad's place looks like the pictures, it was spacious for our family of 5. Brad was responsive and accommodating. The building itself was not properly maintained and the hallways smelled bad, but I understand this is not the host's responsibility. Once inside the apartment everything was ok. Beautiful views of the lake and the city.  We found a parking spot that was about 5 min walk, fairly priced.

We loved our girls weekend getaway! The place was perfect, clean, had everything we needed and the mornings on the patio were beautiful and peaceful. I never had any trouble communicating with the host and they were extremely friendly. If I ever need a place in Chicago again I would book them in a heart beat. Thank you for being a part of making our weekend memorable! 🥰
Kind, communicative and attentive host. Was a great accessible location for all we had planned.

Listing looked exactly like the pictures. Checking in and out was seamless. The neighborhood is quiet. Never felt unsafe walking around day or night. Easy walk to multiple bus routes and the Pink line.
Gabriel is hella responsive. Super helpful and easy to work with. Enjoyed my stay.
Just as described, from location to parking to check-in/out. Everything we wanted for an overnight in downtown Chicago.
Perfect for what we needed and at a great price
John was a great host! I appreciated how easy it was to communicate with him. The apartment was comfortable and clean. My group loved our stay here!
Great place, close to lots of great stuff!
Great long weekend stay!
everything was awesome I loved the stay

This place is fantastic! The most amazing location for access to Wrigley. Timothy checked in to make sure all was well,answered questions quickly, and was always kind. The unit is beautiful, clean, and comfortable. We have already looked into staying here again on our next trip! Be prepared for the stairs…Timothy tells you up front about them, but they can be brutal! We loved the place and can’t wait to be back again!
Todo super excelente buena zona todo estaba organizado limpio el lugar es muy agradable lo recomiendo
Everything was great! The only thing I wish is that there had been a table and chairs, since there were six of us and there were only three bar stools.
This place looked just the photos. Great location very walkable and easy access to the trains. The host was very accommodating and responded quickly. Would recommend this place.
10/10 highly recommend.
Lovely stay

Very close to downtown, close to a grocery store, reminds me of when I lived in St Louis. You're in the city so act like it. House had many bedrooms and the necesites to cook, shower, and sleep. Neighborhood was clean and people minded their own business. Definitely people walking around at all hours of the night/day but no one bothered us, all was good.

The unit matched the photos and the location was calm and convenient, but the stay was undermined by real issues. The unit wasn’t cleaned thoroughly (floors were noticeably dirty), and we found a live roach one evening. We flagged it immediately and asked for pest control steps, given concerns about our luggage. The host said he’d “take care of it in the morning,” but nothing was done. Follow-up got only vague responses about someone “checking the unit,” with no real coordination, which was stressful since we’d left our belongings there. We also noticed a man sitting in the backyard for long stretches watching the unit; he claimed to be the property manager, which was odd given no prior communication, and he dismissed our roach concern outright. After checkout, we asked for a partial refund given the cleaning and pest issues; it took mentioning Airbnb escalation to get any response, and no resolution was offered.
Great area. Okay spot overall.

The stay was as expected overall. The location was convenient to what we were doing in Chicago, and check-in was straightforward. The space had the basic amenities needed for a short stay.  The inside of the home was historically beautiful and well kept.
Super Nice Space, Great Host, Beautiful Location, Would definitely stay here again!

Anne was a great host. We will stay there again when we visit my son in Chicago!
Thanks Anne!

If you're going to a Cubs game, the location is perfect and very convenient!
However, there were a few concerns with the Airbnb itself. The Wi-Fi instructions provided were not accurate, and we had to try two different internet connections before finally finding the correct one. It was a little concerning that the correct Wi-Fi information wasn't clearly provided.
The cleanliness could also use some improvement. The walls and bathtub were dirty, and one of the bedroom windows appeared to have what looked like a gunshot hole in it, which was definitely unsettling.
Nothing bad happened during our stay, and we did not have any direct safety issues. We spent most of our time out exploring the city, so the Airbnb worked for what we needed. The location is definitely the biggest advantage, especially if you're visiting for a Cubs game, but there are some areas that could use attention.
Enjoyed our stay! Cute neighborhood near some bus stops. Would recommend!
It was great!
Absolutely loved Bojan’s place. It was in a great location and parking was easy to find every day. All around the place was amazing and I would absolutely book again next time I’m in Chicago!

Anastasia is very responsive and friendly. The place is exactly as described and very clean. As there is only one shower and it is shared amongst 3+ rooms it can get quite busy, specially at check out time.
Great spot close to Chinatown! Ideal for our couples getaway. Apartment was clean and the area was very quiet.

My family and I really enjoyed the house.  It was big enough we could all have some space to ourselves. It was easy to walk to a bus stop or train. The bedrooms and 1 bath are down the spiral steps. It did not bother us at all. It is noted in the description but deserves to be mentioned again for those with mobility issues. I personally found it fun! Thanks for allowing us to stay!
We had a great time, the location if perfect for getting to Wrigley Field
The location was really great and communication with the host was excellent. The unit could use some touchups.

Great stay at Paul’s Airbnb. Host was very communicative and helpful. Very affordable and the location is great for a quick drive to downtown Chicago. We had no issues and he accommodated our very late check in time. Thanks Paul!
Excelente lugar. Mis amigos y yo fuimos a Chicago por un concierto y este lugar fue increíble gracias. Volveré sin dudar alguna!!

Best Airbnb in Chicago! I've stayed at Mindy and Tony's place multiple times, and it's my favorite place to stay in the city. The apartment is always spotless clean, comfortable bed, well-appointed decor. It feels like coming home. Free street parking right out front is always a plus, and just down the street from the best coffee in Chicago (Dark Matter). I always enjoy sitting out in the peaceful backyard to drink my morning coffee. Will always stay here when I visit Chicago whenever possible!
Perfect for my stay this past weekend! Very nice home and warm aesthetic. Would book again 😊

Great place for being in the mix of everything. The A/C could have been better and pressure in main floor bathroom was a little weak. Some of furniture was a little worn but place was very clean. Have a great stay!

We had a fabulous time enjoying the historic surrounding areas and local restaurants. The neighborhood felt safe and had distinct character. We had no problem finding street parking. It was a short walk to the CTA station and a relatively short drive to downtown attractions. The place was great for our family of four adults. The hostess was very responsive with all our questions. Would definitely stay here again if available.
Musa was extremely responsive and this apartment was perfect for our girls trip

**Pros:**
* Great price for the stay.
* The room was clean and well-maintained.
* The A/C in the room worked really well, which made it comfortable.
* I appreciated the help carrying my bag up to the third floor.
* The listing mentions that the room can be noisy, but I didn't find it to be a big issue. You can hear some highway traffic, but it wasn't disruptive.
**Cons:**
* As I was arriving, I received a message saying the door lock had to be changed. I really didn't like getting that kind of message while I was checking in. Even if it was completely legitimate, it made me feel uneasy. I think it's the type of update that's better shared after a guest checks out, unless it directly affects their stay.
Very comfortable. Needs some maintenance.

I loved my stay at Tim’s Bicycle Studio! It was a quaint space with all the amenities one could need for any length of stay. Loved the touch of their being bikes available to use during the stay. Tim was very proactive with reaching out with instructions and checking in to make sure our stay was going well. It was conveniently located far enough outside the hustle and bustle of the downtown seat that you got some peace but was super easy to get to anything and everything we wanted to do within half an hour driving but most of that travel time was accounting for Chicago traffic during a busy weekend! It was only about 10 miles from the farthest thing we had to do. Would definitely recommend this stay to any single person or couple staying in the area since it’s just enough space for you to stay there comfortably

Such an amazing space and a wonderful host! It was just as described and we absolutely loved the personal touches Sarah put on everything - from a personalized recommendation packet to a welcome basket filled with treats, bottled water, and daily parking passes! We will definitely book the Pilsen Gem in the future!

Space really exceeded expectations! Hands down most comfortable bed of any other rental I’ve stayed in. Nice quiet neighborhood. Easy access to public transit into the city. Hosts were always responsive and helpful. This space made for a great and memorable trip for my family.
Great location for going to a game at United Center- easily walkable. Highly recommend, very comfortable and clean. Would definitely stay again.
Jevaux’s place was super comfy and assessable. Located in Hyde Park within walking distance of the beach which was wonderful.
The stay was pretty good, but don't walk around the neighborhood at night - take Uber.
We had a wonderful week at the property. The location is perfection, the space is ample, and parking very convenient!
Thanks again!
Michael took care of us and was always a phone call away!

We truly enjoyed our stay, very centralized to the loop and downtown Chicago. Very walkable, close to the train which is right outside the apartment and can be loud at night but easy to get use to. The apartment was very cute and well kept, loved the look and very clean. Laundry is a plus and the pool was great just to lounge at one of the days. The bathroom was dark. Stephanie was responsive. Over all we love Chicago and will be back.
Extremely clean and great location
Stayed here with 3 others for an event at the United Center and the location was amazing!  Place looked exactly as described and the rooftop was beautiful. Would definitely come back!
Brandon was a great host and very responsive. The space was perfectly located for us, walking distance to everywhere we needed to be for the weekend.
Great Airbnb! Hostesses were great and helped enjoy our stay by being communicative and providing us everything we needed for the weekend. Highly recommend
Great location and apartment! Large and spacious with plenty of room for a group and children. Highly recommended!

Shay is an excellent host. Very responsive. I stayed for an extended period of time, and she was incredibly helpful when small things went wrong in the apartment. I would recommend this apartment and host.
Great place to stay, loved it
provided a great space for our retreat
Our stay in Chicago was made easy and comfortable thanks to Maria, David, and Beau! It was a perfect jumping off point for everything we wanted to do and our dogs loved the back yard!

Donald’s place was nice. He was great a communication if we needed anything. The fridge had some issues but he brought us another one. Parking can be a bit hectic but that’s Chicago parking in general anywhere you go. Other than that I’d stay at his place again for sure!

Sam’s place was the perfect place to land after a long drive! The area is very quiet and cozy, we slept amazing. We didn’t end up using the kitchen but it was so spacious, amazing meals could be made in there. The water pressure in the shower was a little low, but nothing too bad. Would stay again!

Place is beautiful, in a gorgeous area. Easy to get in, host responds quickly and is very helpful. Parking is a little rough as you either pay to park for up to 3 hours at a time in the street, or find a parking place close, which there is within a 3 min walk. Overall great place to stay.
Excellent location! Very cool vintage space. Room was a lot larger than expected. I did not use any of the common spaces, but communication was excellent. Would stay here again!

Steve's place was perfect for our needs- my husband, our teen daughter, and myself were in town to see Metric and we were just a short walk away from the venue. The space was comfortable and homey. There are many restaurants nearby and my favorite, coffee shops! Steve recommended taking the redline instead of driving and that worked out really well for us when visiting the art institute and Navy Pier. Thanks again, Steve and Loong!

Natalie was so responsive and an amazing host - her aesthetic was so cute and she had little touches of hospitality everywhere which made us feel taken care of ! It is a great location and the restaurant downstairs is so cute and delicious ! We loved it ! Thanks Natalie !!
Great location and nice space!
Great
Very close to Clarke street and many other neighborhood bars and stores. Great neighborhood.
Great location. Apartment was spacious and clean. No complaints!
Ain’t gonna lie. It was a good place and I like the house. I recommend the place. Nice places to visit

Overall a nice stay.
Pros for me were the great Andersonville location, fast and reliable WiFi, strong air conditioning, great shower, and the open, airy feel of the space. A few things didn’t work as well for me: the sheets are polyester and bedding all felt a bit flimsy, and the couch was not very comfortable. I also would have appreciated more hangers, shelves or dresser for clothes, and a full-length mirror. I think this is a great place to stay for people who like a simple, clean spot. If you tend to notice details and prefer a more upscale feel, you might look elsewhere.
Beautiful property. Excellent, walkable location to Wrigley field.
Awesome stay!

Very spacious home! We arrived in the later evening, got in easy, but a bit later there were some scary noises outside. It only happened the first night and during the day the neighborhood was very peaceful. The location is a very convenient walk away from the bus which takes you to the red line. There could have been more available blankets and only one of the bathrooms had body wash. Overall our stay was good, LaKesha was very kind and responsive and made sure to check up on us.
Clean, quiet, comfortable beds.
This is a very nice and comfortable stay. Three good size bedrooms upstairs. The kitchen is fully equipped. There’s a nice front porch stoop to sit out and relax and see the neighborhood pass you by.
Great location and very close walking distance to public transportation. Safe neighborhood and very quiet.

We had a great stay! We had a group of 10, and there was more than enough space for everyone to spread out and be comfortable. The house was super clean and had everything we needed.
The host was awesome—communication was clear, they responded quickly whenever we had a question, and everything was easy from check-in to check-out. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago, especially if you’re traveling with a bigger group. We’d happily stay here again!

Abe was an excellent host. Great communicator, quick and helpful. His place was as advertised! My larger group and I all felt very comfortable and really enjoyed our stay ! There were also a lot of lounging areas to hang out !

We had a wonderful stay! Our host was responsible, responsive, and incredibly accommodating throughout our trip. He was helpful with any questions we had and made the entire experience smooth from check-in to check-out. The location was excellent—convenient, walkable, and perfect for exploring the area. We’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it to others!
Smooth check in and check out, great deal for a clean and private place to rest and freshen up during my stay in Chicago!

We loved staying with Sue! There were two different bus stops within a 10 minute walk but her home still had a private and quiet feel. She was great with communicating where the shared spaces were and we were able to co-exist peacefully for the duration of our stay. The bedroom and bathroom were upstairs so we had our own private space as well. Before we even left my fiancé said we should book with her again.

Amazing location it the heart of Lake view, close to a lot of things to do and places to eat. Easy access to downtown, apartment was squeaky clean and with everything you might need, Thomas was super responsive and helpful with clear instructions. Highly recommended.

Alex’s place was fantastic. The apartment was very easy to find and I was able to get quite easily. Inside it was very clean and spacious.
Although the location is on a busy active street the apartment was very quiet.
The kitchen was well equipped to cook a meal but there are so many restaurants around the area you won’t need to use it!
The garage was private and secure and big enough for my SUV.
As an added bonus the piano works if you are looking to play :)
I would definitely stay there again.

Great home! Will visit again if we ever travel to Chicago again. Rooms were big and spacious, ceiling fans and AC work great! Only recommendation would be to put something up over the opening in master bathroom no privacy using rest room if someone is in the room.
The loveliest Airbnb! Eclectic design made it feel homey and fancy at the same time. Loved the comfort of it all. Everything you need is there with a balcony all your own. Would definitely return.
Thank you for welcoming my friends and their small children. You made their visit so much easier

Overall, we had a good stay. The location was convenient, and the neighborhood felt safe for the most part. Keep in mind that, depending on traffic, it can take a while to get to some of the main attractions, and Uber/Lyft fares can become expensive during busy times. If you're relying on public transportation, expect some delays as well.
The space and beds were a bit smaller than we expected based on the listing photos, especially for four adults. If you're staying with a group, just know there are only two mirrors in the apartment (one in the bathroom and one just outside of it), so getting ready may take a little longer. Adding more mirrors in the rooms would be a nice improvement.
Milton was a good host. He was very responsive, answered all of our questions promptly, and made communication easy throughout our stay.
Es un lugar muy seguro, limpio y a unos pasos de varios lugares icónicos de la ciudad.

This was terrible. I wanted to leave from day one. When we got there, the police was surrounded by cops and had yellow tape all around. We had to actually walk under the yellow tape to get inside of his house. He had just got back. I’m going out with this girl and she is the one that let us in, but she had no idea where we were staying and she was drunk. He was a nice guy and very responsive. He ended up having to stay in his bedroom. I don’t even think the sheets or pillowcases were changed. The bathroom was disgusting. There was people in the bathtub in the toilet had not been cleaned in a long time. I cannot tell you how terrible of experience this was for me. I was disgusted for all three nights. I wanted to just take the loss and rent a different Airbnb. I wish I could get a refund. I have pictures. The kitchen was dirty as well and old food in the fridge.

We stayed four nights and had a really good stay all-in-all. The location is definitely the top thing about this listing The place was clean, nice, and just a nice place right. Great food right around the corner, along with train stops.
My 4 stars is based on the price for the listing. I know the price is right on par with other AirBnB and hotels in the area, but these bugged us pretty bad.
Negatives:
Weak toilet: It's silly, but at this price, we shouldn't have to worry about if every flush was going to back up the toilet. Every flush made the clogging sound. Sometimes just for TP, it had to be flushed 3 times!
Extension cords were used many places. Made it where we had to unplug lights or whatever to be able to plug things in.
The worst was the loud hallways at night. There's an entry door to the hall in the bedroom. With people's doors banging at 3AM each night, we didn't sleep well.
Lack of amenities. Just the VERY basic was there, which is fine, but again for the price...

I had an excellent stay here for about a month, the apartment is nice with lots of light and the location is fantastic. Street parking was pretty easy although there was absolutely no need for a car with the L so close and so many walkable restaurants and things to do. WiFi was also worked great for remote working!
A little small but for someone that travels by themselves it was perfect!

Industrial loft type unit in heart of Chicago.  Very walkable w lots of nearby attractions and terrific restaurants.  Near lake, parks, museums, and river walk. The EL is right outside your many windows so noise was a challenge. You have a view of the EL and the EL passengers have a view of you. Also, the shower did not properly drain and the numerous windows, which created an urban vibe, were dirty.  The lobby and hallways are dark, outdated, a bit depressing.  It is a popular time which explains higher costs but, our fee w taxes, a little over $500. per nite, was not a reasonable price given the noise, size of unit and the units finishes. Stephanie is a very good host as she quickly responds.
Walkable to everything I went to. Great place to stay.

Location is perfect, 5min by walk to orange metro station and then by metro maybe 15/20min to city center.
Still around the Airbnb you can find a lot of restaurants and shops within 5-10min walking.
Room was okey, small but with wardrobe, desk and comfortable bed.
Bathroom is total mess, and it’s not just dirt from day before or from morning. It’s dirt from not cleaning it since long time. Somebody should do a deep cleaning there
Great host. I would stay here again!

Very nice and peaceful place to stay. The neighborhood is quiet, and I had no issues during my visit. Michael was very responsive, friendly, and incredibly hospitable. The place was clean, well-maintained, and the service was excellent. I would definitely recommend staying here.

I stayed at Samoane’s play with my friend and her 3 kids. This place was about 10 minutes from downtown. The apartment is comfortable and clean.  It has good space. It also has access to a porch, and you can add access to the patio. The area where it is is a quiet area.  We had a good time here, and I recommend it.
Adamm’s place is unique and in a very cool, old building in Chicago. The kitchen is nice and big and it was very comfortable overall.
Wonderful stay in a great walkable neighborhood. We really enjoyed all the walkable restaurants and shops. We would love to come back

We loved Matt’s place. One caveat - the bedroom does not have a door which we did not know. This is probably not a big deal for most, but we had our toddler who is a light sleeper with us which made doing anything after bed time challenging 😅. Would 100 percent recommend for anyone without a kid! Matt was very responsive. Thanks y’all!

I am a local and had family come visit and stay at Justine's. It was easily the cleanest and homiest stay we have ever booked for my family. We asked several questions throughout our stay and Justine had timely and helpful responses. We will be booking again in the future!
Great location and clean spot, only slight issue was had some issue with the opening the lock but got it after a couple tries, otherwise the rest of the stay was great and Jose was very responsive
Perfect location for all things Wrigley.
Great location. Great place to stay at
Great place to stay! Host provided clear check in instructions, place was incredibly clean and walkable to restaurants/shops. Highly recommend!
Great place in an awesome location! Host was super responsive. We will def be back on our next trip to Chicago.

Kash was a great host to my family and I. The home was beautiful with upgraded amenities in the bathroom and a gorgeous upgraded kitchen with a coffee area stocked up for you and your guests. The bedrooms were perfect, you have closet space and dressers in each room. I would definitely recommend kash to anyone looking for a Airbnb in Chicago.

Victor's place was the perfect spot close to everywhere our group wanted to go and had enough space for everyone to get their own bedroom. We found it easy to relaxed, socialize, and feel like we had a really solid "home base" during our trip.
Best Airbnb we’ve stayed in. Wonderfully equipped kitchen. Will definitely return

Great space. Nice layout. Completely furnished kitchen. New accessible washer/dryer. CLEAN! The space is located in the basement with AC, so it stayed very cool on hot days. We were not there during the day, but our night time was quiet, restful, and cool. All in all, we enjoyed our stay.

Lilly’s townhouse is beautiful with lots of space for the whole family. It has a lot of stairs so have that in mind if you’re traveling with older family members. It is about 15 minutes from the loop, 10 to Chinatown and really close to the beach and museums. The only day we had issues with parking were Saturday and Sunday with a lot of people parking and walking to the beach. It was really easy to communicate with Lilly.

Overall good place to stay. I was in the master bedroom upstairs. A few oddities like no mirror above the sink and lacking in furniture (no bedside lamps, not very cozy) but clean. Window AC unit took quite a while to cool in July but adequate for sleeping. Shared spaces were clean and well furnished.

Mary was very kind, flexible, and accommodating aa we navigated Chicago. The airbnb is right by the train station where we could go into town. Our only critiques are that being in the lower level, it truly did echo every footstep and loud noise upstairs. It was totally fine except for in the middle of the night where it was a little difficult to drown the sounds out. Her home was also as described, but I do wish it was a little cleaner and that the beds were a bit more comfy. The home was a little more dusty and felt more lived in than what we were looking for, and the bed was really hard on our backs. However, location with the price and the kindness she gave was great. We probably wouldn’t stay again, but we enjoyed the stay we had.

Everything was a 10-15 min walk. Soldier field was super close no need to pay for Uber or for  Bicycle taxis.  Busses ran on State st and two blocks away on Michigan ave. Further away locations the red line was available about a block away. Plenty of restaurants and cafes within two blocks

This was our second time staying in this building - we love it! This was our first time in a 2-bedroom unit and the extra room was exactly what we needed. The apartment is cozy, clean, inviting and bright. All our needs were met, the kitchen had all the right stuff, the beds were comfortable, the layout was perfect.
Ben was a thoughtful and communicative host. We had a hiccup checking in (100% my fault) and he came through and saved my day! I couldn't be more grateful for his quick response and compassionate handling of my issue.
We know that we will be back (more than once)!

Host was super responsive. In a great location, just over a mile from the waterside and the primary walking path along the lake that includes beachfront views. There were five of us; we had plenty of hot water and appreciated being able to easily Lyft to Wrigley and good restaurants.

Jeffrey’s place was exactly as it looks—clean, spacious, and pretty, beds were comfy, everything worked great! Jeffrey was super helpful and in touch, we really liked this place and would come back in a minute. I loved the neighborhood, it felt like a quiet oasis in a large and crowded city!

Robert’s place was perfect for our weekend in Chicago. It was about a 5 minute walk to the blue line train. Robert was super responsive to one issue that we incurred and was fast to fix the problem. We’d definitely recommend this place!
very nice property and fit the 4 of us well

I would recommend Yuanyuan’s Chicago location to any/all people that are looking to visit Chicago! Not only was the inside very clean and well kept, the house was just plain beautiful. It has an amazing outdoor patio that was my personal favorite feature.
Yuanyuan was extremely kind and responsive during all of our interactions. They proactively reached out with a ton of options for food & fun.
5/5 stars - amazing hosts for an amazing property
Amazing place!  Super clean and spacious. Loved this for a quick girls trip.  Easy access to the train a d great restaurants n nearby
Very peaceful and nice home to enjoy a weekend in Chicago !
Great place and location!

We arrived to wet bedding and wet floors, so we had to dry the sheets before we could relax. The fridge and freezer didn't work, and while the host quickly brought a small replacement fridge, it wasn't large enough for all of our groceries. The broken fridge also beeped during the night and woke us up. The next morning, an HVAC technician was working on our private patio for several hours. There were also no coffee filters, very limited silverware, and no extra bath or hand towels. The host was responsive, which we appreciated, but for the price we paid, the overall experience wasn't worth it.
would not go again or recommend
Clean, convenient,  accessible, everything we needed! Would definitely stay here again :) and a great price for a 3 bed 2 bath apartment!

The space was perfect to celebrate our bride with her girls!! Lots of great seating, plenty of bathrooms and rooms.  The patio was darling overlooking the beautiful neighborhood.  Very walkable, felt safe and easy over ride to the city.  Highly recommend!
Great stay, good if your staying for night life

We had a wonderful stay at Justin's place. It is in a terrific and safe neighborhood filled with bars, restaurants, stores, and tree lined streets. There's a very spacious kitchen, living room, and a nice upper floor bedroom. The lower floor bedroom is quite large and includes a sleeping futon and en suite bathroom.
Justin is great with communication, and I would recommend his space any time!

Trata-se de um ótimo local para ficar hospedado em Chicago, pois ao mesmo tempo é próximo da região central (basta tomar o ônibus 66) mas eu uma região muito tranquila da cidade com uma boa rede de serviços ao redor (restaurantes, mercados, farmácia, etc). O apartamento corresponde à descrição do anúncio e não tivemos nenhuma surpresa. Tudo funcionou muito bem durante a estadia (internet, cozinha, banheiro, água quente) e o contato com a anfitriã foi bem tranquilo. Recomendo a hospedagem aqui.
Great space. Great host

Very nice apartment with easy access to west loop restaurants and Jewel-Osco (grocery store). The place is very clean and the bedrooms are spacious! The gym and basketball court in the apartment are also amazing. Highly recommend for families.
Great place to stay, easy access to downtown. The floor plan didn’t match the room as there was no sofa in the room, only negative. Super responsive host, great communication.
Great spot! Loved the area and the cozy stay!!

This place was exactly what we needed for an easy trip into the city! The apartment was just as pictured and described. The neighborhood was beautiful, quiet and safe. Super convenient if you have a dog with the park right around the corner and it was even nice to just walk around the neighborhood. Parking was not hard to find during the day and getting an uber was also very easy. We had a great time! A+

The airbnb was very easy to find and check in was easy. The place overall was okay! The pillows on the bed and the mattress need an upgrade, the AC sounds like a plane taking off and the kitchen floor was very sticky feeling. The place was able to accommodate 4 people somewhat comfortably. I do recommend this place because although it has some things that need improved the price is reasonable for the quality!
A beautiful historic stay in the historic Pullman area! Absolutely charming and easy to get to.

We had a great stay! Building was easily locatable and street parking is available on both sides of the street- we initially had to park a but far but were able to find a closer spot later on. Close to an L station that goes to the loop so easy access to downtown, and lots of cute stores/restaurants within walking distance (as well as a 20min walk to Wrigley). Apartment was as described, clean, and comfortable. Futon in the second bedroom was kind of uncomfortable but that is to be expected for a futon. Would stay again.

Amazing place, amazing host, and Fernando is extremely kind and responsive, if you’re looking for a nice place to stay while you’re in Chicago, and want to be easy on the wallet, Fernando is your guy!

Stayed for 2 nights with my partner for a weekend in Chicago. This was a perfect location - easy access to downtown by bus or the L, and a 15 min walk to Wrigley or 30 mins to the Lakeshore. Lakeville is such a great neighborhood to be in, I wouldn’t stay anywhere else. This apartment is clean and spacious for 2 people, and we found the (large) bed very comfortable.
Great stay in a fun neighborhood!

I went to Chicago to see Karol G and luckily I found this place, such an amazing and nice host. Was so welcoming and was so helpful whenever I had questions. Place was so cute and loved how it wasn’t far from downtown. Would 100% recommend it to anyone whom is looking for a place especially for people who want to travel with their friends. Will for sure be coming back and booking again soon.
Cozy apartment in a calm area, I would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay! Everything was exactly as stated.  We felt safe and comfortable the entire time! We would definitely returned if coming back to Chicago! Excellent location, welcoming home, and safe! Lots to do close by!

This rental was absolutely stunning! It matched the photos and was very dreamy. However, there were a few issues that I did not like for the price I paid. One, there was a very bad smell in the unit when we arrived. It was horrible the first two nights. Two, there were so many gnats in the unit and in the hallway area entering the unit which were very annoying. Third, the existing stairs next to the unit did not lead downstairs, which led my friend and me down a hallway filled with trash and gnats. This explained why they were close to and inside the unit because the stairwell is next to it. Fourthly, pubic hair was left in the shower. Lastly, upon arrival, I did not see a garage opener and with the information in the description and in the unit as well there was no opener. I did reach out to the owner, who said to use the button in the garage. To be later asked if I had it. Though that was kind of odd! But again, overall, a lovely place!! I just think I booked on a bad weekend.
The home is in a great location and the hosts were very accommodating and friendly. Highly recommend!
Muy atento y servicial a cualquier necesidad que se pudiera presentar el lugar es cómodo y acogedor nos sentimos en casa 🙏🏻
This place was lovely! Kept clean and overall a very beautiful home. Michael was very easy to talk to and very responsive. I would definitely stay again!
Thank you for letting us stay. I love the dog theme!

Cómoda,Limpia y en excelente ubicación.
Nos volveríamos a hospedar ahí.

Clean, nice bathroom, right next to a train stop, very very easy to get downtown or to Wrigley. Lincoln Park and the beaches are all accessible. Trains passing by are very loud, earplugs are provided. The door/lock has seen better days, it can be hard to lock it from the outside when leaving.
This was a beautiful home! Michael was a great host I would just be aware of the area, not the best area but everyone was friendly!

Lisa was a wonderful host. Her communication was excellent, and her instructions were thorough and clear.
The space was fantastic. It was roomy, comfortable, stylish, well-thought-out and well-appointed. With plenty of lighting, lots of seating with different conversation areas with multiple functions. It was equipped with just about anything you’d need in a home away from home.
We would stay there again. Thank you, Lisa!

Highly recommend. The place was clean and easy to access. The space felt bigger than I expected it to be from the pictures.  Easy to get access. Quiet, walkable neighborhood that felt safe. Plenty of street parking, we didn't even have to use the provided garage space. Prime location, not too far, not too close to the city. Restaurants and stores nearby. Eugene was extremely responsive during our stay, friendly, and accommodating. I would stay here again.
Amazing host awesome location

This Airbnb is a very nice. There are some issues if you need to park a car; however, Angie was able to help us through this and was very responsive and proactive.
The space was clean when we arrived and is very close to the Damen stop of the subway, making it easy to get anywhere in Chicago.
Overall this was a great Airbnb experience.

The location is great, lots of local bars and restaurants right on this block, easy access to the red line subway, and a 15 minute walk to all the shops you could want.
The building itself is older and it shows, it's fine, but it's old. The entrance instructions could be updated, there are 2 pin pads you need to use, the instructions only mentioned one. Fortunately, it was the same pin code for both of them.
The apartment is exactly what's pictured, plus a window AC unit, which we were grateful for.
Our major complaint about the apartment is the bathroom. The toilet leaked at the handle when flushed, enough that I had to put a towel down behind the toilet. The bathtub was worse, trying to dial in a tolerable water temperature is impossible and it drained so slowly we were standing in water over our ankles at the end of a shower. Our host said someone would look at these, but our last shower ended with a half full tub, and the toilet still leaked the morning we checked out.
Thatheu’s place was absolutely perfect for our group! We had such a great time and would absolutely stay again!
Great place and easy to get around! Exactly what we were looking for!
My daughter and I loved everything about the place, only downside is there is no private parking but parking wasn’t too hard to find. Will definitely stay here again next time.

Excellent emplacement, proche des transports en commun.
Le logement est très propre même s'il se trouve dans un ancien bâtiment.
C'est un peu bruyant la nuit, prévoir des boules quies.
Le seul reproche est que le lit est vraiment très petit pour 2 adultes.
Mon mari avait ses pieds qui dépassaient 🤣

We had an incredible experience staying here! Kristie and her family are truly fantastic hosts—so welcoming, kind, and attentive to every detail to ensure we felt completely cared for throughout our trip. The apartment is extremely well-maintained, spotless, and incredibly cozy. We especially loved the phenomenal location, close to everything, combined with the peace of mind of having secure parking for the car. The thoughtful supplies and extra touches left for us were a wonderful surprise and showed how much they truly care about their guests. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

We had a wonderful stay at Derrick’s place. The home was beautiful, spotless, and incredibly comfortable. Derrick truly thought of everything, and the amenities were amazing. Every detail made us feel welcome and at home. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
I loved it! Such an amazing location.
Great stay overall! The home was clean, comfortable, and accommodated our group well. Communication was smooth, and everything went as expected. Thanks for helping make our weekend enjoyable!

We had an overall good stay and were very appreciative of being able to check in a bit earlier. The space served us well for the quick weekend and is located very close to the train and bus which was very helpful. My only feedback would be to bring extra blankets if you prefer more than one as only one (and no top sheet) is provided. The blanket for the futon is also very small so I’d suggest bringing spares.
Shay was a wonderful host, very responsive and attentive to our needs.  I would love to stay at any of Shay’s properties and look forward to having her as a host again.

Micha was amazing! He was so helpful all the time and she was answering really quick to all my questions!
I’d definitely come back!
Super cute neighborhood with amazing food. Space was great and as pictured. We would definitely stay again ! Loved Pilsen. Close to the CTA and overall wonderful option close to downtown.
We had a wonderful one night stay at Josh’s place. The loft was clean and the neighborhood had many good restaurants.
The place was spacious and very clean! Would recommend!
Juanita is such an accommodating and nice person. The listing is exactly as described and I felt comfortable during my stay. Would recommend to anyone traveling solo!

This was the perfect location for our girls weekend. Not only did the Airbnb exceed our expectations, but it was also located right in the heart of Logan Square. If you're looking for a walkable neighborhood with plenty to do, this is the perfect place to stay. There are countless restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and local arcades nearby, making it easy to explore without needing to commute. The Blue Line train station is just an 8-minute walk away, which worked out perfectly since it was our primary mode of transportation throughout the weekend.
Joe was a wonderful host who responded promptly to any questions we had and made our stay seamless from start to finish. I highly recommend staying here and would absolutely book this Airbnb again on a future trip to Chicago.
Roxana greeted us at the door and was so kind.  Great apartment with historic charm.

We stayed here for a weekend. Had a big group and this place accommodated everyone. The host was amazing and very quick to respond to my questions. Would recommend staying here if you are coming into town for a quick trip. But the highlight of it all was definitely the host ! Super accommodating always got a text or call within 30 minutes of asking questions.
A very nice location. Walking distance to Winnemac park and all of the great restaurants and shops in Andersonville on Clark.

My mother and I really enjoyed our stay. Everything was ready for our arrival and they provided extra toiletries just in case needed. Mark was very attentive and had great communication with us. The book had clear directions for us and tons of resources if needed. We would definitely stay here again for any future trip to Chicago.
Fantastic stay
Stayed at Andrew’s place with 2 friends and found it to be a good value. Everything was as described. The neighborhood was nice and walkable to bars and restaurants. Would stay again.
This place is good for Family outing. Besides, the dedicated parking space, there is lot of Public Free Parking and paid Private parking spaces within 3 minutes walkable distance.

Charming, well-maintained, and super clean apartment in a great location. Quiet and peaceful but only a couple of miles from the heart of downtown. Lots of restaurants and shops in walking distance. Danny is a great host! He is very proactive about checking in and super responsive to questions. I would definitely stay here again.
