Place was very clean and had all the essentials we needed as well as extra snacks and candies for us to enjoy which was very nice. Host was also very helpful and responsive and even gave us things we could do while visiting in Chicago which was also very nice of her. Overall the house just felt like home and the host was very friendly !!
Everything was amazing!!
Jordan was great and incredibly accommodating! It's in a nice area and is right by the bus, which is a huge plus. Would definitely recommend!

The home was well cared for and the host was very accommodating. We were comfortable throughout. It's not the most convenient location for public transportation so would recommend having a car if staying in this area.

Everything was great! It does say they have quiet hours, but the guest above us on arrival day were blaring their music which didnt bother us, what did was on night one the upstairs guests arrived home around 2am and were extremely loud until around 4am. Wasnt enough for us to complain. I would still recommend this place to other's.

Thank you for the stay we had a ball! And was right in the middle of the city! Very convenient to talk or quick uber wherever we needed to go! We look forward to spending time in Chicago again with this host!

Todo estuvo muy bien
limpio organizado la para nuestro grupo fue excelente

My husband and I stayed here for a full month and had a fabulous experience. The Bucktown/Wicker Park area is wonderful - walkable, charming, safe, with lots of restaurants and shops. This home is clean and comfortable and Hien is super responsive, helpful, and friendly. The location, in particular, is perfect -- on a quiet street, but super convenient to everything (L stop, gym, 606 trail, shops/restaurants). We definitely lan to stay here again (in fact we already booked our next visit). HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
Very homey and comfortable. Loved all the amenities and extras that were for our use. Highly recommend.
David is a great host and was very responsive. The bnb looks even better than the pictures, it’s very spacious while also being comfortable. Would highly recommend!
Wonderful host. Very friendly and willing to help. Would definitely stay here again. Richard gave us very helpful information that helped us guide ourselves throughout the city. Thank you

What they listed and the instructions were exactly what they said. The other guests staying there were respectful and nice to me and my guests. The host and co-hosts are responsive in a great timely fashion.

Erick’s place was exactly as described. Small but spacious enough, clutter free. It is a basement so if you aren’t comfortable with people living upstairs then this is not the place for you. It is very close to the train station and midway airport. Lots of city noise, but I love that! Parking is street parking so it is a bit of a struggle. Erick was very responsive to all our needs. He made sure we were comfortable and satisfied. Kitchen is full equipped. Bedroom has extra pillows and blankets. We had an issue with the pull out sofa bed but Erick took care of it and we were very happy! 😊

Our group loved staying here. A quick walk to Wrigley and a relatively quick drive to local attractions.
We were in town to go to Wrigley and we couldn’t have asked for a better location. A quick walk around the corner and we were in front of the stadium. Lots of food and entertainment choices right in Wrigleyville.
Property was easy to find and was exactly as described in the photos. It was very clean and it had everything we needed.
Jason was a great host, reaching out prior to our check in to provide me a link to the garage door app. (It didn’t end up working) but Jason was super responsive to let me know where the button was to manually open and close the door. We only left the property a few times by car, so it was no big deal to us.
We also found the property to be relatively quiet. Even with the close proximity of the bars and stadium we didn’t hear much while inside.
Would stay here again if we happen to be in town!
great location! super walking to all sorts of cute restaurants. We had 4 people stay at this place and it was plenty of room. recommend staying here

5/5! So happy to have found Tina and Jon’s place and if given the opportunity to return, we would book in a heartbeat! Peaceful walk to Wrigley (1mile) and in a really cute, friendly neighborhood. Great amenities and it was just what we needed for the weekend!
Kevin was an amazing host who communicated well throughout our entire stay! His Airbnb is in a perfect location, making it a great home base for anyone looking to explore the area!
We enjoyed our stay and would recommend for anyone visiting Chicago.
I like that he was very helpful I miss read the fine print it’s rooms not an entire upstairs
This was a lovely home close to the L train so convenient for our trip. It had several nice touches such as coffee pods and tea. The host was very responsive. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay for our family vacation! Plenty of room for everyone and we were able to walk to lots of different places to eat. Having a garage was also really nice.
Five Star experience all around — the accommodation, the location, and Will’s fantastic communication throughout was appreciated. Highly recommend
We had a great stay! Very walkable area with lots to do. The apartment was clean and comfortable.
We loved our stay! Neither of the beds are a king as listed, but the unit is beautiful, with incredible views and much more space than we even anticipated!

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and beautifully maintained. The location was excellent, making it easy to explore the city while still feeling safe and quiet. Check-in was simple, and the host was responsive, friendly, and helpful throughout our stay. Everything we needed was provided, and we truly felt at home. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
Thank you, Eladio, for being such a great host! We really enjoyed our time and would happily book again.
Wonderful place with wonderful hosts!

The place is clean and check-in was very easy. The host was very responsive. Very well-equipped kitchen. The location is great - lots of great spots within walking distance. Recommend it and would stay there again.

Had a stress-free stay at this clean, parking-friendly place close enough to downtown. Thomas' instructions and proactive outreach made checking in easy and gave me confidence in renting a space from someone who cares about his guests and their experience.
Dave was a great host with clear instructions and very responsive when I had a question! The place was HUGE and slept everyone very comfortably! Very homey feel with a lot of character.
Great spot - easy to get in and out of. Easy street parking. Up a few flights of stairs but other than that, great stay!

Great place to stay with access to bars and restaurants nearby and close enough to the rest of city.
Super easy to find for our entire group (12 girls!) and our grocery / takeout delivery people.
All the rooms were clean and everything we could think of needing was available.
Had a great time overall!
Excelente ubicación

Loved the location, right in the middle of Pilsen, super fun neighborhood. The host was very responsive and helpful and accommodating. Super smooth process throughout and really made this weekend memorable. Would absolutely recommend, great experience!!

Stay here for the roof deck, neighborhood, proximity to public transportation, coffee, gym
Really best case scenario. Jerry is the man too.
Great Apartment in a great and convenient location of Chicago!

The instructions were clear, and the kitchen and bathroom were clean; I had no issues with the other people sharing the house. It felt a bit deserted at night, though I wouldn't call it extremely dangerous; it was close to buses and a 10-minute walk from the Blue Line.
Great communication with host

My family and I loved staying here! It’s so beautiful and colorful and spacious. We loved the culture that surrounded not only the Airbnb itself but also little village. We felt right at home. Janet was quick to respond any questions or concerns I had and even left us some champagne for our concert.
The apartment was clean and comfortable. The location was perfect, walkable to all the restaurants and shops around Wrigley field. It was a great place to stay!

Ewa’s place is amazing! The bathroom and shower alone is worth the booking. Her rooms are newly renovated so everything is modern, sleek, and clean. She also went above and beyond for an ask I had and she exceeded expectations. Our stay was incredibly comfortable. Her dog Bruno is also adorable! I highly recommend staying at Ewa’s!
-Lisa and Drew

We were in town for a wedding and only needed a place that was clean and affordable to sleep.  This was just what we needed.  Tory and her daughter were friendly and helpful with recommendations on where to get a "real" Chicago pizza.
Great place to stay when exploring Chicago! Super homey and a great host!
Great stay, very responsive team!
This unit was just as described. It had everything we needed, and was very clean and uncluttered. The hostess was proactive and very responsive. I recommend this unit.

Very clean, comfortable, spacious; lots of kitchen utensils, paper goods, plates, etc. two coffee machines (drip and Kuerig).  Responsive host.  Lock was a bit tricky and parking but house was wonderful and area great too.
Great location, wonderful space! Would definitely stay here again.

Small apartment in a great location, look at photos which are accurate, there is no living room - which did not bother us. Bella was quick to respond whenever we reached out. We did run into a couple of hiccups — the listing had an error about the AC (only one of the two bedrooms has a window and AC unit), which Bella corrected in listing once we pointed it out, and we had no hand towels and ran out of toilet paper - later we found above refrigerator cabinet.  She ordered a delivery right away, but never got because Wicker Park Fest had the street closed  — timing rather than anything she could control. Would've been nice to know about the festival in advance since there were bands playing and road closures around the apartment. Overall a pleasant stay with a responsive host.
Place was great. Host was great and very communicative.

Demitri has been a go-to host for  5+ years now whenever I am training at a dojo in the neighborhood. Always responsive, consistent quality of the apartment. Absolutely recommend (and hope that I remember to book far enough in advance not to lose out to those who take me up on that recommendation)

Nice apartment over all. We didn't have paper towels, laundry soap and a few other necessities. It could have been cleaner (bathrooms) too.
Be ready for a full interview in order to gain access to their property. I felt like I was being questioned by the FBI. They are owned by a management company.
Overall, the space was decent, beds were cool and the street parking was a plus. Don't think you can walk to a variety of places for entertainment or food either. Was also fairly pricey.

Alejandro was always responsive whenever we had questions.  The home was clean.  The unit was the main floor and lower level.  The backyard was fenced and had grass, which was perfect for our pups who had traveled with us for the wedding.  The washer/dryer was out of service for our stay, but we were only there 2 nights.  We would stay again!
Great location, comfortable for our family of six. Local recommendations and clear instructions great place.
Our stay was very nice, Tuan was very helpful with checking in on us throughout our whole stay. Communication was top tier.

Real good communication skills Andrew was understanding and considerate. The location was close to a lot of restaurants and stores i love the dining room area. I was able to eat dinner with my family in a traditional fashion.  The kids loved the popcorn machine i would definitely recommend it.

This small but mighty AirBnB really impressed! It’s in a nice, walkable location to multiple cafes, restaurants, breweries and shops. Loaf Lounge was a favorite for breakfast! Only a 20-min or so drive from Field Museum, too.
The place itself is super neat and the space is maximized for use and convenience - and for beautiful plants! The bathroom does have slanted walls so tall folks might have difficulty, but we three made do. We didn’t have to use the kitchenette but loved that there was a hot plate available, along with a microwave that has air fry and convection function. A washer and dryer is always a huge plus on vacation, and we were glad to refresh our clothes.
The only downside is that this place is on the third floor, so lugging very heavy luggage can be an issue. Keep that in mind!
Overall, I’d highly recommend and would stay here again :-) Hosts were responsive and nice!

Kim was super helpful with everything and always available if we ever needed anything. We always had parking available. Beautiful place.
Definitely recommend trying out a breakfast spot, 7 min walk, Eggsperience!

We had a great time at the Coach house! Everything was exactly as promised, and Jaime was a very responsive host. Backing up to Wicker Park proper was delightful as we stumbled upon Wicker Park fest towards the end of our stay. The access to the local business businesses and the blue line made this the perfect spot for our stay. We will definitely be back again!

We had a great stay and would definitely stay here again! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and very private. We appreciated having cookware, a coffee maker, cleaning supplies, and everything we needed to feel at home. The beds were also very comfortable after long days exploring Chicago. The location was one of the best parts—it was easy to get downtown whether we walked, drove, or took the train, and there were plenty of restaurants nearby. The only downsides were outside of the host’s control. The neighboring houses had construction going on throughout our stay, making it difficult to sleep in after late nights because the noise started early every morning. Parking was also a challenge. Although street parking is free, finding an available spot close to the Airbnb often took time. Overall, we had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.

Its okay if you need something for a few night, but the bed was pretty hard, so was the pillow , blanket was rough and not big enough. Lamp didn’t turn on. Bathroom toilet was dirty and just everything felt very cramped in. Was merely satisfied with somewhere to stay but I don’t think I would book if expecting having high expectations very much bare minimum.
Great location—close to beach, transit, every kind of restaurant—and nice clean renovated apartment in old building—upscale appliances, nice beds, clean. Communicative host. Would stay again!
Great place for a quick visit!
Agradable
We had a great stay. Thank you

Our family of 6 from Houston (4 boys aging 9-19) enjoyed our stay. Plenty of room and space for everyone. The washer, dryer, and kitchen came in so handy for us.
The CTA is blocks away and so convenient. There are bus stops on every corner and 2 convenience stores, some great coffee shops and restaurants all within minutes.
When we had questions or concerns, Nicholas responded proactively, quickly, and was very friendly.
The kitchen had plenty of dishes, cutlery, glasses and cookware.
The bathrooms were super clean and I loved the storage inside of the mirrors as well as the first aid kit in each bathroom.
A few small peccadillos:
The walls are paper thin. You can hear everything but you are supplied with earplugs.
I would've enjoyed more towels- there are only 8 (2 per bathroom) but with the washer there, we just washed them every other day. (bring your detergent)
The living room is small with a tiny couch but we made it work just had to squeeze in.
Only one TV avail
Great area and very responsive and great communication. Would recommend anyone to stay there or at any of David’s properties.
They were very friendly and responsive! Location was great! Also, I appreciated the effort they took to provide us a crib and high chair for my kiddos.
Richard was an amazing host, very responsive and quick to answer any of my questions! My family and I loved his place and would definitely book again!
From the subway it’s easy to get there you need to walk 8 minutes, the instructions are simple, just noticed that more people stay there and it can be a little noisy but in general good place.
The host was very supportive and nice!
We had such a lovely stay. The Airbnb was spacious, modern, and so homey. The neighborhood is stunning so walkable and safe! Had a lovely time!

This place was the perfect balance of homey/classic and modern/updated. There were no issues and we had a great stay!
The kitchen and bathrooms in particular were so luxurious without feeling lifeless and cold
The location was great to where we had to go to the concert and the place was overall very clean and very well decorated.
Very communicative, friendly, and helpful host. We loved our stay!

Great place to stay, amazing view over Grant Park to the lake. Able to walk to just about everywhere we wanted to go, but the parking garage was really easy to get to and very helpful. Awesome place for our family to stay.
Great place to stay for the weekend and accommodate a large group
Great host. Fulfilled all commitments as stated. No issues.

The Blue Apartment is a great place for a short getaway in Chicago. It's just a short walk from the Belmont Blue Line station, with easy access to both the airport and downtown in about 35 minutes. Surrounding is a quiet neighborhood.
The apartment is on the third floor. The stairs are old and narrow, but we had no trouble carrying our luggage up. The unit is spacious, with a comfortable bedroom for two and an extra sofa bed in the living room. The full kitchen, with a range, fridge, and microwave, was very convenient.
As described in the listing, the building is older. While some may mistake its age for being unclean, everything was actually well maintained and spotless. The AC worked great, and the smart thermostat made it easy to stay comfortable.
Daniel was a fantastic host. He is responsive, accommodating, and flexible. He kindly allowed us to check in early and check out late to better fit our flight schedule. We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this place.
We had a great stay! It’s was in a perfect location and was nice to be close to the train. It was clean and looked just like the pictures. Geo was very responsive and check in and out were simple.
Great place, lots of space, great location and fantastic view. Kitchen was not stocked as fully functional. Worked well for our group.

We had a thoroughly enjoyable stay. The place is as described...clean, updated, happily decorated. The location in Wrigleyville cannot be beat. Great communication from owner.  Check in and check out are easy.  Love the available coffee, creamer, sweeteners. Plenty of towels, extra blankets. Air Conditioners work well.  Parking stickers provided. So much to be thankful about!

Plenty of space for our extended family. We didn't use the kitchen or laundry but appreciate having them available. Clean and bright, no noise from neighbors or street, and great to have a dedicated parking space.
AMENITIES: no towel hooks in the bathroom (one towel bar is not enough for 3-4 people) or the two bedrooms my family used (didn't check master where my parents were staying) and the only mirrors are in the bathrooms. Would have appreciated a house guide as there were no remotes for the ceiling fans (I had to stand on a chair to switch the direction of one fan from winter to summer and adjust the fan speed) and so many light switches we weren’t sure what did what.
LOCATION: We knew the rental was far from downtown when we booked, and we spent a lot of time in the car. At least 30 minutes, usually an hour, to get anywhere. Keep that in mind if that’s where you’ll be spending most of your time.
Very clean and cozy place. Felt right at home. Appreciate the extra water plus snacks. 10/10 will visit again.

We enjoyed our time in Chicago. Olivia was very responsive. The place was adorable and clean. Very friendly. Parking for more than 1 car can be tricky, but everyone in the neighborhood we talked with was friendly!
Great location, very walkable!
They communicated well! It was great to stay somewhere with my whole group.

We had a great time Tamara and Tony’s place.  Great location with the Blue Line a few blocks away.  There is also a great park literally a few steps from their place.  They were very attentive and gave great suggestions for restaurants nearby.  The added plus was the backyard after a long day in downtown Chicago! You won’t be disappointed!
My family (2 adults and 3 small children) were very comfortable here. The unit was nicely remodeled and as described. We love this neighborhood in Chicago and would stay again
Location made this spot well worth it.
El departamento estaba limpio me gustó mucho

Absolutely loved the location and apartment. I booked because it was near to family but its proximity to the 606 and the green space Humboldt Park was very much appreciated. Check in was a breeze and parking was easy to find. Will definitely be prioritizing this place for future trips

We had a wonderful stay! The location was perfect and made our trip so convenient. It was within walking distance of the event we were attending, so we didn't have to worry about traffic or parking. The home was comfortable, welcoming, and truly felt like a home away from home. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a great place in the area
Comfortable condo in a great location. We enjoyed being able to walk to sights, shops, and restaurants. The rooftop deck was a fun bonus!
We will stay here again!

Overall we were disappointed with this place and didn't end up staying there. The biggest issue was that the beds are not standard mattresses. They are 4-5 inch firm foam mattresses supported on a metal frame. With two members of our group having some back issues, we were concerned about pain if we tired sleeping on these mattresses. Other issues we had were the smell of marijuana wafting in from other units in the building. When I walked into the entry vestibule, it hit my like a train. And it could be smelled inside the unit. We were also disappointed that we were offered no amount of refund for these issues. I would not recommend this place.
Great value for money. Amazing location near the stadium and subway. The space is tight for 5, but we knew this prior reserving. Good communication.
Great place to stay! Very welcoming and responded in a timely manner!

This apartment checked all the boxes we were looking for in a rental for our weekend in Chicago. Communication and check-in were great & easy and the place was clean. We would recommend it to anyone wanting to stay somewhere close to Wrigley Field and hope to continue staying there again in the future.
Just as described. Awesome location.

The place was great!! The amenities were as listed and all very nice. The rooftop is such a nice feature and you can even see the fireworks from navy pier up there! The location also is very convenient, with a bus stop and the red/orange/green line less than 10 minute walk away. The place was as listed, the only inconvenience was the couch in the living area wouldn’t pull out, but we made sleeping arrangements where it worked out. I loved my time in Chicago and would definitely stay again!!
We enjoyed our Airbnb. The place was clean and nice, its really relaxing and feels like home. The area it’s very private and peaceful which we enjoyed so much.
The host was quick to respond to any inquiries we had during our stay. The rental was more than sufficient in space for our large party.
Toy was so responsive! I locked myself out of my room and we got it situated right away. Any questions I asked were answered. Great communicator

This place was a great find! So close to
Chinatown and the red line, it was the perfect place as a home base for our stay.

Had a wonderful stay! Very convenient walk to the bus in a very peaceful neighborhood.
The unit was very spacious and looked exactly as pictured. If you’re looking for a place a little out of the congested downtown areas and don’t mind a slight commute, this is the perfect spot for you :)

Location was great - easy to get to/from, but a nice retreat from the busy city areas.
Beds and bedding were very comfortable.
Darsh sent us detailed and clear instructions ahead of time, touched base shortly after check-in, was responsive within 30 min when we asked for additional glassware, and checked in with us again right before check out.
Was great to be able to store our luggage after check out so we could continue to enjoy Chicago before our flight home.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and very well equipped. The location was great, making it easy to get around and enjoy the city.
Our host was incredibly kind, responsive, and accommodating throughout our stay. Communication was excellent, and they even went out of their way to help us after we accidentally left a pair of sunglasses behind, which we truly appreciated.
We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you for your hospitality!

We loved our stay here! The place was very clean, and smelled lovely and fresh. Oscar was very communicative, responded quickly, and made sure to give us all the information we needed before we even arrived. We were concerned about being able to find parking at midnight, so Oscar arranged for us to have a spot behind the gate in case we had any trouble. He also checked in partway through our stay in case we had any questions or needed anything, but everything was great. I highly recommend Oscar as a host and my partner and I really enjoyed our stay.
Great apartment and great location. Clean, easy to access, and responsive host who was able to get us in early to help with our plans that day.

Quiet, cozy little spot. This was perfect for our concert + tourist weekend. Host was very responsive. I appreciated the notes around the space to let us know where to find things. Would definitely book again!
Super lovely place and great location! The deck was 👌
Great location, WiFi a little spotty and garden unit darker than photos, but great communication and very comfortable, plenty of room.
Alma was so sweet and accommodating! She insisted several times that she was there for us if we needed anything at all.
We were so pleased and grateful for such a wonderful opportunity to stay here while visiting our son. Everything was just perfect!
We had a great time staying here! The place was just what we were looking for. Ami was very responsive and helpful with communication. I would recommend this place to anyone!

Stayed here for a 11-person bachelorette trip and thoroughly enjoyed the space! Plenty of beds, bathrooms, and seating for a group that size. The host was very responsive and accommodating—we were able to store our bags a few hours before check in which was extremely helpful! The neighborhood was conveniently located and had a lot within walking distance. Would definitely come back again!

Described pretty well. 10 minute walk to CTA, uber back if it gets too late. Inside is secure and surveillance is throughout the building.
Best way to describe this stay is “Convenient”.
Thanks!
Muy fácil la entrada con las indicaciones que nos dió el anfitrión, el lugar muy limpio, cuidado e incluso parece recién remodelado todo, un excelente lugar.

The best airbnb experience I've had. The hosts made the space incredibly comfortable for my family, setting up a crib for my daughter, lots of baby toys, and booster seats. Far far exceeded our expectations. On top of that the host was incredibly communicative and provided numerous suggestions  for morning coffee and activities. Would recommend!

Definitely one of the prettiest and most peaceful place we’ve stayed. Bedding and linens were incredibly comfortable and nice. The apartment itself  is very pretty with exposed stone/brick, the kitchen and bath were modern and lovely, and furnishings and amenities were much nicer than most places. The courtyard garden was the icing on the cake!!! We struggled momentarily with the lockbox (we were tired) and Robert was outside offering help before we even thought about asking for help. The location is fantastic. There’s no dedicated parking, but this is Chicago so it’s certainly not something a person would expect anyway. Finding a nearby space on the street never took more than three minutes. We will definitely be back!
The place was perfect for what we needed. Having 2 kitchens and green space to hang outside was awesome! Comfy beds too!

A nice, clean place in a great location. Most everything was fine and Tere was a responsive host, but I'd like to make two recommendations. Because its an old building, the floor boards squeak with every step taken, every where in the apartment. We had four people staying here, so it made for a lot of noise!  I would suggest more rugs and runners throughout the apartment to soften the noise. Also the middle bedroom has a very soft mattress that offers little to no support. I found this bed to be very uncomfortable, however, the other mattresses were fine. Besides these factors, we had a great stay.
Dave’s place was so clean, comfy and easy to get to everything we needed. We truly enjoyed our stay. His directions and responsiveness were on point! We would stay here again 100%
We really enjoyed our stay!

Overall, the place was decent, and the hosts were very responsive and helpful. The reason for the 3 stars is that for the price we paid, we expected better quality and amenities. We booked for four people for three nights but were only provided four towels. There was also no bath mat, and because the shower door doesn't fully enclose the shower, water covered the bathroom floor after every use. Both beds were very firm, and one had a noticeable dip in the middle creating discomfort. We appreciated having AC units in each room, but the living room unit pulled air from the indoor entryway rather than vent outside, creating extreme heat and making us uncomfortable using it. We also found underwear and socks hanging on a window, and both the towels and bed sheets were clearly worn and stained. Both bedroom closet doors were also off their hinges. It wasn't a bad stay, but we didn't feel it was worth the price we paid.

Everything was good and matched the description/photos. The host was very responsive which was nice. The house was about a 13 minute walk to the nearest blue line CTA stop so it was very easy to get around Chicago.
Lovely place! Very clean! Host was proactive and very responsive. We would stay there again!
Ceasar and Maria were such helpful hosts who replied to our group in a timely manner and aimed to accommodate everything we needed.

This Airbnb was perfect for my mom, aunt, and I during our first trip to Chicago to visit the Obama Center. It was about a 20-minute drive away and conveniently located near downtown. The neighborhood was quiet and felt very safe for the three of us.
We loved the individual A/C units in each bedroom since one of us is always hot-natured and could keep her room cool. The home was clean, cozy, and beautifully decorated, especially the artwork. Each bedroom was the perfect size and the kitchen and home were well stocked with everything we needed.
Check-in and check-out were easy. We met the host, who shared the history of the neighborhood and recommended a few additions to our itinerary that made our trip even better.
The hospitality was outstanding. My aunt had a later flight and the host made sure she was comfortable and even waited until her Uber arrived for the airport. That extra kindness gave us great peace of mind. We would definitely stay here again and recommend!

Stayed here for my anniversary weekend with my girlfriend. The location could not have been any better for people wanting to enjoy the north side of the city and is just a quick train ride away from the loop. Highly recommended for anyone that wants a stay in a great area while also feeling like they’re in a home away from home. Made for an amazing anniversary!
Exactly as he described it!

Kevin was a perfect host. The apartment is in great conditions, very clean and comfortable. The apartment is in a “scary” building, but once you are inside, you realize that it’s amazing. It is located near “Indiana” metro station which makes it so convenient. Kevin had always excellent communication, very responsive and his instructions were 100% clear… Highly recommended.

Angie was a wonderful host with a lovely home. From the moment I arrived, she made me feel welcome with her kindness and hospitality. The property was exactly as described, and I had a comfortable, enjoyable stay without any issues. I would definitely recommend staying here and would be happy to book with Angie again in the future.

The location, 25 minutes away by the L train from downtown, is ideal. The place is cozy, but please be aware that there is no kitchen, so you will have to take care of most, if not all, of your meals outside. Thankfully, the neighborhood around the place has a lot of great restaurants.
Fue increíble alojarme en ese lugar, me sentí en casa

This house was in the PERFECT location for Bachelorette weekend.  Easy to find, easy 2 minutes walk to train, walkable to a great Farmers Market, and shopping in a super cute, safe, friendly neighborhood.  Quick uber to Old Town, Pier and Downtown.  We LOVED our Stay!!
Everything was amazing!
Great place in a good location.
Although our stay was okay, the photos of the units did not accurately portray the wear and tear inside. We hoped for better quality with the price we paid.
Host was very responsive to messages and friendly! Very easy check in and check out with clear instructions. Easy parking and a nice, quiet neighborhood.
Craig was extremely responsive and kind! The place was beautiful and very clean when we first arrived. No complaints! Would 100% book again!
Me and my significant other loved staying here! So nice and felt so at home! The back yard is sooo nice and the animals were sooo cute! Will definitely be staying here again in the future!
Outstanding location!! Beautiful apartment!  Worked perfectly for us for a long weekend in ChiTown!
had an amazing stay! definitely recommend
Beautiful, peaceful, clean, cool, dry, private space, exactly what I needed to sleep and recover during a long weekend in the city. Espresso pods saved me too!
This place is such a vibe! Feels like luxury. Rooftop is very spacious with beautiful views. The hosts were super accommodating and very responsive. Highly recommend.
Had a great stay. Everything was located around where I needed to go. Comfortable home with great space!
Nice room and shared spaces. Close to cta.
Good place

Eugene's place was a great location within walking distance of the blue line trains. The place was clean. If you are a very tall person then the roof leaning may be a concern but we adapted quickly. Our original flight got canceled and we could not get another flight until the next day. Eugene gave us a partial refund for the lost night which was super generous. Would stay here again!
Great place to stay and great location!! Lots of space and easy area to navigate.

I had a great stay in this unit. It's exactly as advertised. The location in Lincoln Park is fantastic with lots of restaurants and parks in close proximity. I was able to do some remote work from the unit with no disruptions or internet issues.
Great central location in a lively area!

Reggie’s place was perfect! It was super clean with a nice open layout great for entertaining. The highlight was definitely the rooftop with a nice dining table, speakers for music, and the upper rooftop with beautiful views of the city. It was a perfect spot for a girls weekend, and was close proximity to a lot of great bars and restaurants in the west loop. Reggie was also extremely responsive with any questions we had before and during the stay. Would definitely recommend!
The house was perfect for our quick stay in Chicago. The house was located super close to United Center so this was a huge plus.

Great little space to stay in. Just as was described, instructions were very clear and we were able to walk form the apartment to a bunch of great places. Only issue we had was finding parking due to the nearby arena. Would definitely recommend!

Everything is was great. The bed was comfortable and the space felt quiet and private even though it’s shared with host living downstairs. My only suggestion is about the bathtub. It was clogged for our stay so the water drained slow while showering. I didn’t reach out to the host so that was on me. Everything else was solid, would definitely stay here again.
Great place
The hotel was perfect!! It was easy to walk to the Riverwalk and Millinieum Park. The subway was across the street. So many great restaurants, coffee shops and stuff to do close by!!

The host was amazing and friendly. He responded in a timely manner. The location is in china town but far enough off where it’s not busy and it’s quiet. It’s also close enough to all the attractions Chicago has to offer without being in the mix of everything. I def would stay there again.

This place is great, and I would definitely stay again! It felt safe and was close to the bus stop. The 50-minute bus ride to downtown Chicago was perfectly fine for us. Once inside, I realized it’s in the basement, which isn't a problem for me, but I mention it for others. As others have said, you can hear people walking around, using the laundry, or cooking, but it didn’t bother us, just felt like a normal apartment. We arrived early and received a message around 2pm with clear check-in instructions. The only issue was that I asked about early check-in to drop off our luggage, but I never received a response. I also noticed that I often said thank you in response to their generic messages but didn't get a thank you or reply in return. As a clean freak I think it scored a 4/5 but was definitely still clean. I’m just very picky. Overall, we liked the place; it gave us exactly what we needed.

Beautiful house on the inside. Lots of space.  Would have given 5 stars if the surrounding was a bit better.  The backyard is too noisy due to a train that runs right next to the property. It is described in the listing but you really don’t estimate the noise till you are right there. House has lots of amenities
The apartment was the perfect space for our group of 7. Milan took care of everything. Would definitely stay again.

Host was very timely with communication and responses.  The condo was in a  terrific location.  The place was clean however there was mold in the bathroom shower. We pointed it out to the owner and sent pictures yet no one came to clean/remove the mold during our stay.  Also having to download an app and create an account  to get in and out of the condo was a pain.  It didn’t consistently work so we asked for keys which was no problem and easily provided to us.

Great location, close to the Red line and Lake Michigan. Regina is a very gracious host; easy to check in with detailed instructions. Enjoyed our stay. Highly recommend “The Fried Egg” for breakfast/brunch!

My son and I stayed at Sara and Drew's while in Chicago to see the White Sox play at nearby Rate Field. The location near the Green Line was great and a big selling point for us. We had a slight problem at check in as the instructions didn't quite match what we found (the room numbers had accidentally been painted over) but Drew responded quickly to my questions. Our bedroom was clean and the beds were comfortable. We slept great! It was a hot July weekend and the apartment temp was perfect. We also appreciated the box fan in the room to help circulate  air. Drew was very friendly and takes his hosting seriously. He was responsive and helpful. I did learn that in the future I do not want to stay in an Airbnb with a shared bathroom. This review does not downgrade Drew for that as I was aware of the situation beforehand, it's just not something I experienced before and it is a lesson learned. Thanks for the hospitality Drew!
10/10 across the board!! Would stay here again Ina heartbeat. Great location, great host.

Really nice home, everyone felt comfortable. The only down side is how the other 2 rooms upstairs got really hot during the day due to the lack of air conditioning, but the fan and strong conditioning from the master room did seem to help. Other than that, it was a very nice place to stay at, would definitely stay at again.
We had a great time staying here. Would do it again.
Great location. Lots of amenities  clean home. Kitchen fully equipped. Play kid area was great. Definitely will be returning to this home.

My friends and I absolutely loved this stay! The host was unbelievably kind, and it made our experience even better. This stay is perfect if you have a group of friends visiting Chicago. The space was welcoming, clean, and fun. It’s only a 12 minute walk from the brown line, 5 minute walk from the bus. I loved how Roscoe Village wasn’t too busy and overwhelming, but still close to busy areas like Andersonville and Lakeview. The local restaurants were amazing, as well as the local shops! The host is a good soul and you can tell that they can host because of their love of hosting and hospitality, not just for money. The place was also reasonable priced. I would absolutely stay here again:)
Super cozy place, and Tim was very inviting. Highly recommend!

It was a great place to stay me and my family liked the place 2 kids and wife
Rilwan was very quick to reply and communicate which for me was a plus
Also it was close to downtown Chicago and for me that’s what I liked !!!

Jane’s home is in a lovely neighborhood with so much to do and so convenient to public transit. The beds were so comfortable and the space is huge, plus two baths and laundry with parking in the city is unheard of! Jane is a wonderful host and would absolutely stay again.

Thankful is the main word I have! This trip wasn’t easy but Todd helped
Me out tremendously! Very thankful and Happy! Trip was amazing! Place was clean and in a good area!
Thank you for helping make my sister’s bachelorette weekend the best! This had lots of space for all 7 of us to stay. Thank you for being proactive and helpful!
Bridget’s place was spacious and clean. Great shops and restaurants were in walking distance.
We enjoyed our stay here and the place had everything you could need to make yourself at home. The area is peaceful and the beds are comfortable. Would recommend to others.
Saurin is so kind and so nice !! He gave us so many good advices !! If you need a place to stay in CHICAGO, go to his place !!!

Our family of 3 had a lovely time while staying  at Michael’s place.  His place was clean, felt safe and met all of our needs.  We enjoyed walking to the CTA blue line and taking the train into Chicago.  We walked to Cafe Urbano and had a fabulous breakfast panini and coffee.  My son loved playing the baby grand piano! If it works out, we would definitely stay again!
Great host,  very accommodating and fast replies
Cozy home and comfortable stay. Location is central to many neighborhoods in Chicago.
Thnx for a very relaxing stay highly recommended

Unfortunately, our stay here didn’t live up to the expectations that I anticipated, mainly due to the very musty smell/feel it had which I’m sure is because it is located in the basement and it’s summertime. I think they attempted to use air fresheners to help but that almost made it worse. I think a dehumidifier would work wonders in removing the moisture. It really could also use a deep clean and a paint job, it was very dingy. And lastly, there were four of us and exactly four towels, but the towels were the size of hand towels and barely covered anything! And there were no extra towels to be found.

The location of this apartment can’t be beat as it’s so close to Wrigley. We came for a Cubs and Savanah Bananas game with friends which was perfect for us with multiple families. Right in the heart of Wrigley.  Roof top was awesome and we spent alot of time up there. We did some cooking and the kitchen is stocked. Some amenities could be upgraded such as the towels.

My stay here was one of the most easy-going stays. I was here with family for the weekend. We felt right at home the entire stay. Looks just like as pictured, clean, equipped for guests. Check-in and check out were clear and simple. I would recommend this place to stay and would personally stay again.
A great landing space for a quick weekend trip to the city. I exactly as described

We had a wonderful time. This place was beautiful & matched the pictures. Very clear instructions on how to enter which was very helpful considering everyone in our group was coming from a different place.

Spacious home, location is convenient - close to freeway and subway stop direct to city. Vince was always available and went above and beyond to give us everything we needed. Backyard was great for an outdoor lunch while kids were playing mini golf. If you need easy access to the city in a place that can fit a big family, this is the spot.
This place was exactly as described. The pictures did not lie. It was located in a quiet neighborhood close to all of the xultural tourists attractions. Definitely worth the money spent.
My time was too short! The spot was cozy and centrally located. O'hare, Downtown, CTA, etc.

LOVED this stay in Wicker Park!! Right in the heart of it! Felt like a true resident for the stay. The houses and little gardens and everyone out and about. Coffee each morning and wine each afternoon pre-evening out on the back deck was perfect! Spacious and everything we needed and more for a great stay. Got lucky and there was even a festival a block or so away for the weekend. Used the El from the airport to a Division St station stop about .5 miles, flat and walkable! Good way to get the lay of the land.
There are stairs as this is a 3rd floor walk up but it didn’t both us. Tons of restaurants, a target, wine and beer places, shops etc all close. Perfect and we loved our stay! Thank you!
Highly recommend Angie’s place! Great host, clean space, quiet neighborhood, near Humboldt Park.
Very clean, beautiful, and well kept!

Kaitlynn's place was nice and comfortable. Everything was clean and easy to settle into. Better than what I originally thought it'd be so it exceeded expectations. Kaitlyn was very responsive and helpful. Would happily stay here again.
Clean, easy street parking, great AC on a hot summer weekend.

Perfect location and great space! We had a wonderful time at this listing. It was perfect for our group of ~10. Felt spacious with a lot of areas to congregate as a group.
The location is great. Right in the middle of everything. Given the proximity to local bars + restaurants, it could get loud in the evenings. Nothing unmanageable / disruptive. Just important to note.

At first the stay was just fine- we stayed 3 days. On the second day we tried to reheat some food only to find out that BOTH microwaves did not work and NEITHER did the stovetop. We messaged him immediately and he made us text his number, made me text him multiple photos after I had already sent a whole video about the microwave not working, showing us plugging it in and everything.
Afterwards when we complained, he told us he would look into it after we left. We left Sunday night and it’s now Wednesday with no updates. After we complained again about NONE of the appliances working, Monday, he tried saying we brought animals into the unit because of some hair he found. Hair! I took a bus and my friend took a flight- no way we could have brought animals.
Overall the stay was fine until that moment. I didn’t ask for any compensation until he tried to say we brought animals in. he has ignored my messages since then.
Easy access to the main drag in wicker park, nice quiet neighborhood. Clean/updated space.
Just loved the place.  Tastefully done, well equipped, private.  James was super responsive with questions.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Patricia was a responsive and thoughtful host, making check-in and communication easy throughout the stay. We had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. We’d gladly stay here again and would recommend this listing to others.
Andersonville was a perfect neighborhood for our trip to Chicago. Very walkable and lots of dining options. Thank you for hosting us!

Had a fantastic time out to Chicago for the first time, largely thanks to Freddy’s hospitality.
He was extremely responsive, caring, and helpful. His property is in a great location that is very walkable to many local resultants and bars, as well as even the Fiesta del Sol festival, which we enjoyed.
Thanks for the hospitality Freddy. 😀

The place is clean and nicely distributed. The house is 20 minutes from downtown Chicago, and around it, you can easily find everything you need without feeling too hectic. Parking is free. Jody was great at giving instructions, follow-ups, and even gave us complimentary snacks,  kitchen items, blankets, and toiletrie. We would definitely come back and would recommend this place to anyone looking for a stay in Chicago.

This Airbnb was perfect for our stay to visit family nearby. The check-in process was seamless and the space matched the description. The beds were especially comfy. Would definitely book this place again next time we’re in Logan Square.
This is was an amazing stay!

The place was simply beautiful, they had everything you could possibly think of needing to make your stay pleasant. The host was wonderful and the location was great. We will definitely be booking this place again in the near future.
Nice place, it has a really cool vibe. I was so focused on the cool decor that i totally missed the gym set up in the details, but it was super nice to have a place to do pull ups and stretch.
Frank went above and beyond!

Very clean, tidy, modern condo that is perfect for families.  The kids loved having their own room with bunk beds and their own bathroom.  Kitchen is well appointed, I enjoyed the coffee machine :) Dedicated parking in a secure garage is a huge plus.  Friendly, responsive, proactive hosts and excellent, clear check in/out instructions.  Convenient to I-90 and walkable to the Western blue line station. Thanks, Hanna & Mark!

Dorian was a great host!
He was very helpful and accommodating during our stay. The room was very clean and cozy and had everything needed during the few days we were there. I would definitely recommend this spot if you will be out all day and need a nice clean spot to sleep and shower.

Vin’s place is the perfect spot for people familiar with the North Park neighborhood who want to be close to all that contains. Easy street parking on Kimball, and we loved the space for our family of four.
Booking was easy, although we had to send identification twice and I’m not sure why. Also while I’m sure the delay in check in instructions was innocent, it did feel like we were in a holding pattern waiting for instructions that weren’t received until 4 hours after the stated check in time. While this wasn’t inconvenient for us in the end it did start to make me worry we had not received it and I didn’t feel confident making my way to the apartment until we had those in hand.
However - once received they were extremely thorough and easy to follow!
Would stay here again - thank you Vin!

Joan’s place was great! About a 15 minute walk to Logan Square with plenty of bars and restaurants nearby. The place itself was well taken care of, clean and very spacious. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking to stay in the area.
David was very helpful, and the property was exceptional. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. It was highly convenient, low maintenance and low key. I would happily room with him again at his residence.
Overall great stay! Felt like home away from home.

Nathan and Jake were great hosts--extremely communicative and responsive, very helpful with any requests that we had before and during our stay.
The apartment itself is located in a great area, right next to a train station so transportation is very convenient. There are good restaurants and bars nearby, also close to the lake.
The apartment was clean and well stocked (towels, soaps, shower supplies, etc), but we did notice several things that could use some maintenance attention. One of the toilet seats was loose and nearly coming off and one of the bedrooms had no curtains beyond very thin blinds, so sunlight enters the room very early in the morning.
Overall, I'm happy with the stay and would recommend this apartment to a group.

Shovany apt was very clean with a peaceful neighborhood. I would definitely stay here again. There are stores just up the street where you would be able to walk and enjoy the city. Definitely recommend. Shovany, kept in touch with us to make sure we had everything we needed. My friends and I loved it.

Loved this place! Me and my friends were looking for a short girls weekend in the city and this place was the perfect option! Although we didn’t physically meet her Regina was super friendly and was always checking in on us!

My group of 5 stayed for 2 nights and was very happy with the space! The space was well laid out, there were plenty of beds, and the two bathrooms were key to a good group trip! The location was convenient for both the train or for Ubers. The place was clean and the hosts were very helpful and quick to respond.
The house was amazing! Genesys clearly has a green thumb because all of her indoor plants were thriving and it was very clean and organized inside. I would come back again next time Im in Chi Town.
Sena is a wonderful host and very attentive. She does well to make you feel at home and was always available. I have no complaints and would happily stay with her again!

Amazing location is a giant pro. Apartment is kinda dingy and really in need of a deep clean. Overhead noise as described. Recommend not keeping anything on the floor to avoid more bugs. It’s definitely a basement makeshift room in an old building with lush plants.

Kathleen was a fabulous host. We loved the Ravenswood location and access to public transportation with options for local shops and restaurants recommended by Kathleen. There were thoughtful little touches throughout the space that made everything very comfortable. The patio was a nice option and it was fun to get to know Patrick, her sweet, friendly, and relaxed furry co-host.
The building is in an out of the way street in Pilsen, and is walking distance to the pink line.
Cute little spot on a quiet street. Walking distance to so many great spots. Our group loved having parking included.

The house itself was fantastic! We had a group of 10 people, from all over the country, all staying together for the first time. The fire pit, basement, and outdoor space was incredible to have for chatting and hanging out in the evenings. Having a full kitchen saved us so much money for meals as we cooked the majority of our meals. While sometimes how many people hanging out around the area made us nervous, we never had any problems getting in or out or any other issues with the area/neighborhood. Check in and check out was easy, with clear directions and instructions. Even with 4 vehicles parking wasn't terrible, we had two at the residence and 2 at the end of the block which is still very close. Traffic in and out of the immediate area was good, though getting downtown or to the airport was sometimes delayed or through intense traffic. All in all it was a great stay and we had a ton of fun!
Place is spacious, well equipped and in great location. Neighborhood convenient and safe. Thanks!
Top class host. Very attentive and hospitable. No complaints from me.

Tom’s place is an excellent property located in a beautiful, clean, safe neighborhood. The accommodations were perfect and we can’t say enough about how great of a host he was. Excellent recommendations, spotless place, great communication, and it felt like home. The location was perfect for us, a peaceful neighborhood with plenty to do in the vicinity, yet getting into downtown Chicago and other areas was easy, and provided us a sanctuary to escape the business. We highly recommend this property and would definitely book again if we are back in the area!

The beds were soft & comfortable. also a nice living room area, dining area, and kitchen area.. There are window air conditioners in most rooms that kept the house a comfortable temperature. Inside the main entry there is a spiral type staircase with no hand rails, other than a very small section at the very top .I would not recommend it for the elderly, nor someone with very small children. There was no remote in the house. I contacted Mike about the remote and a remote arrived late on our last evening. When we turned on the TV of course you need to set it up which I’m not doing that. I didn’t mention only 4 towels, no hand towels, washcloths, etc  I didn’t want to keep bugging him . One other thing that we didn’t particularly like, the beds had just a fitted sheet and a comforter , there were pillows with cases.  The couch we wanted to make up for the kids, we finally found a blanket and pillow (no pillowcase )for that under a side couch piece . Wish sister could have come up stairs.

An immaculately clean, well-stocked spot close to the Fulton Market area of Chicago! Soft new towels, bathroom supplies, new water filter, and overall exactly what my friends and I were looking for while in town.
Thomas and Sarah were excellent hosts and we really enjoyed our stay. The location was perfect with plenty of places to eat nearby and access to the L just a few blocks away.
Our stay was great! The place looked exactly like the photos and the hosts had a great description of everything that was included in the place! Plus the location was amazing! Would recommend
Such a cozy little spot to spend time in! Close by to so many gems in Logan Square and public transportation options but also a quiet neighborhood!
Great update place / hosts / location!!!
Very nice and quiet place.  Lots of things to do within walking distance.
We loved the place very nice and cozy. Very walkable to stores and not too far from downtown
We had a lovely stay at the Roscoe House! Courtney & Garrett were super responsive and had tons of recommendations for the area. The house was cute and well equipped for a weekend in the city.
Great stay! Loved the easy access to Wicker and Bucktown, home was great for our big group of friends. Would stay again next time we are in Chicago!

Our four night stay at this Kasa unit was wonderful.  The place was clean and spacious for the two of us.  The instructions were very clear and the front desk person was very friendly.  Location was great and the option to park in the garage (for a fee) made it really convenient.  We also really appreciate the pet area (top level of garage) to take our little Chihuahua.  Overall would highly recommend and would love to stay here again next time we are in Chicago.
Jerobs we really appreciate you and your lovely home.

I had such a great stay! the place was clean, comfortable, and welcoming. Nesha was incredibly kind and made me feel right at home. Had a great time here. Best part about the place is the neighborhoods nearby for sure, as it made for a safe trek to subways and such. Place was clean, price was fair, all around good stay.
Great location, clean and good communication with Sebastian. We would definitely stay here again!!
I had a great stay! The place was super cute and quiet. I didn’t have any issues. Everything was just as described, it was a nice area and pretty walkable. I would definitely stay here again!

This was the perfect place for our weekend getaway. Good options to walk to and right next to the train station for convenience of getting around. The place itself was clean and comfortable. It had everything we needed
We had a great weekend stay at the Montrose Hideaway.  We were very comfortable and had great access to everything we wanted to do.  We would stay again.
Ron and Rachel are very friendly and responsive. The apartment was just like the pictures and I enjoyed my stay.
The host was extremely kind and had quick and helpful responses. Space was clean and looked like the photos, no complaints!

In all, not a bad spot. Good location, easy access to transit, and the street itself is quiet enough. However, the walls in this place are THIN. you could hear the person above you so much that we heard a phone charger fall out of the wall and then go pick it up. the street parking in this area is also extremely difficult- it’s all permit and we had to park in a parking garage 12 mins away. however, this is nothing that the hosts didn’t warn us one million times about and it wasn’t super disruptive, just inconvenient, so i don’t fault them at all. i’d stay here again if im ever in the area again !

Sebastian’s place was beautiful and spacious. The location was convenient for us near downtown; however, there weren’t many restaurants or shops within near walking distance. Check in was slightly confusing as there were two codes given- but one of them was correct. We loved the house and had a wonderful stay. Everything was clean and just as the pictures looked.

The hosts were incredibly attentive, responsive, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay. The cleanliness of the apartment was top-notch, and it was clear they take great pride in maintaining the space.
We visit Wrigley often for Cubs games, and this will definitely be our go-to place to stay from now on. We highly recommend this Airbnb and can’t wait to book it again!
A great place to stay and such a bonus to have parking in the city!

Oasis from the noise and humidity! Thoughtful amenities, very we stocked kitchen and bathroom, super accurate and clear instructions, and we felt very supported throughout. Cool neighborhood with easy walks to subway and bus. Garden was sooo peaceful

Great place and great area.
This place was so clean and a great place to stay! It was also pretty close to a bus stop so getting around was super easy.
Perfect location. Very comfy beds. Parking available at an extra cost

I loved this rental.  It was very close to Wrigley Field and in a very safe neighborhood.   We were talking about how we would definitely stay again before we even left.  It’s clean and spacious. Nice place, friendly staff.
Loved staying at this property for a boys trip. The place was very spacious and comfortable. 5/5 would stay here again!
Enjoyed our stay! Loved the hostel feel and meeting other guests. Will definitely return

Una ubicación en una zona horrible, parqueadero inseguro y sin espacio, al entrar mi primera impresión fue horrible por el olor que había en ese momento mis planes se dañaron, al entrar claramente vi que el aseo de ese alojamiento era ineficiente, mucho polvo, el inodoro con papel higiénico, las camas llenas de pelo, las alfombras con restos de comida, piso sucio, baño sucio!! Loved the place, can't wait to come back pretty close to everything and very walkable and safe
Great place. Very clean and neighborhood is quiet.
Had a fantastic stay! Milan was very attentive and responsive.

My overall stay was okay. Due to having family/friends in town I never made it to the Airbnb the first night, which was a bummer. I arrived after 7am the following morning and had a smooth and easy check-in. I was gone again by noon and didn't return til around 2am. It was again an easy entry and it was very peaceful. My only complaint,  although the home was clean, was waking up to lots of ants in the bed. Jermaill was very apologetic and even Comp'd me $50 to travel back to the airport that morning. He advised that he'd handle the issue immediately!

We had a great stay and truly appreciated the host’s hospitality. They were very responsive and helpful throughout our visit, which made our stay very comfortable.
The property is welcoming and well cared for. Check-in was smooth, and overall communication was excellent.
The home itself is a good base for a stay in the area. We especially appreciated the cleanliness and the overall layout of the space.
Had a great time. Would come back

The place is great and very conveniently located, close to many attractions and other key places. The studio had everything we needed for both the bathroom and the kitchen, and the bed was very comfortable.
The only thing worth mentioning is that the elevator wasn't working, which made it difficult to carry our luggage. Other than that, everything was perfect. Ping was a wonderful host, and I would definitely recommend staying here.

Apartment was clean, felt like new, well stocked, had everything one could need. We stayed for a weekend in July 2026, myself and 4 nearly adult children, only had to bring our personal belongings. Enjoyed the deck. Beds are comfortable, space is well thought out.
I would definitely stay here again!
Thank you Hanna and Mark!

Jeff is a superb host that made us feel very welcomed and allowed the better part of his home to the guests. A unique space with two bedrooms available in case you’re coming in with a bigger group. He was always up for a chat and is very well travelled which made us feel all the more comfortable as travellers ourselves. Thanks Jeff, we have a friend in Chicago now!
We enjoyed our stay

Great view of the Chicago skyline from this place! The beds and pillows were comfortable, letting us recharge for the next day of adventures. The location is excellent, as the building entrance is just a few steps from the Blue Line, and everything we wanted to visit was about a 20–30 minute Uber ride away.
There's plenty of natural light throughout the space, which really brightens the place up.
The only downside is the interstate proximity, which brings some traffic noise. That said, the host thoughtfully provides eye masks and earplugs. We didn't need to use them as the noise and light didnt bother us.
Overall, a comfortable and well-located stay. Would recommend!

This was a perfect place for my family vacation.  It was clean, and central to a bunch of fun stuff to do in Chicago. I Loved that it had two bathrooms and was spacious. The host was friendly, accommodating and always responsive. I asked for a crib the day we arrived because I had forgotten to ask prior  and it came within the hour. Would def stay here again. It was a great stay!
I appreciated how responsive the hosts were!
As advertised. Thank you!

For my purposes (sleep, then leave for the day) this place worked fine! The description of the listing is accurate. If you are looking for a place to hang out during the day, I would look for someplace nicer, but if you just need a place to crash it works alright.
The bathroom is shared by up to 4 rooms, and the stairs getting upstairs are fairly steep. You should bring your own pillow and blanket if you are particular.
Getting in was easy, hosts were responsive, and room was clean! There was a window air conditioner which made it very easy to get the temperature that I wanted in my room!
Home away from home! From the flexible check-in and check out time, description of the home, the area and more importantly the host made you feel welcome! Highly recommend!!
This was a great place, close to the airport, and close enough to the highway to get to downtown. We had a few minor issues, but the host was quick to respond and solve it.

Excelente ubicación, ambiente súper agradable, muy bonitas las instalaciones, personal de limpieza y de el edificio súper amables. En general muy agradable y ampliamente recomendado. Sin duda volvería a regresar aquí.

I had a wonderful stay in this clean, cozy space! Loved the beautiful, leafy neighborhood, walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants, shops, and more. It was easy to check in and the host was very communicative. Appreciated the coffee set-up and helpful extra toiletries, too!

We loved this Airbnb! It felt like we were staying in a luxury hotel- not only was it beautiful, but the care that went into our stay was impressive. We really appreciated the makeup cleaning kit/travel toothbrush/toothpaste kits in the bathroom! Overall, very impressed with the space and our stay as a whole.

Excelente todo, el cuarto es pequeño como lo dice la inscripción para que no se sorprendas, yo ya lo esperaba, ya que así lo describe el lugar es muy tranquilo y como soy una persona solitaria me encantó!
El anfitrión respeta la privación del huésped
Es muy amable y te ayuda con consejos del transporte y donde ir.
Volvería ir nuevamente ahí! ☺️😉

We had a great stay at this property. Host was extremely responsive and flexible with check in/out process which was a big help for our group as we were coming in from all over the US. It’s a prime location that is walkable to Wrigley and all the bars/restaurants/activities that come with that. I would definitely stay here again.

We had such a wonderful stay here. The unit was gorgeous, not to mention was clean and ready for us upon arrival. Honestly the pictures didn’t do it justice. We loved the spacious living room and kitchen most of all and spent a lot of time hanging out there.
The host was very communicative and responded quickly to my questions before booking and afterwards. The check in process was seamless also. Both the check in & parking instructions were so clear and helpful that we didn’t have to reach out for anything during our stay.
We liked the area as well, we all felt safe. There’s always someone at the front desk too which was comforting.
All in all, my group was very satisfied with our stay and can’t wait to do another getaway trip. We know where we’ll be staying! Thank you again for accommodating us! :)
Unit was described accurately. If you want to be within uber distance of downtown, I’d highly recommend staying here. Has everything you need within 2-3 blocks!
The spot is standard nothing too high end but does have the basic amenities and lots of space. Location is great if you plan on exploring the southern side of Chicago.

I was worried about the street parking, but there was always parking right in front available. Neighborhood was quiet the whole weekend so don’t let appearances fool you. The host provided a binder with lots of recommendations which was super helpful! The host provided great communication for check in and out. Place was very cozy and cute! Only weird layout was having both bathrooms in the middle of the hallway- I would have assumed they’d be connected to the rooms.
Kristy’s place was super lovely! My friend and I had everything we needed for a few day’s stay. Hosts are extremely lovely and very hospitable and responsive! Extremely appreciate :)
GREAT PLACE!
Great place. Lots of open space to hang out with your friends. Awesome location! Easy to get around in the city from there.

We absolutely loved and enjoyed our stay!
Great communication and very flexible with early check in. Each room has its AC unit, it is a clean place to stay in, and very quiet place. I would stay here again, and highly recommend it.
Great location. Great space

The location, size and amenities at Declan’s place are ideal for exploring West Town and the West Loop.  We took advantage of the location and visited several local spots.  Declan and Candace, the co-manager, worked diligently to address an issue with the hot water at the place.  Though they couldn’t fix the problem during our stay they procured maintenance and plumbing contractors as well as the local utility when the problem turned out to be related with gas supply.  They also fairly compensated us for the inconvenience.   Had it not been for this our review would likely have been 5 stars.
We were in town for the weekend.  Would live to stay again if in town.
Beautiful accommodations, very comfortable, plenty of amenities.
Beautiful room! Amazing location.

John’s listing was clean, spacious and very comfortable. Our only complaint was that from 9:30 pm-4:30 am there was a night club below that played ridiculously loud music. During the day it was a quiet and very nice area.
Beautiful views. Very clean and very responsive.
The property is very clean.  It’s in a great location and we enjoyed our stay.  Justin is a great host
Amazing stay! 100% recommend it!

My first booking with Airbnb! I had a great experience and loved the space. It looks exactly like the pictures and is super close to cta! Jorge was kind and helpful; I could not have asked for a better host.
Excellent base on the north side of Chicago. Can’t commend the neighborhood enough.

Very spacious, clean space close to public transportation. Very easy drive into downtown Chicago. Josey was quick to respond to any questions and very kind. There was a welcome basket upon check-in and clear instructions for check-out. Free street parking which is a huge bonus when staying in Chicago.

Great place . Great host , very responsive and respectful . The place was a little small but I guess that's expected for the area so if you know that then it's not a problem . It fit our needs . The only thing that I can say should be changed is the curtains in the living room , you could see through them standing outside - I didn't know this until a day or so into our stay . But other than that , clean space. I enjoyed the space . There's a park right across the street which was convenient for my toddler who loves being outside . Easy to get to & we appreciated the street parking being easy outside the home , very convenient .You can hear the tenants above ,it got a little loud with them moving around but I have a toddler so it didn't bother me too much. The location was also good . I like that it wasn't too close into the busy areas so traffic wasn't awful around the location & it wasnt too far from the most of the main attractions, which is convenient if you're a traveler. Recommend
Very quiet but with easy access to public transportation to take you farther into the city.
Joseph was a great host and is very friendly and very helpful. Making my son's first time in Chicago a great time. He can't wait to come back to stay there again and experience more of Chicago.
nice stay... no complaints... clean... great location
Larger than anticipated and well located

We loved Stephanie’s place.  We felt right at home.  The views were stunning and walkable to Grant Park, museums, aquarium and many other places.  It was stocked with kitchen items for cooking and having a nice meal.  The washer and dryer were convenient with detergent.  Thank you Stephanie for being a great host.  We would definitely stay here again.

This was a great place to stay - exactly as expected. The instructions to get in made things simple. The bed was comfy. Nice toiletries (I always appreciate this!). I really appreciated that the check out instructions were just 'leave the keys on the table'. It was a very full weekend and it was nice to know that there wasn't even a short list of 'to-do's' in checking out.

Marissa’s place was in the perfect spot for a lot of what we wanted to do. It was close to a lot of very good food options while also close to the subway, giving us access to the entire town. Would stay here again
Really beautiful place!

I thought this place was great for my 6 week stay. Very comfortable, very good A/C for the summer and great location. Everyone in the building was very nice and I didn't really have any issues. The internet was sometimes spotty for streaming, but there were no outages or anything. I thought the kitchen had everything I needed or more than a usual airbnb has. Maybe missing one good sharp knife. And Freddy was very responsive as a host which i think is very valuable.
Great place. Walkable distance to the beach , playground and shopping
Clean apartment! Easy to find and easy and secure access. All good. Maybe some noise from the outside.
If you love music like we do, staying above Empty Bottle is incredible. Loved the vintage Victor speaker cabinet in kitchen! Hope to be back!

I appreciate the way Elizabeth communicated with me, the friendly way she welcomed my wife and me, and how she checked back with us to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed.  The place has a lot of character as seen in the photos and it met our needs for the reason we were in Chicago.  We had to cut our stay short due to a death in the family so we missed out on the full stay, but I am grateful for our time there and especially for the complimentary coffee, cream, and sweetener that was provided by the host.

House was spacious but cozy and well-equipped. Water pressure was great, hosts extremely responsive, neighbors incredibly friendly. It’s a beautiful tree-lined street, but on-street parking can be difficult (not the owner’s fault!) and walkable restaurants etc are very much part of the Ukrainian part of the village! The steps up into the building and then into the unit can be difficult, and the stairs down to the bottom floor are extremely steep. Definitely not an ADA-friendly home, but also not advertised as one! Plenty of linens, towels, and toiletries available as well. We had 5 of us and were able to all have our own space without being on top of each other.
Lucien was a great host and responded quickly
Would stay here again. It was clean, felt, safe, and had everything we needed. I had no trouble finding street parking. The shower was always hot. It was better than expected.
Excelente lugar y muy tranquilo

This place was perfect for a Cubs fan looking to walk to the game. There is a lot to do over near Wrigley.
Daniel was very responsive. He was helpful with the lock instructions as well as checking in and out. He checked in on us daily. I would definitely look to rent from him if we come back to Wrigley.
Great host, responsive. Place was very clean and organized and well-equipped for a short term stay. Neighborhood very lively lots of great restaurants, bars, cafes within close walking distance.
Incredible location. Clean, cozy bnb. Zero complaints!

We had a good stay at Katty’s place. The location was ideal for our needs and it was an easy walk to some cafes/restaurants and to the U Chicago campus. Plenty of room for the 3 of us. The only downside was that the place felt kind of stuffy, maybe the AC not working super well. There were a few fans which helped!
Everything was how she explained, first time experiencing shared places. But it was worth it. For the time we was there.

Traveled with kids, loved the park across the street. Great communication from host. Clean space, wonderfully stocked kitchen, and there wasnt a huge to do list for check out which was amazing. We would definitely stay here again!

I had a peaceful and comfortable stay at Richard’s place. Richard was responsive and proactive, checking in over the week of my stay.
