He even accommodated a 5:30 am check in which was greatly appreciated. Very clean and well stocked place. There was noise from the Metra train across the street but it didn’t bother me. A lovely bakery around the corner and convenient to walk to my class at Chicago Mosaic school. Will book again for my next class.
Great place to stay! Central to a lot of places in Chicago. The host is very responsive & helpful as well! Would definitely book again!

Enjoyed our stay very much. It is a beautiful apartment. Would have liked to be able to spend more time there. Very comfy bed and hot shower. Did not use kitchen - but was well stocked . Enjoyed the seating area at night and little balcony for a cup or coffee or glass of wine. One of the nicest Airbnb’s we have stayed in Chicago. We would return!

We had a great time at Stephanie's place in downtown Chicago. It is walkable to everywhere. There is public parking right across. The unit was bright, nicely decorated and very efficient. The noise from the train was not a problem at all. We also had a chance to enjoy our drinks by the rooftop pool. We hope to be back.

Bart‘s place was a great location for us, near relatives in Wicker Park. The kitchen is fully stocked, and the place is comfortable and quiet. There was a little trouble getting in because a code was missing on the instructions, but the staff got back to us right away. We would stay there again.
We really enjoyed our stay. It was comfy and a nice and affordable place to stay while in Chicago.

Kim was very attentive and quick to respond. Overall great experience!
The apartment was very clean and well maintained.
Check in instructions were also very clear to follow!

This Airbnb is a little slice of Heaven as is the Andersonville community and street scape. The bed is super comfortable, every kitchen item you’d require, great tv with many channels and all located in a quiet serene street, walking distance to every amenity and shop you might require (loved the First Slice of Pie shop). Every single person we met was helpful and friendly and took the time to have lovely conversations with us. We’re so happy we chose not to stay in the downtown or any other area. If you don’t stay in Andersonville you’re really missing out on a unique and magical experience. So close to Chicago proper, but a world away. We will be back.💗
Wonderful stay. Perfect location, close to China town for great food and just 16 minutes to downtown and the beach!  Very secured a friendly staff.  Thank you!

Really nice place, it was clean and as described. The keypad was a bit confusing to get into the apartment itself, but once we got the hang of it was OK. Very spacious, so many rooms and well-equipped for my family of 5. The bathrooms were clean and the neighbors were friendly. Lourdes was very very helpful and responsive.
Colin was a great host. Very responsive and informative. Very nice 3 bedroom.
This place was exactly what we needed for our stay. Will come back in the future. Had no clutter, had our own space and bathroom. They even had moveable fans in our room to use at our convenience.

My son and I stayed 5 days in the apartment, and the whole experience was terrific. Perfect location—easy walks to great restaurants and coffee shops; public transportation downtown is close by; and the neighborhood vibe is great. Our host was amazing—prompt in responding to any questions and very welcoming. It was really the ideal place for us.

I'm so glad I found Jaime's home for my birthday trip to Chicago! it was a great place for me and my dog (pet-friendly stays are very hard to come by). Jaime was communicative, responsive, and a very kind person overall! His space felt very homey and it didn't take much time to get settled in/comfortable.
I felt safe taking my dogs for walks, the area had a real neighborhood feel. I especially loved having the mini fridge in the room and a private bathroom!
Thank you for being such a great host, Jaime!

The stay was great, the spot was perfect for easy access to nearby shopping and restaurants. We could get downtown within min 30-45 on high traffic times. The Airbnb was clean, came with plenty amenities, and was good price. My only complaint is there is thin ceilings so the upstairs neighbor who comes home at 3am from their job each night (I assume) is a bit nosey if you are a light sleep like me. I used headphones and was able to sleep just fine but it was overall worth what I paid and I would stay there again. Host was helpful and nice.
very nice place, just what i was looking for!
Great location and very spacious! I would stay again!

Early check in was unavailable due to cleaning crew being there and needing four hours to clean. We could possibly have checked in early but at a fee. This has never been an issue at other air bnbs. We get there and it took us 15 min to retrieve the key. It was very hard it kept getting stuck. We arrive and it smells like smoke very pungent smell. I’m sure because of neighbors around but it was very noticeable. When we were at the lock a worker for the air bnb gave us a bag w extra body wash and other things tbag we think he was supposed to take but since we were there he had us take it up. We found it upsetting we had to wait four hours after our flight to get in bc of cleaning crew being there but we get there and the light fixtures has spider webs. Fridge didn’t even have waters. Other air bnbs have been way more accommodating. For the 800 we paid this was not up to standard at all
Very good location in terms of transportations. House was clean and quiet. Host was very responsive.
En cuanto a la ubicación muy buena, solo ten en cuenta que se comparte y las áreas comunes hay un poco de desorden

Very clean and comfortable place at a good and convenient location.
Has all the basic amenities for a multi-day stay.
The host was very responsive to questions.
Front desk staff for the building is very friendly.

Great location in Logan Square, steps to trains, restaurants and bars. Great parking which is a huge help in Chicago. And the apartment was awesome for our family of five. Bedroom for the parents which was comfortable (and had a view of a beautiful garden next door), a Murphy bed for our twin girls and a comfortable couch for our 8 year old son. Everyone was right at home, comfortable and happy! Also loved the space shower :)

Jorge’s listing was the perfect spot for me and my girlfriend’s first trip to Chicago. Everything was listed and shown as it is, and the space was the perfect size for us. We also really enjoyed the location. About 10-15 minute walk to the red line, and a bus stop right when you get out. We also deeply appreciated Jorge’s communication. There wasn’t a time where we felt he didn’t respond quick enough. Only complaint was that the elevator was out of service when we were there, but that is not the listers fault, and we probably needed some extra steps anyway lol. Overall I’d highly recommend this listing!

We had a great time! And part of it was thanks to the host and location of the unit! The host was always friendly and helpful. There are a lot of restaurants around and if you want to visit downtown and the Soldier Field Stadium they're only a short drive away! You have to park on the street but it wasn't an issue for us as we were always able to find a spot available. Plus, it is located in a safe and quiet neighborhood! We loved our stay!
Great host

We had a good stay! The parking was convenient and never an issue. It was easy to access the apartment. It does seem to be part of a residential apartment building in which the resident across the hall was quite noisy, but was not bothersome once inside the room.

Beautiful, well-appointed space. Exceedingly clean, easy access to everything. Great decor. Walkable neighborhood, close to restaurants and coffee shops and public transit but on a quiet, peaceful street. Russ was so communicative and kind. Would absolutely stay again!
My stay was nice & peaceful, Saravanan was a great host

Perfect location! Super close to shopping and eats and right on the edge of the apartments to the north so it's very walkable. Walk north 1 block and you are in the middle of a lot of nice apartments so it's very nice to walk around.
Kyriako was super responsive for any questions that we had and help accommodate a timing change for us.
The place itself was in excellent condition. The inside is pretty much brand new. All of the windows (which open easily) have nice window coverings for privacy or opening during the day. Everything was comfortable, and the AC worked great although it wasn't super hot during our stay.
It's a second floor unit, single flight of stairs and you are at the entrance. A+++, will try to stay here again!

The stay itself was great. The location of the apartment is top notch in terms of transit and things to do. For the price, however, I would've liked the bed to be a bit nicer, it felt thin and wobbly. The bathroom was also just fine. Not bad, but nothing special.
When we checked in , the apartment smelled like it had just been cleaned, which was nice.
Overall, if you need a place to stay for a few days and you don't want to spend much time at your apartment, it was a good choice.
I always love staying in Andersonville and this place couldn’t have been a better location!
Exactly as described with very responsive hosts. Within walking distance to everything. Highly recommend
Muy recomendado, los anfitriones son muy atentos y muy amables. La habitación es bastante cómoda para descansar y está a menos de cinco minutos de una estación de metro. Sin duda volvería ⭐️

Lakeview was very nicely appointed and clean. It was walking distance to restaurants and the EL. The train does go by regularly but none of us thought it kept us up and it wasn't bothersome. It didn't run much (or at all?- didn't notice) at night. The AC and fans were good.
It was a wonderful stay and Hayk was very responsive to our inquiries. All in all a wonderful stay! I'd stay there again!

We stayed here for 3 weeks and really enjoyed it! They had everything we needed to cook there in the apartment.  Joseph was super friendly and helped us store our luggage until our check-in time. The master bedroom mattress is firm. The location was easy to access and we walked/ran in the neighborhood throughout our stay. Street parking was easy. Loved the stay here!
Loved our stay. This will be my hiding place anytime I am in Chicago!

This is a great place.  The use of the garage was a life saver as there was little to no parking on the street in front of the house.  Overall we enjoyed our stay and there was plenty of room for everyone.
Great spot that’s central to everything. Easy to take the train in and out of the city. Would stay again!

One of the best places I have been for the summer time. It's quite cozy and the guess inside of the place are very friendly. The surrounding area is okay but it's very convenient cuz it's not that far from downtown.
It was a great stay, I truly felt like at home! Thanks to Anna and Daniel for being nice and kind hosts! Definitely recommend!

We had a great 2-night stay with Ronaldo and Carla! We got to to know Ronaldo on our 2nd morning on our way out when he made coffee and tea for us.
The condo is clean with many bright colors. Ronaldo and Carla have collected great artwork over the years. The hosts were mindful of how much time they spent in common areas.
The room is pretty small and has no windows. It has a projector screen and a Google device for temperature adjustment. The bed was so comfortable.
I loved the bathroom! Great colors, quality materials. Good shampoo, conditioner, and body wash were attached to the shower wall.
Parking is by permit only on many streets in this area from 6pm-6am. The spot we reserved online was about 1 mile from the condo.
I would absolutely stay in this condo again!
really nice home especially it is just you and maybe one other person. not too big but not too small it was perfect for what i needed to enjoy my vacation.
Fantastic stay for a short trip into Chicago for a concert! Everything was clean and organized when we arrived!
The place is amazing and the apartment is spacious. Very close to UChicago campus chicago.
Great stay, great communication!

I forgot my bag at the location instead of putting it inside where it was safe and secure.They left it outside on the front porch. This is even after I told the owner that I would be working for the next twelve hours. I was  distracted with the multiple locks that it takes to get in and out

Highly recommend! Good for those looking for a place to crash after a long day of walking. Host was super responsive and kind! Main bed was comfortable and we were provided all the basic amenities to feel at home. Would definitely book again.

This Airbnb was a perfect home base for my family's first time in Chicago! There was plenty of space for the nine of us to hang out and have comfortable sleeping arrangements. We originally picked the location mainly for its close proximity to the United Center but were happy to confirm that it really wasn't a bad drive to anywhere in the city. (It was about an hour from the airport during peak traffic times, but that was to be expected. It only took about 30 minutes on average for us to get to places downtown.) We didn't have any trouble with the street parking, and it was easy to find thanks to the Airbnb signs pointing us in the right direction. It was clean and well-kept, and we would absolutely recommend this to any group looking to stay a little bit outside of the city in a quieter neighborhood. We would definitely stay here again!
Great stay. Close to transit and to the interstate if wanted to drive in closer. Very clean and spacious perfect for our family to stay comfortably.

We had a great time as a family here! Plenty of space, comfortable and spacious rooms and the kids loved the basement and the main living area. The location is great, felt safe and had everything you need. The garage won't fit a vehicle like a Yukon/Suburban so parking on the street isnt the easiest but it was fine. We loved the home and Kelly was great too! We will be back next time were in Chicago!
Felt like I lived in the neighborhood and made friends with the neighbors. Great time and I will be back.

This was my second summer residency staying at Kristen’s place and was just as perfect as last time. Quiet neighborhood, plenty of convenient parking, comfortable & clean accommodations. I was able to fully rest each night between 6 weeks worth of 12 hour days in the city which was just 25 short minutes away by car in morning rush hour traffic. Kristen is so kind & friendly and has made me feel the most welcomed. I’ll likely stay here again for my 3rd & final residency next summer!
Great location at the Chicago old town, safe and near to the subways. Very clean and apartment and nice host! Highly recommend.
Nice spot, fairly easy parking, had everything we needed.
Michael was very responsive. The space was very clean and gets cleaned several times a week. The instructions he gave were clear and easy to follow. Overall, I enjoyed my stay.

Stephanie’s place was fantastic! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We especially loved the amazing views and all of the building amenities, which made our stay even more enjoyable. Stephanie also included thoughtful extras that made us feel welcome and at home. The location was perfect for exploring Chicago, and communication was excellent throughout. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!
Really enjoyed staying over this beautiful apartment! Lots of great restaurants in walking distance. Nice and peaceful neighborhood.
Muy buen lugar y espectacular los anfitriones super atento y amables
A great place to stay!

Excellent place to stay while attending a local conference and working remotely (greatly appreciated having desk set up)
Everything was extremely clean and updated nicely with new appliances. Beds were very comfy and appreciated the smart TVs in living room/bedrooms. Host was also very responsive and made sure we had everything we needed. Will absolutely stay here again!
Gracias estuvimos muy agusto

One of my favorite Airbnb stays! The apartment was decorated sooo cute and the backyard was such a lovely oasis. Roberto was incredibly friendly and a great host. We went to a concert at the Brookfield zoo and it was the perfect location between there and downtown. Nice and quiet and I felt totally safe walking around. There were some very sweet kitties, too!

DO NOT RENT FROM THIS COMPANY. This property is the definition of putting lipstick on a pig. On the surface the place looks nice but upon further inspection you can see how poorly constructed this place is. The stair case is a hazard, multiple people nearly or fully fell and there was glass shards that were on the stairs from the cheaply and poorly constructed glass rods in the stair case. The basement was a complete mess (stained couches and cluttered game room), bathrooms are weirdly constructed where you can see other going to the bathroom just due to the design of this place. The company is completely unhelpful with issues, the internet did not work our entire stay.
Do both stay at this property or any Dream Rentals in the future.
Awesome spot to be close to the white sox and an easy walk to the train to do anything downtown!

This place was worth every penny. Incredibly responsive and helpful host, all needed amenities, excellent location, family-friendly, the whole deal. We stayed about a week and loved it. Portage Park is a great neighborhood, and we were within a sub-20 minute walk of Portage Park, and a sub-5 minute walk to the local library, a bus stop, and an excellent coffee place/café (Perkolator--go!). Everything I needed was at my fingertips. If I come back to Chicago and need a place downtown again, I'll be checking availability for this place first.

Great location in Wicker Park, a very walkable neighbourhood with lots of restaurants and shops. The apartment was spacious and had everything we needed. Easy street parking and easy to get into the town on the blue line. Highly recommended!
It’s a great place. Very quiet neighborhood. We truly enjoy our stay. Highly recommend to everyone.

Stones Throw is a wonderful home-away-from-home.
Communication with Luke was easy & he was quick to respond.
Its an intimate space within walking distance of U of C campus & the Obama Presidential Center. Laundry was practically in-unit. I could go on & on. We loved this spot.
Great stay!

Great place in a great neighborhood. Also great that it was on the first floor!!
Only thing that was annoying is you can hear everything in the hallway. Other than that i would definitely recommend.
Exactly like the pictures! Very helpful and responsive hosts. Our only struggle was to find parking.

Jessica is a wonderful host with an amazing place for anyone especially someone wanting an unbelievable location to Wrigley field. It was a dream stay for my baseball loving kids! I would recommend this place to anyone and hope to return next trip to Wrigleyville!
Exactly as described.  Basement unit.  Very clean and well-appointed.  The Logan Square location is perfectly situated between downtown and O'Hare.
Wonderful apartment! Super comfortable beds, great shower with great water pressure.  Bar/coffeehouse downstairs has great food, coffee, and cocktails.  Best air bnb in Chicago.  We will be back!
Dan’s home was great for a big group of 9. Plenty of space, clean, updated and comfortable. Highly recommend!

Had a nice stay! This was a clean budget-friendly place with easy street parking. Quiet and cozy. A great place to come back to for an afternoon nap and after a night out. Would definitely stay here again!
La casa súper linda, el anfitrión siempre pendiente , volvería muchas veces más, está súper recomendado el alojamiento ❤️

We stayed in the Home Run suite at the Inn at Wrigleyville and it exceeded our expectations. We were visiting for a Cubs and Savannah Bananas game so the neighborhood was incredibly busy, as you’d expect. But the place was still peaceful and reasonably quiet considering everything that is literally right outside the front door. The place was perfectly clean and ready for us upon arrival. Beds are all comfortable. The bathrooms are spacious and the showers are all great. The kitchen is well equipped to cook if you want, though it’s pretty unnecessary with so many restaurants nearby. The views out the front windows are spectacular. You’re looking right into Wrigley. Host instructions were all very easy to follow.
Great location, nice and private, cozy, conveniently close to the trains, best find
Laura's places was very chic and comfortable. Love the cheetah wall paper. Walkable to coffee shops and small convenience stores. Would stay there again. Thank you!

I spent five nights at Mark and Lisa's place in Lincoln Square and it was great. Beautiful neighborhood, quiet and peaceful, close to local shops and restaurants, and a short walk to the Damen stop on the brown line to begin my greater-Chicago adventures. Hosts were communicable but respected your privacy despite their living upstairs. I can't recommend this air bnb enough!

We had a fantastic stay in Chicago! The apartment was clean, fully stocked with everything we needed, and located in a wonderfully quiet and safe neighborhood. Having a Target, great local restaurants and the Blue Line metro all within walking distance made exploring the city and getting downtown effortless. Street parking in the area was also a breeze, which is a huge bonus in Chicago. On top of the great space, Chanda was exceptionally friendly, fast to respond, and easy to communicate with from start to finish. We couldn't have asked for a better home base and would definitely stay here again!

My family and I had a terrific week in Michael's apartment. The location is great (in fact, it was our old block!), the beds are comfortable, and Michael is an excellent communicator. Would absolutely book again!

Es un hostal. La limpieza está súper. Nelson y su equipo siempre están al pendiente. Está a 12 minutos del metro 35th-Sox que te lleva directo al centro. Caminar por ahí de noche está solo aunque no nos pasó nada ni tuvimos experiencias malas. Está a un costado de la carretera. Para el precio y la proximidad está excelente.

Dirty plate, no linen or towel change, washed and dried them ourselves, floor to main apartment could have been cleaner. A vegetable peeler and grater even kitchen scissors would have been helpful, even a couple of containers for left over food would have been helpful, was not aware at the time of booking it was four flights of stairs to bring up a 29kg suit case and four bags of grocery shopping was not ideal

We got to meet Brad during our stay. He was taking care of some Wifi challenges for the property and was very welcoming and communicative!
We enjoyed our stay very much!

La ubicación es muy central, el anfitrión es muy gentil y cordial. La casa es muy linda, tiene muy buenas instalaciones, es espaciosa y las camas son muy cómodas . Todo estaba muy limpio y ordenado. Completamente recomendado.

We booked our Chicago stay at this location due to its proximity to the L, so we could get to various places within the city without having to drive our own car and deal with traffic and expensive parking. It was about a 5 minute walk to the L, and from there roughly 20 minutes to Wrigleyville and 40 to downtown!
The host was very friendly and checked in via message several times during our three-night stay. We did not need anything at all; the place had everything! It was very clean, well-decorated, the AC worked great, and the bed is super comfortable! We will definitely book here again when we return to the city. 😊

We had the Teal room and it was great! The host was responsive to all of my questions and answered them in a timely manner. The other guests were also respectful so my friend and I had a peaceful stay here.

Overall had a great time at the place, I will say coming with kids however did not realize how small the toddler bed was. My toddler just barely fit so be aware the bed is smaller, also there is only set of sheets for the toddler bed and the main bed. Luckily we did not have any accidents from our kiddo but be aware you may wanna pack a pull up or two just in case you are worried about it! There was no welcome packet so had to ask a few questions regarding wifi however the host was very great to communicate with just worth noting so you do not come in like and feel a bit turned around. Last thing regarding is there are no blackout curtains so if your kids sleep with blackout curtains like many do today there are not any for this location as of this review.
Again had a great stay overall just worth noting this for those traveling with kids, highly recommend still and will use again.
Hosts were very responsive and accommodating. Place for our needs perfectly. Parking spot a plus for sure. Clean and near plenty of dining and transportation. Worth it

Lovely breakfast in the morning, and a kerig for rooms in the basement! In the center of the action, but back off the street, so relatively quiet for sleep. Beautiful garden walkway up to the house. Felt very safe and secure. Well worth the money. Had what we needed for our stay.

We stayed at this location last year and we were happy to see that it was available for our trip this year.! The location is easy to get to from the freeway and has plenty of free street parking.  We like that it was in a quiet, peaceful neighborhood but still a quick walk to the blue line to get to destinations in the city.

Airbnb was nice very clean and comfortable. I slept VERY well the bed was amazingly comfortable. Only thing would be the steep stairs going up the Airbnb (felt a bit dangerous lol) lastly the parking situation had me a bit worried only because there was street parking and the roads were always packed with cars, we were just afraid someone would hit our car.

Had a great stay w 3 teen grandkids! Apartment was as described & on quiet street within about 6 blocks of Blue Line El train. Nikole was very helpful w directions & recommendations for local places to eat. Fully stocked w toiletries & kitchen accessories, including Kerig coffee! Lovely neighborhood w several stores & restaurants w/ I 6 block radius. We had a great time the entire week we were there. Thank you, Nikole!

This was a great place to stay! It’s within walking distance (5-10 min) from the train station, good restaurants, and cool shops. The house and room were clean and all amenities in good order. The hosts are very friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again :) Thanks!

Wir hatten einen angenehmen Aufenthalt in der Unterkunft. Bis in die Innenstadt ist es ein gutes Stück zu fahren, aber das war uns bewusst. Die Wohnung liegt im Erdgeschoss. Aufgrund der amerikanischen Bauweise hört man jeden einzelnen Schritt der Bewohner des oberen Stockwerkes. Diese waren nicht überdurchschnittlich laut, es war einfach alles sehr hellhörig.
Die Ausstattung ist in Ordnung, war jedoch sehr knapp bei der Anzahl der Teller z.B. Wir hatten das jedoch angemerkt und sofort wurde Nachschub der Teller gebracht. Die Kommunikation war sehr gut.

Room number three was a very nice room with good air conditioning and silk bedsheets/very clean. I met the owners upon arriving, and they were very nice and accommodating. It was nice to see a very clean kitchen, bathroom, and fridge in an Airbnb (which I don’t find is very common). I also found the floors to be very clean. I would not recommend a late check-in because there seemed to be an issue with another guest there. The front door has some issues, however, if you are patient and use it correctly, it should lock and be okay. I really enjoyed room number three however, the other rooms in the apartment did not look as nice, personally.

Staying at Jasmine’s place was an absolute delight. She was very proactive in communicating and ensuring that our needs were met and accommodated our early check-in. Location was easy to get around in Albany Park. Her place was clean, organized and comfortable.
Lovely place for a family. Convenient to brown line and buses. Very cute neighborhood.
Great location and easy access to the blue line. Kevin and Heather were very responsive and their place was perfect for our visit.
Had a great stay! They were extremely responsive and were always available to talk about anything that came up. Would stay again!
Ronneisha was super responsive and helpful.  Didnt really need much from her.  The place was completely remodelled recently, very clean with vaulted ceilings and nice furnishings.

I very highly recommend staying with Felice! Her home is beautiful, clean, in a great neighborhood/location. Be sure to ask Felice if you’re looking for recommendations on coffee shops, restaurants, or any local attraction. I greatly enjoyed my stay - Felice met me on the street at check-in to welcome me as her guest, and did the same as check-out, this time as her friend. Can’t wait to stay with her again.
Beautifully decorated and clean! We were in town for an event a Wrigley and found this place to be an easy walk there. Having a parking pass was a major plus. Would stay again! Thanks!

Beautiful layout, very spacious and comfortable. The neighborhood is walkable with the beach and train access only a few blocks away. I would suggest Le Piano for cocktails and live jazz. Overall the unit was tidy and comfortable in spite of it feeling a bit sparse. Would definitely recommend.
Nice quiet neighborhood.  Perfect clean place to stay.  Public transit close by if you need it.

The place was great for our trip to Wrigley for Savannah Bananas. We have 5 children and everyone had their own space. It was so nice! Don’t be like us if you park in the garage and walk all the way around to the front 🫠. It was unnecessary when there is a back entrance 😆 it is a 2nd floor unit! I am also an Airbnb host near by and took notes for ours. We loved our experience given location and having a family with young kids.

Me and my dog had a wonderful time staying in Andrea and David’s garden unit BnB in Irving Park. It was spacious and comfortable. A great place to work remote and stay for a month while exploring and getting to know the area while planning for a relocation. The neighborhood is very walkable and diverse with plenty of cafes, bakeries,  grocery options, and restaurants within a 10-15 min walk or very short drive if you need to. CTA transit options are nice as well.  Highly recommend staying with them and the area
Place is ok, nothing special, just the minimum, I guess for the price it’s ok.

This is a great apartment close to the red line. It is very easy to get downtown from that location, and there's a Trader Joe's just one station away. There are tons of restaurants just down the street. Our plane was delayed and when we got there around 8pm, the access code was not working, and we couldn't get in touch with the host. We ended up having to book a hotel for the night. We got reimbursed and the code was working properly the next day. The apartment was absolutely perfect for us for the whole rest of the week.

Absolutely wonderful hosts! The house is great and the location is fantastic. Located right in the heart of Wicker Park, we had access to great shops and dining. My family and I had a great stay at Nicole and Matt’s place and we would definitely recommend you stay here.
Very responsive, clear instructions, and great home to stay in
Convenient location, clean, and matches the description. Would stay there again.

We had a wonderful stay in Bridgeport! The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful, while still offering easy access to great bars, coffee shops, and restaurants. Getting around was incredibly convenient, whether by Uber or public transportation.
The accommodations were lovely, comfortable, and exactly what we were looking for. Laura was an exceptional host—quick to communicate, responsive to every question, and always making sure our needs were taken care of.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend Laura’s place to anyone visiting Chicago. We would definitely stay here again!
I enjoyed my stay it was easy finding the home and getting in , very quiet and safe. Louis is very helpful and responsive 10/10 I’ll book again when i visit again!!

Bill and Susan are by far the best hosts we’ve had with Airbnb. They are so thoughtful, friendly, and kind. We felt safe and Bill helped us with finding our way through the city. We loved that we could park our car in their driveway and use the city transportation. They thought of every detail and we especially enjoyed our coffee while learning about their home and themselves. Of course Mighty Theo their dog may have been our favorite! 😆
Solid apartment in a great location. Alma was a very responsive host. The towels and some rugs are in need of an upgrade though.

Public transportation was easily accessible from the airbnb, all within a 5-10 minute walking distance—specifically the Red & Green line + a bus stop. Both lines were completely safe to walk to during daytime but once the sun set it definitely felt unsafe walking home. However, each station has police officers surveilling so that kept us at more at ease!
The airbnb itself was exactly as pictured. Everything in the listing is accurate. A 20-25 minute car ride from Chicago MDW. What others have reviewed about neighbors from above being loud, especially after quiet hours, is true. However, we didn’t let that affect our stay. Just something to keep in mind. The host is super responsive and will do everything to ensure you enjoy your time!

I stayed here for two days, and it was not worth the money. The place is significantly overpriced for what you get.
The biggest issue was the air conditioning. It barely worked, and the host appeared to keep the temperature set too high. I asked if it could be lowered, but he refused, saying he needed to "balance the temperature." It felt like he was trying to save on utility costs by keeping the AC at a warmer setting all day.
If you decide to stay here, be prepared to feel hot, especially at night. Since you can't adjust the temperature yourself, sleeping comfortably can be difficult. I wouldn't stay here again.
Cristina’s place was beautiful and perfect for my group. It was spacious and the common areas were great. Very good commutation and responsive. Would definitely recommend to stay there.

This place was so peaceful and comfortable. I wished I could’ve stayed a few days longer, just to have time to relax and enjoy the space more. It was very clean and spacious. I have friends in the area and will definitely be staying here again the next time I visit.

We had a great stay and would definitely book again. Everything was very clean, the appartment is well equipped and nicely decorated. The area is a mix of residential and commercial, we liked it and there were a lot of good recommendations for food. We especially liked Kuma‘s Corner (great burgers, a heavy metal themed place and extraordinarily friendly staff) and the Avondale coffee club (a great place for coffee geeks that also has nice pastries). If you are looking for an area that is entirely quiet at night, you might be disappointed, but we liked the vibe of the neighborhood. Check out is quite early (10 a.m.), but this was clearly indicated. Towels and blankets looked like new and the beds are comfortable.

Nancy and Brian are the perfect hosts. While there were few requests, like how to use the Washer/Dryer machine, our month long stay was all we desired. When you have a long stay you really get to know the apartment and the surrounding neighborhood. In the summer, if you are a walker, runner or biker, the Lakefront is a stones throw away. Baseball fan? Walk to Wrigley Field for a Cubs game or other events. Restaurants galore in all directions. Even a coveted parking space.
What's not to like?
Nice stay in a great location. Would love to return next time I’m in town. Host was very responsive.
Cody’s place is great and he is a wonderful host. Highly recommended!
Place is as described , great location , nice and quiet

Really great place! It had enough space for my group and a kitchen for our needs. Very comfortable to stay in and had a tv with streaming services. One thing to note is that it can take close to an hour to get to the downtown via transit, but it is easy to do so. Would recommend!

This spot is in a great location with plenty of shops, bars, and restaurants within walking distance. There were a couple of hiccups with entry, but Josh was extremely responsive throughout the entire stay and solved the issues quickly.
The walls of the unit are a bit thin so you can hear folks coming in and out of the building as well as the footsteps in the unit above, but it's very manageable.
Overall, this is a great place to stay in Chicago for a night, a couple of months, or anything in between.

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb and would absolutely book it again the next time I’m in Chicago. The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully put together with everything I needed to feel at home. It was clear the hosts take great pride in maintaining the property, and every detail made for a relaxing and enjoyable stay.
The location was another huge highlight. It was easy to get around the city, with plenty of great restaurants, coffee shops, and attractions nearby. Whether I was exploring during the day or heading out in the evening, everything felt convenient and accessible.
The hosts were friendly, responsive, and made the entire experience seamless from check-in to check-out. They provided clear instructions, communicated promptly, and made me feel welcome throughout my stay. Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago!
It was great for its price. Nothing special, but also nothing bad.

The room was absolutely true to the pictures. This is not only a huge money saver but the location is almost perfect, like you’re surrounded with tourist restaurants and there’s a lot to try, not only that but I felt very safe in this part of Chicago due to how popular this location is for tourists. I was originally afraid of the idea of sharing a bathroom but the apartment has many restrooms to choose from and I seen the owner cleaning them a lot during my stay. The owner is doing a great job keeping this place comfortable for everyone. This is a great choice if you want to save money and have a comfortable place to stay with great air conditioning in the middle of Chicago.
Great place to stay and will definitely return

Was the perfect place for my vacation. Nice walking distance from Wrigley Field, and both the Brown and Red Line stations. Had a hostel vibe, so there were other people in and out and in shared spaces. Room was the perfect size for all my stuff. Would highly recommend if in coming to Chicago.
Great private area! Would definitely book again when I return to Chicago. Thank you

Noel’s place was the best! I even accidentally got there a day early and he accommodated us. He gave us great places to eat and even asked all about our nonprofit, and followed us on social media to support our kids. Noel is so kind, and brings authentic Pilsen to the place. If you want to support the neighborhood, this spot is the best! loved the towel warmer and heated floors in the bathroom! The shower is AMAZING! The kitchen is so cute that I came home and wanted to replicate it here at my house in Cleveland! This was the best stay.

Very nice, clean, and comfortable place, spacious for our group of 5 adults.  We had our own cars and parking was available in a reserved spot and on the street in front of the building (free). While there's not much to do in the immediate area, it's close to the metro transit and not a terrible commute into the city.  The host provided clear instructions for the property and offered recommendations for places to eat nearby.  The accommodations were definitely affordable for our short stay.  Thanks.

Slavyana’s place is amazing! It’s a quiet and beautifully appointed home right in the heart of everything that Chicago has to offer. It was honestly even better than we anticipated. The space is open, bright, and comfortable. We spent a lot of time on the deck as well. We didn’t want to leave!
Erica’s place was clean, quiet, and comfortable. The neighborhood is very walkable and pretty. I took the bus to the beach and to my concert venue and it was so easy. Would stay again!
Great stay for a family of 5 in to Chicago for the first time for a family wedding. Very active neighborhood accessible to downtown.  Fantastic restaurants, amenities and beautiful Wicker Park.

Anna was so nice and very helpful. I enjoyed my time here, very clean and spacious looks exactly as the photos. A plus is the bed was very comfortable, had the best sleep during my time here. Thank you again for having us!
Place was clean, host communicated very well. Would stay again.

Jorge’s place met my needs - I had to stay for a couple of weeks close to the UChicago med center campus. It was a beautiful walk every day. The building is right across from a park. Felt very safe. Walking distance to Trader Joe’s and Target and some restaurants!
Great easy location for exploring the city!
Thank you Andy!  It was very comfortable stay.

We visit Chicago often and have stayed at many short term rentals. Sean’s spot is now one of our favorites! The location is walkable to many of our favorite restaurants, the lakefront and Wrigley Field.  The daily free bagels were a great touch that our kids loved.  The only downside (but expected) is you do hear a lot of street noise on the weekends from the bar across the street and theatre next door.  This was no big deal to us as it’s part of city living.
Very nice, clean and affordable place in safe and quiet area. Highly recommend!
Had a good time there. Everything is very clean and the owner is really nice and gives great advice for tourists. Also is the AirBnB located very good for quick trips to the center of Chicago
The place was clean and exactly as described. It was a good stay for the night and check in was easy. I appreciate the host and would recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient place to stay.
I enjoyed my stay at Carlos! It was a quiet zone surrounded by a lot of good Mexican restaurants and close to downtown. We appreciated the parking permits!
short but nice stay

Very spacious living area and kitchen that flows to a spectacular outdoor space. Furnishings were dated and I would describe the general vibe as ‘hodgepodge’, but not in a bad way per se…it’s just the vibe. You can’t be the location - we’d do it again for sure.
Great stay! Plenty to do! Great communication!
Great stay! Place was super clean which is always important to me. I would most definitely recommend.

Very close to CTA Green and Red lines to get to and from downtown. As with any major city the area in front of the apartment can feel slightly unsafe at times although I had no problems. Would stay here again.

Love it! Beautiful cozy place! Very well organized maintained and cleaned. Definitely recommend it. Kyriako and Maria were fast at responding. Give out very detailed information and instructions love it! Thank you for having us!
Great value for the location.  This is a great stay for people who plan to spend most of their time exploring.  It’s nice and cool (temp-wise) for sleeping, and I like the rumbling of the train!
Lovely place to stay. Corinne was an excellent host and very accommodating.

We had an amazing stay at Jeannette's. She was very responsive, friendly, and even allowed us to check in early.  The place was exactly as described, clean, cozy and perfect for our needs. It was also right off the blue line and bus lines to easily get around the city. We did hear the blue line passing by in the room, but it didn't bother us one bit. The bed was comfortable, and we always got a good night's rest to get ready for the next day. Would definitely recommend Jeannette's place to anyone who is looking for a place to stay. A+++
Great hidden gem on the South Side! The larger 3 full-bed room is a great bang for your buck. Big windows, ceiling fan, futon, workable space and good closet storage. And it’s on the first level.

Excellent location, an easy 20 min walk to Wrigley Field and a 5 minute walk to the beautiful Graceland Cemetery where you can do self-guided tours. The place was pristine and very comfortable. The AC units kept the place nice and cool. Very comfortable bed and the shower had great pressure. Coffee and sodas provided, a nice touch. The artwork made the place feel unique compared to other vanilla Airbnb’s. Loved the check-out process- leave keys and walk out the door. Absolutely gorgeous neighborhood too- beautiful streets to walk down with little local cafes and bars. Highly recommend!
Zen was very nice responsive to our needs and the place was very lovely.

This is a great place to stay. It's small (really ideal for one person) and aspects are a bit run down (most notably blinds and curtains), but a great location in a walkable neighborhood and a great value for the money.
Really nice apartment we stayed at the place was clean and the host was responsive making it easy to get in and find everything overall we had a good experience and would recommend
Phenomenal digs and great location! Super spacious and very clean. We’re very grateful we got to stay here.

Apt was cute, cozy, and clean. Hosts were very responsive and super helpful. Area is fun and close to transit, not super family friendly for young kids but the area is cool, fun restaurants,  good coffee shops, quiet compared to other parts of the city.

Très bon logement pour découvrir Chicago.
Logement pas dans Downtown, mais la ligne de bus 65 à 2mn.

It was such a quaint & lovely stay. Nice quiet neighborhood & the beach access just steps away made me feel right at home, being from Tampa. I will definitely return to Tammy’s if my travel takes me back to Chicago!

We enjoyed our stay as it was a quick L trip to all the areas we planned to visit. While we felt safe in the Airbnb unit, the streets were not our favorite walk coming back late at night from the subway station, but that was easily fixed with uber drives when we had nighttime returns. The unit itself had all we needed for our stay and the owners were responsive when we reached out.

Hi, really nice place in a great neighborhood. Really clean. Good wifi. The only thing to note, bedrooms are quite small and the beds are full size, or maybe even smaller than a full size. Just something to know when you are considering the place.

We were in town for a tour of Loyola and this was apartment was located in an ideal location.
It was clean, well appointed with two bedrooms and two bathrooms (key for a family of four with two teenagers)! We had very clear instructions and the apartment was as described and very clean.
We would not hesitate to return.

Devin was such an accommodating host! I ended up having flight issues that pushed my initial check in back but she was super considerate and I was able to check in with no issue the next day. Logan Square is a beautiful neighborhood and having a location so nearby to transit and local restaurants was great. I would love to rebook next chance I get to come to Chicago!

It was absolutely lovely. They are so accommodating and quick to respond as well! I 100% would recommend and would stay here again! The bus line drops off/picks up right in front as well, and there is a target down the street with a parking lot!
Great stay in a fun neighborhood and close to to public transportation.  Super clean and nicely decorated.
環境もいいところで、ゆっくり滞在できました。

Would definitely take my money and put it towards a nicer bnb without bed bugs. I understand things happen but my trip was ruined, I still haven’t received my refund, and we had to pay out of pocket for a expensive hotel because everything was booked up. Was told I would be compensated 100$ a night for a hotel but when I reached out I didn’t receive a reply. Had to throw away my belongings that were affected and my mother got bit 4 times.
Katie's place was wonderful and was exactly what I needed during my stay.  I would highly recommend it.

This is a wonderful get away spot to escape to for an individual or a couple looking for some cozy time to disconnect and dissociate. It’s small but extremely cozy and private which I love!  Very responsive host to even the smallest of requests and is extremely accommodating to checking in. I highly recommend this location! You will not regret it!
Walid is the Goat, you’re missing out if you ain’t booking from him. He was so friendly and always responded quick. Place was awesome and made our first time Chicago feel memorable.
Excelente estadía; sin duda volveré.
Thanks as always

We absolutely loved our stay! It was our first trip to Chicago for my birthday, and this is the perfect place. Clean, cozy, comfortable. The host is friendly, responded quickly, and was always happy to help if we needed anything. We’d definitely recommend staying here!
Great location in Old Town with easy access to restaurants, coffee shops, grocery store,  and public transit.

Fue un gran lugar para quedarse toda la familia .  Está en un barrio tranquilo y tiene un lugar grande para estacionarse.  La casa cuenta con todo lo necesario y dos baños grandes.  También la cocina está muy bien equipada.  Al entrar tiene unas escaleras por lo que una persona en silla de ruedas puede tener dificultades. Pero si son jóvenes no hay problema.  Es un gran lugar para quedarse.
Large, clean rooms. Great location.  Would return in future!
Great place. Exactly as advertised. Very good location too. Super convenient.

My boyfriend and I were visiting Chicago for a little getaway vacation and the place did not disappoint! It was very comfy and it felt like there was enough space and privacy. The bathrooms were clean and the patio area was a nice touch! Fun fact: there were a couple of cute chickens next to the building and my boyfriend and I loved saying hi to them when we left the building. The area was quiet and peaceful and I did not mind the shared space aspect. I would definitely come back here again!! 🐓❤️

Incredible property. Beautifully appointed. And terrific bargain. Do not be put off by the exterior. Lovely neighborhood. Friendly and helpful neighbors. My only challenge was the two flights of stairs with luggage. No elevator.
Be sure to visit The House of Bing on Thursday night and converse with the three gentlemen that meet there every Thursday.

Scott and Mindy's place is incredibly decorated in one of the cutest neighborhoods in Chicago. Extremely charming area. You have approximately 18 stairs to get into place but has a railing. Beds are comfortable. Decor is adorable. Perfect for staying in the city but feeling like you've found a gem in the city. Thank you again !

We had a great stay at Phil’s Airbnb in Chicago! The house was comfortable, welcoming, and a great place to come back to after exploring the city. Phil was a wonderful host, and we even had the pleasure of meeting his dad upstairs, who was very friendly and made us feel right at home. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend Phil’s place to anyone visiting Chicago!

My boyfriend and  I drove to Chicago and stayed at April’s/Gaby home for two nights for a concert. The Airbnb is the basement, we had the whole basement to our self (bedroom/half bathroom/living room) I really liked that the bedroom included a desk, chair, and bench table. Gaby’s home felt welcoming, safe, and comfortable. We got to meet Gaby in person, it was a pleasure to meet Gaby. The neighbors/area was pretty quiet during the day and night, we slept through the night with no issues. The main floor offer a full bathroom for Airbnb, shared fridge, kitchen, living room. We enjoyed our stayed at Gaby and April home, we would recommend this place and stay with them again, Thank you!
The hosts were so kind and accommodating. The place was really clean and perfect for the three of us. We loved it.
Great location! Cheryl was very responsive and checking in on our needs. Highly recommend!

Family of four adults. I will explain here the info I was looking and could not clearly see from the pictures when I booked. The apartment was very clean and tidy. It is a first floor(main level) and lower floor. Someone lives upstairs(third level). There are two bedrooms on main level than can share a full bathroom and can be locked from either room if privacy is an issue. There is an additional half bath. Downstairs has two more bedrooms which are better if you make noise. Entering and exiting was easy for us. No need to worry about losing keys. We traveled Wednesday through Saturday and found several street parking spots every day. The area has several medical facilities and is a few blocks from the highway that takes you straight to the pier area(fifteen minutes drive). We did see a few pizza and fast food restaurants nearby. The neighborhood appears safe, people jogging and walking their dogs. Communication with host was great.    I would recommend this place or stay again.
Excellent stay, would go back again

We absolutely loved Matthew's place!  I thought the photos did not do justice to the spaces, it was super welcoming with a great ease to everything.  The technology was easy to use, we cooked several meals there  as well as bake and we found it had all the kitchen amenities we needed.  The jacuzzi was awesome, we were in it twice a day!  The yard was a great respite from the city, and it was so nice to have for our small dog! With two tourist-days seeing the museums and the city, it was such a lovely and peaceful place to come "home" to!  Thanks Matthew!

Great location
Good unit

Awesome place! The house was super clean and nice to be in. We slept 5 adults comfortably. The back porch sitting area worked out great with the perfect weather we had and was a huge plus to have. Quick access to the blue line made it easy to get around and see the city. The Bloomingdale trail was close by too, which was nice to use to get to areas along its path. Thank you Mary & Andrew!

This was my favorite AirBNB!
Excellent location; a bus stop within a 1min walk.
Very close to Lincoln Square and endless options for shopping and food.
I had a great time overall and look forward to staying here again.

We had a great stay in Lincoln Square! This place is right in the heart of this beautiful neighborhood with walkable access to shops, restaurants, Welles Park, and the L train. The apartment was exactly as pictured, very clean, and easy to access. The host was very quick to respond and even let us drop our bags early so we could get some extra time to walk around the neighborhood. Highly recommend!
Lauren's a great and welcoming host! She's very easy to talk to and made sure everything went really smoothly. Would certainly recommend.
Great place to stay in Chicago, very comfortable and inviting, great job on providing things that are useful in a BnB setting!

A nice, clean and cosy place ideal for solo travelers. Walking distance to Chinatown and fast commute to downtown. The bathroom is private and there’s a fridge and microwave in the room which’s super convenient. I feel very safe and comfortable in the neighborhood. Elaine is a very attentive and helpful host who gave me insightful recommendations.

Our family of 4 stayed here and found it to be a fine place to rest and recharge after long days of sightseeing. The apartment was clean and met our basic needs throughout our stay.
One thing we experienced, which other guests have also mentioned, was the living room couch. Since there aren’t TVs in the bedrooms, we had hoped to relax together with a family movie night after busy days exploring the city. Unfortunately, the couch wasn’t very comfortable, which made it difficult to unwind as a family.
The host responses were a bit robotic, but everything went smoothly overall. The only thing that stood out was that the check-in and check-out policies felt a bit stricter than what we’ve experienced at other Airbnb properties. That said, we still had an enjoyable stay and appreciated having a clean, convenient place to come back to each day.
Very kind and responsive! Can’t wait to visit again.

Karen's place was AH-mazing! Super cool & cute. Perfect location. Safe and just a close walk to either the L line or many different bus stops. We had no issues getting to and from downtown, either baseball field, Navy Pier or Linkin Park etc.
This is also the most well stocked Air BNB I have ever stayed in. Karen goes above and beyond to supply things you might need and even better things you might WANT. There was coffee, eggs, waffles, bread, wine etc. It was great.
We will definitely be staying at Karen's when we visit Chicago again!
Great location with tons of options for food, drinks,  and transportation. Very walkable and beautiful neighborhood setting!

We had an amazing stay! The Airbnb was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The location was perfect—close to downtown Chicago, the beaches, and just a quick L train ride to Wrigley Field. Parking was incredibly convenient with both a garage and street parking available. Just a note that we had a mini van, and that fit in the garage tightly but doable! Anything bigger would be a challenge for sure. Still a GREAT positive for parking in Chicago to have a dedicated space!!
The neighborhood felt safe, clean, and welcoming, making it easy to relax and explore. Communication with the host was outstanding from start to finish—friendly, responsive, and helpful every step of the way.
This was our first Airbnb experience and we will absolutely stay here again on our next trip to Chicago. Highly recommend!
Was a great place to spend some time with a friend and explore Chicago!  Enrique was very helpful and accommodating.
RUE IS THE BEST DOG EVER! I LOVE YOU RUE!!!!!
The suite was excellent and we so enjoyed being there.   We so enjoyed the extra amenities and hope we can stay with them again.

Stayed here with a group for WNBA All Star Weekend and it was the perfect stay. From the garage, street parking and space for a large group, it felt like a home away from home. I’d highly recommend for a group/large family!

An absolutely great place to stay when visiting Wrigley or Chicago in general.  Close to the ballpark, transit, and plenty of dining options. Sharon was super helpful and everything was great. We'd have no hesitation recommending it to others.

Ming war sehr hilfreich und auch im persönlichen Gespräch sehr nett. Ich habe keine Beschwerde über die Unterkunft. Das Wäschewaschen mit Waschmaschinen im Keller war sehr hilfreich und günstig. Die Mitbewohner sorgten für keine Probleme. Die Umgebung bot gute Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und ich fühlte mich auch sicher. Das Zentrum von Chicago ist sehr gut erreichbar gewesen.  Ich kann die Unterkunft empfehlen.
Very nice home but could be cleaner

Great location, but unfortunately that’s where the positives ended. We were very disappointed with our stay and couldn’t wait to leave the next morning.
The bed sheets had large brown stains and there were no clean replacements, so my pregnant wife and I had to share a single clean sheet. Tried to resolve the issue with the advertised “concierge service” but they didn’t call us back & the host didn’t offer new sheets. Other issues included loud neighbors, unreliable Wi-Fi, holes in the walls, exposed wires, cobwebs, gum on the walls, a detached toilet sensor sitting near the TV, and a staircase without a railing at the top. The bed frame squeaked so loudly that it woke us up whenever either of us moved.
We ended our trip early. The host refunded the unused nights but refused our request for a partial refund for the night we stayed. Airbnb ultimately granted the refund after we spent about 3 hours with customer support. We appreciate Airbnb’s help, but wish the host had resolved it.

We had a wonderful stay! The location was perfect—within easy walking distance of plenty of great restaurants while still being quiet and peaceful at night, making it easy to get a good night’s sleep. The home was spotless, comfortable, and well-maintained. We especially loved the spacious primary bathroom and the beautiful shower. We would absolutely recommend this property to others and would happily stay here again.
Love her place she always communicates with us  via email making sure everything is ok very nice lady

Great location, super value. Rida is extremely responsive.  The apartment’s furnishings are pretty basic, know that it is not a luxury experience, but I do think it represents great value for the price if the Belmont location is what you need.
Great quick stay in the center of Chicago. Great neighborhood and the place had everything we needed. Thank you!

This is an absolutely wonderful place to stay while visiting Chicago. The place is very clean and has everything you could need. It's in a great location near the beach, great restaurants, and the Red Line for easy access to other Chicago neighborhoods. I would love to stay there again!

Nice place. A long walk to downtown but we wanted that area as I have a friend who lives close by. There are restaurants around and you can walk to Chinatown pretty easily. Public transit not far either.  Seems safe. One of the bedrooms has an opening at top, kind of like a loft.  Didn't bother us but incase someone would need more of a sound barrier.  We enjoyed our stay.

My family and I were visiting Chicago for a couple of days and absolutely loved our stay at this Airbnb. The host was super responsive and very helpful! The area is super walkable and very accessible. There are a ton of bus routes and the orange line is within walking distance. There’s also a grocery store and a lot of local shops and restaurants. There’s also a very nice park within walking distance as well. Would highly recommend and would definitely stay here again!
Nice place. Recommended.  I definitely  will try to get this place next time i go t chicago area. Thanks leo and alex

Smooth stay. Definitely read description.
It won’t be sparkly clean, but manageable for a couple nights. Host was good. Area was good for me, love Hispanic people. There’s a good natural farm store around few minutes walking.
Great location

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful condo! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, with everything we needed for a relaxing visit. The location was fantastic—close to great restaurants, attractions, and public transportation, making it easy to explore Chicago.
The host Lisa was exceptional: friendly, responsive, and incredibly attentive throughout our stay. They made check-in seamless and were always available to answer questions or offer helpful recommendations. Their hospitality really made us feel welcome.
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this condo to anyone looking for a comfortable, convenient, and enjoyable place to stay in Chicago!
Great place, comfortable, spacious, fantastic location in Chicago.  Would stay again!

This house is absolutely beautiful with a great set up and tons of room where everybody has their own space. Super convenient and pretty much 30 minutes tops to all of Chicago’s best areas. We loved our stay here.
The inside of the house was clean and in good condition

Love Chicago so much, this was my 2nd visit and Jeff’s place was amazing! It was a convenient location to bus stops / blue line station. Cute neighborhood, easy to get inside the home and overall Jeff was communicative and friendly. I would definitely stay here away if I were to visit Chicago again!

Location was fantastic but the room was small and I was given an accessible room with stains on the carpet and wet section of the carpet. The room needs updating. Also, the elevator was inoperative so we had to take the stairs or wait for someone to take us in the service elevator which looked like something out of the Saw movies. Water pressure was not good in shower or tub shower. Again, location was fantastic.
Great location and a great stay!

It was exactly as promised, plenty of room, close to Obama Presidential Center, very personable, excellent parking, optional alarm system (and we didn’t feel the need use it), lite snacks - in all 5+ ratings. Would definitely stay there again!

Great place in a beautiful neighborhood. Comfy beds and relaxing living room.
Laura was helpful letting us drop our bags early before check in after our flight landed. I’ll definitely stay here again.
Great place. Clean, great views, central to great food.
Muy cómodo y limpio, buena ubicación para el transporte público
Nice room and location! Nice host!
Nice location. Very quiet neighborhood. The condo was very clean and the bed was rather comfortable.

The apartment was as described and really comfy. All in all I would rate the place a 4.5/5. The other .5 isn't their fault but there are people above you and they can be a bit loud as they move around in the morning and in the evening. But besides that it was a great place which helped provide a great visit to Chicago.

Soraya is very accommodating and responsive. Place is just as described, very clean and spacious. Amazing location, my sisters and I utilized public transport and there’s a bus stop 2 min walk away which was very convenient!!
lovely stay loved chicago
Great place to stay! Very clean and well decorated
Great Stay Thank you Elia!

The convenient location was great for all the things we wanted to see and do - perfect for exploring a new city. The space itself was fine. If there are staff members on the premises as was mentioned, they should be sure that all the common areas are kept clean. The kitchen sink had stinky food in it the whole time we were there. I never got a straightforward, helpful answer about parking and eventually figured it out myself, but it could have been a very easy answer from someone who was familiar with the area. The cost of the Airbnb plus the cost of parking really added up.
Top drawer apartment in absolutely cracking location. Full aircon an absolute boon. Lots of little touches like the coffee pods, chocolates and gummy sweets. Bathrooms x2 and a wonderful balcony.

Paula and Adrian were excellent hosts. They were very responsive to all of our needs. Directions to the apartment were clear and made the entry so easy! The decor is beautiful and the kitchen is well stocked with every amenity you could possibly need. There is a shared outdoor space that is lovely for morning coffee. The location is about an hour walk to the lake (if you like walking)  and a short walk to the bus stop to the airport. An Uber/Lyft ride in non rush hour to downtown was only 15 minute. The apartment is in a lovely neighborhood.
Overall we had a great visit. Super clear instructions and we look forward to visiting again!

I always book Anthony’s place for my parents when they visit and they absolutely love it! Every time they come to Chicago they request this Airbnb. It is clean, close to so much including Milwaukee and and CTA/bus stops, and he is so responsive and an amazing host. Will keep booking here!!

This is the third time I've stayed at Deborah's AIRBNB and I can't say enough positive things.   Her place is exactly as pictured and described.    It has a wonderful shower, great AC,  parking on site, and everything you need to be comfortable.   Her neighborhood is quiet, safe, and beautiful.   She is kind, responsive, friendly, and thoughtful.   I plan to stay here every time I'm in Chicago if her place is available!  Her price is so fair and her place feels way more homey to me than staying in a hotel.   I highly recommend Deborah's AIRBNB!
super unique place, really nice accommodations, very friendly host. would definitely book again!

We had a wonderful stay and would happily stay here again. The location is outstanding, on a quiet street in the heart of Old Town and near Lincoln Park. We walked almost everywhere, including downtown, with great restaurants and coffee shops nearby.
The hosts were terrific: quiet, respectful, responsive, and thoughtful. They provided parking passes (or a dedicated parking space), left a personalized welcome sign and a bottle of wine, and made us feel at home. The house is also dog-friendly, with reliable internet, central A/C, and a washer/dryer.
This is not a polished corporate rental or luxury property. It is a well-loved older home with character and charm. The two main bedrooms are small but comfortable and the third is an office with a crib. If you appreciate a cozy, older, welcoming home in an incredible neighborhood, it is hard to beat.

We had a wonderful stay at Staywell in Chicago. The apartment was clean, modern, and exactly as described. The location was excellent, making it easy to explore the city, and the check-in process was smooth and hassle-free. The host was responsive and provided clear instructions throughout our stay. Everything we needed was available, and we felt comfortable from start to finish. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.
Great location for me and my kids to explore Chicago. Cheryl was more than helpful and provided a parking permit. Couldn't have asked for more.
This place is located on 61st and St Lawrence. Google map the area for yourself
Loved the place. Will definitely book again next time I’m in town
Quaint apartment in the heart of Wrigleyville. The turnover of the apartment could have been better.

The property was well maintained, in a very accessible location.
Close to the train and 606 walking path.
Coffee shops and food in the area are great.
It was a privilege to stay in what is obviously a very personal home. We loved its quirkiness and originality.

Julio’s place was great and thicker park is a really vibrant interesting neighborhood.
Would stay again!
Very clean and neat place. The furniture settling is well done. Beautiful place to stay in Chicago!
The house was just what we needed!
Great stay with all the basic amenities and much more! Gorgeous sunroom and living room for hanging out and watching tv.
We loved Yolie's place, spacious but also cozy, with a great location near Fulton Market, highly recommend!

My experience at Marilyn’s was amazing! The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful with no disruptions. I didn’t get to explore much of the area as I spent most of my time in downtown, but there seems to be a lot of restaurants near by with a walkable distance and there’s Walgreens right in front of the home in case you need buy anything that you are missing. I will say I did occasionally find a few ants crawling around the bathroom but nothing too drastic. Overall, I loved my stay here
Mimi’s place was clean and comfortable.,We enjoyed the patio area as well.
Great place!

This is a great spot right next to downtown.
We stayed a week and had no trouble getting around.
The kitchen is easy to use and had just about everything we needed.
The bedrooms were clean and comfy.
The laundry was easy enough to use but if you have specialty soap you prefer, remember to bring it.
We really appreciated the elevator.
Bring eye masks for sleeping past dawn. It's super bright outside in the mornings and the curtains aren't dark.
