The host was amazing and accommodating to us and our needs! Communication was fast and easy. We’re going to miss this place <3
Great place to stay! It was very comfortable and relaxing, me and my boyfriend really enjoyed it as our first vacation together!
This place was amazing and was even better than I expected. Definitely a gem and a great location as well!
Great location, nice neighborhood!
Everything was great! Easy walk to the White Sox stadium.

In a developing neighborhood, felt comfortable walking around. Quiet at night, public transportation was extremely close and felt very safe. Great off street parking, plenty of room. Had a minor ant issue but nothing uncommon during this time of year. Just had to make sure all food was sealed and away. Beds were very comfortable and it was nice and cold in all the rooms. Window units in each bedroom allowed for personal adjustment. Plenty of space in the apartment. Kitchen supplies were a bit limited to do basic cooking but was still manageable and not a big deal, very close to the grocery stores as well.
Sarah was very responsive to any questions I had. The location was great and easy to get around from there. Plenty of space for 2 adults. Great to have a full kitchen.
Good airbnb
Great location, very clean in the apartment. Host is very responsive! Recommend this stay! Also very close to the beach and can be in the inner city within 20 mins.
We had a nice stay at Laura's place. The neighborhood was vibrant and well located. The apartment itself was very clean and the beds were extremely comfortable. We would definitely stay here again.
Would stay again. Easy to access via public transport and good neighborhood

Ed and Hillary are the absolute best!!  We were in Chicago for 3 weeks for an intensive therapy session for our son with disabilities. We had our big family of 6 including young kids (4 kiddos age 4-7) which can be a lot for anyone to handle ha! Ed and Hillary couldn’t have been better hosts!  From the beginning when we asked about the number of steps into the apartment for our sons wheelchair, communication was always quick and helpful!  We especially loved capping off our stay with sharing cocktails in their beautiful garden!  I would recommend this house to anyone staying in the area as it was walkable and bikable to everything!  Thanks again guys!!
We had a great time staying here. This apartment is in the perfect location in Wicker Park, and it is very close to the L which made the rest of the city very accessible.
I was in town for my sons college orientation. This was a great space to stay while visiting Chicago.
This place was beautiful! It was immaculately kept and with all the essentials. It was easy to get to and in a safe quiet area. Exceptional communication from the hosts!
The host was very responsive. It exceeded our travel needs. Although the building was older the unit was modern, updated, and had everything I needed for my stay.

Everything was perfect! The apartment is wide enough to ensure comfort and rest also for medium-long stay, furniture and facilities make feel you like at home. James is a host really kind and proactive for every possible needs. I strongly recommend this accomodation for every sort of vacation, job transfer or other necessities.
Buen Airbn
Adriana was easy to contact and very helpful. Very flexible with time as well.

We were slightly disappointed with the accommodation. The apartment did not really match the photos. The pictures were beautifully taken, but in reality, the furniture and several areas of the apartment were damaged, scratched, and definitely in need of replacement.
The biggest downside was the mattress. Sleeping for two weeks on a completely worn-out and sagging mattress was a nightmare. As a result, we were sore, exhausted, and sleep-deprived throughout our holiday. The Airbnb definitely needs better maintenance, and after several years, the old furniture and other worn-out items should be replaced with new ones. These are not particularly high expenses, and ensuring that guests get a good night’s sleep should be a top priority.
On the positive side, we appreciated the large kitchen with appliances, the good facilities, and the really pleasant and quiet neighbourhood.
However, we would probably not choose this accommodation again.

Enjoyed our stay! Was always able to find a close parking spot, when we did take the trains it was an easy walk to the station. Place was bigger than expected, beds are comfy and really enjoyed the art!

5-Star Review
Location, location, location! We stayed here for a Cubs game and a Bananas game at Wrigley and honestly could not have picked a better spot. Being able to walk to the stadium made the entire trip so easy and enjoyable.
The apartment was very clean, the beds were extremely comfortable, and we slept great after long days in the city. Communication with the host was excellent from start to finish—quick responses, clear instructions, and a very smooth check-in/check-out process.
If you’re coming to Chicago for a Wrigley trip, this place is absolutely perfect. We would definitely stay here again!
We had a great time! The location is great and near the red line so it is super easy to get around. The host was super responsive. I would recommend!
The place was very nice, and I felt super safe in the neighborhood. Would stay again!
Nicholas es muy amable. Es un buen alojamiento que cumple como un lugar para literalmente dormir. Si eres mujer sola lo repensaría por la zona y la privacidad.
We stayed here as a family for a Savannah Game. This was a perfect location for us and Josh was extremely helpful with our needs.
Leonid was an excellent host the place was clean and organized definitely recommend staying here if you’re visiting Chicago!
Fantastic location right by the Belmont blue line stop. We had some issues with the furniture but  the host fixed them quickly. Would stay here again.
Awesome spot, comfortable, clean, all we could ask for!
Location was great for seeing a show at the United Center. Everything I wanted to do was about half an hour away in every direction.
Nicole and Matt had wonderful communication and their home was amazing! We are very appreciative for their stay and all of their accommodations!

Great location-walkable to all kinds of wonderful restaurants, coffee shops, & a kid’s playground just 10 mins away. David’s place has a couple comfy sunlit rooms that were perfect to curl up for coffee and reading. Also has laundry which is a plus when traveling with kids for a week. We loved his place and look forward to staying there again when back in Chicago!
Great stay for a couple of days.

Quinton was an incredible host! His garden apartment was perfect and located close to OPC and the University of Chicago, which is where I needed to go. The space was comfortable, air-conditioned and felt like home immediately. It was easy to find and the directions were perfect. Quinton went above and beyond to ensure my stay was warm and welcome and I genuinely appreciated his kindness and hospitality. He had plenty of items in the bathroom that were great in case you forgot anything like a toothbrush, mouthwash, and shampoo and conditioner. Although I didn’t cook, his space had everything you needed to prepare a meal and he had tea, coffee, and creamer available for guests. Thankful I found Quinton’s space during WNBA All Star weekend when a lot of spaces were sold out.
Quinton’s spot is on the Southside of Chicago, which might make some folks uncomfortable, but after living in SW/SE DC for many years, I had no problem with it. Highly recommend Quinton’s space!
What a nice place! Maria was so communicative after my flight was delayed and helped me get in late. The space was gorgeous and a nice walk to some of my favorite spots in Avondale

Opeyemi's place was very accommodating and fit very well for my family's trip and stay in Chicago. We enjoyed spending time in the living room and watched some movies in the cozy home theater. The kitchen was equipped to cook for the 6. The rooms are very comfortable, and they provided extra blankets when we asked for them! We always found a spot right in front of the apartment to park our rental car—a 10-min walk to the subway station to go downtown. Having a laundry room was super useful too.
Great stay. The shower is a alone worth a visit. Amazing. Great area. Close to train. Easy to get around.
Amy was the best! Helpful and nice.
Alis was a great host, and her place is very cute! It was the perfect location for a couple days visiting family and exploring.

The place is very comfortable, and the Pilsen area is vibrant with great dining options. It's conveniently located near the pink subway line, which takes you to Chicago's Loop in no time. Highly recommended for a vacation visiting Chicago. Nala was very kind and attentive to all our questions and needs.

Everything matched the description perfectly - it was very clean and quiet. Despite initial worries about the location, it was fairly quiet and nothing out of the ordinary. I loved how close it was to the university of Chicago (10 min walk)!

A clean and cozy apartment in a good neighbourhood.
Additionally, the host was very prompt and responsive for smallest of the requests

Everything great! Travelled with the whole family, all comfortable, good beds & matresses, location is tops, very quiet but within 10-15 mins walk from great amenities, including Willis Tower, water taxi, etc. and good restaurants at little Italy.
Our flight arrived very early, and host was kind to let us check in earlier to drop the bags and shower. This was really great after a long flight.
Host provided parking passes for parking on the street. Coin operated washer and dryer un place, I had to use them as I was coming from a week-long trip, it was easy.
Internet is good 👍🏼
Large fridge 👌🏼
Plenty of quick and very hot water, the five of us could shower consecutively without problem.
A/C works good 👌🏼
Would gladly stay here again, family loved it, 👌🏼👌🏼👌🏼

We were a group of 5 and had plenty of space for us all. Cris always responded super fast when we had questions. The neighborhood is peaceful and safe. Something to note which is no fault of Cris‘: the sidewalks will be torn up around the apartment. The first of the marked sites was torn up during our stay; the workers arrived at 6:30am and the sledgehammer started at 7am.

The Airbnb is not what was expected at all.
My stay had been full of concerns due to the fact that the living room space and any others rooms were not cleaned before arrival. Firstly, I let the host know about the condition the Airbnb is in as soon as I arrived. Noting that the sofa was full of fur and trash, making it a spot that could not be used (additionally that another guest is allergic to pets). There are bugs and spiders, the fridge is dirty and smells bad. Parking was not available nearby. Had to park 2 blocks away because it’s a busy street. Location wise, it’s close to downtown. Would rather have stayed at the nearby hotel. Lesson learned.
Still waiting for next steps as it was not worth the money we paid.
Great stay! The host was super helpful and responsive. The apartment is in a fantastic location for exploring Chicago over a few days, and the price is very fair. Highly recommended.
Thanks! Perfect location. Apartment very clean and looked just like the photos. Would definitely stay there again.

We had a lovely stay! The location is great, tons of restaurants, bars, and train access in easy walking distance. It was also a very easy walk to Grant Park/Millennium Park and the museum campus/lake, which was perfect for sight-seeing around Chicago. The unit was clean, well stocked with towels/linens, and well sized bedrooms for the stay. Navigating check-in was a bit tricky as the lobby was undergoing construction, but this was not the fault of the owners. The only minor issue was that the AC units did not quite keep up with the heat, especially during the afternoon/evenings with the sun shining directly in the west-facing windows, so we had to keep the blinds shut and AC on high. Overall though we were very happy with the unit and our stay, as well as communication from the owners. Would definitely stay here again!
It was in a perfect location and perfect for the week!
Had a wonderful time. Loved walking around the space enjoying the unique features. Great location, walkable to many places. Would definitely come back.

A great location in walking distance to many shops and restaurants. The train is definitely audible from the back bedroom, but the earplugs they provided helped. The condo itself is beautiful and well equipped with working A/C.
Great place for I intended to do; host was responsive and accommodating

Fantastic stay. Beautiful peaceful neighborhood a short walk to all the restaurants and shops of Lincoln Square. Spacious clean comfortable well-provisioned apartment. Angela was kind, friendly and super responsive. A++++ Would definitely stay here again.
Cozy place to stay and getting to the L was a short walk down the street from the property.

We had a great week staying here & would stay again. It’s in a quiet neighborhood close to public transportation & felt more like living in a home than staying in a rental.
Adrian was friendly & responsive. The Owner's Unit was spacious with a well-stocked kitchen & lots of amenities. During a particularly hot week in July, the 2 bedroom A/Cs struggled a bit to cool the entire unit in the afternoons, but it never became uncomfortably warm.
The internet was fine for most uses but struggled when streaming & multiple devices were connected.
Access to the Garden Unit through a small unfinished area is a bit unusual, but I didn't find it creepy or dirty/moldy as another reviewer suggested. It felt a bit musty at first, but opening the windows helped considerably.
We enjoyed the backyard picnic table & umbrella throughout the week. Just be aware that you may occasionally spot an unshy rat passing through after dark.
Overall, a comfortable stay with a welcoming host. We'd happily book again.

We had a wonderful stay! Great location and very walkable, close to shopping, restaurants, and Wrigley field. Near train and bus stops.
The apartment was clean and tidy, comfortable beds. Nice amenities in the apartment. Stocked fridge with soda and water, oatmeal for breakfast. The bathroom had shampoo, conditioner, toothbrushes, and ear plugs. Attention to detail makes for an easy and comfortable stay.

Nail was great. The rental is near River North which does not lend itself well to parking or traveling with young children. But that’s on me not on our host.
The kitchen had coffee but not coffee cups or plates to eat on. The unit is beside a fire station. All the city sounds serenade you to sleep.
The spiral staircase is narrow and not intended for parents with small children to navigate.
Great place for young people to stay in the heart of Chicago.

Samad directed us to check in to his downstairs unit, which was not the one he advertises on Airbnb. It hasn't been renovated, is filthy (sheets were not washed) and looks like a 22 year old college kid decorated it.
I pointed this out and he said that we didn't have a choice of which of his units we were assigned. After much back and forth, he agreed to have us move to the originally booked unit the next night. We had to spend one night in his dirty overflow apartment. He offered a full refund on the spot, but we didn't have anywhere else to go so had no choice but to stay until he moved us.

Went for a concert and all my fam decided to come with me, pretty satisfied with everything in the Airbnb! Would definitely book again. Loved the area and found walkable places to go eat. Parking wasn’t bad! Exactly how the host described it, considering Chicago this was easy to park for.
Thank you!
The Airbnb was clean and spacious! Lokesh was very communicative and easy to get a hold of.
Great location! Ensavi was super helpful with instructions and was super responsive when messaging!

The place was alright. The main complaint was the bug problem- insects and spiders all over the place which was not reflected in the description or photos. The pillow covers had blood on them, some of the utensils and dishes were not clean at all. AC was not keeping the place cool enough. The blinds did not fully cover the windows so people could still see in. I understand that it’s a budget friendly place but there still needs to be standards if people spend their money to stay at an Airbnb.

The stay was located close to Wrigley Field with the Lakefront a 15m walk away. It was spacious and comfortable.
To note:
For light sleepers, there is a bar located right in front that brings noise pollution at night.
There is a daycare located in first floor that made the place slightly smell like powdered milk, especially at entrance and hallways. Once in the apartment, it’s gone.
Safe, comfortable place.

Great location, easy to hop on either the subway or pick up a bus. Easy access to Grant Park if you are a walker or runner. We tried two of the restaurant recommendations and found them to have great food. For now, a little difficult to get in and out because the lobby was under renovation, and we dealt with a barking dog across the hall - just little inconveniences that this owner cannot control. The entire unit was clean and comfortable. I was expecting, based on the pictures and price, something a little more upscale. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and our time in Chicago.

Room and shared spaces were as described and clean. Great location with plenty of street parking.
Check in instructions could have made the exact room assignment more prominent and identified which floor the room was on, as rooms are split between two separate floors with two separate codes to the shared spaces. I also wasn’t sent the check in instructions until 20 minutes after the check in time.
This is an amazing place to stay. If you’re not familiar with Chicago, this is the place to stay!!
Great, comfortable stay near chicago. We were able to travel into downtown chicago via the blue line that was close to the apartment.
If you want a small room which is well connected within Chicago and don’t mind sharing a bathroom and a kitchen, then this is the place for you.

This Airbnb was very convenient for visiting Chicago. It was right next to the 18th street L station on the pink line. We attended a concert at the United Arena and it was a quick ride and walk to the concert. We also were able to avoid having to rent a car at all while visiting Chicago and were close to tourist activities. There were some good coffee shops and restaurants in walking distance. The Mexican restaurant a few doors down from us was expectionally good. It felt like a real neighborhood instead of a tourist area. I felt safe and would stay there again.
We had one request & it was taken care of within 45 minutes!
Great place to stay! Super convenient to anything you could want or need. Building has the nicest neighbors and door men/women ever!
Charles was very friendly and helpful in preparation for the trip and while there. He was knowledgable and generous.

I had a great stay! The place is brand new, very clean, and the location is not far from everything I wanted to do.
I also loved that my room had its own bathroom. It really felt like I had my own private suite.
One night the guest next door was a little noisy, but as soon as I let Sydney know, she took care of it right away. She was very attentive throughout my stay.
I would definitely stay here again the next time I'm in Chicago. Highly recommend!
Very clean and quiet. Close to public transport. Fulfilled our needs. Thanks

Tippi was very helpful during my stay. The environment was calm and relaxing, providing the perfect escape from the hustle and bustle. What made the stay even better was the host, who was incredibly helpful and attentive, ensuring everything went smoothly. I left feeling refreshed and would happily give this stay 5 stars!

This place has Roaches infested 🪳 🪳 crawling on the paper towel on the countertop! Bedbugs were also in the bed! I left 2 hours after checking in because of the bugs! She was very inconsiderate; I had to find a place to stay! She told me sorry for the inconvenience. She also charged me for that day I checked in although I left 2 hours later. It was horrible!!
Loved our stay, but we wish there were more mirrors available around the house and/or one more bathroom available for our group to use.
Great place! Hosts are available anytime. Would recommend to all! Will come in the future too!

Cristina was great -- responsive and friendly.  Apartment is as-described in a shared space.  Straightforward, simple room with a decently-stocked kitchen.  It was perfect for my brief stay in the city and I was able to walk to several bus and train routes.
Awesome location. Walkable to everything. Communication was great. Would stay again.
We loved our stay here especially the close proximity to a free public beach!! The parking was a little difficult, but we managed to make it work just fine. We would definitely stay here again!

The place is huge, comfortable and clean in a great neighborhood. I had a car so can’t speak to walkability but parking was plentiful and easy.
Absolutely first place I will check on my next trip.
Whenever I have to be in Chicago this is my preferred place

I had a wonderful stay. The apartment was clean, cozy, and in a great location, making it easy to get around Chicago and the charming local neighborhood. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. I would definitely stay here again.

The decor was amazing. Everything was well thought out and the space was very homey! I would definitely stay again
!
The space was exactly what I needed for a couple day break. Snacks and some drinks were a huge plus upon landing. Everything in the unit exceed expectation. Definitely would stay here again!

We had 4 families with 17 people stay here and we were all very comfortable. There was plenty of space and the beds were comfortable. We loved being able to go to the field and park with our kids behind the house. Our morning walks felt safe and there were some beautiful houses to look at, and a coffee shop within walking distance. Dave was a very clear communicator with quick responses and was very accommodating. We would stay here again, if ever in the area.
Everything was just as advertised. Lovely little place in a great area.

Our family had a wonderful stay during our trip to Chicago! The biggest highlight was the location—it’s hard to beat being just steps away from Wrigley Field. We were able to easily walk to the ballpark, restaurants, shops, and everything the neighborhood has to offer, which made our family vacation so enjoyable.
The convenience of the location allowed us to spend more time making memories together and less time worrying about transportation. If you’re planning a trip to Wrigleyville, especially for a Cubs game, this Airbnb is in an unbeatable spot.
Thank you for helping make our family vacation such a memorable one!
Excellent location and plenty of choices for food and entertainment.

This was a great neighborhood and a wonderful property to stay at. There is plenty of on-street parking but is not for overnight without a permit. We found a parking garage a few blocks away near Second City which was reasonable. My family loved this property and I'm sure yours will as well.

Brandon’s place was perfect for my family.  We went to a Cubs game and had a short walk to the field.  Being able to park in the garage was awesome.  We parked our car on arrival and used public transportation while we were there.  Super convenient
Great place, real close to the main tourist spots in Chicago! The bus is outside of it too, very convenient.
The listing was accurate and location was excellent for my needs. My special request was accommodated although i didn’t end up needing anything additional. Would book with them again.

Stayed here for a few days and had a really good experience. The place was clean, looked just like the pictures, and had everything I needed. Thaer was easy to communicate with and made check-in super simple. I’d definitely stay here again if I’m back in the area.
Clean house, great location, close to train station and many bus stops. Check-in was easy. Only downside was that the thermostat is not inside the apartment, so we couldn't control the temperature.
Would stay again if in Chicago. Nice place.
Good location to explore the hip North side of Chicago. The L train is a short walk which will take you anywhere. Place was plenty big enough for 4.5 people.
Stay was great! Only problem was we only had 1 roll of toilet paper also if you coming and want to do more activities downtown I’d say to find something closer!
Great house for family’s vacation to Chicago. Plenty of space and centrally located. The host was extremely responsive. We would definitely stay here again.
Great place. It really made our Chicago experience even better. Next time I'm in Chicago I will make sure to book Denzilt's place.
My stay here was great! The room was comfortable, and the neighborhood felt safe and quiet. I’d stay here again!

Had a great stay at Jummy’s place! Very spacious and clean, good amenities all around. Appreciate the parking spot as well. He was very responsive and ready to help. It’s a little far from public transport so expect to walk 20 mins or bike to the nearest train station if you need to head into the city.

I had a lovely two night stay at Nick’s place. Located close to the train for getting around the city. The neighborhood has some great coffee and food options.
The apartment is very well equipped and comfortable. Bathroom is a particular highlight.
Bonus points for having two lovely doggos!
Nothing but positive
Great place for short term or long term stay. As close to private apartment as it can get since I almost didn't encounter other residents. Good communication with host.

The place was really cozy , clean & the area was great nice park across the street , walkable to things you may need for quick finds. Only thing is the bed wasn’t as soft ; it was sleep able but just a little on the firmer side . But overall it was great for a quick trip !
I was worried about bit initially but I found the neighbors nice and area quite peaceful.
Great location for our visit.  We greatly enjoyed the stay.

Excelente ubicación, departamento en buenas condiciones, muy limpio y todo funcional. Nos encantó!
Nos alojamos una familia de 5 personas y estuvimos como en casa !
Great location

This is a lovely, spacious apartment in a nice neighborhood. The photos don't it justice--it's a huge 2-bedroom with wonderful light-filled rooms. It was also a great location for visiting the University of Chicago and the Obama Library. Finally, we appreciated the Keurig coffee maker, easy check-in, and great communication. Overall--highly recommend.
Awesome place, host and location.
Lizbeth, has a lovely home. Clean, organized, and very welcoming. I really enjoyed my stay in her home and look forward to staying again.

Great place! The Airbnb was clean and looked just like the pictures.  The location was also a plus, since many things were within walking distance.  We got a little lost upon arrival, but that was a GPS problem and being unfamiliar with the area.  The only downside was the noise you could hear from the people staying above, living up to the name Paper Box.  But that shouldn't stop anyone from staying here.
Great place and close to downtown. Really enjoyed our stay
Everything was very nice and a smooth experience didn’t have to worry about anything check in was easy and so was check out
Thank you Abel! My sons and I had a comfortable and affordable stay!
Victoria was very responsive with a beautiful home. She was welcoming. The neighborhood was great and the beds were the best part.

Lived in CHI many years ago and lots of plans to see lifelong Chicago friends so this was a perfect spot to stay. The hosts John & Terry are chill, nice people so you sorta feel like you are staying with a distant relative. This neighborhood is where a lot of locals desire to live these days. It’s safe, easy to walk around in and near some affordable and casual dining spots, coffee houses, diners serving breakfast all day and an actual beautiful beach and park with ocean like views of the grandiose LAKE MICHIGAN. The area is full of various age groups and extremely LGBTQ friendly with a cool bohemian vibe.
Lastly it’s a five minute walk to one of my favorite spots SPHERA, an Italian spot specializing in Sicilian style street food. I could eat breakfast, lunch and dinner there as they’re open 9-9!!!
The place is near a plethora of public transport to get downtown or west side. I hope I can stay there again when I’m back in Chicago.

We had a great time here. Even with all the different businesses in the neighborhood, the Airbnb itself was very quiet and peaceful. We loved having easy access to so many restaurants without having to get in the car and go. The room was very comfortable for our party. I also really appreciate how quickly David responded to any of our questions.
Disfrutamos mucho la estafia, sumamente limpio, ordenado y Reinaldo muy cordial.
Excelente departamento, es mas grande y cómodo de lo que parece en las fotos, todo de 10
It was perfect for our two night stay. Only issue was the wifi was not great for me, so I had to use my hotspot for work. But, I definitely plan to stay here again! I love the interior and location.
We had a great stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I would definitely stay here again.
Great Stay and Very Clean!
It's the best Airbnb I have ever lived, it's my pleasure to live in this wonderful place. You can find everything you need in Erica's place, I would come back to Chicago again for this!
We loved the piano, and appreciated our host’s responsiveness when we had questions!
Excelente anfitrión

The location was incredible if you are planning on staying in Wrigleyville. Parking was easy to find on the street and getting to and into the apartment was easy and efficient. The noise was not as bad as we were expecting. I do recommend taking some of your own essentials if you need to have them for cooking along with some extra towels or use the washer/dryer if staying an entire week. Be warned that the stairs and hallway are tight going up the stairs. We were able to get everything up there without a problem but make sure you are physically capable of lifting all of your things easily if you book this apartment.

Very clean and stylish home. I really liked the house plants. The beds were comfortable.
Make sure that you are physically able to carry your luggage up a flight of tight, steeps stairs.
Excellent place!
It was a great experience to stay here! The bed I think is more comfortable than my home one. Thank you again for this stay.

I had a great stay at Edgar’s place. The room was just as described, small but cozy, and the instructions for accessing the place were clear and helpful. I really appreciated the silence, the comfortable bed, and the host’s quick responses whenever I needed anything. If you’re in the area and want a solid, comfortable place to stay at a great price, I definitely recommend this spot.
A great spot for a solo traveler or for work.
She was very nice and communicative. Her instructions were clear and it was easy to get inside the house.

Chris and Ana are friendly, responsive and communicative hosts. Their place is in a perfect location for easy and convenient access to a broad swath of Chicago neighborhoods and the north/northwest suburbs, as well as multiple places to grab needed items or groceries (Costco, Aldi, Target, Jewel-Osco, Whole Foods).
Place is as pictured and it is clear they care a lot about maintaining a clean and comfortable environment. Enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay again in the future.
Cute, small, clean!
Everything was clean and cozy, the hostess was very responsive—I recommend it to everyone.

this was a perfect apartment for me to stay during my work trip to Chicago. it was conveniently located near my offices and in a very quiet, safe neighborhood. it was also conveniently located near some useful amenities and shops. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it.

Out of my 10+ years using Airbnb these were the BEST hosts I have ever had.
Amy and Brandon were one of a kind and I now consider them friends.
Also the accommodation was fantastic.
If you even think about Airbnb in Chicago this should be top of your list.
The place is very beautiful and clean, and Judy with her family was very friendly - nice area to stay

The place was great. The place looks just like the pictures showed. The location was central to visit the loop as well as attend cubs game, and it was close enough to walk through the park or near the lake. The only comment is that the upstairs bedroom was extremely warm for sleeping. Other than that, great stay. Thanks.
Great place! Easy in/out. Perfect location for where I needed to be.

We had a great stay. House was very nice, clean, well stocked and comfortable. The off street parking was so nice to have. Jesse was quick to respond and always helpful. I would stay here again. Thanks.

Die Wohnung von Aurora ist sehr gut geeignet, um mit einer Familie Chicago zu besuchen. Es gibt viel Platz und bequeme Betten. Die Wohnung ist im Erdgeschoss und hat einen Eingang auf der Vorderseite und auf der Rückseite. Die Bushaltestellen für die Linie 21 nach Chinatown und Linie 8 in die City sind nur wenige Schritte zu Fuß entfernt. Aurora hat uns viele gute Tipps gegeben für  Aktivitäten in der Nähe und war eine perfekte Gastgeberin. Wir würden jederzeit gerne wiederkommen und können die Wohnung absolut empfehlen.

The apartment is very nice and cozy. The kitchen is very nice and equipped with coffee pot with coffee. This apartment is located on the street side and located right next door is a Public bus pick up area. If you are planning on parking a car, here is what we learned. The street that is located right beside Mc Donald's and the Public Bus pick up, is a permit parking only. You will need to drive to the next set of houses, which is located on Pensacola Ave and locate a place to park. This area is not a permitted parking area and you are free to park there as long as you are not blocking someone's driveway or a Fire Hydrant. It is a nice neighborhood and walking the short walk back to the apartment is about 7 minutes. This is a great place and we will definitely look to stay here again. I think showing a picture of the front door to the apt building would be helpful. There is video that you will have access too, but,
I think a single photo would be nice.

The location is the real star of this place! Very walkable, safe and family friendly. Lots of cute dogs walking around. There’s a cute vintage shop down the street called Shangri-La that everyone should check out!
Check-in was fairly easy, but it’s a little cumbersome to have all members of your party download the app and get approved to check-in. Host was very responsive though.
Place itself was okay! One of the bedrooms had a flashing strobe light coming in through the window at night and we had to hang a blanket over it to get any sleep.
Nothing remarkable, but perfectly adequate for visiting the city.

I found this to be the perfect place to stay, very classy and in perfection condition. Communication was easy and very responsive. Location is great, right near the lake front and lots of restaurants and activities. Very peaceful and quiet.
I would highly recommend this place to stay while in Chicago!
We had a wonderful time!!! Great location, clean, spacious. Perfect for a family vacation!

We loved our stay here! The neighborhood is super walkable and the host includes a great booklet with some meal recommendations. When we got back at the end of a long busy day, there truly was no place like Gnome! Clean, comfortable bed, in a gorgeous building with tons of charm. I'd happily stay here again — thanks David!
Great location and even better communication. Everything was as described. I plan on staying again.

Awesome neighborhood! Very walkable. After figuring out the lay of the land, getting around to other areas around Chicago from here was easy enough. Accommodations were simple & exactly as described. Would recommend!

I loved my stay here! Perfect for a solo traveler, nothing crazy just the essentials which was all I needed. Space was tidy and cute and extremely quiet which I wasn’t expecting. I hadn’t ever been to this area before but it was super easy to navigate the busses and trains from there. I felt really safe here. Host responded super quick too which was awesome. Overall really great experience for my first time solo in Chicago. I’d definitely stay here again!
5 star.

My husband & I truly enjoyed our stay! Hosts were very communicative throughout our stay, which we really appreciated! We were also within the walking distance from plenty of restaurants in Uptown as well as the Red Line, which made traveling around the city so easy. We definitely recommend staying here on your next trip to Chicago! Thank you for making our stay so wonderful!

I enjoyed my stay. The apartment is cozy and thoughtfully equipped and in a peaceful, walkable neighborhood. I enjoyed the presentation of music and literature in the living room, the homelike furnishings, and the low-stress, quiet atmosphere. Would definitely come back!
Our stay was good overall! Neighborhood was nice and there’s a ton of cool places to walk to from the house. Host was responsive and our check in and check out was super easy.
The Stay couldn’t be any better for me. Inner city Chicago stay very safe place

This place  was perfect for our family’s 4 days in Chicago. There were 5 adults and a child in our group and we were very comfortable. Very close to downtown and an easy Uber ride everywhere. Beds were comfortable. Place was spotless and the kitchen had everything we needed. We would definitely stay again!!
such a cute neighborhood and a five minute walk to the L station nearby, such a cozy stay for our first time in chicago!

This Airbnb is wonderful. It could be two individual units - a two bedroom and 1 bedroom which can be separate or connected! I brought my team here for a conference and it was a wonderful, spacious stay. Great location, backyard and the host is extremely responsive!

First off it’s a whole escape room to get to the room. The place its self is cute but if you are looking for a quiet place, this is NOT for you. Traffic is loud, the metro goes by all night, and we were lucky to experience construction right outside our window. Main bathroom fan is so annoying, it’s an automatic fan so if you wake up at night it will stay on for a good 5 minutes. Parking situation was ugly! You park at a structure across the street. So if you plan on staying several days and plan on driving around….. keep in mind there is no in and out of that structure unless you want to pay $34 every time. Dont mind it myself but yes, you need to take all your trash out before checkout.

The location was really easy to find and close to the Blue Line which really helps if you're travelling to/from the airport. We managed to fit the SUV in the parking lot, there was enough space. The house was really clean and we had everything we needed. Ericka answered almost immediately whenever we had to reach out to her. I recommend her place if you need a quiet neighbourhood but also in the proximity of public transport to go downtown.
Very happy with our stay here!
This host always provides a good spot to be, especially if you’re in Chicago for work.

Nice place in a nice neighborhood.
The hostess is responsive and instruction is clear.
Street paid easy during the day, difficult but manageable at night.
A very cute and practical apartment that had everything I needed, and it was tidy and clean.  Mouna was responsive and friendly.

This place was great for our group of 10( 4 separate families)
The host was great at responding and the listing description was accurate.
We would stay again if visiting the area.

Great location for our stay - convenient for both getting downtown and to Montrose fields.
Accommodation was in very good condition and very nicely refurbished bathrooms.
Alicia was incredibly helpful and responsive.
Very clean and very nice apartment

Overall Maria’s place was suitable. The home was a nice size and well furnished. The living space was large and was comfortable for our family and gave our kids some space to stretch out. The home was clean and the linens and towels provided were sufficient. The location was convenient to many places and parking was a plus. We also felt safe. Now the parking is tight for two vehicles. The garage is 1 car not two and the second outdoor space is for a small car. The street the home is on is pretty tight with residents parking on both sides of the road. Construction was taking place in the home next door and the home on the other side was an eye sore with a backyard that looked like Sanford and Son. Maria was very proactive with her communication and shared local recommendations. She also provided a highchair and a pack and play which was very helpful to us. A couple of areas of improvement would be the condition of some of the blinds, the tears and stains on one of the sofas.
Really nice touches with the coffee options and super clean.
Very helpful host . Highly recommend . Always accommodating and kind . My fav place to stay

Great stay! I’d absolutely stay here again. The location is fantastic, perfectly situated between the West Loop and the Magnificent Mile, with amazing restaurants, bars, and coffee shops nearby. It was about a 20-minute walk to my conference on the Magnificent Mile.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The living area has huge windows with lots of natural light. The bed was comfortable, the A/C worked great, and the kitchen had everything I needed, including coffee, tea, sugar, Splenda, and creamer. The host was communicative, and check-in was easy.
Regarding the train: yes, it’s close, but not nearly as close as some reviews suggest. It’s noticeable but didn’t keep me from sleeping, and earplugs are provided.
My only minor suggestions would be to provide an extra roll of toilet paper (I came dangerously close to running out), a couple bottles of water, and another mirror outside the bathroom. Overall, an excellent stay!

Beautiful place. One of the showers was clogged but everything else was great. Noooo parking near. Very close to train which you could hear but I didnt mind. The host was very nice. They tried to get the shower fixed but it didnt work out but I could really appreciate the attempt and using one was no inconvenience for me.

We stayed at Heather's apartment on a family trip to Chicago. It was incredibly convenient to get to the brown + purple lines and also had great access to the red line.
Clean apartment, well stocked kitchen, neatly decorated, amazing neighborhood -- I'd highly recommend it to anyone looking to stay in a Chicago neighborhood!
Beautiful home and great communication!

The place is better than listed!  Stephen is a top tier host!  I could go on and on about how wonderful the place is, how great Stephen (and his Guest Guide) is, and even how perfect the location is, but it would take me all day.  If I had to leave one piece of info it would be this.  If you hope to prepare and cook 5 star meals while staying here, you will find it a challenge...not impossible, just challenging.  It is a small kitchen with everything the average user could wish for, but if you plan to enter "chef mode" be sure and ask Stephen for an inventory first.

Great location, minutes from the red line and couldn't ask for nicer accommodations. The listing is as advertised and I would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient and cozy stay outside of the city.

A true gem of a place if you intend exploring around the avondale / logan square and beyond
Safe, quiet building, well kept and truly cozy

We stayed for 4 nights at the Airbnb. It suited our needs just perfectly. The apartment is right next to the busy interstate, but noise wasn’t an issue for us. It was a 10 minute walk to the Division blue line train station. Several places to eat were also within a 10 minute walk. The host was very responsive, as we had a couple of minor issues that the host immediately addressed. The apartment was spacious and comfortable, with ample supplies. It does have neighbors above and below, so expect to hear some normal noise associated with that. Everything was as described and worked well for our visit. We would definitely stay again. It served as a great location and we traveled everywhere around the city by foot, train, or uber. No car was necessary, but street parking was easy to find for the car we had with us.
Great place, building had great amenities!  Loved being on balcony watching the city!

이 멋진 도시만큼이나 멋진 숙소였습니다! 아파트가 매우 깨끗하고 완벽한 주방을 갖추고 있었습니다. 공간이 넓지는 않았지만 6인가족이 편히 머물기 충분했습니다. 시카고 관광하기 최적의 장소였습니다. 360도시카고, 미시간애비뉴까지 도보로 이동 가능했고, 리버워크나 네이비피어까지 우버로 10분이내거리였어요. 링컨파크와 노스비치까지는 정말 가까웠어요. 집옆에바로대형마트가있었고, 주차도편했습니다.
예약시에 본인인증절차가 넘 엄격해서 다소 당황스러웠지만(어떻게보면 그만큼 철저하게 관리되는곳이라고 볼수도있을듯요)호스트가 양해해줘서 이부분도 잘해결되었습니다. 시카고에 오면 꼭 다시 머물고 싶은 숙소였습니다.

Beautiful place in a perfect location at unbeatable price. Clear and concise instructions and consistent communication from the host. If we go back to visit Chicago, this place will definitely be at the top of our list!
Good place to stay if you want something budget friendly, host is very responsive. Neighborhood is a bit noisy but for the price point its an excellent value
Nice clean condo in a nice clean area, with quick access to all the touristy stuff. Plan a mix of public transportation and Uber during your stay.

Jenny was a wonderful and generous host.  She gave clear instructions as well as recommendations.  The space was cozy, clean, and welcoming, and the space was well stocked with kitchen and bathroom items.  The neighborhood is lovely with plenty of restaurants and shops within walking distance.  Very close to public transportation options.  Highly recommend!

John provided great instructions for us to find the place smoothly when we got there, the room was clean, it was a shared bathroom, but we didn’t really run into any other guests.  Great place to stay on a budget!
Excelente

Natasha was very nice and easy to work with.  The neighbors were nice and welcoming and the neighborhood was convenient with good places to eat within walking distance.  Be aware that there are alot of stairs in the house.  There is a comfortable porch right off the kitchen that we enjoyed.
Theodora was a great host! She let us drop off our luggage early and checked in to see if there was anything we needed. The apartment was great too

Super friendly host and the location is great for travelers. Really cute neighborhood out of the hustle and bustle of the city but around the corner from the Brown line to get into the city. Very clean accommodations and comfortable living space.
Great location perfect for lots of time out and about. Helpful and responsive host.

Clean and spacious stay, with wonderful bathrooms, a gracious king bed and an amazing eating area. Location really helped us fall in love with the city! Easy check in and check out, with responsive hosts.
The space was so cute and the patio was so relaxing! The location is also so perfect for any use of public transportation :) definitely worth the stay for my birthday

We had a wonderful stay at Vince’s place! The home was beautiful, spacious, and exceptionally clean. The party room was a great bonus and made our stay even more enjoyable. The neighborhood was quiet, peaceful, and perfect for relaxing. Vince was an excellent host with great communication. I highly recommend this property to anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable stay. We’d definitely book again!

This was not a luxury condo as described in the description. The rooftop pool is only 3 feet deep in the deepest part. When we stayed here, our floor was under construction. It was extremely dirty, dusty with an abandoned shopping cart and an old dirty shop vac sitting on a tarp right as you get out of the elevator the apartment itself was OK but the appliances were broken. The listing shows a coffee maker, but no coffee itself was available. This was unexpected because even hotels give you coffee for their coffee makers. Overall, our experience was not luxurious.
This was the perfect place for our family. Plenty of space, parking was a breeze and it was very close to many of the things we wanted to see in Chicago.
Great location in gorgeous RP! Added to my favorite locations for those summertime Chicago Lakeshore vibes. Thanks for sharing the space with travelers like us!
When I visit Chicago I always try to stay at Ingo’s. Beautiful space and neighborhood.

Not recommend…  The place smells very bad like garbage and mold, I put my food in the oven  and the next day it had so much mold on the food. The bed room had a whole where the air conditioner supposed to be so at night it got really cold and through the day it was super hot. There were small pieces of glass everywhere I even had to pick them up myself I also step on one and start bleeding like crazy. I told him he never sent anyone to clean the apartment and it was very small. He told us he would give us 30% of our refund back for the Airbnb and only give $27 dollars his price is not worth it the place was down right disgusting a waste of my money and my four days…

Great little place to stay.
Very clean
Was able to park right outside the house.
Great location. Ac worked great in hot weather. Clean. Only issue was the toilet kept making loud noises something was broken but she responded quickly.
Perfect for UChicago visitors

We stayed a little further north than we usually do when coming to Chicago. It gave us an opportunity to experience Old Town for the first time while also having easy access to the Mag Mile and Wrigley. Saw a great show at Zanies, ate at several good restaurants in Old Town and also caught a Cubs game and tried our luck at Bally's.
Alexandra was a great host. Stayed in contact and checked in to make sure our stay was going well without being intrusive. The property has a ton of space, was clean and has about anything you would need in a kitchen. Having garage parking was a plus.

Ann was a wonderful host! Her home was even better than the photos, and we had a fantastic stay. I had the chance to meet and chat with her briefly, and she was incredibly welcoming and knowledgeable about the area. She made the experience easy from start to finish. I would absolutely recommend staying here to anyone visiting Chicago!

We enjoyed our stay at Freddy’s place. Although small, it had everything you needed. As most of our time was spent in downtown Chicago, the bus stop directly across the street made getting in and out of the city a breeze!
This was a great place to stay! Walkable, clean, and great for 2 people.
Excellent emplacement près du centre de Chicago,  avec vue sur le lac Michigan. Équipement complet et de qualité. Coup de cœur pour le rooftop. Nous recommandons sans hésitation.
Great place in a good location.
Great place in a quiet apartment complex. Kim was very responsive and checked on us pre-stay and during. Would recommend to my friends and stay again. Neighborhood was also nice.

My stay was amazing ! The home is beautiful, the cats made me feel right at  home☺️ It’s at a very convenient location, you’ve got the train 5 mins away, on the train it’s a straight shot to all the touristy areas of Chicago. If I ever want to come back I know where I’ll be looking to stay !!
A fantastic stay and great hospitality! Highly recommend.
Great stay! Walkable to Cubs game and lots of restaurants! Easy to get around via the L or bus. Host was super responsive and provided all the information we needed. Thank you for the stay!

Kelly's place was super cozy and in a quiet & super cute neighborhood. It was clean and as described on the listing and photos. 10-ish min from either the Logan Square or Belmont blue line stations, which was super convenient to get to downtown. Check out the Milli by Metric coffee shop, which is only a 5min walk away. Great coffee! Definitely will recommend for others to stay here.

Maria’s place is a fantastic option for a single person or couple visiting Chicago. The unit was so cozy and a perfect spot to recharge after long days exploring the city. As others mentioned, the bed was super comfortable, and the entire space was spotlessly clean and well-maintained. It’s incredibly quiet and peaceful despite its location near the intersection of 3 bustling streets. The location is excellent, just a few minutes walk to the blue line and Divison and Ashland buses. Plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, and bars within a 5-15 minute walk. Maria was an amazing host, always responsive to questions and requests. Would absolutely recommend Maria’s place (and Maria!) without hesitation.

One of the best Airbnb stays we’ve had. Host was extremely responsive. The building host was so nice and welcoming. Unit was clean and stocked with welcome items which was so nice coming off of a day of traveling. Check out easy peasy. Highly recco!

We were in the Portage Park area to visit nearby family. From the very beginning, Jay was friendly, hospitable, and super-responsive. The apartment was just what we needed—very, very clean, comfortable, and perfectly well set-up for our five-night stay. We will be back and we will tell others to stay there.

Loved our stay here!! The Cubs were in town, and the vibes were awesome. Great neighborhood. Access to the L was super handy. Place was clean and beds were comfy.
Close to the train, but the sound never bothered me. The host graciously provided ear plugs for those who may be sound sensitive, but we didn’t need to use them.
We really enjoyed our stay at Laura’s place. The beds were super comfortable, It was nice that we had a parking spot, dishwasher, and W/D. We would definitely stay again.
Great place to stay by Ravenswood with two bedrooms
Estuvo bien, el anfitrión fue muy amable y atento en todo momento

I highly recommend this AirBnB for your Chicago stay!  It is right in the heart of Andersonville, close to restaurants and shopping. The apartment itself is immaculate! This is by far the nicest AirBnB I've ever stayed in.   The attention to detail, comfort, and absolute cleanliness. Nicholas & Jesse were phenomenal hosts.  They were proactive with communications, met me at the door, and were so helpful during my stay.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!   You will love it!
We loved this place so much, we’ve already booked it again! Truly a special and thoughtful space, and as well appointed as any AirBnB I’ve ever rented. Quiet and cozy. Just great!
This was a great place to stay in a great neighborhood! Yolie was responsive and helpful.

Lisa is a great host and a really cool person. Particularly since I was traveling alone, I appreciated that someone was aware of my comings and goings and was super responsive and helpful.
The place is really comfortable and quiet. I love the neighborhood - it feels really safe and easy to navigate.
Our stay at Milton’s was great! He always responded quickly and was very helpful with any issue we had during our stay. Would def stay again for our next visit.

Dede is a great host and the amenities and location were awesome for a stay centered around Wrigley or the Metro! Easy access to the loop or anywhere else in Chicago via transit. The area is super safe and I never once felt uneasy walking home after shows at 11pm. Plus there are a ton of late night food options open on Clark St!
From the jump, Dede was super helpful and I knew exactly how to get in with the code based check in process. One of the best Airbnb experiences I had and I really hope I can stay here again next time I’m in Chicago!
great patio
I appreciate how attentive the hosts were to our needs.
Great location, quiet neighborhood, close enough to the big city still with lots to do and see locally. Very friendly host and clean space
Walking distance to Wrigley- quiet neighborhood- chalk board messages were a unique touch!
I had an awesome stay at this home.

Erika’s home was fantastic for our three week stay in Chicago this summer - we had a great time and I would recommend her apt / location. It was good for kids (we have three) and had good amenities (kids plates, kids travel crib, kids bath tub for in the shower, kitchen was well stocked with cooking equipment, Vacuum cleaner available for interim cleaning). More than enough towels. Clean sheets and good mattresses and pillows. Washer and dryer worked great. Parking in the back was super.
10/10 awesome hosts!
Wonderful and private listing with a very responsive and helpful host.
交通很便利，街道也很安静安全

We'll be back, really liked this place; couldn't be more convenient to Loyola. Just kinda felt like we did an apartment swap with some friends (my son spent a couple hours at the keyboard). We like some character in our rentals and this place has a ton -- if anything I'd say the listing doesn't do it enough justice. Christi was very responsive and helpful.

The host was great he was very communicative and welcoming. The inside of the place was exactly as described. It’s great place to stay if you in town for a few days. Be able to walk up stairs because the place is on the last floor, but the exercise was good for me. The only thing is parking is a little though you have to have a permit to park by the home, however if you have a park app it gives suggestions. If you’re ok with walking a little going across the street and up a block to Main Street there is free parking and it’s safe. Overall my stay was great. Thanks Demetri
Absolutely amazing stay! The unit is old school Chicago charming and right in the middle of the summer action.
Great place to stay. We will likely come back here next time in town.
great location, great size for our party of 5 people, nice common area, communicative hosts.
Apartment was easy to locate and exactly as described. The place was clean and a perfect location for our stay.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay here!  It was very clean, comfortable, and quiet.  While only being a short walk away from some of the best restaurants, unique shops, and lake front beach Chicago has to offer.  If you are looking for an amazing place to stay on your vacation, look no further!
Great dedicated host!
Great location!

We had a wonderful stay and spent 9 nights at this apartment. Everything was exactly as described, and the photos accurately reflect the property.
The apartment is modern, clean, comfortable, and very well maintained. Check-in and check-out were smooth and easy, and the hosts were always responsive and kept in touch throughout our stay.
The location is excellent. Many of Chicago’s main attractions are within walking distance, and there are plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies, and everything else you might need nearby. We hardly needed to use a taxi because most places we wanted to visit were easily accessible on foot.
The apartment was also very quiet, and the neighbors were respectful, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
We truly enjoyed our time here and would be happy to stay again. We highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago!

Tere was great with communication when the key was stuck in the door. The place is close to public transportation and there are restaurants, a market and a few local bars nearby. Nice for a solo trip or a quick trip for two.

Great spot in a wonderful Chicago location - fantastic neighborhood with loads to do and easy transportation access. The apartment itself has a comfortable bed is a perfect place to stay. Bathroom amenities of all those little things you tend to forget while travelling are a nice touch!
We had a wonderful trip to Chicago and enjoyed the area! AG’s place is in a good location and walkable. Not far from the lake and close to the L. Thank you for everything!

I went into it assuming it would just be Anastasia, her boyfriend, and me staying in their home while renting a room. I didn’t realize there were six bedrooms, with one for them and the rest rented out to different Airbnb guests. That made me a little uneasy because you never knew who you’d run into. Was it a man? A woman? At one point I walked out and there was a man in a towel heading to the shower, and it was just awkward.
Overall, it was a good experience, but I wouldn’t do it again. The neighborhood felt more inner city than I expected, and as a woman traveling alone, I never felt comfortable taking public transportation back and then walking the last 10 minutes to the house at night.
One night an Uber dropped me off, and as I was unlocking the front door with the keypad, a man parked his car, turned off his headlights, and got out. Because it took me a moment to enter the code, I don’t think he realize, I called the police
Enjoyed my stay. Clean and comfortable.

We stayed at the Designer Oasis in Wicker Park. There ended up being 11 of us and we had plenty of space to relax from the multiple outdoor decks, to hot tub and spacious interior. We had a few issues come up during our stay and the rental agency was very responsive. The place was super clean and well stocked with kitchen and cooking supplies. Wicker Park is such a fun area of the city and we got around to multiple parks and restaurants by walking and scootering. We had a blast! I would definitely recommend this spot.
Shay was amazing. She was so quick to respond to any of my inquiries and this place was in prime real estate location. Would definitely stay again. Thanks Shay!

Everything was exactly as pictured, and check-in was quick and easy :) The ceiling height is accurately described in the listing, so there were no surprises, and it wasn’t an issue during my stay. I had a small question about the hot water, and Dan responded almost immediately and resolved it right away! His communication and attentiveness really stood out. The location was another highlight, with easy access to public transit and plenty of restaurants, shops, and attractions within walking distance. Overall, I had a great stay and would happily stay here again :) Thank you Dan for going above and beyond!
Vi havde et dejligt ophold i boligen og kommer gerne igen næste gang vi besøger området.

Nice comfy room in a quiet neighborhood not too far from little Italy, Ukrainian village and Pilsen neighborhood. What I appreciate the most is the hosts, very friendly, cool, quick responses, made sure I felt comfortable and welcomed. Ideal for short stays at a reasonable price in Chicago. Thanks for hosting me!
Great place!  Thanks so much!
Couldn’t be a more perfect Logan Square location.
Very very nice
Loved the location. Easy walk to the subway. Good area.

Great stay! One of the cleanest ARBNB'S we have ever stayed in! It was new, modern, clean, safe and had everything we needed. Steps away from the 606 bike and walking path which we used to enjoy a true Chicago experience. The in home laundry and 2 baths a plus! Easy walk to coffee, and food. Chiara and Kyle were great hosts! We can't wait to return!
Everything great!

Loved this lil stay!! Using the washer and dryer to have clean clothes for the rest of my trip was awesome! The kitchen has a little bit of everything, I was able to make simple meals easily. And the big roku TV was the icing on the cake. Great spot, right on the #9 bus line that goes straight to the blue line! Couldn't have asked for better. 😊
Very nice place & the host communicated with us very fast & helpful!! definitely would come back

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Overall, it offers excellent value for the price. It’s a great option if you’re looking for an affordable place that’s still conveniently close to downtown. The unit was definitely worth it, and we would happily recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

Great, easy spot near numerous  public transit options --- which we loved! Lots of the city's best restaurants are less than 15 minutes away in Logan Square, and we really appreciated Alana's hospitality. Thank you!

Brett’s Tea Studio is just as designerly and well appointed as it looks in the photos. The chef’s kitchen was a pleasure to work in. The solid door on the master bath kept the sounds of the washer and dryer from reaching the bedroom.  The Tea Studio is even well appointed with plants, dishes and two baths. We stayed for a long visit, so we would have loved more hanging space for our clothes. But that’s an easy issue to remedy. We hope to stay there again in the future!
The perfect small space for a business trip to the city. Steps away from the best Old Town restaurants and had all the essentials!
Great place, easy check-in, equipped with everything you need. Great neighborhood, safe, clean, 20-40 min to downtown with uber depending on traffic. Overall great experience.

We absolutely loved the place. Vladimir's attention to detail was made us smile; we know what it takes to do this, having been Airbnb owners in the past.
Whoever redid the place originally did a fantastic job, and I imagine when Vladimir saw it available he happily swooped in.
The location is unparalleled for this part of town.
The rooms, the furniture, the beds and pretty much everything else were perfect.
And to top it off, the gorgeous deck with all the greenery was a great place to start the day, and a great place to watch the evening sky.

We enjoyed our stay at Hanna and Mark’s. It was a good location and the garage space and elevator made it very easy to access. The apartment was very clean and spacious and had everything that we needed. The only hesitation we would have to stay again would be the noise from the adjacent apartment, which made it challenging to sleep in the master bedroom. Otherwise everything was very nice and we enjoyed our stay.
Perfect place for downtown exploring! Great views and amenities!
Fine for a very short stay. Everything was pretty clean and comfortable, but I did find a cockroach in the shower :(
We really liked that Brad’s place was walking distance from all the great restaurants in Hyde and an easy walk to the Metra and bus stops. Clean, convenient and well maintained.

Max’s place matched the photos and he was very responsive. The area was great with a lot of nearby eats. However, the place could use a few touches- curtains were stained, base boards were dusty, there was a wet dry towel in the bathroom, and the bed frame appeared broken in the middle. These are all things that are small fixes. We did reach out to Max about the cleanliness and he responded quickly but the places still could have been cleaned better.
I've stayed @ Tim's place multiple times and it's very homey with convenient public transportation and great places to visit in the neighborhood.

We had a great stay at Caza Bonita and really enjoyed our time in Chicago. The house was very clean, had a great layout, and offered plenty of space for our group. The neighborhood was also much more peaceful than we initially expected, which made us feel comfortable throughout our stay.
A few suggestions that could make the experience even better: we did notice some roaches in the kitchen (the only area where we saw them), the kitchen knives could use sharpening, and one of the frying pans is ready to be replaced. The smoke alarm is also very sensitive, and while the nearby train wasn’t bothersome at all, the air conditioning unit was quite loud, which may be an issue for light sleepers.
Overall, these were relatively minor issues compared to the positives. We had a very enjoyable stay, appreciated the home, and would recommend it to others visiting Chicago.
My stay in Chicago was good
Great place to take rest after long days at Downtown. I would come back to this location again.

The place was cozy and as advertised. Nearby there was a nice grocery store (Agora market) and entertainment, such as Daisies restaurant, Logan square improv, Mitocaya Antonejeria and coffee places like New Wave, Gaslight.

Amazing, peaceful space within walking distance of restaurants, 24 hour cvs and other stores. The space itself provided a clean, cozy, relaxing feel. While not in dowtown chicago, you can easily get to downtown, navy pier, and so much more with a quick uber ride or stay in hyde park and enjoy some of its restaurants and bars.
A great unit to stay in for a baseball game.  The neighborhood was beautiful and clean and felt very safe
Perfect for one person and VERY AFFORDABLE

Great stay! The apartment was very clean, cozy, and comfortable-it truly felt like a home away from home. The hosts were wonderfully hospitable and communicated very well.
The only thing to keep in mind is that it's a bit far from the city center, so you just need to plan for extra travel time. Other than that, everything was perfect. Highly recommended!

Ideal location if you want to be close to a CTA Blue Line stop and be in a bustling neighborhood with lots of shopping and restaurants/bars. Not a lot of natural light in the apartment since it’s below sidewalk level (garden apartment).  Also, there is very little in the way of comfortable seating -  one very small loveseat and 4 chairs surrounding a small dining table (and two benches). If you plan on spending most of your time in the apartment, not out and about, that might be an issue. Beds are memory foam and comfortable. 2 smaller Bedrooms have no furniture besides the beds (no nightstands or chairs).  No art on the walls. Overall this feels like corporate housing, but it’s fine for a few days in a great neighborhood in a great city.
Great place, great price, great location, Nice host(s) and easy entry.

Stayed here for a week with my family (2 adults and 2 kids - 8 and 4). We absolutely loved it. The unit was very clean and had all the supplies we needed (enough paper towels, toilet paper, dish washer soap, good quality shampoo/conditioner/body wash, also spices and oils for cooking so we didn’t have to buy any). The noise from the trains didn’t bother us at all - it was an endless entertainment for the kiddos. The location you can no beat - close to literally everything  no matter if you’re in town on a business trip or a vacation.

Imran’s place was spacious and perfect for the 4 of us. It was unbelievable to get free parking in Chicago. We drove to the place, parked, and the took Uber around the city. He had good recommendations for restaurants. The apartment was in a very safe feeling neighborhood.

Here’s the updated version with a bit more detail:
We had a great stay and really enjoyed the apartment. It was spacious, clean, comfortable, and had plenty of room for us to relax. The beds were very comfortable and the living room was the perfect spot for us to watch the World Cup together. The neighborhood was very walkable, with lots of good food nearby and easy access to public transportation.
Joan was wonderful to communicate with—very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We also really appreciated being able to store our luggage in the storage unit on the property both before check-in and after checkout. It made our arrival and departure days so much easier. We’d definitely stay here again!

Casa 18 was great for our 4 days in Chicago.  The suite was very clean and modern. It was a great location for transit access as we didn't have a rental car.  Just a block away from a bus stop and two blocks from the Damen L Train station. The neighborhood was quiet in the evening and felt safe.  One thing I will say is there is no options for food or drinks later in the evening, so if you stay here and are out late at an event or game, plan ahead because there is nowhere that we could find to get anything close by. Overall, a great stay and would recommend.

First time in Chicago as a solo trip and everything at the listing was great! Clean, quiet, private and comfy. It’s so close to the green line and makes getting into downtown Chicago a breeze. Would definitely stay here again ✨
Marissa and Nathan were great hosts.  Very responsive and very friendly.  Easy access to freeway,  close to grocery stores.  The space was very welcoming and I felt right at home.
We had a wonderful stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and perfect for our family. The host was responsive. Great communication and a great experience overall. We would definitely stay here again!

overall we had a great stay! the apartment was super clean and had everything we needed. kitchen was usable as there was many appliances and everything needed to cook. there was even laundry, which was a nice bonus. check-in and check-out were super easy, and the host was very friendly and always quick to respond.
the location was very convenient, with train and bus stops close by. when we first arrived, we were a bit surprised by the neighborhood as it wasn’t quite what we expected, but we didn’t have any problems during our stay. the apartment itself felt very safe and secure.
do note that roommates are also going in and out and using the space. wasn’t a problem for us but depends on whose there :))
overall, we’d definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a clean, comfortable stay with great access to public transportation!

Great location.
Great views.
Issues were responded to quickly.
Only concern from us was so-so furniture. Couches unfortunately were not that comfortable and made for smaller people.
Good place to stay

Great space to recharge in a long week of vacation activities. Hosts were accommodating and answered all my questions when booking. They checked in during the stay, but we didn’t want for much once we were there!
Awesome place. Def will stay again
Spacious apartment in a convenient location. A couple things arose during the stay and Alma was helpful in getting those addressed.

We enjoyed our time at this Airbnb a lot. The hosts were very responsive and friendly. We checked in late and needed assistance locating the building, they quickly responded and helped. The home was clean and the beds were very comfortable. There was a tv in each room, an elevator in the building, and the a/c worked very well. The kitchen had all the dishes we needed and was stocked with tea and coffee, which was a nice treat! When we arrived the couch was orange and not comfortable for sleeping on, but we didn't need that. The location is fantastic, near attractions downtown and Chinatown, with wonderful tea and food selections.
Tim's house is absolutely great. My private room was very comfortable, and the surroundings were both private and generously appointed.  I would definitely stay here again.

Great place, as described. Very clean, bright. Extremely convenient from O'Hare and the blue line. Many wonderful walkable restaurants, coffee shops. Well sound proofed from busy street, but not insulated from apartment next door, can hear everything from master bedroom. Didn't bother us but for one night.

We loved our stay! That bed! Sooo comfy and made for wonderful sleep. I forgot there was supposed to be a bar below, never heard it. Super convenient location & street parking was not a hassle! Will totally book again next time in town.
We enjoyed our stay. Host was very responsive when ever we had any questions. Airbnb was clean and had everything we needed. It was in a good area. Would book again.

Family-friendly, safe neighborhood about a 10-12 minute walk from the red line station so we could park our car in the parking space provided (which was an added bonus!) and take the red line downtown for all of our activities. You do have to allow time to walk to the station and ride at least 30 minutes from there into the heart of the city, but the safety and peacefulness of the neighborhood was important to us. The beach was also within a mile or we could drive 10 minutes for free parking at Montrose Beach and could enjoy the beautiful trail along the lakefront. Nancy was very responsive and the best host we've ever had. She even left cupcakes for my husband's birthday and a big snack basket upon our arrival. The home was very clean and comfortable for our family of 4 and it was amazing having an exercise room in the basement! This place had everything we were looking for and I highly recommend it!

Peaceful place. Hakim is very responsive and communicative. Diverse and great restaurants around, including Korean, Persian, Mexican.

Great location, the place needed some updates with WiFi not working initially as well as the television not working. Parking was included, but permits were not left. Messaged host and they were very responsive letting us park in the garage, which was helpful.

A location that makes it easy to hit all the amazing things in Logan Square with a short walk, and then another short walk to hit the Blue Line. Très bon emplacement avec un accès facile au métro à 10min à pied. Parking facile et gratuit pour une voiture.

Great location! Jake's place was very comfortable.

I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay. Thank you for a wonderful experience!

The apartment is adorable, clean and comfortable. The parking space is perfect and neighborhood is wonderful. Public transportation is easy and the neighborhood feels safe to walk around at night when returning from downtown.

Highly recommend this booking, ideal location - parking especially in a city like this.

Apartamento novo e amplo com vista bonita para a cidade . Quartos confortáveis e roupa de cama ótima e nova , aconchegante. Toalhas boas nos banheiros modernos e limpos . Silencioso à noite . Próximo ao supermercado Target.

The apartment was amazing! Darryl was very responsive whenever I had questions and the place is exactly like the photos and description listed. Would definitely stay here again in the future!
Very cute and comfy apartment in a quiet neighborhood. Hugh and Claire were helpful and kind hosts. Easy to find free street side parking was a bonus! Thank you for a wonderful experience. Becky
Great location close to Lincoln Park Zoo and the lake front. Process for checking in was straightforward and host made it easy.

Great place!

This was the most clean comfortable Airbnb. I have spent in a while, and I love the fact that it was a studio apartment, but it still was very spacious….. I would definitely love to book here again. For the price the place was great.

Very comfortable Wrigleyville home for my family of 4. Felt very safe, great neighborhood with a lot to do. Chris was accommodating, supplying parking permits by request, but it was still a bear to find a spot being so close to the park. Great stay and Chris was a great host.

Tawney’s house was cozy, clean lots of light and very comfortable. I particularly liked how easy it was to get inside whenever we left the house. I am definitely going to come back the next time I visit Chicago - the house was perfect! The area was surprisingly beautiful with a great park nearby that we spent some time at.
