The location really can't be beat and I feel like the price was good for staying in the West Loop. 10/10 - would stay again.
Very nice casual second floor apartment. Spacious for two people. Comfortable queen size bed. Has a little wear and tear but still very clean.
Beau Airbnb, grand, correspond aux photos, un peu loin du centre-ville mais station de train pas loin.
We loved this stay next to Wrigley Field! This was great for our family of 6 plus grandparents! We enjoyed the bedrooms  +TVs and utilized the kitchen and washer/dryer! Everything was clean and cozy!

From start to finish our stay at Junni’s place was just as advertised. The house was spotless and the amenities were awesome. If ever in Chicago I highly recommend staying at Junni’s house.

Joan was a great host. No complaints!
We loved our stay here!
It was a great stay
Great experience.  We were steps away from Wrigley Field and a shirt under to downtown Chicago.

The home is beautiful, spacious, and located in a great neighborhood. It worked well for our family vacation, and we really enjoyed the house and the area.
Unfortunately, during our stay, the upstairs bathtub leaked and caused significant flooding in the kitchen below, including water coming through the light fixtures. We cleaned up the water and placed buckets as requested. This was stressful and concerning, especially during a family trip, and it did affect our overall experience.
The house itself has a lot of great qualities, but I do think the plumbing issue needs to be fully repaired before future guests stay.
Incredible value, very clean, wonderful place. Thanks so much for hosting me.
Michael was a great host! His place is PERFECT for our family! Incredibly close to Wrigley, the train, and very walkable area! We thoroughly enjoyed it and will definitely be back!

Great place in a great location.  Super convenient with easy walking to Wrigley and all of the great restaurants and bars on both Clark and Southport.  Check in and check out super easy and very stress free.

Tuve una excelente experiencia. Todo estaba muy limpio, organizado y exactamente como se describía. La atención fue amable y siempre estuvieron pendientes de cualquier duda. Sin duda volvería a hospedarme aquí y lo recomiendo a cualquiera que busque un lugar cómodo y agradable.
Great place in a great location. Freddy was a great host! Would stay here again in a heartbeat!

We loved our stay in this gorgeous home. It is super close to the United Center (within walking distance). The place was immaculate and the beds were very comfy and the shower and heated floors were amazing! The garage was an awesome added bonus. We had 1 minor issue with the Keurig but the owner came out and replaced it right away. Thank you for everything, we will definitely be back!
Fabulous location! The apartment has everything you need!
Fantastic cozy apartment in a great location. Everything was exactly as described, would absolutely stay here again!
A wonderful trip, great location, beautiful space.
Excelente estadía; sin duda volveré.
A cozy Airbnb right across the street from Pequod’s. You can’t go wrong!

Logement gigantesque et très facile d'accès par les transports en commun, que ce soit depuis ou vers l'aéroport, ou depuis et vers le centre ville de Chicago.
La maison est mystérieuse, ce qui lui donne un charme indéniable. Je pense qu'il ne faut pas hésiter à la parcourir afin de trouver ce que l'on cherche, comme la buanderie. On y trouve de tout.
Il y a de nombreuses chambres, ce qui permet de rencontrer beaucoup de monde de toutes les provenances.
Les chambres sont climatisées, et Ryan est très réactif.

loved stay at yingjian's place, it was super cute, close to the bus line and easy to get into downtown. felt safe and with being a little hesitant with just street parking, it was actually really easy to get a spot and would recommend as a place to stay!
Great place walkable to the Bean, Millenial Park, and the  Theater district.  It was really nice having 3 bathrooms and 3 bedrooms, the rooftop space was pleasant and clean. Would stay here again!
Great stay! Comfortable and clean. Great location too.

Needed a last minute place to stay after my flight got cancelled and stumbled across this gem - spacious, quiet, charming and near the airport. Plus, the bed is big and comfy.
Erin was so accommodating and went above and beyond to ensure I had a comfortable stay, letting me check in just hours after I booked, and helping turn a stressful situation into a relaxing overnight respite.
Great place to stay!
Great location and awesome views to the lake !

The location and place was great, the only issue we had was the cleanliness. Beds weren't made, there was trash from the last occupants out, a basket of dirty laundry, and I found what seemed to be another woman's hair throughout the home. It seemed as though the place wasn't cleaned between guests. Luckily the people before us didn't seem super messy or anything. It just isn't the most comfortable experience when you can tell it wasn't cleaned before arriving.
The location was wonderful, safe area with several walkable businesses and beach.  The bed was extremely comfortable.  Host was quick to respond to any issues that arose.

We rented this spot to attend three Cubs games..the location was great for this! Host was always very responsive. The setup upstairs is good with rooms that offer a variety of sleeping space. The stairs can be tricky, very steep, and a lot of them. The basement worked well for our teens, but very low ceilings and some floor repair is needed.
The living space is roomy. I only enjoyed the chair space by the front window. The couch is very worn and needs replacing. It was great they provided kcups, but the ground coffee was old and the coffee cups were tiny. The close location to a local coffee shop was nice! Overall, I would say the home is very basic, not great decor, but provides good sleeping space and a convenient walk to Wrigley.

Overall a good value-- somewhat walkable, parking spot that was a bit tight but is off main street which was a plus. Loft area was a bit hot in the summer, which was understandable, kitchen is a bit barebones and the fridge wasn't super efficient, but, it helped during our stay. Host was nice and we had plenty of toiletries and towels. Much appreciated their responses and it was easy overall! Thanks
I really enjoyed my stay.

Great location near restaurants and sites. Very walkable. The kitchen had all the things we needed during our stay. I enjoyed the historic building,  but that does come with some more noise than a newer building. I loved the sitting area overlooking Chicago Avenue.
Nice place! Great location,  clean and good beds.
Amazing host! Amazing property! Enjoyed my stay and will be back!

Good location, safe neighborhood. It's 5 rooms on the floor with one bathroom, hostel like environment. Could use some hooks in the bathroom for towels, toilet paper roll attachments and one shelf at least in the shower, shower water pressure is too low - takes longer to shower, 5G internet is very slow, had to use my mobile data. Bedroom was clean, good a/c. Not a  bad deal for the price for a few days.

Beautiful and comfortable apartment close to the lake and to public transportation, super walkable and lots to see, neighborhood was beautiful and easy to navigate. I would definitely stay here again any time I'm in Chicago!
Met and surpassed expectations.  Great airbnb if you have kids - they loved foosball and darts - and the location is excellent for foodies.  highly recommend.

The pictures shown don’t compare to the actual look of the inside, they’re AI generated to cover up how much of a mess it is. There are holes in the walls, large brown water stains in the ceilings, burn marks in the furniture.. the list goes on. The host is hard to get ahold of and doesn’t respond after multiple attempts. We ended having to cancel our reservation the next day due to the poor condition and upkeep of the inside of the home.
Extremely quiet neighborhood,  ideal location for my visit, and lots of peace and quiet here.
Clean and well maintained space!

The value cannot be beat. Period.  The location was incredible because it’s right off Wells St which made walking, bicycling, and eating super convenient.  We parked our car in a covered garage only two short blocks away.  The unit was very quiet despite being only slightly above street level.  I always felt safe which was important to me because I had my two young boys with me.  Cons:  the bathroom tub was very clean but could use some attention (caulking near the faucet area).

Beautiful updated condo on a pretty street.   Walking distance (20+minutes) to Wrigley Field.  Several good restaurants and bars in walking distance.  Furnishings well appointed, comfortable beds, modern kitchen and bath.  Clean, Safe and secure.  We could have used more towels - bath, hand. and face cloths, plus a trash can in the bedrooms.   Washer and dryer worked well, but didn’t want to spend time doing laundry.
Wonderful host!

We enjoyed this very simple and clean basement unit. The entry is super easy (one door, one key) and it was convenient for unloading our belongings. I was nervous about the street parking being scarce but aside from Sunday when a nearby festival was in the park, there was parking very close, even late at night. This place is walkable to many great spots in Logan Square, including Scofflaw. Overall it fit our needs perfectly.

This place is in the perfect spot - truly minutes from cute downtown Andersonville, the bus stops and close to the train. The place is well-stocked with seasonings, etc but you’re also really close to a Jewel and Walgreens to grab food, drink, etc.
The interior is adorable - very comfortable and clean. We felt right at home. Street is quiet. I’d stay here again in a heartbeat and other properties owned by Kory given how nice this one is!

We had a wonderful stay here! Everything was spotless and comfortable. Neel and Kevin were very thoughtful, kind, and helpful hosts. We walked or took to the train to everything we wanted to do, which was what we were hoping for. Definitely recommend!!

I can't speak highly enough of my experience at Kerem's place! I stayed for two months on a work assignment, and it was the perfect haven for me and my husband during a busy summer. The apartment is even more beautiful than in the photos, with floor-to-ceiling views of the park outside (facing southwest, so tons of great natural light), and the building amenities are fantastic and never overcrowded. We used the pool, gym and business center; the staff is all very welcoming and helpful. 10/10 experience.
Kerem is a wonderful host; always responsive and helpful and very kind.
Great location, too, at the edge of the West Loop, with all kinds of fantastic restaurants and bars in easy walking distance, while the park outside the building keeps things more peaceful in the immediate area. I loved everything about my stay. Thanks, Kerem!
It was an efficient cost effective choice
Great location! I enjoyed the walking distance to great restaurants. Very safe neighborhood.

Our stay was AMAZING! Location was convenient. We took about a 15 minute bike ride to the beach, minutes from the dog beach, restaurants, night life, hospitals, etc. pet friendly which was awesome because my fur babies r my babies and we do travel with them… to have a private back yard for them to play and go potty was priceless. Hits were very welcoming and responsive.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exceptionally clean, neat, and very well maintained. Vince was an amazing host—he responded to our messages and calls almost immediately whenever we had a question. Everything went smoothly, and we didn’t face any problems during our stay. Thank you so much, Vince, for your outstanding hospitality. We would definitely love to stay here again and highly recommend this place to others!

My stay at the apartment was just okay. Here are my pluses and minuses:
PLUS:
• Location - Near lots of great restaurants and the area is very walkable. Felt safe the entire time.
•Bed - King Size (or bigger!) and very comfortable.
MINUS:
•Building access - The lock below the keypad requires some finagling to get it to work. I struggled with it a couple times.
•Buliding corridors - The smell of cannabis is overwhelming. I personally don’t like it.
•Seating - The unit does not have comfortable seating for lounging. There is a couch, but it’s lumpy and not comfortable at all.
•Bathroom - The bathroom sink is incredibly small and difficult to place items on it. There is a medicine cabinet, but it did not appear very clean to me so I didn’t use it. Also, a towel hook somewhere in the bathroom
would be very convenient.
I neither recommend nor discourage people from booking this apartment. This was just my experience, and I would not stay here again.
Located in a Nice neighborhood that had a short walk to bus stops great restaurants, grocery store and a beautiful park.
Was very comfortable and convent. Very clean as well. Kim communicates great. The video instructions were very clear as well.
Great stay for my daughters and I their favorite part was Starbucks being around the block!
Fantastic place if your in town to watch a ballgame at Wrigley! Block & 1/2 away and I felt safe walking to, from and the surrounding area.
Great location.  Nice place

Perfect place for our short trip to Chicago. Nick was very accommodating and helpful, and the place was just as described. Loved the shower-great water pressure. We had everything we needed and more. Super clean. Thanks Nick for a hosting and offering a comfortable stay.
Great hosts and cute sweet pets!
Exceptionally clean. Simple accommodation…perfect for solo traveler. I appreciated its closeness to the University and the Obama Center
Someone said if you don’t have something nice to say, don’t say anything at all.
This was a great space! Nice spacious bedrooms and two baths made the stay super comfortable. The neighborhood was great and the host had lots of suggestions for places to go.
I loved staying at Ewa’s home. The place was so very clean, quiet, and a great place to relax and recharge. The patio in the back is a nice place for a morning coffee and some work! Highly recommend.
Everything was perfect.
Nicholas was a great host, he was very responsive and even accommodated me when I missed my flight. I loved my stay at his home

Marissa’s place was as described.
Great, safe location. Nice parking included which was a PLUS!
Easy to walk to dinner or grab coffee at Starbucks right across the street!

She provides earplugs for sleeping but we didn’t need them. It was quiet enough. I wish there had been blackout curtains bc I could have used them since I’m a light sensitive person.
Would totally stay again.
4.8/5 for me.
Stayed one night. Don’t miss Tweet restaurant for breakfast. 10 minute walk. Recommended by host and it was fantastic!
Todo estuvo muy bien, nos encantó el lugar y el host fue súper amable siempre.
Great place, amazing location. Sweet host.

The neighborhood is fantastic. Safe residential neighborhood, nice restaurants, hometown feel, but very close to all the downtown stuff you’d ever want to see/do. The place itself was spacious and served our needs quite well. There were a few minor issues, but nothing I found too bothersome at all, but things that I could see a very particular, finicky person may take issue with. Parking on the street was pretty tough to find at times, so definitely be prepared to walk a couple blocks from wherever you find a spot. But overall, it was well with the price!

This two bedroom, one bathroom unit is in a beautiful and quiet location, easy to walk to from the bus and walkable from the train but definitely more of a distance. The house itself is older and thus the apartment has some of the things you might expect like a small bathroom and open closets, but overall it's well maintained and met all of our needs. The beds were comfortable and each bedroom had an additional window unit to support the central air. Thankfully the temps during our trip were unseasonably cool for summer (high 70s/mid 80s for the highs, into the 60s at night). Front door access directions were clear and easy and my family and I thoroughly enjoyed our three nights there. Emily was quick to respond to any questions and helped make our first Airbnb experience a good one.
The house was clean and exactly as pictured. The area was safe and quiet! The bed was super comfortable. Would stay again!

Loved it! Clean, comfortable, quiet, with easy street parking. We were lucky to find this place, we were looking for a centrally located spot so we could walk to an event at United Center one night and spend some time in the city, and this checked all the boxes. Host was friendly and responded quickly to any questions I had.
We had a great stay! The location is ideal. The place was clean and comfortable for the six of us.
1 block from the Friendly Confines!  What more could a Cub fan want?

Isabel's place is exactly why AirBNB was invented.   Much more like home than a hotel room, space to spread out, etc.   The location a 3 minute walk to the Blue Line and 77 bus was perfect for our needs.

I waffled between a 4 and 5 star review, but went with 5. The location of this AirBnB is truly truly fantastic -  GREAT walkability to anything you'd like in the city while also in a quiet, lovely neighborhood. It was spotlessly clean. Great communication from the host. Beds are pretty comfortable. Kitchen is pretty well provisioned for cooking. The 4 star items are: (1) it photographs too well - when we arrived I felt a touch let down based on my expectations. We stayed during a sunny patch of July weather and it felt pretty dark inside and the condition of the painting in the unit could absolutely use a refresh. (2) The internet (Verizon Wireless) was decidedly mid-level. If I was working remote I would have been unhappy, but since I was on vacation, it was OK.

Great stay! Nice and clean, spacious, easy check-in, responsive host. The included parking passes were a nice touch, but we didn't need to use them as there are three free parking spots at the end of the block. My only complains aside from the minor maintenance issues listed in other reviews were the lumpy pillows and the lack of a non-stick mat in the slippery shower. The neighborhood is utilitarian, but very safe, quiet, and near the L stop and with lots of restaurants and shops in a 5-10 minute walk. Would definitely stay again!
We really enjoyed our stay! Everything was very clean and the view was amazing. Thank you!!!!
Stephanie was super helpful the whole time.  The place was amazing, perfect for families.  Quiet, easy to park around the corner.  Easy walk to the L with kids.

Great stay. Location is perfect with everything being walkable. It is exactly 1.5 miles to Wrigley and was an enjoyable walk thru the neighborhoods. Very safe. Parking was easy on the sidestreets. Space was private and quiet. Beds were comfortable. Instructions for entry were clear and easy to follow. The Cubs gate key does stick a little and repeatedly had a little trouble with it, but eventually could get in.
Only complaint is that there were no washcloths (just towels) in the bathroom and the tub of coffee in the pantry was empty. Luckily The Bakehouse across the road has great coffee and friendly staff.
I would definitely stay here again.
Perfect blend of in the city but away from the hustle and noise of the city.

Lovely loft apartment. Perfect for a Chicago getaway. Bright, spacious with comfortable bed, nice kitchen and pleasant outdoor deck. Excellent location in fun and interesting neighborhood. Walk to excellent restaurants and bars. Will stay in Amy’s place again.

We had plenty of space for a group of 8. Beds and towels for all. House and bathrooms were clean. Neighborhood was quiet and about a 4-5 min walk to the Kedzie Green Line L station. Felt safe in our group of 8 (4 kids and 4 adults). Latest we came home was around 10:30 at night. Never felt we needed to do anything other than be aware of surroundings on the train. Rarely saw any other pedestrians on the sidewalk while walking.

Very nice place. Clean and comfortable. Location is on Division and above a bar so there is some noise occasionally but it wasn’t bad at all. The plus side is that it is easy walking distance to many great restaurants, bars and shops and to the blue line.

Really enjoyed this space. So convenient to get to wrigley and all the local restaurants. Very walkable. Parking was never a problem. Brandon was very quick to respond when I had a question. Couldn’t have been happier with this booking.

Great apartment in a great building with a terrific gym. Looks just like the pictures (though the futon wasn't very comfy as a sofa). I used to have work video calls there (good internet) and then go to meetings in the Loop.
Easy access in a good neighborhood, 2 min walk from the Lawrence L stop... Neighborhood is still coming up with regard to restaurants; most are good, but very takeout or cheap-and-cheerful-oriented. There are great eats 2 stops north, or Wrigley a few stops to the south.
The hosts were VERY quick to respond with any issues or questions.
Clean and spacious in a nice quiet neighborhood. Would definitely stay again!

The Lucky Penny was the perfect find for our  family trip to Chicago. The house was beautifully decorated and so fun to live in for 4 days. It was clean and very comfortable. You can tell that Kelly put a lot of effort and thought into everything for her guests. It was perfection. We were unfamiliar with Lincoln Park but the neighborhood really blew us away. Kelly has an easy guide of her favorite spots displayed in house but she will also tailor recommendations if you request. It was safe and walkable and the restaurants were some of the best Chicago has to offer. Really made you feel like a local. We were able to hop back and forth between all the neighborhoods and downtown for the museums with no problem. I can’t recommend Kelly as a host and the Lucky Penny enough. What a gem! Thanks for making our trip so magical!

We loved our stay!  The house was great and the location was even better.  We chose the house because of its proximity to Wrigley Field.  However, I would stay here again for the peaceful setting of Roscoe Village.
The location had lots of shops and things to do. It was perfect for our little getaway.

An absolute 10/10 stay! The apartment is in a great location - just a short, easy walk to Wrigley Field.  The place was spotless, incredibly comfortable, and had everything we needed. Our host Arlene was phenomenal - super responsive and welcoming. Check in was a breeze. We couldn't have asked for a better home base for our Chicago trip and would stay here again in a heartbeat!
New and clean apartment in the good neighborhood. Really enjoyed our stay

Great place to stay, local to shops and great restaurants. Clean and exactly as described. The only issue I had was that the elevator was not working so I had to carry my suitcases up the stairs by myself. I wish that was listed but overall great stay

Clean, great location if going to a Cubs game. Host very helpful with many recommendations. Very clear, detailed instructions of how to enter the property- a bit of maze but easy enough. A big plus is the free designated parking spot.
Demitri was a great host! Very responsive and communicative. I enjoyed my stay.

Our family of 3 found Fenton’s place to be our home away from home while in Chicago. All amenities were as described and the place was clean. Andersonville is a very walkable neighborhood with restaurants, shopping, and groceries. This specific location also has a bus stop almost within arm’s reach and the el/subway is a short walk, as is Wrigley Field. If you stay during the summer, the Sunnyside Farmer’s Market on Wednesdays is nearby and worth the trip!
If this is your first visit to Andersonville, please be aware of the proximity to the street and the continuous noise it may bring, particularly if you are a light sleeper. There is an inner bedroom positioned away from the street that may be a more insulated option. The unit itself is well decorated and modern. This property should be on your short list for your next trip to Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay and truly felt right at home! The kitchen was well-stocked with utensils, making it easy to prepare quick breakfasts and dinners for our child. The home also had a great selection of board games and books, which our kid thoroughly enjoyed. The location was extremely convenient, with easy access to all the downtown attractions and tourist spots. We had a fantastic time and would happily stay here again!

Place was very comfortable in a very nice area. Parking can be a little tricky but that’s anywhere in Chicago. Still I had no problem finding a spot. It’s easy to get into the apartment and it all felt very private. I do recommend this place.

TJ was a superstar host an d great communicator!! Amazing apartment in great location! We came in town for Cubs game and it was so easy with the garage parking and walkable neighborhood. Beds were comfortable and everyone basically had their own bathroom! Stocked mini-bar was a win and filled with so many options!! Loved the space and furniture was perfect. Also enjoyed the outside spaces to chill with the fam!! Thanks a bunch!!
We had a great work retreat for 12 people. Nice meeting space in the living room and enough space for everyone to spread out.

Everything was good here. We look forward to coming back again. The directions to the place were amazing and complete with pictures. Convenient to everything we wanted to see and a cute diner around the corner with amazing food.
Great stay, plenty of room. Host was very nice and communicative. Loved our time in Chicago. Thank you!
John was an incredible host!  Not only was the place amazing but loved the flexibility and responsiveness.  Will definitely book again for our next trip to Chicago.

Marco was a great host. The entire process was super easy to check in, my room was ice cold when I checked in. The kitchen was clean bathrooms as well plenty of towels.
Definitely will be staying here again, very well priced establishment

Great stay and location! We love this area of Chicago and would definitely stay here again. The place was very spacious for a couple and would even be great for two couples or a family. Lots of natural light and air conditioning on the hot days kept us nice and cool. Thanks for a great stay!

We had a wonderful little getaway! The place was perfect! We loved everything about it! It’s a quiet neighborhood and Paul was very communicative and quick to respond. Wish we could have stayed longer!
Great place to stay. Clean. Building's amenities are the best part-- gym, pool, ping pong & foos ball.
Very comfortable and hospitable stay. Will definitely recommend
Good Logan Square room - worth the price. You will be sharing the main level of the building with another potential guest and the owners who live and hang out there.

We stayed at this location for 3 nights and 2 full days on a brief stop in Chicago before visiting family in central Illinois. This location is exactly as shown in the photos and has everything you need for an efficient trip to Chicago. It is less than 10 minute walk to the zoo. Very close to several great restaurants. We did not take public transit during our brief stay and instead opted to take uber since we had a small child but it was convenient for many of the other highlights that are less walkable.
3 adults would be tight, but it was the perfect size for a family of 3 with a young child.
Great place, worked very well for family of five, even though dad had to take the couch! Outstanding location. Hosts also sent us glasses we left behind which was much appreciated

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout our visit. She provided great recommendations for places to explore in Chicago, which made our trip even more enjoyable.
Communication was excellent, and check in was smooth and hassle free. I truly appreciated the host’s hospitality and attention to detail. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you for helping make our trip such a great experience!
Great location! The place is beautiful!

Un lugar limpio, moderno y acogedor, bien ubicado , aunque el estacionamiento es en la calle todas las noches pudimos encontrar un lugar sin mucho problema ni mucha distancia. Definitivamente lo recomiendo tiene todo lo que necesitas para cocinar bañarte y lavar. Muy bien! Volveremos.

Michael's place is exactly as advertised and was comfortable for a two-night stay. I was there for work and needed to be in that neighborhood, so I would stay there again. Michael was very accommodating with parking, which was very helpful.  Overall, a great stay.
Great walkable location for our family getaway! We loved the rooftop area too. Definitely recommend!

Keith’s place is in a very safe part of town, has a bunch of bars and restaurants with in walking distance, and even has a Starbucks right next door. Couch was comfy, and so was the bed. There were plenty of kitchen appliances, which made cooking food very manageable.
Great location near Lincoln Square. Close to the Brown Line Train and bus stops. Quiet neighborhood, but near shops and restaurants.

Our flight home from Paris turned into a nightmare after weather forced us to land in Pennsylvania, divert to Chicago, and unexpectedly stay there for two nights. We booked this Airbnb around 11 p.m. after finding that nearly every hotel was full, and our host responded immediately. They had everything ready for us within an hour, making an incredibly stressful situation so much easier. We were so grateful for their flexibility, responsiveness, and kindness. They truly came through when we needed it most, and we couldn't recommend them more highly.
The home was very clean and well stocked. It was exactly what we expected. The location was perfect for catching a few games.
Great location, walking distance to the arena!

My stay at this accommodation was very good; it met my expectations and was exactly as described in the listing. The place was very clean and comfortable. The owner is attentive to messages. The only thing worth noting is the thermostat, as it needs constant adjustment, but the owner makes the necessary effort to ensure the unit stays as cool as you need it to be and keeps you informed via message. Parking is limited, but that is a general issue in Chicago, so come prepared!

Mary's place was a great place to stay! It was clean, had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, and the location was superb! The free parking spot on the backside of the building was a nice touch too. We felt safe for the duration of our visit, and really enjoyed getting out and walking around Chinatown. Such a cool area to explore, shop, and eat! I highly recommend staying at Mary's place and would stay here again with my family!
Nos encantó el lugar. Sin duda lo recomendaríamos y nos gustaría volver en el futuro. ¡Gracias nuevamente!
The apartment was perfect for our group. The location was walkable and near great restaurants. The garage, with electric charger was a nice bonus feature. The backyard was nice.

Great host, very hospitable & communicative. Recommendations provided for things to do in the city which was greatly appreciated! Located in a quiet neighborhood to easily access the main downtown area
Awesome and spacious studio apartment, well worth the $!
Clean and comfortable! The amenities were modern, and there was plenty of space. The host was very helpful in getting us parking passes, too.
My family and I had a great time at Sadie's place. It was very comfortable and we had a wonderful stay. Sadie was helpful and we would be back in the future!

What a fantastic apartment for my family and me diring our annual pilgrimage to Chicago! It was just as described and then some ... Not only is it such a perfect location to blend into the thriving culture, happenings and people of Wicker Park, but it immediately felt like a home away from home. Being literally across the corner from the Damen stop on the blue line made getting around the city a breeze and a welcoming, quiet respite for that afternoon break before heading back out. Plenty of great food (even with vegan options) practically on the doorstep in an extremely walkable neighborhood. Highly recommend!
Really nice building with good views and amenities. Check-in was smooth, the area is pretty walkable, and overall had a great stay!
Very clean space. Friendly hosts and very responsive.
Very nice place! Shaun and Christina were great. Very helpful and responsive to any needs. Thanks so much!
Great location for a quick trip into the city and the space was clean and spacious!!  We’d stay here again!
I liked the rooms, washroom and living area. Very well maintained. I just wish access to parking area could have been a bit easier to get in. Over all fantastic place to live.

We felt like Elizabeth's place was a great value.  It was exactly as pictured, very clean and great host communication.  We only had trouble finding parking on her street on street cleaning day, which is typical of most neighborhoods in the city.  One of the beds was slightly uncomfortable for 2 people, but as there were only 3 of us, we were able to shift to make it work.  It was a solid stay in a great location.
The home and the neighborhood are everything we wanted. Downtown is accessible but we were happy to just explore the area of Wicker Park and Bucktown on foot for the entire stay.
Spacious, quiet, walkable to restaurants and train. Just a few stops from the Loop. Worked out perfect for us!

I can’t thank Charles enough for his hospitality.  He’s a great host.  Very informative on restaurants or bars nearby for us to go to.  The space was clean.  And we all had a great night of rest after our concert. If I’m ever back in Chicago again, I would try to stay there again.

This was a fantastic place to stay, in a great area of the city. There are so many great places nearby, and it is conveniently very close to the O’Hare train. I struggled a little bit checking in but Tugba was very communicative & helpful. I would definitely recommend this place, the value alone makes it incredibly worth it.

Perfect for a cubs game. Guthries bar across the street gives free hot dogs on game days.  Great coffee shop down the road. Pizza place there is amazing. Very clean neighborhood, felt safe walking at night.
We loved our stay in Logan Square. This space was exactly as advertised. Clean, comfortable and lots of walkable options in the area. Easy drive/train downtown too.
The beds are very comfy, everything is very clean, the overall experience was great!

The house was just as described, and the rooms were cozy and very clean. The neighborhood was so lovely and the stores and train station were an easy walk away. Justin was a great host, and was very responsive.
Les recomiendo el lugar muy tranquilo y seguro

Sulaiman was a great host, very responsive, and helped us resolve a couple of issues quickly, including accessing the unit when we accidentally forgot a some items. We’re so thankful he accommodated our last minute stay!

Great place! Close to everywhere we wanted to be.  Jake was very responsive!

Great location, very conviently close to Brown Line and other public transit. The neighborhood was very walkable! The apartment was very quiet, despite being on a pretty busy street! We very much enjoyed our stay.

This home served as the perfect gathering point for our family traveling in from the West Coast and the northern Midwest for a concert weekend. We truly enjoyed our three-day stay and would gladly recommend this property to anyone visiting Chicago.

Fantastic Stay in Hyde Park!

Kathy's place was perfect for my 2 day trip to the city. The neighborhood was easily walkable to everything that I needed and the apartment was perfect for my stay.

Travelled to Chicago from the UK for a concert - well worth the effort!.

Loved staying here.  Amazing location and close to everything you could want to enjoy a summer in Chicago.  The unit was clean, had a great view and the building had wonderful amenities like a pool, workout facility and lounge with a pool table.  Would definitely stay here again!

The location of the apartment was great. But I think it should have a t v in the bedroom. And also I think it should have more rugs especially in the bathroom. And I think it should have better towels and more towels. Some of the dishes were dirty. I think it was too much money for the price that I paid.
Good communication with host.
my experience was great! thank you!
I had a wonderful stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
Perfect position spotlessly clean and a joy to stay. Would definitely recommend
Great communication! Aligned with reviews and pics. Super convenient for a visit to Wrigley.

I had to ask for laundry soap, multiple times and never received it. I also reported a smoke alarm that wouldn’t stop going off and the communication to get that taken care of was excessive and annoying.
Thank you for having us!
Exactly what they say it was.  Definitely recommend.

We had a great time here.  The place is exactly what is shown in the pictures and was actually more spacious than we expected.  Easy access to bus and train lines.  Neighborhood is quiet and felt very safe.  I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again in the future.
Un apartamento ideal para pasar tiempo en familia.
Highly recommend for a budget  trip not far from the city
This was such a great stay for a short stay in Chicago. We loved how there was so much to do within walking distance.
This place was so convinient, it was near so much to do, such a nice neighborhood, and such a steal on the price!

What a charming and lovely place in the heart of Lakeview! Truly, it's at the epicenter of all things north side and was the perfect place to launch our Chicago adventure. MJ was a wonderful host, and so kind/communicative throughout our stay. Will definitely be back!
Nice place- walkable to bus stops. Nearby food places to walk. House worked out well for us (family of 3).
Loved our stay!
Great stay! Would definitely recommend.
Great place - super clean, great shower, easy in, easy out :)
Met Chris during our stay and he was warm and welcoming. Love this place in a great neighborhood. Will rent again. These Tiger fans can even forgive his misguided Sox love.

Nicole and Matt were very attentive and excellent hosts. We only had 1 issue with the coffee maker and they addressed it right away. Overall very nice lodging and great area. We lived in Chicago many years and their restaurant recs were spot on to the places we frequented 15 years ago (CBA, Pequods, Ba-Ba-Reeba, etc).

It was our first Air Bnb experience . I wanted to see Rush on their final day in Chicago 7/22. I searched many , many Chicago hotels but I couldn’t find peace with it. I messaged her via Air bnb site on 7/22 and asked if she was ok with 2 dogs . My beagles are 10 and 12 years old , both have special needs . One is partially blind , the other is too old to be home with a dog sitter . Viviana immediately said we could bring them . The porch and stairs are well lit . She stated there was no railing , which proved to be difficult with a nearly -blind dog ( 5 ) stairs , a little steep . There is a pathway to the back yard , which needs some attention . It is well lit as well . My only big problem was the city of Chicago was tearing up the roads in front of her house on the day we left 7/23. They were driving by, blasting the horn , warning owners to move their cars or be towed away . We barely got packed by 10:00 am , no parking was 9-4:30.
Signs were on the tree . We spoke with workers
Great spot! Maria was a great host and worked with me in an early check-in. Enjoyed my time here.
Great spot.

In town for a Daddy-Daughter Cubs Baseball trip. Excellent location, easy check in, cozy and comfortable. Will absolutely be our go-to every time we come in for a game. By the way, the city guide is hilarious and helpful. Worth taking time to read.

Cheryl’s place was perfect for us. Free street parking, we didn’t use our car the entire stay. Easy walk to restaurants and public transport. The apartment was very clean with all the amenities we needed. The neighborhood was friendly with lots of beautiful wall murals. Cheryl answered all questions in a timely fashion.

All was great and cozy. Just as described. Only one item it’s great to have access to the brown line as it’s directly behind it. If you are a light sleeper bring ear plugs or sound machine for at night as it’s a little loud.
There a few restaurants 5 blocks away but the walk thru the neighborhood is calm and peaceful.
It’s also a 20-30 minute ride to downtown.
Great place walking distance to Wrigley and Lake Shore Dr.

Everything went fine! The place was clean and organized and Nathaly replied quickly answering all my questions.
Definitely recommend it.

The apartment is located in a lovely area in Lincoln Square. There are many restaurants, bars, coffee shops and little stores. The building is also near the L, which is convenient if you want to take the train. The cons are that the building itself is old and you can hear the other tenets walking in the building, closing doors, etc. (floor boards are squeaky). You can also hear the L, so it isn’t necessarily a quiet environment. The unit itself has what you need and it was clean and equip with what you need for basic cooking.

We’ve stayed in Wrigleyville before, but we definitely liked this place better than the first place. It’s got fun vibes, is spacious and is right in the middle of Wrigleyville. A Cubs fan’s dream!!! Next time we come this is where we will stay.

The place was exactly as it was listed. Kyriako was so amazing to work with and very responsive to messages. We had to drop off our luggage early and when we got there the place was already cleaned. The neighborhood was very nice, quiet and walkable to Wrigley Field. We will definitely be staying here again when we come out to see our favorite team play.

Parking is always plentiful, however on this stay there was construction on Ashland, so parking was not as plentiful.  Lida always is friendly and and communication is a 10+.  Beds are comfortable, the area is safe to walk with plenty of activities just around the corner.  We have stayed here six times and will always look to stay here if available.
great location!

David's place was pretty modern, comfortable, and clean. Floor squeaks with almost every footstep, can hear the above residents every footsteps as well...other than that, David's place was great!! A bit pricey but worth every penny. Thanks David!! Loved my experience!
Everything was clean and cozy, and the hosts were very responsive! I recommend it to everyone!

Fortino was very responsive and a great & kind host. I was happy with the small apartment — great if you’re just looking for a place to eat and sleep while you’re in Chicago. Super close to Midway. I would stay again.
Great location... 5 minute walk to Chinatown and to the red line, Great communication and a beautiful clean place

This was a very nice place to stay in Chicago. The apartment was clean, the dining and living areas were larger than they appeared in the photos, and the kitchen had plenty of plates/pots/etc. Osiris was quick to respond to messages and got us parking passes.
Although the apartment itself felt relatively spacious and clean, a couple of aspects fell a little short of what was described. The "main" bedroom had a sliding glass door covered by a not-wide-enough translucent curtain (different than in the photo), so there wasn't much privacy; the mattress was definitely quite old and lumpy; the pull-out couch didn't have a mattress—just the firm couch surface; there wasn't much water pressure in the shower, and it made a screeching noise after a few minutes; the toilet required a bunch of jiggling to stop running; there was hand sanitizer instead of soap in the bathroom.... None of this was particularly serious, just a heads-up for future guests.

This apartment is spacious, clean, and has a great view of Buckingham Fountain and the lake. Location is walkable to restaurants, Grant and Millennium Parks, the Art Institute, and the south loop museums. Access to public transportation is only 1-2 blocks away making all areas of the city easily accessible including direct trains to O’Hare or Midway. The only problem was that the AC was not working. We were not notified of this before arrival. The manager had arranged for a window ac unit to be installed with the hose duct taped to the window.  Unfortunately there was a significant leak with this setup and along with only 2 fans for 3 bedrooms made for an uncomfortable 80 degree stay. I communicated the problem to the managing team daily, and although they were always quick to respond, they were not able to correct the problem or offer alternative solutions. This as quite disappointing as the unit was otherwise perfect, but I would not return again unless this was fixed.

This location gave me exactly what I was looking for and need for a much needed Friendscation getaway ! I had never seen Lake Michigan from the top until this experience. The beautiful views from this 24th floor apartment gave me everything and more. Woke up to the most beautiful sunrise that glistened on the water💦 and I fell asleep looking at Chicago’s best Skyline lights at night. I will definitely be back !
Thanks for a beautiful experience ❤️

My family enjoyed our Chicago stay! We were greeted by a lovely welcome basket on the kitchen island. The house was decorated just like the pictures. The beds were super comfy with plenty of pillows. There were extra blankets in the closets if needed. The bathrooms were all modern and equipped with shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. It felt like we were staying in a nice hotel. Our host, Radu, was very friendly, responsive, and gave clear instructions for entry. The location of the house was perfect for us. We were visiting a relative in Evanston, and we also had great access to the city. My sister easily used the L. We’d recommend entering the alley off of Rosemont for easier parking. We had a large car, but I figured out how to maneuver in and out of the spot. Quiet hours in the house are from 8pm-8am, which seems to mostly apply to one of the upstairs bedrooms that shares a wall with the neighbor.

Musa is a great host. His instructions are clear and made my stay very easy. The apartment is about a mile north of the river, and it’s another mile to “the bean”. I enjoyed the walk every day to my office downtown, and the area is very safe and peaceful. You can easily run or walk along the lake from here, and the CTA red line stops just a block or two away.
We have stayed here for two years in a row and love the place and location

I think the host was incredibly sweet and very communicative. This is an excellent place for short term travel. I stayed long term and I was in a very small room with a shared bathroom down the hall. It was doable, but those who want long term stay should make sure to get the other bedrooms because they are much bigger and have their own bathrooms. Overall, very clean place. Olga came to change the trash a few days a week and always checked in which was great. I chose this place so I could be near my hospital which was only 5 minutes away.

The perfect home base for exploring Chicago! Located close to public transportation and good bites, this Airbnb felt secure and navigable for our quick paced vacation. We would definitely stay here again!
Anny’s place was perfect for my stay in Chicago and had everything I needed for a great stay. Anny was also really friendly and helpful.

My stay was okay. I expected more for the money paid. The backyard and front yard was not maintained. One bed was broken my over seventy guest had to sleep on a sofa the entire stay.
There wasn't any offer to reimburse and funds even though we had this problem and one less guest as originally stated.
David’s place is just close to everything that makes it so perfect for a trip in Chi! Would love to come back!
We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything was worth it, and we’d definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Wonderful hosts, great place that offers all the essentials for a great price!
We had a great time at this house! Great location and very clean. We would go back again.

Overall, decent experience. The place itself is nice and very new. It was cleaned well and had high ceilings. I was also able to find the on-road essentials. There were a few issues with my stay: when I arrived, the lock box instructions given to me were not working and I waited on the sidewalk with my luggage for more than 30 minutes for the owner to send me the correct instructions to access the apartment. Also, the hair dryer was broken and it took multiple hours for a response to that issue. I expected, and have received, a lot better service for the price.
Beautiful place!  Love the room and privacy with the 4 bedrooms & 3 bathrooms!!

I can’t speak highly enough about this place and host. The private area is spacious and inviting. I slept well as the bedroom is very quiet and dark, with a comfortable bed. The area is both lively and quiet at the same time. The home is off the main road so is peaceful, however it is only a 2 minute walk to the main road where there are lots of shops, restaurants, cafes etc. I did not have a car during the stay, but found it easy to get into downtown by using the regular pink line trains from the station, which is only a 10 minute walk away. Abby was a tremendous host, she provided local recommendations, was responsive to questions, and made me feel completely comfortable. With the combination of the home and host, I can’t recommend this place enough!
Bella was very accommodating and the property location was phenomenal.
It was a great stay. Nice neighborhood and easy to get public transportation. The place was clean and just as pictured. We would definitely stay here again.
Great place

This stay was in the perfect location for my friends and I! We were able to hop on the train and go to everything we wanted to and had a wonderful homebase for the weekend!
Train was bit louder than anticipated but there were ear plugs in both rooms!

Stayed here for a few days with my family and everything was great! Host was very responsive and the location was great! It is a renovation in progress but for the price, well worth it. Can't wait to stay here again!

We loved our stay at Cathern’s place. The location couldn’t be better — it’s just steps from Wrigley Field, surrounded by tons of great restaurants, and even a Target only a few blocks away.
Cathern herself was wonderful. She was friendly, very responsive, and incredibly accommodating, especially with both my husband and me needing to work from her home during the day.
The room was great: the bed was super comfortable, the window AC added extra cooling even though the house already had central air, and the bathroom was spotless with plenty of fresh linens.
We would stay again in a heartbeat — highly recommend!
Inga’s was definitely one of the cleanest Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. The neighborhood is lovely, close to tons of restaurants. It’s small but perfect for what we needed it for.
Andy’s place is great. We had three men and we all had our own rooms. It’s a great location too.
Fantastic stay.  Would recommend to anyone staying in the area.

Tom’s place was the perfect stay for our visit to Chicago. Great location, spotless interior, and filled with every amenity we wanted. Tom gave great recommendations for local restaurants and was quick to respond to any questions we had. We would absolutely book this home for a future visit.

Host was very responsive, and communicative.  The parking situation was not very  accurate as the garage parking is basically inaccessible unless you have a compact car. One of the bedrooms has no ac.  And the place wasn’t fully clean when we got there.  However, host sent someone to address bugs in the kitchen when we noticed them the second day.  He also paid for a cookie sheet so we could make cookies in the home which communicates a desire to help.   For families with children, although the bedroom and bathroom space is nice, this house is close to a sketchy area of town.

I think the nicest thing about this particular place is the location. Admittedly, I am a bit biased because I grew up not far from this neighborhood. However, I am not immune to the charm and cozy environment where this home is nested.  The abundance of trees, the big backyards and the variety of architecture always gives you something to look at and appreciate. If you are opting to stay in a comfortable and safe neighborhood where you feel at ease walking at nights, this is the place to be.

Me and my friend stayed at this Air BnB for her birthday trip. It was very clean, it has a great ac unit in the living room, the view was pretty good. The only thing was it’s only one tv which is in the living room, and the microwave was missing the clear plate that’s supposed to spin. Other than that, everything was great! Definitely would recommend you stay here.

Very cool place with plenty of room. Set up great for entertaining. Large rooftop deck with amazing views!
We booked last minute due to problems with our hotel reservation, and while I would say this place is ideal for a group of adult friends, it still worked nicely for my family (including our 4 kids ages 4-14). The entrance could use some work and it felt a little strange using it as it is a commercial/restaurant building, but the unit itself was very nice.
Muy agradable el lugar, cerca de transporte y fácil de llegar a la ciudad, nos sentíamos seguras ya que todas éramos mujeres. Y el host muy proactivo y buenas indicaciones
everything about the place was as stated.  very comfortable.
Easy access to public transportation. Very comfortable.

We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this place! The host was incredibly responsive and made the entire experience smooth from start to finish. Check-in was easy thanks to the clear instructions, and we appreciated the safety information provided for the home.
The location was very convenient—close to the highway, railway station, and bus station. DoorDash had no trouble finding the property, which made ordering meals quick
Overall, this was a great experience with an attentive host and a convenient location. We would gladly stay here again!
Scott is a great host! Extremely accommodating and a great communicator. Thanks for hosting us!

The location was amazing, in walking distance to transport, the beautiful Lincoln park, and other areas of Chicago. We enjoyed spending our evenings in the old town.
The apartment was so spacious! And amenities provided were just what we needed. A perfect stay, thank you Celiane
Very easy to reserve. Easy to get to restaurants, sight seeing. Excellent place to stay all around. Could not have asked for better!

This rental exceeded expectations! Comfy beds with clean bathrooms and kitchen. Our family of 5 had plenty of room to spread out. The building was easy to get into, in the middle of a super cute neighborhood. We would definitely stay again!
Clean, convenient, and great location.

We had a wonderful stay at Ketan's!  The accommodations were beautiful--clean, modern, large open living space, spacious bedrooms, and every convenience imaginable.  The location was perfect, too.  Ketan was super quick to respond to any questions we had.  We would love to stay here again the next time we go to Chicago!

Loved this hidden gem! It is clean, cozy, and has everything you need for a short trip. I enjoyed staying in for a couple of hours and taking advantage of the books and amenities of the place. Host was very welcoming and responsive. We will be staying again!
Very clean and great location. Would recommend to others.

The location and place were perfect for our needs! We really enjoyed walking around the neighborhood and exploring Chicago. We had a group of 4 people (parents and two kids) and the place worked really well.
Great experience for a small town boy in the city!

This was a great stay! It was easy for us to find. The instructions and communication was clear and easy. The hosts were quick to respond when messaged.  The place looks like the pictures. One bed is softer than the other. The ac works great which we were grateful for in late July. It's very easy to get around. You are only 10 min walk to the Brown line which bri g you right downtown or to the other L trains to get wherever you may want to go. The red train brings you to the sox as well as the cubs game as well and was a quick transfer from the brown line. We didn't even use our car once the 4 days we were there. We left it parked on Western Ave. For free☺️ I would definitely stay again!!

We loved this place! Super clean and right in the heart of the neighborhood. It was great to have a garage to park in and not have to worry about parking. 2 full bathrooms was awesome for 5 of us traveling. Everything was cleans comfy. We would definitely stay again.
Great accommodations, very spacious and clean. Easy walk to Wrigley Field which was our main reason for rental in that area. Great communications and instructions. Would definitely rent again.
Extremely accommodating! Extremely clean! Very thoughtful with the snacks. 10/10 would book again.

This is a great place in a GREAT location.  Very clean apartment, and very inviting.  Kim is a great host and gave very clear instructions.  Looking forward to staying here again on my next trip to Chicago.

Great little unit. Very clean.  Beautiful decor. It's about .5 miles from the blue line stop (Chicago). Super easy to get into downtown area from Anny's place. It's a long commute if you're in town for a Cubs game. I would definitely stay there again.

Laura is the perfect host and the accommodation was exactly what we needed. Clean, comfortable and very well located for exploring Logan and Wicker Parks. Close to the Blue L made travel to downtown simple. The nearby train line added some background noise, the provided earplugs sorted that perfectly.
Will stay here again if we visit Chicago in the future.

Wichtig zu wissen: die Klimaanlage ist für das gesamte Haus zu steuern und es gibt keine Möglichkeit sie für einzelne Zimmer zu steuern. Es war in den Nächten extrem kalt (haben mit Pullover und 2 Decken geschlafen).

Really enjoyed my stay! Very convenient location and short (3 minutes carrying luggage) walk to the door off the nearby Blue Line stop. Proactive communication with Owner with clear, straightforward and unfussy check-in/check-out instructions. Place was very clean with fresh linens and clean bathroom/kitchen areas. Lots of restaurants, coffee shops and great scenery within walking distance (Daisies, Four Letter Word Coffee, Lula, and Middle Brow all recommended). All-around excellent…would stay here again!
Highly recommended! Groovy apartment in a great location, close to the train and PARKING!!! Would definitely stay again.
Thank you for having us, everything was amazing!
Great host! Great property! Great location! Very responsive every time I reached out. Thank you!

Very welcoming and comfortable home with wonderfully soft towels and thoughtful touches throughout. The location was perfect, an easy walk to the field and nearby restaurants. The neighborhood felt safe and beautiful, and the owners were incredibly responsive and helpful.
We enjoyed the unit, although parking was a challenge.

Todo excelente, el único detalle es que en varias ocasiones encontramos un chico bajo los efectos de sustancias nocivas en la entrada y era
Agresivo, lo que incomodaba la llegada al edificio

Odi is incredibly responsive, welcoming, and very helpful. We had some issues with the door, but he is always quick to reply and help out. We went for 5 days for my son’s fourth birthday and had a great time. Drivable distance from all touristy things and the house is amazing. Can’t wait to visit again.
Wonderful location within walking distance to everything needed. Nice and quiet with lots of nice restaurants near by. Parking was easy to find.
We had a great stay.  Beautiful street, very walkable, easy to find parking.  Home was exactly as described, clean and quiet.  We would stay here again.

Helen’s place was easy to find, very clean and the bed was very comfortable.  Bus stop just outside and convenient for visiting the local attractions. We enjoyed our stay and would book again if we visit Chicago in the future.

What a great place to spend a few days. Stayed here with my husband and our two kids, to show them our old stomping grounds before moving out of town.. this was a great spot, and a pool in Logan square?! Unheard of, and having Haas park and the soccer field right there was also wonderful. Thanks so much, we’ll be back!

It is easy to connect to city centre but parking at the streets bit challenging. Have to take off the car 9-11 am week days. So practically will need to check out by 9 am instead 11 am. It may be ok during weekends.

We enjoyed our stay. We picked Michael’s place for the easy El access and really appreciated the quick walk. We used to live in Chicago, so the train noise definitely didn’t bother us (part of the charm!).
There were lots of small details that the hosts provided for comfort, which was lovely.
Common building areas were pretty dirty, which the hosts had mentioned ahead of time may be the case, but the apartment itself was clean and nice.

Really friendly and accommodating hosts. The place has some truly lovely appliances, even better than many hotels. Close to bus stations and easy to get around. On top of everything it is very affordable. Will come back if I need to stay in Hyde Park again.

This conveniently located and well
appointed apartment was just as shown in the photos. The friendly, quick, and easy communication was helpful, and the garage parking was a bonus. I will definitely check to see if this apartment is available the next time I am in Chicago, and recommend it to others.

Darina’s place was wonderful. It was clean and comfortable, just as described. She responded quickly when we needed help. We got there early and were able to check in. From her place it was easy to get into the city and other suburbs of Chicago. Great place for our family of 6.

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was very clean, quiet, and comfortable. The beds were especially comfy, and we slept well every night. Everything was well maintained, and it was a relaxing place to stay. We’d definitely recommend it to others and would be happy to stay here again!

This was a very nice place to stay. Photos are accurate. Great space for large groups or families. More privacy than your everyday hotel. We had a great experience and the host communicated in a timely manner with any questions that arose. Thank you!

Loved the place. Was in the perfect location, able to walk everywhere I wanted to go.
The place was quiet and homey. Enjoyed my stay, home away from home.

Land Lord special.
It’s a decent place to lay your head, good for short stays!
Great place!

Dieses Apartment ist sehr geschmackvoll, modern und gemütlich eingerichtet. Wir haben uns auf Anhieb sehr wohl gefühlt.
Die Badezimmer sind der Hit und laden zum Entspannen ein. Die Küche ist mit tollen Geräten ausgestattet und tip top sauber. Kaffee aus dem Kaffeevollautomat, Salz&Pfeffer, Öl usw. wurden bereitgestellt. Der Esstisch wurde voll eingedeckt und sah einfach wunderschön und einladend aus. Wir fühlten uns wie bei Freunden “eingeladen” mit der schön gedeckten Tafel inkl. Wein und paar Snacks.
Die Kommunikation mit dem host war perfekt. Rundum schöner Aufenthalt 👍

Came to Chicago from out of state to see a concert at the United Center. Quick drive there and back. Location is great- quick walk to plenty of diverse restaurants. We tried the Breakfast House and Forbidden Root, both were excellent.
The loft was exactly what we needed. It was clean and host instructions were clear. Ended up not even turning the beautiful TV on because we were having so much fun playing ping pong!
Recommend any locals or out of towners like myself to give this place a shot!

Very good location for getting around city if you are using public transit. Very convenient to have a dedicated parking spot off the street. The building is quiet as far as other tenants and secure with coded entry. You will hear the train, so if that bothers you this is not a good choice. The apartment was clean, but was not well stocked. No TP in one bathroom and a limited amount in the other, no paper towel, or tissues. TV is a Roku and would not connect to streaming service - error message that internet signal was not strong enough. Rental is via a company, not an individual host. We probably could have tried to reach out but it did feel impersonal. Also did not like that a requirement was to put down a security deposit via an app other than Airbnb. I was assured after contacting customer service that this was legitimate and allowed but personally don't like being redirected to use an app outside of Airbnb due to concerns about losing the protection that staying in the app provides

We enjoyed our stay. The home was very clean and located in a nice, quiet neighborhood. The only thing future guests should be aware of is the strict visitor policy. The host was kind enough to approve a limited number of visitors, which we appreciated, but because we were in town visiting family, it made gathering together more difficult than we anticipated. If you plan to have friends or family stop by during your stay, it’s worth discussing the policy with the host before booking.

This was a very cozy Airbnb. Sylvia has every amenity you can think of available to use. It is very clean and neat and the beds are very comfortable! The directions to get in from the front or back doors were excellent.  There is a garage to use and we were able to fit our Toyota Sequoia in it. There is a bit of street noise at night, but Sylvia provides you with sound machines and earplugs if needed. The air-conditioning and ceiling fans work perfectly.  Sylvia is a great host.
Great location. Lots of space. Very clean. Would definitely book again next time we are in town.
We had a great time at James place! Easy walk to everything we had planned. Beds were comfortable and the place was clean. We will be sure to stay here again in the future!
El lugar está bien ubicado, las camas son muy cómodas y la atención excelente !

It was absolutely worth the price and we would use them again. My husband described it as tony. We rented the space because of its proximity to the United Center. We went to the Rush concert, which was a bucket list check-off, so we wanted it to be special and it was. As an added bonus, it’s within walking distance of the venue. We had no questions or needs, so we did not contact the hosts. We did however, feel that we could have at any time and they would have helped us. We went with four people total, but it would accommodate more people than that .
Seriously, we loved everything about this place.
As advertised. Easy.
Responsive hosts, super walkable from union station and the red line. Felt super safe staying here on a girls trip!
Great spot. Great neighborhood. Easy to find parking. Patio is super cool, especially at night. Great city view! The bar downstairs is cool too.
Great location!

We stayed with our two children and this place was wonderful! Exactly as described and clean and peaceful. We enjoyed the board games and the access was easy, parking included was amazing, and tv was easy to use all great for our family!
Beds were comfy and place was very very clean!
I appreciated the warning about the dogs next door!
Was nice to have a peaceful space close to the highway, thank you for a wonderful family friendly stay! Would stay again!

Easy to book, find, stay, enjoy, checkout.
Not much to say, but that is a good thing if you know me.
Great place to stay and quick drive into the city! No complaints!

Our stay at David’s apartment was wonderful. He is a fantastic host and has thought of everything to make the apartment a perfect home away from home. The location is great, beds and sofa are super comfortable, and the kitchen is well equipped. Highly recommend.
Place was exactly as described. Friendly staff. Easy to navigate and walkable.

This location is close to everything. We didn't drive our car once the entire trip. Tara's place is within walking distance to restaurants, breweries, and the CTA system. We easily made our way downtown, around the neighborhood, and to a Cubs game.

Great stay! Will be back! Close to the beach, pier and family friendly parks.
Lots of space - felt right at home. Hosts were responsive, prompt and attentive.
Great place. Even better than the pictures. The only place I’ll stay in Chicago when visiting
Great neighborhood plenty of places to eat and drink, very walkable, small place but all we need is a place to sleep and shower. Kimberly was so friendly and responsive

We had a wonderful stay at this location and house had all supplies needed for our stay including spices and breakfast essentials...super close to the Damen station which made our travel smooth and never took our car throughout the trip...thanks so much for hosting us Blanca
Great location, great hosts, fun stay! Would totally go back again.
Latrells place was nice and very peaceful. She was very understanding and polite. Great place to stay and close to a lot of things. You won't be disappointed.
Great place and great location. Convenient to the city and convenient to the suburbs. Griffin  Museum close by and very close to University of Chicago. We'd stay again in a heartbeat!

We had a great stay at Jevaux’s place. We were a bit nervous about the location knowing that it was on the south side of Chicago. However, we felt perfectly safe throughout the whole trip. Check in was super easy, the host was very responsive, and everything in the apartment was perfect. It was way more spacious than we expected. While it was 30 minutes to an hour to get anywhere from the apartment by train, it was only a 15-20 minute drive to the city depending on traffic. We never had trouble finding a parking spot right in front of our apartment building. There is a nice lake trail in front of it as well with lots of people out walking/running/biking. There is building security and multiple locked doors before you can get into the apartment. This also made us feel very safe. This apartment was more than we could’ve asked for during our 3-night Chicago stay! If you are hesitant to book for any reason, just do it! You will not regret it!

Great host - very responsive. The place was so charming, clean, and comfortable. We felt right at home. We felt safe as well and loved that there was an ice cream place right across the street. Definitely recommend and would stay here again.

Had a really great stay here. The hosts are really friendly and responsive. Their house is so beautiful and modern.
The little Airbnb suite downstairs is private and has everything you need, even healthy snacks! I appreciated the hair dryer and iron that was provided. I had a really nice sleep in the comfortable bed.
Will definitely return if my travels bring me back to Chicago!
Great stay! Jorge was very professional and communicative! Would highly recommend!

Excellent location, conveniently near the Fullerton L station and within walking distance of several great areas on the North Side with lots to do. Keep in mind you are staying in someone’s actual home while they’re there, so privacy is mainly kept to the bedroom. They do have three cats who are very sweet and cute. Jen and Dan keep a quiet home, but since they are right by the CTA station, the train noise can take a bit of getting used to, especially at night. I’d highly recommend this for a busy solo traveler spending 1-2 nights in Chicago. If you’re okay with sacrificing a little personal space for convenience and location, it’s a really great spot.

Myself and a group of old friends rented David's place as a landing spot for our trip to see the Detroit Tigers at Wrigley Field. Whether we were from Detroit or anywhere else, staying at David's place made us feel like we lived right there in Chicago. The neighborhood is a beautiful, walkable, little enclave on the north side. For baseball fans, the walk to Wrigley is so convenient we literally saw "Wrigley Premium Parking" signs just around the corner, but our parking spot at David's was included with the price! Add that to 5 individual beds for 5 adult men, and the place was everything we could have wished for on our trip to the Windy City. Great communication throughout, and everything was beyond expectation. I'm already getting asked when we can come back. Thanks for a great experience!
A perfect place that’s ideally located for easy transit around the city

Victor was very responsive to any question we had during our visit.  We needed a 9x13 pan for a casserole. Victor sent one to us within the hour. Not expected but was very appreciative.  Would highly recommend.
The hosts were very helpful and responsive. Instructions were clear and everything was easy to find. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Milan is always a wonderful host. He and his partners always take good care of the guest. This is my third time staying there and it is always a great experience. For this particular space, the only downside was I could hear the neighbors during the day but at night it was peaceful. Wonderful accommodations and easy to get to and from McCormick and restaurants.
I strongly recommend Milan and I will be staying there again next year.
Really a comfortable place for me to stay, everything was simple and accommodated me well! Great host
They were very nice and very welcoming! Felt like we had known them for years even though we had just met them! Great area, close to the CTA train
Great location close to downtown Chicago. Lots of walkable restaurants and entertainment. We really enjoyed our short stay and the very helpful/accommodating host. Thank you!
Great spot in the heart of River North neighborhood! Everything was walkable, great restaurants and attractions. The host was communicative and helpful. Would absolutely recommend!

Our stay at Latasha's was perfect! We had everything we needed and more to enjoy a stress-free week in Chicago.  Latasha was helpful, attentive, and responsive from day one, and it made for a very smooth experience. The space itself was so lovely; we felt right at home, and we really liked the decor. There was plenty of room for me, my sister, and my niece (who especially appreciated the large screen TV). Great location, with grocery stores and restaurants within walking distance, and easy access to buses and the train station. The neighborhood was really nice and calm, and we ran into some friendly neighbors from time to time. Overall, we had a very comfortable and welcoming stay. Thank you so much, Latasha!

Perfect setting and absolutely wonderful hosts. The location was exactly what we wanted with everything we needed to connect to all the things we love about Chicago. The hosts were so helpful and pointed us to great places with immediate responses. Loved them both!

Superb location for a group! Walkable to Millennium and Grant Parks, museums, River North area. Accessible to public transportation. Space was comfortable and the common roof space was perfect! Hosts were prompt in response to messages and super helpful. Would stay here again!

This place is in a great location for exploring Chicago. Walkable to many places and very close to a subway station.
Ensavi was a great host, reaching out to to make sure we checked in okay and everything was as expected.
Great host and location
Outstanding experience, very comfortable. You cannot find a better location for taking in a Cubs game. Close to "L". Kitchen is well appointed.

We enjoyed our stay at this location! If we travel to the area again, we would love to stay in this spot or another by this host. The place was easy to find, beautifully decorated, great amenities, and a very easy walk to Wrigley! Highly recommend!
Amazing host

Nice neighborhood. Easy access to the train for commute. Cozy lil space for a family. Loved the games to keep the kids entertained. Mary was very friendly and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay again.

Die Unterkunft war stilvoll eingerichtet und sauber. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und haben noch ein paar gute Empfehlungen für Chicago bekommen. Auf Fragen haben Axel und Amanda zügig geantwortet.
Absolutely perfect week for us! Cubs, food, wonderful community to make friends and connect!

We absolutely loved Jeffrey's place! It was perfect for our family vacation in a Chicago. The house was a quick walk to subway or bus line. Quiet and friendly neighborhood! House was clean and had all the necessary supplies when away from home. Jeffrey  was also super responsive. Highly recommend!

Great value. Derek is a super nice host. Location is great. I strongly recommend staying at Derek's Airbnb.
And if you want to chat with Derek, Derek is a wealth of knowledge and fun to chat with
Our stay was relaxing and the apartment suited our needs very well!

Location was great. Host was responsive. Apartment needs some TLC. Toilet doesn't flush anything down, needs could be more comfortable, and the smaller room is warm. Water stains on the ceiling. Rooftop was a great place to hang out. Great views with comfortable seating.
Thank you for a great stay!
Great place, great location.

Pros-The host- Vic was pleasant, responsive and very easy to contact Inside is as pictured, good sized rooms, bathrooms were as shown, all amenities were as descrbed. Cons- Floors were creaky. broken shades, stains on pillows and comforter. Smelled of fish and refrigerator smelled bad. It was ok. Outside entrance was sketchy. Unkempt yard, broken glass on side walk. Maybe I should have looked into the surrounding area more before booking.

This was a great spot for our family of 5. The kids enjoyed the game room. I liked the dual living areas.
The kitchen was well stocked with plates and utensils and we had plenty paper products, soap, dishwasher and laundry detergent.
We had just enough linens and towels. I washed them throughout our stay. The washer and dryer worked great.
The location was better than I expected. We walked to China town and were a short Uber ride to attractions.
This is overall a great space for a family to have enough space to spread out and an opportunity for in unit entertainment.

El alojamiento, es tranquilo. Esta cerca de los atractivos turísticos de la ciudad. Tenes acceso a transporte publico, muy cerca. Es un barrio de mucha gente latina, así que como hablo español, me sentí muy a gusto en este barrio
The hosts are super responsive, proactive and kind. I felt right at home here and so grateful to them for accommodating me.
