Great proximity to the red line and the beach.  Hosts communicate proactively. Great guide book for additional tips about the location.
Family had a great time!!

Afsha was very welcoming and proactive with the booking, which took a lot of questions out of the air upfront. We felt very at home and were able to decompress in peace after a very long flight to Chicago. Great stay!

I will definitely stay here again, perfect for us and our guest.  There are stairs, not a problem for us but all bedrooms on 2nd and 3rd floor.  This is a beautiful old home, on a beautiful street, so easy to enjoy the neighborhood and restaurants on the nearby corner!
Always a great time. Very clean. Great space. Great location.  Josh is an amazing host.

Nicky was great and the place was wonderful.
The location was extremely walkable and we enjoyed it thoroughly.
Would stay again if she’d have us.

The only complaint during my stay was the lack of cleanliness in the first room we were given, but Freehand willingly moved my friend and I into a cleaner room that only suffered a few stains on the curtains by the beds. Despite not being the cleanest or most spacious spot, it was convenient, had its own unique vibe, and the hosts were helpful at all hours!

Matthew was such a great host last year that we came back again! Despite a few hiccups on this trip with the lock and fridge, Matthew's communication and generosity meant that every problem got quickly solved. And the house is still a gem! Thanks again.
Excellent stay, travelled with a couple of friends from the UK. Great location, everything you needed inside the property. A short bus ride to downtown, highly recommended 👌

Location was easy to find, and the property was very secure- the private parking spot in the back was a bonus!
The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and cute. It was so nice to relax in the soaking tub or by the fireplace after a busy day exploring the city. We would definitely stay at one of their properties again the next time we visit Chicago!
Fantastic stay, easy instructions, beautiful place and very walkable to everywhere we wanted to go. Would definitely stay again!
Terrific location, beautiful views from the 26th floor, wonderful local neighborhood in a big city.  Couldn't have been a better escape.
Nos encanto ! Y la atención fue 100/100

We stayed for an extended family trip to see the Cubs game. The house exceeded our expectations with so much space and lots of bed options! It was nicely decorated, 3 fully stocked kitchens, lots of sitting and visiting areas and so many details, even down to the earplugs in the room closest to the train. Our kids loved it and there was so much space for epic hide and seek games to keep them entertained! The arrival and parking instructions were so clear and helpful and the location to Wrigley was great for a short walk and the train quite literally is next door. Some in our party felt distracted with the train noise but most of us didn’t even notice it after a bit. It was a great place to stay and would 10/10 recommend!
Very easy to find! Great location next to the train. Would definitely stay here again.
This place was worth the price and then some! It was an excellent place to stay!
Great place for a larger group! The location was ideal for all that we wanted to experience in Lincoln Park. Easy in and out process. Nice neighborhood

very cute, airy and open, spacious,  little home with just the right amount of things to make it very suitable for a week or longer stay. lovely neighborhood, perfect for strolling after the heat of the day dies down. the little backyard has seating to enjoy a quiet morning coffee, and of course the hottub is perfect for relaxing in at the end of the day.  Def recommend, when i visit Chicago i hope I'm able to book here again.

We loved the location of this apartment. It was a block away from the train and offered a quiet neighborhood. The proximity to the train was not an issue, there was a sound machine provided to the apartment and we both slept straight through the night. I’m not sure the description specified it was on the third story with only stairs to go up, it was a non-issue for us but may not be the right accommodation for someone who can’t go up stairs.

Janet’s place is our favorite home away from home when we are in Chicago. We love the quiet neighborhood, easy parking, walkable location to parks and restaurants.
The property is very clean and comfortable with great amenities.
Janet is responsive and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay.

The apartment was perfect for a few days exploring the city. It was extremely clean, tidy and exactly like the photos. There was plenty of space in the apartment and loads of storage for suitcases. Our host was very responsive to messages with my multiple questions. We will definitely book again for our next trip to Chicago.

Everything was as pictured and was what we expected. The location was very convenient for us as we wanted to visit North Park University and we wanted to be able to walk to the L train. It is a nice quiet neighborhood. We did find that the people living directly above were noisy well after the stated 10:00 pm quiet hours.
Our host seemed very eager to help us with any issues but there just weren't any :) The apartment was clean and comfortable. Easy parking & easy to find. I would stay again for sure!
Great place in a great neighborhood with a great price
Nice "studio" feel .   Was in the heart of the neighborhood.   On main street and had some traffic noise,ect.  We had no issues with parking.
This is a great place to stay in a great walkable neighborhood.  Penelope was very responsive and helpful.

Diana’s place was great for our family of 4 for a quick trip to Chicago.  The neighborhood was walkable to a great bakery ( Hearts and Flour) and Vicky’s restaurant.  Her place was so clean, safe, the beds were comfortable and the neighborhood was great!  Diana was so helpful with any questions and very quick to respond.  We would DEFINITELY stay there again.!

If you find yourselves in need of Chicago digs, absolutely book this place. The apartment was spacious and light-filled, clean, and as pictured in the listing. Josh and Jordan were incredibly communicative and checked in several times during my stay to make sure all was well and to ask if I needed anything. Check-in was extremely easy with the clear and concise instructions provided. The apartment is only a couple of blocks from the brown line and convenient to both the Ravenswood Metra station and Wrigley. Highly recommend!
Great and responsive host with clear instructions!
Nice place, less than 5 minutes to CTA green line. 5 minutes from Griffin museum and Obama’s library.

Rhett’s place is spotless, modern, sleek and stylish, with high ceilings and lots of natural light. At the same time, it’s inviting, filled with comfortable furnishings, and a nicely curated collection of paintings, books, and photography. It also boasts a spacious, rare-for-Chicago outdoor space.
You’ll be close to the “L”, shopping, fun bars, and highly-rated restaurants — all in a great neighborhood that’s within walking distance of other great neighborhoods.
Bonus: Rhett is a very nice guy and an accommodating host, and communication was spot-on. Happy to give five stars to him and his beautiful home.

Excellent host, effective communicator, kept me up to date on everything, apartment was exactly as described, nice location, quiet, close to public transportation access. Would definitely stay again if I come back to Chicago.
Adresa was very responsive and helpful with questions. Room was clean.

I had a great stay. Janet was really communicative and helpful, online and in person. The room and bathroom were nice (small but not too small), and Janet had cleaned and prepared them well before I arrived.

We had a wonderful stay and Lokesh was very kind!!! We checked in a bit later in the day and had no issues. The place was very clean and cute!! Also the neighborhood was adorable and a bus stop was close by. Thank you Lokesh!!
Recommend

Die Wohnung ist ideal für Familien und bestens ausgestattet – es war wirklich alles vorhanden, was man für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt braucht.
Die Lage ist ebenfalls super: Der Bus 66 hält direkt um die Ecke und fährt bequem bis zum Navy Pier. In der Umgebung gibt es viele nette Cafés und Restaurants zum Frühstücken, und die Gegend ist ruhig und angenehm. Uber war jederzeit problemlos verfügbar, und auch das Parken war unkompliziert.
Insgesamt hatten wir einen tollen Aufenthalt und können die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

Super cute place in a great location. We brought our dog and the walking trails all around were perfect for him. Kim gave us some great suggestions. Also, we loved Andersonville for shopping and restaurants. The mediterranean restaurant called Fiya was delicious. Will definitely return.
This was a great flat in a really nice part of the city. The neighborhood was great.

We had an excellent stay! The space was incredibly spacious, comfortable, and perfect for our team traveling together for a trade show. The location was a major advantage, with McCormick Place just a short distance away, which made getting to and from the event extremely convenient. There was plenty of room for everyone to relax, work, and recharge after long exhibition days. A fantastic choice for business travelers or teams attending events in Chicago. We would absolutely stay here again!

Great stay right in the heart of Chicago — the place was spotless and matched the listing photos exactly, no surprises at check-in. Loved the neighborhood too: quiet enough to sleep well, but walking distance to some really solid restaurants. We were in town for the Rush shows at United Center and this made for the perfect home base. Would absolutely book again.

Cindy’s place was perfect, we were very comfortable, the industrial style space was very cool and very Chicago style, being on the Main Street was super ideal and in the middle of wicker park it was perfection!
I was in town on business,  and this was close enough for an easy Uber ride to my office.  Amelia's place feels freshly painted and new!

The space was great! Clean and neat, well supplied, quiet and comfortable! Owners are great and very helpful! The taco place nextdoor is really good and open 24hrs!! Close to the united center if you are coming for a show. I would stay again and recommend to a friend!
The only negatives I have are: 1) parking is on the street only and for us it was difficult to find spots! Be prepared to carry your things across a busy street to the door, or farther depending on where you find to park. I recommend temporarily using the lot for the Mexican restaurant to unload, then go find parking.
2) it is an older building and the stairs up to the apartment are steep. If anyone has difficulty walking stairs, this is a challenge. Not the owners fault, just an observation.
Whole experience was great!
Great location, walkable nice neighborhood, wonderful place, nice kitchen, clean bathrooms and overall well kept and maintained.

We loved Vin’s place, and would definitely stay there again when visiting Chicago. It’s perfectly located between two fun walkable areas, but the street itself is fairly quiet & feels very safe. The apartment was bigger than we expected, and the bed and linens were so cozy! Great space & nicely decorated, too.

We had a great stay! The home was clean with comfortable beds and great amenities. We loved how close it was to the L, shops and city life!
We would definitely stay again.

The air bnb was perfect for my family. The game room was a hit, the movie theatre and movie chairs were perfect. I will gladly stay here again every year with my family. Ray was also very responsive with any questions or concerns I had.

LOVEDDDDD Ro’s place! Everything about the home was perfect. Def recommend, close to the train station and a walkable area surrounded by restaurants. Felt extremely safe and neighborhood was very quiet and nice. Worth it 100!

Highly recomend.  Host is incredibly responsive, helpful, and proactive.  Space is clean and updated, with a large kitchen island, comfortable queen bed with attached private full bath and comfortable king bed with attached private full bath.  All pictures arecaccurate.  Will stay here again when I am in Chicago.

The inside of the apartment was nice and decent. It is what it is for the cost. But the building itself, Jesus Christ. It is dirty and stairs are not the best. Also having to go up 3 flights. Other than that the host was responsive and helpful. Just a nice apartment in a weird building lol
James was easy to work with and the house had everything we needed.

We loved Julia’s place!  It was perfect for two couples.  It was easy to find and check in was simple.  The beds were comfortable and it was well stocked with everything we needed - I especially loved the heated toilet seat!  The neighborhood felt safe and was a short walk to a great coffee shop.  We appreciated the parking permits and were able to park right out front.  Julia’s place was beautifully decorated and we felt right at home.  We would definitely recommend this cute condo!

Very nice and simple lodging that gives you a small kitchen to use and save some money on food, comfortable enough bed, decent sized restroom. The kitchen unfortunately had non-stick cookware that was scratched making it unsafe to use (we just covered with aluminum foil) and some of the utensils had fingerprints and smudges on them. But it was easy enough to clean everything ourselves before using. The area is right by the Blue line making travel easy, and there’s a decent coffee shop and a really cool Asian market within walking distance as well as a local frozen gelato place and a CVS if you need anything. Would definitely stay here again if visiting the area again.

Great place to stay! Clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. We'd happily stay here again and would definitely recommend it to others.
Super recomendado ! El departamento 10 de 10 tal y como lo describe la publicación. Estábamos muy contentos con todo lo de la estadía .
Came into the city with some friends for a couple days to go to a show at the United center and a Cubs game. It was perfect. Comfortable, convenient, and just a very pleasant place to stay.
Great place

The host was very responsive -and super quick with his responses. The stay could not have been any better.  The train is close but it does not disrupt.  We will definitely recommend this stay to our friends.  We will go again.  It was absolutely wonderful.

Overall stay was ok, but here is some things
1. Need to replace beds and mattresses, beds are not stable and mattress are cheap spring mattresses.
2. Should have double curtains, one with black out curtains in living room as well as bedrooms
3. Air conditioners were not cooling enough
4. I see old shampoo, conditioners, body was bottles, you should put new ones after every guest.
5. Floor were creeping loud when we walk over it, consider fixing/upgrading.
6. neighbourhood crime rate was pretty high that you cannot do anything about it.
7. It is actually 1.5 bedroom apartment because of half bed in one bedroom
We loved our stay here! The apartment is warm and cozy, with all the amenities you need! This is also the cleanest Airbnb I've ever stayed at. thank you for a lovely stay!

Perfect for the price, and worked out great for the evening in town with my daughter. The atmosphere was calm, peaceful, not what you'd expect when u think of Chicago. Host was respectful and responsive. Thank you once again.

My stay with Anastasia was perfect! The Airbnb was exactly as it was described. It was comfortable, clean, and cozy. It couldn’t have been better! Anastasia is extremely friendly and quick to respond and flexible and understanding! Would absolutely book again!

This place was just as described and great for my family’s stay while in the Windy City! We loved how close it was to restaurants and parks for my little one. The beds were cozy and two full bathrooms were great for us all to have! Our host was kind and very responsive and we were so appreciative of the space we stayed in. Definitely recommend this spot for others.
Very nice apartment, love the aesthetic. Close to downtown and very easy check-in process.

We felt right at home in this peaceful, cozy space. The home was walkable to the lake, multiple restaurants and shops, and the Red Line, making downtown Chicago easily accessible. The home was nicely decorated and felt calm and inviting. The beds and bedding were so comfortable. We loved the furniture, the sun rooms, the books, the musical instruments and the record player. It was such a vibe. There were plenty of towels and everything we could have needed in the kitchen. We even liked the garden and the neighborhood. The host was responsive and kind. We loved Chicago, and did so much during our stay. Thank you for providing a safe, clean,  peaceful place to land.

This definitely sticks to the 'simple' rating: small bedroom, but comfortable; the basics in the kitchen, though there's good places to eat out around. You'll want to explore those as there's VERY little furniture in the apartment on which to sit.
Definitely recommend bringing a sleep mask, as the back yard & alley lights can shine and may give difficulty to light sleepers.
This super clean spot is surrounded by great restaurant and bars in a lovely neighborhood. Easy access to the blue line made getting downtown very easy.

We have an annual trip and our usual place is no longer available, so we
took a chance and we all loved it(11 of us) From 9 to 80 years old. We had a couple of issues and Hymie was very quick to respond. We are hoping to make this our new 'annual trip location'.
Great place to stay and very communicative
The place was amazing and the host was just as pleasant. Couldn’t have had a better last minute stay in Chicago would recommend 10/10!!
Great place to stay. We have older children. Lots of  room and a nice neighborhood!

A perfect place to stay for baseball weekend at Wrigley. We were very happy with the accommodations. Clean and just a really cool space. Got our moneys worth with the ping pong table. We appreciated the proactive responses and just the overall experience of staying here. Would be thrilled to do it again in the future!
Great space.  Great location.  Would stay again.
Wont be returning. The AC didnt work and the bed was one of the worst mattresses Ive ever slept on
Great location! Easy access, comfy beds and linens! Very clean. Internet was a little quirky, but Demitri was quick to respond and help!!

We had a blast! Anthony is super responsive, friendly and helpful.
The house looks as pictured, it's decorated really fun. Yes, it's dated, which gives it charm, shows the history of Chicago!
Had all the basic things we needed. Fence in front and back, cameras, ring doorbell, we felt very safe. Don't let the neighborhood make you blink. Very friendly neighbors!
The back yard was amazing! Privacy, TV, furniture, pool table, we had fun.
If we're ever back in Chicago, we'll be making sure to see if his home is available again!
Clear instructions, clean area, as well as answering questions and concerns readily!
Very clean space in a very walkable area

great place neara green and pink line. easy to get downtown. great communications.
maybe some Coffee for guests. nearest coffe brewer isn't close.
had a great stay
Five stars, great apartment, great area.
Great stay. Convenient and walkable location for a Cubs game. Nice kitchen but if you are planning on cooking bring your own oils and spices. Salt and pepper was provided. Garage was nice.

Perfect for our multi-family trip to Chicago! So many good things to say about our stay. The home was welcoming, clean and spacious. Parking was easy with a large vehicle and the neighborhood was safe (we left our overhead and trailer luggage boxes with items inside locked up on the street multiple nights with no issues). We had plenty of space in the home for our group with kids, the rooftop was definitely a bonus area for them to play. Our hosts were great at communicating with us and we had privacy in the shared building. Easy access to the interstate made it ideal to get to our activities in & around downtown by car. Overall great experience with Chux as a host!
Great location! Felt right at home.
A very enjoyable stay

Good location. Walkable or easy to use public transportation for most places! There is a parking garage across the street and spothero was recommended and easy to use! The shower was a little tricky at first but thats just a quirk of an older building! Felt safe in the area as 2 women.

Place was as described, was very clean, the host answered questions promptly. We had problem with the blinds which was addressed promptly. Parking can be a problem given the location, suggest getting the parking slot provided by the host. Bathrooms were excellent and large for the apartment. Apartment was very secure, has controlled access. Concierge service bring up stuff we order. Views from the terrace were 10/10.
Wow! The location is incredible and everything was within a 5 or 10 minute walk. Beautiful place to stay and they went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed.
Great location, very well equiped apartment. Great view, we had a great time.

Our stay had a few significant issues that impacted our experience, though the location itself was quite convenient. The room was uncomfortably hot throughout our visit, even with the window air conditioning unit running constantly. It struggled to cool the space, making it difficult to relax. Additionally, the oven was completely non-functional, which was a real disappointment. We had planned to cook some meals and ended up wasting money on groceries that we couldn't prepare. We hope these issues can be addressed for future guests.

Good location, very walkable to everything in downtown and the loop.
Although situated close to a lively bar area, the area felt safe and the noise was scarcely noticeable. Earplugs were provided but we definitely didnt need them.
Comfy beds, and a quirky but nice apartment which was better value than many hotel rooms etc in the area.

We loved staying at Charlotte’s place. The bed is so comfortable and her place is very clean! We walked to Wrigley and enjoyed checking out the shops nearby. We felt safe and loved the local feel! We will be back!

By far the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed, spacious, modern, clean, quiet neighborhood, close to highway, the fact that I have already submitted a request for my next visit before I even checked out with current reservations, says how much I appreciate this place and the owner.
Have stayed here before and have enjoyed each visit. Felt right at home; walkable, calm, close to Archer, grocery store, and laundromat. Fantastic location and room!

Had an awesome stay at Aitor’s place ! Very clean and responsive host and helped with local recommendations 😊 the only thing I would personally change is if you’re someone who likes to sleep with a fan (me) bring one with !! Other than that I would definitely book again!

I genuinely enjoyed my nights staying at Gogo’s airbnb. It was a nice, clean, quiet, top floor studio. Everything was nicely stocked and the building was located in a peaceful area. Many nearby restaurants and a nice laundromat right around the corner. Thank you for having me Gogo! I’d definitely stay again!
Great place. Close to Wrigley. Close to the train. Many restaurants.
Great place! Would definitely rent again if we are ever in the area again.
It was as expected. I had a last minute change and this is not the place I scheduled for, but it was not bad.

Do not stay here. The previous reviews and high-rating are the exact opposite of what we experienced. We didn’t last 24 hours in the home. The issues presented made us feel extremely discouraged to continue our stay there. We shared all of our notes directly with the host first in hopes that they would address the issues with compassion. Instead, the host took no accountability and instead shared images that their cleaning personnel shared with them, requested images from us(after we already opened a case with Airbnb), gave little to no attention on the fact that they gave us an incorrect address and our packages were returned or the fact that they put me in a danger. We were out less than 24 hrs after our first complaint (the night we got there), yet the host refused to refund us for our less than 24 hr stay--once again showing a lack of customer care. We booked this Airbnb for our party of 3 for very important work trip with confidence only to have an awful experience.

Luisa was a great host - we stayed for a month during a home renovation and live near by. She checked in on us and helped with any inquires we had. Her place was great and would recommend it to anyone
New places to eat are popping up in our neighborhood and it’s very close to the blue line
Adresa’s place was  great! Not far from downtown just a short ride and a 20 minute ride from Midway. Adresa was a very responsive and quick to respond. Adresa was a great host!
House was beautiful and comfortable. Hosts were very responsive and friendly.

This was perfect for our mini trip!
15 minute ride to Wrigley Field!
Very easy for us to park the car, leave it & Uber where we needed to go!
Lovely three bedroom walk up close to the university of Chicago. Well equipped with everything you need. Easy entry great communication with the hosts.
good

The place was perfect for my business trip.  Quiet neighborhood, cute place with everything you need, bed was very comfortable and the host communicated perfectly and was there to help if I needed.  Highly recommend
Comfortable spot for a brief work trip. Quiet and roomy. Nice neighborhood with lots of amenities within walking distance
The place was exactly like the pictures. Very good quality for what we paid. I would come back for sure!!

The apartment is beautiful and full of art. It’s in a great location, just a 10-minute walk from the subway. Honestly, this is one of the best places to stay when visiting Chicago, and it’s only about a 10-minute taxi ride back from downtown. Ewa is wonderful—very flexible with check-in and incredibly helpful with recommendations. If I ever come back to Chicago, I would definitely stay at her apartment again.
If you don’t want to stay right in the city this location is perfect! Parking was easy and the place was spotless.
Thank you So much Nikki for hosting me and my family everything was awesome
We arrived on Sunday after a long drive only to be locked out of our apartment. That sort of set the tone for the whole stay. Not recommended.

Fantastic place,  the pictures actually didn't do it justice,  it was much bigger than I expected.  Great place to spread out with 3 bedrooms and a large open kitchen.  We couldn't be happier with the place,  the peaceful neighborhood,  and the walkability of the area.  Rida was on top of everything quickly in the booking process.  This is one of the best places for the value that we've stayed at in the last 10 years of our travel
Place is worth it., i came from canada so., it was better for me worth the price and location

Great location!  Easy walk to Wrigley, restaurants, train, etc.  We had a lot of fun playing pinball, pool, darts and other games.  The patio area with koi pond is also very nice and relaxing.  Mark was friendly and helpful.  Highly recommend.
Great location - easy bus access to the loop, access to the lakeshore, etc. Would stay here again!
Always an amazing time here for the Cubs games! We will be back next year!

My team used this home for a 2 1/2 day work session and had a good experience. The home is very clean and newly remodeled. The beds are very comfortable and the linens clean. The dining room table upstairs is a good size and looks nice but the chairs are not comfortable. I suppose if you were only sitting in them for 30 min to eat, they'd be fine, but if you are hosting a meeting or long weekend playing games, etc., it's not super practical. The kitchen amenities are adequate if you are getting takeout to bring in. If you are making full meals, it leaves a lot to be desired - not even a baking sheet or oven mitts between two kitchens. There are a lot of random things scattered about but practical pieces seem to be missing.  Bhavish is very responsive. He let me know the cleaners were running late (an extra 1.5 hrs beyond regular check-in time). The garage is behind the house and very helpful if you have 1 or 2 small cars. Parking on the streets may be allowed but is impossible.
Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay while visiting Chicago.

Absolutely loved this place—it was exactly as described, clean, and close to attractions, restaurants, and public transportation to get to other parts of Chicago! Kristie and co-hosts reached out to provide timely, detailed instructions for check-in, recommendations for restaurants and things to do, as well as to check-in to see if we needed anything and how are stay was. If you’re visiting Chicago, I highly recommend this spot to stay.
Daniel and Jen were very communicative and their place was the perfect location. We would definitely stay here again!
You wont find a better place!   Go Cubs

Wow! Where to start?! Dan's place is perfectly described as a gem! My family of three loved our stay , and felt comfortable right away. The place looked better than the pictures , and Dan has thought of everything to make you feel right at home. The neighborhood was quiet and walkable to a lot of great places including a market and smoothie shop. We wish we had more time just to explore Lincoln Square itself. Dan was also very responsive during our stay, and we are already looking forward to planning another trip back to Chicago!
Had an amazing stay at Adresas’, prime location , walkable, responsive host. Had a great time and will definitely ecommend

Had a great stay at the Grotto.  Beds were comfy and all rooms were very clean.  Location was amazing, 2 blocks to Lakefront Park for morning walk and .9 miles to Wrigleyville for evening activities.  Lots of restaurants within a short walk.  Lincoln Park location felt very safe. Single garage VERY convenient if you’ll have a vehicle.  Will was super responsive to any questions and was a great host.  Would love to come back for another visit!
Space is spacious and host are very helpful I would book again

This was our first time visiting time visiting Chicago and both of us were really glad we chose this airbnb to stay at.
It wasn’t too far from the orange line, just a bus ride away, we unless you’re feeling ambitious enough for a walk. Really nice restaurants open late nearby and other shops as well.
The airbnb itself was clean and comfortable. Whatever you needed was most likely supplied already since the drawers were labeled and they had plenty of kitchen appliances for convenience.
10/10 stay would come again 😛
great place to stay would definitely recommend to others
We had a very comfortable stay. The place was spacious for our family of 4 and in a great location for getting around. There was free parking on the street, which was very important.

The detailed instructions were great, we found the place easily. The street parking was busy, but we didn`t have much trouble finding a spot. The room was quiet and comfortable and we appreciated having a private bath which was very clean and updated.

We came to Chicago to visit our son and take in a Cubs game. We’ve stayed at hotels in the area but decided to get an Airbnb this time. We travel quite often, and I will say that this place has been one of our favorites! It is decorated lovely and has everything you need plus some. Truly, one of the cleanest places we’ve stayed. Reed and Emily were amazing, quick to answer questions and great communicators. They even provided us with a list of fun spots to grab a drink, restaurants, and coffee shops nearby. It was the perfect area where everything was within walking distance. We were able to find parking and felt very safe. Definitely booking here again!

Thomas was great host. The place was in a good location surrounded my many walkable restaurants. Close to bus and train stations for getting in and out of the downtown area. Apartment was very clean and felt like home.
it's a great location 10 minutes from airport.
Good location! It was clean and cozy! Host was very nice and helpful!
Place is great

There was a lot we liked about this great apartment that fit our family of 5 very nicely. We really enjoyed the location--close to Downtown and walkable to lots of restaurants nearby. The apartment was kept very clean and the beds were comfortable, a/c was nice and cool. We had trouble with the main lock for the apartment door, as it ran out of batteries. While there was still an option to leave around the back alley exit, it made securing the place and coming and going a headache. We requested it to be remedied, and while we did get a quick message that it would be fixed, it was never taken care of during our stay. It was a minor detail...everything else was great, it just felt like something that should have been a priority during the stay. We'd still return and recommend it for others. Thanks!

I have no complaints! I brung my 1y/o and my 11 y/o. This place is beautiful. The view at night from my room was amazing . and near everything! The best location literally. Definitely coming back everytime I visit from now on.
We enjoyed our stay and Nicole and Todd's.   The rental was exactly as descirbed in the listing.

We had an amazing time reuniting in Chicago at Freddy's spot! There was ample room to host all 5 of us and we so enjoyed being in such a location central to the CTA. there was access to downtown but also good street parking here and it was nice to be a bit removed from the noise of downtown but also so close via CTA! the place was cozy and thoughtfully designed with a beautiful and spacious layout and kitchen!
Freddy went above and beyond to help us make our stay workout and was super communicative! We would definitely stay again!

This was the perfect place to stay for a family trip to the city! Laura’s instructions were incredibly clear and she had a very helpful .pdf with photos for reference for parking & entry. She was so wonderfully proactive in communicating with us ahead of our arrival and throughout. We loved the fresh market across the street for easy access to groceries, etc. There are some great bars, coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance (a block or two). We had a comfortable and relaxing stay!
The house is close to everything you want to do while in Chicago.   Just a few blocks from the train and a 15 minute walk to all the Michigan Ave.
Quiet spot, nice neighborhood. About 20 min walk from nearest subway station and 10 min from nearest bus stop.  The apartment was cozy, enjoyed our stay!
The house is very comfortable! Good for the family!
The place was very nice and clean. Sebastian was very responsive when I had questions. We really enjoyed a great  coffeehouse a couple doors down called Muse!
Great location.   Near trains, great restaurants, museums and a safe neighborhood.   Clean and modern apartment and modern appliances.  We would definitely stay again.

The stay was amazing! I’ll leave a pros and cons list, the cons weren’t bad enough to affect me but might affect you!
Pros:
-great area
-super comfy place
-good decor
-really easy to find
-amenities were good and usable
-the walls are pretty thick so if the person ur staying with is a bit loud it’s fine
-accessible thru bus and train
-clean and tidy, easy on the eyes
-it feels like a home rather than a sanitized temporary stay
Cons:
-can get loud at times: you can hear the train pass every so often (not too loud) and if there’s ppl upstairs you can hear them walk, also once or twice a night there’s loud motor vehicles (didn’t affect our sleep at all)
-thermostat doesn’t go under 72: totally fine for us, feels cooler than 72 most of the time anyway
-the decor is SLIGHTLY different but still has the same vibe
The place was very clean and was exactly as described. The in unit washer was amazingly helpful! Very close to some good restaurants and the train station.

Un accueil très chaleureux. Un appartement spacieux, propre, situé dans un quartier résidentiel, à très faible distance du métro... ou de la plage. Il n'y manque vraiment rien, le logement est très bien équipé ! En 2 mots, un excellent séjour pour nous.

I LOVED staying in Amanda's beautiful apartment in Hyde Park! I had never booked a shared space on Airbnb before but I'm glad I did. I immediately felt right at home - the apartment has wonderful energy and everything was squeaky clean and tidy upon arrival. The balcony is lovely, you can sit and watch the hummingbirds while you sip your morning coffee. The building is on a quiet, historical street lined with trees and flowers. There are several grocery stores within walking distance and also plenty of places to eat. Only a short walk away to stunning views of lake Michigan and places where you can swim. Walking distance to trains and/or buses! Amanda is extremely friendly and welcoming - we could have sat and talked for hours if we had the time! I will absolutely be booking this place again. It's a gem in the heart of Hyde Park!

great last minute find for me. Very close to  above ground (loop) and below grounsd subways.and bus Also walkable to many of the downtown attractions and the lake side lake, Subway runs  close to the building so if you are super noise sensitive it might not be the best fit It did not bother me much though. Perfect for one person or a couple. amenities listed more than sufficient. Patricia was an excellent communicator , Especially as she was hours from going to the labor during my last two days. (I hope it went smoothly Patricia)
We loved staying at David’s home! It was clean and very convenient. Will definitely book again when back in Chicago!

Thank you, Mr. Wonderful for providing a wonderful first Airbnb experience! Our one month stay at this Airbnb was a comfortable setting and close to UIC Hospital. There were plenty of grassy areas for dog walks. The garage was the only downside - it is a very small garage and difficult to park a car. Wonderful,  was a great host and took care of our requests and/or bnb needs!

I stayed here with two friends. Apartment is on a quiet cul de sac in Chinatown.
Clean place, easy temperature control, complimentary coffee. The 3 of us had separate bedrooms and there was virtually no noise in the house or neighborhood.
Excellent value for the price!
Excellent host. Extremely helpful and responsive. Amazing place.
I called this an oasis in the hood. Englewood is an up and coming revitalized community, super affordable and very safe at the property. The hosts are very professional, friendly and welcoming.

Dennis’ place was absolutely perfect for our visit to Chicago. Roscoe Village is such a lovely, charming and peaceful neighborhood with everything we needed close by and downtown is easily accessible by public transportation.
The balcony was a great perk-perfect for coffee in the morning with a nice breeze, even on the warmest day of our trip (July).
The free laundry perk was great as well as free and convenient parking (as noted on printed info in the apartment-be aware of street sweeping days).
Overall, everything was wonderful, comfortable (the bed was so, so comfortable!), and peaceful.
We would definitely choose to stay here again!

Absolutely beautiful accommodations in a classic Chicago Victorian home!!  Highly highly recommend.  If I could give more than 5 stars I would!  If you are looking for a place to stay in Chicago, this is an absolute gem and the hosts were very friendly and hospitable!

It was great for us to have an opportunity to spread out as a family of 5. Each of our kids was excited to have their very own room. Luckily we were all exhausted after our adventures each day and we were able to sleep through  the night despite the train, but be advised that it is noisy when that Red Line goes through regularly if that would be something that would bother you. As far as cleanliness, it wasn't pristine, but it wasn't gross either and I felt comfortable enough with my family in the space. Host was responsive to my messages.

It’s very clear that the owner/management does not put any care or love into the property they own.
Check-in was smooth and easy but when we checked into the unit it was filthy.
Vents were completely covered in dust, trash was not taken out and stunk up the unit, the “clean towels” were still moist and had debris from being washed. Additionally Smoke detecters were broken apart and not in the unit which is a huge safety concern.
Normally we don’t care for this type of stuff because we planned to spend more time in the city than an a BNB..but for the price point-the quality is completely unreasonable.
Finally the bed was insultingly uncomfortable and this is coming from someone who spent time sleeping in foxholes.
I really wanted to give this place a second chance because the check-in and area was so nice, but from reading the past reviews it’s clear nothing is gonna change.
Chicago is an amazing city, wish I could say the same about our stay at this listing!

This place was great!! The location is amazing! We took my dad to his first Cubs game and you can’t get any better than this location! Great walk to a Cubs game, stores and restaurants! The house is beautiful and Alan was very helpful! He answered all my questions and made our visit even better!
The place was exactly as described in a beautiful part of Chicago. We had an emergency and had to leave early, and our hosts were quick to respond and helpful.
Check in process is smooth and all the instructions helped and  host is very quick in responding. Overall great experience.
Bonnes prestations
Cute space and as described
Nice place great price great location and she was very responsive and helpful throughout the stay
They were the best hosts. They even bought an air purifier sent to our door because we have a baby and there was a wildfire nearby.

Spacious home, with everything you need for your stay. Kitchen was perfect for our needs, and having access to laundry was so helpful. While we didn't turn the tv on during our stay we did lounge on the couch and it was nice to relax after a long day exploring. Brittany's home was perfect for our needs and she checked in on us a few times and provided helpful recommendations and instructions for check-in/out. We were worried about finding on street parking but it wasn't an issue, we were able to park right in front of the building every day. Would stay here again :D

Die Wohnung von Juan ist sehr gemütlich und wohnlich eingerichtet und war für uns als vierköpfige Familie eine super Basis für unseren Chicago-Trip. Sie ist sehr gut ausgestattet und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants, die L-Station Kimball und diverse Bushaltestellen sind fußläufig zu erreichen (ca. 15 Minuten). Den Mietwagen konnten wir kostenlos an der Straße parken. Die Gegend ist eine eigentlich ganz hübsche, ruhig wirkende Wohnsiedlung. Wir haben uns tagsüber weitestgehend sicher gefühlt, abends waren wir aber nicht draußen. Man sollte sich bewusst sein, dass man schon so gute 40 Minuten bis in die City und zu den Hauptattraktion braucht, wenn man mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln fährt. Uns hat es nicht gestört, da es unser zweiter Besuch in der Stadt war, aber man sollte die Wohnung nicht mit der Erwartungshaltung buchen, sehr zentral zu sein.
Leider haben wir Juan nicht persönlich kennengelernt, Kontakt per Mail war aber unkompliziert und nett.

We had a great stay here during our time in Chicago. The location was excellent—perfect for exploring the city, with plenty of restaurants, shops, and attractions nearby. The apartment was spacious, comfortable, and well-equipped, making it ideal for a longer stay.
One of the highlights was the stunning views, especially in the evening. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would happily recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago.
Great spot if you want to stay in the heart of River North!
Jamal was great at communicating and making me feel safe in his space. Jamal made sure my and my friends needs were met throughout our stay.
Sparten, small but good value.

Very pretty & clean place to stay. Beds were really comfortable & there were plenty of towels & linens. There are two window air units (one in each bedroom). There is no air unit or fan in the main room (kitchen/living). The units from the 2 bedrooms cool down the front room. If you’re the first one up in the morning and there are people still sleeping (with the doors closed) it’s very warm in the main room where the sun rises.
The “private” beach they have listed is a rock beach. It’s a 10 minute walk to the train station along with a few restaurants/bars. No real shopping nearby. Overall, very pretty place with beautiful views.

We came to Chicago to see Rush with friends from near and far (rock on, Anika Nilles!!!) It was very very nice to have parking and a short walk to and from the event. Chicago is pretty easy to navigate by various means and we took advantage of them all!! We went into town for the riverboat architecture tour and up to Wicker Park to go to Reckless Records and Irazu. Great trip!
Place was nice and loved the neighborhood and how close it was to Wrigleyville.
Great space in a great location
Great location in a quiet building.  Easy access to Hyde Park and U Chicago. Well appointed, super clean, and nicely updated.
Kyriako was very responsive. The instructions were super easy to follow. I love that there was coffee AND creamer for us and supplies for washing dishes and clothes! It was a great stay.

Nicest Airbnb in town. Super well appointed. Parking spots are easy and convenient. We walked to Wrigley a couple times- nice walk. The Wellington Station is very close. We stayed with our two small kids and though the metal stair was initially intimidating, everyone felt right at home.
Sharon's place worked so well for us.  She's an amazing host and always quick to reply to us.  Definitely will be staying here again!

we enjoyed our 5 day stay. neighborhood was calming; we enjoyed a few walks around the area,  all anemeties were listed for the property, home was neat and spacious.  The host(s) also checked up on needs throughout stay.
This place was clean, comfy, and an overall nice place to stay. It’s very easy to get downtown via train/bus. Overall the unit was nice, the host was responsive, and we enjoyed our stay.
This place was great! Everybody had plenty of space. We really enjoyed the finished living space in the basement. I believe this place could sleep more people.

I stayed here with my wife and two young boys and felt right at home. The neighborhood was quiet and easy to get around. I also really appreciate the garage and not having to worry about finding parking on the street. Noemi was proactive and also super responsive any time I had any questions. I highly recommend this place!

We had a wonderful stay at this rental property. The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was well-maintained, had everything we needed, and made us feel right at home. The location was great, and the host was friendly and responsive. I would definitely recommend this property to anyone looking for a pleasant and relaxing stay. Thank you for a great experience!.
The accommodations made our stay in Chicago that much better. I’d definitely stay there again.
We had a great stay! The Wicker Park area has lots to explore, and the train is a short walk away. Nice, well-kept place. Highly recommended!
We stayed for two nights and the apartment was in a great location and met all of our needs.  The hosts were very responsive with anything we needed to ask.  Would stay here again.
A great place to stay, clean and well appointed. Enrique was very helpful throughout the process and the property was just what we needed for a short stay in Chicago.

It's a very nice apartment but the only downside is it's right next to the train tracks hence it's super noisy and very difficult to sleep at night if you are a light sleeper. Other than that everything else was amazing, very convenient location right up near the train station and near west loop lots to do and offices are also near by.
No doubt Rida is quite responsive but I found place little low than my expectation

We stayed here to go to a Cubs game and a concert at the United Center. We were able to take the L train everywhere we needed and it was only about a block from the apartment.
The sound from the bar downstairs wasn’t too bad and there was a sound machine available if you’re a light sleeper. The only downside was that the shower was on the smaller side, but that’s really all.

Great little spot. Exactly as described/shown and super affordable. Hosts were extremely responsive. Instructions were very concise so didn’t leave many open questions. Kid absolutely loved the place and the board games that were there also. Absolutely no complaints.

My stay was lovely! I felt safe in the building and the apartment was quite spacious. The location is perfect! There’s a restaurant attached and the area is walkable. I was able to walk to downtown Hyde Park, the Obama Center, and the beach. There are also train and bus options nearby. It was perfect for a quick trip.

Cute place and great location. Impressive butcher block kitchen counter and stove, with inviting skylights and plant decor throughout. Shower / water pressure was on the light side with low ceiling, but all else made for a great stay.

My boyfriend and I had a great stay at Mark’s apartment. It was a clean, cozy space that immediately felt like home. The area was peaceful and quiet. It wasn’t too far from Wrigley Field, which was great for us! Mark was very helpful when I had questions during our check in and gave clear instructions. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Very happy with our stay!
Property was exactly as advertised: clean, convenient, charming and, most importantly, comfortable. Communication with the host was excellent! Definitely on my list to stay at again. Thank you!
Great apartment in convenient location. Katty was extremely responsive. Parking can be tricky but that’s Chicago. Very much worth the stay.
Host was very responsive and helpful. Great place!
Encun的房子很適合一家入住，房子乾淨整潔，樓下交通方便. 可以輕鬆的找到美味餐廳與購物. 房子位置相連交通線.出門便利.很推薦來芝加哥入住他們的公寓.
Responsive host, apartment fully equipped with everything you would need!
For a first time doing Airbnb it was worth it overall. Super nice and made me feel at home. After a full stay I would definitely come back

I had a great stay. The hosts were communicative, responsive, and easy to reach whenever I had questions. The home is beautiful, with a unique artistic style. It's tastefully decorated, clean, well maintained, and comfortable. The location made it easy to get to many of Chicago's main attractions by car while staying in a quieter area. The hosts also let me leave my luggage with them for a little while after checkout, which was a thoughtful accommodation and gave me some flexibility before heading to the airport. Overall, I would definitely recommend staying here, and I hope to be back again!!

Had a great time staying here! There was a bit of a hiccup when it came to check-in, but Alek came to the rescue so quickly and solved the problem. He was so kind when we met, as for the stay itself it’s beautiful, homey, and in a great location. Would definitely rebook to stay here again!

Ewa's place is one of the best I've ever stayed in — a beautiful, artistic and cozy full unit that's incredibly comfortable and spacious. We loved the surrounding neighborhood: very walkable and just a short distance from Wicker Park, so it's a great area for strolling around. Ewa was so nice and welcoming, and shared lots of great local recommendations with us. She was very responsive, and she has the sweetest dog! We'd definitely love to come back.

Nice size house for 2 or 3 people. Nice quiet neighborhood.  Parking on street available with permit stickers supplied. However, be very careful! We got a ticket for not moving our car for “street cleaning”. Apparently they post signs 24 hours in advance on trees. We never saw the signs because we never went out the front door. So be aware and check trees! Expensive ticket!
Definitely would come back. Thanks for making this last part of my transition very easy.

Our stay exceeded our expectations in every way! Victor was kind and accommodating from the day we booked our reservation and attentive when we had questions during our stay. The space was perfect for our group of 4 adults (the steep steps to the 2nd floor were a little hard for the grandparents but they managed) and 3 teenagers fully stocked with extra linens, toiletries, a coffee bar, and games for the kids. Finding 3 queen rooms + 1 king room felt luxurious for a condo. Being a block from Wrigley Field was definitely a highlight for our family! We also walked to Whole Foods easily to get groceries. Would love to stay here again in the future!

Had a great stay! Location was perfect, very walkable to lots of bars and restaurants, nearby train stops, and just a few steps away to Andersonville. The Riviera and a really cute old school diner are next door. There’s no hotels in this area so finding this place was perfect for where I wanted to be.
Had all the amenities you would need, spacious shower, tv, fridge, washer/dryer.
It is in an apartment building, that used to be an old hotel. You hear typical building and street noise but nothing you wouldn’t expect staying in a city apartment. The neighborhood is pretty quiet too.
Hosts were very communicative and provided all the details you would need. I had no issues for my stay, everything was described and pictured accurately.

Damien’s place was perfect for our family’s first time in Chicago. The neighborhood was quiet. The house was pristine, modern, and had lots of great amenities including a sauna and whole house Bluetooth speakers!
As a host, Damien was as good as it gets! He was very proactive with his conversations, and provided some snacks and drinks in his home to welcome us.
We were a short drive to everything we wanted to see in Chicago and would highly recommend staying here.
Lovely weekend getaway

My son and I had a wonderful stay in this Andersonville apartment. I can't overstate how PERFECT the location is. We could easily walk to many great stores and eateries. The apartment has everything you could need. We had a blast. The hosts were accommodating and friendly, check-in was a breeze. Highly recommend!

We had a great stay at Matt & Brad's place. It was beautifully decorated, very clean, and had everything we needed and more. We felt right at home cooking meals in the kitchen and playing games and hanging out at night. The location is amazing - so close to great restaurants and shops and yet so quiet at night. It felt so good to get back to this quieter area after spending all day in the city taking in the sights. Matt & Brad were very responsive and really thought of everything to make this space such a welcoming and comfortable place.

Mirsada’s house is a nice place to stay at.  The upstairs suite has lots of room to move around with 2 bedrooms and beds are comfortable. Neighborhood is quiet and safe. Stores and restaurants are near by.

It was great for my short trip.
Easy to find and access.

Prince and Victoria's place was exactly what we needed for our stay in Chicago! It was beautifully designed, thoughtfully decorated, and had all the comforts needed for a wonderful stay.
What truly made our experience special were the thoughtful personal touches—from the handwritten welcome note and celebrating my husband's milestone birthday with a thoughtful gift, to the care packages and cozy house slippers provided to enjoy the space. It was clear that every detail was carefully considered to make guests feel at home.
Thank you both for your incredible hospitality. We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely stay here again—hands down! Highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago.

My son and I stayed here for 4 nights and loved the home.  It was a great home base for a summer vacation, walkable to everything we needed, yet on a quiet, tree lined street.  We would definitely stay here again.

Io e la mia compagna Julia abbiamo soggiornato per 10 giorni in questo fantastico appartamento. Pulizia, ordine e tutti gli utensili che servono per cucinare sono davvero curati per offrire una permanenza di qualità. La comunicazione con l’host (che è super reattivo e gentile) impeccabile. Istruzioni chiare, parcheggio privato (in pratica avete un posto contrassegnato con un numero e una lettera e quello è vostro garantito).
Area perfetta per raggiungere il centro di Chicago in una mezz’ora o poco più.
Non trovo difetti. Sono davvero soddisfatto e la consiglio vivamente.

Amit’s place fit our needs well. He is a thoughtful host, and addressed any questions we had very well (quickly, correctly, professionally). Nicest place we’ve stayed so far in Chicago; Logan Square is a great neighborhood. Would love to stay again.

Justin is a great, helpful and responsive host. And if you're looking to be in a great walkable neighborhood near Wrigley, Lincoln Park, Lake Michigan and great restaurants and bars, this is a great spot.
The unit is has large and comfortable living areas and two comfortable bedrooms, including a nice space that can be used as an office if needed.
We would certainly stay hear again.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The property was clean, comfortable, and beautiful maintained. The host absolutely wonderful kind , attentive and very responsive , answered all my questions and made the experience smooth and enjoyable. The location was perfect with walking distance of museums and many attractions. I truly appreciate the host’s hospitality. I highly recommend staying in here and would happily return in the future! Thank you

Stayed here for 4 nights, the night time is definitely much more intimidating due to the darkness and people walking around but not dangerous. The place is exactly what you see in the photos. It is very clean and cozy. Marketi is a great host and the response time was a 10/10. Would definitely book again😊.

Eric’s place is amazing. We felt right at home, safe and peaceful. Slept great. They thought of anything you could need.
Eric was so kind to us and I highly recommend their home for your stay. You will not be disappointed.
We plan to come back next year for sure.
Great place!
The place was great! The natural lighting in every room made the space feel very warm and cozy. My family got to enjoy Navy Pier and the city! Everything was within walking distance.
Great summer stay in Lakeview. Great location.  Free on street parking. Good times at Austin’s place

Nikkole was extremely helpful and friendly! Everything you want: clean bathroom! Comfortable mattresses! Typical street noise (not out of the ordinary)  in front bedroom but back bedrooms are great. Good coffee: 3 ways to make coffee (Keireg-spelling?-, French press, and drip!) really good safe location. Parking wasn’t nearly as difficult as I thought. It was really the perfect spot.

This was my first time in the USA. The location was absolutely perfect for getting around and the room was much bigger than I thought. It was a heatwave when I arrived and the property was air conditioned so it was a great impression from the get go. The host also came round to clean the bathrooms every single day. If I’m back this way, I’ll definitely be booking here again

This constant noise made it quite difficult to relax and get a good night’s sleep. It’s also worth noting that the elevator was not working during our stay, so carrying luggage up the stairs was quite challenging.
Overall, if you’re looking for a well-located apartment and don’t mind significant noise and stairs, this is an option to consider.

Beautiful area, very peaceful. A little challenging to find a parking spot. However even when I had to park a block away at night, I felt completely safe walking to the residence.   The apartment matched the photos, loved the fooseball table, and the gas stove. It was a little chilly in the basement but there was a heater in the bedroom closet along with extra blankets. All in all this really was a great place to stay. Thank you Erick for sharing your home with me.

I had an absolutely wonderful stay! The host was incredibly kind, welcoming, and responsive throughout my trip. The place was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything I needed was provided, and the attention to detail made me feel right at home. Communication was excellent from check-in to check-out, making the entire experience smooth and stress-free. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a fantastic place to stay. Thank you for such an amazing experience!

We enjoyed our stay. Nicholas was very responsive in answering questions. The neighborhood is ethnically diverse and friendly. The place was clean and had everything we needed. Our only issue (minor) was the key fob did not work at the main door; however we simply walked around the corner to the side door and it worked there. I would definitely recommend the place.

Location: perfect, CTA Blue line, w/o any jumps out. Will bring you directly from ORD to Robin's place. From Western you'll reach Downtown in 10min. Robin has everything in the apartment If I decided to come Chicago, definitely will take this apartment
Great place in a great location. Rida was always quick to respond to any messages. No problems at all. I would recommend this place to everyone!

This is a no frills place. I've stayed here several times due to reasonable rates and its proximity to downtown. The host is responsive, but don't expect they'll go out of their way to accommodate any special requests. A great choice for people on a budget that are satisfied with the basics.

A great spot if you’re staying downtown or south of the city. Lots of parking and a very easy check in. The place is fantastic for a short or long stay. Highly recommend! Soraya is friendly and very helpful.
Nice stay very nice and responsive host
Joseph was a great host. Would stay here again.
Go Cubs Go!!!! literally 10 houses behind the infamous fire house next time wrigley loved staying here

I was in the city for a couple days and found this place to be a perfect spot. Was able to find free parking and enjoyed walking 53rd street looking at the many shops and dining options. I was also able to grocery shop and cook in the rental space with ease. Check in/check out was very easy. Communication during my stay was superb!

Justin’s place was absolutely perfect.  Stayed for a couple nights to go to a few Cubs games. Just a few short blocks from Wrigley, and walkable to everything you need. Vibrant neighborhood but still quiet and peaceful. Place was clean and well appointed, even better than advertised. Could not have asked for more.  I highly recommend staying here.

Everything from requesting the stay to checking out was easy! Everything was communicated clearly, with helpful videos explaining where various amenities were.
I would definitely stay here again!
Amazing place!!! I wanted a girlie place for our girl’s trip, and boy did it delivery! Adorable neighborhood! We will be back!
Loved the condo. Amazing location a block away from Fulton Market. Great views, great amenities, easy to get an Uber or walk to the train.

The apartment was very comfortable and spacious. The sitting space was especially comfortable for hanging out. The backyard access was a lovely, quiet outside space. Easy access and the hosts were very responsive to questions and inquired about our comfort.
Walked to excellent restaurants and bars.
INCREDIBLE!! Thank you so much for EVERYTHING!!
Beautiful place!  Brand new!
James place was great. Very cool neighborhood and very comfortable.

The host was very responsive, the building is old but the unit itself was decent, things we liked, big spacious apartment, air conditioning was good, close to beach, going to downtown was easy, kitchen had all basic things we needed. Some inconveniences were, parking and noise from the train. Overall I would stay here again.

Steve was a fantastic host, extremely responsive, proactive and overall just a nice person. He cared if we had a good experience and was very helpful. The location is fantastic, we were able to easily get around on foot and with the EL, never used our car once it was parked nearby.  Near tons of restaurant options and Wrigley Field. The apartment was very clean.  We traveled with our three kids, ages 17, 14 and 11. It was great for us. Highly recommend!
Great location! Room to spread out for our family of four. Very comfy beds. Thanks for letting us live in the city for a few days. It was fabulous!

Great location, quiet neighborhood, easy to navigate the city via car or public transportation, no issues finding parking. Aisha was very friendly and communicative. We loved the space—perfect for our little family.

Once you entered the unit, it looked exactly like the pictures. We knew from the listing that the Airbnb was a basement unit. I’m not sure what we expected to see upon entering, but the first door before actually enter entering the unit was a jumpscare!! like the other reviews, we could hear kids talking laughing and could smell of cooking from upstairs. Other than the stay was good.
Great location! And very responsive host.
Very responsive and respectful host. I enjoyed my time at your unit in Chicago, thank you Evan!

This is a garden apt, which means limited natural light and small head clearance. If these are important to you then move on. Otherwise it’s a very clean, safe affordable stay in Chicago. Also came with parking passes which was great. Location was excellent. Host very communicative
Amazing location with lots of space especially for our family. Well appointed and so close to great restaurants and shopping! Excellent value!!

I stayed at Jb's place for three months while I transitioned to a new job in Chicago. It was perfect for my needs. The location in historic Pullman is great. I highly recommend it for short- and long-term stays.
Was a great place for our group!
Our crew had a great stay at Matthew's place. Good communication and exactly as advertised. Will stay again in future!

Home away from home. We stayed for 4 nights and have everything we need.
Location: red line within 3-5 min walk to take you to Downtown in 15-20 min.
Wholefoods right across the road
A lot of small restaurants around - we tried sushi place (Union), Nandos and Meddeterenian - all great. Sweetwaters coffee place open 6am - 9pm with good selection of coffee and snacks.
The place itself is very cozy (good enough for 2-3 people).
Everything was brand new.
The unit also has washer and dryer which was great addition
Want to mention that all supplies (including cleaning and washing powder) were provided
We did not cook but unit has induction cooktop, microwave, toaster and coffee machine.
The building itself is nice and clean too - spaces for work, relax, fresh coffee and roof top.
We had a great stay at Matthew’s Place. Location was great. A great home base for exploring Chicago!
Perfect spot and the description fit the place

Absolutely loved our stay here! You can tell that the place is packed with amenities that were carefully and thoughtfully planned out, we had absolutely everything we could’ve needed. We brought our two year old and the supplies they had ready for kids was greatly appreciated!
The space was very clean and organized, and all the rooms were extremely comfortable. All in all we felt right at home and would highly recommend this place for anyone’s stay, especially those traveling with kids. The care they put into this place really shows.
Mera’s place is in a great location right in between Lincoln park and wrigley. Mera helped me when I needed it and the place was nice.
Great place to stay!

This was a great space. Gorgeous apartment, very clean. Short walk to wrigley field, which was perfect. Walkable distance to bars and restaurants.
The train is very loud and very close, just like the listing said. We couldn’t find any sound machines in the apartment, the only thing I would do is make sure to bring one. Host was great and very responsive.

Awesome place to stay. The memorabilia alone is worth it, especially if you are a fan of post punk and industrial music. The neighborhood of Bridgeport is well on its way of making a huge comeback. It is quiet, and many of the amenities are within walking distance. The neighbors that we encountered were very friendly, and many of the homes in the area have recently been remodeled. We had a chance to tour the museum which was incredible. Martin and the staff were welcoming and very excited to showcase the exhibits, which are mind blowing. We are definitely coming back to stay again. Thanks Martin.
Great house big driveway

The location is great for access to the blue line stop (2-3 minute walk) and in a nice residential area.  The small backyard space is helpful and there are also nice green spaces at the end of the block.  Close to a number of eating establishments and retail all very walkable and simple.  I would stay again.  The space is garden level (walk out/view out basement level).  Matthew is a great host and accessible.  Would definitely stay in the Logan Square area and with Matthew as a host.
Anne’s home was the perfect stay! I’m in the process of writing my book and she made me feel right at home:)
Robert was great at communication and helped me get back in quickly when I accidentally locked myself out. Would definitely stay again.

This place was so nice. Though it was a shared experience, the other guest kept to themselves and made no trouble at all. This was very big for me because I struggle with social anxiety. The area was beautiful at night and easy to find and not too hectic of an area to get picked up and dropped off. It felt like a nice place for even a long term stay! 5 out of 5 would recommend!

This was a wonderful property for my business trip. The unit larger then I expected, the loud train that went past the window every 20 mins was a surprise but got used to it after a while.
Overall great experience
Great place to stay near Wrigley Field!
Good accommodations in a great location!
Incredible spot to stay to enjoy a beautiful home in Wrigleyville. Would easily stay again in the future

The location is right at central Wicker Park which made it super convenient to get around the city! The unit itself does look like the photos and is at basement level which made it really cool temperature-wise. We got plenty of use out of the ping-pong/pool table at night!
The hosts were also very proactive to message me before, during, and after my stay. I didn't have any issues with any parts of the apartment, but they did message me to let me know they're there if anything arose. The best part was minimal checkout tasks to do--just start the dishwasher and put all the trash in the kitchen trash can.
All in all, this unit's location really can't be beat if you're looking at the Wicker Park area. I would stay here again!

Great location! As a solo parent traveling with two young kids, safety and walkability were top priorities, and this place delivered—restaurants and coffee shops are all within a 10-minute walk. The unit is up a substantial flight of stairs, but inside it’s cozy, clean, fully equipped, and has comfortable beds.
Great place! Peter is an excellent host. The place seems bigger than the photos suggest. The coffee maker didn’t work, and Peter rushed one over to us. Thanks for going above and beyond!

The apartment was close to my daughter and all our favorite restaurants. It was clean and the traffic and trains were not even noticeable.
Great value.
One recommendation, more linen choices. Not everyone can sleep under a fluffy comforter. A sheet would have been perfect.
This was my 2nd stay. Sarah was a wonderful host. I love staying here. Don’t hesitate to book your stay. I will be back.
Perfect spot for individual or couple.  Close to Lincoln Park, Lake Michigan, and tons of restaurants all while being on a nice quiet street.  Highly recommend!

The pictures don't do the rental justice - more modern and nicer than it appears. The short drive to the President Obama Center was a nice surprise, and easy access to Lake Michigan was enjoyable. Tanys and Drew are helpful and quick to respond. We'd stay again if we return to Chicago.
Great place to stay if looking for something affordable and accessible to public transportation. I was traveling by myself and felt safe.

I choose this location because it as only about four block from McCormick Place, where I had a conference. It was very convenient for that - only about a 10-12 minute walk. I was also glad that it had parking so that I could drive into the city and then leave my car parked the entire time I was a the conference. Milan was very easy to get in touch with.
Loved staying here. Matt and Wendy were extremely responsive and helpful. Great unit as well!

If you are looking to stay somewhere in the center of Logan Square - close the restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and public transportation... Matthew's place is perfect!  We easily walked to all of our favorite Chicago spots and had luxurious access to the blue line to get downtown and to the airport.   The space is clean and simple with two comfortable beds and AC (which was a must in late July).  We would stay here again.
Convenient to the train, accommodating host
Such a beautiful, comfortable home. Open and friendly communication with hosts. Loved the neighborhood and the convenient access to public transportation. We had such a wonderful stay!
We enjoyed the stay- Thanks Brad!

Tolle Wohnung, tolle Gastgeberin. Wir haben es geliebt, mit Blick auf den Michigan-See zu frühstücken.
Leider etwas laut wegen der Straße nach vorne raus und den Zügen auf der Rückseite.

This town house is huge. Lots of space and a great location. Some of the problems include stained walls through your the house. Bugs in the houses like flys, bed was lumpy, water was not hot and only lasted 5 mins. The entrance was at the back of the house. Lots of signs about target rats! The back of the house had trash on the floor. It just looks dirty and unsafe at night if your by your self .

It was overall a great stay at Andrei’s place! The space was nice and clean and huge. What a great value! Some things to note that the front door of the building didn’t always lock correctly and that the app to unlock the front door was kind of annoying and the other people in my party had trouble getting access. Other than that it was lovely and in an amazing area!

We chose the Bluebird Loft primarily for its location - an easy walk to the Brown line L station and also walking distance to Wrigley Field.
All the 5-star reviews clinched our decision to book, and they are well-earned! Jason reached out immediately to make sure the space was going to work for our group, and that we were okay with the stairs. There ARE a lot of stairs, as this unit sits above The Long Room bar as well as two other apartments, but we didn’t have any issues navigating them - and Jason personally, kindly, helped us get our luggage up to our room when we arrived.
The space itself is lovely, and worth the climb. We appreciated the whimsical decor, the thoughtful details, and all the amenities. The record player and record collection featuring Chicago artists was a favorite.
The unit was cozy, but comfortable, for our family of four. One of my teenage sons slept on the pullout, and was comfortable enough not to fight with his brother to switch into a bed on night two!

We loved our stay at Leslie's place!  It was beautifully decorated, and we enjoyed seeing the souvenirs from around the globe. Everything was extremely clean, and there were so many thoughtful touches. We really appreciated things like the air purifier (great for white noise too), snack basket, and welcome card. We didn't need it, but she even had a clothing steamer. There were plenty of extra toiletries, toilet paper, and towels. She thought of everything. It was a very cheerful and bright space. She was also accommodating with adjusting the temperature when we were cold.

We really enjoyed our stay at La Vecindad. The location is very conveniently located next to a bus stop. It was very easy to get around. The mattress was comfortable. The pillows were pretty flat, but we had brought our own. If you have neck problems, I suggest you do the same. Be sure to bring your own toiletries (soap, shampoo) as well, because this is an Airbnb that does not supply those. There is no TV in the bedroom, but there is one in the common space. We used our laptop.
You are in the city, and on the northern end of the south side. We never felt anything but safe in this neighborhood, but when riding the bus, just beware and keep your eyes open as you have to do in the city. All in all, this was a great stay at a great value. We plan to come again.

I was there for a conference at McCormick place and it was perfect. Was a quick 15 min bus ride to the location.
The directions were easy to follow and check in was seamless. Ed really in the house only to sleep, but it was perfect for that. PS- there is air conditioning.
Everything was great! I’m glad that I chose this place to stay.
A perfectly comfortable place to stay at a reasonable price with a convenient parking spot!
Cute little apartment that was perfect for our family of four. Host was responsive when we had questions and was super helpful.

Had a great stay, what a view! Shay was very communicative and the space was bigger than I realized. Would stay again!
Thank you!
Loved itttt
Great place to stay on the northside. Feels like retro times when you stay,lots of old school decorations.  Very comfortable for 2!

There’s place is an ideal HQ for exploring the north side of Chicago. Right around the corner from the bus stop on Ashland and we did not have difficulty finding parking within a block or two off of Paulina. Plenty of nearby restaurants and Scooter’s frozen custard was across the street!
There are several steps to access the unit with keypads and keys, but the instructions are clear and we didn’t need to contact the host for help. The unit is clean and spacious enough for a few people. Chicago was warm the week we were there, but the AC units and ceiling fans did the job. I would suggest bringing an eye mask if you are sensitive to light when you sleep. There are no blackout curtains. It was also quiet at night considering the location and any noise from the neighbors was barely noticeable. We would definitely stay here again.

I stayed here for a couple of days and I think it was  just the right place for me. I was travelling alone and a small room with a desk to work on was all I needed.
