Things that are great about the place is how clean it is. The kitchen cupboards are well organised and everything is pretty much easy to access/navigate. Also Yingjian is very responsive . She would respond almost immediately whenever I needed something and also would reach out every now and then to check I am comfortable. All in all it’s great.

This place was absolutely beautiful and immaculate! Everything was perfect, we loved this place so much so I will highly recommend. The bus station was a block away and the train station around 12 min walk so the location was great! This place had everything we needed, we felt right at home!

Will responded within minutes if we had questions, which we truly appreciate. The AirBnB was great! It was Super clean and updated. It had an amazing Modern Chicago vibe. We would choose this place again if we come back to Chicago.

We are two friends traveling together and could hardly have been more comfortable. The location is ideal—so close to the red line, an easy walk to the lake, and right next to Clark street for all of the great Andersonville shops. The hosts are so friendly and responsive, and had breakfast foods, fresh fruit, and coffee with creamer ready for us. They have great recommendations too!
Great place nice and clean very cool host will stay again.
I had a great stay at Michael’s property. Accomodating of early check in, easy self check in, and a good neighbourhood with great access to public transport to go to/from downtown and the airport.

Yingjian’s place was well worth it! It’s easy to find and check in and quite cozy. The location is near multiple bus stops and easy to get where you need to in Chicago. It’s a shared space that is clean and offers sufficient privacy. Would recommend Yingjian’s airbnb to anyone looking to stay in Chicago

I have been using Airbnb for over a decade. Every single one of my reviews of homes and those that reviewed me are positive (see my profile). This is my one exception. If in need of an apartment in the Chicago, River North area, I would not recommend this one. First, you are always dealing with a management company, not even located in this city. I was told that a $250 refundable deposit is required (wierd) then told it was actually $500. I get to the apartment hours after my check in time and the front door was wide open, it was dirty, the bed was slept in and no house keeper to be seen. No key fob for the gym & rooftop patio, as advertised (both important to me). The door code did not work after it was closed so our luggage got locked inside. We ended up getting a hotel room (lucky because the whole city was sold out) and Airbnb worked with me to get a refund. If you decide to rent, I would recommend having a backup in mind.

Taimoor's place was quite nice, but a few things could be added. The kitchen was missing a few essentials things for cooking. There was really no place to store groceries and a couple of the bedrooms lacked places to store folded clothes and underwear. A couple of nightlights would help also since it was quite dark when all lights were out. But with those few upgrades the place would be great.
Great spot, exactly as described. Staircase and doors are a bit loud, but nothing crazy. definitely worth it if you are looking for a north side vacation spot.

Llegar al alojamiento y encontrar todo muy limpio y todo muy cómodo. ... la atención q tenían si yo les escribía contestaban rápido la ubicación tranquila  los vesinos muy amables solo la serradura de la puerta frontal un poco floja pero de ahí todo muy  muy bien......
Beautiful, newly renovated apartment with high ceilings and near to many great bars and restaurants. Highly recommend!
We had such a good time in otoniels apartment. Everything was clean and nice. He was very friendly. We definitely will book this place again

Really enjoyed our stay and the Pilsen neighborhood. The flat was clean and had everything we needed plus some fun treats. Quiet spot and neighbors while being close to restaurants and the L train. Would definitely stay again
Great spot in a great walking neighborhood. I felt like a Chicagoan for a few days.
Great stay! At most 10-15 minutes away from downtown. Great location, few things are within good walking distance highly recommend the Gangnam market. Host was very responsive and helpful. 10/10
We were three adults in town for an event at the United Center. Nice place, easy parking, close to the L and the water taxi. Chinatown is vibrant and fun. Jake is a great host.

Really nice, clean, and spacious apartment with comfortable beds and bedding. As stated in previous reviews, the hallways are fairly dirty but the apartment itself is great. Very easy parking and very close to the subway. The apartment is nicer than the photos. Highly recommend.

What a great place to stay!
Was in walking distance to United Center for a concert.
We loved it.
Would totally stay here again!
Great place & great hosts!

Great place to stay with a group!
There were 7 adults that stayed, plenty of space. Right next to Wrigley Field, everything was walkable and easy to get to!
We had a great stay at Nancy’s.  Nancy was very responsive to any questions we had.  We liked the neighborhood and had a great time exploring Chicago!
Good home in a great neighborhood

The Cozy Library was a great home base for our Chicago adventure. We walked to the bus stop to visit the Obama Presidential Center and took a short drive to the United Center for a concert. Pizza places, cafe, and Mediterranean food were all nearby. Nicky was quick to reply to our request for a pizza recommendation. Furniture in the apartment was comfortable and allowed us a good night’s sleep. Kitchen is well stocked. Interesting books to peruse and games to play.

Absolutely loved our stay at Brad’s place! It was a very quiet neighborhood and the multiple levels of security gave us peace of mind. Brad was very responsive and gave very clear directions on where things were located. We came to town for some ball games at Wrigley Field. It was less than a mile walk and a very simple one at that! We also ventured down to Broadway for some of Nancy’s pizza! All very walkable.

Perfect location!  Red line was just a few minutes away, and plenty of restaurants, shops, and unique places.  Neighborhood quiet too, and very safe.  The establishment was also perfect.  Clean, well sized, and fit my needs,  recommend!

This airbnb was amazing! It was very secure with the two locks listed in the listing as well as an additional bedroom lock on the inside. I highly recommend this place for solo travelers. Every now and then you will hear walking above you but nothing loud enough to disturb. The sheets and entire room were very clean and so was the bathroom. The private bathroom was also very worth it. It was also very close to transit lines. Thank you for the stay!
Very responsive! Quiet neighborhood and close to everything

This cute apartment had everything we needed for our short trip to Chicago! Great amenities, convenient location near public transit, and clean. Sarah is a very friendly and attentive host. We were also excited to find a Little Free Library in front of the building!

This apartment is next to a train tracks and every 5 minutes a train passes, the sound of the train passing is so loud that it feels that you are sitting at a railway station. The host is completely inconsiderate to publish this information and after been up all night we vacated the apartment the next day had Airbnb refund us the charges.

I highly recommend Shonte’s place. We felt right at home. You can smell the cleaning products as soon as you opened the door, which made you feel right at home. It was close to downtown area and all the activities we had planned. Always parking nice neighbors. It was 3 couples we all had our own bathrooms which was great. We could have had one more couple if the sofa in the basement was a pull out. New updated home. We are planning our next visit. The only issue I had was how long it took her to respond back but thankfully it wasn’t emergency questions or needs. Everyone was pleased and I had a hard crowd. Oh and the ice maker worked which was a plus for me lol. Thank you for having us.

Excellent location - very easy to catch the train and bus.  Very comfortable space and clean bathroom.    I stayed there for five nights and was provided with everything I needed for a comfortable stay.  Will stay here again if I come back to Chicago for a visit.
Great easy spot on Michigan! Uber easy access !

This apartment is amazing!! Beautiful views day and night from all living spaces, comfortable beds, and access to high quality amenities (pool, hot tub, grills, social spaces with billiards and ping pong). We attended one of the RUSH concerts at the United Center which drove our choice for this location. We also appreciated how safe we felt in the surrounding area and the market that was only 2 blocks away. Only a 10 - 15 minute LYFT/UBER ride to downtown depending on where you are going.
As other reviewers have noted, the building is close to the train and you can hear the train in the living room/kitchen/deck area. The train is not as noticeable in the bedrooms with the doors closed.
The place was perfect for our 2 night stay. Plenty of room and close to everything we wanted to do. Transportation was easy to arrange and best of all was within walking distance of Wrigley Field.
If going to a game or want to have easy access to city without the noise and hustle this is your perfect option.

I would recommend this flat provided you are ready for the walk to and from the blue and pink line CTA stations. We were a little apprehensive walking to the flat on the first day but after a few days we encountered no problems and were more at ease. Blue and pink lines offer easy access to Chicago city.

James’s place was bright, stylish, clean and super spacious —  perfect for our family of two adults, three teens and a younger one. Having four bedrooms, three bathrooms and two living rooms was a huge plus for us! We also made good use of the well equipped kitchen, and the AC was perfect for the heat wave we encountered during our stay. The neighbourhood was quiet, and we were less than a 15-minute walk from the blue line. James was super responsive and accommodating. There were plenty of towels and really stylish  linens. The place made our stay in Chicago fantastic!!
Muy bueno
Everything was alright, nice place, nice location !
Loved the place
大変お世話になりました。ありがとうございました。いつも親切にしていただき、とても快適でした。
Would definitely stay again awesome place!
Super cozy place, stayed cool in this hot summer heat. Good shower. Close to a lot of different shops/food. Easy access to blue line. Exactly what we needed!

The home was perfect for my friends and I. Walkable to almost everything we wanted to do. The rooftop was a great place to hang out and relax. Having a garage to park my car in was great. Assel was friendly and always responsive to inquiries.
Great place to stay. Mary makes you feel comfortable and is very knowledgeable about the area and helpful.

Our stay at Scott’s place was perfect and he is an amazing host. Extremely helpful and friendly. We enjoyed our time with him and his hospitality. The space was clean, private, and had everything we needed for a long weekend. Parking was easy and always felt safe. The neighborhood is very walkable with no shortage of things to do or places to eat and drink. Would absolutely stay here again and recommend to others.
One of the best Airbnb stays we had!!

We had a great stay at Marc’s! The place was spacious and had everything we needed. It was also conveniently located with only a 10 minute walk to the red line, as well as a nice playground and Dunkin down the street.  The street was beautifully tree-lined and quiet, and Marc was very accommodating and responsive. Thanks for everything, Marc!
Beautiful place and plenty of room for two people. Very close to Wrigley Field and yet quiet when you need it to be. Would definitely stay here again.

Our family enjoyed our stay at this very accommodating  home for our large group. The home was very clean and spacious and provided lots of comfortable areas for everyone to hang out and relax. Our teens enjoyed playing ping pong and hanging out in the basement. Overall, this was a perfect home for our family and we would come back again.
Everything was very clean and exactly as pictured!

We enjoyed our stay in West Town at Bart's place. The living room had a comfy couch and very large TV and the bedrooms, bathrooms, & kitchen were as advertised. We found the space a little less clean than we would've expected but it may be that our standards are rather high. And then lastly, it was a bit strange to have to log into a separate website outside of Airbnb to manage our booking. This was required to go through an identity verification process, to receive check-in and check-out instructions and to pay an additional deposit ($250) outside of AirBnb.
We really enjoyed our stay here, especially the location! You’re across the street from millennium Park and a quick walk to the main downtown tourist areas. Thank you!

Had a slight hiccup at check in but Benjamin was very responsive and the technology was fixed quickly. The space was exactly as advertised and the neighborhood is pristine. Thank you for a great stay!

We had a wonderful stay at Kavin’s place and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. The space was extremely clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. Kavin was a fantastic host—very responsive, accommodating, and helpful throughout our stay. He made the entire experience smooth and stress-free. We truly appreciated his hospitality and would gladly stay here again in the future.
Host was super responsive and friendly. Easy to follow instructions for check-in. Clean unit. Located in a cute, safe area of Chicago. Would stay here again :)
Great location, plenty of space for our group of 4 and the host was very responsive and helpful.  Would definitely stay again!

We felt very at home in Logan’s Square. The location was conveniently located to those we were visiting.  We were surrounded by a beautiful park and a lovely neighborhood, and were within a walkable distance to get great coffee and food. We did not have any issues parking our car in the neighborhood.

Out stay at Reggie's was perfect. Could not have asked for a better experience. Apartment was spotless and looked just like the photos. Rooftop was private and had a beautiful view of the Chicago skyline. I would definitely recommend staying here if you're in the area.
Great place! Great host! Great location!

We had a great stay here. It was spacious and clean. Nice that each room has access to its on bathroom (some en suite and some across the hallway). We had a guest with mobility issues and it was a good place for her with elevator access which we had a hard time finding in the city. The team was wonderful and communication. They were very professional and thorough which helped us maximize our stay.

A la hauteur des attentes
l'hôte est réactif et attentif !

La estancia estuvo muy bien, es un edificio bien ubicado, fácil de encontrar, el detalle de los locker para usar antes de la entrada al departamento es espectacular, el apartamento es muy cómodo, se nos agotó las pastillas de jabón y nos dieron mas, las sabanas limpias, el líneas generales estuvo genial, solo el Internet que nos falló en un par de oportunidades y el piso necesita mas limpieza, del resto todo estuvo perfecto en mi estadía con mis dos hijas. Lo recomiendo al 100%. La ubicación es genial, cerca de la parada del metro y de las líneas de bus.

Fantastic spot. The apartment is cozy and has everything you need for a nice stay. We stayed with our baby, and we were even provided with a travel crib. The neighborhood is wonderful - walkable to good coffee, restaurants, public transportation, and Wrigley Field! I couldn’t recommend this place more.

If you are a Cubs fan and not familiar with Chicago this place is perfect. The location is literally a 2 minute walk to Wrigley Field and 10 minutes to the CTA train to take you where you want to go. The place was accommodating and exactly as advertised.  It made our first trip to Chicago a relaxing experience.

I had a lovely week staying in Jevaux's unit. It had everything I needed for living/remote work for a week including 2 A/C units which was so helpful during a heatwave. Street parking in the neighborhood was not hard to find. The WiFi was fast.  The bed was comfortable. I would absolutely recommend this listing to anyone visiting Chicago.
This was the perfect place to stay for a Cubs game! It was super clean and we could walk everywhere we wanted to go. We would definitely stay here again!

Book this place!! The view of the lake is gorgeous. His place feels like a friend’s, not a stale Airbnb. The location is great for lots of shopping and sightseeing. Very clean and clear instructions from host as well.

Really nice apartment in the heart of Chicago! It is a ~5 minute walk to the L station which made getting around incredibly easy. The place was spotless. Our only suggestion would be to put darker colored blinds in the living room as it stayed illuminated for anyone sleeping on the air mattress. We would stay again!

Wonderful hosts!  Kind, thoughtful communication—very friendly and accommodating. We loved everything about the apartment and the neighborhood. Honestly if they were renting it out we would love to live there.  Super clean and absolutely anything one could need is provided. Feels like home the moment you step in!
We had a great time staying here with Jorge and his team. They were very responsive our entire stay and the place was cleaned perfectly. Highly recommend!

Cute. Convenient. Cozy.
Great neighborhood with restaurants and public transportation.

Had a great time at Nikkole’s home. She was super responsive when he had questions and gave great local recommendations. The home was cute and in a good area. Close to a lot of places. Would definitely stay again

Nathaniel's place was perfect for what we needed. All the amenities for traveling with kids and plenty of space to spread out a bit was very appreciated. The rooftop space was so sweet, kinda wish I had more time to spend up there. I'm a huge fan of the neighborhood. Tons of places to walk to and grab food and drinks. Couple of well-priced bodegas nearby makes it so that you don't really need to leave the walkable area.
Would absolutely stay here again.

This is a lovely apartment, well-cleaned, and with helpful amenities like laundry in unit!  Our host was responsive, and even brought us masks during the unusually bad air quality from Canadian wildfires.  Be aware there are no ceiling fans in the bedrooms, though there was a table fan.
Great location, cute house, convenient parking! 10/10

What a fantastic place! It was just three of us traveling so it was much more space than we needed but it would be perfect for family traveling together. It was just near the train, we took walks over to the beach, used city bikes. (We are city people ourselves so we love taking advantage of the all city perks!) We loved watching the World Cup final right around the corner at a spot with the rest of the neighborhood! We hopped right on the train to catch the Cubs game. (We found a street parking spot easily then left the car there and used city transportation but there was also a paid lot right on the corner.)
We did hear the train from the rooms...and we LOVED IT. (Again, we are city people.) It is s gentle, slow rumble as the train passes and we really enjoyed it.
Great spot. (Oh and catch the French bakery for sure.)
I had such a wonderful time in this gem of a space. I would come back in a heartbeat!

Host was very responsive, when we checked in there was an odd smell coming from the bathroom but host sent a cleaner to check it out. The view is beautiful and great location. My only complaint is that someone came in while we were out of the bnb for maintenance and we weren’t told anything prior.

Our group enjoyed our stay at The Rectory! Super walkable to Lincoln Park hot spots and within walking distance to the L to get to other places in this city. David was communicative with check in details which we appreciated. We would definitely stay here again!
This airbnb was a very cosy space! It was close enough to transit so getting to the well known parts of chicago was super easy
We had a great time here! Super close to brown line, cafe just around the corner, and the inside was spotless and very spacious. Neighbourhood is very safe also. 10/10 recommend
Great place!

Unfortunately, we were extremely unsatisfied with our stay. Although the location is in a nice spot/area- the Airbnb unit itself did not meet our expectations. Not only does it look absolutely nothing like the photos, it was also very dirty and unkept.
There were multiple bugs flying around inside upon entry.
The refrigerator was a bit dirty on the outside with God only knows what. Not only was it dirty, but the refrigerator door did not close all the way without having to place something in front of it to keep the door shut.
The entryway stairs are unpaved- which I would consider unsafe not just for us but for other guests as well.
There were stains on “clean” towels in the closet, and there were stains on some of the pillows in the common areas like the living room as well.
The microwave was absolutely filthy
The shower did not drain at any given time. And there was no handwashing soap for the washroom.
Very disappointed with our stay, especially considering how much we paid.

This apartment was great! It was a quick walk to the L and then you’re just a stop or two from the heart of downtown Chicago. The rooms are as described, with walls that go all the way and each has its own bathroom right across the hall. Our trip was for two couples, so the layout was perfect for us.

The unit was very clean, excellent layout for separation/privacy for members of the group. The middle bedroom is a bit too small for 2 adults (no accommodation for folded clothing), so unit is most comfortable for no more than 5 adults.  Late arrivals should be aware that there are no amenities such as bottled water or coffee for the first morning.  The Dollop Coffee shop mentioned in the instructions is no longer in the building, but there are nearby options.

Thomas and Sarah's place was great! I loved the location, and the check in/out process was smooth. The room was clean, AC worked well, and to address other reviews, the drain/bathroom smell was present, but not overpowering. Overall the stay was nice, and I hope to be back!
The house was great. Loved the brick and hardwood floors. Rooftop area was fun to hang out on. Very clean and comfortable. Would definitely stay again.

We had a great stay at Miriam's place, the apartment was beautiful, clean, and had a well-stocked kitchen with everything we needed. It comfortably fit our group of 3, and could easily accommodate 5 people. We especially enjoyed the patio and garden, they were great spots to relax. The neighborhood was peaceful, but still within walking distance of plenty of bars and restaurants. We'd definitely recommend staying here and would happily come back!
Henry's place was what I needed very affordable. I would highly recommend this place to others.

Wonderful location and outstanding host. Shawn is very responsive and was so helpful with sharing recommendations for things to do in the area and tips on using public transportation. I can’t recommend this Airbnb enough as a great place to stay to explore Chicago! Thanks Shawn! : )
Exactly as described. Plenty of room.
We had an amazing time seeing a couple of Cubs games. The Airbnb was exactly what we needed for this trip!

We were visiting our daughter for a long weekend and this met our needs very well. It is as-described. The host was responsive. The location is great. It's on a quiet residential street that seemed very safe and a short walk to restaurants and shopping. We used the Diversey Brown Line station which was about a 10 minute walk. We also walked to Wrigley for a Cubs game.
Only downside was the entry is dark at night. The area seems safe so we didn't feel unsafe, but we had to use our phone flashlight getting in at night.

Our experience was mixed. Before our trip, the host was very responsive and accommodated moving us to the upstairs unit due to an issue with the one we originally booked. After that, communication became much more limited. Several questions we sent before arrival were never answered.
The home was generally clean, but we found some basic items, such as hand soap, laundry detergent and blankets for the pullout couch, were missing and the kitchen wasn't as well equipped as we expected based on the listing.
As far as appearance, the home was very welcoming and matched the pictures well. The immediate neighborhood surrounding the house was beautiful and quiet. As visitors unfamiliar with the area, we were less comfortable walking to and from the CTA, particularly in the evening.
Our stay was unfortunately cut short due to an unexpected issue with the property. Airbnb assisted us, and we appreciated receiving a refund for the unused nights.
Emily is amazing! So incredibly accommodating and responsive. The place was perfect for our needs and worth the money for sure.

Ugh Sadly the  place was gross, not just dirty floors and appliances, but they even had 6 air fresheners trying to hide the smell. We just couldn't stay. Mera tried to move us to another spot, and even though we were hesitant and probably should've just gotten a hotel, we gave it a shot. It was cleaner, but no washer and dryer like I paid for, and mold in the shower that definitely needs fixing. Plus, no hot water during our shower, probably because of all the units in the building. The pillow protectors were gross and stained, so I'm glad I brought my own pillow. The bed only had a fitted sheet and one blanket, no flat sheet, and they only gave us two bath towels. And get this, three different codes just to get in the place? Insane. Honestly, this was the most disappointing lodging ever. Mera was good about responding, but seriously, we should've just gone to a hotel.

We had a wonderful stay at Jay’s apt. It was a great location for getting to Wrigley field, close enough to walk but not so close as to be disturbed by all the hustle and bustle that occurs in Wrigleyville.
The apartment itself was very clean. All lights, appliances, faucets, etc. worked as expected. The beds were comfortable and enjoyable to sleep in. There is nothing like falling into a nice, crisp clean bed after a hot shower and a long day walking the streets of Chicago. I could easily do that here. We would absolutely stay here again.
Nice place. No couch for sitting. Just table and bar stools.
Nice, cozy and affordable place to stay. Host is properly communicative.
This was a great space for our family in town for a wedding. David checked on us a couple of times and provided everything we needed. So great to have a garage so no hunting  for street parking.

This apartment was in a great location, and it was so convenient to use the L to get around the city. We enjoyed being able to walk to the Field Museum and Shedd Aquarium and having excellent restaurants within walking distance. The apartment faces west, and in the summer, it really helps to close the blinds before leaving for the day to try to minimize excess heat in the space. Staying here worked well for our visit to see a concert at the United Center and some of Chicago's other famous places!
Convenience of public transportation was appreciated. Cleanliness is important to us- and we were not disappointed!  The amenities were plentiful. Thanks Ag and team!
The apartment was very clean and exactly as described.  For those familiar with Chicago the location was easy to get to and navigate to and from.  I would definitely stay there again.

My family and I had a great stay here! Very comfortable and accommodating  after our long day in the city. We were surprised at how nice it was when we arrived. Just like the photos described. Parking wasn't too bad either.
Nice accommodations, great value, and responsive communications.  Very recommended, I look forward to my next stay here.

We had a party of 10 stay at Jean’s place. What was so nice was we had the full house but one family was able to stay downstairs while the other stayed upstairs. So you have some privacy if you want it.
The house was very clean, that’s always a big item for me. The kitchen was fully stocked. They had all kinds of cleaning supplies, kitchen bags etc. The bathroom was fully stocked with soaps, shampoos. Bedrooms were very comfortable with extra blankets and pillows.
The outside was so beautifully maintained!!
It was a great neighborhood to walk, find locate restaurants and grocery stores.
My only complaint would be that we couldn’t really sit on our porch because when the air conditioning was running all the hot air would come through the deck.
I would definitely rent again.
I so

We had a great stay in this place, location is perfect with local bars and restaurants yet easy access to the downtown. Leo and Alex are super friendly and responsive, if I’m ever back in Chicago, it will be top of my list

Had two wonderful nights here. Spotless and perfectly equipped. These hosts are true pros. I loved the personalized manual, thoughtful design, comforting bed, that it was walkable to restaurants, some of the best house music in Chicago, the coolest movie theater nearby, and in a peaceful setting... Highly recommend this as a home base for exploring Chicago. I would definitely book it again!

Fantastic condo right in Wrigley! Took us 5 min to walk to the stadium! Loved the area and could walk everywhere.
Condo was clean and accommodating
Overall, great place to stay. Lots of small cafes and restaurants within walking distance.
Great Host, unit had everything you need, very clean and an easy walk to Wrigley Field. 5 Stars.

Great small apartment, with very comfortable king bed, perfect for 2 people. Very nice stay with coffee, tea supplied. Great air conditioning. Just so others are aware, apartment is close to a rapid transit line, can slightly hear the train go by but not too loud. Also be aware 3rd floor(3 flights, no elevator). Overall a great apartment to stay it.
Had an awesome time with the family in Chicago!  The space was very clean, well-stocked, and having 3 bedrooms with big windows was definitely a plus for us.  Would definitely recommend!

This is my second time staying at one of Laura’s properties, and I was, once again, delighted by the accommodations. The apartment was beautifully decorated without being cluttered. The kitchen was well stocked and I felt very comfortable.
Laura is always prompt and helpful with her responses and I am looking forward to my next stay in Chicago’s Pilsen neighborhood!

Victor & Rudia were very accommodating & responsive hosts. They went above & beyond for me to ensure my stay was a smooth one. Location described with complete accuracy. Location is ideal & proximal to much of the big downtown sites. Would certainly stay here again!

Enjoyed a long weekend with my family in Logan Square.  Reinaldo's place is conveniently located to too many great restaurants and bars to ever visit in 4 days.  Easy access to many other locations in Chicago.  The accommodations were perfect for the 4 of us and fit our budget perfectly.  I would absolutely stay here again next time I'm in Chicago.

The home featured enough space for our large party, and overall has good bones though current upkeep leaves lots to be desired.
I initially booked for nine guests, though by 6/1, 3 guests had dropped off. I reached out 6/1 (trip 7/16-21) to amend reservation to six guests which constituted a refund of around $343. This request went unanswered until I followed up on 6/28, to which the host replied "guest count doesnt matter unless you go over." I then explained the pricing difference in app, which ultimately led me to reach out to Support, where host finally accepted amended reservation.
Upon arrival, we were met with thick cobwebs behind front door, a kitchen with no working dishwasher with food inside, burnt pepperoni in oven, a large hole in main floor shower wall with no hot water, and various trash inside box spring in main floor bedroom amd filthy mat taped to floor in upstairs bath, amd both shower liners were full of mildew/pink slime at base.
We walked to a restaurant & the grocery store. Most people initiated greetings as we walked by. It was a nice neighborhood with friendly neighbours.

Sarah's place truly felt like a home away from home. Super quiet and private guest house in the back made my friend and I feel super safe and comfortable. We will definitely come back again to this AirBnB if we are in the area again!

Amazing place to stay! Beautiful inclusive neighborhood, felt safe at all times even walking at night. room smelt great and was clean. Really appreciated hangers in closet and heater. Bathrooms were clean and easy to shower etc. Although others are staying there as well, everyone is very private and keeps to themselves. Overall amazing stay and would recommend!

What a wonderful place to stay! We had two nights in Troy’s beautiful home and loved it! Super clean and comfy and tons of room! Very easy to get to any place in downtown- this was a dream spot. Would definitely stay there again!
We had a great time staying here! Very spacious for a group stay! Location was perfect for what we needed.

Jorge's place is right in the Lake View neighborhood, near Roscoe Village. The apartment is small but comfortable for one or two people (as long as you can manage stairs - 3rd floor walk-up with no elevator). Jorge was always quick to respond to questions and very helpful. It was the perfect place to use as home base.
There are lots of restaurants in the area, a huge Whole Foods store across the street, and multiple CTA (public transit) options nearby. It was an easy walk to Wrigley Field, just a few blocks to an L to the Loop - super convenient! The neighborhood feels safe. Parking is limited if you have a car, but there were reasonable options within a fairly short walk.

Great location and friendly host.
Very steep stairs might be an issue for anybody with mobility challenges.
Gloria place is cozy and comfortable , perfect for a weekend stay with all the amenities you need.  I enjoyed the community and felt safe walking my service dog around.
Clean, convenient, comfortable.  A great place meeting all our needs. Fernando was most helpful.
Nice and clean place, host was very communicative
STAY HERE!!! Incredible location, pristine apartment, and clear, regular communication. We were only here 2 night, but I could have stayed a month.
Good location. Easy access to great food and attractions. Space was just as advertised. Super responsive host. Great stay!

We greatly enjoyed our stay at Heather and JP’s place! The location is central to countless restaurants, shops, and cultural destinations, and the nearby area is charming and walkable. The space is cozy and well-appointed, and we loved spending time in the secret garden. Heather and JP are friendly and very responsive to any issues that arise.
We had a wonderful stay. The location was  walkable to lots of locations. The house was lovely and so were the hosts. We would definitely recommend!

This was my 3rd or 4th stay at Tomasz’s place. It’s a lovely place — well-appointed, pristine, new appliances, cozy — all in a quiet, peaceful neighborhood. Easy walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants, shops, parks. Tomasz and Ewa are wonderful, responsive hosts. I obviously love it since I’m a repeat guest! Highly recommend without hesitation.

This place was very nice and clean. I liked it because it was close to all the places in downtown Chicago.  I wish I would’ve understood Chicago parking a little bit better, that probably would’ve helped me some some figuring out my destinations.
An awesome space with a friendly/communicative host!
5 Stars! Thank you so much Gloria!! We will never forget to Chicago ❤️

Felixa and Rene were truly exceptional hosts! From the moment we booked, their communication was warm, thoughtful, and welcoming, making us feel at home before we even arrived. The photos don't come close to capturing how beautiful this place is. It was immaculate, stylish, and full of thoughtful touches. The beds were incredibly comfortable, the cookware was excellent, and they even thought of tea drinkers! Every detail felt intentional. The bathroom was stunning, and when we had a question, they responded immediately and were so kind. They also provided fantastic recommendations for kid-friendly activities, restaurants, and dessert spots that made our trip even better. Yes, the stairs are steep, but even our 2-year-old managed them with supervision. Parking fit our Hyundai Palisade, though it was snug. We would book this Airbnb again in a heartbeat and recommend it without hesitation. Thank you for making our stay unforgettable!

I really enjoyed my stay! Everything was clean and cozy well organized. Claudia was kind, responsive, and made sure everything went smoothly. I had a great experience and would happily booked this place again.
Great space for our family of 4 visiting Chicago!  Definitely big enough for more people.
Great location and clean place. The hosts are very communicative and made our travel experience easy and comfortable.

Wills place is exactly as described: clean and comfortable in a great neighborhood. Will was responsive and helpful with requests. The unit was perfect for 11 of us, bunk beds very helpful. Would stay again in a heartbeat!
La ubicación está muy bien por todos lados llega un transporte público, ya sea metro estación Damen o un bus, hay tiendas cercas, el barrio es limpio y pasamos de noche y se sentía seguro.
We had a great stay! Location was close to the blue line train, with lots of restaurants / shops in easy walking distance. Would happily stay again.

From the get go, Yara was upfront, thorough, prompt, and super friendly. Her description was spot on, and all questions we had were answered. The location was great. We were just blocks from the Green and Pink Subway lines, as well as just a block from the #9 Ashland bus line. Anyone going to United Center for a concert or a game (bus line goes to Ashland and Madison), or don't want to spend the money to stay "downtown", I would highly suggest this location, and this host. Lastly, this was the best stocked kitchen I have ever had at an airbnb, Yara, we truly thank you! Cheers!

This was a great place to stay and we would definitely rent here again! The apartment was so open and spacious! It is comfortable and decorated so tastefully. We stayed with another couple so we really appreciated the placement of the bedrooms and separate bathrooms.
Donna was excellent! She communicated often, gave clear instructions and was super friendly! She made it seem as though she was as excited for our visit as we were!
Great place to stay in Chicago!!

Martha’s place was perfect. We were in town for a concert. Her place was comfortable and beautiful. Great kitchen, 2 bedrooms. Very comfortable. We required parking permits to park on the street and Martha had those right away for us. There’s great restaurants in the neighborhood and we’d strongly recommend the Parkview Restaurant Grill. Had an amazing breakfast there. This will definitely be our go to place for our next visit to Chicago!

This condo was perfect for two people going to two shows at the United Center. Amazing location, great communication with host, easy to access, warm inviting space, and it was wonderful to have a washer and dryer. When I let the host know that the toaster was broken, she instantly sent another one. Couldn’t ask for a better response.
The only challenge to be aware of is that sounds from the upstairs neighbors really carry into the condo. Two nights were fine and two nights were not - the neighbors were up past 1:00 AM and then up again around 7:00 AM. Music, loud talking (usually can’t hear individual words), a blender, and every single footstep was heard in the condo.
Nice place. Good location to restaurants, the train, and Wrigley field.

Beautiful stay in Chicago! Perfect location!
Everything was clean and comfortable.

​You really can't beat the location. It’s nestled on a quiet, beautiful tree-lined street, yet just a short walk to local cafes, restaurants, and public transit. We loved being able to walk to Lincoln Park and the lakefront so easily. The space was spotless, cozy, and looked exactly like the photos. We would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Chicago and highly recommend it to anyone visiting!

Great location. Small things like broken blinds bathroom ceiling had some peeling paint, small stain on one of sheets, entrance was really dirty but shared with others. We did not do our research and realize it was in the area it was. We quickly realized it was not a location meant for our boys as we walked by make GoGo dancers with nothing but speedos on. Great location for a Cubs game just would not bring kids next time.

Location and townhouse were perfect.  Attended a concert at United Center and this was perfect.  Place was spotless, walkable to United Center, and safe. Easy uber to downtown and anywhere else you want to go.
Great place to stay if you’re exploring Chicago.

We were looking for a place close to downtown but wanted a house due to traveling with an infant. It's an easy drive into downtown. Kitchen and bathrooms are very nicely updated. The property manager was very nice and responsive. Exactly the place we were looking for to stay for a few nights.
Convenient location, nice neighborhood, a garage for smaller vehicles I would stay here again.

We had a great time here! The bed was comfortable and all the appliances worked well. The location was absolutely beautiful - we didn't use public transportation so I'm not sure if it'd be good for that - but we had access to nearby yummy food, a convenience store and it felt very safe!
Incredible location within walking distance to everything.  Loved the amenities in the complex.  Looking forward to staying here again in the future.

Great clean space with plenty of room for our group of 6. Walkable to some restaurants and a quick Lyft away from everything Chicago has to offer. Milan was helpful, communicative, and always a quick message away if I had any questions. A+ location, would definitely consider staying again!

This was everything we wanted it to be. For an end-of-summer family getaway, we surprised our 9 and 11 year-old boys with two days at Wrigley Field. This peaceful, clean, and beautiful home allowed an easy, safe walk to and from both the day and late night finishes at Wrigley! Also allowed a quick and easy walk to go back and forth from the Wrigley area pregame to bring some shopping back.
Angela was more than accommodating and quick to respond with any questions or needs. Couldn’t have asked for a more ideal Wrigleyville experience and hope to stay here again!
My family and I will definitely stay here again  a really good spot to be when you’re visiting Chicago. Love it!
Perfect spot to stay for a couple nights, easy to get around the city with all the public transport nearby.

Mostly great: very nice, clean, can’t beat the location.
Downside: We wished there was a room darkening shade.

Our son just moved to Pilsen so we were looking for something close to him. This was perfect as far as location for us. There is a parking spot in the back which was ideal. We walked to wherever we went in Pilsen-tons of good restaurants. Took the train to Wrigleyville and the bus to a concert at United Center and we felt safe at night walking. It was clean. He was very responsive and had some extra supplies in a closet. We didn’t use the kitchen or anything so I can’t speak to that. Can’t think of anything that we needed that wasn’t there. But we just needed a place to stay really. We had 4 people with us.
The home was beautiful, well decorated, comfortable for a family with young children, and in a great location.

Amazing stay, bed was super comfortable!
Would love to stay again!
Great apartment. Nice and clean. Perfect location 5 mins way from downtown. Highly recommended
Great place to stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Communication with the host was easy, and the check-in process was smooth. I would definitely stay here again

The pictures do not do this place justice. It was beautiful and big enough for our family of 4, two of which are teens! The area is a in a great and safe location  Amenities were as described and perfect for making breakfast for the week. We loved it!

We had a great stay at Brad's place!  Six adult family members stayed together to attend a concert at United Center and explore Chicago over a long weekend.  The location was brilliant.  Five minute walk to the United Center, and close to the rail station to get around the rest of town. Kitchen was very clean and well-appointed.  Beds were comfortable.  Neighborhood was very quiet overnight so we could all get a good night's sleep.  Brad responded quickly to all messages which was really appreciated.
Easy street parking. Quiet building. Be aware there isn’t a stove.

Great stay overall! I’ve stayed at Jennifer’s Airbnbs in the past and always had a good experience. This space is such a cute little suite! Bed is comfy, kitchenette is well-equipped (even has an air fryer!) and the price can’t be beat. Recommend for solo travelers or couples bc it’s small.
Our family had a great stay!  Perfect location, friendly responsive hosts and very comfortable.
Very nice place to stay for the budget! Recommend!
I enjoy my stay at Tim's house. would recommend

Perfect, affordable stay for my family of five. Comfortable beds, clean space and walkable to public transportation and coffee shops, restaurants and convenience stores. Would stay again in a heartbeat. Thanks for an amazing stay, David!
I really enjoyed staying at this property. The host was very friendly and responsive. The place was very clean and spacious. The beds were VERY comfortable! I’ll definitely recommend staying here!
Worked for what I needed!
We really enjoyed this condo! And in such a fun area! They did a great job of communicating with us and being so helpful with everything I asked for! I would highly recommend this unit!

Excellent stay. Immaculately clean space, also stays very cool for which was I was extremely grateful for during this summer stay. Alberto was a great host; at one point the battery died in a door lock and he was very quick to replace it. Highly recommend this location.
Tim was very responsive and has a great location. Home was great access to the trains and theres also good eats at a walking distance.

This lovely Airbnb truly felt like a home away from home! As a native Chicagoan, I appreciated how perfectly situated this spot is in Edison Park—it is a perfect location within easy walking distance to great shops, restaurants, and convenient train access. The space itself is spacious, cozy, warm, and inviting, featuring a remarkably comfortable bed and a cute back porch that we loved. Erin and her family are phenomenal hosts; they went above and beyond to ensure our comfort while still giving us the space to feel completely at home. With plenty of amenities and a cozy atmosphere, it was a flawless stay. We are already planning on being back again and again!
I would 100/100 recommend this for a stay. Great location and beautiful home. Top notch!

Tara’s home was very clean, easy to access, and the perfect location as we visited family nearby! Her communication was clear, prompt, and so kind. We will definitely remember this location for future visits! Londa
Great location. Great host. Great city! Tell Harry that Jason sent you, and order a #5 from Wrigleyville Dogs.
Great stay
perfect little spot, base camp for 2 days in Chicago. super clean, super easy, was a lot of fun. would recommend
Place was nice and cozy and was close to everything we wanted to do. Jeannette was always able to answer any and all questions we had.
Clean and quiet space . Hosts explained directions perfectly. Will be coming back to stay again
Lovely place! Safe, great location, well decorated and clean.

Our family of five enjoyed our time at Greenleaf very much. The toys were a big hit when were stuck inside during a bad wildfire smoke day. The whole place had us feeling at ease and Sarah was always nearby to answer any questions.
An excellent very responsive host.  The apartment was perfect and in a great location!

Michael was very quick to respond to our messages and very helpful when we had questions! The apartment well very well kept, clean, and comfortable! We didn’t venture out into the area but felt safe during our stay! Overall we had a great stay at this location!

The roof top balcony was dirty no one maintained, the hallways were muddy and smelled . The apartment was exactly as advertised which was absolutely great and the owner was good.
Likely just the way it is but I am old school hosting with kindness not money based early arrival I think should be accommodated with in an hour or so.

We really enjoyed our stay.  The property is in a perfect location.  We were able to walk to many bars and restaurants.  The property is comfortable and matches the description.  We wish we would have scheduled a longer stay!  Parking is street parking,  but there was no issue finding a spot on a side street.  We would recommend staying at Glam Hidden Gem and hope to return in the future.

Very nice place! Convenient location, short walk to wrigley field and all the shops, restaurants and bars in that area and surrounding neighborhoods. Easy access to get to the L to travel to the downtown area. Very Comfortable bed and the cooling system was very refreshing. Looked forward to getting there every evening after log days out & about! Would definitely stay again and recommend to others.  It is on the second level so some stair climbing is required to access. Not a problem for us, but could be for others. Enjoyed the little extras offered there!! Thank you David!!
Overall, a nice place. Nonresponsive when someone took our parking spot and the rat was a concern.

perfect place to stay if you’re wanting to stay in chicago without needing to stay directly in the city! short ride to get to the city if that’s where you want to visit, and very walkable. and my bf walked to the beach a few times during our stay and we love it!

Isabel's house was great! It was exactly what we needed for our baseball trip to Chicago. The blue line was literally right around the corner. We were worried that there wouldn't be any street parking, but Isabel assured us that it wouldn't be a problem - and of course she was right. I would totally stay there again! Many thanks for a great location, clean home, and easy access to everything we needed!

My friends and I had such a great stay at Karen’s place. The views of the city are amazing and the place was comfortable for 3 people. Karen was responsive when we had questions and the place was really clean. We would definitely book here again.
If you are planning on attending an event at the United Center this is the place for you. It comes as advertised and is a short walk to that facility. Exceeds expectations.

Owner was very responsive and helpful, which was great for a first-time Airbnber like me. House was a great value for the money for our party of 9, and the kids really enjoyed the Pac Man arcade machine.
Great spot! Highly recommend.

Maria and Slava have a nice place and has all you'd need.  There are stores within walking distance and they were great about checking to see if I needed anything and if did, would provide it asap.  Everything they indicated would be present was in the unit and more, great hosts
Great place to stay when visiting Chicago.   Short walk to the lake and to restaurants.

Great place to stay! They mentioned potential noise so I carried some earplugs with me, but I really didn’t need them. The bed was absolutely amazing, the place was really clean and they were always responsive. It’s extremely close to the Riviera Theater, and they offered great restaurant recommendations, which I always appreciate. I would definitely stay there again!
Great place and wonderful stay!
It was a great location with some restaurants and stores close by. Walkable to Wrigley, which is why we were there. Host was very responsible and helpful.

Ming is a lovely host! She was very proactive and quick to respond. Everything you need to know about the place is outlined carefully and easy to find. We had a different schedule from the listed check-in and check-out times, and Ming was gracious enough to let us be flexible with that.
The location is well connected. The Pink Line is within walking distance, and there are lots of frequent bus routes in the area. Pilsen is bustling with life at all times, and you'll find every type of store you may need not far from the house.
Having a kitchen and laundry in the building was a huge plus. We ended up cooking some of our meals at home, and the kitchen had almost everything we needed. Overall, it's a lovely, very homey place! Thank you, Ming!

This was a great spot to hold all 8 of us! Paul was very responsive and helpful with any concerns we had. The back patio was wonderful and we loved that there was enough room for all of us to relax together. Parking was a little tricky, but so worth it. Within walking distance to a ton of restaurants and not too far from public transportation!
We felt so confortable in this home. We came for our daughter’s wedding and it provided lots of space to get ready. We liked the artsy feel and comfy beds. The showers were great!
Host made it very easy to get in an out at late night hours getting in for a work trip, great spot, great location!

Great stay overall! The place was easy to find and the entry instructions were clear and simple, so check-in was smooth. The host was fantastic — went above and beyond to bring my deliveries inside before I even arrived, which was such a thoughtful touch.
The only downsides were noise-related. One night there was a loud argument between a couple out on the street that woke me up. Also, the upstairs neighbors have kids who run around every morning, and since the floors are wooden, it carries a lot — light sleepers might want to bring earplugs.
Would still recommend, especially for the host’s hospitality, but worth knowing the walls/floors aren’t the most soundproof.
Great location, quiet surroundings, nice apartment with brand new appliances

The place was perfect for our needs! Within walking distance of plenty of food and/or coffee options, and the neighborhood was pretty quaint, with an artsy feel.
I LOVED that the air conditioner was already set at a cool 64 degrees, and I slept like a baby!
If I find myself in Chicago, I’d go back if available.
It matched the description and was perfectly workable for the single individual who stayed in the room.

Great location, walking distance from most tourist attractions and the red line—for those who want to go see the cubs (and who doesn’t!). Apartment was clean and housed our family of 6 well. We really enjoyed the pool.
Place was lovely and I thought it would be in a sketchy area but it was actually in a pretty safe and peaceful area

pros: we were able to leave our luggage to wait for check in and check out. we were able to do laundry. close to restaurants. will use again.
cons: very long stairs. linen has a smell i think from not properly dried. my son pointed that the kitchen smells the first we entered. it reminds me of philippine smell. nearby restaurants opens at 11am.

We had a wonderful stay! The house was exceptionally clean, and everything looked exactly as pictured in the listing. The appliances and furnishings were all new and made the space feel modern and comfortable. The neighborhood was quiet and felt very safe, which made our stay even more enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this home to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable place to stay.
Such a sweet spot. Loved the neighborhood and the hosts were very communicative throughout! Would stay there again!
Thank you for a great stay and being so accommodating. This rental was great for a quick city visit! Very accommodating hosts.

This Airbnb was in a great location, red line train station was about a block away. Plenty of things to do in the area. The private balcony’s were great too! I will say the street was very busy and noisy especially on the weekend, obviously not faulting the host on this just busy downtown Chicago! We would definitely stay here again!!
Space is as described.  Good location, close to Blue line station and United Center.
Everything was great!  Thanks Josh!
Great location and the host was very communicative! Nice clean space, perfect for a quick trip.
Excellent location. Would stay again.
Parked the car on Sunday and did not have to use till we left on Tuesday. Very walkable.

The host was very responsive, communicative, and provided clear instructions, which we appreciated.
Unfortunately, the unit was not as clean as expected. The floors were so dirty that our socks turned black after just a few steps. There were stains on the bed sheets, fruit flies throughout the apartment, the kitchen sink was unclean, and a noticeable mildew smell. We also felt the listing photos did not accurately reflect the current condition of the space.
While the host was easy to communicate with, the cleanliness and condition of the unit made for a disappointing stay.

We were in Chicago for a concert at the United Center. This place is perfectly located in a nice area close to restaurants and coffee shops. The room was nicely updated and decorated with the antique look of the property. The bed was comfortable and the window AC unit worked very well. The stairs are steep but it wasn’t an issue for us. Plenty of paid parking nearby so we had no issues finding a spot. We will definitely stay again when visiting the Chicago area.

Great location, the area is so nice and easily walkable to the L and to Wrigley. The instructions to get inside were very helpful and easy to follow. Perfect little spot to come back to after long days of being out and about. Would stay here again!
This property was excellent, the host was attentive.

This is an excellent place to stay. First of all, the location is amazing—it’s directly across from a beautiful park, the Museum of Science and Industry, and Lake Michigan, making it a perfect base for exploring the area. The building is historic, well maintained, and full of character. As an added bonus, there’s also a great restaurant connected to the building, which makes grabbing a meal incredibly convenient.
The studio itself is cozy, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped with a full kitchen, a nice TV, and all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay.
I would definitely recommend staying here and would happily book again.

Such a beautiful townhouse that reflected the owners style in the furnishings as well as artwork too!
The home was well equipped in every area; kitchen, bedrooms, and bathrooms.
The beds were quite comfortable.
It was a great location with a lovely Italian restaurant across the street and delicious Mexican around the corner. Not far from Wrigley, zoo, train and more! I highly recommend this property. The owner responded very quickly to any questions we had.

I stayed for five nights and paid over $2,000. The location was excellent, and Dimitri was responsive, but the property did not provide the comfort expected for the price. The kitchen had no microwave, which made it difficult to reheat food. The bathroom was outdated, with chipped paint, and only two thin bath towels and two small face towels were provided for two guests. Extra towels reportedly cost $50. The air conditioner was extremely loud, close to the bed, and made sleeping difficult, while turning it off made the room too hot. The television was only in the bedroom, and the furniture was not very comfortable. The property needs updating and better basic amenities. Unfortunately, I would not stay here again.
Great decor, comfortable bed and bedding. Efficient use of space. Well equipt for a short stay, convenietly located garage space was a huge bonus. $20 Uber to Willis Tower.

Rida replies really fast. they were clear about everything
good experience and location for the price
Great place. Clean and peaceful. Walkable location to public transportation. Exactly we needed for a few days exploring Chicago.
Exactly as described and pictured, and Cyndi was very communicative. Extremely close to all the best that Chicago has to offer!
Excellent location if you're visiting the city. One block from the trains and Whole Foods. Close to the beach too.

The house was not what it looked like in the pictures—it was much smaller than expected. The listing also stated it was only 10 minutes from downtown, but it actually took about 25 minutes to get there.
The bathroom was not as clean as it should have been, the couch had several stains, and the bed sheets didn’t seem very clean either.
Another disappointment was that we weren’t allowed to drop off our bags before check-in unless we paid an extra fee. If early bag drop isn’t included, I would at least expect the property to be thoroughly cleaned and ready when we arrived. Overall, the experience did not match the expectations set by the listing, and I was disappointed.

Very friendly host. Space was clean  with easy parking. My first night, there were some neighbors with a lot of people outside chatting and talking next to the building late into the night, but that’s not the hosts’ doing. I would just suggest taking ear plugs just in case. However, my second night was very quiet and peaceful, so that might have just been a one off, like a graduation party or something. Overall, had a very nice stay.
Dom przestronny, komfortowy, zlokalizowany bardzo blisko metra. Okolica spokojna po rewitalizacji. Gospodarz komunikatywny polecam

Michael and his friends responded to every question promptly and thoroughly. The location is close to the center of Chinatown, the Red Line, and the Chicago Water Taxi. Parking our rental car was convenient. The brochure they provided was very helpful.

We truly enjoyed our stay at the Dugout. It was perfect for the 3 of us. We were in town to catch a Cubs game, so being 6 houses from Wrigley was important to us. Although the location and setup was great, what truly set it apart from other places we have stayed were the hosts. Bret is clearly detail oriented and had things lined out beforehand with parking permits, Clear parking instructions, restaurant recommendations and little things like a welcome sign with my name on it on arrival. You won’t have to worry if you will get a response from the host if you need anything. Bret’s communication was on point and although we didn’t have any issues during our stay, he checked in multiple times to ensure our stay was going good. I would definitely stay here again the next time we are in town for a Cubs game.
We had a great experience at David's Codfather in Wrigleyville.
Benjamin was very responsive. Nice and clean place, 10-12 min to the Blue line.
Cute and quaint place in a walkable neighborhood. Neighbors were super friendly. Great hosts and very communicative.  My husband and I will be booking again for our next stay in Chicago!
Clean, well kept, and great location.
Great place!
Very nice place! Close to the subways! Would definitely come back!

A really exceptional space. If you want to stay outside downtown Chicago — and we do — Logan Square is an excellent choice. Everything we wanted was easy to get to, either walkable, a short drive, or in the case of Wrigley Field, a convenient bus ride away.
The apartment itself was impeccable. Super clean throughout. Special touches like a welcome gift basket, another basket of toothbrushes, toothpaste, shaving acc and other things you might need.
Tamara was great with communication, proactively reaching out and keeping in contact.
Parking was no problem. Every time but one we were able to find a spot close to the front door. The only time we couldn’t we found a spot right around the corner, maybe a minute away.

This is a beautifully renovated place with great bedrooms and bathrooms. Also had a great kitchen and prep space, which worked out great for us, as we hired a local catering service that was awesome. While everything on the inside was great, the neighborhood is just ok.
It was easy and the room was super nice and the service was top notch
Really enjoyed our stay in this adorable two bedroom- Super clean and the beds were very comfortable!  Parking was a bit challenging but overall a good place to stay if you’re in the Chicago area.

This was a family vacation of four adults and we enjoyed our stay here very much. We try hard to find homey places rather than those that look like an Ikea showroom. Don's place is in an older house, decorated in an eclectic array of treasures but did not feel cluttered. The three sofas gave us ample space to sit comfortably, a good sized dining table, high ceilings, and a large well stocked kitchen all added to our sense of comfort and space. The ensuite bath is tiny, but critical for 4 people and the main bathroom has good storage space. Great neighborhood-walkable to Wrigley, restaurants, shops, the lake and, very important to us, transportation. Both the Brown and Red lines are close by. It was very hot and humid, so having air conditioning indoors, especially all three bedrooms, was a godsend.
Don is a terrific host. Necessities are well stocked and we wanted for nothing. He is responsive and helpful. I would recommend his place for groups of sports fans and families.

This place met all of our needs! It looked exactly like the pictures and was very clean and well-maintained. Not much noise from the people above us. It is on a VERY busy street, which made it a little more difficult with toddlers, but there was typically street parking right in front of the house and the street noise didn’t really bother us at all.
Phoebe was very responsive when we let her know the pack & play listed in the amenities was nowhere in the house and she had a new one delivered to the house within an hour. We were very grateful that she took care of our needs so quickly!
The checkout process was much more simple than other Air BnBs we’ve stayed at as well. I would definitely recommend this house and host.
Enjoyed our stay!   Been to Wrigleyville before and stayed at another place close to this location, but next trip will look to book here again!

I enjoyed my stay at Giillermo's place. The room and house matched the photos, and the hosts were proactive in communicating everything I needed before my arrival, making check-in straightforward. Also, the home is in a convenient location, with a short bus ride to nearby shops and other amenities. Thanks again!

This is my second time staying at this Airbnb - and definitely won’t be my last! Any time I visit Chicago and I need a place to stay, I always check to see if this spot is available!
Located in a great area of Chicago, this Airbnb is not only incredibly affordable, but is also located right by a train station.
Edwin is also a very friendly and helpful host - always quick to respond and ready to help you with anything you may need.
Jane and Francisco were very kind throughout our whole trip. The neighborhood was amazing, lots of things to do in walking distance. I would 100% stay here again.

Perfect in every way! We immediately felt at home in this beautiful apartment! Carlyn is an incredible host and has thought of everything! The location was perfect for a family weekend enjoying the Lincoln Park area and walking to a Cubs game! Truly fabulous!!

We enjoyed our stay at Brandon’s! Short walk to Wrigley Field. We were able to park our car early in garage and ended up checking in early.
We were pleased with the cleanliness and space! We will definitely stay again!

This place was incredible. Paul was an amazing host and helped out incredibly when we needed him to, even late at night when he wasn’t expected to. The place was clean and accurately described, the area was amazing and Paul himself introduced us to the place and gave us a tour on our first day, even leaving us milk! He was very welcoming and his place was very clean, spacious and overall just amazing! Would definitely stay again if given the chance!

This was our favorite place we have ever stayed. Todd and Tripp are the most wonderful people, and as another couple deeply in love it was so wonderful to be with same. Their dog is amazing, the space is amazing (the back patio is done ZERO justice by the photos!), they are amazing. We were sad to leave! ❤️
It was as described and Tone was very attentive in responding.  Nice place with cute extras like the pop tarts left out and waters in the fridge.  I would book again.
This is fine second time we've stayed here and will be back!  Such a cool location, yet silent in the room. So clean and fresh, lovely place!

I loved this place for the most part, but WARNING: There is an event venue below you and it is VERY loud. You can hear people’s conversations, the walls shake from the bass.. it felt like the party was right outside my door.
It only happened on my first night, but I’m a heavy sleeper and I was very tired, so I tuned it out easily and slept soundly. The rest of my stay was event free so it was quiet. Walls are thin so you hear everything happening in the apartment, but it’s not a huge deal if you’re just there to sleep like me.
Apartment and room were immaculate, very comfortable and clean! And I felt at home when I was in the room. Loved that!

Amazing place. Super walkable, neighborhood felt extremely safe and lively. Lots of restaurants and things to do, place was really easy to find. The airbnb itself was cozy and felt a lot more spacious than expected. Had everything we needed. Definitely one of my favorites, would 100% book again.

Mimi’s  place was just perfect for our stay! Enjoyed the walkable neighborhood and we even walked home from the concert at the United center. Very well stocked with everything you could need, spotless and Mimi was very helpful and responsive. Would recommend  her home 100%
Great!
Karen is the best Air BnB host I've ever experienced. Friendly, extra helpful, concerned about our comfort. The unit is spacious and in a convenient, quiet location. Highly recommended.
Easy stay! Comfortable bed, space to spread out, and quiet. As advertised!
Great stay!
Cozy and quiet stay

Spacious apartment. Very clean. Very friendly and responsive host. The only downside was the shower in the guest bathroom had very weak water pressure.
Otherwise, great for staying in Hyde Park.
Great stay! Very responsive!

Overall, I had a good stay. The place was comfortable.
It was a bit noisy when staying in the basement unit because I could hear people walking around upstairs.

Really enjoyed the house -- it was perfect size for 4 guys traveling into Chicago for some concerts and Cubs.  Impressed with cleanliness and had everything we needed in the bathrooms and kitchen.  Highly recommend.

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Kyle's coach house.  The location is perfect with its close proximity to the train and walkable streets.  There are many good restaurants and shopping within walking distance. Kyle was very responsive to any questions we had and provided great recommendations of places to eat.  The space was just as described with a comfy bed and nice AC. We look forward to visiting the city again and will definitely be staying here again!

The basement apartment was perfect for our stay. The kitchen is somewhat basic in terms of dishes, etc., and the cracks in the sofa bed hadn't been vacuumed. But the neighborhood is beautiful, the proximity to all of Chicago's great attractions was extremely convenient, and check in/check out were very easy. We really enjoyed our stay and would stay here again.
Milan siempre estuvo al pendiente de nosotros.

Beautiful place, up to date, extremely clean. Downstairs neighbors were great. 2nd floor neighbors we did not meet. The unit is located in a great neighborhood.
We didn’t have a car so we were looking for something that was within walking distance to Wrigley Field, the bars, and the restaurants. We took the red line to Wrigley and within a 4 minute walk we were at their rental.
We would definitely book again the next time we are in town for a game.
Thanks for sharing your place with our family!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean and well-maintained, and it’s close to all the major attractions, which made getting around so easy. The Airbnb had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The host was incredibly nice and welcoming, and made us feel right at home. Highly recommend!
Great stay and close to United Center, easy walk to and from our concert.

Clemencia and Michael are super responsive and helpful. The garden apartment is easy to enter with a keypad. Plenty spacious and very clean, and very comfortable mattresses! I didn't use the parking space but it is very accessible in the alley. Wifi is excellent, and checkout instructions are posted on the back door if you can't find on your app.
As a former resident, Logan Square is one of my favorite restaurants. The location is two blocks from the Blue Line (to O'Hare and downtown). Sunday farmers market in the square is a can't miss! Many great restaurants. If you love Chicago neighborhoods and avoiding downtown hotels, this is the place. I hope it's available every time I visit the city, I don't want to stay anywhere else.
Lovely place, well organised and everything you might need. We had a hard time finding the parking (it's down an alley) and the furniture, in general, is hard.
Great place. Clean and well kept. I would stay there again.

The apartment was great! We were in town for Rush concerts, and it was perfect for me and the other two guests. It was well stocked with water, coffee, tea, and much more. The bathroom was nice with plenty of towels and washcloths. It was one of the nicest AirBnb’s I have ever been in. And the documentation that was provided there was easy to understand and covered just about anything about the place you would want to know.
Thank you Alina for a wonderful place to stay for our trip!
Mike
Great Host!
Brandon was communicative and friendly. Hopefully we can find a time to use the property again.

I had a very good stay at this Airbnb while visiting Chicago. The host was responsive whenever I had questions, and transportation was extremely convenient, which made getting around the city very easy. The apartment is also surrounded by a lot of great Asian restaurants, so there were plenty of good food options within walking distance.
I also really appreciated that the Airbnb has two bathrooms, which is a great feature, especially if you’re traveling with another person or a group.
Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to someone looking for a comfortable and conveniently located place to stay in Chicago.
Good place!
Great location, excellent accommodations, very well appointed home. Comfortable, lots of space and very cozy.

Great condo in a fantastic location!  The Red Line is directly outside the building, which made it super easy for us to get around.  Old Town has some fun restaurants and everything you might need (grocery stores, drug stores, and more). Don’t miss the rooftop balcony — some great views!

We lived our stay here. Ryan was a communicative host and checked in on us after our first night to make sure everything was ok. The shower here is amazing!  Plus, there were some nice touches, like a fan in the bedroom and a filter pitcher of water in the fridge. The neighborhood felt safe; I even waited outside for a Thai food order at midnight (we attended a concert and weren't hungry beforehand, but definitely famished afterwards).  The parking was always very easy to find. It was a small apartment, but the price was right for a Chicago stay and perfect for two adults. I will keep this one on my list for the times I travel into Chicago!

This place is in a great location but it had a number of issues. The place did not feel like a penthouse, it was not clean and sheets had stains. The title seems to imply a level of luxury "Penthouse" that was not present. The interior had some noticeable  dry wall and interior patch work, and there was a lot of maintenance that is needed. The refrigerator went on and off, and was not working properly. We had to use a step ladder to access the top bunk bends which I found to be unsafe and outside of being reasonable for this advertised level of accommodation. The view was great from the roof top with the hot tub. The folks at the bar below were great and neighborhood was a definite highlight. Although this place was not worth the $1500 I paid for 2 nights. I was very disappointed, and a little embarrassed having my family stay here.
Laura was very responsive and helpful, answering quickly. Her place was so nice, just as listed. She anticipated everything a guest would want and need. We had a great time at her Airbnb.

We just got back from a week stay at Cloud9. The view from this apartment is absolutely breathtaking! Out in the balcony you see the entire City! Unfortunately they did not have table and chairs out there even though there are pictures of that on the listing. The apartment itself is beautiful. There were a couple of problems with the amenities. The listing says coffee pot but there is only an espresso machine, not a coffee machine. The shower has low pressure and it goes from scalding hot to cool throughout your entire shower.  The beds seem smaller than a queen mattress so we pulled out the roll away bed and one of us slept on that and it was very comfortable. The location is right in the heart of Fulton Market with tons or restaurant and bars. To get downtown you have the blue line close by but choose to Uber. Overall it was a great stay minus the coffee.
Enjoyed our experiance.

The place itself was cozy and spacious, but I was not satisfied with stained bed sheets (the host replaced it with the new one, but I had to make the bed by myself) and the limited number of towels provided (2 people stayed for 3 nights, but only two bath towels available).

Perfect location
Very clean
Cute space
Great, close to blue line , clean and nice

This place was great! The area is awesome - just a few minutes walk from a red line stop and easy walking into Andersonville and the Argyle stop (with a lot of awesome Vietnamese restaurants). The space itself is nice enough. The kitchen is nice, there is plenty of space.
As other people have commented, the furniture isn't terribly comfortable. The couch is pretty uncomfortable. We weren't using the couch TOO much, but we have a young kid who wanted to rest on the couch. I also found the queen bed pretty stiff/hard and uncomfortable. So, if you are sensitive to hard beds, that's something to know.
