Iris was a fantastic communicator though!! And the video that shows where to go is very helpful. And check in was super easy!!
great location and value!

We loved our stay at Glenn and Laura’s place. They were very accommodating and communicated very well with us. The Air Bnb
was in a great location and was nice and quiet.
Wonderful location, wonderful host. The best part was great sheets, pillows and beds!

Jamisyn was a great host, very communicative!  Place was thoughtfully decorated and we had plenty of snacks, coffee, etc.   walkable to both United Center (we were there for a concert) and a wonderful grocery store.   (Pete’s).  Would definitely stay there again and recommend to everyone!

Sarah was so helpful! She stayed out of the way, but she asked for permission for letting the neighborhood use our front lawn for a block party. She was also very understanding.
The whole house was very comfortable, spacious, free of bugs, and extremely clean. As a very particular person, I found this place to be calming at the end of a day of travel. Especially for the low price, I'd highly recommend this location.
For those who would like to use the kitchen for complex dishes, I would recommend bringing a couple hot pads and measuring cups, but the kitchen was outfitted decently for most purposes. Overall, the stay was wonderful--thank you Sarah!

The space was as described, easy communication & check in.  Super clean!!  Nice appliances and fixtures.  Very comfortable beds/ linens.  We did need fans as the bedrooms didn’t have ac vents, but the rest of apartment was very cool.  Leah provided us fans for the bedrooms and the rooms were adequately cooled by fans. There isn’t much insulation for soundproofing between floors, but that was mentioned in the previous reviews & not a big deal.  The neighborhood was nice, safe and quiet.  We would definitely recommend staying here!
Very nice place, and very peaceful

Great condo, as described and matching the photos.  Perfect walkable location with big grocery store and pharmacy across the street with a full deli and hot food buffet.  Host was very responsive and professional.  Will rent here again.
Clear instructions for entry, clean place, easy to find. Would definitely stay again!
Had a great time. Loved drinking coffee in the garden. Ample street parking. Very walkable.
Danielle was friendly and very nice and great to talk to and get to know. Great place and easy to find and was close to concert event I was attending. Would highly recommend!
I would stay here again! Nice spot!
This is the second time we have stayed here and will continue to stay here when we visit Chicago.  Great apartment and excellent location!

Place was as described and a perfect location.  So convenient to walk out right in the middle of the shopping and restaurants of trendy Andersonville.  Would recommend and definitely stay there again.

Apartment was filthy, broken, and extremely unsafe. The blinds in the living room are absolutely disgusting and have a foreign substance splattered all over them. The walls throughout the apartment are filthy. There appears to be blood on the wall and side of the cabinet in the kitchen. Absolutely disgusting. The shower is inoperable. The water does not properly divert from the bottom faucet to the shower head above. There are no secondary locks to the front door of the apartment to secure it from the inside. Anyone with a code has 24 hour access to the apartment. We could not secure the door from the inside. The lock does not work properly. The door does not shut properly. Extremely unsafe. The WiFi does not work. Info provided by host was inaccurate. WiFi we were told to join by host does not exist. Tv channels do not load. This apartment should not be available to rent. It is filthy, broken, and unsafe.
Stay far away from this place.
Rob’s place was clean, spacious and convenient.

We had a great time, with no trouble getting in. Our host was very responsive. Beds were comfortable and the unit had plenty of room for 4 people!
If we're ever back in Chicago, we'd stay there again. Just note, there is parking for only one car. Ubers are always available and convenient to downtown and over to the United Center.

The Orange Cat apartment was so nice! Brought my father downtown for a game at Wrigley and it was a 20 minute walk away with lots of fun restaurants and bars along the way. Jason had phenomenal local guides and house guides on the table waiting for us that had great local recommendations and easy to understand instructions. Everything was spotlessly clean and the beds were very comfortable. Can’t recommend this place enough, hope we can stay again soon!

As others have said, this is really a hostel. A private room or rooms and shared bathrooms and kitchen spaces. There were some issues upon checking in with the condition of the assigned bathroom, but they were remedied with being granted access to another bathroom and shower on the same floor. Overall great location, near transit, responsive host. Basic accommodation with shared facilities.

Excelente ubicación! El departamento te hacía sentir como en casa, super bien equipada para poder cocinarte y desayunar. Las habitaciones muy cómodas, los colchones deliciosos para dormir, al igual que las almohadas. La vista imperdible a los edificios. Sin duda me volvería alojar en este lugar

Perfect location for going to Wrigley, hands down! So many choices of restaurants/bars in the area to walk to. The apartment was mostly quiet, directions are spot on how to get in. I cannot stress how much I loved not having to do chores before I left, so please don't ever change that. Loved the fact that the fridge came ready with a cold Coke and water purifier too. The emergency Pepto, toothbrushes and tampons in the bathroom was a great touch. Pretty good, considering the 100 year old building and neurotic host.

Great stay, good convenient location in Wrigleyville near loads of pubs, shops, places to eat. Just about all ya need ya can find in that area or near it.  The hosts very kind and communicate quick. Will definitely book there again if available when needed. Thank you

First of all, place was super cute! Loved how the apartment was decorated! The surrounding area is very chill and walkable. Very easy to use public transit to get to wherever you need to. I would love to book this place again when I come back to Chicago.
Thanks for the hospitality!
Great location, prefect place to stay if you have an event at Wrigley.
Özlem was very communicative — great host! The place is small but looked exactly as advertised in the photos. The location is close to lots of bars and restaurants in Old Town.

As my cousins said AWESOME AF. Great location with easy access to transportation both public and private. Next to the Green Line so if you're not used to city noise ask to be on the street side but I slept fine. McCormick, Chinatown are within easy walking distance. The museums and Soldier Field are quick drives. Definitely coming back to stay again
Great location. Served our needs well.
Great time and place to hang out with family.
The owner needs to stop renting out
Aside from the mold in the corner of our room and the random bug in our bed it was nice.

Had a great stay while attending a convention at McCormick Place which is a quick 10-15 min walk.  20 min walk to Chinatown. Easy access to transit station.  Restaurants and corner grocery nearby.  Value was great!  Stayed with my 82 yo mother and two young adult children. We were comfortable, able to do food prep, work remotely, an elevator, enjoyed the gym, well equipped laundry facilities, nice touches like spare toiletries and herbal tea bags, and the price was less than two hotel rooms for 4 nights.  We were able to store the key fob in the lock box which made it convenient for the 4 of us to access independently.  Only concerns were it took several days for the wifi to come on line, the building is adjacent to an alley and a parking deck so there was some noise from car alarms, carpet in the hallway needs cleaning but the rental unit was very clean.  The hosts were very responsive, pleasant and professional.  Would definitely stay again!

Petra was very welcoming! Her place was spacious, functional, and cute. She provided everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location was also great, we were able to park our car and easily utilize public transportation the whole weekend. The neighborhood felt very safe, and being able to walk to Wrigley was another plus! We had a great time and definitely would stay again.
Really enjoyed our time in Chicago. Very beautiful abode. Would recommend to others.

We had a lovely stay! The apartment is in an older building, which we actually really enjoyed—it gave the place a lot of character. The location is fantastic, and we had everything we needed. We were also pleasantly surprised by how quiet it was considering how central it is. We could hear the people in the apartment above us occasionally, but it was minimal and didn’t bother us.
There was a small issue with the toilet continuously flushing at one point, but Ensavi responded really quickly and had it fixed for us. Just one of the little quirks that can come with staying in an older building, which honestly added to the charm for us.
Thanks for a great stay, Ensavi!
Thank you for hosting us. We loved it! 🥰

They apartment looked great, the location was excellent. We really liked how easy it was to reach the places we planned to visit. After we tired ourselves walking downtown were a 10 minute effortless drive back. We plan to stay there again!
Beautiful, welcoming property and equally wonderful hosts! So friendly and kind - even when there was an issue with a stubborn dead bolt! 🤣 I've already booked a return stay!
Great spot, easy to get to all parts of Chicago from, while still coming home to a place with easy parking. looking forward to staying at Oscar's place again on our next visit.
Enjoyed our time..very comfortable place to stay.
Nice place to stay with a larger family! Rich was responsive and helped with all of our needs!
The apartment was great. It was really clean, great location, and comfortable. While the kitchen was clean, it was missing a few essential tools and parking was a little tricky.

Saurin was a great host. The home was very welcoming and comfortable. It was very clean and in a nice location. The communication with Saurin was top notch. I would not hesitate to stay at Saurin's place again. He was an excellent host.

The pictures do not quite do the apartment justice.  It is much larger and more spacious than the pictures indicate.  Tons of room and really cool layout.  The bedrooms are large.  Kitchen right in the middle.  And the living room overlooking the street was charming and nice.  You cannot beat the location as it is right in the heart of RiverNorth and as soon as you step outside you are in the thick of things.  Getting in and out was simple and the neighborhood is safe and active.  We really liked this spot and I would come back in a heartbeat with my family (8 of us) or on business.  I brought my 6 kids and they loved it.  We all fit and had plenty of room.  Geo is a great communicator and helped us the one time we asked about something.
Interior of building was recently renovated. Place was super clean.
Loved the space, Darin was a great host and easy to communicate with. We had everything we needed beds were comfy, liked the hand held shower head. The decor was cool! Would highly recommend
Comfortable & stylish.  Walkable to restaurants & free parking.  Kitchen is well-equipped. Comfortable beds. Responsive host. 15 minute drive from downtown.  Perfect for our brief trip!
Great location, off highway, safe neighborhood, free parking, close to Blue Line.  Clean and quiet location.   Host responds quickly to any questions.
Me encantó la casa creo que volvería a solicitar su disponibilidad en otro momento, nos la pasamos súper bien con los amigos y lo mejor tienen una coscona súper equipada
great!

This place was perfect for our family to hang out and attend a Cubs game, be close to the field and all the bars and restaurants in the area.  We really enjoyed it and would 100% recommend it to anyone staying in the area.
We checked in and left, the smell of cigars and other was unbearable. Blind were broken. The building was dirty and saw roaches as we entered
Perfect place to stay !

Ann’s place was great for our short stay in Chicago. The space looks just like the pictures and is very easy to access. However, when you have parking listed as an amenity in the listing, it would be helpful to know that it is with a permit that you need to request ahead of time. We parked at the cleaner’s next door, which was fine with us. But for people with multiple vehicles it could be a challenge. Otherwise, Ann was prompt with her responses and the area of Bucktown was beautiful with lots of shopping and restaurants!

Adam’s place is an absolutely perfect place for anyone looking to enjoy Chicago in the summer. It is a short 5-10 minute walk to Wrigley Field and the lakefront is easily accessible. The unit itself is absolutely fantastic. Immaculately clean, modern, spacious, and extremely comfortable.
The unit is located on a somewhat busy street so there is the usual city street noise, but it was absolutely no problem and nothing a good set of earplugs won’t block out. We slept wonderfully for our entire stay.
Adam was also an incredibly gracious host and was extremely responsive to our communications. We could not figure out how to turn the AC on upon arriving, but he responded within 30 seconds to help us turn the air in (which had been turned off by the cleaners).
I cannot recommend Adam’s place enough and we will certainly be back.
Good spot to stay while in Chicago. The neighborhood was safe and quiet. Would definitely stay here again.
This place is in wonderful neighborhood River North, full of great restaurants and bars and close to public transportation. The master bedroom is very spacious. A good home base to explore Chicago.

Grateful to Lois and Eduardo for sharing their lovely space.  A well crafted experience and everything I could need.  An easy walk to the beach, or the train, or the bus.  I travel solo, mostly, and found the area easy to navigate.  The room very comfy and sharing a bathroom quite lovely.  Highly recommend.
A nice and comfortable stay at Rafael's place, with a separate private bathroom to ourselves. The beds were comfortable and about a 8 min walk to the nearest subway in a quiet suburban area.
Great stay across from Grant Park. Unit was  small but had everything you need. Fast WiFi was great for work. Excellent views, especially from the roof deck. I’d stay again.

The airbnb was exactly what we needed for a 10 year college reunion. We had 13 guests and the place had plenty of rooms and amenities. We made use of the rentable tables and chairs for our hibachi night out on the patio. The host was responsive to any questions and provided wonderful instructions prior to (and during) our stay. Recommend for a large group looking to have fun in a perfectly located spot!

The house is well equipped and in a great area - close to shops, restaurants and transit.  Matt was very responsive when we had issues and came over to fix a door that slipped off the hinges.  We had 9 people and fit well in the house.  The house is on three separate floors so it made it easier for some of our group to stay up and others to sleep, get up at different times etc.  There is a grocery store a couple of blocks away and restaurant, bars and shops a few blocks away.  It was totally worth the splurge.

Great Place,,, great location. Easy to get in
Many thanks

Absolutely loved staying here! Check in/Check out was very easy and Alma was very responsive! The home itself was very clean and a wonderful landing place for our stay! Quiet and walkable neighborhood!
It was exactly like the pictures, and very clean. It met my needs and was exactly what I needed for a couple days !!

We visited Lincoln Park for 2 nights to attend my daughter's college orientation. It was a great location, we were able to walk to restaurants for breakfast and dinners. There are probably 6 or 7 coffee shops within 2 blocks of the apartment and several cute gift shops and other retail. The apartment was cute and clean. We enjoyed sitting on the back deck in the morning. 3 bedrooms and plenty of shared space. Very comfortable for 4 full sized people. The couch is huge, all of us fit together and watched a movie our first night in town.  Check in was seamless and we had no problem finding parking. The host provided a sticker/parking pass one night and there is free parking on one side of the street, which we were able to score the first night. Highly recommend this property.

Marco and Sarah’s place was great! It was one of the nicest I’ve stayed in. It was spacious and clean. Little extra touches was icing on the cake…like a full size ironing board instead of a tiny table top one! Meet all our needs and then some.

Ken and Curt’s guest house was a peaceful respite within easy walking distance of the L and bus stops. We especially enjoyed reading Ken and Curt’s stories about how they furnished their Airbnb. We will definitely stay here on our next visit to Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly friendly, checked in regularly to make sure we had everything we needed, and was always available if we had any questions. Their kindness and attentiveness made us feel very welcome. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.
The house was fantastic, gorgeous all  was fantastic. The description was perfect and Elizabeth is an amazing host.
Tim & Barbara were super friendly,  we felt right at home and the house was beautiful and clean. All the wrigleyville attractions and stores were also within walking distance. Honestly no notes

The home was easy to find,  the host provided clear instructions and was very responsive when we asked questions or needed assistance. The home was a great value and not too far from the places we were going while in town! We were a little unsure of the neighborhood and parking situation as the street filled up quickly and we had to park around the corner late at night. The home was clean and well stocked with necessities. The main concern was that this is a basement apartment with very low ceilings and my husband is 6 foot tall. He hit his head multiple times walking through the home. The host did nothing wrong in that regard, it was just a struggle for him particularly when using the restroom in the middle of the night. This home is definitely a great place to stay if you want to be a little bit further from downtown and you don’t want to spend downtown prices for your stay!

Perfect spot. Very walkable part of town. Cozy and comfortable with everything we could have needed. Most importantly, very clear instructions on entering the building. Very much appreciated the recommendations for things to around the city. Would stay again!
We had a great time! Perfect place to sleep, enjoy Netflix, walk around the neighborhood, and get coffee. Didn't have any trouble with the people upstairs!!
This place was great, close to literally everything you do in the city! The place was great, clean and accommodating with the amenities provided. Thank you for hosting us.
Beautiful place & very cozy. My family and I enjoyed my time there and will definitely be coming back! !!!

Great place for our short stay! Very close to everything downtown Chicago has to offer. Clean space, full kitchen, looks just like the pictures, extra linens and towel available in the building, very responsive host, safe building, would definitely book again!

We enjoyed our 3 nights at Candice & Enrique's place. Enrique met us and helped us carry up our luggage even though it was a bit late when we arrived. When I book an Airbnb, the things most important to me are a comfortable bed, light blocking window treatments, and quiet; and this place had all three! Furthermore, it has character and nice amenities like hardwood flooring (if not real wood it's a good imitation), an arched interior door frame, a comfy couch, and good name brand bath products. Thanks Candice & Enrique!
This was a great base from which to explore different parts of the city. Everything was clean and neat. We especially enjoyed the record player and the eclectic collection of records.
Amazing apartment in an outstanding neighborhood. We had never stayed in Ravenswood before and I highly recommend it. David was an outstanding host and we’d definitely stay again.

We had a great time at Sara and Salvador’s basement apartment. We were able to park directly in front of the house upon arrival. Easy 10 minute walk to the L or 20 minute walk to Wrigley Field. Can’t wait to book again for our next Cubs games!!

Location is excellent! It’s in the buckingham student housing so super safe and secure. Literally half a block from Michigan ave. Our particular unit was on top floor with great view of buckingham fountain.
The beds are memory foam, which isn’t my favorite but fine nonetheless. The central AC seemed to not work or work poorly. They did have fans and nice temporary AC units which kept temperatures nice.
We used only public transportation while here and it worked great. It’s maybe a 5 minute walk to the L station. Plenty of places to see and eat at within walking distance.
If you’ve got the money I highly recommend this place for ease of transportation and the views!

We were in Chicago for a family wedding; Anne's lovely home provided a perfect space for our family to gather and rest between events.  It was truly like being a guest at the home of a thoughtful friend.  Anne made sure that everything was spotless, comfortable and well appointed with all of the items that you might find yourself saying, "I wish I would have remembered to bring…"  A few examples include a steamer, umbrellas, sunscreen and even dental floss…I could go on.  The location was convenient to all the areas we needed to get to, and the street has a wonderful neighborhood feel.  As frequent visitors to Chicago, I think we have found our home away from home.  Thanks, Anne!

My group of 5 stayed at Studebecker fam's place during our trip to Chicago during the World Cup finals. Our host was on top of communications, with clear instructions for check-in, restaurants/bars recommendations, and would proactively check in on us during our stay.
The place has really nice high ceilings, very comfortable beds, and two bathrooms to share among the 5 of us during our stay. We were able to use the TV to watch the world cup final games, use the water kettle, and settle into the place like our home.
Studebecker fam even offered to extend our stay and a separate private area to keep our luggage when our flights got cancelled on the day of our check out. Despite we didn't accept the offer, we truly appreciate their thoughtfulness. Overall, I highly recommend this place if you're in town in Chicago!
Great accommodations!  The home was beautifully decorated- would definitely recommend it!!!
Really enjoyed staying here! The place was clean and as described. The location was slightly inconvenient as far as getting downtown, however was great for what we paid and very clean.
Had an awesome stay. Very clear instructions and also accommodating. Nice quiet area.
We can’t say enough positive remarks about this host and unit.  We have stayed in this unit for multiple years and each time we have never been disappointed.
We had a great time and would love to come back here

Our daughter lives a few blocks away, so this location was absolutely perfect for us - but that wasn't even the best part!  This apartment is adorable beyond words, super comfortable, beautifully maintained, and super fun.  Access is easy and straightforward, all amenities work perfectly, and the decor was creative and intriguing. The host's communication was amazing, and I felt like a treasured guest in this home.  A truly terrific experience.
Lovely studio apartment attached to a beautiful and peaceful garden.  Located one block off main road with restaurants and music. 15 drive to museum campus and lakefront.

The hosts are nice and responsive and the neighborhood is very walkable. Unfortunately, I had to find a new Airbnb after checking in. I couldn’t stay inside the unit for more than 5 minutes and didn’t feel comfortable opening my suitcase much less sleeping there. The place was very dirty with soiled sheets and a noticeable odor. Probably from the lack of widows in both the unit and the building. The building is very, very old and in major need of repair. You would be better off in a motel.

David was a great host that always responded within the hour and gave concise answers. The home itself was beautiful and pristine and in a great neighborhood. Close to shops and restaurants of all types and a perfect neighborhood for family’s or just a group of friends newer to big cities. I would stay here again without a doubt if I found myself back in Chicago. 10/10

We had a great weekend in Chicago.
The Dreams airbnb was top notch. It was just as shown in the pictures, clean, everything we needed. Coffee was a nice bonus.
Location was good for us. Walkable to restaurants, bars and the United Centre.
I would book again.

Great location that served very well as our launch pad and landing spot for museum, aquarium, and the planetarium visits. Easy walk to transit/bus lines for the full Chicago experience. Host was responsive and helpful.

Stacey's home was just like the pictures. Very clean apartment. Nice & Quiet neighborhood. The AC went out briefly during our stay. Stacey quickly rectified the issue, and the AC was back working in no time. We appreciate it!

I really enjoyed staying here. The place was very clean, and the bus stop right in front made getting downtown quick and easy without a car. It wasn’t a big issue for us since we were exhausted after exploring the city all day, but you can hear footsteps from neighbors fairly easily throughout the building. Overall, it was a great stay, and I’d definitely recommend it.

Natalie is a gem of a host, and her place is just perfect. We loved the neighborhood, and the space couldn’t be more comfortable and well appointed. It was the perfect spot to rest after walking around Chicago all day. My kids loved the big windows and comfy beds, and I loved the rooftop deck. Natalie has anticipated anything you might need during your stay. Those little details made our stay exceptional. I’d love to stay with Natalie again.
Great location, clean place, and easy access to public transportation made getting around simple
Christina is the best! We had a lovely stay.
We had a great experience here! Md was so nice and always responsive. I would definitely stay here again!
Florin and Claudia were super responsive and made everything easy. The neighborhood is great and the place looks exactly like the photos. I would stay again in a heartbeat.
We had a great time and very easy to access the freeways. It felt nice and private.

Esmirna was very nice and accommodating. She communicated well and timely. Her place was like the pictures. It did have a notice cat smell, so if you're sensitive it might not be the perfect choice for you.

Th neighborhood was beautiful. Everyone had lots of flowers and plants.  The place was clean and had everything we needed.  There was a grocery store and coffee shop right around the corner.  The bus and train were very close and took us wherever we needed to go!  Plenty of restaurants to walk to.  I would definitely stay there again!1

Jennifer’s place was one of the best- if not the best- Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. Everything was exactly as described, and honestly, it looked even better in person than it did in the photos.
Three friends and I were in Chicago to watch the Tigers play the Cubs at Wrigley Field. The walk to Wrigley was a little over a mile and a half, and we felt completely safe walking to and from the game, even afterward. If you’re looking for an authentic Chicago experience at a great value in a quiet neighborhood, this is an excellent option.
We were a little concerned about street parking before we arrived, but it ended up being a non-issue. We found parking right near Jennifer’s place and left the car there for our entire stay. I’d absolutely stay here again and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to others.
Best communication we have ever had.
Loved our stay it was amazinggg:)

Only stayed for one night and one full day but this place was everything I could’ve wanted. Everything was so sleek, so clean, and beautiful.
Our host was extremely kind and responsive to our check-in and out concerns, as well as providing super clear and helpful instructions for finding our space.
Perfect for our small vacation to Chicago

We had a great visit to Chicago, and this AirBnB was beautiful and in a great location. We did not have any issues with noise, and the neighborhood felt safe. We were able to park on the street as promised, which was very helpful. We had a few glitches during the visit. On arrival, the key was not where we were told to find it, though the host responded right away and helped us out. At night, we realized that there were no sheets for the sofa bed, and there were not enough towels in the bathroom. The host got us what we needed the next morning. Overall, it was a positive experience, though I was surprised that we did not have all the amenities we needed.
Val was great! The place was perfect and had everything we needed. Super walkable and matched the photos
Awesome spot, in a great location, busy, yet quiet. Walked to Wrigley and a few local breweries. Would 1000% stay again.

We were a family of 4 on a summer vacation for a week. We had a great time in Chicago and the target across the street was extremely convenient. However, we did have quite a few issues during our stay and the host was unresponsive. There were 3 barstools instead of 4 like in pictures. There was a huge strain on the desk chair, so we didn’t use. Knob on the gas stove was broken and actually created a gas leak during our stay, huge safety hazard. What made things worse is the host never responded when we let her know. The balcony door made a loud noise every time you opened it, and so did the bedroom door. No chair or table on balcony. There wasn’t a shelf in the shower so all the toiletries went on the floor. AC units were loud and woke up the kids multiple times throughout the night when the AC would turn on. Primary bed squeaked every time you moved. Beautiful views of Chicago through the huge windows but the blinds could definitely be upgraded, or at least get pull strings untangled.
Thank you so much for all your accommodations.
A great place for our small family! We were able to walk or take the train everywhere we wanted. The hosts were very responsive to any questions we had as well.

This was by far one of our favorite places to stay in Chicago! Joe and Shannon were super friendly, accommodating and made us feel right at home. Their space is beautiful — just like the photos, and was a peaceful place to come back to after a busy day in the city. We will be back!

We had a great time in this apartment and it worked really well for two adults and two children. It was completely spotless and the beds are very comfortable. You really have everything you need and we could have stayed there longer. The location is really cool and there are tons of options at your doorstep, including a really nice supermarket. The hosts were also very responsive and helpful which I really appreciated. Thanks for having us!
Had a great last-minute stay. Thanks for making us feel welcome!
We loved our stay at Mike's place. The carriage house had everything we needed, and was very dog friendly. Parking was easy, and the location was perfect for our time in Chicago!
Thank you! My kids and husband truly enjoyed Chicago! Love your place❤️🌺
Great place in Pilsen!

We had a great time here! The place was very clean, especially the bathrooms and kitchen. Very cute decor and enough sitting for 5 adults.
Emma was extremely responsive, replying back within minutes to my questions. She was also very flexible with checkout.
You are in Little Italy and there were many restaurant and cafe choices within a block walk.
Highly recommend!
Keith was great and his place is even better!  It’s such a great location and such a cute place!

Small and clean, as indicated in the listing. The entryway of the building (outside of the host’s control) was messy and felt kind of dirty. We kept the bathroom fan on to keep the place from smelling like smoke. Per others’ reviews I brought ear plugs and eye mask, I also put on a sound machine and with those helps, I slept well each night!
Had a great stay here, couldn’t have better located for all the things we did. Walked to Wrigley Field in 7 minutes, fun coffee, bars and restaurants all with in a few blocks. Loved it!
Fun neighborhood, easy to get anywhere in the city. Host was knowledgeable and helpful.
Everything worked out very well for our Chicago trip and it was very convenient for our visits to the Chicago Art Institute and Shedd Aquarium.

Was clean enough and worth what we paid. The biggest advantage was the location—it was an easy walk to Chinatown, which made getting around really convenient. If you’re looking for a budget-friendly place in a good location and don’t expect luxury, it does the job.

Perfectly located in Roger’s Park, with easy access to the Red Line and Lake Michigan, this is a great place to stay while in Chicago for one or two people. The full kitchen is especially nice, and the bedroom/living room space (even as a studio set up) is spacious and comfortable. The neighborhood is fairly quiet and full of restaurant choices, with plenty of opportunities to check out farmer’s markets and local events.
The only small note I have about this rental is the shower doesn’t have great water pressure and it takes a long time for the water to get hot, but this is probably an issue with the building itself. Otherwise, I highly recommend this rental!
Het is een hele prettige buurt en op loopafstand van de bruine lijn (een bovengrondse metro die je direct naar het centrum van de stad brengt) Lekker rustig slapen dicht bij de grote stad

This is our second time staying in Ryan’s home. First was a basement room which was pretty nice. This time we had this room and loved it even more. Extremely comfy bed and sheets. The room layout is so nice with a comfy couch as well. The decor of the room is excellent. Mini fridge worked great. Bathroom and half bath close to the room. Just a great space to stay, so unique and charming at an excellent price. We will be staying here again!

Exactly as described. Home was squeaky clean upon arrival. Great location my family & I felt very safe. Host was great at responding in timely manner. Overall Great place to stay. Thanks for having us as guests😇

Exactly as listed online, Josh was a great communicator and the neighborhood/area had really good food options and isn’t far from beaches. Price made sense for the amenities and room itself, as well as the fact it’s in the city, not far from public transit, and other restaurants/shopping.
Second great stay for us at Jason's place.
Great host! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Communication was quick and easy, and everything went smoothly.
Very clean place. The location is very convenient. The owners were very communicative and helpful.

Perfect place for large groups looking for inexpensive and reliable housing! Airbnb was in a beautiful neighborhood and was not too far from major Chicago activities. There’s also plenty to do in the neighborhood itself. Beds and couch were incredibly comfortable. The place is small, but for a trip with more than 3 people, it didn’t feel that way. Free of bugs or weird smells and was overall a positive to my trip.
The apartment is in an amazing location ! So many things to do and try

Loved the location, quiet but close to shops and restaurants.
Felt safe walking in the neighborhood.
Perfect parking and comfortable space.
Great deal for the price and host response was prompt.
Will definitely stay there again.

Great basement apartment in Lincoln Square. It was better than the pictures, clean, had all basic amenities. We loved exploring the neighborhood. Used the train and bus to get to the beach, downtown, and Wrigley Field.
Walkable area, easy access to Metro and Wrigley field. Amazing diner around the corner.
Great location for events at Wrigley. Walkable to the park with plenty of options to stop for food or drinks in between.
This location is great. About a block and a quarter from a very fun street with shopping, food and fun! Great host and will definitely book again if we visit

We enjoyed our stay at Sara's place. It was conveniently located near the train and local restaurants and shops. Bonus that it was only a few blocks from the people we were visiting! We loved the classic design features of the apartment.

Great location and amazing hosts. Carlos & Laura were very responsive and the condo is beautifully designed, very comfortable space for two couples. My favorite was the heated floor in the bathroom!
Tips for future guests-
It is loud with the eL being right at your back door, we did get use to it and we had a sleep mate machine which helped, our travel partners not so much.
Bring your own washcloths, there were only 2.
Takes a hot minute for the shower off kitchen to warm up.

Good overall experience. I personally found the pillows very flat and didn't like that wasn't a hand towel in the bathroom for after washing our hands. The location felt safe, was quiet, and the instructions were very clear. It was convenient to have the home so close to the pink line.

Great 1 bdrm / 1 bath for my solo weekend trip to Chicago, visiting family in Logan Square. The property was exactly as advertised — the bed and bath were spotless and comfortable, and the shared kitchen was clean, nicely decorated, and well stocked with coffee.
Some reviews mentioned noise from the venue below. Over my two-night (Sat/Sun) stay, it was active in the afternoons, but I was usually out enjoying the city then, and it was completely quiet well before bedtime — never bothered me.
The location is very central; a quick Uber gets you to nearby neighborhoods and Blue Line stations. It’s less walkable than other, pricier rentals, and I preferred taking a ride over walking back after dark. But for the price, it was great.
Check-in/out instructions were thorough and made everything easy, and the host checked in regularly to make sure everything was going well.
I’d definitely stay here again on my next visit.

One of the best Airbnbs in which we have stayed.  It was light and airy.  The appliances were new, a large refrigerator, a washer and dryer, and an easy to use thermostat and television.  There was a large and convenient walk in closet.  Public transport was nearby.  Thanks to Ronaldo for a wonderful stay.
Very friendly and the place is very cozy and cute!

We had a wonderful stay here! While staying here we visited the Obama Presidential Center, nearby restaurants, west loop, and navy pier - a good location for all. Home was super cute, well decorated, and clean. Free street parking. Felt safe in the area. I would stay here again!
Really enjoyed our stay. Very short walk to the “L”.  Easy to get around.
Milan was a great host and very helpful. Staff at the building were not very kind but the stay overall was good.
Great stay
Great for what I was needing. Greg was super friendly and accommodating and had some great recommendations for nearby restaurants
We really enjoyed our stay at The Walton Residence.  The location is top-notch and everyone was so friendly and helpful.

Our stay here was very good. It was easy to find and we were able to access public transportation from several easy points so we could travel further into the city smoothly. We had plenty of room and many towels and kitchen items and more! Larissa, our host, was very nice and flexible for our unique needs. We’d be happy to return here on our next visit to the area!
Nice house, nice host, very safe and quiet neighborhood

My wife and I really enjoyed staying at Tracy’s beautiful house. It was wonderful to meet Tracy, Andy and their sweet daughter. The room is spacious, clean, and very comfortable. Everything was exactly as described.
For us personally, the fact that we were a stone’s throw from our daughter’s residence was a huge plus!
Great host! We had a lot going on and the hosts were super responsive. A great stay and a beautiful location in a nice neighborhood. Highly recommend! Thanks for the stay
Anita is a great host, the home was beautiful and exactly as described.

We had an excellent stay and thoroughly enjoyed our time here. The property was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything we needed was provided, and the overall experience was smooth from check-in to check-out. Our host was incredibly responsive, welcoming, and especially appreciated for her willingness to work with us through changes that came up during our stay. Her flexibility and commitment to making sure everything went well made a real difference. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend this property to anyone looking for a wonderful place to stay.

Overall good experience. Some normal living noise from upstairs since it is a lower level unit. Great location! Very walkable to bars, restaurants, and shopping.
Would stay again!
Brad was a great host! He left detailed instructions, while also providing quick responses to my questions. We loved the space during our stay!

I had a wonderful visit. The building is conveniently located with easily walkable restaurants, stores, bars, and the Logan Square train station nearby. The unit matches the photos, and the backyard with a hammock and chairs was a nice addition. Hosts were very responsive. Would high recommend.

Tom’s place was fantastic! Clean, nice touches throughout the apartment, very comfortable and plenty of space for us two. Tom greeted us when we got there and gave us lots of recommendations of things to do in the neighborhood and the city, and he and his wife were flexible with letting us store our bags after checkout so we could roam around the city a bit more. It’s a great neighborhood with a gorgeous park across the street, and an easy walk to the subway. We really enjoyed our trip to Chicago and were so happy we chose Tom’s place to stay.
Very cute spacious studio in heart of south side. If you want to experience living in the city this is a great find. Hosts are kind and considerate. We enjoyed our stay.
Nice place, clear instructions

Abby was a great host and accommodating when our evening flight arriving to Chicago was three-plus hours delayed. Cute, walkable neighborhood and convenient access to the metro and bus. Would stay here again!
Comfortable place with nice amenities for cooking or staying in.  Heather was very friendly and quick to respond to our messages.  Look forward to staying here again in the future!
We had a great time and the place was as described
Great place to say.

Great location, friendly atmosphere, excellent restaurants.
We had a great time exploring the area. Very walkable with fun restaurants and beautiful surroundings. Had a blast at a Cubs game with dinner afterwards - both venues about a 10 minute walk from the condo.
The condo was neat and clean and had all the amenities one could ask for.
Would not hesitate to book another stay.
Great place, I was really satisfied.
Good communication during stay. Spot was kept clean! It will be on the southside of Chicago where a bit goes on.
Great place.
Absolutely wonderful stay! Luis was very responsive and made us feel comfortable during our whole stay. Would highly recommend!
Lovely place to stay. Right where we wanted to be! Thank you!

It was just as described, there was some small changes from original photos so I had a bit less space to put my things but overall the space was easy and simple for the price. Host was wonderful wuth communication and friendly! There was an issue with lock but it got fixed, thought that was end but it happened again the next day.. I had to put code in at least 3 or 4 times for it to work. Neighborhood was pretty quiet. Overall it was a great place and I would stay again if I needed to :)
Overall i enjoyed the space, but the air conditioner was not working well which made it fairly uncomfortable.
Carla was a very responsive host. The property was spacious, clean, and had everything we needed for our stay.
The location is fabulous and highly walkable. The customer service was wonderful and friendly. I had a great stay!

Had a great and comfortable stay here. A bit dusty and could perhaps be a slight bit cleaner but aside from that it was a great stay at a beautiful place close to a metro line in a beautiful area. Had no issues.

The apartment is all the way on the top floor (3 flights of stairs) in case anyone was wondering, we personally did not mind. This is actually our second time staying at Owen’s property [first being in a different apartment] so we can say he is a wonderful and reliable host. Everything is always clean and so much is provided. The a/c was wonderful in the room. The only downside was we wished the room had curtains because you can see into the apartment from both the room and living area which made us a little uncomfortable especially since the balcony is shared with other tenants so anyone can see into the place. Besides that it was wonderful and we will always book with Owen when coming back to Chicago now.

Check in was easy, communication was basic with Julissa - nothing bad with that. However I had a major safety concern because all of the smoke detectors were removed from the unit and the carbon monoxide detector wasn’t working either.
I also felt as if this unit just had the absolute bare minimum. We didn’t have a toilet paper holder which isn’t a big deal but I could see there was damage to the wall were it use to be and that wasn’t taken care of. The A/Cs in the bedroom do not work and it was easily 85°-90° in those rooms had to keep the doors closed so that I could actually have a decent temperature in the living room because that was the only working A/C.
The bathtub spout was not attached to the wall so when you pulled on it to get the shower to work it came out from the wall.
My guests and I just dealt this these inconveniences because it didn’t impact the stay too much but I do feel it’s expensive for what you’re actually getting.

We booked Danielle's place for our family to stay in over our wedding weekend and it was perfect! The location is fantastic and the place is beautiful. All of our family thought the place was great but I can't put it any better than our niece so I will paraphrase her from here: "it has coasters and poles and laundry and plants so it's a luxury house. It's the best place I've ever been! "
Thanks, Danielle!!

5 star Hosts!
This place has it all! Great hosts, thoughtful room arrangements, every amenity considered. Snacks, coffee, and games a plus! Comfortable, clean, positive vibe. Hoping to stay again soon! Hope it will be available. Loved the Bridgeport area.

We had a wonderful stay at Drea's place.  Felt like we were at home.  Tons of space and very comfy beds.  I sent a couple text messages and she replied instantly every time with very clear and straight forward replies.  The chickens in the yard were so cute,  and their eggs were delicious!!!  It was quite a fun experience.  Highly recommend!!
Internet issues impacted work
Very cute, cozy and small. I loved it! Perfect for a couple for sure. The area is safe, peaceful and quiet. It’s always super walkable! Loved it here!

Gina was a great hostess, even left a kind note, snacks and cold water to enjoy. Communicated Well, flexible with check-in time as we were driving from Tennessee and Ohio respectively; we appreciated the early check -in to relax.
Will definitely use Gina's house again if it's available.
Margaret

First, the good things:
1. Very responsive via the App.
2. Location was very walkable. Art Institute was an easy 1 mile walk.
3. Facility located right next door to Lou Mitchell's legendary Chicago breakfast spot.
4. Easy to get in and out of building.
5. Unit was nice and clean.
Things you should know:
1. The walls are paper thin. In spite of brick walls, we could hear full conversations and plenty of noise from our neighbors throughout our stay.
2. Rigid company late-checkout policy and fees. We could only check in at 3pm and check out at 11am. We did not ask for an early check in. We did ask for a one hour late check out and were told it was company policy that we had to pay $30 for that, or $50 for 2 hours. I was told that this was because there was someone else coming in to that unit later that day. So, how does my $30 change when that other person is arriving? It doesn't. We paid a lot for the few nights we were there and this feels like nickel and diming us.

Great place to stay that isn’t too far from the city! The room was just as described, clean and private clean bathroom. The shared spaces were also clean.
Olga was very responsive and flexible with checking in. She gave great recommendations and directions to transit around the area.
The neighborhood was quite nice. I had no issue walking around alone when I needed to.
The amenities were just as described. There was just enough space for us, and everything was clean and organized. The fridge in the room was a great touch. Highly recommend!
Great place! Clean, quiet, comfortable…everything was perfect! Nice neighborhood, would definitely stay again!

Amelia’s place was amazing for a short stay and very convenient for our needs. Very clean and spacious stay. Amelia is very responsive and attentive when we needed help! The location is in a residential area so you get a real Chicago experience while visiting. Transportation is easily accessible and the location is walkable to the local stores in the area. The only issue we had was parking. Parking was very difficult later in the day, but Amelia recommended free parking zones surrounding Dvorak Park. I recommended utilizing the local transportation or walking! Very scenic area and close to Chinatown! Overall, we had an amazing stay at Amelia’s place.

You can’t beat the location! Plenty of restaurants and stores to explore. Walkable neighborhoods and the 606 trail nearby. Very close to the blue line and multiple bus routes that will help get you to the airport, downtown, or the lakefront. The views were stunning from the rooftop deck and we enjoyed watching the city buzz from the front porch. It’s also very quiet inside making it easy to sleep/block out traffic noise. Highly recommend!

El lugar de Azam es perfecto. Fui de viaje con mi pareja y el espacio fue increíble para nosotros dos. Todo fue muy agradable, es un espacio muy cómodo y cuenta con muchas amenidades. Las sábanas y almohadas son excelentes.
Hay que mencionar que está en un sótano, aunque realmente nunca hubo alguna molestia por los ruidos, fue prácticamente imperceptible.
Una estación del tren está prácticamente a 3 minutos caminando, y justo es una linea que conecta con muchos atractivos de la ciudad, así que fue muy fácil llegar a cualquier lado con eso.
Llegamos a tener un problema con el wifi, y a pesar de haber estado ocupado, Azam hizo todo lo necesario para solucionarlo con brevedad. Es muy atento.
Sin duda volveríamos a quedarnos ahí.

The location is fantastic, great neighborhood but in a quiet street. Building is old but pretty nice. The apartment is small but has everything you need for a short stay and there are great places close by for meals and fun.

Being in a basement was the best way to cool down after a hot day exploring the city! The location is a short walk/drive from the train station so we easily got into town and back. The neighborhood is much quieter than the city, it made for easy sleep.  Everything was as pictured and we never heard a peep coming from upstairs. It was exactly what we needed!

The description doesn't match the experience, there is nothing I would call "Luxury" about this place as written in the heading "Modern, luxury apartment downtown - TO"
There were black scuff marks all over the walls in the common area and one of the bedrooms. There were stains on a couple of chairs.
The balcony door didn't open at all, we were told the owner was coming the first full day we were there, never showed up. We followed up the following day, and never heard back except for a message about leaving a 5 star review. From reading other messages during our stay, the balcony door being broke has seemingly existed since May and hasn't been fixed.
It's worth noting that one of the bedrooms has an opening next to the kitchen and common area, so if you want a quiet/private room while other guests are staying with you, would suggest otherwise. The opening is visible in the photo of the kitchen, but fails to show it in the bedroom photos - this should be written in the description.

Great apartment!
10/10

Upon arrival at the Airbnb, there was an extremely strong odor throughout the unit that smelled like mildew mixed with sewage. The smell was overwhelming and made the property uninhabitable, so we were unable to stay in the unit.
I notified the host immediately upon arrival to report the issue. Unfortunately, due to the severity of the odor, we had no choice but to leave and find other accommodations.

The place was cute and decorated with a lot of beautiful art made from local artists. It was clean and had everything we needed. The train is less than a ten minute walk away and it is only a twenty minute drive from the Loop at night when we would return. I mean, someone has to say it, I know Garfield Park has a bad rep but don’t believe everything. This spot was a great place to come back to after the hustle and bustle of the city. Every night was quiet and the neighborhood gave us no issues. It was a worth it stay for my first time visiting Chicago!

We were there with a group of 5 for our wedding, and there were ample sleeping options and everything was so clean! We were close to friends and a great breakfast spot. Diana was so helpful and friendly. Felt like we were at home, and we will be back for sure!
My family and I really enjoyed the home. We had enough space for all of us to relax. Felt like home away from home. We would stay here again if available when the next time comes.
One of my favorite stays in this neighborhood, easy to find, super walkable, love the neighborhood and the street parking made it possible to come and go with ease
As often as I visit Chicago, I wouldn’t mind staying at this great location again. Peter was an awesome host!! Thank you for the thoughtful gifts & for your hospitality.😊

I am very particular on places I stay in & Tim & Taylor’s checked all my boxes! I am so beyond happy with my stay at the Bicycle Studio. It was very comfortable, in walking distance to coffee shops & other stores which was very convenient! I love how quiet the neighborhood was too. I felt very safe in my stay. Everything was so clean & the weather was rough outside due to the fire in Canada & the smoke but inside the Bicycle studio everything was very comfortable. I will definitely rebook & recommend to my friends & family when we come to stay in Chicago! Hosts are well responsive too, amazing 10/10.
Cozy spot close to shops and restaurants . Friendly and responsive host

The apartment is in a great location. Host company was extremely friendly and responsive in all communications. Apartment was clean and all appliances were there and functional. Downsides were a few: one of the bedrooms had non functional window shades so morning sleep was not possible due to heavy day light in the room. There is train service running several times per hour almost entire day and night (with maybe 2 hour windows between 1 to 3 AM when it is not operating) so if someone is sound sensitive there is a lot of noise from the train entire night and if you are jet lagged like us coming from another continent the sleep might be very challenging. Lastly there was just one lift operational out of 4 so getting up and down took tremendous amount of time. Other than that we had no other complaints or comments and enjoyed our time in Chicago very much. Thank you.
Was in a great location downtown and the apartment was perfectly described! The rooftop was also beautiful with great downtown views and plenty of seating!
Super spacious, easy parking, and close to freeway access points. Would definitely stay again!
Demitri was very responsive and communicative. The location is close to Jarvis square and bus stops right outside the door. Train is only 3 blocks away

Cute home in Uptown! 10min walk to the train station, with only two stops to Wrigley. On street parking is narrow, and parallel parking is probably going to be required. I would absolutely stay here again. Clean, quiet and as a single woman I felt safe every time I ventured out.
Great place to stay with our family this weekend.  Looks just like the photos.

Convenient location located right next to the "Jeffery Jump" bus stop, which got us downtown quickly.  Plenty of space for myself, my two kids, and a friend.  Very clean apartment, very quiet location.  Would recommend to anyone looking for a nice place to stay.

We really loved staying in this apartment. It was far more spacious than we expected, had every kitchen accoutrement you could possibly want, and was in an incredibly walkable location. Great restaurants and coffee shops were just a few minutes away, making it easy to explore the neighborhood on foot.
The hosts were wonderful: responsive, thoughtful, and genuinely helpful throughout our stay. Communication was easy, and they made sure we had everything we needed.
11/10 would recommend, and we’d happily stay here again.

This is a great budget friendly Chicago option!  It’s clean and comfortable, the building is super quiet, and the location is very walkable and convenient to public transportation.  Oh!  And the AC works great!  Thanks for having us!!

We had a fantastic stay at Heather's two-bedroom unit in Chicago's Lincoln Park neighborhood. The location couldn't have been better—it's just a short walk to public transportation, making it easy to explore the city, and Wrigley Field is close by.
The neighborhood is full of great bars and restaurants. We especially loved The Brunchery, which served delicious breakfasts, and The Pasta Bowl with its incredible, generously portioned pasta dishes at very reasonable prices. We also spent time at Galway Arms, where the welcoming Irish staff made us feel right at home.
Heather was an outstanding host throughout our stay. She was very responsive, provided clear check-in instructions, and offered excellent local recommendations that helped us make the most of our visit.
The apartment was comfortable, well-maintained and an excellent home base for exploring Chicago. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would absolutely recommend staying here. We'd be happy to book again.

Had a trip to Chicago for a Religious reunion, home was very close to the location and was as described. Had a minor issue one day with padlock but host was extremely nice and responsive to request. Would highly recommend!

Megan and Alfredo were excellent hosts! They were very responsive and accommodating. The Airbnb was very clean and exactly as described and as pictured. Great restaurants in the area. Would definitely stay again as the location was great and was just a 20-25 minute drive to downtown.

1636 N. Western Ave, Unit 2 was an excellent place to stay. Convenient access to transportation and a walking/running elevated path, restaurants, and shops. The apartment was clean. The 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms were very nice to have at the end of busy day. There is plenty of storage. Nicholas was very quick to respond to questions and thorough information.
From ground floor to the apartment there are 40 steps total to Unit 2; with landings and handrails on both sides. I would definitely stay there again.
Awesome locale right near an “L” station with lots of amenities nearby.  Kim was very responsive to queries throughout our stay.

My parents stayed here for a month while visiting Chicago and had a great experience. The location was perfect—close to the beach and within walking distance of Devon Market, CVS, Target, and the Red Line.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and felt very much like home. Everything was well maintained and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and very patient when we ran into some issues with the door code. They were quick to help and made sure everything was resolved.
Overall, it was a great stay, and we would definitely book with this host again.
Quiet, clean, simple spot just a block from Andersonville shops and restaurants. Would stay again.
Nothing to add.
Jordan is very sweet and professional! The house is so comfortable and the on-location laundry is a huge plus if you’re doing a longer stay!

This was our second time staying at Afsha’s. We love everything about it … it’s spotless, wonderful furnishings, great neighborhood, nice green space for our dog, parking spot, it has everything you need, and Afsha is a fabulous host!

Location is great. Right off the brown line, walkable to Lincoln Square and surrounding neighborhoods. Quintisential Chicago neighborhood with a main thoroughfare close by.
The unit itself was just ok. It was extremely hot and humid when we stayed and some of the doors had trouble latching or opening but that's understandable in an older building. The layout was good, but little things like burned out or missing light bulbs (as noted by someone else too) left some of the parts of the unit dark. Some of the space was not utilized well, like a record player and large vinyl collection setup in a small room with no furniture other than a desk, and there was a decent amount of space dedicated to storage of the host's personal things (fine) but fully accessible to us. The air conditioner in the bedroom worked but also leaked excessively (again, very humid) to the point we had to put a pan under it to keep the floor dry.
Overall it was a fine visit but we'd likely not stay there again.

This is a fairly bare-bones apartment quite far (minimum 15 minute taxi, 40+ minute train) from the main sights of Chicago. It is not in west loop as claimed in the description, so look carefully at the map when booking. Check in was smooth, but we were missing amenities like lightbulbs and bedside lamps and the hair dryer. The host did not remedy those issues. The apartment does not feel lived in and is missing basic bathroom comforts like shelves or caddies in the shower or a toilet paper holder. The window ac unit struggled to keep the full apartment cool in the summer heat, so only the living room felt well air conditioned. Given the steep price (we paid over $400 per night including taxes and fees) I cannot recommend this apartment.

Great area, location, ease of access, and cleanliness. My only gripe is the parking was not explained at all in the guest book or information and I still got a ticket despite asking clarifying questions with the host

Big difference in quality of stay and quality of communications with host. The place itself is clean and well cared for, my only complaint being the washcloths left on my bed with the towel when I checked in were soaking wet:/ additionally, the others guests at the house were extremely loud, slammed doors and didn’t observe the quiet hours. The cleaners also came around 7am and were extremely loud. The location itself is great, close enough to chicago but without the city price. Parking also super easy. However, communication with host absolutely terrible. My code didn’t work for the entirety I stayed, including checking in early after paying for early check in. I will give tbe host credit that they eventually shared their code which worked, but mine never did. Before my stay, communication was terrible as well, requiring way too much back and forth for tasks i already completed. Overall, frustrating stay but the house itself is nice.
The view was amazing and we really enjoyed the rooftop deck! Communication was outstanding and the apartment was very well stocked.
Very nice area to stay in with clear check-in instructions. The host was great with responding quickly and warning us when maintenance may be by.

We had an amazing stay at Jeannette’s place for almost four months while working in Chicago, and we couldn’t have chosen a better place.
Jeannette and Gerri were always attentive, responsive, and genuinely cared about making sure we had everything we needed. Anytime we had a question or needed assistance, they responded quickly and were always happy to help.
The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The location is excellent—only about 10 minutes from Downtown, close to the train stations, and just a few minutes from the lake, making it very convenient.
On top of that, the price was very reasonable, especially for a spacious three-bedroom apartment. We truly enjoyed our stay and felt at home.
If we ever return to Chicago for work, this will definitely be the first place we’ll look to book again. Highly recommended!
Great place in a great location. Very convenient to pretty much everything the neighborhood has to offer. Will stay again!

Estuvo bien, pero recalcaría que las camas son muy pequeñas para acomodación de dos personas.
El lugar es muy limpio y tiene lo necesario para una estancia corta.

Overall, we enjoyed our stay here. We did report dirty floors to the host (crumbs and hair, mostly in the kitchen), but they promptly sent their cleaning team to fix it.
Guests should be aware that only one of the 3 bedrooms has floor-to-ceiling walls, so this is not a good option for couples. (The room with the king bed and ensuite bathroom does not have a full wall.) We are 2 adults and 3 kids, so it worked OK for us.
Guests should also be aware that a lot of communication is off of the Airbnb website, which can be confusing if you're not super tech-savvy (and I am not). For example, check-in and check-out instructions are sent via a different website, so I couldn't find them on the Airbnb app upon arrival.
The upside is that responses from the host are very fast, so our check-in was not delayed.
Other than that, the location is great and the rooftop and lobby amenities (pool table and ping pong) were fun for our group.
This was a great location in a peaceful neighborhood. It was easy to get to many places, and the space itself was comfortable.
Garry is a great host and the apartment is awesome. Good location, clean, spacious and very close to the university. Will stay here again if visiting next time.
Great host and Great place!

The location was fantastic and the unit was pretty spacious.  Our only negative was that the air conditioner wasn't very strong/effective, so it was incredibly warm throughout the day.  Would definitely stay again during a cooler season!
it was in a safe neighborhood
Luis’s place was very clean and in an excellent location. I would recommend staying here!
Great location and space!
Our stay was wonderful. Everything was clean and updated. The shared kitchen space was well stocked and great to have.
What a great place. Super walkable. 20 minutes to Wrigley. Lots of dining options near by. Parking not a problem . Would stay again !

Our family of seven had a great stay. The condo was spacious, clean, and a perfect central place for everyone to gather. We loved using the large dining room table for daily breakfasts and board games, and the outdoor space and grill were a wonderful bonus.

Pros
- 10 minute walk to blue line with city access + the 76 bus right on the doorstep is handy
- decent coffee and breakfast within 10 minute walk
- Gio was very communicative.
Cons
- coffee pot and whole beans but no coffee grinder, so we couldn’t make ourselves (without buying grounds)
- the shower is exactly 67”. Any taller and you have to crouch.
- i had to kill a half dozen large horseflies over 4 nights. Apparently they’re bad right now in the city, but still gross.
- there were a handful of small ants in the bathroom and kitchen that appeared if anything was left out
Overall
- this is a done-up basement unit that is pure barebones. Not very clear in the description, but the description does well match the unit.
- probably worth the price of a private room. No regrets. Would consider staying again if cheaper private rooms were not available in the future.
- no cigarette or gas smoke
- plenty of storage space
Lage ist sehr gut direkt wenige Minuten von Bus und Bahn entfernt. Leider hat der Nachbar gerne Gras geraucht und dementsprechend konnte man den Geruch öfter wahrnehmen.

Michelle’s unit was just as described. She had everything we needed to feel right at home. Her attention to detail stood out the most; from the games; to all the items to make a good meal. To her proactive communication when the power went out on the block. We hope it’s available during our next visit!

Overall our stay was good. Space was pretty much as advertised, except that sectional sofa pieces did not snap together so kept separating during the night, making it uncomfortable for my grown son to sleep on. Bathrooms spacious, equipped with shampoo,conditioner, body wash, plenty of towels, hot water, quiet at night. Great location, easy access to public transporation. Restaurant downstairs has excellent breakfast!
Easy check in with good instructions.  Nice neighborhood; felt safe the whole time.  Plenty of room for the 6 of us.  2 minute walk to the El train that took us right downtown.
Okay just need to add WiFi & couldn’t watch NOTHING ON THE TV

We had a nice stay.  Caleb’s place is clean and spacious.  It is conveniently located at the heart of Andersonville on a quiet street.  He communicated with us proactively and is always friendly and helpful.
Good pick for a big group!

Perfect location for our trip to see Wrigley Field!  Very comfortable and relaxing apartment, great beds and kitchen was fully equipped.  We walked the neighborhood for all our meals out.  Highly recommend Carlos’ place.
Good value with three bedrooms. We chose it for the location in between the Now Arena and Chicago.

We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb. The location was excellent—easy to find, with the added bonus of convenient on-site parking, which was a huge advantage. Once we parked, we were able to rely on public transit for the rest of our stay, making it easy to explore the city without worrying about driving.
The neighbourhood had several great local restaurants and bakeries within walking distance, and additional shopping was only a short trip away. It was a perfect home base for our visit.
The apartment itself had everything we needed. The air conditioning was fantastic and very much appreciated during the hot weather. We also loved the artwork throughout the space—it was thoughtfully chosen and beautifully installed, adding warmth and character to the apartment.
One pleasant surprise was the hot water. Being on the second floor, I expected there might be a wait for the shower to warm up, but the hot water was instant every time. We would stay again.

The place was pretty clean and tidy, the only caveat is that the bathroom sink leaked from the faucet when turned on, and at one point one of the bathroom lights stopped working temporarily.
The address said 5309, but the apartment was in a building with a different address number, so that made it confusing to find.
Jevaux was pretty responsive up until we actually arrived at the Airbnb. He instructed me to text him 5min before arriving, and since we weren’t driving, he said he would be able to hand me the keys in person. He became slow to respond once we arrived, we had to wait about 30min before someone was able to bring us the keys, there were no initial instructions on how to access the Airbnb and the number of the apartment, so we had to ask the person who dropped our keys off who did not speak English fluently. Overall, the location was great and the airbnb was nice, but structurally the check-in process was a bit confusing.
Iris was extremely helpful. This was our first experience using Airbnb and she walked us through flawlessly.
Excellent location and comfortable spot. Would recommend for future stays in Logan Sq. Walkable to train stops.

Very spacious home located within a block from Wrigley Field.  It may game access easy and private garage parking let me park my car without worrying about street parking.  The house was amazing and very comfortable.

What a great place to stay! Excellent location, spacious home and, above all, the best host on the planet, Jerry!!
Just know that there are stairs, including to get to the apartment itself.
Had a great stay and was a wonderful location.

John was an incredible Airbnb host, and we couldn't have asked for a better stay in Chicago! His home is absolutely beautiful, with impeccable, thoughtfully curated design that is truly unmatched. Every detail made the space feel welcoming, stylish, and comfortable. The space was very clean and kitchen was fully stocked.
John went above and beyond to make our visit special. He shared all of his favorite local restaurants, hidden gems, and fun things to do, which helped us experience Chicago like a local. When the Canadian wildfires affected Chicago's air quality, he was incredibly thoughtful and brought us two air purifiers because my son has asthma. That level of care and kindness meant so much to our family.
He also took the time to show my son how to ride electric scooters for the first time, which became one of the highlights of our trip. His patience and enthusiasm made the experience so much fun.
Wholeheartedly recommend staying here if you're visiting Chicago. Amazing Home!
Great place, unbeatable location!

This is a great location, with the park, grocery store, cafes, restaurants all within a short walk.  Easy access to the trains, Magnificent Mile, Wrigley Field, and downtown Chicago.  The place itself was perfect for our large group!
Awesome place in a great walkable neighborhood — Ashely is very responsive  and we highly recommend this great rental!

Kathleen’s place was the perfect home base for our our visit to chicago. Right next to the Brown Line Train, but still very quiet, everything we needed was either a few blocks away or already in the AirBnB! Kathleen was very responsive and generous with her communication, and I cannot think of how we could have felt more welcomed into her space. Only downside was not getting to meet the dog, Patrick.
Thank you Kathleen!
Great place.

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! We were two couples traveling together with a nine-month old baby, and Mariotruly went above and beyond. He set up the apartment thoughtfully for a family with a baby, even buying blackout shades for the bedroom and a brand-new pack and play so the little one could sleep comfortably. He checked in throughout our stay to make sure we had everything we needed, which we really appreciated.
On top of that, the apartment itself was beautifully decorated and thoughtfully designed, with plenty of space for all of us. We couldn’t have asked for a better home base for our long weekend in Chicago. Highly recommend!
Recomendable por la ubicacion. Fuimos 4 personas y todo anduvo muy bien
Laura was a responsive and helpful host. Place looks like pictures, good location.
Really well communicated and helpful. Will recommend to anyone planning on staying in the city.

Me and my family came to Chicago for our family reunion. We are from Cleveland, Oh and just wanted to feel like we were still home and that’s how this Airbnb made us feel. Everything was perfect. Thank you again for making our stay peaceful.
Great location , comfortable unit and the building has an amazing roof top view. Highly recommend

Excellent home in a good location. Not easy to find a 5 bedroom, 3 bathroom place close to Downtown Chicago. Absolutely wonderful home with lots of space. Neighborhood was quiet with similar townhomes on the block. No problems with parking on street. Very easy to reach everything from this location. Beach access was a few blocks away. Kitchen was large and worked great for our group of adults and kids. The hosts were great and responded quickly to questions. They even offered to mail a souvenir photo we left behind. Great place for a large group.
Everything went according to plan
The host was responsive and friendly. Lots of close restaurants to walk too. Only negative was finding a place to park due to street parking

We chose this apartment because it is close to McCormick Place. The apartment itself looked like the photos. The building it is in looks like an old tenement building. The windows outside and the carpet in the hallways were absolutely filthy. The apartment had a strong smell of cigarettes when we arrived, and I was very impressed with how responsive  Adresa was. They came right away to try to rectify the problem. The smell was not as pungent afterwards. The bed was extremely comfortable and we never heard noise from other apartments. The water temperature in the shower was a little tricky and the tub drained slowly. But the water pressure was great. Adresa communicated extremely well. Instructions were clear, and responses were fast.
Nice place close to the metro station
Great place near the festival that I visited and meeting friends. Safe community. Great communication with Jorge.
A nice clean apartment. Plenty of space for 3-4 people.

This was a solid stay outside of me needing to clean the bathroom thoroughly with bleach. Everything else was clean, towels were provided and it felt safe. The 7 bus takes you to the train station and medical district, you can find a few good foods spots. There are a few homeless people but they are harmless like the listing said. Overall not half bad.
Thank you Terry and John for making my stay comfortable and relaxing. And a shout out to your delightful pup Katie, the wonderful third host who made me welcome with a conversation all her own.
Great location, enough space for a couple. Easy check-in and responsive host.
The house is beautiful and very clean. Sue is very friendly and helpful. This was a wonderful stay.
Stayed 9 weeks and had an amazing time! Jb was so responsive and helpful with any issues or questions that arose.
Marc's place was very nice and comfortable. I felt at home. Be mindful it is an apartment setting so you will hear others. I will definitely stay again.

A nice place to stay! Although we didn't see much of the host, communication was smooth and we felt comfortable. The outdoor seating area was a nice feature, and we especially enjoyed the location near cozy restaurants, bars, and the Sunday market. It meets expectations—just keep in mind that there is no kitchen or cutlery available if you plan on cooking.

Our family met in Chicago for a heritage tour to retrace my father's childhood homes. There were 7 of us and we were very comfortable in space.
