The bedrooms were exactly as described and the beds were comfortable. There were plenty of towels for us and having 2 full bathrooms worked out perfectly. Everything was clean, neat and free of clutter. What really stood out were the wide variety of high quality snacks and beverages left by the host which were completely unexpected. Garret was off the charts responsive. We reached out to let him know that a cutting board and dish scrubbers would be a nice addition to the kitchen and with the next half a package was delivered by a courier with the requested items plus olive oil, salt and pepper and Swedish Fish. We felt safe in the house and the neighborhood was lovely- easy access to the train and Logan Square. We highly recommend Garrett's place.
Great place. Easy access to public transit. Close to a lovely coffee shop we frequented in the mornings.

We enjoyed our stay in Chicago for a visit to see nearby friends. The apartment was large and would easily host a family or two couples. The neighborhood very nice. and neighborhood park to walk the dog. The host is very responsive and provided recommendations. Thank you for having us!

Beautiful and clean unit. They allow you drop your bags off at the front desk before checking in, which was very convenient since our flight landed early. Also, there was a brunch spot next door that was really good.
easy to access home and bedroom. It’s in Bridgeport which is a safe neighborhood with easy access to trains to the loop
Great stay.  Nearby street parking no issues.  Great fun neighborhood.  Place was even better than we thought it would be.  Would stay again!

Noe is an excellent host! He is extremely responsive, proactive, and a generally great human being. He went above and beyond to set up the apartment with birthday decor to surprise my partner when we checked in. The unit was very clean, even the furniture had covers that were freshly washed. All in all I highly recommend staying with Noe.
Two comments for future renters: 1) it's a bit further away from Logan Square and the Blue Line stops than I originally thought, but thankfully it's pretty easy to Uber or park near those stops, and 2) if you are driving, street parking can be pretty hit or miss, especially if you're coming back later in the day--you may have to park on Newport or Cornelia and walk over. Not a huge deal, but just know you will struggle to get prime parking after like 9pm.
Felice was an awesome host and the house is beautiful.  Will go back again next time I need an AirBNB in that neighborhood!  Highly recommend!

After a long day of traveling there was a problem with problem with our checkin. The problem was resolved very quickly by the host. We enjoyed our stay and would stay again. This was our second time we stayed with this host in the same location and will try to stay again next time we travel to Chicago.
It was a well kept apartment and the e host was incredibly accommodating.
Great place to stay

Loved staying at Victor’s place! I was shocked at how tidy and spacious his place was and it was conveniently located 15-20 minutes north of Chicago area, which was very easy to get to from his place. I will absolutely stay here again when I’m back in Chicago.
Friendly and extremely clean, thank you.
This is a great place for a bigger group with a great location.
Awesome area! would definitely go back.

Great location right on the main drag of Roscoe Village, with a bunch of good restaurants and a Starbucks close by. There’s a large living room area and spacious bathroom, very comfortable throughout. The host is very responsive, and will get back to you quickly. This was the second time we stayed here, so you know I mean what I say here.
Very cozy stay in a lovely neighborhood

A pretty out-of-the-way bungalow, Mary’s place provided a safe area to be in every night as I explored different parts of Chicago and the surrounding suburbs. Was also flexible when I had an additional guest staying with me; minimal fees. Don’t hesitate to stay with Mary!
Good place to lay your head if you’re frugal. Only issue is the toilet. I think it’s a weak septic system so you may or may not have to flush from a prior visitor.

loved how easy it was to find. I appreciate there response time and I loved that the air was on as we came in on a hot sunny day. its an okay neighborhood best to not explore to much but easy access to the L and busses. I definitely recommend staying here for the price.
affordable stay!

We loved staying here with our two daughters—delicious food across the street at Francesca’s and an easy walk to all of our shopping dreams.
We had everything that we needed and our girls loved relaxing on the daybed. 10/10 would book this again!
Great location with easy access to shops, dining, and the train.
Enjoyed the stay. Very easy check-in and Jeff was always a message away to help !

Noelle's home is lovely! She has thought of everything to make her guests comfortable. The neighborhood is lovely and very safe. The best thing about her property is that I actually felt like I was staying a a friends house.
We got to know Noelle, her husband and neighbors. At the same time she made clear that while she was close by, it was our home for the short time we were in her home. Highly recommend her property!!!
This is probably one of our top air BnB stays ever! What a gracious host and awesome place.  Felt just like home!
The apartment was a nice layout, the ac worked amazing through the heat. there was a hiccup with the wifi but eventually Brendan was able to get it fixed.

We had a great stay at Ericka's place! It was just as described, super clean, well appointed and very peaceful inside the unit. The parking spot was a bonus and communication was great. The location was perfect, very walkable and easy to drive to so many great spots. Also only two blocks from Chef's Special which is a favorite of ours. Would highly recommend. Thank you for the wonderful time!

The place was nice, the lockbox to get keys was not. We had to wait 45 minutes while chatting with someone online to get into the Airbnb. Check out was similarly frustrating. I saw the lockbox issue in prior reviews and hope they’d fixed the problem, but they haven’t. I wouldn’t stay at this Airbnb again.

We had a wonderful stay! David was very clear with the parking situation and proactive with our check in. The kitchen is stocked and ready for you with a Brita in the fridge, coffee and a french press in the cupboard, and ice in the freezer. The bathroom was fully stocked with additional items such as towels of varying sizes, Q-tips, a smaller mirror, and other convenient items. Each bedroom was supplied with ample pillows, blankets, and plentiful storage space for clothing. We would 10/10 stay here again when visiting Chicago!
Jorge was very nice and if I had any questions and concerns he answered them or fix the problem right then & there !
Enjoyed my stay with Milan. Everything was as expected. Location is very good for exploring the city.

Stayed here while we were in town for a wedding at The Walden (further West) and it was the perfect space for our group! Clean, easy access, and well laid out space. Super clear instructions made check in a breeze and host was always quick to reply. Thanks!
Fantastic spot, great value! Juanita was lovely to working with, and the space was clean and comfortable. Would stay here again.
We really enjoyed our stay at Chanda’s place.  The community is great (the Italian ice spot around the corner was a big hit!).  Would definitely stay here again.
We enjoyed the neighborhood and found it quiet and peaceful. Walkable to many restaurants and parks. Located near the train for easy transportation.

Our group had another great, comfortable stay at Hidden Oasis. We were guest in 2022. This location will be great for any size group. Great location. Everything was great as usual. Sherry & her family are the BEST!!
Thank you again for your hospitality & for being so accommodating.

I highly recommend Lina's AirBnB.  While being right in the middle of Wicker Park, it's incredibly quiet - virtually no street noise.  The bed and linens were extremely comfortable, and the place was spotless.  The AirBnB is nicely decorated and a very fun place to stay with lots of interesting boutiques and restaurants within easy walking distance.   Lina is exceptional in her clear communication, and was very helpful regarding parking options.   When a mishap occurred on my end, Lina handled it with incredible grace and understanding. You couldn’t ask for a more accommodating and thoughtful host. Highly recommend!

Michael perfectly balances privacy with intuitive and sincere concern for his guests' experience. Our stay was peppered with subtle yet sophisticated elements that complemented our stay while representing Avondale as the perfect locale to fully embrace Chicago.

Very nice place. All of us were comfortable and loved the free street parking for all our vehicles. Emily was a great hostess and her place was perfect for our stay.
Would cone here again anytime!!
Algenoy made our stay perfect! He helped me with accommodating my short film and his spot was the perfect place for our script. I would book here again!

This place looks brand new and is very stylish. I stayed with my husband, brother and 2 teenage nephews. There was space for everyone. Check-in was easy and the home was super clean. For some, the stairs may be too much. Street parking was easy to find - we didn't use the garage. The patio is nice, small and view is residential.

I booked at the last minute and really appreciated the quick and friendly communication and flexibility. Unfortunately, the cleanliness could have been better, and there was a noticeable unpleasant smell in the house. Overall, I was grateful for the easy last-minute arrangement.
Clean, stress free, and safe

Thank you Stephanie for being a gracious host. Excellent location, a beautiful apartment with stunning views. I appreciated the workout room
and the sauna.

First of all this house is absolutely stunning! It has that beautiful old Chicago charm with beautiful stained glass windows and beautiful dark wood staircases and grand living room with a pool table 🔥! The house was decorated so nicely and it was a no shoes  house not the floors were veryyy clean I never felt grossed out or nothing! The house was very clean and no smells or fragrances!  Our host Ryan was super nice and ANYTHING we needed he had or had an answer for answer for!! Our room was much nicer than it looked online so that was cool! The basement is gorgeous! It was so pretty and the bathrooms and shower were very clean! The basement is very hot but your room feels like an ice cold oasis so that was great!  Keep in mind we did stay here during a 85+ degree day so we were expecting it to be hot but our room was sooo cold and crisp! We enjoyed our stay! It’s so close to the fun and hip areas in Chicago! We had a blast! Check out the conservatory it’s stunning!! Thank you Ryan!! 🔥
Sharon was very proactive at ensuring there were no problems. The house is beautiful and very clean. We had a wonderful stay.
Great value. Josh was responsive and met me at the time we agreed upon. All positives with this experience. Would recommend.
Really great place looks better in person
James had a great place and we had a wonderful time. Thank you, James!

We had a fantastic stay at Nicholas’s place. The apartment is beautiful and charming, and the location provided easy access to different parts of the city. We were also really comfortable there with a toddler, between the pack and play, blackout shades, etc. Thanks again for hosting us!

It's a perfectly acceptable spot if you just need a place to crash. The main living area/shared space is smaller than it looks in the photos and probably smaller than each bedroom. It's short on towels, you might need to bring your own.

Loved this little efficiency place! Perfect for our trip to Chicago with my daughter only a 10 minute walk away. So many options for food right outside our door. The brown line was a 3 minute walk and super convenient. The place was just as it’s described and looks online. We had zero issues. I loved the cosmetic mirror on the dresser so I could get ready outside of the bathroom which is small but clean with a great shower. Bed is firm but we slept well with the hum of the air conditioning unit that kept it nice and cool. Loved this place and hope to book it again on our next visit!

Jasa’s Airbnb was an excellent place to stay! It was very clean, welcoming, and had everything we needed to feel comfortable during our trip. The space was well-maintained, affordable, and exactly as described. It was clear that a lot of thought went into making guests feel at home. Communication was easy, and the overall experience was smooth from check-in to check-out. If you’re looking for a great value and a comfortable place to stay in Chicago, I highly recommend Jasa’s Airbnb. I would definitely stay here again!

This spot was perfectly located for my work event. The bed was comfortable and the ac unit worked well in the bedroom. The furnishings are a bit worn down, but I didn't mind. Just needed a place to crash after the event. Overall, it was a good fit for a quick trip.
Great, spacious apartment in an excellent neighborhood. Danny was a helpful and communicative host. Would definitely come back.
Such a lovely home right in the heart of the city! Really impressed with all the amenities and special touches that made our whole family feel right at home. We would definitely stay here again!

We stayed in 312 was just as i imagined it . We felt at home was quiet and the host was very responsive. We had a minor issue where the fridge was not working but she immediately had a mini fridge brought in for us . I choose to pay for garage parking . Only issue i had was a silver suv blocking traffic almost two days in a row . Who would park near the garage door making it extremely complicated to get in and out . Wish I would have got outside parking but did not change the fact i still loved our stay here! I would recommend this place and i would return !
Great location if looking to be uptown. Close to Wrigley.  Super charming neighborhood.

Cannot say enough good things about my stay with Sujata! Private basement room was clean, quiet, and the perfect oasis from the City. close everything but out of the way; check out the Elkhart Park farmers market! super host provided snax for me and my service dog travel companion. i know Airbnb says you don’t have to state service companions, but definitely do! we appreciated a clean, comfortable room with all modern conveniences. street parking was a minor concern. the Welcome booklet identified best local shopping and food delivery. neighborhood is safe/secure. highly recommend! 👍🏽

Excellent location on the edge of the Avondale and Logan Square neighborhoods.  Walkable to the "L" and restaurants/shops.  Parking not available on site but readily available on the street in front of the apartment.  Two full bathrooms in the unit were definitely a plus.

Great place for a weekend stay. Apartment was as described and very clean. Instructions for check in/out were thorough and easy to follow. Even though it’s in a busy area (which was great—lots to do!) inside the apartment itself is very quiet. Nicole and Matt were impressively quick in their response when we had a question during the stay. We had a great time!
Amazing neighborhood , great food and so close to wrigley
clean place

The apartment looks just as described in the photos. Clean and comfortable. Air conditioning worked great. Location was smooth for us. Neighborhood was quaint. There are some stairs to get up tot he flat, just to be aware. We enjoyed our time here!

The property is OK on the inside, but it's in a building with boarded-up windows located in a run-down neighborhood. The night when we arrived, there was a noisy block party until late. Nothing in the description prepared me for this. I am not planning to stay there again.

Mark was a friendly host; we always felt welcome and responded to!
As someone who used to live in the Roger's Park/Edgewater area, this place is situated perfectly for a Chicago stay. You're close to everything the nearby neighborhoods have to offer, as well as the local train station if you want to head downtown.
Staying here for a wedding was a fantastic decision; would highly recommend!
Everything was fantastic! Definitely would book with her again!
A great place for a quick stay.

Great for a solo traveler like myself . Only went to the Airbnb to sleep and was out during the day. Had all I needed . Bed , tv , bathroom haha. Other people weren’t noisy. I was very chill and quiet . Neighbor is pretty bed at night , so walking alone can feel weird . It’s only 12-15 minutes away from downtown Chicago, so it was an easy commute! Would definitely stay again
Overall great stay, just a little hot on the hotter days but that’s out of owners control. Great stay and will deff stay there again l.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at John's place. It's located in a beautiful neighborhood, and the apartment was cozy, spotless, and very comfortable. John was an excellent host—he responded quickly whenever we had questions and provided great recommendations for nearby restaurants and grocery stores.
The apartment is within walking distance of Wrigley Field, which made it easy for us to catch a Cubs game during our stay. It's also conveniently located near a Brown Line "L" station, making it easy to get around the city.
We highly recommend staying at John's place and would gladly stay there again.
We stayed in Chicago for a few days here. Great brand new building with high end amenities. Would recommend for sure.

If you’re in a large group, this might just be the dream of a home. We were a group of 11 guys looking for a base for our trip to Chicago (Cubs baseball, golf etc). The bedrooms were all spacious and comfortable, as were the bathrooms. The basement is especially a highlight, with a great pool table, ping pong table and other fun games to play. The grill and blackstone in the back yard were also a great amenity. Would 100% recommend this place and will definitely be back!

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful two-bedroom condo on West Ohio Street. The location was perfect—close to everything we wanted to see while still feeling quiet and comfortable.
The condo was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. One of our favorite features was the rooftop space, which was a great place to unwind after exploring the city.
The host was responsive, welcoming, and made the entire experience seamless from check-in to check-out. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend this property to anyone visiting Chicago!

The Bucktown area is quaint and walkable. Kimberly’s unit is so cute  and well appointed with all the amenities you need. We had to reach out twice during our stay and she was very responsive. I highly recommend this gem!
The room was extremely clean and in a great location. It’s a walkable distance from Millennium Park, and also close to subway systems which make travel much easier. He is extremely friendly as well!
Very nice place, convenient, walkable neighborhood, and very responsive host. Also, checkin was a breeze.

Tere was a great host! Not only was Tere very responsive and friendly, Tere would check in on us to make sure we had all resources to check-in/out.  The host team was also available as support. The location of this AirBnb is perfectly in the middle of downtown and walkable to many places, including a small convenience store and CVS for any essentials. The one thing we did wish they had was a mini fridge for us to keep any drinks/leftovers. Since the walls are on the thinner side as well, this would be a perfect spot if you're planning on exploring the city at night. The unique interiors throughout the room and the common areas are so lovely and made this place special. Highly recommend!
Amazing place in a great location!
Combine a beautiful home with a warm welcoming host and you’ve got the recipe for a great stay. Thomas is great. Would recommend.
Solid place for the price with a convenient location

The unit is livable for a traveler. Every detail has been thought through from plugs near the beds,  lights, bathroom set up with workable towel racks, kitchen with a few soft drinks, and adequate cooking utensils.  Although you do not need to cook with all the good local restaurants. The apartment  is very quiet and has lots of light, it is worth the walk up three flights of stairs.
Very clean and comfortable place with a European vibe. Enjoyed my two night stay.

We really enjoyed our stay! The house was exactly as described and very clean when we arrived. We have young kids and the house was very safe for them to walk around and play. The location is great, street parking was easy to find, and it was nice to find a place in the city that both had space and didn't break the bank. Joseph was very responsive and helpful when I had questions. Would highly recommend!

Great neighborhood, walkable location. Tracee was very accessible and responsive. The unit was clean, spacious, well-appointed and comfortable. We visit Chicago a few times per year and hope to stay here again.

Check in was great and communication was there. The area is not great at all. Granted I did not do the research beforehand. But we were woke up multiple times through the night with people screaming arguing with each other and heard a couple gunshots. Overall the inside of the location was great and Taylor is a great host just a rough location.
Good value for Chicago. Neat and tidy with everything as advertised.

I had a great stay at Benjamin’s place, My room was clean and it was quiet while I was there.. The bathroom was clean and the kitchen was equipped with what you need to cook.
The neighborhood was quiet and there was great restaurants and bars close by to walk to. I would definitely recommend this spot for someone needing an affordable and good, safe place to stay.

This place was easy! Nice to have a managed building with front desk, however, please note that this is within student housing. It’s still very quiet and you wouldn’t really be able to tell except for college students gathering in the lobby at certain times of day. All very nice and nothing crazy at all but good to know. Would stay again

I'd say this is the 3-star hotel equivalent for Airbnb. No frills and a little underwhelming but the value was good. Very safe neighborhood and was good for a long weekend in Chicago. About a 30 min Uber into Downtown. If you don't plan on spending much time in the Airbnb itself and spending time in Chicago then this is a good option. If traveling with family or for an extended stay I would probably splurge for somewhere nicer.

Lovely little place to be a home base for my weekend in Chicago! Clean and functional kitchen, plenty of space for one person. Would definitely book again. Only small gripe? Scratchy sheets! But they may have been new. Other than that, the space was great, good safe location, near a grocery store and plenty of coffee shops and restaurants.

My partner and I stayed at this place for a concert at millennium park, but we wanted to stay in a neighborhood. Rob’s place was less than a block from the Berwyn stop, which made getting downtown a breeze. The place was far enough where it did not have excessive train noise through the night. The bed was super comfortable, and everything was exceptionally clean. Getting in and out of the place was super easy and safe with a unique passkey for me. We explored a lot of amazing shops and delicious food options in Andersonville and Argyle, which were both less than a mile away. I would definitely recommend this place and would stay again.
We enjoyed the stay! Thanks so much!
Accommodated so many of us! Good location and super nice place. Good climate control for the hot weather.
A very cosy space...I had a great experience at Kristy's condo. It was a convenient location and well kept room..very comfortable. I would go back next time I'm in Chicago!
Beautiful place. Charles is very responsive. Really enjoyed our stay. Will be back.

We enjoyed our stay! The unit is in the basement of their home, but you come in through the front door and right down the stairs to your private area. We had no issues parking right in front of the house each day. Having a full kitchen is very nice! There are several great restaurants nearby. The bed was comfy. The unit overall is spacious and had everything we needed. Veronica always responded to any questions within minutes!
My guest and I loved staying here. The location was great, close to the lake and the Red Line, and the unit was clean, updated, and comfortable. The host was wonderful. We'll definitely book again!
Great long weekend stay. Plenty of gathering space for our group. Loved the easy access to sights, transportation and restaurants. Lovely place.

Relatively inexpensive stay, Tamiz was away for most of my stay but we made some nice conversation when he was around. The bedroom was well cooled which was important given it was in the mid-90s when I arrived. Served very well as a place to hang my hat in the evenings.

This was our second time staying here, and it was just as pleasant as out first visit. The apartment is clean, the location is safe at night, close to great restaurants and the Green Line. Joseph is a wonderful host and always quick to answer any questions.
One minor thing to note. The Wi-Fi can be a little spotty at times. However, this small item did not ruin our stay. This place had become our home away from home whenever we are in Chicago. Highly recommended.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend this Airbnb! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. During our stay, we experienced an unexpected electrical issue, but our host handled it exceptionally well. She responded immediately, arranged for maintenance right away, kept us updated throughout the process, and even had water and refreshments delivered to us as a thoughtful gesture.
Her communication was outstanding from beginning to end, and she truly went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and taken care of. That level of hospitality made all the difference.
Thank you again for making our family feel so welcome. We really enjoyed our stay and wouldn’t hesitate to book with you again!

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour de 10 nuits chez Norma. l’acces est ideal sur le ligne Bleue CTA qui permet d’accéder facilement à l’aeroport d’O hare et au centre ville. le quartier de bucktown est agreable. nous avons pu visiter les jardins des maiskn pour la fete des jardins. Damen la station suivante sur le ligne bleue. en juillet il y a plein de festivals dans les quartiers alentours dont nous avons bien profité.
l’appartement est tres vaste et tres bien equipé. il n’y a pas de lave vaisselle mais c’est Ok quand on n’est que 3 comme c’etait notre cas. le chambre qui donne sur le rue est assez bruyante tandis que la seconde chambre est calme ainsi que le sejour.
c’est un bon rapport qualité prix etant donné l’emplacement tres bien situé à seulement 5mn à pieds de lave station western. nous reviendrons volontiers.
A very comfortable and chill place to stay.
Thank you for letting us stay!

The hosts were great communicators, always message you back and look for ways to help during the stay.  The property was clean, comfortable, and included everything you’d need to stay doe a weekend or a month.  Loved it!
Laura's place was extremely clean. The location was in a quiet neighborhood with a bus stop directly in front of the building.

Sibani By Taims’s apartment served us very well! The bedrooms were nicely furnished (loved the bedside lamps) and the bathrooms had nice extras. The kitchen amenities were sufficient for our needs.
Thank you for a lovely place to stay while we enjoyed Chicago!

Brain’s place was wonderful!! Great location, only a short distance from downtown, and it had all the amenities we needed during our stay! The hosts are very responsive and checked in with us many times to make sure everything was up to standards and it absolutely was. Would stay here again for sure!
The apartment was perfect for what we needed. Petter essential to where we wanted it to be and the host communicated well throughout the stay.  We would definitely stay again.
Loved the place, very clean big place for the price in my opinion  ❤️❤️
This condo is a great location for visiting Wrigley Field and has very easy access to the Red Line. The condo has plenty of room and was exceptionally clean.

Our stay at this Airbnb gave us an overall pleasant experience. The area felt safe, and getting around was very easy, rides were readily available, and there were plenty of nearby restaurants with a great variety of options.

My family of 4 and I stayed in Milan’s place for several days to attend a convention at McCormick Place West.  We loved being located close enough to walk right over.  The unit was clean, spacious, and stocked with everything we needed.  Milan was always responsive and polite.  I am likely to book with Milan again the next time I stay in the city.

We were in town to celebrate our granddaughter’s birthday last weekend. Our stay at Pippa & Kendall’s added to the family celebration. It is well appointed and beautifully furnished. Everything we needed was at our fingertips. The patio was especially lovely and the location was perfect for us. Thank you for being so thoughtful, helpful and responsive, Pippa & Kendall.
Jeanne
Great place in a pleasant neighborhood!

Clean and well-equipped with all the essentials for the week's stay I had. First class all the way. Location is ideal, next to a CTA Station for easy access to the Loop, and with cool restaurants and bars up and down the surrounding streets. As the apartment is on the doorstep of Fulton Market which is a lively food and entertainment zone, the neighborhood can get loud, especially on the weekend, so that is just something to be prepared for.

Kenneth is a great host. He is very hospitable left our kids tons of snacks and treats!
He was very responsive when I messaged him with questions.
The place had what we needed. Even though we came on some of the hottest day, Ken had the AC running daily and fans available for every room. Our stay was comfortable. Thank you Ken for your hospitality!!
It’s solid
great place

Very responsive, which is really helpful. Close to the train if you're utilizing this like we did. Great coffee shop on the same street. We didn't realize this unit was in a student housing building but it wasn't an issue. Secure access and plenty of space for our family, would stay again.
Comfortable place for a short stay in Chicago! Fabulous location.
No complaints.   Lovely stay
We stayed for a long weekend and had a great time! Easy to get on public transit, lots of space for four of us, and nicely air conditioned. Quiet neighborhood and building.
Perfect. That is the best way to describe our stay. Clear communication from the owner, peaceful area and immaculate home. Couldn't have wished for anything more.

We loved staying in this quiet and peaceful neighborhood! It was the perfect place to relax after exploring the city. The location is very convenient, with the bus stop just a 2-minute walk away, making it easy to get to downtown. Thank you for hosting our family of six—we had a wonderful stay!

We had a great stay at Jun’s place. He keeps it spotless. It smelled fresh and was EXACLY as described.  It’s a very convenient location. The train is right there. If you’re a light sleeper, the fire station is right across the street so consider that (Jun also mentions this so this isn’t a surprise). Just amazing stay overall. As per Jun’s recommendation, we parked our car at the Chinatown parking station and didn’t use it until we checked out. We will 1000% be back at Jun’s.
Very good neighborhood. AC needs to get checked out, sheets need to be changed for sure, needs sweeping and disinfecting more often. overall peaceful stay.

We loved our stay at Dean’s place! Communicating with him was easy from the get go and the check-in instructions were very clear and easy to follow. Apartment is in a great, walkable location, it’s very cozy and it matches the pictures in the listing. We’d gladly stay in Dean’s spot next time we’re in Chicago again!

This place is very cool. It’s on top a very busy bar but you could not hear it from the bedroom. There was a drainage issue with the bathtub and though it wasn’t resolved during our stay the owner/manager was in constant communication regarding getting someone to come by. It’s very close to Wrigley without all the extra foot traffic. Close to everything by bicycle if that’s you thing.

I rarely give bad reviews . But this one had me have to do it to help other people not get screwed .
It was a booking during hot summer July during a Canadian wild fire pollution alert.
The listing has AC on it. There was absolutely none .
I asked for a fan ( I wanted to be a reasonable team player ). He stated the fan is in the room . The fan was no where to be found.
Mind you that the listing mentioned A/C as an amenity.
I asked a second time and got ghosted
The bathroom shower curtain had moulds on it.
I value integrity , honesty and communication. This host lacked both.
I could have let it pass had he accepted a partial refund .but, I had to go through Airbnb dispute center to make him refund me 20% of what I payed. I should have asked for full refund since it screwed my weekend in Chicago having poor quality sleep.
Hakim ,do better.

Loved my stay at Demitri’s Airbnb. The Airbnb was clean, in a quiet neighborhood, and right by the train lines for ease of access. The Airbnb is a bit further out from the city, but is great for quiet stays. The only issue I had is with the sink in my bedroom, that wouldn’t drain — while Demitri was extremely communicative in trying to get the issue resolved, the maintenance team never came out and fixed it, and my sink would not drain throughout my stay.
Amazing
Great location, very convenient, parking included was a HUGE plus, would definitely stay again!
Nicky is a very responsive host and my family loved her urban farm!

Overall, the stay was okay, but I expected better for the price. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout the stay, which I really appreciated. However, the cleanliness could have been much better. The bathroom and couch were not as clean as expected, and there were random holes in the ceiling along with exposed electrical wiring on one of the light fixtures, which was concerning. There were also quite a few scuff marks throughout the property. I also think providing paper towels and a few more cleaning supplies would have made the stay more comfortable. With a little more attention to maintenance and cleanliness, this could be a much better place to stay.
Kim was a very good host
Very convenient location and host was quick to respond when needed. Would definitely stay again!

Location is unbeatable.
I didn't get a good start with the hotel, but they ended fixing it and were very accomodating.
Place is as described, very centered in a busy district, it's safe.
Room was clean and pretty quiet - both room I stayed in.

Le séjour s'est bien passé, assez propre dans l'ensemble.
Facile d'accès et arrêts de bus à proximité.
L'hôte est très réactive quand on demande un service, c'est très agréable.
Le seul point un peu gênant c'est le bruit de pas au-dessus dès 7h le matin.
Je recommande toutefois cette adresse.
Claude was fantastic: super responsive and helpful through and through. Couldn’t ask for a better host. The apartment and location are both phenomenal. 10/10 recommendation. Thank you Claude!
Great place to stay! Easy check in and out process and the hosts were very easy to communicate with
Great place, close to the trains, and very walkable. Definitely a great option if you need to stay outside of downtown Chicago but want easy access to the city.
Nice place! Dominique was very helpful and clear with his guidelines.

I love this Airbnb-it’s perfect for my husband and I when visiting Chicago. Close to all the things we love-The cubs, Southport, the music box theater, the Davis theater, and lots of fun restaurants-and of course family lives close by!

Very clean, nicely decorated garden apartment. Joe included photos of the building and signs to locate the unit which made access super easy and stress free. The apartment is comfortable and looks like the photos. Great location, street parking was easy, had no issues. Would definitely stay there again.
We had a really nice time and the unit had plenty of space for our family.

Nora’s place is incredibly spacious, colorful and was a great stay for my family and me. We loved that she had a pack and play in the office, as that saved us having to travel with one. Her bathroom was well stocked and had a lot of wall storage hardware (hooks, towel bars, shelves… oh my!), which is a godsend for a family.
She was also very responsive when we had a faulty doorknob. Only downside we had was that the door to office where we set up the pack and play for our toddler didn’t fully close but that wasn’t a huge deal as the house has central air.

My wife and I enjoyed our stay! what a wonderful place loved the high ceilings and the spacious layout! Seriously within short walk of some of the best food we have had! loved the history of the neighborhood and all the beautiful homes! Next time we visit Chicago we will definitely try and stay here again.
We had a wonderful weekend stay in Wicker Park!  Great Airbnb location.  All aspects of the rental process and our stay were excellent.  Would definitely go back another time.  Thank you!
Excellent location near the blue line ! Everything was exactly as describe and the old school arcade games added such a fun touch to the place.
This space is amazing, so thoughtfully decorated and comfortable. The proximity to both the red line and the beach made it easy to stay in a quiet neighborhood but get downtown easily. Great stay!
Great place, as described! Some noise in the neighborhood but it’s Wrigleyville!
Loved our stay here. Perfect location and definitely worth it!

This apartment was perfect for our needs! There were bus routes right at the intersection, but it still felt safe and walkable, never too crowded. Plenty of late-night spots for food and drinks within walking distance, along with cute small-business-owned shops to explore during the day. Check-in was easy with very detailed instructions, and the parking lot in the rear of the building felt safe and secure even late at night! The apartment itself is simple yet elegant, with a generously-sized shower in the bathroom and the comfiest loveseat I've ever sat on in the living room area. All the appliances were in good working condition, and the hinge-mounted television was an awesome and thoughtful touch. The bed was insanely comfortable. The AC worked almost too well, which if you've ever lived in Chicago, you know how much of a flex that is! As if all that wasn't enough for a solid 5-star review, there's an in-unit washer and dryer! Just book it, you'll love it at Milwaukee and Montrose!

Kristins place was the perfect stay. The bed and spa shower are so dangerously comfy and cozy that you wont even wanna go out and enjoy the city 😅 Fantastic location. Felt very safe and was walkable. Easy to get around town from that location. I cant say enough good things about this spot. HIGHLY recommend!

Great place to stay if you’re seeking the full WrigleyVille experience!! Within minutes of the stadium, any sort of food option you’re searching for, and a very peaceful neighborhood. Would not hesitate staying again
Cozy basement ideal for two, it has enough to keep you operating while you figure out your next play around Chicagoland.

What a great stay! It was a perfect fit for me as it reminded me of my grandparents home and also had two of my favorite things there, books and vinyl.  I was very pleased with the stay. Parking at night was my only struggle, but if i didn’t have a car, all would be amazing for me! Overall I’m greatful for the stay!
Weihong is a great host! She responded very quickly to my queries and took care of my requests immediately. The place is very quiet and spacious, with free street parking. I would come again!
Great stay!

Everything was lovely. My husband in particular loved the books! It is a comfortable basement apartment on a nice street with ample parking.  Lots of to do in the area and easy walk to University of Illinois Campus and to stores and restaurants in the area.
Great place to stay if you want to be out of the city and close to Tinley Park for an event!

We really liked the location, Plenty of restaurants nearby. It was very close to a train station which made it easy to get to the places we needed to go to that we couldn't walk to. The place is small but was as described so it was what we were expecting. Overall it was a very good experience.
We had a great stay and enjoyed the restaurants in the neighborhood. Convenient location.

A terrifying occurrence happened when we were elsewhere that shook us to our core and the way the hosts handled it was flippant,  heartless, and then accusatory and nasty. We came home to the closet completely collapsed onto both the pack n play and toddler bed that both of my children had been sleeping on. Given we had nothing on or hanging from those shelves, we can only assume it collapsed under the weight of the mountain of books on it. My kids could have been killed had they been napping there. The hosts came to clean up the mess. At first they offered a partial refund, but never followed through on that and provided a gift card instead. As we tried to express the gravity of this situation they accused us saying, “I think you did something to cause this” accusing our children of hanging on rods and saying, “frankly think that you are lying”. I’ve never been treated so poorly by an Airbnb host. They truly ruined the second half of our family wedding weekend.
Newly renovated and clean at a good location. Host was responsive. Will consider booking again when I’m visiting Chicago.

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The host was friendly and easy to communicate with, and everything went smoothly. We'd definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay!
Movie theater was a great touch and host was very responsive.
The place was incredible and the host was the best I’ve ever dealt with while using air bnb.
Lois was very responsive and informative. She is very sweet and the property was all we expected and more.
Perfect
Great!

Took a solo trip to Chicago and this was a great find! The neighborhood was peaceful and friendly and a walkable distance to River North!
The place was exactly as described in the listing, and Christina was very responsive!
Would highly recommend!
Thank you for a great stay!!

Our stay at Michael’s in Lincoln Park was great! Walkable, safe, quiet with great amenities nearby. We had 2 kids under 2 with us and Michael provided lots of kids supplies for the location (toys, baby bathtub, pack n play, high chair). Next time we are staying in Chicago we will absolutely be staying here again!

I enjoyed my stay here while visiting Chicago ! The place was clean and was just as advertised. 30 minutes out from the downtown area, but has some local businesses around as well. The shower is a bit small, but was clean and serviceable. Nice lowkey spot if you’re looking for a place out the was from downtown. Very peaceful and quiet. The home is very secure as well as with security cameras and locks. I would book it again 👍🏾

This place was perfect for our group. Everything was as described and clean. The neighborhood was quiet and walkable to stores, the gym and restaurants. The only issues were the parking space is only for a compact car and the keys did not work for the back door. . Will definitely stay here again!
my stay was comfortable and simple! very clean and the hosts didnt hesitate to respond! would stay again!

we loved having sam as our host. absolutely beautiful home, just like the pictures! super easy check-in with easy to follow instructions. very clean and spacious home! walkable distance to fast food! overall, we loved our stay  and would book with sam again when in chicago!

I cancelled this stay shortly after arriving. It is advertised as a private penthouse, but it is actually a loft above a public living space with no door. There is no private entrance; to enter you go up the main stairs, through a common living area, and then up another set of stairs to the room. If you are looking to be in and out and exploring the city, you will have to have some level of interaction with the rest of the household each time you leave your room. When I stepped out on the patio to get some fresh air while waiting for my taxi to arrive, the host was there sunbathing shirtless. I closed the door, and he messaged me on the Airbnb app that I could use the upper deck while they use the lower. This is a guest favorite location with many reviews which is why I initially selected it, but different guests have different level of comfort with sharing space with their hosts. Nice, clean room, but they should be more transparent about how much privacy guests can expect.

LOVED staying with Amy. The place is spotless and Amy has some amazing furniture/decor so you leave inspired. She also has great recommendations for restaurants and things to do and is overall so great to talk to. Brandon is super sweet and always drops off great pastries! The location is so close to the Red line, the beach, restaurants and beautiful homes. Really enjoyed my stay here, thanks Amy and Brandon!

Jose is a flexible and caring host! Good location. The unit is clean and spacious. I like the layout of the unit as well - 2 bedrooms on opposite ends allows for some privacy between your travel companions! The beds are comfortable. We had a great stay!
Great location with many restaurants nearby. Easy walk to the L. The house is very roomy. Josh and Jordan are awesome hosts. Josh responds immediately to questions. They are very friendly.
Very walkable, quiet residential neighborhood with a few good bars and restaurants nearby. The apartment is clean, cozy and convenient. I’d definitely stay here again.

A very nice unit with a full kitchen and large table to fit all the guests. We were grateful to have fresh coffee available along with a variety of spices in the cabinet. We enjoyed the balcony and there are 3 of them!
We are appreciative of the art in the unit. However, the photos may need to be updated on the booking site because some of the art in the bedrooms now may not be appropriate for younger guests.
We have not experienced public transportation in Chicago but had no problem learning how to use it. It was great being able to rent garage space so we did not have to park on the street.
The interstate is nearby so that noise can be annoying- but it is Chicago.
This is a unit we would reserve again when traveling to Chicago with family.

Leo was on a business trip, so my communication with him was by text (he was always VERY responsive); however, Tatiana was an outstanding hostess! She made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. The place was spotless, the room was comfortable, and though there were other guests some of the time, the place never felt crowded.
The location is urban in an up-and-coming area with a diverse, ethnic population. Personally, I didn't feel unsafe; however, I've lived in Chicago before as well as other large cities. Not everyone will feel the same way since the area is not "wealthy" and "white." If you are looking for a place with restaurants and nightlife that you can easily walk to, this isn't that sort of place. You can easily drive into the city-the freeway is only a few blocks away, as is the subway.
I would highly recommend Leo's place and will stay here next time I'm in Chicago.

i would not recommend staying here. she was slow to respond and i had to guilt trip her to even think about fixing the blown fuse when all of the ac stopped working, and we had to go and fix it anyway. pics on the losting need to be updated but is fairly accurate

Opeyemi was so friendly, proactive, and communicative! We had an awesome stay. The unit is very clean, thoughtfully laid out, and very comfortable. Located in a quiet, peaceful neighborhood w nice cool residents. Great location with delicious food options a short drive away. A convenient short drive from downtown. I appreciated having a coffee in the morning, the comfy sofas, and firm comfy bed. Highly recommend!!

Terry’s place is awesome. Fabulous location and on a nice quiet block. Very walkable. The apartment is roomy and Terry has thought of everything. I’d definitely stay again.
On top of that Terry is a wonderful host. Great communication and very helpful. It was everything we hoped for.
Stayed here before; great location and very walkable. Clean place and communicative hosts!
Enjoyed my stay very happy that the place matched the description, wasn't far from the train station so was able to utilize that for traveling paired with Uber. Definitely would stay again
Cool storefront space in convenient location. Great AC!

It was a beautiful and clean Airbnb. There was so much to do in Chinatown, and we enjoyed our stay so much! Kenneth always got back in a timely manner and was always very polite and helpful. I would stay here again on my next trip to Chicago!
bryan was very helpful, place was exactly as described and well equipped with everything we needed. for sure recommend!

Catherine is a wonderful host. The place was very clean and cute. We especially appreciated the Chicago decor. There was a rather noise every time the upstairs neighbor flushed. Aside from that the location was walkable and neighborhood was perfect. We had a great stay!

Eduardo and Lois were extremely accommodating, allowing me to use their refrigerator and microwave.  This made my stay much easier as I have serious food allergies which make it hard to eat out in many restaurants.

The apartment was as expected. However, on the first day the air conditioner broke. I notified Marijes about the issue and she communicated back with me letting me know that someone would come to look at the AC. Later, she advised us that it was not able to be fixed. As a solution, she had another apartment nearby that we could stay at instead. We moved to the other location per her suggestion, and that location was nice with working AC. We appreciated her effort to make this situation right for us when something went unexpectedly wrong. Thank you!

RedAwning was very responsive to the problem with the AC, although it took a while to get it fixed. We arrived between 10pm and 11pm and the entire place was 85 degrees. We had a difficult time getting windows open, but at least there were fans. This was compounded by the smoke from Canada and the fact that there was an air quality alert.  We got up the next morning and left as fast as we could - and at 11AM, I finally demanded to know why a tech hadn't been sent out yet. It was finally fixed then and the rest of our experience as great. The beds were amazing!!!  The place was also very clean.
Patrica was a great host, definitely recommend!!! Until next time Chicago 🫶🏾

Lugar muy acogedor comfortable y un excelente vecindario tranquilo la casa muy limpia y muy bonito igual a la fotos e incluso hasta un poco más grande mi familia y yo quedamos encantados con el lugar y la atención del anfitrión.
Excellent home. We would definitely stay here again when we come back to Chicago.

We had a fantastic stay at Bryan's place this summer! This is one of the best Airbnbs we've staying in. It's a garden but there is so much light and space it doesn't feel like it. The parking was extremely convenient. The laundry was a must for us and was super easy to use. The kitchen was well stocked. The neighborhood is so wonderful! We went to the farmer's market every Sunday we were there as it is only a few blocks away. Recommend getting there early as it is very popular. All of Bryan's restaurant recommendations he gave were so good. Highly recommend Daisies and Mi Tocaya Antojeria. We would definitely make this a regular stay:)
Very nice accommodations in a quiet neighborhood. Great stay. Thank you, Jacqueline.

We had the best stay at Iris’s place. Not only was it impeccably clean and so adorable, but the location was great. Restaurants and bars in walking distance. Getting in to the apartment was easy. Iris was communicative and responsive and even reached out to make sure we got settled. We had a great stay and I would highly recommend Iris as a host. 5 stars in every aspect. Many thanks!
Brittany was an amazing host! The place had everything we needed. I also loved the little personalized welcome sign! Would stay here again 😊
This was a very cute comfortable place to stay. I loved the culture of the neighborhood!
Great location. I loved the first night here where I was just walking around the neighborhood and seeing how cool Hyde Park is!!
Emily's place felt like home. The best thing is that there is a AC unit in every room which was very good especially during the summer.

The apartment was clean and matched the description. Just heads up that parking was really tough to find as a lot of the streets surrounding it require a permit. The AC had a hard time keeping up with the summer heat and it was pretty hot. But Jorge was very communicative and provided great instructions for the house.
Great location with quick subway links right into the centre of Chicago
This couple was amazing. They welcomed us and made us feel right at home. Would recommend them and this rental 10/10!
Good amenities, responsive host and good location.
Clean and comfortable place and a very friendly, responsive host! The bed was comfy and satin pillowcases were a nice touch.
Wonderful place. Margo was super helpful and responsive throughout the process. Walking distance to many shops, stores and restaurants. Would highly recommend.
very good host loved the stay
Absolutely loved the place. Was walkable to restaurants and grocery store. Had no issue with finding street parking. Apartment was fantastic. Clean, well stocked and bonus points for easy check out.
Lyla’s place was perfect as described. Great for 2 people. Close enough to various businesses and restaurants, but still quiet and reserved on what feels like an isolated block. I have no complaints.

Location, parking and communication were excellent. The kitchen could use a few more pans and pots if you are making a meal. If you aren't cooking there it is fine. 6 of us stayed 3 nights, space was big enough. AC keeps the living roim cool. The back bedroom was stuffy, but there was a fan. Could have used more than 2 rolls of toilet paper. All and all, great location, place was clean and Olga communicated well. Cost was okay, any place in this area is going to be on the high side. I would stay again.

Great place to stay, especially if you’re going to a ball game at Wrigley! Great restaurants nearby, and very close to public transit, too. Comfortable and clean inside - wonderful apartment from which to explore the city!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was responsive, friendly, and made check-in and check-out very easy. The location was convenient, and we had everything we needed for a relaxing visit. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a great place to stay. We’d be happy to stay here again!
I had a great stay at Cordaros place. Everything was extremely clean and just as advertised in photos, will definitely stay again when needed!!

The place was okay - the garage is in an alley a few hundred feet away. The garage door opener failed; rather than replace its battery or leave the garage door open, she told us to access the locked garage thru the house (back fence was locked) this made parking a two-person challenge, especially at night- one circling in the car, the other going through the front gate, along a narrow, glass-strewn and barely lit sidewalk to the locked back door of the garage.This should have been an easy fix, instead of a source of continuous irritation
(Also, more than one washcloth please)

you are getting the bang for your buck at this place. it's a nice area. beautiful furniture, kitchen and my favorite place during my stay was the front or back patios definitely at night with the street lights on and The nightlife alive with below plus with all the choices of the restaurants and bars around we had something to do each night.

This stay was great for my visit, location wise it was perfect! The host was amazing with response time and going the extra mile and checking in on us during our stay. The environment was clean and quiet so no complaints there, I will be keeping this location in mind for my future travels!

Location was perfect!  The apartment was absolutely perfect for what we needed - place for us & our son to stay while visiting our daughter in Chicago.  Was so happy with the amenities and the price.  The hosts were very proactive - they had a water cooler there & knew it was close to a refill, so let us know immediately that when we needed it to just let them know.  They also gave us some suggestions & made sure everything was good!  Very happy with our stay!!

Miejsce jest super- spokojna, bezpieczna okolica. Dobrze skomunikowana poprzez Blue Line z lotniskiem i całym Chicago. Tuan daje jasne wskazówki zameldowania-wejście do pokoju odbyło się bez problemu. Łazienka była bardzo czysta, łóżka bardzo wygodne. Klimatyzacja działa świetnie.

Staying at Adriana's place was exactly what I wanted - quiet, clean, peaceful, close to transportation options. Communication was outstanding, very responsive. I felt right at home, would stay here again.
it was amazing

place was amazing! had an issue with the shower and Carla was super proactive to fix the issue :) sent a fixer within the hour and made sure everything was okay after wards! it’s a great neighborhood lots of parking, it was a little confusing getting there since for some reason Google Maps maps directs you behind the house, but other than that me and my boyfriend had no issue with the place :) bath is super nice too + it has jets !

Aurora was very responsive and helpful throughout our visit. The place was comfortable for our group of four for a two-night stay. Parking was very easy, and we were always able to find a spot right in front of the apartment. The neighborhood was also quiet. Overall, a good stay!!
My boyfriend and I loved staying at Ingrid’s place! It was so cozy and had everything we needed- including snacks and tea!  The neighborhood is also perfect
The place was perfect! Location was wonderful! It was a very plesant experience overall. Would definately recommend.
If I could give this home 10 stars I would. This was the best stay I’ve had with air bnb. I will book this place every time I come to Chicago!!! I didn’t want to leave!!!
Quick response when it came to instructions. Walkable to a lot of restaurants and other things.
Cozy condo and pristine in a very quiet neighborhood.  Surroundings were clean a people friendly.
A great stay with Lois and Eduardo! Thank you so much for welcoming us into your wonderful home!

This was a great stay! only thing I would say is that it got a bit noisy especially in the morning, and late at night. Also everything we wanted to do was at least 30 min away, but we knew this when we went into booking this place! The parking was also hectic, there is no guarantee you would have a spot near the apartment but it is stated in the listing for the airbnb!  The host was very friendly and responsive. Very clear instructions on everything. I would stay here again no doubt!
nice home to stay at
Great spot! Good for visiting Chicago if you want to be a bit out of the city with easy city access.
Excellent place for an extended weekend in Chicago. Fantastic location, walkable and very close to public transportation.

We had a great stay! The space was clean, comfortable, and had all the amenities we needed. The neighborhood was quiet and felt like a great area to stay, with easy access to public transit and plenty of things nearby. It was everything we needed for our trip, and we would definitely stay here again.

Big and spacious.  Three good-sized bedrooms, the third bedroom has two double beds.  Open floor plan kitchen/dining/living room were super comfortable.  Location is excellent.  The apartment was perfect for the weekend with family and friends.  Riya and Vraj were good at communication, too.

Nicole’s home was amazing. She was easy to contact. The neighborhood was quiet, even has a driveway to park your car. I literally have no complaints. I’ll be booking with Nicole when I visit Chicago again
Amazing place, great location, very responsive hosts. Highly recommend!

The place is thoughtfully decorated and cute! If you are a light or sensitive sleeper, I would not recommend- Colin’s footsteps are very much present and the ac unit doesn’t easily flow into the bedroom area. We visited during a very hot week and I’m sure the heat isn’t an issue always!
James was great as a host and gave clear instructions. Loved the location and would rent this unit again. Very walkable to lots of great restaurants and bars.

Upon entering Lesley’s residence, my girlfriend and I felt very comfortable and cozy staying here. It has all that you necessarily need for a couple of days and parking wasn’t much of an issue on the adjacent street. The area can appear to be rough, but overall it wasn’t an issue to us both. It was quiet at night and easy to get to the airport and downtown Chicago-only about 20 minutes without traffic. Lesley is also an amazing and very attentive host when it comes to responsiveness and a great communicator! Whenever I’m in the Chicago area, I’ll look forward to searching out for this place again! Thank you, Lesley, for also making your residence stand out as it was my girlfriend’s first time in Chicago!
Our stay was great the host was responsive and even brought more toilet paper to the home when we had extra guests arrive. Everything was clean and comfortable.
Was the perfect stay for our team of 12-year olds ….they were in Heaven with an on-site arcade … had a blast

We had a great stay overall and really enjoyed the Airbnb. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The host was helpful and the check-in process was easy. The only thing to note is that the train outside can be quite noisy, especially if you’re a light sleeper. Other than that, we had no complaints and would definitely recommend staying here.
My family enjoyed the stay.  We look forward to staying again
Great place! Convenient for me! Plenty of room. Dedicated parking is a plus

The refrigerator never worked during my 4 days/3 nights and no replacement was provided, not even a mini fridge. So every morning and evening I had to go to the store to buy ice, empty my coolers, pour out the meltwater, and repack. It took a week of requesting a partial refund of one night’s cost, ending with a deadline when I said I would lodge a formal complaint with Airbnb before Iris finally agreed. It was like a part-time job trying to get reasonable compensation. So much for customer service!

Great location to restaurants, coffee shops and more than just a few unique shops. Caleb was very accommodating and easy to communicate with. Apartment was clean and worked out great for our trip. We had a great time!

Great location as we walked to the Shedd and Field Museum. Convient to trains including Green line to downtown. We walked to China Town for Paris Baguettes almost every day and highly recommend. Our family of 8 had a great time.

Aitor is an amazing and caring host! His space was located in an excellent location and has thoughtful amenities. He was attentive, proactive, and respectful. The space was clean, comfortable and welcoming. Truly an AirBnB gem! 💎
Great place and neighborhood!
Lizbeth’s place was amazing. The neighborhood is quiet and it felt safe. Her home is super clean and the beds are extremely comfortable. If I were to come back to Chicago, I’d choose her place again.

From booking to arrival to checking out, I found Kim to be a great host. The apartment looks just like the photos. The space was clean, serene, and extremely comfortable. I was also grateful for the window cooling system for not only the outside heat and humidity, but because of the smoke from the Canadian fires. The apartment was an oasis.
We had a previous reservation that canceled on us with little time to find another place. Robert's place was perfect for what we needed for the weekend and for a reasonable price.

We loved our stay here! The check in/out process was straightforward and seamless and Jorge was very responsive. The place was clean and spacious, the beds were comfortable, and the towels/bedding were fresh. The neighborhood is nice and walkable with a great cafe right across the street. I would recommend this spot to anybody looking to stay in the area. Thanks again Jorge!
Such a cute little space! Nicely decorated and close to all of the spots that we wanted to visit while in Chicago. Will for sure book again!

This area is charming in its own right and is worth exploring. For example Jackson park is serene, it’s where you’ll find the Obama Center and it will lead you to the beach! There are two museums nearby and good food too! Felt safe in the apt, didn’t have to dig up any of my passwords to watch TV, and best of all, no excessive cleaning to check out 👍🏿👍🏿
Tram was a great host and the place was perfect for our family. She was super responsive when needed. I would definitely stay there again!
We had a blast here!

This place is an amazing find and in a great neighborhood! Everything we wanted to do was either directly walkable or accessible from the train station that was a couple of blocks away from the house. Jason and Tracy were very helpful and responsive. Finally, having a parking spot in the garage behind the house was an absolute god-send.

My family and I stayed here during a trip to the city and booked based on the many great reviews. Unfortunately, our experience was very different. When we arrived, the floors were noticeably dirty. We planned to clean them ourselves but found there were no mop pads or Swiffer sheets available. About 30 minutes later, we realized one toilet wasn't working. The host took a few hours to respond, then stopped by with cleaning supplies and arranged for a handyman to come while we were out. After returning, we discovered the second toilet also wasn't working properly, requiring another handyman visit. The next day, we found several dishes and plates in the cabinets were dirty, so we didn't feel comfortable using them. While the host did try to address the issues, dealing with multiple maintenance problems and cleanliness concerns took away from what was supposed to be a relaxing family trip.
This is truly a great find especially if you’re driving in to town for something and need parking. The host is very very responsive. Place is very spacious and clean. Bed is 11/10.
Clean, spacious, and full of helpful amenities. Well-situated for exploring Pilsen and close to public transit.

I selected this rental due to its proximity to my friends who live in Chicago. It’s in a great area / neighborhood with many coffee shops, restaurants, bars, and shops, but located on a peaceful residential street. Thoughtfully remodeled carriage house with a great layout if you need to complete a little work or just want some time to decompress at the rental. We just encountered a couple of minor issues that I communicated to the host privately, but I would absolutely stay here again.
Really great stay here. Was comfortable and quiet, perfect for working. One block away from public transit. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay at this apartment. The place is a good size for two people. We really enjoyed the included amenities. This place is in a great location; it is close to public transportation, and the neighborhood is very walkable with nearby stores and restaurants. The host was responsive and proactive in responding to our concerns. I would definitely come back!

Disfrutamos mucho nuestra estancia. El alojamiento estaba muy limpio, organizado y exactamente como se mostraba en el anuncio. Gabriel fue un excelente anfitrión: siempre atento, amable y respondió rápidamente a nuestras preguntas. La ubicación también fue muy conveniente. Sin duda volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí y lo recomendamos a otros huéspedes. ¡Gracias por todo!
Thank you for opening your home to us.
Nice place and convenient to Wrigley. Very noisy traffic makes it difficult to sleep on Fri Sat Sun nights and game days.
Sweet spot!

Perfect location to walk to the United Center for our concert! A short 10 min stroll away! Plenty of street parking available and the place was comfortable for the 5 of us.
Ariel is quick to respond and take care if something is needed! Great hostess!
Great place to stay. Detailed instructions for check-in and check-out!

Apartment is fine inside but BR window is right on busy road that is noisy all night. Very hard to find parking. Spots out front are 2 hrs max. Shower water pressure is laughably low. Note there is no dishwasher or washer/dryer. Only 1 bath towel each for the week. Only 1 soap dispenser in bathroom we had to switch back and forth from sink to shower. No hair conditioner provided. Not one big bowl in the kitchen. 5 keys provided and no info on which was for outside gate, building door, and apartment door. No info provided on which gate to enter and how to find apartment door. Tried wrong gate first and found the unmarked back door before going back out to the street to try the other.

A+ location. Literally 20-25 minutes from the airport. Very quiet and clean apartment. No issues at all. I was out a lot so I didn’t get to enjoy the BBQ grill or outdoor seating area. Close to highways and driving distance to many food spots. I didn’t cook at all so I can’t tell you if the apartment had pots and pans. Parking was always available. Overall, will definitely stay here again.

My son and his friend had an amazing stay at this place. The property already offers an early check-in, but the host kindly allowed them to check in even earlier, which we truly appreciated.
From the moment they arrived, their first impression was that the host was incredibly kind, thoughtful, and welcoming. She prepared breakfasts that were truly Michelin-level—beautifully presented, delicious, and made with great care. She also generously offered rides whenever she could, which was a huge help.
My son and his best friend had a wonderful experience staying here. Everything exceeded the expectations, and the host's hospitality made their trip even more memorable.
We would definitely stay here again if we have the opportunity in the future. Highly recommended!
We had an amazing time! The location was perfect, host was super responsive and helpful, and the house was exactly as described. Would absolutely stay here again!
Thank you for the stay, everything was great! The host was very understanding, and welcoming!

Honestly I cannot give this place and Beth enough praise. First time going to Chicago and definitely will not be the last at all. The pictures do not to it justice, the place is BEYOND BEAUTIFUL. Made us both feel right at home in a very friendly neighborhood as well. Really great location as we went to the United Center, Wrigley, and the Navy Pier! She was very responsive for all of my questions and even had a greeting sign for me when I walked in! Everything was nicely clean and the water pressure also amazing. The weather was perfect and honestly we did not want to leave. This is an amazing space for two people, had everything we needed and more. We will most definitely be back and we cannot wait until then. Thank you so much for welcoming us into your home!!!
This place was just what we needed for a weekend stay—quiet, comfortable, and affordable. I’d be happy to stay here again if ever in the area.
I had a great stay at Zheng place. Very responsive and thoughtful host. I highly recommend

Clean and perfect location for a visit to Chicago. Easy walking distance to both Wrigley Stadium and beaches and walking trails along Lake Michigan.
Jim
Christiane and Patrick were amazing hosts. We loved staying with them.
Great place to stay  and host!

This is our “home away from home” when staying in Chicago and we love it!  The hosts are fantastic; the property is amazing; the location can’t be beat, and free parking is awesome!  The beds and pillows are so comfortable, like sleeping on a cloud.  It’s very well decorated; bedrooms are spacious; the rooftop lounge is incredible; private garden so charming.  I look forward to returning soon!!!!
Very comfortable accommodation right in Chinatown. Easy access to the red line. Host was very friendly and hospitable.
Great stay.  Location is very close to restaurants, coffee shops, and a Dollar Tree.  It's super convenient to Downtown.  I'd stay here again.
Very good for the price.
Awesome location in Hyde Park and the space has so much character!
This is my family’s third time staying at Margaret’s place and it continues to be the ideal airbnb! It is so clean, comfortable, and perfectly located. Can’t wait to be back next summer!
Good area and felt safe, would highly recommend
Pleasant everything worked went smooth.
This is a very nice place to stay. It worked out great for 2 couples.

This place was amazing, everything was just like the pictures or even better! And the best part is that it was equipped with everything, you know how’s there always that one toiletry you forgot to pack? Somehow this place had it. Also the snacks were a plus, all the little things were just great. The location is also good if you are looking to stay away from the touristy area, everything was very quiet at night. Transport from the airport was pretty easy, there’s a bus stop nearby and also a train station 15 min away. I’m a very small person so I didn’t have any problems but do keep in mind that the ceiling is very low, definitely not made for super tall people.
Everything was exactly as advertised and Bozena responded quickly to messages. We would definitely stay here again!

Beautiful Airbnb, loads of space, rooms are really big with lots of storage and full length mirrors, the bed was very comfortable, shower is state of the art. Mayra was extremely responsive and helpful. Shops and restaurants within walking distance. Thanks Mayra we would be happy to return!

I had an amazing stay at Wrigley Rooftop! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as advertised. The location was perfect, with easy access to restaurants, entertainment, and everything we wanted to do. The host was responsive, friendly, and made the entire check-in and check-out process smooth. The space had everything we needed, and it really made our trip even more enjoyable. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay. Thank you for a wonderful experience! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Bella’s place is perfect for 1 or 2 people. It was in a great location. There are many restaurants and stores within a walkable distance.  It is not a long walk to Wrigley Field. Most importantly, the place was spotless and the bed was comfortable. We would definitely stay there again if we are in the area.

We had a great weekend in Chicago at Karlov Inn with our daughter and son-in-law. The place was just as described and very comfortable and relaxing. We weren't sure how we were going to get around, but we found the nearby bus stops easily and found the buses very easy to use to get to the Blue Line train and other locations.
Amazing stay. great location and amenities. highly recommend this place.
The unit didn’t have ac it was very hot. But overall the location and the Airbnb was nice. They did accommodate me so I can’t complain
I loved staying in this air bnb! Its proximity to China town was what drew me to it! It was very clean and peaceful and the host was wonderful!
good communication

This was an incredible stay. They were extremely helpful before/during the stay and the place was amazing. Extremely walkable, lots of helpful/thoughtful things between the kitchen/bathrooms/games etc. Just overall an amazing location and hosts!
We had a great stay!
Amazing place with a great location! It was very cozy and they were super easy to communicate with. Be aware there are no pans for the actual oven. Just the stovetop. Everything else was fantastic.

A+ Stay! This Airbnb was perfect for my family weekend. The house was spacious and clean. The bedrooms were comfortable. The beautiful backyard was ideal for my family gathering. The basement, pool and foosball table kept everyone entertained.
Everything exceeded my expectations. We made wonderful memories and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend❗️💯✨👍🏾😁

We love this quiet street with a community garden just across from the apartment. It always surprises me when I reach the corner on the block, look to my left and see the Chicago skyline. This is the perfect place to go out and explore  or stay in and hang out with our daughter who lives close by. Don't miss checking out The Jumping Bean coffee shop near by!
We had a great stay overall and Angela was a very responsive host! This place worked well for our larger group and what we needed!

We experienced some difficulty obtaining the keys for the unit because the apartment complex staff were unaware of their location. The staff indicated they did not have a manager available to contact, resident services was only reachable through an automated system, and maintenance personnel were unavailable as well. Although the host was not on-site, her staff were able to assist us remotely and ultimately helped the apartment staff locate the keys.
Aside from that initial hiccup, the unit was perfect for our short stay. The on-site fitness center was a great bonus! The science museum and beach are conveniently located just across the street, and we highly recommend the cookie butter latte at Dawn Restaurant, which is attached to the apartment complex.
The only downside of the unit itself was that the window A/C unit in the living room didn't quite cool the bedroom, making it a bit warmer than we prefer for sleeping. Will suggest the host include fans in the unit for future guests.
Have stayed with Alle before and would again if given the opportunity. If you need a no-frills space this is as good as it gets for the price and location.

Mark’s place was exactly what we were looking for our 4 day trip to Chicago. Easy to get in and out in a quiet and very walkable neighborhood. The condo was very spacious and everything was very comfortable for the 2 of us. The a/c worked well and overhead fans made everything cool for our summer trip.
