We didn’t cook anything but the kitchen was very large although we only had enough silverware/dishware for 2 meals for both of us. I would for sure recommend this place to anyone coming to Chicago and hope to stay again in the future!

Kenya was great, responded quite accurately. It’s not expected right but appreciated when the host does leave enough plates/silverware/cups etc for the guests. Other than that it was a pretty convenient place to stay at as our reunion was just a 10 min drive.
It was worth the stay very productive host greatly appreciated her and anything I needed she was able to help with right away and made my stay comfortable I felt at home highly recommend

Ebony and Ean were wonderful hosts. They made feel right at home.  The room and bathroom were great. The bed was super comfortable, and the bathroom was spotless. It was easy to find parking. The location was close to the University of Chicago. Great stay overall.

The second bed is really so so hot and my friend found a bug in her ear. Neither sleeping spaces have good ventilation, only the living room space. If you have trouble climbing stairs or up ladders and have issues with small spaces to sleep, this isn’t the space for you.
Otherwise, it was fine and walkable. For the price we pay, feels silly to require us to wash and return all dishes to its original space.

Jacqueline’s place was in a very nice neighborhood - walking distance to the blue line and lots of food. Check-in and check out was also very easy.
The neighborhood was quiet, but the upstairs neighbors and dog were always loud around 7-8am.

The kitchen was nice and stocked with the basic essentials needed . The air conditioning worked great throughout our stay, and we never had any issues with running out of hot water. However, the living room wasn’t very cozy or inviting, making hard to relax in. Walls are thin.
The bathroom could use some attention. The sink was clogged, and the shower didn’t have any shelves or racks to hold toiletries, so everything had to be placed on the floor. The only toiletry provided was a 3-in-1 Suave product, which felt like a very basic amenity for the price paid.
The host wasn’t able to accommodate an early check-in or late check-out, which is understandable. Given the premium price point, I expected a few more thoughtful touches or upgraded amenities to justify.
Overall, if you’re traveling solo for work or simply need a place to sleep, this property would get the job done. hotels in Chicago during the summer can be expensive I’d probably choose to stay here over a similar priced hotel
Andris’s place was wonderful. It was clean and super comfortable. The neighborhood was great. We would absolutely stay again.

Ikechi’s place was as described, clean and comfortably suited our family of five adults. It is conveniently located near the Orange Line and even closer buses. Street parking was easy, neighborhood felt quite safe. The apartment was very quiet at night. Ikechi himself was very responsive and even helped us out with an early check-in. Highly recommend!
Great stay a lot of people everyone was polite recommend

Apartment was as described and pictured. Comfortable for our family of 6. Didn’t cook in the kitchen but it had everything we needed if we wanted to. Also, there were very thoughtful items throughout the apartment. But be mindful the back stairs are slightly steep when small children are walking down or when carrying luggage.
This was an excellent stay! The hosts were always responsive and ready to help. They checked in on how things were going throughout the trip. Would definitely stay again!

This is a great, no-frills two bedroom apartment in Ukrainian Village. Folks who like to sleep in will appreciate the very effective blackout shades + curtains, and pretty much everyone will appreciate being able to walk to a wide range of restaurants (including a nice cafe right next door). There’s also a good array of herbs & spices in the kitchen for folks who like to cook.
Although the unit doesn’t come with parking, I was able to find free no-permit parking just two blocks away, and left my car there for a three-day weekend without issue.
And as a bonus, the decor is fun — somebody is a puzzle enthusiast and has worked very hard on their collection! :)

Our stay was absolutely perfect. We arrived during the day when the air was so smoky from the canada fires and there were masks for us ready by the front door. Kitchen was perfect for cooking, and everything was super clean, but still cozy and nicely decorated. We felt right at home! We’ll be recommending this place to all our friends for sure!

The apartment is clean and a very nice space for traveling with a small group or family. It was great having 2 bathrooms. The location is perfect. Quick access to the subway and train. The train noises did not bother my group but we are pretty heavy sleepers. The upper floors with the rooftop patio and game area added some extra fun at the apartment. Would highly recommend.

Fenton was a great host! He was always responsive to all of my questions. I wish Airbnb allowed half stars because I would have selected four and a half stars instead of four stars. We had a few nitpicks. The coffee maker didn’t work properly. (Although Fenton did offer to replace it immediately - it was our second to last day so we managed.) The shower handle in the shared bathroom felt like it was incredibly loose and we’re worried about it falling off. And there were no hot pads that we could find to remove food from the oven. But overall, the experience was great!
Large space and very comfortable stay.
just like the pictures
was nice place to stay
We would definitely stay here again! Erika was kind and accommodating. Quiet and safe neighborhood with easy access to public transit. The apartment was extremely clean.
We had a lovely time at Diane’s place, by the end of the week it truly felt like home. We’d love to come back to Chicago and would love to stay here again!

What a beautiful Airbnb Matt and Nicole have… Location, Location, Location… seconds to MAGnificent Mile, Navy Pier, Street Beach & Lake Michigan. We were able to walk everywhere in a very safe area.
What a beautiful Rooftop view that was very enjoyable to relax at the end of the evening! We hit the jackpot by actually meeting Matt who shared alot about he and his wife’s Airbnb, gave us some great leads of places to go and try including restaurants, shopping, coffee shops and history.
What a wonderful person, place and Airbnb home they have to stay !

No geral é uma boa acomodação, com tudo funcional, entretanto tivemos contratempos com a energia elétrica e ficamos algumas vezes sem energia no apartamento, os disjuntores desarmaram, foi resolvido porem foram 3 vezes esta ocorrência, o que gerou um desconforto e uma preocupação durante a estadia.
It was ok
I really enjoyed the stay it was cozy and very convenient! Thank you so much for allowing me to stay In Your home

My girls and I needed a place last minute, and Erica graciously accommodated us. She allowed us to drop off our luggage early, and she personally brought us the house keys during a downpour. The apartment is spacious, inviting, and conveniently located to eateries and public transportation. Highly recommend.

What a great space and location! The apartment was just as the photos showed.  Clean, plenty of space for the two of us.  The rooftop deck is a fabulous perk with plenty of seating.  (Neighbors are close, but that’s city living). Secure location with a coded door to gain access to get to the apartment entrance.  The location cannot be beat!  Was perfect for the two ball games we went to.  Lots of restaurants, bars, grocery store within blocks. Faves: Toons, D’Agostino’s (tavern style pizza). If Wrigleyville is your destination, this should be at the top of your list!

Beautifully updated brownstone! A 5min walk to the green line which was amazing. Very quiet neighborhood!
The apartment was spacious and clean. Loved the furniture and all the little touches that were kid friendly. Felt safe and right at home.
The stocked coffee bar was so incredibly appreciated after a long day of travel.
Beds were really, really firm.

Wonderful place to stay while in Chicago for my daughter’s birthday! Only an 11 minute walk to the beach! Very clean and had all the things we needed! Cyan is a wonderful host and made sure we were all set!
Good host and has everything you have at your house and more. Really good location as well and very fair prices.
Was the perfect place to stay for a week getaway

I believe this may have been my second stay with the host but gave good instructions and the area had a Chicago familiarity. Also, there was a local festival going on over the weekend. Overall, great stay at a great price.

We had a wonderful stay! The host was very communicative, responsive, and available whenever we needed anything. Johanna went above and beyond with thoughtful, personalized recommendations based on our interests, which made our trip even better.
The home was clean, unique, and full of character—a stylish home in a great location, convenient to Andersonville, Uptown, and the lake. It was stocked with everything we could possibly need and more, including extra umbrellas, cooler backpacks, and towels for the lake, which were thoughtful touches.
We especially loved relaxing on the front porch and enjoyed the quiet, friendly neighborhood. We would recommend it to anyone visiting the area!
Clean, perfect stay and hub for visiting the city by bus, train, or car. Maureen is a warm, helpful, and very communicative host. Would gladly return!

I had a great day at Tim’s place. Everything was perfect and I very much appreciated the fabulous coffee machine. Location is perfect to both Wrigley Field and public transportation. Lots of bars and restaurants in the neighborhood and coffee, shops and stores. Super easy to get downtown and anywhere you wanna go. I absolutely plan to stay here again when I’m in Chicago.

Great little place to stay!
On a main busy street but yet still super quiet!
Jewel, Whole Foods, McDonalds whatever you need is close to walk to!
Comfy bed, shower pressure also great (important to me)
In unit washer/dryer if you need it!
Great area/great host/great place
Thank you! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Great place which hosted us for our trip to Chicago.  Very comfortable house with plenty of space for the 6 of us.  Kitchen had all the necessities which made cooking breakfast and lunch very easy.  Walkable neighborhood with plenty of coffee shops, bars, restaurants, grocery store etc.  Few minute walk to Wrigley Field as well.  Highly recommend and would stay again!

Loved our stay here! It was super clean, spacious, and equipped with everything we needed. The AC kept us cool in the summer heat, the shower pressure was great, and having awesome laundry facilities in the unit made our trip so easy. Would definitely stay again!
Location was great !

Building was nice and secure, owner lives in unit below so is readily available. Spacious unit, comfy furniture, quiet neighborhood.
We met the building owner and he was very sweet, he has a beautiful dog (a malamute I believe) that we asked to meet, she was very very sweet and well behaved, we didn’t hear her at all during our stay.
Two things that could have been improved: the bat mat in the shower is old and has mold stains, should be updated. The biggest concern was the railing going up the stairs into the unit. The railing doesn’t go all the way to the top and it is a steep staircase that curves at the top and is dangerous without the top railing. The owner asked for feedback and when we shared our concern he was thankful for it.
Overall, it was a nice stay and we enjoyed our short time.
Elizabeth & Harvey son muy amables y atentos, el lugar muy limpio y tranquilo, fue un gusto haber encontrado un alojamiento como este, lo recomendaría ampliamente
We had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean and met all our needs. The surrounding area had lots of restaurants and was beautiful.
We had a great stay. We are a party of 5 and we had so much space. The kitchen was fully stocked. Loved the coffee mugs. The beds were comfortable and all the little touches made us feel at home.
Good place
La ubicación y el lugar son increíbles. Soraya y sus hijas son muy lindas, amables y muy dispuestas. El departamento es muy lindo, independiente y tiene todo para pasar unos días muy agradables
We all enjoyed our stay! The house was in great shape, clean, and accommodated us all.

Cheryl’s place was great. The photos and description are spot on. What she doesn’t mention is the local life is awesome! Tons of locally owned businesses right next door. There are bus stops going in all directions within a few minutes walk. As an extra note my family and I felt safe walking this neighborhood in all hours of the day and night, and felt welcomed by everyone we met.

We found this place to be wonderful. It was located in the middle of the two locations we were attending (church event) and it was easy and close to arrive to both locations in very little time. The house was exactly as the pictures showed. I would like to comment that the few times we were at the house and not at our event every now and then a smell of sewer would reach our nose but after a minute or so the smell would pass with that being said if ever the opportunity presents itself I would stay here again.
Thank you to the Dukes Family for letting us stay!

Bianca’s place was amazing! Looked just like the listing So close to the pink line and bus stops, it made getting around very easy. Very walkable and friendly neighborhood, felt safe. Had everything we needed for an easy stay. Plenty of kitchen, laundry and bathroom supplies was  a nice bonus. Noise from the train was there, but never bothered us at all. We were able to walk the Tacos and Tamales Festival-great fun! Minimal noise from the upstairs neighbors, and got to meet their pups-nice folks. I think this is a rare find in the city. Will definitely keep it in mind for future trips.

While this apt was beautiful and unique, a great location, and air con, th faults outweighed some of the positives.
While accidents happen in old buildings, fuzes are normal to blow, but no info on where the box was or how to access it was provided and response time was slow and stressful.
Luckily happened on an open gate and unsecured basement door and were able to fix issue ourselves. However, when told how to fix the fuse hours later, the gate was locked for the rest of the stay (2 more days) so we had to tiptoe around the dark in fear of once again not being able to contact owner or access box.
The bathroom door did not securely close and the step leading up to it was popping out at the threshold. In the dark, given we had to be careful of lights, this presented an additional danger.
One bedroom was incredibly dark, not updated, and compared to the rest of the apartment, underwhelming.
The location is great, the apartment served it purposes, but does not match the price paid.
Lovely place to stay, good value, responsive host 5 stars
Muy bien acondicionado baño limpio habitación impecable y sobre todo céntrico para desplazarse a los lugares máximo 15 minutos manejando a las recomendaciones que te envía el anfitrión

Can't say enough about the location... Easy access to the CTA and Metra, and plenty of restaurants (and a park and the beach) within walking distance. The single bathroom (with poor water pressure - - a common issue in buildings of that era) was a little challenging with 5 adults, but we made it work. Air conditioning worked very well. This would be a great choice for a family with 2-4 young kids.

The Airbnb was in great location—you can experience the residential and the city. My family had a very comfortable time staying. And a couple times we had a question, Susan was extremely responsive and helpful. They were such friendly hosts!
Exactly what we wanted. Clean, spacious, and a short walk to Wrigley Field. Todd was a great host and took care of us. I’d stay again in a heartbeat.
the unit had no a.c, there was dead bugs by the window, and the lock for the door would sometime not work. but the owner was very nice and she was very responsive to all my questions and concerns

Booked this stay for my boyfriend’s band and us partners, it was so beyond any expectations we could have had! Super clean. Super cute. And had everything we needed. Parking out front was easy, and the whole apartment had a very non toxic feel, like natural bedding, wooden cutting boards, nice metal pans, amazing coffee. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you again to the wonderful hosts! Yall have an amazing spot!

Taimoor was very responsive and helpful. The place was exactly as described and worked very well for our group. The location was convenient and safe. The only issue that we had was working the access codes for entry. The keypads were very sensitive and usually took several attempts before entry, but that was very minor. Great stay, and we would certainly use it again.
Great place to stay especially for the price. You can’t go wrong!

The host was nice and responsive, but unfortunately, I had a very unpleasant experience with the apartment itself.
During my stay, I encountered multiple centipedes and large spiders inside the apartment. I reported the issue to the host, and he sprayed the room, but I continued to see spiders even afterward.
I also had concerns about the cleanliness of the apartment. When I first checked in, there were stains on the towels, dead bugs on the floor and even inside the dish rack by the sink, visible chunks of dust, and spiders in multiple areas. Based on the condition of the apartment when I arrived, I was unsure how thoroughly it had been cleaned after the previous stay.
The neighborhood also did not feel particularly safe to me, especially when coming and going from the apartment.
Overall, I did not feel comfortable staying here, and I do not think it was worth the price. I would not stay here again even at a lower rate.

Gran lugar, estuve de visita 8 días con mi hijo, la casa es muy comoda en espacios y en su equipamento. Tuvimos todo lo que necesitabamos. Rosa muy atenta en su comunicación. Nos sentimos seguros, comodos y muy felices. El barrio me encantó tiene cerca supermercados, buenos restaurantes, farmacias, negocios locales, un parque hermoso a cuadras para poder trotar o hacer ejercicio. Además de estar muy bien conectada con transporte publico.
Had a really nice stay at Thomas's place!
Cozy location and good access to Chicago. Gave clear communication, and was very responsive.

My husband and I went to college in Chicago and it was so great to return for a couple of weeks and stay in such a comfortable place! The neighborhood is great, walkable to the train, tons of restaurants and the 606! Christina was also extremely responsive, we stayed 2 weeks so there were a few times we needed help and she always responded promptly. There is also a neighborhood pool right next door which was sadly under renovation during my stay, but I hope to use it in the future!! I will definitely be returning to Christina’s place!

We had a lovely stay at Karina’s home during a long weekend in Chicago! The neighborhood has several cute spots walkable from the home (Karina had a list of recommended places which was so helpful!). Quick drive to downtown for touristy things. Our daughter loved the backyard!

They say you get what you pay for, so I was not expecting a whole lot from this place. But let me tell you, it’s way worse than what you think. The owner of the place does not answer to your messages whatsoever. Bathroom floor is filthy, room floor and walls are filthy, dusty, and trash bin had not been emptied out when I checked in. Room is way smaller than what you see on the photo, like literally only room to sleep and get up. Walls are paper thin, the couple staying in the room next to me were arguing at 1:30 am and I could hear it like they were doing in in front of me, and when I messaged the owner about it, of course I didn’t get any response.
If you only need a place to sleep at night and nothing else, and you are on an absolutely tight budget, consider this place as your last resort. Otherwise, do yourself a favour and pay that extra 100 dollars and avoid this place at all costs.
Lisa was very helpful, she lives in the building. Which was very useful, if you were to have any questions. I would definitely book the place again.
Thanks for the great stay!

Everything was as pictured.  Great location.  Close to the lake. Secure building.  Apartment was pet friendly which was very important to us as we were traveling with our dog.  Parking spot a huge plus!  Definitely would stay here again on a return trip to Chicago.

The apartment truly is a huge one bedroom with an incredible view! It was clean, well stocked and had enough decor to not look stark and cold like some airbnbs.  Everything worked well and no real complaints other than it might be time to get a new mattress for the sofa bed pretty soon.

This is our second stay in Kris and Daniel's home.  As with the first time, commuication with the host was very easy,  the house is beautifully decorated, filled with the necessary amenities, AND TREATS left for us by the host.  We enjoyed the back garden which was beautifully planted.  We always feel so at home in this house!  We would love to return from August 6-10 but unfortunately the home is not free. We highly recomend Kris and Daniels's home!!

Great hotel, the room view was looking at a brick building but we weren’t there for the view. The only downside is the bathroom had a shower head that was super low and very hard for tall people to use, we had to squat down to wash our hair. Otherwise we loved the location and price, the hotel staff was very friendly and the valet parking is easy and fast.
It’s nice to stay at a place with a laid back host that doesn’t have a mile of rules to follow and instructions to remember.

This was a great place to stay for the weekend! Within walking distance to a great restaurant and fast uber rides to places we wanted to go (bars/downtown/baseball field.) Host was quick to reply to any questions as well. Place was clean and looked just like the photos. Would definitely book here again if needed.

overall, the place was great, had plates, cups, silverware, but was looking forward to cooking as we have dietary restrictions and would have been convenient to have more utensils to cook with, such as spatulas, pans for oven, etc. But we managed and made it work.
Host was great and check in was very easy. Location was also good.

This spot is a lovely hidden gem. the entire apartment is quaint but spacious, impeccably clean, and exactly what we were looking for. Its nestled away in a quiet part of town just outside of Chicago and was an easy drive into downtown AND to and from the airport.
Cindy & Mike were both very polite and accomodating! I highly recommend for anyone wanting a peaceful stay in Chicago!

We wanted a place of our own while visiting family in Chicago. We loved our stay...close to cafes, restaurants and shopping in Andersonville, easy to get to the train, and such a beautiful walkable neighborhood. We loved coming "home" to unwind after the day out.
very quiet neighborhood in safe area of Chicago.

This was a good location with getting into the city and there are  plenty of restaurants within walking distance. It was just what we needed size and space wise to relax as a family. We did have issues with the neighbors that threw a large party and were loud. Even with this issue being outside of Piotr and Beata's control, they made it right for us. We would book again and recommend this location overall.

We enjoyed our stay and we loved the property. The windows and giant ceilings were beautiful. It’s more spacious than what we saw in the pictures. The neighborhood is awesome and you can’t beat the location. Hosts were very accommodating and responsive. Looking forward to our next stay :)

Matthew's place was everything we were hoping it would be - charming, spacious, impeccably clean, and easy to reach. Getting to come back here every night after exploring Chicago was honestly a delight and our group was extremely pleased. Matthew was very helpful and responsive and provided local recommendations as well. We would love to stay here again in the future.

Laura is kind and very good in communication. Instruction was clear and easy to follow. The room was good and spacious. The location is convenient as it is close to street. We heard vehicle noises. Washer and drier were very helpful.
A great place and a great host!
Great stay and awesome neighborhood. Excellent communication and let us drop our stuff off prior to check so we can roam the city hands free!

LOCATION WAS EVERYTHING! Such a cute area, lots of spots in walking distance, and anywhere we ubered was less than 20 mins. Perfect for 3 girls having a girly pop chi town weekend!!! Celia was super responsive and a fabulous host. 10/10 would recommend!!!!!!!!!!!!

Apartment was perfect for our two-generation family grouo. Immaculate, spacious, and comfortable. Not much in the neighborhood but steps from a bus stop to the Loop.
Communication was excrptional for AirBnb. Responses were prompt and helpful. We had a minor maintenance issue which was addressed in minutes.
One suggestion: the checkin instructions included some inaccuracies. A call cleared this up quickly but it would save time for everyone if the instructions could be updated...
Would stay here again, and would recommend.
The place was very cozy. It was a great place to stay.

Bart's place was absolutely perfect. We were a family of 6 and the space was big enough and didn't feel cramped at all. The area is great too! Such a beautiful neighborhood to take a stroll in and take in the city. Would definitely stay here again!

This air bnb was very nice to stay at if your looking to go somewhere very close to the subway and fast eats, the air bnb was just like the shown pictures, Kendal was very fast at responding to any questions that were asked to him, and was very nice. I will be booking Kendal’s air bnb again for my next Chicago trip!
Delighted to have stayed at this beautiful accommodation.

Exceptional staff over the busy weekend. Desk to valet treated us like royalty! Highly recommended & most likely to book again on next visit! The highlight was the gift for my wife on her birthday from the hotel! Big W in my book!
This was a quiet and clean place to stay for my time in Chicago, I had no concerns about cleanliness and house rules, everything was set up for me when I arrived at the place.

Very central to where we needed to be. Had a great binder of suggestions for all things we'd need, food, drink, entertainment, etc... Even had directions for things in the apartment, the only miss was TV was hard to understand (three remotes), found shows but not sure we did it right😏

Cyndi was a great host. When I had some questions about checking in, she responded right away and she was flexible when we asked to put our luggage in the apartment before check in.
The apartment is safe and comfortable on the 13th floor. It looked just like the pictures and we felt very comfortable.
I would note that I wasn't familiar with Chicago before our visit and chose the apartment because of its close proximity to the sites in the City. What I didn't think about was we were in the heart of Chicago with all the sounds of the L train and city noises. I'd recommend bringing earplugs if you are sensitive to excessive noise. Even though the apartment is high above the street, the sound carries.
Other than the excessive sound of the city, the apartment was ideal.

We had a very good stay. The apartment was exactly as described, felt almost new, and was very clean. The host was responsive/easy to communicate with.
The two bedrooms gave us some personal space, though they were a bit tight. The beds were comfortable. The only downside (not a gamechanger) was noise from the unit above. We heard heavy footsteps, conversations, and what sounded like something being dropped/crashed to the floor between 1:00–5:00 a.m., which woke me up several times. It seemed more like limited sound insulation than anything the host could control. The common areas occasionally smelled like marijuana, but it wasn't a big concern.
The location worked well for Uber and public transportation along Fullerton Ave. The lower nightly rate more than offset the extra Uber costs, and the neighborhood felt safe throughout our stay.
Overall, this was a great value. I'd definitely stay here again, especially if you're looking for a clean, comfortable place with a responsive host.
very spacious for the amount of people ,we stayed

If you're an industrial music fan, you owe it to yourself to spend a couple of nights (or more!) at this Airbnb above the Museum of Post Punk and Industrial Music. The apartment is a museum unto itself, with tons of artwork, memorabilia, books, records, and videos to explore. All that, plus the place is very spacious and comfortable. Just amazing!
Great price for a great location. Easy walk to the L train. Communicated well and great lighting at night. Quiet and loved the extra little immenities just like a hotel.
Had a great stay, the neighborhood felt safe and walkable!

The place was perfect for us. We were working in the area so the commute was easy.
Restaurants and coffee shoos were close to the place.
Rachel was so helpful and responded within mins.
Love the place!

We had a great experience here. The host was very communicative and friendly. The unit was clean and as described and the location was quiet with easy access to restaurants, stores, and public transit.
House exceeded our expectations for space and location. Beautiful home and outdoor space. Conveniently located on a great Lincoln Park street. Highly recommend.
I loved staying here! The host was so nice, responsive, and gracious! The place was very clean and spacious, we absolutely loved it and appreciate everything! Thank you so much! :)
Great place!

This airbnb was gorgeous it looked exactly like the pictures, Richard has a great taste! I also had the chance to meet him & he is extremely kind. He made sure that everything was perfect for our special weekend. There was a small issue with one of the outlets in the room but he answered me right away & stopped by to fix it up for us. 10/10 host would definitely stay again!

Neighborhood is awesome, decor was great, parking was easy, walkable. Vibe was modern yet cozy. Kitchen was stocked with fancy gadgets and many different ways to make coffee - 5 stars for the coffee!!
Very clean and private! Fantastic stay! Great neighborhood found parking right by the house every time over the weekend, walkable to the beach and good!
Cozy place and good for small getaway weekends.

We absolutely loved our stay! From the moment we walked in, this Airbnb felt like home. It was beautifully decorated, spotless, spacious, and the beds were so comfortable it felt like we were sleeping on clouds. We also loved the refrigerator with the built in ice and water dispenser, which was such a nice touch.
The location was perfect. We always felt safe walking to the train, and everything was easy to get to. Our host was amazing, always quick to respond and gave us great recommendations that made our trip even better.
Everyone we met was so friendly, and we completely fell in love with Chicago. Thank you for making our stay so comfortable and memorable. We can’t wait to come back and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Amazing location & place to stay!!! Very clear directions and when we had questions they answered quickly !!! Loved staying here and will stay again!!
Great place to stay with my family. Tracy is very responsive.

This was the second time I stayed at one of Kyriako's places this summer, and once again everything was perfect. I highly recommend their places.
The apartments are very well equipped, very clean, and the hosts are incredibly friendly.

This was such a great host and location! Highly recommend as so much was accessible through the blue line and much to do within walking distance. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the city but wanting to not stay downtown.

Henry was friendly and very responsive. I felt safe and I would have given a 5 star but I had issues with the blankets and pillow cases. I had to buy blankets to sleep better because the ones provided had strong male smell that I couldn’t sleep with. Other than that, everything else was great. Parking can be a challenge at night but you eventually find something. Henry was kind so it was worth it.
Beautiful home! Host was very responsive and our stay here was great! We’ll definitely be a “book again” option!
Great place to stay

This is our third consecutive year of staying here. We love the location and enjoy the large, clean and private apartment. Cody is always a pleasure to communicate with. We hope to stay again when we come to Chicago.
Great place and location. Easy access to public transportation. Checked in to make everything was good.

We really enjoyed our stay here! Spacious and clean. The neighborhood was safe and quiet. Easy to get into the building. I appreciated that there was a parking spot in the back. It was about a 20 minute uber to Lincoln Park area and 30 minute uber to navy pier.
Nice place and great location!
Great place! Couldn’t be happier with our stay

I would definitely recommend this stay! If you are worried about it being other people there I promise you don’t! They both are so sweet and helpful! It was even CANDY in the room! Lol Also I  would bring extra cash for parking. The end

This was a great location for all our wishes.
The apartment was clean with all the amenities we needed.
Street parking was easy. Most nights parking right in front of the unit. The furthest we parked was 1 block away.
Highly recommend this rental.
LC
Good place
Silvia was really nice and accommodating, and a great stay if you’re visiting UofChicago as a student or for a Chicago internship. Would recommend!
Great place. Jake was responsive. Great parking place

Our group loved staying at Aisha's place! She was very attentive and communicative throughout our stay. Great location by a number of restaurants and access to public transportation. We would definitely stay again!

The location of this stay was wonderful! However when we arrived there were dirty dishes in the sink and dirty towels on the floor of the back bedroom as well as the clean towels smelling like they hadn’t been dried all the way. The sheets also had pet hair and possibly human hair over them and a couple of the pillow cases had stains on them. I hate to leave a negative review it just seems like the cleaning crew needs to be more attentive.
Thank you.

We had a great time when we were here. Andrew was very responsive and helpful. He even brought a fan to accommodate us when we asked. The site says 4br 5bd, but there’s only 4br and 4bd. It didn’t affect our experience, but if it means anything to anyone just a heads up.
Great small apartment in a terrific location.

A very stylish and warm place and social area.
We enjoyed walking out of the door and walking a block to a quality breakfast place or restaurant. Just a very vibrant neighborhood.
Very close to Wrigley.
A great place in a cozy neighborhood!

The suite was very cozy and nicely maintained. Suzanne and Christian were very responsive and approachable. The place is very close to bus routes with easily available streetside parking. We had great time staying here and will surely visit again!!

En general, tuvimos una buena experiencia. Alma estuvo siempre muy pendiente y respondió rápidamente todas nuestras inquietudes.
El alojamiento cuenta con lo básico para una estadía tranquila en Chicago. El vecindario se siente seguro y agradable, tiene una parada de bus frente al edificio y estaciones de las líneas verde y roja a pocas cuadras. Su ubicación es bastante central, por lo que ofrece una buena relación calidad-precio teniendo en cuenta el tamaño del apartamento y la zona. El acceso al edificio y el proceso de check-in también fueron muy fáciles.
Antes de la llegada se nos ofreció una póliza opcional de USD 200 por daños. Decidimos no adquirirla y no tuvimos ningún inconveniente; la anfitriona respetó las condiciones acordadas inicialmente.
Aunque no es un apartamento lujoso, es una opción práctica, bien ubicada y con una buena relación calidad-precio.
Clean, comfortable house in a very quiet neighborhood. Not far from the Metra station to take you downtown.

Marco was a great host, very accommodating and responsive during our stay.
We wanted a place that was outside if the main downtown, but still easy enough to get to public transportation. The Blue line Division station was about 1/2 a mile away and from there we could get to any of the major attractions easily using the "EL".
We found the apartment perfect for our needs, 4 of us with 2 teenagers. Everyone had their own space, 2 nice bathrooms but still a cozy and authentic Chicago neighborhood feel.
We didn't use the cooking facilities, but found the place to be well appointed with everything we needed.
Easy check in and out with detailed instructions of how to find the place and the garage. The garage was a tight fit for our average sized sedan, I don't think our minivan would have fit.
Marco was a pleasure to deal with and was very quick to help solve a tech issue as fast as possible.
My wife really liked the authentic Chicago feel of the place and we would definitely recommend it!
Really enjoyed our stay here!
The pace was as advertised and it was well equipped with convenient items.
Check in easy. Very communicative. Even though you enter their home the steps down to unit are right as you go in. Did not see or hear them the whole 2 nights we were there
Great location, cute place! Owner communicated very well and checked in to see if we needed anything throughout our stay.
Great place to stay for the weekend.

We will plan to stay here on our next visit.  The unit was clean, and had everything we needed.  It’s located an easy walk to food and retail.   Had to give less than 5 stars on “check in” because we had trouble getting the key to work after trying multiple times, and spent extra time trying to make sure we were even doing it right.  We learned that it just takes a lot of “jiggling” with the key to get it to open the door.  Not the owner’s fault, but a note about this in the instructions will be very beneficial.
John is a great host - very kind and attentive. The place is also in a convenient location and walkable to nearby stores and restaurants. Would recommend!

Had the most excellent Airbnb stay of my life at this beautiful townhome! It was so well-decorated, clean and remarkably well-stocked with anything you could want from an Airbnb. Walkable to Fulton Market and accessible to the rest of the city. Would highly recommend to everyone!
Great location, super clean, well appointed, awesome pool!  Thanks for a great stay!

We loved Brendans place.  The apartment was clean and well appointed.  We felt very safe in the neighborhood.  Brendan provided many great recommendations and his communication was great.  Would stay again
Great location and easy check in.
Great place to stay. In the city but just enough removed to feel peaceful.

My fiancé and I really enjoyed our stay here for a short summer vacation. The condo was beautiful, but our favorite parts had to have been the bathroom and the kitchen! We especially loved the tall and spacious showers. A smaller detail that I appreciated was the autofill water pitcher in the fridge since I take my water bottle everywhere! The neighborhood felt safe and quiet, and the garage was great to come home to after a day in the city looking for parking.
Theodora was also a wonderful host and always quick and responsive to any questions or issues we had.
Wonderful hosts and fast response times.  Fantastic location and it feels like home :)

A gem in Ukrainan Village -- I loved this place. Clean, plenty of room. Quiet neighborhood. Damen and Chicago a few minutes walk north.  Sarah the host was responsive and very helpful when needed.  Highly recommended.
Very quaint place, nice-ish area and a lot to do.

Matt was an excellent host—really friendly and quick to respond, which made everything easy and comfortable. The place was clean and exactly as described, and the neighborhood was a huge highlight with great restaurants, coffee shops, and everything within easy walking distance. I would happily stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay at Garden Retreat. The location was quiet, safe, walkable and very close to a CTA station. There were also great food options within walking distance. Jose was very responsive and allowed us to check-in an hour early. He also let us leave our luggage at the Airbnb a couple hours after check-out as our flight back home was later in the day. The place was spacious and clean, we also really appreciated the A/C as it was a hot weekend and Jose provided extra filters in the A/C as there was smoke from the Canadian fires. Jose was a very accommodating and polite host, I would definitely rent from him again!
It was a great location with a tidy space that’s been regularly cleaned by professionals.

The bathroom drain was extremely slow and the water pressure was poor, which made using the shower frustrating. The morning before checkout, I woke up to a small insect crawling on me, but at the time I believed it was an isolated incident. While packing my clothes shortly before checkout the following day, I found three similar small insects in the bedding. I photographed one and contacted the host first to give him an opportunity to address the concern, but no meaningful resolution was offered. Airbnb later instructed me to seal my belongings and use high-heat treatment as a precaution against possible bed bugs. I was not given confirmation that the property was professionally inspected. Based on the maintenance issues, the insects found in the bedding, and the way my concern was handled, I would not stay here again. However, the location is great and walkable. Jhon was responsive up until I had an issue and requested the refund, due to the insects. All conversation ceased.

The condo itself was fine, neighborhood was pretty nice. There was a mouse running around in our room and out into public space. We were also never given clean towels after the first night.  The bed was very uncomfortable and it got far too warm in there over night. I wouldn’t stay in their place again

The location is very good. We walked to the red line most days to take it into town. We enjoyed having a great coffee shop 2 blocks away. The space was comfortable and I found the bed in the master bedroom very comfortable.
Has a great stay here - would definitely recommend for a group!

I read loads of reviews before booking a place, and after reading all the reviews Natalie's place seemed like the obvious choice! All of the amazing reviews were 100% correct. We had the best experience here. Do not hesitate to book!
We traveled with our 6 and 10 year old. The location felt very safe, and the it was so convenient to resteraunts, Lake Michigan, and the train! We were mainly in town for games at Wrigley, and the train ride was very easy.
The space itself is so beautiful. We loved it so much we ordered delivery several times so we could hang out and enjoy the space.
Finally, Natalie is a welcoming host. She was so responsive to my questions leading up to and during our stay. We appreciated the luggage drop-off option to accommodate our flight schedule. She helped us feel at ease with expert suggestions and a friendly demeanor.
This was a top-notch experience. I would tell others: book now! Thank you, Natalie.
We had such a great stay at Song’s airBNB. Plenty of space and great location.
Had a lovely stay here in Logan Square, the location was great and it was super easy to get in. Nice clean space everything as described. Chill host, would stay again!

Inside apt was very clean and well decorated.  Location is great and walkable to museum, beautiful walking paths , and Obama Center. Outside of actual apt- building seemed in transition, run down, and misc trash in building yard. A bit noisy at night with motorcycles and loud music building over.

Our stay at Gabriel and Tina’s Brick House in Pilsen was absolutely wonderful! The home has been beautifully renovated and feels brand new. It features a fully equipped kitchen, a washer and dryer, and two comfortable bedrooms—everything you need for a relaxing stay.
This place is truly a gem in the heart of Chicago. It’s within walking distance of the train station, great restaurants, unique local spots, and a large green park. The neighborhood is very clean, welcoming, and felt incredibly safe. In fact, we comfortably walked to grab tacos at midnight which says a lot about how secure the area feels.
We rented a car so we could easily explore every corner of Chicago, but honestly, you don’t need one. Public transportation and the walkability of the neighborhood make getting around very convenient.
I would absolutely recommend staying here to anyone visiting Chicago, and I will definitely be back the next time I’m in the city. Thank you, Gabriel for giving lots of information.
The location was perfect for us. Plenty of space and especially liked 3 baths for three couples. The townhouse was airy with high ceilings.we would stay again.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay, the apartment was exactly what we wanted. The host was very responsive and answered all of our questions quickly. The area was very safe and there is a lot of things to do within walking distance. Also, it was only about a 12 minute drive from downtown so we got to do everything we came there to! The initial door to the apartment complex was a little tricky to find at first, but once we found it, everything else went very smoothly. Thank you for hosting us!

We really enjoyed our stay. They had a list of local restaurants , coffee shops, and things to do. Felt like a home not an air bnb which we liked. Loved the bathroom and the kitchen. Everything was great
Had a great stay

What Wrigley dreams are made of! Literal steps from the park entrance. If you’re a light sleeper, bring ear plugs since it or right next to the fire department. They are definitely mindful of their sirens, but light sleepers will notice. Make sure to drink your coffee on the deck in the morning to watch all of the dogs taking their owners inside the fire dept to visit. The players also enter across the street so you can catch a view of them, too!
if you are doing anything at wrigley field, you cannot find a better spot then Carlos' home!

We loved Mike’s place and felt immediately at home. He was so helpful and responsive, especially regarding our dog. We loved the neighborhood and being outside of the city. Tastefully decorated! Would highly recommend!

This was a very nice place to stay for the weekend! Close to a lot of restaurants. Check in instructions were very clear and understandable. Overall, pretty clean (minus the scuffs on the walls). Very soft mattress and it was comfortable. Keep in mind it is right next to the train and a major street, so you will hear the train and the emergency cars driving by. Ear plugs are provided, but once you are sleep, it wasn't that bad. I would definitely recommend.

The neighborhood was described accurately. I appreciate that Benny set expectations regarding noise (close proximity to the police station). Communication was prompt and Benny handled concerns very quickly. There was ample space, the hvac worked very well and even enjoyed a very nice breeze with open windows. Benny’s unit is conveniently located close to the very nice area of Oak Park. This is a great Airbnb if you’re wanting a comfortable place for rest after a day of Chicago adventure.

My family is from Chicago. We were just visiting and celebrated my 40th year high school reunion picnic at Carver Military Academy. We felt comfortable and at home. I don't come home often but want a peaceful and pleasure place to chill. I found that place here with this host. Thank you and be blessed. I would recommend to rent again from the host.

This is a great place to stay that is convenient to the lake, the river, and other fun areas of Chicago. It's easy to get in and out and the rooftop deck is great to hang out.
One of the bedrooms is sort of an alcove off of the den area, so it doesn't have a door or wall for privacy. It didn't impact us much, since my son slept in that area, but might be if more privacy is needed.

Daniel was an extremely nice and accommodating host! The place was spotless and the location was very convenient— just a 5-10 min walk to the train that will take you downtown. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Overall space was super cute and easy to check in! Smelled super good and was very clean as well. There were some interesting people in the area, and the upstairs neighbors were a little loud as to be expected with kids! Other than that everything lived up to our expectations! The hosts were super responsive and friendly as well!
very nice and quite location to stay at.

The home was very clean and neat as a pin. Host was very helpful, responsive,  and made us feel very welcomed.  He had snacks and drinks in the kitchen,  plenty of clean towels, toiletries.  The home is very spacious. We would stay there again.
Great location , easy to work with host.
Had a wonderful time in Chicago. Great place very clean and close to everything. Thomas was a great host.

We had an amazing stay! The place was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and everything we needed was provided.
A special thank you to Hanna and Mark for being such wonderful hosts. They were friendly, responsive, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay. Their hospitality truly made the experience even better.
Highly recommend staying here we would definitely come back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

My friends and I stayed at Daniel’s apartment in Lincoln Park for four nights and had a great time! The apartment was clean, cozy, and matched the description. Daniel and Jennifer were friendly and extremely proactive in their communication. Daniel even personally dropped off some extra towels and linens for us, which we really appreciated. It was the perfect home base for our trip and I’d gladly recommend anyone stay here.

This a great spot with a lot of room, it has a surprising amount of outdoor space. Parking is a bit tight but I has a private garage. the location is a great home base for exploring the city, with a lot of restaurants and stores close by

Fantastic place. Really easy to get to transit (15-20 min walk), quiet, clean, and a great space. The kitchen was very well appointed. We appreciated the number of spices available and they even had stuff like a garlic press! We loved our stay!
Had a great weekend and place was peefect and close to wrighlyville as well as a park with good running path. Very responsive with any requests

We had a great stay at Auroom’s place! Went with a group of friends for VNL games and everyone was very comfortable and had plenty of space! The couch is huge which was nice for our one couch sleeper, and the back deck was super relaxing. Blackout curtains, very sharp kitchen knives for cooking, and tiny complementary toothpastes were all great touches!
Very nice place in a great location. Very responsive hosts. Would definitely stay here again.

First off, the pictures didn’t give this beautiful home justice. We were in a very nice and peaceful neighborhood, even a few rabbits stopped by to say hello. There was plenty of space for our family. My favorite was the top floor. That the perfect set up for sharing a room with a roommate. I loved the lower floor as well. Bhavish supplied us with everything we needed and then some. The decor to furniture were well selected for the home. We really felt at home. If you’re ever in the Chicago area with a large family or group, this is the perfect place!!
Great stay. Fantastic communication.

Great space and awesome location! Very walkable to Old Town and conveniently located near two train stations. Host was great - proactively provided clear instructions and made the entire experience easy and enjoyable for my group. Highly recommend!

Easy check in and out. Good location near end of Randolph and walkable to many shops/restaurants. Place was clean and free of clutter. We had a larger vehicle so couldn’t utilize garage parking and street parking was a challenge around here. Would stay here again!
Super great!
Great place! So close to city!!

We had an absolutely fantastic weekend in Chicago, and Rida’s apartment was a very nice home base for our group of 6.
The location in Lakeview put us close to everywhere we wanted to visit on the North Side. It’s centrally located in a vibrant neighborhood and within easy walking distance to great coffee shops, restaurants, and Whole Foods. Our weekend included a walk from Wrigleyville following a Cubs game—which is a bit of a longer walk, but totally doable and a great way to see and experience more of the area.
The apartment itself was a clean, historic yet updated space and equipped with everything we needed for our stay. We also were pleasantly surprised by how easily we found parking in the neighborhood.
If you're looking for a convenient, and comfortable spot to stay in the heart of Chicago, this is it. We’d absolutely return for a future stay. Thank you, Rida!
Great!
This place was lovely! Not to far from the city and was easily accessible. Only thing was the ac was not very strong so it was a tad warm. Other than that we loved our stay in Chicago.
Was a great place to host a large group of people and was on a very peaceful street. Easy to get everywhere we needed to go! Highly recommend

We had a great stay! The place was very clean, the rooms matched the photos, and check-in was quick and easy. The location was excellent and made it convenient to get around. We’d definitely recommend staying here and would happily book again.

Everything about Tara’s placed matched the descriptions provided and was in a great location. I would stay again if i’m ever in need of an Airbnb in Chicago. Everything was in great condition and instructions were extremely clear and easy to follow.
I’d recommend Tara’s place due to the location, amenities provided and the quality of the hosts communication.
Jen’s place was everything it was described as. Beautiful neighborhood, lots of food options, and she’s very helpful and friendly. Definitely recommend this homestead!!!

All in all it was a great stay not too far outside the city. The apartment was very clean and orderly. However, it was very warm inside and it took awhile to cool down using the air conditioner unit and several fans. The fans were in the apartment but we had to leave all doors open when going to bed to make sure there was some airflow. It also would have been nice to have a few extra blankets or pillows available. The other thing that wasn't necessarily an issue but something to know, is that it is on the second floor with wood floors so the sound does travel below, as we were asked to keep down the running and heavy walking (we had kids with so it is understandable). So that is something to consider.

I had a friend join the trip last minute. I asked Jane for an extra towel upon arrival. My Airbnb was then adjusted and I was charged almost $70 more for the extra guest. Not sure if that is an Airbnb policy or their own personal policy. Everything else was great. Clean and cozy.
A fantastic launch point to visiting Andersonville. Cozy and well-located. Very responsive hosts.

Rays place was wonderful. He was very accommodating to our Pampered Chef ladies. Will definitely stay again. We locked ourselves out and he already had a plan put in place in case this were to happen. Please note the door does lock behind you when closing so we just always immediately put the key back in the lock box so it didn’t happen again. Completely our mistake. Parking can be a small challenge but we were able to find it on the street not too far away or the lot on the next street over at Ricobennes
Which btw eat at the 3 restaurants right there on 26th they are all worth it!
Great place for a guys trip. Speaker system is elite for tunes. Great food around and A/C in the place was awesome.

Kennen was very attentive when i texted him a question!   Place was very nice!   Within walking distance distance to everything.  Buses to Wrigley Field only a block away away.   Great place to stay!    Thanks Kennan
Great place!
Tia’s place was fantastic and exactly what we were looking for. The decor and amenities were a great touch, would definitely stay again.
Great spot in a great area. Very practical for big groups and responsive host
I had a nice stay with Sezgin. The place was as described and very close to transit.
Great place to stay at, dan was very responsive and friendly. Would stay here again!

We had a great stay for my friend’s bachelorette. Place was clean, secure, safe, great atmosphere. Communication was excellent. No question was left on read more than a few minutes. We were given a phone number for emergencies as well. Kitchen could have been slightly better stocked with pots and pans and glassware since it’s advertised for groups but all the basics were provided. A bit more description in the listing about the distance to the parking garage would be helpful as it doesn’t really translate when you look it up on Google Maps and we would have planned our arrival slightly differently had we known. We also hit a snag exiting the parking garage and were stuck for a few minute. But all in all it was a fantastic stay.

This listing is great for those who are visiting Chicago but want to stay in a quieter neighborhood. We visited with our dog, and we did not have any trouble with the noise level. The area is quiet and pet-friendly. The place was also clean and comfortable to stay. It had everything you’d need. We would definitely book this spot again in the future!
It was a good place to stay.

Great place! Not in the center of the city so it’s a great place to relax after exploring! We did have to ask for a fan because of the heat while we stayed and Kim got us one in less than an hour! He is a really great host and responds quickly! Would stay again!

Melissa and her place were great!!! The space is conveniently located in town and a perfect space for a quick getaway. Melissa had the extra bed made up and waiting for us when we arrived. The place was spotless and had everything we needed for a great weekend.
We loved the location and comfortable beds. We will definitely come back to stay. Thanks
It was the perfect spot for our group! We had plenty of room and it was very peaceful. No complaints!
Overall, it was a good stay! My boyfriend loves Star Wars, so that was a great touch.

Thankfully this place had clean floors, one of my most important issues with Air B-n-B’s, being able to walk around and not have filthy feet. Great for Ukrainian neighborhood experience. Very walkable to restaurants, bars, deli’s.
Great stay
Easiest Airbnb experience yet — so communicative, clean, and convenient! Had such a great stay and will gladly recommend to others!

I think this house was a nice place to stay. I would say it definitely could have been cleaner, the sheets felt like there were crumbs all over. The bathroom had hair in the tub, the drain was just dirty. The hosts were very kind and replied right away with any questions we had.

This was my first time in Chicago and I was here for a tournament in Cicero so the location and proximity was clutch. 5 min walk to the pink line and 10 mins total to my destination. Evegenii was super communicative and instructions were clear. I came here to play in the tournament and sleep.
The outside of the house looks completely opposite of the inside. The neighborhood does seem a bit sketchy and I ubered at night. Across the street was a mountain of furniture and junk but the inside was super clean with modern aesthetics but it’s still shared space. On the second night, one of my neighbors came in at 2 am and was being inconsiderate. That’s my only complaint but the common space is shared so I suppose it’s par for the course.
The access to laundry was a plus since I was competing, the host was attentive and responsive and overall a fine stay. There aren’t any hotels within the location of where I needed to go so this was the optimal solution.
The apartment was in a nice neighborhood, close to the lake and close to the red line.  We enjoyed our visit.
Perfect!
I enjoyed my stay here, place was nice and clean. Always quick response didn’t have a problem staying here.

The place was easy to find and 2 parking spots in the alley was nice. The location was good but wish it was a tad closer walk to the trains. The kitchen was very nice and well stocked. The bathrooms were a little dirty and didn’t have towels or conditioner. We found towels left in the dryer. The mirrors had stickers leftover from a previous bachelorette. The AC unit is on the 2nd level outside the bedroom which was extremely loud when it clicked on and off, but the AC was cold. The light switch situation was kinda comical, would help if you labeled them. Overall it served its job, but wouldn’t be my first choice in Chicago.

We enjoyed our stay here for a long weekend. Place was clean, great location with easy access to bus lines, and quiet and comfortable neighborhood. Downside was the inconsistent AC temp- we would set it to cooler and it would take a while to cool or would bump back up to a higher temp. Unsure if that was interference by the host over a virtual app or the system setting itself. Overall, a great stay.
Susan was amazing, will be staying here again!

Alojamiento muy limpio, Brad muy amable y atento.
Fácilmente puedes llegar, hay un estacionamiento muy cercano y también hay transporte que te lleva al Downtown.

This is a great location in a more residential area of Chicago given that it's downtown.  it's easy to walk to the metro and it's right on a few different bus lines.  the house was in very good condition and was very comfortable for our large group.  It's a walkup inside so if you have anyone with mobility issues, it may not be the best fit.  For anyone else I couldn't recommend it more.
We stayed with 6 adults, 2 children, and a toddler. There was plenty of space. The view was beautiful. The L was close and easy to use/walk to. Everything about this place was amazing

The photos do not do this place justice! Gorgeous and clean home, 8 of us were able to stay here very comfortably. Hosts were very accommodating and communicative. Location was great, walking distance to a lot of fun places. Highly recommend staying here.

The apartment was clean, the bed was comfortable, and we appreciated the thoughtful snacks, including gluten-free options. However, the entrance was difficult to find, and the top-floor unit requires climbing several flights of stairs. When we arrived, the apartment was very warm, the window AC needed to be drained before it would work, and there was a strong cannabis smell throughout the space on both nights. Overall, the apartment met our basic needs, but several issues made our stay less comfortable.

Beautiful home, plenty of space for 2 couples.  The parking garage for 2 was great!! The master bathroom shower is gorgeous!!!  Lots of extra amenities in case you forgot something, thanks for the toothbrush! : )

Great communication from our host. Quick responses and easy directions. Parking was a breeze. Building seemed safe and we loved the view from the top floor!  Tidy space. It was within walking distance of restaurants, coffee and the beautiful lakefront was across the street! Would recommend.

We stayed for a few nights to explore Chicago. We drove into the city each day and it was only about a 20 minute drive. The dedicated parking spot at the house was great. The apartment was well stocked… some spices already in the kitchen, enough pots / pans to cook meals, and plenty of linens / towels for the apartment. It felt more like staying at a family members house than a hotel. But because you are in the basement we occasionally heard footsteps above us in the morning.
We had a very comfortable stay! The unit was quiet and in a great location. We loved the building amenities, especially the pool. It’s definitely a splurge but it was worth it!

We were a 3 generation family of 9, including 2 children under 5 and a baby. The house layout and location worked very well for us. The accommodations and furnishings were very nice.
The trains are quite close and loud - as was disclosed - but we became accustomed to it. All of us adults found the bed mattresses a bit harder than we are used to. But we were so active and exhausted each day we still slept well. Host was very responsive to all questions - and prompt!
Great stay. Everything just as described with clear instructions.

Overall, I was very pleased with our stay at Daniel’s studio!
My partner and I felt this was located perfectly to allow you to explore all of the local amenities while being near the Red line, which connects you to everything Chicago has to offer.
The space was immaculate and had everything we needed. I am a brand-snob with hotel stays, so AirBnB’s are not typically on my list of places to explore, but on a whim we tried it and I left incredibly pleased with Daniel’s space! Clean everything, wonderful shower, full fridge, oven/range, dishwasher - you name it, he had it.
My partner and I appreciated Daniel’s kindness toward us during our stay. We kept busy with our own plans, but had we been around more or asked Daniel for help/recommendations, I know he would have been happy to help us out. He struck me as a social butterfly who is wonderful to every human he comes across.
When our next trip to Chicago comes around, I anticipate we will be checking with Daniel first. Thank you!!
Great stay. Would be back!
Great location, better quality than the images imply
Great place. Amazing view of Solider Field, home of THE Chicago Bears. Wonderful stay. Thanks so much!

Great location in a great Chicago neighborhood. We were able to walk to local restaurants and had easy access to public transportation to get to the major attractions. We would love to stay there again.

Knowing the location is key for out of towners with kids. The unit itself needs some maintenance. The ac barely worked, but the overall experience was good. The location of this place is the only thing that would keep me from staying here again.
Great communication from the hosts.  Easy check in.  Appreciated their neighborhood guide that was informative about the area.  Clean and comfortable.  Great stay overall.

We stayed for a Bachelorette girls weekend! We absolutely loved the apartment. It was clean, beautiful and comfortable. Excellent communication with owners. Definitely a place we would love to stay again!
We had a great stay. Basically everything was walkable. Close to Wrigley Field with lots of great restaurant options. We felt very safe and comfortable. I would recommend and go back!

The host was very welcoming. Quick to respond and take care of minor things that was not a concern but she set a standard and made sure it stood.
Property manager was the sweetest and very helpful when needed.

We LOVED our stay at this Airbnb! The duplex was so peaceful, cute, and perfect for a girls weekend. Every amenity you could think of was carefully placed including nice shampoo and conditioner, towels for your face to wash off makeup, robes, and extra stock of all supplies. The whole vibe of the Airbnb was extremely clean, chic, and updated. I would recommend this Airbnb to anyone. Only about 15-20 minutes to wrigley and 30 min to downtown this Airbnb is the place to go!

Ishin was super responsive, welcoming and helpful. The apartment was clean, cozy and in a great location. Only downside was some noise from upstairs neighbors, to be expected in an older house. Overall great stay!

We had a lovely stay with two toddlers! The apartment was roomy and looked like the pictures. The ease of indoor parking was lovely, and the proximity to bus made it quick and easy to get to the loop or to connect with L lines and explore the city. I would definitely stay at Thomas' place again!
The condo was spotless and in a great location. Would definitely rent it again. The hosts were also very responsive and proactive in their communication. Overall a great experience

"A fantastic stay from start to finish! The place was spotlessly clean, incredibly comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. Check-in/ Check-out were easy, and John was communicative and helpful throughout. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!"
We had a great stay!

Justin was a perfect host!  The apartment was exactly as it was described and was a perfect place for our weekend in Chicago.  The area was very nice and peaceful with lots of little businesses in the area.  The CTA station was walkable which gave us easy access to the entire city.  The apartment was clean and very spacious.  Would definitely stay here again when we return!
We had a great time at this location! It was everything we could have asked for. We would definitely come back!

Amazing two-bedroom flat in Chicago. We've stayed in this neighborhood a bunch of times and this is our favorite among all of the places we've stayed in terms of both location, finishes, and amenities. Would love to stay at Paul's again sometime soon.

We had a great four-night stay. The location and neighborhood were excellent, with convenient access to nearby attractions and everything we needed during our visit. The host was a great communicator and made the stay easy and comfortable. We would happily stay here again.

Amazing stay!  Super clean and loved the decor.  Very welcoming with water and cold beverages and even some snacks! Linens smelled good and the entire place was very clean.  Walkable to coffee and many restaurants.  Def would stay again.
Lovely historic home with a nice vibe. My bedroom was clean and well-air conditioned - big comfortable bed.
The place was on the 3rd floor so multiple steps but was perfect for our larger group.   Very clean and pictures were an accurate description of the place.
What a great surprise! Tim and Barb were so friendly and welcoming, and they really have everything so together. Could not have been nicer.

Anna was incredibly welcoming and responsive for our recent trip to Chicago. We felt right at home and you cannot beat the view of the city from the roof. 5/5 stars and we would all absolutely recommend this property for others looking for a spot to spend their next trip to Chicago.
Great place. Bring a sound machine if you are a light sleeper . Amazing location !

Great place to stay. The location is in the River North area of Chicago close to downtown, restaurants, and so much to do. Miya provided pictures so we were able to find the location easily and the place is great. Very clean and spacious. We hope to be back soon!
Place was nice and very spacious. Super easy to check in and responsive host. Linen was very clean and I felt comfortable at this listing. Would stay again for sure.
The description and photos provided by Amy are accurate. It’s a good location and she is quick to respond.

We had a wonderful stay in this beautiful loft-style apartment! It was cozy, tastefully designed, and had every amenity we needed for an enjoyable trip. The location was incredibly convenient, making it easy to get around.
Noise does travel given the loft-style design, so at times we could hear our upstairs neighbors, which is worth noting as something that can be expected due to the building's design, but overall it didn't take away from how much we enjoyed our stay in this cozy space.
The host was fantastic, warm, attentive, and quick to respond to any questions. We'd happily stay here again!
Derek was a wonderful host. He was very responsive and helpful with any questions we had. Will definitely would book again!
The Airbnb was very nice and open with easy access to the City. I would definitely stay again if I'm ever in Chicago!
Great place! Very large kitchen and living room. Well stocked with all the things we needed. Easy and free parking! Great host!

Our group of 12 friends had a wonderful stay. The Inn has excellent, spacious common areas, a great kitchen, and 12 very comfortable bedrooms that provide real privacy. The location is superb too! We would happily stay here again if we’re back in Chicago. Thanks to Eva and the team for a great stay!

The apartment itself looked like the pictures, and the amenities and area were safe and accessible. However, I had a few issues during check-in. Check-in was originally listed as 3 PM, but at 2:45 PM I was informed by the host that it would be delayed until 4 PM, which was inconvenient. Upon arrival at 4 PM, the apartment was still being cleaned. My biggest concern was that the person pictured as the host was not actually the host. The host used a different person’s photo, and I only discovered this after meeting the actual host while she was still cleaning the apartment. When I asked about the photo discrepancy, the explanation was not acceptable and made me feel uncomfortable. I was also asked to wait inside with this person while the cleaning was being finished. Since I was visiting another city and had already noticed something that felt misleading, I did not feel safe and waited by the doorway instead. For the amount of money spent, I expected a more safety and professionalism.
Wonderful option on the budget friendly side when visiting Chicago. Very clean and a nice spot to unwind after a hectic day in the city.

The place location is convenient, travel time to downtown is less than 20 min by car. The house has everything you need to stay for a few days, the only problem were some of the beds not being as comfortable as they should. The backyard needs a lot of care so is not usable and the neighborhood doesn’t feel super safe with people late at night yelling in the vicinity.

Tere was a wonderful host and very responsive and proactive. The location is great and our walks to Wrigley were a breeze. However, when we booked the unit it was advertised as having one queen bed, and two twin beds. When we arrived it was two queen beds. The photos had changed so it is currently advertised correctly. However we chose the unit so that my dad and brother and I could each sleep separately. Aside from that we have nothing but positive feedback.
Beautiful place wonderful communication nice host I appreciate her being so nice

Our stay at Nick’s place in Roscoe Village was absolutely perfect!
The space itself is incredibly charming and relaxing, making it the perfect home base for a Chicago trip.
Nick has thought of everything—the rental is loaded with all the amenities you could possibly need, along with so many thoughtful touches that show how much he cares about his guests.
From the very beginning, his communication was proactive and clear with a video sent for where we would be and exactly how to check in.
He also went completely above and beyond by saving a parking space for us with a cone on a busy Friday night, ensuring our check-in was completely smooth and stress-free. We were also blown away by how kind and welcoming he was, even stocking the fridge with water, soft drinks, and beer ahead of our arrival. We cannot recommend Nick and his beautiful space enough!

We had an extended stay as we were helping our son and daughter in law with their new baby.   It was very convenient to their apartment.   A great walkable neighborhood - close to many restaurants,  Target, CVS, Trader Joe’s and Whole Foods.   The host was very responsive!!   The only downside was that appeared bigger in the pictures.     I would recommend!!
Yazmin was a very responsive host and did a great job making sure our stay was as good as possible.

We loved our stay here! It was a group of 10 of us so we had just enough space to all sleep. It did take quite a bit of coordination to help everyone get their belongings inside since there is only one key fob, and it took us a minute to figure out how to access the keys that were left for us. But we figured it out and all was okay.
The space is really nice! Actually a bit bigger than I’d anticipated based on the photos. Lots of bathrooms which was essential for a group of 10 women.
The location was tucked away and pretty quiet though walking distance to West Loop bars and restaurants. The building itself seems to be geared towards university students so it was fairly busy but everyone seemed to be respectful of quiet hours!

Very good location that was convenient for our stay.  Very clean.  Had no problem finding parking on the street near the apartment.  Walked to restaurants, bars and coffee shops in 5-10 minutes.  Pictures and description were accurate.  Not that the host can control it, but there was a crying toddler running around at night above us both nights, around 10:30pm-midnight.  It was quiet after that.

The host was very responsive. My flight landed earlier than I thought and they allowed me to store my luggage on site. Only downside is it next to a fire station so it can be a little loud it random times. but they provided ear plugs to help remedy that. It was clean they provided soap for the laundry machine. The shower was nice very good pressure. Little run down in certain parts you can tell that it's a very frequented Airbnb. I would stay again. it's in a great location next to the subway if you need to get around the city and not too far away from Navy Pier or other places.

We attended a concert at the United Center and it was an easy 25 min walk! There are so many restaurants, Walgreens, and bars in walking distance, too! Spacious kitchen to cook, nice balcony space off the upstairs bedroom, and super easy check in and check out. Highly recommend!

Lovely, and well appointed. Enjoyed the neighborhood and nearby eateries within walking distance. Our group enjoyed playing albums on the turntable. Overall, we truly enjoyed our stay. However, the bed mattresses and pillows were not very comfortable and we wished the ice maker worked. Despite these inconveniences, we still felt the property deserved a 5 star rating.
Donald was a great host. The apartment was a lovely home for our weekend in Chicago.
Everything was fantastic!

A group of 9 of us stayed here for the Twins vs. Cubs series and it couldn’t have been more ideal. Spacious living room and kitchen, plenty of sleeping arrangements, and the bus to Wrigleyville was only a 5 minute walk and a 10 minute ride making navigation incredibly quick. The parking spot behind the building also saved us a huge headache whenever we decided to drive somewhere. Keypad entry also allowed us to come and go as we please in smaller groups without having to share a key or someone needing to be home. We were very happy with our stay here and would recommend it to anyone with a large group staying in Chicago!
