Good place to stay. We had trouble finding nearby parking for the duration of our stay, but the location is very walkable and felt safe. The check in and out process is easy. Does have bathroom requirements, multiple signs to let you know you must sit down for all restroom activities. We had issues with bottom lock, but one of the other visitors helped us in. Overall, a good place to stay with rules in place to ensure all visitors are able to rest easily during their stay.
Great location!!

Our shower in the master bedroom was clogged the first night, which caused major flooding in the bathroom and almost into the carpeted bedroom. We used all of our towels to clean up the flood. We expressed to Drew how we resolved his plumbing issues but we used all our towels in the process of doing so, and he told us to just do laundry. Lack of initiative and unhelpful. The washer absolutely wreaked of mold and also imbalanced, causing loud noise and shaking throughout the unit. Pots and pans were not properly cleaned in between guests, which we noticed residual food our first morning cooking breakfast. There was also cat hair all over the couch and blankets despite advertisement as pet-free. This also does not comfortably sleep six guests as listed, in which my total of four felt uncomfortable with the provided sleeping arrangements. Drew was completely rude and dismissive- which was especially disappointing for my birthday trip. Spend your money elsewhere with a host that cares.

More than adequate accommodations for six adults. Easy to check in and out. Clean. Nice little outdoor area to relax which was enjoyable . Near several restaurants and bars. Nice and safe neighborhood. Easy to get a ride share. Colin was very responsive to messages. I would definitely stay here next time we’re in Chicago.
It was a lovely house. Clean and easy to get into.

Staying at Lana’s property was great! Lana was hospitable, welcoming, and communicative. The property itself was spotless, modern/updated, quiet, and very comfortable. Thank you for the wonderful stay!
Thank you for hosting our quick weekend!

Connor’s place was fantastic! Check-in and check-out were both quick and easy, making the entire stay hassle-free. The neighborhood was friendly and welcoming, and the outdoor playset was a great bonus for the kids. The gym was well-equipped, and the stylish living room made the space feel comfortable and inviting. Connor was very responsive and answered all of our questions promptly. Overall, it was a wonderful stay, and we would absolutely love to stay here again.

What a fabulous place! We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Right in the heart of Logan  Square with many restaurants and things to do!  Rooms were spacious and the living area had comfortable seating to allow visiting. Wish our visit was longer!
It was exactly what we needed, great stay!
Cozy and unpretentious. Terrific location. Would do it all over again. Thanks!

We had an amazing time staying here, the apartment was adorable and decorated so nicely. The area is great to walk around and we felt safe the whole time. Everything was clean and Jennifer makes it so easy to feel at home with all of the included amenities. We were pleasantly surprised by how stocked the place was with snacks, spices, skincare, slippers and so much more. Our entire experience went smoothly thanks to Jennifer, she was extremely accommodating and communicated everything well. Honestly, I can’t say enough good things about the place and would absolutely book with Jennifer again.
Great spot for a a group guys getting together for a weekend. Would recommend.
I had a great stay at Cynthia’s! The home was very spacious and easy to navigate. She was very easy to communicate with!

Really enjoyed our stay here. The condo is beautiful and well laid out and decorated with a nice roof top seating area. The location can’t be beat if wanting to go to a Cubs game - step out of the door and walk to the ballpark in 2 minutes. Plenty of walkable restaurants and activities as well. Loved the place and highly recommend.
everything was great. I would recommend it to everyone.

We had a great stay in this beautiful, tastefully decorated apartment! It was perfect for our family of five (two adults and three small children). It was very clean and our host was very responsive. Great neighborhood and the off street parking was perfect. We’ll be back again!
Like everyone has mentioned, this is as good as it gets for a spacious, beautifully designed spot for a larger party. Bob and AJ were extremely accommodating and welcoming. Thanks for having us!

We had a great stay! The place was clean, in a convenient location, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. We’d definitely recommend staying here!
The efficiency apt was quiet and clean. Maria was accommodating and very responsive. The apt is in a great, walkable location in wicker park! Perfect for our weekend stay!
The host was communicative and helped us with anything we needed. The unit was cozy and accommodated our needs.
As advertised, easy to get in and out.  We choose the location based off a friend who lives in Chicago, and this place was close to public transport so worked for us.  Would stay again.

If there was an award for best Airbnb experience, Jason would have it! I can't say enough about how perfect The Bluebird Inn was for our group of four. We were able to check in early and even meet Jason at The Longroom before heading up to The Orange Cat Flat. Instructions were thorough and the flat was spacious -- full of natural light and thoughtful local details with loads of character. Everything was where you'd want it, from outlets and chargers to a bar cart with glassware and utensils. The curated vinyl collection was a highlight, so we could discover local musicians together while playing Jenga (yes, games!). It was also super convenient to have the welcoming Longroom just downstairs. We arrived during the bad air quality, so grabbing pizza and drinks without having to go outside was a stroke of luck. On mornings, we'd get coffee and breakfast, then walk over to the L train. All the bartenders were awesome. Everyone's love of the city is contagious. We'll be back for sure!
Very convenient for our concert at the United Center! Was also close to the blue line. It’s a converted basement, three very comfortable beds and good bathroom- perfect for our short stay.
love the place! i would genuinely stay at this place again especially with how easy it is to get public transportation around the area.
Amazing location and very homey. Loved this spot and would definitely stay here again!
Fantastic place and fantastic value- would stay here again and again!

Overall, we had a good stay! Our hosts were very responsive to my questions and any problems. Check in and check out had clear instructions and was very straight forward. The neighborhood was very nice, lots of good restaurants and coffee shops around.

We had a great stay at Alicia’s Airbnb! The home was quiet, clean, spacious, and nicely decorated, making it a comfortable place for our group of four. It had everything we needed, and Alicia was kind, responsive, and very helpful throughout our stay. We also appreciated the free and convenient parking right outside the door. The home itself was wonderful. The surrounding neighborhood felt a bit less safe than we expected - we were approached once while awaiting an uber ride, but we didn’t experience any other issues during our stay. Overall, we had a positive experience and would absolutely stay again.
Incredible location. Lots to do in the immediate area if not going downtown. Great hosts, very attentive to guests needs. Loved where we stayed, recommend highly to anyone!

The place was nice and busy with people because we came on the weekend. Lots of traffic and a 30-40 min ride to Riverwalk. My boyfriend and I appreciated the privacy. It was a little pricey to not have certain amenities but overall ok stay for a quick unplanned getaway.
Overall a great stay! We had a couple issues with the keypad not working but easy fix with the key being provided. Nice to have the parking permits provided! Would recommend

Good place to stay in Chicago. Priced well and spacious for groups too.
When we needed more parking passes they were very responsive to pass us some more.
Comfy and cozy, all the essentials you need for a stay + some.
Thank you!

Cristian’s Airbnb was amazing. It was more beautiful in person than the pictures. The back yard is spacious, has tables and extra seating area. Cristian also responded promptly. My guest and I caused a bit of chaos, but Cristian handled it well and in a respectful manner; better than I would have expected from the lack of communication on my end and number of people. Nevertheless, We enjoyed our  stay.

Amazing stay.  So clean, so many extras and thoughtful touches. Thank goodness for the beautiful windows that overlooked the train tracks - my sons never stopped watching the trains go by. They have all of my kids cute welcome bags and it was just such a good set up.

The place was very nice and very clean.
We did not receive the code to access the unit until exactly 4 pm, after driving 6 hours to get there was a little frustrating since we had our grand children with us.
Window covers in bedrooms need to be improved; beds were very hard. Shower was fancy but knob were hard to operate.
Overall nice place to stay.
Great staying at David’s place with family. Walkable neighborhood with easy public transport access. David was accommodating to extend our check out for a bit.
Smooth. Nice location. Would use again!
The Airbnb was in a great location nearby plenty to do. Overall, it was a great experience.
Served it’s purpose for the weekend, appreciated how close it was to the city
It was fine. But on a very busy street.
Great location for a Cubs game and access to train

The experience here was quite unpleasant. First the street we were told that was free parking for the building, ended up getting me a $75 ticket. Then in the 100° 3 days there was one AC unit was only in the bedroom and did not span through the entirety of the attic. On our second day, we woke up to the freezer broken and all contents in spoiled and a wet floor to clean up, with the only two towels we were provided. When there was no wine opener, we tryed contacting one of the 3 people in charge and they did not get back to us till the day we were leaving. The photos provided need updated because they no longer have an iceplundge and had a very untrained lawn, the couch springs were almost poking through the fabric, some small fixtures in the rooms were also missing. All over communication wasn't very helpful, comfortably was scarce and my overall time was quite unfortunate especially for the prices payed.
Jamie was a great host! Very responsive and easy to talk to. I didn’t have too many questions but whenever I did, he was quick to respond and helpful. Everything was very simple and straightforward

For a one night stay, the villa totally suited our needs. The space was tasteful and clean, and the street was very quiet and safe. We were happy to have a bus so close to take us straight into the city with no hassle. The host also did a great job at responding to my questions quickly and kindly.
A few slightly picky things to note:
There really isn't much in the area to eat or do, so plan accordingly
The bed does sag in the center, comfortable for one person, but a couple can expect to taco together
No baggage drop off prior to check in (this is not a biggie, we just had to carry our packs around for longer than we hoped)

A few friends and I were in town for another friend's birthday weekend, and Matt's Airbnb was a perfect place for us to stay.  The house was very clean, well appointed (games, supplies, dishware / cutlery, etc.), and perfectly located for our activities both planned and unplanned.  We had a great time exploring the neighborhood and just relaxing at the house.  Matt and Pam were always proactive in providing information before we needed it for check-in and check-out, and responded instantly when we had minor questions.  We couldn't have been more impressed by their communication and flexibility.  All-in-all, we had a fabulous stay and would recommend the house to small groups or anyone looking for a great trip to Chicago.

The location was perfect for the weekend catching games at Wrigley. Exactly what we were looking for in terms of being able to walk there and to restaurants/ice cream after etc…Worked out perfect and Mary was very easy to communicate with!

Great stay for a great price! We loved the location as there was quick access to public transit and plenty of good eats within walking distance. The shower curtain does need replacing (dirty and too short for the tub). Also comfortable seeing may be limited depending on the size of your group and whether you like bar stools without back support (they were cute stools though). These issues had minimal impact on our stay. The bedding was comfortable. The TV had several sources of entertainment. We didn’t make use of them, but I do wanna give kudos for allowing us access to a washer and dryer. Overall, my friends and I had a phenomenal time in Chicago in part due to the stay Global Getaways provided us!
Great spot!
Great place Very relaxing for a group of 4! The Tv was very nice to have and so was the kitchen! A bit of a ways from Downtown Chicago but still this is a great deal!
We had a nice stay – – the space was clean and exactly as pictured. The location is fantastic – – walkable to many restaurants and attractions.  Great jumping off place to enjoy the city..

We stayed at their home with our 2 young children and appreciated they had a pack and play to use with a nice mattress.
Overall felt the home is not being well maintained visit over visit, it felt like it needed a good cleaning - heavily marked up walls, blankets over couches, dingy rug. Didn’t feel I could put my child on the floor.
The bedroom faces an alley with a very bright spotlight that is not covered by the blind they provide. We could not resolve the light issue with a towel or anything.
I provided details of being there with two young children and 2 adults and they only left us 3 towels. They also didn’t have a drain cover for the bathtub so we couldn’t use it.
Overall it was fine - we used it as an Airbnb for the location but overall think it was very expensive for the bare minimum being offered.

Michael’s place was so great!! Right in the heart of Boystown and amazingly close to Wrigleyville and Wrigley Field. Tons of great restaurants and bars around for a fun weekend. Beds are perfect for sharing if you are a couple.

We enjoyed our stay with Alexandra, who is an extremely kind creative! We also enjoyed her cute birds! Please be sure to ask to keep the cage closed if you do not want the birds flying around.
Public transportation is near which made navigating Chicago pretty easy. Thank you, Alexandra for your kindness and recommendations!
This house is a great location, clean, and as advertised. Pool is a fun addition to the house.

Overall, our stay was okay. The host was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our visit, and the room itself was clean upon arrival.
That said, there were a few things future guests should be aware of. The neighborhood felt older and somewhat run down, and I personally did not feel comfortable walking alone at night. The bed was not very comfortable, and the room only had two thin pillows. Because the thermostat is downstairs and locked at 70°F, the upstairs bedroom became quite warm. There wasn’t a fan in the room, and with limited airflow it often felt stuffy.
We also received several additional house rules the day before check-in, after it was too late to cancel for a refund. While I understand hosts have house rules, I think it’s important for guests to know them before booking.
Overall, the host was kind and the space was clean, but the comfort, ventilation, and timing of the additional rules made the stay less enjoyable than we had hoped.
Absolutely incredible stay. Exactly what was advertised & peaceful neighborhood! The host was very kind & accommodating. 10/10

Emily was a wonderful host! Communication as our stay was approaching was great. Emails came clearly explaining everything about our stay, and with very easy instructions as to how to access entry.  The apartment was very clean, and had every imaginable amenity you would need. Loved the available coffee, cream and sweeteners as well as a few snacks! There was nothing we would need that wasn't there. Emily is super sweet, and responded quickly to any question I had.  Thank you for making our stay so easy and perfect!  I would definitely stay again if in the area!

This place was a great home-base for out quick weekend in Chicago, tons of great food, restaurants, coffee shops, bars right there in the neighborhood. We felt safe and our car was safely parked in back. Also extremely close to bus stops, there's a gas station and super market nearby so everything you need is right there! Truly a perfect location! 3 great sized bedrooms offer plenty of space for 3 couples, the game space was a really nice touch for our son. Host was super responsive and proactive for our arrival! 100% recommend!!!

The hosts were very attentive to our needs and responded quickly to any questions we had. Great location and the supplied parking permits made it super easy to park. I would recommend this place to anyone and rent it again for some time in Chicago!

Had an excellent stay with our almost 4 year old who asked to go see skyscrapers. This was perfect. Beautiful panoramic views of the city scape, harbor, museum campus,  and a bonus to see the Navy Pier fireworks show on our arrival evening.  The building is beautiful and well maintained,  the apartment was spotless, and we really appreciated the fridge filled with staples to get us through our first morning.  We could walk or take an easy bus or train everywhere, and we were especially grateful for the awesome building amenities (game room, observation rooms,  lounges) to keep entertained when the air quality alert hit the city.  We are looking forward to returning!

Great location for a group, good space to hang out! Easy access to all things Chicago and walking distance to the Blue line was great for easy in/out to O’Hare. Lots of things nearby in the neighborhood too.

This place was a perfect landing spot if you are looking to stay north of Wrigley Park! Just blocks from a great beach and close to the red line where you can get anywhere in Chicago in no time!
Place was just as it is described.

Had a great stay Hannah and Mark were very responsive and the place was extremely clean apon arrival. The only issues were that we were told an early check in time by the hosts but they didn't recall agreeing to it. That issue was resolved over messages quickly. The other issue being that the oven set off the smoke detector anytime we tried to use it to the point where the host came in to remove it.

The Airbnb was easy to find and the check im was quick and easy with great instructions. Sara checked in during the visit to make sure everything was going well and asked if we needed anything. The area is great and felt safe with some wonderful food in the area and only a short drive to downtown. Would definitely stay at again.
Would stay here 1000 more times, it’s cute and clean! Cris is a great host and got back to me almost right away every time I reached out. Recommend staying here!
The home was beautiful and we had plenty of space for sleeping.
Great location and host was quick to respond and accommodating.
beautiful clean and comfortable space in a cute and quiet neighborhood! lots of walkable amenities nearby. this was a fantastic stay and I would absolutely recommend it
Great little spot. Sean was very responsive on all communication.
Great place to stay for family
Great spot, convenient to so much great stuff! Hyperlocal great food, convenient to the train, easy to Uber from too. Comfortable beds, clean, and just lovely.

Matthew was a super communicative host and very responsive.  The place was exactly as described, great amenities and incredible location. Would definitely stay here again when visiting Lakeview. Thanks Matt!

Michelle’s space and communication were nothing short of fantastic for our stay in Chicago. The location is excellent, and it’s an incredibly relaxing environment to come back to after a day out in Chicago. The walkability to the el, bus, or just places nearby make things very convenient. And if anything was needed, Michelle is very quick to respond. I highly recommend this space for any Chicago trip considerations and will look to stay again!

We really enjoyed the neighborhood with friendly neighbors, a nice park across the street, and walkable to the 606. The home was very clean and comfortable and well appointed. We would definitely stay again.
En general fue una buena experiencia. Vin siempre contestaba rápidamente los mensajes, fue muy amable.

My party had a great stay at Habib’s property! He was very responsive and fixed any hiccups that we did have promptly and kindly. The house was spacious for a large group and the instructions Habib left were concise and clear - made everything really easy! He was also flexible with some car issues I had upon leaving. Would recommend for a large group stay in Chicago!
Great location and space!
Very nice convenient location, perfect if you're visiting the city! Everything was clean and easy to check in. There was a bit of noise since this is a shared space but overall we enjoyed our stay!

Great location and comfy stay! Good if you have a baby. The cot was set up when we arrived and Kathleen was super accommodating and responsive. Really nice and walkable location. The 50 bus is right there!

Un très beau Airbnb où on s'est sentis comme à la maison. Un endroit très près des différentes attractions de Chicago.
Les hôtes répondaient très rapidement lorsque nous avions des besoins.
Nous avons très appréciés notre séjour.
Gabriela was very communicative and responsive to our questions. The space truly fit our vacation needs, including having room for family conversation. Would stay here again!

Spacious home, as described. Clean and well appointed. Three ovens! Not listed in posting…added versatility. Secure, with locking gate to enter the property. All bedrooms on second and third floors. Not the best for elderly guests.

Like many other reviews have said, this place is exactly as described. We stayed Thursday-Friday. The neighbors were partying late on Friday night but we had stayed out late for a concert, were exhausted from a hot day of exploring, and popped on the noise machine and fell right to sleep. Our other nights were pretty quiet. We loved the accessibility to public transit options making it easy to get around the city and to the airport. We were hardly at this Airbnb bc we were out exploring but it was convenient and the bed was comfy which was all we needed. Downstate Donuts and Golden House were both perfect for a short walk to breakfast. Would stay here again!

The place is located in the quiet neighborhood of Roscoe Village and was the perfect stay for traveling an extended period of time with a toddler. The space has every amenity and then some. The hosts were very communicative and helpful!

Overall great stay and accommodated our larger group of 8 people comfortably. While the surrounding area did not have much to explore we knew that going in, it’s a very easy walk to the pink line to get into the city. I wouldn’t recommend the location if you’re wanting to be closer/within walking to the touristy parts of Chicago. We chose a little further out since there’s limited options downtown for a group of 8 to sleep comfortably.  This way everyone got their own room which was very nice.
had great time here. thanks

We came in for 2 Cubs games. The place was great, beautiful neighborhood, and a great pizzeria close by. Hector was able to help us out with some free parking passes for near Wrigley Field and gave us an early check in. We will definitely be back if we are in the area in the future.
Great location. Includes parking so that’s helpful. Place was spotless. Everything worked. It was great to have 2 bathrooms

Wow! Just wow! Great location, beautiful house and yard was so enjoyable! Mary and Andrew were responsive and communication was very clear. They thought of everything! You will not be disappointed staying at this house. It was amazing thank you for sharing your beautiful home!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was beautiful, spacious, and incredibly peaceful. We stayed for the summer and truly had no complaints. The host was always kind, helpful, and very quick to respond whenever we had a question. I loved reading books on the back deck. We also loved having a nearby park for walks and fresh air. It was such a comfortable and relaxing place to stay, and we would absolutely recommend it to others!
This air-bnb was amazing, Eli had given us a deal and was super responsive! Would definitely say again!

This place was magnificent. Incredible character in the home, in a phenomenal location. LOTS of fridge space and convenient to so much! No better place to stay if you’re going to a cubs game with a large group!

Great spot, ideal for solo travelers who want to spend time along Chicago’s gorgeous lakeshore.
Wonderful hosts, too. We had a minor miscommunication early in my stay and they acted quickly and communicated clearly to get it remedied. The mark of true hospitality!
Would 100% stay again!
Overall high quality stay!
Perfect place for our group. We were able to park a vehicle, get to and back from the Wrigleyville area, and it has plenty of space to sleep 8

We had a wonderful stay and would happily return. The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. It was well-stocked with everything we needed, and the location made it easy to explore Chicago while still enjoying a quiet place to relax at the end of the day. We really enjoyed the porch with beautiful views of the neighborhood.
Our host was friendly, responsive, and provided clear check-in instructions, making the entire experience smooth and stress-free. We truly appreciated the thoughtful touches and the care that went into making us feel welcome.
We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago and would definitely stay here again. Thank you for a great experience!
Great place to stay. It’s in a good location, close to Chinatown and a lot of the main areas in Chicago. Parking was easy and convenient. Would stay here again!
Jeff was a good host and very responsive. The neighbourhood was great and relatively close to downtown.
Loved staying at this apartment. Perfect for two couples and so very cute!! Loved the shower amenities and appreciated the coffee! We come to Chicago often-hope to be able to stay here again!

Great place to stay if you are going to a show at the United Center. Great walkable location for that.
Interior nicely designed and comfortable for 2 people.

Highly recommend to anyone that is looking to stay in Chicago! There is AC and WiFi, which is not listed in the amenities so we were pleasantly surprised. Charie provided clear check-in and check-out instructions, and the place was quiet despite being an apartment complex. We felt very safe next to UChicago’s med center campus :)
Jamal was friendly professional and made sure we were safe

This was a fantastic location for what our group of four came here to do. Great walkability to the lake, restaurants and the red line to Wrigley Field. Kate's place was very clean, fairly comfortable and surprisingly quiet.
What a great place! Incredibly spacious for four people. Good for hanging out or as a home base for other activities. We’ve already recommended this place to friends and can’t wait to come back.
10/10! Would recommend this place to anyone

The Airbnb is a great size and the beds are comfortable. Host was extremely responsive, even when I messaged at 1 am. The rooms are not very sound proof and I could hear the neighbors being loud on Saturday night, but that is not a fault of the host.
Place was very clean
Love the place

We had such a great time during our stay! The check-in and parking instructions were extremely helpful, especially as out-of-towners navigating Chicago. The location was fantastic, with an easy walk to the nearest train station, making it convenient to explore all around the city. The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!
Great location! Walkable to Wrigley, trains, buses, restaurants, grocery, pharmacy!!! Better than expected!!! Highly recommend. Will stay again!!!

Was a great sized space for hosting 12 people. We were disappointed that the back patio was not set up nicely at all like the photos showed. The host also was did not respond to multiple questions that we asked. There were not enough bath towels for all 12 people so we reached out the host and they said they could deliver towels but then never did. The carpets were pretty dirty. Overall it was a great location and spacious for the amount of people that it holds but it would have been nice to have extra towels and the back patio in better shape.
Me and my girls love the place we had a blast and will recommend.

This place is great! Steve was an excellent communicator! The place is exactly as described and the location is unbeatable! Such a cool place with all the games! For the price, you’re not going to find any better in this area!

Great place for a weekend at Wrigley. Just a few blocks from the L making getting to and from the ballpark easy. The parking space is tight but my full size car fit no problem, just have to hug the passenger side against the garage. Awesome to have parking at all in Chicago because the street is hard to find a spot. We loved having three bedrooms because we traveled as three adults wanting separate space. The bathroom is small but completely functional for a few days! Samuel was a great host, very responsive.

Overall great experience staying at Dubb's place. Unit was very clean and spacious for our family of 5 adults. Free street parking out front was easy and finding a spot was never an issue. Public transportation is not too far, although we just Ubered everywhere and it was generally a 15-30 minute ride to all the locations we visited (United Center, Wrigley, downtown, museums, airport, etc...). Dubbs Mgmt was very easy to communicate with throughout the process. I would not hesitate to stay there again when visiting Chicago. Highly recommend!!

It was a very nice place to stay.  Overall, I have to say the experience was great.  Quiet neighborhood near train stops, Wrigley and North Halsted street.  Parking can be tough, however we were able to find some on the street, the few times we moved our cars.    It was a very nice place, and perfect for our stay!

The place is much more spacious than the photos make it seem. This is a great space for larger groups to not be on top of each other and still be comfortable in separate spaces. Great location near Whole Foods and a ton of great restaurants within walking distance, as well as many options for gyms. I would 100% stay here again for the next visit.
Everything was great during our stay! The place was very nice and was able to sleep 7 people very comfortably. The hosts were wonderful, responsive, and helpful!
Great AirBnB with a nice variety of living spaces - dining room, TV room, breakfast nook, etc. Safe neighborhood and easy walk to Loyola Red Line station. Would highly recommend!

The apartment looks like the photos and it was very clean. The building seemed safe but I wouldn’t walk around the neighborhood at night. This units bedroom is adjacent to the trash shoot, which was startling late at night. Also,  I didn’t like the managements additional check process where I had to provide my drivers license for a background check. And :15 to downtown is a stretch.

Spotless with a solid set up of kitchen utensils and appliances. Perfectly air Conditioned for our hot summer stay in Chicago. Great natural lighting. The apartment’s distance from the city center is ideal for a good night’s sleep. That being said parking is a bit of struggle, but there is food in walking distance and public transit nearby for an authentic Chicago experience.

Very nice and spacious home was just like it shows in the pictures. Doris was very accommodating with our late checkin due to car problems. We will definitely be booking with Doris again in the future. Overall great stay and experience !
Would definitely stay here again! We loved our time here. Convenient distance from downtown, especially if you take public transit. Thanks for having us :)
Thank you for your responsiveness, Lourdes.
We had a great stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and the perfect location for us. We would stay here again.
Space was great for our group and very clean. Within walking distance to the L stop made it convenient to get around. Would stay here with a group again.
A lot to do within walking distance of many attractions. Check in was easy and overall I had a very nice trip.
Our family of seven really enjoyed our three nights! Very nice place outside of the city, but yet close enough to a lot of things like the museum and Chinatown!

We were in Chicago for a family wedding which was nearby. Having the garage for our car and the area being so walkable made the weekend super easy. The home was clean and comfortable. Our host checked in with us every day to see if we  needed anything or had questions.

Great spot!
Recommended for a Chicago getaway.
very nice place

Fantastic spot!   Quiet neighborhood close to lots of restaurants and coffee shops.  Walking distance to wrigley field. Easy street parking.  The apartment was spacious, clean, and lots of little details that made it extremely comfortable.  Highly recommend and we’ll definitely stay here again.
Comfortable space with kitchen.  Walkable to Train station to go downtown.   Close to Loyola U. and restaurants.
The apartment was centrally located and walkable in a terrific neighborhood. We had everything we needed plus the parking was very convenient. Highly recommended.
Really enjoyed the apartment & location. We would definitely stay here again.
I had a wonderful stay! If you’re looking for a place that truly matches the pictures, this is the spot for you. It’s definitely a luxurious experience.

This was a great experience. The home was very clean, extremely well stocked, and any questions I had upfront were answered in minutes by Kwan -- cannot recommend enough this AirBnB and host. The neighborhood is tree lined and beautiful -- and the windows in the primary room let in plenty of natural light into the living area - which is cleanly designed and well appointed. We enjoyed many rounds of Uno as well (courtesy of the host - thank you!)
Thanks Kwan for a great experience my family enjoyed.
Great place to stay with a small group. Comfortable arrangements with a large kitchen and dining room to hangout in. Definitely recommend

This top floor apartment was great! So great not to have anyone walking around above you. Could hear the people talking from the floor below sometimes but luckily they were not too loud. Quiet and nice neighborhood and comfortable beds. It was the perfect place for a few days visit to Chicago. Felt safe in the area-Great that a good grocery store was a 10 min walk (Mariano's)  Very nice to be able to drop our luggage off earlier than check-in time. They were quick and responsive hosts which is always wonderful.

The inside was 80 degrees when checking in. The loft area was at least 10 to 15 degrees hotter. When messaging the host they said it was a heat wave and there were waters in the fridge. We had to bring the mattresses down stairs and the kids had to sleep in the floor on them. With 3 fans going none stop.
Due to ten age of the house, doors were little cracks and bathroom floor tile was cracked. But other than that the place was great
We stayed for a trip to a Cubs game and some other Chicago fun. the red line was very close. We loved our stay and would recommend for future stays as well.

Russ was a kind and responsive host. We had one problem (due to my mistake) and he was there to fix it. His place is clean, comfortable, firm beds, modern design. I just downrated location to 4, which is about Logan Square, not this Airbnb.

Had the absolute best time with this home I have never been to Chicago. This was the absolute perfect house for a group trip or a big family super spacious. Everyone was comfortable great sleep. The only thing I wish was different was maybe a king comforter in the big bedroom outside of that, everything else was great.

The location is great, right in the heart of the River North area. Very walkable and also near a train station. There were 6 of us visiting for a guys weekend, and there is plenty of room in the place as well as enough beds that no one had to share. Highly recommend.
Awesome host! Very responsive and polite during communication. Place was clean and had everything we needed to enjoy our stay!

This place was perfect for us as we were seeing two concerts at the United Center which is a mere 3 blocks away.  The kitchen was very useable for preparing meals.  We very much enjoyed our stay in this space.

Thanks so much for a great stay in Chicago! This property is perfectly located to get to the amazing eateries in West Loop, explore all the vintage stores on North Milwaukee Avenue and quickly get to the built up downtown area, with all the museums and tours. We were in town for a show at the United Centre, and this property was a great spot to base ourselves.

This was the perfect place for a baseball weekend in Chicago.  Walkable to Wrigley Field, it offered lots of space and an excellent neighborhood with convenient public transportation.  And Samad was an excellent host!
The Airbnb is close to a lot of local restaurants and walking distance to the Green line station.  The hosts were very accommodating. We really enjoyed our stay!
Beautiful view, comfortable amenities, and a kitchen stocked with literally everything you could possibly need! We loved the pool and outdoor spaces. Perfect for our little family.
Great place and great host!!!
Clean and tidy!  Fast WiFi. Comfortable beds.

Loved our stay at LIVN Chicago! The location is quite central for everything we wanted to do; the apartment was spotless, spacious, and beautiful. The staff were super friendly and responsive. I would definitely stay here again next time.
Place was great, perfect location

My husband and I are from Florida and rented Brad’s place for a weekend getaway in Chicago to attend 2 Cubs baseball games. This place is easily walkable to Wrigleyville and there are tons of restaurants and shopping in any direction! Safe to walk any time of day or night with lots of other people out and about walking dogs or taking a jog. Easy access to public transportation and about a blocks walk to the L which we took directly into the city for some sightseeing. The place was pristine and does have a window unit for cooling since the weather called for 90 degree temps while we were there. Thanks for hosting us, we’ll stay again next time we come up for sure!

We enjoyed staying here and would definitely stay again! The apartment is very charming. The neighborhood was beautiful and peaceful. I felt safe as a female walking alone. Bus transit there was a little unreliable though. We had a little hiccup with checking in, but overall, we had a good stay.
Andrea met us right when we arrived, she was very welcoming and was responsive. She provided lots of breakfast options, and the place was very cozy. Would stay again if in the area!
I would recommend Hanna and Marks place to anyone staying in Chicago. Great location with lots to do.

We had a wonderful stay.  Matthew was always responsive and professional.   We made him aware of a couple of issues which was resolved.   The area was quite safe and walkable to parks and restaurants.  We really appreciated his willingness to accommodate an early check in, which greatly helped us due to the air quality situation from the Canadian wildfires.
Beautiful spacious apt in great location near beach and also with 1 parking spot and a piano! Our kids loved the scavenger hunt too.  Thanks Sean

My friends and I were looking for a place to stay in Chicago but we’re having trouble finding somewhere that could fit everyone at a reasonable price. Once I came across this place, I knew it would be perfect. The house is a short drive from downtown making it very easy to get around. Dan sent multiple messages checking in to make sure we had everything we needed. The house itself is very nice and is perfect for a large group
We had a great stay. Neighborhood is amazing!
Nice place, super spacious, comfortable bed. Great location!

I cannot imagine a better airbnb experience for this price in the city of Chicago! If you like beautifully designed spaces, but intentional and functional, then this place is for you. This is a perfect location for driving easily into downtown, or just walking to nearby coffee and art experiences! All while sleeping in a private oasis on this quiet street, in a quaint and safe neighborhood. Street parking was never an issue. Come for an airbnb that feels luxurious, but also like home! Our group will definitely be back!!

We had the best time here! It was such a beautiful home. Feven was so helpful with anything we needed, very friendly and responsive! We left something at the Airbnb on accident and he immediately let us know and offered to ship it to us. Would definitely recommend! Lots of space for big groups and overall a wonderful experience. Thank you for having us!

khang was an amazing host. the place was perfect and fit all my needs for my first time in chicago! the place had great restaurants (all walkable) nearby and was close to the bus/trains. whenever i needed something/texted khang, they were very responsive. they also provided amazing recommendations for me. will for sure be coming back here.
Clean and very friendly home.

Our stay was really good. It was a 15-20 minute walk to Wrigley and that was our main point of the trip. Neighborhood felt safe and had several options for places to eat.
Parking will cost extra. We parked at a local school parking lot and paid $60 for Friday-Sunday come and go parking as often as we needed.

We loved our stay at Zoe's place. It was nice to return to a clean space, comfy bed, and cooled apartment after our time out in the neighborhood (so many great restaurants and bars). We appreciated the coffee maker in the morning too! Perfect place for just a couple of nights.

We felt very comfortable staying here - the place was cozy, clean and safe. I feel like everything here was very thoughtful and we appreciated it so much. We were 20 min from downtown so the location was good for us.
My husband and his buddies had a great time celebrating his 50th birthday! The place was in a perfect location for everything they were looking for! They had a great time!
Great place! Would definitely stay again!

Rafal’s place served us very well for our son‘s wedding in Chicago. We had plenty of room to spread out and it was convenient to the blue line. I would suggest a deep clean, clearing out cabinets (pans, toiletries, and cleaning supplies) but overall happy with our stay!
Un alojamiento muy cómodo, completo y limpio, ubicación buena y tranquila. El único inconveniente fueron algunos cortes de electricidad pero la comunicación continua con Jevaux fue importante.
We enjoyed our stay. It was very spacious, clean and comfortable. We would definitely rent this place again.
Amazing place would stay again!

This place has a lot of potential. Great space and location (walkable to coffee and restaurants, short ride to everything in the city). Attention on the little details and improvements or upgrades (cleaning, bedding overall) would make this place a great deal.

Sam’s place was in a perfect location. We really appreciated the fact that he had a pack-n-play so we did not have to bring ours. Sam provided clear instructions on how to check in and check out. We really enjoyed our time in Chicago staying in Sam’s place.

Great spot and easy walking to wrigley field
We would definitely stay here again
We had a great time, the only problem is there’s no where to park on the street. Besides that everything else was pretty good.

We had an amazing stay! I celebrated my birthday during a girls’ trip to Chicago, and it was the perfect place to relax and enjoy the weekend. The jazz-themed decor gave the space so much character—it was even more beautiful in person than in the pictures.
The Airbnb was clean, spacious, and had more than enough room for our group to be comfortable. Tosin was a fantastic host who provided clear instructions, making check-in and check-out effortless.
I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.
Five stars!
We enjoyed our stay here!
Hannah and Mark were attentive hosts and the space was great and exactly as described. Check in and check out were really easy. Appreciate them hosting us
Some insects in basement but other than that good
Great stay, the accommodation was exactly as expected.
Lovely room. Clean, spacious, and just like the pictures!

Good things:

Justin was very communicative as a host and I think could turn this place into a 5 star stay with some TLC, but it has a ways to go.
Great stay for the weekend in Chicago she was helpful with letting us check in early Our flight landed earlier
Great Chicago find! Loved staying here and would come back. Host was communicative and the check in process was smooth.
The place was very nice and clean and in a good location! Thank you

Loved location

We also got lucky with parking, which was free and easy to find
Davids place was great! It was comfy and it had a lot of refreshments ready for us when we arrived. The neighborhood is very walkable with several restaurants and bars near by.
Absolutely loved!! Will be booking again with this host, they are lovely people! Very comfortable and very welcoming!
Very quiet and peaceful worth the money

Kyriakos place was a great location to Wrigleyville, bars, coffee shops, grocery stores and restaurants. We all felt safe in the area. The space fit us 6 well, beds were comfortable and common area was spacious. We would definitely stay here again if in for a Cubs game. We did use Spothero for parking and parked within the block which worked well.

It served its purpose for us. You do have to go up two sets of stairs not one like the photos showed. The stairs are steep and not really safe for young children. The unit is definitely a short term rental and has been beat up over the years and could really benefit from some good maintenance being done. There are holes in the walls, cracks in the tile, mismatched paint, etc. and the bathrooms are very small.
Perfect for our family! Traveled to Chicago for the Cubs game and we loved the location. House was clean and set up was great. Kids loved the games downstairs and outside area was great too!

Patrick was amazing. My crew and I managed to lock ourselves outside at 11 PM at night.  I texted Patrick and he came immediately. We were so appreciative! Amazing! Patrick is amazing and the area of the home is amazing!

Great value in a good location. Walkable to many shops and restaurants in Chinatown area, as well as buses and CTA red line. Room is a little tiny, but very clean public area, especially the bathroom. Good place for people traveling solo.

Vanessa was super responsive to all my questions, and she proactively reached out since I had a large group to let me know where all the sleeping areas were. The AC was great, there’s coffee, and the beds were very comfortable. We were able to park on the street with no issues. The house itself is really cute and has a lot of character and decoration.
One thing that might be useful to know for larger groups: there are technically 2.5 bathrooms. However, one of the bathrooms has a clear door, so it’s really like 1.5 bathrooms for most folks, and a private bathroom for one of the bedrooms. It didn’t end up being much of an issue, it just meant we had to really schedule our showers.

This was a clean, basic space close to Bucktown. The street itself was quiet and calm. The immediate neighborhood didn't have a lot to offer in terms of charm, but a short walk gets to you to some good stuff in Bucktown.
Great location for going to United Center events.

Shaun and Christie’s were great hosts!
The process was simple, straightforward, and easy.
The unit was clean and well-provisioned. —A great place to hang your hat.
Avondale is great area, with lots of coffee shops and restaurants walkable from the unit.
Highly recommended!

Always great to stay in Jeanette’s place. The room she provides has an outside entrance and is exactly like a motel room. Jeanette quickly answers questions. The room is cute and comfortable. The chickens are chickens and I did buy a dozen eggs for my daughter. “The ladies have been busy.”

We came to visit Chicago for a long WE from Nashville with our teenagers and we’re looking forward to it .

Couldn’t recommend this place enough and would love to come back for another trip in the future!

An ideal location for a quick weekend stay, being steps away from the blue line. Unfortunately not very sound-proof and rather echoing, as we were woken up by voices and work happening on an upper floor.
Highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a fun time at Wrigley! Place was clean and exactly like the pictures. 10/10  location. Host was great to work with as well.

Great stay, very quiet neighborhood, and close to local food places and quick marts (which you'll need if you don't bring any basic needs with you such as paper towels and plates!

The place was very clean and i was undisturbed the whole time. Would recommend

This home is in a great location and was an awesome set up for our girls trip. The only issue is that the dishwasher was broken and the smell was atrocious when we opened it up. We notified Aly who said she would send someone to fix it after our stay, so hopefully this is a short-term problem.
Had a great stay! Perfectly located around many great restaurants and bars. Would highly recommend the jalort shots downstairs at Desert Hawk.

My stay was nothing short of exceptional. The place was incredibly clean, peaceful, and located in a fantastic, quiet neighborhood. It was the perfect spot to unwind, yet close enough that we could walk to amazing restaurants and fun local bars. Highly recommend. The host was very responsive and provided great nearby recommendations for various cuisines.

We had a fantastic stay! The location was perfect and easily walkable to all the sites we wanted to visit. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our trip. The unit was well-stocked with thoughtful amenities, including shampoo, conditioner, paper towels, toilet paper, and dishwasher tablets—enough for the length of our stay, which we really appreciated. Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. 10/10, and we would happily stay here again!
Great place in Uptown, building amenities were a definite bonus. Close to restaurants and train. Room to relax and visit.

We had a great 4 days at Sean’s place. It was spacious, clean, and just as described. They’ve got a lot of the little details thought out, which would make a longer stay comfortable, as well. It was easy both staying cozy for the evening or heading out and exploring the Humboldt Park area. Felt right at home with our two dogs!
One of the best BNBs I have ever stayed at!

I had a wonderful stay at Kayode's place.  Was as the pictures showed and a very responsive host. The neighborhood was quiet and safe.  I came in from hanging out at all hours and I had no fear.  Wonderful neighborhood.  Would rent again.
Exactly as advertised!

This was our second time staying at this location. Roscoe Village is a great location easy to get to Wrigleyville and just a few blocks from the Brown Line.

Host was great!
This is a great place to stay! Clean, updated, and so close to Wrigley Field. Definitely recommend staying here!

Prince and Victoria’s place was great! My boyfriend and I stayed for a few days and loved it. Location was great, not far from alot of tourist attractions. Most we drove was 20 mins. Definitely will look to stay here again if I come back to Chicago!
Loved Pislen

We had a wonderful stay at this Lincoln Park gem.
The location is as advertised, right across from the park itself, and only a stone's throw from many restaurants and coffee shops. The neighborhood is very leafy and quaint.
Bedrooms and the living room are generously sized, and the kitchen is well appointed.
Communication with the host was friendly and effortless throughout. We would definitely consider staying here again.
One detail to keep in mind is that the interior stairs are quite steep, which may present a challenge for guests with limited mobility.

I would not recommend staying here. The cleanliness was disappointing. There were stains on the comforter, a used tissue underneath the comforter, and a hair tie under one of the pillows, which made it seem like the bedding had not been properly cleaned.
The listing advertised that the property has air conditioning, but the only AC unit was a small window unit in the living room. It did not reach any of the bedrooms. It was around 88 degrees outside, and although each bedroom had a fan, the fans only circulated the hot air. The bedrooms were extremely hot, and none of us slept well because of it.
If the space had at least been clean, we might have overlooked the inadequate cooling. Unfortunately, the combination of poor cleanliness and the lack of effective air conditioning in the bedrooms made for a very disappointing stay.
Very close to U of C and public transportation. Excellent location. Emanuel is on top of everything; terrific host.
Easy in and out. Very responsive and accommodating.

Very clean and safe! If you need to use street parking, plan to arrive earlier in the day, since all the streets were packed with cars by sunset. Just make sure to thoroughly read all parking signs. Other than that, a great stay! Right by bus stops too!!
Go cubs! If you agree, get this place.

Allyson’s place matched the description and photos in her listing. Very clean. The proximity to the Blue Line train was so convenient. A 30 second walk!  So easy to get downtown. Since it was so close we did hear the train quite a bit, but to me, that added to the charm.  The Cozy Corner restaurant is directly across the street with fantastic breakfasts (and lunch but we only had breakfast). All in all,  it was fun to stay in an actual neighborhood.  Thank you, Allyson!

The place was a decent size and clean but everything is outdated or needs maintenance. The shampoos and hand wash were a awful scent and needs to be replaced!! Overall, not worth the price but the location was great, only 15m from downtown!

The place was great… clean and well stocked. We had no problem finding parking for our two vehicles during our stay. The neighborhood is great and had everything we needed including a Jewel-Osco grocery store 4 blocks away. John was fast to help out when we tripped a breaker, and we experienced no other issues during our stay. John’s place will be top of our list if we are ever back in Chicago!

Clean, spaceous, and walkable neighborhood. Managed to get pretty lucky with street parking despite Cubs playing a weekend series. Had a fantastic stay returning to my hometown with my kids. Hosts were responsive and provided clear instructions.
Great location in a great neighborhood! Very quiet. Would definitely stay here again.

Stayed here for two months for a summer internship and it was great! Genova was very responsive to any questions I had, and in general was a very helpful host. As can be expected when you are sharing a space with other guests, mess could sometimes accumulate, but Genova came by to clean frequently.
Cozy place, good vibes, great location for walking to pubs, cafes, stores, stadium.
Great place to stay close to the airport. Easy access street parking was a plus.
Place was great and Josh was a wonderful host. Very communicative and accommodating. Would stay again.

This was a perfect spot for three adults for a long weekend. Friendly, communicative owners, easy walking to lots of stuff (including the subway), and a nice apartment and furnishings.
A few things to know before you rent to be aware of; they might not bother you.
1) It's 4-5 steps down to the basement (and it's a basement apartment).
2) The owners live upstairs and a lot of noise comes through when they're up and about. It was only an issue for us one weekday morning when they were up and we were sleeping in.
3) The light switches in the stairwell are funky - I've never seen that type before. They're sliders, and there are buttons on each slider that push in to turn lights on and off. They worked perfectly; it just took a sec to figure them out.
4) The temperature is controlled by the owners upstairs. We were very comfortable even though it was hot.
we loved staying at Assel’s property. it was easily walkable to everything, lots of space for all of us (12 people in total), flexible with our plans, and extremely friendly and responsive!
Great stay just had trouble with the lock getting in a few times . Would stay here again my next trip

Wonderful home, great location and neighborhood.  We loved singing along with the dance floor bangers from 6-9pm, then were happy it was quiet after that for a good nights sleep.  Gorgeous home, impeccably decorated and furnished.  Highly recommend.  We did need a reset on the security entry codes upon arrival.  Within 5 min it was taken care of, which was quick and easy.

The place was as portrayed inside.  It was beautifully furnished and looks like it was newly renovated.  We were impressed by the cleanliness, the decor and the amenities.  If we had a question, Alain was quick to respond and we were very happy with her responses.  It was very quiet at night and we were satisfied with the place.

The apartment was another story. The second bedroom has no A/C, and the fans are too weak to help. A/C were filthy, filters so dirty the check-filter lights were on. The place never cooled and the living room unit leaked, so we slept on the couch for cool air. No blackout curtains (east-facing, 5–6am wake-ups) and two sets of broken blinds. Minimal stocked kitchen-no spices, no containers, chipped dishes. One towel rack for four people=wet towels, one kitchen towel for five nights, a dirty washcloth left to greet us. Sheets didn’t fit and balled up nightly. No mattress pads. Peeling paint from ceiling water damage and hall closet door half stuck shut.
At ~$4,000 for five nights, I expected more. Wonderful staff, but the unit needs attention.-

This apartment was in a great area. About a 15-20 minute walk to a lot of places, including the riverwalk area, but far enough away to be quiet at night.  Grocery store was very convenient. Had a great experience, Thomas was extremely helpful and responsive throughout our stay here.

Our primary goal was to visit museums.The house location allowed us to accomplish that objective.The host was very nice to convey information whenever we requested it.

Modern, clean apartment in a beautiful neighborhood. Street parking was easy with plenty of spots nearby, as long as you pay attention to all the street signs!! Close to so many CTA options, so any part of Chicago was within easy travel distance. Great place for a short, simple stay.
Nice spot! Very fun for our group and appreciated the on site assistance from Kelly.
Heidi was very nice and welcoming. The location is a couple of block way from the Chinatown subway station, which made my trips to the Loop nice and easy.

Place was super clean, very close to wrigley, quiet for the location which was super nice. Host was amazing, super helpful, responded quickly.  Would stay again!

I really enjoyed my stay here and would gladly book this location again. It's conveniently located just a few blocks from the Blue Line, making it easy to get around the city without needing a car. The neighborhood was another highlight. There are several great restaurants, cafés, and bars within a short walk, so it was easy to find a good meal or grab a drink in the evening without traveling far. Having so many dining options nearby added a lot to the overall experience.
Overall, this was a comfortable, convenient, and well-maintained place to stay. I would definitely recommend it to others and would be happy to stay here again on a future trip.
Great space, very nice finishes and very clean! Great Hosts!

Troy’s place was great for our family to gather before venturing out to explore the area. The place was very suitable for five people. We found some great coffee shops within walking distance from his place and some good restaurants nearby.

We had a great time at Andy’s place. The apartment was incredibly clean and located right in the mix of Wicker Park while still being incredibly quiet and low key. I would highly recommend this place for a fun stay in Chicago.
Nice stay, a few inconveniences, but overall good stay.

Our stay was wonderful! Tory was very welcoming and gave us some recommendations on places to go in the area

Sam's house was exactly as advertised and a great place to stay with a large group! Not far from the Blue Line and easy access to the highway.

We had a great stay at Austin's place. It was easy to get around the surrounding areas (Wrigley, etc) and also to go downtown for other sightseeing. Very walkable and not far to the CTA stations. It was quiet at night for us who live in the country.

Leo & Alex are excellent hosts! The apartment is in a great, walkable neighborhood with great restaurants, cafes, bars and shops.

Great and convenient + nice location! Quick to respond!

Adriane was extremely helpful and had whatever we needed. Uber rides were relatively inexpensive to get down town. ($16-$25). The place was private and felt safe.

Was a great place for a group of friends to gather and sleep on a weekend that had us out and about. Everyone slept well, the location was perfect for what we needed, and the place made our whole weekend work better.
Really nice hotel in a good location! Would stay here again. The room was large and robes are comfy. Stayed with a toddler and they had plenty of room to play.

I would stay there again.

We LOVED every minute of our stay. We were especially blown away by the many thoughtful extras that made us feel immediately at home. This stay was fabulous! Great location, clean house, comfortable beds, and tons of space. Thank you!

Great location and the beds were amazing!

This was the perfect place for a quick weekend in Chicago. We would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago and would happily stay here again!

This apartment was clean and cozy. Great backyard to hang out in. Fabulous location!
Beautiful, unique older home with so much character!  Great area with so many places within walking distance.  We really enjoyed our stay!
Great place.

A couple of small things that didn't take away from our experience but we all noted: there isn't a ton of seating. There's a table that sits 6 (tight) and then a couch so technically all 8 adults had seats, but we'd often find someone who would stand instead or sit on the ground so everyone had room. This wasn't a problem for us, but could be for other parties. Also, the walls are thin so we could hear our neighbors, but it wasn't worse than typical apartment living and the location is near the train which runs all day but we didn't really notice the sound over other sounds like the a/c or if the tv was on. Overall a good place, good location (next to Chinatown and McCormick Convention center) and we'd stay again!
Great stay and responsive host

The unit is modern, spacious and beautiful. Everything was so clean and it’s located in a cute, walkable area.

Another great stay, we’re hoping it’s available for our trip next summer!

The house was absolutely perfect! It was spotless, beautifully decorated, cozy, and incredibly well organized. Junni was wonderful to work with, very responsive, helpful, and communicative leading up to our stay and throughout the weekend.
I’m so glad I chose this home for a girls’ weekend with my best friends. Everyone kept commenting on how beautiful and comfortable it was. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing getaway!
