I was glad that the listing mentions the stairs before you book! We enjoyed our stay.
The Airbnb & host were amazing! We could not have found a better place to stay for the bachelorette trip!

My kids and I stayed here because we wanted an authentic Chicago weekend. Its a hip hotel, and the guests are pretty hip. Not much to do for kids but we just hung out in Chicago until we couldn't walk anymore. Its a great location, with great views. Super cool joint, check it out if you like old buildings and hip vibe.
The home was exactly as described and the space fit the 9 of us comfortably. Odi was also incredibly responsive.
Lovely little one bedroom apartment in a great location and quite comfortable. Would stay here again.

Apartment is clean and lots of space. Location was convenient to museums and shopping. Red line to Wrigley was easy to access. Beware of the air conditioner in the unit. We spent 24 hours with no air on a 90 degree day in Chicago. Apartment was 85. Host said they called maintenance but no one came to fix it. We figured out where the breaker was and got it running again but the breaker will repeatedly trip so you have to watch it closely.
Super nice and updated place! The shower is amazing and in a very cute walkable neighborhood.
Property was as described, in a very nice neighborhood with close proximity to Wrigley Field and many bars/restaurants. The host was responsive and helpful for the limited times we had to interact.
Place looked very clean and bed was super comfortable. Easy access to public transportation. Felt overall safe during the day walking in the area.
Great experience to be able to step back into an older style of living. Nice and quiet neighborhood. Would definitely do it again!
The location is perfect for shopping as well as walking along the lakeshore. Very comfortable and a lovely rooftop area

Thatheu’s place was very clean and he was always quick to respond. Not only did he have many amenities listed, he also included items for breakfast, which was a nice surprise. The location was great. We were able to walk about 2 blocks to a bus stop that took us to Wrigley for a Cubs game. We enjoyed our stay and would stay again.

Cozy Retreat with Great Amenities!*
I recently stayed at Victoria's Airbnb for 2nights, and it was a fantastic experience. The place was exactly as described clean, cozy, and well-maintained.
*Pros:*
*Location:* Perfectly situated in Blue Island, IL, making it easy to travel to and from Chicago local attractions.
*Amenities:* The kitchen was fully equipped, which was a huge plus for us, and the living area was spacious and comfortable.
*Communication:* Victoria was incredibly responsive and provided detailed instructions for check-in and check-out, making the whole process seamless.
*Extras:* We especially enjoyed the access to the garage and backyard indoor patio which was a special feature and complimentary snacks that added a nice touch to our stay.
*Cons:*
No complaints.
Overall, I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming stay. I would definitely book again on my next trip to Blue Island, IL!

Victor’s place was perfect for my stay to attend a weekend event in Chicago. It is a hostel style set up where guests are asked to respect quiet hours. Instructions were clear for check-in, parking and emphasized maintaining a clean communal environment. As I was traveling alone the rate was reasonable for one person and the home and neighborhood felt secure. It was clean and comfortable and I appreciated the peace and quiet upon returning form the bustle of the city. Will stay again when traveling solo to Chicago.

This Airbnb was amazing. Felt old Airbnb- the house was stocked with everything you need, and then some. Welcome basket goodies were clutch. Walkable to everything but on a quiet street. Tommy is a great host!
Mi familia y yo nos encanto el lugar de David, muy limpio, ordenado y tranquilo, definitivamente nos volveriamos a hospedar con él
This place was perfect for hosting my sister’s bachelorette weekend for her and her friends. I would stay again!

We had a wonderful stay. The location was perfect — just a short walk to the Southport Corridor, which meant plenty of restaurants, shops, and places to explore without needing to load everyone into the car.
The host was fantastic. They were incredibly responsive and provided detailed, thoughtful information that helped us plan ahead and feel prepared. Every question we had was answered quickly.
Inside, the apartment was great for a small family. The kitchen was very nice and well-equipped, making it easy to prepare meals for the kids. The bathroom was spotless, and both beds were extremely comfortable. We always travel with sound machines - even without those running, we didn’t notice much noise at all from outside or other units.
The included garage parking was a huge bonus. It made unloading/loading the car super convenient.
This was the perfect home base for a family weekend in Chicago. We would absolutely book again.
spacious area, convenient location, felt right at home; highly recommended
Great place to stay in River North. Place is as described with good amenities. Air conditioning worked very well for the hot summer weather. Would stay here again.

This place was VERY spacious for a 2 bedroom apt. Fri was a great host and very responsive. As described in the listing, this place is on a very busy street on the weekends. If you like to go out you will have a great time and the convenience of being in the middle of the everything was an added bonus.
Everything was clean, relaxing and peaceful. When we had a question, Dimitri answered us within  a few minutes and was extremely helpful.
Milan was very responsive and was consistently making sure our stay was going well. Place was very clean and had great amenities.
Solid option for large groups with easy access to the Brown line.

Kavin and Sophia were very nice hosts and available for a few needs that came up. Their apartment is clean and modern with plenty of accommodation and extras, such as hair dryers. The Metro is just a few blocks away with downtown and museums just a 15 minute ride. I gave 4 stars instead of 5 because of the neighborhood, which had a lot of urban blight, and shops with unfriendly people. But of course, the hosts have no control over that. All in all recommend!

We enjoyed our stay immensely! If you’re coming into the city for Wrigleyville and Cubs game this place is THE stop! Location was an easy walk to everything Wrigleyville. It also felt  very safe. Space was super cute, clean and comfortable. Felt like a home away from gnome 😋
Hosts were great, apartment was exactly as described, and in a great part of town with lots to do. Would stay here again.

Silvia's place was everything we expected and a lovely place to stay. It's a classic older Chicago 3-flat so be aware parts of the house can get a bit hot during the summer, even with AC units.
Beautiful neighborhood and a lovely place to walk around, especially with the restaurants and brewery just a few blocks north.
It was so easy to check in and our stay was easy and quick!

Darsh’s place was the best. Right in the middle of all our activities. Very nicely laid out for 4 people. Enough kitchen gear for full meals. Although for lunch and dinner we ate with many good restaurants in the area. We will definitely consider coming back. Next time we will add on Parking. Some days it was about 2 blocks to find a place, but we used the driveway to drop stuff then parked. Thanks for sharing the little slice of home.

Great place for a larger group. We had 11 guys staying there and the house was exactly as described in the listing. The space worked well for our group, was clean, and had everything we needed for the weekend. The location was also very convenient for where we were going out in Chicago. Overall, a smooth stay and we'd definitely recommend it to other groups visiting the city.

We had a great stay at The Drake! There were no issues with parking, we were able to park right out front every time. The apartment was immaculate and easy to access with the clear instructions that were given ahead of time. The host was very nice and quick to respond to messages as well!
The rental was clean and well kept. Great location.
This was an excellent Airbnb! Amazing location. Walkable to so many great restaurants, boutiques, and cafes. With the two floors lot of flexibility. Hosts were super responsive and helpful. 10/10!

Great stay for a week in Chicago.
Far enough to have some quite but close enough to be able to use public transit and miss out on all the traffic in the city and the parking. Easy check in and out and very responsive host. I look forward to our next stay
Beautiful home, and parking space was great to have.
Comfortable condo with a great layout. We enjoyed our stay

We had a great stay! The bedrooms were very spacious and the living areas and kitchen were perfect for hosting a girls weekend. Danny and Diana were very communicative throughout the visit and made check-in and check-out super easy.
Michael was a great host he was quite easy to work with and very responsive to questions when they were asked. Airbnb was fantastic, clean and very comfortable.

Good space for my bachelorette group! It accommodated 13 of us very well. It was within walking distance to many dinner spots and the train which was convenient for traveling to the bean and cubs game.

The location was ideal for our focal visit to the Obama Presidential Center- an easy 5-minute drive or 10-minute bus ride. Restaurants were within walking distance. Our host was very responsive and we appreciated that.
The drawbacks were with the neighborhood, safety/security of building access, and the quality of the apartment infrastructure. We had unsafe encounters getting to/from the apartment building. Inside the apartment, the very loud air conditioning unit made sleeping difficult and the broken windows blinds made the over look unappealing.
Great place and great host!
Wonderful location. Loved having gated parking. Outdoor spaces (balcony and roof) a huge plus. Fed was very attentive and responsive.

Great place to stay. Located in a walkable convenient location, space was as described, clean, and had everything we needed. Provided lots of dowels, kitchen has plenty of dishware and the air conditioning was great during a heat wave. The space was easy to access, check in was easyand the hosts were very communicative.
Rob’s house was awesome. Very modern, tons of space and was very clean upon arrival. Rob was very responsive and answered all my questions if I had any. Highly recommend!

Location was great, good to have a parking spot included as well. Kitchen had essentials. The biggest con was cleanliness- there were lots of cob Webbs in the lower level indicating no deep cleaning had been done. One of the rooms downstairs we didn't feel comfy sleeping in as you could see a layer of dust over the comforter. The bathroom had some hair, Webbs and dead spiders. Gnats were in the upstairs bathroom. For the price we paid, we expected a much cleaner space. It does get very cold but provided heaters were helpful. We did not reach out about the cleanliness as we were just staying 2 nights and stayed out of rooms not cleaned well. Lots of space. FYI for those that like to do deliveries,  not great for deliveries due to the confusion on what door to deliver things to- 3 orders had issues. I'd do a pick-up instead. Would not recommend for the price we paid.

My husband and I came from Boston to officiate my son’s wedding in the heat of July.  Silly me in addition to officiating I offered to cook a lot.  I also needed a second bedroom because my oldest son was going to stay with us for a couple of nights. Brett’s place was not only exactly what we were looking for but more so.   We spent five amazing nights during one of the best times of my life in a very comfortable peaceful setting.   We will most definitely be back because of course my son is there and if we do, we hope to stay here again.
Apartment itself was very nice, the area was even nicer and very walkable. Feels a tad overpriced but that is my only complaint.

Friendly, professional hosts who gave clear instructions. Looks just like the photos; nice, updated little apartment in the back unit. Appreciated the easy check in and out (no crazy requests or requirements for cleaning up!). It’s a small space; bathroom is particularly small so not ideal for very tall or bigger people.

Great place to stay.  Comfortable and very well supplied.  Cute neighborhood, with a fabulous grocery store close by and easy to get to buses.  We didn’t get a chance to use it but the outside area seemed lovely.
Very nice place and comfortable stay

The was lots of beautiful artwork throughout the property.  Community areas were spacious.  Only one of the bedrooms was large enough for comfort.  The other two rooms were small with full size beds.  The second set up stairs to the property were narrow and acquired to climb.

Our stay was very good. We had issues with the door locking and they were responsive and helpful. The place was comfortable and cool, which was nice because it was hot outside. We were happy to be on the bottom floor as my mom has knee problems but you could hear when the upstairs neighbors walked around. The area had a great cafe for breakfast and lunch that is not even a 5 minute walk. All in all a wonderful stay.
Excellent unit and excellent service! Thanks!
Great place and exceptional host! Would return to Tamara and Tony’s place whenever I visit Chicago!
We enjoyed our stay.  The house was spotless and well appointed.  Kyriako was very responsive to messages

Getting in was easy - kind of disappointed in the lack of amenities. Had to buy a roll of toilet paper and some paper towels. Bathroom wasn’t super clean. Dust on fan in the bedroom and found hair on the sheets.

Irma quickly responded with advice on where I could park.  While it’s in an old neighborhood, the apartment seems brand new and very bright and clean. Plenty of room for several people to stay. There are about 20 wooden stairs to climb inside the front door.

Very cute vintage 2nd floor apartment. Great location - wonderful neighborhood and easy walking distance to restaurants, shops, & public transportation. You don’t need a car. If you have one, there is free street parking. Niki and Sean were amazing hosts - very helpful and responsive, especially when we accidentally left a few things there. Comfortable and well stocked kitchen, including snacks. Highly recommend!! Would definitely stay there again.
Good stay
The home was even bigger than the pictures. There was as much room to hang out as there was for our large group to sleep. Will was a wonderful host!
Awesome spot! Thank you Mary
Beautiful spacious apartment in the perfect location!

This was the perfect place for our group of seven! The home was spotless, spacious, and had plenty of room for everyone to relax and hang out together.
The location was fantastic. Ubers were always easy to get—we never waited more than five minutes—and it was a quick ride to Wrigley Field, the United Center, and Michigan Avenue. The neighborhood was great, with multiple coffee shops, sandwich and Mexican restaurants, gelato, a CVS, and a really nice grocery store all just a couple of blocks away.
The host was responsive and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. Overall, this was an excellent find for a larger group, and we’ll definitely keep it in mind for our next group trip!
Helen’s place was perfect for our little get away. The place was as described and the neighborhood safe. We would love to stay again  if we come back to Chicago. Thanks Helen!

Had a wonderful stay with my family! It has an elevator, great for traveling with elderly parents. Super conveniently located. Host was very responsive to our questions. Great for traveling with an infant too! We didn’t use the pack n play but it’s available as well as a high chair and a baby bath tub. The place was clean also!

We had a wonderful experience at Allie and Majda’s flat! Excellent location and a beautiful apartment. There was a pack and play for our 15 month old and lots of room for her to practice her walking and play. We had everything we needed. The location is amazing - we were able to walk to the Lincoln Park Zoo and farmers market. The parking passes made parking easy and we were able to come and go as needed. Overall a wonderful experience! We will be back!!

This apartment in Chicago was exceptional. The space was impeccably clean, with stunning architecture and stylish, thoughtful decor. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, and the host was incredibly kind and accommodating. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the city.
Very nice and spacious is on the third floor so be prepared to be tired overall nice stay. Very clean looks like the photos listed on the link provided. In a nice neighborhood and the area is decent.
The place is a great one bedroom. Very communicative. Right next to amazing restaurants and theaters. Love the area. Close to the train.

Great safe place to stay in a friendly neighborhood close to everything. Toby’s house is comfortable and well located. Lovely beds, great shower in the bathroom, and plenty of space to relax and watch TV. Toby was extremely helpful and was very easy to contact, would stay here again next time I am in Chicago.

Our group felt right at home with all the kitchen amenities we needed to enjoy happy hour on the rooftop. The location was perfect for local restaurants and an easy walk to the "L". Very proactive host!
Good size bedrooms made it easy for our family to spread out.  Close to public transportation.

The space was roomy, full of comfortable beds and easy to check-in. The host was incredibly responsive throughout the stay. It’s about a 10-minute walk from the closest train station and a strip of restaurants and bars. We loved being across the street from a grocery store, especially with a kitchen available.
Had a great stay for two days. Place was as described and host was amazing!
Had a great stay, and Junni was very responsive to all questions, perfect spot for a large group of guys to enjoy a weekend in Chicago.
Great quick airbnb stay!

There is no mirror in the bedroom. We shared a bathroom with a random man who left hair all around the toilet and inside the bathtub. Bring your own cleaning supplies bec they’re not provided. Be mindful that check-in is at 5pm but the host will try to accommodate you if possible.
Beautiful, comfortable apartment! Probably the best AirBnB I have stayed in to date. Katherine was responsive to my questions and answered promptly. Highly recommend and will stay there again.
The place was perfect for my group of 13!
Very nice

This is in a great neighborhood with the Lake just down the block and a nice coffee shop and restauants another block away. Overall host was very helpful and responsive. The inside of the place is as shown. The entrance to the building where the unit is located is not as nice. The unit uses window AC, which is at times nosiy and the unit above drips onto theirs making it hard to sleep.

Me and my partner stayed at this place for our anniversary weekend. We really liked this place, very quiet, clean and comfortable. There’s also lots of good restaurants around! Our favorite thing in our stay here is their sofa, it was very cozy and comfortable. We will definitely go back here!

Mike is a great host and was very responsive to our requests.  Location is great, short walk to train/groceries/restaurants.  Very comfortable place.  Only downside is no dining table, just a bar with three chairs so it was not perfect for four people to eat.

In town for the 2016 Cubs 10-year anniversary ceremony/ballgame. Took less than 10 minutes to walk to the stadium. Perfect location for our needs. Justin worked with us getting in late and was helpful every step of the way. Would definitely stay there again for a game.

This wonderful little gem is a great place to stay in Chicago. Located in a quiet, peaceful neighborhood, Hazel's home was clean, comfortable and nicely appointed. There aren't many places with three separate bedrooms, and that was a real plus. Hazel was a great communicator and even provided us with masks during the recent intense smoky conditions. Very nice!
Nice place!  In the heart of the West Loop.  Morgan CTA stop about 3 blocks up.  A lot of restaurants nearby.   Andrew was really good at communicating. I'd definitely stay again!

I felt right at home from the moment I arrived. It’s in a great neighborhood, and the place looks exactly like the photos. It’s within walking distance of public transportation and a supermarket.
Sarah and Marco were wonderful and checked in to make sure I had everything I needed. The flights of stairs were well worth it, especially given the layout of the apartment. There’s plenty of lighting, and the space is incredibly quiet.
I absolutely loved staying here…felt like it was my own. I will definitely be back.
Thank you Sarah and Marco!

Great place to stay just 15 mins away from downtown Chicago and 25 mins from ORD! Decent restaurants, grocery stores, and pharmacies close by. Quite neighborhood. Great host and place had all the amenities as mentioned.
Tere's place was in a great location! it was exactly as described and extremely comfortable. Tere was responsive when I had an issue, one that I created myself! I appreciated the responsiveness.

Maria was very friendly and welcoming! The place is extremely cozy and accommodated three easily. The couch is very comfy! She had snacks had for us, even brought us water and more snacks! Bathroom was extremely clean and shower was amazing! Very nice location near California blue line! I would strongly recommend staying here she is amazing!
Great stay!  We had an awesome weekend and Roxy’s place was amazing!  Would definitely recommend and would book again 🤩

Great location, easy walk to train stations and chinatown. Street parking is available but recommend idling to unload and using parkhero to rent a spot for extended stay. Heads up, stairs are creaky but only one floor!

Alex’s place was perfect for us 3 couples for our weekend exploring Chicago and going to a Cubs game. It was so well stocked, very comfortable and big enough where we all felt like we had space when we wanted but could hang out in his awesome basement when we all wanted to be together! The location was awesome too.

This was my first experience renting with a corporation and not individual owners. My group paid a premium for some of the amenities. I had to jump through extra registration hoops outside of AirBnB to get access to the apartment, including an extra security deposit.
The biggest disappointment of the place was that it was clearly not cared for by anyone who had a stake in the stay of their guests. There was black mold on shower curtains. The only chair in the living room was broken with springs broken through the bottom of the chair. One of the floor to ceiling curtains was broken and couldn't be raised. It was also a curtain in front of the door to the balcony. This was particularly frustrating as the exterior windows had street lights feet away from the window, and a fully lit parking garage next to a bedroom that illuminated the room all night.
This wasn't the cheapest AirBnB in the area, and absolutely wasn't worth the increased cost.
Location was good, close to a lot. Pictures match description.

Assel was very responsive and answered all questions promptly.
The place matched the description and is an easy walk from the Chicago Blue line station.
We had a great stay here. Great location and very walkable neighborhood!

El alojamiento esta cerca del metro y a cinco estaciones del centro de Chicago. Tienen todo lo necesario para una estancia. En el baño hay shampo y acondicionador.  Lo único es que la cocineta esta muy pequeña le hace falta una pequeña barra para colocar cosas. Muy importante que tiene lugar para estacionarse en la parte trasera de la casa.

The place was great and the host was very responsive.
The train was pretty loud but I think we got used to it.
Great part of town and a few easily walkable neighborhoods.
Good value for a two bedroom with living room and kitchen.  Host was attentive.
Cheap and simple place to stay
Z
The place was cozy, private, and the neighborhood was the same. It was a short drive to metro Chicago.

This was the perfect place for my family weekend trip to Chicago. We needed a bit more space than a hotel would give us, and this was that and more. Avantika was a great host, and helped us through the check-in process. The unit was spacious and had great views of the city. We'd look to stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay at Vin's place. The apartment was clean, beautiful, and very spacious. Having access to a parking garage was also a big plus. The bathroom had a slight odor, and the bathtub faucet was broken. It was still usable, but it could use some maintenance. Other than that, everything was clean and well kept. The location was convenient; the train station is about a 12 minute walk away, and there are stores nearby if you need anything. You can get to downtown Chicago (the Loop) in about 50 minutes by train.
Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend this place.
All around solid stay. The place was awesome and exactly what we wanted. Dylan was very helpful as well.

What an absolutely beautiful place to stay!  A designers dream- we kept finding new hidden treasures to look at over the course of our stay. We had plenty of room to spread out for our family. The beds and linen were perfect for a good nights rest. We had worried about the outside noise but it did not bother us at all with the provided ear plugs and sound machines in every bedroom. We would highly recommend!

We had a group of 8 stay for 2 nights in this unit. The host(s) were extremely responsive to all of our questions (usually responding within 10 minutes).
Check in and out were made easy with instructions by the host.
The beds were extremely comfortable. The location was walking distance to the lake, groceries, markets and some restaurants. We felt safe in the location. We would all stay here again.
thanks, Matt Raven

We stayed here for a Bachelorette weekend and it was the perfect place to unwind and connect after being out each day. East street parking, 3 bedrooms that gave us privacy and a fun common area to gather in the living room & kitchen.
Definitely recommend especially if you are going to any shows at Thalia Hall!
Very nice place to stay, George is very communicative and a great host.

This AirBNB was exceptional in every way. Lots of little amenities to make us feel at home. Beds were super comfortable, LOVED the rain shower heads and fluffy towels and temperature controls in every room. Parking was easy to find, neighborhood was quiet. Host was responsive, friendly and gave a lot of attention to detail. We come back to Chicago once or twice a year so hopefully this Airbnb will be available because I will definitely want to come back!

This is an amazing place, the place was clean and very comfortable and spacious. However I felt quite unsafe at the surrounding area outside, especially at night. On our way to the subway nearby from this room we came across a crime seen a short distance away with blood on the floor. It turns out there was an armed robbery that occurred the night before. If this place were somewhere safer I would 100% always come here though as both the condo and host were great.

The home was very comfortable. Mini AC splits in the upstairs bedroom or fantastic for sleeping in a cold room during a hot summer without having to bring the whole house down in temperature. Excellent location at most importantly check out did not involve me doing a huge laundry list of chores, 10 out of 10 would stay again

Alex was a supportive and responsible host.
Our family thoroughly enjoyed our time at his place in Chicago. We loved being in a diverse neighborhood with great local restaurants and markets.
The home was beautiful and so spacious. The beds were incredibly comfortable. We loved having the front and back deck. It was a good place for our dog with a safe backyard to take her outside.
Everything we needed was included in the house. AC worked really well, as did the WiFi.
We highly recommend Alex’s place.
Excellent overall
My group had a great stay. Will look to book again for future visits to Chicago!
Stay was really nice and the location was lovely
Nicole was a great Host. Great communicator! Loved staying at this location!

We had an overall great stay and really enjoyed this beautiful home. It was clean, well-kept, and looked just like the photos.
A few things to note for future guests: the A/C didn’t seem to stay below 73°F, so it was a bit warmer than we would have liked. The listing also says it accommodates up to 6 guests, but there weren’t enough towels or bedding provided for 6 people. Additionally, the blinds in the back bedroom could have offered better coverage, as they let in quite a bit of light and didn’t provide much privacy.
Overall, we had a great experience and really enjoyed our stay. The home is beautiful, and we’d still recommend it to others. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Great location in Hyde Park. Nice clean place to stay and very helpful and responsive hosts
This was such a great spot for our first time. The host was super responsive, and very kind. If we ever visit again, I would 100% stay here again.

This apartment was exactly what we were looking for. A quaint, quiet stay in a peaceful neighborhood. Plenty of restaurants and parks within walking distance, and the host recommendations were 10/10! I would recommend them to anyone looking for a stay in Albany Park.
Great stay! Walkable to Wrigley Field and great restaurants ! Would highly recommend !

Pros- Great location with easy accessible bus stops literally right in front of the house. Quiet neighborhood with walkable food and convenient stores with shops just a couple blocks away. Bedding was comfortable and overall cleanliness of place was very well kept. Host was very communicative with short responsive wait times despite being at work, very much appreciative of that. Did best to troubleshoot/accommodate when asked.
Con- A/C issues during our stay made the nights a little rough to sleep, host attempted to troubleshoot/fix but problem persisted afterwards, possible WiFi/programming problem so it wasn’t their fault is my assumption.
- may seem/feel a bit far from downtown area needing multiple transfers from buses and subways but easy to figure out once you get the hang of it.
Overall would recommend as best value for your money.
Thanks again to the hosts!
Calvin is nice and helpful.   Everything was just as pictured.   Close to blue line which was great!!
Clean stay, LaShonda was proactive in following up on any needs.
This place was so great! It was unique and comfortable and in a great location! I'm telling everyone (or not) to stay her!

Zenobia was a super sweet host. It was an amazing check-in process where she met me at the door and walked me through every single thing I might need in the house! Super accommodating, and it felt like I had a caring aunt who was looking after me!
She checked in and made sure that everything was perfect as far as the temperature and anything else I might need!
The location is super walkable, super safe and close to transportation, like the green line and parks and restaurants!
We were worried about the area, but it ended up being completely fine! Clean place with great AC! Easy in and out and about a 10 min uber into downtown. Would definitely stay here again.
This is our second time staying at the in-law suite… as always Ed made us feel right at home.

Joyce was an excellent host from start to finish. Communication was quick, friendly, and helpful, and the home was exactly as described. It was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained, making for a relaxing stay. Check-in and check-out were easy, and everything we needed was provided. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend Joyce’s place to anyone visiting the area.

The location was ideal! The residence was clean and we had plenty of room!! Took a bit for the water to get hot enough to shower but wasn’t a big deal. We were not able to access the trash outside so had to leave the gathered trash in one bag and leave it. We didn’t have much though.
We enjoyed this trip and would recommend to others!
Great location. Clean rooms. No complaints! Nice people !
Amazing! Highly recommend for your stay in CHI

The standout negative of the unit was the parking situation. Parking is scarce between 1630 and 0500 nightly. Even during the day you may need to park in "metered" parking down the block. I recommend getting the Park Chicago app.
That aside, the unit was everything advertise: neat, clean, in good working order, and provided amenities such as kitchen appliances along with dishes and flatware, a TV, and WiFi. The hot water pressure is on the low side and the kitchen sink cold water starts warm so you must run it for a long time before coming out cold. In older multistory buildings, that's not unusual.
The stairwell was a challenge as we are our seventies and my wife has mobility issues. We expected this as it was clearly explained the unit was on the second floor. I just mention it if one is mobility challenged as well.
There's a bus stop across the street and the Morse L stop just over two (lengthy) blocks east.
Overall, it is as advertised and we do recommend it.
Всё было очень хорошо 👌

We stayed at Karen’s for the Noah Kahan concert at Wrigley Field. The location was within walking distance and the area felt safe. We enjoyed walking the neighborhood. The apartment was perfect for the 2 of us. I would definitely stay here again when in Chicago.
Great spot, comfy bed. Perfect for my needs.
Very beautiful place.
Everything was exactly as described. The location was convenient and parking was easy.

I came here with 3 friends for a reunion hangout. The location of this stay is fantastic. Division St is just steps away and is full of cute shops and restaurants. We did have an issue with check-in (the lock code hadn’t been updated and we had to wait 30 minutes to get ahold of the host). The beds were comfortable, but the futon couches are best suited for children. The member of our group who slept on one found it very uncomfortable. Overall, this is a good stay in a great location, but don’t plan to sleep an adult on a futon!!
Good place for the value and close to public transit.

We loved Chicago and our stay at Demitri’s Airbnb! We spent our days exploring Chicago and our evenings at the Airbnb as a family. We especially appreciated the nice bathroom and kitchen. We got groceries at the nearby Aldi and ate breakfasts before we left each day. We used the washer and dryer to clean our clothes for our roadtrip home. Great memories! We’d definitely recommend this Airbnb.

Great for our stay in Chicago for a few games at wrigley. Walkable to everything you need, food, stadium, redline.
Great communication as well
Exactly as it is in the listing. My staying was unbothered and very comfortable. I would definitely recommend this place. This place has everything you need.
Very responsive and caring. On a quiet street. Didn’t even know you were in Chicago!
Great apartment, exactly as described on the pictures. Very clean, easy to check in. Nice neighborhood, walkable and easy to park on the street.

Had a great four night stay. Plenty of space for our party of seven. House was clean and pleasant. Lack of on site parking not an issue. There was always plenty of street parking available in front of the property. Rene is as good a host as can be expected. Responded quickly. Informative. Helpful whenever asked. Highest rating.
Jared was very responsive relating to our Airbnb reservation. Location is great. Minor issues relating to air condition, but Jared had someone out within the hour.

This was a nice place but definitely needed a more feminine touch. Nice and big. We paid extra for decorating and it was nice when we arrived. The bed was big and soft. When we got the there blanket was folded on the chest in the room but was damp. I had to open it to dry before bed. I had to contact host on what to use on tv because there wasn't clear instructions listed. He was very helpful and accommodating. The living room is set up like a movie theater which was very nice. But there was no way to cuddle on the couch. It is comfy though. Complete with charger station and cup holder. Nice porch. Hot tub was nice and big but there was hair in it and a nail from the pervious guest. Host stated that it cleans itself at night.
The towls provided for shower are microfiber and are soft but dont really dry anything. There were nice black robes and slippers also. All in all the place was nice and a nice spot if your heading into Chicago for you trip.

Really beautiful neighborhood from where it is also super easy to get downtown, super friendly and helpful hosts, and just a great apartment. We completely enjoyed our stay and would recommend this place.
Thanks for hosting us!
Only small note is that the AC can be a bit noisy.
Abia was a pleasure to deal with, extremely helpful and the place was really nice for our group. Highly recommend

Jennifer was very friendly and helpful with any questions or concerns I had. The property was well-maintained, clean, and in a convenient location. There was ample space for my group. The sitting space out back served as a gathering spot for socializing and dinner. Definitely recommend if someone is looking to stay in West Town.

The closet door was broke on both sides, the kitchen floor was gross, we went to conference, came back and the entire living room had ants. there is mold around the baseboards. found a pair of kids shorts in the couch. hair left all over the bathroom & stuck in the jets of tub. will definitely find a different place next year 😭😭😭

where in town for the Rush show. had a great stay apartment was cute, clean, and comfy. had a little trouble logging into wifi on breadroom TV but hosts were quick to respond and got it working. would definitely recommend! we would stay there again

We had a great time and loved our stay at this condo. It is a little removed from the heart of old town in a quiet residential neighborhood on a cul-de-sac. Everything was as described and we had no issue with the permit parking for our vehicle.
We loved our time there and will definitely be back!
Really enjoyed the rooftop lounge area.

Stayed 5 nights for work. Instructions provided by Nicholas were clear. The room was on top floor; 2 flights up narrow and creaky stairs. The room was cooler than expected for top floor in 90+ degree heat outside; Nick also provided a fan just in case. Bed and pillows were comfortable enough for me. Bathroom was small, but the shower did have handheld shower head, which helps. I had no problems with shared bathroom as I wake early to head to work. The Neighborhood was not too bad for south-side, but I was not out late. Ample free street parking was available out front. The WIFI worked well as I needed to finish work on my laptop on some days. My only issue is the thin walls as a couple of nights, the next room would have their TV on late into the night (1-2AM), and you can hear everything. The rule of quiet hours needed to be respected by the other renters. Overall, it was a great stay for me and reasonable priced. Met Nicholas briefly; seems like a good guy.

I wasn’t able to complete my trip, due to things that were out Rashad’s and my control. Rashad was very understanding and worked with me to resolve the situation. I wish him continued success with his property. I absolutely loved the decor and how the property is in a quiet, historically African-American community.
Great place. Clean with plenty of space for all of us.
Beautiful home with lots of light, very clean and spacious, also has secured parking.

I had a very comfortable stay. Great location near bus stops and blue line to airport or downtown. The room was exactly as described and I appreciated how clean the kitchen and bathroom was! Victor left clear check in instructions and was very responsive!
The place was great!
Outstanding host and place and great location

We stayed for 3 nights. We loved everything! We were a bit confused with the parking however she was right there to help us out. All the mandatory things were available and we have no complaints on anything. Loved our stay here!
Clean, location was close to tollway! Very safe and secure.. would stay again

Mark's place is great. My wife and I stayed here for 4 nights and it made a great home base for exploring all areas of Chicago. It's conveniently located near lots of great restaurants and activities, and just a short bus or Uber to nearly anything we wanted to do. Would definitely stay here again!
The spot was perfect for our group. Bianca was incredibly helpful and responsive. The home was in pristine condition.
Very convenient location, responsive and accommodating host. Plenty of options to eat around as well.

Alana is a wonderful host! Always responsive to our concerns in a very timely manner. Just one example: the drain in the bathroom sink was running slow. When I contacted her about getting some Drano, the gal who cleans for her left us Drano and a hair clog removal kit that same day. (Turns out the previous guests had clogged the sink by being irresponsible with hair down the drain.) We took care of it, but the maid had even offered to come back to do the work.
The apartment was a little small for our family of five, but the location was great. Public transportation is so easy -- the bus stop is ten steps from the doorway to the apartment, and it is a short ride to the train station.
The apartment was clean and the beds were comfortable. Good internet. The shower had decent water pressure and hot water throughout--I tend to take long showers and usually run out of hot water at my in-laws' house! The kitchen is on the small side but functional. It was fun to cook on a gas stove again.
Great place. Clean, easy check in. Close to the Brown line and walkable to Wrigley Field. We had a great stay
Great place in a freshly renovated building. The location is incredibly convenient, and the host was highly responsive throughout my stay. Highly recommended
Lora was a great host! Excellent neighborhood, comfortable beds, good shower, nice kitchen. Would definitely stay here again!
Wonderful host and great place to stay!
We did have a couple issues, but Andre quickly and effectively corrected them. No place is perfect, but I’ll take a host that is helpful over perfect every time, and Andre was certainly that!
Wonderful place to stay. Beautifully decorated and so close to Wrigley for a game.  Jessica responded immediately to our questions.   Highly recommend staying here!

The house is beautiful and all the common areas are clean and well maintained. On the negative side, the house is old and not fully A/C equiped so all the space is pretty hot during this time of the year. The Vintige room is just under the roof and the temperature was extremely high during our stay.
The A/C should work non stop however as the room is very small, the noise from the A/C is quite significant even if you use ear plugs. We were not able to relax at all and actually had to relocate.
From the surroundings, the vibe on the streets and the park next to the house was very depressing. If you are a solo female traveler, keep your eyes open or just use car for transportation and personal safety.

This is a great location. Walkable neighborhood and three blocks from the Damen brown line train. Street parking was always available and right outside the apartment. Lisa is a great host, very friendly and a good communicator. We highly recommend this location and would stay here again!

This Airbnb was so nice! The owners garden that you walk through to get to your room is so beautiful. We would see the owners in passing and they were very kind and friendly. The Airbnb was well taken care of and very clean. We had a hiccup when checking in. Our entrance code didn’t work, and it took a little bit of time to get that figured out. And unfortunately, the smoke from Canada‘s wildfires cut our trip short. But I would recommend and stay at this Airbnb again. We recommend going to stockyard coffee house that is a short drive away!

I had a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb. The place was exactly as described, very clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the check-in process easy. The location was convenient and made it easy to get around. Overall, I had a really positive experience and would absolutely stay here again! Highly recommend
We really enjoyed our stay - it was perfect for a couple looking for an easy and comfortable home base while enjoying Chicago. Min was very responsive and helpful.

Awesome place!! Perfect location in Wicker Park. We loved how we were walking distance to so many great restaurants and shops (and the Salt Shed for a show!), but the actual street we were on was so QUIET! Easy to park, and very peaceful neighborhood. We didn’t hear any of the city noises you expect to hear!
We loved the house- cool layout, comfortable furniture, awesome art! We could live here😅.
Our group of 4 appreciated the large living room which was perfect for hanging out in. We also appreciated the outdoor space.
Will stay again when in Chicago!

This cute spot felt so spacious and tidy! The bedrooms were nicely furnished. The AC worked super well. It was such a nice reprieve from the city.
We wished for blackout curtains- the kiddos woke up early each day since the blinds let in a lot of light. The four floor walk up was a bit tough but we managed! Super nice. Will be back.
A lovely stay.
It was a great experience staying here for the week. The room was cozy and had everything we needed, and the pets were friendly, as were the hosts!
The view was spectacular. The amenities were perfect. Everyone was so nice. We loved our stay!
This has probably been the nicest air bnb that I’ve stayed in super clean and nice, the host Claudia responds very quickly and is super kind!

the place was as described. stayed for a week and had no problems. worked during the day and wifi held up with no issues whatsoever. not much to do in the immediate area, but there's a bus stop right on the corner that takes you into downtown. red and green lines are a very short walk away. comfy firm bed. nice efficient washer/dryer. parking was always easy. nice, friendly neighbors. Wonderful provided easy instructions well before check in and was very communicative and helpful.
A nice apartment in a nice neighborhood. Having a reserved parking place in a garage relieved my parking anxiety.
It was a beautiful, clean apartment. Donna was very responsive. Everything was as described.

I really enjoyed my stay. The apartment itself was really nice. I ended up having to do more remote work than I intended, and the office space in the living room was the perfect place for my remote set-up. The space itself is very cozy and provided a great space to unwind and relax after a long day. I appreciated the free coffee that was provided. Another plus was the cafe that is attached to the building. Having to not look around for my first meal of the day added to the wonderful accommodations. Overall, my mother and I enjoyed our stay. The king size bed was a major plus...so comfortable. You can't be the location for all things downtown Chicago. Even with the place being in downtown, the apartment was quite.The only thing that I'd suggest is adding a bluetooth speaker so guests can play music in the background. I ended up using YouTube for that, but it would have been nice to play the music on my phone. A home away from home!

Overall it was a very nice place to stay. It was close to the hot spots of Boys Town, so there was no need for taking the train to a hotel or a rideshare. I appreciated that we could drop off our luggage before check in so we did not have to carry it around.
Erica was so responsive and was always willing to help! The studio was very homey and we felt right at home. we would absolutely stay here again and loved this experience.
Enjoyed my stay. Very well-maintained, peaceful neighborhood.
Amazing and comfortable stay! Near the blue line as well

Excellent stay! The unit was impeccably clean, truly spotless. It was comfortable, had everything one would need. Convenient location. Friendly and helpful hosts! Would certainly recommend this location :)

We had a nice stay. Selena’s place easily accommodated our group of 9 — two families with teens / young adult kids. We especially appreciated having room to gather in the living room or dining room and make some meals at the place. We were there during a very hot, smoky week and the AC worked great. Location is convenient — easy to hop on highway and get downtown. Rooms are as pictured in the listing. Some of the furniture is pretty worn, but we were still mostly comfortable.

Overall we enjoyed our stay at Alex’s place. Location was fantastic, beds were comfortable and Alex responded quickly when we had a question. Not as kid-friendly as we would have liked, but that obviously does not apply to everyone. While the amenities offer a patio, it is really just a back entrance, as the furniture is owned by the neighbors and guests are not allowed to use it.

Staying at Jeannine’s place was an absolute delight! The space itself is modern, super clean, and offers plenty of room to unwind and feel completely at home.
Jeannine is a wonderful host. She was incredibly helpful and proactive about checking in to ensure I had everything I needed, while always fully respecting my privacy. You can tell she truly cares about her guests' experience.
I’d stay here again in a heartbeat and highly recommend her place to anyone looking for a seamless, comfortable stay!
Overall great stay, love the location, host, and building.  Close to Wrigley but not a lot of fan noise or L noise
Super cute space just steps from Wrigley field.  Fun neighborhood with lots of things to do.  Carlos was a great host and would recommend this place to anyone wanting to visit Chicago.

We have stayed here before and this was even better than before. The apartment is in the best spot with plenty of places to eat, shop and walk right around the corner. We will definitely be staying again!
Judy is a gracious host, definitely top tier. I strongly recommend a stay in Judy's home, she provides a very welcoming environment.

This house is classy, beautifully appointed, and charming. Such unexpected luxury. Plus, the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in! (I even asked the host what brand the mattress was!) Having the train right nearby was so Chicago. Camesha was responsive, prompt, cheerful and helpful. A delightful host! I definitely recommend this stay.
Very good and safe stay place at Chicago.

The neighborhood the unit is located in is beyond beautiful. the unit is private, has snacks and beverages, it's easy to get to other parts of town via public transportation and other means.  The place was an incredible value, with absolutely stellar hosts. Book it!
Charla was a terrific host
Great house very cozy
This apartment was perfect for our trip! I would recommend anyone (especially traveling with a kid) check this place out. Truly one-of-a-kind.
It was ok.
Host was amazing!! Air bnb was perfect. Cute location and we loved the list of close things to do.
So good!! Perfect place, very clean, very spacious, at a really good price and location. Any time I go to Chicago, I would want to stay here again :) Petra was very communicative and responsive.

We enjoyed our stay with 4 adults and 1 infant here. The location feels extremely safe and is very quiet. This is most important to us. It was well above average heat when we stayed, and the upstairs area was a no go because of that. The air didn’t really touch upstairs. Also it’s just a small area (low ceiling) made for kiddos I suppose. There is also a section by the stairs where it is open to the stairs but has no railing or wall on one side. It felt a bit scary for adults walking around. I was glad our baby isn’t crawling quite yet. I assume this comes with the charm of these homes but maybe a railing would be good there! Lastly, parking required booking via third party (SpotHero). I believe the listing mentioned street parking. While there is some, we only found it to be permit parking within walking distance. We would recommend this space, but think these are important to note!
Eine einfache, saubere Unterkunft. Umgebung ist sicher, Fußweg zur nächsten Station etwa 15 Minuten zu Fuß. Wir würden wieder hier bleiben!
Place was nice. Great location. Small problem with check in but it was resolved in a somewhat reasonable time frame

Evgenii’s place was great. The guests were great.
My comments are more about the community: Someone hacked my gear, no damage done to me, just inconvenience. Use own WiFi to be secure, just in case. If you are a community activist, looking for an internship, look up Food Apartheid.

Rashad’s place was perfect for our stay. We had our entire nuclear family and one grandchild (7 total) and we all had adequate space. We cooked breakfast some days and had everything needed to do so. Good location to step away from the hustle and bustle but close enough to catch a quick uber (10-15 minutes) into the madness of the city. Clean and as described, would visit again!

Fantastic condo in an amazing Chicago location. We had plenty of space, incredible views, and everything was comfortable and convenient. An excellent value, especially for the location and size. We’d absolutely stay here again!
I had a wonderful time staying at Judy’s place. It’s close to airport and to downtown which is great. She is a friendly person that cares about her guests comfort.
Great place for our trip, close enough to the city & far enough away for peace. Would stay again

Nicely decorated modern space in a historic building perfect for my family of three. Check in was a breeze and Maximo was very quick to respond to any questions. The apartment is within walking distance of both the bus and train, and restaurants and shops. DoorDash and Uber are also readily available in the area (a treat for us, since we are from a small town).
I had a great stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and secure. The host was very responsive and accommodating.

Thank you Wilma! Her home was just as described, super clean, and Wilma was flexible with our checkin. The home is in a great area with several great restaurants around and a quick walk to public transportation. Had a great time in Chicago and stay at Wilma’s home! Will visit again soon!

Milen was very responsive and the apartment was in a good location for a base in Chicago, with a Trader Joe's and some good, friendly neighborhood  restaurants in the area. There was coffee available for the first morning - always a really nice touch!
Very comfortable

El alojamiento cumple con la descripción, el lugar estaba limpio y la ubicación relativamente cerca de los lugares más turísticos. Se puede mejorar en el aire acondicionado y el check out es muy temprano.

The interior design of the studio looked even better in person, and everything was very thoughtfully designed and planned out. However, I did run into some issues upon arrival and reached out to David and the Trove team. They both responded quickly and were able to get them resolved. So while it would have been ideal not to have any issues at all, I was really relieved to find how understanding and responsive David and the team were. Overall, I’d recommend this studio to anyone who doesn’t mind squeaky floors from neighbors above (as mentioned in the listing). That didn’t bother me, but some people may be more sensitive to that kind of noise.
Great value and quiet location, quick train ride to the city. Three rooms share one bathroom and the bedding has staining.

Notre séjour a été très agréable et confortable. Le logement est décoré avec goût, super bien équipé, assez spacieux pour plusieurs personnes et bien situé. Les lits sont très confortables, rideaux opaques, tous les électros fonctionnent. Plusieurs petites attentions ajoutent au plaisir d'y séjourner !!

Great stay in this parlor level 1 bed! This place is in a prime location, steps from North Ave. It was close enough to hit the beach in the morning and great restaurants at night! plus, being close to Lake Shore Drive meant I was never too far from any other part of the city. Amenities and appliances were easy to figure out. I felt right at home. Sara and the management team were very responsive to any questions I had.

Josh was a great host. The location was ideal for seeing a game at Wrigley - it’s about as close as you can get.
The condo fit 6 of us comfortably. Overall it was a positive experience and I’d stay there again. Just know that things such as paper towels and dish soap are not provided but there is a grocery store walking distance away.
I gave it 4 out of 5 stars because there are some things I’d like to see improved and it needs some TLC.
Stayed here with my parents for the week while in town on work.  The place is great, I would definitely stay here again.

Place was in a good location plus having a parking place in the city was wonderful. We were there for work and it’s a bottom unit that was really loud when there was a guest in the unit above, and you can really hear everything from that unit. Other than that was great!
Awesome place - amazing location - timely and on-point communication!  What else does one need from an Air BnB?  Cheers to these guys!

We had a lovely stay, the staff was very attentive and strove to meet our requests during the week we were there.
The room with a kitchen is very good, the location is excellent , it is pet-friendly and we slept well too. Thank you so much.
Great location for a Cubs game. House is perfect.

Nestor was an amazing host. He responded to all our needs and checked in on us throughout the trip. His directions were clear and easy. The house was clean and the perfect size for my best friend and me. When it was time to explore Chicago, Nestor gave us ideas on where to go. 10/10 I'd recommend. We rarely heard the neighbors, but if we did, it was only during the day. We’ll gladly book with Nestor again when we come back to Chicago.
We spent every night on the rooftop patio.
Matched the pictures, great location to the United Center.

Patricia’s place is in an excellent location!  My family of 4 ( 2 teenage girls) stayed here and it was perfect for the 4 of us. Easy walks to Old Town and the Miracle mile. Easy walk to the subway stations. Beds were comfortable and bathrooms were good size for the 4 of us. Would stay here again.

If you are looking to be within walking distance to the Field Museum, Aquarium, and Planetarium, this place is perfect. The Bean is also walkable. Overall the apartment was great! My family loved the location.

We hebben een super leuk verblijf gehad bij Karl. Echt een bijzondere ervaring qua huis en inrichting. We misten wel een beetje een keukentje want je moest in de badkamer afwassen maar verder prima verblijf.
Stacey’s place was great!!! Clean, looked just like the pictures, close to downtown Chicago. Very helpful and responsive!! I will definitely book here again!!! 10/10

The stay at Frida’s flat was amazing!!
The location was great, we loved the opportunity to be able to park our car.
Erika was so kind, kept us all well informed, had great suggestions, always answered all our questions and was eager to help!! We love all the details of attention in every place inside the apartment!!
Great experience and we will come back for sure!
Marta
We loved our stay in this comfortable and spacious home. Both the beach and the Red Line were within walking distance and the nearby market was amazing.

Loved this place and all of the thoughtful design and details. Perfect amount of quirk, just like the city itself. Everything was smooth and clean. Really liked the area. It was nice, safe, and peaceful but a short walk to a lot of things to do. My only suggestion for improvement would be a little clearer explanation on the downstairs space of the property. It left us nervous upon arrival that there would be someone in that space. Thankfully that was not the case. All in all, a great experience and place that I would recommend to anyone!

great place and very good location. neighborhood was quiet and lovely very typical of Chicago architecture .Many Parks available near by ( River Park free public pool so cool from 3pm to 8pm) .Foster and Montrose beach easy to reach with a 15min drive ( free parking at foster beach). lincoln sq has plenty of nice restaurant and cool shop within walking distance , western L station around the corner and privides easy 45 min access downtown for 3usd.
Lincoln Park zoo, riverwalk, navy pier, millenium Park Grant Park, sears tower, John hancock 360, field museum, shedd Aquarium, soldier field, united center , Ohio beach, north avenue beach , Foster and Montrose beach, Michigan avenue , magnificient mile...there is so many things to do in Chicago that 2 weeks was not enough.
we definitively have to come back and there is no way it will be anywhere else than at Dan's place . the appartment is great and thanks to Dan and Brent Who were such wonderful host so friendly and always helpful.

This apartment is super spacious, modern, and easily has plenty of room for a group of 4 to 6 people to hang out comfortably. It’s also in a great spot, putting you really close to Hyde Park, the Obama Presidential Center, the Field Museum, and other cool local attractions. Plus, the host was great—incredibly friendly and super attentive, making sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay.
wonderful place, very comfortable,  appreciated  washer/dryer! Nosy neighbors upstairs. Very convenient,  friendly neighborhood
Great location for what we were doing.
Quick communication, friendly, beautiful & clean space.
My family stayed here for 2 weeks and we had a lovely time taking in all that Chicago had to offer. The place is walkable and has all that you need to have a comfortable stay.

I had a wonderful stay at Zheng's place. Zheng and his family were incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout my visit, making me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. The room was clean, cozy, and had everything I needed for my stay.
The soundproofing isn't perfect, but it didn't bother me at all. The location is also excellent—it's right by Chinatown and within easy walking distance of both the CTA Red Line and several bus stops, making it very convenient to get around Chicago.
I truly appreciated Zheng's hospitality and support during my stay. I would definitely consider staying here again the next time I visit Chicago.
Steve's place was exactly as listed.  It was clean and check in was super easy.  Steve has great communication when telling procedures for check in and check out.  Worth the amount paid.
We’ve stayed a lot of places and this was one of my favorites. It felt like a real home— cozy and stylish. Everything was extremely well taken care of and clean!
Pretty good location, never felt unsafe, or struggle much finding street parking.

Walkable to the United Center but other than that there's not much in the neighborhood to do. Quiet street. The flies swarming the entrance made it a game of skill trying to enter w/o any of them getting in. The couch was saggy and uncomfy. Overall though good place to spend a couple nights.
Bellisimo much good and great stay.
We enjoyed our stay. Plenty of room for our large group.
Laura was very responsive and allowed us to drop our bags so we could see the city! Quiet location!
Great value! Would highly recommend.
Had the most amazing time staying in Bernard’s place. I would definitely stay again when I return. The communication was great and the atmosphere was welcoming.
Great apartment, very spacious, could not recommend more

super communicative and caring host. wifi was lagging and he was immediately making a service appt, offered his hot spot in the meantime and constantly checked in. this place is BIG for chicago. we wanted space to work from home and its super spacious. having a parking permit for that street is nice as well.

Little Italy was super nice to come home to during our stay.  We found lots of lovely places to eat and enjoyed the view from our suite.  The space is amazing and comfortable with modern decor, great coffee and there’s a French bakery right on the ground floor. We had a great night’s rest every night because the building was completely quiet and everyone respected the space. I would highly recommend this spot to anyone looking for a perfect place to call home while you’re visiting Chicago.

This is without a doubt one of the best deals on Airbnb. The location is wonderful, easy to commute everywhere, the apartment is spacious, fully equipped and accessible. The hosts were incredibly kind and flexible due hour flight hours. 10/10 no notes :)

This is the second time I've stayed at this listing. its a great location, very spacious, and the Studebecker family always makes sure we have everything we need for our business trip. from shampoo to toothbrushes for personal use to paper towels and dishwasher tabs so you won't need to bring anything like that for your trip. the beds are comfy and kitchen is great to save money while in town.
Excellent location, attentive host and easy check in!
A well maintained clean place . Host is super friendly and everything is the same as described.

Overall, we had a decent stay. The location was convenient, with downtown Chicago only about a 15–20 minute drive away. The host was very responsive, communicative, and helpful throughout our stay, which we really appreciated.

Good location, near a good bus line. Plenty of free parking as well. Spacious condo for the Chicago area. Furniture is a little more worn than pictures show and the place could use some fresh paint. Owners were quick and responsive when the Internet was down and the front door smart lock was malfunctioning and was locking us out.

Todo estuvo muy bien. El alojamiento estaba muy limpio, era cómodo y muy acogedor, y las camas resultaron especialmente confortables.

Muchas gracias por todo. Ha sido una estancia muy agradable.
The third floor AC units were great!

The condo was as described. The location is close to the bus stop and 0.5miles walk from the red/orange lines.  We did not rent a car and were able to use public transport for all of our exploring and the location was great.  The views from the huge windows are as pictured and even more beautiful in person.
Alexis was a great host!  Her basement apartment is cozy.  It was super clean and comfortable.

My friend and I loved our stay here! We were only in Chicago for a short trip, but Lois and Eduardo made it a great experience whenever we wanted to come back to our room and enjoy the Rogers Park area and their beautiful home.

Brad was friendly and very easy to get in touch with!

Estoy muy agradecida con la atención que recibí durante mi estadía, todo fue muy bonito me sentí segura como en casa

It was a nice place to stay! Close to public transportation options
My first Airbnb and I was completely satisfied.

We loved our stay we had everything we needed and then some. The beds were comfortable. The neighborhood was walkable public transportation was also easily accessible. Would highly recommended!!! Sean was very helpful with his recommendations and was also kind to check on us because of the heat and the air quality during our stay. Would absolutely stay again when we are in Chicago.

The unit was nice, the beds were real soft and the bathroom was real nice. It was extremely hot due to the thermostat not being the unit, we had to kill multiple bugs, & found it extremely difficult to enter once dark outside due to the lack of lighting and long walk thru the backyard to the unit. And due to the host living above the unit, if you want to sleep in that is not likely as there were kids running and jumping and yelling at 8am. Overall was not a bad stay but would not come back.
beautiful airbnb. it has everything you could ask for and is very clean.

The unit looks exactly as it does on the site. It was exceptionally clean and welcoming, with a window AC in both the living room and bedroom. The kitchen was spotless, and the fridge was huge - I could see how it would be easy to be there for a longer period of time than a weekend. I worried that it was close to a hospital, but there were barely any sirens. The unit is far enough off the road to be insulated from traffic noise, yet still easy to find. I also had no issue finding parking in the area. Overall, it was a good experience, and I would stay there again.
The place was great! Plenty of space, great location, and super fun decor that made it feel like a real home. Would absolutely return!

Very convenient location and parking; great space for a family; lots of great surprises (personal note, snacks, great kids book for my daughter and fun games for my son). Was super hot (and Smokey given Canadian wildfires), but easy to make inside temperature comfy and no smoke in the unit. Would definitely rent again.

good little place. clean and basic but comfortable. you can hear and feel the train on the bathroom/dining side of the apartment, but wasn't an issue. we use a white noise machine but didn't really register it while we slept and it's not enough to make it harder to watch tv or talk. and it's great being close to an L station. easy to get downtown or Lincoln park or wrigley with a transfer. good for a couple for a weekend.

The place was great inside. Everything kept very clean all the time. The pink loop was right behind the place which made is very easy to travel to downtown. Evengii was responsive, helpful and accommodating. Liked my stay here
Enjoyed my two night stay. Had all the necessities and great location.
Match the pictures and description. Having a parking pass would have been great!

Really enjoyed our stay at Jordan and Holly's cottage. It was clean, it looks exactly like the pictures, and check-in was easy — the three things I care about most in a rental property.  The kitchen was spacious, and it was a huge help to have laundry on-site, as our group was on a week-plus trip. There wasn't too much that was walkable in this part of Logan Square (although a few Chicago friends told me they'd really call that neighborhood Humboldt Park, but it's very close either way).  However, we found some gems, including great coffee at DayGlow, solid burritos at Chema's, and a very cool elevated walking/biking trail called The 606... highly recommend all! Just a little further away is Best Intentions, our new favorite bar in Chicago, so that was a treat. Finally, big thanks to Jordan for being flexible when we had to slightly change our dates just before arrival. I recommend this spot for the clean, comfy, straightforward accommodations and the excellent host communication!

Great place! Only negative is I wouldn’t recommend for 6. The mattress for the twin cot is too thin. You can feel the frame. That would’ve been the better option. Thankful for the blowup mattress, but we had to use the pullout couch as well. The blowup ended up in the kitchen. Kitchen could also use a few more basics for cooking and such. Ian is very responsive and a really great host! Went the extra mile for us by bringing masks during the wildfire smoke! Beautiful yard, great neighborhood. Nice people living in the building. The parking is a HUGE plus!
Great location, very residential but so easy to access the rest of the city. Host was really responsive, and apartment itself was well equipped and exactly what i needed on my solo trip to chicago

This is in the heart of the loop and close to  all things. The building itself is quirky! It is older and in the process of updating. The pool and amenities are good. The apartment gives a unique Chicago experience. The raised L train is right out the window and offers a unique fun city view. The train was not loud or bothersome to us. The place was excetionally clean. A bit smaller than photos but still a very functionable and comfortable spot. It was the priciest Airbnb we have stayed at and I believe this has more to do with the location than quality. If you want want easy access to Millenium park and the lake this is your spot! The bed was firm and comfortable. We used the pool once and it was a nice afternoon break after a day of walking.
The place was great room was great people there were awesome and the cleaner coming daily kept everything outside the room tidy I’d stay again

I used this air bnb when my sone graduated from bootcamp camp. This is about 20 minutes from downtown and 45 to the naval air station. Both drives were easy from this location. The address is easy to find with GPS. There’s free street parking everywhere. Be aware that if you park after 8pm it might be around the corner or on another street. The parking fills up completely every night! The entrance is up one very small flight of stairs, so not good for wheelchairs. Everything inside was as described and matched the pictures. The AC was cold and comfortable for everyone. There is a great stock of kitchen and bathroom supplies. Beds were comfortable, but pillows were on the flat and frumpy side. Overall, I was happy with my choice, I felt like the price point and what we got were a good match. Host was extremely responsive and patient with me. When I had difficulty understanding some of the policies and procedures, he remained professional and continued to explain until I understood.
Kasa was communicative and responsive
Cozy and happening. Would return
Ideally located, with everything you need for a few days stay. Very clean and the window AC works great!
super lovely place! had a great time!!!

My grandmother and I had a fantastic stay at Iris' apartment on Chicago's South Side during a brief end-of-week visit to the Obama Presidential Center. The home had everything we needed to feel comfortable and at home.
The building is older, but it has lots of character and felt welcoming. The real hidden gem was Dawn, the restaurant near building's lobby, it was the cherry on top of our stay. My grandmother and I loved both the breakfast and wonderful service at this stylish spot.
We would definitely recommend Iris' place to anyone visiting Chicago.

One of the best air bnbs I’ve stayed at. Host is so welcoming and accommodating. Great utilities around the house she’s happy to share and house dog is adorable. Hard to beat this price and quality. Staying with host was honestly a perk because space is extra cared for. Thanks for a great stay Ewa!
