Bryan was great with communication and the place was exactly as you see it in the photos - clean, well decorated, and the AC was really appreciated.  Bryan had really nice touches, especially the extra toothbrushes and toothpaste in case you forgot yours.  Every surface was clean, the bathroom was spotless, and the shower pressure was excellent.  Everything in the apartment showed that he takes great care of his place.  When our plans needed to be adjusted Bryan was super helpful and worked with us, again with excellent communication.

We really enjoyed our stay. Logan square had many restaurants and bars to choose from and it was convenient to the CTA Blueline for travelling to the surrounding areas. Liz and Martin were exceptional hosts. As for the studio, it was quiet, clean with a comfortable bed and amazing shower.

The view was intoxicating! We could have sat in the living room the entire time and enjoyed our stay. Cloud9's team was very responsive and incredibly helpful with recommendations and even a few handy tips. We truly enjoyed our stay in this magnificent place.
It was great just like the picture, we really enjoyed our stay. And it not far from downtown like the listing, about 20min drive at most.

I stayed at Tippi's place for a concert in the area and I had a wonderful two nights stay! Very clean and inviting home. Clear labels so things are easy to find and use. I loved the individual room air conditioning fan with a remote it was delightful and made sleeping comfortable. The personal room and rest of the place has everything you need for a comfortable stay! Additionally, in an inviting neighborhood with plenty of walkability to public transport or stores and restaurants. Tippi was very kind and enjoyable to talk to as well! I would definitely recommend staying here!

This property  was in great location. About a block from DePaul University. Very walkable area. It look us a five minute Walt to the train for easy transportation to Downtown and Wrigley. We also had a car and was super easy to find parking on the street. Would definitely stay again!!

I had a wonderful stay at Ewa’s place and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.
The home is exactly as shown in the photos and genuinely feels more like your own home than an Airbnb.
Ewa is an amazing host - kind, polite, generous, and always willing to help with anything you need.
Brady is one of the sweetest and best-behaved dogs I’ve ever met!
The house was clean, quiet, and comfortable. The shared spaces, bathroom, and backyard were all very well maintained. I had absolutely no issues during my stay.
Getting to downtown Chicago takes about 50 minutes by bus and train. The bus stop is only a 5-minute walk away and connects to the Blue Line, making it easy once you’ve done the trip once
Overall, this was a fantastic experience. I felt completely at home during my stay, and if I’m ever back in Chicago, I wouldn’t even think twice about staying here again. Thank you, Ewa, for your wonderful hospitality.
I highly recommend Brad and his units. He's attentive, great character and always makes sure you are satisfied. If you're staying in Chicago, please look for his places.

I was very happy to find a place in the neighborhood. This apt is in a great location. Nothing fancy, as far as the place goes, but it was a comfortable and clean place with an accessible host and really clear directions to get situated. I had a great week in Chicago with this place as home base.
Decent place in a nice location. Able to walk to the L and Chinatown. Lots of street parking available. Responsive host.

This place was a perfect HQ for our family of six.  We spent a week exploring Chicago. The home was a great pace to recharge and reset for the next day.  We chose a very warm week and the AC was a game changer for us.  The neighborhood was great, short walk to the grocery store do pick up a few essentials if needed was also really convenient.  The garage space was great for our rental, as the street spots always seemed to fill quickly.  Would stay here again if we return to Chicago.
Had a great stay with the family. Enjoyed seeing the sights of the city and catching a game at Wrigley!
The space is better IRL than the wonderful photos. So many great details and thoughtful touches and of course the art. Impeccably clean, well located right on the blue line, generous amenities.
We had a Great stay and would happily stay there again

Aleksandra & Kyle were very wonderful host! They allowed us to add our dog onto our trip last minute which was very helpful. It’s a lovely apartment and the location was perfect for what we were looking for.
We had a great time! Our host was exceptional. They even accommodated a late request for additional bedding. I’d highly recommend!

Great place.  Stayed for 3 nights back in the city visiting friends after moving out of state.  Lived in the area for 23 years so was very familiar with the neighborhood.  Tuan was very responsive and helpful.  Place was a described.  Would stay again when back in the city.  Thanks Tuan.

The place was nice and had plenty of sleeping options. Parking was easy to find and was super close to the home! The place can be pretty hot during the day, but we expected that. The main window ac unit in the living room had fallen out the window so we retaped it up and it was able to get a lot cooler inside our second night. One of the upstairs window ac units is pretty leaky but with a towel you can manage it for a short stay! The shower head was also spraying water in a bunch of directions but it was a quick fix. Overall for a quick 2 night stay it was good!

Great location near U of Chicago.  We stayed for 3 weeks comfortably.  Good internet, large TV, nice touches. Nicole was very proactive in communication and made it clear that her goal was to accommodate us as guests.  Would definitely look for this place next time I visit the area.
Great host! Quick to respond and sent someone to fix the issues immediately. Loved the bedding and very comfortable beds.!

We had a wonderful stay at Dan's house. He is responsive, accommodating and a great host overall. The home was super clean, spacious and very family-friendly which we loved. It also has all the amenities that you would ever need to make your stay convenient and comfortable. Thank you Dan for a fantastic time in Chicago.

I also appreciated that the host was responsive when I initially had trouble with the lock on the unit. I would highly recommend this property!
We loved our stay here! Great location, 15min walk to Wrigley & about a 7min walk to the red line. Quaint, quiet, a little small but we weren’t there often :) loved it!
Patricia was a great hostess.   Answered questions rapidly.   Her attitude was friendly.    She made us feel welcome through the whole process.  The bnb was pristine!

Would book again!  I had some concerns about parking since Chicago has so many people in it, but during my stay I had no issue at all finding parking with my vehicle.  If you don't have a vehicle and don't mind walking or taking ubers and lyfts around the city this place is even more perfect for you.  5 minutes from Chinatown, 10-15 mins to downtown Chicago whether it's for the Willis Tower or Soldier Field, or the Field Museum, this location is extremely convenient for all activities for sightseeing in Chicago.  I had a great stay and would hope that this Airbnb is available again for future trips!

We had an amazing room with a lot of space and a great view, and the room was clean. The location is central so it was good for exploring downtown chicago. Great place to stay in Chicago! Clean, modern, great for 4 people, nice kitchen and bathroom, comfy beds.

Auroom was very responsive and easy to work with. We had an issue and they were prompt and able to help with a solution. We enjoyed our time and the unit we stayed in was just as described. Would stay with them again.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was spotless, spacious, and in the perfect location in beautiful Roscoe Village. We loved being able to walk to so many great restaurants, coffee shops, and bars, and it was an easy walk to Wrigley Field for the Cubs game, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.
Sharleen was a lovely host. Friendly, responsive, and made everything seamless from check-in to check-out. The home had everything we needed and was very comfortable for our group. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!
Loved the space, it was exactly as described and shown in pictures! Great location, easy to check in, and very accommodating. Loved the personalized welcome sign too :)
Very accommodating and thoughtful host. Appreciate the consideration and flexibility. Very nice to communicate with.

Mary was very responsive to questions and very helpful with information prior to arrival. Her place is beautiful, with any amenities we needed. It is easy walking distance to the United Center. The neighborhood is quiet, and Mary had parking permits for us for street parking. We had a wonderful stay.
様々な気遣いがあり、居心地よく過ごすことができました。また、近くのレストランは美味なことも、大きな利点です。シカゴに来る機会があれば、また滞在したいです。

This beautiful space is perfectly located and made for an incredible stay! The host was incredibly friendly and always quick to respond to any questions. Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a seamless and enjoyable trip.

Charie was a great host from the beginning. Very responsive and provided instructions ahead of time. The apartment looked like the pictures and the kitchen was fully equipped. The place was pretty clean. The walls had some markings and could be touched up, but other than that I have no complaints about cleanliness. The neighborhood was quiet. While it wasn’t in the heart of the city it was walkable and safe. I would say my only complaint would be for more towels to be provided. I was there with another guest for about 6 days and only 2 towels were provided. It wasn’t a big deal since there was a washing machine, but it would have been more convenient to have a spare.
All in all it was a great stay and I would recommend it.
This was a great place in a good area! The place was very clean and relatively easy to navigate. Great stay overall

El hogar de Jeanette es simplemente espectacular. Fuimos a Chicago por unos días y nos hospedamos ahí. Tiene todo lo que se necesita para unas vacaciones, es una casa muy espaciosa. Además, ella es una persona muy cálida. Nos permitió entrar antes y salir después sin ningún problema. Sin duda me volvería a hospedar ahí. Gracias!
The place is perfect for our day to day activities, bus  runs right in front of the place.
Great place!

Second time staying here!! Great spot to hangout with a group.  Many good spots in the house for cute photos. The hosts kindly provide toiletries, first aid kit, washer, dryer, etc. Felt great to decompress in the airbnb after a night out. Parking can be a bit difficult but it’s free which is a huge plus and well worth it for our group who wanted an airbnb that was spatious and dog friendly. Hosts are super helpful and kind. Will be back!
Beautiful place

What a wonderful place! As an Airbnb hosts for over 5 years and   super-host,  I learned a lot from this space. I appreciate the welcome, the amenities, the snacks, the ability to cook, plus more. I loved it so much, I booked it again for the next year!

Well appointed, clean town house in the middle of Lincoln Park. It’s less than 10 minutes from Halsted and Armitage and very close to Oz park. It’s located on a quiet street and the apartment itself was well stocked with seasoning, oil, pots and pans, and plenty of towels. The beds were amazingly comfortable! We highly recommend this place. Andy was super helpful when I left my medication in their apartment after check out. Thank you!
Had a little hiccup, but owners were very responsive and fixed the issue promptly. Would stay again if ever in Chicago again.
The hosts were very responsive and La  Vecindad was a decent bargain for the space!

The little studio checked all the right boxes for my husband and I. The unit is accurately shown in the pictures David uploaded. The vibrant colored walls match well with the Scandinavian/minimalist style furniture. Expect city living in this smaller sized and older apartment. It is located on the ground floor, with a couple steps down upon entering the unit. From the creaking wooden floors to the louder sounding window AC unit, this space has the quirks of an older apartment in a gentrified neighborhood. Side note: be careful in the shower. The water heater must be shared with other units and can send scorching “hellos”. It is nestled on the edge of Wrigleyville, in the heart of the Lakeview neighborhood. It’s a very walkable area, two blocks from Southport (an upscale shopping district) and two blocks from Wrigley Stadium. It’s not far from one of the train lines and right across the street from a Divy bike station. The host was excellent and very responsive to any concerns we had!

Another five star review from us because Daniel and the carriage house make Hyde Park feel like a home away from home. A real gift to know it's there (if I'm lucky enough to snag it and no one's already rented it ahead of me!)

Clean, comfortable and well-stocked with every amenity imaginable. We loved the helpful local business guidebook, and the carefully curated selection of music memorabilia made this one of the coolest Airbnbs we have ever experienced.

L'appartement de Coty a parfaitement répondu à toutes nos attentes et même plus, dans la mesure où nous y sommes restés "coincés" pendant 2 jours à cause de la très mauvaise qualité de l'air due aux fumées des incendies canadiens. Idéalement situé et d'un excellent rapport qualité/prix. Propre, bien équipé et spacieux, nous nous y sommes sentis comme dans un joli cocon pour notre séjour romantique.

Sean’s place was very nice, clean and just as described. It was convenient to great restaurants, Wrigley Field etc. Sean was a fantastic host who communicated very well throughout our stay. We would and will definitely stay here again!
Scott's place was amazing! It was really cute, clean, and comfortable. Scott was incredibly communicative and responsive. Would absolutely stay here again.
Andrei is a great host. Good communication and very quick response time

We had a great stay! The place was clean, spacious, and exactly as described. The 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms were perfect for our group of six, giving everyone plenty of space to relax. The location in Chinatown was convenient, with lots of great restaurants nearby and easy access to downtown.
The host was responsive, check-in was smooth, and everything we needed was provided. For the price, it was an excellent value. We'd definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago, especially groups looking for a comfortable place in a great location.

My family and I really enjoyed our stay at Sandy’s home. It looked just like the photos and provided plenty of space for our group of 6. The couches and beds were so comfortable! Having access to the garage was also great. Sandy is a great host and very responsive.
Great location. Clean and comfortable stay.
wow. genuinely just wow. such a beautiful place, and definitely took advantage of that pool table! ryan was also a great host and very helpful when needed
Great location. Convenient for our trip.
Absolutely perfect for what I needed. Thank you Jackie !
The Airbnb is located within walking distance to Chinatown and subway stations. It has great amenities as well.

You get exactly what you pay for. A room to sleep for cheap. The area/neighborhood felt very safe. Train station was a chill 10 minute walk away and you could barely hear it pass by when in the house. There was a cleaning person for the main area every day which kept the space clean. Good value!

We absolutely loved staying in Matt and Brad’s beautiful home!  It had a great, walkable location and the unit is spotless with really nice finishes.  They are friendly and responsive hosts!  We would definitely stay again!
The listing is as described. Good location if you want to catch a White Sox game or enjoy the good food in Chinatown

This is a budget friendly, centrally located space with easy access to bus and train lines. Hidden gem restaurants and dive bars located close by as well.
The space is small, but adequate.
Greta place!
Was a very nice place to wind down after long days of exploring downtown.  It was an easy and reasonable drive to everywhere we wanted to go.

My husband and I were visiting Chicago - my 29 year old daughters first time.  This place was wonderful for us as a base.  It has all the amenities listed plus more - things that other airbnbs we have been in haven’t had but were thoughtful and helpful if needed.  The neighborhood is quiet - a nice break from the honking horns in the city.  I was a little concerned at first about the street parking - but it wasn’t an issue - we always had street parking available.

Honestly, Mark and Collette’s place is the best AirBnB we have ever stayed at. We are very active and need a nice place to refresh and rest in. And we felt so at home here! We walked everywhere. The Brown line is so close, so we also hopped on that and enjoyed a day in the Loop. Everything was top notch! Five plus stars! Thank you Mark and Collette!
Great stay! Friendly neighborhood and very solid proximity to downtown!
Great location and close to the train station!

Easily the most worth-it Airbnb in Chicago. As two women traveling alone, we felt incredibly safe here. The location is prime with a stunning view, check-in was a breeze to navigate, and the hosts were very helpful and welcoming. They provided everything we needed for a perfect stay. Highly recommend!

Good value for money. District is well connected to the city center by public transport. A few nice places to eat at the walking distance. Great atmosphere inside the house. For me only a reasonable supermarket with a human food nearby was missing.
We had a great stay! The location was awesome, it was easy to park, even without the reserved space, and we had everything we needed.

Great loft in a good location if you want a lot of restaurants and bars to check out. You get used the blue line train right outside. Doggy day care right next to you is loud during the day but they go home every day.

The place was easy to find and we had clear instructions on. How to get inside. Street parking was generally easy to find. A couple times when we got back past 8pm, we had to park one street over but it was not too bad. The pots and pans were pretty scratched up but besides that, everything we needed was provided.

We loved staying here, we were here for a Cubs game and the walk to Wrigleyville is so convenient. The actual unit we stayed in was exactly as described, very unique, and had some cool unique features. Will definitely be back for future Cubs games.

This shared unit with a private master bedroom and bath was conveniently located.  It was close to our family members plus there were some parks and restaurants nearby.  The rooms were adequate for our purposes.

This was a great location for our visit to Chicago.  We went to a concert at the United Center, Cubs game and restaurants in downtown Chicago. All were easy Uber rides from this location.  Would stay here again.
Great location and easy access to public transportation made it seamless to get around the city. Our host was helpful and easy going which made for a great trip overall!
Love the place as a solo traveler loved it was close to the red line
Great place! Very clean and had everything we needed for our family during our stay. Highly recommend

Absolutely horrendous and unsafe stay, avoid this rental at all costs. I checked in for a 6-night booking, and the power tripped out entirely at 11:07 the second morning after I used the supplied hair dryer for under 30 seconds. AC and all lights died instantly.
I contacted management immediately, yet they ignored the crisis for almost 7 hours with no on-site help, only generic “will update you” responses. The apartment turned pitch black and sweltering without cooling, plus there was a noticeable gas smell that forced me to turn off the gas supply for safety. Requesting a refund through Airbnb wasted an extra 4 hours of my trip.
Parking is equally awful: advertised free spots are always full 24/7, and I could never find a place to park. The host offers zero support during urgent, dangerous issues, making this a completely unreliable, stressful listing. I cannot recommend it to anyone.
Muy buena ubicación y edificio muy moderno. El gimnasio excelente.
Really cute area. Felt safe to walk around. Suuuuper clean! Stocked with everything you could need from soap, laundry detergent, water, etc. Super responsive host. Great place, would stay again!

Donald and Colby were very friendly and provided lots of helpful information about history of the neighborhood and local recommendations for nearby food and activities. Convenient location to access downtown!

This was the perfect spot for our stay in Chicago. Conveniently located just a short walk from the train station, made getting around super easy. The place felt like home with one of the most comfortable beds ever! Hosts are super responsive and made sure we had everything we needed. I would recommend this place to anyone traveling to Chicago.
Bahnsteig ist nicht weit weg, mit dem Zug ist man schnell in Chicago
This place was convenient since it was very close to downtown. The beds were very comfortable we loved them!! So many options for food all around. Milan was very kind and always responsive!

The apartment was exactly as shown in photos. We stayed for a week while attending a conference at McCormick Place, and the location was very convenient, just a short walk away. There are also plenty of bus and train stops nearby, so getting around the city and visiting other attractions was very easy. Asta was a wonderful host, always kind, responsive, and quick to help whenever we had a question or needed anything. We really enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend this place.

Sean was a great host. The location was overall less than ideal, the floors squeak a lot, neighbors can be noisy. all of these are problems with the property itself which is old, but the space was clean, Sean was professional, great amenities available for a comfortable stay. parking pass was provided.
Great location, great amenities and clean and comfortable space.  Would definitely return!
Daniel’s spot was perfect for enjoying Logan Square and had easy access to other areas in the Chicago. Quiet and comfortable, I would recommend this spot for anyone looking to visit!
We had a great stay!

Ryan’s place is in a peaceful neighbourhood and walkable to the metro station. It’s easily accessible from O’Hare airport and Downtown Chicago. The snooker board is a great touch. I would surely stay at his place again. Definitely worth the price.

This was a wonderful, restful place, with so many small but lovely touches. Neighborhood was quiet and friendly. House stayed nice and cool, even in the heat outside. Treats in the kitchen, and extra toiletries if you forgot. I have been to several dozen homes over the years, and this is one of my favorites!

The host was quick to respond when we were given the wrong code to the lock box, the place is pretty spacious and the location is great. Aside from that, it was severely lacking. There was hair all over the sheets and towels, and spiders crawling on one of the beds. The bathroom sink and bathtub do not drain and fill up with water. As a result of this, the soap did not go down the shower drain which made it extremely slippery and caused me to fall in the shower. There is an awful odor in certain areas of the apartment, and the bedroom in the front is unbearable to sleep in as there is extremely loud music and noise the entire night. I would not stay here again.

This is a beautiful place to stay. Our family loved it. The rooms are very spacious, and the kitchen is extremely well stocked for cooking. The entire place was extremely clean. Ian is exceptionally friendly and he went out of his way to accommodate us. This was a perfect place for us. And we would absolutely stay here again.

My buddies and I were in town for a Rush concert and Cubs game.  The Belmont Sleep Station and Gallery was the perfect place to stay, as it was convenient to ORD and the city, as it was right across the street from the Belmont CTA station.  The apartment was very well appointed, as Jeffrey and Nick thought about every detail, from many charging stations, generous linens, helpful lables, to the nice coffee station with gourmet coffee provided.  It was spacious and comfortable.  Jeffrey and Nick were very flexible with check-in.  There was a little bit of noise from the street traffic and the bar below, but the white noise machines provided made it hardly noticeable.  We also enjoyed all of the artwork, which made the stay even more interesting and pleasant.  I would definitely stay here again!
Angela’s place is literally a block from Wrigley it was great for the Cubs game. It’s cute, convenient, and very clean! Would highly recommend and hope to stay there again!
Great stay. Everything as described. Quick reply’s from the host.

The Airbnb was very nice and looked exactly like the pictures! The host had great communication and was always quick to respond. They also made sure there were plenty of toiletries and other essentials available for our stay, which were conveniently stored in the bathroom and under the kitchen sink.
The only challenge was parking later in the evening. After around 7 p.m., spaces were limited, and some available spots were pretty tight. The neighborhood seemed decent overall, but we did have a couple of interactions that made us feel a little uncomfortable. One evening, a man walking nearby would stop whenever we stopped and watched us as we entered the gate to the Airbnb. On a different day, we encountered someone with a very large dog that they seemed to have difficulty controlling on the leash.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay. The Airbnb itself was exactly as pictured, well-stocked, and the host was very responsive!
A great place to stay in the area! very clean and close to restaurants and the metro
Kory was a wonderful host! The Airbnb was exactly as described and great location to many restaurants and local shops. We will absolutely be staying here again😊
Very nice home. Easy to get to the L. Very easy to walk around, very safe neighborhood.

Alex's place worked great for us. The location was excellent - close to groceries, eateries, and public transit. The apartment was spacious and the bed was very comfortable. Alex was a very responsive host.
Great location and very accessible to bus and train to go everywhere! The place was spotless and it felt cozy. Despite having an event place under, the music wasn’t intrusive and we had a blast!
We had a great stay. The place was clean, cozy and close to downtown. The host was friendly and easy to communicate. I recommend this place.
Nice location and convenient to public transportation.
We love our stay in Casa Montoya!!
We had great family vacation, and Chicago was amazing! We were able to comfortably sleep two families!

We stated this location for a work event and six people fit extremely comfortably in this unit. Jeremy was extremely communicative and helpful.
House is in a great neighborhood with walkable parks and close to public transportation.
We had a slight issue with our air-conditioning over the Fourth of July and Jeremy was exceptional at getting this issue resolved, which showed his dedication to providing great service to his tenants and customers.
We certainly recommend this location in Chicago for families and groups. We look forward to staying here again in the future if needed.

Seriously the best place to stay! So convenient - turn left from home and hit great coffee shop, grocery and breakfast! Turn right and so close to The L and local bars and Wrigleyville - super fun! The home- just WOW. Had everything we needed, the artwork! Such a blend of style- great showers… always a plus with our guys! Thanks, would 100% recommend

Overall, we had a good stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Our only issue was the parking, which was extremely frustrating. On our last night, we spent nearly four hours driving around the neighborhood trying to find a legal parking spot. We eventually parked at a metered space, but the ParkChicago app gave confusing messages about whether payment was required or allowed. We were worried our car might be ticketed or towed before our early drive home. We even asked a local for help interpreting the parking rules, and I stayed awake until early morning so I could pay as soon as enforcement hours began. I understand the host cannot control street parking, but clearer instructions about parking options and how the app works would have saved us hours of stress and lost rest. Aside from that, the apartment itself was great, and better parking guidance would have made this a five-star stay overall. We would gladly return if parking details were clearer next.
Great location and very smooth check in and check out. Made my vacation a breeze!

My daughter stayed here for almost 3 months while working at Northwestern Medical school for the summer. It was outstanding in every way -- safe, comfortable, clean, gorgeous, and everyone she/we came in contact with was kind and helpful. She had a fantastic summer because this place truly felt like home. Thanks Matt!!
worth every penny...clean cozy everything u need for a quick and quiet getaway...
Great place to stay for a weekend visit to Chicago
First time booking an AiBnB but it was completely seemless experience with Jeff!  Loved the space and was beyond comfortable.

Lynette and Efrain's apartment was hands-down one of the best Airbnbs we've stayed in. Their communication was excellent — clear, quick, and proactive from start to finish. The apartment itself was spotless, spacious, and had a genuinely homey feel, and the location was great and easy to find.

The apartment was just the right size for 3 adult couples. We had plenty of space to be together and apart. We really appreciated the closeness to the L train as this made it super easy to get around Chicago without the need for a car or expensive Uber rides. The place was clean and tidy. We would definitely stay here again if we came back to Chicago.
Overall a great place to stay

Nous sommes restés 4 nuits. Le logement est spacieux et conforme à la description.
Le quartier est calme et l'accès à la ligne 65 est à 3 minutes.
Le rapport qualité prix est excellent. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir.

Perfect location! Quick walk to the blue line which we used daily and to/from O’Hare. Near amazing restaurants (union, Lula cafe), cafe (colectivo), stationary shop etc. Excellent/spotless bathroom and kitchen. We’d stay here again for sure!

Caroline's place was perfect for catching a show at Wrigley! It was very close to a central bus line and metro, there was a tasty Korean coffee shop down the block we went to almost very morning, and so many options for other meals close by. It was easy to get to the downtown area, too.
I was a little nervous about there being a daycare above the apartment but we had no issues, we could tell when the kids were there but it was still really quiet for the hour or two we hung around in the morning.
Caroline also stocked the place really well. I've not seen this level of care at an airbnb in a long time: plenty of snacks, water, and kcups, along with other kitchen and bathroom amenities. (We were really greatful for the snacks after getting back from the concert XD)
All in all, this was a great trip. Thank you for a wonderful stay, Caroline!

Wonderful Airbnb. Super nice set up and wonderful hosts. It’s a cozy and clean space. We definitely felt well taken care of. Do keep in mind that it’s fairly far from the main tourist attractions of Chicago. We would travel about 60-75 minutes (by public transportation) each way to see things like The Bean, riverwalk, etc. It was well worth it, but important to know!

Eventhough the building is quite dated but the unit doesn't feel so at all. It is unique. What I love the most is the location. Just minutes away from the lake shore. Maybe 15 minutes walk to lincoln park and lincoln park zoo. And 10 minutes walk to Michigan Avenue and the shopping district.
We had a pleasant stay. The room itself is clean and comfortable. Quite noisy at night thanks to its strategic location. But the host provided ear buds in case you didnt bring any.
Prompt response. Plenty of street parking. A kind host.

Gloria's place was wonderful! Exactly, if not better, than pictured. Everything we needed for our short stay. The room was immaculate! Lots of great personal touches and thoughtfully prepared with snacks, coffee, etc. Very quiet neighborhood with restaurants close by. We took an Uber to downtown and the United Center. Even with traffic it was only about 15-20 minutes. Gloria was so responsive when we had a question and checked on us throughout our stay. Highly recommend this lovely space. We look forward to coming back!

Le logement est situé a proximité immédiate de la ligne rouge du métro. L’appartement dispose d’une superbe vue, n’est pas très grand mais tout à fait suffisant pour 2 personnes. Globalement bien équipé en électroménager (à part le four qui ne fonctionnait pas), avec Clim et ventilateur pour supporter la chaleur. Situé au 15eme étage, l’extérieur est un peu bruyant la nuit mais on s’habitue et c’est relativement normal pour cette zone. Globalement très satisfait du logement et sa localisation.

Great location with easy access to public transportation. Communication with the host was easy and responsive. The space was clean, and the kitchen was fully equipped with everything we needed. The only downside is that the room doesn’t have much of a view, so it’s best suited for guests who don’t mind that. Overall, it was a good stay.

Good location, the master bedroom had a pretty strong smell of marijuana, my wife couldn't sleep in the room. I let you know so that future rentals do not have that experience because they could easily give you bad reviews. It wasn't what I expected in terms of cleaning either, but thank you.

Due to the Canadian fires, we attempted to cancel our trip given all the smoke in Chicago and as my wife was 31 weeks pregnant it was too dangerous.
We offered to find another solution (pay half or I travel alone and pay full at another one of their properties) but they were unwilling to be flexible.
Unfortunate how greedy some of these businesses can be.
Great location and great hosts.  Promptly answered any questions.
Perfect location. Great place. cleaners didn't do a great job, but would absolutely stay here again.
We had a great time here, thank you for a great place to stay! We especially loved the back patio!!
Loved the atmosphere.
The space is great. Plenty of space, great kitchen and bathrooms, and comfortable bedrooms. The neighborhood is charming. We had a great time.
Place was great.  Perfect for what I needed.  Thanks!
Right next to the Chinatown Gate! How cool!

Terrific location with super easy access to the park, zoo, and restaurants. The host was very responsive and kind, she went out of her way to make sure the check in process went well.
The bed was firm and the space was small. Overall a good experience

Loved staying in John's place. It was really comfortable in a great neighborhood with lots in walking distance. Parking was also very easy, it was very clean, and John was great with communication. I left a toiletries bag in the unit after we checked out, and John told me and made it easy for me to grab it later in the day.

This two-bedroom apartment is perfectly located for exploring Chinatown. The space is very walker-friendly and convenient to downtown. While the unit was clean upon arrival, it could have used a deeper tidying. I would also suggest darkening shades in the living room and back bedroom. Additionally, the beds could have been more comfortable, but the location makes up for it. The host was extremely helpful; she created a handy booklet on how to navigate the area. Ubers had no issues finding the location.
I really enjoyed staying in the apartment during our trip. The experience was great and the neighborhood was very quiet which I preferred. The place was exactly what it was marketed to be. Our host was very responsive. Thank you again for hosting us and hopefully we can return again in the future.
Beautiful place, very kind people.  Marty and Rob took care of everything and were wonderful hosts. Loved sitting out in the garden with my coffee in the morning.

Room 5: The place is a nice size for 1 person, average size space for 2 people. The central AC wasn’t working, which was unideal, but Victor did have a window AC unit installed before I arrived. I’d say it worked with about 70% effectiveness: it blew cold air, but not enough to cool the entire room because of how hot it was outside, even at night. While the size is nice and the neighborhood is quiet, the home is WAY OLDER than it looks in the photos—the windows in the bathroom and the bedroom are sticky and lots of the paint/ sealant inside the bathtub is chipping off; the entry door to get inside is old; the kitchen has no drinking water. Overall, an alright stay with no major issues, other than the house being way older than I expected based on the photos in the listing. The bed is also against the same wall as the doors, and I would suggest moving the head of the bed against the wall with the window, so the airflow of traffic from the doors doesn’t disrupt you while you sleep.

Matt's place is awesome.  Beautiful inside and out.  Easy communications. Very comfortable beds, and the furnishings are just lovely. Easy parking on the street as well as off-street parking. Close to restaurants, shops, and bars in Logan. Highly recommend staying here.

Great choice if you’re looking for a clean, quiet, no-frills neighborhood place to sleep and relax. Has all the basics you need to cook, shower, and rest in a somewhat dorm-like experience and is close to public transit. Have your own locking room along with a shared kitchen and bathroom. Other guests kept to themselves and only one was loud after hours so that was a bit of a gamble. Bring earplugs and you’ll be fine. I enjoyed it and would stay here again.

Clare was very quick to respond if there was an issue. The place is in a great location and we really enjoyed walking the neighborhood. Place looks just like the photos and  it was really nice to be able to spread out.
I really enjoyed my stay and I  felt safe.

Everything was as described.
We had an issue with the air and within 20 minutes they came and fixed it. Fastest response time I have ever experienced . Host responds very very quickly. It was wonderful.

Perfect place to stay with an incredible view of the skyline! Easily walkable to the train stop, Fulton Market/West Loop restaurants and shops. One thing to note is that there is a decibel meter close to the TV/common area - so watch the volume. Would definitely stay again!
Great spot to stay, super conveniently located near the orange line that makes navigating the city easy. Quiet neighborhood with lots of street parking.

Great place! Bigger than it looked
in the photos. Super friendly host with a ton of nice touches to make you feel welcome.

We had a great stay in Chicago!  Our hosts provided us with a beautiful home. There were plenty of towels as well as extra pillows and blankets. There were snacks left on the counter and bottled water in the fridge. The neighborhood felt safe. We would definitely stay here again!

This AirBnB was really great.  I own a couple STRs as well and everything was as expected.  I actually think the house is bigger than the pictures give it credit for. Our family of 4 were very comfortable.  Short walk to the brown line, electric bikes and scooters available a block away.  The place is right where everything happens but was on a super quiet street.  Would definitely stay there again when we head back to Chicago.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! Everything was as described, if not nicer.
The backyard was a relaxing oasis we enjoyed after spending the day exploring the city. The property location was in a quiet neighborhood, but still walking distance to a lot of restaurants, shops, and public transportation.
We will definitely stay again on our next visit to Chicago!

Overall, we had a great stay and enjoyed our time here. The location was a huge plus—the train was just a short walk away, which made getting around incredibly easy. The check-in instructions were clear and straightforward, and having access to a large laundry room was a nice convenience for our family.
There were a few areas that could be improved. The biggest issue was the cleanliness, particularly in the bathrooms. Nothing was terrible, but the home could definitely benefit from a more thorough deep cleaning. We were also disappointed with the living room seating. For a home advertised to accommodate up to 10 guests, there wasn't enough comfortable seating. The couch only fit 2–3 people, and the additional chair was quite uncomfortable, making it difficult for everyone to gather together in the evenings.
We enjoyed our stay and appreciated the convenient location, but addressing the cleanliness and seating would make this an even better experience.

The entrance being in the back of the apartment was a tad bit creepy especially going in at night but other than that I have no complaints and it was a great stay. Place was clean, private, and had everything I needed.

the house was convenient to the University of Chicago campus, museums, restaurants. Hyde Park is lovely and safe. Lime scooters everywhere and great public transportation options. The flat had everything we needed including air conditioning for a very hot week,  free laundry and basic cooking supplies. Just what we needed for our trip. Thank you so much! highly recommend.
Amazing stay. 10 out of 10 unit and host. The stay was amazing and one of my best experiences.
great stay with brilliant food spots nearby.  twenty minutes drive to downtown. real feel of Chicago living.

El aire acondicionado del lugar es insuficiente, entiendo que chicago no es una zona de calor extremo, pero ultimamente el calor es muy fuerte, deberian invertir en Aire acondicionado con mas capacidad,  lo que no me gusto tampoco es que no hay elevador y subir esas escaleras con maletas es demasiado pesado
Had an amazing stay! Thank you!!!
Perfect location in between downtown and the Obama Center. Not to mention a very accommodating family which offered a couple food recommendation's too. We enjoyed our stay. Thank you!
Amazing long term stay thanks Ahmeena

What a lovely space to stay!
I found Vladimir to be a very considerate and kind host that went out of his way to make sure I was comfortable.
Hopefully, I can stay again in the near future

Overall, I would absolutely stay here again. The kitchen and living room were truly fantastic and the location was great. There is a lot of effort put into the place. My only individual criticism was we honestly didn’t find the beds to be our favorite. For a person who likes very firm mattresses I’m sure they’d love it - just not my personal cup of tea.
Otherwise, it was great and wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.

As advertised—nothing fancy but met our needs.  Not a ton of space if you want to hang out at the hose but we were on the go so it worked great for us.  It was unseasonably hot but the window units kept the bedrooms cool. Heather was responsive and had great suggestions. Great location—short walk to a beautiful pond!  Would stay here again

I had a positive experience! The room and apartment were beautiful and clean, A/C was perfect, a very comfortable stay! Something that wasn’t completely clear on my end (and maybe because it’s my 2nd time using airbnb) was that the host resided in the apartment as well, and this resulted in a misunderstanding during check-in. Other than that, I really enjoyed my stay!

Wow this is one of my top rated Airbnbs and we have stayed in plenty!  The PH was spotless with and had comfortable beds linens and towels.  The neighborhood has everything you need in walking distance. We had the best Chicago experience because of this property’s location.

We loved David's place -- it really felt like a home! It was spacious and comfortable for our family, and he graciously agreed to a later checkout when our rental car was delayed. Lincoln Park is a beautiful neighborhood to walk around, too. We would definitely stay there again.

Tuve una estadía super cómoda! El departamento es tal cual figura en las fotos y está super limpio y ordenado.
Milton fue sumamente amable y rápido en su comunicación, nos dio recomendaciones de bares locales, y tuvo flexibilidad con el horario de check-in.
Volvería a alojarme acá, muy recomendable!

Great location. Spotless condo. Very responsive and helpful. We loved our stay at Heather’s. I stayed with my family of 4 and everyone loved the condo ! Definitely would book again for our next trip. Location is great. Trains are walkable. Many restaurants that are walkable as well. Loved it.

The staff is very friendly and helpful! The location iis convenient and near CTA stops that can take you across the city. The room was nice and the bathroom was spacious. However, my only complaint is that there were a few hairs in the bathroom and on the desk when I checked into the room. which made me question whether the room was properly cleaned. On the up side, they offer room cleanings upon request. Besides that, I didn’t encounter any other issues during my stay!
Would definitely recommend!

The overall stay was pretty comfortable. My biggest issue was the way the hallway smelled. It seemed like the odor was coming from the apartment next to us. The environment was pretty cool , no issues there other than the parking. Would recommend for future visits.

Lourdes was amazing his home
was beautiful and I would book again.
Adam’s place was absolutely amazing! It was clean, in a great location, and was perfect for my friends and I. We would definitely stay with Adam again!
I really enjoyed my stay and the host was very commutative. I loved the Airbnb very nice and spacious. Highly recommended!
Small studio close to many restaurant and public transportation.
Convenient location, very spacious

Antonio was an amazing host! He was incredibly proactive and responsive! Our AC went out on night 1 and we didn’t even mention anything to him- he was watching the thermostat on an app to make sure we were comfortable! He also gave great recommendations and was incredibly kind and understanding about everything we needed!

Ag was very communicative, which gave my party and I peace of mind during our stay. The Airbnb itself was beautiful and very spacious. The parking was free and plentiful, which is a huge plus in a city like Chicago.

Overall our stay was nice. Quiet neighborhood, walking distance from Roosevelt.
While the place was clean, there were some areas that could have been cleaner especially since checkout time is 10am and check in is 4pm. 6 hours is enough time for a place to be spotless. I’d also recommend having cleaning supplies accessible for guest.
I’d stay again and recommend this spot to anyone looking for a nice stay or vacation. The host was responsive and kind.

Noel was very responsive and sent recommendations without being asked and they were great recommendations!  The house was clean with comfortable beds and pillows and a brand new kitchen that was super cute! One of the best hosts I’ve ever had!
Yolanda was fantastic, attentive, and readily available for everything I needed. I would be more than happy to stay at a property she manages again.

Responsive hosts.
Place looked exactly like photos.
Quiet and peaceful neighborhood with a few minutes drive to Walgreens, which came in handy more than a few times.
There were a few issues, but all were addressed and taken care of within just a few minutes. Communication was readily available any time that we needed the hosts and solutions were made available, also.
Overall, great value for the booking. We will stay again.
Muy buen lugar, se puede descansar de buena manera y es exactamente como lo describe.

I had a great stay at Mera’s place! Would highly recommend and hopefully will be back soon!
Thank you!

- Quiet neighborhood
- easy access to downtown (cta and uber)
- shared space
- good price

Milan was very communicative & the place was easy to find/get into w the instructions. The apartment is a modern loft & has lovely light through large windows. The location was close to the conference we were attending at the Marriott nearby, which was convenient, although the area is somewhat dull for Chicago.
The biggest issue was there were zero towels of any kind in the apartment when we arrived at the normal check in time of 4pm. Not even a hand towel. We communicated this immediately to Milan & he was very responsive, saying they would bring towels quickly, but after an entire evening of back & forth messages, towels were only finally dropped off around midnight. This was a 90-degree day where we had flown in from across the country, & we ultimately had to go to sleep without showering until the next morning, which was very frustrating & inconvenient. After that, there were no other issues, but unfortunately it did put a damper on the trip!
Overall, a good but not great stay.
I loved how there were disposable slippers, tooth paste & brush. also roughly 15 minute walk from red line metro so although it's not DOWNTOWN, great location

A great stay! The Airbnb host is very easy to get ahold of, the space is small so great for 2 people! A lovely kitchen and the room was a decent size. The shower water was very hot and stayed warm, & The bed and the sheets were the best! I couldn’t be more happy.
Thank you for the stay :)

At first I wasn't going to leave a review bcuz they asked me not to, but I don't believe they will change.
When we checked into the unit, it felt dirty but tidy. the couch is broken, the cushions dip so low its unenjoyable. When I got in the king bed, there was hairs, drool stains on pillow, glitter in the bed. sheets were unwashed. Probably from multiple previous guests. The second bed was unwashed too. We contacted the hosts the next morning and they tried to fix it by sending us new sheets. When we got home at 12am that night and began changing sheets, the mattress had stains everywhere, there were insects living on the mattress and there was a BED BUG on the pillow I slept on the night before. We left in a panic, had no where to go (In CHI you can't book a hotel after midnight). The next day the host told me they would "change the sheets". Entire unit needs to be deep clean and needs new furniture/MATTRESSES. They also try to take damage deposit. Would not recommend staying here.

The place was great and exactly what we were looking for. The water heater wasn’t working so we all had to take cold showers the first night, but the host sent someone to fix it the next morning. Other than that, the only real issue was with the top bunk bed. It was ridiculously squeaky and shaky, disrupting everyone else who was staying in the room with this bed. Also the blinds in the living area didn’t open which was unfortunate. Overall, the space was exactly what we needed for our group and host was responsive!

This place is amazing. Absolutely loved the location. The place is crazy cool. I think I could have never left the house and had an incredible vacation. The master bath is more like a car wash than a shower. Amazing! The technology is crazy in this place. I even had to let my kid show me how to get a couple things going. Beds are all super comfortable and the automatic shades will really block the light and let you sleep in if you are not careful! There are incredible views from several balconies. The top floor Eastern balcony shows a beautiful view of the downtown skyline. We really enjoyed sitting on the balcony of an evening taking in the sights and sounds of the neighborhood. We found so many great places to eat and drink just a few minute walk away. Public transit is easily accessible.
The only draw back to this place is the stairs. There are a lot of them. You might have issues if there are any physical concerns that make stairs difficult for you. Overall we hope to stay again!

We had a great stay at Louis's home. It was a short walk to the metro which took us downtown. Louis gave us great recommendations and was quick to respond when I had a question. I think the only downfall to his place is there isn't much within walking distance,  but we loved our stay.
Josh was super responsive and friendly. Room was clean and just as pictured. Plenty of parking nearby, and it’s a cool area with some cool bars and breakfast spots right down the block.
clean, comfortable, and convenient. Perfect for peaople attending or exhibiting at McCormick Center.

This was our second time staying here, and it truly felt like a home away from home. The house was just as clean, comfortable, and welcoming as we remembered. Everything we needed was provided, and the host was responsive and thoughtful. It's always a great feeling to return to a place that consistently exceeds expectations. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing and comfortable stay!
Did not spend much time there but the place was clean and quiet.  Small bedroom but that was the trade off for having a private bathroom.  Shared area was very nice though.

This place is wonderful, especially if you’re a couple looking for a calm little spot to relax and enjoy some quality time together. I’m honestly demanding you book this place — you won’t regret it.
The air conditioning works great, the TV is big with amazing picture quality, and the dishes are very nice and spotless. The bathroom is beautiful and has a relaxing feel to it, although it’s not really a bathroom designed for two people to use at the same time.
The bedroom and bed were my favorite parts. The bed is extremely soft and comfortable it feels like you’re sinking into a marshmallow. The high ceilings also make the place feel much bigger and give it an even better atmosphere.
Overall, this place was amazing. It’s clean, comfortable, peaceful, and perfect for couples looking for a cozy place to chill.
5 stars
super close to train station! very clean! very nice host

It was amazing trip and stay at Alex place. Place is well maintained and sufficiently stocked with necessary items. Location is amazing and conveniently located near Foster beach (walking distance) and other important areas like grocery , pharmacy, restaurants etc. Had initial hassle with check in but Alex and concierge team were super helpful getting us into the home. Basement area is very good with pool table and wet bar. Parking is free on local streets but not available all the time, glad I booked paid parking in advance (highly recommend if you are traveling in peak seasons). Area is very safe for local commuting. Overall amazing experience visiting Chicago and even worth staying Alex place.

Private and quiet location with spacious bedroom big enough for 2 adults. Do not expect flexible check-in or baggage luggage drop-off. We arrived into Chicago early and were not able to drop off bags at 11am as we’d hoped. You are occupying a room in a larger house so expect to see other guests, but we did not find this to be an issue at all. All other occupants were clean, quiet, and respectful. We did find the ambient temperature in the room to be quite dry so bear this in mind if you have any skin conditions like eczema/psoriasis. In terms of location, it is a MINIMUM 30min bus/train (over 1.5hr walk) from major Chicago locations like Millennium Park and even Chinatown. Major food options are not in the area either. If you are looking for somewhere cheaper, about medium distance, and clean, this is for you. If you want something more at the center with expansive amenities and a luxury feel I would keep looking!
Great spot, very communicative host and accommodating - sauna is a game changer :) highly recommend! Very spacious and solid location. Renewing our stay already for another week!

Pilsen is by far our favorite place to stay in Chicago. We were beyond lucky to come across this availability, especially with Henna as the host! She was probably the most responsive host we’ve ever had, and even though I felt like I was annoying with all my questions, she never made me feel that way. Her place was very clean, very well located, and there were also great neighbors. I would definitely recommend, and I hope she allows us to come back! The only thing I can recommend is having a fan for ladies like me…in their 40’s and enduring the tortures of womanhood. Lol thank you, Henna! We love your place!!

The place felt safe and clean. Everything we needed was less than a mile away, including things to do as well. We had a great time & Stephanie was a phenomenal host. We would definitely stay here again!

The only positive thing about this stay was the location. I had multiple problems with the locks, getting in the room, as well as getting locked out. The host uses an external website that requires your credit card, and everything is very badly automated. Very confusing and conflicting instructions. I contacted them about the issues, and there was simply no response whatsoever. Unlike all hosts, they do not answer the phone. The bed is awful, as many reviews said, it sinks in the middle, I felt my back the next day. The house has clutter on every direction that you look. Shower curtain was disgustingly stained, and the shower is just decades old.
Really great. Very enjoyable.

This property was homey and met all of our needs for our stay. The only down side was the skybar/rooftop was closed for renovations and would’ve enjoyed seeing the city from that view. This place was cleanly, walking distance to EVERYTHING, and easy to access as well courteous staff.

Great location, easy to park with the permit stickers provided. We arrived a half hour early after driving all day and Ari very kindly reset the locks to let us in. Clean, comfortable, quiet. Would definitely stay again.
Great place!

My boyfriend and I stayed here with our two dogs for one night. Very nice hotel and bar.
The room we chose was very small for two people and two dogs though - had I known I would’ve definitely upgraded but there are no square footage descriptions on the listing that I saw. Tricky finding a place to let the dogs out, no patches of grass in the area and any garbages are kinda far away from the building.
Aside from that, the staff were all incredible and we had a great stay here, highly recommend!

Wonderful location and beautiful details! The flat was stylish and the beds were very comfortable! The coffee maker, dishwasher and washer&dryer made our stay nice and comfortable. We enjoyed walking around the neighborhood, which was so pretty, and visiting nearby Wicker Park and walking trails. The host is welcoming and kind. Overall, a great location for exploring Chicago and a great experience!

We had a great stay at Jonathan's place!!! Everything was what we expected, the area felt extremely safe, and best of all it was a <5 minute walk to the brown line train making all of the city extremely accessible!! Simple and easy! Thank you!
Great place to stay. Stayed for a concert at Wrigley field and would book again. Also 100% recommendation to others.

Great location! Glad I booked it because it made me explore outside of the touristy loop. Lots of good restaurants and very walkable to the rail line. I’d come home around 9/10pm at night and felt safe. Loved it.
The apartment was very clean and exactly what we expected. We appreciated that the AC was on when we arrived as it was 90 degrees outside. We would definitely stay there again.
Great stay! Very walkable location! Had everything we needed.
Great host!  Clean and as advertised.  Perfect Wrigleyville stay for a quick trip for four. Thanks!
The house was exactly as described, it was very good, blad was very helpful if I ever had any questions and very responsive, would definitely recommend

Had a great stay! Very spacious and well maintained. The neighborhood is very quiet. I did notice that there was some hair on the sheets, but otherwise clean. The walk to the blue line was slightly long (17 min) but overall happy with the location.

We were a group of 14, ages 5-69, and having a place for all of us was great. Overall, the place was as advertised. There were a few issues that we notified the owners about and I believe they will take care of them as soon as possible. Chicago had both a heat wave and a bad AQI spell, so I had the A/C running (which can be a bit loud), but earplugs at night allowed me to sleep well. They also had an air purifier, which was great foresight. Bike/scooter share easy to access and for birders, a family of cooper hawks right in the neighborhood! Would absolutely stay again.

The location is good. The apartment is spacious. The towels and shower curtain were stained and there were 5 towels and no wash cloths provided for 6 adults. We let the owners know and were asked to try to locate the towels in other spaces in the apartment. The suggested spaces did not have towels and the owners eventually gave us a code to a closet to get clean towels. We did find towels and a few washcloths in that closet, so that was nice. There was hair in the bed where my husband and I slept left from a previous guest and hair in one of the bathrooms. The dining room table was dirty when we arrived, and only one burner worked on the stove. I let the owners know of those two issues and neither were acknowledged. The air filter on the AC unit in one room was so dirty that it created a loud noise that prevented sleep. We cleaned the filter ourselves. Outdoor area littered, furniture dirty and in disarray. Overall, would not recommend staying here.

Ewa is a fantastic host and her apartment is just as fantastic.
Well appointed place above a cool art gallery. The high ceilings make the place feel bigger than it is and Ewa is always available in case you need anything.
Great value as well, would stay again!
房间很大，洗漱用品提供完整，干净度有待加强，总的来说，性价比高
Dzīvoklis ir ļoti laba rajonā netāluno mičiganas ezera.

Cool little place on Southside. It is close to many things including local cuisine and the new Presidential Center which is beautiful but book your tickets way ahead of time. Helen is very hospitable and quick to respond.
Cute space. Small but perfect for days out in the city and a quiet refuge at the end of the day.
What a sweet location and place. Great and responsive host. Will be back.

The place was much larger in person than in pictures. Living room furniture chairs not comfortable. No snacks whatsoever unless you count spices. Coffee pods were provided but no creamer, bring powdered if you require some. Just a couple of towels provided and shower only bathroom super tight squeeze. Face towels/wash clothes were a little gross. One was dirty and the others ehh. No access to the beach that is listed as own beach. Maybe if you made friends w neighbors and they let you in from their access. Very nice washer and dryer. Unit is extremely roomy. Isa was very fast at responding and the bed was very very comfortable. Tons of spices provided although we didn’t need them. No steak knives in unit but Isa offered to bring some to us. An abundance of pillows and a high chair and a pack n play if you need one.
I had a great stay at Dominique’s place! I found everything to be very clean and well taken care of! I felt very welcomed, and accounted for!

I had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described, clean, and good location. The host was incredibly responsive and check-in was a breeze. Fast Wi-Fi and access to a wash machine and dryer was an added bonus.
Highly recommended…

Let me first start with the apartment itself was very beautiful.  However, this stay just missed the mark on accommodating guest. No early check-in or late checkout. Long list of house rules for subpar accommodations. Upon arrival the description on where to locate the unit was incorrect. There was also no mention of the unit having stair access only. The unit was not properly cleaned. We could not fully use the furniture due to previous damage. The bedrooms do not have TVs.  There were no cleaning supplies to help maintain the unit if needed. I had 2 other ppl with me for almost a week and we could only use one shower. The whole experience of an Airbnb is to have special amenities and home like atmosphere with privacy. This did not achieve that goal.
I really liked staying here. Edwin was very responsive and accommodating my last minute reservation!
Amazing location.  A great place to stay.
Great place. Very close to blue line subway. Highly recommend it
Great property in Old Town Chicago with easy access to restaurants, shopping and the L.
Way better than expected, great time.

Nice inside and good location in Pilsen. We liked the neighborhood. Just 2 blocks from the metro. Some of the bedrooms didn’t have blinds so a lot of street light comes in. We were a family of six and found the kitchen didn’t have enough supplies for a full house. The AC had a hard time keeping up during the heat of the summer. Responsive hosts overall.
Nice place

Wonderful location in a residential area.  My teen girls loved the coffee shop across the street and we felt it was plenty safe for them to get their own by themselves.  The parking was super close and the spaces are next to each other, but not parallel.  We parked our car and just Uber’d around.  Within walking distance of many restaurants.  Our last day they were setting up for a small River North tasting festival on the street. CVS is diagonal and Target is fairly close too.  Thanks for a great stay.

Nous avons adoré notre séjour chez Paula. L’appartement était très bien localisé, à quelques minutes à pieds de commerces et de la gare de train. L’appartement était parfaitement équipé et très agréable et tranquille. Nous y séjournerions encore sans hésiter.

Russell’s apartment was perfect for our couple’s getaway. We were originally going to stay on the riverwalk, and changed our plans last minute. We were right by the CTA green line which made getting into the city, and scheduling plans, very easy and the change was definitely worth the money we saved.
Russell’s check-in instructions made arrival a breeze after a nearly 12-hour drive, which was greatly appreciated.
For a comfortable stay outside the busy downtown area, this is definitely worth checking out.
My stay was good. And the host was good and so is her hospitality. I recommend
Great stay very close to beach!

Wonderful stay here while we visited for a concert at Wrigley and a few days of fun! The location was fantastic and check-in was seamless. Arlene’s instructions for accessing the property were clear and easy to follow. She was also thoughtful enough to provide extra concert information!
The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. It had everything we needed for a relaxing getaway. We'd absolutely stay here again and would happily recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

I regularly visit Chicago and of all the airbnbs I’ve stayed at this one is easily one of the best! The whole is beautifully remodeled and set up with all the amenities to feel right at home. The free onsite parking was a much appreciated perk!

El anfitrión siempre respondió todo rápido, la casa está impecable y en excelente estado, tanto los espacios comunes como la habitación están perfectos para una estadía corta. Mi único inconveniente fue que en el camino desde el tren hasta la casa había mucha gente drogada en la calle y se sentía inseguro pasar por la noche. No ocurrió nada inseguro pero se sentía feo pasar por ahí
Very easy check-in, good walking distance to anything you need, clean. Overall a great stay.
had a great stay. would recommend
Wonderful place, great location! We will definitly stay again.

This is a wonderful place and the hosts were excellent.  The place is clean and well appointed with everything you need.   Beds are comfortable... location is quiet and convenient.  The hosts go out of their way to make sure you're taken care of...

Great stay for our family! We were in town for volleyball in Hoffman Estates and also wanted to explore the city, the location was great for driving to the NOW Arena and also was able to easily access public transportation to downtown.
We would walk 0.5 miles to catch the blue line at Western, or a bus stop was at the end of the street. We always felt safe walking in the morning/daytime. Our family enjoys using city public transportation when we travel as much as we can. We were less confident at night, and had an experience on the train (it was after midnight, coming back from a concert at Wrigley) that made us reconsider using the train at that hour. We chose an Uber to bring us back the other two nights we were downtown that late. It was only $10-15 for the Uber. It was great to use the transit during the day and then Uber back when we were tired and had shopping bags.
The apartment was comfortable & had everything we needed. Traveling with 2 teens, we all appreciated the space!

This place is extremely close to some great eating establishments and couldn’t be any closer to the university campus . In July it is a very quiet neighborhood   .  The apartment was even more spacious than imagined. It had plenty of seating- settees chairs and pillows.  There is only one full size bed so take note. The other two bedrooms have one twin and two twins respectively.
Location is close to downtown and other attractions like the Obama Presidential Center. Location may be deceiving with first impressions, but it turned out to be a safe neighborhood.

Stay was lovely the apartment was cute and modern inside and CLEAN! There was 1 cosmetic issue but it had nothing to do with the host just the building itself check in was smooth and easy there is no designated parking but it’s fairly easy to find free street parking which I was grateful for all around I would stay again when visiting!

The parking was next to the garbage which was annoying since it wasn’t picked up until 3rd day of the trip. I will suggest James to change toilet seats esp the one upstairs because it is not in good shape.

This place is perfect if you’re traveling along for a few nights to Chicago; close to the train lines and to a lot of bars and wrigley field. I would definitely repeat this place since is super convenient. The apartment was what I expected because of how well is described and the photos. You’re definitely getting what you’re paying

This was such a convenient location. So close to so much and within walking distance to many shops and restaurants. But it was also on a quiet street so it was peaceful. I would stay here again and Matthew was a wonderful host!!!

Definitely a gem!  My family and I enjoyed our stay at this property. Host was very responsive and helpful!  We felt right at home! Everything was great and they left a sweet thank you note welcoming us!
Great location walkable to a lot of places. Really got to experience the area. The parking passes were a helpful bonus.
Great if you want to stay close to Wrigley. We were attending a concert at the stadium and it was an easy 25-30 min walk. Very quiet and safe area.
Host was quick to respond and gave great detail about the parking situation. Place was exactly as described and was close enough to transit.
Irma was great(: super friendly, super responsive. I recommend this place
This was a great stay in Chicago!
Très bien ! Spacieux ! Communication excellente ! Je recommande !

I highly recommend visiting the cozy place. My son and I enjoyed it immensely. There are lots of local places for drinks and food.
Great job

The great: clear check in instructions, a beautiful clean apartment, easy street parking, right by the train, and easily walkable to lots of amazing spots.
The not as great: the electrical is definitely older and we were unable to use the AC unit in the living room the entire time, as it made the electrical flicker. We sent a lot of back and forth messages, but the hosts said they were unable to FaceTime or call to walk me through as they sent me on a wild goose chase to find the breaker box. Eventually they suggested I flip the switch for a box that was clearly labeled with a different apartment number which we didn’t feel comfortable doing so we just unplugged the AC and avoided the living room during the daytime.
Regardless of whether anything was plugged into the restroom outlet, those lights flickered constantly too.
Also, the bedroom light turned on in the middle of the night on our first night. Kind of spooky but just added to our struggle with the electricity.
My mom didn't even want to leave the house!  This house will definitely be a first option for my next Chicago stay.

Matt was an amazing host!
The house exceeded our expectations and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, including a crib for our toddler. The kids especially loved the outdoor space, and we enjoyed relaxing in the hot tub, which was great because we could adjust the temperature for the summer.
The location was perfect—close to all the attractions we wanted to visit, making it easy to get around. Matt was always quick to respond and incredibly accommodating whenever we had questions or needed anything.
We traveled as two families, and having each bedroom with its own private bathroom was a huge bonus that made our stay even more comfortable. The home was clean, spacious, well-equipped, and truly felt like a home away from home.
We had a wonderful experience and will definitely be booking with Matt again on our next trip. Highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable, family-friendly place to stay!

We had a great stay! The house is updated and comfortable, and the hosts were very helpful and responsive. It is right on the corner of a busy street, which wasn’t a problem for us, but just something to note. There are lots of good options within short walking distance for restaurants, stores, and access to the train.

Maison Winona is the most generously outfitted Airbnb I have experienced - perfection! It is as though a good friend made sure all your possible comforts and needs would be satisfied. The attention to details were surpassed and so appreciated!
We enjoyed returning home after a day out and about - as well as staying in chatting at the dining room table. We will return next season!

Indira’s place was great - a very cold apartment on some very hot days. The walk to the blue line was about 10 minutes, which we could take into the loop and back to the airport easily. The bus stop is also closeby taking us into and out of each of the locations we visited. Indira had coffee, tea, and sugar. We didn’t have to pack shampoo, conditioner, or body wash, and there were ample towels. The back deck is private and the beds were very comfortable! There were extra blankets under the stairs, and she left a nice welcome picture on her whiteboard when we arrived. A great place to stay!!
The loft is a beautiful space with amazing natural light.  Perfect, quiet location in Logan Square.  Samantha was very responsive and helpful.

El espacio es muy bonito!
Es amplio y muy organizado

Valori's AirBnb was our choice for a three night stay. We were looking for a location near the Salt Shed and we felt this would be the best choice. The Westown neighborhood is full of restaurants, shops, and the fantastic Westown Bakery all within a couple of blocks of easy walking. We used Uber to go into and out of the loop with our vehicle safely locked up in Valori's garage. As it was extremely hot I can report that the Air Conditioning works very well and we were able to cool off day or night. Good shower pressure and lots of very hot water.
Two things we did not care for: Noise and Aged Furnishings. Like many Airbnbs it had a variety of furniture that felt worn out. The bedding felt 100 thread count, the pillows were bricks, and the couch felt like burlap. The A/C was very loud plus unusual noises intermittently. Finally, there were children above us. There was so much running, clomping, and falling. I'm not blaming them. Kids do as Kids do. Just be aware if you stay here.

Tims spot was perfect for the concert that my friend and I went to at Wrigley field. Super walkable and nice area, the only downside is the train is RIGHT behind the Airbnb, but it didn’t bother me while I slept so it was no big deal. Very convenient how close the walk was to the train! The space was very nice and even with all of the rooms being used, we had no issues with common areas/bathroom in the space. Would 100% recommend this to friends and would love to stay again in the future!
I enjoyed my stay in this cozy little apartment. Also love all the fairy and frog decor, very cheerful!

We had a wonderful stay during our three-day trip to Chicago! The Airbnb was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. It had everything we needed to feel at home, and the location made it easy to explore the city and enjoy everything Chicago has to offer.
The host was friendly, responsive, and provided clear check-in instructions, making the entire experience smooth from start to finish. We truly enjoyed our stay and would absolutely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago. We’d be happy to stay here again on a future trip!

Beautiful, nicely decorated condo filled with plants and natural light in one of my favorite neighborhoods in Chicago. The condo looks exactly like the photos and was such a comfortable and relaxing place to stay. Vinithra is an excellent host and her instructions are detailed and clear, which made checking in and staying there a breeze. The neighborhood is very walkable and safe, including at night, and has great restaurants, shops, bakeries, coffee shops, beautiful churches, cool architecture, and two Ukrainian museums. Access to public transit is easy, with plenty of bus routes and quick transfers to the L. I bought a 7-day CTA pass and just walked and took transit everywhere.  I've been to Chicago quite a few times and this time was the best by far. Highly recommend this place and hope to stay there again soon!
The place really felt like a home away from home. This was our first trip and it felt like we really belonged there
Loved the place and location is great for downtown. Very accessible and great place with kids

We had the most wonderful stay at Avra West Loop (#1712)! The apartment itself was stunning and modern—we absolutely loved the floor-to-ceiling windows, beautiful quartz countertops, and the convenience of having in-unit laundry. What truly made our stay special, though, was the incredible front desk team. They took such great care of us from the moment we arrived, bringing a genuine warmth and thoughtfulness to our entire trip.
