Between the amazing hospitality, the great fitness center, and the co-working spaces, we felt completely spoiled. It truly felt like a luxury home away from home!

Place matches photos, peaceful neighborhood.
Couple local bakeries and supermarkets near by
Amazing Chicago weekend gateway, felt right at home easy to find, and questions or concerns we had Ozlem and her team answered fast and clear, round recommend

Stayed in this Airbnb with my two teenage sons, sister and brother in law, and their 2 kids. Was able to have a bedroom for everyone but the littles who slept on the sofa. And 4 full bathrooms! Swoon. Literally a block from the train. We took the train from the airport and it was super easy. We used it to get all over downtown. Cheap and simple. Walk to Jeni’s ice cream for a sweet treat.

The property was as described and spotless. The apartment is in a quiet neighborhood with easy access to the Blue line. The host was friendly, responsive and kind. I would recommend this space and host to anyone visiting the area.
Great place and host. Close to Downtown Chicago. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay, thanks Lily and Wing!
Easy stay!

We loved our stay in Chicago! The air conditioning was a lifesaver during a heatwave. We loved the location and all of the delicious food nearby. It was also very conveniently near public transportation, and Charlotte has a big binder full of the local spots to explore. We would happily come back!

Came to Chicago for Noah Kahan concert - couldn’t have asked for a nicer condo with parking and excellent location that allowed my girls to walk easily to Wrigley Field and for me to also enjoy the music from the amazing rooftop fire pit area!  Condo was nicely appointed and had everything one might need - owners were quick to respond to any questions - will definitely recommend or plan a return trip when visiting Chicago in the future!
It's a great spot for a short weekends stay.  Close to most any activity that you would want to do.
place was great we had a cozy night ! clean spot it is a little hot at first but ac works perfectly fine you just have to turn it on but great place overall !

Property was refurbished with a nice touch. I love seeing these older buildings get a new lease on life!
Access to 290 to get to downtown was convenient. Don't be scared of the proximity to 290 as far as noise. Although you can hear traffic from the front of the building, the bedrooms are in the back and plenty quiet.
Brittney was an attentive and easy to work with host. While the area is a little on the rough side, we always felt safe and on street parking was always available. Our stay was to see a show at the United Center and that was cheap and easy to catch an Uber from our location. The train and bus are close by as well.
A casa é excelente! Muito confortável e organizada. Sadie é uma pessoa muito atenciosa. A casa fica em um bairro tranquilo e agradável de Chicago. Recomendo fortemente.

Clean place. Safe neighborhood. We walked around at night with no issues. About a ten minute walk to the Addison Blue Line station. Convenient to travel to the airport and downtown. Restaurant options within walking distance nearby.  We would stay here again.

The apartment was very nice, clean, and equipped with anything you may need for a short-term visit. The location is very good, especially if you want to be close to UChicago. There was plenty of parking on the street. The building is old but the apartment is pretty well maintained. If you are a light sleeper the noise of the AC can be a bit of a problem, but I appreciate they provided earplugs.

Be careful booking here, it’s likely a scam. They took my money and I’m still waiting for Airbnb to refund me. I arrived at this place around 7pm, the host was unresponsive (to myself and Airbnb support) and the instructions to get in were not right at all. It said use keypad but there was a regular lock and the neighbors said no one stayed there.
Muy buena ubicación del lugar
Love the neighborhood! Lots of great places to eat within walking distance and right on the bus line. Apartment was cute and clean. We will certainly be back!!

Great location. The house was very bare bones. Only 6 coat hangers in the whole place. Bed sheets felt cheap. No full length mirror which made getting ready very difficult. His response time took a few hours.

The place was fine. Bathroom was clean, there was some trash in the kitchen bin, and I didn't have a lock on my door. All told, the experience netted out to feeling like a slightly upscale hostel. Thanks.

We had such a nice stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location with excellent public transport. The area was lovely, and the host was so kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout. We would definitely stay here again and would recommend.

Hosts respond within a few minutes and are very helpful. They accommodated requests for early drop off of bags. The property is part of a UIC dorm, so it is not luxe, but spacious and utilitarian. Each of us 4 had our own room and bathroom. Rail system to O’Hare is very close by. The price can’t be beat—it was 1/3 the nightly rate of the hotel hosting a conference we attended. Very good choice for business travelers on their own dime.
Great unit, perfect location.
Was a nice place, met the neighbor and he was cool.  Enjoyed my stay
The apartment was very clean and it is in a great location! It is convenient to several stores, restaurants, buses and the L on Diversey.
It’s a beautiful place in a great location. I love the fact that it’s next to the park where we could let our dogs play and that it’s close to the metro center.

Thanks a lot for the great stay.
The communication was great and very fast.
When questions came up, they have been answered quickly.
I surely would book the property again the next time I am in Chicago.

I liked it very much and we felt very comfortable during our stay. The neighborhood seemed very quiet, and there were convenient places nearby for shopping and sightseeing.
The only thing I found somewhat inconvenient about the area was the parking situation. Finding a place to park the car was quite difficult and inconvenient, as we often had to leave it three blocks away from the building. After spending the day exploring and walking around the city, the walk back became quite exhausting.

Vraj's place was great! Amazing location in the heart of the city, walkable to many great restaurants and things to do. The apartment was very big and clean and we had a wonderful stay. Vraj was very responsive and helpful throughout the trip.

There were a lot of pros to this stay! The neighborhood is awesome, lots of fun things to do and good restaurants and a 10-15 minute walk to the pink line made getting around super easy. I loved the decor of the apartment, lots of good lighting and mirrors, very fun for pictures.
We stayed here during a heatwave and couldn’t get the AC above 75, which was a little miserable after being out in the heat for hours everyday.
The kitchen was fully equipped, and there was extra blankets and an iron that we enjoyed, but we couldn’t find extra toilet paper, which was problematic late at night.
There is only one TV in the living room and the channels are very bad with the most basics cable and no access to streaming, not the point of our stay, but a little lame while we were getting ready or had down time at night.
We had one incident where someone was pounding on the building door (right outside our door) and knocking on our window which was weird, and the neighbors upstairs were loud
Great place to stay for a couple of nights. Great distance to be close enough to everything.

We enjoyed staying at this air bnb! We liked that it was out of the city and a little more quiet. It was easy to get to and from downtown from this location too! Overall we loved the area and the house!
Lovely space, clean and comfortable! Very responsive and accommodating for storing our bags when we arrived early. Easy street parking and clear instructions. Would absolutely stay again!

This is a fantastic apartment in the heart of Chicago. I have spent a lot of time in Chicago for my job, and this is by far the best place I have ever stayed. Wonderful restaurants and cafes right on the block, great views of the city, and walking distance to some of Chicago's best attractions. it was extremely comfortable and overall a great place to stay. Highly recommended!
Nice place to stay

This is a great option if you're looking for a simple and good value room just south of the center. Two kitchens and two bathrooms are shared. For groceries, a Trader Joe's is just one Metro stop away on Roosevelt. The Orange Line Halsted station is an easy walk for downtown and Midway. Bus stops are nearby too.
Great location!

Brad’s place is immaculate! The pictures don’t do it justice. It’s looks like a beautiful museum. It was nice and clean and we felt right at home. We loved it! Brad was very responsive to any questions or anything concerning the place. We also loved the area, the neighborhood is very quiet, walkable, safe, and beautiful.

We had the best time staying here for our Chicago vacation! Great coffee and restaurants within a 5 minute walk, plus easy access to the Green and Red lines to adventure further. Even with the lines being so close there was NO related noise in the apartment, which was really nice. I also appreciated that the building itself also had a security code, in addition to the apartment. Communication was stellar, and we were able to request last-minute single-day parking for a friend coming in to visit for a night. Just overall very communicative and accommodating. 10/10 would stay here again!
Super clean and beautiful. I love that it was like a coach house and had parking. We love to host with them again.

My wife and I, and another couple stayed at this wonderful home for a few nights. Matt has done amazing job with the furnishings, decor, and artwork. He was proactive with the communication throughout our stay and responsive to all our questions. The neighborhood was so peaceful and incredibly safe (many indicators of that).
Fun pubs and restaurants nearby and just a short walk to the train stop.
I highly recommend this rental of you’re in the Chicago area. Thank you Matt for a wonderful stay.
Good place to stay for small budget, close to subway and most of the tourist attractions as well. One thing to consider could be the cleanness.

Great stay! Easy access to the city - either drive or train. Nice building - Secure and new.
Jay was very responsive.
We absolutely loved our stay here! Very clean and close to downtown. Will definitely be coming back and recommending this home. Thank you for having us!
Home was nice and well equipped. Neighborhood seems to be somewhat under renovation.

Me and my son had a great time 😀.
The neighbourhood is safe, it has a supermarket and a fast food chain.
The bus stop is two minutes away from the building. There is also a metra stop (21st if you travel with the train you should go on the first and second carriage).
Recommend it to families with children and older people.
Marla’s place was great. So comfy, great location. Marla and James were very helpful and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay here again.

We had a great stay at Stephanie's place. Walkable to the river walk, lake, Grant/Millennium park, theaters, and multiple public transportation stops. The kitchen was well-equipped. The rooftop area is fun -- we had multiple meals up there and took a dip in the pool. The gym had plenty of free weights and equipment to keep up on the exercise routine. We enjoyed the urban vibe of the place and watching the "L" roll past.
Another great week of stay at Mikael's place! Timely communications and responses to our need. Walking distance to UChicago, local restaurant and Trader Joe's. We will be back soon!

This place was a great stay! It was very spacious and easily fit all 4 of our guests. Very walkable with lots of restaurants/things to do. It was also very easy to use public transport as it was right around the corner.

Very nice apartment and super helpful host. Only issue was the power went almost every time we’d plug in a device / turn on the tv. But easy to fix.
All in all, definitely would recommend
Adorable loft in a great location.

Great stay.  The location is ideal. 11-minute walk to Wrigley Field.  Good restaurants close by.  Paul was quick to respond to any questions I had.  The room is a good size for a couple or a small family with using the sofa bed.  There were plenty of towels in the bathroom and blankets/sheets for the sofa bed.  I appreciated the fan in the closet.  One thing to note, this is the garden room of a walk up and the family lives upstairs.  You will hear them walking around.  We were prepared for this and had a sound machine so it was not an issue for us.
The place is very clean and close to city. We had a very comfortable stay.

What an unforgettable stay! Amy's home is a perfect example of a beautifully restored vintage home and it (along with her) added so much whimsy to our stay in Chicago! Highly recommend this stay to guarantee a relaxing and adventurous time. Thank you Amy!!

This Home was an amazing beautiful place for us to stay , Great & friendly neighbors. Felt really comfortable and had everything we needed, it was also really clean and incredibly well organized No regrets choosing Julios Home. Thank you so much!
Very convenient location and quiet apartment.
Have stayed here multiple times, each time is perfect.
The location was perfect. Most things were walkable. Grocery shopping and coffee shops were convenient and walkable. City sites were convenient. Highly recommend this location- felt very safe.

The place was great! It was a great base during our Chicago trip as it was close to transportation and many of the places we planned on visiting in Logan Square. Couldn’t be thankful for the AC enough during those hot days. Highly Recommend!
Loved the neighborhood and was a great fit for my stay!
A very comfortable stay in a great location! David is an excellent host and his place is decorated with care and intention. Highly recommend -- would happily stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay for the most part, but there were a few downsides. The building was a bit older than I realized, which wasn’t bad, but it could definitely use some touch ups and TLC. You can tell that there were lazy paint jobs done in the past, and there were many loose ceiling accessories (lights, shower pipe, and vents separating from the ceiling / wall). It definitely has character though, feels homey. Unfortunately, I don’t think the cleaning crew paid close attention to detail before our stay. The kitchen utensils near the sink were dusty, and the trash can had remnants of a spilled liquid on the top. In the bathroom, there were a few dusty surfaces that hadn’t been cleaned. The shower didn’t drain well (I ended up standing in a pool of water), the water pressure was low, the temperature knobs were a bit difficult to figure out, and the inner plastic curtain had a section full of dead skin / dirt /etc. Despite this, Nikka was proactive in checking on us during the visit.

Place was decent for the short visit, close to Logan square , spacious room,. Place is good for short stays. Locks on outside and inside of the door.
My only complaint is the cleaner doesn’t clean common spaces so if your sharing space with an unclean person ( as I was) you’re expected to clean it before you leave. Which I thought was weird, but if you need something quick n convenient this place works.
Great hosts, house, and location! Definitely would stay here again.
Perfect location, so much to do and see. Unique stay and great host!
A estadia foi boa, um pouco na demora de resposta.

It's a great little garden apartment in the heart of Bridgeport and close to downtown. It's in a quiet safe, neighborhood and close to numerous & varied restaurants.
Walkable to the "L" & many other public transportation options.
I would stay there again - recommended!
Great stay lovely home !
We loved our stay at Alba’s- close to the train station & nice restaurants nearby!
Mary and Andrew were great hosts! They were extremely responsive. The place was very clean and such a good location!

Abacus’s place was amazing. Any questions I asked were responded to right away. The place was spotless when we arrived. The area was only a few miles away from all activities we planned. Toiletries were stocked and I could continue but there’s no need. I would most definitely stay here again!

This was a fantastic stay from start to finish. The home was beautifully designed, and exactly as pictured. It was peaceful, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Communication with the host was excellent, and the entire experience was seamless. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a wonderful place to stay.

From start to finish this was seamless experience. Wendy and Matt were very responsive. Their place was clean and had plenty of space. We were in the perfect location, and the train was extremely easy to use. Thank you for a wonderful and clean place to relax after a long hot day of exploring! If we ever come back to Chicago, we would definitely stay here again!

Cute place in the heart of a beautiful neighborhood. Karen’s was very accommodating and responsive. In terms of accessibility, it wasn’t the easiest but that was already written in the listing. The beds were comfortable and she provides a lot of pillows.
Geo was very responsive to all my questions and concerns which made the process of my stay really smooth

Brad was a great communicator, and kept me updated on an A/C repair that was happening the day of our arrival. The location was within walking distance to the United Center, which was helpful for the concert that my family was attending.

A very cozy apartment! Was around a lot
Of walkable places. The host was responsive and helpful when needed. Would recommend!
100% recommended 😉👍

We had a really great stay. Josh was very responsive and we had little to no issues. The location for Wrigley was the best! To walk in and walk out was awesome. We even bought merch from our event and walked back to the condo to not have to carry everything around.
The decoration for Cubs was cool.
We did feel the condo needed a few general repairs that were somewhat uncomfortable. The shower and toilet wiggling around gave us the feeling that with the slightest wrong move we were going to do some major damage. We wish those two things were a bit more sturdy.
Overall a great stay.

The location was great. The space was clean and comfortable. We didn’t receive towels until after midnight, so I’d definitely recommend packing your own. I was looking forward to relaxing on the rooftop but it wasn’t accessible. Those are my only negatives.

Very disappointing stay. We specifically booked this property for the outdoor pool, only to find out after arrival that it was closed. We were never notified, which would have allowed us to make a different booking. When we contacted the host, initially they were unwilling to provide any compensation. It took extensive back-and-forth with both the host and Airbnb before any resolution was offered. The situation became even more uncomfortable when someone who was not listed or pictured as the host arrived at the unit around 10:15 pm, knocking on our door and wanting to come inside to discuss the issue. The person did not match the name listed as host or in the messaging. The check-in instructions specifically told us not to speak with the front desk or mention Airbnb which had us feeling uneasy. There were several other issues that were amplified by the handling of the missing amenity and we spent far too much of our vacation time dealing with communication for an acceptable resolution.

This Airbnb was in a great location and easy to get around. So much to do and family friendly. The Alis was a great host and had great communication would love to stay again and recommend anyone to stay.
Great amenities within the building.  Easy check in.  Space was clean and updated.  Perfect location.  Will definitely stay again!
Great place.  Clean and comfortable.  AC went out at the beginning of my stay, but the owner quickly brought in a portable unit to keep the place cool.

Location, location, location! Claude’s place, right in the middle of the loop, was convenient to most Chicago waterfront attractions and steps from the L train. Our trip was maximized by the walkability and ease of transportation to the Chicago area. The apartment itself was clean, stocked thoughtfully, and had everything we needed. We highly recommend!

I had a great time staying here! The location was a little ways from downtown so it offers a different experience! There’s a lot of good restaurants within walking distance. And the street overall is pretty quiet so it was peaceful in the evenings. Everything was so clean and the hosts were both very responsive!

It is centrally located and just a few minutes walk to the M Blue Line which will bring you from/to O'hare. Building is secure, in a good neighborhood and fairly quiet. Desk staff was super helpful. The unit was exactly as described. Moreover, it was clean and well apportioned. Would definitely stay there, again.
Thank you!
Such an awesome Location. I loved waking to the zoo and the lake. Wonderful stay.
Very helpful and attentive hosts. Great location.

Beautiful place to stay for vacation, Close to everything. Take her suggestion on renting her garage for your time there, very busy area with very limited parking on street. Diane response very quickly when you reach out for a question or concern. I would definitely save this place for another visit to the big city.

Beautiful charming home with personal touches. Comfortable stay and Mickey provided thoughtful amenities throughout. I love an Airbnb that feels like the hosts really care! Great communication, lovely neighborhood.
Great place, easy 3 minute walk to the train station. We came in the middle of a heat wave and the AC definitely held up!

My husband and I had a great time at Alma’s place! We were here for the week visiting Chicago and it was the perfect location…just far enough away from the hustle and bustle but within walking distance of many amenities…we also loved being able to bring our pup Henry!
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had super cute dog decor all throughout which we especially appreciated as dog lovers ourselves.
Any question that arose Alma responded right away with a solution which made us feel safe and taken care of!
Would absolutely stay here again next time we visit Chicago :)
The location was convenient and the apartment was very clean and comfortable.  We’d definitely choose this space again on a return trip!

I rented this space for my mother who is 73 years old and whom needed an easily accessible apartment due to needing a knee replacement. This was also her first Chicago experience. She loved the apartment, it was beautiful and updated but still kept the love for the beautiful
Chicago architecture. I live in Roger’s Park and needed a wonderful place close by, this apartment met all our needs plus parking was EASY!
Very close and walkable distance to Bean, Riverwalk and good restaurants.

With only a 10-minute walk to the blue line, this place is in a great location with quick access to downtown. Free parking in the street which has security cameras was also very convenient.
Although the place has several rooms, other guests were discreet same as us, so there were no noise complaints. The place was also very clean and the kitchen equipment more than enough. Definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to visit Chicago.

We enjoyed our stay. Met two very friendly neighbors. The beds and pillows and linens were excellent promoting restful sleep. The only disappointment was the Roku control. I’m good with the Fire, DIRECTV amd other remotes but not Roku. The volume control remains a mystery.

Absolutely homey feel staying at your home in Chinatown. I love the cleanliness and preparedness of essential toiletries you had readily available. If I could give feedback I’d say, replace the shower nozzle. The shower pressure is low and unable to change the pressure. Thank you for welcome me in your home. Until next time!

Great spot in a great neighborhood! Nat suggested some parking spots and we were able to park our car and leave it for the few days we were there. It was easy and close to lots of things to do and the train station was also nearby to get into downtown (only about a 10 minute train ride!).

The description was spot on. Knew what to expect when arriving and communication with host was amazing. Great budget friendly location. Loved how close it was to the pink line. Overall enjoyed our stay.
Good location with lots of shops, restaurants and activities in the area. The Airbnb was clean and had everything you might need. Host is very friendly and responsive.

Great Location, Easy Checkin. You can hear the street but not nearly as bad as it would seem based on proximity to a busy street.
All in all would stay there again.
The place was perfect. Exactly what I needed for my monthly trips to Chicago. All the things you need inside, quiet neighborhood outside, and a world of restaurants around the corner.
This worked out well. Parking was clear and we walked to all the sightseeing spots.

it's a nice and clean. however we did need our additional air freshener as there were smells made by the neighboring dog 🐶, comfortable bed, safe but with a very low ceiling. if you are above 6'3 you will hit your head on the fan.
Clean and quiet.

Très bon rapport qualité prix étant donné que la Loop de Chicago est très chère. Nous avons eu accès au centre ville facilement grâce à la Pink Line. Quartier tranquille et logement neuf et propre avec un extérieur. Alec était soucieux de bien nous accueillir, nous sommes ravis des prestations offertes (cuisine, climatisation, lit confortable et volets pour dormir dans le noir). Comme à la maison !

Cheryl was very responsive to questions and was able to provide parking passes for the duration of our stay. Street parking was available for each of our three nights, however like all street parking, it is unpredictable. The neighborhood is nice and felt safe to walk around. The unit was clean and spacious and as described. Highly recommend the rental!
Very responsive host, comfortable accommodations, and cute decor.
Great location and perfect for what we were looking for. We appreciated that there was free garage parking. Studio had a good amount of space for two people.
Great Hosts! Responded quick and even helped accommodate us before we could check into the room. Clean and easy to access, plus the station next to us made transport easy. Would recommend.
Really comfortable and inviting, very peaceful neighborhood with easy access to many bus stops. Felt safe and clean

We stayed here for a couple nights to attend at concert at Wrigley and it was a great location! Easy to walk to and from the show within minutes! Even though early check in wasn’t available, the host made sure we could get the parking passes early so we could avoid concert traffic. I definitely would stay here again.

Beautiful place in a calm neighborhood. We enjoyed the comfortable beds, well-stocked kitchen and access to laundry.  There were several restaurants and markets nearby for supplies.  Neighborhood is quiet and feels very safe.  Host was very responsive to questions.

The perfect place to lay your head for a night or two, affordable, clean, secure, and if you are sociable you might stumble into good conversation with a fellow guest. I enjoyed my stay. A friendly neighborhood atmosphere just a train ride away from the heart of the city.

We really enjoyed our short stay. It was perfect for our family of four with plenty of space and was in a very convenient location. The beds were comfortable and it was quiet at night. Carly is a very nice host and we appreciated all the little details to make it a comfortable stay. We would definitely stay again!
Everything OK. It's close to restaurants and to the river it's 20 minutes to walk. the room was small but ok and very clean.  I would stay there again.
Our stay was perfect, we’re not use to a train running all day & night but it wasn’t too bad. We will be back!
Great!
Long was very helpful when I had questions. The place was very clean and nice. I will book again in the future.

Overall, I had a great stay and would happily recommend this place. The shared house was consistently clean, well maintained, and all amenities worked as expected. The air conditioning was excellent, which made a big difference during the summer. Communication with the host was quick, friendly, and helpful throughout my stay.
The location is another major advantage. It's just a short walk to the Damen Pink Line station, with about a 15 minute ride to Chicago's Loop. The Pilsen neighborhood felt safe during my stay and is majority Latino I believe.
As expected in a shared house, you can occasionally hear other guests, but it was never excessive or a problem.
The only issue I encountered was that the rear doors facing the yard were locked with an additional lock, which appeared to block what could serve as an emergency exit. I hope this is addressed, as it is the only concern I had during an otherwise excellent stay.
Thank you for hosting!
Thank you for the clean and conveniently located stay.

Fredrick’s home felt like a home away from home!
The pictures matched the property. The home was clean and had more amenities than we could think of! I would recommend this home to anyone! I will be back myself soon!

Staying at the Garden was perfect. From the moment we arrived my family felt welcomed. With a few essentials to get us stared to the relaxing atmosphere of the backyard, this was an excellent way to start our visit to our home town.  We all enjoyed the fish and the adventures of the cats. We also appreciated staying with a host who is aligned with our practices of composting and recycling. The location is excellent with restaurants, grocery stores and the cheers from Wrigley field. We look forward to visiting again. The Garden is a special place.
Decent
Our stay was great! The place had a lot of room, very clean, and was walkable to Wrigley. We also loved having a garage for our vehicles. Would definitely stay again!
A peaceful & affordable place to stay in Chicago
The unit was nice and in a very convenient location to explore the city.

Absolute nightmare stay. Unsafe, filthy, and completely unlivable. DO NOT BOOK!
We were forced to leave after just one night of a three night stay and scramble to move to a hotel. The dining room window was completely smashed open! You could literally reach your arm inside from the street. There was someone sleeping on the street next door. Without any broken glass indoors, host Edita clearly knew the window was broken prior to our arrival and rented out a compromised home anyway! Chicago was experiencing hazardous wildfire smoke with toxic AQI levels. An open hole to the outside meant dangerous air flooded the home while my young child slept.
The property also has an ant infestation. Ants were crawling thru in the living room, under the rug, behind the couch, and eventually crawling inside our luggage. There were old trash and wrappers under the furniture.
Edita showed zero accountability and blamed us for the ants. Avoid this host and property at all costs.

We love staying at Susie‘s place! We actually live in the area but needed a comfortable and convenient place to stay due to some ongoing construction at our house. We love this area. Everything is super walkable and the apartment was very beautiful and cozy.

This place was very clean, comfortable, and easy to find. It was conveniently located near restaurants, shopping, and transportation, which made getting around simple. I truly enjoyed my stay, and the host was kind, responsive, and helpful throughout my visit. Everything was spotless and ready for me upon arrival. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay.
Clean, easy to get to, right on the bus line so we didn’t need our car, cute outdoor space in back too! I would stay again!
It was a decent stay, quiet and AC works pretty well

My daughter and I stayed at David's place for the Noah Kahan concert.  His place is very conveniently located to most Wrigleyville places. It felt very safe, and all in the unit was as represented. The home is full of all one would want for a multi-day stay.  Even Keurig pods were provided.  David was regularly in contact and very responsive.  Overall,  it was one of my best stays.

The furniture is very cheaply made and not very serviceable, the kitchen has very few useful dishes . Found  a bed with items in it. Air conditioning went out on very hot day . AJ brought out box fans very quickly, but still was a very miserable night . With very little rest
Really expensive for a small space. The a/c blew warm air in one room and leaked in another.

Perfect place for our family for almost a week.  Robert was a wonderful host, very responsive and helpful in every way.  The space was sparkling clean without the smell of toxic cleaners.  Very walkable and beautiful neighborhood with plenty of wonderful restaurants and gorgeous beaches.  Easy accessibility to downtown via the L.  Quiet space and the ability to do some laundry was a plus. 10 out of 10 recommendation.  We will be back. Thank you Robert and Chad for a great time in Chicago!!!
Good

Perfect location, felt like this could be my own apartment! Has everything you need for a stay. The only thing that I would improve is that the WiFi struggled during my time there. Other than that it was awesome and even had in unit laundry

The place as clean and there was plenty of towels and pillows for us to use. The bed was a queen size and it fit fine for my Fiance and I. The bed I would say is a medium firm, it was comfortable for us. Lastly, the process to check in and out was easy and I felt safe in the neighborhood. I would stay there again.
The place was so cute and comfortable. The instructions were clear and thought out and it was in a wonderful, walkable location! Would definitely recommend and will be booking again!

Big place, good kitchen,  three bedrooms on upper floor share one full bath. There's a second full bath on main floor. The fourth bedroom is an open space in the "English Basement". There is a halfbath and laundry in addition to the theater area. All three floors have substantial temperature differences, so send the kids who like it cool downstairs and the ones who like it warmer upstairs. Street parking is manageable during the day, but challenging after neighborhood  commuters park for the evening.

Great place to stay in this neighborhood. Can easily walk to the grocery store and several nice restaurants a few blocks away. The place was great, clean, great showers. Almost felt like you were living at home with all the amenities.
Excelente opción para alojarse en Chicago! El departamento es super cómodo, tener estacionamiento es inmejorable, dejas el auto y te moves todo en transporte público. 10 puntos!
Place was clean and well kept. Very short walk to Wrigley Field and surrounding area.

Traveled to Chicago for a bachelorette trip and the place was amazing! The home had a secluded backyard for a great yoga class, lots of opportunities for great photos, and was very close to the bus stop for easy transportation!
The apartment is spacios and comfortable. The description and pictures are quite accurate. We enjoyed our stay!

The hosts and the home were perfect. The home was clean and nicely decorated. We had everything we needed. There were no issues with parking, the neighborhood was quiet and we were within a few miles of great restaurants and attractions.
Looking forward to booking again so that I can explore the city.
We were a party of four and everyone was comfortable.

We truly enjoyed our stay at Russell’s place. The home was extremely clean and felt welcoming as soon as you enter. Master bathroom is one of the nicest we’ve ever had even staying on luxury resorts! Plenty of outlets around to charge devices and phones. Plenty of clean towels to use during our stay. No serious issues during our stay.
He was very sweet and accommodating. Due to some extenuating circumstances, I was unable to finish my stay with him. But, all the interaction I had with him was wonderful.

Overall clean quiet spacious apartment with easy check in and plenty of amenities. Free parking (beware street cleanings 9am-2pm fridays) was a plus as well as a full kitchen, living room, and clean comfy bedroom. Location is close to public transportation. Would stay here again!

Location is absolutely perfect! And the spot itself is really nice and well kept. I think being an owner of a few air bnbs myself, i find it important to make the space feel like a 2nd home for the guests. The things my wife & I had a rough time with is the shower & sink, the drains are clogged super bad and its like showering in a pool and feels gross, same with the sink you cant run the water for more than 30 secs before the sink gets completely full. The bed was quite uncomfortable. And coffee is provided but no sugar. Very little easy fixes, but if all you care about is location and a beautiful home this ones for you!

Julius home was in a nice quiet street and relatively close to Logan Square. It was near the highway as well which was important for us during the weekday. The kitchen had poor quality materials for cooking though including scratched teflon pans and not much for cooking utensils. The quality of the construction, even though it seemed like it was recently rehabbed with new tile etc., was poor. We had to call for a quick fix on a metal edge profile on the shower tile work to be fixed. It was very sharp and could have been very bad if one of our kids stood up and hit it during their bath. That is the worst example of the shoddy construction. All the windows were not locked and given that its ground floor I thought that was a huge oversight. Bedrooms were good size but the metal frames could be protected on the corners more. Overall not very kid friendly if that matters. Also the massage chair is very old and worn down and doesn't work yet it's directly in front of the TV.
Preis/Leistung stimmt. Sehr gross. Sauberkeit könnte besser sein.

This was a great place to stay for a 3-day trip in Chicago. I appreciated that the space was clean, free of clutter, air-conditioned, and close to CTA stations for easy access to public transit. I did book this place hoping to utilize the kitchen more and was a bit disappointed by the lack of kitchen necessities and amenities, such as kitchen towels or extra silverware/dishes. That being said, Ping was a very responsive and helpful host and we had a very pleasant and comfortable stay!
Enjoyed the property location..so close to everything needed/wanted withiin walking distance. The decor was fabulous! The support/communications was so helpful!
Beautiful apartment. Very clean and lots of little amenities which made for a nice stay. Host was very responsive and gave clear instructions for checkin and checkout. Highly recommend.

We had a good stay, and the apartment was a great value for the price. It had everything we needed and worked well as a home base during our trip. The only reason for the 4-star rating is that it's located within a larger apartment complex, which made it a little tricky to find and navigate at first. Once we got our bearings, it was much easier. If you're looking for an affordable place to stay and don't mind a bit of navigating upon arrival, this is a solid option.
Great location! Beautiful place to stay.  Very clean! Very clear instructions for entering and leaving. Would highly recommend

Great home base near Wrigleyville. Close to the Red Line, made getting around Chicago easy. The place was spotless and exactly as described. Host was responsive and easy to communicate with the whole stay and made check-in smooth. Would definitely stay here again on a future Chicago trip.

This location was fantastic! Very walkable with great restaurants nearby!
Overall, an ourstanding Airbnb that was perfect for our family visiting Chicago for a couple days. Highly recommend.
One thing to note about the closets: There isn't a closet available in the main bedroom but there is one in the second bedroom. There was limited dresser space in the main bedroom but most of it was taken up by extra towels and linens.

I loved staying at Richard place! It was so clean and so convenient. Richard checked on to see how are things and make sure everything was good. I really appreciated it.
I’ll be visiting Chicago and definitely stay at Richard again.

Perfect location and beautiful, comfortable space. We had a lovely stay - the picture windows overlooking the street let in the best light. We actually ordered in so we could spend more time in the apartment!
Quiet, clean, and peaceful. Awesome

Bella's place has consistently been an outstanding place to stay. I've visited Chicago numerous times, and her property is the only place I choose because it always provides a comfortable, welcoming, and enjoyable experience. Bella is a wonderful host, and I highly recommend her place to anyone visiting the city. I look forward to staying here again on my future trips to Chicago.
Host was responsive. During my stay the gas cooktop wasn't working, however the host got it fixed the very same day which was lovely. House was as described. Host was very responsive to my questions.
Really enjoyed our stay here. It’s a bit far from the main city and but it’s a quick uber or bike ride to the train station.

Anny is an attentive and caring host. Instructions for check in and check out are very clear. Great location, I love that it’s near Wicker Park, one of my favorite neighborhoods in Chicago. Perfect for a short solo stay!
For this price it was a very good experience. The only problem was the bathroom which wasn’t very clean and the towels which stinked. The host was very very nice and let us leave our luggage.

Was such a great space. I was traveling with an infant and the space was big enough to put her things like bottles, and other must have baby items. It was also close to all of the fun things we wanted to do while in the city.
The home was perfect for what we needed for the week! David and Andrea were responsive and very welcoming. I’d recommend their property to anyone visiting!
Great space and host!!
Really enjoyed this spot! Pat was really easy to work with and let us know everything we needed! Worth it!
Comfortable place. Good communication. Central location. I'll stay here again.
nice stay!
Loved my stay I can’t and I won’t complain because it was a wonderful stay. Yall won’t regret it because it felt like home and it was super clean and just comfortable.
Great place to stay ! Kitchen wasn’t very equipped for cooking but other than that it was a great stay. Bathroom was really nice and updated. Bed was comfortable. Free parking.

Rob's place is a great location, and it's easy to grab transportation. There is some free parking but you have to pay close attention to the signs and move vehicle often unless you want to pay. It was July in Chicago when we were there- the AC in the bedroom worked well, however it was pretty consistently over 78-80 degrees in the common area despite keeping blinds closed and AC on as low as possible, for the price this was a big disappointment. We had a baby with us and pretty much had to keep her in the bedroom. Couple of good restaurants close by (Forbidden Root, Prequel Coffee). Very well stocked Apt. We would maybe stay here again, but not in the summer months.
Really nice place best for the buck will definitely come back

Our host, Sarah, was very sweet, proactive with her communications, and responded very quickly. When we had issues with parking (not her fault, there was some construction and street cleaning happening) she notified us very quickly, and even offered up her garage for us!
The only issue we ran into was the lack of railings on the stairs. There are two flights of stairs in the house, one as soon as you open the door, and the other to get up to the main bedroom. The first staircase doesn’t have any railings, but does have walls on both sides, which I was able to use to balance myself. The second staircase only has railings for about 2/3 of the stairs, and the angle doesn’t match the angle of the stairs, so it was taller in some places than in others. I was able to get up and down them without too much issue, but someone with more balance issues might have difficulty.
Otherwise, we had a wonderful stay! The house is clearly very well cared for! I would really recommend this Airbnb!
Good central location very private

overall had a really great stay! the host was helpful and very responsive whenever there were issues, and the place was exactly what i thought it would be. pros, great views, great location, clean, private. cons (given the price), a/c in the main space was warm, and the wifi went out on the last day of my stay. besides that, i would still highly recommend staying here, jorge was a great host overall!

This is the best Airbnb experience I have had. Everything about the place was top notch. Clean, comfy, simple, peaceful, and had what was necessary in the kitchen. The host was very communicative. Also heard back within 10 minutes. Free parking right across the street was nice bonus.
3 separate bedrooms with 3 separate bathrooms made is possible to have privacy.
The only noise was in the front bedroom by the street, but it was not even a problem.
We walked everywhere we wanted to go. L train close by.
Clean, cool, and convenient spot. Very easy check in. Close to CTA green line and red line.
Loved it! Decompressed after a complicated move that went sideways, but loved being here! Was a great escape during the hot Chicago weather and smoke.
We had a great stay.

The house was generally very nice, and Kenneth, the host, was especially understanding and helpful throughout our stay. He stayed in constant communication with us both during and after the rental process.We sincerely appreciate his support and would like to thank him.
Our stay at Joan’s place was lovely! Communication was great and the location was ideal! I would love to stay at Joan’s place whenever I’m in Chicago!

This place is great! The location is excellent for exploring all the Wicker Park has to offer, and the place is well equipped with everything you need.
The availability of paid residential parking passes was a nice bonus that made parking a vehicle hassle-free.
The hosts Lina and Fulvio were always responsive, and also provided detailed information that made it super easy to check-in/check-out. I'd definitely stay here again!
Amazing spot! Would definitely stay again. Ari was such a great host and very responsive during our entire stay. Thank you!
We loved our short time here. Beautiful home and convenient location!
Beautiful and quiet. Easy check in and check out. Great communication from hosts. Would recommend!
Amazing location, amazing host, and amazing property.  Host added extra touches that made us feel right at home and made it so easy.  Can't wait to stay again at this property.
Great stay just outside of the city!

Could definitely be better if the price reflected what you have to go through to get there and having clean bedding, clean, washcloths or washcloths in general also when you leave and come back, the thermostat is reset the stairs need new carpet or hardwood flooring the smell is horrible

Super cute place! It was easy to get to and close to all the places we wanted to visit. Instructions were clear and we did not need to contact the host during the stay. I also appreciated the booklet of recommendations and such :). I would recommend this place & host to others!

Great proximity to Wrigley!
Loved our stay-so much around to explore!
Place was clean and cool and had everything we needed.

We had a great stay! The neighborhood was wonderful, with lots of coffee shops and restaurants in walking distance. It was also very close to public transportation which made getting around without driving super easy. Parking was effortless. The apartment was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed and more! We would absolutely stay here again.
Wonderful experience, we will be back! Thank you
All the rooms and inside were great. Only questionable part was fenced yard, which needed lots of work.
My family (and dogs) had a great time and immediately felt comfortable in the home. We had a great visit and had everything we needed.

Home was as advertised, but hosts seemed to be the next door neighbors. We noticed them leaving the unit upon check-in, and laundry was still running in the dryer when we arrived. Wi-Fi range does not extend to the top floor of the unit; luckily we were not in a dead zone and our cell providers came through! Kitchen could use some basics: we were unable to find a large pan, cutting board, or wine bottle opener. Location was incredibly convenient to Wrigley and the Red Line, and the A/C was nice and strong during our visit in 95-degree heat!
Definitely a great stay!

Alex’s place was clean, quiet, and had everything we needed for a couple days in the city. We especially appreciated having a dedicated parking spot instead of having to worry about finding street parking.
Laura’s place was the perfect stag for a quick girls trip for a concert in town. She was very communicative and proactive with instructions!

Really enjoyed my stay here was very close to the train so very easy to get around. The space is very clean and big and very comfortable to go with a group of friends I’d for sure stay here again next time I’m visiting Chicago

great stay, really good location, and plenty of space for our family of 5. the parking spot was a great perk for us
would highly recommend.
Darsh was very responsive. The apt was clean and tidy! Spacious for my family and an infant! Great location close to Chicago spots! We enjoyed our stay!

Great location!!! Everything was just as described. Host is very responsive and answers all questions right away. I asked if they had a blender and he immediately ordered one to use while there. We also received donuts the day before we checked out. Parking is limited if you drive a big suv or van. We had a passenger van but host let us know where we could park,  which was within a 2 minute walk.
Die Unterkunft von Laura lässt keine Wünsche offen. Es war alles sehr stylisch und super sauber. Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt.
Very nice and beautifully decorated space.  Easy to find a parking space on the street, which is a huge benefit in the city.

This was the first time renting an AIRbnb and had a great experience. Checking in and out was seamless. The property was in pristine condition, the listing is an accurate portrayal of the property and I would visit this location again on my next visit.

We arrived after dark but were able to find a parking spot in front of Justin’s place. It was nice to have easy and free street parking. Before we arrived, Justin left us know that there was some street work being done which was greatly appreciated. Justin and Traci communicated very well with us and gave us recommendations on food and activities to do. The apartment was very clean and exactly as described.  We felt safe the entire time of our stay. It was about a 30 minute drive to downtown.  Wrigley Field was a 40 minute walk. Would stay again when traveling to Chicago.
This is a great place to use for a stay in town. It’s clean, has everything you need, is safe and as quiet as can be in a big city! It has great access to shops and food.
Beautiful home, the hosts are so welcoming and go above and beyond with their hospitality
Great place! Awesome food nearby, close to downtown.
Nos sentimos como en casa
Parking was a little tough to find but ended up finding a spot. It was fairly clean and in a good area to downtown. Check in and check out was easy.

A very nice place to spend a few days in downtown Chicago.  Check in is a bit of a challenge to unload and get inside, but likely not harder than any other situation in downtown.  The place was well equipped with all the kitchen supplies and a laundry.  Well situated on Lake and Michigan just a block from the river.

John was an excellent host!  He always responded promptly to questions and needs.  We had a few circumstances that changed our timing and John was most flexible and gracious about it! Highly recommend! Convenient, clean, well appointed, and perfectly located for our needs!

Bronzeville is wonderful. If you want to feel immersed in significant and meaningful history, a sense of deep rooted community, and a cool vibe, this is the place. Ida B. Wells lived right around the corner on the next street over.
Very walkable, we walked to the Field Museum then hopped on the water taxi to Navy Pier.
Great hosts, and everything you might need. Only wish we could’ve stayed longer. Loved it here!

Couldn’t have liked Victoria’s place more!
Convenient to public transport (and less than 15 minutes by Uber to nearly everything in the city), out of the downtown fray but still felt like you were in the city, great coffee nearby, parking was a breeze, apartment stayed cool and the included tower fan were both a huge plus for me as a notoriously hot sleeper!
As a host, Victoria was proactive, helpful, kind, and knowledgeable.
Our stay here made our time in Chicago such a joy. Couldn’t recommend it more for a small family or a couple traveling to the city.
Basic accommodations with convenient access to public transportation (both train and bus) which was perfect for my needs.  I certainly recommend for the budget conscious traveler.
Smooth as always

We had a great stay here! It was clean, nice neighborhood, and Tugba was very kind and responsive! I would just be advised that the ceilings are quite low and do dip below the listed 6’3” in some areas. The doors within the unit were sometimes hard to close but other than that, it’s a great price for a great unit!
This apartment was very clean and great for a short stay in Chicago. Along with this it was a perfect location for easy utilization of the subway!

Comfortable room and private bathroom in a house in Avondale. The house is very clean and professionally run. Pretty quiet for the most part, though some interaction with other guests. Great location <10 minute walk to the Blue Line, close to the airport. Avondale and Logan Square are great neighborhoods with tons of stuff to do. You can also take the bus to Lakeview. Great place, I would definitely stay here again.

My husband and I and another couple stayed in the lovely condo for 4 days while we were in Chicago. Love the living room, very spacious & comfortable for everyone to sit & visit in the mornings & evenings. Kitchen is well stocked and roomy. 2 bedrooms which had their own bathrooms was nice. Only comment I have, is the 2nd bedroom only has a double bed and a bit tight, but was fine.
Jose & Maria, the concierge team was very helpful & friendly. We arrived early and they stowed our bags as we grabbed some lunch.
The Walton Residence is very centrally located & would highly recomend. We were there during a heat wave & for an older building, the condo was very comfortable.

This was a beautiful home away from home. The place is beautiful, comfortable and lots of mood lighting which I loved. The AC was leaking during my stay which did not cause too much trouble other than needing to empty a pot a couple times a day and cleaning up surrounding water. Trove gave me a heads up about this and did not significantly impact my stay.
I would’ve appreciated some additional kitchen staples, like spices. Not having those made it difficult to use the kitchen to the full potential.
The apt is cozy, warm and inviting. I would absolutely book here again.
Very helpful host! Area seemed safe
Great stay here. It was very hot, but the unit was very well air conditioned, clean, and comfortable.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was exactly as described—clean, modern, spacious, and very comfortable. Everything was well maintained, and the check-in/check-out process was smooth and hassle-free. The location was convenient and made it easy to get around Chicago. Danny was a great host, responsive and helpful whenever needed. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. We’d be happy to stay here again in the future!

Excellent location in Old Town proximate to the Brown Line Sedgwick train stop (gets you both downtown and to Wrigley Field). Tucked into a semi private spot with easy access. A quiet location during our entire stay with little to no outside noise which is a rarity in the city.
On street parking is tight but that’s more of a Chicago thing in general.
Condo has a large living room and fantastic roof top deck.
Thanks Nicole and Matt for hosting us.
It’s a big place, nice and clean, it worth it
Muy buena estancia la recomiendo

Great, charming Chicago flat in an area that was easy to get to where we needed to go (Lincoln park and downtown). Huge bonus was easy FREE reserved and gated parking right next to the building. Such a rarity in the city and gave us ease and peace of mind with our Tesla rental!
The round room is super charming and right above a breakfast cafe which made mornings easy also. I will say that if you have a light sleeper in your group, don’t put them in the round room: there is traffic noise since it’s right on the corner of one of those criss-cross 3-street intersections. The other room dampened the noise significantly.
Another amenity is that Pequod’s pizza is right across the street! Open until 2am—which was fabulous for us since we got in at 11:30 pm HUNGRY. Super easy. Also air conditioning made it extra nice in the hot humid weather.

Ashley’s place was truly perfect for what we needed! My partner and I had a concert at Wrigley and were just looking for somewhere close by to sleep for the night. This stay is in an amazing walkable location near many shops and restaurants! The bed was incredibly comfortable and the room stayed very cool even though it was about 100 degrees outside. The only minor downside was due to guests in other rooms during our stay also attending the same concert, once we got back to the room after the show the shared bathroom was a little congested and we had to wait a while for our turn to use it. Other than that, this place was a true gem and I would definitely stay here again!
Had a wonderful stay and a great host!!

Manny’s place was great! It was clean, large and comfortable for 5 people, and had everything we needed! It felt very safe and peaceful/quiet. It was close to things, and a very quick drive into the city. The beach close by was so sweet. Clear water and beautiful scenery. Would book again in a heartbeat! Manny was responsive (I only needed him to reiterate something I had forgotten) and very friendly. Thank you for a memorable vacation.
The place was nice with similar vibes to a hostel and conveniently close to Wrigley Field. I wish the listing stated that there is lots of stairs to get into the apartment.
Kyriako was easy to communicate and really multitask
Sue was very helpful and accommodating during our stay. She went above and beyond to help us with any questions we had. She was very welcoming and answered any question we had. We will be back!
Location is great! Lots of major attractions close to condo. Safe place for families with young kids. Kitchen could be better stocked with basics like salt and pepper. very attentive management team.
We enjoyed our stay.

We are so happy we booked this house for our Chicago visit to attend a concert in Wrigley Field.! The location was perfect, the house was beautiful and comfortable on a beautiful street. It was central to be able to go downtown and to Lakeview. Near great food. Comfortable beds and luxury bedding. The hosts were attentive right away, and even brought over a brand new fan, when we asked if there was one available. It should get more than five stars!
Everything was easy and smooth. It was a quick stay for me. I was out most of the time. If you’re looking for somewhere to sleep at a great price. This is it.
Coty was very accommodating and allowed me to check in a little early. The hosts were both very responsive and friendly. The apartment was extremely clean and the bed was comfortable.

This is a great place if you are planning to primarily sleep there and have a car or are very comfortable with long public transportation rides.  The furniture is not conducive to lounging or watching tv/movies in your downtime or evenings. The host was always responsive which is appreciated, but not flexible with checkin or checkout. Overall this was a good stay with a nicely appointed apartment that I believe would work best for short stays where you don’t plan to spend much time at the apartment.

My friend and I really enjoyed staying at Can’s place. Everything was as promised and Can was very accommodating. It was extremely hot during our visit to Chicago, and I like to sleep very cold. Upon arrival the place was still cooling down, so we had a harder time getting to sleep. We reached out to Can and he tried his best to make the place cooler, and eventually it did become comfortable enough for the rest of our stay.
Alex fue de mucha ayuda, tuvimos unos temas que nos resolvieron rápidamente. El lugar estaba limpio y bien ubicado cerca de la estación de metro. Las camas muy cómodas.
A beautiful stay! Caitlyn was so friendly and helpful. Gave great recommendations for places around our destinations! 12/10⭐️

The location and place was amazing. Only problem was the electronic lock broke leaving us stranded outside condo a few times. They had lock fixed but we missed some of our planned activities waiting for landlord to arrive so we would not be locked out again.
Beautiful home and great location to easily get around Chicago

We had such a great time! The host made everything so easy from check-in to check-out and was quick to answer any questions. It was the perfect place for our trip, and super close to the train. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Very clean room. The check in and check out was super simple and quick and the common area was clean and well furnished. Even the dishware was organized so each room got their own mugs. The area looked super safe, it’s across the street from a catholic school and it’s in the middle of a very nice residential district. Host checked in each day and responded very quickly. We were able to check in at 11 pm and check out around 6, all we had to do was lock the room door and take the trash out; super easy. The only issue I had was the couch bed was a little uncomfortable, it had random rock hard areas, specifically in the middle of the bed. Otherwise, great place, great host!

This was a perfect spot for our brief Chicago visit.  It was a few blocks from the Blue L stop and within walking distance of Wicker Park, Bucktown, etc.  So there was lots to do around the home, as well as easy access to the rest of the city.  The home was clean, exactly as advertised, and in a nice/quiet neighborhood.  The host was very responsive and kind!
Great stay in a nice neighborhood! Close to a lot of stores and places to eat as well as the train. incredibly walkable and easy to find and access

We had a fantastic stay and would absolutely recommend this property to anyone visiting Chicago! The home was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. Having private off-street parking and access to laundry was a huge bonus and made our trip so much more convenient.
The location is what really makes this place stand out. We walked to nearby shops, restaurants, coffee shops, and even Target, which was incredibly convenient. The Blue Line station was an easy walk away, and we used it every day to explore the city without needing to drive.
This was the perfect home base for sightseeing. During the day, we could easily access all of Chicago’s attractions, and in the evenings, we returned to a neighborhood that felt safe, quiet, and welcoming, while still offering plenty of lively restaurants, shopping, and cafés within walking distance. We couldn’t have asked for a better location or experience and would gladly stay here again!
The AirBnB was a quick walk to Wrigley Field and had plenty of restaurants and stores to check out within a walking distance.

This place is great! The neighborhood is gorgeous and felt safe enough to allow our teenagers to exercise some independence. Everything we need is in the space. The kitchen is fully stocked and ready for action. The bathroom is great, the bedrooms are cozy. We traveled with 2 adults and 4 teens.  It was cool enough in the space for 6 Texans used to central A/C. The host is a cool dude with plenty of encouraging tips as we explored the city each day. Don’t wait on this place- book it!

Outstanding location, amenities, style, great security and most of all some of the best service ever! The front desk staff were awesome! So helpful and friendly. Cloud 9 Very responsive online, like the best I’ve ever had! Highly recommend for a business retreat where you can split our into different areas to work!
Great location and beautiful neighborhood! It was very peaceful and had a lot of amenities which made down time feel right at home.

My husband and I had the best time at Settlers Inn this week. The location was amazing and close to everything. The hosts were so friendly and accommodating. The decor was stunning. 10/10 would recommend. I can only hope we’ll be back in the area to stay here again.

This was our second time staying here, and it was even better knowing what to expect with the parking situation. The location is excellent everything we wanted was within walking distance, and downtown was just a short drive away. The place was clean, comfortable, and made for another great stay. We'd definitely stay here again!

The place was great and even came with a few snacks and games too! It was really cozy and a nice place to kick back after a busy day. The host always responded quickly and was really helpful during my stay. The free parking on W 23rd street is rarely available so I would recommend buying a permit if you plan to bring your own vehicle. The only issue with the condo was a centipede that I saw crawling on the wall then under the bed never to be seen again. Regardless, the place was a wonderful place to stay overall!
Bianca is amazing!! She gave us the best recommendations and was very responsive to any questions we had. 11/10 would stay again

Great apartment in downtown Chicago proximity to so much in about 5-10 blocks. Pictures are exactly what you get with lots of room for many to gather. The balcony is an added bonus especially for sunrise  coffee or evening drinks. Most guests probably don’t cook but if you do, the kitchen could be better equipped but the basics are there including spices. Highly recommend this place and our family enjoyed it a lot.
The host was wonderful. They responded quickly to all inquiries and were flexible and understanding. The room is exactly as advertised - a good deal for the price! I would stay here again.
Location doesn’t get much better than this if visiting Wrigley!
A cozy and roomy area to stay in this home.  Quiet and walking distance to public transportation and excellent restaurants.  Host was friendly, caring, and helpful throughout my stay.

Everything was clean and comfortable. Cassandra is wonderful, friendly, made us feel welcomed, and answered all of our questions quickly. Relatively close to downtown and the surrounding areas had a lot of cute boutiques and eateries. A lot of construction in the area, so be aware if using personal vehicle. Spent a few nights sitting on the stoop and met a lot of friendly dog owners, but be aware of the rodents running around the corner, lol. Only drawback is the limited cooking utensils and space (no can opener, griddle or hand towels for the kitchen, and a two burner stove), but that is just a personal preference, as not every guest chooses locations based on making breakfast/dinner before going out to explore the city known for its food. It might be food for thought as families want to save a little more as everything gets more expensive. I would stay here again.
Great spot, close to the train and lots of activity. Hope to stay again when I visit in the future.
Great and fast communication. Will stay here again next time we are in Chicago.
Great location-walkable to Wrigley Field.

Great stay overall! I’ve stayed at Jennifer’s Airbnbs in the past and always had a good experience. This space is such a cute little suite! Bed is comfy, kitchenette is well-equipped (even has an air fryer!) and the price can’t be beat. Recommend for solo travelers or couples bc it’s small.

This place was one of the best Airbnbs we’ve stayed at! It was exactly as described, extremely clean and super close to Wrigley. We were in town for a concert and even with everyone leaving at once, we were all in bed 20 minutes after leaving our seats!!! Best location ever for a cubs game or anything happening at Wrigley field. The apartment was beautiful inside with a few pieces of its old charm. I loved to primary bathroom and now want heated floors and a skylight in my own bathroom.
We found the loft to  be very comfortable and in a charming area of Chicago with easy access to the train. Would highly recommend to anyone considering and hope to return again soon!
Wonderful place to stay!  Quiet and convenient, and Ashley and Amanda were very nice and prompt!!!
Quiet neighborhood, and the space had everything I needed for a week's stay while visiting my daughter.

Super clean space and easy to access, tons of outside parking. Really close to great restaurants and easy commute to downtown.
Super responsive and is great at checking in and seeing if everything is going smooth

I had such a nice stay here. The host was super communicative and helpful. The house was decorated so beautifully and the space is large enough to spread out if you're on a group trip. We loved being able to cook each day and the fact that the host made mint infused water for us ahead of our stay.
This is the perfect home base to enjoy Black Chicago. It felt like old school Airbnb. This is a real home with touches from real people. The spots that could've be improved for us were more comfy bedsheets and cooking utensils. The best parts were the amazing host and the great location so close to the #6. This is the spot to come to explore the city like a local.

Tere was an excellent host especially for such a last minute request for my family and I! She was extremely fast with responding and answered all our questions and concerns! The apartment was exactly what we were looking for; safe, comfortable, large enough for my family of 6, clean, and close to food & public transport! The apartment was super easy to find and self check-in made it a breeze! This location was quite and cozy but close enough to see all of Chicago!
This place was absolutely perfect for us, very clean and tidy and very safe place to stay. Shops and food very close for convenience
Nice location in case of attending an event in McCormick place.

Russell J’s Place was exactly as described. He was extremely responsive to me as the guest. I loved everything about the place. The area is truly walkable and I did so daily. I will definitely be back.

I booked this stay for my team of Executive's who were in town for a business meeting as the hotel options were lacking and this was the PERFECT place for them. The location was unbeatable and the place is exactly what we expected, plenty of room for all of them to spread out, and plenty of communal space for when they needed to work together. The host was incredibly proactive and helpful in her communication. Price was very fair for the amount of rooms and space, given the location. Would definitely book again!
This is a nice peaceful spot in a lovely neighborhood.  We'll visit again!

Ronda’s place is a beautiful home that makes for a great stay during a visit to Chicago. It’s our first time using Airbnb, and we usually stay in hotels. This experience at Ronda’s place has convinced us to consider Airbnb instead of hotels in the future.

Victor is a terrific host and has a great spot. First and foremost, if you are coming into town for anything at Wrigley Field - a place doesn't get better located than Victor's. On top of that, it's in the middle of Wrigleyville, which can keep you busy for your whole trip. Add to that, super convenient to the Red Line, you have the entirety of Chicago available to you.
The place - clean, well laid out, 4 nice sized bedrooms. Victor made sure clean linens and towels were outfitted in each room
The communication: easy to follow access instructions, super responsive to messaging, and then on top of that, we had some last minute travel changes, and he was 100% flexible in our check in and check out times to accommodate.
My wife and I 100% fully recommend.

This is an amazing apartment. Most rentals offer the bare minimum but John goes above and beyond with the extras provided. He lives in the building so he is readily available. The neighborhood is great… typical Chicago. You will love John’s place.

Large studio apparent with a great location in Wrigleyville. Very convenient if walking to Wrigley Field. Several restaurants and bars. Also a walkable distance to the L, but we Uber’d when we had luggage. Charming neighborhood that felt safe.
Great place to stay! Very clean and conveniently located close to public transportation. Host had great communication and made check in very easy!
Muy cómoda para pasar esos días sin estrés y en familia
We loved staying here! The L was right next to the apartment which made it easy to go places. We would definitely stay here again.

The perfect location for anyone coming into town for an event at Wrigley Field! Clean, great size, great location, and a very thorough and responsive host! Only suggestion would be to bring your own makeup mirrors, as there is only one mirror in the bathroom, which can make getting ready at the same time a tad challenging. Will definitely be staying here again in the future!

came in for a show at wrigley and this apartment was perfect! fully equipped kitchen, walkable to cta bus and train lines, and private! street parking was easy to snag during the daytime hours making for easy loading and unloading.

Stay exceeded expectations! Location was excellent and place was even better in person than in pics. Very cozy and comfortable with very cute personality! Host was super friendly!  Would definitely stay here again :)

First-time Airbnb users & WOW! What an amazing stay we had at Marco and Sara's place. Beautiful, spotless, clean, modern home in a very nice, quiet neighborhood on Chicago's northwest side.  It is close to everything! 15 minutes from the airport, 20 minutes to Wrigley Field, 30 minutes from downtown and the lakefront, and only minutes away from neighboring historic Oak Park and architectural tours. Just an all-around perfect location. Now the home itself. It's a newer townhome in a really nice, safe, well-kept neighborhood. The home is beautiful, with every amenity you could ask for, well furnished, and with a washer & Dryer. I stayed here with my wife, son, and mother-in-law, and we had more space than we would have ever had in a hotel. Marco & Sara were awesome and provided excellent communication throughout our entire trip. We are already planning our next trip to Chicago, but since we are spoiled now, we will only plan a trip if their place is available.
a very nice unit and a great host. I ll definitely book again the next time I visit Chicago.

The basement apartment was very nice. Lots of space. The bathroom shower was especially nice. We did hear some movement above per expected with the family living upstairs. Overall, the hosts were very friendly and helpful. I Appreciated how close it is to the train and the parking permit you gave us to be able to park in front of the house easily. Thanks!
I didn’t know I’d have housemates, but it was a cool place
10/10, would stay again!
It was exactly what we needed and they were super responsive when we messaged them.
Mark was really responsive and helpful. Condo was very clean and looked exactly like the photos. It was within walking distance of restaurants and we would return!

Our family of eight had an absolutely wonderful stay! The home was beautiful, exceptionally clean, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. It was the perfect space for our family, and everyone—from the adults to the kids—felt right at home.
The host's communication was outstanding from start to finish. They were responsive, helpful, and made the entire process easy and stress-free.
The location was another huge plus. Everything we wanted to do was nearby, making it so convenient to explore the area without spending a lot of time driving.
This was truly one of our favorite Airbnb stays. My kids loved it just as much as I did, and we made some wonderful memories here. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this home to anyone looking for a beautiful, comfortable, and family-friendly place to stay!

The apartment is in a great location, but the stay was extremely uncomfortable because the AC could not keep the unit cool. Despite repeatedly raising the issue, the host only checked the temperature directly under the vent, where there was minimal airflow, instead of addressing the poor cooling throughout the apartment. A fan made little difference, and I ended up with one of the worst nights of sleep I’ve had before leaving early. After Airbnb required a refund, the co-host, Hatice, then made what I believe were false damage claims against me, which only added to an already disappointing experience.
great!
The host provided clear instructions and was responsive when needed.
Everything was wnderful!

The Claremont Cottage was a perfect resting place for our short visit to Chicago. After busy days experiencing some of what the city has to offer, it was nice to come to a quieter neighborhood to rest.
The Cottage was clean and comfortable and we received great communication to let us know what to expect.
The beds were very comfortable, which is a big deal for us. Some beds make it difficult to get a good nights sleep, but these were excellent!

We had a great stay! If you’re coming to Chicago for a Cubs game or a concert at Wrigley Field, this location is hard to beat. It’s an easy walk to the stadium, plus all the great bars, restaurants, and the Wrigleyville atmosphere. The place was clean, comfortable, and made for a perfect home base to enjoy the neighborhood without worrying about driving or parking. We’d definitely stay here again on our next trip to Wrigley!
Great location, lot of stores and things to do around, grab an extra towel if your party is big

I was in town for a concert with my 15-year-old daughter and her two friends. Mike’s place was the perfect location for a fun few days away, just a few blocks from Wrigley Field.
