Mike could not have been more responsive and accommodating. The home was lovely, nicely decorated and well appointed. The communication before and during our stay was great. We would definitely stay there again!
It was great and cozy, in a comfortable part of Chicago. Owners were great and extremely communicative. Very cozy little studio and would stay again!
Nada por decir… todo excelente

Uno de los mejores lugares donde nos hemos quedado mi familia y yo en Chicago, el departamento estaba súper limpio, aprecio muchos que tuviera todo lo necesario para que mi bebé de 1 año estuviera cómoda, incluso libros y juguetes. Matthew nos recibió con una botella de vino un gran detalle! Seguro volveremos a buscar este lugar para nuestra próxima visita!
Great stay, and location.

Nous avons adoré séjourner chez Rene, le logement est très confortable et pratique pour 4 personnes. Nous avons apprécié pouvoir profiter du café et de beaucoup d’ingrédients présents pour faire la cuisine. Le supermarché mexicain à proximité était très pratique pour acheter de très bons fruits notamment. La proximité des transports en commun métro et bus a rendu la visite de Chicago très facile. René et Sergio ont toujours répondu avec beaucoup de gentillesse à nos sollicitations. Nous garderons un excellent souvenir de notre séjour grâce à eux.
Great host, a great location, we stay here repeatedly every time we visit Chicago

Stephanie’s place is stellar.  Modern building with 24/7 security.  Great neighborhood with plenty of food nearby and close to the park.  Good amenities.  Good furniture.  Quiet.  Great views of Soldier Field and you can even see the lake in the distance.  I come to Chicago often for work and this is the Airbnb I’ve stayed at in Chicago.

Sharon was the best!! It was my first time navigating Chicago by myself and she helped me a ton with the bus, and anything else I needed help with! It was cozy and she was very nice :) will definitely be staying here if I come back to Chicago!
This stay shattered my expectations for what a budget-friendly property could look like.  Comfy bed, clean, safe area and the complimentary coffee/tea saved us money. Thank you.
Great location. Train station just steps away. Close to Michigan avenue. There’s even a little cafe shop below the apartment for coffee and pastries if you don’t want to grocery shop

The hosts were so nice and quick to respond to any questions asked, the plave is exactly described and the area wasn’t too bad I felt like at home with a lot of Hispanic shops nearby haha, I would go back if I have another trip in Chicago, thank you guys!
Great communication, location, and space! Highly recommend.

Really good value for our group of 6. We fit nicely. The place was very clean and in a great neighborhood. Very quiet and peaceful. And walkable. We made it to Wrigley in 20 minutes on foot. Within striking distance of restaurants, etc. Only one bathroom, but that was enough for us. There were ample towels and linens available. I appreciated that. Our group had plenty of room to spread out. Never felt cramped. The place is well-designed and laid out. Freddy did a good job of communicating all instructions. Check in and check out were easy. We had one minor issue, but it was resolved quickly enough. All in all, we would not hesitate to stay at this property again. Definitely recommend.
John and his wife were the best hosts! Super responsive and gave great suggestions. Will definitely be back if in the area again!
Very cozy place in a peaceful neighborhood!

Had an amazing time staying here! Got a little toasty at times, but you should expect that with it being the middle of summer! Hosts were very friendly and nice! Look forward to booking with him again.
Perfection! Can’t beat the location and Heather was incredibly helpful! 10/10

My husband & I enjoyed our stay in Chicago at this place!  It was easy to walk to the L train and get everywhere we needed to go.  At night, there was an excessive number of people hanging out on the sidewalks, so we felt more comfortable taking a Lyft home rather than walking from the L.  The place was very cute & cozy.  We loved having access to a garage parking spot--it felt much more secure than street parking.  The value for this place can't be beat!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was incredibly cute, cozy, and exceptionally clean. Jay thought of so many little touches that made us feel welcome, and the beds were very comfortable. The neighborhood felt safe, even when we were out later in the evening, and we appreciated the coded entry for both the building and the apartment. Street parking was always easy to find, and the location was perfect for exploring the city. Jay communicated well throughout our stay and made sure our first visit to the city was a great experience. We would absolutely stay here again on our next trip!
Hotel staff were so friendly and helpful especially with a flexible check-in and storing our luggage. Room was exactly as pictured and described.
We enjoyed our stay. The condo was clean and spacious and we appreciated the attention to detail in the space. Great location for our plans to get to Wrigley Field and Lincoln Park Zoo.
Spacious apartment in a historic building. Great location in Hyde Park.
We had a wonderful stay! The home was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Check-in was easy, and the host was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay.
Host was so nice and responsive and helpful.

We chose Brandon’s place for the architecture and it didn’t disappoint. Brandon was a congenial host who basically left us to ourselves - which was fine.  We relied on public transport so it wasn’t the most convenient for restaurants or grocery stores - but for a short stay we managed well.
Clear communication, no surprises, good balance between cost and amenities/experience.
It was a great space and easy to find! Easy to grab Uber/Lyft to head downtown and explore the city! Dominique was very kind and responsive.
It’s a great place to stay. It’s close to restaurants, train and bus stops. Walkable neighborhood.

Kendal was a wonderful host! He quickly responded to all my questions. His property was comfortable, conveniently located, and affordable. If you’re looking to stay in Chicago, I would definitely recommend Kendal’s home!

Amazing apartment!
10/10 !

We had a wonderful stay at Michael's place. The attention to detail throughout the home was exceptional. The two bathrooms were a great feature, and everything was spotless upon arrival.
The house has a modern, comfortable feel and is located in a safe, quiet neighborhood. Downtown was about a 15-minute Uber ride in traffic (around 8 minutes without traffic), and the L train is within easy walking distance, making it convenient to get around.
We would happily stay here again and highly recommend Michael's place to anyone visiting the area.

We had the best stay here! The hosts were super kind & responsive. They were even able to accommodate us with an early check in, which was so appreciated. The location was amazing - walking distance to Wrigley & great local restaurants & bars. The apartment itself was beautiful, so comfortable, and filled with all the amenities we could need. We’d love to come back!

Nate’s place literally felt like a home away from home. I am truly grateful for the charm and care that went into every little detail during my stay here. Location, Location, Location. We loved it so much we came back a second time. Mike is great and his place is perfect.

Parking information/access was limited but we also came during a huge artist event at Wrigley, otherwise it would have been free/no issue. Our hosts were incredibly communicative and very kind! Everything was easy and comfortable during our stay and we had no major issues.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was smooth, and the host was friendly and responsive throughout our stay. Everything we needed was provided, making it a great experience for our family. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to other guests.

This spot was perfect for a short stay with my partner. It was clean and had everything we needed for our trip. The location was great and with lots of things to do in walking distance and easy access to bus stops and the subway. Would definitely stay here again.
Love the space. Nice and convenient location. A bit noisy wit car traffic but with windows closed it didn’t bother us at all. Place is spacious and clean. Gym right next at the same floor was nice.

We enjoyed are time at Frida's Flat and the Pilsen area so much! The space was as pictured, comfortable, and had a great A/C!! It was so nice to arrive "home" after spending long days running around the city, seeing the sites. The host thought of all the details and what guests might need, or what might be nice. everything was easy and location was great.
Eileen’s place was incredible!  It was the perfect place to stay as we were traveling to the area for a concert. Beautiful, comfortable and clean! We felt right at home.

Very nice that it was walkable to Wrigley field! The code they gave me did not work to get into the smart lock. They were responsive within a reasonable amount of time and were able to give us a new/temporary code to get in.
Great Location in the city near a lot of the places you want to be.  Recommended if you're travelling and want a walkable and great location.
Comfortable stay, felt right at home

My family and I really enjoyed our stay at this house. It was exactly as described and shown in the photos. Everything was very clean, and the bedroom décor was unique and unlike anything we’ve seen before. My kids especially loved the movie room. On top of that, everything was spotless. If we ever come back to Chicago, we would definitely stay here again.
Great place to stay. We have friends who live around this neighborhood and always enjoy our visits. Very clean and nicely updated.
Enjoyed my stay! The place was clean, quiet, and nice.

Visited with me partner and kids on a road trip through Chicago. This was such a perfect space for us - truly steps from the L Blue Line, a decent coffee shop around the corner - and even a CVS across the street for the random things we forgot or needed in the kitchen. Will definitely stay here (and other properties Matthew reps) again soon!

We enjoyed our stay at Mike’s place. We had plenty of room to spread out and the couch downstairs was a cozy place to snuggle up at the end of each night. The earplugs next to each bed was a nice touch, although we didn’t find it too noisy at night. The house is a quick walk to the red line which brought us to all the locations we wanted to go and there were also plenty of places to eat and shop within walking distance. Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend this home to anyone wanting to visit Chicago.
the apartment was great and Dmitri was quick to respond when we had a question.

Great value and great location on the corner of North & Ashland. Easily accessible to public transportation, the highway, and city destinations like the Salt Shed. Great spot and location is incredible.
They were very responsive and the place was worth the price.

very clean, cute & cosy space - looks just like the pictures. It was perfect for my 3 night stay.
Kind and responsive host.

This place needs a lot of maintenance. Just adding curtains and blackout shades would make this place a lot better.
The first night there were gunshots taking place on the street below - understand we are in a city but wasn’t a good feeling for paying so much for a place.

The checkout instructions were very intricate and high maintenance for a place that’s not that nice. Cleaning dishes and taking out all trash seems like a job that would fall under cleaning fee that we are charged.
Photos make this place look much nicer than it actually is.

Beautiful space in a great location.  Everything we needed was available. Hosts were very accommodating to me adding an additional day to our stay. I especially enjoyed meeting the two lovely dogs who were also very gracious hosts and gave me a tour of the yard.
Nice apartment near to magnificent mile.

There were bugs inside unit that looked like roaches crawling on the wall. The AC unit inside can not keep up with any form of heat. My kids liked the place
Everything went smoothly. nice to have 3 bedrooms
Great location, took the el and busses frequently with easy access. Joan was very communicative and friendly.

I was visiting Chicago again with my teens and decided to stay at David's again. Short walk down the street and around the corner to the next street for the train station.  Parking available on the street and clean place to sleep and relax! We would stay again!

I was there for a conference so spent very little time in unit. It is definitely spacious and gets a lot of sunlight—great during waking hours. Bedrooms don’t have blackout curtains/blinds, so pack a sleeping mask (I forgot mine). Relatively well-appointed, but the upstairs bathroom doesn’t have a toilet paper holder, nor a bar or hook to hang bath towels from—this should be corrected. A shelf or rack to place toiletries would be nice. I also encountered dust bunnies in the bedroom and bathroom. As someone with allergies, I was a bit concerned, but ultimately didn’t have any flair ups. Angela did not respond to my initial messages until the day before. They were better at responding the day of. The first code I was provided didn’t work. After a few attempts in the hot sun, I reached out and was afraid I’d be stranded for a while. But Angela responded quickly and provided a new code after attempting to troubleshoot. Proximity to McCormick Pl was the main draw.

Bel was incredibly clear and helpful, house was great for the price, and was perfect for what we needed. No complaints at all and I’d go back in a heartbeat!!!
FYI… parking is pretty easy but can be a tad difficult depending on the time of day. We stayed in one spot and ubered the rest of the time. Everytime we left the house there were a handful of spots within a block of the house that would’ve been an easy spot.
Thanks Bel!!

Great for my short stay where I didn't really need much more than a place to sleep. Heidi was very communicative, and her instructions were quite clear. There are two cats, which may be important to know if you have allergies—I do, but even I was fine as they were kept away from the room and it was quite clean when I arrived.

Our group of six had a fantastic stay! The garden residence was immaculate, beautifully designed, and had everything we needed. The bathrooms were especially impressive, with modern finishes and thoughtful features that made the space feel luxurious.
The hosts went above and beyond by providing parking passes, which made our visit incredibly convenient—especially with the concert traffic. The location couldn't have been better: it's an easy walk to Wrigley Field and surrounded by great restaurants in Wrigleyville.
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area. It was the perfect home base for our trip!

We arrived late into town and often came home from our daily adventures after dark. Entering through the alley or even the front was a little scary at night because you had to walk through a dark and narrow passage way to get to the front door. However- there were bright flood lights once you reached the gated door to the walkway. The garage was spacious, but there was an open construction hole (without a safety covering) inside the garage that led to the underneath of the home. This felt a bit unsafe as we had two little kids with us.
The apt is in need of a fresh up. The walls are scuffed and the blinds are broken in some spaces or not long enough. The biggest complaint was that the air conditioner did not work properly which led to two uncomfortable nights during a 90-100 degree heatwave. Laura did not send anyone to fix the ac as she said she would. The portable ac unit did NOT make up for the ac being broken. More towels and utensils would be helpful for a family of 4.

Would not book again. It was 87 degrees inside! Central air was broken which was okay given portable AC unit is pictured in the listing photos. The problem was that the portable AC unit was not properly installed and was completely inadequate for the summer heat.
It was 87 degrees inside the apartment. Plus they don’t list it but this is a student housing location which may be okay for some but wasn’t really ideal. Wish they had mentioned that.
Did not provide a realistic solution to cool the unit (additional portable AC which isn’t cooling an 800+ sqft apartment when it’s 87 degrees) and suggested I attempt to reset the central air myself.
The apartment was as advertised. Thai place (Blue Frog?) 2 min. away was very good. Very quiet at night.
This was a wonderful air bnb for our 3 adults! The space was clean and bright, very comfortable beds, and great location. The AC worked wonderfully as well in VERY hot conditions outside!

I was in town for a conference not far from Avondale. It was a great place to come back to after a super busy interactive day.  Aaron was a great host! He was responsive and accommodating, and the place itself was perfect for me and my daughter.  Thank you!

Great location in the West Loop!  The space was expansive with plenty of room for multiple guests.  Some concern about all the steep/open staircases if older guests are present.  As others have mentioned, the parking is very tight on site.  I would be hesitant to try and park any mid-sized vehicle or larger.
Lois and Eduardo's home is perfect! My stay was great, quiet and so convenient to walk to Loyola.
great neighborhood and awesome stay Melissa is very accommodating
Thanks for the stay, I had an amazing time.

Had a great stay here for vacation with my mom. Loved how spacious it was! So many great restaurants and fun places in walking distance.
Worth every dollar!

Safe neighborhood and a cute and nice. Parking passes were not left as we were told they would be. She did run one out the next day but only 1 when we were told we’d have two. Thankfully our other vehicle did not get ticketed and it all worked out. Great location, everything about the unit was as described.

Jane was the nicest and most helpful host ever. I can off an 18 hrs flight and she let me check in early. Everything was as promised. The coffee and tea and clear house rules made my stay a pleasure. Also Chicago is a wonderful city. Ignore all the negging from mean reactionary cowards.

This place was very clean and spacious. The host sent very detailed instructions  and pictures about getting in the place. Loved that we were in walking distance to so many eating places and to Wrigley Field.

Such a fantastic location. Just be aware this room lacks natural light and is right by the entrance so you can hear everyone coming and going. I would consider staying again, just not in this specific room.
I recommend this apartment! It was just as described and fit all of our needs. Parking was easy and free. Good communication. I would stay here again.

This place was perfect for my family. It was extremely spacious, clean, and comfortable. It had everything we needed and the games were a major hit. David is extremely helpful and responsive. This is an ideal place to stay and we would love to stay here again.
Really enjoyed our stay. Comfortable, clean, and family friendly. Would definitely stay again the next time we visit Chicago!

Very spacious apartment, very well kept and parking was gated.  Felt very secure and safe.  Would recommend!!

My stay at Atlas’s apartment was the best Airbnb experience that I’ve had. He and his wife were extremely friendly, helpful and welcoming. He gave us some great recommendations ahead of our trip, and there was a welcome packet in the unit with more suggestions, including QR codes! Atlas promptly came over to help when we had an issue with the television. His wife provided us with masks on a day that the air quality was at hazardous level due to Canadian wildfires. The neighborhood was pretty and quiet. The entire experience was lovely, and I intend to plan my next Chicago visit around Atlas’s availability!

Overall, the home was nice, clean, and had plenty of space for our group. However, there were two major issues that affected our stay. When I contacted the host, she asked if the mini fridge was there and then told me the previous guests had already reported the refrigerator wasn’t working. I was disappointed that we weren’t informed before arriving and that no other solution was offered. The home has great potential, but these issues should be resolved or clearly communicated to future guests.

Overall great stay and Kim was very responsive / easy to work with. The area was great - easy walk to subway and Wrigleyville. There were a couple hiccups but outside of that, highly recommend this property!
The place is super clean and it’s super peaceful!!!

Cute + comfortable spot! Loved visiting such a fun neighborhood and walking everywhere. Check in was easy, parking was easier than expected, and the apartment had everything we needed. Would definitely stay again.

Great place to stay when visiting Chicago, especially if you’ve stayed downtown before and are wanting to branch out to some of the surrounding neighborhoods. The garden was beautiful and the space was very quiet and private. Would stay here again!

The place was adequate, but a bit cramped in the main bedroom and bathroom. It worked out for seeing our son’s family in the Lakeview area. Parking was easier here than in his area. Milen was always responsive to our communications. Overall—a good stay.

Great place to stay close to Wrigley Field! We vacationed here for a concert so it was a perfect location. Nice walkable area and a short drive into downtown. This place was roomy and had everything we needed. Being above a bar was an awesome plus!
Great experience overall! Convenient location and the space itself was amazing.

Great location! Close to everything and super easy to access transit. The stairs are steep, so be prepared!! But we had a perfect stay, we were even able to find free parking about a block from the Airbnb.
Amazing location and very communicative host. Would for sure stay here again!

Shaun's home was lovely, surrounded with a nice neighborhood that had close coffee shops for the morning and delicious restaurants for the evening (we loved the polish restaurant, Staropolska). Shaun was also super helpful with answering any questions we had and offering recommendations to enhance our stay! We would stay again!
Great stay. Thank you!

This apartment is an absolute gem! The location is perfect— close to everywhere you want to be in downtown Chicago. Even though the building is on a bustling Chicago street just steps from fantastic restaurants and shopping, the bedrooms were sufficiently removed from the city noise.
The host was proactive in reaching out, prompt to respond, and consistently friendly and helpful. The entire unit was very clean and tidy; when we walked around without shoes, our feet/socks stayed completely clean.
The bathroom situation was even better than we expected— in addition to one full bath, there is one room with a sink and shower and another with a sink and toilet. This made the bathrooms incredibly functional for our family.
We would absolutely return to this apartment in the future and will highly recommend it to our friends!
The apartment was very nice & peaceful. I didn't feel like i was being watched or anything & the owner was super nice & made sure we had everything we needed.
We had a great stay. The host was very rey responsive, the neighborhood was great! We were close to Trader Joe’s, restaurants, and public transportation. The apartment was spacious and clean.
Kevin was a fantastic host! The place was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. Location is great, we'll definitely stay again.

Beautiful home close to everything we needed to get to downtown/Metro. Perfect for our group of colleagues traveling for a company event. Super comfortable beds and all the amenities we needed. Would stay here again.

The inside space was excellent - felt new, accommodating and very clean. The location is about 20 minutes to downtown which is convenient and is the primary reason we chose this location for good value. The surrounding location is sketchy and isn’t the owner’s fault. A+ if you want value and a nice place. If you care about location surroundings and want to walk anywhere, this isn’t for you.

Really nice and clean place conveniently located within walking distance from Logan square. Parking was easy, and the apartment had some nice touches making it welcoming to a family with young kids. I had a very good stay and he is a thoughtful host. The bottles of drinking water really helped. Thank you. I would stay again.

Stayed for 2 nights with my 18yr old daughter for a concert at Wrigley. Conveniently located close to the L train. Very walkable and adorable neighborhood with the sweetest shop owners nearby. Dimitri answered all of my random questions VERY quickly. Very impressed with the comfort of the beds, we slept like babies. Thank you for hosting us and will gladly stay again.
Todo bien, sí había aire en la zona común y una recámara, la otra no tenía pero no hubo problema

We had a great stay! We had a little trouble finding the parking and figuring out the rear entrance but Eric was super responsive and handled everything really well. The apartment is in a great location. We walked everywhere! Lots of restaurants nearby.
Lugar exactamente como se describe, cerca de transporte, gasolinera, ambiente muy tranquilos, el lugar tenía todo lo que necesitamos, comunicación rápida y amable.

The host is considerate and provided earplugs and eye masks, though we personally still needed a bit more noise cancellation to get a good night's sleep. A sound machine in every bedroom would make this place absolutely perfect.
We will definitely stay here again.. with our own sound machines. :)
Very clean and responsive. Good deal for the price! Free drinks were a plus. To get to downtown it’s about an hour train or bus. About a 25 minute bus to Wrigley.
좋은 숙소 덕분에 시카고에서 행복한 시간 보낼 수 있었습니다.

Really nice apartment in a great part of Chicago! Perfect for 4-5 people and has all of the amenities you would want. Only caution would be if you are traveling with children there are no black out blinds however they do provide eye masks for everyone which is a great touch but just something to be aware of. I would certainly rent this apartment again!
The airbnb was beautiful and we loved our stay! Amazing location as well, so much to do around. The vintage look of this place was incredible, I would highly recommend!!

Had an amazing stay! Lots of amazing restaurants in the area that were easy to walk to. Also not too far from public transportation. Everything was nice and clean when we arrived and Amelia kept contact throughout our stay to make sure we were doing alright. I would definitely stay here again!

great location next to metro line, so super easy to get anywhere which is great and very much felt worth it with that regard alone. The only problem I really had is that the bed was not the best. It reminded me of a tier above the mattress in my sleeper couch. If they improve the bed at this location and keep pricing and everything else the same I would highly recommend.
We had a great stay at Tony’s. Everything was as described. The parking was a huge plus. There is a really nice grocery store within walking distance of the apartment. No complaints.

Ten en cuenta que el airbnb está ubicado en la zona caliente de Chicago. Lo que ves en las imágenes en lo que contiene el airbnb, las sábanas, las toallas y la habitación estaban limpias.

The air bnb definitely met my expectations. The host was very responsive to all questions I had and was extremely helpful.

Steven’s place was perfect for our recent trip to Chicago. My daughter and I were doing a quick trip to familiarize ourselves with the city and the neighborhoods nearby. Steven was helpful with recommendations prior to arrival.  While we were there, we were able to utilize the train to go downtown, out to shows, and to see several apartments for her to consider. During our downtime, we enjoyed walking around the neighborhood and going to some nearby restaurants and shops. Absolutely perfect for what we were looking for. I would definitely recommend.  We enjoyed being a quick train ride from any attraction we wanted to see but being able to enjoy downtime in a walkable neighborhood.

My second time here, roomy, cozy, comfy house just steps from the main strip of Andersonville, but far enough back to be quiet and chill for sleeping and lazy morning.  Hosts always available and friendly.  Feel very zen there! :)

Spazio accogliente e molto pulito. Una notte c’è stato un problema con l’aria condizionata e la mattina Gloria ci ha subito scritto che aveva già provveduto a contattare il tecnico e così è stato, al rientro la sera stessa era di nuovo tutto funzionante.
Posizione ottima per spostarsi con i mezzi pubblici e molto tranquilla. Grazie di tutto!
We enjoyed our stay, great location, clean!

My partner and I came for a week in the summer and this was the perfect place–clean, good location, and cool temps in the unit! It’s close to grocery stores, restaurants/cafes, and the beach, plus less than a 10 min walk to the red line. Would definitely stay again :)
Great place. Easy and fast communication.

Our overall stay was nice. Great location, friendly neighbors, quiet. Luckily the cleaner let us in because the instructions for the lock box were unclear. We were late to check in about 30 minutes, so we wonder how that would’ve worked had we been on time. The rug in the living room should be replaced or cleaned at the very least. Otherwise we had a nice stay. close to the beach and about 15/20 minutes from downtown. Lots of space, the unit was nice and the other furniture was nice. Laundry was great to have. Definitely glad we chose this route over a hotel
Good spot! Easy communication
Great stay for what we needed! Perfect location to walk to restaurants and shops. Clemencia and Michael were very helpful and responsive.

Harry was awesome.  Possibly the best Host I have ever dealt with.  As long as you like the pictures you will like the place.  If you are renting this place due to wrigley field, then it is perfect.   A/C was AMAZING!!!

Had a great stay here! It both seemed close to everything but just off enough to be quiet and private.
Communication was easy and proactive, and I was easily able to get inside at my own schedule due to clear check-in instructions and asynchronous check-in instructions.
The unit itself was spacious, clean and had enough amenities to have breakfasts and lunches at home, have to bedrooms, and a dedicated workspace as I worked remotely.
Would definitely stay here again. Thanks for letting me stay in your beautiful home Kyriako!
great value and for us perfectly located between Hayes and U of chicago in south and in north the bean and jazz clubs. host was very responsive.

What an amazing place and amazing neighbourhood and the A/C was a life saver during an insanely hot spell in Chicago.  Nikkole was quick to respond to all questions.  There were a few very minor things that I suggested to Nikkole for future guests that will make the stay even better (ex. have a few tissue boxes in the house).  The house was well set up and we had no issues finding free parking at anytime on the streets. We were never parked more than a one minute walk to the house. Also a very safe neighbourhood with respect to walking around and leaving the car parked for multiple days.  We had a transit pass and the bus stop was just a minute walk from the home too.  Do not hesitate to stay here.

To be honest, the area is really ugly. It smells bad behind the house. You should renovate it. Even so, it's way too dangerous. Lately, there's nothing I can recommend about it. People who go there aren’t going to like it.
The plants are beautiful and the space and location were perfect for our time in Chicago!!!

Really great stay at TJ’s. Responsive and also proactive in communications, and were able to get some extra pillows during our stay which were delivered promptly. Ideal location for Lincoln Park on one side, as well as the great restaurants, bars, coffee shops and culture in the neighborhood with Clark St at the other end of the block.
Really easy downtown access from bus stops on both sides too. Highly recommend.
Amazing place, only place I stay in Chicago! Great location, even better host! Will be back soon.

Our recent stay at Tere’s was fantastic! We came to Chicago for a concert in the area. The place was exactly as listed, extremely clean and comfortable. Tere was responsive and happy to help! We enjoyed our stay, and will definitely rebook when we are in the area again! Check in process was smooth, just make sure to read the instructions!

My first experience with airbnb and it went so much smoother than I expected!
I really appreciated the responsiveness and courtesy :)
Thanks to Serg, great place and the furniture, beds, towels are all great quality and incredibly clean. The kitchen and lounge are great. The parking is so very useful too!
We liked the location and apartment. It was very secure and staff were helpful. Kitchen was very nice. We enjoyed it.
Very nice hosts, helpful and responsive. Cozy upstairs living, and easily walkable to restaurants and corner stores. Enjoyed our stay in Chicago!

Lovely stay at this property! Host was very responsive with any questions I had as well as very clear instructions on property. Property was well maintained and beds were very comfy! Definitely book with this host again!:)
This was a great place to stay and the host was awesome!
Perfect, clean, and just the right location!

You cannot beat the location for its proximity to excellent restaurants, night life, and Wrigley Field!

The location is great - right next to Harper Court and a short walk to plenty of restaurants, TJs, and Target. The place was clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.

Five stars!

Only a couple of miles from Wrigley and still a quiet neighborhood. Will definitely stay here again when we visit in the future!
It actually looks better in person . Very spacious & clean . 9/10 only because a few games didn’t work .

We absolutely loved this place! Very spacious and comfortable felt like home. You’d think being next to the L would be a little too noisy but it wasn’t at all. Beca and her team were very nice and responsive. We would definitely stay here again in the future!
Wonderful hosts! Lois and Eduardo were friendly and so helpful!

I loved this AirBnB. It was a beautiful space with great energy. It has a  small private balcony/porch and street parking. It is close to everything. The bed and linens were amazing! Very clean and well organized! Great communication. I couldn’t have asked for anything more ….thank you Mindy and Tony!! I will be back!

We had a great stay with Nala and Owen. The instructions for the building and the studio were very clear. Easy check in and out. The space was as advertised and perfect for my husband and me while we were in Chicago. We stayed for three nights Monday-Thursday. We could hear some noise from the surrounding apartments, but it was never enough to keep us awake or cause problems. Never any noise that was for extended periods of time. We slept great. The location of the studio was close to two Red Line trains. We solely used the L for our travel while in Chicago, so that was important to us. Our hosts sent us food and drink suggestions which were very helpful.

Natasha's apartment was a fantastic get away in the center of Chicago. Easy to find, centrally located, and with great access to public transportation stops.
The apartment was clean, and had everything we needed. The kitchen is small but functional.
A very comfortable apartment. I had no issues with noise from the city or from the neighboring apartments.

This was the perfect Airbnb ! We came to Chicago for a concert and found this great! The train station nearby made it easy to travel car free , and stress free. The host was very responsive and kind, and had tons of tips and recommendations! I would stay here again if I ever came back !
The place was a good price, and the owners' communication was quick and friendly.  Thank you so much!

It was a great experience stand at this location. House is very clean, family friendly close to everything that you could dream of going to customer. Service was excellent. Would definitely recommend anyone to rent this location.

Rashad was incredibly helpful with recommendations of near by restaurants and seeing the neighborhood. Also helpful with anything you needed with the apartment!

Our stay was a 10 out of 10! I lived in Chicago for several years and I would have killed for a place like this Airbnb. So well kept. Private. Safe. Parking. Multiple beds and baths. Incredibly close to the action. You cannot go wrong. It is clear why this is always booked out. It is a gem and Jamie was so good at communicating how we would access the home and parking. If this is available, book it now. Hoping to stay again soon!

The location was perfect -- 2 blocks from Broadway near Belmont, a vibrant and bustling district with lots of foot traffic, cool restaurants, stores, and amenities. The neighborhood is generally very well kept up with nice apartments and shady streets. The included parking spot was a big plus for our party, since we had one member of our party drive in to stay with us. Surprisingly quick access to downtown.
Will was very friendly and responsive. When a technical issue came up (not his fault), he came over within one hour to fix the situation in person even though it was after 10pm.
Would definitely book again.
Great location, super walkable to key spots. The check-in/out process was easy. Condo was clean and fully stocked!

Greatly exceeded our expectations. We stayed with our daughters and had the most incredible time attending a concert and enjoying the neighborhood. The condo is beautiful and was spotless.  The parking was great and the location is unbeatable. We will definitely be back for another stay.
Great place to stay! 5 minute walk from the bus station and train making it easy to get around the city.

Such a great stay! The Airbnb was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed for a quick visit to the city. It was comfortable, well maintained, and made us feel right at home. We’d definitely stay here again if we’re back in the area. Highly recommend!”
The Airbnb was very clean, quiet and nice. It had everything I needed to be comfortable. I will choose it again if I visit again.

This place was beautiful, and it looked exactly how it does in the pictures. The high windows and ceilings are one of my favorite things about it. Everything was nice, clean, & spacious. The neighborhood was very nice and quiet as well. The highlight in my opinion was the private parking spot. It felt so relieving knowing that we had a spot to come back to no matter the time of day. Coty and Anna were very accommodating and responsive. I will definitely book again when I come back to the city!
Clutch accomodation for a last minute booking I needed on a trip for business. Very user friendly and perfect for what I needed, very professional experience working with the hosts.
Wonderful host that was adaptive and responsive! Great location and the apartment was spacious and clean.
Cute little spot!

I loved Heidi’s place! I stayed for almost a week, and it truly felt like home. I had such a comfortable stay and slept really well every night.
The only small thing I noticed was that the shower water pressure was quite low, so it took a little longer to shower. It wasn’t a big issue at all, though, and it didn’t affect my overall experience.
Heidi was incredibly accommodating from check-in to check-out, and she was so kind and responsive throughout my stay. I would definitely stay here again if I come back. Highly recommend! 🙇‍♀️🙇‍♀️🙇‍♀️🤗
We really enjoyed our stay. Great location and lots of comfortable space to enjoy for a Chicago getaway.

The Treetop Oasis in Roscoe Village was the perfect spot for us to explore Chicago. It was easily accessible by car with convenient free street parking along the property. We left the car there and used public transit during our stay. There's a bus stop right there on Damen, Divvy rental bikes nearby, and short walk to Brown Line trains. Wrigley Field is about a 30-min walk. Definitely doable. We could have spent the whole time in the neighborhood though with all the great restaurants, pubs, and shops.
The apartment was secure with easy check-in and was absolutely spotless. Daran was excellent with communication. I didn't need to reach out at all since he anticipated typical questions that might arise. Checkout was also simple.
We really enjoyed our time and would definitely book it again if staying in the same area in the future.

We loved this property! Great vacation spot for our family during a few days in Chicago.  We say walk to Wrigleyville. Beautiful home, very clean and fun layout/decor. The living rooms/sitting rooms were a great spot for the family to hang out and visit. Host was very responsive and helpful. We would absolutely stay here again and we recommend it highly.
Everything was as described and it was perfect for what we needed!
Super convenient location and the house is clean. Highly recommend this place.

We loved it here! Great location, a brisk 20 minute walk to Wrigley was perfect for our concert. Conveniently located for everything you could possible need in wrigleyville, Lincoln park, or lake shore east. Would absolutely stay here again!!!

Incredible apartment- by far the best rental we’ve ever stayed at! Gorgeous aesthetic, very comfy living room, office and bedrooms. Kitchen fully stocked- with all sorts of extras like coffee and tea and creamers too. Very kind hosts. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

Friendly and responsive host. Accommodation was fairly conveniently located for the conference centre at McCormick Place. AC was good and much needed in the heat. Shared bathroom was a little basic but serviceable. Overall, good value.
Great for what I needed, would be happy to stay again in the future.
Wonderful place to stay. Thank you!
Really enjoyed our stay! Everything was nice and clean and as described. We would stay again!

Mixed opinions. While the apartment was very basic, it was well worth the money. The check in instructions were a little unclear and needed clarification from the host. It’s super close to the Lawrence stop on the Red Line, but the area doesn’t feel super safe. The building itself is nice enough and feels safe. All in all, I think you get what you pay for. It’s a basic apartment 1/2 hour outside of the city that simply gives you a place to sleep if you plan to be out and about most of the time.
Alle's fue un excelente afitrion siempre al pendiente y muy atenta.
Great stay and perfect location!
This was the perfect place for my daughter and I to enjoy a girls' getaway. The neighborhood is great, and the home was so cute and comfortable! Definitely would stay here again.
great deal and great basic place to stay
Very spacious, clean apartment with great facilities. A fair walk to downtown, but location was fine.
Loved the comfy beds, spacious bedrooms, and oversized couch. Everything worked perfectly. Would stay again!

Entry to the building and inside the house was straightforward. Upon entry into the building there was a foul odor that lingered into the house once you opened the door. The house looked exactly like the pictures shown on the site. Decor was very nice. I appreciated that both bathrooms were directly across from the bedrooms. The kitchen was very nice been a long time since I used a gas stove, could use new utensils and pots and pans. Also the water pressure sucked really bad in the showers and kitchen sink. The first bathroom when turning on the faucet made a loud noise. Cleanliness was just okay floors could’ve been sweeped and mopped better. Our linen in what I think is the primary room had a funny smell as if it hadn’t been washed. Neighbor left a coke can outside the door, not sure what that was about. Also you can hear the neighbors upstairs every move as the floor boards were loud and squeaky. Area was questionable when arrived. All in all good trip and stay.
Great space and great location!
Loved our stay! Place is so much bigger than it looks in the photos. Location was great with a convenience store right around the corner. Value for money.
Volveré; nuevamente.

Words can’t explain the beauty of this home. Everything was clean and fresh. Perfect location, restaurants , ice cream/shakes, park etc.. so much for a family to enjoy .. very spacious home and large bedrooms . I recommend this home !
Host very responsive
The property was spacious and the a/c was welcomed in the heat of walking a Chicago summer
I really loved the place and had a very peaceful stay. I’d love to come back again:)
Great place an location. Very clean. Great restaurants nearby. My son starts college in Chicago in the fall and I’m definitely going to save this place and book it again.
Nice place. Close to West Loop attractions.
Great place! Would absolutely return.

Very clean house and very responsive host
I enjoyed my time at the apartment

Great small place to stay if you’re in town for an event or visiting, had everything we needed. Community felt safe and there were plenty of (paid) parking options nearby if the street isn’t your cup of tea. Many small family owned businesses and shops that I recommend you support. If you are looking for a more affordable option while visiting Chicago, this is a great pick!
Jacob was an all around great host. Stay went without a hiccup and would book again!

I highly recommend Katty’s place. The location is an easy walk to the Obama Presidential Center, multiple museums, and the beach. The apartment has everything you need and the air conditioners are a must in Chicago summers. The host is very responsive and an excellent communicator.
The place was very clean and in a quiet area tucked away. The price was great, we would stay again!
Brilliant host, great location and clean and tidy apartments. A little noise from the train line but nothing that kept us awake. Would definitely stay again.

Bryan was an amazing host! From the moment we arrived, he made sure we had everything we needed. He checked in throughout our stay to see if there was anything he could do to make us more comfortable, which was greatly appreciated.
When I needed to extend my stay, Bryan made the process incredibly easy and accommodated my request without any issues. His communication was prompt, friendly, and professional the entire time.
The home was exactly as described, and Bryan’s hospitality made the experience even better. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend booking with him. Thank you, Bryan, for making our stay so comfortable and stress-free!

I wouldn’t stay here again. There were two holes in the ceiling with debris constantly falling into the room, which made it feel poorly maintained. The shared bathroom was consistently dirty throughout our stay. On our final day, drilling and construction work started outside our room at 7:30 a.m. and continued right up until checkout, making it impossible to rest. Work also began on the bathroom ceiling that day, leaving the shared bathroom unusable and meaning everyone staying at the property had to share a single toilet. To make matters worse, we woke up each morning with what appeared to be insect bites. Overall, it was a very disappointing stay, and I wouldn’t recommend it.

Small studio, but has everything you need inside. Decent location with anything you need within walking distance. However, smoke alarm is extremely sensitive and went off multiple times while we tried to cook

What a fantastic place to stay. The interior is decorated with a really cool Chicago vibe, perfect for the Wrigley Field area. We were in town for a concert and spent two nights here. Once we parked our car, we walked everywhere. So much room.  The 2 living areas were nice to have.  Communication was top-notch, with very fast responses. This place is at the top of our list when we go back to Wrigley.

Our stay was great! We loved having garage parking because we walked or took the train everywhere we went so our car was able to stay put. Jason had great directions for checking in and was responsive when we had questions.
great cozy apartment.  train station less than a block away.  great bars and restaurants nearby.  10/10
It is a very good place.  We enjoy 3 nights overhere.  If we have a chance to stop by this city, I would like to live in this again.
Great large condo in a perfect location for anything at Wrigley Field.

Will definitely be staying again for another visit! Evgenii was a great host. Super responsive to everything. Even gave us local recommendations. Everyone else that was staying there was super friendly. We had no issues finding the place or issues with parking. We had a rental so downtown & anywhere we need to go was only about 20-25 minutes away.
Great budget place close to Logan Square that had a very homey feel and great beds
My stay at Eugenes place was wonderful! I would absolutely recommend this spot.
Omar’s place worked perfectly for our family’s stay. Great location!
Unbelievable service and responsiveness. The location was close to so many things! Friendliest front desk staff! Very secure.

Great stay in Wrigleyville! The location can’t be beat (just a short walk to Wrigley Field). The unit was spacious, clean, and comfortable, with reliable WiFi that made working remotely easy. Even as a garden unit, outside noise was minimal. Check-in and check-out instructions were clear and simple. We’d happily stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

We had a great stay! The host was amazing throughout the entire process. He always responded quickly, was incredibly patient, friendly, and understanding, and was happy to help with any questions we had. Communication was clear from start to finish, which made everything stress free. He made us feel welcome and ensured everything went smoothly. I would definitely recommend staying here and would happily book with him again! 🥰

Olgi and Paul’s place was perfect for what we needed. Super walkable to Wrigley Field and close to so much other things. They made sure we had a parking spot when we arrived. Highly recommend this space!

Great communication!
Spotlessly clean!
Lovely area!

Enjoyed a 2 night stay here. Unit was exactly as described and very clean. Bed was comfy. It's a quiet residential area and we felt safe walking to and from the train station, about an 8 minute walk. The coffee maker & provided k-cups were much appreciated. The only downside is the parking, which we knew in advance. We found a spot at the public beach lot less than a block away and moved to a spot on the street near the building the next day. I would stay here again if we ever come back to this area.
Clean and easily accessible. Parking was not a problem.

Freddy’s place was great! He was very responsive to the few questions I had. Check in was super easy. Close and walkable to our planned event at Wrigley. Close to Montrose beach. Walkable to Belmont & Diversey stations. Neighborhood was safe, peaceful, and walkable.  Check out was the easiest we have ever had…put the dishes in the sink and bag the trash. That is it!  So simple.  Like many others have mentioned, the arcade games were awesome!  We all had a blast playing them, especially the grandkid’s!   We will be booking with Freddy again if his place is available the next time we head to Chicago!!  Thank you for the great stay, Freddy!

I arrived to the property with two kids following a transatlantic flight. I noticed and contacted Emily less than an hour after arriving (at 4:45pm) that the crib listed as an amenity was not there, and that I needed it for my baby. I also mentioned later in the night an extremely bright motion-activated light that was turning on and off illuminating both bedrooms and making it difficult to sleep (there are only mini blinds to block light).
Emily responded while we were sleeping (around midnight) that the crib could be brought over in 15 minutes, but I was sleeping at that time. I later responded that the next time we needed the crib would be for baby’s 8am nap. She said it would be brought over and I confirmed. Next message from her at 9:15 am asking if it could be delivered, well past what I thought we . No response or solution offered regarding the intrusive light either.
My reservation was for 2 nights but due to those issues i preferred to leave after one night.
Bryan's man cave bnb is super cool!! Loved the posters and collectibles. 5 min walk from the train station and divvy station. Bryan was very helpful and friendly.

Sharon was very responsive and flexible. We arrived to the Airbnb earlier than the listed check-in, Sharon let us drop off our bags early so that we could roam around without hauling our luggage all over.
Although, the listing stated it was 1 bedroom with 2 beds, we only got 1 bed. There was a slight problem with fruit flies in all of the drains, and the Brita water filter was flashing red to be replaced.
Nothing detrimental to our trip, the neighborhood was great, there was so much to do. Definitely looking forward to our next visit.

Claudia was a great host! She was very quick to respond to any questions or concerns we had, and was very accommodating of our last minute booking. The whole place was very clean and comfortable. The only reccomendations I could make to this host would be to have more kitchen necessities like pots/pans, baking dishes, more silverware, and scissors. We also couldn't find any broom to help us clean up after ourselves, which would've been helpful especially since we had a pet with us. These additions would make this place even better than it currently is! I would definitely reccomend booking here, you'll feel safe and comfortable.
I always love my stays at 747 Loft. It is perfect for long business trips with a kitchen and stocked washer/dryer. I recommend it to everyone!

My family and I had a great time at this property! The views were incredible,
amenities fantastic, and necessities in the property clean and comfortable. We would stay here again!

The place looks just like the pictures and the location is fantastic- walking distance to great Wicker Park cafes, restaurants, and shops. We thoroughly enjoyed exploring the neighborhood. The host was responsive throughout our stay and wanted to make things right when issues arose.
Our bedroom was the one weak spot: no memory foam topper like the other rooms, a very firm mattress, and sheets that were pilling with debris. However, these issues were immediately rectified. The host sent new sheets and a memory foam topper, which was appreciated.
The AC also struggled to keep up with the heat for 2 days, which cost us part of an afternoon waiting on a repair. After the HVAC repairs, it cooled off considerably but never fully down to where we'd set it.
The host worked hard to make things right, but between the sleep setup, the AC, and no gesture offered for the disruption, it wasn't quite the polished stay we expected.
That being said, our children loved it and I would stay again.
Awesome! Will come back! Recommended!

horrible, if you had to sleep anywhere else i’d pick somewhere else! horrible communication & parking. Dirty apartment, seems like they expect the guest prior to them to clean it. Nothing looks as is in the photos, expect nothing but horrible water pressure, a rude host, dirty amenities & a horrible bed to sleep in. If you’re low on budget great! but trust me you could find better

Our stay was wonderful. The apartment was spotless and we loved the nespresso and were appreciative of the laundry in unit. The front door staff was extremely kind and helpful along with the host. Be sure you checkout the Gangnam market across the street. We really hope to stay again.
We had everything we needed. We especially appreciated the laundry capabilities and the dedicated parking space.

It was a great spot for me. I was working and suited our needs well.
Pretty basic kitchen area and no laundry facilities.

My stay at this property was great! Very close to transit and good restaurants. Please check out Lola’s diner and order the pancakes! Quiet neighborhood. The Airbnb was easy to access and clean upon entry. The hosts were easy to communicate with and responded quickly. I liked that they had a small office desk I could work from. Good for 1-2 people. I would stay here again.

La casa de Tim es muy bonita, nos sentimos como en casa. Él fue muy amable y estuvo al pendiente todo el tiempo. Tiene buena ubicación y hay tanto bus como metro relativamente cerca, así como las bicis. Quiero recalcar la amabilidad de Tim, en nuestro último día nos dejó unos croissants muy bueno, fue un lindo gesto de su parte.
Great location & great accommodations! Justin is very responsive and a host I would rent from again!
We had some confusion on arrival as there are two buildings in the same development with the same street number but we found it. Jorge was very helpful and the apartment was great!

Andresa responded right away to any questions. Good location, loved the open living room/ kitchen, and the bedrooms were a good size. We used spothero to find parking in a nearby parking garage that was only a few blocks away. Short Uber ride to everything we wanted to do.
Great space and easy to get to our sons place. I would definitely stay again.
Great location, walkable to the beach, restaurants, grocery store right around the corner and  Wrigley Field.  Parking can be tricky.

The place was good for what we needed. The parking situation was a little confusing, but Donald helped us solve the issue. The instructions for getting in were very clear and the place was clean and functional.

Overall it was a great stay! Clean, comfortable, and kid-friendly. I have two complaints but both were entirely outside of their control, which is why I stuck with my 5 star review. The upstairs neighbor stomped so loudly it woke up our 7 month old more than once. Also, I'm 7ft tall and this space has low ceilings, so I hit my head, A LOT. So as long as you aren't 7ft tall or have a fussy baby, this is a great location. Walkable parks, safe neighborhood, and very friendly host!

This was an amazing stay for our vacation. The home was extremely clean, homey, and comfortable. It was about a 20 minute walk to the nearest train and super close to great restaurants. There’s a super nice park super close if you have time!! The neighborhood felt safe and clean. I would 100% stay here again!! They are both super communicative and helpful with any of my requests.
Awesome place!  Steps to Wrigley!

Cute area, easy to access & has parking! My sister and I had the best sleep while we were there, the bed & pillows were so comfortable and they have an amazing bathroom! Quick responses to the few things we needed to contact for!

The location was very close to the red line making the city very navigable without a car. It was a great place to cool off from the heat wave that took place during our visit. The bed was very comfortable and everything was very clean.
Room was very spacious and even better than the photos. Location was amazing. Check was super easy.  Host and hotel staff were very friendly and helpful.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was spotless, the balcony was a great place to relax, and the location was perfect—within easy walking distance of so many great restaurants and shops. The host was also incredibly responsive and made everything seamless.

Good location in Lincoln Park. Comfortable, well furnished, and very clean. Had everything we needed for our stay. The pull out sofa was very easy to use and perfect since we had a group of three. Host was very kind and responsive to our questions.
We enjoyed our stay.
Annie’s place is great. Right next to a park and great restaurants off Chicago Ave. Easy to get to public transportation and Divvy bikes. I would highly recommend.
Excelente lugar para quedarse con familia o por trabajo. Muy cómodo, bien implementado, moderno y muy bien mantenido

What a hidden gem! Not many walk ups in this neighborhood and this one is FABULOUS! The cutest little spot with everything that you need both at the Airbnb and just steps outside your door. Will definitely book again!
Cute area outside of downtown but still pretty easy to access transport. Hariharan was great and very helpful!

We loved our stay here and I’m sure we will be looking to rent this home again next time we’re in Chicago! Bucktown is in my opinion the best neighborhood in Chicago. I love that this home is about 1 block off 2 of the main streets so you have easy access to everything but it’s nice and quiet. The home itself is spacious, clean and well stocked. It also didn’t feel all beat up the way some airbnbs unfortunately can. Whether they’ve just had good luck with guests or they’re taking great care to repair and replace things, it feels like you’re in a brand new space.

Emily’s apartment was a wonderful way for our family to access Chicago. We came for a concert at Fenway and appreciated the fact that we were able to walk to the venue  though it was a bit of a hike. The apartment is clean and quiet- and the ac worked well, which was a big deal for our mid-summer trip to the city.
Great location to McCormick Place. Some rooms are just right next to the railway track so will hear the sounds.
很好的住宿体验

Great place right near the beach that is quiet and super convenient. The parking comes in handy if you are driving because extremely hard to find parking that close to the lake unless you have a spot.

We had a wonderful stay! Ivan was an excellent host — communicative, thoughtful, and clearly puts a lot of care into every detail. The place was spotless and beautifully maintained, and the location was fantastic. Everything from check-in to check-out was seamless. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and well-run space. We’d stay again in a heartbeat!”

The stay was great! The property is clean, super cool and exactly as described. The star off is only for the poor water pressure in the master bathroom upstairs as well as the bed being a little uncomfortable. Otherwise, everything was perfect!
Friendly host and clean home , will book again
We loved our stay at this apartment! We were in town for a concert, and this location was perfect for visiting a few Chicago attractions as well! It was clean and well-stocked for our short stay.

This was a perfect location for walking to events at Wrigley Field. I would recommend planning parking in advance. We ended up dropping off bags and then parking about 30 mins away and ubering back. Not a huge deal but would recommend reserving a spot in advance.
Pretty awesome place. Very close to restaurants and public rail systems. There was no need for us to use our car in the city.
Would stay here again

Yes, there is a toddler in the apartment above you. No, that should not stop you from booking Susan's place. The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and felt like home. It had all the amenities within that we required for our stay. The garden is absolutely beautiful and we spent quite a bit of time sitting in it. For being the city, it was peaceful and quiet. Yet it was still easily walkable to many things. Its also a short walk to the L which can easily get you to most of Chicago. I would definitely stay here again.
Great home - with plenty of room for a big family! We walked to great restaurants and had fun enjoying Chicago!

The apartment was fairly dingy. it felt like the place was a bit thrown together. There was definitely a bit of a bug problem too. On top of that, whoever cleaned the room last left very wet towels and sheets in the dryer without starting it, so when the dryer was opened, it smelt like bad mildew. I was told the street parking out front was all open which was NOT true. I talked to a police officer and he told me I would get towed or booted if I parked there overnight so I had to find alternative parking half a mile away. The fridge smelt so unbelievably bad I had to plug my nose whenever it was opened. Paint was chipping everywhere the bathroom seemed not well kept up at all, and the toliet is so bad you can't even flush toliet paper as told to me once I checked in. Overall just not worth the high price I paid whatsoever. it was nice that it was a mile and a half from Wrigley, but not close enough for that price or those conditions. It wasn't the worst stay but definitely not the best.
Agradable casa, se siente como hogar

Joanne made our stay so comfortable and cozy. The whole space was very accommodating for our needs. Clean, comfy bed, couch & extra linens. Bathroom was very large and so was the shower. Nice hot water, soft towels and access to washer/dryer. Nice full kitchen too. Nicely kept yard as well.
We loved walking everywhere from here. Nice neighborhood and walking distance to so many local eateries. Absolutely loved our stay and would definitely return. Thank you, Joanne!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Todd was a great host, with excellent communication and an easy check-in/check-out process. I would definitely stay here again when I come back to visit my son.
We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this Airbnb. Thanks again, Todd, for your hospitality!

Best Airbnb I have ever been to. Blocks from the convention center. Clean and a great open space. Very comfortable. We had a great time as a place to unwind each night after our show.
Definitely my go to from now on.

We hosted a big family gathering here, with people coming from Ann Arbor, Minneapolis, and Eau Claire, and this place nailed it. Tons of bedrooms, and we loved the layout, with the main living space up on the second floor giving everyone room to spread out. Lots of stairs throughout, so better for mobile groups, but our younger cousins treated it like a playground and had a blast.
Alexandria was an amazing host. We had a couple of random maintenance hiccups, and both times she responded fast, was reachable any time, and had a plumber out quickly. She even sent a cleaning crew the next day as a thank you. Rare level of care.
Old Town is one of the best home bases in Chicago: historic, walkable, gorgeous old buildings everywhere. We strolled to a Second City show and felt completely safe the whole time.
Fantastic spot for a big family gathering. We're already planning to come back next year.

Was traveling for work and I needed a place SUPER last minute (legit within an hour) and Drew came and saved the day! He responded immediately and I was able to check in very easily.
Stay here if you’re looking for a different (slash better) vibe than “downtown”
Citi bike station at the corner of the block made me so happy :)
Great place for big groups but I stayed here alone. Way better than the overpriced hotels nearby.
Neighborhood is 10/10 walkable. Like his listing says though, the train is right outside. Coming from NYC so this didn’t bother me at all.
Thanks Drew!
Had a great stay with both an infant and a dog. Location and apartment was perfect. Would highly recommend for an affordable, multi family stay
Demitri’s place was very cool, close to a lot, walkable to Wrigley, & great restaurants nearby.
Great home base near Lincoln Park and easy to get around the city. The apartment was the perfect size for our family to relax after a long day sightseeing.

My daughter and I went to see Noah Kahan at Wrigley field and wanted a close spot. The place was wonderful, clean and very comfortable.
Ute provided good recommendations for restaurants and was quick to reply. We would definitely stay again during our next time in Chicago!
Very modern place

The location is excellent! It’s walkable to anything you might need, and the neighborhood is quiet and charming. The common area was comfortable, but having another chair or sectional would improve it. The hosts were responsive, but the towel supply was a little stingy for a four‑day stay in the summer. Great location, decent apartment
Great place for the budget!

We had an amazing stay at Vince's place! The house was absolutely beautiful, spotless and had more than enough room for our entire group to stay comfortably. Everything we could possibly need was readily available, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
Vince was an outstanding host from start to finish. He was responsive, accommodating and truly went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect for our group.
