It was a hot time of year to visit but we slept comfortably after cranking the window unit AC on. Overall great value for Lincoln Park!

We really enjoyed our time at the OHC penthouse! It was great being able to park our car and leave it, traveling using the blue line located steps away. Matthew was a great host and the place was one of a kind!

Hannah and Mark were extremely communicative and the condo was perfect.  The parking space is very tight and challenging (which they describe in the listing). CTA is close with bus stops are only a few blocks away and the L just over half mile away. We had a minor issue with the building and Mark responded within minutes and was on-site to help/follow up almost immediately.
Abel was a wonderful host.  Gave clear instructions for check-in and check-out. Easy to find parking in this neighborhood.  Apartment was super comfortable and had all the necessary amenities.

Arlene was one of the best hosts I’ve ever interacted with on Airbnb. She was incredibly proactive and helpful during our stay to make sure we had no issues. The location is perfect and easily walkable to Wrigley Field, as well as great shopping and restaurants. The space was perfect for the two of us to stay and the bed was super comfy.

Great location across from the park. Limited on grocery stores in the area but great restaurants and farmers market twice a week directly across the street in the park.
Lovely stay.

Easy to find. Clean. Hvac worked excellently well which was v important to me in the thick of Chicago summer. I used the laundry machines multiple times. Cooked and cleaned up after myself.  Everything in the kitchen worked well. Good value. I would stay there again.

The space was large with high ceilings, and clean and secure (had to go through 3 sets of locked doors/gates to get in).  You have to walk several blocks to get to many restaurants.  The location is between an industrial area and a neighborhood, but was fine for catching an uber to downtown.  I was attending a trade show at McCormick place and it was a much cheaper option than nearby hotels.
brad was a very chill host 😁 easy check in/out

I really enjoyed my stay in Laura's unit.  It is in a very convenient location close to public transportation.  The apartment was very clean and it had everything that one might need during their time there.

Great little spot for a quick visit to Chicago. Located on a quiet street, with numerous walkable restaurants or shops and the train was just a few blocks away. The place itself was adorable, clean, and cozy. I would absolutely stay here again!
Great place to stay especially if you are visiting Wrigley Field.
Great place for McCormick events and getaway to Chinatown for food. Will definitely stay again for future McCormick events.
The apartment felt like home! It was clean and in a good location. A perfect location for a wonderful stay. Ben was very nice, helpful, and responded quickly to any messages!

This was perfect for what we needed. It looked just like the pictures. Very home like feeling. Gladys made sure it smelled good and everything was nice and clean. There was also everything we needed in case we had forgot something, I really appreciate that. It was in a great location. We were able to walk to a few convenient stores around the corner and it also was not too far from the places we had planned to go via uber. I would definitely stay there again.
It’s very far away from downtown in Chicago, you need take two buses to go there. It costs $5 to get to there.
Great location, convenient and walkable. Everything I needed for my business trip to Chicago. Will definitely book again if I am in the area.
Super convenient and smooth stay. Great communication and customer service / support from this host! Great place to stay for the conference that I attended in Chicago.

This was the perfect bnb for a trade show at McCormick Place. It’s a safe, 15 minute walk to the convention center. The place was easy to check in to and clean. Check out was also a breeze which I really appreciated.
Absolutely exceptional experience. You will not regret your stay at The Coach House. Perfect for a weekend trip!

It is a good place! I had some issues accessing the unit on day one. I ended up outside of the unit for over an hour communicating with the host as to why the lock wouldn't open. The view was beautiful, and the location was a quick bus ride to the loop/downtown. The space is definitely a bit older and beat up than pictured, but was very clean and put together. Can be a bit noisy at night, but earbuds were provided.
Overall great and easy stay!
They’ve thought of everything!

For two former Chicagoans—plus their kindergartner—this place felt like coming home. Fantastic location (one of the city’s best neighborhoods plus easy CTA access), thoughtful amenities, comfortable beds—just a great place to spend time between sightseeing. We can’t wait to come back on a future trip!
Very responsive, greeted us and told us useful information we had no idea of. Place was spotless and had many great features.

Wonderful place to stay. Clean comfortable, great amenities in the building, super helpful management, everything is easy and perfect. The beds are so comfortable we messaged to buy them for our own home. The views are gorgeous. I was there with my older parents and younger kids and it was easy for all to be together.
Nice and clean and has parking garage in the back that fits 2 cars so you don’t have to worry about getting parking spot, we’ll definitely be back to this place on our next trip to Chicago,
Great location! Perfect for enjoying Wrigley Field!
Theodora was very responsive and helpful. The place was a little further out to where we needed to be but still very walkable. I would recommend Theodora!

I expected Evanston to be safe, but it is not a central location. Gunshots around the corner both day and night. The hosts are abominable (they are not present on the premises at all times). Be warned: the weed smell is rampant. Not a clean space to stay. I had to visit the hospital and although I proved my (physical) condition related to smoke was legitimate, Joe tried to call me crazy for being on meds. I could not breathe. I have evidence I was off premises getting air when he began berating, called me “dramatic” and recommended I “go outside,” although I had heart palpitations. Rather than giving us permission to open a window, though my roommate Alice & I requested it simultaneously. This violates the law in Illinois. There is a serious problem with people sneaking drugs in so they tried to blame me for reporting it. Finally, they hide check-in instructions within the extended house rules. “Nico” then requests additional money through Z-elle. My clothes were stolen
Great hosts, extremely responsive and caring.
Place is clean and spacious. Each bathroom inside bedroom. Brad is responsive, if any problem come up, he’s take care of it.
Great host!

We absolutely loved our 3 nights at Debra’s place. It was stylish, clean, and very well appointed. They had everything we needed, and were quick to respond to any questions. The hosts said hello when we ran into them and were very friendly and welcoming! We stayed during a heat wave, and the ACs worked quietly and efficiently. Our kids loved the front porch and the vintage furniture. The beds were super comfortable and everything was easy to find. We can’t wait to stay here again next time we’re in town!
Great location, very clean, responsive hosts
Great location and next to great Chinese restaurants! Jun was very communicative and responsive. Apartment was clean and comfortable. Would stay again.

Brandon’s place was great! We loved the space, and the location.
When we realized we were missing something we needed they responded right away and accommodated us the same day.
Good experience for us!

Great location, close to Wrigley for our concert and walkable to coffee on Belmont. Excellent space with room to spread out. A lot of towels and extra pillows and blankets. Also a lot of entertaining extras - pool table, games, video games, tvs all over the place.  Garage is tight but we were able to fit an Escape and a Grand Cherokee in so it is workable for sure. Responsive hostess as well.  Strongly recommend for large groups and families.
Would stay here again!
Had a great stay at Joan’s apt. The apt was neat and well organized. Check-in instructions video really helped with process. Nice and safe location, would definitely recommend.
Great location and place was bigger than the pictures showed!
This was a perfect stay! The location was great. Easy access to the train, coffee shops, and great restaurants! We loved our stay and the connivence of everything. I highly recommend
Really enjoyed our short stay. I would have loved to spend more time here. The staff are amazing. Beautiful place!
Great communication and loved the area
Very nice location and home. This was our first trip into the area and we felt very safe and “at home”.
Super clean and a great amount of space.

Thank you so much for letting us stay. The house was perfect for our stay, both cosy and comfortable for our few nights. We were within walking distance from the Blue line tram to downtime and there were also some cute coffee shops in the area. The hosts were super responsive and helpful with any questions we had. Will definitely recommend Susie’s place to anyone who would like to stay in a nice Suburb of Chicago! Definitely a great spot!!
Very clean easy to get in and very spacious and great communication and place was very clean would love to stay again

Beautiful place to stay.
Walkable to restaurants and the McCormick Place.
The train is fun to have. I didn't find it loud. I slept great!
Petra was an amazing host that helped me check in early and place was in great location. Would recommend this place and her as a host 100/100 times !
We had a great stay at this place. It was very close to lots of shopping, food and the brown line. The host was incredibly helpful, kind and extremely responsive!
Todo muy Bien!!
Amazing location! Easy to find parking, great space, thoughtful touches. Would happily stay again ☺️
Fast wi-fi, easy check-in, great public transportation options nearby.
Walkable to McCormick and public transportation
On a beautiful street, close to the 151 bus, restaurants and the mag mile.

We stayed here for 5 nights over the weekend and really enjoyed our stay! The location is great, lots of super walkable restaurants, bars and coffee shops. It’s a 10 minute walk to the subway and parking was super easy and we were able to find some within a block. Inside the unit is good, all exactly as shown on the images and it fit perfectly for our group! Would highly recommend people to come here!

Lugar muy lindo, cerca de paradas del bus para quienes les guste conocer y tomar transporte público. La anfitriona es muy comunicativa y atenta de cualquier pregunta y problema que se pueda presentar. Muchas gracias por recibirme!

Clean, spacious apartment on a quiet street. Nothing fancy, but everything you need. 10 minute walk to the train, two quick stops to the Loop. Free street parking, never had a problem getting a spot. Be sure to check out the Sugar Shack and Pancho Pistolas a few blocks away.

fantastic place to stay! was exactly as described, clean, & comfortable. the location is perfect, easily walkable to millennium park, the riverwalk, restuarants, shopping, & train stops. highly recommend!

We were in town for a concert at Wrigley field and Kevin’s home was so great! Kevin was easy to communicate with. Check in and check out was easy. The location was awesome- easy to walk to restaurants, cafes, shops and wrigley field! Near the red and brown lines. It was very clean and had all the listed amenities. We drove in from Michigan so it was really nice to have the two parking spots (not a common amenities for this neighborhood). One thing to be aware of is the condo is directly next to the brown line and the train comes by every few minutes almost 24/7 (doesn’t run for a few hrs in the middle of the night). We got more use to it by night two but it was hard to sleep night one. Otherwise, Kevin’s place was great and we were really happy with our stay!!

I will be staying here in the future! I needed a place to stay for a couple of days in Chicago, and this place was super convenient as it was just 15 minutes away from the jobsite, you have Illinois Medical District within walking distance with several options and places to eat, and not too far from MDW airport.
It's very satisfying when you choose this place.

Exactly as described and extremely well located! Great nearby restaurants as well. Even with the extreme heat the fans and window units were able to keep it cool. Really comfortable place with everything you need.
We loved our stay! The apartment was nice and clean, the area was beautiful and had plenty to do. The best part was how close it was located to our event. 10/10 would recommend.

Exactly as described! This Airbnb is clean and well stocked with amenities. The location is amazing and very walkable to tons of cute places in Andersonville. Would definitely stay here again in the future!

Cleaning could have been better. There was a French fry left behind under the counter top table in the living room as well as goldfish crackers in one of the bedroom closets. Also bad mosquito problem at the entrance as it is sub-ground level and damp. Walkway along the front yard and side of house are difficult to navigate with children, strollers, or large luggage with wheels. Overall, I got what I paid for…

Yes the ceilings are low as it’s a basement unit, but if you are 6’2” or under you won’t have to duck. :-) Nice clean, quiet location and a great spot to stay. Easy to get to other areas of the city as well as close to good restaurants in Lincoln Square (Warbler was a fantastic meal for the price)….recommend the coffee at Luna Cafe, just a couple minutes north on Western! Would stay here again.

My friends and I very much enjoyed our stay. We found the apartments location, extremely convenient for walking to the downtown area or visiting the beautiful Michigan lake. The apartment was extremely spacious and comfortable. We loved our stay and would recommend this Airbnb to any of our friends.

We stayed here for a concert at wrigley and it was perfect! Not to close to the venue that we had to deal with the noise and traffic but close enough that we didn’t have to spend an arm and a leg for an uber after the show. Laura was super helpful and her communication was fabulous! She made sure to check in with us and send us helpful information all throughout our stay. I know some people mentioned it being noisy but honestly in my opinion it was no noisier than anywhere else I’ve stayed in Chicago! Overall a 10/10 and we would love to stay here again on our next Chicago trip!
Beautiful home, very clean, prepared for guests, check in instructions spot on, and very responsive
We had a good stay here! Host was very responsive and helpful when needed. Thanks for having us.
Amazing place and great location! Walkable to so many locations and easy access to public transit.  Would definitely stay here again!

We had a fantastic stay here! The location was absolutely terrific—great neighborhood—and the place itself was beautiful, clean, and comfortable. Also, the communication was great from start to finish. Highly recommend
Just a quick heads-up for future guests: the apartment is a 6-story walk-up. I might have missed this in the listing description, but it’s definitely something to keep in mind
Overall, we loved our stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone who doesn't mind a few stairs.

Great place with an awesome location. We stayed for a concert and it was so nice to be able to walk to and from wrigley, several bars/restaurants, and the red line. Bed was comfy and the unit was quiet.
Great space! Felt safe and comfortable!

Great location with tons of restaurants, shops, and a train station right around the corner. I recommend this place if convenience is a top priority for you. Just keep in mind that there are only stairs and no elevator in this building.

we stayed here for a concert! area was AMAZING! So many great places and everything is within walking distance you could need!
only complaint was it was VERY hot outside and the dehumidifier is broken. also there is three different doors to go through, our codes weren't working but we were provided a key! just scary to keep track of in a big unfamiliar city!
but truly would stay again!!!!!
Very good experience.  Loved the location, very comfortable place to stay. Hosts were responsive and friendly.  Would stay here again.
非常棒的入住体验！
Big w
I enjoyed my stay. The place was very clean, well-maintained and quiet. Andy is a great host. He was attentive, checked in throughout the stay and showed amazing hospitality.

Clean and spacious location. It was a quick walk to the train. The beds and pillows were great. I did ask about the free street parking when we arrived to confirm what I was seeing, and I was told there was no free parking anywhere and the only thing available was the $60 parking per night which is not true. There was free street parking all along where the Airbnb is located in the back front and on the side if you could find a spot (which we did).
Awesome location- apartment was perfect!  Would definitely book again.

Loved staying here! Check in and out was a breeze. Clear instructions on everything. House felt clean and smelled clean too! Location really can’t be beat either. We walked EVERYWHERE! And so it was great to be right off the red line. Made it so easy to get to where we wanted to be.

Location was excellent for visiting various parts of the city. It’s about a 4 minute walk from a major connection point for buses that we used every single day of our stay.
The air conditioning was excellent and such a relief every time we came inside.
The amenities were excellent, albeit in need of some TLC. We did make use of all of them during our stay and they were appreciated. The gym in particular stood out to me as being very impressive.
The noise at night was one of my biggest issues, being that you are only on the second floor just above the entrance. There was one night where people were having a loud, raucous conversation past one o’clock in the morning. The bed was comfortable, but a very soft mattress if you have a sensitive back. There is also a distinct lack of storage for luggage.
Water pressure was excellent and heated up quickly. The full size fridge was great. Water fountain in the gym to fill water bottles. We greatly enjoyed our stay and hope to return.
Made our stay very easy, very clean, neighborhood was very quiet.
The place is very nicely put together in a nice quiet neighborhood close to many hot spots. Access in and out was simple and having a dedicated parking spot was a major plus!

Erika's place is a great choice if you plan on attending an event at Wrigley Field.  It is on a quiet street, but is only one block from the field.  The apartment was clean, fully appointed and had an enormous garage, where we parked our minivan.  I highly recommend Erika's place.
We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Our host was incredibly welcoming and made the whole process seamless. Would definitely stay here again!

Nala and Owen were great hosts, responsive and attentive. Their place was beautiful and exactly as described. It is a little bit far from downtown but there’s a convenient bus stop 2 minutes away, over the weekends there is a bit of noise because there is a private event space on the upstairs floor but honestly the beds were so comfortable and we were so tired after walking +20k steps touring the city that we honestly did not notice it.
Thanks Nala and Owen!
Great stay, easy parking. Very walkable
Vilma’s place was very cute and clean. We had no issues staying here!

We had a great stay! This place had everything we could have possibly needed, and was very quiet and comfortable. The neighborhood felt safe, and having a designated parking space was a great bonus. I would definitely stay here again!
great place to stay for a concert at Wrigley.
It was a perfect place to stay, walking distance to main places around Chicago. The apartment was very clean and in perfect condition.
Nice place, convenient and appreciate there was a parking spot and it was close to transit. Laura was a communicative host and I appreciated her help with checkin in and a slightly later checkout

Host is very responsive and kind. He was able to answer every question 8 have. Thank you for hosting us.
Great stay, perfect location for bus/train, lots of restaurants that are walkable, clean, cozy space, we would definitely stay again.
I had a terrific stay at Ming’s place! It was very well located and a great value! I found everything to be very clean and well cared for. Ming was very responsive and welcoming!
Lovely private suite in a safe neighborhood, with easy access to great restaurants and the metro. Highly recommend for everyone!

We had a great stay. The apartment is within walking distance of McCormick Place, which was very convenient for our trip. The neighborhood felt quiet and safe throughout our stay.
The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well equipped. It had thoughtful amenities such as a hair dryer, a garment steamer, and a fully stocked kitchen with everything we needed.
The only minor issue was that the hallway carpets in the building could have been cleaner. This was outside the apartment itself, which was clean and well maintained.
Overall, we had a very positive experience and would recommend this place, especially for anyone attending events at McCormick Place.

Perfecto. Cada detalle esta pensado para que la estadia sea perfecta. Muy cerca del metro. Jannette nos dejo agua en la heladera lista para tomar. Ella nos respondio siempre en cuenstion de segundos. Además nos permitio hacer check in temprano.

Jhon was honestly a great host, very attentive, responsive and accommodating. The place was beautiful, and comfortable. The pictures were very accurate, very upgraded and beautiful kitchen. Thank you for everything.

What amazing stay! A beautiful building in a great location. From the comfortable beds to the snacks available in the kitchen to the delicious breakfast - everything was top notch. Will definitely look to stay here again on our next visit to Chicago - highly recommend.
We LOVED staying here. We have small kids and they loved the apartment too. It was very spacious and pretty. The location was amazing. We will definitely come back!

joseph's place was great! we came to the city for a concert at wrigley and it was right near a bus line and a short distance to the blue line. joseph was a great communicator and the stay was excellent!

There was utility work being done in front of the house the first day. It was extremely loud and disruptive. I called the host who said they would check with the city to get an update and get back to me. I waited 4 hours with no update so had to follow up again.
Additionally, the alarm panel malfunctioned at 3 AM and woke us up. Scared us all to death as we weren’t sure if there was a break in or not.
When I messaged the host, it was clear that the responses were coming from a bot.
We decided to check out a day early, asked for a late checkout, and we were told we couldn’t get one because they needed to have the house available in case someone else wanted to rent it.

Everything about the place was really good. There was a little issue with the AC in one of the room. The host communicated timely about it and came by to check too. I would recommend this place to anyone who likes a peaceful neighbourhood. The rooms are a little small but the common areas are spacious.
A perfect close walk to Wrigley field!
This was such a cute place in a cute neighborhood! It was exactly as described and made for a cozy place to sleep at night. I will look out for this place the next time I go to Chicago!

The apartment was cuter than we thought. Great decor, nice tv in the living room and both bedrooms, modern washer and dryer, amazing AC, and owner was very responsive when we had questions. If I’m in Chicago again I will definitely stay here!
Thank you!

Recently stayed here for mini-vacay and the unit looks exactly like the pictures. I had issues gaining access to lockbox because I did NOT watch the video. Katty was kind to help me and thank goodness I didn’t need anything else. Felt totally safe in the area & building. I noticed that Katty provided ear plugs. I wasn’t sure why they were there because the neighborhood & building were quiet in the evenings. I slept great. Kitchen was well stocked for making any meals. All bathroom items such as towels, body wash, and hand soap were available.
The best part of this unit is the location. I walked 1 block and rented a bike and rode the Lakeside Trail admiring Lake Michigan, that was less than a mile away. You can walk to some of the best restaurants, and Trader Joe’s, Target, and the Obama Center are less than 2 miles away. Virtue & 14 Parish are outstanding restaurants.
I highly recommend this place. Thanks for a wonderful stay, Katty. I had a blast and can’t wait to come back and visit

Milan was communicative and responsive throughout the booking process and stay, which I really appreciate and checked in about how my stay went. I booked this spot because of its proximity to a work conference but unfortunately, had to end my stay early due to a strong chemical odor that was irritating me. The space is smaller than it appears in the photos which isn’t a big deal for me just sharing for awareness. The mattress was uncomfortable and basically a piece of foam. I left after my first night. They also don’t allow any visitors unless they are listed on the reservation which I found odd as someone who has stayed at many Airbnb’s over the course last decade and never seen such a stringent rule. I completely understand a no party rule but not allowing any visitors is unreasonable. There’s a surveillance camera angled at the door to the unit to enforce the rule.
Spacious, clean and will located.
No
Would stay again, Kim was quick to respond and had great local recommendations. Location was near the train to get down town.
All was excellent
We had a nice stay. The place was comfortable. Private parking was a plus. It was easy to find and Laura was very responsive anytime we had questions. Would stay here again.

The house was exactly as described, clean, with parking & excellent location to Wrigley. We enjoyed easy access, to Wrigley, quick in/out for the concert which was welcome in the heat. Walking distance to other things we wanted to do & easy access to the L. Would definitely recommend & would book again. Only caution is  upstairs accommodations were not easy to get up & down the stairs but had to do with age of house.  All in all, perfect.
The host was very responsive. The place is a little smaller than expected, but still nice and clean. Did not have any issues staying here.

Beautiful home and neighborhood with communicative, accommodating hosts. We appreciated all the local recommendations—lots of good food, shopping and transportation nearby. Parking was a breeze and passes were provided. Great place to unwind and relax after exploring the city!
todo realmente espectacular, la limpieza, la comodidad, la ubicación....todo genial, lo recomiendo ,100%.....

This was a home away from home!
I stayed with my parents in one of the rooms and this place was the best thing about our trip! Would absolutely recommend if you are looking for a cutie host, a cozy feeling and a peaceful place!
One of the best Airbnbs in Chicago I would say!

The place was just how looked in the listing. Jorge was very responsive abd timely. We a little trouble with check in finding thr building but he was very quick to help out. Overall it was a good stay.
Fun amenities and Freddy was very communicative
Great location

Great location, walking distance to great bars and restaurants. Few blocks from the brown line which was easy to navigate. The neighborhood was very cute and had friendly vibes. The apartment was perfect for our needs.
great stay
Beautiful building and unit with few issues. The host was extremely communicative and responsive.
Nicole place was very clean and modern and we felt very safe, she was great to talk to and we felt like we've been knowing her forever! no complaints...
Becky and Ryan were fantastic and welcoming hosts. We will be coming back the next time we’re in town!

Sarah was a great host.  Very responsive to all my special requests.  I even left something there and she went back to retrieve it for me.  Great place with split level bedrooms on both floors for privacy.  Clean bathrooms and entire place.  Tons of towels, soaps, kitchen items.

The place was very cute, clean, and comfortable. A couple issues with the keypad- the code did not work when checking in and then stopped working late the next day. However Sean was responsive and quickly problem solved so we could enter. Very walkable and close to Wrigley. Bagel place underneath was great!

The apartment was very nice and just as it was described in the listing. The neighborhood is very cute with easy access to Lincoln Park and lots of restaurants.  Parking is a bit of a challenge if you have a car, but definitely not impossible. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay there again if back in Chicago.

I loved it here!  So close to the el stop, very convenient.  Super clean, too.  But what I loved the most was how nice Tim was.  He answered several questions for me and made sure I felt welcome and had all the information i needed.  I felt very comfortable at this place and would stay here again every time!

Enjoyed our stay here! It was walkable to many great places in Lincoln park and suuuper easy to navigate to the train in the event you want to explore other neighborhoods! It was clean & felt safe with lots of easy and free parking!

Stayed here for an event at Wrigley. It was an easy walk to the stadium and back, and there were many restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance as well. The place was exactly as described with clear directions on how to get in and out, and the communication from the host was consistent and helpful! Would definitely stay here again for an event like this in the city.

My sister and I stayed here for a weekend and it worked well. Angela’s place matches the description - the building is older, therefore there is noise from upstairs apartments and the parrot that can be heard from the unit, but nothing that isn’t mentioned in the listing already. The unit has everything you need for a stay in the city, and is walkable to the L, coffee, food, etc. Angela was responsive and proactive when it came to communicating about needs and updates regarding our reservation. If you read the full listing and are okay with everything mentioned, I would definitely recommend the unit for a short stay in the city! Cannot find anything else in the area for this price.

I stayed here for a month, and Clara made the space feel like home! Anything that I requested was mediated within minutes, the kitchen was well stocked for everything that I needed to cook, and there’s a Divy bike station across the street if you’d like to explore Chicago. I’d stay here again, for sure.
The houses was perfect accommodating, the host also took us in last second which we are so thankful for! And the hot tub was perfect! Thank you for an amazing stay!

I have been an Airbnb member for about 7–8 years and have stayed in many Airbnb homes. I don’t always leave reviews—usually only when I am truly impressed and really enjoy the place. Azam’s house is one of those places, and I would love to come back and stay here again.
The house is extremely clean. I especially love the beautiful hardwood floors throughout the home, with area rugs instead of wall-to-wall carpet. The design and decoration of the house are tasteful and make the space feel very warm
The beds were incredibly comfortable, especially the king-size bed in the master bedroom. The pillows were so comfy, and I slept very well during our stay. I also appreciated the extra blankets and pillows that were provided—it made us feel even more comfortable and cared for.
Another big plus is the two-car garage. In a big city like Chicago, parking can be very difficult, and most places only offer street parking. Having a private garage was a huge advantage and made our stay much easier

I can’t say enough about how much fun we had at this day. It was a seven minute walk to Wrigley Field where we got to see the Noah Kahan concert. There are so many restaurants, shops, and cafés within a 10 minute walk to this place. The rooms were very comfortable. I can go on and on about how lovely the little neighborhood is. My wife and I and our two teenagers were with us. The place itself was well appointed with coffee pods, toothbrushes and soap and other small items that you could easily forget. This is honestly probably the easiest checkout I’ve ever had.
The only thing that I had an issue with was The Parking. Apparently I didn’t fill out the parking pass for the instructions and received a ticket. I wish more information would’ve been given on this as I’ve never been to Chicago before. Aside from that, the only thing I would change about the accommodation would be to add a chair to the living room. There was only one couch and we all didn’t fit on it.

Stayed there several years in a row.
Little change. Few improvements.
Basic but good value if you're in town for a conversation.
Wish check in could be adjusted for repeat guests.

One of our favorite AirBnBs we've experienced in Chicagoland. Tree-lined, dog-friendly neighborhood with easy public transportation to downtown. Apartment is beautiful and well-appointed. Kept us cool in one of the summer's heat waves. Enjoyed dinner at iconic Twin Anchors a few doors down. Appreciated being able to use the washer-dryer in the basement, and the host accommodating a later check-out.
So lovely!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this loft. We were in town for a funeral, unfortunately, and needed a place to accommodate our group. It was larger than we had imagined! It was very comfortable for us. Other than the glitch of having some difficulty because the code was not changed for the entry door, everything else was perfect. Even with this difficulty, the response time was more than adequate, and the issue was resolved fairly quickly.
Also worth noting, the communication was exceptional, which we really appreciated. We never waited more than a few minutes for a response from the hosts, which is almost unheard of! I would highly recommend this Airbnb.
One of our highlights of staying in this location was taking a walk to the Robey hotel and having a drink at the rooftop bar at sunset. The views were amazing. Highly recommend doing that if you were in town.
Fenton’s place was great! Perfect for a few days of touring downtown and attending a concert at Wrigley. It was comfortable, clean and a short distance from pretty much all things Chicago!

This flat was fantastic. Absolutely beautiful - the photos don’t really do it justice. Beds were comfortable and the shower was awesome! Great location as well, walking distance to all sorts of great stuff- shopping, restaurants, and wrigley field! Host was also great. Thank you!
Nice place, near from downtown, very responsive host,

Bradford's home was a wonderful place to stay during our trip to Chicago! It was close enough to downtown attractions for easy sightseeing, yet far enough away to enjoy a quiet, peaceful neighborhood in the evenings making it perfect for traveling with our toddler. We loved taking afternoon walks around the neighborhood after spending our mornings exploring the city. The home was incredibly spacious and comfortably accommodated three adults, one toddler, and our dog. Everything made for a relaxing and enjoyable stay. We will definitely be booking again the next time we visit Chicago!

very wonderful stay! my sister and i went to see noah kahan in concert and this was the perfect place for us to stay. host was very responsive and accommodating, and the view was just as beautiful as the photos, if not more stunning. very happy we chose this.
Felt like home away from home. Lots of character and thoughtful touches in this home. Will be back hopefully soon 👍🏻

Dawn place felt comfortable and fit our needs for a 9 day trip. There are a couple of shops and restaurants walking distance and a nice park, and green corridor for urban walking or running nearby. The place felt quiet and calm.
Tudo ótimo com a estadia!!!

Place was in great location . Accessible to train and bus . It’s exactly how it looks. It just was not clean properly . And a bit of issue with parking late at night. Otherwise was a great stay. I’ll recommend other guest to rent tho apartment

One of the cutest & most efficient places we’ve stayed in our travels; very clean, small studio &had all we needed for a weekend in Chicago. Was there for the Noah Kahan concert and was literally a couple blocks from Wrigley field~ it couldn’t have been more perfect! Also a quick uber ride to anywhere you wanted to go downtown~ very convenient and prime location while also being in a very peaceful and walkable neighborhood. It truly couldn’t have been any better if you’re coming to town to tour around!
I had some challenges with an injury before arriving so Bella switched our reservation around to a ground unit to accommodate that without me even having to ask, so that was a nice touch that I greatly appreciated. Lastly, I know some have said she is late to respond and we experienced some delays at times as well, but she does manage a multitude of other properties, so please keep that in mind; Bella is a terrific host.
I would highly recommend to anyone and would stay again myself!

This Studio apartment was perfect for two people and the area was a lovely neighborhood … walking distance to restaurants, etc. The apartment was beautifully decorated and very clean. As mentioned in the description-there definitely is a loud /heavy footed Neighbor who seems to be doing some sort of dance routine through all hours of the night. We appreciated the sound machine, but would advise  light sleepers to bring ear plugs. Other than that, the apartment was perfect.
to stay here was very good. everything was clean and neat and tidy
Great location, place and host
Great location in the middle of it all.  Lots of street noise especially in 1 bedroom but worth it.

Close to areas of interest.
Comfortable.
Nice parking spot.
Very nice visit.
One of the best places I've stayed.  Joe is an amazing host!

Had a great stay at Miya‘s place and would definitely stay again. The place was spacious, extremely clean, comfortable, and located in an ideal location. It’s a short 5 minute walk to the red line/subway, Whole Foods grocery (with an Aldis supermarket across the street), and great neighborhood restaurants. Although Michigan Avenue/Magnificent Mile was a short 5-10 minute walk away, the location of Miya‘s Place was on a quiet street away from heavy foot and car traffic. We walked to the Navy Pier numerous times and which took about 25-30 minutes on a leisurely pace. The place looks exactly as depicted in the photos and Miya herself was extremely friendly and responsive to all our questions. She went out of her way to get us a kettle when we requested one and had snacks and drinks ready upon our arrival. Bathrooms, bedrooms, living room, and kitchen were all pristine, and the air hockey table was a great touch! Thank you again for the wonderful stay!

Anastasia’s place was clean and comfortable. It had everything we needed for a short stay, and was a quick walk to Andersonvilles main drag. The parking spot was a nice addition, and she communicated with us promptly during our stay. Would recommend!
Lovely neighberhood !
Another great stay! Rafael’s place is the perfect place to stay. Clean. Quiet. Great area.
Maria was a great host who was very responsive and helpful! The place was clean  and we would definitely stay here again!
Enjoyed our stay and was exactly as described. We will stay again when we visit!

Thank you so much to my house emily and Roya. Had a wonderful day. They were super responsive and everything was just as it was described online. Definitely helped with some of the recommendations on stuff to do when I wasn’t working.
Great location, nice room, easy check in, lots of cats
The space was great, lovely accommodations in the heart of the City.  Great coffee downstairs, easy access, very comfortable.  Hosts were easy to reach and very helpful.  Would definitely stay again.

Fantastic stay at the Greenleaf House! This place was such a good value in an amazing location. I loved how the space was dog-friendly—my pup definitely enjoyed his stay as much as I did. Brian was a great host and I’d 100% stay here again.
We had a great stay at Charles’s place. Would definitely stay there again.
Had a great stay at Sharon’s place. She and her husband were helpful and responsive. The unit is quiet and tucked away behind the street, well equipped, and clean. Thank you for having us!

We enjoyed our stay here. The apartment was perfect for our needs and the location worked very well for our plans in Chicago. We also appreciated the instructions and communication from check-in through check-out.

It was what we needed for a few night stay in Chicago. It was super close to the red line which made it easy to travel. The building was a little noisy, but that was well stated beforehand and didn’t affect our stay in any way. We were able to find parking on one of the streets they suggested.
Great place,very clean and worth every penny!! Will be staying again.!
It was good. The area was a little far out there.
very clean and nice apartment,  host were very responsive in a quick manner, will definitely book with them again....
Great location in a nice neighbourhood. Short walk to Armitage station. Found Greg to be a responsive host. Room as described - perfect if you are just looking for somewhere to sleep.
We loved our stay at Alan’s place! The proximity to Wrigley Field cannot be beat! The home was very comfortable and beautiful. It was great to have an outdoor space to relax as well.

This was a good stay for us -- we came in for a few days and didn't spend much time. The place was clean and well taken care of and the rooftop deck is pretty cool. The host gave really clear instructions (with photos as well) to make sure check-in ran smoothly, and we had no issues during our stay. Giving it 4 stars only because the location isn't the most convenient if you're going into the city each day and the neighborhood isn't great for things to walk to. We had to take a Lyft anytime we wanted to go anywhere. But if you're staying outside the city and/or don't care about that, this place works!
A note: it is on the 4th floor so you do have to go up a lot of stairs (keep that in mind with luggage)!
This is the 3rd year to get this place for business use, great location between Chinatown and McCormick Place.
Great place to stay. There for a trade show at McCormick Place. Short 10 minute walk away. Saturday night was a treat - if you like the noise! Aside from that, no complaints.
I would definitely come back and stay.  It was comfortable and convenient. I appreciate the amenities.

Stephanie's place is amazing!  2 large bedrooms, 2 large baths, and a full kitchen/living room.  It is immaculate and such a great spce.  Views were great from the large windows.  24 Hour doorman, pool, theatre room, game room, BBQ's are some of the amenities that are included.  Walkable to supermarkets, eateries, and more.  More than enough room for 2 couples or a small family.  I would stay here again in a second.  Treat yourself!  It is a great place!

Stayed here while in town for a Noah Kahan concert and glad we did! It was affordable, SO close to the red line train along with many restaurants and shops (10 minute walk or less) and had everything we needed during our stay. Initially when arriving it was confusing for 30 seconds on where to go/which building was which, but thanks to Dave’s precise directions we were able to figure it out in no time. Dave was proactive when it came to giving us key information as well, which we appreciated! Overall a great stay and would recommend to others.

The place was great for our trip to Chicago! Dan was super communicative and helpful when small issues arose and worked quickly to get them resolved.
A major plus of this place was the close proximity to the pink line station!
Warning, the ceilings are short, we’re around 5’6” and with our shoes with one or 2 inches added to our heights it felt like we were almost touching the ceiling. But it wasn’t a problem for us!
Everything clean and comfortable, attention in every moment!
Nice place. Will sure stay again
This property was amazing, and it was so easy to get out and enjoy Andersonville.  We hope to be able to stay there again.

The ground level apartment is charming and clean. It's located near Logan Square which makes walking to some great places easy. Getting into the loop area was a breeze. We used public transportation most of the time. Thank you Sarah for an excellent stay.

We loved staying here! The space was great and in a prime location. It was clean and matched the listing description. Hattice is responsive and friendly and made sure we were enjoying by our stay.  Step right outside and walk all of Old Town to enjoy the famous architecture. Walkable to the Lincoln Park Zoo. Just as easy, use the subway to go downtown. We felt safe and like locals staying here. The nearby Italian restaurant was fantastic. I 100% recommend staying here if you want to enjoy Chicago like a local and use the subway for city transpo!

We had a great two-night stay! The owners were very responsive, provided excellent communication and directions, and even let us purchase two street parking passes at the last minute, which was incredibly helpful. The apartment was an easy walk to Wrigley Field, making it a perfect location for our concert and it had lots of thoughtful amenities that made our stay comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!

O apartamento é como nas fotos, mas no calor que estava de verão os ar condicionados não conseguiam resfriar os quartos, principalmente. Ele fica em andar alto, mas mesmo assim o barulho da rua, especialmente aos finais de semana, pode atrapalhar a dormir, recomendo tampões de ouvido. O ambiente é espaçoso e bem equipado. Obrigada pela hospitalidade.

We stayed here for concert at Wrigley field! It was approx 25 min uber ride but a great location where we could drive to things without feeling too overwhelmed with city traffic. We had issues with permit parking, but the host gave us alternatives that were easily found and we were able to park without issues. Did feel like the bathroom wasn’t perfectly clean with some hair in the sink and in the shower.. I am pretty picky about my bathroom cleanliness but otherwise felt like it was clean. Comfortable bed and pillows with cool AC for the crazy heat wave. Would stay again!

This is a nice place to stay for a couple or single person trip. Neighborhood is nice and isn’t noisy. The home does have a drive to downtown + traffic so leave early for any plans. Other than that everything in the home was very clean and includes essential things.

We had a great stay and really appreciated the cold AC during the summer heat wave! The room is in an awesome historical building and the location could not be better if you want to visit River North and visit the river walk.
The bed is extremely comfortable.

We had an excellent stay at this amazing property!  The layout is such that bedrooms and bathrooms were on multiple levels of the house, allowing for space and privacy for our entire crew.  Lovely rooftop deck with 360 degree views of the city.  Updated baths and showers were a bonus.  Peaceful location between River North and Gold Coast neighborhoods, with easy street parking.  And Florin was a great host.  Highly recommended!

He was very welcoming as if old friends. He gave me tea. Was helpful. And was flexible with checking checkout times. His place was clean. I would definitely stay here again. I wish I stayed longer to. Explore the neighborhood. He gave recommendations and he also respected privacy.

We stayed here while attending a conference. The property is in a great location, within walking distance of several iconic attractions and our conference shuttle stops. It was very clean and comfortable, and Cyndi was an amazing, helpful, and supportive host.

Nice place if you just need a no frills spot. It has everything you need for your stay. However, if you have a lot of luggage to carry this isn't the place for you. It's on the third floor of a walk up with a tiny staircase.

We had a great stay here! It is such a pretty neighborhood with lots of charming streets but quiet and peaceful. The air mattress was losing air and the host replaced it right away. She was very responsive and made sure we had a good stay! We did not have kids on this trip but would definitely come back here with ours, it was very family friendly!

We had a great time. Location was right by lots of restaurants and public transit. Our hosts were very responsive and reached out to offer any help we might need. It was a nice apartment to spend the weekend!

We had an overall great experience with this location.  We had a little bit of a communication error early on where we thought we had to go to a different door to access the place, however that was quickly addressed and from there no issues moving forward.  One thing to note is that this space was located on the top floor and the only way to get to it, was walking up 5 floors.  Not a big deal, just for people with small kids, or if you have bad knees, might want to plan for this.  The place itself is located in a great spot for restaurants, bars, or just walking around.  Will definitely stay here again if in the area!

Meighan’s place was the perfect home base for a friend trip. Delicious & diverse food options within a short walk. Stunning back garden to relax in between adventuring. Very close to public transit. Would love to stay again one day!
Perfect location if you are going to a show!
This home was exactly as posted. It was very walkable …. Could see Wrigley field from the front stoop. Home was clean and very spacious. Would definitely stay here again when visiting Chicago again!
Lovely private room and place overall for our quick stay.  Impeccable cleanliness and kindness. Khang was so welcoming and offered us helpful items for our planned activities.
Very spacious, great location. Highly recommend

The perfect studio for a stay to see a concert at Wrigley! Very clean, well decorated, and has everything you need, from a small kitchen to big bed. So walkable to everything, loved strolling down Southport and the train is less than 5 mins away. Highly recommend!
Amazing stay! It was the perfect place for our group of 6. Very grateful for Joan, who was an awesome host. Thank you!

Daniel is the best host I’ve ever had. Very helpful and responsive. His place felt like home, seriously, I’m not exaggerating anything. The place was incredibly clean and organized, to the point where the silverware were all match and organized. Sleeping at Daniel’s place was one of my best sleep. The pillows and mattress were the most comfortable in terms of the balance between firmness-softness; turns out they were similar brands I use at home. So great choice of bedding stuff! The location was strategically close to several bus stops. There are lots of food options as well just within 1 min walk.
Clean and comfortable! Great walking distance to a lot!

We recently stayed at Josh’s place for a concert at Wrigley. The apartment was perfect for us- clean and lots of amenities. The location was an easy walk to Wrigley and there were several food options nearby as well. Josh was a great host and very responsive to our questions!

Lito & Chip were such amazing hosts! Extremely helpful and genuinely kind people~
Their place truly has everything you might ever need and more 🌸
Delia was  a great host!

This is located within walking distance of a ton of great shops and restaurants! The neighborhood was very quiet and the basement unit is very easy to get to without interfering with upstairs tenants. Fresh linens and a very clean kitchen and bathroom! The only thing keeping it from a full 5 stars was it was a little warm, the AC was having trouble keeping up. It looks like HVAC company was there working on something as we checked out, so I’m sure it’s being rectified.

We had a wonderful stay at this charming upper apartment in Chicago's McKinley Park neighborhood during our girls trip. The host was fantastic and provided such clear, detailed instructions that we never needed to reach out with any questions. Check-in was effortless and made arriving stress-free.
The apartment was exactly as pictured; clean, comfortable, and absolutely adorable. The decor was thoughtfully done and made the space feel cozy and welcoming. Everything was well maintained, and we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
We really appreciated how accurately the listing represented the property, as there were no surprises upon arrival. This is a great option for anyone looking for a cute, comfortable home base while visiting Chicago. We would absolutely consider staying here again and would happily recommend it to others.

I was very comfortable in my own surroundings.  Monica quickly responded any time I needed her.  Perfect place to stay if you ever need convenience, a laundry room and a nice kitchen.  She provided extras to get me started in the bathroom and the kitchen.   I enjoyed my stay.  The outside was always kept up and clean.  Close to a lot of restaurants also.  Nice place to stay
Good place

My family and I truly enjoyed our stay at Thomas’s property. The location is absolutely ideal, offering unmatched convenience with a variety of restaurants and shops just steps away. We were especially blown away by the rooftop terrace, which offers breathtaking, 10/10 views. If you want a spacious, comfortable, and peaceful retreat not far from the action, this is the perfect place to stay

Great location and a great host that quickly responded to inquires. Would def stay there again. Parking could be tricky as there was only spaces available on Fullerton. Adjacent sides streets were restricted to local residents and required permits.
Great spot!!
Everything was perfect!

We had a great time staying here! Super close and an easy walk to Wrigley, restaurants, bars, cafes and shops. The location was fantastic. The unit was spacious and the pool table was lots of fun. We would definitely stay here again!

Location was great, the neighborhood is nice.
The place has some features that most airbnbs in the area might not have (garage, small yard, laundry) and the kitchen and common areas were spacious. The rooms were a little tight if you aren't from a big city but overall the house had plenty of space.
Internet was good and shower was nice and hot. The host made sure the place was well stocked with plenty of towels and full kitchen.
Well worth the money.
Great spot, very close to the metro

Host was incredible, the space was exactly as described, spotless and comfortable, the perfect place to stay just out of the busy city, located a block away from a train station so it was a great place to take a train into the city, 10/10 would recommend and plan to stay again someday!
Enjoyed our stay! Was great location and had no issues.
Great location and charming place to stay!

Loved the air bnb decorum.  When we arrived the place was pretty clean. A few small improvements could have been made like cleaning out the window seal which had a dead bug in it and hair that was under the bed.  Michelle responded within an hour whenever we reached out. The rooms all had comfortable beds my only complaint was the bedroom closest to the street was extremely loud when trying to sleep you could hear every car, siren,or airplane that went by. Also that same was warmer than all the others. Overall it was a very nice place that just needed a few small adjustments to make it perfect.

Beautiful neighborhood. Park is so close- if you like to run or walk it is perfect. The wild flowers in the park were amazing ! Close to restaurants too
Home was perfect for the 6 of us Lots of room. Felt right at home
Fantastic location, near transit and the beach. Our stay was fantastic no issues, really happy with our stay!

Such a fantastic experience! This Airbnb is in a great location, making it easy to get around and explore. The entire place was spotless and clean, and we had a wonderful time staying here. Thank you for being a great host!
Great Airbnb in the Chicago area! We traveled for a concert and loved being close to Wrigley field, and the tons of things to do. Love how accessible it made the city feel for us!

Excellent location! Very clean and actually quiet.. despite being on a busy street. The only issue we had was the key was difficult getting into and turning the lock to access the building. Other than that is was a perfect stay for our needs! Thanks for the excellent service and quick responses.
Comfortable, clean, and in a great location!

We stayed here for a week long trip in Chicago. Fairly decent, friendly host. Parking had some rules that weren’t disclosed to us. The place looked clean at first but still needed some work done, the cleaning job looked a bit rushed in some areas, and there was open leftover food left in the fridge. Cute green area, very safe and comfortable. Overall it was a great place and Ruth was very sweet to us.
What an incredible homy place. Really enjoyed it, and was perfect for my business trip.

The location was wonderful. It is just around the corner from a coffee cafe, book shop, and the L red line for quick and easy access to downtown and Wrigley Field.
The accommodations were clean and organized; we loved the space of the front sitting area with the natural light coming in from the front bay window alcove.

Great Airbnb in a safe location!! Host instructions were very clear and easy to understand. Checking in and out was smooth. The 2-bed/2-bath was spacious, clean, and comfortable.  Well equipped, there were so many thoughtful touches.  Having the train station and on-site parking made navigating the city easy.  We would recommend this place and would absolutely stay here again!

The apartment was clean, beautifully decorated and comfortable. A grocery store, many restaurants and some shops were within walking distance. Check in and check out instructions were clear and simple. Highly recommend!
Awesome location with an insane amount of food choices. Would stay here again.
I had a great stay here very nice!
Great location and value.  Would stay again.

Michael’s place was absolutely beautiful. They have added so many nice touches, and it is absolutely a gem of an AirBnB. They have figured out how to do AirBnb really well, and we appreciated how helpful and kind he was as a host. Gorgeous place, safe, comfy beds, and special additions.

We really enjoyed our stay. Great walking distance to so many restaurants, bars, Wrigley Field and much more. Great community with families and young adults walking around. The only drawback that maybe I missed is the L train is very close by. So that first train is definitely something you hear. We got used to it but it is noticeable.
We were all happy with the location.
Hosts were extremely responsive to any and all questions leading up to, during, and even after the stay. Very clean and great location.
Great stay near to public transport

We enjoyed our stay at Mindy and Tony’s iKlektik House. Everything was clean, instructions were clear, and the space was cozy and peaceful, which was made for a perfect place to rest in between exploring the city. It was also really nice being in walking distance of a great coffee shop! Would definitely stay at another of Mindy and Tony’s properties in the future and would recommend this stay to others.

This place was spacious, beautifully designed, thoughtfully stocked, and in the perfect location.
We walked almost everywhere—to the Magnificent Mile, the Merchandise Mart, the Chicago River, shopping, coffee shops, and some of the sweetest neighborhood restaurants. Having a grocery store and pharmacy on the block made it easy.
I brought my four kids—three teenagers and one pre-teen—to Chicago to experience the city that first sparked my love for design, architecture, and creativity. This space was easy to house all of us with 3 bathrooms and an entire 2nd story.
Architectural boat tours, museums, shopping, matcha runs, late-night card games, Noah Kahan at Wrigley Field, Jack Johnson at Northerly Island, long walks through neighborhoods I once called home, and all the little details that made for a magical trip for all of us.
Wonderful location and simple check in process!
Lovely place, will stay again!
Was very nice, clean, and convenient. Host was great!
good

Place looked just like the pictures and was very nice! The area is great and had plenty of options for food and activities, very walkable and safe. Parking could be difficult depending on the time of day but overall not that bad. It was very  nice that there was free parking nearby. The only negative was that the electronic lock on the door gave us some trouble, I think it may need charged or something. But overall a great stay and a great place! Definitely recommend!!

Nala and Owen were amazing and very communicative. They gave very clear instructions and clearly take care of the space. I felt like I was at home and was able to sleep easily even at a new place which is rare for me! Would love to stay again.

We had an excellent experience during our stay. Andris was friendly, attentive, and easy to communicate with, making everything simple from arrival to departure. The property was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Having a dedicated parking space was a plus!
We truly enjoyed our time here and would gladly stay again. We highly recommend staying here to anyone looking for a comfortable place and great host.

We loved our time here. It is great location wise for anyone going to Wrigley. The parking pad in back was great for us driving into town to not worry about parking. Decor is chic. AC was cold. You get used to the train noise pretty quick unless sensitive but ear plugs were used by our noise sensitive and they worked perfect. Would definitely stay again.
We booked same-day for impromptu college tour visits, and it was a great two-night stay. The space is very well laid out for two guests, and we were able to find free parking within a block.

Die Wohnung ist Tip Top, alles bestenst.
momentan sind aber nur einer von fünf Fahrstühlen in Betrieb, was sehr nervig und zu langen Wartezeiten führt und die Haupt Dachterrasse ist wegen Renovierung geschlossen, was nicht die Schuld vom Vermieter ist sondern die dir Wohnung, weswegen man hier nix anmerken kann.
Wir durften aber die zweite Dachterrasse im zweiten Haus nutzen, was sehr schön war.
alles in einem ein sehr guter Aufenthalt, preislich natürlich etwas teuer, was aber an der sehr guten Lage mitten in Chicago liegt.
Vielen Dank

My 20 year old daughter and her 20 year old friend were in Chicago to attend a concert.  Vin was not only extremely responsive, but he was thorough and asked questions about my daughter and her friend to make sure he was having responsible individuals staying at his place.  I would highly recommend.  I had a few questions, and he always responded within minutes.

Kyriako's flat was generally comfortable stay. Communication was excellent—quick to reply—and the location is great, just a 20-minute drive into the city with easy street parking. The flat is also well-stocked with everything you need.
However, it's smaller than expected, and the sofa is in the building's entrance hallway, not inside. The mini AC is quite loud; we had to turn it down at night. Cleanliness was a letdown, as we found dirty false eyelashes on the bed on our last night—which made me wonder about the sheet changes, since I had been feeling itchy since day 1.
Overall, it’s a decent place, but I do hope these points are improved for future guests.

Such a great location to stay. Andersonville is a wonderful community with great restaurants and bars. It’s also just a short walk to the red line and the bus stops that allows you to get anywhere in the city.
It was super lovely and the hosts were great. Appreciate them and their kindness.

Had a great stay in this 3 bedroom apartment. Location was very convenient, check in was smooth and instructions to get in were very clear. We had six adults and there was plenty of space for everyone.
Great place to stay for large groups!

Great stay with Patricia. Convenient location. There were just two of us but there was a LOT of beds in the apartment if you need it.
We parked across the street, garage entrance next to the Dominos. It's pretty cheap (20-30$ per night) with SpotHero.
Was an absolutely wonderful stay. Accurate to pictures, excellent location, and extremely kind and responsive hosts. I will definitely stay again if I come back to Chicago.
Great place to stay with our whole family and very clean. Neighborhood was very nice and there was a lot to walk to!
The stay was great and location amazing, but I'm awaiting a response on an expensive missing item. I know people get busy, but we just need to know whether or not it was found.
Comfortable space in a great neighborhood.

A nice little private space. The apartment was well taken care of and very clean. It was nice to have a washer & dryer handy also. The parking was a little further than I expected but still reasonable walking distance. Would definitely book this space again for future trips.
Great amount of space. Clean. Location, location, location... walked to Wrigley for concert. Street parking was easy to find and close! Host is responsive and helpful. Would 100% recommend!

I love this apartment and the location!
This is my second time at this place and hopefully it will not be my last. I am planning to come back soon!
Amazing views and sunsets!!
The apartment is spacious, clean, and beautiful.
The hosts are fantastic, very attentive, responsive and understanding.
Nice apartment. Not updated but lovely all the same. Comfortable. Parking is not always easy immediately near the house but a spot can always be found.

This was my second time staying here, as I stayed here for the first time three years ago. I felt right at home! It’s a short walk to Wrigley and the red line, and it’s in the middle of a beautiful neighborhood.

I would not recommend this location to anyone.
The air conditioning does not work, and as you can see from previous reviews, this property has an ongoing issue with the AC. The location is next to an abandoned house and is not in the best area of Chicago. Parking is basically nonexistent — we had to park around the corner because there were no available spaces.
The host listed on the profile is not the person you will actually communicate with. You will be dealing with a customer service representative who claims they will respond within 24 hours, but even that does not happen. They also do not properly communicate through the app.
The house itself was not clean. There was hair and other debris left in the bathroom, which shows a lack of proper cleaning before guests arrive.
Overall, the experience was disappointing, and I would not recommend staying here.
The place was super cute and a GREAT value for the price. So happy with the stay!! 😊

Great location !
Loved the vibe of the whole place and it was close to so many walkable coffee shops and restaurants.
Perfect for 2 couples and family trips.
I also got to enjoy a barre class with my family which was super fun and worth it!
Already looking forward to staying there again. It was fanatic!!

Great stay! The studio matched the photos perfectly and had an amazing view of the lake. The host was super communicative, replying within 20 minutes and giving great local recommendations right when I landed. The location is super convenient with public transit right outside and lots of walkable spots. While parking by the building is scarce, we paid for a parking garage two blocks away for our entire stay, which worked out great. Ideal spot for solo travelers or couples!
premium location and apt is luxurious

Nice spot. It’s a smaller space but if you’re 1-2 people and spending most of your time outside exploring the city and great food nearby, you won’t mind the smaller space. The location is what matters here. Hosts are super communicative and kind. We had one concern and they addressed it quickly. In the summer when it was 90-100 degrees outside, the place was still cool and comfortable. Has all the basics and worked out great for us. The walls are thin and they make that well known in the description so it’s not a surprise. unfortunately we had some neighbors for one day that were loud coming home very early in the morning and then arguing loudly at 9am, but that’s life in the city. Not the hosts fault. We had a nice stay in one of the bests neighborhoods in the city.
Great place right near Addison blue line stop! Beautiful apt with everything you need!
Air conditioner didn’t work

Really great place to stay. Super clean and comfortable. Neighborhood is pretty safe and the place is a few minutes walk away from a bus line and CTA line so pretty convenient. Decent place for its price!
Good Location.

Perfect place to stay while in Chicago for a family of 4. The views are incredible and the balcony was really spacious and so nice to have in the mornings and evenings. Auroom was quick to respond and helpful.

The shared space Airbnb worked just fine for me and my partner for a long weekend. It is close to a bus stop and not far from the train, which was convenient. A lot of great restaurants, coffee, shops and bars around the neighborhood within walking distance or a short bus ride. Would definitely stay there again if we come back! The music from the event space wasn’t too bad. They promptly finished around 12:30 AM.
Great location & place is as pictured! We had a slight issue with the lockbox. There were also bugs in the main bedroom as well as bugs & a centipede in the bathroom.
very nice host
Comfortable place, very clean.
Great location, fantastic amenities, and great views.  Everything I needed for a fun and productive visit to Chicago.

I had a wonderful stay here over several weeks and would happily stay again. The space was exactly as described: comfortable, clean, and well-equipped for a longer visit. The hosts were excellent communicators, always responding quickly and providing helpful assistance whenever I had a question or needed anything.
The location was convenient, and I felt at home throughout my stay. If you're looking for a reliable place with attentive hosts and everything you need for a short or extended stay, I highly recommend this listing.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and very well equipped. The location was excellent and made it easy to get around.
Our host Danny ,was friendly, responsive, and made everything smooth from check-in to check-out. We truly felt at home during our stay.
We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area. Thank you for a great experience!
Very pleasant stay and very comfortable beds!

Excelente anfitrión, muy proactivo, el departamento está igual o mejor que en las fotos. Tal como se menciona la ubicación es tipo subterráneo, con ventanas pequeñas, para el caso nuestro fue perfecto ya que más bien se usaba para dormir. Todo estaba nuevo y muy limpio.

It is fine if you have your own car and are not traveling alone.  We were told by every Uber driver that we had that this was a high risk area and not go out at night.  Also, you do not have your own control the temperature of the unit. You have to have the host change the settings on request.
Muy bonito espacio, cómodo, barato y cerca de lugares ricos para comer!!
Really liked how centrally located this Airbnb was for the landmarks we wanted to see. Budget friendly, quiet, and spacious!
Nathan was extremely friendly and flexible with times. He was communicative and allowed us a late checkout after a rowdy wedding the day before had us wiped out. 10/10 recommend!

Todd and Tripp were ideal hosts - great communication from the moment we booked, very welcoming with awesome recs and shared all the cool spaces of their home with us.
Location is within walking distance to great restaurants and literally blocks from the beach.
Their home and our quarters were very clean, comfortable and well appointed. Highly recommend!
Raymond was a very kind and responsive host who always helped when needed. The neighborhood is also very peaceful and has good transportation options. We greatly enjoyed and appreciated the stay!

Great place to stay and enjoy Chicago! The blue line train station is a 10 min walk so going into downtown was super easy and convenient, lovely place away from super busy areas, amazing host and experience
Highly recommend Musa's place, look forward to staying again with him soon. Great location, space, and communication throughout.
There were bed bugs and the outside was so messy 0 out of 10 wouldn’t recommend it was close to the city but not worth it at all

It’s a very nice unit (once fixed) in a convenient area if you plan to move around in the west loop, near downtown area. Place stays cool & has a beautiful view of the skyline in the master bedroom shower. BUT I had multiple issues throughout my stay. There is VISIBLE water damage in the unit. Cracking paint on the ceiling and light water staining. It had to be bad because some lights are unevenly hanging from the ceiling & the couches have slight water damage which tells me they don’t visit the premises often. The guest bathroom sink is cracked BADLY, from a prior guest possibly? It’s caulked but a poor job. I didn’t have working internet half my stay. I left early because it was clearly shut off in my unit & I had work to do. The gate where my car was parked was left open by staff twice. The surrounding neighbors are decent people & advised they saw them leave the gate open & at times where I’m the only car parked in the back. Check out times on the site & on here are different

Kate and Rick's place is perfectly located near Logan Square and literally just steps from the Blue Line, which made getting to and from downtown and other locations super easy.  Two families rented this together, but the place is actually two levels, which worked out well as the kids were able to escape the adults and have their own space.  The grill on the patio worked great and allowed us to eat at "home" a few times.  We also requested a crockpot for a couple meals; the hosts located one for us and it really helped with meal planning.  Parking can be a bit of an adventure when it was busy, but the supplied parking passes were obviously appreciated and we didn't do much with vehicles during the stay.  Having not done an Airbnb in Chicago before, the building seemed pretty typical for the area, was redone and well cared for, and worked extremely well for our two families.

Although we were unfamiliar with the Pilsen neighborhood of Chicago Leigh-Anne’s rental was easy to find (once we learned that every street has a “place” and a “street”…and perhaps a “named street in between!). Both the “El” trains and multiple bus lines are within a ten minute walk which gave us access to everything from the Lincoln Park Zoo in the north, the beach at Lake Michigan and Millenium Park in the east and a whole slew of ethnic neighborhoods with terrific “hole in the wall” restaurants. The apartment itself was perfect for my wife and I with a well-equipped kitchen, a very comfortable living room and separate bedrooms when the need (snoring…) arose. We won’t hesitate to contact Leigh-Anne in the future when we’re back in Chicago for our son’s graduation from SAIC.

The location to Loyola Chicago was perfect for our trip!  Very walkable and a great space to stay very comfortably.  The hosts were so kind and communicative.  We had a great stay and would certainly come back!

Sergs place was amazing and he was very friendly, prompt and helpful.
The Airbnb itself was very nice, clean and great location and it felt just like home.
Definitely recommend!
We had a great stay!

The Good: Spacious, windows with natural light, hardwood floors & wood trim, very responsive.
The Bad: Place wasn’t deep cleaned, there were some crumbs on the stove & in the refrigerator, there was hair on the top sheet & hair on the floor underneath a table leg in the bedroom. There wasn’t a middle sheet, just the comforter & the fitted sheet in summer heat. Luckily there was AC.There were missing pieces & broken slates on the blinds. In the bedroom there was a missing slate in the blinds which didn’t allow me to feel full privacy. There are a lot of areas that need to be repainted, or plastered & repainted, especially a burnt wall by the stove, the cracking paint on the ceiling in the bedroom, scuff marks on multiple walls, & holes that have been patched & not repainted. There were weird scratch marks on the front & back door. Also yellow & black spots on the ceiling over the shower. Windows in multiple rooms with dried drip streaks that makes them look dirty. Got a partial refund.
I really appreciated all the recommendations that were given to us from Staywell!
House was very beautiful.. great location for metro to downtown.. walkable surroundings
Fantastic location. Highly reccomend.
Loved everything! No problems at all and everything in the space felt like I was right at home. I would most definitely stay here again!

A great affordable stay!! It was really easy traveling up and down Chicago from this location. Honestly coming back to Pilsen was a nice break from the city noise. Thank you Abigail for the tips and tricks and truly amazing hospitality!
The apartment was in a great location with lots of restaurants and shopping nearby. The space suited our needs for a great weekend in Chicago! Brad was a very responsive and helpful host.

We had a wonderful stay at Chris' place. Our hosts were so welcoming and friendly, particularly towards our young son who had the time of his life there. The location is perfect and the setting is beautiful - it's very walkable and ideal for families. Highly recommended!
Parking made this a no brainer! The space is small but you’re not really in the city to hang out in your room- the neighborhood is fantastic great spot!

Rosa's place was perfect for our stay. Close enough to walk to public transit, coffee shops and there was even an Aldi near by for necessities/groceries. The small touches to make us feel at home we're very much appreciated. The beds..... oh the beds were soooooo comfortable, got a great night's sleep every night after long days of sightseeing.
