We enjoyed our stay and would book again. Thank you Rosa for a wonderful stay.
Alma was more than accommodating in our conversations. The area itself is nice, not to mention close to the metro, but it's a place that you need to know more about beforehand.

Overall, the location is perfect! Easily accessible and walkable. No issues with free street parking. If anything, you’re paying mostly for the location because there were a few things to note:
1. Listing states “cozy living area” but the sparse furniture is far from that
2. Bed sheets not supplied (has fitted sheet and scratchy duvet only)
3. Compared to other bookings, this one required more information and messaging prior to booking approval.
4. Received a text message from possible host? Not sure why it wasn’t an Airbnb message.
Very nice

A beautiful home that was lovely to stay in! It was clean, very nice, well appointed, and luxurious. Genuinely nice place to stay in the heart of Wicker Park. It was a quiet place to stay and my kids loved the loft bedroom and the nice park next door.
The amazing location made everything super accessible. We walked to numerous top-notch bakeries in the morning and restaurants in the evening. It was also close enough to the metro that we walked to the train for an easy ride into the heart of downtown Chicago.
Nicole and Matt were very responsive and clearly take great care of their home - 10 out of 10, would absolutely recommend for anyone visiting Chicago.

Good, safe location for families. The apartment was spacious and clean. It has all the amenities needed for a long stay for a family of 5. Couple of negative experiences; the check-in process, it was unclear and the keys provided did not work, having to wait approximately 20-30 minutes outside the apartment until remote help sorted things out. Very frustrating and poor first experience after a tiresome travel looking forward to some rest. Secondly the free parking as per description is very misleading. There is no assigned spots, there is enough parking for 4 cars in front of the apartment which if you are tourist after late visits and travel, you will never get. You would have to drive around searching for parking ending up 4-5 blocks away from the apartment. This was very inconvenient and sometimes stressful.
Access to the city was easy, I had a rental car and in 20 minutes you can reach all notable destinations. Everything else was fine with the stay.
I had a lovely stay! It was in a safe area and close to Wicker Park which mare transportation easier. Clean bathrooms too

Cyan is a great host who is proactive is solving any issues that might arise. It is evident that she takes pride in her place and she has air purifiers, humidifier, and even an ozone cleaner if needed.
The neighborhood is only a few minutes drive (about 7-9 minutes to 53rd street area) to restaurants (a few healthy options available), the gym, etc… However, if you want to walk you will find most of the neighborhood has tree lined sidewalks with beautiful beautiful gray stone and brick houses. It is also near a park and I loved walking around the neighborhood for a bit of exercise. (I discovered a few parks scattered around and even a walking bridge to a huge park and the river.
It is important to know that there might be impact noise from upstairs and that when there is heavy rain there will initially be a bit more water to walk through. There is a drain, however it takes time when there is a lot of water.
Overall, it is a nice change of pace.

Ewa’s place was so cool!! We felt like we were staying in a little art studio, and she is wonderful!
Also is a 3 block walk from the Blue line which takes about 10 minutes to get to downtown Chicago. Really convenient.
Thank you Ewa for sharing your place with us!

Great stay, classic Chicago neighborhood with plenty to do. The place was clean and new. Got great photos of my daughter getting ready for her wedding. Would definitely stay here again. Thanks Samuel!

Probably one of the best AirBnb’s you can get. We were a group of 5 and the apartment is more than enough. 2 bedrooms with a restroom each, and a matress in the living that was really comfortable. Spacious apartment, amazing views from the 15th floor and the pool, gym and lounge zone from the top floor were amazing.
10/10
Lugar limpio y ordenado. Indicaciones precisas para llegar. Conocí personalmente a Antonio y me pareció muy buena persona en cuanto al diálogo. Lo recomiendo
Excellent location to Wrigley Field! We had a wonderful stay here, highly recommend!

Wow, a beautiful couples oasis. I would come back to this air bnb every time me and my partner visits because of the exceptional communication , the beautiful space and the quiet neighborhood. This listing was entertaining, clean , and all around a chefs kiss pick !

Milan was an amazing host! He was very responsive whenever I reached out with a question, offered great flexibility for checkin and checkout, and proactively reached out to ensure that my stay was going well. The home is nice and cozy, and provided great space for my group. Everyone felt right at home and comfortable. Would definitely recommend to anyone and I would stay again if I come back!

Visited Chicago with friends and all 6 of us enjoyed the stay! Location was super closeby the train station and there was ample street parking for our rental car as well. Description and photos matched the listing and everything was very clean! Our host also made sure to send reminders and offer assistance whenever needed, which I believe shows exceptional service. I would 100% book again if I come back to the area :)
Loved the place, Gena was an awesome host
Stellar location! Right next to public transit. Made getting around so easy.
Muy bien todo! De facil acceso con metro y todo muy bien

Great place. Very clean, well equipped, and an excellent part of town. Our family had a blast. Clear, fast communication with host. Definitely recommend.
Thank You!
This place was well maintained and the other guest were quiet and out of the way. 10/10 would recommend.

Pete's place is an absolute gem and Pete himself is one of the kindest hosts I have ever met!
I stayed for 20 days as a solo traveller from India. I had explored many places across Chicago for an accommodation — but this was hands down the best of the best. Choosing Pete's place was the single best decision I made for my entire trip.
The space is stunning beautifully decorated, immaculately clean, with a gorgeous bedroom, a private bathroom that felt like a boutique hotel and a dreamy living room with that magnificent TV and fireplace.
What really stood out was Pete as a host. He was warm, gracious, responsive and genuinely caring. Any question I had was answered
Devon Ave nearby was a dream for authentic Indian food!
This place stole my heart. I will be back! Thank you Pete, Ludovina and Jen — you made Chicago unforgettable!
I would not hesitate to stay here again and would recommend Pete’s place to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, private and well located home in Chicago.
What a great place. Way bigger than the photos, high ceilings, great neighborhood, fun bar downstairs, comfortable beds, and easy. That’s a good combo
Mary was the most helpful and informative host I have ever head. Great neighborhood beautiful place!
S

Dennis's place is great. Roscoe Village is a great neighborhood. Very close to restaurants, shops, and coffee shops. Easy walk to public transportation. Easy to find parking nearby (around the corner typically).

We had a great two day stay at Alex’s home. The location cannot be beat. Near Small Chaval and Jeni’s ice cream. The house  has lots of space to spread out. Wifi is suitable for remote work/school. Kitchen is well equipped. Alex is extremely responsive and helpful. Checked in on us and was ready with answers and even a new coffee pot when we needed it. Baggage storage was really appreciated. Thanks Alex!
Great place!

A very nice place to stay 100%, very spacious inside, looked just like photos, had everything I needed to make me feel right at home, and host was great and responsive throughout the whole process. One downside about the area though is the parking of course but once we got it down packed  it wasnt much of a big deal. There were lime scooters around so it made getting to the airbnb and the area where we had to park much easier because it was quiet a bit of distance so if you ever book this placed have a plan about parking, but besides that amazing home and host.Will definitely book again in the future!

Great place, good location - parking can be tricky but we always found somewhere. Very clean and tidy, felt at home. Lacey also checked in with me a couple of times to check if I needed anything which was very thoughtful!

This is place is a hostel. You can book it through Hostelworld or on Stay 424 for 1/4 of the price. If you’re into hostels this place is fine. If you’re looking for a room in someones house this is NOT it.
Great stay, great communication
great stay for a lovely family break in chicago
Great location. The property was exactly as portrayed in the listing. Lovely neighborhood. We will definitely return.

We had a great stay overall. The place was clean, comfortable, and matched the listing. The only minor issue was that the cleaners were still finishing up when we arrived a few minutes after check-in, so the unit wasn't quite ready yet. Other than that, everything went smoothly, and the host checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. We'd be happy to stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay for 2 days. Location is fantastic with lake and riverwalk being at walkable distance. View of city and lake from the balcony is breathtaking and  a huge plus. Public transport(busstop) is right across the street. CTA redline is 5 minutes walk. The apartment was  clean and kitchen well stocked for a comfortable stay.. We will definitely stay here again for our next trip.
Brian's place was clean, cool, and in a quiet part of town. Walking distance to a rail station made it perfect for us. The space was bright and clean and comfy! Would absolutely stay again.
Place was very comfortable for our family and was very close to major attractions and restaurants. Plates and bowls could be updated but overall a great experience.
No volvería, la habitación no coincidía con las fotos. Habiatacion MEGA pequeña, el baño con falta de mantenimiento. El ingreso muy sucio con olor a cigarrillo. Una pena.

Super séjour chez Geo qui a toujours été très réactif, je le recommande chaudement ! La chambre reste un petit peu sombre mais très cozy quand toutes les lumières sont allumées. L’emplacement est parfait pour aller visiter Chicago !
Dan's place was amazing! Lots of room, great basement with a huge tv, pool table, and games. Also, it had an cool backyard patio with a bonfire. Will definitely be back next time we're in Chicago.

We put visiting family up in Leah's place for four days - we live nearby, so obviously we like the neighborhood. More importantly, the whole check in procedure was very easy and the accommodations themselves are very spacious and seem like they were updated recently.

El lugar es HERMOSO!!! y está súper bien ubicado, definitivamente me quedaría otra vez ahí.
Está ubicado en una zona con bares alrededor y hay ruido, así que eso puede ser un tema para algunas personas. (Not for me)
Mi única observación importante es que sentí muy impersonal el trato ya que es como quedarte en una casa/hotel donde el recepcionista es virtual. Te envían un link con el paso a paso de todo y con los costos extras x check in antes o después de la hora, cuidado de maletas etc.
Se nota que tienen muy bien pensado todo y que eso les funciona. Tienen un servicio de desayuno en ciertas horas que se valora que lo ofrezcan.
Como decía, yo si me volvería a hospedar ahí, solo no siento que es para cualquier persona.
Hotel is in a great area! Staff was super friendly. We had a good stay

This was our first time traveling to Chicago! With a big family we need something big so this was perfect. Communication was helpful with Matt. He was super nice.
After we checked in, we did notice that one of the shower faucets was broken and a shower curtain had black stuff on it and needed to be replaced. He did ask if he wanted to send someone but we said as long as two of the bathrooms were fine no needed to replace. Some of the dishes in the kitchen needed to be washed again.
Other than these minor things, we enjoyed our stay. Tv had everything for the kids to watch. We were close to a lot places and the city which was the bonus! The place was in a safe neighborhood which made it feel more comfortable.
We enjoyed Chicago !
Definitely want to come back!

We arrived to filth . Pictures look stunning . In person apartment had no toilet paper , no sheets , no pillow cases . I had to go to target to buy towels and blankets . There were no trash bags . No complimentary shampoo etc . Not worth your money . Location was great !!! When I told host about situation his response was he would let cleaning people know . I didn’t expect the 4 seasons , but clean and environs would have been nice . I suggest the host do a deep deep clean and provide the next tenant clean sheets and appropriate towels . Basics toilet paper etc
Place was clean and cozy within walking distance the blue line. We enjoyed our stay!

We were in Chicago for my son’s wedding! We had beautiful weather and Elizabeth’s beautiful home, with plenty of space to enjoy our special occasion.
Easy walking distance to restaurants and shops. Easy ubering to everything else. Needing a snack, we stopped into Twin Anchors which is at corner by house. From the outside it seemed “sketchy”, but wow! So many people inside and great food! It’s actually one of the oldest restaurants in the city!
We didn’t cook, but the kitchen seemed well stocked and very large to enjoy meals with family.
The den that overlooked the park had a huge window seat that we all fought to sit at!
The front garden was spectacular! So many people stopped to comment on it too!
Loved our time in Chicago!

For those of you interested in great museums, the lakefront and Grant Park, it is a very good location. The view is spectacular from the living room. There are grocery stores nearby as well as mass transit. We enjoyed our stay very much!
Very nice stay
Great stay! We loved how big and spacious the place was with the most incredible views. Would definitely book again for a future Chicago trip!

In general it was a good place to stay. However, the smart lock on the door ran out of battery on Sunday afternoon and no one from maintenance could come until 9:30 am on Monday.
The host was able to accommodate for us to stay at a different unit that night, however all of our belongings were inside the locked unit and we lost a lot of time, both that night and the next morning, for which we already had plans.
Really unfortunate situation that hurt the overall experience.

The views from James's apartment are stunning!
It's a perfect base for Chicago theatre and the River walk.
Thanks James
So happy to have found this apartment for my pup and me while exploring Chicago. Great location and a short walk to the beach. We enjoyed our stay!

This apartment is such a gem, it's located on 26th floor,views are breathtaking, even better than on pictures! Large enough for our group of 6,internet was fast and kitchen had everything needed to make breakfast. 100% recommended!

What a great place to stay while visiting Chicago! I felt at home immediately. Sue is super friendly but provided privacy and the house is gorgeous! The furniture was so comfortable and everything was nice and clean. The little decorations are adorable; the little bench cracked me up. Shower pressure was amazing and towels were abundant. The private den/tv room and patio were great amenities, as well! The house is located in a gorgeous neighborhood and close to some great food and bars. Buses were close by, but if you don't time them correctly you may have to walk the mile to the train (though it's a beautiful walk lol). Would definitely return!
El alojamiento de Nicholas es excelente, un lugar muy limpio y tranquilo. Tienes todas las comodidades que podrías llegar a necesitar :) buena ubicación a 25 min del downtown. Recomendable 🇺🇸 ~

We booked Ray's place for our son's 16th birthday which included our son and 9 of his close friends along with my husband and I.  From the moment they walked in they were beyond thrilled with all of the amenities, from the large assortment of video games, pool table, hot tub and awesome movie theater space, they were kept very busy and had so much fun. My husband and I loved it all too, especially the outdoor deck space where we were able to relax and unwind.  Ray was extremely helpful and quick to respond to any questions I had. Everything was extremely neat, clean and organized. We all had a fabulous time and hated to leave. We would definitely recommend Ray's place to others and would love to come back and stay again someday!
Overall, a good place to stay - except for a small glitch, rest went well. Would certainly come back, if we ever visited a place near this neighborhood
I enjoyed My stay there .
As advertised, clean, great location with easy and secure parking included.
房间打扫得一尘不染，卫生标准很高，生活用品整理有序。房东十分注重细节，软装、日常备品考虑周全。民宿选址优越，公共交通出行方便，周边配套完善。环境安静惬意，整体氛围舒服放松，这次入住十分愉快，下次出行还会选择这里。还有手写卡片和巧克力
Spacious room with everything we needed supplied for our stay! Super responsive host too
非常干净且整洁 硬件设施配备齐全！咖啡机吐司机都有准备 去市中心打车也很方便 度过了很舒心的休息日 性价比也很高

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  The home is beautiful.  We especially appreciated that each room is a private suite with its own full bathroom and sitting area.   I will definitely book it again on my next visit to Chicago.

The apartment was beautiful, well-equipped with everything I needed, and in a fantastic location. Mary was a wonderful host, she was kind, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout my stay. Everything went smoothly, and I would be very happy to stay there again.

Excellent week at Bianca’s penthouse. Location is hard to beat — two minutes from Rush Street restaurants, short walk to Oak Street Beach and the Lakefront Trail.
Plenty of space for three of us, and the roof deck was great.
Prompt communication from the host team throughout.

Staying at Jamie’s place was amazing! The room, kitchen, and bathroom were all very clean, and the kitchen had everything I needed for cooking. The bed was extremely comfortable, and I slept like a baby.
Jamie was incredibly kind and accommodating. He let me check in at 6 a.m., and when my flight was delayed, he even allowed me to stay longer without any issues. Check-out was easy and stress-free.
Everything was perfect, and I would 100% recommend staying at Jamie’s place!

Ian was great, super friendly and was really sweet to give us an early check in & out. The place is walkable to a lot of places and the transit. It was nice to have a private parking space to keep our car safe. We did have an issue with our door lock which Ian helped me locate the keys as back up and the only other thing is that sleeping on the pull out couch and the single pull out bed was a lil rough to sleep in. Overall a great experience & stay!
We had a great stay and this apartment is extremely close to Wrigley!

We enjoyed our stay. Giving us the chance to cook and eat “at home” after several days of vacay was nice. The beach is such an easy walk and there’s some nice shops and art all within a short walking distance. Would stay again!!

This home was absolutely beautiful and sparkling clean. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and having the lake so close by was a huge plus! Since it was my first time visiting Chicago, staying at such a wonderful place made the trip truly special. What I loved most, though, was the host’s warm hospitality, thoughtful touches, and super quick responses. Thanks to the host, we made some truly happy memories. I’d love to stay here again next time! 😍

Great place in a nice location near Portage park. Lots of beds, games in the basement for kids, projector theater on the top floor. The host was very reaponsive. They helped overcome a hiccup with the backdoor lock within minutes. The espresso machine was a nice touch for sure after late nights chatting around the table since we had so many folks together for our Chicago stay.

Our stay was absolutely exceptional from beginning to end. The home was even more beautiful than the photos, immaculately clean, thoughtfully decorated, and incredibly comfortable. Every detail had clearly been considered, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere that made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived.
The hospitality was outstanding. Our host Karina was kind, responsive, and genuinely invested in making sure we had everything we needed for a relaxing and enjoyable stay. Communication was seamless, and the home was beautifully maintained and stocked with all the amenities we could have asked for. It was the perfect place to unwind while enjoying the Chicago area.
We couldn't have asked for a better Airbnb experience. We highly recommend this beautiful home to anyone looking for a comfortable, peaceful, and memorable getaway.
We would gladly stay here again and already look forward to returning.
Thank you Karina, for such a wonderful experience!

Beth's place was the perfect location. We could walk easily to Welles and Horner Park, and all over Lincoln Square and Albany Park. We couldn't have picked a better spot for exploring the neighborhood with kids. The apartment is also one of the most accommodating places we've ever stayed at with kids. Beth had a booster seat, a real crib, children's books and toys, plates and cups, etc., which made it an easy transition with two very little ones. The beds were very comfortable, the place was spotless, and any time we needed anything or had a question, Beth responded right away and came downstairs to help us. Great stay!

this airbnb was amazing and he was the best host to communicate! fast replying and amazing service. the home was beautiful and clean me and my family enjoy this place a lot and no issues at all and i would 100% book again if i come back to chicago it made my travel experience so easy and it so close to downtown! the only thing i wish was that they had a private parking space it is difficult finding parking space but other then that it was amazing!
Axel’s place was perfect for our Chicago stay. The check-in instructions were so clear and the free street parking worked great for us. I would highly recommend staying at Axel’s place!

We really enjoyed the apartment.   Only one thing that caused us some discomfort was the bed mattress and the metal frames.   The mattress has no support on the edges and easy to role off.   And the bed kept sliding around on the frames.   It required daily readjustment.   Other  than that it was perfect.   Thank you.
Great view, helpful staff!
Had a wonderful stay!
Host was responsive and kind. The location is nice, and so is the home. Next to Old Town Chicago.
A thoughtfully decorated home, walking distance to UChicago's campus. I had a lovely stay!

We had a great stay. There are a few shops and plenty of restaurants in walking distance. We were able to find parking easily, which isn’t always the case in cities. Convenient access to the trains as well. The place had everything we needed for our quick trip.
Place was exactly as described.  Clean and spacious, extremely responsive host!

This place was great for me and my extended family to stay on our way through Chicago! Location was great, super safe and walkable to many restaurants, bars and coffee shops. Would definitely stay here again!
Super amazing, not too far from everything i wanted to go to

We had a fantastic stay at Heather’s place during our Chicago girls’ trip! The home was clean, comfortable, and in a great location with easy access to public transportation and nearby restaurants. Everything was exactly as described, and communication was smooth from start to finish. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it to future guests. Thank you for helping make our trip so special! ❤️

Our stay was fantastic. The location couldn’t be beat, we were close to everything and it was super convenient with a Target just steps away, which made it easy to grab anything we needed. The host was very accommodating and quick to respond to our requests. The place was clean and well kept. We stayed Friday through Tuesday and had zero complaints. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Chicago who wants a stress-free, well-located home base.
Brandon was a great host and the home is great! Modern and well set up.
This was a safe neighborhood, spacious area for my wife and toddler, parking was easy and exactly what we needed, and we would recommend to everyone.
This place was PERFECT! Totally affordable and absolutely fantastic. Great neighborhood, easy parking and comfortable!!
Nice cozy place, I’m about 6 foot and the ceilings didn’t bother me much, just have to hunch down a little in the shower and watch your head going into the basement, great stay nonetheless
Very quiet and very accessible location

Outstanding area with great walkability. Tons of shops, restaurants, and activities; and the beach is just a few minutes away by foot. Everything is reachable by foot or public transportation. Parking instructions were incorrect which led to a frustrating hour of confusion and back and forth messaging, but that should be an easy fix.
The units themselves were a bit confusing. The listing is for "luxury" and "designer" but neither unit fit our expectations of those descriptions. They were not similarly outfitted with one being noticeably more dated and in need of simple repairs and maintenance that would have brought it closer to our expectations. Fixing wobbly beds, broken bed frames, and other maintenance issues is simple and will help a lot.
We loved the location, the views, and the ability to host our entire family for a reunion to bid farewell to a loved one. Hosts were communicative and quick to respond to our concerns. Would recommend for the view alone but adjust expectations.
Clean place, everything is spotless, the train noise did not affect our sleep. Host's instruction was very clear. This is a pretty nice place overall.

Great location. Parking stickers provided which was amazing. Easy walking around. Easy walk to the Sheridan Station for the L, but we couldn’t hear it. So that was perfect. Block and 1/2 to Wrigley. Just over 1/2 mile to Southport. Overall Perfect!
Enjoyed the stay. We will definitely be back to visit Chicago!

Karen was a lovely host! The apartment is spacious and fun. We stayed with two kids and she provided high chairs and a pack and play which was a huge help! Parking can be tricky but Karen let us park in her driveway a few times—a nice unexpected bonus. The area is great, very safe and lots of fun things to do. We took full advantage of the outdoor space and the proximity to the lake. We would stay here again!

Highly Recommend! This is an excellent choice especially for groups going to McCormack Place, the convention center, a game at Soldier Field, or any other nearby event. The apartment is huge and beautiful, matches the pictures exactly. We felt spoiled as compared to my colleagues staying at nearby hotels. Adresa uses a third party site which you can trust and which helps facilitate the process, but everything is ultimately through the Airbnb app. The location is such an easy walk. And check in and check out were so easy. Great communication. Tons of bedrooms and space. Great experience, would stay again!

This space was wonderful! The host was extremely helpful and kind to us. When we arrived at the Airbnb, we nearly jumped for joy with how spacious and clean everything was. The beds are so comfortable!
We also appreciated that we didn’t have to fully clean the entire home like some Airbnbs require. The check in and check were wonderfully smooth. Just the thing I look for on vacation.
The area felt safe and had shopping and restaurants close by.

Really great area, feels safe and I didn’t get my bike stolen off the back of my car which is surprising if you saw what my back rack looked like. Place was clean and quiet yet still central with a downtown feel. 10/10 would stay again.

We had a great stay here. The AC was much appreciated and kept the place very comfortable. It’s a little far from downtown to make the trip on the L more than once in the morning and once in the evening, but the proximity to the Jefferson Park station was nice.
Excelente ubicación, instrucciones claras, el anfitrión todo el tiempo estaba al pendiente
Great neighborhood stay! A block from the park and decent street parking.

The attic loft is in a very safe location, clean and aesthetic. It felt like a little home away from
Home . I’d definitely consider staying again during a future trip to Chicago.

This was my very first AirBnB rental. It was a seamless experience, and had everything I needed. Parking was easy, and I was given access to store my camping gear in a closet. I was able to come and go at all hours for four nights.

Reservation got cancelled in the morning of the check-in day. We trusted him is due to the unavoidable maintenance needed from the previous guest. If he can provide us a longer Leadtime will be better. Anyway, we stayed with this host for 3 years, and only happened once, I do trust Milan and truly believe there are always room to improve. Thank you Milan again.

Vin is a super nice guy and super helpful and responsive. His customer service honestly made my stay in Chicago so much easier and more comfortable. You won’t regret booking here. It’s a good spot, very clean, nicely furnished, and very short distance from downtown.

I don’t know where to start!! The location is perfect and so walkable, but obviously not too difficult to get downtown either - but the place itself is so nice I almost didn’t want to go out! Super cute decor, awesome little kitchenette stocked with essentials, nice large bathroom, very clear instructions to get in, and of course a cool record collection. Matthew was very responsive and helpful, his guide helped us find the BEST brunch I’ve ever had (Lula’s!!), I really couldn’t be happier. Thanks Matthew!!!

Great location. Near Lake Shore Drive so it was easy to hop on and access the sites of Chicago. Walkable, diverse neighborhood. Friendly neighbors. Park nearby with a splash pad for kids. Somewhat complicated but secure entry (had to download an app to access the lock box to get the key to open the first door, then another code for the second door), but Todd was very helpful in answering our questions.

Wonderful host who was was very responsive and friendly, the apartment is lovely and has all you need and the location was perfect!
Would visit again
Super cute space and perfect location!
Nice space and a very responsive host
Fantastic place. Had many days where I had to extend my stay, and each time it was quick, easy, and affordable.
Fantastic location  near restaurants, shops, and more.  Offered plenty of space for our family trip. Host was quick to respond with any questions or concerns we had. Definitely recommend booking!

I had a wonderful stay! The hosts were incredibly communicative, responsive, and helpful from start to finish. The place was very clean, comfortable, and in a great location. It had all the amenities I needed, which made my stay easy and enjoyable. I highly recommend staying here and would definitely book again!
Great place and location!
Great house right in the midst of downtown area. Plenty of space for the whole family
Great place , Lucas a Great Host ...

This is a great apartment and perfect landing pad to enjoy Chicago! There was so much to do within a 5-10min walk by foot. Trove was always easy to contact and available to resolve any issues—which there were none. Also, the bed, linens, and towels were all high quality and very comfortable.

This was our first time using Airbnb and we’re so happy we went with Chelsey and Gillian’s space! It was beautiful and quiet, comfortable and spacious. It truly was the perfect place to stay on our vacation! If we ever visit Chicago again we will be looking to stay here again!

Wicker Park is in the heart of a great Chicago location.   It is walkable to many bars and restaurants.  It is right up against the L so the train noise was pretty constant.    We had a few issues while we were there.    Primarily, it was extremely hot and the central AC did not work.   While the hosts did not have anyone out to repair it, they provided a window and a standalone AC that were generally adequate.    They were friendly and responsive to our communications (and even brought us some Stan's Doughnuts).

Thank you so much for your care and thoughtfulness in keeping your space homely and welcoming.
My family and I had the most comfortable and wonderful stay.
Visiting Chicago for the first I am very happy we had a nice place to stay.
Thank you we shall definitely comeback.

We were so impressed.  Didn’t know what to expect, but was so happy with the location, space and cleanliness.  3 couples had their own bedroom and bathroom.  The toddler had her own bedroom.  There was space for the baby in his pack and play that we brought.  There was enough chairs for all of us at the table to eat and play games.  We checked out the rooftop which was very nice.  Would have liked to spend more time there.  Would 100% stay there again.  Thank you!
Great location. Walkable to lots of cool bars and restaurants. Would stay again.
Perfect location for a downtown Chicago visit. Unit presents as advertised.

Nathan and Jake were super accommodating and communicative while finding a place for 18 year olds to stay in Chicago. The place was incredibly spacious with its two living rooms, and a wonderfully air conditioned escape from the sticky summer heat. Would book again!

My stay was okay overall. When I first arrived, there was a noticeable odor in both the home and my space. I also found stains on the blanket that was provided and on one side of the fitted sheet. Because of that, I only used the flat sheet, which appeared clean and looked brand new.
One positive experience was when I accidentally got locked out of my space. Fortunately, Jorge happened to arrive just a few minutes later, which worked out perfectly since he was able to let me back in.
The location was convenient for the reason I was visiting, which made the stay workable. However, based on my overall experience, this would probably not be my first choice if I were staying in the area again.

One of our favorite Airbnbs ever! We paid a little more for this stay, but it was absolutely worth it. We’re a family of four with two teen girls, and the space was perfect. They loved their cozy twin-bed room, and the high ceilings and abundant natural light made the apartment feel spacious and bright. Everything looked like the photos, if not better! The entire space felt thoughtful and intentional, from the well-labeled kitchen and closets to the incredible amount of supplies. I’ve never seen an Airbnb so well stocked! The primary closet had plenty of space and hangers, and I loved details like the magnifying mirror and shades that made the rooms nice and dark at night . The outdoor space was fantastic for both lounging and dining, and I wish we’d had time to cook in the beautiful kitchen. Check-in and elevator access were easy, the building felt safe and secure, and the Old Town location was amazing, with great restaurants and easy train access. Clean, comfortable, and exceptional.
Clean . Host was great and responsive . Would stay again .
I really enjoyed my stay. The property was extremely clean and just a couple blocks from green line.
Great location, awesome coffee shop at the corner.

Had a wonderful stay with a big group of friends’ first time in Chicago.
Extremely walkable location - just a couple blocks to the red line El that will take you anywhere! So many places to eat and drink within a block as well as a great, deceptively large corner grocery/liquor store with everything you need! Easy walk to Wrigley. Location is 10/10!
Home itself is equally fantastic. Very comfortable with lots of places to lounge after city walking all day! Every room very clean. Beds very comfortable. It was exceptionally warm during our time in Chicago and the AC was clutch! Kept everyone comfortable and cool.
Parking out front also clutch. Big enough to fit a large, extended cab truck.
Leigh was extremely communicative and attentive to all our requests. We cannot thank him enough for his flexibility during our stay!
Can’t wait to come back!

We had a great stay! The place looked exactly like the pictures and was very cozy and comfortable. The hosts were wonderful. They checked in to make sure everything was going well, and their instructions for check in and the house were clear and easy to follow.
The neighborhood was not the nicest, so we were a little wary on our first night. However, throughout our stay we never felt unsafe, even when returning late in the evening. There was no noise or commotion outside, and everything was peaceful.
Overall, we had a great experience and have no complaints. We would definitely recommend staying here!
The house was very clean and cozy. Our family of four had a wonderful three-day stay here. The neighborhood is safe and quiet, and we even spotted fireflies during our evening walks.
Chiaka was an excellent host and everything was to our satisfaction. we look forward to staying again next time we are in Chicago!
The space was super cute and a perfect space for a solo traveler! I slept well in the bed and appreciated the host checking in on me throughout my stay. Highly recommend!
The place was neat and clean.  Glad the lights were on when we arrived since it was at night

We had a wonderful two-night stay at Aaron’s place in Chicago. Aaron was an excellent host, and the space was absolutely immaculate. Everything was exactly as pictured—clean, comfortable, welcoming, and perfect for our trip.
The location was incredibly convenient. We used the “L” quite a bit, and the nearby station made getting around Chicago very easy.
This is such a special place, and we are so grateful we had the opportunity to stay there. We would highly recommend Aaron’s property and would gladly stay again!

A quaint and comfortable apartment in beautiful Wicker Park. It was just what we needed. The neighborhood is wuiet, safe, beautiful and anything you need is in walkable distance including public transportation to downtown Chicago. Paul was a great host, was quick to respond, and made fantastic recommendations to delicious restaurants. We will look him up for our next visit to Chicago for sure.

My family and I had a great visit at Michael and Abbey's place! It is 0.3 mi (6 min walk) from Wrigley Field, where we went to a concert. The location was perfect. The house is in beautiful condition, and the rooms had plenty of space to have our luggage out. Each room had a very handy hotel-style folding luggage rack. The parking passes were very helpful (on non game/concert days). I had a question before our stay, and Michael responded within a few hours, which we greatly appreciated. Overall, it was an excellent airbnb - I highly recommend it.

Marty and Rob were exceptional hosts. Their home is like a cool art museum and garden oasis in the middle of the Chicago neighborhood, Andersonville. We stayed in the loft, which has an amazing view of the garden through the house's back glass wall. The loft was private even though open to the second floor. The decor is modern and eclectic, with many original works of art. It felt good to "come home" after a busy day of activities around the city - peaceful, calm, and quiet. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and definitely hope to stay there again in the future!
~Alice + Brett
Loved the area, very safe and there’s so much to do nearby. Josh was friendly and helpful the entire stay!
Great stay!

We had a wonderful stay! The location was perfect—close to the Red Line, great restaurants, and plenty of shopping. The space itself was clean, spacious, and had everything we needed. It was actually even better than the pictures!
Our host was amazing and incredibly responsive throughout our stay. The entire experience exceeded our expectations, and we felt it was an excellent value. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!
Very nice place to sleep but there isn't a single tv in the place which was difficult.  Also the kids are active and running marathons early in the morning.

Reed’s place is quiet, private, and well-appointed. It’s walkable to Southport’s many shops and restaurants. Reed was also very communicative and answered any questions I had within minutes. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a lovely place to stay in Lakeview!
It was nice staying here!

Me and my 6 friends stayed here and we all fitted very comfortably. After contacting the host about a few small questions she was able to respond in minutes, which was extremely helpful. Highly recommended
We enjoyed staying at Maya's Place! The location was perfect for our stay! Everything we needed was close by! I would definitely stay here again!!

Wonder location near the train and in a quiet, charming neighborhood.  The place was clean and comfortable and well-equipped with all a full kitchen and plently of AC! We enjoyed our morning coffee in the sun room off the kitchen.

Great spot!
Loved the character of the home and neighborhood. House was comfortable with plenty of extras. Comfy beds, pillows, and linens.
Upstairs walking noise comes through ceiling clearly but can’t often have charm without the effects of an older build. Should be drowned out fine with a noise maker if you’re sensitive.
I enjoyed my stay here! Amazing host!
Another great stay and our favorite in Chicago!

The good: Nice to have a two car garage. Lots of beds and bathrooms for a bigger group. Living room / kitchen setup was nice. Two comfortable sofas and a large TV to hang out after a day/night on the town. Ten minute walk to main drag in Old Town with bars and restaurants.
The bad: House was dirty. Mirrors and shower doors looked disgusting. Bugs and hair in the bottom of a broken bathtub. Silverware drawer dirty and had hair in it.
Place needs a good deep cleaning and a coat of paint (which is all too common in Chicago it seems) Most places I've stayed at give you a few K cups or coffee to get you started. Not here.
I’ve had the pleasure of if staying in Two of Karen’s properties and the consistency of great service in each property made my stay very comfortable.

Room was as described, clean, and Evgenii was a very responsive host and always checked in on us. We were on the second floor and the building seemed mostly full, so sometimes there was a wait for the bathroom.

We really enjoyed our stay in Chicago. The apartment was wonderful with lots of transit options nearby. It was a great landing spot between the Loop and South side of Chicago. Very easy and convenient to get into and out of and there was a Trader Joe’s close by to get groceries at. Very happy with our time and stay in Chicago.

Great location! Close to downtown and not far from the expressway to get to airport or suburbs. Location was very clean and it was safe area. There was a nice small park close by we walked to and in passing the neighbors seemed friendly. Host was flexible with check in time and responded quick to answer all questions.
We loved this place so much! It’s a beautiful space and super clean. Honestly one of the best Airbnbs we’ve ever stayed in! Jocy was wonderful!
We enjoyed our stay! We would definitely book again!

Thaer was super responsive to my questions. The home is well appointed and maintained. It was super clean. And the main bedroom shower is especially nice! I definitely will stay here on returning trips and recommend it to all.

This Airbnb location was great. It was perfect for our purposes (2 adults visiting Oak Park friends) - a single bedroom and a bathroom and a kitchen. Way less expensive (hundreds of dollars less expensive over four days) than other options in the same area! If, like us, you need a base to sleep at, this is perfect.
The multiple doors offer good security, but they could also stick sometimes, so don't be afraid to really throw your weight when opening the second and third door. The keys were well-labeled, which was a great help.
We visited in July, and it was warm inside, and very humid, despite full-time running the AC. I think this is normal as per the hot days and the basement level apartment. If you get warm when you sleep, definitely bring a thin blanket or sleep blanketless.
Overall, the price was fabulous and the space was ideal for ur location and to minimize trip costs.

Had a wonderful family gathering with our kids and grandson. The condo was very modern and updated. In a quiet neighborhood close to the Blue Line station. We went into downtown a lot and it was a safe walk to station. Enjoyed the local stores and especially La Nonna restaurant in the neighborhood. We found parking on the street easily usually. Could use an electric broom/sweeper for hard surface floors for guests to use.
We had a wonderful time staying in the carriage house! The fenced in backyard was great for our dog. It was quiet, clean, and easy to get around the city.

Magret's place was even nicer than pictured! We said on multiple occasions that this was one of our favorite Airbnbs to date. Some stand outs:
- Absolutely spotless (cleanest rental I have ever experienced)
- Peaceful outdoor space
- Very walkable to local bars and restaurants
- Easy and speedy communication - Margret was also very willing to work with us regarding checking in and out, as our flights were at less-than-ideal times.
A reminder that this is an apartment setting, so there can be some minor noise from above since this is a first floor unit. Nothing to worry about, but if you're a super light sleeper like me, have your white noise ready :) They do have fans in the bedroom closets, which was such a nice touch!!!
Thanks Margret for a wonderful stay!

Very organized space, with clearly labeled cabinets and shelves for each private room. Was the first time I have stayed in a shared space with strangers, and honestly I would do it again because of this experience!

Different questions arose on my part and Bella quick to respond. Additionally I made an error in making the reservation date, but she was invaluable in adjusting it. The place is a complete self sufficient unit and very quiet. A/c worked great for very hot days. Lack of available parking is a major limitation if one has a car, because neighborhood is all permitted.
Eileen and Eric are great hosts! The room is very comfortable and spacious and also within walking distance to the red line, grocery and restaurants. Highly recommend!
Great location and easy check in!
Super easy to work with!

Wood’s garden apartment was exactly as described! The 2 queen beds were comfortable. The space clean. The location fantastic (especially if you have interest in seeing the White Sox play). We especially enjoyed the huge flat screen TV.  We also enjoyed walks in the neighborhood which has ample sidewalk space (a nice change for us). I would recommend!

We stayed for 4 nights to do sightseeing.  The location was perfect.  A short walk through Chinatown to the Red Line and then a short train ride to the museums.  The unit was very clean and spacious.  2 large beds in one room downstairs and 2 bedrooms upstairs.  The bathroom is downstairs.  The A/C worked great.  We found parking down the street and left the car there while we used public transit.  So, we did not move the car all weekend. We felt safe in the neighborhood.  The kitchen had enough equipment to make simple meals and reheat leftovers.  We were  very happy with the amenities and the location.  We felt this was a great deal and recommend it!
Very clean, nice location and a great host.
Great stay! Cute and cozy place, room was very clean, nice location. Jen and Dan were friendly and helpful, and made it easy to share space. Highlight was definitely the 3 super cute and sweet cats!

Shovany’s home is absolutely perfect for your holiday. We stayed for 10 nights. Kitchen is fully equipped, bedrooms are perfect and extremely comfortable, washing machine and drier, bathroom kitted out with shampoo, conditioner and body washes. Every detail was so thoughtful and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Conveniently located beside the blue line. There was 4 of us girls in our 20’s and we felt extremely safe. 100% recommend. Shovany was also extremely quick at responding to anything we needed or requested.

Convenient location, close to major tourist areas. Also it was very clean and felt safe. It has a balcony and there is also a gym and rooftop access. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking to stay in downtown Chicago.
This was the perfect place to stay for our Chicago vacation! The owners have done a great job creating a space that felt homey and comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!

Our group of four stayed here for four nights, and it met our expectations very well. The location is excellent, and for the area, the price was a great value.
The essentials were all spot on:
Clean, comfortable beds & clean bathrooms.
The location felt safe & secure.
The refrigerator & coffee maker worked perfectly.
The air conditioner kept the apartment comfortably cool.
As a home base for sleeping, relaxing, and starting the day with coffee and a quick breakfast, this apartment worked great.
Here are a few things we noticed:
a) A nearby parking garage and streetlight keep the apartment bright at night, even with the blinds closed. Bring a sleep mask.
b) Noise from the downstairs gym is easy to hear. Earplugs help, or wake up early!
c) Some furniture and fixtures need attention: the chair is hilariously uncomfortable, a window shade doesn't work, the coffee table wobbles, and there were only 2 bowls and 1 wine glass (which is only a problem if the group wants ice cream or wine).

Positives:
1. Location -
2. Outdoor space
3. Well stocked kitchen
4. Parking space included
Negatives
1. Lots of stairs/backs to el station
2. Could be cleaner, black mold around refrigerator door and washing machine gasket
3. Tired decor, drawers fell out of fridge, doors fell of grill, grill was dirty, weeds in front yard and planters
Great communication, easy check-in, fantastic location. This is a good place that could be great w a little tlc

The apartment was clean, calm, comfortable and a really lovely place to stay. I had some trouble figuring out how to use the key code on the doors, but Cheryl was quick to respond and explained in more detail how to enter the code. I would definitely consider staying again! We had everything we needed.

Maybe the best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had, and certainly worth the price. Perfectly clean, nice AC, walkable, and had a private parking space which was HUGE. We especially appreciated the picnic table outside which was great for late night hangs. Nice natural lighting, great neighborhood. Felt safe and sound the entire time we were there, and Rolando and his co-host were very responsive and easy to work with. I would HIGHLY recommend this spot to anyone looking to stay in Chicago. Also very easy to get to the trains and busses and into town as needed. Book here!
Great place to stay!  Will likely come back!
Wonderful stay highly recommended! 5 star treatment. Will return soon
It was good for the price. I’ll stay again.
We had an amazing stay, felt right at home! Bonus points for the sweetest little dogs I’ve ever met!!

The apartment itself was excellent—beautifully and thoughtfully furnished, with a great kitchen equipped with everything we needed. Communication was clear and timely.
Unfortunately, you cannot choose your neighbors. Although many people on the street greeted us warmly during the day, there was one place across the street where we could hear varying levels of noise every evening.
The stay was amazing! Highly recommended for anybody looking for a welcoming place and a peaceful area!!!
Great location and very responsive host!
Great location, close to lake and restaurants.  Hosts are great communicators.  Decent value.  The building is old and the apartment could use some updating.
The place was clean and decently located, check-in was easy, Saurin was a kind and helpful host. No complaints, I would certainly recommend.

Our first visit to the Windy City, enjoyed it immensely.  Our hosts were friendly and helpful. Our family of 7 thoroughly enjoyed the Museum of Science and Industry and then the beautiful Japanese Gardens per our host’s recommendation. Apartment was lovely, welcoming and clean.

We had the best stay in Chicago! The airbnb was spotless and had everything we needed to be comfortable. Also, the neighborhood was charming. Highly recommend walking to De Luna Taco Grill (cash only)  if you get the chance!

La ubicación del departamento es espectacular conectas muy bien a cualquier parte de la ciudad
El edificio es de categoría y está todo en perfectas condiciones
Es ideal para llegar en auto a Chicago ya que tiene estacionamiento dentro del edificio
Muy buena ubicación para poder hacer turismo en la ciudad de Chicago

Very comfortable and cozy place.
Good neighborhood. I enjoyed my stay

Marco's place was one of the best, cleanest, and most accurately described rentals we've had in Chicago. He was clear with his communication throughout the process and incredibly responsive. This location was exactly as described in the listing and the interior was spotless. The bathrooms were especially well appointed when compared to other rentals we've had in the area.
Highly recommend.
Muy buen lugar para quedarse
Richard is so nice! He was very clear about all the rules and was very helpful throughout. Great location as well, right next to the Metra train.

We had an amazing time. The location was close to everything we had planned. The just was responsive and took care of anything we asked for. We would recommend this place 10x over. The neighborhood is going through renewal, but it was peaceful and people were very friendly.
had a perfect stay at the coach house! great, walkable location in Wicker Park, close to everything, and secure! Jaime was super responsive and welcoming.

閑静な住宅街で、都心部からも遠くなく便利。アメニティや家具等もよく、広々として清潔な良い環境でした。
ゲストが書くことの出来る落書き色紙がよかったです。子供たちが喜んで書いていました。
ドライヤーがなかったのが残念。

Great location - short walk to everything you need but on a gorgeous, quiet neighborhood street in one of the most beautiful parts of Chicago! Both bedrooms had a private bedroom which was great for hosting my parents. Would stay again.
Had a great time! We had everything we needed and more:)

Ok.
Todo según lo descrito en el anuncio.

Tim's place was only about a block from public transportation, which made it super convenient as I had several places I needed to visit in Chicago. I was traveling by myself and felt very welcome and safe.
Tim does a great job of providing upfront directions and information. He's also super responsive.If you have other questions. it was extra sweet of him to provide earplugs, as the place is very close to the train.
Great place in Roseland

We stayed at this house mainily for the location, number of people it accommodates, and the attached driveway parking. The house is older, as are some of the furnishings, and has a few quirks as is stated in the description but has been kept very clean and functional. Miguel was friendly and flexible (allowing us to check-in early and check out late). The property is located right next to a corner gas station but don't be put off by that in any way. It still felt very private and was nice and quiet at night. Overall we had a comfortable stay and we would definetly stay again.

Mój pobyt w tym miejscu był świetny. Pokój był czysty, a łóżka naprawdę wygodne. Łazienka również czysta i dobrze zaopatrzona. Okolica jest spokojna i bezpieczna. Czułam się tu bardzo dobrze. Gospodarz pomocny i szybko odpowiada na wiadomości. Zameldowanie bezproblemowe. Serdecznie polecam!

Good stay in a great neighborhood. The place was accurately described and maintained. The host helpfully noted that street parking is difficult. This reminded me of typical apartments I’ve lived in within the city.
Great location, easy to get too, clean apartment. Perfect for a short stay in the neighborhood.

The location is absolutely perfect! Walk to coffee, restaurants, shopping, the park and the lake. Very quick train/bus ride anywhere else. Unit is much larger than anticipated, with all needed amenities. Parking spot was a perk, but it’s surprisingly easy to find street parking nearby.
Todo lo que se describe se cumple a la perfección, fácil de conectar con el CTA y los anfitriones siempre están al pendiente de tus necesidades

10/10 airbnb, very beautiful and clean. 3 very comfortable and clean rooms/bath rooms. truly a stunning apt
walkable neighborhood. walked to nearby food and bars and target and back from the salt shed venue 25 mins away (walking) felt safe and comfortable. parking was not that difficult but just prepare for it (always plan ahead for parking if coming to chicago anyways) great stay overall. host was really great as well. thank you so much, if ever in the area again definitely will rebook
Perfect place for the price!

The host was helpful and very professional throughout my short stay. Communication from her was great. The location was perfect for a comfortable stay with no car (Walgreens and blue line stop). There are cool local spots for nightlife just a few minutes’ walking distance. I felt safe walking alone in the general area.

The accommodations were unremarkable.
1) The grass in the front of the apartment had not been mowed.
2) The white washcloths & towels appeared "very" well-used (old) & were stained & dingey.
3) The provided canisters containing shampoo, conditioner & body wash, in the bathroom, appeared to have been used so much that they were barely filled (maybe an inch of product was in each one). I had brought my own but to have empty canisters is not a good look.
4) There was one less-than-full roll of toilet paper.
5) The freezer & refrigerator contained open/unopened food (against the owners' policy), as I understood it.
6) The refrigerator needed a new filter.
7) A plaque with the Wi-Fi network and password were smudged beyond understanding.
8) TV in the back bedroom wasn't working properly; static-ky picture.
It seemed their cleaning person cleaned but didn't put 100% into the job & report issues to owner.
Again, what I did like were regular texted check-ins, the quick responses & decor.
Nice place,roomy and host was very responsive.

We didn't have a car for our visit and the Logan Square neighborhood was full of good restaurants, shops and other places we could walk to. The blue line station was a five to ten minute walk and that made it easy to get downtown and to O'Hare.
We'd definitely stay at George's again.
This home is spacious. It was perfect for my friends and I to come together. The train is not too far away and there’s grocery stores nearby. The hosts are very responsive as well.
Feven was an excellent host. Quick responses, clear instructions and the home was amazing. We would definitely rebook for our next trip to Chicago.
Great stay would definitely recommend
Lots of room for our big family, and convenient location. Nice kitchen and well stocked. We were very grateful at how well the air conditioning worked!
Iris's place was perfect, easy parking and quite, even though its right on a busy street it wasn't noisy, when I'm back in the area I would  rent again.

Great communication with Cheryl prior to trip. Ran into Cheryl as we checked in and she took time to tell us about community, transportation and stories about historical sites in area including the Airbnb. Easy walks to good restaurants and transportation hubs. The apartment was comfortable, clean and enjoyed our stay. Would come back. Thanks Cheryl!!
Everything was SO nice and clean loved it, it was so cute. Location was a lil weird but not far from a bunch of things. Overall would def recommend and be back next time I’m in town.
Very Nice Place to Stay. Right next to the Blue Line station.

The location and cleanliness of this place were good, and the AC was great. The dedicated parking space was wonderful. Tariq was also very responsive.  Unfortunately, the home was not as well maintained as the photos and description show. Two of the three ceiling fans did not work. (Tariq did offer to provide a portable fan when we inquired about the ceiling fans, which was nice.) Most of the blinds had some breakage, and the lack of curtains in some of the rooms made sleep very difficult due to the bright lights outside. The beds were also extremely firm and some of the bed frames loud. The furniture was  also more worn than the pictures really showed. The unit seems like a nice place that isn’t being as well maintained as it could be for the price, but it was an adequate stay for our purposes.

This Airbnb is located in a building on Milwaukee Ave about a 10 minute walk from the Damen Blue Line stop, right in the heart of Wicker Park with all the great restaurants and shops nearby. That said, as other reviewers have noted, the unit is remarkably quiet since it's on the alley-side of the building. There are two flights of stairs to walk up to reach the unit. The unit itself was clean, comfortable, and well appointed.

Really enjoyed our stay. Beds were super comfortable, the house had ample space, and the kids loved the game table and movie area. The kitchen was workable and spacious, especially for a downtown Chicago house. It was a touch warm upstairs at night as the temps were extremely high for July, but each upstairs bedroom was equipped with either a box fan or a ceiling fan (or both). It made all the difference. No issues sleeping despite the warmer temps. Parking was a bit of a challenge despite the parking passes due to street cleaning and public works/street closures in the area, but none of this was something the host could have controlled, and it worked out just fine in the end. TLDR: would stay here again for sure.
We had such a lovely time staying at Colin’s home. Amazing location, very walkable, convenient train stop. A very cozy and well decorated home as well! Would absolutely love to stay again.
Very clean, pristine almost. Host was very helpful and responded fast, beautiful home, very peaceful as well. We enjoyed ourselves!

This walk up was in the perfect location for us. Just 2 blocks from my son who we were visiting. It was close to the train station, grocery store and multiple restaurants. It does have 2 flights of stairs and no elevator. We ate out most of the time because the kitchen was small and dark without many dishes etc.  but was in such a great location. I didn’t want to cook anyways. Haha.

Really enjoyed my stay here! The place was clean, cozy, and had everything I needed. The host was kind, responsive, and easy to communicate with. They didn’t have an ironing board at first, but they went out of their way to arrange one overnight, which I thought was such a thoughtful and sweet gesture. It really showed they cared about making my stay comfortable. I’d definitely stay here again and would happily recommend this place to others!
Great place for a group of friends
Great Airbnb! It was highly walkable, close to transit and restaurants, and clean and pleasant. The well-equipped kitchen and comfortable living room were bonuses!
Very cute apartment in a great spot. Easy to get into, very comfortable, and had everything I’d need. I would absolutely stay here again on my next visit to Chicago!

I've stayed at two of Laura's apartments, and both have been excellent. Her check-in instructions were clear and made getting inside incredibly easy. The apartment is charming, comfortable, and in a fantastic location, with plenty of great restaurants and things to do nearby. The beds and seating were especially comfortable, making it easy to relax after a day out. Laura is a wonderful host, and I would recommend staying here without hesitation

This is an incredibly well appointed, supremely comfortable and convenient unit in the heart of Wrigleyville. Perfect for games and concerts at Wrigley with easy access to surrounding neighborhoods walking/biking and public transport. Easy on site parking, very secure building. We have stayed at dozens of AirBnB properties and this was the cleanest, freshest, unit we have ever enjoyed. Looking forward to a return visit.

Loved the location! Adorable building in Wicker Park, walkable to tons of stuff. Super cute exterior, and the inside was quite nice as well. Well furnished and stocked with everything we needed. Bedrooms were very small (I was surprised neither felt like a master bedroom), but not an issue for us. There was a ton of foot traffic above the unit that went until late (way past 10 pm) and started very early (way before 7 am). I would stay again, but maybe I would pack some earplugs! Also, 4 pm check-in is pretty late compared to most places I've stayed. 3 pm, though late, feels more typical, so plan ahead!
My mom and I stayed at Adrianna’s home for 2 days and it was great! Clean and very quiet, the host was open to questions and gave us clear instructions. Will def book again!

We loved our stay here right near the Riverwalk!! We were able to easily get around and explore the city of Chicago!! It was neat to stay in an older building with lots of character! We had a great visit and would highly recommend it!

Host. Jhon is friendly, professional and very responsive.
Building. A little dated and the elevator was not working the entire stay. Made the stay a little arduous and stressful. Especially, since I was on the 4th floor.
Apartment. Clean, cozy and comfortable. However, it did need a little work. Had to add some extra lighting with soft light, light bulbs. The one lamp with the daylight, light bulb did not provide good and comfortable lighting. The shower needs a shelf to place your bodywash, etc., instead of on the shower floor. Also, the baby/small iron board was useless. I bought me a regular ironing board.
Overall, a decent stay. Really wished the elevator was working though. i put in some mileage on those stairs.

My family had a wonderful stay at Alana’s place! The place itself was just as described and quite cozy. We had everything we needed for our stay. The neighborhood was quiet and had several shops and restaurants in walking distance. It was also close to downtown and many other beautiful areas that were fun to explore.
Great, convenient place!  This was super convenient for access to UChicago.  Nice layout and clean.  Thanks!
Very friendly and very responsive hosts. Great neighborhood and cozy place. Will definitely stay again in the future.

Overall, our stay at the lofts was nice. Most of the day, we were outside meeting with friends and exploring the city, and only stayed in the room to wash up and sleep. The weather was hot and humid during our stay and the window ac units did its best to keep the room cool, but it still felt muggy in the room. The location was great and close to everything including both train and bus stops. Communication was prompt and helpful.

Our group had an excellent stay! The home was extremely clean, comfortable, and exactly as pictured. It had tons of amenities and was incredibly well stocked, including plenty of cleaning supplies and a kitchen full of spices and everything we needed to cook.
The gated parking was a huge plus, and we really appreciated having no long list of checkout instructions or chores to complete. We were able to enjoy our trip until the very end without worrying about a bunch of tasks before leaving.
Everything about our stay was easy, comfortable, and thoughtfully set up for guests. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!
Great place to stay close to events, restaurants, and shopping. Had everything we needed and enjoyed our time.

Heather is/was a great communicator from the very beginning, proactively providing pointers on how to best experience Chicago - points of interest, parking options (a must know), and answering questions in no time.
For the local area, Heather provided pharmacies, grocery shops, and specialty foods near us. Upon arrival, it almost felt that we'd already been there.
I absolutely recommend this listing.

The apartment was very spacious, perfect for my family. It was clean, safe and located in a perfect spot and close to down town Chicago. We felt very safe and the neighborhood was friendly. We found a cute neighborhood Italian Ice in walking distance that we went to. We would stay here again and recommend!

Great place, fulfilled our needs.
Having a balcony and parking is wonderful.
The host did a great job communicating check in details and answered any questions we had. It was a great stay!
We needed to be on the North side of Chicago and this location is great. Close to public transportation and plenty of grocery, Walgreens and fast food.
Fantastic location that had everything we needed. Great job communicating and was easy in, easy out. Personnel was very friendly. Thank you Kasa!
Cozy place, perfect for one or two people. Great location. So much is within walking distance, including public transportation. You do NOT need a car here. Stephanie is a great and gracious host.

We enjoyed staying at Scott's place in the Edgewater neighborhood.  When we visit Chicago, we love to visit different neighborhoods and experience what they have to offer.  Scott was really helpful with information and we enjoyed being able to walk to public transportation, restaurants, grocery stores, concert in the park.  The studio apartment had everything we needed for a 3 night visit.  It was super hot outside, but the A/C unit and fan did the job!  There is a steep staircase to get up to the 2nd floor, so be aware of that when booking.  But we would definitely consider coming again!
Great stay, lots of nice restaurants and taverns nearby.

This was a very open, comfortable space. We really enjoyed it. It’s in a great neighborhood and was in walking distance from many cafes, pubs and restaurants. Maria was great. She was traveling in Europe, but was always reachable and quick to help.
This place definitely met our needs and was very close to family that we were visiting in Avondale. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it highly.
Becca handled any issues quickly.  Enjoyed the stay very much, wonderful safe neighborhood. Great communication prior to stay!

We stay at Nick’s place every time we come to Chicago! We love it. It’s so convenient that we can cook and that there are two bathrooms. We never have had to wait. The house is quiet and comfortable. Multiple busses stop on the corner, so it made getting around easy in addition to the L stop being close. Nick is a great host! Highly recommend.
Jess was Awesome! I got the rest I anticipated.  I was able to check in and out at a reasonable time frame. Will most definitely stay at the properties again.

I stayed here for a weekend, and it was the perfect place for my partner and me. The location is fantastic, with plenty to see, do, and eat nearby. Carlo is an excellent host, and everything was smooth from start to finish.
Great area!
Nat was extremely accommodating and the place was easy to access, great location, and perfect for what we were looking for. Thanks again!! ☺️
I liked the place a lot
Great place.

Excellent property and an awesome host! The amenities are fantastic—great water pressure in the shower, reliable plumbing, and a powerful, responsive AC system. The location is quiet, very secure, and I felt completely safe throughout my stay. 10/10!
Wir hatten eine wirklich schöne Zeit im Haus. Es hat alles ohne Probleme geklappt und die Lage war wirklich hervorragend.

Me and my family stayed here for three nights and enjoyed every second! Although we had a little of complications checking in, kody was very quick to help us out. Overall, clean space, quiet area (besides the dogs next door 😂), beautiful views, and great facilities. Would definitely come back.
We had a wonderful stay! Very safe and walkable neighborhood. David’s property was very clean, easy accessible, and a central location to everything in Wrigleyville. Would absolutely stay here again!

We had an amazing stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location. Check-in and check-out were seamless. The place was very welcoming. We loved the cool urban feel of the space, especially the street art wall mural that gave the apartment so much character. You can tell these hosts really take great care of the place and put thought into making it a comfortable stay for their guests.
We stayed for a couple of nights to celebrate my fiancé’s birthday and attend a concert at Huntington Bank Pavilion, and the location couldn’t have been better. We didn’t need to use our car once! The walk to and from the concert was easy, and even though it ended late, we felt safe walking back since there were plenty of other concertgoers heading in the same direction.
It was also within walking distance of Millennium Park, great restaurants, and so many other attractions. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

We had a wonderful time staying at the apartment. Place was spotless, great amenities, easy access, secure and garage parking with in and out access located just around the corner.
Hosting team was very responsive and helpful.
Will certainly stay here again on our next trip.
It was as described and the instructions were clear. Restraunts are fantastic in the area

The positives are there are three beds with the ability to close barn doors for some privacy on the entry room. The host was proactive with instructions to the property. He also answers quickly and assisted immediately when we had troublr getting in, etc. There is air conditioning in each room. The kitchen has basic utensils and pots for cooking. There is a garage for parking. The not so positives: The unit I stayed in (no. 3) is not accessible. Although the Google maps view from the street shows a ground floor breezeway, if it matters for you, there is a steep set of stairs. The parking garage was impossible for me to lift so I resorted to street parking. You cannot access the apartment from the back of the property so you have to wheel luggage around the block to the front. (told on arrival). There is street parking in front on a busy, congested street. The curtains block the window unit so I had to pin them out of the way. The bad: The unit has an underlying damp, moldly smell.

I loved our stay! We traveled from PR and stayed there for 6 days. Super close to the city. We ubered but there’s a train station near by to get around. Beautiful clean house and quiet neighborhood. Would deffinitely stay again 🙏🏼
Location, location, location. Extremely walkable and felt very safe. Would absolutely stay here in the future
our stay was great and affordable. felt pretty comfortable. I enjoyed the area it was in and was the perfect location to get to everything we were doing. only minutes from so many parks
Beautiful home
Great stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and the hosts were very welcoming.

Nicholas was amazing! An amazing host and was responsive almost immediate.
He was understanding and patient with my picky ways.
If you want a comfortable place to rest your head and have no need for a lot of hustle and bustle, this is perfect.
Thank you again Nicholas for your pristine hospitality!

We loved staying at Gabrielle's! The space was very comfortable and clean. It is more spacious than the photos portray. It is conveniently located a few minutes' walk away from the Blue Line and bus stops. She and her partner were friendly and happy to chat whenever we passed them in the back stairwell.
We would happily book this place again on our next visit to Chicago :)
Great spot, perfect 15 minute walk to Wrigley The bed is super comfortable and the balcony gets a wonderfully pleasant breeze for hot days. Karen was very kind and communicative throughout! Recommend

Overall, I had a good stay and felt it was worth the price. The check-in process was straightforward, and the host was responsive whenever I had questions. For anyone looking for an affordable place to stay, this is a solid option. I appreciated the communication and would recommend this listing to others.
As advertised, would stay again
Ideal location, clean room, Patrica responded quickly to any questions
Nice spot for our plans would stay here again thanks!!
Thank you Ken.  The location is close to the museums and historical sites
We struck gold with this Airbnb! Lots of amenities, incredible neighborhood, and such a clean and cozy home. Bozena is the best host! We would love to come back next time we’re in town.
We had a great stay! Laura was very responsive and flexible. Location and apartment were great.

Location was great, and the space was perfect for what we needed for a quick weekend trip. Sort of a little basement apartment, and they did well with the small space. But the neighborhood and area was amazing.
While the main a/c unit was quite effective, the 2 individual bedrooms can get a little stuffy at night if you close the doors, as there is no central cooling. Just something to keep in mind if staying in the summer…but not a big deal.
Hosts were incredibly responsive, gabe great recommendations and had great communication. Would stay here again.
Tommy really thought of everything. This is probably the most welcoming Airbnb I’ve ever been in. Great location. Perfect for this trip.

I enjoyed my stay. The place is as described. Vlad obviously takes time to include small details to make guests feel welcomed. I really enjoyed reading the picture book about the neighborhood and historical places. The studio was clean and well decorated. I felt safe and comfortable.
A FEW TIPS FOR GUESTS:
The studio is in the lower level of the home and so there are 5 stairs to walk down. If you arrive at night, use a flashlight because the front of the home and front walkway is not well lit. However, once you get to the entry door to the studio, there are lights outside.

This was a great spot to stay in Chicago it I close to a bunch of places and super clean and comfortable. Ag and Krista were exceptionally accommodating to our needs for our stay and made us feel right at home and welcomed to the community with a ton of recommendations to places. I would recommend this place to anyone who plans on staying in Chicago 10/10

Laura was a fantastic host. The apartment was easy to find, and her check-in instructions were clear and made accessing the space effortless. The apartment itself is charming and comfortable. We felt right at home. Laura was also very responsive throughout my stay. I would definitely recommend staying here.
Excellent stay, unit exactly as described. Super easy to get to Obama Center and Univ of Chicago campus is beautiful! Great condo!
