Had an amazing stay at Kate's coach house! The location is fantastic—it's even closer to Hollywood Beach and the vibrant Andersonville neighborhood than it appears on the map. Getting around was incredibly easy, with Ubers arriving within minutes, so we never felt like we needed a car.
The space is even more beautiful in person than the photos suggest. The pictures simply don't do it justice. The layout is so well designed that it feels like you're staying in a private home rather than a studio. The kitchen is spacious and thoughtfully equipped, the shower is absolutely gorgeous, and the bed was incredibly comfortable.
One of our favorite things was how peaceful and private the coach house felt. Tucked behind the main house, it was quiet and relaxing—you get all the benefits of staying in the city without any of the noise or hassle.
Kate was a tremendous host and made the entire experience seamless. We would gladly stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.
Nice bright, clean and spacious space!  Loved the location (Andersonville), and would book again. Thanks!
Beautiful home, the beds  were very comfortable. It was very convenient to Jackson park because we were in town for the house party picnic. I would definitely stay here again

This is *such* a good spot -- easy walks to Lincoln Park and the lakefront path to the east, or the Brown and Red lines to the west. Didn't have any issues with street parking, or anything else for that matter. Highly, highly recommended. Many thanks!
It was very nice to have the private parking spot. Easy to get in and out and the instructions were so simple! Highly recommend!
My second time staying here, always a great spot in Chicago. Plenty of things in the area but also very accessible to the trains and bus lines! Will continue looking to stay here whenever I visit!
Great location, great hosts

We stayed at Anthony’s place with our three teenagers for a short family vacation. We were a little nervous about everyone sharing one bathroom and the three of them sleeping in the same room, but it all worked out really well. The living room with three beds is very spacious, even with the beds down, and none of them complained about discomfort. Anthony was very quick to respond to our request for more bedding. The bedroom is also very large, so there was plenty of space to get ready in the morning or relax. It’s also a walkable neighborhood with convenient access to parking, public transportation, and tourist attractions.

We loved our stay at the Wrigleyville house! We had six people—two kids, two parents, two grandparents. Everyone had their own spaces and more people could have fit on pull-out couches, etc. Perfect for our multigenerational trip but would be a great friend getaway for a couple Cubs games, etc.
I appreciated that Chris messaged us and let us know we could check in early and the check-out instructions/procedures were the easiest I’ve ever encountered!

Jed was very helpful and friendly. The photos made it easy to locate. The house was clean, spacious, and comfortable. We enjoyed the neighborhood including the Bakehouse out front and the shops and restaurants.  We would love to stay here again next time we are in Chicago.
Great location. Easily walkable to the stadium and many other places in the city.
The space was wonderful. Street parking was free and easy to find close to the house.
This place was exactly what we needed for our trip. The neighborhood was so cute and walkable. And our host was extremely responsive! Would recommend.

Unit was not as pictured, once our final deposit was paid there was no response to any of our messages.  The unit has quite a list of issues that were messaged along with a request for 15% refund which was never answered or acknowledged.  There were ants in the kitchen, broken tiles and other issues through out.  Beds were short sheeted causing us to remake the beds.  One closet was unusable I’m the hanging rod so high even my 6’4” husband couldn’t reach it.  Overall the unit was shabby and not deserving of a five star review.  We tried to communicate and deal via messages and refund requests which were ignored.  The location was convenient and neighborhood quiet, but expectations based on photos and description were not met and too expensive for what the actual product was.

The home was clean and neat and the area was really beautiful and mostly quiet. The host, Brad responds within a timely manner and overall, for my first visit to Chicago, this has been a nice experience.
Very clean! Very comfortable! Great communication. Highly recommend this place if visiting Chinatown.

We had a great stay at Rida’s for the weekend. We ended up enjoying some local restaurants as well as the local Irish bar for a fun evening, too! Different from the downtown Chicago scene, but we enjoyed ourselves. The apartment was very clean and easily accessible. We felt safe and comfortable our entire stay! Thank you, Rida!
This place was perfect for us. Brad was very responsive and instructions to check in and out were very clear.

Chiara’s place honestly looked better than the pictures. Chiara was extremely responsive and very kind! Initially the neighborhood looked a little sketchy, but my three friends and I felt safe during our stay. I would definitely stay here again.
This place is perfect. We loved the cozy feel of the room and the serene garden. Would definitely stay here again.

Brad was great! His Airbnb my partner and I stayed in was lovely! We enjoyed our time and would definitely come back. The only con was the parking was hard and the hallway carpet outdoors smelled a bit strong but none of these things are in brads control. Great place and great host
I had a great stay at this property. Kyriako went above and beyond to ensure I had a wonderful experience. I will certainly stay here again.

overall a very good stay if you can handle all the details that are explicitly mentioned on the page. yes, it will be loud if there's something happening at United center. but if you're here for an event at the United center then it's a very quick trip there and if there's a concert, you can sit outside and enjoy the music.
the bed was a bit squeaky but it wasn't a problem for me. and it's really just a place to crash, shower, and relax. granted the bathroom situation can vary as one guest was in the bathroom for 2 hours for a morning. but I think that guest was highly irregular as most people don't need a bathroom for that long.
overall great stay if you read through the description and decide it's worth it for you
Nick's place was great. Would definitely stay there again.

My friends, sisters and I had our first trip to Chicago and stayed at this place. It was a perfect location for us to explore the city because it was 11 minutes from the Chinatown station, and right across a bus station. We had a wonderful stay as a group, and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to be in the city, but have room to walk around and explore.
Milan was a wonderful host as well! He was proactive with his messages, and was informative with directions regarding the lock outside our apartment and the building as well.
Quaint space. Just what we needed for a long weekend in the city.

We stayed in Jacqueline's place in Chicago for a long weekend and it was great! The space was very clean and easy to find. The location was great for easy access to public transit and some great local bars and restaurants. Jacqueline was very easy to communicate with and her hospitality was very welcoming! I highly recommend staying in her space if making a trip to Chicago.

A very beautiful, comfortable home with a great location and wonderful hosts. Will definitely be my first choice whenever I return to Chicago!
Tammy even took the time to mail me back something important that I left behind, thank you so much!

This house made my stay stress-free. It's close to the areas I came to the city to visit; the check-in was easy; the house was clean and reminded me of my own home. My children and grandsons really enjoyed the stay. I would recommend this house to anyone who needs the space. The house is three levels with bedrooms and a bathroom on each level, which made it so convenient for all of us to get ready for the day.
Me and 6 of my friends stayed for my birthday trip and it was perfect. Just enough space and rooms for everyone to stay comfortably!

Erica was a great host! She responded quickly and was always available. Getting in was easy and the location was close to the event I came for.
Be mindful that the other tenants who live there are regular renters and are on the younger side. So, the cleanliness is not the best as the stay goes on. Body odor was an issue for one of them. Personally, I don't think I'll stay in another Airbnb with unknown guests who aren't the owner moving forward.

Leonidis was responsive and active from the moment I booked the bnb! He was always clear with everything and made it extremely easy to find and get in the home. The home itself was SO cool, tons of games and actual arcade games,  it actually matched the pictures to a T. The kitchens is spacious and stocked as well as the bathroom. The beds are insanely comfy and there are tvs in every room. It really feels like a vacation spot. I will be coming back again next time I’m in town :)
That is a pretty lovely house, really comfortable, it was an unforgettable experience in Chicago for the two weeks stay!
We had a lovely stay. Very convenient location to Old Towne and Brown Line, easy check in and check out. Celia is an awesome host. Thank you

What a great place to stay for my friends and I (and turned out we know some folks who stayed at the same place last year). Cindy was super responsive when we had questions about the door and lock. Would definitely stay here again!
First time in Chicago and Ping's place was definitely worth it. Centered in the middle of all the happenings! Very clean and tidy. I would definitely stay here again! Thanks Ping 😀

We went to a concert at Wrigley and the location was perfect. Parking is a challenge. We are experienced Chicago travelers but we usually stay in hotels. Do your research before hand if you’re bringing a vehicle. Otherwise it was a cozy and quiet place!

We absolutely loved staying at Alex’s place! It was exactly how it was described and looked in the listing. There were snacks and k cups there for us until we got to the grocery store. Location was super quiet but yet just a few blocks to coffee shops, restaurants, and Target for anything we needed. The best part was the roof top view! Can’t be beat! I hope we can stay there again in the future!
Other than tough parking everything was great! Would book again

This was our second stay at Angelika and Zibi's place.  We returned because we had a good experience the first time, liked the location, and felt it was a good value for money.  This second stay was also a good experience.  Host communication was excellent, the unit is clean and nicely furnished, and our party of 3 adults was very comfortable.  On this stay we did experience quite a bit of nighttime noise from the upstairs neighbors so earplugs are recommended.  There were a few maintenance items that we also communicated to the hosts upon leaving, but nothing major.  One small tip - when you are entering the building, you will enter a 4 digit code to unlock the door.  You have to push a button (any button will do) to wake the keypad up before entering the code.  The door into the unit itself does not seem to require an extra button push like this.  Overall, another good stay at this airbnb and we would stay here again!

Leroy was a very responsive individual . However the air didn’t work in the rooms but only in the living room area . The sheets were dirty as well so we ended up sleeping on the couches which weren’t very clean either . I think if a cleaning crew came in and deep cleaned the place this would be an ideal spot for the money but it definitely needs to be cleaned and up kept . Some noise from above us as well after midnight but nothing unbearable .
Great stay! Shawna was very easy to work with and we had no problem with the place. Good amount of space, quiet neighborhood.  Everything worked, no issues. Will stay again if available!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was very clean, comfortable, and exactly what we were looking for. The bedroom was cozy, and we felt right at home throughout our visit. The neighborhood also felt safe and peaceful, which made our stay even more enjoyable. The location was convenient for getting around and exploring the area. Overall, it was a great experience, and we would definitely recommend staying here!

This is the second time we have stayed here, and Kristine’s place is just what we need. It is fantastic! Beautifully appointed, very walkable neighborhood, close to the el if needed, helpful instructions, and so many “extras.” We love to stay here when we are in Chicago and will definitely stay again.
We enjoyed the place the kids loved it and area had a few minor hiccups but I overall stay was enjoyable would book again.

My partner and I stayed here with our two friends to visit some of our other friends that live just down the block, this place is in a great neighborhood and feels right at home as soon as you walk in! Has everything you would need for a weekend stay in a cozy Chicago neighborhood :) the hosts were very friendly as well and always available for help

The apartment was clean and within walking distance to many stores, restaurants etc. It can be noisy at times due to it being the lower floor.  The shared washer and dryer work well, remember to bring your own supplies!
Bel was fantastic.  Great communication. Early luggage drop off and check-in.  Location was close to easy transportation to the Loop and near fantastic food/bars/coffee shops. Thanks, Bel.
We really enjoyed our stay. The place was exactly like the pictures. Quiet neighborhood so that's a plus.
Wonderful house in wicker park!
We were very pleased with our stay. We were in town visiting our nephew whom lives in the neighborhood. Easy walk to the train and Dunkin for coffee and breakfast!
Our stay in Chicago was wonderful.
Good stay! Looks like the pics. We had a great time in Summertime Chi!

Very clean condo.  A/C worked great.  Location is close to lots of areas, china town, little Italy and Greek town.  Very easy to uber or Lyft places.  The free parking spot included was very nice to have.  Surrounding area is very urban.  It was a bit noisy at times outside but to be expected.  Overall it was a good experience.

Rich was a great host and very proactive throughout our stay. He was incredibly accommodating, especially since my group had to leave our previous Airbnb unexpectedly. The house was clean and well-maintained, and we appreciated his responsiveness.
My only concerns were the number of spiders we encountered inside the house, having a back door in one of the bedrooms, and seeing groups of people walking around the neighborhood late at night, which made us feel a bit uneasy. Overall, Rich was an excellent host and did his best to ensure we had a positive experience.

Great location, walkable neighborhood with good food, grocery across the street, and easy bus access. The house has really nice fenced in outdoor space, with a small deck, grass yard, and patio. There were thoughtful touches like toiletries provided and plenty of equipment in the kitchen. The downside was a big temperature difference between the lower level and main floor (outside temps were 80-90 this week), so it was tricky to get the right temperature for everyone to sleep, but the host has plenty of fans, blankets, etc to help make it more comfortable. Check in and check out were a breeze.
nice apartment in the perfect location, right next to the bus to get into downtown chicago, pretty quiet steet, easy to check in and out, clean place, comfy bed, nice hot water exactly what we needed
The Airbnb was very beautiful, clean and the surrounding area very peaceful and nice. I will definitely stay there again when it’s time for me to go back to Chicago.. I really enjoyed myself.
Todo perfecto, el anfitrión siempre predispuesto a ayudarnos en todo

The apartment was clean, cozy and matched the description. We were impressed by how well stocked it is (sunscreen, floss, candles, chargers, fun books and puzzles) without feeling cramped. Great location close to needless options for delicious food and coffee.

Good stay, close to the metro, good neighborhood, Airbnb had everything we needed. Slightly noisy if you are a light sleeper (but you are living under someone). And unit is a bit musty. But stay was good and so was the trip.
Our stay was enjoyable. Great for a few nights in Chicago with a few guests. I would stay again.

This studio was a great spot for our weekend trip! The space is a perfect yet cute crash pad for when we were ready to stop exploring the city and rest. Logan Square is an amazing neighborhood—we loved how many restaurants and cafés were within walking distance. Benjamin and Karen not only provided plenty of amenities (extra towels, makeup remover wipes, a TV that we could watch in bed), but they were also very helpful whenever I had a question or concern during our stay. Would absolutely stay here again during our next visit!
Fantastic for my friends and I for the weekend. Great location and the price was incredible for the place. Highly recommend
We enjoyed our stay. The location was nice with interesting places to explore from all directions. The bed was comfortable.
very nice place 100%recommended

Wonderful stay! We have visited Chicago many times and this is the first Airbnb that we say we would return to. Not because others were not good stays - this place just marked so many boxes for us.
Well kept, spacious, amenities great.
Cannot say enough good things about our stay.
Thank you Latasha for being a wonderful host!

Our family of 17 enjoyed the property. The space was beautiful and the neighborhood was really nice. I would have preferred the fee for the hot tub to be rolled into the rental but thats not a major issue. The host always responded with 20 minutes whenever I had a question. I would absolutely rent from the host and rent this space again
very responsive! great location!

It was great for what we needed. We had trouble with the monitors and the property manager was very responsive and very attentive.
I would definitely rent again ☺️

Needed a place to stay on the south side while in town for a festival. It was easy finding and getting into Louis’ place. The neighborhood/home was a quiet and clean resting place for us. The home was clean and there were plenty of linens and soaps available for the folks in my group that forgot to bring them.
Great place to stay
Olga was very responsive, accommodating and helpful on personal things I asked for I would definitely book with her again and you should book with her now!!

As a host, Marissa deserves 5 stars. She was proactive, responsive, professional, and incredibly helpful throughout my stay, basically everything you’d hope for in an Airbnb host or just anyone in hospitality.
For value, I’d give the apartment 4 stars. It’s an older building located right next to the train tracks, and the window AC units are quite noisy. That said, compared to other Airbnbs and hotels in Chicago, I think the pricing is fair. Marissa even provides earplugs for guests, which was a thoughtful touch.
The apartment itself is charming and exceptionally clean. The bed was one of the most comfortable I’ve slept in, and I had a great sleep. Overall, it was a wonderful stay, and I’d absolutely give it 5 stars.
My fiance and I really enjoyed staying here. Great location. Very quiet.
Nick was a great host, dogs were very friendly and area is super accessible to many different things around Wrigley. Can't wait to come back and enjoy another weekend away!

Overall I am very satisfied with the stay. The apartment was nice, the neighborhood seemed great, the room was as described. The hosts rules of no visitors and strict 10am checkout seemed restrictive but as long as you accept the terms you’ll have a good stay.
Nice place, good furniture, comfortable beds and and amenities. Also very conveniently located.

Lilian was a great host and  accommodated our last minute reservation and requests from e an early check in. The unit has everything we needed for the weekend and Lilian always responded promptly to questions and requests during our stay. Will definitely consider staying at her place on a future trip to Chicago.
Very responsive host and welcoming. Willing to help and accommodations were appropriate. The location is good just a bit on the noisy side because its beside the street but nothing too excessive

We enjoyed our stay, it looked like the pictures and was very roomy. It was a reasonable drive from Midway and didn’t take long for us to get to most of the sites we wanted to visit. Parking was always available directly in front of the house, so we never even had to use the garage, but if you had multiple cars in your group, you would have the option to utilize both.
This place was very nice! He provided plenty of towels, linen, blankets, and cleaning supplies, and hygiene products. My mother really enjoyed the stay here
Great stay at a great place. Safe area with lots of access to public transportation. Would definitely stay again. Space also felt big and comfortable (:

Eugene was great to communicate with and made the whole stay easy. The Airbnb looked exactly like the photos, felt welcoming, and everything was very clean. The neighborhood also felt safe, with lots of people out walking, jogging, and running throughout the day. I was a little worried about parking beforehand, but it ended up being a complete non-issue.
One thing to note is that there’s a gym underneath the Airbnb. If you’re staying in the first bedroom, you’ll probably hear it more than the other rooms. It didn’t bother me much, and Eugene thoughtfully provided earplugs just in case.
The only real downside during my stay was that the people upstairs were pretty loud at times. That’s obviously not something Eugene can control, but it’s worth mentioning if you’re a light sleeper.
Loved being able to sit on the balcony in the mornings.
Overall, I had a really pleasant stay and would absolutely stay here again!!
Was a great place for us to spend the weekend in Chicago area!

The location of this Airbnb was so charming! It feels tucked back into a quiet neighborhood but bustling city life is just a few blocks away. We came for a concert at Wrigley field and the location was perfect for that!
We would definitely stay here again!

Great place and exactly as advertised, can walk to the lake shore, Andersonville shops / restaurants and never waited longer than 3 minutes for an Uber ride. Hosts were very responsive, slept great in the comfortable beds, and there wasn’t anything we needed the place didn’t have, highly recommend it and will be back.

Perfect place to stay in Chicago!! I used to live in the city and came back for a concert at Wrigley so wanted something walkable for our friends. This spot is 15 min from the field and walkable to soooo many great restaurants and bars. The apartment was clean, had AC in the rooms and was quiet on a beautiful street!! Vin was a fantastic host and very communicative!! Easy to get in and simple instructions to follow upon departure!! Would absolutely book this spot again! Thank you Vin!!

Milan was the absolute best host! The unit looked exactly like the photos and was actually even more spacious than expected. It was incredibly clean, and had all the new amenities and furniture.
Before check-in, Milan provided clear instructions along with a helpful video, making the arrival process completely seamless. He was also very responsive and communicative throughout our stay. The check-out process was incredibly seamless as well.
This was the perfect stay for a large group. There was a great ratio of bathrooms for everyone, which made getting ready so much easier. He also provided towels and even travel size personal toothbrushes and tooth paste for people to keep. I thought that was a thoughtful gesture.
I would absolutely recommend booking this unit, or any property Milan manages. We had a fantastic experience and look forward to booking with him again for future group trips!

Helen is absolutely the best hostess I’ve had the pleasure to meet. Her place felt like home! She greeted us with a big smile and I knew I would love it. Will be the only place I stay when I’m in Chicago!!

The place was nice for what I needed it for. Host was very responsive. The bathroom tub did have hair in it but the rest of the bathroom was clean. I did not know that the apartment was on the 4th floor with no elevator so it’s not handicap accessible. It is very noisy at night because of the train however I was provided with ear plugs. Good stay overall.

Great place with a fantastic skyline views. The home is nicely decorated, very clean, and full of lovely plants both inside and outside. I especially loved the outdoor spaces.  The instructions were clear and I didn’t need to contact the host for anything.  I’d stay here again!
The place was amazing, and the hosts were responsive. I take fault at this, but I should've paid more attention to the guest policy.

Mouna provides excellent instructions and guidance for check in/ departure which is extremely helpful because it’s a bit of an odd location. The unit itself is gorgeous and extremely well maintained but it is in a back building almost built like a shed on the rear of the building.
You need to find your way up a few floors of winding staircases in a rather dimly lit and kind of grungy (for lack of a better term) entry way. You will truly have no idea what to expect once you reach the door but be pleasantly surprised once you open it.
My chief complaint is not as much with Mouna but the Air BnB location sharing process. I booked this for my parents as it looked like it was on the border of Roscoe Village and Lakeview and thus walkable to Wrigley Field for the concert they were seeing.
It is was far west as Roscoe stretches which makes it extremely inconvenient for travel. It is more than a 20 minute walk to the closest train station which makes it very difficult for elderly guests.

Kohen's place was so clean and inviting. We were able to walk to local restraunts and a cute little coffee shop around the corner. Had everything we needed for our 2 night stay and the dedicated parking space was a huge plus. Also easy drive into downtown. Great 1st Chicago experience.
Great stay at Manny’s place.  Great location and great place.  Manny provided good communication during our stay.  I would stay again.
Very clean place and accurate to what was shown on the listing. Also about 15 minutes from O’hare which is really convenient for flights. The place also smelled really good upon check in.
Was spacious and layout was good for our group. Melvin was accommodating.

We had an excellent time. The neighborhood was quiet and very close to the Obama Center. It’s an ideal area if you have family on the Westside and the SouthSide. I’ve already told many family and friends. I’ll definitely stay again.

The place was super nice and close to downtown!  Extremely clean, well priced, and in walking distance from the gym, store, and a few restaurants. If I’m Chicago I’d definitely stay there again. Check-in was extremely easy, all in all, no bad things to say! Thanks for a great stay.
Perfect location and check-in was smooth. Very responsive with communicate

LOCATION! We were in town for a concert at Wrigley Field but also wanted to explore downtown and this was the perfect in between spot. 10-12 minute walk to the L. Lots of bus stops close by. The apartment was very clean. The living space (TV/Couch) is located in the basement alongside the second bed - keep that in mind.
Amazing little neighborhood. We had a blast!

Location? Incredible, with unbelievable in/out on-site parking. Space and furnishings? Exactly as shown, space felt even larger. Rooftop? Lake and cityscape views soothing and private. Communication? Responsive and timely. Recommend, stay again? Absolutely! But, for us,  not when Chicago has intense near-record heat.
Tiffany was amazing and our group really enjoyed ourselves. Thanks again
Peaceful location easy to find and plenty of space for my family. A++
Nice, conveniently located place. Would stay again.

Luckily, I didn't need to contact Ian because everything was exactly as expected. The only thing we didn't like was the cookware. The pots and pans are quite worn out, and dirty, the kitchen really needs a decent frying pan.

Needs better towels (were thin and small).
Temperature control an issue

What a lovely apartment just a block away from the L. The neighborhood is beautiful and walkable. The actual apartment was spotless and stocked well with anything that might be needed. As both the Host and previous reviews mention, it is right next to the tracks so it could be noisy for light sleepers but we slept right through it — felt like white noise! Again, super clean place in a great location with a wonderful host, absolutely would stay here again!

We felt the location was perfect for our itinerary. Close enough to wrigley field and close enough to midway airport. Area was quiet and private. We were able to attend a food festival and see the famous cloud gate. Close enough to big city activity without the big activity crowd and congestion. The place had everything we needed and we felt very comfortable here.

Our stay at the Walton Residence was amazing! The apartment was clean, had everything we needed, and was close to everything we were looking to be able to enjoy. We definitely have a go to spot for future visits in Chicago.

We had a fantastic stay! Everything looked brand new, spotless, and we really loved the thoughtful decor. We were all totally comfortable and had everything we needed.
We really loved the location which is directly across the street from Wrigley Field. We felt like we were in the heart of all the action, but had a quiet peaceful home base. The private two car garage was a huge bonus for us!
The host has created an amazing place to stay, and you can tell a lot of thought went into every detail. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great experience in Chicago.
Great area and place will definitely be staying again
Enjoyed our stay.
I stayed here to celebrate my birthday in Chicago. Yolanda was a wonderful host and was very responsive. The Airbnb was nice and clean just as pictured. 10/10

Extremely well-appointed and very spacious apartment in a well-located neighborhood with lots of bars, cafes and restaurants. The house was clean with great linens and lots of amenities.
Be mindful that parking in the neighborhood is quite difficult – restricted to two hours in most places, or permitted for residents only. We received a couple parking tickets despite our best efforts – do use Rob's $25/night parking option. We didn't and regretted it! The early checkout time (10am) is rather tough on Mondays, when all proximate parking is restricted due to 9am-2pm street cleaning.
There is no elevator, so luggage must be brought up a narrow staircase to the second floor – bake in time for this. A bit tough for mobility-impaired guests (we had one family member with a portable wheelchair).
If you note these things, the apartment itself is quite lovely.
Solid place to stay and good accommodations!

Booked this place for a long-ish weekend getaway, and it was perfect! Rida was a great, responsive host who was always ready to help! The apartment was great and spacious; it was also in a quiet neighborhood which was amazing :) Getting to places around the city was also very easy! I would highly recommend this unit to anyone thinking about traveling to Chicago!

We had a great stay at Alex’s place. The apartment is spotless, clutter-free, and very peaceful. Andersonville is an awesome neighborhood and we love being close to the beach. The free parking space and proximity to public transportation made getting around very easy. We would definitely stay here again!
Beautiful place, very comfortable! The location is perfect!
Prefect
This was such a great spot to stay in Wrigleyville! Super easy walk to Wrigley Field and tons of restaurants. Parking was also very convenient and safe in the garage. Would definitely stay again.

We were back in the city for a few concerts, and this was the ideal place to stay with kids! Close to a field to play,walkable for a family, and near friendly, delicious restaurants — plus a short walk to Wrigley Field. 10 out of 10, would stay here again!
Great place! Definitely recommend it!
My friend and I had a great stay. It was quiet and clean. There is only one bathroom, but we were able to share with other guests ok. Good area and super close to the blue line.

Gorgeous townhouse and great for a family vacation of 10 people and 3 dogs! Well-worth the price for a beautiful 4-floor home! The ground-level bedroom with en-suite, (just off the garage) was perfect for a guest with mobility challenges. Would definitely stay again!

This was our second stay at Patrick’s place. Very convenient location, near our daughter’s house, and very walkable to where we needed to go. Everything provided that we could possibly need! Patrick responded very quickly to questions and needs. We will return!
We enjoyed our stay here. Darsh was responsive to any questions we had. Place was clean and had everything we needed. Close to coffee shops and restaurants. I would stay here again.

We had a great stay at Kim’s apartment! The space was spotless, smelled amazing, and we felt very safe the entire time. The location was perfect with a Walgreens around the corner, cute bars across the street, a sushi spot open late, and so many food options all within walking distance. Communication was always quick and helpful. Parking was easy to find, reasonably priced, and free on Sundays, which was a huge plus. Our only small issue was that we wished the keys had been labeled since we struggled a little getting into the main entrance at first. Other than that, everything was wonderful, and we’re so happy Kim hosted us. We’d definitely stay here again!

6 Star Worthy!! Even better than the photos. Extremely cute, extremely comfortable. Record player and stocked mini fridge were amazing touches. Very nice, very updated. Clean. Cozy. Well-appointed kitchen. Nice bathroom. Lots of space. Beds were comfortable. Bathroom was nice. Had everything we needed and more. Plenty of towels, linens, cozy blankets. Felt very safe. Cute and a pretty peaceful neighborhood, lots of spots right nearby. We would *definitely* stay here again!
Very responsive since we had a couple of questions.  Place was clean and big enough for 3 adults.  We are all from Chicago so knew our way around and neighborhood seemed safe and pretty quiet.

Nice area surrounding the property felt comfortable waking around at night.  Very close to restaurant, bars and coffee shops.  Walkable or short Uber to Wriggly field events.  Anne was always available when we needed assistance

Loved our stay here and would definitely stay again in the future! Jay was very active on greeting us and checking in to make sure we were all set. There was a hand written thank you note and snacks on the counter when we walked in. Everything was extremely clean and nicely set up for us. This is a perfect set up for a family of 2-5 or two couples traveling together, etc. 10/10 would recommend!

This was a great place to stay, close to where I needed to be for the weekend and on a great quiet street. The apartment had everything we needed and was a comfortable place to stay! Check in was easy and the hosts are very communicative.

Susan was a very attentive person. I always responded very quickly. The house is wonderful, everything very clean and organized. We felt safe and very comfortable, there was plenty of space for my 18-month-old baby to feel at home. And I will definitely stay there again in the future. Thank you very much, Susan.

We were in Chicago for a concert at Wrigley and the Dugout could not have been more perfect! To leave the show and be “home” in less than 5 minutes was great. The neighborhood is lovely with a variety of restaurants and shopping within walking distance.
The Dugout has everything we needed including fantastic bedding and extra fans for a good night of sleep. It was a fantastic stay!

Very comfortable bed and cozy place. We were going to an event at the National Museum of Puerto Rican Art and Culture and it was a perfect location. It's next to Humboldt Park which is a nice place to walk. Jeremiah was responsive and caring. I would stay again!

We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago. Check-in was seamless with clear instructions provided in advance, and the luggage drop-off service before check-in and after check-out was incredibly helpful. The location is excellent, with bus stops and subway stations nearby, making it easy to get around the city using public transport. You can hear some traffic noise, but it didn't bother us at all and we slept very well every night. One thing to note is that the ensuite bathroom doesn't have a lock (the bedroom does), which wasn't an issue for us as a couple but may matter for friends travelling together. The air conditioning runs 24/7, which was great in summer, though we found the bathroom a little chilly. The shower also gets hot and we experienced difficulty adjusting the temperature back down. Overall, still a fantastic stay and we'd happily stay here again!
comfortable place great stay and great host

Such a great place to stay! Absolutely love the property. Really cool neighborhood that is super walkable with a ton of great places to eat. It’s near the L, so transportation around Chicago is simple. Perfect is a word that gets thrown around a lot, but it really is a perfect place to stay. And Dave was an excellent host. Highly recommended.
Everything exceeded expectations

I hope I get the chance to stay here again! Tim was a great host and this is the perfect spot. I used the train/buses my whole trip and this is the best location. Lots of little considerate touches like a coupon to a local coffee shop, games in the shared areas, water bottles in the fridge. I can’t say enough good things!

Great interior, but a terrible overall experience due to the building and neighbors.
The apartment itself is updated and very nice on the inside. However, the exterior environment was awful. There were multiple piles of large animal poop on the walkway into the building, and the private balcony was covered in inches of bird waste. To make matters worse, horrific noise from the adjoining neighbors partying kept me awake until 6:30 in the morning!
Things to know, you must climb 3 flights of metal stairs outside with no covering from weather to get into the apartment.
Beautiful inside, but the lack of sleep and unclean property exterior mean I would not stay here again.
excellent price but you will have to walk roughly 10 minutes to the nearest stop. 9/10 budget stay

Next day we didn’t have hot water on our first full day until late in the afternoon, along with the rest of the building. My husband just dealt with a cold shower & I just opted to not shower because we had too much going on to wait for it to get fixed/heat up again. Once fixed (but still not hot) I asked if there would be a credit/refund for the inconvenience and they literally JUST DIDN’T RESPOND. I shouldn’t have had to skip a shower and/or plan around the inconvenience. I would have respected them far more if they declined and gave a legit reason. But to just not answer is a joke.
The location couldn’t be beat, but checking in was confusing because there are two entirely separate gates with codes. Both addresses were on our reservation so we went to the wrong building in the beginning, Very prompt response from staff for this issue.
Awesome location / easy process. We loved Ben’s place and we definitely stay there again.
Outstanding location. Great space in the living area and dining area. Comfortably sat 9 at breakfast each morning. Bonus space with a fridge in the basement area was a nice addition.

We unfortunately experienced an HVAC failure during our stay. The building’s AC was out upon arrival, making the apartment quite hot - this was a July summer date. We purchased additional fans and an air mattress to make the stay manageable. Temporary window AC units were installed the next day, but they never fully cooled the apartment, and one bedroom remained without AC because the window couldn’t accommodate a unit.
One other note: the listing originally showed 6 beds, but the unit actually had 3 beds and a sleeper sofa, sleeping up to 6 guests. The hosts explained the discrepancy, but I think the listing should be updated for clarity.
Despite the issues, Jonathan, Matthew, and their team communicated well, worked quickly to improve the situation, reimbursed our out-of-pocket expenses, and provided partial refunds. While the stay wasn’t what we expected, I appreciate how professionally they handled a difficult situation.

The alcove entry was very comfortable and a nice place to enjoy the summer warmth.
And even though the space has a window unit AC, with the ceiling fans running the space stayed cool.
The beds and pillows were excellent, and I heard the same from my travel partner about her bedroom.
It was also an incredibly well stocked space. Every kitchen appliance possible was there, cleaning supplies, towels, TP, and anything else you might need was in abundance.
We ran into the neighbors upstairs and had a great chat while waiting on our food. They gave us a wonderful breakfast recommendation as well (Reno)!
I would totally utilize this space again on my next trip to Chicago. It was a clean, friendly place to be.
Thank you for allowing us the opportunity to stay!
The place was well-stocked and very spacious. Nice outdoor space. Owners were very accommodating!
Everything was perfect!
Great location and as described. Host was awesome.
Well-supplied kitchen with cleaning products available; comfortable beds; and well-designed living/dining space.  We’ll always be looking for this listing when we return to West Ridge!

My friends, husband, and I stayed at Otto’s place for the weekend. The home itself was very charming and the amenities were great - we had everything we needed! The abundant street parking and short walk to the train station were a big plus! Thank you for sharing your home with us!
Maureen’s spot was great for a few days in the city! Glad it was available. Grab it if it is!
Overall, great stay. Vin is an excellent communicator! Keys were a little difficult to sort out but once we figured it out, it was all good.
Quiet neighborhood with a short walk to the orange line. Hosts were very responsive and the house was exactly as advertised.
Great place for staying

This is one of the best Air B&B's our family has experienced. Michelle was incredibly communicative, the place was spotless, well-stocked, and the beds were so comfy!  The location is about a mile from Wrigley field - but an easy walk. Also, close to many restaurants and bars ... in each direction. Super close to the Irving Park Subway stop (Brown Line).  The off stree parking in the garage is an amazing amenity for a city air bnb.  We highly recommend and will definately stay again!
Wonderful stay and great neighborhood!

Rob’s place the perfect location for walking around the area and close to a lot of public transit to get around the city. Great bars and restaurants right downstairs, and the grocery store right across the street was very convenient. The apt has everything you could need and is perfect spot to rest after a hot and busy day (the bed was very comfy). Would highly recommend and would stay again.

I can't say enough about how much we loved our stay!  The place is pristine, in a wonderful location, and the hosts did a number of things to be welcoming, accommodating and helpful.  I can't wait to come back and stay in the same place again!

The accommodation was clean, in a quiet location that I really appreciated after a long day of exploring, and had everything I needed.
I do have some constructive feedback regarding the check-in process. The exact location of the lockbox wasn't entirely clear, and the lockbox itself was quite difficult to open once the code was entered. Additionally, I would suggest using a different color entry mat to help distinguish your door from the neighboring apartment.
Overall, the place and location were wonderful, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a low-key stay away from downtown.
Absolutely amazing visit ! Thank you for our stay !

We can't say enough about this fantastic home! The home was lovely, spacious, well-equipped, and absolutely spotless. We were in Chicago to celebrate my retirement and couldn't have picked a better home for our needs. We all had our own rooms and bathrooms. The house is so thoughtfully designed that we all had privacy, as well as great spaces for hanging out together. The parlor level is very open and has a wonderful kitchen, living area, and long dining table for gathering. The beds were and bedding were awesome. Being able to easily park for free directly across the street from the house was an unbelievable bonus. We never once hunted for a space.
Harry's directions were excellent. Through my own mistake, I somehow missed his notes for unlocking the gate. I called Harry, who answered immediately, even though he was out of the country. I felt awful bothering him, but he encouraged me to contact him whenever I had a question. So kind!
Everything was perfect!

We really enjoyed our stay. We had an event at the United center and it was a quick and easy walk over to the event.  The parking was super easy - I was worried about street parking but there was plenty free and easy.  Both times I moved the car I was able to park in a spot right in front of the apartment.  The place looked like the pictures. Any time I messaged Ariel our host (mostly about the ease of parking) he got back to me immediately.  Getting in and out of apartment was a breeze and I liked that the door locked automatically if you forget after you come in.  Everything seemed clean and efficient.   Will happily stay here again!
Lori's unit exceeded our expectations her space is uniquely decorated and clean. I would definitely rent again.

AC’s were in windows (living room & dining). Due to the heat from outside, they didn’t provide much cooling. There was zero air conditioning in bedroom.
The bathtub drained really slow our entire stay and didn’t drain any of our last day.
We were without power in the kitchen and living room from last Saturday night through Sunday evening. We lost our food that was in the fridge.
Because of the air and plumbing issues I don’t think this place is up to standard to rent out to anyone. Book at your own risk.
By far the worst air bnb experience I’ve had.
Location was great and the stay was nice and clean. Tons of parking space.

Excellent. Guys trip for the taste of Chicago was a success. Already planning to come back. Could become an annual trip. Very clean. Bluetooth speaker was on all weekend. Private, came with parking, and a comfortable outdoor space.

Me and my friend had a great time staying at Daniel’s Airbnb! We found it to look just like the listing and amenities were as described. The location is excellent and there is a ton of shopping and food nearby.
Permiegoti - normaliai. Nebuvo kavos puodelių, nebuvo taurių, vonios stiklai riebaluoti. Norėtųsi jaukesnio būsto. Patalynė švari. Niekas netriuksmavo.
The covers were dirty

My husband and I were visiting family in Chicago for three weeks and were extremely happy to be staying in such a comfortable, clean, and spacious home. Portage Park is a quiet, relaxing neighborhood that’s fun to explore. Local markets & restaurants had everything we needed for easy and delicious meals. We didn’t have a car and depended on the CTA system to get all around town. It’s a long commute to the Loop, but since we were mostly with family across the North Side, the location worked out well for us.
For a few days, an old college friend joined us. There was plenty of space for the three of us to hang out in comfort, as well as work remotely.
Veronica and Rigoberto were very responsive to all our questions, and they proved super helpful with a couple of problem-solving issues that popped up for us. They’re now among our favorite hosts for their friendliness and all their thoughtful touches. We’re definitely looking forward to staying there again on future visits.

The condo here is totally suitable! It is extremely well located and easy to park and access. The restaurant, Dawn, downstairs was also delicious and very convenient.
Unfortunately, the listing pictures seem to be slightly AI modified to give the impression that the unit is more modern and updated than it actually is.
No real issues with the place aside from floor staining, outdated/old bathroom accommodations and just general upkeep of the place.
I would certainly recommend staying here, especially for the location, but I cant give the unit 5 stars based on the mismatch with the marketing and the reality of the condos’ state.
Love the location and well worth the price!
