I rented a car and there is plenty of street parking, local shops, and a great breakfast spot near by Roux and Dawn.
We had a great time, it is only a block away from the train which was very convenient. Was as described and was quiet.

Clean, well organized flat with good security access. Place is downtown, we can do all on walk . Some noise because of the tube but mainly on daytime when we were out. So no harm,
I recommend this place if u love the city tourism !

We enjoyed a great long weekend. The house is located close to public transport and there are some great restaurants around the neighborhood. Both Lois and Eduardo were great hosts and easy to reach. Their house was everything we needed with comfortable beds in a quiet neighborhood. It’s a wonderful place to stay at.
Very kind host and a great place to lay your head down and rest after a long day :)

I loved staying here that I didn’t want to leave. The only thing that would prevent me from rebooking is the parking. Parking around the corner was very inconvenient especially when you’re leaving in and out.

Outstanding  AirBnb for large groups and has all the amenities.  Walkable to restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, local transportation and Wrigley Field.  Great for socializing  and also private with 2 floors.  Host was extremely responsive with all questions we had.  He even helped with locating my 90 year old mom's IPAD (left behind)!  Thank-you Brandon!!.  While a bit pricey for us, it was well worth it for location, size and responsive/helpful host.  Would definitely stay again!

Great location especially if attending anything at Wrigley Field. Easily walkable to many places. Great place to stay for a few days. I was there for an extended time and would have liked more of a kitchen but that’s really on me as I didn’t look at the pictures close enough. David and the property management company super easy to work with.

Christiana’s place was the perfect place for our stay. The hosts were helpful in finding local places and had plenty of suggestions. The room was comfortable and the entire place felt very cozy with houseplants throughout. The place was easy to navigate with public transportation and/or ride-shares, plus it’s only a short walk away from some great restaurants and local hang-outs. Christiane and Patrick were wonderful to have a conversation with, but were also happy to let you get along with your day. I look forward to booking with them again!

This unit is just okay, nothing special. The trip was a total a total of 4nights however, there was only one set of towels for each guest no extra towels provided. Was unable to use the microwave due to the door handle malfunction. The quality of the unit could be better and the photos should reflect what you are getting. However, the host was responsive and provided clear instructions on accessing the unit.

Very nice and secure facility with plenty of room to house guests . Views of the skyline is great. Food , bars and fun are within walking distance. Brett was great with communication throughout the entire trip .
Great place! Awesome location and clean!

Everything was great but the wifi did not work at all the whole time I was there, it maybe worked for 5-10 minutes at a time. I had to use my personal hotspot the whole time which was fine, but annoying. If you need to work or take work video calls here, I wouldn't recommend it. The only other issue I had was that the keys were very difficult to use for whatever reason. I had a really hard time unlocking all of the doors and I really am not stupid I promise haha. The key thing really wasn't a huge deal, just a minor inconvenience. Otherwise, everything was lovely! Especially because I booked so last minute! It was clean & as described and the location is really great. It was incredibly close to a lot of great shops & restaurants and getting downtown from there was super convenient and easy!

Excellent location. 10 minute walk to “The Point” and 5 min walk to the Metra & bustling 53rd. Right across the street from Harold Washington park.
Brad is an excellent host. Very responsive.
A couple of observations:
1. The key receptacle (that contains the key to the apartment and fob to the building ) is very difficult to open.
2. There was no cold water from the kitchen sink faucet.
3. The keypad to the apartment stopped working the day before we left. Fortunately, there’s a backup physical key for the deadbolt.
Other than that, our stay was excellent.
Amazing location.  Beautiful place! Amazing host!
Great location, very clean, close to everything. I would rent the place again!

Beautiful home. Just the place to go, home away from home. Rochelle was very professional and direct with any questions or concerns. Home clean and have the best mattresses. I would recommend to anyone thats traveling to Chicago. My siblings and I enjoyed.

we loved staying here! It always had available street parking. It was super easy to get checked in. Francisco was quick to reply when we had questions and made sure we were able to have a comfortable and easy stay. I would love to revisit this home.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour. L’appartement était vraiment très propre, spacieux et agréable. Nous avons également beaucoup apprécié la disponibilité et la gentillesse de notre hôte, qui a toujours été à l’écoute et prête à nous aider au besoin.
Le seul petit inconvénient concernait le stationnement, qui se faisait dans la rue. Avec les différentes restrictions selon les rues, il n’était pas toujours facile de trouver une place tout près de l’appartement. Cela rendait parfois les déplacements un peu moins pratiques, mais ce petit détail n’enlève rien au fait que notre séjour s’est très bien passé et que nous avons vraiment apprécié l’appartement.
This is a perfect little getaway in the north side of Chicago. The host is more than accommodating. Made the trip so much easier.

They are very clear about what the place exactly is. It has everything they advertise. Close enough to downtown (not walkable), and like a minute from the green line train station.
Hosts are very responsive, they answered my questions within an hour or two every time. Didn't need any help from them during the stay itself, so cannot comment on how good they are with helping out on that
Had a nice stay visiting family and going to concerts at United Center - which was walkable. Garage and washer/dryer were great amenities. Fairly quiet for the city.

Oh my gosh - this place was absolutely perfect for our Wrigley weekend! Practically in the shadow of the ballpark, the area is full of great restaurants, history and things to do.
The home was just as promised and more. The fridge full of complimentary drinks was thoughtful and much appreciated.
We were guests for 3 nights and there were concerts 2 of those nights - car sounds was noticeable those nights, but not an issue and settled down quickly.
Would not hesitate to stay there again.
Very clean and had everything I would have needed for the weekend. Location was right along bus routes and made it really easy to get anywhere I wanted to get. I couldn't complain even if I tried :)

Appartement sympa, tranquille et propre.
Les lits sont agréables, nous avons bien dormis. Très bien pour quelques jours.
David est un hôte très attentionné.
Merci à lui pour se séjour.

My husband and I stayed in this apartment for a long weekend and it was perfect. The apartment building opens into a shared courtyard that was clean, peaceful and secure. The location is very walkable with tons of restaurants and shops. The bed was very comfy and everything was as described. The host was very responsive to any questions we had. Would stay here again!
Perfect location, cozy, and had all the essentials!

Vince was very nice and responsive, the home was super clean, the house accommodated 11 people comfortably without us being on top of each other. I would definitely rent this house out again if visiting this area with a large group of people.

Beautiful stay my husband and I had such a lovely time! The pictures of the Airbnb honestly does not do the home justice! Ms. Latarsha airbnb is very spacious, homey and beautiful decorated beautiful home God bless

Pilsen is an incredibly vibrant community and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Denise & Nathan’s flat. The street is deceptively quiet and a haven of tranquility. The furnishings and amenities are perfectly suited for those who are actively seeking to sample the varied cuisine and culture that this great city has to offer. Blooming brilliant hosts.
Had a great stay with my family I will come back for a third time

This is one of the most impeccably decorated AirBnb's I have stayed at, and I have stayed at quite a few. Well done, Alfonso, really a beautiful place!
Alfonso was also WONDERFULLY communicative and helpful when I had trouble opening the back gate; it was user error in the end, not his fault . .. the track is to turn the knob ALLLLL the way to the left until you feel it click.
The back entrance is actually a kind of narrow set of fire escape type stairs; I actually recommend entering from the front if you have a large suitcase.

Beautiful studio in a great part of Chicago- lovely neighborhood with nice restaurants & bars & walkable to metro station.
I especially loved the attention to detail in the studio that helped make our stay more comfortable- small toiletries, an ironing board & iron, lamps throughout to manage light level. It was great.
Had a great stay at Sean’s place! Convenient location, walkable to Wrigley and many bars and restaurants. Sean was super communicative and helpful - would stay again!

Thomas fue siempre muy comunicativo y respondio a todos nuestros requerimientos y dudas.
Agradezco su colaboracion y asistencia.
El barrio es hermoso y el departamneto cumple con lo que se ve en las fotos.
Esperamos volver!
Thanks for a great stay at your place.  The location was great and your unit had everything I needed.
Great location. Safe location and also near Chinatown and easy drive to downtown Chicago.  Gorgeous kitchen. Would stay here again.

A lovely place to stay while visiting Chicago. Just a 15 minute Uber from the loop. The hosts were friendly and helpful and the apartment was clean and lovely. The back deck was a nice addition for morning coffee.

We loved staying here for our trip to Chicago! Big, clean, and comfortable space for large groups, with extremely convenient access to public transit (just a few blocks from the Pink Line). Very well air conditioned for a hot Chicago summer! The hosts were communicative and check in was easy. While it is right next to the train line, we weren't bothered by the sound of the train passing, and got used to it very quickly.
Place was great and as advertised

This house was even better than the pictures and information described. It was so light in the house from skylights. The private backyard was absolutely wonderful. We ate out there several times and enjoyed the outdoor sofa.
The projection TV was fun to use. We watched World Cup soccer and the Wimbledon finals on it. The house was immaculately clean. The bathrooms and kitchen were extremely well stocked with linens, cleaning supplies, cooking items, coffee and ice. GREAT house!!!
Great host, made us delicious Nigerian food

Our stay wasn’t horrible however the photos online definitely made the room look bigger as well as the space seeming nicer. Overall tho it wasn’t bad you get what you pay for honestly, I will say the hosts were very nice and responsive.

Great place with lots of beds and space. The family room is comfortable and the place is very quiet considering how much is going on around Wrigley. Right on the train, but didn't both us. Great location if you are looking for a fun and very Chicago experience. The host was very responsive to anything we needed.

The place was nice.  A very small place. Small bed. The side of town seemed a little dangerous right across the street from the project houses. Lots of road work noise as well. It was a good stay and was overall comfortable.
Great location but this wasn't advertised as a students accommodation being let out as a flat. The lobby was full of 18-21 year old university kids checking in.

Great stay overall and I’d stay here again. The location is excellent with CTA bus stops on the corner, a beautiful park across the street, and about a 15-minute walk to 57th Street Beach. There are also convenient shops downstairs, including a great coffee shop. The host communicated well and answered my questions before arrival. The unit had the essentials, including towels, dishes, and cookware, but if you use a lot of towels, you may want to bring extras, especially washcloths. The building has key fob access for both the entrance and elevators. The unit was tidy, though not spotless, with some normal wear that isn’t fully reflected in the listing photos. The only drawback was the A/C. There are window units in the living room and smaller bedroom, but not in the larger bedroom (there is a tower fan). Thankfully, three days of our stay were mild; had it been hotter, sleeping would have been difficult. The building was quiet, and downtown was only about a 15–20 minute drive away.

Very accommodating and responsive host. We arrived before check in but were able to drop off bags and come back when the space was ready.
The description of the house was accurate and very spacious for our big group of 11! I will definitely stay again. Convenient location from downtown as well, no issues with calling Ubers/lyft.
10/10 recommend

Staying with Steven feels like stepping in a time capsule that spits you out sometime in the 1970s.
There is a pool table if you can play & the backyard is really the best part.
The host also helped me out with some things & overall was just super chill.
Loved staying here.

Although we had a pleasant stay in Chicago and appreciated the kindness and hospitality of the host, I cannot say we were thoroughly comfortable. The host was nice and encouraged that we make ourselves at home. However, it was not disclosed that we’d be sharing a space WITH THE HOST (only disclosed sharing with other travelers). We felt uncomfortable and felt like what I can only describe as being watched to perform a job duty under your boss’s surveillance. The shared spaces themselves were not very clean as the host claimed, though I understand that the upkeep may be hard with several guests staying at once. I just do not think one should claim a deep clean took place when all that was done was a wipe down and disinfection. The air vents and AC vents/units were not clean and constantly blew dust and dripped water… further making the difference in air quality between outside and inside the place more noticeable. I’m sure he’s a nice person though.
Great place to stay, the locations is great everything is walkable.

I am so glad I chose this home to celebrate my birthday with friends! It was easy to get to different restaurants, bars, & coffee shops. The light rail is so close as well that commuting to downtown was a piece of cake! I was greeted with birthday wishes and truly enjoyed my stay. Hope to visit Chicago soon and stay here again!
We had a fantastic long weekend here. Perfect location to explore all of Chicago. We would recommend Kelsey’s place to anyone!

An ideal place to stay when visiting Chicago. Right outside the downtown area and much to do nearby. Would definitely recommend booking this listing from Rida, she’s friendly and responds in a timely manner.

I loved the stay! Just what was needed for a weekend. But the bed was super hard! No issues with parking. the code pad is upside down...not bad just hard to read. Only windows air. That did keep the place cool. Thanks so much for letting us stay!

As a native of Chicago and the area this gem is located in I grew up just a few blocks away. If you are looking for convenience and want to be close enough public transportation, walking distance from Washington Park, Dusable Museum, not far from the New Obama center then Brian’s place is for you. I can’t wait to book again on my next trip, my friends were so happy I was close to them this time around. One thing I want to highlight about Brian’s place is that he accommodated the place for every need!!!!! Thank you again Brian.
Really nice spot near great places on Clark. I appreciated all the extra things this place had, like tape and an avocado holder! A really nice space
This was a wonderful place to stay for me and my kid. Near public transit, walkable to great restaurants and coffee shops and playgrounds, in a pretty and peaceful neighborhood.
Great place in a fantastic location. Enjoyed the restaurants and parks in the neighborhood. Easy access to the blue line.

My friends and I come up to Chicago every summer to reconnect. This is our third Airbnb and of them it has been our favorite place we’ve stayed. Internal A/C, privacy window treatments, TWO full bathrooms, and comfortable furnishings secured the bag for us with this place. The charm of the older building sold the fantasy we love to play out as well, the floors were a little creaky, and the second floor walk up was charming. I should also mention the convenient proximity to the Granville station and the bus lines (36, 151, 156) made it very convenient to get around without a car, of which there is a dedicated parking space for.
Last thing I mention was how friendly our hosts were, they created a lovely well stocked apartment for our stay.
This is the 2nd time we have stayed here. The host was just as great as the first time. The place was very clean and had all that we needed. Will stay there again for sure!

We had a fantastic stay! Everything just as described and pictured, and very comfortable. We appreciated so many thoughtful touches that made us feel right at home! Proximity to the brown line and bus stops made it very easy for us to get around during our stay.

Maria and Tina were wonderful hosts! They were extremely communicative and helpful. Check-in and check-out were super easy. If you’re lucky you might get a surprise visit from their cat (say hi to him again for us please!). Will definitely be staying here again if I’m in Chicago.

We travel to Chicago often and always try to stay in Logan Square! It’s a beautiful neighborhood with all the best restaurants. The L is easy to access to get around too. Mark’s place was perfectly located a short 10 min from the metro which we rode in from the airport. The basement unit apartment is exactly as pictured - very functional and a perfect spot for us to come back to after exploring the city each day.
In good location and worth the money

Pros:
I loved the location. Starbucks was within walking distance. And dollar tree as well. Place was clean. And private.
Cons:
Hassle having to unlock gate. To get to unit, then unlock door, then walk up stairs.
No clear instructions on how to get hot water to work in shower. Took a cold shower the first night because was not informed that if you turned shower nozzle fully. Hot water would not work. This is something that should be disclosed ahead for guest can know how to operate to shower.
Other than that. I loved the home.
Great location and host!
We had such great stay! Location in Wrigleyville was absolute perfection. Unit was fantastic. Hosts were responsive and friendly. We will definitely stay here again!

Very cute studio!! As noted, night life noise was definitely experienced but didn’t worsen our stay. Big windows, stunning natural light, clean spaces.. great place! And the breakfast spot right across the street is phenomenal!!
We loved our stay! Lots to so in the area and easy to get around the city. This place had lots of charm and Sharon was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!
Noe’s place was quiet, peaceful, clean and easy to access. The best part was their very sweet, quiet, loving husky greeter. ❤️
I enjoyed my stay with Ewa! Very cleanly and a very peaceful stay at night after my busy days out and about! Would recommend staying here!
Has all the amenities you need and at a good price. Owner is super helpful and responsive
Very easy to work with and the spot was as described.
Loved our stay in this historic neighborhood. The house has plenty of room for groups, lots of natural light, and very close to anything you might need. Easy walk to the redline and the beach.

This place was perfect for 2 couples enjoying a long weekend in Chicago. Laura gave very clear instructions for getting in, she was very responsive and even checked in throughout our stay. There was free parking on the street which was a big plus and many great places within walking distance. We were very happy with our stay at this unit.

This was the perfect location for spending time in the Andersonville neighborhood which including unique shopping and restaurants. It was only a 15 minute walk into town.  If taking the redline into the city, it was about a 30 minute walk to the redline, but we chose to drive in which was pretty easy, and the city parking was reasonable at $15-$30. The apartment itself was easy to access, clean, and comfortable.  We easily found free street parking right by the apartment.  It’s worth checking out First Slice on West Balmoral which sells pie by the slice, coffee, and other food items at a reasonable cost.  Overall it was a great Chicago getaway!
Very place to stay.

The place was exactly as advertised. Freddy was fairly quick to respond to any questions and was very helpful in responses. If I to list one negative, the street the house is on requires a permit to park (of which Freddy does provide some) and that parking in general on the street of the property and the surrounding area is difficult but that's hardly Freddy's fault.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The location was excellent—convenient while still being in a quiet, peaceful neighborhood, which made it easy to relax. The host was friendly, responsive, and quick to answer any questions we had. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
Joe Moore

We stayed in Russell’s rental for a long weekend while visiting family in the city. The rental was as described and easy to locate/check in. However, please be aware that this is a very noisy street; there was loud music and vehicles racing up and down the street at all hours of the night. This was a big disturbance to our toddler while trying to sleep. If adults only are staying, this may not be a bother. Additionally, we felt the bedrooms in the rental stayed very hot. The thermostat was not adjustable, which seems extreme given it is July. Overall things were clean, spacious, and nicely decorated. The proximity to the grocery next door was unbeatable. Thanks for hosting us.

The kids absolutely loved the place soon as we walked in the door. Very spacious for 3 teens to chill and also be the kids they still are. The sky lights were beautiful even though they woke us up early lol but it gave us time to use each day to our advantage! The pool table, chessboard, card games all nice touches to an already beautiful home that gave it that home feeling. Being able to bring my little fur baby with me was also amazing! Would definitely recommend for families with children !!

This was probably the most beautiful Airbnb we have ever stayed at! Designed beautifully and very historic! Gorgeous!! Easy walk to the beach on Lake Michigan and also an easy walk to Wrigley Field! We were in town for a Tyler Childers’s concert at Wrigley Field. We had such a great time and it was the perfect place to stay to catch up with family and friends before and after the concert! We will be back to see the Chicago Cubs! Thank you! Ten out of five stars for sure! ⭐️

This Airbnb was very homey, cozy, and relaxing. We were aware of the low ceilings before booking, so it wasn’t an issue for us. I would say that if you’re much taller than 5’5”, the space may not be the most comfortable due to the ceiling height.
The host was very responsive and quick to help with any questions or concerns we had, and the check-in process was smooth and easy. Most of the attractions we visited were about 25 minutes away, but we traveled during a busy weekend, so I’d imagine the drive is even shorter during normal traffic.
Overall, we had a great stay and really enjoyed the area. I would definitely book here again and recommend it to others who are looking for a comfortable, relaxing place to stay.
Great place to stay. It was perfect for our group of 8. Close enough to downtown to get there quickly, but far away enough to have privacy and not be worried about city traffic or noise.
Great location , clean and beautiful place
Perfect quiet place. Highly recommended

The photos deserve five stars. Unfortunately, we stayed in the actual property.
Online, this place looks polished and inviting. In person, it felt like a tired rental dressed up by a very talented photographer. The aesthetic was pure “landlord special”: layers of paint slathered over hinges, trim, and baseboards, a bathtub that appeared untouched since the 1990s, and window A/C units running in three rooms.
We booked for a family of five and were given four hand towels to bathe with—no bath towels and no extras in the unit period.
The place was technically clean, but dingy, worn, unloved, and equipped with the absolute bare minimum. Nothing felt thoughtful, comfortable, or remotely luxurious. It felt less like hospitality and more like a businessman maximizing profit per square foot.
With all the being said, Vin was very prompt and responsive to our questions and requests. We just didn’t feel the love.
Amazing hosts and very clean and safe home!
This house was great for my friendcation. A private room for everyone, great kitchen and amenities. Would like to come back!

This property was great! Clean and well stocked. The host were polite and responsive. The home is conveniently located near the train and the highway. Quiet and safe neighborhood. I would stay again and recommend to others.

Algenoy’s place truly felt like home.  He’s a great host and was so warm and welcoming.  The place is perfectly located and very spacious.  He has everything needed for a quiet and comfortable stay.  I would definitely stay there again.

This garden level apartment was in a great part of Old Town. We could walk to everything, including restaurants and Lincoln Park Zoo and Lake Michigan.  Parking was definitely a challenge and should be considered when booking.
Appartement assez vaste.

This sweet garden unit was bright and modern. It’s a great space if you are a traveling professional or student. The shower is absolutely spa-like. It’s huge with plenty of clean fluffy towels. The beds offer wonderful comfort with sumptuous bedding and pillows. I would rate them a full five stars except, during the summer months, in Chicago can be very humid.  If your hair is likely to grow and frizz up, you’ll need a dehumidifier or good products to comeback that. The kitchen could use an island or some kind of table for eating and prepping. I wasn’t there to cook. But needed more space to pack up for a festival. There is decent parking even for  a real city neighborhood. Lanre, Rilwan and son are lovely owners. They gave me a cake for birthday. They were very accommodating with all asks. I visit my hometown quite a bit and hate to impose on family. So their space was a nice retreat. Highly recommend them!

Corinne was an exceptional host. She was responsive, welcoming, and provided clear, easy-to-follow directions for getting to the house from the airport. Check-in was seamless, and the home was exactly as pictured, clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The neighborhood was quiet, peaceful, and felt very safe throughout my stay. I would absolutely stay here again the next time I visit Chicago.

The condo was perfect.  There were 6 of us and it had more than enough room.  It was in a quiet area with the Green Line very close.  We used CTA often throughout our stay.  Joseph was very responsive with all questions.  We will definitely stay again.
The space isn’t fancy, but it met our needs. Thanks for having us :)

This airbnb is amazing. The decor has a cool speakeasy moody vibe. The details of this place from the lights to the furniture ,the retro fridge thats stocked with local beer and sparkling water , to the candy machine ...the attention to details the host took is evident. The bathroom was amazing the shower was hot and luxurious. We will definitely  be booking the next time we are in Chicago.
Great place to stay within walking distance to lots of places and/or bus and train stops!
Fantastic place to stay and great host!
Clean home, awesome deck, and quiet area. Def would stay again!

Stay was nice, relatively small place but that was expected based on the photos and description of it, as it is not a full house. Limited toilet essentials (only found 1 roll of toilet paper stocked, nothing in cabinets, closets, or under bathroom sink) and not much in the way of seating for use at dinner table. Only 1 leather chair and an office style chair in the living room. Found leftover(?) food (eggs and lunch meat) in the fridge after checking in. Checkout instructions did not specify what to do with the bedsheets and pillow sheets. Also not much elaboration on where to take full trash bag. Asked for elaboration night before checkout but didn't receive anything in response. Bathroom as a whole was nice, shower with different faucet options and a bidet were great.
Had a wonderful time staying, place was beautiful!

Charming neighborhood, great restaurants, lovely place to stay for our Chicago adventures. The host was responsive and helpful, we loved their local recommendations. The place was comfortable and nicely stocked with things to make our stay more comfortable. The space was perfect for our group, it was nice that each bedroom has their own bathroom to use. Would definitely consider staying here again.

Isabel’s unit was perfect for our Chicago getaway! The apartment was spotless and very comfortable. Had opportunity to meet Isabel upon check-in and she was so welcoming and friendly. Location is perfect on a quiet street but 2 mins away from public transportation. You cannot go wrong if you stay at Isabel’s unit.
It was 10/10
Unit was clean,peaceful and private. I highly recommend it.

Ideal location for exploring Chicago - easy options to get around… walk, ride a city bike or transit anywhere in the city! If you’re sound sensitive - it does sit above the L train - so it’s an urban experience! We loved it! Simple and awesome food and/or shopping options right out the door!

Gorgeous Chicago home with a private room and bathroom (in basement - lots of privacy). The home is fabulous, clean, and welcoming. Karyn and Asif are kind and helpful. Coffee and tea were wonderful. Walking distance to ALL Logan square activities (including blue line). Will stay again!
Good

Great location. Walkable to subway. Place was welcoming, clean, and safe. I stayed with my daughters and nieces. They all loved how much we did in Chicago. Thank you for everything! Also sent recommendations of things to do in Chicago!
Gabriel was a great host. The apartment felt like home away from home. The neighborhood is safe and vibrant. I would definitely stay here again when I revisit.
We had a great stay at Dorian’s place.

Anybody that’s saying anything negative about this space ignore it, because they have woken up on the wrong side of the bed or the type that’s never satisfied! Lol this was one of the best Airbnb experience I have endured! Elizabeth was very accommodating to my needs and very responsive with clear instructions, her place was very cute, nice huge bed so if you are a wild sleeper this will be your playground! No complaints on the temperature because I love the very cool setting so I can wrap myself under the covers like a burrito at night 🤣 Quiet and peaceful area, neighbors are extremely nice, one beautiful neighbor prayed over me while I was strolling down the block. Elizabeth has refreshments, sleep masks, slippers, mostly everything to create a cozy stay for you. I’ll most definitely book again! 🥰
The apartment is well equipped and Joanna's instructions were excellent. Very smooth trip.
Good location and Paula was extremely helpful.

This was a great place to stay. It’s spacious, right by the L, and easy to find. A few things to note, the L runs every few minutes. If you are a light sleeper, bring a sound machine. We were not bothered and found the location very convenient. Overall, we were pleased and would stay here again. Checking in was easy and there weren’t an overwhelming amount of tasks for check out. We appreciate the hosts being responsive and providing a clean, safe place for us to stay. I highly recommend this property.
We had a great time. The Air BnB was spacious and very clean. It was in a very walkable area and close to restaurants.
We enjoyed our stay very much. The home was clean and very fun. The location was great, walkable to Wrigley Field and great restaurants. We would highly recommend this home.
Felt right at home!! Every morning the place smelled so good and clean. They keep it in tip top shape! Plus the Red Line was sooo close for walking. I really felt right at home! Would stay again :)
Very nice, convenient place, loved our stay.
Perfect place to stay for a concert at Wrigley Field.

Kristin was such a lovely host! The unit was not only spotlessly clean but there was so much attention to detail (the filtered water, actual/ real toilet paper that is not thin sandpaper). The bed was comfortable and the spa shower was just incredible.
Location is amazing - great restaurants, walkable but also easy access to the L, quiet neighborhood.
We’ll definitely be staying here again on our next trip to Chicago.
Host was responsible and helpful. Very quaint and peaceful neighborhood with easy access to several areas of the city
Our host was very responsive and quick to resolve any questions or issues we had.
Totally amazing! Thank you for everything!
Wonderful space, great location, and terrific host!  We are looking forward to our next stay with Iris!!

We had an amazing stay and would definitely come back! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well stocked with everything we needed. It was the perfect spot to relax after a day of exploring. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the whole process easy. We really enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great stay!

Elizabeth’s place was a treat to stay at, especially when it’s only a few blocks away from the best bakery I’ve ever gone to (Sugar Moon Bakery). She was also very responsive, flexible, and made sure we had everything we needed.
My only small nit picky issue would be to clean the bathroom fan vent, it was gnarly…
Everything else was great!!

Ari’s space was great and we liked staying there! Seemed like a safe neighborhood. The electronic lock to the door was on the fritz, so several times we had trouble getting into the apartment, but Ari was very communicative and worked with us to get in.
great communication and the place is so peaceful highly recommended..
Enjoyed our stay
Perfect place for our weekend get away. Everything was as described.
Great stay!

This was my first time staying in an AirBnb room instead of an entire place, and it was a great experience. Tammy and Scott are excellent hosts who make you feel right at home, but also give you as much space as you need. They have a lovely, comfortable home, including a relaxing living room/dining room/kitchen for guest use, a front yard, and two cute dogs. Definitely not a hostel or rooming house vibe, you really feel like you are a guest in a nice home. Located in tranquil Rogers Park, half a block from the beach and about a 5 minute walk to the Red Line, easy train ride to Wrigley, River North, and the Loop. Thank you Tammy and Scott for a great stay!
Enjoyed my stay. Would book again for the family. Clean apartment, well stocked. Host responded quickly. Busy street so some noise at night. Great outside sitting area.
Very nice place to accommodate my large group.
Beautiful place! spacious open floor and very accommodating. Thank you for adding to a great stay. I am satisfied and them some.
It was great. We’ll definitely stay there again. Just need more towels to stay more than a couple days. 😊

I loved the place it was perfect for what I needed, super spacious and in a great location. I had an unlimited CTA pass so was able to take buses and trains the whole time and they were all walking distance. The washer and dryer was nice, I didn't think I would use it, but wound up being helpful so that was a big bonus. I liked the option of the patio, but didn't realize how public it was with people right next door and below. Luckily the neighbors were friendly so it wasn't a problem .

My family and I really enjoyed our stay. The place was nice clean just a beautiful home all together. We were visiting Chicago to bring in my daughter’s Sweet 16 and allowed her to choose our place to stay. She fell in love with the layout and decor. Most of all she enjoyed what we called the pink room. Our host was amazing in providing all the information we needed to enjoy our stay. Thank you so much and I highly recommend!!!

Super cute place and very nice neighborhood. Didn’t need to bother the hosts much but if we did send a message they responded right away!
Would definitely stay there again.

I have been booking with AirBNB for a decade now and I think this was one of the most thoughtfully put together places I've ever been in. Kitchen was well appointed, the furniture curated (and beautiful). The hosts were great and the location was perfect - short walk to the train and short walk to restaurants and coffee. Will definitely be trying to get back here!
Jason was such a friendly and great host. He communicated extremely well with me, and the space was absolutely gorgeous upon arrival. 10/10 from me

Very clean and comfortable, nice quiet neighborhood.  Beds were so comfortable, I love the push button shower system!  Kash was quick to respond, easy check in and check out. I felt safe.  I will definitely look for Kash’s place next time I visit.

Overall great stay for a couple nights, bedroom was super clean and comfortable, as was the bathroom. The neighborhood felt safe and was quiet. I appreciated the a/c unit’s ability to get extremely cold, it was great coming back in from the heat to a cool room.
The place was great. Clean, cozy, and a great find. Fernando was amazing, and so responsive to any messages we sent. Definitely will think of booking here again if we are coming back to Chicago.
Can’t wait to stay here again!

This place was gorgeous and spacious long hallway with a beautiful pictures on the wall. I would definitely book again. It took me less than five minutes to catch a bus to the city! Lots of restaurants and bars surrounding the area even had restaurants that were open 24 seven right around the corner

Villa D’ Citta is a beautiful building that is very welcoming and impeccably clean! The kitchen and shared areas are great. The bedroom, and bed, are very comfortable. The location is fantastic! Easy access to transportation and very walkable to a myriad of activities. The hosts have created an enjoyable experience for guests! It’s nice to share the breakfast table and visit with other guests. I would absolutely recommend a stay at Villa D’ Citta!
We really enjoyed our stay! Great location and the home was as described. Definitely recommend!!

My group had a wonderful stay at Jason's! The apartment was exactly as described. We particularly enjoyed all of the local Chicago touches -- the locally made coffee mugs, records from Chicago-based musicians, etc.. The apartment was clean and the kitchen had everything we needed to cook dinners at the Airbnb. It was nice being right above his restaurant (The Long Room) for coffee, yummy cocktails, and a quick meal. There are plenty of other bars/ restaurants within a 15 minute walk. We spent most of our weekend at the beach or downtown so we took an Uber most places, but if you were staying near Wrigley field it was very walkable. I'd highly recommend, and my group would stay again!

I had a great stay at Annika's place and would definitely stay again if she'd have me! The location was easy to reach from O'Hare using public transit, and Uber rides into downtown Chicago were affordable and convenient. The neighborhood is quiet, residential, and felt very safe.
Annika added some thoughtful personal touches, including a welcome sign with my name and snacks, which made me feel right at home. The space was clean and had more than enough room for a solo traveler.
Annika was very responsive throughout my stay. She mentioned that sound carries between the basement unit and the main house, and I underestimated that by playing music past quiet hours. I apologized, and I appreciated the heads-up and her understanding.
If I had any suggestions, they would be to provide an iron or steamer, a can opener, and slightly stronger shower water pressure. None of these were dealbreakers, and they didn't take away from an otherwise excellent stay.
Overall, I highly recommend.
We gave a good time everything is good here

Our family really enjoyed our stay! The unit is located close to the Red Line which made it incredibly easy to get around the city. The unit is near several train lines, which was a dream come true for our train-loving kiddo! The train noise was easily ignored at night with our sound machines. The neighborhood felt safe and welcoming for our visit. We would definitely stay again when we visit Chicago!

Had a great stay. The level of  commuication and helpful instruction was outstanding! Abby was very accessible and responded quickly to any questions, and provided everything I needed to help with my stay. Would stay with her again
Good place, excellent location, clean, and overall comfortable for our group.

Great location minutes from train and walkable to restaurants and shops in Andersonville. Very comfortable bed, ample space. Highly responsive hosts! A couple things to note are the very loud (but effective) A/C in the main room, and squeaky floors (only a concern if getting up in the middle of the night as they are quite noisy). Overall, a great space for our weekend in North Chicago.
Great location, very comfortable, a perfect place to stay!
Ryan was super helpful, responsive and friendly. I would definitely recommend staying here.
Wonderful stay. Parking is an issue — however there is a parking garage 1 block from the house where paid parking is available.s

Our group of 5 women really enjoyed our stay. The house was beautiful and more than enough room for us (we didn’t stay in the basement/lower level). The hosts were very responsive; we had questions the week prior and day of, and we received clear responses within the hour. We stayed in the middle of July, and the upstairs bedrooms were really warm at night, so we brought down the temps the following nights and closed the vent in the main floor bedroom to help (it worked). The neighborhood is also pretty quiet, which was nice. Overall, a wonderful stay

We had a great stay at this house.   We went to a concert at Wrigley so turned the weekend into a short vacation with the family.  The house had all we need for 3 adults sand 2 teens.   Parking was close by and easily walkable to lots of stores and food options.     I’ve stayed in Chicago over 20 times but this is my first stay in this neighborhood and we loved it.   The house was simple in its appointments but cozy and comfortable at the same time.    Hosts were responsive and made us feel welcome!  Would stay here again!

This is a great location right across from the museum. Check-in was easy and there’s a 24 hour front desk if you need to leave the key with them while you go out on the city.  I was always able to find on street parking within a block. The apartment was clean well stocked and had an old-school charm.  Host was super responsive. Definitely will stay again next time I am in Chicago. Thanks!!

What can you say about this place. It’s a little vignette of Chicago history. Roxana and her family are true stewards of the city. One thing I can guarantee: this place will be unlike any other Airbnb you’ve visited. It’s like a prop from a Wes Anderson movie.
10/10
It was perfect for our trip to Wrigley Field. Plenty of restaurants to choose from and only a mile and a half walk to the field.
Michael was very responsive.  The place was very clean.
Our stay in Daniel’s home was great. Super communicative and responsive. Calm area and a great amount of space for my group. Would book again!

This was our second time in Chicago and this time we decided to stay in/around Hyde Park area. We were not disappointed at all! From arrival to departure everything was just as described; easy entrance/access, cozy space and comfortable beds, educational / cultural decor that added a special touch. Prompt responses and kindness were what these two are great at for sure, amazing hosts indeed!
Thank you for your hospitality and we
Wish you the best for you and your future guests ! If ever in Chicago again, we will most certainly look you all up to see if available again first!

My 2 siblings and I spent 4 nights at Charley’s place. It was perfect for us. The location was close to other relatives as well as for the venue for an extended family gathering. We had the whole floor to ourselves with bath and toilet and the neighbourhood was pleasant. In all, it was a very pleasant stay. Many thanks for the warm welcome and hospitality.

We stayed 2 nights at this location north of Chicago — convenient, with an easy 5-minute walk to the Brown Line.
Communication with the host was prompt and polite, which I appreciated. Unfortunately, the unit's condition fell short. On arrival, the hot water and shower were barely functional in both bathrooms — almost no pressure, and the shower only ran if you physically held the tap, making it hard for our family to shower. A curtain rod in the master bedroom fell on me twice, once narrowly missing my daughter — a real safety concern. The front door deadbolt didn't lock reliably either. Also worth noting: the unit is on the 3rd floor with no elevator, which wasn't communicated up front.
We reported everything right away with photos and video, and to the host's credit they acknowledged the issues and sent maintenance on the second day. I'd encourage the host to inspect the unit more thoroughly between guests so these issues — especially the safety ones — are caught before check-in.

The only thing great about this bnb is the location. I would have booked someone else but couldn’t find accommodations for 8 with short notice.
When arriving the back door was open as if it had been tampered with. We also saw ants and crumbs on the floor. There were several vents either hanging or missing. There were stains on the carpet and the shower curtain. Two of the chairs at the table were faulty. Someone sat in one of chairs and nearly fell. We did not feel comfortable sitting on the couch. The pictures did not match the listing. It stunk in the hallway. The water did not get hot and had a low pressure The dishes were filthy there was no paper towel or wash cloths. We also found a roach in the refrigerator. I attempted to reach out to the host and they were unresponsive. After all of the issues I found it was hard to believe they had such a high rating. Looking over the reviews I found some with similar experiences.
Nice place. Quiet neighborhood. Easy to get to. Will stay here again!
Great place to stay for the weekend! Quite peaceful town. Good restaurants near by and walking distance to the bus and grocery store. Would stay again!
Awesome location, close to L station, restaurants, bars, grocery and walkable to Lake Michigan! Place was exactly as described and pictured! Perfect for our stay.
Odi was very responsive and accommodating during our stay. The place was clean and matched the pictures.

To say that the view was incredible is an understatement and walking out on the patio every morning and night was inspiring. It isn't often you can find a rental with that view. The location as well was perfect with a grocery store in the same block and lots of restaurants, shopping and activities nearby. The people at the front desk were cordial and helpful.
The pier was about a mile away and we walked there twice (straight down grand) which was convenient. I highly reccomend.
Great Stay!! Perfect for someone like me who had to travel to multiple cities in Illinois a day during her trip!!
Great place to stay !
We had another great stay at Lida's place. We hospitable hosts, they make sure you have everything you need and the house is super clean and comfortable.
Great location, host was communicative and friendly.

Loved our stay here! Everything was clean and as described/pictured. Amelia was super helpful and responded quickly when we needed help with the parking situation. We arrived on a busy Friday afternoon, so available parking near the Airbnb was slim. Be prepared to drive around and look for a spot for a bit. Otherwise, location was amazing for Ubers on the cheap side, and it felt very safe and quiet.
Such a great location, I really appreciated the local recommendations.

We were in Chicago for our daughter's 21st Birthday. She picked this listing based on the location and also the rooftop bar area which unfortunately we didn't see it was currently being renovated. Regardless of that, the stay was amazing! We were in walking distance of so many of the sites she wanted to visit and the rest we Uber' d to. It was nice to have someone greeting us at the entrance to the building no matter what time it was. The residents we visited with in the elevator multiple time each day were helpful with recommendations of activities.
The apartment itself had amazing views of the city, and the two bedroom and baths was so convenient.
I also had questions prior to and during the stay and the response was immediate each time!
We would highly recommend this venue for anyone wanting to visit Chicago!

Unfortunately this place fell pretty short. I know the area so I knew it was a bjt of a walk to the L- it’s about 10-15 minute walk to the Jefferson Park blue line stop. The place itself wasn’t cleaned very well or maintained in general. The toilet paper holder, and the hand towel holder in the basement bathroom were broken and on the floor when we arrived. There were lots of bugs (both alive and dead) in the basement bedroom and there were shoe prints and squashed bugs smeared across the walls and ceilings. Every glass and utensil we tried to use in the kitchen was disgusting and dirty and the surfaces in the kitchen were all greasy. There was a constant buzzing sound coming from one of the closets that made it difficult to fall asleep. In general the place is pretty shabby- scuffed walls, broken window shades, missing baseboards, and dusty and grimy.  It wasn’t worth the price, and we won’t be booking this place again.

We had a great stay here. It was a great location, with lots to walk to. The space was clean and had everything we needed. It was pretty hot the weekend we stayed and the window AC units kept the place very cool. We would definitely stay again when we are back in Chicago.
We loved our stay at Florin’s place. It was exactly as described, clean, and cozy. Perfect for a family or groups, I highly recommend this house for your Chicago stay.

Our stay at the Chicago mansion was amazing. The family was in town for a wedding and we needed a home for 8 people for a week in July. We comfortably had 10 people for a couple days. The house is great and is set up with an awesome kitchen with dishes etc for us all to sit together at a big dining room table. We cooked a couple of great dinners. The neighborhood was great with everything we needed in walking distance. Walking to the beach is easy. Everyone was impressed with our Chicago home. We didn’t want to leave.
Great Air bnb. You can’t go wrong staying there.

The place was clean and just like the pictures. It was very easy to communicate with the host and we didn't have any issues with our accomodation! The house has a smell that I believe might be from oil paintings. We weren't bothered by it but those more sensitive might be. We'd come back.
Had a wonderful stay at Keenan’s place, even with having an emergency come up, he stayed up late into the night to make sure we were able to check in without issue. Recommend staying here
Fantastic location, and Rafael is truly a perfect host.
great host and addressed our needs right away. thank you for having us!
the place was as advertised. It's a down the street from a blueline station to get downtown and a Starbucks for a quick breakfast and coffee. it's in a good neighborhood.

Walid was great, he was very helpful and responsive and gave great recommendations. The place was amazing and perfect for us and another couple. It was very clean, cute, and comfy! We definitely recommend!
We stayed a few nights for a concert at Wrigley - felt safe and easy walk to and from the stadium, and lots to do! Easy train into downtown Chicago, and the apartment was exactly as described!
Had a great stay! The location was great and apartment was very clean.
Great location, location is super clean, will definitely stay again if in Chicago, no issues with the host, only issue is the the upstairs neighbor making late or early noise which.

My husband and I stayed here recently and really loved it! We like to stay places with some character and this spot is full of charm and thoughtful touches. It’s so great to be above a good neighborhood restaurant and bar and weren’t bothered by any noise at all. We walked to incredible shopping and restaurants and public transit. And the host was super communicative and quick to answer any question. Would definitely stay again!
We had a great time . The apartment fits the description very well.
Been here on four occasions and it never disappoints!

Overall the stay was very good, rooms were clean and shared bathroom was also very clean and never faced a busy time. The house is in a residential area which is good as per safety. The only downside side is that in the rooms you can hear noise if anyone is walking upstairs or cooking upstairs very loudly.
Clean and walkable neighborhood.
The place is a nice apartment on quiet street in East Lakeview with easy access to all of the amenities Lakeview and Chicago have to offer.
Great place to stay! Happy with the neighborhood and the owner was very responsive.

Had a great stay! I would definitely stay again and recommend Megan’s place, location was very clean and had everything we needed. Fast responses to any questions we had and the host did a great job of checking on us.
Lois was very responsive and helpful! She made sure to check in and made sure all arrangements were good for our group. She also had everything clear and labeled along with a helpful guide!
Lovely apartment in a fun neighborhood! Perfect location if you’re going to Wrigley for an event.

This spot was so perfect for our trip. The house was beautiful and the area was cute and peaceful. Necessities were in a walkable distance. John was very polite and responsive, couldn’t have asked for a better experience for our first time in Chicago!
Perfect distance to downtown and very clean place

What a beautiful home to ring in my 60th birthday.  They even had a wonderful birthday message drawn on the side of the fridge.  The house was so comfortable and the backyard was an added treasure.  Matthew is an incredible host.  Would love to stay there again in the future.

Sharon's house is beautiful and the guest room is so cute, as are all her cats. They might cause a little chaos late at night or in the early morning, but that's part of the fun. Sharon is a great and responsive host. If you are a cat lover who wants a quiet space in a great location, this is a great stay!
Great location. Very clean and spacious. Walking distance to countless restaurants and Wrigley. The parking is challenging if there is any event at Wrigley (not just Cubs games.)

It was a cool place to stay. The bedrooms were simple. One of the paintings was in the closet that undoubtedly fell from over the bed in the 1st downstairs bedroom and the memory foam mattress did get a little too hot when lying on. Would have been nice if it had cooling in it as it was regular memory foam which doesn't dissapate body heat well. But for it being a last minute reservation, that may explain the picture in the closet. Overall it was a pleasant and peaceful stay. The things I mentioned are very minor and can be fixed and addressed easily by the host.
That said, it was quiet as we eased into feeling safe as the neighbors were nice. I would definitely rent again now that I know the surrounding area isn't as bad as it first appeared when we arrived which was a bit unnerving at first. However, Keith was very responsive and helpful, which definitely eased our nerves and made it a comfortable stay. All the appliances worked flawlessly and the sofas were comfy. Definitely 8.5/10

This is a wonderful 5 star place!! The top floor of her house is beautiful, extremely clean and very comfortable!! We slept very well in the Queen size bed . The jacuzzi bathtubs was the “cherry on top” as we brought Epsom salt after our long downtown days!!!The refrigerator and microwave was handy during our 5 day stay!! Tracy had a lot of great walkable recommendations too!!
We also loved being so close to the Red Line to get downtown and we used the bus#147.
Best of all was the .5 mile walk directly down her street to the Lakefront where we took morning and evening walks. I felt very safe walking around her neighborhood!
Also Evanston is on my one mile up Clark street!!!

Pros:
Spacious
Located near public transit
Well-stocked amenities
Clear instructions
Cons:
Hotter than hades (broken AC)
Surprise chores (due to broken AC)
Heavily stained rugs
Poor issue resolution
Appliance issues
We were notified of the broken central air only ten minutes prior to 4:00 PM check-in, despite a review indicating this issue has persisted since May. Brad said that window units would be installed the next day if the central air could not be repaired. This never occurred. Our bedrooms reached 80-90 degrees, forcing some to sleep on couches. When I messaged for an update, my inquiry about the window units was ignored, and we received no further communication until checkout.
The portable units required us to monitor and empty water buckets to prevent overflow, affecting our schedule. We also encountered some other issues, including heavily stained rugs, a broken upstairs microwave, a fridge filter light, and a downstairs fridge that failed to keep items sufficiently cold.

Beautifully decorated and comfortable space which was conveniently located and walkable to Lincoln Square. Owners were responsive to concerns. Lovely space all in all. Look forward to staying again in the future.

Michelle was an amazing host! She was so friendly and very responsive. She really made us feel right at home and very welcomed into the space. The AirBnb was spotless, had plenty of extra linens if we needed them, and had a great list of things to do in the area. The patio was perfect to sit out at on a summer night with my sisters and chat about our stay. I would recommend staying at Michelle’s AirBnb to anyone!
Stay was great. Would go back.
Very clean and spacious place. Not far from the airport or the downtown area. Sarah and Marco were very communicative and I was able to check out a little later than expected, which was nice.
Great place! Very clean and well kept. We felt right at home here for our quick weekend stay. The beds were extremely comfy. It’s perfect for 2-3 people. Laura was also very responsive.

The area isn’t the best but it’s conveniently located near downtown. We got to do a lot of things in the city without having to travel too far. Jorge communicated very well throughout our trip! There was a fair amount of dust, hair, and some cupboards that do not open or do not close. I would stay again for convenience and affordability.
Place was nice and clean. The best part was for sure the location. Close enough to downtown but far enough away to not feel cramped. Restaurants in the neighborhood were also really nice.

The apartment is tucked away in a neighborhood and you would not know it was there. I appreciated the parking also. The home was a decent size for 2 couples in Chicago to see the city. The host made sure that we had all of the comforts of home in the kitchen and bathroom, as well has games.

La estancia fue muy agradable!!
El departamento es tal como se muestran las fotos, muy limpio y acogedor.
Contaba con todo lo necesario para estar varios días y Juan siempre respondia a tiempo y daba soluciones prácticas.
Caminas cuadra y media para tomar la línea 78 que te lleva al tren para llegar al centro de la cuidad.
Lo único que debes tomar en cuenta es que la distancia es amplia y requieres de una hora de anticipación para poder tomar el Bus y el Tren y llegar al centro, lo cual si lo haces por visita turística, será cansado los últimos días.
En cuanto a la zona es tranquila y bonita y por las noches no escuchamos ruido ni molestia de las personas que viven en la planta alta, así que para nosotros fue una placentera experiencia en el alojamiento.
Josh is super friendly and the place was exactly what I needed for 3 days!

They were super nice, very helpful and ultra communicative. Place was spotless – honestly probably the cleanest Airbnb I’ve ever been in. Neighborhood has lots of good shopping and restaurants and we had no problem finding street parking for the weekend. Also they’ve got it really well stocked – I was impressed by the number of kitchen gadgets and utensils as well as toiletry and first aid items. They thought of everything!
Hosts are very helpful and clear with their instructions, also provide lots of local recommendations when needed!

The place I started was well worth the money I paid — extremely close to the orange line, which made getting in and out of chicago convenient. The location was a bit hard to find at first (it’s just a door in a building, no particular signage or standout features), but was easy to find after that. Room was clean and came with some basic toiletries (toothbrush, shampoo, body wash, towel). Towel was washed, but had signs of prior use. Bathroom was relatively clean, but the sink had weak water-flow. The shower was good enough as well. Well worth the money, especially given the proximity to the orange line.

This was our first time staying in an Airbnb in the Chicago area. From the get-go Thomas was very responsive with all questions that we had. The room was a good size for my wife and I. The shower was a little tricky due to a smaller space but after my first shower I got used to it and my wife did as well. Thomas provided plenty of towels and was able to instruct us quickly on additional towels as needed. The first night we were there I found a critter crawling across the wall also known as a spider. That's to be expected however as the room is in a basement of a house. The other concern we had which really wasn't a huge deal but when entering the door to go into the basement there is only one small light that lights up the area and it is very faint so you have to be extra careful as the floor is concrete and there are steps leading to the laundry room which then leads to the basement room. Once again this is only in the night hours that it can be a little tricky.

Dan was incredibly easy to reach and responded quickly with questions regarding amenities for the baby before we arrived. The check in and check out instructions were clear and easy to understand. We have stayed in rental homes for 25+ years now for vacations and I have to say this is the best stocked kitchen of all the homes we have stayed! They had all the cookware we needed for a large multi family gathering 😊 The home is newly renovated with beautiful decorations and plenty of seating inside and out,  sleeping areas, and bathrooms for large families. Great location for catching the L, Uber, or parking for 1 or 2 vehicles. We would totally stay here again and highly recommend it! Thank you Dan for a wonderful experience.
excellent experience

Our stay at Melissa’s was great, the place was clean, had lots of amenities, and was very comfortable. It was close to downtown Chicago, and having a designated parking spot was very nice. Melissa was nice, helpful, and responsive. The neighbors were very nice as well. Overall, we had a good time staying here.

My partner and I had a wonderful time in Chicago and appreciated the air conditioning to come back to! Easy 15 minute walk to the brown line, beautiful neighborhoods and businesses nearby. My girlfriend loved the lighting in the bathroom for her makeup! Easy getting in and finding parking. Old style but cozy, everything we expected. Overall an enjoyable experience and stay with Fabiana!!
Beautiful home with a lot of space inside the home and outside. Host is very responsive and friendly. Amazing experience I highly recommend this home.
Tanys and Drew were very responsive, their home was was very clean and comfortable, it checked all the boxes. We enjoyed our stay and would not hesitate to refer someone to stay with them.
I had a great time at Katty location. Very comfortable, the bed felt comfortable, the ac was working and also very cozy . The shower was amazing , very clean , !! Definitely would book again

I would recommend David’s place for anyone going to Chicago. It was very easy to find and close enough to everything we wanted to see in Chicago. The place was very clean and very easy to check in & out of. Perfect spot for a couple to spend a quick weekend! I will keep this place in mind next time I visit.
It was a pleasure to stay at the NHLI! The room was extremely spacious and comfortable. The service and location was great as well, would definitely recommend!
We had a wonderful stay at Carla's place. It's in a great, peaceful neighborhood. such a perfect base for our trip, and so close to Wrigley Field where we went for a concert
Nice place clean easy to get in and was perfect for being close to downtown

I travel to Chicago every summer for work and have stayed in many places over 20+ years, Tatiana’s beautiful place is at the top of the list. The location, furnishings and space are incredible. You are literally steps from Michigan Avenue and close to all major attractions.  Restaurants, grocery stores, retail are all a stone’s throw away.  Though it is in the city center, the two bedrooms are toward the back snd quiet. Tatiana was helpful, friendly and above all an outstanding host! Cannot wait to stay again!

This is a 5-star property as described and is in a killer location. Great food in any direction and a great anchor spot to enjoy all things the North Side of Chicago has to offer.
Why only 4-stars??? this house was packed with single-ply toilet paper. That's insulting for $1,000/night listing. Host provides single-ply tp, 4 stars is the best they can get from my ranking system. Hopefully, guests that follow will have that Charmin, cushy 4-ply supplied.

The apartment was true to the description of the listing, and suited my family of three well for our stay in Chicago. The location was solid and the building felt safe/secure. Would definitely stay again!

Good location in Chinatown. Some nice restaurants nearby.  Lots of transit nearby that helps with getting into the main part of Chicago. My sister and I had a super comfortable stay. Even made breakfast a couple times at home.  Would stay there again if in Chicago.
Place was exactly as described, great neighborhood and probably a 2 minute walk to Wrigley.  Highly recommend staying at Peter's place.

Great location, very clean, and exactly as described. We really enjoyed our stay. The only downside was that the host initially gave us the wrong access code, so we had to wait several hours before we could get into the property. Other than that, everything was excellent.

Loved the convenience of being close to the Hyde Park neighborhood and The Obama Presidential Center. We were able to enjoy proximity to 31st Street beach as well. Thank you for the comfortable and enjoyable stay in the city!
Jason was very responsive and the apartment was great! Clean and well decorated. Really nice neighborhood as well.
We had a great stay. We felt right at home in the cozy library, and our host was very responsive and had a wealth of recommendations on things to do during our visit!

We loved the apartment! Excellent location, very walkable, great nearby restaurants. We enjoyed renting bikes near by and riding downtown on the bike path. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable. The bed and shower were amazing! Lots of great little details. Would definitely stay again.

Good location for our weekend trip. Easy to find, not too difficult to get in but we did have to play with the lock feature when closing the door. A little more homely than the pictures show but not far off. Space & couch could use a deeper clean, the rooms could use places to hang clothes and the towels/wash cloths could use an upgrade. Overall decent and no complaints.
Clean. Great location. Walkable. Plenty of room. Would definitely recommend!
Super close to the blue line, making it easy to get into the loop and to O’Hare!

Highly recommend! The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Parking was easy to find, which made our stay even more convenient. Emily was a wonderful host, she is very kind, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. We had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!
Super helpful host, easy to locate check in and park.
Beautiful, spacious home and I would definitely book again!
Great stay in Streeterville!

We had such a lovely trip to Chicago staying here.
