Had a nice stay. Quiet, safe, and pretty area. Place is like it is seen in pictures and in descriptions. Good space for the five of us that went. Quick response to management.
Spacious place to stay - close to a lot of bar and restaurant options in Logan Square. Responsive hosts as well and nicely decorated place
Great host, great location
Gina & Jose’s place was clean, comfortable and cozy! My family & I had a good time there and felt comfortable.

A great host, great house, and great location! Located right by two busy CTA bus routes you’re able to get anywhere on the north side easy! Host was responsive and friendly. Patio was great too! Would recommend to any of my friends.

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago! The home was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, well-maintained, and in a great location with easy access to everything we wanted to do. It had plenty of space for our group, and we felt right at home throughout our trip. The only hiccup occurred just before our arrival and the host was responsive, understanding, and worked with us to find a fair resolution. We truly appreciated our host's honesty and transparency. Unexpected situations can happen, but it's how they're handled that makes the difference, and she handled it with kindness, professionalism, and integrity. Overall, we had a fantastic experience and created great memories during our stay. We would absolutely recommend this Airbnb to future guests and would gladly stay here again. Thank you for your hospitality and for going above and beyond to ensure we still had an enjoyable trip!
Great location! The stay was accurate to the listing. Eladio and others were great hosts and responded quickly. I would recommend to those exploring Chicago for the first time.

The location was close to downtown which was nice. We were not happy with the cleanliness or amenities; black hair found on a few of the towels, old contacts that were left on the bedroom nightstand, two sticky areas that were spilled near the living room rugs and one spill looked recent on the rug that wasn’t cleaned, no basic amenities in the kitchen like dish soap and a sponge or even some basic spices like salt/pepper etc which was always something we had at other Airbnbs. It was very bare and tight for 6 people. I will give it a 3 out of 5 for location.

Place was exactly as described! We had a mishap with not getting the code in time, but Sharleen was super responsive and communicative. I recommend! I came here with my family including 3 kiddos, and there was plenty of room for all of us.

It was a cute basement unit with everything you need for a short stay. The bed was super comfortable! The location was close enough to a bus stop that takes you to a train station. Would stay here again.

Very affordable and nice little spot for solo travelers! It’s a little far from public transit, but the walk was nice and felt very safe. Also felt safe inside with keys for front door AND personal room.
Great location. Comfy rooms
The stay was nice and in a good location
Great place very spacious and good area
Had a great time! Johnie was friendly & helpful.

The location is walkable and convenient to anything around town (especially Wrigley). Easy walk to the shore/bird sanctuary. The Mexican restaurant downstairs is a great spot for a quick bite/drink after travel. Really enjoyed coffee at Osmium (long walk or quick drive if you have a vehicle). Great location and beautiful space. Parking is available (adhere to the host’s instructions). Looking forward to visiting again in the future!
A good place to be for the night!
We loved staying here, the apartment is big and has everything we needed for our trip. The location is also great, would visit again!

We booked at the last minute and had a question after regular business hours. He responded promptly. Throughout our stay, he was extremely responsive and accommodating.
Although the main living areas and bathroom are shared, the space still felt quite private. If you're uncomfortable using a shared bathroom that isn't cleaned between each use, this may not be the right place for you. That said, most guests are considerate, and cleaning supplies are readily available.
Street parking was available throughout our stay. Uber and Lyft rides to and from the city were a bit expensive, but the L is an easy walk away (Kedzie Station along pink line).
I would definitely check this host's availability if I visited the city again.

This place was just right for us. The apartment was immaculate, comfortable and in a great location. David was a very responsive host and provided a clear and accurate description of the apartment itself as well as the directions for access.  We would definitely consider staying here again.
Nice stay for the price. AC was always on which made sleeping comfortable considering its been in the 100°s

Exactly what we needed for a weekend in Chicago. Their home was welcoming and comfortable. Nice, quiet neighborhood. And right around the corner from the train so we could park our car for the weekend and take the train downtown.

Overall, I had a great stay. The place was clean, and the host was very kind and responsive. The only minor downsides were that check-out was a bit early and parking could be difficult in the evening. Other than that, everything was comfortable, and I’d be happy to stay here again.
Very clean ,accessible location and close to the train station great hosting and very communicative
We enjoyed our stay. The location was great, and there was on street parking right in front of the building. Communication with the host was prompt and he even let us check in early.

Can't say enough about how pleased I was with this space! Set on a lovely, quiet side street, everything was walkable and lots of shops and restaurants near by. Kitchen supplied with everything you could need (and is quite high end as well). Quality furnishings and linens made the trip complete. Our event was at Wrigley and it could not have been more convenient. Don is bar none the fastest responder I've ever dealt with about rental properties and it's extremely appreciated!

We enjoyed every minute in this apartment for a girls celebration weekend.  The unit was clean and fresh, Elizabeth was so helpful and responsive, and we found a fantastic coffee shop within a 5 minute enjoyable walk.  It was perfect!

The apartment was very clean and the decor is unique and fun. The location is great! It is walking distance to the pink line, and has shops, cafes, and restaurants nearby. I saw other reviews had mentioned an overwhelming perfume scent, but we had no issues with this at all. The host also kindly allowed us to check in an hour early, which was great.
Our only complaint was that the host’s response time was a bit slower than we’re used to. One day, we messaged to ask how to get the air conditioning to work because it was quite warm inside, but we never received a response. Thankfully, the air conditioning seemed to come on the next day and worked fine after that.
There was also only one roll of toilet paper provided, so we were without toilet paper for about half a day while waiting to hear whether there was another roll somewhere in the Airbnb. The host did respond to that message and kindly had someone deliver another roll, which we appreciated. Overall, our stay was pleasant.

We had a wonderful stay with Iris! We were in town for a quick weekend trip and the location was perfect. It was fairly easy find street parking and we enjoyed being a quick walk away from the beach, restaurants, and bars. There was even a cute little farmer’s market around the corner on Sunday morning! We would definitely stay here again 😊

The place was clean, the location was great. Parking was a little difficult but it’s expected.
Overall a great stay!

Absolutely loved staying at the Cozy Andersonville Cabin. It was in the absolutely best location - Andersonville is an incredible spot to stay for its food and shops and relative ease to get to other parts of the city. And the Cabin itself was adorable and so comfortable. I would absolutely want to stay here again in the future.
Great location close to everything.  Parking was not included but garage is a three minute walk through SpotHero that was secure, enclosed and reasonable.

Was a great location on a nice quiet street and very close to so much! Perfect for one, maybe two, people - it is an efficiency for sure, but all I needed for this trip
They were proactive in their communication and getting into the unit was very easy!

Honestly, we travel a lot in groups and this is one of the coolest Airbnb’s. We’ve ever been to in the country. The host was great with communication at all times or anything that we needed if you are attending something at Wrigley Field you’re literally is no better Airbnb in the world.

The apartment is managed by a company, so it lacks a personal touch when communicating. The apartment was clean, and the bed was comfortable. The AC is extremely loud, and the vent is directly on top of your head. Making it hard for you to sleep with the a/c on. On another note, my flight landed before check-in time. I reached out to ask if the apartment is ready before the check-in. Can I check in early if it's ready? They replied with a simple payment link which range with pricing depending on how early you want to check in. A fee ranging from 60 to 120 dollars.  This is what happens when an Airbnb is run by a big company, Just lack empathy and common sense. The apartment was clean and ready by 12 pm because they told me the earliest I can check in with a fee is 10 am, but I landed after 10 am, so I declined. I am pregnant, so I emailed them around 1 pm to ask if the apartment is ready now, and they kept sending a payment link. I will not recommend this Airbnb.
Had a great stay- the place is super clean and comfortable. Located in a great spot. Would stay again and recommend to friends
I have stayed twice, it is simple and exactly what I need for my trip :)

David and Andrea’s place was perfect! This is one of the nicest Airbnb’s I have ever stayed in. Clean, spacious, well-stocked with what you need, quiet, and beautifully designed. I would highly recommend staying here, and look forward to staying again in the future.
This place was great and the location was perfect we were close to everything thank you
Easy check in and minimal, breezy checkout process. Simple, comfortable accomodations, just what you need for a quick stay. Very comfortable bed and the AC worked very well. Cozy, quiet spot.

Enjoyed my stay at Susan's place.  It had everything I was looking for when I wasn't exploring Chicago, great cozy homebase with kitchen amenities to quick meals and the ability to do laundry as I packed light.  Location is excellent with easy walking to restaurants, breweries, grocery store and the L.  Would stay again.
Jeff's place looks better than the pictures. It was very clean, parking was easy, and you are not to far from public transportation.

Had a great stay here for a Chicago weekend - would recommend. The photos matched the unit. Beds were comfortable and towels were plush and clean. Amenities included nice touches like white noise machines and small fans in the bedrooms. A/C was cold and water pressure and temperature in the showers was great. It backs up to the L-train tracks but it didn’t disrupt any sleep.

The place was in the perfect location for us. The neighborhood is safe to walk in day or night. We were close to my daughter’s home.
The place was as portrayed in the listing. Emily was responsive. Check in and check out was very simple.

The pictures dont do this place justice. A beautiful home. Very clean.  My family and I felt at home. Walkable grocery stores and restaurants. A short drive to museums, Chinatown, parks. Great hosts. We'd definitely stay get again and recommend them to friends.

The condo was nicer than the photos!
Perfectly clean, comfortable, great neighborhood, plenty of space. I would stay here again, and highly recommend.

El lugar esta perfectamente ubicado, nada más como se avisa si es dificil encontrar estacionamiento, un poco chico el apt para 3 personas pero está bien para un trip de findesemana. recomendado si buscas una estadia tranquila por un precio justo, el internet nada mas un poco lento
Great stay! The host was quick to respond. She even brought us extra trash bags when we couldn’t find any at the store. Very clean.

Iris was a great host! I did a last minute booking for Chicago and this was the perfect place for me to stay. It was convenient in terms of location and only being about 20 minutes from the city and all the activities that I did. Iris was always quick to respond which made me feel more relaxed with my stay as well. The home itself was clean and had everything I needed for a weekend getaway. Would definitely book again!

Great place to stay and very walkable to a lot of the tourist attractions and a short walk to the train station.
Only thing is that the bed is a Full Sized bed, not a Queen like listed

We loved our stay here! Great location and easy to get to everything we wanted to do.
If you’re worried about the parking situation, don’t be- we drove into the city and used Spot Hero to get a reserved parking space in a garage on N Halsted, super easy.
We would definitely stay here again!
Host was so responsive and accommodating. Such a clean and organized space + great price would recommend!

In general Richard was a very polite and helpful Airbnb host. For my first time expirience it was amazing. I have no complaints but only a good memory that Richard could be my first host.
100/10 would recommend
Great stay, everything was as it appears in the pictures and description
We had a great stay at David's! No issues whatsoever and the apartment was a fun and comfortable place to hang out and rest our heads during our trip. Great location, too!
as described! ideal for a short stay in Chicago😊
Nice house but cleaning needs to be better as we found some dirty areas. Pillows were too hard.

We had an amazing stay! The home was incredibly clean, cozy, and comfortable—it truly felt like a home away from home. Everything was neat, well-maintained, and thoughtfully prepared for our arrival.
The location was also a huge plus. The drive to Michigan Avenue was quick and easy, making it convenient to explore the city while still enjoying a peaceful place to come back to. The neighborhood was quiet, safe, and relaxing, and we slept wonderfully every night.
Our host made us feel so welcome from the very beginning and was always accessible whenever we had a question. Their hospitality made the experience even better.
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this home to anyone looking for a comfortable, peaceful, and convenient place to stay!
Khoy was responsive to issues quickly and rectified them.
Yanko was one of the most responsive, understanding, and helpful hosts I’ve ever had. I really appreciate his assistance with my stay, and would highly recommend it to anyone!

Great place to use as a base for exploring Chicagoland. Walkable to local parks and coffee shops. Highly recommend Baked by Jane! The space is comfortable. It is easy to access and quiet at night. Remember that you are in the basement of someone's home, so there is normal life sounds! Nothing was disturbing. We were very comfortable.

Im a Chicago native living in Omaha and in the Chi, basement apartments are very popular and economical. It’s no different with this Airbnb. It’s convenient for me as I’m a northsider so it’s close to fam and about a good 30 - 45 minute drive downtown. Instructions were clear, not a single issue and I’ll like be using Mariels Airbnb again. 🙏🏽
Good
Waking up in the peaceful atmosphere was indeed wonderful
It’s was a great spot really walkable and 15mims uber to the main city and attractions. Got a little loud at night since it is the city it was expected. Really spacious apartment.
Great stay and answered all questions needed during stay

My guest and I came for our organizations convention, and we had a great time! This place was everything that we expected! Very nice and clean when we arrived! Freddy kept us updated about the heatwave and parking. Check-in and check-out was easy!
Phebian’s place was clean. It was easy to find. She gave clear instructions on how to get inside the place. The neighborhood is very quiet and peaceful.
Perfect Airbnb, right in the heart of the city on a quiet street provide some of the best bars and restaurants in the area overall would rent this spot again
Great place. Great host.
Great location and well described.

Host was very kind and fast to respond. It was a good place to stay for the price. It was clean and comfortable. Not too far from downtown. It’s a little complicated to find but their directions and instruction are very clear, just follow them. Overall we were happy.
Great location and within walking distance to shops and restaurants. Very clean and well stocked and very comfortable. Will definitely stay here again when back in Chicago!!

This was an incredible Airbnb with everything within walking distance from the spot. All of the guests loved it. We had a group of 8 of us and it was more than enough room for all of us to sleep and also hang out. You are right by the train but you do not hear it at all. There was also an event happening at Wrigley and we could easily listen to the performance. It was great!

location location location! we were quite happy with this gold coast flat, steps from Division and State streets. The access instructions were clear, with working codes. There was a fair amount of foot traffic in / out of the building; everyone we met was friendly and didn’t seem to mind our pet dog. The elevators were vintage, well serviced and efficient (moreso than a nearby big chain hotel). Our host, Jeveaux, communicated promptly. The apartment was clean and uncluttered with a good window unit AC and ceiling fans. These did a decent job of keeping the apartment temp regulated even in the current heat wave (upper 20s-30C/80Fs). The pictures in the listing are accurate. We would enjoy coming back here for future visits to downtown chicago.

Troy was an amazing host—quick, responsive, and incredibly accommodating throughout our stay. Feeling safe, comfortable, and at home is very important to me when traveling, and this stay exceeded my expectations.
The home was absolutely spotless, beautiful, and incredibly spacious, making it perfect for our friend group. We especially loved the backyard area, which was such a cozy and enjoyable bonus. The nearby train was not a concern for us at all and did not take away from our experience.
The location was another major highlight! The home provided easy access to the city and plenty of great restaurants, which made our stay even more enjoyable and convenient.
If I could change one thing, I simply would have made our stay longer! This truly felt like a home away from home, and I would absolutely recommend staying here.
Thank you Troy!
Excellent stay! Beautiful home, responsive hosts, perfect location!

Overall, we had a very enjoyable stay. Check in and check out is super easy. The area is great and walkable to a lot of good spots. We didn’t hear any noise from neighbors and loved the multi floor patio. Most of the main rooms were super clean. TV had easy airplay and ample sitting room for multiple guests. However the queen bunk beds on the second floor were full of hair and unusable. We could not find fresh sheets to replace the hair filled sheets on the bunk beds. And the room on the highest floor had no AC and was sweltering. So, all in all, about 3 of the beds ended up being unusable because of hair or because the temperature of the rooms. Otherwise it was a lovely experience

They only allow me 1,000 words, so I’ll try to be to the point-Nicole & her place were AWESOME!!! Super clean, vintage charm throughout, tastefully decorated, spacious, quiet neighborhood & we always felt very safe! The backyard deck was really nice & private. The  yard was really cute & very well maintained. We really enjoyed walking around the neighborhood & looking at all the well-kept vintage homes. Nicole is an awesome, proactive communicator. We fully enjoyed our stay & will definitely return!!
The place was great! Super close to so many things. We initially had trouble getting in the door but the host was so responsive very quickly and were able to help
It was a great stay, we look forward to coming back soon!

It was a great place to stay for a weekend trip! Kyriako was very responsive and communicative, and the check-in and check-out processes were very straightforward and easy. The space was very clean when we arrived as well!
Really cool, well-decorated, clean space just a couple blocks from an awesome downtown Avondale area. Highly recommend!
We really enjoyed our stay here! The home was clean, private & our family of five was very comfortable! We would definitely stay here again! Elba was helpful & very nice!
Great stay near China Town with easy access to the train for easy commuting to Wrigley, and all of downtown. Great rooftop patio next door, relaxed people.  Fun weekend in Chicago!

This apartment is in a fantastic location! We chose to walk the 20ish minutes from the Amtrak Station and were pleased that the flat is literally around the corner from the main drag of Fulton Market - we had so many great restaurants at our fingertips. We also loved that there was also a Whole Foods just down the street. The L wooshes by the flat regularly but anywhere you stay in the heart of the city will have these types of noises. We had plenty of space in the apartment and appreciated the nice towels and bed linens.
Great place!  Great communication.  Close to downtown.  Easy to get around all of Chicago.
Beautiful stay. Thomas & Cynthia always responded back in a timely manner. Bnb is absolutely beautiful!!!  I enjoyed my stay, I’ll be back.

The host was kind and responsive throughout our stay, which I appreciated. Unfortunately, the space itself fell short in a few important ways.
The listing accommodates up to 4 guests, but this is really a small studio comfortable for 2. There’s a queen bed, a small couch, and one air mattress — except there wasn’t actually room to inflate the air mattress once you account for the accent furniture and coffee table.
Cleanliness was also an issue. The couch had a large, noticeable stain, and we ended up laying our spare own clothes over it before anyone could sleep there. Bedding was limited too — only one extra sheet and blanket were provided beyond what was already on the bed, which wasn’t enough for 4 people.
Lastly, the wifi listed didn’t work — the network wasn’t even detectable, and the password provided was incorrect.
The host’s communication was a bright spot, but I’d recommend future guests go in with 2 people max, and that the host
Nice place to stay, responsive host, 5 stars
Awesome place, me and my wife stayed over to relax after a long month of work. It was worth it! There was a lot to do in the area, especially with the train nearby.

My family I enjoyed our stay at this beautiful modern penthouse! My teen loved the indoor basketball court and the bridge to the next door grocery store was so convenient! Would definitely book again for our yearly Chicago visit.

The hotel staff were incredibly courteous and helpful.  Room was spacious and comfortable.  Very comfortable beds and pillows.  Great location and walkable to main attractions.  I would note that the rooftop is only available to private booked events, though it looks like it has a wonderful view of the city.
Great place and great location! Definitely plan to come back!

Having previously lived in Chicago for many years, we found Diana’s apartment to be a little slice of home. Great location, excellent size and layout, exactly as described. We made good use of the two offices, as my husband and I were both working remotely.
I also recommend this stay to anyone visiting Chicago with dogs! Great, big backyard space for pets to play between walks and exploring the city.
Highly recommend this Airbnb, and we appreciate Diana for being such a responsive and helpful host.
The house was great. close enough to the transit station.  But our favorite was the rooftop lounge, a great extra perc on a warm night.

I liked how bathroom amenities were provided. On the listing it only says there is a towel and shampoo, but there was also conditioner which was nice. She was responsive when I wasn’t able get in due to the door lock battery being low.
Joses place felt very homely and he was always proactive and responsive with everything. great location and easy to get into the city
The place works well for the area.  Loved being close to the lake and beach.

Clear, kind, professional communication, quick responses, well-kept property in an excellent location.
Looking forward to returning.

Really enjoyed our time here. Quiet treelined street with lots of parking. Very walkable and great part of Chicago. Rooms and layout were great and easy to find. Amenities were what we needed for our family and small dog.
It was clean, private and convenient for Chicago.

We loved our stay at Jean's place. It was perfect for our adult family! Great walkable neighborhood and beautiful surroundings. Great location, short walk to the C Line.
Jean was a very responsive host. We will definitely stay there again if we come back to Chicago.
Excellent stay - super clean, very attentive, overall great spot
Milton was a great host! The rental was clean, in a good location, and was quiet. would book with him again!
The host was incredibly helpful!! the place was peaceful and just a bus and train ride from the city! i loved this if i come back to chicago i will be staying.
The location is in a great,  walkable neighborhood. The unit was clean and the building was quiet. Would definitely stay here again!
Todd place was an excellent choice to stay the wife and I can't wait to stay there again

We had a great stay at Rasheed's place!  It has all listed amenities and beds were very comfortable.  The highlight for our group was the great location relative to the lake and shopping.  The outdoor deck was very fun for our summer visit too.  Hope to visit again soon.

Overall a good experience. Iris is very responsive which is always a great thing! The place has a few cosmetic issues but outside of that a very nice place. Small issue when it came to check in time but overall I enjoyed our stay.

Nice place with a great location if you want to be on the north side of the City. The unit does face a major street, so there was definitely noise, especially because there was building construction happening a few doors down. It was a functional place and was very clean, but pretty basic for the price.
If you are needing to be close to the United Center, this is your place! Plenty of places to grab food or coffee within walking distance.

We had a wonderful one-month stay and would absolutely stay here again!
The location is outstanding—an easy walk to the Brown Line CTA, great restaurants, coffee shops, and shopping. We always felt very safe walking around the neighborhood, both during the day and in the evenings.
The home is bright and welcoming with lots of natural light from the large front windows. The kitchen is beautifully updated, the air conditioning worked great (even upstairs), and having a dedicated parking space was a huge bonus that we used every day.
Diane was an excellent host. She was very responsive, easy to communicate with, and quickly answered any questions we had throughout our stay.
The only minor negatives were that the upstairs is carpeted (which isn't my personal preference, although I knew that before booking) and the area rugs are also showing some wear and could probably be replaced.
Overall, these were very small issues compared to everything this home has to offer. We loved our stay!

Dana was very responsive if I had any questions, comments, or concerns. All the instructions were clear and received beforehand so I wasn’t left wondering what to do. Place was absolutely lovely, clean, and comfortable. Parking was easy and i was always able to park near the home :) Everything was perfect
There were thoughtful details like coffee pods readily available and usb/usb C chargers at every night stand. Very spacious and comfortable for myself, toddler and sister.
Ledys’ place was nice. She was also very responsive to any concerns we had.

Sedo remained proactive and professional from the time we made our reservation to the time we checked out.
The initial is spacious and clean. Not far from Midway.

This was a nice walkable Airbnb. Best if you’re looking to be out most of the day. Definitely a basement - was very humid and there are large bugs crawling around. You can’t control the air but she turned it on when asked and that solved the heat and humidity but it sucked bc we couldn’t change it to our liking so I was freezing. The listing details you can hear noise upstairs but I wouldn’t say it’s unbearable. Overall nice location and really in a nice neighborhood but if you are looking for something a bit more polished I’d look more into other places.
Really nice place to stay while in the Chicago area. Great location and host. 5 Stars!
Fantastic location! Beautiful street and surrounding area. The apartment was easy to access with clear instructions. The upgraded kitchen was a standout feature.
Our stay was great. The apartment is in a lovely old building in an amazing, walkable location. We stayed with our one year old and it was more baby friendly than most places. We would stay again.
Great light, spacious, glad to have place that felt like home for the weekend while traveling with our dog!
The unit was exactly what you see in the pictures! Clean, easy check in / check out process, and in a great location. Would recommend!
Amazing place to stay just right outside of the city. 15-20 minute drive to nearly everything Chicago has to offer. Beautiful, open kitchen with all amenities one would need to feel at home.
This was a great place to stay! Great spot in South Loop and ~5 minute walk from two L stations so super easy to get around the city from here; the place was super tidy as well.
Perfect location!! Walking distance to Wrigleyville, restaurants, train, and bike rentals. But far enough away from the hustle and bustle. Thanks Mark we enjoyed our stay.

Very nice place, not too far from wherever we needed to go. Having access to both floors was very nice as we were a big family, and everyone was able to have their own space. Whenever we had a problem, Josh and Jordan were on top of it and were very accommodating!

Parking, especially for a group of 10, was difficult, there was limited permit space on the block and there was some confusion as to which streets were permit only and which were free game (West 24th is free on both sides with there being street sweeping Thursdays on the south side and Fridays on the north side).
That said, Freddy made sure guest parking stickers were available for us and was in constant communication as to how many more we needed for our stay. The place itself was clean and had plenty of space for 10 of us.
Loved it❤️

Shaun was an amazing host! His home was perfect and looked just like the pictures! He was very responsive and answered any questions that we had! We appreciated his hospitality and will continue booking here when we return to visit!
We had a large family get-together visiting some old friends In Chicago with our three children. It was an awesome experience. 10 out of 10 would do it again.
Grace was a wonderful host!  Location was perfect!

Such a nice stay! Brendan was super responsive and helpful when we had any small issues! The place was so spacious and we had plenty of extra blankets & towels. Best part of the stay was the breakfast vouchers! The food at Wolfhound was amazing, definitely would stay here again :)

I had a great stay! The host was very friendly, responded quickly, and always checked to see if I needed anything. The place was clean and comfortable. Even though it’s a little far from downtown, there are several bus routes nearby, so it’s still easy to get around. I definitely recommend staying here!

We loved our stay here! It was the perfect space for 6 of us (3 couples) to hang out and enjoy a long weekend together. We were in Chicago for a show at Wrigley Field and this was the perfect spot - about a 5 minute walk but on a quieter street.
Enjoyed our stay while visiting family.  Great location to coffe shops, restaurants and a wonderful farmers market on Sunday . Plenty of space with everything we needed.  would definitely stay again.

Very quiet and safe neighborhood. I actually dropped my wallet in the road and didn’t realize til I saw it the next morning. Very clean space and pretty neighborhood. Emily was extremely responsive. No complaints from me.

Great location, extremely clean and comfortable.  For the most part communication was good--just had to be the one to reach out for WIFI info that wasn't updated and app to get into apt. was not functioning.  Overall, would stay here again~
I enjoyed my stay. 10 out of 10

The location is great - close to restaurants and the Brown and Red lines. Communication and cleanliness of the apartment was not great. There were not enough towels and toilet paper provided. When this was relayed to the host, the response time was very delayed and instructions on how to obtain refills were unclear, so this did not occur. Angela stated she was sick, which was the reason for this. The sheets on the bed also had some stains on them and there were not clean sheets provided for the pullout sofa. The on-site parking is nice and the instructions to get there were helpful.
Vin’s place was great! I would stay there again.

The unit was clean, appreciate the snacks, and art work in the unit and the building. The views were immaculate, the location was superb! Concierge very friendly and helpful. Though the unit would be a little bigger for the price.
Nice place. We were able to watch fireworks at Navy Pier from the roof top.  Easy for multiple families as lower level has a separate entrance with 2 bedrooms, kitchette living room and full bath.
So grateful for this space & the time spent with my family this weekend for my bachelorette trip. Nick was kind and responsive and the Airbnb had everything we needed.

My Family and I enjoyed our stay at Naomi's Place! All of our destinations were from 10 to 25 minutes from here! Great spot, the rooms were spacious and the main areas are very opened for family time. The deck was very quiet and relaxing for a nice chat. Naomi's Place was very accommodating to our needs, having extra blankets and towels, even pillows! I definitely recommend!!

Justine’s place in Avondale was perfect for our short stay. My only regret is that I couldn’t stay there longer. I would have loved to utilize the very well equipped kitchen as I really enjoy cooking. Justine apparently lives here and you can tell because it feels like home. I could go on & on about how great this apartment is but I’m going to keep this short. Communication, ease of access, beds, sitting areas, amenities, neighborhood, quiet environment, all 10 out of 10. Loved being able to walk to restaurants, bars, bakeries and coffee shops through a beautiful area. Justine, I can’t thank you enough for hosting us, your apartment was exactly what we needed!
Definitely was a great getaway stay! Very clean and cozy with an amazing guest shower! Very peaceful and safe neighborhood.

Talie was very responsive throughout the process. We had a miscommunication, but he took accountability and was willing to help in any way possible, which I really appreciated.

I stayed here with my family and we really enjoyed the house. The place was really neat and there was so much inside for everyone to enjoy. Overall I would definitely book this place again.
Everything was wonderful, neighborhood was extremely safe and had a wonderful stay highly recommend this spot.
Valerie was the best host! She was so helpful, even with finding things to do in the city!  Very nice and communicative. 10/10 recommend and we will be back!
Sharon’s place was perfect for my weekend stay. It was very close to the metro stop and in a well-located place. She was incredibly responsive both during the trip and before. Would recommend.
loved it
Joan was a wonderful host, we had a great stay.

Absolutely loved the space! It was a nice to have garage parking available and an easy commute to the train. Also the beds are so comfortable!!!

Our family of 4 gives the highest possible praise for this Wrigleyville GEM! Incredibly well appointed, spacious, and elegant. The apartment was great home base in Chicago. Great location by Southport shopping and the CTA station. You can see/hear the train but it is not disruptive -our baby slept right through it.

Overall not too bad. Did smell strongly of marijuana and the noise from a nearby rooster may throw you off a bit. Beauuuuutiful area! Very safe and clean, you won't regret staying here 💚

Overall not a bad place to stay at all. The inside is really good. Tons of options for people to sleep with all the beds. TVs were very good and had no issues with them. However, I didn’t feel unsafe at any point. Having the garage to leave our car in was amazing. Still was very responsive and offered a very early check in. Solid Airbnb, would recommend.
Clean and comfortable. Enjoyed my stay
Very comfortable, great location, responsive host. They helped us resolve a minor issue and allowed us a late checkout. Highly recommend!

It was very comfortable, even through late nights and early mornings, never felt uncomfortable or out of place. Even got to relax on the balcony with my friends without any issue. Great guest friendly and clear, I would definitely stay here again. Down to the area it was overall beautiful.

My friends and I had a lovely weekend stay at Hector's place! The place was very comfortable (great air conditioning, which we needed!!), towels folded on each of our beds, clean house and free of clutter. There are 2 common areas with big couches and TVs, which was perfect for us to relax, catch up, and watch a basketball game. The location is also amazing! It's close to cute coffee shops, restaurants, bars, but it is also far away enough from the action to be peaceful at night. :) I would definitely stay here again--thank you Hector!!
A beautiful place that was completely remodeled. Everyone in my group who stayed there loved it. There was a lot of attention to details. Liliana had everything well thought through. BRAVO!

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was beautifully decorated, super comfortable, and had so many thoughtful little touches that made it feel extra special. You can tell Sherry put a lot of care into making guests feel welcome, she had great knowledge about the neighborhood and was so friendly and patient . We'd absolutely stay here again!
Cute little place for the weekend! Thanks for allowing us to stay!
Really nice and comfortable

This unit is NOT newly renovated. It is run down and dingy. This is a basement unit, and it smelled very musty when we arrived. We had to run the dehumidifier constantly to keep the smell at bay. The place was quite dirty as well. The couch had stains and dirt on it. There were hairs in the bed and in the bathroom. There is only a small window AC unit that barely kept the place cool. We lost sleep on the first night because it was so hot in the unit. The night before my stay, the host tried to charge me an extra pet fee, but I complained, so it was waived. Overall, I’m very disappointed with my stay, and I do not feel that it was worth the amount I paid. The only good things I can say are that it is located near a train station, which was convenient for travel, and the host was friendly and responsive to my messages. I wish I had read the reviews more carefully before booking, because it seems that many guests had similar issues.
Great spot, super nice host, no notes!

julio’s place was absolutely amazing. photos were accurate, but in person the space is even better. beautiful rooms, layout was excellent and the kitchen/living-space was perfect for entertaining ourselves.
julio was generous, communicative and the perfect host.
would definitely stay here again, 10/10 highly recommend.
Will be booking again!

Overall, we absolutely enjoyed staying at Geo's and will be looking to return for next year's Taste of Chicago.
We had a great time in Chicago! Our stay was great. Thanks Jie!

It was a fun Airbnb. It felt like a hostel more than a stay in someone’s house. Not that there’s anything wrong with that. We didn’t have AC when we got in and he responded when he could and found the tripped breaker. He was also very eager to share spots around his home and Chicago. He also loves his home and wants to share its story which is very unique and something you don’t get in most places.
Absolutely wonderful host! She made me feel right at home. Will absolutely be renting this airbnb again if I’m ever in the area!

Great location, super clean. Love the shower. Only a few minor inconveniences- the front door lock and gate were not working, there was no ice in the freezer, and I couldn’t figure out how to use the oven.
Place was decent, upon booking was a little confusing talking to 3 different people but overall the place was okay.
Beautiful home, very spacious and very clean. Very easy instructions and very accommodating. Any issue that arised, Tonija handled it with the utmost professionalism and respect.
was a great stay worked with us on early check  in very friendly came right over and helped get the keys . very cute place we really like the rooms on opposite ends of unit as it was 2 couples
This place had everything we needed and more. Loved the proximity of bus stop and train station for easy transportation into the city. Very responsive and kind hosts.

Nice home. 20 mins from what we wanted to do (Millennium Park, 360 tilt, riverwalk). Home was very clean had everything we needed! Claudia had clear instructions & was friendly. Roomy and excellent accommodations. Provided all the comforts of home and then some. Really comfortable space for 4 people as it had 2 bathrooms and 3 bedrooms where guests are able to move freely. Quiet surroundings in a very tranquil space. Excellent host as she was responsive, offered recommendations and made herself available for assistance.  Highly recommend!!
Lovley setting, very helpfull owners and staff was very nice.

1STCTIME EVER RENTING AN AIR BNB AND WHEN I SAY, SHONTE'S ABNB SUPERCEDED OUR EXPECTATIONS, I MEAN JUST THAT. THE PLACE WAS BEAUTIFUL, CLEAN AND COMFORTABLE, IN A QUIET NEIGHBORHOOD. SHE DIDN'T HASSLE US ABOUT ANYTHING AND RESPONDED IN A VERY TIMELY MANOR TO ANY QUESTIONS WE MAY HAVE HAD.
I HIGHLY RECOMMEND BOOKING WITH HER 100% AS I AM DEFINITELY LOOKING FORWARD TO BOOKING WITH HER AGAIN NEXT YEAR.

We had a great stay. The location was great; close to public transport but not in a loud area of downtown. Place was clean and beds were comfortable. We would happily stay again.
This was a return visit to this lovely place. As always, the accommodations and host exceeded our expectations! Can’t wait to come back again!

We had a wonderful stay at Enrique’s place. He greeted us as soon as we came to his home, showed us around, and left us the key, and gave me his number to let him know if we need anything. The neighborhood was very nice, quiet, and parking was plentiful.
Cute place!  Very comfortable bed.  Blinds need replacing in kitchen for more privacy.  I’d definitely book again!

Had a great time in the city, made possible thanks to Nae and her beautiful home that she let us stay in while we visited. Thank you!

One of the nicest hostels I have stayed in! Host was very kind and welcoming. There was plenty of parking available. The home is within walking distance of the red line and some bus stops. The location was convenient and the hosts were lovely! Thank. You so much for a great weekend.

Stayed at Freddy’s place while a group of us played golf around the city. Finding parking was much easier than expected and the flat was clean and had everything needed for our stay, which was a shower and comfortable beds! Would not hesitate to stay here again.

Everything was amazing for our first time in Chicago. The parking was a challenge given that you have to hope to get something close by.

Aaron’s place was perfect for a short trip. The location is fantastic with plenty of things within walking distance. Check in and out were seamless and easy.
I am extremely happy we found Bernadette's place!  She was wonderful throughout our stay!

Would highly recommend & would definitely stay again.
I critique is it was hot in the house despite air conditioner cranked. I guess expected in old home w tall ceilings & windows. We loved this studio! So clean and spacious. Great neighborhood. I have already shared the link with friends so they can stay there on their next trip to Chicago!

Convenient location. Good value for the price. Secure parking a huge plus. Unique building.

Overall a good stay, the two car garage space was incredible to have. The balconies and rooftop were great. Beds were comfy. Great location,  good quiet neighborhood.  close to downtown and freeway.

Die Unterkunft von Nelson entsprach exakt der Beschreibung und somit passt Preis-Leistung meiner Meinung nach vollkommen - besonders in einer teuren Stadt wie Chicago. Wer nur zum Schlafen eine Bleibe sucht, ist hier genau richtig.

Manchmal gibt es Wartezeiten von 5-10 Minuten beim Badezimmer, aber das hat nicht weiter gestört.

Das Zimmer ist meiner Meinung nach gut schallisoliert, die angrenzende Straße hört man nicht. Auch die anderen Bewohner:innen haben wir nicht gehört.
Hab super nette Bekanntschaften geschlossen - unter anderem mit den beiden Langzeitmietern :) Gerne wieder!

Richard was an Amazing host, we felt right at home 🏠 day 1. His hospitality was stellar, if we had questions or concerns of any sort he was very accommodating. His place has such a serene and peaceful atmosphere. We will truly be staying here on our next visit to Chicago! 💯

Great apartment with classic Lakeview feel, close to great restaurants, transportation, and Wrigley. The kitchen was very well-appointed with basics and cooking supplies, and the host even left some pop and popsicles in the fridge for us as a welcome gift! The only air conditioners are in the bedrooms, it’s true, but even on super hot days the ceiling fan was enough to keep the living room mostly comfortable. Would definitely stay again.

While we had some struggles with the code being incorrect, the hot water and AC not working properly due to a switch being flipped, Eric was very responsive and able to help us make corrections to fix the problems quickly. The apartment is beautiful and was very clean. One area for improvement would be to include shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. While I don’t think it was advertised as being provided, we were not prepared and had to go buy some. Clean up expectations upon check out were easy and reasonable. The apartment is near the White Sox stadium and a fire station so there were  some fireworks and the occasional siren that went off at night, but my family did not find this to be an issue.
Innocencia was a very responsive host and was quick to help with the minor issues we had upon check in. Would come back when visiting Chicago any time.

The Airbnb was spotless, spacious, and private. If you are visiting Chicago, this is the best Airbnb you will ever find. It has everything you need and it is conveniently located close to everything while still getting the peaceful neighborhood vibe. We absolutely loved our stay and we would stay here again every time.
great
This was a great place to stay. Great location, really responsive hosts, and immaculately clean.  Would definitely recommend.

This was good enough for what I needed - a place to sleep. However, I think the bedroom could use some updating. The pillows were really flat. Appreciated the box fan though! Also, was super close to a cute coffee shop called The First Sip.

We loved this location and had a great weekend! Super great neighborhood and a free private parking space made things easy. Instructions and house rules were easy to find and follow.  The bedrooms and beds were comfortable. We loved this place and would gladly stay here again.

This was a great find for our trip to Chicago and the perfect place for our party of 5. Home was clean and located on a nice quiet street. I would definitely come back to stay here when back in Chicago.

A great place to stay—pleasant area and quick walking access to downtown activities.
Great stay, plenty of room with 3 bedrooms and living space to spread out. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook a meal. Everything was clean and as described.
Clean place in great location.  Can’t wait to come back!

Nice place. Responsive host. Nice being able to park car in garage in the back. We ride shared (Uber and Lyft) to the Riverwalk and Millennium Park. Felt very safe.
Would recommend and would stay here again.

Overall fine place to sleep and shower for a quick weekend.

it was a very convenient, clean, nice space, and Daniel was responsive and helpful.

We enjoyed our weekend here. The area is great if you want to be near main chicago downtown but not stuck in traffic. The place was very homey as well. Had anything you needed in case you forgot something. Very beautiful place!
