We had an amazing stay! 10/10, definitely would book again 😁 Our accommodation were met and everything was easy to navigate!
Location was absolutely perfect. Short walk to the lake, restaurants and train. Place was clean and inviting.

The AirBnB was exactly as advertised. Very spacious for our group of 5, and convenient location walking distance to the Metro station. Even has some great local food spots a few blocks away. For light sleepers, keep in mind that the unit is the bottom floor of a house, so you may hear a dog bark on occasion (rare) and the train tracks aren't far from the backyard, so you can hear the train passing by into the evening/morning. For our group, it wasn't a big deal, since we usually didn't hear anything when we were sleeping or woke up in the morning. Entering the building was pretty standard, and while entering the second door took us a bit with the lock system, once we understood how it worked, it was a breeze. Blanca was responsive with our questions and gave clear instructions on check in & check out. A/C worked great for a summer day in Chicago. No complaints!

Was "ok" for the price - but could use a refresh in a few areas. The second bedroom, was a very small room under the stairs. The twin bed in 2nd bedroom  was so hard it was almost un-useable. The HVAC unit that has been added recently is so loud when it kicks on, that you have to turn the volume on the TV from 8 or 9 to 48 to hear anything. Ridiculously loud unit. Larger bedroom full or Queen (maybe?) was too soft and old... lumpy.  Both bedrooms need new beds. There was exactly 1 medium towel for each of us (2 people) and one (1) hand towel in the bathroom for the entire 4 day stay. The towels, sheets, pillow cases and pillows need replaced. They were old, stained, almost thread-bare on the pillow cases. No kitchen hand towels, or dish towels either. Just bare bones minimum of everything. ( side note: the stairs leading up to the apartment need pressure washed and painted. It looks like it hasn't been taken care of in a long time.) I would not stay here again.

My kiddos and I have had many AirBnb stays over the years, and this gem of an apartment is easily in our top 5.  Very clean, exactly as described - no surprises.  Beds, bedding, and pillow were very comfortable; living room furniture was so comfortable I asked the hosts where they got the set.  I was initially skeptical about being able to find street parking, but we were in and out at least a couple of times every day and we always found a space - often right in front of the apartment but in any case the longest walk we had was 30 seconds.  : ) The hosts were kind and responsive and very helpful.  Staying here was easy and comfortable.  My kids and I felt right at home and we would stay here again any time.

Cute apartment in great location. Dennis was very responsive and the apt was close to restaurants & bars. Walking distance to workout studios, shopping and coffee shops. We would definitely stay here on another visit.

I enjoyed my time in Chicago, and the stay was nice for the weekend. The home had the essentials I needed, and the host’s communication made everything simple and convenient. Thank you for the warm hospitality.

Nala and Owen’s apartment was just as it was described. Great location, in walking distance to alot of places, restaurants, bars and local shops. Definitely enjoyed our stay and look forward to coming back.

Great place for our family to stay for two weeks while we explored Chicago. Easy to cook in the kitchen and we are a single family so having one shower was no issue. Clean and had everything we needed. Street parking was almost always available just outside and only once had to park a block away. Train noise is a hum in the background and it didn’t bother us. The location is great to get to train station to get around as well. Lots of great restaurants and coffee shops and multiple grocery stores nearby.
We had hoped to use the roof top but that is not as kept up so if that is a deciding factor perhaps look elsewhere.
Great stay
Great host and great location! Check out was a breeze.

The place was in a great location and Mr. Frank was a very helpful and responsive. The neighborhood was calm and safe and it had so many shops close by. I would definitely stay at Mr. Francs place if I visit Chicago again!

Close to the rails and the United Center is right there.
Fantastic all around
Larissa was a gracious host. We had everything we needed. The location was perfect for all of our many activities.
Daniel’s place was neat and clean! It was located in a nice and quiet and safe neighborhood. We felt right at home! We definitely recommend this place!
Mia was very helpful and the house is in a great location to walk to places on Milwaukee.
This was a great day! Affordable and exactly as described. I loved the neighborhood, lots of interesting things to do. Thanks😊

The team was very responsive and offered great direction.  The space was as advertised, clean and cozy.   A great place to put your head down for a few nights in a great location.   Noise was not overly concerning.  AC units were helpful with keeping cool during hot summer nights and muffling the noise.   A great value for the location.

Justin‘s place is exactly like described and it is clean! It’s in a great community with easy walks to the train and lots of good restaurants. Super close to Wrigley Stadium !! The parking garage made it easy to park and leave the car for the weekend. I would highly recommend.

This place was very clean & had great comfortable beds. However, the listing stated 8 beds, there are only 6 beds here. Unless you want to count the two 4 foot long futons, which the host apparently counts as being a “bed.” They provide air mattresses, but again, I don’t AirBnb would approve of them listing that as a “bed.” When we arrived, the air conditioning was not working at all, but in the hosts defense, they were able to get it fixed within 24 hours of arrival. The backyard also has little to no privacy. Overall, our experience here was not great & I would not recommend this location to anyone. But, if you’re in a pinch & you have less than 6 people, it’s not a bad place to stay, given the AC works.

Our group had an amazing stay at Brandon’s place! He was very responsive and helpful which we appreciated. The location is nice for getting to Lakeview and Wrigley! While we did have to sleep many people on cots - they were fairly comfortable.
Would stay here again!

I booked this location based on the reviews of others. It was definitely worth the price and served our purpose of a weekend stay. Russell and Christine were very informative, thoroughly communicated all details and responded quickly.

The hosts were very friendly and quick to respond to any questions we had, to include offering a flexible check-in time which was quite helpful.
The biggest issues were cleanliness and missing basic necessities. There was visible mold and mildew around the bathtub and in the grout, which made the bathroom feel unclean. The property did not provide any washcloths, and there was no ice available or even ice trays to make our own. Another inconvenience was the lack of mirrors in the bedrooms. Having only the bathroom mirror made it difficult for multiple people to get ready at the same time.
Another disappointment was there were no kitchen table or chairs, so there was no comfortable place to sit and eat meals.
These are relatively inexpensive issues for the host to address, but they had a noticeable impact on our stay. With better attention to cleanliness and more thoughtful stocking of basic amenities, this property could provide a much better guest experience.
Fantastic place felt like home will definitely be back soon 😊 great host 5 stars all around thanks so much....

The place was as described and worked for our needs. We stayed during a bit of a heat and humidity wave so the room was a bit warmer than we would’ve liked but they had fans and we made do. This is a basement room and the tenants above were pretty noisy, but the listing and host were very upfront with that. Super close to the L and there was good parking near the house so it met our needs as is.
he was perfect 👌 can't wait to come back ill definitely rent again

it was cute and Very clean little apartment with perfect views. The location was PRIME, you're close to the L, and everything is walkable. we didnt have to get in our vehicle until we left.
The only down side was the temperature. The vent hose for the AC would not stay connected to the windows (it was duct taped) so all the hot air blew back in. we managed, but it was definitely warm. The beds were also comfortable and the bathrooms were clean and tidy with planty of extra towels for our family of 6.

We enjoyed the location, and the loft itself was nice and looked like the listing. Unfortunately, we arrived to multiple stained towels and stained bed sheets, and there was also a noticeable odor in the room.
We contacted the host right away with photos. They acknowledged that the laundry service and cleaner should have caught the stained linens, which we appreciated. Since we were only staying two nights, we purchased our own sheets and towels rather than wait for replacements. We asked if they would reimburse us for those items or offer a partial refund for the inconvenience, but no reimbursement or compensation was provided.
The location was definitely the best part of the stay, but the cleanliness issues and lack of resolution made the experience disappointing.
Great location, apartment as described, responsive host.

Excellent place for a group of 9. Plenty of space and beds. The downstairs was a perfect area to watch some TV and hang out. Easy to walk to restaurants in the area and close to the bus which took us to the beach. All in all a great place for a bigger group!
Easy in and out in a nice neighborhood. Alley parking. Beautiful home and the downstairs suite is fantastic for a long weekend. Great value compared to hotels!
Good place to stay

We would stay here again.
It is a 3 minute walk to a CVS pharmacy and a Jewel-Osco grocery store (Safeway family).
Within walking distance, there is a nice mixture of retail stores and restaurants.
The neighborhood feels safe.
There were a lot of people walking while we were out.
We stayed in early July 2026. There is a window unit air conditioner in each of the two bedrooms. They kept the bedrooms cool. However, the rest of the apartment could get warm on hot days.
If you plan to do laundry, you need $4 in quarters for each load ($2 for washing machine plus $2 for dryer). The laundry room was out the back door and about 2 floors.
We were in town for a wedding and just needed a place to rest our head at night. This place was a good match. Overall, we had a nice stay. Great location! Tons going on right outside the door!

The place was right in Ukrainian village and a perfect place for a short getaway to the Chi! Had everything we needed to accommodate a family of 4, and great water pressure in the shower too! Place may need a little bit of TLC but overall comfortable stay.
The place was pretty cool. Close to where I needed to go. Bathrooms were clean bedrooms were clean. It’s a cute little spot. Had a garage for the vehicle as well. That was a plus.

The place was as described and very comfortable. I would stay here again. Although kitchen had lots of amenities, baking dishes would be helpful. Some of my time there was by myself and I felt very safe.
It was a nice quiet apartment close to Downtown  Chicago. I would definitely recommend staying here.
Great space! we had a really good time, lovely weather and balconies
Great hosts great location
The house was in a decent area. The walls are connected. The neighbors were quite & very respectful. The owners were very polite, helped with any issues. Also replied within a timely manner.

This was my second time staying in this beautiful apartment and I would not hesitate to stay there again. It's incredibly well-located in a walkable and charming part of Andersonville and is close to public transportation. There are many restaurants, shops and amenities nearby but the apartment is on a quiet side street with very little traffic or noise.
The apartment was cool and comfortable even during 90+ degree Chicago heat and humidity. The kitchen is well-appointed and nice for cooking. In the cool early mornings and evenings, I made good use of the table and chairs on the porch. The workspace area is private and quiet and has good broadband, a desk and comfortable chair, a door that closes, and lots of light.
Because I was staying for several weeks, the host made sure to check in regarding cleaning and fresh towels and to recommend laundry services. I did not lack for anything. A great apartment and a great host!

This was a great bargain for Chicago and a great place to rest after a long day in the city. Easy walk to good restaurants in Chinatown and public transit. We always had access to street parking and the neighborhood was quiet and nice. Would stay here again!
Very convenient for our needs in the area. Very close to the train, etc.

It’s a cozy space and comfortable for 2 adults, or 2 with a child
Amy had everything we needed.
One of the more affordable places in the area 😊
Good host, parking in the area is not very secure.
so quiet and comfortable! an easy stay, the hosts made everything clear and the home was charming and comfortable!

Robert’s place was great. We’d stay here again. He was an excellent host. The neighborhood was admittedly on the rough side, but we felt safe and secure, and the house provided an incredibly nice and private space to hang out with a large group of friends. The patio area and over-garage space were so wonderful!

The Lakeview home was in a great location and easily hosted 5 people. The space was very clean and the neighbors using the shared courtyard were friendly and welcoming! Nini was very communicative and answered all questions we had throughout our stay.
would book here again!!
Great place, glad I stayed here!

A hospedagem foi ótima de uma forma geral : Excelente localização, a poucos metros da estação de metrô, Bairro residencial, com bom comércio nas proximidades. Apartamento bonito, moderno e muito bem equipado com eletrodomésticos.
Após nossa solicitação, o anfitrião providenciou shampu e sabonete líquido, e de ótima qualidade.
Apenas 2 pontos negativos, que pode não ser problema para outros hóspedes: O ar condicionado é controlado exclusivamente pelo anfitrião, sem possibilidade de ajuste pelos hóspedes. O apartamento permaneceu frio durante a estadia. Quando solicitado, a temperatura foi aumentada parcialmente. O anfitrião informou que o equipamento precisa permanecer ligado continuamente devido à umidade do verão. No entanto, isso compromete o conforto térmico, especialmente no banheiro, onde há uma saída de ar. O metro passa há 20 metros da janela da sala, que pode atrapalhar o sono de quem dormir naquele cômodo. Eu me hospedaria novamente nesse Ap.
Cool unique spot, easy to find parking. If you are into weird and retro vibe this is a neat spot for you.
Clean and great stay.
This location is in Boystown, and is known as the gay strip part of Chicago. I loved the bustling nightlife, but it can be a bit loud; earplugs were made available, and I’d bring an eye mask!

What a fantastic spot to call home for a long weekend. In the heart of everything, minutes from some of the best shopping anywhere, a quick walk over to Oak St. Beach to enjoy the lake, more restaurants and coffee shops then you could possibly want, all while nestled in beautiful tree lined surroundings with classic Chicago architecture.
Highly recommended - thanks again!

I hate to leave a negative review but unfortunately, this property was not fully functional during our stay. One of the bedrooms, the bathroom, hallway, and several kitchen outlets were without power. The window AC units in two bedrooms worked adequately, but the third bedroom and the rest of the apartment stayed around 80°F due to lack of power. The bathroom was completely dark, one bedroom was unusable, etc.
The host was polite and tried to help, including sending small clip-on desk fans eventually but the electrical problem was not repaired and the fans were not useful without working outlets or extension cords. I The host offered 30% of the room rate, which is consistent with Airbnb policy, but excludes fees and taxes and did not fairly reflect the actual loss of use and disruption realistically. Based on this experience, I would not stay here again.
Other than that, the property would have been fine and met our needs. This was unfortunate lack of resolution.
Excellent communication & responsiveness during our special celebration weekend! She went above & beyond to meet our needs. Could not have asked for a better place or host!
We had a great experience staying at John’s place. It was very comfortable, clean, conveniently located, close to downtown. Would definitely recommend it!
Loved the location and the unit itself   So convenient to many things   I will be back!
Accurate description and convenient location

The host cancelled on me just a few hours before check in due to bed bugs?? Not sure how true that was I felt like she kinda scammed  me and knew she was going to cancel my reservation just by our conversations and her giving me robot responses. To say the least the process was a nightmare

I never had an airbnb experience like this before. For the price, I don’t think this place is worth it. The pictures shown appear to be similar but the apartment was different.
Pros:
-bed was comfortable
-neighborhood is in a good location
-transportation is easily accessible
Cons:
-had to walk up 4 flights of stairs our whole stay (elevators are not working so if you’re disabled or have any health issues that will be affected by this don’t book)
-airbnb was not cleaned properly (stains on table, mirrors were dirty and not wiped, bathtub was also unclean with hair)
-there was a hole in the wall of the bedroom (appears that someone had fell into the wall)
-shower handles were leaking and the handle to adjust the hot temperature burned us every time because it is metal
-no cleaning supplies or extra trash bags for the bathroom
-dishwasher smells TERRIBLE
-My guest and I were told to send our IDs which isn’t in the description and they didn’t give us their full name when asked
Great location and spot!

Overall was great.
Location was incredible. Space was perfect for us.
Only draw back was the water pressure in the shower was very low and the shower size was incredibly small.
Everything else was great.
This space is great for a small group looking to walk to a lot of Chicago attractions! The layout is really unique and different groups can have their own space to relax
This place had plenty of room and was in a perfect location.

The space truly felt like a home away from home. The place was well thought out and hence, it was very functional yet cosy. A wonderful location, very close to everything that mattered. The host was very very responsive and that was definitely a plus. I will pick it again the next time I visit.

Marilyn’s was super sweet and super responsive and so helpful with all the questions I had while our trip to Chicago! Totally would book with her again and her cute little home if we’re ever in Chicago again!! 😊
The place was lovely and Holly was so friendly and helpful. She gave us recommendations and even a beach bag that made our stay extra fun for the kids. Would definitely stay here again!

It felt like home. Though I think my old dog liked more. Not often she can be outside and just lay in grass. She and us enjoyed spending time outside. And now my dad is on a mission to get a projector for the house. Overall just awesome!

The host was clear with their check in instructions and gave us all the codes we needed. It was unclear which door to enter from so we had a little trouble finding our specific room. I didn’t realize this was only a room and not an entire house as that portion was not well advertised. It was unclear if we were welcome to use the common spaces in the house. Other than that, it worked for a weekend stay. Close to food spots and a short Uber to downtown. I parked on the street and it felt like a safe neighborhood/had no issues with my car parked on the street.

Super flexible with check in time (offering us an early check in without asking). Place was easy to find in a quiet neighborhood and easy access to get in. Upstairs can get a little hot but the AC units up there cools it fast. Also very accessible to public transportation lines as well. Overall we enjoyed our stay and felt at home.
This is a wonderful hideaway in Chicago
Great spot, great host!

Snap this place up if you can! It's a truly excellent location from which to explore Chicago, especially if you don't find anything suitable nearer the Loop or you don't want to pay the higher prices of that area. You'll be staying in a historic neighborhood full of character, and you'll get to wherever you need to go in Chicago within 15 to 30 minutes. The apartment is very spacious, with all the conveniences and amenities one can need, and is full of charm. Darius is a truly caring and attentive host. Very highly recommended!

Our stay was comfortable, there were minor things that stood out, but nothing worth nitpicking or complaining over. Joseph was a very kind host, he was responsive, and he was very informative prior to my booking and continued to be helpful throughout our stay. He has some really sweet neighbors, and the neighborhood is very peaceful as well. We enjoyed our stay, looking forward to booking again.

Good location! Well equipped kitchen, just a couple of stove burners were not working, but not an issue to not enjoy our stay. Smooth communication with the host! We would  consider staying there again.

Cesar & Maria are some of the best hosts I’ve ever had. They are extremely accommodating and their home has everything you’d need. The home itself was spectacular. We had a group of 8 and still felt like we had plenty of space. If you’re looking for a spot outside of the hustle and bustle of downtown but still within a reasonable commute, look no further. I would recommend this to anyone staying in the area

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago in Johanna’s beautiful home. The place was immaculate, thoughtfully stocked with plenty of amenities, and very comfortable throughout.  Excellent location in a lovely and very walkable neighborhood. Johanna was very responsive and helpful whenever we had a question. Everything was exactly as described, and the attention to detail made the stay especially easy and enjoyable. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to others.
Great Location!
Bigger than expected.

We’re on our way home right now relaxed after one of the best weekends in Chicago. The location is perfect to access downtown in quick uber ride and wake up in the peaceful burbs, greeted by green trees. The townhouse is just as advertised. It was SUPER CLEAN. The decor really made it feel warm and inviting like a home. The bedrooms were larger than expected as well as the living room and the sectional! If you have a baby with you (we didn’t) they have tons of baby equipment! We didn’t hear any neighbors, very quiet neighborhood. Plenty of parking right outside the front door. It was perfect for my husband, me, our son and his girlfriend❤️ The owners were always quick to respond and very friendly, clear, communicators. Even the check in/out instructions, super clear and easy! Oh, and a FANTASTIC VALUE!!
Excellent stay! The place is super clean, AC window units worked great during a hot weekend, neighbors are not noisy, street parking was reasonable. Planning to stay again :)

I absolutely loved the property and enjoyed our stay. Easy check-in process. Host was very responsive but we didn't have any issues at all. The home was just outside the city but central to everything we wanted to do during our stay. Loved it and will book again when we come back!! Awesome experience overall.

The location itself was nice and the parking was great, but the upstairs and downstairs folks were very loud throughout the night. We found out halfway through our stay that the 1st floor is some sort of event space, so there was loud music and shouting until midnight when it abruptly shut off. The upstairs people also were really loud around  3am-5am one night. Suffice to say, you’ll hear most of what’s going on. The room itself was very nice though, and using public transit from here was great!

Thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Ross’s Airbnb! Traveling with toddler age children is always stressful but Ross went above and beyond to make our stay easy and comfortable. He was able to accommodate an early check-in and was always quick to respond for anything we needed.
The unit is well stocked with quality cookware, utensils and everything needed for a stay. The neighborhood walkability was great to many restaurants, coffee shops and even a local playground. The elevator in the building was incredibly helpful toting all of our luggage and essentials to the top floor. One of the highlights of our trip was enjoying the roof deck patio and the sunset scenic views of the Chicago skyline.
We would gladly come back to this Airbnb again. Thanks for hosting us! Cheers!
First of all Noemi was awesome as a host, she was quick to respond about any questions or issues we had. The place was quiet and clean!
muy bueno y relajante para descansar

Loved staying here! The place was spotless and well-maintained, exactly as pictured. Great location in Pilsen with tons of amazing restaurants within walking distance, El Mezquite was a favorite. The host was super responsive and quick to answer any questions we had throughout our stay. Would definitely book again!

Lara’s place was perfect for our visit to our old home of Chicago. Brightly lit with skylights but with bed rooms dark enough to escape the light. A full kitchen with water, coffee, and tea provided. Easily  walkable to transit that offers access to the city. We took the L all the way up to Wrigley for the John Mulaney concert with very little walking involved. We would definitely consider staying there again on our next visit.
Clean, comfortable, quiet, convenient location if  you want to be in that area, a few blocks from the L.

We had an excellent stay at this Airbnb for my brother’s bachelor party. The location was perfect and made it easy to get around and enjoy the city. The house was beautiful, clean, and exactly as advertised.
The rooms were spacious, with plenty of space for everyone to relax without feeling crowded. The common areas were also large, which made it a great place for our group to spend time together.
The host provided a smooth check in process and everything we needed. We would gladly stay here again and would recommend this property to anyone visiting the area, especially larger groups.
Great host, great place!
Très bien situé, confortable et conforme à la description, je recommande !
Alfredo’s place was clean, and he was super friendly and quick to respond to any questions we had.

The place was accurately pictured and a safe walk to the United Center with kids. My only complaint is that if you have a Tahoe or bigger vehicle, the private parking is very tight and we wouldn’t have fit if all apartments were booked with guests who drove. I understand there may be street parking but I paid more for this rental because of the private parking. We also had a couple of issues with housekeeping but let the owner know so hopefully those are addressed for future visitors.

Nancy was really thoughtful and communicative. She helped make our stay memorable and added to our celebration. We enjoyed the space and felt at home. Parking in the area was easy and having a driveway made it even better. The in-room AC units worked great and kept the sleeping areas cool.
Great
Very great host.
This was the perfect place and location. We celebrated a friends birthday and we were in walking distance of several restaurants.  The place was clean and exactly what we were looking for.
It was a nice to place to be, you are walking distance to nearly everything the city has to offer. The place was clean, cozy and overall great.

Beautifully renovated condo with ton of natural light and everything you need for either a short or long term stay.
Julie was an amazing host and I look forward to staying there again when I’m back in Chicago.

This apartment was convenient and pleasant during our stay in Chicago. Entry and exit were easy, the place was clean and spacious, and the kitchen was well equipped. It wasn't the most "home-y" place I've stayed, and felt more like a hotel than someone's home, but for my purposes, it was absolutely fine.
Rida’s place was great for what we needed — a place to end and start the day.

Simiao was an incredibly responsive and hospitable host throughout our extended stay. She went above and beyond to help my mom and mother-in-law, who were visiting the U.S. for the first time and only speak Mandarin, feel comfortable and enjoy their experience.
She recommended places to visit in the neighborhood, showed them how to use the laundry, and even created a step-by-step instructional video in Mandarin for them. Whenever we needed extra supplies, she had them ready for us right away.
Her thoughtfulness and kindness made our stay even more enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again on our next visit.
Great place, reasonable rules, perfect location. Just one very minor complaints: toilet paper was cheapy, so bring your own. Otherwise a great stay. Definitely recommend.
Beautiful home, great neighborhood with a great location. Tons of stuff to do around and an easy drive into the city. Ute was a great host very responsive. I’d stay here again.
Had a amazing time will stay again 💚💚💚

Kyriako’s place is exactly as pictured, very beautiful home. It was lovely being guests for them. They are very communicative. If you need anything, they respond promptly. As they recommend for parking, read the signs thoroughly because you don’t have to pay for parking on the street as long as you know when to move your car, which was a good thing.
Extremely communicative and a perfect place for 3 people! Great location and would absolutely stay here again!
Had a great stay! Perfect spot for my needs on a short weekend trip.
Comfortable place to stay with easy access to tourism locations. Good value

I stayed here over my birthday weekend with a couple friends, and it was so so amazing. The house is beautiful, we had such a lovely time just hanging out upstairs and outside by the fire pit, and there were also so many cafes/restaurants to explore nearby! Christina was so accommodating with a special request I had while booking (which she didn’t have to be!), and a very warm host in general :)

We had a delightful stay at Wendy's place! Spacious, well appointed, and convenient to multiple fun neighborhoods on Chicago's northside. The bed was comfortable and the shower amazing, just as other reviews noted. I'd stay here again.
The apartment was well located just a short walk to the L -Train. check in was easy direction’s clear. Apartment provided everything we need plus the addition of coffee available with the machine .
Loved the house , super comfortable.
Cynthia & Thomas’s place was great! I would stay here again if it’s available next time we come back!

This was a great house for our group of 4. A perfect location and a huge perk of include free dedicated parking! Grace was super responsive to questions and check-in and check-out was a breeze. I highly recommend this stay for someone looking to be close to the action of Wrigley Field.

My wife and I have stayed in many Airbnb properties in Ukrainian Village since 2011. This was easily our worst experience. The entry hallway was dirty and cluttered, creating a poor first impression. While the bedrooms, bathroom, and kitchen were clean, the apartment itself felt dark, worn, and cheaply furnished. The sofa and chairs were heavily stained, several blinds were broken, and the kitchen was poorly equipped with mismatched glasses, basic appliances, and inexpensive utensils. At about $400 per night, including fees and taxes, we expected a well-maintained, comfortably furnished rental. Instead, it felt like a budget accommodation priced as a premium property. We booked only because our preferred rentals were unavailable. In hindsight, we would have been better off staying in a hotel. I would not stay here again or recommend it.

We enjoyed our stay at Millan’s Airbnb. The place is close to bus stops, train stations, convenience stores, etc.
The apartment also has everything you need: water, WiFi, a kitchen, A/C.
Next time we come back to Chicago we would like to stay at this Airbnb again :)
I loved the place, nice clean, not too far from attractions
Place did not look like the picture. Place is full of bugs
Our stay was great. Near the Brownline which made it easy to get downtown. Enjoyed our stay and would stay again.

The airbnb itself is exactly like the pictures and is very clean. Check in instructions are quite clear and the host is very responsive. The only 2 issues we faced were very noisy upstairs neighbors and you can hear them walking throughout the day and night. The noise insulation for sounds from the outside is also pretty bad which affects your sleep given the apartment is at ground level.
The other aspect being the neighborhood itself is a bit sketchy at night and you randomly see groups of men shouting and acting aggressively as soon as the sun is down.

Hunter was super communicative before and during our stay. We had a lovely time everything was clean and handled with care. There were a ton of toys for my little one to play with too! We felt right at home!

The host was really thorough and polite and he offered instructions and guidance very quickly. The place was quiet and clean and we slept well. Very chill spot. Cute decorations. I wouid book here again. Thank you Valeriy!

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience was extremely disappointing from start to finish.
I booked this Airbnb two months in advance, and my reservation was fully paid more than a month before my stay. Despite that, I did not receive any check-in instructions until around 12:00 a.m. on the day of my arrival. I had already informed the host that I planned to check in at 3:00 p.m., which is the advertised check-in time.
At 3:00 p.m., instead of receiving check-in information, I received a message stating that the unit would not be ready on time. While the host apologized, there was no offer of compensation or any effort to make up for the inconvenience. We arrived at approximately 4:20 p.m. and found that the unit was still being cleaned. We had to leave and find somewhere else to spend our time until it was finally ready.
Once we were able to enter the unit, we discovered there was no Wi-Fi. This was one of the biggest issues with our stay. The listing does not clearly d
Loved our stay! Everything was seamless.

Location is great with just a short walk to the lake. In walking distance from a grocery store, coffee shops, restaurants, and the L. It is an older apartment, but it is clean. Great hosts who were responsive when we needed something.
Thank you!!!
Favorite this Space! I will definitely return! Perfect location!

Brandon and his team were responsive, kind and accurate leading up and throughout our stay. The house was perfect for our group of 12 and even had the best air mattress we'd ever slept on! Highly recommend. Thank you Brandon!

This place was great for a bachelorette weekend! Very spacious for our group of 9 and then 10 the next night. The deck was amazing to relax on in the mornings. The host was very responsive and even helped us get parking passes when we realized we had more cars than what could fit the driveway. 100% recommendation this house to groups!
Great time, and good base camp for the weekend in Chicago.

Greatly enjoyed our stay! Place was perfect, neighborhood was quiet and we were a very short walk from the “L”. I was worried about parking but it turned out to be a breeze. Hugh was proactive, responsive and made check-in and out seamless. We will be back!
Adam was the best. Very responsive and helpful.   the accommodations were very clean and all amenities were plentiful,  clean and easy to access.

Cool place. Lots of collectibles and interior decoration charms. Attentive host. On street free Parking is available in front of house.  Nice bidet. Apt is in the bottom level of a Tri-story home below grade.
Very nice stay, place was clean, as described, John was very responsive. Maybe the full beds in one room were a bit smaller for 2 people to sleep but he got us an extra air mattress upon request.
Super reliable and convenient place to stay at my travels.
We had time of our lives with great memories.  Thank you for hosting us
Stunning view!  Clean and great location!

Vin’s place was very nice and spacious for 2 people. It was such a cute place and never once did i feel nervous getting in. Parking on the street is limited, however there’s a parking lot in the back (park on the left , the spots with no #’s). Beautiful place, great place, and close to tourist attractions!

The reason for the poor review is simple, it stated 2 beds and the is only one. That couch is tiny and covered in stains. I wouldn’t put any person on it to sit, let alone sleep. I had to book a nearby hotel for my entire trip and was unable to use this place for anything more than a shower one time.
Great location
Great location with great hosts! Plenty of space for either big families or a large group like ours.
Would definitely recommend staying with Alma! We will do it again when we come. The Airbnb was in a great location and was clean.

Overall, our stay had both pros and cons. The Airbnb looked just like the photos, with updated appliances and a very spacious layout. The home was bright and beautiful, especially in the morning.
However, there were a few issues. We had to use a lot of stairs at the back of the building to access the property, which wasn't expected. The house became very warm during the day because there were no curtains on the windows. There were also quite a few flies throughout the house in every room. Some bedrooms did not have working lights, and most of the ceiling fans were not functioning.
Despite these issues, we still had a good stay and made the best of our time there.
We really enjoyed our stay at this rental. The place was very clean and spacious. The neighborhood is wonderful, and the parking space was a nice perk. Would definitely stay here again!
Great property, and upbeat neighborhood with nice surroundings.
Location is so ideal - had an amazing time. I host 7 ladies for a bachelorette party and it was the best place to have a party!
Great place to stay for a large group! Fun basement to hang out with lots of space. Thank you!

Bring extra towels as they only supply enough for one person. Only one washcloth. Should be extra towels in the hot tub room. Be careful on floor in hot tub room, it is slippery and should have some anti slip mats down. No interactions in the hot tub room on how to use it, Leave the blue hose in the tub. Hot tub wasn't very clean either. All cleaning supplies left out in the open in the kitchen. Only one sheet on the bed so you might want to bring you an extra unless you want to fight over it. Only 2 pillows in the whole house and no extra blankets. Rear deck looks like it is going to fall off the house and needs addressed. Don't walk out back without shoes on, a bunch of broken glass that was everywhere. Overall it was a good location to get to the white sox game but needs some issues addressed before I would stay there again.
Great centrally located spot. Would absolutely stay here again. Thanks!
Our stay was fantastic. Krysztof was a delightful host and took care of all our needs. The house is wonderful and the backyard and garden are gorgeous. We really appreciated staying here.
Nice, clean, and well-appointed space. Walkable neighborhood, close to transit and plenty of restaurants, shops, bar close by. Definitely recommend
enjoyed our stay at the 747 Lofts.  it was right next to the blue line and easy access to the city
Cozy, clean and convenient.

We enjoyed our stay. Peaceful location and attentive host. Very spacious and clean. We drove here, I recommend using a uber if you’re not used to city traffic.Location is close to downtown. We’d love to stay here again. Chicago is Beautiful!!

The place was exactly as described. Clean, bright, spacious. There is an echo because of the high ceilings but it feels so big and open because of them. We loved this place and we were grateful for the dedicated parking. The host was also very responsive.

I had a very pleasant stay with Jane and her husband Joe, who were both so friendly. Jane was responsive to all of my questions and accommodating to my nighttime arrival because of a delayed flight. The room was cozy and cool thanks to the A/C, while the bathroom was clean and had anything I needed. The neighborhood felt safe and convenient to get to via public transit. I definitely recommend this place for anyone needing somewhere to stay in Chicago.

Definitely enjoyed my stay and exploring the neighborhood. Lots to do and easy to get around. Just a little noisy with all the traffic and people especially on weekends but otherwise a comfy room to stay in for a casual trip into town.

The place was clean,  nicely decorated and in a great neighborhood. The only issue was the road was too busy and loud. If you are a light sleeper this is not for you. Other than that I enjoyed my stay.

I stayed here for 2+ months, from April thru July 2026. Overall, I give it a 4.5 (rounded to 5).
The Pros:
*Location: Solid neighborhood with great restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and activities within walking distance. The Blue Line stop is about 10 minutes away.
*Responsiveness: Martin was responsive to any issues and proactively checked in to make sure things were going well.
*Cleanliness: The place was very clean at move-in.
The Cons / Things to Consider:
*No Dishwasher: This caught me off guard, as I didn't think to check. I cooked a lot less than usual (and spent a lot more than expected as a result).
*Charges: They list a lot of charges, e.g., dishes in the sink, forgetting to take out the garbage, dog hair (in a dog-friendly apartment?), etc. Thankfully, I didn't get hit with any, but I didn't like the prospect of additional fees after a pricey long stay.
All said, it served its need as temp housing. Martin was a good host and I would recommend to future guests.

Michael's place is everything he describes and more. The unique touches he adds makes the stay exciting. He goes above and beyond to make sure you feel welcomed and at home. The home is exactly as described with everything seeming to be brand new. The instructions he gives are very detailed making finding the place and entry super easy. The place is spacious and had everything we needed and more to enjoy our stay. We enjoyed staying up late playing all of the games. The neighborhood is nice and everyone was friendly. With the temperatures in the 90s the central air made our stay comfortable. Check out was easy as he is really laid back and does not require much. He even sent a text to check on us and see if we needed anything during the stay. We will definitely stay here again when we visit Chicago. Skip the hotels and book with Michael.

I can't praise this property or the location more highly. Bel was an amazing host and the house was just perfect in a nice quiet and safe neighborhood.
I had the best stay and felt right at home as soon as I walked through the front door. Couldn't recommend this place more highly - if you are looking to stay in Chicago then you should definitely book here.

Sentral is a hotel and apartment complex mix so it was cool but had some interesting quirks
Pros: perfect location right next to Grant Park and a Divvy bike station; spacious rooms; pool and shared hangout spaces were beautiful
Cons: there were some stains on the carpets and towels but they were clean so not terrible; a dirty towel was left in one of the bathrooms; there were no dish towels;
Not a con but just a quirk: there are no games available in the room and their game center doesn’t have games you could very easily take back to your room if that’s even an option; their in-room coffee making machine is weird and we couldn’t easily find refillables
Excelent stay!
Fantastic!
This was a lovely place to stay in a quiet peaceful neighborhood. It is close to the subway and has parks nearby. The apartment was clean and large!
Great host!

The Loft is a great home base for my time in Chicago. Very convenient to the neighborhood amenities and public transportation. The interior is stylish, functional and homey all at once. Wesley s is an excellent and responsive host. I hope to start here my next time in Chicago!

The apartment was just as nice as the pictures showed. It had everything we needed, including TVs, cookware, and other essentials. I would definitely stay here again. The only downside is that the building doesn’t have an elevator, so you’ll need to carry your luggage up the stairs. That’s a building issue rather than the apartment itself, but you’ll definitely get some extra exercise.

I personally found the place to be very clean, and well organized (Virgo speaking here). It has very comfortable beds and furniture. There are wallpapers and paintings of Leopards and Tigers in the bedrooms if you’re into that. My friend wanted the place for her birthday partly because of the Art Deco as well as the Heron painting and the big cats.
The only downsides would be nitpicking. You are in a downstairs unit so occasionally you’ll hear footsteps above. Also it can be cold for some. Which I was fine with the temperature. But my friend wanted it warmer otherwise I’d have left this out.
Definitely recommend it to others.

This is a beautiful unit just like the photos. Location is beyond my expectation. Walkable to everywhere. Big grocery store is nearby, makes the upgraded kitchen area even more valuable. 100% recommend to those who’s visiting Chicago downtown.
Located close to public transport, felt very safe having the fence and keypad on the door. Relatively quiet neighbourhood & was super easy to come and go anytime we wanted!

Directions to find the lock box wasn’t 100% clear. Had to try a few lock boxes before locating the right one.
The main issue with the unit is the creaky floors and the upstairs neighbors who seem to walk around what seems to be all sorts of hours. 1 am, 4 am, 5am. The other issue, but less of an annoyance, is the lack of parking. The area is very congested, and finding parking can be difficult.
Very stylish, clean, and accessible condo.  Private parking garage is a very nice bonus.  Stocked with essentials.  Quiet building neighbors.  Enjoyed our stay!
Great location

This is the second time we stayed here. After the first time, Danny's place met all our needs so well we tried to make sure we booked it again for our next visit.
It is clean, roomy, and comfortable.
It has all the amenities anyone could want.
You can't beat the location.
It has its own parking spot which is great for when our son, who lives in Chicago, drives over to visit.
Danny responds to any question almost immediately.
Better than five stars.
Decent place but make sure to check the location before booking it’s in a pretty sketchy area

While this location is super affordable for someone who is looking for a temporary stay while in Chicago, I wouldn’t let my dog stay here. There was a terrible order in the entire home, the mattress was filthy, the bathroom sink and tub had so much hair all over the place. The guest was so loud and kept trying to enter my space. As someone who travels for a living and has stay in multiple Airbnbs, this was this worst so far. However one thing I will say the host replied very well and often. I just pray they do a throughly cleaning and cleansing of this location.

Exactly met our family’s needs while I attended a conference at IMSI/UChicago.  (Location is only one block from IMSI!) Spacious, clean, lots of natural light upstairs, convenient laundry, and comfortable beds. At a cooler time of year, I also would have loved to sit out on the back deck. We would absolutely stay here again.

it was wonderful! the place is super cute and cozy. the only thing is the elevator in the building doesn’t work and the unit is on the fourth floor. it didn’t bother me but might be something to keep in mind.
Great location, great communication and a friendly building. So close to everything and very safe. The property had everything we needed and Michael was very responsive
Comfortable home with plenty of space and a comfy atmosphere.  Junni was easily reachable, proactive, and a good host.

Carlo's place was perfect for our short stay. The neighborhood was nice, felt safe, and was quiet at night. The bed was very comfy, and it was great to be able to do laundry while we were there. Carlo was a helpful and responsive host. Would stay here again!
Loved our stay. Perfect location with tons to explore
Nicholas place was very spacious,clean and friendly really enjoyed my stay here in southside Chicago would recommend anyone to stay here. Thanks Nick And Ms. Lynn
Super nice and cozy place to stay with a couple friends/family. Couple blocks away from a target to get some things. A couple good restaurants walking distance too.
great place!

Great spot that was like a second home for our little family. Clean, safe and easy to find with everything we needed for a week away including in unit laundry. Already looking forward to our next visit.

Loved our stay here! Had everything we needed. Bed was comfy, shower was hot, ac was cold, kitchen had coffee!
Brett was kind and communicative and the neighborhood was awesome!
Would absolutely recommend!

Very nice place. Me and my family had plenty of room, we were comfortable and this was very simple and easy. I loved the champagne gift James left for us. Very nice and thoughtful. No complaints and when I come back this is one place I’d definitely come back to.

The place was fairly expensive due to the fabulous rooftop with grill, outdoor kitchen, games, seating, fantastic city view. Only, we could not use any of it- rooftop entrance lock was broken, grill was broken, fridge was leaking some brown foamy stuff thru the door, etc, so we left it alone.
The first 2 days of our stay we did not have WiFi due to the previous storm. The owners organized some alternate way to get online but it did not work. We missed 2 days of Soccer World Cup games because of that. So, after 2 days of trying to reach Jacqueline (turned out she was in Europe at the time, different time zone and no one else was responding), finally the third alternate WiFi solution worked.
After that, all was good.
The apartment was on the 4th floor. There’s no elevator which we did not mind. It was comfortable for the 4 of us and a baby. It is situated in the best area of Chicago, plenty of restaurants, lots to do and see, and fun for the baby.
We had a great stay here! It was exactly as described and perfect for what we needed. Marissa was very communicative and friendly. Would love to stay here again during future visits!
The location is excellent.  I enjoyed my stay .
Was fun

My partner and I stayed here for 9 weeks in the summer. The host was very responsive to our messages and the location can’t be beat, but it wasn’t very clean when we arrived and the apartment furnishings weren’t comfortable. The internet was really spotty, which made working and watching games difficult. It would work better for short visits than long stays.
Sylvia was very helpful and responsive, the space was clean and comfortable and check in/logistics were all easy and clear! Thank you so much!

The place looked exactly like the pictures, which was a huge plus. The neighborhood was nice, and everyone we encountered was friendly. It was a great location for my family while we enjoyed the Taste of Chicago. Overall, we had a comfortable stay and would recommend it. The only downside was the traffic, which was pretty terrible and made getting around take much longer than expected. Other than that, we had a great experience.

If possible, I would rate this place even highe than allowed.  It was everything as advertised and more.  The place was spotless,  comfortable,  and a pleasure to enjoy during our stay.  It was also great to sit outside in the beautiful garden area at the end of the day.  The hosts were fantastic and extremely responsive to any question we had.  Every amenity that you could want was also available.  There are good restaurants in the area within walking distance.  I look forward to staying here again some time in the future.
Great first experience in Chicago, can’t wait to visit again !
This was a great Airbnb. Easy parking, great location.
Excelente opción para cualquier persona que visite Chicago, excedió todas las expectativas, hermoso hogar y excelentes host.
Love the place great location

We paid close to 600$ for two nights which i didn't think was bad but what we walked into wasn't the best. Street parking & if you know street parking in chicago it can be overwhelming but we managed. We then had to ask for the check in instructions because they were not received,we  went to locate our room with the room number and code given,we opened the door to a dog running up to us, there were people in this room. Immediately i was uncomfortable that i was given a code to where someone else was staying. We then told the host and communication was lacking she took a while in between texts while we were waiting and it was very frustrating given the circumstances. She then gave us a diff room number and code and there were people staying in that room as well. I felt uncomfortable to the fact that if i was on the other end and someone just walked in i would be so uncomfortable & unsafe in a area i do not know so we decided to not stay at all. Host communication was ok, we got a refund
Thank you!

The stay was absolutely exceptional. I enjoyed every aspect of my experience. The attention to detail, thoughtful amenities, and consistent communication from the host made my stay truly outstanding. I would highly recommend this property to anyone looking for a home away from home. I would gladly stay here again.
It felt so neat staying in the heart of the city.

We really enjoyed staying at Jill’s apartment! Our room and shared spaces were very clean, and her place is beautiful, cozy,  and with character. It was also very quiet throughout the day and night. We loved meeting and hanging out with Nala, who is a sweet and calm dog. The location is perfect, right next to the L Brown Line and Lincoln Ave where there’s lots of great restaurants/bars/cafés and cool stores - a great area. Thanks Jill!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was smooth, and the host was friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. My wife and our 9-year-old daughter really enjoyed the place, and it made our family trip to Chicago even more special. The location was great for exploring the city. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Keith's place was great!  The location was perfect for my needs and was close to everything I wanted to experience.  The pictures did the place justice and it looked just like it was advertised.  Also, street parking wasn't too hard to find for my rental car....I had no problems so if you plan to rent a car, rest assured that your car will be safe and you shouldn't have a problem finding a space.  Keith was also great as a host and very responsive.  I asked him for some recommendations and he responded with some very helpful info in less than 15 mins.  I highly recommend staying at his place.
Nice cozy in a nice quiet, and friendly neighborhood.

The apartment was gorgeous, very clean and in a quiet neighborhood across from a natural location. It was close to the airport right where we needed to be in the office. Space was good for work area to be set up in utilized. There wasn’t any noise around us and the neighborhood felt very safe.  The only thing I caution is that the guests would be going up three flights of stairs with no access to an elevator, which may not be good for someone with health issues carrying luggage upstairs to get to the apartment.
We had a lovely stay! Incredible location and amazing host! Everything was as expected and we loved our stay. Recommend!!!

I pick this place to stay for a few days for my birthday and this place exceeded on every level. Nice, quiet, very clean all describes this place. We love it here and will definitely stay again our next visit back. 5 stars for me

We had a wonderful stay at Noelle and Rob’s beautiful home! They are fantastic hosts who welcomed us with a thoughtful gift of wine and cookies, which was such a lovely touch. The house served as the perfect base for our whirlwind trip, making it easy to enjoy incredible food in Lincoln Square, hang out along the Riverwalk, and visit the peaceful Montrose Bird Sanctuary. Thank you both for your wonderful hospitality and fantastic memories, highly recommend staying here!

Definitely will stay with MD again! He was very helpful, responsive and respectful during our stay, the room was private and had everything we needed, The apartment was super close to the beach , metro and wonderful restaurants (blowfish recommended) , it's clean and spacious :)
Nate was a wonderful host. His home was perfect. The neighborhood was very safe, and walkable. Good distance from everything. Would definitely stay again

We enjoyed our stay at this home! It’s very spacious inside and looks just like the pictures. The host checked on us often and I truly appreciated her! The beds are truly comfortable. I rested so well. There is tons of walkable coffee shops and restaurants near by. We walked across the street to a Mexican restaurant late at night after a concert and they were open and the food was fresh and delicious! I would recommend booking this Airbnb, I plan to book this stay again in the future.

We had a great stay at Shaun’s place. The location was good and we parked right out the front. Highlights were the comfy beds and a great coffee shop right next door. Shaun was helpful and responsive. Thanks for having us!

Ming is an exceptional host and very accommodating! I booked the place for 4 days and had a change of plans in between she was very responsive and did her best to help. Coming to the place, it was very neat and ming made sure it was clean. The area is pretty safe overall, I wouldn't stay out very late past 12 or 1 but other than that it's perfect. would highly recommend
A fantastic fit for my parents and sister. It was great to have them stay in the neighborhood. Extra points for the availability of a crib and excellent communication about local places!
We had a great stay! Beautiful decoration, spacious and super well stocked. House was perfect for our 2 families with plenty of privacy for both. I’d easily come back!

Amazing location!!!
Super quiet stay but right in the middle of everything!

Este alojamiento es ideal para familias o grupos que viajen en automóvil y busquen una zona tranquila y cómoda.
Dispone de tres habitaciones: una en el primer nivel y dos en el segundo, todas de tamaño básico. El acceso a las habitaciones del segundo nivel puede ser una limitante para adultos mayores, debido a que la escalera es angosta y empinada.
La cocina está bien equipada con todo lo necesario. El centro de lavado cumple su función; sin embargo, está ubicado en el sótano y se accede por una escalera angosta y empinada.
Cuenta con un baño completo en el primer nivel. La altura del techo sobre la tina es reducida, por lo que las personas altas podrían sentirse incómodas. También dispone de un servicio sanitario en el sótano.
La velocidad de Internet y la televisión por cable son excelentes. Parqueo para 2 autos
Por último, queremos destacar la excelente atención del anfitrión. Marco siempre estuvo atento, disponible y dispuesto a colaborar, brindándonos un servicio excepcional.

Very unique and clean home. Everything went well with check instructions and spacious enough for a group of 4. Smoke smell was non existent for it to be a smoking unit. Only small notes would be to replace dining chairs that were all leaning and to invest in a full body mirror for guest.

The AirB&B was comfortable and as photographed. Joan was very responsive to question. The instructions for checking in and  out was very clear and understandable. The grocery store was within walking distance and a fantastic sushi restaurant was two blocks away! Would stay here again in the future!

My girlfriend and I had a wonderful stay at Susan's Airbnb and was a home away from home while visiting Chicago. The space was clean, well decorated, spacious, and well maintained. Susan was very responsive and communicative during our stay. We would definitely book here again and would recommend others to as well.
The place is VERY centric. Clean and cozy. The last night of our stay we had a problem with the water heater but Kim was able to solve it very quickly.
a good place to rest and enjoy the city

Great place to stay in Chicago if you want a place to sleep at night while exploring the city. All the essentials are there. The place was very clean. Off street parking was provided. Checking in and checking out was easy. There’s an amazing bakery two doors down for breakfast.
20 minute walk to the cta Orange line, 30 minutes to cta red/green. It’s probably 30 walk minutes from the white Sox stadium. It’s so easy to get around the city from here. There’s a lot of good restaurants and bars in Bridgeport if you want to stay nearby, too.
Perfect place to stay and explore the city
Great location, great place. Catherine was awesome host and easy to coordinate with
Super responsive, had a great stay. Photos look exactly how the place looks.

Su alejamiento es muy cómodo y limpio. Con todas las amenidades que vienen descritas .
100% recomendado, sin duda regresaría ahí
The apartment is just as described - located in a very nice area with plenty of restaurants and short walking distance to the stunning brown line on the ‚L‘! Definitely would recommend staying here!
Absolutely wonderful from top to bottom!
Great property and good neighborhood, definitely will be back.
Had a great stay - the apartment was very clean and communication was clear and simple! Jason was very accommodating :)
Good place, neighborhood looks a little rough, but I thought everyone living there was actually quite friendly.

Jamisyn's place is wonderful for family visitors to Chicago. She communicates very well with her guests. The place has everything you need for an enjoyable stay and is is located close to the many downtown attractions. I recommend this staff if you plan a trip to Chicago and would stay again with her on our next family visit.
We had a great stay in this beautiful house! Lot’s of natural light and well appointed. Kim was helpful and answered all of our questions very promptly.

This place is not worth the money they are charging. The listing is completely misleading. In the listing they said 3 queen beds in 3 rooms but we got 2 single beds in each rooms. Even their main picture is also misleading.
In one room there were pipes and water was continuously flowing in it. There was no leak but the sound of the noise made it extremely hard to sleep. The host was kind enough to send staff for inspection and they said it’s normal which is clearly not. Pipes in the ceiling was absurd.
The rooms are dark and no mirrors as well.
It’s an old building.
There was a bad smell in one corner of the kitchen.
The place is only good if you plan on just crashing for the night in downtown area.

Such an adorable little place, easily accessible to bus, train and restaurants! We really enjoyed our stay here.  The train never woke or disturbed us. Parking was close, a bit expensive, but convenient.  We would definitely book again!

My family has the BEST week in Chicago, thanks in part to Danielle. She had some great suggestions to add to my itinerary I sent before we arrived which was so helpful when coming with two kids. I wanted to maximize our time and she gave some great feedback!
The neighborhood was beautiful, quiet, walkable, and so convenient to anything we needed..we felt safe and enjoyed the atmosphere. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had exactly what we needed! We would definitely stay again next time we visit.

Great people to work with! Bill and Sue had some thoughtful extras. We enjoyed the chance to meet them and see their home. They went above and beyond with local recommendations. They were very accommodating as we had bikes with us and they allowed us to store them in their garage. Their place is walkable to many local restaurants and public transportation.

We enjoyed our stay. The place, was nice, clean, and had everything we needed. Auroom was quick to respond and very attentive. The location is what we wanted, quiet with some walkable places to go. Definitely worth the money!

My daughter & I loved staying in Andersonville!  Victoria’s place was tucked into a cute neighborhood that was walkable to area coffee shops, restaurants, & main street shopping.  It was also a .7 mile walk from the Berwyn L train redline that whisks you straight into the downtown loop-super convenient!  Victoria was prompt & responsive in her communication & check-in/check-out was a breeze.  We enjoyed walking to Cafe Collectivo & Lost Larson for coffee in the morning & Cafe Libra for a delicious Balkan breakfast & Pizza Lobo for a lively pizza dinner.  Loved the area!

This place is in a great spot in Chicago. Steps from the Brown line on the L and about 20 minutes to the loop. Lots of restaurants in very short walking distance. Also walkable to Wrigley field (about 30 mins, but better than paying for parking, or a short Lime Scooter away). Elizabeth is a great host thats proactive and willing to work with you. During my month stay I was able to work remotely and explore the city on the evenings and weekends.
Great stay host was very attentive to my needs

This place was perfect for what we needed for our short stay, great walkable area near public transportation. It was nice and cool in the unit, perfect for a summer weekend. I loved the private bathroom in the unit! Thank you guys so much!
Beautiful and comfortable space in a good location!
Fantastic location. Katherine and Dimi were great hosts, easy to work with, very communicative and helpful. The apartment was as pictured and very clean. We thoroughly enjoyed staying there!

Carly’s flat was perfectly situated on a quiet street in the lovely Lincoln Park neighborhood. My family of five including three teens thoroughly enjoyed the flat with plenty of space to meet our needs. We especially enjoyed spending early mornings sipping coffee and ending our days enjoying a glass of wine in the front garden. We felt at home by Carly’s exceptional hospitality! The next time we visit Chicago we hope to book this space again.
the washer & dryer were tapped shut so we couldn’t rewash any laundry we wanted too. also, found a couple wrappers that seemed to be from old guests on the floor tucked away.

This was a great find! So convenient to walk or take the bus to the Blue Line for city exploring. Nice, friendly neighborhood felt safe no matter the time of day. Also in close driving distance to favorites like JollieBee.

The airbnb and host were both great! Everything was as described and the amenities were exactly what we needed for our stay. For light sleepers, it may be important to know that you can hear the footsteps from upstairs. Also, the location is convenient as it’s in walking distance to the 47th street and cottage grove stops on the green line; though I don’t necessarily recommend the walk during nighttime (we didn’t have any issues though). Overall, the place was great and helped make our first trip to Chicago so much fun!
I enjoyed my stay here! Would definitely book again!

Selena hosted 4 friends and me, and we all really enjoyed our stay. We specifically loved the proximity to the train station (only a 15 min walk). The unit was clean, and Selena gave great instructions for check-in and check-out.

The place was as described and had everything we needed for our stay. The location was great, with easy access to public transportation, which made getting around very convenient. We also appreciated the friendly security guard, who made us feel welcome. Overall, a good stay!
The place was quiet, well appointed, and close to shops and restaurants.  Highly recommend!

It's a beautifully curated space. The attention to detail is lovely. Very clean. Comfortable. Wonderful location. The only drawback is the space is directly below the main house and you can hear noise and activity from above and you do need to walk through a backyard to get to the entrance.
fantastic host. Apartment was really cool.

This place didn’t specify it was part of a guest house with at least ten other rooms. The moment I checked in, there was a noticeable smell of feces coming from the downstairs bathroom. The room that was assigned to us, had numerous amount of lives flies, mosquitos, and other bugs. The sheets were not clean and had seen at least two bed bugs. Vraiment un endroit incroyable dans un environnement tout aussi incroyable!  Nous avons adoré notre séjour et sincèrement, nous y retournerons sans aucun doute! Location location location. I loved being in the middle of the best chicago has to offer. The hosts were super responsive.  Building amenities were top notch. I would easily choose to stay here again.

We had a great stay!!  Everything was very clean and in great condition. The shared kitchen/dining/living room area was very clean and had everything we needed!! The place is in a great location with it being private still, but also walkable to public transportation and other stores/places. Overall a great stay!
Great place to stay very quiet

Niki and Sean were responsive, very helpful, and generous. We had everything we needed and their recommendations were spot on during our visit. The beds were comfortable and the area had everything about Chicago we were looking for to explore. I’d love to stay again on a future visit.

This was a great place to stay that worked well for our family. The setup was very practical and it had everything we needed. Having a designated garage parking space was so helpful! Amir was an excellent host and responsive communicator and we would definitely stay here again.

Norma’s place was great. The location was perfect, a few blocks from the EL so it’s easy to get to O’hare and downtown. The location sits nicely between Logan Square and Wicker Park/Bucktown so there’s a ton of things to do in the area. The apartment was clean and cozy and the beds were very comfortable. Norma was also very responsive. The front bedroom faces Western Ave which is a very busy street so there was some street noise but I’ve lived in cities for most of my life so it didn’t bother me at all. There’s a nice little white noise machine on the bedside table if it’s bothersome. I’d definitely stay again!

We had a great stay! The location was in a great spot, a super easy walk to the water taxi and train station for getting around the city. The view was a beautiful skyline view of the city. The train is right out the window, so there is noise but it added to the ambiance of staying in the city. My kids loved it. As others have mentioned the cleanliness of the building could be improved but the condo itself was immaculate and very clean. All neighbors we encountered were very friendly. The condo had everything we needed. I appreciated having a washer and dryer as we had been traveling so it was nice to be able to do our laundry. It was great to have a dedicated parking spot. We would stay here again when visiting!

My biggest concern was finding somewhere that was safe, had easy access to parking, & quiet. This place had it all! Also, the hosts were very responsive and flexible. I would definitely recommend this place, especially if you’re bringing kids.
Beautiful place in a great location walkable to restaurants and bus and train lines. Host is responsive but the elevator wasn’t working most of our stay.
Had a great time in West Loop. This location was absolutely perfect location. Everything was walkable and the city was just minutes away. Would stay again!

Recent stay for my daughter’s surgery the location was great close to Hospital and Downtown. Would’ve of liked host to be alittle more accommodating for early check in . The unit itself is nice has some imperfections and could be alittle cleaner especially the bathroom. The parking space in the back is a bit of struggle with larger vehicles and not a lot of street parking available. Overall it was a nice stay!
Great location, loved the area and the experiences nearby

Everything about our stay was excellent and as described. Milan was great about throughly providing all needed details and promptly answered any questions. Would book again if I end up back in the area.

This is a lovely apartment. Perfect for 2 people and our dogs. Close to downtown(30 min) and Obama Presidential Center(10 min), which is why we were there.Close to parks and lakes. Very quiet, nice bed, and the host was very communicative. My recommendations-If you have trouble with stairs, be prepared, there are a lot and they are steep and narrow. Carrying up luggage was challenging. Going up and down can be challenging. We had an older dog with us that struggled and our other dog had a hard time with the narrowness of the stairs, so keep in mind if traveling with dogs. The air conditioning was not efficient enough. They had a small window unit for the whole apartment and a portable unit for the bedroom. We were here during a heat wave and it could not keep up so be prepared for cool not cold.
We would recommend this to others but be aware of the things I commented on.

There were some hiccups when I checked in since the room allocated to me wasn't clean (but upon communication, it seems there was a mixup with the cleaning service and they took care of it right away). Despite that, 5 stars for the price, location, and communication.
Simply wonderful! I will stay again!
Great spot for a good price not too far from Wrigley.
Todo es super bien!!

We loved the neighborhood — it’s peaceful, green, and has plenty of great food options nearby, from Vietnamese restaurants to Scandinavian bakeries. The apartment doesn't get as much sunlight as the photos suggest and could benefit from a deep clean, but otherwise it was comfortable, with a well-equipped kitchen and a cozy bed. We had some issues with the front door, but Dave responded quickly, resolved the problem, and was very communicative throughout our stay. He let us leave our bags for a few extra hours after check out which was very kind and helpful.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had an excellent stay at Joseph’s place! He was a fantastic host friendly, responsive, and very welcoming from the moment we booked. Communication was smooth throughout our stay, and he shared great local recommendations that helped us make the most of our first visit to the Chicago area.
The home was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, cozy, and well maintained. The location was perfect, with easy access to public transportation, making it simple to explore downtown and all the major attractions without having to drive.
I highly recommend staying with Joseph if you’re visiting Chicago. We would gladly stay here again on our next trip!

Laura’s place was wonderful for just the three of us! Quiet neighborhood, great local food and coffee shops. Bridgeport coffee house is the place to go! While street parking can get a little dicey, that doesn’t take away from how great Laura’s is! The house had everything we needed. Close to downtown. We would definitely stay again!

Bon accueil, l’hôte a tout fait pour que je puisse déposer mes affaires dans l’appartement parce que je suis arrivé assez tôt. Le quartier est super tranquille et le centre-ville de Chicago est facilement accessible en bus/metro. Le logement est largement assez grand pour 1 voire 2 personnes avec une chambre, une salle de bain et un séjour assez important. Vraiment je recommande le logement !

We Stayed in Chicago as part of a 3 week trip to USA for the FIFA world Cup.
Positives;
Walking distance to the United Center
Walking distance to the green line and a major supermarket.
Lovely apartment - clean and spacious, High spec
Comfy beds
Responsive host - Serg was very attentive and responsive
Negatives:
Second parking spot was $90 for 3 nights
Check in was 4pm - quite late in comparison to other Airbnbs that we've stayed in on this trip
We could hear the neighbours above moving around
The apartment is on the front, so you can hear the street traffic. It is also close to a fire station so we had a few nights of disturbed sleep when they called to jobs.
The area close by had groups of residents sitting around at night. Some lone females may feel vulnerable.
On the whole we were happy with our stay here, although with all the fees etc - it was much more expensive than other airbnbs.
Great place!

This was a great apartment. We only had 4 people with us, but it could easily host more. The apartment was clean, cute, and felt very Chicago...
The location was great. We could walk to lots of restaurants and shopping. The street was really quiet.
I'd recommend this spot!

Dominique was a great host! We went to the Windy City Smokeout and could walk to the United Center. Dominique was always very responsive and helpful. Parking was very accessible on the street. We had a great two night stay!
Highly recommend this spot for future guests

this is a great spot to stay my adult daughter and i stayed here while moving her into her new apartment it’s a great location lots of great restaurants and stores for anything you need all in eyesight the backyard is a great place to sit have a drink and a smoke and recharge your batteries the beds are very comfortable the shower is spa quality and feels amazing it’s a great place to stay the owners are sweet and friendly

This is a terrific, spacious apartment in a quiet, lovely neighborhood.  Roscoe Village has lots of good restaurants and shops - all within walking distance.  It's a short walk to the Brown Line as well.  The apartment is bright, comfortable, and has everything you need - including a well-stocked kitchen.  And it's on the top floor!  So many AirBnB's in Chicago are basement or garden apartments.  Parking is free and there were plenty of spots on the street.  Loved A'isha's place!
Sam’s place was as described — comfortable, bright, clean, in a great location, and the amenities made it feel like home! Highly recommend for a Chicago trip!!

Great location, responsive host, however parking the first night there wasn’t a parking space available. Would strongly encourage better communication if there’s no parking available after you’ve paid. Overall stay was ok.
