This stay was very convenient and very comfortable, very beautiful place and very well accommodated I would stay again!

My daughter requested a quick getaway to Chicago for her 13th birthday. This Airbnb was the perfect, centralized location. The place looked just like the pictures and the bed was extremely comfortable. I appreciated the detailed manual on how to find the keys and parking spot. It was so nice not having to stress about parking! We enjoyed our stay here and would definitely recommend it.
Very cool place, highly recommend

Responsive host, apartment is comfortable and clean . However it is on the 14th floor. The elevators are slow to arrive and there isn’t a cart for the luggage. Inconvenient if you have a lot of stuff.
When I got there found out that the air conditioner was missing. In a heat of the summer it was a deal breaker. I gather that the host was not aware of this. She was quick to respond but couldn’t get the building maintenance to install a new window unit within 24hr. I booked the place for 4 nights but ended up leaving after one. Host refunded me for the 3 nights with no problems.

The apartment was very spacious. The kitchen was updated with needed utensils and appliances.  The pool table was a bonus that everyone enjoyed. Plenty of beds and pillows. The apt was overall clean. Great safe location just outside of downtown. We didn’t utilize the EL train but the blue line was very close. The only minor issue was it little damp (it’s a basement unit). Also there were other cars parked in designated spot almost every night. Thankfully we were able to park in another open spot. Hosts were very responsive. They even had new TV remotes and batteries delivered from Amazon the next day!  Overall good safe place for the money.
距離地鐵站近，環境安靜。房間乾淨，裝潢別具風格。屋主Josh親切友善，回覆迅速。住宿體驗非常好。
A great place to stay in Chicago! Definitely recommend this place and the host is amazing! Super responsive and such a nice person!
A clean modern space and a very convenient location.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described, very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The host was incredibly responsive and kind, and they even let us check in early, which we really appreciated after traveling. The check-in process was easy and the thoughtful touches throughout the home made us feel welcome. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a great place to stay!

We had a wonderful stay! We were in Chicago to prepare for the Chicago-to-Mackinac Race, and this apartment was the perfect home base. It was comfortable, thoughtfully appointed, and had everything we needed. Having on property laundry was a huge plus, and the kitchen was well stocked, making it easy for me to prepare and provision meals for our race crew.
The decor had a warm, curated feel that made the space feel like a real home rather than a typical cookie-cutter rental.
The Wrigleyville neighborhood is absolutely charming. We even managed to squeeze in a Cubs game, walked to several fantastic restaurants, and had no trouble getting Ubers whenever we needed to head down to the marina.
We couldn’t have asked for a better location or a more enjoyable stay. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!
Fue un placer , el lugar súper limpio una de mis mejores experiencias en Chicago gracias

nice little spot with your little courtyard! can easily walk to the brown or red lines to get most places in Chicago fairly easily.   also just down to street from second city and the bars that make up old town.

There was a slight hiccup with parking at check in but that was resolved very quickly. Otherwise our stay was incredible. The unit was quiet and stocked with everything we needed to enjoy our stay. The views were special and the outdoor space allows for even more enjoyment. My family and I will absolutely be back.

This was my second time staying here. It’s a spacious studio with a full kitchen that has exactly what I needed: easy access to the waterfront, the highway north and downtown. There are shops and restaurants nearby and the street parking was (generally)  easy to find. Thank you Ola for making this place available, I plan to book again when I next need to be in that part of Chicago!
Classic east lakeview vintage with all the right upgrades. Amazing location, walk to the lake, restaurants and shops! Super clean condo, as pictured.

Daniel is an absolutely wonderful host. From communication to friendliness to accommodating Daniel was on point. Location is great, right next to Ferro’s (best Italian ice ever) and a 7 minute walk to Sox park and Red Line. 2 bus stops right outside his apartment as well. Beautiful view from balcony, safe area, and had everything you would need for your stay. Highly recommend!
Excelente alojamiento, muy bien ubicado

Sunnyside Up was mostly the way as described in the pictures. Aside from some cosmetic aesthetics that come with an older place, the stay was a good one with walkable access  to public transportation such as the redline train, and to stores, entertainment, etc. They also provided a manual that was very informative and helpful to navigate the unit and the city.

The place was just about perfect. I already knew the area a bit so I was excited to stay there. The place was really cozy and comfortable, made me feel right at home.
The hosts were really responsive and proactive with their communication about my reservation, which I appreciated.
I’d love to stay here again, anytime!

The place was exactly as pictured. Everything inside was clean and nicely decorated, very easy to feel comfortable here. We came during the heat wave so the central air was perfect to have and easy to use. The apartment had all the basic things we needed as well and were easy to find. The only thing I didn't like was how hard it was parking on the street at night, especially after long days in the city. The apartment is very close to the city so that was nice for us because of everything we had planned during our stay there.
This was the best Air BnB I have ever stayed in. Great spot, amazing patio and a super friendly host. I will be back.

Great place located in a friendly neighborhood.  The space inside was open and clean, and the AC was great during hot days.  The unit does include and washer, dryer, and dish washer so you have everything you need as well as a full kitchen.  Be aware that it is up stairs.  Parking is on the street but there was always spots available.

My husband and I enjoyed our stay. The space was perfect for the two of us. This was our first time renting an apartment and/or shared space with the host and our experience was great. Being able to smoke inside was a plus, made it easy to relax after a full day of adventures in Chicago. Definitely would recommend and keep on my list of places to return.
This is one of the Airbnbs in my roster of places to stay while working. Great location and helpful hosts. Will stay there again.

We had an amazing stay! Great location, quiet, walkable neighborhood. House was beautiful. Basement was clean, well furnished, and had great amenities. Would definitely stay here again! Thank you for a peaceful, clean, cozy place to stay during my trip.
great for what our group needed. responsive host.
Good spot, convenient street access and close to lakeside
Beautiful condos in a great, walkable location. The hosts were extremely responsive and helpful.
Exactly as described. Clean, and in a great location just a bus ride away from downtown and navy pier. Ming was a great host and responded to our queries very quickly.
No
good stay however there was loud construction directly beside us that started at 5am. it was endless -- we were not notified that this would happen.

The host was friendly and helpful! I had the whole apartment to myself while I was there, which was super nice of him. The apartment was as listed. The area was really nice. It is next to Welsh Park and the 606 biking/walking trail. It was very quiet and safe. Street parking was so easy and safe, and lots of spaces were always available. The other reviews were correct about the noticeable smell in the building entry area, but what can you do about that? Once you are inside the actual apartment, there are no issues. Overall, the description of the Airbnb is correct.
Place was wonderful just like the photo.  Few things need to be fix but not a big issue at all.   Love it will stay again next visit.

My daughter was visiting. And this was a great location. Jevaux was very helpful and answered all questions very quickly. I would stay here again. Thank you Jevaux for being a great host.
A.Monty

House was great.  Quick walk to the L.  Train is right next to home but did not bother us.  We brought ear plugs but slept through and didn’t need them.  We drove a Jeep Grand Wagoneer and it was a very tight fit in the alley/garage.  We moved it to the street after a couple of days for ease.  Had to renew permit every 24 hours.  Lots to do eat within walking distance.  Host left sweet note and some snacks!! A very nice touch!

We had an amazing stay at Hygge Hideaway! Perfect location, surrounded by quiet, tree-lined streets and a block away from a gorgeous park. There are a ton of great restaurants within walking distance. It made for a perfect trip for my wife and I to enjoy with my dad and our two dogs. The apartment was clean, cozy, and most importantly cool! The a/c worked great during an excessive heat wave during our stay! Will look forward to booking again on our next extended stay in Chicago!

James’ place is what airbnbs should be! It felt like staying at someone’s actual home, not a property that only exists for holiday rentals. The kitchen had everything a cook needs - air fryer, electric kettle (great for making baby formula), oils and spices etc. Every TV app was ready to watch with accounts already signed in. Beds were very comfortable and plenty of space to unpack clothes. Plenty of towels and extra bedding. A uniquely Chicago property in a brilliant part of town.
Very good at communication, nice clean place really enjoyed
Loved it! Especially location
Great accommodation

Ewa was an incredible host, and I really appreciated all of the tips she gave me to make the most of my time in Chicago. The apartment was beautiful and it's very easy to get around Chicago from the Blue Line stop nearby!

Wale did a great job thinking of everything you’d need to stay here. I think that more up-front information about parking would have been helpful, and the building is a bit older, but both could have been solved with more careful research on my end. I would absolutely recommend staying here!

Melissa’s place was fantastic! Great location, we felt safe, it was very clean, was easy to check in & check out, she was very responsive. The only thing I’d say; the hot water pressure is low but that’s expected in some older buildings. It was still useable. Other than that everything met our expectations & we would definitely recommend Mellissa’s Place to stay at!

This was our second stay! Reminds me of our condo that we had back in the day, which was right around the corner. Great location! They had a lot of nice inclusions! Even umbrellas, that came in handy!
Beds and pillows were super comfy. Everything was really clean! Owners are very accommodating and responsive! Neighbors are very nice, and super quiet! The parking is a great perk too! We fit our Mercedes large SUV with no issues. We will be back. Thank you for another great stay!
Great location and a great host. I will definitely be back the next time I'm in Chicago. Very conveniently located in a great neighborhood. Highly recommend.

Excellent stay -
Water in shower was not hot either day, just lukewarm.
And the message we received with check in instructions to not throw toilet paper in the toilet was strange.
All in all - it served our purposes very well.
Thanks Katty
Had a great stay at Marc’s place exploring Bronzeville. Close to really good restaurants and points of interests on the south side. Place was beautifully decorated with accurate descriptions.

The host was responsive and attentive before and during my stay. The apartment itself is lovely and located in an accessible area to the city. If you choose not to leave the area don’t worry because it has everything you will need from great restaurants, shopping for groceries and many other stores. The area is really walkable, I liked that they had two gyms near by, a target, Ross, Walgreens, cvs, Whole Foods, Trader Joe’s and as I mentioned many restaurants… the homes are beautiful , the nature is amazing and I would love to come back.

Honestly, the kitchen was super dirty. The trash was piled up in the trash bin with ants, crawling over it and bugs. It was having somewhat of a smell in the place. The floors were sticky and the hardwood floor. I didn’t like the fact that the room seemed smaller than what was listed, and even though the host was very responsive. I had an issue with the air-conditioning being super hot more than my liking and asked to have it turned down twice during my state and by the time I checked out, there wouldn’t be anything worth changing so during my stay honestly it wasn’t the best that I’ve ever had and I wasn’t very satisfied with what I had paid and wish I maybe found another place that was a little bit nicer and well kept, but the host responded very promptly and gave clear instructions and made it easy to find the place. I just wish it was a little bit better with Maintance.
Clean and well-equipped, with comfortable furniture in a good location. Looks exactly like the photos. Friendly and responsive host. Thank you!
the space itself was nice, but the owners of the property downstairs had an incredibly loud dog that would bark whenever any noise was made in the unit or a door was opened.
Great place!

Lovely remodel with very nice finishes and furniture. It was perfect for our family and our time in Chicago. Kitchen had everything we needed to cook a few meals there. Beds were very comfortable. Having two bathrooms was nice, as well.

Parking was included in the price, so we left the car parked the 4 days (3 nights) and walked everywhere. The apartment was almost centered between Navy Pier and the Planetarium / Aquarium.
The street intersected with Michigan Ave.
The apartment was really spacious and clean. The view from all the windows was lovely. We saw the sun rise on one side and could watch it set on the other.
We had everything we needed; such as: iron & ironing board, clean surroundings, full kitchen and each person had their own privacy.
Very important for us; our group was made up of 2 women and 2 young girls, we felt VERY safe.
We all talked about it and the above is unanimous and would love to go back.

Stephanie has a beautiful property. The location is great  in walking distance to many restaurants, bars, shops etc. The property was clean, the amenities especially the gym was outstanding and the view is amazing. Thank you Staphanie and I will for sure love to stay at your property on my next Chi Town visit.
Place super clean and nice. My space has its own master bath and very private. Comfortable bed and nice cooling system.  Overall very satisfying stay.

This is the second of David’s properties I have stayed at and, just like the other property, it was so uniquely well decorated with lots of thought to little touches. David and his team are friendly, warm,  and humorous. They also make sure that the stay is going to be perfect from the moment of reservation through the final checkout. I will always check for one of his properties first when visiting Chicago.
Fantastic location and great spacious house!
Nice, clean place in a great location near public transit. Quiet neighborhood.

This was our family's first visit to Chicago and we loved staying in Logan Square! Elizabeth's place is tidy, welcoming, and convenient. She was responsive to messages, and made sure we would feel very welcome!

Definitely would recommend. Host was very attentive and informative, available to answer any questions, facility was in good location to united center walking distance, beautiful apartment and very clean even had people come in to fix the tap they were very quick and helpful. But overall excellent experience.
Very clean and nice place to stay
Communication was great. The space was unique and very cool and comfortable

This place has a fantastic location and is a great value. We found the actual space to be fine--it is definitely showing its age in places and feels very much like a purpose-designed rental. The one bathroom is small, the kitchen is basic, and things felt a bit worn here and there. That being said, if you're looking for a comfortable-enough space in a great location, with responsive and caring hosts, this a great and relatively budget friendly option.
Great place to stay in Chicago. Walkable distance to Willis Tower (formerly Sears Tower). Lots of nearby restaurants and nearby the city center.
My son and I loved this place so much. He definitely wants to come back. The team was so quick to respond too and very friendly. 10/10 I definitely recommend. 😌

Marty and Rob’s loft experience is absolutely amazing and highly recommend! Not only is the art, interior design and exterior landscape beautifully executed which brings another level to an air bnb space. But, Marty/Rob were super friendly and easy to talk. The loft area is super private, very quiet since it is on the top floor and gorgeous with the garden/pond view. Great space for a single trip to Chicago!

Michael’s Airbnb was even more than we were looking for it wasn’t just a place to sleep he made it inviting for adults and kids. He checked in to see if our needs were met and if anything else was needed. He was friendly and I would definitely stay here again and again!

This place was perfect! The cleanest airbnb at which I've ever stayed. Everything is labeled and the instructions for check in and out were clear and descriptive. It was the perfect location for my family of five's Chicago vacation. It's literal steps away from Chinatown, which is so much fun and the food is amazing. The red line is just a few minute walk away (which we took to get downtown every day) and the apartment comes with a free parking space, which is huge! 12/10 would recommend and would definitely stay here again next time we come to Chicago.
Decent place for the price. Location is excellent. Rooms are fairly small and showers have effectively one temperature—very hot. Air conditioner also has only one temperature.
Jason's place was excellent--clean, great location, solid amenities, and the communication was great. Would absolutely stay here again.

We had an incredible week long visit and the place was perfect for my family of 4 (wife and two small kids).  Nancy and Bill were incredible hosts, and made our stay comfortable and easy.  Perfect location in the city on a beautiful street.  We can't wait to return!

We had a good experience at this property. The host was extremely responsive. Everything was clean and well kept. The pictures provided leave out a lot of great features/details that are included. One of the best places to stay in downtown Chicago.

There were four of us and the space was perfect for us. The common area in the rental doesn't have HUGE private space, but the rooftop area was really very special and the area near the entrance was also really nice. We were able to walk to everything we needed, making the space super for us. We weren't cooking, so we didn't really use the kitchen. It was easy to find, easy to enter and overall wonderful. We would certainly stay again.

I have never stayed at a cleaner Air BnB! Absolutely spotless! The place felt peaceful, safe and honestly, blessed.
Our family was looking at several universities in the Chicagoland area, and Shalom’s place was a central location between all of them.
We are so happy we stayed there and would do so again!
A wonderful host and would recommend to anybody.
great place
We enjoyed our stay the place was beautiful and location was everything

First time using Staywell as a host and I satisified with both my property and the communication with this management company. I would recommend them if they are the host in a location you're interested in.

I have been to many different cabins and lodges, but this was by far the best! Most stocked house I have ever been to during vacation. Mike and Maya were super helpful and had great recommendations. Would most definitely recommend and I will be staying here again next time I’m in Chicago!!!

Thank you Tina and Jon for a great stay. The place was lovely, and so clean and comfortable. Neighborhood was safe and nice. It was super easy to check in and out. We had everything we needed! Recommend this place for anyone wanting to stay in Chicago!
Great stay
Great place to stay. Hosts were very nice.

For a family reunion trip with people of varied interests, Will’s place worked very well. We found everything we needed in the kitchen for the few times we cooked, and there were lots of restaurants nearby for all those times we didn’t. We spent a week at Will’s and were very happy with our choice.

This was my second stay at Wendy's in Lincoln Square. The garden apartment was perfect for me. The neighborhood is quiet and within walking distance of public transportation, restaurants, parks and whatever I needed.

A great location near Humboldt Park and a really good amount of space for the price. We made good use of the kitchen and I loved that there was laundry available on the same level. Lots of stairs to get up to the place, but totally worth it.

Great location - If you are native, then you can make your way around the city very easily on the cheap using a 7-day Ventra pass.
The unit stayed relatively cool because it is a garden apartment.
The beds are clean, made up well, and very comfortable.
The host was very attentive to our needs. They were super friendly and accommodating. They responded very quickly to all of my inquiries.
The backyard became our sanctuary during down time.
The place was really nice, clean and spacious! It had all the amenities described in the listing. We had a very pleasant stay😊
Tiene que venir con mas instrucciones de uso! Luces, persianas, etc...buena tech pero no tan intuitiva.

Our family loved staying at Nicole and Todd’s place in Uptown. The place was very comfortable for our group of 6 and felt more like a home than an AirBnB. The kitchen, living room, and master bedroom were highlights for us - very spacious and comfortable.
The location was great for public transit and also for driving into the city using Lakeshore Drive.
Nicole and Todd were very responsive and helpful. We would gladly stay here again for future Chicago trips!
Staying at Marks place was amazing! The long room is a must try for bites and drinks! Will be back
very clean and nice and budget friendly
Excellent stay! The host was hospitable, kind, and responsive. Home was clean and in vibrant area. I would recommend staying here!
Amazing place with a great location! Would recommend to anyone!

Its my second stay at Dimitri's house, and once again, I can only highly recommend this Airbnb! This is becoming my favorite place to stay for a trip in Chicago. The apartment is in a very friendly neighborhood, close to many nice restaurants, coffee places and useful services, and 5 mins away from the metro station.  I have always found the apartment extremely clean, with a well-equiped and cosy living room, which makes it a nice place to rest, appreciate Chicago and work in a private and calm environment. Demitri is always extremely reactive, making sure that your needs are well covered, and making you feel at home. I totally recommend this Airbnb and gives it a 5-stars! Thank you Demitri!
5 stars ⭐🫡🤝🥇

We grabbed up this spot for a staycation. Highly recommend it for that or for out-of-town folks who are really comfortable navigating a city. Very cool building. Loved the rooftop and the common areas. Aaron was a great host, and we had no issues at all with our stay.
جميل جداً

Hugh’s space was as shown and described. Communication was excellent and instructions clear throughout. The location was perfect for our needs. Very walkable and not far from public transportation. Lots of dining options with a near by grocery. Parking was free street parking and we had no issues finding a spot. The unit itself was clean and well stocked for our short stay. If in the area I recommend Hugh’s space.
A really great stay! Next to a very big walkable park, nearby the CTA that you can take to downtown. Overall a hot spot! Will definitely come back! Thank you!!!
Great place to stay while exploring Edgewater! Very welcoming/accomodating hosts & we fell in love with old lady dog Katie 🧡

This is a fantastic property.  Clean, spacious, and a perfect location.  The pillows and towels were plentiful.  The kitchen was stocked with coffee and creamery.  The living room television was nice.  It was fun to people watch out of the front window as people were leaving the clubs.  This is 2 blocks from the river and a very safe area.  Bedrooms were spacious and absolutely loved the 4 beds.

Doni was fantastic! He checked in on how our stay was going but ensured our privacy and wanted to make sure we were enjoying our trip. During a rain storm he alerted us to some downed branches in the walkway and quickly resolved the issue. The property was very well equipped. More than what you would expect from a typical rental. If you needed an extra linen it was already right there in the closet. Running low on bath soap? Extras in the cabinet. The kitchen was very well equipped and spotless. Also, for a city rental it felt very protected behind fences and key coded gates. The area right behind the house had a nice park and pickleball court. Restaurants, a movie theater, and a grocery store steps away.

The location, walkability, and privacy made for an enjoyable experience.
The blue line is steps away and Wicker Park offers many restaurants, bars, & stores. All within minutes by foot.
Would 10/10 recommend!
Accommodations were clean and had everything we needed in a cozy environment.
Enjoyed the artistic vibes.
As a host, Jeannette was quick to respond and the check in/check out process was a breeze!
The host was really nice and helpful during our arrival. If there was anything we needed, he was there to help. I loved the surrounding cafes and restaurants.
Short walk to the train. Short walk to the beach. Comfortable apartment (but lacked table and chairs to eat at). Easy to use Roku tv. I would stay here again.
I really enjoyed staying at Marilyn’s place. We felt safe. Her small place was perfect for 3 people. She was friendly. I will definitely stay again at her place.

Our family of 6 really enjoyed our stay. The blow up air mattresses were great to accommodate all 6 of us. We LOVED the balcony! The parking garage is separate which was fine. Just took us a minute to find the paper box lofts. Over all we would like to come back for another stay!
We really enjoyed the place was perfect for our group of 5 and the location and view were perfect!
Great stay!! Sooooo nice & accommodating! Wow! Maria and David were so friendly and helped set up my twins party! Great people, and nice for it to be a basement unit.
Our Airbnb was exactly as it looked in the pictures. Although the space is small, it more than met the objectives of my visit. My only annoyance was the wifi signal was weak.

This is a great Air BNB in a fantastic location near Lincoln Square . The apartment was easy to find and very clean. There were 3 flights of stairs to negotiate but I was prepared for that. The L train was a few blocks away but with the windows closed and AC on it never bothered me. I appreciated the ear plugs that were provided.
The host was very friendly and responsive. Definitely would stay here again.

L'appartement est situé dans un magnifique quartier où il est facile de manger, faire des emplettes et les arrêts d'autobus sont à 3 minutes de marche.
Il était vraiment propre et tellement bien équipé, noud avions tout ce dont nous avions besoin et plus encore !!
J'y retournerais sans hésiter
We enjoyed our stay! Very spacious and comfy for our large family of 12. The neighborhood was nice and quiet. Lina was very responsive and a great host. Thanks a million for your hospitality!
Can’t beat the location. Derek is a sweetheart.

La casa es genial, muy bonita y agradable, muchos cuartos y tres baños completos, todo muy bonito. Lo único malo es que Adrian es muy rígido con el check -in no quiso que lo hicieramos una hora antes, y el apto estaba libre. muy mal por eso.. poco flexible. no me gustó
Really enjoyed the apartment, excellent condition.

I stayed at Gloria’s place while I explored Chicago as a first time solo traveller. The place made me feel so cozy and comfortable. It was stocked with everything you could ever need. The bed was comfortable and the space has such an “at home” feel. The lower patio was one of my favourites. Gloria was the most responsive host, checked in with me frequently. Thank you for making the trip memorable.

Our family loved having a cool private space to return to each day that felt peaceful right in the middle of a bustling Chicago neighborhood. We spent a week exploring the city on foot, using buses and the L, as our car sat parked in the driveway. To be right in the city, not have to worry about parking, have 2 floors of living space with 2 bathrooms , was perfect for our group of 5. We loved all the options on Wells, quick walk to Lincoln Park and Lake Michigan, and public transportation everywhere. Would definitely stay in Old Town again, and this specific home was perfect. Thank you!
Great experience
Great spot in a great area.

Jevaux's apartment is truly a wonderful place to stay! It has everything you need to feel right at home. We loved the building, and the location in Hyde Park was absolutely perfect. The views of Lake Michigan are beautiful! (If you're petite like I am, the windows are a little high, so it was slightly harder for me to fully enjoy the view—but that's certainly not a dealbreaker!)
The apartment was spotless, and I have to mention the beds—they were honestly the most comfortable I've ever slept on in any Airbnb.
The only small negative was that the sofa wasn't especially comfortable, but that was really the only thing that fell short of an otherwise excellent experience.
Jevaux was also incredibly kind and accommodating. I have severe fragrance sensitivities, and he was very respectful of my request to avoid scented candles, laundry products, and cleaners. That meant so much to me and allowed me to feel comfortable throughout our stay.

I stayed in the basement apartment at Tuan's place. It was very spacious and private. The instructions were easy to understand, and it was simple to get in. I also liked access to the TVs, which were equipped with Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, etc. You could hear people upstairs walking around, and it did get a little cold, but there is a space heater available for use, and it warms up the space quickly. I felt like the shower in the bathroom could use some updating as well. Overall, this place has everything you need and is conveniently close to the airport.
It was a very nice stay and very easy to check in and out. The host was also very helpful!

Overall not bad. For the price it’s worth it. I will say the space is small so I wouldn’t do an extended stay especially if it’s with 2 people. But for just a few days it was good. The shower is very small so i wouldn’t keep that in mind if you are tall. We did have trouble getting in and out of the building but the host was very communicative. The only other thing is i would request more towels we were only staying for two night and they gave us one towel and wash cloth each i’m sure if i requested more they would have provided more. As for location it was not bad you are close to the train station so keep that in mind and you are more so on the outskirts of the city but still not bad! You are over a bar but idk if it’s because we were there through the week but we had no problem with noise plus they provide a really nice sound machine!!
Private and peaceful spot .  Very clean.

A great value, stylish apartment in one of the most walkable neighborhoods of Chicago. The room is very clean and spacious, and it’s quiet at night. I was able to walk to restaurants and nightlife. Definitely recommend!!
Very nice and clean Airbnb easy to get in and out amazing parking spot! Would recommend for a trip to Chicago bus stop was right outside as-well.

My dear friend and I needed a place to stay while in town for a visa appointment. We both work remotely and it worked out great!
There a lovely little patio in back and a nice yard with grass, plants, and trees. Plenty of room for us both to spread out.
Comfy rooms, stocked kitchen and everything we needed in walking distance.
Audrone lent us a park blanket so we could go enjoy a free symphony at millennium park! She was a delight to talk to and we had a perfect whirlwind visit to this great city. We will stay here if/when we return!

The place was nice and clean, spotless linens and matched description/pictures. And the host was extremely responsive and helpful!
To get to the apartment was a bit janky, there was a noticeable smell in the hallways with massively large horseflies in the building. The parking was hard to find especially during late night parking (free street parking). The ottoman bench lid was broken off the hinges.
Otherwise, a wonderful stay!
spacious and nicely furnished.

It’s an amazing street, just down from the Thompson & Gibson’s. 7 min walk to the beach. While there are lots of restaurants and shops down the street, it was quiet inside. Towels, umbrella and beach chairs included, very nice. Two living rooms, but only one has a TV so that was disappointing. And the one TV is small, around 40”. Not good for watching the World Cup. All four bedrooms require you to walk in the hallway to access the bathroom. Main level has a very small powder room. 2nd level has two good size bedrooms, that share a bathroom. 3rd level master (king bed) good size room & bunk bed room very small they both share a bathroom. It was very hot during our stay and the ac was fine at night, but never got cool in the day. Overall it is a nice townhouse on a great street. Some updates to the interior and front porch would be nice, but I would stay here again.

We had a great stay and Nala and Owen were great hosts! From booking to check out, they did an amazing job communicating and providing information. The noise levels were not bad at all, especially for an apartment in a busy Chicago area. As well, free street parking was easy to find and closely located. Would definitely stay here again!!
we enjoy our stay i grew up around the area and brought memories from my childhood luv it..if I come to Chicago will love to book it again

We had a great stay! The apartment was clean, modern, and very comfortable. It was conveniently located just a short distance from many tourist attractions, making it easy to explore Chicago. We mostly used Lyft, which made getting around so much easier you don’t have to worry about finding or paying for parking, which can be hectic downtown. Overall, it was a wonderful place to stay, and we would definitely book it again!
Great place to stay and great location and value!

Selected to stay here as could bring pet and was located steps from where son lives so ultra convenient. Plenty of room and good size bathroom. Although not need the kitchen as much, was nice to have large fridge. Silas and Pauline were extremely friendly and very helpful. Silas even helped arrange for us to book again when in town for graduation. Rogers Park is great place to stay. Very diverse neighborhood, steps from the beach/lake, many restaurants and minutes to L.
I love the place it very peaceful, spacious, and very close to everything definitely if i come to chicago i would stay here again
Great quiet place to stay!
My husband and I really enjoyed our stay! It is in a great neighborhood, and the Airbnb is fantastic. I would definitely stay again!

El alojamiento es bueno para viajar sólo, utilizar el cuarto para dormir y arreglarse. Al ser mi primera vez de visita en Chicago no me quedé mucho tiempo en la habitación, sólo la usé para dormir y arreglarme. El baño está medianamente limpio aunque compartes el baño con otra persona muchas veces depende de la higiene y limpieza de la otra persona, pero considero que no estaba tan sucio ni tan limpio. La zona es super tranquila, llegaba a las 11 de la noche y todo estaba seguro.
Very nice.  Neighborhood is quiet at night.

We had a wonderful stay in this comfortable and cozy apartment. The location and neighborhood were great for us, especially since our kids and grandkids leave in the walking distance. Kristal & Harry were very responsive - every time we’ve sent a question, they responded within 5–10min. Check-in and check-out were seamless. We would definitely consider staying here again!
Tatyana & Alex

My stay here was great! The host was very responsive and helpful. The unit was the right size for a solo traveler or a couple that needs a safe place to stay while visiting. Parking was a hassle in the neighborhood if you arrive after 7pm. It was no fault of the host and they were very helpful in suggesting areas to park at if you did not want to use a permit. I would definitely stay here again it met all my needs and was a great deal!
Nice neighborhood
Wonderful communication! Iris took great care making sure my family was comfortable! Great accommodations and location. Thank you!!

Thank you for the wonderful stay in the room, which was lovingly furnished with great design sensibility and featured a perfectly equipped kitchen. Everything was clean, and the bed was comfortable. I’d especially like to highlight how well our communication went—the directions made it very easy to find the apartment. Thank you so much!

This unit is very stylish. Well located on the north side. Close to bike paths and the lake.
Recommended.
Had a great stay! Place has all you need and Martha was super kind and helpful!

I loved staying here. It was a comfortable apartment in a perfect location and the host was very responsive no matter what time I reached out. Everyone in the building was friendly. Overall a great vibe.

Overall the place was ok, the check in directions were easy to follow. The location was close to downtown. Parking is very limited. Prior to booking I saw that someone else had an issue with the AC I message to confirm that the AC problem was fixed it was confirmed that it was. When we got there only the portable AC was plugged up. After the first night of being really hot and trying to get the nest to work that controlled the system AC I messaged the host. He gave steps on the portable AC and told me someone was going to come see about it. No one  ever came by I told the host there was no follow up on this issue. I was hot inside even with the portable AC especially as night. All the rooms also had fans but it still hot !

Laura’s place was a decent value for a 3BR apartment with a washer and dryer in-unit. The water was hot, the A/C was cool, and the beds were comfortable. The host was also friendly and a great communicator.
However, the place is sorely in need of some TLC. Described as “modern and peaceful” as well as “immaculately clean,” we found it none of these things. The walls were scuffed and stained, the bathroom floor is peeling off, and there is a very distinct smell that, despite the multiple odor absorbers around the apartment, lingered. The living room area rug was covered in dirt and hair. Also note the surrounding “neighborhood” is a two-block street with a few hole-in-the-wall restaurants. The apartment is located on a noisy traffic corner.
This is a fine budget Airbnb if you need a safe place to store your things, a hot shower and a comfortable bed to sleep in at night. But the description is misleading, so I hope to help manage others’ expectations so you won’t be disappointed.

Great location if you’re going to a game at Rate Field as it is one train stop away. Easy access to downtown as well. Lacks some of the creature comforts one usually expects at this price point. WiFi is essentially on par with what you get on an airplane, so forget about streaming anything (no TV either). And whatever you do, DO NOT go on the fire escape as it doesn’t actually go to the ground and you can be locked out of the building (learned this the hard way).

We came from MN towing a uhaul trailer so we drove our Ford F150 super crew cab. Parking was tricky but it worked and was well worth staying here with the off street parking. The apartment was super clean & cute. Plenty of space for us. Delicious coffee was just down the street (d*mn fine coffee). Easy access to the bus & train. We will definitely be back since this is such a close and convenient place to our daughter’s apartment. We’ll just make sure to drive our smaller SUV for easier parking!
We had a fantastic time, the apartment is lovely and in a terrific location!
Enjoyed our stay!

This place worked out great for us. Plenty of room to gather togeather and big enough to not feel like we were all on top of each other. We had our three girls and the grandparents for the trip and everyone loved it!

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and matched the listing. The host was responsive and helpful whenever we had questions. The location was convenient, and check-in and check-out were easy. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to others.
The hosts were fantastic. The location amazing. The place was very clean and so relaxing. We recommend it for any family or group looking for the perfect Chicago stay!
This place was absolutely perfect for staying in Chicago!! Lovely neighbourhood and very clean😊 Very close to the trains and short uber into the city centre. Would definitely recommend!!

Really loved staying at Tj's place.   It matched the description and photos and was super clean when we arrived.    The neighborhood is great with lots of restaurants and very easy access to the "L" just across the street.   Great communication during the entire stay.   Would definitely recommend and stay here again when in Chicago.

Unbelievable communication from Laura and a lovely place to stay at! It’s in a great spot with everything you need around you
Would truly recommend 🙌🏼

This is our second stay at Daniel's place. First time was in October, now July. Both times of the year have been great to stay there. We love the location and it has all we need for a short trip. Daniel is responsive if you need anything at all. We hope to be back soon!
Great host and place to stay
Cute and comfortable apartment. Very close to the action in Andersonville and just a few blocks to the lakefront. Parking was fairly easy. Overall we really enjoyed our stay!

We absolutely loved our stay here! We had our 2 year old toddler with us, and Margaret made sure the high chair, toys, snacks, and pack and play were all set up for him when we arrived. I thought it was more spacious than it looked in the photos and we were very comfortable the whole time. The location is honestly PERFECT. There are so many cute restaurants and shops nearby (you can literally see a donut shop from the front door), plus we were able to walk to the beautiful park across the street and Lincoln Park Zoo. We felt safe the entire time and would definitely stay here again!

Debra's place was an oasis  that we'd love coming back to over and over again. It was conveniently located in the heart of the vibrant Edgewater neighborhood, within walking distance of great dining options, shopping, cafes and bars and we couldn't have asked for more. Our hosts were also incredibly friendly and went out of their way to respond quickly and thoughtfully every time we had questions about anything. Will definitely be back when we are back in the city again.

Our stay was great! Billy was so responsive to all my questions and the unit was completely as described in the listing. We are from chicago and stayed at the unit while we had some renovations done to our place, and I have already recommended it to folks who are planning to visit.
Just as described, great location for Cubs games and walkable to anything we needed. Would use David’s place again.

Fantastic stay! The house was clean, comfortable, well located, and exactly as described in the listing. Communication from the host was prompt and helpful throughout. Everything was easy from check-in to check-out. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!
Nate has thought of everything to make this a welcoming and comfortable place!

The first night I was there I found a spider in a bug on my bed. I reached out to the host and she told me it’s nothing really that she can do about it. I asked if she could switch my room. She told me no that was very inconsiderate since I’ve paid my money.
Our stay was great! The place is beautiful and had great amenities. Communication was prompt. Street parking was a bit hard to find sometimes. Would definitely stay here again!
The apartment was as described and had everything we needed. It was great having a parking space included!

It is so much better than the photos, a complete gem. The house is beautifully decorated, and you can feel the history and the artistic effort behind it. The brick walls immerse you in the charm of Chicago’s architectural style. It’s perfect for anyone looking for more than just a place to stay.
Would recommend and will be back again!! Well worth the cost! Great hospitality!
Very nice apartment. Great location, spotless and spacious. The bed is really comfortable. We had a great time!

Beautiful apartment, extremely responsive host.  Walkable to CTA, restaurants and bars.  Gorgeous neighborhood.  If you want a place in a quieter neighborhood but still accessible, this is an awesome place.

Jackpaul is awesome at responding to my messages right away. Very friendly and attentive. The location of the place is perfect where it’s still in the city but with somewhat of a suburb feel. The place was clean and included extra towels and sheets. All amenities listed was there. Didn’t come with parking but we had no problem finding parking on the street. I would definitely book again.
Very much enjoyed the location and the accommodations. Great restaurant in the same building and beautiful park across the street.
Great location for so many great activities. inclusion of a parking space is huge for anyone  visiting Chicago with a car.
Had a great stay. It was a wonderful place and an awesome location. Parking was easy. The host really seems to care about making sure you have a great experience.

Great stay loved the home just didn’t like the fact we couldn’t use the hot tub room at all because it was so hot.. & if your on the bigger side the toilet and shower are super close together lol everything else was great

Stay was good, transportation was easily accessible due to it being a short walk. Neighborhood wasn’t bad, only problem we encountered was bugs. Specifically centipedes and beetles in the rooms and living room. Overall place wasn’t bad.
Charming, respectful, and interesting hosts offering a great space in a perfect location. This is a gem. Wholeheartedly recommend.

The host waited until our check-in time to clean the bnb and we were waiting around for 30 minutes. The tub had lots of sand in it. Maintenance came while we were there and accidentally shut off our water access. Finally the bnb manager, while a very nice lady, told us we could park in the alley as long as we didn’t block it, yet, we woke up to a ticket. Wouldn’t recommend.
Beautiful, perfect location, felt right at home. Nick was a great host.
Loved our stay! Great location, walkable to restaurants and grant park. Very clean and spacious. Host was responsive and kind.
Great place to stay and I appreciated the secured garage to park my car in. Overall great hosts and I would recommend this Airbnb!
This is a very comfortable place to stay that is close to a lot of fun places and restaurants. Amazing value! This is perfect people who like smaller and cozy places. We loved it!!!

While the host is responsive, place was clean and had a great location, it needed some maintenance. Pink bedroom was missing a blind so light shined in all night. Upstairs ac stopped working and it would’ve required us to drain it when I reached out or have them come drain it. The upstairs blind was broken and not blocking street level lights. Has great potential just needs some thoughtful updates.
Awesome stay for a family of four.  Parking was super easy and the apartment was great!
Solid, safe, comfortable spot in a great neighborhood.

Great location!  We have been to Chicago at least 15 times and have never stayed in this area.  We will def be back!  A different vibe from staying closer to downtown.  Walkable to Lincoln Park ( a few blocks) and even downtown if you aren't in a hurry....30 minutes or so.  A 2 min walk to Secind City, which is a must do.  Too many amazing restaurants within 5 minutes walk to even mention them all!  The home was perfect and very spacious!  Very quiet and safe.  Thank you and we will be back!
Had a wonderful time with my family here! It was a great location and our host made us feel very welcomed!!
La description correspond très bien à ce que j'ai reçu. L'hôtesse répond très vite au message. Endroit très propre. J'y retournerais si jamais je retourne à Chicago. Merci Adriana!

Great stay! The host was kind, responsive, and very accommodating throughout our trip. Communication was smooth and they were always happy to help whenever we had a question. We really appreciated their hospitality!

Thank you Tim for hosting me on this long journey! With how close everything was to Wrigley and the helpful instructions, it made Chicago feel like my second home. Hope to catch you around another season in the Windy City! Again, thank you for the hospitality!

Daisy’s place was exactly as described and perfect for my family’s stay while they helped me move! Spacious, clean, and close to everything we needed to do, I absolutely will have this host saved for any time my family comes in to town!
Excellent place. Tracee communicated well with us. The only advice is to have pest control since we observed several small cockroach in the bathrooms.
Liked this location. Always a good experience with this team. Thank you again for your service.

Staying at this apartment managed by Brad was an absolute pleasure. Nestled right within the University of Chicago campus, the location strikes the perfect balance between safety and convenience. You can easily walk to Target, Trader Joe's, and a variety of great restaurants.
Brad keeps the property in pristine condition; it’s impeccably clean, fully equipped with everything you need, and the check-in process was effortless. His communication was incredibly fast and helpful, making the overall experience a perfect 10 out of 10. Highly recommended! It’s clear that Brad puts a tremendous amount of care into managing this place.

Great location. Spacious apt
Great host. Would stay again.
Carl & Denis were great hosts.  I had a nice stay.
It was a good place and nice neighborhood, me and my friend enjoyed our time here and would come back

When my husband and I travel with our M/teen and F/teen finding a hotel room is always hard. No so with this Quad! It was perfect! Add in easy check-in, great staff, felt so safe, keys for elevator and ideal location made it a hit with everyone! Would stay here again in a minute!
Beautiful place, definitely coming back.  Michael was so nice
Good, convenient, and safe place to stay. The location was great, and the overall experience was positive. Billy was responsive!

Appartement tout neuf avec une vue incroyable dans les pièces (les fenêtres du sol au plafond sont epoustanflantes). Super amenities dans l’immeuble. Très pratique et rapide pour aller dans le centre en métro . Enfin Ben est un excellent hôte.

Musa it was a great host and apartment was well suited. They only seen was one of the bedrooms walk-through but other than that it was nice and clean and really well located in heart of Chicago convenient to downtown and never send it. We would need thank you

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, with everything we needed. The location was perfect for exploring Chicago, with plenty of great restaurants, attractions, and public transportation nearby.
The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in and check-out incredibly easy. The space felt safe, cozy, and well-maintained, making it easy to relax after a day of exploring the city.
I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!
My family LOVED this apartment. It is clean, roomy, and in a great location.  Check-in was smooth. There are plenty of stores and restaurants within walking distance. I would stay here again.

It was so nice staying in this cool apartment over a few hot days in July. Everything worked fine, and there were no problems at all. I didn’t know much about the neighborhood beforehand -- it was a very pleasant surprise. It always felt safe, and I saw a lot of friendly people out and about. There are some good grocery stores and dining options within walking distance.

We loved staying at Heather’s place in Old Town. It is the perfect spot if you are driving in and want a safe place to park and leave your car. On a cul de sac street, so low traffic. A safe, peaceful, family neighborhood super walkable to the L (brown/purple) and places like Second City, Lincoln Park Zoo, North Ave. beach, and lots of restaurants. As someone who lived in this neighborhood 20 years ago, it was the PERFECT place to stay and I will absolutely recommend it to anyone I know looking for a place to stay in Chicago!

This was a great stay ! Located in the vibrant Hyde Park neighborhood! Really close to Lakeshore Dr. Super clean! I was on the main floor and my private bathroom was right next door to my room. Mini fridge in the room that was stocked with bottled water! It is street parking but I didn’t have too much trouble finding a spot. I would definitely stay here again!

We had a fantastic stay at AG's Airbnb and would definitely book it again. Parking was easy, and I had no problem fitting my medium sized pickup truck in the back. The location is great. It's about a 10 minute walk to the Argyle Red Line station, which makes getting downtown quick and easy. The lake, several restaurants, coffee shops, and other amenities are all within walking distance.
The neighborhood felt very safe and was quiet the entire time we were there. We came to Chicago for a wrestling event where CM Punk became World Champion, and this Airbnb was the perfect home base for our trip.
We had an amazing time, and we're already looking forward to coming back. It's honestly too bad we have to leave. Thanks again, AG
Great stay
Gayet iyi
host was amazing! quick to help and made sure we had everything we needed! the bnb was very clean! would stay again

We had a great time during our stay in Chicago. We travelled with two little kids so location was a top requirement for us. And we were pleased to find that the location was in Chicago downtown (as described) with CTA bus and Loop trains available right around the corner. Lots of restaurants around the property which was a huge plus. The unit was on 11th floor with 3 bedroom and 2 bathrooms and had great views. The master bedroom was a little congested as the King bed is huge for that space but overall we loved every bit of our stay. I recommend Dream rentals for a peaceful stay.

This place has so much character. Laurie is very accommodating.  It was great having a backyard to relax in.  The neighborhood felt safe to walk around in.  We had extra family join us at the last minute and she went out and bought more towels so we would have enough.  We loved all the plants and garden.
Stellar place, would stay again. Rob was super helpful!

Todo estuvo muy bien durante nuestra estancia aquí! La relación - precio/calidad está muy excelente.
Está en una zona segura - hay que caminar un poco para alcanzar el metro; sin embargo hay muchos camiones.

This was the perfect place for myself and my family. The place was nice and clean the neighbors were very friendly . I am coming back to Chicago in December I hope this place will be available. Brandon our host was very friendly and the communication with him was great thank you so much for letting us stay at your home.
Kris

Anthony & Paul had possibly THE best Airbnb for the North side of Chicago.
I forgot my toiletries and they had everything, even a salon professional hair dryer. Better yet, there was a yoga mat in the closet.
The inside was spotless, and it felt like 5 star-hotel level cleanliness.
They are both very communicative if you have any issues, but you probably never will!
It's a great place and great host. I would recommend.

We loved our stay in the West Loop! The space was huge, it is great for a large party. Our kids loved staying in “the penthouse .” It is well maintained and walkable to so many great restaurants and shops. The host was very responsive and helpful. We would absolutely stay again!

The place was very spacious and in a great location. Everything was comfortable and as expected. The only minor drawback was that the Wi-Fi could have been faster and more stable. Overall, we had a great stay.

The rental was just as described. Clean, great walkable location, spacious apartment with a beautiful, private, terrace overlooking the city. We spent all of our downtime on the terrace. There are so many restaurants and shops within walking distance, we didn’t even need our car (which was safely parked in the controlled-access parking garage)! Would stay here again the next time we are in Chicago and would definitely recommend it to others. My two teenaged boys loved it too!

It was indeed a great stay . Don't think you are staying in a small apartment it's pretty big and nice
Building is too nice and so is our host 😁

I enjoyed my stay at Kasa.  It’s a great location and the room has almost everything you need.  I will say that the knives they provide are terrible and they don’t cut anything.  And the plastic cutting board with bad knives means micro plastics are going in the food you make.
The place was perfect for me. Great location and the home was clean and very spacious.
Could be cleaned a little better. However, good location in relation to a lot of areas. Great walkable neighborhood. Besides the cleaning situation overall a great stay !
This apartment was exactly as described and what we were expecting.  Everyone we met in the neighborhood was super friendly.
Everything was amazing!! Great location

Our stay was great. The apartment had everything described in the listing, and was in such a good location. Great stores close by for shopping. Fantastic restaurants everywhere.
The place was really clean, and had everything we needed. Parking was easy and free on the street also. There were a few times we had to walk 2-3 blocks, but it wasn’t bad. There’s also public parking connected to the building that has a few spaces available if you don’t mind paying. We will definitely stay here again!
It was okay

Upon arrival, we discovered significant flooding, water intrusion in both bedrooms, a strong mold and mildew odor, and a broken bed. The smaller bedroom was immediately unusable, and the master bedroom was also unusable due to flooding and water damage with mildew and mold odor. The building engineer and maintenance supervisor, Herman, confirmed the severity of the flooding and advised repairs were required.
Both bedrooms and part of the living room were affected, making the property unsuitable for occupancy. Traveling with children, we had to secure emergency accommodations. Airbnb instructed us to relocate and advised that refund and reimbursement would be provided.
The Host failed to respond until the following day despite repeated attempts. We vacated the unit, provided photos, videos, receipts, and documentation, and fully cooperated. Despite clear evidence, the Host and Airbnb have not provided a full refund or reimbursement. I request escalation for a fair resolution.

would stay here again. host was responsive and the house was nice. only complaint is 25$ early check in for being 20 minutes early and the dishes werent cleaned before arriving. i opted for buying paper plates and silverware while there. other than that i recommend this place!
Great spot with a great location - close by to plenty of transit stops. The place was very clean and the rooms were very spacious. Highly recommend!

We had a very nice stay at Donna’s apartment and really enjoyed our time there. Donna was a kind, responsive host and communication was always easy. The apartment was exactly as advertised, and we appreciated that it had everything we needed for our stay. The kitchen was well equipped for basic cooking, all appliances worked well, and we also liked the green surroundings with so many trees nearby.
The location worked well for us too: there was a bus stop close by, and we found it easy to reach most sights in Chicago by public transportation.
The apartment was quiet enough for us overall, but guests who are sensitive to noise should know that there can be some street noise and occasionally noise from neighbors because the building is not very soundproof.
Overall, we had a very good stay and would happily recommend Donna’s place.
Great accommodation ..

Perfect Chicago apartment for solo travelers! Clean, comfy, and fully equipped with everything you need. The skyline views at sunset and night are absolutely breathtaking. Unbeatable location within walking distance of the main sights. Highly recommend, and I’ll definitely be back!

Well maintained.  I am a repeat visitor and I’d for sure stay again.  The owner has made improvements to the space and continued to maintain the property which gives me confidence when I book it.   Love the west loop, great for families.

The host is excellent and the location is top notch, but as noted in other reviews, the street noise is extreme.
Only reason it wasn't five stars (wish I could give it 4.5) was that all of the furniture and accessories were cheap; there was no comfortable place to sit in the entire apartment.

My husband and I stayed for a couple of days at Becky's, and we had such a wonderful time. It's been ten years since we visited our roots in Chicago, and Becky's place made it that much more magical. Great location, peaceful, easy to park (thanks for the parking passes!), comfortable bed, and Roo, their dog, was adorable and very friendly. Highly recommend staying with them!

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment was clean, modern, spacious, and perfect for our family of four. It had everything we needed and was in a great location for exploring Chicago. The building felt safe, the host was responsive, and the entire experience was seamless from check-in to check-out. We would definitely stay here again. Highly
Great room and a great location

Pretty good private place, clean have everything what's needed. Quite cold, especially comparing to hot outside. Responsive and friendly host.
In 2 minutes on foot from Subway stastion. 15 minutes on subway from Downtown. So quite good place to reach out anything in Chicago.
We enjoyed our stay. It was as described and comfortable.

Wonderful, cozy and clean. This place has vintage charm with modern updates. The design, layout, and natural light made it inviting for my family and Emily and Roya could not have been nicer hosts. Access to the brown line and a park across the street made it an ideal location. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Our stay at the Solar Lodge was wonderful and James and Colin were the perfect hosts. We had such a peaceful and relaxing stay - highly recommend.

Nossa estadia foi maravilhosa. A casa é exatamente como as fotos. Local limpo e aconchegante, com privacidade e preparado com muitos detalhes que melhoram a estadia. Localização excelente. Com certeza voltaria. Excelente anfitriã.
Good place to stay
Great stay , clean environment, the pool table was a nice addition only thing i would’ve like if we were able to control the thermostat it did get kind of hot in there at random times

I have stayed in Sylvia's Quiet Room multiple times and plan to continue staying here, when I visit Chicago. The rooms are tidy. The location is fantastic and Sylvia is an excellent, respectful and kind host.
Lovely place in the heart of Chicago. We loved the view, the privacy, and our kids loved the pool!

Heather’s place is absolutely gorgeous and in such a family friendly location. Me and my family immediately felt right at home. We have two under three and there was a baby bed, feeding chair, changing table, books, toys, toddler dining table and pretty much everything that helped my children settle in with ease. Heather has the place stocked with toiletries and kitchen items. I could have shown up with the shirt on my back and I would  have everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The neighborhood is top-tier. There are several playgrounds and I felt safe walking after 9 p.m. The master bathroom was one of my favorite spaces in the home. It’s considered an apartment, but very spacious. We didn’t want to leave!

Edward was a friendly and responsive host.  The kitchen was well stocked (appreciated the ice in the freezer), street parking was easy, TV was huge, and the neighborhood was safe and quiet and surrounded by good restaurants (especially Italian).  It was easy to get to the Loop.  We had a water issue on a holiday weekend evening and Edward promptly got someone out to fix it, probably paying emergency rates to make us comfortable.

Very pleasant stay! Street parking was easy to find and always available. the neighborhood was quiet and safe. It was a quick drive to nearby restaurants and parks. AC mini-splits kept the rooms comfortable. The washer and dryer were easy to use and Shimmy provided some detergent. I'm glad I stayed here and will again in the future.

We had a great stay. The apartment is very spacious, with a full-size kitchen, dining room, living room, and two large bedrooms. It also has central A/C, which kept the apartment comfortable during our stay. The mattresses were comfortable, and we slept well throughout our stay.
Humma was a responsive and helpful host who replied quickly whenever we had a question.
The apartment is located on the second floor in South Chicago. We felt safe in the neighborhood, even in the evening. Transportation was convenient - you can take the #28 bus to Hyde Park, take bus #87 to the subway station, or walk about 15 minutes to the Metra Electric train, which runs about once an hour to downtown.
For longer stays, we found a nearby laundromat that worked well when we needed to do laundry.
Overall, this was a comfortable, spacious place to stay, and we would recommend it to others.

Very cute and spacious basement apartment. Convenient to 2 major bus lines. Host was available and responsive. As others have noted, ceilings a a little low (though the amount of space makes up for that) and summer air conditioning makes it chilly (which I loved but my spouse would not have lol). Excellent stay for the price!
I felt very at home. We had plenty of room to stretch out. Neighborhood is very walkable and overall safe. We would definitely rent again.

Jason and Bluebird Inn are the best! Comfortable and spacious apartment in a great location. The Long Room bar is right next door with yummy drink menu for afternoon/evening and delicious breakfast options and coffee selection for the morning.  This is our second visit so we would definitely stay again and highly recommend unless one flight of stairs is difficult to climb.
Great place to stay

The apartment was large, clean, and fit our needs for a 4-day stay. It was a quiet building and WiFi was great, so we were able to work remotely. Street parking was easy, about a block away on side streets. Fenton provided clear check-in and check-out instructions and was very responsive when we had questions and an issue with the TV. The place was walkable to restaurants on Southport and in Wrigleyville which we enjoyed. About half a mile to the El station to go downtown, right on bus lines, and about $20-30 for an Uber to the Loop. Would definitely recommend to others.

I was very satisfied with my stay at 747 Lofts. The loft was very close by the blue line train which got me to & from the airport in a timely manner. I was  able to store my luggage earlier than my check in time, which helped me tremendously! I will be booking again when I visit thank you so much for the great hospitality. This is a very cozy & comfortable place to live if you’re ever visiting Chicago & the price is unbeatable!
Beautiful house and room exactly as described.

We highly recommend this place as an excellent home base for a visit to Chicago. We were visiting Chicago for the first time with our 3 kids. This home was perfectly located - with easy access to two L stops and multiple bus lines. We used public transportation during our entire stay, and the location was perfect. Also, it was a very easy walk to Lincoln Park Zoo, North Avenue Beach, and Oak Street Beach. There were so many great restaurant options very close by. We loved being steps away from a popular street but still felt tucked away and quiet. The home was very clean and spacious. It worked very well for five people. The AC/fans, washing machine, and dryer all worked very well (which is so important when traveling with kids). Nicole and Matt were lovely hosts - they were responsive and helpful. We didn’t have any issues during our stay, but it was nice to know that they would have been quick to help us. We would definitely stay at this home again

This place was pretty nice, I will mention that there is a steep stair case that isn’t mentioned about which was a bit of a problem for us. The pillows are a little uncomfortable, but over all everything was great! Everything was clean and the neighbor hood wasn’t too bad. Also it’s really close to downtown which was perfect for us!
Great clean space close to the train as well as the beach
Good value location.

The stay was awesome. The room we rented was excellent, really clean and with a really comfortable bed. The bathroom was also amazingly clean and had a great shower .
The house is its own show, as it is a historical castle from the 19th century that Ryan and his father renovated.
We loved the house and the room, and I would recommend those for everyone.
Just as a general warning, the neighborhood is not as good as the house, but you should have a good stay by being street smart and not walking around at night
Nice place and clean
Place was clean nice neighborhood will recommend
Great location and space. Place provided all the things you needed for a stay for a large group. Yuanyuan was helpful and communicative throughout.

This home was perfect for my family of 5! It had everything we needed. The location is unmatched. Safe, walking distance to the L train, Wrigleyfield, and so many restaurants. We could easily catch a ball game and get into the heart of Chicago in the same day. The neighborhood is so safe and quaint- I was able to go for a run throughout the day and night without feeling anxious. We had a wonderful experience and the host was extremely friendly and responsive. Absolutely recommend this rental!

This was a very lovely place for our family of six parking was fairly easy and very walkable to nearby restaurants and attractions . Felt very safe. The host was very friendly, and the place was very clean.
Great place!  Highly recommend

Everything was exactly as described—or even better. We really enjoyed the location, and street parking was easily available just a couple of blocks from the house. The layout was perfect for our needs, and the home was exceptionally clean.
The only issue we encountered was that the Wi-Fi did not work during our stay. The host was responsive and tried to troubleshoot the problem by communicating back and forth, but I was busy at the time and wasn't able to respond, so we couldn't get it resolved.
Overall, we had a great stay and would highly recommend this place.
I think that the listing is great for the price you pay and what you get

Nice place and we had a great and peaceful stay!
Host was great with quick responses and we enjoyed our time at the place !

Very spacious room with a shared bathroom. I love how organized everything was, including the printed tapes on keys and shelves etc. Street parking is limited, so it's recommended to arrive before 10 PM, else it may take time to find free parking.

We had a wonderful two-week stay! The backyard truly felt like a private oasis and was one of our favorite parts of the home—a perfect place to relax.
The location worked out great for us. My husband loved taking Divvy bike rides and I thoroughly enjoyed my runs along the lake. It was the perfect home base for experiencing Chicago.
Chiaka is a fantastic host—friendly, responsive, and incredibly easy to communicate with throughout our stay. She made everything seamless from check-in to check-out.
We would happily stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago!
Great family spot close to playground
The place was beautiful and they were very responsive!
Great place. Great host. I'd come back. Highly recommend.

Near Chinatown and downtown Chicago, the location was convenient to access where you want to go in Chicago. The alley to access the parking spot is quite narrow and tight, but a designated parking spot is a huge merit as street parking gets full pretty fast in the evening. Kevin was always responsive and replied very fast. We had someone parking on our spot, Kevin resolved the issue pretty fast for us. The neighborhood is pretty quiet at night, which was great for family to stay. The stay was mostly great!
Great!
Very nice, highly recommend staying here.
Very welcoming place, close to a lot of things, the view is amazing and the amenities are top tier. Definitely will be back!
Excelente lugar, muy acogedor y tranquilo recomendado

We have wonderful memories of our stay in this beautiful house. From the moment we opened the door, we felt welcomed. Everything was spotless, neat, and well organized. The host was kind, responsive, and very helpful. The backyard was lush, beautifully maintained, and a joy to spend time in. We especially loved the creative ideas for the climbing plants and creepers.
We would definitely recommend this house to anyone looking for a comfortable and memorable stay.
It’s walkable to the Wrigley Field, and it’s 5 mins away, super close to red line station.

El alojamiento estaba en una buena ubicación. Las instrucciones fueron sumamente claras. Ming estuvo todo el tiempo atenta a cualquier mensaje o contratiempo. El alojamiento es descrito de manera clara, y está en una zona tranquila, y donde hay muchos lugares para comer cerca. También está relativamente cerca de el centro de Chicago.
Enjoyed by stay at Nichola’s place. Places was clean and peaceful. He was also very accommodating. Highly recommended.

One of the best spaces we have stayed in when visiting Chicago, felt much more like a home than an airbnb.
Min and Yoel were very responsible and very kindly let us extend our stay. We will be sure to visit again!
We had a great time staying at Matt's place. He was extremely friendly and the neighborhood was perfect

Nice place. It was very hot in Chicago when we were there. The upper floor was a bit warm. Hayk mentioned that using the fans would have helped level the temp on both floors.
Only 4 of us, so plenty of room. Great to have the dining table for meals.
Kitchen is well-stocked.
It is close to El train, so you can hear it.
Back deck was nice. Deck umbrella would have been useful as it was so hot.
Overall, the place worked out very well for our stay.
Gave Hayk a couple improvement suggestions and said they would take care of it forthwith. Hayk responded very quickly to our questions.
Thank you Hayk!

Great stay, beautiful environment and loved the views. The space was nice and tidy, the Wi-Fi was going in and out though , but I’m sure it was because of the rain. Apart from that, I hope to be back! Thank you

Deborah was very kind and accommodating for my stay in Chicago! She even went as far as to give me recommendations of things to do in the city while I was here. The Airbnb itself was as described and in good condition. Thank you Deborah!
I'm obsessed and I want to live here forever. Couldn't have been any happier with this place, it's amazing!
Great apartment and service in a wonderful building and neighborhood. Thank you!

We really enjoyed our stay! The place was very cute, clean, and in a great walkable location. The host team was also very responsive whenever I reached out with questions.
I did experience the same issues that other guests have mentioned regarding the overhead lighting in the bedrooms and the dryer not functioning properly. While neither issue significantly impacted our stay, it would be nice to see them addressed.
The only other suggestion would be to provide a few more essentials for longer stays. There were five of us staying for six days, and only two rolls of toilet paper and one roll of paper towels were provided. It wasn't a major inconvenience, I just made a quick trip to Target to pick up what we needed, but having a little more stocked initially would have been appreciated.
Overall, we had a great stay and would absolutely stay here again.

We've stayed with Lynette and Efrain several times. They are the best hosts we've ever encountered.  Their apartment feels like a second home to us.  It is filled with light and immaculate.  Great park at the end of the block, especially for children.  We take our 2 year old grandson there whenever we come to visit.   We can't recommend their place more!   Steve and Linda

The locations of this rental is great and the parking is a huge plus.
Aesthetic of the place is nice. Beds are incredibly comfortable, and the kitchen was fully equipped.
The listing mentions that it’s renovated which I’m sure it was because it has a beautiful aesthetic. However, I think this was a bit ago. The place is not freshly renovated as the listing makes it sound. The floors and doors are creaky. The windows are incredibly thin, you can hear conversations people are having outside by the sidewalk when you’re sitting in the living room. The place is located 2 streets away from a fire station so you hear fire sirens ALL day long. This rental is located right above a restaurant so you hear loud music starting at ~9am until.
Overall we had an okay stay, had it been a weekend stay I think it would have been perfect, however, since it was a month long stay the noise and other little things got to us.

Really nice quiet
and comfortable place. Loved the location, felt safe and easy walk to the science museum. Free on street parking.
