Tuvimos una muy grata y cómoda estadia en el alojamiento. El vecindario es tranquilo y lindo para pasear, con excelente colectividad y comercio local. Beca se preocupo de hacernos saber que estaba siempre disponible por si necesitábamos de ayuda.  Lo pasamos genial en Chicago y sin duda lo cercano al centro ayudo con ello.  Recomiendo 100% a Beca y su alojamiento.

Great neighborhood and very walkable. The apartment was perfect for us... Plenty of room and the shower is hot. Parking is a little bit of a chore but Parkwhiz had a cheap spot a few houses down... Would definitely stay again. Perfect spot for a Cubs game weekend trip!

Awesome house with great host. Very convenient commute to the city both in bus and red line and just one block away from grocery store and five minutes walk to the lake shore. Definitely recommend whoever visits Chicago for business trip and for leisure.
Great location and attention from the host.

Location, location, LOCATION!!!!!!! Penthouse in a beautiful historic home in the best part of the city. Dream location between rush and the lake on the gold coast. It truly does not get better than that for a Chicago experience. You can walk to everything from the best restaurants to the best shopping in the city. Beautiful unit. You do have to walk up 3 flights of stairs, but I didn't find that to be an issue at all and we had kids with us.
My only critique is that the beds and linens really weren't that comfortable. For a PH, I'd expect better quality beds. That being said the location trumps everything. There are not a lot of AirBnbs in this part of the city.
I want to buy this unit!!
Great location for visiting U Chicago. Easy on street parking.

Super affordable and convenient place to stay during the 4th of July with a very lively and fun neighborhood. Alejandro was friendly and accommodating. Would definitely stay again if I'm ever back with a large group.
Great place—only downside was bathroom was across the hall (not in room) but overall great location and the hosts were very responsive and helpful!
Very professional. I loved how there was videos for everything. I do wish they had a few extra towels available

We absolutely loved our stay! The unit was beautiful, but the balcony and unbeatable location truly made it exceptional. Everything was comfortable, clean, and exactly what we were hoping for. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend!
Place was so spacious perfects for family staying together and way better than staying at hotels and got a great deal!

Amazing area, amazing staff.  On premise amenities are outstanding.  8th floor shared space is great for working, entertaining, and simply relaxing.  Sports lounge has billiards, darts, shuffle board, ski ball, etc.  Staff is beyond friendly and helpful.  The building, rooms, elevators, shared space, and pool patio and grill area and constantly cleaned and maintained by the dedicated building staff.  Front desk personnel such as Nina, Josh, Daniel, and Kelli always made us feel at home during our 31 day adventure in The Windy.  The location is amazing with the DialTone coffee bar in the lobby, Aldi literally connected to the property, a Fresh Market a block down, not to mention the 100's of restaurants, pubs, and speakeasys all within a 5 minute walk.  A quick walk north puts you in Lincoln Park or a few blocks South to River North.  Lakeshore Trail is only few blocks to the East.  We will definitely return to Level at Old Town Park for another extended stay!
Nice and clean place in a friendly neighbourhood.

Had a lovely time staying at Francisco's. Had some light coming in the bedroom that I was sensitive to, but it was very comfortable. Low ceilings but not at all musty. Glad to have a car, but also walkable to Walgreens, Dunkin, and some local restaurants. Barely heard Francisco upstairs. Loved the decorations.

We really enjoyed our stay at Michael's place! He was so kind, communicated all details clearly, provided local recommendations and even allowed us to check in early. The apartment was clean and was in a GREAT location! Walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants,  Lincoln Park, the lakefront and an easy bike ride to downtown. We would definitely stay here again!
Great stay in a great location! Thank you!

Beautiful townhouse.  Looked just like the pictures.  Host was very responsive.  Only a 5 min walk to a CTA train on the Blue Line, making it very easy to get to downtown.  There’s a Target only 3 blocks away for groceries, etc.  Parking is TIGHT but I had a van and was able to back in okay.  Nice balance between being very near city center but far enough away to be quieter.
The AirBnb was amazing. Felt right at home.  The host was also very responsive.

We had a wonderful and comfortable 5-night stay at this property. It was the perfect home base for exploring Chicago—close enough to downtown (about a 20-minute drive) .The home is beautiful, spacious, and comfortably accommodated all six of us. Everything was exceptionally clean, and the well-stocked kitchen had everything we needed to prepare several meals during our stay. It truly felt like a home away from home.
A couple of us needed to work during the trip, and the house provided a quiet, comfortable space to do so. We also loved spending time in the backyard, making s'mores around the fire pit. our family enjoyed watching FIFA games together in the cozy living room. The bathrooms were spotless and generously stocked with plenty of fresh towels. Street parking was easy to find during the day, parking permit provided. Parking could be a bit more challenging at night, but were able to find a spot on nearby streets within a short walk.
Overall, a fantastic stay and highly recommend.
Great place! Great location! You should book!

This unit was in a great location for us, very close to a friends apartment. The loft layout with a large kitchen / living room was great for us to relax in.
That said, it needs some TLC - tender, loving care. While we were there, there were three separate ceiling leaks from the A/C unit / roof, two in the living room and one in the hallway bathroom. The damage at the most active leak in the living room, indicated that it was not new.
To bring out the trash and recycling we were told to exit through a basement door into an alleyway where the bins were located. Two times we couldn’t get out due to a delivery truck blocking the door. Another time we were unsuccessful because the trash bins were blocking the door.
This could really be a fantastic unit with more ongoing attention and maintenance.
Very clean, homey apartment for your Chicago trip. Close to subway station so the whole city is accessible! Host was extremely accommodating and was very responsive.
Great peaceful place to stay and an excellent host! Highly recommend!
Our stay was excellent.  The place was clean and well equipped.  Nearby were some excellent restaurants.  The blue line was about 15 minutes away.
Beautiful property!

We definitely recommend this place! The communication was excellent, and the hosts were always responsive and helpful whenever we needed anything. We really appreciated their kindness, support, and attention throughout our stay.

I had such a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend this place! The location was very convenient, close to downtown and made it easy to get around the city. The home was clean, comfortable & exactly as described.
What really made this stay special was the host. She was incredibly kind, thoughtful and genuinely helpful. I had a few questions about transportation and instead of just sending directions, she took the time to record screen videos walking me through everything step by step. It was such a thoughtful gesture and made navigating the city so much easier. That level of care really stood out to me.
A special thank you to Jennifer, the housekeeping lady. She always greeted with the warmest smile and had such a calm, respectful presence. She was incredibly proactive about keeping the shared spaces spotless, often cleaning the bathroom shortly after it was used yet she did it so quietly and naturally that it never felt intrusive.
Thank you for such a lovely stay ❤️😊

Great place to stay in
Only issue was the noise from the train station and the city that starts early in the morning
Besides, the appartment is very nice

Bridget’s place was a lifesaver for me when I needed somewhere to stay last minute with my 2 cats! Super spacious, clean, had everything you needed. She was responsive & easy to get in contact with.
Would definitely recommend! :)

This apt is very good location.The place was clean and nice as described! The 3rd floor was a bit challenging for walking upstairs with luggage’s on your hands.
Stair case was dark when and smelly because of its old rugs. We got an allergy and sneezing constantly in the apt.
We came in to Chicago early to drove to the location about 2:00 PM, soaking wet due to the rained storm and asked a permission to check in early. The host declined a request and informed us that the cleaner was still cleaning the place. In facts, he did not know that we were there, outside the apt and knocked on the door and there was no one there about 2:30 pm
We went for foods shopping in soaking wet and check in late about 4:00 PM.
There are things that host could managed a bit better while an apt was vacated, but he sticked the rule of 3 pm check in .

Our family of 4 had the perfect trip to Chicago and much was because of this fantastic rental with great hosts.  The location is perfect for walking all over Chicago while practically being on the beach.  We loved the views of Lake Michigan from the unit/breakfast nook as well as the roof.  The toiletries, laundry, space in general was great.  The building is very secure and safe.  We would absolutely book this unit again in the future and highly recommend to others looking.  The master bedroom was bigger than expected.  The view of the lake were better than expected.  The size of the unit in general was bigger than expected.
Maybe my fave stay ever. I loved everything about it except the lack of shade on the deck and the running toilet. Both hit a big deal. Hope to come back and stay sometime!
Very nice place to stay. We had a great time and were able to do everything we wanted to do, very close to the L

We had a great stay, and the property is in an excellent, convenient location! The hosts were wonderfully communicative, exceptionally kind, and very open to thoughts and comments. They even proactively sent photos of the specific kitchen utensils, pots, and pans ahead of time, which allowed us to know exactly what to bring with us to prepare a special dinner for our daughter’s 21st birthday.
Just be mindful of a few limitations depending on your party size and needs. The front porch requires walking up 10 steps, which is helpful to know for anyone with mobility concerns. Additionally, seating can be tight for groups of eight or more, and the kitchen is best suited for limited meal prep. We did need to supply our own garbage bags, dish towels, and pot holders, which was a bit unusual, but it was an easy remedy. Thanks for allowing us to stay at your location.
Amazing location and views! Very easy to get in and out of as well!
Everything at Charlie’s place was excellent. From the moment you checked in you feel right at home, easy access and she’s a great communicator. Will be excited to work with her again!
Rented this place out for my 20th birthday & absolutely loved it, felt at home and all
brandon was super responsive and a great host, highly recommend
Great aria
Loved staying here! Close to the bus and subway. It was such a quiet neighborhood and the place has such charm for almost being 100 years old. Made me fall in love with Avondale! 10/10 stay!
The place was great had everything you need a home away from home

Magnifique appartement associé à un très chouette projet artistique. Matthew est aux petits soins pour ses hotes, ses recommandations sont des vrais bons plans, est ses instructions complètes et compréhensibles; l'appartement est confortable et plus spacieux que sur les photos, literie confortable, machine à laver et séchoir opérationnels avec produits disponibles, situation idéale dans Chicago à proximité de la blue line. Une perle !

Very cute and homey little space. It was a good size place for 2 people. It was clean, had the amenities we needed, and the neighborhood offered a variety of shops and restaurants. Also, being close to the beach and the red line was a plus. Walter was a good host, giving clear instructions for check in and check out. I would definitely stay here under Walter’s hospitality again!

This is a great house. We had a family gathering there over the fourth of July, and found the space great for being together but also big enough and separated enough that people could have their own space as well. Also, the location is great--very short walk to a bus or Metra, and a not bad walk to the train. Would absolutely stay here again.

Tuvimos una muy buena estancia con Abby. La comunicación perfecta, todo estaba en orden. El barrio está genial, y la calle donde está la casa muy bonito. Abby nos facilitó aparcar en la misma calle de la casa, todo gratis. Muy recomendable la estancia. Espero repetir.
Very responsive and always comes in clutch when I travel to chi which is every week

Great stay! We stayed for 2 nights and the place came with everything we needed. For the price, I can’t complain. I would consider the area quite as well. A lower middle class stay (nothing wrong with that). I would definitely book here again.
Amazing stay

Kwan’s place in Rodger’s park was perfect for our family!  It was very spacious, clean and quiet. Walkable to local restaurants and coffee and easy access to the rest of Chicago and Evanston. Would definitely stay again!

Apartment in a great location, minutes from beach, CTA, shops and restaurants. It was comfortable and clean and the area felt safe. Musa was extremely responsive to any questions we had… literally within minutes each time, and he was very flexible and helpful. I will book this apartment again if I come back to Chicago

We really enjoyed our stay in this 3 bedroom unit. The place was clean, comfortable, spacious, and had city views that included the Chicago River and the frequent architectural tour boars cruising by. The beds were comfortable and showers were nice. The shared amenities in the building were added perks, and we made use of the spotless gym and game room. We were there on a foggy, stormy 4th of July, but were able to enjoy fireworks to the west and south from the full windows of the apartment as well as to the east/lake from the rooftop! There is a Target next door, which we visited the first day to stock up on breakfast and snack items. There is a Lou Malnati's just a few blocks over for deep dish pizza, and two subway stops within easy walking distance. If we didn't take the subway, then we walked to the lakefront which was less than a mile away. Also, whenever I had questions, the responses came back very quickly. I would definitely recommend this rental!
Very worth it. Safe area.
good place to stay with big groups or family

The home was perfect for our family's trip to Chicago! It was exceptionally clean, beautifully decorated, and spacious enough for everyone to relax comfortably. The host was responsive, friendly, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.
We rented a vehicle, and most of the downtown attractions including the beach were just a 20–30 minute drive away, depending on traffic. The location was convenient, the home exceeded our expectations, and we would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
wonderful stay! the staff were incredibly helpful and kind. every person i interacted with was fabulous. i loved everything about the hotel. excellent location, also. highly recommend.
We enjoyed our stay at the house. Our family of 5 loved the space. We could walk the neighborhood. Great bakery, Bad Butter, and pub Hurley Tap,  just down the street.

We had a wonderful stay at Abel’s apartment! The location in Lincoln Park is fantastic…close to great parks, restaurants, and everything we wanted to explore. The free parking was a huge bonus and made getting around so easy. Abel was incredibly helpful, responsive, and genuinely kind throughout our stay.

This place was awesome! Excellent location, within short walking distance to stores, resturants, train station, many things. The unit was nice and very comfortable and there were 6 of us, adults.  The view was great. We stayed on the top floor. Clean and quiet building. We enjoyed the outdoor space as well (fire pit area one night and full BBQ area another evening. We will stay here again. Thanks Ben!

This was a great convenient stay in Chicago! I booked last minute and the hosts made it easy to find the place and check in. We had a private room with an attached bath, which was great value for money. Basically like a hotel room but with the added bonus of being able to use the kitchen.
we loved our stay here. perfectly close to the bus and the train we didn't have to drive into the city at all. nice cozy spot for us to rest our heads. the hot tub after a long day was a bonus.

This was a great stay. The neighborhood was very walkable and so close to our daughter and her family. The house was very comfortable. Chicago was experiencing a heat wave during our stay so thank goodness for the additional window unit in the upstairs bedroom.
We would definitely book this place again.
Unit was nice sized and clean. It is close to the red line train, groceries and Fenway park. Easy to find. I would recommend to family and friends.

The room had everything I needed, the bed was comfortable, and the place served as a nice base for me to spend a few days while exploring Chicago. The neighborhood was very nice but a little far from the main transit corridor to get into the city. Overall, the Bohemian Lodge is a nice place to stay when visiting Chicago, and I would stay there again.
I really enjoyed my stay. The place is clean, pretty and in a calm neighborhood. the host was also very responsive.  I felt at ease.

Wonderful stay from start to finish! The location was fantastic — really walkable, with great restaurants just a short walk away. The space itself was comfortable and welcoming, and the host went above and beyond, helping out whenever needed. Would highly recommend and would love to stay again!

Janet was a very responsive host throughout our stay. Our space was private, neat and clean. The kitchen and bathroom were well stocked and had everything we needed and then some. The backyard outdoor space was beautiful and inviting. We will definitely stay there again when we come to Chicago.
From the moment we arrived it felt like home. Very cozy and located in a great area. Silvia was very responsive and provided detailed instructions
What a beautiful neighborhood! Such a lovely location with cozy vibes. And steps away from the CTA & Metro. Making trips to the city soo easy. We will definitely be staying here again!

What a fabulous place!  Comfy, quiet and lots of space for our group of four. Pleasant neighborhood and well connected to public transportation. Parking, although sounds confusing (where to park, possible need for host-provided permit) was super easy and convenient. 10 out of 10 stars! Wish we could have stayed longer; will definitely consider a revisit.
Fantastic space! My second time staying.

My stay was perfect it was only 9 mins away from the downtown area. It was nice and clean very quiet location. But it also was right around the corner from this place that had the best tacos my wife and I ever had

Alan & Sandra’s place is wonderful and in such a lovely neighborhood. This was our second time staying here as their place is a perfect fit for our family and we would definitely stay again. The hosts are very responsive, helpful & kind.

Casper was very responsive to our requests and very kind in his communication.  The apt. is beautiful, very open and airy with lots of light.  I thought the beds were comfortable and bathrooms were very modern with great water pressure.  The central AC was very appreciated since we hit during an extremely hot spell in Chicago! I would definitely recommend this and stay again.  My only disappointment was that the "master bathroom"  was not closed off from the living area, so if you are in the living area no one is able to use that bathroom (with any privacy that is). This got by me on the pictures.

Good for stay. Close to public transit, still 40 mins to downtown easy. Burrito house and olive garden near by, good food options. Coffee machine and pods are available. Shared bathroom, but clean and tidy.
The location was great, right in the heart of Wicker Park. The apartment was modern, clean and comfortable. We were very happy with our stay.
Benny was helpful.  the area is little close to south of Chicago

We loved our weeklong stay. I’ve stayed in plenty of Airbnbs, and this one is easily among my favorites. The unit exceeded our expectations — it’s spacious, beautifully prepared, and entry was simple with the keypads. The fridge was stocked with eggs, milk, and plenty of drink options, which made mornings relaxing as I enjoyed coffee in the living room while people‑watching in my pajamas.
The place was immaculate, and the kitchen had everything you could need. There’s a washer and dryer in the unit, and we were especially grateful for the central air during the heat dome. The location in Andersonville is fantastic — steps from Clark Street with tons of restaurants and shops, plus a Mariano’s within walking distance.
Transit is easy: the Clark and Broadway buses or the Red Line at Berwyn get you downtown in about 25–35 minutes, and Wrigley Field is roughly a 20‑minute ride. I highly recommend and hope to return.

Perfect last minute stay. I appreciated the comfortable accomodations and really enjoyed the neighborhood. I enjoyed the bed, and the space was charming. It was safe, cute, and lots of good bars/food/coffee nearby.

I really wish I could rate this place and the host higher than five stars.  Everything was exactly as advertised.  The host was responsive to any question and very timely.  The place came with every amenity you could possibly want and nothing was forgotten.  It was clean and nicely decorated.  Our stay was comfortable and a pleasure.  I have no complaint whatsoever and only positive feelings for our stay.  I look forward to staying here again.
Easy, flexible, and clean in convienent location and had everything needed for a 1 month+ stay
Great place to stay at the Chicago.

the place was as described. It is definitely a little noisy but the host has clearly mentioned it in his listing. The cleanliness was on point and did not have issues with that. Room is a little small but other than that no issues
Excellent location and communication. Highly recommend

Great instructions
Timely responses and a good area

Our stay here was well worth it. Great location, walkable to so many attractions, restaurants, parks. There was plenty of space for 5 of us. The place was clean, big bathrooms, lots of towels and bedding available if we needed it. The beds were very comfortable. We loved the big windows in the living area and the view of the Loop area. We requested an early check in since my sister who was flying in would be there earlier than my family and the host was able to accommodate her early check in. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others.
Decent place to stay! Good amount of space. The stairs are tough 😆 The upstairs rooms get pretty warm, it took a couple days to get to a comfortable sleeping temperature upstairs.

Nicholas was a great host. Location was amazing, so many close restaurants and bars nearby. The only reason I put 4 stars is because the curtains were missing from 1 windows in the bedroom which allowed a lot of light in really early in the morning. Outside of that minor detail everything was great!

The location was great but very difficult to find parking nearby. The inside was not clean - carpets full of hair, dirt, and stains. There were pieces of tape on the kitchen cupboards. On a positive note the beds were comfortable and the showers were great.
This was a perfect place to stay. It was spacious and had a homie feel. Very walkable and near the train which was helpful.

Corinne’s place was exactly as described. Any issues were addressed promptly and remedied. We were able to access transportation to downtown easily and street parking was always available.
Thanks for a great stay!

I don’t usually leave reviews but have to leave one. I absolutely love this place, this is my second time staying here and i will without a doubt stay here every chicago trip i have. Super friendly, responsive hosts. Check in is super easy and the place is easy to find. My biggest plus is the saftey. It’s in a great neighborhood walkable to a bunch of restaurants, workout classes, etc. This is without a doubt the best airbnb i’ve ever stayed in and i will continue to stay here. Once again never leave reviews but had to share my thoughts!!
Super miejsce !
Great value! AC runs really well, and I felt totally comfortable and safe. Quick walk to good food and drinks, transit, corner stores, and much more. Free parking options available too.
Great location,  beautiful, quiet street.  Not far from public transportation if needed.  We would stay here again.

Bijzonder ruim en vrolijk kleurrijk appartement. Van alle gemakken voorzien en goed bereikbaar. Het is een beetje gehorig (onderburen en af en toe verkeer), maar verder perfect. Wij zouden hier zeker terugkomen en raden het appartement van harte aan.
Host was wonderful home nice it was a wet smell in the room that was my only issue with the room other then that it was okay

This was such a great spot for my family of four to stay during our trip to Chicago! The garage parking was great (though we were also walkable to the L), the beds were comfy, and the kitchen was well equipped. The space was so bright, too! We had a blast in Chicago, walking to a Cubs game, exploring downtown, and eating lots of delicious food. Pavlo set up the space so well and it was a home-y space for us to crash at. Hope to visit Chicago again and would definitely stay here next time, too.

Although apartment was right on the street it was pretty quiet at night. Very convenient for getting north to family and Southwest to other family. Free parking on street but someone broke a tail light on my rental car during the night.

This stay was super comfortable and accommodating. My baby and I stayed for a few days while waiting for our new apartment and it was a very nice stay. The hosts were super communicative when necessary and totally went above and beyond. Would absolutely recommend!!

Great stay at this place for our family! We have two boys and they loved the foosball table and games available. The apartment is in a great neighborhood and very close to restaurants, transportation and entertainment. We will be back!
Great place to stay, everything is around ten minutes from the home. Easy to find, parking wasn’t as bad ! Would stay again.
Alberto's place was exactly what we needed, a nice, safe, quiet place to stay within walking distance of my MIL's. Great option for the Eastside!

James was very communicative and made check-in and check-out a breeze. The unit was as promised and the views were amazing!  We are grateful for sharing your home and hope to stay again on our next trip to Chicago.
The apartment was clean & as described, in a quiet building. Easy access to highway & public transit.
Location was great, clear instructions for parking and access, beds and linens were very nice.  Overall great stay!

I wish Airbnbs had been more popular when we had smaller kids. This place is a dream for families with kids of all ages. Our 18 year old used the chalk to make a drawing on the provided chalkboard. We loved have a glass of champagne on the private front balcony. We left our car on the street and toured the city using public transportation. Fantastic stay!
Marissa was very responsive and friendly. i my mother really enjoys the space and always considers this place when coming to Chicago..highly recommend
Great location, super clean, super easy check-in/out.
Wonderful place, more or less exactly as advertised.
Beautiful view, excellent location with plenty of things to do and places to see. Delicious restaurants all around!
The house was very clean. The host was responsive. We found everything we needed. If you’re traveling with kids they have lots of board games.
Chill
Milan was one of the most super responsive communicators and kept updated my entire trip. Super friendly and very accommodating. Thank you!
Spacious, clean, well situated. Host was very responsive. A+
Ryan and Elizabeth's place was amazing. This was our first time in Chicago and they made everything easy. The bedroom was very accommodating and clean. Would definitely go back.
Definitely a great stay, good location, and the hosts are good at communicating 👍

Had a chance to meet Atlas in person. He was incredibly nice and professional. There was a bit of an issue during our late night check-in (the code to one of the individual locks on one of the bed rooms did not work; effectively locking one of us out for that first night). Atlas resolved the issue as soon as he was able. In exchange he allowed us to checkout out later than normal, which we greatly appreciated. Overall he was very helpful. The neighborhood was good and highly walkable during the day, with some good coffee shops nearby. Would come back for another stay.

The unit we stayed in was very nice, clean and in a good spot for places to walk to. Especially the grocery store was only a couple of blocks of the street which came in handy more then expected. Liz was very responsive and polite. I saw the complaints in other reviews about the train and it honestly wasn't that bad to me. Didn't disrupt my sleep at all. If I come back to Chicago for extended stay I will be trying to get this place again.

We had a fantastic time! Song's place had all of the amenities we needed. It is very spacious and beautiful inside (loved the door handles). The rooftop views are a great addition to the end of your day in Chicago!
Great location and great place for a couple days stay. Host was quick to respond when there was a small issue and house was well stocked with all you need. We slept well too!
We enjoyed Laura’s home! It was creative and homey! It was a spacious 2 bed 2 bath great space for me and my team :) closeby to downtown which was awesome!

It was great home away from home. Host was available to message and responsive. Unit was spotless. Views from the unit and rooftop were amazing. The location was perfectly central to navigate the city. The building amenities were excellent. We paid extra for parking and worth it. We also walked to nearby restaurants, shops, and the movies. Overall, we had a wonderful stay and would certainly repeat.
Great location! Really enjoyed the neighborhood and proximity to the brown line.

Having read all the reviews on this place I wanted to add detailed thoughts.
Stella as a host could not have been more awesome. Proactive care is a great way to describe it. Reaching out to check in and super responsive.
There’s detailed instructions and pictures to go with everything like how to get in (and operate the shower 😁)
The place was very clean and well put together. (And I’m picky about that often taking my own pillow case ‘just in case.’)
The place itself got 4 stars because I’m not a city girl
The tram was a bit loud for me. (Again, Stella being awesome had ear plugs available)
I played music on my phone to help.
The police headquarters is nearby so there a lot of sirens that go by.
Nothing that is Stella’s fault- just different for me coming from a more rural area and nothing that made my stay bad.
I loved how accessible it was to the lake trail- definitely a highlight!
I would describe the area as a clean NYC
I wouldn’t have a problem staying here again.
Such a find ! ... fortune if get to stay in cozy coach house!  Excellent in every way !!

What can I say, my friend and I have travelled all over the world and this was by far the nicest Airbnb we have stayed in. So much heart and soul poured into the place, decorated beautifully (will be redesigning my entire home after seeing this!) loads of space, everything you need in the kitchen and bathroom, a book of recommendations on the table and some other cute touches. The local neighbourhood was lovely and we got the best tacos of our whole life in Little Village (seriously La Chaparrita, do it). Short walk through the residential area to get a train direct to downtown or a bus stop at the end of the street. Janet was so responsive and lovely to deal with. Thank you for a wonderful stay, would recommend to anyone ❤️

I truly enjoyed my stay at Rebecca's place! The apartment was spacious, clean, and exactly as described. The kitchen and living areas were spacious and excellent for relaxing, making it perfect for both short and long stays. Rebecca was highly responsive, accommodating, and attentive to every detail. It is also conveniently located right near public transportation. I highly recommend staying here and would definitely rebook! ❤️

They are responding very fast in very short time,

Excellent place in the perfect location. Will look to book again when we’re back in Chicago.
Excellent, clean place to stay in Hyde Park with easy access to public transportation. Highly recommend.

Great spot that’s very well maintained and taken care of. Host communicates well.

I enjoyed my stay at Mera’s place. It was everything as advertised. It felt as though I was in a hotel—yet I had all the amenities as I would at home. I loved my stay and would do so again should the need arise. It was top notch, 10/10, would recommend to my mom. :)

Great place to book—clean, excellent location, and easy instructions. The host, Jennifer, is very friendly, always attentive to any needs, and responds quickly.
Excellent place!
Great Airbnb. Michael takes good care of the space and his guests. Private parking was nice. Michael checked in and made sure we have everything we needed.
Excelente estancia; volveré. Sin duda excelente ubicación, zona muy tranquila.
Great host, great place,  and very helpful!  Made a great weekend family reunion!

A wonderful stay! Had lots to do around and close to the L to go to many more places!! We had an easy check in and check out. Everything was stated clearly and they were very quick and kind with responses! Everything looked exactly how it did online and was super clean. I would recommend this to any single or couple traveling!

It was a nice, peaceful stay. The place wasn’t hard to locate, and Jennifer gave clear instructions on how to get there. She also allowed us to check in early, which we appreciated.
However, there were a few issues. First, we weren’t given the lockbox code, so we had to wait outside until we received it. Second, when we walked inside, there was an empty bag of chips left on the shelf and hair on one of the pillows. We brought our own pillows and blankets, so it wasn’t a huge issue for us, but it was still disappointing.
Other than that, the neighborhood was quiet and beautiful. It’s not right next to everything, but it’s centrally located enough that most Uber rides were around $10.

The location was great for us. Plenty of space and everyone got their own bed, which was a huge plus. Instructions were simple and easy to follow, the place was clean and the A/C cold. We would stay here again in the future if we’re in the area again.

Great hosts with fantastic attention. The location is more than ideal: you are close to the CTA lines, you have plenty of walkable spots, and you will always spot ride-share bikes and scooters around. The TVs in each room were nice to have, and 2 bathrooms for bigger groups/families is a must as opposed to hotel rooms.

Nicholas is a phenomenal host. Above and Beyond. He is one of the most professional & accommodating hosts our there.
The room itself is good as well. Make sure you're good with stairs though. You get a good work out on your way up
Todo estuvo muy bien y el anfitrión muy atento.
Had a great stay and would definitely stay again

Tom was a delight to deal with and was very responsive every time we messaged him. He was an amazing host and was brilliant with our two kids. He gave us lots of local recommendations, hints, tips and insights to the city. I would highly recommend this place to stay. The place was immaculate and perfectly placed and within walking distance to fantastic restaurants, cafes, bars and amenities. We will definitely return! Thanks Tom!
Fantastic stay! We loved it, will be back! Thanks!
Great convenient location and beautiful apartment. Very responsive host. We were 2 adults and 3 teens and everyone had their own room. Would definitely rent again next time we are in Chicago.

I stayed for a few days and it was a nice, air-conditioned room to come back to after a long day of walking. I didn't use the kitchen but it looked very clean! The host responded quickly to my questions and the other guests were very quiet and kept the shared spaces clean.
Conveniently located, walking to UChicago, many restaurants and a big park. Clean and spacious apartment with good A/C and WiFi. Easy street parking. Great hosts!
Sarah’s place was great. I would definitely recommend and stay there again.

The Airbnb was cool and calming in a heat wave, and the location is perfect for me. It’s on a busy street but earplugs provided.
The neighborhood is lovely and convenient, and just a 3-4 block walk to hip and lively Andersonville. The host was super responsive.

Great stay, highly recommend! The location was fantastic — super walkable with tons of great restaurants just a short stroll away. The place itself was really comfortable, and the hosts were amazing hosts, attentive and welcoming throughout our stay. Would definitely book again!

Such a great neighborhood and very easy to walk around. Very safe, many great restaurants, close to Wrigley Field, Music Box Theater, lots of national brand shops, and great coffee shops. The Little Goat and Ella Elli were our favorites!
Great stay! Very responsive host.
The place is great and looks exactly like it was listed on the website. It was clean, comfortable, and matched my expectations.

Tout s’est bien déroulée, bon rapport qualité prix .

We will definitely stay here again!  Amazing quiet, given that the condo is on a busy street.  Kitchen was well appointed.
Ray was super nice and super understanding

I will echo what the vast majority of reviews have stated. The location and amenities are hard to beat. Access to public transportation is excellent so no need to rent a car as parking can be cost prohibitive and inconvenient. There is even a Lyft bikeshare docking station right around the corner.  Stephanie's place is very nice. It's a corner apartment which will give you a great view of the skyline.  Having access to a gym and swimming pool on site was awesome. Five stars and I would definitely stay here again.
Estuvimos muy felices buena ubicación igual que en las fotos respuesta rápida recomiendo mucho el lugar fácil acceso en trasporte público

The neighborhood was great  and walkable. Took my dog and it was nice to have a nearby park! I’ve stayed in other places that allow pets and there was evidence but this house was very clean and had no odors. AC worked great.
Everything was good and worth it

My husband and I and our two teenage kids stayed at this apartment. It was the best location for all the various people we had to meet and the Cubs game we planned to attend. The apartment was very spacious and comfortable. We haven't lived in Chicago in 18 years so the neighborhood has changed a lot but we still enjoyed the Spacca Napoli Pizzeria down the street and various places in the area. The walk to the Cubs game was only 30 minutes and the parking was reasonable most of the time except for very late arrivals. The owner was incredibly generous finding an important item we left behind. All in all, I'd recomend this place is spaciousness and location are the top priorities which for us they were. The video game table did not work but the owner offered to bring us a game council to make up for it. We didn't need it and just opted to get really good at foozball instead. The bathrooms were clean but there were some quirks with fixtures which is part of old building charm.

What a gem! Great neighborhood. So walkable and easy beach access, easy to hop on a bike and head to the west loop. Quiet at night and in the morning so you can be fully rested for a full day of activities. Her house was so clean and welcoming.She was also very thoughtful in her snacks that catered to my gf restrictions. Cant wait to come back and visit again.
It was genuinely an amazing experience
We had a great visit. The home was nice and just as Petra described. Free parking and easy to find.
It’s a better place to chill in as compared to downtown Chicago. Not far from stops and near to Halsted station. Will opt to book here again in future trips.

We recently stayed at Cathy's home. This was our fourth time doing so. That should tell you all you need to know to book a stay here. Everything is as described. Great home, quiet, wonderful location, superb amenities.   Last but surly not least, Cathy is a wonderful host who communicates excellently. My wife and I are already planning our next visit. See you again Cathy!
Beautifully renovated graystone in Logan Square.
Great house and stay! Very convenient access to public transportation
Had an amazing stay here! The house was clean and beautiful, as explained in the listing. The hosts were friendly and helpful.

I let Jeffrey know we'd be arriving late, and he was very accommodating. Since we arrived after dark, it took us a couple of passes to find the property because the gate leading to the entrance wasn't illuminated. Thankfully, Jeffrey's check-in instructions were clear, so getting inside was easy.
The unit is a basement apartment, with a low ceiling near the entrance that opens into the laundry area with the refrigerator. Once inside the main living space, however, it was clean, comfortable, and well put together. My only concern was security: the main unit door doesn't have a lock, which made me a bit uneasy. The bedroom itself has a locking door, but there's also an "unlockable" folding door connecting it to the living room for airflow from the AC.
These are personal observations, and overall I may just be picky. On the positive side, Jeffrey was extremely helpful with our parking situation, and we really appreciated his responsiveness.
Recommend to a solo or a couple traveller.
Our leadership team shared an Airbnb during a working session in the city. Everything was as described, we loved it! Thanks!

Great hosts, the place is well kept and rooms are as described. The hosts do everything they can to make the stay a good experience. They are very communicative, keep the house clean, and have even labeled partitions in the fridge and shelves by room so there are no issues with sharing the space with other guests.

Really great experience staying at Hatice’s place. By far my favorite AirBNB in Chicago. Really great apartment, perfect location, and the host is super communicative and helpful. Look forward to staying again!
gran apartamento, cómodo, limpio, espacioso. muy agradable. lo único malo es que es un piso alto y no hay ascensor. de resto el lugar está muy bien
Great location, absolutely insane view, easy to get in and out, super clean and overall just a great stay. Was ready to move in after 2 days but unfortunately had to head home

I have stayed at nearly 100 Airbnbs and this was, hands down, the nicest I’ve ever stayed at. I genuinely felt like I was staying in someone’s generously appointed home. It had everything we needed and was honestly more luxurious than any hotel I’ve ever stayed at too. We would love to stay again!

Very nice space. Very clean and organized, this stay was very well kept and had everything you would have at home which made the stay even more comfortable. I would definitely choose this location again when visiting Chicago!

Great place in the West Loop of Chicago. Close to many great restaurants in Fulton Market, and only a 4-minute walk to the Ashland train station. Quiet, safe neighborhood. One important item to note, it’s a two-level unit, with the sleeping area and living area/TV upstairs, and kitchen and bathroom downstairs. And it’s much cooler downstairs. This wasn’t an issue for me, but may be for others. Overall a great stay!

I had a great experience with the host. She was very polite, responsive, and communicated in a timely manner, which was greatly appreciated.
Be sure to read check-in instructions carefully before arriving. There is a lockbox on the side of the property to access your key, then a key for the main entrance, and another key for your private room—so there are quite a few keys to keep track of.
The neighborhood was great with friendly people, and I felt very safe during my stay. One thing to note is that GPS can be unreliable in parts of Boystown, so it may take some extra attention/time when navigating.
The space itself was nice and worked perfectly for my stay. The only things I would mention for future guests are that you can hear a lot of activity outside the front door, so I was very mindful of my noise level and quiet hours. I also noticed there was a smoke/noise detector in the living room I didn’t catch in the description. If you are a smoker/vaper you have to leave the property.
The place was as described & adequate for our short trip in downtown Chicago. The host were very responsive though out our stay.

Tara is an excellent host and provided a perfect place for a week. I was able to work from there at a nice deck and everything was spotless and worry free. Tara’s hospitality is unmatched. I highly recommend if you are looking for a place in Chicago.

I’ve stayed in Chicago a few and this arguably was the best airbnb I’ve stayed in while in town. Private garage to park and plenty of free street parking directly out front. Gorgeous interior with everything you could need like dishwasher, washer, dryer. And having a backyard to lay out and enjoy the sun was just icing on the cake. Will 100% be returning :)
I would come back to Ensavis place just for the location! Very walkable and Ensavi was very responsive.
We had a wonderful stay! Close to the lake and so many great restaurants, shops, etc. Host was great and responded quickly.
Perfect place to stay!
Everything was great except for the slight mix up with the code for the front door.  We had to wait outside for about an hour for the code to be reset.

Phil and Michelle were awesome hosts! They were so friendly and responsive to all our questions - truly went above & beyond making sure we were all set up! Their place is as pictured and was such a comfy home base for my family during their visit. Thank y'all so much for sharing your home!

Great home base in the Chicago Loop for adventures! We loved being able to walk just a couple blocks North to the river, or a couple blocks West to Millenium park. It was easy to get there by train from the airport, and the pub downstairs was a good place to catch some World Cup games. The pool was also a great way to cool off and have some fun with the kids in between other activities.
We had a full group with 3 adults and 3 kids, the pull-out couch was great for the kids and there was a pack-n-play for our youngest.
The host is very responsive, they helped us with getting more linens and with an AC issue quickly. The building had some construction at the time we were staying, with the rooftop being inaccessible and only one elevator in operation. This was only a mild inconvenience though, it didn't bother us. The train also runs nearby so be aware there is street noise, earplugs are provided. Up on the 23rd floor it's not too bad though. Would stay again!
I’d book again.

What a lovely person Erica is. She was so patient with me. She doesn’t know this but I recently lost my brother and her kindness was an oasis to me at this time.
Thank you Erica.
Sincerely from the bottom of my heart.
Great neighborhood!  Small affordable place to explore Chicago.  Having dedicated off street parking was a nice bonus.

It's a nice place. It's someone's home so it's not sterile. It's filled with the host's belongings in a good way, I thought. The location couldn't be better - close to the lake and the el and walkable to a lot of things in the area you'll probably go to. Parking is a little tricky but not impossible. I liked it. The photos are representative of what you will get.

Great host. Made us feel right at home while checking in.

Absolute perfection! We loved every minute of our staycation and even ended up extending our stay because we didn't want to leave. They had everything we could possibly need and was stocked with all the essentials, making our stay so comfortable.
Gloria and Lee were wonderful hosts!! so kind, welcoming, and friendly. We truly couldn't have asked for a better experience and can't wait to come back. Highly recommend staying here!
Tim kindly accommodated my very last minute booking! Everything was clean, lots of amenities, and great recommendations! Really friendly host as well.
A cozy and comfortable apartment with friendly and responsive hosts. They answered all of my questions quickly and were always helpful. I had a great stay and would definitely recommend this place!

Our family enjoyed our stay - there were many thoughtful amenities and everything was as described. We enjoyed our stay!
The apartment was spacious which was great as we were there 4 nights. Lots of windows and nicely decorated. We felt comfortable.
This place was a great stay. Coinvent location to lots of options. Clean room and friendly welcome. Would stay here again the next time I travel to Chicago!
Wonderful host, comfortable apartment and ideal location. I have to emphasize that the location could not have been better in the Loop.

EXCELLENT location; Avondale is popping off right now! Walkable to a bunch of fun bars, restaurants, and shopping. Close to the blue line too!

Great place… nice and clean! Location is great as well. Street parking is easy and zone passes provided. 5 stars!

Great location and fantastic space. Memorable weekend.

Convenient location and unit as described
Great location with metro into downtown only a short walk away. Drew was very nice and friendly. We enjoyed chatting to him! Accommodation was pristine. Affordable pricing. Can’t go wrong folks🤟🤟

The host was very responsive and attentive regarding our stay. However, the apartment is better for those with a car because it’s not very accessible for those relying on the CTA. Additionally, the apartment had some pests like roaches. Overall, great stay for groups on a budget.
We loved the place. The single beds w pull out singles was perfect for our family. The couch was comfortable and we felt right at home. The laundry in the space was perfect

Great house in a safe and quiet location. Walkable within 15-20 minutes into the west loop and easy to get Ubers to anywhere in the city. Would recommend for any large group.
Good place to stay, no complaints
Stayed there for a week to see some friends. Just needed a bed to sleep in and bathroom. The room is cozy and everything was clean.

Communication with the host was excellent and the house was exactly as described. The space was spotless and in a perfect location for exploring the city. I definitely would book again when traveling back to Chicago. Highly recommended!

We were absolutely happy with our decision to stay at this location! Bridget's space was roomy enough for our family of five, comfortable and included all of the necessities we could think of. My stay at Tuan's was great, I have no complaints, it was quite, clean and have great parking.

I’ll definitely be back! The host responded quickly, the check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow, and the unit looked exactly like the photos. Everything was clean, comfortable, and just as expected. I had a great stay and would definitely recommend it!

It was soooo cozy and comfortable!

perfect stay thank you !

Great lil place very close to the blue line!

In general terms I would definitely recommend the stay despite the issues mentioned.

This is a lovely unit in a great location.  We were a short Uber ride to downtown, and there were many restaurants just down the street.  We really enjoyed the hot tub.

I recommend the stay especially if you don't mind cats.

it was a great house. we will definitely return..we only had issues with few people sitting opposite to the house and drinking in the morning and trying to shout at us. we had to ignore them. parking was a bit tough in the back as there were lot of other cars parked infront.

Estuvimos muy a gusto en este apartamento, muy bonito y muy bien ubicado tanto del centro como del lago. Repetiría sin duda!

Super tidy- easy to find. Will stay there again!

This is one of the best airbnb's I've stayed in. Patrick and Christiane were so kind and made sure I was comfortable. I highly recommend their home. Their hospitality was above and beyond. I will most definitely be returning. 🤗

Great place! Nice location! Beautiful 🤩

This place worked just fine for our needs! It was near the bus stop, which took us to the L, which if you didn't take the bus was about a 15 min walk. The A/C was nice + cold, and the apartment was well-stocked with supplies, and thankfully lots of coffee pods! Yay! Also, plenty of coffee shops, grocery, and gas stations walkable for convenience. House is on a very cute street and felt safe. Easy to park right in front!
Originally, we were bringing our dog, which was why I booked it, then we ended up not. All good, but in retrospect it may have been a little cramped with us, our three kids and our larger dog! The kids were in a pretty small bedroom all together, though it worked out fine, and all of us sharing a small bathroom was tricky.

The Biddle House #2 was exactly what we were hoping for! It was clean, cozy, and the perfect size for our family of four (including two teenage boys). We loved all the natural light and the charm of the neighborhood.
Thank you, Elizabeth, for providing such a wonderful home base while we explored everything Chicago has to offer! We visited all the major sights, walked to Lincoln Park Zoo and the Lakefront Trail, and had easy access to both the bus and the L train….everything was within about a 10-minute walk.
We would absolutely stay here again the next time we’re in Chicago!

This location is perfect!  Walking to distance to restaurants, bars, grocers and other retailers.  Two nearby bus stops made getting anywhere in the city easy.  Apartment was lovely, spacious, clean, and had everything we needed.  Printed out directions and info were very helpful.  We had a couple of minor issues, but the host was very responsive with quick replies.   We would likely stay here again, if we decide to visit Chicago for a month in the future.
It was wonderful
Stayed here for a month and it was the perfect spot. The neighborhood is so lovely and Melissa was a very helpful host. Great experience overall!

Actually great! very clean, very quiet, was amazing after 2 days travel on the road!
The neighborhood is safe, clean, and beautiful.

Great location. Lovely neighborhood. Perfect for a large family visiting Chicago, especially Cubs games. Everything is exactly how it looks and as it’s described.
Hosts responsive if you need anything at all. Thank you for a memorable stay!
Beautiful home and he was really responsive and helpful.
El lugar cuenta con una excelente ubicación, las fotos muestran el sitio tal cual es, un lugar bastante cómodo para 3 personas, las vistas son bastante agradables y es bastante céntrico
Great stay for my family…host very available and helpful throught stay

Myself and my family were in town for a short of a week and loved our stay at Michael’s place. Location is so nice, close to everything from the lake to the city to Lincoln park. So close to great food and drinks spot. Michael was super responsive and helpful. Would stay again.

Kelsey’s place was perfect for our group!  Very centrally located in the northern part of the city! We were able to walk to Wrigley and take a quick uber to areas such as Lincoln Park and the Field Museum.
Great location and very clean!

Truly a gem of a place. My friends and I do a Fourth of July trip every year to a new city. Of all the houses we've stayed at this was by far the best one. Beautiful city, beautiful home, and had everything we needed to stay inside and relax after a busy day in the city.

We had a great family stay over the 4th of July weekend. Everyone had their own space and multiple bathrooms. The house is older so there was some squeaking with stairs, etc. Our weekend was great and there were several groceries and restaurants close by with great prices. Would definitely come back. Thanks!

The house was very comfortable for my husband and me. Although the house has 2 bedrooms and a pullout sofa bed, we only used one room. The location for us was great. I could always use more hangers because I always unpack everything when I travel, and we were there for a week, but because we only used one bedroom, my husband hung his clothes in the closet in the second room. I liked having a washer and dryer in the unit! We were always able to find street either right in front of the house or a few steps away. We will certainly come back again.
I can't recommend enough! Amazing place to stay, extremely clean, perfect location, has everything you will need. I will definitely stay again for my next visit to Chicago!

I’m from OKC but I love Chicago and love going to Lincoln Square to shop at the local shops, especially Book Cellar.  We were close enough  to walk to Lincoln Square and also had available parking on the street, which made driving to other parts of town convenient. My teenage kids and I loved the vibe of the place and appreciated how large the space was.
We had a great stay here. A beautiful house. 2 car garage access was super convenient. Great location with a quick drive to downtown and Chinatown. Very spacious perfect for larger groups.
Awesome stay. EXACTLY what we were looking for!
As described. Simple and easy

I had a great stay!
The location was walkable to the riverwalk. Theres a rooftop bar around the corner that’s good and also plenty of coffee shops nearby.
The gym has the necessities and a sauna.
The apartment was cozy and comfortable.
At night I noticed a security guard is on duty which made the stay feel even more safe.
I would for sure come back!
We really enjoyed our time at Greg’s place.
buen lugar para bolver a regresar

Place was spacious and perfect for our group as everyone had their own room. Very central location, tons of good food and night life options within walking distance. McCormick Place is also within walking distance and is a good option for large conference groups. Very easy as well to get to a lot of the major attractions in Chicago with it's location in South Loop.
The additional amenities in the space, pool table, etc were a very nice added bonus, and the size of the unit itself made it so everyone had space to move around freely.
Host was very communicative throughout the stay and very responsive. Would definitely 10/10 book again.
One note - There are a bit of stairs to reach the unit so I would take that into account if you have a disability or heavy luggage.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was beautiful, very clean, and stocked with everything we needed. It was in a fantastic location just a short walk to Wrigley Field, which made getting around incredibly easy. There was plenty of space for our friends to stay with us comfortably, and the house was well supplied with thoughtful amenities.Alan was extremely kind, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to any Cubs fan!

お部屋はとても快適で、近隣もとても静かな住宅街でした。
バス停や駅も歩ける距離です。
ホストもとても親切丁寧に対応してくださったのでとても快適に過ごせました。

Assel was a great host and this place was very worth our stay. Convenient location to walk to bus stops and train stations. Spacious place for a group of 6 people. All the amenities were working properly. Only issue we ran into was the one parking spot reserved for this place. The private lot has 3 parking spaces and our designated space was blocked because of the other two cars. Assel easily resolved the issue and the cars were moved so we can park in the space.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The place had everything we needed for our holidays. Richard was very accommodating and ensured to keep in touch us ongoinly to provide tips and make sure we are feeling right at home.

It was written in the description that they didn’t provide bath towels so it was not a surprise.  However, I feel that providing bath towels is like bottom of the barrel when it comes to hospitality. You expect your guests to pack bath towels in their suitcase? Seriously? I had to go to target and buy bath towels to dry off after a shower. I left the bath towels at the place so hopefully they keep them there for the next guests to enjoy and not feel inconvenienced. Also, the upstairs AC was stuck at 79-80 degrees for the first day and a half. That’s not a comfortable setting for July in Chicago. Would not recommend.

Laura was a great host! We had an awesome July 4th weekend staying at her place. Very quick walk to the blue line/Logan Square station which makes getting downtown super easy. Logan Square is a great neighborhood and we would stay here again!
Nice area and space. Affordable
It was a good experience. Other than the bed is small for two people , everything else was awesome .

The place is great everything like they mentioned.the host is responsive and easy check in process.Close to CTA. Good place to stay. But the only thing is its surroundings, which felt not so secure and as a girl i was frightened about being outside the house at night. Apart from that everything is super good

This is a beautiful, sparkling clean space in a walkable area.  The owner must be an experienced traveler because he has equipped the place with everything a traveler might need. I highly recommend this.

This place was so comfortable and charming. The backyard opens to a local park with the playground right there. My littles loved it. Clear instructions and easy access. It was great and we will be back. Thank you

It was a really good deal. I thought having a shared kitchen would be more of a problem but honestly now that I’ve done it, I would prefer that my future Bnb’s also have shared kitchen to save on price. We didn’t actually hear any live events downstairs the whole weekend.
Loved the location and it was super easy to find. The place looked just like the pictures. One thing to note: this home doesn’t offer wifi to guests. I still had a great stay!

Our group (4 adults, 2 kids) had an amazing stay at Bradford's place. Bradford was responsive and accommodating to our group and we all loved the place itself. You can tell the home is well cared for and everyone was very comfortable throughout our visit. The kids also loved the hot tub which was clean and worked great.
Bradford's place is a fantastic option if staying in Chicago. There is plenty to do locally via the Bloomingdale elevated walking trail right nearby. We were also never too far from many of the other sights and activities that Chicago has to offer! If we are ever back in town we would absolutely look to stay here again.
lovely and clean !
The unit accommodated my family of 6 comfortably. The building was clean and quiet. Would stay again.

This place is amazing. Short walk to the subway and in a peaceful neighborhood. Very accommodating for families and there are even toys that your kids can play with. Nate was very friendly and even left us a personalized welcome message. I will be looking to see if his place is available anytime I come to Chicago now.

Overall, our stay was fine. I understood we would have to share a bathroom, but I did not think we would have to share with three other rooms. When we booked, we stated it would be for 2 adults and 1 infant and there was not message or indication that there was an age limit for the location. We even messaged our host almost a week out about if they had a pack and play, there was no response. Then 24 hrs before our booking we were notified it was an 18+ only location. The caretaker (not owner) said they don't normally have kids here since it's an 18+ spot and was nice about letting out daughter stay. However, if it was not allowed, why did they not say something when we booked the room. For the price we paid, we should have booked a hotel room. This spot is perfect if you're going to be out and about and just need a place to sleep.

This is my second time staying at this wonderful gem! Very convenient location to get to downtown and other attractions. I would recommend it to anyone who wants to visit Chicago and have a great place to stay!!
Carrie was an extremely thoughtful and kind host.  Communication was excellent, the room was lovely and quiet despite it being July 4th, and staying there was relaxing, comfortable, and fun.

Perfect location, wonderful host, well equipped kitchen, plenty of coffee, grocery  store and restaurants just minutes away. The apartment has 4 set flights of stairs, so be aware of if it. Great work out! :)
Great location, very walkable to multiple locations. Only con we had was noise coming from outside from the road or surrounding workplace or parking spaces.
This apartment is pretty accurately described in the post-- very new and nice complex amenities. Not much of a neighborhood vibe where it's located but the L is one block away.

This property has a great location. It is close to the bus line and Palmer Park yet quiet street. The neighborhood has a peaceful feel. This property was clean with spacious living areas. It was a good fit for our family.
Right by Chinatown which was nice. Very clean space and smooth check in.

I found my second home!!!! Dave’s place is centrally located and very nice. The beds were comfortable and modern, the bathrooms were beautiful and the kitchen was perfect! It was fully stocked and ready to use. I will definitely rebook each time I visit Chicago!!!
Great location relative to Wrigley Field and area restaurants for a Cubs game.

Loved staying here so much - great location near so many cute bars, restaurants, and vintage shops. And only a five minute walk from a blue line station! Made getting into the city center so easy. We miss it already

The house was very accommodating for our large group. It slept my family with no problems. It's in a good location to get to many different stores and restaurants. The host was was responsive and helpful, definitely give this 5-stars. and would stay again.
Aaron was great! Very responsive when I needed something! Great place!

We were very happy with the accommodations and convenience of location. Lots of shops and restaurants in the area. Walkable part of town.  We felt very safe and appreciated the exceptional access to public transit.  David had a really nice book of suggested places and he was always available for any questions that came up.
Nice place. No outdoor seating or central air just as an fyi so it can get warm. Comfy beds. Good location
Awesome spot in the middle of beautiful Andersonville.  Hosts were very accommodating at the last moment!

overall good stay. the apartment was nice and clean. the view was fantastic. check in was easy and the staff were friendly. the location is great and easy to get to. there is also a few parking spots close by if additional parking is needed. the only complaint I really have is that there is no central air so the bedrooms felt super stuffy at night, and you can’t open the windows that big. at night, the train still runs so it was loud. the building also requires you badge in and out for entry and exit which was a bit annoying. also, the oven was acting weird and didn’t work. while the host offered to help, it just felt inconvenient. the stay was good but just a few things to consider!
Layout worked for a family with two older boys. They were able to enjoy downstairs. Most attractions are 25-30 minutes away and the neighborhood could be better. Host was responsive.

This home is beautiful! There was a tranquil garden in the front of the home and the house itself was exceptional. Very spacious with a lot of space to snuggle in and get cozy.
The hosts were very accommodating as well and the most responsive of any host we have ever stayed with. We truly enjoyed this home and would recommend to anyone!
I would definitely book again the home was gorgeous!! Check in was easy and simple, and the hosts were very friendly and helpful the home was worth every penny
Great place all around, and as a first time staying at an AirBnB it set expectations really high. 10/10
We had a great stay at Antonio’s cute, clean and comfortable place. He was responsive and flexible to our needs. We were always able to find street parking too.
We had a great stay and will for sure use it again when we come back to Chicago!

When we arrived it was pleasant at first. Left a a hour later then she text me to say her neighbor told her the gate wasn’t closed. I addressed her and told her i was at the airport picking up my grandson not to mention she stays up above the rental and could have easily closed the gate or tell the neighbor to since they watching everything. I highly recommend this Lincoln Park stay! As long as you’re comfortable with stairs, this is an ideal location. Quiet, convenient, and beautiful, we loved every minute of our time.
Fantastic place for a larger group, very helpful when we occurred a slight problem. Nice location would recommend

It was a beautiful home and was situated in a peaceful neighborhood. We were in town for the 4th of July and they had pretty fun organized block party. They communicated very well. Easy and private access to get inside. I would stay here again if I was back in town.

Robert’s place is great! It’s a beautiful house that is very comfortable.
Great location near Western Avenue which has lots of conveniences at hand
Very spacious for a group
Great place! We loved being so close to Chinatown and enjoyed walking to different restaurants and the whole neighborhood! This is a place added to our favorites!

We loved this Airbnb! It was just outside downtown in a neighborhood that felt pretty safe. Enrique was easy to communicate with. He helped us check in and carried our bags upstairs. I think it was a good deal overall and would totally stay there again.

We had a good stay overall. Frank and Susana were friendly hosts, communication was easy, and having a dedicated parking space was a huge bonus. The location also made it easy to get around the city.
There were a few things that kept this from being a 5-star stay. We were only provided one washcloth per guest for our four-night stay. We also didn’t realize that the apartment itself doesn’t lock when you’re away; the key only locks the exterior entrance to the building. While the hosts explained that only they live in the home and don’t access the upstairs, we personally would have preferred to be able to lock the apartment while we were out.
The TV only offered local over-the-air channels, so guests looking to stream movies or shows should plan accordingly.
Overall, we appreciated Frank and Susana’s hospitality and enjoyed our visit.
great place! very clean, easy to access and comfortable arrangement
Sylvia is great. The stay was great. Location is minutes away from the loop. We also had a private garage for our car. Everything was great! Would recommend!

This home was absolutely amazing! It truly felt like a home , so comfortable, cozy, and welcoming. The decorations were beautiful and added such a warm, inviting touch to the space. The location was also perfect and made everything so convenient. I would definitely stay here again! Thank you!!!

The apartment was exactly as pictured. Beds were comfortable although space was tight. Towels were very soft and the shower was great. Kitchen was very good and the coffee was fantastic.  The parking space provided was very convenient. It felt very safe and the neighborhood was clean and walkable. Jose was very responsive.
We had a great several days in Chicago for my son's birthday.  Thanks Val!

Amazing hosts. Very flexible and accommodating. Helpful in giving suggestions of places to go and places to eat. Extremely friendly and outgoing. We weren't there very much since we were at the Cub's games and touring the city, but the bed is very comfortable, bedroom is quiet with own temperature controls, hot water for shower and beautiful/serene garden space.

Stayed here with my wife and four children. I was able to get the decibel levels in the house from the host. We considered the decibel levels and decided it would not be an issue for us. Right underneath the train where the parking is, outside, it’s pretty loud and you’ll want to use the provided earplugs if standing under them for more than 4-5 minutes but while inside we didn’t consider it a problem and it matched the decibel levels given. Everything else from the description of the property was correct also.

I loved staying with Evelyn; she was always so friendly and warm, and made the experience wonderful. She was so accommodating and helped with any requests I had. The apartment was gorgeous; it was cool, clean, a wonderful space to relax and live in, and so comfortable. I loved the furniture and art in the apartment, it was one of my favorite parts of the experience. The neighborhood was great, I had easy access to public transit, great local restaurants and stores, and an incredible running/biking/walking route right along the lake. I would absolutely stay here again; I loved it!
Great place to stay will definitely return.

So clean, so comfortable & an easy walk to Wrigley and all of our favorite spots on Southport.
We showed up on day one of the heatwave and the AC did not disappoint!!
This place is pristine, cozy & well stocked with coffee & soaps. We felt right at home.
Oh, and not only were we fortunate to get an early check-in, we couldn’t believe that the check-out To-do List was literally “Safe Travels & Have a Nice Day”! They didn’t even ask us to take out the trash!
Now that’s hospitality!!
We hope to land there again next time!!

The location of this place is fabulous and the unit was clean and tidy.
I would recommend staying here for sure.
Great location, very close to the city, and stunning views!

Dryer was broken. I reported it and if it could be repaired or replaced, but no response.
