Walls needed holes repaired and painted.
Brilliant stay in this accommodation. Apartment was clean and host was extremely responsive to any questions we had. Overall a great stay!
Was very responsive with any questions we had check in and check out was smooth would book again!
Nice, clean place, but not worth what we paid for 2 nights. Also, it would have been nice to know that the parking really only accommodates compact cars

Love the house! Stayed cool even in the blistering heat wave. My favorite thing to do was read by the windows at the front of the house. Kitchen left nothing to be desired and I even got some use out of the office. Walkable to lots of great coffee. Just a mile to Whole Foods. Traveling with kids, we were able to hit up a handful of nearby parks. Such a great house and neighborhood. Leigh was a 10/10 host.

This was a great place for exploring Chicago. Great neighborhood for restaurants and access to public transport. The studio was just as described- very comfortable and clean- had everything I needed. I'd happily stay here again!
un lugar con excelente ubicación !! todo tranquilo y en orden,limpio ... el tren a unas cuadras lo que nos facilito movernos al centro de Chicago!! gracias Alec

Truly a great experience. This was my first ever airBnB and it was wonderful. Hosts are amazing. I arrived very late at night and needed assistance and they still picked up the phone to guide me inside. Clean place very close to downtown. If I come back to Chicago I will be right back here. The apartment style also allows you to meet some first time visitors as well.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. One of the biggest advantages was its excellent location it was easily accessible to all the major attractions nearby.
The best part was the bus stop right next to the building, which made getting around incredibly convenient and saved us a lot of time. Overall, it was a hassle-free and enjoyable stay, and we would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!

We had a great stay at this location. The kitchen was very clean and well equiped. i had everything i needed. The living room was very comfortable with a nice TV. The bedrooms were on the smaller side but fine with great comfortable beds. We all were very pleased. Having 2 bathrooms was nice. Those were very clean as well. Walkable neighborhood to coffee, bars, and restaurants. The Brown Line was next to the house and was a little loud at times especially when we first arrived but after the first night it was fine. We seemed to get used to it quickly. Clear quick communication from the host was a nice treat. By far this was our best experience at any rental. We really had a great stay at this unit. This unit accommodated 6 adults very nicely. We all felt safe in the neighborhood walking. Having a driveway to park in was great! I would recommend this apartment and would return.
Beautiful location and building with high ceilings and beautiful interior design! Thanks!

This cute condo was so accessible to everything, close to the train stations and bus stop, walking distance to local attractions. We walked to the Bean and different areas. I’d recommend it if you wanna be close to public transit or like to walk near the lake. Very family friendly too.

Upon checking Simon gave us a very warm welcome, walked us around the property and told us everything we needed to, he also gave local recommendations, instructions on how to get around the city and where to find the main tourist locations. The place was very comfy and felt right at home, I would definitely stay again.

Wonderful, spacious, clean and quiet one bedroom apartment. It is walking distance to great restaurants and Lake Michigan.
Mark is very responsive and answers questions quickly and resolves any concerns promptly.
I enjoyed my stay and would stay there again.
Place was clean and pristine. Photos are very accurate. Very cozy and comfortable rooms. They also have netflix in both TVs which is a plus.

Angelika and Zibi were amazing hosts! They were very attentive and were quick to respond and communicate. This Airbnb was in a very peaceful and beautiful neighborhood. In addition to being close to the city !
We had a lovely time at David’s place!  It’s very cute and close to public transit. Check in and out was a breeze.
Great pricing , great decor and a very responsive host.
We enjoyed our stay! Coming from Tennessee it felt like home! Already have plans on coming back in the fall. Look forward to booking again!
Anna is a great host I felt very welcomed in her home. She is a very nice home her and her husband are super kind I totally recommend them!

Long weekend in Chicago for Cubs v. Cards with my husband and grown kids.  Wendy and Matt's place was exactly as described and fit our family perfectly.  Views were tremendous.  Beds were comfortable.  Location was unbelievable!  We arrived during a  heat wave and Wendy and Matt were very responsive to our concerns about the inside temps. They were easy to work with and responded within minutes.  We loved our stay and would highly recommend it to anyone!  Hope to come back and stay again when we return this fall for a Bears game! Thanks Wendy and Matt!

What a find! Conveniently located, just blocks from both the L and my son's home, with lots of shops, restaurants, and parks within 15 minutes walking distance. Clean and comfortable, a great place for my mom and I to stay and the 5 of us to hang-out for a bit. Even better than the photos!
The place was great and located in a perfect spot

We absolutely loved our stay here! We brought our two very large dogs and they felt right at home. The place is exactly as described!
We really really enjoyed the neighborhood. There are so many coffee shops, restaurants and bars right around you. Our dogs had plenty of green space to explore.

My family and I spent a long weekend in Chicago and enjoyed our stay at Joseph Ricardo’s home. The neighborhood is safe, calm, and walkable. Having a parking spot was extra nice amenity, but there’s also free street parking. The home is walking distance to a metro station, which we used to get to/from the loop.
The home itself was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. It was perfect for us, especially traveling with three kids.
I would definitely return!
great place to stay and vist Chicago, easy access to the train
Loved our stay, extremely spacious! Thomas and team were also very responsive
Great host and close to the train
Perfect place if you want a family friendly option in Wrigley. Great location, safe and easy parking!
Location was great and convenient to downtown. Apartment had a beautiful view of the city and a private deck. Great stay, modern, and quick/easy communication.

Very good location In terms of handiness, plenty of shops and food nearby. Also close to the train and a bus right outside the apartment. Host was very quick to communicate too and check in and out were very smooth and easy.
Everything was excellent!
staying here was a good experience with my friends. Beds were clean , great smell and enough amenities to provide for your needs.
The house was clean and comfortable.

This Airbnb was in a great location! Plenty of stores and restaurants within walking distance. Was the perfect area for getting to downtown and near the lake quickly. I would definitely stay here again the next time I visit Chicago!
Silvia is a fantastic host.

My girlfriend and I had a wonderful stay, It was very peaceful and felt safe the whole time. Street parking was no issue and we were able to park right by the house each time. The air bnb was very clean and free of any kind of mess. Would definitely recommend to anyone needing a place to stay in chicago!

nice place , clean, big room , big closes
alot room in house

The place worked out great for us! We came to town for a ballgame and it was a short walk to Wrigley Field. It is located in the Graystone district on a beautiful and quiet street, with many places to eat and visit within a very short walking distance. Daniel was very nice and easy to communicate with and the place was just as described. I would definitely recommend ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Brett’s spot was a great landing spot for us. Great coffee shop around the corner may or may not be contributing to this high rating! Although it’s a basement unit the ceilings are really high. Well stocked. Comfortable bed. Great for us!

I would not recommend staying here. The Airbnb was not clean when we arrived. Because of the condition of the property, we decided to check out early instead of staying for the remainder of our reservation. It was disappointing because the listing did not match the cleanliness we expected. I hope the host addresses these issues before future guests arrive.
Upon arrival, the listing stated that we would receive a parking pass, but one was never provided. Communication regarding that issue was not helpful.
Great Chicago experience
Was quiet and beautiful view loved the balcony
very cute little place, in a cute neighborhood!

It's also just a quick walk to the Red Line or an even quicker hop on the bus to get around town easily.
I'd never been to Andersonville but I'll likely be back. I found the neighborhood and the people there to be quite charming and friendly. Thanks Philip!
Would definitely stay again. Just like photos and has everything you need.
Makes such a difference when the host is so responsive! Thanks John.
I enjoyed my stay here the house was nice and spacious and very enjoyable to stay in, only issue was the parking around the street was bad because of the weekend
AC only goes down to 76 degrees. But other than that great stay. Would come back.

I absolutely loved staying in this Airbnb. I grew up in the suburbs of Chicago, moved away after high school and typically stay with family in the burbs when visiting. Plus, the unit is spacious, well designed, cozy and felt like being at home. I would absolutely stay here again and hope to! Chicago during the summer months is incredible. So happy I got this experience.
Derek was a excellent host and very responsive.We will be back excellent location. Planning on sharing with others.
exactly as promoted! I booked this for a friend who was in town and he said it was perfect.

Cristina was great! She provided clear instructions to the place, how to get in, and what was available. The pictures are accurate to what the apartment looks like. They ran in and out of the yard through the building next door and were out during the day and night. There was no evidence of rodents in the apartment, and we were still able to use the grill after some cleaning. This did not impact my feelings towards the apartment itself or the host, just something that I was not expecting and would want to know prior to booking. With that said, we enjoyed our stay.
The location was amazing. Easy to walk to bars and restaurants.

I found crumbs on the floor, stains on the bathroom counter, white stains on the blankets, and there was a noticeable urine odor. Unfortunately, the list of cleanliness issues continued.
When I complained and provided photo documentation, I was made to feel like I was the one in the wrong instead of my concerns being taken seriously. After I mentioned that a cleaning staff member had entered the unit unexpectedly, the host questioned whether it had actually happened and said they would check the CCTV footage, which made me feel as though I was being accused of lying. That was very disappointing. After requesting to be moved to a different unit, I was told management would first need to “inspect” the unit. I was not comfortable with that, especially after someone had already entered the unit unexpectedly.
The location was great, though.
The Fillmore Flat is located in a lovely neighborhood with several fantastic restaurants within walking distance. It served as a welcoming home base during our trip to Chicago.

Unfortunately, my stay did not go as planned and was a stressful experience.
The check- in instructions stated the apartment would be unlocked with keys inside. When I arrived, however, the door was locked and I was unable to enter. While calling the host, two unfamiliar men exited and re-entered the unit. As a woman traveling alone at night, this raised significant safety concerns for me.
When I explained the situation to Ensavi, he said he wasn’t sure what happened and would look into it, but I did not feel that my safety concerns were taken seriously.
After waiting in the lobby approximately 90 minutes, Airbnb was able to reach the host, cancel the reservation, and help me secure alternative accommodations.
I did appreciate that Ensavi came to the property while I was waiting for a solution.
Overall, my interactions with him felt dismissive. I did not feel my concerns were addressed with the level of professionalism or empathy I would expect from an experienced host.

We visited Chicago with one other couple and this space was perfect for that! The living room was spacious and comfortable, and the house close to bars and shops in Logan Square. I will say it was not as walkable to the train as we were hoping, but there was a heat wave when we came so it was unbearably hot for part of the time, even for a Chicago summer. Just something to consider depending on the season!
The actual street is beautiful and we enjoyed looking at all the cute homes and walking to the farmers market. We also felt very safe the entire time!
Great place to stay.  Loved the location.  Very nice neighborhood.  Having the parking spot is definitely helpful.  Would highly recommend!
Great place for the weekend, the host was attentive and helpful. Would definitely recommend and book again if I’m in town.

Came in super late off my train for the holiday! Scrambling for an air bnb and this one saved that day! Affordable, very clean and in a super nice peaceful area! Thanks again for allowing me to stay over the holiday!
Great location, close to many of the Chicago landmarks!

My stay at Zhi Guang's apartment was very comfortable. It is located on Chinatown, and it is very close to Chicago's downtown. In addition, Zhi Guang provided clear instructions of the check in process, so it was very easy to move inside the apartments.
Our only issue had nothing to do with Ledy's but we were there for the 4th of July weekend and there were fireworks going off until 2:00 or so Friday through Sunday night.....
Nice place! Quick respond! Good neighborhood located around lots of restaurants

This was a terrible stay for our family!Pictures of the unit are not up to date the unit is very rundown water damage to the room windows near air conditioner definitely not kid friendly unit. Missing curtains inside the room and blinds are damaged also the Airbnb ad says black out curtains and there are no black out curtains in here.wifi doesn’t work if you work from home or in school this isn’t for you. Tv works very slowly and lags.Washer stopped working the day before we checked out texted host and she sent a check out message instead of responding to our problem.

The neighborhood was clean, quiet and beautiful. We met the owner of the property as well as her. Son, very helpful, a very proactive, and anything that we needed. I will do this again every time I come to chicago five stars for sure

Getting in was a little challenging because the door was sticking due to the humidity in Chicago, but David was super quick in responding to my message.   There’s so much to do in the area. (coffee, shops, restaurants, some nightlife ) The Lakeview area is very safe. Easy walk to Wrigley Field and a quick walk to the Brown Line.

The house was clean, comfortable and as shown in the pictures.  Parking was sometimes difficult to find but we always managed to find a spot close by. Host was very friendly and responsive. My son loved the fluffy rugs in the kitchen- they were extremely soft he enjoyed sliding around on them in his socks.  The AC was kept nice and cool in the heat of the summer. All together we really enjoyed our stay.

Our family loved this home! The pictures show the property exactly as we found it, and the size was perfect for our family of four. The heat index the days we were there was over 100 degrees and the air conditioning kept both levels of the house cool and comfortable. The inside of the house was clean and the backyard space was lovely. The neighborhood is what makes this home even more special - it’s quiet and safe, and having a park in walking distance was a huge plus for our kids who went there to play baseball and basketball multiple times. We were able to park right in front of the house every time we came home, and any interactions we had with neighbors were friendly. We wanted to stay somewhere close enough to the city that we could get there easily, and this home gave us exactly that. The hosts were very responsive both before and during our stay, and we never had any issues that needed to be addressed. Truly can’t recommend this place enough!
Great place to stay with a terrific rooftop! We had a wonderful weekend and will stay again!

I’m rating this stay 3 stars because it was doable, but not enjoyable. I booked this 4-bedroom home so my brother could stay with us while we visited. When I asked if he could stay, the host said it would require an additional $211 charge, even though I had already paid for a 4-bedroom home and the fourth room would otherwise go unused. Because of that, my brother had to stay 40 minutes away, and we spent time driving back and forth each day. We also arrived to find two beds with noticeable stains, which made us uncomfortable. The host initially said the cleaner believed the marks were from detergent pods, but regardless of the cause, the beds didn’t appear clean. After I expressed my concerns, clean comforters were eventually brought over. The home also could have benefited from a much deeper cleaning overall. The stay worked for what we needed, but between the guest policy, bedding concerns, and overall cleanliness, I expected a better experience for the price.

This is a lovely place to stay, ESPECIALLY in the summertime. I came here for a trip with friends and had a blast. Tony and Tamara are lovely hosts with a sense of style! And they were generous with snacks and amenities. The neighborhood is excellent for getting around and also perfect for having an authentically Chicago time. I will always remember this weekend.
Charles place was perfect for my staycation,  great block, great neighborhood and neighbors and great place. Everything was as seen/described, super clean, great decor. Would book again/recommend!!

Do be aware of the low ceilings! This was the perfect place to sleep during our busy weekend in the city. The lay out of this home works very well as it feels more spacey than a studio. Note, there is no door to the bedroom and is instead an open L shaped layout. Tom was vey accommodating to our unexpected change of guests. Safe and friendly neighborhood.
Great location, beautiful place and friendly hosts!
Same chill experience, different day. You can always count on an easy stay at Josh's .
Really enjoyed the place I loved how peaceful and quiet it was I definitely needed it and definitely would book again

The house had everything we needed. It was clean, organized, and easy to get to. Matt was responsive and very helpful in getting us set up. Location was great for where we needed to be, but also easy to access all of Chicago. Having its own parking was another bonus.
beautiful place in a beautiful neighborhood. Loved our stay here.
Highly recommend!  Deserves a 5+++ rating!

We had exactly what we needed at Rasheed’s place. Easy to drive anywhere in town, not the quickest access walking places but not bad either. It was clean and communication was seamless. Thank you Rasheed for a lovely home away from home for our family!

The place was bigger than I thought, I traveled with two of my other friends, all of us loved how spacious it was, cheers to the architect, whoever designed it, even though it's a studio design, bed, living area, dining, kitchen, bathroom everything had it's own space not clumsy or cluttery, it's just a perfect shareable space for 2-3 adults.
Kaitlyn was always responsive, proactive, informative.
Thanks to the host and place, we really had a very comfortable stay.
Great awesome place.

Had a great experience at this property. Very convenient location with a lot things to do both day and night with just a short walk.
The hosts were extremely helpful and responsive. The private deck attached to the property was perfect and the interior was very clean and well kept up. Our party will for sure book again.
Thanks for a great stay, T A I M S!

We really enjoyed our stay here! The space is sleek, modern, and very comfortable with outstanding amenities. The location is absolutely fantastic—extremely walkable to all the shops, restaurants, and spots we needed to get to during our trip. We would definitely stay here again.

Troy is a great host and the location of the Airbnb is great. Very safe area. The house is a bit small, I’d say it’s ideal for one couple in the master room and two more people. The rooms are cramped but it works for one person per room. The house was extremely clean.

This place was perfect for what we were looking for.  Great location, easy to access, comfortable and so much more.  I can’t recommend it enough.  Stephanie was amazing!  Her listing instructions were clear and simple to understand.   The L runs outside one set of windows but the quality windows and noise machine did a great job helping us sleep well.  Thanks for helping our stay in Chicago be all that we were hoping for!
Julia was very helpful and always replied to any issues we had. We had a few small issues but Julia helped whenever she could as some of them were out of her control.

The apartment was very comfortable. We really enjoyed the big bedroom and the king bed with nice linens. The whole place was very clean. If you don’t mind climbing stairs then this is a great place in Bucktown
Great area, definitely great place with, importantly, comfortable beds.  Theodora is a great host and prompt communicator. We will return for sure.
Great stay the house was fully outfitted and comfortable. Lovely outdoor entertainment area for grilling and dining  Rafel was very accommodating and available if needed.

Jeffrey’s place was just right for our group. We slept 5 comfortably . We were able to walk to Wrigley and a number of great restaurants and bars on Southport. Jeffrey even had some coffee for us and was quick to respond to any questions. Highly recommend.
Great stay
Wonderful place, equipped with all we needed. Enjoyed movie theater in basement.
We had a great stay! The Airbnb was clean, quaint, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. It was well maintained, cozy, and exactly as described.

This place was excellent and the host was super responsive. We arrived in the middle of a heat wave and found that the AC had broken. Host had an HVAC repair person on site ASAP, despite that this likely happened to a bunch of people in the city. He was constantly checking in that the problem was solved and everything else was going well.
One thing I loved about this place was that the kitchen was properly stocked for a large group. There were enough plates, utensils, and —most importantly— pots and pans which were all in great shape. I cannot count the number of times I arrive at a place that bills itself as hosting large groups and there aren’t enough forks or pans or the pans are scratched. Not so for this place. If you cook when you travel this place has what you need including salt and pepper etc. I appreciate that the host leaves things like olive oil from prior guests so you don’t need to purchase ALL the basics when you arrive.
Great communication flexible entry
Location was great and the apartment was as described.
I have stayed in quite a few Airbnb’s and this is one of my favorites. It was clean, comfortable in a great location and great parking.

My family (grandmother, brother, wife, 4 year old, and I) had a great time at Laura's apartment for our 5 night stay in Chicago. We were close to the Blue line and 65 bus which helped us get to museums, zoos, playgrounds, and aquariums. The apartment was functional and the AC worked well during a heat wave. Having the laundry in unit was helpful. We ate at a couple of restaurants on Grand nearby and enjoyed our food. Laura was helpful and responsive with our questions.

Kim was a great host that was very friendly and responsive. Instructions for check in are very helpful. Being close to the brown line was great for going out and about, but the trains are pretty loud. Kim did provide ear plugs though! Water pressure in the apartment wasn’t great, but that was literally my only complaint.

The place was
perfect for what we needed and Antonio was very responsive and accommodating!!
Third time staying here and love it each time! Quiet and safe neighborhood, clean and spacious home with all the needed amenities. Andrea is an awesome host. Will be back.

Alex’s home is beautiful. We loved staying in an old Chicago home with so much character. The house was very clean and comfortable. It was big enough for everyone to spread out. The patio outside was a great spot to end our nights. The neighbors upstairs were quiet. We were just a block away from the train and the supermarket, which was very convenient. It’s a great location if you’re visiting Wrigley Field which was just a 15 minute drive or train ride away.

Very comfortable stay, we felt right at home.  The building was very quiet. We never heard any neighbors. Very close to Wrigley for Cubs games and easy access to stores and restaurants.  We had a lovely time.

Really enjoyed my stay here! Clean and comfortable space. Well stocked kitchen with Keurig coffee and lots of water bottles in the fridge. Friendly host. Altogether great value!
The location is very convenient, it's an easy commute to the airport and to the city center. Also, if you're a runner definitely check out the nearby Humboldt Park.
Staying here was so convenient and efficient for our trip! The place was incredibly clean & had a lot of amenities. Alex was extremely communicative and accommodating during our stay!
My family and I had an absolutely amazing time during our stay. The place is lovely and had everything we needed! You cant go wrong staying here with a large group!
Highly recommend. Nate was a great host. Spacious living area and very clean.

Overall, I enjoyed my stay.  Great communication and open space.   The kitchen needed some additional items in order to make a simple meal like spaghetti.   I’m not sure if the tenants above are permanent or temporary, but I could hear the vibrations of their phone notifications and alarm which was annoying throughout the night and at 5:30 am.

I really enjoyed the house. Very beautiful. Very accommodating. Felt like home. The area wasn’t the best, but the home is beautiful. Gym, grocery store, and quick restaurants are walking distance. This was a plus. Downstairs is freezing, so if you don’t like the cold stay upstairs. Parking garage. Rooftop deck was a plus. The description matched the house perfectly.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was great, and everything we needed was provided. The only issue we noticed was a used face cloth left behind in the bathroom, which seemed like a small housekeeping oversight. Other than that, everything was excellent, and we really enjoyed our stay. We would definitely stay here again!
It was a great stay I enjoyed it!!!

Great stay! The place looked just like the photos and was completely as advertised. It's very affordable compared to other spots in the area, felt private, and check-in was super easy. Joseph was really fast to respond to messages too. Would definitely recommend!
Host was very responsive, directions were very clear and the home was not only welcoming but very secured with alarm system

Our family had an amazing time  and the unit was perfect for us.  The kids loved the bunk room.  The views were so amazing that most nights we watched the city view instead of tv.  The location was great, close to coffee and groceries.  Our visit was too short.  We hope to come back again.
It was good stay for 2-3 days of trip
Wonderful place! Matt was responsive and very helpful.

Such a great stay! The studio was spotless, cozy, and had everything we needed(we even cooked one night!) The hosts were amazing to work with..friendly, communicative, and genuinely cared about making sure we had a great experience. We got a great list of places to visit and all were 10/10. The view from the top of the studio was amazing as well.
We loved the Pilsen neighborhood. It was easy to walk to restaurants, coffee shops, and explore the neighborhood, while still being convenient to everything we wanted to do around Chicago.
We are definitely booking here again when we are back in the city and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Be for sure to check linen on beds and pillows for cleanliness.  I had food stains from previous guest on the bed linen and pillow cases, very unsanitary. However, I reached out and they came to make it right by replacing the linen right away. Overall outside of that incident the stay was nice.

The stay at Victor's was great! He was very responsive and flexible with requests.  The place was much bigger than expected.  We were close to the places we planned to check out. Plenty of parking. 2 of the 3 beds are very firm. Overall I would recommend and stay again. I've struggled with finding decent places at a reasonably price. This air bnb has been my best experience in Chicago.
Was a perfect place to stay while in Chicago for the long holiday weekend. Was very charming and was thrilled there were many places to check out nearby. Would def stay here again.
We enjoyed our stay very much! The apartment was perfect for us and our dog. Fantastic location. Very helpful and communicative hosts.
Na

Good place to stay if you prefer a quiet neighborhood relatively between O’Hare and Chicago. House was overall clean and had nice on-theme decorations and various amenities. Host was very communicative. Bus stop is a few min walk away and connects to the blue line (but transit takes ~1 hr to the city vs. 30 min by car).

We had a lovely stay!  Q.5 blocks off ñ the North End of the Magnificent Mile (Michigan ave).  Great space, good AC, no ce kitchen and beds.  Comfortable space with so much to offer also rooftop access, free laundry.

Our stay at this home was lovely, i would highly recommend this home to anyone traveling with a large family. We had a group of nine, and the house provided plenty of space and entertainment for the children. The neighborhood was peaceful. We also appreciated the convenient location, which offered easy access to nearby stores and pharmacies. Tasha was a great host, check-in was easy and we appreciated her quick responses.

Rating: 5/5 Stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had an absolutely wonderful stay! Lynette and Efrain were awesome hosts who made us feel welcome. Their communication was excellent—they were very responsive and understanding from the day we booked.
They kindly stocked the fridge before our arrival and left a nice welcome basket.
The place was clean and nice. Great park across the road and overall quiet. There is some creaking from the floors above but it's not a deal breaker. We were there during a heatwave so the 2 AC units had a hard time keeping all the rooms cool, but each room had a fan which was nice and one had a unit pushing hot air and humidity out of the unit.
If you are visiting Chicago, recommend Lynette and Efrain’s place. Thanks for making it feel like a home away from home.

W O N D E R F U L ‼️
We had a wonderful weekend. Oliver provided the house rules and codes before we arrived. This place is beautiful, spacious and it was located in the
middle of everything we needed and wanted.(shopping & eating) We were in town for our family reunion, our party consisted of 4 adults and 2. children. The 2 units were perfect for us and it was cheaper than our host hotel. Every family member that visited us LOVED this place and we felt right at home‼️ Thank you Oliver‼️

The stay was very comfortable, and the location was convenient with easy access to the metro. Dorian was very responsive throughout our stay and was always helpful.
He also kindly allowed us to leave our luggage at the property after checkout, which was a huge help and made our travel plans much easier.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend staying here.

I paid $30 to check in early. The air-conditioning never worked the entire state. There was absolutely no resolution and as soon as compensation for no air-conditioning was brought up I was ghosted by the host. In addition, it was dirty there was animal droppings behind the couch the windowsill was filthy. The toilet was disgusting and under the bed was filthy. The floor had not been cleaned. There was open food containers in the cabinets in the fridge.
Prudence’s place was great! Steps away from Wrigley Field and Wrigleyville it made for an awesome CUBS weekend!

Excellent property in the heart of Chicago. Enjoyed being able to walk to many attractions and restaurants. Also an easy spot for Uber pickup and drop off for the longer adventures.
The property was clean and surprisingly quiet. We rarely heard other guests/tenants. We were in Chicago for the long holiday weekend with our college age children. Liked having space to spread out and relax at night, but also good common areas to enjoy our time together. Also a very usable kitchen.
The balcony was a plus and something I was looking for in a rental for this trip. We spent our mornings and evenings looking out over the city and enjoying its sites and sounds. Also nice to have private, easy access to outdoor space in the city.
Definitely would stay again!

Apartment was clean, comfortable and perfect for our stay! The neighborhood has great shops and restaurants nearby. Grocery store and Walgreens was a 10 mins walk. Jackalope Cafe was my daily go to. You don’t need a car. Beautiful park across the street. The transit system is spot on and I got everywhere I needed without much walking using the bus and train.
It was clean, in a safe area, and as described. Would return anytime.

This is a beautiful rehab of a basement Chicago apt.  The place was easy to find and get into it. There is a small flight of steps going down into the apt for those who may not be able to do them.  Our daughter lives in Lincoln Square and this place was a 10 min walk to her house through Lincoln Square.  I love to walk the neighborhoods.  Beautiful gardens, lots of people out and it's walkable to restaurants and shops.  The apt itself was very comfortable and spacious and like everyone else said, the spa shower is great.  There is a small closet to hang a few things.  No dresser or anywhere to put other clothes but we ended up using the kitchen table for that.  It worked out very well for our needs!
Very nice place to stay - super clean and quiet. Loved the great collection of books on the shelves!
Everything was super smooth from check in to check out. Exceptional neighborhood and convenient area for a weekend visit to Chicago. The home was clean and everything worked fine. Thank you!
This is a great location.  Checking was easy and everything was exactly as described. Would stay again.

Great and clean house ! It’s highly recommended!
Thanks again for hosting us
Great place to stay and always helpful!
Our stay at Ryan's place was great. The area was very nice and it felt safe getting in and around the building. the place was very clean and comfortable.

Safe and welcoming neighborhood.
Definitely recommend and will be staying here again on my next visit.
Me and my wife and friends love the place nice and clean. Excellent kitchen will be booking again.

Great location. Very walkable. Close to coffee shops and lots of art!  There’s also a park across the street so it was great for our small family. Rene was great to communicate with. He answered all of our questions quickly & was so accommodating. We would definitely stay here again.

I had a really chill time at the gallery. An artist residency, the space is creativity incarnate.
Every person I ran into and had the chance to spend some time with were delightful.
You cannot go in thinking this is some pristine 4seasons. Not at all the point. Becoming part of the Chicago Art and Wicker Park community is such a great feeling.
Way to go!
This a great place to be to visit the area. Especially the beaches and Wrigley Field. Very clean and accomadating. Lots of shopping and dining within walking distance.
Anton and Kira's place had everything we needed for a week long stay in Chicago. They offered plenty of neighborhood recommendations and the apartment was tidy and easy to access.
Enjoyed the stay! Would definitely book again!

We had an amazing stay! The apartment was spotless, cozy, and had a beautiful downtown skyline view. The location was perfect and made it easy to get around the city. The host was fantastic, checking in with us each day to make sure we had everything we needed. We truly felt welcomed and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!

I had a pleasant stay with my sisters at Neighborhood Hotel ! The check-in was easy, the host very responsive and communicative and the place beautiful ! Although there was a problem with the AC, the host asked us to change rooms but overall a great experience and I'll definetely recommend the place.

This place is perfect. Close to everything wriglyville!! Walking to and from the game takes minutes at best and it’s just a short uber ride to things you may want to do in lakeview or wicker park etc. This place checks all the boxes. Will be back!

Great value for a solid hub for city exploration. Immediate area is so-so and not particularly walkable but you're only a short Uber ride away from great neighborhoods like Wicker Park and Logan Square.  Host does a great job being super transparent and the Airbnb listing gives an honest description of the peculiarities of the specific unit (like the upstairs footsteps...which weren't a bother to me). Only other thing to note (which has been mentioned in other reviews and is hinted at in the description) is the wifi is a bit flaky and it went out repeatedly while watching Roku and later while working so just a heads up if you really depend on the interwebs. But that was really the only quibble. Also it has a board game called "Keeping it Saxy with Kenny G" so overall it's a 10 out of 10.

Quite frankly, the unit was extremely unprepared for guest. Upon entering there was a strong mildew stench and the window AC unit was off. There were several dead bugs found throughout the home, most noticeable in the bath tub, kitchen, and living room. The floors were covered with dirt and grime. The dishes were not clean and cups in the cabinet had brown grime in them. There was a yellow stain on one of the mattresses and trash left under both beds. There was also mold under the kitchen sink. There was a garage advertised for the short term renters, but was not ready for them to use. If you have a chance to stay somewhere else, do it.

The back door leaks so when it rains there is water all over the floor inside. The shower door in the bathroom the liner is coming off. There will be no street parking in front of the building. Over all the stay was great.
Great host and stay!  Highly recommended due close proximity to downtown activities.  Place is beautiful and look forward to rebooking.
Very welcoming host, offered me coffee in the morning:)
What a great find! Gorgeous view, beautiful design, super comfortable. Would love to stay there again. Went to Manchamanteles for dinner and loved everything we ordered and the chef.

Was a super nice family, friendly, and clean space. Beds were super cozy with a nice patio set up in the back. Couch was great for movies to wind down at the end of the day. Mimi was super responsive and great to deal with. It made our anniversary that much better. Not to mention the neighborhood was cool to drive around and look at.

Andy was a great host. We ran into some small issues but he was very accommodating and quick with communication/problem solving. I will consider staying again since I visit Chicago a few times a few times a year to see family.
Amazing stay ! would recommend,  Thank you!
The description may have undersold how great of a place this is to stay at. The communication from the host is amazing!

Good location, roughly 10 minute walk to California blue line station. Logan Square also has cafes and bars around. I did not explore the features of the apartment but it seemed to match the description and was clean all around. Relatively quiet neighborhood at night. I would stay here again. The hosts were mostly responsive; however there was one instance where I requested a house supply be restocked and they only acknowledged the request the following morning.

Fantastic clean well appointed and walkable to everything
great area to stay while in Chicago
Nicole and Matt were very responsive from time I. ooked to departure
anyone coming to Chicago should look to stay at their place

Lovely apartment in a great area, within walking distance of Wrigley field and plenty of restaurants and bars. The building was clean and quiet. Washing machine and tumble dryer with detergent provided was a nice touch. The floors are a tad creaky so we could hear our upstairs neighbours walking around but otherwise it was very quiet with minimal street noise.
Yasmin’s place was comfortable and had all the amenities needed for a home away from home. It was a great stay!

What a fantastic find. We loved our stay here so much that we changed our plans to move on and tried to extend our stay.
We arrived during an extreme storm with an electricity black out in the whole area and Stan/Rick couldn’t do enough for us. Immediately we felt fortunate to have such great hosts.
The place itself had the best equipped kitchen we’ve ever seen. Totally home from home.
The area was fantastic. Five minute easy walk to the red line and lots of restaurants and shops all close at hand.
I would 100% recommend Rick/Stan’s place & would definitely return to this accommodation should I ever be lucky enough to be able to return to Chicago.
Private parking for 2 cars was also a very welcome benefit of this property.
Until next time. Take care. X
Great place close to Lincoln Park, clean house and safe location.
The house was  great and the host was responsive and helpful!
The home was exactly like the pictures. Very spacious, clean and well equipped for vacation rental. The area was very peaceful and most importantly safe. We enjoyed our stay here.
Great stay, I would recommend!

Four of us traveled from Texas to attend the Cubs v Cardinals series. Michaels place was the perfect location for walking to Wrigley!
We utilized the outdoor space everyday for coffee and drinks. It was peaceful and relaxing.
Visited the farmers market on Saturday and walked to the Lake on Sunday morning.
As hosts ourselves, highly recommend this place!!!
Loved My Stay Thank You For Letting Me Stay For The Weekend

Loved our stay here! Place was just as described and worked very well for our family of 4. Never felt dark or closed in despite being a basement apartment, and the trundle beds worked great for our two kids. Ample closet space for clothes and luggage. Also stayed nice and cool during a heat wave! Wonderful location in one of our favorite parts of Chicago. Would happily stay here again!

This is the second time we've stayed at Elizabeth and Santi's place. It's lovely, spacious and down the block from our kids we were visiting. There's room for us to spread out and have our other children when they are with us. Both are very responsive and helpful when needed!
Very beautiful, spacious and private space! Location is also close to bus and subway station
This was a wonderful place to stay on a family trip down to Chicago with my wife and two daughters. Thank you, Kimberly!
Great Host! Great place to stay while in Chicago.
Everything went swimmingly. The communication was prompt and extremely curtious. Space was clean and homey.

We stayed at Matthew's place over the 4th of July weekend. His instructions for check-in/out were very clear as were his notes about the space. Our son enjoyed checking out the expansive Lego city display. The kitchen was perfect for what we needed over those few days. There were plenty of pillows and blankets to use.
The only thing that stuck out was that all of the wooden floorboards were creaky, which is fine for an old building, but made it difficult to move around while one of us was sleeping.

Great location. The unit was clean, comfortable, well put together, and homey. This was a great spot for my friend group to stay and it exceeded all of our expectations. The neighborhood was walkable and had several restaurants nearby.
Emma was proactive, communicative, and ensured that we had all the information that we needed. Thank you for hosting us!
Great stay! The place was exactly as described. Johanna was also super responsive when we had questions-- really appreciated it!!
Great location and fantastic fenced yard!
Property matches the pictures.

Alicia is definitely the host with the most!  Great communicator--friendly, quick to respond, AND calm in an emergency! Yes, after wild thunderstorms in Chicago, our place flooded. Alicia jumped into action, made sure we were OK, and got Airbnb in touch with us immediately. Happily, due to the wise design, the water was contained in the living/dining room, and our stuff was untouched! The next day, Alicia graciously delivered some items we left behind in the fridge to our conference venue. I want her to be my new best friend!
Great location, great host, it was a great stay!

Daniel was an awesome host, checked in with us that everything was going well and was very responsive when we needed assistance. The house is in a very nice neighborhood and is spacious. It does need some maintenance however; a closet door didn’t work, towel hooks/rails were missing, and one bedroom window had no blinds or curtains so it was quite light. A little bit of tlc would elevate the house from good to great.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The hosts were extremely communicative and we genuinely experienced no issues during our stay.

The air conditioning stopped working on the second day and the host was not able to get it fixed (no available HVAC technician). On the fourth night we moved to a new condo,  but Chicago during a heat wave was not fun with no AC.  Everyone slept horribly and we did not want to cook there because it was so hot and ended up eating out a lot more than planned. Host only offered a $200 credit for each of the two nights impacted but when I paid over $700 a night this was ridiculous. Place has six bedrooms versus five and was in a good location.  Definitely not hotel quality beds/pillows/linens but other posted this so knew going in.  2nd floor trash chute backed up but that was an issue with building maintenance (common areas were also very run down).
Amazing home great spot
Stayed a few days. Love the Southport area and very easy to get to Wrigley. Davis and Trove were easy to work with and very responsive.

The beds at Tony’s palace were extremely comfortable! His home is just how it was described. The parking garage was clutch considering there was no street parking available. We arrived in 4th of July and oh my!! The neighborhood fireworks were amazing however it was extremely loud, clearly not anything Tony can control but be mindful of that.
Great spot with plenty of street parking. Comfortable and clean interior. Matches listing. Has two window A/C units even though listing says no A/C.
Loved Wrigleyville Oasis! Great location. Easy for Cubs games. Great patio for morning coffee. Carlos was communicative and friendly. Will definitely recommend and be back.
Cannot recommend this place enough Tripp, Todd and Eddie(dog) were perfect hosts.
Great location and views! Easy access to all the things we wanted to do.
Great place to stay.   Very clean & roomy.   Well liked area.  Walking distance to many different shops & places to eat.   Host very prompt on messaging back.  I highly recommend.

Great location, especially with the Red Line less than a block away, and the shared spaces were clean. We knew we were booking a shared space, and everyone we met during our stay was friendly.
One suggestion would be to let guests know ahead of time if there will be additional guests in the common area. We arrived very late due to a flight delay and were surprised to find guests sleeping on the couch. The host explained the situation after we reached out, and everything was fine, but having that information in advance would have helped set expectations. We also experienced some loud door slamming early in the morning on two nights, but otherwise had a pleasant stay.
Just a wonderful place and a wonderful host and a lot of her personality in Lisa design will love to go again thank so much for support during or stay all the best for your future

Laura was super responsive before, during, and after our stay! Everything was easy to access, and we had everything we needed to be comfortable while traveling with my 1-year-old. Would definitely stay again next time we’re in town!

This was our second stay and we loved it just like the first time. Great amenities in the building, great location, great restaurants, responsive hosts and clear directions/instructions. Would do it again!

This was a great, quiet, and peaceful place surrounded by an amazing walkable community. Argelia was responsive and was totally friendly. I strongly recommend her place and would stay again when I am in the area!
Overall it was a good stay.
Great location and easy access. Very friendly hosts

Our stay was fantastic. Everything was in walking distance. It was in the right location. We went to a couple of cubs games, went bar hopping, had a great time, beautiful place.  Flew in and out of Midway airport used the "L" train everywhere we went, went downtown to beaches used the train, great create location used the "L" train didn't have to rent a vehicle didn't have to Uber, it was great place.  Both bedrooms perfect, bathrooms were perfect, living room great to sit and relax everthing was like being at home.
Bianca was such a sweetheart! Beautiful home, would recommend!

The house is filled with beautiful black artwork that truly graced me eyes and time spent there. The host was soo responsive, easy to talk to and great curator of the space. Thank you for welcoming me into your home!

This location and space could not be better for anyone looking to have both a relaxing and magical Chicago experience! Andersonville is one of our favorite neighborhoods -- locally owned businesses, family friendly, amazing food, cafes and nightlife.
The hosts were so communicative and friendly! When we encountered a question about the tub they immediately jumped into action and fixed it.
Would definitely stay there again and recommend it for families and friends to have a peak Chicago experience!
Place was in a decent area and well located

Really enjoyed my stay here. Place was cozy and felt like home. They did a great job in providing everything we needed and so much more! Place is right next to a few bus stops, made it super convenient  to go out and explore Chicago. I was able to take the bus directly to all the destinations, restaurants, etc. that  I wanted to see! Great hosts who are kind and responsive. 10/10 recommend this place. Looking forward to booking this again when I return!

Loved the place. I was supposed to arrive around 9pm, but got delayed and arrived closer to midnight. Mary was superb in accommodating the late check-in, sent me all the instructions and notes beforehand, and if I missed a question someplace, she checked-in about that too. All said, had a great, peaceful stay, and would happily return to stay here again.
Jhon’s place was in a perfect location and was great for my 7 guests. I recommend booking.
Appreciated our stay!
Great hosts! Very clean, excellent location. Walkable to Wrigley field and restaurants. Will stay again. Highly recommend!

Great place to stay. Very walkable area. Comes with free parking with your stay in a covered garage. Hosts responded to every message quickly. Very clean and modern. I wished the sofa was a little bigger/comfier when waking up or winding down for the day. Als Italian Beef is only a block away great place to try. Everything you need is at the apartment very spacious. Coffee available as well as glasses and dishes. I would definitely stay again.
Our stay was great and the home was as described. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely book again in the future.
We really enjoyed our stay here. The unit is thoughtfully designed and well-equipped. Building is in a great location. Beds are quite comfortable too. Highly recommend.

Area felt very safe and taking the dogs out to the little yard was very convenient! I also appreciated the bed rooms had extra fans in them since I always need one to sleep and air bnbs never have them!

My boyfriend and I took this trip to visit family I hadn't seen in a long time. Not only did Nicola's space allow me to come back home, but it gave a great first impression to my boyfriend who had never been to the Chicago/Evanston area before. It was clean, beautiful, comfortable, all with great communication
Convenient location, responsive hosts, and very comfortable!
Stayed here with wife and two kids. Great setup for my family and so conveniently located! Perfect spot if staying in Lincoln Park.
The instructions were clear. I was able to check in and out easily with no problems.
Nice street in a good location. Clean and tidy. Basic supplies and decor. It worked  for our stay visiting folks on the street.
A charming little spot for a weekend getaway. Glad I booked!

Our family of 5 really enjoyed staying at Colin’s. The neighborhood is great for walking around and access to grocery store, restaurants and bars. The parking was really helpful for the neighborhood. The place fit our needs with teens as everyone had a bed. Colin was very communicative and flexible.

Right next to Chinatown. Walking distance to redline. The place is clean and you can see Zane put effort to maintain the place. The only thing is the location is close to fire department. You can hear midnight sirens but it didn’t trouble me.

It was a cozy little stay that was close to everything we wanted to do in Chicago. Parking is a bit tricky but SpotHero helped as well, always read the signs. Brad was very responsive when we asked questions and the apartment was adequately stocked with necessities. I’d recommend his place to anyone staying in Chicago.
Wonderful place to stay!
Our company stayed here for a business trip. Nice to have everyone at one location. The neighborhood was quiet, off street parking was nice. The home was clean. Would definitely stay here again.
Easy check in, great location, accommodated our group size, we would definitely stay here again! The rooftop at night… 😍

The place looks just like the photos, it is a nice open space that is good to be in for a short stay.  The neighborhood is nice- lots to do and easy to get around. There is a flight of stairs to get up to it that we overlooked- it is fairly steep and narrow/windy. There is a fair amount of noise at night from outside the windows that may make it difficult to sleep if you are a lighter sleeper. Also, the radiator for the air conditioning can be quite loud. Amy is a great host and she was accommodating/flexible for check ins. I would recommend the place to all looking for a comfortable stay.
Very nice place to stay, close to restaurants, Wrigley field,  the host was very helpful, easy to get in, quiet place.
Had a great stay! Communicative hosts and a great location.
Great place, very clean and nice. Great location with a lot around.

Anyone in search for a perfect spot for you and your partner, or your family near the 606 and in between Wicker Park and Logan Square, look no further! Great location, plus a great host, plus retro arcades all combine for an enjoyable weekend stay. Kudos for such a creative Airbnb design. We had hours of fun checking out the city and local recommendations and loved playing some classic arcade games! I would recommend this spot to anyone looking for a great time and sweet spot for the price, location, and unique experience.
Great location.  Walkable to Magnificent Mile and Navy Pier.

Great place to stay! Quiet neighborhood. About 15-20 minutes from all the touristy spots. Nicholas was very responsive and helpful. I would recommend his place to anyone going to Chicago. Perfect spot for girls trip!!

We had a wonderful stay with our two children, the apartment is comfortable and had everything we needed. Dean responded quickly and was very friendly, we broke a cup while washing it and he was very understanding.  We were able to take public transportation to do all the tourist attractions and to get around in the city. We would definitely recommend it!

Nice neighborhood near Wicker Park. 7 minute walk to the train line. Close to a main street with little shops and restaurants. Quaint accommodations with clear directions and a very responsive host. Covered parking available.
Great host and pristine home with plenty of room to spare on a quiet street! Close enough to access downtown, restaurants, and lake within a few minutes.
We loved staying here. Close to the park and lake michigan. Thanks for having us.

Enjoyed our stay here and appreciated the king size beds and layout! There are two bedrooms and two bathrooms upstairs and two bedrooms and one bathroom downstairs which worked well for our group as half of us were on west coast time. While we didn’t use them it was appreciated that there were tvs in every bedroom and the upgrades in the basement to the wet bar area were great.
A few upgrades like better towels, pillows, and including small dressers in the downstairs bedrooms would go a long way as there’s not really any spot to store your clothes downstairs.
Overall, felt like a great place and the location felt safe with easy access to several spots.

Host was great and very communicative and answered anything we needed promptly. We had a great time and the listing was accurate so 5* no doubt, but there were some things worth noting for future visitors:
I've never stayed that close to a train so if you're like me be aware that it's very loud and runs all night. I'd never take a star off for that because it's clearly mentioned in the description, but I wasn't as prepared as I needed to be for it.
Place sleeps 2 comfortably between the bed and the pull out sofa, 4 if it's two couples or people willing to share a bed. It was 3 grown men in our group so two of us had to share the bed. I misread the listing and thought we could have 3 individual sleeping situations, but that's not possible in this space.
RECOMMENDATIONS:
- Kelly's across the street isn't fancy but we loved it and became our nightcap spot
- Both coffee shops across the street were excellent
- You can walk anywhere from here, hit the Zoo if you can
- Easy walk to train
Great place close by great areas
The area was peaceful the house itself is peaceful. Anything I needed the host were very responsive and polite. Cannot wait to book again.
Great spot on the northern end of Chicago, especially for a larger group!
Enjoyed my stay! Alina and Jeff were amazing hosts. They communicated clearly and in a responsive manner, always were willing to help and make us feel at home. 100% recommend this place!
Great stay
overall great stay !

The place is coveniently located on a bus line ( bus #20), which makes it easy to commute to and from the city. Check- in and check-out instructions are very clear and that made the the process easier for me and my family. Having a dedicated garage parking spot was a great addition to our experience. Generally a great host, space and location.
place was clean, as described, clear instructions for checking in and out, Mike is a great host, always responsive and helpful and will recommend this place.

The design and decor were masterfully done, the beds by far the most comfortable of any Airbnb we've ever visited, and the upstairs private deck idyllic.  We enjoyed a relaxing 4-night July 4th weekend, complete with a game of Monopoly, excellent local dining, and a short walk to the beach. And a turntable and disco balls?  Yes, please!
We had a great time despite all the rain thank you for you accommodating us

Very nice and spacious on the inside. Always had parking in front of the house. Host very nice and responsive. Curb appeal could be better with a few simple upgrades. Clean quiet neighborhood easy access to the highway. We enjoyed our stay.
Amazing location and clean apartment with all the essentials!

This place was a beautiful, clean, and spacious. A two bedroom, two bathroom apartment this nice is difficult to find in Chicago for the price! Owner was fantastic and was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!

I have stayed here twice now. It’s always very clean and exactly what the pictures show. Very close walk to Wrigley. The host is extremely responsive and willing to accommodate any concerns you may have. I plan to spend a weekend here each year for the foreseeable future!

Highly recommend!!!  We stayed here in July 2025 and again this past weekend. Maurizio again was a great host.  Along with his great communication, he furnishes the property with amenities, coffee and snacks for your stay.  His property was immaculate, private and cozy. The location is excellent right in the heart of Wrigleyville.  Great restaurants, bars and Wrigley Field are all in walking distance. We had a great weekend and will definitely stay again.  Thank you, Maurizio!

This is a decent place to stay for a few nights. It's important to understand that this is a house divided into two sides of 5-6 rooms each, converted solely into short-term rentals. They're all listed on here, but are advertised like it's someone's guest room. The walls are are paper thin, the bed creaks and mattress is very thin, door hinges squeak, and you can hear every movement others make in the area. There's a shelving unit pushed in front of the kitchen drawer now so you can barely open it to get silverware. You're sharing a bathroom with 4 other units on the same hallway, so it can be awkward at times. I wish I'd spent a little more and read more reviews, but it was fine for what it is.
Ight

Very convenient location. The neighborhood feels safe and has plenty of facilities around (restaurants, bakery, coffee, grocery store). It is also within walking distance to the second city main stage which is a delightful surprise. The apartment is exactly what we expected, clean and cozy. Just be careful with the low ceiling on the second floor. We bumped our heads when getting up and forgot about the ceilings 😂 otherwise it’s a wonderful place to stay.

I must says that hosts were very caring and attentive throughout our visit, making sure everything was comfortable and well taken care of.
The property was exactly as shown in the listing photos, with no surprises. Everything was clean, well-maintained, and accurately represented. The only problem is Master bedroom is right next to train station. Trains run through out. Expect this rest all are really good.
I liked the way it was organized- Kitchen Utensils. You need not to bring anything. Everything is around. Just grab as you need.
Overall, we had a good experience and would recommend if you are looking for a spacious place as we have 4 bedrooms.

We had a lovely stay, we loved the view and were able to watch fireworks from the west side of the city right from the room over the 4th of July. The gym is amazing and there are buses and the L access to get anywhere within walking distance. Also, of you have train lovers there are plenty to see throughout your stay.

Beautiful place right on Humboldt Park. The living space is beautifully furnished, and we had plenty of space to spread out. The kitchen was immaculate and well equipped. The upstairs shower in the primary bedroom is so luxurious! Highly recommend.
Great place!
Michael was very responsive and his house was much nicer than I expected. The outside area was very inviting. It was close to public transportation. It was a great spot for us.

We stayed here with a large group of friends visiting Chicago, so we needed a place that could comfortably fit everyone and was well-connected to public transit. Sibani’s place checked all of the boxes. It’s close to the Blue Line as well as several helpful bus routes, making it easy to get around the city.
The space itself was clean and had plenty of room for our whole group. We also loved having access to the on-site gym and in-building laundry. Would definitely recommend this spot for groups looking for a comfortable, well-located home base in Chicago!

Incredible location for our visit to Wrigley Field. Loved the neighborhood and so much to be able to walk to. Plenty of restaurants and everything you need within a couple of blocks. Loved the access to the L train as well. Unit came fully stocked with everything we needed for our stay. Huge place for our family of 3. Be aware that there are 4 flights of stairs to get up there. Really had a great time in Chicago!

Abel was a great! Super responsive when we needed to access another set of keys. The yard was perfect for my doggo, and the house was tucked away on a quiet street in the most eclectic neighborhood of Avondale. Would totally stay again and highly recommend.
Great location for Cubs games. Very responsive host. Great value. Thanks!
Very responsive host, Airbnb looks just like the pictures very convenient.
An easy and flexible check-in goes a long way for me, and this was exactly that

The apartment is great for two people.  The bedroom is not air conditioned but there is a floor fan, so it wasn't too bad at night.  The location is no more than a 60 seconds walk from Wrigley Field - couldn't ask for anything better! We found the entire space comfortable, but be warned if you are on the taller side you have duck your head a lot and be very aware of where the pipes are. I understand location most likely drives the price of this apartment up during the baseball season, but I feel it was over priced.  I booked it knowing the full price only because it was my wife's birthday weekend, otherwise I definitely would not have paid that much. This is strictly my opinion and the apartment itself was nice.

Emily was a great host and very responsive. This is definitely the place to book for a very clean and well put together airbnb. It fit the 4 of us comfortably and there were no complaints at all. We’re all very happy with our stay.

We had such a great time staying at Ashley's Airbnb! It was everything she had described… And more. We were surprised at the short walk to Wrigley for the ball game and also surprised at all the bars and restaurants surrounding the Airbnb. Boys Town did not disappoint! We had a great meal and had a great breakfast at a local café bakery right down the street. We will definitely be back.
The pictures do this home no justice! Loved the terrace area so much. Highly recommended

Oba Soft home was very nice and affordable. I came to visit Chicago for a family reunion.  The apartment felt just like being at home. Communication was very clear ans easy to follow. I would definitely stay here again. 5 out of 5

Great communication from the host.  AC went out the first night but the manager had an HVAC guy to the home immediately and replaced the HVAC.  Loved the location, nice neighbors, felt safe.  There was some noise from upstairs tenant, no filtered water available.  Frig water dispenser doesn’t work.  Some bugs in the apartment.

We appreciated Rasheed's responsiveness so very much! The apartment was fantastic! It was spacious and clean and exactly as he described! The Gold Coast location could not have been better for our family with all of the July 4 weekend activities! Perfect!

Everything was just as described and it was very clean and surprisingly quiet even though you’re right there in the middle of the city. There were plenty of things to do right there on the street and you’ll never get bored.
Great safe place to stay
Mae was extremely responsive and give clear instructions of how to get into the house. She was also flexible with an early check in time.
Nice neighborhood and very nice place. I felt at home. AC in both bedroom and main room which was really amazing in this weather. Would definitely recommend

We had a great stay overall. Jeveaux was incredibly responsive and friendly throughout our trip, answering questions quickly and making check-in very easy. The apartment was clean and comfortable. We also appreciated the nearby restaurants and the convenient access to the Metra, which made getting downtown easy in about 20 minutes.
There were just a few minor things to note. Some of the dishes in the kitchen were a bit dirty and needed to be washed before use. The bedroom tended to be much warmer than the living room since that’s where the AC unit is located, so it took a little extra effort to keep the temperature comfortable. We found ourselves preferring Uber over public transportation after dark.
Overall, the excellent communication from the host, easy check-in process, and convenient location made this a very enjoyable stay. We really appreciated Jeveaux’s hospitality and had a great trip.

Great location, easy ride to downtown/the cities attractions. Living room decor is very nice. Amenities are as is, no complaints. Great AC, nice shower in master bedroom. Plenty of curbside parking. If staying on 3rd floor, stairs are a little steep. Great place, great host. Would recommend & would stay again.

We really enjoyed our stay! The place was in a great location, with many of Chicago’s popular attractions within easy reach. The host was very responsive, checked in on us throughout our stay, and was always willing to help. We’d happily stay here again!
Great neighborhood and location! Nice park across the street, lots of street parking. Very responsive and kind host!
Excelente hotel muy cómodo
Excellent house to rent.

Lizbeth was a great host and made us feel welcomed. She was also very responsive. Everything appeared as advertised.
The location was 20 minutes away from everything and close to the l station.
The home was clean and the parking permits were provided. We had no problem parking. I recommend this home.

The house is located in a North Chicago residential area. Lois and Eduardo are professional Airbnb hosts who are friendly, responsive, and proactive. Their place is pristinely clean and free of clutter. The bed is huge and very comfortable, and I got a great night's sleep. To get downtown, we took the Red Line and the 147 bus. The commute takes about 40 minutes, and the house is conveniently located just a 10-minute walk from the station. I would recommend this place.
Beautiful, massive house in a wonderful neighborhood. Great for a family get together. Would stay here again
My friend and I enjoyed our stay in Chicago. The place was very nice and cozy! Vin was a great host and very communicative.
Spacious house, good location, responsive host.

I was pleased with my stay. Host was very responsive, upon check in we realized there were not enough comforters for the beds needed and host immediately sent a comforter over. The couch/sofa bed does not stay in place as it is a modular couch so we did not use that as an extra bed. We had originally reserved for 7, however one person dropped out of our trip so we luckily didn’t need the couch as a bed. The inflatable bed was comfortable enough.
The place is clean and comfortable. We did attempt to access the pool however it was out of service. I understand that is more of a building maintenance issue so I didn’t hold it against the host. I especially loved not having a long list of instructions to check out. Host said to leave everything as it was, we did try to tidy up however, appreciated not having a long laundry list of chores to do prior to leaving.
I definitely recommend and would stay here again next time I visit Chicago.

We went for a long weekend in Chicago for games at Wrigley Field, it was about a 20 min walk, perfect for us. A great home in a great neighborhood, everything we needed was close and we really loved the space! We would absolutely recommend and stay again!!!
The location was amazing. No issues with parking. Apartment was clean and comfortable.
Place was wonderful. Exactly what our group was looking for. Clean, large, beautiful, perfect spot in the city and the balcony is just amazing. Absolutely no complaints from top to bottom.

Overall, we had a good stay and enjoyed our time here. The host was very responsive, and check-in was easy. The apartment is in the basement, so it has the normal basement smell, but it wasn't a big deal for us. The towels and sheets aren't new, but they were clean and perfectly fine. The floors could've been a little cleaner, but they were dust-free and nothing that affected our stay. The neighborhood felt fine. Like in any big city, I wouldn't recommend walking around late at night. We had our own car, and the private parking was a huge plus. Just keep in mind that the parking spot is under the upper deck, so if it's raining, you'll probably get wet getting to the entrance. We expected more noise since it's the lower level, but it was actually very manageable. The only thing I'd improve is the pillows—they were pretty flat and not very comfortable. Overall, we'd stay here again.

Lovely apartment on a peaceful tree-lined street, very clean, comfortable and safe. Plus its walking distance to all the Andersonville fun stuff. Akay and Katie are kind and welcoming hosts. Highly recommend this place - you wont' regret it!
