Incredible location! We really enjoyed shopping on Southport and having groceries and food easily available.
The house was very clean, had everything we needed, and Austin was very responsive.
I also really appreciate that he made checkout as painless as possible.
Lovely apartment! Very clean and tidy, although the rooms were smaller than anticipated. Overall, great stay!

We stayed at Veronica's place over the 4th of July weekend. What a lovely neighborhood! It's quiet, safe and clean. The apartment is exactly as described. Squeaky clean and very welcoming. We really enjoyed her recommendation for breakfast at the Churro Waffle. That place is amazing! I would most definitely stay at this apartment again when I come to Chicago.
Clean and quiet stay with kind and responsive hosts. I would definitely stay again. Good value and nice neighborhood.5/5
was wonderful stay. super beautiful place
we were only in town for a couple days but it was perfect for what we needed. back off from the street so it was quiet. en easy ride on the pink line to downtown
Great place, great location, excellent and responsive host!
It was a very convenient location, close to many attractions and L stops
Masato's is a great host . I will recommend strongly to others .
Victor was a nice host, the communication was very good!! The room is clean and the instructions were clear
Very clean and nice home, would recommend.
Great experience, clear communication, clean place, and easy to access! Thank you so much!
Great stay, clean, superb communicator
Better than the photos

Let me start by saying how much we appreciate Ilyas, we had flight delays and he let us stay until 2pm and didn’t charge us for late checkout. Comfortable and clean beds, clean bathroom and a living room with dining table! Top notch communication and definitely  coming back here next time we are in Chicago.
Had a great stay with Ruby! Very large and clean place, and she was great at being responsive and flexible. Also close to metro and bus stations!

enjoyed ever minute of our stay! Claudia was super helpful and responsive. The place was very clean and cozy. Bonus points it was 3 minutes from the airport and the food in the area was great. Perfect line that takes you straight downtown which we rode multiple times during our stay. 10/10 experience would definitely return!

My family and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Jared's place. The home was spectacular, very clean, comfortable, and made our trip truly enjoyable. Our kids also had a wonderful time.
One suggestion I would make is to furnish the larger bedroom with the en-suite bathroom as the primary master bedroom by adding a larger queen- or king-size bed for couples. The other bedrooms could then be set up with two smaller beds, which would work well for families or groups. Overall, we had a great experience and would happily stay here again.
We had a great experience at Frank’s apartment! It was clean, spacious, and well-stocked for guests!
Excellent place for a weekend with friends. Tom is a great host! He went out of the way to ensure we had everything.

My wife and I had an amazing stay! High ceilings, spacious bathroom, steam shower, walk in closet, thoughtfully stocked kitchen with clean utensils and a nice nook for my wife to work on her laptop at. This is the perfect location if you’re going to a baseball game. Angela was very communicative and helpful with any questions before, during and after our stay. We will definitely be back to this place!  See you guys soon! -T&J

We are a family of 6 adults. We really enjoyed the place. It was great to have a spacious kitchen to have breakfast and sancks when we were inside in the nicely air conditioned condo (it was heat wave and storms when we were in Chicago). The pool table was fantastic...we played a ton when we were not out in the city. Super conveniet to a 7-11, Jewel and tons of restaurants (go to Frontera's-fantastic). A very convenient location to Magnificient Mile and Riverwalk. If you need parking, there is great parking garage just above the Jewel. It is still a city location so treat it as such and it can be loud with the typical city sounds. It was clean, comfortable, easy to get in and great location for things to do and eat in the area. The owners are very responsive and great at communicating when we had questions. If we get to comeback, we would come stay here again!
Great location, easy and simple instructions, very spacious overall, and jist as described. Would definitely stay here again!
Host was very friendly. Location is great as well

I thank Brittany so much for all her help and communication throughout the whole process this is my first time using AirB&B and if the host and hospitality is as great as this I definitely will book again. My family enjoyed the holiday with a comfortable place to sleep. Thank you Brittany the home is lovely I will highly recommend.

Tamiz was a wonderful host; he was extremely responsive, kind, and welcoming. The apartment is beautiful, looks just like the pictures. Rupa is also great host and very friendly, Remi is (understandably) a little more shy but very friendly as well. The apt is a little less than a 15 minute walk to the blue line and a few blocks from a few different buses. It’s roughly a 15 minute drive to boystown and that surrounding area (& only about a $15 uber which is pretty good!). Highly recommend.
A very comfortable apartment. Spacious areas, a wide range of kitchen utensils, and everything works properly. Very good price.
It was overall a really great stay. It’s hotel so the staff was great and helpful. Food at the restaurant was really great too. Would gladly stay here again as it’s so close to everything.

We stayed at Shaun's place for a wedding weekend in town. Fantastic location - about a 10min walk from the nearest train station, which is a direct line to both the airport and city center. Many restaurants nearby within walking distance. Shaun was a very friendly host, responsive and flexible with our need for a slightly earlier check in. Place is as described. Would recommend!

We had a wonderful stay at this penthouse in Chicago. The views were spectacular. The property was well-equipped, with everything we needed for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
Communication with the host was outstanding from start to finish—responsive, helpful, and professional. The location was also perfect, with easy access to everything we wanted to see and do in the city.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this penthouse to anyone visiting Chicago. We would gladly stay here again!

I couldn’t recommend booking this place enough, it was beautiful, quiet and so cozy, Peter was amazing and helpful! It was a great weekend stay! Will definitely be back! If you’re looking into this place- don’t think twice!
Buen lugar, muy céntrico

Matt and Nicole were wonderful hosts! They were incredibly responsive and provided lots of helpful information about the apartment and great nearby restaurants. The apartment was exactly as pictured—clean, comfortable, and true to the listing photos. Their attention to detail and excellent communication made for a seamless stay. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend their Airbnb to others!
It was a nice experience. No negative feedback
Huge place and lots of street parking, great for groups
Great place to stay! Parking is hard to navigate with it being such a tight space to fit a bigger car but we figured it out & the host was very responsive. Everything else is perfect.

Excelente alojamiento. El departamento es exactamente como se muestra en la publicación. Estaba impecable, muy bien equipado y no nos faltó absolutamente nada. La cocina cuenta con todos los utensilios y electrodomésticos necesarios, y tener lavarropas y secarropas fue un gran plus durante la estadía. El aire acondicionado funcionó perfectamente, algo muy importante porque nos tocó una época de mucho calor. Además, la ubicación es excelente. El barrio es tranquilo y seguro, y está a pocos metros de la estación de la Línea Roja del metro, lo que permite llegar muy fácilmente a los principales lugares turísticos de Chicago. Como única sugerencia de mejora, sería ideal simplificar un poco el acceso al edificio o al departamento, ya que hay que ingresar varios códigos largos cada vez que se entra. Fuera de ese detalle, todo fue excelente. Sin dudas volveríamos a elegir este alojamiento y lo recomendamos totalmente.
Great place to stay to visit Chicago. About 1/2 mile to train station so we walked there daily and took train to the city. Never moved the car from street parking all week.
A very comfortable stay and a clean place.

The apartment was very clean, comfortable , and well maintained.
The only downside was the train noise throughout the night, which could be bothersome for light sleepers like me. Overall, we had a good stay.
You will feel safe and at home with the privacy and security over the building. The home was as described with a clean feeling.

We had tickets to a Cubs game at Wrigley field and the property was perfect for us! An easy 1 block walk to Wrigley. There's plenty to do, see and plenty of restaurants, pubs and bars to choose from. We used Lyft to get around town as parking is not easy or really available at the property. The room we had, had the private bathroom with it.  Both rooms were clean and we had zero complaints. Other people in the apartment were quiet as we're we so all respected each other's space. When I plan to go back to Wrigley, I will definitely stay here again!
We had a great stay at Marco’s. The inside was very clean and had lots of amenities. It is a shared space, but we did not have any issues with this.
I eagerly anticipate my return to this Airbnb when I’m back in Chicago. ❤️
John was very helpful and responsive. Unit was very well stocked and in a great location. Beds were comfy. A/C worked great in Chicago heat wave.

The Airbnb itself was beautiful. It had a very nice layout and was cozy, comfortable, and in a great location. Overall, I really enjoyed the space itself.
Unfortunately, the parking was a major inconvenience. There was no designated parking for guests, and I had to park about a block away and walk to the Airbnb. Finding a spot was difficult because I had to circle the block multiple times before one became available. Considering this is an Airbnb located in an apartment building, I think the host should provide at least one parking space for guests.
The jacuzzi bathtub was a nice feature, but the jets did not work, which was disappointing.
Overall, the Airbnb was nice and I enjoyed my stay, but the parking situation was 100% terrible and was the biggest downside of the experience.

Great stay overall. Comfortable, easy check-in, and a perfect base for exploring the city. We'd happily stay again.
Heads-up for future guests: parking is a rear-alley spot. We were actively coming and going while loading the car, and two of our bikes were stolen within minutes. If you're traveling with bikes or valuables, keep them out of sight until you pull out.
None of this is the hosts fault, just worth knowing about the parking/neighborhood.

Good place to stay if you have a car to get into the main part of Chicago or are looking to just overnight somewhere briefly. Was a bit difficult finding the place only because for some reason my apple maps dropped me a block away so just be mindful of that. But it really is a clean comfortable room to stay in for a very reasonable price.

I’m giving this apartment five stars because the location is amazing and the space is really quirky, unique and fun. Spacious apartment and huge bathroom.
We did have an issue with the shower and almost total lack of water pressure. Tere sent maintenance, but they weren’t able to fix it during our four night stay. There is an alternate shower on the first floor of the building, but that obviously isn’t very convenient. Tere did offer a small discount for our stay. Once the shower is fixed we would definitely stay again.
One other thing to note: the listing says this apartment does not have A/C, but it does have central A/C, just not an individual unit in the room. Thankfully, because we were there during a heat wave, and the room was nicely cooled.

We loved our stay, walkable to several restaurants, and a big shout out to Boulevard Bistro, it was delicious and great service.
Masooma's home was perfect for our large family, we enjoyed the open floor plan and great kitchen, and a great back porch.
Plus having a garage and off street parking was perfect!
Location to downtown and all the sights was perfect!
Very clean and spacious place with lots of beds. Location is amazing - tons of good restaurants nearby, right next to Lincoln Park zoo / North beach as well as light rail stations.

The place was very small. Every single room. No space to really move around in room. The backyard has a gazebo  with fan, hanging lights with fireplace that made up for the small place that I  did enjoy m but got reported for playing music that was not loud at all. AC If booking in the summer time there are only 3 air conditioner thru out the apartment to keep it cool. Honestly feel like central air would be way better. If you plan on cooking defly gone be hot. Far as noise don’t make none. You will be reported. It’s cameras on the front yard and back yard. Only the people in the BNB can be on premises no one else can visit. I ask about parking in garage never got a response until the day of my reservation because i had to ask again. Host did allow me to park back there one night since no one was staying in the above unit. Overall I wouldn’t stay again need more space due to family size, and rules.

We had such a lovely time here! We have stayed at many Airbnbs and this is one of the best decorated yet, with very stylish furnishings, color, and attention to detail. It was very easy to get in, had a well appointed kitchen, and was in a cute neighborhood walking distance from many restaurants and shops. The train didn’t bother us at all and we loved the fact that the station was so close.
Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Great place!
Good spot for a stay of 8 people!
The home was private and quiet. The host was friendly and responsive. We stayed with our service dog and she had access to their yard which was a huge plus!

There are pros and cons to Rameez’s place. It’s super close to the city and has a garage. It’s a large place, so everyone had their own room. It’s decorated nicely with decent furniture.
Rameez replaced the coffee maker right away after we discovered it was broken.
Con is that the house doesn’t have AC “zones” so it’s normal on the main floor, hot upstairs and frigid in the basement. It’s so cold, don’t really expect to spend time down in the basement. I slept in sweats the whole time I was down there.
It’s walkable to a few things, but not much. 4th of July was crazy, fireworks everywhere, which was cool. I’d stay again for location, if being close to the city is a priority.
Great location, apartment & host!
All 5 starts, good place!

Great location, easy to find and get into with instructions provided. I love that everything is walkable and you can find great restaurants/coffee shops near by. It was only 15-20 minutes from downtown. Was a little dirty, nothing crazy. Something that would’ve helped with my larger family is having a dresser with drawers to store clothes into or possibly suit case holders. There wouldn’t have been enough hangers to put clothes in the closet. But I appreciate the books, puzzles and kids toys that were provided. Overall we had a great time, it was everything we needed.
Came into town for 4th of July and James was so accommodating and communicative!! The house was amazing and he made sure any questions asked were taken care of
Very nice apartment with plenty of room for our group of 5 people. The balcony was great with a nice view. Location was great and only a couple of blocks from the red line train which was convenient.
Wonderful stay in Chicago! Was walking distance to bus stops and metros which made getting around really easy. It was very spacious and clean, perfect for our group!

This stay was an amazing find in the safe, walkable, centrally located River North neighborhood of Chicago. We always felt safe and it was not overly noisy. The onsite parking was easy to access and was gated, so we felt that our cars were safe throughout the weekend. The apartment was spotless, and we loved that there were two full bathrooms with showers for our group of 8. It was an extremely spacious apartment and the beds were incredibly comfortable. Our group loved the large kitchen, dining table, and living room for hanging out as a group.  It was easy to Uber to and from as we had different activities throughout our weekend stay, and was within walking distance of a market that had everything you could ever need. Ketan was a friendly, helpful host and was always extremely responsive replying within minutes when we had questions. He was proactive and sent us information in the days leading into our trip to help us with our stay. I would 100% stay here again when visiting Chicago!
Great place to stay! Comfortably fit eight of us for three nights. Host is super responsive and very kind and clear!!!

WOULD NOT RECOMMEND STAYING HERE.

They make you pay another $10 for a parking sticker after promoting Wrigley is walking distance from you. We are already paying a ridiculous amount for a tiny outdated room, they should include the parking ticket to stay and park comfortably!
This place felt out dated and had an old smell to it. There are no TVs, AC wasn’t working when we arrived. (We arrived 4 hours after check in and still wasn’t working)
I also don’t like that Air Bnb is allowing these people to use a full apartment, and have 3 different bookings stay and share restrooms and kitchens.
I walked out to grown men outside my door in the morning when trying to take my son to brush his teeth.
Uncomfortable stay.. do not recommend.
Great location! Felt like everything you could want is close.

We had a great stay! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The parking garage that’s just a little walk away was very convenient as well and the location was perfect for exploring the city since everything was within walking distance.
Overall, a good experience and I’d recommend staying here!

What a perfect location right in little Italy. Lots of things to do nearby or every other area in Chicago is a short uber ride away. The shared house situation was great, everything was clean and all other occupants were respectful. 10/10 would stay here again

Mary was very friendly and helpful our entire trip. The place was extremely clean, and cute and had everything we needed. The walls are a little thin, so you can hear everything outside, or upstairs but it didn’t bother us too much. The location was right by the train station, and it was very easy to get around. Downtown, cubs stadium, anywhere we wanted to go was easy! Thank you!
The place was amazing, Tracy was the best host and we will definitely stay again!!!

Al's place was a great location for my weekend plans! Just down the street from the historic Wrigley Field. Walkable to a nearby store for any last minute items you might have forgotten. The space was perfect with a comfortable bed,hot shower and fridge and microwave for those leftovers. If heading to the area you should definitely consider staying here. Safe travels
As a family with two young kids, there was so much around us to do. Not only was the location great, but the place itself was just as described. We’d definitely stay here again!
Great host!
Great place for a good price.
Great location,  very close to Chicago Lakefront,  South Loop, Downtown and Bronzeville.  Debra was an excellent host and communicated when required.
Great apartment. Clean, comfortable, ideal. Lovely space in a great neighborhood. Excellent communications. Easy check in and out. All ‘round good.
Great hosts & great place to stay!
It was a great experience. Host was very responsive

Great spot for a couple of families with kids. Loved the neighborhood. Thanks for making our trip so memorable. Lots of included amenities in the stay - a fan for white noise, coffee, well-appointed kitchen, nice appliances, etc. and comfy beds.
Mercedes is a very friendly host. I thank her a lot.

My son and I stayed at Joseph's place during the 4th of July. We loved his place as it was exactly as advertised and what we needed. The neighborhood was walkable with lots of places to eat! I loved having coffee each morning at "Dark Matter Cofee". Joseph's place was very clean and had everything we needed. We loved all the firefighting history and memorabilia. You could really tell his place reflected what was important to him. We will definitely stay again!
Great place, close to everything!

Our host, Stacey, was wonderful. He went above and beyond to accommodate us and made sure we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The home was clean, peaceful, and exactly what we were looking for.
His kindness and hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable, and we truly appreciated his thoughtfulness. We can’t wait to stay here again the next time we’re in Chicago. Highly recommend!
My husband and I had a great time.  Within walking distance to everything and my baby boys were able to join us.
Great location

I would gladly stay again with 0 hesitations or reservations. This was a perfect stay!
Older place but it was very clean and in a great location. Brad communicated very well and check-in/check-out was straught forward.

Everything was wonderful and spotless! They had everything I needed. Toiletries in the bathroom, Keurig and pods, iron and ironing board etc. I really appreciated the water that was waiting in my room upon arrival (it was much needed after my travel day took a left turn) Simply put, it was perfect. I will definitely stay here again, thank you all so much!
was a comfortable stay, great neighborhood, and the host was very helpful!
Great communication throughout!

Check-in was very difficult; instructions were outdated, the lockbox was missing, and the keys were just left on the ground. Upon entry, half the apartment had no power. The house manual details were outdated and the host was remote so it took until the evening to get clarity that the unit's electrical system is severely underpowered, only run one window AC unit at a time with minimal other appliances to avoid tripping the breakers again. The apartment itself is small but clean and in an excellent location. However, based on the severe utility issues and critical conversations we had with building management during our stay, we cannot recommend booking this space or working with the host Heather.
Good place to stay

Space was perfect for a few nights while my husband and I explored the Chicago area. Getting into the neighborhood felt a little sketchy, but the street the apartment is on was nice and we felt pretty safe while we were there! Would definitely recommend for anyone wanting to explore Chicago without staying in the city.
Wonderful stay with a communicative and friendly host. Spacious and clean! Beds were also comfortable.
Jorge was very responsive and communicative of anything we felt we needed. Space was clean and comfortable with great location to the Blue Line.

Jake’s place was a great stay! The location was definitely the highlight. We were less than a block from so many restaurants, and public transit was only about a 7-minute walk away. Since we drove in, having a dedicated parking spot was a huge bonus and made everything so much easier.
The unit was spacious and comfortably fit our group of five. It was stocked with plenty of amenities, and it was clear that Jake takes pride in keeping the space exceptionally clean. The walls are on the thinner side, so we could hear our neighbors at times, but it wasn’t disruptive, and there was very little street noise. Overall, we had a wonderful stay and would absolutely recommend Jake’s place to anyone visiting the area!
I wish every AirBnB I stayed at had so much character!

This place was perfect and fully met my expectations. I had everything I needed for a peaceful weekend getaway. The bed was comfortable and I enjoyed the massive TV!  Ray was responsive and made me feel fight at home. I highly recommend this place and I’d book it again in the future.
Great residential location and spacious Airbnb unit! Our hosts were very responsive and proactive in taking care of us and making sure we had our needs met.
Great location in a walkable neighborhood with a lot to do nearby!

Great stay and the hosts were very responsive and friendly. The location was perfect since we were able to take the metro system, buses, and even scooters/bikes directly into downtown because it’s so close to the action! It was also very quiet and the ac was on full blast so it was great after spending the whole day in the summer sun. Overall we enjoyed this location and would recommend it!

Def 10/10 ! The place was beautiful. You can tell they put a lot of thought into the place by the details of it. They were very responsive and sweet. The check in process was a breeze being that they gave very good instructions. I felt at home. I will be back next time I’m in Chicago ❤️

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was beautiful, clean, and had plenty of beds for our group, which made it very comfortable. The neighborhood was quiet, and the neighbors were friendly. One thing to note is that I wouldn’t recommend walking alone at night, but otherwise we felt comfortable during our stay. Our host was very responsive and checked in on us throughout our visit to make sure everything was going well. Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely recommend staying here!

My wife, dog and I stayed here for a few days over the Fourth of July, and it was great. It exceeded our expectations, as we had three floors and the entire house to ourselves in a quiet, peaceful neighborhood near lots of green space. There was ample parking on the street in front of the house. The back yard is enclosed by a fence (although there is a gap near the back gate that a small dog could fit through, but that can be blocked by the trash bin). There is a good Polish restaurant a few blocks away, near a bus stop for the route that takes you straight to Wrigley field. That is about an hour ride and a drive downtown is less than that. We had a great time and hope to stay here again!

As written in other reviews, this is one of the best locations in the city and very walkable to downtown and the lake.  Bustling in the summertime.  Appreciated the very explicit and detailed guides to accessing the home and other guidelines.  The hosts were very responsive to every ask and comment.  Perfect for a family of 4 with separate sleeping quarters for adults and the kids.

Micheal greeted us at the house and gave a tour. It was recently remodeled and absolutely beautiful. The primary bathroom shower was five-star with numerous showerheads, a wand and steam option. Best upgrade ever! The kitchen was extremely nice, too.
Michael was quick to respond. Very pleasant and personable. Gave concise instructions. Most impressive that he looked at the guest list then asked who each of us were by name.
I would recommend this home. If ever I am back in the area, I will definitely see if this home is available.
Vallorie Parks-Turner
Really enjoyed the stay, felt right at home. Easy access to the L train, responsive and friendly hosts, highly recommend!

The place was great and well priced. It had nice amenities and it was very clean. The host and cohost were exceptionally helpful and very responsive. Various restaurants and shopping are within walking distance, along with Wrigley field, which was the reason for our trip in the first place. I have stayed at multiple places in Chicago, but this one may have been the best in regard to its price, quality, and proximity to Wrigleyville. Note: for people that aren’t able to walk a couple of miles, this location might work better with an Uber, but we easily walked to and from Wrigley on both days of our stay.

It’s Chicago! In a big city if you expect peace and quiet you’re not living! We came to Chicago for the 4th of July to catch several comedy shows and a Cubs baseball game. This location is great because it’s across the street from a major train station and walking distance from the Bean and the Pier. It’s centrally located what else can you ask for.

Fantastic place to stay! Great local restaurants and easy bus routes to train stations or wherever you need to be. 15 minute walk to the big bus/train terminal station with all the express buses or express trains to downtown or take the 290 bus east to the station which is a less than 5 minute ride. The unit has AC and heaters and everything is very clean. The host is also very fast to respond and help. 10 out of 10 stay and would book again
Good location!

Rich’s home was a spacious and beautifully decorated place to call home for a few days. While there are plenty of great options for restaurants within easy walking distance, it was also great to have a spotless, modern kitchen that was well equipped for cooking. The home is in a quiet, residential neighborhood—a truly lovely setting for wandering and admiring the architecture. Rich was great w/communication. It would be a pleasure to stay here again on a future visit!
This is a lovely apartment! It’s a short walk to the Damen station and the 606. We really enjoyed our stay here.

Location was very convenient! 20 mins from both O’Hare and downtown. Home was very cozy and comfortable. The only minor complaint was the temperature in the home. It was very hot in the city the weekend my friends and I stayed and it was hard to regulate the temperature with window AC units. Overall, a great stay!

We had a great stay! The house was very spacious, clean, and comfortable. It had everything we needed for a family trip. One thing to note is that you may want to bring your own personal care items, such as shampoo, conditioner, and body wash.
The neighborhood wasn't the best, and we did notice some homeless individuals nearby. However, we never felt unsafe during our stay. It was also quiet at night—no excessive noise or smell of marijuana.
The location was very convenient, with downtown less than a 10-minute Uber ride away.
As a coffee lover, I was a little disappointed that although there was a Nespresso machine, only three pods were provided, and the only other option was instant coffee. It would be a nice touch if the host could restock the pods and offer a small variety for future guests.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it.

I like the stay. It's a nice and peaceful apartment. I liked the ambience inside. I wish the AC is more powerful. Also, it was smelling unpleasant at the entry door of the building. It was difficult to find the lock box K at first to get the building key and later I didn't know how to open the door with the given PIN. I wish I knew how to open such doors; I didn't want to blame the host for this. Once I was able to get hold of keys and find a way inside, It's all peace. I loved the apartment. I love how close it is to the downtown. There's a one-way street beside this place where you can find free street parking.

O apartamento é ótimo, com uma localização maravilhosa, perto de mercados e restaurantes. A comunico com a Shay foi muito eficiente e ela se mostrou atenciosa o tempo todo. Gostamos muito de tudo e Chicago foi simplesmente incrível. Apenas um dia que houve um problema com o elevador e tivemos que subir 15 andares hahaha... mas no final, faz bem pro coração (Lol). Super indicamos.
I had a great stay at David's place
loved the stay!
Great place in a perfect location. easy to access other great parts of Chicago on the blue line just up the road. Getting to the accommodation from the airport was also super easy on the train.
Host was Awesome!
Todo estuvo acorde a lo publicado, Cedric es un gran anfitrión. Estuvo atento y respondió rápido. El lugar es genial para estar unos días en Chicago.

I was hesitant about renting a room in someone's home. We will be using Cordaro's home again in the future. We never even saw Cordaro and only saw another house mate once. Very quite. Nice neighborhood. It felt very safe.
Very nice and clean apartment in  Lake View.  Spacious 3 bedroom. Easy walk to Southport for shopping and restaurants.

Nico was extremely unwilling to accommodate us when we asked him for a small discount considering we were only staying for 3 days and paying for 4 ,we checked in at 10 pm and he had not sent over checkin instructions,  the place had broken blinds and disgusting poop stains on couch from i think animals,  and stains all over the carper , i killed many spiders and the outside around the property was to be nice filthy ,trash and weeds and bugs everywhere,  the bathroom sink was clogged , for the first 2 days and they wouldnt discount a future stay not even $50.00 because we weren't able to use the sink , be aware ... if you stay bere , he did send someone to unclogg the sink after 2 days though ... other than that the beds were comfy and the unit was very nice and comfortable.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The apartment was clean and exactly as described in the listing. The host was easy to communicate and responded  fast to our questions , and made check-in seamless. I would recommend to everyone and I would happily stay here again.

The 747 Lofts were phenomenal. It is located seconds away from a Blue Line train station which puts you into the Loop in a matter of minutes. The room was very clean and the host was very responsive with any questions we had. I would definitely stay here again!

Kitty was a super responsive host and made sure the place was well furnished. The location is fantastic, walkable to restaurant row and plenty of great spots to eat. We even got to attend Taste of Chicago, just a few minutes away on foot, and the Ashland CTA station is an easy walk too.
We did have some WiFi trouble during the first week, mostly because the property was transitioning to a new owner and hadn't been configured properly yet. Kitty was helpful throughout the process, and once it was sorted out we had no further issues. A great stay overall, and I'd happily recommend it.
Great studio in Wicker Park. Lots to do in the neighborhood!!
The host was very responsive, answered all of my questions promptly, and the space was really clean.

Carlos was an excellent host! As a first-time Airbnb guest, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Communication was great from start to finish, and he even checked in on us during the storm over the Fourth of July to make sure we were doing okay, which I really appreciated.
The space was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was also in a convenient location with everything we needed close by. Overall, I had a fantastic stay and would definitely recommend Carlos’s place to anyone looking for a great Airbnb experience.
Really great place to stay!
I had a great stay!

The home is renovated, spacious, and looked just like the photos. We were enjoying our stay until heavy rain caused the basement to flood. The basement living area and two bedrooms became unusable due to standing water, wet carpet, and a damp odor. We had to move everyone upstairs, significantly reducing the space we rented.
The host was responsive and came to inspect the issue. I don’t fault them for the weather, but based on what we experienced, this didn’t seem like a new issue. Guests should be informed if there’s a known risk of basement flooding during heavy rain. We had property in those rooms that could have been damaged. A 10% refund didn’t feel proportional for a stay that cost over $3,000.
Our other concern was the neighborhood. On the weekend there were hours of loud yelling and arguing outside, crazy enough that we called the police ( they never showed). Families or anyone traveling with children should carefully consider the location before booking.
Eugene was a good host. Very responsive.

Exactly how described. Very clean, very new. Gerry was there when we checked in. Had everything we needed but made sure to tell us to let him know if we needed anything else. Felt very at home and comfortable. Would stay again when in the Chicago area!
Really nice place to stay.
Thanks Katty for hosting us! great place to stay!

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this home. We traveled with five adults and four kids under 4, and the space worked really well for our group. It was comfortable, beautiful, and very livable, which made a big difference when traveling with young children.
The location is excellent—easy to walk to restaurants, shops, and neighborhood spots in Wicker Park, while also being only about a 15–20 minute drive to downtown.
The home itself is absolutely gorgeous, very clean, and thoughtfully maintained. We had a few minor issues come up during our stay, but the owners were always responsive, reasonable, and easy to work with, and we were able to reach good resolutions throughout.
Overall, a wonderful stay in a beautiful home, and we would happily stay here again.

Nice place. Looked even better than the photos, which is always a good thing. View of the city was fantastic. We did the same for the pickup of bags, and they was again a delay (but smaller). Also, a little concerned leaving our bags in front of their desk.
Host was great, place was comfy!

We were in town for a wedding in the west loop.  The apartment worked well for 2 couples. Location was perfect. Lots of amenities - pool, hot tub, steam room were all very clean. 2nd bedroom much smaller but worked for us. The people who work here are very friendly and helpful. Shout out to Parker and Ken. The high rise is 75% renters and the building is very pet friendly.
Great spot walkable to tons of restaurants and bars, 50 feet from the L train which made it super easy to get around all of Chicago.

The house is in Pilsen which is a few miles from Downtown and offers a more real Chicago feel than a brand hotel.
We helped a neighbour move in on the first evening and then popped an authentic Korean noodle bowl.
Celebrating 4th July in the Chicago was fabulous.

I really enjoyed my stay at the Bohemian Lodge. The room was comfortable and spacious and it was great having a private bathroom. The kitchen has everything you need to put together a quick meal and there are some nice common areas to relax in. The location was great. You are within a relatively short walk of the el on 18th street, Pilsen's fantastic Mexican restaurants and vibrant murals, and several bus routes into the city.
Super cozy and a great place to unwind after a day of travel!

Our family of 7 adults were comfortable in the home. We were mostly gone during the day but we enjoyed sitting outside in the evenings. We also enjoyed playing pool and playing the video games. We all got great sleep in the beds.
The house is around 20-30 minutes from the city, but we're from Atlanta so we're used to traveling at least 20 minutes to get places. As with many neighborhoods in Chicago, you park on the street.
Nice stay

Keith has a lovely home with plenty of space for families to gather together.  Beds were comfortable and having 3 bathrooms was a major plus for our family.  Plus the back had a small balcony.  It was close to the interstate do it was easy to get around.  The only downside was the neighborhood itself was somewhat rundown.  I’d recommend Keith’s place.  For all it has to offer, it is well worth the money spent

We loved this home. Jason was very responsive and he even accommodated us when we requested an early check-in when he didn’t have to do so. The unit we stayed in was comfortable, clean and even had a great vinyl collection that we thoroughly enjoyed. Will definitely be staying here again the next time I visit my hometown of Chicago!

Amazing place to stay, with perfect access to public transportation. you'll have to figure out what parking works best for you since it's restricted at times.
place was good but the floorboards were a little creaky but other than that a perfect place!!
We loved staying at Gina's place! One of our favorite AirBnBs - we especially loved sitting out on the back deck.

This location was very walkable. Great local coffee shop right down the street. Free street parking. Close to Logan square and literally 20-30 minutes from pretty much anywhere in Chicago. The place was also very clean!
Host was really awesome and very quick in responding. Place is really great and near to downtown Chicago.

Hi Tippi,
Thank you so much for your wonderful hospitality and for hosting me in your home. I had a fantastic stay, and my time in Chicago was even more enjoyable because of your kindness.
Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I truly appreciated your support and would gladly stay here again. I highly recommend your place to anyone visiting Chicago!
Lovely stay! Good price & very convenient find for the 4th of July weekend!
Very central location with lots of food options close by.

Nicole was very responsive from the beginning and the location — while a bit noisy due to the nearby train - was conveniently located. It is a nice property that just needs a little TLC and I recommend reconsidering access through the rear entry. Thank you.
Nicely remodeled and updated building and well appointed apartment. Excellent communications.
Good experience, exactly what I paid for.

Honestly it was a great place that was perfect for our needs. We were heading to Wrigley for two games and it was within either the Metro or walking either way. Lots of restaurants etc within walking distance or a short Metro ride. Walked to a cute diner for breakfast and it was really good!!(Tribu)
The building was older but the apartment seems well kept!
Brad was flexible, super attentive and great at communicating all of the instructions to get in etc. Would stay here again.

We had flight delays and Kit was very understanding and accommodating.  The location was perfect for our family of five to take in a Cubs game.  The AirBnB was very clean and beautiful.  Highly recommend if you are headed to Chicago.

It was a great place and stay .
We had our family gathering and we were 4 different families which fit easily
Everything was as advertised, would stay here again!
Great stay!! Clean and comfy. Perfect for our group which included a 5-yr-old, a toddler and a baby- there’s a great little playground a block away! Would definitely stay here again!!
Loved our time at Natasha’s apartment.   So clean, quiet, comfortable and roomy with amazing view of the lake and walkable to so many Chicago attractions. Will definitely come back!

BEST HOST IVE EVER HAD !! Very nice and clean place. He was very helpful with early check in and check out options. He even has nice enough to set up decorations for my birthday !! Very sweet host and I would definitely recommend and book again !

Excellent location with great access to 606 trail, fantastic for runners.  Eclectic decor, lots of fun to look around.  Responsive host who allowed us an easy and early check in.  Easy street parking - space behind was a bit tight for a compact SUV but Ken provides passes and we never had to park more than a block away.

The space is as pictured however the parking was not! I expected gated parking but had to park on the street sometimes a couple blocks away. Perfect place for no more than 2 occupants.
* Bed was really low, wasn't a problem for me but could be for some.
Both the Airbnb and neighborhood were great! Places to eat and grab snacks were within walking distance. It was a short car ride to the city. Blanca was super responsive and accommodating as well!
Great location and price!
Daniel did a great job welcoming my girlfriend and I for our 4th of July vacation. He always was responsive and always friendly and keeps the place clean and peaceful!

I had a wonderful stay. The place was exactly as described; clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The check-in process was smooth, and the home had everything I needed for a relaxing stay. The location was convenient, with easy access to nearby restaurants, shops, and attractions. Iris was an excellent host, very responsive, friendly, and made sure everything went smoothly from start to finish. I truly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area. I would be happy to stay here again in the future!

We had a great stay! The location was excellent and made it easy to get around and explore the area. The place was very clean, well maintained, and exactly as described. Check-in was simple, and everything we needed was provided. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable place in a convenient location.
We had a great time staying here, it is close to the train line and the apartment was spacious and clean. Highly recommend!
We enjoyed our stay at Patrice's place. The apartment was larger than expected and everything we needed.
Really good place
Convenient location to U Chicago.
Great spot. Thoughtfully stocked too. Comfortable stay. Fully recommend

Beautiful area with quaint shops. The apartment had us thinking about 75-100 years ago and how families might have lived in the neighborhood. We felt the stay and experience was positive. The park just a few blocks away was a nice place for the kids to run and play.
Great July 4th weekend.
Great place, would stay again!

Florencio was a wonderful host! He was kind, communicative, and made us feel right at home. The house was beautiful, spotless, and exactly as described. We had an issue unrelated to the Airbnb, and he still went out of his way to help us, which we truly appreciated. He even treated us to some delicious cakes! We had an amazing stay and would definitely come back. Thank you, Florencio, for your outstanding hospitality and for making our trip so special!
Host is very clear about check-in/check-out instructions, very communicative, and the price is good! Great deal.
Very close proximity to Wrigley. Beautiful. Clean home with lots of great character! The hosts were very accommodating.

Emily’s house was a perfect spot for our family trip. She was perfectly hospitable. Our stay was like being at a friend’s house who thought of everything we might need on a visit to Chicago. So delightful!

Great location, walkable to many locations.
Milan was very responsive and a great host. Parking across the street was amazing to have, although street parking is free in the evenings if you can grab one. Private patio was a great addition to the space!
Nancy was awesome and the place was great!
Owners were very nice and even gave us suggestions about where to visit. The place was clean and nice

Overall great stay. Any issues the host was responsive and took action to make sure everything worked properly and that we had a great stay while on vacation. Will definitely recommend and if ever need to stay here again.

Ryan’s place was amazing for 4 of us and one small kid…the private parking was the best part, can’t best the convenience of a dedicated in-house parking…no wasting time looking for “hard to find” street parking in Chicago….the hosts were super responsive…loved the place…would definitely come back…..

This place was a great place to rest and reset for our time out in Chicago visiting family. Very walkable to some great eats and parks if you want to stay in the neighborhood. Close to public transportation or easy for Ubers to navigate to if you want to head into the city.
Musa was a great host. Very proactive with instructions for check in and check out and if we had questions. It was a great stay.
We stayed here to watch the Cubs vs Cardinals play on the 4th of July! It was perfect 👌
Nice for a weekend getaway.

We had a wonderful and comfortable stay. Victoria was very welcoming, friendly, and made us feel at home from the moment we arrived. She provided clear instructions for check-in and throughout our stay, which made everything easy and hassle-free. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it to others. Thank you, Victoria!

Overall, we had a good stay. The apartment was clean, the bedrooms were spacious, and the beds were incredibly comfortable. The floor-to-ceiling windows offered an amazing panoramic view and made watching the fireworks unforgettable.
There were a few inconveniences. The kitchen had only the bare essentials, so if you plan to cook, bring your own pantry staples. The building is older, and during heavy rain the large windows leaked. It didn't cause any major issues, but it made us a little uneasy with young children. Parking was also difficult, as only one space was included and street parking was limited. We were supposed to have access to the community amenities, but the key fob wasn't there. Communication was through an automated system, so getting responses could take a while.
Overall, it was a pleasant stay with no major problems—just a few things that could be improved. We'd recommend it more for adults than families with young children.

I can't say enough about this beautiful spot! Our hosts thought of everything and it made us feel right at home. The kitchen was well equipped for cooking, there were extra blankets and things for young children! The lovely neighborhood was also a short walk from many cool spots to eat and shop in Logan Square.  I would stay here again in a minute! This peaceful spot made my stay in Chicago a vacation to remember.

Michael and Joanna were so kind, super responsive and considerate.  The amenities were just as described with a few extra kind gestures to make us feel at home.  They were very thoughtful and anticipated our needs based on the reason for our trip.  The beds were extremely comfortable and having waffle robes for us to use was a pleasant surprise. Definitely coming back at some point because we loved Chicago and we loved Michael and Joanna's place.
Great little place to stay in the Chicago area and not too far from downtown. The place very clean and met our needs for the two nights that we were there. Thanks for a fun time!
The Airbnb was fantastic and David communicated very well! I’d highly recommend this Airbnb to others.

We had a great stay at this Air BnB for the 4th of July weekend. The apartment was clean and had great sleeping arrangements. I also think it was a fair price for the size and quality of the apartment.
Great, convenient location!
We enjoyed our stay in Humboldt Park! The neighborhood is peaceful and there is an Aldi within walking distance. The place was spacious enough for all 6 of us and the host, Michael, was responsive.
place was nice and very chill and low-key! I enjoyed my stay
The host was very friendly and kind, the room was beautiful and cozy—this is the best guesthouse I've ever stayed at! My body and mind have both been healed.
Very modern place, walking distance to BP. Only con is parking, street parking is only available until 12am & closest parking garage is far walking distance wise!

Clean bathroom, clear expectations from host (make sure to read the entire rulebook- they were very friendly but notably strict when it comes to check-in timing!). It’s about a mile walk from the red line, and it’s ~40 min to the loop from there. The place feels like a shared college apartment, so I felt right at home :-)

My family of four had a great time staying at Cris's place. The host is kind, responsive and the place was almost exactly as expected. The place is impeccably maintained, clean, clutter-free and sanitary. The beds were comfortable and everything was as expected. The place is in the heart of the Pilsen neighborhood in Chicago, and has a couple of convenient CTA bus stops and train stations nearby to take you wherever you need to go. We kept our car parked on the street the entire time and used public transport during our stay. Cris provides free day parking passes for your stay so you can park right on the street.
These are not complaints: know that one of the bedrooms is on the 2nd floor - up a flight of stairs. Also, we arrived in peak summer (outside temps in high 80s, low 90s) so the place took a few hours (8-12 hours) for the A/C to cool down to a comfortable temp. The A/C is also quite noisy for the occupant of the single bed - it's very close to their ceiling.

Great location, walkable to some amazing restaurants. Easy connectivity to downtown 30 -35 mins through transit
. Finding parking spot was a challenge, parking on the street in front of the house needs a permit, but the street next is free.

Great location, very spacious, good value. However, the upstairs unit is also a rental and the floors and walls are extremely thin and sound really carries. I would consider a different rental if you are sensitive to noise from neighboring units. The cleanliness could be improved- the floors had visible dirt and the dining room table was left sticky with food residue. The unit also was unfortunately not ready at the promised check-in time and had no toilet paper for over 2.5 hours after check in (Josh was responsive to this issue and provided a partial refund for the unit not being ready)
The place was great for a family weekend on the 4th of july

Short version - Amazing hosts, quite place, very easy to commute. Couldn’t ask for a better experience .
Long version -
Sujata and Brian were awesome hosts! I spent a few days in Chicago checking out the city and their place was the perfect spot to come back to after a long day.
They were quick to respond any time I had a question, check-in and check-out were both easy, and everything was clean and ready to go when I got there. They even helped me with parking while I was there!
Would 100% book with them again next time I’m in town. Thanks so much to both of you!

I would highly recommend the apartment. Todd was the perfect host.
The place is perfectly located, you can get easily to interesting places throughout the city, there are bus lines in 6 directions nearby, plus the Damen Blue Line Station to get to and from the airport, the same as to and from the city, which is very convenient. The apartment had all the amenities we needed and, which was sometimes very important, an air condition, which worked pretty well. The neighborhood is very relaxing and quiet, although bars, restaurants and music venues were 5-7 minutes away. For runners important, the 606 was in the same short walking distance.
I would always rent the place again.
Thank you Todd
Uwe, Olaf and Rainer

The place was nice, but felt too corporate. The place had everything you needed, but it felt like not enough. Don’t know really how to explain it otherwise. If you’re in Chicago and just need a serviceable place to lay your head that is walking distance to everything, this is it. If you are looking for a cozy place, probably not your bet. Also, the parking was not connected and was around the long block. The elevator to the parking only went to the second floor.

We loved our stay, what a cute, unique spot in a very lovely part of town! Quaint and comfortable and easy to access some good food and transportation into the city. Johanna was very responsive and helpful! Thanks again!
Great place, and he was very flexible!
Enjoyed my stay. Great location 15 mins walk from Chinatown and ~15 drive to downtown. Tony was helpful and responsible. Will stay here again!

My friends and I stayed here for my bachelorette trip and this home was the perfect place to be. It was an easy walk to Fulton Market and a quick drive to the places we went to. Adam was very responsive even though he wasn’t in the country and we really appreciated that. Highly recommend staying here!

Great location across from Grant Park, easy access to public transit.  Nice having a washer dryer in unit too- hot humid days and went through clothes quicker than expected.  Small grocer downstairs and Trader Joe’s nearby.

We fit 12 adults very comfortably in this space. The outside table provided a great space for us to enjoy the weather. The home was extremely clean and everything we could possibly need was available. We enjoyed playing games on the poker table downstairs as well as the spacious table in the kitchen area. It was an easy walk to Wrigleyville and close to a fun beach. The two car garage was a huge plus as well. Brandon was very quick to respond to my messages and very accommodating. We would all recommend this place with a 5-star rating!
The place was wonderful! J was friendly and sent proactive communication.

Beautiful place that looks just like the pictures. Very close to downtown. Minutes from everywhere we wanted to be like malls and the pier. Wonderful views and the rooftop was a special touch. We enjoyed sitting up there to watch the neighborhood fireworks !

Perfect Stay for Cubs Fans!
Our stay here was absolutely perfect for catching a few games at Wrigley Field. The location is incredibly convenient, making the entire trip stress-free and seamless.
The proximity to the train made getting around Chicago an absolute breeze. Plus, the surrounding neighborhood is packed with energy and a fantastic variety of places to eat, so we never went hungry. Having a grocery store within easy walking distance was the icing on the cake, allowing us to easily stock up on snacks and essentials.
If you are looking for a comfortable, clean, and perfectly located base for a Cubs weekend or just exploring the city, this is the place to book.
We will definitely be back!
房间很小，只适合睡觉。卫生间公用，经常需要等。也许在城区这个价钱只能住到这样的房子。

Cute apartment! Within walking distance to Wrigley Field and Southport. We had some crazy unseasonably warm temps. The team was kind enough to bring us fans to help move the cool air around the apartment. Great communication.

This Airbnb was located very conveniently next to the airport and also close to downtown! I did feel safe in this neighborhood compared to many others we drove by so it is a good spot to stay and explore. Inside the Airbnb was clean and bathroom was super nice and spacious. The parking spot was super tight for a SUV so I would recommend having a very small compact car. There was never any street parking available when we were there. We could definitely hear everything and everyone from upstairs but it didn’t bother us at all since we were gone most of the day time. Not sure if this was listed but it is a basement unit and it got pretty warm even though the AC was running for us. I would overall recommend this Airbnb if you are looking for a convenient location close to everything and don’t mind the limitations with parking.
Great place to stay, would definitely recommend!
It was a wonderful stay. Most of the landmarks were at walkable distance.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as described—clean, fresh, comfortable, and very welcoming. The location was perfect and made it easy to explore the city. We also really appreciated the thoughtful welcome card that Michael left for our family—it was a very kind gesture. Michael was a great host, and communication was smooth throughout our stay. We would definitely recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again!

We had a great time staying at Kim’s place when we were visiting friends who live nearby.  The house was very clean and looked just like the pictures (though it felt bigger in real life).  Great communication and instructions!
Great place! Shonte is was really very responsive and helpful!

Great place! Very clean and friendly neighborhood. I went for a walk around and I noticed there was a beautiful park. The place fulfills my expectations. Thanks you guys for having me in a spectacular place .
The place was we expected.  Would definitely recommend staying there.
Great location. Fantastic space. Comfortable bed, hot shower, and well-furnished.
Bedrooms are too small.

My partner and I stayed here for the long July fourth weekend and it was just perfect for us!! Such a cute neighborhood. The studio was very clean, and Geo was extremely helpful and responsive!! Would definitely stay here again :)
Perfect location, perfect amenities, perfect communication. We love the host’s style, everything we needed was there, and the furnishings are very comfortable.
Overall was a good stay. Sometimes it can get hot in the room.

Karen's place was even better than it looked in the listing. Sometimes you see airbnbs and you get there and you're disappointed. This was not one of those times. Karen had many extra amenities which no one ever includes but really made it feel like you were staying in someone's home and not just a rental. If I'm ever in the area again, I will not think twice about staying anywhere else.
Great place great neighborhood

Love it i enjoyed the experience!! Great  place and area

Great plan for a weekend trip. Especially if you are in for a cubs game. Two train stations nearby and plenty of rental bikes. My room was clean and has a lock. The common area was also clean with respect doom mates. Highly recommended.
Thanks for a great stay! Appreciate the responsiveness! Clean!

This is a great location, very comfortable, well laid out, and nicely furnished. It is vey well stocked with everything that you could need. We happened to hit an extreme heatwave, so the top floor bedrooms were quite warm until the heat broke. The entire house is very comfortably air conditioned, but the HVAC for the top floor was not adequate for extreme heat. I would absolutely rent again. It was a very unusual situation.

Great location. The host was very responsive which we appreciated, and they gave us the info we needed or resolved our issues very quickly! Parking is outdoors. Overall had a good stay but had a few issues that added up.
We didn’t have the pack and play we requested on arrival, but they did get it to us quickly. We enjoyed the lofted ceilings, but the second bedroom ceiling is open to the main area/kitchen so is not ideal for kids. No drain stoppers in the tubs or kitchen, no kitchen towels, only commercial paper towels. Several little issues but overall a good location!
The pictures are very accurate and John was very responsivel during booking and check in. it was perfect for our weekend visit.
I experienced no issues at all, it was a great trip. Laura did an amazing job hosting us.
Incredible location especially if you are headed to Wrigley. Modern home. Super comfortable beds. Very responsive and helpful hosts.

We had a very pleasant stay over the 4th of July weekend. The location was perfect and street parking was free. Scott was welcoming, friendly, and responsive. He even carried a bag up the narrow stairs for us! The  space was open, bright, and clean. The bed was super comfy. Highly recommend this charming spot.
Very nice place to stay. Clean and tidy with fair price. Next time I visit Chicago I’ll choose it once again.
This place was great & spacious for our large group. The host & co-hosts were extremely friendly and responsive!
Love this place everything was absolutely great

This was a great stay! The host was super responsive to my many questions. We were really wanting a place that had a lot of versatility for walking and we found that at this spot!
Great spot, great host.
Great location! Amazing space! Would love to stay again!

Overall, this was a pleasant stay. Spent most of the trip out and about but was a fine place to return to for sleep and shower. Only setbacks were the location not being close to a ton of local food options, saw some ants in the bathroom, and fobs are required to get into the building to access the elevator but those were not available until AFTER checking in. We had to wait for someone to open the building door to access elevator/apartment to reach said fobs and one fob did not work. Good place for the price. Bed and couch were comfy. AC worked perfectly during the hot July stay. 4/5 stars!

The pictured description for this place did not compare to the actual cozy and comfortable experience. Every convenient amenitie including toilets, a neat and clean living space and clean linen was truly appreciated. The place was worth every single cent. It was a home away from home comfort level. The stay was spacious, beautifully decorated and extremely peaceful. Carla was available when needed and her hospitality was top tier. My family would highly recommend this space and would absolutely stay again if available. Thank you sincerely Carla for making our trip home to Chicago a memorable and serene time well spent.
This was a great place to stay. The place was even nicer than the pictures. We would definitely go back.
Great place to stay
Stayed for 3 weeks with our small family, perfect for a long stay. Hosts are incredibly responsive and helpful.
Brandon made our stay very easy with clear communication and straightforward check in instructions.  Cute apartment that was perfect for our weekend stay.
The stay was great. The house is situated at a very convenient location and Joshua is a great host. definitely recommend people
Good stay!

Was fairly clean and decent stay if u dont mind highway noise like me, its pretty allright main issue was the AC in my room it would make the lights flicker when on and wasnt that hot during the heat wave and its not properly installed which made me a bit wary with safety overall the other guests were quiet rarely ever saw them I only stayed for 3 days but i would not recommend for a long period however a few days was fine as I was barely in the apartment.
Clean and functional.  We felt very comfortable in the home & neighborhood. The studio arrangement with privacy curtains worked well for the short time we were there (family of 4) .
Excelente cumplió mis expectativas 🫡
Amazing location, great hosts, comfortable stay. Would definitely stay here again!
Great place in a great part of town.  Receptive to a couple issues with the place.  Easiest check out of an AIRBB I’ve ever had.  Very clean, recently renovated it appeared.
Great host, wonderful stay!

The view can't be beat and the apartment is well appointed. Pay attention to photos rather than listing for the beds--the two couches are convertible however I wouldn't recommend them for adults--they were great for our kids though. The bedrooms have king beds rather than queen. A great walkable or public transit-friendly location. Super friendly desk staff. Very responsive hosts.
The air conditioning absolutely did not work. The temp was above 80 almost the entire time we were there. Though I communicated this with the hosts, and they were responsive, it was recommended to use the provided fans.
And just as an FYI, though I didn't find it to be a problem, the L curves right outside the apartment so you do hear the frequent squeaks of that.
Amazing location! Very nice property.

We enjoyed our stay and Kimberly was very responsive with any concerns.
Very nice place.
In town visiting my sister. The apartment was convenient, in a great neighborhood, had everything we needed. We’d definitely stay here again.

Daniel's place was great. Spacious, cozy, and a super convenient location. Close to the Blue Line, close to cafes (Milli is a great place to work in the morning), and plenty of bars/restaurants nearby. I would definitely stay here again.
Great stay… this is my second time booking this bnb for my trips to Chicago! I highly recommend booking this bnb for any future trips!!!
Overall the stay was good, the house was very clean and well equipped, the only thing that bothered us a little bit was the cats and their food and the party box at the entrance of our door.

Danny's place is nicely decorated and well appointed. The Juliet balcony is pretty cool. Solid place. We used the back stair outdoor entrance because the main building entrance steps were covered in dog hair.
Close to red line, easy street parking, safe area, and cute studio for a weekend trip
Everything was perfect thank you

I really enjoyed this place! It is very unique and spacious.

Angela was very responsive and communication was clear. Check-in process was easy. Plenty of street parking. Nice and quiet neighborhood. Close to a park and convenient to north Chicago sites. Same discrepancies as previous stays: kitchen not well stocked, broken stove knob, dishwasher detergent door doesn't open, lacking kitchen cleaning supplies, and leaking kitchen faucet.
