Es un apartamento precioso, la decoración, los libros, el menaje de cocina es muy completo. El balcón trasero es lindo para tomarse un cafecito, tomar el sol o leer algún libro.
Definitivamente lo recomiendo!

This was an amazing stay! Dede was super responsive, kind, and respectful! The whole house was beautiful and the Airbnb was clean, cute, and even tailored to our stay. There was any amenities we forgot and lots of additional little extras that made this place feel like home! Overall great experience, and would definitely recommend!!

This place was ideally located. We were 11 people, but didn't even need a car because the subway was across the street and many businesses were close by. The place has many bathrooms, and the kitchens were well stocked. If we ever visit Chicago again, we would definitely stay here again.

Our family had a fantastic stay!  It was a beautiful sanctuary in a big city.   The location was an easy walk to many of the key attractions.  Inside, the finishings were beautiful and our family had plenty of room to gather in the living spaces, but also retreat to individual spaces to take a breather after the day's excursions.  The deck was a fantastic spot to spend the evening together.   It is also one of the most well-stocked places we've stayed in.  All the details were taken care of, and we didn't have to run to the store for anything.  I would highly recommend.
Very nice place to stay with really nice beds. Easy walk to the red line and shops. Host was great and communicative.

We had a wonderful stay! Ray was an excellent host, the home was clean, comfortable, and everything was just as expected. Great communication and a great experience overall. We’d gladly stay again. Thank you, Ray!
It looked exactly like the pictures and was such a fun place to stay. We didn’t have any issues during our stay.
Great stay, will stay again
Dawn's place was clean and convenient, and she was very communicative and accommodating. All around great stay!

Kyriako’s apartment is located at a quiet residential area in Pilsen, close to I-90 ramps. The place is clean and it looks exactly like the listing. The amenities make you feel like home. The first floor unit is easily accessible.
The only issue is the parking as described by other tenants. It is difficult to find a parking spot close to the unit after 6:00pm. With a short walk (near Dvorak Park), there are more spots to find.
Overall, it is an excellent choice if you need to access I-90. We will book it next time when visiting Chicago.

I absolutely loved my stay here! From the moment I arrived, everything exceeded my expectations. The space was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything I needed to feel comfortable and at home. The location was perfect—close to everything I wanted to do while still being peaceful and relaxing.
The host was incredibly responsive, welcoming, and made the entire experience seamless from check-in to check-out. You can tell they truly care about their guests and pay attention to the little details that make a stay memorable.
I would 100% stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you for such an amazing experience—I can’t wait to come back!
everything is an experience

Gabriella was an amazing host! She kindly allowed us to check in early and also gave us the privilege of a late check-out, which made our stay even more enjoyable. She responded to all of our inquiries very quickly and was always helpful. The place was spacious, clean, and incredibly peaceful—perfect for a relaxing getaway. We would definitely love to stay here again!

My wife and I loved the location and the open floor plan. The bed was really comfortable and the AC was clutch during a hot Chicago week. We lived like locals during our stay, with great recommendations from Cindy (Dove’s was a fave). We would definitely stay again.

Hands down one of the best air bnb’s I’ve ever stayed in. Felt right at home, very spacious, smells amazing and Zully is a wonderful host. Plenty of good local food options in the area as well to give you the real Chicago experience!
Thank you!!
great repeat stay. we love coming here.
Great location, close to to lake with plenty  of parking.

Awesome place to stay. I was in town with my in laws and my parents. Perfect place for family. The property has private parking, surrounded by parks and a lot of cool restaurants. Heather was excellent in communication. Will stay again if I am in town.
Christopher was such a great host and very responsive! His place is located in Pilsen and was very walkable to nearby coffee shops, restaurants, and thrift stores.
Very cute place and just a short walk to the beach or Red Line
Love the place, bathroom was nice clean & spotless; nice rooftop area where you can chill at. Everything about this was nice; breakfast inna morning was A1 I recommend.
My son and I had a great time here. Felt safe, everything was clean and the owner was very responsive.
excellent and rapid communication from hosts, close to multiple buslines, and walking distance to several  places to eat!

This apartment is perfect for anyone wanting to visit Chicago but not directly downtown. It's super close to the metro and made getting around really easy. Kayode is also an excellent host, he always responds quickly and was able to give good recommendations!

We loved every moment of our stay at Richard and Margo’s beautiful apartment.
Tucked away in a one of Chicago’s picturesque neighborhoods, it is perfectly located for walking to a game at Wrigley Field, exploring downtown Chicago, or enjoying the multitude of restaurants, pubs, and bars in the area. Our family thoroughly enjoyed our “home away from home”
and hope to visit again next time we want to watch the Cubs play.

We had a very good stay. They are really responsive and fixed any issues we faced promptly. The only hiccup was pack and play not being in good condition on day one. which was replaced on the very next day.
It was a nice stay here, as it close enough to the downtown Chicago & in a pretty peaceful neighborhood. Everything was really clean, and the host was really responsive which I appreciated. (:

Geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Angenehme Atmosphäre. Klimatisiert. Downtown Chicago mit Public Transport in ca. 1,5h erreichbar. Umgebung ist sehr ruhig, allerdings während des Tages Fluglärm durch Nähe zu Airport. Trotzdem sehr zum empfehlen
This place was great! Conveniently located to transportation. Easy parking. Clean. Easy access. Perfect for our family for a weekend!
Lots of interesting books and games. Walkable spots made for a nice stay. Would definitely stay there again.
Muy bonita la casa, solo el estacionamiento estaba un poco complicado encontrar

The airbnb itself was perfectly described. There were a few things that made us feel a little uncomfortable in the area though. At one point the locals nearby were yelling profanity randomly throughout the day and night, then a few gathered around the corner and popped off fireworks during the 4th of July which was expected. The part that made us feel uncomfortable and a tad bit unsafe was them yelling and sort of made it seem like the start of a small riot.

I rented Nicholas & Jesse’s place for a month while waiting for my own rental to be ready. I’d been to Andersonville before, but this was my first time staying there for a while. The location was great- quiet & residential, but Clark St was just a 5–10 minute walk away with lots of restaurants, shops, & grocery stores. Parking on the street was always easy, too.
The place was super clean & looked just like the photos. The decor was fun and a little quirky, but still really comfortable. They had everything I needed for a longer stay: plenty of sheets & towels, all the kitchen stuff, a washer and dryer, a shared backyard, and 2 really comfy chairs on the front porch. I loved sitting out there and people-watching. I was there in July, and their Pride decorations were up, which always started fun conversations.
Nicholas met me when I checked in to show me around, & he was quick to answer the few questions I had. Overall, I had a great time and would totally recommend their place.

Highly recommend! This location was absolutely perfect for everything we wanted to do and the place itself was gorgeous and great for a big group to hang out and have fun! Will definitely come back in the future!

I really like this place and it’s definitely felt like home, me and husband were visiting Chicago for 4th of July and found this gem place and it’s close to all popular places and most of all the house felt like home, kept really well and spacious, we would definitely recommend this place if you are visiting Chicago, thanks you for having us.
Stayed here for a month and had a great time. Easy to get into town but the local area is also great. Would absolutely stay here again
Sauber, einigermaßen zentral gelegen, ruhig
Great stay

This is a lovely apartment in Chicago and great for two couples. It was very nicely decorated and had most of the basics needed. If we were cooking, there may not have been enough equipment - but in Chicago - who wants to cook with so much incredible food?!
The positives were:
1. Walking distance to Grant Park and museum campus
2. Clean and comfortable
3. Two king beds and two bathrooms - ideal for couples traveling together.
The few things that prevented a five-star review:
1. Master bed is very squeaky. Barely moving makes a lot of noise.
2. Master bath is old and grimy looking. Seems like the only part of the apartment that has not been updated.
3. External noise - the building's AC units are right outside the window of the master bedroom and VERY noisy at night. I know this cannot be controlled by the owner, but it did impact the overall comfort of our stay.
That being said - with some good earplugs for a quiet night's sleep, this is a very nice Chicago apartment.
Anastasia was very communicative and helpful with responses! The place itself was wonderfully kept, and both trains and buses to the Loop are easily accessible. We had a great stay!

Great place to have friends all together for a weekend in Chicago. The neighborhood was quiet and safe but in a great location to west loop where everything was. Great coffeeshop on the same street for everything we needed in the morning.

We had a great stay! The place was very comfortable, clean, and spacious. It had everything we needed, and the washer and dryer were a huge plus. The kitchen was well equipped, the beds were comfortable, and the whole place felt welcoming. Everything worked perfectly, and the host made the stay easy and enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable place to stay.

Seth was awesome! I surprised my family with this Airbnb and now it’s the only place my husband wants to stay when we visit Chicago! It rained most of our trip but we enjoyed to rooftop whenever we could. We enjoyed the Sonos system as well. If I could take the master bath with me, I would!

Overall, we had a good stay and enjoyed our visit. The place was clean, the location was convenient, and check-in was easy. The only thing was that we thought the space felt smaller than we expected but it was totally fine, and there was a small noticeable odor when we arrived. We just bought a candle to help with the smell during our stay though. Other than that, everything went smoothly, and we appreciated our time there.  We would stay again. Thank you!

We stayed at Nicholas’s property for four days and three nights with a group of four women, and we had a wonderful experience. The bedrooms were very comfortable, and having bathrooms in three of the four bedrooms made sharing the space so much easier.
Nicholas was friendly, responsive, and a great host throughout our stay. One thing to note is that there is no elevator, so you’ll need to carry your luggage upstairs. Guests who require elevator access may want to keep that in mind.
The location was excellent; we loved having a Dunkin’ directly across the street. We also felt very safe, as the building requires a key fob to enter before accessing the property.
If we’re ever back in Chicago, we would absolutely stay here again. Thank you, Nicholas, for your hospitality and for making four Southern girls feel so welcome in Chicago!
The location was perfect for urban exploring and sightseeing. Hotel staff we’re awesome.
We enjoyed our stay! Place was as described and was perfect for a weekend in Chicago! We weren’t in the apartment much but was just what we needed!

A phenomenal stay for my family and I while we visited Chicago! Very walkable, near little Italy and Illinois Medical District which has lots of restaurants near by. We enjoyed the Italian bakery down the street. Everything was clean inside and exactly as described. Barry was also a responsive host, eager to hear feedback and help when needed. Definitely will be back!

Highly recommend Silvia’s place! It’s clean, comfortable, and packed with handy amenities like a fridge, hair dryer, and iron. The location is perfect if you want easy options for taking the bus or subway!
Great stay stay in. Loved the location it was centrical and quite.

A good budget-friendly option if you're looking to save money. The place is older than expected, and I think the overall cleanliness could be improved. That said, if your main priority is an affordable place to stay for a short visit, it may still be a reasonable choice.
Overall Sharon’s place was as described and very nice. Loved being so close to the new Obama library, lakeshore drive and the convenient parking. Sharon and her team were incredibly responsive.

Christina’s place was exactly as described…and exactly what we wanted! We were there during a heat wave and while we still enjoyed the city, we appreciated having such a lovely spot to just hang out in! The neighborhood is lively and easy to get downtown. Christina is a perfect host and we’d love to stay here again!
La anfitriona muy nice!

This was a great place for my family to stay at.  The home was inviting, comfortable and clean.  The neighborhood had some really nice restaurants that we ate at while there. We would definitely stay here again.

I’ve stayed at many Airbnb’s, but Yakini truly makes you feel special. Her house is decorated beautifully, and is very clean. You will not regret staying here. I was completely blown away with my time spent in Chicago and Yakini was a big reason for it. Beautiful human, beautiful house, beautiful city. It’s money worth spent.
Very responsive to any and ever question I had, nothing to complain about with the host

This was one of the best airbnbs we have stayed at.  The host went above and beyond in communicating with us and being conscientious about the space.  We hope to stay here again. 😄

This place was a very convenient spot , out of the city’s chaos yet pretty close to it. Parking and commute was an add on. Amenities were as mentioned and ample. Would definitely recommend this place.
Perfect spot for my visit and Victor was a very helpful host!

Our stay was wonderful! The location was perfect for the baseball games. There was plenty to do within walking distance! The stay was peaceful, clean and comfortable! I would highly recommend the stay!

Kyle and his Wife went above and beyond when it came to hosting.  Kyle literally told me everything about the neighborhood when I got there. The location was excellent—quiet, safe, and very walkable, making it easy to get around and explore the area. The home was comfortable for six of us staying there and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would happily stay again.
The house was well appointed, as expected based on photos and in a good location, just a short walk from shops and restaurants.

The place was great. Everything was very clean and felt like home. The host is very responsive and helpful. The neighbourhood is very nice with good restaurants and close to transportation.  We warmly recommend their place and look forward to visit again.
Perfect location if you're going to a game at Wrigley.
Ewa was very nice and responsive! The home was quite clean and she even provided some snacks. Great location and exactly what we were looking for the weekend.

This is a hidden gem. The host was phenomenal, she really went above and beyond. We arrived during a heat wave but it stayed cool, which we strongly appreciated. All was good, would recommend.
From communication, location and how beautiful the place is.  Everything ran smoothly.  Definitely recommend it

Had a really nice stay! Really liked the house too, not too far from most places in Chicago.
Justin is an amazing host! Great little place close to transit and great spots in the city!

Brad was very responsible, welcoming, and professional. The location of the unit was ideal being in Hyde Park. Check in was seamless and the unit was very clean and looked just like the post. I will be reaching out to Brad on my next Chicago visit.

Easy to find and access minus the slow elevator but the sign inside was a nice touch. Very clean inside, comfortable accommodations. Host is responsive and friendly. Convenient location to lots of walkable entertainment and food. Would recommend!
I would recommend this place! Iris was very quick at responding and very helpful! Beautiful location as well!

Claude is a very pleasant host. The apartment was everything that I needed. Perfect amount of space, lots of natural lighting, clean, well decorated and the showers water pressure was simply amazing. Great stay. Will rebook if back in Chicago. Hands down  close to everything Chicago has to offer

Excellent place to stay. Close to the train. Easy to get in and out of the neighborhood.  The place was cozy,tidy and comfortable. I would recommend for anyone visiting the Chicago area.

Great place for a weekend trip, no issues.
Great place for two of us to enjoy wrigley and surrounding area for the 4th of July weekend.  Very nice and easy stay.
This was my first Airbnb experience and we really enjoyed our stay here, Ryan was very nice and accommodating. Highly recommend the stay here :)
Easy booking and check in. Clean, comfortable space. Short walk to Wrigley, perfect for my trip.
Amazing stay in Fulton Market, would 100% recommend. Staying here when I return to Chicago.

The apartment was perfect for us two. Our friends picked us up from the apartament and it was great to have a small living room to visit with them before heading out. Beds were comfortable, mattresses more on the firm side. Couple of suggestions: the steps to the place are a bit slippery after a rain and offer beach chairs or beach toys/stuff for guests & families. Thank you!

My family enjoyed our time at this apartment. We felt very comfortable the whole time. The apartment had everything we needed. If you’re looking for a quiet, safe place just outside the city, I would certainly recommend this place. We would definitely stay here again on a return trip to Chicago.
Great place, we had everything needed to accommodate our family with different age groups. House was very clean and just like in the pictures.

We had a wonderful stay! The home was clean, comfortable, more than enough room and exactly as described and pictured. The location was safe, convenient, and made it very easy to get around. There are a few small maintenance issues that could be addressed. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area!
I ask if a friend could change clothes after going to the beach. And they responded a big NO. Not even in a hotel are that rude.
Helen is such a wonderful host! Place is great and nearby to downtown. She was very accommodating! Will definitely stay there again ❤️

This was perfect place for us. We were within walking distance to beach, food, Obama center and beautiful parks. If we didn’t want to walk or wanted go further, the train and bus station is directly across street. Extremely convenient.
The condo was very cute. I appreciate the coffee pods and nice refrigerator to store some of our food so we didn’t have to eat out every meal.
We would definitely stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay! The unit, furniture, beds, bedding, were top notch! Kitchen and bathroom were fabulous and fresh! The location was so safe feeling and so close to many places to eat and hang out. We went into the city everyday and it was a snap with either the train or Uber. Parking was on the street but was no problem getting a spot.  Thanks for hosting us for our son’s graduation trip! We will be back!

This place was very clean and we loved the location in Chinatown Chicago.  Walkable to lots of shops and restaurants and close to the "L" for getting around Chicago.  Angela was a great host and very responsive to all our needs!  Would highly recommend!

We enjoyed our stay! We did wish that the a/c was a bit stronger. Listing was exactly what was advertised. Host was responsive and kind. There was ample street parking. Host recommendations for food and activities were great!
Great location! Not far from downtown. Local grocery store down the street! Beds were so comfortable! I will stay here again . Thanks for everything.
This place is close to downtown Chicago and there are pace bus services close by. Place is clean but the kitchen is small. But for the price it is good.

We had a fantastic stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Everything we needed was provided, and the space was even better than we expected. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the entire process easy from check-in to check-out. The location was great, and we wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again. Highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a relaxing, hassle-free stay!

If you’re traveling into the city to sightsee or do not have your own vehicle present, the apartment is solid. Close to everything we wanted to see and safe location. BUT if you have a vehicle with you, be extremely aware of parking. Parking is not included (told to park on street), but there are permanent “no parking” signs around building. There’s a parking lot for building tenants (you’re not a tenant so not for you), and you absolutely will be towed without any notification or signage for which towing company was contracted or that it’s restricted. Unit is also in a high rise apartment (one of several buildings) so be aware of any possible people/noise if you’re sensitive (host provided ear plugs). Also know the AC/temp isn’t controlled by the unit (felt like no AC during July), so plan accordingly. Solid place to stay if you’re touring/not spending too much time in the unit. Looks as pictured, but some supporting details for unit weren’t the clearest. Host is responsive though.

Everything was great. I used to live in Chicago and it was in this neighborhood, Lincoln Park. It’s the best area. The apartment was in perfect condition. Everything inside is completely new even though that the building is old. Abel was really responsive at all time and let us stay check at our convenience. I definitely would repeat again! Thanks Abel

Great stay right in the shadow of the White Sox stadium! The neighborhood felt safe, and Chinatown is conveniently close by. It’s about a 15-minute walk to the nearest subway train. The space itself is very minimalist—it doesn’t have that lived-in "homey" feel of some other Airbnbs, but that didn't bother me at all since it has all the essentials you need. Even without ceiling fans, the A/C worked well and kept the place comfortable. Check-in and check-out were a breeze, and the hosts were incredibly responsive.

Came here with some friends and loved our stay. Christian’s place is in a great neighborhood, the bedrooms are very nice and a cool common area on the ground floor. He was responsive the whole time. Would definitely stay again.
Prime location with easy access to all the train lines. Appreciated the pool and close proximity to the lake given the heat.

Nicole is a fantastic host! She is incredibly attentive and genuinely wants to make sure you have an enjoyable and comfortable stay.

Overall, I highly recommend staying here and would gladly book with Nicole again.

This place is amazing!! You feel right at home. Everything you need is right there for you. The space is very open and spacious. Every room is clean and the decor is well put together. The location is very close to the Obama Center which put the cherry on the top! I will definitely be back!

Perfect location for large family from out of town to attend a wedding. Minutes from downtown.

This was a sweet, comfy spot in Bridgeport. Hosts were very responsive. Great stay. Wed come back.

Jay’s place was exactly as described! The house was super easy to find and close to the CTA line which made getting to and from ORD easy. The place was spotless and the kitchen was so well stocked with pans, utensils, and even snacks. Jay was very helpful and responsive throughout the trip. If I ever visit Chicago again, I would love to stay here again!

The place was so nice! I'm from Chicago and was visiting family for the 4th. It was truly a midway point for all the things we had planned from seeing the Obama Center and going downtown to being able to get out to the south suburbs easily. Whitfield was able to assist with issues that came up due to the excessive rain. We would definitely book again.
Great place to stay. Place was spotless and everything needed to clean or use was easy to find. Would recommend the Airbnb again.

Everything on the listing was accurate, other than the AC, which is controlled by the unit above, so you depend on the temperature they set.
Host was very accommodating with early check-in and late check-out times, which was really nice.
Overall it was a great stay! The place was impeccable upon arrival, the location was great, and the environment was super comfortable. We would recommend and we would stay again!
Nice

Solo travelers: this is your sign to book! My second time back in Chicago and perfect distance from Wrigley/downtown to make it feel like you’re a true local that loves to explore the city. Private place to lay your head, peaceful with no loud disturbances. Also close enough to the trains/buses that wherever you wanted to be was a quick jump away. But most importantly, Felice is a true joy of a host, very accommodating and courteous but not overbearing, a quintessential example of how an AirBnB host should act.
Bonus points for the place being so close to the water (a couple of blocks) I LOVED swimming in Lake Michigan in the mornings to find tranquility and refresh myself
This will definitely be my go to place when I visit Chicago! Can’t wait to go back.
Comfortable, cozy, clean, centrally located and quiet. Would definitely stay again!

Perfect place to stay with a bigger group and need a parking space. Not close to the area we wanted (Wrigleyville) but we knew that going in. We waited too long to book closer. However, quick uber pick ups so it worked great for us. Hosts were great and very responsive.

We had a very comfortable stay in Chicago. The place is conveniently located, with most popular attractions and the lake just about a 30-minute drive away. It offers excellent value for the price and is well-equipped with all the amenities you might need, whether you're staying for a few days or a few weeks. Tuan was also incredibly responsive, easy to communicate with, and very accommodating throughout our stay. Highly recommend!

This was a perfect place for our quick weekend trip
Easy to get on the red line and be downtown. Tons of stuff to walk to including the lake which we did several times, food places, ice cream, grocery really whatever you need. We love comic books and found a fun comic book store really close. Parking spot was great to have. Everything was clear and easy from check in to check out. This is a basement unit so you do hear people above but did not bother us at all!! Thanks for a great stay - we would stay here again!
Nice place to stay. It was quite and cozy. Very spacious. The train was not as bad as I thought. I enjoyed my stay!  Thanks again Eric!!
Cute, clean apartment - well located, good amenities. We appreciated the coffee and tea options! Parking instructions were a little confusing, but we figured it out. Would stay again!

I was traveling for the 4th of July holiday and I had a great time! This was a spacious unit that I could see a group of people (maybe 3-4) staying in. It's not too far from the train station either (<10 min) and there's a bus stop right up the street as well that can take you to Hyde Park. Overall, it's a great location.

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was very clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for the weekend. Our host was responsive and answered any questions we had quickly. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others visiting Chicago.

Great place! Would stay here again. Walking distance to everything including the beach, with a cute ice cream shop right next store. The place had all the little things needed to make a stay comfortable. The hosts were very nice and responsive.
Had an amazing stay this 4th of July weekend

What a wonderful place for a family of five to see the city of Chicago and be within walking distance of Wrigley. The location was perfect and close to Southport on the L. The host was responsive and quick when questions came up. We would definitely stay there again!
I had no complaints at all, looks just like the pictures felt completely comfortable and the bed was very comfortable I slept great. There are steps keep that in mind it is on the third floor
Amazing space! Well furnished. Great charm and comfort. First class experience!
Beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood!
Will be booking again

This place was perfect! Very walkable nice residential area. Horner’s park is nearby and was 10/10 for a morning run. There was even a farmers market on Saturday morning. Also very close to brown line so taking public transportation to downtown was easy. The apartment is simple and spacious, and I’d stay again.
Great location

I recommend Md's place for any solo traveler visiting Chicago for a short stay and with limited budget for accomodation. The place is as described. The bedroom is very big, which is cool. The kitchen is very small, not sure it is the best option for guests who are into cooking. Md is very reactive on the app to answer questions and make sure the guest is fine upon arrival, which was appreciated. If you visit during summer, make sure to bring ear plugs. The AC is old school, it works well but does a lot of noise. The neighborhood is nice, I truly recommend the cocktail bar called La Pharmacie just down the building. Few minutes walk to the beach and to the Red Line, which is very convenient to reach Downtown.

The host is great at communicating which is always a plus. I did experience Chicago during a time of bad weather unfortunately and that led to a little flooding inside but the host responded immediately & even came to clean the place up within minutes. I was also reimbursed a bit so that was appreciated. 8/10 stay overall I’d recommend for solo travelers or couples.

Great stay for us!!  This is the third AirBnB we have stayed at in this area which is where our daughters live. It was super close to their apartment and very walkable to great restaurants and bars.  Very clean unit and the perfect size for the two of us.  Also easy to get to expressway to ORD, West Loop, museums, etc.  Will definitely stay again.

Noelle and Rob’s place was beautiful, peaceful, and a much bigger house than we were expecting for Chicago! We would love to visit again! Felt safe and loved walking to local bars and coffee shops, and was a 15-20min uber ride from anything else we wanted to do. Loved it!
The Airbnb was clean and safe. It was as described and provides easy access to the city and transportation.  I would book the location again.
Close to the CTA transit line and in a fairly quiet neighbourhood. Worked well for a last minute stay.

Bella’s place is great for this area. It’s clean and comfortable and she is flexible and clear on instructions for check in and check out. There aren’t really hotels in this area so it is nice to have the option. As long as you expect it’s an apartment you’re staying in and not a hotel, the value can’t be beat.
Great place and location. The beds are so comfortable!

What a wonderful clean place in an excellent neighborhood! It is very walkable to both excellent restaurants and great shopping on Southport Avenue. Multiple grocery chains nearby if you need supplies. Fully supplied kitchen with cookware,plates, utensils etc., bathrooms stocked with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap. The hosts work hard to ensure guest comfort and convenience. If you're a Cubs fan, you're under a 15 minutes walk to the friendly confines; we did that a lot! We chose this place for its proximity to those amenities and it really delivered. The space is well appointed and the beds super comfortable. Our hosts were very communicative and gave us great recommendations when asked. The in unit laundry was a huge plus. We like that parking is included but do note, your Suburban will not fit (our car fit fine, but it's something you should know). We would definitely stay there again. Thanks to Andrew and Kailey for offering this gem.
The stay was great and had no problems at all! I definitely would recommend staying here!
Afsha's place was super clean and well accommodated! We loved the location (it was super close to a friend we were visiting, yay!). Afsha was very communicative and a great host. Thanks you Afsha!

This was our third visit to The Garden and we love this B&B! The hosts are wonderful, the location is perfect,  and the apartment is lovely. The location is walkable and peaceful with lots of food and entertainment nearby. The place itself is cozy and welcoming and the hosts are fabulous!
Nice place for a weekend get away.  The host was awesome. Felt like I was at home

The place was clean and the host gave clear instructions about everything that needed to be done. We were a party of 6 people and everything was set up well for all of us. Overall, the house was clean and everything was good.

My stay was absolutely fabulous. I immediately felt at home in the apartment. It was very cozy and not just a white box like so many other listings.  The kitchen & bathroom were very modern and very well stocked. Both the bed and sofa bed were very comfy with high-threadcount sheets and comforter. I slept great!  The apt stayed very cool during the heat wave while I was there. The hosts were extremely friendly and genuinely wished us a wonderful stay. Overall, I'd rate my stay an A+. I can't wait to stay here again on my next trip to Chicago. :)
Great as always
Great location in the middle of Lincoln Park. Walk to everything.
Everything went smoothly and the communication was amazing!
Great patio, location, and clean.
Lovely place to stay with  a small group.
Our group had an amazing time at this property. It was centrally located and very spacious. We can’t wait to book again next time we are visiting Chicago.
Very close to Wrigley

It was really convinient and unqiue staying with Lou! We had all the information we needed and a great sense of comfort. Very friendly with great attention to detail with instructions, along with great local spots. Would love to stay again the next time I'm in the area!
Great place to stay and visit
We had a great time visiting!

My stay was exceptional! Truly a 10/10 experience. Owen's home was beautiful, and they were an outstanding host with excellent communication throughout my stay. The check-in and check-out instructions were clear and easy to follow, making the process seamless. I highly recommend staying here and would gladly book again in the future.

Alonzo's apartment is spacious ,  very cosy, with an artistic touch. It is very close to the Chicago University campus and to the newly open Obama Presidential Museum . Even though I was initially a bit worried about the safety situation in the Woodlawn area, we felt safe, walked around and never encountered any issues. Last but not least,  Alonso had been super responsive and helpful whenever we needed something or when there was an unexpected issue. All in all, we had a great stay and would definitely consider coming again.

Outstanding experience! If this is your first time visiting Chicago, this location is a real treat. The photos simply don’t do justice to the incredible views from the balcony and bedroom.
One recommendation: be sure to take advantage of the rooftop on the 24th floor. The views and overall atmosphere are absolutely amazing.
One final tip: factor the $69 parking fee into your budget. While it’s an added expense, the convenience is well worth it. Highly recommended!
Nice Place!!!  The public building entrance needs to be cleaned… but the actual unit itself is nice..
Great host

Great place that’s close to Chinatown! We had a fun long weekend trip in Chicago and Weihong’s place provided a great location with easy access to restaurants and transit. The internet is a bit spotty but our mobile service worked great this wasn’t a huge issue for us. Good host with very clear instructions, would definitely stay again for a short trip!

This was an amazing property! The location, the cleanliness, and the fun outdoorsy decor made this place truly special. It was very thoughtfully put together allowing a very relaxing and comfortable stay! All of the extras (snacks in the fridge, coffee, filtered water, etc.)  made this property stand out! This is a quiet neighborhood, but the soothing noise machine was an added touch that even drowned out a noisy thunderstorm. We would definitely stay here again!

We had a very enjoyable stay overall. The property was exceptionally clean, felt very safe, and the location is outstanding. It is within easy walking distance of many of Chicago's major attractions, restaurants, and public transportation, making it a great base for exploring the city.
There are a couple of things future guests should know. Because the property is close to the train tracks and the Fulton Market area, there can be noticeable train noise and late night street activity, especially on weekends. Also, the listing should more clearly mention that the unit is on the second floor with no elevator. We were traveling with an 87 year old family member, and carrying luggage and climbing the stairs was challenging.
Overall, we had a great experience and would recommend this property, particularly for guests looking for a clean, well located, and convenient place to stay in Chicago.
Great place to stay near the city. It was clean and the host was responsive. We had a great stay. We would recommend.
Good location the thick of it.

This was a great home base for our trip visiting friends in Chicago! Super walkable and near Wrigley Field. It was the perfect size for 3 people and we felt right at home. Would definitely stay there again!
Excellent all around.

I was hoping I would be able to book this place for a birthday trip. The pictures sold me on the place from the living room to the kitchen but the weekend I spent there had some really bad storms sweep through Chicago. I saw this on another review and didn’t think it would rain during the 4th of July but during the down pour the ceiling started leaking and there were multiple puddles on the stairs. That was a huge inconvenience but the host were responsive. It got cleaned up but it was a little unsafe IMO. They sent someone there when we were out but the floors remained slippery & one of my guest ended up falling on the stairs and sustaining some bruises. I also didn’t like that the garage was the game/workout room & as soon as you opened the door to the house there was a bedroom! It made those guest who slept there a little tough b/c if we had to leave we would be walking through their personal space. Just wished we had better weather and other kinks worked out for me to rate this a 5
This is a nice house, it had the Cubs and bulls merch. We loved our stay and Dukes was very responsive and helpful.

We had a wonderful stay at your place! It was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, with everything we needed. You were so friendly, responsive, and made the entire check-in and check-out process smooth and easy. The location was very convenient - I think it's right in the heart of Chicago, making it easy to get to all the places we wanted to visit. We really enjoyed our time here. We would definitely stay here again with other friends and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free place to stay. Thank you for your great hospitality!

Had a wonderful stay at Abacus’s place in Chicago. The house was clean, comfortable, and it’s located in a great part of the City. Abacus was very helpful and responsive during the stay. I’ll definitely be coming back!
Great location and space!

When you book with Kasa you don't actually book the apartment you see here. Rather, one of several apartments on the 16th floor that Kasa owns. What I wish I knew? Not all of those apartments are appointed equally. Ours varied so much from the photos, we thought we were in the wrong place. The comfortable blue chair in the photos? We had a white, plastic, folding chair. Our view? It was a parking lot and construction. I don't have enough characters to list all the ways it fell short.
When I messaged Kasa that the quality was not comparable to what is promised in the photos---we were told that "furnishings may vary slightly because our Kasa decor is one-of-a-kind!" We were given $50 back as an apology.
The pros? It was very clean. The location was great. Kasa replied to each message. It was "okay," hence the 3 stars. My family and I still had a great time in Chicago for the 4th of July weekend. But at $300+ a night, plus the misleading photos----this feels like a bait-and-switch.
The host gave us all the information we needed for a smooth check-in and stay. Everything was clean and lovely!
Nice place in a nice area. Would definitely stay again.

Valerie’s place was perfect and so cozy for my family of six. We truly enjoyed our stay—it felt just like home. Valerie was incredibly communicative, welcoming, and made the entire experience smooth from start to finish. We’d definitely stay here again!

T A I M S is constantly improving their guests experience and cares about improving the stay of their guest. This is my second stay with them and it went even better then the first and I had no problems at any point.
Wonderful location! Very helpful and responsive host! Rules were clear and posted well. Perfect for our family getaway

Our family was visiting Chicago for the 1st time. our daughter had just moved there 8 months prior. The available parking was an added bonus in addition to being 2 blocks away from our daughter's apartment. Jennifer was a responsive host. The place was perfect, the community safe, accessible, and walkable. Jennifer's listing did not disappoint.
Location was perfect for our 4th of July weekend stay.

This place is as pictured and described. Such fun decor in the bedrooms. The space was clean and comfortable. The neighborhood is quiet, and it is easily walkable (and safe) to Southport corridor, the brown and red line trains, and Wrigley field. The garage helps save on cost and added convenience of not trying to find parking in the area, although fitting 2 medium sized SUVs was a challenge. But we did it!
It’s a great spot for adults and teens as my kids loved having their own tv area with access to the stand up video game machine. Kitchen was fully equipped for us to cook a meal. We had room to play games and eat together. Such an awesome space.
As a former resident of the neighborhood, I understand the cost, noise factor, and living spaces. You will hear trains going through as well as the neighbors going up and down the stairs, which did not keep us up and I’m a light sleeper. Not an issue at all for us, but something to keep in mind.
I would recommend Brandon’s place!

Place was super clean. Great amenities- provided lots of towels, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, dish soap, cleaning oil and seasonings. The best thing was they had cool waters and Gatorade in the fridge which was perfect after arriving from travel. Seems like something small, but these things make places remarkable. The rooms/beds were spacious and very comfortable. They also had blankets which is always a plus. Overall a great stay!

Great location with a great host! We just recently relocated from Chicago (not far from Kelsey's place) and loved being able to stay here while back for a whirlwind week of work, concert, and wedding. The space was big enough for two of us to WFH comfortably. Air conditioning units got us through super hot temperatures better than expected. Very easy street parking and just all-around great stay. Would definitely book again!
The apartment was in a fun location next to a lot of great spots. Sharon was incredibly responsive and helpful and was willing to offer guidance whenever we needed it.

El lugar está cerca de casi todo caminando, lo único que comentaría es que le falta un buró à la segunda habitación y a ambas les faltan persinas en los cuartos porque ya estaba rotas, entraba mucho la luz. De hecho un black out no estaría mal para descansar de forma apropiada.
Alfredo was a great host who was very responsive to any messages we had. A very quiet but fun neighborhood.

We had an awesome time at Jake's townhouse.  Location is so convenient.  Walgreen is a step outside, bus stop and train station is very close.  The property was squeaky clean and very thoughtful amenities such as portable fun/air conditioning unit, chair to put shoes on, etc.  Jake communicated very timely manner.  I recommend Jake's place.
Great spot with good security and easy check in. Plenty of towels, hair dryer and ironing board.

We had a great stay at this Uptown apartment. Nearby are great restaurants and coffee. Super close to the red line and bus routes. For the unit itself, everything was as described and very clean. Other than the occasional coming and going we did not find the building to be noisy or disruptive. We would definitely stay here again.

This listing came up as a "Rare Find" and I can absolutely see why! We were soooo fortunate and grateful to find this gem.
Beautifully updated with modern style and amenities, we instantly felt right at home.
The hosts, Marco and Sarah are very accommodating and have thought of everything and anything to give us an A++ experience (including children's toys and games, which we didn't use cause we weren't traveling with young children, but if we were, there were plenty of options).
The neighborhood is very quiet and safe, we went on multiple morning walks to explore the area. There is a vibrant shopping center 4 minutes (by car) and 15 minutes (walking) away. And many restaurants and bar options in any direction, which are also walking distance.
As much as I would like to tell others too not stay here (out if selfishness) but that's just a joke. Honestly, you will absolutely love your stay here and we'll just have hope this place is available for our next visit to Chicago.
Loved the location , def will be coming back and booking!
We enjoyed our stay! Gave it 4 stars bc not all of the arcade games worked and the hot tub didn’t get very hot, other than those minor things…great spot! Thx Ray.
Enjoyed our stay
I just want to thank Nnamdi and his team for an excellent stay. The next time I am in town, I would definitely stay here again.

Brian was an excellent host and was always quick to respond whenever I had a question. We had a group of 11 people, and the home had more than enough space to accommodate everyone comfortably. The pull-out ottoman bed in the basement provided additional sleeping space, and the basement was a great area for our kids and cousins to relax and spend time together.
Overall, the home met all of our needs and made for a very enjoyable stay. Parking was also easy. Brian provided a parking pass, and there was plenty of additional street parking available on Roosevelt and at the ends of the block for the other vehicles in our group.
Minutes away from downtown.
I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to larger groups visiting Chicago.

It was all we needed at what we thought was a reasonable price- Had exactly what we needed. We felt as if no money was wasted on things we did not need at all. Bed, shower, toilet, refrigerator for your leftovers and there’s a decent amount of spots near us where if we wanted to walk we could! China town is about a 40 minute walk… coffee shops nearby were solid. Wood was really cool, accommodating is the best word to describe him. We had parking in front at all times–even on the 4th of July weekend. Neighbors and neighborhood is pleasant. Overall great dude, great place great price!
Check out Big Bird restaurant nearby, it's great! Good location and awesome friendly host. Would definitely stay again. Thanks!
Home was clean and spacious. Had everything you could need and more. would definitely stay again
Probably wouldn’t stay here ever again. The host was fairly nice though.

I cannot recommend this stay enough—it’s been my favorite Airbnb experience so far. Eduardo and Lois are fantastic hosts who made me feel so welcome. They gave me great tips for exploring the city, and their home is beautiful and cozy
Very enjoyable stay, the area looked bit strange on the street view but once there everything was great. Loved the place.

If you’re planning to go to Chicago (especially if you’re seeing a Cubs game) you need to stay here! It’s right next to the Red line — so if you take the train in, easy ride in (or anywhere else in the city) and you’re literally by an entrance into the stadium.
Also, kudos for the security. Even with the hustle and bustle outside, we never felt nervous or uncomfortable with the crowd of people. We felt like we were removed from it all.
This is the perfect place to stay for anyone going to a cubs game with friends/a group!
100% would stay here again!
Also, there are stairs that take you up to the apartment. Just noting for accessibility or anyone with mobility issues!
The stay was great!
This was a top-notch place

Overall, the apartment was pretty nice to stay at. We only had an issue during the first day of our stay with the AC unit not working properly, but after a couple of hours, it worked normally for our whole stay

A wonderful space in the best location. The space was exactly as described and pictured — only with more light in the space!
It was the perfect space for my friend and I for the weekend. The space was very comfortable, clean, and cute! Walking distance to Logan Square, which is an amazing neighborhood.
The welcome wine bottle, note, and local recommendations were such a nice touch.
I would certainly stay here again!

The apartment is exactly as listed and the location is great. I especially love the kitchen. It was very clean and easy to navigate. The AC unit was a little loud but we visited during 100 degree weather, so we understand and were grateful for the cool air! There is a nice mini fan already in the bedroom, which we greatly appreciated. Very clean and comfortable! Thank you, Keith!
The place was clean, great location, safe, easy access, comfortable, and perfect for what we were looking for.
Felt like home when we stepped in! Has a homy feel with great amenities!
Gorgeous home! Super responsive host.

Highly recommend Natasha's place. My family of four stayed for 4th of July weekend. The apartment matched the description and was clean and cozy. The beds and linens were comfortable, and plenty of towels were provided. Loved having enough seating for all in the living room, as well as full-sized beds in the second bedroom. The two full baths made getting ready a breeze. We didn't cook, but the kitchen was well stocked. The location was ideal, steps from Michigan  Ave, Millenium park & the Chicago Cultural Center, and an easy walk to the Mag Mile, Riverwalk and lakefront. There is also a train stop less than a block away.  Check-in was exactly as described, and the front desk folks were always pleasant and greeted us coming and going. Natasha checked in to make sure we arrived and again when we were leaving to give us detailed instructions. No cleaning necessary at check-out- just drop the trash, lock and leave. Would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Chicago!
really nice place in a beautiful neighbourhood. Paul was very easy to communicate with and helpful. really great comfortable bed and lots of tv channels which was nice. would highly recommend.
Good place to stay and decently close to the tourist attractions

Henok was a great host who above and beyond during my stay!! My Dad went to the wrong address and Henok was a great help in trying to get him course corrected. So in my book he's like family. The place was great and it gave me an awesome night's rest while enjoying home in Chicago! I'd recommend and stay again!

This place was great!
Our group had 4 adults and 1 toddler. Check-in was easy and the host was accommodating with letting us drop off our bags earlier than the check in time. The host also provided a pack n play for us to set up for our daughter. We used Spot Hero to park at Sky 55 which had secured covered parking and just a short 5 minute walk from the apartment ($42 for two nights).
The views from the apartment were spectacular. We ended up spending more time in the apartment because of the weather and we had a great time just enjoying the views.
Our first day we walked to the art museum and around millennium park and then we carried-in dinner from the Thai restaurant the block up from the apartment (which was fabulous).
The next day we had breakfast at the Spoke and Bird close by which had a nice outdoor patio and then we walked to the Shedd Aquarium. After the Shedd, we spent the afternoon at the apartment’s pool! Then dinner at Flo and Santos. Would definitely stay again!
We had a great stay! Gregory and Hannah were super responsive, flexible, and helpful. The space was clean, cozy, and well placed for accessing downtown Chicago. Highly recommend!
Amazing weekend and would stay here again. Very kind and responsible owner and everything was great.
My stay was great! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I had no complaints at all. I’d definitely stay again! 💖

Our family of 6 thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Richard's place. The kids loved it and didn't want to leave.  The area was mostly quiet, aside from a very noisy 4th of July party in the common area below us that kept us up past 1 am. I also would've preferred curtains in the main bedroom as people coming up and downstairs could potentially see inside.   Otherwise, the condo was BEAUTIFUL..even better than the pictures.  Richard was super helpful, responded very quickly to questions,  and even set up surprise birthday decorations for my son upon my request.  I thought that was so nice! 10/10 recommend!

It was the perfect space for a weekend getaway for me and my boyfriend. We loved the location and how close everything was to walk to. We had no issues finding parking in the garage across the street! Overall a really great stay for a holiday weekend!

I hate to be rude as this was not a terrible experience, but was also not great. I thought very highly after reading so many good reviews. The hose was never rude as well! I’d say these pictures are probably edited heavily with AI. It is a decent place but not nearly as nice as it looks. Musty smell, looks cheaply remodeled, long list of things that need fixed. First night of our stay we had water pouring in from the bathroom walls and near the washer/dryer. Upon messaging the host and getting short answers back and forth it was one hour before coming to a “resolution”. They then did not do anything except for bring towels the next morning. So we cleaned it up ourselves with the few small towels we had but by the next morning it was soaked into the floors. No help was offered in cleaning this mess or having to deal with it after spending nearly $600 for a vacation weekend, just some extra towels 11 hours later…
Very responsive host. In a fun neighborhood. She gave lots of recs of bats and food options. Easy parking.
Great place to stay! Quiet neighborhood, everything we needed was within a 10 mile radius.  Apartment was clean, neighborhood was quiet and check in was easy.
Great place. Definitely check out the rooftop!
Great space for us! Close distance to everything we wanted to do. Would recommend to others.

Jeanette was wonderful to work with and was very accommodating. The apt. was exactly as described, and there were several restaurants and a comedy club within walking distance.  We would certainly stay in her Airbnb again.

Our stay went very well considering we booked last minute on a holiday weekend! My only issue was the listing advertised sleeping 3 people with a pull out bed under the mattress. This was not there when we checked in, but the host was very responsive and quick to resolve the discrepancy.

Milton did a wonderful job of communicating with us! Everything was as described. We had what we needed to cook breakfast each morning. The grocery store was a 5 minute walk away. Lots of restaurants close by. We felt safe and enjoyed experiencing the neighborhood of Bridgeport.
Not more than 20-25 min from a lot of fun things in downtown!

A great location and very walkable to lots of areas. There was a big storm while we were there that caused a little issue that she was very responsive and on top of and was very helpful. I would very much recommend for a group of friends or family

We had a great stay! The place was very cozy, clean, and comfortable. Rida was an excellent host, always responsive and quick to help with anything we needed. She made sure we had everything for a comfortable stay. We would definitely recommend staying here and would be happy to come back!

I really enjoyed my stay here! The home was clean, well-maintained, and it was clear that the property is cared for regularly. Tina was an excellent host. She was very informative, communicated clearly, and kept guests updated whenever needed.
There were a couple of minor hiccups during my stay, but Tina responded quickly each time and resolved everything promptly, which I really appreciated. Her responsiveness and professionalism made the experience stress-free.
Overall, I had a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to others. I would happily stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago!

The apartment is nicely decorated.
Pros: nice neighborhood, well supplied kitchen, great shower, quiet.
Cons: we didn't find the bed very comfortable, and the exterior lights didn't work, meaning that each night we had to come into a dark walkway (entrance is on the side of the house). We contacted Victoria right away and she offered to correct this, but it stayed dark through our time there.
Overall, a nice apartment.
Great staff, very easy to work with. Excellent location, clean place.
Really nice place

Thomas was super responsive and check-in was a breeze. The unit is clutter free, linens were spotless  and it has a well appointed kitchen. The bedroom with the king bed has no closet so some hooks on the wall would be super helpful to hang clothes on during longer stays (we were there 7 nights). Unfortunately the hot water heater kept turning off so taking hot showers was sporadic. For five nights the unit was super quiet but on the weekend evenings the tenants above us partied hard during the early morning hours (1-3am) so we couldn’t sleep.

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was very clean and located in a quiet neighborhood, which made it a relaxing place to stay. The location was excellent, with plenty of restaurants, shops, and attractions within walking distance. We’d definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

The second day I walked in to the apartment during a rainstorm and there was an inch of standing water throughout the apartment, extending into the living rooms dm bedroom. We were staying in summertime so it wasn't a big deal, but in wintertime it would be way more cozy with better lighting.

I ended up canceling and leaving after only one night.

The bedroom is exactly like the photos, but includes a mini fridge. The bed was large but the 'mattress' was just a large foam pad that sank down terribly at all the edges. The blanket was visibly dirty and unwashed. The bedsheets and pillowcases looked clean but reeked of months of sweat and BO. There is central aircon but it was so cold I ended up opening a window to not freeze. The roadway by the window is constantly in use so bring earplugs.
I could've lives with the dirty shower, but for ~87/nt I'd at least like a clean bed.
