This place is amazing I will always stay here everytime I’m visiting Chicago there’s lots to do and fun places to see . The host is always so welcoming responds really fast 10/10 recommend

This place is really awesome. My friends and I had an amazing time here. We used the projector to watch a show, the showers were awesome, the beds were so comfy, and the kitchen had everything we needed. My only concern was the AC not working on the top floor, but Nigam did offer to send someone over to take a look at it - we just weren’t home long enough to take him up on that offer. But overall phenomenal experience and would definitely stay here again. Id recommending Ubering out of here rather than walking to the train.

Joan
Is a great host she is quick to answer questions. great location lots choices of place to eat. it was easy to get around from our location. I would definitely here again.
Beautiful place to stay and a lovely neighborhood. Perfectly central for travel to all different parts of Chicago.
Great Location

Ewa was an amazing host from start to finish! She was incredibly accommodating and even let us check in early when our flight arrived much earlier than expected, which made the start of our trip so much easier.
She shared so many great recommendations for restaurants, shopping, bars, and things to do, and gave us the best tips on getting around Chicago efficiently. Her local knowledge really helped us make the most of our visit.
The Airbnb itself was spotless, cozy, comfortable, and had everything we needed. It truly felt like a home away from home.
Ewa's hospitality was outstanding. She went above and beyond to make sure we had an incredible stay. I would highly recommend her Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago. We would absolutely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay here with our family. One of our favorite things was the location—being just a short walk from the L train made getting around Chicago quick and easy. Having a washer and dryer in the apartment was also a huge plus during our week-long stay.
We happened to visit during a heat wave, and the air conditioning kept the apartment nice and cool the entire time.
We also appreciated how well stocked the apartment was. The bathrooms had shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and plenty of toilet paper, while the kitchen and laundry area were supplied with dishwasher and laundry detergent. It’s surprising how many places skimp on those everyday essentials, so it was a pleasant surprise to have everything we needed.
Overall, we had a great stay and would definitely recommend this place to friends and family.

We very much enjoyed our stay at Emily's
listing, it was excatky as shown.
She was very flexible allowing us an early check in time and being able to extend our stay a few days. Very responsive to any questions
Would highly recommend

This was an amazing place to stay. The apartment has a beautiful view of the city and pool area, and is in a safe neighborhood with anything needed in walking distance. No need for a car - transportation was easy with the red, orange and green lines 3 blocks away at Roosevelt, and numerous busses on the same street as the apartment. Stephanie was a great host, flexible and friendly with clear instructions and very reasonable checkout expectations. We would definitely stay here again!

We had a nice stay at Sarah’s! We really loved the location - so close to the lake! Sarah was also great with communication and responding as issues arose.
The apartment could use some updates, as a number of things were run down/need to be fixed. Most things weren’t a big deal, such as fixtures that are loose or the living room blinds not opening (though $200/night felt steep for the quality). One issue that was a problem for us was that the washing machine had a severe mold issue. The bath towels also were very mildewy after a single use (which makes sense with the washing machine). For many guests this is probably fine, unfortunately I have a severe mold allergy so we were not able to use the washing machine during our stay and by the end of the trip I had an eczema flair up. Sarah was very good about communicating and did her best to fix the problem during our stay. For future guests I just recommend confirming the mold issue has been resolved if you are sensitive to mold.
Great place, location. Had a terrific stay.
great location, clean, nice space and cool during the heatwave

Great place, great location, great hosts. Nothing could have been any better. In addition, I had an accident a couple of weeks before my trip and they helped me with all issues regarding the mobile scooter which I needed. My gratitude

Overall, we didn't mind staying here and would come back because the size relative to the price is more than reasonable. The host has a few rules we don't quite agree with, and the "house rules" are lengthy.  We understand it is a home, not a hotel, but if you're this picky, consider not using Airbnb? The television was a letdown. It has nothing on it besides local news. Also note that many (if not all) of the doors and windows, aside from the front door, do not lock. This made us feel a little insecure and unsafe, but it wasn't a big deal after 24 hours and took some getting used to. The house also was not that clean. Nothing egregious, but we strongly suspect that they do not use a professional cleaner. Expect to clean any dishes and cookware before using them. We felt a little policed/mistrusted by the host but overall had an okay experience in the house.

Steve and Loong offer warm and genuine hospitality which made us feel right at home.
Very warm, kind and friendly hosts.
The location of the stay is the biggest plus, near red line station, not far away from any amenities, close to great restaurants and pubs, close to the beach and close to Wrigley field.
I certainly recommend people to stay at their place

This place was great! My family of four loved staying here.  It was close to the L, easy to walk to restaurants and museums. We especially loved the rooftop pool to cool off after a day of exploring the city during a heat wave. The walls of glass provided amazing views! Stephanie was quick to respond to questions and was accommodating when we asked to leave our bags a little early when we arrived.  We would definitely stay here again.

exceptional hosts from beginning to end. They were friendly, responsive, and made us feel very welcome. The home was exactly as described clean, comfortable, well maintained, and had everything our family of six needed for a relaxing getaway.
We stayed to celebrate my 40th birthday and my daughter’s 19th birthday, and it was the perfect place to make special family memories. When we noticed a small issue with the front door, they responded immediately and took care of it quickly. Their communication throughout our stay was outstanding.
We especially appreciated how much they cared about their home and their guests’ experience. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this property to anyone looking for a peaceful, clean, and comfortable place to stay.
Thank you again, Tony and Tamara, for helping make our celebration so special! ❤️
We really enjoyed our stay at Michael's place. The bed setup was perfect for our family of five. There was lots to do in walking distance. We would stay here again for sure.
beautiful view. full amenities. great part of town

Nat was SUPER responsive, addressing anything that came up and giving recommendations for things to see and do. The place is pretty close to the pink line and less than a block to several bus lines. Recommend checking out Monday Coffee Company if you're down for a walk. The neighborhood just north is a bit rough, we discovered.

Mi estancia de cinco días fue excelente. Desde el primer momento, el personal fue muy amable y atento, haciendo que el proceso de check-in fuera rápido y sencillo. La habitación estaba limpia, cómoda y bien equipada, con todo lo necesario para una estancia agradable.

I loved this stay, the place felt just like home, was very clean–could visibly see the vacuum lines across the couch! Lots of lighting from beautiful windows in common areas and bedrooms, nice spacious bathrooms + more. We were walking distance from multiple restaurants, and about a 10-15min ride from downtown, very easy to get back and forth. The neighborhood felt safe, as I walked around day/night. Not only was this a beautiful stay, Milan was a gracious host. He was very responsive and even proactive, reaching out and making sure we were enjoying our stay.  I am looking forward to coming back!!!

Our stay was fantastic - from arrival to a lush garden scape to every amenity available. Our son was moving from Chicago and having access to a large washer was ideal. We would come back after a long day of packing, put laundry in and watch the World Cup on a tv so large you felt like you were at the game. Mark was a wonderful host checking in to make sure all was good and quick with answers to questions. We hit it out of the park staying here. We will be back - I have a niece and nephew that still lives in Chicago.

We had a great stay! The place was clean and comfortable. The neighborhood was quiet, peaceful, and beautiful. It was close to the airport and easy to drive to and from. We would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

Place was ok, but it was hot the A/C was not good. The water took a long time to heat up. It was hard to get in the building the first time but luckily someone came by to let us in. I would not stay here again for the price, a lot of better options.

The unit was nice, clean and modern. The Couch and beds were comfortable. The location was great.  It's a block away from the cta red line station which made it easy to go to Wrigley field or the Chicago loop without needing to drive.  It was nice that Lane Beach and restaurants were in walking distance.  I would stay here again.
Was a great stay. Great amenities. Walkable to good shopping and restaurants. Only 10 mins from downtown. Would definitely stay again!
The accommodation was excellent and the host was very helpful and responsive. 5 stars all round from our stay.

Kathleen’s place is a sanctuary in the city! We are Chicago natives and visit the city several times a year. The location, comfort, and amenities of Kathleen’s place can’t be beat. We slept incredibly well, appreciated the local restaurants & coffee shops, and enjoyed winding down in the lovely space. On top of the wonderful airbnb, Kathleen is a gem. Thanks for a great stay!

We really enjoyed our stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and looked just like the listing. Check-in was easy, and we had everything we needed. The train station wasn’t right around the corner, but it was only a short Uber ride away, so getting around the city was easy. One night there was a kids’ party downstairs around midnight, but it wasn’t a huge issue. The person managing the property had already told us to let him know if the noise ever became a problem, and when we reached out, he took care of it right away. Other than that brief part of one night, it wasn’t  noticeably loud for the rest of our stay. We’d definitely stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay at The Catfish Loft at the Bluebird Inn. The Loft was clean, comfortable, and full of thoughtful details that made it feel warm and inviting for peeps not really native to Chicago. The location was great, with easy access to local restaurants, cafes (The Long Room, Diner Grill, and Q' Bo Latin Cafe were our faves) and everything we needed while visiting Chicago. Check-in was smooth, communication was easy, and the space had a lot of character without sacrificing comfort. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great Northside Chicago getaway.
The place was nice. Very clean. So close to great restaurants and shopping.

Aaron's place was clutter free, clean, good shower pressure, and the bed was comfortable.  This location is a 3 minute walk to Aragon Ballroom, 2 minute walk to a convenient store Uptown Deli for essentials. The host was quick to respond to any questions.  Thanks for hosting us.

Very hospitable, great location bus stop right in front and awesome parking for a Chicago location if you know Chicago parking can be hard. This BNB was perfect. Very clean, organized and definitely will use again for our Cubs games.

Host was always responsive. Space was clean and felt much larger than 3 BR space. I stayed with my wife and 3 teens and we never felt cramped. The rooftop shared patio on 3rd floor was the perfect spot to relax on a summer evening.

I had a great stay at this studio. It had everything I needed for a comfortable visit, and the space was clean and well-equipped. The location was reasonably convenient, especially considering the price, and made it easy to get around Chicago without spending a fortune on accommodations. Overall, it was a great value, and I’d definitely consider staying here again.

I've stayed here a couple of times and it's a very convenient location, right on bus route... kept clean and everything you need in kitchen to cook. I had a couple of questions and Adriana got back right away and I appreciated that!
Enjoyed our stay! The neighborhood has some good, walkable establishments including Cleo’s where we watched World Cup soccer and Breakfast House. The garage was great since we drove.
It was a really nice place to stay. It had parking on site and the target across the street was very convenient!

We had a great stay overall. The apartment is lovely, in a fantastic location, and had everything we needed and more. The host was incredibly friendly, communicative, and even stored our luggage for us after checkout, which we really appreciated.
A couple of things to note: we happened to visit during a heatwave, and the window A/C units struggled to keep the third-floor apartment cool enough. The bed also wasn’t our favorite since it’s memory foam, and the bedroom can be fairly bright at night because the blinds are a single panel that can’t fully close around the window A/C unit.
Those were fairly minor issues compared to everything else. We’d happily stay here again and really appreciated the host’s kindness and hospitality.

This stay was wonderful! I stayed with my family for a week long family vacation and this place was in the perfect location for walking, eating, taking the train, and so much more! Lots of space and beautifully kept.
I totally enjoyed my stay. Everything was exactly as described. The host was great.. responded quickly. I will definitely be back.

This was a great spot for a week stay with my kiddos. My brother lives in the area, so that'd made it easy to link up with him; and the train & bus are short walks away. I will say the beds were a little too firm for my own preference but that's minor. Having 3 bedrooms was great & a parking spot in Chicago, also a bonus! I would definitely stay here again.

Anny's place is a great spot to check out Chicago. Location is a quick walk to the blue line and has easy access to many bus lines. There was also free street parking out front to leave a car if needed. The check in process was easy and the room was comfortable and clean. Anny was very responsive throughout the whole stay. We stayed during the heat wave and Anny helped with ensuring the AC was working properly after a warm first night. We didn't use the shared space too much, but the living room and kitchen are accessible and there was coffee/tea provided.
I enjoyed my staycation it was exactly what I needed to get away in the city for my birthday
Peaceful quiet space just a short walk from the Brown line and bus lines. Grocery store is nearby and several cute restaurants. Very well stocked in terms of toiletries. Great place.

We loved our time at Lora’s place.  This was our second stay in the Ukrainian Village.  Such a quiet and peaceful neighborhood.  Everything we needed was walkable.  We appreciated the coin laundry.  Definitely recommend.
I will always stay at Caroline’s if there’s an opening.

Kyriako's place was exactly as described. It's a beautifully updated space not far from Chicago's Pink Line. I enjoyed the space. Two small issues came up and Kyriako and associates dealt with them immediately. I appreciated their willingness to rectify the situation promptly, and they easily exceeded my expectations. One thing to note: the front door slams hard and is loud. Overall, my stay was great, and I would stay again!

This rental was exactly what I was looking for! Located right at the loop lines made travelling to our various destinations easy and quick. The view of the Willis (Sears) Tower was awesome. The lobby and upper deck were very nice spaces to hang out in. I could walk to everything we needed - drug stores, groceries, restaurants and food trucks, the river-walk, I could go on. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Access was easy, and the host provided simple check-in and check-out instructions well in advance. We had an awesome time and would definitely recommend!

We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely book this Airbnb again. The apartment was exactly as described and looked just like the photos. It was clean, well-stocked, and had more than enough supplies for our stay. The beds were very comfortable, and we appreciated having extra linens and blankets available.
The building itself felt very safe, with a front desk attendant and excellent security, which gave us added peace of mind. The rooftop pool and gathering area were a great bonus and a nice place to relax.
The location was perfect with just a short walk to Randolph Street with its many restaurants and shops, while still offering quick and easy access to downtown.
The host was responsive and communicated promptly whenever we had questions or needed assistance. Overall, this was a fantastic stay, and I wouldn't hesitate to book this property again. Highly recommend!
Very adventures very vague response but I’m simple Kim’s spot was decent in price and lovely home

This was our second stay, and it was just as wonderful as the first! The home was spotless, parking was easy and convenient, and the hosts were incredibly accommodating throughout our stay. Communication was excellent, and everything was exactly as described. We truly felt comfortable here and wouldn’t hesitate to stay again. Highly recommend!
Great location in a beautiful Irving Park neighborhood.

Our family of 5 was very comfortable staying at this location. We appreciated having a full kitchen, comfortable rooms and even a garage to put our vehicle in. It was a beautiful space and the check out instructions were simple.

Oasis lives up to its name! It’s a beautiful and chic place to stay. Not far from the Obama Center.
Sherry and Michael were resourceful and told us exactly how to get around town. Chicago was good to us and we will be back.

Upstairs neighbor can be a bit noisy at times but otherwise everything was excellent — especially appreciated the great a/c during a weeklong heat wave. Petru is a very responsive host and even helped make arrangements for delivery of packages and mail during my long-term stay.
Great stay. Local recommendations were helpful.

Was what we expected!
Would highly recommend it!
All good.

If you are looking for a host who cares, look no further than Tracee.  She rescued us during the recent Chicago heatwave.  We are locals who found ourselves without working AC.  We booked Tracee's place at about 7 pm ish at night.  She communicated so quickly and confirmed not only our reservations, but the fact that the AC at her place worked.  She even got cleaners over for us so fast and let us hang out in another unit while ours was finished.  We were finally able to get 2 wonderful nights sleep in her very cool unit.  Even though we are locals, we loved being in West Town for a few nights.  Made our way over to Publican for coffee and treats.  Shout out to Standing Passengers over on Chicago as well. Delightful coffee and lattes. The place itself was cozy and clean.  It was hard not to feel at home right away.  Thank you again, Tracee.  We are so grateful to you!

We had a great stay! We went there to help our daughter move apartments and the host was very friendly, quickly responsive and helpful with any adjustments we had to make. The place is cute and clean and in a great location. The beds are nice as well as the linens which I really appreciate. Kitchen is well supplied as well. We come up often to see our daughter and I will absolutely stay here again.
great stay. close to everything in Andersonville. very proactive and responsive host
Good place to stay

I can't say enough great things about this place! Staying with Derek is like staying with an old friend ; chill, kind and generous. Great recommendations for around the city that made the trip very special. Location is amazing! Room is perfect! A great stay with a great host!
Great location in Lincoln Park.  Beautiful accommodations and very responsive.  Would book again.

If you're coming to Chicago with young family, friends, siblings - this spot in the West Loop can't be beat. Not only is the location killer, but the place itself is clean, well stocked, with small thoughtful touches. The washer and dryer helped in the 100F weather. Managed by owners themselves - very responsive and kind. I found their check in/out times renter friendly and checkout instructions short and fair.
Great location, steps from the bus line, central to our plans, quiet & safe neighborhood, friendly folks all around.  We will be back!

The apartment was great! The beds were comfortable, the bathrooms were beautiful with soft towels, and the kitchen had everything we needed. The dedicated garage parking was awesome and the view from the balcony of downtown was beautiful. We really lucked out to be able to stay here while our family explored and enjoyed Chicago. It was close enough to drive everywhere easily but enough outside of downtown that we had space in the apartment to relax and have some separate activities.

Michele and Marsh’s place was wonderful, tidy and very comfortable. The room was very cozy and the bed was very comfortable. There were plenty of spare sheets and towels provided in the closet as well as four spa robes that were a very special treat. There was ample room provided in the kitchen for my groceries including my own cupboard for dry goods and a spacious shelf in the fridge. The washer/dryer was available for use and easily accessible and accommodated large loads of laundry. There is also easy parking out front and parking stickers are provided. It was very easy access to all of the spaces in the house with very kind, helpful hosts. Both Michele and Marsh were very easy going and helpful. Michele made this wonderful chicken noodle soup that she shared and it was delicious. I highly recommend this airbnb and cannot say enough about the wonderful hospitality.

I spent a week at Nat’s place. Half with a childhood friend and half with my teenage boys. The place worked great for both mini-vacations. The bright yellow and pop-art decor brought joy to me every morning! And for the price of a single room at a hotel downtown, each of my kids got their own room- so no fights!!
We enjoyed walking around the neighborhood, checking out the architecture and enjoying the local restaurants. There are gelato places, great pie places, gyms, bars, cute shopping, plus convenient public transportation (trains and buses) to many great Chicago neighborhoods - all within walking distance.
I rented a car for the second half of the trip and parking was easy and free in the neighborhood (once i figured out the signs).
Nat provided proactive instructions and then helped out with recommendations when we needed them. A perfect vacation.
I’ve already recommended the place for family for future Chicago visits!

This place in Pilsen is close to many restaurants and coffee shops in 18th street. Barring some sanitation concerns which Phil and Cory were very responsive about, the place is beautifully kept, and spacious for relaxing in.
Some good food spots and a solid location. Was very happy with the space, would book again.
Great inexpensive spot in a prime location, loved the design and vibe of the hotel!
Good condo and surroundings. Second time staying. I would recommend this place.

This apartment was very nice, with easy access to the Blue Line of the L, and close to some interesting shopping areas.
We did have a problem with the street parking, but our host was responsive, and offered space in their garage, which cleared up the issue.
There is also a playground at the school across the street that is open access and allowed us to take our toddler out when we were having some down time.
We were very happy with the place. It was clean and was in a good location!

The space was great, we brought our dog and walking him was easy.
Neighborhood was friendly. There’s great local food, laundry down the street, playgrounds for kids and they have a cute garden in front.
It is street parking but we always found parking spaces in front of the home no matter the time.
La estancia estuvo muy cómoda, los anfitriones estuvieran pendientes de muestra estancia. lo recomiendo para familias pequeñas.
Had a great time, loved the area.  The place is really spacious and great for a longer stay, we felt right at home

Great little studio, everything I needed in a convenient place and at a reasonable price!
Very much recommend

FOR TALL FOLKS: Pipes run along much of the ceiling, including above primary pathways. I love how that adds to the cozy, hobbit hole feel of the space, and at 5'10" I still had plenty of head clearance. But my tallest friends and relatives would be uncomfortable here. If you're 6'1" or taller, maybe book elsewhere.
FOR EVERYONE ELSE: Don't hesitate! This is a cute, clean, sunny, tasteful space in a safe, walkable neighborhood. Comfy bed. Fancy shower. Wendy was helpful and friendly -- great communication.
Contra other reviews, I heard very little noise from the apartment above, other than some (delightful) puppy paws my final morning. If you've lived in apartments, especially in a large city, you'll probably consider this place quiet.
Bonus: Free street parking is abundant during the day -- rare in much of Chicago. The neighborhood gets fully parked up at night, so if you'll be out late just plan to leave your car and take the el (the Rockwell stop is a 15 min walk) or rideshare.

We loved staying at David’s! It was perfect for our family of 3 generations and very comfortable, conveniently located, and spacious. David spared no detail in amenities and the fruit, snacks, and candies were an added touch which were devoured by my grandchildren. The outdoor deck was a bonus although we were there during a heat wave and couldn’t enjoy it much. I would highly recommend this apartment for your stay in Chicago!
Great location. Very walkable to Magnificent Mile and tons of good restaurants. Place was perfect for a family of four and a dog. Would highly recommend.

We had a great stay here for two nights with our family! The house was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed. One of the best parts was the location—it was very close to downtown Chicago, which made getting around and exploring the city easy and convenient. The host provided clear and detailed instructions, making check-in and our stay completely hassle-free. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend this place to others!
Recommend the place. Although the walls are thin and you can hear a lot of people. Overall still a really nice place with good amenities.
容易找到房子，入口有一点点难找。房间卫生整洁，也宽阔明亮。房东回应及时，服务态度好。步行3分钟可到附近一间Walgreen和唐人街，食肆多，9分钟到地铁站，交通便利。

Location, location, location! Easy to say the location was excellent and being located near two CTA stations made accessing the city easy. The room was spacious and clean. The whole place was clean and was very inviting! Thanks to Tim for providing the ear plugs for the passing trains. I will be honest with the ear plugs the train did not bother some. Check in was easy and was provided clear instructions. Easy to say it was great stay with great access to the city!

Our family of 8 had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago! The home was spacious, clean, and comfortable, with plenty of room for everyone to relax. The layout worked perfectly for our large group, and the amenities made us feel right at home.
The location was convenient, making it easy to explore the city while also enjoying a quiet and comfortable place to come back to each day.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend this home to other large families or groups visiting Chicago. We would definitely stay here again 😊

I live in Chicago and stayed in this apartment for almost 3 weeks due to renovations. The location is wonderful located in West Loop with multiple restaurants extremely clean apartment. Host was very responsive. The apartment building itself has good amenities with a nice gym and a pool.
The only thing worth mentioning is that there is a train that runs there so this is something to be aware of. Additionally, I believe the entire building has very low water pressure so after a long day with two kids, I was frustrated that the shower did not have strong stronger water pressure.
Overall great stay but pricey which is expected for the west loop

Great place to stay! Convenient for all our plans and food options!
Laura was quick to respond and very helpful! Definitely would recommend.
Great deal for the place I would 100% stay here again if necessary.

The location worked out so well for us! We were on a family vacation, wanted to be n the Wrigleyville area, and near the EL station for access to downtown sights.
The 4-bedroom space worked out perfectly for our family with 3 kids.
The space was large enough for all of us, and we felt very comfortable.

From the start, this was a wonderful experience. Hector was extremely responsive to any questions we had. There was an issue with the AC and Hector drove out at 10pm to bring window units to ensure we were comfortable, and had HVAC guys out the next day. My kids had a wonderful time and enjoyed the toys and games provided.

This place as indicated in the post is about a quarter mile to the train station. We parked our car on day 1 of our 2 week stay and never had to move it.
As for the place itself, it was exactly as described. The house was incredibly quiet.
Despite it not having central ac we were there on consecutive 90 degree days and the box units did the trick.
Anna and Jason are great hosts. Very responsive and they have great suggestions of what to do in the area.
If you are going to Chicago, I highly recommend staying here. We would go back in a second.

The space was initially as described, but we had some unfortunate mishaps during our stay. The first morning we were woken by scratching and animal noises coming from the attic. Our host was very responsive, but ultimately it took over 48 hours for anyone from “maintenance” to check the space. By which point we had done research, and made enough noise to scare the animal (later confirmed as a raccoon), away. We had kids with us, so an unknown creature in the attic with unknown access to our space was uncomfortable. The next 3 days we struggled to keep the temperature of the apartment below 80. There was an unforeseen heat wave at that time, and we are aware that the AC was still technically functioning, but 80-83 degrees was not a comfortable temperature indoors. It seemed like the space itself couldn't keep heat out enough for the AC to keep up, which is only a concern in extremes of weather. The garage was a great amenity, and the neighborhood was very walkable with good food!
Nice and clean place to stay, Anastasia is always there to help
Had a great stay. Kristen let us check-in early which was super helpful. Everything was clean and comfortable, and it was a nice location!

Great location, pretty views from the balcony, real close to the L to get anywhere in the city.
Sara was awesome, her communication was excellent. I will definitely stay here again.
Cool!
The Airbnb accurately matched the posted pictures. Very clean with all the amenities listed. The arcade games were a nice touch and fun.
The place was just as described. I had no issues during my stay and it was near many restaurants and close to the city. Parking was very easy to find and spot hero locations were close.

I would give it a 4.5 stars. It’s just a few minor things that prevent me from giving 5 stars.
It was very convenient to public transit, it was comfortable, and they were responsive.
The place wasn’t perfectly clean, Security was a slight concern because the balcony door only had a bolt on top - it would be nice if they fixed the key lock. There’s 3 doors to the stairwell (1 is the main door), and the bathrooms were slightly dated. There was no bath soap or detergent, but it wasn’t advertised as such.
I would consider again. Good value for me though.
Had a blast in town with family, was the perfect location for seeing all the sights. Hosts recommended locations were a added pleasure to the trip. Thanks
Quick response from host. Great location
Loved the place great host will be staying again. No complaints everything was great
Wonderful stay was clean, and comfortable. The whole stay.
The place is such what you pay, the neighborhood is safe you have the subway and bus on one side which helps a lot to move around the city

Great! Two couples In Chicago for a Sunday - Wednesday conference at the McCormick Place Convention Center. This two bedroom, two bath apartment provided an ideal location to rest and recharge during non-conference times. Just a 16-18 minute walk between locations. Also, public transportation was just a short walk away.  Lots to do and see with numerous attractions and restaurants nearby or reachable using public transportation. Apartment was clean and secure, requiring a code to enter both building and apartment. Milan was friendly and quick to respond from initial reservations through checkout. Only flaw I noted was there was a lack of adequate clothing storage space. Bedrooms have large closets with a top shelve, however I would have liked  some drawers or cubes for folded clothing. I wouldn’t hesitate to reserve a stay at Milan’s place again.
Nice stay for me and my friends , really had a good time in Chicago

Weihong’s place was exactly what we needed for our stay in Chicago. The neighborhood is peaceful and the host was helpful and friendly. The only negative side was that we could not regolate the AC and it was quite chilly inside

A great little garden-level studio--well-equipped, clean and quiet. I slept like a baby. Less than five minutes to get to the Pink Line and super easy to walk to great Pilsen spots. Tons of great restaurants nearby, I ate SO WELL. Dan's directions and instructions were super clear, easy to follow, and he checked in to make sure I had everything I needed.
Had an unbelievable time here! Thomas is a fantastic host! Strongly recommend

My stay at the Bohemian Lodge met all my needs and expectations during my recent visit to Chicago. Communications with the host and responses to my questions and requests were addressed quickly and thoroughly. Very positive experience overall!

The location was excellent. Close to the lakefront, mag mile and tons of great restaurants. The street was quiet and we had no trouble with parking thanks to the included parking spot. Communication with the owners was easy and fast. We would definitely stay here again.
Thank you!
Like everything about the place just the living room air did not run cool air it was to hot but other then that great place to stay at
Great place
me sentí en casa
Greta location close to restaurants, supermarkets, the Zoo and public transport - the neighbourhood is beautiful. The space was like advertised and provided everything we needed. Would book again
thank you do much for letting us stay at your place. my boys 14 and 13 loved the city and your location. thank you for being so helpful and kind.
Steve was a great host and the penthouse was beautiful!

Tamara is a great host! She is very prompt to respond. Her BNB is very homey, cute and super clean. It’s located close to public transportation. We will definitely stay there again next time in Chicago.
Amazing host! Everything was straight forward. The space was clean, the area was nice & it was very close to the subway. Would definitely return
Nice apartment. Had what we needed. Good location to connect to different areas of Chicago. Demitri always contacted us.

Was good and quiet place for a family of 4.
Home was clean and all the amenities were as expected. Reserved parking was a life saver.

Though we ran into a couple of minor challenges with the host at the very start, we figured it out together quickly. The rest of our stay was absolutely amazing, and we really enjoyed our time here. Definitely recommended!

Calvin's place is a total gem with so many kind and practical gestures. We loved his flexibility with check-in, enabling us we to drop bags from airport before heading to town (so easy to take the blue line there from ohare and then again into the city). Water cooler with filtered water was terrific for the 94+ degree heat. Terrific options for spreading out our young family to sleep (futons actually comfortable). And terrific multiheaded shower (3 kids can shower at a time). It's quiet with safe, free, secure off street parking.. And even has a new putting green out back!
Super friendly hosts, nice space. Quiet inside despite being a bit close to the freeway. Can walk to 18th street. Lovely little neighborhood.

Wow.
What a location!
200ft from Wrigley entrance.
We had an amazing time going to 2 cubs games and also taking the red line downtown.
We hope to stay at their Airbnb again!
Great location, host, and airbnb. Would stay here again.
Great stay
Great place to stay if you’re going to a Cubs game. Super close to Wrigleyville!

This be place was perfect for our visit to Chicago. The train into downtown is a couple blocks away, parking was easy (especially with provided permits), and great food and drink of ALL kinds nearby. And of course you are walking distance from Wrigley! We only had a couple reasons to talk to Kelsey and she responded very quickly. Bedrooms are tight, but have good closets and that is not always the case, so I felt they were beyond what we typically see in our city Airbnb places. Bathroom and kitchen upgrades were very nice. We wish it hadn’t been SO hot this week, so we could enjoy the deck, as it was a nice space. The other nice thing is that they don’t expect a lot of their guests. Easy to get in and easy to check out. HIGHLY recommend staying here!
Coty was extremely responsive and provided assistance when we needed it most! Definitely recommend this stay, such a nice walkable area with delicious food.

Very tiny 3 “bedroom” apartment. Kind of a cross between hotel and apartment. The living area was incredibly small—if sitting at the dining table, no one can be at the stove (and be careful not to get burned)! Only 4 can fit at dining table unless you move the couch up against the tv wall. Two bedrooms are open at the top and the regular bedroom’s door didn’t close (which I messaged about on day 1 and they said they’d get someone to fix it the next day but never got back to me). These issues made for not much privacy and very tight quarters. Which is why it felt more like a hotel room. Loved the location and easy parking in lot across the street with daily discounted rate with in n out privileges.
Wonderful stay! Wish the rooftop was open but otherwise the place was clean and organized. The people from Staywell were very helpful and response quickly!

Sonya was so kind and responded quickly to my messages. The home was very cute and comfortable with all of the amenities for my family of 4 all week. Highly recommend for a short trip to Chicago in a nice neighborhood that feels safe!
This place was very clean and stocked with all the necessities.  The hosts were extremely responsive.  I would stay here again.

The location is conveniently situated near various attractions. The host promptly addressed my concerns. However, the apartment requires some updates and a thorough cleaning of all areas, including the blinds, ceiling, bathroom sinks, tubs, and other fixtures. During our six-day stay with six people, there were only six sets of towels available, and the apartment lacked a washer and dryer inside. The dishwasher was malfunctioning, and roaches were present in the kitchen. I contacted the host regarding these issues, and they assured me that they would contact pest control. Despite these concerns,we were there only at night mainly so overall, it was acceptable. However, I personally do not believe I would choose this location again.
This place was perfect for two teens and 3 adults! We ate at the local pizza places, as well as the Asian grocery store with a food hall nearby.

Host failed to label 4 identical keys in lockbox all needed to enter premise & unit. Host Unit was also unlabeled and not instructed on which building floor, leading to almost trespassing another unit. Hallway toilet paper holder almost fell out of its socket, bedroom door handle does not latch, fridge filter unit expired and beeped for replacement, caked on dry food on utensils in the drawer, hallway bathroom exhaust fan leaked during trip. False advertisement of assigned parking as a regular tenant (confirmed by host) took our assigned spot for the whole duration of trip. When alarmed about these concerns with photos included multiple times, host promptly replied that management was informed and yet did not address any issues above. Host also falsely claimed to call/contact by checkout time to compensate for unaddressed issues with my full acknowledgement but never called, messaged on this app & completely ghosted. Neighborhood also extremely unsafe with many abandoned/booted cars.

We were lucky to find Taher’s place free as a same-day booking.  The location can’t be beat, & is a very short walk to shops, the metro stop, the beach, and the restaurants along Sheridan ave.  You can park your car for free, & just use the metro/train to get around.   The place itself is just like in photos, and was very clean and comfortable.  We stayed as a family of 3, with our oldest teen, during an extreme heat wave.  Taher already had the apartment fully air conditioned when we arrived, and cold water in the fridge waiting for us.  The kitchen is particularly nice & easy to navigate.  We are glad to have the opportunity to stay here, and will come again on our return one day.  Thanks again!
The backyard was very special for our children and the neighbors were most welcoming.  A great place.

Extremely unsafe neighbourhood, had a shooting incident nearby. The place itself was old and sockets didnt work. The host sent a notification at 10:10 am saying to check out at 10am of the same day. The bed sheets were stained. The area was very far from downtown and not even public transport was safe

Amazing beautiful place with great amenities, I love the place. I don’t give 5 stars because the stairs going up was very uncomfortable for me, and in this hot weather no AC was very hot only with fans, but the place beautiful, beds, kitchen, everything was nice
Nice place near Logan Sq for great access to restaurants but heat and limited and noisy cooling meant the place was particularly difficult  to  sleep in.
Clara was very friendly and helpful. I would stay again.
The place is great. The neighborhood is in an ideal location.

This is a great place to stay! In a great area. I felt very safe! The only thing is when I first moved in depending on who’s living in the apartment can definitely determine how your stay will be. Luckily the people who caused me the most trouble left and the stay became better. Which you never know and isn’t to blame on the landlord. I had issues with people constantly turning on the heat when it’s 80 degrees or more. Once they moved out the apartment was great! Room was perfect, bathroom was great! Loved that the shower was always hot. The only thing I’d recommend is getting the WiFi checked because it just didn’t work well on any of the networks for me! Very responsive host! Thank you for having me.

Great location being on Grand, next to D'Amato's. The unit is on the top floor, so note they don't have A/C listed as an amenity. The host was communicative and provided clear check-in/out instructions, and the unit was accurate to its description. The condition of the bathroom was rough, there was leftover hair and peeling paint. I think it could be cleaner, but the host supplied our stay with plenty of towels, toiletries, and toilet paper. For its location - I'd stay here again.

The place is very strategic and close to bus stations that connect with the train so it is easy to get to the city On the other hand, if you come by car, parking is not guaranteed since it is a neighborhood and area open to the public, Yingjian’s place is very quiet and has what you need, although my friend and I suffered a little with the mattress in the room it is too soft and uncomfortable, however everything else was very good! The host is very attentive and the communication was very good. Thanks

Ryan was an engaged and thorough host. He gave very clear guides for check-in/out, passwords, recommendations, and even let us check in early. He also checked in frequently and always responded quickly. I cannot stress this enough- the location is PRIME and definitely great for newcomers to explore. We walked or took the Damen Blue Line train everywhere for five days and had no issues just stepping outside and going somewhere. We loved being in central WP. The train does come by frequently, but it’s not too loud and didn’t personally bother us much. This is definitely the kind of place for explorers and people who want to get out and about immediately.
The only issue we had was on the last night, there was a small leak from the ceiling when a storm hit. I spoke to Ryan about it and he responded immediately.

We had a great stay at Kelly’s house in Lakeview. It was an easy walk to the Cubs game and the kids loved the video games and the pool table. The house is very spacious and the two car garage comes in very handy. We would definitely stay here again!
Great host and a beautiful home. Definitely would stay there again.

Craftsman Gallery är en väldigt trevlig och spännande våning. Älskar att det är konst i hela våningen. Har det man behöver i köket, lokalt kaffe och schyssta tvålar.
Möjlighet att tvätta och torka.
Ett bra boende helt enkelt

Marty is an excellent host. I had a great stay and didn't run into any issues. The neighborhood is safe, peaceful, and close to some great restaurants. If you're looking for a place away from downtown, Marty's listing is a great choice.
11 minute walk from blue line was nice

We enjoyed our stay here. The house is beautiful and exactly as described. The bedrooms have AC units, which we were so grateful for in the heat. And since they're in the basement of this very old house, all the walls are essentially brick or concrete, which means we didn't hear anyone, and I didn't have to police my children every minute to be quiet like I do in a hotel. For the money this was a good value and we would choose it again.

The house was was easy to find and clean, perfect size for our family of 7 adults and 2 children. Everyone felt right at home, the kitchen was well equipped and the dining room was the perfect size. Plenty of hot water as well.
Shops, bars, and restaurants were all within walking distance along with the trains, which made getting around to the city very easy. Also very bike friendly area.
Josh was very communicative and helpful when it came to parking our second car as the City was paving the street which limited parking.
Thanks Josh

we loved staying at Laura's. it was easy to access, cozy, clean with a fully equipped kitchen, play room and relaxing living room. we felt at home especially after Laura and her team made sure to have some great coffee for us to brew. Laura was responsive and attentive. Our 7 and 5 years old boys loved the basketball and play room. They used it while we chilled in the living room watching the world cup. I found the beds to be comfy. I did however suggest that something be done to address the bright light through the blinds in one of the rooms. Laura agreed to address it for future guest.
Thank you Laura for keeping your place clean and welcoming.
This was the perfect little apartment for what we needed! Super clean, cozy, and perfect for couples. Carlos was great to communicate with and you can tell they put a lot of care into the apartment.
Thanks for hosting us, it was our first time in Chicago and we hope to be back again.  Location next to Target was great for quick meals/snacks.
clean space to spend few days. well equipped.  recommend if need to visit places near chicago.
This is a great place in a fantastic location. Kevin is a friendly, welcoming host and quick to respond to any issues that arose during our stay.

What a great place.  We had plenty of space to spread out from the back deck, the basement, living room and dining room.  Everything in the house was in good working order and the location was convenient to the beach.  Especially liked the fact that it was 1/2 block to the train and there were two Divy bike stations within a block.  We'll definetly be back again.

Marc’s airbnb is such a steal! The apartment was beautifully decorated, comfortable and clean. Marc was a friendly host who went above and beyond to make our stay a great one. Would highly recommend this airbnb as a perfect home away from home in the city!

The apartment is charming, stylish and comfortable. And so quiet! (I’m a light sleeper and appreciated this.) It’s just as nice as the listing pictures. The host was super responsive and helpful: let us check in early after an early-morning flight, and was quick to respond to minor issues that came up. Andersonville is a quiet and appealing neighborhood with fantastic bakeries (Lost Larsen, Loaves & Witches, The Coffee Studio), restaurants and shops. We walked a short way to the lake for some relief from the July heat wave Chicago was experiencing. A delightful stay!

Vas was responsive and proactive whenever we needed to be in touch. Check in was smooth and instructions were clear. Very helpful to have access to all the amenities of the apartment and it was all as described and clean. The neighbours were lovely as is the neighbourhood, I really felt at home there. Easy to get around and to get back to and close to Logan Park but set back enough to be private and quiet. The furniture is comfy and the bed was better (for me) than most hotel beds. The little turret is nice to hang out in too! Check out was just as easy and I honestly can’t find anything negative to say. Great place and great host!

Great location for visiting downtown Chicago and surrounding area. We were able to walk to Lincoln Park and there was a train station close by. The place was clean and stocked with what we needed. The only hiccup was that the parking permits were not in the condo on the night we arrived, but we contacted Kevin and were able to get them that night.
A cool stay!!!
Caryl的房子很漂亮，房间干净整洁舒适，我在这里很愉快。附近有餐厅和超市，生活也很方便。
Erica was so friendly and the room was so comfortable!
Host was very good at communicating! Great place!
Great location with easy access to the city. Great space for 9 of us. The pool table was a treat for the kids. Space is functional and satisfied our needs.
Hariharan was very responsive and proactive with messages and details. Parking was street parking but never too difficult to find a space. Very happy with this stay.
This was a great stay. The neighbors were quiet and the area felt very safe. The hosts were also very responsive.
What a great stay and a great place to catch a baseball game at Wrigley Field!

Overall excellent. Place was clean and well maintained. There were a couple of small issues, though nothing that would stop me from staying there again. The doorknob on the hallway bathroom was loose, and could come off, but we could push it back together and it worked. Also, the light in the other bathroom would not turn off (seemed to be an issue in the switch). That wasn’t a big deal either, just kept the door closed at night. More of an issue for the hosts electric bill.
Plenty of food in walking distance, and Wrigley Field is just over a mile away, so walkable if the weather is decent.
It was an amazing stay! Everything was great and wonderful. I hope I can stay here for the rest of my stay in Chicago.
I felt so lucky to find this place. It’s clean, well located and a great value. Thank You!
Place was great, and the location was awesome!
Great stay! As described, & nice and clean.

Nearly 100 degree days...amazing to have a beautiful pool to enjoy.  We loved a lot about Damian's home including the location to restaurants and nightlife, pool, movie theater projector and unique use of space.  The home has been updated, but it does lack the "fit and finish" we would expect for the money spent.  The listing was accurate, but the home was a little underwhelming.  We would consider the home again if the price were lower or the home was further upgraded.  If the value was better, we would have considered 5 stars

Disfrutamos mucho cada espacio de la casa. Se adapto perfectamente a nuestras necesidades en cuanto a capacidad, ubicación y lugares de estacionamiento.
Nos encanto el buen gusto en la decoración, lo cómodo y acogedor de cada ambiente, lo que hizo nuestra estancia aun más agradable.
Muchas gracias Lina, por tu hospitalidad. Esperamos volver pronto!

Good location, easy to get to public transportation and get anywhere in the city. Bedrooms are cozy but do feel a little tight with beds right up against the wall. I have small kids and the space isn’t super conducive to children, so would probably find somewhere else if a came back to the city with my family, but overall, a good spot and worth the price.
Beautiful place. Very clean. Communication great.
Always clean and great location
Great location and responsive host
Love it!

First time in Chicago for my new bride, it was the perfect setting. We did so much in 4 days   we will be back next year and we will use the transit system which the bus stop and train station is very close. Should utilize that way more but overall great experience thank you Joyce.
Great experience all around, highly recommend!
great stay !! quiet and peaceful location. enough space for two people, lots of character in the home which made it very enjoyable!
James was friendly, responsive, and proactive throughout our stay.  His place was comfortable and spacious, with high end amenities.  We had a wonderful time there!
Shay is very sweet and accommodating. Her space is absolutely gorgeous!!! We loved the amenities and the walkable community! I can’t wait to come back to Chicago.

Highly recommend Daniel and his place. The unit is VERY clean and comfortable. Daniel is very responsive and provides detailed information prior to checkin. It’s on a beautiful Chicago street with free parking. We had no issues finding a spot during our stay. The neighborhood has lots of great restaurants nearby so we chose to walk or use transit most of our short trip. We hope to stay here again!

We had a great stay!! It was a work trip and the living room allowed us to all sit and have a team meeting. We used an hdmi cable to present on the tv and it was perfect.  The beds were so comfortable and they helped us with our bag drop off since we got in early and let us add late check out to our stay for a little extra. They were quick at responding to any questions. There’s a nice park across the street and coffee shop around the corner. It was 96 degrees outside and the house stayed cool, even upstairs.

Our stay here was nothing short of wonderful! First the rental is beautiful! So is the location! It is a prime location for whatever you want to do and there was easy access to everything. Plenty of clean towels, bedding smelled fresh and clean, shampoos and conditioners provided, kitchen was stocked with everything you need, rental was spotless and it smelled amazing. FYI the mattress is firm (I am a soft mattress sleeper) but not uncomfortable and the pillows were suuuuuper comfy!
Beforehand Celiane sent a welcome packet that was so thorough and helpful for finding the rental and for our stay. We were interested in staying another night and Celiane was able to accommodate us for that. Highly recommend this property and hoping to stay here again in the future! Excellent host. Thank you!

A really nice and clean space, accommodated our family of 4 perfectly. They had a pack n play and bunk beds. Spacious enough that the late sleepers weren’t bothered by early risers. Amazing location. Thank you for having us.
Amazing place to stay steps away from Wrigleyville! Stayed for a couple nights and absolutely loved it here! Very Clean!
Great location for visiting the Skydeck and museums. Clean and a good price compared to others in surrounding area. Parking included was a +.

We loved our stay at this lovely Airbnb in Chicago! The apartment is spacious, bright, and beautifully maintained. We especially enjoyed the kitchen peninsula, where we had several meals when we weren't eating out. It would have been nice to have a few basic cooking essentials like salt, pepper, and cooking oil, as those are commonly provided in Airbnbs.
The living room was one of our favorite spaces, with a huge TV and an incredibly comfortable sofa. A coffee table would make it even more functional. The bedroom was comfortable overall, although the pillows could be improved, and the closet could use a little more attention and a few shelves. The bathroom was bright, well-equipped, and stocked with plenty of towels.
The hosts were outstanding—friendly, attentive, responsive, and incredibly accommodating. They kindly allowed an early check-in and even let me park in the garage, although my reservation didn't include a parking space. We LOVED them! We'd definitely stay here again!

Hi stop scrolling, this listing and the house was beyond amazing. We had issues soon as we arrived  to Chicago and the other Airbnb was a mess up. However we contacted the host and she accepted us immediately as we were in the city. She even checked on us to make sure we were ok 🥹 some things is just priceless like a clean house, clean sheets and more than enough beds for a family of 4. If you reading the reviews to see what you should pick, I’m very ocd and personally the garage the apartment to the host was amazing. Thank you again for stepping in and helping us some host deserve more than just a review❤️ btw we was 5-20 min away from everything even downtown activities.

We enjoyed our stay and would happily book here again. The studio was as described—clean, modern, compact yet comfortable, and thoughtfully laid out with almost everything we needed for our trip. Just note - no hot plate.
One of the biggest highlights is the location. It’s in a quiet area yet convenient, easy to get almost anywhere. We were able to quickly reach downtown, Chinatown, museums, the lakefront, restaurants, grocery stores, and public transit without any hassle. It made exploring Chicago so much easier.
Check-in was seamless, communication with the host was excellent, and the space felt welcoming from the moment we arrived. The bed was comfortable, the apartment was well-maintained, and it was a great place to relax after long days of sightseeing.
If you’re looking for a clean, comfortable home base with access to many of Chicago’s best attractions, this is a fantastic choice. Highly recommended!
Great space and rooftop
The house was beautiful and close to so many things. Erica was such a friendly and responsive host. I will definitely be back! 😊
As described. Simple and easy
beautiful little home in a walkable neighborhood! easy to get to everything whether by car or train. sharon answered instantly to any questions we had and made our trip so much easier. thank you :)!

Josh’s place was spacious and in a good location for accessibility to Southport shopping and wrigley. During a heat wave it was ice cold inside which provided a nice respite after being in the heat. Plenty of space for our large family gathering.
A great walkable neighborhood and a nice cozy home.

Our stay felt familiar in a small town midwest kind of way. The neighbors are all very nice, and it is a fairly quiet neighborhood. Being able to bring our cats along with us was a huge selling point, it feels like we got way more than we paid for. The access to Northwest Indiana (as well as Chicago) means it is a very convenient place to stay if you have a car for transportation but also want to be slightly removed from the action of your day.
It's not a luxury hotel, but if you want all the comforts of home and an affordable, pet-friendly stay, with a highly knowledgeable and communicative host, then Richard's place is the right choice.
Excelente estancia.  Buenas comunicación.  muy limpio y completo

It was the perfect place for me and my friends on out 3 day vacation, had plenty of space, more than enough to do and was in a good area for our plans. The kitchen and bathroom are great and in very good condition. The amenities listed were all there and very helpful to us, the towels in the bathroom were very helpful, the washing machine and dryer were a big help. This place is a great stay with great hosts and great environment.

This was far and away the best "downtown" Air BNB I've stayed in. The apartment was perfect and the process was easy. The neighborhood is adorable and there is so much to do in just a few blocks. Public transport is convenient, but I barely did any tourist things because there was so much nearby.
Iris was a great, responsive host and everything was clean and pleasant to the eye. Highly recomended!
Great location, great beds, nice decor, central AC was fabulous during the heat dome.
Awesome location! Very responsive to questions and anticipating needs. So many coffee options provided - much appreciated.
A great couple days stay, apartment stayed incredibly nice and cool during temps nearing triple digits!
I really enjoyed my stay the home was great, very spacious, clean and the neighborhood was peaceful.
Beautiful apartment in a great area!

We had a great time staying at this apartment and I would highly recommend it! It was clean and quiet. Had all the extras we needed like coffee pods and laundry detergent. We enjoyed using the pool and gym. The closest bus stop and parking lot were both a short walk from the apartment.
Perfect location for downtown access with cheap Uber and public transport nearby. Very nice neighbourhood, house was extremely clean and had everything we needed. Would highly recommend
Perfect spot, clean and comfy!

Staying at The Plymouth Chicago was an absolute highlight of our trip. The space was stunning — beautifully designed with thoughtful details that made it feel both luxurious and homey. Everything was spotlessly clean upon arrival, and the listing photos were a perfect match to the real thing.
Check-in was a breeze. The instructions were crystal clear and everything worked exactly as described. The location is fantastic — right in the heart of Chicago with easy access to great restaurants, public transit, and top attractions.
Communication with the host was exceptional. Responses were quick, friendly, and proactively helpful. We felt completely taken care of throughout the entire stay.
For the quality and location, the value was outstanding. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend The Plymouth Chicago to anyone visiting the city!

When we booked the home we asked the host for an early check-in. While this is limited on what they can generally accommodate they were able to help us out a bit. They also recommended a luggage storage place across the street which worked out great.
We had a few hiccups with our stay but the host was quick to respond and offer a remedy which I really appreciated.
The downside was the building was under some renovations and only one elevator was working. We also didn’t have access to the rooftop lounge.
However we still had use of the pool which was a bonus.
Overall it was a lovely stay. The location was right in the heart of the city and walkable to so many great options for shopping and dining.
I also read previous views about the noise. We truly had no issues at all. We are not used to city noises and were unbothered. The train that runs nearby is like a white noise. We didn’t even need the earplugs and I’m a light sleeper.

Dennis is a wonderful host, this was our second stay at his place. It's a great location in one of Chicago's more fun areas and convenient to transit. The place is very clean, nice kitchen and features a wonderful little balcony for morning coffee off the living room! Would highly recommend to anyone!
Family trip: walkable area, clean, parking spot, and warm home. Would book again.

My needs were simple. I stayed in a room with a bed, small desk and window AC.  I had no need of the kitchen, except for the fridge.  The common room was not air conditioned, and it was HOT the week I was there so when I needed to get on the computer I stayed in my room. Plenty of places to eat down the block. Very quiet.  I only saw one other person.  The room was not elegant, but quite functional.  Good Stay
We have had multiple stays with cloud nine and they are always great to work with. Places are always clean and never any complaints!

Our family of 5 had a great stay at Rasheed's place!  The location is fantasic - walkable to the Division street entrance to the lake, Old Town, and Magnificent mile.  There are plenty of great cafe's, bars, and restaurants nearby.  We had plenty of space at Rasheed's place and we felt right at home during our month long stay.  Thanks again!

I think when I originally booked this Airbnb, I didn’t realize it was its own private apartment within the home. It was very private and quiet. Also we were in Chicago during the little heatwave and it was perfectly cold when we got back to sleep every night.
It’s in a very beautiful neighborhood and it was very easy to get around to other neighborhoods to explore.
I would highly recommend Gabrielle’s space!

This is the second time I have stayed here during my time in Chicago. Absolutely recommend it! The neighborhood is amazing, and walkable to downtown and the West Loop area. The host always responds quickly and answers any potential questions. Had a lovely time!

I enjoyed my stay here. Air B and B was nice. I was mistakenly told my dog had come to this place when I had told them in advance the dog had…claimed the dog damaged stuff when it did not. Claims there is a $50 fee if a dog or pet damages things. The host should probably mention this in the listing instead of waiting to tell me at the last minute…anyway that aside I enjoyed my stay and the home was lovely, and easy to get into and I’d recommend it for people in the Chicago area.
This was a very comfortable and clean room in a great location.

Incredible host and home alike. This place has all the things listed and more! Whether a romantic getaway for couples or for a family trip, this is the place. Close enough to the city yet peacefully tucked into a quiet residential neighborhood- easy to access by both car and train. Definitely would recommend to anyone and everyone!
Great Place! Great Host!
The stay was excellent and the location was great! Would definitely stay here again.
We had a great night at Jonathan’s house. He is a really good person and taking care of us. We are really appreciate that.

Russ is a great host. The neighborhood had an electrical surge and everything went out - we couldn’t get bedroom plugs back online - Russ came right over and fixed the issue.
Friendly, responsive host is always a huge plus - thx Russ for providing us a great place to stay and making our adventure that much better!!
Comfortable apartment within minutes of major Chicago neighborhoods
Really nice little house in a cool neighborhood. Surrounded by small markets and shops.

Glenn and Laura were amazing hosts, the room was beautiful and clean, and the home was perfect for every one of our needs. We definitely recommend this place for everyone, as it is close to the blue line, cozy, and private. The hosts are very attentive and welcoming, and their dogs nice and calm.

Overall my partner and I enjoyed the stay, it was clean, just as pictured, and perfect for what we needed. We had a small issue with check in but Roberto was responsive and we were able to check in quickly and with ease. Overall a delightful stay.

We had a wonderful stay! We were a family of 10, and the apartment was perfect for our group. The rooms are spacious, the kitchen is well equipped, and everything was clean and exactly as shown in the photos.
The location couldn't be better. It's in a very quiet neighborhood, yet it's incredibly convenient. The bus stop right across the street takes you directly to Navy Pier, and the Green Line is just a short walk away, making it very easy to get around Chicago.
We also appreciated the thoughtful touches when we arrived, including fresh towels and a small welcome kit with basic toiletries. It made us feel right at home.
Communication was excellent throughout our stay. The hosts were always quick to respond, friendly, and helpful. We didn't have a single issue during our visit.
Overall, we had a fantastic stay and would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. We'd be happy to stay here again!

Great location for going to a Cubs game, literally just walk across the street.
Josh was very professional and communicative.
AC worked great, even with extreme heat outside.
One bathroom for 5 of us was tight, but manageable.
Would recommend both the host and location.
El departamento es muy agradable, cómodo y está totalmente equipado. El barrio está un poco alejado del centro (The Loop) pero es muy tranquilo y simpático (especialmente de día).

Aaron’s place was very accurate and looked just the like pictures. For me the neighborhood was like most neighborhoods in Chicago. It was very clean and had a homey feel to it so I think anyone would be comfortable staying here. I would book again!

The place was exactly how they described it and what it was in the pictures. He was very accommodating and helpful with any questions that we had. It got so hot while we were there that the lock stopped working and within minutes of me messaging him he responded and had an answer to the problem for us. Would def stay again if in that area

I love this place, the host was really responsive. the size was just right for me and my partner and I like how the blue line is literally around the corner if you wanna go do some things downtown. Definitely wouldn't mind coming back
Super nice place to stay, good walking distance from a lot of places
Worth the price.

We loved our stay in Wrigleyville! The apartment was just as stunning as the photos. Being able to park in the private garage and then walk anywhere we needed (especially to Wrigley!) was the icing on top of the cake. We will be back!

The property is nice and the hosts are incredibly attentive, quickly fixing a check-in glitch, replacing a broken iron overnight, and promising to fix the master bathroom fan after we checked out. The kitchen is missing oven pans, but a grocery store is conveniently located next door to buy foil. Unfortunately, sleep was a major issue in the back bedroom. Gym noise from next door—loud thuds, talking, jumping, boxing, and wall vibrations—lasted until 1 AM. We had to relocate to the front bedroom. The master bedroom was much quieter, but the back room is tough for light sleepers.

Location could not be beat. The parking spot was a definite plus…but it is a bit tight getting in and out for larger vehicles. We had a minivan and were able to make it work, but it was tight.  Lots of great coffee shops within a block or two. Walking distance to magnificent mile and the subway stations.  The apartment was as described and lots of windows. It was a bit loud, but that is to be expected in that location. We would stay there again.
Loved our stay!
Lovely place in a strategic location. Troy was responsive to all my questions. Would definitely recommend to a friend!

We had a wonderful stay in Bridget’s place! The host has done an amazing job with the interior; it’s thoughtfully designed and feels welcoming. They went above and beyond to make sure guests had everything they could possibly need during their stay, including thoughtful touches for our dog, which we really appreciated. The home was spotless and very well organized.
Amazing place with an amazing view!  Appreciate all the great communication.
My family and I had a great experience staying here during a trip for a family wedding. It was a much nicer experience than staying in a hotel downtown!
Had a great stay at this place! We loved that it was walkable to Wrigley Field.

This was an easy in and out in a great location close to the train. Be prepared for the train sounds and the sun to shine in early. The bedroom setup was flexible and great for our family and both bathrooms are accessible through the main living space.
If you’re looking for somewhere to stay in the Ravenswood / Lincoln Square area this is your place. Cozy, easy access to transit or parking.

As described in the Airbnb listing, the home was extraordinarily spacious. It was beautifully decorated with everything we needed.
The neighborhood was beautiful. The parking garage was super nice to have. Brandon and his team were highly responsive when we had questions. We would definitely come back to this home.
Good place. Straight shot from downtown, decorated nicely.
Communicative host. Great space. Comfortable. Well worth it.
Beau was a responsive and helpful host. The apartment was clean and nicely furnished.
Thank you for having us! Beautiful space.
Perfect place to stay if in town for a cubs game!

The perfect location to see a Cubs game. Walk out of gate 3, cross the street and you’re home! Jessica is a great host and went out of her way to make the place feel like home! All the little extras, she really has thought of everything! Next time we’re in Chicago we will be back!

Excellent stay at Demitris apartment in Lincoln Park. Took Brown line from Union Station to Western and walked quickly to unit with luggage. Had awesome time and can't wait to stay here again. Amazing location in the city of Chicago and a great 5+ star airbnb experience.

Very cute place to stay in Bucktown. As an animal lover I was absolutely thrilled being greeted by extremely friendly chickens and Fluffy the cat. (I met Fred later). The space was spotless and as described. You are on the lower level of the house that is quite close to the Blue Line so expect to hear the occasional train go by or the hum of laundry. Nothing major. Also be prepared to carry your luggage over the walkway as the chickens do their business there. If you are driving, Jeanette will provide you with daily permits to park in the neighborhood. Nice touch. Thank you!
We love our stay at the place. Location is great! Close to grocery store, cvs, and public transportations. Very welcoming and accommodating host! Would recommend!

We loved staying here! Lots of room for our family to relax especially after our toddler went to bed. Very walkable to the train and many places to eat/drink! The furniture in the main space was very old and stained. The kitchen faucet kept coming off as well and there was no filtered water offered in the home as the fridge water was not working. Overall a great spot to stay
Jamie’s place is located in a great neighborhood! We enjoyed our time.
El sitio fue demasiado agradable, todo se encontraba tal cual la decisión sin duda volveríamos.
Everything was perfect! Thank you Melissa

I enjoyed my stay at Jason's place.  It was clean and well-stocked.   Communication was great and I appreciated the welcome bag and note.  It's in a good location with shops, restaurants and the Brown Line station nearby.

The neighborhood is not safe at night but during the daytime it’s okay to walk around. The train stop is right outside the house making it easy to commute. If you plan to return late at night etc. I probably wouldn’t stay here. The place was beautiful just not the best location.
Great stay!
Would definitely go back!

Brandon and his team have a wonderful condominium. The location is safe and walkable. The team is very responsive and helpful. The instructions were clear. We loved the city of Chicago. Thanks to their team for amazing accommodations. We appreciate it.
This was our third time staying here and as always it was great.

We were a group of 6, and wanted 6 bedrooms in a great location. That is typically hard to find, but this home was the perfect match. Very clean, comfortable beds, and great neighborhood. The house worked for us perfectly,.. great spaces to hang out, as well as enough space to get some private time,..
2 full kitchens is a plus, and the basement has fun games to entertain you!

We had an excellent stay at Emily's place. It is in a great area of the Wicker Park neighborhood. Convenient and easily walkable to coffee shops, restaurants, Target, and the train station.
Check in was easy, and the place was clean and updated. It's a great space for families. They had lots of games and things in the living room. The AC worked well, which was nice and refreshing during a very hot and humid fews days that we stayed.
Great location for going to Wrigley.

Location, location, location. There's a reason this is a top neighborhood in Chicago - from restaurants to bars to shopping to the lake to Second City comedy, everything is walkable. The street itself is full of charming older row homes and condominiums, and it's well worth walking the path at the lake (goes for miles). There's a beach right where you access it, super close to this home.
The home itself is one giant great room and then a bunch of bedrooms. The primary bedroom is on the floor of the great room, and the rest are in the basement, which has no windows except for in the one bedroom that faces the street. The bedrooms have glass walls between them, but there are curtains on both sides so you can't see between them. You can tell the building was built for something else, but it works fine as an AirBnB. One other funky thing is there weren't many outlets around the dining room table, so bring some extension cords if you want to have a lot of computers on it (as we did).
