VERY CLEAN! Michael provides a great space close to Wrigley. Even supplies water, coffee and snacks! We had to park behind the building as no street parking was available but honestly, I think I preferred that. Felt safer and just a minute walk around to the front door. Wrigley is literally a block away. Michael will provide you information of all the area attractions and restaurants!

Fantastic, beautiful neighborhood, everything you could need is close by and walkable.  The apartment is spacious and clean, with plenty of hot water in the shower.  I traveled to Chicago during a brutal heat wave, but the a/c and the ceiling fans kept the apartment very comfortable.  Excellent location and value, I'd like to stay there again.
Great spot next to the train. Easy to park across the street. Walking distance to the bean or field museum or the river.

We had a great stay overall. The host was friendly, responsive, and did an excellent job keeping in touch throughout our trip. They replied quickly whenever we had a question, which made everything easy and stress-free.
The air conditioning worked great, which was especially appreciated during the warm weather, and the neighborhood was quiet, safe, and a nice place to stay. We’d definitely recommend this Airbnb to others and appreciate the host’s hospitality. Thank you for a great experience!
We chose this Airbnb last second after we had a negative experience at a different Airbnb and this one was a breath of fresh air! Very clean, cozy, and pleasant experience overall!

Great unit, parking, and location.
However, to no fault of the owner, the neighbor upstairs is quite a social gamer until at least midnight if not later in the weekend. His room is directly above ours and there’s pretty much no sound insulation between the floors so he sounds like he’s literally in the same room with us squealing with delight of his gaming conquests. Fortunately, our kids were in the other bedroom.
The couch is also way too small for a unit this size. I’d recommend if you only need one bedroom for sleeping.
A fantastic place to stay. Perfectly located and appointed. Appreciated being in such a lovely walkable area and so close to the blue line. A perfect Airbnb experience.

1. The apartment is conveniently located near grocery stores such as Whole Foods and Mariano's.
2. Cloud Gate, Millennium Park, the Art Institute of Chicago (my favorite entrance is on Columbus Drive), and the Field Museum are all within easy walking or biking distance.
3. CTA public transportation is very convenient and easy to use.
4. Although there is a railway across from the apartment, the earplugs provided by the host effectively solved the noise issue.
Stayed here with my 10 year old some for 2 days while visiting friends. Place was perfect for us and we enjoyed it.

Another great stay at this property. My family always loves this spot because it’s close to everything for tourists. It’s becoming a bit of a tradition to come to Chicago every few years. Happy to stay at a place that’s is private secure well maintained and very organized. Has all the things you need like you were at home. Thanks Tony and team. Hope to be back soon.
The location worked well for my trip. The A/C was worked well and was a life savior in the brutal heat.

The property is conveniently located, with most Chicago attractions about a 15-30 minutes drive away. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful at night, making it a pleasant place to stay.
The home felt a bit compact for a group of 8 or more people. Also, while the listing includes two bathrooms, it may be more accurate to consider it as 1.5 bathrooms, as the second bathroom is quite small and may not be comfortable for regular use.
If you’re traveling with a larger vehicle, keep in mind that our 12-passenger van did not fit in the garage, so parking may require some planning.
One thing to keep in mind is that a taxi driver mentioned the area may not be very safe late at night, so it would be wise to avoid being out in the neighborhood after dark. Overall, the stay was comfortable, but these points may be helpful for future guests.

So happy we found this place! SUPER clean home in a lovely area with shops and restaurants a block away and Wrigley Field an easily walkable distance. The train is a few doors down and is heard when it goes by but after the first few times it’s really not noticed and did not disturb us when sleeping at all. Would definitely stay here again!
Place was great and Rida was an amazing Host!
We loved our stay in Chicago! We were always able to find parking very close to the door. The house was clean and had plenty of sleeping options for our family of 6. Freddy was a great host!
Wonderful host!  Very helpful suggestions. Quick with a response if we had questions. Perfect place to stay and enjoy Chicago and the surrounding area.

The location with a closed garage makes this place an actual winner. My family really enjoyed the stay here. The host were very prompt with any questions. The apartment was exactly as in photos. I would strongly recommend this place for anyone looking to come to Chicago!

We had a great stay at Nestor’s place. The location was excellent—close to downtown and many of Chicago’s top attractions—and the designated parking spot was a HUGE BONUS. Nestor was an outstanding host, always responding quickly and addressing any questions or concerns right away.
We visited during an extreme heat wave with temperatures over 100°F, and Nestor made sure the home was cool and comfortable by running the A/C before our arrival. Having a separate A/C unit in each room was especially helpful. Overall, the stay was comfortable, convenient, and hassle-free. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend Nestor as a host.
Had such a wonderful stay; such a beautiful apartment!
Apartamento bien ubicado en la av michigan, facil de entrar, las camas pequeñas pero estaba bien para el grupo de 5 que visitamos chicago. No tuvimos ninguna sorpresa

Such a great place to stay! Easy to find..about 35-40 min to get to milenial park realistically. Quiet neighborhood with a good bit to do locally. The parking spot was extremely tight and blocked a bit while some of the houses were being worked on but hey..it worked out!

We had a fantastic stay! The location to Wrigley Field was hands down the best—you truly can't beat it if you're in town for a Cubs game or a Wrigley tour.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and the perfect size for our family of four. Our host was also incredibly accommodating and let us stay a few extra minutes on our last morning so we didn't have to drag our luggage to our Wrigley tour, which we really appreciated.
We arrived before check-in and used Stash-It to store our luggage. It was extremely convenient—they even sent us a photo once our bags were safely inside the apartment and ready for us. We highly recommend using their service if you arrive early.
Overall, this was a 10/10 stay, and we'd absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting for Cubs games or to experience Wrigley Field!
We had a great time! My family loved the location and any time we had questions, the Taims team was very helpful and friendly!

Great location, clean, and felt very safe. Unfortunately, the host was a nightmare to deal with. He tried to charge us a ridiculous $450 fee for a standard plumbing maintenance issue that we had nothing to do with. He is argumentative, hard to communicate with, and quick to blame guests for things out of their control. The house is nice, but dealing with the host'(s) terrible attitude isn't worth the headache.
Nice place for visiting tourist attractions in Chicago / living-room very small

George is an incredible host that goes above and beyond.
The space is tidy, simple, and in a perfect location. Close to the train, Dil Pickle Grocery, and all Logan Square has to offer.

Host was very polite, but not the most responsive to issues. This listing is a closed off/finished basement, which was a bit small for the price that is being asked. Other than that the location is convenient!
This was the perfect place for my granddaughter and me to spend a week together enjoying Chicago.  It was beautiful, safe, clean, and really close to public transportation.  We loved it.

Great spot in the heart of River North!  Geo was super responsive and the spot was perfect.  The Riverwalk is just a couple blocks away, lots to do and a very lively nightlife right nearby.  Definitely recommend!

The neighborhood and the house were great.  The house was very clean and the supplies (e.g., soaps, paper, tp, towels) were generous compared to many other places we've been to.  The only issue we had is with the central AC which is not adequate for the size of this house during 90F+ temperatures.  We had 2 rough nights that were difficult due to the overheated house but eventually window units were installed and the rooms felt great.  Unfortunately the rest of the house was hard to enjoy due to the heat.  We would recommend this place anytime in the fall, winter, and spring but in the summer if there is a heat wave/dome like the one this year, it will not be enjoyable.  Otherwise great location overall.
It was a great stay I’m used to staying in environments that have loud outside surroundings so I felt very at home
Michelle’s place was great and perfect for our stay! Easy to walk, accessible to buses to go into the city or a 15min drive, great restaurants and cafes!

This Airbnb was exceptionally clean. The apartment looked recently updated and was tastefully decorated. We ran into a few minor issues, but the management company responded quickly. The unit is in an older building, but it has a nice common area, gym, and roof deck. We loved that a parking spot was included (a few blocks away) and that it’s close to a subway station.
The unit also came stocked with baby items, which we appreciated even though we didn’t end up using them. One tip: the bedrooms get very bright in the morning, so bring blackout curtains if you want your kids to sleep in.
Nice spot. Great location

We just returned home from this beautiful studio apartment. We were in the city for a Cubs Game at Wrigley Field and there couldn’t be a better location for proximity to the park. Arlene was very prompt with any communications. The Studio was clean, comfortable and quiet given that it is in the middle of a lively neighborhood. We would certainly return without hesitation.
The apartment in Logan Square was perfect! Very comfortable, lots to walk to, and a lovely interior design. We had a great time!
Place was perfect for my stay.  Five stars.

The location in the West Loop was ideal- very walkable location. Spacious apartment a little dated especially in the city but great for groups. We had multiple issues but management company very attentive. Issues derailed over half day of trip which was unfortunate.

The neighborhood was quiet, the apartment was clean, and everything went smoothly. The host was friendly, responsive, and easy to communicate with. I would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to others.
Great neighborhood and close to the train for everything else.  Felt like home!
Perfect spot in Lincoln Park, parking on Fullerton was pretty easy and the place was very clean and nice and cool for the hot week!
Good location and had everything we needed
Great location, very nice property.  Hosts are extremely responsive.  Would definitely rent from them again.

everything is convenient. and clean.
We really enjoyed our stay. The property was exactly as described, check-in was smooth, and the host made everything feel simple and well-managed.
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay!

Enjoyed this house while visiting the Chicago area! Easy walk to utilize public transportation to get around.
House has plenty of space, for adults to talk and children to play. Fenced in backyard also! Had no issues and host was super responsive! Would book again if I’m in the area.

First, Kavin has been responsive - and won’t make you wait with replies. He sent clear instructions on how to find his place, including photos. He even shared specifics about parking lot. Next, Kavin’s place is exactly how his posted photos look like. It’s neat and chic. Minimalist and I like that. But all the things that you may need for your stay are made available. 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms are more than worth the amount I paid for. I would definitely recommend his place.

Thank you Shuang & Chai for a most beautiful space!
After traveling for 2 + weeks with our family of four (plus dog) it was a welcoming arrival to this Old Town charm. Easy parking, gracious hosts.
The first floor apartment was exactly as described— we never would have known that there were tenants upstairs- very quiet & peaceful. Communication was responsive & easy.
The home had all of the amenities and was very clean. Well-stocked kitchen (though with all of the restaurants within reach we didn’t utilize too much). Beds were comfortable. Home was curated with care—
I cannot say enough about the location— just blocks from the L train/Sedgwick, easy accessibility to everything. Morning walks with our dog through the tree-lined streets of Old Town, to the Concrete Beach & Neighboring Gold Coast was one of our favorite parts of the vacation. After a 3 week roadtrip, Parking our car and navigating the city by foot or by train was such a relief.
Grateful for every moment!
Very kind  and respectful , very easy instructions and a nice  place well kept !
This place was absolutely gorgeous.   We had fun on the scooters riding about downtown and China town.  Close to everything.
Great communication with the host. Perfect spot to catch a Cubs game without worrying about driving in and out.

An exemplary stay. Space was exactly as described- spacious, beautiful, and easy walking distance to both Andersonville proper and public transport into the City. No trouble finding parking within about a two block radius. Our host was so kind to make sure our favorite apps were loaded to the Apple TV. Shower water pressure was lovely. Would absolutely recommend for any length of stay and hope to visit again soon!
Muy bonita la casa y sobre todo muy limpio y tranquilo el lugar

Apartment was in a great location for what I had planned in the city and it is very walkable and close to public transit which was nice. It was the perfect space for two people who had lots of activities planned. As the description noted, it is close to the train tracks which are right out front and it does get loud. I am a light sleeper and was fine but watching tv or talking on the phone with a train coming you needed to pause because you wouldn’t be able to hear. The building provided luggage storage which was really nice after checkout, it allowed me to still explore the city without having to haul around carry-ons. I would stay in one of the hosts listings again, thank you!
Host was wonderful and did excellent to communicate. There were unexpected booms in the night that woke us up and very difficult to find parking. Other than that the experience was great.

First off I would like to say a big Thank you to our host Jhon. Our office was there on a training trip and his place was exactly what we needed. I was clean spacious and exactly what the picture and description said. Also Jhon always stand in contract whenever there was a question. We will look to be hosted again by Jhon if ever we have training in Chicago again. Again a big thank you to Jhon and we look forward to staying with you again in the future.

The owners seemed very nice. We saw them in passing a few times and they seemed friendly, but also gave us space. Mike was very responsive to messages and gave very clear instructions on finding the space. The house was kept very cool despite the heat wave. Having the ability to house my elderly dog who needed around the clock care so we could still have a little family trip with my daughter was very important, and I’m grateful for the space. There were a whole lot of towels but very few bed linens. The only extra blanket (that wasn’t the comforter) was very sour smelling and covered in hairs. The kitchen was functional enough but very random for cookware and dishes. I would definitely stay here again if I were traveling to Chicago with a pet, although I would pack more of my own linens and kitchenware. Although I didn’t need them, it was nice that the house was supplied with a small pet cage, dog bowl, and couch covers. I recommend checking out Cafe Mas around the corner.
Great place, responsive and professional host
clean modern and fun!

Zheng was a great host, very responsive
Place was clean and the area was easy to get around and metro station was very close

Overall, we had a good stay. The apartment is in a lovely building close to the lakefront and about a 15-minute taxi ride from downtown Chicago. It was spacious, clean, and comfortable for 2 adults and a 17-year-old.
A few details could have made our stay better. There were no clear apartment instructions, so we had to ask where the laundry room was. We found it, but there was no detergent either in the apartment or the laundry room. For a short 2–3 day stay, buying a large package is inconvenient, so we ended up not doing laundry.
The apartment was also quite warm during the 30°C+ weather: one room had no air conditioning, while another unit was noisy. We asked for extra bedding and simple sheets to sleep under because of the heat, but unfortunately none were available.
We were also initially asked to collect the keys from another location, which was unexpected, although the host later kindly arranged delivery to the apartment.
Pleasant stay, but a few details could be improved.

This was the perfect location.  It is just a two minute walk to Wrigley Field and L station, and ten minute walk to Target.  Apartment was super clean and hosts responded to questions really quickly.  I will definitely be back!
Great stay

This was the most beautiful stay I have ever had. As a solo traveller I felt safe, respected and at home. Not only was Bernard an amazing and gracious host but the area was beautiful. His presence was welcome in the home.
Whenever I return to Chicago I will be staying here.

An absolute must when visiting Chicago! A beautiful space, with kind, responsive hosts! It’s truly everything you could want in your stay. Location is perfect in Little Italy, walking distance to incredible bars, shops and restaurants. The apartment is immaculate and has everything you could ever need. Emma, the host, was immediately responsive and was the absolute best! Cannot recommend enough!

The apartment complex was nice - it felt secure and was quiet. Wonderful location - near Whole Foods and multiple restaurants and shops - felt pleasant and safe. The apartment was nice and comfortable and being able to pay for parking in the building was a great perk. Quick and friendly communication by host. Thanks for a great stay!
The location was fabulous. Few blocks from Wrigley Field which was our main purpose. Apt. Very clean. Host very responsive. Only issue was with the lighting.  Otherwise, great place to stay!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We found the location very convenient for a concert at northerly island on the first night and  a very short walk to the red line for a cubs game the 2nd day. I found the pictures accurate and a very comfortable stay for 2 couples. The host sent a link for discounted parking in the buildings garage which was greatly appreciated.

Great spot for an extended stay in Chicago. Used this place for an extended multi week work trip and it worked out well. Descriptions were accurate and while the style is older it did the trick. Full kitchen was helpful. Would definitely stay again if needed a spot for an extended stay.
We were very pleased with our stay at this AirBNB.

I stayed here for 5 days , I met some other guests staying there , they were very friendly and made my stay worth it . I didn’t like the cleanliness of the room itself my walls were extremely dirty and that made me uncomfortable . I reached out to host and told her about my complaint and she responded that my room was clean and said her cleaners sent her pictures and left it at that . I didn’t feel like it was clean nor sanitize and there’s a difference between the two . I end up cleaning my room entirely with Clorox wipes walls and all  and smell good spray to meet my needs . It is a shared house so if the people that are staying there don’t clean after themselves the place will remain dirty . The area itself is walkable to UC Medical Hospital and the grocery store was a 5 minute walk , so I enjoyed being able to be close to things . But it could’ve been a lot cleaner for me .

David was a great host. Responded quickly and attentive to our needs. We arrived early at O'Hare and he allowed us to drop our bags off before check in, which was so incredibly help with our family of 5. Would stay again.

Nathaniel's place was very beautiful. Everything was exactly the way it was described in the advertisement. Place was spotless and very inviting. Our party included 4 adults and one child, slept very comfortably. Off-street parking was convenient and easy with the pass provided by Nathaniel. I highly recommend this listing, and we will stay at Nathaniel's place when we visit Chicago again.

It was supper convenient to McCormick place. It said it had parking that you could pay for daily but they didn’t. Said lots were full and didn’t offer other places to go. Took awhile to get answers about parking. Only thing I thought was weird they didn’t have dish towels. And only two washcloths. But they did bring more washcloths. Overall it was fine the location was well worth it. Could have been a little cleaner. But beds were very comfortable.
A great stay. Super comfortable and safe feeling.

Jason is nothing short of amazing. His communication is out of this world. I hope we are able to find him in the future as a host and I can’t express enough good about him.
As for the place it’s exactly what is pictured. The patio views are great and fun for a small group. Can’t wait to stay again in the future. #1 option in our future stays!
Thank you Jason for allowing us to stay and making it the best! Go cubs!

Location is everything and this unit is in the heart of beautiful Gold Coast, close to all the hot spots and the absolute best shopping. If I could have given my over-all stay 4.5 stars, I would. Communication was immediate via a digital assistant, entry instructions were precisely detailed. This pristinely clean unit has soaring ceilings, brand new everything, top notch linens, large screen tvs, etc. But to call it "designer decorated" is a huge stretch. The furnishings are the lowest end Wafair finds imaginable, tacky little Target pillow, framed posters with kitchy Chicago themes images, curtains that are falling off the ill-fitting rods. I was excited to prepare a simple meal in the adorable kitcken BUT when I messaged the host to please deliver a can opener, the immediate response was "we do not provide can openers." In my judgement, this is basic, but the digital assistant did not agree. That said, when I asked for an additional blanket, it appeared in a magical moment.

We had a great stay here! Everything was as described/exactly like the photos, and very clean. Labeled drawers and cabinets were super helpful in the kitchen. Laura was very welcoming and friendly, and very responsive. The neighborhood was quiet and felt safe, with easy, free street parking. Would stay here again!

The location was great but that’s it!  The beset way to describe this place is that it looks like someone’s grandmother lived there 60 years ago and nothing was changed. Broken slats on the shades, broken floor tiles, uneven floors, dirty area rugs and the towels smelled like moth balls
Really Enjoyed my stay. Came for a concert at the Salt Shed and it was like a 6min drive. Will definitely be booking this again when next I come to Chicago.
Appreciated the terrific AC and layout.
Angel is a great host, and we thoroughly enjoyed a months stay at this location

We stayed with our 18 month old and it was the perfect set up. Lots of space for all of us and close to everything we needed.
Perfect location, clean and spacious condo.  Great all around for a trip to Chicago.
Great stay in a great location! The bed was comfortable and the rooftop area had a great view of the skyline. Continental breakfast was a plus. Definitely would stay again if in the area.

loved my stay here in this charming historic building. amazing street to be on for first timer in chicago taking transit! super peaceful but busy just one block over with food and shopping and train station.
the house itself has everything you need, but not much more. you can tell the hosts care a lot about making sure you have a great experience!
we did have some crawlies appear during our last night of stay as it was quite hot out for several days, but not at the fault of the host. the unit is on the third floor so much better than some ground level units i can imagine. just be aware if you have a bug fear!
the place is one bed, one bath, but has 2 living rooms and 2 tvs for easy hanging out. no crazy views but nice natural light. the window AC units really helped in the hot summer, we mainly stayed in the 2 rooms that have it installed. the place was perfect and enjoyable for my party of 2’s weeklong stay! felt so homey.

Stayed here for a week and the house was great, plenty of room for myself and my friends. Jackpaul was a great host and was always quick to respond and very helpful during our stay. Would highly recommend.

Affordable place to sleep & shower. 1-2 miles out of downtown loop. Not luxurious, building itself not secure, no need to enter code to access into building due to the lock being broken. Entrance/ lobby & escalator to apartment needs upkeeping of basic moping. The code for us to enter into the apartment was actually left displayed (for anyone to see) on the lock box (assuming this is where the key storage is for cleaners).  Personally, I would choose something more secure & up to date. It did suit basic needs, cost was affordable, you get what you pay for.

This place was very nice and spacious. I will say it seemed the place was cleaned a while ago and just left sitting. As I found spiders and cobwebs everywhere in the house. Also I felt like the air conditioning never really cooled the bedroom which is all the way towards the back of the unit. Seemed warmer in the back and cooler in the front. Overall great place I would stay again.
The apartment was great!  May have been the most comfortable bed we’ve slept on in the last ten years!

This was an awesome neighborhood with lots to do within easy walking distance. There are so many incredible restaurants within walking distance. The place is very nice and clean. It was a little warm and the AC units had a tough time but to be fair it’s in Chicago and we were there during a heat wave.
The place was nice, clean, and comfortable. Communication was great. Parking is on the streets, but not a big deal during the summer. Humboldt Park is right there and easy to walk to.

Ben was super responsive. We paid for parking but someone was parked in our spot. Ben got it taken care within 20 mins. Each room had adjustable thermostats so that was a big plus. One of the best things, the beds were all king and super comfortable! My 3 young adult children didn't complain once!
Although we didn't explore the neighborhood during our stay, we did walk to whole foods and felt super safe.
Jasmine was so genuinely helpful and super nice — really nice place. Very cozy and clean. 10/10
Walkable to lots of shops and restaurants. Spacious apartment. No parking options without paying, just fyi for those driving. Overall great place!
Great stay, stayed for 9 nights, great house. Clean, good communication, would do again

It was awesome staying here! It was so close to the stadium which is what we were all about. Lots of Cubs stuff, and the AC was highly necessary during the heat wave! The only thing to consider is there are people directly above you - it was a little hard during the night and early morning because it was quite loud above us so maybe bring ear plugs. Otherwise incredible stay!
Place is great! Perfect location, highly recommend
Friendly host, very walkable location  with lots of good restaurants near by. Trader Joe's and Jewel Osco are around the corner for groceries.

We had such a wonderful time during our stay! It's clear that this family cherishes their home. The neighborhood was so serene and convenient, with everything we needed just a short walk away. Being near downtown was a bonus. The host was very accommodating! Our experience was absolutely fantastic; we're already looking forward to returning.
Bagel Inn was great! Perfect location to get to Wrigley, downtown, and great restaurants.
Very nice place in a great location! We enjoyed it very much and would stay here again! Recommend it to anyone who is looking for central location, walkable and close to nice restaurants.

Loved everything about staying here with 5 adults.  The location is great-10 minute walk to the Lakefront Trail and about 3 minutes to Broadway and tons of cool eateries.  Also walked about 20 minutes to Wrigley Field.  Never took our car out of the garage, which is a huge bonus because street parking can be tough to find.  The apartment itself is huge.  There were 5 adults in our party but it could easily sleep 10-15.  Apartment had every amenity needed and then some.  We were there during a period of excessive heat warnings but the apartment stayed cool and comfortable the entire time.  I would absolutely stay here again and will be highly recommending it to my friends that are considering Chicago.  Thanks, Will, for being a great host and making Stone Mansion available to us.

I had a wonderful time with my partner in Chicago! This place was a great home away from home and had everything we needed. The de-humidifier was a LIFESAVER!! So many games, books, movies, and etc provided by the host!

If I could give zero stars, I would. Our stay turned into a complete nightmare when the toilet's flush mechanism broke at 3 AM, leaving the unit uninhabitable. When I reached out to the host, his only response was to ask if I had 'tried the plunger.' I should not have to deal with this bullshit to begin with. If it doesn't work, put a sign saying so. I told the host I would be checking in late, and he said it was fine.
Because we couldn't stay in a place without a working bathroom, my girlfriend and I had to pack up all our belongings in the middle of the night and scramble to find a nearby hotel out of pocket. To make a terrible situation worse, despite being forced out by their faulty plumbing, the host refused to issue a refund for the unused days of our reservation. It is incredibly frustrating to be left stranded, asked to do your own plumbing diagnostics, and then denied your money back. Do yourself a favor and book somewhere else.
Kamadi's place looks a whole lot nicer inside than outside. Very well decorated and excellent amenities. Kamadi was very responsive whenever we had a question. We would stay here again in the future.

So glad we chose this house for our recent family vacation. The place was exactly as expected from the description and we instantly felt at home. We traveled with our 3 kids and everyone had plenty of space, particularly with the playground right out back. The train was about a 10 minute walk, and we were able to commute into downtown each day to see the sights and then come back to make dinner and reset. I only wish we hadn’t been there during a heatwave so we could have spent more time outside on the deck. Would definitely recommend, particularly for families - everything was spotless and just what we needed.

The location was absolutely perfect. Any uber was so easy to get to this Airbnb. The rooftop was amazing. The place was super clean. The host was super responsive to any questions we had! Would highly recommend anyone looking for a place to stay at this location!!

The place is big and was comfortable for our family of 5. The place needs a little TLC to make it a perfect place for a family. We reported two issues and I got a response indicating they would get to me shortly but never heard from them. One was more of a safety issue (glad we did not have small kids) and the second did cause an inconvenience other than that we were only there to sleep as was out most of the day.
Couldn’t beat the location. Home was pretty aged, some electronics were hard to use but other than that the place was great.
all was fine
Nice place with great amenities, accurate info in listing

In all my Airbnb experiences, Eugene was THE best host I've ever stayed with. He was very responsive and even let me send a package to be delivered there. The house was very clean, perfectly set up for us and it really felt like home. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.  You will not be disappointed
Excellent Airbnb. Great location very easy to check in and out. It would be good if there was a washer and dryer. And, better internet service. I wasn’t able to watch soccer match (Fox).

This was our second stay at this apartment, and overall, it’s a great place to stay. Very easy to get inside, generally easy to find parking, great location near restaurants, shops, and parks, and space to spread out. My only complaint is that it could really use a deep cleaning and some home updates and maintenance to make it more comfortable and functional for guests. The bathtub stop doesn’t work so it was tricky to give our child a bath. The bathroom sink didn’t seem to be properly cleaned before arrival. Some of the bedding had bleach stains. These things are necessarily deal breakers, and  I think would stay here again because of the location and amount of space, but if you’re particular about cleanliness, or require a bathtub for kids, it’s good to keep in mind.
Enjoyed our stay for a second time in 3 months! Definitely our go to place!

Great hosts and location. The apartment is bigger than the pictures look and was very comfortable. You don’t have access to the temperature controls, but John was very responsive to any adjustments to the temperature.

Overall the place was great, the host was very responsive & he also was able to accommodate me multiple times. Some reviews complained about the noise but I didn’t experience that, it was a typical noise level if you have upstairs neighbors. I do however feel like the location it self was far from all the activities I had planned. But the neighborhood was nice quiet and safe.

Super nice place, easy parking . The place was very warm inside A/C wasn’t working properly so we brought a fan, Then found out the night before check out that the batteries needed replaced in the thermostat. Only had one pool stick the other was broke and also didn’t have chalk for sticks which was a bummer because we all enjoy pool. Also it took us over 15 minutes to get the lockbox opened in 96 degree heat. But I definitely can see myself booking again if all those things get resolved.

This Airbnb apartment is in a terrific downtown location with great views and has decent amenities (pool and gym). The host is welcoming & accommodating and she communicates quickly. This apartment is comfortable and nicely furnished. The kitchen is well stocked with gadgets & appliances, but the dryer broke during my month-long stay. It is superficially clean, but it could use a deep cleaning. There is black mold along the seams in the shower and an air vent in the kitchen is black as well. The cream-colored couch is badly stained, and I kept it covered with a throw blanket. With attention to these issues, this apartment would easily be a 5-star rental.
Carl & Denise were very hospitable. My stay was great and quiet!
Great location, easy access… just be prepared for the stairs :)

Shanna's place was so lovely and quiet! It was exactly what I was looking for. Great Neighborhood, parking was easy and free, bed was comfortable and she had some coffee ready to brew. I'll be back for sure!
Clean, spacious, nice and cool for the summer👍🏻

The place itself was beautiful however communicating with the host about a dripping water coming from the ceiling became difficult. The host was very disrespectful and didn’t understand how negotiating me and my husband are. The stay was nice , will never book with this Host again.
Spacious place! Had access to a patio, smart Tv, WiFi, and central air on a hot week in Chicago! Couldn’t have asked for a better place. Host are very responsive as well!

We loved staying here! The home was comfortable, clean, and conveniently located—about 15–20 minutes from just about everything we wanted to do.
A couple of things to keep in mind: we had a hard time getting Ubers, as several drivers canceled because they said the location was too far out. Also, guests can’t adjust the air conditioning. It wasn’t an issue for us since the temperature was comfortable throughout our stay, but it’s good to know in advance.
Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again the next time we’re in Chicago.

We had a fantastic stay at Margaret's garden apartment and would absolutely stay here again! From the time we booked through checkout, Margaret was an excellent host. Her communication was prompt and friendly, and she made the check-in process incredibly easy.
The apartment was spotless, well-maintained, bright (especially for a garden unit) and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. The location is in a wonderful, walkable neighborhood with great restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, Oz Park, and Lincoln Park Zoo all just a short walk away. Having a dedicated parking space included was also a huge plus and made our trip even more convenient.
This is an especially great rental for families with young children. Margaret has thoughtfully stocked the apartment with toys, a Pack 'n Play, children's utensils, and even a stroller, which was such a nice touch. The only thing to note is that th
Great communication.  Nice place. Needs black out curtains. Bathroom is small. Main building common areas  need to be refreshed.
Well equipped and attractive apartment in a central location. Thoughtful amenities in the building make for a very pleasant stay.
I’m was very happy with the location
Melissa’s place was perfect for our visit to our daughter who lives in the neighborhood. Clean and quite yet close to lots of shops, cafes and restaurants in Lincoln Square.
Enjoyed the stay. Very easy process.

I stayed here for two nights. Both nights I didn’t sleep. The host was cool at first but the problem was that my room was the only one without AC. After speaking to the host, I was told to move to another room in the basement that a tenant had just left. Also the vents in my room were covered with tape and that was blamed on the previous tenant. After much frustration me and the host of the Bnb exchanged some not so nice words to each other after I requested a partial refund. The point I was trying to make is that, I paid for an Airbnb and was not able to sleep both nights due to my room being hot and stuffy. But when I walked outside the room the rest of the house seemed cool. I was also scheduled to have a surgery procedure the next day, to which I fell asleep during that. Luckily everything worked out. Host actually threatened to report me and take action if I wrote a bad review. I sent the host photos of the tape on the vents, my surgery, and was accused of being a scammer. Oh well
The Airbnb was bad a** and perfect for a get away place pet friendly highly recommended
Erik was great!

Great stay!
wonderful location. We will stay again when in chicago.

Great place in great location. Unfortunately the patios were unusable (dirty, no comfortable chairs to sit in). No screens in doors in living area room and kitchen to let fresh air in since it gets very chilly downstairs if you use the bedrooms A/C at a comfortable level (bugs would fly in). Owners were very quick & receptive to every inquiry we had.

Great location in old town, surrounding area is really nice and walkable, parking is a big plus as well
Place was nice with spacious bedrooms, only thing was dirty floors, host did offer to re clean. Overall good place to stay

Unloading the car on a one-way street was stressful. The neighbors came out to stare to make sure we weren’t leaving our car or parking in their spot. It took us 4 rounds to unload our stuff because cars kept coming behind us and there was no room to go around. We had to drive around for a while at night to find a good spot to park; it was inconvenient with street sweeping. As soon as you open the main door to the complex it smelled very strong of a distinct strong spice. The studio smelled like cat odor since the neighbor downstairs has a cat. It would’ve been good to know since i’m allergic. There was also construction going on next door so the men on top of the roof can see in the shower/BR window. We ended up leaving 1 day early and did not receive any communication back on whether we’d be refunded $141 for the night we didn’t say. The location looks good on the map; however it was uncomfortable for us. The couch was very itchy and the AC unit was very loud and faulty.
What a great place for a quick stay in Chicago! A quiet neighborhood with plenty of on street parking ... comfortable and spotless! Mark is responsive and very accommodating!

We really enjoyed our stay and would absolutely stay here again. The hosts were incredibly responsive from start to finish, and the check-in and check-out process couldn’t have been easier thanks to their clear instructions.
The house itself was clean, thoughtfully organized, and stocked with just about everything we needed. One of our favorite touches was the artwork throughout the home—it gave the place a lot of character and made it feel warm and welcoming rather than generic.
I also enjoyed the neighborhood. It gave me the chance to practice my Spanish with local residents, which was a fun and unexpected bonus for me.
The only suggestions I’d make are fairly minor. On especially hot days, having a few more fans available would make the house even more comfortable. Also, if you have hip or mobility issues, you may find the seating a bit limited, as there weren’t many places that were comfortable for long periods of sitting.
Great place to stay for to attend Cubs game. Clean, comfortable and quiet property. Great communication. Highly recommend!
The place was clean and in a great location not not too far away from anything you’ll do for a trip to Chicago
Ours was a "working trip" moving my son to Chicago for first job.  The apartment was a nice retreat after a few very long days.

Apartamento bem decorado, confortável e bom custo benefício.
Apenas melhorar um pouco a limpeza.
Clean home, safe location, host was attentive and helpful

My girlfriends and I went for a 5 day visit to Chicago.  The Plymouth was a great spot that put us central to everything. The building was access protected with a code and had prominent security cameras. We felt completely safe and welcomed.
Victor is always a great host. I look forward to another stay here
La casa en buena ubicación, la respuesta fue rápida estuvimos muy a gusto
Great place to stay, place was amazing and clean. Highly recommended for others to stay here 🤙🏻
I appreciate it the way he communicated everything with me and it was easy access to get in

Spacious, comfortable apartment in a great location - especially if a Cub's game is part of your plans. Sometimes the small things make a big difference. We loved the firm mattresses, pillows, and the water pressure in the primary bathroom shower.
The host was very responsive and respectful to all our needs 5/5 would recommend
Brendan was helpful and responsive. The flat was amazingly quiet for being above the pub on soccer nights!
Very nice loft. Spacious and modern. Hosts very helpful when we had a problem with the door keypad.
Location location location! Comfortably fit our group of 4 adults and 3 kids. Well stocked kitchen to sort yourself out as needed. Hard not to enjoy Chicago from here. Even in the heat wave.
Clean, comfortable, and located in a great spot in Andersonville. Bryce was very helpful and communicative
The accomodation is very close to public transportation, it's beautiful, and the room was peaceful.

Nice, spacious, just as described.
Thank you

We spent one week and were really glad to be in a house with enough space instead of staying in a hotel room. We enjoyed the area where you can sit outside. We very much appreciated all the little extras for example the coffee pods and used the well equipped kitchen quite often. Just be aware that there is no dishwasher. The house is in a quiet and nice area, very nice cafes and restaurants nearby. Justin and Samantha were very friendly and did answer very fast to our questions. We would definitely come back if we visit Chicago again, so 100% would recommend!

We had a lovely stay at this Airbnb! The location was close to the pink and green lines of the L and commuting into the city was super easy. The apartment was clean and pet friendly and Mary was always happy to help when we asked for things. Overall, a great stay!

Great place at a great safe location. Had an issue with check in but Ryan was able to support.
The place was beautiful - loved the expose bricks.
Close to everything - subway, coffee shops, Aldi, are all within walking distance. Wingstop across the street. Would stay here again.
We had a wonderful stay. Mera was a great host. Apartment was clean and had everything we needed.

The "3" rating for this stay is generous!!!  The best part of this stay was the convenience of the location.  I would not recommend this place unless you are prepared to bring your own kitchen towels, hand towels for the bathroom, extra plates and dinnerware (says it sleeps 6, but only has dinnerware for 3/4 people), bath mat for safety, toaster, hand soap, dish soap,  and light bulbs to replace those light bulbs that are out in every room!!!  Additionally be aware of safety concerns regarding no grab bars in the shower and/or bath mat (creating a fall risk), an extension cord on the floor across the front door as you enter, (creating a trip hazard) and an uneven floor pattern between the kitchen and living room.  Also, in the back there is a open "hole" leading to the sewer system - the smell is no pleasant.
Nice place and the location is perfect. Cathy is very communicative, I definitely recommend this spot.  We loved it
Newly remodeled inside. Clean and well taken care of space.

A lovely superbly maintained apartment, very well located and in a quiet peaceful area with lots of food options nearby. Mathew was a fabulous host, prompt in responding, very courteous and always seeking ways to enhance the experience!

Kris and Daniel have a beautiful home with a gorgeous private garden. They went above and beyond in leaving a few wonderful treats and the home, and the ever needed coffee snd milk. Super easy to communicate with. I would highly recommend snd will definitely be staying again! Thank you !

Despite the Extreme Heat Warning during our stay in Chicago, we undoubtedly would stay at this AirBnB again. The space is cooled off with window AC units which are more than adequate for staying comfortable.  The fridge had a few sodas (Coke, Diet Coke, and Sprite). David was a great host, communicated often, and allowed us to drop off our luggage early. His place is about a block to a block and a half away from the city bus stop.  We would highly recommend anyone who stays here to get the City Transit Pass (Ventra) which includes the El (Chicago's Subway) and their city bus system. This unit is the lower level of an apartment.  With that said, noise was very minimal.  Never once had an issue sleeping. The bed is very comfortable and is on the firmer side.  The curtains kept the room cool and dark. There is a piece of art in the bedroom that may be startling when someone wakes up. The shower pressure was nice and the water was hot. The entire unit was spotless. Neighborhood is nice.

this place was such a nice pick !!!! the neighborhood was very peaceful and parking was never a problem !! always a spot on the street right in front of the place! while we were checking out, the downstairs neighbors even helped us a little !!!! this was an amazing time and it was such a nice little safe haven after roaming the streets all day !!!!!!! most likely will be returning to this airbnb when i return to chicago !!! so so nice (and if there was any music in the neighborhood, it was all straight BANGERS !!)
A fantastic stay! Communication with the host was excellent, and the place was exactly as described. The space was spotless and in a perfect location for exploring the city. Highly recommended

Great location, easy to walk to the zoo and beach and even a farmer’s market. The bed was very firm, no pillow top which is not my preferred bed. Everything else was good. Maureen is very responsive and made our same day booking easy. Thanks Maureen.
Great location, responsive host, and nice unit. Couldn’t ask for more.

We had a really good stay here! The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. It was in a great location, which made getting around Chicago easy. Check-in was smooth, and the host was easy to communicate with. Overall, it was a great trip, and we’d definitely stay here again. Thanks for a great stay!

The host is very helpful and responsive. Allowed us to store our bags early and responded quickly to any questions we had. The location is great! Very walkable with lots of restaurants / stores and right next to an “L” station. If I could rate this stay solely on the host and location, immediate 5 stars.
The accommodation itself needs some work. Most of the furniture is very beat up. The hardwood floors are in rough shape (multiple soft spots or areas that are “spongy”). One of the bedrooms had a flickering overhead light. Wall outlet and fan did not work. The bathroom shower / tub had dark stains at the bottom of it. ALL of the towels provided were damp. BUGS….large ants and flies inside the accommodation throughout our stay.
The host did offer to have a cleaning team come and take a look at everything mentioned which I thought was really great of him. Again, 5-star host, not quite a 5-star accommodation.
We ended up leaving early. The place has potential but needs some work.
Great location across from a park and walkable to tons of great restaurants. Street parking was easy as advertised. The place was clean when we arrived and easy to get into.
We enjoyed our stay! Was the perfect place for us because we went to two cubs games and Wrigley was a short walk. Carlos’s place was also close to the train! My son also loved the game machine.
Always enjoy staying at the rooms at this house! Extremely quiet, clean, comfortable and plenty of space. Thank you very much to Sezgin and his team, once again!
Great! Felt at home.

We had a great time at Nicole and Matt’s place. If you’re looking for a house in Wicker Park you can’t do any better than this one. So spacious with the finished basement. Very close to the Blue Line trains and tons of shops and restaurants within walking distance. Nicole and Matt were very responsive and always quick to get back to us. Can’t recommend this place enough and when we come back to Chicago we’d look to stay here again for sure!
숙소가 엄청 깨끗하고 넓고 시카고 다운타운으로도 버스 하나만 타고 갈 수 있게 접근성도 너무 좋았어요 잘 쉬다 갑니다!

We loved staying at Kitty’s place! It was so beautiful and spacious with so many thoughtful details! If you’re a tea lover like me, you will love it! The reading room was my favorite! Kitty is so friendly and responsive too and gave us a great tour when we arrived. It’s about a 15 minute walk to the L through lovely neighborhoods and it’s also very close to the wonderful Bloomingdale Trail where I walked every morning. We miss it and can’t wait to go back!

Kelly was a wonderful host! She was accommodating and responsive to us, easy to reach and very friendly. The home was clean, bright and cozy with lots of unique amenities. The neighborhood was walkable and felt very safe. We had a great time!
Great quiet spot. Within walking distance for multiple restaurants and convenience stores. Easy access to the CTA stations.

This place is great. Loved the layout of the place for my friend and I. Would also work well for two couples. Kitchen is well equipped. AC blows cold. Very clean and everything worked. It seemed we had the entire building to ourselves so it was extremely quiet during our entire stay. Wicker Park neighborhood is amazing. Perfect place to escape the hustle and bustle of downtown while having endless great restaurants and bars at your fingertips. Very walkable neighborhood. Saying that, I was a bit surprised by the challenge of getting to downtown proper by bus or train. I thought it would be simple in and out on the blue line train or a single bus, but in reality we ended up taking Uber most of the time ($30-$50 CAD each way) which added up over time. Still, by the end of our 5 day trip we both agreed that staying in Wicker Park was the right move for the vibe and endless food/drink options. We shopped at ALDI grocery (15min walk) and it was very cheap and had everything. Recommend!

Great 2 bedroom w good space within walking distance to Wrigley Field.  Well equipped kitchen and comfortable beds. AC is a bit on the louder side but we got used to it. It was a very comfortable stay with lots to do in surrounding neighborhood.
Had a great stay Iris she was good at communication and any problems I may have had I would definitely come back

Overall a good stay. Many restaurant’s near by, walkable distance to a nearby park. About one hour walking distance to Navy Pier. Upstairs bedroom that has 2 queen beds has the nicer/bigger jacuzzi. Garage is a very tight squeeze, we rented a mini van so we can make sure we could fit.

We had a great stay!! Amazing location! Easy to walk to Wrigley, and many options for public transportation.
Petra's place was so clean and comfortable. We can't wait to stay again next time we visit Chicago!
The place was very cute, great neighborhood, and close to the El train!
Great place in a great neighborhood
Its a great and calm location. One room softer matress and other harder. Milan is always available. Would come back.

absolutely enjoyed staying at Ryan's place - it was neat clean and what a wonderful place it was to stay !
ryan was a fantastic host - made sure we felt comfortable and at home , was very responsive
would definitely visit again

The unit was just as pictured. Quiet neighborhood with lots of restaurants and shopping to walk to. Close to public transport. Julius was a great host. He communicated very quickly and helped us with anything we needed. Will stay there again when we are in Chicago!!

The home was as described. It was very spacious for my family and I (8 adults and 2 kids). We were in Chicago during the heatwave and let me tell you, that central AC was AC’ing! The pedestal fans in the house didn’t work, but no worries cuz the rooms had ceiling fans - all in all we were very comfortable.
The kitchen is well equipped and we were able to cook meals easily. Theres PLENTY of storage space which we loved!
The bedrooms were perfect with lots of space. My husband and I shared the masters bedroom w/ my 2 kids and we all fit in the room. The bathrooms were very spacious and clean. The shower didnt take forever to heat up, theres very good ventilation in the bathrooms as well.
I would def recommend this home and would book again if I visit Chicago. Thank you!
Jane and her husband were the sweetest, although my stay was cut short due to personal issues, they made me feel comfortable!
Clean, well-equipped place with great views of the city, train, and a glimpse of the canal. Multiple amenities with long hours and availability that we really enjoyed.

Lägenheten var rymlig, ren och välutrustad med allt vi behövde för en bekväm vistelse. Värden var fantastisk – alltid tillgänglig, snabb att svara och mycket hjälpsam under hela vistelsen. Det fanns även gratis parkering, vilket var ett stort plus.
Området kändes inte särskilt tryggt och det fanns inga restauranger inom bekvämt promenadavstånd. Vi upplevde därför att bil i princip var nödvändig för att ta sig runt speciellt med två små barn.
Sammanfattningsvis är detta ett bra boende med en utmärkt värd, särskilt om man har tillgång till bil.

I had a great stay here. The basement space was clean, comfortable, and had great airflow, which made it very pleasant. The neighborhood was quiet, so it was easy to relax and get a good night’s sleep. The host was friendly, and their cats were adorable! I also really enjoyed the beautiful backyard.
If you can get a car, this is an excellent place to stay while visiting Chicago. It offers a peaceful atmosphere while still being convenient to get around. I would definitely stay here again.

Felt right at home in this spacious flat.  Huge kitchen, very clean, comfortable beds, safe area close to everything like the Magnificent Mile, beaches, and Navy Pier.  Hosts were friendly, very responsive, and accommodating.  Five Stars!!
I had a lovely second stay here.  The space was comfortable and cool in spite of the roasting outdoor temps. Thanks again!

Gabriel was a great host. He saved a parking space for us upon arrival & provided the necessary permits for street parking. We were on a quiet residential street & felt very safe. The lower level apartment was clean & true to the photos. We were especially pleased with the air conditioning that had the thermostat inside so we didn’t have to rely on the host. It was hot during our stay & we were happy that the place was cool and comfortable when we returned from our outings. Gabriel & Tina responded quickly to us when needed and promptly resolved any concerns. We were very pleased with our stay and would recommend their “Hidden Gem.”

My wife and I enjoyed our stay here. The space was clean and the washer/dryer was convenient. We always found parking in front and lots of great restaurants nearby. I recommend this place and would definitely come back.

The apartment is well-located, close to public transit making it easier to get around the city. The apartment was clean and had all the essentials. Ben was quick to respond to any questions and communicate any updates. Overall, we had a great stay.

Hosts were very accommodating when asked for help. They came and fixed the door to the bedroom as  it would not shut and lock correctly at first. When told about this they came and fixed it for me. My issues were mainly with the guests that were staying there. People were up in the middle of the night being loud, two people on two separate occasions knocked repeatedly on the bathroom door when trying to shower in order to rush me. Whoever was staying above my room would move the chair and drop something at 3am which woke me up. This happened two days in a row before I left. I spoke to the host and explained this and they should be more mindful of who they have staying in their home to prevent this from happening again. Host was very understanding and saw my point of view. Overall it was guests that were a problem, not the hosts.

Good restaurants near by and good location for access to public transportation, downtown, West Town and surrounding neighborhoods. Able to street park without issue.  Enjoyed the open floor plan and natural light. Appreciated it was clean and well maintained with comfortable beds. Kitchen was adequate for food prep. Matthew was highly responsive with great communication throughout our stay.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! The apartment was spotless, beautifully maintained, and exactly as described in the listing. It was well-equipped with everything we needed, and the location was perfect.
The host was kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable.

The apartment is in a great place near millennium Park, and close to museums and theaters.
The place is close to te loop subway. If someone is sensitive to night noises, this may not be a good fit.

Wife and I traveled to Chicago this place was perfect.  We used it as a place to keep our luggage and sleep. Wrigleyville has so much right there and short walk to Red Line to get to downtown so we didn’t spend much time at the place. Had no communication with Josh since February but we didn’t need to. Everything was clearer mapped out on app. Would stay there again especially if attending Cubs game.

We had a comfortable stay at Matthew's place. We loved that the second bedroom had beds that were at just the right height and size for our children. The building was quiet and we didn't hear too much noise from neighboring apartments. Parking was easily available in the back, as was accessing the entry door from the apartment. Although the apartment building is on a busy main street, the bedrooms are in the back of the unit, so we did not hear any noise from the street. It was also fun entertainment for our children to look out the sliding glass doors and watch traffic go by.
There is a Starbucks just down the alley from the unit, plus parks in walking distance. The unit is also on 2 major bus lines that one could use to transfer to the EL.
Please know that the unit is two floors up and the stairs have a downward tilt. This was not an issue for us, but wanted to give the heads-up for guests who may have mobility challenges.
We would strongly consider staying here again!
The location of this home was exactly what we were looking for during our Chicago museum trip. Jennifer was flexible, responsive and helpful, which helped alleviate travel stress. Would stay again.

Alma’s place was amazing and made our stay feel very comfortable. Me and Xylose really enjoyed it, and I loved that it was pet friendly. One of my favorite parts was the beautiful city view. It was so nice to enjoy it while drinking coffee, relaxing, or eating outside.
I slept great during the stay, and everything was very clean, including the bedroom, bathroom, and the rest of the home. The kitchen also had everything I needed for cooking, which made the stay even better and more convenient. The space felt peaceful, welcoming, and easy to settle into, especially with Xylose there with me.
Alma was a wonderful host. She was very responsive, communicative, and made everything clear before and during the stay. The check-in process was smooth and easy, which made the experience even better.
The only small thing was that parking could be a little hard to find, but that was not Alma’s fault at all. It is just because of the street and area. Overall, me and Xylose had a great stay

We had an amazing trip. Tariq was so great with communication and made the check in process so easy. We would highly recommend to stay here again and we will definitely look to stay here again in the future.
If you’re going to a Cubs game this place is absolutely perfect. Tons of food and bar options. Super nice to have a small convenience store next door was so great. The walk to Wrigley was so easy and fun.
The decor inside was so fun with the sports theme. Bathrooms and kitchen along with the apartment were extremely clean.
Thanks again Tariq for your everything.

Milan’s place is a great play to stay and Milan is a wonderful host. Such a spacious apartment, easy to get in to (with very detailed instructions). It’s also so nice to have parking options.
We have never stayed in the south loop before, if you’re looking to stay in this area or Chicago in general, would highly recommend!

A beautiful Airbnb that is upscale in every way. My family felt extremely comfortable there, and it felt like we were living the high life! Beautiful kitchen! Our boys enjoyed the bunk beds and loved having their own space. There was a park right across the street for our kids to play. Close to restaurants and coffee. Very luxurious accommodations. Song was extremely great to communicate with and was a very clear, welcoming host. We would absolutely stay there again and hope to in the future. Thanks, Song!
The location allowed us to walk to many attractions and use public transportation for the rest. Plenty of space to relax.
Great spot!
The G Estate was perfect in every way - space, cleanliness, location, and hosts.  We will be back the next time we are in Chicago!
Affordable. Clean. Safe area. Decent hostel vibe. Would definitely return

I loved Nina and Richard,
He was a god send and the place was just what we needed during a very difficult but necessary trip,

Everything was great. Jean’s place was fantastic.
Highly recommend!

Fabulous location, adorable neighborhood and close walking distance to Wrigley Field. The home was immaculate and comfortable. The hosts made it super simple and don’t make you do any cleaning upon check out. You simply leave! Highly recommend if you are staying in this area.

Tuan's place was just like it was described. He was so friendly and helpful. We made one request and it was fulfilled right away .
We stayed here while visiting Chicago for a couple Cubs games. The parking was GREAT - no need to search for a spot, always free.
We ate at Joe's on Higgins - a lovely restaurant with phenomenal Italian food and walking distance from the space. We also ate at Sweet Cafe for breakfast which was SO GOOD.
Our stay was during one of the hottest days of the summer - 98 degrees - and although the space doesn't have central AC, the window AC kept us cool.
Thanks, Tuan!

Viviana was an exceptional host. We needed a last minute place to stay at and Viviana was there for us when we needed it. Place overall was very clean however a lot of noises coming from the upstairs. Sounds like heavy footsteps but other than that it was pretty good.
Quiet and easy to sleep, clean space!

Staying at Dave’s place was a great choice. There is so much to do all within walking distance! The train and bus stops are close which made getting to downtown Chicago super easy. There is shopping nearby, Wriggly field, bars, restaurants…. All within a 20 minute walk at the most.
The house is super clean, beds are comfy, good linens, well stocked kitchen with 3 types of coffee maker 👍🏼
Thanks Dave next time in Chicago i would definitely stay again!!
Room was comfortable and clean! Very responsive and helpful

Great location in uptown near all of the wonderful Vietnamese spots. Easy to walk to food, coffee or transit with the red line. This was essential to our stay - the location can’t be beat. And because we had to drive to the burbs to see family, the private parking was perfect for our rental car. Our xc90 fit fine, but a larger vehicle might be an issue.
The interior of the unit has its quirks due to age, but was very clean, even felt comfortable with our baby playing on floor. The spacious unit allowed us to watch tv in the evening without waking baby too. Well stocked, we never felt like there was anything we needed but didn’t have. And very much appreciated the pack n play for baby to sleep in.
Joan was quick to reply and gave super clear instructions for check in/out and parking. Would gladly stay again on a future visit!

Guirlaine's place it was perfect for us to spend a week with our children and grandchildren in Chicago. Yhe house was warm and welcoming. The backyard was beautiful. Everything was perfect! Guirlaine was so patient with us when we lock ourselves out. We will book again!
We throughly enjoyed our stay, the location was ideal and the local coffee shop had the best lattes.
We had a lovely stay! The space and location were perfect!

Great place! Very clean. Exceptional location. We will stay here again when we go to Cubs games. My family loved the short walk. It’s very close to Whole Foods as well and a great coffee/breakfast place.
It is located at a peaceful neighbourhood.

This was a good place to stay while apartment hunting in the area. It was clean and met our needs, but there were a few issues we didn't expect. The listing mentioned noisy upstairs neighbors, but we didn't realize just how loud they would be. With three young boys upstairs, there was frequent running, jumping, and items hitting the floor throughout the day. Additionally, I would describe the upper bunk as having more of a foam pad than a true mattress. It was very uncomfortable, so I ended up sleeping on the couch instead. Overall, the host was great and the space worked well for our stay, but I'd recommend considering your tolerance for noise and the sleeping arrangements before booking.

Our stay in Lake View was great. The house had everything we needed and plenty of room for our family of 5. The garage parking space was a HUGE bonus. Josh was prompt and professional. We had a great stay.

We come to Chicago a lot and love this area. This is the best place we’ve stayed. There are functionally two connected (inside stairs) apartments both with sleeping areas and kitchens as well as a full bathroom. Outside there is a porch and a yard. We’d definitely come back.
Decent place to stay and the only complaint I have is the A/c went out twice and roommates always leaving dishes in the sink
great stay in Chicago. one thing to note: the wifi is not secured. it's an open network.
It was nice, great location.

WONDERFUL STAY!!!
I frequent Airbnbs and I look for 5 main things.
Clean
Quiet
Safe
Good Bedding
This topped ALL and more! Will DEFINITELY be staying here again and also it was HUGE and crisp cool air conditioning even upstairs in a 96 degree Chicago day! China town food and shops were amazing and quick to get to Michigan Ave and Navy Pier!

We had a great stay! So nice to get out of the hustle of the city and into a walkable residential area apartment. Elizabeth and her team were delightful.

James was a good communicator and the location was ideal — close to the L and walkable to Wrigley Field. Comfortable bed and the AC unit helped us get through the excessive heat warning.
The keys/locks to open the apartment door were very difficult to use, but the instructions were clear and the heat was probably partly to blame. There was a cockroach in the bathroom and James said he’d get the cleaner to come take a look, but it didn’t happen while we were there.
It was a little odd to have a coffee maker but no pods, but having coffee wasn’t advertised so that’s fair and Pedestrian Coffee is close and great.
Ultimately, it was pretty quiet and private, a good value, matched the description, and served our needs.

felt safe walking around. only concern was 2 doors that open to another location in back room. (stairwell and who knows where). that was a bit alarming. there were no dish cloths, dish towels, or wash towels in kitchen and bathroom.  beds were extremely comfortable.  parking was a bit tricky,  but with daily permit everything worked out. this location did meet our needs
Good deal that's exactly as listed
Perfect for our short trip! Everything was within drivable distance (20 ish minutes from downtown Chicago). Would definitely book again! Safe area too!
All in all, I had a good stay.

This is the most beautiful AirBnb we have ever stayed in.  The finishings and decor were absolutely stunning!  The outside patio with the garage door opening and fun lighting provided the perfect hanging out spot.  Super close to so much and incredibly well-appointed!  Bravo!🤩
This is a nice place to crash, and it was conveniently placed next to public transit.

The place is exactly as described. Perfect for what I was looking for. The place is very cute and modern and had everything I needed. The bed was super comfy and I loved the little sofa. There is noise from the bar as mentioned, but it did not bother me. Great value and perfect for a solo or couples trip
Had a great stay! A few blocks to the trains, close to a bunch of other things.

I would certainly stay again! Everything matches the photos.  This place was so peaceful, & the unit provided a luxury feel while being local in Chicago. Rida was very responsive & helpful with any questions. Such a pleasure to stay, I wouldn’t think twice about rebooking!!
Great place for large groups traveling together!
We were very comfortable here! Great natural light in the space. Just a short walk down the street to many charming cafes and shops.  We would gladly stay here again.

We had a fantastic stay! The location was perfect, close to everything we wanted to do while still being quiet and peaceful in the evenings. We especially loved walking through the neighborhood, which was beautiful and felt very welcoming. The host was wonderful to work with and made everything easy from start to finish. We would absolutely stay here again and will definitely keep this place on our list for future trips to Chicago!

I honestly couldn’t have asked for better hosts. I stayed here for the entire last month of my pregnancy while waiting for the arrival of our baby boy, and Casey and her husband made me feel so safe, comfortable, and cared for during such an important time in my life.
They were incredibly kind, thoughtful, and always quick to respond if I needed anything. Being away from home and spending the last month of pregnancy can feel overwhelming, but they made the experience so much easier with their genuine warmth and hospitality. It never felt like I was just renting an Airbnb—it truly felt like I was being looked after.
The apartment was spotless, cozy, quiet, and had everything I needed for a long stay. It was the perfect place to prepare for our son’s arrival.
And I can’t forget their adorable dogs! They were so sweet and always brightened my day whenever I saw them.
Thank you both for making such a special chapter of our lives even more memorable ❤️

Excellent location and one of the most unique Airbnbs we’ve stayed in. The owners are completely committed to the camping theme. The place was clean and comfortable, even during a little heat wave.  We loved all the extra thoughts and subtle sense of humor shown in throughout the place. We would definitely stay here the next time we visit the area. Thank you for being a part of our awesome vacation.

We had a fantastic time here.  It's a beautiful place in a great location with a friendly team of hosts.  The beds are super comfy and my daughter loved the well-equipped bathrooms.  There's a paid laundry room on the same floor, which was very convenient for us.  Parking is a bit complicated, but the hosts have put together a guide you can read ahead of time that makes everything easier.  One of the nicest places I have stayed and a great value to boot!

I had an Amazing stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The check-in process was simple, and the host was friendly, responsive, and made sure everything went smoothly. The location was convenient and close to everything I needed during my trip.

We had a comfortable stay at Katherine’s place. It is a great location to Lincoln Park and Old Town. Living room is clean, spacious and bright with large windows. The place is a one bedroom with a king  bed and  good quality linen. The bathroom is smaller with a washer and drier in a tight space . The kitchen is well equipped except there is NO dishwasher. It would be great if there was additional seating like two sofa chairs in the living room as the chaise sofa provides minimal seating. Owners were always responsive and friendly . Good overall stay and hope to be back.

Maurizio place is wonderful. It's just like pictures & description . He is a wonderful host & very helpful with suggestions.
We came to town for cubs game. Wanted some place we could walk to the game & places to eat.. It was maybe a 10 min walk to Clark street where the food places are & then the stadium.
We will stay here again.
Beautiful little apartment with amazing A/C for this Chicago summer heat. Loved it.
Sharon and Jeremy were very kind and helpful! Parking was hard to find late at night but they were quick to respond to help us out! Would definitely stay again!
Host was very communicative and helpful. Would definitely return.
Gran lugar era sencillo entrar y el departamento era hermoso y grande. Todos los servicios y si te estacionabas cruzando la calle tenías a la vista el coche. Lo recomiendo ampliamente

Es una excelente casa para grupos grandes. Tiene habitaciones amplias, una sala grande con un buen televisor. La casa tiene doble parqueadero. Tian es una persona muy proactiva: tuvimos problemas con el aire acondicionado en la ola de calor y la ayuda fue casi que inmediata. Con lo único que se debe tener cuidado es que el entorno y el barrio cambia radicalmente cuando se esconde el sol, pero entendemos que es un tema social más de la ciudad de Chicago.

We really enjoyed this s! It was really clean and had the space we needed to wind down after long days. The living room area was super comfortable. Kitchen was small but we didn't need to cook. It had supplies if we had decided to do so. We used the fridge and coffee machine plenty. Beds were comfortable. We didn't get much light in the early morning but that was a positive for us. Bathrooms were really clean and we had the soaps and towels we needed for a week stay for 5 people. We would have loved to have sat outside in the backyard but we came during the heat wave. It's a nice space to have a morning coffee and read a book.
We really liked the location as well. We were probably at the most north side of Andersonville but maybe a 1 minute walk from the main street that was lined with restaurants and bars. It was also very convenient to grab the bus down to Halsted and Wrigley.
Jacki responded very quickly to our questions and needs.

It was two blocks away from Wrigley Stadium and had easy access to local transportation.  Be prepared for the train that passes every 15 minutes. Prudence was always quick to respond with any questions or concerns.  I highly recommend if you plan on attending some baseball games.

This was a perfect place for me, my husband and two adult children.  The townhome itself is beautiful, spacious, and has everything you need for a comfortable stay.  We went to the Carnival grocery one afternoon and cooked in for dinner in the well stocked kitchen.  The location is THE BEST to be near restaurants, transportation, etc while still being quiet.  Robert was excellent with communication.  I will absolutely stay here again!
place was great! the host communicated well and often.
Un lugar tranquilo en una zona muy tranquila
J's rental was a great home base for our trip to Chicago. It has everything you need, it's quiet, and the bed is very comfortable.

Highly recommend! This cozy and clean house perfectly matched the listing description and photos. The parking behind the house was so convenient and provided a stress free experience. We could sightsee all morning, easily park when we returned, and comfortably walk to Wrigley Field for Cubs games. We'd definitely stay here again. Thank you, Grace and Joe!

We loved our stay in Lincoln Park. Perfect location, responsive host, flexible check-in, very comfortable bed and pillows. Plenty of room for unpacking -- loved having the washer and dryer and full kitchen. AC worked well and would definitely come back.

Stunning!
