Peter's place was a great find. Great location to transport, Wrigley field, shops and restaurants. Beds were comfy, towels were fluffy and showers had great pressure.
Peter was very friendly and responsive to all enquiries.
We would definitely stay here again, highly recommended!
Thanks Peter 🇦🇺🐨

Dan is awesome. Super friendly and helpful. Place is great. I'm a med student and was doing a rotation at Mt Sinai which is 5ish blocks north. So this was awesome. Only thing to be aware of is the parking is by permit stickers and they are vicious and petty - so... not great for parking. Though there's always spots. Also Chicago's Online Parking ticket site has never worked for me - so we'll see what happens. But the Airbnb is also close to the train. 100% recommend this place and I would stay again if I had another rotation.

We enjoyed our stay here. It was a smaller space than expected but it fit our needs well. The only issue we had was the noise from the top part of the house and the adjacent unit. We could hear heavy footsteps, a possible washing machine or dishwasher, the door to the adjacent unit opening, and sometimes talking/media playing. Overall we loved the neighborhood and walkability to so many restaurants, bars, and cafes. It felt like a safe and quiet neighborhood.

Terrible experience with this host. They canceled our reservation 40 minutes after our scheduled check-in time and then stopped responding. When I contacted Airbnb, I was informed that they were also unable to reach the host because the host wasn't answering their calls.
After I sent multiple messages through Airbnb, the host finally responded and offered a different property nearly 10 miles away. After we had already arrived and were expecting to check in, this was not an acceptable solution.
This was an extremely irresponsible and stressful experience. If you're considering booking any property with this host, I strongly recommend having a backup plan so you're not left without a place to stay if something goes wrong.

We had a great stay. People complain about the train, but we got used to it right away and it was a part of really feeling like we’re in the city. Excellent location and views.
Just a couple very minor things to improve, not worth mentioning.
Thank you Cyndi!

Great spot for exploring the city of Chicago and surrounding neighborhoods! Easy walk to the train station and quick trip into downtown. We had a car also, and parking was super simple on the street. It was a perfect fit for the 5 of us, and we had everything we needed. I would definitely stay again and highly recommend to others!

The location of the property is outstanding-you’re close to public transport, the lakefront, museums, coffee shops, and restaurants.
And the host is very nice and responsive.
But the property itself was a lot smaller and older than it looked in the photos.
One of the bathrooms lacks proper ventilation and smells strongly of mildew.
The building itself is very old and the listing doesn’t state that the hvac system is older and the air con can’t go lower than a certain temperature. The host only said that after we checked in and had we known beforehand, we probably would not have stayed there as there was an extreme heat wave.
There is also very loud construction taking place on the exterior of the building. The security is also lax-the front door to the building is always propped open and there is rarely security or someone at the front desk to check who is entering the building and going into the elevators.

Great little flat!! Super comfortable bed. Very clean. A little bit of a chaotic neighborhood with some construction and parking was a little difficult, but nothing unmanageable. Hosts were so responsive and accommodating. Would stay here again.

This Airbnb is in a perfect location - the heart of river north with lots to do surrounding!
Clean and updated space. However, do note there are some steep stairs leading up to the space.
Hosts are friendly and quick to proactive to respond to anything you need
Great visit to Chicago. Was able to combine business with pleasure and our location was perfect. Everything walkable.

I’ve stayed with Eduardo and Lois before and loved it just as much this time! The home and grounds are wonderful and they are so kind! The neighborhood is beautiful! I’ll be staying again next time I’m in Chicago.

Location is prime to restaurants and bars. The space is large and open. Definitely wear and tear on the furniture and the air hockey table is there for aesthetics and is broken. Back room is quiet for sleeping. Front room is crazy loud and you can hear a ridiculous amount of noise from the bar across the street. I’m not sensitive to noise I lived in midtown NYC for 8 years. Overall, if you’re there to party and need a big space you’re in luck.
Great and cute spot! We had a wonderful time there.
Great stay. Host was quick to respond and even offered early check in. Plenty of extra linens and other listed amenities.

Mark was a fabulous host- very friendly, responsive and helpful.  The house is great, the koi pond, fun indoor and outdoor space!  There was a heat wave when we stayed there and the climate of the house was perfect.  I highly recommend the house and location - close to Wrigley, the train, restaurants, shops.  Lots to do close by!

The place was exactly what I was looking for. We enjoyed ping pong and tic tac toe. The bathroom has heated floors that was pretty cool. Pictured and very detailed step by step instructions. Onsite garage parking was the icing on the cake. I would recommend this air bnb.
We enjoy our time together. It’s a wonderful place to stay.
Fantastic location, private patio, and fully stocked kitchen.
As advertised. Great space and great views of Chicago.

This 2-bedroom home is situated in a very nice Andersonville neighborhood. Very nice sitting room, clean and bright bathroom. There’s a beautiful deck next to the kitchen. Laundry is in the basement. The location is surprisingly convenient if you don’t mind taking the CTA bus which is about 1.5 blocks away.  Steve is very nice and helpful.

Fantastic stay! The apartment is beautiful, comfortable, spacious, great location and lots of amenities. It's well worth the cost, and the AC works very well (100-degree heat wave when we were there and the AC cooled the apartment completely). Can't beat the location, 3-4 minute walk to Wrigley and restaurants. Very nicely decorated, but still very comfortable to hang out, and spotlessly clean. The host also accommodated an early check-in for us, which was much appreciated. I don't have a single complaint. Rent this unit, you won't be disappointed!
Great location and very responsive host. Would definitely stay here again.
Great spot. Walking distance to Wrigley which was perfect. Nice space to kick back after a busy day.
Great spot in Bucktown. Very clean, easy to get to, spacious, and well equipped.

This place was a great find! Awesome price, right next to a bus stop so we could go into the city extremely easily, and the free parking was an added bonus! we will definitely be back the next time we are in Chicago :)

We had a really great stay! The apartment was very spacious and had such a unique style and atmosphere. There were so many interesting details, and the whole place had a special vibe that we really enjoyed.
The host was amazing — very kind, welcoming, and helpful. We felt comfortable from the moment we arrived and really enjoyed our time there. We would definitely recommend this place and would happily stay here again!

Tracee was an awesome host!!! We thoroughly enjoyed our stay… she responded so quickly and thoroughly to the things we needed… it made our stay a pleasure!!! And it looks as good as the pictures!
If we get any family this way, we will sure recommend them to stay! 🫶🏽
Very nice
Great location to explore the city. Perfect apartment for a family of four. Easy communication and flexibility. Good restaurants and running nearby.

Highly recommend! Located in the heart of Wrigley.
Great host, beautiful home, amazing atmosphere and neighborhood. Very safe location and 10 min drive to a local beach on Lake Michigan!

As others have said the hallway was smelled like stale cigarettes. And it felt dark and my kids were a little freaked out. But once you open the door to the quaint apartment, it smelled amazing and it felt very comfortable. Very small bathroom, but it was doable for our three nights stay. The beds were very comfortable and hard which I like. I never heard any of the noise that others have described. The place stayed nice and cool with the window units. I have nothing bad to report.

The place was great and easy to find! The host was extremely responsive and helped us with any issues. Only reason for the 4 stars is because the shower was very cold and never fully stayed hot during our whole stay. But they did come twice to try and fix it for us, but it was still pretty finicky and not getting very hot. Other than that, everything was great!

I will start by saying the inside of this home is beautiful. It was one of the most beautifully decorated and designed Airbnb's we have ever stayed in. We also really enjoyed the area around the home and the restaurants nearby.
The main issue was the noise from the train. It has been pointed out by others, and we were aware when we booked the house, but the noise was still more disruptive than we were expecting. The internet was the other disappointment. It was inconsistent while we were there and generally just slow.

Danny’s place was great for my family. There was plenty of space for us to run around and the bedrooms were large. It was nice having a full sized crib and not just a pack n play for our little one. The designated parking spot was amazing, not having to look for parking in front of the house.
Apartment is spacious, clean, and well lit. Well located too. Easy check-in and out.

Angelika and Zibi’s place was the perfect place to stay while my boyfriend and I visited Chicago. Their instructions were helpful and the place was clean when we arrived. It’s the middle of summer, so the AC units in each room were much appreciated. There is lots of street parking and restaurants nearby.  We definitely enjoyed our stay!
Beautiful home built in the early 1900s
Comfortable 2 bedroom for our 4 family. Close by to lots of the top things to do in Chicago.
Nice roomy apartment with good location in central area of Loop.

We appreciated concierge showing us the apartment and the location of everything. They were extremely friendly when we came in and out. We loved the location. Michigan Avenue was a half a block away. We walked to restaurants and to the grocery store. We really enjoyed our stay there and can’t wait to back.
It was a great place for my family & I to relax  each night. And great place to get ready/ chill during the day before heading to many other attractions near the home!

Overall, a really good experience! Michael was clear about expectations and made check in and out very easy. The green line was an easy walk away. The only thing to be aware of - the third floor in the summer doesn’t cool as well as the rest of the house, so it was toasty! That aside, I’d absolutely stay here again.

Michael was very accommodating and had lots of recommendations. The neighbourhood was quiet and it was an easy walk to the nearest train station so we could easily explore downtown Chicago. There was an option to park the car in the garage at the end of the driveway which was a huge bonus. This top floor suite felt very private with a separate door entry to the rest of the house. The room was very comfortable and spacious. There were some useful kitchen amenities and a lovely bathroom. We would definitely stay there again.
Great stay! Easy access to the “L” train, clean & comfortable space, quiet neighborhood. 10 outa 10 would stay again.
Patt é maravilhosa e a casa é incrível! Uma pessoa sensacional
all good
Very nice place and super convenient to campus.

Super Hôte ! Super accueil ! Olga est très réactive. Logement propre, cosy, spacieux et ressemble parfaitement à la description de l’annonce ! Très bon rapport qualité-prix. La hauteur sous plafond n’a pas été un problème pour nous bien que nous fassions plus d’1m80! Je recommande. Merci pour tout Olga!

Joan’s place was fantastic! It was very clean and had everything we needed for the few days we were there. The apartment was about a 20 min walk from the metro, and car services into the city were readily available. The drive to the apartment (in the city) was not stressful at all, and parking was super easy; no issues there at all. The apartment was on a very quiet, clean, and safe street (we went for walks at night in the neighborhood and felt perfectly safe). Joan was very friendly and communicative with us and answered all our questions promptly, even if it was late at night. I'm super happy we had the chance to stay at Joan’s place because it really made our time in Chicago enjoyable!!

The pictures do this place no justice. In person it looks even better! Especially the flooring on the rooftop! James is very patient and makes instructions so easy to understand. The hot tub was phenomenal!!!  That view is crazy day or night! The lights on it set it off and the jets feel so gooooood! That bed was so comfortable in the master bathroom. The place overall is just comfortable . There's a review on James page from a lady who said she'd been here twice and I definitely get it! Don't cheat yourself. TREAT yourself. Book it right now z
The host was incredibly kind and welcoming, making us feel right at home. The space itself was spotless and beautifully decorated, which exceeding our expectations.

my husband and I loved this Airbnb and would absolutely stay again. The bed was comfortable, the kitchen had what we needed for making quick breakfasts. Also, it was about 100 degrees outside and the  a/c was fantastic. It was very convenient to the Brown Line and some of the yummiest bagels at Beans & Bagel. Highly recommend that place, too!
This was a wonderful Airbnb and the hosts were very thoughtful. They kept the place well stocked and it was well designed with everything clearly labeled. We enjoyed our stay very much!

Comfortable stay for our family of four - the two teens appreciated their own bedrooms. The neighborhood had some great spots in printers row and transportation is easy to access to move about the city. Great place!
Great Wicker Park Location

Thank you, we had a great stay! The location of the apartment is perfect in a very lovely area with a lot of cafés and restaurants! Tim was a very nice host and the house was well equipped with everything we needed!

Hanna and Mark’s place was exactly how it was described. It was clean and comfortable. Location was perfect for our mini vacation to Chicago especially coming home from the Cubs game. There wasn’t much traffic getting back. We loved the views from the big picture window and also the balcony. Even though their condo is close to the train tracks and also seems to have typical “downtown” noise, we barely heard a thing when the windows were closed. We would definitely book again with them.

This was a great find. The space was comfortable and John & Terry were great hosts. I stayed for a week and couldn't be happier. It was conveniently located near the L, had a beautiful garden backyard and was very just as described.
great place very clean and nice! entrance lock was a bit tricky but got the hang of it after a while, AC unit runs great, very cold when needed, overall great place to stay!
We had a great stay. The loft was a great place to chill and relax after a long day of touring. The beds were comfy, shower nice and hot and the couch was a cozy place to watch a movie and chill.
Great time staying with Laura and the pets! She genuinely has everything you’d ever need so don’t bring too much. definitely felt right at home.

This is a HUGE unit. We were able to spread out, decompress, and get some space between us after a long car ride. We were here during crazy hot heat wave (unit was cool and comfortable) so we didn’t get to do as much local exploring as we would have wanted to but it looked like
there were a ton of local coffee shops and restaurants to explore. it took about 35 minutes to get to downtown via car during the day/early evening and only about 18 minutes at 9pm at night. beds were comfortable, shower had great water pressure and plentiful very hot water. it was lovely. Kitchen was well stocked.
nice place, think i’ll stay again for another month

Nice spacious studio located above a bar (had no problems whatsoever with the noise). Bit of a small shower but pictures are accurate (shower itself is amazing). Bed was great! Great option, would book again!
Great location and stay for our family. Exactly as described.
Great place, would recommend for a short or long term stay.   Nice area and quick walk to the water and a local beach.
Great value and location. And there’s chickens in the backyard!

Pro's
1. Location one block from Old Town and half block from the L is great. Lots of restaurants in the neighborhood.
2. Only a mile to Lincoln Park with zoo, lake, and green space.
3. Plenty of room for large groups. Our family of 13 with 6 kids ranging from infants to 12 years had room to spread out over two floors.
2. Govardhan is a great host. He responded to every message within minutes.
Cons
1. Two levels of steep and winding stairs to get to the apartment.
2. Town house is a block from the Marshall Fields Garden Apartments, a large subsidized housing complex. Although we never were approached or felt threatened, wewitnessed a street fight below the town house one night that had to be broken up by two police cruisers.

Wonderful stay at Jason’s place. It was just as described in a great neighborhood. Lots of close things to do and very walkable. Jason was always responsive and very helpful. Would definitely stay here again!

I had a wonderful time visiting my son and daughter in Chicago for 10 days. The
location in Avondale was ideal. All the amenities and laundry helped a lot. Wilma was friendly and available and responsive.
We felt like we could get whatever help we needed.
And the window air conditioning was a life saver during the heat wave.
Nice place

Mccormick Place is in easy walking distance. The hard surfaces, bedding, and towels were clean, but the carpets in the bedrooms are very stained and felt dirty. Also there was a really gross stain on the couch when we arrived, but management came quickly and resolved the issue.
The kitchen has just the basics (we had to ask for bowls), and it would be hard to cook for a larger group here. Building is secured at night, but during the day the main door is unlocked. The management is very responsive and they don't require any cleaning on check-out, but they do ask for an additional damage deposit of $140. Pay attention to the fine print on their smoking policy.

Este hospedaje es realmente hermoso, todo estaba muy limpio y las habitaciones son amplias y cómodas.
Rameez es muy amable y respondió rápido a nuestras inquietudes y nos ayudó con todo lo que necesitábamos, volvería sin duda a hospedarme

I had a wonderful stay at LIVN Chicago! The apartment was extremely clean, which is always my biggest concern when booking an Airbnb. The location was fantastic, just a 7-minute walk to Millennium Park and about a 20-minute walk to the Magnificent Mile. It’s also conveniently located near several bus stops and a train station, making it easy to get around using public transportation.
I did experience a small issue with my door code upon arrival, but the team responded immediately. Someone came in person to resolve the problem, and they even refunded my early check-in fee for the inconvenience without me having to ask. Throughout my stay, the staff maintained excellent communication and responded quickly to any questions.
I would absolutely stay here again the next time I visit Chicago!

I had a great stay at Leo and Alex's place! I needed a very last minute reservation (requested at 5pm day of) and they were very responsive and helpful, getting me in quickly. The place was clean, comfortable, and spacious, and the location was very walkable with food and other conveniences nearby. I would certainly stay there again!!

Stephanie was such a fantastic host! She was so accommodating with any request we had. I stayed with my elderly parents who felt safe and right at home. Location was super, so much to see and do within walking distance. We’re already planning when we can come back and stay again! Thank you so much!

We really enjoyed our stay; the place is in a great location walkable to many of the main local downtown attractions and to the Brown Line.  The rooftop area is a definite plus.  Assel was very responsive and provided clear check in and check out instructions.  The garage parking is also a plus but be careful about parking in different locations than your assigned spot as they will be quick to check for violators.  Overall would stay again.

Great hosts.  The communication was excellent and everything was as we expected. The area offers quite a bit and is in a great location and with walkable or a short Uber ride away from a lot of what Chicago has to offer. Lots of food options nearby as well as grocery stores, coffee shops, etc in the neighborhood.  One of the highlights is the garage parking and front office staff that are very cool and super helpful.

Ryan was a fantastic host and made our stay very enjoyable from start to finish. Communication was excellent throughout, with quick and helpful responses.
The apartment is located in a brilliant area of Wicker Park, with so much nearby — grocery stores (including Aldi less than a 5-minute walk away), plenty of great coffee shops, restaurants, and amenities. The location is also very convenient for getting around the city, with the Blue Line providing easy access to O’Hare Airport in around 30 minutes.
Ryan was incredibly kind and accommodating by offering us an early check-in and late check-out, which was a very thoughtful gesture and greatly appreciated. It may be worth noting that the WiFi was inconsistent, and some noise from neighbours could be heard, possibly due to thinner walls. However, these were small issues and did not take away from what was otherwise a fantastic stay. We would highly recommend both the apartment and Ryan as a host. Thanks again for having us!

We loved staying at Alex and Jordan's home! It's in a sweet, quiet neighborhood. We were out walking around with our kids in the morning and night to and from the Red Line and it was so convenient!
Super comfortable beds, so nice to have the kitchen to cook in, and a great location to walk to restaurants, shops and cafes. The parking spot was also incredibly helpful. We would definitely love to stay here again. Thank you!

The space was clean and appeared newly updated and the kitchen was stocked with basic necessities. However, the unit is very small, which is important to consider when booking. Upon arrival, we could access the building but not the unit and waited about 45 minutes in the lobby before getting in. The host was very responsive and ended up providing a link to an app for entry, which worked for the rest of our stay. Only two towels were provided, which was insufficient for a 4 night stay and 2 people. There was also no Wi-Fi, and the TV required Wi-Fi, making it unusable. We were told installation had not yet been completed due to the listing being new, but this was not clearly communicated upfront. The night before checkout, we were asked to allow installers in the next morning, which we declined. We found that quite distasteful as it would have no benefit to our stay. If 3.5 stars were an option, that would feel most accurate, but we are giving the benefit of the doubt.

Place is nice and clean and exactly like the photos. Nice area, felt very safe even going out at night and tons to do: restaurants, nightlife, parks, shopping. Host was very responsive and communicative.
Thanks Janice! We had a lovely stay!

We had a great time and Pauline was so helpful during our entire stay! The kitchen is well stocked, which I took advantage of. We loved being able to walk across the street to the beach. I would love to stay again.
Jeffrey was a great host! Very responsive and accommodating. We were able to get a last minute late checkout that helped make the timing of our flight a little easier. Great stay in Chicago!
Super location.  Walkable to El, Wrigley Field, Southport, Restaurants, etc. Would book again on my next visit.

This is our second stay-it is clean, well-maintained, great layout, private balcony a nice feature, nice area of town, quiet building, off the street private parking a huge plus! Attentive and responsive host. No complaints whatsoever!
Clean, quiet, well laid out and spacious. Near many good spots—coffee, roof top city views, book stores and food. We will stay again. K

Sadie’s place came as advertised.  She’s a very eco-conscious host which I thought was nice.  Check-in was super easy.  It was nice to have notes all around the house to help navigate some of the quirks of it being an old home (ie. using remotes to control hard to reach lights due to socket locations).  I liked reading through the guest book and appreciated the recommendation book.  It’s a short walk to bus and subway train stations.  We spent most of our time in the downtown area so we took the subway.  The neighborhood was super quiet.  Parking was easy to find on the street too.  Thanks for hosting us!  I recommend staying here if you want a roomy, quiet and affordable place in Chicago.
Great stay!  Clean and close to a lot.

Damien’s place was great for our needs. He responded quickly to any inquiries and turned on the A/C before our arrival during the heat wave. In addition, the place was very clean and the complimentary snacks were appreciated.
Everything fine , thanks for all  Matt
We had a wonderful stay in Chicago and this place was perfect for our needs. Lauren had everything as advertised. Foster beach was a highlight for our girls. We’d stay here again!

I was a little hesitant to share a space with strangers, but everyone my son and I met were very nice. The place was clean and the hosts were very responsive to any questions. The room was smaller than I realized, but it ended up being an adequate space. The kitchen was well stocked with dishes and anything a kitchen should have. The living space had a very comfortable couch and TV with a lot of channels. We felt right at home.

Had a great experience. Great location, very clean, very safe, quiet, and I loved that there was free, no hassle parking. We were even able to walk over to the beach for a day which was a great perk. I couldn't have asked for better accommodations and for a great price. Also when I originally messaged Zen Garden about needing accommodations last minute, the response was quick and friendly. Will definitely book again when I'm in the area.

This was a nice place to stay close to the train and bus stops. I was here 1.5 months. I had some issues at check in but the host was responsive right away and fixed it. The lobby is under construction but it didn’t affect my stay at all. If I need to come back for an extended period of time I will definitely stay here again.

fantastic place to stay, very good for accommodating large groups. clean, felt very homey and well decorated. overall very nice and would stay again if i’m ever in the area again. loved how close it was to the train. robert is very responsive and accommodating.
only big downside were the stairs, they appeared to be under renovation and are really in need of a handrail as they curve twice. i’ve got a bum ankle and need a bit of stability going down stairs.
Stayed a few days, had no complaints. Michael is very responsive.
Had a great stay! The home was exactly as pictured and described. Very convenient and exactly what we needed for our group of 4.

Would definitely recommend especially with such a fantastic view of downtown. The neighborhood felt safe and right at home. The place was very clean and convenient to all of chicago either by train/uber/bus/walking. The host gave clear instructions to the place especially when we had some difficulties that was easily cleared. Would come back!
was a wonderful place for my team and I

The place is as described, minus the ceiling fans. The view is even better than pictured, very beautiful and visible from the entire front of the unit. The layout of the unit was perfect for two couples traveling together, with separate bedrooms and bathrooms. The kitchen is well stocked with all the basics. The hosts were very responsive and helpful. The back bedroom was very cool, but the front room did get warm in the heat of the sun.
Angela is helpful and her place is very clean and spacious. Walking distance to different restaurants and shops in Chinatown.

The home was conveniently located and worked well for our group. We arrived to find that the home hadn’t been cleaned before our check-in, which wasn’t a great start to the stay. However, Adrian responded quickly and did a great job arranging for cleaners to come out right away to resolve the issue. We appreciated the prompt communication and effort to make things right, and we’d happily recommend this Airbnb to friends staying in the area.

The space is not entirely private—there’s a door across from the bed that leads directly into the host’s home, noise travels clearly, and you do not have control of the air temperature. The space was clean and organized, but due to the noise I did not sleep well. The patio is beautiful, but the neighborhood is not the safest for street parking and walking at night. Dominique was kind, but unfortunately I would not stay here again.

nice place, loved the garage, not much of a walkable area, but easy to drive everywhere in Chicago. comfy beds and pillows, but no AC vents in bedrooms - and of course we were there during a heatwave. also, lots of stairs; we were traveling with someone with mobility issues so was difficult for her. not a problem with the space, just a heads up for anyone who may have similar difficulties. James was a great host, quick responses and provided thorough checkin information.

This is review from guest, Kerri Klugman
If you want a friendly and comfortable stay choose this Airbnb! The hosts are super supportive and will help in many ways (for example allowing us to use their washing machine and clothes line for my daughter's wet camping clothes). They are both musicians and will share music with you if asked! They also will share the history of their home and the area. Their wonderful dog. Domino, will adopt you and, if you like, play with you. The back yard is available for sitting and the area is nice for walks. There are several yummy places to eat only a quick walk away. I highly recommend this wonderful home!
Very beautiful place, clean and the car garage was convenient , kept your car safe and quick access to building! Will definitely stay here again!!!

Really enjoyed our stay, the place was immactulate with lots of thoughtful details, and was nice and cool with air conditioning during a Chicago heat wave, so that was much appreciated. Easy to get in and out, beautiful neighborhood with great access to Lake Michigan and train.

We highly recommend the hosts and place! Great location, close to downtown and quiet at night. We really enjoyed our time, and we appreciated how responsive the hosts were about any questions or clarifications we needed. We look forward to visiting again!
Great location, great value, beds were comfortable, short walk to Wrigley!
10/10 would recommend!

I stayed at Lydias place for a week. It was exactly as per the photos. Lydia gave clear instructions re: check in etc. The place was clean and secure. It is located a 2min walk from the train station on the green line approx 15min journey to downtown.
I enjoyed my time and would recommend.
Liam Rahilly
Ireland

I had an absolutely amazing stay at this Airbnb. The home was spotless, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a relaxing visit. Every detail was thoughtfully prepared, and it truly felt like a home away from home.
Ivy was an exceptional host—kind, responsive, and incredibly welcoming from start to finish. Communication was seamless, and she made sure everything was perfect during my stay.
I highly recommend staying here to anyone looking for a beautiful place with outstanding hospitality. I would gladly stay here again. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

all in all the place was great!! the price was amazing, it was a 15min train ride to chicago city center and a 7min walk to united arena, which was the main reason i booked this place bc i was there for a concert!! it was really clean!! considering the price you are paying it was good, ofc some walls would need a new coat of paint or some maintenance would need to be done but if you don’t mind thats the perfect place for you to stay!! the host was really responsive and nice as well!! all in all i would come back!!

Great little spot couple blocks from oak Street beach. Old building but updated apartment. 4 of us stayed there comfortably. Very comfortable. Host is super responsive.   Only things that would improve it. Provide a microwave. So many restaurants in Chicago and we had so many leftovers.  Bathroom has a large step up to get into and out. A vertical grab bar on the wall outside the bathroom to safely go in and out would be great. Accident waiting to happen. Update the faucet handles for the shower. One of them kept falling off while we were showering and my daughter got scolded by hot water cause she couldn’t turn it down.  And the shower wall paint was bubbling and falling off from the humidity.
The host was so sweet. She was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. It was the perfect size for my family and I. Close enough to the city, but also far enough for a break. Very private.
This was a great place to stay in Chicago! We will definitely look to stay here again next time we’re in Chicago.
Great place, excellent location!

We were travelling with our 1 year old, so it was great to stay so centrally and yet, unlike a hotel, have access to a kitchen and washer/dryer too.
The apartment is an experience! On the 3rd floor, it's exactly level with the trains going by on the Loop. The noise is generally a faint rumbling, except occasionally when two trains pass at once, or they sound their horns! From the bedroom, it's less audible and the service reduces (and eventually stops) at night.
The only criticism I have is the light. The 'room-darkening shades', as listed, don't do much to block out the light. It remained light until the sun went down, which wasn't so ideal for toddler naps and early bedtimes, but we managed.
The apartment was very well-stocked, clean, and the gym and pool are decent enough too! Would recommend.
Great communication. Very clean !!
Great location to Wrigley Field. Very clean and accommodating to our family.

Good: Location is great. Easy to walk to Wrigley and plenty of restaurants. Place is pretty much as described.
Not so good: bathroom needs some sprucing up. If you have smaller kids make sure to not let them near the broken mirrors in the bathroom.
Terrible: If you are traveling with kids, please think twice about staying here during Pride Weekend. Streets are closed in the area from early Sunday to Monday and it is not safe to be out walking once the parade is over. We were unaware of the chaos that ensues well into morning hours and actually needed police escort to walk us several blocks back to the place. Now if you like chaos, police barricades, glass bottles being thrown, fireworks going off in the alley way and streets, then you’ll love this place in June.

Bozena was extremely helpful and responsive. We stayed for a month and loved our time there. The location was perfect with easy access to restaurants, transportation, the park, the zoo, and the beach. One of the best places to stay in Chicago.

A great place to spend the week. You can see pretty much what the place is like through the photos, but a few things you can’t:
It smelled nice, but didn’t smell to strongly of fragrance
Some of the ceilings are quite low, at 5’8 I didn’t have any issues but if you’re 6’0 or taller just be aware there are a few lower spots (it’s a basement location)
There are some pots and pans, mixing bowls, and even a small baking sheet under the oven, but cooking a shepherd’s pie without a casserole dish took some creativity with aluminum foil. Cooking and baking was still definitely very doable, just be sure to plan your meals after you’ve verified you have everything you need (including spices, the salt offered was extremely coarse and difficult to use)
The family living above the space was incredibly kind, and while there was occasional noise, it was infrequent and relatively quiet
All in all, it has its quirks, but is a great place to stay, close to many things, and I’d say worth the trip!

My friend and I had a wonderful stay at Anna and Daniel's place. They really went above and beyond to make us feel at home, including writing us a welcome letter, making us coffee and breakfast, offering us a ride, and sharing the berries from their garden. They were friendly and responsive and also gave helpful tips and recommendations for exploring Chicago. The room was super comfy and clean, and it was easy for us to come and go on our own time. Anna and Daniel were great hosts and I would definitely recommend staying with them.

Great location for a Cubs game. However, if you want to spend time further south (Obama Presidential Center for example) it is an hour train ride (not a problem; just something to note). We felt very safe in the neighborhood and walked at night multiple times from the train or bus stop. Cute coffee shop at the end of the block. Nice cold AC (we were there during the heat wave)!

location is everything and this place is perfect. Gold Coast is upscale and safe at night. Just a few steps from the mag mile with an outdoor space overlooking the street. Place was clean and well sound proofed from the busy street below. Why would anyone pay for a hotel room in the same area with the amenities that comes with this place. When we come back to Chicago we will sleep staying again.

Overall, the Airbnb matched the listing description, and the decor was stylish and thoughtfully done. The space looked like the photos, and the location and amenities were as advertised.
The only issue during our stay was that the air conditioning struggled to keep up with the extreme heat wave, so it never really cooled the space as much as we would have liked. While that may have been due to unusually high temperatures, it's something future guests should be aware of.
The biggest disappointment was the housekeeping. We found hair from previous guests in several areas, and the toilets were not cleaned to the standard we expected. A more thorough cleaning between stays would make a significant difference to the overall experience.
We enjoyed our stay. Great location! Easy street parking! Close to downtown and Chinatown!

This is a spacious place in a great neighborhood - very walkable to train, restaurants, other neighborhoods, and the lakefront. We never had an issue finding nearby parking, which was great. Overall, the unit had basic necessities and was comfortable, but it seemed like it was given a quick clean-up rather than a deep clean before our arrival. There was a musty smell, and the windows weren't easily openable. General clutter in the kitchen cabinets, and the blanket for the couch bed hadn't been washed. There is no cable television, only streaming channels. The laundry room wasn't easily accessible, so for a long trip, take that into consideration. We also couldn't get the dishwasher to run so washed our own dishes. Water pressure in the unit wasn't the best. The host was friendly and fairly prompt with responses to questions. We enjoyed our stay. With a little extra effort and touches, this could be a really great place!

Nancy’s place was the perfect homebase while our family was in town. Everything was as described and fully met our family’s needs. Plus, you cannot beat the location! We will definitely return again if we are looking for a place to stay in the future.
We loved Emrah’s place! The location was perfect and felt very safe. The loft was beautifully decorated and very comfortable. The kitchen was well stocked. We would definitely stay again!

The perfect spot for exploring Chicago! The apartment was perfectly equipped for our family of 4 and the location cannot be beat. The space was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed! Paula and Adriana were also very responsive and helpful.
Very great communication, and we were easily able to retrieve a ln item we accidentally left after check out with no issues! great experience
Jamisyn was amazing! She made sure to check with in us and left us the sweetest welcome basket. Would definitely stay again!
Very roomy.  Great for 3-5 people
Great place! Walked in after the cubs game while apartment was cool!
Great stay in the south loop. Right next to jackson L train and convenient to walk to a lot of places. Clean safe building with a nice view on the 17th floor. Apartment was modern and clean.
Nice place to stay with little warning before we stayed
Afsha’s place was perfect! Right off the 606 bike path and close to lots of bars and restaurants. Afsha was extremely responsive and helpful as a host. Highly recommend!

This is a spacious one bedroom in a fun neighborhood and the host communicated clearly. The laundry was a bonus. It was wicked hot when I was in Chicago and the AC worked great.  It was very clean and the pics described it well. Also quiet and I’m sensitive to noise.  The kitchen has a great stove/range, fridge etc but the cooking utensils were pretty sparse for a unit this good.

Overall, I had a great stay and really have no complaints. The location was good, and everything was as expected. The only downside was carrying heavy luggage up the stairs, which was a bit challenging. Other than that, I’d definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable place to stay.

My wife and I absolutely loved our stay here. The place feels genuinely homey and comfortable — a perfect choice for exploring downtown Chicago without the high cost or restrictions of traditional hotels. Free parking is a huge plus, and the location is close to downtown just as described, without the usual traffic hassles.
Marzena, the host, is incredibly kind and even allowed our children to visit us during our stay, which we truly appreciated. The unit is fully equipped with everything you need, and being able to cook made it feel even more like home. I also really enjoyed the lighting throughout the space — it added a warm, relaxing vibe to the entire stay.
This was truly a home away from home for us. We’ll definitely book this place again the next time we visit Chicago. Thank you, Marzena, for having us.
Megan and Alfredo were great hosts. They were very responsive and communicative throughout our stay. Their home was clean and spacious for our family of 6.
Great stay for a fun several days in Chicago!
Enjoyed our stay. Awesome location made the trip very easy.

It was a perfect place for us to stay to visit with our daughter in Edgewater. It was a quiet place and the a/c worked great during the heat wave! It was very clean and the breakfast items were very appreciated.  Richard and Peg were  available and checked on us during our stay. I would stay here again.
Die Unterkunft war super, die Betten sehr bequem. Ich würde diese Unterkunft jederzeit buchen. Es ist abends ruhig und man kommt nach downtown in ca 30 Minuten mit dem Auto
Comfy and accommodating, though I was slightly rushed out before check in with a knock on my door an hour before

The condo is exactly as pictured and described.  It is just a few blocks from Wrigley, making it great for going to a Cubs game, as well as hopping on the Red line to travel to other spots in Chicago. The  parking spot was great, a rare find in Chicago.  Karolina was always very responsive and helpful.  We would absolutely stay here again when we visit!!

Amazing stay. Amazing abnb. This place is nice and clean and have great appliances.
My only complaint is that street parking at night is difficult. I had to park almost half a mile away some nights and walk to the property.

The apartment was immaculate and spacious with a decent view from the living area into a northern view.  At the eleventh floor in a city of thirty and more story buildings,  it was up to par.  The kitchen, bath, and laundry areas were well-appointed and stocked.  The building was quiet, but not necessarily the area outside, with the Ell within a half block and a huge HVAC building adjacent, but this is Chicago in the Loop.  The comfortable bed made it easy to ignore the extraneous street sounds.  There was a pastry shop, convenience store, and a couple quick- eating spots on the ground floor.  The Alfred is so very central to both transit, restaurants, and many must-see sites that I don't think we could have chosen a better place.
Thank you!

Victor and Lalis were fantastic hosts. The previous guest had left the bathroom sink clogged and did not inform the host. We notified Victor and Lalis and they immediately had it taken care for us.
Complimentary beverages, snacks, body wash, and coffee bar made this one of the best Air Bnb stays I have had the pleasure of staying at.
I would 100% come back to this location the next time I visit Chicago!

The apartment was exactly what we hoped for. Everything is new and clean. The view from the 23rd floor is wonderful, especially the lights of the city at night. The floor to ceiling windows make the apartment spectacular.

Abel was extremely responsive and the unit met all our expectations. It was in a great location to go to Cubs games at Wrigley and visit the zoo and beach. Abel even left some food and drinks for us which was very nice. I would definitely rent the place again and would recommend it to others!
Had a ton of fun in the city. This place was very cozy and even though it was hot, it stayed cool throughout our stay.

We had a great SAFE stay!  Justin answered my many questions without being annoyed and responded very quickly.  The parking process was a bit confusing, but I did get everything I needed when I asked and I was so grateful for Rich's help getting parked or I'd never got my car in there. We don't park like that in the southern part of the state lol!! The unit is in a basement which was a bit unexpected and confusing to figure out which door the first time, but it was very clean, no musty feeling and glass blocks for natural light. My daughter is ready to live here!  We were in walking distance of everything we needed for two nights at Wrigley and Southport for breakfast and shopping. The bed was very comfortable. We didn't try the pull out. We barely used the couch and never even turned on the tv, we showered and slept here then on the go again so it was perfect. We did try to nap an afternoon, but footsteps and voices above were pretty loud, however, at night you could hear a pin drop!

A truly incredible 10/10 stay! Samantha and her family are incredibly kind, the neighborhood is so great and just a short walk to parks, walking paths, & delicious food/drinks. We spent several days working form the house & it was just what we needed, can’t recommend enough
Eric and his team was the best!!! CLEAN AS ADVERTISED!!! THAT'S WHAT MATTERED!! THANKS AGAIN!!!

I was on a solo trip so the space was perfect for me. It was very clean and well organized I personally didn’t need much but it still has everything you will need. Communication was top notch and every questioned was answered without me having to ask. If you’re familiar with area then you understand the parking situation if not know that parking isn’t really available you will most likely have to walk a block or three. Walking and Uber would be the best option.

Great Place! When we arrived the place had not been cleaned because of a mix up with the cleaners. Dubbs Mgmt responded right away and the cleaners came out and did a great job. Dubbs Mgmt compensated me for the inconvenience and the remainder of our stay was wonderful. I would highly recommend this place and I would book it again.

This is a great spot for any medium/large groups looking for a central Chicago spot. Great neighborhood, one block from MTA station, and plenty to do in the area. Just be prepared to get your steps in; a lot of stairs for both units!
Todo tranquilo

Cozy spot and a perfect home base to explore Chicago from. Just a 10 min walk from Southport station. But there are also lovely shops and restaurants in Lake View that you can walk to.
There is a coin operated washer dryer in the basement as well which was great!
Anne was very responsive to any questions and has a lovely set-up.

This rental was a good home base for visiting Wrigley. We were able to walk to the game and several great restaurants. Consistently found free parking one block east. The host improving disclosures regarding pet requirements.
BEST PLACE IVE STAYED IN SO FAR IN CHICAGO! Highly recommend!!
GREAT STAY

This place is charming. The rooms are large, the furnishings are just right. So clean!  Beds and pillows were comfy! Matt made it so easy to get in and out with clear, prompt messages. The location is very helpful. Walgreens is just down the street as well as good coffee shops, basic groceries and spirits. We will come back!!
Enjoyed our stay, felt right at home!

We stayed here for my son’s orientation at Loyola. The location was convenient and a quiet street. I booked my second stay before we left for this fall. I would definitely recommend staying here! Thanks, Ben!

Extremely small. One side is all window and very hot. Also why have a balcony if you can’t smoke?
Parking is separate from the building resulting in a far walk to the building while hauling your bags manually.
It was a beautiful apartment and we all loved it a whole lot!

Great customer service. Had an issue and was resolved in under 24 hours. Great views. Easy walk to all the things and buses pick up and drop off right at the corner. market in the building is also ideal for picking up kid snacks. GREAT STAY!!
非常好的住宿体验
Top notch view and very beautiful home. The hosts were great and very quickly responsive to anything I needed. I would recommend this place 10 times out of 10.

The neighborhood is VERY charming with many walkable restaurants and shops! We felt safe, and Vin did a great job of communicating and responding. The apartment is older than it appears in the pictures, but still very clean and livable. The apartment has window AC units (we were plenty cool on such a hot weekend!) but we blew a breaker while using the hair dryer. Even though it got pretty hot in there while we waited for power to be restored, Vin was VERY communicative and proactive in resolving the situation. He called maintenance IMMEDIATELY and we had power back in less than 2 hours!! That is what you want from a host!
We also liked that he “vetted” us before confirming the booking, making sure we’d be compatible with a quiet and calm apartment complex. That’s what we wanted… calm and relaxing…. And this place definitely provided that! We will stay here again in the future! Thank you, Vin!

Book direct through AirBnB, transaction was flawless.
Booked the exact same villa through Hopper and the reservation never went through. Hopper failed me tremendously and wouldn’t provide a refund.
Good stay and very responsive host.
Catherine was very responsive and helpful. The space was very clean and comfortable, in a pretty neighborhood. We had a great stay!
Amazing place to book, more than enough space! Great vacation stay
Great stay! Very responsive. Close to the L train and Wrigley! Would stay again!

A thoughtful, well-cared-for space with a personal touch that sets it apart from generic rentals. The apartment is clean, comfortable, and well-equipped — it's clear the owners put real care into making it feel like a home rather than just a listing. Lots of natural light, second floor, and a decoration that feels genuinely personal.
Practical details worth knowing: there's a supermarket right across from the metro station and packages can be received safely. The walk to the metro is about 15 minutes — worth keeping in mind when planning evening outings.
On value: the price point is on the higher side relative to the neighborhood. That said, the quality and care of the space itself are genuinely above average.

Pros: The home was beautiful and comfortable, in a peaceful area with little traffic. The grocery store and a dollar store was only a short drive away. We were able to park directly outside the unit most of the time (other times we were still within a block of the front door). The laundry was easily accessible and with quick and efficient machines which was helpful for a 5-day stay. The outdoor space was well maintained and comfortable. We overall had a wonderful stay.
Cons: The temperature was difficult to control, so the downstairs stayed very cold throughout the stay. The place was clean but we did notice some ants roaming in a bedroom window sill. The upstairs unit was noticeable with the floors and stairs being fairly creaky; the guests weren’t disruptive but rather the sound just seemed to travel between units. Overall a fantastic stay, and loved the theater space downstairs. Well worth its cost and short drive from a great beach and all the downtown attractions.

Everything with the stay was great with one minor issue. The pool table was not balanced and all balls settled towards the  middle. Told Rob about it midway through the stay just so he was aware. He said he would look at it after our stay so it may be fixed.

This place was an amazing value in Chicago! Great for families with washer/dryer, and kitchen. We really appreciated the coffee, tea, laundry detergent, dishwash detergent, kitchen sponge, trash bags and toiletries that were provided. It made traveling with our kids so much easier! The views were amazing from all windows! It was a less than 10 minute walk to the train.
Tres propre et facile d’accès, je recommande.

Very nice location and had a responsive host. It was pretty clean but well loved. You can walk to the train or bus easily. Found it to be a quiet and a ok neighborhood. Some things needed to be replaced or fixed better, such as loose outlets, and broken towel racks and tp holder. Very strict on rules for the kitchen but it was also a very clean kitchen. The steps going in need some TLC as the wood is loose and unstable. But besides that it was an ok stay for only being there to sleep and such.
Great place to stay! Convenient parking and location is close to most attractions.

Best Airbnb we ever stayed in. Great spot
For the best part of Chicago
Nice location and house.
great deal for a great place to stay! thank you, Alle

We had a lovely stay in this airbnb. It was very spacious as we had the entire basement floor and very private. The location is great in Pilsen with easy access to train and bus services into central Chicago. Abigail is an excellent host and very responsive.
Second time staying and I enjoyed it again. I’ll be back before summer ends!

Our stay was fantastic! We loved the proximity to Wrigley Field and the Red Line. Victor was a wonderful host and was very responsive and helpful! Check-in and check-out were super easy, and although we did not rent a car this time, the available parking at the home would be great if we did! We would definitely stay here again!

Very clean and had everything we needed!
Thank you for a great stay!

The apartment is beautiful and in a great location, making it very convenient for public transport.
However, there are a few wear-and-tear issues that need attention. The bathroom door lock and one of the bedroom locks are not functioning properly. Additionally, some of the living and dining room furniture require maintenance—particularly the rocking chair, which is unstable and unfortunately caused an injury to my wife.
There was also some confusion regarding the checkout time. The booking information mentioned a 12 noon checkout, but I later received instructions indicating 11 AM. Thankfully, the host was able to accommodate the original 12 noon timing.
Overall, it was a pleasant stay, but addressing these issues would significantly improve the experience.
Easily the best Airbnb experience I could’ve had! Suzanne is one of the most caring people I’ve met and I would definitely stay here again.

Highly enjoyed our stay at Alex’s place. We love the Andersonville neighborhood and the location couldn’t be beat. We’re only about a block from all the shops and restaurants yet the house is also in such a quiet neighborhood. The house was very clean and well taken care of. Loved all the plants around the home and the overall design/decorations. Check-in and checkout was also extremely easy.
This location was great! Charlie was very proactive and detailed with their notes on how to find the place and access it. They were also very responsive to questions that I had about parking.
Felt right at home at Danny’s. Was immediately with the cleanliness, and location of this home. Will absolutely stay here again.

Tuan's place was overall good. He and other host members were exceptionally kihd. a few things were left behind from a previous guest ( trash etc) but I told them and they addressed it. I would highly recommend. Their kindness went above and beyond.
The neighborhood has a lovely park within walking distance as a plus! i would recommend a stay.
Great communication and very accommodating!
Great garden unit! There was also a rabbit that greeted me every time I came through the gate, so that was great :)

Jay’s place is beautiful, clean and perfectly located. Jay was very responsive and super helpful. I love this neighborhood and this space. I will return to Chicago and will stay here again! Thanks Jay!
In Chicago for a wedding with a group can be difficult to find enough space, but this had plenty of space and tons of walkable restaurants for everyone!
House is clean and feel's like home. The Host is Very accomodating and easy to deal with! We'll book again!
We felt right at home and loved the view from the patio. Close to posts of attractions, coffee, and dining.
Loved it !
The building was easy to find, the instructions/directions were very thorough!
Nos sentimos como en casa. La casa estaba bien agradable y hermosa. La sala de teatro excelente para una noche familiar despues de un largo dia de caminar.
Great location, family friendly, and above and beyond host.

The home is spacious and easy to access. The garage parking is a plus. There are a few parts of the home that could use some maintenance, but not bad value for the space as long as you do not have any issues which require the host’s attention during your stay.
We arrived during a record breaking heatwave! The windows were open and the fans were on in every room when we arrived which immediately concerned me. The thermostat read 88° in the home and never cool down. The A/C was blowing warm air the entire time. Despite reaching out to the host several times about it, they never offered any real assistance outside of typical troubleshooting. The third floor was uninhabitable due to the heat which left us down several beds. By morning after being offered no solutions from the host we had to leave as no one in our family had gotten any sleep.

Location was so good! So happy we chose this area over staying downtown.  It’s very walkable and easy to pop in and out of the Airbnb. We enjoyed our stay, and appreciate the ability to check in a tad early with an earlier flight. Thank you.
10/10 will stay again!!

what a terrific place. views from the balcony are amazing. it is a terrific apartment in a building with excellent amenities.
location is tough to beat, with so many restaurants and bars in walking distance, as well as the Riverwalk.
Jeri Lou and James were wonderful hosts and made my stay a truly great experience. 10/10
Felt very homey and welcoming! Great stay!!

This home is luxurious, from the towels and bedding, to the tastefully done, beautiful decor. The ambiance is sophisticated and comfortable. The teenagers loved the large, shared bedroom and all the games. Restaurants and bars are very close, within a short walk. Next time we want to stay longer to enjoy reading one of the books you provided with our coffee in the morning and finish the evening reading with a glass of wine. Thank you, Sam!
Lovely place with lovely light, lots to walk to in the area.
Convenient location to see sights and get around Chicago. Stephanie was very responsive and helpful.
The host and co-host were clear, responsive, and took feedback very well.
The Airbnb was perfect, everything was exactly how it was shown in the pictures. Communication was great, and overall I was very satisfied with my stay. I’ll definitely be booking again.
Good quiet place to crash in Chicago for a great deal!
Lovely host . Very kind and helpful . Place in great location easy to commute .

The Hyde Park 2 Bedroom Retreat was clean, comfortable, and in a great location, with an easy check-in. However, several issues prevented this from being a five-star stay. My original reservation for Katty's Rock-and-Roll-themed condo was accepted, then canceled without explanation, and relisted at a higher price, leaving me uneasy when I later booked the unit and discovered she owned it as well. Before our arrival, an early check-in offer was presented without initially mentioning the $50 fee (I declined it). The unit was clean, but there was no Wi-Fi, and the hot water pressure was extremely low. Most concerning, the tub had no non-slip mat or grab bar. My 77-year-old mother slipped and fell while showering. Thankfully, she wasn't seriously injured. I notified Katty afterward and suggested adding safety features, but I have not received a response almost 24 hours later. A five-star rating should reflect a five-star experience, and unfortunately, this stay fell short of that standard.
Great location to explore the north side of Chicago and attend a few cubs games.  Communication was great and instruction to check in very easy to understand.  Would highly recommend to anyone.

My whole stay was so peaceful and relaxing. Had a great time and definitely recommend this place for a stay in Chicago. Walkable distance to the Millennium park and restaurants. Friendly staff and especially the responsive  and kind host. Thank you!
It was great we were very happy and satisfied very clean thank you
We loved the house. It was our first Chicago visit and we most definitely will be coming back. My kids loved the design and the area. Easily to get to Target right down the road.
Jane was very responsive with any questions. The space was comfortable and the air worked great with the heat wave Chicago was having during our visit.
super nice
Very comfortable and great stay!
Nice place west of Lake View, quiet area 25 mins from city. Place was clean and spacious in the living area. Only problem is that the toilet didn’t flush paper, but other than that, perfect.

We enjoyed our stay at Tracee’s place!  The place has a simple elegance - not cluttered, but had everything we needed.  The area is very walkable.  We found a great place for breakfast a block away and a grocery store a few blocks away.  We felt comfortable and safe.

Overall a great stay! Retrieving keys was simple, there was plenty of parking. Nice area right by the lake. Apartment was very clean and had a nice smell. Everything in the unit was exactly as described. I would definitely stay at/ recommend this place to any solo traveler or couple looking for a nice simple retreat with good location. I read reviews before booking and saw that one thing people complained about was the walls. Walls are slightly dirty upon first couple of steps into unit. DEFINITELY NOT deal breaker dirty. Host was very nice & helpful and also responded very quickly which was a blessing. Long story short 9.9 out of 10, absolutely would stay here again!!

Great location, lots of good food, very accessible to the city, and pretty much everywhere.
Place was very spacious and in a quiet neighborhood, despite being so close to many visited places.
We will definitely be staying here again next time we are in Chicago!

Heather’s apartment was the perfect place for our recent visit to Chicago.  Lots of restaurants and a grocery within walking distance, easy to find parking in spothero and the apartment was just as gorgeous as the photos.  We would definitely book again!

Wonderful neighborhood, felt very safe. Walking to public transportation, restaurants and entertainment was easy. We enjoyed Mochinut for matcha and donuts, Nadu for Indian food, Bourgeois Pig for afternoon coffee and Kingston Mines for blues music. Nice apartment and very responsive host. Just be prepared for stairs at the apartment and at the “el” trains.

A few hours away from checking in we were told a bathroom toilet was not working in one of the bedrooms. It could not be fixed until after our stay. Once we arrived at the house it was so hot you could immediately tell the AC was not functioning. The host was quick to respond and got a maintenance worker out there, however this should have been checked before anyone arrives. We had to find an open hotel last minute with our young kids. The next day we were informed the AC was broken and was an inconvenience to them because that’s how they make money. We had to find another hotel room at an available place in wrigleyville. We were only able to find 2 nights available out of our 4 original planned nights within our budget. We drove 24 hours for a 36 hour stay in Chicago. Missed reservations and sad kids. To avoid anything like this with your family I would make sure the host checks everything before you arrive.

Great, easy spot in the city. The place was spotless and really well maintained. The location was super convenient with easy access to transportation, lots of great restaurants, grocery stores (Jewel and Trader Joe’s), playgrounds, and plenty to do nearby.
We especially appreciated all the kids' gear and toys—it made traveling with little ones so much easier. We'd definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

Would definitely recommend and stay at this property again. It was spacious, clean, and in an excellent area of which we were able to utilized by either walking or taking the cta/metra.
The hosts were excellent. They responded in a timely manner with clear direction and gave proper information.

John & Gorkem’s place was just what we needed for our stay while we came in for a concert and some local exploring! It was as described, they are both the friendliest people ever and their 4 cats are the best! We had our own space but it also felt like we were at a friend’s house when we did want to socialize and like we had know them for years—they are so easy going! They are also so accommodating and overall it was a great stay!
It is a shared bathroom but we didn’t have any issues with not having it when we needed it.
The bed is really comfy, it’s in a good neighborhood that’s very walkable & close to public transit and also has nearby street parking available if you do have a vehicle. We will definitely be back if we find ourselves in Chicago again! :)

The cleanest Airbnb ever! Every detail was taken to make sure the spacious apartment was thoroughly cleaned before the arrival.
Jorge was was very friendly and responsive. He went above and beyond to ensure a smooth stay.
The patio was awesome at night. Food readily available nearby. This place is also very close to the lake.
Don't hesitate, just book it!

Great place to stay in downtown Chicago. Close to transportation and restaurants.
A little noisy with trains, but only until 11pm

Location is ideal! Walking distance to tons of restaurants and other entertainment. The apartment was so cute and exactly as pictured. It is an old apartment but we found that it truly is part of the charm and experience. Since you are close to a very popular destination it can stay loud fairly late with vehicles when there are events nearby. Normal for being in the city and we use a white noise machine so we were fine (there was even one provided if you didn't bring your own!) We loved all the extra touches that made us feel more at home, all the goodies were very much appreciated. One of the things we worry about is the AC in older buildings. We like it fairly cool, especially when we sleep. We were there during a significant heat wave and the units held up beautifully! We never once felt uncomfortable. Our daughter lives nearby so we will absolutely stay in one of Aaron's properties next time we are in town!

Tere's place was exactly as pictured. We did have a little trouble with the lock to get into the building but think it was just because it was old and once we figured out the secret (push in while turning the key in the lock) we didn't have any more issues and Tere was quick to send me a code to try if we couldn't get the key to work. And yes, as others have mentioned the floors are old and creak a lot, but as we were only there at night to sleep this was not an issue for us. Tere was very responsive any time we had an issue or question and the place was a good value for us for what we needed.

We booked this home for my grandmother’s 85th birthday. The entrance requires climbing 21 very steep stairs that are not shown in the listing photos. We had to carry her up the stairs and would not have booked had the access been clearly represented.
We planned to host the celebration on the patio. The patio is directly beneath a train line, with trains passing overhead about every 20 minutes at approximately 100 dB. The noise made the outdoor space unusable for our event.
We found used balloons in the living room and food under one of the beds, suggesting the home had not been thoroughly cleaned before check-in.
Other issues included smart locks that frequently required multiple attempts to unlock, no shades on a west-facing window, and limited air conditioning, making the home difficult to keep comfortable during the afternoon.

Sharon was an amazing host! She was quick to respond, though I had few questions because all of the instructions were so clear. The location is great, walkable to lots of food, transit and parks, while still being quiet and neighborly. The kitties were such a bonus and so sweet to hang out with whenever I wanted to relax. 100/10 recommend if you're looking for a right at home feel while traveling!
Jevaux’s location on Belmont was perfectly situated and quite clean.

Laura is one of the most proactive and responsive hosts we’ve had. The house is beautifully decorated and has lovely exposed brick throughout. It was surprisingly quiet and private even while being in an area with lots of bar and restaurant options. Beds are very comfortable, and the kitchen is stocked with cooking staples. Short walk to transit options. Great location for exploring Chicago!
Always my first choice when I come to town to visit. Jasa is a great host and very responsive

10 minutes away from millennium park, has every amenity listed, very comfy clean beds, and over all close to downtown. there’s a mcdonald’s, wendy’s, and taco bell down the street aswell. would love to stay here again!
This was a great space for us to visit and relax after each day’s adventures. Very clean and comfortable. Ben was a great host.
Due to other circumstances, we were in a situation to find a place with very short notice and it was spectacular!

Check-in was very easy, we had Patrick and he was amazing and so kind! Every time we came back to the hotel, everyone greeted us and was friendly. The location couldn’t be better especially for the price, you’re right near the magnificent mile, millennium park and the L loop. You do have to pay an extra fee everyday that you’re staying but you pay it all at once when you arrive and I feel like the price is worth what you pay, anytime we needed waters or towels they sent them directly to our room and there were specific times during the day when you could go to the rooftop bar and get free drinks. Room was extremely clean and updated. We actually were in Chicago for to see 2 different sporting events so it was really cool to see everything sports themed!

Enjoyed our stay at Carlo’s place- great host, super clean, cozy and quiet. Perfect home base to explore
Chicago. Carlo was very gracious and helpful. Highly recommend!!

Great stay, I love the pilsen neughborhood and the pink line is my favorite train. Was nearby transport and local eats. The place itself was a great stay as well !! Cozy rooms and living room and the deck was my favorite !!! A bit pricey but definitely worth the price all things considered. Julissa was also a very communicative host and very kind and helpful. Would definitely stay here again !!

Andreea and Shaun are wonderful hosts. Andreea always greets us with a friendly welcome and she is very accommodating,  making us feel right at home. The space is clean and organized, with plenty of snacks, fresh fruit, breakfast food and drinks. This was our second time staying at Andreea's and Shaun's and we are definitely coming back. Thank you for sharing your home with us

Really enjoyed our stay! Comfortable and clean apartment. Host was very responsive and organized with a binder of instructions and recommendations. There are pretty steep steps leading to the unit and then steps again when you enter, but this was not an issue for us. We walked to the nearby train station and also used Uber to get in and out of the city. Enjoyed the restaurants around the Airbnb as well.

Great location. Park once and you can walk or take the train.
Good space. Comfortable. Everything we needed for cooking was in the kitchen.
We have stayed other places in Chicago, but this is our new favorite. Price point is fair.
Great stay!
A beautiful and lively area. You will find beautiful murals along the way!

Loved staying here! I'm from Chicago and wanted to book an Airbnb as I had friends in town. Great residential location in Lincoln Park, cute patio, and just a great place for 2 couples. Would definitely stay here again!
Great location. Enjoyed our stay. Would definitely rent again.
Excellent experience.  Huge area and great location to Wrigley!

Came to celebrate my birthday and the just was very responsive. Located in a great area, a lot of things are in walkable distance. The loft itself is spacious and was clean. The host was very responsive. Would book again!
We loved the home and the location.  Julius responded within minutes and provided everything we needed.  We will stay here again if it's available.
Lovely place
Great spot! Host was clear and responsive.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described, in a fantastic neighborhood, and was a perfect fit for our family vacation. The host was communicative and helpful throughout our trip.
A few things worth knowing for future guests: the twin beds in the second bedroom are on the firm side (our boys said they were very hard, though some people may prefer that!), and you can hear the CTA train rumbling throughout the night. It didn’t disrupt anyone’s sleep, but light sleepers may want to bring earplugs. Overall it was a great experience and would stay here again!

This spot was perfect for our two night stay while we went to a Cubs game - great location, comfortable bed and nice space overall. There were several steps involved in getting into the unit however Charie provided clear instructions. The wifi didn’t seem to be accessible, but Charie responded to my inquiry about this when I asked for help. Overall great stay. Thank you!
House was large enough, barely an outside space, no 2nd bedroom with king. Place was tired and needs to be updated and repairs done

Spacious, clean, comfortable space for some of our family members to gather together and see more of Chicago after our son's wedding! Plenty of walkable restaurants nearby for takeout meals and easy to access rideshare or the bus line to get to all of Chicago's big attractions.

Great location with so much to walk to including restaurants, coffee shops, target, the zoo, beach, etc. It is on the first floor of the building so there was some noise from the street and other tenants but to be expected in a city! If you are looking for a spot in this neighborhood, it is a great spot. Beds were super comfy!
The location was amazing. The property was also clean and in great condition. The host and the management team was Johny on the spot the entire way. We’d definitely recommend this place.

The next time we're in Chicago we will check to see if Lydia and Mayra's place is available first! Outside the hustle of downtown (which is what we wanted), it was an easy walk to the L Train to get everywhere we wanted to go. We felt very safe and easily understood the instructions to get inside. Be prepared for any kind of neighbor in the shared Airbnb, but the place itself was perfect. There were a couple of minor hiccups with some of the appliances, but Mayra or Lydia responded VERY quickly and had a solution prepared! Definitely a great place to stay!
Great host and place to stay had a great experience highly recommend!

The property itself was nice, clean and in a neighborhood with plenty of access to food and convenience stores. Be mindful of local events that might be going on. I was not aware of the pride parade which was in the area the day of check-in. Many streets were blocked for several hours into the evening that made accessing the property and area businesses difficult.
Eric was great at responding quickly whenever I had a question. The place was very clean, and had everything we could have needed. A short walk away from Lincoln Square and the L train as well.

Great location not too far out from downtown with an L station nearby. It was clean and exactly what I was expecting. Host made everything easy and responded quickly. Definitely would stay here again.

I felt like I got more than I paid for with this place.  I’m from Chicago, and was in town for a business trip, but wanted to extend it a bit longer, so I booked here for my bonus days.  And since I’m familiar with Chicago, I just kinda grabbed a spot that would work where I didn’t have to sell my first born 😆. But it was really fantastic.  Clean. Easy access. Close to good food, good beer, fantastic breakfast, and public transportation.  The place itself was clean, and since it was so very hot out during our visit, the AC did not disappoint.  All in all, I’d definitely come back and stay longer if I was planning something more deliberate and not just a quick random couple of days.  Communication was quick and helpful.  Would definitely stay again.

We couldn’t have asked for a better stay! Dan was a fantastic host—friendly, communicative, and always quick to help if we had a question. The home was clean, comfortable, and made the perfect home base for our week in Chicago.
Thank you for helping make our trip such a great experience. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to future guests!
