Had a wonderful time here , she went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect & that I was enjoying my stay. Super quick to answer any questions I had.
Would definitely stay here again. 😊

Kareem's place perfectly met me and my girlfriend's needs, everything was super clean and exactly as advertised. The area is calm and safe. Kareem himself is friendly and makes you feel welcome. In room minifridge comes stocked with waters and snacks when you arrive. Bathroom was quite literally spotless. Kareem has installed code/finger-print activated locks on the doors in the apartment that make the apartment easily accessible for guests while maintaining security.
We had a great time in Chicago at some baseball games! This was a perfect place to stay and having a garage for parking was a huge bonus!
Jefferson es una persona muy amable y atenta. Su hogar es muy cómodo y está muy bien conectado con transportes y es fácil moverse desde ahí. Me encantó su alojamiento.
Sarah’s place was great- the location was superb and she gave excellent recommendations for things in the area
Super location and wonderful hosts. We had a really nice time!

Rental was as described. It was perfect for my daughter and I who were in town for 2 concerts. It was a good base to be able to explore  Chicago. Having a parking spot was a plus after seeing how awful the parking is in Chicago. Neighborhood was very nice. Able to walk to restaurants, coffee shops, ice cream. We also love  to walk so we chose to walk to Lincoln Zoo and the beach ( about a 30 minute walk) . Close to a lot of things. No issues with our stay.

Location was great! There's a convenient store kiddy corner to the condo! Parking was probably the biggest negative, but it's as stated in the description! A block over though there is a paid parking ramp which is nice! Walking distance to Michigan Lake where there's a beach to swim, beautiful scenery, and parks every block! When we arrived, there was maintenance issues of a leak in the ceiling in the bathroom, which I informed him of and he sent maintenance after confirming I was fine with that. There were also a couple bugs here and there, but all were harmless ones.. Upstairs neighbors do make random loud noises, but he leaves ear plugs in every room for your wanting! Wasn't needed, but for those who are light sleepers perhaps... Overall it was really a great place to book and he was very attentive and helpful, even before we arrived! I would highly recommend!

We really enjoyed staying here! The accommodations were great and Ryan and Josie were very responsive to any questions we had!
All the restaurant recommendations were spot on!
We would 100 percent stay here again!

The apartment is in a very cute neighborhood, the Ukraine Village where you can walk to interesting restaurants, coffee shops, dive bars. It is just 15 minutes from downtown by car, and there is a bus stop  just a block away. The apartment has everything that one could possible need including a fully tooled kitchen and an office with a small printer. The place was clean and very comfortable with a big tv where we watched some of the World Cup. The bed is very comfortable with lots of pillows and extra blankets. There is a cute rear balcony with a beautiful grape vine that provides privacy and we caught some sun and ate on open air. The hosts were very helpful and responded right away.

From arrival to departure everything was great. There was only two times we needed some items replaced and Dennis was right on it. All we had to do was text him.
Wrigley Field is within sight. The Cubs played one night and you could hardly hear anything.
Dennis's Airbnb was clean and tidy. Our bed was very comfortable. There were six of us sharing and we had plenty of room. Loved the mini bathroom!!!
Saurin was so nice, helpful. Would recommend with my eyes closed.
Great location - less than 10 minute walk to nearest CTA station. Very responsive and helpful host.
Ari’s attic was great for our needs! Great location, we were able to park the car and walk/use public transit throughout our stay. Everything was clean and comfortable.
The owners were communicative and this was a good place to stay for our family trip to Chicago.
My friends and I had a great stay at Rashad's place. It was beautiful and easy to find.
Great place!

I’m a supervisor slash manager for An AirBNB company Housekeeping Department I’m big On Cleanliness I Will Be Returning to this property Communication excellent cleanliness excellent clear instructions very comfortable great amenities overall great stay no complaints 10/10
I loved our 1st cousins stay here there were 11 of use and with space it worked
Quiet peaceful neighborhood that is a quick walk to the Brown and Purple Lines.  Great restaurants nearby and very close to Second City which I recommend checking out.
Gracias Valeriy por una estupenda estancia. El lugar impecable, limpio, seguro. Recomiendo este lugar.
This is a good spot if you want to stay out of the downtown area but close to everything.
Steven’s place feels like home to me!

Great location, great communications with host, just average unit amenities. Examples include very minimal kitchenware, minimal towels, no extra blankets, low levels/low quality body wash and shampoo in showers, very cheap/thin toilet paper. The blinds were all left up by the cleaners which made the unit very hot at check-in and were very difficult to lower. Good value for the price based on comparable area hotels however, nothing special to give it an at-home feeling.
This Airbnb was in a perfect area of Chicago walking distance to public transportation, entertainment, bars and restaurants.

My friends and I were in town for a conference and enjoyed our stay.  Location was close to the convention center (even when carrying 40-50 pounds of books) and the Red and Green lines.  Place was clean and had a fresh smell, even with the 420 friendly rating.  Woud stay here again.

Vin was an amazing host! Very responsive, very informative and great response time.
Apartment had great local grocers and restaurants in walking distance. Apartment was clean and a great value. Would definitely book again!

Un agréable studio idéal pour votre séjour à Chicago. A 5 min à pied du métro qui vous amène dans le centre de la ville rapidement. Le quartier est très mignon, paisible, nous avons même régulièrement rencontré des écureuils, lapins et jolis oiseaux. L’accès à l’airbnb était un peu compliqué mais une fois que nous avions compris, c’était OK. Le logement ne bénéficie pas de la lumière du jour mais c’était OK pour nous. La cuisine était super moderne et équipée nous avons pu préparer de bons petits plats. Légère odeur d’ancien dans l’appartement. Beaucoup de serviettes et tout ce qu’il faut pour votre confort. Les voisins du dessus faisaient un peu de bruit. Mais dans l’ensemble, c’était très bien.

It was a basement property which’s sounds awful,the road noise comes in due to a cheap window,bad smell because underground property.
I’m not recommending anyone to book this property
Perfect spot to relax and unwind while touring
Exactly as described . I loved how close it was to public transportation. Walkable neighborhood.

Our stay at Maria’s was quite pleasant!! The space was a lot bigger than how we perceived it through the images. She provided the space with a lot of common needs and toiletries and everything was easy to find. We both found this particular Airbnb charming and would recommended to anyone who is looking to stay in Chicago!

Our first trip to Chicago was a great one. This airbnb was part of the great experience. It is in a beautiful neighborhood with dining and buses within walking distance. The room itself is perfect with everything you could want or need when away from home. Scott was a gracious host, very pleasant and easy to talk to. We are very happy with our choice and would, without a doubt, stay here again.
Tyler’s place was cozy and in a great location! Very responsive and flexible host. Highly recommended!

We loved Danielle's apartment! The location is great - very walkable to Logan Square and easy access to the L for getting around the city. Even though it was incredibly hot outside, her unit has two window ACs that kept the location very cool. We would stay there again!

What an amazing find!  I visit Chicago frequently and I am so excited to have found Joshua’s beautiful home.  Perfect location, upscale accommodations, and Joshua was friendly, helpful and so accommodating.  I highly recommend this lovely property.

We had a great stay! The unit was perfect for my wife and child and had all the amenities we needed for a longer stay. It was spacious, located on a quiet street, and parking was easy. Everything was comfortable and well-maintained. We would definitely book this property again the next time we’re in the area.

We really enjoyed our stay here!! Khadija gave really clear instructions about check in and check out. She checked in on us a few times to see if we needed anything and to ask how we were doing. Overall we had an amazing time and would love to stay again.
Rene was extremely responsive and helpful for any needs! Great host to work with- no complaints.
Very cozy, close to a lot of great restaurants and bars. Even extended my stay because there was so much to do around the apartment. Demitri was so good about communicating!!

it was a pleasure staying here! finding parking nearby was NOT hard which is almost a necessity for me! the place was clean, quiet, and just what you need to wind down after a long day in the city! the host was so helpful and made checking in and finding their place less stressful !
It was easy to get in, nice bathroom, and comfortable bed
Wonderful location and a cute place, hosts were very helpful and responsive.

Vins listing was perfect for me & my family 9/10 overall terrific fast replies & also very reliable.Hope to book this listing again in the future . Also 10/10 On the area for lots of green spaces & close stores nearby for me & my family
Great place, really close to the metro station.

Overall, the place was in a great location, very close to most attractions and bus stops if you prefer to use public transportation. Communication with Milan was excellent—he responded very quickly whenever we had a question. We were very happy with our stay and would definitely recommend this place to others.
I stayed for to nights and enjoyed the space and how easy it was to get to the train..  would recommend you anyone

Had a great stay. Michael was an excellent host and provided everything you could need. Would definitely stay here again and definitely recommend staying here if you are attending a conference at McCormick place, location was perfect!
Larissa was a nice host. She was easy to communicate with and very accommodating. The neighborhood is phenomenal.
Great location, lots to do. The apartment is spacious, bright, and very clean. Looks just like the photos. David is a super responsive and helpful host. Overall great experience

Really enjoyed our stay. The unit is even better than the pictures; it was well-stocked, comfortable, very clean, and the mattresses and linens were comfortable and cozy. The area is extremely safe, and walkable to absolutely everything, from parks and bike trails to restaurants and grocery stores. Perfect spot to enjoy Chicago while still being in a quiet family neighborhood. Joe was extremely helpful and quick to respond.  Can’t wait to return!
A perfect location, very close to both the Red Line and Brown Line subway stations. Sean is a great host—very responsible.

Katty is a fantastic host! The apartment is immaculate. Spotless! The issue is the location and the parking at night. As stated, there is street parking, however it is very limited and in an area that is not so safe(my experience) at night. Every night of my stay, there was an issue with rowdy people at night. This is out of Katty’s control, but should be known.
Accommodations were well described, close to blue line so that was a plus.
Great stay!

This location was great for West Loop. Lots of restaurants within walking distance. The host was very responsive  when I had questions. The L train is close by, it can be heard when it comes and goes if you are in living room and kitchen. Bedrooms were quiet though.  I would overall recommend this place and stay again.

Walkable to Lake Michigan and several green areas/nice neighborhoods nearby. Very clean and reasonably stocked with kitchen necessities like plates, cups and coffee maker, etc. Outdoor area to enjoy as well as common area. Weekend noise of comings and goings was tolerable but weekdays were fine. Lack of parking wasn’t an issue as I either walked or Ubered. Some street people in the area made me a bit wary but most didn’t engage at all or were considerate when asking for donations.

Le logement est parfait, tel que la description le mentionnait.   Tout est propre et l'hôte est facile à joindre tout au long du séjour.  C'est facile d'accès de la ligne bleue du métro à 20 min de l'aéroport et à 25 min du centre-ville.   Le cartier est très propre et sécuritaire.   Je recommande !
Central location near Newberry Library. The place was clean. Host was very accommodating.

My husband, doggy, and I had a terrific stay at Matthew’s place for a month. He is an extremely responsive, proactive, and accommodating host. The apartment is spacious, well appointed, and has everything you need for a long-term stay. The neighborhood feels serene, inspiring, and safe. The apartment is super close to the train, and there are a ton of restaurants, bars, etc. nearby. I would love to stay there again. Highly recommend!
They stay was amazing and Russell was very responsive when I had questions I absolutely loved the bathtub and shower in the main bedroom and it had a lot of stuff in a walkable distance
Anthony’s place was fantastic. Great location, plenty of room, and everything we expected it to be.

Very well appointed unit. The layout and large separate kitchen makes it feel larger than a studio and I really enjoyed the way the host seemed to have eveeything I could need down to little things like scissors in the kitchen and shampoo and conditioner in the shower and extra blankets in the living and bedroom space. Location is great too with easy access to the Morse redline, UP-N Metra and Clark bus so I was easily able to get anywhere in the city. There’s a beautiful beach nearby as well.
Host was also very friendly and helpful. Loved the photos and easy instructions for check-in and how quickly and easily we resolved a minor wifi issue. Would definitely stay here again in the future!

Harry’s place was ideal for our budget and needs. We were in town for a Cubs game and the free parking spot, proximity and space to stay were great. You can even see Wrigley from the window. The apartment needs some repair, especially in the kitchen and it wasn’t clean, but Harry was responsive and very friendly. Staying in communication with him was easy.
Millie, l’hôte, est accueillante et très gentille. Elle est réactive face à nos questions. Le logement était très agréable et propre. Un grand merci
Excellent location. Very thoughtful host… everything we needed for a comfortable stay was there for us.
Nice place, comfortable, clean, host was easy to communicate with and very helpful
This was our second time in this location and it is great!  Close to Lincoln Park and Wrigley Field as well!

Air-conditioning was good and the beds were comfortable. Ann had provided us parking permits for our time there, but we still got a parking ticket on the day we were checking out. The carpets and couch need to be cleaned. There were spider webs in the window. There was only one frying pan which was dirty so we had to use another pot for making eggs. The alley leading to the back of the house and the entrance needs to be properly power washed, it was so dirty with green algae all over and dead leaves from fall, and there were lots of bugs and mosquitos there which made going in and out an unpleasant experience. There was no garbage bag in the trash can, nor anywhere in the unit.
We feel that in the amount we paid we could have gotten a better facility.

Initially we wished that this unit was closer to Lincoln Square — but it turned out to be a terrific location. The neighborhood is so pretty. It is a sweet walk to Lincoln Square. And we LOVED having the brown line stop literally across the street. This did mean that there is train noise that you hear all the time in the condo but we soon got used it. And it could not have been more convenient to hop on the train to go wherever we wanted. The unit was also very nice and clean and exactly as described. We would definitely stay here again.

Michael’s place was a very well equipped place to stay. There were so many options walking distance to the apartment, yet it was quiet for being in the city. Great neighborhood vibe and so much to do steps from the apartment. The convenient parking and outdoor spaces are wonderful! I would recommend staying here and would love to be able to stay again in the future.

Great location w lots of restaurants and multiple coffee options. Appreciated 3 actual bedrooms w queen beds that were very comfortable. Recommend the earplugs as Division stay busy quite late. Hospital in the next block so sirens. Would stay there again.

This is a great place to stay in Chinatown! The condo is clean with plenty of space. Michael was very responsive throughout the stay. You’re close to the red line and there are several bus stops walkable. I’d definitely stay here again.
It was a great home away from home. Very cozy and a definite must stay again whenever we are in the city. Beautiful view and very peaceful thanks again. Can’t wait till the next stay ❤️

This was my second time staying at Eileen’s place and it won’t be my last. Very walkable area with great shopping and restaurants nearby and only a 7 minute walk from my kid’s house. Perfect place for my Chicago visits.
Awesome place - phenomenal location and a responsive host.

We had a great stay! The place was nice, clean, and exactly as described. It was also within walking distance to Chinatown, which made it easy to explore the area. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!
The place was very nice. I enjoyed the place and location.
Great stay

The small space was just enough for our family. Located within walking distance to so many things, amazing rooftop views, and great food right outside. Hosts were helpful and quick to respond. I’d recommend this to a friend.

Anne's place was so incredibly cozy; it honestly felt like we were living there! The kitchen was well stocked, the bathroom had plenty of towels, and the general vibe was laid back and easy.  I highly recommend her place for your next trip to Chicago!
Nos encantó el hospedaje. El alojamiento está cerca del centro de Chicago. Especial para una estadía corta para recorrer los principales puntos de Chicago. Recomendadisimo!

Cozy and comfortable place! Just what we needed for our stay in Chicago. Nice closed in sun porch- had my coffee there! Quick uber ride or long walk to train station to go downtown! Gracious and responsive host!
Muchas gracias, todo genial!
Great host, great location. Lovely neighborhood. Excellent location to public transit.

The house is a beautiful old building with a cool history. It's super close to the public transportation, there are multiple bus and train stops nearby. There is a gas station right across the street. The room was spacious, nothing fancy but gets the job done, and I must say it’s very comfortable. The space was clean and welcoming. The host was very clear with instructions and I had no issues finding anything. Also, he recommended local spots to grab a bite, and that was great!
Great place to stay and was a great place for our pets! Would recommend!

Our stay was perfect! We will be back for sure. The apartment looked exactly like the pictures and had everything we needing including extra perks of fun books to read, snacks and coffee. Having a Target directly across the road was a huge plus. Make sure and take advantage of the rooftop terrace. It was perfection!

Karla was an awesome host- so warm, friendly and responsive. Answered my many questions before booking this shared space and I'm happy to report it worked out perfectly! I had never booked a shared space before but would definitely book this great spot again!

It was a good location. Please read details before you book…especially if you have kids!!! This is an organization not a single owner. That means you have to add additional information to the reservation, not just selfies but asked me to text my ID. It would be different if it wasn’t over text message. There was additional money per day for more than 4 even thought it says 6.  Also they asked me to give a $250 security deposit which I understood. When we walked in, there was a crack in the mirror and chess pieces broken, it took awhile for them to agree it wasn’t me or my children. I also sent photos of putting the key back in the lock box (added photos and video- what they asked) and I received multiple messages they couldn’t find the key. It was in the lock box but it took 2 phone calls to resolve, they wanted to charge me for lost keys. The location made it worth it, but it was difficult to feel like I wasn’t staying at my grandparent’s home afraid to relax and truly enjoy the space
We had a great time! Hosts were very responsive and location was close to city but still quiet for downtime.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exactly as described—clean, spacious, and very comfortable. It had plenty of room to relax after spending the day exploring, including visiting the Obama Presidential Center.
The host was incredibly communicative from start to finish, making check-in and our entire stay smooth and stress-free. We really appreciated the quick responses and helpful information.
If you’re looking for a clean, comfortable place with a responsive host, I would definitely recommend staying here. We would happily book again!

Place looks exactly like the pictures! We felt right at home staying here. It was 90° during our stay and the A/C units worked very well. The neighborhood was pretty quiet especially at night; we felt fine walking around. There’s some convenience stores nearby and some restaurants. There’s a CTA bus stops about a 8 min walk nearby that’ll take you to the main lines. Going into the city was about (40) min overall but definitely worth all the sights you see while on the train! (If you have a car it’s only 20min into the city) Oliva was an amazing host, was able to accommodate with early check in, checked in on us, and even gave us some food recommendations nearby that was delicious! I’d recommend this place and can’t wait to stay here again.

Romana’s place is awesome! It’s a super convenient walk to the L, and safe and secure with a private garage for peace of mind for keeping a car safe during our stay. She was very responsive to any questions I had, and proactively checked in on us to see if we needed anything during our stay, as well. I’d gladly stay at Romana’s place again the next time I’m in Chicago.

Absolutely in love with Megan’s apartment unit and looking forward to visiting again. It was walking distance to various restaurants~ 10/10 recommend grabbing Pollos Asados Ocotlan to-go.
Having 3 kiddos present it was helpful having cozy open space in the living room as well as a safer parking area and stairwells for them to run around. While we didn’t have babies present, it was nice to see all the things necessary for a baby and caregiver’s comfort were readily available.
Lastly, I was so impressed and highly appreciative of the host taking responsibility towards being environmentally sustainable. Their amenities, cleaning supplies, etc are mostly all low-waste and ecologically safe products. YOURE THE BEST! I have nothing but positivity to share about our communication, the location, the comfort and cleanliness of the apartment etc.
Make sure you know how to get in and who to call for help.

It was very exciting to stay in a house that was 176 years old. It was very well taken care of. It was located very close to everything we wanted to do on the magnificent mile in the surrounding area. Lots of easy parking. Nice neighborhood. Laurie responded back to any questions or concerns. I had within a couple of minutes. Overall, our day was fantastic and we look forward to booking again.
Great location. Would stay here again.
we really had a great time and enjoyed it thank you for everything. nice place to stay in.
We enjoyed our stay! It was the perfect size for one couple to spend two nights for a few days in Chicago.

We wanted to be able to see a lot of Chicago since our kids had never been. The location was great to be able to both walk to local attractions and to easily catch public transportation.  The unit definitely felt like home and was great to return to at the end of long days in the city. We arrived several hours before check in time and Cyndi was accommodating and let us drop our bags so we could start exploring right away.  She checked in to make sure everything was okay. We had no issues with the unit.  Thank you Cyndi for being a great host!
Great place at great location, easy street parking in the neighborhood of Edgewater.

The host didn't mention that the space was shared with other guests, we got our own room but the common areas (kitchen & hallways) were communal. The kitchen also has courtesy hours of when to not use it.
The room was also right next to the train so we heard that a lot throughout the night.
Free street parking was included, which was a nice benefit. There were also three keypads necessary for entry, which made us feel secure & safe.
Loved the spot! Great layout of the unit & within a nice driving distance to some nice destinations & restaurants
Best AirB&B in the Roger’s Park neighborhood! John was friendly and communicative and the apartment was classy, comfortable and in a great location. I WILL definitely be coming back! Thanks, John!

My daughters and I enjoyed our stay and felt right at home. Lots of space for the 3 of us and even with it being very hot outside, it was always nice and cool in the unit. It was just a short drive to the Garfield Green line where we were able to park and ride the "L" into the city to explore. We can't wait to come back in the future!

This was a great place to stay with a fantastic location. It is within walking distance to a bunch of stuff. If you don't want to walk the train is nearby. Loved the neighborhood and the local eating spots nearby.

I came to Roscoe Village for a porch fest concert event. This was a great location for that as it was easily walkable to the houses that were hosting and restaurants bars, and coffee shops as well.
The place was very nicely appointed.
Everything we needed was here and exceptionally clean.
My only note is that the couch is not very comfortable. Which is not a big deal unless you’re wanting to watch a movie and snuggle in. We ended up watching a movie in one of the bedrooms, but had to use a laptop because there were no other TVs than the one in the living room.
So maybe come for your furniture in the living room or a TV in a bedroom. 😊 definitely not a problem big enough to take a star off of. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Great experience, very nice cozy spot, fully stocked kitchen and everything is super clean!
This place is a wonderful place to stay. It is close to many transportation points to get further into Chicago. The location is quiet and relaxing.

Nice walkable environment with public transit just a few blocks away. Living spaces a little cramped, but perfect for up to 4 people. Host was very responsive to every question I asked and spaces were neat and orderly.

Tracy was a fantastic host. She was able to get my group an earlier check in so we would be able to start doing activities for our trip. She was very responsive which helped tremendously and the place is in a great location. Only a few blocks from Wrigleyville. Highly recommend this place!
Great stay in a safe environment close to downtown!

The apartment was perfect for our trip to Chicago to watch a couple of baseball games. We were able to walk to the stadium for the White Sox game and then easy access to walk to the station and ride the red line to the Cubs game. Lots of great restaurants within walking distance of the apartment. We parked our car right in front of the apartment and didn’t need to drive again until we left town. Thank you for a great stay!
Exactly as pictured, very clean. Michael is a very responsive host. Unit had everything we needed.

Great location in a safe neighborhood with easy access to transit, restaurants, and bars. We loved being able to head south to Chinatown or north to Wrigley Field for a Cubs game.
The host, Patricia, is incredibly responsive and attentive—truly in the top 1%.
As a coffee-first person, I really appreciated finding coffee grounds ready to go after our late-night arrival.
Just a heads-up: the master bedroom has a short wall, so sound carries from the living room and kitchen, but the master bathroom is very private.
Good location.
My family of five stayed comfortably!  We enjoyed being only 15-20 mins from all the things we wanted to do in Chicago.  The home was comfortable and worked well for our family.
Clean, quiet, large space, perfect for our quick Chicago family getaway! Prompt and courteous communications. Thank you!

Great location, nice kitchen, and there are multiple restrooms which make the stay convenient. The only flaw is that the floor is squeaky and I could clearly hear any walking movement from upstairs. But, given the price and the value, I would still rate it 5 stars.
It was the perfect location for a long weekend in Chicago! Nicole was very helpful with local recommendations and was very responsive when I had any questions!
Great location just minutes from Wrigley. Would definitely stay again. Perfect host responded timely to all my questions. Perfect spot for Cubs fans.
This place was great! Loved the location, space and overall experience.

Ive stayed at this location in a different loft and it was fine. THIS loft, however, is listed as "2 beds" with one being a sofa bed. thats fine, I dont mind. I woke up to travel at 300am, and when we tried to finally get into bed at 11pm, exhausted from travel, we find out you dont get real bedding for the roll-out futon. you dont get a blanket. you get a fitted sheet, thankfully, because that holds the pieces of the futon together, and a sheet. the cheapest, lightest, coldest sheets. no blanket. I slept with towels the first night. I was told "its not a real bed so you dont get bedding". I said "its listed as a secondary sleeping arrangement, a blanket isnt an extra". I received no help, but while complaining they gave me the storage closet code so I grabbed 2 more sets of sheets and slept with the sheets and fitted sheets of those packages.
i hardly slept and worked the whole trip. this ruined my trip.

Anjali was an exceptional host! She was incredibly responsive, proactive, and checked in regularly to make sure everything was going well. The place itself was quaint, beautifully designed, and had an amazing aesthetic. It was a wonderful stay, and I couldn't have asked for a better Airbnb experience. I highly recommend staying here A+ all around!

A charming brick beauty in historic Bronzeville! This home was far more spacious than the photos let on, wrapped in classic old-city character that made us feel part of the neighborhood's story. Staying in one of Chicago's most storied communities meant soulful mornings and an easy hop to all the big tourist spots. For our family, the space was a gift, everyone claimed their own little pocket of the house, no negotiating over the good room. This place rewards the curious too, with charm tucked into every corner. The kitchen is genuinely functional for real meals, not just reheating leftovers, and our host was a bright spot, responsive and generous with local recommendations. We felt secure the whole stay. The only reason it's not a 5: old homes have thin walls, so we could hear the kids in the living room and everything upstairs. If your crew runs quiet, you may never notice. Bronzeville stole a piece of our hearts, and we'd happily come back!
Great stay in a great neighborhood.  Served as a perfect home base for our weekend in Chicago.  Added bonus was the excellent AC during a heatwave!

You get what you pay for as far as the room. It’s more of a hostel then and air bnb..The location is pretty great. Walkable peaceful neighborhood. Close to the rail line and lots of bus stops so easy to get to the city. But I did not appreciate walking into a room infested with ants. Henry took care of it after I asked him to so I was glad of that. I personally think he needs a better cleaner and the place would be amazing. Someone who cleans the stairs and the window seals. Over all, it’s a place to sleep if you’re out and about exploring Chicago on a budget.

Great stay! The River North location was perfect - walkable to restaurants, attractions, and the river. The condo was clean, well appointed, and exactly as described. We especially liked that the two bedrooms were identical, making it ideal for two couples. The sofa bed comfortably slept one, and the rooftop deck was a wonderful bonus. We’d definitely stay here again.

Location was great
view out the window was spectacular.
Rooms / beds were very comfortable
Shower pressure was good.
AC worked great
There was an issue with several of the outlets not working but it really wasn’t a huge problem. We worked around it.
Easy in/out lots of free street parking at night.

Sylvia was quick to respond to any inquiry I had, and was willing to find solutions to any minor problem I was personally having, like arriving much earlier than I'd expected. The stay was peaceful, and while the house overall gets quite warm in the summer heat, the window AC unit did a perfect job of keeping my room just the way I like it. The area is a little bit of a distance from the downtown area, but not bad; the bus stops at the end of the street, so getting around is easy.

Private spot near happening area. Very walkable and felt safe.  Parking was always available on street, but wouldn't call it abundant.  Beds comfortable and 2 baths very convenient. Going up stairs takes care, not really elderly or kid friendly.  Very quiet except for garbage trucks in alley.
Outstanding area! And it was beyond easy to access. When I sent text out Alex and Leo responded very quickly! I will be booking again !
Wonderful place right in the middle of the city. Easy to get around to any sights. Great room for the price.
Such a great and place and wonderful location!
it was nice apartment and a good area just stains on the covers and dog hair on the couch but other than that amazing stay

David’s place was amazing. It was nice and quiet for the neighborhood it was in. It is right across the street from an elementary school. It was just as described. It is on the second floor so you just have to be mindful of those under you. It was nice to have a stove and fridge for cooking. I know that people have mentioned bugs in other reviews and we only saw 1 centipede. (although it’s my absolute biggest fear my boyfriend killed it for me) This was my first time being in an airbnb and it was great! I would definitely recommend his place to my friends and family.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and perfectly located, making it easy to explore the area on foot. The building staff were always warm and friendly, and the host was incredibly responsive and helpful from start to finish. The entire experience was smooth and enjoyable, and I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again. Highly recommended!

Laura was a fantastic host — she was quick to respond, helped us out with an early check in, and also checked in with us throughout the stay.
The space is nice and open and also in a great location. Beds are comfortable and the washer and dryer in unit was an added bonus.

Our host was very informative and explained well about the location! Train station is right around the corner and very convenient for public transportation! It was nice and cool inside with some little noise activity around but nothing horrible! Very much enjoyed our time!
Place was great, great location
such a great stay! would book again :)

Lyla’s place is a “WOWser”. Impeccably clean, beautifully and newly furnished: we felt like we were the first residents in a new place. It is so convenient to Logan Square and its restaurants and local events. We walked the neighborhood and greeted families and couples. It was just what we needed! We will definitely recommend to family visiting in the area and be back again!
Great place! Near the train stop!

Great place to stay ! tons of food options and stores to shop around and fun things to look at. The air BNB is super clean and looks exactly like the pictures. Easy to communicate and very fast and helpful responses from the host. I would highly recommend if you are ever looking for a nice exciting visit to Chicago!
Me pareció muy tranquilo ,espacioso y todo limpio ,un lugar muy seguro me sentí como en casa 😊
Great place for visit to Chicago. Thank you for the stay.

For the area it was located in it is worth the price. Beautiful old homes in the neighborhood. Noticed a slight smell in the air and sheets but not enough it was a problem. It is in a basement so as far as heating/AC it won’t be the same as up top. Decorated nicely and provided what was needed for a short stay. No instructions provided as far as trash so we took everything out ourselves, which we would have done anyways. Only downside in summer are the bugs trying to get in the door when you open and there is a big drop after entering which you have to be careful. Overall decent stay. Close enough to city and activities given there is no horrible traffic or big even going on. Just need to leave at right time of day.

Jay’s place was everything we hoped for. Again, it was spacious and very clean. There was a slight issue that Jay found out prior to our arrival and he informed us right away just as a heads up and we were never impacted. His team handled prior to our arrival, so there was no inconvenience at all. We hope this space is available when we return!

Yakini is an incredible host was very proactive in her communication with us. This condo is super unique and located on a very quiet street just minutes away from lots of what Chicago has to offer. We really enjoyed our time here and will definitely return when visit Chicago again. Highly recommend!

What a wonderful stay in Chicago! We were here as a family of seven visiting the Obama Presidential Center and other Chicago attractions, and this place was perfectly situated for every thing. Also, the neighborhood Logan Circle is extremely walkable with a ton of restaurants and bars, and make sure and walk over to Damn Fine Coffee for the best coffee in Logan Circle! Lastly, the neighborhood is so peaceful and the house itself is so modern and spotless, we will definitely be back!
Great location

Comfy, cozy spot with all the basics we needed. Al and Jude are very friendly and helpful. We didn't even have trouble finding free parking, which is pretty magical for Chicago!
Happy to recommend this place to other travelers.

Our visit to that place wasn't great. It was super hot weather there and them refrigerator wasn't working. No cold water there .  It also didn't feel very clean to me. Plus, I didn't really get any of the Japanese vibe they mentioned. Not recommended.

Very clean and tidy space walkable to both Lincoln Park, Magnificent Mile, and the train. Comfortable beds!! Really great deal for a couple of nights! Can be difficult to get up the stairs to the apartment with heavier luggage.
Hey so i loved this place, she was very nice and very and i mean very responsive. i would definitely come back to this airbnb and recommend, price was great as well!!

From the pictures, the place looks absolutely beautiful, and when we arrived, it did look like the listing. Unfortunately, once we settled in, we realized it wasn’t as clean as it appeared.
There was hair on several of the chairs, mold in the shower, and little black bugs coming up from the shower drain and gnats coming out the kitchen drain We ended up cleaning so we could feel comfortable staying. The host did offer to send a cleaning crew, but they weren’t able to come because their car broke down. I completely understand that unexpected things happen, but I wish another solution had been found. I came to Chicago to celebrate my 30th birthday, and it was disappointing that we had to spend our trip dealing with cleanliness issues instead of simply enjoying our stay. I hope these issues are addressed but based on my experience, I was not satisfied with my stay.

Our family had a wonderful stay at this beautifully remodeled three-bedroom apartment! It was the perfect home away from home while visiting Chicago. The location was great—right across from a park with a playground and plenty of free street parking.
The apartment was exceptionally clean, modern, and thoughtfully decorated with beautiful Chicago-themed artwork. We loved the cozy atmosphere, especially the enclosed front porch with its peaceful tree views.
The beds and pillows were comfortable, every room had blinds and night lights, and the central air kept us comfortable during a very hot summer weekend.
The hosts were very personable and kind in all exchanges. They provided thoughtful extras that made traveling much easier in their pantry (like sunscreen, shampoo, conditioner and a stainstick). Overall, this is a very welcoming, comfortable space, and we'd happily stay here again. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommend!
It was pretty awesome and walkable. The train is 8 min away at most walking and free parking was available close by.
Great spot especially if you want to take in a cubs game. Place was awesome and Pavlo  was very responsive to anything we asked.

Clean, good location that was a block from Whole Foods and Walgreens. Has 2 window ac units that kept it cool even on a 95 degree day. Nice big TV. It is a third floor walk up which was fine for me. Walkable to Wrigley too.
I stayed 10 days and had fun exploring the local stores and restaurants.
Host answered questions very quickly and was easy to work with.

Excellent hosts! The room was perfect for my stay. The hosts were very responsive to messages. I stayed for a few days, and it was evident that there was a commitment to keeping the entire space clean with notable attention to detail.
It was a okay stay somewhere to lay your head but bedroom had damage on roof and walls weren’t pleasantly cleaned. They Had a few marks

Great location to restaurants, bars, zoo, beach, Lincoln park area as a whole! Parking was kind of hard to find/expensive but understandable for Chicago. The front room with windows def gets very warm once the sun is up, overall can hear plenty of traffic and the people above you. The place could use some actual repairs/updating especially the bathroom.
Great place for a short visit and absolutely loved the location though!

If you are planning a baseball trip to Wrigleyville this is the best spot. We were one block from the park. It was exactly as described and Samuel was super helpful. The L train is really close too and can take you anywhere in Chicago.
Great place‼️
Check in and check out was straight forward. BnB was clean and in a nice neighborhood. Overall amazing experience!
As described- met all needs!

Lizbeth's home is beautiful, with a lot of extras, comfy beds, and everything you could want or need. This time I came with my daughter for the first night as we had her college orientation, so i had the king bed upstairs and she had a comfy queen downstairs. Lizbeth is thoughtful in what she offers - snacks, water in fridge, necessities for coffee plus a Keurig. She even left a bottle of wine.
The neighborhood is private and quiet but easy to get to. There is plenty of parking on the street and she leaves permits for you. There are restaurants and grocery stores nearby. She is very responsive and sent me a greeting message as soon as I entered her place. I cannot recommend Lizbeth's places enough.
A nice place to stay for 4 adults.  We appreciated the spacious kitchen and dedicated parking spot.  Shaun responded quickly to our questions.

We took a girls trip to Chicago and not being a city girl, I was nervous. It turned out great. We felt very safe at this location and we were close to the blue line and plenty of places to eat. This apartment is wonderful. Very clean and modern. The showers are amazing! Very nice at the end of a long day exploring. It is a garden apartment so you will hear a bit of walking in the apartment above but totally worth it for the location and the comfortable stay. Easy check in and check out. I would gladly stay here again.
It was a beautiful space where we were able to come together and enjoy time as family! Clean and comfy.

Our stay at Kyriakos place was excellent I was wondering if it would be as mentioned on the Airbnb website but to my surprise it was just as described. Our daughter’s house was walking distance 10 mins made it convenient.
For both me and my wife we already miss the place and we sure will reach out to Kyriako when we are Chicago next. Thanks Kyriako and team for the wonderful hospitality.

Staying at Jaime's place was a great choice. It was clean, quiet, and super convenient to transit (1-2 blocks from major bus lines). The room was cool during a heatwave and the shower had great heat and water pressure! As a host, it was very easy to contact Jaime, he was very friendly, and he left clear instructions for check-in/check-out.

This was our second time staying here and it won’t be the last! It really is the perfect place to stay in the city. Beautiful views, walkable, lots of restaurants and stores close by, easy parking, easy getting in and out of the building while also being safe as there is a security guard in the lobby at all times. Can’t say enough wonderful things about this place and can’t wait to come back!
Thank you Josh for making us feel welcomed

If you're looking for a quiet place in the city to stay, Oriane's place is it. The Lakeview area is beautiful and walkable to several restaurants and coffee shops. We also appreciated the free parking on premise.
Oriane's place is clean, spacious, and comfortable. Few things I would note to consider: you are staying in the ground area of someone's home. You might hear some noise upstairs although most of the time it was quiet. If you need to adjust the temperature in which we had to, you need to contact the host to do it. The hosts were very responsive and accommodating. And lastly, the check out time and check out instructions on their Airbnb online instructions and the binder you will find in their space differ. That was a bit confusing. I think the binder should be updated for consistency.
Overall, a wonderful stay! We would come back.
We enjoyed our stay. The property is exactly as advertised. Special mention to the location for convenience of public transportation. Enjoy your stay.
Great location. And nice studio space

Overall, the apt. was a good choice for us  based on location, and worked out quite  well. We were happy with our choice, but have a couple of comments: (1) it would be nice to have plug-in adapters on each side of the bed with USB & regular plug-ins as we had to compete with lamps for plug-in space, (2) as a short person, I couldn't reach the plates/bowls that were in the upper cabinets, so having some type of stepstool available would have been needed for me to fully use the kitchen área, and (3) the window blind situation doesn't give the ability to "blackout" the light in the bedroom, which would have been preferable. The apartment worked out well for us, but the things noted prevented a 100% 👍 That said, ŵe were not unhappy and we enjoyed our stay.

The apartment is large and super comfortable. The surrounding area has lots of restaurants and things to do. Close to Lincoln Park, the zoo, and the lake. Easy to get downtown on the bus or train. I would definitely stay here again.
Beautiful place . Easy public transportation. Friendly hosts . Highly recommend

Gina is a Good host. Place is great for 2 people, little basement apt , very clean and in walking distance to all restaurants and shops. Sofa can be more comfortable but bedroom bed is good. We enjoy the stay, thx Gina.
Felt as though the lighting in the apartment was a bit dark. Besides that it was comfortable. Very nice place.
Beautiful place/Location, walking distance from multiple stores and restaurants. The inside was really nice as well! Would definitely stay again the next time I'm in Chicago.

Nicole and Matt's place is lovely and in a fabulous location.  It's a block off the Mag Mile and easy walking to shopping, food and attractions.  We will definitely stay here the next time we're in town!

Die Lage und die Aussicht sind leider die einzigen  Pluspunkte dieser Unterkunft. Das Inserat beschreibt die Wohnung als „luxuriöse Suite“, tatsächlich ist sie jedoch deutlich in die Jahre gekommen. Besonders störend war der starke muffige Geruch in den Schlafzimmern, der vermutlich von den alten Teppichen bzw. Klimaanlagen ausgeht. Auch die Badewanne ist in einem desolaten Zustand und sollte dringend renoviert werden. Auffällig ist zudem, dass im Inserat nur das Lavabo gezeigt wird. Die Jalousien verdunkeln die Zimmer kaum und bieten wenig Privatsphäre. Die Wohnung wird für 7 Personen beworben, realistisch ist sie jedoch höchstens für 5 Erwachsene. Bereits vor der Buchung sahen wir ältere kritische Bewertungen, gingen aufgrund der neueren positiven Rückmeldungen aber davon aus, dass die Mängel behoben wurden. Das war leider nicht der Fall. Statt die Unterkunft weiterhin als „luxuriöse Suite“ zu vermarkten, sollten die seit Jahren bekannten Mängel endlich behoben werden.
una casa muy acogedora con todo lo necesario, la anfitriona Angie siempre fue muy atenta.

This place is a true 5 stars!!! Everything you need or want.
Very comfortable, highly functional, great showeres! Unit was squeaky clean! Room to spread out, lounge and watch sports!
The location is perfect for Cubs games. Literally walk across the street and into the stadium. We also went to White Sox vs Royals and the CTA red line, a 4 minute walk, runs straight to Rate field. Very convenient. Wrigleyville is charming and fun.
Jessica mentions the road noise can be present and it was, but she has sound machines in bedrooms, and we had ear plugs and no issues! You are in a bustling city after all!
Jessica was responsive and flexible, instruction to enter and exit were clear and worked perfectly.
We will absolutley stay again when we visit Chicago.
Thank you for an exceptional stay!❤️

The place was beautifully decorated. The kitchen was perfect. She had all the things we needed. Parking was great too. It was great that she had streaming. That made it easier for me, cause sometimes I can’t get my own. I will think about using her place again if needed. We were there to visit close friends that were sick, and they weren’t too far away. Thanks again!

great place, would recommend to others. Transit is readily available within 5 min walk, the room and bathrooms were great and clean.
One note is that there is one outlet in the room, which is unfortunately on the other side from the desk. I had to move the desk so I can keep my laptop charged.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ My mom, sister, and I had a wonderful stay! The place was cozy and inviting from the moment we walked in. The view was lovely, and the blackout curtains were a fantastic touch — they made the mornings so much easier. The bed was plush and supportive, and the sectional was the perfect spot for the three of us to relax and watch TV together in the evenings. We also loved the thoughtful extra touches, like new toothbrushes with mini toothpastes — little details like that go a long way. It did get a bit noisy on Saturday night, but that's just part of being in the city. We'd happily book again!

Maria was an excellent host - responsive and communicative. The space is lovely with lots of light. The neighborhood is one of the best in Chicago in my opinion. I stayed for a whole week and was always happy to come back to the apartment at the end of a long day.
Thomas was the best host ever! Not only would I stay here again, I would stay anywhere that he was the host!
Great location with a courtyard entrance.  The place was clean and well put together. Comfortable bed too!

It was an awesome place to stay in. Ella and Peter were great at accommodating our inquiries and few other requests. They have been so responsive. We had a delightful stay. Overall, it was a worthwhile experience. Will definitely go back if we can🙂

Visita desde Ecuador 🇪🇨
Nuestra experiencia fue excelente de principio a fin. Desde antes de nuestra llegada, Jean fue muy amable, respondió rápidamente a todos nuestros mensajes y siempre estuvo dispuesta a ayudarnos con cualquier duda o necesidad. Las instrucciones para el check-in y el check-out fueron muy claras y completas, por lo que llegar fue muy sencillo. Incluso dentro de la casa, hay un libro de instrucciones que indica cómo manejar los procesos de la casa.
En esta ocasión alquilamos ambos departamentos para un grupo de 10 personas y estuvimos muy cómodos durante toda la estancia. El barrio es tranquilo y seguro, lo que nos dio mucha tranquilidad.
La limpieza fue impecable. Toda la casa olía muy bien y cada rincón se sentía realmente limpio y bien cuidado. Las toallas estaban frescas y limpias, y las camas eran muy cómodas.
Great place overall. Highly recommend!

Staying at Danny's brownstone was a dream! There was plenty of space for our family of five along with an extra bed and air mattress that made it very comfortable. It is a beautiful 10 minute walk down Kedzie to the Logan Square stop and is located on a quiet street. We were able to have a sweet picnic in Palmer Square and enjoy the Logan Square Arts Fest while we were there! The backyard was magical and we loved all of the charming historical details throughout the space. My 3 year old fell in love with their dog Debbie and Danny was super friendly when we ran into each other. We went downtown several times, but also got to enjoy tons of restaurants in Logan Square. We would love to stay here again on our next trip back!

Martha’s stay was exactly as described. Nice quiet place away from the hustle and bustle of the city but close enough to the station to get in quickly. The place itself was nice, clean, and private. We would stay here again!

This unit was totally fine. Could be great with a few changes.
Pros:
Great location, close to market, train, super walkable.
Nice beds and bedding.
Quiet (there’s train noise, but we didn’t find it to be a problem).
Cons:
It was pretty hot during our stay and the single AC window unit plus two provided fans couldn’t keep up. We are thick-blooded people, so others might not have taken issue, but we had trouble sleeping.
Good experience, made my trip experience enjoyable.
Lovely spot in a great location!

I would 100% recommend Nora’s place to anyone looking to stay/visit Chicago. I lived here for 6 months, and I never had any complaints. The unit was spacious, clean, and pretty much anything you need is within walking distance.
Nora was also wonderful as a host. She is very responsive, friendly, and accommodating. I wish I could have extended my stay 👍👍
Benjamin’s place is in a perfect location in a residential neighbourhood. It was exactly as described and very comfortable as it was 100 degrees outside so the central air was essential. Nice host!

We couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay in Wrigleyville! The home was clean, and we enjoyed the decorations. It had all desired amenities. The location is perfect for a quick (and safe) walk to Wrigley, and there are good restaurants nearby.  Our host was friendly, helpful, and gave great recommendations. We would certainly stay here again!
First time using AirBNB and this place was a great option! It was small and cozy.
Great place to stay.
Heather was a great host. No issues. Clean place and close to many things. Good place to stay if you want to go watch the Cubs.

Ed was a very gracious host and accommodating. He was responsive to my texts. His place is bright, welcoming and comfortable. He’s thought of everything to make one’s stay at his in-law suite easy and relaxing. The neighborhood is beautiful and quiet. I look forward to returning in the future.

Awesome spot! In town w 3 kids (infant, 2 toddlers) + 4 adults, plenty of room for all of us. Super walkable, great neighborhood, and Angela was very responsive and helpful. Wives can’t stop complementing the “uplighting.”
Highly recommend for anyone attending a game, as we did, and also want to explore the neighborhood. Easy access to public transit, which we took often, and plenty of restaurants.
Great stay!

Incredible location, a few steps from Millennium Park, Art Institute, Shopping, restaurants and public transportation.
Place was clean and host very responsive. Check in easy!
We had a great time and would definitely come back!
Would have been nice to have facial towels and a more equipped kitchen.  Overall, clean and host check in instructions were helpful.
Perfect location in Logan Square, close to the train, and the South Loop Market downstairs has an amazing deli! The apartment was clean and spacious.

Great visit to Chicago and to Anthony’s place.  Went with family and the place was quiet, comfortable, clean, and cool (it has AC units). We happily walked to restaurants and to the bus stop where we took a bus to the blue line. Very straightforward to get downtown. Anthony was very helpful and responsive to any of our questions.  It was the perfect location for us as we were visiting people in the area, as well as sightseeing downtown. Nice quiet neighborhood with big sidewalks and leafy streets.

The hosts were very helpful and accommodating! Went out of their way to let us store our suitcases before check-in, helped make sure we understood how to use the locks, gave us recommendations for the area. Thanks for a great stay!

I have never stayed in a shared space Airbnb before. I opted for the room with the private bathroom. The first thing I noticed was how clean everything was. This is always a big concern of mine followed by strong smells and roaches. I am happy to say there were no overwhelming smells and no roaches. It was actually airy and comfortable. If you are asthmatic and don’t mind shared spaces this would be a good option.
It is important to note that the private bathroom is not en-suite so you have to exit your room to go to the bathroom.
Note: I didn’t use the shared space and I used the back door near my room.
Excellent location and a helpful host! I would definitely stay here again.

Great location: close to Whole Foods, some fun dive bars, and good restaurants nearby. The space itself was quiet at night, with enough kitchen equipment for simple meals. Good pick for a short visit to Chicago!

This property is a wonderful, spacious & clean space. It was very well equipped & met all of our needs perfectly. It is located in a fun, walkable, easily accessible part of the city - Lincoln Park area. With so many options for dining, entertainment & simply enjoying  the urbane environment. We thoroughly loved our stay in Chicago & coming home to this place made it all that much better! The only adverse comment I would have relates to the El running adjacent to the property. If you are not from the city & are sensitive to loud noise - the trains which runs most of the day & night, might be problematic. Otherwise, total perfection!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was excellent for exploring Chicago, and the host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again.

I was a little nervous about sharing a space until I met Shaun and his partner Ken. They were lovely, friendly hosts. Shaun is hilarious and has great recommendations for local restaurants and activities. The private bedroom room and bathroom were spotless. The bed was very comfy and the bathroom had all the amenities of a hotel- with better towels. Shaun let me check in early and even helped me up the stairs with my luggage. I was in town for a convention and he gave me a ride there with my equipment for a small fee so I didn’t have to order from a ride sharing app. The apartment was clean and cozy with a nice, relaxing back patio. The neighborhood is safe with a park and restaurants nearby. This stay was above and beyond what I was expecting. I would definitely stay here again. This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had.

This was a beautifully decorated unit and street!! Was fine for me but be aware , there are several sets of stairs as unit is on 2nd floor .
I found parking right out in front always . I felt very safe coming and going important as I was solo . The building was incredibly quiet . Great tv , way to listen to music, books, laundry . Small Cheval is great burger spot not far, nearby coffee shops, and highly recommend Map Room( local bar).
Loved listening to birds frm deck area .
Very nice place very comfortable. Look like the pictures would definitely stay there again.

Nós amamos estar alojadas lá e com certeza quando arrendaríamos de novo, O Jeremiah foi muito amigável e útil, pronto a resolver qualquer problema.
Apesar do quão quente está lá fora a casa estava sempre a temperatura agradável, foi de fácil check-in e estava tudo limpo e organizado ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The location was perfect for my time in Chicago. I have a sore foot and the train station was extremely convenient AND no climbing of stairs required.  Restaurants and parks are close and summer festivals are plentiful. Thank you Mary & Don for sharing your precious home with me.

Zed was so responsive. If you're going to the United Center this is the spot for you. It took probably five minutes to walk to the concert. The other really great thing is street parking was no problem. There were always spaces available even on the event night. It was peaceful and quiet. I would stay here again.

absolutely loved the place, neighborhood feels very rich in culture. the space was great, very spacious, great natural lighting! couldn’t recommend it more, and dan was a pleasure. super responsive and proactive.

We had a nice 2 day stay. The apartment is clean, the building is very quiet and the A/C worked well on 90 degree days.  The location is close to where we needed to be.  There are lots of restaurants and a few markets in walking distance too.

I recently stayed at a fantastic Airbnb rental that perfectly suited my needs for a quick weekend getaway. The condo was exceptionally clean, making it a pleasure to settle in right away. The attention to detail in maintaining cleanliness was evident, which really enhanced my overall comfort.
This place truly had a little bit of everything! From kitchen essentials to cozy bedding, it was well-equipped for a short stay. Whether you’re planning to cook a meal or just relax, you’ll find everything you need.
The host was incredibly friendly and responsive, making the check-in process seamless. They provided helpful recommendations for local attractions and dining, which added a nice personal touch to the experience.
The location was another highlight. It was conveniently situated near popular sites, making it easy to explore the area without the hassle of long commutes. Street parking was difficult at times but seemed to always find somewhere close along the street.
Great little place for a stay in Chicago! Clean and quiet!

Beautifully decorated place in the heart of the city! Sure, it’s loud at times (never woke us up at night) but to be expected given the prime location and ease of walking or taking the train to pretty much anything you want to do. The place felt bigger than anticipated and the host was prompt in responding and checking in about our stay. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!

Wonderful neighborhood; nice apartment.
We greatly enjoyed our stay here.

This was the perfect location for us while we were at a conference at nearby McCormick center. Easy to walk to, close to delicious food in Chinatown and near McCormick. The only drawback was some noise at night. Milan was very responsive and helpful.

This was the perfect apartment for a few weeks stay.  The apartment was light and airy - just perfect!  And the location was superb.  The neighborhood has great local restaurants, parks and even a Trader Joe’s.  I would love to stay at Stephanie’s the next time I am in Chicago.
Had a great long weekend and it was a great spot to stay.
John is a very attentive host who is proactive with his instructions and quick to respond to our questions! We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

We had a wonderful stay at this home! The house was incredibly clean, family-friendly, and perfect for traveling with kids. It is in a fantastic location that is very close to downtown Chicago, making it easy to get around and explore. The host was exceptionally responsive and helpful throughout our entire stay. Overall, it is a great place to stay with family, and we highly recommend it!
We enjoyed our stay at Ell's place. It was comfortable and clean. I'd book just for the fancy toilet. It was also right near a bus stop which made travel easy.

Highly recommend RickStan Manor. We stayed 6 nights for a family wedding and all the family agreed we had the best Airbnb!  The apartment has a comfortable feel, just like being in a friend’s home and had everything we needed - and more. Having laundry powder etc there was so helpful as we were travelling light for five weeks so not something we could have bought without wastage. The layout was prefect for us as there were only 3 of us staying but we needed kitchen/living room space for wider family pre wedding preparations. Beds were very comfortable and there was no shortage of linen and towels.. W Hood St is in a beautiful residential part of the city and pleasant walk to shops, etc. We didn’t have a car but, with all the wedding preparations, it was very useful having a car park space to use as needed.. Stanley and Rick were very quick to respond to messages and very helpful.  We will definitely stay again if we are able to visit Chicago again.

Sehr schönes Stadthaus in schöner Gegend. Parken vor dem Haus problemlos möglich. Wege in die Stadt waren sehr kurz.
Zimmer waren super. Küche bestens ausgestattet.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und empfehlen die Unterkunft gerne weiter!
Great location and place!
Great place, plenty of room for our party of 5 to spread out, and the rental had everything we needed. The view was great and the outside patio was a great feature. Thank you.
Dave was a responsive host that accommodated us last minute. The place was nice. There is a bit of street noise, but otherwise great!

Great place for families to stay. Big kitchen with a ton of up to date appliances. Freezer door will hit the crown molding when opening. Kitchen area can get hot during the summer days but there is a portable AC which helps however Central AC throughout rest of house - It can get cold! Beds were comfortable & there are toppers for the pull out couches. Bring extra blankets if you have a lot of people! Patio area was not cleaned before arrival however the rest of the house was clean! Host quickly replaced the gas for fireplace in a couple of hours! Pete’s groceries is close but not a lot of restaurants close to walk. I’m assuming another B&B is upstairs so early mornings sometimes you can hear footsteps. We felt very safe in the area and always had parking in front of the house. Overall had a great use of the home!

Wings place was terrific! Spotlessly clean, comfortable beds and lovely soft towels etc.
location was great as well with easy access to subway for all attractions.
Thanks so much to this host - we felt right at home here.
Jorge was a great host - very responsive. The area was safe and walkable. Would recommend this place to anyone looking to visit the area.

Linh’s house was beautiful! The neighborhood was cozy and quiet, a quick 18-20 min drive to downtown with plenty of parking on the streets. The suite was quite spacious and was spotless! Check-in was very simple and easy, definitely a great place for a short trip to the city! Would definitely book again :)

The place is very nice everything is exactly like the listing the area is decent too but I am currently in a dispute with my bank to try and get a refund for a second stay I booked there which I fled because of a creepy roommate that identifies as non-binary leaving my notes under my door at midnight coming onto me a romantic advance to the point I feared for my safety and fled to a hostel at 2a.m. In the morning. I contacted the host and Airbnb instead of them terminating this person’s residency so I could feel safe and return they basically said deal with it and they only have 2 days left so I was left to just deal with the potential danger which I didn’t I am currently staying some place else.
my son and I had a wonderful time staying and exploring the area. The home was located right next to Wrigley and restaurants. The hosts were amazing and very responsive. neighbors were great.
Great space. Fantastic view. Hosts were very responsive, friendly, and helpful.

Logement situé a 5min à pied de la ligne verte CTA, 10 min de la ligne rouge, possibilité de se garer gratuitement dans la rue. Pratique pour visiter Chicago sans trop se ruiner ! (compter tout de même environ 30 min de trajet jusqu'au centre "The Loop"). Fast foods à proximité. Hôte réactif (notamment vis à vis de questions suites à un changement d'adresse de dernière minute ! ) (l'autre logement proposé est situé a quelques centaines de mètres)
Very clean!
The apt was really nice.  The neighborhood was super quite and located near a lot of food options, coffee and breweries.
Enjoyed our stay. Jasmine was very communicative. Would definitely book again in the future.

Victor was an excellent host - he accommodated an early check-in and even ordered baking utensils (baking sheet and parchment paper) to ensure they were available in the unit upon my arrival after I asked in advance.
The unit was gorgeous and very spacious - even with the Metra right below, it was quiet within the unit. The amenities on the 17th floor (gym and pool) were much appreciated with the intense heat during my trip as well. I had a lovely visit and it was great staying in the Loop :)
Great stay as usual. Love this area super walkable.
Great spot for a fun urban experience right in the heart of Chicago!
very nice place definitely would stay again and recommend it

We had such a wonderful stay! This Airbnb is definitely a hidden gem. It was spacious, clean, and in a quiet neighborhood. The beds were comfortable, the water pressure was nice, and the location is close enough to a bus stop and the Green line. Manny was also a very communicative host and provided great check in and check out instructions!
This is great  place to live in always recommend

Super logement !
Petit mais très bien équipé.
Nous avons pu profiter du jardin ce qui était vraiment top.
Les propriétaires sont très accueillant et serviables.
Il est vrai que le bruit extérieur surtout la nuit est un peu pesant mais malgré cela je recommande ce logement et ces hôtes.
Luis y su pareja son excelentes anfitriones. Siempre atentos a resolver cualquiér inquietud. Muy recomendable! La pasamos muy bien en nuestra estancia allí.

Well maintained older apartment building in the heart of Albany park. The three story walk up could be an issue. Close to the cta bus lines and brown line trains. Very nice, safe multi family neighborhood with lots of restaurants and bakeries within walking range
The host was very responsive!
We had a great stay at Natasha's place!
Overall it was a simple stay. Jorge communicated fine and was able to enjoy my stay. Appreciate his grace regarding my situation and would come back under different circumstances.
very responsive and resolved my issue in the end

We loved our stay here! It was a heat wave in Chicago, so we found the proximity to the lake and Loyola’s campus to be perfect for us. The neighborhood is peaceful and welcoming, and the basement apartment was quiet and stayed very cool. We had everything we needed, and Diane was so kind when we needed a late check out at the last minute. We’ll definitely be back!

First time in an Airbnb and I’m so happy I picked to stay in Andresa Stays because the place was so peaceful, clean, easy to reach out in case of anything, provide extra blankets and towels. Overall a great place to stay. Thank you so much!
Exactly as describe
Location was my main objective.  It worked out great.

This was a very comfortable stay for our family of three, with easy access to McCormick Place convention center for me, easy transportation options for my family to sightsee, and a comfortable landing pad for in between activities. Lots of restaurants available nearby as well. Far enough away from the loop so that you're not paying downtown prices, but close enough that it's super easy to get to popular attractions. We would definitely stay here again!

Great location and good communication on entry. I wish I had known about their no-shoes-inside policy because it is painful for me to walk without my supportive shoes. I would not have reserved it if I had known. Also, most places have more than coffee grounds (that were expired) for the 'breakfast' part of BnB. Other than that, great place for what we needed.

We loved Isaac’s place. Beautiful, spacious, extremely well appointed.  Location in Logan’s Square is fun and quaint. Lots of character. Arrived during Arts Festival! Near train, co-op, coffee house, restaurant. Fast and straight shot from O’Hare. My first thought: this is better than I even hoped/expected. And my travel partners last thought: this might be the best place I’ve ever stayed. Isaac introduced himself and was so friendly and then left us alone. The fridge had beer and champagne for us. The beds were comfy. The bathroom floor was heated. It was perfect. Thank you Isaac!
Pleasant location, huge house!
Great stay, even more beautiful in person.
An excellent refuge from Chicago's summer heat when visiting there. Just be careful at the to of the stairs! I hope to return on future trips.
Fantastic locatio. The beds were sooooo comfy!

This was a great place for our group of 4 at a prime downtown location. Our room was facing the L train tracks and it can quite loud as the trains pass almost every minute during peak hours. They did provide us with white noise machines and ear plugs. If that's something you can live with, which we could even with our infant, you cannot beat the value of this place. The rooms were quite clean and well maintained. We parked at the Grant Park North Garage with Spot hero and its about a 5 min walk from the Munroe St. exit to the garage. Would definitely recommend this stay just for the location right next to the millennium park.

Be prepared to walk a flight of stairs and if interested in public transportation endure a fifteen minute walk if your staying over the weekend or communiting at night. Also know that you will constantly be informed of the rules and in my case of  feeling surveillance be reminded to close a shared bathroom door after one incident of it possibly not being closed. Also take heed if your a female to male guest carrying on in a concerning way. Expect there to be noise rising from more than that of a voicing person. And beware that you sleeping in a windowless room which may not offer a lot of ventilation.  Aside from the many transparent things I've mentioned to be resourceful I will conclude with thanking the host for being consistently responsive

Carla was super helpful and responsive, left us eggs from the chickens and really really lovely. However, as other reviews mention the sofa bed was completely broken and unusable, I had to sleep on the floor. The place was also quite dusty but apart from that, good value for money

This little gem of an apartment is perfect for a stay in the City. The neighborhood’s vibrant, and the apartment had all the necessary items. Trove was super responsive, access was easy, and the apartment stayed cool during a crazy heatwave. I would absolutely come back.
Nice neighborhood, close to transportation and Loyola University.
Great stay!

Hard to find a better space than the Coach House. We had a group of 6 and it was perfect for us. The beds are comfortable, the kitchen is clean and well stocked, and the rooftop is a nice bonus. As a host, Dave is great. He had easy to follow instructions and was quick to respond to any questions we had. You can tell he cares about the Coach House and its guests. If in Chicago again with a group, we would stay here in a heartbeat.
Had a great stay, very responsive host.  Would recommend to anyone looking for a great two bedroom place to stay around Logan Square.

Nicer than the photos! Beds are comfortable. Location worked for what we needed. AC kept the place cool and plenty of fans offered, too. Shower gets properly hot!
We stayed for a month and it was not as well appointed as other Airbnbs we’ve stayed at, a note for those considering longer stays where you might want to cook or clean up… so I ended up buying a number of basic items myself.
If traveling with a baby, I wouldn’t count on the baby items in description - I found them too dirty to be usable.
This is also connected to an Airbnb on the bottom floor. Most of the time i didn’t notice them at all, and when there was a loud late-night party the hosts were helpful and responsive.
Overall, I’d probably recommend for shorter stays.

My husband and I stayed at Larry’s apartment for the month of June to explore Chicago. You could not get a better location! River North is walkable to all the great areas downtown and on the lake. A few blocks from the Red Line.
The kitchen had everything we needed. Larry provided lots of little things like night light, hamper, detergent, etc. It made staying there very easy, we didn’t have to think about much. Beds were super comfy. More storage/closets than shown in the photos, which was great!
Staff at the building was very friendly and we used the gym a lot as well as the pool and scenic outdoor space to sit and enjoy the skyline. Safe area too.
We had a few questions for Larry when we were settling in and he was very quick to respond and helpful.
Overall, a wonderful place to hang out in Chicago for a bit. Thank you Larry!

It was a beautiful spot and the hosts were kind and super responsive. Logan Square was a great spot. The bed and pillows were incredibly comfy. Will definitely keep this place saved for future visits to Chicago.
ana was great. she answered all questions timely , and provided great amenities
