My partner and I stayed for 8 nights while our place was renovating and this unit was the perfect location between our home and my work. Place was clean and the hosts were super hospitable! Free street parking in front and washer/dryer was a huge plus. Thank you, SB & Drew!

The photos in the listing don't do the place justice. They can't--they're just pictures after all. The location in the heart of Chicago, combined with the installed art, gives a delightful and immersive experience not typically found on AirBnB. 11/10 would book again in a heartbeat.
The place was great and neighborhood was friendly. Really enjoyed our stay!

Loved this spot! Very close to where we wanted to be. It’s a beautiful quiet neighborhood with lots of varieties of restaurants within a walkable distance.  The apartment itself was so spacious! Made for a very comfortable stay! Would definitely stay again!

Perfect for a large group. We had a family group of 11 people and were very comfortable. The house is exactly as pictured in the listing. The location couldn’t be better. Very close to the beach, easy walk to the Magnificent Mile and great restaurants are only a block away. The keypad at the front door made things easy for a big group. We appreciated being able to store luggage in the garage before check in.  The kitchen had everything we needed. Alexandra showed us around upon arrival and was super responsive throughout our stay. Only suggestion to make it more comfortable would be to have dressers / chest of drawers for people to be able to unpack - especially in the rooms which were not built to be bedrooms and lack closets.  High recommend.

This space was absolutely wonderful. It was the right size for me and my guests to feel at home without feeling overcrowded.  We were able to use the space well and create a great experience. Maggie was absolutely lovely host. No complaints about anything. We loved that there was a supply closet for us to use items, but also leave items behind for the next guest to use. It helped us from having to take several extra items we wouldn't use again home. Thank you for such a great space and such thoughtfulness, Maggie!

가족여행으로 7명이 이용했습니다.
추천합니다. 가까운곳에 큰 마트가 있습니다.

The Chicago Hideaway was exactly as pictured online. We enjoyed the convenience of the ease of self-check in, the parking space  behind the building, the well-equipped kitchen complete with a dishwasher,  and the timely responsiveness of the owners.                              We were a bit surprised that the apartment, while well set up, does not seem to be maintained as well as we might expect from an Air BnB. The furniture was unusually shabby for an Air BnB at this price level, there were spots on the floor, blankets, furniture and on a wall. There was also a smell of mold or mildew from the front closet, which seemed to have dirty sheets shoved in it. We were in Chicago during a little bit of a summer cold spell (temps in the high 60s), and were freezing cold in the apartment during those days. And as others have mentioned, there’s a lot of noise, from wipes, from car parking and neighbors in the alley. Fortunately those noises usually ended by  10 pm.
Most impressive:  Katty's amazing communication and responsiveness... this made the trip very comforting and reassuring.  Location:  Can't beat it.  Great stay.  Thank you, Katty!

This is an excellent place to stay for exploring Chicago. It is in a fun neighborhood with lots of places to eat and is an easy walk to the blue line. Plenty of room, good AC, and a responsive host really make it a no-brainer when booking a trip. I would absolutely stay here again in the future.

Great stay! The place and neighborhood were very nice. I made the mistake of parking the car on our (sleep deprived) first night, not seeing the sign about street cleaning the next day 9-2 so I had the privilege of contributing to the city of Chicago with a $60 parking ticket on my first day, before moving the car at 9:30. Other than that, no hiccups or issues.
Blanca was a great host!! We loved our stay and will definitely book again :)
非常乾淨舒適的房間，設備齊全，床和床單都很舒服，距離各景點搭乘uber很方便，房東回覆問題迅速，推薦！

The location was perfect, and the house was exactly as advertised with everything we needed. Noelle was fantastic from our first contact all the way through checkout—it’s clear she truly cares about her guests.
We walked everywhere! The area is safe, absolutely beautiful, and we particularly enjoyed Lincoln Square and Andersonville, which both have great restaurants and shopping. There are several high-quality breweries within walking distance to the north and south, plus some fun local bars close by (including one with turtle races).
Public transportation options are plentiful. You can easily walk or catch a bus to the Red or Brown train lines, making trips downtown or to the lake incredibly convenient.
If you are into bird watching, there are several great spots nearby, like the Montrose Point Bird Sanctuary. We chose to walk there, but it's an easy bus or Uber ride. There are also a couple of beaches and a marina nearby to visit.
I highly recommend staying here!
Nice place. Not much around the area without walking a bit. Overall it was a good stay and place is nice especially the deck.

We had a wonderful stay! The location was great, in a safe neighborhood, and the place was easy to find. The home was very cute, clean, and comfortable. Our kids especially loved the putting green—it was such a fun bonus! We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
loved my stay with MD great guy . close walk to beach.
One of if not the best place to stay in town ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This Airbnb is fantastic! I have had an excellent stay at the apartment and would totally recommend it for several reasons:
The location is incredible: 5mins walk from the metro and easy access to everything, there is a lot of nice restaurants, coffee places in the street, and also a warm and safe neighbourhood for my trip to Chicago. I love this location!
The apartment is extremely cosy, clean and is maintained in very well order: you will find a bathtub, a well equipped kitchen and living room, and a cosy bedroom. I felt at home and in a good space to appreciate Chicago, while also have the needed calm to work on my own projects.
Demitri is also a very proactive host, making sure that you have everything you need and that you are well settled in the apartment.
I definitely recommend this Airbnb and give it a 5 stars. I can’t wait to come again for any other trip to Chicago !
Thank you Demitri!

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Susan's place. It's so clean and spacious and we found all the furnishings to be very comfortable. Window AC units were super quiet, but worked exceptionally well - especially on a hot and humid 90+ day during our visit. Susan let us park in the garage which was a wonderful bonus. The street and immediate surroundings were peaceful and friendly. But just a couple blocks away, Avondale is abuzz with activity and great places to check out. Beware of the nearby intersection of Diversy, Western & Elston. It's a doozy whether you're on foot or in a vehicle. That said, we liked the proximity to Logan Square and the Addison L stop (brown line) in Roscoe Village where it's easy to find free, no-permit-required street parking on Damen. Overall really great stay!

This was our second visit to Karina's. It is a great apartment with a beautiful backyard to hang out. The space is super comfortable and clean with a well equipped kitchen. The street is quiet with a little park at the end. It is an easy walk to cafes and restaurants. We even walked to Rate Field to watch the White Sox win! Karina is a wonderful host.  I would highly recommend staying here!

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Ukrainian Village! The host was incredibly responsive and truly went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed throughout our visit.
The space was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. The neighborhood was quiet and felt very safe, while still being close to excellent restaurants, cafés, and local food spots. Getting around was easy with convenient access to public transportation, the bus ride to the Loop took about 25 minutes. Having free parking was also a huge bonus and made our stay even more convenient.
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago!

Jaime was an amazing host! I sincerely enjoyed my time here. If you are a mindful guest who enjoys the quiet of the suburbs, this place is in a great location for that. Host is very communicative and accommodating. Close to bus line that connects to trains into city. I recommend the South room on a budget, and the north room for comfortable, homely stay.

The place was clean and easy to find. The parking space is limited but is free. The place has nice lake view, walking trails and beach nearby.
I’d definitely recommend this place for your stay.

Amazing room, very comfortable and spacious. We stayed for 3 nights and everything was very well organized and well kept. Finding parking might a bit challenging as its on the street but you will find one in the nearby blocks.  Overall, it is worth the money payed.

Good location. We made use of the redline station and the water taxi that were both a very short walk from the unit. 3 beds and 2 bathrooms were a necessity for us. Also Mariano’s grocery was very close. We had no need for a car for our 4 day stay.

We loved staying at Brett’s place! Brett is a kind and communicative host. He knows his way around the city and will give you the best recommendations, especially for dining. The bed is the most comfortable bed I’ve ever had at an AirBnB. The bathroom is also idyllic with heated tile flooring, a bidet, and a walk-in shower with two shower heads. A great place to stay if you’re coming to the city!

We had a great 6-night stay. The space was cozy and perfect for two people. The weather was cold at first and then warmed up quite a bit, so the extra blankets were a thoughtful touch. Once we turned on the air conditioning, the space became much more comfortable.
The location was excellent—we were able to walk to restaurants and shops, and having a dedicated parking spot was a huge plus.
The only suggestion I have is to provide a few more towels for longer stays. Since the washer and dryer require payment to use, it would have been nice to have extra towels available without needing to do laundry.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend this Airbnb.
Great host, and the sheets smells great!!! Would stay again.

Great value for a family to visit Chicago!  Lots of room, great kitchen, laundry. Can reach any Chicago destination by Uber quickly. Parking for rental car was easy. Host was helpful, responsive, and friendly.  Highly recommend.
Great spot. Lovely neighborhood. Owen was very helpful and responded quickly. Would love to stay again!
amazing overall, literally can’t go wrong!

The host had good communication while we were there and checked in to be sure we got in okay. There are a few steps to get in the property so be sure to read all instructions. The bathroom does need an upgrade but otherwise the property was nice. Very convenient location for access to public transportation. The host did request the names and ages of all guests before my reservation was approved, which I was a bit uncomfortable providing.
Great place

The host was great, friendly and responsive. The beds were comfy and you get all king beds and huge TVs. The house needed better cleaning and the showers need some maintenance and upgrades. I got the impression that there might be a lot of bachelor/bachelorette parties there. Super convenient location, but know you’re in wicker park with all that it brings. Overall we enjoyed the stay but I did wish it had been a bit cleaner and better kept.
Place was very cozy and spacious!
El estacionamiento y acxeso fueron horribles . Vecinos mariguanos

Very nice and spacious listing that accommodated my family and dogs! My husband uses a wheelchair and other than having to need a little assistance to get in the small front step, was very easy to get in and out... and definitely easy to get around inside! It's a very nice area and close to a lot of things. The train was right there, but inside you can barely hear it. The only real complaint I could possibly have is that the one bed was a little too firm for my taste, but that wouldn't stop me for staying here again or recommending this place to anyone!!
Great spot in a very cool neighborhood!
it was so nice
As described.  Super clean.  Almost never heard anyone else in the building.  Appears entirely newly renovated inside and the quality is high.
Super Lage, schöne Einrichtung, die Dachterrasse mit mega Ausblick ist ein Highlight.

Loved the location of this place , very easy to get to most popular restaurants as they were 10-15 mins away by walk. Easy access to take outs and also grocery store if needed. Best part they provided free parking. Check in felt a little invasive than most hotels but I hear it’s the norm for most places in the city. No issues with that. We walked in a few minutes post 4 pm and the lady was finishing up cleaning and we could ask her questions if needed. Had a leaky kitchen faucet they tried to fix but continued to leak but didn’t bother us as we were out most time. They provided keurig and local ground coffee which was a nice touch. They provide a poloroid if you bring your own film. Beds were comfortable. Train station is super close but noise didn’t bother us as we slept with a sound machine. But even through that we could hear the loud footsteps of the upstairs guy when they were awake. Communication was quick and efficient.

i thoroughly enjoyed my stay here! it was perfect for me and very reasonably priced. gladys was very nice, helpful, and had very clear, easy-to-follow check-in and check-out instructions. the loft apartment is SO cute and cozy! it was in a great location, very peaceful and quiet neighborhood. i would absolutely recommend this stay to anyone, especially for a solo trip or even if there is 1-3 of you, there is enough space for you! whenever i come back to chicago, i will definitely be booking again :)
Great place to stay!!
Nice visit

I owned a condo in Edgewater for 30 years that I sold when I moved. Being in a familiar location was a plus. Last year I stayed in a studio apartment in Rogers Park. The king size bed took up a lot of space. No microwave in the small kitchen area.
At Alma's I had a one bedroom apartment with fully furnished kitchen. Another plus was the laundry room that took coins, no need to sign up for a card and it was reasonably priced.
On my trip next year I hope Alma's apartment is available for my travel dates.
Also, the people in the building were very friendly.

This was our 2nd stay at Joan's and we had another positive experience! Parking is easy, the area is very pet friendly and walkable. We have found many restaurants and shops that we love to visit, even when we're not staying in Logan Square- all walkable from Joan's. We enjoyed the walking/ bike path (606) and friendly neighborhood. Great area with a dog! Joan's airb is very cool (ac) and cozy. We will stay with Joan again on one of our many yearly trips to Chicago! Roomy closet and comfy bed!

The place was nice however maintenance could be better the sink was leaking the dish washer also did not work properly and the shower was missing . Jorge was genuinely concerned to help fix things but I assume it was difficult to find someone. I’m sure those are things that can be improved rather easily for the next stays

This place is located close to Downtown. Vin was pretty good responsive all the time. However I felt the parking instructions needed to be more clear. Be careful about getting tickets. Wifi didn’t work for me that much for the whole time

I had a great time at La Casita! It's in a quaint and quiet neighborhood and it's near the Pink Line and several bus stops. The wifi was slow and spotty, but Salvador was responsive and tried to fix the issue during my stay. Would definitely recommend if you're looking to spend your evenings away from the busy city.

What a wonderful place to stay our 3 days vacation, is super close to the places we wanted to visit and was perfect for having breakfast and sleeping for the busy day in Chicago! we loved it and totally recommended to our friends and with the feeling we'll be back.
If you're gonna see the Cubs, the location couldn't get any better. Watched players arrive for the game from the stoop. We hope to return in the future!

Had a great extended stay here! It was quiet, walkable, clean, and comfortable. Check-in and out was incredibly easy and had all the amenities we needed. Would definitely stay here again in the future!
amazing host and good place
Excelente alojamiento, limpio, comunicación y servicios
Love it❤️
Location was fabulous, we were blown away with the space. 10/10 would stay again!
We have stayed here several times and will definitely continue to do so!!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was spotless, beautifully maintained, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. All the amenities were thoughtfully provided, making us feel right at home. The host was amazing—friendly, responsive, and made the entire experience smooth from check-in to check-out. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!
It was a very clean and well-appointed place in an interesting neighborhood.

Robert’s place was nice. Had a small hiccup for the check in process but to no fault of his own. I had to stay an extra day due to me not paying attention to flight departure and he quickly allowed me to stay and accommodate me and I really appreciated that. Very responsive, very helpful. Will stay again.

An hour before check-in, Iris informed me that the unit I had reserved a months in advance did not have functioning electricity. She requested to move my reservation to a lesser unit that was a 20+ minute drive from the one I had initially reserved. I told Iris this would not work for me, as I had booked that unit specifically to be near a friend I was visiting. I asked for a refund. Iris informed that I was eligible for a full refund. This is when things got fishy. Iris sent me a reservation for one night, so as to still get me to pay $100 for a unit I never checked in to (due to a lack of electricity). She told me the faster I approve this incorrect reservation, the faster this would be resolved. I ended up having to go through Airbnb to get them to force her to actually cancel the reservation on her side and give me the refund I was entitled to and promised. Luckily it all worked out because I didn’t fall for her tactics - but I recommend proceeding with caution!
Great place.
Great neighborhood, quiet, close to trains. Clean apartment, great air conditioning.

I had a great stay at this rental. It is about a 10 minute walk from the nearest train station and very close to great attractions like the National Museum of Mexican Art. Alec was very helpful and responsive when we asked about dropping our luggage off early to explore the neighborhood.

We’ve been traveling to the Andersonville-Lakeview section of Chicago for several years and this is a perfect location. Loads of local restaurants and coffee shops (e.g. Understudy), Koval distillery and microbreweries on Malt Row, bus and Metra lines, walk to Montrose Beach or the Chicago River. Had no problem finding parking close to the apt. Kitchen had all the essentials.
Less than 15 minutes from downtown. Very modern/luxe vibes. My friends and I enjoyed staying here!
Great location! Responsive host!

Laura's place was great, the place was spacious, with a full kitchen, high ceilings and very clean.
A couple things to be aware of, the place is street level with frosted glass front doors, which can be quite noisy in Chicago. Also, there is only street parking which could be hard to find depending on the time of day. Also be careful of parking zone times, otherwise you could get a ticket

This space waa simple and no fuss. The location was perfect for me as I stayed alone and felt safe and secure. The surrounding cafes, small businesses were within walking distance, it was nestled in a cool ecosystem! i would stay there again.
The house was super clean with very easy parking and in a good neighborhood
Heidi was a wonderful host and this was a great place to stay as a solo traveler. I will definitely try to stay with Heidi again if I am back in Chicago!
This was a great place to stay when we weren't out exploring Chicago. The staff was very responsive, it was very clean and modern, and it was in a good location! We would stay here again.
We were very happy with our stay. It looked just like the pictures. It was a secure and safe building and in a great location.

We loved our stay at Michael’s place! Everything felt very cozy and comfortable, and to quote our 12 year old son, “Let’s come back again next year and stay here!” Great communication, a lovely place, and very quiet and convenient. Thank you!
Great location, comfortable and clean apartment, quiet and easy walk to so many cool places!

This was the perfect spot for exploring downtown Chicago. For a first timers we couldn’t have picked a better place! Public transportation was right around the corner, it was close to a ton of things, and had great restaurants near by. The place was just as the pictures show. Bed was comfy. The street noise was not even noticeable with a white noise machine. Will definitely be back to this place!

This is a good spot if you are gonna be out and about all day and just need a place to sleep. Based on the location, size of the room, and distance from everything, I didn't think it was the best deal.
In terms of location, it's not too far from the main city but with unreliable buses, sometimes public transportation can take 30 minutes. The area was quiet and felt safe but not a lot to do / eat unless you walk to chinatown.
As for the space, the place was not dirty but didn't feel the cleanest. When we first walked in, the room had a noticeable smell, and we also noticed it in the bathroom. I am not sure how many other people were residing at the same time as me, but despite only having one shared bathroom, I never had to wait to use it. Additionally, it is worth mentioning that the room holds 4 people, but would be very very cramped if 4 people stayed.

We stayed here for 4 nights and it was very comfortable. It’s impeccably clean, thoughtfully decorated and outfitted with everything you would need. We are all around 5’9” and the ceiling height was not a big deal to us - the lower height is in one section. If you’re really tall it would be an issue - but Afsha notes this in the description.
We would definitely stay here again. It’s a lovely place! The street is quiet but it’s convenient to public transportation and getting downtown. Highly recommend!

This building is conveniently located if you are attending a conference at McCormick or event at Wintrust. It is also a short walk from Green and Red L lines. The space was clean, beautiful large windows with a great view. Parking was  good deal at 30/day but I recommend letting your host know that you’d like parking in advance as there is a bit of a procedure and you will need to pay a refundable deposit. Overall, a comfortable and well located stay.
Everything was just awesome. Loft has everything you need for your travels and even a little extra. Thanks a lot for the great stay and attention!!
Very welcoming and close to the city had everything we needed.

I loved how close it was to the blue line. Made getting to and from the city very easy, as well as the airport. I found the neighborhood quiet and calm. My room was right on floor level and I didnt hear much outside. Its perfect for one person. I would definitely stay there again.

My second time staying in Paula and Adrian’s basement unit! I love the location and the space, they were also great about adding the amenities that I had mentioned I missed after my last stay. For my purposes as a digital nomad who works with two computer monitors, the standing desk and chair in this unit are perfect. My go to rental in the city 😊👌
Really enjoyed our stay! The location always great

Nice 3B/2B unit. Love the Roscoeville neighborhood, walkable.  And close to many restaurants and activities. Newly redone and decorated.  Beds very comfortable. Backyard basketball court was a great amenity for us.  AC wasn’t able to keep up during the 100 degree heat wave, but team had rapid response.  (And AC worked great normally)
The space was very comfortable and quiet. Would highly consider rebooking again whenever I'm back in Chicago!
Excelente estadía,  el lugar perfecto muy familiar, todo limpio y organizado. Muy fácil de llegar en desde el aeropuerto en metro y tren. Tiendas cercanas para surtir.

David's place was exactly as listed. I had a wonderful stay and David was very welcoming and a kind host. It's very close to the 18th station on the pink line with close to proximity to departmental stores. Thanks!
Very nice apartment, comfortable, clean, great kitchen and bath. The location is terrific with walkable restaurants and tree-lined streets. Young, active residents in surrounding neighborhood.
Our stay was amazing! Very clean and had an at home feel our entire stay. The parking spot was a nice added bonus. Would definitely stay again!!!
Beautiful apartment, amazing communication, ideally located by the red line. So happy to have found this gem and can’t wait to stay here again!

Coming from Cali, we were visiting Chicago for the 1st time and traveling with an infant too. And we very much enjoyed our time at this BnB! It included most of everything you might need for your stay. The hosts were very responsive—which I appreciated! It’s beautifully renovated, it’s clean, and in a quiet neighborhood. Parking is a bit of a challenge due the limitations of it being Street Parking only (on Tuesdays, half the street has to be cleared from at 9am cleaning). We were always able to find the last spot of the night without having to walk far with our infant! Overall, we very much appreciate our Hosts, Diep & Kevin for providing a beautifully finished home and allowing our family to stay.
The space was clean and has two bathrooms for three bedrooms. Hosts were communicative and proactive. Incredibly convenient if you're attending a conference at McCormick Place.

This was an absolutely amazing place to stay at. My friends and I enjoyed the space and how comforting it was. We were able to use public transportation comfortably. We also appreciated how the host communicated with us. They allowed us to drop off our bags early to be able to explore Chicago more. They also were very quick to answer any questions/concerns we had. While we had people above us, it was never too noisy.

We had a great stay at this place!! Lynette & Efrain made us feel right at home. The location was quiet at night and ideal for visiting family in both Oak Park and Evanston. The block’s permit parking was easy using the sticker our hosts provided. We especially appreciated the blackout shades in the bedrooms, the dedicated office space, the washer/dryer, and air conditioning! We hope to return for a future trip to the area!

Nie mogłam lepiej trafić, nie miałam okazji poznać Rafała ale Iwona to anioł nie człowiek. Pomocna, życzliwa i cudowna osoba. Samo mieszkanie wspaniałe, od razu czułam się jak u siebie. Wszystko czysciutkie i zadbane. Mieszkanie jeszcze ładniejsze niż na zdjęciach a łóżko tak wygodne że mój kręgosłup protestuje po powrocie do domu i chce tam wrócić 😁
Lokalizacja bajeczna, wszędzie blisko, bezpiecznie, cicho a do tego można podziwiać przelatujące samoloty 🩷
Polecam z całego serca i na pewno wrócę!

This place was great!  It was clean and we had no problems finding free on street parking in the neighborhood. She supplied a lot of little extras you wouldn't think to pack, which was really nice. Accommodating and friendly couple! Peaceful, quiet, and easy stay. Cool restaurants and nice neighborhood, close to the interstate. Will definitely stay again on the next trip through Chicago!
Fantastic spot! Lia was a super responsive and communicative host. Overall wonderful space in a great neighborhood. Would stay here again.

Nuestra estadía fue excelente. El apartamento estaba impecablemente limpio, muy bien organizado y con suficiente espacio para que todos estuviéramos cómodos. Todo se veía tal como en las fotos.

Lo recomendamos totalmente y si volvemos a Chicago, nos encantaría hospedarnos aquí nuevamente… Muchas gracias por todo!
Very enjoyable. The neighborhood was wonderful; easy to walk and very friendly neighbors.

Location is great. Nestled in a quiet, safe, clean, community with lots of walkable restaurants and bars.  Entry into complex and appartment is easy. Joseph and William are very kind and helpful host while they also respect guests' privacy. The communication before check-in and during the stay were smooth and responsive. Their place is clean and spacious. Will definitely recommend for people who are visiting Greater Chicago!
Amazing location, away from the busyness towards the evening. Place was great and as described. So many things to do around the area.
Quite a quiet and lovely stay & definitely a nice landing spot after a long day of exploring. Close enough to any transit to get you where you need/want to go. I would love to stay here again :)
Our stay here was great! This was such a beautiful home and a short walk to the train. The apartment was just as described with great amenities. Highly recommend!

We had a great stay here for our quick trip to Chicago. You absolutely cannot beat the location. It was right in the middle of everything and extremely convenient. The building itself is beautiful and there is a cute little cafe on the first floor that was perfect for breakfast in the morning. The apartment itself was also beautiful. There were only a few things that were slightly inconvenient. The keys to the door of the apartment are tricky to use. They aren’t traditional keys, instead they are cards, similar to a hotel. But they only work when used in very specific way. We thought they were broken and had to be shown how to use them by the front door security guard. I feel like the confusion could have been avoided with better communication. They should put in the check in instructions how to use the keys. Also the toilet in one of the bathrooms was leaking and we couldn’t use it. Hopefully they get that addressed quickly. Overall though, it was a great place.
Really cool place!
Everything was great and as advertised.  Location was superb and parking was easy.  Always felt safe!  wlWould highly recommend!

We absolutely loved our stay! The Airbnb was so stylish, colorful, sleek, and beautifully designed. Every space had such a fun and vibrant vibe, which made it the perfect place for my birthday trip to Chicago! 🎉🏙️
My girls and I had an amazing time and truly enjoyed the space. It was comfortable, welcoming, and even better than we expected. We made so many wonderful birthday memories and had an absolute ball! I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago and would happily stay here again. 💕✨

Very accommodating host! Daniel was very responsive and a great host! Enjoyed our stay and recommend this place for anyone looking for a quiet neighborhood to stay in. Very walkable and lots of things to do nearby! The apartment gets very nice natural light and very clean :)

Jane and Joe were my favorite hosts I’ve ever had. They were kind and helpful. They were so sweet and they had everything I could need at their home. I felt very comfortable and happy. Would definitely recommend anyone to stay with them. 10/10!
Great place to stay and a short walk to the L to get around the city. Extremely close to White Sox stadium and only 1.5-2 miles away from the L for easy travel around Chicago area

This place is in a safe, quiet area of Bridgeport. As a Chicagoan myself, I was surprised I never even heard sirens. There are toiletries if you forget soap, and a bag of coffee was supplied. Bring your own pillows, a thicker blanket, and an extension cord.  There's only 1 outlet in the bedroom. It's a 150+ yr old Chicago basement which is humbling (and nostalgic. If you want a true Chicago experience, this is it), but if the a/c isn't on high then the place is humid which made it hard for me to get ready for the conference I was attending. If you're just coming to sleep, it's all you can ask for. Like others said, you can hear the other people in the house if the other airbnbs are rented out, and a couple times it did sound like they were opening the doors to my space, but I got over that quickly.
Tippis room in her apartment was very tidy and the whole apartment is beautiful. It was a very pleasant apartment for short trips and I would definitely stay there again.
Beautiful home in a quiet, well-located neighborhood. Worked great for our large group.

The apartment and the room were very nice. The host was responsive. Common space was clean. We felt a little bit unsafe in the neighborhood. We encountered quite many drug addicts while on the way walking to the bus/train station and back.

We had a great time staying at this airbnb. It was very conveniently placed next to the blue line making travel fast and inexpensive, exactly what we wanted. The location was in a nice neighborhood with places for breakfast, dinner, and night life at a walking distance. Thank you to the host for being so responsive and allowing us to check in an hour early :)
Everything was first class, clean and well updated. Great Chicago location. Well worth the price!

Very smooth check-in nice and clean and good area would book again !!

Our stay here was nothing short of amazing. The location is wonderful and within walking distance of most necessities. Host was quick to respond to questions and checking in/out was a piece of cake. Can't wait to return!

We had a wonderful stay! Great neighborhood. Very clean and easy check in instructions. Definitely recommend!

when I entered the property with me and one other guests. I carried my luggage up the stairs as I did the night before and the entire morning of the trip. Clean and nice inside!

Great place, quiet area despite being very close to a lot of attractions!
Stylish, cozy, and comfortable. This place feels like if you had super cool friends who lent you their place for the weekend— well appointed and clear instructions for check in/check out.

ホストも親切だったため、また機会があれば訪れたいと思った。

The host of the AirBNB was great! We had a little hiccup in the beginning at no fault of hers or ours but she immediately responded to us and helped us along the way. We landed really early on the day of check in so she allowed us to check in early which was a great perk! Throughout our time there she checked in on us and assured us that if we needed anything she would be available.
The home was clean and looked as described on the listing.
The kitchen was stocked with paper plates and cups which was a nice bonus.

Outside was so beautiful it felt like i was walking into a garden and im the princess i loved the home. Beautiful set up inside the home, very spacious and clean smells great also a very fast responsive host, loved that. 10/10 experience

We were delighted with Randy's apartment. It's clean, spacious and has everything you'd want to live comfortably, plus spectacular views, especially at night. The location is absolutely spot on. The frontdesk staff were friendly and helpful and the building is a truly nice place to return to each time. All our messages were responded to promptly, although we had no issues during our stay.
Awesome stay! So close to everything we wanted to see…a true walkable distance.
This was a great location and found it safe and clean.

We visit Chicago/Logan Square a few times per year. This is by far the nicest Airbnb we’ve stayed in while visiting. The apartment is spacious and thoughtfully decorated. It truly felt like a home away from home. Martin was incredibly responsive and helpful. The garden in the back is a peaceful spot to relax and enjoy morning coffee. The location can’t be beat. An easy walk to many wonderful shops and restaurants. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a relaxing place to stay in the heart of Logan Square.
Was a lovely stay! Very spacious, clean, and just what we needed for our stay. John was very responsive and very friendly, would definitely recommend a stay here.

I really enjoyed my time here. It was quiet which meant a lot after a busy conference. I looked forward to getting here each evening. The local grocery was also within walking distance which was really helpful.

The apartment was wonderful. We had an easy time finding it. we loved the location and oyr host was fabulous. we have never had this happen to us but we unfortunately lost our keys to the apartment. we messaged our host and she had another set for us in mo time. we were so embarrassed to have lost the keys but our host was lovely about the whole thing.
Host was great very spacious and cozy will definitely book again.
Our second time staying here. Very clean and well cared for with a great location!

Ryan was nothing but helpful, responsive and very communicative.
I felt right at home at this airbnb and I couldn’t have been more happy with the house and how close the nearest train station was for a beautiful scenic ride right into the city.
If you needed any recommendations or information he was happy to give it and I would absolutely stay with Ryan again if we come back to Chicago !!
perfect place for a stay in wicker park! super clean super comfy! exactly what I needed. parking was a little tricky in the area but such is the life of the city. would definitely stay here again.
This was a great place to stay. Close to a lot and the space is just enough. The bathroom was a little dirty, but the rest of the place was pretty clean. I would recommend.

Tuan was a great host and very responsive. He was flexible with allowing us to drop off our lounge early while we went to a baseball game. The kitchen has pans that were great to use, I made breakfast tacos for my son's team for their football tournament. I would definitely book again if I come back to Chicago.

My wife and I stayed here for three nights while visiting Chicago, and we had a great experience overall. The location was one of the biggest highlights—it made exploring the city incredibly easy, and we were able to walk to many of the attractions we wanted to visit.
Check-in was seamless, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay, which made everything stress-free. The place was clean and comfortable. The only thing worth noting is that it didn’t quite match the listing photos. It wasn’t an issue for us, but future guests may want to keep that in mind.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would absolutely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a convenient home base while exploring Chicago.
Great Proximity to Downtown! Will rent here again.

This was the perfect place for our family during our week in Chicago! The location truly is a major plus; getting breakfast and coffee at La Fournette around the corner quickly became a favorite way to start our day. We had plenty of space and my son appreciated having the lower-level suite as a separate quiet place to let the baby nap. We loved walking in the beautiful neighborhoods nearby and out to the river. Our family was delighted with the rooftop patio; what a treat! A few surprise "extras" were the filtered water dispenser inside the fridge and the super quality of the washer/dryer (very fancy but user-friendly). Hosts were great and we felt well provided for. Everything was very neat and clean. Check-in/out instructions were clear and easy. We found that we could park more easily by using the alley across the street to make a straight approach into the space. Thank you for a wonderful experience!
Very convenient to public transportation. Very clean. Overall quiet area. We enjoyed the ice cream truck coming by.

Lovely time spent in this adorable spot. Great neighborhood with lots of fun things to do in walking distance. The hosts were amazingly kind and super helpful with any asks or requests we had. Really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely be back again!
Quiet Area & Close To Everything . Would Recommend !
no problems

Jen and Ben’s home is amazing! It was very clean and easy to find/access. The neighborhood is quiet and very friendly. Jen and Ben were very accommodating and highly responsive. The location, home and hosts were all great! I look forward to staying here again I. The very near future.

Had a great stay here! Place is exactly like the pictures, clean, neat and well stocked! The location is close to everything and I felt very safe. As others have noted, there are a few stairs as you walk down the path to the entrance and a few stairs down into the space, but I walked around the other side of the house once I figured out the location and it is a flat, easy, wide, lit alleyway. Easy access. Charles was great with communication, gave me some great "local" tips and was very welcoming. Thanks for a great stay, Charles!
Loved our stay— great location! Spacious and clean, really couldn’t ask for much more!

O lugar é pequeno como descrito mas tem o que precisamos ! Único problema é a distância , fica há 30 minutos andando da estação de metrô mais próx , então tem que ficar pegando Uber pra ir pra estação ou ficar andando meia hora para pegar o trem e ir pros pontos turísticos . Por esse motivo eu não voltaria a me hospedar lá novamente !
This was a convenient solace to stay.  Jeff was attentive to the concerns I had. He responds right away.

I stay at a lot of Airbnb’s on the north side of Chicago, and this has to be the best one I’ve been at yet. Clean, spacious working appliances and an actually comfortable bed, I will make sure this place stays on my radar.

This place is an awesome location in Chicago! It's comfortable, private and is very well stocked with travel necessities. I traveled with my wife and two teens and we were all very comfortable. The hosts are super friendly and helpful also. I will try to stay here again when I'm back in Chicago!
Everything about the property was great. I will definitely keep this one in mind for my next stay in Chicago.

Could not speak more highly of this place. Matt was extremely helpful and truly made sure we had the best experience. This house is stunning and in such a perfect area. So many different places to walk to and just a gorgeous neighborhood. It was a perfect fit for our girls weekend away!
We really enjoyed our stay at Michael's place.  It was a lovely and quiet location.  Michael is very responsive to any questions.  Definitely would stay here again!

We enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb. The lower-level unit was clean, thoughtfully designed, and well-equipped. I especially appreciated the welcome notes, complimentary snacks, and extra amenities that made us feel at home. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with.
One thing to note is that the listing is advertised as a two-bedroom unit, but the second bedroom was set up as an office and did not have a bed. The only additional sleeping option was the couch, so guests should confirm the sleeping arrangements if two beds are needed.
The exterior was well maintained with a beautiful lawn and flowers. The neighborhood is being revitalized, and street parking was easy to find. Restaurants, museums, and parks were all within a 10–15 minute drive. Overall, this Airbnb offered great value for the price.
Host was very welcoming, helpful, and friendly. The space was very clean with everything we needed. We would highly recommend to others.
Great stay! We loved the neighborhood and home.

Beautiful apartment to stay in.  Cozy enough to feel at home while also feeling like a vacation spot.  Great host communication—a totally seamless stay experience. Location is fantastic-so many restaurants, bars, coffee shops and retail surrounding. Terrific experience !
Better than described. We had a lovely stay with Sue, and we look forward to staying with her again.
I enjoyed my stay at Yingjian’s. The bed was comfortable and the rest of the place was clean and tidy.
Was a great location so we were able to access pretty much anything we needed.
Min is a wonderful host!  Great communication and extremely responsive! The neighborhood is perfect to get a real taste of the city.  Would definitely recommend.
Great place to stay! Close to all the tourist things in Chicago (15 min drive). Always found parking. Def recommend.
Great stay! The place was very centrally located to stores/restaurants and easy to get around. The space is pretty big as well! Host was responsive to questions before and during stay. Thank you!
Great stay - Bella was a very responsive host when we had questions for check in and throughout the wknd. Very walkable fun neighborhood. Thank you Bella.

Great location! Close to everything you would want to do in Chicago. Lots of restaurant choices within easy walking distance. And, if you’re going to McCormick Center, it’s just a few blocks away.  I highly recommend this apartment
The cutest little apartment, perfect for two! We came for pride and the location was walkable, neighborhood felt safe, tons to do. Would definitely stay here again!

Loved our stay at this listing! Place was indeed huge and super well stocked. Linens were crazy comfortable and high quality. We asked for a crib and it was ready and waiting for us on arrival. Hosts were super responsive. We had a snafu involving the parking space that was less than stellar, but the hosts were sympathetic and we resolved the issue without much fuss.
Excellent hosts.
Great location, responsive host.
Was a good place, nice area

I am writing this review for Unit #801, 802 and 803. We stayed nine nights and no one wanted to leave.
All the units are amazing. The outside patio on t 801 is spectacular with plenty of seating, fire pit, TV and view of downtown. Unit 803 also has a great patio. Unit 802 is good just not as large.
Unit 801 has large living area and kitchen which the photos do not do it justice. Floor to ceiling windows make feel even larger. The kitchen and dining and family are open to each other.
All three units were spotless, very comfortable and enjoyed watching the World Cup on several nights. The write up of the units were accurate.
Location is great for seeing the Chicago sites.There is an abundance of walking distance restaurants. Chicago Cut is must for steaks as well Fogo De Chao for excellent service.
The first-floor security was comforting. the indoor parking spaces included are a nice plus in the downtown area. I would not hesitate to stay here again.
THANK YOU, Nathan, Eric & Connor
Great room - great location!
Accurate to the listing. Host is very responsive, always replied within minutes. Can’t ask for much more when it comes to Airbnb. Expect I do wish there were paper towels.
Nice place not good communication between host and guest.

David's place is fantastic! The Brown Line on Montrose is right there and will take you to the Loop and all the fun places in downtown that Chicago is known and loved for. We had a few issues getting in, but David was very responsive and on top of it after long flights. There's also plenty of Lime scooters in the area to get to last mile places like where my DJ gig was at. The deep dish pizza spot in walking distance is some of the best deep dish I've ever had (and I grew up near Chicago!).
Go check out David's place. It's fantastic and he's a great host. The heated floors in the bathroom were especially nice, and I did my best to take care of the place as if it were my own. This place gave me some nostalgia of my young adult years heading to Chicago and going to school in the midwest. Great place, great location, and lovely host!

This is a nice little apartment in a great location.  It is in a historic building & there are fun details like ornately carved wood in the elevator & painted gryphon silhouettes pointing out the apartment numbers.  The apartment itself is furnished in a modern style,  with sparse furnishings & lots of black/white/beige); it feel like a rental, not someone's home.  The location is great, near public transportation & some little restaurants/other businesses.  The Griffin Museum is across the street.  We had no trouble getting in/out, although the check-out instructions were incorrect.  (We had to give the key back to the front desk, but the instructions instead referenced a lock-box.)  There is no dishwasher, so it would be helpful to add a drying rack.  Also useful: a cutting board, a large sized bowl, & more than one kitchen towel.  Otherwise the the place had everything needed.  I found the bed comfortable, not too soft nor too firm; my daughter prefers a softer bed/squishier pillows

Super convenient location! Quite and beautiful neighborhood, with 5mins walk to bus stop and metro station (which takes you everywhere), bars and restaurants and shops.
Nice room and private bathroom, responsive host, would definitely love to stay here again!
I love love this place

Perfect place to stay with family for a wedding. Direct train to Ohare on the blue line one way and downtown the other. Logan square is a fun place to explore in itself as well. Martha thought of everything in the apartment, down to a sewing kit in case of a tear! Very spacious and comfortable. Highly recommend!! Also came with a bonus parking spot that was a huge help to us.
As advertised. Above and beyond as far as hospitality! My family needed a kitchen gadget, my wife messaged our host and asked if they had one. The host sent it right away! We are so grateful.

We had a great stay! The location was excellent and very convenient for everything we wanted to do. The place was exactly as described in the listing—clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The host was also very responsive and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. We would definitely recommend this Airbnb and would be happy to stay here again.
Awesome as Advertised!
Great hosts. Beautiful house. Lovely location. So much character. Really enjoyed it!

We really enjoyed our stay here! It was really clean and welcoming. Amelia also always responded right away so there was no space to have any worries. Definitely recommend staying here if you're in Chicago!!!
Everything about this place was comfortable and easy ! Great selection of local shops and restaurants within a mile walk or less
Great little spot in a lovely and very safe neighborhood.
House is very clean. No complaints besides the parking. Otherwise I enjoyed my stay.
Great apartment and location.  Would definitely stay again!
Katie was a great host and very responsive. Great place and very charming.

It was easy to access the space and to safely secure the room. Jane very kindly let me store my luggage on my departure day. The place needs some maintenance and I was surprised at the small, frayed towel (not the fluffy grey ones in the room picture) I was given for the bathing and that the hand towel in the bathroom didn't change once during my 3 days there. The kitchen was very undersupplied, no potholders, dish rags; one pot had dirty, encrusted food burnt to the bottom of it. All in all, it's a great value for an expensive city like Chicago and the proximity to the Blue Line was super helpful.
Clean place with lots to do nearby. Very spacious and worth the price.
Great place. Had an amazing time. Very clean. Within walking distance to the lake.
A great place to stay in the heart of a vibrant neighborhood!

Sabir’s place was perfect for our trip to Chicago. The house was very beautiful, spacious, and provided us with everything we could possibly need for our stay. The surrounding neighborhood was quiet and peaceful. Sabir was very kind and answered any questions we had in a timely manner. I’d definitely recommend this place to any families looking for a place to stay near downtown Chicago.

Daniel’s place was nice and really close to were I grew up, which even though the area was totally gentrified it was pretty nostalgic for me lol. The only issue I had was the tv didn’t work in the master bedroom and the door was broken.

This place was fine. It was pretty close to the McCormick Place conference center which made for a nice, easy walk. However, I gave this place a low rating because the unit clearly hadn’t been cleaned prior to our stay and some of the appliances didn’t work. Overall, I was happy with the convenience of this location but would probably not stay here again.
We enjoyed our stay at Melissa’s place. It was clean. Always cool on a hot day.
Great spot in a brilliant area. Couldn’t have wished for anywhere better to spend our time in Chicago. Thank you!

The place was ok parking was a hassle don’t recommend if you overly pack like myself because the stairs will definitely give you a workout. The towels were still wet on the bed and found a dirty white towel on the floor in master bedroom closet. The area was  ok for the activities we planned only a 20 min drive from everything but wouldn’t recommend driving downtown. House is definitely overpriced and rules of not being able to smoke OUTSIDE of property is even more insane.

Extremely clean and comfortable condo in the heart of Wrigleyville. 3 good-sized bedrooms and 2 full baths made for quite a pleasant stay for our family. Naomi's communication was excellent. The condo was very clean and well-appointed. We did not do any cooking, but the kitchen appeared to be well equipped. There were snacks and drinks stocked, which was a nice touch.  You could not be in a better location if you are coming to Chicago to see the Cubs play. We were there during a major non-baseball event, and the neighborhood was loud and raucous. We were provided parking stickers, but it was still a challenge to find a nearby spot, undoubtedly much worse than usual given the activity level over the weekend. Overall, we were very pleased with our choice of Naomi’s place.
For the city, it was a fairly quiet neighborhood.
We had a short stay and had a few issues come up but hattice responded very quickly and was a 5 star host. She even sent a guy out to address the issues the same day for us!
Spacious place that was perfect for a 4 night stay.
It was a great stay for our family.  Our family enjoyed the spaces, cleanliness, views, and how walkable it was!

We had a great stay in an amazing neighborhood. Amanda was super responsive before and during our stay. She was helpful with directions and recommendations. The room was comfortable and the apartment was the perfect base for our weekend spent exploring Hyde Park.

Dave’s place in Chicago is amazing! It was just what my group was looking for! It had plenty of space inside and the outdoor area was a plus! Dave is a wonderful host, as he is super communicative and helpful! We ran out of something, so Dave came to replace it the next day and even left us some drinks!

The location was great but unfortunately that was the only positive aspect of our stay. Overall, this property was a terrible value for the price.
Check-in was frustrating. The key was missing from the lockbox and we had to wait outside in the heat with all our bags before we were finally able to get inside.
The listing is misleading. It didn't disclose that there was active construction inside the building, that our room had no window, or that the bathroom had a very awkward layout.
There were maintenance issues as well. The shower had extremely poor water pressure—so bad that we couldn't shower normally and had to pour water over ourselves using the sink. Eventually, the sink also lost water pressure. The toilet area was extremely cramped, and the light in that room didn't work.
There was a used bar of soap left in the shower when we arrived. We left food in the communal fridge (shared with other guests) which was then stolen but the hosts did not help us.
Overall terrible value

Ryan was an amazing host for our girls trip. Perfect location. The beds felt good. Overall I would book again. The only thing is parking, if you have your own car it may be hard to find parking but again small issue. Great host Ryan, loved the spot.

Place was as described.  Seemed newly remodeled so colors and lighting were nice.  Bathroom well done. Floors extremely uneven so that some doors hard to open/close, unable to sit on stool so uneven. We had issue with dirty skillet in sink and ants all over the counter each day (before we brought any food in). We put some food in microwave to keep away, and they even got in there. Wonderful said would send exterminator but they were postponed until after we left.  But he did provide an partial refund without my prompting for our trouble however, which was very kind and appropriate.  The place was EXTREMELY quiet and peaceful, tucked off the main road a good bit. Could definitely use more dishes, glasses of various kinds, etc. Be aware, like most on BnB, the pictures make the spaces look larger than reality.

Our stay was amazing! It was spotless and a very nice place. It was spotless and very cozy. It was within walking distance to many amazing restaurants along with public transit to easily get around. Highly recommend this spot, we will definitely look into this for our next trip, thank you so much!! 🩵🩵
Very comfortable and convenient to the convention center.
Estuvimos muy agusto en el alojamiento de Nicholas, muy cerca del freeway que te lleva directo al centro de Chicago, muy tranquila la zona

What I liked most about the apartment was how clean and comfortable it was. They had thought of every detail, which made our stay even more enjoyable. The apartment is also very well located, with easy access to public transportation.

We enjoyed our stay here! The location was great with a golden nugget, dunkin, and Al’s Beef a couple mins walk away. The only thing we would have “improved” is every bed was very hard and the skylights upstairs woke everyone up with how much light there was with no curtains so for future guests more comfortable couches and beds and maybe blinds for the skylights would be a great upgrade for this space. Overall we had a very nice stay!
Perfect place to stay. Walkable to restaurants, a grocery store, and Lincoln Square. Had everything we needed. Great apartment in a charming neighborhood.
Daniel was very helpful with quick responses & the house was beautiful loved my stay.
Muy buena vista , lugar muy cómodo y los anfitriones tienen buena comunicación.

Home was very easy to access and felt like a safe place. Very neat and tidy and was amazing at responding to questions. We only had 2 qualms, the space was very heavy of wallflower scent plugins and it was a lot. We just unplugged them and then plugged them in when leaving so not a big deal but if you're very sensitive, you may want to say something. The other thing the host can't control but just be aware of sensitive: the neighbor has motion sensors you will set off everytime causing flashing lights and high pitched alarm sounds. For people with epilepsy and sound sensitivity, this may not be great for you but it's not the host's property so nothing she can do. Other than that, highly recommend.
Well designed and comfortable place to stay for Wrigleyville and Northalsted adventures!

This apartment was worth every penny and more. Absolutely spotless, conveniently located and tastefully decorated are only a few of the qualities that make this apartment perfect. The amenities that were offered were far more than adequate and the back yard , with its fountain and fire pit were truly an oasis from the hustle and bustle.
Bryan was always helpful and available. I hesitate to recommend this place as I want to keep it as a secret for myself! But if I'm honest, I have to say that everything about it was the best.
DO NOT stay if there is MORE than 2 PEOPLE. VERY cramped. It ONLY comfortably sleeps two people: anything more and it very uncomfortable: Very misleading one bed and a bunch of army beds.
Great location for our family of 4 while visiting chicago! Very walkable to lots of cute restaurants and shops. Easy to get in and around chicago while driving.
Very nice Airbnb to stay at, everything is walking distance to restaurant, boystown and wrigley field! The home was very clean and was an easy check in and out!

What an incredible stay! We loved Martha’s home so much, it was safe, comfortable and clean. It was very easy to travel using public transportation with various bus stops just a 6-10 min walk from her home. The neighborhood was quiet, safe and full of friendly neighbors. We came back at different times each day and this was always the case. Martha herself made this our most enjoyable Airbnb experience to date as well. She was responsive, friendly and made us feel so comfortable from the second we arrived. This will absolutely be the place we want to stay for any future trips to Chicago. Thank you, Martha!
I had a great time. Thank you, Tim!
Great place, very comfortable accommodations, excellent location and amenities, I’d definitely stay here again!! Was easy and quick to get in touch with the host when needed and they were super nice.

As our first experience with Airbnb we found an amazing place, highley recommend anyone that wants to go to Chicago without deadling with the crazy noise! our place has clean sheets, towels and kitchen wear, it also had its own washing and dryer for those who choose to stay longer.
we slept really well and it felt like we were at home in Chicago. 10/10 would go fot again for the next Chicago trip❤️

We stayed at this Roscoe Village gem for a little over a month and couldn't have been happier. The location is fantastic—just a short walk to all the restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and boutiques in Roscoe Village, yet tucked away on a quiet street with the bonus of easy, free street parking.
The apartment had everything we needed for an extended stay. The beds were incredibly comfortable, the Wi-Fi was fast and reliable, and the kitchen was well stocked with quality pots, pans, and everything we needed to cook meals at home.
It truly felt like a home away from home, and we wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. We will definitely be back!
Second time staying in this unit for an annual meeting. Perfect for my needs.
Bon rapport qualité/prix

Such a great location for our group of 8 during my daughter’s bachelorette party. River North is walkable, safe, and full of great restaurants, bars, and shopping and this apartment was located right in the heart of this wonderful area. The apartment met all our needs, and Omar was very responsive when a bed frame issue arose, even arranging a repair late on a Saturday night. I’d definitely stay here again.  I would recommend parking close by (which we did) since walking in the city with a bunch of luggage and groceries is not easy. Overall, a great choice and would highly recommend!
Beautiful home and great base for the Loop and rest of downtown, with your own private grass oasis.
This is a nice, well appointed place to stay if you’re doing anything near the miracle mile/soldier field. Lots of restaurants close by walkable to Lake Michigan.
Great place to stay. Easy to get around, not for from the “L”. Could have used a few washcloths. Other than that great place to stay
This place was very clean and a great location!

We enjoyed our stay at the Inn At Wrigleyville. The unit slept the 8 out of us comfortably. It met all of our needs with 2 full bathrooms, central air, laundry, full kitchen and plenty of space. The location was ideal and walking distance to bars, restaurants and shops. The instructions were clear and management was responsive. Highly recommend this listing.

Jorge’s place was clean, comfortable, and in an excellent location. We stayed for an event at Morgan MFG, and it was only a 5-minute walk away. There are plenty of restaurants, shops, and Fulton Market all within walking distance, and it’s about 15 minutes from both Chinatown and Wrigley Field.
Definitely check out Bari, the Italian market next door the subs are amazing! Overall, we had a great stay and would highly recommend.
Joe was incredible helpful and responsive, making our stay very easy and pleasant.  Joe’s place was clean, quiet and a great location - would utilize again!

Doug's place was amazing. It is super convenient with public transport available all around. The area is peaceful and beautiful. The place inside was great, super comfortable. Will definitely come back next time I'm in Chicago!

The host was kind although he did complain to us quite a bit about silly stuff, like saying we can’t stand in front of the building, or telling us we were slamming the door which was broken and couldn’t be closed quietly. Also the ac in the room was blowing pretty hot, wouldn’t go Lower then 75 degrees
This stay was so beautiful. The pool was amazing and SO warm! There are so many restaurants and bars to check out within a 10 minute walk.

The Airbnb was perfect. We secured this unit in addition to the other two units on this floor for a family vacation. It worked out perfectly the living areas as well as the patio provide an excellent place to socialize.
The location provided lots of flexibility for restaurants as well as sightseeing. We would definitely consider for future visits in Chicago.
Great Place! Clean and accessible.
The unit we stayed in was unfortunately not prepared for habitation upon arrival. The host did her best to relocate us, but that unit also had problems. This stay was the low point of out weekend.
Amazing host, beautiful house, definitely recommend!
Property is accurately listed and the value is great.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully maintained. It had everything we needed, and the attention to detail made us feel right at home.
Our host was responsive, and made the entire experience seamless. We truly appreciated the hospitality and would happily stay here again. Highly recommend !!

The host was super polite and responsive. The place is in a great location and not far from a lot of activities and great food! The place was clean. The pictures were accurate. I will say the a/c is colder in the front bedroom more so than the last bedroom. However, they did provide box fans. They provided clean towels and wash cloths along with travel toothbrushes/tooth paste.  This will definitely be my go-to place whenever I return (which will be soon!)!

Great location, simple and clean accommodations with all the necessities. Towels, kitchen supplies, etc. The street is pretty loud (there was construction during June 2026) but the host provided ear plugs and a white noise machine right next to the bed, which I thought was a lovely touch. Host communicated promptly and clearly. Good value for price. I will definitely stay there again!

This was a lovely stay, with the convenience of public transit right around the corner. The unit looked as advertised, and fit our needs for a group of 4.
Sara was a proactive and communicative host and made sure we were comfortable. Check-in and check-out was flexible which also helped with our plans.
Great location and amenities. Unit was beautiful and comfortable. A/C seemed to work well during the day, but we could not get it cool enough to be comfortable to sleep in.

Very nice, especially for the price! You did have to walk briefly between the private room to the bathroom, but it wasn't a big deal at all. I also appreciated how quick a walk it was to the blue line!
Amazing place would highly recommend

I'm still fairly new at trying airbnb versus hotel stays and it seems I'm getting that bang for my bucks! I appreciate the thought that goes into the amenities and making sure all the items a home has is already present when you open the door. Thank you Freddy for making our Chicago trip memorable and stress free!
Great stay, great location

We loved staying at Aaron's place! He was kind and so responsive, the place was well equipped including a pack n play and kids cups/plates/cutlery. It was clean and smelled good, the beds were all comfortable! Check in and out were easy. Definitely recommend!!

Erin’s place was absolutely beautiful. It’s the small touches that make the stay amazing. Drinks in the fridge, freshly baked banana bread on arrival, and parking passes for the car we had. Will definitely stay again! But planning to move to Chicago in 2028. Thanks for making us feel right at home!

Christiane and Patrick were wonderful hosts — truly the best! I was in Chicago for a conference at McCormick Place, and this spot was just a short taxi or bike ride away. It was also close to Chinatown, and Pilsen itself was super hip. The whole Airbnb experience was fantastic: the space was cozy, and I got to enjoy breakfast and lunch with the hosts a few times. I'd love to come back and stay here again!
정말 집 같은 Airbnb! 다운타운과 가깝고 (특히 McCormick Place), 차이나타운하고도 가까움. 필슨 정말 힙함. 호스트들이 너~무 친절했고 매일 아침을 만들어주셨음. 오후엔 점심이나 티타임도 함께함! 유럽 Bed and Breakfast에 온 느낌임. 아주 많이 강추!

Very cool place to stay! So many delicious restaurants in the area and close to public transit. The apartment was beautiful and had everything we needed. We appreciated Dave’s quick responses to questions and all his local recommendations. We would love to come back!
The apartment was very nice. Well appointed, quiet and nicely located. Highly recommended for a stay in Chicago.
Really enjoyed my stay here. You get used to the train pretty quick, at least i did. lovely walkable neighborhood central to all the things we did in the city. will def be staying here again!

Paul y Abey fueron unos anfitriones excepcionales, nos sentimos como en casa, además de que el lugar estaba muy cómodo y la ubicación cerca de lugares importantes teníamos todo cerca, restaurantes, tiendas, bares.
It was clean and had parking available even late at night. The rain shower was great and the towels were super soft!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had an amazing stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and beautifully maintained. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in and check-out super easy. The location was perfect, and we felt right at home during our entire stay. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a great experience!

Rafal's place was fantastic for the week leading up to my daughter's wedding. There were some issues with deep cleaning in the house that I will send to Rafal. I have confidence that he will address these given how SUPER responsive he was to any needs or questions we had during our stay.
We had plenty of room to spread out - plenty of activities in the house to keep everyone entertained and plenty of room for any much-needed privacy. Kitchen is very well equipped.
Location is phenomenal!!!
Thanks Rafal!!!

Nice apartment
Good neighborhood
Great host!!

Overall was a good stay. Pros: location, responsive host, ample set up (kitchen etc.). Cons: One of the bathrooms are super small and there are a number of things that could be better maintained in the property. A little pricey in my opinion but it was overall good!

The apartment was spacious, comfortable, clean, and quiet. It was an easy, short walk to nearby restaurants and coffee shops. We found free street parking on a side street. The host was quick to respond to any questions.  We will definitely try to book this place again for our next visit to Chicago.

I was traveling from Ohio to care for my son after minor surgery. Nikkole was kind to tell me where the pharmacy was and how to get to her place from the airport. The apartment was clean, and unlike other rentals I have stayed in, had extra supplies like trash bags, shampoo, soap, and dish soap. The beds were comfortable, and there are plenty of dishes. I did encounter an issue on our last night that was not Nikkole’s fault, and she was apologetic, accommodating, and resolved it to my satisfaction. She is probably the most responsive host I have encountered across multiple rental websites.
The pharmacy was an easy 14 minute walk, a coffee shop is a 10 minute walk, but the grocery store was a 25 minute walk. There are several free parking spaces across from the unit. The only thing that I didn’t feel was communicated clearly in the property description is the staircase leading to the apartment curves and is slanted. It gives a bit of a funhouse phenomenon trying to walk up it.
We enjoyed the amenities & were very comfortable during our stay.

My family and I stayed at Davlin court #3 for a long weekend in Chicago! This unit is As ADVERTISED! Easily accessible, with very clear directions from Sean on how to enter and exit. Sean was very responsive to all my questions and concerns. The unit was super clean, and spacious. Plenty of room for my family of 5. The neighborhood for the most part was quiet. I was able to sit on the front porch, enjoy coffee and read my book. One night the neighbors did have a party that ran well until about 2-2:30am. Other than that no issues. The floors and doors are a lot squeaky, but kinda of expected for an older property, but even with that -The decor was amazing!
For what we wanted to do we were a little far, so we took Ubers. Please note there are NO tvs in any of the bedrooms, but there is a huge one in the sitting area. the unit is fully stocked with everything that you need, with the most comfortable beds and thickest towels!!
Would recommend! Thank you Sean!

We had a fantastic weekend staying at Song’s place. The location can’t be beat, the condo is literally surrounded by fabulous restaurants! The trains are just a short walk away, so we were able to explore downtown Chicago really easily. Being able to park the car behind the condo made parking completely stress free. Communication with Song was fast and easy. We appreciated all the recommendations in the Host’s Guide. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to explore the Fulton Market District!

The apartment is on the second floor of a walk-up building. If you are driving, be aware that the parking is a couple of blocks away from the apartment. The home was very clean and perfect for our group trip.  We emjoyed ourselves and the location was excellent.

Are you looking for a peaceful place to stay in Chicago that is right around the corner from diverse food spots, shopping, close to interstates, and a quick walk to the train, I would definitely book this AirBNB!
The space was clean, comfortable, and absolutely perfect. I slept well, and the shower had excellent water pressure (It was pretty fancy LOL- Loved it).
Although I did not cook this time, the kitchen seemed spacious and had everything necessary to drink coffee/ tea, prepare a meal, and sit out on the cute patio.
Very stylish! Very safe! 5/5

Great stay overall! The location was excellent, with restaurants, nightlife, Wrigley Field, and the Anderson L station just a short walk away. The apartment and building were nice, and the price was great for the area. The bedroom was a bit bare, but everything was comfortable. The host was friendly, responsive, and very accommodating. I would definitely stay here again.
Hanna and Marks place was very clean and spacious! They were very proactive when it came to communicating and really made us feel welcomed! Highly recommend!!

I enjoyed my stay everything was very clean and very peaceful. Other guest were very respectful of shared spaces. Parking was semi easy to find. In my experience Neighborhood was very respectful. I would stay here again!
Very nice location and stay
The stay was amazing, Francisco was helpful and very responsive. Any request he responded quickly and accommodated us immediately. Would stay here again if I’m back in town!
Great place and communication from the team! Very happy with our stay and would highly recommend!

I’d highly recommend booking with Plymouth. Room was great, clean, and well air conditioned. Building itself is beautiful. From the entrance to the room to the roof top, everything was nicely decorated and clean. I will advise reading their description as there is a damage fee, I did not read before booking but fee was not much.
Stay was great. We had everything we need for my son to recover from his ACL surgery.  Location was awesome and the parking space was a great option.  Thanks James for hosting us.
I’ll stay here again. I loved it.
We stayed here for a conference at McCormick Place. Super convenient and comfortable stay!!!

Kim was a very helpful and responsive host.  He provided great information on the rental up front and got back to us promptly when we had questions.  The apartment was very roomy and clean.  It had a really nice and workable kitchen.  It was cool when we were in Chicago so we did not need to use the air conditioners, so I cannot speak about them.  Kim left great instructions on how to get in.  The building felt secure, it had both a locked gate and building door separate from the apartment.  The location of the apartment in Lakeview was ideal, we could walk to many locations and the apartment is close to a subway stop. The closeness to the subway however was also a con.  The only negative to our stay was hearing the subway until late at night. The trains were pretty loud and ran frequently.  However, once we were asleep the bed was comfortable and good to sleep on.

This place was perfect for what we were in town for! We had a conference at McCormack and it’s only a 15 minute walk. I will say the air conditioner has this constant whistling to it that sounds like your ears are ringing… if they fix that this place is absolutely perfect.

Sean was a great host! He responds quickly to any questions and checked in with us to make sure we had everything we needed. If I ever come back to visit Chicago I’ll be sure to book with Sean again. Beautiful home!!

Brett’s place was perfect for our weekend in Chicago. It was clean, spacious and very walkable to the train, bars and restaurants. Something to note is the train is very audible from the unit and passes by frequently, but was manageable when we turned on white noise at night. Check in process was very easy and Brett is super responsive. Would stay here again.

I had a wonderful experience staying at Donald and Colby’s Airbnb. From the moment I arrived, they were incredibly welcoming and helpful. Colby took the time to share valuable insights about the neighborhood, even providing a beautifully hand-drawn map highlighting local eateries and shops.
The location is perfect—just steps away from the Pink Line, making it easy to access downtown Chicago. The Pilsen neighborhood is vibrant and rich in art, with the National Museum of Mexican Art being a particular highlight.
Overall, I highly recommend staying here for anyone looking to explore the area!

Nice place, good location. Host very responsive during communications. We were traveling with a team, and they would not allow ANY guests not on the reservation without penalties. Obviously not something we anticipated when trying to coordinate with other team members. The bunk beds were a bit uncomfortable. However if you are traveling with just the people staying in this unit, I certainly recommend.
