This was the first time my Partner and I have traveled together. I’ve been to Chicago many times, after visiting Logan Square once I immediately knew I wanted to go back! The Blue Line was a 20 min walk away which sounds crazy, I know. But its such an easy walk and there were so many pretty bakeries and cafes one the way there. I would definitely book again!!
We loved how walkable this location was. So many cute shops and restaurants to explore!
Beautiful house with lots of space!

Nice host and the place was clean. Outdoor shouldn't be listed as an amenity if it isn't maintained or accessible. Indoor amenities are great, but the pictures are misleading (probably 0.5x) as it's a very small space. Prices vary, but it seems more expensive than it's worth.

Nice place. Around 45min from the airport and downtown, my fault for not checking, a lot of traffic at all hours. The house was comfortable and looked as described. The ice machine was broken and no water came out of the fridge. I needed a iron, advertised having an iron but it's a steamer; we made it work. Overall, we liked our stay and would stay again.

I booked this for my son, who was traveling to Chicago to attend a conference.  Apartment is located near multiple transit stops, so he was able to get to/from the airport on the Blue Line, and everywhere else he needed to get.  Instructions were very clear for checkin, luggage storage, and checkout.  He told me the place was very clean and comfortable with good water pressure.
Such a great place for our weekend stay! Joanna is very responsive! Her place is in a very cute neighborhood!

Me and my wife loved it. Perfect for us. Definitely if we in Chicago again we will be looking to book our stay there. They had a nice restaurant next door to called Dawn good food. Definitely recommended.
Meghan was very communicative, and I appreciate that! My family felt welcomed.

Highly recommend this spacious two bedroom in a great location. Beautiful space and centrally located to the lake, restaurants, transportation. Fully stocked kitchen for family style meals and enjoy the back porch with table and chairs. We will re-book!

My second time staying at Taj Masmall and it keeps getting better. Great location with lots of restaurants and Wrigley Field within walking distance. Also close to a train station for getting to other parts of the city. The host are very helpful and informative. Well worth the price.

I’ll start with the positives:
1. Very spacious room and bathroom
2. AC window until worked well
3. Mini fridge in the room was very convenient and clean
4. Super close to the grocery store
A few negatives:
1. Toilet did not work well, had to flush a few times
2. Host provided us with 2 towels: one was nice and fluffy, the second was ratty and torn but smelled clean. When I asked the host for more towels she said she’d “ask her cleaning person if they had extras and that over visitors stole her towels” and never got back to me.
3. Bring your own pillows because these were the flattest pillows I’ve ever seen in my life. The bed was also very uncomfortable.
4. The house smelled like pot the whole time
Overall, for the price it was fine.
We loved Vins place and would definitely stay there again! The street parking was easy enough, and the decor in the space was beautiful. Thank you Vin!
It was perfect for our trip with family to Chicago. We felt safe in the neighborhood. Great location and the free meal from the restaurant was a delicious bonus.
We had a large group and was able to all fit. The price and location are very worth it. Very responsive host and we really enjoyed our stay!
This house was perfect for our group of 16! Plenty of space for everyone when we were just hanging out, and everyone had a bed.
Super cute place in a fun area. Easy check in and check out.

I enjoyed the stay here as it was identical to the photos. The photos for the outside need to be updated because this property looks so much better in person than the pictures do online. I just wish we could’ve utilized the back yard more but overall, we enjoyed our stay here.
Excellent stay in this apartment. My family and I are planning to take another vacation in Chicago and our first choice will be this site.
We stayed at Vince’s for a flag football tournament. It was a great space for our big group with ample bathrooms and a nice open kitchen/dining/living space for us all to hang out together.
Great value stay with a private space, convenient to White Sox and train for other areas of Chicago. Would return!

Putting a bible out the weekend of Pride was a choice that made the stay uncomfortable, when communicating concerns about this to the host they were suddenly very unresponsive about it, despite really good communication about everything else, which at that point I was ready to seek lodging elsewhere.
The listing says one towel and that means there isn't a towel in the bathroom to dry your hands so make sure you bring that with!
Description is what you get and while it's very detailed and clear, and though the security cameras weren't as described, I caution booking here because it seems more of an Airbnb mill than they give it credit, though they are organized about it there are other lodging options at this price point that are likely nicer.

Fantastic visit and place to stay. Eduardo was there to greet me and provide tour. Lois was very responsive in the app chat if anything was needed. Tidy place, amenities a plenty and great location. Definitely would stay again.

Clear instructions for check-in were helpful when we arrived late at night, the place was nice and clean, we didn't need to reach out to the host for anything all weekend, and enjoyed the location. Great experience.
House was clean and host was responsive and great. Will be staying over again

Home away from home! Such a lovely stay and a peaceful home. LOVE the collection of art inside, too.
The house layout was great for a large family and nice to have pool and games to play.
The host is one of the friendliest people as well. Their food recommendations were perfect. Would happily come back.

We had a wonderful stay. The location is great, very walkable and safe. Speedy communication from Andrew and Lauren throughout the stay. Definitely would recommend this property to others if you are looking for a spot in this area.
We enjoyed our stay in the large, well-lit, safe, and clean apartment.

Close to the Green Line, Metra Station and 63rd Street Bus, so you can get anywhere in Chicago on the Southside! Ryan and Elizabeth communicate well and their Airbnb is set up with everything you need.
Good location and spot
Hector was responsive and a great host! The townhome was renovated and had so much space for 7 guests. It was on a relatively quiet street and located in a great area.

We traveled with 2 kids under 2, and not only the place was spacious for kids to run around, but also they provided with so much brain stimulating games and books for kids, kids plates and cutleries, high chairs and pack n play. I was so thankful for those amenities especially because we have been traveling with kids! Location was also peaceful and beautiful, host was very responsive and i would come back there again!!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Josh’s home. It was very spacious, well-furnished, and perfect for our large group. The garage fit both our rental cars, the massive couch was great for movie night, the kitchen and bathroom were stocked with necessities, and Josh was kind enough to provide extra towels upon my last minute request! We were also a short walk away from several cute shops, restaurants, bars, a pharmacy, and a grocery store. I highly recommend this spot, especially for larger groups — a home like this (especially in this location) is hard to come by!

Lovely and comfy space, super clean, great location, and had everything we needed! Carolina was also super communicative and quick to respond to our questions. Will definitely check availability for this listing next time I’m in Chicago!

This is one of my favorite airbnbs I’ve stayed at in Chicago. It is plenty spacious, fitting 8!of us very comfortably. It’s also walkable to bars, restaurants and public transit. I highly recommend this spot.
Bryan’s home was conveniently located. We had one issue when we arrived that was promptly handled.
Good location. Great area.

Very good host! The area is walkable and made public transport easy my only complaint would be the downstairs people banging on the ceiling at 9pm and how much you can hear everything upstairs other than that great stay!
Thank you for a great stay! Solid affordable option with easy transportation to Chicago. We felt safe the entire time during our stay.
Was a nice place to stay, good neighborhood for walks. Was very clean and well put together
Very beautiful home everything was nice and clean ! I love the ambiance
The apartment worked really well for us.   Super convenient for what we needed to do in the Portage Park area

Our stay was great, everything was very up to date and clean with a bathroom on every floor of the house. We had everything we needed here and could easily travel with the cta stop a 6 minute walk away.
We accidentally set off the smoke alarm while making pancakes and Evgenii came out and helped us turn it off which we really appreciated and were relieved (and sorry) about.
Lovely neighbourhood.
Our room was exceptionally clean which was a huge relief after our last airbnb was filled with ants and dirt and our host was unkind. Because of this I was very paranoid about everything so I inspected our room for my own peace of mind and it was so clean and it put all my bug paranoia to rest immediately.
Any questions I had were answered within minutes and one of the other guests even offered us some fresh brownies. All the guests were kind and respectful and stayed out of each other’s way.

My 5-day stay was great. My bedroom with ensuite bathroom was just as described with a comfortable bed, fresh bedding, hangers and a bedside lamp. My host was always responsive through the Air BnB messenger, asking how my check-in and stay was going, and quick to respond to any questions or concerns I had. It was apparent the home contained many different rooms on various different floors that other guests occupied but I only bumped into a few of the other guests briefly during my stay.  The neighbourhood felt relatively safe at night, and accessing local transit was pretty close by. Some interesting art galleries, asian food market are closeby, and a nearby shelter attracts a lot of homeless in the area but I did not feel unsafe walking around. Overall my stay was very good and I was so appreciative of having  access to a standing fan and not having to share a bathroom with other guests. Highly recommended.
My parents spent a month here and had a great stay! Everything was clean and comfortable. Excellent location close to restaurants, parks, and public transit. Would recommend!

We enjoyed are stay. Had everything we needed and helped out with any questions asked. Everything was clean and nice. All I would say is maybe let people know how to use the fans. We had a instance where he had it on a timer setting and wasn’t able to get it off for a while and the air also doesn’t blow out directly straight it was coming out of the sides . Other than that everything was great . We had an amazing time . Thank you.

I stayed 5 days in Chicago to attend the American Library Association annual conference. I intentionally wanted a place in a real neighbourhood and I love long walks (8.8 miles to McCormick place) so I was happy to choose a place in Logan Square. Zoe’s place was truly a spa like experience. It was spotless clean and I was very impressed. Checkin was a breeze and Zoe provided easy instructions. The unit itself was on the 3rd floor of an old historic home with lots of charm. With a spacious living room, bedroom with skylight, and cosy eat in kitchen, it was truly the perfect space. As a person who is 5’8”, I did bump my head quite often as the unit is an attic with slanted ceilings in some spaces. It was all worth it. Loved everything - the furnishings, the fully stocked kitchen, and Zoe was so kind and welcoming. The unit is near Wicker Park, Bucktown, and Logan Square- all amazing neighbourhoods. Highly recommended.

I was on a quick work stay for the weekend. It was a very easy process to book. Proactive on communication. The house was very well kept and spacious! On-site Parking was the only challenge.  Would book again!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a wonderful stay! The home was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and made me feel right at home. Mykia was an exceptional host who was very attentive throughout my stay and always quick to respond. Communication was excellent from beginning to end, making check in and everything else smooth and stress free. I truly appreciated the hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Would absolutely stay here again
Nancy was kind and communicative! Her space is clean, well-located and cozy - we really enjoyed our weekend and would return in a future trip!
great host, services and location!

If you are looking to stay in Andersonville, then this place is PERFECT for you. The unit is well equipped and very comfortable. The pictures are very accurate. It is very nicely decorated and has the small things that make you say "ahhh that's cool they have that in here" The bathroom and the amenities are fantastic. The place is a very short walk to the restaurants and bars in the area.  The Host is very responsive and very proactive.  Check-in and Check-out was a breeze with no issues!  I can't say more about this place other than I would live there if it were mine.  Next time i'm in Chicago I will check to see if this place is available without question!

A good solid little spot! Nice neighborhood where kids ride bikes and grannies sweep their driveways, garden, and salsa dance on their porches. Walkable to some good hole in the wall spaces, good murals/graffiti, peaceful. The space was nice, clean, and met my needs. Juanita was flexible with check in and made sure I was able to get in okay. Responsive in messages and was around every once in a while during my stay to maintain a nice space for her guests.

The Coach House was cute and comfortable. The patio and grill were very much appreciated in the hot weather, as was the AC. The location is fantastic, a quiet tree lined street within a 5 minute walking distance of an excellent supermarket and other shopping 15 minutes' walk away.
Mike the owner was very responsive and made sure we had everything we needed for our stay.

We had an okay stay. The place was clean. They had cold waters for us in the fridge which was a nice touch. The beds were comfortable. But we didn't realize how close it was to the train and how noisy it would be at night. The curtains didn't full block out light in the mornings. And it sometimes smelled like cigarette smoke (possibly due to neighbors since it is in an apartment complex). The battery to the key box died, so we struggled one day to get in, but they stopped by to change the batteries. Also this is just an FYI about the location for anyone going there for conferences: the taxis there don't want to go between chinatown and the convention center, so they overcharge.
Great place to stay, looked exactly like the pictures. Great bathroom and very comfy beds

This was our second time staying at Elizabeth’s place. We loved it there first time and it was just as we remembered it. It’s very cute and comfortable with plenty of space and thoughtful details. And it’s in a really lovely renovated two flat. Charming and cozy with the right amount of modern touches. Plus a great location especially you want to be near Loyola and beaches. And Elizabeth is a great host.

My family reserved this rental unit for 3 nights at end of June 2026. There are 2 rental units on this property, upper unit and lower unit. Alec operates 2 units and rents them to different quests. I booked upper unit.
The first night was fine. On the 2nd night, nightmare began. Guests from lower unit started to party all night long, loud music, kids shouting and visitors coming and going from midnight through 5:30AM next morning. It was very disruptive night for us. Six of us did not sleep a minute all night. We have 85- and 78-year-old persons with us. It caused health concern of those folks. I messaged Alec, but he was unable to stop the party. We had to cancel all tourist activities the next day, staying at the unit resting. Alec messaged me, saying he ensured the 3rd night is going to quiet. However, I cannot trust him. We moved out of it and stayed in a hotel. If you want to book this unit for a quiet stay, please exercise caution!
Customer is extremely not happy!

Our stay was great. Traffic location. Far enough away from the hustle and bustle but easy enough to uber/lyft to the city nightlight.
James was very kind. Let us check in 2 hours early. Also provided parking since we were driving.

Great location if you enjoy biking and walking for transportation or if you use rideshares. We really loved exploring the 606 multi-use path with its incredible murals and street art, both Garfield and Humboldt parks and all the delicious Puerto-Rican food right down the street!! The apartment is on the third floor so make sure you don't pack your luggage too heavy and it can be a little noisy inside as the walls are thin. So thankful there was AC controls inside the room and laundry avaialble for us to use. The hosts were responsive quickly whenever I had questions or concerns. We will definitely stay here again if we explore this part of Chicago- highly recommend for others to stay here and check it out! Very special neighborhood. Thank you for having us.

I enjoyed pretending I was a local for six days and five nights. Excellent communication, well/equipped, two comfy beds, lots of bed pillows, two comfy couches. Air conditioning units  and fans made things comfortable. I appreciate the many small touches, such as candy, Vinci coffee maker with provided pods, kettle, first aid kit, games, easy to use Roku set up, as well as soaps, lotions, and cleaners for the kitchen and bathroom. Mickey even provided two choices of cheese graters when I asked her if the AirBnB had one - so I could enjoy some fancy cheese I bought. Lovely walk to Logan Circle.
The only drawback was no bathroom on the main floor, but everything else was great. Didn't take the el which was right there, but home was easy for guests and Uber to find. Easy highway access.

This apartment is in a great location in Pilsen. The neighborhood is very walkable and it's not far from the nearest L train stop with many delicious restaurants along the way! It was very clean, the neighborhood was quiet at night and was just what we were looking for to spend the weekend in Chicago! Pilsen is a fun and unique neighborhood that I highly recommend!

This was a great Airbnb experience. The unit was as described, and the hosts were very communicative! The only "issue" I had was that I had seen a box fan in the photos that I didn't see once I was there, and I usually sleep with a fan. It wasn't even that inconvenient for me to worry about messaging the host, I just turned some music on my phone. The one thing I would say to keep in mind - you can really hear the upstairs tenant very clearly, especially with footsteps. So, if you're a light sleeper or need sound, prep for that or ask the host if there is a fix for that. I was pretty tired both nights, so it was a minimal bother. But worth noting for those others who are fussy with noises. I expect it from a city Airbnb, but thought I'd share the feedback!
Thanks for hosting our family, Atlas! We appreciate your responsiveness and you keep a beautiful home!

The place was fine overall. Communication was very limited. There were not enough towels and face towels in the home suffice for the 4 day stay. I don’t recall a time efficient response to the inquiry either. The street parking was okay up until my car was towed after the city put tow signs unexpectedly and at the last minute due to a movie. Also, the neighbors were having a loud party. Didn’t really bother us, but keep in mind if you are looking more for relaxation. The home was spacious though and location to downtown was good!

Conveniently located for the conference I attended at McCormick Place. Having a garage to park in was a bonus. If you'r considering it for a conference visit but are wondering what the walk to/from the convention center is – it's safe. Clean and well-lit. Also, you can tell there are lots of others staying in the same complex for conventions. Often, we walked alongside other attendees to/from the venue.
There are two convenience stores just a block away. One is significantly more polished than the other and has far better grocery/household items. Made it simple to grab the things we forgot at home.

The place had a great layout and all the things you need. The hosts were also  incredibly responsive and welcoming to feedback about a couple tiny things. Would definitely stay there again if I need to be in the same general area (near the convention center).

Great stay at Jesse’s place.
Clean, peaceful, and felt just like home.
My daughter and I enjoyed our time. I definitely recommend.
Overall great place to stay ! Easy access to the train station.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly what we need for a long weekend. Parking was abundant. They provided lots of food & neighborhood recommendations. They were proactive in checking in with us and very responsive when we had questions. I will be looming to stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

Cute apartment, quiet street- this is a plus, centrally located. Perfect for 1-2 people, great place to stay. Make sure to pull the front door towards you tightly so the lock engages easily. Would recommend!

Great location right by the train to explore the city. We had a large group of 13 guys and there were plenty of accommodations, which is rare in a city. Hosts were very proactive with plenty of instructions and checkin/checkout was very simple. Highly recommend if you're looking for a place with easy access to the major neighborhoods of Chicago!
Exactly as posted. Comfortable beds. Close to the metro. Plenty towels.
Very nice clean quiet
very near to Indiana train station, so it is convenient for going out. and very quiet and peaceful. I like it.
Very convenient to McCormick with a fun restaurant across the street! Very comfy beds too!
Great stay! Host was responsive and friendly and extremely considerate of our experience here. The neighborhood is lovely and peaceful and lots of good food nearby

All of the comforts of home in addition to a great location within walking distance of restaurants, shops, etc. It’s rare to stay someplace that has everything you need away from home. I was so grateful for all of the care they put into the space. Probably the most thoughtful space I’ve stayed in during the last decade.

What I loved most about this place was how easy it was to get around using public transportation, especially to reach the airport. The location was fantastic. It's a basement, just like in the pictures, but since I mainly used it for sleeping, it worked out perfectly. I didn't hear any noise around me, and I felt comfortable in the shared spaces. During my stay, all the other guests were respectful. The host works hard to keep the shared areas clean and is very proactive in ensuring your stay is smooth and hassle-free. Just a heads-up, there are a couple of stairs, so be aware if you have large luggage. The neighborhood seemed very peaceful. I walked around late at night when using public transportation, and nothing about it made me feel unsafe. If I have the chance to come back to Chicago, I'd love to stay here again.

This was cute Airbnb and the host was very responsive and quick to action. We had a slight issue with one of the bathtubs and the host responded in minutes and had the issue fixed before we even made it back to the house.  The area is kind of ghetto and there isn't much to do in the direct vicinity but that is not the fault of the host and she created a book of things that you can do locally should you need it. My only recommendation would be to have dishwasher pods in the home so we can wash them as we go as well as aluminum foil so that food does not need to be cooked directly on the baking sheets. Over all this place was quiet , clean, and relaxing.
The stay was great! Being close to Loyola and away from the city was a plus!

Had a wonderful stay at Anita’s. Very comfortable and spacious. Great interior and comfortably hosted 9 family members in the space, with room for more. Definitely recommend it if you’re visiting the area.

The listing was as described, it wasn't too loud, it was what was expected and very accessible with a L station within a couple blocks and two bus station on the next corners. Was in town for a short convention and this was perfect for that.
Close to e-bikes, train, and food.
Such a great location and perfect space if you’re staying with family!
No where to park very noisy and the checkout is normally at 11 but theres is at 10

I don't even know where to start. This place was so perfect for us. Our daughter got married a Lacuna lofts which is about a mile from the airbnb. We had our dog from Indy plus our daughter's dog. Miranda fed them and let them out for us the night of the rehersal and wedding for a VERY resonable price. It took so much pressure off. If you have a dog, this is the place to stay. The dog run is very secure, so there was no way the dogs could escape. And her backyard garden was very beautiful to look at.
Lots of walkable restaurants in the area, and parking was always easy to find.
Also LOVED the vibe of the place. The signs in the kitchen and bathroom cracked me up. I sent photos of them to some of my animal friends. Finally, where else are you going to get a disco ball in your airbnb!
Finally, apologies to Miranda for arriving a half hour before check-in. Forgot about the hour time difference between our states.
We really Enjoyed our stay there very peaceful I would come there for my first choice when coming back to Chicago is parking and very peaceful host was outstanding!.

Super bien ! La cuisine avait toute les commodités nécessaire pour cuisiner. Le logement était propre et sentait bon.  Plusieurs moyens de transport était accessible a moins de 10 minutes de marche. Vraiment super bien !

Very well organized host when it comes to check in and out, giving clear and detailed instructions. Quick to respond when needed at anytime, neighborhood is walkable with shopping center in front, walkable through the daytime at night it is up to your discretion. Laundry, kitchen usage with working appliances. Overall loved the stay and felt right at home will definitely be coming back when I’m in the city.
Don’t
Easy to get to and perfect location! I will stay here again.

Great location! The place was very clean, spacious, and comfortable. The area felt safe, which made our stay even more enjoyable. The host was very responsive and answered right away whenever we had questions. Check-in was easy, and the property was very convenient to access. We had a wonderful stay, would definitely recommend, and would love to return in the future!

Location, location! We took public transportation or walked everywhere. There was a bus stop super close and the blu line stop was a 10 minute walk. You could easily walk to find new neighbourhoods. Bridget was great to deal with. The apt was spacious. The king size bed and the two bathrooms were the best!
Hosts were so helpful and accommodating! Would definitely recommend!

The location was great and the space was just perfect for a weekend in Chicago! Close to many walkable restaurants and even the pharmacy is just a short walk away. Dana was great with her instructions and I felt right at home. Thanks!

One of the better Airbnb locations.  The apartment was as described. We were comfortable the minute we walked in.  The pillows were awesome and that was unexpected.  We actually had goodnights sleep.  The location is great if you want to visit the park about couple of blocks away but it's a bit of a distance from the magnificient mile and it's attractions. Otherewise everything else was awesome.

Sarah’s place was the perfect spot for my family and I to spend a beautiful summer weekend together. The rooms being on different level really helped with privacy and having little kids in the same house.
Great stay with my family. Huge space and very clean!

Brandon was a great host, he always responded immediately whenever I messaged him. The apartment was clean and looked exactly like the pictures. Although there was no Central air, there was ac units in the apartment to keep it cool.. very convenient location, near plenty of stores and downtown. Would stay here again🥰
Perfect spot for a long weekend in Chicago. Simple place with good A/C and a comfy bed. We enjoyed ourselves here!
Thank you for having us!

Step into an oasis of quiet & comfortable.  Easily accessible, well appointed decor, comfortable furnishings, super spotless clean, top notch lil kitchen & bathroom.  Proactive and communicative hosts.  Very welcoming.   Pay attention to parking permit zones and street sweeping.  Near everything you need. Highly recommend.

The home is beautiful but there were some things that could be improved. I would gladly return if the cleanliness, stocking of essentials, and communication were improved. While the property has great potential, a more thorough cleaning and better supplies would enhance the experience. With these issues addressed, I believe this could be a fantastic place to stay.
We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location in Edgewater was perfect with easy access to restaurants, Loyola, and public transit.
Very pleased with my stay! The location was great, very clean, and the hosts communicated quick and efficiently.
The place was nice and host was very responsive when I needed anything. Just thought it was a three bedroom instead of two but we made it work.
This was a great place to stay in Wicker Park! Fun cafes, restaurants, bars and shopping within walking distance and despite that the room itself was peaceful and fairly quiet. We had a great stay!
Simple and cozy apartment in a great location. Perfect home base to explore the city.
Amazing Host and Beautiful place we will stay there again.

Location was great and the place looks just like the photos- Fresh and clean and new. I traveled with 2 other girlfriends and we had a great time. It's super walkable. We popped over to Aldi's when we arrived to grab a few snacks to keep in the apartment but Chicago has such good food, we didn't really need to. Upon arrival, you do have to bring your bags up a narrow staircase which was fine for us but could be difficult for someone with movbility challenges. There is a Karaoke bar downstairs on the same block, but I never really heard any noise from it except for a few people coming and going outside. I would stay here again if I visited Chicago. Hosts were very fast communicators.
Nice apartment, a very quiet and safe area
Very responsive host. Great location

Simple and easy to find.
House rules easy to follow.
Clean room and house.
Plenty of towels and pillows given.
Straightforward cleaning procedure.

Was a really nice accommodation and stay. The hosts were really responsive and helpful. The area is fine and accessible with a lot of surrounding restaurants and stores. Definitely recommend for your next trip to Chicago.
We had a great stay and the hosts were extremely responsive.

Sharon’s home is a great spot for anyone visiting Chicago. It is just a few blocks away from Wrigley Field and within walking distance to restaurants, bars, and various public transportation options. The unit is spacious and great for groups of five or more. I would definitely book this spot again.
Very lovely home- hosts were very helpful! Proximity to transit station was convenient
Had a great trip and would recommend staying with Tibo ventures.
Good location.

Very spacious inside - nice size bedrooms and open spaces. The back deck was a great place to enjoy the summer weather and the 1st floor living room sofa was a cozy spot to wind down with friends. We made use of the well-stocked kitchen and the location was convenient to the places we wanted to be (all northside). Had a little difficulty accessing the unit at check-in time but it was resolved in about an hour.
Felice is a wonderful host, and welcomed me into her home.

This apartment was a beautiful space and convenient to our family and restaurants.  Many thoughtful amenities made our stay quite enjoyable. The street was quiet and peaceful.  It seemed to have plenty of parking. We loved walking in the neighborhood.  Since our daughter lives close by we would love to come stay again.

We were downtown for my kiddos first pride parade! Mera’s post was honest about the train noise and even provided earplugs! We didn’t spend much time in the place but it was clean and peaceful when we didn’t spend much! Thanks for helping us give my kiddo a Pride to remember!
Great location, place was clean and easy to find! Anastasia also let me check in earlier which was very kind of her :)
This was the best place to stay for our visit to Chicago! Highly recommend the accommodations and host!
great stay!

We never wanted to leave
Hunters home was everything you could want and more in an Airbnb. It felt like staying with family or good friends. The little touches, from the comfortable beds to a scented spray for your bathroom needs, made us feel right at home. The neighborhood is adorable, walkable, and full of street parking. We were never parked more than a half block away. Hunter was friendly, attentive, but never intrusive. His recommendations were fabulous; the miso mushroom brioche and the tiramisu cloud cookie at Super Moon our favorite bites all trip. This place fells like an adult retreat while still being kid friendly. The books and toys were a huge hit with our toddler and we were grateful for the little bluey toilet cover and pack and play. We very much enjoyed our weekend in Chicago and Hunter’s place was the perfect sanctuary to return to after a long day of fun. Thank you again! Can’t wait to stay next time we’re in town.
Aysin’s place was very nice, comfortable and located in a lovely walkable neighborhood. Aysin was very accommodating when I needed to request a late checkout. Definitely recommend staying here!

The apartment was perfect for me and my daughter. It was close to various public transportation, and many eateries and shops were within a walkable distance. Mikael was very helpful and quick to communicate. Would definitely recommend this stay!
Quick responses and a beautiful neighborhood. House was spacious and very clean!
This is the best place to stay in chicago. The location is perfect and you can walk to anything. The host is just as AMAZING! The greatest city in the world. 10/10 stars

From the very start Alvenna was communicative, helpful and knowledgeable. Please note that this residence is inside a 100-year-old building. Things creak, the walls are sometimes thin and there is no HVAC. We would definitely stay again when we visit Chicago!

Easy walking distance to 18th street, Pilsen. first floor, so no hiking the stairs, which was nice. Parking place too. The whole package was worth it.
Would stay there again.

Booked this for 6 people and paid for early check in. Upon arrival there was a horrendous sewer smell. Contacted host immediately and there was no sense of urgency to come and remedy issue. Host was unable to come and check out property in a meaningful time. Host came 8 hours later and by then I had already requested a full refund and found a new Airbnb to check into. I explained multiple time I wanted to cancel but host refused and still attempted to charge my for the full stay although we had already checked out and moved to new Airbnb. I would not recommend staying here. Neighbors upstairs are loud and have two smelly dogs. Kids running up and down the halls as well. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

I had a great stay at Heidi’s place for three nights! The house is very clean and comfortable and is a short walk to the Chinatown red line station, making it easy to get around the city. (She also has two sweet kitties!) I felt safe and comfortable here as a solo female traveler. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for reasonably priced accommodations in Chicago.

This place is really cute, private, clean, and a great location in a nice neighborhood. I felt very at home. They have a late checkout time which we didn’t need but is a plus. My only complaint would be the bed was not comfortable for two people.
What a lovely spot!  Well laid out, all the things you would want in a place, comfortable everything, clean and welcoming. The back porch is a bonus. Will be on our repeat list for sure!!

Really enjoyed spending a long weekend in Chicago and this place was perfectly located to take advantage of all the city has to offer! On top of that, Tere was an absolutely exceptional host. She immediately responded to every question I had and handled every need in a friendly and professional way. The apartment is lovely - very clean and spacious and included everything I needed for a great stay. Highly recommend!

Musa's place was a great place to stay.  It is on a charming street and felt  safe.  It is very comfortable and extremely clean!  Musa was easy to communicate with and gave us some good neighborhood recommendations.   I would definitely stay there again.
Great place near Chicago downtown! And honestly host is great at communication and is always very helpful with the instructions!
Very easy to contact, always got a quick response!  The beds were wonderful!  So comfortable!  Great location to restaurants (walkable) to many places.  Would stay again for sure.
Place was exactly as described and I love that it’s a very walkable area and close to the L train!
Thank you for your stay. Wonderful host and always responded if I needed anything. Wonderful location

The Hosts were amazing and super helpful. From the beginning they wanted you to feel welcomed and like you belonged.
The house is spacious and has tons of space for a family or a big group of friends. The decor makes it feel like you transported somewhere fun and not just a Home.
When things arose that needed attending to they were right there to solve any and all. Would recommend this 10/10
Janet was very communicative and all the instructions were very helpful and easy to follow. Great location to check out Lakeview!
I had an amazing time in Chicago and Mark made that time all the easier. Perfect for a low key solo get away. Highly recommend.
Wonderful! Very responsive host and good instructions. Great price and area, lots of stores and food and close to redline.

Annika’s place is a lovely apartment, very spacious and comfortable. It’s very quiet and secure,and the apartment is nicely furnished, two large TVs (living room, bedroom), large kitchen with a big dining table. Parking is easy and free on the residential street. The neighborhood is also very quiet, a block away from a Chicago Transit Authority bus stop. It’s one of the nicest Airbnb accommodations in which I’ve stayed, and I hope to stay there again. Also, Annika is a very responsive host. I didn’t need directions and had my own itinerary, but I know I could have counted on her had I needed anything.
Freehand was a great place to stay with plenty of locations nearby to enjoy

10/10 Would stay here again! The garden path is so peaceful and lush, it gives you this extra feeling of privacy. The street is quiet. The space definitely feels comfortable. Mark and his family are very respectful and they respond quickly to any issues or concerns. Couldn't ask for anything better.
Simiao place is in the top places  where i stay very clean and organized with easy instructions  beautiful decorations i definitely stay there in my next trips
We greatly enjoyed staying at Gabrielle's place! It was clean, charming, and she was incredibly friendly and accommodating throughout. We couldn't have had a better visit to Chicago!
100% will book here again for the next occasion. This place was very clean, short walking distance to Wrigley and Boystown attractions.  Host was very responsive.  A unique Chicago experience.
Brett's place is beautiful!! Huge with a great kitchen and living area. Neighborhood is close to restaurants and shops
The space was exactly as advertised. Clean, comfortable, and a great location. Would definitely stay again!

We were in town for a long weekend helping our daughter move and Alma's place was perfect for us. It's very secure and in a great location. There's a Whole Foods and Walgreen's right there if you need anything. The photos are accurate. We'd definitely stay here again. Highly recommend.

This unit is directly above a beloved wicker park neighborhood bar. I fully knew what I was getting — previously lived in the neighborhood.
It honestly was not nearly as loud as I thought it would be, and I slept like a baby with the super cozy pillows and fluffy bed sheets. Didn’t need my earplugs. The bedroom is also situated away from the busiest section of the bar itself, so closing the bedroom door was enough for me to drown out all extra noise. Loved the randomly rustic interior, and it was very clean.
Location is excellent; it’s in the middle of wicker park, and everything is walkable and close.
The only thing I’ll add is that there aren’t any other extra doors separating the inside of the unit. Basically: front door -> stairs -> unit. You really have to make sure the front door is closed and locked all the way. I really wasn’t worried about it since I know the neighborhood well, but I guess I could see anyone unfamiliar with the area feeling a bit unsure about it.
Very nice, comfortable accommodations. Easy to find, very visitor friendly. A very nice experience.
It was a beautiful place, if I could I would live there.  Great location.  The upstairs neighbors never seemed to stop stomping and making noise but overall it was lovely!

We had a very nice stay at this flat. It was spotlessly clean and quite spacious. We had no issues gaining access and Mera was always very quick to respond to any inquiries. The neighborhood is a great place to stay and the location puts you on a leafy street between two streets with a lot of shopping, restaurants, bars, activities and several grocery stores if you want to prepare your own food at all.

Clean. Walkable to McCormick Place. Nearby parking available that is cheaper than other places. Two bedrooms with their own bathrooms was exactly what we needed. Slight delay in response to some questions, but was made up for in professionalism. I would stay here again! Thanks, Milan!

Unit was clean but looked old. Bathroom had a water dripping that seems not being taken care for long time. Building is very old and smelly. Someone pee in the elevator and no one cleaned it until Monday morning. It was 45 mins by Public transportation so not very convenient for a family that went only for 2 days.
This place was perfect for my large group. Very peaceful & homey location. We had an amazing time there. Shomari was very responsive & ready to help with whatever we needed. 10/10 ! 🫶🏽
This is our 3rd time staying here and we hope to stat again.  The neighborhood is very walkable to plenty of bars and restaurants.  Public transport is very close, as well.  We love staying here.
Wonderful place !
amazing place to stay . close to everything I needed. very clean and relaxing vibes . sound machine was a huge plus would definitely stay again

We stayed here with our two kids and had such a nice stay. The place was spotless when we arrived and it was so easy to find it. There were some lovely snacks and coffee pods available. The beds were quite comfy and my kids slept great because the street the house is on is so quiet but still very close to a major road with a bus. Leah recommended a few spots for us to check out and one of the coffee shops we ended up going to every morning. Leah was also so responsive to our questions. We would definitely stay here again
Great spot to stay on a short combined family/work visit. Easy to get to locations I needed and plenty of room.
The place was great,  well stocked, in a great area. Adam was responsive and the place was super nice. Would stay again in a heartbeat!
My stay at this BnB was all I could ask for and more. I was very appreciative of the hosts swift response and daily check-in.

Beautiful home! They were very responsive and accommodating - allowing us to check in very early the first day! Would definitely recommend! Walking distance from some lovely neighborhood coffee shops and restaurants!

Great stay in a lovely neighborhood! The backyard and barbecue grill made for a nice evening activity. The place had plenty of space for two adults with everything we needed. I’d definitely stay again.
The place is very spacious and has plenty of beds. Worked well for our group!
Hosts are very responsive and helpful!

Great place for the price! About a 10 minute walk to the orange line, which connects to Midway. Easy public transportation and took about 45 minutes to get to the Loop. Edwin was nice enough to let us store our bags after checkout since we had an evening flight!
A great space for our family of 4.  Beds were comfortable, handy tech everywhere and well furnished space.  Will try to book again next time we're in the area

John went above and beyond to provide extra requested amenities during my groups stay. The beds were extremely comfortable (including the cot). The neighborhood is absolutely adorable and is SUPER walkable. We had some issues with getting the door to lock but felt safe enough in the neighborhood to just keep it unlocked until we returned. The place itself is quite dated and could benefit from a thorough deep cleaning. Overall I would recommend John’s place and would come back again!
Great place clean comfortable and easy parking. Will definitely book again.

We loved our stay at the Hygge Hideaway! The space was huge and well-decorated, with comfortable beds and furniture. The location in Lincoln Square could not be better- we were walking distance to Horner Park, great restaurants/coffee shops, and groceries. Our hosts were so friendly, helpful, and responsive. I could have stayed forever, truly!

Inside, the apartment was clean. Outside, however, was pretty messy. We had to wipe down the rocking chairs and sweep the front porch in order to use this area. (Lots of dirt , branches, leaves and bird poop.) Also, we couldn’t turn off the heat inside - which was a problem during the warm summer weather we experienced. There were no instructions available for turning off the heat (not sure if visitors are even allowed to do so) or operate the window AC units. (We tried to operate these units but they just seemed to blow warm outside air.)
Great location.  Very clean.  Walkable to Wrigley and Southport Ave.

Abby was so friendly, responsive, and provided everything we needed, including extra pillows upon request. Very clean, spacious room with nice bathroom and shower. Easy to find and enter/exit the home. Delicious food all walking distance. Short walk from Thalia Hall which is what we were there for. Would definitely stay here again! We had a lovely time and felt right at home.

This is a great spot around Lincoln Park. Beautiful street.  Walkable to every restaurant you would want to go to. Adam is very easy to get hold of and responds promptly. We would definitely stay there again when we are back in Chicago.
Benjamin was super responsive and helpful and his place was easily accessible and in a great neighborhood !

This air bnb was perfectly located and lots of little amenities! I appreciated how thoughtful the hosts were and seeing their studio and artwork was very heartwarming. The hosts went above and beyond to ship us a special item back we left behind and were super communicative the whole stay. We would stay here again!
Great place to stay, close to Division St restaurants. Friendly and accommodating host

Molly is a wonderful, kind, informed and responsive host. I very much enjoyed my stay and will definitely be back. Super easy access to public transportation and other amenities. If the room is open for your dates, don't hesitate to book your stay! You won't regret it.
Good location and the host was responsive and helpful.
The stay was great, lots to do around the apartment, close to public transportation.
Brilliant place! Super nice air BnB in a nice neighbourhood. Short walk to the metro, made it easy to get to downtown or the airport. Responsive and helpful host, would definitely recommend.

Amazing home! Amazing host! Amazing neighborhood. Stayed at Sean’s for a friends trip and we all agree, one of the best airbnbs we’ve ever stayed. The area is walkable and central, the house itself was so clean and had many group areas to lounge around and everything you could need was provided. Sean responded quick and was very helpful to any questions we had! We would absolutely love to stay here again.

This basement apartment was in an excellent location for what we were doing in Chicago and was in a quiet, safe neighborhood with plenty of street parking. Both beds were comfortable (but the foundations were quite noisy if your partner moved at all - especially the full bed). The bathrooms were nice, but brighter lighting is needed in the main bathroom as we couldn’t see well to fix our hair, etc. Things were pretty clean other than some cobwebs/bugs, but we know how quickly those come out in basements! Overall, it’s a great space for 4 people, and Maria was a responsive host. Thank you, Maria!
I’d stay again.
Great place to stay! Josh was very responsive whenever there was an issue or we had questions.

Was going to a conference at McCormick Center and this was very convenient, with plenty of room for my family of four. Everything went smoothly. Very close to public transportation and lots to do within walking distance. Would stay there again.
Worked well due to the location and we only needed a place to sleep.
Had a great time! Good location and walkable to many bars/restaurants; host was responsive when we needed help with keypad. Enjoyed our stay!

We had an amazing stay! The home was spacious, spotless, and truly felt like a home away from home. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the entire experience seamless. We’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

This was our second stay at Helen's. It's an amazing base from which to attend a conference or convention at McCormick Place, and we love that the fabulous restaurant Yassa is right down the street. We felt right at home in the neighborhood and at Helen's place.
Milan’s place was clean and lived up to expectations. He was very responsive to any issues that came up and followed up on resolution.
Our family (with 2 toddlers) was very comfortable! Provided an awesome home base for our busy wedding weekend with extended family.

Wonderful stay at Kavin's place! Easy to find and get into the airbnb.
Airbnb itself looks exactly like the photos and honestly even better in person! So new and clean, has everything you need for a longer stay even though we were just there for a long weekend. Very spacious and the private bathroom in the master was so nice. Beds are extremely comfortable, but it can be a bit bright in the morning. Felt cozy and right at home.
Location, although seems a bit far from the Loop just looking at the map, the airbnb is just a few minutes walk to the Pink Line, which takes you straight to the most central parts of Chicago in about 20-25min. We never felt that it was particularly out of the way or that is was inconvenient for getting around. Overall I felt the location was good because it was in a quieter neighborhood and we were able to get some good rest, start the day a bit slower.
Lots of Mexican food in the area and Costco a few streets away!
Already wish I could go back :)
Good place for a weekend trip for 5.  All the basic amenities provided.   Milan was quick to respond to any needs we had.

We had a great time at Serg’s place in Chicago. The space was exactly as pictured and was very clean. Easily slept 6 adults with room to spread out. The location is right across from a fire station, so it can be a little noisy. It’s about a 15 minute walk to the train and there is also a bus stop right outside of the property. We split our time using public transportation and ride share services. Serg is very communicative, often messaging us each day to check in. While it was helpful to have an available host, we felt the check-ins were a little too frequent. Overall would stay at Serg’s place again!

Mel and Ronneisha were great hosts! The place was just as described and very nicely decorated and cleaned! They gave very nice clear instructions, I had a comfortable stay and it was centrally located. I was always able to find parking right around the corner with no problems. Close proximity if you have lots to do downtown.
Excellent location within easy walking distance of McCormick Place Convention Center.  Beds very comfortable and kitchen well equipped.
The apartment was very clean and comfortable. Close to our grandchildren’s  home. Perfect for us.
Went here for my bachelor party and had an absolute blast! Eva was great and was incredibly easy to communicate with. Had a great time!

Zen Garden was a great choice for the conference I was attending at McCormick Place. I was able to park my car for free in their driveway or the street. I took the #3 bus that had a stop by Culver's and it was a short ride to McCormick place.
Zen Garden had everything I needed in the room and it was super clean and comfortable. Loved the shower and appreciated all the hooks to hang things. They even had hangers so I could hang up my clothes. It was nice having access to a kitchen and a living room with a nice view out the window of a green space. I also really appreciated the bottled water.
I went to the grocery store Jewel to get food to eat to save money. I kept it in the fridge in the room, but again had access to a bigger fridge in the kitchen if I needed it.
Zen Garden was very accommodating when I found out my conference went longer than my check out time. They allowed me to stay parked there until I was ready to leave which I really appreciated.
Would stay again!!!
Great communication and the house was great!
It was very nice. Cihan was easy to reach and gave me full details of instructions. Thank you.

This was the third time I've stayed at Ryan's place and it's just the perfect spot!  As noted in my earlier reviews, his place is beautiful, in a great location and is just a short walk to the CTA Brown Line, to shopping and to great restaurants.  His kitchen is well-stocked if you prefer to eat in, the beds are very comfortable and the living space is well organized.  There is also a separate work space and fast internet if you need that.  Please check out my previous reviews too, but this time I want to mention a few perks that I really enjoyed.  Ryan offers a great parking space in the garage and it's easy to get in and out if you're driving.  His place also has a rooftop deck area that we really love!  We grilled on the deck several days and enjoyed breakfast and evening drinks on the deck watching the sunset.  It is a great spot for beautiful Chicago days.  Ryan is a wonderful host.  He is very proactive and responsive.  I highly recommend his place for a long Chicago stay!
Good stay near Lincoln Square.
Location is perfect for if you plan to stay in Northalsted area. It has great restaurants and places to visit that are very walkable. Would stay again
Great space and great location, especially for a larger group!
Great location. Place was clean and charming. I loved the historical architecture of the apartment.
The place was great.

The place was in a great location, safe and quiet neighborhood. Not too far from anywhere you'd want to go. It was clean and the central A/C was really good.  It averaged out to about $228/night which is expensive for what it is but it was the cheapest option we could find and it was very nice for what it was.

Stayed in town for a get together with friends. The host was incredibly accommodating, proactive, and the place was spotless.
The pictures understate this incredible living space.
If we are back in the area there is a high likelihood we come back here.
Just some things wasn’t what it was described to be ijs
We enjoyed staying here during a visit to Chicago for a wedding. We were walking distance to the beach and plenty of other amenities. We enjoyed the rooftop access the gym and the club room as well!
The space was incredibly functional for our family. It was a wonderful choice for our visit, and we’d definitely come back!

Laura and Glenn have a space that is truly a gem on the north side of Chicago. Here you can see eclectic beauty in every corner, ranging from fun colors in the living spaces to a wonderfully curated backyard full of thriving native species plants. They are always ready to answer any questions you may have and are a joy to interact with!

Hate to keep it short, but not much yo say. Everything listed is what you get, and the host is very kind, helpful, and responsive. Felt like I was staying at a friend's house and they wanted to make sure our trip was perfect. He went above and beyond for us.
Spotless when we showed up. Either he or someone else is a top notch cleaner. Everything seemed brand new it was so clean.
Great location and walkability for Edgewater and Andersonville . This neighborhood is residential with many trees.
Nice clean place to stay in a comfy suburban environment

Kirsten was friendly and communicative and gave helpful instructions for check-in and check-out. Upstairs neighbors were a bit loud the first night, but otherwise a quiet neighborhood and great location close to downtown.

My wife and I visited Chicago for the first time and this airbnb felt just like home! easy to find and located in a great spot close enough to either uber downtown or find good public transportation. Place was clean and beautiful. It can be noisy in the mornings/nights depending on the other guests sharing the same space (private room though) but other than that I can't recommend this place enough!
Great host, would stay here again.
Excellent spot in a fun neighborhood. The place was easy to access and was within walking distance of good restaurants and coffee shops. Access to transit and the park were a nice bonus!
Great location! Lots if good restaurants and walkable activities near by!
Great stay, Thanks for everything!
Excellent location for visiting family who lived in the North Center neighborhood.  Close to restaurants, pharmacy and the El train.  Richard was always in contact if we had questions.

The place was light and bright and cozy with way more light than you would expect for a basement.  There were really nice touches like big cozy towels and easy pull down shades for the bedrooms. Host was thoughtful. Great experience!

Wir hatten eine perfekte Zeit bei Janet und Chuck.
Die Lage der Unterkunft ist toll, direkt in einer wunderschönen Nachbarschaft mit schönen Restaurants und Boutiquen.
Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und wir haben uns dort extrem wohlgefühlt. Janet und Chuck sind sehr freundlich und haben sogar kostenlose, Bagels, Snacks und Getränke zum Verzehr bereitgestellt.
Ich würde es immer weiterempfehlen.
Everything was nice, great host and location of the place close to a train station 👍

Jennifer was an excellent host! Can’t recommend enough. Her place was quiet, nice and cool during the summer months, and dog friendly. Our pups loved her place. Jennifer was extremely responsive to any needs we had. We will be returning 100%!!!

Thoughtful host who obviously cared about the experience of the guests and condition of the rental.  Incredible Lakeview location, easy access from ORD by CTA subway and bus, saving an expensive car ride.

The location of the space is right in the middle of everything. Getting inside was simple and easy and the place was as described. Communication with them was super easy and they were very responsive.
The unit was very clean and comfortable! We loved the neighborhood. The hosts provided helpful recommendations and responded quickly to our questions and concerns.

My friends and I mainly used this airb&b for sleeping overnight between ventures into Chicago, and it was just what we needed! It was also a nice pitstop if we had some time in between. It was cozy, and I didn't have any complaints. Denisha was also very kind and very responsive. I would definitely stay here again!
This was a wonderful stay and even better service from Angie’s. Would recommend staying here if you are in the Chicago West Town area!

This is a great cost effective option if you're looking to visit Chicago. It's a 15 minute walk from the Red Line so if you're wanting to go downtown fast for cheap that's available for you. The area is great for walking around or just getting some air too! Highly recommended.
Loved having the pink line so close by. The apartment was very quiet and the host was very responsive. This place was perfect for my stay!

Dejlig roligt område boligen findes i.
Rummelig og hyggelig kælderetage.
Nemt med bus nr. 152 lige udenfor døren, som går mod byen eller mod lufthavnen (med et skift).
Petra var sød og rar til at hjælpe med forskellige ting.
David was very professional and considerate. Everything was clean and organized and ready for us to have a good weekend 😌
Everything was centrally located  to everything. The only downfall is the noise upstairs other than that excellent place to stay..
Great location right next to the ballpark! Very walkable area and close to the Addison stop on the L. The hosts were very responsive and quick to address any of our needs/requests.
Perfect airbnb stay. Thank you!

The place was very clean, but also very sparse in terms of decor and some comfort.  There was just a bed in the bedroom, no dresser or chest to unpack some things. There were only 4 hangers. The pillows were uncomfortably large/thick for sleeping.  But overall it was fine for sleeping, and accessing other things.
Great value. Google Maps doesn't work well for the address FYI. Parking is scarce but normal for the city.

Signs said “no smoking” but the second I walked in it smelled like smoke. The bunk bed frame made a lot of noise making it hard to sleep especially when turning over. I’m not sure if it was the smell of cigarettes or air quality in general but both my friend and I woke up with a stuffy nose. I also noticed mold on the ceiling of the bathroom. The steps after getting into the apartment need repair. They are uneven. There were other guests in other bedrooms which used up 2 rolls of toilet paper a day. I only stayed 2 days so by the next morning we ran out. It was the cheapest I could find near the city. It is in a convenient spot. The inicial text seemed a bit passive aggressive. They also told my not to rate them less than a 4 star. When there was mold on the ceiling and smelled like cigarettes. If I were to come back to Chicago I wouldn’t choose this place.
Stuart’s place is very neat snd clean. It looks just like the description. The Airbnb is in a great location. Easy parking spot available.

My family and I had a great time! One thing that stood out was when we initially arrived there was someone parked in our designated parking spot, when we reached out to our host, he responded almost immediately and was urgently correcting the issue. The issue ended up being a neighbor parking there by mistake, but our host read our message and was honestly more concerned than we were! Overall great stay, as far as the place, being on the top floor it was quite the walk up but very much worth it.

This property was perfect for us as a group of four. The location is great. There are Divvy bikes outside the door so it's easy to cycle everywhere. The 606 trail is just around the corner which is beautiful. Great restaurants, bars and cafes within walking distance. Property was clean and had everything we needed.

Ensavi's place is perfect for one or two persons that want to go to Chicago. It is as photos show and temperature is very good, it can be regulated with what is inside. It is located in a very nice, pretty neighborhood and it also felt very safe; it is also pretty well connected with public transportation (bus station few steps away and subway a block away)
If you want to stay here, I will recommend to have earplugs because floors in the building are kind of old and any steps from above are heard.
Very pretty place, missed the part where it said he was living there, so was shocked when I found that out. Wasn’t a big deal though Devon was super kind and welcoming.

Really nice place to stay if you don’t want to be in the city. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful. I didn’t mind the 15-20 minute drive to the city. Overall the stay at Jermaill’s place was pleasant.

Perfect little spot for a  long wedding weekend. A true slice of Chicago neighborhood living, within easy rides to everything. Kevin was a great host and very responsive. The balcony area is cute landing spot in the evenings and Sunday morning to listen to the church bells.
Host was very helpful and quick to respond. We had 10 guests that fit quite nicely in this space.
Gorgeous space, Vladimir was an amazing host and was super responsive, will definitely stay with him again
Right in the heart of Wicker Park. Walkable to restaurants, public transportation, parks and entertainment.
We have stayed here before and will be back.
Amenities were great. Good snacks and drinks as well as a toothbrush for the one that forgot to bring one
This home was perfect for our group. The location and price were unbeatable.
Great Stay and Great Neighborhood

Andrew was a great host!  The listing was very neat and clean.  Andrew was also very responsive and gave us very clear instructions in getting all checked in and out.  I definitely recommend staying here if you want great food options and walkability.
This place felt so cozy the moment we stepped in, and I had such an amazing stay here while having a weekend in the city. Thank you Jacob!

Alma's space was exactly what I needed for a long weekend in Chicago. The location is top tier in Lakeview and made it incredibly easy to walk to restaurants, coffee shops, the lakefront, and public transit. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and matched the listing perfectly. Check-in was seamless, and Alma was responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great home base while visiting Chicago.
I enjoyed my time staying here. It was quiet. The neighborhood felt safe. On street parking was very easy and I was able to park right in front of the house.

We loved our stay in Chicago and thought this was the perfect spot. Andrew was responsive and had great recommendations. We loved the neighborhood and had some wonderful meals that were within walking distance.
The most spotless Airbnb I’ve stayed in. Other highlights are very comfortable, king sized beds, upscale bathrooms, and short walk to the lake.

We booked this place because it was closest to my brother's apartment. It was smack dab in the middle of all the celebrations but far enough away that we weren't disturbed by all the people. Very comfortable and clean. Very close to all the festivities and walking distance to several amazing restaurants.

absolutely beautiful victorian with super easy street parking. great value and super close to a train station.
i would not recommend for summer. our room was super hot and humid even with the AC on full blast. for anyone who wants to play pool, the table here was pretty janky.
Really enjoyed my stay at this Airbnb! Reinaldo was proactive helpful and a lovely host. Highly recommend for those looking for a place that’s just outside of the city and close to the airport.

This place could be fabulous with a little love. The apartment smelled nice. The bed was comfortable. The air conditioner in the bedroom was powerful and we were quite comfortable in June. Great location with plenty of access to public transit, shops, and the lake. Very responsive host. However, the whole place is overall very dark and lacked some basic amenities (like conditioner).

we had a nice stay at this airbnb! besides the fact that the bar downstairs is open very late and you can hear and feel the music and all of the street noise it was a convenient stay with all that we needed. we loved the area and appreciated being so close to public transit. maybe not the best if you want to be in the center or the city but great spot for a cooler downtown-ish experience. the airbnb was well stocked with linens, towels, etc. but some felt a bit musty and the place was a bit dusty. otherwise fine for the few days we were staying. host was responsive and flexible about check in/out!

Brad was amazing and we loved staying at his home! We had everything we needed and then some. I really appreciate his attention to detail, care for his guests and overall just being a great host.
Recommendation: If you stay in Chicago or in the Ukr Village area, you have to try Monster Ramen! Ask for Iris, she was an incredible server and made us feel like we were locals in the city! :-)

Gogo provided extra coffee beans and offered to grind them, even though there was a grinder in the apartment. We were also offered to enjoy snacks and beverages left in the refrigerator. We had a great stay!
Johnie’s place was perfect for my group of six guests. It had everything we needed and was in a great location. I would definitely recommend his place and would stay there again!
It was nice meeting you and my wife enjoyed it
Excelente todo muy bien

My team and I had an excellent stay at Troy's home. It's a safe neighborhood, close to restaurants and coffee shops (I particularly enjoyed Standing Passengers and its eclectic pop decor). We were interested in Catholic sites like St. John Cantius, St. Stanislaus (a striking Marian monstrance and 24/7 adoration there), and St.  Mary of the Angels (a breathtaking basilica). The Mother Cabrini national shrine was inspiring. We typically ubered to spots, but some of these were walkable within 15-30 minutes. An uber to Navy Pier was about 20 minutes (though traffic can make that vary). Troy was quick to communicate, and everything was great!
Lovely place, gorgeous kitchen and outdoor patio! Close to a ton of restaurants and Cleo’s is right across the street, was fun to watch a few World Cup games there.

Fantastic location,  very comfortable stay. The split level layout made it really nice for us and our family to feel like we had our own spaces. It was very peaceful and I cannot stress enough how great the restaurants are within a block! Betty was a very nice host and we would definitely stay here again.

Very nice appartement with a great location ! Marta gives clear instructions for the entrance and everything corresponds to the pictures :)
The district is cool and peaceful !
I 100% recommend this flat !!

Really cute apartment! Especially loved the stunning tub in the bathroom and the peaceful porch / balcony space. The host is super responsive and friendly. Adding it to the favorites list to suggest to friends or rebook in the future!
Place was comfortable, clean, and great for a private quiet stay! Enjoyed my stay at Roberto’s Loft, will definitely stay again.
Great spot!

Michelle was a phenomenal host! She was responsive, communicative, and quick to help whenever we had questions. The check-in and check-out instructions were very clear, which made the entire process easy.
The Airbnb was clean, well maintained, and had everything we needed for our stay. The neighborhood was quiet, and the location felt like a rare find. I'm somewhat familiar with the area, so I really appreciated how conveniently located it was. It was close to several places we wanted to visit, and getting to the expressway was quick and easy whenever we wanted to explore other parts of the city.
We also appreciated Michelle's professionalism and fairness when an unexpected issue came up during our stay. She communicated clearly throughout the process, and everything was handled respectfully.
Overall, we had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend Michelle's place to anyone looking for a comfortable stay in Chicago.

This home was amazing. I had 5 of my friends come to Chicago on vacation to travel the city with me. We had a great time, and it was very convenient to the brown train line. The host and his dog were very friendly and gave us recommendations for places to eat in the area. There was just enough space for us, and it was very easy to get around. We had a great time and would highly recommend this home to anyone!
Family and I enjoyed ourselves staying here at the home. We planned ongoing next month. Hopefully it will be available.

Mary was such a wonderful and thoughtful host. I absolutely loved the style and taste of her apartment, and everything was so beautifully organized. After several flight delays, she was still able to receive us and made everything feel smooth and welcoming. She really took the time to make sure every detail was clear and easy to understand, which made us feel comfortable and well taken care of during our stay. Thank you so much, Mary, for sharing your lovely space with us!

Tommy’s place is very well maintained. It was very clean. It was very practical. Tommy met me upon check in, and he was easily accessible. The location is excellent, as it is very close to Wrigley Field and many bars and restaurants. We used the parking space which was wonderful. I would stay there again.

This was the perfect stay for our large bachelor party group! The location was incredibly convenient with plenty to do in walking distance and easy access to the train. Our host was accommodating, communicative, and flexible  throughout the visit. We are appreciative he was able to check us in early! He ensured we had everything we needed, including plenty of disposable earplugs placed throughout the house for the nearby train.
Good location

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had a wonderful stay! The home was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The hosts were friendly, responsive, and provided clear check-in/check-out instructions. The location was convenient, and everything we needed was available. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to others.
Rasheed communicated great and was exceptionally responsive.  Place was in a great location and was a spectacular place to stay!
we had a great stay. they both were very helpful with any questions I had during the stay. They always responded fast. we would for sure stay here again.
We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend. The hosts were very friendly and responsive, reaching out regularly to check in and see if we needed or anything or had any questions
very happy wpuld stay again

Karolina and Ramon were terrific hosts! They were very accommodating to my wife, toddler daughter and myself. They even provided a highchair for our daughter when we last minute realized we needed one :)
Comfortable and perfect size! Also great locatipn- exactly what we needed for our weekend visit!
Apartment was conveniently located and exactly as described.  We would definitely stay there again.
Great Airbnb for larger groups, nice distance to downtown either via car or public transit. Basement is a very cool hangout spot!
Lovely place to stay, so clean and ideal for a trip to Wrigleyville. Would highly recommend!
very good response time and was very kind to me throughout my stay.

Staying in Leigh’s place was a dream! It was beautiful, in the perfect spot in the city, and very comfortable. He describes it perfectly in the listing. He was very responsive to our messages. Would certainly stay again!
Great place, location, friendly staff. Highly recommended!!’

Really enjoyed our stay here. The neighborhood was really cute & conveniently located to stores & restaurants. The space was clean & had everything we needed. Communication was great & the host was very responsive. Would definitely recommend!!

My friends and I stayed at Sean's for a weekend. The apartment is beautiful and we felt so lucky that we were able to stay here while we attended a wedding nearby. The apartment is huge, with so much space to hang out. The 4 bedrooms feel private and gave each couple a comfortable place to retreat. There was also a parking spot for one of our guests to use, which was very convenient. It is a block away from the water and close to a Whole Foods, coffee shops, etc.
Amazing stay! The location was ideal and the place itself was so comfortable and clean. We would love to stay again! Thank you for being such a thoughtful and responsive host!
La’zeric was very nice and answered all my questions the place was nice to

Jerome was a very attentive host and check in on my and my guest when we weren’t checked in at the time we estimated to check in. He’s very friendly and his place is very nice and in a nice neighborhood. The Metra stations are close and easy to get to for transportation to downtown.
The place felt very homey, very spacious, and well kept.
The house and location were amazing! Austin was great at communicating and answering all of our questions!

Great place for a quick weekend in Chicago.
Beds were comfy, plenty of towels, kitchen was fully stocked.
Would definitely stay again.
Easy to access
Great location.

This place was fantastic! Exceptionally clean and located in a quiet, safe neighborhood. The home was well-equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable weekend stay, including a fully stocked kitchen.
I stayed with some teammates for a sports tourney, and the fitness/recovery area was a huge bonus. Having a stretching space, hand weights, a bench, an exercise bike, and foam rollers made our morning warm-ups and evening recovery sessions easy.
The bathroom had a bidet, and all of the beds (and sofa) were very comfortable.
The location was ideal, with restaurants, Whole Foods, the beach, and the Metrorail all just a short walk away.
Robert is a great host. He stayed in constant communication, graciously allowed us to have packages delivered, and we even had the pleasure of meeting him during our visit.
Overall, this was an excellent stay, and I highly recommend it. I would absolutely stay here again!

We stayed for a weekend meeting g up with our friends and had an amazing time. We had 4 adults and 5 kids u see the age of 12 and it was a wonderful space for us and the outdoor patio is gorgeous. We walked everywhere for the most part and highly recommend!

We had a wonderful stay! The space was absolutely beautiful—clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We felt safe throughout our visit, which made it even more enjoyable. The hosts were incredibly responsive and went above and beyond by quickly providing extra blankets when we requested them, which was greatly appreciated.
