The free parking was an added bonus and made our stay even more convenient. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing, hassle-free experience!
It’s a convenient location and comfortable unit. A bit tight the way it’s configured but nice.

Joan's place worked very well for me. It is definitely better for shorter people (basement apartment), as explained in her listing. Place was close to great restaurants and the neighborhood is quite and good walking distance to buses that can take you to trains. You could hear some movement from upstairs but it didn't bother me.
Joan checked in to see how the temperature was in the apartment since I couldn't control it. Overall, she was very responsive and I had a good experience in this stay!

John’s place was great!  We stayed a few nights here as home base for a bachelorette weekend. Very convenient  location  and close to the blue line. Plenty of things to do and easy to get around to various parts of the city. Everything was very comfortable and clean. There is also a great view of the skyline from the rooftop patio. Having a secured parking spot (room for 2 cars if needed) was a rare feature as well.

We had a great time during our stay. The Airbnb was conveniently located within walking distance of the train, which made getting around the city easy, and worked well for a large group.
This property may not be the best fit for those prioritizing a high-end Airbnb in a pretty area. However, if you are looking for a comfortable place to sleep with easy train access for a group trip or party-focused weekend, this is a great option.
The home does have minor cosmetic issues (wood rings, paint peeling in some drawers) and some functional issues (a bathroom lock didn’t work, pantry drawers installed improperly). Despite this, I do feel the space is attractive and for a good value! The views from the home are not ideal as the entire street is under construction and the back overlooks an empty lot.
We never felt unsafe during our stay and would recommend this Airbnb to groups looking for a similar experience. The owners were responsive, thoughtful, and helpful with all of my questions!

I enjoyed my stay overall. The room was clean, check-in was easy, and the shared space was quiet during my visit. My only issue is that I was expecting a private unit, while the accommodation is actually a private room in a shared apartment. I also interpreted the listing's "2 beds" to mean two beds in the room, but the second bed is the pull-out couch in the shared living area. It wasn't an issue once I arrived because the other house guest ended up being super chill, but it wasn't what I was expecting from my initial booking.
Our quick weekend stay at Gladys’ was everything and more. Thanks so much for a wonderful accommodation. Will be back again one day.
Perfect place to stay, just one block away from the CTA, pretty clean place and awesome hosts!

What a nice clean place to stay.  Walkable neighborhood with great restaurants and bars.  Loved the pac man game in the apartment.  Will definitely stay here again. Unfortunately the whole reason we came to Chicago was to see Lionel Richie and it was postponed at the last minute.
Great location and a fantastic place. Jeannie was an awesome host. Definitely recommend this spot!
Good location, private and walkable to west loop / Fulton market
Colin was a great host! Very responsive. The place was clean and perfectly located. We had an incredible stay.
Beautiful house, great location

Great vacation spot. We had a 1st cousin trip with 9 adults. The bunk beds are strictly for kids. The house was clean and had everything you would need away from home. Ryan response and communication was never delayed, she updated us on everything concerning the home. All beds were very comfortable. There are a lot of different restaurants, stores, nail salons in less than a 10 minute walk. We enjoyed the patio, so relaxing. I will be staying again when I return to Chicago.

Our stay here was wonderful! We had everything we needed and there were enough rooms for an extended family of grandparents, parents and teens to spread out. Super close to the Obama Center and we added a night visit to Navy Pier for the fireworks show. Neighborhood felt very safe coming back at night, not loud, low traffic, and check in was so easy. Thanks Brandon!

I'm the Local Coordinator for the Chicago chapter of Irreverent Warriors.  We just had our on the Lakefront this past weekend. we used the airbnb as setup point for the team for the day of the hike.  The garage was very helpful as well as the space.  Very comfortable space to stay.

This place was perfect for our bachelorette party! Instructions were clear, easy to get to, it was walkable to a lot of good places, great area, had everything we needed. The only thing I would say is it could have been cleaner, but it wasn't super dirty or anything!

Stayed here for my bachelorette trip and enjoyed our stay! Spacious enough to accommodate our large group and Louis was flexible with check in and had clear instructions. Place was clean and served its purpose!

This place is well remodeled. Easy to get to, felt very homey. We extended a few days because we felt comfortable and the weather opened up for a longer visit. All & all terrific modern home very well done. We will visit again.

Great people! So nice and communicative.
However, this place needs so much maintenance. No lock on the apartment building entrance. That is wild in Chicago. Anyone could have entered and been hiding by the elevator, in the stairwell, or up by the apt.
This apartment needs to take a month off Airbnb and closet doors need to be fixed, fridge needs maintenance (not that cool and no ice machine), floors need a deep clean and not just a swiffer, walls need to be repainted, guest bathroom is moldy, both bathrooms need a deep clean, windows need to open if you are not going to allow the thermostat to go down at night. Dusting needs to happen…
This place is good if you are going to be messy and you don’t want to get in trouble. That was not what we were looking for during our stay.

We stayed at this Airbnb with our adult children and their spouses. It was a perfect location for walking to the downtown area or grabbing bikes to ride the Lakeshore trail. A great little Irish bar across the street and lots of cute coffee shops nearby. Communication with the hosts was excellent. The apartment was perfect for a 3 day stay and we would definitely consider this place if we ever return to Chicago.

Arlene is the host everyone hopes for. Super attentive, helpful, and incredibly welcoming. Her instructions were spot-on and made check-in totally stress-free.
The apartment is lovely, but her willingness to go above and beyond is what made it special, she didn’t have to share local bar/restaurant/tourist suggestions or be “as available as we needed,” but she did anyway. We really appreciated that thoughtfulness!
10/10. Highly recommend and would 100% stay again.

First timer booking an AirBnB & visiting Chicago for the first time! Elizabeth’s private suite was incredible! She made instructions very clear for the guest like myself and her place was spot on! Very neat and organized! If I’ll ever stop by in Chicago soon I’ll definitely booked again with Elizabeth
It was good. I liked how close it is to the train station. The lincoln park area feels safe and the park is just 20 minutes of walk away.
We loved staying in Uptown and found everything super walkable of the L is right down the street.
This was a fantastic location, great apartment, and very communicative and responsive hosts! Absolutely recommend! Thank you so much for helping ensure our trip was a success!
Great place and just, very accommodating and responsive. Walkable neighborhood with several goodies. Felt safe and the space was clean
Heidi fully deserves her superhost rating. She went above and beyond to accommodate my needs while attending a convention at nearby McCormick Place.
This worked very well for us
Loved this place. Perfect location walkable to all the best Andersonville has to offer. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! Kory is a fantastic host and we would love to come back some time!

Location was easy to get to, with lots of places to park. Close and walkable to a lot of main areas such as Soldier Field, Millennium Park, Buckingham Fountain, the lake and surrounding areas.
The unit is on the 3rd floor and during our stay the elevator was out of order so we had to walk up the stairs. Just wanted to mention incase someone has an issue of walking up 3 flights of stairs, so you might want to make sure to ask this first.
Our family had a wonderful time here. Loved the kitchen, amenities, the layout, location, and overall vibe. Made our first ever visit to Chicago especially memorable!

Great space and good area. It was a little further from the hustle and bustle than expected but nothing too crazy. The space was nice and taken care of. Parking was a bit difficult at first (but only because we had 3 vehicles.) Florin was quick to respond when we had a small issue during the visit. I would stay again.
great place to stay, comfortable, and with lots of things to do nearby

Shana’s place is as described, clean, in a good location, and in a basement under people living their day-to-day lives. I wanted to give five stars, but when specifically asked about value, it would be dishonest for me to say the experience to cost ratio was more than “ok”. Lots of reviews reference how comfortable the bed is. I am 5’9”, my husband is 5’11”, we both wear mediums, and the bed was objectively too small for us. Shana is upfront about the bed size, but I hadn’t slept in a full in a very long time and the reviews saying it was comfortable definitely influenced me to think it’d be fine. I urge caution if you are sharing the bed with someone. Had the price been lower, I would say it was worth bad sleep, but for $190 a night (not including taxes and fees) this was not a great value.
Enjoyed my stay. Near the city and fun attractions, but still private enough and away from traffic.

Wonderful place in a great neighborhood. Perfect for the four of us. Clean, comfortable, quiet.
Emma was great host, very proactive and responsive.
Highly recommend this place and would stay there again in a heart beat.

Alis is amazingly responsive and extremely nice to deal with. Place was very clean,  very quiet, everything as it was listed. A few short steps away from the hottest spot on Division, Foxtrot a few steps away, great food options, easy to get Uber/Lyft pickup.
We had a great stay here! Everything was close by and Josh responded to all my questions!
Excellent place to stay in a pinch. Plus the free parking was a huge plus.
Very, very nice place and very conveniently located! It was clean, quiet, and peaceful! Absolutely enjoyed my stay!

I think for the price it was more than accommodating! Great location to walk to some local cafes and food! Felt like a private hotel room with the private bathroom and entrance! Ten min drive to some of the good spots for shopping also! I’ll be back asap ! I would have booked the room again for my trip in two weeks but unfortunately it’s booked out for all of July !!

“Absolutely beautiful Airbnb! It was exceptionally clean, cozy, and exactly as pictured. The attention to detail made it feel like a home away from home. The host was wonderful, and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and relaxing stay. I would definitely book again!”

nothing but amazing things to say about P & V!!!!!!! they were so welcoming, respectful and held great conversations. it was a beautiful stay there and I have found my go-to air bnb for Chicago! I will be recommending them to anyone I know that will be visiting Chicago as well. thank you for everything and opening your beautiful space to us! ♥️

La ubicación es excelente, el departamento es muy acogedor.
Lo único que agregaría es tener un poco mas de utensilios de cocina como sartenes y ollas para gente que en mi caso acostumbra a preparar au comida pero todo excelente sin lugar a dudas volveré de nuevo.
The location was perfect and the Airbnb was exactly as described
Fabulous weekend, exquisite accommodations!

Great space, with lots of included amenities, and clear check-in instructions.
Michael is a very friendly, accommodating, and responsive.
Friendly dog as well!
Very responsive, great location.
Great place close to everything

Everything was clean, well-organized, and very well maintained. The location was great, and parking was easy and convenient.
Some guests might think the house rules are a bit strict, but to me, that just shows how much the host cares about keeping the property in excellent condition. I actually prefer staying at places with clear and well-enforced rules because they usually provide a much better experience.
Everything was exactly as described, and this was one of the best places I've stayed. Highly recommended!!!

Overall good place for the price. The area did not feel entirely safe. Wifi worked well for recreational use but not strong enough for work from home needs. Upstairs neighbors were walking around all hours of the day/night. Talie was responsive when household needs ran low. Place was clean and as described.
We had a great stay! Nancy was wonderful and the place was perfect!
The home was absolutely beautiful and clean, and spacious. I will definitely book again.

Robin is a fantastic host! This is our second stay here and now our first choice when visiting Chicago!
I felt like he went the extra mile, very thoughtful and greeted us warmly. Very accommodating with our requests
It worked well for what we needed it for. The upstairs neighbors were a little loud at times but not too late during the night and it didn't prevent us from doing anything.
Great apartment with a beautiful patio!
Tastefully decorated, immaculately clean, perfect hostess. Could not have been better. Will never use a different place in Chicago.
Clean, responsive, great host. Space is bigger than it looks too

12/10 experience and super cool apartment! Steven was very communicative and Sara was so friendly and accommodating during my stay. The location is very walkable and there tons of cool cafes/restaurants/bars in the area. I can’t wait to book here again!
Laura did a great job checking in to make sure we got settled okay and was quick to respond to questions.

After having bad experiences with Air BnB hosts lately it was such a pleasure to be hosted by Valerie. Was proactive in promoting early check-in and check out even though we couldn’t take advantage of either.
Her amenities were great - nice towels, games for Kids, quality touches in a very historic unit and building.

What a beautiful and spacious home!  It worked perfectly for our family vacation!  The location was great - walking distance to great pubs, parks and restaurants.  We would stay again.  The art was magnificent, too!!

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Check in was smooth, and the host was responsive and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. The location was convenient, and we really appreciated the thoughtful touches that made us feel at home. We'd happily stay here again and would recommend it to others. Plus was given a free bottle of wine loved that.
fantastic stay!  great location, stocked kitchen, clear easy process, exactly as advertised.
The place was lovely and quiet peaceful the bed was also very comfortable

The house was in the perfect location and made it easy to get everywhere we wanted to go. It was comfortable, and exactly as described. We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this home to anyone looking for a convenient and enjoyable place to stay. Thank you for being a great host!
Very Good Host, Robert. Clean and Neat. Highly recommendable
Nice and cozy comfortable space. Great location for a stay in Chicago.  I will be back.
Great stay for a large group just outside the city!
We had a great stay at Jake’s place. He was also very accommodating when we requested a late checkout.
We enjoyed the space and slept great! Our host was helpful and accommodating. We would stay again 😀
I booked Kevin's home for my bachelorette in Chicago, and it was a great experience! Great location, easy access to get in/out of the building, and in a beautiful neighborhood. Definitely recommend!
Great location in the middle of Wicker Park. Nice spot with great communication with the hosts

I chose this air bnb because they allow pets. There are lots of places nearby to walk our dog. We also like the little grocery store on the ground floor of the building. The apartment has a comfortable bed, the unit was clean and we very much enjoyed our stay. We will definitely be back.

This adorable little space is exactly as advertised. We had a wonderful stay! We were in town for national dance competition and it was perfect for what we needed. Walking distance to a subway stop - Walgreens, Aldi also within walking distance. Neighborhood is unbelievably quiet. And Kristina is a fantastic host - I wish she hosted every AirBnb we have ever stayed at. She answered my questions quickly, gave fantastic recommendations - was patient with me as I booked the place very last minute - I'm so glad it was open and available. You will not regret staying here!
Excellent stay. TY for making us feel at home. Location was perfect. Highly recommend. Definitely be back. TY again!
LIVN was a very nice stay in downtown Chicago! Walkable and easy to find, and management was helpful with good communication on how to check in and check out. Would stay here again!

This is a perfect location if you want to be in Chicago but also be tucked into a nice neighborhood with lots to do and look at. The pizza shop located below you is really great pizza and highly recommend checking out the shops on Lincoln Square.
Julian was a wonderful host and was very attentive the entire time. The place was very clean and cozy. I will say the train is a little noisy but we soon got used to it.
We had a great time, would definitely come back again.
We had a great stay! The house was great for our group and in a fantastic location!

Our stay was absolutely fantastic from start to finish! The home was exactly as described—spotlessly clean, beautifully maintained, and equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Check-in was seamless, and the host was incredibly responsive, friendly, and accommodating throughout our visit.
The location was perfect, making it easy to explore the area while still enjoying a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. Every detail showed how much care the host puts into creating a great experience for guests.
I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and stress-free place to stay. I wouldn’t hesitate to book again the next time I’m in the area. Thank you for such an amazing experience!

The place was clean and functional, with everything I needed for my stay. Although it's a bit outside the city center, the neighborhood didn't feel unsafe. That said, I preferred using Uber in the evenings. It's also very close to the metro station, which made getting around easy and convenient.
One thing to keep in mind is that if you want fresh towels during your stay, there is an additional charge. However, the host was kind, responsive, and very helpful throughout my stay.

wonderful stay! she had everything we could need to settle down after a day of being out! extra towels, water purifier, a fan, streaming services, full body mirror, and so on! it was super clean and just enough space for a group of 5! would love to stay again in the future if available
I really enjoyed my stay at Bai’s house. Check in was easy, communication was great & the home was clean and ready! I will be back for sure.
Very clean space! We had plenty of room for 6 people
This home was a perfect spot for our long weekend in Chicago! Public transportation was close by as were some great restaurants and coffee shops.

Great neighborhood, clean and comfortable apartment.
Just to note that it is an old building and the interior is definitely not renovated. It has the look of a bygone era.
That said, everything worked as it should have and we had what we needed. The air conditioner was clutch, especially on the hot muggy days, it kept us quite comfortable.
Everything was as described. Clean and in a great location!
Great stay for family in town. No complaints. Would stay here again.
It was a great stay and would definitely stay again!
Immaculate and modern! Great location!

My husband and I came to Chicago with my 82 year old parents for a family wedding. My parents were very apprehensive because they have only stayed in hotels and they were thrilled with this unit! Super clean, comfortable, easy to get to, and Maximo was very easy to get in touch with. We didn’t know about the handicapped street parking and he responded quickly about that. He even messaged me at 10 pm to let me know that he had left a Britta water filter by the front door with a new filter in it! I opened the door, and there it was! My daughter lives a couple of blocks away, but I will definitely remember this location when needed a place to stay when we aren’t able to stay with her.
Brendan was a great host!

From the beginning we new the place would be small but we love that neighborhood and we really just needed a place to sleep. The lock box direction worked but the door direction were wrong. This was answered immediately. The appartment was semi clean but not what I would call clean. Grime on the stove and dust on every ledge and blinds. screens were missing on windows and room air-conditioner was not ON so it was HOT. The couch needs replaced. its hard small and sounds like its gonna break when u sit down. not a relaxing place to sit after miles of walking. shower head was so full of scum water barely came out, until it fell off while I was showering.  I think the most off putting thing was the rules say you have to clean at the end. Out of all the airbnb's I have stayed you neverhad to strip your own bed or clean the stove. Which clearly wasn't done. Last after all that and no complaints from us we were accused of taking the shower head apart on purpose. Not a friendly way to end trip
Awesome

We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely stay here again! The location was perfect, close to everything without being in the middle of the chaos. Our host was exceptional.
Parking is a little tricky, but that’s just Chicago. The trains run right outside the windows, but we’re heavy sleepers, so they didn’t bother us at all.
Our only minor issues were that the upstairs neighbor sounded a little heavy-footed, and the bedroom light and fan would randomly turn themselves on (never together). It definitely freaked us out the first time! 😂 The only inconvenience was having to get back out of our cozy bed to turn them off since the remote stays on the wall.
We’ve stayed in condos and even the Trump Tower, and we’d choose this Airbnb again in a heartbeat. Highly recommend!
Felt like home! Amazing stay and was very helpful!

Overall a good stay at Ann’s place! Great location and a perfect amount of space in the city for a large group. I will say the bed situation was tighter than expected (one of the sofa beds was basically a chair) but we were able to make it work. Ann was very responsive and rooftop space was awesome!
Very responsive and great communication from the host!

They were upfront that their Airbnb was above a business that might be playing loud music, which did happen the first morning we stayed there. I would say it was early morning hour noise (maybe 6am) but not totally terrible. We did room next to a loud neighbor who was pretty rude but Nala and Owen were responsive and dealt with our issue so it didn’t occur again. I really felt our hosts were great. For our trip purposes we probably should have booked a more central location, so we had to use Lyft quite a bit to get downtown for wedding events we were invited to and that was a bit of a drive.

We really enjoyed our time in Grace’s place. She was quick to reply and was very accommodating for our check in/out times, which we very much appreciated. The area is amazing and we were able to walk to so many great spots. Thank you, Grace!

Mimi and Paul’s place was a great stay for 2 people, we stayed a week and walked all over the West Loop, CTA stations very close and the neighborhood is clean, friendly and quiet.  Would and have recommended this location to friends.
Next level AirBnB, super supportive host that actively reaching out. Great little community to stay, definitely worth it!
I wanted to believe past reviews mentioning it being dirty wouldn't indicate anything for me, but was disappointed. I'd planned on using the tub for a bath and decided not to because of bugs.

Really enjoyed our stay here! The hosts were incredibly timely in their responses, super helpful and detailed in their descriptions of how to get to the house and into it. The only downside was the area however I wouldn’t count that against this place if you are staying with a large group just something to consider.

It was a very nice stay and was close to a lot of thing. The only bad things I have to say it that I feel like you should let people know that there is a garage below it because after I entered the first code I got a bit confused but the guest house was above & the couch was a bit old and could use new cushions but overall it was a good stay and it was a peaceful neighborhood and there was free street parking I would definitely stay there again.

Good place. Works as a place to sleep and store your things. There’s a washer and dryer as well for any laundry you might need done and 1 bathroom with no shower and 1 bathroom with a full shower. Not too far from the popular places of chinatown but quietly tucked away. Does feel a little sketchy at night but just keep your head on a swivel

The four of us stayed for over a week and found it perfectly placed for a group who wanted to take public transportation, a block away from the L. Each room had an artistic point of view, which we really enjoyed! It did feel like sleeping in an intimate gallery, while also being clean and comfortable. A great local coffee place around the corner (Big Shoulders) that we could walk to every morning, and Gagnam Market a few blocks away for a unique food court experience. Master bathroom's steam bath was fun! It felt very safe and comfortable. We'd stay again.
Derek was flexible likes to talk sports friendly guy. Ask him about the Bears
It was a good airbnb. As described

Wendy's place was the perfect Airbnb experience. It was everything that I needed and more. Also, quiet as it was slightly away from the busy-ness of Lincoln Square, but close by to everything as well. I would 100% stay with her again :)
Very clean, comfortable beds, and easy check in and check out. I especially enjoyed the little side porch!

We had a wonderful stay here, visiting friends in the neighborhood. The check in video made it easy to check into the place, and it matched the photos so well. It's a huge 1 bedroom apartment, with tons of natural light. Definitely will stay again.

MD is a great host. Super responsive, kind, and helpful. His schedule is sort of opposite from a normal person so you will likely rarely see him. I didn’t until I was on my way out the last day!
The place is perfect for if you just need a comfortable and reliable place to sleep. Has everything you need 100%. You are so close to the water and the neighborhood is great. I would definitely book this again for a cheap Chicago stay while I go sightseeing.

We loved the space, number of rooms and layout for our kids were perfect! We really enjoyed the cookies and water in the fridge and the kids loved the huge upstairs room! They also let us check-in super early which was really kind and communication was great. The unit was also clean and looked like the photos.
We ended up putting away a significant amount of glass decor. Also the dishwasher didn't work because a switch was flipped and there was no coffee (only instant) which made the first morning a struggle. Also the direct neighbors played music incredibly loud from 6-11pm which woke up our kids and limited conversation during that time due to noise.
A few location notes: getting downtown takes 1-1.5 hrs (without a car) and includes: walking, multiple buses and multiple trains. I also didn't realize there is no washer/dryer in unit (laundry mats are nearby and about $6 per load).
Overall the unit is great and the owners were excellent to work with.

You cant beat the location  of Luis' place...near good food, good coffee, and easy groceries...all walkable. Everything was clean and neat...seemed like brand new floors and paint. Could have done with a closet and some hangers, but for the price and location, it was well worth it. Needed some help with the gate key at first but Luis responded immediately. Thanks for the great stay, Luis!
Victor is an amazing host, very responsive and place is worth for the price. I did not face any safety concern and room was clean, spacious and nice.
The stay was amazing , we loved the location & the place. Ryan was very helpful , friendly & proactive with making our stay so comfortable. Preciate you a lot my guy! Can’t wait to book again

Beautiful home, very quiet and relaxing space. The house was very clean, spacious and charming. Great place to stay with kids! Lots to do around the house and convenient location. Elizabeth was very responsive when we had questions! Highly recommend staying here!
Place was perfect!
Thanks for the communication. Easy access to highway and can find a places. Every thing needed to cook and open spaces
fue muy bien estar en ese apartment.
Was a great location and provided all we needed for a short two day stay. Thank you!

Place is clean, as described/pictured. Lots of free street parking options around. Very walkable to bars, cafes, restaurants, etc. Sits on a busy street but no issues for adults/toddler sleeping at night. Would stay again!

We stayed at Rasheed's place for my bachelorette weekend and had such an amazing time! There were 11 of us and the house was very spacious for all of us. The location was absolutely perfect and walkable to great restaurants, coffee shops, the waterfront, and so many other great spots! Rasheed was also super nice and very responsive! I would recommend Rasheed's place to anyone looking! We all had such a great time and I'd love to go back! Thank you, Rasheed!!

This apartment was a lovely slice of home, with A/C, two full bathrooms, and a washer/dryer we truly had everything we needed for a group of 5 staying in the Chicago heat. Matthew was incredibly accommodating and we were able to get early check in. He also made sure we had everything we needed! Would definitely recommend this cute apartment
Simple & cozy. Good for a few nights after spending the day out enjoying the city.

The place was more spacious than expected. The beds were comfy. It was a perfect home base for my bach party. Super clean. We had an issue with the keys, but Natalie responded within 10 minutes and was at our door to help with an immediate solution. Great location for partying in Wicker Park and parking was not too hard to find nearby. Thanks, Natalie!

The place was nice and clean but there was a workout class at 7am on Saturday with extremely loud music and you could hear throughout the unit.
They need to invest in blackouts, you could see the light from the outside all through the room.
Parking was a 5 minute walk, not in the unit.

We had the best girls trip to Chicago staying here- it was a large house with multiple sitting areas,  a fabulous kitchen, and great bedrooms. The location was great, and made for a great base camp to check out the city. Would recommend!

We had a group of 6 adults and the space provided everything we needed. The neighborhood is very walkable with access to cafes, restaurants, shops, bars. Being very close to the CTA Brown Line was a huge plus. I'd definitely recommend this space for anyone looking to stay in and explore Chicago.
Great neighbor, quiet! Bnb was very clean and easy to get into and find. Would definitely stay here again the next time I'm in Chicago!
We had one little problem and LaWanda got it solved right away. The six of us and our three cars had no problems with space. I'd happily stay here again.
The house was amazing and secure. I felt safe staying here. I loved the outside area, the multiple bathrooms, and the atmosphere.
Very close to public transportation stops and stations. Coffee shops nearby.
Great stay. Location is perfect for concerts at Thalia Hall and close to train station. Apartment was clean and quiet.
Beautiful house with lots of space! Had everything we needed for the weekend! Brandy was extremely responsive and was even able to have some items delivered that we needed!

This location was in an amazing neighborhood with a ton of great restaurants, bars, and things to do. All communication with Jhon ahead of and during the trip was easy and the space matched the pictures. If I needed to stay in Lincoln Square again I would definitely stay here!
I’m not sure why the 3rd bedroom was locked but we didn’t need it. Although we were not able to use it, the kitchen was well stocked, and the stove looked amazing.
Although, I had to cut my trip short.. the host was so responsive and so understanding. Thank you for being a great host.
Beautifully decorated place. Cute backyard, well-stocked kitchen. Bedrooms as described. Elevated walking path just outside the door.
Nice clean place, as described in the listing. Self check in was easy and proactively communicated. Basic apartment with a nice view. Good location if you want easy access to the loop.

Although location was ideal and host was responsive, this property was extremely overpriced for what we got. King bed was very uncomfortable, furniture was poor and rickety. Invited family over for a drink and place didn’t even have a bottle opener or wine glasses. There were small black ants throughout apt. The 2 sets of keys had several unlabeled keys on each ring which made it frustrating and difficult to find correct key each time returning to apt. Dishwasher had a foul smell and couldn’t use. Living room rug didn’t seem vacuumed. Patio was in bad shape with the privacy screen ripped and falling down. Host needs to put some TLC into this property or lower the price by several hundred. Overall,  a bad experience.
We enjoyed our stay area was quiet house is a lot bigger than pictured ! Definitely would stay again . Host was very responsive and friendly
Fantastic location in Chicago! Clemente was a great host and provided clear directions and the place was everything we needed plus an amazing price for the location. Would absolutely stay again!
Nice comfortable place exactly as described. The host was responsive, flexible and friendly. Would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great place to stay with a large group.
Great location.

We stayed 4 nights for a long weekend & overall had a good experience. We booked last minute bc the location was perfect for our event. The Red Line metro is a short walk away & made getting to the city & airport very convenient.
The apartment is compact, as expected, but makes good use of the space. The small kitchen, in-unit washer/dryer & basic gym were all appreciated. The laundry room also doubled as a great place to store shoes & luggage, & the wall AC kept the apartment comfortably cool.
The apartment had the essentials, but not much beyond that. The kitchen could be better stocked—there were barely enough utensils for 2 people, no baking sheet, only a very small frying pan & a wok. A kitchen towel would also be helpful.
The shower pressure was excellent, but the half-open glass design let water spill onto the floor after every shower. With only 1 hand towel & 2 bath towels, extra towels would have been appreciated.
Overall, this was a clean, convenient place to stay.

This was the perfect place the location was walkable and we were able to get what it would feel like to live there . Tom was an amazing host and the place had alot of nice little extra touches. I would definitely stay here again.
Great experience and amazing city. Borja was extremely prompt with responses to my questions. Would stay here again.

The place was just as advertised. The room was perfect for us with our own bathroom. The patio on the room provided nice view of downtown Chicago and was a nice place to relax. It's in a great part of town - convenient to all sorts of restaurants and activities. But it is in a quiet and safe neighborhood. We really enjoyed our stay and had a blast in Chicago!
Let us check in early, very responsive to questions, and even left us a small welcome gift. Would definitely consider staying in her home again.
We had an amazing stay! No issues at all.
I love the house, the smell made you relax and at home look so clean from top to bottom love the modern look with ol
We had a great time! We will be back!

L'hébergement était très propre et proche du centre ville
Nous avons adorée notre séjour
Great location, excellent value.
This was a great stay at a beautiful house! Extremely spacious and private in a great neighborhood
Nice apartment, as described.  Good location.  Nice and clean. Easy check in and entry.  Shower with low pressure, but otherwise great!
Very amazing host!! Very responsive and friendly. Felt right at home! Place is pretty easy to get to and close to downtown. Loved our stay here.
Beautiful stay. Very responsive and helpful host. Would absolutely stay again.
Stephanie’s place was perfect for our weekend outing in the city. Can’t recommend her place enough!

Me hospedé en este apartamento para ir a un concierto en el Soldier Field Stadium. Hice el recorrido caminando y es muy seguro y fácil de llegar. El apartamento es muy espacioso y acogedor. Tiene todo lo que se necesita para sentirse como en casa.

Very quiet with friendly neighbors that made you feel safe. The inside of the apartment was comfortable with many upgrades and sleeps a large group easily. Host was very responsive and even left a very nice welcoming gift! Will stay again soon!
Rajeev's apartment near Lincoln Square is in a great location for enjoying the amenities of the Square, including easy access to the L.  The place was clean and well-accommodated.
Great place to stay- quiet neighborhood and close to lots of things.  Highly recommend!

Our stay at Shonte’s Airbnb was wonderful. It was clean, comfy, and spacious. And located in a quiet quaint neighborhood. Also, it was located near the California L train stop on the green line. The station was literally around the corner. Perfect location to head into downtown Chicago. I would highly recommend booking with Shonte. She was very responsive and was always there when I needed anything. The perfect host.
Exceptional stay - the sweetest space, great neighborhood, lovely garden, helpful host. The whole stay was seamless. So happy we chose it!
Loved my stay . Planning my return.
Perfect place for our family to stay while celebrating our daughter’s wedding! Highly recommend—the location was amazing and the space had everything you could possibly need.
Muy limpio, el anfitrión siempre respondía rápido, muy cómodo todo, y tranquilo. ¡Nos sentimos como en casa!.

This was my family's first time visiting Chicago, and I couldn't have asked for a better place to stay! The space was spotless, cozy, and thoughtfully equipped with modern amenities that made us feel right at home.
What truly set this Airbnb apart was the host's exceptional hospitality. She checked in with us regularly to make sure we had everything we needed and even shared a great recommendation for places to visit, which made our trip even more enjoyable.
One of the most memorable touches was the handwritten postcard welcoming my family and me. It was such a thoughtful, personal gesture that immediately made us feel valued as guests.
If you're looking for a clean, comfortable, and welcoming place with an amazing host, I highly recommend staying here. We would absolutely book again on our next trip to Chicago!
Good spot! Easy to get downtown, west loop and other areas! Clean & as advertised on the inside, parking was clutch. Not much street parking

Given the short time frame, Sandra really took care of me. Even when I had to add one person due to a domestic violence issue, Sandra was gracious.
I would definitely recommend her spot and I am looking forward to staying there again when I return to Chicago (if her spot is available of course)
Had a wonderful stay, very clean place. Great location
We really enjoyed our stay! Everything was as described. We love that we were able to walk to local restaurants. Communication with the host was easy and they were very responsive. Highly recommend!

Comfortable apartment with comfy bed and big main room. The snack basket and coffee pods were a nice touch. Easy check in and an accommodating host. Great location in a walkable neighborhood and near the Blue Line.

Sebastian’s place was very nice. We used the office room for our 5 month old for the stay and it was great.
One downside for us was that the place was absolutely bombed with cleaning supplies smell ( like industrial fabulouso )- so much it was causing us headaches and we had to air out the place when we first got there. The floors even had an extra residue of cleaner sticky to them. The smell was too intense but subsided after two days. Other than that it was great.
Majorie’s place was exactly as listed and the building was peaceful. There’s a great selection of restaurants in the surrounding area. I felt safe and right at home. I’ll definitely be booking again.
Love the Lincoln Park area.  Easy access to Clark St, Broadway, Halsted, and everything you need to see in Chicago!
Our group of 10 really enjoyed our stay! There were plenty of beds for us to spread out. The location was great, super walkable to so many restaurants and bars.
Really great stay.  We had everything we needed and very clean.  Location is great for walking to local stores and restaurants.  I would definitely stay here again.
Great location, service, amenities.

The space is in the Cambria hotel, so I am not sure where the issue lies, but our room would not cool down. The lowest temp we could achieve was 75, which I am not a fan of when sleeping.
When we arrived we noticed the window was cracked open, which now tells me someone else or the cleaning people were trying to stay cool. We closed it so we would not hear the traffic & sirens you hear all night in the city & the temps were creeping in to the 90s.
I did tell the front desk that they need an HVAC person to look in to this.
Other than that, a nice stay, strangely, on the 13th floor :-)
Fantastic location, great communication and wonderful stay, will definitely be back, highly recommend
We enjoyed our stay in this easy-to-access apartment; it was simple to visit many of the area museums and parks by walking or train. The rooms are quite roomy with a lot of natural light. Thank you!

This was perfect for our Chicago trip. Instructions were clear of how to get in and where to park. We found free street parking each night on Damen Ave, so we didn’t need to use spot hero. Everything went smoothly, so we didn’t need to contact Kathleen.
It’s in a great location and easily walkable to restaurants and activities in Wicker Park or West Town. It was a 15-20 min drive to all the downtown activities we wanted to do.
We only had two people, but I’d imagine staying here with 3-4 guests would feel tight. We didn’t use the second bedroom, but even as a young adult, I thought the second room bunk bed was difficult and uncomfortable to climb up the ladder and would really be best for a kid or teenager.
The apartment was clean and exactly as pictured. There wasn’t much natural light or windows, so it did feel dark inside. We used it as a base while we explored the city, so not a huge issue.
Overall, I’d highly recommend staying at Kathleen’s AirBnb for your Chicago trip!

We had an overall great stay at this location. I loved the included amenities, especially the thoughtfulness that went into what guests could potentially need during their stay. The only small drawback inside that slightly surprised us was the room off the kitchen. I think the people who stayed in that area didn’t feel like their space was private. We also had some words with a very rude neighbor, however, another neighbor assured us that we were fine, that person is generally upset & a “Karen”. So long as you can have a thick skin early in the morning when you venture outdoors, the stay was peaceful. I would still definitely book again.
Great, responsive host, place was clean and close to the ballpark.

Very friendly and responsive host. Very spacious unit and super easy to get into and out. Also had  security which made safety feel more important. Parking was very easy and only across the street at a decent price compared to other Chicago parking lots.

Great. It was not obviously from the listing that the apartment was a shared apartment. I just learned of it the day before I arrived when the host said the bathroom and living area was common space.
Super clean. Very nice. I did not feel comfortable using the dinning room, kitchen, living and I used the bathroom a little as possible since there were other guests in the apartment.
Wonderful stay! We loved the apartment and the location. Would definitely stay again in the future!

Tessa's place was beautiful and pristine, felt like being in your own apartment. Lots of space for five people and very comfortable. Great location too, not too far from the loop by train and close to a stop. Good restaurants around. And Tessa was very responsive and accomodated a late check out so we could get some rest. Would definitely stay again, highly recommend.

We had a large group and overall it was a great stay for everyone.  Richard was on point and responsive to any minor issue we had. The place looked like it did in its pictures. We didn't use the ceiling fans due to the accumulation of dust on them and didn't want to have that circulating in the home but outside of that minor thing, we loved staying there and if we come back to Chicago,  would definitely stay there again!
Wonderful stay. Host was amazing and super helpful. Highly recommend. Will definitely be back.

Excellent property with a very responsive host. The location of this place is amazing. It can easily handle larger groups. Bedrooms were great and there were plenty of places to hang out. Hymie was very accommodating for our group. Check in and check out were very easy, and we had no issues during our stay. Absolutely worth the price.

Weekend stay for a family baby shower. Host was very responsive to any questions we had. Street parking was always available. Traveling with an infant and hosts were very accommodating- providing pack n’ play, high chair, and infant bathtub.
We had a lovely stay here while visiting Chicago. Would recommend.

Basic accommodations for a place to sleep. Room was clean, carpet in room and hallway could use deep cleaning. Shared bathroom also could use updating but was always available when I used it. Didn't meet the host during my stay but she communicated actively.
Wonderful stay! Very clean and close to everything. Alma was a great host.
Absolutely fantastic place and location. Super friendly hosts with lots to do within walking distance. Great location in the city

Super responsive, we had some issues with the door code but they were fast to help us out. There is so much in the immediate area we could’ve just stayed within a few mile radius and had fun. Also it’s about a 3 minute walk from the train station which was so handy.
Me and my family loved our stay. Very clean house, the area is very safe and a lot to do close by. Definitely recommend this place.
Best Airbnb I've ever stayed at in my life and I've been using Airbnb for 7 years. The ideal Airbnb actually.
It was great!
Great host, very responsive! Highly recommend

Location was great (why we chose it as it was 0.25 mi from our son who we were visiting), but mattresses & pillows were awful, floors need sweeping & mopping, bugs in the kitchen, lightbulbs out in the living space, sofa is a black hole when you sit in it, shower drains very slowly, vent in bathroom broken, tiles in bathroom floor are loose, furniture is dirty.  Place is ideal for a large group of young adults that don’t mind dirt or care where they stay (closet has several air mattresses too)!
Worked out well to drive in to Chicago and stay here. Place was clean and bed was comfortable.  Location was good for our needs.

We had a great stay! The host was incredibly helpful, attentive, and always quick to respond to any questions we had. When we needed an extra air mattress, they had one couriered to us right away, which we really appreciated. Their prompt communication and willingness to help made our stay smooth and stress-free. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to others!

A beautiful, spacious, clean home. Jonathon was a great host and always responded quickly.  The home was about 30 minutes away from everything we wanted to do (chicago traffic added a bit more to it). The home had plenty of linens, towels, etc. Great for a family trip!
Solid basic accommodation that was very well located for spending time in Pilsen. The code didn't work for check-in, but Frank was able to help quickly when we called him.
This was our first trip to Chicago, and we had no idea where to stay. David’s place met all our needs. We are totally satisfied.  Would consider staying here again.
Would definitely stay here again, noise level is not loud at all from the bar downstairs.

Abia was awesome! The most responsive host I’ve had on Airbnb in a while! Very kind and made check in and check out easy! With that being said there were ants everywhere on our first night. And some roaches in the downstairs bedroom as well. As well as gnats in the upstairs bedrooms. Abia said she was scheduling pest control to come out before the next guests arrived so hopefully it’s not an issue for anyone else. Other than that the house was exactly as pictured! And again abia was an amazing host!

My friends and I loved our stay!! The space was beautiful and just as pictured and very clean! Amenities were top notch. Smart TVs in the living room and bedroom. Game area by the kitchen. Our group had so much fun! Check in and check out was a breeze. The neighborhood was very typical for Chicago and is great for tourists looking for an authentic, local experience. I would definitely book this space again!! 😍
Great stay in a great location!! Super friendly host and very clean apartment. Very good restaurants/bars in the area. Would definitely book again!

We had a wonderful experience at this home. Home very spacious and close to major roads and highways while being on a quiet street. Very clean. Host very responsive to all my questions and concerns. Car garage gave us added peace of mind. Will definitely stay in this home if I visit Chicago again.

Emily and Roya's apartment was perfect for our Chicago stay. It's located on a quiet, peaceful, tree-lined street. If you need something, they are responsive. The apartment is very clean, the kitchen has modern appliances, and is well equipped. We'd love to stay here again when we visit family nearby.
We had a great stay at a great location in the West Loop! Thomas was very responsive and helped make the stay easy and enjoyable.

Luis was a lifesaver after having a terrible experience in a hostel. Admittedly, the place was a bit far from downtown Chicago but public transit was pretty easy to use to head that way. Forever grateful for the hospitality Luis showed and will be recommending his place to others.

Paul’s place was exactly as described. Check in at the Cambria was easy and held our bags at check-out until we needed to get to our train. Walking distance to Michigan Ave, multiple restaurants, parks, etc. Made for a great weekend stay.
Great location right in Old Town.

Host was nice but this apartment was inaccurately advertised as 3 beds when in reality it was a 200-250 sq ft tiny studio old studio. There was no dishwasher or central AC. The bedroom was a closet/storage turned into bedroom with a cheap mattress and metal frame. The bathroom was too small for even one person. I paid 650 bucks for two nights and that was a very bad deal. The bedding was old.
I would say the place was unsafe too as I had my bags stolen from right outside, not the host’s fault but still tells you about the place.
I would not recommend staying there unless you have too. The host needs to correctly advertise and fix a lot of things. It is basically a 100 years old small apartment with cheap fixes all over.
Will stay again.   Host was very clear on how to get in.   Place was clean and as expected.  Having a parking space was such a bonus after driving in heavy traffic.   Highly recommend.
Great place to relax and unwind, love the style, had all amenities that I needed. Cozy and very private.

The listing on airbnb said we were renting a whole house but there were other people there during our stay. The listing also said no pets but there was a dog upstairs that we could see and hear during our stay. The airbnb itself was okay, but the listing for the place was inaccurate and not something i would rent out again.

Oyindamola was a great host and communicator. We really enjoyed staying at her place, everything was very convenient in the apartment and it was located in a nice, peaceful neighborhood. We would definitely recommend having Oyindamola as a host in the future!
Great place, perfect for what we needed. Communication was great and the space was tidy and clean!

A bit off putting at first because it’s a basement where the set up is, and also the parking was not the greatest but I will say that I had an amazing time with my family. Once you go in through the gates you forget all about anything, you have a pin set up to go in and cameras so you feel very safe. Then you walk in and the place is beautiful, clean, very homey feeling to it and we really enjoyed our stay. Literally everything is so close by, no matter what direction you go in, this property is in the center of it all which makes driving amazing.
Absolutely stunning house! Cannot recommend this place enough. It was such a peaceful retreat to come home to while we celebrated our friends’ wedding. Would happily book again!
Great house. So great to have all the bedrooms and bathrooms and such a nice, comfortable living room. Worked so well for our family gathering.

We had a great time staying at this location. We were in town for a family wedding; it accommodated 4 adults and a baby. The location was a great side street to take our time loading a car seat into an uber or just taking a walk down Clark st to restaurants, grocery stores, coffee shops, etc. We could occasionally hear a siren or a car honking but otherwise quiet and peaceful.
Everything we could have asked for and more for our group of 9. Would absolutely stay here again!

Daniel was a great host even while out of town. The studio is very spacious and the full kitchen was great! The place has all the essentials you would need and the bed was very comfortable. Whole Foods, coffee shop and delicious restaurants all within walking distance. It has street parking and it's busy, but I was always able to find a spot not too far away!

There was NO smell of mold, mildew, animals, dust, or smoking. It smelled better than some hotel rooms I have stayed in. The bathroom sink had plenty of room for all my toiletries (unlike most hotel rooms). It is in a beautiful, quiet, neighborhood that is very walkable. It's about 1 mile away from the brown line station that takes you into downtown Chicago (aka the Loop). It's an easy walk -- it's flat -- no hills. And even for someone like me who is not used to public transit, the brown line is very simple to figure out. I would definitely stay here again!

Mark and Marcelo’s home is absolutely lovely! It’s located in a beautiful neighborhood with walking distance to a local restaurant for brunch.  From initial booking to the last day, Mark and Marcelo were easy to communicate with and provided clear instructions on check in/check out.  I highly recommend their home if you are coming to Chicago!

A great apartment for the price. The most obvious con is that the building is right on the Brown Line, so you will hear the trains coming all day and all night. This actually didn't bother us as much as we expected and we slept fine, but it could deter a lighter sleeper.
Aside from that, everything was great. Obviously great proximity to a Brown Line stop, a lovely historic neighborhood with a playground across the street and plenty of cafes and restaurants in walking distance in either direction - towards Lincoln Square or towards Kedzie.
We stayed during a colder week, so we didn't need a/c and couldn't say how effective the window units were. The kitchen is well-stocked with supplies and the bathroom has the basics. Street parking within a block of the apartment was very easy at any hour.
The place was clean and great for the price. I spent my time out in the city then came back to sleep, so it was perfect.
Only needed a few days stay but it was the perfect spot to relax and regroup for the whole trip. Thanks again!
The location was great. Instructions and response were great. We would definitely stay here again!
Pat was a great host, even giving me recommendations for restaurants and places to visit during my stay. I would absolutely visit again.

Great stay Jose! Thank you very much. Clean, well appointed and exactly what I needed. Right on public trans CTA lines if you have no vehicle. Kitchen, refrigerator had plenty of room and common spaces very clean and well appointed. Room was very clean and had plenty of towels. Bathrooms were very clean as well. It was so quiet I didn't know anyone else was there. Yes, i would stay at one of Jose's places again. Thank you.

Tuvimos una excelente estancia durante nuestro fin de semana en familia. El alojamiento estaba muy limpio, cómodo y tal como se mostraba en las fotos. La ubicación fue muy conveniente y el anfitrión siempre fue amable y respondió rápidamente a nuestras dudas. Sin duda lo recomendamos y volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí. ¡Muchas gracias!

This place was perfect for a stay in Chicago. We stayed here for a weekend with two families (10 total) with 4 little ones. The place was clean and had a lot of space for all of us. The location was close to great restaurants and walking distance to city activities. We would definitely stay here again in the future.
Exactly as pictured, perfect amount of space and comfortable beds! Very close to downtown, was able to park and uber everywhere.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and very well maintained. One of the things we appreciated most was the neighborhood. It felt very safe, and it was nice to see so many people out walking their dogs, families pushing strollers, and neighbors enjoying the area. It created a welcoming, peaceful atmosphere. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.

I'll start with the pros:
1. The host was very responsive and communicative.
2. The bed in the master is comfy.
3. The unit was clean and smelled nice.
The cons:
1. You could tell the unit was in need of major comestic repair (e.g., you could see the wall and frame around back door was recently fixed but it was not painted, the shower head was not properly attached to the shower wall/tile.
2. The unit was not up to code. There was plastic trash bags inserted around the perimeter of the electrical panel in utility room where the washing machine and gas water heater is. Putting plastic next to electrical wires will cause a fire and 2 out of the 3 smoke detectors (located in the utility room and kitchen were missing or not installed.
3. The walls are thin. Although no fault of the host, a brand new home is being built next door. From 9-5am all day all you hear is banging. And you can hear the red line train and motorcycles from across the Dan Ryan.
I would not recommend

Our stay in River North was excellent. TAIMS management group were very responsive and were very accommodating to our inquiries and requests. The apartment itself is very clean and very modern with complete amenities. The high ceilings and the modern furniture made the home comfortable and luxurious. My favorite part about this stay is the location. We were walking distance from Mag Mile and so many restaurants and bars close by. It was a residential apartment building, so we needed to be mindful of noise after 10pm and are not allowed to have parties, which was fine since we went out most nights.
The place was nice, clean, comfortable and looked just like the pictures!

Mi estancia en el alojamiento de Iris fue una experiencia maravillosa. El lugar es realmente hermoso, acogedor y está lleno de detalles que hacen que uno se sienta cómodo desde el primer momento. La ubicación es excelente, en una zona muy agradable de Chicago, perfecta para disfrutar de la ciudad y sentirse tranquilo al regresar después de un día de paseo.El espacio está muy bien cuidado, limpio y transmite una sensación de hogar que pocas veces se encuentra en un alojamiento. Pero sin duda, una de las mejores partes de la experiencia fue Iris como anfitriona: una persona amable, atenta y hospitalaria que hizo que mi estancia fuera aún más especial.Definitivamente me sentí como en casa. Si regreso a Chicago, no dudaría en volver a hospedarme en este hermoso lugar y disfrutar nuevamente de su excelente ubicación y la cálida bienvenida de Iris. ¡Muchas gracias por todo!
We enjoyed our stay. It was relatively close to public transportation. We enjoyed having our own space.
I don’t have words to say how much I love the house. It’s just perfect for us. Cyan was very  kind and helpful in everything we need . Definitely we are coming back to the same place 😊

Beds were so wonderful, even the pull out couch.  Loved all the coffee and add ins provided.  Definitely the best ever on that.  Half bath sink very small, used kitchen sink for face washing and teeth brushing.  Would definitely stay there again for the comfort and quietness in a busy loud city.
Places was very comfortable, clean, walkable distance to public transportation.
perfect little apartment in a great location. I was very happy with my stay.

A wonderful place that was easily walkable to Chinatown and to catch the train into the heart of Chicago! Super quiet when we needed it after a long day of exploring and doing day trips! It was also great to find we were right next to Ricobene’s for the amazing breaded steak sandwiches.
Excellent host.. very clear on details. Place was spotless and just as described. Looking forward to my next visit
The apartment was spic and span and well located. My family enjoyed our stay.
Was a perfect place to stay for a downtown girls weekend!
Está muy bien el departamento, la zona no es la más segura pero eso no depende de ustedes, me volvería a hospedar con ustedes!
Very much enjoyed my stay in a cool area. Hosts were very responsive.
Great stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. We'd definitely stay here again.
Donna’s place was great. Very clean upon arrival and everything was as shown on the listing. We would stay here again!
We had a great stay! Plenty of room for three couples. The home was clean and we appreciated that the checking out list of to-do’s was very short. Would definitely stay here again.

I had to make a last minute trip to Chicago, and chose this room based purely on the vibes. And the vibes were IMMACULATE. The space is so cute and cozy, and feels very homey. The instructions provided were amazingly detailed. Roberto answered pretty much every question I could have come up with, before I even asked it! The room I stayed in was the perfect size for me as a single occupant. But it would also work really well for a couple! The house is literally a 2 minute walk from the nearest bus stop, and I was able to commute daily to Wicker Park easily.
The entire apartment is clearly taken care of very well. I never had to guess about anything, because the hosts had everything labeled and explained so thoroughly. They were there to greet me, and they were so welcoming and lovely, and made sure I had everything I needed.
Will absolutely stay here again!
Great location, easy access, and perfect for our large group with the air mattress accommodations
Place was just as pictured and it’s very spacious !! Hosts were wonderful and very communicative
Awesome garden apt in beautiful Chicago neighborhood. Accessible to the expressway, the CTA blue line, and also walkable neighborhoods. Would def recommend!

Perfect. Just perfect. My husband and I came to town to visit our daughter and Sarah’s place was a great location.
Very clean, well appointed and easy to get everywhere. Cute art in the apartment too!
We will definitely be back.
Thank you Sarah and Joe!
Great stay.  Perfect for what we needed, clean, cozy, easy to get around.  Host was great- highly recommend
Great stay! The place was very clean, and check-in and check-out were easy. I would definitely consider staying here again.
Everything was great about the house and communication was very easy

We had a great stay overall! The home was clean, comfortable, and worked well for our group of six.
The host was very responsive, parking right next to the building was incredibly convenient, and the checkout instructions were simple and easy to follow.
The downstairs queen bed was especially comfortable. One thing to note for future guests is that one of the bedrooms has a trundle with two twin beds rather than a standard bed, so plan sleeping arrangements accordingly.
We also found that long charging cables or extension cords were helpful since outlets weren’t always close to the beds, and some of the comforters were a bit rough for our preference.
Our only suggestion would be to provide a few more face towels because we had one for every three guests, so we ended up washing them twice during our stay.
Overall, these were very minor issues, and we’d happily stay here again.

Half the price of hotels the weekend I stayed — walkable to Roscoe and lots of bars and restaurants. Street parking was free and this area felt very safe and surprisingly quiet. Really happy that I stayed here to visit family! The bnb was very clean
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It was a beautiful home and close to public transportation to get around the city!

Fun part of town if you’re looking for less touristy vibes. Walkable to many shops, bars and restaurants and the blue line. Gotta check out Alice’s for late-night karaoke! Shovany was very responsive and check-in in was easy. Spacious alley parking spot as well.

Sam’s place was everything he said it was and more! Excellent location for food, retail therapy and activities. Perfect space to stretch out and be comfortable with all the necessary amenities for our family!  Will return! Thank you Sam!

Our stay was wonderful. The apartment was clean , comfortable and in a great location . Public transit is just around the corner making this the perfect spot to explore Chicago !! The neighborhood is peaceful and walkable as well .
Great place to stay.  Close to walking to stores and restaurants.   Clean.  Comfortable beds.   Nice size bathrooms.  Nice and open area.

I loved this stay! The apartment is spacious and welcoming. The host (and his 2 cats) is so kind and generous. I felt comfortable when he was both in and out of the apartment.
I really liked the room and it is well equipped with closet space, a large mirror, and lots of fans in case you get warm.
It is, however on the third floor with narrow steps, so I would consider that in case you don’t pack lightly.
It was my first time staying in a room with AirBnb, and I’m so glad it was here.
Was great! easy to find, the place was very cute and the shower was nice.
Perfect place for a weekend getaway!

The place is amazing. Better than the photos. The art work was really impressive. Like it was professionally curated. The hosts were very helpful. The was an overall wonderful place to stay. I would happily stay again.

Tory not only had a wonderful and clean place, but was also an amazing host! She generously allowed us to use her kitchen and the appliances in it, gave amazing food recommendations, and was incredibly hospitable! She also has cute pets (a very friendly cat and dog), which was a plus!!
Great location.  Nice pub nearby.  Host super responsive.

This is a great place in the middle of the city and we had 9 people stay here very comfortably. The kitchen/ living room area is also plenty big enough to host a get together. I would definitely book this place again.
Todo muy bonito , cómodo. Sin dudas volvería otra vez!
Great place to stay! We all loved it!
Great location. Had a very nice stay. Assel very responsive.

Olesya’s place was great! The back deck was especially nice. I spent a few hours out there getting lost in a new book and often forgot I was even in the middle of the city. It was surprisingly quiet and peaceful. The location was super walkable to great restaurants and lots of things to do. Check in and out were very easy, too. Excellent place; would stay again!

Our stay was okay overall, but there were a couple of frustrating issues. The biggest problem was that the bathtub wouldn't drain while showering, and the bath mat was already soaking wet when we arrived. Jevaux said he'd come take a look the next day and let us know he had, but the tub still wasn't draining afterward.
On the second day, our building entry code also stopped working. Thankfully, someone was leaving the building and let us in. I messaged Jevaux, and he responded quickly with a new code, which I appreciated.
Jevaux was responsive, but it was disappointing that the drainage issue wasn't resolved during our stay.
Great place. If you stay there, go up to the 47th floor for the views and sit outside, especially at night. Shay was very helpful, meeting us to show us where parking was. Fun time!
Great place to stay and close to downtown. Would stay here again for sure.
Excellent location and a great host.
Perfect stay for my needs. Short walk to the train, very clean, comfortable bed, everything you need.
Good location close to the blue line, clean place. Overall good stay, no complaints
Great stay!

Making a visit back in the city with our little ones and this Airbnb couldn't have been more perfect! The hosts were incredibly accommodating to our young family and made us feel right at home. They paid attention to every detail, were quick and helpful with communication, and made the entire experience seamless. The neighborhood felt safe and was within walking distance of great stores and restaurants, which made traveling with little ones so much easier. We’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it!
Very convenient, easy, and hassle free! Everything worked the way it should. Host was very hospitable.

Definitely will come back again. Very clean and spacious. The only downfall there was only one TV in this big house. But we didn’t come to town to stay inside. House is close to the highway so trip to the Obama Presidential Center was only 14 minutes away.
We were a little nervous about the neighborhood but we had zero issues. Very quiet part of the city.

The Airbnb is a great place for a quick visit and it is located in a safe neighborhood. Close to the train and there are tons of restaurants close by. The Airbnb was clean and the room had everything I needed.

I had a wonderful stay! The home was beautiful, clean, and exactly what I was looking for. It was in the perfect location—close enough to enjoy the city while still having a peaceful suburban feel. Everything was very walkable, there was a beautiful park nearby, and the host provided excellent local food recommendations.
I truly felt at home here. I especially admired the layout of the house—the kitchen was by far my favorite space, and I absolutely loved spending time in the backyard. The Chicago Red Line photography throughout the home added such a unique touch, and the plethora of games kept both me and my guests entertained throughout our stay.
The host was professional, welcoming, and always prompt with responses, which made the entire experience even better.
I hope I’ll have the opportunity to stay again—if only for the peace and quiet. I would absolutely recommend this stay to anyone looking for a relaxing home away from home.
Loved the location of this airbnb! Walkable distance to coffee shops and restaurants. Only around 15 minutes from downtown! Sean was amazing and super accommodating. Highly recommend this stay! (:
Me and my boyfriend came to Chicago and Eric’s place made are stay made the trip even more better.
Everything was easy smooth well explained. The house was clean and the location was very easy to access with some restaurant near by
It was a beautiful Airbnb with a great view! There were a couple of hiccups but Milan was very responsive and quick with fixing anything that needed to be done. Highly recommend to stay with Milan!
Bryan’s place was really cool. It was close to down town and we had a great time!

Myself and friends stayed at Jake's place for the weekend and it was fantastic. Very spacious and clean. Mostly comfortable beds. Great location in Chinatown. I absolutely recommend staying here if visiting Chicago!
Great location, and amazing to have a parking spot!
Lilly’s communication skills were overwhelmingly professional. She was very warm, friendly and engaging. In addition, she went out of her way to make sure our stay was an exceptional experience.

Awesome location (close to train and middle of a nice street). Paul was great, very responsive with extremely clear instructions. Clean unit with well stocked toiletries and coffee station (Keurig).
2 things to note: it is a garden unit, but still gets good lightning. Also the mattress is on the soft side.
Note there was some required cleaning (wash and put away dishes, strip the bed). But at least no cleaning fee.
Overall, a great place to stay for our short trip and an excellent value. Check-in was clearly explained, which I really appreciated after a long day of travel.”
Great location convenient to the train and lots of restaurants! Cute, clean and perfect for our group of 5
Beautiful home and a very nice stay! Absolutely loved it! The hosts were very friendly and helpful. The house was just as described and extremely clean. I would recommend!

We had an excellent stay! The home was exactly as described, very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. It was the perfect place for our group during our trip to Chicago.
The location was a huge plus. We felt safe throughout our stay, parking was easy, and it was only a short drive to the conference we were attending. There were also plenty of nearby restaurants, grocery stores, and conveniences, which made everything even more enjoyable.
The host was responsive, professional, and provided clear check-in instructions. We especially appreciated how smooth the entire process was from booking to check-out.
The home had everything we needed, including comfortable beds, a well-equipped kitchen, reliable Wi-Fi, and plenty of space for everyone to relax after long days. It truly felt like a home away from home.
I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this property to anyone visiting the Chicago area, whether for business, a conference, or a family getaway. Thank

This apartment is in an excellent location that made the stay in Chicago 10X better! We loved being able to park our car and know that it was in a safe and secure location. The apartment had not yet been cleaned when we checked in, but this was quickly taken care of once we contacted Harry. Overall I would highly recommend staying here. Definitely visit the staff at Wrigleyville Dogs in the shared parking lot as they were so fun as well!
It was a fine.

We stayed here for a girls trip and absolutely LOVED Julio’s place. Very cute and homey feeling apartment, in a nice and walkable area. It was our first time exploring Pilsen and 18th street is awesome and a 5 minute walk from the Airbnb! We would recommend their place over and over again and would 100% stay again!

Super pleased with this apartment. Great location. We would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to friends. We had one issue with during the stay, but the owners remediated it promptly. I was very appreciative. Great place overall. Great rooftop deck, too.

We spent a couple of nights at Karl’s place while visiting the city. The apartment is spacious and had everything we needed. The decoration is very nice and we loved the whole library selection.
The neighborhood felt safe and calm and it had good food and shopping options near by.
Thanks Karl

Overall, our stay was great! The home did have a bit of an odor (not sure if it’s because it’s an older building or not) that made it a little less enjoyable, but still tolerable. The hosts were super attentive, quick to respond, and very helpful. I will say the water pressure wasn’t the best and we could’ve used a few more towels but those are minor things. The home was nice, the neighbors were super friendly, and check-in/check-out was very easy. Definitely recommend!
Amazing studio apartment that was clean and a great location. Super easy check in process and amazing experience overall!

I had an amazing stay for my rotation in the Loretto Hospital. Walkable, easy to access, friendly tenants, amazing host. Helen is truly a gem. And she keeps a beautiful cozy house. She was proactive and helpful and actively invested in keeping the house clean, tidy, and stocked with all the necessities. Laundry on site is a big plus. Kitchen was always clean. Bathroom too. Close to the Green Line and buses. Highly recommended!
Loved Everything about the place and how clean it was
The stay was as great as expected, Jason answered in a timely manner.

Very quaint home. Just enough space for the 4 person max.
I appreciated the amount of blankets and the open and close communication.
When I return, this will be my first option as far as housing goes, especially because of the quiet neighborhood :)

Michael was incredibly responsive and made the stay really helpful. It was clear the home had been prepared thoughtfully - there were more than enough linens, towels, and anything we could need for small meals in the kitchen. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!
Great place to stay in a great location! Chris was always quick to respond to my questions during our stay. Would stay here again!
Perfect room to crash in for a couple nights. Thanks!!
Exceeded expectations. Great space, amenities galore,  incredibly helpful building staff, close to everything. Perfect for our city staycation!

Steve and his wife were fantastic hosts! They were very friendly and made you feel at ease - despite the space being in their home.
