They gave me great recommendations for coffee shops and local running.The space was exactly what my sister and I needed for our short stay in Chicago. The loft we stayed in was clean, private and had a fantastic outdoor deck with a beautiful view of the neighborhood. The amenities provided were very helpful - especially the umbrella! I've already passed on this listing to friends visiting the area in the future. Thank you Steve!

This was our second time staying with Larry and it was a pleasure just like last time. The couch is great for movie night and hanging out with friends, the pillows and blankets are great in the bedrooms, and the kitchen is nice with everything you need. For the price and place it’s a great spot to stop for a couple days at an affordable price. Thanks again for everything!

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was well maintained and spotless when we arrived. It had everything we needed. Tere was very responsive to my messages. She replied within minutes.
The apartment location is great. Even though it is on a busy street, it is set back and very quiet. No one had their sleep disturbed.
We will definitely stay here again when we come to Chicago.
Great stay in a super walkable West Loop location. Host provided clear, complete check in and check out instructions. Would stay again next time we’re in the city

My boyfriend and I stayed at Mindy & Tony’s place for a friends wedding. We didn’t realize the wedding was in Highland Park and got nervous and the commute but Mindy & Tony’s place is so conveniently located near the Metra it wasn’t even an issue! In fact it made the stay even more fun!
A great neighborhood and awesome restaurants. The apartment is wonderful and private but in a really great community. Highly recommend staying here and we certainly will be back!

My husband and I had a fantastic stay at Hatice’s studio in Old Town. The location is fantastic and literally a few steps from Wells Street. We were able to visit our daughter and explore the city easily from here. The unit was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a great stay. Hatice was super responsive and sweet and checked in with me multiple times to ensure we were having a great stay. I wouldn’t hesitate to book this studio again if I am back in Chicago! Thank you Hatice 🙏🏻
Great place, great hosts. Thank you!

This was our third stay and it was just as comfortable, cozy and convenient as always.  We took advantage of the back patio to enjoy our morning coffee this time.  Beautiful flowers and plants!  Looking forward to our next visit and stay at Laura’s!

Valeriy’s place is the way to go! The room was nice and comfortable. Very attentive to offer his help or recommendations. Easy access to nearby transportation. I would definitely book again if traveling to Chicago.

Timothy was an amazing host, super responsive and thoughtful. Location is great, a half block from Wrigley Field, but just be aware it's an urban environment and the L is a block and a half away.
Tons of walkable restaurants, expansive private roof top + lower floor patio, easy access to downtown Chicago (and parking was included which we didn't use). Couldn't ask for more.

Great place and very easy to find and access! Parking was a little difficult (it's expected with Chicago) but Juan made it very easy for us by answering All our questions promptly and providing us with passes to help! Juan is very friendly and always there to answer, and the Airbnb was nice and clean overall! Recommend this place to anyone looking for a stay when in Chicago! Would be back if we're ever back in town.
Great stay in Sheridan Park with remarkably helpful, hospitable hosts. Walkable neighborhood with easy street parking if you're driving in. Highly recommend!

This airbnb is great and in such a cool area of Chicago! Very walkable and so many cool things to do, places to eat, etc. The room itself was great and provided everything we needed. While we didn’t use, the availability of laundry and the nice shared kitchen is a plus!
Great location and comfortable apartment. Highly recommended.
I love that Daniel was so responsive. If we had any minor issue it was addressed immediately.

La ubicación de la casa es muy buena. Era fácil llegar desde el centro y moverse con el tren desde ahí hasta la ciudad. Durante los días de semana había gente por la calle. Muchos sitios para comer y beber y la gente  bastante bien vestida y amable. Es fácil encontrar un buen sitio para comer y beber por un precio aceptable. El barrio bastante limpio. El apartamento está situado muy cerca de la estación de tren y se llega en 5 minutos. La habitación estaba bien, pero no demasiado limpia y con polvo. Las sábanas y toallas limpias. El baño es antiguo y le faltaba un poco de limpieza también. Tiene frigorífico y microondas, aunque este último no funcionaba. Greg nos dio información de todo cuando llegamos y nos recomendó sitios para comer y beber que estaban bastante bien, además de algunas tiendas. Atendía rápido cuando se le escribía algún mensaje y no hubo ningún problema durante nuestra estancia. Buena experiencia en general por el precio y la localización.
Great location, super clean, affordable and communicative. Would stay here again for sure.
exactly what we were expecting

great place! easy check in, comfy bed, felt safe, clean, close to blue line, let me store my luggage, responsive host! 10/10 would stay here again. had everything i needed for my quick weekend trip. thank you!

I loved staying here. It was very easy to get an Uber to get the the places I wanted to visit and was not far at all from main attractions. Literally right around the corner from basic needs stores. I definitely will be back next time I'm ever in Chicago.
Love the area! Perfect space for a big group or a family.
The place was clean and had everything we needed. We would stay again.
This home met our family’s needs at a difficult time. While spread out in three living spaces, everyone had their own beds. The home is in a nice quiet area and we felt safe walking.
Host was great to communicate with. Instructions were clear and easy.  Accommodations were classy. Check in and check out process was very easy.
Dawn was awesome. Great host!

Amazing amazing place! The house was just like the description and photos maybe even bigger. The house was very nice and responsive. Everything was super clean and clear instructions. The neighborhood is beautiful and felt right at home with homemade cookies waiting for us when we got there. A little far from the city but easy to get to with bus. Would totally stay here again!!!
Great location. Walk to a Cubs game. Walk to any number of great restaurants. Take the train into town. So easy!
Loved the place! Felt right at home and was very peaceful. We didn’t have any trouble w anything and there was plenty of parking in front of the house !

Location was fine. Certainly noisy with fire engines but what can you do. Was in room 201 and the above room had extremely creaky floors. Mostly clean space, some trash from a previous stay was under the bed and the walls are scuffed up all over. Parking was a little tricky for sure and the road outside was under construction as it was completely torn up.
Me and my family enjoyed our stay. Very good and vibrant neighborhood. A variety of places to eat. Parking was hard to find on some days, but was able to always find a spot.

The condo was clean, welcoming and a great size. The building amenities were perfect and easy to find and use. The neighborhood has a lot of great restaurants and is walkable to the lakefront, museum campus, and the South Loop. The building security was also very welcoming and informative. I would highly suggest this location to anyone!

Samuel went above and beyond to accommodate myself and my husband on our quick trip to Chicago. From the very beginning he was generous with helping us get into the city, offering to help us with an extra early check in and quickly responded to our messages when we needed more help. Upon our departure we were at a wedding and had left some personal items that Samuel personally delivered to us at the late hours of midnight. He was so kind, helpful and absolutely went above and beyond to support us. Couldn’t recommend enough

We had a very enjoyable stay at Steve's place. Steve's communication was great throughout the duration of our stay at the condo. The location was wonderful for our stay and walkable to bars, restaurants, and shops in Wrigleyville and Boystown. Would stay again for sure!
Voisinage bruyant, réveillée à 5h du matin chaque jour. Autrement le quartier est top et la chambre aussi !

This place was great in wicker park! Above a 23/4 restaurant and fun vibes neighborhood! Easy to walk to good food and coffee! The place was really clean and spacious living room to hang out! I would stay here again!

I came here for a weekend with family! Juan and Yvette are excellent, excellent Hostess’s . Not only do they communicate so well, the place looks even better in person. I love how comfortable the bed was, big screen tv with all my favorite shows, very quiet neighborhood.  If You’re looking for a peace and quiet and want to sleep good, book them!  Also, the house is very secure with locks so you feel safe! I will book them again 💯%  I was very Happy!😊

This is a gut rehab in an ideal location. New kitchen, appliances, new and very comfy beds. Living area pretty cramped though appreciated the comfy sofa. Kitchen is well designed, but lacks some of the condiments, seasonings (including pepper!) and other cooking essentials. Some pots and pans need to be tossed. Short on glassware. Some more area lamps and seating in the main area would be helpful. No one wants to lounge under a blaring overhead light. With a little more attention to detail, this place could be top notch.
Rebecca è un’ottimo host! La casa è come nelle foto, molto pulita, e le indicazioni per check-in e check-out sono molto chiare.
Great location seconds away from the blue line.
Thank you for a great stay! The location worked out so well for a wedding that we were attending. The condo was incredibly clean and organized, felt right at home!
Great stay! Easy to find and check in. Florin was very communicative, instructions were clear. Place was clean.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and very well maintained. Ella was an exceptional host and responded to every question within minutes, making the entire experience stress-free.
The directions, check-in process, and house policies were all very clear and easy to follow. Ella was incredibly accommodating and made us feel welcome from the moment we booked until the day we checked out.
The location couldn't have been better! It was just minutes from the airport, as well as a great selection of restaurants, making it extremely convenient while still being a comfortable place to relax.
I highly recommend staying here if you're looking for a clean, comfortable, and conveniently located Airbnb with an attentive, responsive host. We would absolutely stay here again!
Enjoyed our stay ! Thanks for having us !

My family stayed here, my brother niece and elderly parents, and had a very nice experience. The stairs were an exercise for my dad and you could hear the train, but not to the detriment of their stay. Great location and great host. Thank you.

Stayed for a long weekend in Chicago—it was our first time, so we just used the listing for sleeping and freshening up. Check-in and check-out was easy to follow and didn’t require us to do a list of chores like other AirBnBs. The hosts are very transparent with their space so there was nothing I didn’t expect and everything fit the description exactly. The neighborhood also felt safe and quiet.

This home was perfect for our party of 7. We could cook, travel, and entertain as we choose. Perfect location and easy access to major attractions.
Good value and Wonderfully designed home away from home

Had a great weekend here with our friend group! Great communal space to hang out and slept everyone comfortably.
Wonderful location with conveniences and things to do all around. No cars needed!

Noemi was a great host! She was very responsive, check in/out was super easy, and we appreciated the high quality feel with modern fixtures, appliances, lighting, and lots of space for a group of 6.
Floors could’ve been cleaner to support the “no shoes” rule but weren’t terrible. The immediate vicinity wasn’t amazing (dark alleyway, lots of sirens at night) but as soon as we stepped inside we felt safe and secure.

Really enjoyed our stay, the building was very easy to get into and very quiet. Location is great with some amazing restaurants within a block of the building, but it's a little far from the Magnificent Mile north of the river.
The space has a lot of glass for a tremendous view of the city, with peeks at Lake Michigan and Soldier Field (we could hear a concert one night from the pool deck!). We had everything we needed in the apartment. Space was as it showed in the pictures (the pool is down two floors, for some reason I thought we were on the same level as the pool).
The common areas (pool, rooftop patio) were incredible. There are pagodas on the pool deck and firepits outside of the pool area for gathering.
Dryer wasn't working while we were there, so laundry was tricky.
Overall, we loved it and would stay here again.
Fantastic stay. clean, comfortable, great location, and an excellent host. Everything exceeded my expectations. Highly recommended, and i will gladly stay here again.

can’t recommend this space enough! abe was a great host who really went above and beyond. we felt so taken care of! the space has so much love poured into it. you can really feel it in every detail. 10/10

We had a great stay at Johana's. The apartment was amazing, exactly as advertised. The neighborhood is great with many good food options nearbly. Johana was very friendly and responsive.  We'll be back!
Location was perfect . Great experience for my family and I.

If you’re looking for a comfortable cozy place to stay, you’ve found it. The bedrooms were as expected and precise, and the balcony is perfect for a relaxing moment. Overall, my family and I really enjoyed everything about our stay and the neighbourhood is very peaceful which made us feel right at home. Thank you Alec🖤

House was beautiful. My family and I easily felt comfy. Within walking distance of food and shopping. Parking was a bit hectic but that has nothing to do with Robert. Robert was very welcoming and responsive. We really appreciate having such a positive experience.
An excellent, comfortable spot in the Streeterville area of Chicago. If you're not out walking to enjoy everything Chicago, you're chilling and enjoying the views from this 20th floor oasis.

This home was perfect for our group of 9! Very spacious and in a fun location with lots of restaurants within walking distance. Sachin was very helpful and gave great recommendations on where to eat and things to do. When we had questions or needed anything, he was very responsive and understanding.
Great location and beautiful place.

Evgenii was an amazing host! He allowed us to come earlier than expected due to our early flight. He kept the kitchen and shared bathroom clean and stocked. I truly enjoyed his responsiveness and his respect for his guests. Overall, great host and would love to stay here again next time I visit Chicago!

Amazing host instructions and set up was very easy and understandable. Any and all questions were answered immediately and thoroughly def look forward to making another booking when I return to Chicago 🙂
Perfect two separate living areas for privacy yet togetherness.  Lots of space.  Worked well for our family of 5 with infant.
We had a great stay at Alis’s place. Everything matched the description. Beautiful surroundings in a good location.
Great place and great area!

Afsha’s place was just right. It really had everything we needed in a walkable neighborhood and close to so many other things to do in the city. The parking spot was a bonus and she gave perfect instructions on where to park and how to enter.

This place was great! The location was awesome and there was so much to do. It’s definitely a bit overpriced for what you get - but location is great. Host is super responsive and made sure check in went great.

This apartment was exactly what we hoped for. It had everything we needed and was very peaceful. The space was really clean and full of light. Tenna' was a great host and obviously cares about the needs of her guests. It was lovely sitting on the back porch each night with a view of the Chicago skyline.
Thanks for hosting us.
We stayed here for a dance competition being held at Navy Pier. Perfect space for our family, less than 20 mins drive to the venue, lovely decor. Thank you!

Good place that fit all of us well enough. Host was very communicative and accommodating.
Sheets were provided for the sofa beds which fits two perpendicular.
Would stay again.
It was a great experience and Damani was very fast to respond if we had any questions. Highly recommend!!!

Great place and host! Easy to find and very walkable to all that Wicker Park has to offer. Location alone makes this place worth it. Comfortably fit our group of 7. Host was proactive in checking in and responsive to questions. Easy uber to downtown and train lines are close. Neighborhood was quiet and safe.

Serg’s place was all it said it would be.  VERY clean, not cluttered, everything you would need to be comfortable.  The bathroom had great pressure and super clean.  The tv’s all in the right places.  The kitchen was very well done.  It could have a used a few more utensils but we got by just fine.  Will definitely come to Serg’s next time in Chicago.  GREAT PLACE AND A VERY PROFESSIONAL HOST!
Great stay in Chicago, very clean and comfortable! Thank you

This place was the perfect stay for our group of friends! This space was so nice with great living spaces (kitchen, living room, and adorable patio!). I appreciated Natalie's responsiveness and flexibility with our trip timing. It was a great spot to walk around and access public transport to tour more of Chicago!
Good stay. Clean. Shower was small but would definitely stay again!
Nice location, spacious and thick walls. Clean kitchen, big spaces.
Well-kept house about 2 blocks from the beach. Enjoyed our stay
Great stay for a lowkey bachelorette weekend. Close to downtown for plenty to do but tucked into a quiet neighborhood.
Most responsive and helpful hosts i've ever had

Very cute little home. Carmen was the easiest to work with. Her place was very clean, comfy, and made us feel at home. Highly recommend booking with her. We will be back next year and will try to rebook her home.

Simon is one of the best hosts ever. One of the most thoughtful and gracious hosts I have ever had. The space was immaculate and comfy. Simon also left us water, fruit, and other thoughful things we weren't even expecting! The bathroom is amazing as well as the shower. The back patio is like a fairy garden, it's amazing. Everything was super easy from arrival to departure. Thanks again Simon. you're the best. <3

Bernadette's place was a great place for my family and I to stay. Very quiet neighborhood, only a 15 or so minute walk to the Metra Station. She gave some great recomendations for dinner nearby and was always very responsive. The driveway is a tight squeeze at first, but our Blazer was able to get through just fine!
Thanks for everything Bernadette!
We had a great stay in Chicago! We loved having plenty of space for our family.

This place was a mixed bag. The location was very good, and the host was helpful when it was him responding and not his AI bot. The cleanliness was average, and there were things not finished throughout our stay (i.e. AC filter left in sink, some laundry left wet in the washer). Overall it was decent.

My husband and I had a great stay. Sarah was very responsive to questions and provided great recommendations for local food and drinks. The space was cozy and the bed was very comfortable. We would love to stay again in the future!
Very nice place. I loved the private parking where I felt like my vehicle was safe and securely locked in. Host made everything very clear and easy to navigate.

This cozy basement apartment was a great choice for my monthlong research at the Newberry Library. It’s in a lovely residential neighborhood, with shops, grocery, restaurants, etc. in easy walking distance, and just a few blocks from the Brown Line El. Hosts were very responsive and friendly, while fully respecting my privacy. It’s more spacious than it looks in the photos, and is well-equipped for simple meal prep. Note that the walls are *not* bright lime green, but rather a calming darker sage.

This place is pretty central in the Wicker Park neighborhood. We parked our car on our first day and did not need to use it for the rest of the time. Very close to the L! Extremely close to some amazing restaurants and cafe’s.
The house itself was larger than I expected! A lot of space, especially for 8 out of us, very clean & had everything we needed!
Great stay! Very clean and amazing location!

Cute and clean space in the best location! Lovely neighborhood and walkable to so many great restaurants, shops etc.  Bryce was a great host and I highly recommend this place if you want the full Andersonville experience!
Nice place, easy to find a parking spot on the street right out front, lots of communication from the host.   Would reccomend.

Tammy and her family were so welcoming! The house is beautiful! The room was cute and full of natural light. The bed was comfortable. Tammy was welcoming and thoughtful throughout our stay and struck a good balance of conversation and privacy. Roger's Park is a lovely neighborhood with plenty of access to CTA options, and the beach park around the corner was a lovely place to end several days. We will definitely stay here again if we have the opportunity.
Freddy’s place was spacious with lots of seating in the common areas. The place was definitely bigger than what we thought based on the pictures. Great location and great communication!
Quite place, easy neighborhood  to get around in.  Restaurants and grocery store close by.
Anastasia was a great host and the place was perfect. She even answered my questions about some home decor in the apt I liked. Highly recommend. I would stay here again.
I had a family of 9 of us that stayed, and it was a great experience! The host was extremely responsive and all of our needs were met. I would absolutely stay here again!
Very cozy rooms and atmosphere. tons of entertainment options including movies games and books. Very easy access to public transit and a very responsive host.

Talk about a nice place to stay!! Very clean and just what you need for a little vacation away. Rida was amazing and easy to talk to if we needed anything. Her instructions were spot on and easy to follow. It was by far the best Airbnb I have been too. Thank you so much Rida : )

Our hosts were amazing and quick to respond with any questions. The apartment was easy to find and took us a minute to find the lock box, but all good. The space was very clean and the linen and towels were fresh. The kitchen was well stocked with cooking pots and dishes. Lots of spices and some cooking oil made it very helpful to make meals. The location is perfect for dining out and entertainment. Many of it being walking distance. Overall and excellent and highly recommended!
Place was exactly as described! Olga was extremely kind & responsive. Would definitely stay here again

My husband and I had a great 2 night stay while attending shows at Thalia Hall. Even on a busy summer weekend on a main road, I found the unit to be super quiet, which was nice. Very clean, with nice amenities. We were able to get paid street parking right out front all weekend and it was easy to grab Lyft as well. We definitely would stay here again.
One of the best visits i have had! Went out of there way to help secure groceries for us as our train got in late.. thank you
Bien en général, mais l'appartement aurait besoin d'un peu d'amour (Wi-Fi instable, stores qui ferment mal ou sont défectueux, lit brisé, etc.

This was Great! I came in town for a Conference. I did not know what to expect for it was my first shared Airbnb experience. I arrived and it was absolutely seamless in addition it was great! Other guest was friendly. The space was great! Space was clean and very nice. I will definitely be booking with them again!!!

Wonderful place for my family to stay when they came to visit - gorgeous condo with plenty of room for everyone and in one of the city’s best neighborhoods! Clean, cute, comfy, walkable to the Osterman Beach and great restaurants but also near public transit that can take you anywhere you want to go. Our host was so kind and communicative as well!
Note: the neighbors of this unit are not keen on having an Airbnb next door, so they will complain frequently that anyone staying here is being loud whether you are or not. My family were barely in the unit while in Chicago and are very calm, quiet people so we knew something was up when complaints kept coming.
I felt bad that our hosts were in this neighbor situation; but if you’re quiet and considerate and let the complaints roll off your back, you’ll have a great stay!
We had a great stay at Marissa’s! We were out and about for most of our visit so it made for a great spot to crash after a long day of exploring.

We had a great stay at Rob’s place! Ukrainian village had a lot to do especially restaurants. The apartment was one block from a big grocery store which was super convenient. The apartment itself was AMAZING! Gorgeous decor and modern kitchen and bathroom. The place is way bigger than we expected! The kitchen had everything you could possibly need - you don’t need to bring anything. There were tons of towels in the bathroom. Beds were comfy, tvs in every room and we enjoyed watching the World Cup matches in the cozy living room. We ate at Beatnik and Club Lucky - both fun restaurants that were close by.

This is our second time staying at Milan’s place so I’d definitely recommend staying here to others. Not quite walking distance to the heart of the city, but close enough to drive downtown within 10-20min depending on traffic. There is a small breakfast/brunch spot underneath the building, so sometimes you can hear faint music, but it isn’t super loud and  they aren’t open late so it didn’t  interrupt my sleep any. We parked in the garage which is an extra fee, but worth it if you’re driving in town. Overall, very satisfied with my stay..and needless to say we will be back 😊
This beautiful apartment was a great place to stay while exploring Chicago. The neighborhood was peaceful with the subway only a couple of blocks away to take us downtown.

This place is great for those who need a reasonable place with relatively good parking options. The neighborhood seemed completely fine, even at night. The location was pretty good; lots of good Mexican restaurants within walking distance, about a 15 minute walk from California Station, and a relatively easy drive to anywhere around the city. The space was very clean and had all the usual amenities, as well as a variety of games. Plus the beds were quite comfy. Street parking was mostly easy, but definitely got more crowded Saturdays night. My only complaint was that I could hear the upstairs neighbors walking around periodically, but it wasn't too bad. It's a simple place, but checks all the boxes, especially if you have a car.
Extremely responsive. Only thing was smoke detector battery was low and was constantly beeping. Informed host but it was not fixed during our stay.

I was in town for the Ed Sheeran concert with my husband and two children (9 and 12). We wanted a place close to the venue so we could get home easily afterward (first concert for our kids).  Location was amazing and definitely walkable. Check in was easy, we were able to meetup and Fed showed us around the place which was perfect for us. We had a few questions and he was very responsive. We went downtown a few times and ended up walking back once seeing some sights along the way. The area was beautiful and safe. The rooftop views were stunning. Thanks for sharing your place with us.
Great location, right by a train stop & Whole Foods. 5 min to Montrose Park.
Beautiful space and wonderful hosts!
Perfect

Really nice place for a big group, amazing location, and great communication from the host! Only downside really was the train right above the patio area, it runs pretty frequently and is super loud. But it felt like a true Chicago experience and they gave us earplugs in each of the bedrooms

We throughly enjoyed our stay at Sean's airbnb, and would recommend it to other's as well.  Not too far from downtown respectively, so was an overall good location to use.  Sean was very proactive with communication and ensuring we had what we needed.
Fantastic location to explore Chicago from. The host was really helpful and responsive

Brad was a great host. Communication was clear throughout my stay, and he was very flexible with my departure time when I wasn’t feeling well, which I really appreciated.
This was my first time visiting Chicago, and I absolutely loved the Hyde Park neighborhood. There was so much to do, and I felt it was a great area to stay in. I would definitely choose this neighborhood again on a future visit.
The Airbnb photos were similar to the actual space, although not an exact match. That said, the accommodation worked well for my trip and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Overall, I had a positive experience.

Nicholas was a great host - his place looks like the pictures, and has super clear instructions on how to get in his place for checkin.
Great location with a lot of things in walking distance; also makes downtown and west loop available with at most 30min uber ride.
Ragan’s place was great for a couple of nights in Chicago! 10 minutes from the White Sox and lots of bars and restaurants nearby. I would definitely stay again if I’m ever in the area!
Very comfortable house in a beautiful neighborhood!
great house in a quiet neighborhood, am convenient and low-traffic drive to the highway. craig is an awesome host
This spot was perfect, close to our family and super quiet.
We enjoyed our stay. It was central to everything we had planned. Parking was on the street but we never had problems finding very close parking. It was clean and easy to find anything we needed.

The place was great and easy to find! Check-in/-out instructions were simple and clear. The location also felt safe. Only issues we had were the lack of kitchen supplies and the stove top did not work; the front door to get into the building was very finicky as well (it wouldn’t shut all the way and the deadbolt got stuck many times making it hard to lock). Other than that we enjoyed our stay!
Good
Great stay! We felt very comfortable and check in was very convenient.
Loved the interior! This place was so cutely decorated!! 15 min from downtown so it was a great place to lay our head down! Anais gave wonderfully detailed instructions on everything we needed!
Joe and his team run a classy operation. A very comfortable bed-and-breakfast co-living space that has all the comfort of home. Also, easy access to the rest of chicago Villa public transportation.

We very quickly felt that Paul’s
Place became our little flat. My sister and I met in Chicago to reconnect and get some 1:1 tome together, and this place was perfect. The neighborhood is so nice, beautiful homes, big leafy boulevards, artsy shops and lots of restaurants and bars. Easy access to Public transit and Lyfts always near. Paul treated us like neighbors. It’s a very special place. Comfy beds and furniture, lots of extra, caring touches. Highly recommend!

The condo is walkable to many coffee shops, grocery store and attractions. It was great to have parking, and yes the spot was small but we were able to fit a minivan. The condo is also small yet has everything we needed for the weekend.
Great host

My husband and I stayed the weekend at Devin’s place and it was the perfect spot! It’s in a lovely neighborhood that has plenty to walk to as well as close to the train. The room was exactly as described, clean, as well as comfortable.
Thanks so much for having us!
The bnb was extremely nice and close to the city!
Great location. Very clean. The host is very responsive
A gem
We were very very pleased with the home, easy access, clean spacious, and perfect for our group. We absolutely loved it.
Nice, clean stay
Great location and charming studio for your time in Chicago! The host is friendly and was thoughtful throughout my stay.

we had a great stay for 6 girls. plenty of room for everyone and plenty of bathrooms. nice and clean too. only downfall was it was noisy all throughout the night. was farther away from downtown Chicago than we thought but we just stuck with ubers instead of the train/bus.
The building is brand new, the amenities were great including the workout room and the basketball court and the Target store next door is extremely convenient.
Great!

Absolutely loved my stay! The place was spotless, beautiful, and exactly as described. The host was kind, responsive, and made everything easy. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

The location is great. Plenty of things are walkable. Plenty of amenities. However, the listening clearly states 3 queen beds. It was 3 full beds. That alone would have lead me to choose another property because this property seemed liked a deal for 3 queens but it’s on the more expensive side for 3 full beds. So our group of 8 guys were crammed in a little tighter than expected. Still a great location. Only other negative is that the air conditioning was struggling for us (26th floor of an old building.) This is understandable for an old building, but if it’s too hot to open the windows you may have an unpleasant stay.

This was a great place for 4 people (2 couples) + a chill dog. The proximity to the blue line was great for our party & the surrounding area offers a lot to do within walking distance but not so much that it’s busy, loud, or distracting. Free, off-street parking was easy to find. We weren’t in the airBnB too much, but, for sleeping, take-out breakfast in the kitchen, and feeling safe/comfortable, it met all of our demands.
One of the best Air BnB’s I’ve stayed at. Excellent hosts, prime location, and top notch accommodations. I’d gladly stay here again and recommend to anyone.
Had such a wonderful stay! It felt very private and the place was very nice.
This was incredibly easy to find and locate the unit! The owners were super responsive and helpful. We would definitely re book a stay here!
Loved my stay with Marty and Rob. Will stay there again next year!
Blake’s place was spotless & very clean. He was a responsive and a great host! Will definitely be looking to book his place for future trips!

This is a great place to stay! It is close enough to the L train that you can get where you need to go easily! Also about a mile from the river path. It is small, but that was to be expected based on the listing and we were only planning on sleeping there anyways. Great place to stay!

The unit we stayed in was ok, the rest of the building was disappointing. The rooftop deck was closed and we were made aware it was under construction the day before we arrived. By the looks of that area I’m guessing it’s been closed for a while and there was no one actively working on it during our stay. We did find another outdoor area although it was complicated to find and not very nice. This was definitely overpriced for what we got!
Great place, just as described, excellent location, clear and prompt communication. Very happy stay!
We enjoyed the place. It was really great

Jevaux place was very cozy and clean. The area was filled with a lot of local spots to dine in and grab any last min essentials. Host was very responsive and the communication throughout was very quick. Would stay here again !

Benjamin's place was exactly as described, a great place for 1 or 2 people. It is akin to a hotel suite, but at a much better value! As others have mentioned, the entry way with steps can bea bit tricky.

Great location to walk to everything you need/all the attractions. We were there with our two little kiddos and it was just what we needed for a long weekend trip. The heated pool was especially appreciated for during our down time.
The living room only seats 3 people on the sofa. It holds 10 people but there isn’t enough seating to sit comfortably in the living area. Everything else was great.

Great Airbnb and host! My boyfriend and I loved the location best. Directly beside blue line, walkable to all Logan square restaurants/bars/coffee shops. The building is older so you do hear upstairs neighbors and transit nearby but that didn’t bother us at all. Host was very kind and responsive

Mark and Colette are such greats hosts and we were honored to be able to stay in their lovely garden apartment. There are tons of great restaurants and bars within walking distance and top it off, there’s an awesome ice cream place around the corner.
Great place for a couple or a family looking for a neighborhood vibe!
Thank you both!!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We waked to the nearby Aldi and breakfast restaurant. It was also easy to catch either the train or bus.
Beds were comfortable. Kitchen was well stocked with essentials.
Our favorite part was the beck deck where we had dinner our last night.

This was my first Airbnb experience and I learned alot. The host Erica is very kind and responsive. The home is clean and nicely decorated, as the pictures depict. William, who lives in one of the rooms, is friendly. The price is very affordable, but if you’re not familiar with the neighborhood, you may want to do some research. Soon after bringing my luggage inside, I headed out to an event. While at my car parked in front of the house, a shooting occurred in the empty lot next to the house. Returning that night was frightening and it was difficult to sleep all considered.  Erica apologized for what occurred and suggested I cancel the reservation and that I could dispute the charge without her objection. The lights outside and inside the property are kept low or off. This made it difficult and I suggested, for safety and convenience, that more lights be kept on. I just want others to be aware of the possibilities at this home, if you’re not used to a neighborhood with as much activity
This was a great location! The photos are accurate and we really enjoyed how walkable the neighborhood is. Would stay again

I loved staying with Iris and would happily stay here again. She’s the kind of old-school Airbnb host that made me fall in love with Airbnb in the first place. She lives on-site, cleans the space herself, and clearly takes pride in every detail. The apartment was clean, welcoming, and even included hand-cut soap, which was a fun touch (and something we appreciate as fellow Airbnb hosts!).
The space is small but thoughtfully laid out and had everything I needed for my stay. The location was fantastic and made it easy to explore Chicago without needing a car.
If you’re looking for a polished hotel experience, this isn’t it. And that’s exactly the charm. It feels personal, well cared for, and hosted by someone who genuinely enjoys welcoming guests. Thanks, Iris!
We had a great experience. Comfortable, clean and easy access to the city. I would come again for sure.

The unit is as advertised. Clean and recently remodeled. Some oddities that are normal with these older remodeled Chicago buildings.
It is up stairs and you can’t walk around front to back (where the parking is) without going up the stairs and through the unit. (Or long way around the block)
The dedicated parking space is in the back. Access from the back is up a narrow staircase and then enter through one of the bedrooms.
The exit/entrance to the front is in the living room and you have to remember not to lock that door or you will lock yourself out. Free parking on Ashland ave (very busy road) in front. Generally easy to find a spot but not always close to the front entrance (if loading/unloading) . The rooms are very small and beds against the wall but clean and comfortable.
There are not a lot of power outlets.
Kitchen cupboards didn’t have many staples -such as coffee. But everything was clean, new and nice.
No issues with street noise. We would stay here aga

Sky’s home was simply wonderful, clean, elegant comfortable. You can tell there was a great deal of care placed in the investment in this space not only was it cozy and comfortable, but it also felt elegant and sophisticated. One of the best features was the luxurious bed and pillows. I’ve traveled around the world and this was the most comfortable bed. Bravo on the bed Sky was very helpful in a myriad of ways one of which was the guest book full of information. A very nice touch was providing the local newspaper ads. Sky was always responsive to any questions friendly professional and patient. This Airbnb is highly recommended. The location of the space was perfect 20 minutes away from downtown 20 minutes away from the Obama Center. Just a jewel of a space thank you sky bravo,
Myla
Christina’s place is in the cutest neighborhood and walkable to so many shops and restaurants! It was very clean and had everything we needed! We had a lovely stay and would absolutely stay again!
Great place
Great location, very quiet street with many walkable restaurants, coffee shops, bars and more. Easy street parking with permits provided. Watch your head on the ceilings.

My daughter and I stayed at Janette’s place for my son’s engagement party. She was very responsive and accommodating. The set up inside her place was perfect for my daughter to work during the day. We had plenty of space and it was very clean. It was quiet for a city location. Easy to get in and out. The decor was cute and welcoming. This was the perfect spot for our weekend. I would definitely stay there again.
Great stay!

Perfect location it is a quiet area.
If you are using public transport the average time for travel was about 40 mins. You are close to multiple bus stops.
The house itself was great and accurate description. Host was very responsive.
Loved the house.m!  All the amenities and so comfortable. Plenty of room for our group to spread out and spend time together. Super cool rooftop was such a plus.
Loved my stay here. Clean. Quiet. Was not prepared for the stairs with my huge suitcase lol, but overall wasn’t a problem. Would def stay again if I’m ever in Chicago again.

Noel was a fantastic host. Always responsive and even gave some recommendations for the area. Easy check in and check out. His place was very intentional and visually pleasing. Perfect place to stay while visiting the Chicago area.
Great place to stay neighborhood is cute and apartment itself was very clean and well maintained

Location was perfect! Walking distance to the Blue line to get right to downtown or ohare. There are tons of restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife opportunities all within 10-15 minutes walking distance. There are also a couple locations to pick up rental bikes in the area to ride a bit further out if needed (we biked to Lincoln park zoo and area very easily and safely). The place itself was very comfortable, clean, and the perfect amount of space for our group of 4 people. The place felt very quiet and perfect for catching up on rest
Kyriako and George were very communicative and responsive. The apartment was as advertised and clean. I’d recommend the apartment if you’re staying in Wicker Park.

家の中は非常に清潔に保たれているし、新築のように綺麗です。
キッチンも広くて料理もしやすかったです。また機会あれば泊まりたいです。
This was an absolutely beautiful place and a great location! It was clean, matched the photos, spacious and there was supplies and toiletry provided. 100% Recommend!

Lovely basement apartment in a peaceful, quiet, and walkable neighborhood. Robert was kind enough to let us check in early and provided everything we could need for the stay. The location is close to the beaches and public transportation; we couldn't ask for more!

Stayed at Ian's place for my first visit to Chicago. Parking spot in the back was super helpful -- used the L and Uber for the whole trip, so it was nice to not have my car parked on the street for the whole time. Very close to the train station, and pretty central to most attractions in the city. Place was clean and well-stocked, and the area is pretty quiet. Ian was very responsive and friendly. Would definitely stay here again!

Kerena was a wonderful host! The apartment was very cozy and in a lovely neighborhood. She was communicative and flexible. I had a late arrival and she also let my friend bring his dog over in a last-minute request. Milwaukee Ave is a great street to take a walk down; plenty of thrift shops, bars, and coffee shops. The apartment is only a 30-minute subway ride to the Loop; super easy to get to all the sites downtown. Would definitely recommend staying here if you want a quieter neighborhood when visiting Chicago!

Jeff is a very friendly host who would personally welcome you into the house and sit down to chat. And if the occasion is right, you can even have a taste of his personal whiskey collection! The house is clean and very comfortable, with a full kitchen and a shared bathroom, in a fairly quiet neighborhood. The wall is thin so just mind the quiet hours. If you have a rental car, there is plenty of street parking around. I highly recommend this place for what you get for the price you pay!
We stayed here with a large group and had a very easy pleasant stay. Would recommend and will come back if we have another large group in the future!
Perfect location!

The home and the character of the neighborhood is amazing!!! I have never been in a sturdier built home in my life. The neighborhood has beautiful homes and has free parking on the street. I prefer quiet and a neighborhood feel. I got so much more than I bargained for. John and Terry are amazing. The grounds, rooms and home have such character. The shower has an adjustable shower head and great water pressure. My only negative issue was that I couldn't spend more time in the home! 5 stars for me!
Tony was a great host and quick to respond. Would definitely stay here again.
This is our second time staying here. it is really close to family and walkable for anything you might need. its quite a d relaxing.
Great place. Well equipped for a comfortable stay. Having a designated parking spot was wonderful!

Erica was wonderful! When I got there and was struggling with the door, she came fast quick and in a hurry… she was super cool to talk to, very hospitable and greeeeeat communication. The kitchen was missing a few things and the things she had, she shared with me. The room I stayed in was for (Airbnb ) but there were two other rooms in the shared space who were people that paid rent and lived there. They were both really cool. The space was quiet and in a pretty quiet area… Great parking. I will say some of the doors were a little hard to get through because they were heavier had to push hard, but other than that great experience. Would definitely stay there again if I’m back in Chicago in that area.

​Really enjoyed my time here! The hosts were super quick to respond and made everything very easy to navigate. The apartment was spotless and felt very welcoming. The location is perfect, too. Even though a later checkout wasn't available, I had a great stay and would definitely recommend booking this spot.
I had a wonderful stay with three of my friends for my low key bachelorette trip! Very clean place. No complaints!
Very nice place! In a great location

Great and safe location. Shower was AMAZING. Like what dreams are made of. I want to take a plumber to this house, let him take a shower there, and teach others how to install a top notch shower like that 🔥
Would stay again. A china town gem. 💎

Great spot, walkable to coffee shops, bars, restaurants.  Marco was super responsive and a great communicator.  The Airbnb was clean and had all the amenities we needed for a weekend in Chicago. Would stay here again.

Had a nice stay here. The bed was comfortable and it has everything you need. Just a heads up if you’re a bit of a neat freak—there was some dust on the baseboards and blinds, but nothing terrible. Would still recommend!

Kyriako’s place was just as described. The location was perfect for our stay, being less than a 15 minute easy drive from sites in the city like Shedd Aquarium, Field Museum, Soldier Field, Griffin Museum of Science and Industry, and more. There were many places within walking distance for us to dine at. We tried 5 Rabanitos and Ascione Bistro - both were great. We felt safe walking to both for dinner. The apartment was just right for our short 2 night stay. The bed was very comfortable. I expected to hear more noise, but only occasionally noticed noise from the front door of the building - otherwise it was very quiet! Parking on the street is free. It always seemed very full, but we actually never had an issue finding a spot! Kyriako and his team communicated extremely well leading up to and during our stay. They were super quick to respond when we had a question. I would definitely recommended their place to others considering!

Dawn's place is in a great location within easy walking distance of the train, shops, coffee spots, and many bars and restaurants. The area is charming and fun to walk along the side streets to see the many cute houses. Quiet at night and very comfortable neighborhood. Accessing the unit was easy and the unit itself is clean and welcoming. The kitchen amenities are a nice perk to have morning coffee or tea before heading out. The proximity to the blue line makes it very easy to get in from O'Hare and to head downtown. I would absolutely look for Dawn's rental again on a future trip to Chicago!

Perfect spot for a weekend getaway. Walking distance to a lot of great places and easy access to the train. Maria was very friendly and the space felt private and quiet. Bed was very comfortable, good water pressure, and very clean. The little patio out back was a nice touch. Maria provided easy clear instructions. Would stay again. 😀

Our stay was great. It was a nice comfortable setting to enjoy some family time. I must admit the one TV was a little disturbing BUT after we settled, we actually bonded more by sitting and talking and less screen time so it worked out well. Everything was amazing and Tosin was nice and very responsive!! He had a personality that was welcoming and that was important! The space and rooms were great!

The place itself was clean and fine for a stay, but the location wasn’t the greatest—it is in an area that is currently being gentrified. Before arriving, I noticed the address format looked unusual and asked the host for clarification. She simply repeated the address without mentioning it was a rougher neighborhood. I had asked ahead of time if I could ship a package there, but received no specific delivery instructions or warnings. Ultimately, the package was left outside and stolen. I wish the host had been more transparent about the area so I could have avoided shipping important items here. And the cleaning guy kept coming through out my stay. I wish I was warned about that too prior to my stay.
Amy was great, very friendly and helpful. Space was nice - a restful home-base while visiting Chicago.
Great location and easy in/out!
If I ever visit Chicago again I’ll definitely stay there.
it was very clean and peaceful and I felt very safe
Good Location, Clean I WILL STAT AGAIN TO QUESTION ASK 🙏 😊
great location and check in was easy.

Great location, very walkable and the spot itself is nice. Just be weary of the train if you’re a light sleeper. The only “issue” I had was that communication was sparse as it took a little bit to respond but I also didn’t have a single pertinent issue that I needed to reach out for. Overall I would stay again!

Incredibly charming apartment on the third floor of a classic Lincoln Park home. Perfect location. Beautiful garden that we used for having friends over. Carly was extremely welcoming and helpful. We’d stay there again!
Kathleen is a wonderful host and the place is fantastic. My parents stay here whenever they come into town and always have a fantastic experience.

Jesse is very hospitable. I think the stay could’ve been more accommodating to short-term stays, ie no towels provided at all and long-term guests hogging amenities. I do believe that the cost is reflective of the experience.

Zen’s place was a good fit for our stay. It’s a shared home with a private bedroom and a separate private bathroom, so if you’re comfortable with that setup, it should work well for you. We never actually saw any of the other guests, though we could hear people throughout the home, which is something to keep in mind if you’re a light sleeper.
The only inconvenience for us was that the private bathroom wasn’t connected to the bedroom. Since both the bedroom and bathroom required separate entry codes, going back and forth was a bit less convenient than having an en suite bathroom.
Overall, the space was clean, check-in was easy, and we had no issues during our stay. If you’re looking for a clean, straightforward place to stay and don’t mind the shared-home layout, I’d recommend it.

Overall, the house is great! Clean with plenty of room for our group. Location is really good-across from park and near lots of good restaurants. Only issues were the front gate not shutting all of the way and we couldn’t use the backyard because of a previous storm. Danny was great at communicating with us and answering any questions.

The management company was incredibly responsive when I first arrived and requested the AC be turned down for this unit. It was late at night, but they were quick to respond.
I did see comments about a yellowing ceiling from leaks, but the paint is just patchy.
Everything I needed to touch was clean (bathroom toilet, sink, and shower, towels, sheets, kitchen items, floor, etc.). However, the apartment is in need of some "spring cleaning" as the doors, baseboards, air vents, etc. are dirty.
The mattress is the kind of foam you really sink into.
The one drawback for me was the strong odor of pet urine when I walked into the building. The smell wafts under the apartment door and saturates the space. When I blocked the draft coming from under the front door and opened the windows on both sides of the apartment, it aired out just fine. So it's not an issue with the apartment, just the neighbors.

Arthur’s place was perfect for our trip. The accommodation was incredibly comfortable, well-maintained, and in a great location. Arthur was attentive, helpful, and quick to respond to any questions. Thanks for a great stay! Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay! The location was perfect for us since we were visiting friends nearby. The apartment was clean, well-stocked, and had everything we needed, including plenty of towels, toiletries, and a washer and dryer. Parking is a short walk away, but it was convenient and we appreciated having a secure parking option. The building also has a secure entrance with a front desk, which made us feel safe. We accidentally left something in the dryer after checking out, and the host notified us right away and held it at the front desk for us to pick up. We really appreciated that extra level of care. We’d definitely stay here again!
This was in an incredible location where we felt right at home. Brad was incredibly responsive and checked on us via messenging several times throughout our stay. Would recommend!

Je recommande Très belle chambre dans un quartier calme propre
Métro à 10min de marche
20min du centre idéal pour séjourner à Chicago

David was a great host - great communication throughout and very helpful. The beds weren't the most comfortable, but that would be our only slight complaint. Everything else was perfect, and would definitely stay here again.
Great location however it’s right on the L line so pretty noisy especially at night. The apartment could be better maintained and cleaner but it was good. Host was very responsive!

Needed a place in this area and this was perfect. Loved having a parking space. Our host James always replied immediately with any questions. Great neighborhood, safe building, clean apartment with a lot of space.
This was perfect for what we needed for a girls trip! Great stay and good location as a "home base" to get around the city
My friends and I felt at home - this condo had all the amenities we needed to make our time in Chicago great!
Clean place with a great location. Quick responses to questions, nice to have some breakfast foods available, very accommodating and friendly. Thank you!

The apartment is on a beautiful quiet street in Lincoln Park but it is safe and walkable to anything you might want (and an easy Uber lift to downtown or West Loop). I was concerned about the noise from the upstairs apartment that other guests wrote about, but footsteps and creaky floors did not disturb our sleep one bit. We did hear people upstairs during the day, but we weren’t in the apartment very long during the day so it didn’t matter anyway. Just a warning, if you are 6’4” like my husband the ceiling is super low and the basement beam is a bit of head-bonking risk if you don’t pay attention. Otherwise the apartment is perfect and we would definitely stay again!
Good

Great location near public transportation and lots of good eats. Place was nice and clean and host was very responsive. Only downside was the train sounds were pretty loud and kids were not able to sleep too well because of it

This location is unbeatable. It's a three-minute walk (tops) to the Logan Square station on the Blue Line, and a one-minute walk from all the restaurants, bars, and coffee shops you could want. If you're looking for a real neighborhood experience in Chicago, this is it. The hosts were very friendly and responsive to messages. Check-in and check-out were a breeze. The apartment was very private and quiet with almost no street noise.
Great spot in Wrigleyville! Close to everything you could need!

We very much enjoyed our stay and would happily stay here again. The beds, pillows, and linens were exceptionally comfortable, and we were pleasantly surprised by how little we noticed the sound of the nearby train. Having Whole Foods just around the corner was incredibly convenient, and the ease of getting in and out of the dedicated parking space was a huge bonus.
The property management team was exceptionally responsive, kind, and helpful throughout our stay. We also appreciated having a washer and dryer in the apartment, which made our visit even more convenient.
The only suggestions we have are that dish towels would have been appreciated, and we found the couch less comfortable than the rest of the furnishings. Overall, however, we had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again.
Great home and location for our group of 6 adults visiting for a family celebration.  We appreciated the lower level “suite” for someone who had sleep differences from the 5 of us upstairs.
So happy to find a place where we could check in early after a red eye! It was just as described and had everything we needed.
The host was very accommodating.  I would consider staying at this location again. I had a wonderful time in Chicago.  It was easy to access the building.
The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed—thank you, Brian and Gloriann!

Staying at Martin’s was the perfect addition to our Chicago weekend! The apartment is an experience all on its own. A must do if you’re a music fan. The neighborhood was fantastic and a quick easy commute to all the typical Chicago tourist attractions. We will be back without a doubt.
great place
This place worked great for our family on a short visit. Had everything we needed. Only issue was an unpleasant smell that we noticed when we first checked in, but pretty quickly got used to.

This was our second time staying here while visiting family. It is a very clean, apartment with a nice kitchen area. The location is hard to beat ! It is within walking distance to restaurants, coffee shops , the zoo and lake. It’s on a beautiful street in a great neighborhood.  Can’t wait to come back!
Tuan was very nice and has a beautiful home! He was very responsive to the few questions we had and made us feel very comfortable our entire stay!

Great location right near Millenium park. Easy access to train and a short walk from the riverfront. Clean, comfortable accommodations, seamless check in and check out process. Overall, exactly as expected and would recommend to anyone looking for these things in their Airbnb.
My family and I had a wonderful time. The unit was exactly what we needed. Latasha was a great host- kind, communicative and made sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely stay here again!
Eugene's place looked just the the pictures I  would definitely sta again.

I liked Danielle's place! The bed was great, the self check-in was easy, and the pet bunny was very welcoming. I spent all my time downtown, so having the train right out the back door was extremely convenient. The main drawback was street noise, mainly the train and the occasional motorcycle, even people shouting in the street. I was able to sleep well, but if you're noise sensitive, bring earplugs. Also, there are no places within walking distance to eat. Lastly, the bed has a frame, so for anyone taller than me (5'10"), it would be short.

Tina's place was amazing. My family and I loved the personal touch of welcoming us with a big sign! That was so great. Thank you, Tina. Tina was also very quick with replies and was very helpful whenever we had any questions. Would definitely recommend this place to others.
On another note, the kitchen cabinet colors are just beautiful.

A really perfect location to stay in Chicago, right next to a train stop and huge commerce area. The bathroom and kitchen were really nicely updated and there were clear instructions on how to get set up inside. I would stay again
Comfortable apartment, nice roommates. Matched description & met expectations.
Apartment was great, and easy to find. Easy access and met all needs. Would stay there again!

Condo was just as described. SO CUTE!  It was definitely cleaned recently as there was an overpowering smell of Murphy’s Oil Soap when we arrived. Comfortable beds. Had an issue getting connected to Wifi but was resolved in a reasonable time.  Definitely would stay again.
Great spot for a big group! Raphael was awesome
Stayed here for my bachelorette and it was perfect!!

Coty was a pleasure to communicate with. He made us feel so comfortable. He was very accommodating and informative. He checked in on us more than once to see if there was anything that we may need during our stay . His communication and hospitality was top tier !
Convenient location for our event, extremely clean.

We were in town for a wedding and it was the perfect stay! The directions were easy to follow and it was a nice, private location that felt very safe! They provided parking passes so I had parking right in front of the building both days. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

Matt’s place was fantastic. We needed a last minute place to stay after the hotel we booked had roaches. The Airbnb was spotless, the location is amazing and Matt was very responsive and proactive in his communication. My family loved it and we would definitely stay here again whenever we’re in Chicago.
Carl was a nice guy and very communicative

In a big City Joe’s place makes you feel right at home. Peaceful neighborhood amd cozy home.
If you rent a car , you are able to use car garage for parking. Enjoyed our stay

We had a great time. The place is exactly as advertised. Clear instructions for arrival and check out. Neighborhood is very walkable with lots to do. Our host was very responsive and helpful.  We would stay there again.
Perfect spot for a couple or small family. Great location near shops, restaurants and transit in Bucktown/Logan Square. Clean and well cared for!
Great space for 12 people, loved the multiple bedrooms! Host was incredibly responsive.

This was a great space for my family, exactly as advertised, easy to find, ample parking, and clean. Location worked well for visiting our son in Avondale. The neighborhood is lovely, the sidewalks make for safe walking, and it's well-lit. Close proximity to bus and train lines. Plenty of restaurants and parks nearby.
A great place to stay. The space was clean and felt spacious. Love the nearby park for evening walk.

So glad I chose to stay here! Checking in and navigating the downstairs area was easy thanks to good instructions with photos from Sam. I found street parking right outside on a Friday afternoon with no issue. Both bedroom and bathroom were very clean and tidy. Love the aesthetic (and books, lots of wonderful books!) in the bedroom, and the deep tub in the bathroom was a nice bonus. The coffee/mini fridge/microwave setup was perfect for snacks and small meals. The A/C was cool and running as it should, and if you have stayed in an older Chicago building before, you know how rare this can be! It’s clear the owners have made thoughtful efforts to create a cozy, clean space, and it was so appreciated. I had wonderful stay and would highly recommend to any single people or couples wanting to stay in a quiet, comfortable spot in a quiet but convenient neighborhood (south Rogers Park) in Chicago. Thanks for having me!
The location was perfect no complaints walking distance everything and the host was perfect with communicating and assisting
Decent but pricey stay!
Great stay close to blue line for easy transportation

Exactly as advertised! And, definitely worth the cost for how close to everything it was. Also, the guy at the front desk upgraded us to a bigger room for no extra cost. Wish I knew his name, because he was great!!
Great location and wonderful boutique hotel. Spacious, well equipped kitchen, lovely living space and comfortable bedroom.
Jed was quick to respond, checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. The neighborhood was great, lots of good restaurants, very walkable and safe area.
Great place, Awesome host. Well in line with the highest airbnb standards. Great work Zainab's

Cynthia’s place felt just like home! She was very accommodating and responded very quick to any messages. We liked the neighborhood as well there were small restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance. It was also a great central location and not far from the city. We would definitely stay here again!

The place was beautiful. Backyard was stunning. It was very easy to find because the porch lights and the back lights stay on during night, very easy to get into via the code lock. Very close to the places that we wanted to go to like the Obama Center and family. Good local restaurants nearby. Also owner was very responsive and replied back within the hour, altogether loved our stay and would definitely book with them when coming back.

The property was exactly as described and the location was great to be able to get around the city in any direction with or without a car.
The host was very proactive and timely with all communication and I was especially appreciative to be able to check in early.
In line with the historic Hyde Park neighborhood, it is an older building, however, the space has been tastefully remodeled.
The walls are thin and a few small things could use updating. In addition, the property could use a more thorough cleaning of the ceiling fan and baseboards.
Overall, the property is a great option and I would definitely look to stay again!
TJ was a wonderful host…very accommodating and responsive. The place was absolutely beautiful and in an ideal location! Will definitely be back!

Nice, clean, roomy unit with all of the amenities. Great locations, walkable to several nice restaurants, Wrigleyville, subway stations, etc. Very quiet and peaceful at night and the parking space is a real benefit! The subway ride to the main river district was easy and about 40 minutes long. The airport drive is approximately 30-30 minutes depending on traffic.
Definitely will be coming back on return trips to Chicago!
Great place and great host, easy check in and very hospitable
Good quality, slightly smaller than expected, in a great location.
Great place to stay, will definitely book again !
a great place to stay!

INCREDIBLE place! I can't give it enough praises. Fully stocked everything, incredible vibe, at no point felt like "oh, were in a basement" lol. Easily walkable to the main street nearby with a great couple resturants, and a bus route. Friendly neighborhood!
Place was great. A little bit noisy from the unit above.
great

Appartement très bien situé et décoré. Bien agencé également. Par contre nous aurions aimé avoir été rendu attentif qu'il se situait au 5e étage sans ascenseur. Avec 2 petits enfants et 100kg de bagage, compliqué... de plus il est précisé que nous aurons le code avant 11h30 avant l'arrivée et rien. J'ai du recontacter pour obtenir le formulaire à remplir avant l'envoi du code. Manque de propreté à notre goût.
Great place to stay for a bachelorette!

The photos don't indicate how spacious the apartment is, it's beautiful. anthony was also highly communicative and allowed us flexibility when it came to leaving time (which we very much needed due to a baby shower)

Ag and Krista were so kind and responsive. We loved their place, very cozy. You could hear the upstairs walking at times, but nothing too bothersome.
They were so helpful and flexible in scheduling, it was a perfect place for our trip.

Place was as described and matched the photos. The location was perfect; it's a quieter area with a coffee shop down the street  and a 20 minute walk away from a busy neighborhood with excellent food and drink options. Parth responded quickly to all of my questions as well. This place was just what my friends and I needed for our stay in Chicago!

Wow. This was an amazing space for a big group. The house was actually NICER in person than the photos; we were SO impressed!!! Matt and Pam have though of everything and have included everything you might need or may have forgotten for your trip. The beds were comfortable and there were plenty of towels (things often lacking in airbnbs). Matt gave me some awesome local restaurant recommendations and was soooo helpful every time I had a question!!!
Kelly was an amazing host! Super responsive and helpful. We loved the house and truly enjoyed our stay so so much!
Great location to explore the city from!

Very nice bedroom with attached private bathroom! Large living room with sofas, tv, kitchen, utensils, microwave, etc. Very convenient overall. Close to bus 62 and Orange line. Very good deal overall if you’re here to visit Chicago.

Joes place was very clean and she was a great communicator.  The street out front was loud and very busy.  In 3 days & 2 nights we never found a spot to park out front.  I always had to park a block or better away and cross the street.  The street/ally had a street light that came in the smaller bedroom window.  The shade had several missing blinds and it made me uncomfortable for privacy so I put a plastic bag in there to keep anyone from seeing in.  I did inform her, and I would like to think she will fix that.  She is very responsive. The coffee pot is just a 4 cup which might be fine if you are not a big coffee drinker.  We were.  Not much coffee we brought our own.  I always do as I do understand why hosts don’t keep much coffee in the units.  We did have a problem finding the exact unit the first night as the street was busy and the address was hard to see from the street with the trees. Maybe put the # on the security gate?
Sehr schöne und saubere Wohnung! Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen und kommen gerne wieder.
We enjoyed our stay and felt comfortable.  We only had a 2 night stay but we had everything we needed and the house was very clean.
Cool apartment in pilsen…close to the L and easy walk to restaurants and shop.

Marc's place was perfect for a weekend stay in Pilsen. It's clean, comfortable, and quiet. The neighborhood is so vibrant, amazing Mexican restaurants nearby, 5-10 minute walk to the pink line Damen stop. Never felt the slightest bit unsafe for even a second. I didn't have any trouble finding free parking on Leavitt, which was more convenient than the permit parking on 23rd.
Marc was a great host. I didn't have any problems, but I can tell he's very responsive to messages and the kind of host who would fix any issues on the spot. 10/10, would book again!
Love this place! Stayed there twice in 9 months and will always choose it as long as it’s available. Local breakfast places are walkable and so is the nightlife!
Good!

Doko was an amazing host, and the apartment was great! The hosts were very helpful with our early check-in request. Everything was clean when we arrived, although the bathroom had some bars of soap that looked like they had been used. Other than that, we had a great stay!
Lovely view would stay again!! A little hot but if you open the windows it’s perfect. Bring an extra fan if you like it real cold! They do have a window unit in the closet that may work

Perfect place and so close to Wrigley.  Even if you are not going to a game the location is perfect to get to the lake or anywhere downtown.  Loved the recommendation of parking app; as this made the stay perfect

It says in the listing that the door doesn’t have a lock on it. This isn’t true. The room has a lock, a good size closet, a window ac unit, and a desk. The host also provided towels and bottled water.
Wonderful home! We thoroughly enjoyed the space and convenient location. Would happily return.
We were here for a long weekend and this place was great. Very basic but building is very quiet and close to a lot of great areas in Chicago.
Beautiful home with such detailed decor and amazing taste! Not as close as we thought it would be the the train station but it’s ok it all worked out!

My sister and I had a great stay! Rob was so helpful, responsive and friendly. It’s a beautiful apartment. The area is fun, safe and walkable. The unit does face a busier street and there are a few bars that stay open late but the fan and some ear plugs helped! Thanks Rob! We would definitely recommend and stay again.
Great host and very fast response and kindness
Perfect paradise for our crew of little children! Added bonus was the playground RIGHT across the street.  Hosts were super communicative and responsive.
amazing host. went thr extra maile always

Had a great stay here! The instructions were very straightforward and we didn’t struggle with getting in and out. Just a heads up that the location is on the second floor and you will need to take stairs to get to it. It’ll be hard for people who physically can’t take stairs. Another thing is that this place is close to the busy road so it can get loud at night sometimes. Parking is great though, we were able to park our SUV and Van on this location.
We have now stayed in two of Darsh's units in the same building. The location is amazing and is walkable to restaurants and to downtown as well. It is the perfect space for 2 couples to share.

This apartment was not cleaned prior to me coming there. There were stains in the bathroom that looked like blood on the cabinets. There was animal poop on the back porch. The neighbors threw a party and the noise was very loud. The bed was uncomfortable and I would not stay here again. It’s priced too high for what I had to deal with.
Beautiful space! Very clean! Great location! Adrain was responsive and made sure we had everything we needed!

This was the perfect place to stay with a couple friends the night before my wedding! I am local to Chicago, so it was really fun to explore the neighborhood and a different space! It was the perfect place to get ready for my wedding, too! So much light and space!

We spent a month at Brett’s place in Andersonville. It was clean, comfortable, and in a friendly neighborhood location. Lots of great restaurants in walking distance and convenient to Lake Shore Drive and the beach. We would definitely return!!
Great place
Great hosts! Were easy to communicate and work with, space was perfect for a group of 7-8
Nice hidden gem lots of local places around that were fantastic.  favorites was Chip Inn and Standing passenger coffee.

I stayed at Christine’s place for a week,  so I could watch my grandson play for the Chicago White Sox. Rate Field was very easy to get to from her place. The place was quiet and has a beautiful park across the street which I walked and sat in daily. Christine was great at giving me a list of city attractions to visit, which I did on the day the Sox did not play. The only downside for me was that it was on the 3rd floor with no elevator and I am a senior citizen. But other than that it was a great visit.
Great stay!!! Beautiful home, great location

We booked this property because it looked perfect for our family, and for the price, we expected a luxury experience. Unfortunately, it wasn’t.
The biggest issue was that an unsecured dresser panel fell directly onto my foot. It honestly shook me because all I could think was, “What if my toddler had been standing there instead?”
There were also multiple maintenance issues, including an unstable dining table, a broken balcony chair, a bed that appeared to be assembled incorrectly, stained and musty-smelling towels, and other deferred maintenance. Overall, the unit felt worn and far below what we’d expect for a property at this price point.
The elevators were out of service much of our stay, and the pool—one of the reasons we booked this property with a toddler—was drained and unavailable.
The view is beautiful, but the El runs all day and night. If you’re traveling with young children or are a light sleeper, I’d think twice. This place just felt really cheap and uncared for.
Melissa is a fantastic, responsive host whose hospitality was the cherry on top of our Chicago trip.

I felt like a local! Beautiful apartment in a quaint, quiet neighborhood near cafes and restaurants and public transportation.  Well-maintained apartment with no detailed spared. There were lights everywhere to greet us as we made our way in late at night. Cody was responsive and friendly.  Very pleasant experience, highly recommend.

Perfect for what I needed. Just caution with parking. I arrived at 6pm and there was no street parking available. I ended up having to park 2 blocks away and got a $250 ticket. If you have a car you need to arrive early to secure a spot or figure something out before you come. It was very challenging to park my Dodge Ram 1500 nearby the place. Besides that the place served my needs well. Thank you!
