emily’s place was perfect for our weekend away with kids! the house was warm & welcoming & was one of the most well stocked airbnbs i’ve ever stayed in. emily was extremely helpful & even offered was able to provide some extra baby essentials. this house is very kid friendly with toys/books/puzzles, a fenced in yard and more.

The place was perfect for a tournament weekend. The place had everything we needed, from towels to extra chairs to being with to the games. Once we figured out parking, it was easy. Appliances and bathrooms were great
Great spot, super walkable!
Lovely place to stay, we felt right at home! Very comfortable and clean. Plus the chickens were adorable! Perfect for any trip to Chicago!

I booked Tiffany's place for the weekend to celebrate My niece's 23rd birthday in the city. There were 5 of us and there was plenty of room for everyone to be comfortable. The house is actually pretty massive with 3 full bathrooms. Tiffany was suppertive and helpful through the entire stay providing check-in details, very clear instruction on how to access the property, and even providing restaurant and attraction suggestions. The house was super clean and felt like home. The neighborhood was quiet and had that true feel. The price for the amount of house ypu get was an absolute value compared to a lot of other similarly sized rentals. Overall, I enjoyed the stay and would absolutely, stay in Tiffany's home again in the future.

We had an amazing stay and couldn't have asked for a better place for our Chicago trip! The home was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, spacious, and very well maintained. It had everything we needed, and the neighborhood was quiet while still being conveniently located for getting around the city.
The host was friendly, responsive, and made the entire check-in and check-out process smooth and stress-free. We especially appreciated how welcoming and organized everything was when we arrived.
Our group of six had a wonderful time, and the house truly felt like a home away from home. We would absolutely stay here again on a future trip to Chicago and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable place to stay.
Thank you for your wonderful hospitality and for helping make our trip so memorable!

The property is a charming, more historic type of home, so the floors can be a bit squeaky, but it wasn't too bad. We also really enjoyed the nice backyard and having a garage.
It did take some time to figure out the check-in situation because one lock wasn't set up correctly. However, the host was very responsive, though it seems they might need a bit more coordination with their actual property management team. Still a nice experience!
Nikka was a great host.  She gave great instructions for finding and accessing the unit.  She also gave recommendations for restaurants in the area.  I would recommend this unit to others.
David was very responsive and welcoming! The place was exactly like the listing and it is in great location to downtown Chicago.

We loved our stay! The place was perfect for a girls trip. Great location, super clean, and had everything we need. The hosts are great and very accommodating. Would definitely stay here again next time we’re in Chicago.
Great stay at Laura’s place.  Perfect location. Awesome to have a parking spot.   Close to the subway.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The location was convenient, and the host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in and check-out very easy. We really appreciated the thoughtful touches throughout the home, which made our stay even more enjoyable. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area and would happily stay here again!
Great stay. Beautiful place. Very responsive host. She was able to come over and assist me with an issue in 5 minutes.

Thank you Kate!!  For Christmas my kids got me tickets to the Ed Sheeran concert for the whole family, so I have been eagerly looking forward to this trip since then.  The concert was phenomenal, but the icing on the cake is having perfect accommodations while we were in town!  Kate is truly a Superhost and our stay in Chicago was the best we've ever had!!  Everything is exactly as you read in the listing.  We we lucky to have the parking space directly in front of the building (parking passes exactly as offered), entry was easy and secure, the living space was impeccable and artistically decorated, the neighborhood was quiet and safe, anything you need/want was walkable (including the lake), and travel to downtown was easy having a Red Line station so close.  We couldn't have asked for anything else and had the BEST family time imaginable!  "I will hold on to the Afterglow!"  THANK YOU KATE!!

Safe, good location, clean. Small touches like the unevenness of the flooring, and finishing of baseboards left a bit to be desired for 700 a night. Might be standard for older buildings. Host was great.
Greta place great location plenty of room great view of the city it can get a little hot but other than that this is a beautiful place to stay and definitely would recommend to others
Great location in Andersonville. Cute home that matches the neighborhood “vibe.”
Cyrus was attentive and answered our questions in a timely manner. House is within walking distance to White Sox park which was great.
Great spot in Wicker Park, easy access to the train, great for a group! Tom was a great host, we would definitely stay here again.
Great spot in Avondale and well appointed! Laura was very accommodating to our request related to check out and available whenever we reached out with questions. Thank you!

Stay was ok. Flew in from Atlanta and I can confidently say that this location was ghetto. The inside of the house was warm so if you struggle to sleep in warm houses, good luck. We figured out that if you run the fans the entire time of your stay, it will help cool it down slightly. Another thing that I wasn’t expecting was how the house was very stuffy like a dog/cat had been inside the house. My buddy has bad allergies for them so he was struggling to breathe and sleep well at night our entire stay. The main convenience was it was next to the train station but the walk to and from there was not the safest, especially at night. House was clean for a hostile vibe stay is the only upside.
the neighborhood was very quiet and provided a great alternative to staying in a hotel. very clean.

Tuve una muy buena experiencia durante mi estancia. La habitación estaba limpia, el baño privado fue un gran plus y todo coincidía con la descripción del anuncio.
Sin duda volvería a hospedarme aquí y lo recomendaría a quienes busquen un lugar limpio, bien ubicado y con una buena relación calidad-precio.
Theodora was a great host! Very responsive and helpful. Thank you so much!
Great place! Easy to access, really good location,  comfortable bed. Excellent for an overnight stay - street parking was easy and convenient. Highly recommend!

The photos in the ad do not match what you walk into. The photos appear as if there’s two bedrooms, but it is clearly one bedroom with a pullout couch that is extremely old and uncomfortable. My son had to purchase a blowup mattress to put on the floor because the couch was so small and the mattress on it was so thin there was not enough blankets or pillows for multiple people. The shower wash was empty and there was only two washcloths for three people for five days. The main bedroom bed is also uncomfortable. It slides to the middle and needs to be replaced. I would say that the Kitchen area was very cute and clean, and he offered all of the amenities that you would want although we didn’t use anything. There’s a strong smell or odor in the garage where you park a rental car very strong garbage smell a bar across the street with lots of screaming and yelling late into the evening.
Loved the stay, would do it again next time we visit this city.
Wonderful and convenient!!!’
very nice hospitality

My girlfriend and I stayed here for a weekend getaway to Chicago.  This a really well-kept and inviting space to stay!  Michael was very helpful and communicative, and he helped us carry bags when we were checking in!
Had a great time! Would definitely stay again!
It was a great stay!! Would definitely book again.

The ModernFarmHouse was very good to us during our trip to Chicago. The home is so cute spacious, clean and comfortable especially the beds!! Its close the city but there is also lots to do in  the neighborhood of Hyde park. Naomi was kind and responsive. We really felt at home here, I would definitely book again !
Great stay and location. Excellent and responsive host. Will visit again thanks Leo!

Patrica was an excellent host - communication was always cheerful and quick - and her place perfectly accommodated my stay! The location was excellent, making it easy to walk many places and or catch the red line to those a bit further away. The apartment is a small studio best suited for 1-2 travelers looking for a comfy place to crash after a long day of enjoy all Chicago has to offer!!
Please note: the apartment is in an old building right next to a train line so it might not be suitable for light sleepers. If you are a heavy sleeper, or you can make do with earplugs, then it should be fine!

Overall, the stay was good; the place was clean and had easy access to the bus—about 25 minutes from Millennium Park, though only a 10-minute drive. The apartment, located on the 17th floor, has everything needed for a comfortable stay. There aren't many shops nearby, so I’d recommend buying anything you need before arriving. Adresa was very kind and always attentive to our needs.🫰
This is one of the cleanest airbnbs I’ve stayed in. Adam was great and incredibly accommodating, extremely responsive and a wonderful host. Thank you!

Absolutely amazing experience staying here. We had a group of 6 and everyone gave it a 10/10.
The view from the patio is as good as it gets.
Able to see the city + Lake Michigan is unreal.
Hosts were amazing and always responded very fast if we needed anything. If I come back to Chicago this will be the first place I’d look to stay at again

As a first time airbnb user this couldn't have been more perfect! Darius was the sweetest man very helpful with everything. We had ordered pizza and our food got stolen.. literally within minutes Darius came to our door with two pizzas. The place was beautiful and cold (which is exactly what i wanted!!) If i come back to chicago i would absolutely come back to this air bnb genuinely perfect:3

deverdad lamentablemente dar esta evaluación pero es necesario toda la propiedad necesita limpieza y reparaciones tenia un olor a mariguana a umedad no tiene ni tapetes los baños las colchas sucias necesita muchas reparaciones pisos que necesita poner loseta que falta  cojines rotos  viejos  nada que vervon las fotos y tengo fotos de  todo  no es exageración.
Convenient

Overall the place was great! Clean, in a cute neighborhood with lots to do and short walk to public transit. Matthew was easy to get ahold of, and when problems out of his control (loss of power) arose he immediately made us aware of what was going on and when we could expect it to be back. Street parking was painless and easy.
Super cozy place that’s easily walkable to the businesses on Clark or the Red line. Would stay here again.
Great house full of character!

Absolutely loved the stay. The hosts were very kind to recommend local restaurants and helped immediately when I asked for information or insight. Although the apartment is in an up and coming neighborhood, it is conveniently close to public transport, close to the heart of the city, and has a large Target store within walking distance for any odds and ends you might need. Very impressed and I hope to stay again!
We had a great weekend stay at Heather’s! Perfect location, very spacious and clean.

I highly recommend Angela’s place if you are visiting Chicago. It is only a few blocks from the Red Line Train and Interstate 94/90. We have stayed in numerous Airbnb homes and this was one of the nicest. Exceptionally clean, lovely decor, comfortable beds, large kitchen, and big screen TV. We would stay here again!
nice place
This was a lovely place to stay during our time in Chicago. We especially loved the neighborhood and appreciated the ease of communication with our host.

Jorge was a very great host! Very responsive and very friendly. The apartment was very clean and included an AC. The only downside was the parking. There is no parking at this complex aside from street parking which was at times hard to come by.
Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood around downtown. If you’re looking for a place to stay only for a few nights, this is it.

Selena was an amazing host and we loved the Airbnb! I was celebrating my birthday in Chicago and she took the time to write happy birthday on whiteboard for me to see when I walked in. The beds were very comfortable, the place was in a great location, and it was the cutest little gem of place. 10/10!!
Great place, very spacious and clean. Good area and responsive host
Loved this place and would stay again! It was extremely clean and we felt extremely safe.

I would recommend Yolie’s place. She was proactive in giving us check in instructions and local restaurant recommendations. The place was very clean and exactly as described. The king bed was memory foam and moderate to firm firmness, and very comfortable. The location allows for walking, taking public transit, or Ubering for a reasonable price to downtown. There is also an Uber Eats pick up spot with like 20 restaurants across the street. It was perfect for a quick bite while working from the house. The desk with fast Internet and the washing machine are nice touches. The last day of our stay we got a car to take out of the city. I was worried it would be hard to find parking, but that was not the case. We got a spot overnight right in front of the house. I’d definitely stay again.
The beds are super comfortable, and the best part of the stay is the most important imo. They are a few things that need improvement, but its a good house.

Brian's house was just as pictured clean, spacious, and comfortable for all five of us. We had an early flight, and Brian was kind enough to let us check in early, which we really appreciated. We also had a minor issue with one of the toilets, and Brian responded quickly and fixed it right away.
One thing future guests should be aware of is that the basement is also rented out separately. Because of this, noise carries, and we were asked to keep our conversations and laughter down after the basement guest complained. Once Brian reached out, we moved our conversation upstairs without any issue. It was a little disappointing not being able to fully use the living room later in the evening, so it's something to keep in mind if you're traveling with a group and plan to socialize at night.
Overall, we had a great stay. The home was exactly what we expected, and Brian was a responsive and accommodating

This was the great home base for a long weekend in Chicago. We'd absolutely stay in the Gold Coast again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a mix of convenience, charm, and a true Chicago experience.

Mark's place was perfect. I had my family come in for my wedding and this was the first place we saw when we were trying to book a place close to mine. We are so lucky that the first place we chose worked out so well for us. The place was very well maintained, had easy access to other areas we wanted to go to and Mark himself was very good with his communication. Only point of sadness for me was I couldn't write recommendations for the next guest in the book. :)
Beautiful place!

Great place to stay near downtown Chicago without being in the city itself. It was a good fit for our family trip and we loved having our own rooms and bathrooms. The space was very unique and felt spacious.
Nathaniel’s  place was great! Tons of natural lighting, a private rooftop patio, and easy location. Would recommend to anyone!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 Stars!
Our stay at Carter Blue Airbnb was absolutely amazing! From the moment we walked through the door, we could tell the home was well cared for and exceptionally clean. The decor was beautiful, modern, and welcoming, making us feel right at home.
Every area of the house—from the living spaces to the bedrooms and bathrooms—was spotless. The attention to detail did not go unnoticed. We especially appreciated the thoughtful touches, such as the complimentary coffee and bottled water, which made us feel like valued guests.
One of our favorite parts of the property was the patio! It was beautifully designed, comfortable, and the perfect place to relax and spend time together. It truly elevated our entire experience.
The host clearly takes pride in providing an outstanding guest experience, and it shows in every aspect of the home. If you’re looking for a clean, beautiful, comfortable place to stay with excellent hospitality, I highly recommend Carter Blue Airbnb. I would def
Good deal for the price

Our stay at The Muse in Chicago was absolutely incredible!
First, a huge thank you to our host, Sheldon. From the moment we booked until checkout, he was attentive, professional, and proactive. Before we even had questions, he was already checking in to make sure everything was going smoothly. The check-in process was seamless, and his communication made us feel so welcomed throughout our stay.
Now let’s talk about the space… WOW. Every room was thoughtfully designed, stylish, and full of personality. I kept saying, “I wish whoever designed this place could decorate my home!” It was such a beautiful and unique experience.
If you’re planning a trip to Chicago—whether it’s a girls’ getaway, a couples’ trip, or a weekend in the city—I highly recommend staying here.
The only thing to keep in mind is that the bedrooms are all upstairs, and there are quite a few stairs. If mobility is a concern, this may not be the best fit. But otherwise, this place is a gem.
Thank you again, Sheldon,

We had a wonderful stay at Solomon‘s home.  We could not have asked for a better location. It worked out perfectly for us.  The house is very nice very clean and had absolutely everything we possibly could have needed.  The beds were very comfortable.  Two lovely bedrooms and two full bathrooms on the second floor with all the amenities.  It was perfect.  I wish we had more time at the house so we could’ve sat outside and enjoyed the porch.  We did not have a problem finding street parking   Such a quiet neighborhood, walking distance to everything.    We definitely will stay again.!!

Great location in Lincoln Park.  Very busy area if you like city life. Come without a car if you can as there is absolutely no parking anywhere near the property. The property itself was very nice and comfortable. Would book again.
Extremely supportive. Amazing area and even a better home + host

Grace and Joe were incredibly responsive and friendly. The location was steps away from the L train which was so convenient. The area seemed very safe and the house was very clean. The upstairs bathroom only had a tub which would be perfect for small kids. The addition of the A/C unit upstairs kept the rooms very comfortable.

We had an amazing stay at Jay’s home! The location was great, a 10 min walk from the blue line and in a very nice, green neighborhood. The unit itself was clean and had some staple groceries and snacks waiting for us. Jay was very accommodating and quick to respond. Check-in/out was seamless and we definitely plan on staying here again next time we visit :)
Place amazing!! and incredible location. Also, the communication with Brad was very smooth. Thanks so much!

Tariq was incredibly responsive and the location is great! Lots of restaurants and easy access to the Red line. Make sure to bring an eye mask and ear plugs to sleep though. Tariq says he is going to get curtains, but if you are booked soon I would recommend bringing an eye mask just in case.

This is our second stay at this property and we will continue to re-book. It is located on a nice residential street within walking distance to Wrigleyville, Southport, and many nice restaurants & shops. The property is 2 floors and has new appliances & amenities. It is spacious, clean, & well-stocked with towels. The upper outside deck is particularly nice. We always enjoy staying here & the host, Kimberly,  is nice & responsive.

Janet’s place was exactly what my group needed while in Chicago! Her binder filled with house rules/local tour recommendations was extremely helpful. Celebrated my 30th birthday here and appreciated the complementary bottle of champagne!! Would easily stay here again while in Chicago

This Airbnb is in an excellent location with a lot to do in the surrounding area. Getting downtown is not too bad with a 10 minute walk to the metro and a few stops.
One thing to note that we did not notice - the main couch and TV are in the one bedroom which is located in the basement. This was a little bit of a bummer for us since we have little ones that got to bed early leaving the adults with only the dining room as a place to hang out. Something to keep in mind.
Great location super easy to walk everywhere-
Great neighborhood stay! Felt right at home!

Host was very responsive and instructions were easy to follow. Very easy check in and check out!
Plenty of space for 6 people and great, quiet location in the city, peaceful but so close to a lot! Although having a designated parking spot behind the building, there was lots of street parking in front of the building as well. I would definitely recommend staying here if staying in Lincoln Park!
Comfortable place for 8 people. A quick drive to many bars and restaurants. The garage in the back was very nice!
This house had a great location. It was very large. We had a great time

I canceled my stay shortly after arriving because I did not feel comfortable with the condition of the property.
The biggest issue was the bed. I always check mattresses when I travel, and this was by far the dirtiest mattress I’ve ever seen. After pulling back the mattress protector, I found numerous large stains that made it appear extremely unsanitary and in need of replacement. In my opinion, it should have been replaced rather than covered. A mattress protector does not fix a heavily stained mattress or provide comfort. The setup was also just a box spring and mattress placed directly on the floor with no bed frame, which did not meet my expectations.
The hosts were kind and communicative, allowed immediate checkout, and issued a full refund, which I appreciated. While the hosts were professional, I personally could not stay due to cleanliness concerns. I would recommend the hosts, but not this particular property until the mattress is replaced and bed is removed from floor.
great place.

My friends and I are here for a concert and needed a place to stay for a couple nights! The place is very clean and well maintained! The set up was very cozy and we felt right at home! The host Sarah lived on the main floor and we lived on the second floor, she was very friendly and welcoming when I greeted her from the balcony. I would recommend this place!
Great hosts ! Very welcoming friendly and accommodating. Place was a great location.

We had a fantastic 3 night stay. The location is fantastic and lots to do and see within walking distance. The unit itself was well appointed with a very comfy bed.  The instructions received to check were very detailed and easy to follow. We loved walking to Oak St beach to take in the beautiful views of the city. Highly recommend this unit and will definitely visit it again!
Beautiful condo right in the heart of Wicker Park. The private rooftop deck with gorgeous views of the Chicago skyline was fabulous. We will be back again!
We loved every second!!

Convenient location near the blue line. Has two nearby streets with plenty of food, bar, shopping, and necessities options. Five minute walk to blue line. Cute, safe, quiet neighborhood. Unit itself has a full kitchen, good wifi, and a nice shower.
Conveniently located between Oak Park and the city and decorated very nicely! Parking was not an issue
It was great

It was a very nice place to stay.
Subway is pretty near.
Great spot! Edwin let my fiance and I leave a little later than the initial check-out time and leave our bags on the property until our flight as well.

We had a great stay in this pristine apartment. All of our needs were met and our host went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Jamisyn answered our queries very quickly and made sure we were enjoying ourselves and enjoying the apartment during our stay.
We had a great stay! Carly was very responsive and helpful. Her place was in the perfect location to walk to everything we needed. Would recommend!

Mings place was exactly how it looked in the photos. Clean and felt right at home. The neighborhood was great and it was easy to get into the city. Ming was very responsive and made sure I had everything I needed for my stay. I will definitely be staying again when I’m back in Chicago.

Wonderful stay in Chicago! My husband, 3 month old, mom, and I were in town for a family wedding. We were very comfortable and loved the walkable neighborhood. The space was very easy to find and had everything we needed. Laura checked in plenty and made it easy and enjoyable for us.
Amazing place for a vacation spacious, nice area, and good communication from host

Von’s place was absolutely amazing. It was easy to check in. Everything was clean. The place looked exactly like the pictures that were posted. The surrounding areas were pretty decent. Be aware of a lot of cop cars if certain situations go down it can be pretty loud but other than that, the overall stay was amazing and everything worked as it should.

The place was very basic, as advertised. I'm fine with that but the bathroom had black mold in it and seriously needs a little TLC. I'll still give it 4 stars because Anthony is easy to work with, accommodating with details, and, as they say, location, location, location!  Great location to the blue line, Aldis,  CVS. and the rooster next door does start crowing by 4am, but he didn't bother me. I knew in advance and brought ear plugs and I play white noise on my phone.

The hosts were great and very responsive. The neighborhood was okay, not the safest (our car did get broken into one night) but we didn’t ever really feel unsafe either. The condo is a little rundown. The leather covering on the couch was peeling and stuck to absolutely everything. The patio was dirty, the outside of the condo was just kind of grimy, trash routinely washed from the park next door into the yard, and the mosquitoes were SUCH a problem. The washer and dryer had missing handles and were cracked, and the dryer when we arrived was so full of lint that it wouldn’t dry. They did come and clean it as best they could. The toaster oven tripped the plug every time you turned it on. The place is also cluttered, and the living room especially didn’t have great light. I expected the place to be in better condition for the price. But it was overall pretty clean and fairly quiet and the hosts were friendly and replied quickly.
Good value for the price, we wanted to go to the field museum and United center, the location made it very easy to get to both. Private bathroom was very nice to have.

We had a great time staying here. They had everything we needed. The parking spot was amazing 👏, as we learned parking in Chicago is crazy. If we ever decide to come visit Chicago again we will definitely be looking up Sharlyn again!!
Beautiful space to stay and close to public transportation! Highly recommend!

Located in a quiet neighborhood with some stores, restaurants, and cafes within walking distance. The space is really nice with all of the described amenities. We found street parking right in front of the place. Easy check in and check out process.

La estancia en casa de Al y Jude fue un plus para nuestro viaje. Fueron muy amables y respetuosos, nos dieron recomendaciones increíbles y nos proporcionaron todo tipo de comodidades. Alojarte con ellos es absolutamente recomendable! Gracias por todo Al y Jude!
Very responsive and accommodating host!
good place to stay in Bridgeport for the money. close to Sox Park and public transportation. house was very clean and bed was comfortable. clear and easy communication with host.

The listing accurate reflects the property. This is a good stay if you’re looking for a place to crash and don’t mind simple amenities and IKEA furniture. Justin is a responsive host.
That said, a couple of things. First, the place could use some repairs. The shower caddy was loose and appeared close to coming off the wall, a bedroom tile came off the floor, and the AC cycled on and off unpredictably with no apparent way of controlling it.
Second, the guest policy could be clearer. I received a message right before check-in that NO unauthorized guests were allowed. Since I had friends stopping by before we went to the lake, I asked for clarification and learned this referred only to overnight guests.
Overall, I’d recommend this place for short stays (3 days max) and for travelers packing light. It’s best to have as a base to explore the city rather than one to spend a lot of time in.
Rashad’s place was so cute and cozy! It was close to everything. He was very friendly and responsive. I would definitely book again.
Great location and the are is very walkable to restaurants, bars and things to do! I’ll definitely stay again in the future!

Great place, good balance of peace and proximity to downtown with a lovely walk. The unit is spacious and clean, comfortable for everything I needed during my stay. The building is quite cozy and safe, really letting me rest and enjoy my time in Chicago. Overall, great place for anything you might need when visiting Chicago, perfect location, caring host, unit in great condition! Thank you!

Great value stay for a large family! James was a fantastic host, quick to respond and easy to work with. The location near the city worked well for our group, and the house had plenty of room for everyone.
A few honest notes for future guests: the kitchen could use more cooking tools and basic amenities, given the place's size. The house also felt a bit unfinished in spots, though you can tell it has a lot of potential.
Overall we appreciated the space and the price, and James made sure we were taken care of. Thanks for hosting us!
The unit was great, one of the better places i’ve stayed at. Parking situation is perfect for multiple cars. Definitely worth the stay.
Great place, just too much noise in the middle of night but overall great!
Great location close to the train
Quen’s place is beautiful and well-decorated. The only issues we had were not having hot water and the communication about the drain not draining the water properly in the tub.
We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is clean, renovated, cozy, and located in a nice neighborhood with easy access to restaurants, bars, and shopping. I highly recommend!
very nice home in a middle of a nice neighborhood and not far from urban chicago

Super easy to get inside, I always love going to the Chinatown food and shops so it was so nice to walk out of your door and be right there. We also walked to the field museum and it was a BEAUTIFUL 35minutes. Full kitchen, decent bedrooms. Fun to watch the trains go by! Will be saving this spot for our future Chicago trips!

Had a wonderful stay. No problem finding parking right out front regardless of time of day. House is well appointed and very clean and modern. Worked out great for my family to be able to spend time together, with plenty of space for 5 adults.
We enjoyed our stay, good value, comfortable accommodations. Helpful and responsive host !
Karyn & Asif make you feel at home !
Incredible stay! Highly recommend

This stay was good, the hosts responded very quickly and were very nice. I could tell they made an effort when looking at past complaints, the remote for the tv was there and stocked with plenty of toilet paper! Unfortunately there were a few things that we could not overlook. Such as one of the main mirrors being broken completely across it, the bedroom door not shutting or locking, the bedroom main light was not working( lamps were provided and worked well), the shower curtain needed to be replaced and was brown on the lower half (the rest was white), as well as the bedroom frame was broken. When we looked closer it looked to be bent/put together wrong. Overall this stay was nice, and the hosts responded very were very nice as well, it just needs major maintenance. We did enjoy our stay very much but there were things we just could not overlook.

Great location, spacious rooms and updated appliances and bathrooms. Our only negative is that the street noise could be loud at times, however I would recommend this spot and would stay there again in the future.
Very clean. Yes a little noisy because of upstairs tenants but didn’t bother me (may bother others). Would stay here again

Thomas's home was perfect for our needs. We had a group of seven and had no issues in terms of space. The two parking spots were super convenient, and anytime we needed anything, Thomas responded almost immediately. Not a big deal for us but just a heads up that there's an island in the kitchen but no kitchen/dining table. Everything was exactly as described and expected and we'll 100% be staying here again!
Everything was great. The accommodation was clean and comfortable, and it was only about 40 minutes from downtown Chicago. I had a pleasant stay and would recommend it :)
good location. easy instructions. the unit is fine for short stays but could use some finishing touches and a deep clean. it's also missing smoke detectors.
I loved staying there, near the blue train we got everywhere quickly. The place is nice, tidy and clean. Jane and Francisco were excellent hosts.

We enjoyed our stay at your property.
The home was beautiful and exactly as advertised.
The lower level contained a foosball table which the children thoroughly enjoyed. Adults too! The beds were very comfortable and loved the number of restrooms. (all ladies) We were in Chicago for a dance convention and competition for a full week. Convenient to and from venue.
Can’t say enough about this property.
I would certainly recommend this property to anyone.

Our family met here to spend time together. It was perfect and allowed us to watch baseball, play games and enjoy precious time together. It was very comfortable and plenty of
space. I will definitely stay here again.

Generally, it’s fair for its price and location which was vey conveninent - 5 min walk to a bus stop and then 10-15 mins to the Downtown. The area felt safe unlike other parts in Chicago, tho the streets were really dirty (not in capabilites of the host).
One thing to mention is that our room was covered in dust which was a critical part for me since I have severe dust allergies and the night table was greasy and not clean at all. The worse part was that after check in I spotted two mice running off from the kitchen floor which didn’t give the best image of the general cleanliness of the whole apartment.
On the other hand, the host tried to be on spot and help us.
Great location. Walkable to many restaurants and things to do. Appreciated the items  provided by the host!

Decor was nice, beds in rooms were comfortable. Pull out bed has gross stains, and no linens for it. Very, very noisy neighbors, sounded like they were moving furniture late, and early in the morning. Internet went out, when I told the host, I got no response. No directions on where to put trash, no visible dumpster to put in. No dish soap, only one roll of toilet paper for 5 people.
Jaime was very kind and responsive. The house was beautiful.
Everything was perfect the location it was peaceful. I enjoyed everything about this place

Was the perfect place to stay at for the all the plans I had for the weekend!! Pilsen will always have a special place in my heart and so will this beautiful cozy spot. Every time I got back from where my plans were it honestly did feel like home. Adriane and Coty were super nice and helpful! Definitely will be back if I have the chance!

Innesa was a wonderful host. She was very accommodating, responsive and kind. The location was great, with an awesome city view, an easy walk to our concert, and great restaurants nearby. Overall, a very smooth and positive stay.

Excelente estadía. Jed estaba super pendiente, muy amable y amigable.
Contaba con todo lo necesario y siempre habia café para el desayuno.
Departamento muy cómodo para 4 y hasta 5 o 6 personas tal vez. Tiene 2 dormitorios y 3 sillones disponibles a parte.
La zona es nuy bonita.
Es un barrio lindo muy seguro y limpio.
This place is amazing!!! Super cozy and has all of the amenities needed for a cute stay. Love the ice machine. I will be back. Super spacious too.
very nice air bnb & perfect location

We booked the place while travelling with 2 infants, we did not feel the place was up to our expecations and price we paid. There was smoking smell in closets and various corners of the place. A lot of things are operating as a hack, air conditioning doesnt work as expected and needed constant adjustments to the window joint.
Très beau séjour au Freehand hôtel!! Vraiment bien situé.

Great stay! The location was perfect for the conference we were attending and was also convenient to all the downtown spots on our agenda. The home looked exactly as pictured, was clean, and met our expectations. We would definitely stay here again.

Nicholas was very responsive prior to our stay which was great. The apartment was clean and it had everything we needed for the stay. All in all it was a nice stay and I would definitely recommend staying here.
We loved our stay at Ken’s place! Great location, very fun art and decor, stocked fridge, skyline view from the back deck! It was the perfect getaway for a girls weekend.
The location is unbeatable and the space is as described in the listing. Alma was responsive and the instructions were clear. We had a great time in this space!

Jamie is a pro.  She was completely on top of our trip as soon as we booked it.  The home & neighhood was very safe.  we walked at night to an Irish pub 3 or 4 blocks away.  Parking was a concern but we had no issues finding spots new by (and I drive a gmc sierra full size pick up truck).  Jamie was gracious and thoughtful in every way.  She gave us the quick tour and was ready to help yet at a very respectful distance.  Her consideration and preparations shined through.  I could go on but instead I will say this was a terrific place to stay and you should book it:-)

Kate’s place was exactly as described! It was a fun and clean place to hang out. We had a bachelor trip in Chicago and found ourselves saying we could spend the whole time at the place and have a blast. Highly recommend. Kate was also super friendly and accommodating!

This is a very roomy place with enough parking for 3 cars in the back near downtown Chicago.  We had a group of 13 and that was about right.  The location is great, near down town and Oak Park.  The hosts were very responsive when we needed more chairs and new lightbulbs.  They had 8 folding chairs delivered and that made a huge difference.  The fire pit was a great place to hang out in the evening and we loved how the lights would come on at dark.  I would recommend this place but be aware that the additional parking is street parking at least a block away.

We really enjoyed our stay at Rob’s place! He was incredibly communicative and helpful as our host! The home was so clean; the appliances and furnishings are all new and high quality. The primary shower is heavenly. All the beds are super comfortable. Our group also loved the outdoor space. If you’re a light sleeper like me, I’d recommend just bringing ear plugs because you can hear the upstairs neighbors walking around, but the ear plugs did the trick! The location was also walkable to lots of restaurants and coffee shops! We’d definitely recommend this Airbnb.
Very nice place, roomy, well appointed kitchen.

Just returned from a Chicago vacation and had an amazing stay at Jason’s Catfish Flat. My kids enjoyed having their own rooms, and the apartment had absolutely everything we needed. The location was great - just a short walk to the Brown Line and plenty of restaurants around. Jason was so communicative, and checkout was super easy. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!

Josh’s place was great!  It had everything we needed and more.  Beds were comfortable and the location was outstanding.  Very walkable to great restaurants and public transportation.  Josh was very responsive and helpful for anything we needed.  I’d definitely rent from Josh again.
Great location and everything about this place! Had such a great time! Highly recommend!

As advertised. We liked the lovely little outdoor balcony, sunny sun room facing street, comfy beds, 2 living rooms, well equipped kitchen. Quirks included the long narrow layout (but could be a plus if subsets of the group want orivacy) and smallish kitchen (kitchen table seats 4; no other tables). We had a glitch at checkin -- never received special instructions about lock box located 1 block away (and had trouble figuring out how to open lock box), but host was responsive. We would stay here again.

Apartment was clean and comfortable for our group of 5. Seating was limited for dining and relaxing for parties over 4. Great neighborhood for shopping, dining and sightseeing; walkable for many attractions. Rasheed was VERY responsive and helpful. Typical city noises. Beds were comfortable, plenty of clean towels/linens.

Kitty's place was perfect for 2 nights with a friend. It was quaint, quiet and had everything we needed. Kitty communicated quickly and with great suggestions before and during our stay. I would recommend booking her place.
Great place, and kind hosts!

Nice, cozy stay. Myrtle was flexible when my check-in had to adjust because of my delayed flight. There’s 2 key bus stops within <5 min walking which is helpful. One will get you to the brown line in a few minutes. Lyft bike rack is also about a 5 min walk away.
Great location and nice place
Great place, even better host. Would love to stay again!

Great apartment with good facilities and great value for money. We found the bed very comfortable.
Good location, not far from downtown. Fortino is a lovely host with great communication and answered all questions we had. We would definitely stay here again.

Pros: Location is near a lot of tourist attractions and food. Amenities are nice. Rooftop has a nice view (the room not so much). Host is responsive.
Con’s: Place was smaller than expected, I wasn’t able to use the tv since there wasn’t any cable and Netflix wasn’t working. You also have to pay for parking.
In my opinion for the price, I would rather go to a hotel.
Great place in a safe area. We really enjoyed everything and we’d definitely stay again!

Everything was nice! I felt that I was in a safe and clean environment. It wasn’t too far from downtown, which was perfect. Overall 10/10! I would highly recommend anyone visiting Chicago to book with Max!

I felt like I was visiting granny’s house in the most endearing ways. The porches were a huge added bonus. If I grilled, it would have been even better. I love Woodlawn as an extensive walker. We were really close to restaurants on UChicago’s campus and nearby with loads of food and grocery delivery services. Public transport is available via CTA buses, Metra, Green, and Red Line trains.
Great apartment in an awesome neighborhood. Christina was very communicative and a great host!

Dave is a polite and understanding host. This is a unique, historic home. The neighborhood of Pilsen is beautiful and lively with excellent Mexican food. This place is surrounded with e-scooters and a short walk to the pink line.
Wow! What a wonderful listing & marvelous host. Beautiful space lovely part on NW side of the fabulous city
Place was small but well organized and great for a couple or solo traveler.

Good location- very accessible. The place is basic but it actually is nicely/thoughtfully furnished and answers all the necessary needs of the travelers.
Very close to good restaurants and pubs . Thank you!

We really enjoyed our stay at Ryan’s. It was one of the cleanest Airbnbs we’ve ever stayed in, and everything was cleaned daily. Our bedroom was spacious and included a small refrigerator. The bathroom was conveniently located just a few steps away. There was also plenty of street parking available, which made things very easy. We had a wonderful experience and would happily stay here again. Thank you, Ryan!

My stay was enjoyable! The apartment was clean, tidy, and exactly as described in the listing. There's a great selection of books and games, and even some exercise equipment. The neighborhood is fantastic--quiet and safe--and the location is ideal, with lots of very good restaurants close by, a Brown Line L-train stop just 7 minutes' walk, and a Whole Foods within 5 minutes' walk. Passes were provided for on-street parking, which was great and super convenient.
It's a basement apartment, so people above are sometimes audible, although it's never all that loud.

We had such a wonderful stay—everything was perfect from start to finish! The space was spotless, beautifully maintained, and exactly as described. It felt so cozy and welcoming, like a home away from home, thoughtfully and artfully done.
We really appreciated the thoughtful touches, especially the snacks and drinks—it made everything feel extra warm and cared for. We also loved that she provided baby items even though we only requested the pack n’ play; that extra effort made traveling with a baby so much easier and more comfortable.
After long days out, it was so nice to come back and relax in such a comfortable space. The host was very kind and responsive, always quick to help and make sure we had everything we needed. Check-in and check-out were smooth and stress-free.
Overall, such a cozy and memorable stay. We would absolutely stay again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Great stay, definitely recommend it!
A lovely place in a nice neighborhood.  It was quiet and private.  The host was very responsive and helped us with anything we needed.
We had a great stay. The apartment was as described and it was clean and comfortable.
Silvia has a beautiful space in the heart of the Southside. The whole process was smooth and her responses were quick and informative.
Had a great stay at 747 lofts! Clean and organized, and very close to the blue line.
Nice place to stay, good location, interior of the house is cute.
Felt comfortable and safe. If we had any questions, Susan was quick to respond. Clean and matched photos!
The space was beautiful, nice and quiet neighborhood.  There was occasional noise from neighbors above.  Owner was very responsive with clear instructions.
Perfect place to stay while traveling
a real neighborhood with access to the public transport
The apartment was great and Milan was very responsive!
Had a great stay at this place. Would visit again!
The place was clean and spacious. Street parking was always available. Would definitely book again.

The Airbnb was literally a 2-3 minute walk from all train lines, a 5 minute walk from the buses we needed, and an 8-minute walk to Willis Tower.  There were tons of restaurant and coffee options just minutes from us.  My kids ages 12 and 16 found plenty to do and never complained once!  We would absolutely stay here again!
Great stay for us! Easy to get to, easy to check in.  The place was clean and comfortable. Fun location with LOTS to see and do. Would definitely stay again!

I loved staying here on my vacation with my 7y/o son. They made us feel very comfortable and the host responded pretty fast. Thorough instructions on how to check in and check out. The other people staying there were nice as well. I got to meet the host gf and she made me cup of coffee before checking out which I thought was super nice of her. I’ll definitely be back. ❤️
Perfect for what I needed, Sharleen was very responsive and helpful

Very nice spot and stay. Noise machine was provided which was helpful for the train. The "L" is loud anywhere in the city. The ease of getting on the train is always a double edged sword with noise. You can't have both! Place was clean and just as Kim described. Would stay here again. Kim was always very responsive with any questions.

This apartment was absolutely perfect for our group of six friends coming together from different parts of the country. We wanted a place with plenty of room to relax and reconnect, and Ian’s place exceeded our expectations.
The apartment had two adorable, cozy lounge areas, plus a spacious formal dining room and kitchen, making it easy for everyone to gather. All of the bedrooms were generously sized, the beds were comfortable, and the entire apartment was spotless. We used both the bus and subway during our stay, and everything was easy to navigate. The neighborhood was quiet, and the location was great.
This is one of those rare places where the pictures truly don’t do the reality justice. Ian has styled the apartment beautifully; it felt rich, warm, and cozy in the best way. Super personal.
Only minor note: kitchen had every pot and pan you could possibly, there were no basic condiments (ie salt) We bought some and left them for the next guests. We will absolutely stay again

Świetny apartament, duży i przestronny, wyposażony w niezbędne rzeczy. Spokojna i bezpieczna okolica. Zdecydowanie polecam i gdybym miała wracać z pewnością wybrałabym ponownie. Gospodarz bardzo pomocny i komunikatywny.

Nice, cozy stay for our group of 6 in the Chicago area - about a 20 minute drive from downtown sights. Entrance steps were a bit steep for older members of the group, and parking was a bit tight for our van, but overall it was a definite 5 star stay.
The unit was just as described in the listing. Very accommodating and responsive. Everything was within walking distance. With traffic downtown still was not far. We would stay again
Nos sentimos como en casa, fue fenomenal hospedarnos ahi, llegamos al centro de Chicago de forma muy rápida, sin duda volvería a hospedarme ahí

Wonderful location and stay. We needed a place for two weeks that was located near the art school. The location was perfect and the condo was clean and comfortable. We would definitely stay there again.

We had a lovely stay. The check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow and Russell was incredibly responsive throughout our stay. Great communication and a smooth experience from start to finish.

Super happy with my stay!  Clean space and roomy.  Lots of sunlight.  A very feel good house overall!  Beautiful artwork everywhere, a real pleasure to be inside the house.  Brandon was nice to speak to!  He's friendly and helpful.  The train stop is about a 10-min walk away.  The bus stop is a 2-min walk away.  Convenient location to get downtown.  Highly satisfied with the stay!  Strong recommend.
Very easy to work with and convenient for a concert at the Chicago Theater!

The apartment is just as pictured. Clean and welcoming. Hosts are very responsive. As others have mentioned, the floors are extremely squeaky, and the lack of carpets and sparse furnishings create an echo, for an overall very loud environment.
Conveniently located for adventuring around Chicago, with many stores and eateries within walking distance. Large park across the street is great for kids needing to burn steam after a long drive!

Jim was a fabulous host. As well as the other staff involved over the weekend. He gave us recommendations for local restaurants. Southern Chicago was fabulous as well. The apartment is very spacious and well appointed.

This was an absolute gorgeous location! We were walking distance from major bus stops, train stations, and from the Logan Square Arts Festival. The neighborhood felt safe to walk through, and the house was super clean with cool vibes. My friends and I are musical people so we LOVED playing on the electric keyboard near the back door. We had an early flight and were concerned on where to keep our luggage, but the host was friendly and responsive and gave us the option to pop our bags in the entryway several hours before our check in time. I HIGHLY recommend this location to anyone looking for a relaxing Chicago stay!

The location was perfect and the place had everything needed. Except there was no WiFi so the TV provided is useless for streaming as there is no cable, and slow to no response.
Overall Cute place - great location.

Michael was super responsive. We could not get in the apartment because we weren’t turning the knob correctly. He came over very quickly to make sure we not only got in but left snacks, water and had the air on an apartment cooled. The apartment was  beautiful and accommodated us well.

We were very comfortable staying in Wood’s place. Beds were comfortable, having (good) coffee there for our use was great and having the little backyard space  was lovely. The neighborhood was quiet yet close to things. Would definitely book again.
Very nice and peaceful place to live in. The hosts were very nice as well.
Was an amazing stay m. Comfortable and had everything I needed and more.

I went to Chicago to attend a conference at the University of Chicago and had the pleasure of staying at Ryan and Elizabeth's place; their room is everything I could ever expect from an AirBnB. The location was great, within walking distance to both the university and the CTA green line which goes downtown. Ryan and Elizabeth were both very kind, welcoming and responsive; they gave me some good recommendations for dining in the area, helped me with my laundry and introduced me to their beautiful dogs. Regarding the room, it spacious, comfy and very well stocked with anything you might need during your stay. In addition, having a private bathroom is a great plus. Overall, I think this AirBnB is a great value for the money and I would love to stay there again the next time I am in Chicago.

This place is amazing!! It’s so beautiful. I loved the inside of the space. There are stairs but they are even and easy to get up. The whole space is beautifully decorated. Peter is very responsive. We felt very welcome and at home here. Every time we come to Chicago, we will be reaching out to Peter first before hotels or anything else. This was the perfect place. So close to downtown and so close to the Obama center. Highly recommend!!

It was a nice and comfortable place to stay.
The host is very nice

There are a lot of good things to say about this property. The neighbourhood is lovely and walkable, it is close to transit. Our kids loved the playground around the corner and it had parking. The unit is spacious and well equipped. Some fixtures have some obvious wear and tear and the exterior of the property hasn't received as much attention as the inside but overall it is a great space for families. The noise from the subway is significant and unlike other guests, we did not get used to it over our 5 day stay. The white noise machines are quite helpful for sleep. Additionally, the parking is under the subway tracks and our vehicle has a fair amount of grease on it still (it did rain heavily so that may have contributed). We had a good time there but next time will likely choose to stay somewhere else.
The house was clean and spacious.  Nancy was very responsive and friendly.  Great communication.  She had a full basket of snacks and goodies waiting for us when we arrived.

Beautiful home in a fantastic location! Roscoe Village has a terrific collection of restaurants, coffee shops and stores. Street parking is never a problem but you can walk to just about everything you would want. The space is quiet, clean and modern and has everything we wanted or needed.
Very kind, he was on the lookout and let us check in earlier

Le logement est très bien situé, en face d’un parc, pas loin des transports en commun. Notre séjour s’est très bien passé. L’appartement était propre et spacieux. Bonne communication avec Jeremiah. Je recommande !

Love love love the location! Gives you a great feel for what it’s like to actually live in Chicago north of downtown. Bathroom was darling and totally functional. I wish they would buy better living room furniture- sofa was not comfy at all, but other than that we really liked staying here. Thanks!

I had a wonderful stay! The place was spotless and very well maintained. The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, making the experience even better. The aesthetic of the hotel was beautiful and thoughtfully designed, creating a relaxing atmosphere. The location was perfect & close to everything to see and do. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!
The location can’t be beat! Lots of restaurants and Wrigley Field are within walking distance. Beds were comfortable and place was clean.
Was a fun and comfortable stay
We enjoyed our stay and I would absolutely stay here again.

Very spacious and walkable to the metro station, bars, restaurants, coffee shops, grocery markets and anything you’ll need to find during your stay. I can’t think of a reason why you should not stay. Matt’s place was just perfect for our Chicago trip. We drove in and loved that we could park right out by the Airbnb with temporary parking passes that were provided. We would definitely rebook again in the future if needed.
Great location and great view. Had  an enjoyable stay

Lovely place to stay while on vacation or short visit. I really liked how close the blue line was to the place. Although the fire station is right outside the host were kind enough to leave ear plugs for us.
The place was fantastic! The rooftop patio, spectacular. ⭐️ Great views. There are a lot of stairs. Make sure you can climb stairs.
Enjoyed staying here. Neighborhood was safe and easy to navigate.

Location is the star of this property! Literally across the street from Lincoln Park where there’s so much to do. We went walked to the zoo, beach, farmer’s market, and took near daily strolls through the park. It was an easy bus ride downtown to Millennium Park and Navy Pier too! We stayed with our two little ones and David provided everything we needed (high chair, utensils, pack n play, toys, books, etc.) We didn’t get to use the beach towels and toys David had ready for us due to weather, but appreciate having everything available. The place is pristine and very nicely styled. The ONLY thing is you’ll definitely hear kids running around upstairs even with a white noise machine running. I think at one point they were even riding scooters. We were ready for it though based on reviews and didn’t mind due to having loud kids ourselves, but worth noting for light sleepers thinking about booking. Otherwise, absolutely perfect! Thank you!
Helpful and communicative hosts!

This was our first time staying in Pilsen, and we had a great experience! The location is just minutes from downtown, making it easy to explore the city. We also loved the restaurants in the neighborhood. The hosts were welcoming, and the place was comfortable and in a great location. We'd definitely stay here again!
Patt was very helpful figuring out how to accommodate me on very short notice.

The apartment itself was nice and had some good features, but there were a few issues that affected my stay. The area felt a bit sketchy, and I did not always feel comfortable walking around. The windows and curtains were quite dusty, and noise from the neighbours upstairs was very disruptive, especially at night. Other than these points, the place was comfortable and the host was helpful. With some improvements to cleanliness, maintenance, and noise insulation, it could be a much better experience.
Stains under mattress. Stains on sheets. Stains on the walls. Never disclosed how many other people were sharing a single bathroom. Messy kitchen. Laundry in the washer.

Nat’s place was great! It looked just like the photos and was very clean.
The location was fantastic! There’s several bus stops and a train station within walking distance. There’s also a plethora of shops, restaurants, etc. within walking distance. Very easy to get to other parts of the city.
Wonderful location.  Very spacious unit with a great floorplan
Cool unique space, looks great for events and large groups!
great place to stay quiet area and not far from alot of sights
very easy to book and a very cozy place.

My 3-month stay at Sebastien’s was an excellent experience from start to finish.
The place is comfortable, clean, and has everything you need for a longer stay.
Wicker Park is a great neighborhood full of great restaurants, coffee shops, and bars, with easy access to public transportation, making it simple to get anywhere in Chicago.
Sebastien is a welcoming host who strikes the perfect balance between being friendly and giving guests their privacy. Communication was always easy,
I can confidently say this is a place I'd happily recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located home base in Chicago, whether for a short visit or an extended stay.

A Best Western isn’t exactly why I use AirBnb.  I guess Chicago has pushed out many of AirBnBs we have used in the past.  It was safe and clean and was the cheapest stay we could find.  Come on Chicago, allow unique Airbnbs to  exist in your city.
Well maintained stay in a great location. Quick drive from all the attractions in downtown Chicago! Has a lot of great restaurants around.
Marissa was great with communication, helped us replace something we needed and we had a great time staying here

Stayed here for 3 nights and really enjoyed the art and decorations. The area was extremely walkable and felt safe. My reason for 4 stars is that the upstairs neighbors were the loudest people ive ever heard. I was woken up during a nap to nonstop banging at 5 pm my first day, and every single morning at 7 am to running up and down steps. There was never a break from the constant noise of the neighbor until late at night. I read the reviews where people said they could hear the neighbors but I wasnt expecting that and Im the type that can sleep through almost anything. If I would have stayed any longer I would have had to say something to our host. The other thing that surprised me was no wash cloths being provided. I know it said in the listing essentials weren’t provided but at almost $400 a night I guess I expected to be provided a wash cloth since we were given such nice towels. I cant honestly say id stay here again, but only due to the noisy neighbors, not the place itself.

Brilliant place to stay as the room was just as described. Very good location with many walkable places and activities to get up to. Host was responsive and always helpful with any questions.
Thank you very much

Wonderful place to stay.  They were very good at communicating exactly where to park and how to have a great experience in the Chicago area.  Clean, comfortable, and a walkable distance from the Blue Line.  Would definitely go there again.
Nice location, good accommodation for a large group. Helpful hosts.

The host was very attentive and ready to help when needed. The place was very nice and cozy, they really make you feel at home, there's coffee, tea, microwave and a small fridge. It was perfect for what we needed, the only thing I would call out is the shower is very tight and public transportation times are sometimes double what they are by car, since you have to take a small walk and then a couple of buses to get anywhere, it's not a bad location it's just the way it is.
A nice modern home at a great location. Enjoyed our stay !

A perfect choice if you travel alone. Julio is accessible and always fulfill the facilities very soon after you ask. He would not stay long at home and that means the restroom and all public area are private after you check in. As well he's also nice to answer the questions about Chicago.
Commute to downtown is convinent. There's a hint that taking #9/X9 and transfer to green line would be a nice choice and that costs about 30 min, and you can see a lot of city views along like the cross of L lines at the northwest of the loop. While Google Maps always recommend taking blue line or #72 to red line, it often delays on the peak that costs more time actually. (Of course taking #72 to north beach & lincoin park would be a good plan for evenings and weekends)
The only drawback is the enviorment of the hallway you get in, as it's old and some flies from the basement level. The solution is closing the unit door immediately after you get in.
Overall it's a wonderful and well-valued place.

I am always anxious in new areas and I felt it was a breeze finding the location and getting in. Great communication when needed!! Area is nice but could never find parking (not their fault). Wifi was great. Streaming available. Would come back if I was in the area and needed a place to stay again.

The place was conveniently located in a peaceful neighborhood, and we had no trouble finding it. The attached garage was a huge plus, especially for our luggage. The place had all the amenities we needed during our stay. They had a pack ’n play for our little one.
It’s a three-story townhome, and the master bedroom is on the top floor. So, if you’re carrying luggage, be prepared to climb a few flights of stairs. They had white noise machines in all the rooms, which helped drown out the train noise that comes from the tracks right behind the house.
However, there was a noticeable temperature difference between the two bedrooms. The one on the ground floor was colder than the one on the top floor. They did have extra blankets, which helped.
Great hosts, great location. Safe, easy parking, and close to everything.
the house has lovely vibe, I felt good there. 👍

Our stay here was wonderful. The beds were very comfortable and everything looked as described on the listing. We mainly used the place to sleep but we loved how the restaurants surrounding the place were at a walkable distance. It was a peaceful neighborhood and we had no problems finding that place. The check in instructions were clear and the host was very responsive and nice. If given the opportunity, we’d stay here again!
Great stay, comfortable bed. Short walk to Southport or Roscoe village
Nice place. Safe neighborhood.
Had a great stay!

Tim was an amazing host from start to finish, responsive and helpful with all my questions, from booking all the way through checkout. The location is right by a subway line, which made getting into downtown really easy and convenient. It can get a bit loud at times given the proximity to the subway, but it was a small trade-off for how convenient the location was. Overall, a great stay and I'd definitely recommend it!
appreciated
Very quiet and nice close to bar and restaurant and all areas of Chicago you need to visit.

It was not shared that we would be sharing the space with the house owner when we booked the airbnb. Every time we came upstairs to leave he was there and it made it very uncomfortable to stay in. The ad listed the kitchen as well as a part of the airbnb but it felt like we weren’t able to use it due to the owner being there. In addition when we arrived and the owner had not yet fully cleaned up upstairs and it was very off putting. Also while we were trying to sleep both nights we could hear him waking around upstairs before and after we woke up (around 12AM and 6AM) and it made it difficult to sleep.
The best stay in Chicago, everything spotlessly clean and efficient and beautiful, super easy check-in and clear instructions. Many Thanks!
Chris is a great host, always responsive and proactive.  Great place to stay, very clean, quiet, and in a great neighborhood.  We enjoyed our stay!

The host was responsive and helpful. The place is unique, very charming. Lots of little trinkets, and the design is intentional. It’s colorful and intricate and definitely has a historic vibe. Only fair disclaimer is that if you’re allergic to cats, this place may not be for you. Thanks again.
Was nice!
Nice and cosy little house in Oldtown. We very comfortable and had everything we need. The area is also very nice. Would come back.

Norma's place was a great home base for us to explore the city! It's close to the blue line and easy to get downtown. It was clean and in good condition. You can hear traffic in the front bedroom but they do offer a noise machine and it's just part of a staying in the city.
They offer guests a credit to use at their restaurant below. The food was delicious and a nice perk! We would definitely stay at Norma's again.

I am very happy with my stay! The place was clean, and the room met my needs. I wanted a bed, a desk, and a good internet connection. The shared bathroom and kitchen were very clean. The location is 15 mins walk from U Chicago campus. I am delighted to recommend it.

Our stay here was so great! The location is perfect with how convenient it is being by the train station. The noise didn’t affect us too much and there was a white noise speaker that helped drown out the sound. Since the photos matched the space, it was easy for us to get comfortable in the space. Very grateful for the amazing stay here!

I’m at a loss for words to describe how enchanting my stay was at John and Greg’s place.  They were stellar hosts and beyond generous with their stunning home, yard, scooters, Martinis and insights into the neighborhood.  Not to mention the marvelous city right outside their door.   Life is grand!
Great Location, exactly as listed. Clear instructions upon checkin and check out with no issues.  Great Host! Thanks for everything!

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment is on a quiet residential street, yet it’s just a short walk to all the restaurants, cafés, and shops on Clark Street. It was the perfect balance of peaceful and convenient.
The apartment itself exceeded our expectations. The layout is excellent, with spacious, light-filled rooms, beautiful bay windows, and separate living, dining, and kitchen areas that made the space feel much larger than we expected. We were four adults and never felt cramped. It was comfortable, welcoming, and felt like a real home rather than a rental.
Barbara was a fantastic host—friendly, responsive, and thoughtful throughout our stay.
We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable home base to explore Andersonville and the surrounding neighborhoods.
Leah was very responsive and helpful! Would stay again on our return to Chicago!

Nikkole was a great host and her place was perfectly situated to be off main roads but very walkable to restaurants, playgrounds, and transit. She was super communicative and honest. While perfectly fine for adults and big kids, this isn’t a great place for crawling babies (she graciously warned us ahead of time!) It’s an old building with uneven floors and peeling paint on the baseboards. We gave her some feedback on the baseboards needing to be cleaned better and the peeling paint, and she was receptive to this so hopefully the next guest will benefit. Overall, we were comfortable and pleased with our experience.
We had a great 4 day 3 night stay. The place was very clean and the host was very responsive. Throughout the night was honestly very quiet. Overall, we had no complaints.

Location was excellent for our family's trip to Chicago. We had a multiday event at Navy Pier which was a quick 10 minute Uber away. Plenty of restaurants within feet of the apartment an easy walk to the shops on Michigan Ave.
Parking was a massive plus for us. You park in a private parking garage about 2 blocks away. It's a little tricky to find at first, so follow the instructions/video they provide and it's a snap. Typically in this part of Chicago you'll spent $65 a night for parking, so happy about this situation.
Apartment is very nice, clean, spacious and safe. Would stay again.

Good location and easy check in process .
It was hard to get good sleep because of the train noise and the bright windows, wish they had blackout curtains.
We were not well rested and woke up groggy every day.
Apart from that the property matched the description and had all the listed amenities!

It was a very comfortable place to stay. It was very clean and was decorated really cute. The kitchen was well stocked with everything you could possibly need. The beds were comfortable.
No issues with the renters upstairs as far as sounds.
The floors did squeak quite a bit. A little disruptive for the couple staying in the lower level.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay.
Please heed to the parking restrictions as we received 2 parking violations ($75 a piece) for parking to close to the end of the road.
Chicago...steep fines.

Fantastic location! We're not super familiar with Chicago. We took a chance on West Town, and it did not disappoint. It is groovy and real in all the right ways, and confirmed my suspicion that Chicago's patchwork of neighborhoods is the very nature of the city. Transit is easy; plentiful and diverse food options abound; there's early morning and late night liveliness — the works. This apt. is very easy to find and a comfortable base to explore the city.

Carissa was a great host!
She answered quickly to any request.
The apartment was very nice.
The location was great. We loved to be in a typical neighborhood.
A great option for Chicago, the neighborhood is lovely, well connected and the place was very well equiped with all you might need and more…

Cordaro is an A++ host and has a great location! He went above and beyond at providing amenities and I would highly recommend  anyone planning on visiting Chicago to stay at his place. Great/easy access to downtown via public transit. Thank you for hosting!

Taimoor was an excellent host and the house was beautiful with lots of space, amenities and felt like home.
We went with kids and they loved the place as well.
We will be sure to come back!!
La casa muy bien ubicada,  silenciosa por lo que se puede descansar muy bien,  Mary y su equipo son muy amables y están muy  pendientes de solucionar cualquier necesidad
We had a good stay and would definitely come back

We had a lovely stay and the house was very comfortable and well appointed. The beds, pillows, and linens were especially cozy. The street is beautiful and it was a quiet area and a nice central location. We would definitely stay here again.

The location can’t be beat! So many great restaurants, bars, coffee shops right in walking distance. Andy is a very helpful and responsive host. The space is cozy and comfortable. I’d highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!
Great stay
Excelente relación calidad precio! Me gustó la experiencia

Valeriy was an amazing host, being extremely responsive and having an amazing space. The other guests were loud at times but it wasn’t too awfully annoying. I would totally recommend Valeriy’s space for whoever’s looking to stay in Chicago!
Stayed here for a week for a dance competition! It exceeded my expectations. I felt safe and comfortable with my family being there. It was great and kind of fancy lol. Will come back if needed.

We specifically wanted to get to know the South Side and it did not disappoint! We enjoyed running in the South Beach area and we walked to the Obama Center and explored the many local historic places. This apartment is spacious and quiet, beautiful and clean. We did some cooking and found everything we needed. Special touches like sparkling water and snacks were really nice! We would definitely stay here again.
The property is in a great location
Je recommande 👍
Aaron was very accommodating

In the Chicago area it can be tricky to find something good and this checked all our boxes! We were comfortable, felt safe, parking was easy, right off the highway, easy travel into downtown, and the outdoor space was a huge perk!!
Great decor and host was very responsive!

A great stay from a great host. We used to live in the neighborhood and are always looking for the right place when we come back and visit, and James’s place really fit the bill. Perfect location right by the park, pretty and roomy, well kept space, and incredibly responsive host, making sure we had what we needed throughout the entire stay. Would highly recommend and hopefully we can come back again next year!
Excellent brand new place to stay. Had all amenities we needed and very easy walk to train, shops, and food. Super responsive when we needed something or had a question. Great value!!
The communication is immaculate and the photos match up to what you as a guest will walk into!
Nice apartment
Great stay. Very quiet & clean. Jeff is a 10/10 host!
I plan on coming back to space just to get away. It was the perfect getaway and possibly one of my favorite BNBs thus far!!! The host were super kind and accommodating even down to the last minute!
El departamento era muy amplio y espacioso. Es muy lindo y acogedor, es muy accesible ! Queda uy cerca el Metro y el tren y el barrio es bonito y no es inseguro. Igualmente tiene supermercados cerca
窗帘坏了，不能自动打开。希望修好为下一个客户服务

The home is just like the photos depict. Area is walkable and close to bus transportation. Hosts greeted us upon arrival and were very friendly and helpful with directions to bus and train stops.  Kitchen could use a few additional items such as a toaster, plastic wrap and foil, and mixing bowls, but otherwise had everything we needed to cook meals. Overall a great place to stay.
We enjoyed our stay in Johana’s place. We appreciated the views and the location. We were thankful for her prompt communication and flexibility.
Very cozy place to stay

Just spent a couple of nights at Todd and Tripps place and could not have been happier.  Todd and Tripp are both extremely nice guys and made us feel welcome from the minute we arrived.  The home is beautiful and located in a great neighborhood.  Walkable to many shops and restaurants.  Hosts could not have been more responsive.  Hair dryer broke Friday morning and 5 minutes later a new one was there for us.  We guessed they ran to Walgreens down the block but incredible for a host to do!  Back yard is beautiful and so peaceful.  Fire table and Koi pond and could not believe how quiet it was in the middle of the city.  I could go on and on but suffice to say it is an amazing place.  Thanks Todd, Tripp and Eddie!  I am sure we will be seeing you again soon.

Great location, on a quiet residential street but surrounded by tons to do. About a block from the lake and a block from the bustling area of the Gold Coast neighborhood.
If you like walking, you can walk to downtown, Lincoln Park and Old Town (super cute shops and a better grocery store than Jewel). Or rent a bike and cruise to Millennial Park along the water front.
Studio is on the first floor of a brownstone apartment. Bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper since the main door to the building is right on the other side of the bedroom area and some tenants allowed the large, heavy doors to slam shut.
