Comfortable bed, clean, and a kitchen with everything needed to make meals.
The place was clean and quiet, and it has quick access to public transportation.

A great apartment in chicago. Close to downtown without having to be down town. A cute 2nd floor flat. Two hug rooms, a good size bathroom. A kitchen with everything you need.  Would love to stay here again for our next visit to the Windy City!

We loved our stay at Ingrid's! The place was cozy and clean, and check-in was super easy. I loved how organized the place was too. Ingrid reached out early and followed-up to make sure everything was as expected and to see if we needed anything. It was quiet and serene throughout the day and night, which made it a great working space too. The location was nice too! A variety of cafes and restaurants were just a short walk away.
We would absolutely stay again.

This is a great space with plenty of shops, restaurants, and bars to walk to. It’s nearby to public transportation stops that makes traveling to the loop easy. The inside was a good size for four of us to sleep, hang out & play games, and make some meals.

I stayed here for two weeks and had a good experience. The room was clean and comfortable, and the hosts did a great job managing both rooms while keeping the shared spaces clean and well-maintained between guests. They were friendly, easy to communicate with, and always responsive when needed.
The kitchen and bathroom were both consistently clean, which made things easy and convenient during my stay. It was also really nice to have access to a kitchen and laundry facilities for a longer visit, which made the stay much more comfortable and practical.
Overall, it was a comfortable place to stay for an extended visit, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, well-managed Airbnb.

Gregory and Hannah, were great hosts. Quick to respond, and eager to help. The area was beautiful, and the space was comfortable. The only issue was the number of beds available. We had four single adults, so 4 beds was going to be perfect,  but one of the pullouts in the living room was small, hard and uncomfortable. The hosts were very accommodating, and gave us an air mattress as a replacement, but I would not recommend this Airbnb if you plan on using all four designated sleeping spaces.
the apartment is so god so far.

We stayed at Nala and Owen’s apartment for 5 nights during our Chicago trip. It’s conveniently located near the CTA, restaurants, and convenience stores. Check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow, and Nala and Owen were responsive and provided great recommendations for nearby restaurants. We were mainly out exploring, but the apartment had most of what we needed, and the noise wasn’t an issue for us. One heads-up: there are only stairs, so plan accordingly if you have a lot of luggage. Any issues that came up, Nala and Owen were quick to help. Thanks again!
Friendly host and a very nice place. I stayed for more than 6 weeks.
We enjoyed our stay. The place was clean and our team was able to get our work done.

Nat’s place looked just like the pictures and was a great location for our Chicago visit.  I appreciated the fun decor and the beds were very comfortable.  Nat was responsive and flexible…a great host!

Erin was super-helpful and communicative throughout. Gave us lots of local recommendations for eating and more! Allowed us to check in a little earlier and in the meantime leave our bags at the property. Apartment nicely furnished, clean and comfortable. Would recommend!!

Check in was very easy and welcoming, the place was beautiful and smelt good and parking was easy. It was very comforting and so far the best place I’ve stayed at. She was easy to communicate with as well! Definitely will stay here again when I have another trip in Chicago!
Great space and host! The unit was clean and stocked with essentials. It was perfect for me and my two children.

This apartment is a gem! It was absolutely spotless and the bathroom and kitchen were beautifully renovated. AC worked well and the water pressure was super strong. Loved the addition of the white noise machines and phone chargers in each bedroom. The road was busy but you couldn't really hear it once you were inside. Would definitely stay here again!

Loved my stay at this beautiful home. Located in the cutest neighborhood.
There are tenants up top, and they were rather loud at times that prevented me from getting some much needed sleep. So just an FYI. They also control the Temperature of the unit. So if you prefer it warmer or colder, that’s something to be mindful of. Lea and Cliff did provide a heater which was kind.
Other than those two things, I would absolutely recommend this Airbnb and would stay again when I visit Chicago.
The restaurants in the neighborhood are also a quick walk away and everyone we encountered on our walk was so friendly wand warm! Lea and Cliff were quick to respond and meet our needs. Communication was amazing.
10/10 stay in my book.
Excelente! Ficarei novamente quando for para Chicago!

This was a perfect place for me to stay while visiting my son who lives nearby.  The apartment was very clean and nice for one person. My only suggestion is that the mattress was very thin and a little uncomfortable. As the description says, the walls are thin and earplugs were provided , but I didn’t need them.  Other than that it was a great place to stay for a few days.

Good location
Cozy appartement
I recommend it

LOCATION!!
Right off the Sheridan stop on the red line. St. Mary of the Lake was down the street. The lake was a beautiful walk away.
Having two bathrooms was nice. The bed was comfortable. The two tvs was also nice especially when the world cup was on.

Lovely staying here. The space is beautiful and spacious. Check in & check out were both the easiest I’ve experienced on here. In a very walkable neighborhood close to two train lines & tons of restaurants! Had no issues at all through my entire stay. Everything you want in an airbnb :)

The host was very responsive and efficient in communicating everything needed for the stay. However, the listing describes the room only as being on the “lower level,” which is actually a basement reached by a steep staircase. From the bed, the pipes overhead are fully visible. The checkout time is an unusually early 10 AM.
Before arrival, Ryan let us know that check‑in would be delayed due to the previous guest leaving late, which was fine. But when I asked for a bit more flexibility on departure day, the answer was no. I was offered the option to stay in the living room until 3 PM, which was kind, but my train wasn’t until 6:40 PM, so I still had to leave the house at 3 PM with all my luggage. Overall, an OK experience.
Afsha's place was great. The space is even larger than the pictures show. Very clean, great location. We didn't love having to pay for laundry.

Walking into the space was felt like coming home. The house is elegant and well appointed. It’s in a wonderful neighborhood with terrific restaurants and close to public transport, if needed. I would highly recommend staying here. Argelia was a kind, gracious host, very responsive to us.
This is in a great location. Easy to use and find public transportation and several places that’s are easily walkable. The apartment was roomy enough for the 5 of us!
Nice place

I am incredibly disappointed with my experience at the LIVN Airbnb. The unit we initially checked into was not as described; the bathroom in particular looked nothing like the listing photos. It was so small that my 6-foot-tall husband couldn’t even use the shower comfortably. After reporting the issue, we were relocated and given a $100 credit. Unfortunately, the second unit was also unacceptable. It was noticeably run down, with chipped paint, cracks in the bathroom floor, a cracked toilet, and a clogged sink upon arrival. We reported these issues as well and received another $100 credit. While I appreciate that the host provided compensation, it did not make up for the overall poor quality of the accommodations. The value simply did not match what was advertised or what we expected. Frankly, this was the worst Airbnb experience we’ve had. I would not recommend this host.

I booked this for my sister because she was coming in to Chicago for a visit. We have two Great Danes and they are not too friendly with strangers. Better to just have a place where she could just relax and not worry about the dogs.
She remarked how nice the place was and how quiet and laid back. She would definitely book it if she were to visit Chicago again.
Si quieres sentirte como en casa está es una muy buena opción, Craig siempre estuvo al pendiente. Si tuviera que volver a elegir volvería a elegir esta casa.
Patt was incredibly responsive and a great host.
Beautiful place! Great location. Abigail was very friendly and helpful with anything we needed. Definitely recommend.
Matthew is a great host! Very responsive, and professional! The space had everything we needed, and we had a comfortable stay

Overall good experience. However, It was difficult to locate the lock box when we arrived at night. The Lock box was located on the rail and that was not noted in the home instructions. It felt like an escape room to get in, but we eventually figured it out. We did contact the host, but it seemed like they used a foreign call center to manage communication.
The apartment was as pictured internally however the lobby and elevator was a bit dated. Great location and community vibes.
A worthwhile destination - prime location, great vibe and decor and friendly and responsive host.
I would definitely recommend to others !

First of all, It needs a lot of maintenance. There is pieces of the floor coming out. There's transitions between floor levels just sticking out and dangerous so you can trip easily or cut yourself. The bathroom floor between the tub it literally      coming off. The grout on the shower it had a lot of black stains. The baseboard on one of the bedrooms had a big gap all the way around. And bugs were coming out from there. There was a lot of bugs around the house that look like cockroaches. The pictures from the list make it look really nice and tidy but it really isn't. It needs a lot of work this place is not in good conditions. It was a waste of money. Airbnb should inspect places before they list them somehow.
Andy was an amazing host, always responsive. The place was very nice and cozy, especially the living room. We ended up spending most of our time there.
Loved the stay! Beautiful house and neighborhood.

Josh’s place was perfect for our needs. Lots of bedrooms, nice kitchen for cooking big breakfasts, we found a great bar/restaurant within walking distance that we visited each day (Wolcott Tap), and the L was close and got us everywhere we needed to go without moving the car our entire stay. Will stay here again.
Enjoyed staying here for a work trip. It’s a walk up and even though it’s next to Tao night club it was quiet in the apartment. Very thoughtful hosts. Thank you. We would book again.
Perfect place for a three night stay while I was visiting for work! Close to metra and cta for transportation  downtown and plenty of fun spots/close to lake to explore after work.

Wonderful stay! The apartment was clean and in a great walkable location, with an amazing view of the fountain, park, and lake right from the window. The hosts were also super responsive and helpful throughout our stay, quick to answer questions and easy to communicate with. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to stay in this area!

Overall it was a very good stay. I gave 4 starts for couple reasons :
1. The place is listed as ground floor but it’s a basement.
2. Uncomfortable furniture (beds and chairs).
3. The door to the bathroom is very hard to open and it makes noise which is very disturbing at night.
Otherwise my family and I liked everything. Very convenient location. It’s 20 mins ride to downtown, 1 min walk to a big grocery store, coffee shop and in general it looked safe.
The apartment was very clean and had enough of everything to stay for few days. I just wish we could have a kettle to make tea.
The host was wonderful to accommodate our needs and very responsive.
I would love to stay there again.

This is a great place in one of the best neighborhoods in Chicago. Unit is spacious & well appointed. Close to great restaurants and nightlife & extremely convenient to transportation. Great stay, highly recommended.

hermosos dueños que nos atendieron de diez! super amigables y amables!
el studio estaba super limpio, tal cual las fotos y descripciones de la publicacion.
punto que suma es tener el lavarropas y seca ropa en el mismo espacio donde se habita, todo preparado para estadias largas!
muchísimas gracias por recibirnos los ultimos dias de nuestra estadia en ee uu , nos falto hacer mil cosas en chicago, esperamos poder volcer a concretarlas porque es una hermosa ciudad y la gente muy copada! 🥰
Brittany was very kind and clear with her communication. Her place was very clean, homey, and spacious. We had a great time during our stay.
good spacious and comfy place
Such a fun place in a convenient location!  Why stay somewhere with grey walls and IKEA furniture when you can go full quirky??

It was a pleasure staying at Laura's Airbnb! Although it was a bit far, the area was quiet, safe and walkable to lots of restaurants. The beds were very comfortable and overall the apartment was very clean. If I rent a car next time, I will stay here again.

Tracy is a good host. She answered all questions that we had in a timely manner. We stayed here for a bachelor party and the location was perfect. Just a short 5-10 minute walk from Wrigleyville. The place was clean upon arrival and well-maintained. One drawback to this location is parking. If you are bringing more than 2 cars, parking will become an issue. Tracy does have a parking spot available at the location for an extra charge. If I can say one thing that was not so great about the host it is that she was very pushy about the money for the parking spot. Going as far as to leave a note in the front door twice during our stay. Overall, a great stay!
A great room, near the university. The host is very friendly and caring - totally on your team! - made my stay perfectly straightforward. No complaints :)
Clean, comfortable, as described, and great location. I would stay here again.
Besides the Parking issues. the pictures of this home does no justice you have to see and feel for yourselves.

We reached out to Ray about renting his place.  He was very open and transparent about a couple of recently reported items that needed to be addressed and wanted to make sure all guests had a great experience.  We reached out again because we were trying to fulfill an experience for the kids and Ray accommodated our request.  The kids loved the experience and we had a wonderful time sharing it with them.  Check in/out was easy.  Having a dedicated parking spot was great.  Sitting out on the rooftop deck was nice.   Communication was good!
bill and sue were so so sweet! and their dog theo is adorable! The place was perfect for a 3 day trip and had everything we needed. I would definitely book again in the future :)
Amazing stay!!
Great location for visiting Chicago. Logan Square is handily placed on the Blue Line between O’Hare to Chicago. Spacious, well equipped property which I would highly recommend.
Home was fantastic! Plenty of room for the family and friends that spent the weekend there with us!
Great little spot. Apartment was clean and host was friendly + responsive.
The stay here was wonderful!
l'appartement était propre et le quartier était calme. Lewis était très réactif et gentil. Je vous recommande à choisir ce logement parfait et incroyable.

Great location! Super close to the train and Wrigley Field. Lots of great restaurants nearby and the neighborhood felt very safe.
Be aware that Google Maps led me to the back of the building when I first arrived and was walking from the train, which is not a big deal and absolutely no fault of the owners, but no fun to pull a suitcase that far!
I would definitely stay here again, thank you!

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exactly as described—very clean, tidy, and well-maintained. The hosts were fantastic, communicated promptly, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. They were friendly, helpful, and always available if we had any questions. We truly enjoyed our stay and felt right at home. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming place to stay!

My teen daughter & I had an incredible stay at the Pink House. 🩷 It's a quiet, quirky little spot in a neighborhood with lots of character & convenient to public transportation. Niki & Sean are lovely humans & gracious hosts who made our first trip to Chicago less complicated & more memorable. An absolute gem!
Great value for the price. The place was comfortable, and the host was very responsive.
anything you need, Mera is a quick responder and very personable!

The host was kind, responsive, and easy to communicate with. However, the home felt dated and in need of maintenance and updates, including holes in the walls and missing bricks. The seating was uncomfortable, the kitchen knives were dangerously dull, and the cooling was very uneven between rooms. The back bedroom was especially cold and had no effective way to block the bright morning sun—so don’t plan to sleep in! Overall, we appreciated the host but did not feel the accommodations were worth the price we paid.
Jake is a great host and this was a great spot, especially during pride month!

Great location, Don was the man!
They allowed us to put our luggage in a room while we waited for the flight.
Didn't enjoy having to pay a deposit before using an Airbnb, shouldn't be this way.

This was a great place to stay while visiting DePaul for a college tour with our daughter.
Clean, modern & enough space for the three of us- we would definitely stay again!

Me and my friends really enjoyed our stay here! It was honestly better than what we expected. We were a little nervous just because it was a first time in Chicago and we weren’t sure about the area but the area was perfect! We felt safe to walk and safe in the apartment building. There were so many places that were walking distance. The apartment was beautiful, spacious, and had everything that we needed. It felt right at home. The host provided detailed instructions, was responsive and very helpful. We will definitely be booking with them again.

I think I found the place to stay when I am back to chicago, I have stayed in many ones, and I think this has been the best so far. Close to Blue Line, food close by, groceries, etc. I slept very well, no noise, loved waking up with the brigh light going through the skylights.
Place was decently clean, location was good, host was quick to respond to messages. Only bad thing was that there was a massive roach crawling around.
okay stay

- Great location
- Friendly host, responsive
He sent over some stuff that was urgently needed at 2am in the morning which was amazing and very helpful. Very responsive host! The place is also very close to CTA and accessible.

Stay was great! The host was very good at communicating with us. Clean and accessible to the location we were visiting. The bedrooms were spacious, the couch was comfortable, and the kitchen was big. Some improvements would be to have more cooking supplies, like cooking oil, better pans, and more cooking utensils. In addition, there was no kettle, which would have been convenient for boiling water. The parking space was also small behind the building; however, other options of parking were given. Overall, the stay was good, and I would stay here again.
Great host very responsive and reached out to make sure we had a great stay.

This unit and the team that manage the unit are one of the best I have had the pleasure to stay with. Consist of a well design/planned layout providing optimal use of the space allowing you to fully feel at home. Unit is clean and well stocked for anything you would need. Wonderful home, perfect location!

Not worth the money paid.
Overall, we were disappointed with our stay. The listing did not meet our expectations. One bedroom had both a king-size bed and a queen-size bed, making the room feel overcrowded and uncomfortable. Another bedroom only had a baby bed, which was completely unsuitable for an adult.
The bathroom layout was also inconvenient, with one bathroom located downstairs off the kitchen. In addition, the bathtub had been converted into a shower with plastic sheeting wrapped around it, making it feel unfinished and uncomfortable. It reminded us of the temporary shower setups used during the COVID period rather than a properly finished bathroom.
The entrance door was also noticeably dirty and appeared not to have been cleaned in quite some time, which created a poor first impression.
Overall, the property has potential, but the layout, cleanliness, bedrooms and bathroom setup significantly affected our comfort. We hope the host addresses these issues to improve experience.

This airbnb was lovely and matched the photos almost exactly. The area was somewhat noisy, but definitely not the worst I’ve seen in Chicago. Parking was pretty easy to find as long as you’re in a smaller vehicle and willing to search for a bit (I got a spot right outside the building in less than ten minutes). It was easy to commute via bus and train from here. My only critiques are a lack of bottled or filtered water if you’re wary of drinking from the tap and that I found roaches (which could and does happen in most apartments anywhere at some point). Overall, a great little apartment!

Really enjoyed my stay! It was clean and cozy. Felt very taken care of 10/10 recommend☺️

great place to stay in the Bridgeport area. very cozy and great for kids.

very welcoming place to stay, I enjoyed the location proximity to public transportation.  very easy to move and lots to do and see.

Absolutely a great airbnb. Quiet, safe and walkable neighborhood close to transit. Beautiful neighborhood. Everything was very nice and homey. Just a little hot but is easily fixed with the fan.

Cute place, amazing location, fantastic communication, clean and easy to find. Great for families traveling with kids - two of the three bedrooms are kids’ rooms. Paula was flexible about us leaving our stuff there for a little past checkout, which I really appreciated.
Our third time staying here and Mike and Deborah has just been the consummate hosts. Great place great surroundings. We look forward to returning.
Thanks so much, team, for the seamless early check-in! You guys are wonderful hosts.
Would love to come back.
We had a great stay and time in Chicago. Your property was perfect for our stay. A great place, quiet, and very clean. Appreciate the breakfast referral. Thank you, Chuck / Deb.,

Communication with Peter was very easy. He was always responsive and thorough. The Greystone was just as described and pictured in addition to being clean and well appointed. We were traveling with friends and all of us were very pleased with the accommodations. We would definitely stay here again.

El departamento muy como y muy bien amoblado, la zona muy cómoda y tranquila, tiene el tren muy cerca que se hace muy cómodo para ir al centro, Martha y Érica son espectaculares, muy atentas y dispuestas 👏👏 excelente todo
Great communication. The space was beautiful, clean, and exactly as described.

The place was great! It was a massive place that can easily fit 10 people comfortably. The place was clean, no central air but had window A/C units. The host and the place was awesome

Recomendo muito o apartamento da Liz e Martin! Os anfitriões foram extremamente simpáticos e receptivos. O apartamento estava muito limpo e a cama é muito confortável. Banheiro é excelente, com uma ótima ducha! O bairro é excelente: fica a meio caminho do aeroporto e do centro de Chicago!

I appreciated that Mr. Porter allowed me to reschedule my stay during a family emergency and offered kind words. For that, I’m genuinely grateful.
That said, the property itself is absolutely not worth the $2,500 price tag. It’s located on King Drive in a rough neighborhood, and walking in to see the door lock hanging off was unsettling. There’s a large red stain on the carpet and another stain on the sofa that should have been cleaned long ago.
The home is not accessible for older guests, as there’s no main‑level shower. A few days before my stay, I was also told that towels and washcloths wouldn’t be provided — which is unreasonable for anyone flying in.
While the house has charm, it’s old, dusty, and not well maintained. Tile and grout were grimy, and overall cleanliness was lacking. Mr. Porter seems like a kind person, but this listing feels like a grift at this price. Nothing about the property justifies the cost, and I left feeling hustled.
Great place close to downtown and quiet at nights with parking! Loved it

The location is good, walkable to the Chicago Art Museum and Cloud Gate, easy bus to the Navy Pier. And there are restaurants and supermarkets.

The staff at the entrance, Wallace, he is extremely nice and helpful.

Lovely spot, excellent location, perfect for my Chicago stay.

Fantastic stay for our family. Spacious and comfortable, with plenty of surprise touches and available amenities to make things easy traveling with kids, like plenty of extra linens, towels, and blankets, white noise machines in the bedrooms, a stool for our toddler to safely access the sink in the bathroom, great washer/dryer duo, and well stocked with all basics, from shampoo and toiletries to laundry and dish detergent. Well furnished with plenty of comfortable seating and tons of natural light from corner location. Location in the neighborhood was PERFECT… very close to tons of restaurants, parks, and stores, and steps away from the Lincoln Park Zoo, while still being on what felt like a secluded corner with minimal traffic and a very secure parking spot. Couldn’t have been a more comfortable and stress free city stay. We will absolutely look to stay again next time we visit Chicago.
My family had an amazing stay! There was lots of room, several games to keep everyone busy, and lots of things within walking distance. Host was extremely responsive and made our stay comfortable!
Great location. Was able to hit all of the neighborhoods we wanted to visit very easily. Parking space is a definite plus.

This place is in a very convenient location. Lots of shops within walking distance. You can hear the traffic, but that wasn't a huge issue for us. The host responded quickly and was able to answer any questions we had.

Artsy and beautiful little apartment in a safe and quiet location. Very clean and homey, and Aleks is a responsive and welcoming host. Overall excellent location, space, and host. Would stay here again.
The host was very responsive, helpful and friendly. Location felt very safe with many people and families always outside walking. I would recommend this place to all my friends and family.

The location was great. We loved having access to the garage and not worrying about parking. We also love the close accessibility to the bus and area restaurants. I really enjoyed my stay. It was convenient, quiet and Benjamin was so helpful. It’s such a great location if you want to stay outside of the downtown area. Easy walk to buses and trains and the neighborhood has a lot of bars and restaurants to walk to.

My co-worker and I stayed for a week to attend a trade show. With separated sleeping rooms and two bathrooms it is very convenient for this. i had a wonderful & beautiful stay.. it felt like im staying at a famouse artist appartment. comfortable and clean soft bed was waiting for me after a late night galavanting.

Had a great stay at Mindy and Tony's place. They are very welcoming and their home has a great aesthetic and was perfectly clean. Would definitely stay there again.
Great place to stay that is close to a lot of things! V comfy stay!

We had a wonderful stay at this charming Chicago home on North Sawyer Avenue! From the moment we arrived, everything felt welcoming and well-prepared.

The short walk or quick bus ride to the Brown Line at Kimball or Kedzie also made exploring the city a breeze.
The place itself was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The neighborhood felt safe and vibrant, with easy access to great local food and shops. Our host was responsive and helpful with any questions we had.
We truly enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you for a great stay!
Exactly as advertised.  Terrific.

This place worked out well for our trip with a family of five. It isn't too far from transit or from I-90, so it's accessible to attractions throughout the city.
The host communicated everything we needed to know before we asked - proactive and just in time!
I'd stay here again if needed.
Was perfect for our quick stay and easily accessible to lots of attractions!

We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. Thank you for your hospitality!
Great spot close to the train!
Nice place and great stay experience. Excellent location

Wir waren zu zweit für drei Nächte bei Eduardo und Lois und es hat uns unfassbar gut gefallen.

Great house for our multi-generational family of six spending a week in Chicago, touring colleges and seeing the sights. Easy walk to the Fullerton L, grocery stores, Oz Park, and tons of great restaurants and cafés. The house is lovely and comfortable; we especially enjoyed the kitchen and cozy family/entertainment room. We did note some wear and tear, and encountered some mildly unpleasant odors near the laundry (our hosts attributed this to the 19th century plumbing in the neighborhood, so perhaps a common issue in the area—they were very responsive to this and other minor issues during our stay). Other reviews have noted the early-morning noise from the adjacent alleyway, which occurred every weekday during our stay—light sleepers should be aware. Nonetheless, we enjoyed our stay and would return!

The place was clean, exactly as pictured, and in a great location with easy access to the train for getting around the city! The host was extremely responsive and helpful throughout my stay, especially when there was an issue with a beeping smoke detector.
The one thing to be aware of is the noise. As some other reviews mentioned, the building is directly next to the above-ground train, and you can definitely hear it. It's also near a hospital, so there was occasional ambulance noise as well. The host thoughtfully provided earplugs, and I found that running both air conditioners helped create some additional white noise.
If train noise doesn't bother you, I would absolutely recommend staying here! Overall, it's a well-maintained place in an excellent location with a great host at a reasonable price.

Great place to stay on our quick trip thru town. A 1.2 mile walk (about 30min with 2 young kids) from Millennium Park and the Art Institute. Museum Campus is only about 10 min. We felt safe in the area and it was well lit at night. The unit had everything we needed for easy meals and sleeping. Overlooks the pool which would be nice with older kids you can trust to send down and still watch from the window. We would definitely stay here again.

had a great stay!  Was very comfortable

I would absolutely stay here again.

Exactly like the pictures. It has nice amenities in the master suite like a steam feature in the shower and a jacuzzi bathtub. The rooftop area is a nice feature that we enjoyed with nice weather. We felt safe on the property since the doors were heavy and there were bars on the lower windows and a tall fence surrounding it. We just Ubered everywhere, so it was fine. It's about a 15min Uber ride from the downtown and River North areas where there is a lot to do. Overall, would recommend!
Jummy’s place was as described, good ambience for a desirable holiday in Chicago. I’ll recommend this for you should ever find yourself in the Chicago area.

The location was walkable and very close to an "L" station. The common area would be improved by having an additional chair and bar stools that fit better with the eating counter provided.  We were a group of 4 and appreciated that we each had our own bedroom and bath.  In addition, the view from the unit was very nice.  I would most definitely stay at this location again.
Hanna and Mark's listing was exactly as pictured. Hanna was super responsive and checked in often to see if we needed anything.
Just what we were looking for. Visiting Loyola University for the week and perfect walking distance. Everything was just as described and very well kept. Beautiful place.

We chose this airbnb for the location, which is excellent, and we were won over with Jacqueline's attention to detail and care. For our family of 4 (with 2 teenagers) the location was close to so many great Chicago restaurants, shopping, and activities. We were all so happy doing things together and separately. This location meant a lot to us because before we had kids we used to live/work/play in Wicker Park/Bucktown/Ukranian Village/Logan Square. This location doesn't get much better! Pro: This little ground floor apartment was beautifully appointed, funky and very comfy. It was surprisingly well equipped with enough kitchen utensils, cookware, dishes, etc, that one could really just move in and stay. The actual access to the apartment was clearly communicated and not difficult. All in all, a great place in an amazing location.
Con: I'll start by saying, it's my fault. I didn't see the check-in time on the listing. Caution: you're flying in on a redeye and exhausted, note the absurdly late 4 pm check in time. Plus, no where to keep bags while you shuffle around like a zombie. The closest bag storage place is a 25-30 min. walk, 4 bags will cost you $30-50. The owner makes it clear there is no early check in. I've traveled worldwide for 30+ years, multi-x yearly, mostly staying in homestays and never seen such a late checkin. These days, 2-3 pm is standard, and many places will let you in if the place is ready, even if being met by owner. Nope. No exceptions here.

My family came to Chicago for a reunion. This place was able to accommodate so many of us (with four bathrooms) with giant rooms and some double-sized bunk beds. The kitchen was not outfitted entirely for a lot of cooking, but it did have a nice stove. The dishwasher did not have a door on the compartment to hold the powder, which makes for less clean dishes. No problem, we washed by hand. There was no water filter in the pitcher for filtering water, so we just drank tap water. There will always be things that we would want to be different, but on the whole we were very happy. The building is just a mile from the National Mexican American Art Museum. It is 15 minutes from the Pink Line train to get to the loop. The bus on Cermak was a stone's throw from the building, which could take us right into China town. There were lots of friendly neighbors with pets. I would definitely stay here again.

Having rented a number of AirBnB and VRBO properties over the last 8 years, I would describe this one as the best value I have e perienced thus far; especially in Chicago: a LOT of nice house for the money!
Spacious, clean, great area. Thanks!

Muy lindo apartamento en un barrio muy lindo de Chicago. Con ómnibus cerca para moverse rápido y a toda hora a downtown. Súper lindo y recomendable. Nuestro único punto fue que la cerradura de la entrada al edificio no funciona bien, y nos llevó tiempo poder abrir la puerta.
We enjoyed our stay very much! Thank you for hosting us
great and easy location
The apartment is clean and the view of downtown is great.  About a 20 minute walk to McCormick Place for conventions.  Lots of choices for food within a minute or two.  Overall, a good place to stay.

Overall, we had a good stay and were pleased with the Airbnb. The space was clean, comfortable and matched the listing in most respects, making it a great place to stay.
The only downsides were related to parking and the basement. When this was booked, we were under the impression that parking was included and a necessity for us ( which was accounted for since we were in city). However, only street parking was available and it was consistently full making it difficult to find a spot. Additionally, the basement had a noticeable musty, mildew smell and there were visible signs of mold on the bathroom shower curtain that should be addressed.
Despite these issues, we still enjoyed our stay overall. With improvements to the parking information and attention to the moisture and mold concerns, this would be an even better place to stay. I would stay here again if ever in the area so definitely still leaving a 5 star review.

Erica was an amazing host and her home was very comfortable to stay after getting off from work. The shower was a plus, room was clean smelled really good and the air conditioner was cool and comfortable. I had the pleasure to meet Erica in person and she was very kind and welcoming always checking in on me everyday to see if I needed anything. Will definitely come back again!
This place was exactly what I wanted. It’s quiet and lovely and clean and has a lot of space and trees out the windows. Walking distance from one of my favorite Chicago neighborhoods. Perfect.

This has to be one of the best airbnbs we have ever stayed in… so great we stayed an extra night. We were in town for a concert and getaway with plans to return Thursday. We loved the space so much we decided we wanted a day to just enjoy the apartment. With that night available, James was super flexible and we booked it with ease. The whole space is wonderful. There’s an ear in kitchen or a dining room table. The couch in the living room was so comfortable for a tandem World Cup marathon. We walked to a great coffee shop James suggested and tried a Hawaiian place in the neighborhood. We are back in October for another concert and will absolutely stay here again.
Marjorie was very communicative and helpful!

The house is in a very calm and peaceful neighborhood. They made sure the house was clean for my stay with everything in place. What I loved the most was the touch of vintage with modern aesthetics. The host was friendly and responsive to queries.

Patricia was always so helpful and really was a very attentive host. You can tell that she knows what she’s doing because everything has a very smooth process. It was perfect for a single person, but they were multiple beds. If other people wanted to stay it was perfect for me. I was there to live stream for Tiktok so it was a great location to get to all of the hot hotspots and a nice place to come back to once I have been out all day. 10 out of 10 would highly recommend.
Well taken care of and close to the city and Navy Pier.

Enjoyed this place. Was on a solo trip for combo work and play. TJ’s place was just right and a great value. It’s a cozy and comfortable apartment that had everything I needed. The best part is the location in Old Town. A great area surrounded by lots of cool restaurants and bars. Multiple grocery stores just blocks away for basics. I could get some remote work done during the day and enjoy the area in the evening. The host was very communicative and checked in a couple times to make sure all is well. I would definitely stay here again. Would also be great for a couple’s getaway. I recommend.
Basic apt. Good for a few nights
Great stay thank you for a nice memory
The garden flat was exactly as described.

I’ve stayed at quite a few Airbnb’s and this one did not let me down at all Thaer always responded to whatever questions I might of had and was very helpful the place the very clean and easy to find also close to the airport. Highly recommend staying here for a vacation!

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was spotless, beautifully decorated, and in a fantastic location that made exploring the city so easy. The host was communicative and everything was exactly as described. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Easy to walk to Loyola and many things were walkable distances. Target and CVS both just around the block.
Nicole and Matt’s place was lovely. Exactly as described and located in a convenient location. Super clean. Very responsive. Good instructions for each check in. Would stay again! 10/10!

Carla’s apartment was perfect. We loved the space. The layout was very nice.
Horner Park across the street is an excellent bonus!

My daughter had a wonderful stay in this lovely, exceptionally well-appointed, spacious apartment. The hosts could not have been nicer or more thoughtful. So many special touches. The neighborhood is fantastic for great restaurants— Bar Roma,Jinji, Lady Gregory’s—, shopping, Women and Children First Bookstore. Great vibe all around. And free parking right in front.
Super last minute and was fast and responsive. Would stay again , what you see is exactly what you get. Rare these days, would and will book again. Host is awesome!

Very nice place, excellent location just outside the busy area of Randolph and close to Fulton market. Train was noticeable but not bad, especially with noise machines. Overall had a great stay and would stay here again if we’re back in Chicago.
This place is good to stay if you planning your activities in downtown Chicago.. For us there was always parking available in front of the unit.. Overall i recommend this place.

Long’s place was charming, fully functional, well equipped and at a great location. Not quite in the city but super accessible via public transport or car. Quite spacious and convenient free parking, proximity to Devon, Bucktown and old town make it a great location to stay. We stayed 10 nights and it became a home away from home for us. Highly recommend the place and the gracious, super responsive host.
Good location for easy walkability.  Nice doorman building.

Good Apartment, But we weren’t told there would be no refrigerator at the time of booking, it took 1 1/2 Days until we got it. There also was a roach under the refrigerator. We did not receive any compensation!
Nice place. Would recommend it!

Devin’s place was a cozy and beautiful place in a wonderful neighborhood. The home was clean and comfortable and we enjoyed sitting on the covered porch during a thunderstorm. I couldn’t recommend Devin’s home enough. We will be staying here again when we come back into town.

Gloria was super friendly and always responsive to any questions we had. Along with a super easy check in system since we were unsure what time we were going to get in. The room was very comfortable and the bathroom was very nice too. Highly recommend
The loft was very cute and clean. Close to everything. Safe quiet super friendly area!! Will definitely book again next time we travel to Chicago!!! Thank you both!!!!!
This place was amazing. I would stay here each time I want to book an Airbnb from now on.
It was a fabulous few days at Justin’s place! Super clean. Bed was so comfy. Very quiet. Lovely stay. Highly recommend.

So happy I found this spot in such a cool neighborhood. Everything is walkable, trains are nearby, and the space was clean and tidy with a great kitchen and clean bathroom! Ryan was very responsive and gave great instructions and local recommendations for the area. Would recommend.
This was our third stay at the property. It’s always clean and uncluttered. We find it very beneficial having the designated parking. Parking can be a challenge in the area.
Great location and decent price for the time of year.
Great historic townhome right in the middle of everything! Easily walkable to lots of activities for our family.  We enjoyed our stay! We'd love to come again when we visit!

Great place. Refrigerator was stocked with random items. The hosts dad let me in, very interesting guy. Wish I had time to talk more! Only made coffee and used the microwave, but the kitchen looked well kitted out.
it's available the next time i need to spend time at the convention center, I hope it's available.
Thanks

Had a great stay at Brandon’s place. He was very accommodating regarding my delayed flight and early morning arrival. The home is beautifully designed with incredible rooftop views and is super close to the bus line. Highly recommended!

While the hosts were responsive in the chat, the property had several severe issues that significantly impacted my stay.
The check-in was delayed.
The main entrance door did not lock properly, presenting a major safety and security concern for myself and my belongings until it was fixed.
The apartment also lacked basic cleanliness; I encountered cockroaches and found a secondary kitchen sink completely clogged with stagnant, dirty residue from before my arrival. There was also a constantly beeping smoke detector.
Managing these structural, safety, and cleanliness issues took up a considerable amount of my limited vacation time.
Additionally, the washing machine, which is listed as being "in unit", is actually located outside the unit. There are also no windows in the bathroom, no hand-held shower hose, and there is significant noise from the building's staircase and the surrounding street, where every movement can be heard. I cannot recommend this property.

Brian was a wonderful and very responsive host. The place was clean and had all the necessary amenities. Absolutely loved the location. Also, loved the convenience of having food delivered to the location as well. Would definitely like to stay here again if we are ever back in town.
The room was clean and nice, conveniently located walking distance from UChicago campus. Communication was quick, clear and easy. Highly recommend!
Loved the place. Great location and responsive host.

This place was great! The neighborhood was lovely. The airbnb itself was nice and clean. Would happily stay here again.
The only downside is parking can be a little difficult to find in the evening, but the place is still worth it!
It was great place to stay for a girls weekend! Also, thought Jose was patience and responded quickly to anything we needed at the moment!

Kareem was a great host and a joy to talk to. He truly goes above and beyond to keep his guests comfortable. The transit lines are easy to access so getting to the city is easy. I can’t praise him enough!

Great place, very spacious and cozy. The terrace was a great place to hang. Wifi always worked great. Location is ideal for taking the blue line and being near hip Wicker Park. Blocks around the apartment aren't as interesting, but I do recommend the wraps at Krasa 2 blocks back, they're amazing.

I feel so lucky to have found this Airbnb!  Ebony and Ean are both very friendly and accommodating, and the basement area for the guest was spacious, very clean, and quiet. The value was also amazing, especially considering that weeks in advance of my stay many of the nearby hotels were either completely booked out or cost at least three times as much!  A surprising bonus: the pillows on the bed also were also more comfortable than any I've ever had before out of dozens of hotel and Airbnb stays.

Everything was so amazing! The rental was beautiful and well taken care of. The location was amazing and made my trip. Was able to walk a beautiful neighborhood with great options and also grab public transportation down.
Our stay was wonderful for the price and location! Perfect for a couple to stay in and explore different areas of Chicago.
Malo
I loved it thanks again will be booking again

We loved staying at Inge’s place! It was exactly as described, clean, cozy and in a great location. inge and her team were so accommodating and responsive. Would definitely recommend friends or family stay here
Good place to stay. Awesome view and the host is responsive. I would stay here again.

We enjoyed our week long stay at Dena's dog-friendly home in the Logan Square / Bucktown area! Great area with coffee and bagels nearby, on a quiet street, and a grocery store and walgreens all <5 minutes away if you need anything. Close to the blue line CTA to get downtown. We enjoyed the fenced backyard with grill and garage where we could park our car. The house itself has tons of charm and thoughtful touches, clearly a beautiful older building with lovely modern updates and renovations. Plenty of space in the house for two couples, and the kitchen is well equipped for cooking meals. Reminds me of the good old days of airbnb when people opened their homes to others and shared local experiences. Would happily stay again.
Easy check in, great location, and quiet space. It was the perfect home base for exploring Hyde Park!

Coty was an excellent host. He went above and beyond to assist our team throughout our stay, including promptly helping resolve an issue with the remotes. Although we experienced a few minor issues with the iron and fan lights in the bedrooms, Coty made every effort to ensure we were comfortable. The place was also clean, well-maintained, and provided a very pleasant stay for our team.

I loved my stay at Philip's place. It's a beautiful home, the studio is well outfitted and every little thing in place. It was super clean, nice amenities, and the a/c worked great! Highly recommend and definitely would stay again.
Great host. Would stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay at Daniel’s Coach House. Beautiful neighborhood, walking distance to restaurants, shopping, University Of Chicago.Our trip was to Visit our granddaughter in Grad school at U Chicago. We really fell in love with the area. I  highly recommend Daniel and his Coach House.

During my stay, noise levels were quite high at various times, often exceeding 40 decibels and sometimes reaching over 60. I could hear conversations and daily activities from nearby rooms and the hallway, making it hard to relax. The air conditioning added even more noise.
The building has no elevator, so upper floors require stairs, which may be inconvenient. The WiFi was unreliable, with frequent disconnections and slow speeds.
The towels had a noticeable odor, and the thin walls allowed sound to travel easily, reducing privacy. The surrounding neighborhood in this part of Chicago has some safety concerns to consider.
Great little space! Hosts were very communicative.
Heather is a great hostess. Extremely responsive and clear with instruction. The house was very cute, clean and well decorated. As a bonus, parking was a breeze!
Great space, great location, and the space is as-described. Would recommend!

Lovely, well appointed and naturally-lit space with plenty of room. Excellent location within walking distance to many restaurants and shops, while still being on a quiet, tree-lined street. MJ was very communicative and responsive. Would definitely recommend, and I will certainly stay here again.

I was so happy and satisfied with my stay! It was a really great deal especially if you’re looking for convenience and a clean space! Sharon is exceptionally friendly and overall a great host. I would definitely come back to this city, and choose this bnb again in the future.

A great place to stay.
It's conveniently located near bus stops and several restaurants. Amelia was very communicative and always checked in through the chat to make sure we had everything we needed.

Inessa was extremely responsive, checked on us during our day, which is appreciated. We had a bit of a rough start to our vacation with two other bookings and this one was a god send for us. The place was so cozy and homey, it was in a great location, close to the venue we were at for a dance comp. We are grateful for our experience at this location. Even our daughters were extremely happy with our stay.
Nice place to stay and the host was very nice and responsive. Very walkable as the place is close to everything.

The apartment was as described and very spacious with everything we needed. The communication from Anthony and his team was very good (we needed some assistance with the app that controlled the entry for the building and apartment). It was great to have the gym on the same floor!

Cyndi was a phenomenal host with great communication before during and post stay. The property was in a secure building with front desk staff and walkable location, never used transportation. Comfortable with all the amenities you need. We look forward to our next stay and highly recommend.

Great place. Clean and comforatble. Exceptionally close to China town and dozens of restaurants. Close to station for travel into town. Great base to access.
Children loved the fairy lights and hanging chair

Overall, we had a good stay and would recommend this Airbnb, especially for the price. The location is excellent—very walkable with easy access to public transportation and nearby attractions. The apartment was clean, and the value for the money was 10/10.
There were a few downsides to be aware of. The building is close to the train tracks, so it can get noisy, especially if you’re a light sleeper. The hallway also had an odd smell, and the Wi-Fi wasn’t very reliable during our stay. Despite those minor issues, the cleanliness, location, and affordability made it a great overall experience.

This place was a great option for just a couple nights for my boyfriend and I at a price that wasn't outrageous... However, any longer wouldn't be suitable.
As others have listed, the water pressure is pretty horrible, lighting and electrical in general were not all that great, the pillows were a joke, and the walls and ceiling are insanely thin. The neighbor upstairs could be heard doing everything throughout their day and late into the night.
I was grateful we were only there for a short while because otherwise it would not do. The location is amazing, and the space itself could be really nice with some adjustments and more realistic images on the Airbnb listing. Thank you for the stay nonetheless, we loved our visit to Chicago.

Sarah's place is hands down the best AirBnb we've ever stayed at. I should add that at times parking could be a problem, but we were always able to
find a place no more that 1/2 of a block away. Very secure place. Stocked with everything and more, including children's games and puzzles, and
beach needs. And the place was spotless.

This place was lovely and I definitely would stay here again! Abacus was great at communicating with me to make sure I got settled in and if I needed anything! Such a great communication throughout our stay.
I really enjoyed the stay. We had a great time!  The location is great.  Would book again.
Loved the space and as a bonus, there’s an amazing restaurant below!
Great location for commuting by bus. The place was very clean, and the host was responsive and provided recommendations on things to do around the city..
Carlos was very quit with the responses when I needed help or had questions. It was very nice and even provided complementary sanitary pads for me and my female cousin.
the bed sheets were super soft, and we were provided towels, shampoo, conditioner, and body wash! it was basically a hotel experience without the insane costs

The front desk staff was so friendly and helpful. Maria and Jose we're great. Building felt safe and secure.
Older building with character. It was a little noisy but that's what you should expect in the city. It was a great location, right off mag mile, close to the water and beach, easily walkable to shopping and restaurants too.

If you are new to Chicago, this location is in "The Loop".  Michigan Avenue (shopping) is a bit of a walk.  Otherwise, right off on south Michigan Avenue and probably 2-3 blocks to "The Bean".  Nice view.

Song was a wonderful host: friendly, responsive, and always answered questions in detail. It's next to the rail although it did not affect my sleep.
The location is great, right in Chinatown with plenty of great restaurants nearby. It's also close to McCormick Place and conveniently located for exploring downtown Chicago. Recommend staying here!
the kitchen and living room areas were clean, it is just the bathroom. it seemed like the other tenants weren’t that clean. other than that, super nice and convenient that it was next to the train.
Couldn't ask for a better location! Very nice and clean apartment. I would love to stay there again when back in Chicago.
The most place was perfect for a getaway with my granddaughter. Easy walking distance to a lot of attractions. Felt safe.
Nice space in great neighborhood.
Milan was an excellent host, extremely responsive, and very helpful throughout the stay.
Nice place. Good location. Host was responsive. Thanks for the stay.
As always great stay Eric! Be back soon! Thank you!
Natalie was a wonderful host! The place was beautiful, super comfortable,  stylish and spotless. We had a blast and would highly recommend. Check out time was a little early (10AM).

Such a cute place! First thing we noticed when we walked in was that it smelled amazing.
The clawfoot tub was great after traveling for 8 hours AND after the concert I attended. And I appreciated the extra stuff in the bathroom since I completely forgot my ENTIRE bathroom bag in Michigan.
Reinitta was super helpful after I absolutely couldn’t figure out where the key code was located in the messages and super patient with my siblings and I getting to Chicago way later than planned.

Amanda was an incredible kind, responsive, helpful, and extremely knowledgeable host! Her place is a hidden gem in my favorite neighborhood and was a sanctuary stay. I loved the plants and flowers, inside and outside-the coziness of the bedroom - slept sooo good here and the over all the energy was so good💎
very nice living experience
This is a solid value for a basic, reliable apartment. Ming’s place is centrally located, near great restaurants (Mexican, Italian, Thai), with easy access to public transportation.

The place was as is in the photos. But it could've been better.
When we arrived, the place wasn't clean — there was significant amount of animal hair, what appeared to be animal urine, and the bed sheets hadn't been washed. We reached out to the host and asked them to send someone to clean.
The host did respond and sent a cleaning crew, but the cleaning was incomplete and on top of that, the crew left additional mess behind after eating our food out of the fridge. I asked the host to send in a different cleaning crew since the original cleaning wasn't done properly and wasn't being held up to expectations of the listing, but I guess the host couldn't find a different cleaning crew. That usually diminishes the experience at a listing, more than it provides.
It made for a really uncomfortable stay for me and my colleagues. If you have allergies or are sensitive to pets, definitely keep that in mind before booking.

The Good:
1) Location
2) Everything you need
3) Elevator
The Not So Good:
1) The building is old & you can hear footsteps louder than anywhere I've ever been. Before 6am, loud footsteps can be heard over both of our phone sound machines... & you could hear them past 1am as well. It was so consistent that I wasn't sure it was possible from only the neighbors above us, maybe the hallway as well... But always oddly loud.
2) The shower is really annoying... getting the right temperature takes several minutes & it's easy to go way too hot or cold if you try to adjust after getting in... I had to set the temp for my wife each time & the right temp somehow sacrificed pressure as well.
3) Parking - it's Chicago & the host did advise me to use SpotHero app which could have saved me $24 had I accepted the price the night before check in, but I waited & we ended up paying $70 for less than 48 hours to park across the street where I had multiple loads to bring in from a week long road trip.
We stayed here for two weeks and it was the perfect space. The whole apartment was very clean and well appointed, the beds were comfortable. Building is very secure and the neighborhood is great.

We loved staying here, the apartment was beautiful and looked exactly like the photos. So many thoughtful little touches from the artwork to extra blankets and pillows made Jason’s place feel comfortable. Our family of 5 had plenty of space and we loved the location. Just a few minute walk to the train made it easy for us to explore Chicago. We really appreciated Jason’s recommendations and enjoyed a bunch of places in the neighborhood. We also ate breakfast twice downstairs in the long room which was not only convenient but also delicious. I highly recommend staying at Jason’s place and we will definitely stay again on our next trip to Chicago.
I really enjoyed this condo in central Chicago. It could definitely have suited a large group, but even for the two of us it was a great stay! Plus an easy parking spot- we’d definitely return :)
Very nice location with clean maintenance. We will definitely come back again!
Book it! An amazing stay. So walkable, close to transit. Steps from the beach. Always felt safe, and the space was family friendly too. Thank you for hosting us for a relaxing week Walton Residence.
Great experience, nice host.

Ewa is an amazing person
Very friendly helpful

Will always recommend Ewa !!
Will stay next time n always
Safe neighborhood,  quiet, host was very responsive & overall good services!! Thank you, Gio.

Pros: (1) It's a well-furnished and clean apartment. (2) The host was very responsive. The Cons outweigh the pros: (1) The most terrible and life-threatening situation was that the building staircase had no light when we checked in. The lights were broken. The stairs on the backside of the building, and hence do not receive a speck of light during the day. At night, it is more terrible - it is just pitch dark. This unit is on the second floor, and the flight of stairs leading to it is extremely narrow and steep. To top it off, as there were no lights, it was indeed life-threatening and horrible to go up and down. The host did not mention this to us before we checked in. It was extremely difficult for us to maneuver up and down the stairs with the stroller and our bags. (2) Suddenly, one morning, someone accessed the unit, and we were just shocked. (3) I think this is a company that manages several units in the area. It might be that you are talking to different people through the chat

This was the perfect place for our sales leadership meeting! The home comfortably accommodated all 8 of us with a great bedroom and bathroom layout. The theater room was an ideal meeting space—the projector and sound system worked flawlessly, even for teammates joining remotely. The location is fantastic, with several restaurants within walking distance. The owner also owns a nearby Italian restaurant, and when we couldn’t get a reservation elsewhere, he got our group in, which was greatly appreciated. The house is full of personality, with a vintage jukebox, theater popcorn machine, hot dog roller, and everything needed for popcorn, hot dogs, and s’mores. Those thoughtful touches made the stay memorable. Our team loved it, and we’ll absolutely be back for future Chicago leadership meetings. Highly recommend!

The location of the apartment is amazing and a great value!  The surrounding area has plenty green space and park setting.  The neighborhood felt safe.  It was a roomy two bedroom.  There's a nice beach quite close with a bar and grill.

My family of 4 had a great time staying at Plymouth Chicago. We used the pool table, roof top patio, and workout room during our stay in addition to enjoying our unit. Host was proactive, easy to reach to via messaging, and very accommodating. Location if a great central point for moving around town and exploring the city. We will definitely look to stay here again if we visit Chicago in the future!
This was not my first time staying in one David's apartments. All of them are great and I highly recommend staying if available.
Beautiful surroundings and very clean. Our host Larry was very welcoming and Super friendly. We enjoyed our stay. We highly recommend!

Overall our stay was good but we did arrive to the deck and hottub  being covered in used beer cans, towels, old cigar and dirt in the hot tub. It seems the cleaning crew didn't get to cleaning the deck before we checked in (30 mins prior to the 4m check in time, which was agreed upon with Tom). They ended up resolving this! The other noticeable issues were the beds while appearing to be made had hairs under the comforters on all of them, except for the master bed, and one of the bunk beds had half drank Gatorade and water bottles from the last guest. This concerned us that the previous guests may have made the beds themselves after using them and then the cleaning crew thought the bed were not used and did not change the sheets. Sheets should always be thoroughly clean each time no matter what in my opinion. However, Tom was very nice and responsive and willing to refund the cleaning fee. The space was nice and as pictured! My group had a great time, good location, great parking!

A nice and functional apartment with a lot of light. Close to the blue line and buses. We also enjoyed the possibility to use the fitness in the building. The communication with Ben was easy and friendly.
Great host, great house, great location, would recommend and would stay again!

Place was super wonderful. Spacious. Giant closet. Washer snd dryer.  just comfy and pleasant, pretty felt like home.  location is great. cant beat it. Host is super responsive and I had to change my dates and they made it so easy. It’s a great great place.  STAY HERE!
the place is great

Stayed here during a Cubs away week, but it’s literally just a two minute walk to Wrigley Field. Lots of great places to eat or go out for a drink in Wrigleyville and Boystown which is also in walking distance.

완벽한 시카고의 숙소였어요! 우크라이나빌리지는 정말 안전했고 저녁에도 버스 또는 도보로 이동할수 있을만큼 안전하다고 느꼈어요. 다운타운까지 버스로 한번에 이동도 되고, 유크라이나빌리지 근처 맛집도 많아서 참 좋았어요. 그리고 가장 놀랐던건 청소 상태에요. 먼지도 하나도 없고, 화장실 샤워기에도 물때가 하나도 없었어요. 이런 청소상태는 정말 놀라웠어요. 침구도 정말 깨끗하고 집도 러블리했어요. 5점만점에 6점을 주고싶은 숙소입니다.
Parfait pour visite à Chicago. Proche des transports pour rejoindre le centre ville.

We enjoyed our stay at this unit. 4 adults and 2 kids fit nicely, with enough chairs for all. There was even a rollaway bed we didn't need. Location can't be beat, and 2 bathrooms is so helpful. Train noise didn't bother us; it was there, but not loud. When we arrived there were only 2 bowls but we contacted the manager and they got additional bowls delivered right away; very responsive. The included parking was great (we parked when we got there and didn't move our car until we left!) and instructions were clear. One thing to note: there are not blackout curtains over the windows, so you will get light in at night.
Over all experience with our stay was great. Perfect location.
what a lovely place.  big space and very comfortable. great location great neighborhood

We also faced significant noise disturbances during most nights and early mornings. Although we informed Taher about the situation, there was unfortunately nothing he could do to resolve it.
The noise levels were consistently high, to the extent that we were unable to sleep properly on many nights.
Responsive host and clean space in a nice area

This was our second time staying at Helen’s place while we were having some renovations done to our house. The apartment is cozy and offers plenty of room for cooking and hanging out. Beds were super comfortable. Coffee shops and restaurants are easy to walk to, and a convenient bus line as well. Would definitely stay again!

Great place and great location.  Went to the theater (TimeLine), strolled down Clark Street,  and went to the beach.  All easy to do.  I couldn’t find the hair dryer and Robert got me a new one within an hour.   Had a great time.

We had a fantastic stay at Gustavo’s place!  Perfect for our family!  We were very comfortable and felt right at home.  Gustavo was always very friendly and responsive.  Would love to stay here again the next time we are in Chicago!

Fine stay. Reasonable price based on Chicago prices. Not a place to hang out at.
My room needs a table lamp. A more comfortable couch in the main room would be nice.
Nearby park and groceries were helpful.
Great spot located in a quiet neighborhood. Perfect spot for a couple or even a small group. Great local restaurants, and really speedy response times from the host. Would definitely recommend
We had a lovely stay. Easy connection to the city centre and nice and peaceful area to stay in!
Good location, plenty of free parking, a spacious and clean room, and an overall great experience. Everything was excellent. I highly recommend it and would definitely stay again.

The home was nice & clean . Felt safe in the area it was in . & the home looks exactly as pictures and it is super spacious ! I would definitely book again on my next visit to the city of Chicago thank you !
excellent comms and very clean. lots of games and other amenities, even a sauna. would stay again

However, here is a half bath conviently next to the room on the third floor in case it is needed in the middle of the night. I had a great visit and will look to stay with Terry next time I'm in Chicago.

The location was great and it was walking distance to a lot of food and bars. The unit is 4 floors tall so there’s a lot of stairs. We booked this trip last minute, and our host was amazing. The place was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and in a great location. We’d definitely stay here again!
Danny did a great job!  Exactly as described - only leaving out the fact there was a great ice cream place just steps from his front door!  We'd absolutely stay there again. Thanks Danny!

Peter's place was fantastic. the bathrooms felt brand new and everything was exactly as pictured. We could not have been closer to Wrigley yet the neighborhood around the apartment was quaint and quiet. Would definitely recommend staying here!

As for where you sleep, there are multiple bedrooms and (I assume) each have their own bathrooms. I stayed in Room 4.
My room was perfect. A single room with a nice sized bathroom.
Just two blocks away is a great coffee shop and a great bar that makes killer tacos…both with cool vibes. I’m sure there are other great spots, but I wasn’t able to explore that much due to work.
Definitely a great value. Would recommend to anyone visiting Chicago.

Nothing but positive things to say about staying in Lois and Eduardo’s lovely Victorian home. Exactly as pictured, clean, comfortable room. Responsive and welcoming hosts. Peaceful neighborhood with good walkability. Felt safe and at home. Will definitely be back!

The Plymouth Building is located in Printer's Row in Downtown Chicago, a prime location for walking, located on the bus-route with the train 1/4 block away for those wanting to access neighborhoods outside of the downtown area.

Both had closets to store clothing--one with a window facing out to the street, and the second with a 3/4 wall to allow in light. This unit has a full stove, microwave, fridge and dishwasher if a visitor would plan to cook in. In unit laundry is also available with an ironing board available, an appreciated amenity for travelers.
There are additional shared amenities including a gym, pool tables and dartboards on the main level plus a lounge with ping pong on the rooftop. A gorgeous view of the city was available on the rooftop as well, with ample seating, a fire table, and even a barbeque grill.
Building is well secured with coded access at the front door and for each unit.

really really nice place to stay! very close to the bus stops and near grocery stores and restaurants and places to get coffee

Clean and beautiful place. Nicely decorated, comfy beds/couches, and kitchen was fully usable with cutlery, spices, etc. Host has very good communication, and was transparent with all aspects of the stay. Thanks for a wonderful stay!

Lovely apartment, walking distance to shopping, restaurants, Wrigley Field, Boystown, transit train, and located on a beautiful tree-lined street. Every detail in the flat has been thought out—from toiletries to board games. I will book again on my next visit to Chicago.

This place is truly a gem! From the moment we arrived, we felt safe and comfortable in the neighborhood, which made our stay even more enjoyable. The host was wonderful: very responsive to every question we had and incredibly accommodating by trying to get us into the Airbnb early, which we truly appreciated after our long drive.
Overall, we had a fantastic experience and wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again. We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago!

Our family had a great time at this Airbnb!  We enjoyed the location and space. Would recommend this place for people who are not light sleepers or picky about sounds from the train. We were able to park our RV and stayed for 2 nights. No complaints here.

House is easy to find with clear instructions on check in, spotless with all the amenities listed. The place was amazing 👏. Definitely 5 star. Great location for business or pleasure. Easy to access downtown from public transport and walking. Beautiful surroundings and place. I'll definitely come back.

David is truly a Superhost! His communication, recommendations and desire to make certain our stay was a 5-star experience was greatly appreciated.

Notre séjour chez Christiane et Patrick a été tout simplement formidable. Des hôtes adorables, d’une gentillesse et d’une convivialité rares, toujours extrêmement serviables. A few friends and I extended our stay in Chicago and had an excellent time here.

Bianca was excellent at responding, and I highly recommend this stay if visiting Chicago.

Had a wonderful stay at Sarah's place! Very nice neighborhood and within walking distance to grocery and bus lines. Hosts were extremely accommodating, and the space was the perfect size. Hope to stay here again!

It was also located near a cute grocery store and bakery we liked visiting in the mornings as well as a fun Ukrainian restaurant. Highly recommend staying here!
Would definitely come again and recommend to everyone I know! One of the best stays, and space is bigger than looks in the picture and my 6’1 bf had no problems walking around :)

The design is perfect: ingenious use of limited space, good aesthetic choices in the remodel, and comfortable furniture (though the bed might be too soft for some). Nearby are many restaurants, one of Chicago’s best coffee shops (Colectivo), Lincoln Park, and the lake. The area is safe and very walkable and to get downtown there are buses and, a bit further away, the elevated rapid transit railroad. And the host was proactive and responsive. We would not hesitate to choose this apartment on our next visit to Chicago.
Daniel's place was a great stay for my family coming to visit me in Logan Square. Everything was clean, the neighborhood was great, and we loved the deck. Would definitely recommend!
Great location and responsive hosts.  Highly recommend for trips with family.

Was great. Would stay again.

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was a great location, and we really enjoyed our time there. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others.

I would stay at the airbnb again in a heart beat!.
