Parking on site was clutch, but I would not recommend for a large car. Getting into the parking lot from the alley was tight, but doable.
Comfortable bed, and living room furniture, nice big TV. Hot water in the shower was instantaneous! Everything in the apartment was super clean. Very grateful for the coffee maker and coffee pods.
Great communication from the host. Proactive and responsive. Self checkin was super easy with plenty of photos of everything. Central AC and a ceiling fan in the kitchen area kept it very comfortable. Building was quiet.
Thomas was very responsive and generously let us leave our car in the parking spot behind the building for about an hour after checkout so we could have a final breakfast with our son before heading out.
Beautiful and clean place to stay. Everything is like the Description.
I had an amazing stay here wirh my two friends! Brandon gave clear instructions, and the house was spotless, we had a lot of fun playing pool during our stay

a sweet spot - loved all of the intentional stewardship done to the land and the animals. the area didn't have much to do within walking distance, but there was easy access to the train and some decent bikeable areas. a little noisy with the nearby trains. overall, a nice stay for something on the more affordable end in Chicago

Fenton was a fabulous host during our stay in Chicago. He was incredibly accommodating during check-in and responded promptly whenever we had a question. The home felt thoughtfully decorated and welcoming—not like a typical rental put together just to generate income. It was comfortable, quiet, easy to access, and in a great location. We would absolutely stay with Fenton again—10/10 experience.

ubicación genial.
espacio perfecto
solo que entraba mucha luz por las persianas. no tenía black out era incómodos en las mañanas, puesto entraba el sol.
el baño me imagino que por los otros huespedes estaba sucio y desordenado.
puse para dos personas y me dejo una toalla pero bueno es mi novio asi que pudimos usar la misma

The garden is beautiful. The interior is pretty, but cramped and tight for two people. Location is close enough to everything, but 15/20 min walk to anything good. There is a "utility" room next to the kitchen that is not in the photos. The host did not make it clear they would be accessing the room during our stay. It appears to just be part of the airbnb (and this is an entire home listing). There is a door inside that says fire exit do not open or alarm will sound. I don't care where I stay I want to lock the door, so I put something in front of it. At 10 pm on Sunday they came in, made a huge noise, woke us up, and scared us. Took us 15 min thinking the place was haunted before we figured it out. When we asked them about it, Heather was rude and unapologetic. If you have a weird little room - explain it in the online listing (buried in a printout it refers to it as a community room which has no meaning during a quick read). If you do something like this - just be nice about it.
great communication, great guest, great appartment
Nice clean place and David was fast with his responses.
Loved the accommodation! And the thoughtful touches - snacks and the range of teas / coffees with the Keurig. Would definitely stay here again next I’m in Chicago.

What a wonderful place!! Marla & James were so kind to us during our stay. We traveled with our two dogs and stayed for a few nights. The instructions for parking were very clear, the place was very clean and well decorated, and the hosts were absolutely amazing people. If you are ever in Chicago, this is a must stay! We would love to visit here again in the future.

This was an amazing place to stay! Easy walk to Wrigley field, restaurants, and the Red Line Metra train. Parking spot a plus and huge, comfortable living space with lots of towels, bedding and coffee making supplies. Yes you can hear the train. Did it bother us? No! Would love to stay here again!
This house is in a great location- very clean with updated kitchen and bathrooms. Would  definitely stay here again!
Affordable, super clean, pet friendly, and quiet! Loved this space and would definitely stay again! Thanks y’all!

This was my second time staying at this airbnb… I love the private bathroom in the rooms. Room was clean and bed was soft… never knew I liked firm pillows until I stayed here. I would stay here every time I visit Chicago!

I do not recommend this place, especially if you're visiting for work or attending an event at the convention center. At approximately $330 per night ($660 for two nights), I expected a much better experience.
The windows are very thin, so you can hear nearly every vehicle passing by, and the busy street makes the noise even worse. On top of that, the room only has sheer curtains and no blackout curtains, so it gets bright early in the morning, making it difficult to sleep. The bed was also not comfortable at all. You can also hear people talking in the hallway while they wait for the elevator.
The towels did not feel clean, so I chose to use one of my own T-shirts after showering instead.
Lastly, the internet was slow and unstable, which did not match the description in the listing. Overall, I did not feel this stay offered good value for the price I paid. Based on my experience, I felt the overall quality was closer to what I would expect from a property costing around $100 per.

I had a short stay in Chicago but absolutely loved the spot. It’s close to the city and the area felt super safe! I loved the Airbnb my only thought was the main bedroom didn’t have a door which felt a little strange but the place was stunning, clean and the hosts are so detailed with descriptions on everything! If I’m traveling solo to Chicago again, I would definitly book this Airbnb!
It was absolutely beautiful!!

Cute place in a really charming neighborhood with historic homes. The neighborhood was decked out for pride month. Walkable shops nearby and about a 25 min walk to the redline. Parking was surprisingly easy and the place was clean.

The apartment was comfortable and clean. I really appreciated the nice beds and extras in the kitchen. Our host was also very helpful by storing our luggage while we explored the city. The location is close enough to great restaurants and the river that you can walk. Would definitely stay here again if I'm in town.
Good area and good airbnb to stay at. Close to metro line and has good shops and restaurants nearby.
Easy person to work with and he’s very communicative and understanding.
Cute place, plenty of room to stretch out. Thoughtful little touches like skylight shades in the bedroom made my stay feel like home.  Sweet neighborhood too!
Wonderful place for the price! Definitely will be back!

The apartment was exactly as listed. Clean, up 2 flights of stairs, bedroom and bathroom with doors, and small living area with open kitchen. We read the reviews beforehand and all the complaints from previous reviews had been addressed - one person said there was no cutting knife, coffee/maker, sugar, etc but we found all of those items upon arrival. The bathroom was in excellent condition - we found no leaks as a previous tenant had described so that must have been addressed as well. So close to amazing delicious Vietnamese and Ethiopian restaurants, a really fun cafe just downstairs, walking distance to the lakefront, famous jazz club "Green Mill" with live music every night of the week. The only tiny thing we realized we needed was a corkscrew to open a wine bottle, and the host had one discreetly delivered the next morning. We parked our car using the SpotHero app for a very reasonable rate in the open lot the host recommended on Winthrop, with in/out privileges. It was perfect!

Reed was a great host. Super responsive and flexible on the check in and check out times.
He gave me a place to leave my suitcase for a few hours after checking out. The place was newly renovated and in pristine condition. The bed was comfortable and there were plenty of extra towels. Huge closet as well! The apartment is in a great location and walkable to a lot of the sites.
Your windows will face the street but it’s very quiet so didn’t bother me at all.
Place was super nice and made for a great spot to stay if you’re ever going to an event at united center. Definitely recommend.

Yolanda was super nice and sweet! Any issues or questions I had, she responded immediately. When we checked in, the kids wanted to play a game and we noticed the TV was not working. She immediately came over and replaced it with a brand new one! I also loved having garage parking, and the place is in a nice area, centrally located around a good attraction. Highly recommend!
place was exactly as described.

Lovedddd our stay at Gabrielle’s place. We felt immediately at home. Cozy, comfy, in a great area. An easy 10 min walk to the blue line. Great space, and great communication. Would highly recommend staying here
location was perfect. i/2 block to Lincoln Park and 2 blocks to Conservatory and Zoo. Also..1 block to Clark St and tons of bars, coffee shops. restaurants.
We enjoyed your place clean and comfortable.
Awesome place, great location, clean, spacious, and functional. All of that in a nice neighborhood.
Beautiful place, exactly as described, great neighborhood, super nice host. 100% recommendation. Looking forward to my next stay there.

I travel for business and the North House was perfect for me. Clean, peaceful, easy to come and go, and less than a half hour from door to downtown on the Metra. I had 3 days in Chicago as a solo female traveler with no car and felt very safe walking in the area and on the train.
Richard and Cathy were kind in accomodating my changing arrival time and generous in their recommendations and directions.
The space itself is charming - a garden level apartment that looks out on a real garden(!)- and well-maintained. I especially appreciated the firm mattress, super soft linens and tranquil household vibes.
Very close to McCormick center. Nice and simple.

My family and I had a great stay at this apartment. The place was beautiful and the views were amazing. The primary bedroom in the back with the en-suite bathroom felt very private and the teenagers enjoyed their own space in the other bedroom and sofa bed in the living room. The location was very convenient to everything we wanted to see and do. The “bean” was a 5 minute walk away. You can faintly hear some traffic and train sounds, but that’s to be expected in the heart of a major city. I slept great in the comfy beds. I would definitely recommend this place!
Awesome condo in a great neighborhood. Very clear communication during the whole process. I would stay here again and it was great for my family with the downstairs area.

The location and space were beautiful. however on closer inspection everything was wobbly and minor details were off. we noticed that a lot of the shared space furniture was wobbly and the end tables were wobbly. there was a scary door leading to the backrooms in the basement of our unit. the supply closet was kind of locked so we couldn't get extra supplies if we needed. the basement shower drain was slow as well so having multiple people shower consecutively was a big problem for us. the beds were comfy and the kitchen utensils were useful. the space was cozy and comfy if you didn't sit on the barstools. the roof access felt rude to take though in the hours you would want to go up there, mainly later at night. my biggest gripe without nitpicking was the upstairs neighbor pacing vigorously from 11:30pm to 12 ish am. he did it every night we were there. I know the first night we were silent and the second we may have been louder but we had daytime activities to attend so that was scary
I’ll be staying again next Chicago trip. Great location, had everything we needed, very easy stay.
Great view, clean place, and close to the riverwalk.
Good stay!
Perfect place to stay for our weekend trip. Loved the location and the Airbnb!

Bianca was an exceptional host from the moment we booked until the day we checked out. She was friendly, responsive, and made the entire experience seamless. Her home exceeded all of our expectations—it was even more beautiful in person than in the photos. Every detail was thoughtfully put together, and the space was spotless, comfortable, and incredibly welcoming.
The property had everything we needed for a relaxing and enjoyable stay. The amenities were excellent, the location was convenient, and it truly felt like a home away from home. It was clear that Bianca takes great pride in providing a first-class experience for her guests.
I can't say enough good things about our stay. I would absolutely book this property again without hesitation and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a beautiful, well-maintained place with an outstanding host. Thank you, Bianca, for making our trip such a memorable one!
Great location and very clean! Easy check in/out process and never an issue finding street parking close by.

The apartment is spacious and modern with many beds. Everything was clean. We had everything we needed, and lots of towels. We were able to cook breakfast at home and find all kitchen appliances, as well as oil and spices. It was easy to find a place to park in front of the house. The location is just a 20-minute drive to the city center. The instructions were detailed and clear. It was easy to get inside.
Executive stay in Chicago, wonderful views.

We had a great stay! Tom was friendly, responsive, and provided excellent recommendations for the area. The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. It was in a quiet neighborhood, and had nice walkable restaurants. We really appreciated the hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Highly recommend
Great location that is close to Wrigley Field, local restaurants, and the train. The hosts respond quickly and are incredibly helpful. We would absolutely stay here again!
The apartment was just as expected! My tip is  just be careful where you park. I parked somewhere for 15 minutes and got my car booted and had to pay $170. Everything else was great!
No issues at all

Ping was very helpful and communicative. The studio was clean and comfortable. The elevator wasn't working during our stay, but Ping made sure our room was accessible for us. The location was convenient and walkable.
Nice cozy place

The K2 building was everything we wanted for a city staycation - great location, amenities (kids loved the basketball court and pool!), and easy parking. The unit was comfortable and gorgeous with plenty of room and a well-stocked kitchen. We will be back!

This is one of our top three airbnb experiences! The apartment is so clean and so well-equipped. Sometimes hosts provide things just for the sake of providing them, because something is not easy to use or not in good condition. However, here we feel everything is designed to make our stay as comfortable and enjoyable as possible.
The host always reached out proactively and was responsive, organized.
The location is really great. The building is next to the L station, and the line provides direct access to both the airport and Union Station without any transfers. There's also a large, affordable supermarket right across the street.
If we ever return to Chicago, we would absolutely stay here again!

Great stay in a great area of town. Very responsive host and easy and clear instructions. Wish we had more time to enjoy the rooftop but it was within walking distance of the sears tower and even navy pier if you’re ok with a longer walk. Pretty close to a L train so a little loud from that and just general city life but never kept us or our kids up. Bring a sound machine if you’re a light sleeper.
Great stay!

Run. Don't walk! The home is nestled in a quiet community. It's a 10 minute walk (or so) to public transportation. Patrizia was an absolute gem of a host. Her home is warm and she was very accommodating the entire time. I will book again when I return.

We had a lovely stay at Karen's for our girls trip! Communication was a breeze, the place is lovely. It's only a few block walk of a quaint area with food, cafes, etc. It was a 10-15 minute Uber to many great neighborhoods with cafes, restaurants, and things to see/do. If you're looking to experience Chicago without being right downtown, this is a great, accessible option. Two memorable bright spots were Mella's Ethiopian Cafe and Kopi Cafe & Shop - check them out!

Super nice place, wonderful host. Great location! Close enough to most everything but not too close to the noise and chaos of the city. A good place to decompress after a long day of walking around the city. 😊 I wish I booked more days! I recommened checking it out.
Really loved this unique spot. Recommend noise-cancelling headphones / earbuds for the noise from the train, but it did not disturb anyone's sleep too badly.
My mom always loves staying at Jane's place when she comes to visit Chicago. Jane is so kind, communicates well and her place is so nice and in a wonderful location.
Amazing place!

The place was just as described and pictured, We all appreciated the cleanliness and how we all loved the location. The security was terrific and covered parking a bonus as it did rain some. Highly recommend staying here. Actually we will stay again really close to places we liked and our son's place.
In a walkable area with lots of places to eat.
Great location. Cute well stocked place!
Had a nice stay! We felt super comfortable and enjoyed our time there.
Great place !!!
Victor was totally on point and willing to help with anything I needed. Chicago was awesome and the location was perfect for running around and exploring :)

Great place for the price. Beautiful area and nice to have the whole apartment to ourselves. Super close to the train, so be warned if you’re sensitive to sound. Earplugs were provided, which was kind.
Great place!
We had a wonderful stay, would absolutely stay again

Great place to stay! It was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host was friendly and easy to communicate with. Great location and within walking distance of restaurants and shops. I would stay here again.

This place located in a great part of town and is walkable to the train and other public transportation. Daniel was extremely responsive and helpful. It met all of our needs and we would definitely stay here again.
I had a wonderful stay and it was lovely to meet Scott. The house was clean and in a great location. Would definitely stay again.

Overall, the place is great. Clean, close proximity to restaurants, etc. in Old Town, well-appointed. New building is nice as well. I feel inclined to mention it is right across the street from a fairly massive low income housing complex, though so be mindful.
J was always very helpful. I would definitely stay again in this Airbnb!

very comfortable place if you dont need much :) cozy and clean beds, amenities listed were fully functional, constant and clear communication with hosts if anything additional was needed, and i felt safe with the security system in place. location is nice and quiet, with a few things within walking distance worth checking out! lovely spot in chicago, with lovely people all around. thanks to the hosts for making my stay easy and relaxing!
Overall a good stay and good value for the location.
Great place.  Would totally stay there again!
Great place. Good location, price, clean.
We had a great stay in Noels apartment. The place was clean and quiet. Excellent communication with the host. Overall a great experience.

We had a great stay! The home was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Communication was easy, and everything we needed was provided. We had no issues during our stay and would definitely recommend this property to others. Thank you for a wonderful experience!
I had an amazing stay! Everything was perfect and Loong was very friendly. The neighbourhood is great. Highly recommend!

The property was clean, spacious and has the most stunning views of the city. Check in was simple and easy, and our host was great to communicate with. I would highly recommend staying here and hope to do so again next time we visit Chicago!

Great rooftop! A little overpriced- this is managed through a third party so the response of the “owner” is always someone informing you they are asking. Takes a while to get actual information. For the price, having a missing cushion on the rooftop, a half cleaned grill, and the lack of paper supplies was a little crazy. There was only one roll of toilet paper per bathroom when we stayed for 5 days. To pay 3k and have to bring paper towel from my house felt cheap. The upfront messages about our stay felt like we were staying with a military officer and definitely felt like they were trying every way to penalize the people staying there.
It ended up being fine! a bathroom per bedroom was convenient. Overall it was fine! Just some annoying cheapness since its not run by the owner.

The accommodations and the convenience to local restaurants and other attractions exceeded my expectations. Host was extremely responsive and very proactive to ensure that the check-in, the stay and the checkout process went off without a hitch.  Would gladly stay at this property again and would highly recommend it to others!!

Lynette and Efrain’s place is a great place to stay. It is exactly as described and the hosts are super response. The place is a short walk to the blue line train station which can take you to O’Hare and downtown.
Easy and straightforward check in and check out.
The only reason we did not give this place 5 stars is the creaking floorboards from the flat directly above and the very thin walls.
Looked exactly like the pictures. Very cozy and clean with everything you could ask for in a kitchenette. Josie is extremely kind and accommodating, I would definitely stay again!

Good food spots near by! Easily accessible to local stores and restaurants by foot, bed was comfy as well! Would recommend if looking to find something affordable but not necessarily in the heart of the city!

Super fun unit in a fantastic location. Easy walk to cafes, restaurants, train, etc. Kelly was a phenomenal host who went out of her way to ensure we had a great check-in and stay. Would definitely stay there again!

We loved David's place! It was unique and beautifully decorated. It definitely is a hidden gem! The beds were comfortable & the house was in pristine condition. We would absolutely stay here again! It really is a neat place that is on top of a vacant office space. Check in was incredibly smooth with very clear instructions. There is a local coffee shop and neighborhood bar within walking distance which was a plus!!
cons:
•it did get a bit noisy at night but that is expected being directly off the street. However, a sound machine was already provided which helped tremendously!
•it got a bit hot at night but could be because the AC unit is in an odd position with the bed pushed up against it
•not the best location if looking for easy access to public transit (15-20 minute walk to the nearest station)
Overall, these cons would not deter me in staying here again. Despite these very minor issues, we would return!

The positives: the neighborhood was nice, walkable, and felt safe. The listing photos were accurate, and the unit generally matched what was advertised.
Unfortunately, our stay was significantly impacted by cleanliness issues. We observed multiple German cockroaches (approximately 9) in the kitchen around the sink and counters, which caused us to end our stay early. There were also other cleanliness concerns, and the exterior/common areas around the unit did not appear well maintained.
The host ultimately arranged for pest control after we reported the issue, which I appreciate. However, communication was slower than expected, and we were disappointed that we were not fully reimbursed despite cutting our trip short because of the roach problem.
Overall, while the location was good and the photos were accurate, the cleanliness and pest issues made this a disappointing experience.

Chicago is a mass transit city, and this studio apartment is a quick walk to several trains. We used the L lines to go to museums, music venues, great restaurants, shopping and even a day at the  zoo! We slept well on this quiet street.
We loved the neighborhood and how close everything was! The home is cozy. The beds are very comfortable.
The location is very convenient. I really enjoyed the quiet, clean space during my stay.
We had a great stay in Chicago and were very comfortable here.

Fantastic stay in a great Chicago location — walking distance to amazing restaurants, shopping, coffee, and pretty much anything you’d want. We were there for a girls’ weekend and had plenty of room for everyone. The bedrooms are on the smaller side but very comfortable, and the beds were seriously great. The front bedroom also had a really nice view. Everything was spotless, and the place was cute and well put-together. The host had everything we needed (including coffee!) and communication was excellent throughout. Would definitely stay again.”

This place was perfect! We just had a two day trip to the area and it was exactly what we wanted. The place was cozy and was full of cool high tech stuff that we loved. It was fully stocked with necessities and coffee which we really appreciated and was super clean!
Excellent! Thank you!
We loved Casper’s place! It was perfect for our needs, clean, and Casper was 10/10. Highly recommend staying here if you’re looking for a place in this area.
Clean rooms, well maintained house.
Great agent to help find hotels for cheap. This hotel an additional fee on top of what airbnb had. Just to keep in mind. But over all, staff was amazing and helpful
Vin was a great host and very responsive toward all the questions I had. The unit itself was very peaceful, and clean and looked just like the pictures. Would definitely return.
Clean, looks exactly as listed
Michael's place was extremely peaceful. It is spacious and very comfortable. Looks just like the photos. The neighborhood is quiet and walkable. Lots of street parking. Would highly recommend :)
Apartment is beautiful and all the rooms are incredible!
Clean, modern, and with a convenient location, walkable to the blue line. Was a very comfortable replacement for a downtown hotel for this work trip. Great place!

We had a wonderful stay and Khadija was the sweetest host! The apt was spotless, fully stocked and was in a great location. We had everything we needed for our stay! Location is about a 15 minute walk to the brown line. If you’re looking for a place in Albany Park, this is it! We can’t wait to come back!

Harry place was great. Really spacey place. Unbelievable location.
Would Def stay again.
Amazing experience!!!
Amazing place to stay and we always had an open and continuos communication with the host.

We loved our stay!
This was our first time staying in the Lincoln Park area, and we absolutely fell in love with the neighborhood. The location was fantastic—we were able to easily walk to the zoo, and within just a block there was a great local pub, a restaurant, and a deli that became our go-to spot for coffee and breakfast sandwiches each morning.
Our host was wonderful to work with. They were easy to reach and responded to any questions we had almost immediately, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
The kitchen was exceptionally well stocked and had everything you would need, especially if you're planning a longer stay. The bed was very comfortable, and our kids had no complaints sleeping on the pull-out couch. There were also plenty of extra blankets and bedding, which was a nice touch.
Overall, this was a wonderful place to stay, and we wouldn't hesitate to book it again the next time we're in Chicago!

Great location, with easy walking to multiple restaurants. We also walked a half mile to the United Center for a fantastic concert! The free parking spot was also a game changer in Chicago’s ridiculously pricy street parking. A quiet (apart from the occasional Green Line L Train in the background), comfortable, clean location. Recommended!

The place was very nice and clean. No complaints. It’s a shared place but I never ran into anyone. You can slightly hear others on the top floor but not enough to disturb my sleep. It felt like a stay at a hotel but better. Best stay I’ve had so far in Chicago.
Was very nice to stay at! beautiful place, very informative instructions. great place, perfect distance from a bus stop that goes right into the city. Great time staying here!
Very nice place to stay and would stay here again ☺️
Great location, clean, front desk was helpful, the hot tub wasn’t working is the only complaint but I would stay there again as the location was perfect and the views were amazing.
Great place. I just hate there was no free parking besides street parking. I got off work after 5pm and finding parking was hard. The host was great and responsive though. Would definitely recommend.
As advertised, very comfortable bed and nice bathroom

Everything about the rental apartment was perfect. Our only issue was we were under the belief that there was a yard that we could take the dog on a leash and pick up after. We have a suburban dog that is not used to doing his business on city sidewalks. We would not have chosen the location if we knew we had to take him all the way to the park (4 blocks or so) each time he had to go. Other than the confusion in the description we were satisfied with everything. Ian was very quick in getting back to us with any yard confusion. We are sad that we can't choose this location again.
Excellent stay, lots of room and very comfortable. great spot too!
Responsive host, great area wi the lots to do, clean home. I’d stay here again
Had such a beautiful stay at this air b&b. Very clean and beautiful space and the host was so responsive very quickly with any questions we had.

I stayed here with my husband and two children.  It was very cozy and we had a wonderful time here. We walked to eat at multiple restaurants and there is also a small park close by too. We will be back!

A great stay here. There's lots of restaurants a few blocks away for dining out, the apartment itself is very nice and public transit is only a few minutes walk from here to get around the city if needed. This is a perfect place to stay in one of the best neighborhoods of Chicago.

Carla is AN ABSOLUTE GEM and I mean that with my whole chest!! 🙌🏾 This home has SO much personality and is beautifully decorated, great energy, quiet street… it was a total vibe from the moment we walked in. I traveled with my two adult kids (21 & 22) for the Automate Conference (and food) and this place was the perfect home base for all three of us. There were two bedrooms so I gave my daughter the queen and bunked up with my son. Honestly? One of the best parts of the trip. 😂
We had a little emergency during our stay and Carla was there in less than an hour and handled it immediately and made sure everything was taken care of before she left. That kind of response says everything about who she is as a host. Would I stay again? Absolutely, without question. Five stars and then some! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

¡Que hermoso departamento! En verdad tiene todo lo necesario para una familia grande.
Estuvimos en van y estacionar a lado fue complicado, pero josh nos ayudó a encontrar parqueo cerca.
Todo increíble en verdad.

This is a really beautiful space in a beautiful location. Walked everywhere! Great amenities with dishwasher and laundry. Negative was difficulty finding lockbox to get in and it was dark and raining and no markings to identify lockbox. They are very strict about any noise with multiple reminders sent regarding that. On another positive, they responded quickly to any messages!
Great stay for what we needed it for! Convenient and not far from lots of places.

This BnB was so good it made me want to move to Old Town! The atmosphere was so cozy and clean, the kitchen was stocked with teas, coffee pods and snacks, and all the included appliances made me feel right at home. With the unit being an actual apartment It was great to feel like I actually lived in the space I was staying in. Thank you to David and the Trove team for a wonderful stay, 10/10 would come again.

도보로 버스 정류장이 가까워서 좋았어요

Das Apartment liegt im ersten Stock des Einfamilienhauses von Kitty, in dem sie im Erdgeschoss lebt. Man kann von dort zu Fuß Busse und die U-Bahn in circa 15 Minuten erreichen. Die Straße ist ruhig und es ist eine sichere, freundliche Umgebung mit einigen Restaurants und auch einem kleinen Lebensmittelgeschäft. Das Apartment sieht genauso aus wie auf den Fotos und war tipptopp sauber. Kitty war immer erreichbar und hat uns sehr warmherzig empfangen. Die Betten waren bequem. Kitty hatte immer kleine Wasserflaschen und Snacks im Eingangsbereich stehen, an denen man sich bedienen konnte. Als einzige kritische Anmerkung wäre zu erwähnen, dass der Küchenbereich stets einen seltsamen Geruch hatte, und dass der Vorgarten und auch der hintere Garten des Hauses, ungepflegt wirkte und im hinteren Garten, Müll und Unrat verteilt war, was eine unangenehme Atmosphäre verbreitet hat. Die Wohnung selbst war jedoch tipptopp sauber.

Overall, this place was exactly what I expected based on the listing. It's a small space, but it's clean, functional, and very affordable.
There is noticeable airplane noise and typical neighborhood sounds (cars, people talking, etc.), but that didn't bother me. The window A/C unit is also louder than I'm used to, coming from Texas where central A/C is the norm. If you are a light sleeper, bring ear plugs.
The check-in instructions were clear and helpful. My only suggestion would be to include a few more photos showing how to get to the entrance. This was a great place to stay while visiting Chicago. I was looking for an easy clean safe place to sleep while in the city for work.
Great place to stay!
easy to find, very convenient location, the apartment was great.
Very cozy sleep and the apartment also smelled very good and clean with convenient transport with the Green line right next to it. Very respectful host and overall amazing Airbnb❤️

Stayed a week and loved it. The unit was extremely clean and spacious, the kitchen came stocked with coffee and oatmeal, and it was quiet and peaceful. I was pleasantly surprised by how quiet it was despite being next to Wrigley Field. The only negative I have to say about the place is that the wifi was pretty poor. I couldn’t take video calls for work as it was too slow and I got intermittently disconnected. The hosts tried to reset the router to help but something bigger was wrong. Otherwise, truly awesome place to stay and I’d stay again assuming the wifi gets fixed.

This place is great, especially if you like a little country living in a busy city. It was a lot of fun to see the chickens every morning and the cats would greet you every night. I would definitely stay here again!
Excelente espacio, la vivienda es fresca y moderna, cercana a los medios de transporte de la ciudad. Recomendado.

For our first time in Chicago being from the south, it was a good place to crash. It’s right off of Kennedy Expressway, easy to walk to the trains/bus stops. The place is exactly as shown in the photos, parking was easy and always available. We opted to park on Balmoral ave across the street. Neighbors were quiet and neighborhood in general was very nice! Best part was walking down to the Yellow Rose cafe for breakfast one morning, and the people there were awesome.
The major and only complaint I have was the smell. As soon as we walked in, we were hit with a strong smell of cat litter and it didn’t go away the whole time we were there (4 days). It is partially underground, so with no consistent air circulation, it stayed stale and smelled bad. Not sure if it was due to previous people who stayed, but that really did ruin it from being a 5 star review. Other than that, it was worth the trip and cost
Vivianas place is very conveniently located between the airport and downtown Chicago. We loved our stay!

We had a fantastic stay at David’s place and highly recommend it! David was an excellent host he was very responsive and made check-in/check-out a breeze.
The house is beautiful and even better than the photos. The kitchen is fully stocked with high-quality dishware, cookware, and glassware. The neighborhood is quiet and lovely, just a 5-minute walk to the “L” for easy access to the whole city.
We parked our car in the Weiss garage around the corner, only 87.00 for 4 days. David does provide free street parking passes and it seemed like getting a spot would not be too difficult.
Everything was perfect—thank you, David
The space was clean, the host was very welcoming, it was very convenient given how close it was to the red line.
Great host!
Conveniently located. The place was a perfect spot for our family to relax and enjoy what Chicago has to offer.
This is a beautiful space. Easy and great instructions as well!

First off Brandon was a great host, very accommodating and a quick replier. He gave us lots of good recommendations around the area. The area was quiet and safe, we walked to the train everyday, a bit of a walk but there are buses close by you can take instead.
The unit was as described and all we needed with comfy beds.
Wonderful stay, quiet neighborhood and near a lot of fun places for us to explore. Would highly recommend this place, comfortably fit 7 people and had everything we needed and more.
We enjoyed our stay with private bedrooms for the four of us .Great kitchen and living/ dining room area for post ball game get together.
Good
We are a family of 6 adults and one 17 month old.  The house was so nice and comfortable and had everything we needed.  The game room was super fun.  We would definitely stay here again!!!
We had a pleasant stay. The house was clean, the neighborhood felt safe, and check-in was easy. We appreciated our time here and thank the host for their hospitality.
This was a beautiful home and the host was amazing everything was perfect the basement was everyone’s favorite place

Location good. Simple but comfortable, unfortunately extremely noisy neighbors above. Till very late at night both nights if they could correct that problem it wouldn’t be a bad little place to stay for the price.
Very clean and quiet neighborhood really close to the main city the owners are very responsive and they responded within an hour or 2

Colby was a great host. She made me feel really welcome and we shared some great conversation. The place was really nice and clean, the bed was really comfortable too! Really easy to get downtown from here too.
Súper bueno tranquilo
I loved my stay. It was so cozy the apartment is beautiful and feels super chic. I would recommend the stay to anyone interested. Has a great location very walkable to many restaurants and shops.

The apartment had everything we needed, and made for a nice stay! It was in a quiet neighborhood, with a lovely coffee shop within a minute walk. The host was always so quick to respond! We would stay here again.

Chanda is a fabulous host who literally thinks of everything. Tons of items available, from any kitchen need, coffee, essentials, drying racks in addition to full w/d setup. A tv in every room. Tons of towels, bathroom supplies and more. It is very well located for those who go to Chicago and want to explore different neighborhoods outside of the city center. Lovely area with plenty to do by foot, cta, uber or whatever you prefer! Place was super quiet at night. Zero noise — which was amazing for being a basement unit.
Angie was very responsive when we had a slight plumbing issue. We loved the many Mexican restaurants in the neighborhood, and easy walk to the train station. Great appliances in the kitchen!

The place was perfect for two people, my friend and I have zero complaints. Super clean, smelled great, and very cozy!! Dan, the host, was awesome, so nice and ultra responsive. We had a little mishap on our last night and he had zero issues trying to help us figure it out regardless of what time it was. 10/10 host for sure and we WILL be staying again in the future.
Great value and location. Super proactive communication.

She was very responsive, had all the amenities she listed, and was very helpful. There was so much parking and she even sent you a parking map! We were wary about having roommates, but each guest had their own key and could lock their bedroom, which made us feel secure. One thing to note is that the home smelled like cats during our stay, even though the listing indicated that pets weren’t allowed. Other than that, Anastasia is a great host and we felt very comfortable!
Thank you so much for the convenience of the earlier access. It made it possible for us to make it to the ball game. One of the highlights of our stay .
The apartment was wonderful.  The noise from the train nearby dampened the experience.
extremely spacious! modern bath. kitchen fully stocked. very responsive host!

Heel fijn appartement in een rustige wijk. Loopafstand van een metrostation waardoor je makkelijk naar downtown Chicago kan! Het appartement had alles wat we nodig hadden, parkeren was makkelijk naast het huis en Hikaru reageerde overal vlot op. Zeker een aanrader als je naar Chicago komt!
Beautiful and quiet stay in a great location
As advertised.  Clean. Good location.  Would stay again.

My wife has extreme allergies to dust, as well as my son. With the level of cleanliness of this location, my wife and son had zero allergic reactions because it was that clean.
I really appreciate the very effective and responsive communication from these hosts. It made for a very enjoyable and stressful free stay.
Perfect week
Great location. Off street parking was important. Found a spot easily every day..
Gregory’s place was amazing, great location and beautiful flat. Would stay again.
Nice place to stay.
Very cool place ! I was surprised how spacious the place was. Will book again soon for sure !!
i loved the stay great place to stay while your visiting chicago the host was very helpful i'll def book this again ❤️💯

David’s spot is perfect for staying in west loop and for getting around. Subway station is next door. Very walkable to surrounding restaurants/bars. David himself is great for recommendations and his instructions for check out and in are very clear. The Airbnb is perfect for cooking if you need a kitchen. We didn’t use it but we had everything we needed if we needed to cook.
Great host and very clean inside. Would recommend 100%

This was a quick 4 day trip to Chicago and I don’t think our accommodations could have been more perfect.
Great location for public transportation. Bus stop across the street, two train stations within a 5-15 min walk.
15 min walk in most directions for food, groceries etc, including Chinatown which was fantastic.
Halfway through the stay we requested a small thing be brought to the apartment and they immediately obliged, it was a lifesaver!
I highly recommend this location for a trip to the City. Had a toddler that used the lower bed all on his own and he loved it.

Beautiful house and beautiful neighbourhood.  Everything was easy to find, clean and Josh responded quickly to all of our questions.  Neighbours were friendly too.  Lots of restaurant choices in the neighborhood and an easy walk to Wrigleyville.  Would highly recommend.
Wonderful

We loved staying here in the heart of Lincoln Park, yet tucked away in a quiet location.  The English Garden was beautiful!  The apartment had everything you would need and lots of extras too - lotion, shampoos, coffee, etc.  We really appreciated Martha's helpfulness and responsiveness.  We definitely hope to stay there again in the future!
Great host! Great stay!
Everything was as expected, we felt right at home. Grocery and restaurants were easily walkable, and we felt comfortable and safe the whole time. Thank you for a great stay!
This apartment was darling and bright! The location was EVERYTHING!! Would definitely stay here again. The big bowl of candy was an excellent added bonus for those with a sweet tooth!! 🍬😎
Good stay
It was great stay with cozy, nice and quiet place. Erica was also really responsive and friendly!

This location was convenient and close to the beach. The apartment itself is extremely cozy. The bed was one of the most comfortable beds. I slept on in a while. I enjoyed my stay here and all of the natural sunlight the apartment provided. The apartment also felt welcoming. I love that there is laundry in the building. The neighbors are so nice.
David’s place was great! Fantastic location and felt right at home. Great if you’re a solo traveler.
The room was clean and nicely decorated but we found it to be too small and too costly
It was a spacious unit in what seemed to be a good location. Nice upgrades throughout unit.  Responsive host.

We had a great stay at Auroom’s place and it was exactly as described. Across from a park with lots of Puerto Rican pride and food. Approximately 1 mile from Logan Square and a shortish Uber ride to downtown Chicago. The place was spacious and the beds were comfortable. Would stay again!
fueron muy amables, el cuarto estuvo muy bien justo como en las fotos y la ubicación es excelente

Our stay was very pleasant. The beds were comfortable, the place smelled good and was clean. It was walking distance to Wrigley field and a bunch of restaurants. Our hosts were responsive and accommodating. We’ll definitely be back.
We were in town for a concert at Soldier Field and this location was amazing! Walkable to Soldier Field and many other places. Host was very friendly and responsive. Would definitely stay here again!

Great place to stay in Chicago!! Very close to the Blue Line so getting around without a car is super easy. Also very clean and tidy spot tucked away in a residential neighborhood! We had a wonderful time staying here and would consider coming back next time we're in the city!

Sarah’s place was super easy to get to, very clean, and perfect for our stay in Chicago. The neighborhood is super cute, walkable, and nearby public transit. Highly recommend this for your stay in Chicago!

While the Concierge is relatively responsive, the approach to maintaining this airbnb is much more reactive than proactive.
For our stay we were locked out twice from our code not working and came across 2 other guests that were also locked out.
There were many issues in the unit that made our stay uncomfortable. The hot water would only work intermittently so sometimes none would come through the sinks. The overhead lights flickered. The shower would leak a bunch of water and soak the bath mat even though we had the door securely shut and the bathroom door didn't close properly so there was no privacy. We also tried using the dishwasher and a terrible smell came from the laundry closet drain so we had to turn it off and air out the unit and hand wash our dishes.
While the Concierge offered to send someone out to fix the bathroom door and take a look at the hot water and dishwasher, these should have been dealt with already and not during our stay.
A little bit too expensive, but it was a decent place. Enjoyed it.
House decor was very well put together.  Great Location.   Great for our family.
Great stay! Location is great with walkable grocery store, restaurants, bars. Ben is a wonderful host and very responsive.

My family and I enjoyed an extraordinary getaway in Chicago over Juneteenth weekend, which turned out to be an exceptional experience. The highlight of our trip was visiting the Obama Presidential Center, conveniently accessible via a $10, 5-10 minute Uber ride. Our accommodations were situated in a historic area of Chicago, radiating a sense of timeless elegance. Since we didn't have a car, Uber was our primary mode of transportation, and we also frequently ordered from Uber Eats. The host ensured our stay was comfortable by stocking the Airbnb with an impressive array of essentials and treats, including snacks, drinks, and other goodies that delighted my granddaughter. The property's emphasis on safety and security was evident, and the abundance of amenities was impressive. Our host's exceptional service extended to offering a personalized tour of historic sites, including the Obama's primary residence. As an Airbnb Super Host, I wholeheartedly endorse this property. Thank you❤️
It was great

It doesn’t take much to satisfy me when I’m on vacation. I’m not even in the room most of the time, so it provided exactly what I needed and was a great price, as well. Public transportation made getting around really easy and there were like 3 bus stops and a train station close by. The place was very clean and even had rules in place for maintaining it in a good condition. The bedroom was pretty small, but I’m one person barely ever there, so I didn’t notice it or think negatively of it. Nicholas was a great host. Very responsive whenever I needed him. Would definitely stay again if the option was available.

We came down from Canada for a concert and baseball game! We had a great stay. Thank you David! The place was in a great, safe location and very walkable to anything we wanted to do.  Thanks so much for a great vacation.
Amazing stay! 5/5
Beautiful home in a convenient location! Leo and Alex’s home was exactly what we were looking for during our time in Chicago. Cute, clean, easily accessible - would stay again!
We loved the space and the neighborhood. Tons to do just within walking distance. Easy check in and check out. Also the private parking in the back was a major plus. Would definitely stay again
great stay! host was very communicative and made everything very easy. :)

Had an extra guest fee tacked on for all three nights when realistically, an extra guest only stayed overnight the first night. We left the place in a great clean condition, and did everything they asked when checking out. On top of that, we were barely there, so their utilities were barely used overall. But of course, they tacked on a fee for all three days just to make a quick buck off of us. Everything in the city was way too far from us for the price point as well. We spent way too much just to uber anywhere. And did I forget to mention a chair broke just from my friend simply sitting on it? Cheap furniture as well. Definitely not worth the price. We will not rent from David again.

Wonderful stay!  Very clean and matches description.  Many restaurants within walking distance.  Rosa was extremely responsive and during an emergency situation on our end at checkout she was extremely accommodating.  Would definitely stay again.
We really enjoyed staying here two nights. The place was clean, inviting, and close to everything we needed.

This was the perfect location for walking to Wrigley. Unfortunately we got rained out, but we still had fun and made the most of it. Very close to Red Line and was able to find a parking lot less than a 10 minute walk using SpotHero app. Apartment was adorable and very clean. Loved the sound machine! Wished there were extra blankets, as we followed the instructions for the AC unit and it never turned off like we wanted. There is only one mirror in there, which was tough navigating with my partner while we were getting reading. An extra surface in the bathroom would’ve been helpful, because the top of toilet was off limits. Overall, we enjoyed our stay! Sheets and bed were incredibly comfy and we slept well both nights.
Wonderful stay. Great location and nice home. Would definitely recommend
Ideal location for less crowds and easy access to Lake Michigan. Walkable distance to train, grocery and pubs. The home is charming and uncluttered and our party of 7 was very comfortable!
Great place. Lots of space. Plenty of towels and blankets. Located under 2 min walk to an awesome local-owned pub Vaughan’s. In opposite direction there’s a coffee shop and bagel store on the corner.
Had a great stay at this unique and comfy place. The location and outdoor space are fantastic. Highly recommended.
One of my favorite stays! Also right in a neighborhood where there is great food open super late and a 7/11 right down the block!
Beautiful property! Great location. 5 stars

The location served its purpose for our trip, but the property itself unfortunately didn’t quite live up to expectations based on the listing photos.
While the space was functional enough for our basic needs, the unit felt a bit neglected and would benefit greatly from a deep clean and some maintenance. The property is quite beat up. Multiple light switches didn't work, the bathroom shower door was off its hinge and hard to move, and there was no ventilation fan. The windows were also in poor condition, including one that wouldn't stay open on its own. Additionally, the back door lock was broken and wouldn't unlock, keeping that door unusable for our stay.
In terms of location, it is a significant walk to the metro station, and some of the areas along the route were not very nice to walk through, especially at night.
Overall, the rental got us through the stay, but it has not been well-maintained. Because of the current condition, I wouldn't stay here again or recommend it to others
Good stay, close to UChicago, affordable and clean.
The rental was beautiful, clean, and in a great location. The neighborhood is walkable and close to Wrigley Field. Peter was so kind and accommodating and the parking spot was so helpful!

Reinitta was a great host! Very friendly and communicative!
10/10 would stay again!

If you’re visiting Chicago and want a place close to everything Milan’s place is where you need to be.
There were a ton of food places in this area.
Milan’s place look just like the pictures.
The instructions that are provide for you are very easy to follow.
I would stay here again and again.

This is a wonderful home and is very well equipped.  This was our second time this year .  The kitchen had everything we needed and they even provided umbrellas and a stroller, plus many other amenities.

Richard was an excellent host! Very good communicator.
His place is in a safe, peaceful neighborhood with shops, restaurants & breweries all within walking distance. Just around the corner from Irving Park Brown Line station which takes you straight into downtown.
Great experience overall!

My group and I really enjoyed staying at Norma's place. The location was perfect. We also really enjoyed how clean the Airbnb was and how communicative Norma was throughout our stay. We'd highly recommend staying here!

Perfect for our stay in Chicago!
Walkable to brown line train station & very close to local shops!
Great location with lots to do in the area! Will definitely rebooking next time we are visiting Boystown!
This is a very nice and quiet place and decorated nicely. It was a little unusual to check into the place the first time, but the instructions were very clear with nice photos.

we had a fantastic 3-day stay at this place. we really liked the grocery store across the street. only problem was the train station - very far away. parking was easy too as the street is not full. there is a tiny sun room at the back that me and my friend really liked. they also offered us 50% off for the first night of our next stay. we will stay here if we come back to Chicago :)
a last minute reservation and I was pleasantly surprised by the communication and how great the place was.  I'm definitely coming back.
Billy space was an amazing place to spend our weekend in Chicago. I would absolutely stay there again in a heartbeat! It was very restful at night and easy to get to the city during the day.

What a fantastic space, one of the best AirBnBs I’ve ever experienced. Everything was beautifully appointed, clean, and well thought-out. It was perfect for my family of four to use as a home base for our visit: convenient to the Blue Line, walkable, and plentiful dining options. Forest was an excellent host. He was always responsive as well as proactive. We hope to come back!

This was the absolute perfect place for our weekend getaway! Walking distance to an amazing beach, lots of great restaurants nearby, easy to hop the Red Line anywhere else in the city. We felt right at home in Rogers Park. We’ll be booking here again next time we head to the city!
Nice little spot with a great location. Grocery store right across the street was very convenient.

This place was great! Was visiting family nearby and this was perfect. It exceeded our expectations. Everything was of a high quality and Maximo was exceptionally helpful. Instructions were great. He even had a blackboard in the kitchen with local recommendations. Definitely a place I would stay again and recommend to others.

Great stay and perfect location for us. Close to family, restaurants and activities. Place was clean, well taken care of and appointed as well as comfortable. Tawney was very responsive to all of my inquiries. Highly recommend this accommodation.
No towels anywhere inside when we arrived. No one at front desk to give us our parking keys. Had to wait for 30 minutes to receive them after paying extra for early check in.

Michael was wondering to work with! Everything was just as listed, clean, and very friendly. He was always very quick to respond and check in. Even gave us some great recommendations too! The home is a fairly short walk to the train station as mentioned. The neighborhood was decent but like most I still would not walk to the train station at night. Would definitely stay again if we are in the area! :)

I really don’t know where to start! The house was very clean and super cozy! Rashad was very quick with his responses. He checked in to make sure we were ok! He gave great recommendations! We’re most definitely booking again! It was an easy ride to downtown and to my family members houses.

Loved our stay, very clean and is exactly as described. Great neighborhood , friendly people and close to many amenities! As a note, entirely my fault, you must read the full instructions about access. I did not page down after the access code. This a multi unit complex, the condo is in the rear. Thanks for the great stay Bai Bing 😊

Good for some extra space including a kitchen with basics, comfortable furniture, but the bedroom was noisy enough to require earplugs (outside noise plus window AC) some wall/ceiling repairs looked unfinished, “buzz in” at building door didn’t work at night, we didn’t get the backup key box option until later, but other residents let us in (which was nice of them but also a security risk) rainstorms leaked lots of water into the stairwell, water was  falling from the ceiling and all over making for slippery steps. The Building’s Maintenance guy was nice and very helpful so that was a plus.

Lucien was quick to respond on anything we needed or questions we had.
When we arrived- we arrived later than expected due to a train delayed. The lock would not work so we had to contact Lucien. He was able to get us in. We did not have toilet paper or paper towels and he had them delivered to us within minutes.
I did report concerns to him like plumping issues- and he was receptive to come up with a solution.
Other reviews discuss a crack in the tub- that is still there. Some overall cleaning could improve. For example, if there could be mold somewhere, there is. Front loader washer, sink, bathroom- things that just require extra cleaning and attention.
This was our first time in Chicago and every single uber and taxi made comments about our location being unsafe and not to come out after dark. This made us very uneasy with our children. The train noise at night didn’t bother us. There are bugs like previous comments mention, but it’s a basement Airb&b.
Xx

We enjoyed our stay at Nathaniel's place. Beds were comfortable. We brought a car and never had trouble finding parking on the street close by. I had a question during our stay and got a quick response back. Keep in mind that the television is upstairs in the loft and the stairs to the loft are tricky to navigate.
My friends and I had a great stay. Nat was very responsive and helpful throughout our trip.
Such a helpful host! One of the people in our group left her water bottle behind and John was willing to ship it back to her. Great place and really positive experience with the host!
Yolanda‘s place was great. Very clean. He would definitely stay here again and recommend it to people looking in the area.
Paul’s place is perfect — exactly what you need for a trip to Chicago. Walkable to so much, near the El, and a quiet and beautiful neighborhood.
We had a fantastic stay! The house was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect, just a short walk to Wrigley Field. We would definitely stay here again.

Heather's place was perfect for our visit! The apartment is exactly as described and super easy to locate. Everything was in great shape, and we especially loved the screened-in porch. The neighborhood was beautiful and peaceful. Heather was proactive and very helpful. We would absolutely stay at Heather's again next time we're in Chicago.
Great host and great home. Quick responses, and very accommodating. definitely recommend!

Great place, very responsive host. They were accommodating of our early check-in as well.
Place is as described and worth the money we paid!
Very nice studio in a great location.
Excellent place to stay. Super clean and excellent amenities. Host was very friendly and very responsive to any questions. Definitely recommend to anyone visiting Chicago.

This rental was exactly as listed and pictured. The host was super communicative and responsive to all needs. We loved the neighborhood and didn’t experience any issues during our stay. Check out instructions were very reasonable.

The apartment is very conveniently located, just steps from the Blue Line metro station and close to stores such as Aldi and Walgreens. It’s a much better option than staying in a suite hotel, especially for a group of four people.

Loved our stay! The location was perfect and close to just about everything we wanted to do in Chicago. The place was easy to find, check-in was super smooth, and the host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Everything was convenient and made our trip even better. Would definitely recommend staying here and would book again!

This place comes as advertised. Three private rooms with shared kitchen, living room and bathroom. No issue getting street parking. Short walk to bus to get to Wrigley.
Nice concept of keyless entry to unit and each bedroom. We had two rooms , the third was rented to a nice fellow.
Kitchen is well equipped.
Rooms are standard with a dresser , bed, desk and closet.
We didn’t spend much time at unit.
The ceiling is low , but not an issue for us.
The other renter was tall and he managed.
The place was somewhere to sleep and make plans for touring the city.
Host was responsive at beginning and end of our stay. I had messaged mid/stay for something that ran out- no reply.
Not a deal breaker.
The room and beds were quite comfy!!
Thanks for making our first trip to Chicago a memorable one!!!!
super responsive host. had a few mishaps and sarah was super helpful and understanding. her local recommendations were great as well!

This is a spacious, comfortable and visually appealing apartment that looks just like the listing photos--which is always a great thing. Great for larger groups and less than ten-minute walk to the train.

Great price for what is being offered. Location is within a 10 minute walk to public transit/bus stop. Neighborhood was pretty quiet and felt safe and inviting. The air bnb was very clean and was easy to get in and out of.
My only request would have been that the remote worked for the automatic shades in the room I stayed in, as when they are down, not much natural light able to come in. However the hosts were very responsive when I reached out about it, and we assumed it was just dead batteries.
All in all it was a very pleasant experience and the situation with the shades wasn’t a huge deal when compared to everything else the space had to offer. I’d high recommend staying here and would definitely return for another stay if I’m ever back in the area!

We loved our stay at this Airbnb. It was a perfect location, and the house was very clean and comfortable. There were a lot of great bars and restaurants within walking distance, and it was a short ride to downtown, the airport, and other desirable areas.  The host was friendly and responsive.

Loved Sharlyn's home!  It's spacious, well-appointed, and clean, and it's also conveniently located a short 5 minute walk to the Blue Line which heads directly to downtown Chicago.  Most importantly, Sharlyn is kind & responsive. I highly recommend staying here!
Amazing place to stay!

The owner was accommodating and responsive throughout our stay of 5 nights. Any concerns or issues we had were addressed and resolved fairly. We truly appreciated their attentiveness and willingness to help whenever needed.
The property offers a budget-friendly experience. While there were some areas that could use improvement, the host’s responsiveness and effort to make things right helped make our stay more enjoyable. If you’re looking for an affordable place and value a host who is easy to reach and willing to assist, this property may be a good fit.
Very convenient! Great Stay.

Firstly, don’t be put off by the neighbourhood. This place is a hidden gem and throughout my trip felt completely safe, and met some great neighbours. The apartment is fantastic. It has plenty of room , and was immaculate. Within walking distance to the Metro to take you downtown. If you do stay here you must try ‘Daleys’. The food is amazing. The host Brandon was quick to respond from start to finish, and always helpful. Thank you Brandon for a great few nights in Chicago

The location was very convenient. We walked to things nearby and felt safe. We are used to the sounds of passing trains so we weren’t bothered by that at all.  My friend who is a lighter sleeper used the ear plugs provided which was a thoughtful touch. We had everything we needed and were comfortable for our 3 nights!

Loved staying in an apartment. Felt more like I lived there than was vacation, which I personally enjoy. Lots of stairs to get up, but felt easy by the last few days. Loved how close it was to west loop. Tons of restaurants and bars. There was a decent amount of free street parking, just had to search. Overall great stay.

Tanto Andy como su mujer han sido dos personas excelentes, se han preocupado en todo momento porque todo estuviese perfecto, y si surgía algún problema solucionarlo lo antes posible. Recomendable al 100%

Very decent place in a nice part of the city! Photos matched and it was a very smooth and easy check in/check out process! 10/10 communication and was very responsive with any questions or inquiries I had! Would book again!
We had a great stay! The space and the neighborhood are so cute and there is plenty to do in walking distance. I would definitely stay again when visiting family in the area.

Nice location. As advertised.  I would stay again. Guest upstairs was load at night.

We spent a long weekend here, and had a great time! This stay was exactly what we needed; great walkable area and close to the CTA. Very cozy and beautiful space, lovely to come back to after a long day out and about! We were here over a busy weekend and the neighborhood still felt very quiet. All in all, we loved our stay! Rahaf was a great host!!

Great Airbnb for a solo traveler. The door was a bit challenging to find at first but was easy to get in!
Henry was very thoughtful by having slipper and toiletries in the bed!
The kitchen was nice and spacious. There were about 3 other rooms with guests right next to eachother but overall you wouldn’t really hear them much and the shared restroom was never really a problem.
The area seemed calm but not sure if I’d walk it. Luckily I was in Ubers while taking the trip.
Overall a solid choice!
