We have stayed in many Chicago vacation rentals, and this one is tops. The condo is in a great location, well-appointed, and bright and airy with its many windows and high ceilings. The outdoor space, however, was our favorite place. We enjoyed coffee in the mornings and drinks at the end of the day on the back deck. A real bonus!
Everything was excellent, neighborhood is unbelievable.
I loved this little apartment! It was perfect for our short stay. I highly recommend 👌

Great space in Andersonville..exactly as described. Plenty of room! Walk to the red line to grab train and lakefront to rent Divvy bikes and enjoy all Chicago has to offer. Walk to restaurants, shopping and cozy coffee shops.

Our family of 5 was perfectly comfortable at Larry’s place. We had a little difficulty getting in the the house, but luckily it was early in the day and Larry was nearby to help.
We had plenty of space to get some quiet time when needed, and were able to cook breakfast and dinner a couple times.
The chose us only about a 20 minute drive from downtown, which was convenient and quick.
Parking was ample and the neighborhood was quiet and peaceful.

I had a pleasant stay. The accommodation was clean, and having a private sleeping area gave me a good level of privacy. Everything matched the description, and the hosts were very transparent about the expectations and conditions before booking, which I appreciated.
The location was convenient for getting around, with the train station about a 15-minute walk away and the city center only a short ride from there.
Overall, this is a great value for the price. If you're looking for a simple, clean, and affordable place to stay and have realistic expectations, you'll likely be very satisfied. Thank you for the stay!
This is a private room in a very clean apartment. Common areas are very comfortable. Short walk towards the subway station. Highly recommended!

The place was just as pictured but when you are there the place is huge!!! Parking could be tricky but we made it work. Chinatown and train easily walkable and if you like walking there is alot in the area. One little hiccup with the apartment door but we made it work. Overall great experience and would stay there again.

Spent a weekend in Chicago and couldn’t think of a better place to stay . I had an amazing time , everything was close and
convenient. 10/10 highly recommend
A cozy little slice-of-life space that was great to come back to after exploring Chicago!
great location, easy spot to rest your head. good for the price.
We felt at home in this safe, pleasant location that I recommend.

The unit was in a good location with easy access to casual dining, the interstate, and a cute neighborhood. The entrance to the unit was directly next to a well frequented bus stop which made it uncomfortable to enter at various times of day. Located at a very noisy intersection made it difficult to sleep. Minor improvements to the interior would go a long way (more chairs for dining, non paper curtains, softer mattresses, surfaces in each room, and doors on closets/laundry space. Would be a great option for a younger friend group to stay for a weekend but didn’t meet the needs of an age diverse family group. The unit met all of our basic needs but we were hoping for something a little more comfy, cozy, and elevated for the price we paid.
Must check out Sando Street Japanese restaurant for takeout!!

We had a great stay here on our trip to visit family. The apartment was clean,  spacious with 2 bathrooms and comfy beds. It was perfect for our family get together. Grocery stores, shops and restaurants in walkable distances. The only challenge was minimal parking. Would definitely stay here again!

Great stay for those looking for a central point to get around the city. The unit’s location made our experience in Chicago a smooth one, with easy access to bus and train stations nearby. Fathom across the street had phenomenal cocktails! I would definitely stay here again on my next visit.

Daniel was communicative and was flexible with me checking in early. Instructions were clear and he offered great recommendations. Neighborhood was very safe and close to the metro and many restaurants/bars. Parking was easy.
There was some important accessibility/safety information missing from the listing. You have to navigate steps right when you enter the gate and then down to the unit. Throughout the unit, there are small step changes, so I wouldn't recommend for people with mobility issues. Additionally, it's not disclosed that the unit is not securely divided between the upstairs. There are dividers and curtains blocking stair access, but you can see that the upstairs is only blocked by a sheet, and it's not clear who has access to that space.
Although the listing says there is A/C, you don't have control access. There are a lot of books and movies, but it makes the space feel cluttered and is definitely dusty. Minor--but body wash was unavailable despite being listed.

this was a great stay. very easy to access from the L and within walking distance of a few late night eats. overall it was a nice spot. the beds weren't the comfy-iest we've stayed in. pillows we're very flat as well. overall good stay, we will stay again !

The perfect launch & resting pad for our Juneteenth weekend in Chicago. Location, setting, & set up made this such a great place to finish out our amazing trip to this special city. They had umbrellas and ponchos in case of rain, which was super thoughtful. Checking in and out were super easy and Dawn & Penny were very communicative & responsive. Their back deck and garden were lovely and a great setting for breakfast. The choice of streaming services enabled us to keep up with World Cup soccer using our own accounts. Most importantly, the location was so central to tons of restaurants & shops, and very convenient for taking the blue line from the Demian stop to other parts of the city. The neighborhood was beautiful with lots of trees and nice gardens and very quiet. Thank you, Dawn & Penny for a lovely stay. We would welcome the chance to come back & highly recommend the place.
Great stay overall. The place was as described, and the host was responsive and quickly resolved a minor issue.
Had a great time during my stay in Chicago and Kyriako was a very helpful and responsive host! Can’t wait to come back and visit again
Candace was a great host. She was very responsive throughout the trip. The location was perfect. There were lots of restaurants and things to do within walking distance. Overall, it was a great trip

Overall this place was great & Victor was such great host! He was extremely friendly and proactive, reaching out consistently ensuring all our needs were met regarding the Air BnB. Victor recommended local places and things to do which is always helpful when you’re not too familiar with the area. Victor was responsive, understanding and very accommodating which is a huge plus when booking an BnB. Check in was quick and easy and the ABnB was very clean upon arrival and had the basic essentials needed. We would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking to stay near downtown without having to pay the downtown price!
Interesting place!
Great stay. As advertised. Sketchy neighborhood, but no hassles or issues.

The location was excellent and very close to Wrigley Field, and the beds were comfortable. We did have a question and the host was friendly and responded quickly. It was a basement apartment. Unfortunately the bathroom photos listed showed a completely different bathroom than what was actually in the unit. The apartment was also not very clean, with dust, cobwebs, and leftover open food in the cabinets. Overall, the property’s condition, cleanliness, and presentation did not match the expectations set by the listing.

Really enjoyed my stay here. The place was clean, comfortable, and looked just like the pictures. Everything was easy from check-in to check-out, and the host was cool and quick to respond if I had any questions. Definitely felt at home and had everything I needed. I’d stay here again for sure and would recommend it to anybody looking for a nice spot.
This property was perfect. Jay is an amazing host!!
Just what we needed!
Everything was good. No problems.
My family had a great stay! The location is perfect, the hosts were very responsive, and my kids were fascinated by the koi pond. We would definitely stay there again.

Very clean place and Yolie was good at communicating with us. Central location.
The L runs constantly and goes right by the unit so it’s super loud. Wish we would have known that. And then minor thing but didn’t love advertising the washer and dryer but not providing laundry detergent. Not sure I know anyone who travels with that.
Otherwise though very nice host and appreciated her flexibility for us storing bags before and after checkout time

Honestly if I had the money, I’d offer to buy this home because it’s just so perfect! Loved the neighborhood it’s in, the natural sunlight, and how it really felt like being home.
In ways, it kind of felt like a little museum. So many interesting pieces of art and eclectic rugs/lighting fixtures/and furniture. We spent a lot of time outside exploring, but I actually wish I had had an extra day to spend inside to read, cook (those cast irons were perfectly seasoned), and draw. Also, everything was SUPER clean.
Matthew was very responsive, friendly, and really made things easy for our stay. Thanks for sharing such a beautiful home for people to experience. I would absolutely come back!!
Perfect spot for an easy walk to Wrigley and central to all sorts of good food, shopping, etc. Great host, would definitely stay here again!

Great place to stay at for convenience, especially for the price. I would say just consider that it is a hostel type stay so the shared spaces could be iffy. Also, bring your own wash cloths but he will provide towels which is great! It’s always good to have some type of sanitary wipes with you as well.

Place was great, despite the Juneteenth celebration which had fireworks up until 3am, the area was actually very quiet. The mattresses still have the plastic bag it came with so the beds made a lot of noise when tossing and turning. For some reason everything is connected to a extension cord. Big fridge doesn't work, but they do have a small fridge you can use.  Internet wasn't working properly for us. We could not connect the big tv to the internet. I recommend they leave extra supplies onsite vs calling it in when were out of it. we ranned out of trash bags which he send in 4 extra bags after which still wasnt enough for a house with 6 adults in it. Of course ranned out of tp late night so had to doordash some in . A big one is finding their parking in the back, alley is super dark and its hard to find it. there is no number in the back of the house of gate to identify it. Maybe a picture added to the house description would be amazing. Overall our stay was good.
We had a very pleasant stay at Mary's. We appreciated the cleanliness and the amount of space we all had in the apartment.
We had a great time and enjoyed our second stay at Kate’s place. We will likely be back!

The place was pretty decent, luckily I have no problem with the neighborhood. Some rooms are upstairs so keep in mind if you’re traveling with a lot of suitcases. Self check in instructions are easy to follow and host was very responsive. Overall, you got what you paid for😇

Safe area and walkable to stores and some restaurants. For what we paid, this is a good spot about 25 mins from most of the major spots we wanted to see while in Chicago. Few minor stains on the bedding, but host was very responsive and communicative throughout the entire stay. Would stay here again. Just to note, apartment was located up 3 flights of stairs.

I have stayed at Shanna's place before and will stay again. She is a terrific host and her place is exactly what my husband and I need for our stay in the city: A polite, friendly host, with cute/clean accommodations in a wonderful location, available for an amazing price. Thank you Shanna for your hospitality!

Abe was an excellent hosted - would stay here again without hesitation. He accommodated an early check-in for us (the place was already pristine at that point, despite a large group leaving that morning). He gave us excellent recommendations on where to watch the US World Cup Game. He provided some refreshments and a film camera to document our experience in Chicago - definitely above and beyond.
The space fit our group perfectly. Well taken care off, had all of the amenities we needed. It was nice to have the hot tub, projector, and games downstairs, which gave us plenty to do. Check-out was just as easy.
Basement apartment in Chicago, hosts communicate well, easy to find and comfortable sleeping arrangements
The host was great! Made the space feel like home. Gave clear instructions and was quickly responsive to any questions we had.
Great place to stay. Good safe location. Great host. Clean rooms

The apartment was well equipped and furnished. We really appreciated the Keurig! One bathroom for four bedrooms is a little tight but the kitchen was nice. The only real downside was the extremely noisy neighbors. This happened almost every night.
We truly had an awesome time and had a great experience and memorable weekend at this lovely home.

The location was perfect for public transportation.  We we 20 mins from the city.  We also used ride share …be aware with the address to use St and not Place.  We had a little confusion when we arrived.  Overall it was very nice, spacious, quiet and clean home.  Easy and smooth check out.
Rafael was a very responsive and great host. He replied very promptly to all of our requests. It was a great homebase for exploring the city of Chicago.

Nat's place was exactly as described. Very clean, bright and happy place.   Nat was very responsive and even checked in with us to see if we had everything needed.  Everything you need is within walking distance including some great restaurants and only a 10 minute walk to the blue line.  There is a great little bakery right downstairs, they make their own bagels with a really good bagel sandwich for breakfast.  This is a place we would definitely stay again if we are back in the area.

We really enjoyed our stay at Anca’s place! The home was spacious, beautifully decorated, very clean and fit our group well. It is in a great location with many shops and restaurants nearby as well as the brown and red line stops. The train is close but we never had a problem with the noise. The home was well insulated and there were noise machines for every room. We had a wonderful time and would happily stay again!

There was a bit of confusion at the start but Tenna' was extremely responsive and helpful to get us settled and set up for our stay. Parking was maybe the greatest difficulty and even then it was reasonable and we found a spot at all hours even if it was a bit of a walk. We were at max capacity with the rooms available, even using the convertible sofa/bed in the sun patio and Tenna' was quick to arrange more sheets to cover that bed as well. They were totally accomodating and always quick to respond. It was a relaxing stay, the only real complaint was the squeaky floors, but that was more for us trying to be mindful of anyone trying to sleep beside or below us in the building. We had a lovely time altogether.

Tamiz's place is so cute and cozy, and very clean! Steps away from bus stops as well so very easy to get around. Neighborhood felt safe, apartment was easy to access. Tamiz was a sweetheart, I loved getting to know him!  And his cats were so sweet as well. Amazing stay for the price, absolutely would book again!
very clean, close to the subway, and in a cute neighborhood. would highly recommend for exploring the city or wanting a weekend inside :)
Lovely apartment and great location!
It was amazing. Recommend if you just need a place to stay

This property has a great open living space. It's very clean and looks just like the pictures. It had everything my party of 5 needed, including a seperate bed for everyone. The host was great and checked in regularly to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. 5 stars.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
10/10 would highly Recommend! PERFECT FOR LARGE GROUPS!
We had an amazing stay! Our group of 11 fit very comfortably, and the home was exactly what we needed. It was incredibly spacious, spotless, and had a wonderful open floor plan that made it perfect for gathering together without ever feeling crowded.
The beds were very comfortable, and all of my guest commented on how safe and at home they felt throughout our stay. The Wi-Fi was fast and reliable, which was a huge plus for a large group.
The location was excellent—we were centrally located ever uber ride was no more than 8-12 mins. It made getting around the city easy and convenient.
A special thank you to Alex, who was an outstanding host. Alex was incredibly responsive, answered our questions quickly, and was so friendly and accommodating from start to finish.
Overall, this home exceeded our expectations. We would absolutely stay here again. Thank you, Alex, for helping make our Chicago trip such a memorable on
Tara's place was great. Friendly neighborhood, playground for the little ones, all of the amenities. I'd recommend.

Ideal location for Cubs games or concerts at Wrigley.  Short walk to Wrigleyville, plenty of food and shopping near by.  Parking is very easy.  Train is close by but the noise was not an issue at all.  Will stay again.
wonderful stay would definitely come back

Super impressed with my stay. The apartment is beautifully updated, in a very clean building, with parking directly downstairs. Had everything we needed to enjoy our stay. Also,  communication from the entire staff was fantastic. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again when I come back to Chicago!

Perfect location for our team playing at McCormick! Walk was less than 10 minutes, Starbucks right there, very clean, very accommodating. Didn’t realize it was 3 flights up with no elevator but that’s it n me for not reading the description fully. Perfect though for what we needed for our team. Nicely decorated rooms. Pictures were 100% accurate. Great stay!!! Oh, and I used Hero Parking for parking right behind the building so that was perfect!!!
Excelente acomodação! Fica um pouco longe do centro, mas perto do metrô. Então é super acessível para usar o transporte público. Passamos dias incríveis! Muito obrigada!
Great time with the family. Would stay again.
Great place to stay! Close walk to Chinatown and the red line! Can get to downtown quick! My family had the best time!
Had a great stay. My most important things were location to Wrigley and the AC working well and loved it

Samantha’s place felt very much “cozy.” It was in an excellent location, very close to public transport, and great restaurants. Samantha was very accommodating and checking in at least once a day. Next time I visit Chicago I will most likely check to see if Samantha’s place is available first and recommend it to any of my friends as well!
Beautiful Airbnb and great host. Wonderful for latter family get-togethers.

Our stay was great! Host was responsive and very friendly. The location was peaceful and quiet. I've been to Chicago before so I knew parking would likely be an issue. So, I was drawn to this location due to the free garage. I was pleased to find out that it did fit our Yukon XL (bonus). There is on street parking but sometimes hard to find a spot. I definitely recommend this host and location 😊
Amazing location, comfortable home, clean and fun decor!

Peter's place is soo close to Wrigley Field in a quiet and safe neighborhood. Lots of bars nearby to pre game and see a band after a game. Clean, modern apartment. Comfortable beds and furniture. Great experience.
David was so helpful and responsive with any questions/requests! They have a lovely deck as well, perfect for the nice weather. Will definitely be suggesting this place to anything visiting Chicago!

The place has a nice location to most things you would like to do. It was extremely noisy the first night through the early morning hours with an event next door, back alley deliveries and cars racing. The next two nights were a typical noise level for an urban apartment. The place itself was just ok. I will choose to stay in a hotel next time I am in Chicago.

We stayed as a large family of three children and three adults and the apartment was roomy, well stocked and clean. Check in was easy and the parking spots in the garage were key as we had a family minivan. The hosts were both responsive to any concerns / issues / questions and suggestions we had. We grew up in Chicago and were hesitant about West Town but wow has it changed. So much to do and see and eat, And public transportation was super easy from here. He

If you're looking for a place with all the right amenities in a great neighborhood, look no further! My family and I visit Chicago at least three times a year and usually stay in Airbnbs, and David's place is by far the nicest we've stayed in.
The basement apartment was spotless, beautifully renovated, and very comfortable. With a background in real estate, I especially appreciated the quality craftsmanship throughout the unit. The bathroom's heated floor was a wonderful touch!
David was friendly, responsive, and provided clear instructions, making check-in and our stay completely stress-free. The apartment also offered thoughtful amenities beyond what you typically find in an Airbnb—we even found a first aid kit, and every room was stocked with tissues.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and look forward to returning the next time we're in the Chicago area. Highly recommend!
Home as advertised. Close to transportation lines. Nice, roomy space. Recommended for anyone wanting to come see Chicago.

The place is well located, and very close to the red line of the train. That being said, the place itself needs a lot of maintenance, there are wholes in some parts of the wall, one of the chairs is full of stains. It doesn't look exactly like the pictures.
The AC unit is very old and it didn't cool down the apartment at all, we try lowering the temperature but nothing. Having a ceiling fan helped, but not ideal.
The towels provided were very old, and one of them was small for the body.
The place was somewhat clean, but the top of the fridge was very dirty, visible dust, and the kitchen was a bit sticky.
We had issues with the lock, one day the building electronic lock was not working, we texted Regina, who provided instructions for the alley entrance, it worked once, but the second time we tried it was locked, we found another entrance and that one worked. But all this was very inconvenient.

Huis ligt op goede locatie vlak bij voorzieningen. Groot voordeel is dat de brownline vlak om de hoek ligt. Ideaal voor het ondernemen van trips. Tegelijkertijd betekent dat ‘s nachts je moet wennen aan het lawaai als de metro voorbij komt. Verder prettig huis.
An enjoyable stay as always!
This place is just as described. Raymond and Marlo are kind hosts and very hospitable. I would recommend staying here.
We had a wonderful stay! Fenton was incredibly communicative and the apartment was beautiful and clean. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!
We had a great stay! The space was cozy and the projector was a great touch! The only drawback was a sewage smell coming from the shower.

This place was spotless, though it gives up some comforts in order to be that way. There are no hand towels or bathmat in the bathrooms. If cleanliness is your top priority then this may be a great spot for you. If a homier feel is more important, this place may not meet your needs…I wont be back because it’s not my style. I did not meet the host Anastasia in person but she was readily responsive, warm, and helpful.

very nice place and garden. Weighong was very responsive and friendly with us , always making sure we got everything. Place was clean, had everything we needed and the location was very good too. I’d book again

Our overall stay at Jasmine’s place was okay. The unit was smaller than expected so if there’s more than 2 guests it feels crowded. The unit was clean except for hair found in the shower and accessing the unit is a task because there’s multiple doors that you have to access before you get inside. The neighborhood was clean and quiet but parking was nightmare. There’s only street parking so if you’re going to be out you will most likely have to park on the Main Street and walk around to the house which is what we had to do most nights. I would recommend this stay to a single person or couple who will be utilizing public transport or uber to get around because of the size of the unit and the lack of parking

Next time we are in Chicago we would choose this place again. Mark and Collette are great host. Beautiful property peaceful property. We loved that Damen Ave and the surrounding neighborhood is very bike friendly area and the Brown Line is within walking distance

Aibike is an amazing host - kind, friendly, caring, and incredibly responsive. She made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived.
The neighborhood is wonderful: quiet, safe, green, clean, and charming. There are plenty of great restaurants, cafés, and wine bars just a short walk away, yet the area remains peaceful and relaxing. It’s also conveniently located, making it easy to get anywhere you want to go in Chicago.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would absolutely love to come back. ❤️👌🏻
James’ penthouse is located in an extremely walkable area with great views of the city. The building has solid amenities as well.

Was a great place to stay, the apartment was clean, quiet neighborhood, easily walkable to restaurants and Wrigley field. Every morning I started my day with a walk around Wrigley but if that’s not your thing there was tons of stuff to do nearby. They left the fridge stocked for me, plenty of coffee, plenty of towels, enjoyed my stay thoroughly!

There is no central air. One air condition unit in the living room. Only one tiny fan. Other than that the stay was great and comfortable, also very clean. Sheets and covers smelt amazing. The beds were really soft and I love the swinging chair aesthetic.
Manuel’s place was amazing! Perfect for a solo trip/traveler! Very responsive host and made sure I had everything I needed. A+++😀
This was a very lovely, comfortable home. Lots of extras and host were very responsive and helpful. We would definitely stay here again.
It was a clean, comfortable, and scenic place to stay. Highly recommend
I had my parents visit for my birthday and this place was the perfect place for them to stay. Very clean and very nice setup that feels just like home.
The only thing that I believe people should be aware of is you'll have to use a parking garage several blocks away that cost $105 for 3 days. Otherwise everything else was perfect.
Comfortable space for a girl's trip!  Close to downtown, and Midway airport
David was fabulous. Very helpful!  Thank you for having us.
it was great
The perfect spot to stay while we visited our son in Logan Square. Easy access and comfortable sleeping. Lots of activity upstairs but that was expected from the description. Thanks, Mark!

Honestly best place to stay if you’re visiting Chicago, the place has a bus stop right in front of the house which connects to the train into the downtown area, we had no issues getting to and from the location through public transportation if you’re trying to have a budget friendly trip. We had a rainy day and Joseph had umbrellas available for us to use and accommodated our needs from the time I booked until the time we checked out, definitely recommend
The unit was very clean and comfortable. It is right in the heart of North Center Chicago so very easy to get around the area.

Our family had a wonderful few days here, the place was in a great location walkable to the Lakeshore and a number of really good restaurants nearby, and the unit was high enough that we never had any issues with noise or anything else.  wish we could have stayed longer!

Freddy was a great host! friendly, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. The place was very clean, and exactly as described. We had a comfortable experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Cute place!
great location
Good location and clean.

This place is in a great spot, easy to get to and from via uber/lyft, or like we used train and divvy bikes/scooters. Only thing I didn't like that I haven't really ever had an issue even if there countries is with Roku/TV, I'm not sure if it was locked or what not, the bed room with a tv was not connected I had to use a power bank but I didn't reach out because I didn't notice until our last night. I also did not want to be bothered or wait during our stay. It was not absolutely necessary, but it was definitely noticeable for the times we did want to unwind a bit. Other than that. Beds slept great, shower was hot/warm so quick, and kitchen was clean and very equipped but we didn't use it much except for the electric hot kettle. I would give 4.5 out of 5 if I could because it was really bothersome for our group of 5 since it was World Cup games. Literally everything else was great!

We had a great stay! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and in a perfect location near Wrigley Field. Olgi and Paul were wonderful hosts—friendly, responsive, and very helpful throughout our visit. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend their place!

Our stay was mostly comfortable. Outside was pretty noisy - bring a white noise machine. Not the greatest (immediate) area for restaurants or nightlife but still walkable. Milan is a great host! Super responsive and helpful! Lobby staff is friendly/helpful too.

Bradfords home was a great stay. It really set the standard for my first trip to Chicago. He was an amazing host and the spot was even bigger than what I saw on the pictures. If I were to ever move to Chicago this would be the place I’d love to stay
A sweet, comfortable place in a wonderful neighborhood. The hosts were kind and communicative, and the location was perfect for my visit. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would gladly return.
Great location! Responsible & respectful host.
Enjoyed staying here! It was peaceful and close walk to the train and bus stations. Felt right at home and any question I had was answered very quickly! 5 stars ⭐️

We had a wonderful stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. We truly enjoyed our time here and would happily stay again. Highly recommend!

Tian’s place was overall a good stay. Clean home. Great access with a 10 minute walk to public transport. 10 minute train ride to downtown. Home was pretty secure with the cameras and digital locks. Many beds to sleep in if you have a big party. The yard was nice and garage was perfect for us to place our uhual and car in during the visit.
Location wise, if you aren’t use to city like surroundings this might not be a location for you. Both nights we were there constant sirens and gun fire. Car alarms going over. Definitely do your research on the location.

The apartment was fine for our purposes. The neighborhood was mostly quiet. The patrons of the bar across the street were loud at closing time (2 am). It's was well equipped with adequate seating for the 6 of us. The TV was great for watching FIFA soccer. We didn't use the back garden space, but it looked nice.
Thanks for the hospitality.

I absolutely loved staying here. For the price point, you simply can't beat it. Though it is a basement, it doesn't feel like one. It has natural light and every amenity you could ask for. A Brita, microwave, toaster, coffee maker, an electric kettle, and more. I was not expecting the kitchen area to be so stocked. Everything about this place was better than expected. Amy was very kind and even brought down a space heater because it was cold at night. Whenever I come back to the city, I will be staying here!

We had a great stay! The host was very friendly and responded quickly to any questions we had. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was also beautiful and well-maintained, which made our stay even more enjoyable. We would definitely recommend staying here and would be happy to return in the future.

logement très bien situé pour visiter Chicago, avec une gare à quelques minutes à pieds pour rejoindre le centre ville en train (attention, bien regarder les horaires car à certains horaires, il ne passe que toutes les heures ou toutes les 2 heures 😅). très facile de se garer dans la rue (stationnement gratuit).
je recommande vivement !

We stayed at Eddie’s for about 10 days.

The house is big, nice, and it’s in a nice neighborhood, it’s comfortable, unless you want to visit Chicago city, it’s about a 30 minute drive.

The fire alarm is quite sensitive when cooking, so make sure all windows are open.
The pool table is a little wonky.
The dishwasher is quite slow, I’m talking about an hour to wash.
Apart from that, it’s a great place!
Thanks for having us!
Very nice location for boys town.
