There is no Wi-Fi and the air was not working but besides everything else the Airbnb was amazing and it was a lot to do around the neighborhood. and the house responded back soon as possible. She tried to fix the issues, but it was out of her control.
The home was excellent and just as described. Jacob was a gracious and accommodating host with great communication.
Great and quiet place! Close to train and bus stops.
The space was very homey and clean. Karina was very responsive, friendly, and overall a great host! Hopefully will visit again one day!
Great location for events at McCormick place West. Milan communicated clearly and frequently.
The home was just great - clean and very convenient.

We had a lovely stay in Chicago! The space itself is very modern, clean, and perfectly situated right across from a stunning park. The host was incredibly responsive and friendly throughout our visit.
A few things to note for future guests: The entrance to the Airbnb is located on the side of the house, rather than the main front entrance shown in the listing photos. Also, we had a small hiccup with the check-in code upon arrival, but the host was quick to resolve it for us immediately. Otherwise, it was a great spot and only about a 15-minute drive to downtown. Would recommend!

Would definitely recommend this listing. PM Company’s communication was wonderful from the start, very responsive. Space was very clean and spacious. Everything we needed, such as plates, utensils, garbage bags, was available and easy to find. Beds and couch fairly comfortable.
Great location and a spacious home! The hosts were highly responsive, flexible, and happy to help whenever they could. Great stay!
Thank you as always

This was one of the best - if not the best - experiences I’ve had with Airbnb since I joined almost 10 years ago. Huge thanks to Bianca and Jason for their hospitality and understanding with everything. Since I would be driving, I was looking for a space that would accommodate a car and found this listing. Bianca was communicative and helpful from the moment I reserved the space until the time I checked out. The space itself is beautiful and perfect for a solo or couple trip. The pictures show the space well but it’s even more charming and cozy in person. It was also extremely clean and provided helpful amenities like a steamer, iron, bathroom supplies, and kitchen set up. It is a climb, but the view and private patio overlooking it the city is worth it. I had the chance to meet Bianca and Jason throughout my time there and they were both very friendly and welcoming, as well as their dog Nanook. Loved the windows that offered a nice view of the sky and breeze. Would love to stay again!

Stayed here while in Chicago for my daughter’s wedding. House easily held entire family anf everyone had a private space. The kitchen was fabulous. The backyard space was great - the son, son-in-laws and grown grandson love the basketball court!
No problems at all. Good deal for a clean place.
Clear communication from host, no issues.

Excellent location and the unit itself is beautiful, but it fell short for the price and what was advertised.
Marketed for up to 12 people, yet with only 5 of us there still wasn’t enough seating in the common areas to entertain comfortably. The place felt tired and lacked proper upkeep: cracked sinks, no fitted sheets on the beds, broken fans, stained/dirty couch, and fridge filter that needed changing.
Major issues included the master shower not draining (we all shared one bathroom until it was fixed), water dripping from a ceiling pipe onto the hallway floor our last morning, no hand soap in the kitchen, and unannounced maintenance walking in without knocking. Checkout instructions were also confusing (host said don’t strip beds, but notes on the wall said to).
The experience felt very transactional and micromanaged. For the money, these maintenance and cleanliness problems should have been resolved before arrival. Beautiful space, but not enough care put into it.

Great little place! We needed an easy home base while in town for a nearby wedding, and this worked great. It was simple, clean and well stocked. Bonus points for free street parking and a walkable neighborhood near some great restaurants, coffee shops, and parks.
We were traveling with our toddler and while this worked fine for us, I wouldn’t consider it the most kid-friendly (steep stairs upon entry, no bathtub, informal living room space, bar dining seating). That’s no fault to them - we knew this going in - but just something to keep in mind if you have littles!

Alfredo and Megan were very gracious hosts and were a pleasure to communicate with. The space was very clean and very comfortable space to just hang out in.  Overall we had a very pleasant stay and would book again in the future.
The decor is amazing in this spacious unit , host communicated responsively, there was plenty of room for all guests

Eduardo greeted us upon arrival and walked us through how to lock and unlock the door. He showed us to our rooms and he provided us with a personal key to our room to be able to lock when we leave. Bathroom was stocked with supplies including a hair dryer, q-tips and cotton pads which came in handy, as well as shampoo/conditioner and body wash in the shower. He was very kind and the second day we were able to make ourselves coffee and tea in the dining room and sit down to enjoy it. The last two days though we were awakened by loud children running around above us. This did go on for over an hour and I believed it to be during quiet time hours (before 8am) at one point in the morning the dining room with the coffee/tea bar was closed off so we were not able to help ourselves to the coffee bar before we left for daily excursions or access the outside porch that was included in the listing as well. I am unsure if they were guests like us or family due to the dining room being closed off.
We had a great stay! Great space for a long weekend. The place was clean and looks exactly like the pictures. Ari is friendly and responsive to any questions.
Great place, easy transaction and communication

Our stay here in Chicago was amazing. We love staying in neighborhoods for the experience and this apartment and Andersonville did not disappoint. The place was perfect for the 4 of us. On a beautiful tree lined street, quiet with friendly neighbors.  Felt very safe here. Easy to get in. Nicely decorated. Comfortable couch, chairs and beds. Individual fans were nice but not really needed. Central air. Bathroom was great. Didn’t cook but the kitchen was nice and well stocked. Highly recommend staying here for a great time in Chicago. We walked a couple blocks to the main area for meals and some shopping and Uber’d to father away places including downtown. Thank you for sharing your place ,Paul.

Juan's Airbnb met our needs perfectly for our 3-night trip to Chicago. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything we needed during our stay.
We did have an issue on the first night with noisy ventilation that was switching on every 30 minutes, but Juan was very responsive and quickly resolved the problem, which we appreciated.
There was some creaky floorboard noise from the upstairs neighbours, but earplugs worked very well and we had no trouble sleeping.
There are several takeout options and restaurants within walking distance. The nearest train station was about a 15-minute walk away, and from there you can purchase a daily transit pass for $5, making it easy to get around the city.
Overall, we had a good stay and appreciated Juan's responsiveness and hospitality.

This is a very nice apartment in a great neighborhood. Everything you need is there, but this is an older building in an urban neighborhood. It's not exactly quiet, and so the earplugs Brad provided helped a great deal. Great location to explore Hyde Park.

The owner was very friendly and responsive! The beds were comfortable, and the area inside is spacious. It’s generally an older style space with small imperfections throughout the space, but age-appropriate. The street was rather dirty, but this is not the fault of the owner.
I had no complaints
We enjoyed our stay!

Our stay at The Ivy was fantastic! Such a fun area, close to all of the action but still felt quiet down our side street. Really unique front lawn pergola/patio that was perfect for hanging out with friends, having coffee in the mornings, etc.
Carlos and Laura and the rest of the team were super responsive and kind. We had one issue with a toilet and a maintenance person was by right away.
All of our friends loved the location and had a true Wrigleyville experience! Could not beat the convenience of the red line and nearby bus lines and of course the proximity to Wrigley field for a game one day.
Thank you!
This is a very quiet neighborhood, and there is a CVS right near the house.

Jennifer and Dan's place was exactly as described. It was exactly what I needed for a weekend stay in Chicago. Very easy to get anywhere in the city as it is super close to an L stop. Lots of stuff to walk to around here in general.
The room and bathroom were clean and exactly as expected - clean and comfortable! I got to meet the kitties and they were lovely and friendly. Jennifer was very warm upon my welcome and made me feel at home. Also extremely good communication throughout the entire experience - much appreciated!

Location was great. Very close to where our son lives who we came to visit.
The suite was very clean with lovely furnishings.
We enjoyed our stay .
Nice place , great location . Shower would back up occasionally but everything else was clean and up to par

Great location with dedicated parking and easy access to the CTA. The unit looked as advertised and was generally comfortable. However, cleanliness needs more attention. We found several stains on the bedding and an old croissant left in the air fryer, which suggested the unit had not been thoroughly cleaned before our arrival. Noise may also be a consideration, as the upstairs neighbors were quite noticeable and the AC unit was fairly loud when running. Overall, the stay was fine, but improvements in cleanliness would make a significant difference.
Very nice and responsive hosts. Room was a bit small but for the short weekend we stayed it served its purpose just fine.

The rental delivers what it lists. It was fairly clean although some linens were stained and one of wall in the bathroom could use a good scrub. It is very spacious, and fairly close to bus stations. Great local restaurants are also nearby. The hosts were kind enough to let us drop off our bags a couple hours early. The renters that live above are very loud at all hours, but if you’re as tired as we were each day, it may be a non issue. A couple things that could take this place to the next level would be complimentary coffee and body wash (neither of which were promised in the listing, so no ding). All in all a great rental.
Apartment was in a wonderful location, with easy access to L-train, and convenient to many restaurants/bars.  Apartment was as described.
great place with a responsive host.

I appreciated Vladimir reaching out and checking in on me.  His directions were clear.  I really loved how comfortable the bed was and the variety of pillows.  This is not a cluttered apartment, and it felt open and airy.  The refrigerator was spotless. He had some thoughtful touches such as extra toothpaste and toothbrush and nightlights.  This is the big city and the apartment is on a busy road.    The first night. there were sirens and a party and fireworks!   The steps to the roof terrace are very steep and I found it a little scary going down them.  So, I just enjoyed hanging out on the balcony.   Overall, I was very comfortable there and felt secure.

We had a great stay from start to finish. The home was exactly as described, check-in was smooth, and Brian made everything feel simple and well-managed. The home was also well equipped, which made the stay much more comfortable. The home was very nice and the beds were comfy!!

This was a great stay! It was conveniently located to a very central subway line to both the airport and all of the touristy spots! Tippi’s place was very clean, and beautiful. The beds were very comfortable and it was a perfect spot for anyone looking to visit Chicago! Tippi was very kind and generous, I definitely recommend staying here and would do so again!

This condo was beautiful., clean and spacious.  Perfect for my family stay. The host was very responsive and helpful when we arrived early, we always forget about the time zone change when coming from MI.
Symone and I loved our stay. The other guests were nice as well and definitely would come back.
I enjoyed my stay at this beautiful Chicago Victorian estate. Ryan was a great host, friendly, highly communicative and helpful. Thanks for the breakfast recommendation, Semaphore Cafe was a banger.

Unfortunately, our stay was less than expected. When we arrived it wasn’t clear as to which door to enter- we had to refer to the listing picture in order to figure it out. Additionally, we were told the code would be the last 4 digits of my phone number and that didn’t work. We called and text the number sent to us via the app and it went to a woman named Angela (who is that? she isn’t listed as the host or property manager in the details sent through the app). The unit was very stuffy when we entered. Lastly, there aren’t any sheets or blankets for the pullout couch. We messaged the host with no response, however they were quick to send us check out instructions.

Host was responsive and communication via the app was easiest as the front desk lady didn’t speak English well. We booked for 6 people and only received towels for 4 and got the rest a day later. One bathroom lacked cleanliness (moldy shower and gross baseboards and floor). Would work well for 4 people as the “pullout sofa” is just a couch with ottomans to extend it out. Luckily we didn’t have 6 adults. Some of the extra bedding for the pullout sofa, was stained (looked like body fluids on them).

fantastic location, great amenities, host has good communication.
only thing would be that I wouldn't recommend the couches for sleeping on but they could be slept on.
otherwise, cant beat the location and the space is big and has everything you need.

Had dinner at rosebuds Father’s Day which is about a 2 minute walk from this apartment, which was excellent. Anything you want to do is within a few minutes walk great location, safe, and accessible…….loved the stay!!

1.5 blocks to the red line, countless restaurants and bars nearby.  We booked for a sweet 16 birthday concert and city exploration trip.  The bathrooms were a little lacking for prep space for 6 girls, but the big round table in the dining area with massive mirror wall and outlets was the ultimate get-ready and snack hangout.  The building feels a little run down and the lobby/elevator experience isn’t welcoming (seriously, why are all you people just standing around?!).  But, the room space fit our needs well.  The neighborhood is lively (and loud!) but we truly enjoyed our stay.

Cindy and Mike are amazing hosts! They are so kind and helpful. This spot is clean, cozy, and in a peaceful neighborhood close to a park and grocery store. Every major attraction or town is an easy ride on the blue line. We felt safe and comfortable, definitely a great deal. We would love to come back soon!

We loved that the community was walkable and peaceful. It was easy to get to the grocery store, cafe for morning coffee and breakfast and a gas station if needed. There was Dollar Tree where you could grab miscellaneous items and snacks. The beds were comfortable.

Daniel’s place is convenient and a perfect stay for 2. If you’re from the city and don’t mind the sound of the train like myself, this is the place for you. Daniel is responsive and has a clean and beautiful, accessible space near the train. Would book again.
Julian’s air bnb was perfect for the weekend, was attentive when we needed him, great place to stay.

This place was amazing - very clean, updated and a very roomy studio!  The neighborhood was very nice and walkable.  Close to the city, trains, parks and the airport.  The hosts were extremely responsive , provided water, snacks and a mid stay treat!  Totally unexpected.  The hosts went out of their way to make sure our stay was perfect and it was!  I will for sure be staying there again!   I cannot say enough great things about the hosts and the place!  More than 5 stars
This is absolutely a Luxury apartment in a luxury complex. Had a lovely stay - was pleasantly surprised by just how comfortable the roll out bed is!!
We had a fabulous stay here! Very comfortable space with everything we needed.  Communication with the host was excellent and the location was great as well.  Highly recommend!

Space was great. Accommodates all guest. Upstairs was hot but the host has fans and AC for the individual rooms which made the guest in those rooms very very happy! The only thing is the shower on the upper level isn’t suitable for tall people but the other bathroom showers  will accommodate all heights ! Loved my stay!

We had a wonderful stay and would definitely book here again. The rooms were very spacious, and the home was exceptionally clean and well-maintained. Having private parking in the garage was a huge bonus, especially since street parking was limited in the area. We really appreciated being accommodated with an early check-in after arriving ahead of schedule. Communication was excellent, and any time we needed assistance, responses were quick and helpful. The basement movie room was an added bonus that our family really enjoyed. Overall, it was a great experience, and we would absolutely stay here again!

This location is great for a group exploring the city. Peaceful neighborhood with friendly people, walking distance from many stores and shops. Quick ride into the city or a 20 minute walk to the closest train station for ridding into the city. I would suggest this stay to anyone. Our hosts were extremely responsive and friendly. We would stay again.

Great stay for a very affordable price. Fans, smelled of cleaning product, towels blankets and bathroom amenities were all present. Very good for travelers who just need a place to relax and sleep in between their activities. Would book again
We liked our stay and the transport to our destinations weren't too bad. The response times were a little long, but we had almost everything we needed at our stay.
Our host was wonderful and super welcoming and helpful with everything. The space was perfect. We loved it here. Definitely coming back!
Amazing location right near transit, clean and comfortable!

Me, my five sisters and my daughter spent four nights in Jonathan’s home. It was a very good experience. We’re all seniors, except my daughter and we found the home to be very accommodating. The house is beautiful, comfortable and well furnished. We were there for the Obama library celebration and wanted a place close by. We had all traveled from different parts of the country. The location is perfect and the neighborhood is quiet and peaceful. Jonathan met us there for check-in and gave us a tour. He was very friendly and responsive when we had questions or needed information during and after check-in. The house was a nice comfortable place to rest and recharge after being out all day each day. After a couple of days at the Obama Center, we spent time touring Chicago. It was easy to find our way to restaurants and points of interest. We loved everything about the house and highly recommend it for families or groups of seven or eight. The house was exactly as described.

I truly enjoyed my stay. The location, just minutes from the United Center, was perfect for my needs. The space was quiet, safe, and spotless, creating a very comfortable atmosphere. The host was friendly, attentive, and always quick to communicate. I would gladly stay here again.

Sam's house was comfortable and welcoming. My parents stayed there for a week and had a wonderful time. The cat was very cute, and Sam was a kind and friendly host. They really enjoyed their stay and would happily recommend it!

Naga and Grace were the perfect hosts! Very responsive and solution oriented to any issues I was experiencing. Their space felt like the perfect home away from home. I’d stay here every time I come to Chicago!
Staying at Nicky’s place for my first time in Chicago was awesome. Very easy to get into the air bnb. The neighborhood is very peaceful and felt very safe. I would recommend anyone to stay here.

This home was absolutely perfect for our trip! It was clean, cozy, and in a very quiet neighborhood. If you are looking to be out of the immediate downtown area while still being surrounded by plenty of great businesses, this house is perfect for you too!
Kelsy’s list of recommendations was very helpful - we now also highly recommend the Lincoln Lodge for a standup comedy show that is only a 3 minute walk from the house!
The only thing that caught me by surprise was that this is the bottom level of a two story house. It was initially confusing during check in and we did not have control over the thermostat. However, overall it was not an issue at all.
Thank you Kelsy for being such an amazing host! If we find ourselves back in Chicago we will definitely be booking with you again!
Enjoyable stay! Beautifully decorated and central to things in Chicago.

We had some tech issues with the codes getting in and coordinating parking, BUT Teddy was very responsive, no matter the time, and got everything taken care of. Great space. Worked out perfectly for the Cubs games!
This BnB worked well for a guys trip.
We had a big weekend planned and Alma was sure to make sure we had everything we needed and enjoyed our stay! Highly recommend!

Overall I had a great experience. Lumi is an amazing host and easy to communicate with. Small concerns around the cleanliness of the property inside. Feels as if the cleaning process was rushed and delayed before my groups arrival there. Somewhat confused with check in instructions in terms of the door having an access code to the door and it was two lock setup and not the keypad.
Ian was a great host. The home was perfect for our large group. We would definitely come back!!

Great experience. Would recommend. Apartment as described in listing. Clean, well stocked. Comfortable. In good condition. Host team extremely responsive throughout stay to any questions. Incredible lakefront view. Amazing location.

We loved this house! Yes there is a train but honestly it added to the experience and the house is so well done that it didn’t disrupt our sleep. The rooms and place is done so unique and fun. Had access to tons of things to do within walking distance that our group was easily able to what everyone wanted without uber.

Great location. I had everything that I needed to feel at home. Because of my elderly age, the steps became a little too much for me. I opted to use the very comfy couch as my bed. And there was a full bath on the main floor.

Estuvimos hospedados durante dos noches y nos sentimos como en casa, realmente cómodo y acogedor, nos encantaron las áreas comunes y todo estaba muy limpio y ordenado, el estilo es único y definitivamente volveremos!
Great host. Clean and easy check in. Had a lovely experience.
The bed was very comfortable and the kitchen had everything I needed during my stay here. The space was perfect for my needs.

The place was fine and in a nice neighborhood. Musa was very helpful. The parking is very convinient, especially if you travel in large groups (we were 5).
The rooms are small, but that's expected in Chicago.

Kirsten & co. were a great host - they accommodated our early arrival and was very communicative and friendly.
The place was very cute and quaint, all the touches were intentional and thoughtful, especially as someone who needed to use the extra bed, it felt like another room in itself considering the size of the space. We had a brita filter, ice, great bathroom amenities, and the dehumidifier kept the room fresh despite the humid conditions outside (it also doubled as a lovely white-noise machine, which is great for muting out sounds!). Do note that the ceilings were low, but they were no issue for us (< 5'6")
The location was walkable. Note that it is about a mile to the nearest train stop, which may or may not be ideal depending on the person - but for us it was just right for getting around everywhere on foot!

Mimi’s place was fantastic! The inside is even more beautiful than the photos…impeccably clean, tasteful decor and the back patio was such a great place to enjoy the summer weather. Mimi was always responsive within 10 minutes and checked in halfway through to see if we needed anything. Quiet street close to tons of restaurants and shops. Would stay here again for sure.
Amazing Host!!
Great location. Parking was not really an issue!

This apartment is perfectly located for Cubs fans. Walkable to Wrigley, Southport, Ashland and Lincoln with lots of restaurants and shopping. Appliances were great, although a couple of the stove burners wouldn’t lite. Kitchen was adequately furnished but not fantastic. Towels were sufficient but not great. Internet didn’t function from the time we checked in. We reported this to the landlord but it wasn’t resolved  during our 3-night stay. This meant no TV either (and no Netflix as we could not access our own account.) Not quite the experience we’d hoped for.
I am very particular in the house was great! The host was very responsive to any questions I had, the house was very clean and centrally located in the heart of Chicago.
Stayed at this location for my husbands birthday. We had a great time the location was great, space was clean, views were amazing. I would recommend to everyone!

this place was nice. the biggest problem I had was it wasn't mentioned until the day I couldn't cancel that it was a shared space. she listed it like an apartment which it was. It was an apartment where she rented out separate rooms for others to stay in. its not inherently a problem but wasn't at all what I was looking for and the fact she failed to mention that till the day of check in is extremely unprofessional and should've been listed in the booking.

Totally recommendable. It's a good place for a low budget traveller in a peaceful neighborhood close to public transportation and with easy access to the Loop and local well established old Italian restaurants 2 blocks away from Ming's house. Do not miss it if you're visiting Chi. Thank you Ming and kind Yolanda.
Loved staying here for an extended weekend getaway :)

Overall great experience. The apt has everything you need for your stay and is in a great location. The washer/dryer was no operational unfortunately but we managed without it - host communicated in advance. Super friendly and flexible host
As has always been the case, Peter was the consummate host.  His place is fantastic. The location is superb. And he was available to answer questions.  We’ll definitely be back!
Loved the stay. In such a good area with great restaurants and right next to Fulton Market and West Loop. My local Chicago friends loved seeing the space as well and thought highly of it!
great apartament in a very nice place. Noel was ver responsive to any questions we had

First off, Joelle was incredibly helpful. She's responsive, and is always willing to help you out. The place itself is also very good. All the amenities listed are available, the place is clean, and the inside just looks and feels very well kept. However, the only problem is the location which unfortunately is not in the control of the host, and therefore does not reflect her.

I have stayed at multiple Airbnbs in different countries and this was the best one I have ever been at, the host was so responsive, the home was clean and beautiful. The information that the host provided both on the site and at the home was helpful to the location and the neighborhood. We all had an amazing time. I hope I get to book this place every time we visit Chicago. Thank you for making your home available! 💜

Caleb’s apartment offered good space for my partner and I, my sister, and nephew. The location is fantastic. Andersonville is a wonderful neighborhood with so much to do, and it’s walkable to Foster beach, to the red line El, and buses. Parking is difficult, as is to be expected in a Chicago neighborhood, but you don’t need a car.

this place is simple and spare but clean and has everything you need. It was great to have a private bathroom and the beds were comfortable, though the bedding could definitely use an upgrade ( the fitted sheet never stayed on and I woke up on the bare mattress every night) and it would be nice to have hand towels in the bathroom. great food and train nearby.
Great location, great house, and you could walk to a different coffee place every day for at least a week:).
Wes’s listing was a great place to stay and gave us all our own space to settle into.  Having the three floors made it feel like home and we all enjoyed our time here.
Nice place great host
Great stay! very spacious clean and awesome host.
A perfect space!❤️
Fabiana was a wonderful, responsive hostess. We really enjoyed the neighborhood and her place was appointed exactly as she said it was. Close to public transit, too. Bravo!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! The apartment was bright and the living area spacious. The location is very convenient and it is walkable to local shops and restaurants.  Ian is a wonderful host! He  is friendly and responsive to any communication. We would gladly stay here again on our next trim to Chicago!

This a great no-frills place to stay -- convenient to mass transit & right next to the United Center.  Hosts are very responsive. The bathroom was very clean. With only one for 4 rooms, it can get backed up, so plan accordingly. Great stay overall & will book again in the future.
Beautiful unit in a great neighborhood! Enjoyed our stay.
Stayed here for Juneteenth weekend and the place was AMAZING! It was clean, close to everywhere we wanted to go and the host was very welcoming and responsive. I would definitely stay here again!

Had a great stay! We loved that it was in walking distance to the beach & what a beautiful front garden! The beds and linen were so comfy. & the shower had the perfect pressure and temperature always. Hosts were very responsive. Would stay here again! 10/10.

Great location, easily walkable to many bars, restaurants, and Lincoln Park attractions. The bed was comfortable, and the portable a/c worked well to keep the apartment cool. There was no sitting area, if that’s something you need, but we were rarely inside so it did not detract at all from our visit. Clare was very responsive, and was quick to accommodate my request for an early check in. Great place, and I highly recommend.
The apartment was just as described/very spacious and clean, easy to find and within walking distance to Division Street which had a ton of unique places to eat.
Everything was wonderful.  Only thing to note was the hot water took a little longer than expected to come out of the faucets. Still very nice place!
Great host - Enjoyed my stay!

No hyperbole in that this is one of the best Airbnbs I've stayed at, esp one that can house 5 people.
Spotless, amazing location, a very well stocked kitchen, nice patio, keyless entry, close to everything you'd need. I don't see a world where I come back to Chicago and I don't stay here.
Not to mention the hosts. Truly wonderful people who were attentive and accommodating all the way through. Simply the best.
11/10
We loved our stay here, the apartment was perfect for our trip. Walkable, great neighborhood, super close to the red line.
Great place to stay! Beautiful location

Great place to stay near Andersonville, Uptown, and Edgewater. There was minimal noise at night, and just a little bit of noise from upstairs neighbors.
Close to a lot of shops and restaurants!
For accessibility: this is a basement unit and there are steps to go down to the front door. There is also a step to get up to one of the bedrooms and a step to get up to the shower and toilet. The shower entrance is a little narrow.

Assel's apartments were perfect for my group of 14. If you're at all on the fence about it being split units, don't worry even a little bit. It was really easy to go back and forth between the two, and they've got everything you'll need for your trip. Highly recommend staying here.

Location was perfect for our needs, and the place handled my family of 7 comfortably. The lock code didnt work initially, but Kiva was immediately responsive by phone to fix it. Although I could tell the place had been cleaned, there were a few issues with quality that Kiva seemed genuinely concerned about, and I am confident will be addressed for future guests. We would stay again!
I thought this airbnb was great and the location was perfect. We could walk to everything and found it easy to navigate. This was such a good stay!

Andy was a great host, very responsive. The place was as described. Andy came to clean the common areas multiple times during my stay. Great value and comfortable stay.
I was also able to make friends with one of the other guests staying at the townhouse during my stay, which was great!
The only thing that caught me by surprise:
- the building complex where the townhouse is located felt a bit sketchy to ME as a woman traveling alone from out of town, arriving in the dead of night. It was a bit hard to find due to how the buildings are set up. Some of the immediately surrounding units in the complex were dilapidated, which added to the sketchy vibe. However, the rest of the area felt safe enough and I walked outside alone during the day.
Clean and comfortable but the check in process is a little complicated. Wished the location would add WiFi and a microwave but other then that we had no issues
Leslie’s place is an absolute gem - wonderful host, excellent accommodations and perfect location! We will absolutely be back

Alvenna’s place has the perfect charm and homely touches to make guests settle in. The amenities she provided are above and beyond; we loved the collection of snack items and even oatmeal samples for breakfast. The full stocked kitchen allowed us to cook daily for breaks from dining out. Her instructions are clear from the time we booked to the time we checked out. She even came out to meet us while we waiting for our ride. I will definitely stay again.
Place was amazing.    Had everything we needed and so close to Wrigley!

We had a few significant issues with check-in and check-out for which we received a bit of a refund so I won’t go into the details there; other than that this was a fairly acceptable spot.
The beds and bedding were not the quality you might hope for but they’re not necessarily worse than you’d expect from an AirBnB. You’ll need to provide your own soaps and shampoos etc for the shower — this I was more surprised by than the quality of the bedding, but maybe it’s a more common situation than I’ve experienced.
At this price point, for an apartment that has clearly been purchased, remodeled, and decorated specifically to be an AirBnB, I would want these sorts of basic things to be at least baseline hotel quality, which I’m afraid was not the case.
That said, this is a great neighborhood and if you need a place to crash between days of exploring Chicago that’ll comfortably sleep 3 (and more if you have kids or couples) I’m sure you could do much worse. Your mileage may vary.
It was a perfect location for us. Thank you guys for hosting us!
Very nice location, close to public transportation, restaurants, coffee, grocery stores and the beach. Easy parking and very responsive.
Had fun

This has easily been one of the best airbnb experiences I’ve ever had. Adrian was a Spectacular host in every way. He was extremely communicative and accommodating at every step of our stay, and the space was beautiful and well kept. We had a fabulous time, and absolutely would stay again if we take a trip back to the city.

My husband, 5 and 3 year old sons were in town for the weekend to catch the Jays play the Cubs. While the game was rained out, we did enjoy our time in Chicago. This was a great spot and location and easy to get around on foot or transit. The place was clean and comfortable, I would highly recommended this spot!
Really accommodating host. Had everything you would need while away from home. I would recommend!
we loved our rental. we stayed for 5 days and 4 nights. it was a beautiful home and the communication with Bartosz was always responded quickly. We will definitely stay again. I highly recommend.
Good spot
Great stay, space and location!

Really enjoyed the stay, with the location exceeding expectations. Beautiful neighborhood/area with lots to do within walking distance. Everything was clean and organized, and we slept five comfortably. Only minor concerns were the brightness of the main living room area (we had someone sleep in that area) and parking. Got lucky most of the time with street parking and ended up walking, using rideshare or nearby rental bikes most of the time.

David and Andrea's was a great place for us to relax at the end of a busy few days exploring Chicago with our kids. They have everything you need for a comfortable stay. Our kids loved the reading nook and there was room for them to play. David and Andrea greeted us and were super friendly and they really have thought of everything with this place. It was a lovely stay and we would stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

My family and I really enjoyed our stay. The place was very clean, comfortable, and looked just like the photos. Check-in was super easy, and the host was very nice and responsive. We’d definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago

Perfect spot in the heart of Lincoln Park. We had two kids and the place worked out perfectly. Walking distance to parks, lake, restaurants, buses, etc. Michael was very responsive during our stay and made sure we had what we needed.

Location, location, location! This garden apartment is in a great spot near Hyde Park restaurants, shops and attractions like the Obama Presidential Center. Very walkable. Decent interior and very responsive hosts!

Derek’s home was spacious and had great amenities. I traveled along with 4 other girlfriends to visit the Obama Presidential Center during its grand opening.
Its location and close proximity was spot on. Having 3 full bathrooms was a great perk as well. The kitchen was modern
& we loved the water dispenser on top of the island. Derek always responded timely to any of our questions. He is a great host.

This is a fantastic place to stay!  Beautiful, clean apartment, comfortable, fully stocked kitchen, and a wonderful outdoor patio.  The location is unbeatable - lots of cute shops, restaurants, markets, and a terrific park at the end of the block.   The hosts were friendly, and communication was clear and proactive.  I highly, highly recommend this property.
Accurate description.  Had to wait past our check in time 4pm

This was our first time staying in a brownstone, and it exceeded all expectations. The home was beautifully decorated—from the artwork to the kitchen appliances—and every detail was thoughtfully curated.
Our host was incredibly helpful, responsive, and provided excellent food recommendations that made our stay even more enjoyable
When we booked, we had no idea we would be so close to the Obama Presidential Center, which made the location even more special. The combination of a great location, a beautiful home, and an outstanding host made this an unforgettable experience.
We will definitely recommend this home to our friends and family and would love to stay here again in the future!
My trip was great
Spacious. Well located to brown line. Convenient location and great neighborhood

Great location. Walking distance to record stores, cafes, train station. The place is clean, and the host responds quickly. The beds are made for smaller folks (if sharing), and you'll hear the noises from the streets and the standard buzzing from older appliances (AC, fridge). I slept well, but if you're a light sleeper, bring ear plugs. The place has nice natural light, and is cozy.

We hosted my mother-in-law here and she loved it! The location was great, the space was cozy and enjoyable to spend time in. Excellent location close to the Andersonville corridor. Only 5 minutes from Calo, her favorite restaurant.
Side street parking was easier than we thought. Saved us a lot of anxiety

My wife and I and our two teenage kids stauee here for our week stay and this place was perfect for what we wanted. First, the place was pristine and very clean throughout. The three bedrooms were comfy and gave us each our private sleeping rooms. They kitchen had everything we needed. The TV area was great for relaxing at night after days spent out in the city. The location of this place is what made it perfect. It is walking distance to Hollywood beach and even closer to the red line, which in Chicago can't be beat. Put the bikes to use and head out to the lake front bike path. I highly recommend this stay!
A cozy & clean place to stay near the train for easy transportation! Robert was a great communicator and wonderful host!

We absolutely loved staying here and hope to return! It felt like such a special, beautiful place, and a great homebase from which to explore the city. We had a rental car and were worried about parking but somehow managed to get a spot on the block each time. Johanna was very friendly, responsive, and communicative. She has truly thought of everything we could possibly need while staying there including coffee, beach towels and beach bags, a good quality clothes steamer, a basket of things you might've forgotten (toothbrush, sunblock, etc.), and the list goes on. We loved the balcony overlooking the street and wish we would have spent more time out there. Everything was clean, beds were comfortable. A fantastic stay!
The stay at Russell J's property was good.
We had a lovely stay here during our stop through Chicago! A great price for a spacious townhome! Highly recommend.
Michael was very communicative which was appreciated!

This a wonderfully unique and artistically designed space.  Definitely as described in David’s lengthy and entertaining description with more info and entertainment in the house “guidebook”.   We did drive to Chicago and so had to play the “hunt for parking” game but we are familiar with that.  Hit the trifecta of Cubs home games every night, street sweeping and road construction to add extra degrees of difficulty, however we were able to find free street parking within a few blocks every night.  The bed was a little too firm for my back but that is a personal issue.   Would be delighted to stay here again!

Lisa certainly earned the title SUPERHOST! She was such a beautiful lady, very welcoming! She was there to greet us when we arrived and escorted us out when we were leaving. Any breakdowns, Lisa rectified the situation immediately and accomodated any needs we had. Lisa’s space is in a prime location, it is very spacious, private, and a comfortable stay. I fully enjoyed the in-house massage chair and outdoor balcony space. I truly appreciate Lisa accomodating us for our short stay. It is truly a hidden gem. Definitely looking for to connecting with Lisa and planning future stays. Thank you again for having us !!
Great apartment in the heart of Boystown. Enjoyed our stay during Pride Fest. Would stay here again. Dimitri was a great host.

The Airbnb was nice, and we had enough beds for all of our guests. Having TVs in every room was also a nice touch. The only feedback we have is that the towels didn’t smell fresh, and the power went out a couple of times due to a rainstorm in the area.

Beautiful home and plenty of room. Home is just as listed and looks like the pictures. Close to downtown but you still need to take either public transportation or an uber. One of our guests said they could hear the neighbors at night from her window, but I didn’t. The smoke detector alarm needed new batteries, it kept beeping and we did ask for them to be replaced. Nobody came to replace them so that was a little annoying, but other than that, we had a good experience.

We really appreciated the stay at this BnB. The apartment was very open and spacious. I personally liked the bed in the front nook as I like being by the window. It was especially nice on the rainy day we had. The location was very good for the city. While not exactly on a lively strip, really great neighborhoods are a five minute bike ride in nearly every direction. Late night bites available across the street at the taqueria. Clear and easy instructions and smooth checkin/checkout.

We loved staying at Nicole & Matt’s quaint home in old town. The gated space is private while only being a few steps away from the bars and restaurants on the old town strip. The space is so pretty and dreamy we will be sure to stay again next time we are in Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was very clean, cozy, and comfortable, and it felt like a home away from home. Shaun was an excellent host—very friendly, attentive, and responsive throughout our stay. He made sure we had everything we needed and was always available to answer questions.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming stay. Thank you, Shaun, for your hospitality!
hidden gem, will def try to book again when i come back to the city!
Alex was great & very quick to respond. Most of the recommendations provided were awesome. Place was exactly as listed & very clean. Definitely be back.

The host was responsive and communicated well throughout the stay, which I really appreciated. Unfortunately, the property itself wasn’t what I was hoping for. It felt very damp, likely because it was essentially a basement unit, and that made it less comfortable. I also noticed stains on the sheets and some of the furniture, which affected the overall cleanliness impression. In addition, the sound insulation seemed poor, and we could clearly hear the people in the upstairs unit walking around. The beds and pillows were also not very comfortable, and many of us woke up with neck and back pain each morning.
Overall, while the host was excellent with communication, we didn’t feel the accommodations matched the price. We’ve stayed at several other places in Chicago that were cleaner, quieter, and more comfortable for less money. I appreciate the host’s responsiveness, but I wouldn’t choose to stay here again.
Demitri is a super host.  He was quick to respond if we had questions and addressed a minor issue quickly and thoroughly.  It was such a good experience we have already booked it again.
Plenty of room for our group. Close to Wrigley Field.

A cool place to stay for a visit to the city. Close to train and bus stops, and within walking distance to food, shopping, etc.
I played the arcade games more than expected, it was a nice addition to the stay.
If you have young children, the doors can be a little loud, but it didn’t bother me.
I would definitely stay again.
My stay at Bryan’s bnb was great. The bnb was clean and it was easy to get in contact with him.

Excellent stay! Janet has a beautiful home that was very comfortable for six adults. We enjoyed some of the local spots (with Janet’s recommendations) and easily traveled downtown. Janet had excellent communication. Very proactive! We loved our stay!
The place was GREAT to stay in! Majorie communicated VERY well & quickly. Although, I don’t think the neighborhood was very walkable but the overall stay was amazing & I would stay again!
La comunicación fue excelente, muy atento pero habían algunos detalles de limpieza
Place was very clean and  the location in Lincoln Park was perfect.
Beautiful and spacious!  Lots of beds for a large group but all the spaces felt homey and intentionally decorated.  Everyone in my group said they’d like to live there.

The pictures do not do this place justice. The apartment was decorated beautifully. It was also extremely clean and spacious. My fiancé and I felt comfortable and wish we could have stayed longer. Great location. The hosts were very responsive. Great amenities. The next time we come visit Chicago, this will be our only choice for lodging. You won’t regret it!

Easy to gain access with the instructions and never needed to have direct conversation with the host, although I believe it would have been possible via the chat if necessary. This Airbnb is for the bedroom only, the bathroom is shared (it is not clear if it is shared with the host alone or if there are other guests). The bathroom is adjacent to the bedroom, which is useful for easy access. The doors of the building and the front door of the apartment were sometimes left unlocked, which was a bit worrying. The area felt safe and I was informed by locals that it was safe to walk outside, it was completely residential with no shops etc in the direct vicinity but there is a train station, which can be accessed by walking.
The Airbnb was clean and spacious. The hosts were responsive
Great place to stay, very clean and host made our stay very easy with detailed instructions and provided great suggestions while being in the city

En general todo bastante bien. La zona linda, la ubicación buena. El problema es que durante una semana entera reclamé por el internet del departamento, la velocidad promedio no superaba los 10 mb/s, y a veces ni siquiera funcionaba. Pero a pesar de los constantes reclamos, nunca lograron hacerlo funcionar bien. Solo me reintegran 40 usd que es como una burla, cuando el internet hoy en día es algo esencial para usar, trabajar, etc. Al punto que volvía tarde al departamento sabiendo lo mal que iba a funcionar internet.

Fue una estancia muy buena, Rosy ha sido super amable al igual que su esposo. El único punto que tengo por resaltar es el ruido en la noche, se escucha principalmente en la madrugada, fuera de eso estuvo genial, todas las atenciones, recomendaciones. Sacaron 10 de 10  Rosy.
Excelente lugar, con tiendas 24horas por algún antojo a la vuelta de la esquina, parada de bus a media cuadra que conecta con el metro, ambiente tranquilo, todo estuvo muy bien gracias por todo
Michael was incredibly sweet! Unfortunately I had to cut my stay short for family but I would absolutely come back!

We enjoyed our stay at this Airbnb during our time in Chicago. The space was comfortable, clean, and welcoming, and it gave us a nice place to return to after full days with family and activities. The location was convenient, and overall, the home had a warm and inviting feel.
We especially appreciated the host allowing us to check in early since we had an early arrival at the airport. That kindness and flexibility made the start of our trip much easier.
The only challenge we experienced was with the shower, as the water temperature was not stable and made showering a bit difficult at times. Aside from that, our stay went smoothly, and we appreciated the host’s responsiveness and hospitality.
We would recommend this Airbnb to others visiting Chicago, with the hope that the shower temperature issue can be addressed for future guests.
Zemoria-Philadelphia, PA.
Very nice loft, plenty of space

Great home for a large/extended family gathering. Victor is amazing and very responsive to any issues that we had. The neighborhood is very quiet and there are several places to eat & shop a nice walk away. The beds were very comfortable and the home, though older, felt very spacious and comfortable. The home could use a good deep cleaning from top to bottom - hopefully the hosts have remedied that for their next guests. Some details of the home felt like they could also use an upgrade even though they look really good in the photos, they’re lower end cosmetic finishes. There’s ample parking in the two car garage as well as on the street in front of the home. The jacuzzi is a nice amenity but I do feel that at the price point, it should be included and not an additional fee. The basement was a great gathering place and the little ones loved the kids’ area. My favorite spot is the deck off the primary bedroom - very cozy on a nice evening.

The apartment was exactly as described and was spotless upon arrival. Miya was incredibly helpful and communicated everything promptly and clearly throughout our stay.
It was such a thoughtful surprise to find water, drinks, and snacks waiting for us when we arrived; our kids absolutely loved that welcome touch!
The location was extremely convenient, with easy access to everything we needed. There’s a grocery store and a parking garage right across the street, which made our stay even more comfortable.
We had a wonderful experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Echo what others said about the noise. An active toddler ran back and forth across the ceiling regularly.  We also had issues with the hot water heater so were without hot water for a few days.  A cute place with lots of space in a great neighborhood.
Great location in Chicago. Walkable to some great spots.

Tims place was a wonderful place to stay. He was so responsive and kind. The house was very clean and matched the description. He sent a great list of things to do and places to eat. Walkable to Wrigley to catch a game. Overall a great stay!
Perfect stay! Will for sure be back!
Es muy bonita y tiene lo necesario para q disfrutes Chicago.
I love all the paintings and plants around the apartment! Drea was very friendly.

We had a nice stay! Once you learn how to get into the Airbnb the rest is easy peasy. The bus & blue line are close. DOLLAR TREE is right down the road incase you want snacks/food/drinks tha are affordable. There’s also a Wendy’s, a Little Cesar’s, etc! So much in walking distance!
The host was responsive about the AC. There wasn’t a lot of noise like the other comments might say. It was a lovely AirBnb and I would happily stay here again!

The place was exactly as pictured, and the building felt very safe. There are restaurants within walking distance, but it was also very convenient to cook in the kitchen during our stay. Yasmin was very responsive when I had questions. It felt a lot like staying at a friend's house while they are away.
Great location. Good vibes. Friendly barista.

Yolanda's place is well stocked and nicely decorated. She thought of many details that made us feel at home and made our stay more convenient, such as having coffee pods available, a well stocked kitchen, and wonderful touches in decor throughout. The kitchen is especially nice! We did have trouble finding parking our first night when we arrived late. After that, it was not a problem. I would not consider it a very walkable area. If I returned to Chicago, I would probably try to stay in a different area, but the place itself was great.
It was a great place to stay with a family. Plenty of space for everyone.
Everything went smooth. Only a 20 minute walk from the United center so great location if you're catching a game or show.

Everything about this rental was wonderful - we loved Bucktown, and the gardens, and the bunnies at night in the neighborhood.  The flat was perfect for our family of 4. Thanks Jean for the hospitality!
we had a great time.  will book again in the future

Right in the middle of Wicker Park neighborhood it was easy to walk to many places.  Location was also away enough from the busy streets.  If you are tall (over 6’) be careful with the ceiling beams, I bumped my head a couple times.  Keep in mind there is no kitchen which was fine because we ate out every meal, including at the farmer’s market on Saturday.  So many restaurants in the area, it’s fantastic.  One morning we were awakened by what seemed like a toddler running in the apartment upstairs, however that was about all we heard.

We had a great stay and will happily book with Rebecca again. He place is an easy walk to the UChicago Medical Center and the grocery store was very convenient.
The king room with attached bathroom was very clean and comfortable. Rebecca is a great communicator with her guests and we always knew when other people were arriving or leaving.

Nice place! Great location! Responsive hosts! The only difficulty for us was the spiral stairs you must walk down to get to the bedrooms, but we knew about this ahead of time. For this reason and only for this reason, I would not stay there again.
Great place to stay! Great host as well.
Overpriced and under delivered

Great location for cubs games! We were able to walk to Wrigley and back quickly and easily. It was also an easy pick-up/drop off spot for ride share drivers for our other Chicago adventures. Outside of location, host was communicative and the unit was cozy.
Lovely spacious apartment. Kitchen and bathrooms were well stocked. Front desk concierge staff was kind and helpful. Location fantastic!

Overall the space was nice, the apartment was spacious and had great lighting. Ben was very proactive in his communication and the check-in/check-out was easy.
The neighbors next door had very loud parties Thursday and Friday night until around 3am but we had a noise machine for our son so it thankfully didn't mess up his sleep.
The listing said there was an in-unit washer/dryer but I never found it so it was either really well hidden or not actually there.
Great host, great breakfast places near by

first, she did offer for us to move. We had already unpacked for our 10 days and did not want to repack. we did report broken blinds, no skillet, non functioning oven, burnt out light bulbs and broken bathroom tiles. None which were corrected during my stay. she did communicate quickly with me but no resolve . I purchased a skillet, I hung sheets over windows so my wife would feel comfortable in the apartment, I took our meals to our son's house to cook, and placed tape over broken bathroom tiles. We are an older couple who has stayed with this company in the past very happily. Again,  she did offer a new apartment but we did not have the help to move our things. Our son had to carry our things in for us up the 3 flights of stairs, but he was no longer available to help us move. Hopefully this was just a one time bad time. And, I feel, there where addition fees in the end.

My wife and I had a great time staying at Scott and Jill's guesthouse and would absolutely stay there again. The guesthouse is as advertised, with all amenities you could need. The outdoor area is a serene setting with plenty of greenery, as is the surrounding neighborhood. There are tons of great cafes and restaurants within walking distances. I cannot recommend this place enough. Scott and Jill are good people and great hosts. 10/10!

Overall we enjoyed our stay. The view is amazing. location was great for going to the Field Museum. The  beds were VERY firm, which was not our preference. Blinds allowed a lot of light through, actual light blocking blinds would be better than see through shades. They allowed us to drop our bags early. but there was confusion when we showed up at the front desk because they did not see our reservation. it got cleared up. it would be nice if they could hold bags after check out.
Beautiful space in a beautiful neighbourhood! Food recommendations were especially helpful. We will definitely be back to Lincoln Square! :)
Throughly enjoyed staying here! It was a beautiful home with a lot of amenities and situated in a great part of the city. The hosts were very communicative!

This place checked all the markers.   It was so cozy.  I love that it had a private entrance.  It is a ground unit but it didn't feel like one.  The place is super cute.  The decorations look intentional, like they cared to make it welcoming. There're plenty of places to eat nearby, with plenty of nightlife.  And public transportation is nearby.  Communication with the host was easy.  They were very responsive.  The location is perfect because it's far enough yet close enough to the downtown area, which can be too much.  I would stay here again.
Geo was very responsive and super helpful! I would highly recommend his place.
We had a great stay. lovely Neighbor ☺️

We really liked this Airbnb.  The room was all we needed- we were out most of time- and was a good price.  Still it was great to come back to at the end of the night.  We liked the location- it was a quiet mostly residential area and parking was easy and free.  We were able to bike from the Airbnb to the lake mostly on bike lanes and enjoyed that journey.

We had a fantastic weekend trip, got to see the sights and enjoy delicious food. This location was centered in Old Town next to ample transportation.
The room had a beautiful view and was very clean and nice. When we experienced an issue we reached out to the host, who was very quick and responsive. Would recommend this stay!
Great stay!
Great stay with easy access to the train! Excellent host, too. I will certainly visit again!

After a long day of layover bc of the weather our group didn't get in til 3am. Nay still answered the phone and answered all our questions in the middle of the night ready and available as she states in her listing. However, after checking in there were a few hick ups that made us feel a bit unpleasant. This is a nice last minute stay but it just wasn't ideal for our group. Thanks Nay
Great location. Great communication. Very clean.
Great spot by wrigley
Great place, great host👍
Very nice and cosy place:) Good spot to stay and explore Chicago.
We had an amazing weekend in Logan Square. Gorgeous property, gorgeous neighbourhood. Steps away from dozens of bars and restaurants and the Blue Line. Highly recommend Liz and Martin’s place!
I would 100% recommend. The place was very clean and organized. They communicated very well!

Our family had a great stay in Katty's place. Conveniently located in Hyde Park just a few blocks from where we were visiting family, the apartment was clean, easy to get to, and met our needs during our stay. Location-wise, there are great coffee shops, restaurants, and the MSI is a few blocks away. It's also conveniently next to the Metra if you're going downtown. We would stay again!
We had an excellent weekend. I appreciate the host, the property, and the location. Thanks for making it a great experience
Exactly as pictured, quick drive downtown.

We had an awesome stay. We were close to so much stuff and took the train/bus a lot to get to our destinations. The Airbnb was an awesome retreat from the busy streets and night life. Definitely check out small Cheval if you like a good burger. Tyler’s instructions were clear and communicative but we had no issues to address during our stay. We would love to stay again in our next visit. Thank you.

David's place is spartan, but nice.  The overall building is *very*dated and courtyard was very overgrown, which detracted from the overall appearance.  The unit itself was comfortable, but also fairly dated.  The bed was comfortable, everything was clean, but for the price I think I some updates are in order.  The WiFi was spotty at first, but then David replaced the router and it was fine afterward.  The location is about a mile south of Andersonville (about a 20 minute walk) and about a mile north of Wrigley Field (also a 20 minute walk).  The closest mass transit is the Montrose stop on the Brown line or the 22 Clark bus, or the 78 Montrose bus.  There is a Walgreens just up Greenville Ave and there is a Dunkin Donuts and 7-11 about a block away.

We booked this penthouse condo for a long Father’s Day weekend and it was perfect. Less than a five minute walk to everything in the Fulton Market district and 15 minutes to the Riverwalk. The grocery store directly behind the building is ideal as well.
We checked out the amenities but ended up not using them as we spent more time hanging out in Fulton Market than we had anticipated.
Perfect location, knockout views of the skyline and lake, really couldn’t have asked for anything more.

We have an excellent stay in this apartment. So comfortable for our group of 5 people. Everything was perfect for 3 nights, excluding the location, that’s a bit far from the downtown, but you have a bus stop and other transportation options very close, so it's not a problem at all, and it’s just 15 minutes by Uber. I would recommend this place definitely.
