great place!

Beautiful home with a 10/10 location. Alan’s place was clean, well equipped with quality linens/soaps, coffee, a welcome basket of snacks and had everything we needed to enjoy our weekend. He was very responsive to messages and the whole process couldn’t have been easier. We would not hesitate to stay here again.

Jun was a great host. We arrived early and she accommodated us before our actual check in time without hesitation. The place was clean and cozy. It’s located next to a fire station, so during the day it was nosy at times, but we didn’t mind it at all. 17min walk to McCormick Place, which is what we needed. There are many restaurants in the area. We loved staying there. Thank you Jun!

Extremely comfortable space, with basically everything you would need. Jeff and Nick thought a lot about what guests require on trips and provide those items and amenities in spades. The home was spacious and comfortable with a lot of different areas to socialize, and the surrounding neighborhood provided a lot of opportunities to explore as well. We had a memorable, relaxing, and fun trip!
Lovely gaff and a great host. If you stay make sure to check out Di’s bar just round the corner!
Great time! Thank you for all of your hospitality!
Great space for 6 of us! Has everything you would need. Neighborhood felt safe and Brian was really responsive and nice
The place is a nice and safe location. Rooms were nice and comfortable. My only complaint was that there was only one towel for a two bedroom rental.
It was a cozy and peaceful location
Clean and private. Easy to get to. We were able to walk to the train station and felt safe and comfortable.

Jill's place was very inviting, and very comfortable. The room itself was very spacious, open, and loved the natural lighting.
Jill herself was an amazing host!
She was very friendly, extremely helpful when it came to directions since it was my first time in Chicago, and had a good amount of recommendations on things to do, and good places to eat.
Plus, her dog Nala was so sweet!!!
Would definitely stay here again :)

We really enjoyed our time at Dennis’s place! The neighborhood is quiet and felt very safe. It is very walkable with cute shops and restaurants close by, and only a few blocks from the train. The pub across the street was great! Good food and friendly staff. Check in and out was easy, and everything was clean and well stocked.

This condo was in an amazing location and was very spacious for me and my 3 guests. It is a 4 minute walk from the L and also a square with food, bars, and coffee. The beach is also a short walk away. Falon was communicative and very helpful. I would stay here again.
Cris's place was awesome! It is a beautiful apartment and a very quiet area. We enjoyed our stay. The beds and pillows were extremely comfortable. The place is even decorated nicely.
Clean and in a great neighbourhood!
Great location!

Lovely Airbnb in Woodlawn. We have stayed in several Airbnbs in the Hyde Park area and this was the nicest. Would be nice if second bedroom had a regular bed, rather than sofa bed. But otherwise everything was perfect.

This was a lovely stay in one of my favorite neighborhoods in Chicago. Clean, comfortable, and walkable to all the best of Andersonville. Paul and Anthony were friendly and welcoming hosts. Thank you both!

We had a great stay in Chinatown of Chicago. The apartment was as advertised. It was great for a family of five, two parents, two kids, one Grandma. Would definitely stay here again. The neighborhood is very cool. We got to see a dragon boat race!

Ben's place was the perfect spot for our group trip to Chicago. The location was perfect, bed's were extremely comfortable, layout of the space was fantastic, and it was spotless. We felt like we were at home, thank you so much.

The location was perfect. Just a short walk to Wrigley Field and the red line train that goes to the Loop. Considering the active, busy neighborhood of Wrigleyville, the apartment was surprisingly peaceful. It was very clean, and the beds were v
Very responsive host. The home was decorated nicely. The distance to most things was less than 15/20 minutes.
Easy access and great location!

Apartment is spacious with abundant natural light. Host is polite and responsive.Beds were very comfortable. Designated parking behind building was always accessible and so convenient. Only one of the requested extra blankets was provided, only 2 bath towels each for 3 guests for 7 day stay. HVAC is super loud.  Cleanliness issues with both bathrooms. No nice extras such as foil, baggies, bottled water. No lamps for ambient lighting or reading, unattended dog on balcony left to bark. 5 out of 7 nights we barely slept until 4 a.m. because of loud male voices or loud walking in other units (for hours),  parties on 3rd floor with the group noisily returning at 3:45 a.m. Tenants or visitors regularly  leave items in the exterior rear door to prop it open, making the building accessible. Issues are referred to a management team. If you are visiting to go out to clubs and enjoy the nightlife, and don't need to get up early, you might do well here. Unfortunately that wasn't  us.
Great host, beautiful home.

Lisa was a great host! Our flight had gotten in early so it wasn’t time to check-in yet but Lisa held onto our bags for us, which allowed us to go out and explore. She also gave us a lot of local recommendations and with so many things to see and do, that was a big help.
Lisa’s place is about a 15 minute walk to the L which made it nice to take the blue line all the way to the downtown area. If you’re looking for a spot in between O’hare and all downtown has to offer, I would definitely recommend Lisa’s bungalow!

We had a fantastic stay! The place was incredibly clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect and made exploring the area so easy. Our host was wonderful—super responsive and provided great instructions for check-in. Would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend to anyone!

This was a perfect place for a quick weekend. It was conveniently located close to public transportation but was also walking distance from all of the most wonderful restaurants and coffee shops. The beach was also right there. The apartment was stocked with everything we needed and Walter was an excellent communicator! If we're ever back in Chicago we already know exactly where we're headed.

Brandon’s place was great for our family’s Chicago getaway. It’s in a great neighborhood, walkable to Wrigley and many restaurants and bars. Brandon’s home is clean and well equipped for family gatherings. Great stay!

The apartment was very clean and exactly as listed. It was a bit further out of the city than I thought when I booked it, but it wasn't a big deal. There are bus options close by and  Ubers and Lyfts were easy to call. The hosts offered a bunch of recommendations that looked interesting but we didn't have time to check them out. We enjoyed our stay at this place.
Great apartment in the BEST neighborhood.  Perfect home base to explore the city.
Nikki's place was extremely clean and appeared to be recent and well done construction. Beds were comfortable and shower was awesome! We would totally stay again!
We loved our stay! This was one of the most accurately described and overall easy Air BnB’s at which we’ve stayed.
We had a great time! There was plenty of space, the kitchen was beautiful, and check in and check out were pretty easy.
Loved our stay in Chicago here! Great space, walkable neighborhood with good foods and close to the bus lines. Definitely would come back!

The apartment was lovely, very clean and in a good central location.  There is a Dunkin right across the street for easy morning coffee before the day.  3 minute walk to the bus and 9 minute walk to the red line.  There are several small restaurants within easy walking distance.  The only thing to be aware of is that there are a lot of stairs to get to the apartment.

Airbnb as described and pictured. Larger than expected and nice outdoor seating area! Convenient location to lots of great spots! Stayed here as I was going to a concert at United Center, and this was a great location. Thanks!

Dawn's place was beautiful!
The house was spotless, the space was inviting, and the fridge was stocked with drinks and snacks.
I highly recommend Dawn's place, and will happily book again on my next trip to Chicago!
Absolutely perfect stay!! Unbelievable location and quiet neighborhood street, but also only steps away from Wells St. and there is a nice patio outside! 10/10 stay.

Overall, this location functioned well for our 3 mid-30s long weekend friend trip. It is right by an L station, walkable to multiple restaurants and convenience/grocery stores, and close to the neighborhood we wanted to explore.
However, the unit needs some love. We encountered a rat in the kitchen that was present for our entire stay, some proactive care from the host probably could have mitigated that issue prior and even after some clean up we still were unable to safely eat in the kitchen. Additionally, the beds were pretty uncomfortable and there are several signs that the unit could use some physical and aesthetic repair. Which is a shame because this particular area of Chicago is low on hotels.
Overall, worked okay for us since we were out and about often but would have been nice to feel like we could have relaxed a bit more and enjoyed the space during our night downtime.

Overall not impressed with the host or the unit. Paid a lot of money for the dishes to be dirty and the host to be rude. The rules discuss quiet hours and being mindful of noise quite a bit, however the other units on the floor were very loud and disruptive.
I enjoyed my stay with Iris, highly recommend!

Beautiful place in a great location. The parking space is very narrow and can be difficult to maneuver with a larger vehicle. The home appeared clean upon arrival, but we later found a significant amount of dust behind the curtains, a sticky side table in the TV room, a couple of pills left behind, and food under the beds. The bathrooms were clean.
We experienced some issues with a clogged sink and toilet, but they were addressed promptly. The bedroom curtains are not blackout curtains, so the rooms became bright very early in the morning. The kitchen was generally clean, although we found a couple of dirty dishes.
The beds are comfortable, and overall the property is very nice. However, the stairs are quite steep and may be challenging for elderly guests. Considering the price we paid, we expected the home to be spotless.

Roxy's Hidden Gem was a great experience for my husband and I. Within 2 minutes from Oak Park, where we visited the grocery store, nearby restaurants, and coffee shops. Roxy's place was immaculately clean. We loved the layout of the unit and the nice welcoming message left for us. Neighborhood is in the process of gentrifying, but that didnt really bother us.  Neighbors didn't bother anyone. Roxy's instructions were very clear with checking in and check out. Great appliances and other amenities. My husband and I will definitely stay there again.

We stayed in Vin's unit for two nights as we were in the neighborhood for a wedding. For us, it was a good location because it was close to the festivities and the L/blue line. In terms of overall location and value, I think we probably could have done better in other parts of the city but, again, we wanted to be close to the venue.
Something to note, the unit is rather old so there's some some obvious downsides that come along with that - the most notable for us being that the building is very creaky. Being in the city, you obviously expect some noise but the upstairs neighbors came back late (1am or later) both nights and you could basically hear every footstep. It's clearly nothing that our host could control but something to note if you're a light sleeper.
Otherwise, though, it gets the job done if you're looking for a spot in Old Irving Park or near Logan Square. It worked well for us for a quick weekend trip.

Mindy and Tony’s Iklektik House is my go-to home away from home when I’m in Chicago visiting family. It’s large, comfortable, close to everything, and a perfect fit for me. I’ve stayed here at least four times already. The instructions are clear, Mindy and Tony are responsive, and the layout of the place with its full size kitchen, living area, bedroom, and bath are just right. It’s located in a great neighborhood of Chicago - easy walking to eateries, breweries, shopping, parks, you name it.

Great place to stay near Logan Square and easy to get to the Blue line or take the bus toward the loop. Barry & Charlene’s place is exactly as described and they give tons of detailed info about the unit and everything else. It was a great stay!

The house was clean and matched the description exactly! The instructions were a bit confusing during check in/could use more details about which unit it is, but eventually Jose helped us figure it out. The only issue I had was with the tenants living upstairs. They were very loud and disrespectful by throwing a party until 3am, and the walls were very thin we could hear everything. We did not get any rest because of this. Otherwise the stay was good and the airbnb is very nice.
Great location, clean, comfortable, and easy to enjoy. Everything was well done, and the stay was smooth and relaxing.
Wonderful place to stay for a summer weekend in Chicago!
Kai’s home was great for our group, the communication was thorough and responsive!
Great location to explore Chicago. Hosts were very communicative and friendly providing a number of great recommendations for the area.

I've used Airbnb quite a bit over the past few years, and I usually avoid booking a private room in someone's home. This stay completely changed my perspective. The Airbnb was an incredible value, and it was close enough to everything I wanted to do that Uber rides were inexpensive. The rooftop was a huge highlight, such a beautiful place to relax.
Sujata was incredibly responsive, kind, patient, and accommodating throughout my stay. She does rent out the second bedroom to other guests, so you may see someone else during your visit. She gave me a heads-up about that before I arrived, which I really appreciated. The other guest during my stay was very friendly, and it wasn't an issue at all.
The bedroom was spotless, comfortable, and had everything I needed. The bathroom was also very clean, and the entire home was well cared for. Overall, I had a wonderful experience and would absolutely stay here again. I definitely plan to come back!

Had a great stay. The building is dated but they did a great job with remodel. The apartment is spacious and clean. We were worried when we saw earplugs on the night stands, but it was quiet despite being there over a weekend, and the bed and pillows were comfortable and we had great sleep!
Great stay and host in Kenya! Very responsive, easy to work with and did a sensational job taking care of us during this trip. Would highly recommend to anyone looking!
Great place that was perfect for our trip!

this is my second time staying at Alle's and both times I found staying there extremely convenient to get to the United center arena and enjoy a concert. it is a 10-minute walk and it is so smooth and quick if you are trying to avoid the crowd after a concert. other than that, I found the place clean and worth the price. downtown is also fairly close! I recommend it

We had a great stay! The place was very clean, cozy, and well-maintained. The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful, which made for a relaxing visit. The beds were especially comfortable, and we slept very well. Overall, a wonderful stay, and we would gladly return. Highly recommend!
The place was very well put! The location was nice. The host was great and attentive!

The outside of the building is unassuming but the inside was nicely renovated. There are 3 levels with a finished basement. There were extra towels and blankets. The host was very responsive and helpful. The location is near train tracks so at night, the train can be heard. The neighborhood is quiet and was close to the downtown area where all of the events were. I would absolutely stay here again.
Adrienne was there to greet me when I checked in. I highly recommend this place if you are traveling solo and need a place to stay outside of a hotel. It's definitely worth the price!
First time in Chicago and host was super accommodating and friendly from the start to checkout. Would definitely stay again!

We had a wonderful stay at Joyce’s place. The house itself looked exactly like the photos. It was spacious, comfortable, and had everything we needed. It even had a coffee pot and coffee available in the kitchen which is not always easy to find when booking Airbnb’s. You can tell the house is older but they have kept it very clean and cozy. The area is as described but very close to the green line so it was convenient for us. Joyce was very thorough in her description and preparation so there were no surprises. She checked in on us at the beginning and end of the trip, but we had no issues at all! I would definitely recommend this place to anyone booking a trip to Chicago!

Can’t recommend this place more. It’s exactly what we were hoping for. Super convenient location on a quiet street in Lakeview. Found a parking spot right outside the unit and didn’t move the car until we drove home 3 days later. It was a short walk to Whole Foods for groceries, Will’s Northside for beers and Coda di Volpe for dinner. The unit was well appointed with great products in the bathroom and in the kitchen. Beds and bedding were clean, crisp and comfortable! We loved making a Nespresso coffee in the morning and sitting outside. The outside space in the back was lovely. Summer in Chicago is amazing and this spot lets you enjoy it all!
Claudia was a excellent host would definitely come back ❤️
Cesar & Maria space was comforting and prime for all the groups needs. They were excellent hosts.

Had a great stay this past weekend! The space was very clean and matched the listing description perfectly. No surprises, which is always appreciated. The host was incredibly helpful and responsive throughout the whole process. Would definitely recommend and would stay again!
Great place to stay. Darius Sr was very responsive to our needs. Highly recommend staying here.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay with Mike and Channon! The property was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, well-maintained, and equipped with everything we needed for a great visit.
The hosts were fantastic: friendly, responsive, welcoming, and genuinely invested in making sure we had a great experience. Their communication was excellent from booking through checkout.
The location was perfect for our trip. If you're visiting the Obama Presidential Center, this Airbnb is an excellent choice—only about 6 minutes away and very easy to access. It was also convenient to downtown Chicago and many other popular attractions, restaurants, and sightseeing destinations.
We felt safe, comfortable, and right at home during our stay. Everything exceeded our expectations, and we would not hesitate to stay here again on a future visit to Chicago.
Thank you, Mike and Channon, for being such wonderful hosts and helping make our trip so memorable!
Kimberly's place was immaculate and roomy. Great neighborhood, and a short walk to public transportation. Kimberly was very responsive and check-in was a breeze.
A very nice place in a quiet neighborhood, we enjoyed it!
Great place in a great neighborhood. Lots to do in the area. The apartment was spotless and well stocked, and Salvador was super friendly and helpful. Would 100% stay again in the future!

Erica is very socialable and responsive.  I had no problems and I would like to stay there again because of the condition of the property, its location and the professionalism and kindness of Erica.  I must add Chicago was very hectic while I was there beause of the Opening of the Obama Center which is down the street.  Erica took the time to provide much needed information.
Great location and a pleasant place to stay for a few nights

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this property. In my opinion, it would be better suited as a long-term sublease for a family in need of housing rather than as a short-term Airbnb rental.
My breaking point occurred when I returned to the property one evening and heard gunshots nearby. Upon arrival, there were several people gathered in the alleyway being loud and unruly, and there were individuals sleeping in their cars near the entrance while I was trying to open the gate.
These ongoing safety and quality-of-life concerns made me feel uncomfortable and unsafe and significantly impacted my experience. As a result, I chose not to stay at the property.
I am also very disappointed with the lack of communication regarding my refund. I have yet to receive a refund for the nights I did not stay, and it has now been five days without any response from the host. The combination of the safety concerns and the absence of timely customer service has made this an extremely frustrating experience.
Recommandé à 100%. définitivement si je reviens à Chicago j'aimerais céduler mon logement ici encore une fois.
The place was as adorable as it seemed, Kristina went above & beyond to help us out during our stay, and I would recommend the location as a perfect homebase to anyone visiting/looking to explore.

El apartamento es muy bonito y amplio y está ubicado en un barrio mucho más bonito que está lejos del centro pero que está bien conectado para llegar. La comunicación con el anfitrión fue buena, ya que nos ayudó muy rápidamente para darnos papel higiénico y un una manta que necesitábamos. Sería bueno que la cocina estuviera mejor equipada con más ollas y platos, ya que éramos cinco y la cantidad no era suficiente, además a ciertas horas se escuchaba ruido del piso de arriba, sin embargo, no fue algo tan grave

Host was very communicative which was appreciated. However, the unit was not as clean as generally expected (found hair on the sheets, actual dirt on the shelving because this is a basement unit, floor boards not properly aligned resulting in holes that fill with dirt). Also worth noting that the bathroom has bad airflow resulting in the bath mat never drying and a general wet smell. Honestly, you stay here because the location is top tier, but manage your expectations for the unit.
Great place and responsive host.

We felt right at home. The house is across from a beautiful park with many walkable restaurants near by. It was private and peaceful. The place was very clean and tidy. It was great having two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Tom was friendly and proactive and gave great recommendations for local spots. Easy to get around town from this location.  Would stay here again.
This will be my primary Chicago accommodation during visits moving forward. Fantastic experience!

If you are visiting Chicago for a few days with a group and need a home base for your trip, this place will absolutely be adequate for your needs. It is decently priced, clean, and big enough to comfortably house up to five individuals or couples. The hosts are also very communicative and willing to make recommendations in the area.
However, when my friends and I visited, certain things were lacking. In the bathroom, the toilet paper holder and hand towel rack were ripped out of the wall, and the towel rack fell off when we placed a towel on it for the first time. The closet doors in one bedroom were also completely unattached. I made the hosts aware of these issues for the next guests, and to their credit they apologized.
All in all, it's a nice place if a little bare bones, and I would stay there again. That said, there were enough things that fell short of expectations that I do not feel right giving it a higher rating.
Great stay! Very flexible when checking in, would recommend!
This place was super cute and perfect for what we needed for a girls trip!
The guest house was so cozy and accommodating.   I instantly felt at home.  The local restaurants, book shop, and people made it a very welcome and enjoyable stay
We had a great stay. The apartment is just like the pictures, lots of space with everything you could need. Cyndi was responsive and helpful. Would stay again!

We had a wonderful stay! The host was incredibly communicative and made sure we had everything we needed. They went above and beyond by leaving a bottle of wine for my fiancé and me, along with bottled water, coconut water, ice in the freezer, and even seasonings stocked in the cabinets. The thoughtful touches didn’t go unnoticed.
The space itself was beautiful, clean, and well-maintained. We especially appreciated the extra amenities like plenty of towels and makeup towels. Everything was comfortable and made us feel right at home. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a relaxing and welcoming place to stay. 😊
Everything was perfect except for the 10am check out time. We would have preferred noon or at least 11am to allow us reasonable amount of time to get up and leave without rushing.
Comfortable stay with an accommodating host!
Great spot and Cristina was very helpful!

Host was amazing. Very responsive and proactive, made things very easy for us. The home was simple, clean, beautiful and very functional. It had everything we needed and we didn't even to call the host for anything. My family really enjoyed our stay and we would recommend Sergii highly to everyone.
We enjoyed our stay and will be back.  Thanks!
Comfortable spot in a fun area. Centrally located by lots of places to eat and drink as well as the park.
Had an amazing stay at Alex's place. It was beautiful, exactly as photoed, spotless clean and safe. Great experience!

Perfect spot in Logan Square-close to public transportation, shopping, & lots of restaurants! Hosts were very responsive & promptly took care of all requests. I would highly recommend this spot to anyone wanting to enjoy Chicago without the city craziness!
Very convenient location for our stay and appeared as photographed but bedding not super comfy and strong smell in the house (cleaning products?).

Nancy was helpful in getting us checked in and comfortable.  Provided great recommendations and accommodations. She was easy to communicate with when we needed anything. Will definitely use her place when we visit again!
Great place for a group going to the Cub game. Thank you!
Great stay very clean
Great neighborhood, very close to downtown attractions, and cozy home. Rachel was easy to reach regarding any questions we had as well.

Home was clean and beds were very comfortable. Easy access and felt great about having a garage for our car. We had zero issues. Qing was great to communicate with and always answered in a timely manner.

Great location and great host! Very responsive.
House was beautiful and everything we needed. Can't wait to come back to Chicago!

We loved Dan’s place! Our first trip
To Chicago and we got so lucky to find Dan’s home, it’s in a great location and easily walkable to Lincoln square, lots of shops and restaurants close by. Felt incredibly safe, the home and neighborhood was very pretty. Easy street parking as well. We will definitely stay here again! Dan has done a wonderful job with this rental, it is clean and had everything we needed, he is a great host.
This was our second stay in Anne's  apartment. it is the most warm welcoming Airbnb we have stayed in.  A perfect location for visiting family.  we already have our next stay booked.
Perfect apartment for three guys in town for business. Place is large, bright, and airy and located near restaurants and coffee shops. We had a great stay and would definitely stay here again.
10/10 — Wonderful stay, would come again! Amazing views, private building. Great location.

This AirBnb was very enjoyable. Super clean place! Located in the heart of Wicker Park - the easy access to great pubs and restaurants was outstanding! Ryan was very quick to respond to messages and frequently checked in to make sure my stay was going smoothly.
Love this place! Clean and nice host!

The place in Hyde Park was very convenient to our visit to U Chicago. It is in a quite neighborhood and the apartment was clean and cozy. The furniture and furnishings were clean and new. Emily and Roya are very responsive hosts and quick with their communication.

John & Kyrsten's place was great for a Chicago girls trip! The location was very convenient for walking within Lincoln Park and to surrounding neighborhoods or catching an Uber to downtown. The hosts were very responsive and communicative to our questions. We especially enjoyed the patio in the backyard. Would highly recommend a stay here!

5 star stay for us especially for the price. Great location, walk ability high, near lots of restaurants (Kasama!) & bars, also had fast WiFi for us to work. Everything was as described. Natalie is very responsive and we would stay there again.
Couple of things to know
- buy or bring body wash/shampoo (target is close by)
- lockbox is shared with another unit (we stored keys during our days out and didn’t realize it was shared until one day the other tenant mistakenly took our set of keys. Natalie had someone come by with a backup, she resolved it quickly).
No big deals but worth knowing. Thank you Natalie for the great stay!

Hello I have a lot of concerns and issues with your Airbnb. First walking through your house that I rented it wasn’t clean at all. It was hair all over the floor and toilet. The floors throughout the entire place hadn’t been swept or mopped. Also, the bed in room 3 was definitely an issue with the box spring steady falling off even after you rigged it up. Also, i had let you know that 4 people would be staying and you only gave us 2 sets of towels to start. Then 2 extra sets. With your towels being white we should have had more than just 1 towel a piece to shower with for the weekend. And I’ve  never stayed at an Airbnb where you didn’t have access to the washing machine and dryer. And for you to have the rules that you have your place should be cleaner whether you hire someone or clean it better yourself. But the stay was definitely a 2/10👎🏾

A great stay in Lincoln Park for our family of four and grandparents! We were worried about stairs but they weren’t a problem at all! In laws took the ground floor room. House is walking distance to great restaurants and Second City. The parking was a huge plus. The driveway was a bit tight for our mini van but we managed every time! Having a dedicated space was amazing, especially for people not used to parking in Chicago! Twin Anchors bar is basically across the street- so welcoming and delicious - we ate there twice! Liz was very responsive and we were greeted by the property helper when we drove up. Super comfy beds. We also appreciated the floor plan photos so we could plan ahead. Truly great stay! We will be back!
absolutely amazing! 10/10 recommend
Nice place in good location. Only issue was parking during games at Wrigglyfield. A couple of daily parking vouchers would have made life a lot easier.
Great location, so many restaurants within walking distance. The unit has everything, including travel tooth brushes and paste in case you forget. Great stay.

This is our second time staying in one of Danny’s properties, and we will definitely be back again! We love the location, the amenities the space had (it’s fully stocked for anyone traveling with a baby!), and it’s the cleanest place we’ve ever stayed in! Would definitely recommend!
Really great location! Walking distance to most restaurants in west loop
Great host and cute cozy place.
Dan was extremely helpful! The basement and the double bunk bed were a hit with my kids (ages 2-10). Would stay here again!

This was our first visit to Chicago and the location was close to the CTA. It’s what we used the whole time. The apartment was very clean and felt right at home. They don’t leave anything out. Even has stocked the little things you might forget. Antonio was very responsive to any questions and was very accommodating. Would stay again if we visit again!
Muy buena ubicación,  prácticamente no necesitarás transporte.
This was a perfect place for us and included everything we needed. Cafes and restaurants are nearby. We would definitely stay here again. Thanks!
Enjoyed our stay. Milan was a great host and checked in daily. Place was clean and easy to access.

The apartment itself was overall really nice very clean, the neighborhood is cute and has a target and grocery store easily accessible. Minor things like the noise from the street are a bit annoying and the dog across the hall but you can really only hear him when you’re in the hallway.

Brandon was very responsive and helpful, and assisted us with getting an early check in. The place was beautiful and was great for my friends and I. The location is super convenient for walking to Wrigley field, and in walking distance of a bunch of great bars and restaurants. We had a lovely time and would love to stay here again next time we visit Chicago. Thanks for a great experience!
very clean! on-street parking included was a huge factor for us. neat neighborhood. convenient. Great location considering our plans!
Great place, great location! We stayed for my son’s wedding - walked right over to St. Michael’s and several other event locations in Old Town.

The location was so convenient and within walking distance of so much. The place was very private and spacious. We hosted a private dinner for a friend's bachelorette party, and the host was very accomodating of us having extra people over for the evening. There were plenty of amenities and the hosts were very quick to respond to any questions we had.
It is such a cute home and very well decorated. It felt comfortable and bright, and we all felt right at home. I would happily stay here again!
Nice and very clean! We would stay again!

Great long weekend in Chicago. Always try and stay in this neighborhood. The condo is in a quiet neighborhood and you wouldn't know you are a block off a busy street/ intersection.  Everything as described. The parking spot is a bonus! Would definitely stay again!
Great place to stay, was about a 10 minute walk to the Subway/Train line, easy access to everything!
Brad’s place was just as described!! The space was comfortable for some rest and relaxation & was also close to lots of things which made exploring Chicago so fun & easy!
Great place to stay

Had a great time staying here with two friends. Conveniently located with nearby coffee and cafes, plus easy walking distance to Wrigley Field. Clean and comfortable!
One minor note to future bookers - there is one convenient parking spot available, but for any other visitors, watch out for local parking restrictions, which are confusingly marked and resulted in a ticket for one of my buddies.
Great place. Gogo communicated well and was very helpful with everything.
Cyrus is super friendly and super helpful. The stay was comfy and homey. Great location.

Dog owners please be mindful that this apartment is eye level with the train. It was so noisy and stressful for my dog that I had to have him sleep somewhere else.
The house rules were also very confusing. At one point, I was told that I could never leave my dog alone in the apartment, even in his crate. If I wanted to just run an errand, I needed a dog sitter. After a ton of back and forth, it was agreed upon that my dog could stay alone when in the crate. All the discussion about my dog being left alone was ultimately unnecessary since it was too loud for him anyways.
Affordable and homey.  It didn't have that AirBnB feel, it felt like we were staying in a home.  Great location.  Joe was very communicative and made the whole process super easy.
Nice space. Helpful host.
Lissette’s place was a great stay. The balcony was nice. With the blue stop being steps away it was easy to see the city.
This cozy apartment is in a fantastic location in beautiful Lincoln Park. We were close to tons of great restaurants, the train, and parks. We loved our stay here.
Very clean and comfortable. Laura was attentive and responded quickly to our questions. We had a great time!
Easy to find, at a great location next to a lot of great things and walkable!

Danny and Diana were the best hosts you could ask for. First the place is absolutely beautiful and was the perfect spot for my friends and I to gather during our weekend trip to Chicago. Admittedly we spent more time in the Bnb than the city...it was just that great! They curated a booklet of instructions of instructions and things to do close by that was super helpful. And my favorite thing was the added touch of toiletries in each bathroom (including tooth brush and toothpaste, deodorant, shaving cream, and feminine products. 10/10 would recommend.
Felt right at home! Had everything we needed. Walkable neighborhood + close to bus stop/train/restaurants and bars.
Couldn’t have asked for a better location for the game. The host was great and would definitely stay again.
Very convenient location and easy to access. I wish I had realized it was a twin bed before booking it, which is on me!

James’ place was excellent! Our original AirBnB had to cancel last minute and I’m so glad we came across James’ AirBnB. The location was excellent, it was very clean, there is lots of space to spread out, and it ended up working perfectly for our girls trip. Highly recommend this place to others!
Perfect place to enjoy the Cubs and Wrigleyville

Perfect house for a large group of people visiting Chicago for a weekend. Close access to food and groceries (Chicago Pickle Across the street is a great deli for lunch). About a 20 minute walk from the beach and 15-30 minute uber into downtown. 20 minute walk to Wrigley if you want to catch a game. House was exactly as pictured and fit 12 guests comfortably. Host is extremely responsive and available. 10/10 would recommend.

This was our 2nd stay with Tim. He is the host of a beautiful home in a safe, quiet and picturesque neighborhood.
I would definitely recommend!

Overall a good experience. The place is comfortable and like you see in the photos. It is pretty easy to check in and out, although the location is not ideal, however, that's not the Airbnb's fault. Would probably return!
Great stay, great service.

This is the only option I had for under 200$ a night on the weekend I stayed in Chicago.
First off, Antonio was kind and respectful. The house is in a neighbourhood that’s enjoyable.
Why are there are 5 Airbnb accounts in the discussion thread, 4 of which are variations on the name Alex? I was asked to rate the place highly after my checkout.
Check-in and checkout times were ridiculous.
The house is sketchy. From the outside, the house is the most unkept on the street. The inside of the apartment is not messy but not clean. The floors would need a good scrub and the a daily vacuum. The first thing I did when I arrived was to check the mattress for traces of bed bugs, which thankfully did not seem to be present.
I hardly slept on the first night. Cars honking, people screaming, bottles breaking, the constant noise from the nearby trains running.
I very much regret staying here.
very clean and just like the pictures! quick to respond as well. overall lovely stay :)
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and matched the listing. Communication was easy, and check-in/check-out were straightforward. Overall, we had a pleasant stay.
It was one of the best Airbnb! I highly recommend!
We had the best time here. Walkable to the blue line, really nice space, and our hosts were super helpful

This place was fantastic. The beds were comfortable! It was nice that there were fans in every room. Johnie was very responsive when asked a question. It was a cozy home with lots of amenities. Very thankful to have found it!
The place was very nice and everything was easy to follow when it came to instructions.
Great place to stay and convenient to downtown areas. Place is very new and great conditions.

Stayed a few nights while in Chicago to watch a couple of ball games at Wrigley Field.
We found Lisa’s place to be perfect for us.
Very nice neighborhood, walkable to restaurants, groceries and restaurants.
Highly recommended place to stay.
Jaime is a reactive, friendly host. He is always helpful and makes everything to make you spend a good stay. very good experience!
Easy check in, nice place, great for our weekend!
Great stay! Would definitely come back!

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago's Little Italy neighborhood. The location was fantastic—close to great restaurants, coffee shops, and many of Chicago's top attractions. The host provided clear, simple instructions that made check-in and finding the property completely stress-free.
We especially appreciated the recommendations on where to eat and places to visit in the area. Everything was easy to access, and we felt right at home during our stay. The property was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
If you're looking for a convenient, well-located place to stay while exploring Chicago, especially Little Italy, I highly recommend this Airbnb. We would definitely stay here again!
Thank you for a wonderful place to stay!!!
Very clean condo with everything needed for our stay. Communication was great, very responsive host. Would stay here again, no doubt!
Great responsive host. Friendly place, clean, and overall satisfied.
Great Stay
A lovely place

We loved the location! It’s so close to museums, restaurants, and less than a block from the train. Easy to get around. The apartment and building are older, but everything was clean. The hosts were very responsive and provided clear instructions for check-in/check-out.
Beautiful and stylish slot in Portage Park. Easy enough to take a bus to the blue line to get around Chicago. The hosts were responsive and the listing matched the description. Would recommend.
Great short stay for my first time in Chicago — hosts are welcoming/responsive, beds are comfortable, and above all I appreciated the cleanliness!
Luke's apartment is clean and lovely and in a beautiful neighborhood. it is walkable to the Obama Presidential Center and our family had a great stay.

Andrea’s place was a great stay. Andrea was accommodating of an early check-in, gave us a walk-through of the house herself, and made everything very smooth and easy!
The house is in a quiet neighborhood, 5 min walk to a blue line station. Hot tub is 🔥. My friends and I loved it! Would definitely stay here again.
Our stay at Regina’s place was perfect! Great location! Was able to take public transportation to get around.

Great Airbnb for a big group,  tons of rooms/beds, and a solid living room setup as well. Perfect location and super easy to get in and out. AC on both floors was great too, especially on hot days outside. Highly recommend

Very stressful trying to find an open spot on the street to park that wouldn’t get our vehicle towed. Ad says there is parking on the premises which isn’t accurate, only parking is on the street.
If flying into Chicago to O’Hare Airport the blue line subway brought you right to the street the unit is located. One of us had to fly so that was very handy. Bonus how close it was to the subway. We were able to ride for $5.00 each for the entire day.

Really loved staying here! Communicative host with a lot of details and support about parking and getting inside. The room and bed were perfectly suitable and was bigger than we thought! Appreciated the hosts support and swiftness in helping when we had a small ask around the temperature :) would stay here again!
Great location and very comfortable place. Thank you!

Estar en una zona tan vibrante y dinámica como lo es Fulton Market en el West Loop ayuda a explorar zonas magníficas de Chicago, y en lugares tan pulcros como el loft de Matthew hacen de la experiencia algo extremadamente grato
Great place to stay for the weekend. Great neighborhood. So close to everything I wanted to do. And it was cozy. Don’t even sleep that well at home

The location of this property is excellent and incredibly convenient to the downtown area; we easily walked or used Uber to get around, depending on the time of day. While the lockbox instructions for check-in and check-out could be a bit clearer, the staff was very helpful and responsive when we reached out for clarification. Our only real issue was that our first-floor room was right next to the alley, which got quite loud.
This was our 2nd stay here. Really appreciate the hospitality - we arrived later in the evening and the sofa bed was already made up for my teenager. Will come again next time in Chicago.
Great location and easy checkin and checkout. Really enjoyed our stay.
Great place. Clean, comfortable, and convenient location!

Julio’s place is located in a very convenient area- restaurants, coffee, etc. all within walking distance. His home was very comfortable, tidy, and we felt right at home. We would definitely stay again! Julio was also very communicative and provided great local recommendations.
Thank you so much Julio!

Lovely place to stay! Felt like home away from home. Michael was very friendly and considerate. Great conversations! Walkable to catch the “L” to downtown. Felt like a pretty safe neighbourhood for those who want to walk. Overall wonderful experience for our first time in Chicago! <3

Tommy couldn’t have been a better host, responsive, helpful and made our trip to wrigleyville as easy as possible. Stayed all weekend and went to a few games and Tommy made the trip so simple for us to enjoy.

We had a wonderful stay at Michelle's place. Everything was exactly as described on-line, plus she added so many extras. There was a toaster (greatly appreciated) and floor mats when you step out of bed! She had filled ice trays in the freezer and even a Bose system hooked up to Alexa from which to play relaxing music! Michelle went out of her way in every detail. Anyone staying here will appreciate her hospitality!
Jay was super responsive and his place is perfect for baseball at Wrigley

My husband and I stayed in Chicago for a weekend to see a concert and visit family, and Erin’s place was in a great location with plenty of space. The sauna was a nice touch as well! We really appreciated the responsiveness when we arrived later than planned and the temperature was adjusted immediately upon request, even though it was late at night. The only drawback was that it was tough to find street parking when we first arrived, but I’m sure if we’d come earlier in the day it wouldn’t have been an issue. I’d definitely recommend this apartment to other travelers and would stay here again!
Awesome location for our family. Close to Old Town and walking distance to the lake and Zoo.Piyush was a great host and the home was clean and comfortable. We will be back!
Fue una estancia cómoda que me permitió descansar por las noches para realizar mis actividades de día. ¡Obtuve lo que quería!

My family had a wonderful stay here! The location is such a relaxing, peaceful getaway after a long day in the city. The neighborhood is gorgeous and the home is lovely. Great amenities, relaxing private little backyard, and Robert had great local recommendations!
Very nice place. Parking spot made getting in and out without searching for parking was so nice. Personally my favorite part.
Amazing stay and super kind host. The location was perfect with lots of restaurants and stores but also peaceful and calm.

The first thing you notice when you walk into the apartment is the amazing view!! The apartment was perfectly appointed for the needs of our group and the location desirable for the sites that were on our list (the “bean”, the riverwalk and water tours, museums and sears tower..)
We had an issue when we checked in which was quickly resolved with a call to TAIMs (they were very responsive) but overall I would recommend the space and if we were to return to Chicago we would stay again!!!

I’ll start this by saying in hindsight we should have put complaints in the first day. I’m not a huge complainer, I tend to just deal with things, but some I will point out. It was pretty clear when we arrived that the Airbnb had not been cleaned, dirty rugs, sand on the dining table, hair in the tub drain. We noticed later on that the shower curtain had black mold as well. Weird things too like the microwave could only fit a very small plate. The location was good, but the check-in description was a little hard to understand until you were there. Although we had another door locking our airbnb, the front door was open multiple times when we came down. Pertaining to allergies (which luckily none of us had) there were a couple cats wandering around outside and would come in the door with us to the first floor apartment. For the amount we paid, it in no way felt worth that much. I attempted to complain about the black mold on our check-out day, but nothing came from it.

Dan's place is cute, cozy, and very clean.  The bed was quite comfortable and we appreciated having the fan at the foot of the bed.  The ceiling is a little low but that was explained in the listing and was fine for my husband who is 6'. Felt very secure with 2 separate doors with key codes. (Make sure to watch Dan's video about getting in as we tried to use the keypad on the wrong door at first, oops!) The video makes it very clear :) You do have to park on a side street but we didn't have a problem with that and it was only a short walk. The location is so close to the pink line that we never drove our car again until we left.  Great stay!

A very responsive host, and the apartment was fine. The carpeting didn’t feel very clean, although the kitchen was very clean. The bathroom clearly had mold or water issues, and the layout of the apartment was odd. Also, the apartment faces the back of the building so the garbage collection in the early mornings was very loud.

Great place for two people to spend a weekend in downtown Chicago. Had everything we needed to rest after long days outside sightseeing. Across the street from a red line station and walking distance to Millenium Park and the Riverwalk. Thank you!
This is a great stay i really loved the aesthetic and way everything is set up. Just make sure you know the rules. Cool historical pieces near by.

“Excellent apartment! It was spotless, very well organized, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect, with easy access to nearby attractions, restaurants, and transportation. The neighborhood was safe and pleasant, which made me feel completely at ease. I highly recommend this place and would happily stay here again.”

Laurie was an absolute 10/10 host. She was super responsive when we had questions and very friendly.
Her home was perfect for our group, we had plenty of space and felt right at ease.
The location is great, super close to the green line and easy to navigate. We would absolutely stay here again!
We enjoyed our stay At Christina’s.  Her place was in a great location and very clean.  Would stay there again should the need arise on my next visit to Chicago.
Great little spot, close to lots of transit options. Had all the stuff you need for a comfortable stay in Chicago.
This was a great place to stay.

Hunter was an excellent host! Was incredibly responsive and friendly and gave us so many recommendations on things to do and eat in the area. The place was so cute and a very easy Lyft or train ride into the city.

Had a lovely stay for the holiday long weekend. Slept well every night. The bedding was very nice!
The hosts were very responsive with communication which was very much appreciated.
Note that Lyft/Uber will drop you off on the back side of the building. Just walk down the alley to the next street and turn right. When we’d arrive back late at night, our drivers were nice enough to drive us down the alley. There is an emergency station right in front of the building so we honestly felt quite safe throughout our stay.
Great place!

Jennifer’s place was a great home base for our family of 5 when we traveled to Chicago to tour the University of Chicago. Jennifer was great to deal with and very responsive. Check-in was super easy with a QR code for the building and a private code for the door. The place is exactly as described in the listing. It was very clean and had thoughtful touches such as live plants and great artwork. The beds were very comfortable. As noted, there was always street parking available the entire weekend which made the visit very easy. It was within walking distance of the University of Chicago which was why we were there. We would highly recommend Jennifer’s apartment to anyone looking to go to the new Obama Center or the University of Chicago. We will certainly request to stay again if our son decides to attend!

There are three rooms on a basement level that share a bathroom. Our room was clean and comfortable, as was the bathroom.  The hosts were very friendly and accommodating.  The place is about a 20 minute drive from the Loop, and there is an L stop about a 10-15 minute walk away.  The neighborhood was nice and quiet.
Tiene muy buena ubicación, esta muy cerca del metro, por lo que fue muy facil moverme a la ciudad
Hakim was all around helpful and made my 5 trip possible. Will be back for sure
Great host and an awesome stay.
It was a great place for the weekend!

Steven was very kind and flexible with check-in. He also was very responsive whenever I reached out with a question. The space was cozy, clean and looked exactly like the photos in the listing. My favorite part about my stay was the bathroom- very clean and spacious with everything that you need. I would stay again next time we’re in the area!
Great stay in our old neighborhood! Beautiful outdoor garden seating and rooftop area for lounging.

A++++
Fabulous place. Peaceful neighborhood. Parking was easy. Close enough to everything to be convenient. And if you're into vinyls, the record collection was AWESOME.
very kind and thoughtful host, no issues at all during our stay. everything was wonderful :)
Great location only a block from Wrigley and quick access to the L. Even though it was so close the noise was not an issue. Loved the character.
Great communication.

The place was great, especially for a last minute reservation since our first one was canceled. Rich, the host, was great as well. A few things - it’s not really kid friendly, there was a piece of undergarment in the master bed, and the dishwasher leaked. Other than that, it was great. The Obama theme was cool!
Clean, roomy, very secure and beautiful neighborhood. Not too far from all the touristy hot spot. I would rebook again.

We loved the place.  It was very spacious.   The communication was top notch.  It was in a great location s had more than  everything we needed.   The popcorn and wine were a nice touch.   We would definitely stay again.
Amazing time
great place to stay for a weekend at Wrigley

The place is in a great location, great bars, restaurants. Very easily accessible to Wrigley field by one train, a 5 minute walk away.
The place itself is old, the apartment is fine. The bedrooms are clean. I found the space itself good for what we needed it for.
I will say the two front doors that are supposed to lock to the building, were completely busted and look like they have been for a long time. So the safety, isn’t really a big deal given how nice the neighbourhood is, but when you’re given clear instructions how to enter due to the security of the building- and both doors have clearly been busted for a very long time. Found that misleading, but we did report it to the host, which he responded too.
All in all was fine enough for our trip. Demetri was great with communication and accommodating.
Great host! Very cozy space.
We had a great stay.   It is in a perfect location.
Had a great time at Rafael’s. Very responsive host and house was very clean

Great spot in the north of the city. 10min walk to the 22 bus on Clark takes you right to Wriglyville and the 81 bus to the red line gets you right downtown to all the action.  Quiet and peaceful area to stay.

I absolutely loved my stay here! The apartment was very clean, comfortable and welcoming. The kitchen and bathroom were fully stocked with all that I needed. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful. The neighborhood was ideal for me... quiet and very walkable. I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Becky and her partner were so kind to us. They went out of there way to make sure we were taken care of and happy with our stay. Very grateful to have had hosts that were earnest, honest, and friendly! Their space was clean and quiet and served us well on our little Chicago adventure.

Visiting from rural MO and felt so safe in the building and area. We were able to walk to so many good restaurants. Anthony’s was also incredibly clean!  He gave clear instructions for how to enter the building. We really enjoyed our trip and stay. Thanks!
Great spot in the heart of the city. I would recommend staying in this apartment.

I had a great stay here for the weekend. It was easy to get in, the host was great and the place was clean. My only flag is that it was quite far from downtown and the ubers were expensive (especially if you are canadian lol).
Overall we had a good stay!
We have stayed here multiple times. This host is so kind and responsive. The place in kept well, in a great location and has everything you might need for a Chicago stay! We will be back!

Julie Ann was a great host and we had such a great time! She was very responsive and also let us check in early which was a huge help to the group. She provided local recommendations and her space was super clean and we all felt right at home! 10/10 would recommend booking with Julie Ann’s property in Chicago!

This place was an awesome find. We loved the location in a quieter corner of Chicago. The place was very well appointed with things you would need on vacation in the bathroom and kitchen. It was clean, well done, and very clearly communicated. There was always a spot for us to park as suggested in the listing. We walked to the north branch of the river easily, and checked out one of the recommended restaurants that was right around the corner. We would certainly seek out this rental again if we came back to Chicago!
No complaints. Nice stay considering the price.
Definitely recommend this place it's centrally located close to transportation and the host was great we enjoyed our stay and the beautiful city ❤️
Valeriy es un gran host. Siempre pendiente y predispuesto a responder dudas. Pasé 2 semanas en su airbnb y no tuve ningun problema. Todo en perfectas condiciones.
the apartment was just perfect for our family. the rooms were spacious and the location was great. I love staying in historic neighborhoods and this one did not disappoint.

This was a great place to stay! Very spacious and slept 7 people well. The place was clean, the check-in and checkout instructions were very clear. Milan was also able to respond quickly with a couple questions I had upon arrival, made for a very smooth and easy stay.
Very clean great location excellent host

We loved the place and would absolutely stay again for the convenience of walking over to Wrigley. The decor was amazing and so eclectic and it felt very homey. I don’t think this warrants a lower rating, but it is worth mentioning that the second bed was a bit uncomfortable and incredibly creaky.

Jay is the ultimate host! This was the best Airbnb experience I have had. Welcome, warm, comfortable, clean— and such a local vibe! I felt so at home. When I go back to Chicago, I hope his place is available.
Very clean and convenient to our plans

We had a great stay definitely would book again
10/10 !!

Had a bachelorette weekend with 6 of us who stayed and this was the perfect home for our stay. The location was perfect, home was very spacious & clean. Pictures don’t do it justice! Would definitely stay again!

I’ll say this. If you’re in a bind, this is a a good price in Chicago. The location is great and parking is free. Yes, there is a lot of noise from the highway and you’re living with like 5 other people in different rooms but that is fine.
What I was not satisfied with was the basic amenities in the room. The bed frame is super cheap and slides everywhere. The mattress is uncomfortable, very old, and full of stains. The pillows have zero padding like a sheet of paper. The blanket/comforter is skinny so if you turn the A/C on you’re freezing. I asked the host for more sheets or blankets and they asked me like 5 times if we had more than 2 people in the room? Ridiculous. They never gave them to me.
The host was also rude and kept telling me to cancel the booking before the trip because I simply asked if I could check out an hour later. Also, the check-in time is super late (4 pm) and super early (10 am) for no reason. You don’t need 6 hours to clean. There is nothing to clean!!!
Marco was helpful and sincere during our stay! He was able to accommodate another guest for us after reaching out the night before the stay. Thanks!
This stay was as expected, really great host and very accessible to downtown Chicago

El departamento de Rob se encuentra a pasos de la estación Berwyn de la línea roja que funciona 24hs. Eso nos hizo muy sencillo el traslado. Se encuentra en un barrio muy tranquilo, a pocas cuadras de una playa. Rob fue muy atento y respondió rápido mis necesidades. Mejoraría el funcionamiento del wifi.
Great stay all around. Host was very helpful and accommodating
The place was very clean and comfortable. Quiet, but close to a lot of stores and restaurants. Check in and check out we’re both frictionless. Would definitely stay here again!

Caspers place was perfect, we stayed for 3 1/2 weeks and it was ideal for a long term stay,  there are no washing machines however there is a laundromat a short walk away. Slightly far out from downtown Chicago but in a really nice area and the blue line is very accessible. The host was very accommodating and we had great communication with him
Great location!
Fun stay for a bachelorette!

Marco was fantastic!! He is an extremely responsive host! His place was well-stocked, and he had several special touches that made it extra nice ie bottled water, a thank you note. I would highly recommend his place and would definitely rent from him again!
The location is great with easy transit connections and walkability. The host is very responsive with clear directions and would definitely stay again!

An absolutely beautiful property in the cutest neighborhood! Tree-lined quiet streets and a really clean and relaxing Airbnb. We were extremely happy with the unit and it was a perfect place to come back to after a long day of exploring the city!
amazing Airbnb close by Logan Square! Best place I’ve stayed in in a while. Sue was so great!!

Lois and Eduardo were excellent hosts, the whole experience felt more like a stay at an Inn than just an AirBnB. They added so many little touches, like leaving us bagels and fruit for an easy morning. They were easy to get ahold of and very accommodating. We traveled with small children and the set up was excellent. The neighborhood was quiet with many walkable restaurants and coffee shops. The home itself was quiet, clean, and comfortable. We couldn’t have asked for a better stay!

Lori was very helpful and responsive.
The apartment was mostly very clean and it was brightly furnished. I found the lack of curtains in one bedroom meant I woke up very early with the sun. I could hear the neighbours but the other bedroom did not.
The kitchen was well equipped and clean.
Plenty of towels were provided for the bathroom.
We found the location to be further than expected from the city centre and from the airport ( o hare) and therefore expensive in transport. We didn’t have a car and relied on Ubers.
Chicago was a great destination and we mostly enjoyed our stay.

Spacious and modest unit that was easy to find. We stayed for the Obama Presidential Center opening weekend. So there was a lot of festivities everywhere.
The location was perfect with everything we needed and more within walking distance.
We weren’t sure how one bathroom would work for three ladies, but it was just fine.
Rooms were spacious, with plenty of storage and comfortable beds.
Kitchen was well stocked with two table options while dining.
Things to consider is it’s located on the first floor so people will be walking above you. There’s a wonderful pizza place across the street but that also meant the carry out traffic could be noisier late in the evening, if you’re sleeping in the front room. For these reasons, I couldn’t describe it as quiet, but Tere provided earplugs which was thoughtful. (I didn’t need to use them)
If I could change one thing it would be brighter lighting throughout the unit.
I definitely will look to stay here when I return to Chicago.

This place was the perfect stay for us on a weekend trip in Chicago. It’s super close to the Red line and it’s really easy to get around. We were even given parking permits so we could park our car nearby. Loong was always responsive, super friendly, and made sure our stay was a 10/10. Wouldn’t hesitate to come back and spend another weekend here.

Charles was always available to answer our questions and gave us a few suggestions on what to do in Chicago and where to eat in the neighborhood. Nearby his place there’s a few good breakfast spots, moreover the Brown line is quite close and brings you to downtown Chicago. Neighborhood felt safe.
Great place! Would stay again
Good location for walking around some of the city and being closer to tourist things. Parking situation wasn’t ideal. The inside needs updating and maintenance. Overpriced for those reasons.
Matt’s place was incredible! Great host, very communicative, clean space. Would recommend to anyone in the area
she was super helpful and friendly. The room was organized and clean. She was available all the time to answer questions.

Carl's place felt more likse staying with family and friends rather than an AirBnb, the inviorment was quiet comfortable and cozy, Carl was quite accomadating, and helpful as well as patient enven when I had locked myself out of my room a coulpe of times, the neiborhood was also peaceful and pleasant, I was most grateful for the easy access to the local transit systems, weather going to Hyde Park @ lake and 55th or Downtown the 55th garfield lines is just minutes away from redline or greenline, I would definitly use Carl's place again as well as recommend it to my family and friends.

We thoroughly enjoyed staying here. It’s a close walk to the blue line and on Sundays there is an awesome Farmer’s Market that you can walk to. The apartment was clean and comfortable. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you!
We loved our stay! Super cute, clean, comfy bed and great neighborhood.

Michael was incredibly thoughtful and reached out to check in on our second day.
The bed was so comfortable! The place was as described. The train noise was fine, we brought our white noise machine to help. The heavy curtains made a big difference at night too.

Came to Chicago for a 3 night girls trip. Jake was more than accommodating as we had an early flight in and I asked for a 4 hour early check in at the last minute and Jake made it happen. Location is perfect! You have a two minute walk to Chinatown and the subway. Jake gave us clear directions on how to check in and it was a breeze. The apartment itself was absolutely SPOTLESS!!! Jake provided us with everything we needed and some. The railways are across the street so you can hear the trains going back and forth but we got used to it after the first night. Highly recommend Jake's place and would def come back!!
we had an amazing time at Bob's! It was a very accommodating stay for our bachelorette party.

This place checked every box. The location alone is worth the stay — Right in the middle of everything. Shops, restaurants, bars, and grocery stores are all within easy walking distance, and the neighborhood energy makes it easy to just step outside and explore without needing a car or rideshare. I honestly walked more than I planned to because there was always something worth checking out nearby.
The property itself was clean, well-kept, and straightforward — exactly what you want when you’re out exploring and just need a comfortable, no-fuss space to come back to.
The host really stood out. Communication was quick, clear, and friendly from the moment I booked through checkout. Any question I had was answered promptly, and I never felt like I was being left to figure things out on my own. That kind of hospitality makes a real difference.
Highly recommend — great spot, great host, great neighborhood!

Overall a great stay, Amir was a responsive host and the check in was very easy. Neighborhood was quiet, never struggled for street parking, and kitchen had everything we needed. Lower level is very spacious and perfect for a group of 7 like ours. Grill did not come with propane which was a slight inconvenience and changed our dinner plans as we didn't want to buy a tank for a single meal. Would definitely stay again!
Bus stops muy cerca para poder moverte
Great place, lovely neighborhood, felt safe.

Brandy, was super communicative. Clear instructions and understanding. Although I was concerned with the leaking of the shower into the bedroom downstairs the carpet was extremely soaked and did get items wet after we found out.. the door to the trashcan was also missing and the washer didn’t work. Otherwise she offered cleaning for our clothes due to the issue. The location is convenient for downtown as well as included beds for a decent size group. I also would say the AC was confusing to control because it was warm there.
We had a great weekend - it’s a great location for visiting our daughter! It was very clean too!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Jasna’s place. The apartment was clean, well-decorated, and as described. Clear instructions were provided for both check-in and check-out, which made things a breeze.
The only small issue was that at night, lights from outside would flash into the bedroom (through the blinds) and a loud hum, presumably from something outside the windows, made it hard to sleep for a bit. If you’re a heavy sleeper, though, this shouldn’t be a problem.
Overall, we loved our time at Jasna’s. The location was perfect, close to both the blue line and the 65 bus, which made it easier to get downtown. Thank you for opening your home!

The best part of this Airbnb is definitely the location. It was convenient and made it easy to enjoy the area, which was the highlight of our stay.
That said, the listing photos were somewhat misleading. The property only has three true bedrooms with actual beds. Any additional "bedrooms" are really living spaces with cots set up in them, which was not clear from the listing and made the sleeping arrangements very different from what we expected.
Upon arrival, we also found stains on several of the sheets, and many of the towels had been left in the washing machine and smelled mildewy. To the host's credit, they were gracious and addressed these issues promptly. However, it did leave us questioning the overall cleanliness and upkeep of the property.
Overall, the location is the strongest selling point. Whether this is a good fit depends on what you're looking for. For us, the quality of the accommodations did not quite match the price, but others may find the location alone worth it
O apartamento corresponde ao anúncio. O lugar é bem tranquilo. Vale muito a pena se hospedar ali.

Loved the location and how easy it was to get in and access the property. Unfortunately, the stay itself fell short. Great location and convenience, but the cleanliness and upkeep need improvement.
This was a great place to stay! Everything is described accurately and our expectations were even exceeded. Cute, fun place to stay with friends or family!

Gustavo went above and beyond to accommodate our group, and the space was clean, well stocked and the perfect size for a group of 9. He was also very prompt to message and provided clear and detailed instructions on the accommodations.

Great stay! 10/10 experience. Neighbors were friendly & I didn't have an issue with the neighborhood, a lot of nice restaurants, & stores close. Quiet place, private bathroom, nice kitchen space & room was nice. I recommend to anyone looking to stay. Parking was super easy aswell. Came in and out of the house at all hours of the night & didn't have any issues with safety. Very clean space as well.
Excellent! Will definitely use her when I come back to Chicago
Everything was how described but the place at night was warmer than expected. They have fans and you can open the windows but it took me out guard because I was expecting full AC.
Very lovely place. The apartment is historic and you can tell the owner takes very good care of it. It was very clean on arrival. Owners were also responsive and we felt safe staying there.

The apartment was smaller than anticipated, which was a bit disappointing. The pull-out couch was broken and no linens were provided for it, making it a challenge to use during our stay.
The bedding overall could use some attention. The towels were thin, worn, and did not smell fresh. Upgrading the bedding and towels would greatly improve the comfort of the apartment and the overall guest experience.
Great place! Easy to get around with public transportation and walking. Steven was great to communicate with. We would stay again.

Russ’s place was truly so clean and stylish and cozy, in a great neighborhood, and he specifically put out helpful items for traveling with a baby which we found to be so thoughtful and sweet. Thank you again to Russ for being an excellent host, we really loved our stay.
We enjoyed our stay.  We pretty much had everything we needed.

We had a lovely stay in this beautiful and spacious apartment. The apartment was spotless and very comfortable and attractive. The neighborhood was terrific - quiet, safe and very walkable.  Parking was also easy and did not require a permit. We would definitely stay here again if the opportunity presents itself and recommend it without any hesitation.
Great host! Great place where everything was thought through!!! Thank you Carrie!!!!’

I had an excellent stay at this Airbnb in Bronzeville! The property was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making it feel like a home away from home.
