The Bronzeville community itself offers a great selection of restaurants, entertainment, and cultural attractions, all within a short distance.
I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago and would definitely stay here again.
Great spot for a weekend in Chicago!
Great spot for 4 people!
Great place to sleep and easy bus access to get around
Excellent spot. Peter was a great host and everything was extremely well prepared. Great location!

It was such a pleasant studio for my stay while enjoying Chicago in June. Bella was incredibly helpful and went above and beyond to make my vacation memorable. The studio is located in a lovely neighborhood with easy access to public transportation, while being just far enough from the busy Chicago “L” to offer a peaceful stay. I would definitely consider staying here again on my next visit.
There are quite a few stairs to climb, but I was aware of that before booking and had no issues with it.
Larissa was an excellent host.  Very responsive to all of our questions.
Great stay that is located near many attractions and easily walkable. We would definitely stay here again!

We had a fantastic stay for a long weekend. The house was exactly as described, clean, and the outdoor patio was wonderful. Our host was very flexible and responsive - we were running low on towels one day and he sent someone with extras very quickly.  It was also a very quick walk to the lake which we loved and took advantage of. Would definitely stay here again with a large group.
Not fancy and quite old, but clean and a convenient location for the university
The apartment was everything we needed it to be.  It is a good location and easy to get to the places we went.  Alain provided clear instructions and was responsive to our questions

This place was great! My husband and I took our 5 year old on a trip to Chicago, and this was the perfect place to stay. A ton of awesome places and parks in the neighborhood, plus easy access to the red and brown lines to get to the museum campus and loop for more touristy attractions. Anne was very helpful and responsive, and the place was pretty much exactly as described. One thing to note is that the outdoor space shown in the pictures is a shared space at the back of the building. My husband and I had hoped to hang out there after our son was asleep, but it was a little far for that. Other than that, we absolutely adored this place and would rent again.

AI chatbot host.
fine apartment.
Great location, spot was spacious and clean.
Unit was nice, new and clean. Location was perfect. Travis was terrific to work with.
Amazing house in a great neighborhood. Michelle communicated perfectly and made check in and out, and getting whatever information we needed, extremely easy. Highly recommend staying here!

This home was extremely clean with a perfect view of the skyline from the balcony! There are plenty of amenities near this home within walking distance and plenty more that are a quick drive (3-4 min). This area feels really safe and uber/lyft comes very quickly.
Nice place to stay if you want to stay somewhere outside of Downtown Chicago while having good access to it via bus

La casa es muy agradable, y Catherine es una gran host. Nos encantó la tranquilidad del Ukrainian Village, y fue una sorpresa estar tan cerca de varios puntos estratégicos de la ciudad con una activa vida cultural (como es Wicker Park). Ideal para las personas que no quieren dormir bajo el ritmo del Downtown, pero aún así estar a una distancia prudente del centro
Absolutely terrific place to stay.nWould 100% stay here again when vacationing in Chicago.

We had a great stay in Chicago! We were traveling with two babies, and Eugene’s place was perfect! There was tons of room, the walls were thick and there was no shortage of stores nearby to get all the things we forgot to bring. We went on several walks to the 606 elevated trail, a stroll through the DePaul campus and found the cutest coffee shop- the Cuptown. All in all it was such a great trip and Eugene’s Place was the perfect place for our family vacation.

I would do business with Imran again
I am very pleased with my experience
Worth the stay !

John’s place was great for my quick trip to Chicago. It is located in a great neighborhood, very walkable with lots of restaurants, shops and parks nearby. It is also very convenient to the south Chicago places I was visiting. John was a very responsive host & provided very detailed communication to make sure everything went smoothly. Would definitely stay here again!
The home felt very welcoming and cozy (they gave us flowers and wine, which we loved🤎) The beds were comfortable! The hosts were very responsive when there were questions, and It’s was a great stay!
Responsive. nice home. my only complaint which is not their fault were the neighbors kids that ran and stomped and jumped all night and all morning. but other than that we would stay again.
Loved the location and ammenites but definitely needs to be cleaned better in between guests.
Great location! Very clean and up to date! Would stay again!

Jose was very quick to reply and answer our questions. The space was clean and had everything we needed for our weekend. We thought I was very thoughtful that Jose had snacks and coffee available for us to use.
Fantastic hosts, exceptionally responsive and flexible. The space was great for all of us to comfortably crash for an event in town, and the 10 cup drip coffee machine was excellent for our purposes.
I absolutely loved my stay here. The location was perfect- walking distance to restaurants, bars, coffee shops, etc.
This is our second time staying in this place. Great location and can’t beat the Starbucks right next-door. Highly recommend!

Staying here was very nice. Micheal was very accommodating and willing to meet any needs we had. Parking was nice and easy, and the neighborhood reasonably quiet for it's density.
Beds and bedding were comfortable and the kitchen has anything you could need.
Central location right in between everywhere you want to go. Walkable to the definition. Felt safe for my young family
Nice place love the walkable neighborhood

Assel answered all questions prior and gave details or info on top of the answers. Asked for a possible early check in only if cleaning was done to drop baggage off, nothing crazy just an hour or so before normal check in time. It worked out and was able to get in hour before normal check in without additional cost, very appreciative.

We had a wonderful stay! Our group of 9 fit comfortably in the space, and it was perfect for our Chicago trip. The gated property made us feel very safe, and the neighborhood was family-friendly, and welcoming.
The location was also a huge plus—most of the downtown attractions were only about 15–20 minutes away, and there were so many great food options nearby. We also never waited longer than 10 mins for ride shares. We’d definitely recommend this stay to other groups or family visiting Chicago!
Heather and Kevin communicated very well during our entire stay. They were wonderful hosts.
We had a great stay at Emily's place in Wicker park! Very homey and clean. No complaints whatsoever. Thank you!

We chose Sam’s house primarily through the location, which was close to a venue where my son’s wedding reception was being held, and the location and house itself exceeded all expectations… Walkable, charming neighborhoods, restaurants close by very comfortable house

This stay provides convenient, walkable access to the Wicker Park neighborhood with plenty of shops, restaurants, and bars. It’s a lively area with close access to the CTA train, making it so easy to get to/from ORD and explore Chicago. The space is small but stocked with necessities. It is located on the fourth floor, but that is clearly disclosed and you’ll get used to the stairs during the stay.
When I had an issue with the shower draining slowly, Bella was able to get it fixed extremely quickly. I appreciate it!
This was a great space. Very conveniently located, clean, and Bryce was a responsive and caring host. Would stay here again next time we’re in Chicago!

My family loved their stay at Brett's place. They felt comfortable and safe. They did not encounter any issues and especially loved the extra toiletries for the few things they forgot to pack. Beds were comfortable and rooms were private.

We had an amazing weekend in Chicago for Hannah Bachelorette trip! Brian and his wife are amazing hosts! They were very accommodating of our needs and their home is to die for! It’s a perfect home to stay in if you want to visit the city, but not stay downtown.

We had an overall great stay at Kim’s place. The area was walkable and there were delicious restaurants nearby. The neighborhood felt safe. The check-in instructions were clear and Kim was a very responsive and helpful host. The unit was clean. Some things to note:
-Street parking was easy on the weekend, but appeared to be more restricted during the week, so keep that in mind if you plan to have a car Monday- Friday
-The hallway of the building has a strong unpleasant smoke smell, though once inside the unit we couldn’t smell it so it didn’t bother us
-Though the unit is technically on the first floor, there is a set of stairs you have to walk up to access the unit, so it may not work for those with limited mobility
-There was street noise/ light at night, which could be challenging for light sleepers. Kim left earplugs in the bedrooms and I brought a sleep mask which did help a lot
Overall, this was a comfortable stay in a good location and was a good value for the price!
Great place to stay
Great place for a girls weekend in Chicago. Walkable to many things

Nala and Owen’s place was just as described and a very nice place to stay. The only reason it’s getting 4/5 stars instead of 5/5 is that on the first night we were there, the air conditioning in our room went out. I understand this can happen to anyone in any building, so I don’t hold that against the hosts, but it still did make our first night not as enjoyable. They were very responsive and sent an HVAC person out the very next morning to fix the AC. In our second night, the AC was working great. That first night it was a little hard to sleep after traveling that long, which was a downside. Again, everything else was great in this air b&b.
Great place to stay & the host is exceptionally easy to work with. Highly recommended.

Great place had everything we needed. Blankets were very soft. Was a bit far out but nothing an uber can’t fix. Water pressure was questionable but temp was good. Hosts were responsive. Very close to the train but we didn’t take it.

Clean apartment within a much larger building clearly setup as a Airbnb network.
Most guests respected the quiet hours, front desk was helpful.
I enjoyed the coffee machine in the lobby and people watching the absolute chaos below from my 7th story window.
Nice place to stay, Milan was a great responsive host
Beautiful space, very comfortable and clean and just as described. The  building is very secure and the neighborhood is great. Gated parking space was a huge plus. Easy walk to blue line.

I thought this Airbnb was perfect for a little getaway with my friend! The place was very clean, conveniently located near plenty of restaurants, and incredibly easy to find thanks to the distinctive color of the door. Everything was just as expected, and we had a great stay. I would absolutely book here again the next time I'm in the area!

My family and I had an absolutely wonderful stay at Robert's Airbnb. The space was clean, comfortable, spacious, and very accommodating for our group's needs. The location was excellent, with plenty of restaurants, stores, and local attractions just a short distance away, making it easy to enjoy everything the area had to offer.
Robert was an exceptional host who was responsive, attentive, and made sure all of our needs were met throughout our stay. His hospitality truly helped make our trip stress-free and enjoyable.
We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would not hesitate to book with Robert again on our next visit. I highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable stay in a convenient location!

Fed’s place is nothing short of perfect! It was a great space to land while in between places. The room was clean, comfortable, and spacious. Very friendly vibe in the house, while also being very quiet. Also a great location, near some great bars/restaurants, and Humboldt Park. I’d totally be back in the future!

Lobby of the property was filthy with over flowing trash from the time we check in on Friday until late Saturday afternoon.
The hallways up to the suite was filthy and flooring needs replaced.
Everything about the place was great! The host very helpful. I Recommend this place.
Cozy and comfortable!! Jody provided many amenities and had clear instructions on checking in and out of their home. Thank you. 😊
Loved this property and the park across the street is amazing morning and night to walk in nature and see the city skyline.
Was great!
Great stay and communicative hosts!

We really liked our stay here, and quicky felt at home. We love cooking when staying at Airbnb's and felt this kitchen was well stocked with utensils, baking sheets and pots and pans.. even the blender came in handy!    We also loved how close home was to the Lake and convenient to the Red Line and bus stop.  We normally don't have a car when we come to Chicago, but we had one this trip, so I was a bit nervous about parking. We luckily had no problem finding a spot quickly, and kept it parked the duration of our stay.   I was also appreciative at how quickly Demetri  responded to any questions I had.
Wonderful space

Great location if Boystown is why you’re here — you’re walkable to basically everything. Main thing to call out / clarify is the train: it’s not “nearby,” it’s directly outside the building, loud enough to rattle the whole unit. Our group struggled to get quality sleep once the trains started running in the early morning hours.
Great overall stay in a fun location. Andrew and Lauren were extremely responsive and offered suggestions to enhance our weekend. Highly recommend!

Christopher and Preeti are incredible hosts. The Superhost tag has never felt more appropriate. Their communication is prompt and reliable and clear. The space is gorgeous and exactly as described/depicted. It’s spacious and feels like an entire apartment—your home away from home—much more so than any cramped hotel room ever could. They’ve thought of everything to make guests comfortable. The neighborhood is quiet and quaint. Truly one of the best, if not the best, AirBnB experience we’ve ever had. If you’re on the fence, don’t be—you’ll love your stay!
Great location and host! Comfortable, well stocked and clean. Recommended!
Great place to stay! Beautiful view of the city! We enjoyed our time here!
Clean place, had everything we needed!

Really loved this spot!
The location was super ideal—located in the charming neighborhood of Roscoe’s village. Really close to lots of food and the place just felt like we got the real local Chicago experience! Would stay again!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was beautiful, comfortable, and had everything we needed—and more. We especially enjoyed spending time relaxing in the backyard, which was a perfect place to unwind. The house was well-equipped with thoughtful amenities that made our stay even more enjoyable. The host was friendly, responsive, and quick to answer any questions we had. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this property to others!
Great location & friendly staff. Clean and spacious rooms! Will definitely book again when in Chicago !
Charie was a responsive host. Easy instructions and the place worked out great for my and my family for our stay in Chicago.

Our stay at Juan’s place was great. Juan was very responsive and friendly, met us with the keys for the apartment, gave local recommendations. Overall, wonderful experience. The apartment was in a cute, old building with a great rooftop porch, it was very safe and a nice little spot away from the craziness of the city while still being close to fun restaraunts and bars. Would love to stay again. Thank you!
Had a great stay at Justin’s place. Would definitely book in the future and would recommend to anyone looking for a great base in Chicago

This was a wonderful place for my quick weekend stay. The bus and train are nearby which makes the place nice and walkable, but if you have a car, you may have to park down the block some. The place is also up three flights of stairs which was definitely communicated to us and not an issue, but something to be aware of. Host was wonderful and friendly. Place was clean and comfortable for a weekend stay.

Staying at Sharon’s place was great! It was super easy to check in and the place looked exactly as described. It was really clean and more spacious than I thought it would be. The only surprise was the strong pet odor inside. I was not expecting this but I did see that pets are allowed so it made sense after seeing that. We still had an amazing stay!
For anyone looking to frequent downtown Chicago, just be aware that this location is a good distance away. On average it took us about 35mins in an uber to reach locations downtown.
Location, location, location! Great spot just a couple blocks from the Blue Line.
Great little place to stay for a few nights near the city. Easy to get to transit lines.
Excellent home in a great, quiet neighborhood. Walking distance from the train station and Ubers pick up right outside. Lots of beds and two separate kitchens
Great location for the best of the north side.  Place comes as advertised.  Easy access to restaurants, night life, CTA, and Wrigleyville

Airbnb is in a great location! Roscoe village is so peaceful and there were great restaurants just a couple minutes walk from the Airbnb. It was conveniently close to the the Paulina cta station! Alex was super response and friendly.
Great spot for our group!

stay went well, unit is very small, perfect for a single person or couple but I would not try to get a 3rd person in there.  location was perfect, close to public transit and not far from plenty of restaurants and activities.  would definitely stay there again
Had an amazing time! The place was perfect for our group.

Brendan was a great host. I felt secure knowing that it was his bar under our place and his place above ours. He was friendly and very responsive. His bar downstairs has excellent food. Coming in from KC for a Morgan Wallen concert he made my friends and I feel right at home, even tossed on some Morgan Wallen at the bar to set the tone for our concert day 🫶🏼.

Amazing stay! The host was great, responded incredibly fast, and was super flexible with our check in time. The place itself was spacious, spotless, and stocked with tons of snacks and towels. It’s in a very safe neighborhood with a beautiful park and a Target close by, plus plenty of other places within walking distance. Not too far from downtown Chicago as well. I would book this place again. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful stay with 6 couples in Chicago. The location was great, condo was beautiful and the host was very responsive to any questions or issues we had. The porch was absolutely amazing to have and we enjoyed keeping the doors open with 70 degree weather.
Amazing location! so close to the water and a small peaceful beach. Getting places was so easy with how close to transit you are. Great neighborhood, it was super quiet when we were there.

Our family loved staying here. The place was impeccably clean, comfortable and cozy. Jacki’s decorating style is lovely, the place was stocked with everything needed. You can’t beat two full baths as well! All places are walkable, we it shopping, eating or catching the bus/train. We visit this area often and plan to put this top of our list continued stays. Thank you, Jacki!
Worked well for us, close to Soldier Field where we went for a concert.
This place was even better than the photos captured! Great neighborhood if you want to stay away from downtown. I would definitely stay here again.
Host was quick to respond and accommodate. Place match description and was very clean.
Great location.  Plenty of space for our family

Airbnb is located in a Good location. I’d recommend looking at the details of the map when getting there, as the parking lot is well hidden on a one-way back street. The lockbox with the keys are located in the front of the building by La Cantina, so either get your travel buddy to get it and open the back door for ya or you’d have to run all the way around to do it yourself! Other than this tiny inconvenience, the rest of the experience was amazing!!
Our stay was wonderful! Overall 10/10 on location, comfortability, cleanliness and ease with the hosts!

Wilma is one of the best hosts I’ve ever had. She was always super responsive and checking in around check in and check out times. Her place was extremely clean and had everything we needed. It was easy to get to public transportation and also park our car in the back. The coffee shop, markets, and restaurants nearby were all excellent.

Do not recommend. Our stay was disappointing from check-in to check-out due to poor management, inadequate amenities, maintenance issues, and lack of communication.
Check-in was scheduled for 3:00 PM, but upon arrival the cleaners were still working and told us it would take another 2.5 hours. We finally accessed the apartment at 4:30 PM, and cleaning was still ongoing. The delay disrupted our plans and made us late for an evening event.
The supplies provided were unacceptable for a 3-bedroom apartment with four guests: only one hand towel and two washcloths, no tissues, and low-quality single-ply toilet paper.
The shower drain was badly clogged, causing water to pool during use.
Communication with the host was poor throughout the stay. Responses were infrequent, and when received, our concerns were ignored rather than addressed.
For the price paid, we expected a clean, ready property and responsive hosting. We received neither and would recommend booking elsewhere.

This place is a great stay! Really central location to almost everything and ravenswood and a very easy pickup for Ubers to head downtown or to Wrigleyville. Only thing I would consider is it is in the basement of the home so you are able to hearing the walking above you really loudly. Other than that the stay was great!
perfect for visiting Wrigleyville

My travel companion and I stayed in the apartment for two nights. We had a good time in Chicago. The apartment is pretty close to the bus to enter the city. The check-in was very flexible, even though we arrived quite late at night.

I liked the location of the place and host was very responsive. I particularly liked the set up of the entry that it was tailored to my booking. However, I feel that I over paid for a 3 bedroom place and wasn’t able to use all 3 rooms. The twin size bed is poor quality and we were not able to utilize it - resulting in us sharing a bed which is why we booked a 3 bedroom place. The bedroom with the metal bed frame made noises every time you moved. Loved the place but would like to see some updated furniture to make the experience more comfortable.

If you want an immaculate, wallet-friendly stay in Chicago, this is it!
The Highlights:
Spotless & Secure: The space was pristine, exactly as described, and felt super secure.
Pure Comfort: The AC worked flawlessly, it was mostly quiet, and we slept peacefully every night.
Zero Stress: Street parking was incredibly easy, and the host was an excellent communicator.
The Location:
The immediate neighborhood is quiet—it looks like most nearby stores and restaurants recently closed. However, you are literally two blocks from the train, making zipping into The Loop.
For the fantastic price, safety, and cleanliness, the lack of walkable dining wasn't a dealbreaker at all. I would absolutely stay here again!

Rafael’s place was well put together. Except for items such as an extra roll of paper towels, available water pitcher, or an extra dish sponge, the interior amenities were good.
One bummer I wanted to point out was the abrupt closure of the roof deck. While Rafael was accommodating in our disappointment of this occurring, a highlight of this unit is the roof deck and its’ views of the skyline.
Also, please beware of the steps. For myself, having knee issues, I am thrown that having such a steep stairwell entry to the living quarters was not called out. Having previously lived in this specific area for 10 years, having an entry like this is not uncommon. However, a heads up in the description would have been nice.
Overall, I give this unit a strong 3 out of 5 for the many AirBnB’s we’ve stayed in. And, to be clear, a strong 4 wouldn’t have been out of the question if a few of the amenities this unit was absent of were there.
Thanks Rafael!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had an amazing stay in Chicago! The host was incredibly responsive, friendly, and made the entire process seamless from check-in to check-out. The property was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, well-maintained, and stocked with everything we needed for our stay.
The location was excellent, with easy access to restaurants, attractions, and transportation. We especially appreciated the attention to detail and the thoughtful touches that made us feel right at home.
I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you for being such a great host and helping make our trip memorable!
We enjoyed our stay at the Inn. Accommodations were as described and were comfortable. The train noise did not bother us at all. Being right across the street from Wrigley was a great experience.

Great little apartment with comfortable beds! Cute restaurants within walking distance. Laura was super helpful when my son left his airpods behind and made sure we got them back!
The in unit washer/dryer was a bonus!
A great house for bigger groups to stay, Mike and Vince are very responsive and made the process go smoothly

This place was very nice, it was cleaned and definitely had enough room. The couple of neighbors we met were also very nice! The area is a little rough but honestly no problems. no issues parking on the street. The only thing was that the essentials needed restocked( shampoo, body soap and kitchen dish soap and dishwasher detergent) but other than that everything was great.

Great place to stay! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed. It was an easy walk to Wrigley Field and plenty of other places we wanted to visit. The neighborhood was lovely, parking was easy, and our host was excellent and made everything seamless. We’d definitely stay here again!

I felt as though my best friends asked me to stay in their house when they were away.
Everything was better than expected and the host was incredibly responsive.
It's a perfect place for two or three couples and/or older children.
There was plenty of space, very well stocked gourmet kitchen in a great part of town.
Do not hesitate to book this Airbnb.
David & Diane

Pros: We liked the place overall. The location worked well for our group of six and it was great to have 2.5 baths and a big shared kitchen/living space, including outdoor space. The kitchen was well-stocked and the unit seemed clean. Kevin was responsive to questions and concerns, including bringing over an extra luggage rack and television remote.
Cons: Some in our party found the mattresses in the primary bedroom and on the bottom bunk uncomfortably soft, and we had to switch up our sleeping plan because the upper bunk bed was a bit wobbly and didn't have a railing. It was missing some small conveniences, like reading lamps by the beds. Although this is partly just the reality of being in the city, it was also noisy past 11 PM all three nights. I believe most of the noise was from another Airbnb group downstairs and the host did ask them to quiet down when we let him know.
The space was beautiful, and its location can’t be beat. Hatice was a wonderful host.

We visit Chicago annually and decided to stay outside of the normal downtown.  So glad we did.  Rachel's ducked off oasis was pleasing and comfortable. It's definitely city living and can get a bit noisy but Rachel was so understanding of this.  My favorite aspects were the garden tub, moveable tv, and the Sunday morning church bells.
Great place to stay, Confidently located, and Tone was responsive and giving recommendations
Great stay, amazing location and Julian was incredibly helpful with local tips and recommendations.
Location was amazing!   Easy access and so close to Wrigley.  Communication was great from the start.  Helpful with parking too :)
Clean, pretty quiet at night, close to the train station.

The apartment was great for a weekend stay. Super spacious and clean, and the location was lovely with lots of great restaurants/shops in a 10 minute radius. There was no central AC (which we expected), but fans and the wall unit cooled down the unit effectively. Check-in was easy, only note is that there is only one set of keys so if your group wants to split up you will need to plan accordingly.
Nice neighborhood with a lot of restaurants nearby. Both red and brown line trains were within walking distance.

I absolutely loved this place! It exceeded my expectations. It was clean, smelled amazing, had everything needed if I forgot to pack something, and spacious. Nate was extremely accommodating and sweet. He communicated from start to finish. I would 100% come back when I visit Chicago.
Great location easy check in and out and plenty of space.
Geo made check in easy and the place was so great. Thank you so much!
Good location for our visit.  Plenty of room for our group.   Easy parking.  Jennifer was so easy to work with and great at communicating!
Our stay was amazing. Perfect location for the concert at soldier field. Gorgeous building and great apartment.

The place is doable for the price but it doesn’t feel homey. If you just want a place to shower and lay your head this is a good fit. The beds aren’t soft or anything because there’s no mattress pads just the mattress itself and the place can use some more practical touches.
Had a great time staying here! Easy to park and check in, clean, and close to the train station.

The place looks exactly like the photos & it’s pretty neat & tidy. I definitely recommend getting the room with the private bathroom. The place is very secure with code locks on every door. The only downside is there is no central AC, just a large box fan & ceiling fan in the room. It did get hot at night. If you don’t care about that then it’s worth a try. I would stay here again in the fall/winter. Also it’s a shared space and the other guests were very kind, you’ll rarely see them.
Beautiful residence, very clean.
We enjoyed our time.  Vanessa was highly responsive.   The home is beautiful has lots of space .

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago. The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and very well equipped. The location was excellent, with easy access to restaurants, shops, and public transportation. Communication with the host was smooth and prompt, making the entire experience stress-free. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. We would happily stay here again!
Really a gem of a place.
we loved our little Hollywood nights trip.   the place was better than described

This was a great little spot to stay with a friend for a wedding! Cute and quiet neighborhood with easy access to the train to get downtown. If you're not wanting to pay downtown prices but still have easy access I highly recommend. It wasn't far from some cute neighborhood places too to do a little shopping and eat out. Would definitely stay again!

I had a great stay! The location was in a nice, quiet area and getting around to nearby attractions, restaurants, and other places was very convenient. The host was extremely friendly, responsive, and always quick to answer any questions I had before and during my stay. The property was comfortable, well-kept, and exactly as described. Overall, it was a very positive experience, and I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Awesome place. The room was very comfortable and the neighborhood is very peaceful. There are good restaurants and bars in walking distance and public transport stations get you to downtown easily. I was warmly welcomed and felt right at home.
Location was easy to access downtown with an uber. Neighborhood was quiet at night and the place is a good choice for a short stay. Overall happy with my stay.

We had a wonderful stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb! The host made everything incredibly easy and smooth from start to finish. Communication was excellent throughout our stay, they were very responsive, attentive, and always available to answer any questions we had. Their attention to detail and hospitality truly made us feel welcome and ensured we had a stress-free experience. We would happily stay here again in the future!
Basic but very clean and nice host

Located in a beautifully safe neighborhood, the unit boasted a variety of useful amenities for our stay. We were surprised to find that the bed was located in the same, singular room as the pull-out sofa, however. We missed all indications of this setup from the listing’s photos, but we easily made it work. Future guests may want to take this into account when considering sleeping arrangements for personal privacy.
Ultimately, our stay was very easy. Marc and his co-host were proactive in making sure we had all the necessary information for check-in, WiFi, parking, etc. The king-sized bed was incredibly comfortable and I was told that the pull-out sofa was just fine. I would 100% recommend this listing to others.
Enjoyed our stay! Lovely home
Loved the place, clean bathrooms. Kitchen so you’re able to cook and warm up food. Very spacious!
Liliana was a great host...super responsive and was flexible on check-in/check-out. We loved your home and definitely recommend to others.
Recommend this spot to anyone trying to visit the main street!
Good value and location
Great stay! Very cozy and easy to get around

Amazing, spacious apartment in a great location. 3 beautiful outdoor spaces to relax. The decor and furnishings felt modern, and made for a very comfortable and inviting space.
Nicole and Matt were extremely responsive to various requests we had, helping us out with an extra parking spot, and overall making sure our stay was going well.
This is our fourth stay with Charles and we enjoy the location and his well kept unit.
It was a beautiful place the place just as the pictures 🥰 which was a plus and close to everything literally not far from anything , CHICAGO IS A NICE GREAT HOME FOR TRAVELING..
Beautiful place!!! Very clean and comfy. One of the top places we have stayed in Wicker Park. We would definitely stay here again.

This is a very located spot. Great to book if you don’t plan to spend much time in the unit - it’s a tight fit for more than 2 people but totally workable.
There’s a church nearby that I was worried would be loud and was not an issue.

Large chunk of wood missing from the floor in the kitchen. There was one wine glass and two pans. In a listing that fits up to 10 people (we had nine). The roof was missing half its cushions, so it couldn’t fit our group.
The blinds were essentially pieces of paper covering the windows - which made it extremely difficult to sleep. There is a club directly across the street, and the noise was so loud we had to sleep with a speaker playing white noise.
The bunk bed was so rickety it felt unsafe to use.
Each person had one very thin towel and one pillow. It was honestly comical.
Great apartment in an amazing location! We had so much fun exploring the neighborhood. Easy to get on the CTA as well. Would definitely stay here again if we’re back in Chicago!

What an absolute gem! It was exactly what we needed. Opted for a shared space as we weren’t going to spend much time in the Airbnb. Paul was friendly and respectful of our space as two females but provided such a clean and aesthetically pleasing place. Even came with the CUTEST dog Abby who was a sweetheart. Even willing to ship a very special watch that I left.
Horrible smell and shared the floor with guests. Woman kept on coming up on the floor we were staying at without invitation. Didn’t even stay the night

This was a great location for me and a friend meeting for a Cubs weekend! Within walking distance are so many great streets and Wrigleyville. It is also near a Target, Whole Foods, and anything else you will need. There are people living or staying above this unit, but it was not problematic…the hosts were very helpful and accommodating. Great place!
Looked just like the pictures! Super spacious apartment. The location was great! Located in a quiet street but lots of restaurants and bars in walking distance.
Was good for what I needed and that's a place to sleep in the Pilsen neighborhood.

My fiancé, brother, and I stayed at this location for a weekend trip to Chicago. The location was great for getting to places like Galloping Ghost Arcade and downtown Chicago. Although the listing warns of the “bad” location, I felt extremely safe in the area and even walked to get breakfast at nearby cafes. The room looked as described in the listing. The A/C worked just fine and kept the room comfortable throughout the night. The entry/stairway could use some cleaning, as it smelled like urine about halfway up the stairs. The bedroom and bathroom itself was clean, no bugs or visible dirt on any surfaces. My main complaint would be that the pillows (not just the pillow case) smelled like they needed to be washed and the bed sheets would constantly slip off during the night, causing me to sleep on a bare mattress until I woke up and noticed. Deeper sheets or clip on sheet holders would be useful. Other than that, it was a great, quiet, affordable stay for the weekend!
Was a great place to stay!

Thank you, Bianca for a great stay in Chicago! This space was perfect for our group of 8. It was only a short walk to the 9 bus which gave us easy access to great restaurants, and CTA to and from O’Hare. The place was clean and had everything we needed for an enjoyable weekend. Would stay again!
Aside from the place, what set this aside was Bianca’s responsiveness to our questions. Much appreciated!!
We had an excellent time, Mike was very responsive and friendly, and it was the perfect spot for a weekend with friends
Very responsive host. Lovely updated home in a fun part of Chicago!
Airbnb was in a great location. Very specious apartment and the bathrooms were very nice! Would recommend and was a good price especially for the weekend we were there
Amazing host
Great location , great house , great host
it was a good three day stay i was shocked when i realized we’d be staying with multiple guest but not a problem n it was hot but not unbearably hot there was also a fan in the room which def help

Nothing but good things! I would 100% recommend! Perfect location, beautiful views, surrounded by everything you need! Natasha was amazing and very responsive. She helped accommodate my needs! Will definitely come back!
Very nice place

What a fabulous stay!  The hosts go above and beyond with little extras that truly made our stay enchanting.   A great location within walking distance to so much. We’re thrilled to have found such a gem for future travel to the area!
Great stay! Lovely house, comfortable, and peaceful neighborhood. There’s tons of room and a Metra station a couple minute walk away to take the train into downtown Chicago.

Nice place to stay , very clean, nice view, pleasant staff. The parking be prepared to pay 68 dollars a day to park in the hotel garage. Also, I think I paid $78 for the free amenities that I didn’t use but it was nice to tour the premises . They have pools, nice grills, gym, study hall, pool table, lounge area and sauna. I would book this place again. They just need to be mindful about parking. I say that because the place is already expensive so the least they can do is lower the price or give free parking.

Olga is a fantastic host and the room was clean and conveniently located. We appreciated the private bathroom and the shared kitchen was comfortable and always available when we needed it. One thing to note is that the room is up two flights of relatively narrow stairs, which we knew about ahead of time, but definitely makes this inaccessible for folks that can’t do stairs. We found the pillows to be uncomfortably flat, but I’m sure Olga would have been accommodating if we had mentioned that during our stay. The street noise wasn’t too bad either and we loved how close the apartment was to the train station and fantastic restaurants. The neighborhood felt safe and the off-street parking was convenient!! I would recommend this stay to anyone visiting Chicago.

Great location, nice amenities, and super spacious for our group of 15. The house was pretty walkable to bars, restaurants, and groceries. The only downside was that one of the futon legs was broken, and the deposit is paid outside of AirBnB. Otherwise I’d recommend this place for any large group!
Great location for taking a nice stroll to Wrigley Field.  Wonderful and super safe neighborhood and two blocks from coffee shop and some decent places to get a bite.
Great place! Would stay here again!
What a vibe! So well curated and thoughtful, we really enjoyed our stay in this great neighborhood. Will absolutely return next time we're in Chicago.

I was only there for a brief wedding weekend. Olga made the check in/check out process very easy and was always available for questions/concerns. Everything on the listing was accurate and I had a great time staying here for the price compared to what a hotel would've cost. I would easily book here again when I come back to Chicago.
Place was incredibly clean, host was friendly and welcoming.

Kim’s apartment was a lovely stay for me and my girls. We really enjoyed our time there and felt comfortable throughout. The space was clean, orderly, and well kept, which made everything feel easy and welcoming.
We did run into an issue with the door, but it was addressed and resolved ASAP, which we truly appreciated. Overall, great host and a great stay! I would definitely book again.
We had all of what we needed and were a short drive from all of things we wanted to do!

We had a great stay. The room and bathroom were extremely clean and private. The neighborhood is walkable and quiet and there are also some great options for coffee and breakfast nearby. Our hosts were nice and responsive, and gave us some good tips about the neighborhood. Highly recommended.

I had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this Airbnb! The host was incredibly kind, responsive, and accommodating throughout my visit. As a female traveler, I felt very comfortable and safe during my entire stay, which was extremely important to me.
The location was fantastic, just a short walk from the shore, making it easy to enjoy the beautiful views and surrounding area. There was also a convenient store right on the corner, which made grabbing necessities quick and easy.
Overall, this was a great experience, and I would definitely stay here again. Thank you for your hospitality!
Great location with an easy check-in. Close to the blue line so transportation to and from ORD is very easy. Would recommend !
Roxane was a wonderful host and very responsive. The suite was exactly as described and I enjoyed my stay here!

The stay was great! They provided small travel sized toiletries and housing essentials to help us get accommodated during our stay (multiple towels, snacks, waters, chips, snacks,etc.) . The place was very clean and well presented. The host gave very clear instructions and the response time was great - I was never left waiting!
I would absolutely recommend anyone book this place!

We hit the jackpot with Demitri's condo! We are former Chicagoans and LOVE the neighborhood, which is a great mix of residential and urban. It's a short walk down Francisco to the brown line, which will take you downtown or to many of the fun Northside neighborhoods. Right next to the stop is the best pie shop in town, First Slice, and a cute park if you have little ones. If you walk west on Montrose you can get pizza or small plates at Angelo's and along Kedzie there are great options for Middle Eastern food.
With regard to the space itself, Demitri's condo is stylish and comfortable with all of the supplies you need. The check-in/parking instructions were impressively detailed. (He even provides photos of the parking space and entrance!) We also appreciated how minimal the check out requirements were. We've stayed at Airbnb's in the past that require a lot of tasks, but Demitri keeps it simple and guest friendly.
We highly recommend this Airbnb and would stay here again!
Huge rooms and very comfortable stay!
Excellent host, apartment, and location!
Great location.

For a short weekend stay to attend a concert at Soilder Field, this AirBnB rental was great. It was easy to find parking, we felt safe, the neighborhood was quiet, and the host provided everything we needed. We would definitely stay again.

Enjoyed my stay here! The bed was so comfortable, I slept better here than I do at home. Very quiet neighborhood. Walkable to restaurants, and about a 35 minute walk to Wrigley Field. I definitely recommend this place! :)

This place was a great location for enjoying everything Wicker Park has to offer.  It was a quiet location but just a short walk from the hustle and bustle of Division street. The place was spotless. It had everything we needed. The hosts were very welcoming.
Loved the stay! Perfect for my time in Chicago

Thanks again! He was super easy to communicate with. Our flight was significantly delayed, but he was very accommodating and worked with us, providing clear instructions for everything. The room was private, comfortable, and conveniently located close to just about everything we needed. Highly recommend!

Dimitri is an excellent and communicative host. The apartment is spacious and perfect for both work and vacation. It features two small tables for working comfortably and very strong Wi-Fi. We loved the fully equipped kitchen, which had everything we needed to cook our own meals.
The neighborhood is incredibly safe; we felt completely comfortable walking at night. There are plenty of restaurants and parks nearby. Public transit is very accessible: bus and subway stops are just three blocks away, taking you downtown in 45 minutes. You can also easily rent Lyft bikes to get around.
The only area for improvement is the mattress. It definitely needs an upgrade, as we had a hard time sleeping comfortably.
Overall, despite the bed, I highly recommend staying with Dimitri!
This is actually our second time staying here. It is in a good location (only 20 minutes from downtown) with a beautiful space. Phyllis was nice and helpful.
Such a beautiful Airbnb! Was comfortable for all people staying and such a safe area that is walkable to restaurants. Would stay again!

We had a 14 person group stay at this location and it was the perfect size. Very spacious and has enough bedrooms/bathrooms to comfortably fit a large group. The area was nice and super convenient. A free garage spot and free street parking also made this place a great find. Overall, would definitely recommend! My only note is the bedrooms do not have mirrors if you have a group that needs to get ready at the same time!
Easy to get to close to the city and easy check in and out.
I greatly appreciate Ben for opening up his property to us as we had a great stay. The area was great and so many things to do in the area. Great property and great host!!

Jeannette is a wonderful host and we had a great stay at her place. The apartment is well stocked and has plenty of space for up to three people to stay comfortably. Location wise it can't be beat, surrounded by activity in Wicker Park and so easy to travel around the rest of the city. It made our stay in our favourite city that much better. We would be thrilled to stay here again next time we're in Chicago!

The place was really nice and cozy, and especially clean. We literally had no problems since Andy gave us really detailed instructions on how to get there and inside. We also met Andy on the way out and he was the nicest host I’ve ever had.

The hosts were amenable, responsive, and very flexible to our check in time, early bag drop, and instructions for check in, hot tub, and other amenities. Location was great for free street parking and a few blocks from public transit that brought us right into the city. Would stay again!
Had an amazing time staying here. Veronika is truly an amazing host ❤️
The house was right near where we needed to be and in a very nice neighborhood. Our host was responsive and very tentative to us and responded right away

I cannot stress how great of a locaiton this unit is in. Walkable to the beach, coffee shops, restaurants, Target, etc. It was quiet, peaceful, and comfortable.
This is the perfect spot to stay if you plan on spending majority of your trip out and/or exploring the city. It was comfortable and fit all of our needs. And the bed was fantastic!!
We had a slight issue on our first night there but Connie was more than accommodating and helpful so we could resolve the issue. We absolutely would stay again!

The space was just what my husband and I needed for a long weekend in Chicago. It was quiet, safe, and a nice retreat from the craziness of downtown. Although it's not super close to a CTA stop, it's nearby a bus stop that can get you to where you need to go. Cindy was super communicative throughout the entire stay and gave clear instructions for check-in and check-out.
We had a nice stay while we were in Chicago! This host was very easy to communicate with and very accommodating. We would love to book again in the future.

Hanna and Mark were great hosts! The home was very clean and exactly as pictured. There were no issues accessing the building and I would definitely stay here again. Very responsive and friendly and they made sure to check in with us throughout our stay. They truly value providing a great experience for all guests.
Had a great stay.  The house was just as described and our host took great care of us.
Great place and very responsive host! Nice and safe neighborhood but not super convenient to public transportation. The shared rooftop patio is lovely with excellent views!

Hip, comfortable apartment; in a great location for upscale restaurants and bars, and for transit or even walking.
Two things to be aware of:
- Right near the train, which is very convenient, but does mean noise. I'm fairly noise-sensitive, and I found it noticeable, but not actually a problem.
- One flight of somewhat steep (but wide) stairs.

Excellent experience staying at Brian’s place. Very peaceful and accommodating place for all of us.
Brian helped us out at every step, especially accommodating us to extend the checkout time.
Highly recommended for anyone visiting Chicago.
The property is exactly as described in the listing. It’s conveniently located near public transportation, and the host was kind and welcoming.

Amazing location and property. Easy check in, clean space, and great host. I know where I’ll be staying on my next trip to Chicago.
People watching from the balcony is 10/10. Highly recommend.
This was excellent for the number of people in our party. The place was also close to the venue for my niece’s wedding.

We had a good stay at ZEE’s place. Checkin and communication was smooth. Place matches the description. It was a plus to be able to park in the garage. Would stay here again when I’m in the Chicago area
Place was nice and clean when we got there. They were great at responding quickly to any questions we had before and during our stay.
Great location, very modern and clean, with four bedrooms that were perfect for four adults.

Leonid was very kind and responsive throughout our stay. I would say if you are young female travelers make sure to thoroughly research the neighborhood. There were a few times I felt unsafe going out to my car at night but it was fine in the daytime. There is a homeless camp a block over with tents. Our Uber driver had to walk us to the front door because there was someone who appeared to be on drugs (there was a street party going on) blocking the doorway. I feel like the price is fair for what you get, but our room did not have a nightstand, lamp, or TV. No TV in the living room as well. Kind of like a hostel but the hosts were very nice!
A nice/spacious living space, easily accessible, good parking/check-in accommodations.
It was great staying here. Nicole was great at communicating and the whole process was a breeze!
Not the safest neighborhood and run down

We had an amazing time in Chicago and made Shuang’s home our place for 8 days. The location is perfect and we were able to do and see everything because of the accessibility to the trains and easy parking for our rental car. The home was very clean and comfortable! I always get a little anxious before checking into a rental but Shuang’s home looked just like the photos and felt good to be in. Shuang is very pro-active in giving information needed and super responsive when I messaged questions. I highly recommend staying here on your next Chicago vacation!

Kash’s space was clean and comfortable and we had a good proximity to downtown.
We would stay here again next time we come to town.
Place was clean and in a good area
Thanks MJ, had a great stay. Appreciated the bag storage.
Gran estancia! Época un poco cara para hospedarse pero por lo demás es lo que esperábamos

My friends and I booked this home as it was large enough to fit our 6-person bachelorette group (more on this).
Overall we had a great experience and I’d highly recommend this place for your stay. The home was perfect. It is beautifully decorated and very spacious- the airbnb photos don’t do it justice. The host was very communicative and accommodating.
The only con was the large number of very detailed house rules. The home is gorgeous so I understand having rules in place to keep it pristine. But given we were in town for a bachelorette party, we found it difficult to fully relax and enjoy the space for fear we’d accidentally break a rule (e.g. quiet hours, no speaker phone, keeping tv volume at 50%). As you can imagine, 6 girls + bachelorette = very difficult to keep noise levels down. Had we known about these rules ahead of booking we would’ve found a place more suited for the occasion. I am not sure if anyone lives on the property but I sincerely hope we weren’t too disturbing.

The space was fine for what it was, it worked for our group and our needs. The host was friendly and responded quickly. It appears to be a converted office space- office ceiling tiles and lighting. One of the bedrooms has no windows and seemingly thin wall to the neighbors. The shower was inconvenient to use, it was very high up and tilted towards the wall. There was a hole in the middle of the bathroom floor with a broken cover that is covered by a rug which could be dangerous. There is a very bright flashing light outside of the living room that made it difficult to sleep on the living room couch (which pulls out into a bed, we only realized at the end.) There were not any hand towels / smaller towels available. The place seemed clean and the kitchen was stocked with basic utensils and plates, but missing anything more (no mugs, no salt) so if you’re cooking you may want to bring more. The entrance is shared with the neighbors and the locks did not seem the most secure.

This apartment was easy to find and was located right next to a host of restaurants. There is a subway stop very close to the unit, which made it really convenient to take the train to/from the airport. Felt very safe in the neighborhood, building, and the unit.
Very kind and welcoming, house was very cozy and comfortable. She gave plenty of reccomendations and was very helpful whenever we needed.

The place itself and location is nice. It wasn’t that clean. There were stains on the walls and dirt in the washer machine. The host also was not honest about policies. They blatantly lied about policies. Overall the stay was ok.

This was an awesome spot - we would definitely come back. Charming, walkable location (we came for a Cubs game and it was an easy, mile-long walk to Wrigley) with lots of cute restaurants within a block or two. Brett was helpful and responsive throughout our trip.

Thank you so much for accommodating our needs during our stay Your condo was spotless, comfortable and beautifully maintained. The rooftop was truly the Cherry on top. It made our experience even more enjoyable. We also greatly appreciate how quickly you responded with every question we had, your prompt communication and attention to detail made our stay stress-free. Our trip was wonderful, thank you for being such a gracious host. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend your condo to others.

Emrah was a wonderful, thoughtful, and a super responsive host! The place looked just like the listing photos. Decors were cute and bathrooms were clean. We loved the short walking distance to the blue line. Emrah's thoughtfulness showed through the earplugs that were available, in case the street noise needed to be blocked out. Really enjoyed our stay and would love to stay here again when we visit Chicago in the future!

We loved our stay! Helen was extremely helpful with everything we needed from restaurants, grocery stores, public, transportation, and other local favorites. She was an absolute joy just to talk with. Anytime we come to Chicago, we will be sure to check out her place again and, if available, will book it immediately!
Isaac was a very responsive host and made the check-in process very easy. We loved the location with so much to do in the area. I highly recommend staying at his place!
Great place. Rare pool. Nice amenities and convenient location. Reasonable pricing for the area. I’d stay again.

This was our first Airbnb in Chicago and we had a great experience! Latrice was very proactive in her communication and the space was very nice and clean. We felt comfortable with the street parking and our friends were able to get here easily via public transit. The rental is positioned well for easy access to the south side of Chicago and is far enough away there wasn’t any traffic to worry about.
We would definitely stay again!
Great location and place to stay on our trip to visit Chicago for the first time. Modern amenities with easy access and super responsive hosts. Thanks for hosting us!
Great location; roomy accommodations. All necessities available, would stay again!
Great spot, lots of activities local and within travel distance, and friendly/proactive hosts! 10/10 would recommend.
Fantastic location. Close to downtown and the lake and Lincoln Park, but in a quiet, tree-lined neighborhood with great and walkable food options.
great spot! great host!
Fantastic location and very clean apartment. Easy check in and check out. We had a great time - thank you for everything

This stay was a great time. Hosts were extremely accommodating and receptive. The area was quiet and not too far from downtown Chicago and other neighborhoods in the city. Would 100% recommend this property!

This listing came in clutch when trying to find a nice place to stay that’s close to the city. Due to a public figure staying in the area, parking without a permit or accessing the street is difficult however, once inside the apartment the clean and pristine layout outweighs any inconveniences. Henderson was very responsive and when I had an issue with the WiFi he was able to provide a quick solution.
We had a great stay and would definitely come back if returning to Chicago. Place was clean, well kept, great location, safe neighborhood!

Really enjoyed the modern updates in this comfortable and clean basement apartment. I graded my stay a 4-star just because the first night was a little humid and I had some trouble regulating the temperature to sleep well. A small fan did the trick perfectly for day two, and overall, it's a great place to stay!
The park across the street is wonderful. The walkability to all things is amazing. It really is a wonderful place to stay.
This place is as great!

I had a wonderful visit with my daughter and son. The location was ideal. The room was spacious with big windows and full of sunshine.
And Jim was responsive, friendly and helpful.

The location was amazing, great neighborhood, and lots to do around the area.
We did ask for early check-in at the last minute which they were able to accommodate which was amazing! However, the apartment was not fully cleaned. They were stained towels in the bathroom, hair on the floor, walls, covered in smears and stains, as well as baseboards being very dirty. I know that the cleaning was rushed so that she could accommodate our early check-in request, but I wish that she had denied it so we could’ve stayed in a clean location.
The bathroom in the guest bedroom would not switch over from tub to shower spout, leaving only 1 functioning shower.
I reached out to let them know and did not hear back. If this had been a cheaper apartment, I probably wouldn’t have an issue, but paying $1000 for two nights I expected more.
There is also limited amenities in the kitchen, no coffee available but they had coffee filters. Leads me to believe it was not restocked after the last stay

So many issues it's easier to list them all.
1. The listing states an apartment in Logan square and it is not very clear that it is a room with shared space. Upon entering I was met with a man in his underwear and a woman hiding under the covers in the bedroom. The man told me it was a shared space and we immediately left as this was not our expectation. Regardless, there is no explanation for someone to be in their underwear in the common area.
2. We were not given the address ahead of time and was told that for security purposes the address could not be given out prior to the 4pm check in time.
3. The host's picture indicates a woman named Joe, however the person who called was clearly a man and identified themselves as the host named Joe.
4. I asked for a refund and was told I could re-rent the unit out myself! Airbnb support said it was up to the host to provide a refund. I never heard back from the host after the initial call.
We will not be using Airbnb again after this!

Really nice apartment in an older building - key situation is a bit tricky but fine after the first run-through. Neighborhood is quiet and a short Uber ride to just about everything. I stayed as a solo, female traveler for a wedding and felt very safe. And the place was immaculate, bed sheets & bathroom felt cleaner than most hotels.

Me and my friends stayed at this Airbnb for a long weekend, for a boys trip. The spot was in a great location and was an awesome home base for us. It comfortably slept 6 of us and could of handled more. The best part was the on site manager who stayed below us was awesome. He also manages the bar around the corner which served as our home base. If we had any questions he was behind the bar and always had recommendations and was super friendly. We had some later flights and they allowed us to checkout an hour late which was super helpful. Neighborhood is quiet and safe, super walkable to anything you need!

Great place extremely close to Wrigley. Spacious, with lots of room. The basement includes great activity space, and the back patio is a nice outdoors addition to the house. Hot water heater had no issues for 12+ people showering across the 3 bathrooms in under 60 minutes.

The place was very spacious and in a great neighborhood! My only complaints were that the pillows and couch were very uncomfortable, and for the price of the unit (comparable to the area but objectively pricey), I would expect a little better. Additionally, upon booking the host asks for the ages of the adults and I personally find that to be an unnecessary, invasive question.
Great house, perfect for 6 people. Having 2 bathrooms was so nice, that can be hard to find in that area.

The location was perfect! Close enough to walk to public transportation, parks, restaurants, etc. Nice neighborhood & happy to have access to free parking.  Place was clean and comfortable. Would definitely recommend!

This place was great for a weekend stay in Chicago! Super close to public transit, two bathrooms and a kitchen stocked with appliances, dishes, and utensils. Iris was also very communicative the whole time.

We had a great time here. The neighborhood was so peaceful and beautiful. It is such a great location. Street parking, for the most part, was very easy. However, it was a bit crowded our first night as we arrived around 7pm when everyone was likely home for the evening. If that’s the case for your arrival, just keep that in mind. We just parked a few streets over and then moved closer the next morning! There were parking passes provided for the street out front, which was great! The bed, sheets, and comforter were all so incredibly comfy, which was a necessity after the amount of walking we did in the city. The kitchen was stunning and had any necessity you may need! Sarah was a very friendly host and made sure to check in via message to make sure things were going smoothly. Our only hiccup would be that you can hear some noise from other unit, so be sure pack your favorite noise machine to play at night and you’ll have no issues! We would certainly stay again!
perfect space for our visit - loved the staff and the neighborhood.

Jamie was responsive, helpful, and the house was clean and tidy. We loved the snacks, coffee, and tea provided! We also enjoyed the body wash, clean towels, and linens. Information on recommended restaurants and what public transportation was available was helpful. I would stay here again!

One of our favorite places we have stayed in the area!  First the location was perfect- super close to the blue line but also to the incredible bars and restaurants in the area - Lardon, Union, Meadowlark, Middlebrow, Solemn oath, Lula, Kyoten next door, and daisies were all a short walk (and delicious!). The space is very well decorated and so comfortable!  We didn’t cook (because of all the restaurants noted!) but it would be a great kitchen to do so!  I really appreciated that the washer/dryer was in unit as opposed to shared too. Would definitely stay again!

This place was amazing. I stayed in a few Airbnbs during my time in Chicago and this one was definitely the cleanest and most homely feeling. Super close to the Belmont blue line stop. Super nice hosts, they changed my check out date very quickly when I needed to leave sooner than planned. Overall 10/10.
Loved staying here! The location was great and the apartment had everything that we needed. Angela was extremely responsive and had clear instructions. Would definitely recommend and stay again!
Hello! Responsive host, reach out early for late/early check-in/out. Place is as described, we felt right home.
This was such a nice place! The decor had such a neat vintage feel and the place felt cozy.

Laura’s unit was bright and clean with comfortable accommodations in a great location. A quick walk to Lincoln Square and to the brown line for an easy trip downtown.
We experienced a minor check-in issue upon arrival, but it was resolved quickly through responsive communication from the host. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would stay here again and happily recommend this property.
Great Hosts
Great location, massive, well-stocked apartment. Was a perfect base for a few nights to explore Chicago. Would stay again. Thank you Jay!!
Really great stay! Was perfect for me and my friends, great walking distance to lots of bars and restaurants. Game room downstairs was nice and cozy!

Caryl was a wonderful host and we felt right at home staying at their listing. From the beginning of our stay through the end, Caryl was thoughtful, checked in on us, and ensured our stay was wonderful. We will definitely be back! Thank you again!
Katherine and Dimi were super helpful and responsive. Their apartment was very clean, spacious, and in a great location. We enjoyed our stay very much!

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago! The property is in an incredible location - plenty of coffee shops, bars, restaurants, and an easy walk to Wrigley! We loved exploring the neighborhood - felt very safe & enjoyed all the beautiful homes and gardens. Huge perk was off-street parking (our large truck easily fit into the space). Chris & John were amazing hosts - very friendly, responsive, and provided great recommendations. The space itself was very clean, beds were super comfy, nice towels/linens/blankets, and we really appreciated the snacks, drinks, and unique beauty products (shampoo/conditioner/hand soaps, etc.) Highly recommend & will definitely stay here again next time we are in Chicago!

Thathue was a wonderful host. He gave a quick response to any questions. He gave easy to follow instructions for getting into the house. The kitchen was well stocked with kitchen items and plenty of food!  The five of us were very comfortable.

Kevin and Jackie’s hospitality stood out to me the most! Given that the location is in a basement unit there is more bugs than normal. other than that i would highly recommend staying here especially with the green line being around the corner.
pasamos unos dias increíbles,  el alojamiento esta muy bonito y super confortable

We had a wonderful time at this place for our trip to Chicago! The location was fantastic, with easy access to walk, drive or take the train to several destinations. The space was great, very clean with comfortable beds and nice amenities. We would highly recommend for any family coming to see the sights in town.
Accessibility was great and neighborhood was peaceful
Amazing place. I would stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay at Sheena’s Airbnb! She was incredibly responsive and quick to answer any questions we had throughout the booking process and our stay.
The home exceeded our expectations—everything was clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully decorated. The space felt welcoming and was perfect for our family. One of our favorite features was the theater/entertainment basement, which provided a fun place for everyone to relax and spend time together.
Overall, this was a lovely experience from start to finish. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend Sheena’s place to others!

A really lovely neighborhood, very quiet & safe. The check in steps were clear & easy, beds were comfortable, and the TV and ceiling fans worked well. Unfortunately, we weren’t able to find a lot to recommend other than those items.
We had concerns about the cleanliness—the shower curtain wasn’t cleaned & had visible mold, the windowsill & base boards in the bathroom also had mold or wood rot along the edges.

The photos of the listing don’t accurately reflect the condition of the current space. A lot of broken, non-working items, more than normal wear and tear: chairs in the living room are not the ones pictured and are missing the legs, they’re just sitting on the floor. Both lamps were broken in one bedroom, a broken door handle to the exterior door in the kitchen, broken blinds missing slats throughout, knobs missing from cabinets, multiple walls & parts of the floor with holes.
Looking at previous reviews, many of these things have been issues for a while.

5 stars! Ho Eun was very responsive every step of the way. We comfortably had 3 couples stay for a weekend and had plenty of room to hangout and sleep. The area was walkable to different restaurants and parks as well. Would highly recommend!
Laura was incredibly communicative! Easiest, most seamless Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. Great location that was perfect for our group.
Wonderful location, walkable to lots of nearby restaurants and bars, quick CTA to Wrigleyville and downtown.
Location is great for Cubs game goers within 100ft of Wrigley. Great spot and within walking distance to all pre-game activities.

Amazing place to stay, great responsive host. Looked just like the booking listed it, comfortable bed, nice amenities. Location was incredible- walkable to Southport (recommend D’Agostintos Pizza, Southport Grocery), Boystown (Replay Bar was fun), equally walkable to Wrigley for a Cubs game or down Clark street for their restaurants- (Happy Camper and Mia Francesca’s were our favs.) Maurizio was a great communicator and had clear instructions on how to find, and get into his place. Hope to stay here again in the future.
Despite a lot of troubles with the pin to get in the unit. She was a very responsive hody and tried her best to satisfy our needs
We loved staying at Mary and Andrew’s! Their place felt like home and was even more beautiful and spacious than the pictures. They were wonderful hosts!
What a wonderful place, area and hosts, we will be back for sure
Gary was a great host, and abundantly accommodating. We would definitely stay here again on future visits to Chicago!!

I loved my stay. Visited Chicago for the grand opening of the Obama Presidential Center. The apartment is only 1 mile from the center and less than 10 miles from downtown. The perfect spot for Uber around town or Midway Airport. Elise was an excellent host, very responsive, and gave us great recommendations for things to do around the area.  I will definitely rebook for future visits. 🌹

Highly recommend! Perfectly nestled in the heart of little Italy. You are in walking distance of everything you could need: food, drinks, groceries, etc. The place was squeaky clean, easy to find, and easy to get in. I can’t say anything bad about about our stay. Usually there is a small hiccup here or there that you can nitpick but this place was everything we wanted and needed. Would stay here again in a heartbeat the next time we are in Chicago!! Do not hesitate to book. You will not be disappointed!

Can not recommend highly enough, especially if you are going to a Cubs game.  Literally three blocks away from Wrigley Field, and the same distance from the Addison Metro Station. The host were great communicators and everything was just like they said. There are tons of restaurants in the area also. Yes it is close to the L tracks, but the noise really just blends in and is not bad. Same with the street noise. Do not let that hold you back.

A casa era muito boa! Completa, limpa, móveis confortáveis e iluminada. O problema na minha estadia não foi a casa e sim a vizinhança. A rua era um ponto de encontro de jovens e pessoas que faziam muito barulho e festa, não sendo muito receptivas. Por isso, não nos sentimos muito tranquilos. Oswaldo comentou que estávamos numa época de feriado, por isso as festas. Mas, no mais fiquei satisfeita com a casa em si.

Cozy unit and convenient location.  Great spot for our Chicago weekend get away.  Loved the windows and light in front bedroom!  Vin was an A+ host, everything was clear and easy to get in/out of unit.
awesome location, clean and beautiful place. can't beat the view and location....amazing experience

We were disappointed with our stay overall.
The main issue was that the room did not have functioning air conditioning, despite being advertised and paid for as an air-conditioned room. During our stay, the room became very uncomfortable, and when we contacted the host, the only solution offered was a fan. While the host apologized, we did not feel that this adequately addressed the problem. We chose to accept the situation because we wanted to enjoy our trip rather than spend our time dealing with complaints, but it significantly affected our comfort.

Enjoyed our stay, home is lovely, in a great neighborhood. Parking was easy enough to find and there are some nice resturants in walking area if you dont want to go all the way downtown. The host was extremely kind, well organized, and helpful. We really enjoyed our weekend here. Thank you
Dave was an amazing host. He was extremely thoughtful and kind. his place was absolutely beautiful You can tell that it was well it's all out and he prepared the space we care.

Quiet tree-lined neighborhood just steps from everything. Including the Brown Line. Apartment was clean and comfortable. Hosts were helpful. We were visiting family and this will be our go to place to stay from here on!
Great place to stay!

This apartment was absolutely perfect. It is a perfect location in the West Loop. Walkable to bus stops and trains as well as coffee shops, pizza, and restaurants. Check in was easy and Thomas was so accommodating allowing us to drop our luggage in the apartment prior to check in time so that we could walk to lunch free of luggage. Apartment is beautifully decorated, clean, and comfortable. Beds are comfortable with perfect linens and kitchen is well stocked. Balcony is perfect for morning coffee and beautiful evening sunsets. Great community, better location, outstanding host!

This was a great space to accommodate me and 3 friends. Great location; down the street from Midway, the Obama Presidential Center, and easy access to the Dan Ryan Expressway. Great amenities and felt like home as well walked in. Highly recommend staying here.
Was perfect for a bachelorette weekend!!!
The Airbnb had everything you'd need, and was nice and clean. Comfortable bed, clean bathroom - perfect space for 1 or 2 people.

Jorge was a great host. He communicated clearly days before the booking and was interested in what I was doing so he could give recommendations of things to do locally. He was also responsive and answered questions promptly. Would recommend.
Location was very good for our visit with our son.  Had a bit of a snafu with getting in as the lock box malfunctioned but they were responsive to getting us in eventually
Great value. The home was true to the pictures and comfortable throughout our stay.  Melvin was friendly and responsive.

We had a great time staying at Junni's home. Rooms were nice and spacious and the kitchen had all the amenities we needed. There is plenty of parking by the house and it was easy to get to. We liked that there was a playground just across the street for the little ones to enjoy as well as it being close to restaurants in the neighborhood. We would definitely stay again.
Great stay! Felt very homey and Luis was a wonderful host.
Great location and easy to get to with check in instructions. Would definitely book again!
Was a great experience. Clean space

Great location! Walkable to some restaurants etc. Having a parking space was great. Very easy to take the train, Uber, or drive to downtown Chicago for sightseeing. So peaceful to come home to after a long day walking around the city.
Everything was clean and nice. Slept great and really enjoyed the little touches like the snacks, coffee, and sparkling waters.

Overall our stay was great. The check in instructions were clear and the place was easy to fine. We also found the checkin YouTube video very helpful.
