The hosts were responsive to messages in a very timely manner which was also helpful. The property is located in a great location and in close proximity to the downtown area which was a huge plus as well. One of the only challenging experiences we had was how noisy the upstairs residents were during the wee hours of the morning (they were up between the hours of 12-4am daily which made it very difficult to get decent rest during our stay). I’d suggest bringing ear plugs if you’re a light sleeper like me (and planning to sleep in the upstairs bedroom) otherwise you may be up throughout the night like I was unfortunately. Other than that, the stay was good overall. There were some minor issues that arose which we brought to the concerns of the hosts privately. For the location alone I would recommend this property (downtown).
Had a great stay at this Airbnb. Walking distance to United center and was super close to west loop. Very spacious home and cool rooftop!
Great host, really friendly and accommodating.

Spent the weekend in town with friends and the unit was perfectly comfortable and spacious.   Clean and had all we needed. Location was fantastic, within easy walking distance of so many restaurants, cafes and entertainment.

We had a wonderful four-month stay at Camillia & Phil's garden apartment and couldn't have asked for a better home base while living in Chicago. The location was perfect for us, just a short commute to my partner Greg's job, close to Hyde Park, and an easy trip into downtown for all of our weekend adventures.
The apartment was comfortable, well-kept, and made us feel at home during our extended stay. I loved having the fully stocked kitchen and gas stove. We truly enjoyed exploring the city, and we're grateful we got to experience a little piece of summer in the Chi before heading home.
Thank you both for your hospitality. We'll definitely miss Chicago and have many wonderful memories from our time there!

Great astay. very kind. very clean. The neighborhood is close to Chinatown and close to really great food options. Only a $15 ride away from downtown Michigan avenue. Great location . Bathroom was always clean and tidy. The small issue I had he immediately responded and resolved with no problem. Thankyou for being very easy and accommodating to me.
Really GREAT Host!
Overall our trip to Chicago was good.
Very tidy place ! The host communicated with us very nicely and we had no complications! Highly recommend

We had a wonderful time staying with Janet and Chuck! It was a perfect space for our weekend.
Can’t wait to come back!

Abigail was a wonderful host, and the place was great! It was beautifully decorated, very cozy, with a great backyard and kitchen space. We really enjoyed how clean everything was, and the water pressure and water temperature in the shower was excellent (cannot emphasise this enough!!) The area was quiet and picturesque. Would definitely stay again!
Beautiful home!! The hosts were amazing and very responsive.

Stephanie’s unit was fantastic! We had to book an Airbnb at the last minute, and she took great care of us from the start. Her communication was quick and responsive, and when we needed extra towels, she had them delivered the same day. Check-in and check-out instructions were clear and easy to follow. The beds were very comfortable, and there was plenty of space for our group of 9. We really enjoyed our stay and would happily book with Stefanie again!

One of the best Airbnbs I've ever stayed at ever. Great space, location, and size. It's also near the 22 Clark bus, which runs all night. Hosts thought of every amenity - I even used the umbrella provided! The bottle of wine and bag of chips were a nice touch and much appreciated. Would absolutely book a stay here again. Thank you!
Great location and cozy place! Definitely would return!

Incredible location if you’re doing a Cubs game. The amenities aren’t mind-blowing but this place is 100% about location and convenience for a Cubs game, and you wouldn’t spend much time in there anyway. The hosts were friendly and responsive. Would probably go again!
Above average experience
This was a good getaway. The hosts are extremely responsive and flexible. The room and stay were clean and well kept.

Jerry was extremely responsive when it came to any question or concern that we had leading up to our stay. Will to go above and beyond and made our stay feel like home! It made our trip to Chicago memorable. It’s a cute place for a group of friends to come back to and enjoy a nice evening in or allow you to recoup after a long day out on the town.
A nice and cozy stay, perfect for a couple. The only issue was the noise from footsteps from the floor above, since this is a basement unit.
Easy communication.  Place was walking distance to soldier field.  Perfect for us.  Thank you, Shay!
This airbnb was nice and cozy. Tucked away in a nice neighborhood with quick access to the red line and a lot of nearby restaurants and stores.

This air bnb had potential but me and friends just had bad experiences. The property was dirty once we arrived on top of the issue with the locks, so we had trouble getting into the property for about 25 minutes. This air bnb is located above a restaurant which was not mention so was a shock for us. No privacy in the bedroom right in front of stairs, people that walk by if they are paying attention can see everything in that room and hallway area. While at this air bnb we also could hear loud people outside, they banged on the door once as well. They were outside and were very loud from 11pm till 4am so was very hard to get any type of sleep. I am very unpleased with my experience here because we spent so much and I feel it did ruin the trip a little bit for us as well. Aminah did have good communication we are just upset with these problems occurring in the first place.

We’ve never written a negative Airbnb review before, but while the location was excellent, the overall experience did not justify the nearly $1,000-per-night cost after fees.
The property needs maintenance and updating. The entrance from the street was not well maintained (loose stones), and the backyard grass was shin-high, making the outdoor space uninviting. One of the bedrooms had no ventilation, and the window A/C units throughout the home struggled to keep the space comfortable. Bathroom towels outdated.
Several functional issues. The guest bedroom door stuck badly and made enough noise to wake others when opened. The laundry room was outdated and had no working light. Additionally, the air mattress provided was inoperable upon arrival, although the owner did replace it on the second night, which we appreciated.
The location is the property’s strongest asset, but given the price point, we expected a higher standard of maintenance, comfort, and overall readiness.
I enjoyed this peaceful space!! It was  nice change out side of the city.

Kit & Jo's place was great.  It is super close to Wrigley Field, so a perfect spot if you're a Cubs fan and plan to attend a game.  Parking was available in the alley behind Kit & Jo's through one of the mobile apps available for the area.  We didn't do much cooking, but the kitchen was well supplied to enable cooking meals.  There are tons of restaurants and bars within easy walking distance.
Clean place! Some cool spots in walking distance!
Lovely place, great light and detail! We were very comfortable and enjoyed our stay!

Great location! My kids and I stayed here to do the touristy thing in Chicago. we ubered everywhere but it was close enough to the cities that Ubers were usually around $25 each time. We met the neighbors on both sides and they were super friendly! Everything was clean and the host was quick to respond to any questions. There is a train nearby that is pretty loud, but otherwise this place worked great for what we needed!!
it’s was nice house overall

We had a great stay at Andrew’s place! It was in a very convenient location with lots of good restaurants within walking distance. Parking was very easy! Andrew was responsive as a host. Everything was clean when we got there, and the beds were comfortable.
One thing to note (not a downside for our group) - the host does live here when he’s not renting it out, so there’s food in the cabinets/fridge and equipment/bikes stored in the common rooms. We had no issues with this but if you were planning a longer stay or using the kitchen more, it might be worth knowing about! The host assured us that we could use any spices or coffee in the kitchen :)
I would stay here again when I’m next in the area!
This place was a great place for a family vacation. My daughters and I had a great time! Very clean, relaxing and a convenient location for our girls shopping trip! Will definitely book again!

We enjoyed our stay for our weekend trip to Chicago! It was perfect location not far from downtown CHI. The locals around the B&B were very friendly and helpful as well. Would definitely recommend you stay here!
Solid spot in a conveniently located area with lots to do nearby. If you are visiting from out of town I think it gives a good representation of the city feel.
Appreciated Kyriako’s quick responses with the couple questions we did have. I would stay here again as it met our family’s needs.

This was my second time so stay with Jason. My friends and I loved having our own rooms and being above a bar that served meals. The location is perfect for walking to Wrigley Field to see my favorite, Chicago Cubs. It is also close to a brown line EL stop, which took us to our other planned activities throughout the city. Jason is quick to respond and is an amazing host. I would not hesitate recommending staying at one of his properties.

Odi is one of the most hospitable people I have met.  He communicated with me throughout our stay to make sure we were comfortable and happy.  He makes sure his home is your "home away from home".  It is such a beautiful place with everything you need to accommodate your stay.  The bathrooms are beautiful and inviting 😍 The kitchen is a chef kitchen & the beds are so comfortable.   You will want to book ASAP before anyone else finds this gem. Thanks for a most memorable stay.  I will be back
Perfect quiet place between Fulton and busy downtown.   Very walkable to everything in the city.   Would definitely go back when in Chicago.

Renaldo was a great host!  Very kind and ensured I was checked in successfully and that I had all that I needed. Offered helpful dining recommendations. The place is super cute and artsy. Loved that he provided at least three different options for making coffee. :) Kitchen is stocked with any pot, pan or utensil you may need. Bedroom is petite, but fun, comfortable, and functional. Bathroom was clean and contemporary. Nice, open living space. It was a great location for me as it was close to my family I was visiting. Would stay again.
Clean, simple, well located garden studio in the heart of Bucktown. Would stay again!
Host was communicative and the place was exactly what was described!

This is a fantastic apartment! Beautifully decorated, very clean, comfortable, and stocked with everything you need.  In a wonderful location with many restaurants and stores nearby. The host was very responsive and helpful. Very short walk to the lake. We would definitely stay here again.
I had a great time experience here. This was an amazing place to stay at. I was here for a concert at Soldier Field. The walk was very easy from here. The host is amazing and had great communication!

This was a lovely apartment. We really enjoyed being close to the 606 and Starbucks and a bunch of other restaurants. The apartment was very comfortable! Enter on the left-hand side of the building down the alley. We would love to stay here again.
Zed’s place was exactly what we needed for the Fathers Day weekend in Chicago!  Just like it was described.
Great place and very responsive and flexible hosts!
Carlton is a very welcome person, she took the time to met us in person and explained all of things needed. She made sure to update us about the place being ready and if we arrived safe.
Cool townhome, having five bedrooms was perfect, excellent location for those going to a game at Wrigley. Highly recommended.
We really enjoyed staying in this apartment. It was very comfortable and in an excellent location! The host was also helpful when we had questions.

We had a wonderful stay and the home was absolutely gorgeous! It was comfortable, clean, welcoming, accurately described, and made us feel right at home. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful with any questions I had. She provided us with coffee, cooking pans, nice silverware, and more. There are plenty of markets, food places, and shopping stores surrounding the home which is a huge plus! I would definitely stay again and recommend this gem to others, thank you!
I had a wonderful stay, the host did a good job with instructions and responded with any questions or concerns promptly. The bnb was also very clean and neat.
We loved our stay in Chicago. Maria was great and this was the perfect find for our full weekend in Chi town!

Great place! In an up and coming neighborhood and pretty centrally located. Easy to hop over to some of the popular Chicago areas. We stayed with our 12 month twins and although the listed is described as “kid-friendly”, the unit is free of clutter and has a lot of space so the boys had free range to roam around.
Street parking was easy and check- in was smooth!

I was not informed that there was going to be other people living in the space while we were there, when booking I did click on entire unit so that felt very deceiving, the floors Creaked  and I have videos of me laying in bed or sitting in the couch and hearing people walk upstairs. It was very loud. The floors are so thin even when I walked I’m sure whoever was downstairs could also hear, the bathroom was really filthy between the creases and crevices. It looks like either mold or dirt. The place just felt dusty and looked  unclean. Also, every time we would go out and come back there will be packages right at the front and we’d tripping over packages. People lived upstairs so I’m not sure why they couldn’t just get the packages out the way. His communication wasn’t bad and he also was going to allow early check-in, even though we didn’t utilize the option. Seems like a very good host, but the place was not as expected.
Great location and very spacious.
Absolutely great hosts, very responsive, great neighborhood, friendly neighbors, very walkable. i would definitely stay here again.

We loved this Airbnb! The location is amazing - very safe and close to all the fun of Lincoln Park! Ishin was super communicative with clear instructions and frequent check ins to see if we needed anything. Will definitely be booking again next time we visit Chicago.
The location was as advertised, and Carissa was easy to communicate with. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely book again, thanks for having us!

the location was perfect - so many great places to walk and and felt really safe! magda was extremely kind and responsive and easy to communicate with!!
the apartment was pretty dirty but because of the location and ease of check in it was worth the stay!
Great place…. Ultra clean and close to the orange line
This 3 bedroom apartment was perfect for our girls trip!  Comfy beds and lots of amenities and stylish to boot.  Great food just a block away.  It was just what we were looking for!

Highly recommend staying at Sarah’s place! It’s in a lovely, peaceful, and quiet neighborhood yet still in the heart of the city. Parking on the street was easy and we loved being able to walk to local restaurants and cafes. It is also a quick bus ride or 20 min walk to the United Center. The unit itself is spacious, comfortable, and thoughtfully decorated (with real art, unlike a lot of Airbnbs!) Sarah was a kind and responsive host, too. I would definitely stay here again!

we really enjoyed our stay here. the place is just as described. great location for access to all parts of Chicago. the hosts commincated well and we had no issues. great value, would love to stay here again

Molly was a wonderful host, accommodating our belated arrival due to a late flight and meeting us with banana bread in hand. She gave us clear instructions on how to make it to her place, and we loved the space she provided us. Strongly recommend
The house smelt amazing and was very clean. The host is fast at responding and is very friendly. I would definitely book again!

Super clean and fun place to stay. In a great location and myself/friends loved staying here. Got fast responses on questions and the owners were very friendly. Would 100% stay here again and if you’re reading this, you should stay here too!

Brad’s Pullman Townhome was a perfect stay for our family. The home was clean and well stocked. Brad provided excellent communication and clear and precise instructions for the home. He was very quick at responding to questions. A perfect place to stay in the Chicago area!
Patricia is a great host and this property is in a great location. 10/10

Angela es una excelente anfitriona! Nos ayudó muchísimo con todo lo que necesitamos y siempre estuvo dispuesta a ayudarnos. Nos dejó dejar las valijas hasta más tarde del check in, lo que nos ayudó muchísimo. La casa está muy linda, en un barrio con muchos lugares para comer, y es súper cómoda y amplia. Recomiendo ampliamente

Nice place on a garden level of a multi unit building. Location is walkable to the L train, if you don't mind a long-ish walk (there's also a bus). Beds/futon quality didn't get rave reviews - nothing terrible but an upgrade at some point would probably be ideal.

Mera was an excellent host with great communication and always responsive. The apartment was updated, clean and had modern furniture. It had enough space for my family of 5 to be comfortable.
Our only issue was the train noise. The description and other reviews mentioned “background train noise” but it was much louder than I expected. I lived in Chicago for 18 years, mostly near the brown line. This unit was exceptionally loud because each unit had window AC (and one window in the kitchen doesn’t close) so it was like the train driving by your living room. It woke us up a couple times each night and you could not hear the TV when it drove by. I’ve lived near the train much of my life and thought this was too loud for our family. Everything else is great if you can deal with the constant noise as the redline runs all night.
Dede was a great host and very attuned! A lovely human who's offering their space and doing for above the norm to make it accommodating. I absolutely recommend this listing.
Alba's place were perfectly clean and spacious enough for two people. it is a very walkable restaurant with many restaurants options in the surrounding blocks.

This apartment was quite a bit different than indicated in the listing. The listing photos show a different entrance/building and different furniture than the actual apartment. The WiFi cut in and out, especially on the smart phone, and there was limited cell signal in the apartment. The apartment smelled stuffy. The toilet was improperly installed and leaking from the base. The toilet would not shut off easily after flushing, continuing to run. The bathtub drained slowly and had stains around the drain. The apartment had water stains on the walls and ceilings. The owner was diligent in responding to messages but not in addressing the issues.
The place was excellent and communication from host was awesome.

The location and check-in process were great, but unfortunately the cleanliness of the Airbnb was below expectations. We found dust, dirty surfaces, and areas that appeared not to have been properly cleaned before our arrival. The kitchen trashcan was the size of a bathroom trashcan. I got on the floor to find my keys. There was trash and water bottles tossed under the couch and some of the beds. The air filter is covered thick in dust.
It was a great stay besides the cleanliness.

We had an amazing time here!! The space was absolutely perfect for our girls trip and we loved having the backyard area as well. Checking in and out was super easy and Angela was great at communicating reminders and asking questions. All around great stay!
Such a cute place and friendly host!

The location I stayed differed from the listing due to a natural disaster causing flooding so the host proactively moved me to another location which was just as accommodating. Overall my stay was nice and didn’t feel overly interrupted by the change of apartment. The host was very respectful through the whole process and made what could have been a really bad start to my trip a rather effortless transition with no negative impact on the trip at all. I would use this host again.
Great location! Love Roscoe Village and the restaurants. Easy walk to Wrigley.

I liked Shaun, and this house was a great deal for a West side location just walking distance from the #56 bus stop. Having a private bathroom directly across the hall from the bedroom was very much appreciated. The soap dispenser in the shower was nice, but it was empty. There was plenty of shampoo. Plenty of plush towels, and the bed was very comfortable, with everything needed for bedroom. That's where we hung out. Maybe I'm used to a traditional Airbnb experience, but I felt that since Shaun and his partner were there watching the large-screen TV and playing video games whenever we were, it kept us from truly enjoying the house and its amenities. Also, the porch, which is so prominently advertised in the photos, was "not ready" and could not be used, even though it was a nice week in June and we could have taken advantage of it. A little less video-game-playing and a bit more time sprucing up the porch would have been helpful. Definitely a great deal, though, and very convenient.
Very responsive host , accommodated me with parking passes for two days and bathing items.

Lots of rules and slow to respond. We asked to drop off our luggage maybe an hour or so early so we could head downtown…denied. I suppose “rules are rules” but I’ve never had an issue with other places I’ve stayed.
Great location, great place to stay. Recommend mother’s ruin bar downstairs, it has great food and very convenient.

Had an amazing weekend stay! The place was in a great neighborhood that felt close to everything and street parking was never a hassle as there were always open spots. The place itself was very clean, exactly as pictured, and had everything provided that we needed for our stay. This is the place to stay if you’re coming to Chicago!
Clean place, great location, would happily stay again!
They were great!
I love Chicago it’s the parking for me but other than that place was nice

Overall I would say that this house is one of the better Airbnb properties in which I have stayed. Host was very responsive when there was not enough propane and had some brought the next morning so we could use the grill. I would absolutely stay again if back in the Windy City.
I would clarify one piece of the listing though. It lists a Nespresso machine as available, which is true. But only 3 caffeinated pods are provided for use. If you are a morning coffee drinker like me, I would recommend ordering Nespresso Virtuo pods to take with you or, as I did, go to the Nespresso kiosk in downtown Chicago to purchase what you need while there. That was the only surprise and was just a minor annoyance.
decent for its price but if u have clostrophobia i wouldnt recommend u this place and additionally its not safe to walk in nights

We got to spend a long weekend here and it was so spacious and comfortable. With the kitchenette and laundry, it felt like a basement apartment that could meet all our needs between being out and about throughout the day.
Given that the space is in their basement, voices/footsteps were pretty audible from above - so that would be the only thing to keep in mind when considering how private/quiet a space you’re looking for.
Otherwise, a seamless stay in a convenient location (especially with a car).

Had a group of 7 here. Was a perfect place for us. Furniture was so comfy a couple of us used it instead of the actual beds to sleep in. Has a nice patio out back. Easy street parking right in front of the house as well. Multiple rooms & spots to hang out. Again, had 7 total people & never felt like we were on top of each other. Always had at least 1 bathroom/shower available as well. Would highly recommend this host & house!
We had a great stay in Chicago. Austin has a great home in an excellent location. We would definitely stay there again.

This place was in the perfect spot in Gold Coast. Great area surrounded by great restaurants, good shopping, and nice, friendly people. Perfect for a girls trip! The streets around were beautiful! We would definitely stay here again when we’re back in Chicago.

To me this place felt like home. The place itself felt like a private. Clean, everything you would need for your stay; is being provided. I enjoyed watching a free Hulu movies that also being provided.  I strongly recommend this place for your stay.
outstanding option for large groups. 5 min walk from the blue line and 20 min walk to Fulton Market/Randolph St.

Overall, it is a nice place to stay. The location was great. We were lucky to be placed on the 16th floor with a lake view, so the view was nice, too.
It’s clear, however, that this place is managed by people who don’t live there. There were just quirks to the place that would have been resolved if a person (not a company) rented the place. The door to the balcony didn’t lock. The entire east facing wall was windows, which was beautiful during the day, but was a pain in the morning because the blinds they have didn’t block out the sun - hello 5am wake up! A person would have easily been able to install black out curtains. There wasn’t a book to tell you about the special spots in the neighborhood, and the place lacked homeliness.
Overall, I’d stay here again if I couldn’t find a better option. It wasn’t bad and the location was great. But, given the choice between this and another place in the same location and price point, I’d choose somewhere else.
Jaimie’s place was very spacious and clean and it was in a great location next to restaurants and the train. We will come back again.
Wonderful place to stay!  Quick to respond.  Would definitely recommend! Also, one of the more comfortable beds I have slept in at rentals!

We would stay here again. Overall, it felt like a poorly flipped house that wasn't cleaned very well. It is close to transit stop. The house was not very clean. Sheets, wall, and towels had red stains, gum stuck to wall, tea kettle had something growing in it. None of the TVs had a functional remote. about half of the lamps in the house did not have access to a plug. several doors had hinges that were half pulled out of the door jambs.

We had a wonderful stay during our weekend trip to Chicago for the Morgan Wallen concert. We’re from Los Angeles and really enjoyed our time here. The home was very clean, organized, and exactly as described. The location was great, close enough to downtown to easily explore the city while still being in a comfortable area.
The host made everything easy, and the property had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you for helping make our trip such a memorable one!
Great spot! Close to so many things in Wicker. Very cozy place. Easy to get to public transport including buses and blue line. It was so easy to get to from the airport and around Chicago.
This place worked really well for our large group. It was private, had plenty of space, and was in a nice location. The hosts were friendly and responsive to any questions we had.
We had a nice stay at Abigail’s place! She was quick, responsive, and welcoming. Good location with access to kitchen and washer/dryer.

We loved our stay at this spacious, comfortable retreat in wicker park. Our large family had ample space to lounge, play, work, work out and make the most of our time together - with charming walks to sweet parks, restaurants, and cafes. Nick and Melissa were incredibly nice and responsive.

The staff at the hotel were wonderful. The hotel is older and the hallways smelled like wet carpet even though the environment was dry or mold. It’s walkable to very good restaurants. Biggest issue was street noise all night long as if cars were drag racing outside the window even though we were in the 4th floor.

A nice place to stay if you’re looking for something cheap and convenient. Definitely gives haunted mansion vibes but in a good way. We only saw a couple people during stay and everyone was quiet and respectful. Host sends an exasperating amount of messages during the stay (13 messages! surely this can be condensed!) and also requested us a $35 late checkout fee despite being out of the house well before the 10am checkout time, so that’s frustrating.
Personally as a younger female I did feel unsafe walking around the neighborhood at night (was catcalled 3+ times in a 7 minute time frame and briefly followed by someone) though I know this is not the hosts fault. (This does not impact my overall rating of the airbnb, it’s just something for girls especially to be mindful of when booking!)
place was very clean & comforting

If you’re used to staying in hostel type rooms, this place will feel like home.
Budget friendly and good location.
Another great stay at Matthew’s place. We love the location and easy check in. Thank you!
Bel's home was a very comfortable stay for a weekend getaway. Quiet neighborhood with plenty of bars and restaurants a very short walk away. Great communication and very clean.

Logan Square is a great neighborhood and this is right in the middle of it. Very clean and comfortable Carly was helpful and friendly so we felt right at home the whole time. Could not ask for more walking distance to great restaurants and public transportation would definitely stay there again.
Super clean and plenty of space

Hosts were very friendly and responsive, so I really wanted to love the place. However, it was disappointing. The use of “Luxury” in the title was very misleading. Multiple spots on the floor are sinking, the window in the bathroom is missing a piece that was covered with cardboard and duct tape, meaning you can hear everything outside. Living room pillows were stained and some of the furniture is run-down. Only a thin door separates your unit from the one next door, so there’s almost no sound barrier. Expect to hear your neighbors as if they were inside your space. While this is not the hosts’ fault, the neighbors blasted music all night until at least 4 am and we could hear their screaming and partying. Then, on Sunday morning, there was loud music playing again by 8 am. If you want to get some rest, I really don’t recommend it. The neighborhood was okay but I wouldn’t walk to the train station alone at night. Definitely expensive for what we got.
Paula and Adrian’s home was lovely. It was spotless, very comfortable and nicely decorated. There is a full kitchen with everything you need to cook. Great back patio that was nice for relaxing.

4 couples down for a baseball weekend.   What a great spot, only steps from Wrigley and the bar/restaurants.  Unit had more than enough room and the beds/pillows were comfortable.  Our hosts were quick to respond to any questions and even granted us early check in, as we arrived earlier than anticipated.  Quiet location but only steps to change that up and enjoy the sites and sounds of Wrigley.  Great spot, will book again
Great place to stay,  close to public transport, easy to check in and out

Great location and great home
Really enjoyed our stay and so did the kids. Really liked how close it was to the L. Would recommend and stay here again.
Wish it was better communicated in description that the space is shared with up to 4 other units of people.
Very good place in a quiet neighborhood away from the crazy downtown madness
Beautiful place for a family time

Marilyn was so hospitable , I’m happy we were able to score this place! We got in super early on our flight & she accommodated an early check in which was amazing. Everything was as described, felt safe, everything clean, only caveat is if you’re sensitive to smell! Sheets & towels had the “fresh linen” smell, if you’re sensitive to smell it might be a little strong. Overall we were very happy here & would come back if we ever visit Chicago again!

The location is excellent, and space has a lot of potential, but such a shame that the place was very dirty, and had a lot of deferred maintenance items that are very simple and inexpensive to fix. Holes in drywall, stains, loose toilet seat.
On top of all this, I felt misled (lied to actually) regarding the smoke / CO2 detector. The listing claimed that the unit had one. Upon checking-in, I checked extensively all over the place for a smoke / CO2 detector, and the unit did not have one. The space is very small, and there was no sign that a detector had ever been installed in place. No holes in the ceiling or walls where one might have been, no empty faceplate, etc. When I notified the host about this, he stated the previous guest must have stolen it. Really?!? Who steals a smoke detector? With very high ceilings, you would need a ladder to reach. The host did respond quickly and had a new detector installed, but I would bet $100 the unit never had one until I called them out on it.

It was a very good place to stay that had plenty of room for all 15 of us that stayed. Very clean and easy access to the train station. He was very friendly and responsive. We had a smoke detector beeping and he came over after work and replaced the battery. Would definitely stay again

Martin has the place all set up and ready for an excellent visit to Chicago!
The towels and linens provided are clean and fresh smelling.
A very communicative and responsive host as well.
The pad was beyond my imagination, even if you're not a fan of industrial music, the ambiance cannot be ignored. There is memorabilia from every era of Martin's work, and every fixture and detail was touched by his talent. He's got a vinyl collection to die for sitting out for your entertainment, as well as a CD player built by a mad genius.
The kitchen is clean and well appointed, ready for you to cook, make coffee or tea, drinks, etc.
Plenty of room for you and your friends, as well as a few treats for those who know who their host is.
Industrial Music fans, if you book anywhere else, you're wrong.
12 out of 10, will stay again.

Kathleen was a perfect host! Very fast with responses to my random questions. She gave fabulous directions and advice for getting around the area. Her place was *perfect* for our concert at the United Event Center. We walked and it was a breeze. It was also really easy to get to the tourist-y things downtown. Grateful to her for providing just what we needed!
Great distance from the convention center! Super helpful and responsive!

If Lyla’s place is available for you to stay during your visit to Chicago, book it ASAP! Lyla is an amazing host who was super responsive, and the location is central to everything without feeling like you’re in the bustling vibes of the city. Great restaurants and cafes near by!
Great location, clean, more than enough space for my family of four, lots of amenities, secure,  and quiet.  Great place and would go back.
Muy limpio todo
Victor’s house was an amazing stay! Great hospitality!

Very cute neighborhood! This home was in the perfect spot for us! Not too close to downtown but also not too far. The host was amazing, very friendly, helpful, gave us great recommendations! They messaged me back in a very timely manner and if I ever had a problem, they had no issues adjusting or fixing it :) 10/10 would go again !

Absolutely one of the very best rental experiences we have had over the last 20 years! The home is wonderful...we used it for a large family gathering. It has everything you need and Alexandra is a superb host. The location is perfect for absorbing all that the geat city of Chicago has to offer. You will love this place!

This place is definitely unique. Michael, the host, was very responsive. The pictures do not really show how these bedrooms work. I asked for a video walkthrough or a better description of the rooms and Michael provided me a mostly helpful listing of the beds. I recommend doing that too. Although I do recommend to Michael providing a video walkthrough as well.
As for the property, the garage door opener didn’t work, so you have to go around and close the garage and then walk around. We were able to fit 2 suvs in there with some extra room.
The bedrooms are interesting. This house has about 10 exterior doors and then the interior doors are also exterior looking doors. Some bedrooms require you to go through other bedrooms to reach. You also have to go through bedrooms to get to the backyard/garage.
As for bathrooms, if you like gym showers, you will be happy here. Several showers look like that. There is only 1 “normal” shower. That was definitely a disappointment.
Thank you for an easy, great stay!

100000/10!! Host was over the top accommodating and truly went above and beyond to make this trip a great experience. Very responsive. Location was perfect and walking distance to so many things. Highly recommend❣️
We were in town for a volleyball tournament. Perfect distance to downtown, cute neighborhood with great food options. We will stay again next year!

We had a group of 5 college girls staying for a dance intensive. Overall it was a nice place for us stay. The street is nice and quiet and it was an easy walk to the 36 stop which we used most of the time. We felt very safe staying here. The space was clean and organized, and it was really helpful having the washer and dryer inside. Our only negative was that the water leaked out of the shower onto the bathroom floor and by the end of the week the drain in the shower got clogged. But other than that we had a very nice stay.

En la madrugada nos tocó ruido ya que la madera del piso de arriba rechinaba cuando caminaban y el tema de la limpieza ya que encontramos polvo y pelito del perrito y debajo de la cama sucio, de ahí en fuera todo bien

Justin's place was clean and matched the photos. Everything inside was updated and very nice. The neighborhood is close to public transit so easy to get downtown. The hosts were responsive and everything was well explained.

Was in town for cubs game...short ride to wrigley so location was great! Quiet neighborhood! Karl our host was quick to reply or respond. We had the chance to meet him as well. Very nice and personable. We enjoyed our stay and would stay there again in the future!
Go Cubs!

My boyfriend and I stayed for a few days and this place was perfect. Getting garage access was so convenient. The place was just like the pictures in terms of cleanliness and amenities. The closets had great space and the bed was super comfortable for both of us. We felt safe and it was quiet at night. Such a great stay as a chicago native!

POORLY MANAGED — CIGARETTE SMOKE SMELL, UNCLEAN TOWELS, EMPTY SUPPLIES
We stayed at this 1-bedroom property during our Chicago trip. I am giving the property 2 stars, and 3 stars overall only because of the location.
As soon as we walked in, the unit smelled like cigarette smoke. We messaged the host, but the issue was brushed off and not taken seriously. There was only one set of towels, and they were damp and did not appear clean. The host did not seem aware that no clean extra towels were available.
The bathroom shampoo/body wash dispensers were empty, and we were told to find supplies and refill them ourselves. There was no bathroom exhaust, and due to the septic system, toilet paper cannot be flushed, but the trash can had no liner.
This place was a disaster from a management and cleanliness standpoint. I would not recommend it for families or couples.
Unit was just as described.  Fully stocked kitchen.  Friendly host & easy check in & check out.
Very nice Air BnB, spacious and clean. Close to a lot of bars and restaurants. Easy to get around and not too far from downtown Chicago and train station.
Perfect Airbnb for a Chicago weekend
We had a great trip with friends.  The location was great and the space was perfect.

Great spot outside of the city! With traffic, it took us around 30 mins to uber into the city but great for a large bachelorette group! The host was super responsive when we had issues, which we so appreciated! With so many bedrooms and beds, this was a great spot for 8 girls! The one shower wasn’t too big of a deal with some communication with our group. House was very clean, specifically the floors! Pretty well stocked kitchen - would just recommend adding measuring cups and baking sheets. There are portal AC units upstairs and they kept the rooms CRISPY COLD which was amazing! Would definitely recommend this spot for a large group or bachelorette!!
Great location. Place was as advertised. Loved the coffee bar.
Conveniently located and clean! Nearby desired location. Also very secure and safe.
I had a great stay for my birthday weekend!
Great location if you have tickets to Rosemont theater. The Airbnb had everything you could need and more. It was super clean. Had a flawless stay.

We had a great stay at Milan’s! I think this property is more suitable for six guests, as the couch in the living room doesn’t stay together very great and there’s no blackout curtains in the living room, making it difficult to sleep past sunrise. Milan was amazing with communication and anything we needed was very prompt getting to us. The location was good. As an Airbnb host myself I wish there was just a little more decor, kitchen supplies, and more pillows on the beds to make the stay a little more cozy/comfortable. Reggie’s Trainwreck Rooftop Bar was a 3 min walk and we were there at least once a day!
Overall we had a great stay and had fun in Chicago!
Thank you Milan!
Great location close to red line. Apt was clean and just like the pictures and description.
Kimberly was so helpful and provided a generous space for my week in Chicago!

Great garden apartment. Beautiful yard to enjoy. Location was great! Quiet street right around the corner from lots of restaurants, bars, coffee shops. Everything you want to checkout in Logan Square is within a 15-20 min walk.

If you plan on staying at this Hotel know that a standard room is in a separate building which looks pretty run down. My view was an alley full of dumpsters. Not sure how the main building looks like but you can only stay there if you get a suite. Which is what I requested based on the pictures. When I asked the front desk they said that those rooms were full and all there was was what I got. The only other thing I was offered was to find another hotel. Good thing was the room was cleaned, had nice beds and the AC worked great.

Place was very private and peaceful, with easy access to public transit and felt super safe to walk around, day or night. Felt like a hotel, as they were out most of the time (as were we!) so it did not feel awkward or like we were intruding at all. Hosts were super friendly and welcoming. The doggies were so well behaved!! Definitely recommend for your Chicago trip, especially if you are more of a chill traveler and like having the option of sleeping in and relaxing :)
As described. Great place for the weekend
great host!

This is my second time staying at one of Milan’s properties. They are very professional and responsive, and the property is easily accessible by public transportation to most Chicago attractions. The option for parking is also very convenient. We’ll plan to stay again.
Beautiful condo in the West Loop walkable to restaurants and rail transit.  The neighborhood seemed very safe.  The amenities were above and beyond.

The place was as the pictures showed and descriptions provided. It was a good location/base while in town for a concert. It was clean, comfortable and spacious. The kitchen was well stocked with everything you need to make a meal. No complaints. Would certainly recommend to others and to stay if in the area again.
Great location and loved the deck. The place was clean and well appointed but it’s a pretty noisy spot and the bed wasn’t very comfortable
Thank you for hosting and it was great to meet you! Definitely booking again on my next visit to Chicago!

We absolutely loved our stay! The apartment was spacious, comfortable, and even more beautiful in person than the photos show. The back patio was one of our favorite features, a perfect spot to relax and unwind after a day of exploring the city.
The location was convenient, with just a short ride to downtown Chicago for shopping, dining, and sightseeing. Samoane and Cindy were wonderful hosts. Samoane was quick to respond to messages, and we happened to meet Cindy when checking in. As out-of-towners, we especially appreciated her patience and helpfulness about parking and other questions.
We highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Chicago. If our travels bring us back to the area, we would gladly stay here again!

Don’t stay here if you suffer from seizures! Almost all the light fixtures flicker consistently. It was bothersome at first but I guess I got used to it and stopped noticing but I’d be very concerned for anyone with that kind of light sensitivity. There were also tons of past(?) water damage stains on the ceilings around the lights (which I guess is why they flicker?). But overall it was a good stay. Everything else was clean and we really enjoyed the games available in the home. 9 minute walk to the train station and plenty of local food spots to walk to if you’re hungry. It’s in a mostly Hispanic area which I love, got lots of good food and paletas from the neighborhood which was awesome. I’d def stay here again if they fixed the lights and the ceiling stains

The location and apartment were mostly as described. The host didn't communicate with us with the exception of automated messages at check-in and check-out. The day of our check-in I messaged to notify host about stains and issues with the apartment I wanted to make sure she was aware of, that we observed upon entry, and until today I haven't heard back. There were stains in all the fabric surfaces and broken furniture. We booked the place for us and our 4 year old and there was only a full bed, although the place advertises it accommodating up to 4 people. Kitchen didn't have items expected for a stay for three people either (ie: cutlery for only one person). Overall it was an ok stay - place is safe, neighbors are super friendly and it's well located, but the apartment wasn't great. If you need a place that won't break the budget and is well located it could be an option!
We had a great stay! The host was accommodative of our requests.
We really loved our stay here- the neighborhood felt safe, and there were plenty of places to walk to and enjoy. Leigh-Anne was very thorough and helpful. We'd absolutely stay here again.
Enjoyed this property, easy access, great private balconies, safe area (across the street from police academy too), walk to coffee, owner super responsive.

We stayed here for 3 nights while on a couples trip. The 4 of us felt completely comfortable, safe, and relaxed in the apartment. The floors are a bit creaky so we were worried of disturbing the downstairs neighbors but we didn’t hear any complaints or have any issues. The space is beautiful, spacious, and well kept. Tara was so kind & has an entire site dedicated to the apartment, surrounding area, and beyond that was such a nice touch. Highly recommend & extremely well priced!
We had a great time at this place! Would definitely book again if we come back.
Very responsive and we enjoyed the back outdoor space!

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I feel it’s important to share our experience.
Warning: We found a notice stating this unit was an unauthorized (subleased) Airbnb, and a neighbor told us the same. This made us very uncomfortable, and I would not recommend staying here.
Warning: We found what appeared to be bird mites inside the house around all of the windows. There were many (100+)of these small insects crawling around. We also found a slab of wood that appeared to be covering damaged brick near where the insects were concentrated, which made us wonder whether it was a temporary cover for holes in the wall. We left as soon as we discovered the insects because the issue was not resolved quickly enough, and we did not want to sleep in a room with insects crawling around.
Cons: The host sent us a strange message asking us not to talk to the neighbors. We later suspected this was because the airbnb is unauthorized and the host does not want them to find out.
Pros: good location
A great stay! Great location, very clean, easy to communicate with the host!
Great stay, great host!

That place is exactly as described! Our family felt safe and comfortable, the apartment is very secured and the neighborhood isn’t as bad as some reviews say. Great communication- would come back again!!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb! The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The bed was super comfy, and the space felt cozy and relaxing. The host was friendly and responsive, which made everything easy. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a nice and comfortable place to stay.
Great stay! We were close enough to everything we wanted to do so it was a great home base to come back to everyday.
Great location close to Lake Shore Drive. Very quiet and pretty neighborhood, lots of available street parking. Super cute apartment and nice kitchen set-up. Emily is also very responsive!

We had a fantastic stay! The Airbnb had absolutely everything we needed and more. It was spotless, comfortable, and thoughtfully stocked, making us feel right at home. The location was great! Everything was exactly as described, and we couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay while visiting Chicago. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great Airbnb!
Great place! Super responsive host and easy to follow instructions.
Had an amazing stay would recommend to anybody!
Great location and very comfortable apartment.  I definitely would stay here again.
Absolutely awesome place to stay, right across from the CTA bus and the parking was right outside!

Tuvimos un inconveniente ya que nos consumieron productos del refrigerador y el anfitrión nos culpó por no haber puesto etiqueta en nuestras bolsas que estaban cerradas. Estamos de viaje y no podemos estar llevando etiquetas, sería bueno que el anfitrión las brinde o pueda separar el refrigerador con el número de cada departamento. No se hizo cargo y nos culpo a nosotros. Además se metió en la vida privada de un invitado que no tiene nada que ver con esta situación. Nos iba a realizar un reembolso y nunca lo hizo. El horno tampoco andaba, le preguntamos cómo encenderlo y nos dijo que le preguntes a la IA. Una lástima la comunicación, muy prepotente y desconsiderado.

Our stay with Ray and Kay in their basement apartment was exactly what we needed. The space is clean and comfortable and has basic amenities. Location is great, very close to the train in a very pretty and safe neighborhood. Hope to stay with them again!
The location was super convenient, walkable distance to everything & nice staff. Of note, the place is not exactly as pictured. It looks better in photos.
Robin was a great host and the home was beautiful and exactly as described.

Martha was an amazing host and great to deal with. The space is on the smaller side, but worked perfectly for our weekend trip. Just a short walk to the pink line, so getting downtown was a breeze! Overall very pleased with our stay!
This is our second time staying at Brads place! It’s always clean and he is very responsive to all our questions! Love staying there due to the area and everything is walkable. Recommended 100%

Comfortable stay for weekend in Chicago! Convenient location near train stop to get from the airport and many spots around the city. Place was clean. Cool design. Had all that we needed. Host is very responsive and helpful.
Great location - close to downtown. Fun neighborhood and cozy apartment. It worked great for what we needed, and the host was incredibly responsive and kind.

Great communication and flexibility. It was easy.
The home is 80+ years old, so go in eyes wide open. If you want sleek, modern, and new, this probably isn't for you. But if you want a home with character and easy access to the L, this is a good fit.
Wonderful was very responsive. The property was great.
Great location, close to the red line, and easy access to bars and restaurants in the west loop.
Fernando was super helpful!  Answered all out questions, was able to get us in earlier than expected and answered all of our questions quickly!!!!

We came in town from Oklahoma for a volleyball tournament. We had 3 teenagers with us.
Place was super clean and we had a great time!

Great place to stay, has the basics but not what i expected. Description didn’t say it was a downstairs studio connected to the main house so you could hear everything and the check in was difficult because there were so many doors we didn’t know which was ours to open. Got super cold especially since we couldn’t control the ac or heating and the blanket was super thin and not enough. Microwave was dirty, no trash bags. Good place for the price.

Enjoyed my stay! Milan was a great host and her responsive with any questions I had. I appreciated the ability to check in early too! The location is in a desirable area and walkable to restaurants and event venues.

The loft was super comfortable and clean! Light, airy, and spacious. The neighborhood was cute, there’s a great farmers market on Saturdays. I was surprised that the sun rises before 5am in June! Light blocking curtains would have been nice. Otherwise no complaints for the charming place.
The home was beautiful, spacious, and had all listed amenities in good condition. Hosts were very responsive and helpful before, during, and after stay. Would recommend booking this location!

Pros- great location in wicker park, right next to the train, very comfortable beds and dark bedrooms, and the host allowed early check in. The bedrooms, kitchen, and bathroom were very clean. Good place to stay if you are just looking for somewhere to sleep.
Con- while the listing mentions that it’s a one flight walk up, I think it can be more clear that these difficult to navigate for older people or with luggage. They are industrial older stairs where you need to hold onto the railing.
The listing is misleading as to the couch and living room situation. There is not a sectional with a pull out couch, which is one of the reasons we booked this place for our group of 5. There is a 3 person leather couch in the living area with a dining table/ metal chairs and then a very lumpy futon in a non AC indoor patio. This was the most disappointing part of the Airbnb as we booked this place expecting more seating and sleeping arrangements.

Llegamos al Airbnb y pudimos rápidamente hacer el chekin Es un depto pequeño pero muy bien iluminado muy seguro y lo mejor es la ubicación ya que estás en el corazón de Chicago a puedes recorrer todo caminando Recomiendo este Airbnb por el excelente anfitrión ,la limpieza y la ubicación . Muy recomendable
Great place with everything we needed. Close to everything we wanted to visit.

This Airbnb was great for our two families. Wonderful to have a lovely kitchen with a full-size fridge, dishwasher, sink, and all the kitchen supplies you would expect. Having access to a washer and dryer was also fantastic. The Airbnb had lots of fun things for the kids to play with and they also had a pack-and-play we could use, all of which was great!
Location was absolutely fantastic. Short walk to the Western Brown Line stop which you can take to connect to almost any other part of the city. Lincoln Square is very close and has lots of neat shops and restaurants. Neighborhood is nice and relatively quiet.
We all thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and would recommend this to any families or groups looking for a comfortable home base.
This is a very nice place in a great location. Alex is very responsive and helpful.  We would definitely stay here again!

Wow! What a great place to stay. Quintessential Chicago apartment (post great fire) that highlights the history of town.  Great area, right near the train made it super convenient to get everywhere in town and walkable to the beach. I brought our two kids and the layout of the space was perfect for them. I appreciate that it’s obviously someone’s home and felt loving and warm! Thank you Christi!
Dominique was an amazing host! Super communicative, flexible, and responsive. Her place is at a great location as well. Definitely would book again!
Adam was very responsive and the place was exactly as advertised
Daniel was a great host and his place was a nice stay. I would definitely stay again if I visited Chicago

John’s apartment was perfect for us. We were located near Chinatown so it was the perfect distance for a lot of the activities we attended. It was also very spacious, clean  and fully equipped with everything we needed. The parking space was a little tight so be careful with getting in and out but other than that I would absolutely stay here again on my next visit.
This place is very nice and with an easy walk to take the blue line train.

Our stay was really nice. The place was clean and as described in photos. Only issue we ran into was that the laundry dryer was not working properly during our stay and we had to follow up multiple times to get it fixed. Also, there were many pans and utensils to cook and no containers or ziploc bags which would be helpful to carry food. Just a recommendation nothing of concern!
Extremely nice apartment and great location. Perfect Airbnb.

I recently moved to the suburbs but had an event in Bridgeport with late nights and early mornings. I decided to stay at Jose's place because it was affordable, and I could have a private room without bothering my friends. The common area was as advertised with a pool table and darts. The rooms had air conditioners and fans, so I was comfortable. The sheets were cozy. If you're one person traveling on your own, it's worth it!
Great thank you
As advertised and overall comfortable and clean!

I booked this townhouse for a Girls Trip weekend. There was 8 of us and we had so much space and slept comfortably. The area is great for walking to local restaurants. It was quiet and a beautiful street. Parking was horrible considering we used the garage and still have 3 others who drove and found spots close to the house.
loved the space. very spacious and inviting. great experience with shovany!! would def re book when coming back to chicago!
Great place to stay for a few days when visiting family in Andersonville.

I could not have asked for a better host. Tammy made me feel like part of her family. She was very welcoming and kind. She helped me figure out some transportation and parking questions and was interested in why I was in Chicago. I appreciated her knowledge, kindness, and responsiveness.

Great Stay in Chicago!
We had a fantastic visit and really enjoyed our time at this property. The location is fantastic. it's very walkable to everything we wanted to do in and around Lincoln Park.
The unit itself was clean, well-appointed, and fully equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The bed was excellent, and despite being in a busy area, the space felt relatively quiet and served as a great home base to relax and rest after busy days out.
Overall, it was a very comfortable experience, and we would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!
great and lovely place. The broken elevator is a little bit pity for me because I have some luggages
stay was okay , pretty loud during the hours of the day, so If you want to sleep in , book elsewhere , otherwise stay was clean and nice

Amy was the best!!! Clean house and clear instructions! She was super responsive and truly helped a lot with our trip! Place was not hard to find at all and in a super peaceful neighborhood! I will definitely be booking with Amy again!
We had a wonderful stay! Hanna and Mark were very responsive and great about checking in. The loft was very clean and the beds were very comfortable! We would definitely stay here again!
We really enjoyed our stay here! It was a perfect set up for our family. The home was beautifully decorated and our hosts were very helpful and responsive. We would definitely recommend staying here!

Unfortunately, I am forced to put a negative review because, upon our arrival, the code to open the door that was communicated to us was incorrect and Roseanna did not contact us until the following morning, forcing us to book a hotel in the city for the same evening at a crazy price. I recommend accommodation as a position, but I also recommend double checking the code, which is communicated via a message to avoid unexpected events.

Great spot in a great neighborhood. Will's place was awesome! Matched the pictures and description exactly. The garage and parking was a great added amenity. Was able to fit my Ford Escape easily. Will also let us store bags in the garage before/after the official check-in and out times which was great as travel arrangements don't always align perfectly. Highly recommend, perfect for medium - large groups. Thank you Will!
Quaint little spot to stay in Chicago. Budget friendly, clean and easy access to transit. Everything you need for a quick trip to Chicago!

Property was comfortable, clean, and convenient. Great amenities and location in good neighborhood with shopping and excellent restaurants. Easy checkin, clear instructions, very responsive host, and great communication. We felt right at home and had everything we needed. Thank you for hosting us!  Highly recommend and look forward to staying again when we travel to Chicago in the future.

Margret’s place was perfect for our weekend family stay! Everything was so clean and uncluttered. Exceptionally comfortable beds and linens and plentiful towels were so appreciated. The outdoor space was also nice and quaint. You will not regret a stay here at Svaha in this peaceful, walkable neighborhood!
Wonderful, clean, spacious apartment.  Great walkable area.  Restaurants nearby and close walk to the 606 and Blue line.
The location is perfectly safe, and the apartment is super cool. Was worried traveling as a solo female but Derek was more than helpful and a great host.
Kristina was a great host! Location was a bit further from downtown than promoted, and the bathroom door did not close. Other than those small grievances, I enjoyed my stay!
Very nice place and home was as described
The place was perfect for a large group! Great setup and very nice/clean. Jared was very responsive and made everything with checkin/checkout very easy. Would definitely recommend!
We enjoyed our stay in this quiet, conveniently located neighborhood. The home was very comfortable, offering everything we needed and more!
Great place. Close to downtown. Perfect if you want to explore the city using public transportation.
Perfect for if you’re trying to find a cheap spot next to Wrigley. It’s nothing fancy but it does the job!

Beautiful, cozy place. It was a great spot to base ourselves from while visiting family in Chicago. We loved the neighborhood, walkable and delicious recommendations from our hosts. Well-appointed home, we loved sitting in the living room with the old windows and happy house plants. Thanks for the lovely stay!
Ruth’s place is the best super accessible to public transportation and not too far away from where we needed to be during our stay.

Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made the check-in process easy. I had a wonderful experience and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to others. Thank you for a great stay!

The place was spacious and clean, although it’s an older apartment which was noticeable. The only glaring deficiency was the mold around the bathtub. There was also a burned out light bulb in the bathroom mirror that required a change.

I had a great stay. The place was cute, clean, and felt very safe throughout my visit. The location was excellent and convenient to everything I needed. The host provided all the essentials, and the space had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. I would happily stay here again and recommend it to others.
The stay was exactly as advertised. Milan was very good about sending very clear instructions and checking in to make sure we had everything we needed for a pleasant stay.

It is a nice apartment with great views. Fortunately it wasn’t very hot while we were there because the rooms got very warm with their Eastern exposure. Without black out curtains, the rooms were bright at 5:30 am.  A few more amenities would have been appreciated, such as hooks in the bathrooms, a grab bar to get in the very deep bathtub, tissues, some tea bags and a little sugar.

David’s place was cozy, stylish, and welcoming. Everything was as described and looked just like the pictures in the listing. Though a bit pricey, it’s clean, in a great location, and fully stocked with coffee, sodas, tea, oatmeal, and smarties (which happen to be one of my favs). I would definitely recommend this place to others and would stay here again. It’s apparent that David and the Trove team truly care about providing a great experience for their guests. What a great stay for my first time visiting Chicago!
We had an amazing stay here I will definitely have to book here again when I go. You could walk around at night and feel safe and the place was just beautiful and felt peaceful

This place is great value! Walkable to public transportation, nice park nearby, and grocery stores. Easy to get to the city via bus or train. Neighborhood is incredibly safe, even at night. Would stay again!

There weren't enough spoons in the apartment for the 5 of us, and the other cutlery wasn't the same type. The entrance to the apartment is not presentable. There is no curtain on one side window in the living room. So a passerby can see what's going on in the apartment (and the apartment is on the ground floor). There is one door in the apartment that is locked and it's not known where it leads. The location of the apartment is ok because it's not far from the center. There are shops nearby.
loved this place and it being 420 friendly. clear instructions and responsive host in a very peaceful neighborhood, would definitely book again!
Awesome experience. Would do again for a cubs game. Thank you to the host for sharing clear instructions.

Wonderful host, great neighborhood with a tons to do within walking distance,  and the pictures do not do it justice!! This absolutely exceeded our expectations and was a lot bigger than expected! Jeff had fruit, flowers, and cookies when we arrived, which was so thoughtful and unexpected.  He was such a courteous and helpful host anytime we had questions. He went above and beyond when we arrived in town early! We could not have asked for a better location to explore Chicago!
We spent 3 days in Chicago for my sons 21st Birthday; Florin’s place held 7 of us comfortably each with our own space. Easy to walk to most activities.

Overall the place is good and a great location. There were many gnats or fruit flies in the bathroom and all over the shower. Kept the door closed so they wouldn’t come out into the main area. Beyond that the place was ok.
Very communicative and a great host! Would recommend to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in Chicago.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay. The loft is very comfortable for 2 people, everything is exactly as described in the listing. The check in was smooth, and the house is easily accessible by the trains and is a short walk from the station. Kaitlyn was very accommodating and helpful. If we made another trip to Chicago, we’d come back here for sure.

Very nice stay. Busy Neighborhood, lots to see, really.good restaurants. clean and comfortable. I had trouble balancing on the top stair while turning around to attach the bungee cord on the gate because im short but my adult child was able to get it no problem. Splurged on Ubers instead of the bus all weekend, always available within 5 min. downtown is a very short Uber ride away even in traffic. I accidentally broke a lamp shade in the unit and the host was very nice in response.
Very nice and responsive host. It’s also really close to a train station that connects to downtown.
The location is good

Really enjoyed  staying at Cozy Coach. Both Bern and Anthony were very friendly and they even invited us to their community party. Thanks so much for your hospitality. Greatly appreciated. The house was just suited for our family.

10/10 would recommend. David was a great host. Super helpful and responsive. All of his instructions were clear and he went above and beyond with recommendations.
The place was exactly as described and had even more amenities than I expected.
I've always loved the Fulton Market neighborhood, so I was really excited to stay there. 30 second walk to the train made it super easy to get around. Plenty of REALLY good restaurants and coffee shops within a couple of blocks.
Super pleased with the whole experience. Just book it already! 😉
Honestly it was a great stay! A bit smaller than what I had thought, but it was perfect for what we needed. Everything was what you would want/expect out of a stay, and the price alone was worth it!

Overall David’s place was a good place to stay. Walkable to the L and also nearby a CTA bus line that would transport you there. Easily walkable to Ukrainian Village and restaurants in West Town. The place was a little loud but not horrible for being inside the city. Unfortunately the internet was down during our stay but we made use of the board games and card games that the host provided. Bathrooms were great, very clean, appliances were also fantastic in the home. The guest membership to the Metropolitan was awesome, highly recommend to check it out if you book here!
Comfortable place for 6 adults, no couples. Easily walkable to lots of places.
Very clean, great parking instructions, very friendly host with clear communication. Easy check out as well! Felt extremely safe and good neighborhood!
Perfect
Such a beautiful place to stay at! The place is perfect for 2 people, the area is gorgeous, so many stores and places to eat at that are near. Parking was very easy to find!
Stay was great, host was very responsive, and home was very comfortable. Location was perfect
Great neighborhood. The place was very clean. Good amenities.

I had a great stay at Sezgin’s! He and cohosts were responsive to my questions. Between the high ceilings and upgraded fixtures/decor, the bedroom and bathroom exceeded expectations! The home is close to the CTA train & bus, walkable to nearby shops, and safe. I would recommend to any solo travelers like myself!
Great stay! close to the blue line and about halfway between the airport and downtown.
Stay was good
Rida is very helpful and responsive. I really appreciated her instructions for check in and checkout. Also, the bed, pillows, and linens were very comfortable. Thank you for the lovely accommodation.
A great place to relax after spending the day exploring the city. Getting to the transit line was easy and close. The host checked on us frequently to make sure we had everything we needed.

This is a shared apartment with two other rooms. You share the bathroom, kitchen and living room with 2-4 other people. It is in a really beautiful neighbourhood, with great cafés and bars, and easy access to O'Hare and downtown via the L Train (Blue Line) as well. It is kept very clean and the kitchen is well equipped. Benjamin is very responsive and answered questions immediately, including late in the evening. All of the other guests were nice and kept to themselves during our stay.
The room is ok. The bed is big and comfortable. But the door curtain only partially covers the smoked glass panels, so it doesn't feel very private. The desk has an electric riser and a computer monitor, but they are only for show as there are no power sockets at that side of the room. The towels provided were ok but old.
We had to buy detergent and toilet paper during our stay as the provided ones ran out.
If you know what to expect then this is a good place to stay, in a 10/10 location

This was a solid budget-friendly option in a great location, especially for walking to the nearby hospitals and restaurants. Overall, the stay met my needs. My only concern was the cleanliness. I understand that some mess is unavoidable in a shared space, but the bathroom could have used more attention, as there was mold in the shower and on the shower liner, although the liner was replaced a few days before I left. The kitchen also could have been cleaned more regularly. With more attention to cleaning, this would be a phenomenal option for the price and location.
Perfect spot and set up perfectly for any Cubs fine to enjoy Chicago and Wrigleyville to it's fullest potential.  Prudence was always quickly responsive and helpful!
Nice property and nice people. Would definitely come back!

Fantastic little apartment in one of the best neighborhoods in Chicago. Everything was new and clean, very comfortable beds. The hosts had set up everything very thoughtfully to the last detail, there was a disposable hairbrush, toothpaste., etc. Communication was fast and easy. The place was very clean and comfortable and we loved our stay, highly recommend!
Enjoyed a great stay! Unit was clean and cozy. Great location walkable to many things. Host was extremely responsive. Highly recommend!

We had a great stay and would highly recommend this apartment. It is exactly as described, full of charm with high ceilings and lots of character. The location is excellent, in the lovely Lincoln Square neighborhood, just a short walk from the Damen train station (brown line) and perfect for exploring Chicago.
The hosts were very responsive, helpful, and provided clear instructions. We also really appreciated their flexibility in allowing us to leave our luggage after check-out because of our late flight.
A wonderful Airbnb experience!

Location is walkable, transit is convenient, and there are many restaurant options around the Airbnb. The room was comfortable, and I really liked the bed. The mattress border was firmer, while the middle was soft. I slept great. You are located right next to the rails, so you will hear the train come by and the occasional horn. You can hear the neighbors upstairs when opening and closing the doors or walking. Would recommend earplugs and an eye mask if you are a light sleeper.
Note that the room is separate from the bathroom. When going in and out, you can see outside via the entrance glass door, and vice versa. I did startle myself a few times from the reflections at night. Haha.
Overall, I was provided with everything I needed for my stay. Mosmi can take a bit of time to respond, but was nice, very communicative, and proactive.
Quiet neighborhood close to shops and restaurants,  perfect location if Cubs games are a part of your travel plans. We would definitely stay here again! Thanks so much!!

Came for a concert at Soldier Field. Home was in a great location. Easily walkable to great restaurants & coffee shops!  Easy walk from Soldier Field !Very responsive host and provided great check-in/check-out instructions.
This is an amazing location for taking the family to a Cubs game! It was less than a 10 minute walk to Wrigley through a cute neighborhood. There were also tons of restaurants in the area
Budget friendly accommodation in a decent part of town. We walked to the riverwalk and Navy Pier. Ensavi was great to work with
Perfectly comfortable apartment with easy access to lake front and university. Highly recommended.
Property was great and as promised.  Super Clean and was in a perfect location in the heart of Old Town.

The host was great and quick to respond to any of our questions. House was clean and also kid friendly. Easy access to public transportation. Appreciated the vending machines (there's one for coffee too!) downstairs and the proximity to small supermarket, eateries and cafes.

Beautiful new build in an older neighborhood about 20 minutes by car from downtown Chicago. Comfortable and spacious apartment with basic amenities. Hosts were communicative and it was a good space for our group.
It was an excellent place, clean and well located; in my case I had to work in several times and had not never problem to did it. I appreciated to much stayed here, definitly I recommended.

Overall, we enjoyed our stay here! It's close to public transit which made it really easy and convenient to get to places.
There's a Potash grocery store across the street, which was very convenient. I also highly recommend the Goddess and the Grocer at the corner, which had small pre-packaged dinners and salads as well as great coffee and sandwiches!

As noted in the listing, the city noises can be loud at night so if you are a light sleeper definitely be aware that you should bring ear plugs or a travel sound machine. The small portable fans provided in the bedrooms are also great white noise.
We would stay here again purely for the location and proximity! Can't wait to come back to Chicago!
Ping was very responsive, helpful and accommodating for my stay. I would highly recommend anyone who needs a quick stay in Chicago.
The apartment was spacious and comfortable.  Communicating with Joan was very easy and timely.  Our overall experience was excellent.
Super comfortable place to stay with my son. We didn’t explore the area much but the home was perfect. Thank you!
Josh was fantastic!!! Getting in and out was a breeze and the unit was surprisingly quiet considering the location…we all slept like babies. Would absolutely stay again!
We had a great time during our stay at Armando’s place
One of the best Air Bnbs we have stayed in and would definitely recommend to others!
Great stay! The home was cute, clean, and exactly as pictured. Would stay again.
Barbara’s place was great! Very clean, great location, peaceful neighborhood. She was super responsive and helpful with everything. Would definitely recommend!

L’appartamento si trova in una casa storica, in una zona molto tranquilla, facilmente raggiungibile con i mezzi pubblici. La stazione metro Sedgwick
dista 5 minuti a piedi. Nelle vicinanze anche un mini market dove si può comprare il necessario per la colazione.
In zona ci sono parecchi ristoranti.
