Abbiamo trascorso 5 giorni meravigliosi a Chicago.

We really enjoyed our two night stay in June 2026! The check-in was extremely easy and we immediately felt at home in the space. The neighborhood was well connected to businesses and other areas of Chicago, but was still very quaint and peaceful. We even spent one night in, just enjoying the board games they had in the living room and making dinner in the well stocked kitchen. We enjoyed one of our breakfasts on the terrace and then the other at the famous Michelin bakery Kasama, which is just a block or two away. Everything was extremely well kept in the home and the hosts were very responsive, doing everything in their power to make the stay relaxing and fun. Would highly recommend :)

We enjoyed our stay at ryan’s place, we weren’t there very much as we were out exploring the city but the bed was comfortable and everything was clean. My only concern was the noise from the neighborhood, we had a hard time falling asleep as the neighbors were setting off fireworks until decently late. That is not ryan’s fault though, and if we came back into town we would stay again!

Place is not as expected. Inconvenient location for experiencing downtown Chicago. Lack of towels for overall nights staying and possibly cockroach infestation. On day two, we found a dying cockroach and decided to checkout immediately; however, was unable to receive a full refund for our stay. Though Kim was responsive to our situation, she was only able to accommodate for the remaining two nights of our stay and refused to refund the additional two nights we had stayed. In hindsight, we would have paid the additional hundred dollars or so for a comfortable and convenient hotel experience downtown.
The views are amazing, the location is great.  Everything was exactly as described, and I'd stay here again!  Highly recommend!
Excellent place on an excellent location. The parking spot is a great differential for those travelling with a vehicle. The host is very responsive and very helpful. Definitely recommend.

The space is in great conditions and in a wonderful location. It has everything you need to live comfortably for as long as you need. There are restaurants, stores, and a supermarket a few blocks away. Despite this, the neighborhood is peaceful and safe. We strongly recommend staying here!

we had to change apartments because the first one (the one in this review i think if they didn't change it) was dirty and in poor conditions, but they almost immediately move us to another apartment that marched the LUXURIOUS description. Great place for a large party, we had 7 sleep great for a weekend get away.
Nice location, lots of restaurants nearby. Easily walkable to venue
Excellent stay! Tim was a great host, the space is very convenient and comfortable. Hope to stay again!

Not sure about the neighborhood, felt a little sketchy. Living room is tiny with uncomfortable furniture. No place to congregate. 2 of the beds collapsed on us. Very cheap. Floors are completely filthy!!!! Our feet/socks were black after walking on this floor. Microwave door handle and one of the kitchen drawers is broke. Overall met our needs for a 2 night stay but wouldn't book again.

This city apartment was awesome! It was very clean and roomy enough for our family. The best part about it was the location! Song has been a great host for me and my family, we would stay here again for sure!
Great location! Thanks for hosting, super convenient.

Ming is a great host. She’s very attentive and friendly. She was super accommodating and the space was perfect for our stay. Very clean and spacious. Great location in Chicago. Would definitely choose to stay here again.

Rebecca was friendly, clear, and accessible in her communications. The place was very nice: clean, spacious, with a lovely sunroom. The other guests were quiet and personable. The location was convenient to my work and near an L station. In all, a very nice place to stay during my work trip. I recommend it.

The description of the house was accurate. The house is in a great location and felt like a quiet, safe neighborhood. Joanna reached out to make sure everything was okay and offered assistance with any questions. This will be the first place I look for if I make it back to Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay! The condo was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and everything we needed was provided. Check-in and communication were easy and seamless. We really appreciated the attention to detail and felt right at home during our stay. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to future guests!
숙소는 깨끗하고 조용하고 생각보다 넓어서 만족스러웠어요. 다만 위치가 The roop 으로 이동할때 버스를 타고 30분이상 가야하는점, 전철역을 버스타고 이동해야하는점이 아쉬웠어요. 교통편외에는 다 좋았어요.
Coty was really communicative and the location was great - Pilsen is a great community and very easy access to downtown Chicago.

Great stay! The room we had was towards the top of the building so it was nice and quiet. The views of the city from the room were also beautiful! I loved how close the train station was to the Airbnb - literally right down the block which made exploring the city so easy. There were so many restaurants within walking distance as well which made it easy to grab a bite on days we didn’t feel like going too far. The area itself also felt really safe. Overall, this is a great stay!

John was an excellent host! Communication was perfect and our stay was without incident. The place is cute. The neighborhood is amazing and vibrant! Clean and well kept

Elba was amazing! Very great and accommodating host. The place was also very pretty and clean.

Ishin's place was the perfect spot for our group. Easy access to downtown and to Wrigley. One note - not a problem for our group but it's a third floor walkup so just be aware. Place is clean and roomy and well-appointed! Thank you!

Great space! As others have said, the bunk beds are super squeaky, so just something to note if you are a noise sensitive sleeper, but we really enjoyed the place.

This is an extremely nice Airbnb, I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again when we are back in Chicago. There are many places to eat, conveniences, like Walgreens close by, and a short trip to get on the L or bus.

Great little studio for the price.  Two blocks from the train, and only one block from the beach. Great location!
We had a great stay. Leah was a great host and was very responsive to any questions we had. We would stay here again.

The location of this Airbnb is AMAZING for anybody looking to visit Wrigley Field. We were taking a quick weekend trip to Chicago for the game and it was literally right across the street! The Airbnb was very clean, everything was exactly like the photos and Josh was extremely responsive and helpful with any questions we had. The parking spots are pretty small, having never been to Chicago before we didn’t know what to expect and drove our truck (our mistake) but Josh accommodated immediately with a new place for us to park. It was perfect for a quick weekend getaway and needing a place to sleep/get ready. Keep in mind, as the listing says it can get noisy, there was no noise the first night but the second night there was a fair amount of moving around happening above us. Just something to keep in mind for any light sleepers or people with children. Overall it was a fantastic experience and if we ever come back we will definitely stay there again!
This was the perfect location to explore downtown Chicago. It is right near the train so just be aware of the sound. However, we packed a fan and it didn’t bother us at all.
Ag was very responsive and the location was perfect!  Very close to public transportation and easy street parking.

Really loved our stay at Danny's place! Perfect midpoint distance between downtown and Wrigley Field. The unit was flooded with a ton of light in the large open areas of the living room and dining room. The beds were really really comfortable and the unit was very well insulated - we didn't hear anything from the other units. Traveled with two college aged girls so having two bathrooms was definitely a plus. Kitchen well stocked. To catch Clark street buses - the bus that runs north toward Wrigley and/or south toward downtown is across the street. If you need el transportation – that's about a 15 minute walk through beautiful Lincoln Park. The parking spot in back was the cherry on top since parking in this area is challenging. Danny was very responsive usually in under 10 minutes – we felt right at home. We would definitely stay here again- highly recommend!

We loved our stay in Chicago. The place was so close to the zoo we went every day. Very close to public transportation, restaurants and shops. Very nice space and exactly what my family needed. Would highly recommend!
My friend and I stayed for a week! We had an amazing time and felt right at home. Only complaint I could have is neighbors being loud, but other than that it was amazing!

מיקום הדירה קצת רחוק מהכל ובשביל להגיע לרכבת צריך ללכת איזה 20 דקות. עם זאת זה לא היה כזה נורא. מעבר לזה הדירה לגמרי עמדה בציפיות אם כי היו 2 דברים שהפריעו לי. הדבר הראשון שהיה קצת ריח של עובד בדירה ודבר שני זה זרם המים במקלחת שהיה ממש קשה התקלח בזרם כזה חלש. מעבר לזה הדירה הייתה נוחה ומספקת, ממול היה מרכז קניות שממש הועיל.
Wonderful, we’d stay again. We had a minor issue and host was very communicative and helped us resolve. Great location on major bus routes to buzz in and out of city.

Had a great stay! Home was clean and comfortable with a pretty backyard and patio to enjoy the great weather. Host was super responsive and I really appreciated that they allowed me to check in early.

A basic value room, good for a cat person (like me). Bilel is a friendly, responsive, and trustworthy host with helpful recommendations for the neighborhood. Es una buena ubicación si buscas estar cerca del centro, llegas muy fácil y rápido en el metro. Zhi siempre estuvo al pendiente, sin embargo, a pesar de comentarle que el baño estaba sucio no se realizó la limpieza :(

Fuera de eso creo que por el precio es un buen lugar, solo recomendaría mejorar la limpieza!
Great place! Clean, spacious, and all the essentials. We loved it!

Amazing location. Very accessible to almost every downtown attraction. Lots of restaurants nearby. Downside was the noise from the L train. Runs a little past midnight. At the time of our stay, we had some construction going on. There was only 1 working elevator and roof top was closed. Otherwise it was a pleasant stay.
Great place as advertised !  Very clean and everything you need (towels, sheets, appliances etc). No complaints

We LOVED this place! It was our first trip to Chicago and we're already planning to come back, and hoping we can book Barbara's place again. The neighborhood was lovely and the restaurants were amazing, an A+ vacation all around!
It was a nice stay.

Tucked in a quiet neighborhood a short walk to the L Blue line.
Wonderful thoughtful hosts provided treats and snacks. Off street parking too if you have a car, but you don't need a car from this location... Really enjoyed our stay
Beautiful place in a beautiful neighborhood, Carla was very helpful with everything. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for nice stay in Chicago!
It was very comfortable and clean. Nice kitchen and fridge.

This apartment is in a great location! The neighborhood is very walkable and there are tons of restaurants and stores close by. The space is a nice size. While it is a little more worn and dated than we expected, we enjoyed our stay.
Great stay in downtown Chicago! Walking distance from Millenium Park and Navy Pier. Our bathroom had bluetooth speakers in the mirror which was super fun! We’d definitely stay here again.

Overall, our stay was great; however, we are a very tall family and found that the furniture was not ideal for tall folks. That being said the host was wonderful, but for our family’s needs, we need something for tall folks.

We wanted a place that was in walking distance for a concert at Soldier Field. We were able to walk back and forth from the concert without any problems. The parking spot at the Airbnb was wonderful. The place was great and Michael and his team were quick to respond to messages.
Jack was a great host - friendly, communicative, and extremely accommodating. My stay was comfortable, the location was perfect for me, and I would stay again.
Muy conforme. Buenas conexiones al centro y aeropuerto.

We had a wonderful stay! The house was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was excellent—just a short walk to Wrigley Field, with plenty of great bars and restaurants nearby. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.
Very beautiful! Well taken care of and looked just like the pictures. I would stay here again!

Really nice apartment in a great location. Walking distance to Wrigley Field, lakefront, lots of restaurants, and public transportation. Everything was exactly as described and the communication with the host was good.

The location is fantastic!!!
Walkable to Whole Foods, the EL and shops of Lincoln Park. The roof top view of the city is Absolutely Stunning!!!
Great Amenities in the building too!!
We Loved staying here and will be back!
Nice place to stay in Chicago. Close to Trains and in a nice neighborhood

This is a very clean property!   The owner has made very good use of the space and I love that the integrity of the home has been maintained.  It is in a quiet, safe neighborhood and is a couple of blocks from stores and restaurants.  Everything you need for your stay is provided.  Enrico is quick to respond to questions.  I would highly recommend this property.
Fantastic place to stay. My family and I stayed for an entire week and it felt like a home away from home.
What a great spot! And Ryan is a great, proactive host. Would stay again.
Good stay! We didn’t get to interact much but Amanda was a lovely and thoughtful host. Great neighborhood

Extremely nice hosts and very responsive and helpful.
Close to the L for on and off trips.
This place was fantastic with great amenities and a great location. The kitchen was well set up and there were games and parking permits and I can’t recommend this place enough!

We loved our stay here at the Lincoln Paradise! It was the perfect side of town, walkable to the lake, Lincoln Park zoo, shops, and a short bus ride to Wrigley (we drove but had taken that into consideration!). It’s very charming, mid-century modern which we love. I highly recommend!

My guest enjoyed their stay at Sulaiman's. There was some unfortunate weather that impacted the area during the stay, which caused the apartment to be without power for almost 24 hours. The host was very proactive during that time, offering up battery chargers for a phone, and generally trying to offer solutions.

Great stay!! Walking distance to Michigan Ave and Oak st beach. Neighborhood isn’t very busy so it’s great for ride shares and ordering in!!! The units were also very quiet!
Having two units was a huge bonus to allow some separation between groups!

We had a lovely stay. We had a few issues with cleanliness and comfort and the host offered to correct it right away and even had new bed pillows delivered within a few hours of mentioning it.
A few details were overlooked in the cleaning but overall the place is in great condition.
The host was very responsive and helpful.

This was one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed at in chicago! All of the thoughtful touches (fans in bedrooms, noise machines, fully stocked kitchen, extra towels, blackout shades) made this spot feel like home. The beds and couch were both comfortable. The noise from the street and the restaurant were noticeable but not bothersome at all. You can tell David cares for his guests and his home. It was excellent and I’ll certainly be back!

Matthew’s place in the heart of Bridgeport is the perfect spot to catch a Sox game, enjoy great bars and restaurants, or relax outside in the wonderful patio and enclosed front yard. We had a great time enjoying beautiful weather in Chicago during the best time of the year.
A really good Airbnb
fue excelente la ubicación y el departamento muy cómodo
Obinna’s place is great value and good location. Would recommend for long term stays.
A really nice place to stay looks just like the pictures
Great location and Great host, close enough to the bus/train station to walk and make use of the public transit without any problems

Marco’s place was great. It definitely looks bigger than the pictures. Everything was sparkling clean and he was very responsive for any question we had. There’s lots of natural light and every room feels spacious which we appreciated. There’s lots of stuff nearby in the neighborhood, we totally recommend his place

Fantastic location, very walkable and fun area to be in and friendly and responsive host. The apartment was great but few things were disappointing such as the shower in the master not draining well so every shower (even a quick one) you’re left standing in ankle deep water. The toilet paper roll holder was broken and hanging off the wall, which wasn’t a big deal but for the price you pay you’d assume things would be in top condition. King beds, especially in the master, would be more comfortable and luxurious. Especially because most adults don’t want to share a full size bunk bed with another adult. One night we were there it seemed like the AC wasn’t working that well, warm in the apartment compared to the rest of the stay. Oven was dirty so when we tried to use it, it smoked up the apartment and we had to run a clean cycle and open the windows.  Overall a cool apartment and you can’t beat the location.

We had a great stay in the heart of Hyde Park! Walkable to Whole Foods and other local eateries just blocks away. Easy check-in. The only con was the unit #100 is located right by the building entrance and the walls are very thin so you hear people coming in and out throughout the night when trying to sleep. Host was responsive and provided detailed instructions.
Excellent stay at Kasa. Building was easy to find with onsite parking, clean and great communication!
We had a great stay with Jeanette! Highly recommend staying here, it was comfortable and easy to get around the city from where we were.

Very walkable location. Easy to get to the train from where we were, and there is a corner store/grocery store within an easy walking distance. Cafes and restaurants are within easy walking distance as well. The place itself was as described in the photos. Spacious and well organized with all the listed amenities. The apartment is clean, and the instructions to get in are easy to follow.
The only downside to this units location is that it's right above the entrance to the building and the door opening and closing at all hours is noticeable and sometimes loud. I think I'm just not used to living in an apartment, as the neighborhood is quiet otherwise. I would still room at this location again despite this, I just feel like it's worth mentioning!
Clean, quiet room, walkable to Metra that goes to the city, very clear check-in instructions. Great stay and highly recommend!
quiet neighborhood. walkable to metro but be careful with homeless
We enjoyed our stay!

Robert's place was perfect for our weekend visiting the city with a big family. Robert was super responsive, the place was very usable and convenient with a beautiful outdoor area, and a very quick hop into downtown. will stay again!
Great location, great host

We really appreciated Mario as a host and he’s  just a good person in general! We loved our Airbnb the space was super nice and clean and I will definitely be recommend my friends back home to book with him when they come up to visit! He provided some of the best hospitality out of all the stays I’ve had before and it doesn’t even come close so seriously thank you for that. Location was ideal very walkable neighborhood, and drives to downtown or surround neighborhoods were only 10-20 mins.
La ubicación del departamento es muy buena.
I would highly recommend this location.  It is in a great location especially if you are going to the Obama Library Center. Very Clean, safe and very spacious for a family or friends road trip.

Jon and Tina’s place was fantastic! It was conveniently located, very comfortable, and had everything we needed for our family’s trip to Chicago to celebrate our daughter’s 16th birthday.
Communication was excellent from start to finish. Jon and Tina were incredibly responsive and checked in multiple times during our stay to ensure everything was going smoothly.
A wonderful experience all around. We would definitely stay here again!

David’s apartment was in an ideal, walkable location for exploring the north side. The apartment itself was spacious, quiet, and clean. Great place to stay if you’re going to a Cubs game (straight, easy walk to get there) or getting around Chicago more broadly
Estancia agradable, la zona es tranquila, si buscas donde alojarte a unos minutos del centro de la ciudad está es una buena opción, la anfitriona es muy accesible y contesta siempre que lo necesitas.

I was in the military for a bit. This BnB reminded me of some of the dorms and barracks I stayed in. It is not bad. It is not “too” dirty. It is ok. But the bed is more or less a cot, it is a very small space in that shared apartment, and there is one bathroom and it gets dirty quick. However, this place is cheap compared to rest of Chicago… so if you want to stay in Chicago for cheap and don’t mind a slightly dirty and slightly uncomfortable stay, then this is great! It is right by downtown Chinatown and a brief walk to the L.

This is a wonderful place for a family of 4 with two teens to use as a base to explore the city. Free street parking that always had an incredibly nearby spot if not directly in front of the location. Blake was incredibly available and responsive and we felt right at home after long days walking around Chicago.
Great place!

really good place and super clean!! good location and everything, especially since it’s in the heart of chicago with a bunch of CTA lines close to the place to take anywhere and everywhere. only downside is how hot the room can get and the ceiling fan can only do so much, so prepare for that!! you’ll be walking so much and get back into the room sweaty and hot, and you’ll need to feel that coolness. it’s a perfect place to take breaks in between activities and to rest at the end of the night. the bed is huge and spacious! the bathroom is a bit small but it does what it needs to do!

This is an immaculately clean 1 bedroom on a pleasant street with lots of other small 2 story apartment buildings. Quiet neighborhood. May have to find on street parking a couple blocks away. Finishes in bathroom all new and attractive.
On the downside, it’s a basement apartment with low ceilings, low light and a very small bathroom. We were glad our plans had us almost entirely using the space for sleep only. We would not choose this location again.
Location was great place was very clean. Had everything that we needed for our stay. Definitely would recommend.

Very clean place. I travel a lot for work and I am always looking a place that feels like 'home' - laundry, kitchen, and the comfort of a home-like settings.
I felt that immediately upon arrival and will book here again.

Chicago is a beautiful city! I stayed at this Airbnb for a week and it was beautiful. The host was responsive to any questions that I had and thank you for the snacks and bottle of waters. The location is only about 20 minutes from the city and a lot was explored (while in the city). I will recommend this Airbnb to anyone if you are vacationing/traveling to Chicago.

Great location.  Not worth the money I paid.  Hair in utensil drawers, food on plates,  no HVAC.  Has window units and is located upstairs so very hard to cool down in the day, so incredibly loud late at night and early morning, internet barely worked.

We enjoyed Bozena’s lovely condo. It was super clean, comfortable and fully equipped. The flowers on the gangway created a beautiful setting. The neighborhood of tree lined streets were inspiring. If we’re ever in Chicago again, we would definitely stay there.

This was my groups first time in Chicago. Obviously the photos of the place are a bit stale, but the interior was much worse inside than what was displayed. The shower floor had stains all over it as well as the rug and couch in the living room. All of the panting is chipping in the home. When we addressed the issues and requested a refund she continusly gave us a hard time. She sent an unknown man to a home full of girls to try and repair but the state of the home should have been renovated PROOR to arrival. She continued to harass me saying that I was lying and that the home was as advertised. Even after receiving a refund she still continued to blow up my phone with angry messages. upset that we the bathroom even though we had nowhere to go in the meantime and we left it perfectly fine condition. Even support was in shock that this home was publicly listed. All 6 of us had to crash at a friend’s  home until we could find somewhere else. Truly a nightmare of a situation!
Perfect value for the money in an amazing location. Would definitely stay there again!
Everything you need and a nice park across the street
We loved our stay! The apartment was extremely charming, spacious, really thoughtfully equipped, well decorated - fantastic. We would love to stay here again.
Ryan’s place was perfect for our stay, great location and a lovely comfortable flat. Highly recommend

Had a great stay, only slight complaint is about the listing. It says 4 beds, but counts the couch as a bed. The couch isn’t super suitable for sleeping and did not pull out into a bed, so it felt a little misleading. Otherwise, the stay was super simple and easy. Host was very responsive to the few questions we had.

Not bad for splitting a room with friends as an emergency accommodation last minute when my other host canceled the night before. The room was definitely dirty though, the trash was full with other people’s pill bottles and garbage and there was hair & stains on the bedsheets… There was a lot more but I say just a word of caution. I’m not sure if my experience was isolated. I liked the room itself and the building is super cool. I just wish it was clean.
For what the cost is — you get what you pay for. Hostel vibes… can be a little noisy, but again, that’s what you paid for. Very close to the red line which was super nice. Enjoyed my trip to Chicago.

If you’re looking for a spot in Uptown this one has it all! Nicely decorated - felt homey but not cluttered. The beds were super comfortable! Living area has room for everyone to gather. 2 spacious bathrooms mean there’s plenty or room to get ready for the day. Kitchen had everything we needed. The apartment was perfect for our weekend in the city. If you're coming to Chicago and are looking to stay in Uptown, don’t hesitate to book this!
Great experience, would highly recommend and certainly return if ever needed! Super quick responses too!!

Our host, Jason, was very helpful and responsive.   The flat itself was spacious, clean, and well appointed.  The unit was priced at a premium,  but then it sleeps up to six people.  Places to eat were close by, and rapid transit downtown was just two blocks away.  Street parking is available within a block or two - pay attention to street cleaning signage.  Bottom line, would stay again.

This was my first trip to Chicago, and after researching many places to stay, I’m so glad we chose this apartment. My daughter and I love to travel, and we appreciate having space to relax after long days of museums, sightseeing, shopping, and exploring the city.
The layout was perfect, two comfortable bedrooms with private baths, plus a half bath, a spacious living area, and a well equipped kitchen. I have dietary restrictions, so having a full kitchen is essential, and it made our stay much easier and more enjoyable.
The apartment was spotless, well appointed, and had everything we needed. The staff was warm, welcoming, and made us feel at home from the moment we arrived.
And the location couldn’t have been better. We walked everywhere, to shops, restaurants, attractions, and even Whole Foods to pick up kitchen essentials. It truly felt like the perfect Chicago getaway.
We had a great time at this location! Perfect for Cubs games. 100% would stay here again!
We had a wonderful stay at Garden Oasis. Cyan was friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay here again if I come back to Chicago.
Affordable place in Chicago

David's place was great. Very bright, spacious and clean. He answered any questions I had promptly. I was amazed at the variety of cooking spices that he stocked. I am less than average height so I was thrilled to see he had a stepstool so I could reach the microwave. My grown children and grandchildren loved the video games. I highly recommend his place.

My friends and I loved staying here! Nathan is a fantastic host, and a lovely human being at that! We liked walking to restaurants, using his back patio, enjoying the treats he left out, and spending time together in his lovely home. Close to the airport. Some lovely areas to walk. A sweet neighborhood. We would definitely come again!

Estancia perfecta!!!
Repetiría sin dudarlo.

Emily's place was great!  The charm and comfort of a classic Chicago apartment.  Parking was just street parking but we never had a problem finding a spot, even later in the evening. Lots of coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance.

I stayed for six nights at this clean and comfortable lower-floor unit. The host was responsive and always answered my questions about check-in, amenities etc. within a short time. I especially appreciated the location of Kyriako's place. The proximity to the University of Chicago (about a mile walk) worked for me perfectly. I had planned to cook a few meals during my stay but ended up eating out because the stove lacked a vent fan and there was no dishwasher in this unit (even though a dishwasher is listed in the kitchen section). Also, I wish the huge TV was not blocking the window and I could get some sunlight and fresh air! Despite these small issues, I enjoyed my stay because of the location, the comfortable bed, and cleanliness of Kyriako's studio apartment. It is great for short stays.

Overall the stay was not bad. For us, it was mainly just a place to crash at night, take a shower, + leave our dog for a few hours. The bed was comfortable + there wasn’t a lot of noise.
There were some misunderstandings once we checked in regarding pet rules + one of the days we paid for we could not be at the place for several hours due to last minute pest prevention services. It all worked out fine, but definitely threw us for a loop right after check in.
Not bad for a large corporate type Airbnb.

We had a great time at this property in great measure due to its host Marco. The amenities of the property were great and it was close to everything, not to mention the flowers. This was without a doubt one of my most memorable vacations.
We had a nice stay!
while the place was quite small, it met my needs.
Such a great place to stay. Clean, quiet, and comfortable.  Steps away from everything.

The place was very clean and in excellent condition, and Jorge was very responsive and friendly. The main negatives were that there were some unpleasant smells in the house (first an air freshener, and intermittently some minor smoky smells). It was also a bit noisy outside one of the mornings. But overall we had a great stay.

this location is exactly what we wanted. it's just a few minutes walk from public transit. it's walkable to grocery stores. it's walkable to lake Michigan. perhaps most folks use this space and only eat out, but we cooked and found the kitchen lacking. there aren't enough cooking utensils or pots. the can opener didn't work. we didn't have clear instructions about what to do with our trash. the beds were fine. they didn't have mattress pads which seems strange. they don't have hand towels which was also strange. it wasn't a bad experience but with a few more amenities it could be better.
Wonderful place! Perfect for visiting family and helping show off the city on their first visit.
We would love to stay here again. Great location. Great amenities. Loved the balcony. So close to everything!
Great! Very clean!
Did I mention I've stayed here before and that it's a great spot and that the staff are great?

Great neighborhood and super close to the beach, public transportation, Lime bikes, and parking if you have a car. We felt the space was larger than the pictures can show. The two bedrooms are on opposite ends so it's very nice for privacy. We didn't use a lot of the amenities since we were in the city pretty much all day and night. Very comfortable beds. The family lives directly above so you may hear the pitter patter of little feet every now and then. This is also mentioned in their description - so not a surprise or a big deal for us. Very quiet between 11 pm and 7 am - perfect for sleeping and you an amazing price for Chicago. Did I mention we loved the neighborhood?! 🩷
Flexhome provided great hospitality and services in Chicago. I would highly recommend them to use for AIRBNB as communication was clear and instructions easy to follow.
My guests enjoyed their stay at Jim's place. Communication was great all throughout the process.

A cozy stay for an affordable price!
Pros: Walkable neighborhood, close to a grocery store and a post office. Very quiet house with beautiful decor. Host is communicative and helpful. Room has AC.
Cons: Location is a bit out of the way (although it's only a short walk to the Green Line and buses). Ants in the kitchen despite overall good level of cleanliness.

Our second stay at Hygge Hideaway was even better than the first! Thank you to the friendly hosts and for the great stay for our family of 5 (including our dog!)  We are looking to stay again in 2027. Highly recommend.
This was one of the most charming places I’ve ever stayed and in on my yearly trip to Wrigleyville. Clean, cool and quiet in a great neighborhood.

This is a beautiful home with lots of room to spread out for the 5 of us. The owner was very responsive when we had any questions. Bonus - off street parking because the street parking especially in the evening was sometimes hard to come by.

We had a great time at Stephen's place! The location is perfect, walkable to restaurants, coffee shops. It's also super quiet and very dog friendly! Staying here made for a great first visit in Chicago!
An incredibly clean apartment with everything you need! Plus it’s in a very walkable location. We would definitely stay here again.

Great place, spacious, clean, loved all the extras (coffee, toiletries, decor). Perfect location close to the train stations, restaurants, shopping, just a beautiful place and location, so walkable to anything needed. Was perfect!
Kyriako and her co-hosts were extremely responsive and helpful throughout my stay! Despite some difficulties during our stay, Kyriako addressed all our issues quickly, respectfully and politely!

Airbnb is passable, but not suitable for a long stay. Many problems, including one host removed right before we checked in, so communication around check in was stressful and unclear. Immediate issues with both front door locks and a garage door opener that didn’t work. Host said she would get us a new garage door opener but never did in the month we were there. She also asked if WE could try to fix the front door lock. We weren’t able to fix it, so ended up using the back door only throughout the stay. There are missing amenities and no vacuum. Had to also replace essentials like TP, garbage bags, laundry detergent. No home instructions, so had to figure out how to work the appliances, etc. Several pieces of furniture had broken drawers. This is not a good choice for a long stay or WFH. Host host has a 3 hour avg response time, and after alerting her to the 2 lock issues in the first few days and getting an unhelpful response we decided not to bring any other issues to her attention.

We had a great stay overall! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and conveniently located in Hyde Park, with plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, and stores within walking distance. The host was responsive and quick to address any questions or issues that came up during our stay. Overall, we would definitely stay here again!
Great stay for the cost!
Such a responsive and agreeable host
Very clear instructions and very nice! Great cheap spot to easily get to rest of city, close to CTA!

i booked this airbnb for 1,008$ for 3 nights back in april, and traveled all the way from massachusetts. when i arrived, the hallway and the rooms entirety reeked of cigarettes. I also could not find parking within an hour walk of the apartment. when i got to my room, it did not match the photos what so ever. there was pee on toilet seat, hair and leftover soap in the shower, the sink was completely broken, one of the beds was unmade, the bathroom door didn’t close, there were marks of dirt or whatever it was all over the walls, the bathroom reeked of pee, leftover used coffee bag in the coffee maker, handprints on mirror, and it did not match the photos listed. when i called vin to speak with him about the matter, he was rude and interrupted the entire time, and then proceeded to hang up.
thankfully airbnb support was extremely helpful, and booked me a free hotel for 2 nights, and refunded me every penny.
do not book with vin unless you want to be let down!

We loved our stay! The location couldn’t be beat. Our hosts were helpful and responsive. The beds were very comfortable and they had a lot of extra linens. I appreciated the little things like hooks on the walls, lots of mirrors, spices and coffee, and umbrellas. The place was decorated really cute!  Highly recommended!

Tai’s apartment is very spacious and fully equipped. Coffee was great too.
It is located in a nice area, approx 60 min to the airport and downtown. Public transport is close by in a few minutes walk.
Great clean place !

This was one of the best places I’ve stood at in my entire life. What a beautiful place! On top of it all, it’s in the heart of Fulton st market. You can’t beat that! Seth was a great host and very responsive. Thank you Seth. We’ll be back soon.
Definitely a beautiful and clean apartment.
Great place! Terrific value! Convenient to public transportation, and lots of great restaurants and things to do. Place was clean and comfortable.
Really enjoyed my stay, close to L station as well

This is a great place for a big group. The beds are super comfy! We felt the location in the listing name wasn’t quite accurate- this isn’t in Wicker park, so double check the location. The kitchen could use some upgraded serving ware and glassware. That said, the hosts are super responsive and friendly and we had a lovely time here.

I came down with a couple of my company members we choose Sherrys place it was very easy to explore the city and head to the McCormick place it was very fun!!! It was a nice area! I really enjoyed the service and the clean environment I was :) Overyall we had a good time!!!!

John answered promptly with the few questions we had.
Very walkable neighborhood, I was able to walk to Wrigley field in 25 minutes.
Plenty of street parking!

This was a great place to stay in Chicago. The apartment was clean and spacious. Its conveniently located, with easy access to downtown, restaurants and transit. The host was responsive, had helpful recommendations and provided clear instructions for check-in and parking.

I felt that the pictures didn’t reflect what the place actually looked like. Considering that the price per night is similar to what I could have paid for an Airbnb where I could have gotten an entire room for myself, I didn’t think that it was worth the price. The hostel allows individuals who are struggling with housing to work at the hostel for their stay. The lockers aren’t big enough to fit a carry on luggage.
The place was great to stay in and easy to get around Chicago from this place.

Even though is a room in the basement, this place remains quiet and clean, I liked that is well lighted in the outside of the room and that smells nice. Bathroom was always clean and they have a perfect temperature control.
Our favorite Logan Square Air B and B!

Terry and John were wonderful hosts. They welcomed us with warmth after a busy day and gave helpful suggestions on places to eat and visit in the area (Calo Ristorante is fantastic). They offered a wide variety of options for blankets and overall were very welcoming. The bedroom was very clean and the other guests were friendly. The area was beautiful, peaceful, and easy to get to and from via public transit. Highly recommend!
Studebecker was a great host! Very responsive and assisting. Great property, fit us well. Will book again!

Clint war ein toller Gastgeber, der immer schnell reagiert hat und immer freundlich war! Wir haben uns in seiner Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt und die drei Monate in Chicago genossen. Die Anbindung an Bus und Bahn und die tolle Nachbarschaft hat uns besonders gut gefallen.
Muy buen hospedaje !!! Encantados con Chicago

Wrapping up a long-term stay that took me through winter, spring, and into summer, and I couldn't be happier with how well the place held up across all three seasons. Millie is an incredible host! If I ever needed anything, quick look or a fix, she was on top of it immediately. A truly comfortable, reliable home away from home. I look forward to coming back and staying there in another month!

Tara's place was very comfortable and she was a great hostess.  We were easy walking distance to Wrigley and right across from Donovan's.  Easy street parking and hostess was very responsive  and even able to help out with last minute request. I would stay here again!
Robert’s place was amazing! It’s such a cute neighborhood and he was so quick to respond, the place itself looked exactly like the pictures and felt SO clean! Would highly recommend staying here.
super easy stay for going to McCormic Place

My cousin and I had a great time in Chicago and with the hosts. They communicated great about check in and check out. The place was clean and easy to find! Street parking was also easy to find for parking. Only 20 minutes from downtown so everything was super close. Overall had a great experience with the place!

this is a really cool property.
It is starting to show a little bit of wear and tear that the owners could fix in one day. One other interesting thing to note is that the pictures of the master bathroom do not go with the king-size bed room. That cool bathroom with the soaking tub is connected to the bunk room. The king bedroom does have an attached bathroom for privacy, but it’s just not as grand as the master suite.
Great host, great location, great place. Would definitely recommend!

Excelente opción para hospedarse, utilicé la opcion de transporte público para movilizarme y es fácil de llegar al departamento.
Bev nos envió recomendaciones de lugares cercanas y siempre dispuesta a ayudar, en mi caso la cocina no contaba con licuadora y nos ayudó con una para realizar el desayuno.
El departamento estaba limpio y tal cual las fotos. La cocina contaba con varios artículos que se requieren para cuando se desea cocinar en él, cerca del lugar hay un supermercado con el que se puede abastecer de cosas adicionales.
100% segura que volvería a alquilar el lugar si vuelvo a Chicago.
Great clean place, will definitely stay again!
Erica was an exceptional host.

I loved staying in this spacious basement full of so much natural light! The kitchen was well stocked with dishes and cookware, allowing me to bring in whatever groceries I wanted. I had plenty of room to spread out for the half week for work and play, and the local neighborhood and nearby park were great for walking and enjoying a peaceful, nature-filled oasis in the city. The hosts were friendly and gracious and helped me feel welcome—and were patient and kind when I accidentally set off the smoke alarm because I forgot to turn on the fan above the stove! I appreciated the nice touch of water bottles and a welcome basket and card on the kitchen island. I would definitely stay here again, a comfortable home away from home.
The Staywell unit had plenty of space, was easy to access and was in a very central location. We enjoyed staying here for a bachelorette trip.

A fantastic location to stay whenever You’re in Chicago! the place is extremely well kept and the art adds a premium touch. It’s about 10-15mins drive from downtown Chicago (Michigan Avenue, Magnificent Mile, 360 Chicago etc).
Also very very easy to get to venues like the McCormick Place for events/conferences.
This was my first time in Chicago and it was a pleasure to stay here! Whenever I’m heading back, this is my first choice for a place to stay!!!
Friendly, proactive hosts. Great location and especially beautiful bathroom

Great experience! Would come again! Thank you so much!

I get jealous when others book The Oasis of South Shore. It literally is my home away from during my business travels. Josey is a treasure of a host. It’s like a lil piece of Heaven in the Southside of Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay. The accommodations were both comfortable and spotless. Plenty of space for 5. The location is excellent, just a few minutes’ walk to the lake or Mag Mile. We were impressed and would gladly stay here again!
Great location with restaurants and coffee within walking distance. Super easy to get to. Loved having access to the parking space. Very responsive hosts. We’d stay again.

Iris is very quick in responding our questions and messages. Her place is wonderful with comfortable beds and all supplies we needed to cook breakfast of eggs and toasts. The place is very convenient located with restaurants and coffee shops as well as about 6 minutes walking to the water front. We will definitely recommend this place to our family members and friends when they come to Chicago.

Fuss-free stay and responsive host. Ashley’s place is clean, comfortable, and quiet and she is an excellent host. Quick to respond, knowledgeable, and let me check in early. Would definitely stay here again if back in Chicago.
A perfect spot for vacation!
The location is good and convenient, the bed is comfortable, the surrounding is quiet and safe.
No issues.

I needed a place to stay for a couple of nights while in the midst of a local move and Kim’s place was perfect. Quiet, convenient, clean and in my neighborhood. I did not have any trouble finding street parking about a block away.
Great place and very easy stay!

Daniel had a very clean, quaint, and well-equipped place that was in a quiet, walkable location. At the same time, we sent him a few messages to keep him informed about travel delays and he could have been more communicative.

recomendaría el lugar a otros huéspedes !

We had an okay time staying here, though there were a few things worth noting for future guests.
The basement is dark and quite low — the ceilings are under 6 feet, and you can tell from the doors that headroom was a real constraint. Not a comfortable space for anyone of average height or taller. There were also some persistent pet odors down there, and the walls showed signs of moisture and wear.
The upper bedroom had noticeable cat smells as well, which was a problem for our guest with pet allergies. The neighbors directly above that room were active throughout the night — walking, possibly vacuuming — which made for a disrupted sleep.
On the amenity side, there was no coffee in the unit and the TV had an issue mid-stay; both required some back-and-forth without a great resolution.
Indira does seem to care about her guests, and the area itself is genuinely great — probably just not the right fit for us.

Erica and Jacob were wonderful hosts! They took the time to come greet us and give us the lay of the land when we first arrived, which was lovely. Everything was clean, communication was great, instructions were easy to follow.

Muy buena ubicación y muy amable Anastacia
Laura was very helpful and so friendly. Her place was very nice with lots of natural light and the listing is as described
It was a wonderful stay for first-time visitors to Chicago. We really enjoyed playing pool and staying in spacious house. Thank you.

the apt is lovely and spacious. though next to the tracks they left earplugs and sound machines and the noise didn't bother us. location is very close to museum campus so very convenient. the neighborhood is a little rough, but I think that's accounted for in the price, and we felt safe inside. James is very responsive and clearly has done everything he can to make the space comfortable.

When you are looking for a place to stay with your family that is close enough to the downtown area, but also far enough a way to give you peace of mind- look - no further than this beautiful spot!
As a realtor, I own a staging company, this home was not only perfect in staging, but also every need was thought out for our entire trip. The hosts are friendly, kind, responsive, and overall wonderful people! Would stay here again!
Thank you!

Our stay here was great! Felt safe, quiet area, no issues with parking, comfortable bed, the laundry machine and dryer was a huge plus, they did a good job decorating inside, loved the flooring and wall color. She provided a 'welcome' notebook with instructions on getting any issues resolved. The check out was concise and easy to follow. Would stay there again. Proximity to the Orange line on the El made it easy to get anywhere in Chicago with ease.
Only use a car once in the week.

The moment you walk in you felt like you were apart of a family. The little extra details, like homemade banana bread, stocked Diet Coke and speciality coffee were the true cherry on top.

Fairly good location. Short walk from the train station. Very wonderful hosts. So very responsive a little overzealous with potential charges for late check out. But otherwise nice. Location was great. Didn’t care for all the EXTRA communication letting me know the RULES bc I didn’t plan on having a party or extra guest. It felt like I was going to be watched. Excellent location.  Spacious well equipped.
Wouldn’t recommend
Great stay!
Beautiful house, Super comfortable and clean, Saurin was an outstanding host, always helpful, he even helped us to find a parking spot and gave good recommendations! Definitely recommended

Jennifer was an amazing host. She responded right away whenever I had any questions. Her place was exceptional and felt like home during my month-long stay. Matched the description perfectly, and the location was ideal for exploring the best parts of Chicago.

Spacious room in a great downtown location, but surprisingly quiet inside! Lots of excellent restaurants nearby, and only a 20-minute walk to U Chicago. Clear instructions made the check-in process quick and easy. Highly recommend!
greate appartement.

The stay was wonderful!  The apartment complex it was in could get slightly noisy, but it was not anything that prevented me from sleeping. The pillows were super comfortable. Coffee was available for use in the cabinets, and they provided shampoo, conditioner, and body wash; all were very useful. The only thing I wish was included was a place to hang the washclothes within the shower. Overall, it was fantastic and I would stay here again.

You are staying in the hosts home, and the stay here, felt like home. Comfortable, adorable doggie, and friendly hosts. I am in Chicago for business often, I plan to add this home to my roster of places to stay.
Well-located, quiet, and big. I wish I could keep this spot to myself. I plan to come back whenever I’m in Chicago!
Great location and fantastic hosts. They communicated within minutes when we needed anything. Stay was great. Would recommend.
This is a great neighborhood. Really close to the El. It was quiet and parking was super easy.

We booked this as the home base for a family trip and it was perfect! Great neighborhood, super comfy beds, and even a delicious coffee shop in the lobby.
When we had a small maintenance issue, Patricia was very responsive and helpful.
Would absolutely stay here again!
amazing location. the best stay I've ever had

Our stay was great. Keys are a bit of a hassle but once you figure it out its smoth in and out. We chose  this location because it is walking distance to the United Center where we attended a concert. We also walked a few blocks to ride the Metro downtown.  The beds were nice and comfy after our long days out exploring Chicago. House is clean and spacious.  There are plenty of towels, iron and ironing board if needed. Russell provided great local info on how to get around the city and local spots to visit. We had an awesome visit and stay!

We had such a great time at The Penthouse. The unit is spacious and really comfortable. The balconies were amazing with great views. It is on a really lively street with so many great places to eat and drink within easy walking distance. Steps away is the train to see other parts of the city. Neighbors were wonderful too. Also, the neighborhood is a vintage shopping paradise. —so many cool thrift stores. Kevin is a kind and responsive host. This place was worth the money and exceeded our expectations.

AMAZING location. Near the metro and plenty of stores, bars, restaurants, and fun things to do. I would come stay anytime I am back in Chicago.
They were also very responsive and helpful if we had any questions or issues.

Dean was a a fantastic host and I enjoyed my stay! The apartment has everything you could need for a short or longer term stay. The shower is amazing and the bed is super comfortable. If you're looking for a peaceful city getaway in Chicago, highly recommend!

Brad's place is located in an area of Hyde Park that is within walking distance of shops, restaurants, bars and an L.A. Fitness gym.. Hyde Park is a very diverse neighborhood and there is something for everyone. The place is as advertised "snug and cozy".
Such a great deal with such a wonderful view!

Nice place. Corner, 3rd floor - 2 queen bedroom apartment. Nice views.. cozy place.
Terrace few steps from apartment door on same floor, very convenient for people who smoke.
As its downtime getting stuff in and out is little difficult as you have to be lucky to find a roadside parking next to entrance. Good thing that they had luggage cart.
We had parking added, so we were asked to park in parking lot in front. 2nd night it was full and Milan was super quick to address it and gave me another parking right next to apartment with reserved spot.

Book it-don’t hesitate!
Usually when I come to Chicago I stay at the Drake. Boy do I feel stupid! This place is just a few feet from The Drake (can still walk down to the coffee shop there in about the same time it took from my room there) and is 1000% a better value. Well appointed kitchen, plus a washer and dryer. TVs carry the local stations, which I love and is increasingly hard to find anywhere anymore. It really gives you a feel for the city. Truly a gem of a find! I will book again here and encourage you to as well!

Highly recommend a stay here! So many thoughtful amenities, including a sweet little note welcoming us, a cozy and well-stocked work area, and even a washer & dryer!

A great neighborhood for families, couples, or singles & an excellent value. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

We had a very comfortable stay here with our two young kids, to explore the city.

There are home activity sensors/noise level monitor in the living room but disclosed in the listing.

From beginning to end, Reinaldo was very communicative and provided a lot of great recommendations for the area. The apartment is in a great location and was very clean. Items in the house were easy to find.

Best shower out of all Airbnbs I have stayed at. Excellent water pressure, comfy towels shampoo, conditioner and soap right there. Excellent location near delicious restaurants, pubs and stores. Pretty good stay and location! Host was very proactive
Excellent location, clean and newly redone, hosts were very responsive. Would stay again!

John & Görkem were an absolute pleasure to stay with for the first few days of our Chicago trip! Their home is lovely and easy to find, and they’re both incredibly welcoming. Great place for our family when we’re visiting the city!

Cannot recommend this stay (or its wonderful host) enough! We had a fantastic stay.

This was a great stay, and perfectly located for the convention center.

Brad's place was in a great location in a lovely neighborhood and was super spacious and clean! Our stay was great! The house was wonderful - lots of space, incredibly clean, and well-stocked with everything you could need. The parking space was a massive plus. We would definitely stay here again!
Great location and accommodations. Host was responsive and everything went smoothly

good place for the price
Clean, cute room in a brownstone. Charming neighborhood with Frank Lloyd Wright townhouses nearby and lots of African-American history.

I was there for work for a military and government event in Jackson Park for a couple of days and I want to say that Brad was very easy to find there was on street parking and the location was perfect for what I needed to do for work.

It was very homey. We were greeted with a bottle of wine that was delicious! Great stay close to everything!

I’d like to recommend this place but unfortunately my stay was less than perfect. On the positive side, this apartment is in a pretty ideal location if you want to explore the loop and the north side of Chicago, decent enough inside for one or two people, although as a garden unit it’s definitely darker than the photos make it seem.

The neighborhood was fantastic — lively, walkable, and full of great restaurant options, with easy access to the CTA and the rest of Chicago. My only real complaint was the lack of little touches like coffee supplies, but overall it was a comfortable stay in an excellent location

Loved this sanctuary in Lincoln Park. It was the perfect jumping off point for nearby shops, bars, restaurants, parks and (most importantly) the “L.”

Plenty of room, modern appliances, great outdoor seating on the stoop and much more. Would stay again.

Had a quick stay in Chicago for a concert at the United Center. This place was great for public transit to the venue and pretty much anywhere I wanted to go! Bus stop directly out side the door was so clutch for nearly every outing. Interiors were as described and I felt right at home. Bed & linens were comfy. Check in and out was a breeze. Very grateful for my stay, Brad was friendly and accommodating!
Very good location with parking. Walking distance to a lot of restaurants and shops.
super-comfortable, love the bar on the ground level, great value, central. i'll be back!
We had an amazing time here! Comfortable beds and the listing included everything we needed. I would definitely stay here again with group!
Love the place.  Lots of good food to walk to.  Definitely a place to stay.

Leonard’s place was just like the pictures, clean, spacious and beautiful. It’s right next to Hyde Park where we spent the majority of our time, but it wasn’t too far from downtown. Leonard was a great host and I would stay at his place again when I visit Chicago.

Very nice area, airbnb, and host. The place was clean, quiet, and close by stores & restaurants. There are thin stairs to get up to the airbnb so carrying huge luggage/bags was a little difficult. There is a train station right behind it so traveling around the city is really easy, you could hear it pass by though that wasnt an issue for me. Overall a very nice place and if I'm in Chicago again, I will probably book the place again.

The 2nd floor has one bedroom,  a full bathroom and a living room area. Then the 4th floor has two king-size bedrooms and a large full bathroom. the 5th floor is the large rooftop deck with spectacular view of the John Hancock building. The Uber pickup is just across the street at the bus stop. The parking garage space that comes with the property is a very short five minute walk and the parking spot is right beside the elevator access. The host’s recommended SpotHero garage for our 2nd vehicle was only a 7 minute walk. The host will share that spot with you. We really enjoyed the Nespresso machine! Highly recommend this property!!
it was fine for what was needed

Great place.

Overall GREAT!  Especially loved the coffee.  Nice amenities.  Great location.  Very roomy.  Highly recommend, especially if you’re looking to go to multiple Cubs games.

This was a great place to stay for our family of 8. Everyone had their own space. The kitchen was great!  It also was close to transit which was convenient since we did not have a car. This place made our trip special. Thank you!!
The hosts were extremely responsive and helpful and the place was exactly as described in the listing!

The host was friendly and responsive, which we appreciated. Great place

If I stay here again, I would try harder to spend time at the small, neighborhood lakefront (with a city lifeguard no less). Plus the front yard and patio has nice seating and a grill. More residential than I'm used to from Evanston. About a ten minute walk to Jarvis red line stop and that commercial district has a fine coffee shop, a wine shop and at least two bars with menus. Sheridan Avenue is a major N-S street with ample bus service too. Main challenge for me was the stairs: half-flight up to duplex entry and one flight up to the bedroom. First time I've stayed in home where hosts are also full-time residents. But Tammy and Scott are friendly and I wasn't there much at all. Definitely a good choice for me.

I really liked this apartment! It was easy to check in with a code. I liked that it was neat and nicely decorated with everything you need in the kitchen and bathrooms. Beds were comfortable and has a sofa bed in the living room. One of the highlights is the parking space at the building. You have a super market at the corner and the subway station right outside the building.
My hosts were super nice always answering my messages quickly. My family of 5 were very comfortable and happy here, hope to return soon!

Danielle was a great host, and the location was perfect! We were in town for a few Cubs games and were about 15 min walk from Wrigley. Danielle was very responsive and would definitely stay with her when I come back to Chicago. Highly recommend.

Regarding a 4-night stay at this property: the location is ideal—close to everything—and there is plenty of space for adults, but it falls short in a few areas. There are no clothes hangers, and only one bedroom has a surface for a suitcase; the other two rooms really need additional tables. Cleanliness is my biggest concern; I don't think the bathroom is cleaned between guests—the shower curtain was covered in mold (I had to change it myself), and the floors had stains from old spills. Also, while the owner’s rules state there should be no noise between 11 PM and 8 AM, at 6 AM you can hear a dog barking—and a large one at that—along with heavy footsteps from the floor above. If you want to sleep in, you might want to think twice about staying here. Improving the cleanliness of the place would give it a better appearance; it is important to consider people with health conditions like allergies, or simply the fact that some of us are not used to untidiness. Irena was a great host and very responsive! The studio in bucktown was well decorated and equipped with kitchen ware! We loved the location and would definitely stay again!

Overall had a great stay and the place was as shown in pictures. There were a few issues the first night that were specific to our stay and having an infant. Noise was what you would expect in the city, the back bedroom was quiet though and perfect for baby sleeping. Overall a good option for a vibrant neighborhood stay in the greatest city in the world.

This place was the perfect base for our trip to see our son graduate from college. Comfortable, spacious, clean, bright, airy - everything was great. Great, hotel-like amenities. The hosts were super-responsive throughout. Highly recommended if you’re visiting the Chicago area.
Great place to stay. Super close to the lake. Parking is tricky but manageable with patience. Ron was a great host.

We had a great stay. Instructions to check in were well illustrated and very helpful. The place was pristine and perfect for what we needed. The location was great and not far from where we used to live. It was an amazing place to crash for a few days. I would highly recommend it!!

I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a beautiful, comfortable home away from home. In addition, the neighborhood is so quiet, walkable and adorable!

I had such a great stay! The location is so nice and was close to the friend I was visiting. The spot has everything I could have needed. I worked remotely while here and the internet was solid. The bed was really comfy and the shower was so impressive! I would stay here again in the future.

It’s a nice place and is close to a lot of attractions. The place looks exactly like the photos, and it’s very clean. The host is very responsive and communicates well. Highly recommended!
Great place
The pictures match the description and how is very quiet and I felt right at home.
I would love to come back. Easy check in

Easy check in
Attentive host
All the amenities
Perfect thanks for hosting

This location was very convenient for all that we wanted to do in the city. We felt right at home and found check in very easy and intuitive. Kevin was very helpful and provided all of the information we needed.

Myself and two colleagues stayed here for a conference we had at Navy Pier. This is a short uber away. One day we did walk back to the Airbnb, about 2 miles.
There are plenty of restaurants within a short walk. The roof top patio is a bonus to take in the evening.
We spent 4 nights here. It was great to be so close to Wrigley field. We would stay here again for sure.  it was wonderful! Perfect location for the cubs games and we will hopefully stay again! 💙❤️🤍

I had a really nice stay here. The room decorations were lovely and the lights outside really helped with getting back home late at night. Location is convenient since it was right by the blue line. Host is kind and the dog was not hostile at all even when she barked. Would definitely recommend!
BEST PLACE WE HAVE EVER STAYED!!!

L'hôte est réactif mais comme indiqué une fois payé aucun remboursement pour une nuit en moins même en ayant prévenu plusieurs mois à l'avance donc aucune souplesse. C'était la règle et elle a été appliquée. Le 3eme lit est très inconfortable même avec la mousse rajouté. Hote très réactif. appartement très propre. pour prendre Le métro, il faut prendre le bus donc c'est un peu long. Le quartier n'a pas d'intérêt.
la salle de bain est dans la même pièce que le WC ce qui est compliqué avec 1 autre chambre occupée sachant qu'il peut y en avoir 2 autres en plus de la notre. Un total de 3 chambre à louer.

Jestem w pełni zadowolony z pobytu i polecam to miejsce
miejsce oraz gospodarza. Świetna lokalizacja, szybki dojazd do centrum i na lotnisko

Välstädat boende
