Prisvärt!
Great house and host

I’ve stayed at a lot of Airbnbs and this was the first experience that exceeded expectations. Fully stocked. Very clean. Easy check in and out. All the things you look for in a home away from home. 10/10 recommend.
Great location for us. We were here to see our daughter and her family across the street.

The accommodation is as described in the listing, and communication with the host was very efficient and always prompt. The location is good, close to the Cermak metro station. Considering the price, I believe it met my expectations overall.
The only aspect that was disappointing was the cleanliness. Both the room and the shared bathroom were dirty, with dust, long hairs on the floor, and bed linens that appeared not to have been washed (you can usually tell by the smell when linens have been freshly cleaned).
I asked the host about the cleaning of the common areas and was informed that they were cleaned once a day. However, during my two-night stay, no cleaning seemed to take place. The same hairs remained on the floor throughout my stay, and the bathroom was even dirtier the following day.

The space was great for our family! Awesome location, easy to come and go, and the apartment had all the essentials. Old building with creaky floors, but that was expected from reading other reviews and didn’t impact our stay. Overall, it was great!

Llevo más de 10 años usando Airbnb y puedo decir que este ha sido uno de los mejores alojamientos que he reservado. El hospedaje corresponde perfectamente a la descripción. Muy limpio, ordenado, bien dotado, agradable, y confortable. La llegada fue fácil, y se puede conseguir desde diferentes líneas de metro y diferentes líneas de buses. Está muy bien ubicado y la zona tiene mucho comercio por si se quiere comer en la calle o comprar algo para para preparar en el apartamento.
Khadija siempre estuvo muy atenta, fue muy comprensiva con algunas situaciones que surgieron, y demostró iniciativa en todo momento. Nos dejó muchas muestras de atención y cariño en todo el departamento, por lo que nos sentimos siempre muy consentidos de su parte. 1000% recomendado. Volveríamos nuevamente sin pensarlo dos veces.
This was my second stay.  Place is always extremely clean and well stocked.  Easy to access.  Great communication from owners.

This stay was everything I expected. It was lovely from start to finish. It smelled so good upon walking in every time and I loved the personalized sign as soon as I walked in the front door. The location is easy to find and do not get me started on the bed upstairs. It was so comfy, it felt like I was sleeping on a cloud. I also appreciated the snacks that were left for us to enjoy in the kitchen. The only con I did notice was the bathroom upstairs doesn’t accommodate tall people well. Anyone over 5’0 honestly. But the water pressure and water heat were amazing! Will stay here again if available the next time I am in Chicago.
Well priced, very convenient, exactly what I needed. Spent little time there, just needed a place to sleep, but still felt like I had my own spot being solo on the bottom floor.
It was perfect for all of our needs!! And the location was close to everything we wanted to do!
Thank you so much Andy & Diana. I really enjoyed meeting you and I loved your place. I will definitely book again in case of need. 5 stars!
The whole reason for the stay was to be close to Wrigley and that was definitely a huge plus. The proximity of this house was perfect. The hosts were great and the home was well done.
I stayed at Michael's place with my 2 kids and they loved watching the train from the window. The apartment was clean and very close to the best Chinatown's restaurants.
great location!

We had a wonderful time visiting Chicago and staying four nights in this apartment. The host was exceptional with communications before, during and after our stay and the instructions were clear. The apartment was REALLY clean. The kitchen included a full size frig, gas stove, air fryer, paper towels, coffee filters and "starter" coffee. The upstairs bedroom was like a suite, with table and couch and a mini frig. Both bathrooms had great lighting. We didn't use the backyard patio area, but it looked nice.
PARKING:We were able to park on the street directly in front of the apartment. There is a garage behind the apartment, but we never needed it.
LOCATION:The apartment was very convenient to getting downtown. There's a Target and other stores about a mile away.
We will definitly stay here again when we return to Chicago.
This apartment was described accurately by the host.  The nicest part was that it was clean!  Also,  it is so nice when the second bed is not a pullout couch!  We would stay with Iris again!
Overall it was a good stay. The room was a good value compared to nearby rentals. It could be good for staying a few days but maybe not for longer term stays like a week.

A luxurious gem, and the epitome of coziness! If you're looking for a plush, peaceful respite away from downtown but still close enough for comfortable day-access, look no further! I will certainly be looking for this airbnb first when I find myself in Chicago

Great Hyde Park location, steps to public transit and shops and restaurants.  Nice walk (about 1 mile) to Museum of Science and Industry,  Obama center and U of Chicago. Good for a short stay.  As described - note there is no wifi available.  Parking is limited but  free around the building and we had no problem finding a space. Apartment is very clean and adequately supplied, but in an old building so bit of a wait for hot water. We enjoyed our short stay.
Good stay with a good location.

We had a wonderful 3-night stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. The apartment was exactly as described—clean, modern, spacious, and very comfortable for our family. The two bedrooms and two bathrooms provided plenty of room, and the unit was well-stocked with everything we needed during our stay.
The location was outstanding. We were able to easily walk to many restaurants, attractions, and the Riverwalk, and having free parking included was a huge bonus in downtown Chicago. The rooftop deck offered great city views, and the building amenities were an added plus.
Communication with the host was excellent from booking through checkout. Check-in was smooth, instructions were clear, and any questions were answered promptly.
Overall, this was a fantastic home base for exploring Chicago. We appreciated the cleanliness, convenience, and thoughtful amenities, and we would happily stay here again on a future trip.

Milan and his home are exceptional! The host is very attentive and quick to reply while also making sure you are taken care of. The place is clean, spacious, and completely what you need if you are visiting Chicago. This will be my to go for when I come back to Chicago with such a convenient location and amenities. 5 starts all around. Thank you for everything Milan
Really nice place in Lincoln Park.  We could walk just about everywhere we wanted to go and take a Lyft/Uber anywhere else.  Very clean and organized.
Thanks 🤍
Bill and Susan thought of everything!! They were so sweet and accommodating. Very thoughtful and intentional with the small space. It was perfect for our family of 3.

I honestly can’t say enough good things about staying with Patrizia. This was, without a doubt, the best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. From the moment I arrived, she made me feel completely at home and every morning she set out a sweet little breakfast. What made this stay truly special, though, was Patrizia herself. She is warm, generous, thoughtful, and genuinely welcoming. I looked forward to our conversations when we would catch each other amongst our busy schedules, as they became one of my favorite parts of my stay. By the end of my visit, it felt less like I was staying in an Airbnb and more like I was staying with a friend. Her home is beautiful, comfortable, and filled with thoughtful touches and high-quality details. I left feeling incredibly grateful for her hospitality and genuinely fortunate to have met her. I look forward to staying in touch the lovely Patrizia!
Awesome location. David was very prompt in response. Overall had a good experience.
Adrian's place was great, very well furnished and nicely decorated. Lots of places to eat within a few minutes walk. would definitely recommend.
Great spacious apartment, centrally located and awesome check in instructions.
Aaron’s place is neat and cozy. I like the area too you can walk around and find some local cafes and train station is also walkable.
Great location, stay, and communication throughout. Everything was as described. Would recommend and look forward to coming back to stay with Kyriako again.

A great apartment. Close to several coffee shops, restaurants, and bars. Right off of the L and the Metra. Very walkable area, got to enjoy a couple nice runs in the mornings. Apartment was clean, well equipped, and comfortable. Laundry facilities were brilliant, even though we didn’t have need for them ourselves. Entry was easy, instructions were clear, and communication was great. Will definitely look this apartment up again the next time I’m in Chicago!
Peaceful and beautiful property  and neighborhood is a prime nice location.

This apartment is lovely. It's very comfortable, clean and convenient. The area is well located. It is on a busier street, however, it is easy to find parking (even right in front of the apartment) and it wasn't especially loud. Thank you Phoebe for a great stay!

We had a great stay at Assel's property! The apartment was as described and has everything we needed as a family of 4. The host shared clear directions and instructions for check in and check out so there was no room for confusion.  Oak St beach was only a 20 minute walk away and the kids loved spending time there! Public transport was super accessible and having free parking on the property itself was such a perk. Thank you,  Assel! We would definitely stay again the next time we're in Chicago!
Great time here at the Neighborhood Hotel. Would recommend, Room  is bigger than pictured. Everything was great about this stay,  Host was responsive as well.

We were in Chicago apartment hunting and the ease of interstate access, dedicated garage parking, and overall comfortable and spacious home made it easy to focus on our search! The neighborhood was peaceful and quiet. The kitchen was well appointed and having the office space really came in handy. I would absolutely recommend this place and would stay here again!
Great location and hospitality.

excelent home. Exactly like pictures and better.
Host is very responsive
Beautiful and immaculate home with all of the needed  amenities!  Laura was professional and very responsive regarding all communication. Great value for the money!

For anyone considering booking this place, here’s my honest experience. This was my first time staying in a home occupied by the host family. They do have a friendly cat and a toddler in the home. Since the basement is not separated by a door, conversations and movement from upstairs can be heard fairly clearly.
Personally, I wasn’t very comfortable using shared spaces like the kitchen while the family was home, and I think adding a microwave or air fryer to the basement would make the setup even better for guests.
That said, I’m still giving 5 stars because the listing was exactly as described, the space was extremely clean, and the family was very kind and welcoming. It’s no surprise this place has so many great reviews on it.

It was very comfortable and relaxing. Bed was comfy and the place was spot less and everything you need was right there. Definitely highly recommend and would stay again if I ever visit Chicago again.
clean place
Highly recommend & would go back

This was the perfect place to stay while in town for a concert at the United Center! Within easy walking distance so we didn't have to worry about transportation there. I was initially worried about parking since we arrived late, but we had no trouble parking right out front. Would stay again! :)
Affordable and easy to catch buses to downtown. Host J were responsive and friendly. Highly recommended.
good

Laura's home was perfect for our company of two couples with 2 separate bedrooms and bathrooms and spacious common area. We had everything we needed for three nights stay and felt safe. We were able to walk to all main landmarks , but for people with lower fitness level there is a public transportation available.
Laura was easy to reach, but instructions, directions and apartment itself were so good that that we didn't need to ask anything. Recommend!
Mera was a fantastic host! If you are looking to explore the neighborhoods around Chicago, I can’t recommend this place more. Hoping to stay again soon!
Felt like home staying here !
It was a good stay. It had exactly what I needed and was near some great restaurants.

Hands down, our stay was one of the best experiences we’ve had through Airbnb, and in Chicago overall.
The description of the accommodations was accurate, as were the reviews including that the noise from the traffic and Red Line is apparent. However, don’t let that stop you because the bed makes everything else fade away!! We didn’t even need the provided earplugs.
One of the days of our stay included inclement weather, but with two grocery stores within a block away, and a well stocked kitchen, we had everything we needed for a comfortable day in.
The shower was AMAZING, and check-in and check-out was seamless and hassle-free!
We look forward to staying again soon.
Great place !!

Nice apartment at a great price in the South Loop.  Milan provided great instructions on building/apartment access as well as how to get into the parking area.  It could have been confusing without the details provided!  The apartment was exactly as advertised, very clean and had a really nice view.  Definitely recommend staying here if you’re in the area

Jed’s place was a great fit for our visit to Chicago The apartment was in a great neighborhood location with restaurants right out the door and parks within walking distance. It was very clean and Jed was responsive and friendly. Check in and check out was easy and hassle free.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Great comfortable place to stay, super easy check-in and check-out! Would definitely be back.

We spent the majority of our time out enjoying the city, so didn’t spend too much time in Rafael’s place except for sleep, but it met our needs. The place was as described and in a great location close to the L.

Casper was an absolute delight. He was responsive, kind, and flexible! The place was perfect for our needs which was a work trip with three carpenters working 12 hour shifts. Already booked the place for the following week! Highly recommend if you’re looking for a place in the area. Also, my husband has been traveling to this area for seven weeks at different places and this was his favorite and parking was a BREEZE.

Quick walk to the Blue line, which we used very often during our stay. Easy to navigate into the heart of Chicago. Also easy to get to and from the airport. The place was clean and had the needed basics for the bathroom/kitchen. A/C was powerful, which was needed & very appreciated on some of those days. During check-in, the lockbox was unlocked, and the key was missing; however, we contacted the host, and there was a backup lockbox we were able to use, so that was fairly minor. Tony's grocery store was within walking distance and had great options if you're trying to do some cooking or get snacks for our adventures. We'll likely stay here again on our next Chicago visit. Thanks!
The best Airbnb I've ever stayed at. Dave was a fantastic host
Erica is so thoughtful and nice. I appreciate the concern and care to detail. The room is big and you definitely get your moneys worth considering the price.

I had to leave my booking with Owen and book another property in the MIDDLE of my vacation, due to how loud the neighborhood was, and especially after hearing TWO gunshots and constant slamming and ringing in the building from the outside neighbors. Not to mention, the area appears to be a little ran down, I just wish accurate pictures were included in the initial post of the property. I appreciate the ability to get in so easily though, but on the other hand, I would not book again. Owen was not even considerate and declined my request to shorten my stay after stating that I felt unsafe and was still willing to post a decent review. However, I still booked somewhere else in the downtown area and it was great. My trip was still amazing to Chicago, but I don’t like these types of issues.
Awesome private spot in a great party of the city. Hosts were responsive and flexible, thanks!
Great stay! Greg is super responsive and helpful. Great location.
Amazing kitchen, loved your tea selection. Very comfortable stay. Only thing to note is the stairs and pay attention to the instructions for the shower hot water.
Nice warm place. Would recommend!
Great home in a safe area of Chicago. Spent a few days here with my family and we all loved it!

Absolutely great location, if you’re traveling by car and want easy transit access it’s hard to find better. It’s a little shabbier than the pictures would indicate and if you’re tall there are some low clearances especially in the bathroom. But the beds were comfortable and it was surprisingly quiet given the proximity to Western Ave. Great value for the price.
Great hospitality, location, and Airbnb

Beautiful, spotless apartment in an amazing location. The host was responsive and the condo was well stocked. Beds and linens were comfortable, plenty of pillows, towels, paper and cleaning supplies. The security deposit and ID verification for booking was more than I expected, but understand for the security of the building. Just something to be aware of. Would definitely stay again!
Yo asistí a un concierto en el united center y quedo perfecto el hospedaje, muy cómodo todo y muy atentos los anfitriones

This was a beautiful place in a great location! Check in was easy and Tawney was very responsive and proactive with communication. The place was actually slightly larger than I expected, and tastefully decorated, which is always a pleasant surprise.
The location was ideal, very walkable to all the Lakeview neighborhoods (Wrigleyville, Northalstead, Lakeview East, etc). Lots of restaurants, grocery stores, shops. The L Red line (Belmont station) was only three or four blocks away, easy to get downtown. I would 100% stay here again!
Sidenote: I loved that the place was on the first floor, which meant it was easy to bring luggage in and out. But those who are sensitive to noise might want take that into consideration. It was never loud at all but occasionally there would be some traffic sounds (totally not a big deal for folks used to living in a big city).

James’s place was as advertised. It was spotlessly clean and pretty quiet. Dig the original tiles of the bathroom floor! It’s in a vibrant area with so many restaurants and transit options. The windows face the alley so street noise is minimal. There isn’t an elevator so I gained some fitness taking the stairs up to the fourth floor a few times a day!  Buses stop right on the corner and you are a 3-minute walk to multiple L lines. There is no parking for the unit so if you are driving and will be leaving the same way you came in, my pro tip is to park & ride. I used the Spot Hero app to check for parking in the neighborhood and the least expensive option was $158 for my 72 hours. Instead, I left my car at the Cumberland Park & Ride for $36 and bought a 3-day CTA pass for $15 and saved a bunch of money and even more driving stress. Anyway, James’s place is very nice, if a little pricey, but you get a clean, quiet studio apartment all to yourself in a fantastic neighborhood!

I couldn't have asked for a better location for our first visit to Chicago! Azam was extremely helpful and responsive to our questions. Will definitely be checking this location's availability first for our next trip :)
Joan was responsive and exactly what you would want in a host. The place was beautiful and I adored my stay!
Stay was great!  Thanks!
Great place to stay. Was able to walk to Wrigley with ease.

The place itself was nice, clean, and looked just like the photos. Unfortunately, the hosting experience wasn’t nearly as enjoyable.
Just be prepared to declare absolutely everything you plan to bring. It honestly felt more like checking through customs than checking into an Airbnb. I was asked to provide a full list of every guest, including full names, which felt unnecessarily intrusive and made us uncomfortable.
I also wasn’t planning on having a pet at the property, but one of my friends ended up bringing theirs. Since the listing stated that pets were allowed, I assumed that was fine. We were then charged a $50 pet cleaning fee. If that’s the policy, that’s okay—I just wish it had been communicated more clearly upfront so there weren’t any surprises.
Overall, the place itself was great. Just be aware that the host has very strict expectations and communication that may not be for everyone.

My daughters and I stayed here for 2 nights, and it was absolutely perfect. The apartment was so clean and comfortable. I also felt really safe, being that it was on the third floor.
The neighborhood was adorable and very walkable. We went to a Cubs game, and it was just a 10-15-minute walk. I am an Airbnb host as well, so I appreciate how fantastic this property was and how responsive Vin was as a host. I highly recommend and will be booking again next time we are in town!

We loved our stay here! The outside/inside of the building can look a little sketch, but once we got into our room it was perfect!! It was the perfect walking distance from main attractions. We felt safe and comfortable in our stay. The only thing I will say is if you’re here getting ready for an event there isn’t a tall standing mirror and the bathroom lighting isn’t amazing so I would bring a smaller mirror to get ready in front of the windows with natural light.
We loved our stay here and would happily stay again!
Sue and her home were outstanding! I would absolutely book a room with her again. Great location, clean, and such a friendly host.
exactly as advertised

Second time staying at Silvia’s home . Bed was comfortable room was comfortable and clean . Bathroom was always clean ! Which is a plus giving it’s a shared space . I walked to University Of Chicago Medicine Emergency everyday to get to work and it’s a good 15 minute walk . Grocery store at the corner . Always satisfied to stay here !
The location was nice and the neighborhood felt safe. The home was exactly as described and provided great amenities. We appreciated how well it accommodated our large group.

Clean, comfortable space in a great location. It’s a short walk to the Blue Line (great for access to O’Hare and the Loop). There are some great restaurants and shops, just a block away on Division, and a few blocks farther on North.  We would stay again.
Had a very pleasant stay, everything was as good as the listing described. Very excited to come again.

Great location right by Paulina brown line stop to get downtown easily. Fun bar right at the corner with a pool table. The place was clean and met our needs for a 2-day trip :) very clear check-in, check-out instructions and quick communication. Definitely recommend!

This place was perfect for our family of four! It is in a great location, just a short walk from the train station. It was clean and welcoming and the neighborhood felt safe and warm. A perfect place for any families Chicago stay!

We loved our stay here. It was comfortable and spacious our extended family, and we felt safe throughout our visit. The location was very convenient, with bus stops just steps from the entrance. Host was very responsive. Everything was as described and we would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!
The host was very friendly and helpful during our stay! Felt right at home
Flat was lovely; in a nice area and close to transport links. Laura was very proactive in helping us with an issue on our last day

Great place. Everything was exactly as described. Milan was very attentive and checked on our group daily to ensure things were going as they should. Will definitely stay again if the place is available!

Mark's place is exactly as it is pictured. Everything is clean, modern, and the place is beautifully decorated. The kitchen is extremely well supplied, including spices and coffee. We had a wonderful time and would love to be able to rent Mark's place again in the future.
great location! loved our stay!
Great place!
We had a great stay. It’s walkable to the blue line. There are nice restaurants and coffee shops just around the block. It’s walkable to the blue line, too.

Excellent place in a great neighborhood. Good grocery, food, and drink all within walking distance. Also very close to both buses and train to really get anywhere in the city. The place was very clean and quaint, the bed was very comfy, and the AC units worked well. 😁
Would absolutely stay here again...especially as a fan of Revolution, The Beer Temple, and Dark Matter Coffee. 😏

Al and his wife were very friendly and accommodating. Our room was clean and so comfortable as well as the bathroom. We slept great and enjoyed coming back here to relax after a long day of exploring. Highly recommend!!
We loved our stay at Kirsten’s. The neighborhood is quiet with some walkable gems. It’s a cozy space that is clean and the host is very friendly.
Very walkable area loved the inside of the place very nice stay overall!

Kim’s place was exactly what we needed! Our original plans fell through at the last minute, and Kim really saved the day by being able to host us on short notice. The place was very cozy, super clean, and had everything we needed for our stay. We also loved the location it was easy to get to both the Metra and the L, which made exploring the city really convenient. You honestly can’t beat the value for the location and amenities. We’d definitely stay here again and are so grateful Kim was able to help us out when we were in a pinch. We would gladly stay here again the next time we’re in Chicago!

Overall, our stay was mixed.
Mitesh send us a message of how to get in to the apartment and check-in was smooth. When we had an issue with the ceiling fan, he responded quickly.
Unfortunately there was constant loud noise from the apartment above us that continued late into the night and early morning. We contacted Mitesh and he said he would Tex the neighbors, but the noise continued for the rest of our stay.
We were in Chicago for our son’s graduation and after several sleepless nights, we decided to leave one day early, even though we had paid for all six nights. We ended up paying for a hotel just so we could get some sleep.
I understand Mitch can’t control his neighbors, but I was disappointed that he didn’t respond to my final messages even know I text him early in the morning to let him know that we were leaving a day earlier, no follow or apologies. future guests should know that noise from the upstairs apartment may be an issue

Great location, safe and clean. Very spacious for 2 people, very well equipped and close to great restaurants and bars. Iris was very responsive and gave clear instructions. Self check-in made it a breeze to check in at any time. Would highly recommend this place when you’re in Chicago!

Great little house in a beautiful and safe neighbourhood! Quick bus into downtown or train ride. House was clean and was perfect for our stay with our infant. Great host who communicated promptly! It was a little noisy from neighbours or down below at times which was the only negative.

This place was absolutely amazing and perfect for what we needed it for. When we first arrived the power was out (to no fault of the hosts) and Ari was very communicative and helpful throughout the time. Check in and out instructions were very clear and made our stay easy.

La casa de angelica es simplemente fantástica y tranquila, esta cerca del centro de un restaurante, sobre una pequeña avenida, está cerca de una estación de tren que nos ayudó a llegar al centro de Chicago en camión, definitivamente una gran experiencia hospedarnos en la casa de angelica, la comunicación fue excelente, la casa es justo como se muestra en las fotos, muy limpia, supero mis expectativas, angelica fue genial, sin lugar a duda, volveríamos a quedarnos en su casa, si tendría que definir nuestra estadía en una palabra sería “confortable”

Safe and comfortable.  Host was extremely accommodating and responsive. They let us extend checkout for a couple hours so my son and I could squeeze in one museum. The best review  actually comes from my 13 year old son who said after our first night "let's stay here every time we visit Chicago."

Great location and property layout. We loved walking to Old Town, Lincoln Park, the Lake Front Trail, and the Sedgewick "L" station.
However, the interior needs serious attention. The kitchen was unappealing - grimy appliances, food on the floor, a broken trash can lid, and poorly equipped. Glad we didn't plan to prepare a meal there - it would not have worked. Bathroom toilets and sinks were clean, but shower doors were covered in grime and shampoo splatters. The master bathtub had an "out of order" sign that looked like it had been there a while. There were dead bugs in the tub and very dim lighting.
Bedding was an issue: some bunks lacked top sheets, and the master king bed had a mismatched top sheet that didn't cover our feet. Dust was thick on the mirrors, and baseboards were missing. The neighborhood is awesome, and we were glad for the space, but we recommend looking elsewhere for a cleaner experience. Overall, shabby interior and exterior.

If you’re looking for a place near McCormick Center, this is where to stay! It was a 10 minute easy walk to the McCormick Center. It was very clean, easy to go in and out of, and the host, Milan, is very communicative.

Very nice spot to stay in! Close to vegan and gluten free restaurants for those with dietary restrictions. Close to the beach and bird sanctuary as well.
The host was very nice and responsive. The bed and couch were both quite comfortable (the bed has a softer kind of mattress and the fold-out couch is firmer). Full kitchen to cook in with kettles and coffee maker as well was convenient!
Very very well air conditioned, as well there being a ceiling fan an extra fan in the closet.
Could use some extra cleaning supplies, but it was a really great place to stay!!
I loved staying at this place! Super comfortable and felt safe. Lots of delicious restaurants around this area ! Super convenient if you are using public transportation
Fantastic stay! Little Italy is a great neighborhood with lots of restaurants, parks, and easy access to busses and trains.

We absolutely loved our stay at Stephanie and Zach’s place! The home was exactly as described, was literally a hop, skip, and a jump from the train station, bus stops and Wrigley Field (as well as excellent restaurants, convenient stores, grocery store, etc.). The home was clean, perfectly decorated and very spacious. Even with the L tracks behind the house, it was an overall quiet and peaceful space to come back to each day after our many adventures around the city. Stephanie and Zach were wonderful hosts, very communicative and accommodating, especially when our flight arrived in earlier than expected causing us to need a slightly earlier check-in. The home had everything we needed, plenty of linens and even a pack and play for the littlest member of our family!
