The bedroom is so much bigger than you realise, and nothing was too much trouble! We don’t drive but transport links into chicago are so easy from Erik’s place, THANKYOU SO MUCH we will never forget your kindness, Matthew & Hollie :)
Excelente anfitriones y el lugar con ubicación maravillosa

Sean's place is located in a great neighborhood and plenty big for our group. Everything was extremely clean and the house matched the pictures. My group and I had a lovely stay and it was great to be able to get to all of the cool places in minutes (with a car) -- thank you Sean!
This place is near the bus route and 6 min walk from red line which was really convenient. The place is clean and quiet

Cyndi's place was conveniently located near public transportation, making it easy for our family to explore the city. The space was perfect for our family of four, and we would definitely come back and stay here again.

We had a very nice stay and felt safe in the area. It wasn’t too difficult to park. Good value stay. There’s just a few suggestions I have to help future guests. In the house instructions, there’s two different instructions for the WiFi password. One says the password is located on the router, but that is incorrect. The other instruction has the correct password listed. This is a little confusing for guests but not a big deal at all. The AC was confusing as the instructions don’t explain that the thermostat isn’t for the AC unit despite it having a “cool” setting. There is a small separate AC unit that looks like a dehumidifier/humidifier combo. This caused confusion and led to the room becoming hot pretty quickly the second day. However, when I reached out to the host she called pretty quickly to explain that the AC was actually that small unit that looks like a dehumidifier. Lastly, lockbox is hard to open and hard to see. Unit was a little hard to find and was unsure which building.

We absolutely loved staying here! Elizabeth was very responsive and an excellent host. The space was well appointed and just right for us. The supply of coffee and snacks was a bonus! The home was in a beautiful neighborhood, and it was very convenient to walk to several restaurants, coffee shops, etc. We will definitely be back!
Awesome place and responsive and nice host parking is the only downside but overall 5 stars

Great location to do whatever ya want to do In North Chicago! Walking distance from Wrigley and many places to check out to eat and drink! If ya want to hit the Museums or Navy Pier. 2 bus stops and you are there! The place was beautifully clean and easy to find. Ani issues they were easy to access and communication was top notch! Perfectly priced and a great stay! Hope to come back again and sty a little longer! Thanks for having us Josh and company!!!
Muy acogedor el lugar, muy tranquilo, céntrico, restaurantes suficientes, me gustó y lo recomiendo.

Great location just steps from Wrigley Field, and Jason was a responsive, welcoming host who helped us sort out a small check-in hiccup right away. The house had some fun amenities but was scant in others, and could have used a deeper clean, though that seemed due to a tight turnover between guests. Overall a solid pick for a Cubs trip, and would recommend to a small group looking to go to a game or two!

This house  was perfect for our group of 9 and we hosted 20 relatives for dinner.  Much bigger than it looks from street.   It was spotless  and looked like it was just recently renovated.   I would definitely stay here again.  Overall the family voted it one of the best rentals  we have ever stayed in!

The home was beautiful and zero complaints. It appears as pictured and clean as well as comfortable. It is in a safe location and great for traveling to the conference we were attending. The neighborhood is quiet

The flat was a perfect place for my wife and I to spend a couple days visiting Chicago with our daughter and her partner. It has two beautiful bedrooms (plus a smaller third one with bunks if you need it) and a super comfortable living room for group lounging. We loved having drinks on the rooftop deck with an amazing view of the Chicago skyline. It's within easy walking distance of tons of restaurants and shops, and also close to a subway station if you want to go downtown. A   special thanks to John and Tracy for being so accommodating with our early arrival.

Really well maintained rooms that are placed conveniently for anyone who is traveling to chicago and plans to take the subway/public transit. Tons of amenities for an Airbnb and a very responsive and respectful host. 10/10.

David’s place was fantastic! The location was perfect for attending Cubs games at Wrigley Field and exploring the area. Everything was exactly as shown in the listing, clean, comfortable, and well maintained. We especially loved the thoughtful extras he left for us—they were such a sweet touch. Check-in was easy, communication was great, and check-out was effortless. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely book with David again. Highly recommend!

Location is at best and near to downtown. Bus stop is near to home and direct bus to all tourists’ locations. Parking space is also very convenient. Home space is best for family. Serge has provided good service; communication was very clear.
The location is great, the rooms are very small
Clean and convenient.
This place is awesome. Right in the middle of the action. Great host; communication was amazing. Definitely recommended.
Place was nice but very small. AC wasn’t working when we got there. Went back and forth on chat which she was very quick to respond, but didn’t get fixed until 2 days before we left.
We had a great stay here. The neighborhood is so peaceful and cute and lots of stuff around. Catherine was very responsive and helpful.

Erika is a great host. Very friendly & quick to respond.
The location can’t be beat for all things Wrigley. Not so close that you’re experiencing crazy noise levels or crowds, but just a quick walk to the stadium.
Exactly as described, very clean and a very helpful and responsive host!

We stayed there three days and enjoyed it so much! There was a park close to the home and it was very feasible for our daughter. You can also see a lake view from windows and little bit downtown view from kitchen windows!
we had a great stay! Lourdes was super responsive and communicated frequently.  The space was great! Make sure you visit Aztec Dave's down the street for awesome food and a fun vibe!

This is a beautiful, incredibly large home with high-end finishings and comfortable beds.  The location worked out great for me because I had a moving truck and could park nearby on Elston Avenue.  Otherwise, parking is a challenge and the neighborhood is adjacent to a more commercial district (fast food restaurants, gas station, etc.).  The location, however, is perfect for easy access to all of the surrounding neighborhoods.

Stayed here with three friends and we LOVED it! Everything was super comfortable and clean. It was also super close to public transportation so we didn’t have to get into our car a single time! 1000000% recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!
Always a great stay. Clean place, great area, very convenient. Loads of shops, places to eat and near lots of public transportation. Very nice and quiet area too
非常棒的房子，我带着两个孩子一起入住，非常愉快，下次来芝加哥还住这里

We loved our stay at Kate's place and the neighborhood itself was quiet and walkable. We walked to the lakeshore often and enjoyed the outdoor cafe nearby. The bedrooms were comfortable and the entire place was well-equipped.

Very nice area in the heart of Lakeview and very close to Wrigley Field.  Very clean and very well decorated. Great neighbors. The place is simply awesome. Larger than expected with a large living space and kitchen/dining area. Well worth it. Will be staying again.

Thank you so much for the opportunity to stay in your beautiful home, especially on such short notice. I truly appreciate your kindness and generosity in accommodating me. I had a wonderful stay and look forward to staying at your place again in the future. Thank you once again!
Great stay! Had a hard time getting the key to work on the lock but Sean was very responsive and helpful!
We loved our stay at the apartment! It was very walkable and accessible to downtown via the train.

C'est toujours un plaisir de louer l'appartement d'Alma.
Très pratique et bien localisé!
As always thanks again Nick for such an amazing stay! My go to place when I’m in town! ❤️❤️❤️
great space for family or large group
Very kind and helpful host. Made everything comfortable for our family traveling internationally and did not hesitate to help out wherever they could. Thank you!

Erica was very easy to communicate with and made check in super easy . Tried helping us with parking when they were doing street sweeping and we didn’t know what to do . The space is very clean and has lots of amenities if you forgot something . Pilsen is full of amazing culture and great food ! The Mexican Art Museum is free, close by and was a pleasure going. Would visit this area of Chicago again !
Loved the place, would definitely book again for my next visit.
Abby’s place never disappoints. It’s very good value-for-money option when in Chicago.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago. The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and very well equipped. The location was excellent, with easy access to restaurants, shops, and public transportation. Communication with the host was smooth and prompt, making the entire experience stress-free. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. We would happily stay here again!
Lovely and aesthetically pleasing space -- so great to have an office to work in! Super convenient to the L (airport and nearby spots) and really fantastic eats nearby.
Dan was so helpful with everything! The stay was perfect for a couple of nights after being out in the city.
The apartment was sparse, but clean and well appointed. The train was loud but we got used to it very quickly. Our 10 year old loved watching the trains drive past the back porch.

My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at Erin’s place. The host was very responsive and accommodating to our needs. The space was cozy, and the bed was super comfortable. It was a short walk to a nice coffee shop, October Cafe, which is across from the Norwood Park Metra station.

The place was great! The open ceilings on the bedrooms were not ideal but not a problem either.  The condo was within walking distance of the train, buses, restaurants and many tourist destinations.  The rooftop was cool and the common area downstairs added to the appeal.
I had guests from out of town and all was great, comfortable, easy access. Love the location and a very spacious place.

If you are sensitive to noises, this is not the place for you. The train track is right outside and they run throughout the day, people and children in the building are quite loud as well, you can hear them very clearly.
Other than that, I do think this is a great space. Clean, spacious and many great restaurants around and easy to catch the train and the bus. The host also very nice and responsive.
Great stay! So close to the stadium and loads of other things. Quick uber to the landmarks. As a couple, this space was perfect!
Nice stay that was right in the heart of River North.  We could walk to everything.
La verdad que cerca del transporte publico (a 300mts) con todo lo necesario, comodo y bien ubicado

the absolute perfect stay! much bigger than what the pictures show. lots of food, art & stores around & not too far from downtown. hosts are super sweet & very accommodating. 10/10 would stay again & recommended
We had a great stay! Cannot beat the location, especially with two little kids and being so close to Oz Park and the zoo. Michael was a great communicator and we would stay at his place again!

Gosh, where to start. TAIMS’s communication and quick response was world class. Apartment 1505 was extremely clean and brand new. We loved our stay! We where high enough that the train yard across the road did not bother us.
Parking was close by and the parking fee was part of the complete charge, I love that there were no hidden fees.
I would certainly recommend TAIMS’s and I would stay at their location/s again.
Keep up the what you are doing and don’t change your business recipe!
FYI: please adjust your over the toilet cabinet so that the shelve height does not impede toilet seats angle, lol.

The loft and apartment are well laid out and in a fantastic location, just two blocks from the red line and walkable to lots of good restaurants and bars. The rooftop is a great bonus. House has had some wear and tear since the  photos were taken.
Tucked away in the heart of Andersonville, this is a great spot! Would highly recommend.
We booked Elizabeth's place for our visiting family from Europe. What a great stay it was from them, peaceful, close to us and very welcoming. Highly recommand if you're ever visiting Chicago!
We had a very nice stay here. The apartment was spacious and clean. It's very close to the conference centre, ideal location if attending a conference here. Host was friendly and quick to respond.

Luke's place was perfect for us as it was a block from our son's place. The location is perfect if you want to stay in the Hyde Park area or close to U Chicago. It is an easy walk to grocery stores and places to eat. The place is super clean and has everything you need for a comfy stay. Luke is a great host!
Great place to stay! Clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

We had a great stay! The house was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described in the listing. The neighborhood was nice, and we felt comfortable throughout our stay. The host communicated thoroughly before and during our stay, making the entire process smooth and easy.
One suggestion I'd make is to add more seating in the common areas. The seating matched the listing, so there were no surprises, but I think investing in additional living room seating and perhaps a larger dining table would make a big difference. Since this home is designed to accommodate larger groups like ours, having enough space for everyone to sit together would really enhance the experience.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend this property to anyone visiting Chicago, especially larger groups.

The location is a plus for me because I was visiting family in Lakeview .  The apartment is a third floor flat , stairs no elevator , in an older brick building.  Geo responds within minutes .  I needed clarification on the check in instructions .  AC window units , gas stove .  I advised him that the tub drains very slowly .  He plans to correct that problem before the next guest arrives .  Lower priced than comparable units in the same area .

The house was nice. Nigam was a great host. The only recomendation I would have is the to provide extra chairs for the patio and a different dining table. 11 people couldnt sit and play board games at once. But an overall good experience
Had a great stay here was super nicely located and was also a lovely spot! I would definitely recommend anyone stay here

Great to be just a block from very good restaurants and bakeries. Then only another block to train station. We enjoyed walking every morning in Ping Tom park only two blocks down by the river. you can also pick up the water taxi to downtown in the park. The apartment was very clean and spotless. Neighborhood very quiet at night.
This is the second time in as many years that my wife and I have booked Keith's place. It is our go to Airbnb when in Chicago. It's perfect for our needs. Highly recommended.
The place was perfect and easily accessible to everything for our family! Would absolutely stay again

We really enjoyed working remotely at this Airbnb. It was very comfortable and spacious with everything we needed. We slept well and really appreciated the blackout curtains. The area was charming with restaurants and parks nearby. We would definitely come back!

Wonderful place in the perfect Lincoln Park location! This was an ideal stay for us and our young adult. The neighborhood is amazing — walkable restaurants, cute boutiques, a park right across the street, and an easy walk to Wrigley Field.
We loved being so close to some incredible food spots, including an amazing sushi restaurant around the corner where Cubs center fielder PCA even hangs out (and we got to see him!). Summer House is a beautiful restaurant with fantastic food, and Cedar Palace, a wonderful family-run Lebanese restaurant right across the street, was absolutely amazing.
The parking space was a huge bonus and made our stay even easier. The place was clean, comfortable, and surprisingly quiet. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Everything was perfect for our needs, and we would absolutely stay here again!
The apartment was very clean and had everything I needed for my stay; I would definitely stay there again!

Had a great stay. Everything was very clean and as described. The location was great for me because, though I didn’t spend much time in Lincoln Square,  it was easy to get to Uptown, Andersonville, and Logan Square. The train is very close by, but I mostly used Divvy bikes (never had an issue getting a bike or parking). Super comfy place to come back to at night!
I love the place. Great location it’s not so far from downtown but just a little bit out so less crowded. The owner commented a lot and was super helpful. I enjoyed my experience.

This was a gorgeous stay in a beautiful, walkable area that felt so safe. Ute’s home is like an art museum with so much to see around every corner! My husband and I could not get enough of the artwork! Bed was super cozy and the whole house was spotless. She even left a little treat for our pup Tulip who came with us! Street parking was a teensy bit tricky since we weren’t used to the city but we quickly figured it out! Even with the Cubs playing we still found a spot. We will definitely book here again if it’s available! Thank you so much for this amazing stay!

Amazing host and the perfect location. Less than 1 minute walk from wrigley. One bedroom and bath downstairs. Rest are upstairs in case u have elderly folks.
Ultimate Airbnb in the wrigley area !
The house was very nice. Clean, quiet and near everything we needed. The back porch was everything!
Great location, so much space and super clean and cute… love it and I’ll return
Great location. Gorgeous stay. I would give the walls a wipe down. Host doesn’t respond quickly, but that’s fine. Loved the place.

We absolutely loved our stay! I was in town with my grandson for a couple of baseball games, and this place was perfect for us. Mike was a fantastic host—very responsive and incredibly accommodating. He even allowed us to check in a bit early once the cleaners were done, which we really appreciated.
The two-bedroom setup was clean, comfortable, and felt like a home away from home. Mike also provided great restaurant recommendations—we especially loved the burger spot (a big win for my cheeseburger-loving grandson!).
The neighborhood felt safe and was great for walking around, with plenty to do nearby, including Wrigley Field. Overall, a wonderful experience. We would definitely stay here again the next time we’re in town. Thanks again, Mike!

A place to sleep is all you need! I wasn’t expecting anything crazy, I frequent hostels and know the run down. My roomates were cool, location was good. Generally pretty clean too. I’d stay here again for an affordable stay. Only downfall was the 8am rooftop construction. Pretty loud and didn’t go back to sleep.
I only booked here because of the price. I Wouldn’t stay here again though. Ana is very nice and very communicative though I will give her that.

The flat was really comfortable, close to subway and very walkable.
Super nice kitchen. Plenty of plates and cups, nice fridge and dishwasher.
Nice washer and dryer on the second floor. I would stay here again!

This was an awesome place in a cool area walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go.  It was clean and it was nice and hip and cute.   Playing pool was fun at night after running around all day.   Very spacious for our group.  Loved the extra large bathroom. We would definitely recommend.
great location.

This apartment is very cute and well appointed Dimitri is a responsive host. Unfortunately, I was very turned off by the proximity to the dog grooming place. There is a very thin wall and you can hear dogs, barking and people yelling at dogs all day and it also kind of smells bad in the apartment and definitely in the hallway where you get into the apartment you have to walk in through a back alley into a dark hallway that smells like wet dogs, yuck it is a very tiny apartment and there are no washer dryer so be prepared to go to a laundromat

Nikka is an amazing host! She made sure we had everything we needed and more! She was very responsive throughout our entire stay and was always willing to help. My one and only dilemma was that we kept finding human hairs on the floors as well as some surfaces were dusty and hadn’t been wiped. A very minuscule problem but nonetheless kind of annoying. All in All, I’d give Nikka’s place a 8.5/10. Very quaint and  cozy. Thank you for letting us enjoy your beautiful place Nikka!
I felt safe and the location was good.
exceptional host, very reasonable and clear! room was spotless and comfortable, unbeatable value.
Perfect  to stay for Cubs games.  Great host for a great place.  100% recommend,  book with confidence.
beautiful space in a fun neighborhood, with easy access to everything via walking and public transportation. looking forward to returning!
Great stay! Five stars.
Great location. Spacious apartment. Host very responsive. An issue came up and while a bit disruptive, host sought prompt solution.
房子非常舒适温馨！房间干净整洁，布置得非常有家的味道，生活用品一应俱全。我们全家在这里度过了一个非常愉快的假期，就像住在自己家一样自在。房东Lina人也很好，沟通很顺畅。强烈推荐给带家人旅行的朋友们！

We stayed for 2 nights while visiting Chicago, the home was very clean and felt cozy and welcoming. The host messaged clear instructions before check in. Inside the home is a book that was made giving recommendations for local stores, restaurants, transportation, and check out instructions. The street was quiet and most of the neighbors were out walking their dogs and were friendly. We were able to find a spot to park close to the house every time we needed to come back. The home had basic amenities, but for the time we actually spent in the home, it was plenty. It was about a 25 min drive into the city pending traffic. Overall it was a really enjoyable stay.

This place was fantastic. We stayed here so we could walk to Wrigley Field for Cubs games, but we loved the whole neighborhood. This is on a quiet, tree lined street and close by to the L and lots of stores and restaurants. Would definitely stay here again!
Great place! Perfect for our needs with a little one and dog. Great location, space is just as pictured and described. Bath products felt like a spa. Would recommend.
Pretty okay. Great location!
It was very nice and clean great for a getaway
Wonderful location!  Exactly what we needed for our short stay.  Wonderful communication.
Very clean and perfect space for me and my girlfriend! Parking was to hard either and the neighborhood is nice, not far from the city either. Was well over worth it!

The public parking lot was right outside. The area was safe, we walked everywhere. Check out Tilly’s Bagels for an awesome breakfast bagel, or 11 cities diner both are within walking distance. And for dinner Lou Malnati’s deep dish is around the corner!
The place is on the 13th floor and is really very nice and it was nice quiet. The beds were comfortable and the hosts had everything we needed. Would definitely stay here again when we come back to Chicago…
很好，非常推荐
We really enjoyed our stay. Neighborhood was amazing. The house was amazing. Hosts were amazing! All day everyday!
Very comfortable, clean space.  Great location, very peaceful and quiet and easily walkable.  Directions were easy to follow.  Will stay again soon!

Decent place for some rest and to spend a few days. Took my 15 year old son to a Cubs game and we enjoyed the area. It’s walking distance (1mile) to Wrigley Field! Street parking is free, but you may have to park a block or so away.. Neighborhood and area was chill and friendly.

Felt right at home and safe . Lashonda was a great host , she even took the time to introduce herself in person . I had no issues what so ever. I would stay again . 15 drive to downtown. Beautiful place .

What a fun place to stay with our family! There was plenty of  space for four adult couples to stay and enjoy! It was beautiful, clean, secure and in the coolest neighborhood! It’s surrounded by restaurants, shopping and is just a couple of blocks from good ole Wrigley Field! Brandon was very helpful and communicated with us promptly. The history and beauty of the brownstone and the furnishings were so appreciated. We absolutely loved it and would definitely stay there again. Thank you, Brandon!

The apartment was everything they said it would be and more. I was very happy there and wished I could have stayed longer. I will definitely stay there again if I need a place again. Their communication was outstanding, and they were very proactive and giving me information that I needed. They were also always very very friendly.

Everything was great and it felt right at home!
Any questions or concerns were addressed immediately! Would definitely book again!

Our family of five had a wonderful Chicago vacation thanks to Dan’s rental. The home is in a quiet, beautiful Old Town neighborhood and is conveniently close to two train lines, so we didn’t need a car. Rideshares were also quick and easy on rainy days.
The house was very clean, well-stocked with linens and kitchen essentials, and had plenty of storage space. Check-in was simple, and we loved the nearby restaurants and coffee spots. A nice bonus was the washer/dryer alert system on the TV, it was very convenient after long days out!
One small note: the master bedroom gets bright in the morning due to a skylight, so an eye mask may help. The other bedrooms have great blackout shades and worked perfectly for our kids.
Overall, everything was wonderful and truly added to a memorable family vacation. We would absolutely stay here again!
Brett was a great host!  We enjoyed our stay for the few days we were in Chicago.  Coffee each morning was delightful!  Thanks for a comfortable stay!
Nice place to stay

Чистый уютный дом с прекрасным расположением. О гостях подумали, есть всякие необходимые мелочи в ванной. Очень понравилась посуда и кухня в целом. Прекрасно проводили вечера на заднем дворе, который тоже хорошо оборудован. Немного не хватило прикроватного света с каждой стороны кровати, но это мелочи, которые не помешали прекрасно провести время.
Nice place!
Great location and well appointed. Our only complaint was that the bed could not be accessed from both sides and the fitted sheet appeared to be too small and kept slipping off.

This is the place to stay if you are in the area for an event at Wrigley Field or anything in the surrounding area! Jason's place is one of our all-time favorite Airbnb's and he's an outstanding host -- always responsive and generously offering of tips and suggestions. (His area parking video is a really nice touch.)
Catfish Flat is spacious by city Airbnb standards, and quite comfortable. It was well appointed and very clean. This is the first Airbnb we've stayed in which has a component stereo system along with a selection of vinyl albums by artists with Chicago origins -- another nice touch.
During our stay we enjoyed a number of excellent restaurants, cafes, bar, and breweries all within walking distance. Definitely check out The Long Room which Jason owns.
Enjoyed staying at Dave’s Airbnb. It’s a great place and perfect location.
I would recommend this place to anyone visiting the Chicago area and will definitely look to book this place again on our next visit!
Exceptional Lincoln park gem.  Great unit, great location, very proactive and warm hosts, beautifully decorated and maintained.

We loved how close it was to the Blue Line and some bus stops while still being very peaceful and quiet in the evening. The Airbnb was very clean and felt like home. Hosts were helpful and accommodating as well.

The key here is to READ WHAT ASHLEY SENDS you! If you do, things should be easy. It's not complicated, but she's very clear about the realities of this very old, wonderful house with a spectacular tree in the front courtyard. I had quite-frustrating and time-consuming issues with the online check-in process (don't use military time, consider not using Chrome...) but Ashley (who I didn't meet inperson) was very responsive & as helpful as she could be. You DO NEED to check in ahead of time. My room was quiet and comfortable, bed nice. The (shared bathroom = no problem for me) shower is in a claw-foot tub if you have mobility issues, and the stairs are steep if you stay upstairs. The self-serve breakfast has protein and cereals and teas = perfectly adequate. I will definitely stay in this quirky but perfectly-located place again.
立地が良く便利な場所にあり、スーパーやカフェがすぐそばにあります。とてもおしゃれで清潔感もあります。おすすめです

The space was clean, comfortable, and as described, and the host was responsive throughout our stay. One thing future guests should know: we stayed during Puerto Rican Fest, and the area was extremely congested. Getting an Uber was difficult, and at times we had to walk close to a mile to reach a pickup point because of road closures and traffic.
Overall, we had a good stay + the host was super accommodating, but it’s worth keeping these things in mind when booking!

Great home in a great neighborhood. The house had plenty of space, it was in great condition, and it was in a quiet neighborhood. Plenty of parking and walkable to coffee shops and grocery stores. The house was well-stocked with necessities (paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, etc.) and linens and towels for each bed. Overall, a great stay!
This is a lovely one bedroom place to stay while visiting Chicago.  Bed was comfortable, and it was exactly how I was expecting it to be. The house were lovely and friendly and helpful.

We had a great stay! The property was clean, comfortable, and as described. The location was convenient, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our visit. Everything was well organized, making for a relaxing and enjoyable experience. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others.
Thank you for a great stay!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Great place! Very responsive hosts and would stay again.

Our 16th floor unit was centrally located in the South Loop area of downtown Chicago and walkable to the beach and many local restaurants and shopping. Understand that you are in a densely populated urban area with many high-rise buildings. While on the street noise was minimal between 10 PM and 7 AM, the big city does wake up and you should anticipate local noise. Instructions for getting into the unit were very clear with step-by-step photos and instructions.
The unit was clean and tidy with a full kitchen. To help with fresh air circulation, we cracked open the window near the kitchen and master bathroom. We enjoyed our stay and recommend this property.

While the hallway immediately outside smells like smoke and pee, the inside is truly a haven. It’s as clean as a proper hotel room, linens and mattress were so comfortable, air conditioning in every room for the Chicago summers, and all the appliances were new. The couch is unfortunately very saggy now. I would suggest replacing it (can’t really sit for long periods). Also, some of the wall outlets are falling out, and a bunch of the lights weren’t plugged in (?) with no outlet nearby? So there are some minor house things to be upgraded, but it felt like our little clean hotel haven for less than hotel prices. Pretty much between Chicago downtown and airport.
CAREFUL ABOUT PARKING: side of the street closest to the building is no parking 7-9am weekdays. Opposite side of the street is no parking 4-6pm weekdays. We got ticketed, so might be better to go into the residential area nearby.
Good place. Would recommend. The check in wasn’t as bad as everyone was saying.

We had a great stay and would definitely come back. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Our favorite part was the rooftop area—it was the perfect place to relax, hang out, and enjoy the views after a day out. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and we highly recommend staying here!

This is my second time staying here and I am so happy I did! The room was spacious and exctalty as described. Everything was clean and held to a high standard. Let us check in early and was incredibly accommodating throughout our stay. Was proactive in communicating. I feel so comfortable in this space and it just made for a marvelous place to stay during our vacation!

Staying with Abby exceeded our expectations. It was clean, smelled nice, and more private than we initially thought. She provided us with parking the 3 days we were there which was very helpful as well! Will be staying again when we come back😊

Sharon's place was great for our short 2 night stay in Chicago for some concerts.  Walkable to the L and convenient shopping for groceries and such in a quiet and safe neighborhood.  We did not drive but there appeared to be ample parking on the street.  As others have mentioned you can hear footsteps between the apartments, but it is an old building and did not impact our stay.

Victor was always responsive.
At any time he would immediately communicate with me about what I needed.
He takes a good care of his rental property, and his property is in a good shape. I would stay again next time for sure, and it’s a great place to stay.

Nat was a great host. This was my first Airbnb experience. She helped with check in and responded fast when I had an issue. She also checked in to see if I needed anything and if there was any she could do to make our stay better.
Great stay! Just a short walk to the green line and close to multiple fast food spots. Perfect for getting to and from Downtown Chicago.

We loved the view here. Location is great. Walkable to most things we needed or got an Uber quickly. Lots of local shops and food.Good farmer’s market on Saturday. The owner was quick to respond to any of our needs even late at night. One thing to know is that is right by the L train. Don’t let that deter you. During the day, you do hear it but at night while sleeping I did not hear it. We have stayed in other places that it was so loud. I did not lose sleep this time even being by it. We would definitely stay here again. Our daughter lives in Chicago and this was only a couple blocks from her.
Gracias Ben, volveremos pronto
This Airbnb was perfect for what we needed! Clean, spacious, convenient location, and with all the necessary supplies. Wesley was very responsive throughout as well.

Five stars are simply not enough! Highly recommended
I want to thank you for everything. Two nights were nowhere near enough I truly wish I could have stayed longer, and I will definitely be coming back.
I booked this room urgently after canceling my original reservation due to hygiene concerns, and I couldn’t have made a better choice. Thank you for welcoming me on such short notice.
The hosts were incredibly kind, friendly, and caring. They treated me like family, regularly checking in to make sure I had everything I needed and that I am safe. We even enjoyed some lovely conversations together during my stay.
Communication was excellent throughout fast, clear, and always helpful.
• The room was comfortable, spotless, bright, and smelled wonderful. The bed was extremely comfortable, and both the room and bathroom were exceptionally clean. Fresh, clean towels were also provided.
• The house amenities were great. The kitchen was well-equipped, and the iron came in very handy
🙏🏻🙏🏻💜💜
Just as pictured. Well appointed. Clean, comfortable and very walkable. We enjoyed the stay and would definitely book again! Thanks!
Top notch stay! Clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Great host, smooth check-in, and excellent communication. Would definitely stay here again

We had a wonderful stay at this condo in Chicago. The space was exceptionally clean, modern, and well-maintained. It was ideal for our young family, with plenty of room for us and our toddler to be comfortable. The location was great, and the condo had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to other families visiting Chicago.
Looks exactly like the photos and everywhere was clean and spotless. They had all the essentials such as towels, toiletries, etc. This location is less than 30 minutes away from downtown.
Walking distance to Southport and Wrigley Field. We enjoyed our stay.
Perfect for a quick trip to Chicago. Would definitely stay here again!
Absolutely wonderful host ! Such a lovely well maintained spot , such a fun neighbourhood and had a wonderful time in Chicago!

Being in town for a concert at The Vic, Cathy's place was a perfect location, especially with the parking spot included.  We were able to park the car and just walk everywhere in the Lake View neighborhood.  Clear, detailed instructions were given and a lot of little extras provided which we appreciated.
Geo helped me out when the previous Airbnb was not exactly what was shown in the pictures. He was very responsive and acted fast when I was in pinch. Would for sure stay again.

Awesome location and spacious apartment! Easy to access busses and lots of restaurants, etc nearby. The place was tidy. It seemed like it had been regularly cleaned between guests, but is in need of a deep cleaning. Had a noticeable odor — both from cheap cleaning supplies and an underlying dirty smell. Despite that, it had great bones, a comfortable bed, good layout and an awesome location, so we had a nice stay!

I am a repeat guest at this house. Very nice location. Much closer to downtown Chicago than one might think (literally 20 minutes on the subway). The rooms are large and very comfortable. Ryan was a responsive host and sent me many suggestions on things to do in the area. I highly recommend.

Great location and comfortable space! The restaurant downstairs is great, and there were so many walkable stores and food spots. The apartment was more spacious then we expected and supplied with all the necessities.

This place was perfect for our family trip to Chicago. Traveling with a small child and extended family, everyone had space to feel comfortable. We stayed in the top-floor suite, while other family members stayed on the middle floor, and the first floor was a great shared space to gather, eat, and spend time together.
The home was very clean, and the hosts were super responsive, kind, and communicative.
We loved the separate desk area (great for morning work), the large bathroom, and the balcony on top floor. After full days together, it was the perfect spot to unwind—baths, bedtime, then relaxing on the balcony in the evenings.
Lovely coffee shop next door and Bartelme (Mary) Park a block away (great for dog watching and letting our child run around). A small grocery across the street made it easy to grab everything we needed.
Getting around was simple. We took the L from the airport and had easy access to everything, whether by train, car, or walking.
Had a great stay. Kim responds quickly. Street parking was not too hard to find.
Thanks for hosting, loved your place - it was the kind of visit that made me want to find a place in your neighborhood :)

We stayed for three nights while visiting Chicago for two Cubs games at Wrigley Field. The location was convenient. The apartment was very clean, and everything was just as described. We had a great stay and would happily book again.

The location and flat looked so perfect I wondered if it was going to be real. It all was exactly as advertised. The complimentary parking made it even better.   I decided on this unit because of the reviews.  I concur that Rasheed’s care makes this an easy place to use as a home base in Chicago.

We had a wonderful time staying at Sleepy Suites and will be back again. We are often looking to stay in the Lincoln Park area as we visit family close by. I love that so much is walkable and access to the brown line is an ease. The Sleepy Suites communications allowed for an easy check in and check out and process.
I was able to park for free on the street very easily. There were plenty of spaces when I needed them.

While the bathroom was particularly grimy, my main thoughts are about the “3 beds”. There is 1 bed and 2 VERY thin couches. Like so thin you could only sleep on one half because you could feel the metal bar of the couch against your back if you tried sleeping in the middle.
Poor insolation too. We had to crank the AC way up (granted it was a pretty hot week but the cool air just wouldn’t stick around).
I understand other listings in the area are a similar price but it felt like a lot to drop on very little.
The location was definitely the best part. We were within walking distance of just about everything chicago had to offer that wasn’t the bean (the water, great restaurants, nice coffee shops, etc) and when we got used to the access app it was very convenient (plus this unit is literally the closest to the buildings door which was great)

We loved our stay here. It was exactly as described and was well appointed, from the bedrooms to the living room to the kitchen. We wanted for nothing. On top of that, Marteki was an excellent communicator.
We will most definitely be back.
Thank you, Marteki.
Chris
Tasha's place was great.
The stay matched its description, was clean, and comfortable. Great location for travelers wanting a location between the city and ORD.

We had a great time staying here! The place was clean and within walking distance to lots of good food and fun. We walked to a cubs game which was so fun. We were thankful for the covered parking!  The only complaints we have are the bed being super uncomfortable and the showers water pressure not being super great. My boyfriend and I couldn’t wait to get home our own bed and shower. Other than that it was a fantastic stay and would recommend!!

The place was fantastic!!! Steps from Wrigley and all the action. A short train ride to downtown. The place was exactly as described. Neat & clean.
Thank you!!
nice stay
The host is really accommodating to my requests

Great stay! Very convenient for public transportation! Nice having two bathrooms. You can hear the train, but really not a bother at all. None of us needed the earplugs, but they were provided if needed.

This was a great stay for the price, in a location that was easy for commuting downtown for work. Nala and Owen reached out proactively after booking to clarify some of the noise-related reviews left previously, which was greatly appreciated. While I did not find the apartment’s noise level to be out of the ordinary, the noise machine included in the bedroom was a thoughtful touch. I will stay again if I need a short-term rental near the city!
Thanks

Jean has done a beautiful job of creating an urban oasis in Bucktown.  The original character of the apartment plus the outdoor landscaping creates a relaxing and refreshing respite in the midst of the city.  We really enjoyed our stay.

NOT PET FRIENDLY! Greeted by funky odor (to be fair, it’s been rainy and unit is half underground) and a dead cockroach. Taking in the rest of the space, I found 2 more live roaches roaming (1 in shower) and 2 additional dead ones scattered. I’m traveling with a cat. The listing’s set to allow for early check-ins upon request. On my way (after it had already been confirmed) Kyriako called to inform me that he was unsure why this was allowed bc they actually had their exterminator coming that morning. This was totally fine. Exterminator Aaron was the main reason I remained for part of my stay. “Normally I come now, guests check in at 4, and they’re nonethewiser.” Welp. Ended up killing nearly 20 nasty giant cockroaches over 3 horrible days and sending my cat home with my parents while I scrambled for alternate accommodations. Texted host at # from earlier call, no response bc “iMessage filters”. Better to message them on AirBnB. Seem well-meaning. Great design concept, poor execution :(

The apartment overall was excellent. It is in a great, walkable location for Hyde Park and U Chicago (15–20 minute walk). The apartment was spacious, extremely clean, had a beautiful lake view, and the rock-and-roll theme was a nice touch. Free on street parking was not hard to find within a block or so and Katty was responsive throughout our stay.
We did experience a significant check-in issue. Three minutes before our scheduled 3:00 p.m. check-in, we were notified of a delay that was initially attributed to cleaning, then maintenance, and ultimately a power issue that prevented access to the unit for the first night. We were offered an alternative unit, but the location did not work for our trip. We secured a room elsewhere for the night and received access to the apartment on day two. Katty refunded the first night's stay, which we appreciated.
Despite a stressful start, the remainder of our stay was very enjoyable and I suspect our experience was an isolated incident.
It was perfect for what we were looking for.

Stayed in the middle of the week for a work trip and it was the perfect spot. Clean, cozy and quiet. Was able to get work done from the location and relax but also enjoyed the local shops that I could walk to. I was not a fan of Chicago until this stay where I was able to quickly get downtown and enjoy the city but return back to the peaceful neighborhood to wind down. I can't wait to return!!!!
Good location to walk to the park and aquarium, first trip to Chicago and it was a quiet and safe.
Really enjoyed my stay! The host was very nice and great with communication. Nice clean spaces and very quiet at night. Would definitely recommend.
We had a wonderful stay. Conveniently located near Northwestern campus.
Ariel was a pleasure to work with and her place was absolutely perfect! I highly recommend ! Thank you Ariel!

Very nice place - clean, well furnished, great bathroom, big tv, hotel-like bed and comforter. Felt very private. Entry was easy. Minor complaint, the room was not well air-conditioned but the temperature was tolerable. The weather outside was 70-80 degrees. There was no thermostat in our room, so it does not appear that guests have control over temperature. We did not contact the host about the temperature setting, so we don't know if she would have changed it or directed us to the thermostat had we asked. Otherwise, the condition of the room was excellent, the neighborhood was quiet and safe, and extremely close to green line train stop, so it was easy and convenient to  get downtown.

Great place for money especially in chicago. the home and host was great. be prepared to walk to get transportation, drive yourself or spend a decent amount daily for ride share. overall I would do this place again.
House was great and location was perfect.

David’s place was better than what we were hoping for. The area was perfect as we love Ravenswood and how peaceful it is. The kitchen was stocked with everything needed and the cherry on top was my daughter being so close to us! Parking not too bad - we just needed to look a bit! Loved even about this place and plan on returning in the future!
Nice home with lots of space to relax downstairs.

Amazing stay.  I especially appreciate when a vacation rental includes amenities similar to what I would find in a 5 star hotel…. and this place exceeded that!  Checking in after a long travel day and having ice cold water waiting in the fridge for us was priceless!  Cannot beat this location for Chicago baseball.  Short walk to Wrigley for Cubs game.  Short walk to red line that takes you direct to White Sox park.  And being able to come back to a quiet and quaint street… just one of our best experiences.  Don’t think twice…. book it.

The place was clean and in a great location, which we really appreciated. However, the elevator did not work the entire time we were there, and the apartment is on the 3rd floor. We were traveling with two babies and a lot of luggage/strollers, so getting everything up and down the stairs was very difficult. There were also only two towels provided for a full week for two adults and two kids, which was challenging. On day five, they did bring us two more towels, and we were grateful for that. Overall, the space itself was nice, but the elevator issue and limited towels made the stay harder than expected for our family.
Good location and perfect rental for a group. Was there for a boys weekend and the space was fantastic. Short walk to the Blue Line. Would recommend
Great stay! Great location!

Although the Airbnb was clean the atmosphere of the place is worth 3/5 stars. We were instructed many times to be mindful about the noise level and volume that comes from our guests, however what appeared to be the tenants did not follow the same rules. For our 2 night stay, at 11:30pm until 1:30am the tenants decided to have an outside gathering that was filled with yelling, and cursing directly outside the bedroom window. What this Airbnb failed to mention was the shared patio space in between the two buildings is directly outside your window and you can hear everything going on outside. Despite mentioning the noise to the host, it happened again the next night. Again, great location in terms of being close to downtown, but not ideal if you enjoy a restful nights sleep.

We loved staying here.  It was perfect for our family to use as a home base to explore Edgewater and Andersonville or take the train for adventures downtown.  Our host Robert was amazing - super responsive and thoughtful.  It was obvious that a lot of care and love had been put into the apartment.  Wonderful, spacious kitchen for cooking. We loved that there were at least 4 different ways to make coffee :)

This home was great in every way! From the amenities to the host’s quick response time, everything exceeded our expectations. Our family truly felt at home, with plenty of space to relax and enjoy some quiet time during our mini weekend getaway. If we’re ever back in the Chicago area, we would definitely stay at Bee’s Knees again.
Great place! Lovely and well maintained. We stayed there with our family of 4 that included two college aged boys. There was plenty of room!  It’s beautifully decorated!
Great location clean and easy check out

Las tohallas sucias con manchas que parecían maquillaje o sangre mal lavada. Mancha de maquillaje en la sabana. Pedí cambio pero en 5 días nadie las cambió. El extractor de aire del baño estaba viejo y necesita un cambio.
We enjoyed our stay at Hazel’s place. Very clean and looked just like the photos. We loved walking the neighborhood in the evenings and taking our kids to the local park a few blocks away.

The Dorchester was exactly what we needed! The house is Gorgeous and so well-stocked. Every room has so much personality and charm. The location can’t be beat too. Close to the University and just a couple blocks from the new Presidential Center. Sharon was super responsive if we needed anything. We’ll be back!

The house really was spotless!  Location was great for us. Walkable to wedding venue, beach, Wrigley field and beautiful surrounding neighborhoods. We didn’t cook as there were many restaurants close by but appreciated having coffee available in the morning. Parking on street easy and free. Beds soft and comfortable, as was living room area. Plenty of towels and other supplies. Also nice to have super quiet window air conditioners! Certainly more value for more people but the one bath might be tight for 6 people. Would stay again!
Great location! Near Wilson train station and cute neighborhood. Great coffee shops nearby. Within walking distance of Montrose beach

Evgenii’s place great! It was clean, quiet and peaceful! He is a man of few words but very assessable since he lives on the property. The mattress could have been a little more comfortable but overall it was a nice stay.

Lesley is a very friendly host and made the communication very easy.
The place is comfortable, clean and quite.

There was a huge  storm that came in and it  forced me to cancel the hotel I had booked for 5 days due to a power outage it had, and luckily, she had a cancellation as well -so we were a perfect match!  It felt like we were rescued. We had to come in really late as well,  but it was very easy to follow the instruction for entry. From there, I really appreciated how clean and organized everything was, everything we needed was right there. The apartment was a breath of fresh air. Gorgeous views, spotless, and easy to get in and out of. She was very communicative and accommodating from the start. I’d absolutely recommend and would stay there again! It gave us a true Chicago city experience.  Thank you for  the wonderful stay!

We had stayed with Aaron previously in the apartment just upstairs, so we already knew we were in for a great stay, but this place was even better than expected. It’s so weird (complementary) and it truly felt like a second home. The best. Will stay again

We enjoyed out stay- lots of room forour group, well equipped kitchen. Parks and restaurants in walking distance as was the bus to Wrigley Field.
Johnnie responds quickly to questions. Easy check in.

Great location
near everything within driving distance

Perfect for a couple. Don’t have to worry about doing chores before check out like many Airbnb’s. Clean, cute, and cozy felt right at home. Not the safest area, just be aware of surroundings at night if you’re unfamiliar of course. Wonderful hosts made me feel safe and taken care of during my stay! I would definitely re-book!

This was a great place for a big group.  Fresh eggs in the fridge from the backyard chickens was great.  Off street parking in the driveway was also great.  Clean place and everything we needed was there.  Loved it!
Very convenient spot; location is great & easily accessible to the CTA Red Line & Bus Stops nearby.

Close to transportation, shopping, food and my daughter .   The garage was great to have private access and use to charge two mobility scooters without have to remove the batteries.   And being a bit of a collector and finding some cool estate sales it was easy to store items and have things broken down and take them to UPS to be professionally wrapped.    The neighborhood is extremely safe and the food around the neighborhood was great.   The unit itself was very clean and was easy to come home too.   The communication was very easy.   This was an easy trip because everything just worked perfect.    Thank you for to wonderful place to stay.
nice stay

I had a wonderful stay with Gloria! The accommodations were exceptionally clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully maintained. One of my favorite features was the beautiful outdoor patio—it was the perfect place to relax and unwind after a busy day.
Gloria was a warm and welcoming host, and I truly enjoyed our conversations. She made me feel right at home from the moment I arrived.
I also have to mention Zoey. As someone who is typically afraid of dogs, I was amazed by how gentle and respectful she was. She gave me space while still being friendly, and by the end of my stay, I found myself much more comfortable around dogs because of her.
I highly recommend staying here and would gladly return in the future. Thank you, Gloria, for such a pleasant and memorable experience!

What a great place! Super cute, clean and cozy place on a beautiful quiet street in one of the best neighborhoods! Close to the blue line, shops and restaurants. Parking was a breeze, parked right in front the whole trip. The place itself was perfect for our needs, the finishes and decor were very nice. The host was very communicative. We would definitely stay here again!

We loved our stay here! The house is spacious and in a beautiful neighborhood. It felt like we were staying in a little piece of Chicago history. Within easy walking distance to the Red Line and the lakeshore, with a great deli, coffee shops, and entertainment venues all within a few blocks.

Todo estubo muy bien. Muy limpio y comodo para descansar. El unico inconveniente es que Internet es lento.
Se puede estacionar en la calle con el permiso que el anfitrión te proporciona, pero no siempre hay lugar cerca.

Convent location that is right off the train line made it so easy to get round. It’s also a short car ride to just about anywhere you’d want to go.
I should have believed other guests’ the city noise comments, there is a fire station across the street, but the host generously provided earplugs for each night I was there and they did help.
Host was responsive to questions and clear in communication. The building was quiet with other guests that respected quiet hours. Overall, a great value stay.
Great location! Nice place!

This was a nice place that is exactly like the photos show. The neighborhood is a very diverse experience. It was a little farther away from the center of town, we didn't rent a car and thought it would be much easier to navigate public transportation, (but that's not the hosts' fault). They do offer off-street parking, there were bike share rentals very close by and Uber wasn't very expensive.

The place was great. Super clean, really comfortable bed, wonderful location. Mera was very helpful when I was having an issue finding instructions to get into the building. I’d definitely recommend staying here.

Heidi was a great host—friendly and kind, responded to messages right away.
It was like staying at a friend’s house. She even greeted us with a plate of fresh cherries from her tree. Delicious!

This place was great. The neighborhood was quiet and the train stop is super close. The apartment is big enough for a large group to have some privacy, but the layout made it easy for us to hang out together when we wanted to.
great host. wonderful location. unit was clean and as described.

Great little apartment, perfect for two. It was very clean, in an excellent location, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We had our best time in Chicago and would definitely stay here again!

Check in was easy, and the space had pretty much everything we needed. As Olga noted, the ceiling can be short in areas, especially the shower. However, our stay was worth the price and we enjoyed it!

We had two other couples and our adult son with us. Everyone felt they had the space they needed. The gathering areas were perfect for our visit. We loved having a BBQ! It wasn’t hard to get ride shares and walking to the train was safe and a short distance. Rib is a great host and made an effort to make us comfortable!

Our stay with Anny was the best. The price is unbeatable for the location. We had a very easy time getting around and taking the CTA, with the station being less than a 10 minute walk away. Getting to the city and O'hare was easy. We felt very safe, and the home has many locks and codes to ensure safety. We felt the room was very cozy yet comfortable. It was the perfect amount of room for two people. Although this listing is the only room in the house without a connecting ensuite bathroom, we had no complaints in terms of privacy. We surprisingly didn't bump into any of our neighbors during the whole stay.
Anny was also very communicative about the shared spaces and the potential for loud noise. We had no experience with loudness or any disturbances (we stayed sunday-tuesday). It was a very peaceful stay. She also made sure to send very clear instructions. Overall, Anny's home was the perfect place for us to relax after being out exploring the city all day.
Very nice lakeside place. Incredible patio for BBqs. Very good communication

not a bad bnb but it would’ve been nice if i knew i was sharing it with 2-3 other roommates lol until last minute. also saw multiple roaches  🪳 and i hope i didn’t bring nothing home . also window don’t close all the way. not a biggie ig but when it rains it could leak. wasn’t bad place to sleep but it could’ve been better fs

Good place if you don’t mind the shared space. I only ran into someone twice and otherwise avoided making contact with anyone else, it’s a guessing game to know if the noise is coming from inside or outside. Place was very clean and she was kind enough to have spare keys when I lost mine.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Nos encantó nuestra estancia. Desde el primer momento nos sentimos como en casa. Todo estaba muy limpio, organizado y cuidado. El anfitrión fue muy amable y siempre estuvo disponible para ayudarnos, debido a que experimentamos una mala situacion de que se fue la luz pero siempre estuvo accessible para ayudarnos, Agradecemos mucho la hospitalidad y la excelente atención. Sin duda recomendamos este lugar al 100% y esperamos regresar pronto.

Loved the kitchen, had spices, oil, utensils, a microwave, water filter, electric kettle, toaster, oven and dish washer. Everything you could need for an Airbnb kitchen! The room was nice, everything is very clean and spotless. There’s a mini fridge in the room as well as a full size fridge in the kitchen. There was even a makeup mirror! I liked the shower robes as an added bonus. I did struggle to use the TV, sometimes the buttons didn’t work to the point that I gave up trying to use it, but I don’t generally watch TV anyways so it wasn’t a big deal. I liked the laundry room too, they even had dryer sheets and detergent available. Overall a great stay!
Better have your own slippers. Floor is dirty and you’re not allowed to bring shoes in. Not even a pair of slippers in the SHARED bathroom.

Just returned from spending 4.5 amazing days in Chicago!  Jake's place is in a terrific location; the unit was exactly as described - everything was great from the kitchen to the bedrooms.  Very comfortable; close to trains, restaurants etc.  Would definitely give it two thumbs up!
Place was very clean, Dominique is very nice host would definitely stay again
I would recommend to anyone traveling to Chicago
The space was average, AC was very loud, beds were not great. Very cheap furniture.Stairs are very steep. The location was good for a Sox game.

Alles wie beschrieben.  Unkompliziert. Gute Ausstattung. Der Wasserdruck in der Dusche etwas gering, aber hier normal. Top Lage um unseren Sohn an der DePaul University zu besuchen. Ruhige und sichere Wohngegend. U-Bahn und Bikeshare in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß zu erreichen. Ausflug zum Lake sehr zu empfehlen. Es sind kaum alternative Hotelzimmer oder Appartements für den Preis zu bekommen.
Thanks a lot! I enjoyed staying in Chicago!!!

We had a great stay at Angela’s. The apartment is spacious and the most well appointed airbnb I have stayed in. The location is convenient, a couple blocks from the train and Wrigley field is a short walk. It was perfect for going to a game and not having to deal with the crowds on the train or parking. The unit was quiet and we slept great! I would definitely stay again!
Everything was great!

Danny’s place was an absolute gem, and exactly what we needed after a rough start (our original Airbnb fell through to a scam listing, leaving us stranded). He responded right away, got us set up with check-in details, and even called to make sure we got in okay. That kind of responsiveness made a stressful situation feel completely taken care of.
The apartment itself was clean, charming, and fully stocked with everything we needed. Danny thought of details most hosts miss, like street parking passes laid out and ready to go. The location in Lincoln Park is unbeatable: we walked everywhere, to the zoo, the conservatory, restaurants, even home from a Cubs game when we were feeling ambitious. There’s a frozen yogurt shop right across the street, plus coffee shops and restaurants all within a few blocks. The streets are quaint and beautiful, and it felt like the safest, most walkable neighborhood we could’ve asked for.
We brought our dog along too and everything was smooth and comfortab
Great location! Very walkable to McCormick West. Mostly clean, but some hairs found in shower. Located in an apartment where other units may be a bit loud.

Choosing the option ”to stay with Jacki” made our three-day stay in Chicago very cozy and comfortable for all 5 in our party. This lower-level Andersonville residence sparkles with atmosphere, furnished to
accommodate and pamper. Great choice!

Nice area and was very walkable. Apartment was clean. About a 20 min walk to the blue line. A little confusing at first to find the apartment. (Street parking kind of sucks and the upstairs neighbors were a little loud but I also know that is out of their control and we didn’t mind too much).
Had a great experience with the place. Everything was spotless and well maintained. Check in was easy and to the point. Would definitely book again. Thank you for sharing your space with us.

This apartment was very cute and roomy! The only issues are the the pull out couch, which is part of the bedding we needed for our group, was small and weird to sleep on. Also the parking can be troublesome and you might have to walk a little far. Other than that, the place was so clean, neat, cute furnishings and touches throughout! We all really enjoyed our stay here.

We got in early before check- in time and had a lot of luggage. Our concierge helped us with checking our bags early and was even able to get our room ready. Everyone was so nice and helpful. Our stay was perfect.

Tonya's place was beautiful! It was so surprisingly quiet, too. It felt so cozy! You'd never guess you were in such close proximity to other families. The space was immaculate, and the furniture was comfortable. Parking wasn't an issue at all. 10/10, will definitely recommend to anyone coming to visit Chicago.
Place is huge for 4 guest and very accessible indeed if going to mccormick place and china town.

I recommend staying here very local area super
convenient I felt comfortable here!!

Great area if you’re looking for a small studio to stay in for a couple days! The neighborhood was beautiful and great walking area for pets. Street parking is easy unless super busy. There isn’t a dishwasher or queen size bed. Just to keep in mind when looking! But it’s great for a single person traveling and very easy to get in and out of. The host was very responsive and friendly. They were easy to talk to. The power went out right before we got there and they were super helpful with the situation! I recommend this place for people with pets or just single travelers🫶🏼
Thank you for the hospitality.

This is a great city apartment close to public transportation. Being a city apt, there’s city noise and traffic but nothing unexpected for city staying. It was a very cute place with all amenities needed. Very good response time when I needed help too. Thanks so much for the great stay!

During our one‑month stay, we encountered several serious issues that made the accommodation unacceptable.
Upon check‑in, the property was not cleaned properly. We had to request additional cleaning, which was only carried out the following day. Even after that, the place had a significant presence of insects and spiders, and we even found a centipede inside the unit.
The most severe incident occurred after two weeks, when the waste‑water pump broke. As a result, wastewater flooded the bathroom, kitchen, and living area. We immediately informed Naj, and a technician was sent to repair the issue. The work continued until late in the day, forcing us to remain outside the property for the entire afternoon.
Due to these conditions, we cancelled the remainder of our stay and moved to a new place. The property clearly requires proper maintenance and a thorough deep cleaning to ensure it is safe and suitable for guests.

You can't beat the location!! One block from the Art Institute and Symphony Hall, and adjacent to the Wabash/Adams train stop. The place was very roomy and clean. As someone who prepares food in Airbnbs, I really appreciated the gas stove.
Great place and welcoming hosts.
Such an incredible stay! The rooftop has a beautiful view and the entire place was clean and perfect.

We rented this Airbnb in Chicago to attend my son's graduation from DePaul University. It is literally across the street from DePaul and around the corner from the church where Baccalaureate Mass is held. We had all of our extended family coming from Texas and Colorado, and this allowed us to all stay together. There was plenty of room for each family to have their own private space, but also have great areas to congregate together. We were able to get groceries delivered to make a couple of meals in the kitchen,  ordered takeout from walk able local places and then took the whole crew out to a meal to explore the area. The bed was just as comfortable as my own at home! Note that all 4 bedrooms are upstairs on the 2nd and 3rd floor, so if you have people with mobility issues in your group, this is important to note. I can't recommend this property enough if you have several families coming for graduation.

Stephen and Cheryl’s place was absolutely lovely! It was cozy, comfortable, and the perfect home base after a long day of exploring the city. Everything was clean, welcoming, and thoughtfully put together, making it easy to relax and recharge each evening. It truly felt like a little retreat tucked away from the hustle and bustle. I had a wonderful stay and would happily book again. Highly recommend!

nice place with nice cozy vibes definitely worth booking !

Everything was just as described. The three bedrooms were a good size and quite comfortable. The kitchen had everything we needed for our five day stay. The location is good as we were able to walk to a few areas and to the brown line CTA stop.
Would definitely stay here again.

Comfortable place! We had to get in really late and they were very accommodating. Surrounded by some really cool stores and great food.

Definitely a great place to stay if you want to be close to quintessential vacationer sightseeing locations.

Almir and Majda were exceptional hosts.  They were proactive and communicative about their home and the instructions associated with my family and I having a thoroughly enjoyable stay. Thank you, Almir and Majda!

A very nice apartment in a cool neighborhood with lots of nice restaurants and coffee shops a pleasant one block walk away. . I highly recommend staying here!
Great spot
Nancy is a wonderful host.  The home was super clean and well-stocked, and Nancy went the extra mile in every way.
Perfect for our needs.

The bedroom with the blackout curtains was great for getting a little extra shut eye after days of running around. Overall would stay here again for a Wrigley trip.

Loved staying with Saurin! Very accommodating and made my time in Chicago a breeze! Had a great selection of advice for places to eat and responded very quickly whenever messaged. I was able to check in early which was very helpful and checkout was a breeze.

The place was fantastic—comfortable, welcoming, and filled with thoughtful touches that made our stay so enjoyable. It was clear a lot of care went into making sure guests have everything they might need. We had a wonderful stay!

Great Place , would 10/10 definitely recommend!! Very spacious and clean host was very nice 😊

We instantly fell in love with this place when we walked in. The amount of thoughtful touches and comfortable amenities make you feel like you’re at home. Great place, highly recommend!

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb. The location in the West Loop was excellent, with plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, and attractions nearby. Very responsive hosts. Easy to work with and allowed us to drop off baggage early while cleaners were still there.
The apartment was in college student housing, which was a little strange, but did not impact our stay.
Walking distance to blue line (from ORD), park and restaurants.
Perfect place for us to stay during graduation weekend at Northwestern.
Amazing place, stayed here with a  group of friends for summer smash and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Great location great property responsive host.
Good place. Easy to manage.

Great value in a wonderful part of downtown. Very walkable and the main floor restaurant cafe was excellent.  Always my go-to stay in Chicago.
We had a great stay. The place was just as described. Small, but absolutely perfect for a great place to sleep after a day exploring the city! Would stay again!

Heather’s place was as advertised. Great place for families . Cozy home . Quiet neighborhood close to mass transit to the city. Heather is an excellent and proactive host and really cares about her guests. Recommended!
Great location, responsive hosts
Was great for our large group!

This is a lovely apartment and was in a perfect, walkable location for us. We were one block from restaurants, bars, coffee shops and shopping. Thank you Thomas for keeping in touch with us before, during and after our stay!! We will return!!
Beautiful apartment lots of room. close to the lake. close to subway. The gym was extra benefit.

We had a great stay at Anny’s place. The location was excellent, with easy access to public transportation and a convenient route to downtown. The space was very clean, comfortable, and spacious for two people.
We appreciated the thoughtful touches such as extra towels, tea, coffee, and bottled water, which made us feel welcome. The neighborhood felt very safe, and despite seeing some previous comments about noise, we did not experience any issues during our stay and slept comfortably.
Street parking was free which was a great bonus. The lanes are narrow, but Anny provided clear instructions that made it easy to navigate. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would happily stay here again.

I almost never post a review on airbnb mainly because I forgot but Alvenna gave us such a great experience that I had to write about it. We come to Chicago every year for the Summer Smash festival or other events and no other airbnb has ever made me or my friends feel as comfortable  or welcoming as Alvenna has. The place has a manual that tells you the basic things you should do inside the airbnb and what to do when you leave. It isn’t much and just seems like something you’d do at your own house or a friends to be polite. At the end of the manual there are pamphlets and even a map of the area to help you find things to do which i think was great and something i’ve never seen before. The bathrooms have extra towels, shampoo, conditioner and even makeup towels! The beds are extremely comfortable and even small things like the fridge has a britta and other small drinks. Overall this is a great place to stay. Alvenna is a lovely person and host and we will most likely return next year!!!
Wonderful place to stay. Easy transit to get to the city. Enjoyed our stay

Very responsive, proactive, and helpful hosts! The place was clean and spacious with great amenities. The location was excellent with easy access to the Blue Line. Entry into the building and unit couldn’t be easier.
The apartment is in a great location with lots of options for shopping and dining, but wasn’t very clean and has limited space to hang out.
Bella’s studio apartment was just right for my needs… a short stay to visit student/son. The apartment is clean and comfortable.

We spent 5 days at Alpaca My Bags. David and his team were wonderful hosts and extremely responsive. I didn’t expect to be in the basement of someone’s home, with no door to the stairs. However the space was nice, clean and just like the pictures. There was a lack of wash clothes… but they gave complimentary crackers and water.

This is an absolutely charming place to stay in a wonderful neighborhood. Outside of downtown Chicago but still easily excessible by the trains and bicycles and with its own neighborhood flavor. The restaurants, shops, and bars were a delight. The apartment itself was very kitschy, cute, and full of personality. Would absolutely stay here again.
Obi was very helpful and quick response!
Clean, aesthetic loft in the perfect neighborhood for walking around, shopping, eating, etc. Conveniently located next to public transportation stop with easy access to the rest of Chicago.
Place was clean and everything we needed was available. The instructions provided for check in were very clear . We didn’t have a lake or skyline view as described but this is not a big issue.
No issues. Nice, clean and spacious place.
Easy to find. Close to wrigley. Clean and simple for our one day stay.

Our family of four really enjoyed our stay here. The space was very nice and had everything we needed. The location is very close to train stations and there are many excellent restaurants in the area.

Clean rooms and nice view. We had problems with the door keys. We had to call security twice to have the door be opened for us.  The air-conditioning leading to two  bedrooms  was not working throughout our stay. We called for it to be fixed but no one came.
Great accommodations, and great location. The unit has everything is needed for a comfortable stay

Great area, walkable to the metro and good driving distance from downtown. House is an apartment system so you have neighbors below and above you.
