Other than that, the place was good and I would rent again.

My stay was great! The Airbnb was clean, spacious, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The location was very convenient and close to everything, which made getting around easy. The amenities were excellent, and the overall space felt comfortable and welcoming. I would definitely recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again.
It was a beautifully remodeled large home to accommodate our group.

We absolutely felt at home. There was a welcoming bottle of wine for us.  The location was very peaceful; we loved the neighborhood, great Italian bakery was nearby. We will definitely come back again to stay. The tree lined sidewalks were a joy to walk to nearby restaurants.

Our family had such a wonderful time at this location! Great neighborhood! All the beds were extremely comfortable! Walking distance to restaurants and coffee shops. I would highly recommend staying here.
Matt is a terrific host. We would happily stay again. Great place and great location.

We wanted to be close to Wrigleyville and this was the perfect spot just blocks away. It was a very busy weekend on the strip, but the house sat back off the road enough to feel secluded when we wanted to. Parking permit and pass was great!!! We really enjoyed our Chicago trip!
Really nice apartment, and a good location too. Responsive host.

The stay is great - Mike is a very responsive host. The check in was super easy. The space is done up well, especially for a family stay (there is even a darts room at the back!). Overall, highly recommend!
Very friendly and proactive host. The apartment is great and is located in a quiet residential area, close to a train station.

A lovely place to spend a few days in the city. It's helpful if you already know Chicago neighborhoods. For us, it was ideal. Right off the express way. We had things to do both north and south. Walking was easy, especially the "606 trail".
Beds were comfortable. the kitchen had everything needed, although we didn't do any cooking. The apartment was clean. It worked well for the 4 of us.
Communication was excellent.
Great location that allows you to get to various locations in the city. Even next to the L, it was relatively quiet.

Adam was so responsive and flexible with our request on checking out a little later. Provided details for parking. The place was perfectly located - walkable to restaurants and grocery stores.  Had more amenities than what was listed which was a bonus. Plenty sheets/pillows, two big TVs, umbrellas (which were needed during our stay).  The place felt cozy and beds were comfortable- definitely recommend this place. Thank you!
Great apartment at a stellar location. Would stay here again if/when I come back to Chicago.
Bianca was a great host. Would stay again. Parking and walk distance from wicker park restaurants excellent
Stayed 3 days perfect place for a quick get away with your partner .

Scott & Mindy’s place was just as described and was perfect for our stay. I loved the special touch of having a working record player! Can’t remember the last time I placed a needle on vinyl :).
Thank you Scott & Mindy for sharing your place!

It's pink, it's quirky, it was perfect for our trip to Chicago for a Cubs game. Such a cute place in a great location! Walkable to a lot of great shops/restaurants & coffee. We also walked to the navy pier & beach if that is something you are interested in! Was very clean and looks just like the pictures! Hosts are very responsive & informative! Would definitely stay again.

very comfortable stay !

Location could not be better, and having the parking included is a huge plus. Was able to walk everywhere and not worry about parking my car during my stay. The apartment itself is very comfortable, spacious, and well decorated. Will definitely be looking for this place the next time I visit!

Fantastic location and very reasonable price for Chicago.  If you are looking to house a large group for a reasonable price, this is the place for you. The biggest advantage of this flat is its location. The Red Line of the underground is within walking distance. We absolutely enjoyed our stay! We've stayed at many Airbnb's and this was the first one where we had bagels, cream cheese, milk, orange juice and apple juice in the fridge. There's a lot to do around the area and just strolling the neighborhood was very pleasant. Thanks so much for a great stay. We highly recommend it!

Johanna was an excellent host. The house was so beautiful and her attention to detail was impeccable. She sent a list of wonderful things to do within walking distance and made us feel so welcome. When I return to Chicago, this is the only place I will stay!

This is a solid spot for Cubs fan: recommend for father/son or for brothers. Incredible location near left field wall. I rate it a 5 based on the unique Cubs components and experience, and glad that I had a chance to stay!

seriously such a cool & unique spot especially if you love old arcade games. my partner & i played forever & even extended our trip which the hosts were amazing about. couldnt recommend more!!!
Had a wonderful stay at Bill and Susan’s place. They were very nice and made sure that we had everything we needed.

Cozy place in great neighborhood, was very conveniently located near public transit, grocery stores and the convention center.  John was very responsive and understanding when we arrived later than expected due to travel delays.

The space was great for our large party. Plenty of space for us to spread out and get comfy. The area was great - walking distance to some great coffee shops and restaurants. While we didn't give them the opportunity to come back and clean, I'm sure they would have fixed this if asked.
We had a blast while staying at Natasha's; fantastic location right next to Millennium Park. Host was very responsive and we would definitely stay there again!

I’ll start by saying that AJ is an excellent host — always responsive and quick to answer any questions.

I would absolutely stay here again. Excellent stay overall. Thank you for everything

Considero que es una buena opción para quedarse en Chicago, cerca de una parada de bus y una estación de metro.

Great place to stay if you’re looking for a true Chicago neighborhood experience. The area felt very safe, with lots of families out and about. AMAZING SPACE. The only low building between massive sky scrapers with a giant outdoor roof patio. Views of river and bridges. Very close to Blue Line ‘L’ train to OHare airport.

Geo is a great host, easy communication, before, during and after my stay. The studio is exactly as the description, and if you like cooking, the kitchen has all the "tools" needed. Not fancy cooking, then N Clark Street is about 10/15 minutes walk, with a variety of restaurants.
The studio is located in a nice, quiet neighborhood with trees lining the streets.
Everything you need is within walking distance, a few cafes, a supermarket and the metro station (Berwyn, red line) are just a few blocks away. You reach downtown Chicago in around 30/35 minutes and The Chicago Cubs, Wrigley Field, is five or six stops away.
As the weather was nice when I was there (sun & 30C) went for a swim at Lake Michigan, only a short stroll from the studio.
I will for stay at Geo's place next time I visit Chicago.

super cute interior and easy access to the home. felt like a real home instead of a cheap airbnb product. close to good food, coffee and bars, with public transport easily accessible. beautiful kitchen if you like to cook!

Our stay was excellent. Tina and John were incredibly responsive and made sure all our questions were answered as they came up. The home was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The location was perfect and made everything easy and convenient.

Patrick's place is a true gem. We stayed 4 nights. Upon arrival we parked our car on the street directly in front of the home and didn't need it again until we departed. Great restaurants, pubs & coffee shops within easy walking distance. We walked to and from an evening cubbies game.  We were surprised how quiet and peaceful the neighborhood was.  We enjoyed quite a bit of time in the beautiful garden patio space as we were blessed with some lovely weather during our stay. The bed was very comfortable and the night was quiet which allowed us to have great uninterrupted sleep. The space was perfect for the two of us. The home was well equipped with everything we needed to assure our comfort.  We visit the Chicago area regularly and Patrick's place will definitely be our go to home base.

This is a WONDERFUL redone historic apartment in an unbeatable location (but original wood doors & squeaky floors feel classic!) We were 5 adults in town for a 4 day event in Evanston and found this to be an incredible base. Parking on quiet street was simple and only a little harder if we got home past 11pm.
The decor is modern and simple, and there are multiple amazing touches like a totally redone, state of the art kitchen and new remote-controlled ceiling fans in each room with adjustable light temperatures and fan speeds. We also had 3 AC units which kept everything super comfortable.
While we ate at mostly at local spots the kitchen is terrific and we could comfortably seat 6 in the large dining room.
For local spots, we recommend Ezankaya and SBK - Sauce & Bread Kitchen within a few blocks, or El Pulpo Loco a little further.
Perfect if you want to be within a 10 minute walk to pretty much everything (including 1 minute walk to a very solid supermarket) but in a quiet spot.
Great stay and good location for visiting Chicago. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Great location and super clean home. Would highly recommend and stay here again

Won't be back. Wouldn't recommend. We work hard and deserve a clean resting place. I rented this location for my NYC team coming to do a series of events. Upon arrival, we were surprised by the 4-story walk-up, considering we had heavy luggage and equipment we had for the events. We immediately saw dust and clumps of hair. I was willing to clean it up. Unfortunately, no cleaning towels, paper towels, sponges, dish soap, or wipes were provided. Upon further inspection, we noticed the light fixtures were dirty, the countertops were grimy, and the refrigerator needed to be wiped out. The hallway shower curtain was covered with red mildew and black mold. I contacted the owner, asking for cleaning supplies and for the curtain to be replaced. A cleaning team came and did the bare minimum because we kept discovering more dirty places after they left. The shower curtain wasn't replaced. One of the chairs in the couch area had a broken leg and the seat was saggy. The coffee pitcher was dirty.

Enjoyed our stay in Chicago and overall was satisfied with the Airbnb its self. The place felt private enough, especially the community deck area that is shared by the tenement below the rental unit. Airplanes to fly overhead quite often landing or taking off from the nearby Midwest Airport, which is a good thing distance wise. Some of the furniture was worn and could use replacing (e.g., couch, bed in the single room squeaks. We did like having 3 beds in one room. Shower and bathroom were on the nicer side which we enjoyed. Locks and latches on doors could be swapped to make it more convenient. The door leading out to the deck could only be closed by the lock, so while using the deck, the wind blew the door open several times. Overall a great stay with a few minor updates needed. I would recommend.
Great place, great location!
Great location close to Lincoln Park, clean and renovated house, well organized host.

Jun's place is spacious, clean, and very convienent for my meeting in the convention center.   The location is amazing. It’s in a great location.  Short walk to Andersonville. The apartment was very cozy. Will definitely use again!

A great place in a great neighborhood!

Amazing stay as always! This was my third time staying here, and it is consistently perfect.

I love staying here and am already planning to book with Dana again soon!
Clean, safe, comfortable place to stay in a wonderful neighborhood full of eating and shopping options!
Absolutely beautiful little space and immaculately decorated and cleaned. Perfect location, beautiful neighborhood and close to lots to do in Lincoln Park. Would definitely be back!

Our stay was perfection! The apartment was extremely comfortable, cozy, clean and beautifully decorated, (LOVED the unique artwork and books!). Great location and unit as described. Overall a great experience.

It’s an older house, but it was the cleanest Airbnb (or hotel, for that matter!) we’ve ever stayed in every detail was spotless. I was especially thankful for how clean the coffee maker was! The kitchen was nice and updated, and we loved the matching tile in the bathroom and kitchen along with the cute dining areas throughout. The beds were comfortable, and we appreciated thoughtful touches like the great selection of books and games. Our kids were especially thrilled to find Pete the Cat waiting for them! The location was fantastic. we could walk everywhere, including all the way to Andersonville, which made getting around so easy. The home was peaceful and quiet, perfect for relaxing after busy days exploring the city. Nora was a wonderful, attentive host who made the whole stay even better. Highly recommend, especially for families or longer stays like ours.

This property is amazing for large groups. Extremely clean, and accessible to the CTA and the beautiful Old Town community. There is an Airbnb below this property that carries noise to this property and vice versa (a bachelorette party happened for two nights below us). Hosts Jose was amazing, Kevin was meh.
We stayed for an entire week, and for an extended stay with the number of people, the ratio of towels and facecloths were not enough. We bought extra towels and washcloths to cover our stay, and left it there for future guests.
There was one safety issue of not giving us an exclusive door entry code, rather the default one that is used by the owners and vendors. Other than that, it’s a great property and excellent location.
A great home in an absolutely spectacular neighborhood.  I took every excuse I had to walk around the neighborhood b/c it was perfect.
Highly recommend!

I felt my expectations were met. Michael always thought one step ahead which I greatly appreciate. No concerns from my side. Great place to stay for a few days. Only thing is there is no kitchen but I knew that going in.
Stayed here for my first time in Chicago. This place matched everything with the picture. The neighborhood and area was safe. I would stay here again.
Comfortable, clean, and convenient location, close to shopping and access to a beach on Lake Michigan.

It was a very nice Airbnb and  we felt safe at all times. Very clean and very comfortable. We felt right at home. Lumi was very fast to respond. I would stay here again. Good spot for someone looking to go to a Bulls or Blackhacks games, it’s walking distance to the United Center.

Brads place was perfect for our work stay. My wife and I each had a place to setup and knock out meetings without being in the same room. It was close to lots of public transportation and surrounded by very yummy food/coffee/spirits choices!
The home is beautiful!  The host was joy to meet.  We will definitely book again!
We truly enjoyed our stay at the unit and the excellent amenities accommodation. Highly worth a stay!

Great host and great location, host was responsive when messaged, and the location feels very safe. A bit far from the trains, but close to good bus public transit options. We never had any issues, I would highly recommend this location/host.

Laura's place is spacious and very comfortable, especially for a longer stay. I loved the cook's kitchen with all-new gear, the luxury bathroom, the high ceilings, and having a washer & dryer in the unit. The door opens directly onto a fairly busy street which can get noisy at times. The front door is frosted glass and at first I thought people on the street could see in. But it's actually it's not see-through at all. So you can relax about that and with the other windows being so high, there is complete privacy! The location is great with the Pink line 2 blocks away, and grocery stores and restaurants in easy walking distance. Thanks Laura, for a great stay.
10/10 will be back
I felt super safe and the area was great! Not too far from downtown!

We had a great stay overall. The apartment was very clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. Having a dedicated garage parking spot was a huge plus—it made coming and going very convenient. The location was also great, with most places in River North and downtown only about a 15–30 minute drive away, depending on traffic. The unit had everything we needed and check-in was smooth.
The only downside was that the unit upstairs is also an Airbnb with hardwood floors, so the sound insulation isn’t the best. Footsteps from upstairs could be quite loud at times, especially when people were walking around.
Overall, it was a comfortable stay, and we’d recommend it for anyone looking for a clean, convenient place with secure parking in Chicago.
Great stay. Clean, spacious, bright, and well-located. Would book again.
Great location! Helpful host if you need anything.
Great Chicago spot! Perfect for a family.

Bridget gave clear instructions on how to find the place and how to get in. It was great to have a spacious place with two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The bedrooms were pretty spacious and the a/c kept the common space nice and cool but the bedrooms got a little stuffy during the night if you close the doors. The apartment looks like it could use a little TLC and the appliances could use some updating.  The decor was minimalist but what was there was generally comfortable. There are many restaurants and yummy Italian sub shops nearby and walking distance to Fulton Market. Good coffee shop across the street. Close to subway station.
Great place if you are looking for a place to stay near downtown Chicago. Garage parking was somewhat challenging but doable. Great suprising options in the main bathroom’s shower booth!
Place was nice and clean. No issues. Nice location as well
This is a fantastic location.  We did lots of walking and always felt very safe.  Bed is very comfortable.  Hosts were very nice and helpful.

The place was spacious and as described. It was easy to check in and check out. The host was proactive in asking if there was anything that they could help with.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It was close to the CTA bus stop and train.

The location is fabulous! We walked to several places. The backyard was really convenient with our dog! Space is larger than it looks in pictures, very comfortable, snacks were a generous and thoughtful addition!
Great place. Check in could be a bit more clear for when there isn’t an attendant but otherwise it was a great stay!
Terrific Stay!  2 blocks to Wrigley which was perfect with a toddler.  It was everything we needed for our family for our baseball adventure.
Great stay! Loved the outdoor space. Easy entrance and fast communication. Right by the train and walkable neighborhood.
Great location for convention center. Clean, large room. Some neighbors were noisy and raucous walking outside door, but that was not any fault of the host.
Great place and location.

Julio is a great host! Very good communication regarding check in instructions, and was accommodating and flexible. He also provided good recommendations in the area (which is very close to some great places to visit). The apartment is sparse but comfortable and affordable.

Adresa foi muito cordial, gentileza e colaborativa.
Respondia rapidamente e o espaço é incrível, com certeza eu voltaria

Our stay was fantastic! The space had everything we needed and it was in a safe and quiet location. It was within walking distance to the McCormick Center for a conference (just over 1 mile). It was also walking distance to the beach, grocery store, a few restaurants, etc. Easy to get an Uber to travel to other local attractions or downtown. The place was very nice, clean and exactly as described and presented in the photos. Corinne was a fantastic host and was super responsive if we needed anything. We would definitely stay there again if we visit Chicago.

Great pace to stay if you’re looking to catch a ball game or visit Chicago. Place is nice, clean & private. If you’re looking to catch the CTA train & need directions no worries go to the bathroom you’ll come out well informed! lol. Erin was great!

Perfect quiet place to stay after exploring the city. Stay has a lot of thought out amenities. It is a basement and you can overhear activities upstairs, but with the sound machine a total non-issue. The snacks and small coffee bar were a nice touch! We greatly appreciated the bag drop off option as well
Great place!

Tommy was a great host. He met us when we arrived and walked us through the apartment.  He clearly has the gift of hospitality.  The apartment was perfect for us and the location is exceptional. It is close to so many great restaurants and the train station.  We didn’t catch a Cubs game or a concert, but it was in walking distance to Wrigley Field.
Vin is a good host who is attentive to guests and their needs. Answers questions quickly. The apartment is clean & comfortable. A great place to stay

Absolutely loved our time here! There was a beautiful park for our kids within walking distance as well as a Dunkin’ Donuts! The boys loved the board games and books and the personal touches Hector added were so thoughtful! Would definitely recommend any family to stay here
nice stay

I had a wonderful stay at this place. The host was very responsive and helpful, making the check-in process smooth and easy. The location was great, close to local attractions and amenities. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.
Everything was clean and they replied very fast whenever we had issues. Parking is kind of annoying but there are places on the side of the road.

Julian was a fantastic host—generous, a good communicator,  responded quickly when we couldn’t find things we needed. His place isn’t luxurious but it has everything we needed. It’s really close to an El stop, which is both convenient but a bit loud. The air conditioner fan was good white noise to overcome that. We loved the neighborhood; it’s mostly residential with lots of trees, a pizza place and coffee shop right downstairs, and a couple of restaurants just a block away. It was perfect for us.
The apartment was exactly as described! very clean and spacious. Perfectly clean, and located around great food spots. Would definitely book again next trip to Chicago.
Great neighborhood and fun way to explore the city with our family.
Erica is a great host to a great space. I really enjoyed my time in the studio and would definitely book again when in town.
Everything was great

This was an amazing place for a large group like ours. There were lots of rooms and living spaces so it was easy to accommodate a group of 12-14. Three floors of bedrooms was quite nice. The walk to the Irving Park blue line stop is convenient (10 minute walk) so it’s easy to get into and out of Downtown Chicago and O’Hare. Dave is great and responsive. Great host and great place!

Great location and room condition. Easy to access, and is convenient to downtown Chicago. The only improvement was parking - when we were getting out of the parking lot, the bar didn’t lift up even though our plate had been registered. Turned out sometimes you need to call to have them operate manually for you. For others staying here, it’s something to keep in mind. But overall, good time and good stay!
Very good customer service but just old style looking place and no entertainment not even a tv and everything is basically shared
Great location.  Decent condition.  Hallway has some old building smell

The initial reservation and following multi step process to reserve and ultimately stay at this unit makes it way to much of a hassle to ever stay here again. We had to give the same private information in 3 or more different platforms, fill out tons of personal information multiple times, share personal information about our guests several times and then not only pay the extremely high price per night but also pay a $500 deposit on top of everything else which we may get back in 30 days. I have never experienced a more difficult Airbnb to rent and stay in. On top of all that the coffee machine didn’t work which I reported and they never resolved. All felt very scammy for sure.
Everything during our stay was great! Easy check in, instructions, SUPER convenient kitchen labels, lots of rooms, easy dryer & washer setup. Overall amazing!

We had a great stay at Sharon’s place. She was very responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout our trip. The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
We especially appreciated how accommodating she was when we arrived early and needed a place for our luggage and pet. We also ran into an unexpected parking issue during our stay, and Sharon went above and beyond to help us resolve it.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would happily stay here again. Highly recommend!
Lovely home in a great location for Cubs games and for getting the subway downtown. This was exactly what we wanted for a large-ish group.
Great location. Comfortable space.
Perfect Location!!!
Great location. Nice building with amenities gym, lounge, work stations.
Good place to stay for a short or extended period. Milan is super friendly and responsive. We felt at home.

We really enjoyed our our first time in Chicago. The house is in a great location, close to the blue line and bus stops, which will get you anywhere in the city. We were skeptical about sharing a house, but we felt like we had plenty of privacy and the house felt cozy. Would definitely stay here again.

This place was really nice. It was located a average Lyft ride from Wrigley Field. The neighborhood was quiet. I really appreciated the washer and dryer. The bathroom had a bidet! Very nice! 10/10, would recommend.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exceptionally clean, bright, and welcoming from the moment we arrived.
It had everything we needed (thank you for the coffee and snacks)
for a comfortable and relaxing stay, making us feel right at home.
The neighborhood was convenient and easily accessible, which made getting around very easy.
We truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended!

Really nice and friendly guy, who is super willing to help with food and travel recommendations. The Airbnb is close in location to the blue line and downtown. The surrounding area felt very safe and walkable, with many families outside and walking with their dogs and kids which made me and my gf feel at ease. Would absolutely recommend to others visiting Chicago, and for people looking for proximity to downtown while being able to stay in a neighborhood. I would definitely book again if I were in chicago at any other point. 10/10.
Accommodated our last minute stay and the place was as expected! Excellent location, very walkable
Adam was a great host and his unit was in a great location close to many fantastic restaurants. I would definitely recommend and would stay again in the future.

We loved the neighborhood and the convenience of a very close bus stop. There were some challenges with using the locks/keys to enter and exit; I believe they are working on that. The pub downstairs was lovely, and the $15 a day per person credit there was a real plus.
The condo was  very clean and was exactly like the pictures.  I highly recommend it.

Stayed two days in the apartment and it is just lovely. Felt like walking into the pictures from the listing. Super clean & comfortable. Located in a very walkable area. Easy walk to the train station & local restaurants. Owner was friendly & responses were timely. Would stay here again & would recommend to at others visiting the Chicago area.
Jaime's place was perfect for our needs, and affordable. Jaime was a GREAT host, very responsive, friendly, and kind. Will definitely try to stay here again next time I am in town.
The place was nice.

We had such a nice time here! It’s the perfect location to everything we needed, and easy to get to bus stops to take us to the further out places. Plenty of great restaurants close by. The door people were very friendly and helpful, the neighbors were all very nice. Attached coffee shop was a really nice perk in the mornings.
The apartment itself was very comfortable and felt like home. Lots of table space and sitting space for everyone. So much closet space (really I’m jealous; I don’t have this at home)! Beds were very comfortable. The natural lighting is perfect for early wake ups without an alarm, which I loved.

John's place is conveniently located a few minutes walk from Halsted station (orange line). The flat was very clean and everything matched the provided pictures/description. There was bottled water in the fridge at check in which was a nice touch! John was super responsive and friendly. Only downside we found: walls are quite thin and noise from the main road and upstairs travelled easily so you may struggle a little if you're a light sleeper like us.

Very comfy! Great location. Tamera is very responsive and flexible with check in. Everything was expected and well maintained. I would stay here again and recommend to others wanting to explore Logan Square. Five Stars!
We had a wonderful stay. The neighborhood is beautiful and walkable and was the perfect location for our stay. They were very helpful and communicative.

My group stayed in a 3-bedroom apartment for 4 nights and I don’t recommend this place for several reasons. What put me off most was how commercial they were; they charge you 60 dollars to extend the check out time by 2 hours and 20 dollars for 30 minutes. They had to “make an exception” to let me in 1 hour earlier without charging me, although they didn’t have any booking from the night before.
Apart from that, the building is located in one of the major avenues and it was loud at night due to several sirens. Besides, it seems the entire second floor was converted to vacation apartments. The walls inside the apartment are thin, offering poor privacy but also towards the hallway. On our first day, I woke up twice in the middle of the night because of the noise coming from the hallway. Third, the bed I took made noise every time I moved. Two out of three rooms didn’t have any window and the only room with a window didn’t have blackout curtains.

We really enjoyed our stay! The home was very clean, comfortable, and welcoming. It felt very homey, and the large couch was a great bonus for relaxing after a long day.
Overall, we had a great experience and only a few minor issues. The keypad was a little difficult to use when getting into the house, and there were no paper towels, or dish soap available for washing dishes. The dog in the building was occasionally loud, but it wasn’t a major problem.
One thing to note is that it was sometimes difficult to get Ubers back to the house because some drivers did not want to travel to the area. Other than that, everything was wonderful. The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed. We would definitely stay here again.

Had a great stay! The host was very responsive whenever I had questions or concerns, and the space was clean, comfortable, and perfect for my solo trip to Chicago. The only minor inconvenience was having to walk to a separate building to pick up the keys, but overall it was a great experience and I would stay here again.
nice and respectful host
Nice place, area has a lot of food options and very walkable

Great stay! My family had a wonderful time here for our 3-night stay. The place truly felt like home—it was incredibly spacious and spotlessly clean. Hatice was a fantastic host, she was super responsive and easy to reach. Highly recommend!
Great host and kept the room very organized and clean
We had a wonderful stay in this very cozy home!  Thank your for the beautiful chalk-art welcome!  We also loved the outdoor space!
Sara was very easy to communicate with. Location great for our needs. Spacious accommodations for a 1BR (with Murphy bed).

Aaron let us check in early without hesitating...
Neighborhood is super walkable, perfect if you're going to a cubs game. If you're looking for a peaceful stay, this isn't the area for you. There are people walking by all hours of the day and night. It is quite loud.
Milen’s place was clean and came with all amenities. I’d highly recommend his place.

We came to Chicago to participate in AFSP’s Out Of The Darkness walk for suicide prevention. We chose this home because it was in our budget and close to the area we needed to be in. We were impressed with how clean and comfortable the home was, and would 10/10 recommend!
Really great location with lots of room. Comfortable stay with really easy check in and even easier check out procedure. Host was very communicative.
Location was great! Condo was clean and comfortable! Would definitely recommend!
Great stay

The place was beautiful, just like the pictures. The window overlooking the lake provided a stunning view. Everything was very clean and well maintained, and we felt right at home from the moment we arrived. The instructions were clear, concise, and easy to follow without being overwhelming. The hosts were very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely recommend this place and would love to stay here again.
Thank you!
Great place! Very clean. Beds were extremely comfortable. Nice and safe neighborhood. Wonderful host who checked in to make sure we had everything we needed, which we did. Would highly recommend.

Alexis’s home was a delightful place to spend a vacation.  If you’re looking for a clean, well managed place to enjoy a family stay, especially with young children this is the place for you.  the location was in a very friendly, safe, beautiful neighborhood with plenty of walkable restaurants and amenities for a family or any guests to enjoy.  our needs were met perfectly and it met our expectations as advertised.  thank you so much for the friendly welcome and excellent, timely communication throughout our trip.

This apartment was located on the 14th floor about two blocks from the lake and two blocks from Michigan Ave and near Northwestern Medical School so a great location. Downstairs there is a nice coffee place.
The apartment is a bit old, but they have spruced it up with nice furniture and art work.
The bathrooms are not adjoining the bedrooms.
Overall pretty good for a short stay.
Was able to productively work from home for a few days at this condo. There was a coffee shop just down the street and some really great restaurants all within walking distance.

This place is a great location!!
Great walking distance to restaurants-shopping & the water/beach!
The pictures shown is exactly what you’ll find!
Nice and roomy! Plenty of sitting areas!

Great apartment and very accommodating hosts
Thanks for the nice stay. Made extra special because it was walkable to family. Clean and comfortable!

Great stay overall. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for our Chicago trip. The hosts were very responsive and helpful, and the check-in/check-out process was smooth. The building staff was also great, special shoutout to Don from security, who was always friendly, funny, and helpful during our stay. Would definitely stay here again.
Great spot for a getaway in Chicago!
Our stay was great! We loved the location too

Loved our stay in Chicago. The location was amazing, close to Wrigley and tons of great restaurants all a few steps away.
The place was even better than the photos, woderfully decorated and had all we needed.

Pros: Devin is very responsive. Close by to attend conference at mccormick. Safe and neat neighbourhood
Cons: Doesn’t have thermostat. So thats an issue with controlling AC. Patio is not with this unit which was displayed in the pictures, this is just a basement unit with no kitchen and freezer.
