This was a great place to stay on our first trip to Chicago...cozy, friendly neighborhood with plenty to do right within walking distance. We absolutely loved it, and Sarah was super responsive. We fully recommend this cute home and would stay there again!

Jane’s airnbnb functions most like a hostel, so bare in mind its a shared living space with multiple people. It was a lovely stay for me, only a few days for a short weekend work trip, the bed was very comfy, the kitchen was spacious and functional, there were two bathrooms that worked well. All the listed amenities were provided and available to use. Only two complaints I have is some guests were not respectful of the quiet hours listed and there was only one outlet in my room, so perhaps an extension cord would be nice to have in the future. Overall, it was a relaxing and nice stay for me!

This home is perfect for 2 people. You feel right at home. Kitchen and bathroom were clean with plenty of towels. Bed (double size) was comfortable. Since it is an older building, it may be difficult for older folks or those who cannot lift luggage up/down a few steps to get in/out of home. You need to step up into bathtub/shower. It was a nice stay for me.
This was a great space for our family and the location is awesome!
Fabulous apartment, great amenities. Exactly as advertised. Fantastic host, great communication.
Great accommodation.
Excellent value hostel style airbnb in unbeatable location. Cohosts are kind and quick to respond, and were accommodating to my needs. Will be back!

What a beautifully curated and maintained apartment! Pristine condition.  Peaceful and safe.  Everything we needed was there. Location was great in a lovely and quiet neighborhood with proximity to park, public transit, and grocery. Responsive and excellent host. Hope to stay here again.
Solid digs, it’s hard to find 6BR in near north.  It’s actually 2 units — 3BR each — which makes sense.  Tidy and accessible with no major complaints.  Brad was communicative.
The location of the apartment is perfect you have a lot of things to do in the surroundings

This apartment was great for our stay for our son‘s graduation at Northwestern, we were right on a bus line, so it made easy to get to and from the campus. There was a good amount of space as there were five of us in the group. The medium size refrigerator was nice for keeping food, not much in the way for cooking just a microwave, but we weren’t there much eating.
Perfect, perfect location— especially so close to Red line for Cubs AND White Sox games. Super easy to get around, the neighborhood is lovely, and we were all sorry to leave.
Enjoyed staying at Caitlin’s place. Close to all the activities and in a quiet part of town. A decent amount of stairs up and down to get in and out of the place.

We enjoyed our stay! It is a perfect location to walk to many different areas or hop on public transportation to go further. Being so close to the water and beaches was fantastic for the summer. The keypad/lock system on the door was a little finicky at times, and while cooking we noticed there were very minimal dishes (no bowls, tiny plates). Not a huge deal, just worth mentioning if cooking is important to someone booking. Otherwise we definitely enjoyed our stay in the cute neighborhood!

We had a good stay at Regina’s apartment. Instructions for check-in were super easy and the location is amazing. Walking distance to downtown Andersonville, but far enough that it’s a quiet street. The furniture was different from the pictures, and the bed was sagging (as mentioned in other reviews) but it was okay for a short stay. I had a brief issue with the internet while trying to watch a World Cup game, but Regina messaged me quickly with helpful instructions that solved the problem.

Nice place for 8 guys at a reasonable price! The train is legit a 2-3 minute walk to take you downtown.
Would recommend switching some of the mattresses! A few of the guys said their bed was not comfy but slept okay!
The house is adorable! Perfect size for a week stay and so much better than a hotel. We found the house and yard to be very quiet considering its location. Highly recommend!!!!!
房间非常干净整洁，入住顺利，周边环境很安静，步行可达芝大。

Place was exactly as pictured in photos.
Area was quiet and convenient.Antonio was available and immediately responded and replaced a hair dryer.Will definitely stay with him again when we visit our children who live in the area.
Great spot, a lot to do in the area. It was perfect for us.
I highly recommend!
Excellent host, very communicative and great hospitality!
Loved the stay! It was walkable, clean and comfortable for a last minute visit to Chicago with friends.
I felt right at home. This place is truly an amazing stay. Can’t go wrong booking this place.

This place was awful. Broken elevator without warning (safety concern). The unit looked nothing like the photos.
Water damage around window and air conditioner with curtains missing and blinds damaged. Holes in the walls all around the unit. Filthy mop hanging right at washer lid. The stairway in the building was terrible. Brought issues up to owner with no address.
Contacted Airbnb for a 50% refund. They will offered a $150 Airbnb coupon. This was not acceptable. The owner’s argument was that we stayed for the duration and did t leave! We had no where to go in this area.
We had such a bad experience with the place, the owner’s argument and Airbnb. I spent hours sharing pictures and writing this all up with no acceptable redress. We have had pretty good experiences with Airbnb, until this stay. Shame on the host, Regina, and Airbnb for not covering this was absolutely disillusioning.

Great stay!!! Kelsey and Adam were very responsive on all questions. Loved the house and the decor 😊 especially the bird feeder!!! Everything was as described - beds were also super comfy! Perfect location (except for normal Chicago traffic) to get to downtown Chicago and also up to Northwestern University. We unfortunately did not get to explore the little town the house was in but saw some nice places we would love to visit next time!
Nice area and great park nearby. Easy to find parking on street in front of house.
Great Host! Great Location! Comfortable beds, spotlessly clean, and easy on off from freeways and airport.

Jummy was an incredible host. Communication was excellent from start to finish, with quick, respectful, and helpful responses throughout the stay. The space was beautiful, spacious, and extremely clean. From the bathroom to the counters and everything in between, everything felt pristine and well cared for. Check-in and check-out were easy, and the directions were very clear. Overall, it was a great stay, and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and well-hosted Airbnb.
We had a nice stay - great location, clean and comfortable apartment. Tracee was a great host, communicative and quick to respond when we needed help.
Great location in Chicago, and the space has all of the necessities.

Affordable and nice little apartment. It was comfortable, and having a grocery store within walking distance was very convenient.
Jorge was responsive and easy to communicate with.
The only thing that made me a little uncomfortable was that after booking, I was asked for the first & last names and ages of everyone in the group, including minors/infants, as well as where we were coming from. It was the first time I've experienced that when booking a place.
Other than that, everything went well, and we had a good stay.

location, location, location. I was there for a show at the Vic theater and this location was perfect. it was close enough to walk to the lake in the daytime then to the venue at night. good restaurant options nearby and a lively neighborhood. the bells from the school across the street were a surprise, but only on the first morning. i didn't spend much time in the apartment but it was perfectly comfortable when I did.
Kareem was the most gracious host. The space was thoughtfully designed and stocked.
Decent chain hotel in North River area of downtown. Walking distance to many of the famous Chicago landmarks. Pool looked nice, although I didn't have time for a dip. Maybe next time.
Our family had a great time staying at the house! Perfect for large families.
Andrei was very helpful with check-in and during our entire stay. Bedrooms were very comfortable for my family. Cute neighborhood and very walkable. We would definitely stay there again!

We were so pleased with Sharon’s place. It was clean, well appointed, and conveniently located, with easy access to public transportation, Wrigley, and numerous bars and restaurants. Sharon was quick to reply to questions, and was super helpful. We can’t wait to go back!
Great space in a really nice location. It was clean, easy to find, and quiet. We would absolutely stay here again!

The apartment upstairs is very noisy all night, and we cannot sleep. The blanket also has a bad smell. The apartment needs better maintenance. The host is not very responsive. I asked for paper towels, but they were not provided.

The apartment was very clean and had plenty of room for us. It was centrally located between Evanston and downtown Chicago which was perfect. Parking was really our only challenge but we managed to figure it out.
Thanks for hosting us!
Ótimo local. Atendimento excelente. O quarto tinha um pouco de cheiro de poeira, o que é normal para quem está acostumado com carpete, mas quem não está por ficar incomodado.

Stay was nice & central to Andersonville. Nothing fancy but the place is clean & comfortable. Unfortunately miscommunication regarding a street festival day of arrival, with a stage immediately outside the windows, so check the event calendar for the area before booking if that's not a good fit for you!
Abia is the perfect host and her home is amazing!! Everything was great and just as described I would definitely love to stay there again and would recommend this place!!!

The apartment was in a great location next to the ball park. It's a busy place at night with the games / concerts and bars, but once inside the apartment I didn't really hear the noise. The apartment was clean and well equiped.
Spacious, well-appointed apartment, good location
Such an incredible stay, I would move in if I could! I would stay here every time I am in Chicago!

Clean & very nice place on the inside. Pleasantly surprised. Outside & outside area could have used a little TLC. Grass was overgrown, grill was dirty, & the bar area outside was unusable due to overgrown trees.

Nicki’s place was great for our family of 6. We had an amazing stay while we visited Chicago for our daughter’s graduation from Northwestern. The apartment was centrally located and easy to get around. It was just as it was pictured and it was so nice and cozy. Our family also enjoyed the board games, the outdoor area, and just the easy access to shops and restaurants close by.
Nikki was a great host and was very responsive when we had questions. She even let us check out a little later to accommodate my son’s schedule.
If in Chicago again we would Definitely rebook!

The apartment was clean and the check in and check out instructions were clear. Unfortunately, we were only provided with one bath towel per person, plus a few wash cloths. When we requested additional towels, we were told to “check the cabinets and closets for extras” to which we found none. After we told the host we couldn’t find any, they replied that they don’t provide more than one towel per person. Why tell us to check the cabinets and closets if you know you don’t provide extras? Odd. We were ultimately told there was a laundry room if we needed to wash them. Additionally we, like other guests, had some issues with the WiFi. The WiFi that was initially provided in the instructions was not showing up on the list of networks. After a few messages to the host, we were able to eventually get the WiFi working. Overall a cozy, clean apartment but if you’re expecting more than one towel just know there aren’t extras and you will be denied if you ask for more.
Todo muy bien!
Very nice place as described. Very comfy apartment with all the necessary stuff as you are at home. I'm glad because was a last minute reservation. Next time in Chicago I'll try this place again.

We just finished a wonderful stay at this Lincoln Park Airbnb. The location is literally 4 1/2 minutes from Lincoln Park Zoo (gate to gate). We walked around the park/lake/zoo every day. It is just a fabulous location with lots of places to go up and down Clark Street. The condo has everything you would want and is full of thoughtful and unexpected touches like a high-speed USB-C charger, a Keurig coffee machine with K-cups, powdered creamers and sweeteners, Kleenex and soap in all the right places, kitchen with most of the gadgets and cookware you'd want. A/C!
The beds are comfortable. The bathrooms are nice and stocked with soaps and shampoos. I will point out that the smaller bedroom with the queen-sized mattress is the one with the en suite bathroom and accompanying shower. The bedroom with the king sized bed has blackout curtains and would use the bathroom down the hall with the double sink.
What a lovely place! Host communication was excellent. Thank you so much!
Super host and a terrific place to stay.  Impeccably decorated and appointed. Everything we needed for a family gathering. Would stay here again!
Really nice host and great place! Comfortable and exactly as advertised. Spacious, well designed, and clean.

I had a great stay at Joey and Monica's place! The hosts were punctual and professional in their communication, the place was clean and organized, and the location is connected to downtown Chicago (among other areas) via public transport. Will recommend staying there.

Great location! Very walkable to coffee in the morning, the Jewel Osco grocery store is only a block away and it is an easy walk to the Andersonville shops and restaurants.  The CTA Red Line station is also super close.  The home had lots of traditional Chicago character with beautiful woodwork and high ceilings in the main living areas. The kitchen has everything you would need and more. We enjoyed the peacefulness of sitting on the back deck. Lots of space for everyone.  Highly recommend staying here!
My second time staying here. Great location. Great value. Will book there again!

Great location and wonderful views. We love the restaurants by Fulton Market, and we just walked around the area.
Johana and Akos were very friendly and accommodating hosts. Flexible with check-in and check-out times. Very responsive.
The unit had all that we needed, from working space, laundry, and all the amenities that you would need while away from home.
My partner and I had an amazing time for our little get away. Everything was so nice. Check in was easy. Great communication time. We enjoyed ourselves.
很好的体验
Host Rida was great. Good communication and clear instructions. Apartment was clean comfortable. Location is close to train, but noise was not bad. Thanks Rida
A fairly convenient spot to stay if you're headed to a show at the Salt Shed.

Lito and Chip were friendly, responsive, and accommodating. They left a lovely welcome wine and snacks which we appreciated. The flat was beautiful, comfortable, and met all our needs. A great place to stay for Northwestern graduation!
This place was a great deal. Decently close to the downtown, with plenty to do within walking distance. Definitely recommend!

Hosts were friendly and responsive. Their space was exactly as described.  We really enjoyed having a cozy, comfortable space to come back to each day. The location is quiet and safe. We will definitely rebook in the future!
Great home and great location. It was the perfect stay for our group traveling from Cincinnati.
Good place to stay if you’re really interested in being outside and out and about In Chicago

Great 2 bedroom for a small group. Location is excellent for those exploring Bucktown, Wicker Park, Logan Square. Perfect distance to the blue line train and great cross streets for busses. The included parking in the garage is great, we got to drive into town and unload everything comfortably and then we left the car safely in the garage all weekend while using the public transit.

Loved the location. Just a 9 min walk to train. Block away from bus. Place itself is cute & charming & great bed. Living room was perfect to unwind in. Would definitely stay again.
Few notes: We had what we needed in kitchen because we mostly ate out. Just the basics though. If you're planning on extended stay & really cook, gain clarity on what kitchen is stocked with.
There were only 2 towels. My wife needed a 3rd for her hair & was told no when she asked. Alma told us we would need to wash towels if we needed to reuse. W/D in bldg is not free.
Light in the alcove area & on our floor wasn't working. Every night we came home to a pitch black area where we had to use our phone flashlight to retrieve key from lockbox. It was really inconvenient & felt unsafe going up & down stairs. We told Alma the 1st night. It was not fixed while we were there.
Cheap tp. :(
The place did not feel like it was owned by someone that could actually do anything to help. Alma was responsive but not helpful.
Very nice, clean home. Parking was easy to find just a half block away. Quiet neighborhood. We enjoyed our stay.

We loved this place. It was a short walk from the Brown Line and in a nice neighborhood with some great restaurants. The Airbnb itself was very clean. We also appreciated that it was stocked with things like bathroom supplies, medicine, coffee, etc. Finally, the bed was the comfiest my girlfriend has ever slept in. She could not stop talking about it.
We had a wonderful stay here, the place is exactly as described and very comfortable to fit our family of six. The area is close to the train and the neighborhood is peaceful.
Clean, accurate photos, clear instructions on how to check in, very responsive to questions,  excellent grocery store across the street. Good stuff 👍

We had a wonderful stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was easy to find, located in a quiet area, and made for a relaxing visit. Communication with the host was excellent—they were responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Check-in and check-out were both smooth and hassle-free. Overall, we had a great experience and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommended!
thanks for a great stay.

Had an absolutely wonderful stay! From the moment I booked, the host was communicative, welcoming, and went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed. The space was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and full of thoughtful things.
For the price, this place is an incredible value. Whether you’re visiting for a weekend or a longer stay, this is the kind of listing you bookmark and come back to.
Highly recommend to anyone looking for a stress-free, enjoyable experience. Already thinking about my next trip back!
The place itself is nice but it’s just not in the best area. On our third day our car was broken into, vandalized and disabled. Nobody really seemed to care either.
We loved our stay here! The garage was definitely a plus!!
This place was great in so many ways! Street parking was easy with a spot out front most of the time. Check in & check out instructions were helpful and clear. Overall so comfortable. Thank you!!!!
Great location and lovely place
Matthew’s space was truly lovely and unique—a great launching point for a fun weekend in the city. Definitely gorgeous and do recommend!

Amy’s place was perfect for our family! Comfy beds, walkable area, 3 playgrounds nearby, and lots of great restaurants. Amy was very responsive and I loved the personalized touch at check-in. I would 100% try to stay here again.
Wonderful Host! Would definitely recommend to anyone who’s looking to take a trip to Chicago! Has great coffee shops around the location, as well as amazing food options!
Nice place it is
Fantastic hosts, perfect location!
Place was amazing and just what our group had needed! Lani the host was super responsive and nice! The neighbors were so welcoming and friendly as well, would definitely book again in the future !❤️
Wonderful stay!

Had a great multigenerational stay In Lida’s place. My 87 year old mother, my 16 year old son and me (55) all felt extremely comfortable in the apartment and enjoyed walking around the neighborhood. Would go back!
Had a great stay! Lovely host, very clean and felt safe.
This was our second time staying here. Great location. The apartment was clean and the kitchen was stocked with plenty of cooking equipment. Our host was very responsive. Delightful!
Nice spot! Happy with our stay.

best spot to stay, in my case i was here for a festival in seakgeek stadium, and it was a good distance away and you have a subway or bus right outside to take you to the city. great food around the area. 10/10 airbnb.
We had a wonderful stay at Toby’s place. location was great and the bathtub was a dream

If you have ever stayed in a motel 6 on the side of the free way.....take that quality and amenities and apply it to an airbnb....thats what youre getting here.
The location is amazing, but the unit needs some love.
First and foremost you get one key to the building. Staying with multiple guests? Better hope you stay together.
Power to the unit? Not consistent. power cut out several times in the middle of the night leaving us with no AC.
No towel hooks in the bathroom, put your towels on the sink or toilet.
I could go on.
maybe this is just the state of airbnb.....but next time ill stay in a motel for cheaper
Honestly everything was as described. Price was honestly worth it. They did a really good job with that one.

Kevin's place was fantastic! Looks even better in person, photos dont do it justice. Cold plunge and hot tub were squeaky clean and imo a unique add to the stay. Great neighborhood, less than a block to train, and tons of great food options. Views of skyline and neighborhood were outstanding, just all around a great home base for exploring the city and having a welcoming retreat to come back to - 11/10 would book again.

As we booked into this home we had not realized there was a bug issue. During the first night we did not use a room as our friends were using that room and their flights got canceled.
I say this as this room we found a bug in it so we killed it and left the room alone. We then turned the AC down to around 66 and left the home due to the temp being at 80 upon arrival.
As we came back home, we found that exact room covered in flying ants and we even found a house centipede. The host refuses to refund anything and also is trying to claim it is our fault, this is significantly false as we inspected the room ourselves and found MANY holes in this “new renovated” home.
So with just warning, understand that when you book this place you will deal with a bug infestation, people hanging trash on your door (that the host will say you did), a manipulative and lying host (said that we left damp clothes out to dry on the couch, it was actually FULLY DRY AND CLEAN merch we had just bought)

Muy buen para quedarte si viajas solo. La ubicación está cerca del transporte y casi siempre hay gente, se me hizo segura la zona por eso. La casa está amplia y acomodada, tenía todo lo que anunciaba y al llegar te recibían con amenidades extras y el anfitrión muy amable y atento.
Great host, great home. Perfect for large groups or families. Has parking in the back which is nice.
Cute apartment and good location for exploring Chicago. However, recommend not staying during the Puerto Rican festival as traveling to and from there becomes nearly impossible.

Place was exactly as described. Kim was super helpful and friendly. We felt very comfortable and enjoyed our stay. The only thing is that uber drivers kept canceling on us due to location of pick up if we ordered it too late at night saying they avoid area at night because it is known to be unsafe.  Personally, we didn’t have any problems.

Such accommodating and helpful hosts that went above and beyond. We enjoyed our stay and had everything we needed. Highly walkable location and accessible to public transportation. Was comfortable for 3 adults.
Our second time staying at Cheryl’s place, would definitely stay again! Clean space, easy check-in/check-out, and the ideal location for visiting our family in Chicago.
No issues, enjoyed the stay.

Great home! Great location! House had everything we needed for a long weekend in Chicago. We even cooked food for the weekend and had all the cooking pots, pans and utensils. Very spacious and clean! We even used the cards one night for game night! Loved the parking was free and never had an issue parking!
Nice

The place overall was a pleasant stay! It was close to everything and walkable for the most part. Just enough space for two people and it had everything we needed! Finding the place and getting in was a breeze and very convenient. Charlie was very responsive and helpful! If you are a light sleeper you may need the supplied ear plugs as you can hear everything outside of the bedroom window!
Our only problem was the couch. It was very uncomfortable and small. This posed an issue as the only tv was in the living room so when we wanted to relax and unwind the discomfort forced us to go to bed instead. I would strongly recommend a new couch or adding a tv in the bedroom to avoid this in the future! Other than that we would definitely come back and stay again! Thanks again!

Daniel's apartment was the perfect fit for our group! Just enough space, steps from plenty to do, and was well-stocked with things we might need. He was also great host and was really responsive and proactive to make sure we were settled in ok. We would definitely stay here again!

Beautiful, spacious apartment in a lovely neighborhood! Lots of great Vegan food options and shopping within walking distance! Appreciated there was a kettle in the kitchen for tea- no coffee flavored hot water! Did discover on the day of check out that the hot water did not work in the shower which wasn't the best wake up experience, but without time to speak with the host for anything to be fixed we just dealt with the cold showers.

This was not the airbnb that was listed with pictures. I have photographic evidence of so. The only reason we didn't say anything before is because we feared her making us leave and us being stranded in Chicago. she already promised us a garage door opener before coming including parking but that was NOT there on the counter. Both of our cars ended up getting towed that weekend due to this. Multiple places on the wall with scuff marks not pictured in listing. was NOT even capable of being able to host 10 people as we struggled with 8. Im not trying to hate on this lady because she was nice but I would appreciate honesty from the start and I'll respect you back.

Mr. Rich was a great host. He was very flexible with our early check in. He made sure to check in on us making sure everything went well. Even when there was an unforeseen issue he was responsive and helpful through it all.
Great place and good host i highly recommend

Water all over the kitchen and bathroom. People slipping and falling all over the place because of the slippery floor. Way too much $ and way too many rules for what you’re getting. Not to mention all of my friend’s hair products and skin care and RAZOR that was stolen from the bathroom. When asked about it she got super offended and started blowing up our phones despite saying it was fine. Don’t stay here.
This place was so cute! You can tell everything was well thought of for guests to have an easy and comfortable stay. Everything was neat and clean!
A little hesitant at first because of the location but we felt comfortable and safe.  Host was very helpful with any questions we had. If ever in the Chicago area I would definitely stay here again.

The home was beautiful, beds were comfortable, outdoor area was gorgeous at night, and the kitchen was fully stocked with everything we needed to make the food we bought from the grocery store only 15 minutes away. While the area itself has its fair share of inconveniences (the bnb description is transparent about that in the viewing already) , the bnb still allowed us to feel safe and comfortable! I would not recommend to families with young children if safety is #1 concern but the actual bnb is absolutely lovely and I would be willing to stay again! Especially given the fact there was great communication with the host. Very grateful for our stay🙏🏼
Sheldon was responsible flexible with my check in and was very instructive, thank you for a great stay
We loved our time, clean with lots of space, and Daniel was very responsive

Great location and awesome setup for groups. We were able to get our family and extended family under one roof which was great. Especially liked the parking spot on site and the ability to be able to walk to the train station and go downtown without needing to use the car. Great communication and easy to get ahold of host. Would definitely stay again
Thank you for a lovely stay, Kanan.  We look forward to returning to Chicago!

We really enjoyed our stay here. The neighborhood is full of things to do and very walkable. Convenient to many amenities. The apartment is spacious and clean and was perfect for our quick weekend in the city. Great stay and will definitely be back!

Charming place to stay in the best Chicago neighborhood.  Comfortable and surprisingly quiet despite the vibrant night life just outside.  Very close to some of my favorite restaurants and coffee places (I used to live in Wicker Park).  Very responsive host.

My families first time staying at an air bnb. It was super clean and very up to date. Beds were comfortable but no TVs in any of the bedrooms but that was fine everyone had their phones and ipads. Parking was a bit difficult to find on the streets but not too far from the air bnb. Jhon was very quick at responding to my messages and gave very clear instructions. I would stay here again in the future
Great host, amazing support and great place as well. Will book this Airbnb every time I visit Chicago!!!

Perfect place to stay for a couple days in the heart of busy Chicago downtown. House was clean and comfortable host quick responsive everything as instruction only one thing the ambulance siren, but this is downtown. Thank you again for hosting us. Definitely will stay again if we go there.
Great stay, clean house, beautiful area
Great, clean, loved the location,  walking distance to great shopping and dining! Loved everything about this place.
Nice and comfortable place to Stay!! Will for sure be coming back if I come back out that way!!
Great stay and pretty walkable to the nearest station — safe to get to the place at night as well! Erik is a very respectful and responsive host — willing to accommodate and help you
We loved staying here!! More importantly we loved the nice little city view. Waking up here every morning was a dream.
We had a great stay. Appreciated the clear communication

Junni's place is in a great locatsion. It has lots of separate sitting spaces, so it can be fun to explore. There are five legitimate beds in the house, each in its own room- so don't be confused by the picture of the sofa. The downstairs bedrooms are well appointed but very snug. The bathrooms are all three excellent.

This place was in a great location.  However, when we arrived the fan in the second bedroom was broke. Which Heather over nighted a fan. But the front door lock was broken. No attempt was made to fix it. We had to go down the very steep stairs the entire time with our baby. And on moving out she did not respond for several hours about giving us guidance on where to leave the keys.

I love this area.Her room was confortable and I got enough sleep.
My threedays job was so hard but I felt relax at this house.

Freddy’s place was extremely clean and super cozy!! He is very accommodating and provided anything you could need! He’s also very responsive and proactive with events going on or anything that may inconvenience your stay in the area such as weather, parades and parking. Would absolutely recommend this place to anyone!

This air bnb was booked for 9 people. There were only 6 beds total all of which twin sized. One couch which was not a pull out and one air mattress not sure how 9 people were expected to sleep. Aside from that there were no towels to shower with and warm water only lasted for about 1 or two people max before it was freezing temperatures to shower in. There was also a stabbing on the same floor of our room the next morning there was blood stains splattered all throughout the halls staircase rather than cleaning it the unit decided to slap a wet floor sign down and call it a day. Disappointed is an understatement, my advice is to not stay in this air bnb if you are with a larger group. I was 1 of 9 guys so there is rarely a time where we would complain however this was unacceptable standards were not met and far from it.
Had a good stay definitely worth the money. The home was very beautiful.
I had a great stay

The airbnb was clean and neat. Our host was very responsive and cooperative. The only inconvenience was that there is a door connected to someone else’s home, so please be aware of the door in the kitchen! The floors are also really squeaky and a little eerie. Overall, it was a great airbnb experience and the location was nice. Definitely recommend.

Kody’s place was exactly as advertised. Very true to the photos, spotless, and a good place to stage our Chicago adventures from with easy access to interstates 55 and 90.
Kody was uber responsive the entire time, and even helped us gain access to the house ~45 min early.
The kitchen was well stocked and equipped, though we didn’t cook. The kitchen and dining area stood out above the rest.

Had a great time, this was my first bnb booking & Nesha made it very easy for me. Very easy access to the house when I was getting back late at night, very nice host. It was everything I needed. Nesha even offered to show me around, which I greatly appreciate. She made me feel at home for sure. Very clean living area, sweet puppies & very friendly faces.
Look no further, place is perfect for visiting Chicago. Clean, convenient and host was great. Safe, quiet, beautiful neighborhood.

ABSOLUTELY AMAZING, the place was beautiful. So aesthetically pleasing cant wait to book again, Marjorie was so responsive and helped me so much during my stay for summer smash 1000/10. Will book again.

Beautiful, very clean, and comfortable place for our family of 6 plus a baby. We took full advantage of the location - walkable to the Oak Street Beach (sandy) and paths along the lakefront, shopping, museums, and restaurants (great croissants at a bakery right next door). We walked or took the train everywhere and felt safe day and night. The apartment was perfect for us to unwind and enjoy being together. Lots of thoughtful touches for ex. umbrella (it rained) and yoga mats (Oak St Beach has free morning yoga). Sofa bed was put to use and also very comfortable. Thank you for a relaxing and memorable stay!

This apartment is so beautiful and pristine! It is also very well equipped with anything you may need. My family and I spent the weekend there and felt very comfortable and happy with our choice. We wanted to be midway between Chicago and Evanston and the location was great for that purpose. The host was very friendly and communicative. I would recommend this place if you have a car (there is designated parking) or if you are planning to take public transportation to various locations in and around Chicago.

Place was nice and super clean. Couch and bed were comfy. Way better than any hotel i’ve stayed in. My complaints would be that the upstairs neighbors are pretty loud, not with their volume but with stopping around and moving stuff at all times of day. The neighborhood itself is okay but outside of it is kind of rough. Host was quick to respond and gave me clear instructions on check in and check out. In all I wouldn’t mind staying here again, it just might not be for you if you care about noise.
Awesome place to stay in Chicago!

Worst Airbnb experience ever; this house has no business being rented.
Day one, a hair dryer blew a fuse and a guest got shocked resetting the breaker, killing power to several bedrooms. The host was unreachable for 24 hours and left us to deal directly with a family member during our vacation. Extension cords were run to the bedrooms and an 8am visit was scheduled.
Instead, at 11:30pm, three people rang the bell and tried walking straight in. A guest rushed down and stopped them; they claimed they had other jobs the next day. Genuinely dangerous, and the owner falsely claimed on camera no one tried entering. We barricaded the doors afterward. Power was fixed the next day while we were out.
The house was also dated and dirty: a finger-pinching doorknob (warned by a sign, not fixed), a front door handle that fell off, no spare trash bags, an unscrewed toilet seat, and a master shower with no pressure or working knobs.
Airbnb believes this is acceptable! Switching to VRBO.
Great host, great location, exactly as described. Highly recommend!

Everything was as described. Clean, open space. Parking was easy and close. We will stay here again when we go back to Chicago. And the restaurant below the airbnb was DELICIOUS. A great perk. Definitely recommend!!
Our stay was cute, comfy, and incredibly clean! Instructions before and during the stay were very helpful (pictures were appreciated) and the location was incredibly convenient.

Stay with Jaime was great. The place was easy to find. Parking is free but a tad bit difficult to secure if you aren’t early. Great walking distance from restaurants and public transportation directly to the city.
We will definitely consider this spot next time we’re in town.

We had a great stay overall! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive, and the location worked well for our trip. The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that parking was a bit of a hassle and not as convenient as we had hoped. Other than that, everything was wonderful, and we would definitely consider staying here again.

place was great, comfy to stay at. wish it was a little more stocked with common amenities like toilet paper and detergent, which we had to purchase our self. other wise overall a great place to stay.

A perfect Chicago base. The top-floor apartment in this 1893 Greystone delivered exactly what it promised: vaulted ceilings, exposed brick, stained glass, and a quiet leafy street that felt genuinely residential rather than touristy. The space was spotless, well-appointed, and the location couldn't be better for exploring Wicker Park and Bucktown on foot. The Damen Blue Line is right around the corner, which made getting around the city effortless. Amy was a wonderful host, responsive and warm, and made the whole stay easy from start to finish. Highly recommend. We'll be back for sure.

We enjoyed our stay.  The location was nice for walking around, and it was a short Uber ride to other places we went such as The Salt Shed.  The studio had everything we needed.  We really enjoyed having the back patio area to enjoy the nice weather.  The bed was very comfortable.  We were surprised that parking was so easy; we were always able to park right in front of the building.  Brad was very proactive with communications and answered a question we had very quickly.

My group and I had a great stay with Milan. Everything matched up with the descriptions, host was responsive, and the location is perfect for being near tourist attractions within in the city. The space was lovely and never felt cluttered with all the amenities we needed.
Our flight got completely messed up and she was soooo accommodating and on top of all the communication.  She was so lovely to converse with.
Great stay

First, the house is as pictured, and actually more charming in person. It’s well-decorated, very comfortable, and SUPER clean (and I’m very particular about that!) .
Second, Tara and Tim provided helpful information about the area and checked in to make sure everything was as expected.
Third, the neighborhood is beautiful, safe, and quiet. It’s very walkable to shops, restaurants and to public transportation.
Fourth, some might consider this home expensive. In reality, it’s comparable to many other Airbnbs and hotels. But this home is definitely worth it for the comfort and convenience it offers a family wanting shared space to spend time together - priceless!
I would not hesitate to book here again. I just hope it’ll be available!

I absolutely will book again, on top of being 4/20 check in & out was super easy. no issues with parking whatsoever, even after coming back late after midnight. Roads a bit busy but it just helps me sleep at night! Overall the host was friendly & helpful, and the apartment was super nice, even better than the pictures. Thank you so much!!!
I beautiful spacious home. Did not cook or entertained but gorgeous roof top . The only downside was the 4 th floor w no elevator . Loved the artwork in the house .

Location, Location, location
Hopefully youre agile when you walk up the 3 flights of stairs it takes to get to this shared room. Kitchenette was nice and clean, no stovetop. Cold water was often not available. Also enjoy a shared thermostat located in the hallway. Only a 24 min walk to The Salt Shed.

We had a great stay here! Close to china town and to L train stops. Place was clean and we only heard hallway noise one night. It’s in the city so you’ll hear sirens and stuff at night but in this unit there are two bedrooms and for the light sleepers the interior room is great to not hear them. Thanks!

Richard was easy to communicate with especially since we were dealing with cancelled flights and other delays. He did his best to make himself available for our ever-changing check-in times which we are very appreciative of. The residence itself was small and cute but had all the amenities we needed for a graduation weekend.

Great place overall, nice area with Public transportation. If you’re looking for a place to sleep and eat, this is more or less what you’re getting here. My main issue is just with the cleanliness. The bathroom overall was just a mess, bugs, amenities not organized etc. Aside from that, no complaints. Nice hosts and very accommodating aside from that.
Clean space, conveniently located close to the airport.

I had a fabulous time in Chicago, and part of that was having a fabulous place to stay. Large, pristine, well decorated. Was nice to wake up to sit in the sun on a chair in the front sun room. Hugh was a very helpful and responsive host. Highly recommend. I hope to stay there again next time.

Bianca and Jason are such gracious hosts and have great neighborhood recommendations! Communication was quick and clear and the space has thoughtful amenities. This is our second time staying here and we will be back!

The unit accommodated us. No frills. Weather a bit. Charcoal towels and sheets were interesting.
The unit does get the job done, just not luxury.

We absolutely loved our stay here.
The apartment was spacious, comfortable, and thoughtfully laid out, with plenty of separation of space for our group. What we appreciated most, though, was the feeling of being part of a neighborhood rather than simply staying in a hotel. We walked miles exploring the area, enjoyed easy access to Lake Michigan, Hyde Park, museums, parks, and local businesses, and always looked forward to returning “home” at the end of the day.
The hosts were incredibly accommodating and kind. They allowed us to stay a few extra hours on our departure day and graciously stored our luggage until it was time to head to the airport, which made our travel day so much easier.
The apartment itself has character, warmth, and life. It reflects the creativity and values described in the listing and felt welcoming from the moment we arrived. We truly cannot imagine having stayed in an impersonal downtown hotel instead.
Highly recommended, and we would gladly stay here again.
Our stay at as amazing even though we were out for most of it! Beds were comfy rules were clear, and if you love cats I def recommend this place lots of outdoor cats which i loves

I loved staying here while I was in town for Midsommarfest. The separate keyless entrance made check-in as well as coming/going very easy. It was nice not needing to worry about keeping track of Airbnb keys while I'm on vacation. The bathroom was spacious and spotless, and the bed was comfortable. Great water pressure and the shower gets hot. You really can't beat the location, just steps from Clark Street in the heart of Andersonville. I woke up to birds chirping everyday. I would definitely stay here again!
Great stay. Met our needs. Friendly and quick responses to questions.
The house is simply incredible. Ryan answered all my questions without hesitation and helped me to perfect my stay. Thank you so much!
Small little spot saved my life when my hotel reservation failed on me was able to get it very quickly very easy entry and good communication from the host.
Daivd's place was great in every way. Great location, great condition, great space. I would definitely try to stay there next time I'm in the area.
The only hiccup was a lack of parking passes when we arrived, but Dubbs management responded very quickly and got passes to us before it became a problem.
My Airbnb was cancelled 2 days prior to the weather and I’m still waiting on a refund. My trip was scheduled for 6/13 and still no refund and I reached out twice and no answer.
We had a great experience! The place is super cute and better than expected. Had no issues with the host, she was nice and helpful.
Steven was an absolute incredible host. The house is aincredibly spacious and social. Love the environment and everyone that I met here. The Dock is also gorgeous. HIGHLY recommend!
We liked staying at Monica’s place. We found a little animal hair and some dust but it wasn’t anything bad but we noticed it. It was ideal for what we needed it for.

The hot water is only enough for two people to take a shower, maybe three if they are really small, fast showers. The listing says the hot water tank is 80 gallons, but in actuality the hot water tank is 38 gallons. After we ran out of hot water and inquired, we were told the hot water was out in the whole building, which was not true. The host and Airbnb did adjust the price since some of us could not take hot showers, but the dishonesty is more of the issue. If you let people know upfront, they can prepare better. Otherwise, the beds were comfortable, the host response very quickly, the area is safe, and despite it being a smoking unit, it did not smell like smoke - which was another concern I raised before we arrived. I would recommend for only two people or those who are prepared to run out of hot water.

I had a great time staying here. It was a bit confusing checking in but the host was very responsive and helped us right away.
I enjoyed my stay

We have stayed here before, and will again. It’s a lovely and spacious apartment with a homey feel. Everything was exactly as described. It’s very convenient to an excellent food market…always important when at an Airbnb.
Thanks Eric!
Great place and great host!

Kevin & Adele’s place was incredible! It was a perfect distance from Chicago that wasn’t too far, but secluded enough to step away from the bustling downtown. We really enjoyed the place and came with everything for a great weekend away.

We loved our stay here. The place was so clean, we really appreciated how nice it was. The neighborhood is very peaceful and felt very safe to walk around, even if you’re a woman by yourself. Also night felt as safe as day time for walking. Lots of shops and restaurants close by. Mindy’s bakery was yummy.
There is plenty of space to spread out in this place with its three levels and two porches. It’s close to the train station and has bus stops close by as well.
It was quiet so no disturbances to your sleep.
Everyone found it to be very comfortable and enjoyed our stay here.
Amazing

Enjoyed my stay!

There was only 1 window unit in the front bedroom so the back room was extremely hot to sleep in.

Sharon is very friendly. She responded to texts promptly. When I asked her how to open the door and where to park, she got back to me within a couple of minutes.
I got a ticket for not moving my vehicle before 7am. I thought it was 8。Sharon covere the fine for us.
Mmm

It was a great place to stay and it was very comfortable to be at. Me and my husband had a great time and it was worth what we paid. Brandon did not bother us at all and he let us do as we pleased and he was a very great host. You will like staying here it was great.
Very good
Freddy was so friendly and super responsive to any questions we had. Nice quiet neighborhood as described! Would definitely stay again :)
Great place !
Clean, comfortable, great open space.

The host was a very thorough communicator, and the space was very clean. It’s a small room but for two people it was plenty of space. Be cautious if you are a light sleeper, because the walls in the room are thin and the cleaning crew that comes by to clean the space were sometimes a bit loud. Public transportation made travel very convenient during our stay, the #72 bus stop is right down the street and it takes you all the way to the Blue Line CTA station. Overall a pleasant stay.

Janet is a wonderful host! Available when needed, unobtrusive when not. The mini suite was clean and well appointed. Her listing accurately described the space as small, but suited my husband and I perfectly. The neighborhood is safe and in walking distance to Wrigley, restaurants and train stations. We look forward to future stays with Janet whenever we need to be in Chicago.
This was our first visit to Chicago and we got super lucky to meet incredible locals that our hosts knew! Our time was well spent, thank you again! We already can’t wait to come back to Archie’s 🎱🍻
Great directions were given by John on getting from airport to their place via train. The location was perfect… close to train station, Andersonville, and the lake to run and bike.
THe apartment was very clean, has a good sofa bed, fully equipped kitchen and great to have a parking space included. The neighborhood is safe and quiet.
The site is well located but access is difficult and through the back door next to the garbage cans.

This unit and the neighborhood around it are absolutely fantastic.  It was located in a very quiet neighborhood but very walkable to get groceries, coffee, public transportation or what ever you need. Pat was responsive to every inquiry we made. The place was just as advertised,  cozy, clean, and extremly comfortable.  Highly recommended.
great stay
good place

Great place to stay, easy to access and park nearby for all the days you stay. Plenty of nearby convenience stores, restaurants, bars, anything you could ask for really. If I’m in the area again I’ll definitely check out Thomas’ place.
It was a amazing quiet little place. Easy to find since they have the clear instructions and a sign pointing out where to go. Had 0 problems would stay again if ever in Chicago again.

Good communication before we checked in; gave suggestions on restaurants and check in questions, but slow to respond when we had an issue with excessive pet hair on the living room rug and wanted a vacuum to clean up. The linen was clean and there were ample towels. Missed a hot water kettle to make tea but enjoyed the tea selections offered.
Location great and the neighborhood was very walkable and I felt very safe walking around on my own as a woman. We were we there during the Puerto Rico festival so it was noisy, but very happy sounds.
The photo showed w divisions and plants that were present. The one plant is almost dead and needs replacing. These are little details but they are significant in making us feel at home.
The cost shown when advertising the location compared to all the added costs by airB&B are very frustrating as they are not up front and transparent. That’s an issue with the platform and this may be one of the last airB&B locations for me

Demetri's apartment was in a good location right next to the subway/train station. Neighbors were very quiet and the apartment was easy accessible. The only downfall of the stay had to be the apartment's pictures/conditions weren't as listed. The bathroom was tiny and painted different colors, the ceiling was also peeling. The floors near the entrance to the bathroom were sinking in, and the whole apartment's wood/floors squeaked. My flight there landed at 9am and I had previously contacted Demetri about an early check in multiple times, he said it'd be based on the cleaners schedule/ if the apartment was ready.
I checked his listing for the day before my stay and nobody had booked so I thought it would be clean and ready for us. He then said I'd have to wait til 4pm normal checktime due to them cleaning it which was odd since nobody had stayed there the couple days before, he then later on during the day texted at 2 we could check in. It was a hassle carrying 2 suitcases around town.
Our group had a lovely stay at Joseph and William’s Airbnb. In a charming neighborhood and a few minutes from the CTA red line!

Okay place, had a extremely hard time with the locks had to have another guest staying there open for me and they told me they experienced the same problem but host was very responsive when I contacted them about it.
Beautiful home with beautiful amenities.  The location was great with great restaurants nearby in walking distance.
Wonderful, updated, clean and comfortable place! David is very responsive!

The perfect place to stay! We booked this home for a big group and had plenty of room, great location, very kind and communicative hosts. Overall we had an amazing and peaceful time. Highly recommend!
Great location
Great, cozy little apartment. Within walking distance to coffee shops, pizza, park, etc.

Amy's spot was great for our family. While the bedrooms are small, it wasn't really a big deal and the space itself was definitely large enough for everyone to be comfortable. Amy was very responsive (especially when I left something behind after checking out!) and accommodating. I recommend this spot for a family looking to explore the city!

We had a fantastic stay! It was perfect for a large group. The large patios, as well as the open kitchen and living room space was great for continuously being together. Restaurants were walkable, and we felt safe the whole time. The hosts were extremely responsive and helpful. Would absolutely book again!

Vladimir was so helpful and friendly and made the place beautiful for a family gathering! It is so comfortable- no hinky vibes at all! And the back deck was a real treat. I would definitely stay again but would avoid the Puerto Rican Festival weekend due to the difficulty navigating the area through road blocks and parade traffic.
Bell was a great host and very responsive will definitely be booking again sometime in the future!

Overall good experience in the space. The apartment was very spacious and provided all the basic necessities for a weekend trip. The space could have been a little bit cleaner particularly in the bathroom but it was clean enough.

We had a wonderful stay! The location is excellent, and the views of Chicago’s skyline—particularly at night—are stunning. The apartment is spacious, spotless, and comfortably accommodated our group of four.  A coffee maker for ground coffee and a dish-drying rack would be nice additions to the kitchen, but overall, it was a fantastic place to stay.

Had a great time staying with John and Terry. They were wonderful hosts. Their home is about 30 mins north of the city by train with the station conveniently located only a few minutes away. There are plenty of restaurants nearby while the street itself is very peaceful and quiet. I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. I only wish I could’ve spent more time enjoying their outdoor patio in the back. It looked beautiful!
Nice and clean place with a responsive host! Would stay again.
Jack had a great place at a great price. He was proactive in reaching out to ensure we had a good stay and offered flexible check-in/check-out. The place was spotless and very quiet.

It was a lovely place for our family visiting from out of town. The place was comfortable and the neighbourhood felt safe and peaceful. Communication was proactive and responsive. Thanks for a lovely stay!
Easy to find I felt so safe residence did occupy other guest but was a issue it was very quite and convient easy access it was a perfect stay for my first time being in Chicago
This place was great! It is very clean and spacious, and it’s right across the street from a beautiful park. A+
What a beautiful place to stay while visiting Chicago.  Convenient to Uptown and the lake
Melissa was super nice and responded quickly! Space is nice and clean as well.
very cozy place and nat was very responsive the entire time with any questions we had!
Spacious.  window & a/c.  short walk to subway and Milwaukee bus

Niña has a beautiful home. Clean and clutter free in a great walkable neighborhood of Broadway close to restaurants, bars and the lake. Close to bus stop for easy access to the Loop. Everything we needed for my son’s graduation.
Excelente lugar, muy espacios y confortable
Fabulous apartment in Chicago!  We highly recommend this place.  Great space, super clean, and amazing view of Chicago skyline.  Close to train station (Western), grocery store, and restaurants.

Good value and overall a great stay , just some small inconveniences but all in all didn’t really have an affect on our vacation. Great couple very communicative and nice property other than some spots of dirt but we did check in early so that may have affected cleaning time .
We love staying at Darsh’s place!   This is our third visit and we will keep coming back.  They place is exactly as described.  Excellent location!!

The problem we experienced was that sections of the stairways lacked handrails which were needed for a member of our family. Moreover, city building codes require them. The third floor shower was ridiculously difficult to use as a shower at a non-sauna temperature. The owner provided instructions indicating it was indeed different to use and needed to be adjusted carefully but we couldn’t get it to a comfortable temperature. Despite the aesthetics, the stay was a total bust.
They were the most gracious, kind, helpful hosts!!! Such a beautiful space & we had amazing Mexican food just a short walk away. Highly recommend
Clean, everything you need was available, host was very communicative.
Excellent accommodations for our trip. We were 3 adults and had ample space to settle in and rest up after our exploration of the city each day.
We had a great time while in Chicago and thank you for the great communication. It was really appreciated!
maya was able to help me through any issues i experienced very quickly, very good host
Everything was great! The apartment was comfortable, clean, and exactly as described. It had everything we needed for a pleasant stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would happily stay again.
Great place, as advertised

Nowhere in the description say there wasn’t any a/c. Heads up to anyone interested there is absolutely no air conditioning and even with all the windows open and the fans on full blast we were sweating throughout the entire night and were subject to street traffic noises because of the open windows. Not worth it at the price he’s offering especially in the summer

La ubicación del departamento es muy buena y permite moverse fácilmente por Chicago. Sin embargo, nuestra experiencia tuvo varios puntos negativos:
El acceso al departamento es mediante escaleras bastante pronunciadas, algo que no se menciona y que puede ser un inconveniente para quienes viajan con equipaje grande o personas mayores.
Aunque el departamento se anuncia para 4 personas, no está equipado para esa cantidad; por ej había solo 2 sillas.
El principal problema fue el ruido. El departamento está literalmente al lado de las vías del tren y el paso es constante y extremadamente ruidoso. Durante la semana pasan aproximadamente cada 4 minutos, lo que hace muy difícil dormir.

First time I stayed in an AirBnB that had snacks and personal items in place.  I was grateful that there was a white noise device because I have a hard time sleeping away from home. It was easy to obtain a Lift when I needed one. Thank you Cathy!🤗
Everything was perfect! The location, accommodations and communication with Elizabeth made our stay outstanding. You can’t go wrong with this property.
Loved our stay in Chicago!
This place is in a perfect location. Walkable to great parts of town and safe. Spacious . AC works well. I will stay here once again if I needed to back.
Beautiful spot in the city within walking distance of amazing restaurants and shopping. Highly recommend this spot- the views are incredible!
Great location and views m. very clean. Would stay again.

This place was exactly like it was described. The same as the photos. Very clean and as soon as we walked it smelled nice and clean. The only downside was the parking. We had to park a little far at times due to no close by parking. Other than that we had a great stay. Also it was nicely stocked up with things we needed.

What a wonderful stay!! The location is beautiful and not too far from the highlights of the city, especially for the price! There is an Aldi right around the corner which was super convenient for eating in. The place is spacious, impeccably clean, gorgeous, and very comfortable! An absolute must stay in Chicago!
Host was great, location is nowhere near as bad as other reviews say.
top Location in a nice neighborhood.. green line is just around the corner
We enjoyed our stay here, great home!
Excellent stay, felt right at home. Perfect for graduation weekend with family. Will definitely rebook

Ayla and Steve were very hospitable host and great communicators.

We were here for our daughter’s graduation and didn’t have time to check out the area. There were many walkable restaurants and cafes we would have checked out otherwise.
Amazing stay the only gripe i have is there wasn’t a pizza cutter…
Laundry really came in clutch. Very private and convenient home and the owners were delightful. 10s across the board would boom again.
The location was great and the place was clean! Would definitely stay again.
An amazing city! My place had a great location near two major parks. The host was responsive and helpful.
This unit was really nice and modern and really had a lot of what we needed. It was a bit hard to cool down, though. A big bonus was having easy street parking, too! Beautiful unit.
It was a very beautiful place
Adam was a great host, very attentive and responsive. We loved our stay and 100% recommend it!!
AMAZING STAY!

The one standout was the excellent water pressure in the shower. Overall, the place worked for our trip, but I think the sleeping arrangements could be improved, especially for larger groups.
A very cozy, low maintenance spot that appeals primarily to short-term tenants. The location was vibrant and safe, and everything about my visit was pleasantly convenient.
Place is nice. Just what we needed and nothing more. Pretty clean. Not the cleanest place ever but it was fine for us. Worth the money.
Great host always responsive and helpful I would 10/10 recommend Ella and Peter for future stays

Loved the spot.  The four bathrooms (three with showers) was perfect for our group.  The location is fantastic for activities at DePaul and within Lincoln Park.  Host was responsive and accommodating.  We would  definitely stay here again.
Very nice stay! Walkable to trains and local restaurants. Would’ve liked more blankets though..

Thank you for hosting us! I left the key in the small box. It was a wonderful experience; the house is lovely, the area is safe and beautiful, and transportation is easily available. Thank you, and we will definitely come back again, God willing.
Amazing stay!
wonderful place in a lovely location

Le logement était conforme à l’annonce, l’arrivée autonome s’est faite facilement et la localisation est très bien : situé à 7 minutes à pied du métro pour rejoindre le centre-ville.
Les parties communes, comme la salle de bain et la cuisine, étant partagées, elles étaient parfois un peu sales. En revanche, la chambre en elle-même était bien pour y dormir : serviettes fournies et draps propres.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour. Nous n’étions dans le logement que pour la nuit, car nous étions toujours de sortie en journée.

super clean and cute! Had lots of cooking amenities and was super cozy and chill. The neighborhood was a little noisy but we stayed during a busy weekend in chicago. Super easy check in and check out instructions. Overall loved our stay and would highly recommend!

Amazing location and peaceful neighborhood at a really great price. I was worried about parking at first but it was completely fine, never an issue. Comfortable bed and great shower. Thanks again- would definitely stay again!

This was our second stay at Bryan's in Logan Square. The apartment is lovely, exceptionally clean and the shower is amazing. It is very quiet so a good nights sleep is guaranteed. Bryan provides everything and more that is needed for a comfortable stay. And he is always very responsive. The location is excellent for taking the Blue Line downtown. But don’t miss walking the area, visiting the neighborhood gems and the local farmers market. Bryan provides an excellent list of restaurants and bars.
We highly recommend.
Very nice place and a great host
Our stay was great! Our host was very nice and would respond to messages quickly. It felt like a nice homie place. Would recommend and stay again if we come back to Chicago.
Host did a great job. Good location.

Very clean and comfortable, easy to access, and Tere was very responsive!
