Very easy check in and also communicated well.
great place to stay at very clean and owner is friendly and helpful

Our whole family stayed in the 1st and 2nd floor units for my daughter’s graduation. It was the perfect home base. The neighborhood is walkable, the space is comfy and well-equipped and Christi was great to work with.

Had a great stay at Dan’s place during my time in Chicago. Check in went smoothly and Dan was available for all questions. Everything was as described and nothing out of place. Dan’s is very close to public transport, pink line, and several bus stops that make getting around easy. Would definitely recommend booking here if you are planning to stay in Chicago!
Great place to stay, amazing host always responsive and nice! Would stay again!

The AirBnB was as described. Very clean and in a very quiet neighborhood. The host was very accommodating to our early check in. He communicated very well. Will reserve again on our trip back to Chicago!

I absolutely loved the aesthetic of the place, the green with the gold makes it pop. Also the movie room is really cozy, he has some classics that you and your friends can watch. I recommend coming here forsure.
Would definitely come back

Overall a good stay. only inconceivable thing i can think of is the fridge not working with a odd smell coming from it. we brought frozen breakfast foods and pizzas that thawed as we could get no cooler due to thunderstorms. We were supplied with a mini fridge but it was too late to save the food and was too small to supply much food in. But beds tvs and overall living quality was good 7/10.

Vie is very responsive and was a wonderful host. She answered my questions and helped us when we were frantically looking for a place so that family members could stay and enjoy the family reunion weekend. This was a memorable reunion for us and our first in Chicago. Everything was great and the house was amazing. Only complaint is that the pullout freezer shelf was dirty and the handle on it was broken.
Great for Chicago events Fs

This Airbnb was located within 10 minute walk from bars from Boystown and friends who lived in the area.  The location is tucked away in a small side street that feels cozy and quiet.  I would book this place again if I were traveling solo again. Bella was responsive and flexible with check in times. Thank you!

Easy check-in and a nice, spacious place in a great location. Alma is a very responsive host, and communication throughout our stay was excellent.
One thing worth mentioning is that, as several previous reviews have noted, there is a noticeable basement odor that tends to linger. My son is particularly sensitive to dust and certain smells due to allergies, and unfortunately it affected him enough that he chose to stay elsewhere for one night.
Other than that, we had a positive experience and appreciated the convenient location and attentive hosting.
Host was very responsive and helpful. Location is perfect for the Loop and access to museums, parks, and the lake. CTA is easily accessible.

We arrived late at night after a long day of travel and were disappointed by our first impression of the apartment. Compared to the photos, it felt badly lit, worn, and not as clean or well maintained as expected.
There were visible stains on several chairs, peeling paint in the bathroom, sparse lighting, and inexpensive bed frames with thin mattresses. While the apartment is spacious and the kitchen is updated and equipped with the essentials, much of the unit feels dated and would benefit from fresh paint, better ambient lighting, and updated furnishings to justify the price.
During the day, the natural light makes the apartment feel more welcoming.
The neighborhood is convenient, with a supermarket, a good breakfast spot, public transportation, and the lake all nearby.
Overall, it may work well for a group of students or friends looking for a budget-friendly place to stay, but it did not meet our expectations based on the listing photos.

Great service and nice unit. They took care of us and made sure our stay was good for us. A good place for anyone who wants to take public transportation since it’s a 3 minute walk to the CTA. Would come back again.

Cyrus' place was the perfect place to relax after a long day in the city. The place was private and had all the amenities needed for our group. Additionally, there were board games and the like to help us keep ourselves entertained during off-time, eliminating the need to get them ourselves. Overall, I recommend staying with Cyrus for your duration in Chicago!

This was our second visit to the penthouse, and once again it was stellar. Michael is the perfect host and a new friend. The penthouse is beautifully appointed, near the water, with lots of restaurants and activities nearby. We highly recommend this place.

Great place for a group trip. The house had plenty of bedrooms, the living room was a great hangout spot, and we really appreciated the coffee station. Check-in was easy, everything was clean, and the host was responsive. We’d definitely stay here again.
Responsive host, accurately described, and conveniently located.

Fantastic property and host! If you’re looking for a place with real character, taste and huge amounts of fun in walkable distance this is perfect. Check in was easy and hosts were super responsive. I cannot say enough good things about the area. Would love to come stay again.

A few important things to know about this place: the walls are very thin (not great for light sleepers) and the house has at least 3-4 other airbnb rooms so there are other guests at almost all times. The room itself is sparse and very clean, though it was annoying the fitted sheets immediately come off the corner of the bed when you lie down.
If those things dont deter you, there is a lot that is excellent about this place. This room has a private bathroom that was conveniently across the hall. The location is EXCELLENT and felt very safe, even late at night. There is a ton of incredible Mexican food in the neighborhood so it’s lovely and very close (10 min walk) to pink line transit into Chicago. The host is also very communicative and it is super easy to access the property. Overall, I thought it was worth what I paid but there are some quirks to be aware of.
Tom is a great host and very responsive! Beautiful home and great location. Would absolutely stay there again and recommend to others.
Near train station and great space

Jake is a great host, who cares about you. We have a very comfortable stay at this unit. The check-in process is not hard but need to pay attention to it.
The unit is amazingly clean, and cozy. Bathroom is very clean with shower gel and shampoo ready. The wifi speed is decent (not the fastest but not annoyingly slow). The neighborhood is very safe within china town which has a lot of tourists. Foods are within 3-10 minutes walk as well as Red line train. If you are visiting for conference at McCormick Place, it’s 30 mins walk distance and quite safe to walk there. Otherwise Lyft or Uber are within reasonable price.
Noted : the unit is nearby the train so it might be some noises. My friends say it did not bother them much (for the double bed bedroom) in the single bedroom I could hear the train but did not feel that it’s loud.
You could also hear neighbor footsteps but not too loud during my stays. AT&T signal is low in the unit, but the unit has wifi.
I would come back.
Great place was perfect for my trip. Very clean and spacious. The host was very helpful and responsive.
Felice was a pleasure to stay with, my ony regret was that I did not stay longer.

From the moment we arrived we started getting complaints from the people below that we didn't know were there and had access to our level! People left spoiled food in fridge, freezer food said don't touch it's the owners?? The kitchen sink & bathtubs was clogged. It took them so long we tried to fix it ourselves. The handymen that came was questioning my family about the ages, questioning my daughter about who I was and my daughter asked what is the problem and he told my daughter because strippers had been there? My daughter insulted ask him do we look like strippers? What appeared to be blood stains in the bedroom facing the back with deck attached. I've never experienced anything of this nature and if I had known about the people under the stairs I would have never booked it! We don't share houses with anyone. Then to tell me I had to put out 2 people immediately!! This is 10/11pm in Chicago!! So we checked out before 10am. I was not putting my grandchildren out. OUTRAGEOUS
A very charming space in Old Town. So easy to walk to restaurants, Lincoln Park and the el.  Perfect location to stay to attend  Old Town Art Fair!
it was nice and calm

Nice job place with comfy beds. Love the neighborhood. Felt very safe.
Kitchen was nice. Good coffee shops and small grocery stores.

Host is incredibly nice and responsive, and place was as described but the Wi-Fi and cell service is very slow, the building is obviously being improved and i’m sure it will be much better in the future.
Ben's condo was perfect for a group of friends visiting Chicago for the weekend. Good location and on-site amenities. Super responsive host.

Jeff was THE most amazing host. Very friendly and helpful. Suggested a Pho place that was walkable and the food was great. Gave many other great food suggestions. I felt like I lived there lol. On the second night I came in very late and he was woke talking with the other guests. I sat down and joined the conversation very easily we all stayed up and chatted for hours, it was a very enjoyable stay. Cozy room and the temperature inside was perfect. Absolutely no complaints will definitely be staying here the next time I visit Chicago.
Beautiful place and great location! The place was nice and clean, easy access to food and shops. Would definitely stay here again!
Awesome place to stay! Right between the city and Evanston, right where we needed to be. Thanks for everything!!

We were there for my son’s graduation from Northwestern. Nancy decorated and gave a thoughtful care package that made the weekend extra special.
The location was great! About 30 min drive to the United Center and only 15 min drive to Northwestern!

Had such a great stay at this Airbnb it was very clean and beautifully furnished. I loved the shower and light in the rooms. Also very close to restaurants and shops. Great place all around I would love to come back and stay again!
Really appreciated Kate’s clear and timely communication! Place is very cute but darker (limited sunlight) than expected. Kinda wish if AC could be adjusted in the guest room

We face a massive problem when our original accommodation got cancelled due to the storms in Chicago, after searching all day we found Tiffany who allowed us to book at the absolute last minute saving our trip and allowing us to make it to our festival. The place was well set up and she always responded promptly, I cannot be thankful enough for Tiffany and “the heart of Chicago”.

We had a great time staying at Richard's place. There were 7 of us, so it was a bit tight, but exactly as described. The location was great. We could walk to the L as well as lots of restaurants and shops. We were traveling with my 5 year old, so having a field and playground so close was a great perk!

The airbnb was very nice! The location was pretty quiet and its easy to find. Peter had a bunch of goodies for all of our guests and we didn’t have any issues. It is a split house so upstairs is also an Airbnb and you might have encounters with guests staying there or hear them.

I am so glad I found Ashley’s Airbnb listing. I had been searching for hours and finally everything I was looking for was in one amazing space. Ashley’s home was actually even more lovely than the pictures. The energy of the house was very positive and uplifting. My family who usually finds something to complain about when we Airbnb had NO COMPLAINTS. It was so clean, so sunny, so open and spacious. The backyard was a lovely vibe. The laundry was a super wonderful plus! The parking was very easy. The neighborhood was homey and safe. Everyone had wonderful sleep in their respective beds. It just made my graduation weekend that much more special and easeful! Ashley and co were super responsive go each of our questions and very kind. I would definitely stay here again!
location convenient for art show. very steep stairs at entry could be challenge for some with luggage.
Convenient location to coffee shops and more...
Great place!

Leonid was an extremely helpful and responsive host. It was the perfect place to stay while attending a local music festival for a few days. The wife was also very friendly and warm. I would just advise to be aware of the area it’s in - just be smart and don’t walk around at night or look for trouble. Still, very convenient spot, very close to public transport and central enough to get to wherever you need to go. Thank you Leonid :)

Clare was Very friendly and responsive host ..

Thank you for sharing your beautiful home. We had a wonderful visit. It was our daughter’s DePaul graduation and the home was relaxing for a busy weekend.
We would love to come back soon!!
Caroline was extremely accomodating. The neighborhood wad quiet and family oriented but also conveniently located. We would definitely consider staying here again.
My group had a wonderful stay! The condo was exactly as described. It was super clean and comfortable. Thank you so much!

Our stay wasn’t perfect but the responsiveness and communication from Oriana made it just about perfect. There was a water leak from another unit and it was handled as well as it could have been. We were grateful to be able to stay in a location conducive to walking to work each day and will rent from them again.
Place was great, plus the lovely cat. There are plenty of restaurants near the area and the busses are just short minute walk away.
Had a great stay in Edgewater. The apartment was clean, easy to navigate and close to everything. It was a very relaxing and bright space. Very much enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend!

The location of this apartment can’t be beat. Roscoe Village has a small town atmosphere with little to no crime. There are phenomenal restaurants right out the front door. Perfect location. Perfect price.
Very clean and as described.

Kristina's place was good. They are not exaggerating about the ceilings, they are low. I'm 5'6 so did okay except for a spot in the kitchen where the ceiling dips even lower so beware of that. The place was a short walk to hop on the blue line and take you all over the city which was a major plus. The bed we slept on was very comfortable. The place was pretty clean and cozy.
If you're a makeup person, I'd pack your own light as the lighting is dim in most places (enough to see comfortablely just tough for makeup application). The one con was that the place was kind of warm. We were there on some very humid/ hot days so that could have been part of the problem, but the ac fought to keep up and barley went under 73. So if you run warm, I'd keep that in mind. 2 box fans were in the unit, but one barely worked.
Overall a decent stay!
It was absolutely beautiful and clean. I love our stay. It was just as the pictures showed. The gist was amazing, friendly and helpful. I will most definitely book again

Great location and beautiful place for a getaway at Old Town.  We were there for the Art Fair and loved it.  Could not have been a better location.  Parking is the only draw back.  They provide a space "First Come" but never saw an open spot.  Plan on paying for parking if you are there during a busy time.
Great location

Went with a group of 6 and it was the perfect amount of space! Everything was very clean and had plenty of extra stuff to last us the 2 nights we stayed. We had to cars which was convenient with the street and private parking that is provided. I would definitely book again and highly recommend.

The property and Coty was both amazing. My favorite part was the entrance way of the unit, the lights and little table made it great to just sit outside and hangout. The beds were extremely comfortable and the fireplace is a great addition.
Great spot, Nikkole was a very responsive host!
Great location! It’s not a 5 star hotel but it’s in an amazing location and gets the job done.

What a spacious place to stay and it was so close to so many things we were in Chicago to do. Appreciated the small details to help make our stay enjoyable. The description of the house is spot on and if you have a large group of people there is plenty of room to enjoy hanging out. We did not have any small children but there are even items to provide for some of their needs too. Kelsey and Sean were super responsive and very friendly. Our family enjoyed our stay!
Parking was expensive. It should be included with your stay.
Nice clean basement, located in Pilsen. Great food options around. Just a bit darker than the photos
Good location accessible to major sites in downtown Chicago. Helpful staff.
Perfect spot for a weekend trip to Chicago. Location is very walk able or right next to the metro.
My family had a great time while visiting Chicago and loved the place and the location!

Great spot in a great location
Only complaint is that the hallway smells terrible but that’s not her fault
Peter and Lin were friendly and the space was comfortable and well situated near the Blue Line and O’Hare. Recommended!

I do not have enough words to describe how perfect my stay was at Abe's house! As a host, Abe was top tier - he was communicative, responsive, INCREDIBLY helpful, kind, knowledgeable. Again - I cant say enough. I had planned to have my very chill, low key bachelorette party at his gorgeous home (complete with hot tub and fire pit.. AND movie theater!!) and we only left the house once the entire weekend for dinner Saturday and I could have stayed another week! I wish I could do it all again - and I'd stay at Abe's!!!

I booked this place for my family while they were visiting for my doctoral graduation, and they had a fantastic stay. There were 5 adults, 2 children, and 1 infant in the group. There was plenty of space for them to spread out and be comfortable.
The parking permits that were provided were especially appreciated since street parking requires them. They had no issues finding parking at any point during the stay.
The location was excellent—close to the Blue Line and surrounded by great restaurants and things to do in the Bucktown/Wicker Park area.
Jen was a wonderful host and was attentive and responsive to any questions we had throughout the stay. My family would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it.

Let’s start with the space it has the amount of beds and rooms which was great but there were hair and crumbs all over things needed to be vacuumed or at least have a vacuum so we could do it ourselves then the amenities weren’t working correctly. We weren’t told about the shower water not working correctly either had to take cold showers until we found out hot means cold and cold means hot and in the bathroom we had centipedes falling from the ceiling which was disgusting and this was not a one time thing i have pictures and let’s not even talk about all the ants crawling on the counter. Our first day we arrived we weren’t able to get in because the lock code they gave us didn’t work we had to find other ways in and their response is time was really bad having to spam call them and still not get a answer. Just to add onto our experience we came back home to a power outage that didn’t get resolved until we literally took the first step out the door to check out.
Great location. Close to everything. Communication was great and host was very accommodating. Highly recommend.

I absolutely loved this place! It was really cute, clean & comfortable.  Definitely felt like home! The neighborhood was really cute & the neighbors were nice and warm. If you’re going to Chicago anytime soon.. book with Marc! You won’t be disappointed.
beautiful

This Air Bnb is a hit. It was close to all of our fun for the weekend, the property was clean and we felt really safe. There was enough room for everyone and really nice. And let me tell you the grocery store across the street was amazing. My friends and I enjoyed the stay.
Great location and friendly host that responds quickly to every request.

Great stay! The home was very clean, the host communicated wonderfully, and the location was perfect—just minutes from downtown. Everything was easy and comfortable from check-in to check-out. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Joshua was a great host. Super responsive. Rental was super nice inside and fully stocked with all you can need. Location was great to walk everywhere and despite being on a lively street in Chicago you couldn’t hear any noise inside. We loved our stay and appreciated how responsive Joshua was if we had any questions.
space was easy to get in to and everything was as advertised. Host was responsive and on top of communication.
Such a genuinely lovely home in a great walkable location! Would definitely stay here again.

"I had a great stay here in Chicago. The host was very clear and responsive with communication throughout the entire process, making check-in and the stay smooth and stress-free. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was a great place to stay, and I would happily recommend it to others visiting Chicago."

We had a wonderful stay! We needed to stay there for 6 weeks while our house was being worked on and it was a great home away from home. We were there with our 5 year old and the space worked nicely. The bedrooms were very comfortable. We walked over to Smith Park every night. Street parking was always easy. The kitchen has updated appliances and allowed for easy cooking. Overall a great place for a ln extended or short stay! it felt very cozy and warm with furniture and extra touches.
Very nice place, check in was easy, host responsive, and check out was very simple.
Had a great time!
Andrew and Lauren were great hosts! They gave clear instructions, were proactive in communication, and have a great spot. We loved our stay.
Clean place and quiet  with shared bathroom and kitchen.
Nice apartment to stay a little outside of the city. Master bedroom had a great sized king bed. Kim was very responsive
Great space! Exactly what we needed and so fun addition with the ping pong! Gorgeous bathrooms and kitchen. Wonderful overall!
Very nice. Very spacious. Way more spacious than I thought. Very private. Host was very reachable. Only complaint is the low water pressure of the shower.
This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I've had. Russell was so responsive and made sure we had the best time with recommendations for food/things to do.
Loved it very nice and clean

Amy is a perfect host.I felt right at home and had everything I needed.
Amy even took the time to make coffee in the morning.
I would absolutely stay again.
Thanks for having me as a guest!
Jon

Host is very responsive, place was clean and had the amenities listed,  parking was found within a block at all times, restaurants and stores were in walking distance  and the building was quiet.  We would stay here again.

The Rodriguez Home was absolutely beautiful.  The location was top-notch, especially if you use the public transport in Chicago.  David was an amazing host and provided me with parking passes to park on the street (which took a great bit of anxiety off me).  His space was clean and cozy and the neighborhood felt very safe but lively.  I would highly recommend staying at the Rodriguez Home if you're planning on staying in downtown Chicago.
Jeanette was a great host and her place was fantastic!

We really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely stay again. Perfect for a couple. It was a beautiful space in a beautiful neighborhood and allowed us to walk to multiple of the activities/places we were there to go (Empty Bottle, Salt Shed). We really liked being so close to grocery stores, restaurants, and shops. There definitely can be some sound coming through from the upstairs unit to the below unit when people are moving around upstairs. It ultimately didn't detract from our stay but is helpful to know in case it might impact yours.

We really enjoyed staying at Terry's place. It is beautifully decorated, well-located, and comfortable. The cute neighborhood and tree-lined street were a big plus. We especially enjoyed the local tea shop and the independent bookstore that are just down the street.

My family and I really enjoyed staying at Aaron’s place!  It was a nice size and comfortable,  perfect for how many people we were traveling with for our trip. It was easy to find and get inside. Street parking was not an issue, we were always able to find a spot. Aaron is very responsive to any need that you may have during your stay. Great host! We would stay again!
Nice place, easy host, clean, thank you

Great host! Communication was excellent throughout the stay, and all information provided was accurate. They were responsive, attentive, and made the entire process smooth and easy. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend them to others.
Excellent place
GREAT LOCATION!!! We had a blast staying here for my bachelorette party! The space was so nice and big, perfect for a girls weekend in Chicago!

René was a fantastic host! He was incredibly attentive, hospitable, and had great communication from start to finish.
The home was very clean, nicely organized, and updated. We appreciated the complimentary sodas and the refrigerator with a working ice maker, which is a big plus for us Southerners! René even went out of his way to bring us extra trash bags, an iron, and an ironing board, which we were so thankful for since we were in town for a special event and needed to re-press our clothes.
The shower water pressure and hot water were excellent, the A/C worked great, and street parking was never an issue. We always found a spot right outside the house, even arriving after midnight. We felt safe throughout our stay and would definitely book with René again on our next trip to Chicago!
We had a great stay at Joanna's! The space was nice and super close to the city. Joanna was very responsive and made the check in/out process easy. Would definitely stay again!

It was a great place to rest between wedding activities. Even though we had major Thunderstorms, we were comfortable. The garage made the difference in the rain. While the ELL was nearby it was not loud enough to disturb our sleep. We also appreciate it the ease of check-in and check out.

Thanks David for hosting us! The place was clean and David was reachable all the time. We had a small request to which David attended at earliest convenience and has been checking with us over entire duration of our stay. We will definitely stay here when we visit Chicago again!
Nice place in a safe area with plenty of restaurants and good parking. Place was as presented. Good communication!
So peaceful and comfortable

We had an amazing stay. The location was convenient, especially since it was right off a bus stop. Having that at our front door was a life saver for tourist days in Chicago. It was a wonderful stay - highly recommend!
Great Gold Coast location. Easy to walk everywhere!

The walkable location was fantastic for a Wrigley Field concert, which saved on the hassle of parking.   Well-appointed with all the amenities you need and a very spacious layout for a larger group.  We enjoyed our stay very much.

We loved our stay! Great apartment with a cute aesthetic. I wish that parking instructions would have been communicated clearer. It was not brought to our attention that we needed to get keycards from the front desk before getting into the parking garage. I would contact the host prior to arrival if you are wanting to park as soon as you get there!
We enjoyed our stay and the hosts were very helpful!

We had a great stay! They were great hosts, and their place was just as it was described! We loved the location, walked to different coffee, shops each morning, and had a couple of nice walks to Michigan Avenue. The Irish Nobleman on the corner was great for World Cup and dinner. We would absolutely stay there again when we’re back in town.
Booked this location for a group of 10, there was plenty of room and seating for us. Two kitchen areas and bathrooms! The balcony really put it over the top for us!
Great place to stay! It is above the train so you can hear that, still slept great.  Sound machines provided by host.

If you're looking for a place to house lots of people within a reasonable distance from Chicago city center, or Northwestern, this will do just fine. Each bedroom is nicely furnished. AC is blasting in the summer, with personal heaters if you get cold. There's a personal parking spot, which is very tight, but still nice for the certainty. Here are some cons: the neighborhood is a little rough (great food though. Middle Eastern and Korean). The dining room chairs and couches had stains on them, which didn't make me feel great about sitting on them w/ pyjamas. Bathroom is a little small, and there's only 1 for the 3 bedrooms. The closest bedroom to the entrance seems to be below other people, and it's very easy to hear what's going on above. Thankfully they quieted down at a reasonable time, around 10:30pm.
Despite these issues, I'm still giving it 5 stars for value. It's very hard to find such a big space nearby. Go for it, just keep expectations real.

I really appreciated Victor's super clear instructions and guidance, including photos for everything, quick responses for all questions, and practical advice about transit. My flight was delayed coming in, but even late at night and exhausted I was able to easily figure everything out, find parking exactly where I'd been told, etc. Good affordable, no-nonsense place to stay for a busy traveller. :)
Great place to stay! Went to the sauna and really enjoyed the amenities. Stephanie was a responsive host.

Nice apartment with nice views, rooftop was awesome, great location.
Things to watch out: Unstable wifi and number of fobs if you need more than one (fob problem was resolved during our stay).
We liked the apartment which is conveniently furnished and with everything you need.
Will definitely be visiting again.

Overall, this was an okay place. I was looking for a last-minute location to celebrate my mom’s birthday after our original Airbnb reservation was canceled due to storms that caused a power outage. The host, Tracee, was friendly, responsive, and understanding of our situation. Based on our conversations, I was under the impression that our plans would be acceptable; however, during our stay, it became apparent that the property was not well suited for the type of celebration we had discussed.
The host advised that quiet hours began at 10:00 PM; however, we received two noise complaints before 7:45 PM, which was confusing. There were also a few issues during our stay. The master bathroom sink was clogged, the refrigerator’s ice maker and water dispenser were not working, and there were not enough basic supplies provided, including towels, toilet paper, and garbage bags.
Overall, for the price I say No it’s a good option for travelers seeking a quiet place to relax to avoid hotels.

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful two-bedroom Airbnb in Chicago. The apartment was spotless, spacious, and exactly as described. The location was perfect for exploring the city, with easy access to restaurants, attractions, and public transportation. The beds were comfortable, the amenities were excellent, and the host was responsive and welcoming throughout our stay. Everything was well organized, making our trip stress-free and enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Responsive and communicative, both hannah and Mark had an awesome place and personality! Especially like the mattresses and towels -they were very comfortable like In a nice hotel. We will be back.

The place was as described and the host is very responsive. We had a good stay overall, but our AC unit was leaking for almost the first 24 hours of our stay. It took awhile for maintenance to come out to fix the issue.

When we checked in, someone else was in the Airbnb.  The host took three hours to respond to us and was still confused thereafter. Host tried to blame it on us saying that she thought we were leaving early, when we had not even checked in yet.
This place was great we felt at home it’s in a good location I would stay again!
Great spot to stay in Chicago with helpful and friendly host! William was accommodating and the home was very comfortable.
Very nice! Very clean place would recommend 10/10!
Great stay

Nice, eclectic little space in a cool neighborhood. Daniel was really responsive when we messaged him with questions. Check in was easy and he provided some good recommendations for the area. There was a good bit of noise from the occupants upstairs, but nothing too crazy or unbearable. The space was clean and perfect for our quick weekend in the city.

Reggie was an excellent host, he’s extremely responsive and takes great care of his guests. His place has a beautiful rooftop with so many walkable restaurants nearby. This was one of my best experiences with an Airbnb. I would 100% recommend booking this place.
We had a nice few day stay - super convenient location and comfortable for three adults.

The hosts were very friendly and responsive about my stay & everything looks just like the pictures/descriptions! There is a dryer though, not sure why the listing says it’s not included. Other than that, they included all the amenities mentioned. We also didn’t have any issues finding street parking throughout the day!
With that said, there were some cleanliness issues we ran into like dirty stains in the cabinets and dirty/dusty floors. The dish soap provided was mostly water with very little soap left. I will also note that the pull-out bed rumbles and shakes whenever the train passes by (it’s right behind the house). They do provide earplugs if the noise bothers you throughout the night though.
Overall, I still had a comfortable stay and was able to work around most of these issues! But I hope the cleanliness can be improved or maybe I came at a bad day.
We had a great experience and the neighborhood was really lovely.

Great location and amenities. It's rare to find an apartment in Chicago with 2 bathrooms, an elevator and a dedicated parking space -- so that was GREAT! Also, very conveniently located next to Whole Foods, so it was easy to grab groceries.
I was disappointed by the bedding. Both beds had thin microfiber sheets that didn't breathe well, and the pillows were kind of lumpy. There were also very limited shelves and drawers to store things in the bedrooms and bathrooms (including decorative pillows and extra towels that were on the beds), and limited air flow in the apartment (it felt stuffy when the AC wasn't running). This apartment would be much more comfortable and worth the price if these aspects could be improved.
Perfect place for our stay! Extremely convenient with a Jewels nearby for any necessary supplies/groceries. Highly recommend

We couldn’t have asked for a better spot in Chicago for our college reunion trip. Great bars and restaurants nearby, close to the water for our boat trip, and the space was very easy to get into and had plenty of space for what we needed. The covered back patio was also a huge plus during a big downpour one night.
Leonard’s place was cozy and matched pictures. He was great in reaching out to us prior to our trip and during.
The location was very convenient for us and Jennifer was very friendly and communicative.   The room was quite comfortable and nicely appointed.  The bathroom was clean.  We did not use the kitchen.
Thanks, Kyle, great place.  We'd love to come again...
We had a great stay! Super clean and comfy space. Great area and amazing host!
Highly recommended. Great neighborhood, lovely spot. Would stay again.

My family and I had an incredible stay! We LOVED the location and the place was so spacious. The lake was so close by so I loved being able to do my morning runs along the lake trail. The hosts were responsive and provided plenty of information. Definitely recommend and would stay here again.
Good place to stay, had everything I needed for my trip. Ended up leaving a device there and sent it back to me. Thanks, Carl
This was a great place for our weekend stay ☺️
Location of Andrew’s place was great and the place matched our expectations. Andrew was also a great at communicating and made our stay very enjoyable. We would stay here again.
Great location! We really enjoyed Natasha’s place. Very walkable to the main downtown attractions.

We were so happy to find this wonderful place. Peaceful and spacious in a leafy neighborhood with everything you could want in walking distance (Dark Matter around the corner!). Saturday night neighbors were lively in the earlier part of the night but all was quiet by 10. Can’t thank Justin enough for being so accommodating with our circumstances. Really outstanding host.

Looking at the pictures doesn’t do it justice! This place is so cute and so clean! Jason sent us a video with parking instructions which was super easy to navigate with the video. The little diner across the way was delicious! Definitely worth it!

Such a lovely and charming spot! Super cozy, and the location is perfect - steps from all of the shops, restaurants, and bars along Clark Street in Andersonville. Will definitely look to book this spot again the next time friends come into town!
We loved our stay at the Moffat House! It was comfortable, clean, and exactly what we needed for our weekend! I have already recommended this home to others for their stay!
Hit all of what we needed

The place is spacious for a one bedroom and has a lot more character than many of the corporate owned Airbnb‘s in Chicago. The neighborhood is nice and felt safe. But not super close to restaurants, shopping or the subway.

Description accurate, clean, cozy spot with comfy bed. Small space, conveniently located near the event I was in town for. However not close to the city and difficult to get uber/lyft back to this location. However, If you have a car you should be okay. The only small concern was the shower water temperature. While the kitchen and bathroom sink faucets got hot, the shower remained tepid at best. Overall, a pleasant stay for the occasion.
The pictures don’t do it justice, such a great place to stay!
Definitely would recommend! I live in Naperville but my family came from out of state.

Cute, comfortable, clean apartment outfitted with everything we needed for a nice long weekend. Great location that was both quiet and close to fantastic bakeries, bars, restaurants, and public transportation.
We enjoyed our stay, great location to our family members. Lots of shopping and eateries nearby.

Easy check in, terrific location, spacious, easy walk to brown line or just stay in the neighborhood with lots of coffee/cocktail/food options. 2nd floor walk up, narrow and steep, typical of the city- don’t expect brand new everything. This is not a new build, but clean and has everything you need. Did not cook meals, but used plates and glasses and utensils- all fine. This is very fairly priced given the great location- we will come back!
Very clean and nice place. Owner was great at communicating and answering questions very quickly.
I stayed there 3 days and it was great.

Had an excellent stay at Janet’s.  The space was clean, modern and spacious.  This was on a very nice residential street where parking was plentiful and free.  Janet was available as needed.  Highly recommended!

The Bronzeville Oasis was cute and nicely decorated apartment for my 3-day stay with family.  I was coming to Chicago for funeral and upon arrival in Chicago city limits,  i saw the damage that hit the area  - downed trees, no electricity flood roads.  Since i had  arrived earlier than anticipated, I contacted Adriane to request to check in early and she responded within 30 mins.  We were able to take a shower and leave for the funeral.  Adriane was very accommodating during my stay and the kitchen & bathroom had everything you would use if you were home.  Once my grandson found the remote control and popcorn, he was good.  I will definitely book here again when i come back to Chicago.

This is a fabulous location if you want to be close to all the action and beautiful architecture Chicago has to offer. It’s a very chic space, with super large and luxurious bathrooms/showers, and a nice shared common area on the floor if someone wakes up early and doesn’t want to interrupt other guests. We had 2 couples and it was a perfect size for our short weekend stay. We were able to walk to all the sites on our must do list but they also offer free valet parking at the site so we didn’t need to worry about what to do with the car.  Anthony was responsive to all my last minute questions about the check-in process which is a little more high tech and fully app-enabled than I was used to. Would definitely recommend.
Quiet, elegant block of refurbished homes. Updated bathroom. Apartment backed of to a private garden. Lively!
Clean, large space. Quiet neighborhood
Great place in a great location

This was a great stay for me and my friends. The property was clean, bedrooms were spacious and everything at the property was well maintained. Would definitely recommend this location to others. Was conveniently  located about 10min from the city of Chicago, area that it was in was not great, not a whole lot to do in the area but the apartment itself was phenomenal and was a great time would recommend.
helpful host, good communication, cool space in a great walkable spot.  parking was easy.  would stay again
Came here for a festival weekend and this was the perfect place to stay! Tucked away and a comfy living space. Very clean as well!

We had an awesome stay at this apartment! The apartment and amenities were spacious and well-maintained. The building staff were helpful and friendly. The location was perfect for all the things we wanted to do.(Architectural tours, riverwalk, great restaurants, Art Institute) It was an easy walk from the CTA station which we took to/from the airport. No need for a car! The train noise at night took a little getting used to, but they supplied earplugs for that. We felt very safe in the neighborhood. Would 100% stay here when we come back to Chicago.

Wicker Park is a beautiful area and our host was very kind. We had an issue with the air-conditioning the first night but she was quick to come fix it so the next two nights were much better. We were celebrating my daughter‘s 16th birthday and she even left her chocolates and a little balloon to wish her happy birthday. It was a wonderful stay!

We had a wonderful stay and couldn't have asked for better accommodations. The home was beautiful, well-appointed, and clearly maintained with great care.
Communication with Miriam was extraordinary from start to finish. She was responsive, helpful, and made the entire experience seamless and stress-free.
The home is upgraded, with quality finishes and amenities that exceeded our expectations. We would gladly stay here again and highly recommend this property to anyone looking for a comfortable and welcoming place to stay.
We realty enjoyed our stay - quite beautiful place- super clean and very nice! Thank you For always answering my questions and being kind!
The house was wonderful! Fabulous for the group of people we had. Beautiful neighborhood with easy access to public transit. I hope to stay again in the future!
Clean, spacious and great location
adorable neighborhood, easy building access and nice kitchen in the condo.
This place was amazing! We didn’t have any issues with our stay.

this place was honestly very disgusting.
the pros: decent location, comfortable bed, gas station next door, friendly and communicative host, decent price
cons: when we arrived, i checked the bedding and found that there were stains and/or small hairs on every piece of bedding. the worst part were the pillows. the pillow protectors had red/brown stains all over them (the same staining was also on the comforter). we let iris know, and she sent someone to change the bedding. although this issue was resolved, the fact that it was an issue in the first place is ridiculous. in addition to this, the cleaner did not have pillow protectors, so we had to go without. additionally, the soap in the bathroom was watered down, it was loud at night, and there were brown/red stains on the walls, bathroom floor, and lamps. these are things that a guest should never have to reach out to a host about!
this place isn’t clean, and i’m honestly just thankful i didn’t leave with bedbugs. NOT WORTH IT!!

We had a very nice stay. The only difficulty was parking. This would be an ideal place for someone without a car as very close to public transportation.
Very beautifully decorated and very comfortable.
amazing place and perfect location! walkable to nice restaurants and bars

Thank you for a comfy, well-equipped, welcoming and reasonably-priced place to stay. We enjoyed it.
Home was very comfortable and matched the descriptions, good location for a mix of the city and smaller neighborhood vibes
Great location!  Comfortable room!

Bob greeted us and gave us a tour. Very well maintained property, easy access in and out and private. Entering to the apartment beyond the gate door feels like a court yard. Small garden well cared for. The apartment is comfortable,  clean,  and what you need in the kitchen is there. The king size bed is a plus and comfortable. The place is quiet for a restful sleep. Nice touch with fresh flowers giving you a feeling of home. Plenty of restaurants that are in walking distance, Whole Foods as well and on the corner of the street is a Walgreens if essentials is needed quickly. Host, Bob saved a spot for us to park on the street which was an unexpected nice kind gesture. Very much appreciated. It is off street parking and our guest who stayed with us did not have a problem finding a spot to park down the same street. We were there from June 11th thru the 14th and at that time there was a neighborhood festival going a few blocks away. A place for us to come back to & I would recommend it.

The host was really responsive and made the check in process simple. The apartment is as advertised and comfortable for our group of 4. The neighborhood (Ukranian village) is beautiful and safe. Would stay here again!

This was my first time coming 9 hours to Chicago and I was a bit nervous but I’m happy I got such a great place to stay! Tuan’s place was very clean and comfortable. He gave very clear directions on how to find it and get in, and I felt right at home staying here.

Great location. Very nicely appointed apartment. Comfortable and very clean.
We will be back for sure.

This place is in PRIME location. Right by the Damen CTA stop and 6 corners which has so many restaurants, bars, and shops.
The place is very private and quiet. You can’t even hear the train from the unit.
The rooms were very spacious with en suite bathrooms, comfortable beds, and large closets to allow you to settle in.
It was the perfect place for our visit! Would definitely return.
Fantastic location and space, could not ask for more. If you are looking to utilize the subway this is a perfect spot.
A great place to stay that’s close to the red line for quick access to the Loop and other parts of Chicago!
Good place to stay and visit Chicago! Close to a bunch of stuff and the train to get around

Martha's place is a hidden gem...a cozy space you want to tell everyone about. Her place is roomie, thoughtful to the needs of travelers, quiet

My family and I came to Chicago for my granddaughter’s graduation. We felt very comfortable with the unit and with the beautiful neighborhood. Kyriako was responsive and very kind. Highly recommend!

Parking vouchers provided by our host made it convenient to park nearby, and there were plenty of terrific restaurants within walking distance. The condo was clean, comfortable, and surprisingly spacious. We were traveling with another couple, and having the bedrooms and bathrooms on separate floors provided plenty of privacy for everyone. I especially appreciated the wall-mounted magnifying mirror in the main bathroom.
The rooftop space was spectacular, with beautiful city views and plenty of comfortable seating. We weren’t there long enough to cook in the kitchen or enjoy the huge tv or 3 separate balconies, but we really enjoyed the time we did spend in the condo.
We looked into getting a hotel but Nicole and Matt’s was more value than two hotel rooms. Very easy to get to everything we wanted to do.
Great location. Clean.

Dawn has a lovely place in Wicker Park! We stayed here with a young child, and it was just perfect. Great location with lots of vintage shops and restaurants close by. Would stay here again!
Great location, Great room & Great host

Great stay!! A little bit challenging to figure out the garage and how to get in from the back (included parking was a huge perk! ); however, the place was well maintained, very clean and surprisingly quiet! Convenient location between the airport and downtown Chicago.
Susan was a great host. Very helpful and responsive. The neighborhood is very nice, quiet and walkable to shops, restaurants and the train stop. Would definitely stay there again.

The place was a lot smaller than expected, if you are wanting to cook don’t even think about it. Horrible Wifi connection, the bed is harder than a rock, plan to pack lots of blankets for cushion, kinda hard to locate

The Garden Apt. Is perfectly perfect! Host is amazing and the amenities are spot on. Jay makes sure you have everything you need. I am already looking for more dates to stay in the future.

Maximillian was a great host, super flexible and proactive. My friends and I had a great time at the Airbnb, it was super spacious and everyone felt very comfortable. I definitely recommend checking out this listing if you’ve got a big group and want to spread out.

Amazing place for the value! Yes it’s a “private room” which makes most people second guess booking it, but their place felt like a little home of our own right outside of the big city! I highly recommend you book this adorable little abode. Thank you guys so much! I will definitely book again. <3

Martha was a great host, very responsive, thoughtful and flexible. Proximity of her place right across from the Logan Square blue line stop was excellent and super convenient if you’re flying in or out of O’Hare. Area was not too loud, the space itself was clean and as seen in photos.

Very clean and a super short walk to the grocery store with food options nearby. My only negative is the beds were very uncomfortable. The mattresses are about 4 inches thick and you feel every bar under them. Would also have been nice to have extra blankets available.

Great location. The hallway was dirty. The bathroom was filthy.  Baseboards dirty. The floor was dirty.  The towels a 1 washcloth were old.

We stayed here for my daughter’s graduation. The apartment looks like the photos, but the building is very old and the entrance feels more like a storage area. There are steep stairs and no elevator. The AC works well in the common areas, but the bedrooms were much warmer at night. Some lights didn’t work, and the kitchen was minimally stocked. For four adults, we initially had only four towels, though the host brought washcloths the next morning. Seating was inconvenient — only two bar stools and no dining table, even though there’s space for an exercise bike and a desk. The location is close to downtown but right next to the train line, and trains are loud and frequent. Nights were noisy, though police presence made it feel safe. For the price we paid, ai expected better comfort and upkeep especially for my guests.
Nice area, close to some parks.
Nice place. Accurate description, quiet neighborhood, 10 minutes from Downtown. We enjoyed it.
Great location with coffee & restaurants nearby, in a cute & quiet neighborhood. Parking on site a huge bonus. Great spot for the price

Convenient  location with easy walking distance to U Chicago, to nearby Hyde Park Restaurants, and public transportation;  No problems finding street parking; apartment super clean and comfy. Highly recommended

Perfect location and perfect for my sister’s bachelorette weekend! We had a great time, and the apartment was very clean. So cute and fun!
nice and comfortable room!
very nice interior with a great patio

Great place to stay in Chicago.  Parking was very easy on the street right in front of the unit with the including parking tags. Great place to stay with a very responsive host.  Highly recommended!

We loved staying at John’s place! It fit 4 adults comfortably and it didn’t feel like we were all on top of each other, plenty of room! Awesome place. Highly recommended!

This place was amazing and in an incredible location. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!

-The apt was as described in the photos, spacious, and conveniently located near bus/subway lines, making it easy to get around.
-Unfortunately, our stay was impacted by several maintenance issues. We had to contact the host/management company daily. During a storm on our first day, the windows and ceiling leaked, and the issue was never resolved. We also experienced problems with the toilet, lighting, a slow-draining sink, & a washer/dryer that did not work, leaving us with wet clothes before departure.
-The apartment lacked basic guest info we typically expect from an Airbnb. There was no welcome guide, instructions for appliances/TVs, or information about building amenities. Only 2 TV remotes were provided for 4 TVs, & the beds had fitted sheets and comforters but no top sheets.
-While responses were generally prompt, communication felt more like dealing with a management company than a host. Overall, the apartment had potential, but the unresolved issues made the stay disappointing
Friendly and helpful staff. Room is incredibly loud at night and this location is much smaller than you would expect
Leo and Alex were great communicators throughout the booking, stay, and check-out process. The space was clean, inviting, comfortable, and a great place to stay for a weekend. Highly recommend!

The location for this space is great but for the price it was very disappointing. They didn’t even have basic coffee or a basic coffee maker (nor did they have a Kuerig).  It has a Nespresso machine with a couple weird flavors but that didn’t work.  The place easily sleeps 10 (or 12) but there is only seating for 4 in the living room. There are no windows in the living room (not a big deal except the space with windows has no seating). There were some big windows on the street side but zero seating in that area.  Everything else was fine it was just extremely overpriced for what was included.
Top tier spot and they nail the details. Glad we picked it

Mary was great! She was super communicative and made check-in and check-out super easy. She was in a great location, about a 2 minute walk to the orange line in one direction and another two minute walk to a park in the other, which was perfect for our dog.

The place was exactly like the photos. It was very walkable to all the things, walked to Lake Michigan, Navy Pier, Millennium Park, and many other places! The locals were all friendly, would book again!
Amazing location, steps away from major attractions and public transportation. The apartment is very comfortable, clean and stylish. We loved our stay here and would come back!

We enjoyed our stay and had plenty of space for our family. Mera was easy to work with and communication was always efficient, and friendly. Noise from the surrounding units (particularly the folks upstairs, stomping at ALL hours of the day) was annoying but a sound machine helped with that.

Sara's place was as advertised. Great location, easy to find and get into, felt very secure. Everything was clean and comfy. The art inside the spot made it feel really special. Have nothing but great things to say about this place.

Joseph was super accommodating for our check in. Place was lovely for 4 people to hang out. Plenty of space and every amenity was well stocked. Easy walk to White Sox games. Absolutely would book again if I’m in the area again.

The unit had some positives, including a good in-unit washer and dryer and a nice breakfast spot nearby. However, there were several issues that impacted our stay.
Getting into the property was challenging, as the access instructions were provided outside of the Airbnb app and were not very intuitive. The surrounding area did not feel particularly safe, especially at night. The cleanliness also fell short of expectations, with dust throughout the unit, a kitchen table that was not clean upon arrival, mold around the shower, and very dirty windows.
Layout may not work well for guests seeking privacy, as the open ceiling design allows sound to travel easily between the bedrooms, kitchen, and living areas. In addition, the air conditioning units were quite loud and struggled to keep the space cool, which made it difficult to stay comfortable.
Overall, the property has potential, but it would benefit from improved cleanliness, clearer check-in instructions, and attention to maintenance.

Great spot for four adults and two dogs for an excellent long weekend visit to Chicago. Easy to find street parking, walkable to nightlife and groceries. Nice little backyard for dogs, shared with upstairs neighbors who were kind when our dogs (briefly) barked at them. Clean, air conditioned, nice little home base in between excursions.

The place was clean and free of clutter. The neighborhood was quiet. I did not receive check-in instructions until 4:03 and was not able to check in until 4:30 when check in time was 4 because the owner was concerned about me being from Chicago. The floors were extremely loud, and even when walking on tippy toes, caused noise. The air conditioning unit was also very loud and was disorienting at times. The floors above my bed kept me up until 3am one night and I couldn't even be upset at the tenants because I knew it was the floors and not them being excessively loud. The apartment is also 1.5 baths while being advertised as 2 full baths. That is important to note with 3 teenage boys. It was what we needed for an emergency need due to our home being without power for several days, but I do think it is important to notes the issues we had. It was an okay stay, but the owner definitely did not make us feel welcome in the beginning and the home had too many issues to overcome that.
Bob was a wonderful host! He gave us many recommendations around town and was very accommodating. The place is beautifully decorated and in a great location.
Great place, in a great city!!

No big deal, I figured it was needed to cool off the common areas of the home since it was a shared air bnb but I definitely noticed someone was in the room while I was away. I was able to leave my bags which I greatly appreciated as well as Margaret’s timely response to messages. The cons are that I didn’t find the bed comfortable and the sheets smelled slightly of bleach so I didn’t sleep well but that could just be me. Overall the place is a solid choice and a good price if you need two bedrooms!
Perfect place for large groups. The complementary snacks and drinks were very appreciated. Host was super helpful and even let us check in early.

We loved staying here and Jeff was a great host! When we drove into Chicago, we were met with a massive thunderstorm that knocked the power out in the neighborhood. Jeff came down in the rain and brought us battery lights so we could get unpacked. We really appreciated that!
(The power came back on in the night. Jeff said that power outages there are rare. This storm knocked down trees all over the city).
The location was great, in a beautiful walkable neighborhood. Felt safe. Convenient access to Wicker Park and buses into the city.
The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Jeff also provided passes for street parking. Great stay!
Good location

Our weekend stay in this Chicago Airbnb was comfortable and clean. It was in the right neighborhood for us and we enjoyed being able to walk to more local spots in town. The place itself was quite simple and uncomplicated.

The apartment was clean, spacious, and in an excellent location within walking distance of Millennium Park and the lakefront. We also enjoyed the rooftop deck and game room, which provided additional space to relax and spend time together.
Unfortunately, our stay was overshadowed by a very concerning interaction with a security guard. One evening, he blocked access to the elevator for my 16-year-old daughter and her friends and told them they should go to local clubs to get "white girl wasted." Later, when I confronted him about his behavior, he asked whether I liked to drink and suggested taking shots with him in his van. These interactions were completely inappropriate and made our family feel unsafe for the remainder of our stay.
To the management company's credit, they responded promptly to my complaint, apologized, and indicated that corrective action would be taken. I appreciate their response, but prospective guests should be aware of our experience.
Great space and location! Plenty of room for 6 girls.
This was a great place to stay in Logan Square. Either if you want something outside of the city or some really good local food and coffee. This would be a place to stay again.

We loved our stay in Cheryl's place. Short walk to two major bus routes or a little longer walk to the blue line. It was easy to get around and we had just the space we needed. Bedrooms are both smaller, but Cheryl had a play pin that we were able to use in the bigger bedroom for our toddler.
The home was nice and clean. The host responded very quickly and was very pleasant. It has everything you need in a place to stay. My only comment is that the master bedroom bathroom is small.

Wow, we had a great stay! The home was clean, comfortable, and set up with unique decor that reflected the character of the Bronzeville neighborhood. One of our favorite parts of the stay was walking less than a block to the coffee shop each morning and then heading to a beautiful park just a couple of blocks away. It was a great way to enjoy the neighborhood and start the day. The location also made it easy to get to Hyde Park, downtown Chicago, and plenty of local attractions. Tosin was friendly and accommodating, even searching for lost airpods . We’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking to experience an authentic Chicago neighborhood. We loved our stay and would highly recommend!!
Place was clean and looked like the photos. Good sleeping arrangements. No tv in common areas, and the tvs were a bit difficult to operate, otherwise everything was great. Phenomenal shower.
Great place and great host!
Very nice place! within walking distance of a nice brunch spot and public transportation.

We had such a great stay! The apartment was very clean, comfy, and met all of our needs. The host was quick to respond to my messages, and checked in to make sure everything was going smoothly which I appreciated. Lots of restaurant and bar options in walking distance. Would recommend!
Had a great time

Check in was confusing. We were told someone would meet us with a key but we couldn’t even get into the building. When someone did come open the doors they just kind of tossed a key at us. The room was also not clean yet and we were walking in as cleaning was walking out. The biggest complaint though is the mattress was ridiculously thin and sitting directly in a bar bed frame with slates over 6 inches apart. This caused the mattress to dip and our hips to lay directly on the bed frame bars. This is unsafe for backs by mattress standards and cheaping out on a bed spring is ridiculous. We did not continue our stay because of significant back pain from the first nights sleep. The coffee maker was also disgusting with floating debris and kitchen surfaces were sticky. If it weren’t for the bed issue though, those would have been minor inconveniences. When we let the host know we could not stay they did not respond to our request for a refund and we had to connect with Air B&B directly.

Coming back for sure. Great location for us to be near family. And the back patio is so relaxing. Kathleen worked with as flight delays brought family members in at different times. It all resulted in a delightful weekend.
Nancy was a great host. She was proactive and accommodating. The unit was clean and in a wonderful location. I would definitely stay here again.
Had a great stay! Home was spacious and had everything we needed. Nae was also responsive and was kind enough to let us check-in early.
Always enjoy staying here. Demitri is very responsive and friendly. Checkout process is easy. Will stay there again if available for next visit. Highly recommend!

This spot was perfect for a girls weekend! We had 10 of us total and it was very spacious. Plenty of rooms, sleeping arrangements, and bathrooms! Plus we could easily hang out in all of the common areas. Anny was very helpful and hospitable!

Can’t beat the location. Me and my group of friends were in town for a reunion and it fit all of us. It had 4 bed, 3 baths. All the rooms were clean and modern. Two of the bedrooms were not fully enclosed but it was fine for us. There is a security guard at night which makes it feel safer.
The rooftop deck was an extra nice spot to hang out. We saw multiple groups up there as well. They are responsive but the process for early and late checkout was hard - even though there was an extra fee attached, you won’t find out whether it’s granted until hours before you check in or out, making it hard to plan, especially with a large group.
All in all, a nice place to stay for a big group.
She tired to blame us for a leaking pipe in the kitchen.
It was a very cute little place, Edwin was quick to respond and very flexible with check in time which very happy about it,
Nice updated place.
Great host. Clean apartment. Well stocked and kept up.
Very nice stay here ! City was only 20 minutes out and we had so much to do nearby !
Great spot close to White Sox Stadium to go stay to catch a game or two.

Everything was as described and excellent. I was there for business so only in the unit for a short time. Bath towels were fluffy and soft. Street parking was a bit tricky to find a spot and that part was a bit challenging. Overall, would recommend.
We had a fantastic stay. The place was very comfy. The host is very responsive. Bed very comfy. Fun and walkable area. We had no issues.
We loved our stay! It was perfect for a long weekend getaway with a teen and a toddler. Cozy, private, quiet and had everything we needed. Would stay again!
Had so much fun at Steve’s place! Super easy check in and check out, comfy beds, and super duper clean. Perfect location and great communication too :)
We enjoyed our stay.

Our family enjoyed our stay very much. The Airbnb was comfortable, and my grandson especially loved the pool table and arcade game. My husband and I stayed in the large upstairs bedroom, and the bed was extremely comfortable. We very much appreciated having two parking spaces since we had two cars. We happened to be in town when the annual Puerto Rican festival was in full swing, and between that, the excellent playground at Humboldt Park, and the great local restaurants, it was a very fun and exciting time to experience the area.
Great!

It was cozy and the patio was our favorite part. There was a broken chair back there and some weeds overgrown, but we didn’t mind. The bathroom and bedrooms were a bit smaller than expected but we were still comfortable. Good neighbors, people were friendly. There’s a really cute grocery store around the block. There are rats in the alley and tom cats, but that’s to be expected. Parking is behind the house and plenty of space. Kitchen was mostly well stocked but could use a few more coffee cups. There is a keurig. We stayed in unit 2. Washer and dryer was convenient to have. Kitchen table needs some fixing, it was wobbly. We just used the island or patio furniture instead. Otherwise the place is clean and cozy.

We had a wonderful stay. So glad we booked this place last minute!
The home was clean, beautifully designed, and very comfortable. The outside space worked so well for our group.
Check-in was easy, communication was smooth, and the space looked just like the photos.
Can’t wait to return after the opening of the Obama Center given its close proximity.
We would definitely recommend The Dorchester!

We liked where we stayed close to the park and our wedding venue. There were issues when we arrived …no air conditioners and I had to call about it, but they came and installed that evening. Then the bathroom shower faucet would not shut off and had to call about that too. Had to wait for someone to come turn it off   It needs replacing. There are no towel hooks for wet towels and needs a bathmat in the tub as it was very slippery and a slow drain. I also noticed the smoke alarm in the front room was missing.  I would stay there again if these were fixed as it was clean,  beds were nice and had most amenities for our needs.
Clean and furnished

This spot in Old Town was amazing! Was very spacious for our group of 12 and extremely convenient. Would highly recommend for anyone staying in Chicago! Govardhan was extremely helpful and responded promptly when needed. 10/10 stay can’t recommend this place enough!
Great place to stay! Lot to do in the area!
Cute space, comfortable bed. Would definitely stay here again!
Definitely great place to stay. Very updated and in a great quiet area

Monica’s place was so perfect. Her artwork is amazing and the space/decor was unique and inviting. The set up was perfect for me—a single person—or it would be suitable for a couple. Great neighborhood! I would book it again without question.

Good Airbnb. Was able to accommodate me for an early check in. Check in instructions were slightly unclear but was able to get into contact with them. Ran into slight issues when using the garage but overall not a terrible experience

Very supportive hosts, and a beautiful apartment in the heart of some great coffee shops, cafes, restaurants, and bars. The balcony, with views of the skyline, was a real highlight. Wonderful furnishings as well, and well stocked kitchen and bathrooms. Great way to enjoy Chicago!

There were 6 of us for my parents' 60th wedding anniversary. The size was perfect for six people staying there, as well as for hosting more for a couple of very casual dinners. Stools at the kitchen counter for dining.
The walk-in shower in the master bath, the elevator, and the designated parking spot were phenomenal for my parents.
Communication with this host was nearly immediate.
✅ communication
✅ location
✅ cleanliness
✅ accessibility
Brilliant.

The home was exactly as described. The kitchen and bathrooms were fully stocked in case anything was forgotten at home.
Dawn is great. Super responsive and very helpful. We didn’t need it because we’re familiar with the city, but there were lots of recommendations in a folder on the counter which is a really nice touch.
If we have the need I will 100% check with Dawn on availability before looking anywhere else.

This home is a few minutes waling distance from vibrant nightlife and Wrigley stadium. It was decorated in a "old Hollywood" style and enough room for you to be comfortable. Our stay was enjoyable and we were able to move easily around the city for our plans. I would definitely stay again!

My girlfriend and I wanted to go to Chicago to celebrate our anniversary and we found Mera’s listing and thought it was perfect. It’s in a walkable neighborhood, it’s near great food joints, and right next to I-90. The apartment matched the description and it was a comfortable stay. Mera even pointed out some nice restaurants to go to for my girlfriend’s and I anniversary dinner and I’m glad we chose Bistro Campagne.
We stayed with our family and 2 little children. The location is perfect in Logan Square. The hosts were around during the stay and checked in to make sure we didn’t need anything. Would stay again!

We had a wonderful time here for my bachelorette trip! Comfortable and spacious. Walkable to bars and restaurants in West Loop. Beds were comfortable and kitchen was well stocked! Very quiet and peaceful! Would stay again!
Great place, parking was findable, responsive host!
Me and my partner LOVED this place. Wish we could have hung out there more. Very clean and comfortable. The host was fantastic to deal with.

Absolutely unbeatable location. My husband and I used to live in Logan Square and I return frequently to Chicago for work. Being able to walk to all of our favorite restaurants and jump on the el to get downtown is truly unbeatable. The apartment was surprisingly quiet for being on the corner and the backyard was a cozy little retreat for our toddler.
Peter’s place was fantastic. It’s in a nice neighborhood with lots of trees, very walkable to restaurants and the train, and convenient to the highway. There was plenty of space for our whole family.

Overall a lot of space and activities in the 7 bedroom house. Train is steadily riding by and quite loud and shakes house. Wish there were TVs in the bedrooms.  This is a really big and fun filled house! We took an uber everywhere and it’s no more than 20/30 minutes away.

No disappointments.
The home was amazingly beautiful and every detail was covered.
From the initial booking to check out, the process was seamless.
Location of the home is closer to the airport, but navigating around the city was very easy.
The owners were very responsive and made us feel comfortable.
We had a great time!
Erhan place was perfect for a long weekend getaway with a small child. very walkable & parking in the back was perfect for us. would stay there again!

Overall great experience. Was able to uber in and out of the city no problem. I wasn’t planning on being exactly in the city so it worked for me! However, if you’re trying to walk more, having to uber a lot may be an issue. The host was responsive and check in and out was probably the simplest of all AirBnB I have ever stayed at!
Perfect spot for a solo traveler. Convenient access to the red line.
Super great place! Space was very clean and they accommodated to a last minute request!Would definitely stay again !
Great place! Lots of walkable restaurants, bars and shops. Easy access to transit. Melissa was a great communicator and very responsive
Amazing woman, very nice and passionate. Would recommend this stay to anybody

Staying with Marty & Rob was a wonderful experience !! We thoroughly enjoyed the house, the area and our time in Chicago. This house is in a great spot for walkability, restaurants, and comfort. The house is clean and comfortable with great hosts. You are out of the main downtown area, but the little neighborhood this house is in has so much to explore. You are able to get to downtown very easily with the public transportation. I highly recommend staying here !!

In terms of the actual apartment and it's location - it was truly terrific! however, we've stayed in basement rooms before, but the noise from upstairs was absolutely horrible. you could hear every movement and conversation above. if you need a quiet place, I unfortunately cannot recommend this one. however, the neighborhood was peaceful and beautiful, and the apartment had great amenities!
Great spot for a solo traveler visiting family.  Clean, easy, and great location.

Great place to stay if you are looking to experience either downtown Chicago or its suburban area. It was right down the street from the transit which was affordable and easy to play activities around. Pilsen is a great area with friendly neighbors and authentic restaurants. PPP
Amazing stay! I was able to stay there with a friend and it was great! Really cool and nice space. The area was really nice. I liked how walkable it was and I would totally stay here again!

Great home in Lincoln Square. The property was very nice, exactly as advertised, and in a great location. The host was responsive, accommodating, and easy to communicate with throughout the stay. Would definitely recommend.
One of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed out. Location was excellent and the views were even better. Looking forward to coming back here again !
I had a wonderful time. Beautiful home and location for my needs. If my daughter decides to stay in Chicago, I would definitely stay at this location again!

We had a lovely stay at the Walton Residence for my small bachelorette party! the space itself was very clean and comfortable and the area was safe, beautiful and relatively quiet. lots of things to do within a very short walk. the hosts even offered to prepare the room with groceries prior to our arrival! Couldn't have asked for a better stay.
The house was very accommodating for my group. There were a few hiccups but they were resolved as quickly as they could be. The home was peaceful and calm. I would book it again!!

Nice 3 bed and living room w/sofa stay close to a train station. Beds were large and on the nicer side of airbnb stays, and plenty of closet space. Bedrooms only have in-window AC units, while needing to be deep cleaned, were effective. There was a noticeable very foul smell in kitchen when we arrived but we're able to fix. Everything else was fine.
Not the airbnb's fault at all as it's the city of Chicago and Chicagoan drivers, but the intersection outside the airbnb is horribly laid out- so be very careful when crossing.
Great stay and great location right on the train line. Would stay again!
Loved our stay at Cynthia's place. Beautiful home. Warm welcome with fresh and yummy treats! Beautiful and spacious patio. Cynthia was responsive and helpful. Would definitely stay here again!
The place was awesome and very easy to access public transportation! Would consider staying here again

This listing was exactly as described.  It is located right by a grocery store and coffee shop which was very convenient for our stay. Street parking was always available, although we did not need our car much because so much was within walking distance. Comfy beds and furniture. All the basic amenities were included, as well as simple toiletries, extra paper towels and toilet paper which was nice since we were only staying a few days. Excellent stay in Wrigleyville all around!
Everything was great! Anytime I needed assistance, the response time was instantaneous and info was right on. Thank you for everything.
Excellent location in a great neighborhood. The space was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Perfect for walking around and enjoying nearby restaurants.
