We had an amazing stay in Chicago. The apartment was exactly what we were hoping for, comfortable, clean, stylish. The location was perfect, with easy access to restaurants, attractions, and everything we wanted to see.
Nicole and Matt are fantastic hosts. They were attentive, responsive, and incredibly accommodating throughout our stay.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. Highly recommend!
Extremely responsive and helped us out when the front desk was no where to be found. Made our stay extremely pleasant and the place was exactly as described. Would definitely stay here again.
Accommodating of early check in. Nice place in good location
Had an amazing stay and so close to Wrigley for the Mumford and Sons show.

Definitely a mixed review
Nice space. We had 7 and it was great that couples/individuals had their own rooms. Nice kitchen area. Didn't eat here but had coffee before we took off and it worked well.
Place could use some maintenance. Main bldg entrance had leaking ceiling & was full of water/buckets.
Shelf in shower falling off, loud squeaking doors. Also, could hear neighbors easily.
Surrounding area felt kinda sketchy. We walked to dinner after first arriving. It was a 15 min walk and depending on your route some of it looked unsafe. Parked car near main street corner.
We were in town for a wedding. When we came down to our car to go to the ceremony, driver window was smashed in & air bag was stolen. We piled into our other car and had to go. My wife & I had to leave the reception to deal with police report & to secure vehicle w/ rain approaching. Police said it was common in area
Last day was picking glass out of car for ride home. Not Alma's fault but wouldn't stay here again

This is our third airbnb within 1-block of this location. Loiterers asking for money is uncomfortable but seems to be par for the neighborhood.  This location is excellent for our needs. Proximity to two mini markets, one grocery store, the EL and bus routes and the beach are worth it for us. Overall experience was excellent.

This is a fine air BNB. Walking distance from McCormick so great location for trade shows. The building is close to the L but it isn't too loud when the train goes by. However, the other tenants were very loud and the noise travels through the walls and ceilings. Seems like a spot for people going out as most of the loud noise was at 2 AM when people were coming home from bars.

The issues started almost immediately: 1) keys do not operate as easily and are not clearly marked.
2) Bathroom toilet was not cleaned aside from the bowl.
3) The shower took 7 hours to drain (reported to owner but did not get a reply aside asking if “it was bad bad”)
4) Moths everywhere.
5) Some kind of crust on the pillows.
6) The slowest WiFi that would then go intermittently out.
10/10 do not recommend
Great stay. Very clean place. Great location. Thanks for having us.

Had to switch up my stay at the last minute due to storms knocking out power at my first Airbnb house. Brandon’s place was a great find. Very convenient location and plenty big enough for our group. The garage parking was nice. It’s a tight fit but he was upfront about that and offered street parking passes if we would have needed them.
Sean was always responsive and answered any questions I had.
We loved the location of Rasheed’s place and he was very responsive to any of our needs.

This place is like a traveler’s hostel-relatively clean, spacious for shared facilities, and affordable. Along the same lines, it has a do-it-yourself vibe with only instant coffee, mismatched sheets, basic supplies not always maintained (missing toilet paper, hand soap, light bulbs), and the kitchen and bathroom not particularly clean. The description oversells the room; but that said, the bed was better than some in nicer airbnbs I’ve stayed in, the towels were good, and the location felt safe. Parking was very hard since we spent most of our time out in the city and evenings the streets were packed. I appreciate Hakim’s effort to provide an affordable Chicago option- but be prepared to take care of your own needs.
Spacious! Two levels helped as my group had a toddler with them who needed naps during the day. The group was able to hangout upstairs.

Nuestra estancia en el lugar fue muy buena y cómoda, nos quedaba cerca (700 metros) una estación de metro y una de autobús muy cerquita, en la esquina de la casa. La zona era tranquila aunque llegáramos de noche. Menciona que tiene baño compartido, tiene 2 completos y nunca fue un problema durante la estancia. Hay lugares de comida mexicana cerca, muy ricos. Lo recomendamos para estancia de solo llegar a dormir para después salir a conocer más de Chicago
Such a great find. Beautiful neighborhood and house!

This acomodation was really great value for money. It was quite close to downtown with good connections. Only downside is, that there were some homeless people in close proximity of the apartment. Despite this, the site felt completely safe, with camera systems set up greatly.
This place was exactly what you would expect for this price point! We loved the location and it was a comfortable place to stay

Very clean and comfortable. As described, there can be noise in the area from the freeway, fire station across the street, or people out on the street, but this was only bad one of three nights and it quieted down by midnight. Also, earplugs and the white noise machine and AC/fan helped.
Location is great for accessing the El (less than 5 minute walk to Chicago Ave stop on the Blue line). Also decent restaurants just west of here a few blocks, a good cafe a few blocks away on Milwaukee, and a great view of the nearby cathedral/church; also a public indoor pool (one of the nicer ones I think in Chicago) a few blocks away. Communication with the host was excellent and I was able to store my bag before check-in time. Overall, very good.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was beautiful, spacious, and exceptionally clean. We especially loved the accordion door that opened to the outdoor patio—it created such a great indoor-outdoor feel. The check-in process was seamless, the instructions were clear and easy to follow, and parking was convenient. The space was well-maintained, comfortable, and exactly as described. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!
Really nice guy!
Ewa was a great host. She was very responsive and the apartment was looked just like the photos. Would stay here again.
Excelente ubicacion, facil acceso para el tren. El lugar esta limpio y agradable. Nos gustò estar ahi.
Great place! Would stay again. Matches the description and the price was extremely affordable.

The apartments of Zhi Guang are very comfortable for living. He provided very detailed instructions on how to check in.  These instructions are clear to follow and easy. The kitchen in the house is also equipped with all the necessary tools for preparing food and boiling water for tea and coffee. Therefore, these accommodations are wonderful for living.
very quiet neighborhood. close to Logans Square. felt safe at night walking. Bonus is that son lives <5 min walk
Had a great stay in Avondale!

If you want the true city feel, this area is not the spot. If you’re looking for a spot easily connected to the rest of the city, amazing food, culture, & easily accessible, this is 100% the spot.
Do mind that the warning about ceiling height is true. While my 6’1” partner did not mind, some folks might. Height restrictions mostly in the hallway.
Place was great
Great stay, 10/10 would recommend :)

Our stay got off to an unusual start when a major storm rolled through and knocked out power in the area. Michael was proactive and communicated with us early on move-in day, keeping us informed and helping us make the best decision to postpone our arrival by one day while power was restored.
The next morning, Michael met us at the house, allowed us to drop off our belongings early, and gave us a quick tour so we could get on with our day. His communication and flexibility throughout the situation were greatly appreciated.
The home itself is unique in all the right ways. It is beautifully updated, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed with an open floor plan that made it easy to relax and enjoy our stay. Comfy beds and a relaxing steam shower! The location was also a plus, with convenient walking access to the Metra.
Despite Mother Nature's unexpected plans, we had a wonderful stay and would happily recommend this property to future guests.

We had a fantastic time at Anne's place.  We traveled with a 15 month old baby and Anne let us check in a little early! She even had a highchair and pack-n-play for us.  Her home was clean and comfortable.  It was stocked with everything you could think of! It was great that we were able to walk to the grocery store and restaurants. We enjoyed it and will book again!!
Great location.  Very convenient and great for any events at Wrigley field.  Unit is slightly dated/old but sufficient shape.  Worth staying for the location and would stay again.
Todo excelente

A cozy 1b apartment that accommodated my short stay in Chicago. It’s In an ideal location where only a short bus ride gets you to the city and nearest train stations, or even walkable if you seem fit to do so. Quiet neighborhood to wind down after a long night out. Inside the apartment is simple and easy to navigate, modern design. The only knock I can give is others peoples complaint about the WiFi and TVs, was a little wonky and didn’t really work. Wasn’t a deal breaker for me abut maybe for some if they insist on spending a day inside. More than sure that’s an easy fix though. Overall a good stay that I wouldn’t mind coming back to!
Great place. Bigger than I expected. Cool neighborhood. Liked it was near the 606 walking, biking trail. We walked down that and  took blue line downtown
My family was very happy with the location and the space we stayed in.

Paul was very accommodating even though we had trouble with our flight, which affected our check-in/out times. The room and bathroom were clean, and the interior was beautiful. Thank you for a comfortable and smooth stay, Paul and Abby!
A huge space in a great location. Super easy to work with. Highly recommend for a large group!

We had an amazing stay!  Very spacious unit.  Incredibly clean. Rida was always available for our questions. The unit is very safe and is in the middle of everthing. Thank you for a great weekend in Chicago!!

Our stay at The 606 Retreat was exactly what we hoped it would be! It's a perfect location in the middle of Logan Square. We loved the patio and private garden and the house was thoughtfully appointed. We would happily stay again! Elba was also very responsive and addressed every question and concern we had quickly and provided great support during our stay.
Great location as pictured! Would stay here again!

We had a wonderful time staying in Chicago! The neighborhood was very walkable. We ventured out each morning for breakfast and to walk the neighborhood. It was so close to Wrigley as well which was perfect for the event we went to there. The apartment was lovely and clean. I’d definitely stay here again.
Great
Love this place
Great location in Chicago, host was super nice and responsive. Would stay here again!
Beautiful place will definitely stay again!!!!
Very nice place to stay for a weekend in Chicago

We met with 3 families for a family wedding. The place was perfect with plenty of space and lots of beds and a well stocked kitchen with appliances. The neighborhood was great for walking to shops and restaurants. The provided parking was a huge blessing in a very busy neighborhood.
Enjoyed our stay. Beds felt amazing and the shower pressure was great!

We found this the perfect location to meet up with our young adult daughters and granddaughters.  Enjoyed walking to beach along Jackson park  and the house is close to Griffen museum. Local Market grocery store was only a couple blocks away so we were able to shop and prepare meals, The kitchen was great! Everything was pristine, the beds were comfortable.  The "toy room" is mostly board games for older kids and is really just an area in the unfinished, but very tidy basement.  If you have littles bring things to entertain them upstairs. Parking was not a problem for us, normal city street parking. There were two playgrounds within easy walking distance and as a grandmother walking with  two toddlers I felt perfectly safe.  Of note, this is a city neighborhood, populated by a rich variety of people from many walks of life. There was probably some sketchy activitiy going on down at the local BP station but it was easy to ignore.   Great stay!
Solid spot in a convenient location just a short walk to the red line. Host was very responsive throughout the stay.
This place was nice.  It's in a quieter area, was clean and very convenient.   Completely met our needs for our Chicago weekend.  Would recommend.
Great location and great for larger groups!

Great place in great location, mile or less to the beach as well as Andersonville neighborhood. Great places to eat nearby and new coffee shop Queen Yemeni. Alicia was responsive and everything was smooth! Appreciated the parking stickers
Nice neighborhood, clean spacious house, nice yard. Would book again.
Perfect location for my needs in Lincoln Square while visiting the States. Would definitely use the space again!
Very easy and great spot. Exactly as advertised. Dennis was super responsive, let us check in early and helpful with last minute parking. Can’t get a better location!
Easy and convenient for our short 4 night stay in Chicago. We parked for free right on the street outside the property- watch out for street cleaning signage though. Overall, a great stay!
great location!
Good value, great location, lots of parking

Nice spacious place with plenty of shops in walking distance. Street parking was actually pretty good for Chicago.
The washer/dryer/line area is in the open part of the loft, not closed. Photos are deceptive in that area but accurate for the rest of the place.
We loved Mark’s place. It is a great neighborhood and a short walk to the L train. There are many fantastic restaurants nearby.

Great stay and great price for location in city! There is 2 bedrooms downstairs and then you have to go upstairs for the 3rd bedroom, which is a huge loft! Almost like a 2nd apartment without a kitchen. So good for privacy. Only complaint would be no curtains and we all woke up at 630am everyday.
Beautiful apartment in a great location!
Great area, nice place, great response time and communication with host. No complaints!
2.5/5 stars mainly the ac it was hot the entire stay
let me have a late checkout and was a nice place. neighbood wasn't great (I had kids with me). there is a taco place next door that was the worst Mexican food. (I'm a Texan)
Overall the stay was great. The communication and instruction were amazing.  The only thing i would chang is maybe its time to update the furniture. Overall loved the experience.

We loved our stay here. The apartment was perfect for a small family. Everything was very clean and the location was great. Instructions for check in and parking were easy to follow. Would love to stay here again!
Very friendly host she made me feel comfortable with instructions and area seems a little sketchy but we didn’t encounter a single bad thing even coming in at 12 in the morning great spot

We stayed at Sebastian's Apartment in Chicago for the weekend so that my wife and I could get to know our daughter's soon-to-be-fiance a little bit as he is originally from Chicago.
The Apartment was easy to find, had parking for our car in the back and the boyfriend found ample free parking just around the corner. We ate early morning breakfasts together in the kitchen and spent the late evenings in conversation in the comfortable sitting area. My wife and I slept well in the larger bedroom, my daughter in the smaller, and the boyfriend on the couch ... :-)
Sebastian's Apartment is situated downtown just a few minutes from the Art Institute, Field Museum, and Shedd Aquarium by car or a 10 minute walk to the nearest metro station. We spent the days exploring downtown, the evenings dining out, and even met the boyfriends parents.
I will gladly stay at Sebastian's Apartment again the next time we visit Chicago.
Super nice place and very easy stay.
Quiet and walkable area
It was very nice.Mary’s house is quiet and has a cozy vibe.I enjoyed my stay.

Ari anticipated any questions we had and kept us well informed throughout the process.  The property was exactly as depicted and Ari made  our stay a comfortable success.  We look forward to working with Ari on our return trips to Chicago.
Great spot pretty close to a bunch of options!
Great place, beautiful views and great neighborhood.
Spacious, clean, and comfy beds - awesome stay!

Our stay was great, overall. The beds were comfortable and there was plenty of space for everyone in my family. The place was a short walk to the L so it was convenient to get around. Junaid was a great communicator and even warned us about the upstairs neighbor, who likes to play music loud at all hours of the night. That was honestly the only down side to our stay, but we were all so tired from walking around the city all day that we’d passed out so the loud music wasn’t too much of a disruption.
Close to the area I was working in, and Francisco was very helpful getting me in and settled.

This is my fourth time staying here, and I couldn’t ask for a better spot! The suite is comfortable, clean, and cozy and filled with thoughtful touches and amenities. The location is quiet but near bus and train stops. Will stay as long as they’ll have me!
Shaun's place was exactly as posted and described! very clean, very comfortable!
Very responsive host, quiet neighborhood, beds were comfortable, 8 blocks from the brown line so easy walk to transit, restaurant, and shopping!
Great hotel room.  Clean, neat, great little happy hour bar - the bartender was WONDERFUL!!  Right in the middle of things - great place to stay in Chicago.
It was a nice place.

I was staying for a week in this apartment and it was great! The location was very comfortable, safe for uptown and very close to the red line. My only criticism is the quality of the furnitures: the tables and chairs were unstable, and the sofa and the dedicated workspace place were tiny making it very hard to work in the Airbnb. But overall I enjoyed my stay!

Great location and value, exactly as pictured/described. Clean, good amenities, quick communication, parking passes included, and close to public transit. Only hiccup was hot water outage for a temporary period, which was corrected as quickly as possible. Thanks for offering us a semi-private oasis to enjoy our Chicago vacation.
Cozy and functional with beautiful things- and a superb location- seriously cannot beat it! 5-star experience!

Great location in Chinatown. Place was very clean and spacious.  We did manage to luck out and get street parking, but you might have to park it in the garage and pay not far from the Airbnb.  Family enjoyed their stay in Chicago.

You can’t find a gem like this in the Fulton Market area.  If you want to be in the heart of one of the vibiest and walkable parts in the city…   A must visit is Au Cheval… only 4 minute walk away.  I will be coming back every year!!  5 Stars + 2 for extra credit.

Darsh's condo is the perfect place to stay in Chicago. Very comfortable beds and all the necessary amenities. What I liked most about the condo is the location. Easily walkable to downtown and Lake Michigan as well as Fulton Market and many gems in the area. Excellent stay.
Beautiful setting.   Responsive and kind host.   We were celebrating our daughters graduation from Kellog and this could not be a more perfect setting for our family to call home base.

I would definitely recommend this place to stay! Cars passing by can be a little noisy at night but overall it wasn’t too bad. There’s some great food spots in the area (Pueblo Nuevo Mexican restaurant, Migos, Portage Park breakfast place) Kim was a great host and we would definitely recommend this spot!

This is one of my top favorite places that I’ve ever stayed ! 😃  First of all,  Lisa is the BEST host 🩷 !!   Her communication ( response) was always quick, and always so kind !  Everything about Lisa’s place was absolutely perfect !   The location was great - a quiet, safe, pretty neighborhood.  Street parking was easy, and always close.  Check in was super easy !   When we walked in, we were amazed at the size !  It’s a huge space !,   Very nicely decorated !,   The entire place is SO clean ! (Spotless !!) 😀   It feels very private, and peaceful  !!   A very comfy bed, with wonderful linens !    Beautiful new bathroom ,and nice living room area !  There is even a washer and dryer !  There were snacks, and a nice selection of coffee !    She has truly thought of everything you would ever need !   This is definitely the BEST value in Chicago ! 😊   I look forward to a longer stay next time !    Don’t hesitate !  Book it now !  You’ll LOVE it ! 💜🤗    ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Nice place

This was the perfect in-between place between the south and north sides of Chicago for us. It was a safe location.  It accommodated 4 comfortably.  The only suggestion would be to add 2 more coffee cups. The place was clean, and we were able to relax after excursions in Chicago. I would stay again, and I highly recommend it.
Worked great for our trip, great place, Tonys a great helpful host, place was very clean, overall 10/10 stay no issues
We had a great stay in Chicago. The house is clean and very safe. A few amenities were missing but other than that a good stay for a very reasonable price.
Enjoyed our stay!
Great stay at this place! Super quiet and sweet place to stay outside of the city, but easy access to the city!

Booked this the week of our wedding. Perfect for getting ready photos, tea ceremony and located perfectly for dinner and meals and activities with the family. Even more convenient since our family booked the one down stairs as well and we were able to go between the units very very easily. Loved it
A lovely home in a fun, walkable neighborhood. Quiet street close to L and beach, and house had everything we needed. Thank you for a great stay!
Nice place very nice area with a good community. Only complaint is the blankets on the bed were only linen, and the Wi-Fi only worked in certain areas in the apartment. besides that great day.

Keith and Elizabeth are great hosts and made the stay great! Super responsive and helpful, accommodating, and everything was easy. Very comfortable, clean, and plenty of space. Would stay again for sure.

Tonija’s place was a great spot for our stay. The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Tonija was a wonderful, understanding host and quick to communicate. Would happily stay again highly recommend.
The rental was great. Thanks for sharing your beautiful space with us. Being that I am 71 the front stairs were hard to use. However the rear stairs were easier for me

We were here to celebrate our daughter’s college graduation. The house was a nice size, well kept, and had a lovely patio in the back. There is a park at the end of the block with a playground. Kory was very good about communicating.

great place for a group. We were able to walk to a lot of great spots and hangout in the living room and outside comfortably. People need to share beds (12 guys stayed), but overall comfortable stay especially considering the location in Chicago. Need a skilled driver to fit 2 cars in garage spots, but we had one in there and plenty of parking on the streets nearby. Overall, great experience at this property.
Nice stay

Great stay in Chicago! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as advertised. Check-in was seamless, and everything was easy and hassle-free. We didn’t need much during our stay, but everything was well organized and made for a great experience. Would definitely stay here again.
Nice stay for a quick weekend in Chicago! Inez was very accommodating
Easy to check in and clean

Barry and Charlene's place was great! Firstly, probably one of the best stocked Airbnbs I have ever been to, from kitchen to bathroom - what was there exceeded our expectations (a friend forgot a straightener - they had one in the closet, there are games, books, movies, and a stocked spice shelf). The location is great, just some minutes walk from the Logan Square Blue line stop to get into the city - if you're not feeling that, Logan Square itself has plenty of restaurants to try.
We also all appreciated the white noise machines, I'm a light sleeper and often shared units cause me to sleep poorly, was happily not the case here.
Barry and Charlene are proactive with communication, which meant I actually didn't end up having to reach out to them much, we did have the pleasure of meeting Barry out front.
As this place is only a few minute walk from one of our friends, we'll certainly consider it in the future.
Great location! Easy access to downtown and several attractions. The place was very clean and actually much more spacious than I anticipated. I’d definitely stay here again!

The space was exactly as pictured, and just what we needed to enjoy a quick weekend trip! The breakfast food and daily coffee provided was such a nice touch, and the location was great for catching the blue line. It felt peaceful and pretty private while also reassuring that Andreea and Shaun were available and responsive if we needed anything. Would book again!

Absolutely love this place. Never stayed in an apartment building this big. We were not too far from the city and there were Lyft/Divvy bikes that were a block down that we were able to rent. One way navy pier was 8 miles. I was able to view the whole entire lakefront trail and see a lot of of the city that way.
We also drove into the city of one of the days and the traffic around the area was not bad and it was close to all of the tourist things!
The host was very helpful and responsive with any issues we had. The place was very clean. The views were beautiful.
We had a great time! The location was perfect for many things. We enjoyed the zoo, beach, restaurants and DePaul campus. There was ample space and the amenities were perfect.
the stay was good and location is really good too. Abus ride away from almost everything
Host responded quickly to correspondence sent her way. Apartment is close to my daughter’s place and convenient for walking.
Heather's place was perfect, close to everything and came as advertised.  Lines of communication were great as well.  Just what we were looking for.
David is an awesome host. He was very responsive and even checked in on is during sone heavy storms. I would definitely stay there again.

We had an excellent stay! The house was  a perfect size for our group of 9. Having a garage was an added bonus. There was so much to do within walking distance including restaurants, shops, and groceries.

Had the best experience with my friends for a long weekend. House was fantastic, clean, and in a wonderful neighborhood as well.  Everything was as advertised and the stay was a 10/10. Lastly, Eva was a fantastic host!

Lovely place in Chinatown, which is a strategic place with easy access to the metro and city center.
The house is nice and Zheng has been very helpful.
I will definetly come back if in Chicago again!

Great place in a peaceful neighborhood with flexible self check-in. Everything was as described in the description. The host provided great instructions, responded promptly over chat, and also was flexible to accommodate my early-check-in. A great stay for the budget. It is easily accessible by bus number 82 and 84 just a few blocks away. Only two things to note was weirdly though the thermostat was set to 70-72 the room rather ran hot but thanks to the fan that was provided it wasn’t anything major (i believe it is on a schedule and indoor temp went to 77 by morning). The second thing was the bathtub is fine, gets the job done, but has paint peeling here and there, again solid functionality, but aesthetically might question you, but trust me, you can stay here without a second thought. Overall great budget stay, i appreciate Victor for being prompt and hosting me!
Comfortable and charming studio apartment. Everything we needed for a cozy weekend stay.
cozy space with Everything you need

This was an absolutely perfect location with so many bars and restaurants within walking distance. The park was also very walkable or just a short drive with paid parking right in front of the building. Very safe neighborhood and a beautiful apartment!

We stayed here for a sisters trip and had the best time! We got to meet Natalie, and she was so kind, thoughtful, and friendly - it almost felt like a friend was hosting us! Natalie is very responsive, accommodating, & easy to communicate with.
Everything is super cute with a ton of attention to detail - even has phone chargers plugged in next to the beds! But it’s not only cute, it’s extremely comfortable! We did carry out to eat here one night just because we were so comfortable spending time there!! Oh and did I mention comfortable beds!!!
The location can’t be beat! Easily walkable, tons of things to do, places to eat, go to the beach, etc. Loved the outside patio area as well.
This place will be at the top of my list anytime I come to Chicago in the future!! Thanks Natalie for a wonderful weekend to celebrate my sisters birthdays!!
Great little bungalow, couldn’t get much closer to Wrigley Field.  Gave very detailed info for parking.  Great recommendations for local restaurants.
Great place to stay in downtown Chicago. It was perfect for us all, exactly what we needed for this week long trip!
Fantastic stay! Extremely clean and quaint place. Highly recommend!
Comfortable, clean place with lots of sleeping accommodations for a large group. Also plenty of space to hang out together. Very much enjoyed our stay.
We really enjoyed our stay! Very clean and well furnished. Hanna and Mark were so easy to communicate with.

GOAT stays had a lot of automated messeges. With a lot of repetitive messeges sent. They also were only able to assist from 10am to 7pm which normally wouldn’t have been an issue but the appartment was not clean at all. There was black mold in the bathroom. Pizza boxes left behind. Tooth brushes left behind. Stain under the fridge. Hair in the bath tub. & a drawer completely broke when we were there.
Bedding was clean and towels were clean but there were other items that didn’t meet the mark when paying as much as we did. Outside of cleanliness, it was a really nice spot for myself and 4 friends and was advertised well.
This AirBnB was perfect for a large group in Chicago. Super accessible to many spots by walking and super close to the blue line to get to the rest of the city! Will be back when in town.
loved everything, would stay again!

Stuart’s place was the perfect spot for a long overdue reunion of four high school friends! We used every bit of the house for our long chats. The comfy couch and chairs, the back porch, dining room table. Beds were super comfortable. The house was extremely quiet! Each morning we walked to the coffee shops and caught the 22 and 9 buses easily to get downtown, Lakeview, Old Town and the beach.
A fantastic stay!

The host was very respectful she was flexible with my requests I had. However she did not mention at ALL that her and her family was staying there. They were in our space we payed $800 for, all we got was a bedroom. We had to wait to shower or use the bathroom because her friend/family would be using it.
Great place to stay in Chicago, very clean and comfortable!
Thanks for having us! We’d love to come back!
The host Frederick was very nice. The home itself is extremely modern very spacious and overall the stay was very welcoming. I would book again

Fantastic location! And there is plenty of room for two in the apartment. Lots of closet space and it is so nice having a full refrigerator. There isn’t much of a view because you’re looking at the alley but the bonus is it means it is surprisingly quiet even though you are in a very active area. The park 1/2 block away is such a treat, too! Lots of people walking their dogs and an overall beautiful setting.

Milan’s space was great and he was very responsive to the limited issues we had. Great location, easy commutes to all the Chicago attractions. Family friendly space. Loved having the secured underground parking space option as well. Would stay again the next time I’m in Chicago!
Such a cute place and a good neighborhood!
Perfect place to stay close to Wrigley Field

Our family of 8 including 2 infants stayed here for 2 nights. It was pleasant stay, with no issues.
Few things to consider:
To get inside the house was little confusing. On landing page it showed my last 4 digits of phone number to be used, when tried couple of times it failed, clicked on send message to owner and then other 4 code digit appeared which worked.
Kitchen did not have any utensils for cooking, also limited supply
Neighborhood is little clumsy.
Something you should know(nothing related to this house):
Don’t but water bottle crates from any nearby gas stations (one they are over priced, secondly they are not sealed).
This is a spacious and lovely apartment on a quiet street, walking distance to many restaurants. The Zoo and botanical garden are close too. I highly recommend this well appointed place.
The house was very clean and had a lot of added touches that made it extra nice! Great host!
Excellent host and the perfect Airbnb spot! The rooms were exactly as described, plenty of space, clean, and host had excellent communication throughout the entire stay.
Sheena's place is a little oasis on the Southside! Cozy, clean, quiet, and comfortable. We loved watching the Knicks win game 5 in the home theater!!!
It was a wonderful stay!

The apartment was exactly how it was described in the ad.  I liked the quiet, tree-lined one-way street with great lighting.  The bedrooms are in the back of the house, so no street noise could be heard.  Can't beat the location! I'd go back to Michael's apartment if I ever visit Chicago again.

the photos of this unit is NOT the place where we stayed.
location was close to public transit. parking was easy; we found free parking. location might be considered more rough at night, depending on what you're used to.
amenities were fine with microwave, coffee, etc. THERE IS NO AC!
in terms of cleanliness, overall was good but there were certainly some spots (i wish i could attach photos!) that definitely need a good scrub in the bathroom. some spiderwebs, collected dirt, etc. towels/bed/couch were clean.
check in was easy but instructions were only sent a few hours before arrival (despite being told we would receive instructions 24 hrs before arrival). we definitely had "eyes" on us and i wonder if airbnb are even allowed/legal in this building.
NOTE: neighbors were quite active and loud with evening activities.
if i needed to stay in chicago, i wouldn't mind staying here again, but i would hope to have more accurate photographs of the actual unit i'm staying in.
Nice place. Convenient. Lots to do. Wrigley field close by.
Great stay and location!

Joan’s place was a great find and perfect for a group trip. The train was a little noisy but the listing and Joan were transparent about that and personally I found it charming. Overall great place and would stay here again
Best sleep I got. Excellent bedding!!!

Our group of 12 had a very pleasant 4 day stay. It’s located in a pretty safe area of town. It’s a short walk to both the Green and Red ‘L’ lines which we took during our stay. Great place if you’re looking for a place for a Sox game.
The one downside is some of the amenities were lacking:
Only one roll of toilet paper was in each bathroom. Only one single dishwasher pod was available. Plan on bringing those items.
Beds were honestly some of the most comfortable beds - probably the highlight of the place.
Overall we’d stay there again!

The home was beautiful and exactly as described! Everything was very clean and comfortable. Bai was gracious to let us store our luggage when we arrived so we could easily grab food and explore the neighborhood before check in time.
There is a bakery steps away to grab pastries and coffee in the morning.
Down the street we really enjoyed Runaway Cow for amazing vegan ice cream treats. Super easy to get into the city by bus and/or train. My son was even able to walk to a Sox game.
Great place for us girls to hangout comfortably!!!

Fabulous place for a large group. Great for entertaining, with enough kitchen ware and even a working fireplace. Loved the comfy beds too. A lovely escape within the bustle of a noisy and busy city, while still right in the center of all the action
Love this neighborhood and was a great place to return to in between activities.
Such a beautiful space! Loved our stay and Mimi went over and beyond as a host!
Sachin was extremely responsive and accommodating. The house came as advertised. Great location.
Great spot, would love to stay here again next time we’re in town!

I would definitely recommend this Airbnb. We like it so much it is our second stay there. Close to great restaurants, coffee shops, at the corner of Bowmanville, Ravenswood and Andersonville. So you could walk to many places from her home. The home is lovely, comfy and just full of natural light. Parks nearby too if you like walking in nature. I love Winnemac Park. Anne is also a wonderful host.
Thank you Robert for hosting! We had a great time in old town
Beautiful  and peaceful apartment, walkable area, lots of restaurants choices

Extremely functional, and worked great for me since I was only ever there to sleep late at night and early in the mornings. Felt very safe waking to and from the L line, as the unit is situated basically within a university campus.
House size for our party of 10 was perfect. Bathrooms and kitchen are updated. Plenty of towels and linens. Community is beautiful and easy to access by uber or foot.
Loved staying here, felt like i was at home! So many great businesses around! Check out Pilsen!
Very responsive. Had a problem with the lock and it was fixed immediately. Good communication

Clean, comfortable, and convenient Airbnb in Roger’s Park.  We were a group of four adults and very much enjoyed our stay.  Off street parking was very helpful.  However,  with a larger vehicle it could be a little tight getting into the assigned spot.  The location was convenient to Evanston and downtown Chicago by car, but pubic transportation was easily available via Lunt Street station for the Howard Street line and Roger’s Park station for UP-North line.  The neighborhood has numerous nearby restaurants.  We particularly enjoyed breakfast at the honey bear restaurant.  We wold definitely like to return to this property on future visits to Chicago.
Everything was as expected. We had a great time and the house was just what we needed.
The apartment was really nice and Daniel was very friendly and responsive

Our group of eight adults and one child had a very comfortable stay at Eugene’s Airbnb. Three full bathrooms was perfect for our group size. Plenty of places to hang out throughout the house - we especially enjoyed the basement living room. Easy street parking and the neighborhood was quiet. Also really appreciate an easy checkout that doesn’t require a bunch of steps or cleanup. Would recommend staying here!
Stylish accommodations, great location for walking and train. We loved the big windows.

We really enjoyed our stay. It was conveniently located to public transit and having a dedicated place to park is amazing, especially in this area.  Other reviewers are right- the 'L' is right next door so if you're sensitive to sounds, maybe reconsider. To me, it was just part of being in Chicago. We spent most our days out and about and it didn't disrupt any of our sleep. There's a school with a fabulous playground on the next block so if you bring kids, definitely check it out. We did have a slight issue with parking one night but it was responded to and handled quickly and professionally.   Would definitely consider staying here again.
We felt right at home and we’ll definitely come back ! Thank you so much .
enjoyed our stay.   glad we had our bikes to get around and see the surrounding neighborhoods as well.    thanks abby for the helpful hints and parking passes!
A great stay for a wedding weekend! Location was fantastic and easy to access our events. The beds were so comfortable!
It was just like the description, the hot tub was very relaxing.

Genesys provided a warm and welcoming, safe environment for our young adult kids to stay in and made them feel welcome. Parking on the street was easy and close, great neighborhood, and home decorated stylishly. Recommend her as a host and very trustworthy.
Brett’s place was close to everything in Roscoe Village, and easy access to brown line. Place was immaculate and Brett was very quick and responsive.

A great location with lots culture and personality. It’s also a walkable distance from Wholefoods and TraderJoes, which we really enjoyed during our time. The place was very modern and clean, only thing was the AC did not work and we were very very hot during our stay. Hopefully that gets fixed bc it’s a great unit with a lot of great things nearby:)

Milan was an exceptional host. He was very forthcoming from start to finish about the listing. Very quick to respond to anything I would send him. I didn’t do my own due diligence and thought the unit provided parking options as part of the listing, so that was the only thing I was surprised by, but that was on me and not Milan or the listing. I would recommend using the public transportation instead of renting/bringing a car as the interior garage was really tight and hard to get into and out of. All things considered I would definitely recommend! Thanks Milan!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this spacious and well-appointed home. Wonderful, safe neighborhood. We appreciated the two-car garage. Sarah was a very welcoming host!
Great stay
We had a great stay here. Excellent space, location, cleanliness and very quick communication with hosts. Would definitely stay here again!

We had an excellent stay and highly recommend this property. The condo was exactly as described. It was clean, comfortable, well-maintained, and in a great location. Everything met our expectations and made for a wonderful visit to Chicago.
What truly sets this property apart is the host. She was incredibly responsive, professional, and helpful throughout our stay. Even more impressive, after we had already left Chicago, we realized we had accidentally left a passport behind. Despite her busy schedule, she took the time to drive back to the condo, locate the passport, and help coordinate its return.
Her kindness, dedication, and commitment to her guests went far beyond our expectations. It’s rare to find a host who cares so much, even after a stay has ended. We are extremely grateful for her help and would gladly stay here again.
Book with confidence, you’ll be in great hands!!!

Our stay was comfortable, we felt safe and taken care of! We had everything we need and the host was friendly and responsive. Great spot if you’re planning on going out and exploring Chicago during the days, and having somewhere cozy to crash at night!
We had a great time during our stay. We found the place more than adequate for our needs.
While the check-in process was a bit longer than I'd like, the instructions were helpful. Everything about the stay was great. From the room, to the amenities, and the in-building brunch café
Great stay. Would book again.
Great location, central to great Avondale shops and restaurants. Emily made the stay so easy and the apartment is a great size!

Great location, great huge unit. It's next to the El tracks so if you are a sensitive sleeper, be mindful of that and bring ear plugs. Personally I got used to hearing the El after a day and It didn't both me, I really enjoyed watching the El pass by on the patio. Yolie goes the extra mile for guests, truly appreciated her.
Fairly priced, clean, greatly located garden apartment.
Nice place but very very noisy during the Puerto Rican day weekend!

A really well-appointment and comfortable apartment in a great area of Chicago. North Orchard is a beautiful street, Oz Park is right there (check out the Farmer's Market on Saturday morning!), and it's easy to get around. Highly recommended!

We had a beautiful stay. The home had everything we needed. Everything was very comfortable and clean. We felt right at home. Our host was very kind and checked on us proactively. We would stay again in a heartbeat.
The apartment was clean and exactly as described! Perfect place for two people and close to a lot of what Chicago has to offer
Great place, great location!

Had a great stay here. Beautiful and quiet neighborhood. Close to the train and a lot of good restaurants/Trader Joe’s nearby. The apartment was very clean and the ac kept it cool in the summer. Would definitely stay again the next time I visit!
Great location near everything on halstead and unit is on quiet street
location was close to all events I wanted to go to, would book again!
Enjoyed my time here with friends for my birthday

Milan’s place is wonderful. He was kind enough to allow us to drop off our luggage before our check in time so we wouldn’t have to lug them all over the place!
When we needed a late check out he was more than accommodating! He checked in throughout our stay to see if there was anything we might need.
Milan is one of the most thoughtful and caring hosts I have come across yet!!! Book with him, you won’t regret it!!!

The neighborhood block was quite peaceful. We especially appreciate how tidy and well-organized the house is, and how the morning sun streams through the window. The basement is also beautifully decorated with the ping pong table and entertainment options. It’s awesome!

This place was perfect walking  distance to the wedding we went to. There was a scheduling mix up so we weren’t able to check in until much later but we were compensated fairly. It was a perfect space to stay if you’re looking for a weekend in Chicago

Absolutely perfect location in the heart of West Loop with easy access to the train.  Second floor apartment so street noise is minimal (the sound machine in the bedroom is a nice touch).  All of the amenities are top notch and the place has everything you'd need for a city stay!

Sean's place was better than expected. The house felt spacious for the size, had nice finishes and furnishings, and was very private. The water was hot, the air conditioning was cold, the bed was very comfortable, and the space was spotless.
The only minor complaint would be the stairs getting to the unit. Its a narrow walkway with about 4 stairs going down then 4 back up so maneuvering with bags was a little clumsy. Also, I had parking elsewhere for an event but I don't think I ever saw an open spot on the street over my two night stay so its worth planning ahead.
Overall though, no major complaints and lots of praise. I would happily stay at Sean's place again!
Everything was perfect would stay and pay again!

Wonderful place to stay if you come with pets.  Our dogs LOVED the indoor play area and got plenty of use wrestling and running up and down it.  Projector was fun to watch movies from.  There was a lot of charm and character to this venue!
Third time staying with the hosts and their apartment. Always good. Whenever I travel back to Chicago, I look for this apartment first.

Amazing stay! Everything was perfect. Matt was a wonderful host—friendly, responsive, and very helpful throughout our stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Great location and a smooth check-in process. Thank you, Matt!
Great location and very responsive host

The apartment is fantastic and in a great area. The parking spot a few blocks away is a major plus. My only suggestion is for them to add black out curtains in the bedrooms. The building itself is old and we had some minor trouble with 1 of the 2 elevators.
We were so happy with the place- it had everything we needed and more! Very cute, very clean, very comfortable. Tram was super responsive and we would definitely stay there again!!

Wonderful host and equally wonderful apartment. Everything is quality so you definitely feel at home in this listing. For us, it was the perfect spot to reunite with family for a vacation. Walkable neighborhood with many restaurants nearby. We were welcomed with unfortunate weather, and Stephanie went out of her way to send over the items that made our trip comfortable, due to power outage. She even made sure to send ice for some meds that are to be kept refrigerated. Great communication throughout the stay! We would absolutely book again!

Our son’s wedding was at Bridgeport Art Center and this was the perfect location for our home base. It’s a 5 minute walk to the venue.
The house was huge with plenty of room to spread out. It slept our whole crew and enough bathrooms to get ready for all the events! There was great water pressure in the showers too.
We had no problem with street parking and the garage space was key in moving children from the different events safely.
We were on a business trip for Coffee Fest! This place accommodated my team and more. Great location, & made us feel like we were locals. If we’re ever back, we would stay here again no doubt.
Menar was a great host - went above and beyond with his hospitality.

Alan and Sandy's place is private, quiet (for being located in the lower level of a house on a main street), and comfortable. The kitchen is reasonably stocked for basic cooking and eating, the beds were comfortable, there was ample hot water when needed, the washer and dryer were helpful and worked well. We look forward to a future stay!
Great stay! Clean, comfortable, and in a great location. We really enjoyed our visit and would gladly stay here again. Thank you for hosting us!

We had an incredible time in Wrigleyville!! So many great places that are walkable or a 25 minute Uber to River North. Everything was clean and exactly like the description. Hosts were extremely responsive and flexible with check in and check out times.

Comfy beds and couches, spacious rooms. Well stocked kitchen in terms of utensils and coffee, though the mugs were very low quality. Easy check out with minimal tasks.
Be warned that the cta is nearby which disrupted most of the guests’ sleep especially in the early morning. My room either didn’t have this issue or I did not notice it.
Initial check in takes a while (10 min at least) if you have a lot of guests

I would stay at Maria's place whenever I come to Chicago. It is a cozy apartment that is ideal for a single person or a couple, especially if you plan to explore Wicker Park and the surrounding area. For those attending a show at the Salt Shed, it could not be located in a more ideal location.

Pros: Great location in a really nice neighborhood! Also pretty roomy, we never felt very crammed. Beds were clean and comfy. Host was responsive to any questions we had.
Cons: The place needs general maintenance and upkeep. The sink was clogged and didn’t drain properly, the bathroom door kept falling off, the handrail on the stairwell is loose, most dresser drawers were pretty much falling out, and there was a random bandaid on the ceiling.
Overall the quality of the apartment was not amazing for the cost. The highlight was definitely the location.
Two thumbs up!

This airbnb worked well for my group of friends! Building could use a little TLC, but it was fair for the price. When we arrived the key wasn’t in the box to get in (previous guests had accidentally taken it), so check-in was a little delayed, but Vraj got the key returned swiftly and we were able to enter through another entrance.
Very beautiful area and apartment, no hot water and cock roaches outside. other than that it’s a good spot
Great communication and very clean space. Easy access and a great walkable area with things to do would stay here again.
Tere was a great host!

Gina's place was so cozy and inviting. We felt right at home as we walked into the living room. I love her Mid Century pieces and nostalgic framed photos of classics cars and great art works. The kitchen was stocked up with all the amenities needed. Beds were so comfy! We loved having a washer and dryer at Gina's since we stayed two nights somewhere else (no washer/dryer) prior to staying at Gina's. Walking distance to many great shops, restaurants, breakfast cafes, and much more. About 17 mins into the city with a car. Lastly, the outside deck/patio was bonus to sit outside and enjoy the view of the Chicago skyline in a distance.
I highly recommend Gina's home!

Takeisa was an awesome hostess!  The place was roomy, clean & filled with everything you need!! I utilized the laundry room, too! The historical tidbits about the decor was interesting! We would stay again. In fact, it made for a great staycation for my son! We ubered everywhere, and felt very safe no matter what time it was. You wont regret this booking!
Everything was what we expected. The host was very communicative and the instructions on check in and parking were detailed and easy to follow.
Thank you Walid!! Very welcoming host and nice place to stay. Would love to return sometime soon, thank you!!!

Christina’s place was wonderful!
It was a beautiful place in a very lovely neighborhood.
Being an avid gardener I loved her outdoor space full of beautiful plants and flowers.

Will definitely stay here again. The apartment is lovely. Very clean and nicely decorated. Lots of space. Beds and furniture were comfortable. Kitchen was well stocked and the washer and dryer was an added bonus. Location is fantastic. So close to a great stretch of Southport Ave, but still private and quiet. You can hear the train go by the apartment, but we didn’t find it disruptive at all.
Great spot!
Super cute place and great location!

We really loved this location. It was easy to find, and instructions were easy to follow. It's located in a very safe and convenient part of Chicago for us. It's close to downtown, navy pier and Rate field. Plenty of restaurants and grocery store is a couple blocks away and a convenience store a block away. Nice and quiet. House itself was very clean and had pretty much anything you would need for your stay. One big plus was if you have a smaller vehicle it'll fit in the garage, and we just used Uber and Lyft around town. I would recommend this to anyone but especially families with kids. We were really trying to find a place that we'd be comfortable bringing our young children to and this place fit that need perfectly. It's a beautiful neighborhood and we felt comfortable walking around. Host was very communicative and we didn't have any issues at all. We loved it and made some life lasting memories!
This was perfect for our stay in Chicago! Lots of space to spread out, great walkable location. So welcoming for our bachelorette party!
We stayed at Susan‘s place for my son‘s wedding for the weekend.   The place was very clean and just as described with all the amenities.   Would definitely recommend it!
We loved the house and the neighborhood. There was so much to walk to. Thank you!!

I stayed in this adorable apartment for a long weekend while visiting some family. The location was just around the corner from my cousin’s home! Perfect location for that & also for restaurants, bars, a park down the street & coffee shops! It was close to everything including the brown line. The apt was as described & the hosts were very easy to communicate with. I would definitely stay here again in the future!

Although I booked very last minute (on the day of arrival), everything worked out without any issues. Connie responded within 10 minutes of my request.
I initially had a bit of trouble with the door because I wasn't familiar with the lock system, but Connie helped immediately. After that, I had no further issues.
The room is in a basement, which I was aware of in advance, but it was a very friendly and comfortable space with a private entrance and bathroom.
Overall, a very good stay.
Good experience

Wonderful space right in the heart of wrigleyville! Lovely hosts as well who welcomed us warmly.
We felt very comfortable, even with a larger group. The place had plenty of extras and supplies to help us feel at home.
This Airbnb was exactly what we hoped for even with our short stay in Chicago! They were great hosts!!
Manny was such a gracious host and the place was comfortable and lovely.
place was clean and spacious only issue we had was the stove was left turned on when we arrived and the place smelled. other than that host was very apologetic. 9.5/10

We loved our stay! It was the best airbnb we’ve ever stayed at!! John and Tracy could not have been any nicer or more accommodating! They even watched our son’s dog while a plumber came in to fix a hot water issue. They were on top of that and got someone in to fix it right away! The place was furnished beautifully and all seven of us, plus the dog felt right at home. They thought of everything we could possibly need. What an absolute pleasure to stay there!!! We’d loved to stay again! Five stars all the way.
Great place will stay again
Very nice place. Roomy and clean, in a pretty and chill neighborhood. Thanks Carla!
Great location. Spacious. Comfortable beds
Big fan, amazing place
Beautifully clean and comfortable spot.

Walkable to Lincoln Park, Wrigley Field, and to the L train. Lots of wonderful food there. I love the pizza place. The deep dish was great. The Mexican food on the corner was delish, and it has a cute little bar right there too—a great place to stay. Suppose you don't need a car.  Just take the local Transit, it's easy.

What a beautiful home!  This place was perfectly clean, private, and peaceful to land while in Chicago.  Erin has so many small touches that make it feel so comfortable and luxurious, and the space itself is just gorgeous.

This was a very spacious home, and even more beautiful than the photos could depict. The host was very thoughtful and prepared the home specifically for our stay, knowing about our family event. Each room had plenty of closet space. Everyone slept well. There were nice touches, like the filtered water pitcher, dishwasher, and the first aid kit. The only downside were the squeaky floors (common to all the hardwood floors in the neighborhood, based on our past experience around UChicago).
The stay was nice. The host communicates well & FAST.
Nice place, good location, decent price. If no one’s in the next room it’s perfect, but thin wall if they are

This was a great stay and a wonderful collection of art throughout the place. extremely clean and the ambiance was incredibly warm and cost. It never was the wrong temperature during the stay and the security system is a nice touch. I might buy that dor my house.  I will also add some of the architecture and decor ideas to my home when I get back. The host is very responsive and not overbearing. we enjoyed our stay and felt relaxed and at home when we were in the place.

Esmirna was a wonderful host.  Quick to respond. Had everything we needed there. And seems like a wonderful person.  ♥️  Thank you for hosting us and all the work you do running the kitty shelter nearby.  Such friendly furry greeters

Solid spot in a walkable area near Logan Square. Plenty of nearby cafes, bars, and restaurants. Nico and team were super responsive and answered our questions very quickly. I’d happily stay here again.

The home was perfect for our family of 5. We had everything we needed and the host was very thoughtful with notes and checking in on us.  We were a little concerned about the area before arrival but it was a very quiet street with no issues at all. It was a quick drive into the city and very convenient.

Our stay at Nancy’s place was lovely. The home had everything needed for a very comfortable stay. The neighborhood is full of families and felt extremely welcoming. There are restaurants and grocery stores within a couple of minutes of walking distance. Everything is conveniently located and accessible. There is also a train station that you can walk to and ride into the city. We had no problem finding free street parking near Nancy’s place. We look forward to staying here again when we vacation in Chicago!
We had a great stay!
Juanさんは丁寧で親切な人でした。室内もきれいにしており、快適に過ごせました。ありがとうございました。

This was a great spot in Lincoln Park! Loved that it was super walkable to restaurants, markets and the L train station. Worked out great for DePaul University’s graduation weekend. The apartment was nice and worked out well for our group of 10; however, more than that would have been a bit tight. The back gate area needs some work but the front porch was nice to have to sit outside. And we were not bothered at all by the L train noise.
Had a great stay at Brett’s place over the weekend. Walkable to fun restaurants and the metro in Logan Square. Would visit again!

I had a great stay at Melissa’s place. The instructions were very clear, it was really easy to find and to get in. It’s in a nice, quiet residential neighborhood with tons of restaurants, bars, and other businesses just a couple blocks away. It was centrally located for the places I needed to go, but it’s also easy to get the train to downtown. The apartment looked exactly as shown in the photos and it was extremely clean. There were a lot of nice touches that made it a very comfortable stay. I didn’t have any issues during my stay so there wasn’t a need for a ton of communication, but Melissa was responsive and friendly in the communication we did have.
Place was really nice and clean! I loved the graffiti wall on the outside of the apartment! Really cool would book again if I’m in the area.
We had a very nice stay. The location is great, and Iris was very responsive.
We loved our stay in Bucktown. I highly recommend this place, especially if you're looking for walkable adventures in Chicago. Would definitely stay here again.
Great stay! We had 6 people in our party and were able to fit everybody with two air mattresses in the living room.
Brendan and Sofia were great hosts! Very accommodating and easy check in. Spacious place as shown. Everything went as planned. Would recommend if you're looking to stay in the area.
Provided the perfect experience for me and my family. I will make this my first option next time i am looking to visit.
We had a wonderful stay. The home was clean, well maintained, and had everything we needed. The host was responsive and welcoming. Great location and overall a great experience — highly recommend!”

Karina is a great host. She always responded immediately to any questions I had about the rental. Her place is clean, well equipped, and is located within short distances to all kinds of eateries and coffee shops. We really enjoyed our stay and will definitely book Karina's Airbnb the next time we visit Chicago.

Place was great. Roomy. Street was quiet , very pretty.
Nice neighborhood .
Not cheap but you get what you pay for…
I would stay again when back in town

Alejandro and his wife were incredibly friendly and responsive to every question we had before and during our stay. We had a short stay of four days for a wedding so we did not experience a lot of activities in Chicago, but the neighborhood is very nice and coffee shop and restaurants are in walkable distance. The place was spotless and bad all toiletries and amenities needed, so we didn’t have to pack or purchase items. The back outside area is beautiful and a nice relaxing sitting deck and patio for the group. Thank you!!

We had a nice stay while we were in town for a graduation. The apartment was clean and easy to find. The location is a short walk to trains and busses. There is some noise from the bar on the ground floor, but that was fully disclosed up front and is mainly if people are waiting outside to get in (as they were for World Cup games while we were there).
A friendly host answering questions and helping with directions to various locations.
Great place to stay. Just like the pictures. Milan was really responsive. We were here for a baseball game and it was as a place location to stay

I had a great stay! The host was wonderful and very welcoming. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed to feel at home — including all the essentials and extras like towels, toiletries, and other thoughtful details. The location was also great and very convenient. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

The unit is smaller than it seems in the photos. It was difficult for us (in our late 60’s) to carry our suitcases up and down the stairs. The unit was very clean, but also no frills. Even one extra towel would have been appreciated. I washed dishes, but found no kitchen towel. It would be nice to have a chair with a back to sit on. The bed was very comfortable and I really appreciated the provided ear plugs. Since it was summer and we used the window air conditioner, I was not bothered at all by the train sound.
When we checked into the unit, there was no hot water. I tried several times to contact Jessica, but never received an answer. We had no hot water for 24 hours, which meant ice cold showers. The unit itself is fine, no frills, perfectly situated with conveniences a short walk away. My only major complaint is with the lack of communication when we faced a major inconvenience.
The space was the perfect size for groups. Perfect location and Magdalena is the ideal host. Thank you for having us.
Had a great time at Tippi’s! She was responsive to my needs and the room and facilities were pleasant and comfortable.
Good location, convenient parking and nice amenities in the unit!
We enjoyed the space and it worked well for what we needed.
Great stay! beautiful area in Chicago and everything was close by.
Sibani By Taim’s was a wonderful host team. We experienced great communication, hospitality, and support. We had all we needed to have a comfortable and memorable stay.
Gerry was extremely nice and responsive. I enjoyed our stay. I will definitely stay again. The neighborhood was great, there was park in walking distance. The place was very nice.

This apartment was the perfect blend of location and price! Everything was clean and comfortable. Naomi and the team were also very responsive when we had a lock issue and got it sorted out asap. The street we were on had plenty of parking too, which was a huge bonus. All five of us enjoyed our stay very much.
Lovely stay. The host is very thoughtful and helpful, the place is very clean, and the room was extremely comfortable.
Extremely comfortable and cozy loft where you can be walking distance to all of the major sights that Chicago has to offer!

This is a lovely studio apartment.  It is on a busy street but the noise level is surprisingly low.  Lots to do and great restaurants within an easy walk.  Close to the train.  Only inconvenience was the elevator was not working to get my luggage to the second floor, but in talking to a resident in the building it seemed to have just happened and there had been someone out to figure out what was wrong.
Great place!

My 2 college aged daughters and I stayed at Beth’s place for the last 3 nights and we had a great time! The neighborhood is very walkable and a great jumping off point for exploring the city. We highly recommend! Thanks for having us!

We really enjoyed our stay! Theodora’s place was spacious and comfortable for four people. The beds were comfortable and we really enjoyed the back deck. The location was perfect for what we had planned for the weekend. We would definitely stay here again.

I have stayed at Lynette and Efrain's rental several times now, and it never disappoints! The home is stunning, immaculately clean, and the hosts consistently go above and beyond with thoughtful extra touches. The location is incredibly convenient, offering easy parking and a short walk to restaurants, a grocery store, and a beautiful park. I highly recommend this property!
Great location in Lincoln Park on a beautiful street where you can walk to restaurants & the waterfront. Nice back deck!
Great location, in the middle of everything.
loved this place. i have family in chicago and will definitely stay here again. large space, well decorated, host has very clear directions and instructions.
Fun spot & location in the city

Lois and Eduardo's place was beautiful - inside and out. They made me feel very welcome and personalized what they offered for my specific needs, responding right away when I had specific questions. I especially loved the serene feel to the home- a wonderful place to start and end a busy day in the city.

Overall, the space was clean, and communication from the host was prompt and responsive throughout our stay.
That said, there were issues that impacted our experience. There was a lot of black mold and peeling paint in the bathroom, which was concerning. The AC was not user-controlled, making it difficult to adjust the temperature to a comfortable level. The check-in instructions also contained an incorrect gate code, which caused some confusion upon arrival.
There were a few functional issues as well. The shower head detached and crashed to the ground during use. The kitchen sink drained very slowly, and when we ran the dishwasher, water backed up into the sink and created an unpleasant odor. Additionally, there was noticeable noise from a dog(s) upstairs that could be heard throughout portions of our stay.
Overall a good experience despite the issues listed.
Great stat, responsive owner

Great location.
Great communication.
Secure.
We loved staying at AJ's place! It was very spacious and had lots of places to hang out. AJ is very communicative and was always ready to answer any questions we might have.
Great spot, really close to a lot of good restaurants and cafes. Very high end space. Will be checking for availability here whenever I visit Chicago.

Great location, right near Lincoln Avenue with lots of interesting shops. Very easy parking, which we appreciated, and the neighborhood is quiet. Nothing fancy about the house, but everything worked for our group of 4.

We had a wonderful time here and it's a perfect stay in the Lincoln Park/Old Town area! The space was spotless, beautifully maintained, and fully equipped with all the essentials. We could walk everywhere, and there were many good restaurants and entertainment options just steps from the front door.
Truly the perfect place for a couple. We’d stay here again in a heartbeat!
We had a great stay. Rida was very responsive and helpful!

We have stayed at Karina’s place three times already and we love it! The place is big and available amenities make the stay very comfortable. Karina is a very responsive host and the place is really a great deal for families to stay when visiting Chicago.

Loved!  Spacious condo literally 1/2 block from Wrigley Field and the red line!  Rooftop patio is outstanding. We liked hanging out there and enjoying the concerts at Wrigley. Very close to many bars and restaurants making it super convenient. Would recommend.  Of note, as the listing indicates, it is a third floor walk up unit. The steps are steep, so anyone with mobility issues should be aware. Major plus is the garage, which made parking super easy! Would rebook next time we visit.

Quirky place with fun video games to play. Decent location, easy walkability to Wicker Park and right by the 606. Matt was responsive and accommodating with our check in time. Only docking a star for the missing creature comforts— needed more than a singular drinking vessel (1 mug) and some additional shower towels (2) would have been nice. A few cutlery items could have also been nice as well as a plate or two. You’re definitely paying for an ‘experience’ rather than a luxury stay. Place was clean, quiet and unique.
Great host and a great place to stay for a few nights. Felt right at home. Loved how close this location is to public transport making it easy to get in and out of city.

This was a great stay, we were very happy with it. Perfect location, great views, easy to find, easy to check in, comfortable, as quiet as it gets in this part of the city. We could see the Navy Pier fireworks from the balcony.
There was a minor issue with a piece of furniture giving way and James came to fix it same day and even scheduled his visit for a time when we were going to be out anyway. Very friendly and responsive.
Excellent host . Thank you
Only great things to say!! Super clean, lovely decor, and nice/safe location. Would definitely book again. Host was super friendly and attentive.

Apartment was very clean and comfortable, easy check in, Rida was very proactive. Nice neighborhood but far from downtown. Parking is not easy to find and we ended up paying for parking about $120 for 5 days. Walkable and close to the “beach”. Beautiful sunsets and views to downtown. Apartment is in the 8th floor.

Marco was a fabulous host, accommodating, and very responsive. We arrived early, and he offered to hold our bags while the cleaners completed cleaning the unit, which was great! We had a few questions here and there, and Marco was quick to respond. The location is walkable and lovely, and I highly recommend!

Tim is very responsive and incredibly helpful. From the moment you enter the property, it feels like home .. thanks to its welcoming atmosphere and great vibe. The place is clean, comfortable and well maintained.
If I visit Chicago again, I would certainly reach out to Tim as he is a fantastic host. Highly recommended!

Stay 424 worked great for me. Loved the location - right off the blue line which I took directly from O’Hare. Close to Milwaukee which has any number of great shops and restaurants and cafes. Also just across the river from IO and Joes on weed st where I got my entertainment.
Bottom bunk with the privacy curtain is the way to go. They provided towels and at least during most my trip I was able to get a new towel when needed. I do wish they would have offered to change bedding as I stayed there over a week. Was able to shower everyday and only had to wait to use the bathroom one of the mornings. Great deal for the price and the location!

The 2 major things that wasn’t sitting right with me was the fact that it’s 2 cameras inside the home. And secondly when you walk into the house it feels uneasy, I wouldn’t be comfortable closing my eyes there.

We had a great stay! The location was excellent—easy walking distance to lots of restaurants, shops, and things to do. The apartment was a comfortable size for three adults and had plenty of space for us to relax. George was extremely helpful, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.
Great place, great location. Easy check in and clear instructions.
Mimi’s place was described perfectly

Ideal for exploring downtown Chicago
Clean, spacious apartment with great views.
Thank you

Ryan’s place was exactly as described. The room was spacious for 2 people and even though it was on the bottom floor, we never heard noise from any of the other rooms/guests. The bed was comfortable and the room had an AC so it felt cool during the hot Chicago summer. The restroom was down the hall and we never ran into issues with having to wait on other guests. The kitchen was clean and had a wonderful coffee bar.
Overall, it was a great stay and we would gladly come back in the future!
Everything was great!

This is a very nicely renovated modern studio, cozy and pleasant. The location is wonderful, nice cafe right downstairs, restaurants and good quality stores nearby. The washer and dryer were helpful. I did not hear street noise, however you do hear the upstairs neighbors much of the day (and night!). The noise, including late at night, together with no room darkening curtains, resulted in poor sleep quality. The host was great however, and agreed to a little early check in and later check out - which was very helpful!
Was within walking distance to restaurants and the beach as well as family we were visiting. It was also super easy to find street parking near the house.

Die Unterkunft sah aus wie auf den Bildern und hat uns sehr gefallen. Die räume waren groß und man hatte genug Platz. Es war eine ruhige Gegend.
Die Unterkunft hätte nur etwas sauberer sein können, die Flächen waren nicht abgestaubt. Zudem war zu wenig Besteck dar.

all was great. a sweet place. little so if you plan to be at the apartment alot not the best place bit if you want a cute, perfectly located, clean, has everything you need place to sleep and shower. this is your place. Hosts are awesome.  so responsive and helpful.

Very conveniently located. Easy to get in/out. Beautiful unit too, high ceilings, clean and well-maintained. The dining chairs could use an upgrade and add some more amenities (like paper towel holder in the kitchen), but no major concerns. Unit gets plenty of light. Will definitely come back!
Muy buen anfitrión. cordial y siempre pendiente de los huéspedes, muy recomendado.

Good, clean place with a great and responsive owner.  The Red Line and Green Line stations are close by, about 10 minutes walk.  Very good value for the money if you want a clean place and do not mind not being in the Loop.

Quiet neighborhood, friendly & responsive host, really appreciated the portable room AC unit especially with the summer heat.  Felt safe walking to the local park and to my sister's place 0.8 miles away.

Had a great stay here. The neighborhood was quaint, felt completely safe and it’s a super easy walk to the United Center. We also walked to Little Italy through the Illinois Medical District and UIC. Having the 2-car garage was a great perk and made parking safe and stress-free. The upstairs attic bedroom definitely runs a bit warmer than the main floor, so we had to crank down the AC before bed to get it cool enough up there; just something to note that people downstairs may be a bit cold to get upstairs cool. Overall, a great place with awesome amenities and an unbeatable location. Would definitely stay again.
Great place grocery store right around the corner very calm area
As advertised at a reasonable rate.  Thanks again!
I had a very pleasant time at Nala and Owen's place. Everything was as it was described and I'll be considering staying again!

I had a great stay at this property in Chicago. The location was excellent, the place was clean and secure, and it was very convenient to restaurants and local stores. Best of all, the lake was only about 7 to 10 minutes away, which made the area even better. It’s a wonderful neighborhood, the host was kind, and the property was exactly as represented.

We had some plumbing issues but Bella was able to send a cleaning crew the next day.
The stay was enjoyable and the place as expected. No complaints.

Alondra’s place was amazing. The perfect location, incredibly close to the train and the bus for public transit. The neighborhood is welcoming and walkable.
