The home itself is spotless, comfy, and cozy. It’s beautifully decorated, and has everything you need. The hosts were amazing, communicative, and accommodating. I highly recommend staying here. Perfect for solo travelers, friends, or couples who don’t mind two single beds. Just a great space and an over all great experience.

We stayed here for a girls’ weekend and overall had a great experience. Location is amazing for anything Wrigleyville! The free bagels from Steingold’s are a + and coffee is local and a nice touch!
The host was very responsive throughout our stay and quick to answer questions or address requests, which we appreciated.
The unit itself worked well for our needs. The bathroom and kitchen are recently updated and clean. Bedding was fresh and clean. The beds were comfortable, although they sit very low to the ground, which may be challenging for some guests.
Guests should be aware that this is an older building. The stairwell has a bit of a musty smell when you first enter, but a vintage property. There are also quite a few steep stairs to reach the apartment. Keep in mind with luggage. Parking not easy but passes can be obtained. Perhaps recommend blocks to park. (Hotel chocolate Southport)
Would be nice to have extra towels and linens accessible for 4+ guests. Comfortable overall!
We had a great time staying here! The hosts were responsive and the place was clean and comfortable. We felt safe every night and enjoyed coming back to our spot. We would definitely stay again!

It was very comfortable, super spacious & had a lot of individual spaces to unwind. Kitchen had everything needed to cook, and make all hour of the day meals. Tv was super nice size for binge watching shows.

Sentral Michigan Avenue was very poorly maintained. While the location and views were excellent, the apartment we stayed in showed noticeable signs of wear and a lack of upkeep. Maintenance issues, worn finishes, and cleanliness concerns detracted from the overall experience and did not meet expectations for a property at this price point.

We had a wonderful stay! The location was perfect, especially for being close to Wrigley Field, with great shops and restaurants nearby. The building itself is beautiful, and the space was thoughtfully kitted out with everything we needed. David's place was exceptionally clean and the beds were super comfortable, and the AC was very appreciated. Overall, it was clean, comfortable, well-located, and made for such an easy and enjoyable stay. We would happily stay here again!
Aaron is a great & communicative host who was proactive. Although the space needs some maintenance, it was also very low cost so you can’t complain too much. Thanks again for the stay!
The place was perfect for anything Wrigley Field related.
進到房子裡，有家的感覺，而且非常的乾淨溫馨，光線充足，可以看到屋主的用心，我們入住感到非常的愉快，是一次很棒的體驗。另外可以讓我們待到去機場的時間，這一點也非常的感謝。
Really cute place to stay. Super close to the brown line that connects to all the lines - 10 minutes or less walking distance.
Such a lovely place and great location. Super close to public transportation. Would highly recommend and would definitely stay here again!
Michelle responded fast, her space was clean,  and she provided great instructions how to travel in the city.
Great stay. Host was responsive and helpful!

Great place!  Very comfortable and very clean.  Excellent responsiveness from the host.  Location is great (even if you’re not going to Wrigley Field) — tons of great places to eat very close by.  Highly recommend and will stay again in the future.
This apartment was in a fantastic location and had all the amenities we needed! We will definitely try to book again the next time we are in town.
Perfect place and location. Would happily come back. Great location and close to lots of amenities. The bus stop near the location will take you straight to the beach.
Great place for our family!

This modern apartment was beyond clean and even larger than we expected. All the amenities were prestine and easy-to-use. The garage parking was very handy and helped us feel comfortable leaving the car while we used ride service to crowded sites downtown and walked to amazing bakeries and meals close by. The hosts' communications were super clear and timely. If we have a chance to get back to West Town, we'd love to stay again.

We had the pleasure of not only staying at, but also meeting Michael and learning about the work he put into this wonderful property.
What a gracious, host! Everything is as described and better. The location could not be more convenient if you are in town for an event at Wrigley.
There were several open spots available for parking when we arrived and just walked everywhere during our stay.
If you are used to a king sized bed, like we are, take advantage of the 2 bedrooms and sleep like a baby. IYKYK
And the provided white-noise machines really do help drown out the sound of the train.
I saved the best for last… the couch.

Beautiful place to stay! Everything was clean and neat when we arrived. The stove wouldn’t light but I didn’t end up using it. I wouldn’t recommend staying here with any toddlers because the door is a push to exit with no secure lock. Besides that, great host and a beautiful place.
Was a good location and room, my visitor felt comfortable.
Great host that responded quickly. Close to the train and bus stops.
As described in description!
Thanks!

The apartment itself was good: clean,spacious and as described.
Unfortunately,communication with the host was frustrating.Responses were extremely brief and unclear.I had difficulty getting straightforward answers to simple questions.Despite repeatedly asking about CHECK-IN details,there seemed to be confusion regarding my reservation and payment status, even though the booking had already been confirmed and paid for thru the platform.

beautiful, cozy spot in a charming neighborhood. lots to do in the area, walkable and accessible. near trains and buses. great little spot!

Outstanding stay, would absolutely come again.

Shomari was great with communication, we were not able to stay at Shomari’s place due to unforeseen circumstances. There was a really bad storm that ended up knocking out the power. Everything was as described. Ryan was proactive with communicating before my stay, during, and before my checkout. enjoyed the space and would recommend.  I would rent from him again.
It was an amazing place I felt the care you put into your place.., and if available we will be booking it every year.   A host with the most! ❤️❤️❤️. Thank you for caring about your guests 💖

Good area and free parking did not have trouble with finding a spot. Very clean and the decor is like the pictures and beautiful. They also have a full body mirror that’s not in the pictures, which is a plus.

Place was fairly nice and in good location, but was bare bones STR and best for just sleeping. This is a beautiful apartment - great finishes, well equipped, wonderfully large windows for much daylight, easy to access - a very comfortable place to stay. Parking garage is close if you don’t find street parking. Felt right at home and would definitely stay here again. Alma is very attentive and helpful. Communication was always quick and friendly.
I enjoyed my stay! Great location for activities in the city.

My family felt right at home throughout our stay. We had plenty of space for the 6 of us. Hayk was a responsive, friendly host. The L was on the next block over so while you can here the train, it was white noise. We were able to find parking on the street each night - be sure you’re comfortable with parallel parking and cars larger than a minivan may have a problem finding a spot. beautiful apartment! easy to check in and plenty of space for our group. highly recommend!
Clean place and great location. Easy check in and host was a great communicator.
Otoniel is very friendly and has a great home with character.

Our prayer group really enjoyed our stay.  It was very clean, neat and spacious.  Sherry was very responsive to any questions.  The location was optimal for the event we attended and easy to access.  Thank you for providing a peaceful and very accommodating space.

My friends and I had a nice stay at Denise’s place. The home was clean, and the photos were an accurate reflection of the property. Denise was responsive and always available to answer any questions we had, which made the experience smooth and enjoyable.
The location was perfect—centrally located near plenty of shops and restaurants, with downtown just a short drive away.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated Denise’s hospitality.

Ishin’s place was much smaller than expected and to me, not worth the money that I would be paying for staying there. Overall, I wouldn’t book this place again. However, Ishin was very responsive and quickly replied, despite our differences.

We were a family of four! We really enjoyed our stay. It was close to the beach, train, restaurants and was very safe and on a quiet street. My daughter and niece loved the upstairs play area and loved the unit. It was a memorable trip and next time we’re in Chicago we will return back. I found the unit better in person than the pictures. It was very comfortable with washer and dryer and a working dishwasher. I felt right at home. I would suggest for the owner to have a  broom for families traveling with young children who tend to drop food on the ground!
Great location with easy train, El or bus transportation to all the major sites! Comfortable beds. Beautiful views. Fun historical building with access to everything.

Great place to stay at a great price! Everything is exactly as described and pictures matched what you’ll be expecting! There will be a lot of noise in the morning, which I expected since this was in the listing and was also communicated to me prior to booking. It was a lot louder than what I thought it’d be. It started as early as 5:30am, but for sure footsteps and chair noises will start around 6ish. If you’re a light sleeper, I would suggest ear plugs otherwise this is really a great place to stay.
Storm came through the area right before I got there and was told it caused the lights to not work walking down the stairs to the entrance. Was told it was going to be fixed the next day but it never got fixed the 3 nights I was there. Be prepared to pull out your phone to use the flashlight in case it’s still not fixed.
PLENTY of parking spaces right in front of the entrance, very convenient.

Very close to the park, walkable neighbourhood, lots of stores around the building, this is a great place to enjoy Chicago.

Wow! We are so grateful to have found your curated home. As Airbnb owners ourselves we were delighted to find a place that demonstrated the same level of care and detail that we sought to establish. We'll look forward to returning and getting to know the area more! Definitely 5 Stars!

Roberto’s place is an an excellent location. We felt safe, it was close to everything we needed and had easy street parking. Unfortunately, there was noticeable water damage that looked like it had been there for some time and it was not taken care of. There was water damage evidence in the dining room ceiling from a leak with visible staining and wall was bubbling as well. If we had been told about the water damage, we would have looked for a different place because we were traveling with our children and were uneasy about potential mold due to musty smell. Everything else was perfect but really wish we knew about this in advance, or that it was remediated before our arrival. We arrived late at night and had a very busy schedule so we could not switch last minute. We tried to be out as much as possible due to this issue. Repair was too extensive to be fixed during our short stay so we did not speak to host about it. Otherwise the place is spacious and easy check-in and out.
Thanks! Great location and clean and up to date and good place.
What a great place! Lovely little home walkable to so many great things and public transport. Charming and comfortable. We'd absolutely book again!

Easy to find with clear instructions provided. Room and bathroom was clean and as described. 6-8mins walk to the green line which connects to the orange line for easy access to the midway airport. Shared space was clean and tidy. Did not feel unsafe during my stay.

Matt’s place was truly awesome - it exceeded our expectations! Four of us stayed here for 2 nights while in town for a concert, and we felt comfortable, safe, and welcome. We’d absolutely recommend this place and would stay here again the next time we’re in town.
Communicated very well.  Felt very secure with the electronic key entry and  background check.  It was very quiet.  Nice view out of the living room window.

Bella’s place was perfect for our week in Chicago. Great location in Wicker Park, we were able to walk to Target, restaurants, bars and the L within a couple minutes. King bed was a rare find as well. Would definitely stay again next time in Chicago.

Overall, we were very satisfied with our stay. The host was especially responsive and helpful, which we really appreciated. There were a couple of issues with the shower fixture and the internet connection, but the host addressed them promptly and resolved them right away. Great communication and support throughout our stay.

Our stay at Reed’s place was perfect! We were in town for a concert at Wrigley and the location was perfect. Quick walk to Wrigley in a quiet neighborhood. Great place, will definitely go back.  Safe and easy. Parking is free and right out front

Great place to stay!

Buena ubicación, cerca a la estación de metro y cerca al down town, vecindario tranquilo y seguro.

Easy to access, good communication.  Fine apartment to use as a launching off pad for seeing other parts of the city.  Common areas of building and surrounding block are a bit dingy.  Noise from restaurant is not a problem.

great place & near everything, Max made sure I was taken care of and fast communication. I see myself staying again.

Great location close to Wrigley Field, bus and train stations and so many places to visit!

Cute, quaint & cozy. Decent location within 20mins of Chicago. So much to do. Thanks again Leslie!

Great place!! Phenomenal Hosts!! Beyond helpful and flexible with our needs due to the weather and ever changing travel plans. Apartment was nice, clean and comfy. Will definitely be on the top of my list for my next stay in Chicago.

I had a great stay at Aaron's Airbnb. I was able to work remotely, find close parking each night, and felt safe. Aaron provided great instructions and was responsive. The Airbnb was clean and decorated nicely. As some have mentioned, the AC unit was loud at night-I am a light sleeper and had to turn it off at night. The amenities and concierge were a plus. Would stay here again!
Very nice place to stay near Downtown Chicago.
Great location to Wrigley.  The place was. just as described and felt very cozy.

I loved my stay, and I would truly recommend this place to anyone. It felt like home away from home. They took time to ensure that the space gave renters the feel they really needed. I truly recommend this without reservation to anyone who wants to live in a place where they want value for their money, and a vacation worth enjoying.

good

Verry nice place I really like at with my family it’s clean house like brand new the beds are very comfortable I recommend to everyone it’s worth and the price are so good I recommend everyone if I wil bi back in town I will like to stay again

We had a wonderful visit to Chicago with Elizabeth as our host. Everything you can ask for is available at The Bittle House. Free parking, beautiful walkable streets, close by restaurants and shops, and the L train station is within walking distance.

We had a great stay at Anastasia’s place! It was clean and had just what we needed. The area around felt very safe and quiet and very walkable. Easy to get to public transportation and the parking was fantastic to have. We would definitely stay here again.
Had a nice stay with no issues
Great apartment in a great neighborhood. Thanks for a good visit!
Great spot to visit her daughter at college, which was just down the street. Easy to get in and out whether walking or driving. Easy street parking available.
The Auroom  team was very responsive and helpful!
The place was nice and clean , Jeff was really sweet and communicative, I really enjoyed my stay it was comfortable as well
Great Place, the view was great to hangout. The common outdoor patio was not exactly as mentioned. but otherwise Milan was very helpful, quick communication and overall a great experience
We had a great couple of nights here. Great location and had everything we needed!

A great stay and a wonderful host! The space is beautifully designed and very comfortable. It's full of thoughtful IOT touches, and I especially loved the art and creative areas throughout. We felt right at home and were comfortable the entire time. Highly recommend!
Awesome place
The place was very adorable. It was cozy and quaint but it wasn’t for bigger people but I absolutely loved it otherwise.

Adorable comfy and convenient! So thoughtfully laid out and the park across the street was such a huge perk for me and my pup! Old building so noise from the upstairs neighbor was unfortunate but expected, and while I appreciated the thoroughly clean apartment- it smelled so strongly of harsh chemicals when we got in. Finally, during the heatwave, the lack of air conditioning or a fan was tough! All in all, though, it worked for what I needed!

Great location in West Town. Really nice options all within walking distance. Super clean and quiet with fantastic air-conditioning. Only semi-negative is that you aren't really within walking distance of the train, but there are busses. Fantastic stay.

The space itself was clean, but as other reviews mentioned, it's very loud. Trains run until midnight and start back up at 5:00 AM — and a rooster crows around 4:45, so you'll have plenty of warning before the trains begin. We believe the listing mentions a working central air conditioner but it wasn't functioning during our stay. The only cooling options were a small window AC unit in one bedroom and a small ceiling fan in the living room, which made the space pretty uncomfortable during the hot months. We'd also recommend not walking alone at night or in the early morning hours in this area.

My home was going under renovations  and Jeff’s place was so close to my work which was perfect. The pictures were accurate, place was clean and comfortable. We got to play a few board games which was nice. There was also a filtered water pitcher in the fridge which was a plus! Only downside was the hot water would cut in and out a couple of times.

This was such a great place to stay: beautiful tree lined street with a lot of fun things to do in the neighborhood and the apartment had everything we needed! I was traveling with my dog and she loved it too.

We stayed at Mike’s apartment for a week and a half while I was in town for work, and we absolutely loved our stay. We would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
The location is fantastic. The Blue Line is less than a 10-minute walk away, making it easy to get both downtown and to the airport. Street parking was also easy to find. The neighborhood felt very safe, quiet, and relaxed.
Mike was an amazing host. He was incredibly friendly, made us feel welcome from the start, and was always happy to help. He also shared some great recommendations for restaurants and things to do nearby, which we really appreciated.
This was honestly one of the best Airbnb experiences we’ve had, and we would happily stay here again. Thanks so much, Mike! 😊
Nicholas was very responsive, the unit was clean and tidy.

I was in Chicago for a job interview process. I was looking for a convenient and affordable place to stay since I would be in the area and mostly working/interviewing. The place matched the description, was accessible, and the host very responsive and communicative.

Central location and felt safe walking around. It is called paper box and that is very fitting as you can hear every conversation through the floor above. But hosts are responsive and just bring earplugs.
Great cozy place and peaceful neighborhood. Would book again!

We had a great stay at Nicole and Matt's.  The location is very good, near restaurants and shops. We used the CTA which is very convenient to go downtown and having a parking spot is a real advantage. The apartment is very comfortable. The terraces are great to enjoy outside and the view from the rooftop is beautiful.
A perfect 5-star stay! The home was clean, beautifully decorated, and exactly like the photos. The hosts made everything incredibly easy from start to finish. Would definitely stay here again!

Amazing neighborhood, close to shops and bus stops. Easy to get into the building but there are a few flights of stairs, so be aware if you’re traveling with suitcases. Traveled solo and felt super safe. A few small things (low water pressure, broken bathroom window, no full size mirror) but nothing that made me want to reconsider my stay. Would likely stay here again.
Great location and stay!
Great location. Easy check-in. Comfortable space. There was some ongoing construction which would have been nice to know about but overall the place suited our needs well.

The location was excellent! My grown daughter lives in the area with her roommates and we could easily walk between locations to hang out, watch a movie or meet up for meals. The apartment was clean, beds were comfortable, and it had what we needed. I’ve already looked to see if it was available for a future stay!

Would absolutely stay here again. The place was lovely and even more spacious than expected. Walkable to transit, local restaurants, and coffee shops. Despite being near a busy area in Wrigleyville, the apartment was quiet most of the time. Quite enjoyed my time at Aaron’s place. Highly recommend to others looking to get out of the busyness of the city.
Great location! Great price - super comfy bed in a pitch black room.
Excellent stay, very clean and comfortable!
Friendly host with an amazing home! Would definitely stay here again. Had tons of recommendations for those who are visiting Chicago for the first time!

We stayed here for a week around our daughter's graduation from the University of Chicago . The apartment was perfectly located and well within walking distance to the campus. The restaurants and amenities of Hyde Park were also an easy walk. It is a great location for visiting the The Obama Presidential Center too - about a 30 min walk or a very short car ride.. Downtown Chicago a 25min train/car ride away. Patrice and Courtney were very communicative and responded to our questions in a timely manner. The one time we needed very time sensitive help, on check out, the response was immediate. The apartment was easy to find if you read the instructions carefully. It is huge, clean, well equipped, and very comfortable. All appliances were in working order as were the A/C and fans. The building is old but charming. We would not hesitate to stay there again.
Tasha's place was great, I have no complaints.

This was a last minute find for us and we are so happy we got to stay here. The area is quiet at night and in the day time there are plenty of coffee shops and restaurants. The area is walkable and only a 15-20 minute drive from downtown. We had no issues during our stay, our host was responsive and gave clear/easy  instructions for check in and check out. We would stay here again.
Nice place, nice host, totally recommend
5* Airbnb, clean, safe and quiet location, great host communication, thanks for a great stay!!

This is a great place for a family with young kids that felt safe, is walkable to Greektown, and conveniently located near the blue line for public transportation.  The townhouse inside was very clean and had good air conditioning to help us escape from heat and humidity.  The hosts were responsive and professional to deal with.  Overall, this was a pleasant find and one we would recommend to anyone seeking city living just outside of the main hustle and bustle of the touristy parts of downtown.

This was a great stay, super close to DePaul , a lot of restaurants and stores close by to get things. The neighborhood was quiet, the beds were very comfortable, and Asel was so very accommodating and responsive with any questions. The apartment was VERY clean. I would stay here again for sure. Great pick for our time in Chicago!

Dan's place was perfect for our visit to Chicago. The apartment is well furnished and had everything we needed for our stay. The location is great, short walk to transit and lots of great restaurants and shops. Host was very communicative and check in was easy. Highly recommended!
Tuvimos una excelente estadía, las instrucciones fueron claras y el barrio muy tranquilo
We have stayed at Eric’s home several times.  Eric welcomed us as old friends.  We look forward to staying there again the next time we are in Chicago.
House was phenomenal
We enjoyed our stay and the host was very responsive and on top of things!

I had a wonderful stay here at Minty Fresh while solo traveling for work. The interior is beautiful with great lighting, a huge bed and a balcony. It was easy to travel with the L next door. Using the coworking space Metropolitian Club was a unique experience. The hosts were quick to address any questions to make this experience as smooth as possible. Would definitely recommend

PROS: Brett was incredibly responsive, friendly, and helpful every time we reached out. The complex is fantastic... great views and modern amenities including a pool, hot tub, gym, outdoor spaces, dog run, parking, and concierge/doorman. The neighborhood is excellent and very walkable within Fulton Market/West Loop. The apartment was new and clean enough.
CONS: The NOISE. The listing failed to mention (though it's been added now) that you're directly above the L train, which passes every few minutes. We were here for work and it was extremely disruptive. My business partner struggled to sleep every night. This should have been communicated upfront. The harsh cleaning chemicals and artificial scents were also overwhelming and gave us frequent headaches. The apartment could be touched up as well. There were a lot of scuffs and dings. At $5,220.08 for 4 nights, it felt steep all things considered.

We had a great stay at The Rectory!  The place oozes character, is walkable to some great restaurants, and is a few blocks from the train. Street parking was super easy to find within a block or so of the place, and it was surprisingly quiet given its proximity to lively places.  Would stay again - this was everything I hope for in an Airbnb.
Nous avons passé un beau séjour entre collègues pour un événement en ville. Tous avaient leur espace, c’était parfait. Le logement est fidèle aux photos et aux descriptions. Merci Anny!

Wow, what a gem in North Chicago! Not one detail was left out when they designed this apartment. From the fancy toilets with a bidet, the awesome showers, top notch appliances and comfy beds, everything was amazing. Brian was an awesome host and so responsive!! If we ever come back we’ll stay here again!

This location was such a beautiful apartment, that it made my girlfriend and I reconsider living in Philadelphia. Great central air, very clean inside. The beds were so comfy, and we truly melted right into them after our very late night flight (2 am). The apartment is located in a high rise, with someone working the desk at all time so there should be no problem picking up the keys to the apartment. Next to the apartment is the subway, so you do not need a car. However, there is parking on the street behind the apartment that is complimentary. A bit of a pain to walk to and from since it's not connected to the building but you can't complain about free parking garage parking. Overall, I would stay here again during my next visit to Chicago.
The location was great and street parking was easy. My family had a great time in Chicago
Overall good stay. Convenient location close to campus. The bed and furniture was fairly cheap and the floor could’ve used a good cleaning. But good value for the price.

worth the price.
bathroom walls were noticeably dirty. The mattress was STIFF. If you are a side sleeper, you won't be here.
no major complaints.

I was in Chicago for a couple of nights for work and hotel options were limited in the area. Demitri's place was exactly what I needed and he was an excellent host with great communication. The apartment was clean and comfortable. I would definitely plan to stay here again!
Great location, great place. Communication was 10/10. Would definitely stay again
We loved staying in Alex’s place! The stoop is great for waiting and people watching. The house was what we needed for our business trip!
Nice spot

Wonderful, beautiful home. One of the best Airbnbs I’ve stayed in to date. Quiet yet lively neighborhood with plenty to do. We loved our stay and Mickey was very helpful and accommodating. 10/10 :)
Great stay at a beautiful home with wonderful hosts.
Very clean and responsive host!

The property and location were incredible. Definitely worth the money for this spot. The car port is probably the most helpful and incredible thing known to man in Chicago. The people around were friendly and we felt self and secure our entire stay. Overall this was an incredible stay and we felt very welcomed and taken care of!
Had a wonderful stay here while we were moving our son from Michigan to Chicago. It’s very accessible. Charming older home. Only downside was no laundry.  We’d definitely recommend!

Here’s a concise Airbnb review:
Great stay! The location was perfect—walkable to everything and in a safe, authentic neighborhood that made it easy to explore Chicago — both including and beyond the typical tourist spots.
Check-in was seamless, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay.
The apartment had lots of thoughtful touches that made it feel like home, from the coffee bar to the TV guest mode. The kitchen and living area were also spacious and comfortable, with plenty of room to relax. Would definitely stay here again.
The place was so nice, and honestly the little game machine was the best part. Idc I was up till 4am playing monopoly with my friends!

Richard was a excellent host! It was our 1st AirB&B stay and it was GREAT! So close to the train we walked down there daily to go into the city. House was cozy and very comfortable. He made sure we had everything we needed and then some. I hope we can visit again. Thanks again Richard!

I had a pleasant stay here while in town for an even at UChicago. It was easy to walk to campus from here, and it’s also within short walking distance of restaurants and the lake. The place was comfortable and good value.
Everything was perfect but the only thing that could be troubling for travelers is the lack of parking in the area!

I thought I knew the city of Chicago but now I’m familiar with Lakeshore East Aqua building . The area is beautiful& the views incredible. The staff at the Aqua were incredible . If you’re looking for an incredible stay look no further Drew was a fabulous host . Thank you so much , I will definitely stay here again

Frederick's place has been one of the nicest Airbnb's I have stayed at as I travel every month for a week at a time. The condo looked exactly like the pics. It smelled great, had free parking out front, was on a quiet street and could not hear the neighbors above.  Although I did not cook, there were plenty of seasonings (beyond salt and pepper) if you want to throw down. Frederick was responsive. I would 1,000% book here again.
we had a wonderful stay perfect location to visit both ballparks!

I had a fantastic stay at 747. It felt a lot like my own apartment back home. It was clean and stocked with everything I might need. It was a very utilitarian and accessible space for my time in Chicago and it was steps away from the blue line as well as some great coffee spots. Thanks to my location getting around was easy and didn't cost a lot. I definitely want to book this place again on my stay in Chicago.

This place is our new place to stay!
Alma was a great host from booking to checkout. My daughter and I felt so comfortable, and safe. Definitely can't wait till our next adventure.

Wicker park location in chi town was great! Very walkable neighborhood, ease location to get back n forth from. Neighborhood was very peaceful, lots of family homes. Uber to grant park/ museum only 15 min ride. About 25 min away from airport.
Home was just as listed. Beautiful place, clean, lots of amenities. Home theater room was a nice touch. The space is 4 floors…… lots of room for larger groups. 2 rooftop areas also a bonus. House has 2 car garage, however bc it’s in the inner city be aware that any vehicle other than a small car will be incredibly difficult to get in the very tiny alley road where it is located. Very easy check in/ out instructions. Owners very responsive. Beds comfortable, clean towels n linens. Fully equipped kitchen. All bathrooms very nice. Would gladly stay again!!
Side note: the top floor in summer months stays very warm….temp control on 2nd floor. Most likely due to ventilation, which is at no control of owners.

The unit was clean and Jorge was very responsive and helpful, but we unfortunately had issue and after issue. The entire apartment complex smelled pretty terrible, including the unit. There was no A/C when we arrived (my fault for not noticing that on the listing), however it was supposed to be delivered the day of our arrival and was not until later the next day. This doesn’t seem like a big deal except that it was over 95 degrees out and crazy humid that we could not comfortably stay in the unit. There was also no fan to use and we ended up purchasing our own. When the A/C was finally delivered only one window unit was approved so the bedrooms didn’t cool down and stayed super hot. Then, maintenance came to spray for bedbugs while we were there which was concerning and while there we had them look at the bathroom vent which was also not working. Turns out it was blowing hot air into the unit. Lastly, we had no hot water in the evenings for showers. Not a great experience.
Great space on what might be the best street in Chicago. Pawan was an incredible host. Very accommodating and communicative. Will stay here again.

This place felt private and the neighborhood was friendly. Very close to the Chinatown activities we wanted to explore! We had a car with us and didn’t have any trouble with parking.
You won’t be able to control the thermostat from this unit, so if you’re traveling in summer and the AC makes you cold like me, you’ll want to grab an extra blanket or warmer pjs. I was a little worried at first about how the basement would fare in rainy weather, but it rained on us, and we had no problems at all!!

extremely clean and affordable. however did not realize my room would be in a basement level, was extremely cold and the blanket was extremely thin, I was able to turn up the thermostat for my second night but I had already caught a chest cold. parking very difficult in evening (to be expected in chicago perhaps), multiple stairs up and then down with my luggage. good deal if you are durable, I had to leave a night early.
Great house in a great location.
The apartment is super cozy, private, and more spacious than the photos do justice. We loved the private balcony and easy access to bars, restaurants, and public transit.

Overall, I had a decent stay. The unit was very clean, the kitchen was well-equipped and convenient to use, and the hosts were friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout my visit.
There were a few drawbacks that affected my experience. The location is very close to the train tracks, so the area can be quite noisy, especially at night. There was also a noticeable odor in the hallway leading to the unit. Inside the apartment, some of the lights flickered on and off, and the bedroom lighting was fairly dim. Additionally, the air conditioning could have worked better, as it was difficult to keep the space as cool as I would have liked.
Overall, the property has several positive qualities, particularly the cleanliness and hospitality of the hosts, but a few improvements could make the stay much more comfortable.
Loved the home and will be back.

David’s apartment in the Fulton Market District is very close to great restaurants and shopping. The El stop is less than a block from the apartment, so you can get anywhere. The apartment was super clean, and David was very responsive and helpful - great stay!

Our stay was very comfortable, enjoyable, and easy all around! Omar was very responsive and proactive with the instructions to enter the building and studio. Location couldn’t be better! The beds were very comfortable, bathrooms were remodeled and clean, and we had no issues during our stay. I recommend this space for anyone looking for a comfortable, homelike stay in Chicago.
We were delighted with our stay in these apartments! Everything was very neat and cozy. We are left with nothing but pleasant memories and a desire to return.

What a great place. Easily walkable to downtown and surrounding areas.
Wish we were there longer!

We had a wonderful stay at this downtown property. The location is fantastic—convenient to public transit and within easy walking distance of The Art Institute and other Lake Michigan attractions. The building itself is very quiet, and we didn’t hear any noise from our neighbors. We also enjoyed the shared amenities, especially the rooftop patio and the first-floor game room.
The layout features four bedrooms:
Master and Second Bedroom: Share a bathroom located in the hallway. The hosts also kindly provided a pack-and-play for us.
Third and Fourth Bedrooms: Both have private bathrooms, though please note these rooms use partition walls that do not extend all the way to the ceiling.
The entire place was spotless upon arrival. The kitchen was well-stocked with plenty of dishes, cookware, and silverware. Checkout requirements were reasonable: we were only asked to take out the trash and start the dishwasher. Highly recommended!

We really enjoyed this Airbnb most definitely on my next trip to Chicago. I will be renting again very clean very spacious. The only thing was the stairs, but that’s normal. At least we get our workout in. Thank you jay
We plan to book again when in Chicago!
We had a great stay at Freddy’s place. Very walkable and easy to access local public transportation. Would highly recommend!

This was a wonderful stay! Brendan was super responsive, even when one of the door locks became stuck due to the humidity, late at night. I felt reassured that we'd be taken care of the whole time. The place was super clean, we were able to find street parking easily, and it was a short commute to bus stops and rail stations. Thanks again, Brendan!

We had the most incredible time staying at Song’s place. Me and 5 other students stayed for our first visit to NeoCon and the place couldn’t have been more convenient. The host was responsive and accommodating to all of our needs. If you’re needing to stay in the area, I would definitely recommend Song’s place.
Bethany Lynne was very communicative and nice! The place was very cute and exactly what we needed.
The studio apartment was larger than expected and very clean. I felt safe as the locks were secure and there was a doorman. It is conveniently located as well.
I would definitely stay here again! Loved it!!

GuruNischan was a great host. She provided a great orientation at the beginning of my stay. She was also very approachable and social during my stay. She provided good recommendations for restaurants and tourist attractions in the area. The room was comfortable for my needs as a solo traveler. The neighborhood is safe and walkable. Buses and trains make access to all of Chicago very easy. There are also restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance of her home. I would be happy to stay again on my next trip to Chicago.
Great spot, perfect for McCormick events. Nice view of lake and city.
great value
Great place and neighborhood. Very walkable. Right next to the El train so easy to get everywhere.
Such a great place to stay. Loved the area, so many things to walk to, Frank was very helpful & responded quickly! Highly recommend!

Si bien el alojamiento es en un sótano, tiene todo lo básico para pasar pocas noches (yo estuve 5 y el problema es que es solo tiene microondas y heladera y no podés cocinar)
La ubicación es todo en este alojamiento. Buen transporte público cerca y si te gusta caminar el barrio es hermoso y en 40 minutos estás en las principales puntos de la ciudad.
La atención del anfitrión fue increíble! hasta nos ayudaron con una valija que nos perdió la aerolínea y estuvieron dispuestos a recibirla para que nosotros no nos perdieramos de nada.
Perfect and affordable spot for a quick trip! This spot could work for a solo traveler or a couple who will be spending most of their time checking out the city. Would stay again!

The community is beautiful and the room itself is clean and very cozy. The only thing might deserve the attention is that the room is right next to the road, so there might be some noise at night. But overall a perfect place to stay!
Nice clean place to chill at after enjoying the city.
Great location and kind host!

I really appreciate Jill’s apartment, her hospitality and the area. I saw Jill once, as well as her neighbor, they were both friendly and respectful of my privacy. I ate at a variety of local eateries that were all great. The neighborhood has many tree-lined streets (great for walking and running). The access to mass-transit makes this a great choice if you need to be traveling frequently to downtown (which I did easily each day) and to the airport (with a small walk to the bus, then Blue-line train).

We loved our stay. The home is beautiful and we really loved the neighborhood. Heathers home was also so wonderfully setup for our kids. They had so many things that helped us not have to worry about them being comfortable. The bedding was so luxe and the pillows made me feel like I was right at home.

La description du logement et les instructions étaient justes.
Le plancher était encore humide à mon arrivée et on sentait que ça venait d’être nettoyé. Ping a été très rapide dans les réponses.

We stayed for a week but could have stayed for a month! What a lovely apartment; clean, equipped with everything we could need after a long flight, comfortable beds and a friendly, responsive host. A well deserved five stars.

Excellent stay if you want to experience a neighborhood but be close to transit to get around town. Space is clean, bright and had everything we needed for 5 days in Chicago as tourists. The hosts were super helpful and had great recommendations for the neighborhood. Would happily stay here again!
Place was perfect, parking was easy, so clean will be back
Great day would stay again

Great place! The Lincoln Park area was very nice and easy to get around. The 3 bedroom home was great for my friends and I to get to stay together during our first trip to Chicago. Only negative is that the train runs right behind the home and was a little loud in the bedroom closest to the back of the house. But we moved to the middle room and turned on the fan for noise and it wasn’t as bad. I would recommend bringing a sound machine if you’re a light sleeper. Otherwise, our stay was great!

Beautiful inside and out. It felt like home... super comfortable, spacious, clean and convenient. parking can be tough, but I honestly think that's my only complaint, and it's a minor one. I was able to find a spot 2 of the days nearly right in front of the apartment.
The hosts are awesome, and great communication. We'll be back for sure.
A super comfortable and beautiful airbnb complex for both my boyfriend and I. We stayed for 2 nights and enjoyed every second of it. Their beds felt like clouds it was super comfortable! 10/10!
Great space to relax and unwind after a long day in the city.

We found the location to be perfect with excellent proximity to the Zoo and surrounding Lincoln Parks. The trip to the Museum Campus area is a quick drive up Lake Shore Drive and the ease of getting in and out of the Lincoln Park area was great.
The house itself was well appointed with plenty of space for us as visitors.
We look forward to staying again sometime soon!

This place was amazing! Me and my husband, stayed for two nights. it is exactly as it is described. We had an amazing time. Everything was very clean. I forgot soap for the shower and thank goodness it was supplied as well. We will definitely be back when we visit again.
Had an amazing time at Sarah and Thomas’ place! Wicker park is so fun and it was close to a lot of fun things. A wonderful homebase to a great time in Chicago!
We had stayed at David’s place before and returning was nice. It’s a quaint place with a lot of charm and walkable to Fulton Market with a park across the street.
Great little place in Bucktown with lots of places to eat and drink close by with the blue line into the city only 10 mins away
Spent a girls trip in Chicago and really enjoyed staying here. Everything looks exactly like the pictures!! The neighborhood is peaceful and ideal.

This was a great location walking distance to the lake which is a plus.  The host was very responsive and the place was clean and nicely decorated.  The only downside is the construction across the parking lot- there is an outside odor.   Outside of that- great place to stay!
Location is great. Can get anywhere around town relatively quickly. The rooftop is worth checking out if the weather complies during your stay!

I had a wonderful stay at Valeriy’s place. Everything was clean, well-maintained, and thoughtfully prepared for guests. Valeriy was responsive, helpful, and made the entire experience seamless. I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago .
Worth what I paid for.

The door to get into our room was also very challenging and always took a few minutes to open. We actually had to have another guest help us open it once, because it was taking so long. Iris did offer a small refund to us, but honestly we were still a bit disappointed with the overall state of the Airbnb.
Great home, great host!

The unit that we stayed in was very comfortable, it had 4 large bedrooms - all of which were very well equipped. The kitchen was very well equipped and the unit has a balcony that you can step out on to and spend time outdoors when you like.   The bathrooms were stocked with the essential toiletries.   The unit is located on the 3rd floor and when you enter into the building, it smells and you have to go up a dark staircase.  There were no lights in the entryway or 1st floor.   There is no street parking on the street the unit is on, it's all permit parking.  The description on the listing mentioned "on premises parking" but when I contacted the host, he mentioned to find street parking in his initial communication.  When I mentioned the listing, only then did he mention there was a spot behind the building in the alley.  I had already paid for parking by then.
Un excelente precio por lo que se ofrece. Gran anfitrión, muy recomendable

Excellent Chicago neighborhood location.  Bunch of restaurants within walking distance.  Great place to stay for a family.

Our group enjoyed this space, it worked well for our stay in Chicago. The condo was clean, well maintained, and beds were comfortable. Only minor issue was water pressure upstairs wasn’t super great but we could make it work without too much issue. Hosts were always very, very responsive to any questions or concerns that came up and the communication was fantastic throughout. We enjoyed our visit to Chicago and would highly recommend this as a great place to stay for a big group. Convenient location, not too far from the city.

We had an awesome stay at Michaels place. Had the whole top floor for ourselves. The Red Line metro is only a 15 minute walk away and very convenient. Quiet and peaceful suburban style area. Michael is also an absolute amazing and welcoming host. Highly recommended

Great place to stay in Chicago. Very friendly host, excellent communication, clean accommodations, and a convenient location. Everything went smoothly, and we had a wonderful experience. Highly recommended
Great place to stay if you want to be in Chicago, but not with all the chaos!
We had a great stay,  Bel was super helpful when we couldnt find any street parking as it fills up quick. Very quick to respond. Would definitely recommend.
great!!!

We loved staying at Tariq’s place in Wrigleyville! The location was awesome, just steps away from Wrigley Field and all the action. The unit was spacious and easily accommodated all 5 of us. Most importantly, Tariq was such a responsive and kind host! Even though early check in was not guaranteed, Tariq communicated with me on our travel day and we were able access the unit a couple hours earlier - a lifesaver for my kids who needed a nap!! A great stay!
Warm and friendly. Place was perfect for us. Peaceful and quiet and good local food. Will definitely come again! Tom was a perfect host. Thank you Sir!

i often stay here . One of Airbnb's really good deals. great proximity (half a block) to local laundromat which u can use or drop off/pick up  your clothes. There's the Kimball Bus immediately outside and the very close Addison Bus which can take you to beautiful Roscoe Village or Wrigleyville or the Lake PLUS the Blue Line L Train to Downtown Chicago or Ohare ✈️ ❗️ Amazing

Stayed 6 days, large family group. infant to grandparent.
This is a party house. Not a family gathering space. Plenty of glasses for booze, only 10 forks though for a place that says it sleeps 19. Lots of beds. Room for debauchery in basement. Seems also to be a potential death trap if there is a fire. No idea, and no instructions for how any of it worked.
Furniture is stained. Some stools were broken. Water leaking from hallway shower causing floor damage.
Pile of mail on front porch greeted our arrival. Dead flies on floor in entryway. Condoms in kitchen drawer.
Water/ice/?mold in refrigerator. Stove and oven dirty. Mold on inside of upstairs hallway vanity. Broken light fixture in primary bath. Bedroom door not closing, hinges being pulled from frame. Door knob missing on closet. Towel bar missing in bath. No shelving or place to hang clothes in either downstairs bedroom.
Patio is junky looking, staircase is wobbly.
AirBNB has my photos.
I have soooo much more. No space

Super fun stay in Chicago fully supported by Julian.  He was super responsive and provided all kinds of pro tips to help me have a great time.  The air B&B is kind shabby sheik bohemian, but for a couple guys it was just fine.  Great coffeeshop right downstairs.  Great Italian food downstairs as well.  Right on the brown train line and a super walkable and friendly area.

Was my first time in the city, was pleasantly suprised how close it was to a target, the train station, and Lake Michigan. The neighborhood was calm and lush with greenery. Would reccomend staying especially if you’re a person planning to be in mostly north Chicago for the trip!

Enjoyed our stay at Nicole and Matt’s. They communicated well and were flexible with our specific needs. Beautiful, quiet neighborhood with easy walk to shops, restaurants, train station. Excellent location. Comfortable and clean living space, highlights were roof patio, kitchen/living room area, shower.
Clean, easy to find, and very responsive host. We had a great time staying here and would absolutely stay here again if I were ever back in Chicago!

Kevin’s place was very clean and spacious and in a super location. Very walkable to the lake and to the city and the brown line train is only a few minutes walk away. We were so glad of the air conditioning even though it was very noisy! It was very hot when we were there so having the house cool outweighed the noise. We had just one issue on the first day with a curtain pole that was falling out of the wall and it was fixed before we left. The kitchen was very modern and the three bathrooms were great. I would highly recommend Kevin’s house to any family visiting Chicago for the super location, cleanliness, space and amenities. We had everything we needed. Thank you Kevin
oldie but goodie!

Beautiful apartment with everything I needed. Walking distance from Jewels, CVS and Walgreens which helped alot. Also Kim directed me to the nearest train station which is also easy to navigate. Loved this stay and would definitely rebook.

Had a very pleasant 5 night stay at Karen’s place with my wife and daughter. Parking was tough while we were there because the Pokémon Go festival was going on in the same plaza the building is connected to. We ended up parking in the garage that had access to the elevators up to the apartment. Cost is $26 for overnight. The view is amazing, but the shades let in tons of light so it’s difficult to sleep in. It’s in the city so expect a decent amount of noise and sirens too. All the building staff were friendly and accommodating. Karen was communicative and quick to answer questions. The area is super great and convenient. There’s a Whole Foods and Target very close by, as well as other shopping and some restaurants in walking distance.
Nice location was close to where I needed to go . Friendly and responsive hosts
Great place. Lots of space

This apartment was such a great space to live in for our trip. We visited Chicago for a week and Alma’s apartment was close to the CTA, across the street from the beach, had air conditioning for those VERY humid days, and was all around a wonderful experience. Thank you so much!
Serg is a fantastic host, very responsive and helpful. Really appreciate quick communication. The apartment is in great condition, clean, convenient, with fully stocked kitchen. Would rent again.
Good host. We enjoyed our trip.

Our group enjoyed the convenient location with great access to bus and L train options for getting around the city. We got around easily and really appreciated a short walk back at the end of the day, with the bus stop right on the same block. Our host was responsive and flexible with check in, as they initially offered options to use a concierge app but also easily accommodated our request to keep all info in the Airbnb chat. Both bathrooms were clearly updated recently, with great water pressure and all basic amenities provided. The couch was red and much smaller, not matching the large blue sectional pictured. Checkout was smoot and easy, they take care of everything for you. Overall, it met our groups needs well for a convient base while exploring the city!

My wife is in a wheelchair and the description of the condo with all of the entry measurements and floor layout description was invaluable.
This placement met all of our needs. We would rent this place in the future.
The place was perfect, I would stay here again.
This was a great place to stay very, Central to the city located in a peaceful neighborhood with a very open layout.
Free mini golf at Columbus park was great. Spacious place even for four of us. Great launch pad for city or suburb adventures. Polite and kind neighbors. Loved our stay.

We had a wonderful time staying at Jeff’s place! He was very responsive and friendly, which made for a very comfortable experience. It is close enough to major city attractions while still being in a quiet and peaceful location. We hope to come back!

The place was a bit smaller than I had anticipated but still a great option for families. It had everything we needed to save a little bit of money by making breakfast and a few dinners at home. Free and easy to find parking. We loved the scriptures on the wall and the TV was easy to use with access to streaming services. Over all a pleasant place to lay your head as it was a very safe neighborhood.

Our family of three adults stayed at Musa's place for three nights.  Musa was extremely clear with his communication and very quick with his responses.  The apartment was very clean, beds were comfortable, and the location was perfect to get great restaurants, shops, and attraction spots.  Thank you for sharing your home with our family.

Such a great home! 10 members of our family stayed there for 4 nights. walked to the "L" and walked to Wrigley field for a Cub game. there are restaurants, well within walking distance and a quiet neighborhood. 3 stories so 10-16 year old grands had the basement with plenty of room and couches and TV but house very suitable for families with little kids.
Nice to have big kitchen with very nice appliances for cooking inside. There is a garage if you drive and a patio on garage rooftop. Get a CTA map to help with making accessing the city easier.
Michelle helped with info on getting to O'Hare airport for some of our family. This was SO much better than renting 3 hotel rooms.
Very nice place to stay, if we plan another trip we will definitely try to stay here again!
Great stay in a cool neighborhood.

Overall a great place and location. The space was clean, true to the description, and the host was very responsive. She also gave helpful recommendations regarding nearby restaurants, and there was even a listing on the wall of additional recommendations to try in the area. We were able to walk to several restaurants within about 15 minutes walking distance or less.  Transportation is easily accessible as well. Over all a wonderful stay and definitely would stay again!
The host was very communicative and kind! It was a nice stay and worth the price I paid.

Well designed and outfitted space for our two week stay,  located in walkable residential area close to many great restaurants and public transportation. Hosts Mark and Collette are very responsive to any questions or comments.

We visited Chicago for the first time and weren’t sure what to expect from the area, but the stay turned out to be great. The home is bright, clean, and very spacious. The kitchen had most of what we needed for our trip, and overall it was a comfortable and pleasant place to stay. The host was also very responsive, which we really appreciated.

We loved our stay! The waterfront view, safe location, easy access to all of Chicago's must visit spots were close and the host was very friendly and responsive! We would definitely recommend this to anyone that wants to treat themselves as it was a bit more expensive (due to area and events taking place while we were staying) because it was very worth it!
Jesus was very responsive. When we asked a question, he was prompt in his response.
One of the best AirBnB experiences we’ve had!
was a very pleasantly stay. Was actually as described very well equipped. very spacious

I really enjoyed my stay here and would definitely pick this area again! The room was clean when I arrived and had plenty of things like extra hangers, towels, coffee, and cups. There's also a grill and outside seating on the patio. I was visiting for an event so I was out of the bnb most of the time but from the time I arrived to the time I left it was very easy to get around from here. You're about a 10 minute walk from both the Monroe and Damen blue line stations, as well as the North Ave and Oakley bus stops, making it a smooth transition if you fly into or out of O'hare. You're also surrounded by so many good food and drink options as well as a few 24 hour stores and Walgreens if you need anything. Junior was very responsive and was also flexible with my check in time since my plane was delayed and I was able to get in with no issues. I definitely had a fun time and would stay again.

LOVED being in Pilsen! The apartment is very centrally located in the neighborhood. Very close to mass transit, GREAT restaurants and bars, super cool and friendly vibe. Did I mention great restaurants?? I could not stop eating. And Sharon was super responsive and helpful. Great visit, will be back!
Cozy apartment and conveniant location from CTA transportation.
It was a wonderful place close to a bunch of really good restaurants. Roberto is very helpful and responsive and this is going to be my regular stay in Chicago from now on.
Great location, beautiful place, and Caleb is very responsive.

Perfect place to stay for a couple of days either by yourself or with another person. Keep in mind that the bathroom doors do not fully close. Kitchen is huge with all of the appliances included. In unit laundry is a bonus! Plenty of nearby parking options if using a car
We enjoyed our stay. It was spacious and very clean.

My stay was a very pleasant experience. There were many options within walking distance in terms of food and things to do. It was also only a short 7 minute walk to the transit rail lines which made it easy to explore the downtown area as well. Overall, my stay was quite comfortable and the hosts were very responsive to any questions I posed.
Great location. Nice place to stay.
Very responsive host. Proactive with check in and check out instructions. Clean, looked like the pictures. I would recommend and would stay again.

The place was super clean and spotless! It's in a great location, making it easy to get downtown, with lots of restaurants and shops around. The neighborhood felt safe and quiet, which I loved. Marty and Rob were amazing hosts, and their house is beautiful!
Cheryl is a great host!

This room is nice and is perfect for the solo traveler. To the west you have bus 48 that will take you to the orange line and it doesn’t run on the weekends. 51 to the north will take you to the orange station and then bus 9 is the one who runs to the east and runs the most. It will take you to the orange station. Water pressure and hot water is very awesome and air conditioning is awesome especially after being outside for the whole few days. I have already requested this room again for next year and the following year.

The host was very friendly and answer right away. Everything was clean. I just had a problem with the lock that the keys were. They are two locks. One who has the keys and another one who is attached to the box  and both had serial of numbers. And no one told me that it was two. Until I figure out. And even the clean staff was not able to find the keys as well after I check out. I will like to recommend to removed one of the locks so it will be easier to check in. Besides that it was great! also when you get the instructions for check out. They dont have a dishwasher lol I got crazy looking for that lol But the place is clean. The bed was very comfy. And pillows as well. Love it. And it was a quite area.

I really enjoyed staying in this neighborhood! So many things to do without being too far or close from everything if you know what I mean. The place is exactly as pictured and very clean! LOVED THE BED SO MUCH! The instructions for check-in were very easy and Thomas was very responsive and fast to do so. Next time we’re in Chicago we’ll definitely be staying here again! Thanks again for having us!

Wonderful place. Gracious host. No complaints.
The only comment regarding the location I’d want people to be aware of is it’s the third floor with 2 flights of steep stairs.
The place is beautiful and Chiaka was great!!!
We’d stay again.

The apartment unit was beautifully furnished, tidy and spacious for our family of four. The bathrooms were also pristine and the check in and check out process was so seamless. But above all, the host was fantastic–very communicative and we were even offered a complimentary wine bottle for a special occasion! I definitely recommend this to anyone who wants to explore Chicago while staying comfortable 😊
That apartment was small, but met all of our needs for the 6 nights we were there.
Nice place to stay. Walking distance to good restaurants and the train. Worked great for our family of 4.
Had a great stay!

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect for us—an easy walk to Loyola University, which made getting around very convenient. We also appreciated the garage parking, a real bonus in the city. The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful, allowing for a relaxing stay. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
A great Airbnb deal compared to hotels in a nice home.

This stay was in a very peaceful neighborhood. The location was great because it’s not too far from really anywhere you would like to visit in the city.
The unit was very clean, and had everything we needed to make our stay comfortable. Communication was easy. We would definitely stay here again.
Tara’s place was nice and tidy. She is also very responsive and makes accommodations for additional needs. Would recommend.

Patricia’s place was a great place to stay. We were only there for a couple nights, but were able to experience a number of things locally.  It’s located in a relatively quiet neighborhood, yet there are quite a few restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance. The place was very clean, and had a full kitchen - although we didn’t have much time to use it. We were also fortunate to be able to stow our luggage securely for a couple hours both prior to check in and after check out before leaving for the airport (Thx!). Note that this unit is on the basement level and there may be some noise from early risers from the floor above. All in all, an enjoyable stay.

Very clear and easy instructions to get into the place. Felt very safe with having three locked doors. The neighborhood is a bit boring but it’s very easy to hop on the 82 Blue Line to downtown. The noise warning was semi accurate. We could hear the venue downstairs but it was mostly bass that we could be lulled to sleep with. The main noise complaint would be the fellow persons staying in the other rooms. One night had one of them slamming doors at 3am but otherwise couldn’t hear anyone the rest of the week. Not really upset since we were expecting some noise level with the listing description. The bed was very comfortable and blankets were cozy. The shower needs very slight movement for temperature changes but ran perfectly. Everything was super clean! The hosts were proactive with messaging. 9.9/10 would stay again!!
Great place to stay in a fun area.
Amazing stay! Will definitely book again in the future

We stayed here for a week and the space was plenty for the two of us. Lots of amenities that we did use (cooking utensils, even an umbrella), and so many bus stops and train stations that getting around was not an issue. We will say that the wifi wasn't very reliable so just be wary of days when you may have to stay in due to bad weather because the wifi does not stay connected very well (at the time of writing this).
Great place!
Very wonderful stay

My family stayed at Kate's place for a full month, and it exceeded our expectations in terms of size, comfort, location, etc.  We loved the house, the neighborhood, and would happily stay there again.   Thanks, Kate!

great location,  close bus and easy commute to Chinatown or the main city. bit over an hour away from the airport though. Hosts were responsive and flexible! Just be aware that you are basically sharing a townhome with other strangers, although thankfully we chose the option with a lock on our room and our bathroom (which is across the hall from room). it was just a bit awkward knowing strangers were right next door haha. also wish there was a way to control temperature as it got a bit warm some nights.
Great stay!
Our stay was great and we would stay again.
Everything worked out very well, no issues at all.  Lovely space!

It is a great location. Easy walk to the lake and local restaurants.
Just the right space for a long weekend visit.
I would stay there again if available
We loved this Airbnb! It’s in the heart of Wicker Park and very walkable with a dedicated parking spot. We’ll definitely be back next time we’re in the area!
Great spot. Would recommend
The apartment was great. Exactly what was described on the website. Instructions were clear and concise. And they responded to our questions promptly.
Fantastic stay and wonderful hosts
Amazing place to stay ! 100% recommended.

Le logement était vraiment super! Beau, grand et décoré avec goût. Contient tous les équipements nécessaires.  La localisation est pratique (20min de bus de downtown, métro à 10min). Super séjour, merci pour tout!

We had a wonderful time in Chicago. I can’t say enough about how responsive the hosts were— very timely and thorough. And I very much appreciated your their thoughtfulness in providing more than adequate numbers of power strips and outlets— so important in today’s wired world. I’d definitely stay there again

Great Brownstone in the Gold Coast area - close to bus and L train stops - lots of restaurants and bars nearby- great layout for 2 couples with 1 bedroom and bath on main level and 1 bedroom and bath on the lower level
We loved this little place! The back deck is a GEM the description doesn’t say enough about. We loved having coffee out there in the morning and stargazing at night before bed. WE LOVED IT
Had a wonderful stay

My wife and I really enjoyed our stay at Joseph's place. It was easy to get into the city from there, and nice to have somewhere quieter to come back to of an evening.
We went to a bar and restaurant nearby which were great, and we wish we had time to try some of the others. It seems like a nice area with a lot of variety.
We chatted to Joseph a couple of times, he was very friendly and happy to give us some recommendations.
Would happily stay again!
Great place for a short stay in Chicago.

Molly's place was just lovely, warm and gracious, as the name says! It is perfect combination of old world charm that draws attention and modern amenities to make you feel at ease about cleanliness!
The room along with bathroom is esthetically pleasing and clean. The bed is very comfortable. We slept well. The view of trees from the room and the balcony took me back to my childhood home memories..
Molly is very friendly and had suggested a few places for my interest. She baked a banana bread for breakfast as well.
Her dogs Lilly and Murray are so loving and have unique personalities and we loved being greeted by them. Admired her cat from far (as she would appreciate I suppose)
We stayed there for 5 nights when we came for our son's graduation at UChicago and left with beautiful memories.

So place overall is quite nice, I had some issues and host was extremely responsive which helped a lot. I had some major concerns on the cleaning, as it felt like someone is living in it and just stepped out with my check in. That is about the extreme mess in cabinets, used dishwashing sponge that was left there, dust and stains in some places.
Great location, spacious, well-stocked, worked for our needs as two couples in town for the weekend. The living room was cozy!
great location. thank you
Our stay was great.  The neighborhood is beautiful.  The accommodations were outstanding.

El departamento es muy amplio y cómodo, el sector muy tranquilo y habían varios espacios de estacionamiento siempre disponibles, en cuanto al aseo es lo único que no me gustó, había restos de comida en la cocina y pelos en los baños, encontramos basura también atrás de las mesas de noche, ofrecieron solución de ir al siguiente día a limpiar pero no aceptamos ya que nosotros mismos limpiamos lo que estaba sucio, todo lo demás 10/10.
The space was just as shown in the photos and had a prime location in the center of Fulton market.
Nice place
What a fantastic place to stay.  The host was very responsive and helpful.  The place was immaculate and really spacious, especially for Chicago.  We will be back!
We loved staying here! Great place with super clear communication and expectations. Would absolutely come again. Thank you!
A beautiful space, in a beautiful location.    Well furnished, close to everything on a beautiful street, and to top it all off, great hosts!

Loved the place, cozy and clean and a good location for sure. A K-cup coffee maker would have been a plus for me as a coffee drinker 🙃. Grocery stores in close and walkable distance. Restaurant/ Bar across the road which unfortunately I was not able to try but looked always busy so I assume they are good. The check in instructions sounded more complicated than the check in process turned out to be.
I would rent it again.

Me gustó mucho quedarme en esta casa pues la novia de Leonid siempre estuvo al pendiente de que necesitara incluso me ofreció un sobre de té para resfriado.
La habitación bien, si necesitas usar el sofá cama asegúrate de mencionarlo antes de tu llegada, hubiera agradecido que estuviera igual de cómodo que la cama pero funciona por una o dos noches.
La ubicación es buena si vas a transportarte en Uber o algo similar, si vas a usar metro no te la recomiendo pues en esa estación se ven personas un poco desagradables y se siente un poco vulnerable pero fuera de ello, gran alojamiento, no se permiten zapatos dentro de la casa y hay dos baños disponibles para todos. Se agradece que sean dos baños completos.

We enjoyed our stay here. The property has a charming, homey atmosphere that immediately made us feel comfortable and welcome. It's located in a quiet, quaint neighborhood that offers a peaceful retreat from the city. The surroundings were lovely, and we especially appreciated the calm, relaxing environment. Overall, it was a wonderful place to stay, and we would happily return in the future.

We had a comfortable short stay here. Good location, private, and the washer/dryer were a great amenity. The a/c worked well to cool the space which was nice to come back to after a day outside. Proximity to coffee shops, grocery stores, restaurants and public transit was great. Check in and check out was easy, host is responsive and we didn’t experience any major issues. Some of the linens were a bit worn, there were some random stains/smudges on walls and surfaces, and the unit overall could use a dusting, but nothing too terrible. For a two-night stay this space fit our needs and kept us in the neighborhood we wanted to be in.
Everything was great!

Is as described and had everything we needed. Was a bit far from main downtown but worked out in a good way? The neighborhood felt super safe and peaceful after a long hectic day in the city. Tons of little (food) gems nearby that we preferred over restaurants by the loop. Good transport options from downtown and the airport.
Highlight: Host was responsive and accommodating to our flight time. He went above and beyond to make our stay/checkin work for us. We didn’t have any issues or questions throughout our stay but I’m sure if we did, he’d help us work it out.

The location of this Airbnb was everything to us. It was steps away from bus stops, about a 5 minute walk to the Green Line, and maybe a 10 minute walk to the Red Line. We were visiting with our kids, so easy access to public transportation was important to us. The space was also roomy enough for our family of five, which made a big difference. One of our kids chose to sleep on the couch, but there was an air mattress available if we had wanted to use it. Milan was VERY responsive and helpful whenever we had questions, and the people working the desk were polite.
There were a few things that could use some attention, so it wasn’t a perfect stay, but overall the location, space, and communication were enough to earn 5 stars from us.
This is the 4th times in the last 12months that we stayed in this apartment. It is always our first choice to stay here when we come to Chicago.
Amazing view and great location. Very nicely appointed and plenty of room. However, one of the bedrooms can get pretty warm.
Wonderful spot. Would stay again

Ray and Karen responded immediatly to my questions
Their air band b is located in a nice quiet residential neighborhood that was perfect for us. Walkable area of beautiful tree lined streets with many historic homes.
Impeccably clean, comfortable bed and pillows
Huge screen tv fun to watch
A fully equipped kitchen and washer and dryer were wonderful to have.
Also Afro Joes. A must go to place for coffee, breakfast sandwiches and lunch.
