Immaculate and fresh stay.  Best part is the bathroom - super relaxing. Quiet and cute - fantastic location.  Tracy is wonderful and kind.  This is one of my best Airbnb experience.   Lots of places to walk to - super close to water.
Awesome place. Very close by the #3 bus that allowed us to go in & out the city with ease. Hosts are great! Highly recommend this place.
Excellent stay at Sezgin’s. Very comfortable and clean, easy.
Was a nice place, and free parking was a big bonus.

Fantastic house. I hope to book again soon for a family trip. We booked for a work event at Fulton market and it was a quick 10 minute drive with AM traffic. Highly recommend. Walked to a brewery and local coffee. Super safe location and lovely neighborhood. Plenty of street parking but the garage was a bonus in the city.
Ivan was a great host!
This was our 2nd time booking with Tracy and her husband which has been a very pleasant experience. I will recommend them to others and plan on booking with them soon.
This place was very nice. Much bigger than we thought. Was a great place to stay at while celebrating my 40th birthday with friends.

Great stay for family of five.
Walking distance to nice restaurants and a great florist two blocks away which made beautiful bouquets.
Parking garage extremely helpful too.
Will come back.
Absolutely fantastic place to stay when visiting Chicago.  Highly recommend a stay here.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt! Die Unterkunft war geräumig, gut ausgestattet und sehr sauber. Die Kommunikation mit Tuan war super. Wir haben stets alle wichtigen Informationen bekommen sodass Check-in und Check-out sehr einfach waren! Mit bus und Bahn ist die Unterkunft auch gut aus der Stadt erreichbar. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt!
Love Alma's place right on the park!
Quiet. Very comfortable. Close to lots in Chicago. Great and responsive host. Clean. Lots of free parking.

We loved this place for so many reasons! From the moment we stepped in, we were smiling from ear to ear gushing about how cute the place was and all of the special touches Erica included (I won't spoil it for others, but I swear she thought of everything)!
We arrived on Amtrack and then made an easy transfer to catch a train to the neighborhood. When heading back downtown, the Pink Line was just a 5 minute walk away and the ride to downtown was quick.
After a busy day downtown surrounded by people and traffic, it was so nice to head back to Frida's Flat where it quiet and peaceful. We enjoyed the birds chirping, hanging out on the back deck and listening to the vinyl records.
Taco Loco of Pilsen was a must! Other guests commented on how good the food was and they were not wrong!
Last, but certainly not least, Erica was a wonderful host. She provided easy and clear instructions and was quick to respond to messages.
nice place, kind of tiny beds but super comfortable... great location

Chicago is expensive, so there is no place that is going to feel like a great deal...however this spot is in the "heart" of the city, meaning it is easy to get anywhere from it. Close to the train...20-25 minutes by train (faster by car) to lake shore, Millennium park, museums, and all kinds of other neighborhoods.
Patrica was a great host- communicated well, accommodated some needs we had. Simple apartment & solid choice if traveling with a family or multiple people.

We had a great stay in this quiet, comfortable, and spacious studio apartment, with lots of thoughtful amenities including coffee and nice linens. Host is very friendly and attentive and gave great cultural suggestions. Will definitely stay again. Highly recommend!

This is our second stay at a Hospitality Club property in Chicago & in was once again made for a wonderful stay. Location is great and the actual room is awesome. Completely private & quiet and very comfortable. Couch & Bed are very comfortable and the Kitchen is very useful, which includes a nice table to eat at. Truly one of the best locations in Chicago and having stayed in hotels such as the Pendry & London House, I much preferred this location and actual apartment. Our evening walks along Lakeshore up to the Gold Coast and having a Whole Foods just a few blocks away truly makes this place the absolute best place around to stay at. Very enjoyable stay and could not have imagined staying elsewhere.
The Hosts are completely professional & pretty much keep to themselves unless you need them, which on my stays I have never had to trouble them.

Just back home after a really great vacation in Chicago. John's apartment is in a really nice location. We loved the vibe in Roscoe village which has nice cafes, bars and restaurants. Its also close to great supermarkets. The local bus and trains are also close by which was ideal for a visit down town. Chicago felt very friendly, clean and felt safe. John was a very good host and responded quickly in all communication and was very helpful.
We loved it there ❤️

Our stay was great! Super great neighborhood with a ton to do, and super easy to get downtown on the brown line! Has everything we needed in the space and kitchen, and SUPER nice steam shower.  Parking was also extremely easy, we were right outside of our place with no issue finding a spot. Given it is a basement unit, there was a lot of barking and footstep noise from the unit upstairs, so I wouldn’t recommend it if you are planning to stay in for your whole visit and not explore the area. There was an excessive, off-putting focus on my Chicago telephone number (eg., 773), despite my profile clearly stating I live in California. Apparently this host / company has a policy of not renting to people living in Chicago.

Marjorie was very helpful when it came to checking in and out! Very informative when we had trouble parking! Was very quick on answering for any of our questions! The place was covert cozy and clean me and my husband were very comfortable! In walking distance of a few stores and felt very safe! All and all a great place to stay during our short visit!
Such a great home in the perfect location on a quieter street in Wicker Park a few minutes walking to the cute shops and restaurants.

Very well managed place. Has everything you need,  the hosts were great and had thought of all the details. We especially loved the large bay window in the living room area that was great for sitting and reading in the mornings. Comfortable, clean, bright, spacious, and has dedicated workspace with good WiFi.  Highly recommended.

I can’t say enough good things about this place! Conveniently located a short walk to the L which allowed ease of getting around without having to rent a car or drain your wallet on too many ride shares. Everything looks freshly renovated and in a way that shows that care and effort were put into the design. Great appliances, comfy beds, and the showers were AMAZING!!! I noticed some people had things to say about the noise from the trains, but honestly it didn’t bother us one bit. Maggie was such a delight to communicate with and was always very responsive and helpful. 10/10 would absolutely stay here again!!!
The host were great and the place was exactly what my friends and I needed for the weekend.

our stay at Pete's was amazing. the apartment is beautiful and has been decorated with every amenity you could think of.
The host was responsive and helpful and it felt like a little oasis away from home. it was 15-20 minute drive to downtown Chicago which was ideal.
There are some cool restaurants around the area which made the stay even more enjoyable.
Thanks so much for having us and we will certainly come back again.
Place was super cute, awesome location. Plenty of free parking right out in front. Short walk to delicious options up and down Clark St.
Espectacular alojamiento para una zona tan icónica. Recomendable, aunque el precio es muy alto.
Great place, responsive host, short walk to the Cta stop. Would recommend this spot!

Liebevoll eingerichtete Wohnung mit sehr gut ausgestatteter Küche und bequemen Betten. Alles war sehr sauber und Sukh ein freundlicher, hilfsbereiter Gastgeber.
Die Lage war sehr ruhig und gut mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln ans Stadtzentrum angebunden (ca. 25-30min). Dark Matter Coffee war fußläufig, dort haben wir mehrfach morgens Kaffee geholt. Ein großer Supermarkt (Pete‘s Fresh Market) war mit dem Bus ca. 5 Minuten entfernt, was sehr bequem war.
Insgesamt würden wir die Unterkunft guten Gewissens wieder buchen.

We had a fantastic stay! The place was exactly as described, impeccably clean, and beautifully decorated. Mara was incredibly communicative. The check-in process was seamless. We highly recommend this property and would gladly stay here again.

Very happy that we booked our stay here! Matthew was very responsive and ensured that we had everything we needed. He was willing to help out with any issues we had and made check-in/check-out a breeze. Thank you!
Great host, very responsive and helpful

I absolutely loved it! The unit was spacious, comfortable, and incredibly well-equipped. It has 4 bedrooms (2 on the main floor and 2 in the basement), 2 full bathrooms, a large living room with a very comfortable sofa bed, a dining table that easily seats 8, a backyard deck, and a laundry room with high-capacity washer and dryer.
The kitchen was one of the best-stocked I've seen in an Airbnb, with plenty of cookware, dishware, utensils, small appliances, and a large refrigerator with ice and water. There were also extra towels, linens, toiletries, cleaning supplies, and countless thoughtful amenities throughout the home. The only thing I'd note is that the basement stairs can feel a little slippery in socks, so indoor slippers with some grip are a good idea.
The hosts were outstanding. Communication was fast, detailed, flexible, and genuinely guest-focused. Logan Square was quiet, safe, and convenient, with restaurants, shops, Target, bus stops, and CTA access nearby. A great stay!

Kari’s place is perfect for anyone with a larger group (families). It’s well decorated and comfortable and an excellent place to unwind after a busy day in the city.
It has so many amenities in addition to games, full kitchen, laundry and a nice yard. Their dogs are also sweethearts.
We had a great time.
Great stay, clean place, and easy to communicate with the hosts! Would book again.
I enjoyed my stay. Place was very clean and comfortable. I would stay again.
Great relaxed space near U-Chicago!
This is an amazing two bedroom apartment within walking distance to so many places to eat and a short walk to Wrigley’s Field and the Lakefront Trail.

We had a great time staying at this apartment. It was so close to public transit, close to good places to eat and shop too. Inside was clean, and looked just like the images on the listing. We would definitely stay here again!

We loved our stay at Clemente’s apartment. The location is excellent and for being in the heart of the city, pretty spacious. There is a great Italian restaurant downstairs that we definitely visited. Whole Foods is not too far away either. Everything was great. My family couldn’t have asked for a better Airbnb.
We loved staying here, it was such a cute little spot. Perfect for the 3 of us. The bed was very comfortable and the host was very responsive when we reached out. Definitely recommend staying here!

While we wanted to give 5 stars because of how kind and communicative the hosts were, the experience just wasn’t what we’d hoped for. The positives: very clean and excellent location! A short walk from the L and a wide variety of many great bars, restaurants, a theater, and coffee shops. Also close to groceries. That said, the kitchen is EXTREMELY limited (ex: only one water glass for two guests), so we didn’t do much cooking. After reading reviews, we were prepared for noise that can be expected in an active apartment building, but weren’t prepared for the noise of a domestic dispute in the hallway right outside the unit’s door and the noise of a bike being stolen outside in the middle of the night. While both incidents were out of the hosts’ control, neither was pleasant to wake up to. None of the equipment in the advertised fitness area worked, which was disappointing because we were looking forward to our regular workouts. We just don’t feel it was worth the price.

Tracy was very communicative and informative. She was prompt in responding to my questions, and very accommodating with my request. Our entire group of seven was from out of town, and the stay was great!

Great space inside and out on patio. Such great flow and usability! Great physical comfort from all the amenities! I’d go back again if I needed the space for 4 or more. Distance from city and need for transit is balanced out by the value. 20min rides into city on Uber.
Loved it!

Amazing spot, and would definitely stay again. Simply beautiful space and decor (even better than the photos online, if you can imagine). Great location in terms of walkability and proximity to public transit. Really appreciated the communication with Johanna as well.
David's place was fantastic

The hosts are amazing and provided great service. The apartment is nice and well-equipped; everything was great, thank you. However, there are some spiders and silverfish. While I know they aren’t dangerous, they aren’t the most pleasant company.

Cannot say enough about this Airbnb...location was amazing, very walkable and lots of great options for food and drink all around.  Views were incredible and the unit was so clean and well equipped.  Beds and linens are super comfy.  We were in town for Neocon and Design Days so we were right in the middle of the action.  Loved that the street was not as busy as Wacker Drive, but still right there.  The trains did not bother us, we heard them, but not to the point of interfering with the experience.  Large screen TV's were great as well!  Highly recommend.   Good value for classy, safe accommodations in Chicago!

I booked this for my two colleagues who were over in Chicago for work.
They really liked the experience - comments were "I thought they were pretty good hosts. Everything was clean and organised. We asked for washing detergent which they delivered the same day." and "It was a nice space and good location! You can give them 5 stars!"
Thank you - we hope to be back next year!
great place to stay. had everything we needed!
Great value. Was a treat to stay in the neighborhood that I lived in for so many years. Fantastic nightlife, peaceful environment – great experience overall.
Had a short trip in Chicago and needed a place to stay for two nights. The host was flexible with my check-in and the place was just as beautiful as described. Would definitely stay here again!
Great spot to stay in Chicago!
Julio was incredibly kinda and accommodating to us visiting! His place is beautiful and we had everything we could possibly need. I recommend Julio’s place to anybody visiting the Chicago area
Great apartment in a great area of Chicago. It definitely looked better than the pictures. Perfect for our stay. Thank you!

The place is really nice. The only interesting thing is: Like almost all the apartments in that area of Hyde Park, it was built a long time ago. As such, there are a lot of noises… Wood creaking, footsteps, people coming down the stairs outside the front door, and people living in the units above. If you go into it with that in mind, it’s a great place.
The place was extremely clean and well organized. Plenty of towels, and clean bedding. The kitchen was clean, with plenty of dishes, utensils, pots, and pans. Very well equipped. It has a good fridge, stove, oven, and microwave. But the best thing of all: An air conditioner for each room. I am not used to the humidity of summertime in Chicago, but each room was kept in air-conditioned coolness. Also, there is a large television with plenty of viewing options.
Early in our stay, there was a problem with the toilet. Jorge responded immediately and had the problem fixed very quickly. That was much appreciated.
Very convenient to the University of Chicago and easy street parking!
Great location and clean place! Host was very helpful and efficient when answering any questions!
What a lovely place to stay for a vacation. I enjoyed all of it. I cannot recommend this unit enough if you’re looking for a nice place to relax after long Chicago days.

Bathroom was dirty and had black mold growing in there. Walls are paper thin and you can hear everything from other guests to running water extremely loud. Paper thin bed, very cheap place all around, seems like minimal effort put into maintenance and cleaning…Would not stay here again
This day was exactly as it was advertised as shown in the pictures. The area was lively and the home was clean. I would definitely recommend to friends and family and would stay there again myself.
fantastic
Great location and very comfortable! Vin is a great host and was very responsive to our needs!

Owen and Alexandra's condo is absolutely beautiful, and we loved the Fulton Market! The beds were very comfortable, the kitchen and bathrooms were well stocked with everything you need, and it's very walkable (great cafes and restaurants nearby and a large grocery store right next door). They were both very responsive and had clear instructions. We had a great stay and I would recommend and stay again!
Greg's place was great!  I had a very short visit, and didn't need much.  I'd stay there again.

En general limpio, instrucciones claras de llegada. En la descripción quizá aclarar que solo es un baño para todos. Agradecería una televisión para los raros descripción descanso en la habitación. En general creo que 4 estrellas son suficientes por el costo. Volvería sino encuentro otro lugar en Chicago.

Great stay! The place is lovely and perfect if you're looking for a quiet home base. Fair warning: it's pretty far from downtown, so if you're planning to spend a lot of time there, this might not be the best location. We had 3 people and it worked fine, though it's ideally sized for 2. I'd definitely stay here again.
It was the perfect place for our girls trip! 10/10 would recommend staying here!

Summary: Quiet rental that has been poorly maintained and could use a deep cleaning, especially the bathroom
Pros: nice location, quiet neighborhood, walkable to bus stops and Metra station, okay price
Cons: visible mold on shower curtain and liner, dirty bath mat, only 1 hook in bathroom for towels, various stains on furniture, backdoor was broken and the handle fell off during my stay, broken blinds, lamps were broken or lightbulbs were burnt out, some lamps were aesthetic only and could not even reach an outlet, broken floorboards, confusion with agreed upon early bag drop-off, host was unresponsive during my stay when asking for additional amenities and how to address backdoor issue
Felt right at home and very comfortable. The host is very attentive and acts quickly.
This is wonderful place to stay, thank you so much for hosting, will definitely check availability for future trips!
Another great stay at the apartment! Thank you!
Exactly what it said, great place to stay

Too many issues led to me leaving a night early. The co-host was quick to respond but ultimately ensured me that it’s not their responsibility that the other guests made me feel unsafe & kept me up at night. That being said, the floor in my room was dirty & there were other random stains on the couches and walls in the living room.
Gio’s apartment in Logan Square looked just like the pictures. It was clean and quiet. Having onsite parking was amazing. Gio is very responsive and the trip was smooth!
Great location, close to public transport and Olga was very responsive and kind!
Great hosts made us feel welcome and comfortable in a beautiful older home that reminded me of the old Victorian I grew up in

Loved our stay at Sentral.  The location can't be beat.  The building is safe, clean, and quiet.  The apartment itself was very comfortable and had everything we needed.  Would definitely stay here again!
Great location, clean and quiet accomodations.

Jie has a great BNB, I highly recommend! It’s private & quiet. Communication was easy, it’s very walkable & has multiple beds + toilets! Definitely worth it, my only complaint is there were hairs that weren’t mine or my guests in some places (bathroom/kitchen). It could’ve been cleaner in that aspect but overall I would return for any girls trip to Chicago ❤️!

Love the location and was in walkable distances to a few restaurants nearby. Very quiet and safe neighborhood. Place was very clean and spacious. Quick communication from host. Would definitely recommend.

Her place was my first Airbnb and I have to say that I had a great experience. She was very responsive to my questions, she even got me wine and cookies to welcome me when I got in. the neighborhood is very nice and quiet
I felt very safe and comfortable. her place is beautiful and cozy. i will definitely stay here again

The house was super nice and cozy, as well as clean and tidy. The Al Capone room is very cool and unique, and the bed was very comfortable. The bathroom was just right, and the shower felt amazing after walking around Chicago all day.
Although I didn’t use it, the front room looked very inviting and comfortable, and the kitchen looked practical and fully stocked. The neighborhood is quiet, safe, charming, and easily walkable. The train station, which gets you into Chicago in about 20 minutes, is nearby, and stores, restaurants, and a vibrant bar scene are all within a 10–15 minute walk.
Angelica was responsive, friendly, kept in touch, and provided good suggestions for local places.
I would definitely recommend staying here.
Great place to stay if you’re going to a Cubs game (or two)!

First time in Chicago and I loved it here. This place was a perfect location for me, everything was close in walking distance as well couldn’t have asked for a better location genuinely a perfect location, Also the best for the price to as well. next time I come back I’ll definitely be staying here again.
Enjoyed my stay. The host was very responsive and accommodating. House was clean, game room was fun and outdoor was a plus.
Staying at Luke’s Airbnb was great for U Chicago’s graduation weekend. Luke was responsive and extremely helpful leading up to and throughout our stay!
Will definitely be going with Vin from here on out anytime I’m in Chicago! 5 stars

The home is exactly as advertised. It was clean, had room for us to gather, and had everything we needed for our stay. It got warm in the bedrooms upstairs (in late June), but an air conditioner was provided. The grandmas were glad that two bedrooms were on the ground floor.  We appreciated the garage--street parking was easy enough, but we never had to think about it. We experienced no street noise at night, and we didn't mind the 'no shoes in the house' rule. Gina was friendly and communicative. In all, a good experience!

I really was able to enjoy my stay here. Getting around was super easy and convenient with the public transportation nearby. Olga was very responsive and helpful with anything needed, shared spaces felt like they could be used at any moment, and anytime I needed to use the room, it never felt like I was being disturbed by guests in other rooms or vice versa.

I had an amazing time. The apartment is super well located. You can walk to old town and river north. It’s very convenient. I highly recommend it.  The host is nice and chill. And there is a very friendly cat.
Beautiful apartment in a nice neighborhood with coffee shops, restaurants and grocery stores around. The place was clean and hosts responded right away to our questions when we arrived at 11pm.
Great stay!

Wonderful place in Wicker Park. The location was great and had so many amazing places within walkable distance. The apartment itself was clean and just like the pictures. I stayed all weekend, so it was nice to have somewhere to come back to like this to relax. As others have noted, it’s easy to hear the street outside, but not a huge deal. It was nice that earplugs were supplied. Lia was a great host and was responsive when I had questions. Highly recommend and would love to stay here again in the future. Thanks for a wonderful experience in Chicago!
The place is an older house with some quirks, but it provided exactly what I needed for my stay.
Solo traveler approved very easy to check in, beautiful neighborhood with many great shops and eateries nearby,  a short train ride to the down town area. I enjoyed my trip thank you so much!!!
Very communicative and straight forward instructions, would stay again!

Cordaro is an exquisite host. There are snacks available in the kitchen, water, tea and lemonade in the mini fridge in my room and coffee available in the kitchen. It’s such a cute space and worth the price you pay for the room. I extended my stay and my extension was accepted, very flexible host. Definitely would stay here again!

Gabriela was extremely responsive, and a gracious host. We needed to push our trip back a day, and contacted her about a month prior to do so, and she was very willing to work with us. We asked if we could check in early, and she went above and beyond to make sure everything was cleaned ahead of time so we had the option to check-in early. The location was great. Provided parking permits allowed us to come and go in an area where parking can be hard to find. The space was just as described. Very appreciative of this host!
Overall, the place was really nice and the owners were really friendly and responsive. It was just minor inconveniences as the days went on but nothing to ruin our vacation.

Very nice host who had quick communication. Peaceful and friendly neighborhood. Upstairs neighbor was a bit noisy in the mornings, perhaps a kid running around? Besides that, no complaints. Would recommend and book again.

My adult siblings and I stayed at Priscilla and Craig’s house for a weekend in the city and it was perfect. The house was beautiful, comfortable, and very well taken care of. There were so many little touches that made our stay even more meaningful. The ones that stuck out most were all of the little things available for children. From books, toys, safe outlets, to the child silverware, it made our lives so much easier while taking a toddler to the city for the first time. It’s very hard to find a place to stay that has thought about all of those things, so we appreciate it so very much. My niece now has a new obsession with hot wheels! When I needed anything during the stay, they were extremely responsive and nice! I couldn’t have asked for a better situation. The location is amazing too!!! So much to see and do! Thank you very much for sharing your home with us, we hope to stay again in the future!
Very responsive host! Happy to stay here again

My husband and I greatly enjoyed our stay here! Paula and Adrian take great care of the space and were very communicative the whole trip. The proximity to the train station was fantastic and there were plenty of places for dinner and late night snacks within walking distance.

This place was fabulous!!
Spacious and clean. Jonathan was very helpful and courteous throughout the stay too.
If you’re looking for a quiet neighborhood and a somewhere comfy for 2+ people, this is the place!

Me and my fiancé throughly enjoyed our stay with Christina! She’s so funny, thoughtful, helpful and made sure our stay was maximally wonderful! We’re not from here , but from Cleveland Ohio and we were down for the Beyond Wonderland rave down at northerly island (Huntington area)
Christina throughly told us about what was close, what neighborhoods to stay from, and different things to do for the weekend! She’s very knowledgeable! We will definitely be booking again the next time Chicago has this rave going on again! And everything is very near where the home was it didn’t take long to get anywhere we needed to go! Very convenient location! We were offered groceries (we brought our own) items were offered to wash our clothes and fresh linens were given at request. We felt right at home and were everything about the stay! I definitely recommend this home to anyone coming into Chicago! And the southern hospitality was awesome! See you guys next time! ❤️

Murtaza’s home was a great place to stay for a weekend trip in Chicago. The location is close to the train and has some really good places to eat within walking distance. They were great at communicating and it was just what our small family needed to feel comfortable.

James had a very spacious place that matched the description. There were lots of amenities and it was in a good location, close to buses and the L. When I stay in Chicago next I would see myself booking with him again!
Stay was good! Apartment is clean and has many amenities, including kitchen, parking and private laundry unit. Rasheed is also very responsive and check out process is easy.

Logement très bien situé, très propre et confortable. Situé à proximité d’une ligne de train. Jean a été très efficace pour répondre et très accommodante pour notre départ.
Le logement est conforme à la description. Quartier très tranquille. La nature y est très belle. Nous avons bien aimé y séjourner.
A great stay if you want to be within walking distance to restaurants and the metro. The neighborhood is friendly and has great nature vibe.

We had a great stay! Jerome was super nice and helpful getting us settled and he was easy to get ahold of. It felt like he really cared about the quality of our stay. The home is beautiful and cozy and felt like actually being at home. We loved it. We will definitely stay here again next time we’re in the area! Thank you Jerome!
Great place would recommend!
Very good place with a local vibe. It's very well equipped with everything you need. Just a short walk to the L. I would definitely come back.
Very nice and beautiful place. Marc and Susy were wonderful host. Very responsive. The place was very homey and perfect for us. I will definitely keep this place in mind when visiting the area again.

Emily and Roya’s place was perfect for me. It’s in a great neighborhood, has a cute patio, and felt like home. Their communication was outstanding and it really was just a seamless experience. I will definitely be staying here again!

Great stay at Michelle’s place over the weekend. Space was clean and had everything we could need for our weekend in Chicago. Host was very welcoming and kind, however if you’re on the more introverted side as I am, be prepared for a bit more interaction and conversation than your typical Airbnb.
Great, responsive host!
Great place, great location, lots of local restaurants and easy to get to transit
Good place fora bachelor party! The place was clean and easy to find. The backyard was nice for hanging out.
Really enjoyed my stay with Andy On S. Drexel. Check in was clear and I felt like I had my privacy. You’re definitely in South Side Chicago, and I loved every second of it.
everything was great
Absolutely great place to stay, great price/deal for how close you are to the city. Would definitely come back!

Great stay and great place at a fair price.  Air conditioning went out first night.  Caroline was responsive and got a window air conditioner in the unit as it was the weekend and couldn’t get an HVAC technician.  Five stars except the hot night without AC and that’s not the hosts fault.  They did all they could.

One of the very best Airbnbs we’ve stayed in: beautiful apartment, airy, spacious, spotless and lots of thoughtful touches. Brendan and Sophia were super responsive and gave us great suggestions for the area. Don’t miss Sugar Moon bakery just down the road. Highly recommend this fabulous roost in Logan Square!

Arrived at scheduled time. It was very welcoming and we felt ‘at home’ in an area that we know very well. Bed was quite comfortable and slept well. Neighborhood was a nice quiet bonus. We parked right in front & didn’t move the car once since everything is within walking distance.
Nice home I’m frm the area so I’m used to it it’s quite doe at the end of the day nice place to stay at
Great location and good communication.

My group's stay at this Fulton Market loft was seamless for our entire trip. The residence was spacious, clean, and located right next to the train station which was a must for my group when deciding on a place to stay. The host, Matthew, was responsive and accommodating throughout our whole booking process and stay. We would gladly stay here again if ever back in the area.

When I found the place online it looked very nice and well illuminated, but upon arrival I was a little disappointed in my room, it was small, bleak, dark, very poorly illuminated, with a very low ceiling and with the AC running all day and no way to adjust the temperature or turn it off.
The lobby is fine, but the stairs to go down are very worn, the floorboards on the stairs are starting to warp and look very care worn.
To lock your room you get a flimsy combination lock, and once in its the standard push button on the door which I found slightly disappointing for security.
One of the bathrooms had black mould forming above the shower which I found alarming.
The place was honestly a bit disappointing, if youre on a budget its probably and ok option but I wouldn't return

Location! The rental is perfectly located to Boystown and Wrigley Field. Easy walk to the “L” for easy access to the rest of the city. Stephen has pulled out all of the stops and really thought of everything with the unit which made it so easy to unpack and enjoy being in Chicago! He’s also very responsive - we changed our plans from flying to Chicago to driving and he immediately returned my inquiry about obtaining a parking pass. The unit is clean and I found it quiet and convenient. Highly recommend if you’re in town! I found my new go-to place while in Chicago.
such a memorable and unique stay! the hidden whiskey room is super cool. maybe watch your head if you’re over 6ft. many cool shops and places to eat or get coffee nearby around wicker park.

We had a wonderful stay at this cozy 2-bedroom apartment! The place was absolutely spotless and the beds were incredibly comfortable. The host thought of everything, providing plenty of fresh linens and towels. The location couldn't be better—it's walking distance to public transportation and right next door to a delicious local coffee shop, which was a huge bonus for our mornings! Check-in and check-out instructions were crystal clear, and the host was fantastic—very responsive, welcoming, and checked in on us every single day to ensure we had everything we needed. Highly recommend!

Beautiful and big Airbnb,
rooms are big enough
I traveled for my daughter's graduation, unfortunately we needed an iron for our clothes but never found it.
Kindly he got a new iron for us but was too late.
Todo lo demas supper bien!!
muchas gracias Dukes!
comfortable and good for a quick stay in Chicago!

Het appartement is helemaal zoals beschreven in de advertentie, heel ruim, comfortabel en proper. Echt prachtig. Het is gelegen op wandelafstand vd Green Line, waardoor je in een half uur in de stad kan staan. Echt een aanrader

Exactly what I was looking for, right outside downtown, clean ammenaties, organized household and right off the train to boot. My hosts communicated well all the detais...info for check in, check out, status and any flexibilities I may have needed.
A perfect stay for a young professional.
Thank you for hosting and look forward to next time.
This was a great place. Very clean and in a great area for my trip.
This place was great, clean, comfy & convenient. Walking distance from food, coffee and public transportation. If you just need a place to rest and shower, this is your spot.

My wife and I stayed here for about 5 days and really enjoyed our stay. The keypad code did not work for us, so we opted to use the key the whole stay. The apartment was very cute and thoughtfully decorated, and was very well stocked. Kirsten was very responsive and helped out whenever I had questions. The bed and pillows were also very comfortable. Overall, I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others with a few caveats:
It's a pretty quiet neighborhood and good for going on walks, but is kind of far from downtown and other more popular areas. I highly recommend having a car if you decide to stay here and plan on venturing, as Uber always had LONG waits.
There was a loud, strange hum that would occur at night, and there were no curtains, so it was bright in the morning (for light sleepers).
The shower was uncomfortably small (I'm 4'10 and my wife is 5'4), so if you are tall or chubby (like me), it might be a challenge, but it's doable.

Very cute spot, very easy to get into, close to tram station to get into the downtown Chicago. The rooms are private, but the bathroom and kitchen are shared spaces with other private rooms, and even that was lovely because our neighbors were very sweet and in Chicago for the same event we were there for! A lovely little spot to stay in :)
Thanks for the stay Rochelle! Was perfect for what we needed as a group for an event.
Stay was very comfy and cozy with lots of space within a great neighborhood. Ed is a great host and is very friendly/responsive
Stayed here and it worked great, very close to bus to get to downtown where we spent most of our time.

Place was great.
Only complaint was no curtains in the bedroom only has blinds. The photos show the blinds, and i knew about it when booking. Alot of street light gets into the room.

Good location, walkable distance to red line. Place was nice and clean. Convenient for getting to downtown. Clear instructions on locating place and good communication. Appreciate the washing machine and air filter. Building itself had a bit of a musty smell but if you don’t mind it, the apartment itself smelled clean.

We absolutely loved staying here! It was just 1 bus ride to get to Downtown Chicago! Our host was so quick to respond & made sure that we had everything we needed! We would absolutely stay here again. Definitely recommend staying here :)
Very low shower water pressure, dusty fans and not the cleanest place. Host was nice and communicated very well!!
Jorge was an amazing host, very responsive and the place was beautiful to stay at, loved the balcony would definitely stay here again
Got exactly what i needed to experience Chicago for the first time, everything was made clear and rules laid out. Overall great experience
Miriam was very responsive and accommodating during our stay. Loved everything about it and will definitely be back!
Great location right next to the blue line
We had a great time and the location was great. We could walk to restaurants, the park, and a number of amenities. We really enjoyed our time in the Chicago!

The property my friends and I stayed at was truly the best airbnb we’ve been to! It is a beautiful place that was very clean and close to the event that we went to. The host was very helpful and friendly as well! We would absolutely love to come back if we get the chance!
Great location and easy to find!

Loved the place and location for family of 4 with easy access to different places in Hyde Park and downtown Chicago.
Would love to see some additional amenities like more pillows, clothes hangers, dinnerware, cutlery, bakeware, blender, hairdryer etc. also the description needs to be updated today this unit is in 3rd floor and to say there is a W/D in unit which was very good to have.
I got a msg that said we damage the sofa that didn't hapen with us and the only thing we eat at the house was 2 slice of pizza and chips any damage or stain was not us

Maria’s place was great for all our needs while a large group of us visited Chicago! It was close to public transit for those of us using it and a fast drive into the city for those who rented a vehicle! very comfortable and clean, very easy street parking, host responded to every question and made sure we had everything we needed.

The accommodations were comfortable, inviting, and thoughtfully prepared. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend Anne's home to anyone visiting Chicago.
The place was as described and very clean!  He even provides kitchen appliances to cook with, and clean linen/towels!

The apartment was okay overall, but for the price we paid, it felt overpriced. The location was good, but the beds were very soft and not particularly comfortable.
The master bedroom also had a persistent water-dripping noise, possibly from the ventilation system, which was disruptive at night. Additionally, receiving multiple long automated messages throughout the stay became a bit annoying.
The property has potential, but it could benefit from some updates and improvements to better justify the cost.

My family and I (2 adults and 1 preteen) had a great weekend at Amy's Studio for Go Fest! Super clean and relaxing!
We enjoyed walking to a local coffee shop each morning (Casa Coffee!! make sure to try them!).
We got to see the resident dog himself! Amy does a great job with separating area and ensuring precautions are kept to ensure everyone has their own space!
Thank you, Amy for the amazing space my family and I used!
Great kitchen. Really nice host and comfortable place
It was a good experience, we had everything we needed, a train line very close, a very quiet neighborhood.
We have stayed here multiple times and it never disappoints.  Great host and location.
It was a great location to walk to Cubs games.

Easy walking distance from the blue line, multiple restaurants near by, but still quiet at night. Saurin was very responsive to messages and flexible with check-in/out times. He was also very friendly in person and easy to talk to, but also cool with just saying hi in passing when I wasn't feeling particularly talkative.
Thank you!
Staying here was a match made in heaven. Caroline is the sweetest lady you’ll ever meet and her home is furnished soo beautifully. I would give it 100 stars if I could :)
Simple but all I needed. Clear instructions.

Host was very responsive, the place was amazing and distance to other areas was not bad. I appreciate how welcoming the host made us feel and how quickly he attended to us when we needed help. Would definitely come again!

We had a wonderful stay at this house — easily one of the best value stays we’ve found on Airbnb. The space was exactly as described, with plenty of room for our group. Everything we needed was there, and the check-in process was smooth and stress-free. You really get a lot for the price, and it made the whole trip feel like a win. Would absolutely book again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable, affordable place to stay!
We loved staying in the Morgan Hill/Beverly neighborhoods - fun to see a real Chicago neighborhood with beautiful homes and great restaurants.

We enjoyed our stay at Chiara’s place. Both her and her husband were friendly and responsive. If we didn’t have something that we needed, they were quick to respond and provide the item requested. We would absolutely stay here again if we’re ever back in Chicago.

Amazing place!! Would definitely stay here again! Quiet neighborhood, cute area to walk in, super close distance to the train. Super clean and Erika was so sweet and responsive! Definitely worth the stay!!

We loved our stay at Prince and Victoria's place! It was so comfortable and clean and super walkable to the train station to get anywhere else we needed to go. They were very helpful and friendly at every turn. We would absolutely stay there again.
Loved this space! Felt very comfy and a perfect place to stay for our trip to Chicago. We fell head over heels for the nearby coffee shop Milli and walked everywhere.
Big, clean, and a nice hot tub!

Mel and Ronneisha was super friendly and communicative! The Airbnb was super tidy, spacious and the central air conditioning was a major plus. Linen was super soft and comfortable, the kitchen was spotless along with cooking essentials that they provided for us— which made the stay feel a lot like home and bathroom was nice as well with extra towels they provided for us made. I did not want to leave. My boyfriend and I will definitely return!

Displaced was excellent for a quick weekend. We use this as a homebase basically to sleep. The instructions for parking were good, and there was plenty of street parking in the area both paid and free. We were able to park in front of a bank that you could see from the window of the Airbnb ! The neighborhood felt safe and was easily walkable. The Airbnb is on the corner, but it didn’t feel like it was too in the city. The space was just enough for two people! The only warning I’ll give is that if you are a tall traveler (~6ft) your feet might hang off the bed a little bit.

The pictures don’t do this place justice! This home is great for family trips where you’re not right on top of each other but plenty of space! Emanuel was one of the best hosts I’ve ever had, from the time of checkin where he had some graduation flowers set up for my family who was visiting for my graduation, all the way to his responsiveness with things that came up during our stay. A wonderfully clean and beautifully decorated space! Wish I could give it more than five stars!
el lugar estaba tranquilo, la habitación cómoda y ordenada, no tuve problemas para llegar y había transporte y tren cerca para poder moverme

In town for Pokemon GO FEST 2026!! (Gotta catch em all!!)
Love this neighborhood. Check in was super easy with thorough info provided. ((*WATCH THE VIDEO PROVIDED)) -They walk you through everything. Hosts provided rapid responses to all questions even with later check-in. Unit was clean and in order. AC was sooo welcomed and worked nicely. Pictures matched unit.
Wholefoods, trader joes, CVS, and restaurants like: Virtue Restaurant, Ascione Bistro, and Giordano's --> ALL walk-able. Bed was comfortable. We prefer Uber and lift into downtown. ZIpcar half block up if needed.
Eclectic, inviting neighborhood. Thank you for a great stay and would absolutely stay here again.
Blessing From Boston-

Alex’s space was great. It was exactly as pictured and described in the listing and Alex was responsive and communicative throughout our stay. Would recommend the stay to anyone looking for a comfortable place to relax and enjoy Chicago.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and easy to get to. The host was incredibly attentive, communicating with us from before our trip through our last day and making sure we had everything we needed.
Getting downtown was easy using the CTA train system, though timing around traffic helped. We loved the retro arcade games. As well as the breakfast nook with coffee, cereal, and snacks was a thoughtful touch. Overall, a great experience with a fantastic host—we would definitely stay here again!
Super cute place. We enjoyed our time staying there for the weekend.
Donna was very responsive in answering my questions. She gave detailed directions in accessing the unit. We enjoyed her place.
Great place in Chinatown. Easy to get downtown. Heidi is so nice and very helpful. Loved my visit to Chicago!

This airbnb is very nice and clean. Everything looks new. The beds are comfortable. The fancy shower is amazing. It is just a short walk from the blue line that takes you downtown and to the airport. There are many restaurants nearby. The hosts ate very responsive. It is a great place to stay.
Location was amazing. Home was very clean. Easy to check-in.
Very friendly host.

Will was a great host! He was very responsive and answered quick when I had questions about his home. House was close to a lot of our activities, about a 10-15 uber ride to where we needed to go. Loved that he provided coffee and enough towels for all 10 of my party. Beds were as described and matched the pictures in the listing. I would recommend Wills home for others to stay and if I were to return to Chicago would be in my options :)
was a wonderful stay in a surprisingly large living space with a cute design. Was very close to a few different seamless transportation options for when we needed to get into the city.

This spot was ideal, close to an Aldi’s for food and close to the multiple bus spots to help get around the city. If you need a place to stay for a few days this is great and has all the amenities you may need. Gavino is super nice and responds quickly.

The property served its purpose for our trip, but there were several issues that made the stay disappointing. Upon arrival, the floors were dirty and there was a strong unpleasant odor throughout the apartment. The unit was also extremely hot, and what was not clearly disclosed in the listing was that guests are expected to set up and manage three portable air conditioning units and their exhaust hoses in order to cool the apartment. During our stay, the host unexpectedly came by to tell us to move one of the air conditioners to a different outlet, which felt intrusive and left us wondering how the issue had been identified. The surrounding area did not feel as comfortable as expected, and there were late-night disturbances nearby during our stay. Communication was prompt, but before checkout the host messaged asking for a 5-star review and stated one had already been left for us before our stay had even ended. After checkout, a reimbursement request was submitted for an accidental sta
Was great

We enjoyed a great stay at Kevin’s for my husbands 40th birthday! Such a close walk to Wrigley where we caught a game. Kevin was super accommodating for our early/late check in/out and our dogs! We personally loved having the L right next to us! It was surprisingly peaceful and made the experience that much better. Next time we are headed to a game we will definitely be staying here again!

Long’s place was absolutely perfect for what we needed. Traveled to Chicago for the first time for Pokemon Go Fest. Even though we drove, I wanted to take public transportation. Long’s place is literally 700 feet from a bus stop. It was quiet at night. Peaceful. Comfortable beds, pillows, linens. Extremely lovely shower and bathroom. Everything was perfect, and I would recommend 10/10🙏🏽

From the start Ming was very helpful. The place felt like a home away from home, cozy and peaceful. Short walking distance from a few local restaurants and some fast food establishments. Grocery store was an easy 5-10 minute walk from the stay. Train station was also just about 10 minutes away so public transit was very easily accessible from there. The A.C. In the room was also very easy to work, and it worked very well, took no time for the room to cool down once you turn it on. Would definitely recommend staying here.
Great place to stay!

We were a party of 6 adults meeting up for a reunion in Chicago. We were very happy with the house. Clean, spacious, necessary amenities. The location is terrific, right by the L subway station, and easily accessible to Lake Front Drive if taking a car downtown. The immediate neighborhood felt safe, lots of restaurants and bars and a supermarket just a block away.

Heads up, this rental smells like smoke, is lazily and cheaply decorated, and only has coffee “tea bags” and no coffee machine. Those three facets aren’t the end of the world in and of themselves except that when you charge more than $1200 a night… it’s borderline usurious. At that price point, it better be a baller. Very disappointed and feeling ripped off.
A unit with a nice view and great for family

Freddy's place was the perfect location for us - right near family we were visiting. It was easy to get in and out and was nice and cozy.
One note, especially for any other short folks like us that stay here - the pole with hangers on it in one of the bedrooms was impossible to reach - we had to get creative in order to get the hangers down to use them elsewhere. Ended up working fine, but I wonder if Freddy could come up with a similar creative solution to attach a lower pole for easier access!
Grateful for the convenient and comfy place to stay, will almost definitely be back!
I would definitely recommend this place very peaceful great host and beautiful place will stay again
The space was great, exactly as I expected.  Perfect location in South Loop and everyone was nice and friendly.
The Banksy was a great place to stay, and our host Robert was extremely responsive and helpful during our stay!
I love my stay at Ian's place!  Very convenient location by the brown line with so many cafes and restaurants nearby!
Carl was very helpful. Place as described and cheaper than anything else by a long way.

We stayed here while visiting Chicago for Pokémon GO Fest, and this Airbnb was perfect for our group! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Having two full bathrooms made getting ready each day so much easier.
The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful, while still being convenient to navigate around the city. Parking was easy and a huge plus for our trip.
Also Rashad was an excellent host! He was friendly, welcoming, and always quick to respond whenever we had a question. He was also awesome for allowing our group an early check-in, which made our arrival day much smoother and more enjoyable.
Overall, this was a fantastic place to stay, and we would absolutely book again on a future trip to Chicago. Highly recommend!
Great spot in a lovely location!
The place was great. Very clean when we got there, easy check-in and very easy checkout instructions
This was a fantastic place 👍

Amazing stay in Rogers Park!! Iris was an incredible host and the space was the perfect place to stay while visiting our son who lives in the area. Check-in and check-out were both seamless--unit was easy to find and parking available near the building. The unit was so nicely decorated and thoughtfully appointed--it had everything we could need during our stay! Rogers Park is a wonderful neighborhood with a great grocery store (Morse Market), convenience store (Rogers Market), coffee shop (Common Cup), restaurant (Asian Station) and cocktail bar (Rogers Social) within a block or two. The train is convenient to get downtown or ballpark (Cubs won!). If you are visiting on a Sunday, be sure to check out the Rogers Park farmer's market from 9-12. I'm still thinking about the pastries and coffee....
Iris was a wonderful host and we will definitely stay here again when we are in town!!
Cute spot great for little adventures.

We loved staying here.  Great location and we could walk to most everything!  Sitting on the rooftop porch was a highlight.  Very peaceful even with the park across the road.  Great neighborhood with restaurants and a historic jazz club within minutes.  We would definitely stay again.

My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Cozy Nest. It's the first time we had stayed outside of the "hustle and bustle" of downtown and it was amazing. The space was just as described. It was clean, simple and had all the basics you could ever need. Being a native New Yorker, I appreciated the proximity to the "El" and was not bothered by a space that has definitely been lived in for many years. I would highly recommend and would stay here again!

We had a lovely stay at Tony's place, but in all honesty we just needed a clean, comfortable and safe place to sleep. We were out and about from dawn to late at night, so never really used the kitchen, living area or other amenities. Everything listed including photos were accurate so I think we would have been good if we needed to use any of the amenities.
There were add-on costs for guests and parking and we had to do more clean up on our way out than I'm used to doing at other AirBnBs that I've stayed at recently. BUT everything was clearly communicated so really there were no surprises between the host and us.
Tony was great and timely with communications. Very clear so we didn't go to the wrong address and gave us info on how to get into the house early on so we could plan, etc.
Plus: great black out curtains in bedroom Minus: The HVAC blower was loud
All-in-all - a great AirBnB and great hosts! Thanks for sharing your apartment with us.
Cozy home with parking

We had such a great stay at Andy’s place for two nights. It’s conveniently located near UChicago, and the neighborhood is quiet and peaceful. Andy’s home is incredibly cozy and truly feels like a home away from home. Everything was spotless, and the bathroom was well stocked with everything we needed. Andy is also super responsive and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again the next time we’re in Chicago!
Dan is an amazing host, extremely communicate & check in to see if we needed anything!
Very helpful and friendly.
This place was super cute, and had easy parking. we also enjoyed how easy it was to get on the train from this spot. Michelle was awesome and always super responsive. would definitely stay again😊

Very responsive host, space was just as described in the listing.  Plus for me was very close to the L.  (Not too close--no noise from the trains).  Also bike rental racks are right there.  I felt as safe there as I have in any neighborhood I've inhabited or visited in the USA.   Large fridge and functional kitchen if you need that.

The minor problems that happened during my 3 month stay were quickly fixed!  Nice place.  I would have liked to have known it was a garden apartment beforehand (below ground) but it was comfortable and convenient.  Very efficient and helpful host.  Close to UChicago, which I needed.

We stayed at Century Management’s Airbnb in Chinatown, Chicago. Overall, the place was clean, had great closet space, easy parking, and a great location close to bars and restaurants.
A few things to know before booking: there is no bathroom on the main floor. The three bedrooms are upstairs with one full bathroom. The lower level has an open room at the bottom of the stairs, plus one private room with a door and a second full bathroom. The downstairs shower is small and has a flimsy shower curtain, so be careful with water getting on the floor.
The main floor has the living room, kitchen, and the only TV. The kitchen was a bit limited on dishes, pots, and pans, so plan ahead if you intend to cook or eat meals there. The ice maker also did not work during our stay.
The biggest issue we had was getting locked out on our second night. We left the house Saturday night and had trouble getting back in. It took over an hour to reach someone and have the code reset.
I would recommend it,

We really enjoyed the place. Roomy, quiet and very nice furnishings. Bed was comfortable. Parking was always available. Great area to utilize the bus to almost any popular area in Chicago. I'll definitely check for this place when we come back.

This no frills accommodation was perfect for my short weekend work trip. The toiletries and slippers were a nice touch and came in handy. Laundry was helpful too. Great stay for the right price for someone just needing a place to rest. Would stay again!

We enjoyed our stay.  The neighborhood is vibrant and the apartment has everything you need.  Aisha is a responsive host answering any questions we had in a timely manner.  Would definitely stay here again in the future.

Mark was an excellent host and made our stay a great experience from start to finish. Communication was always quick, clear, and friendly, and he went out of his way to be accommodating whenever we had questions.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was clear that a lot of care had gone into making the space welcoming and enjoyable for guests.
We had a wonderful stay and would happily return in the future. I highly recommend Mark as a host to anyone considering staying at his property.

Jean’s House was clean, cute and located in a great walkable neighborhood. Larry the host was always ready to answers questions or send over supplies. Larry is doing maintenance on the bathroom but he updated me - which I prefer over cancelling. The kitchen is great/updated, comfortable bedrooms (with blackout curtains!), close to a grocery store, and Larry got a pack n play for my daughter. I love this neighborhood and parking was so easy!
Great location, and clean.  Bed is a bit small for two people.  Overall a nice stay.
About eight minute walk from Chicago, Milwaukee blue line station. Comfortable and spacious. Coffee shop and pizza place over the road but limited nearby shopping. Supermarket about 15 minute walk.

Doko and the co-hosts were very friendly, clear with their instructions, and made the place feel right at home. The place was easy to find and get in to, and was very walkable to the train station! We had a great trip!
Great stay! Exactly as described. Enjoyed it and no complaints!
Great place above an art studio in a fun neighborhood with a cool vibe in the apartment. Highly recommend!

We stayed at Mike’s place for our son’s wedding. There were 7 of us including our granddaughter and we had plenty of room and they had a high chair and pack and play.  There was also a washer/dryer which was super convenient!! Definitely worth it!

Great affordable place to stay and enjoy what Chicago has to offer without having the overcrowded busy city lifestyle right outside your door. Location is more low-key with free off street parking and cute family restaurants. My daughter and I used rideshare for all our easy commutes which was only 15 minutes to and from the venues we came for. Mel and Ronneisha's was easy to find and remodeled beautifully. We'd definitely come back!
Close to Wrigley, nice area to walk around.

My Pup and I really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was very spacious, clean and also private.
Alma was very responsive as a host and easy to communicate with. I would definitely stay again.

the first picture for this listing was a beautiful patio that we didn’t have access to, or at least, weren’t told how to access it. we were offered early check in and accepted and paid the cleaning fee, yet, there were massive clumps of dust in higher places, but still within eye view, as well as dust bunnies on the floor in bathrooms and dust on the shower wall. i will say. they were pretty communicative and as things came up (like the AC not working or missing towels) they were address in a timely manner. the only thing left unaddressed was the cleanliness of the place. the area was close to the train station which made everything accessible and it felt safe enough to walk around in there were also things within the unit that needed patching. holes in doors, holes in the ceiling, a crack in one of the wood planks for the top bunk bed, the uneven mattress on the bottom.

Rebecca was an exceptional host. From the moment I arrived, she was kind, welcoming, and very clear with all the instructions, which made the stay smooth and stress-free.
She is genuinely friendly and creates a warm atmosphere without ever being intrusive. During my stay, she generously shared a homemade dinner with me, and we had a wonderful time talking and getting to know each other. She also took the time to show me around the neighborhood, which helped me feel comfortable and familiar with the area.
I especially appreciated her hospitality, openness, and respect for my privacy. Her home was comfortable, well organized, and I always felt welcome throughout my stay.
I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend Rebecca to anyone looking for a pleasant and authentic Airbnb experience.
Very nice home and peaceful. Only downside was no tv and a little hot due to AC units and not central air.  The family was very nice and the place was beyond clean. Several walkable eateries.

Jennifer is a great host and her place is a gem. A few steps to Lake Michigan, short walk to the train, and the local dining options were fantastic. We even found bathing suits at a vintage clothing store for an impromptu dip in the water.
She was very helpful and responsive. Met all our needs. Will gladly come back again.
Host was clear with instructions. Location was amazing and the place was pristine.

Alex was a wonderful host! We drove 13 hours to Chicago and the place was ready to go, easy to find, and easy to get into, with great detailed instructions so that way we could just relax when we got there. The location was great because it was just a quick 15 to 20 minute drive downtown and whenever we didn’t wanna go downtown, the location was super walkable with great restaurants and vintage shops.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! The location was fantastic, with easy access to restaurants, shopping, public transportation, and many of Chicago’s attractions. It made exploring the city incredibly convenient.
The home was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed during our stay. The amenities were great, and the space felt both welcoming and well cared for.
The hosts were outstanding—friendly, responsive, and always quick to help whenever we had a question. Their excellent communication made the entire experience smooth and stress-free. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this property to anyone visiting Chicago.

Great place! I was in Chicago for a couple of days and this was the perfect spot. Very clean and cozy and had everything I needed. It was easy to get around and check in was a breeze. Would definitely recommend staying here and I hope to be back soon!!

My partner and I stayed here for his birthday weekend. The neighborhood is alright, not the best or worst. The complex itself though more than makes up for it. There is a locked gate to even reach the complex(they give you the code), and then obviously the lock you have on your units door. It’s a beautiful complex. The inside was neat, clean, and just enough for the two of us. It’s small so I wouldn’t recommend for more than 2 people ideally. We did rideshare to downtown Chicago, which was kind of pricey due to the distance and traffic, but could’ve been worse. Overall, it felt like a safe, comfortable place to stay at while exploring the city, and the host’s description of the property and pictures was accurate. The host also is very timely on responding to messages, and very proactive on sharing information with you about your stay, such as how to check in, check out, and what not. I would recommend, and I would stay again if I was in the area.
Incredible space! Right in the heart of river north, beautiful large living space and balcony. Everything was clean and clearly communicated

Carly was a very friendly host, she was responsive and helpful.
The apartment looked as advertised. It was comfortable and spacious.
The location was great. It was less than a 5 min walk to the blue line. It was in a safe neighborhood with lots to do close bye. The farmers market on Sunday was great.
We were able to store luggage before/after check-in/check out which was very convenient and helpful.

The communication with the host is what really stand out to me, always helpfull, always there to answer your questions - you can surely trust this place! We been delighted to be offered late check out as a complimentary gesture from the host, which we really appreciate 🫶. The apartment has lovely common terrace which is available for guests.
However, this is a really tiny studio suited for 1-2 people. We booked it for 3 people and there was no bed nor proper linen and readily prepared pillows, duvet, only the mattress that you have to figure out how to fit in this small space. Not recommend booking for more than 2 people. Also, the noice cancellation is terrible, you can hear everything outside the apartment. Speaking about the neighborhood it felt safe 🌼, many grocery shops and cool bar near by. It is accessible via one metro line, otherwise you must use public busses, which can be inconvenient. Walking is not always an option as closest activity-wise area is 2 kilometers away.

Sharon was very helpful with instructions for entry and kind and thoughts of the other tenants of the property. Important because that reciprocated to us as well. On our checkout we were able to meet her partner who was very helpful for future recommendations of things to do in the area. Both very friendly and a positive experience.

Overall, nice place, good value, and very responsive host. The location is great for a game at Wrigley, less than a 5 minute walk, yet on a quiet street (for the city). Good for 1-2 people for a few days. Things to know about this unit, it is on the 3rd, top floor, with no elevator so if you have mobility issues, or lots of luggage that may be an issue. It is also an older building so it comes with its own quirks. For example, trying to use multiple appliances at once (window a/c, hair dryer, microwave, etc) at once risks tripping the circuit. The host does warn you about this, and it wasn’t an issue for me, but something that guests should be aware of.

Great neighborhood and location if your goal is to access Wrigleyville. Property is two blocks to the 'L' which makes transportation to downtown Chicago easy. Lots of restaurants in the area around Matt's place. Matt really communicated well, we had conversations with him and his dog just about every morning as we sat on his front porch. Thanks for everything Matt!
We really enjoyed staying at Joe’s place. It was comfortable and had everything we needed. We were also provided excellent instruction which made everything easy.
Had a solid stay at this location. The apartment was very clean and communications were timely and clear!

We stayed here for a long weekend with 6 people, 3 couples. It’s great for couples since all bedrooms have an en-suite bathroom. The location is great, extremely walkable and safe. And such a fun area! I would definitely recommend this spot!
Thank you Mindy and Tony for being responsive to my messages. Appreciate your clear instructions. Thank you for your hospitality.

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago. The location was convenient and close to public transportation, making it easy to get around the city. Check-in was simple and hassle-free, with clear instructions and easy access to the property.
The listing description and photos were accurate and matched exactly what we found upon arrival. The host was extremely responsive and helpful throughout our stay, which made the experience even better.
Overall, this was a wonderful place to stay, and we would happily book again on a future trip to Chicago.

Jennifer’s place looked exactly like the photos so absolutely no surprise there. The place was just as cute in person. Jennifer was very kind and helpful in her communications and even left eggs and salsa for us. The location was perfect for us and street parking was available at any time.
Unfortunately, the place was not clean in some areas. The inside of the fridge was visibly dirty, the sponge in the kitchen had seen better days and there was a smell to the throw pillows on the bed. The light in one of the bedrooms was broken too. I am writing this because I would have liked to know about this before booking, however, after we did some cleaning and bought a new sponge, we enjoyed our stay!
Thank you for sharing your home with us.  We greatly appreciate the place.  The house is sooo big and comfortable. Everything was well supplied and everyone in our party was pleasantly surprised.

my stay was peaceful and relaxing. Its located in walking distance from the blue line, making traveling into the city easy! a few restaurants are alos nearby.
Line and Peter are excellent hosts. the room was clean and tidy and the bathroom was spotless!

the place was perfect. comfortable beds, neightborhood was peaceful and quite, supermarket down the street. lots more good things to say but im short on time. im booking again if i ever go back to chicago.
I would stay here again. Easy to find and location was great. Walkable to everything we needed. Super responsive host. Thank you!

We really loved staying here. The house was super spacious and probably one of the cleanest Airbnbs we’ve stayed in. Everything was spotless and well taken care of.
The location was great too. We were able to walk to a bunch of good food spots, and one day we just wandered around 18th St and found some really cool vintage and record stores. The area felt safe, and everyone we met was friendly.
The hosts were very communicative and easy to reach whenever we had questions. Honestly, everything was so smooth that we didn’t need much help during our stay. Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!
We felt very at home. The house was very cozy. Host gave clear directions to the house and entry. We had a small issue and he had it handled before we got back for the day.
I was super happy with my stay! The host was such a big help and was extremely fast at responding to my questions. I’ll definitely stay here again!!

Even though there was a check mark through the AC under amenities, there was no mention of it anywhere else, like house rules, etc. June in Chicago, 14th floor in a low income remodel apartment is hot & muggy, and a basic amenity in the Midwest. It should have been expressly detailed in the listing. There were areas for window units, but Jorge just provided fans. It was quite uncomfortable and very expensive ( more than $400 a night + fees) and gelt it was intentionally left out of the listing to sneak it by.
Jorge was extremely responsive and kind, however not likely to stay at another of his properties.

Austin’s place was perfect for our group of 6 adults and 2 children! Lots of hang space to choose from as well as comfortable bed & bathroom accommodations. It was super convenient to get around with the CTA blue line so close and there were plenty of walkable food options. Austin was a fantastic host! Definitely a 10/10 Airbnb.

I think I can safely say that Mark's place is the best experience I've had with Airbnb.  Mark was extremely responsive and flexible and generous with the space.  Everything was extremely easy.  It was a lot of space for 5 people.  We were in town for Cubs games and the walk to Wrigley was easy and there's a lot to do around the place.  I couldn't recommend this place any more strongly!
We had a great time and the location is very convenient. We did have a night in which the Central Air stopped working and we did message Stephanie a bit late but it did get fixed the following day.

Went for Pokemon Go Fest, great location walkable to Grant Park.  Easy to uber from and the parking across the street was great. If you need to be in this area of the city, perfect place to stay for events in the park or stadium. Cute local pub one block down and easy coffee places on the xor we. Great value, especially for four friends staying with private baths and laundry.

Sue’s place is located in a fantastic neighborhood with plenty of great restaurants and access to transportation. Her place was fantastic with plenty of additional amenities and she was always there to help when needed! A+++

Jared’s place was a fantastic choice for me and 5 friends who had a lot planned in Chicago. Check-in and check-out were easy and the host gave us good privacy. Felt safe staying there and it was close to a lot of things we did. I would definitely recommend staying at Jared’s place.
Bernard’s place is cozy and has everything for a confortable stay. The neighborhood is nice, a quiet residential area but a short walk to cafes, shops and restaurants.
lovely basement apt. you do have to go through the basement garage. the actual door to apt would lock from the inside but when leaving no way to lock.

Jane was a great host.  The area is nice with walkable restaurants and convenience stores. This place was absolutely perfect. We flew in from southern California to catch a couple of Cubs games. We went to 5! The location was perfect walking distance to Wrigley. David's place was well maintained, clean, comfortable, and wonderfully decorated. Definitely plan on staying there again. Thanks David

This place was very easy to find, close to trains (both CTA and Metra) only a few blocks away.   Morse Grocery store is a few blocks.   The on-site parking was great!   The place looks just like the photos!
Great deal if you’re bringing a large group. In a good location

Everything was just as described.
She always responded quickly to the messages I sent,
Everything was very clean,
I would definitely book with her again.

I felt safe and secure in this Air BB. I had a lock on the door to close when I left and could secure my room. The door was easy to open with a code. I got my instructions in a timely manner. They always responded politely and promptly when I messaged.

An amazing place right outside the city! Excellent location that's not too far driving  from O'Hare  Airport and within walking distance from the Jefferson station. A beautiful apartment in a fantastic location in Chicago!!! Just steps away from Lincoln Park & the zoo and easy transportation to downtown Chicago. Close to many great restaurants and coffee shops too. We had a great stay and would recommend to anyone looking for a more local Chicago experience.

Have no reservations about making reservations. Don’t tell anyone about this diamond in the rough that is a quick Uber to U of C!  We made a friend in Latarsha!  Our top pick for U of C.

Gerry was an excellent host, very responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. The Airbnb looked exactly as pictured, was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Mary was a great host and this location is awesome! Very clean apartment and a nice area to be in. My stay worked out perfectly and I would highly recommend! Thank you Mary!
Place was exactly as advertised. I absolutely would stay there again. Great views

This place was awesome for our group of 8! It was only about 15-20 minutes from Solider Field where our event was. We really enjoyed our stay here!

Fantastic host!!! Fantastic place. Lots of room for a large group. The surrounding area is very nice and clean. There are multiple convenient stores and restaurants within walking distance. We would definitely choose to stay again if needed. Thank you so much!

Charla's place was exactly what we expected and needed and the price was right. It was conveniently located in walking distance to UChicago, which is why we were there.
