in sum: if you are looking for an affordable apartment near beautiful UChicago in beautiful Hyde Park with a friendly and responsive host -- totally worth it! Just be aware it has a few small kinks.
We had a pleasant stay at Joanna’s place for a long weekend! Spacious and good location, 15 min walk to the metro
Had a great stay!

My brothers and I felt very accommodated and at home. It was a perfect spot right outside of the big city. Full kitchen, plenty of space and we all had our own rooms for privacy at night. Couldn’t be any better :-)
Kristen was a great and responsive host! The place was very clean and ready for us.
Amazing apartment with gorgeous views in a great location! Can't beat it.

Our stay was great. Ryan was very quick to respond and thorough. I loved how clean the apartment was, the location was centric, convenient and safe.   We always found parking.  I wholeheartedly recommend this property and definitely would consider returning.
It was a cozy neat place to stay especially the washroom was spacious, neat and had the toiletries needed for a relaxed bath.
Great place to stay!
Great place to stay with an easy train ride into the city

It doesn’t feel like an Airbnb it feels like a home away from home. Luis has put a lot of thought and attention to detail in making this place special for each guest. It is a great value for the price. I would definitely stay again.

Our stay at this Airbnb was pleasant overall. The highlight of the unit was definitely the balcony with lovely city views, a perfect place to enjoy morning coffee. The space was comfortable for our group, though it would benefit from some general upkeep to address minor maintenance issues. We also found a few basic supplies like coffee filters, dishwashing liquid, and body wash, either low or not provided.
Lumi, the host, was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Overall, we enjoyed our time here and appreciated the great communication!

The place was smaller than expected but clean, and very nice, the bathroom mirror was a little messed up, but other than that no complaints, great location, surge pricing for city events was definitely in place, however.

We had a great 4 night stay! The house was clean and comfortable. Mila was the perfect host; not intrusive and available when needed. The location was convenient, in a quiet neighborhood, with stores and restaurants galore. We highly recommend and would absolutely stay again!
Great location- right between the airport and downtown. Safe neighborhood and plenty of space.
Great place! Not far from Wrigley field. Great neighborhood and awesome for walking.
Good stay
Great place to stay with great hosts. Would return again next time in the area.

My stay was great! The train wasnt loud, its right outside. The bed is a full, so tall people beware. The building keeps the gym, pool, and other areas very clean. We got to grill outside, alot of people were in the pool, it is only 3.5ft.
Area felt super safe! With the traffic that was going on that day we decided just to walk the 30 minutes to and from the shed aquarium, it was a nice walk!
Just overall the stay was calming, Victor did a great job, super friendly and responsive!
We just loved our stay!  Spotlessly clean, safe, exactly as advertised, good value.  Will definitely stay again!!!

This was a great place for our family to stay during our visit to Chicago! We were there to watch SF Giants play the Cubs and the proximity to Wrigley Field did not disappoint. The unit itself was spacious and clean and had everything we needed. Would highly recommend this as a desirable location for exploring the city.

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago for Pokémon GO Fest! Jacob was always quick to answer any questions I had and he is someone that truly does listen and care about his guests! The place was very cozy and welcoming, and the central air conditioning was amazing after a long day of walking! This location was lovely to walk or take a short Uber ride to all the things! Felt like a cozy sanctuary in the middle of the busy city. Once our hiccups were worked out we enjoyed the apartment, the area, and our hosts communication.
Very nice place, clean, comfortable, and convenient.

First time in Chicago and this place was really nice to stay at. The fact that the bus stop is literally right outside your block is convenient. Especially with the metro being a bit less than a 5 minute walk from there as well! Helped us get around better without needing to uber everywhere.
Very clean and comfortable. Great location, close to restaurants and grocery store.
The host was great, everything is like in the pictures..

This was a fantastic place to stay overall, and I would recommend it to anyone traveling to Chicago. The home was very clean with a very nice bathroom and kitchen. Parking was pretty difficult to find in the evening but there was plenty available during the day. The public transportation options in the area were simple to navigate and very efficient to get downtown.

This was a wonderful place to stay! Everything was thought out, clean, and intentional. Lydia responded quickly and clearly when I had questions. I was close to the train and to downtown. Had a great stay the place was cozy and close to everything we needed

Place is very beautiful the pictures were a little deceiving and the space was kinda  small but overall my friend group had a good time just wish it had a little more space he was a very friendly host!

Zone 143 covers a really large area so your permit will even cover parking close to nearby restaurants. An overall great space and would definitely consider booking here again!

I’d give ten stars if I could! Olgi and Paul’s accommodations were perfect for us. The house is on a lovely, quiet street of homes. I can’t say enough good things about Olgi and Paul. They were very prompted in communicating with us. They provided parking permits and truly went out of their way to make sure we had a close place to park. (We arrived in town shortly before the start of a Cubs game when parking was almost non-existent!) Both were very gracious hosts!

What an amazing stay! The apartment was clean, spacious, and especially unique. The industrial punk theme, artwork, memorabilia, and record collection gave it so much character.
There was plenty of room for a group of 6-8, the kitchen was well-equipped, and the location worked perfectly for us. Getting around was easy, with quick rideshares and convenient access to areas we wanted to visit.
Martin clearly put a lot of thought into the guest experience. There were thoughtful touches throughout the apartment, and it was stocked with many little things travelers often forget or end up needing. He was friendly, communicative, accommodating, and flexible with an early check-in, which we greatly appreciated.
If you’re interested in industrial music history, there’s also a museum downstairs that offers tours — totally worth checking out. We’d absolutely stay here again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a unique place to stay in Chicago!
What a beautiful place so close to UChicago.  I would choose to stay here every time I returned to Chicago.  Thank you, Leonard, for being so responsive and caring.  Loved the little gifts too!

Great place, great location, safe neighborhood

had a great stay while in Chicago for a long weekend. no issues with checking in or otherwise. nice and clean. comfy bed. clear instructions for check out. it was nice to have the attached garage, great for loading and unloading our stuff. would stay here again, was a great deal for the price.

Had an absolutely amazing experience with the host, super kind and friendly. Extremely clean place with easy to find appliances.

Great place in a good area, lots of cafés and eating spots around. The host was clear with the instructions and description, and the room was clean and spacious to comfortably fit 2 people. Would book again due to the affordability and location!

Darsh was very responsive and so friendly during our stay. The place is beautiful and in a perfect walkable neighborhood. Would love to stay here when I come back to Chicago!

It was exactly as described and the pictures showed what you where getting! I went for go fest. We were walking distance from a lot of places and even walking distance from the blue line tram which took you straight into the heart of Chicago
this was the perfect landing pad for us on our trip to chicago. host was responsive and space was clean and welcoming. would love to stay here again on our next trip to chicago

great house to stay at with extremely convenient location near the green line train. neighborhood is nice and quiet and relaxing after a long day in the city!

Our stay was better than we could have asked for! The AirBnb was so spacious and clean. It was also a great location to catch the bus into the city. Only thing there wasn’t many restaurants around but overall great stay!
Great place. Awesome location and spacious
Nice place that was very accessible to the city, had a good stay, Angelica was responsive and ensured we were accommodated with anything we needed

I stayed at this beautiful Chicago home for my graduation with my family, and it was perfect. The bedrooms were comfortable and well‑resourced, and the location couldn’t have been better — close to everything we needed throughout the weekend. We especially loved having two separate gathering spaces, which made hosting different family events so easy. This home truly made our celebration even more special. Highly recommend.
We were blown away by the feeling of being up in the trees and yet in the city. We will be back!

Overall good experience and what was expected. Looked just like photos and good for a small group weekend trip. The floors are very squeaky so you can hear the people above you. Missing a few essentials in the kitchen like coffee grounds and wine opener. They offered to drop off coffee and next day and did. Some ants were in the kitchen. They offered to send pest control. If I needed a place to stay I would book with them again.

Quiet, walkable neighborhood with most amenities nearby, and with the Blue Line station so close you can be in the heart of the city in under half an hour. Perfect for those flying in from O’Hare! The only thing I can really complain about was the temperature of the room; we were provided a small fan but even when the host turned on the air it never penetrated our room and was pretty uncomfortable. Otherwise, if you’re looking to save a few bucks and don’t mind the slight inconveniences of sharing a house with strangers, I highly recommend this place!
We had a great stay at Joe's apartment. The apartment was nice. We loved the neighborhood. We would stay there again.
Nice stay!! It was a great location for me and my friends!!
This home is so lovely. Perfectly decorated and in a great walkable neighborhood. Justine was very responsive and a great host. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a fun trip to Chicago!
Great location. Free parking was fantastic!  Would stay again next time in Chicago.

Airbnb location is very convenient as it is downtown and is walkable distance to everything. Our family enjoyed the stay. Host was very responsive and accommodating! Apartment was clean and spacious. We would definitely book again and would recommend!
Nicholas was very accommodating even for early check in. He went above and beyond at his location. Very nice and quiet. Definitely recommend.
The location and size of the unit were great. It was walkable to everything we had planned and accommodated the six of us staying there.
Great spot for a great price.
Everything was seamless and as advertised. Instructions were clear. Place was clean and has the necessary amenities.
Great place will be Back!
Great access to Andersonville!
Juan was very helpful and flexible. The place was clean and easy to access. I enjoyed the privacy. Great stay
Beautiful Airbnb home! Quaint, clean and safe. Host was helpful, responsive and communicated effectively. Would highly recommend this home! Great job Sean!
Outstanding location and great space.  It was close to shopping, food and the el.  Thank you for hosting us.
I enjoy the stay and especially so close to the train station. It was very nice and quiet that I enjoy my stay tremendously. I also liked how secure the place is and put me in ease.
Great place for our long Chicago weekend
Great place in Chicago. A bit expensive but very clean and cozy. Good parking and located near Starbucks and stores.
Friendly host and perfect spot. Walking distance to multiple bars and restaurants. He also left us snacks and a hand written note!
Great place to stay!! Edwin was a great host 😊
Friendly and nice host. Easy to find, get in, and always quick to respond.
Excelente departamento, ubicación perfecta con restaurantes muy buenos alrededor,  muy cómodo y limpio, volvería a hospedarme sin duda alguna

We had an absolutely wonderful visit. The unit was impeccable - pristine, beautifully appointed with great attention to detail, and very spacious.
We really appreciated being away from the bustle of the city and in a quiet, residential neighborhood, with wonderful options for coffee, food, and drinks within walking distance.
All in all, a perfect stay! We hope to be back.
Shawn was an awesome and attentive host. He provided clear and easy check-in/out instructions and I would definitely like to stay again
Great place to stay would recommend to anyone

There were definitely pros and cons that came with our stay.
PROS:
The space was comfy and clean. Hosts were responsive when messaged. Short walk to the night life- many local bars and restaurants just around the corner. Short walk (12 minutes or so) to a bus route and to the red line. We also enjoyed the floor warming component of the bathroom!
CONS:
Each morning of our stay, we didn’t need an alarm clock as we were woken by loud stomps and a child dropping play toys along with loud noise from both adult and child above the bedroom we were sleeping in, always prior to 8am. If you want to sleep in past 7am, this is likely not the place for you.
Be careful walking down the stairs as the stairs are steep and slippery no matter what shoes you’re wearing.
We loved our stay at Theodora’s place! It was exactly what we needed for our weekend away in Chicago. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, luxurious space for a Chicago getaway!

Sezgin was a super host! The house was exactly as described-beautiful, great amenities, and the master suite was spotless and very comfortable. The neighborhood is peaceful and the neighbors very friendly.  There are several restaurants in the area, and it’s very walkable.  We had only minor questions upon arrival and Sezgin was super responsive and helpful. It was fun to meet the other guests too!  We highly recommend his place! Thanks Sezgin!
Great host always replied when I needed him would recommend !!

This is a great spot for a group gathering. It is not too fancy, but it is in great proximity to the expressway and other forms of public transportation and walking to hot spots in Chicago. For anyone that is looking to get some friends together for a trip to Chicago, this is a great spot to do it! Assel is super responsive, and the instructions were very clear for accessing the property.
Cozy spot, perfect for a weekend stay!
Very satisfied.

We really enjoyed our stay. We are a family of 5, with 17, 15, and 11 year old kids. It accommodated us very well. The place was clean and as described in the listing. The rooftop terrace was great, with a really cool view. The neighborhood felt very safe, and great restaurants are a short walk away. Definitely recommend this place.
Wonderful place to stay. Felt at home.

Really enjoyed the location of the property. Super close to the metro station. So much space for everyone. Only issue was getting into the property. we had to call someone to help us. It took about 30 min. But once inside no further problems were had. They were quick to help us if we had any needs.

Mi dispiace perché l' host è disponibile ma è stata una delle peggiori esperienze con Airbnb. Non si tratta di una stanza ma di un verone proprio scantinato tecnico arredato alla bella e meglio (vintage è altro) dove non circola aria in nessun modo, con un odore terribile, il soffitto raggiungibile alzando un braccio, con un bagno sporchissimo , con un dito di grasso sulle luci e sul pavimento. Non esiste un modo di chiudere a chiave l'alloggio e anche la porta esterna, dotata di combinazione, si apre semplicemente girando la maniglia. La cosa più grave : se scoppiasse un incendio al piano di sopra, lo scantinato NON ha alcuna via d'uscita, impossibile venirne fuori.
Una esperienza da cancellare.

This place is adorable. If you’re doing anything in the theater district, this is the place for you. It’s also located close to all of the major downtown parks. I was there for Pokémon Go Fest in Grant Park, and it couldn’t have been any easier.

Joe was a great host! He let us drop off our luggage at the Airbnb before we checked in so we were able to go and explore until the cleaning crew was complete and it was time for check in. The house was great and in the cutest neighborhood. We would definitely stay here again!

Very responsive host. Check in was a little confusing because there were multiple lock boxes on the gate. Location and cleanliness were excellent.  I don’t mind the sound of the train, but it could be bothersome to some people.
Clean space, efficient check-in. A bit pricey  for its distance from transit, but great overall.
I always enjoy staying here when I visit Chicago.  Close to Midway Airport in the nice Pilsen community and the Loop.

The location was very convenient. We were in town for my daughter’s wedding, and she lives nearby. The area is very pretty, safe, and quiet for a bustling Chicago neighborhood! The garden apartment was perfect for the four of us. It was very clean and comfortable. My husband especially appreciated the Nespresso coffee machine in the kitchen. We would 100% stay here again!

We had a friends weekend in Chicago with friends coming in from multiple places. Matthew’s place was exactly what we needed. It is super nice, easy to find and having access to the garage was a big plus. The location was great.

Rasheed was kind and gave very nice and simple instructions for check in and out. The house was easy to find, and exactly like the pictures. The perfect location for us too. It’s in a really nice neighborhood and we could walk to the grocery or restaurants, or order in. The space was great, and had everything we needed. The beds and couch were comfy  and TVs were nice too. Everything was clean and well taken care of. Was a great experience for our first time in Chicago and for an Airbnb!

Eine wirklich tolle Unterkunft, in der wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt haben! Alles war sauber, gemütlich eingerichtet und wir durften die Küche samt Kaffee und Wasser voll mitnutzen. Ein großes Plus war das private Bad mit viel Platz für die eigenen Sachen. Ein kleiner Tipp für zukünftige Gäste: Das Haus ist (typisch für die Bauweise vor Ort) recht hellhörig, sodass man andere Mitbewohner hören kann. Nachts war es aber ruhig und wir haben super geschlafen.

Overall, "okay" describes this studio which is small even for Chicago standards. Cleanliness was not great (hair in shower, dead bugs stuck to bathroom walls, stains on towels and bedding), all the neighbors seem to slam their doors, and it is nothing special. Nothing egregious happened and it is doable for a quick weekend stay, especially for the neighborhood, but if you plan ahead enough you can do much better. For almost $800 for 2 nights, I have had much better and nicer stays in Chicago. I have also had worse stays elsewhere. So yeah, it's "okay".
Great place with great location. Very clean and as advertised

Aaron and his team were very communicative and helpful during our booking and stay. It was a little tricky finding parking due to the area, and the front door was a little sticky- but it just needed a little shove. 🤣
Air conditioning worked great, other guests were respectful. Very close to restaurants, bus, & train lines. Thank you for a safe, affordable place to stay on our trip!

The neighborhood is peaceful and safe. The furniture looks like GoodWill cast offs. It is worn, scuffed, and poor quality. The floor was so dirty that the children had to wear socks else their feet became black with dirt. The linens for the beds were cheap and mediocre; one bed didn't have a top sheet. Some rooms had a closet space but not a closet i.e. no bar to hang clothes. Also, there were very few hangers and a tiny space to put folded clothes. The bedside tables were poorly put together particle board. One of the beds was not very comfortable - we could feel the springs. The nicer sofa had 2 cigarette burns; the other sofa wasn't very big. The place is advertised for 10; we were 5 adults and 2 children, and it wasn't big enough for all of us. The dining table could really only seat 4 because there isn't enough room for it in the kitchen. Some of the A/C vents were covered - one was in the closet!
The peaceful neighborhood was nice; the few neighbors we saw were nice
Had the best time! We felt so at home, such a great neighborhood💕

Neon Dream worked out well for our extended family attending our daughter's college graduation.  We had a great time and made good use of all the spaces (e.g. bar, pool table, sitting areas, quiet TV spot). Kate and Eddie were very generous and responsive hosts and made our trip as easy and comfortable as possible. I highly recommend it for large groups who want a convenient location in the heart of Chicago.
Great place, great  host , great time!
The perfect place to stay while visiting family! Will definitely be back!

I had a wonderful stay here. The place was easy to find, very clean, and looked exactly like the photos. It was incredibly relaxing and comfortable, which made my trip even better. The host was welcoming and very responsive, which I really appreciated. I would definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago.

The place was as pictured and quiet. Good for a traveling group of people. The included parking spot being close to downtown was great for us. The bathrooms were clean and so was the place in general. The assortment of snacks and drinks are a nice touch. No issues with AC or hot water.
The surroundings have much to be desired as well as the exterior of the building but that's not the hosts fault. The beds and pillows were a little firm but that's just a personal preference, otherwise comfortable.
Good value for the money, close to the center, equipped with everything needed including plenty of coffee.
David was an excellent host and had great communication. The place was spacious and super clean. Will rent again!
Great gem in a cool part of Chicago.  She was incredibly helpful and responsive

Proactive communication and clean spot. Hosts were communicative in a good way. It's not the fanciest spot but that's a pro, it was good for my crew that just needed a place to crash after a game in town.

Amazing place, beautiful scenery at night! Check-in is a little late, would like something earlier. The place was clean and each room having its own temperature control was a big plus! There's a super market close by, make sure you have your key or you will have a bit of a walk. Parking is a drag though, was recommended spot hero and used it, but there's no re-entry once you leave and have to take a ticket. I basically lost what I paid for in parking. I would recommend having re-entry for guests.
Overall the stay was nice, I would still recommend even with the minor inconveniences.
Great stay with Nico! What you see online  is what you get, and it’s in a great spot.
Broken bedroom fan and no lighting on the outside stairs-  too expensive
The place was clean, well stocked and makes you feel right at home. I would definitely stay again and recommend it to others!

Andy’s place is perfectly convenient for UChicago families. Super clean and decorated so warmly. Made you feel right at home as you walked in.  Beds were comfortable and good A/C. His communication was always very quick prior to and throughout our stay I would highly recommend for anyone but especially for UChicago families and friends.

Loved staying here with our entire family. Everything was well thought thru and Kai was highly responsive to everything we asked or needed. Very strongly recommended. Also interiors are done very aesthetically and privacy for large groups with multiple bedrooms and seating areas and basement. Couldn’t be better.

You can’t beat this listing if you’re a big group looking to stay near Wrigley. We enjoyed our time and the hosts were responsive throughout.
The home itself matched the pictures/description, with the exception of two single beds transitioning into one bed. That was the only critique I have, as our group did originally choose this place based on the number of single options.
Lastly, it would be great if the check-in time could be bumped to 3 vs. 4. I acknowledge the house likely is a lot to clean, but that extra hour can have a big impact, along with 3 being standard in my experience.
Ultimately, we would stay here again because the experience was overall near perfect. You’re a few steps from Wrigley and all the action of Wrigleyville.
Great place to stay right outside of downtown Chicago! Would come back and recommend to others!

Fantastic stay.  Fantastic neighborhood and absolutely wonderful host.  Totally recommend and would be beyond happy to stay there again.  Comfortable and great place to relax.  Host was responsive and communicative. Highly recommend for your stay in chicago!
Great place to stay in Chicago

The place was exactly as advertised- cute and comfortable/welcoming with well-used space in a great neighborhood for walking around.
Jen was very prompt, responsive and accommodating with our request for an earlier check in as we flew in from another state.
The only critiques I have are that the beds were a bit stiff for my liking and the key box was a bit difficult to open (but maybe I just have weak fingers!).
Otherwise it was a great place and me and my group were all very happy with our stay.
David’s place was comfortable clean and in a great location walkable to everything and convenient to the train to venture elsewhere.

You can’t beat the location if you’re planning to attend an event at Wrigley Field. Unit is extremely well equipped, and very comfortable. We look forward to our next visit to Chicago and another stay at the Grand Slam Suites.
Great hosts and a peaceful, clean, and well taken care of space. Would easily stay here again.
The place was very nice and Alicia was extremely helpful.
Decent.

Couldn’t have been a better launching off point to Chicago adventures.  Great location within a 5 minute walk to the blue line.  Really well kept apartment with some premium touches.  Would stay again in a heartbeat next time I’m in town.
Great place to stay! Loved the porch and the neighborhood was really nice to walk around.
A wonderful place to stay by Wrigley.
Good communication

Great location next to a great park, very peaceful inside, and the AC inside my stay was very appreciated. However, I will say the wifi was not as strong and was cutting off a bit. Probably because I was staying in the lower level. Besides that I enjoined my stay!
Nice place ！

We loved staying here and enjoying a weekend in Wrigleyville!  Very easy walk to the ballpark and lots of shops and restaurants nearby.  This was a great house for multiple families with plenty of space and high quality interior.  Loved it!

Paul is great and super welcoming! My husband and I agreed that he would be fun to hangout with.
He gave us a tour and he was easy to communicate with, too. His place is beautiful and cozy! There is even a rooftop deck that we could access and see the Chicago skyline!
The products in the guest bathroom made our stay feel very luxurious, too! My only feedback is that we thought the pillows could’ve been a liiiiiiittle bit more comfortable, but that’s all! Thanks for having us!

Loved the place. Beautiful, very clean, comfortable. It was in an adorable neighborhood and very walkable to so many restaurants, a market, Target, the zoo, Lincoln Park, e-bike charging stations, etc. Danny is an awesome host and is very quick to respond and provided clear instructions. Would stay here again for sure.

We had an excellent stay at Sean’s place! Everything was very clean and had everything we needed. The towels, toilet paper, kitchen, etc were all well stocked. It was very easy to check in and all instructions and communications were quick, clear, and concise. There were quite a bit of steep stairs to get to the unit but our group was fine with it. We would definitely book again if we come back to Chicago!

The neighborhood is very walkable and close to great downtown spots and restaurants. The Airbnb was spacious for our group of 6, spotlessly clean, and beautifully decorated with everything you could need. Reggie is a fantastic host: proactive with communication, quick to respond, and flexible. Highly recommend!
This place was beautifully decorated and a great distance from everything! Definitely would stay here again!
Nice clean little space. The bunk bed needs to be tightened.
2nd time staying at this location.   Great space.  Next to several wonderful restaurants.

This is the perfect place to stay if you are looking to go sightseeing. Public transportation is just around the corner, so you can get anywhere from there. The place is spacious and comfortable within a quiet area. We had a great stay!

My family loved this Airbnb. It was in a safe neighborhood with a lot to do in the surrounding area. Easy access to public transportation was an added bonus. The hosts were great - super friendly and responsive. Thank you so much!
Amazing place to stay, we loved the view!
Great location right in Roscoe Village and within walking distance of the El and a number of restaurants.  The condo is spacious and clean and was great for our family’s stay

Lovely property with lots of thoughtful amenities I have not seen in other Airbnb's recently: nightstands on both sides of the bed with electric outlets and USB ports; white noise machines in both bedrooms; drop zone for jackets, umbrellas, backpacks, etc.; tons of towels and multiple places in the bathroom to hang them; well-equipped kitchen... the list goes on. Kennan is a great host... super responsive. The location is unbeatable.

We had a great stay at Sulaiman's Airbnb.
At first we were reluctant to book because of the lack of reviews. But we are glad we did.
Sulaiman as a host was very responsive to all my inquires.
The Airbnb was easy to locate and check in was smooth. The neighbourhood was nice as well and family oriented. It was newly renovated and clean with plenty of space for the 6 of us.
Location was within walking distance to bus stops which made it easier to travel.
Would highly recommend this Airbnb.
The place was warm and cozy, quiet and refreshing.
Super cool place
Jun was extremely helpful! She made great recommendations on how to get around and was very responsive to all of my questions. I highly recommend!
Nice stay, comfortable & clean
my fiancé and I had a great time at Audrone's place. lots of great food in the area and friendly neighborhood
The home was nicely updated  and had everything we needed.

We really enjoyed staying with Heidi this weekend. The location is excellent for getting to the city and the room was exactly as described. High value location. Heidi was very responsive and made checking in and out simple. Finally, her cats are handsome and very friendly!

Dorian's place was everything we needed and more. Dorian was there for our check in and was very helpful and fun to talk to during our stay. The place is in easy walking distance to China towns best restaurants and very close to the red line to get to the city. We felt incredibly safe while we stayed there, even walking home late in the evening after a long day of activities. I would absolutely stay here again given the option! Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Loved this stay! It was perfect for a trip with friends. The apartment was spacious and had plenty of room. Caitlin was helpful and communicative. Highly recommend.
Great location
The place was very cute and nice. Really enjoyed staying there. The neighbors were friendly as well. Thanks for sharing your space.
Great host and spot. Went to a graduation at UChicago and was convenient. Wasn’t sure about the location but was perfectly fine

Perfect location steps from the blue line and walking trail. Plenty of food/drink options nearby. The games and history were all very cool and well documented. The accomodations themselves were barebones but good for a few days stay.

For this Airbnb, it’s definitely a good location to stay at for a night or two. Only problem is we had a room on the second floor and I didn’t know there would be other guests there which wasn’t a problem but only complaint I had was about the rooms heat. They had fans in the room but it was so hot that we were still sweating throughout the night and kept waking up. The host was very kind and very responsive so I’d give this a 4/5 stars !

Aaron was a wonderful host. He was very responsive and freindly. The description of the place was spot on, and it was clean and felt like a home away from home for our visit to Chicago. The location was perfect for accessing public transportation, and our family had a wonderful time. The garage parking was very convenient and easy to use. We are grateful to Aaron for being such a wonderful and responsive host, and we would definitely stay here again!
Louis was fantastic, the place was clean and very comfortable. Highly recommended!!!!

Really great experience staying at this house. Everything was very clean, and the property itself was excellent. The location was also very convenient. Patty was always responsive and incredibly helpful throughout our stay. I would definitely recommend this place.
This was perfect for what we needed while in Chicago. We didn't plan to be at the property much since we spent our time exploring. This property offered exactly what we needed to enjoy our stay.
Nicely decorated, clean, and comfortable. Good coffee shop on the corner. Easy to get around town. Plenty of parking. Met all our needs! Would happily return.

The location was good for our trip to Wrigley Field. Mia was quick to respond and helpful with route to the game. The house was clean and easily accessible. The beds were a little uncomfortable but overall was a great little house to sleep at!

The place was spacious and clean. It is a 3 bedroom with 3 beds and 2 couches. We were expecting a 4th bed, but he had extra blankets for the couch, so we made it work! The snacks and cold drinks in the fridge were very much appreciated! There were also extra toiletries and plenty of towels available. We were there for my daughter’s graduation from U Chicago and it was only a $15 uber ride away!
The entire stay was wonderful. The whole house and space is beautiful, there is lots of parking, and the cats were just the sweetest.

This apartment was in a great location with an incredible view over the city and a decent view of the beach and Lake Michigan nearby.  We had several questions while settling in, but Jake and Nathan were super prompt with replies.  Public transportation (buses and the CTA Red line) were within walking distance as were many restaurants and shopping.  The fitness room was well-equipped, and the rooftop pool was a nice plus.  The beds were very comfortable, and there was plenty of space for our 3-generation family gathering of 9.
Had a great stay here for a friend’s bachelorette weekend trip. We were able to walk to coffee and felt safe. Place was great and very spacious for 10 people. Would recommend anyone to stay here.

A decent accommodation for the price. Clean and comfortable beds.
Remember to bring ear plugs if you want to sleep. I did and slept well. AC is very loud, but keeps the temperature cool. Also there's all the time someone going in or out or using the bathroom.
The location is great, not far from the Loop by train. There's a supermarket, restaurants and cafes all around the hostel.

Our stay was lovely. Bryce was so accommodating and he always checked in and offered recommendations when requested! he even provided an extra comforter for me. the space was clean and tasteful. we had everything we needed for our long weekend! it's also an amazing location, walkable to all the shops and restaurants in andersonville.

Jorge was a very gracious host. He was very flexible letting us check in a couple hours early when our flight was pushed forward. Also very kind when we checked out a few mins late. I would definitely stay at his house again. It was also beautiful and very comfortable.
beautiful home, very good communication with the host.
I was satisfied with the apartment, and the hosts were friendly and helpful.
We had a good experience, the only thing was the WiFi connection could be better

Wonderful hosts. Very welcoming and responsive. Brian even came by when our smoke detector was acting up at one time (most likely low battery! The neighborhood is safe and walkable — no issues with the neighbors. 10/10!

This was a perfect stay for a weekend in Chicago! The location was good. Everything felt safe, and it was easy and quick to Uber downtown. The place had plenty of space, and the three bathrooms were great. Overall, it worked extremely well for our needs!
Exactly what we were looking for. Perfect location. Very clean.
Unit was perfect for our group and just what we needed for our trip!
Great stay, I loved the location and I appreciated the quick responses!

Denisha was responsive and helpful and sent us all the information we needed for check in and check out. The location is in a quiet neighborhood near the end of a cul-de-sac.  To get to the nearest train station it was about a 20 minute walk or you could take a bus or get an Uber.  From there it was a short distance to everything you wanted to do in Chicago. We came for the USMNT send off game against Germany as their last preparation for the World Cup and this place was perfect as we could get there and back easily.  Some of us left Chicago on a plane and some left by train and those were also easy to get to from there. We also went to the field museum and the bean and out to eat at Millers pub and all of those were easy also.
Ryan was a great host! Thank you for your hospitality it was very much appreciated.

Emily is a great host who was very communicative and responsive. The location is a quiet, safe and fun neighborhood that is 1/2 a mile from great restaurants/groceries/coffee shops. The apartment is in an unrenovated brownstone & is exactly as described however there are a few things potential renter should know.
1. The apt has window a/c units which is fine however, the unit in both the bedrooms are only 18 inches from the head of your bed. You have air blowing directly on your heads all night which is uncomfortable, noisy and unsafe.
2. If you have a Keurig you need to have mugs that fit your machine. Additionally, you should have enough mugs for all guests which we did not.
3. Back door to the building is left open 24/7 which did not make us feel safe.
Great host, adequate space but the property is not worth the cost.
Lovely location right near Logan square. The place was incredibly comfortable and almost like a little tree house! Would book again

This was the ideal location to stay if you were planning on attending some Cubs games. Less than five minutes to the stadium, a ton of bars and restaurants, and it was exactly how it was described. Samuel was a great host. He let us stay a couple hours past our checkout time to accommodate our flights and was a great communicator. Well definitely be booking in the future.
Junni is a great host and was helpful before and during our stay. We had two families stay here for a birthday weekend and everyone was happy with the accommodations!

We had a fantastic stay and really couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The location was excellent—quiet, easy to access, and with convenient street parking throughout our visit. The space itself was unique, with a cool warehouse-style feel while still being comfortable, clean, and welcoming.
The host did a great job stocking the property with everything we needed, including plenty of towels, shampoo, dish soap, spices, and other thoughtful touches. The coffee maker and tea kettle were especially appreciated, and the kitchen was well-equipped for anything we might have wanted to prepare during our stay.
There was a great little taqueria right across the street, and while we didn’t get a chance to try it, we did enjoy visits to the nearby ice cream shop. The neighborhood felt safe and convenient, making it easy to explore the city and attend the USA match.
Communication was excellent throughout our stay. The host was responsive, attentive, and made the entire process smooth f

Chris and his wife were fantastic hosts! Chris showed us around the place, and recommended some things to do in the area. He was also the most responsive host we have ever encountered. The condo is huge, and very comfortable, and the private parking was a game changer for us. We would recommend his place and would absolutely stay there again if given the chance!
We really enjoyed our time in Chicago! Thank you so much for hosting we would definitely stay here again. Very accommodating for a large group!
The place was as described with plenty of space and a fun rooftop!
The place felt like home during our stay! Kristine was very helpful with everything! The recommendation The Pancake House for breakfast was a hit! Very delicious! The area was so beautiful!
Had a wonderful weekend stay here! Thank you to our amazing hosts and will definitely consider this place next time we are in the area!
We had a great stay! Christian was a very responsive and helpful host. The place was so clean and homey. We highly recommend staying here!
Na
This is indeed a great apartment in great location. Everything was perfect. Serg was very responsive and helpful all the time. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this apartment.
Amazing place to stay! Everything was thought through. Great communication, step by step guide - highly recommend staying here!

This was one of the nicest AirB/B places I have stayed at.  Lovely classic furniture, brand new kitchen, very comfortable beds, and everything was squeaky clean.  I could go on and on.  The location is a short 2 1/2 block walk to Wrigley Field, which is the reason I and my adult son were there.  I'd stay there again in a heartbeat.

It’s probably my fault for not reading the details, but when I got there I didn’t know it was a shared bathroom and kitchen.  As long as you’re ok with sharing those spaces, the place is almost perfect.  Location is amazing and honestly I was only there to sleep.  For the cost, it’s hard to beat.  The thing to remember also is that it is a lil older and the bathroom shows that, but everything works perfectly.
Place is lovely and great location
We loved the attention to detail and the decor. It’s also in a great location and neighborhood. We would stay here again.

Was a nice location wasn’t to far from grant park the house was very clean and neat host was very responsive had a good time

This was as lovely place to stay. Andrew's place is very comfortable and close to so many great places to eat. We had a great time. Thank you for hosting us!

We greatly enjoyed our stay. The house is quiet and tucked in a fun neighborhood! It was the perfect place for our girls trip. The beds are all comfortable (even the sofa pull out), so we slept very well. Having a garage for the car was also a great peace of mind. Thank you for having us, Angie!
This was exactly what we were looking for. It was a great location for our son’s graduation at University of Chicago. The host made everything very easy.

Comfortable space! The hosts were really nice, kind and responsive. It felt cozy! The area is calm most of the time and it was pretty quiet the majority of the nights. :)
Thank you for letting us stay at your place

Great little spot outside of the city, the space was clean and exactly as listed, nice bathroom and the space was very comfortable. Jeff was super responsive and made sure our stay was hassle free, recommended spot for some Chicago enjoyment.
Great location, enjoyed the local coffee shop just a block and a half away and also walkable to restaurants and bars. Good communication from host.
Great place to stay. Super clean & friendly, communicative hosts.

We enjoyed our stay in this beautiful apartment. The place is decorated tastefully, it is bright and clean, and the outdoor space is gorgeous. Cynthia was very responsive and helped us check in a day earlier than planned, which was very helpful.

Thanks so much for the stay! I was there for a songwriters conference and I got a few songs written while sitting on the couch, made some connections, and got to play a little live music. Successful and restful. Thanks again.

I booked this place so I had a fun area to stay in while I was in town for a concert. The area was amazing, the place was exactly as described, and I loved the convenience of the brown line being just a few blocks away. I would love to book this place again if I am back in town!
Had a comfortable stay at James’s place. Very convenient to both UChicago campus and downtown.

The WiFi was pretty much non existent, the primary bath needs maintenance, and over all needs a good detailed cleaning and/or paint job.

The upstairs apartments were very loud. And when in the primary bath, if the apartment upstairs used their shower, water came through the shower head of the primary bath in this unit. Pretty disturbing.

We enjoyed our stay in Jefferson Park and exploring the Chicago area! The place was very clean and tidy as described. Communication regarding the check in and check out process was clear and concise. Was a quick and easy stay.
10/10 recommendations.

Great place. Friendly hosts.

very clean modern interior, location may be a little loud due to street traffic as well as being pretty far from downtown. Host is very accommodating, communication is great. overall had a great experience.
The place was as advertised. It was very clean and what we needed while visiting our nephew.

The Carter Blue was exactly as we expected and its convenient location near the University of Chicago helped the guests and I get around with little hassle despite the festivities that weekend.
Beautiful stay!! Stephanie was very responsive + friendly! Even allowed me and my friends to check in early!! Thank you lots!!
We had an amazing stay! Very walkable to local transit. Overall, cute space and very cozy.

Excellent stay in an excellent area and Kyle was very attentive
Great place, location was on a quiet street, no issues with parking. About a 10-15 minute walk to the nearest green line station. Place was clean and check in was easy. Very responsive to messages.
As advertised, great location and comfortable home base to check out the city from.  Great guide with good local recommendations.  Coffee and mini bottles of olive oil were great.

great place to stay at with a large group of people. It has three bathrooms which was a lifesaver. And the water pressure was amazing! very clean and put together we had some issues but host was responsive and helped us out maintenance was very friendly and also very helpful

We drove from Tennessee to Chicago to take in a Cubs game and the downtown. Everything was as expected. I like how the bedrooms and bathrooms are not side by side. That added privacy worked well for us with the kitchen in the back.

was a great spot! just far enough from the city that it never took too long to get to the heart of it while still being peaceful and quiet. a great place to relax after an exciting and busy day in the city!
Great location, felt very safe, easy to access public transportation and proximity to the 606 trail. Quiet house, lovely space and back porch area.
Stayed at Alma’s when I traveled for a wedding in June. We didn’t spend much time in the apartment but it was a great spot with most things you would need for a weekend. The beds were also comfy!

Milen was super responsive! When we arrived the lock to the door was completely broken so we had to wait for it to be replaced. This was a huge bummer since we had to delay our plans by a couple hours however he was very accommodating and gave us a discount because of the lock issue.
Overall- it was very clean and had just the right amenities! Super close to brown line and Andersonville :)
Thanks again Milen! We recommend this cozy apartment to anyone who wants a quick walk to the brown line and easy access to bars, shops and restaurants in Andersonville.

The kitchen had no curtains, so being right next to a super bright Popeyes drive thru, it was constantly lit up with no privacy. Could hear orders being taken and people yelling. The place was quite clean I will give them that!

Some of the furniture is straight up broken, the TV stand looks like it got karate chopped. Every wall flower in the building was set up incorrectly. They can be turned.
Very responsive and kind hosts. Great communication. Beautiful apartment.
Ragan and her partner were great host. They were easy to communicate with and the space was very clean. I’d would 100% recommend this location.

Walkable to the magnificent mile, Riverwalk, lots of shopping and restaurants. Hotel staff was incredibly friendly and accommodating. Some aspects of the hotel reflected their age and could be updated, but overall this stay was a great value. It was just what we were looking for in our stay.
Hotel was in a good location and was as expected per the price.

This is a perfect location near Randolph street and Fulton Market restaurants.  It was great to be able to walk to many places and Ubers were also accessible. The space was clean and bright.  I will say it is very loud.  there is a metra train line right next to it and it can be heard inside the unit. Lastly, while it is a 2 Br, the 2nd bedroom is practically a windowless closet with a pocket door. Overall, it unit was fine for our needs, but I would not say it was worth the cost with the noise level.

this place was super cute and clean! instructions were clear and detailed. no issues getting in or out which was appreciated. Definitely would recommend to anyone needing a quiet and spacious place in Chicago :)
Beautiful home! Walkable for a guys weekend, and it was a really great stay.
Nice little place in an older building. Super clean and had everything we needed.

Susan’s place is as it says it is: clean, comfortable, and private. We would stay again as everything else was great and the price is very fair!

Space for 4 in the basement unit. I would definitely stay again if going to Wrigley.
Literally a one minute walk to the park.

Thanks for a great location!  We had a wonderful time!

Catherine was extremely responsive and very kind! Her instructions were clear and she made sure we were well taken care of. The place itself is perfectly located with lots to do nearby, easy access to transportation, and situated on a very lovely residential street. It was a great stay.
We had a great stay! Lots of space, plenty to do in the neighborhood, games in the house, and Matthew was an excellent host. We would definitely stay here again in the future!
Great location and host.  Middle of restaurants and other amenities in Chicago.  Highly recommended.

I enjoyed it

This place was a perfect start. The house was responsive and very friendly. He gave clear instructions and proactively explained the check in process to prevent any issues. I will definitely be returning and renting again.

The WiFi did not work, and I messaged and tried everything I know like resetting router. Made working from place impossible and I was late to meetings. Bummer for sure

The location was great as it’s walkable to the blue line. The restroom was kept clean throughout the stay. I’d definitely give another visit again.
I LOVED the location. It was super safe and in a great area close to everything. I loved where we stayed and it was wonderful to work with Patrick and Carrie.

This was my favorite AirBnb I’ve stayed at. The place was very comfortable & had everything you could possibly want or need during your stay. Dede was also a great host & made me feel very comfortable. She was also kind enough to assist when I could not find any street parking due to unexpected construction work. Will definitely stay again on my next visit to Chicago!

This is a great place to stay if you're coming to Chicago to enjoy a Cubs game. It is an easy stroll to Wrigley and while you are close to all the action, it is on a quiet neighborhood street. The train is close---but that was part of the charm, and the rooms have earplugs. Honestly, I didn't even notice the train on the second night. The pied-à-tierre is elegantly designed and comfortable. For what nice hotels charge in Chicago, this was a good value if you're traveling with another couple. We would stay again!
Great place for what me and my group of friends needed it was very clean, host was well communicated with us and 10 out of 10 hope to stay again next time in Chicago

I highly recommend booking with Vlad.  Everything about our stay was some wholesome and full of hospitality.   I will definitely be booking again on my next visit to Chicago!
Everything as advertised. A convenient location. Clean and comfortable.

A sleek, modern, clean apartment above a lively area, this spot was perfect for us on our busy visit to Chicago. Hosts were gracious, informative, and responsive. The parking spot was a plus and very convenient.
There was an issue with the air conditioner that didn't get resolved during our stay, but the hosts were attentive and seemed to do all they could. I recommend the spot!

We had a fantastic stay at Vin's place! Very clean, fantastic location for getting around easily, and close-by to several amenities and services. Vin was a great host, the apartment was spotless clean and comfortable, and access was easy. Highly recommended for your Chicago stay!

What a beautiful home in a fantastic part of Chicago! Highly recommend for larger groups, but my husband and 2 dogs loved it as well! Walkable to coffee & food. We used the garage , as we drove and it fit our 4Runner easily, huge bonus! The home is safe and secure, great backyard!
The primary bed and bath were excellent! We cooked in the wonderful kitchen and found everything we needed! Cannot recommend Matt’s home enough, stay here if you can!

While I didn’t interact with Mosmi physically at all, it was an enjoyable stay with easy access to the bathroom. I am sure though, that Mosmi would have accommodated, if I had just asked 😄Other than that, my overall stay was great, I’d love to stay again with Mosmi in the future, and recommend her place for either solo trips or for couples! Thanks again!
We really enjoyed the Hyde Park Community and its proximity to the University of Chicago.   Really enjoyed our stay.

This is hands down the worst airbnb I've stayed. The room had a significant insect problem that materially impacted our stay. Do yourself a favor and avoid this place and host.
Have stayed for work twice now and loved the space, location and staff.

Kenneth is a very considerate host.  He goes to extraordinary lengths to make guests feel welcomed.  His kitchen was adequately equipped and stocked with more groceries and beverages than is the norm in my Abnb experience.
Like other reviews mentioned, parking was a little difficult to find, but that's Chicago in general. Place was secure and clean.
What a great place to stay! Located directly across the Lake. Clean cute place & Silas was very helpful and had great communication! Thank you so much for a great stay! :)
The place was just as described! Clean and plenty of space. Host responded quickly to messages.

Very comfortable and great Northside location.
This place was great for our stay and had all the amenities we were looking for!
We stayed here for my bachelorette party and it was perfect! Great neighborhood and a cute place to stay for the weekend!
Excellent accommodation. Everything was very clean and just as shown in the pictures. The location is very good and the host was kind and attentive. I would definitely stay here again!

Nicole is a great host and this BNB is one of the few at this price that is not a shared stay in Chicago. The place was clean, comfortable and welcoming and any questions were quickly responded too. Overall a great and enjoyable stay!

Emily was a great host! Her place was perfect for our weekend stay for a wedding! She was super responsive and accommodating. She had toys and a kids table which was so nice to have. Definitely recommend staying here!

I cannot recommend this rental to anyone, especially those looking for an stress-free stay. Our experience was marred by serious safety concerns and a lack of respect for our privacy and time.
The most concerning issue was the safety of the property. There were no locks on any of the bedroom doors, and a window in the first-floor dining room could not be locked at all, which is a significant security hazard. Furthermore, we were shocked to find a table saw left out on an open table in the basement—an incredibly dangerous oversight in a rental space.
Beyond the safety issues, the quality of the accommodations was poor. The mattresses and pillows were extremely uncomfortable, making it difficult to get any rest during what was already a busy and stressful trip for my daughter’s wedding.
We booked this place primarily to have a place to sleep during a family wedding, and it failed to meet even the most basic standards of safety, comfort, and professionalism. Never again.

Arguably the best place we’ve ever stayed in Chicago, gorgeous neighborhood, pristine property, and phenomenal hosts made for a weekend that we will never forget. Would stay here again in a heartbeat, easy Uber to Wrigleyville coupled with a warm and comfortable environment.

Great place! User-friendly instructions with easy check-in and check-out. Beds were super comfortable. Place was larger than expected and very comfortable. Bus stop is one door down and the Airbnb is within easy walking distance of a 7-11, bars, restaurants and more. The location felt very safe and there are two additional locking doors before entering the unit. There are people who live on the top floor but were so quiet that we didn't even realize they were there.
Hosts were amazing! Super prompt replies, very polite and professional. The fridge and cupboards were stocked with some food, coffee and creamer which was a nice surprise. They basically provided breakfast makings for us each day. I'm an ice snob and have my own nugget ice maker at home. What a bonus when there was a nugget ice maker in the kitchen!
Plenty of bedding, towels, trash bags, cookware and supplies. Very well furnished. Upgrades are being made and the place is looking very nice. Will be staying here again!!!
Convenient location and very clean.
lindo lugar espacioso y muy limpio es un poco difícil de encontrar
My friends and I enjoyed this very clean and secluded unit! Our trip to Chicago consisted of long days of exploring the city, so it was nice to come back to a clean apartment that was very cozy.
Fantastic little apartment in a beautiful neighborhood check in and check out were super easy surrounding restaurants were great. 10 out of 10 would stay again!
Great house and stay for us, host was fantastic!

Kimberly’s place was so perfect for all of our needs. Spacious and clean and they were extremely responsive and proactive when we had a few minor maintenance issues pop up so we felt super taken care of. Thank you for your hospitality!

This was an amazing stay! My girlfriend and I had a wonderful time. The host was incredibly accommodating—they didn’t charge us extra when two additional guests joined us, approved our early check-in request, and even allowed a one-hour late check-out with no additional fees.

The place itself had everything we needed: a washer and dryer, a blow-up mattress for our guests, a fully working kitchen, a sunroof, and a nice patio out back with seating.
The location was fantastic—surrounded by so many restaurants, bars, coffee shops, breakfast spots, and parks. Wrigley Field is just an 18-minute Lime bike ride away, and the closest train station is about a 10-minute walk. Just AMAZING stay!!
This place was great! Nice neighborhood and not too far from the trains to get down into the city.

Our group did enjoy the space in the airbnb and we appreciated the active communication from our host, but overall felt the area was unsafe (especially arriving late at night) and that the apartment was less maintained than advertised. It was good value for the time we stayed and would be excellent if you’re not planning on going downtown frequently.
Great place to stay. Really enjoyed the place.

quiet, cute little neighborhood with clear parking instructions given. The common areas were kept very clean, especially the bathrooms. The room I stayed in was simple but comfortable.
Florin’s place was great! It was perfect for our trip to Chicago. Inside looked great and was clean. It was very easy to park on the street. Would 100% recommend this air bnb!
First time staying in Wicker Park. It was great. Enjoyed every minute. Definitely would recommend.
Incredibly friendly and responsive host. Perfect spot near wrigleyville for a guys baseball trip. Naomi and JJ went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed.

Our check-in experience was a little challenging, as we arrived at check-in time but did not initially have the information needed to access the property. After some time and communication with Yuyi, we were able to get everything worked out and enjoy our stay.
The condo was very clean and spacious. For our group of two couples, having two full bathrooms was a major plus. We appreciated the natural light from the front windows, the convenient parking space, easy access to the Orange Line for trips to the lakefront and Grant Park, and Palmisano Park across the street, which was a wonderful bonus for walks.
A few minor notes: the condo took a while to cool down after adjusting the thermostat, the two queen bedrooms were somewhat tight, and access requires climbing three flights of stairs.
Overall, this was a great place to stay and one we would recommend. Once the check-in issue was resolved, we had an enjoyable stay and appreciated the condo's location, cleanliness, and amenities.
Forgot something in the unit after we checked out and Milan was so helpful and was able to get the item back to us.
We had a wonderful stay, lots to do and really close to the train!

This airbnb looks exactly like the photos and is as described! Walkable to the subway el trains and walkable to a lively row of restaurants, cafes, bars, things to do. An incredible, convenient location and a great area for 20-30 somethings who want both a lively, fun neighborhood balanced with peace and quiet at night.
This particular unit is tucked nicely into a neighborhood that is very residential, very clean, and safe (a bunch of town homes and single family homes).
Great for a group trip!

Super convenient space for getting around Chicago! Neighborhood is really walkable. The space is right by a park, a lot of great restaurants, and other things to do. House and space were super comfortable, there was even an umbrella offered if needed since the weather can be unpredictable in June.
Very clean & cute studio apartment with kitchen amenities and walking distance for exploring. Bella is very responsive and detailed instructions. Enjoyed our stay for visiting friends in the area.
Really enjoyed my stay, hassle free and a great deal!

La casa más hermosa!

Home was so cozy and peaceful, very close to city and airport!
Host was incredibly friendly, nice and welcoming. Came home to a a few surprises that just warmed the heart! I can’t wait to Hopefully come back💕
The Airbnb is spacious and clean, with a spectacular view. It looks exactly like the pictures! The amenities are great. I would definitely recommend this place for a stay.
very comfortable feel and beds are the best we have had since we started airbnbing it.

Great place everything walkable great shops and restaurants east train and bus access. Very very close to ball park! We had no issues enjoyed our stay,bed was comfortable and the AC was awesome!!

Nice clean place, a couple block walk from the train station. Enjoyed my stay and would definitely book this place again in the future.
Great place to stay for a little girls weekend, very easy to get to many fun locations around Chicago. The place was also clean and comfortable.

easy to get to.  nice and clean.

This was the perfect place for my friends and I to stay for our weekend in Chicago! The Airbnb was extremely clean and had everything we needed. The living space is really cozy. Its located within walking distance to the CTA brownline which can take you to downtown. The neighbourhood is really peaceful. The check-in process is well-structured in a way that minimum interaction is required from the host to the clients.

We had a great stay and would definitely book here again. Nice quiet neighborhood and convenient to the transportation in city. Plenty of local businesses within arms reach. Friendly neighbors as well. Definitely a 5 star stay if you are looking for a comfortable place to stay. Thanks again!!!
Will definitely be my first choice to stay next trip to Chicago. Thanks
