The Walton Residence was in a great location! It was clean and the parking being so close was very convenient. We would definitely stay there again.
Great spot perfect for my stay for the weekend would book again
Great location for the area. Yes there is road noise but if you are in the bedrooms you wouldn’t have any idea. Clean place and great hosts! Thanks!
Very nice place to stay.  Very spacious and clean.  It was a little further away from what we had planned to do during our stay.
Great location! Greg is a friendly host who is super easy to communicate with.
Great place to stay I loved the neighborhood as well. Would book again
Great spot to stay at. A few bars and places to eat a walkable distance away. Quiet neighborhood. Would stay again if in the area.

We enjoyed our time at the Airbnb. We had a large group staying with us and the house worked out well for everyone. The house was very clean and Junni quickly responded when I reached out to her. We would definitely recommend staying here!

Wonderful place, beautiful neighborhood, and perfect location! So close to Logan Square and the L. However, the hosts will let you know the front door keypad has a "common issue" getting stuck, and the interior lockbox takes some finessing. There are four spare keys on a rack and several homemade signs inside warning of a $50 charge for lost keys, so it's safe to say guests have run into this before.
One of our group used a spare key and it got misplaced. When the hosts reached out about it, I offered to pay before they even mentioned a charge. They sent the $50 request, I paid that morning and confirmed it was sent. Read by both hosts. Never heard a word back.
A new keyless lock (Yale makes one for about $100) runs about the cost of two of those charges and solves this permanently. Genuinely hope they make that upgrade because the place itself is great and deserves a smoother arrival.
Great Airbnb for large group!
Great place to stay and Greta location! Would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Stylish, spotless, comfortable place in an up and coming neighborhood. Lilian was a lifesaver when my VRBO host canceled 3 hrs before my group of 4 was supposed to check in. Lilian responded quickly with a nicer placer, a better location and a better price.
The place (and Lilian) are fabulous.

Rida's place was exactly as described, and even cleaner than I was hoping for. you are right in the neighborhood, and we were there for our son's graduation from UChicago so it was very close to everything we needed, and even for the age of the neighborhood, the unit was really well kept, clean, and the 4 bedrooms are a huge advantage. We would definitely stay again!
The space is absolutely beautiful.  Vic and Grace were responsive and accommodating throughout the entire experience.  Highly recommended!

Three days before check-in, after I had already started on my trip and was fully packed, the host messaged to say that bath towels would not be provided. Seeing as I don't travel with a bath towel (who does?) this constituted a major inconvenience for me as I was staying multiple days and intended to shower. When I asked if the policy could be reversed for our stay, I was told that "the decision can not be unmade." I find it to be highly unprofessional to change the policy of a stay with no warning and with no ability to cancel the booking, since we were past the window for a refund. The only reason I did not bring this to AirBnB's attention was that I did not need the hassle.
Other than that the apartment was fine.

You know, it takes a certain gentle, kind disposition to make someone, who is in his thirties, not feel like a moron for not being able to figure out how to use a lockbox. But there I was, sitting on their porch and fighting with a very simple device, when I was met with a wonderful blend of humor, hospitality, and patience by my host. And that is a demeanor that carried through my stay.
The space itself was beautiful, amply supplied, conveniently organized, and impeccably clean. With its own entrance and floor, I had complete privacy throughout my stay and the comfort to come and go without disturbing or being disturbed.
I left enamored with Andersonville. While I made time to go downtown, I could’ve stayed there and been satisfied. Never did I feel unsafe or unwelcome, and the space was within easy walking distance of many lovely restaurants, shops, and bars, as well as several public transit stops.
I would absolutely and excitedly book this space again. Thank you for everything!
Perfect for our big group in town for a wedding. Some amenities weren’t available, but otherwise, we had a great stay and the home was clean.

This was a great place to stay between the airport and downtown. Clean, convenient and we especially appreciated the opportunity to do laundry and store luggage in a closet in the lobby after checking out
Wonderful stay with comfortable beds and amazing location right by wrigley field! Loved the rooftop area and great communication from hosts. We would stay there again!
Great location, great place
Great location. Walking distance to Lincoln Park zoo. Lots of places to eat walking distance. Parking can be a challenge so plan accordingly, but it is free street parking.
Great location in an amazing neighborhood!

We absolutely loved our stay here. The location cannot be beat with Wrigley Field right there, great restaurants and bars steps away, and endless people-watching opportunities. Highly, highly recommend!

David and Aaron had an amazing guide book loaded with ideas, places to eat, things to do. It was the perfect read and was very refreshing. A gorgeous neighborhood, perfect to walk and loaded with coffee shops, bars and restaurants. Pretty much anything you’d need within a few blocks.

Hosts were friendly and proactive, and the lodging was in a comfortable and cozy environment.  It was easily walkable to restaurants, convenience, and grocery stores and had multiple little free libraries around.  As stated in some other reviews, being in the basement allotted for noise from upstairs. This came from both people and dog barking—more noticeable on the weekends, as it seemed both Friday and Saturday night there was a party that lasted into the small hours of the night. Those sounds filter down through to the bedroom.  Overall, the place was quaint, cute, and felt safe.
such an easy stay, and the host was always quick to respond. thank you! :)
Our very favorite place to stay when visiting our University of Chicago student. Perfect in every way.
Great spot for a big group
Perfect place for a trip to the city! Beautiful neighborhood with good parking and meets all expectations for a quiet clean and stress free Airbnb! So glad this is where we chose to stay.
Great place! Ashley was responsive and helpful, would stay again next time we are in town!

We were concerned about the street noise but it was very quiet in the 4th floor unit.
We could have used an extra towel/washcloth (only one washcloth for two people?)
Also note that the key to get into this unit once you’re inside the building is on the 4th floor outside the unit, not on the first floor with the other keypads. Instructions were not clear on that.
The place was super clean and nicely decorated- overall great place and I would recommend!

We stayed in Jevaux’s place for our daughter’s graduation- it is very well located for getting around Hyde Park and to the university- about 3/4 of a mile to campus and easy walking. The place was comfortable and clean and the air conditioning was great during the hot Chicago summer. Jevaux was easy to communicate with and very responsive.
We had a great time. Cheryl was easy to communicate with and helpful. Gave us an extra parking pass as we came in 2 vehicles. Place was clean and relaxing. Would recommend to friends for sure
Enjoyed the house, good location

Host responded very timely and was always courteous.  Location looked as it did in the photos.  We were able to find it easily.  There was a window AC unit, but, it was in room A only.  When that door was closed the remaining rooms tended to get warmer.  Room B had a fan but it was consistently between 78 and 80 in the room.  We were able to find a second fan that had a wobbly base, but, we made it work to add more air movement which made it so we could sleep in the room just fine.  Hopefully they can add an AC unit to room B?  Place was beautiful and clean.  The shower was really nice with a stone floor which was a nice surprise.  The drain was a slow drain so worried me a little but always drained without overflowing.  We did find a homeless person sleeping outside next to the front door on our last morning.  Might need to make the outside gate have a lock?  He didn't wake up when we left so no issue for us.  All in all it was a nice place and was reasonable price.
We had a fantastic stay, everything was just perfect. Very highly recommended for anyone looking for a quiet place near Logan Square
Unique apartment that's very well designed in a stellar Chicago neighborhood.  Would definitely repeat the stay whenever back in town.

Our family met up in Chicago for a wedding - the five of us were able to sleep comfortably & had space to hangout too. Kitchen was great & the location was convenient. Street parking wasn’t difficult at all.

Location, location, location! It’s a perfect location for a cubs game or to explore Wrigleyville. Lots of places around. The home was perfect! Very clean and nice interior. Even some snacks and soft drinks were there. Just a perfect home for a great price!

This is a lovely second floor studio in one of Chicago’s tree lined, walkable neighborhoods.  The spacious studio is immaculately clean, stylishly decorated (I took notes!) and full of thoughtful amenities.  Seriously, Anne has thought of everything.  Spare readers on the coffee table, city brochures, a selection of games, books, magazines, and movies. She had snacks and a variety of beverages in the fridge.  In the morning I found coffee, cream and some English muffins and jam for breakfast.  The bed was comfortable, shower divine… great pressure and hot.  A lovely balcony complete with spotlessly clean chairs to enjoy the birds chirping in the morning.  We loved her garden and the neighborhood was great as well.  Will definately recommend and make a note to return on our next trip to Chicago.
The space was clean and private. Easy to find and get into.

Overall, a great stay. Our biggest problem was the bathroom - the shower is too short if you're taller than 5' 8" and getting in and out of the old school claw foot tub to shower feels dangerous, I was worried someone was going to slip. The tub needs non-stick lining and a safety bar.
Beautiful and spacious. Very quiet and peaceful neighborhood. Would definitely stay there again
Great stay clean and welcoming

We enjoyed our time at this apartment. It was spacious and quiet (except for nearby construction noise which was not so bad as to disturb us), and the location is really nice, literally a block and a half from a commercial area with a good selection of restaurants and bars. We loved that there was a parking space behind the apartment. Overall, we were quite satisfied with our visit. I would note, though, that the apartment is one of those basement-type apartments with half windows that look out onto the street at sidewalk level.

This was my first time sharing a home with other lodgers. I was pleasantly surprised that everyone was respectful and quiet. My room was very quiet and the bathroom wasn't attached but it was locked and was only for my use. The house is in a great location, just a few minutes' walk from the Blue Line and many shops and restaurants. Sezgin immediately responded to each text. I would gladly stay again.

Anthony was kind and responsive. He let us check in a hour early, and quickly responded to messages.
One of the neighbors has a rooster that crows incessantly from 4am to late afternoon, bad for late risers & light sleepers like my partner.
We were unable to flush the toilet “twice in a row” because the water in the back refills so slowly.
The shower drain was clogged the first time using it. My bf reached in to unclog it and it was full of gunk that ended up backwashing into the tub floor. Anthony did come fix it the next day.
The “clean” towels smelled like mildew before use, and so did our clothes after using the washer.
Bedsheets had visible droplet blood stain. Tissue boxes & dryer sheets would have been nice. TV in bedroom couldn’t connect to the WiFi, living room TV remote was broken.
On check out, the lockbox was jammed and we had to leave the key elsewhere— what if that happened during check in?
Good location, close to L and busses, loaf lounge for breakfast & pastries.

Host had great communication. House was in a neighborhood that felt safe. Had parking on the street and we were able to find a spot near the house. The house was clean and perfect for our family of 5.
Evgenii was a great host and their space was very convenient and clean.  It was exactly what we needed.
James's place is very clean and situated in a nice neighborhood. Plenty of good restaurants nearby to explore. James and Yen are very responsive and helpful.
Wonderful unit, great communication, and overall awesome weekend stay.
This is the second we stayed here because it’s so close to our grandson. Very clean and nice decorations.

Pros: This place provided enough space for me and my 8 cousins. The house itself was very clean. Having two kitchens was nice. The beds weren’t hard. We did have an issue with a bad leak in the ceiling from the upstairs bathroom into the downstairs bathroom. The owner responded immediately, and fixed the problem quickly .
Cons: The parking situation is terrible. It’s very hard to find parking on the available streets in which you wouldn’t have to move your car after a certain time. If you live in an area like that and are used to it, you should be fine. He has a garage, but there was a big pile of trash still in there that smelled. Downstairs smelled like sewage in some areas after the first day. We only received 1 wash towel per person to last the whole 4 day trip.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was beautiful, clean, and felt like a true home away from home. The location was great, and we really enjoyed our time exploring the city. Everything was comfortable and well-maintained, making our trip even more enjoyable. Thank you for your hospitality. we would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!
Nice place to stay

After realizing we should be downstairs instead of upstairs, we were very pleased with the place. Beds were comfortable, hot showers, well-appointed kitchen. It could use at least one truly sharp knife. It was nice to be away from the city center.

Highly recommend staying at James' place in Wicker Park! The location is awesome—super close to public transit, tons of great places to eat, and a huge grocery store right across the street. Having a garage parking spot was also a massive plus, even if it was a little tricky to navigate.
The condo itself was spotless, super comfortable, well-appointed, and had plenty of space for a big group. It was also fully stocked with everything we needed. James was a great communicator, which made the whole check-in and check-out process seamless and totally stress-free.

This was just what we needed to visit with our daughters. The neighborhood is walkable and has easy access to the blue line. The parking in the back was also great to have and easy to access. Unit was cost and comfortable with all the necessary amenities. We enjoyed our stay!
Amazing spot, close to transportation
Great location, easy to access via public transportation, and very comfortable bed.

Kimberly was great! She was quick to respond to any questions or asks I had and the space was great. The bed was a bit firm for my liking, but that’s a personal preference and nothing she could control. The water pressure was absolutely amazing as well.
Hot water in the shower was poor.  Low pressure.

The place was perfect for us! Only thing, It didn’t have much in the way of kitchen furnishings (not many cups, no bottle opener, etc), so that’s one thing to note. We were fine with it but if you have a larger group or plan to cook it’s something to note.
Check in was easy, on a kiosk, and there is staff at the front desk at all times that were happy to help with anything. The views from the room were amazing.
Overall , 5 stars.

Nice, clean place. Free street parking which was a huge plus. Only thing that prevents it from being 5 stars is the beds are not comfortable, very thin and squeaky. As two 25 year olds it was fine for us for two nights but it would have been a rough sleep for my parents if they had stayed. Otherwise everything was great!

This place is beautiful. The house is well furnished with the necessities. Sean and team were very helpful and communicated quickly. The only "problem" was the neighbors next door were loud until 3AM, but this is no fault of the host.
Great location. Easy parking. Great spot to experience Chicago. The apartment felt very safe. It was clean. Attentive host. Thank you!
This place is In a safe neighborhood and is convenient to getting around downtown Chicago. The host was very responsive to my communication and I would stay here again.
Everything was just perfect and Naomi was amazing and so responsive. We highly recommend it and will definitely be back ourselves!
Great place right in the heart of wrigleyville, would recommend!

This place was exactly as listed. Jay was fantastic with communication and made check in very easy. The only thing that could improve is room darkening blinds since it seemed very bright in both rooms all hours of the night. However, that is the only improvement needed in my opinion.
Nice and clean as described, getting in was smooth as it came.  Nicely furnished and lots of room.
The was such a great location for our first time visit to Chicago and Imran was extremely accommodating. Would stay here again 100%
Great location!! And very nice place!

Meighan’s place was even more than we hoped for. Great location in Logan Square, stylishly decorated, comfortable and clean - plus a wonderful back porch and garden sanctuary. Our favorite AirBnB ever.
It was pretty worth it.

Tonja was a great host very responsive. The property was well kept and it a really nice area there was a park nearby and the golf course was convenient as well. Train was a 15 min walk which was very convenient the upstairs bedroom was a little warm but manageable and the primary bedroom felt very luxurious overall a great experience !

Alina’s place was perfect for my event on the west side. The neighborhood was safe and quiet. No issues with parking or access to the living space. My small kids enjoyed the space, and the open space to run around! Alina made check-out easy, too!

The place was just as described. Cute and comfortable. My only concerns were I’m not sure if the bed was a true queen bed. It was comfortable but seemed a bit small and secondly which has nothing to do with our host we did get a bunch of rain overnight and when we went out to the car the next morning there must have been 5 or 6 inches of water in the road making it a bit difficult to get into the car
Me and my friends were very pleased with this place! The shower downstairs was a favorite, and the atmosphere of the inside was very nice. For the price, I would recommend this to anyone.
Very nice place, with good fast communication!
This place was just what our group needed. Raghu was very responsive throughout the whole process.
Great place to stay to do activities around grant park and soldier field. Easy walk, beautiful area.
Beautiful house in a great neighborhood. Very walkable to Wrigley and very convenient train for the city and airport

Fantastic from day one. Wanted to write a review immediately but hesitated just in case there were any hiccups. There were none. The host was super responsive. The attention to detail and available amenities were much appreciated (TV in every room, available snacks and sodas, hygiene products, wifi instructions and QR code, fun light fixtures, character to each room…).
This place served as a perfect base for graduation activities. Our only regret is that we didn’t find this place sooner before our daughter graduated.

The location was amazing, great neighborhood and very close to the train.  The place was easy to find, clean, and worked well for our short stay. I know that the ceiling height is mentioned in the post, but I did find it incomfortable. Other than that, it was a great deal.
Excellent stay.  Connie was a great host.  We loved the backyard and the walkable neighborhood to University of Chicago and the Point - we rode bikes by the lake up to the city.

Great location - walkable to great shops, restaurants, bars, the Bloomingdale Trail, and the Blue Line.  Safe, accessible parking spot.  Very responsive host.  The unit is a bit dated and not exactly as pictured and described.

Nice place to stay- good location.
Very good communication
The room was very clean and comfortable, for a great price! 10/10 would recommend.
Everything was as advertised.  3 minute walk to all of the restaurants and the park and the Red Line train terminal.
Great price for Lincoln Park.  Loved it.

Einzig was mich an diese Wohnungen störrt, ist dass Schlafzimmer (in diesem Fall 2 von der 4) nicht abgeschlossen sind. D.h. sie sind oberhalb der Türe offen und man hat nicht seine Intimität. Ich finde dies sollte in der Beschreibung erklärt werden. Ich weiss aber dass einige dieser Wohnungen so sind (ich bin viel mit sonder gereist in Chicago, konnte nur eine Wohunug in River North finden die alle 3 Schlafzimmer zu hatten)

We really liked our stay in this unit.  Its location in Lincoln Park can’t be beat, close to the action and walkable to the park and lake, about a mile from Wrigley Field.  Our unit was on the back of the building and was quiet and peaceful despite being right on Clark Street.  The interior was clean and spacious with a modern minimalism.  Kitchen was clean and well stocked.  We would stay here again when visiting friends and family in Lincoln park!
This place was very cute & had everything we needed. Very walkable to public transportation & restaurants.

Rashad always answered any questions we had promptly. The house was very nice and clean. Had a little trouble finding outlets to plug in our devices as quite a few of the ones in the home are really loose and couldn't be used but we were able to find enough for what we needed.
This was a great stay! Private, secure, clean, and exactly as advertised! Great location. Super responsive and helpful hosts. Thank you so much.
Great location. My daughter and I came into town for volleyball and this was perfect. Walking distance to alot of restaurant options. Clean space and great neighborhood.

Great place.
Amazing location.
Sofa bed was comfortable.
I visited with my 19 year old son and it was perfect.
It’s cozy, but u don’t come to Chicago to sit inside.
2 people is the limit.
Super cute and comfy.

Milan's place was as described in the photo and he was very communicative and responsive to requests and addressing minor issues.  The Airbnb is very close to great eats in Chinatown (~15 walk).  Overall worth considering if you're planning a trip to Chicago
Cozy living arrangements right in downtown, two blocks away from Grant Park. Would stay again! 😄

I had a wonderful stay at Walter's Place in Chicago, Illinois! The aparment was charming, clean, comfortable, and beautifully appointed with everything I needed for a relaxing visit.
The location is fantastic — convenient with plenty of great food options nearby, plus that peaceful big city charm.
A big thank you to Unc for his excellent assistance and thoughtful help throughout our stay. He made everything seamless and stress-free. I would suggest if your business is in the inner City to stay here and take the local train.
Highly recommend.
Awesome place! It’s in a great location and very walkable. Larissa is a great host and made my friends and I feel very welcomed! I would recommend this place.
Beautiful space in a beautiful area. Made for a great stay.
Great place, thanks for having us
Great experience from start to finish. Rene was responsive and friendly. The space is gorgeous and the bathrooms were amazing!

The garden apartment is amazing! It was clean, open and spacious. It was a bit of a hike to the Cubs game, but well worth it. It worked perfectly for our mother/daughter duo girls trip. We had a blast and hope to be back!

Our stay at Tony’s place was great. We had 10 adults and were able to fit everyone by putting a few on air mattresses and the couch (there’s only 4 double beds). We had everything we needed in the kitchen and Tony made sure we had enough linens for everyone. The space is very bare bones but functional. A bit far to walk to anywhere.

Great stay, great location, uncluttered and clean. Keys were a hassle tho, and only 4 dining chairs, albeit very comfortable. No outdoor chairs, but deck and front areas to enjoy.  Note, there is a Keurig, not a coffee maker.
Todo perfecto. Cómodo y tal cual lo esperado. Hay varios locales y lugares para comer en la zona. Pasta d’arte is a must
Excelente recepción, me sentí como en casa 🤘🏾
The place and host were absolutely amazing. Waking up to a view of Lake Michigan in a quiet neighborhood is a dream
Very clean and comfortable with all the appliances needed to enjoy some time in Chicago.
Great place, great location!
Beautiful home and wonderful hosts!
Had a great stay and everything was exactly as described and pictured. Host was very friendly and responsive. Highly recommend!
Great Hostess & Great Stay!!!
Had an awesome weekend with friends coming into town to celebrate wedding festivities. Place was beautiful, spacious and perfect for hosting my group of 15.
Had issues with getting the door lock to work. Tara was very helpful getting into the room though.

There was a mix-up with the unit address, but we figured it out quickly.  The place was very nice, although the street out front was busy, the noise level inside was low, hardly noticeable.  We went to a Cubs game and the walk was easy. It was close to bus service and the EL train.  I would stay again.
Jill was such a great host, and her place and the area were perfect for the month I stayed there. Her dog Nala is also an amazing roommate.

Larry was such a great host! Not only was he always communicative, but he also clearly thought about what would be helpful in terms of amenities for a large group. One nice surprise was a bottle of sunscreen (we couldn’t have brought such a large size in a carry-on). The top floor can get a little toasty at night, but there are fans upstairs and the AC worked very well on the bottom and main floors. Everything was pristine and comfy.
Would definitely stay here again. Our group sends huge thanks to Larry!
Great host, great location. Would absolutely recommend!
We were not able to use the master bathroom due to the tub needing maintenance / had a leak
Great location, close to food, attractions & public transit. Building was quiet & the unit was very clean. Would stay here again.
Awesome place!  If you have the chance, book this apartment!
Mi estancia fue buena, y tuve buena comunicación con el host, lo recomiendo

The private rooftop deck absolutely steals the show! The city views were incredible, especially at night, and it was a perfect spot to unwind. Being steps from the Blue Line made exploring Chicago effortless. The three stories gave our group plenty of space and privacy. Highly recommend this gem!

Great neighborhood, nice building amenities including onsite parking and gym.  Apartment offers 4 bedrooms, each of which have their own bath which is nice.  Believe the listing says sleeps 8 or 10, which seems high.  We were 6 people and there isn't sufficient table seating nor lounge space for 6.  The building is student housing so the accommodations are relatively basic, with light streaming in through the shades in the morning and few cooking supplies.  We were a family with adult children in town for a graduation and wanted to prepare basic breakfast each morning.  This was a challenge as the toaster didn't work and there were no proper mixing bowls.

Perfect location for our weekend visit to Chicago.  Great location, quiet neighborhood, kitchen and bathroom were clean and well stocked. Beds were comfortable. No issues/concerns. Would definitely stay here again.

Karen’s place is awesome! This third floor Airbnb feels like home and is in a great location. Public transportation is super close by and the place was stocked with amenities. You will not regret staying at Karen‘s place!

The hostess was very responsible, beautiful apartment, clean, everything in order and on our arrival they had some items in the fridge for breakfast, that was so nice for my family. highly recommend this place the roof top was out of a magazine. It was perfect for my family 🥰 thank you all for this amazing experience we had in Chicago.
Bryan was so great and the place is amazing. Incredible neighborhood too.
Great location, walking distance to many attractions.

Great location and hosts were quick to resolve a check in issue! The house was clean and I appreciated the toiletries included. I gave 4 stars because the upstairs neighbors were very loud. The constant running/jumping was so loud it was shaking the pictures hanging on the wall. On vacation that early morning wake up call isnt ideal. I think this is a great location to stay if you plan on waking up and being out of the house by 7am. Overall, it felt like a safe location with everything you need within walking distance. I will also give the side note, 2 of our guests were over 6'5 " and kept hitting their heads on the ceiling so keep that in mind if it applies to you.
Had a great stay. Noel’s place has a distinct decor and character, and he was a very attentive host.
Great place and clean house

Gary is a gem of a host. We appreciated his kind, genuine, and courteous nature. We had a lovely time in his space. It was neat and clean and we were very comfortable. The neighborhood is quiet and a short walk from local restaurants, bars, and coffee shops. And Wrigley Field is a short bus ride away. We would absolutely stay here again.

Nice place, great convenient location in a nice neighborhood, no problem finding close on street parking.
Thanks too for the help getting back the pair of shoes we accidentally left there. Much appreciated!
Lovely home with lovely hosts. We would definitely stay again.

We loved our stay at this Airbnb in Chicago’s River West neighborhood. The pictures and description matched the unit when we stayed there. Thomas was also a super responsive host. We would be happy to return here in the future!

Nice, spacious place with plenty of room for four people. The location was great—right next to the Blue Line, making it easy to get around the city, and within walking distance of lots of restaurants, coffee shops, and other spots in Wicker Park.
The only surprise was that there’s a nightclub right next door. Fortunately, the noise only affected us one of the three nights we were there, and the other nights were fine. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the convenient location and easy check in process!

Fun, convenient location to all things Pilsen and beyond!
Great floor plan with surprising upgrades! Indoor/ outdoor spaces were all clean and crisp!
We’ll be back !!
Al and Jude are both very friendly when we first checked in. The environment and the house are very clean and tidy.
Stayed for a sporting weekend with some friends. Place was great, blue line within a 5-7 min walk. Would stay again.
Our family had a fantastic stay. We loved the location and everything was as described. Jake was extremely attentive and a very good communicator. Will definitely stay here again.

Overall a nice apartment. Exactly as described. I loved the shower (it is definitely new). The temperature in the bedroom across the bathroom was a little warm compared to the rest of the space, we contacted the owner and he was very responsive.

The location is excellent, with easy walking access to local attractions, restaurants, and the Wrigley. 
Unfortunately, the unit fell short of expectations. The listing photos were somewhat misleading, the front bedroom was very noisy due to poor window conditions, several basic necessities were missing, and the bathroom faucet was barely attached. Guests should also use caution with the dining room chairs, as the seat pads are not secured and can slide unexpectedly.
The biggest issue was the host-arranged luggage service, which was extremely unreliable and required repeated follow-ups before our luggage was finally delivered just before an international flight, reflecting a disappointing lack of urgency and accountability.
While the location is fantastic, the overall experience was not, and I would not stay here again.
Comfortable apartment for our stay. 15 minute walk to the Blue Line through a nice neighborhood was quite convenient.
Excellent for the price, I highly recommend staying in the teal room.
A truly great spot! We had a large group of guys in town for the weekend and the space fit us very well. Cozy rooms, plenty of bathrooms, and a really incredible patio space. Would highly recommend!
Great stay.

Incredible location, SUPER clean!!!, and so much more spacious than my group of 7 anticipated! The room with the king bed is on the opposite side of the unit from the 2 other bedrooms which allows light sleepers some extra space in a group environment. The hosts were SO kind and attentive, checking in with us throughout our stay, really went above and beyond! The only things that I could comment on are outside of their control—it’s a 3rd floor walk-up (no elevator), and the 1 parking space available was very difficult for my mid-size SUV to navigate into. Otherwise, this unit and these hosts are second to none!!
The coffee station was greatly

This AirBnb was perfect for our weekend in Chicago! So much space in the Airbnb with various rooms and floors. Jamie the host was extremely responsive to all of our questions and it was in an ideal location - we had a great time. Would rent it out again if we went back to Chicago!
Great location. Great communication.
Great Air Bnb in a fantastic neighborhood! About a 10 min drive from Wrigley and a great deck to hang out on. Loved it!

Great location! Within walking distance (or short bus ride) to Lincoln Park and a few minutes from red and brown line trains.  The neighborhood was very peaceful and felt safe. Everything about the b&b was as described and the host was proactive and friendly. Would definitely stay here again!
Amazing place.
The accommodations were exactly what I need when visiting Chicago. Communication with the host was great! I would definitely stay again.
This was our third stay and we were welcomed like old friends. Edwardo and Lois are lovely people and wonderful and truly professional hosts. Beautiful home in a great location!
Thank you! Beautiful place!

This was a perfect stay for my bachelorette trip! The rooms & beds were comfortable and spacious, and everything was very clean. It was so nice to have 4 bathrooms in the unit for all the girls to get ready and I appreciated the amenities and extra mirrors in each bathroom. It was a great location with lots of restaurant and cafe options that are walkable, or just a short ride share to bars and restaurants in River North and Fulton Market areas. The hosts were extremely responsive, accommodating and friendly from booking thru after checkout. Overall, I would highly recommend this property and would definitely stay here again!
Entsprach der Beschreibung - kein Luxus, aber für alles wesentliche vorhanden und zweckmäßig. Sehr freundliche Gastgeber.

My stay here was exactly what I was looking for. I was able to walk to Wrigley field shortly after checking in to catch a Cubs game, which was perfect. The hosts were very responsive to check in on how everything was going with my stay. The place is exactly as pictured, everything was up to my standards of cleanliness. The neighborhood this is in is definitely highly walkable and nearby to a transit station, so not having a car during my stay wasn't an impediment to getting around the city at all. Overall, I'd stay here again when visiting Chicago. I was definitely satisfied and happy that I chose to stay for my trip to Wrigley.
The location was well located, efficient, comfortable, clean, super well appointed, well priced, and probably the best AirBnB we've ever stayed at.

Our stay was great! We were here for 3 nights to attend a festival in Chicago over the weekend. Easy Uber to the city!
As for the place, it was cozy and had everything we needed. Internet was fast and plenty to watch on the streaming tv. Or just sign into your own accounts and sign out before you leave :)
Lots of storage and the kitchen had everything we needed to make a homemade meal; pots, pans, utensils, etc…
There was a keurig for coffee, a toaster and I believe an electric tea kettle.
Bed was comfortable and plenty of outlets to charge our devices. Only complaint is not having a coffee table or end tables to place a drink on as we sat on the couch.
We loved our cozy stay! Hosts were very responsive. Will stay again!
Anastasia was great and very responsive with any questions I had. I had mentioned I was bringing a guest and had set up the extra sleeping space for my guest so it was ready for our check-in.
Nice cozy place, within walking distance of bakery, gas station, pizza, hots dogs and more. 12 minute walk to the train.

We really enjoyed our stay. We had a small hiccup with the keys & reached out to the host to rectify the situation & they got back to us super quick but we had figured it out by then (it was user error totally not the host’s fault!) It was also great having the Hollywood diner downstairs as we got a discount for staying at this air b&b so we took advantage of that as well! All around we had a wonderful stay.
We had a great extended stay at Jason's place.  He was always responsive and helpful.  The place was comfortable, charming and quiet, and it suited our needs perfectly. Great stay!
Our stay was wonderful. The space fit what we needed for the weekend.
Very easy instructions to get in. Was very smooth to get to and tons of restaurants to do around the Airbnb. Neighborhood was also very chill!

The place was a great distance from the city, and a really reasonable price. The host is very responsive and friendly, and kindly helped us with a last second travel issue. I would recommend to anyone.
Great stay. enjoyed.
The place is very nice and great for a large group! Very clean and rooftop is a fun addition!

I stayed here for the Germany-USA soccer match, and the location was perfect—walkable to grocery stores, restaurants, and Soldier Field. The place was exactly as described—clean and comfortable. The view of the lake and skyline at night was wonderful. We could easily walk or rent bikes nearby. Just note, on hotter days, the lack of air conditioning could be a factor and a fan may be helpful. As it was, we kept the windows open and had a good draft going. But overall, it was a fantastic stay!”
Nathan & Jake were great hosts.  Always communicated well and on time.  The home is perfect for any group looking for a lot of space and location to the west loop!

Our family came from Trinidad and Tobago for our daughter's graduation at the University of Chicago. The taxi driver have us a scare about the neighborhood which turned out to be rumours. We walked around at all times.
The place was ideal for us but a bit expensive being that graduation was in full swing.
The house is a quaint place with all the antique furnishings.
Kenneth the host was very responsive.
At first glance on arrival there were lots of leaves that needs attention.
Great location in a quiet neighborhood. Had a wonderful time exploring the city.

Simida could not have been kinder or more helpful when we found our weekend in Chicago had some unexpected twists, like my kiddo landing in the hospital with appendicitis!  Simida thank you again for everything you did to make sure we were comfortable and well-accommodated — your beautiful peaceful oasis was just what we needed to come home to at the end of every day!

I had a wonderful experience with this property in Chicago, primarily due to its fantastic location and Bozena's prompt responses. I appreciated her attentiveness throughout my stay. I would certainly consider booking again for future trips to the city.

Marjorie was a great host. Very communicative and helpful. The apartment is in a great location near restaurants and public transport. Super clean and cozy. Just be aware that the elevator was not working and the studio is located on a 5th floor..  Had a great stay!
convenient. very spacious inside
More or less as advertised. Responsive to my questions, although they tried to get me to sign extra paperwork and stipulations on a third party website -- which I believe is against Airbnb policy

What a beautiful condo! The location is in an ideal spot and close to several great restaurants, coffee shops and things to do. There’s also a Walgreens right around the corner, which was handy when we needed things. The host was a great communicator and provided easy to follow instructions. Overall, we had a lovely time and would stay here again.

We loved staying here. The location was great. The room was cozy, the decor and collections were a millennial’s dream. Joshua was extremely nice and helpful during our stay. We felt well taken care of. The dog barked when we entered, but was never mean and we never felt unsafe around her. After she became accustomed to our presence, she would actually walk up to us and lick our legs.

Khadija has been the best host I've experienced so far. From the moment we booked until our arrival and throughout our stay, she consistently checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. Everything matched the listing exactly, and the previous reviews accurately described both the property and the surrounding area. The accommodations were comfortable, well-maintained, and made for a great stay. I would definitely recommend staying here and would gladly book with Khadija again in the future.
We loved our stay at Onelia’s , felt like we were at home and parking was amazing you it’s free street parking, it was easy for us
Great hosts. They stocked the fridge and the pantry before we arrived, even left us a jar of homemade jam. They are kind and welcoming! Would highly recommend.

Great Spot, near the blue line, k
park and bars/cafe's near by
Excellent place and great service. The only thing to keep in mind is that there are quite a few stairs, which may be challenging for an older person. Other than that, everything was excellent!
Great space.  Close to everything downtown.  easy access and great on site staff. Would rent again.

Kody's place was perfect for our long weekend stay in Chicago. The home is clean and roomy. The beds are comfortable and we had everything we needed there. It's very close to bus stops and an easy 20 min walk to the red line train. We would definitely stay here again if in the area.
Great place and friendly host, would recommend!

We absolutely loved our stay here. This location was in walking distance to many restaurants, shops, and parks. We hopped on scooters and had a short ride to the blue line, which took us straight into downtown. Thank you again for letting us enjoy your place, our visit to Chicago was most enjoyable!
a fancy and comfortable space

The property was amazing- it looked just like the pictures and was in an absolutely great location close to Wrigley Field. And the host, Peter, was really easy to worth with. If you are a baseball fan there is no better place to stay.
We loved staying in Old Town and found a lot to do within walking distance. The floor was quite spacious and offered plenty of room for a large group to relax and chill. Highly recommend!

This was a perfect place to stay whilst visiting Chicago for Cubs games. It is in Wrigleyville which is a great neighborhood. It is very walkable with nice restaurants and Wrigley Field. There are always plenty of people out walking, running, or walking their dogs.
The space was pristine. There is a cute back porch area which is perfect for a morning coffee/crossword/book situation. The bedrooms are comfortable and the bathrooms are really nice. Peter had the fridge stocked with water which was really nice since it was pretty warm outside. The bathrooms were also stocked with anything you may need or may have forgotten in your haste to pack.
I would definitely recommend and would stay again.
Johnie was a great host. My group and I enjoyed this place. Loved the price and how responsive Johnie was. I would definitely come back.
Joseph's place is well worth the price and is near a train stop!

We had a wonderful stay at Laurie's beautiful home for a graduation weekend with family:  the space is gracious and inviting, the backyard is magical, and the family member with the chronic bad back sang the praises of the firm mattress! We ended up eating in for every meal because the kitchen is extremely well stocked and all the different areas to sit/dine meant that we could really catch up with one another and celebrate the grad.  The house is an oasis in vibrant Bronzeville - easy walk to coffee shops, boutiques, and public transportation.  The place itself is a reason for us to return to Chicago, and Laurie's warm hospitality and extraordinary responsiveness makes her an exceptional host!
Great location. Reasonable price.
The place worked well for what we needed for our Chicago weekend. Easy access and good communication.

Everything was great! Having the parking spot was so helpful. So clean. Nicely decorated. Well stocked. And honestly my most pleasant surprise was the ziploc stash. Haha. When traveling with snacks leftover it was so helpful.

From the start, Freddy was very attentive and responsive to every one of my questions and requests. The place was extremely clean when I checked in and his listing was very accurate. I would definitely book with him again as he is exactly what a superhost is supposed to be.

Great location to stay in Chicago with easy access to public transit. We had our two dogs with us and we had a park within walking distance to take them to. We had everything we needed for our quick weekend trip! Thank you!

My three friends stayed for four days and three nights and it was lovely! Host provided an extra mattress in a spacious guest room. I can sleep anywhere so I was on the floor mattress and my friends who are more sensitive stayed on the bed and it was great for them and I was perfectly comfortable too. Room had PLENTY of outlets for all of us.
All linens/towels were fresh and easy to find. Bathroom had ample hot water & was very clean! Shampoo, conditioner & body wash were provided which was great!
Best part are the three cats! My friend and I are huge cat people so this was nice! You would NEVER know three cats lived there with how spotless every thing was! Also, they had air purifiers on every floor! Would suggest to talk to hosts before petting them!
Free parking could be the only issue but my friends and I found a spot. Spots typically open up in the morning so I would suggest parking at that time.
Overall an amazing experience! Hosts, location and public transit were AMAZING!
Dan was a wonderful host ! Quick to respond and very friendly ! Place was in pristine condition ! I enjoyed my stay and will book again in the future ! Thank you Dan !

Otoniel is doing a great job! His place is beautiful and spotless. It's a very quiet and safe neighborhood. The room was very comfy and he has blackout curtains on the window!! Thank you so much for having us!
Great place in a great neighborhood. Geo was a great host!

I stayed here with my partner and our friends for our joint bach and it was perfect! Even though there were 9 of us, the place felt really spacious and had just about everything we needed for our 3-night stay. Nick and Jeff were very friendly and responsive, and were flexible with both check in and check out which was a huge help. Overall, a really great stay for a great price and we would definitely stay here again!

Exactly as described, adorable old house set back off the street with lots of seating areas to enjoy if you like being outside, which we do.  This place works well for self sufficient, independent travelers; it was perfect for our quick trip.  The bathroom has been updated since the pictures were last posted and the kitchen is well stocked.
Great host, lovely place. I struggled with checking in and out of the place but Frank answered my calls damn near instantly to help. 5 stars

The apartment worked great for us. Everything was very clean. The A/C was wonderful on such a humid weekend. It is about a 5 minute walk to Belmont Station which easily gets you downtown. Kitchen was decently stocked, but we are big coffee drinkers so the single k-cup coffee was kind of a bummer in the mornings. The beds are pretty firm and the pillows are thin.

Though the south side of chicago can be scary, we felt super safe here, i put noisy as we heard what sounded like fireworks or fire crackers every night around the same time, but thats not this mans fault! His rental is absolutely gorgeous we loved it so much it fit our group perfectly and it was 15 minutes away from the event we were going to so it was kismet! i would highly recommend Armando’s rental hes a very nice host! :)
Really lovely host with a place in a very convenient area!
The place is great. It does what it says on the tin. The main thing was that Jackpaul was super friendly and very communicative through the entire process.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The neighborhood was great and felt safe to walk around at almost any time of day. The apartment was very modern and felt like home, and everything that we could need for a great stay was provided. This air bnb helped make our trip great!

We stayed for a quick weekend to attend a Cubs game.  The place was perfect for the 4 of us & it felt more like a home than a super sterile hotel or every some airbnb's I've stayed in.  It was very quiet - only twice did we hear anyone walking upstairs & it wasn't bad.  It was close to the bus stop & walking distance to some restaurants.   It was clean & very comfortable.  Would definitely stay again!
Great location ! Skipping distance to the red line.  Roof top is amazing.  Check in instructions are so thorough.  Good restaurants and bars in the neighborhood and walking distance to the beach. 🏖️

We stayed here while visiting Chicago for a weekend event downtown. Since it was our first time in the city, we underestimated the distance to where we needed to be, but that was entirely on us and not a reflection of the Airbnb.
The Airbnb itself was wonderful. You can tell the hosts put a lot of thought into both the functionality and comfort of the space. Everything was well organized, comfortable, and made us feel right at home throughout our stay.
Noe was incredibly friendly, accommodating, and communicative from start to finish. We really appreciated how responsive and welcoming they were. Overall, we had a great experience and truly enjoyed our stay. We would gladly recommend this Airbnb to future guests visiting Chicago.

Nice little apartment to stay, you could easily get to the CTA Blueline (about a 5-7 min walk) we used that and literally got to anywhere we wanted to go. Everything was nice, clean and tidy. Host was very responsive and even gave some recommendations on places to see. Check in/out was very easy and the area was also very nice. If I ever come back I would definitely re-book!

A wonderful place to stay! super convenient location, with a great deli around the corner to grab coffee.
The apartment is beautifully decorated with furniture that's also very comfortable. It was a perfect spot for a small group for Chicago weekend. Highly recommend staying here.
Place was perfect for a quick weekend in Chicago. Close to the blue line which made getting downtown quick and simple. House was clean and quiet

This is the worst day I have ever had anywhere It was filthy I left something after checkout and went back to the room and saw that the cleaner didn’t even change the bedding just the sheets and refolded the towel I had used the room looked like it had never been swept there was stuff left behind in the porch from a previous guest and the bathroom was the worst part it was so nasty although this isn’t the hosts fault the neighbors were so noisy and had a stray dog wandering around barking at people outside it was in such a sketchy neighborhood I wouldn’t wish this stay on my worst enemy lastly a random man unlocked my bedroom door early on the morning without knocking I was terrified cause I was ok bed and not fully dressed there is no excuse as to why someone was able to enter my room during my stay without notice or knocking especially when the host is a women and they didn’t announce who they were
The property was great. It was clean and spacious and exactly as described.  Bart was a great host and was extremely responsive.  I would happily stay here again.

In a great neighborhood for accessing what Chicago has to offer, the property worked very well for us during a recent stay. We found the check-in to be super easy, the living space clean, and street parking readily available. We rented one of the owners' other properties as well in the past, and it was also a very good experience. Would recommend.

The host Shay was nice and friendly.
The place was clean, comfortable, and easy.
I would definitely recommend this place and would happily stay again.
We had a great time there.  It was quiet and peaceful and relaxing.

This location is immediately adjacent to an interstate and the CTA. It is very noisy. My windows in my room had a clear view of the highway, and it was loud 24/7.
There were dirty dishes in the sink all weekend. I informed the host, and they were not taken care of by the cleaning crew before I left. The fridge had a lot of leftovers and food in it. Bathroom was clean, but could use a scrubbing.
Check-in instructions were simple, and the location next to a CTA stop made for excellent access.

Great motel within walking distance of Millennium Park, Grant Park, Field Museum, Soldier Field, Shedd Aquarium and Navy Pier.  We even walked to Lincoln Park Zoo.  But lots of access to public transportation if that’s not your thing, lots of places to eat of varying price and what you’re in the mood for.  Very nice area of town but still had ample security regardless.

My family and I stayed at Sherry and Michael's place for four nights.  Their home is lovely and I immediately felt right at home.  They have thought of everything.  The kitchen was fully stocked with all the amenities we needed, the bedrooms were clean and comfortable.  It truly is an Oasis.  The next time my family and I visit Chicago, this will definitely be our top choice for a place to stay.  I highly recommend.

We had a wonderful stay at Leigh’s lovely house, which was perfect for our family visit to Chicago for a graduation.  Access to the house is through a beautifully maintained front garden — a peaceful place to sit in the sun.  The house is spacious, very nicely furnished, and equipped with everything we could possibly need.  The office/den was great for one of the family who had to work for a day or two. The location is perfect, quiet and leafy green, but with restaurants, coffee bars and supermarkets in walking distance, and with easy access to public transport as well. Leigh was so nice to communicate with, which made for a stress-free arrival and checkout.  Everything was more than we hoped for, an ideal place for our celebration. Thank you, Leigh.

The two biggest pros of this Airbnb are its location in a great neighborhood and its ability to comfortably accommodate a large group. The outdoor area was private and spacious. The location made it easy to hop to different areas of the city. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb for large groups looking to experience Chicago.

Very clear instructions and phenomenal communication by the Airbnb host. Abby made sure we felt welcomed and the space was clean. Pipes were a bit squeaky but my buddy and I sleep through most things so we had no issues. Overall, highly recommended place to stay. Price was good for us too.
It was perfect. I personally loved the sounds of the trains going by, but if you’re a light sleeper, it may not be the perfect place for you!
Great neighborhood, super responsive hosts - we were very pleased.
Clean and spacious. Easy to find and access, no issues with parking during our weekend trip.

Excellent in all categories! Hosts were responsive, location was ideal for any of the activities we planned around the greater-Chicago area, Home was comfortable, clean, and exceeded expectations. The location was quiet and peaceful. It was within walking distance to any/all restaurants, stores, the ballpark, etc.  I would, without hesitation, recommend this Home to anyone who is looking for an outstanding experience in Chicago.

Stayed here for a weekend to go to a Cubs game and take advantage of the bars and restaurants. Super awesome location for getting to Southport and Wrigley. The home itself is great and easily accommodated our group. Would absolutely stay again

Great location close to the beach, close to the train, and close to some great restaurants: highly recommend Alexander’s for breakfast! The neighborhood is beautiful and walkable and it is just 5 minutes to Loyola beach. The apartment is comfortable for 3 people and the host is very responsive and helpful. When it got a little cold she quickly helped by turning on the heat.
The apartment itself is not the cleanest (some insects and dust) and can smell a bit musty, which makes sense because it is a basement apartment. The internet is fast but only at the end rooms of the apartment, not in the middle living room area.
Overall, it was an ok stay and we enjoyed our time in the neighborhood!

My family and I stayed for a weekend bridal shower. The home was spacious for a group of 9 women with plenty of bathrooms. The description of the home matched with what we experienced. The host, Matricia is friendly and responsive. I would recommend for any south side Chicago visits.
Nice area. Helpful instructions.

This is a family friendly apartment. We had six adults and four kids (10, 9, 7 & 5) in our group that arrived and departed at different times over the weekend. Having an indoor reserved parking spot was great because we had three other vehicles. We were able to find nearby free on-street parking the whole time. Mark greeted me upon my arrival and every message was responded to in minutes. Target is a short walk away which was very helpful. We also walked to a nearby park but it was geared toward smaller children. The rooftop access is beautiful and was a great place for the kids to run off energy as well as a relaxing spot for adults. It was the first time we had ever done a vacation like that with most of our family and it was so very special.

Everything looked like the photos, and the front garden was very pretty to walk through. The bed was very comfortable especially after walking all day! I was also grateful for the white noise machine. The hosts were very responsive too.

Really great location!! Right by the metro so getting to/from the airport and other places was a breeze. Also a really fun little neighborhood to stay in with lots going on! It was perfect for our group. The host was responsive and helpful whenever we had questions. Would totally stay here again!

We had THE BEST stay at this Airbnb and would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!
The home was exactly what our group needed: comfortable, SO CLEAN, welcoming, and in a great location. It truly felt like a home away from home, which made our trip that much better. Everything was thoughtfully prepared, and the space was both beautiful and functional. AND 4 full bathrooms is a rarity. Plus such excellent photo ops everywhere!!
What really set this stay apart, though, were the hosts. Sarah went above and beyond multiple times to ensure we had everything we needed and was incredibly responsive, kind, and accommodating throughout our stay. Their attention to detail and genuine care made the entire experience seamless and stress-free.
If you're looking for a place where you can feel completely at ease, have all your needs covered, and enjoy a comfortable stay in Chicago, do not hesitate to book this property! We are excited to stay here again!
Coty was very responsive to our needs. Would highly recommend. One note - if you are not an early riser, you might want to bring sleep masks. The skylights in the bedrooms were not covered.
Awesome home for a large group. Convenient to wrigley and super easy to navigate. Would stay here again.
Great home, host and location! Very pleased with our stay and unit

my boyfriend and I had an excellent experience staying here during Pokemon Go Fest. The place was super clean and adorably decorated and we really appreciated the snacks and toiletries provided. The neighborhood seemed very safe and quiet and was a short walk to a coffee shop with excellent breakfast sandwiches as well as a grocery store. We arrived off our flight late night/early morning and had no issue getting access.

We absolutely loved staying at this little piece of urban heaven in Andersonville. Our family of four felt right at home in the space and were so grateful for the charming decor and extra special touches like fresh baked cookies and and a stocked drink fridge!  The beds were comfy, the towels were plush and the neighborhood was flush with fun restaurants, excellent shopping and culture galore. Highly recommend and can’t wait to return.

My friend and I had a great stay during our weekend to visit an art exhibition in Chicago. The place was super clean, cozy, comfortable, & accurately described on the listing. There was also a lot to do in the area! Lots of tasty restaurants, shops, thrift stores, & record shops. Would definitely come back some day!

Wonderful host. Very easy to understand check in and check out instructions. For reference on the ceilings, my partner is 5’10 and didn’t have any issues. There is a low spot in the bedroom and the shower area but this didn’t cause any issues during our stay since it’s not the whole unit! Highly recommend to anyone staying in Chicago!
Great home within a great location. Host was responsive in messages, and overall a very nice stay. I would recommend a stay here for large groups!
The place was clean and comfortable. Made for a very relaxing evening and weekendI. Jasmine was helpful with any questions we had during our visit.

Tammy was a great host and it felt like home throughout my stay at her wonderful home. She was flexible with check in time, and was very responsive. The room was very aesthetic, spacious and warm. I was glad to also have the use of the fridge and other kitchen utensils available to me, to keep in the food I had ordered. This home had all the amenities I needed. The private beach at the end of the beach was an added bonus. thank you again Tammy for your hospitality!!
An older home, but clean and tidy. Host was responsive to any needs I brought up. Overall a great place for the price where you can get rested and get right back out into the city.

The apartment is quite large in a great location. The building is old and shows signs of wear.  The furniture was comfortable, but the bed could use a new mattress as it felt soft and somewhat lumpy. The AC was not functioning. The owner was very responsive but was unable to fix it during my stay. He did offer a partial refund.
Jennifer and Ben were great host. The stay was squeaky clean and such well organized. Instructions for check in and check out were straightforward.

The space is beautifully renovated, clean and located in an idyllic tree lined neighborhood.  The hosts provided great instructions and were very responsive to messages.  The quiet times were not as quiet as one would expect.
Muy buena comunicación, amables desde el primer momento.
It was a great house for our group. Spencer was very helpful and made our stay very comfortable. Perfect location to get to various neighborhoods, especially Wrigley
Great location and cozy apartment overall. Everything was clean and matched the pictures shown on the website.

We had a wonderful stay and really enjoyed the Airbnb. The home was clean, comfortable, and provided a great space for our group to spend time together. The location and overall accommodations helped make our trip even more enjoyable.
One small suggestion would be to consider adding additional mirrors in the bedrooms. For larger groups, especially when multiple people are getting ready at the same time, having extra mirrors available would be very helpful and make the experience even more convenient.
Thank you for being a great host and for providing such a lovely place to stay! 😊
Great location, clean house and responsive host! Thank you!

Julie’s place was an awesome stay! Very convenient walk to the Blue Line which made it very easy to get into the city.
The place its self was beautifully put together and had very nice homey touches. Would recommend to anybody and next time I’m with a big enough group will be sure to see if this place is available!
Very nice, comfortable first floor unit. Very walkable area.

Loved our stay, and the highlight was Brandy and the co-hosts themselves. They were incredibly responsive and flexible with checkout. The location was perfect for our group, with easy access to Hyde Park, downtown, and the lake.
A few notes for future guests: the listing photo showing a room with two double beds does not match any actual room in the unit, and the office sofa bed was not functional. The hosts kindly added a sofa bed in the basement to compensate, but the basement is quite open and has a vending machine light, which made privacy and darkness tricky (especially for me sleeping with a baby). For some groups this setup will work fine, just go in with clear expectations on sleeping arrangements.
One small wishlist item: the kitchen is genuinely well-equipped and even had disposable cups, but only 3 mugs for a place this nicely stocked felt a bit short.
Lovely stay overall. Recommend the location and hosts wholeheartedly; just plan ahead for sleeping arrangements. Thanks!

Ideally located for the University of Chicago.  Since one enters from the back of the building, it was difficult to locate, since the building numbers are not visible from the back alley.  Spacious and clean.

Milan’s house was a great place to stay. It is located in an awesome part of the city, close to everything yet not in the craziness of downtown. The private balcony was a hit with our crew as it provided amazing views of the city! He was very responsive to the questions I had prior to check-in and his instructions/suggestions were spot on.

excellent and responsive host! very detailed instructions and responsive!! the place was great for walk ability to the beach (such a quiet and cute neighborhood!) while being easy to go downtown. The host was so responsive.

Great place to stay! The host was very responsive and helpful. Everything was exactly as described and we had everything we needed. The location was convenient and Ubers were affordable to all the places we wanted to visit. Would definitely stay here again!

Benny was an absolute gem of a host—amazing, incredibly responsive, and genuinely kind from the moment we inquired until we checked out. She made everything so smooth and welcoming.
The place itself was very nice, clean, and thoughtfully set up. It accommodated our whole group comfortably with plenty of space for everyone. We especially loved the convenient location right in between downtown Chicago and the airport—it was perfect for exploring the city during the day and catching our flights without any stress.
We had a fantastic stay and would highly recommend this spot to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you!
Amy and Brandon are amazing hosts. 5 stars across the board. So generous and kind. Brandon was thoughtful and responsive as well. We will be back!!! ❤️
This stay was perfect! It was close to the Green Line station to get to downtown and close to the university. Talie was extremely accommodating and responsive. Would 100% recommend!
Great location, cozy space, beautiful views. Just what we needed on our trip to Chicago!

Brandon was very friendly and responsive. Place is located close to bus and metro that will go to downtown, but suggest Ubering at night. Overall, pleased with my stay as the pictures and experience lived up to expectations.
One of the nicest airbnbs I’ve ever been to! Impeccably clean, super comfy bed and room, and also some snacks and drinks available to boot! Literally perfect, and I will definitely book again.
Todo estuvo excelente !
We had a great time staying at Carla’s place! Everything was clean and the beds were comfortable.
Well located in Lincoln Park. Great access to train and bus lines, walkable too. Apartment was homey, felt private and very clean. I would definitely stay here again!
The only negatives were needing a little paint for scuff marks on walls, water pressure in upstairs bathroom really low, gets warm in the middle of the night and the grass was very high.

Third time staying here - the best possible review I can leave is that both kids (8 and 6) were excited when they found out we'd be staying here again. We'll continue to seek this spot out should it be available on future trips. It's been a really nice home base for visiting friends and family. Jason has been an excellent and responsive host throughout as well.

This location was right in the heart of downtown. Beautiful area and walking distance from Lake Shore Dr, the Magnificent Mile, and N Michigan Ave. Great ambiance and places to eat all around. I recommend this location 100% and would definitely be coming again.
Great place in a great neighborhood! The house was spacious and great for a big group.
Great stay!  This was our second visit to this property. Danny was very responsive, even had a minor maintenance issue that was quickly addressed.
Great location and felt safe staying there. Thank you for your hospitality.
Great location for access to Wrigley and other activities. Place was comfortable and clean.

This was a great stay for my bachelorette! The hosts were very responsive and they went out of their way to deliver paper goods that we ran out of as well as a baking sheet when we needed. I would reccomend this place to others!

I know the host isn’t responsible for issues with the building, so I’ll start by saying that we appreciated the host’s hospitality and accommodations. They delivered a very clean space, communicated well, and accommodated us being early. Location is great, too!
That said, a few issues with the building:
- only one elevator was operational for folks spanning 23 floors. Then the A/C went out for a night through early afternoon during a super humid week. One roof deck was closed for repairs.
- the ‘Modern’ building attached with extra amenities was a maze to get through with no A/C
- the “penthouse” seems to only be named as such because its on a high floor. The space definitely worked for our larger group, but that title feels a little misleading. You’re not getting any bells & whistles here compared to a regular 3 bed 2 bath.
I’d still recommend this place if you’re hosting a large group and want to stay in downtown. Just keep in mind, the building has its inconveniences.
Great location!

Our family stayed at Daniel’s place for my daughter’s college graduation weekend and it was perfect for our needs. The neighborhood is quiet and we had no trouble finding street parking.  The beds were comfortable, the whole place was very clean, and the kitchen was well stocked with cooking essentials. Daniel was always very responsive and helpful. Thanks, Daniel!

Great rental! In a nice small building with amazing location! 15 minute walk to the blue line to super easy from airport. Coffee shops and restaurants surrounded. Very clean and responsive friendly hosts! Would definitely stay here again.
loved staying here! it was comfortable, clean, and had a good vibe. the host was super helpful and responsive to anything i needed. if i go to chicago again, i will definitely book here!
Fantastic, responsive, and flexible host. So greatly appreciated their help and patience with us as guests. Great value also! Loved being a 4 min walk to Dayglow Coffee.

This apartment is at a nice location, just 1.5 block from 53rd street where  most of the bars and restaurants of Hyde Park are, but it's not very pleasant inside. There is no natural light, there's a strong smell in the building and it needs better maintenance -- it was hard to figure out how to open the shower, you had to pull it very hard. Also, there's no flexibility in the check-in time (unless you pay extra!) and we couldn't even drop our bags. I would also have appreciated some small amenities, like cold water in the fridge and better coffee. We paid a lot of money for it, I guess it was because our visit was during U Chicago graduation weekend, but still, it was disappointing and I would not recommend it.
Great location!

Perfect location! Just steps from everything you could need and want, including a CVS and grocery store around the corner. Close to great shopping, restaurants, cafes, and Wrigley. Kitchen stocked with what you might actually need if you wanted to make/heat something. Coffee & tea provided. Great towels in the bathroom!!! Good bathroom amenities (barely scented, if that matters to you-it does me)! All of these reviews are absolutely true!!! You can't go wrong!

A wonderful place to host multiple people. There is plenty of gathering space on both the 1st floor and second story. The unit was very clean and had all  the common things needed in the kitchen.  I’ll keep this place as a favorite and would certainly recommend to family and friends.
Best bang for your buck, host is responsive and kind. Would stay again.

A quite space just off Wrigley, what more could you ask for? checkin/out was a breeze, tons of food choices within walking distance. Would recommend for a quick trip to Chicago or to catch a baseball game!
This is a really great apartment for a reasonable price.
Very short walk to Wrigley field. The EL does run right over the top of the house, but we knew that going in.  Lots of space to spread out and check in and out was easy.

Location struck the perfect balance of being central to city offerings & public transit while being a quiet escape from the hustle and bustle. Parking was easy to find. Beautiful interior that had everything we needed during our stay.
Such a cute little space! Perfect for a girls weekend with my bestie. Comfortable and we felt very safe with key fob entry.
Our stay was wonderful.  Was exceptionally clean and the beds were comfortable.  Would 100% stay again.
Space was as described with clear instructions for check in and check out. Good access to metro. Clean space with all essentials provided.

The place was awesome for a weekend in the city with friends! It was walkable to great coffee, food, neighborhood bars, and Wrigley. It was on a quiet street and while close to the train tracks, we never heard it. We had plenty of space for the 5 of us and it had everything to keep us comfortable. Would book again.
It’s a great and cozy place! Thank you, Dana!

I stayed here for a long weekend on a solo business trip. The loft isn't very big, but I was comfortable as a solo traveler. Everything was clean when I arrived. The bathroom is of a decent size. I also found it to be very affordable.
The main drawback is the location. There is not much around in the neighborhood in terms of food. Since I was on a short trip, I did not buy groceries, but it would be challenging to do so without a car. There are a couple of fast food places nearby but not much else. It could also be rather noisy at night. There is a fire station close by, and the sirens kept going off. The one mitigating factor is that the Airbnb is located very close to the blue line subway and a bus line, so you can get to the airport and downtown easily.
Overall, I would stay here again if I'm in Chicago for just a short visit. But I would probably look elsewhere if I stayed longer or needed to be somewhere not accessible by transit.
All was great, exactly as described, clean and comfortable. The baby crib is perfect too.
Perfect location with all we needed.
Met my needs when in Hyde Park for a conference and my son's graduation.

The place nice and was as described and communication was great. We felt very safe and location was secure. Lots of places to walk to. Beware this is a very busy location, it is noisy at night with lots of sirens and honking. To be expected in a city, but this location is particularly noisy location.
We had a great stay! The place was spread out nicely. Very comfortable. Wonderful neighborhood. We had a really great time!
Great stay. Would recommend to friends and come back myself.

Andy was very accommodating. His air bnb was very nice inside as described. The only problem I had was the location. Although I did not have any trouble it is a lower income neighborhood.
I was there for my sons UChicago college graduation and it was convenient to the school.

My stay at Lourdes’s Place was very nice. Easy parking. Not a lot of noise. Very nice on the inside and clean. Balcony was a nice touch for fresh air. Was not far from downtown and was walkable to some places near by! I overall recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago. Host was very nice and responsive.

Great place a little north of Chicago. 2 levels with 3 beds for plenty of guests. Has some food and bars around there which is great. Would come back again if we had 3-4 guests. Just a heads up that with traffic takes 20-30 mins to get to downtown!
The place was great for a few friends to crash, had everything we needed, clean and easy to get inside.

The house was unexpectedly like walking into a beautiful place out of fancy TV show. Lots to do! Very secured! Including having a lock in your room and very quiet neighbors. I enjoyed my stay! Only a 20 min uber ride into the heart of downtown.
Absolutely beautiful home, so happy we stayed here!
Clare’s place was very clean! Overall no issues.
Really well located, clean room with comfortable beds and plenty of space. Ryan was very communicative and clear with his instructions. Great place for the price!
Hanna’s place was a calm and spacious sanctuary during a hectic graduation weekend.  Location was perfect for  easy access to campus and to restaurants on 53rd st.

Amazing location and aesthetically pleasing facilities. The location is safe and walkable to a great coffee shop/cafe and train station to head downtown. The AirBnB was as described, extremely clean, and the bed was excellent. I slept like a rock.
