Having a quiet and comfortable place to sleep is very important for setting the mood for a vacation or work trip. Internet was provided. There was a selection of snacks, chilled water in the fridge, and coffee to start the day. The host was very accommodating, communicated well, and respectful of my privacy.  I had no worries. I highly recommend and will book a stay here again.
Great location and quiet area. Easy walk to West Loop/Fulton Market. Would stay here again!
great location. easy check-in. the common areas were very nice. beautiful views on a summer evening from the 12th floor.

After a slight issue with getting inside, due to no fault of Kathleen’s, the place was wonderful. It is located back from the Main Street and very quiet. The bed is very very comfortable. I would highly recommend this place.
Lovely hotel, front desk and door staff were great.

Great place to be when visiting Chicago! Place was really clean, modern, spacious, and great for spending time with our group! Park next door was really nice, and some great breakfast spots within walking distance. We really enjoyed our stay.

We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend Michael's Airbnb home. He was exceptionally hospitable, friendly, and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. He went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed and was always responsive and helpful.
The home itself was beautiful, clean, and well-maintained, with plenty of amenities to enjoy during our stay. The location is great—just a short walk to Wrigley Field.
Again, Michael was a stand-out host with genuine hospitality and care for our experience as his guests. We would gladly stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting the area.
Everything was up to our expectations! Clean and spacious. Would recommend for the area.

Jasa's place was perfect- better than it's described or shown in photos. There were some noisy little kids next door one of the evenings but they were just having fun and they were drowned out by the fan provided when we were ready to sleep that night. This place is perfect if you want to explore Chicago during the day- just a half hour drive into the city and yet it's far enough away to have a break from the traffic. I was happily surprised by how clean, spacious, and comfy it was. I'll definitely be back.

We had a great stay at Becky’s place! Everything was as described in the listing, great area within walking distance of the blue line to get downtown in around 20-30 mins. Quiet neighborhood with lots of great restaurants/coffee shops within a 1 mile walk. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Chicago or the Logan Square area!
Comfy and cozy, walkable to Wrigley, nothing wrong with this studio space!! Thank you for being a great host.
Great location, smooth check-in
Great stay! highly recommend.
If attending festivals or conventions during the day, makes a great affordable place to hang out in the evenings while feeling right at home!
Great hosts, even better spot! Awesome place for a little baseball weekend getaway with the friends.

This is by far the most beautiful home we have ever stayed in. It exceeded all of our expectations and we would highly recommend it for anyone staying in Chicago. We had a wonderful experience. It made our weekend celebrating our son in law perfect. The hosts have reached perfection in every detail from fresh flowers to delicious snacks! Thank so much for sharing your home with us!

Beautiful apartment a couple
Blocks from the beach. Very spacious for our group. Whole foods and coffee shops within walking distance as well as the train stop. We had an issue with hot water the first night but Sean was very responsive and helped resolve the issue. He was extremely communicative and helpful. Would stay there again!
Great hosts. Flexible and caring.

This place is great.  There is so much to do within walking distance yet the unit is very private, peaceful, quiet, and safe.  Parking was a breeze.  The owners were also very responsive, informed, and nice.  There was a hiccup with the AC and they went out of their way to make it good.  I highly recommend the owners and the unit.
This location was fantastic! Beautifully maintained, Jasna was so kind and helpful! We loved our stay!

Diane was a wonderful host! She went above and beyond for me and was very responsive. I loved her place it was beautiful and the bed was to die for it was so comfortable. She had toiletries, seasonings & snacks fully stocked for us she was amazing.
Great location, easy walk to the parks and restaurants
Our stay here was very comfortable! The house was very clean and the host was very helpful with all instructions on checking in and checking out. Also a great distance from everywhere we were going.
I appreciate how close it was to the green line and how many bedrooms/bathrooms there were

We needed a larger home in Chicago for my family, who were traveling with me for a long weekend with law school friends. David’s house was just what we needed. It was within walking distance from Wrigley Field and several great restaurants. It had all the accommodations we needed for a great weekend!
Beautiful space with lots of character. And such a friendly host! We appreciated the recommendations and the flexibility.

We had a wonderful stay and Erin and Charles place! It was a great location, walkable to many restaurants and shops. The unit was clean and spacious. Erin was very responsive and gave clear instructions for check in. Would definitely stay again!

We loved staying here! The music was a nice addition because we hate sleeping in silence. Our toddler was with us and didn’t have a problem with worrying about him moving around.  Just like the listing says, parking can be hard to find, but there’s lot to look at in the neighborhood so the walk wasn’t a problem! Alek was also super responsive, friendly, and helpful!!!
Great place to stay.

Wonderful place to stay for Cubs games, and the surrounding area is full of places to go. Very easy to get around, the apartment is very comfortable. We were warned, and its true, parking is difficult. Maybe expensive is a better word, SpotHero did help us out finding and overnight spot.
I would recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to stay close to Wrigley for baseball.

Had a wonderful stay, was with in walking distance to green line that made getting around easier. The location is not bad either a few options for food and/or gas near by. The inside was setup nicely and it felt cozy and comfortable. I would recommend this place to anyone that wants to visit the parks, downtown, the zoo, or the field museum. The tram pass is worth it, I basically road it everywhere. The pass works for the busses as well which was nice.
All good!

Nice place to lounge when your done sightseeing
Nice and quiet
They had a party down the street on Saturday didn’t even notice noise from inside
Plenty of street parking
Everywhere you wanna go is 25 min or so away very ideal for this big city. They had everything we needed in the kitchen to cut fruits.
The dining area felt spacious
The beds pretty cozy as well.
Host was great, gave us clear instructions on check in and check out. You cannot go wrong booking at a place that is minimalist and affordable like this 💎!
Overall experience we all enjoyed our stay! Would return if future flights!
perfect for what I needed!

Our stay at Sharon’s was great! We caught a Cubs game at Wrigley Field - the convenience walking to the stadium was awesome. Moreover, the area was terrific with lots of great bars and restaurants. I would highly recommend staying here - especially if catching a game at Wrigley.
Melany’s place was impeccably clean and cozy—perfect for our short stay in Chicago!

Really awesome place to stay, especially if you’re in town for a Cubs game.  You’re within walking distance.  Plenty of free parking in the neighborhood.  The apartment is awesome with everything you’ll need!  Great shower in the master suite with super hot water and a powerful shower head.  Would stay here again!!

Patrick's place was amazing, in a very quiet neighborhood. Clean and cozy, and Patrick himself is attentive.  Has a few spots to eat at just around the corner and a market just about a 10-15 min walk from the location, as well as a Walgreens. The park just behind the house is awesome, especially for a nice little walk. Would definitely stay again and would recommend anyone the same.

We were visiting relatives nearby, so we didn’t explore the area very much. The apartment was a comfortable place to return to at the end of our busy days. We appreciated the sofa, a big table in the kitchen and a comfortable bed. The kitchen had everything we needed to make our breakfast. The home is lovely and Erin was very friendly.

Great host! Responded to questions quickly. Clean property! Amenities were as described. Great, safe, location for walking to meals and other venues.
Was disappointed in the room as the bed was simply on the floor; a mattress and box springs but no bed frame making it very low and hard to get in to and out of.

Michael's place exceeded my expectations. The backyard space was my favorite part of my stay. It's great for BBQs in the warm summer months or just relaxing and taking in some sun. The apartment was extremely clean and very spacious. The coffee with all the fixins was a really nice touch. Conveniently located near the highway so it's super easy to get to both airports and is minutes away from downtown.
Michael was a great host and I would definitely rebook his place next time I'm in town!

I have to be fair and say it’s a beautiful and spacious apartment. The neighborhood was not so much my favorite even though I was a bit familiar with Hyde park but not that side. It was way too noisy at night when in the check in instruction they insisted on how the quiet time is from 10 pm etc. I woke up in the middle of the night to noises from neighbors.
I was really disappointed by the late check-in 5pm. It rained all day and we waited until 5pm to get into the apt. Not their fault, I should have canceled once I saw the check-in time. Overall it was ok, for a weekend.
Niku was easy to communicate with and the space was clean and as expected!
Definitely look forward to planning our next trip to the chi! Hopefully Victoria’s place will be available!!!

We went for an event at Grant Park and were able to walk there and to other attractions very easily. Everything was clean and comfortable. There were enough fans for 3 of the rooms to have their own and the front room didn't really need one. We all stayed pretty comfortable temperature wise and were there in June. The bar beneath the apartment has closed so we had no issue with noise levels from that. The train is fairly close and you definitely hear it, but we sleep with sound machines so the train kind of sounds like waves or a strong wind in the background. The train really wasn't disruptive at all. The Aloha restaurant in the listing pictures is actually across the street and VERY delicious, I'd recommend a visit there for sure! Overall, it was a lovely stay!!
Loved that the place was completely as advertised!  Would definitely stay there again!
Loved my stay in Logan Square at this beautiful Airbnb. The host, Martha, was very responsive, and everything was ready and very clear. Would highly recommend!
Great location, walkable with lots to do.  Free parking.  Neat and Clean interior. Excellent and quick communication from host.

Overall the stay was as advertised -
Clean, like the pictures, helpful building people.
Two issues
Minor one - we had been told we had a second parking spot but on the day we were supposed to get it, they said there was not one available til next night. An inconvenience though there were other Parking lots in area.
Major one - we left a king size pillow in the condo with a distinctive pillow case (clearly not one that came with condo). We sent note that night about it and they indicated they would check with housekeeping. We had to send notes to follow up three times (over a week annd an half) and it wasn’t until we indicated that our review was contingent on their response did they respond that housekeeping hadn’t found it. This did not feel right and would make me hesitate to use again.
Awesome location. Great basecamp for exploring the upper westside neighborhoods. AC works really well. Really happy there wasn't a bunch of old stuff in the fridge.
great place
Super clean and cozy with enough space for our family. Great host!

The property is awsome, there is a lot of history and amenities to enjoy. We were attending the Chicago half marathon and the location couldn't be better. However is somewhat far from downtowon and Chicago's main attractions.
Good place and nice host
Great location in the city - walkable to restaurants and shops. Clean and spacious apartment with comfortable beds.
well maintained air bnb
Fast easy communication, very convenient location to everywhere we needed.

I would definitely stay here again, mostly due to a great location. The host provided clear instructions and answered questions quickly.
But a few things made it less than perfect. First, it’s very close to the elevated train and it’s quite loud when it goes by which is frequently into the evening.
And the walls do not go all the way to the ceiling for some of the bedrooms. Most bedrooms don’t have any windows so I guess this is done to allow natural light in. But if you want to sleep in, or someone has the lights on in the common area, it penetrates into the bedrooms. If you are a light sleeper, neither of these are great but otherwise would highly recommend the stay.
The place was so beautiful! Living room had great natural light and the bed was really comfortable. We loved the neighborhood too.

I was unable to check-in at the original location due to an unforeseen circumstance that came up the day before check-in. Fortunately, Roseanna was able to communicate in advance after reaching out to her about check-in instructions. I stayed one night at that unit, which wasn’t the best, but was suitable for my needs. The next day, I attend my event and got a message from Roseanna that my group is moving in to another unit which happens to be in the same address for the rest of my stay. The prompt communications from Roseanna were well on point as I was able to work around a 2nd move to a new unit in as many days and that unit itself met my standards for a suitable Airbnb unit. Location wise, it’s really close to a CVS Pharmacy unit and a bus route that takes you close to Grant Park and Chicago’s Field Museum and other major subway lines.
Overall, the stay was great and I’d definitely recommend this location for accessibility into the downtown core of Chicago.
Super cute place in a great location!
An awesome stay in West Town! Fun space and comfy beds. We loved the location most - so walkable and easy to get anywhere!

The bathroom was definitely on the dirty side and could use a much more thorough cleaning. That said, the price was very reasonable, and for what I paid, it was an acceptable stay. There was free street parking available, and it was conveniently located close to public transit, which made getting around easy. If you’re looking for a budget-friendly option and don’t mind overlooking some cleanliness issues, it may still be worth considering.

Had issue from day one trying to enter building, specifically key would not work on the second door to enter. This did not get resolved during our stay. Requested a partial refund and was denied. Brian's expectation included me begin available to give locksmith key to building. I had to buzz the neighbors as a workaround during stay.
The air freshener's were overpowering, unplugged them and then determined the reason is to mask the smell of cannabis by the neighbors.
Condo was closer to the train (L) than I realized; noisier than I expected.
Great space! Phenomenal location! Communication was on point and place was clean and inviting. We would stay there again.
Very clean apartment!
Great place! Convenient location!
We enjoyed our stay—great location. Area felt extremely safe. Overall good experience.

Easily one of my top Airbnb stays. This is a nice part of town with easy metro access to airport and centre. Apartment was beautifully presented with lots of little over-and-above extras that made it feel very homely.

Honestly one of the best locations we could have hoped for when visiting Chicago. great location to Grant park, any local food spots, and for public transit. Would definitely stay at this location again when visiting Chicago!

Great location for u Chicago graduation. House is very spacious. We were able to walk to campus and also the lake shore and Obama library. Tarek is a great host. We had everything we needed. Enjoyed our stay.

Marcus and Cathy were amazing hosts! Their home exceeded our expectations in every way. It was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. We especially appreciated the attention to detail and the welcoming environment they created.
Thank you for letting us stay in your beautiful place. We had so much fun, and above all, we felt comfortable and at home during our entire visit. We would not hesitate to recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Chicago.
Great location right by the red line and about 30-40 minutes downtown. Room was clean and common areas like kitchen and bathroom were also cleaned frequently. Would recommend!

Very nice place, host was very responsive and flexible with us! The only downside was the water got cold after 2 people used the shower, was difficult for a group of 10, everything else was perfect though!

Location is great. It's near the orange line and is also on a bus line.
The place is quite secure with security codes for the front, the common areas, and the room being rented.
The pool table room is very spacious. I was very busy during the day and night that I wasn't able to enjoy this amenity but I did take a peek at the space.
The open concept top floor is very spacious and well-lit by skylights. There was an air conditioning unit and fans to keep the space cool.
The room was just the perfect size for me. There were two cooling fans, a desk, and a comfy chair. Towels were provided. There's a closet with plenty of hangers.
The shared bathroom is spacious and kept clean. Discs of soap were provided, as well as shampoo and conditioner.
I didn't get to use the full kitchen but looks like the other renters did.
A cleaning lady came by to clean the kitchen around noon.
5/5 Would book again

We had a few small issues but nothing truly something to complain about. The biggest issue we had was the one side of the gate was stuck making it difficult to park 2 cars but we managed well enough. One other issue was the lack of cooking utensil choices and there was no cookie sheets. Overall the house was lovely. Large spaces enough for our 10 people to sleep, eat, and relax comfortably. When I sent messages they were answered in a timely manner.

Nice location near Hyde Park with ample parking and a safe neighborhood. It was an unusually hot Chicago weekend, so they brought over AC units quickly. Parking in the driveway was helpful and easy transportation.

Amazing place that’s perfect for a weekend at Wrigley or Chicago in general. Location is nice, train isn’t even an issue like others have said. Whether it’s a weekend for wrigley or Chicago in general I highly recommend this place as Ubers are highly accessible. Highly recommend.
We enjoyed this place so much, it was our second stay. Great location; exactly as described!

Harry's place was great! With the location and parking available, it was so convenient for a weekend watching the Cubs at Wrigley and for enjoying Wrigleyville. We noticed a couple bugs on the rugs our last night there, but recognize it's summer and an older unit. Otherwise the place was clean, easy to check-into, and Harry was eay to communicate with. We definitely recommend!

I can’t say enough great things about Kitty! I didn’t feel like I was in an Airbnb while staying with her, I felt like I was visiting family. She is so welcoming and kind, and she truly went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we could possibly need. The place is abordable, so thoughtfully decorated and very clean. The neighborhood is absolutely beautiful and we felt very safe here, plus it’s a quick walk to the bus or the CTA California station. Will definitely be back and invite all my friends :) thanks a million Kitty!!

Matthew's spot in Logan Square was perfect. Right around the corner from the California Station, made it very convenient to get around. The neighborhood itself was fantastic. Tons of restaurants & bars, and fun just to walk around in. Matthew was a great host. Easy to communicate with, and provided some great recommendations. We would definitely stay here again when we return to Chicago.

Carina was responsive and stayed on top of answering any questions I had, the instructions for checkout, and check in were also physically printed out for us to see so that helped a lot! Thank you carina!
Thank you

We enjoyed our three night stay at Jennifer’s apartment in Lincoln Park. The location is great, walkable to many shops and restaurants. Wrigley Field is a 40 min walk, which was a fun way to get to the Cubs game as they were in town during our stay. The apartment is very comfortable, looks like the photos, and had everything we needed. As mentioned in other reviews, the “L” train is very close and does run all day (though less frequently over night). This was disclosed at the time of booking so we were aware of it, but something to keep in mind if you are a light sleeper. It was a little bothersome the first night, but after that the other two nights weren’t bad.
Jennifer was a great host, she was super responsive in the lead up and checked in with us during the stay. We enjoyed the apartment and our dealings with Jennifer.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It had everything we needed and made for a really relaxing visit. Communication was excellent from start to finish — very friendly, responsive, and helpful, which made everything so easy. You can tell they really care about their guests having a great experience. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!”
I enjoyed my stay. I really enjoyed being close to the Red Line. I also food a cool coffee shop, Pedestrian Coffee, try the cinnamon roll!
Large home for many guests.

Troy was very communicative and helpful when we had a little hiccup. We were happy with our stay. I liked the privacy and distance from the master to the other guest rooms. We had everything we needed. it's also a walkable area. It takes a little work to find parking but other than that it was good for a family.

Great location easy access to walk to many restaurants and bars as well as the L to explore all over Chicago. You are able to hear the train from the apartment though overall we did not find it bothersome. The apartment is at the top of a 3 story walk up which we did have to carry our suitcases up. Place was clean and had a coffee maker and AC
Kimberli was very responsive. Her place was clean and easy to get to. Nice location. Near transportation.

Beautiful neighborhood. Can take nightly walks. Across the street from a park with playground/school with playground. Safe neighborhood. A lot of things nearby within 5 minutes and only 15 minutes to downtown Chicago (and WAY CHEAPER than having yo pay the $$$ of downtown prices!) You have your own entry and parking space, dishes, fridge, table, super comfy couch. The beds a little hard but that’s ok. It did get really cold but I’d rather it be cold and able to put the extra blankets on the bed that were supplied than be 🥵 too hot and not able to cool down.
It is in the basement of a 3-plex and you can hear the noise from the people above but it’s not too bad. They get up about 630 and go to bed around 1030. You can’t hear talking just them walking around. It didn’t bother us at all but it might be an issue for some people.
We loved the place and we would definitely stay there again in the future :)

This is the second time we have stayed here. Although it is a basement apartment, it never feels cramped or dark. The apartment is nicely organized, well decorated, and comfortable. The parking was on the street, however we usually were able to find a spot close to the entrance. We would stay here again.

I cannot recommend this property. The AC was broken for the first two nights of our three-night summer stay, ruining our sleep after long days of walking. The process was a hassle, including having to leave dinner to return keys for a repair that didn't happen that night. While the host answers quickly at first, she ghosted me for days as soon as I requested a partial refund for the missing amenity. When confronted, she claimed she missed the messages and was only concerned with whether I would leave a good or bad review. She has since stopped responding completely. The space might be overpriced for what it offers, and the host's lack of fairness and customer service makes it a place to avoid.
Great place. Close to everything. Walkable, very safe neighborhood. Will book again, and again.

The apartment was easy to locate with very clear instructions on how to enter the property. The interior was clean and welcoming with plenty of space for 4 people. The kitchen was well-stocked and snacks and bottled water were available which was so nice!
The houses immediately around the apartment are nice and it was quiet. We walked to UChicago and it was a little far so the use of Uber is required.

We had a great week at Paul's place, he is a great guy very respectful and polite, his place has a very warm and cozy feel and we had access to everything we needed. Abby is a great dog and both are a great team at hosting in their place. The neighborhood feels safe and is very peaceful, also very close to the main busses that take you to Chicago downtown. thanks for everything Paul and Abby
We had a great stay—the suite was clean, we walked to get around, and the steam shower was fabulous.
This was a perfect spot for Lincoln Square! Everything was clean, fresh, and modern. Highly recommend!

Initially, host assumed I didn't have the app. My app did not display the info needed to get into the apartment right away. And the response from Edward when I asked to send it again, was to get the app. I'm a super host and have been using the app for 13 yrs. A little more consideration would have been helpful.
After a HOT day in Chicago, at a festival, the first thing you want when you get to your room in the later evening was for AC. It was HOT in the room for about 2 hrs, until we found the a/c vent was not opened to full capacity. The rest of our stay was good.
Note: Room 6 appears to get the morning sun, thus I think it might be the hottest room in the complex, so keeping the curtains closed initially and having the vent opened all the way, makes a huge difference.
We would stay again. It is close to the bus that takes you to the train. Area seems safe. Clean and good value for the money.
This location was great with a communicative host.
Beautiful place with a great location if you want to visit downtown Chicago or spend time with friends living nearby.

Great location
Nice and clean.

Booked what the Airbnb listing suggested was a modest apartment. Arrived to find a chic boutique hotel with an onsite restaurant, a restaurant/bar manager (Dave) who ensures your comfort, and a location that puts everything within reach.
The listing undersold the space. You get a genuinely nice room, good service, and the best location for exploring Chicago's food scene.
Not every stay needs a gracious host in residence. Sometimes a good deal, good bones, and good location are enough.

We were there for the Blues Fest. Benny was very responsive from the beginning of the process. The check in process was smooth. Benny was an attentive host. It's a newly renovated space. Having two bathrooms was also a nice perk for our group of 5  with a toddler. There were plenty of grocery stores and pharmacies around this place in walking distance. About 20 minutes or little longer drive from millennium park depends with traffic. It served the purpose for our visit. Will consider staying there in the future if we are in town.
It was extremely clean and was a nice place to stay for the weekend! Would stay again

This was our fourth year of an annual friend group trip at Casa Newport and each year is better than the last! We adore the neighborhood and spending time on the patio. The place is always clean upon arrival and the kitchen is spacious. One thing to note is that there is no AC unit in the summer months so it got very humid however there are lots of fans. We will be back!

This house comfortably fit six people! It was so spacious and the rooms felt private. The downstairs area is such a great space to either play games, watch movies, or just relax with a big group of people. It’s located in a quaint neighborhood within walking distance of some food spots. We’d absolutely come back here again if we find ourselves in Chicago!

The place was exactly as described in the listing. It was perfectly clean and in a nice, quiet location. 20-25 mins drive from downtown. Abe really went above and beyond to ensure we had a good time. He was very accommodating for us, gave us some local recommendations, and would always check in with us if we had any any questions/requests. Would highly recommend this place to anyone staying in the city as a large group!

Had a lovely stay with friends here for an extended weekend and everything was exactly as described. Our unit was clean with everything necessary to rest between our activities. The location was amazing to explore, extremely walkable, and would be happy to visit again for a future trip.
Very understanding and flexible! Really enjoyed staying here!

Girl’s trip to Chicago. The unit was just as described. Very updated and extremely clean. Great location, just a short walk to everything. Loved the exposed brick inside the unit. Contained all necessary amenities for a pleasant stay, along with some extras—- fully functional and stocked automatic ice maker/tray and a filtered water pitcher! We sooo appreciated both of those. Made life so much easier during our stay. Keurig and coffee readily available as well.
The gym on the lower level of the building was a nice surprise! We used it every morning. Free weights, exercise ball, universal machine, a couple mats—-everything needed!
This unit is on the 3rd floor and although it’s renovated, sound travels through the floors. You will hear people above you. Only thing that was less than ideal during our stay, but we also may have had a ‘rowdier than most’ group above us.
Host and building management were extremely friendly and responsive!

Not for me. I barely feel the experience here qualifies as an AirBNB property. It was a busy weekend in Chicago, and my first AirBnB location cancelled with less than a week before we were arriving. This property was in a great location, but also 2x as much. That said, what I really did not like was all of the extras that we had to deal with. After booking, there was another whole website to goto, and additional charges for a cleaning fee. There was a process for securing an early check in that also included extra fees, but they would never confirm availability after 5 requests. The response continued to be check back in another day. It was through this exchange that I figured out I was talking to a BOT. While it always ‘Responded’ within minutes, it certainly never ‘Answered’ my questions. Due to allergies we need a kitchen when traveling, so this worked for us when we needed it. Great location and parking too. But downtown hotels are a better deal…and less hassle.
Had a great week long stay in Avondale! Walked around and felt part of the community vibe. Loved it! Took the 15min walk to the train each day and it was wonderful.
Perfect place for 4 people. Short walk to Wrigley and tons of food and drink options around. Easy access to public transit as well.

Thanks for sharing your home, which was clean and overall just as you described. 3rd floor is a bit of a walk but not bad. Area could be a little more family friendly, but it’s a big city and we had no issues, walkable area too. We had 4 adults and 2 infants in strollers. Great stay! Good price! Book if you’re on the fence.
Great little value stay!
For a big group, this was the perfect house. Plenty of space for everybody to be comfortable, in a nice neighborhood, and host was very responsive.

A estadia foi muito tranquila, o apto estava em ordem, limpo e conforme o anunciado.
o que nao foi tao bom foi a localizaçao do imóvel, numa regiao afastada do centro.
Harry was super responsive, we had a great stay here!

We enjoyed everything about Matt's place except the stairs. He does describe the place as a loft, but I did not see anything mentioning the
(4) flights of stairs. Outside of that, Matt's place is very cool, nice vibe and decor, fooseball table, record collection, comfy couch, & a great kitchen.
It's close to a number of good restaurants, less than a mile walk to Garrett's Popcorn, & has an excellent Grocery only (4) blocks away.
Chris and Ana were great hosts. The location is close to restaurants and about 30 min from Wrigley. It was a nice stay that had everything we needed. They also took care of most of the clean up.
Listing matched the description. Served it purpose for our visit to Chicago. Close to train station for access to downtown.
Very friendly, great communication, excellent place and by far the best I have ever dealt with! Highly recommend!
Extremely grateful to Daisy for her responsiveness and clear instructions given to us prior to the stay. The house was also extremely clean and comfortable! Very pleasant stay overall 😊

Definitely will stay here again when back in Chicago.  Beautiful home, exactly as listed.  Great community and walkable to many restaurants and shops, as well as to Wrigley Stadium and the L-train station.  Plenty of on street parking.  Host always responded promptly and check in/out instructions were clear.  Highly recommend this property for any stay in Chicago.

El alojamiento estaba bastante agradable, con lo necesario para tener una buena estancia. Nicholas es un buen anfitrión, muy amable y atento ante lo que se requería. El vecindario no era el mejor en cuanto a la limpieza y vecinos; sin embargo había muy cerca un parque, rutas de camiones y tren cta.
Fue una buena estancia en general.
Excelente en cuanto a costo beneficio se refiere
Wonderful place and great location! And Elizabeth is a super host!

This charming and quirky family home was perfect for us. Located in a residential neighborhood, steps from coffee shops and dinning. There is a park close by. Easy access to the train and buses.
The roof top was amazing.
Great host, nice, flexible, accommodating, and gives great recommendations. Everything was as described in the listing. Airbnb has lots of space and feels like home!
Thank you for hosting the place Annika.

The location and view is without question one of the best. Lodging for my party met all our required needs for the stay.
Alot of things of interest are around (Museums/pier/market) during the day and restaurants were walkable or short trip (Uber/lyft/rain/bus) away.
There were several rules of the house to follow & observe. Understandable from a hosting position, mostly there to clearly define safety for both sides.
Reviews indicated a high level of communication & interaction from the host. Thats not really for me or my party, so we requested minimal/ non-extensive communication during the stay. Again, all the rules to follow were enough for us to know what to do and how to be respectful of the property.
Like all AirBnB's be mindful when you enter the property. Notice anything that is already in place. Things that were in place for us, did not merit reaching out to the host.
My party & I enjoyed this property, hope you do too.
Enjoy
Miguel was great when we needed any help with our stay!

Our experience with Angela and Ryan and our stay at their place is what I think every Airbnb stay should be. We felt right at home with the comfy furniture and beds and the decor was perfect. The space is larger than it appears in photos.
We had a great stay and A+R communicated with us exceptionally well. We would definitely stay again the next time we find ourselves in Chicago.
Roomy house, very comfortable for our group of 9. The house had everything we needed. Walking distance to restaurants and shopping. The host was very responsive and helpful. Overall a great visit!
Lovely home and a wonderful host. If I’m ever back in Chicago I’ll definitely would love to stay again.
Comfortable stay in a great neighborhood.

Charming loft in a fantastic location.  Very friendly and responsive hosts.  Not ideal for difficult sleepers - as other reviews mention, there's lots of light at night from the windows.  Otherwise, top notch spot to stay while in the city, easy to get anywhere via public transportation and the neighborhood is great.  Highly recommend.

Anna’s place was fantastic, and I would absolutely stay here again. The condo is exactly as pictured…beautifully furnished, comfortable, and full of fun Chicago sports-themed touches. The bed and bedding were incredibly comfortable, and my friend who flew in from New York kept commenting on how cozy everything was.
The highlight is the private rooftop, which feels like an oasis in the middle of the West Loop. Watching the sunrise from up there was one of the most memorable parts of my stay.
Anna was responsive, accommodating, and flexible with both check-in and check-out. The location was perfect—close to great restaurants, nightlife, and everything the West Loop has to offer. I was in town to be the Chairman of a fundraising event, and the venue was only about an eight-minute drive away.
One thing to note: there are stairs to access the unit/rooftop, so keep that in mind if mobility is a concern.
Overall, an amazing stay & a host who was a pleasure to work with. Highly recommend!
It was perfect for the weekend graduation ceremony.
Great place! Perfect for three people for a long weekend to see the cubs and get around Chicago. Easily walkable to restaurants and the red / brown line.

Susan’s Airbnb was just what we were looking for. Extremely clean, spacious, private, and safe. The space came with all that we needed, including towels, full kitchen, laundry, tv, and comfortable beds. The unit is only a 5 minute walk to multiple bus stops which transfer directly to the red line, it was super easy and fast to get downtown from here. We really appreciated the quick responses from Susan, she always replied to any questions/concerns we had immediately. One thing to note is that this is a basement unit as listed, you will hear the people upstairs very clearly. Not only that but even when they are quiet, you can hear the inner workings of the home (ac, plumbing, etc.). This was not at all a problem for us, but if you are a sensitive sleeper or want complete silence, please do keep this in mind. Overall, Susan’s Airbnb was a wonderful stay and would definitely return if we were ever coming back to this area!
Excellent experience and location in Chicago.  Rare find with a 3 bedroom!

Awesome place to stay! Very spacious!
If i come back to Chicago for a sporting event, i would definitely stay here again.
Great place to stay. 15 minute uber from most places. Host was communicative and helped change the passcode for the front gate when it wasn’t working VERY quickly

The rental space was exactly like photos - very nice space. The common area exceeded my expectations- roof top area was so nice to have extra space for larger group. We had a bit of an issue when checking in with a small leak in the shower and repair equipment left behind in space. The management company was responsive and resolved the issue as I requested.  Customer service was 5 star - the stay was 3 star because of the checkin issue but if we didn’t have that issue - it would have been higher.
Everyone was so friendly! Great location, nice and clean rooms.
Very good place to stay, great host.

Great space in a nice neighborhood with transit nearby, a grocery store and plenty of restaurants.
Keep in mind the ceilings are low (I’m 5’6” and in shoes just made it under the ducts without bending down) but the space is well laid-out & comfortable.

The location is the key; it is close to a metro station, with red line access, so you can go wherever you want. It is a really good condo, with all the required amenities, and spacious. The only things I see that require some kind of maintenance are the window shades and the AC. John is very helpful and also attends to the questions we had.
Great location great place to stay
Great place to stay at.
Clean, cool and comfortable refuge from the summer heat.
It was a great experience!
Marco was an awesome host he was very communicative. he was really nice. the place was beautiful and big.

The place was perfect for what we wanted to do.  Clean, safe, and friendly neighbors.  Great access to transportation to get downtown.  The gate access and door access were easier than I anticipated.  I would definately go there again when we go back….
Enjoyed our stay. Richard is a very kind & caring host. Appreciated his insight on local restaurants.
Really enjoyed staying in this place in Logan Square. It was room enough for four people and had ample parking in the neighborhood.

great place, beds are comfy, even has laundry available...
the street parking is packed so get the garage parking upgrade its only 20$

I have used Airbnb several times for several different events. This Airbnb was by far the most stocked with tools for cooking and other amenities for guests. The host was also by far the most responsive and helpful that I have ever had the privilege of communicating with. Would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone and everyone if you are looking for a place in Chicago!
This was my first stay using AirBnB and the space was as expected and very clean. The whole experience was positive and this stay sets the bar high for my future trips.

Lovely stay in this Andersonville apartment! Thoughtful touches in the kitchen and bath to make visitors feel right at home. Perfect location with an easy walk to favorite restaurants, shops. A quick walk to the bus stop or red line to head downtown. Our favorite was morning walks on  the  tree-lined street to visit the beach.
Good spot for a brief getaway, but don’t want to be directly in the city.
Just be careful to ask if they are adding any additional fees onto the booking that you will find out shoot during check in.

Great apartment unit with a secure front door and all amenities you need for a stay in Wicker Park.
Bathroom is spacious and water pressure is amazing and hot. Did not really need to fuss with anything, we were very well taken care of and Erica was extremely helpful and accommodating with our stay.
Thanks!

Clean, comfortable, and unique space with everything we needed. The neighborhood was amazing and offered a great variety of coffee shops, restaurants and bars and we were able to walk easily to everything we wanted.

Perfect place to stay for our weekend trip. Beds were super comfy. I never sleep that good away from home! Location was in walking distance of several restaurants and there is a great little market 2 blocks away. Would definitely stay again!
Was a nice place to stay

Very spacious and comfortable accommodation for our family of four.  Three nice bedrooms and two bathrooms with a full kitchen and laundry room.  There was a nice table in the kitchen and the dining room, so space for work, too. Plenty of street parking so no issues with parking close to the building.
Quick quick check in, gated parking area.  The bathroom shower was amazing!  Would stay and recommend again!

My family and I had a lovely time here.  It was the perfect spot to relax after busy days downtown. The large dining room was really nice for having meals together. We walked to Offset BBQ twice as the food was outstanding. Definitely hope to stay again someday!
Had a great stay at James’s place! On a lovely, quiet street in Boystown. Walking distance to lots of great restaurants, shops, and Wrigley field!
Thank you both. Location was perfect to rest of city. Stay was peaceful and neighborhood was great

We loved staying in Otto's residence. It's clean and conveniently located near a freeway and the transit. Street parking is available. Three bedrooms was perfect for us all, and there are plenty of outlets to charge electronics. Up and coming location. Thankfully did NOT have to throw out the trash in the garbage cans, which I appreciate when I'm vacationing. Thank you Otto!
Good place for our group and the parking helped us a lot
Love the Chinatown area. Bit dirty but overall fine, especially considering the price.

Great location downtown in the Threatre District. Very walkable to local restaurants, major parks, and you can even catch a show across the street. Cleanliness top notch while extremely comfortable. Check-in and out seamless. Highly recommend location and host. Thank you!
This condo was clean, comfortable, and conveniently located.

We were surprised to find very little toilet paper & paper towels. The apt wasn’t made for people staying in -not a lot of cups/plates etc. I also didn’t see why we were charged an additional $168 for a 5th family member (for 4 day stay). A good spot for people who are eating out and vacationing & just need a central spot to sleep.

Location is everything with this stay - it was truly perfection for visiting Wrigley. I recognize that the price is for the location, but considered a parking spot is not included, and the maintenance needed within the property, we were a little disappointed. The apartment overall could use a bit more TLC to really make the guests feel comfortable and appreciated. The listing says that a washer/dryer is available. We never needed it so we didn't ask, but we didn't notice them anywhere within the unit. But, EASY walk to Wrigley, and the host communicated quickly!
Place was great. Mike was super responsive and helped with any requests or questions throughout our stay. Would recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay!
Very responsive host and welcoming would come here again!

Great place for my extended family to stay for my graduation. Host was super responsive and helpful. House was comfortable with two major seating areas and plenty of bedrooms/bathrooms, which were all very nice. We had folks flying in from Europe and their flight travel didn't match my original reservation, so the host was able to accommodate extending our stay by a day early. Neighborhood was quiet and pretty conveniently located for us, as we had a car. Kitchen was equipped moderately well and I was able to prepare/reheat food for my toddler easily.
overall I was very satisfied with the host, house and location.... if you want a neighborhood feel and emerged in Hispanic culture then this place is for you. we loved the place and the neighborhood
Trendy and comfortable place to stay!!
We walked to the L train several times and found the neighborhood to be peaceful and the architecture of the homes on the walk were amazing. Several great coffee shops and restaurants.
Nice room. I am going back to Chicago for graduation ceremony. This room gives me nice chance to rest. Sorry for arriving late，host is really patient！

We had a wonderful stay at this spacious apartment with a group of 10 adults and two small dogs. The property comfortably accommodated everyone and provided an excellent home base for exploring the area.
The location was outstanding. The beach is just a short walk away and offers lifeguards, clean restrooms, and plenty of space to relax. The apartment is also located at the end of the 18.5-mile lakefront trail leading to downtown Chicago, making it perfect for running, walking, or biking. There is also a fitness area and nearby basketball courts.
Transportation was incredibly convenient, with easy access to both the L and bus routes. We were able to visit the zoo, local festivals, shops, downtown Chicago, Shoreline Architecture River Cruise, Chinatown, and a Cubs game at Wrigley Field during our stay.
Overall, this is an excellent location for anyone who enjoys the beach, outdoor activities, and convenient access to all that Chicago has to offer. We would gladly stay here again.

Wonderful stay — the apartment is well-located in a great neighborhood with easy access to Downtown. Everything was comfortable and exactly as described. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!

Very good location with easy access to downtown while still allowing you to retreat to a quiet setting at the end of the day. The full kitchen was extremely helpful for preparing meals and getting food ready for outings, and overall I was very pleased with my stay.
My only suggestion would be to upgrade the mattress and couch. Comfort is such an important part of the guest experience, and both felt like they could use an update. Improving those two items would make a significant difference and, in my opinion, would elevate this property to a true 5-star stay.

Shonte went above and beyond accommodating our group. As our group was large, Shonte had an air mattress ready for us to use. Location was quiet and easy to find. There were a lot food options and stores within a 10 minute drive and there is access to the train.

We had a lovely stay at Matt and Brad’s Andersonville apartment. Matt is very responsive and helpful. We arrived early and he went out of his way to help us store our bags until it was time for check in. The apartment is very clean, quiet, well-stocked and close to many things to do. The neighborhood is so cute and people are friendly. We took CTA everywhere and could walk to the nearest stop in less than 10 minutes. I highly recommend this place!!
Great location to University and a few train stops from Millennium Park. Would absolutely book again.
This was a great place to stay. Very clean, well located. It is a beautiful place, great kitchen to cook, and modern. I would stay here again.

Alba’s place was great! In a great location, just residential enough to feel a little suburban, on a quiet street. Place was super clean and stocked with towels, toiletries and a full kitchen. Host was attentive and even let us check in early. Place was nice enough that when our plans got derailed and we had to stay in, it felt like a nice place to be in. Would 100% book this Airbnb again in the future!

Tamiz is a fantastic host and is very responsive to any and all questions. He is very friendly and has great hospitality. I highly recommend him. The apartment is beautiful and he is in a very very convenient location - in between O Hare and Downtown.

Clean, chill spot outside of Chicago. 15 min walk from the train. Took us under an hour to get to soldier field. Plenty of parking if you drove in. A great place to stay if you are not wanting to stay in the city.

PROS extremely clean, easy to find, nicely decorated, laundry was a bonus, extra towels and blankets, always found parking, close to green line/easy public transportation, hardly any noise from neighbors above or on sides, fireplace in main bedroom
CONS queen bed is memory foam and is not supportive, if parallel parking is not your thing you won't like street parking, lots of light into main bedroom at night
Will definitely stay again if we're in the area!!
Great stay as usual

Our family of five enjoyed our stay at Stephanie‘s place. The beds were comfortable, it was clean, in a quiet neighborhood and conveniently located near Hyde Park and U of Chicago where we attended graduated ceremonies. Stephanie‘s response time to messages was great.

Great location! Otherwise left a lot to be desired. The walls were literally crumbling, the floor had not been cleaned and had dirt and hair all over it, the bathroom sink did not drain, no hand soap in the kitchen, very thin towels and very thin polyester sheets. The hosts were responsive and sent someone out to fix the sink and vacuum the crumbling wall dust, then again for the floors. We spent almost no time in the apartment because of how dirty it felt, overall I would not recommend this place.

Samuel’s place is so perfect and exactly what my boyfriend and I needed for our trip! It was close to public transportation and easily walkable and in a safe area. The Air BnB itself was very clean and comfortable with an entire room and bathroom to ourselves with all the amenities we could possibly need and more. Even with a minor problem, Samuel was very responsive and even took it upon himself to diagnose the problem when we were away. We could not have asked for a better host and place to be at for week. Also one of his cats (the sweet tabby) was such a joy to have around and was kind enough to let us pet him when he felt like being social. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to be north of downtown! I would stay here again!
Thanks Samuel- You rock!
Jenny’s place was fantastic! In a great location, lovely host and a clean space. Perfect to explore Chicago.

Everything looked exactly like the photos and was clean and comfortable.  The neighborhood was quiet and we always had a spot to park our car directly in front of the house.  Charles, our host, was very helpful with directions and recommendations of favorite spots to eat and fun things to do.
location was a short drive to down town but far enough away to be peaceful. host was easy to get ahold of and check in was a breeze. would definitely stay again

This is a great spot for 1 or 2 guests specifically for folks who are visiting for short period. Place was very clean and host was very responsive and helpful with figuring out options for luggage before check in. Area was not the most active so it was quiet at night and the bus stop is right in front of the building!
For the value I think this place is worth it!
Nice place, super convenient for me, and very responsive host. Thank you!
Great place to stay for the weekend
Lovely quiet neighborhood in Chicago. Great for families. Multiple good food options within walking distance. 10 min walk to train stop, also easy to uber anywhere in the city.

Joanne was a great host and the space was perfect for our weekend getaway.  We love this neighborhood and it was a great location for walking to restaurants and public transport was easy around town.  Joanne provided clear and detailed instructions for accessing the space and offered parking in the garage which was such a perk.  The space itself was private, quiet, homey, and just as described.  She goes the extra mile as a host with little touches like snacks and toiletries that were much appreciated.  We would definitely stay here again and will recommend to friends!

Love my stay at this house. Clean, spacious and nice set up. Love the over all vibe of the stay. Great location, very peaceful and quiet. Great communication from the host. They even let me check in earlier because it was available which really helped. Would stay here again
Solid option. Very clean. Comes with 1 parking spot. Abnb is on first floor even though address is 3 floors. Don't mistakenly go to the second floor.
Perfect place to stay for a trip to Chicago; we loved our stay here.
Great place
Very clean, easy parking and never a disturbance from the host or other guests, immaculate stay!

It was a wonderful experience: a fantastic place, an excellent location right in the city center, and a very practical and well-equipped home. The host was always available and ready to help with any issues that might arise. Truly a fantastic experience in every respect.

Chambre correcte et calme (pas de deuxième occupant pendant mon séjour). Literie correcte mais basique (notamment le matelas). Salle de bain propre et fonctionnelle. Bon emplacement proche des transports. Bonne communication avec Hana. Appartement un peu "rustique" qui explique le bon rapport qualité-prix.
Perfect stay after a long flight. Cozy and mood lighting helped me relaxed so much. The atmosphere is top notch.

This AirB&B was cheaper than other options, and it reflected it. It was worth saving the money and being in such a prime location, though there was hair on the bed and stains on some of the bedding and some coffee mugs. Walls were very thin, and so would not recommend for anyone who is a particularly light sleeper or wants to have people over even casually.
A/C unit did not work through the whole apartment I and even it at night it was not comfortable to sleep

The listing was as described and very convenient to Grant Park and downtown. Ronald was a very helpful host. Proactive and responsive to any questions. We would stay there again next time in Chicago. Thanks for hosting our family.

Buen lugar para quedarte, la ubicación está cerca de estación del metro (línea verde) que te lleva prácticamente al centro.
Casa con mucha historia.
Excellent stay for a large group. Great location near food and fun. Amenities worked as described. Host was responsive when needed.

Our stay at Henderson’s place was pleasant. Very new on airbnb and he was already accommodating of our requests. Where we stayed was located on the second floor of the residence. Those who plan on staying should be capable of going up 2 flights of stairs leading up to the 2nd floor. The pictures of his place were exactly the same as advertised - spacious and bright. The neighborhood was safe, walkable and patrolled 24/7 by cops. Just make sure to set your pick up point at the corner of their street when booking for uber or lyft as they may have an intimidating presence. Would recommend staying at Henderson’s when you want a safe neighborhood vibe for big groups when visiting Chicago!

Easy to find. #22bus stops right at your door. Small but has everything. Walk to Dunkin, Whisper Park and many restaurants. Surprisingly quiet for the city, although a neighbor got noisy one night—the air drowned it out. Clean building also. Comfortable bed, and good shower pressure. Great towels!
We’d return.
Great place and awesome location. Host was vet friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay again.

I enjoyed my stay at this property. The description of the place was accurate. Jose had great communication and made sure I was set. For anyone staying here, I would recommend bringing a personal fan if you like your room on the colder side. Would book again if I am in the area again :)
my friend and I had a great time staying at this place. Very clean and Jorge was very responsive.
Great accommodations in the perfect location to enjoy Chicago.
Andy is a great host! Took care of the wifi right away when it was out and made sure to check in with me throughout the stay. Clean space as well.

Overall we enjoyed our stay here, the location is good. The apartment was clean and as depicted in the listing. The host was very responsive and helpful. The only reason we didn’t rate it 5 stars all the way is because the apartment is quite dark and could use some improved lighting, especially if you plan to stay for more than a few days and work remotely. Otherwise no issues.

Perfect for my family of two adults and two kids, our first visit to a beautiful city! We rented a car so it was 15-20 mins from all the places we wanted to go. Walking distance to nearby restaurants and cafes. Would stay again.
Great location, perfect for our family of 4

condo was clean and very comfortable. close to a lot of really great restaurants, and we appreciated them leaving out age-appropriate toys for our very energetic toddler. Beautiful area as well! would highly recommend and stay here again!

A’isha was a great host for my wife and I. She was incredibly responsive and helpful when we had any questions. The location is also amazing with its walkability, restaurants, and proximity to the “L”. Highly recommend and look forward to our next stay here.
Liked the place, good house with two bathrooms just in case. Good location to get quickly to the center, but quite dangerous surroundings. I had no issues, but it’s worth watching out

Jed's place was nice... Very clean, plenty of linens and towels and easy to find.
We did have a bit of sound from upstairs each night we were there and the beds could've been a little comfier/quieter.
Overall, Jed's place was okay and we would consider staying there again among other options available in the area.
Had a great stay at 747 lofts! Convenient location close to both the train and bus stop. Ideal spot for a quick trip to the city.

This property is in a great location that is walkable to so many things and close to public transit. The space itself has plenty of room and everything you would need to a shirt or longer stay. And I found the host to be kind, responsive, helpful, and eager to make sure I had a good experience. I would absolutely stay here again.

Can't beat this price for what you get, and for the location. While it is old and a little shabby, it is totally functional in every way that matters. There are also helpful notes around to let you know how things work, and felt right at home as if I was in Asia. Would definitely recommend!

Doni and Samantha’s Cozy Cottage House feels like home and was the perfect spot for our stay in Chicago! It was just as described and had everything we needed. The shower was so rejuvenating after a day of exploring the city! On property washer and dryer were very useful. Loved everything about the property’s interior- so light, bright, and airy with gorgeous decor. My 17 year-old commented that the sleeper sofa was the most comfortable he’s ever slept on! Doni and Samantha’s communication was outstanding and they sent very clear instructions for arrival ahead of time and tons of local recommendations. It was an easy 15-20 minute walk to the DePaul campus and the Fullerton station to catch the red, brown or purple lines. Overall, we had a fantastic stay and will definitely book again!
Clean and organized!
Christi is very responsive and proactive. Very attentive in every respect. You won't need to bring anything because she's got it all covered. Just arrive and enjoy your vacation.
Our stay in Chicago was great! Easy self check in. Responsive host. Nearby street parking was decently easy to find. Would definitely come back! Thanks to the hosts!

The host was unresponsive for our entire visit we did not get any replies. The AC was broken upon arrival and there had been a circuit fire at the location 2 weeks prior which was never communicated or fixed. There were no windows in the entire home. We were not able to check in until 4 even though the previous guests checked out at 10 am due to cleaning. However when we arrived the unit was not clean and there was trash and wrappers still on the floor.

Visited the area for a few days for some CUBS games. Parking was not available at location but available using spot hero app which we found a spot close by for overnight parking.  Overall the stay was everything we could ask for close to wrigley field and train stations to the field and downtown within a few minute walk. The price was a little expensive but overall happy with the experience and location.
Very and very clean place! The hosts are very sweet and took us on a tour of house. Also gave great recommendations on where to eat/ where to go. Would come back :)

stayed in Chicago for 2days. the place was clean and spacious! originally got a hotel but it had gotten canceled, this air bnb was cheaper and homely! it's near the green line train which made getting around the city and back easy! the neighborhood was peaceful and lovely to walk around! Ruby gave several recommendations for things to do and were greatly appreciated! I'd love to stay here again for my next trip to Chicago!
Alexandra fue una gran anfitriona, de verdad que hizo que el espacio fuese nuestro hogar por unos días. Todo es tal cual las fotos, y ella como persona fue muy amable, abierta y súper servicial.
Good location with good AC.
Very comfortable home for us to stay at. We have 2 little kids and they loved the backyard. Everything was clean and convenient.

Fantastic Airbnb stay and host. Comfy, well appointed, the location was great with easy access to the bus and red line. Parking in Chicago is awful and EXPENSIVE.
The hot tub was great, if small, after a lot of walking. There are chickens in the back yard but they leave you alone and we were gifted some fresh eggs, which were fantastic (thanks).
The beds are comfortable. Everything you need, it's there.

We had a fantastic stay and would absolutely book again. The home was even better than the photos — beautifully maintained, comfortable and stocked with everything we needed for a great weekend.
The location couldn’t have been better. We were in town for a wedding and it was just 10 minutes from the venue. The neighborhood was wonderful for exploring on foot, with great boutiques, bookstores, coffee shops and restaurants all nearby.
Communication from Paul was excellent from start to finish. He was responsive, helpful and made everything easy.
A first-class Airbnb experience in every way. Highly recommend!

This was a great place to stay in Chicago! It was very quite and easy to access - the train and bus are not far away and it's easy to get a ride share. The beds were SO comfortable! there were lots of stairs but overall it was a great place and very comfortable. Michael was very nice and easy to work with.

Anthony added extra family members to his communications for my convenience and it made communications easy for me. He even found us another place to stay when we decided we wanted to stay in Chicago another day but his place wasn't available.

One of the best Airbnb stays we have had out of many!  Great apartment in an ideal location in one of the safest and most vibrant areas of Chicago.  Almost anything you could want is within a few blocks’ walking distance.  The apartment was well-appointed, clean, quiet, and spacious.  WiFi worked well for work from home.  Bed was super comfortable.  The staff at the building are wonderful and the Suite Home arrangement is approved with the building so they are familiar with the setup, can help you get packages etc.  Definitely recommend!

Ben was super responsive and helped us find his place when coming in from O’Hare. His apartment is large and had everything we needed for our stay. We got to spend a bit of time with him and his son and he gave us great suggestions. I highly recommend his Avondale apartment!
The cabin was everything the listing said and more. Great hosts; great, cozy, charming space; great neighborhood!!! When we visit again, we will absolutely check out the cabin again.

For a busy few days in Chicago we were glad to find a space where four of us could stay and drive into the park and museum district. Kitchen has all you need to cook with a full size fridge, coffee/Keurig machines, and ample utensils, cups, and dish ware. Updated bathrooms and comfy beds.

This location is as advertised. The location is good and the price is great. You share a bathroom and kitchen with other rooms on the floor. Check in is easy as can be and the host made all details clear.

La ubicación es excelente, porque estás fuera del lío de la ciudad pero a la vez muy cerca. 10 min en Uber y caminando 30 min (y el camino vale mucho la pena). Elizabeth responde todas las inquietudes.
Great, simple,  clean space.   Wonderful neighborhood and a great location for exploring the city.

Impeccable quality, comfort, and quiet—plus a great host. A refined, nature-filled neighborhood; perfect for relaxing after visiting the Loop. Tuman's Tap and Grill Restaurant Very close to home, it impresses with its service and quality. I will undoubtedly return to Mimi's House in Ukrainian Village.Thanks Thank you for creating such well atmosphere!
O lugar é ótimo e tranquilo. O ônibus passa em frente do prédio que nos levava rapidamente ao centro de Chicago. A Adresa Stay é muito atenciosa  e nos respondia rapidamente as nossas dúvidas.
Truly enjoyed this stay. Was clean very comfortable and quiet neighborhood. Will be staying here anytime I’m in Chicago

We were in town for the Cubs Puerto Rican Heritage Jersey game. being walking distance from the park, restaurants and transportation spots made this location ideal for out-of-towners. Tracy was very responsive and accommodating to our needs and would definitely stay here again when we return to Chicago.
Nice location! Easy access to different areas of Chicago. Clear instructions and comfortable stay!
This is my second stay and I truly enjoy her Airbnb rentals, always great value, cleanliness, and privacy is top notch.

We had a great stay here as a home base. With a bit of a walk, you had access to public transit and all of Chicago. We enjoyed sitting on the back patio in the mornings and beds were comfortable. We would stay here again.

Great location. Walkable to Wrigley and many bars and restaurants. Reasonably priced compared to other Airbnbs in the area, which can get quite expensive. Tariq was very helpful and easy to get ahold of!
The room was nice, light and clean, and the neighbourhood felt safe. Good communication from host also. Thanks!

Had a very easy stay with no problems. The house was well kept and very clean when we arrived and towels were left on the beds. I had a couple questions for the hosts during the stay and they responded pretty quickly. The bedroom itself is quite small and felt smaller than what it seemed in the pictures so I would definitely recommend not booking for more than 2 people. The beds were comfy and the dedicated bathroom was very nice. One thing I was concerned about going in was that the listing had a very long section of rules and instructions compared to most AirBnB’s I’ve stayed in which made it feel less welcoming as a guest. We had no conflicts with the hosts and they were all very nice over messages so this was not an issue, but it does add stress in terms of worrying about many rules during vacations. Overall, this was a very good option for a cheaper vacation to Chicago!
An okay spot if you are traveling on a budget and just need a crash pad. The host is nice and responsive.

Departamento cómodo y tranquilo. La zona es tranquila y hay buenos restaurantes alrededor. Bien conectada con transporte público.
Clare y Jonas están atentos a cada solicitud.

Comfortable apartment in a great location. Taking the bus/train into downtown was smooth and easy, and having a parking spot was much appreciated. Kitchen is well stocked, unit is clean, beds are comfortable. Laura was responsive and communicative. We enjoyed our stay.
It was very cute and perfect for a work trip. Very clean and nice location.
Kathleen was very responsive to inquiries and questions.   Close to train station a BIG plus!
Great place & host! Adriane was very friendly & accommodating. 10/10
Great hosts. Nice location.
Great space, walkable to the L for easy access to Chicago. The unit was very clean, very responsive hosts. We did use SpotHero for parking and found a great lot under the L.  We’d stay there again!
great place to stay!  anytime I come back to Chicago I will stay at Brian's place. The place was very clean and comfortable.
Had a great time thanks for being a great Host.

The place was awesome. I had a wedding in downtown Chicago, but the hotel price was crazy, probably due to the Memorial Day holiday. 2 years ago, my mom and I had a good impression of the Lincoln Park neighborhood, so this time, for my dad, brother, mom, and me, I got this place. much better than a hotel, with a beautiful, peaceful location, but still not far from downtown. Fullerton Subway Station was literally just 5 minutes away. wonderful restaurants around this Airbnb. As a Korean, I loved that the host asked us to take off our shoes in the house, meaning that other guests also took off their shoes. Big yes! The house was clean when we got in. One thing that will -0.5 points out of 100 is that the laundry room door was hard to open because it's old, and the basement was a bit dark. Other than that, I highly recommend this place.

This place was wonderful, like staying inside a museum, so much art of all kinds throughout.  Bernard was helpful and responsive.  Neighborhood was nice and quiet and a quick bus ride to anywhere in the city.  this was a nice refuge at the end of each day and the price was literally an order of magnitude below the cost of staying in a small sterile hotel in the city.  Would wholeheartedly recommend.
I really enjoyed my stay! The hosts were very responsive and the place was exactly as shown/described. I would definitely return 😊

Amazing apartment, gorgeous decor plenty of space and very thoughtfully equipped (we didn’t have any issues with noise - but they provided ear plugs and white noise machines for every room). Location is a great neighbourhood for shopping, coffee, restaurants - and short hop downtown. We stayed as a family of 5 and we were incredibly comfortable, would highly recommend and wouldn’t hesitate to stay there again.

We are a family of 3, the place worked great for our 5 days in Chicago.   We walked to local restaurants for breakfast and used Uber to get to downtown attractions, museums,  and restaurants.  There home was a perfect start and finish to our daily adventures in Chicago!

Being close to the action can be a challenge as the action usually comes with noise, but Lina's place has the perfect combination of locations - being in the thick of the action but the apartment is at the back of the building so its pretty quiet. During the day I could hear the L nearby, but at night I didn't hear a thing!
The apartment is well appointed with cozy living room / kitchen space, bathroom accessed from the hallway and bedroom with a dresser and a large closet - with hangers even! We were able to unpack and feel at home in minutes!

We truly enjoyed our stay. The hosts are very nice, helpful and responsive.
The location is great as many others have also said. Nice restaurants, coffee spots very close by. Second City is a very short walk. The area is very safe!
The home is neat, clean and comfortable. Very nice rooftop deck. Yes there are stairs, just make sure you read their listing and look at the pictures when making your decision.
Overall a very nice stay.
Very clean,and everything freshly remodeled
Well maintained and clean house - no surprises
Convenient location, very fast to Argyle Station. Lots of restaurants around. Roommates are good.

Host allowed us to check in early because of our bag situation and was super accommodating. Pretty okay location, wasn’t too too far from anything we had planned out. We were very satisfied with our rooms since the beds, linens, and towels were incredibly high quality. Definitely some love and care put into the making of this place. Would stay again.

Ficamos em 3 no apartamento, super confortável, todos utensílios e equipamentos funcionando perfeitamente. Chuveiros e camas muito bons. Comunicação ótima com anfitrião!
Localização espetacular. Perto de tudo, ótimos restaurantes perto. Vista linda.
Pedimos entrega de mercado e restaurante sem nenhum problema. Inclusive o pessoal da portaria muito simpático também.
Vale muito a pena ! Adoramos.
Amamos nos hospedar na casa da Karina. Tinha tudo e muito mais do que precisávamos.

This apartment was a wonderful stay for our party of five. The apartment is beautiful, clean, and quiet. We enjoyed the back deck each evening after our busy days. Street parking was very easy with the free parking passes provided. The Pilsen neighborhood is full of great restaurants and bars. Erica is one of the most thoughtful hosts I've ever interacted with. We appreciated all the little touches that made our stay so pleasant. Thank you, Erica!

Great place! Lots of room except for the bathroom. Bathroom would benefit from some shelves or more storage. Decently clean but places like under the beds or
Splashes in the kitchen needed to be wiped up. Great overall. We would stay again!
It looks just like the picture. Close to downtown. Right next to train.
Very detailed description.

good stay if you’re going to just sleep there and shower! very hostel vibes. host was great at communicating. we appreciated the advance notice of the slightly sketch neighborhood, but nothing we (personally) aren’t used to. definitely worth the price for a couple days

Wonderful stay! The apartment was spotless and the check‑in instructions were clear. The host was friendly and super responsive. The space felt like a chic musician’s retreat with keyboards, guitars, curated magazines and inspiring books on entrepreneurship and leadership, together with tasteful décor and artful lighting, made it feel like stepping into a rock star’s house.
Modern finishes like quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, hardwood floors and floor‑to‑ceiling windows made it luxurious. We appreciated the comfortable beds, full kitchen, dedicated workspace, washer/dryer and strong Wi‑Fi. It’s just a short walk to the Blue Line.
Highly recommend!

My first Airbnb I ever stayed at and it was such a good experience. I felt right at home and it was very clean. The host was very nice! I highly recommend booking this location next time you visit Chicago.

Good communication and easy to book.  Basic Air B and B that accommodated my entire family.  Coffee pot did not work and it would be nice to have extra linens and a table in the rooms to set personal items on.   But overall, a decent home and was presented as advertised.
This cute place was a great stay!
Enjoyed our stay in Chicago! Great walkable neighborhood with several restaurants and hangouts. Close to train for easy access to all of Chicago.
Very nice, peaceful place with a wonderful host. would definitely visit again
It was nice and they were kind.

David’s place was PERFECT for what we needed! The neighborhood is absolutely beautiful and walking distance from the L and Wrigley. The house is very spacious and the area is safe and quiet at night. It’s a must stay and we will definitely be back!
John is an extremely hospitable host. He made sure that my parents had everything to feel at home for my graduation. I highly recommend staying with John.

We loved our stay at Assel’s place! My toddler had a blast watching the trains and we found everything extremely comfortable. When we had a couple of issues come up, Assel worked quickly to fix them. Would definitely recommend this location to a friend!
Everything was excellent. Just as described
GREAT location.  Walk to Wrigley, the lake, the zoo.  A ton of restaurants/coffee/(food/drug/liquor) stores within a block or two. The four of us had a wonderful four night stay.
It was an amazing stay
Olga is warm, friendly and approachable!
Super close to the red line, was very clean. The host was very communicative. I would recommend staying here!
We had the best time in Chicago and the Airbnb was perfect for us, our friends, and our two toddlers. Very clean with all the convenient amenities and great location. Would definitely recommend!
