We had a perfect Chicago vacation and this Airbnb was a big part of that. The check in instructions were detailed, easy to follow and we got into the building and into our place with no problems. The condo is fantastic! First of all, the views of Chicago are absolutely amazing! There were blinds on all the windows but we never closed them because the views were so amazing! There is a small balcony with 2 chairs and a small table where I ate breakfast every morning.The kitchen was stocked with everything we needed and more. There are even scissors, a hand towel, soap, olive oil and salt and pepper. They provide tea and steeped coffee. There is also coffee in the business center downstairs. The couch was comfy as were the beds. Our room was fabulous with fantastic views. The bathrooms are spacious and clean. They even have a full length mirror in the main bedroom. There is a washer and dryer with laundry detergent.We walked to everything. The area was safe. Great location.We will be back

The apartment was very close to the lake for great walks. There’s a Metra stop a block away, and a bus that goes to the Art Institute is right outside the door. It was surprisingly quiet with very friendly neighbors. The neighborhood is very walkable, with good restaurants close by via quiet, tree lined streets with great architecture to admire as you stroll. Jorge was a great host. I would definitely stay again.
Great stay and space, even better than the pictures.
Vin was very communicative throughout my check-in and stay at his place. The location is great for those attending graduation

I would say this is a place where you get what you pay for. The price was low but for a reason. The window sash in room 2 literally fell out of the casing when I tried to open it because it was so hot in the room. Upon further inspection, there was nothing holding it in. The door keypad seems to be problematic for some people. I did not have issues with it but heard the alarm go off on it multiple times. The neighborhood felt safe when I was walking around. Access to the bus was easy and it was a short walk to the L. If you're just looking for a place to sleep, it works.
Josey is warm, beautiful host! I’m delighted to have met her. My husband and I were in town for a stressful surgery, and Josey’s Airbnb was the perfect oasis for our situation.
Very clean and convenient to UChicago, we stayed for graduation weekend. Thanks Brad!

The place was beautiful. Very clean and modern. We enjoyed the building and parking.  Great amenities. Communication was instant.  Master bed was very uncomfortable. Hard as a rock. Location was not as expected. Walking to the train in the evening felt unsafe. Safer to drive or Uber when leaving the building at night.

We rented this beautiful apartment for my parents that found themselves in town for a longer than normal visit. It was amazing! We were looking for something accessible and easy in and out. Kevin's apartment offered a quiet/peaceful place for my dad to recover post heart surgery and we cannot thank him enough for being so responsive and attentive to our needs. The location itself offers bike path, park, river path at walking distance, along with breakfast spots and other restaurants!
Can definitely see us coming back!

Can't imagine a better spot for a Wrigley Field bachelor party weekend trip. Right in the heart of Wrigleyville with a bar/pizza spot, the main train line downtown, a liquor store, and a late night burrito shop all within like 50 feet. Great amount of space as well.

Great place exactly as described. Had everything we needed for an enjoyable stay. Some reviews mention a sketchy neighborhood and I can see where some might feel that way. We didn't have any problems, but I probably wouldn't go walking around at night. That said, I went for walks around the neighborhood every morning and my son and I ran down and around the nearby park/golf course daily and never felt unsafe. Great having the gated parking space in the back!
Great location, Russell was very helpful, the apt had the right amount of and thoughtful amenities (dishwasher soap, detergent, coffee). It was seamless and would absolutely stay again!
Easy to get to, centrally located, great views.
Jeveux’s place was great. We plan staying there again when we return to Chicago

We were here for the uofc convocation, perfect location. Quiet, close to Whole Foods and a bunch of restaurants, also a short bus ride to downtown Chicago.
Very detail oriented and responsive hosts! You’ll be in very good hands🥰
This is my 1st time making a reservation with Airbnb. Suite Home made it a great experience!
Nice host, and the location is convenient, security measures are good.

El alojamiento está muy cerca del centro de Chicago, no hay problemas para transportarse es muy seguro la ubicacion del alojamiento, la habitación es cómoda y es buen lugar para descansar, las areas compartidas son excelentes, no lo pienses si gustas hospedarse en este lugar, el anfitrión y sus compañeros están al pendiente de tu estancia y como  mi primer visita en este lugar me he llevado una agradable experiencia.

4 couples stayed here to explore Chicago. The neighborhood is quiet and walkable.  Airbnb was clean and plenty spacious for all of us. Kitchen had plenty of cups and glasses for all of us to have coffee etc. Location requires a significant walk to take the metro so we Ubered frequently to downtown.  But, if you are up for a walk to Logan Square proper we felt safe when trekking to restaurants and checking out the neighborhood.
Had a wonderful stay. Great location for those wanting to see a little bit of everything.
Great convenient location and worked out well for our family.

The space is great and has everything needed for cooking. However, around 5:00 a.m., there is very loud banging noise coming from inside the building. It may be related to gym operations or staff activities. The noise is disruptive and occurs outside the hours that guests would reasonably expect recreational facilities to be in use.

This place was phenomenal! It’s right in the heart of a neighborhood that has a homey feeling. The condo is old but that’s what makes it amazing to stay. Very clean and nice amenities makes this well worth the price.
Great place, location, and very responsive host!  Would definitely stay again!

This place was perfect for our big family vacation to Chicago. We took 5 kids (4 teenagers) and this place allowed us to spread out.  The kids had the entire top floor with two bedrooms and a pullout couch so plenty of sleeping room.  This area was so nice too as Wicker Park has so many restaurants, shopping and all the things you'd need close by!  Thanks, Nicole and Matt!
Great place. Perfect location for Cubs games.

This is a place where you just feel the love from the host! Everything as it should be and then some! There were popsicles in the freezer, sodas in the fridge, a Brita filter system full of water in fridge, Keurig coffee, tampons in the bathroom and candy in the bowl. This building is old, but this place had a good going over and felt modern and new! Everything worked great (internet speed, bathroom fixtures, kitchen items, upgraded microwave, nice coffee pot + Keurig system, etc...). Best part was an information book they left talking about the unit, the neighborhood, Wrigley field, things to do, where to shop and the like! Really thoughtfully done where you can get the vibe of the Chicago lifestyle.
The street can be a bit noisy, especially after a night game at Wrigley (Note: host provides ear plugs).
Overall a great experience and value.

This space was very comfortable and absolutely lovely. This was a great location with easy accessibility to all the great spots the city has to offer. Lea and Cliff were great hosts by being super helpful and responsive anytime we reached out. Would reccommend this space for anyone looking for a safe, cozy space to enjoy Chicago.

Soy usuario de Airbnb desde hace 15 años y es la primera vez que me veo en la obligación de dejar una reseña negativa. Durante nuestra estancia, personas extrañas ingresaron al departamento sin previo aviso y sin golpear, a pesar de tener la traba de la cerradura puesta, vulnerando por completo nuestra privacidad y seguridad (viajaba con mi padre mayor).
​Además, a mitad de la estancia, el anfitrión nos presionó reiteradamente para que desalojáramos el lugar de inmediato porque "el edificio se había vendido", ofreciéndonos dinero en efectivo y por fuera de la plataforma para que nos fuéramos a un motel. Tras una larga e increíblemente estresante discusión donde le demostré los gastos que nos ocasionaba mover los vuelos de regreso, se retractó y nos dejó quedarnos la última noche. Dejé el caso abierto con el soporte de Airbnb. No recomiendo este lugar en absoluto; la seguridad del huésped no está garantizada.

The location was convenient for access to downtown and the property. Amenities were as described and beds were very comfortable. We had two families staying there and the separation was great We would stay there again if we have the multi-family situation.
We enjoyed Alex's place. The beds were really comfortable and the location was prime. We felt safe and we were able to walk to many restaurants.
I loved staying here! Patt is responsive and so friendly! She made me feel comfortable and I enjoyed having conversations with her when she was in town!

This cozy space was perfectly situated for our trip. The neighborhood is quaint with lots of restaurants and things to do and is situated well within accessible transportation to the city. The space was spotless and easy to access. Danielle was a wonderful host!

Great location, awesome view of the downtown skyline, lots of windows, window ACs worked great, provided earplugs were a nice touch since you're near the train station. Living room furniture could have been more comfortable. 4.5 stars rounded to 5. We enjoyed our stay.

We had an amazing stay at Nicole And Matt’s’! Beautiful home that was next to amazing restaurants, bars, and a 10 min walk from the beach. Would definitely stay here again next time we are in Chicago!
Me and my boyfriend had a wonderful day thank you Eric!
highly recommend
The apartment was centrally located and incredibly easy to navigate to and from in the city. It accommodated our large group. Had easy to follow instructions and were very responsive.

1. Clemente was an exceptional communicator. Proactive and quick to respond
2. The place was very clean, comfortable, and extremely well equipped
3. Location is top notch. Blocks away from everything and excellent nearby public transit options.

First off Geo was incredibly responsive, There were a few things that could have been better. There were no sheets for the pull out couch and we were told we should have brought our own! Not enough towels for 4 people and no way to get more. One of the bedrooms had a big closet with no closet rod so no way to hang clothes. We were attending a wedding so this was important. An easy fix tho.
There was a good grocery store nearby and a good thai food take out place. Thought it was very expensive for the area. But again, Geo was a very responsive host.

This apartment was clean, well equipped and furnished. We appreciated the coffee and tea provided. It was a short walk from public transport and Tony’s grocery store which sells everything. Logan Square is worth exploring. Joan was very quick at responding to queries and a great host. Thank you so much. We have no hesitation in recommending this apartment.
Thank you for the comfortable stay.
Great location for Cubs games
Very nice stay, clean, safe walkable area.

Clean place with everything you need, kitchen and living room are super spacious and basement room had very good privacy. One bathroom is fine to share with the other rooms.
Location is good, close to public transport. It is a bit further out of town (~45min to downtown), but otherwise you pay double the price.
Would stay again! Thanks for the pleasant stay.

Tanya’s place was outstanding for our stay in Chicago. Highly, highly recommend. Every space was gorgeously designed and functional. It was comfortable and had everything we needed, and more. The view from the living room and kitchen is incredible with a skyline view, all with a neighborhood feel. The kitchen was great and I enjoyed the coffee nook every morning. The bedrooms were beautiful and equipped with blackout shades and the primary bedroom was incredible. It was dark and cozy and so comfortable. The bathrooms were stunning as well. The building and location itself were wonderful -  and we could walk to almost everything,  and a short uber drive to anything else was very easy. We felt very safe and you can’t beat the location. I hope to visit again one day. Truly outstanding place!

I had the most wonderful week here, and I will recommend to anyone looking for a comfortable place in the perfect location! I spent 7 days here, working remotely and exploring the city. Check in instructions were simple, and it was very cute and clean. Easy parking out front, and walkable to so many fun places.  The home was stocked with every amenity I could possibly need, and I enjoyed spending my days working on my laptop in the serene living area. Joan was a very friendly and kind host. Overall it was a perfect stay!

Some of the best host communication I’ve ever had, the place was perfect for what we were doing – I wish it would’ve been a little closer to a CTA stop, but it was very close to the Metra. I do recommend!
Great stay for the price. You get what you paid for. Clean rental with no frills, just the necessities for a place to rest your head. Private bath is great!
Great host

A Reinitta é muito atenciosa e a casa estava impecável , ela pensa em todos os detalhes para deixar o hóspede a vontade e com tudo oque precisa . A casa é linda, estava muito arrumada e perfumada. Precisei de ajuda para ligar a secadora e ela me atendeu prontamente.

Eine sehr schöne und geräumige Wohnung mit allem an Ausstattung was man braucht.
Die Parkplatzsituation ist schwierig, aber wir waren dennoch sehr zufrieden mit unserer Wahl und dem Preis Leistungsverhältnis.
Quiet and comfortable environment

Compared to the other listings this place had the best price for the amount of beds and bathrooms. The neighborhood felt safe and a lot of yummy Chinese restaurants nearby.
It was nice not to have a long list of check out instructions. Most of the apt was clean except the master bathroom. There was black hair everywhere… the floors, sink, shower and even the towels. It just seemed it was skipped, maybe by accident.
The internet was out one day and I messaged the host about it and she responded quickly. The internet was weak in the master bedroom but was better in the other rooms.

Geeta was a great host and very responsive. The location is very walkable to coffee shops, restaurants and an easy walk to the blue line. Parking is street parking. I almost always found a location in front of the property or a few cars away.
我们住了4天，可以自己做饭。进出打UBER方便。附近转角有超市。

Always remember about the policy of the 72 hours, make sure to not let pass places that should not be available on this platform. The bathrooms were really dirty, the beds were not clean, it was indeed not as described, and in the room i stayed at outside that door there was a lot of trash, with tons of gnats. Sadly i did not know about this policy.

Wir hatten einen guten Aufenthalt. Die Umgebung befindet sich Nähe der Luxusmeile und fühlte sich zudem sicher an. Das Stadtzentrum ist fußläufig in 25 Minuten zu erreichen. In 7 Gehminuten befindet sich eine bakery und der Supermarkt Aldi. Die Gastgeberin Shay hat sehr schnell auf Fragen geantwortet. Der Türcode kam erst nicht per Email an, Shay hat jedoch sehr schnell reagiert. Wir konnten zeitgemäß und problemlos einchecken.
Das Appartement war sauber und es standen frische Wasserflaschen für uns auf dem Tisch. Das Badezimmer ist etwas klein aber neu renoviert. Die Küche hat eine gute Ausstattung. Die Möbel sind bereits etwas älter, sahen auf den Bildern neuwertiger aus.
Amazing location, super fun rooftop space, and great apartment. Highly recommend!

It was a welcoming and spacious home for our visiting nieces and nephews. Habib had great recommendations and  was easy to get ahold of for questions. The house was modern and nicely decorated. They even had games for some family fun, we highly recommend his home.

We weren't prepared for the noise.  It was very noisy from the surrounding businesses.  The window AC units makenit hard to block out the noise.  Between the bar/karaoke noise and the alley/dumpster noise you couldn't get any sleep.
Great location! Matthew was very proactive and prompt in his communication.
This place is great and cozy! The host is very responsive as well.
Great place with a great location. Very close to the Belmont train stop and a safe area to walk around!
Host was communicative and kind.
Nicky’s place was great to stay at. It was very clean. A ten minute walk away from the train to get to the city of Chicago.
Really great stay and the hosts were very responsive and helpful, especially with reservation modifications and adding parking.
If you want the full Wrigley experience this is the place!! Super close to the field, stores, restaurants, and train.

Great location and apartment was larger than expected! Basement unit of a townhouse. Garage parking, real non k-cup coffee available and legit non-sandpapery double ply toilet paper (first time I’ve ever had at an Airbnb). Exceeded my expectations all around. Very nice walkable neighborhood, would definitely book again

I’m not sure how expensive other locations are, but we paid over $700 for the room + $70 for parking (we were only given valet where others had the option to park their own car for cheaper), +$70 for my dog (which we were not told about until we got there).
Also, for a dog-friendly place to not have a place for dogs to relieve themselves other than a park blocks away was not what I would call pet-friendly. The park had signs about dogs needing to be on leash and many were not. Also, nothing on the hotel, but the neighborhood where the park is smelled like urine.
I would not choose this place if I were to return to the area.

Clean, spacious place.
Nice neighborhood, lots of trees.
Very nice to meet Anna.
Enjoyed my stay.

The apartment was as described. All 3 bedrooms were spacious, the bathroom good sized as well as the kitchen & living room. Great place for sure! The beds were all very comfortable. The 3rd bedroom was through one of the other bedrooms which wasn't a problem for us at all but it might be for someone else. The 3rd bedroom was a very comfortable single bed with lots of windows which was good to let in a lot of natural light but was quite bright at night so I'd recommend bringing an eye mask. It's also a little noisy from street traffic. It didn't bother me too much but the host had earplugs by every bed if noise bothers you. It's about a 15 min walk to the blue line train to get into downtown Chicago which was an easy comfortable ride. There were bus stops right outside the airbnb but we didn't take those. It is over an hour to get to downtown Chicago so keep that in mind. We just planned around it. Overall we had a great stay and this place met all our needs.
Very nice place and in a wonderful location! Would stay here again. The WiFi was the only issue but we sorted it out pretty fast thanks to Elenas clear communication!

My only 2 complaints were the air conditioning and the fact there was no table for eating.  I kept adjusting the thermostat with zero luck having a consistent temperature.  The window box air conditioner worked, however, blasting down on your head, off and on, while sleeping was not optimal.  Perhaps supplying a fan might help in circulating the air.  Also, my bad that I didn’t see that there was no seating or table for eating.  The full kitchen was stocked with everything you would need to cook, but then what?????  Standing beside the kitchen counter to eat just doesn’t cut it, in my opinion.  There is room for a small table and chairs, or in the alternative, supplying a couple of TV trays would suffice.
Great spot. Close both to the airport and to public transit that can whisk you away to downtown within an hour.
Great location, clean room, walkable to public transportation. Appreciates the staff holding our luggage after we checked out
This was a great place, no problems during my 4 days.
location worked well for us . the space was good for 6 people

Jen's place was very clean and cozy! We really loved the decor & personality she put in for the home. Her place was fully stocked and prepared, so our week-long stay was very smooth. Location was also great - very walkable to all the cute shops, cafes, and restaurants in Logan Square. Lastly, throughout our stay, Jen was so communicative with us, making sure we had everything we needed and that we were having a great time during our trip. Thanks for having us, Jen!
We enjoyed our stay! Ini was quick to respond whenever we had a question. Would definitely stay again.

Mary was an amazing host! She had great recommendations and was very knowledgeable about the area. She let us know about the Blues Festival going on, and we had a great time attending! Her place is stocked with toiletries which was very helpful after realizing I’d forgotten a few things. It is within walking distance of Wrigley Field, restaurants, and the train. Would highly recommend!

Lovely home with tons of space for large groups! Well appointed and thoughtfully designed with a gorgeous master suite. I would highly suggest this location for groups in need of multiple bedrooms. Private parking as well! We had an over height vehicle that sadly didn’t fit through the rolling gate in for the driveway but for any average sized car this is a great feature!

This was a great place! Just a couple blocks away from the brown line which gave us easy access to downtown. Shopping, groceries, and restaurants in walking distance. Clean apartment with all of the basics we needed.

The apartment was absolutely perfect and had everything we needed. Very comfortable beds, cozy living room. Great location, walking distance to Wrigley Field, coffee shops and groceries. Host was excellent with communication and local suggestions. Will definitely stay again.
Great spot for a weekend stay with good access and easy to access building.
Liked the place, and it was well-located.

We could not have chosen a better place to spend a weekend in Chicago with our toddler and both sets of grandparents! It was the perfect location - easy walks to restaurants, Oz park and the zoo - and easy drives to Wrigley and Shedd aquarium. They were so kind to already have all toddler amenities (pack and play, slumberpod, monitor, noise machine, toddler utensils and plates, high chair) set up which made it so much easier for us to pack and get settled in quickly. They also were so kind to let us check in early and late. Truly could not have asked for a better Airbnb experience!😊
Great day! The location was prime. Walkable to restaurants, local attractions, Lakeshore, etc.. highly recommend!
Great place!! I loved staying here, host was super friendly and communicated constantly to check in or answer any doubts. Location was great, felt very safe!

Hien and Brianne's place is amazing! It's in a great neighborhood with tons of walkable shops, restaurants, and cafes. We walked to the coffee shop every day which was great, and it's very close to Mindy's Bakery which everyone should definitely check out! Hien was very kind and answered any questions we had quickly. The off-street parking is a great addition as well, but one thing to note is if you have a bigger vehicle, it's a little tight (definitely not a deterrent, just something to be aware of).  It has a super cute upper deck off the kitchen and a nice little outdoor space on the lower level. I wouldn't hesitate to stay at Hien's place again, we really had a lovely time!

Place was spacious and accommodating for my crew. A few things I noticed during my stay however:
The lock outside the gate was difficult to open to access the keys (for me and my brother at least was outside for about twenty minutes to figure it out)
There was no cold water in the kitchen sink. I had to get it from the bathroom.
The neighborhood was a bit sketchy. I was on high alert at times.
The fan in the bedroom is squeaky when in use.
Air conditioning was effective but pretty loud.

Staying at Charles and Andrea’s place has been awesome right from the start. The place is just like in the pictures and fully equiped. Location is fantastic. The neighbourhood is lovely and you are very close to local shops, the bus stops and the underground train. Charles was super kind and texted before my arrival to say they had parking permits so that I could park if I was driving. The place is spotless and it has a beautiful garden at the entrance, full of colourful flowers that you can see and enjoy through the windows.
I recommend staying at this place without hesitation if you are visiting Chicago. Thank you Charles and Andrea!

Great location and fun place to stay. Communication was fantastic. Would highly recommend.
Thank you to Matthew, our host.

I had a fantastic 6-week stay here and would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting the area. The host was incredibly responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout my entire stay.
The location was excellent. Even during rush hour, downtown was only about 30 minutes away, and during off-peak times I could get there in as little as 15 minutes. It made getting around very convenient whether I was working or exploring the city.
Parking was much easier than expected and never became an issue. The property was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, with everything I needed for an extended stay. The neighborhood felt safe and quiet, which made it easy to relax after long days.
One unexpected bonus was a nice secluded beach area nearby that was perfect for laying out and relaxing. It was about a 20-minute walk away, near the Chipotle, and became one of my favorite spots during my stay.
Overall, this was a smooth and enjoyable experience from start to finish.

Josh was a great host and was very responsive. The location was close to public transit and easy to get into downtown.
Josh’s space was extremely spacious and well kept!
Property is very close to bus stop! we decided not to rent a car this time. Walkable to Portillo's! Property is very clean and very cozy! we enjoyed our stay!!!

Almir and Majda’s place was perfect! It was clean, spacious, and homey. I have stayed at other places in Chicago that were lovely, but they were cramped one-bedroom apartments. Almir and Majda’s place was the size of a small house, and my husband I loved it. It was beautifully decorated and in a nice spot that had restaurants and shopping in walking distance. The bed we used was very comfortable, and there was a good amount of closet space to hang clothes. The bathroom was spotless with a beautiful shower. Almir and Majda were extremely responsive hosts. Their place was worth every penny. The only issue was the train being so close it was noisy as heck! But previous reviewers mentioned the issue which was easily solved with earplugs.  I will most definitely book again the next time I’m in Chicago.

Die Lage der Unterkunft ist super mit der Bahn zu erreichen. Es sind viele Restaurants in der Umgebung, ein großer Target ist ebenfalls nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt. Das Zimmer war sehr groß und geräumig für 2 Personen. Mit der Sauberkeit und der Ausstattung waren wir sehr zufrieden. Neben der Unterkunft befindet sich eine Bar, von der bis spät nachts laute Musik zu hören war. Wenn man einen leichten Schlaf hat, könnte dies störend sein.

Eva’s place was truly such an enjoyable stay. Instructions to locate the place were detailed and easy to follow. The entire house was super clean and neat. Upon walking in, my family was completely comfortable. It was very cozy and homey but still pretty spacious. The beds!! Some of the best sleep I have gotten - it felt like floating on a cloud. Eva was also very proactive in her communication, often checking in first to ensure the stay was going well. While attached to her personal home, you often couldn’t really tell. The neighborhood was so peaceful and quiet. Everything was just as described in the listing and the home is exactly as it appears in the pictures. If you’re looking for a place to stay (away from the downtown area) definitely consider this place! It is a bit far from downtown chicago so if you’re planning to spend most of your time there - be aware of that. I would definitely recommend this place and would stay here again!

We stayed for a few nights to explore the Chicago. The loft was lovely and the Lincoln Park neighborhood location was great. Easy parking, close to public transportation for a day down in the loop and a day up at Wrigley. We especially enjoyed dinner at the Armitage Alehouse just a block away - be sure to save room for the Sticky Date Cake, wow!
Great experience staying at Alma’s home. Clean and comfortable with a great location. We will be back!
Great place, we'll stocked with necessities for staying 1,000 miles from home. Beautiful home perfectly matched the pictures.

We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely book this property again. It was incredibly easy to find, very well maintained, and spotless upon arrival. The neighborhood was quiet, felt safe, and was perfect for exploring the city.
One of the biggest highlights was the location. We were able to walk to so many restaurants, shops, and attractions, and anything farther away was just a short Uber ride. There were countless great food options nearby and plenty of family-friendly activities within easy reach.
As a family traveling with children, we especially appreciated how safe and convenient the area felt. It made getting around Chicago stress-free and enjoyable. I would recommend this property to anyone visiting the city, but especially to families with kids. We had such a great experience that we will definitely be booking here again on our next trip to Chicago!

We had a great one week stay at this apartment. Fun
neighborhood and great location with lots of great cafes, shopping and bars. Walking distance to the blue line which was a plus.
The apartment was spotless and light and bright. It was decorated to make you feel comfortable and all of the little extra touches were really nice. We will definitely book again.

Ericka was a great host. Very responsive and helpful with any request. I had an incident with my car early on and she was able to provide me with the information I needed to resolve the issue.
The place was as described and although there was a lot of foot traffic/activity a few blocks down, the street itself was quiet; I felt safe throughout my stay.
I would definitely recommend this property and Ericka!
The place was great! We really appreciated the location. Thank you Daniel!
Roxane was a great, friendly host and was communicative throughout our stay. The location is quiet but a bit of a trek to get to the journey center. The space was as advertised. Thanks Roxane!

Booked Wood’s place for my wedding weekend and it was exactly what I needed! I live in the neighborhood and needed a place for me and my girls to get ready the day of my wedding. Wood’s place was PERFECT for that! Cozy little spot for a couple girls to have a girls night the night before, get ready the morning of and for me and my new Husband to spend our newlywed night after our reception. The rooms were a good size with a comfy bed. Wood made sure we had cold filtered water in the fridge and we took advantage of coffee pot in the morning. The rain shower was also really nice especially after being in a wedding dress all day in really warm weather. Things to note: the stairs down to the unit are pretty steep so if you’re traveling with an older person keep that in mind. Outside of that if you’re coming in for a weekend, are going to be gone most of the day, don’t plan on cooking and just want a nice place to come home and crash that isn’t a hotel, Wood’s place is perfect!
Great place. Great location. We loved chicago.
Great place

Gabrielle's place is a true gem. Spotless, fun and funky decor, and perfectly located for fun local walks and amenities in an adorable neighborhood, plus a very easy walk to busses and the Blue Line. Gabrielle herself (and her sweet doggos) were friendly, helpful, eager to make sure the stay was a great one. I would absolutely stay again.

We had a great stay here, everything looked like the pictures and it was a quiet neighborhood. The neighbors were really nice as well. Theres a shared backyard and we had no issues as well. Super friendly and easy to find.
Awesome play to stay! Loved being in the middle of Wrigleyville & right by the stadium. Go cubs go!
Great place. Spectacular views. High end apartment living.  Love Chicago!
Highly recommend this place. Everything was well thought out, loved the book they put together for recommendations. Super easy to check in and check out. 5 minute walk to Wrigley was amazing!
We had a great stay at Milan’s place. It was secure, quiet, comfortable, and clean.  We loved that it was within walking distance to the Grant Park area.  We would be more than happy to book again.

Great experience for my first Airbnb! Weihong was extremely proactive in communication and was beyond sweet. The neighborhood was beautiful and quiet, and within a fifteen minute walk of Chinatown. Absolutely would stay here again!
The place was clean and everything was as advertised.

This Airbnb was absolutely perfect! I couldn't have asked for a better location. The property was exactly as advertised—the pictures matched the space perfectly, and it was even more impressive in person.
The location was incredible: right in the heart of the city, just 25 minutes from Wrigley Field and about 5 minutes from the Bean, with amazing restaurants, bars, and attractions all nearby. It made exploring the city so easy and convenient.
The space was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a great stay. I can't wait to come back to Chicago, and when I do, I'll definitely be staying here again. Highly recommend!
Enjoyed the stay and the neighborhood! A nice walk to Andersonville in a homey complex. Would be back!
Great communication with Song. Very responsive to my family. Location was great.
This stay was great! Dan was very responsive and the place was safe and comfortable. Located in a nice area.
Great space. We enjoyed all of the living areas. Very comfortable for the group.
Nice, clean, two-bedroom and kitchen in the very heart of Wicker Park
Great location and in terrific condition.  We would definitely stay there again.  Convenient to the train.
The best 👍🏾

Enjoyed staying at Demitri's, who was a wonderful host. Having received all the instructions from him before arrival, I felt confident about the check-in process. I will note that the photos made the apartment seem much more up to date than it actually was, and it would have been nice to have a towel rack in the bathroom. But the place was spacious, super clean, and overall very well-kept. I also appreciated being in a great location with easy access to coffee and food. Thanks again for having me!

This home was comfortable and had plenty of room for our family. The location was great and felt safe. This was not the best kitchen to cook your own meals but was sufficient. The host was responsive and helpful.

Really cannot speak highly enough of this Airbnb and host. Our entire group raved about this stay. Everything from the host communication to the property itself was impeccable. Cannot recommend enough, this is a fantastic place to stay. We hope to come back!

Couldn’t ask for better location. Right by Intelligentsia, my favorite coffee place in Chicago. Also close to more restaurants than you can count, and a great hair salon.
Great value for the price. The bed was comfortable, the AC worked, the lighting was nice, the kitchen had everything for cooking.
Previous reviews mentioned a heavy smell of smoke in the hallways, but I didn’t smell anything. In fact, I saw the hallways being cleaned twice over the 2-day stay. Also, the elevator was in perfect working order.
Would definitely stay again.
Great place to stay—clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and welcoming, and I would definitely stay here again

The Airbnb is in a great area, the house is clean, and Jennifer is always very responsive and helpful. I stayed for over a month and thoroughly enjoyed my time here. The neighborhood is wonderful for walking, and I always felt comfortable and safe
Perfect stay. No complaints
Love the Trive team and their properties!
Nice place needs more tvs

It was close to Devon Street. Parking in the front was almost always occupied, and the back was a bit difficult to find. Our apartment was on the 3 rd. floor and has no elevators so if you have heavy suite cases it might be a bit struggle.
Overall the rooms were spacious and clean. Has full kitchen and laundry which was great option. Matthew was very responsive

This location is in a beautiful neighborhood and is close to public transport, making it effortless to get into the city. The space was quite large, making it perfect for a family. It gives you a taste of living in Chicago and I felt right at home! Lots of good restaurants, cafes, and breweries are nearby aswell. Whether you're commuting or having a night in, this is a great spot to land! I would highly recommend Bad Coffee not even a mile away and the neighborhood of Andersonville for awesome artisan shops and bookstores that is only a 10 minute drive away. Would most certainly stay here again. Thanks to the fabulous hosts!
Awesome host . Very nice and welcoming, felt right at home and the area and neighborhood is great .
Great location and easy access to so many stops and lines. We were in the city, without the big hustle and bustle. Love coming to Chicago and will def recommend this place to big groups

The place looks exactly like the pictures, the townhouse had many amenities that made our stay more pleasant, the location was great, and the host was very responsive and attentive. We loved the  coffee selection! Would absolutely stay here again!
Great spot for a great price! Gorgeous view with incredibly comfortable bed.
Wish we could stay there longer and would definitely stay there again!
Great host
It was very clean, and I liked the privacy of the place, other the upstairs neighbors being kind of loud the stay was really nice.
Thoughtfully appointed, convenient location for public transit, easy in and out, nice shower, newer bathroom and kitchen fixtures. Solid all the way around.
Wonderful stay in great neighborhood. Lewis is an awesome host.
Great place to stay while exploring the neighborhood/Chicago. Terry and John were always doing their best to make me feel welcome. They have a friendly dog too
It was a great place in a great neighborhood!
In a beautiful apartment building in a beautiful neighborhood easily walkable to the lake/restaurants/shopping. Door person helpful. Especially good deal. Would stay there every time.
Walkable to Michigan Ave. Easy to find using the provided directions. Just as described. Having the parking space was amazing! Great views!

I feel to recommend this apartment. It is really in an amazing neighbourhood, everything of insterest in the city is close. All the hosting staff professional and responsive. Apartment is very nice. Thanks for everything.

Very comfortable town house in a quiet and pleasant neighbourhood. Three large double bedrooms and well equipped kitchen/living area. We didn’t meet Robert the host but he promptly communicated before and during our stay.

The host was very hospitable and made sure my stay was exceptional. Everything was clean and the bed was so comfy after a long shift from work. Other guest sound was at a minimum. I enjoyed my stay here!
The apartment was perfect! We rented for 2 weeks at 2 properties and the experience was exactly the same. Highly recommend using Cloud9.

I had a wonderful stay in Chicago Chinatown. The location was perfect—just one block from the Red Line, making it very easy to get around the city.
Mr. Zheng was an amazing host, very friendly, welcoming, and always willing to help. The complimentary green teas were delicious and a very thoughtful touch.
Great place! Super sweet hosts :)
Great stay, the room was quaint and perfect
Traveled with my family of 4 and the place felt like home. Good spot if you're willing to walk. It's close to the CTA blue line station. The best deal is to get to downtown with it.
Good space for family of four.  Minor issues but Staywell was very responsive.

Anne was really on top of our arrival
She has a really nice place !
affordable, clean and close to public transportation

increible alojamiento, impecable desde que llegamos hastabque nos fuimos! realmente nos sentimos como en casa, todo mega limpio, la heladera parecia recien llegada a la casa, las mesadas impecables , los platos vasos tazones todoncombinaba en azul con la esponjita de lavar los platos y el detergente todo color azul, el baño impecable! la cama grande y comoda! todo excelente la verdad!
claro que volvería!!!!!

A casa foi uma ótima escolha para nossa viagem em família. Estávamos em 5 pessoas e a casa acomodou bem todos. Bom espaço para malas nos quartos, sem ficar apertado para ninguém.
A localização é fácil de chegar pelo aeroporto e de se locomover até o centro ou outras regiões da cidade, usando ônibus ou metrô.
O sofá-cama não é o mais confortável do mundo, mas é grande e eles disponibilizam estofamento extra. Poderia ter mais opções de utensílios pra quem vai usar bastante a casa pra cozinhar. Apenas o banheiro e os exaustores precisam de uma limpeza melhor. De resto, bem espaçosa e bom pra alguns dias na cidade.
This is great place clean place to stay, but the dryer  is not work that only issue I have. I will be back and recommend to anybody, good place
Great Host. Great Stay

We had a really great stay! The location was awesome and made it super easy to get around the city. We spent the week exploring Chicago and loved having so many restaurants, coffee shops, bookstores, and things to do nearby.
The place was clean, comfortable, and matched the listing. It was nice having a cozy spot to come back to at the end of long days walking all over the city. Overall, we had a wonderful trip and would definitely stay here again. Thanks for helping make our Chicago vacation such a fun one!
This place was perfect as an urban "oasis" in one of the best neighborhoods in Chicago. Location! Amenities and needs for anything were organized and thoughtful.
Affordable option, nice choice for individual travel
Great place & super responsive host! It looked exactly like the photos. Absolutely would stay again. Thanks for a wonderful experience!

Everything was just as it said in the description however with the apartment being in the basement the AC unit is very loud when it comes on. If you can’t sleep with noise this space is not for you!  Other than the noise this was a good stay for me and my family!
If you’re looking for a hidden Gem in Bronzeville this is the place. When you walk in the door it feels like home. Peter is quick to respond if you have any questions.
We loved the space and our hosts were super responsive and wonderful to work with! The neighborhood was great and an easy walk to Magnificent Mile.  We loved our experience!
Great location.  Perfect host.  Great home.
An awesome, unique find in a great neighborhood. Would recommend!

Had a fantastic stay! The apartment was spacious, comfortable and very attractive. Not only was the kitchen well stocked with supplies and cookware, the whole apartment was full of thoughtful details and handy items. We enjoyed the restaurants and shops in the neighborhood, and the ease of getting to the train. Hosts provided very clear directions, tips and recommendations. Would love to stay again!

We loved our stay in this cute and cozy apartment! Easy to find and access, yes the dog(s) barked, but we made it through, and we really appreciated the easy communication with Joe & Ruth. Would love to stay in future.

Great location, great host !

I’ve stayed in Airbnb‘s before, but I’ve never actually booked one for myself. I know, it’s pretty lame, but the host was extremely knowledgeable and really communicative and patient with me through all of my questions and was immediately responsive when I got there and had a couple questions. The location was wonderful and my grandson and I had a terrific visit. It was perfect for what we needed! Thank you!!

The location was perfect for my needs, the street was well lit so I felt like my rental car was safe on the street. The apartment was clean but needs a little love. Quiet. Spacious. Not a lot of natural light being on the bottom floor. Hatice was a great host and very communicative. Not a lot of amenities provided, but there was coffee! Full kitchen was nice if we needed to cook (we didn't but the option was there). 2 bathrooms, 3 bedrooms and big enough to be comfortable for a family or group traveling to Chicago.

Nice minimalist vibe, amazing cityscape views, perfect location walkable to lots of restaurants and easy L access. Loved the 16th floor area for spreading out including pool and gym. Comfortable for our family of 4 including 2 teen boys. Recommend highly - would stay here again!
The airbnb looked exactly like the pictures and was nice.

The place was fantastic! I had a little trouble getting inside when I first got there, but everyone (host, building mgr and Airbnb) was very helpful to get me inside and taken care of.
After that - everything was a dream! Safe, beautiful, quiet, etc. Walkable to everything. Will stay here again!

Darren was friendly host and very responsive during my stay. I was in the need for place to simply crash and go to bed each night, and this place fit those needs. Similar to staying with a friend and his roommates for a few days in college. This place served its main purpose for me, and I’d consider returning as an easy, budget friendly option.
Nice place and very responsive host
We had a wonderful stay at Keith’s house. We enjoyed the location and the apartment was beautiful..from the exposed brick and wood beams. The bed was comfortable. We would definitely stay here again.
Excellent place!
Great host and good location.

Such a great location, perfect for two couples and small dog.  Loved the layout - good for a TV hang, walkable to great coffee, bars, eats.  The 606 trail is close and so nice, and the trains are close but not so close as to disturb the quiet comfort of the place.  Comfy beds, great steam shower, the pup loved the turf out front and we enjoyed the deck.    Host was helpful and responsive.

Location is super convenient for Loyola University and the Rogers Park neighborhood.  Safe, clean, walkable. The place was clean and spacious, with thoughtful touches like toothbrushes and toothpaste, coffee, hair products, and body wash. Parking is difficult, and be prepared to walk a bit when you finally find a spot.

David was a great host, very proactive with communication and the place was as described. Nice location from downtown, metro line only 3 min walk away from front door. Accommodation is based in a high crime area, wouldn’t recommend walking alone at night. Although we didn’t encounter any problems, we left a little uneasy as a local we chatted to at the train station was shocked we wanted to stay in this area. The lock on the 2nd door into the accommodation was very unreliable, took us a few attempts to open it, as it was getting stuck. Overall we were happy, place was super clean, beds were comfy, and we enjoyed our stay.

This place was perfect for visiting family, centrally located, and convenient for public transportation. It was I exactly as pictured. We checked out Armitage Alehouse from the guidebook-a great experience and incredible food. There was also a conveniently close Whole Foods.
Upon making the reservation I had a little trouble at first because I had to exit the Airbnb website for additional online screening. It requires uploading a copy of an ID, and the names and contact info of every member of your party. I inquired about it on the Airbnb support page and the AI told me that it was a scam. I continued researching and found this is now becoming a more common practice. I learned I had overlooked a description of this extra step in the property description on Airbnb. Renters should be prepared for this extra security step and a substantial security deposit.
After all that was sorted out it was a very good Airbnb experience. And Ben was very patient with my questions.

A home away from home! Het had alles wat we nodig hadden. De bedden lagen comfortabel, in de keuken en koelkast kruiden, sauzen, koffie, boter, etc. Goed uitgerust met keukenapparatuur. Gezellige woonkamer met grote tv en spelletjes. Buurtwinkel op de hoek om 's ochtends ontbijtspullen te halen. Rustige buurt. Ca. 15 minuten lopen naar metrostation California of Logan Square. Hosts zijn vriendelijk, reageren snel, duidelijke instructies. Ik kan iedereen deze accomodatie van harte aanbevelen!

Emily was super helpful and responsive. We crossed paths a few times, and she gave us recommendations and treated us just like family! The apartment itself was great. Just as pictured with all kitchen utensils and spices you could need. It was especially nice to have some toys and books for our young kids. Couldn't recommend this host more!!

The airbnb is really really clean. The location is close to the California metro stop and the area is filled with good Mexican restaurants and businesses. Would highly recommend! Checkin time super flexible and instructions were clear. Despite the shared common area and bathrooms the rooms feel very private.
wonderful place near the lake and Rush St. fun.

The apartment was great. Jhon was so responsive; he got back to us within minutes of me asking a question. It didn't surprise me that he's an architect. The space was tasteful, simple, very clean and orderly. I booked the same space for September as soon as I signed up for a class in the same location, close to the apartment. I would very highly recommend this space to anyone.

We really enjoyed our stay! The place was great, easy to find places to go and ways to get around nearby. Patrick was very informative and gave clear instructions. He was very responsive to any issues.
The absolute best place to stay in Chicago.
Everything was great! Just wish i would’ve been able to get early check in but other than that the place was great
Great hosts and accommodations
Really cute place!

We enjoyed our stay at Mark’s garden level studio. Clean and comfortable; great location to spend time with our Chicago family. We always found an on street parking spot within a few steps. We look forward to future stays.

I spent a week at Aaron’s place and had a great experience. The house was very quiet, and I never had any issues with noise or crowded bathrooms. Aaron was a wonderful host who always shared helpful information about local attractions, events, and places to visit in the area.
The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and very affordable. I enjoyed my stay so much that I decided to book the same place again. I would definitely recommend Aaron’s place to anyone looking for a peaceful and budget-friendly stay.

an amazing place to stay! The clawfoot tub really made relaxing easy and the space is definitely eclectic. I would stay here again in a heartbeat; the location, the space itself, and how responsive the hosts were made it a full proof, and easy experience. I only wish I could’ve stayed longer!!!
A good location with enough room for accommodation. We enjoyed so much staying in the apartment.

We recently stayed in Patricia’s place for nine nights and were very satisfied. She was responsive and easy to deal with, instructions for accessing the apartment were simple and clear, and the location was superb - a very easy walk to the Bean, Millennium Park and various other key attractions.
There is a Target grocery store across the road and Walgreens pharmacy next door, plus plenty of cafes and restaurants around.
The apartment block was very quiet and we rarely saw any residents.
The street outside is noisy from early morning and right into the night so may not suit light sleepers, However everything else made up for it.
The place was well equipped with all the essentials.
We had a great stay at Rob’s place as a family of 4. Parking was easy in the area, and we had ample space for all of us. Getting downtown was an easy Uber ride.

The place was perfectly located. Ideal for taking the train or just walking around the city. Everything looks like the picture. Would definitely stay again if in Chicago!

We were in Logan to visit family.  We walked everywhere.  The Sunday Market was great, we ate at Parsons, Lula Cafe x 2, a burger place and a BBQ place.   The flat was everything stated and more.  Located in a quiet neighborhood  we ended and started our days of adventuring in this gem of a place in Logan.  Thanks for sharing your place.
We enjoyed our stay at your beautiful home, thank you!

David’s place was great for our family!   It was very clean and was well-stocked with essentials and lots of fun surprises, too!  Dave’s communication was top-notch throughout the process, and while we were in town!  He also provided us with a list of places to go/things to do in the area.

This place was perfect for us! Family of 4 on a roadtrip and we needed some space! I’m so glad we chose here. The beds and couches were very comfortable - felt like home. Thanks so much for a lovely time.

Jodee was kind and communicative. We are very appreciative of her place and the price was ok. However, the property is quite run down and needs a lot of repairs. Some maintenance and better furniture would go a long way.
Really enjoyed my stay!
Free and convenient parking spot right outside the apartment in this area was amazing. The apartment is actually better in person than in the pictures. Very nice host. We loved our stay!

Musa is a great and cooperative host! Loved the location, very happening and lots to do and easy access to the lake! The only call-out would be to book for 2 or maximum 3 people since the place can be a bit small for a group of 4

El alojamiento está muy bien comunicado con varias vías de transporte público.

Damien’s place was very private and I felt very safe staying there solo. He sent clear instructions for how to get in and provided many local recommendations in the info binder. Having a place to park have peace of mind. And oh my gosh that shower?! Took the longest shower of my life and loved every second of it.
Good spot, great location. Off street parking is very convenient for the area. Description is accurate, and instructions were helpful and clear.

The house is in a wonderful location to visit Chicago. It was easy to get around on the train, and the parking spots made it ideal for an out of town visit. The apartment is clean, the beds are comfortable and it was great to do laundry. However, the train is directly behind the building and very loud. Even with earplugs we did not sleep well.
Good location. Smooth communication. Everything is fine. I'll recommend it.
great location & nice place.
This was my second stay! The place is impeccable and spacious. Matches the description and well located in a walking area with easy access to shops and public transportation.
Great location walking distance to everything including wrigley! Great apartment- min was awesome very nice and quick to respond. Highly recommend!
Great value so close to McCormick center.
Loved staying at this AirBnB in Lincoln Park.  Highly recommend.
Place was good for the price, the host is a good guy

Mera’s place was great. Comfortable and clean. Just a heads up if you’re easily spooked or a light sleeper, if the upstairs neighbors are walking around at night, it sounds like someone’s in the apartment with you! Other than that and the squeaky floors - everything was great 😇

Our family had a great time at Rasheed's place. Best location in town! Quiet at night but around the corner from so much to do, including the red line and the lakefront. Clean, very safe, and well-stocked with necessities and thoughtful amenities like fans in every bedroom, an umbrella, and toiletry/laundry items. I would recommend a sleep mask if you are sensitive to light, because the bedrooms are not dark at night (would love some blackout curtains to be added that cover the little half-circle windows above the main windows in the bedrooms). My teenaged kids loved all the space to spread out, the pool table, the walk to the beach, and the retro-80's vibe of the decor: with just a few simple upgrades (fresh paint downstairs, new carpet) it would be even better... but those small things would not be enough to keep me from staying again. You will have a hard time finding a better place to stay, in a better location, for your Chicago trip. I miss it already. Thank you, Rasheed!

Yan Na is a suburb host. Communications were responsive and timely. The lodging is as described and depicted in photographs. These are basic accommodations but served my needs, was reasonable priced, and provided me with two nights of restful sleep. The lodging is ideal for individuals looking to spend most of their time out exploring the City or working and simply needing a secure safe place to sleep and store belongings.  If you require creature comforts and a place to lounge of the evenings, this likely isn’t the place.  If you need basic accommodations that are reasonably priced with convenient access to public transportation I recommend you stay.
Thank you our stay was great! Really walkable area and easy access to transportation. The place was very cool!
Great host.
Sharon thought of everything. we never had to run out for sundry items. All the things you typically may need were already there. there was also much more space than a hotel room.  Thank you!
Great house for friends get together and Cubs Game!!!
My dad and I had a great stay. Cheryl’s place was clean and very nice. There are numerous restaurants and stores you are able to walk to. 10/10 would recommend!
Great location near all of the restaurants in Hyde Park. Studio apartment perfect for visiting The University of Chicago. I would stay here again. Iris responded promptly to any questions.

The place was perfectly located on a one way street, with very little traffic & plenty of street parking.  The CTA Blueline & bus stop was 2 blocks away.  Very secure location, privacy fence all around & locked iron gate out front.  The host responded almost immediately; anytime we messaged her.  They showed up with our parking passes before we even had the car unloaded.  Aldi, Walgreens, & Coffee shop in the neighborhood.  If your a late nighter, there is Mic Ducks next to the train station; munchie bliss!
Convenient location, great stay!
You get what you see if you like what you see youll like it here
Lovely place nice neighborhood . Kind, friendly and  helpful host . Highly recommend . Close to O Hare.

This location is always convenient to restaurants, office, downtown and the L train.  The unit is clean and very well supplied with the things you need, like coffee, dishsoap, laundry soap and bathroom neccessities.  Ben always communicates with information.  Access and departure are easy.  I've stayed with Ben a few times and each unit is the same level of cleanliness and ease of access.  I highly recommend it!

Every year I look for a place that has parking, 2 bedrooms and close to downtown for my colleague and I to help with transit time.  We work very long hours so it’s important we have a peaceful location with amenities we need.  This place was it!  The neighborhood is beautiful, the space was clean, secure had on-site parking and separate bathrooms.  Kitchen was well stocked with necessities, washer and dryer onsite and the decoration was right up our alley.  We hope this place is available next year, we recommend it!

The unit was clean, nicely furnished, and in a great location with plenty of restaurants, bars, and metro access within walking distance. The kitchen was also very nice.
That said, there were several issues. The mattresses in every room felt cheap and uncomfortable, and the top bunk ladder was painful to climb. We also arrived to find the gas stove left on, creating a strong gas smell and a potentially dangerous situation. While mistakes happen, the response felt somewhat dismissive.
The biggest issue was the noise. You can hear nearly everything from the unit above, including conversations and footsteps. On top of that, there is a bar directly across the street that blasts music late into the night. We got almost no sleep one night, and it was only a Thursday. The location is convenient, but the noise insulation is practically nonexistent. If you are a light sleeper, I would strongly reconsider staying here.

Needs some maintenance to blinds which were inoperable in lounge area. Lounge and chair were in poor condition and not comfortable to use.
The extreme 24/7 gym directly under the apartment is very noisy with loud music from 5am and the sound of heavy weights being dropped on the floor is annoying .

I enjoyed my stay overall. The key pickup process was a little more complicated than expected, but once I was in, everything was smooth. The space was comfortable and had everything I needed. The location is excellent and perfectly situated in Hyde Park, with easy access to restaurants, shops, and nearby attractions. I’d be happy to stay here again.
Very clean! Nice part of town close to a lot of amenities. Great views!

This place is all about the location!  Couldn’t ask for better access to Wrigley.  Downtime Chicago 20 minutes.  It was so awesome to be able to be home after the ball game with just a short walk.  There were a few little inconveniences.  The grill was dirty and broke but Peter was quick to try and remedy the issue.  I would go back.
Very clean apartment and convenient location. Would definitely stay here again

We (four of us) spent three nights here and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.  Emily's place is clean, spacious and nicely decorated.  It is on a very quiet street,  yet just a block and a half away from a  busy commercial corridor with lots of restaurants, cafe's, etc.  The L line is just a couple blocks aways and gets you downtown quickly or a Division Street bus can easily take you east to the lake.  We will definitely come back when we visit.
Very good host

This place in Norwood Park was very cozy and accessible. The home is around the corner from the bus station which I used to go to work while I was staying there. The neighborhood was very accessible and warm. Parking was very easy and free one street over.
Victor was very transparent, informative and direct. Accessing the house was as it was presented via the electronic lock. The house was clean and spacious and accessing the room was simple with the key provided. The room was spacious and clean, and the bed was VERY comfortable. I definitely would recommend the place for a short term stay for anyone not familiar with Chicagoland area.

Me and my business partner stayed at Joan's place while in town for an event in Logan Square. We loved the neighborhood, and walked everywhere for the few days we stayed. It was just two of us, and the layout was perfect for us each to have our own sitting area and bedroom on two different levels. We also took advantage of sitting on the balcony to work and have coffee. Highly recommend!
Comfortable, attractive apartment. Great for public transportation. The host is proactive and responsive. I'd come back for a heartbeat.

Jared's place was great for our family. There was plenty of space, and we loved having the garage. Jared was very responsive and allowed us to check in an hour early, which was super helpful. There were a few things that made the experience less than perfect. There were no wash cloths or hand towels provided. The water in the upstairs bath wouldn't turn off completely. Several lamps were unplugged and didn't have bulbs that worked. Overall, I'm glad we stayed here due to the space and location. The little touches would have made the stay even better.
Place was clean and quiet and near good restaurants
Among the best we have stayed in worldwide. Magazine quality details. Fantastic !

The kitchen was very minimally stocked, lacking even a can opener, and the kitchen space is VERY tight. So it's not really a space for making meals other than sandwiches and cereal. Also, the elevator was not working. Regardless, the location made up for these problems and we would rent it again if we wanted the Chicago city experience.
Hena was an excellent host. She answered my questions quickly and was very helpful. The apartment was clean and as described. It was a perfect base for our visit to Chicago. Thank you.

Very nice spot!
Great for a couple days in chicago!
Great little place in the heart of Pilsen.

This was my first time using an Airbnb and also my first time to Chicago, and first ever solo trip. I LOVED my trip so much, and felt so peaceful staying in this Airbnb. I spent an entire day just relaxing and enjoying the peace and ability to Doordash anything. I will for sure use this listing again when I bring my kids with me or if I do another solo trip in the future!

We had a great stay at this Airbnb for a business trip. The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was easy, communication was smooth, and the space had everything we needed for a productive and enjoyable stay. We would happily stay here again and recommend it to other travelers.
Great place to stay for the price!

Bryan and Barb were wonderful hosts! The space was so beautiful, comfortable, and clean. It’s in a lovely neighborhood, close to great restaurants and public transit but still very quiet and peaceful. And they were so easy to communicate with! They went above and beyond to take care of us and make us feel at home. 10/10 will be booking again.

Clean space, fantastic location, good communication.
Description is spot on and it’s good value for the neighborhood. Full kitchen with a private bathroom.

My mom, daughter, and I enjoyed our two-night stay at Ann’s! We traveled with our two dogs and everything was a breeze. Great location, easy parking, comfortable beds, and nice outdoor space.  When we had a slight issue with the WiFi and AC, Ann was very responsive in fixing both. Highly recommend!

This property was in an excellent location relative to Wrigley Field.  This was the second time we've stayed at this property, and it did not disappoint.  It is a place that you want to be for a great Cubs baseball experience.  The stadium and many restaurants and bars are within walking distance.  Uber service is also very easy.  Dennis was a tremendous host and very responsive to any questions we had with regard to the property.  Overall, it was an excellent experience.

This place was huge and exactly as the pictures showed. It was very convenient for quick Uber rides to downtown. If you have a car, everything is about 15 minutes away. The beds were comfortable, the amenities were great, and we were very comfortable. While there, we went to Navy Pier, the Butterfly House, and a Fireboat Architectural Cruise. Plus it's not far from the Magnificent Mile and Millenium Park. The neighborhood is very safe which was a concern for three women traveling together. I would definitely go back. If you're going to Chicago and looking for a great place to stay where you can have four or more people with their own bathroom, it's totally perfect! Each of us had our own bedroom and bathroom. It was better than staying in a hotel because we had a full kitchen and living room, with a table to work at. The Taim's team is highly responsive and very accommodating. Excellent team to work with! You can't go wrong with this spot.

If you are looking for a great location with proximity close to the train and a quaint walkable area this is it!  Our visit was brief and we reached out to Demitri several times with questions/advice on getting around and his response time was amazing!  He was polite and extremely helpful!  His instructions for check-in and check-out are very clear and detailed.  His place was perfect for our visit!
Bella, was quick to reply, assist or support. If you visit Chicago do not overlook the opportunity to stay under her Hospitality.
Great location, very clean, would recommend and would stay again.
Always great! Love this property.

I really enjoyed staying at this place. The house was clean and looked like the photos. The host was very kind and quick to answer my questions. They were always helpful during my stay. I parked my car on the street and had no problems. The location is close to public transportation, so it was easy to go to downtown Chicago. I had no issues getting around the city. I would definitely stay here again if I come back to Chicago. Thank you for a great stay :)

The place is very nice, with spacious rooms, wooden floors, a lovely view, and a beautiful chestnut tree across the street just outside the window. The apartment is uniquely decorated, cozy, and has everything one might need for a comfortable stay.
There is a corner store just a minute away, and the metro station as well as an excellent bagel and coffee shop are only a five-minute walk away.
I would highly recommend this place for an authentic Chicago experience and the unique atmosphere of Pilsen.
Great host!

I can’t think of a better place to stay when visiting Chicago than on Bishop Street at Patricia’s place! The unit itself is more than just a place to stay, it’s a tastefully curated experience with beautiful artwork and thoughtful design. The bed & sheets were super comfortable and blackout curtains made it easy to get some rest - Bishop St is very quiet too, so you won’t be disturbed. At the end of the day it was nice to sit out on the patio & enjoy a beverage in the Chicago summer weather. The neighborhood is beautiful, peaceful, and there is a huge variety of restaurants, coffee shops, and bars within walking distance. I recommend The Embassy and Chez Joel! Overall fantastic experience and I will be back the next time I visit Chicago. Thank you Patricia and Jon for a memorable trip!

We had a great stay! The space was cute, comfortable, and exactly what we needed for our trip. The location was a huge plus really easy to explore Logan Square, grab groceries, shop, get dinner, and get around the city without feeling like we were doing too much.
It was a really nice home base for the weekend, and the host made everything easy. Would definitely recommend

This place was super cute, and the owners were very helpful and responsive. Lots of space. We enjoyed our stay.
Stuart was a wonderful host, happy to work with us and provided assistance with recommendations. Plan to use his place for my family when they are in the Chicago area.
Enjoyed my stay at Aisha’s. Very quiet neighborhood.

I had a very nice and comfortable stay. The location was excellent, with Millennium Station just steps away, making it easy to get around. Free parking was a great bonus and added to the convenience. Overall, a great place to stay.

I stayed with my husband and my 17 years old boy for 11 nights at Francisco’s house and we had a pleasant stay. I truly recommend it!
Was very clean and fit me and 4 others pretty comfortably. Very worth the price!

PROS <.Cons: some things we're not as intuitive, for example, central heating, how to work it, and the closet situation was a little weird, like the actual setup of the closets in the bedrooms-they are pretty much attached to each other, and there's not really a noise barrier.

We loved the house & location, highly recommended! Hanna did a good job checking on us daily to make sure we didn’t need anything.
Had a relaxing stay during my time in Chicago! Great communication as hosts and I had everything I needed. Def recommend!
Beautiful apartment !
Very kind host and clean home. 5 stars, definitely would stay again!
Milan was such a great host. His apartment was everything I had hoped for plus more. It was quiet, peaceful, clean and spacious. Thanks for letting me stay Milan!
Great spot and location.

Julio is a thoughtful and helpful host. He couldn’t have been any nicer. The bedroom is small (as pictured) but the kitchen and living room are large. Amenities were modest, but all the essentials are great for an extended stay (refrigerator, stove,  microwave). I enjoyed my stay.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The place was very clean, and the host was incredibly responsive, answering all of our questions the same day we reached out before our arrival. Everything was well-prepared, and all of our needs were already taken care of, so we didn’t need to contact the host during our stay.
The views were absolutely stunning and made the experience even more special. The temperature inside the space was also perfect, making it very comfortable throughout our stay. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and we would definitely stay here again.
Great place! Very clean and tidy. Host answered all messages very quickly. Would stay again! You will hear upstairs noise and conversations but I wasn’t at the place a lot - mostly just to sleep.
Led by attentiveness and a clear understanding of hospitality, I felt that my stay at Aisha’s place was consistent in meeting my expectations and enjoyable to reside during my short stay in Chicago.

Our stay at Stephanie’s apartment in Chicago was fantastic. The apartment was comfortable, spacious, airy, and had everything we needed for an extended stay. The building felt luxurious from the moment we arrived, with a grand entrance that made the experience feel special.
The amenities were excellent. The gym, pool, rooftop area, and running track were all well maintained and became some of our favorite parts of the property.
Stephanie was an amazing host. When we casually mentioned that a full-length mirror would be helpful, she quickly arranged for one to be purchased and delivered, which showed how responsive and thoughtful she is.
The location was also a huge plus, close to downtown Chicago and many attractions. Having a Target just a two-minute walk away was incredibly convenient, and Uber, Lyft, and public transportation were easy to access.
Overall, this was one of our best Airbnb experiences. We loved our stay and would definitely book again. Highly recommended

Pleasantly surprised by how nice this place was. It’s incredibly spacious and the minimal decor makes it feel quite grand. There are loads of good food spots/cafes right on your doorstep and it’s easy to get around the city from the area. Being on the top floor and the rear end of the building the room is surprisingly quiet too, and you get a pretty nice view at night.
The hosts are awesome, super responsive and very helpful. Definitely recommend!
Pretty solid place. Only downside was how hot it got during the day and the bedding wasn’t really meant for a hot environment.
Super great place, with free street parking right in front too. My wife and I got CTA passes and were able to go the whole trip without driving my car once. Very convenient location and great place.

We had a great stay at Elizabeth's place. The apartment was clean, well stocked with plenty of towels and, though we didn't cook while we were there, the kitchen seemed very well-appointed. Having coffee there upon arrival is such a treat!
Our only issue - not with the hosts or the apartment, both were great!- was parking. If you plan to drive, be aware that street parking spots are few and far between.

Lucus is usually excellent, but a customer service representative shared my personal information with a guest, putting my safety at risk.
When I first got there, everyone was friendly, but over time, the customer service worsened, and the kitchen was consistently dirty and disgusting with flying creatures in the pantry and they over booked rooms making it overcrowded. terrible!!!
除了空调太冷！别的都很好！5🌟

Location was amazing, walk out the back and you can see Wrigley. Easy access to the red line. Food options in the area are great. Josh was very communicative. Saw parking issues being mentioned I other reviews but the parking rules were very very clear from the original listing and Josh communicated with us on game days so not sure how anyone had issues with that, other than not bothering to read when booking. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and would absolutely book again if in the area.
It was clean and the amenities were good.

I enjoyed staying in this house. It was perfect for my family and I loved the walkable neighborhood.
What a great spot right in front of the park. Beautiful location. Right in the middle of two great neighborhoods. And the inside of the building is just as great.

Phenomenal stay in a beautiful pocket of Pilsen! Will definitely be staying here again anytime we visit the area. Felt even nicer than the (already good looking) photos made it out to be, and felt very calm and peaceful. Loved being right next to the park, plus within easy walking distance of two train stops and lots of good restaurants (we especially loved Pochos, Novel Pizza, and 5 Rabanitos), all in a very safe feeling area! Hosts were very helpful and proactive. Would recommend to anyone!

I've stayed in a lot of Airbnbs over the years, and this one is by far one of the best. The apartment was super comfortable. The spaces were extremely well designed and thoughtfully curated. You're very close to the L and can hear the trains go by, but it's not a deal-breaker. I would stay here again.

Blessed and grateful for Helen!
Thank you so much!
I love staying at Felice’s. This was my second stay and she’s always a wonderful host. I will absolutely be staying again in the future! Thanks you Felice!

The description is wrong. Saying that the bathroom is spacious is an unnecessary but harmless lie. What was annoying is the malfunctioning amenities such as the microwave and the coffee machine. 100% Recommend , good location in proximity to #8 Halsted Bus and #62 Archer Bus. Extremely satisfied

The place was small but a nice house in a nice neighborhood.  My biggest issue was the lack of communication as I was on my way there I still had no instructions on how to get in. I had to go to the store and buy some to be able to shower.
