Second time staying here for a business trip in the West Loop, and look forward to staying again.

From the friendly welcome to the spacious apartment, the our stay exceeded expectations. The place was beautiful, and we especially liked that each bedroom had its own private bathroom. Highly recommend!

Lovely place for the price and not too far from downtown Chicago! The room had everything I needed and the house was large enough that my bedroom felt very private.
The host is super nice and accommodating. I felt safe in the neighborhood and could come and go as I pleased since each guest has a door code. Highly recommend!!
A+

Kathrine was a wonderful host, and her place exceeded our expectations. The home was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped with helpful amenities that made our stay easy and enjoyable. Kathrine was responsive and welcoming, and everything was exactly as described. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend her place to other travelers.
Ridas place was great. It was spotless a d she was a great host. Would definitely recommend.
Amazing, I wish I could have stayed here my entire trip, but it was booked already. If this place is ever discounted don’t hesitate to get it. Close access to everything and amazing service!
Great for families and business travelers alike, this unit was the perfect location to get around the city easily and have a supportive home base to come back to.
Great as usual. My favorite so far.
Comfortable stay

Words cannot express how grateful I am to have found this Airbnb! Not only was this my first Airbnb stay, but it was also my first solo vacation and first time visiting Chicago. Serg and his team made the booking and check in process easy and incredibly seamless.
The property was EXACTLY as described, phenomenal, spacious, immaculate, and incredibly inviting. I felt so relaxed and at peace throughout my entire stay, which was perfect recovering from surgery. I especially loved the large shower and hot tub. As someone who is tall, the extra space was greatly appreciated!
I also appreciated that Serg checked in during my stay to make sure everything was going well. It showed how much care and pride he and his team put into creating a great guest experience.
The location was excellent, close to the heart of the city while offering great value compared to other listings. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would gladly book with Serg again in the future. Highly recommended 🙌🏻

The black stairs to the unit are steep, angular, narrow, and there is no handrail, could be unsafe if you are not agile, and they are very hard to navigate especially with luggage. A side chair had stained cushion. One of 2 wall sconces was missing a bulb and shade. The bed is memory foam so be prepared for that, not a traditional mattress. Being underground it is dark and cold. The few windows need cleaning to let in more light. There is a dehumidifier but it is blaringly loud and I opted to turn it off. Upstairs neighbors were quiet 2 of 3 nights.
Great place, very clean, good location, great communication from hosts
It was a wonderful stay at Samuel's place. Cozy and comfy apartment perfect for families
Es uno de los mejores alojamientos que he visitado y alojado me parece un lugar muy comodo, tranquilo, y sobretodo limpio.

Really responsive host with a clean, nice location! Very walkable to McCormick place as well! One drawback- the beds are not very comfortable. There was minimal padding and we found them quite difficult to sleep on.  If you are not picky about your mattress,  this place is great!
Mera's space looked just like the photos and is a great walkable neighborhood.   Mera was super responsive and had clear instructions on how to access the home.
I stayed here for 3 days, 2 nights and it was a good place. Convenient, mostly clean, good location. It did get hot I think because the AC unit didn’t reach to the bedroom but I’d stay here again.
Great place to stay! We loved the area and felt safe.
Christina was an awesome host. She responded to all of my communications quickly. Beautiful home. Better than the pictures showed. Will definitely stay there again when we are in town.

Loved staying here! Just to be helpful for future guests, I’ll list some pros and cons below. It was a 5 star place for me but it might not be a good fit for everybody. Any cons are no fault of the host it’s just how the place is.
PROS: very clean space, clean towels and sheets and pillows provided. Host was so accommodating and easy to communicate with. You’d be close to everything downtown, you can walk or take a train/bus everywhere, no need for a car. Also you’re staying in an old historic building which I thought was pretty cool. I love staying at a place that reflects the character of a city.
CONS: you can hear the train frequently as there are tracks practically next to the building. I’m used to living in loud places so it didn’t bother me when I was sleeping but some people might be sensitive to that. Also I am able bodied so this didn’t affect me, but I wouldn’t recommend somebody with a disability stay here as the building has only stairs, no elevator to get upstairs.
Beautiful neighborhood!

Superb location, walkable and safe neighborhood. Close to restaurants, bars and The Salt Shed. Had everything you need for a comfortable stay. Would definitely stay again if in the area for a concert.

My team at work rented out the entire house at Josh's for a team off-site. Given this was for work, it was necessary we had individual bedrooms for everyone, several bathrooms for getting ready in the mornings, and a few separate spaces people could retreat to for work or socialization. The price and set up for this purpose was great; no complaints! A few quirks getting through all of the various door codes, but when we hit a snag on a door code, Josh was responsive immediately via phone and has a quick resolve. Great area with bars, restaurants close by and walkable to Cubs game.
Great location and seemless experience.
Very nice place. Very clean. Very hotel style stay. Quiet neighborhood. The only issue is the thin walls but the stay is excellent..
Estadia rápida com a família
Good place to stay
It was great to stay right around the corner from the venue we had tickets to, and the arcade games were a fun touch for down time while we were waiting for our concert.
House is like brand new. We felt very safe in busy neighborhoods. We appreciate everything Ryan had available for our use.

we loved the place. It was spacious and just feet from Wrigley Field. It had plenty of amenities and was very clean .Our host Amy, was excellent. She was very responsive and great to deal with. They had to switch our location at the last minute and gave a great option.
would highly recommend booking with Amy. 5 stars!

Great Host! Milan was responsive and very helpful for the duration of the stay. We had one issue and needed more towels which were brought to us literally within 10 minutes! Would definitely recommend staying here!
This was a wonderful visit! Henry was a great host and made the whole experience very comforting. Would love to return here in the future! Definitely a top place for sure!
Great apartment! Ensavi was very communicative, check in and check out and easy, and this apartment was in an ideal location for everything I wanted to do in Chicago.
Clean, simple, comfy.

great
This is my second time and I loved my stay at this property. It’s comfortable and clean, looks just like the photos. The  neighborhood is quiet and the people are friendly. Will book again!

Superb!!!!!! Our stay was absolutely wonderful. The pictures were spot on with the features of the apartment, we settled in and immediately walked to the beach which is so close it’s amazing. The convenience of having a major line of the L train just 2 blocks away along with stores and restaurants in walking distance. We rented a car later in the week and it was great to have a parking space once we came back in from a long day out. The furniture was comfortable and the mink blankets topped it off. I did not cook while there but if I did the kitchen had everything needed. I also utilized the Keurig daily for that single cup of coffee. The host was responsive and gave excellent instructions for check-in and check-out. I would definitely recommend this AirBnB and would inquire about staying here again during my next Chicago visit 🤗
Very quiet/private and exactly as depicted.

A spectacular home with a beautiful location. It was everything we hoped and more! Lito &Chip are the ideal hosts. Thank you so much for the wine, coffee and snacks. They were greatly appreciated. We hope to stay with you again next year
Great place in great neighborhood
Mooi centraal gelegen

The stay was good. checkin process could have been better as there was a wrong unit was referred in the initial communications and it was changed later including the floor. There was some noise from thermostat through out the stay. While the service personnel tried to repair it, it was only temporary as the noise came back within few hours.

Had a great stay in Chicago with this place. Very beautiful comforting place the location was prime not too busy easy to find very quiet and safe! Would definitely recommend you check this place out if you’re in the area.

Could this be the perfect AirBnB ? Well, it's a contender. Characterful, historic, in Old Town Chicago, and remarkably clean.
It's a beautiful neighbourhood, plus a short walk to the beach/lake, and easy to get to downtown. It's even possible to train to the airport.
How could it be improved? Only minor things:
Electronic or pin code door (keys are impractical). And the coin operated laundry requires 16 quarters to wash & dry a load... who uses cash anymore?
Mia placut era frumos (:

I came back home to chicago to visit my family this was the perfect location. Easy to get downtown, museums, resturants etc. The easy parking in the back with direct access to the house is amazing safe and simple. This beautiful house was clean as the pictures. Simple amenities such as travel toothpaste and toothbrush were located in each bathroom. The house was stocked with coffee etc. Natural lighting in the house made working at home easy along with the BLAZING fast internet that I really didnt know was included in this listing made conferencing video so easy. Outstanding house. I would look to book here before anywhere else. Thanks for having me.

Really enjoyed this stay a lot. The room is very big you can actually do some at home works outs in. Everything is clean, the room has AC and heating, 2 big windows to let in fresh air, clean bathrooms with cleaning supplies, and huge kitchen. Communication was simple and fast the host is very fast at responding. Definitely the best Airbnb for the price. The Airbnb is also very close to the 290 bus that’ll take you to the train/bus station that’ll have buses and trains to take you into Downtown and Evanston or wherever you need to be. The neighborhood is very safe. I’ll 100% book again for my travels

The apartment was beautifully decorated and filled with thoughtful touches that made our stay feel especially welcoming. We were greeted with gorgeous fresh flowers, including peonies and wildflowers, fresh Mountain Valley spring water, a light assortment of snacks, and Google speakers in both the living area and bathroom.
Charles was incredibly responsive whenever we needed additional supplies and was proactive in his communication throughout our stay. We truly enjoyed our time here, felt right at home, and appreciated the care that had clearly gone into creating such a comfortable experience.
We would absolutely stay here again the next time we visit.

This is a very no frills apartment in a great location. Any more than two people inside the apartment would be extremely tight. It was clean and updated and most suitable for travelers who just need a spot to lay their head at night. Comfort level of the two beds is very basic, and there will be some light noise from the apartment above as other reviewers noted. The bathtub is a tad odd, with a slippery tub that has an overhead shower head directly in the middle of it. The location is in a charming neighborhood and the street was quiet at night. Just be sure to bring literally everything you could plan on using in the apartment- like coffee filters. We used the ParkChirp app to secure $28 parking total for three days in the nearby Webster St garage, felt like the best deal of the trip.  Host was responsive.

The apartment smells like cigarette smoke, which is not in the description. Due to the smell, I wasn’t able to stay in the apartment for even a night. Despite this, getting a refund from the hosts was extremely difficult and ultimately they refused outside of $250(for an over $3k, month-long stay).
Airbnb gave me a $1500 refund themselves so I applaud them for making this semi-right, although I’m still out over $1k and it was a big nuisance.
The apartment is supposed to be non-smoking and I believe the hosts are lying. Based on my messages with them I believe there was a recent incident where a guest must have been smoking in the apartment. Not their fault, but that should have been clearly disclosed. Very disappointed in this experience overall and would strongly consider you choose a different spot especially for a longer stay.

Great location and views.
Very walkable and everything of need is close by.
Hosts were accommodating, easy to reach out to and communicate.
The apartment itself is clean, as described in pictures and descriptions.
I would rebook and recommend to anyone visiting the area and looking for a place to stay.
The apartment is generally very good. It's clean, has a lot of light and is very well located. Some items might need to be updated, but it's no big deal if you are staying for a few days.

Wir hatten einen rundum perfekten Aufenthalt. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön, sauber, gut ausgestattet und es hat uns an nichts gefehlt. Es ist alles neu, modern und sieht aus wie auf den Bildern.
Die Wohnung eignet sich sehr gut für einen Städtetrip nach Chicago. Es befinden sich Bushaltestellen in unmittelbarer Umgebung und die Blue Line (Station Logan Square) ist in etwa 15 Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar. Da die Anbindung mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln somit sehr gut war, stand unser Auto die ganze Zeit in der zur Wohnung gehörenden Garrage.
Wir empfehlen die Wohnung und Theodora gerne weiter. Wenn wir wieder nach Chicago kommen, wird Theodora und ihre tolle Wohnung unsere erste Wahl sein.
Enjoyed my stay at the place. Roommates were great as well.
I thought the place was great. I would have liked to know beforehand that it shares a space with Zumba, as the music could get pretty loud in the morning and evenings.
The apartment had absolutely everything we needed for the month. We immediately felt at home and loved the neighborhood. We joined a gym close by and took walks through Humboldt Park and the 606.
Great stay! Very good communication, and nice clean house!
Great place outstanding location!
Thanks for all your help. It was easy, comfortable and clean!
Had a fantastic stay at Amy's place in Noble Square. Convenient location and close to public transportation. highly recommend as a home base to explore Chicago!

No better place near the university. Clean, cozy, safe and minutes walking to the green line station, bus stops and Grocery Store (Jewel Osco). I was at Ahmeena's place for a month and was glad I found it. The BnB was clean and had all the amenities. Just walking distance from the University Campus. Ahmeena and Nia were always quick to respond to all my queries. I would recommend the place to everyone and would book it again anytime I'm in the area.

Clean space. Responsive host. Everything looked like the pictures. The only issue was the parking. However, I noticed that is a common issue for Chicago. Neighbors upstairs were a bit noisy but not disruptive. Great stay, will be booking again!

Great host, place, location! Close to transportation from airport
Anny was a perfect host in every way. An excellent property to stay after my long flight with many amenities that made me feel like I was at home. Location was very good to get to the loop Chicago and back easily. Check in/out had detailed instructions and went seamlessly.
Thanks so much Anny!🙂

This was the perfect place for my friends to reconnect after a few years.  The outside deck was great for morning coffee and evening wine. The location was perfect for exploring, eating and shopping. The kitchen- well stocked with everything you could need. Thanks to Natalie for offering this great AIRBnB
We loved our stay and didn't want to leave. Perfect place and a great host!

I was skeptical at 1st because I wasn’t sure of the area. They answered all of my questions and checked on us as well. The home was beautiful and had extra amenities. Will definitely book again for every visit to Chicago! Definitely recommend anyone wanting a laid back, peaceful, friendly neighborhood with a nice park nearby for the whole family.

Great place to stay in Lincoln Park. Walkable, clean area. Cute!
As others have said, the door to the building is on an adjacent wall and is very loud when people are coming and going. But it didn’t bother us, just good to know.
Very good

Emily was very responsive. Made the whole process very easy. We needed to store our luggage before noon after an early flight so the housekeeper opened it for us around 10:00 so we could do that. The beds were very cozy and comfortable so we slept so well. Neighborhood is very walkable and quiet. All around great experience! Would highly recommend!

We drove in from Toronto and had a late-night check-in. The hosts were extremely accommodating and responsive to us. Parking was easy enough to find, even late at night, and free! The upstairs bedroom and bathroom were clean and pleasant to be in. We had breakfast on the patio and enjoyed a lovely conversation with our hosts and the other guests. They bring a warm, welcoming energy to every conversation that really complements Chicago's already amazing charm. Highly recommend.

Sonya's place was perfect. It was even better than the photos. A lovely, quiet neighborhood, but a close drive to everything. My family appreciated the coffee and the trundle bed setup. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Nice place, very clean. Definitely recommend.
Ben had a lovely place and was super helpful

This was a cute spot to stay. Jacob’s communication was amazing. Says it takes him about 2 hours to reply and it never took him that long to reply. I was from out of town so I asked for a few places to eat and he was very knowledgeable. Would most definitely stay here again.

Theodora’s place was an excellent spot to relax and private . Theodora provided amenities , a Laundry Room, and many more thoughtful items for a comfortable stay . We enjoyed the stay and would be delighted to stay again .
Really comfy and pleasant stay .
Amazing all around! Great location and the inside feels like a hotel!

A great place to stay when in Chicago! Jeff’s place is close to everything you need, from restaurants to public transportation to music venues. Jeff if highly responsive and a super helpful host. We plan on staying here again when we return.
Perfect location loved everything  about the apartment. I only wish we stayed longer. Thank you for a fantastic stay in your beautiful place we had everything we could  have needed
Super great and clean place. Easy location for food and transit. Nice hosts and good amenities!
This is my fourth time staying here and everytime has been fantastic. Rooms are always very clean and comfortable. Had another great stay, thank you John!

Very nice Chicago walk up apt. Great location for trips to downtown shopping and nightlife. Also convenient for transportation to O’Hare airport. Joseph was very attentive and responded quickly to any concerns. One of the biggest advantages was the ease of parking which is a premium in Chicago. If you’d enjoy the feel of a traditional Chicago neighborhood then this is a great choice.

Was just passing through for work and wanted somewhere close to Wrigley Field to stay, easy walk to the park, lots of food and bars near to have a good time at. The rooms and kitchen are very nice and a balcony to sit at outside

Perfekcyjna lokalizacja w samym centrum, szybki kontakt z gospodarzem i łatwe instrukcje zameldowania. Bardzo polecam apartament większym grupom, szczególnie z dziećmi (łóżka piętrowe). Idealne miejsca na zwiedzanie Chicago!

Tara’s place was convenient for what we needed. Great size and two bathrooms were a plus.
It was a bit dusty and pillows were all flat (no life left).

I enjoyed my recent stay at this flat loads. The host and co hosts were very  polite, personable and helpful when needed. Great convenient location, very good price for the accommodations. Many shops and takeaways to choose from for quick meals. The bedroom was a nice size, bed comfortable. The flat was quite clean too. What I enjoyed the most was how quiet it was the majority of time even with other guests staying. Everyone mostly seemed to be mindful and considerate of each other.  Will definitely book Eladio's place again when it's available and needed. Thank you

Really enjoyed our stay at Lesley's! It's a clean, well-laid-out apartment. Not a ton of cafes and restaurants directly around the apartment, but within a 15-20 minute walk, you'll find a lot of great spots in Logan Square. AC worked well, which was much needed on our trip, and Lesley was super accommodating.

We enjoyed our stay and especially appreciated the safe location, the layout, and the convenience of having a dedicated parking space. The property provided a comfortable base for exploring the area, and having parking included (for an additional fee) was helpful.
For future guests, I think this property is best suited for travelers who value space, location, and practicality over modern finishes. If you’re planning to be out and about for much of your trip and need a convenient place to return to at the end of the day, this is a good option.
The unit shows some signs of wear and could benefit from a few updates. The kitchen is functional, though guests who enjoy cooking meals may find it somewhat limited. We also found the sofa bed less comfortable than expected, so groups planning to use every sleeping space may want to keep that in mind.
Highly recommend this place.
Got the unit at a short notice. The space was very nice and clean.
Amazing studio apartment fight in Fulton market, easy access from the street and a quick walk to the L, a perfect getaway location for a weekend in Chicago!!

I spent 2 nights at Jhon’s place with my daughter. The description is very accurate, we found all the equipment and amenities needed and the location is very convenient. We definitely recommend this place.
I loved that it had dedicated parking. Took out lots of stress trying to find parking.

My family and I had a wonderful stay. The beds were extremely comfortable and everything was amazingly clean. The only thing I felt slightly lacking was cooking equipment, otherwise the space had everything we needed for a 3 night getaway. Our questions were always  answered promptly. Would definitely love to stay here again next time we come to Chicago!

My mom and I came to visit for a few days, and George's place was a great home base for us during our trip. The accommodation is conveniently on the blue line, making it easy to arrive to from the airport, and then to continue on to make it downtown in under half hour. The apartment was clean, beds were comfortable, and George was very responsive throughout the check-in process and during our stay, and promptly provided some extra soap and silverware that was running low. We would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed staying at Hanna and Mark’s apartment! It was spacious and impeccably clean. Hanna and Mark reached out multiple times to ensure we were enjoying our stay and provided very clear instructions when needed. They helped accommodate our toddler by providing a high chair and crib. While the immediate block in front of the building is industrial, it only takes a few minutes’ walk before you’re on beautiful tree-lined streets. It was wonderful to rediscover Bucktown with my family, thank you!

It was a perfect start to our first trip to Chicago and to get comfortable navigating using the public transit systems. Close to or easy access to everything really! Small quaint apartment that had everything we needed. Host was very responsive and accommodating. Would surely come back again, perfect for two first timers 😎 thank you, I can't wait to visit Chicago again ❤️

We had a wonderful stay! The location is truly unbeatable, the neighborhood is charming, and everything you need is within walking distance. The Bloomingdale Trail Park was a block away and is a lovely way to get around the neighborhood. The space itself was perfect for our family: plenty of room for everyone to spread out and to play cards or watch a movie in the basement. Would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, well-located home base.
Great stay and great hosts!
Very responsive! Friendly and good communication. Amazing space, clean and we had no issues while staying here. Very nice location, lots to do in the area. We had a good time. Thank you!

This is a fantastic location so close to Museum Campus and other attractions. Very safe walking even at night. Amazing quaint restaurants nearby; multiple ethnically for great food tasting. Grocery store across the street. The desk staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Beautiful apartment, quiet,  comfortable, and everything you could possibly need to make you feel at home.  Bus service so close just out the front door.  This is a great location to make a visit to Chicago special.
Wonderful place, very clean and neat. Convenient location and David was a great host.

I needed a place to stay for a 4 week long internship in Chicago and Alewyfe Farm Urban Garden Oasis had everything I was looking for! The hosts were so great and greeted us upon arrival for a tour. There was homemade pear wine and farm fresh eggs from the chickens in the fridge which was such a nice surprise. They gave us time to settle in and let us know to message them if we ever needed anything. There were only a couple times that I reached out, but the hosts responded quickly and were very helpful. For the most part I kept to myself, focusing on my internship, but when we did see each other the hosts were very nice. The house had all of the amenities I needed. It was very easy to cook and there was a grocery store/laundromat within walking distance. Access to the pink line was only a 6 minute walk away and there were buses that ran right in front of the house. There was also a great park across the street that I walked around pretty

Great location - walkable to many trendy spots and public transportation.
Apartment was clean and nicely stocked with amenities in the kitchen.

This is hands down the best places we’ve stayed through AirBnB. Everything was so thoughtfully planned by the hosts and the location was phenomenal! We have only positive things to say about this location.

This is a great location if you want access to most of why you visit Chicago.  Lakeside Dr is close to commute to museums and Willis tower, etc.   It’s a quick 10-15 min walk to wrigley and you have a dedicated parking spot which is worth a morning this area.
Lovely apartment and very helpful hosts. Would definitely come back!

Great location, awesome host and communication, would definitely stay here again!
Worth noting the parking garage right next door didn’t allow my large SUV to park in it by the one just on the next block (Delaware Pl) did for just $20/day
Wish I could’ve stayed longer

Lourdes was very accommodating. The staircase was steep and we have a toddler so we requested a baby gate after the first night. Lourdes responded quickly and was able to get us a baby gate the next day.

This apartment was so comfortable, clean, aesthetically pleasing, and thoughtfully appointed. Tori was very friendly and helpful. My husband and I were traveling with our 10-year-old son and two large dogs. The backyard was great for the dogs, there was a nice dog park about a 10 minute walk away and many restaurants had dog-friendly patios. It was close enough to get to most things downtown with a 20-30 minute car ride through quaint neighborhood streets while offering a peaceful retreat from the city. The street was very quiet and we felt safe.

We had a high school mission trip in Chicago with 11 kids. This place was fantastic with everyone having a bed and there being 4 bathrooms. There was a lot of space to spread out here! We had a couple of questions during our stay and the host responded very quickly with helpful information. The bus stop wasn't far from this place so it made commuting easy. I would recommend a stay here especially for large groups!

Fantastic location with fast access to Wrigley Field, Red line to downtown and a lot more.
We would stay there again!
It's always a pleasure to stay at Daniel's and we look forward to returning. Thanks!

Charles’s place is an excellent option for those looking to visit Chicago with family. It’s near enough to enable daily back and forth from the city, yet far enough to avoid the traffic nuisance and hustle bustle. The parking can be a little tricky and you really need to look at signs (especially on long stays) to avoid sweeping/sanitation citation.
Affordable place. Dirty bathroom. Smelly kitchen. Weak acoustic insulation; we could hear almost everything from our room neighbors.

We had a very pleasant stay, absolutely would stay here again. The rooftop patio was great, and there were several good restaurants nearby. The host’s directions were very clear and they were very responsive.
Great location and responsive host.

I had a great stay at Susan’s place! It looked exactly like the pictures and met all of my needs. Susan was a very responsive and attentive host, which made the experience even better. I travel to Chicago frequently for work, and I will definitely be rebooking this property again and again. Highly recommended!
Very nice place, clean , and close to the main places we wanted to visit! Katty was an amazing host, thank you!
Thomas was one of the best hosts I have had. perfect level of communication when needed. I felt able to fully relax. The snacks and Nespresso were a very nice touch.
I love the space.
great place, very clean, nice neighborhood with a lot of cafes and restaurants nearby.

Good place to stay for a couple visiting the city. Decent neighborhood, close to anything you may need. Except for sleeping, we spent most of the time out of the unit.
Not a reflection of the host or the unit, but the street parking like anywhere in Chicago can be a challenge, especially between 6am-5pm. There’s a daycare on the street and lots of drop off/pick ups. If you park in front of the daycare at night, you have to move your vehicle before 6am.
Thank you for having us, first time in Chicago !! The location was very convenient to public transportation and very helpful with recommendations.
This was the first time I stayed in an Airbnb in Chicago. I wasn’t used to the thin floors and walls. Street traffic and people up all hours in the middle of the week. Earplugs were provided.
Myrtle est a l'écoute est disponnible pour aider. Merci beaucoup à elle !

The apartment is comfortable with good comfy beds. However very noisy since the train runs just next to the building.
The big tall windows looks great! However they should be cover with black out curtains in the bedrooms, since you wake up at 5:30 am with the light on your face.
The kitchen has 2 stools very nice, but we were 4, so we had to take turns to seat down.
In summary, there is room for improvement and Cyndi is a great host and I’m sure she will take some effort to make her place a best option in Chicago.

Amazing place. The view you get of downtown Chicago is worth renting this place!  Wonderful location and very walkable. Host was very friendly and responsive to any needs or concerns. Will definitely stay here again!
We loved the place! The host Azam was very friendly and responsive! Would recommend if you’re in the area!
Great location and very comfortable place to stay.
We had a great stay here. Everything was exactly as pictured and the host was responsive to questions.

Excellente localisation (proximité du centre-ville, transports en commun (bus) pratiquement devant la porte, proche du museum campus), hôte réactif.
Nous reviendrons dans cet appartement lorsque nous serons à nouveau de passage à Chicago.

Ian’s place was just as described! We couldn’t have been happier with our stay! Cozy apt. Clean. Comfortable. Had all amenities we needed for our stay. The dedicated workspace was perfect! Private area, fast WiFi, a great workspace.
Loved the location! Quiet walkable neighborhood. We will definitely stay again next time we are in town visiting our daughter!
Highly recommend!
A great stay!
Loved this B&B. We will definitely book again next time we go to Chicago.

Everything about the stay was great and I had no complaints. The apartment was just as described and very comfortable. As is typical for Chicago, parking can be a little hit-or-miss depending on the time of day, but that’s to be expected in the city. Overall, a great experience.
The place is spacious and in the perfect downtown spot where you have access to everything. The beds were comfy and it was clean as can be! Will definitely stay again next visit to Chi!

The apartment is conveniently located, but can be a bit noisy at night. One bedroom does not have windows. I wouldn’t call it a bedroom because of that even though it is large. This apartment takes great photos but doesn’t quite match up to it in reality. It is big though. There is no Central AC, just several standalone floor AC units and window units.
Great stay for our family of 5 wanting to enjoy a peaceful stay in Chicago. Conveniently located to the stadium for a quick walk to games and food.  Would recommend this place 10/10.

This place was perfect for our family of five: amazing location, extremely spacious and clean, wonderful kitchen perfectly equipped for a nice family breakfast, very comfortable beds, quiet neighborhood but in the thick of it all… Nicole and Matt’s instructions were very clear, and their communication before and during our stay was very warm and responsive. When we come back to Chicago, this is the first place we’ll look for. Highly recommended.
The place was comfortable unique and Candace was helpful and delightful

Amazing, will be staying there again.
The dogs loved the house, lots of room for them to move around.

Perfect stay for both business and leisure! The location is ideal—within easy walking distance to both the University and Medical Center. Booking the top-floor "Green Room" gives you total privacy with the entire upper level to yourself. We loved having a dedicated sitting area, dining spot, and a kitchenette setup (fridge, microwave, and coffee maker). Bonus tip: definitely make time for Caryl's breakfast. It’s fresh, super tasty, and the perfect way to start the day!
Good price for an excellent location and a very comfortable place. It is a studio, ideal for one or a couple. All was clean, and host was very responsive.
I loved the place and it was conveniently next to a bus stop. Very spacious and cozy.

If you’re looking for a reasonably priced place to lay your head down if you know you will out most of the day this is perfect. Although the pics were a little inaccurate the place is great for that type of stay. If you’re looking for more luxury and a skyline view this is not the place for you. Milan was great and very responsive and checked in every day. The location was great and I like that they had a place for parking and the fee was reasonable.  All in all I rate it 3.5 stars.
was a little difficult to find but once there, we had a great stay. the apartment was very clean and is great for a couple
Great place, lots of good places to walk to nearby, communication was very good.

Claudia’s place was very relaxing and enjoyable for me and my partner. Stephanie was great and available to help us if we needed any other information or general support.
The building is well equipped and everyone working there were friendly and helpful.
It was a pleasure to be there during my business trip in Chicago.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had a wonderful stay at this quaint Airbnb! The space was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed for a comfortable visit. One of the best features was its convenient location near the stadium, making it incredibly easy to get to and from events without dealing with long drives or parking hassles

Excellent place to stay with a large group of friends for our first time visiting Chicago. It was also nice to have two separate spaces either the duplex. The house is located in a charming neighborhood only 8 minutes away from a train stop with cute cafes/restaurants/breweries within walking distance.
Josh was a very responsive and accommodating host. When we couldn’t find an extra bath mat for one of the bathrooms he also ordered and shipped one overnight to the place which was very nice! Thanks Josh!
the stay was great,  conveniently located and responsive host.   Would stay again
Perfect place to unwind and very near to many restaurants. Would definitely try to visit again!

very nice place to stay
the neighborhood was very nice and had alot of things to do close by
The apartment was cute and met our needs while in Chicago, very convenient to public transportation and being able to park the car and not drive in Chicago a plus!!
We enjoyed our stay . We liked that it was close to public transportation!

The building is older, elevators were period original brass panels. Mind the signage the elevators are delicate due to age.
The apartment is small, but adequate, original steam heating system. Fortunately the weather was stellar, I even slept with the window adjusted.
All around a lovely experience.
Excellent stay, Gerry was very helpful. Great location too.
Great spot on a gorgeous street. I was very close to lots of restaurants and coffee shops which was nice.

The surrounding area was great, it felt safe and was very walkable but I was very dissatisfied with the apartment itself. The shower water pressure was extremely low and one morning the water of the entire apartment was completely shut off. Shay was responsive about the issue but it delayed our day about 3 hours because we had to wait for maintenance to come fix the issue. There were also no forks with the silverware and only two small bathroom sized trash cans in the apartment.
Excellent location

This lake front apartment was a perfect spot to be connected to both the city and the beauty of Lake Michigan. Clean, well appointed and close to public transportation. Easy parking with reserved spot and easy check in and check out. We had and great time.

We had a great stay at Melissa's! The space is a perfect size for two people, clean and cozy, and an easy walk to public transit to get downtown. Loved being in a quiet, safe  neighborhood away from the busier areas but still convenient to everything. Would recommend!
The stay was very good and much recommended.
Corporate stay and it was excellent! Easy access to the convention center.

Great stay!!!
This unit is so inviting, clean and warm.
The coffee is good, the beds are cozy. 5-15 minute walk to convention center and surrounding restaurants.
Thank you for being an awesome host.
Beautiful, clean, comfortable, and well located. It is a bit noisy, but we turned on a fan at night and had no issues sleeping. West Loop is very convenient and has lots of great restaurants.

I stayed at Nardo’s place while attending a conference at McCormick place. I could easily travel back and forth as the bus stop was a short 3 minute walk from the house and the bus ride was 10 minutes. The apartment was clean, cozy, comfortable  and functional, having everything we needed to feel right at home. Nardo is a wonderful host. He was extremely helpful as this was our first time in Chicago. He gave us excellent recommendations on things to do and ways to get around the city. We felt safe, comfortable and right at home. Thank you Nardo for a wonderful stay. We’ll definitely be back the next time we’re in town!

An amazing studio in a wonderful part of downtown Chicago! The view is absolutely beautiful! There were so many delicious restaurants and shops within walking distance.
The studio was super clean upon arrival and we felt right at home. John was super responsive and a huge help as we prepared for our arrival. Would definitely recommend staying at his AirBNBs!

I stayed at Fabiana's place for a week and a half to visit some friends in the neighborhood. Her place is cozy and convenient, as it's easily walkable to the El and major bus lines, grocery stores, and restaurants. I really appreciated having access to laundry because of the length of the trip, too! Strongly recommended if you're looking for a place with full kitchen and a washer/dryer.
Great unit in a fantastic location. Everything was as described in the listing and we enjoyed our stay.

PERFECT for our Chicago Girls’ Trip! There were 4 moms and 5 daughters and we had ample room for gathering/eating/lounging and sleeping. Beautiful and clean apartment with cool architectural details and nicely decorated. Beds comfortable and bathrooms lovely. Well-stocked kitchen (we cooked twice). Street parking easy. Felt perfectly safe walking to/from car late at night.
THANKS FOR HAVING US!

Our family of 5 loved our stay! Matt & Brad are so welcoming and made our entire stay seamless and enjoyable! Loved the historic charm mixed with updated finishes & walkability to cafés, coffee shops etc. Location is a perfect 15-20 minute drive down Lake Shore Dr to shopping and Museums. Highly recommend!
Great place, super responsive host

This is a cozy property in a very walkable area in the medical district. I was able to walk everywhere during my Chicago visit.
The property is sparkling clean, and clean smelled great. and I really love the small touches like providing Starbucks coffee pods with condiments and water in the refrigerator. these little touches mean a lot for a traveler. Very well priced for such a beautiful, walkable location in a cozy quiet neighborhood.
Joanna was a responsive friendly and helpful host. I give her 5 stars and would definitely stay in her property again and look forward to in the future.

This was a great apartment for the discounted price I scored with a last-minute booking! Large, clean, and a number of added touches such as a cool LED lighted wall in the living room and gentle laundry detergent packets for washing clothes. Note: there are 2 flights of stairs to the apartment. Also, parking is off-street but not gated but my motorcycle was safe there during my 2-night stay there. Shakerah was super friendly, helpful, and always quick to reply. I would definitely book a stay with her again!
Tip: if you love coffee, check out Muse Coffee Studio just down the street. ☕️
Great place, nice part of town.  5 minutes  walk to L to get to downtown. No noise issues or anything like that. Not a lot light, but its a half basement, so expected. Would stay again.

Really convenient location, with great space! Easy check-in and check-out. Others noted the train tracks - they are quite loud into the night, and if you're a light sleeper or can't tolerate the train noise this probably isn't a fit for you. The hosts did provide a noise machine that made the train less noticeable, and I regularly sleep with earplugs so it wasn't a major issue for me.
Just as photographed! Amazing location! Host was incredibly responsive, thank you so much for a great stay!

Excellent location, well connected with metro, shopping avenue, cafés and supermarkets.
The area goes quiet after 8pm.
Place itself was good, especially for solo travellers.
I had a great stay with Marcos and Ed. They were super welcoming and many great discussions were had. The bed was very comfortable too. Overall, this was a great base for my first visit to Chi-town.
Very clean spacious apartment. It was well appointed and had everything you need.

My husband and I traveled from Ohio for my surgery and this Air bnb was so perfect it was so clean and the host were so incredibly nice. We definitely plan on coming back to Chicago with our kids in the future and we will definitely be rebooking in the future.

Tariq was great as a responsive host. The place was clean. Best shower water pressure ever. The floors were squeaky because it’s an old building. Fantastic location for shops and nightlife. I’d stay again.

We came for a family wedding and this turned out to be a great location with plenty of room for folks to drop by. This may be the best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. Beautiful space. Great beds. Well appointed kitchen. We had a perfect trip.

Fantastic Airbnb! We love this place, the location is so lovely, great neighbourhood and felt very safe. It was very clean, spacious and well-stocked. It’s a 5 min walk to the closest metro station to get into the city centre. Lots of shops, coffee shops and restaurants nearby. Would highly recommend!
place was great, location was great and really good for dogs. worth the stay

The property was well stocked to accommodate our multiple week stay. Check-in was easy, we loved having the off-street parking. The location was excellent with great access to the beach, Lakefront Trail, busses and trains, multiple restaurants and bars, and the Hollywood Deli on the corner came in super handy for forgotten groceries. The hosts were responsive and helpful. The neighbors in the building were quiet and friendly. It was very nice having the onsite laundry. Curtains in the bedroom could be upgraded to keep the room darker in the morning and the airflow to the bedroom could be improved as traffic at certain times of the day discouraged opening the windows, but neither caused major issues for us. Overall, a great stay.

Positives:  Communicative, helpful host, spotless apartment, excellent amenities in the kitchen, well stocked, convenient location, easy check out directions, and parking was easier than expected. Negatives: There was indeed the musty odor some reviews mention- got used to it a few after getting settled each evening but not great. The internet connection stopped working the last day. We did not contact the host because we were out and about and a lot, didn’t really need it, and then forgot… maybe just a fluke. Finally, others commented on the beds’ comfort so this may be an “us” issue, but we found the master bed to be extremely uncontrollable- beyond firm and stuff. Some may prefer this but for us sleeping was a challenge. Overall the positives outweighed the negatives and we had a decent stay.
Great location. We felt very safe with two children and it was a convenient location with a dedicated parking space.
Perfect location.  Very clean, nice place.
The place was cute and the location was very walkable. Didn’t have any body wash and not enough towels, and the host took awhile to respond.

Milan's lofts near McCormick Place are the best possible place to stay when you have a trade show. Walk-able to McCormick or a quick ride into downtown. The space itself is great and the kitchen has great amenities. A quick Instacart order and you don't have to eat every meal out during a long work trip. Milan is responsive and offers great service. We've stayed in this specific listing two years now and will always choose one from this building anytime we're in Chicago.

El departamento es muy lindo, muy bien equipado y estético. El barrio es excepcional, hermosas casas y muy cómodo para recorrer. Todo estaba limpio y pensado para brindar comididad. Very walkable in a convenient location. We enjoyed our stay.

Kim was a fantastic host, communicative and easy to work with from check-in to check-out. The space was exactly as described: simple, clean, and stocked with everything you need for a short stay. The kitchen had enough to actually cook a meal if you wanted to.

And if you haven’t been to Mr. B’s Jamaican restaurant nearby, stop what you’re doing and go. Easily one of the best meals I had in Chicago. You do not need to trek downtown to eat well.
Would recommend this listing without hesitation.
Another great stay. Looking forward to staying again in the future.

Very basic studio in a moderate building.
Laundry facilities big big bonus
Wonderful location in North Chicago with transit access lake near by lots of restaurants
Nice Airbnb — was as described; clean; would book again.

We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend Latasha’s home, which was very cozy, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared. The host paid attention to every detail—from the fully equipped kitchen to the bathroom amenities. Everything we could possibly need was available.

The property is conveniently located not far from downtown, yet far enough away to avoid the noise and crowds. We mainly used Uber, which worked perfectly and made getting around very easy.

Khadijah was a great host! The apartment was lovely and it felt like I was at home. It was very clean. As a tall girl (5’10) I was still able to walk around comfortably. Super apartment! Beautiful, spacious, modern, clean. Super comfortable bed. Super easy check in, neighbourhood is lovely. Metro station right outside. Would definitely stay here again - communication was great too. 10/10
Nice, well-kept place in Roscoe Village with lots to do nearby. Scott and Mindy were great hosts.

I enjoyed my stay at Yara’s property. Location was walkable to various forms of public transportation, restaurants and stores. I felt safe and comfortable. Everything was clean and spacious. I highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our month long stay in Matthew's place! Thanks for the great stay Kristin! Our family was grateful for comfy beds, relaxing shower after walking all day, and coffee every morning before we ventured out the door. Parking was safe and easy too.

Silas was a wonderful host, kind, helpful and friendly. He is a great communicator giving clear check-in/checkout instructions, prompt responding when I reached out. It is walkable with access to many restaurants, a library, grocery, cute shops and a variety of activities. Silas even left a few snacks and bottles of water which was a nice touch.

This was our second stay at Todd and Tripp’s place and they didn’t disappoint. They are both so friendly and welcoming, great hosts. The basement apartment is clean, nicely decorated and comfortable. Great location and view of the lake!

Definitely shall recommend for those who want to cover Chicago attractions in a short span.

I had a great stay! Marc’s place is walking distance to everything. He gave me great coffee and restaurant recommendations. The space itself was spotless and had everything I needed. I would highly recommend it and hope to stay again.
This place is convenient to U Chicago. I enjoyed my stay.

The host is great! Provide detailed check in instructions makes everything simple and easy! Secure garage parking is a plus! Quick response and solve all requests efficiently. Everything just look like the photos, new apartment! We had a great stay and highly recommend to others!
Thank you Milan!

Aaron was a great, responsive host and we enjoyed our stay here. Super spacious, comfortable, with all the amenities we could need, convenient location to use the train. Would 100% stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay in Andersonville. A priority for me is cleanliness and this property did not disappoint. It was very clean. The beds were comfortable. There was plenty of hot water for showers. The place was in a very nice neighborhood. Public transportation was nearby straight to the loop and with one stopover to the airports.

Excellent location. Can walk to Lincoln park and many restaurants. Easy to get a ride out to anywhere too.

I had a pleasant stay. The location is excellent, with easy access to public transportation. It has everything you need for a comfortable stay for a few days.
The only area for improvement is cleanliness and the availability of toilet paper. During my stay, the toilet paper roll was not new and was already running low.
Other than that, everything else was excellent.

Kyle and Aleks’s place is gorgeous! Beautifully decorated, clearly by people who care about their space. Bathroom was beautiful! Unfortunately finding parking was really challenging, we spent at least 10-15 mins every evening trying to find a parking spot. It was one of our best stay for business trip. The house is amazing, we are a group for conference in Chicago and it was just perfect, each of us can have a room and we can have a large space for living. Amit was great and super kind! We will definitely can back again!

Wonderful, clean room and house

Great location and Suite Home was very responsive when needed.

The hosts were incredibly communicative and responsive. The home was clean and comfortable. The kitchen was exceptionally well stocked, lots of thoughtful snacks. Super convenient for getting into the downtown area and avoiding super expensive parking fees. Plus, it's situated in a very quiet, and seemingly safe neighborhood. Highly recommend!"

I loved my stay at the Carter Blue! I wanted to do a quick staycation for the weekend and this was the perfect place for just that. It was cozy and felt just like home. The place was spotless and decorated really nice. Robin was also very quick to respond when I had any questions which made me comfortable booking. She was even accommodating enough to provide a discounted rate. Overall, my stay was wonderful and I had the most relaxing time. I will definitely be booking again. Thanks Robin!
Samuel was a wonderful host. Very responsive and flexible allowing us early check in. The place was very luxurious, cute and comfortable. Highly recommend!
Thank you. we had a wonderful stay. it's a great place in a great location

Overall superb stay, highly, highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Very pleasant room on a quiet street with great location near the lakeside trail. Checkin was very easy, and the room was quite clean and comfortable. Shared kitchen facilities were immaculate, and i never even saw anyone else there.  I would be happy to return.
Very nice space and clean. Mosmi was very communicative and responded quickly to all my inquiries
Second time at this condo. A great location and perfect for fit for us.

My partner and I had a great stay at Cindy’s place for a quick trip to Chicago! Cindy was very responsive and provided clear instructions, and the place was very clean and comfortable in a great location.
Lugar adecuado para vacaciones cortas o estadias largas, relativamente cerca del tren, restaurantes cercas, la habitación limpia y con todo lo necesario, todo funcional. La zona es bonita y limpia.
Very tidy space in a great location,

We had a great time in Chicago! Erika’s apartment was perfect for our little family, within walking distance of a lot of things, and the garage was so convenient.
Very nice and clean place to stay.  Spacious and convenient location.  I enjoyed my stay. Thank you
We loved our stay!!! She was so friendly and checked in on us to make sure we didn’t need anything. The views were great! Would stay again.

Great place, close to Wells Ave and lots to do.  Lakefront is about a mile away which is great also.  Robert was a great host and helped us with anything we needed with a super quick response time.  Place is on the second floor with some steeper stairs if you are older fyi.  All in all a great stay was had by all :)
Great place and location. Host was very responsive and gave easy instructions to get into property

This apartment was beautiful and light. I love the sunshine in the morning. We walked to different restaurants and stores in the area. Parking was a little difficult in the evening. We love the space and cleanliness of the apartment

My stay here was great. I came in town for a concert which was 15 minutes away with using uber. I stayed a couple extra days to explore the city which was nice. I would recommend this place if you’re looking for a quick solo trip to explore the city of Chicago.
Comfortable stay, convenient location, excellent host…we will definitely book again when we return to the area.

This was the perfect place for our family to stay while visiting with our Daughter who lives a block away!  We love this are, walking for coffee each morning and all the dining options. Great spot in a quiet neighbourhood. Easily accessible via public transit.

Great location.  Walkable to many attractions and restaurants.  Enjoyed our stay!
