The property is very clean and clear of clutter, kitchen is stocked with the basics to cook some meals.  You won’t want to leave the property because the view is that great!  The gym is huge, full of every weight and exercise machine you can imagine.  Both indoor and outdoor pool, BBQ grills, private areas for working, and visiting.  The property is easily accessible 24/7 with a remote key to enter/exit and the staff is very nice!
Apartamento espaçoso e estiloso, conforme as fotos. Recomendo!

The space looked like the photos, it was clean, comfortable, and I felt safe. Juan was friendly and helpful, he was very responsive. The apartment was great, it is located in the basement of a building so if you don’t mind that I’d recommend it.
Nice stay! Place was 30 minutes from Downtown, train station was about 5 minutes walking. Everything was awesome. 100 recommend
Great communication!
Facilidad de entrada y salida. Muchas gracias
We stayed for the ASCO conference. Very convenient location
Nicole js amazing, one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had. Felt like home. And location is very convenient, metro nearby, trader’s Joe nearby. Nothing to complain. Enjoy my one month stays.

We spent four nights in the unit. Check-in was easy and clear instructions were provided on how to gain access. This space is above a restaurant and access to the unit is from the back of the building outside. Not an issue just unusual. We really only spent time sleeping in the unit but it was comfortable for sleeping, showering, etc. We didn’t have time to take advantage of the pool table and foosball tables but they seemed to be in good condition. A nice touch was the ear plugs the host provided. Not excessive but trains go by regularly and  the ear plugs ensured you didn’t hear them. Communications from the host was regular and they checked in on us regularly to ensure our satisfaction. We appreciated that. The only demographic who this would not be good for is the elderly or older adults with any health issues due to the stairs to get to the unit are long and steep. We will stay here again next year if available.
Great affordable place to stay within walking distance of the convention center. Host was very responsive.

I had a great stay at La Vecindad. The home was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. Communication from the hosts was excellent throughout my stay, and they were incredibly helpful and accommodating when I needed to extend my reservation and transition to another room.
The check-in process was easy, the house was comfortable, and the hosts went above and beyond to make sure everything went smoothly. I would definitely recommend staying here and would be happy to stay again in the future.
Great place! Very close to the subway, safe place, quiet, felt like home :) we just saw a couple of ants walking around but wasn’t really an issue, very comfy
Great host and great place to stay. Would recommend.
Brandon非常友好，房子很干净，周围很安静安全，是独立屋地下带窗户的房间，白天在会展开会晚上回来睡觉没什么问题，交通也很方便，uber或bus直达McCormick Center。建议提供饮用水。
Ďakujeme za ubytovanie, veľmi príjemná hostiteľka, pekné a čisté ubytovanie. Akurát jedine v starej budove, ktorá má už niečo za sebou. Okolie čisté a upravené len usadené v prevažne v gay komunite.
El lugar es agradable. Abacus siempre estuvo atento y resolvía nuestras preguntas muy rápido. Fácil acceso y bien conectada con la ciudad.

After moving from another city to begin a new chapter in my life, I chose to stay at Red Robin Rentals. They were quite accommodating regarding my long-term stay, although there were occasional cleanliness issues that marred my experience. Overall, my time here has had its ups and downs. Lucas, the property manager, was incredibly attentive to my concerns; he was truly exceptional and very professional. His flexibility made a significant difference. Upon my arrival, he greeted me warmly, and his support has made this experience worthwhile. I hope more people like Lucas are hired, and he deserves a raise. Thank you for hosting me for such an extended period.
Netter Empfang. Zimmer sauber und einfach. Grosse Küche, zwei sympathische Kater. Gerne wieder. Vielen Dank, Heidi!
Great Place to stay while visiting Chicago! So nice and gave great ideas of things to do in the city. Close to a metra station which made it easier to get around :) Felt super safe!

I had to visit Chicago for a couple of days and Jenny’s Airbnb was perfect. The location was quiet with lots of good food. It was near the train that could easily access the city center.
The only thing I didn’t account for was the weather; it was still pretty chilly in the apartment despite being late May when I visited. There is a small space heater, but otherwise, plenty of blankets to stay cozy around the apartment.
Great place, very convenient and close to McCormick location.
Ignacio was super responsive.  Place was very clean and comfortable.  Would recommend!
Great walkable location. Would 100% recommend.

Rosa’s
Place was perfect for visiting our son who lives in the neighborhood.
Sue
Great location and felt safe at night. Close to a train station and buses all around. Toby was very quick to reply on anything. I would highly recommend this place.
The place was perfect for the location we needed. Walking distance to a lot of really good restaurants. Very satisfied and will definitely stay again. Host was amazing.

For a variety of circumstances, I made this reservation late in the day. Freddy was very accommodating and was able to confirm my reservation without hassle. The airbnb was clean and comfortable and a pleasure to stay in. I really couldnt ask for more, especially for the price.
Absolutely wonderful stay at Amy’s and Joe’s cozy apartment in Pilsen neighborhood. Such a gem and wonderfully appointed! Will definitely return!

Stayed here for couple nights. Room was cozy and had the place to myself since the co-host was out for the weekend. Check in was fairly straightforward, host met me and gave extra keys. Great location but main reason for booking was the “parking on premises”. Turned out that’s it’s only street parking which was easy to find but would have preferred the option of private parking as the listing states. Ran into a problem of not having any towels for the first night, and although there was a sign stating that extra towels are available in the bathroom, none were found. Messaged the host on first day, followed up before bedtime - no response, made due the next morning with small towel I brought with, and followed up again but didn’t hear back tillage afternoon on day 2.
Great find in the heart of Pilsen area. walking distance to transportation of many types. Fun restaurants near by. great kitchen and living space. Host goes the extra mile. Sweet, relaxing backyard.
Good

A lovely apartment that felt more like a friend's home than a rental. Beautifully decorated, more amenties than any other place we have stayed. Comfortable bed, plenty of towels and so many little touched that made our stay very enjoyable. The neighborhood was quiet and extremely clean. Parking was plentiful and easily found by Lyft/Uber drivers. Gogo was so wonderful and helpful. We would love to stay there again next time in Chicago!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the check-in process easy. The location was convenient and quiet, which made it easy to relax and enjoy the trip. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

A very cosy and clean place with a super comfortable couch that does not smell like a thousand buttholes. It’s in a cute neighborhood close to the lake, and you can walk to other cute neighborhoods easily, too. We had a lovely time. The only caveat is that it’s on a very busy road so you will hear the traffic and it’s pretty loud. Otherwise, the perfect spot if you don’t want to stay in the loop.
We had a wonderful experience staying at this unit! Great location, price and host was excellent. Very responsive and friendly.

Wonderful cozy & very artsy apartment! We enjoyed our stay immensely and appreciated the snack basket and wine bottle left for us so much as well! Would recommend to anyone looking for a nice and private stay in such a busy city and will absolutely book again if we find ourselves back to Chicago.

We are also hosts on Airbnb. In fact, we are super host. I was fairly disappointed when I walked in. There was Drywall falling off the ceiling dirt bugs on the windowsill ledge Christmas decorations up in May.
Location was great and the apartment was very comfortable.  The parking spot and view from the balcony were fantastic.  Great place.

Micha’s airbnb suited our needs perfectly!
Beautiful location within walking distance to coffee shops/ restaurants and to a bus stop when needed. Very comfortable, very clean and nicely furnished, we felt right at home.
Great large-sized bathroom with an amazing shower! Would stay again without hesitation.

My stay at Susan listing was okay/amazing upon booking I was under the impression that it was a “apartment” but once arrived I quickly noticed it was a renovated basement with two direct doors connecting to the upstairs unit (picture online) There was also no direct thermostat for the unit. When in need of air or heat Susan had to be contacted. The wall was extremely thin and I could hear everything going on in the upstairs unit including water flow. The fire alarm when off 3 times during my stay. Eventually she sent down an individual to completely take down ALL smoke detectors. Due to it being extremely cold we utilized the heaters which cause a fuse to blow and everything in the fridge defrosted over night.
Besides those concerns on the renovation the unit was clean and durable but in my opinion falsely post on Air Bnb as an “apartment. The location was indeed close to the city but located next to a degraded unit.

Katty’s listing was exactly as described. Great views of downtown Chicago and very close to the city. I had brought my bike with me and it was a short distance to the riverfront trail. The room was very clean and Katty was very friendly in her communication. I will definitely book the trip place again.

Clean and modern, with beautiful light and a peaceful courtyard. Close to restaurants, groceries, parks, the lake, and evening activities. Responsive and friendly hosts. Thermostat keeps the temperature even. A desk in the loft is convenient for working. Bring an eye mask if you need total darkness to sleep after the sun rises, but it's a happy tradeoff to the sunlight during the day. Highly recommended!
Julia’s place is nice. It was in a decent location and the price was reasonable.

Great host!
Nice place to stay!!
We had a great time in Yuyi's place. I would definitely come back.

One of the best Airbnb stays we’ve had.
The host was proactive, clear, and responsive from booking through checkout, making the entire process easy and stress-free.
The apartment was exceptionally well stocked with thoughtful amenities, including hair dryer/styling tools, toiletries, laundry supplies, and more. The coffee station even had to-go cups, and bar area was equipped with wine glasses and tumblers.
The space was spotless, organized, modern, and easy to navigate, with clear labels and fun touches that added personality.
The location was a major plus. Belmont train station is about a block away. My 77-year-old dad had no trouble walking to/from the station. While we couldn’t hear the trains, there was some typical city street noise at times. The apartment is also directly across from Aldi and TJ Maxx, which was very convenient.
We’ve stayed in many vacation rentals, and this one exceeded expectations. We’d gladly stay again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago

We had a great time! Plenty of space for our family of four plus grandparents. Great, central location. My kids really enjoyed the theater room. Extremely walkable. We even found a neighborhood playground a couple of blocks over for the kids. Ro’s home is beautiful with countless thoughtful details that made our stay very pleasant!

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Silvias Apartment. Leider sind wir am Anreisetag zuerst in die falsche Richtung gelaufen, was uns mit dem ganzen Gepäck sehr geschafft hat. Die Anweisungen für den Self-Check In waren gut und verständlich.
Das Apartment sieht aus wie auf den Bildern und war sauber. Die Räumlichkeiten sind sehr großzügig geschnitten, ein typischer Altbau mit knarrenden Dielen. (Wir hoffen die Mieter unter uns fühlten sich nicht gestört durch uns)
Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind fußläufig und auch die Haltestelle der Blueline (Verbindung Chicago O‘Hare <-> Downtown) ist zu Fuß gut zu erreichen. Die Nachbarschaft ist ruhig.
Die Gastgeberin war immer gut über die App zu erreichen und stets freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt.
Danke
As advertised, very comfortable and great location

Great place to stay! James and Yen were incredibly friendly, responsive, and accommodating.
Our group was in town for a wedding, and when we couldn’t find an iron, Yen replied almost immediately and went above and beyond by bringing us a brand new one within 45 minutes.
Would book here again when we’re back in town.
Beautifully appointed and comfortable apartment...a wonderful retreat.
We loved the neighborhood and access to restaurants, shopping, and transportation was awesome
Great location, well stocked with everything we needed. Close to restaurants and short walk to lincoln park. Jack was a great host and very responsive. Having a parking spot was fantastic.
Very nice and clean place! Ariel was a great, kind, and responsive host. We arrived early and he arranged with the cleaners to let us drop our bags off before check in. Would stay here again!
Nice quiet area with easy access to public transit

Beautiful AirBnB!
Super clean.
Free street parking.
Great location.
We had a great stay here. The place is very cute and comfortable with a well appointed kitchen and cozy back porch for morning coffee. Great, walkable location as well.
Good area in Chinatown, good value
Pracefull area, the house is clean and cozy.

We loved our stay at Michael’s place!  The location was perfect- right in the middle of a vibrant neighborhood with shops, restaurants, bookstore, shoe store and much more.  The apartment was exactly as advertised with a very well stocked kitchen, new appliances, cozy living and eating area and two spacious bedrooms.  The shower was wonderful and the hair dryer worked great - we appreciated the first aid kit too.  Michael was responsive to our initial questions and proactive to solve a problem we had with the stairs.  We will absolutely stay here again, as it is very close to our son’s home, which makes visiting really easy.  Highly recommend this place - a gem in the Andersonville neighborhood.
Super easy, nice folks, would stay there again!
Very clean and thoughtfully set up. I felt safe staying here.
Great, clean apartment close to city. Alma was very communicative. Recommend highly
A nice place in a good location.  Host very clear with comms.

It was a great stay, just as described. Personally, I had a pleasant experience; a place closer to downtown at such a price was a steal, and the host was responsive when needed. No troubles with checking in, and the place also seemed great. Will definitely recommend for solo travellers looking for a cost-effective stay plan near downtown Chicago.

El departamento está muy bien ubicado, con varios lugares cerca y con el transporte muy accesible.
Es un depto cómodo, pero hay un problema grande. La heladera hace ruido y está en el mismo ambiente que la cama. En vez de comprar una heladera más moderna que haga menos ruido te dan tapones para los oídos...
Es un departamento viejo, pero bien mantenido. La presión del agua en la ducha podría mejorar.

Allyson was a great host. The apartment and her hosting deserve five stars. No issues whatsoever. Spacious, everything you would need, comfy and clean.
I will say that I was coming in for business and while I understood that the location was desirable and fun, and that the area was noisy, I wasn’t expecting the noise level to be what it was from the bar next door. The music from the bar could be clearly heard throughout the apartment from before noon to after 2am both days, which made falling asleep hard. The trains were something I wasn’t able to get used to in two days either. Great for a friends trip or vacation - not so great for having to wake up early or get solid sleep. Not the host’s fault, they mentioned it in the listing, but more severe than I was comfortable with due to the nature of my trip. 1000% my fault - would recommend the place for anything but a trip where you needed to fall asleep before 3am. Cool location

Great location within 4 blocks of the convention center. The apartment was clean and worked great for travel with a group of people. The place overlooked the park side of the complex. The place was also 2 blocks from the subway entrance if you need to go anywhere downtown. FYI, there was a train behind the building, but couldn't hear it at all. Overall totally worth the price if traveling to the convention center for business or needing easy access subway.
Prime location!!!!! Clean and easy to get around everywhere we needed to go. 5 adults and a 1 year old baby, felt comfortable due to the ease of being able to come back to the Airbnb to rest.
Casa ampla, com muitos quartos e cozinha bem equipada.  Ambiente muito limpo. Anfitriã Sherry sempre proativa e respondia as dúvidas rapidamente.

Had a great stay here! The space was large, comfortable, and had everything we needed. The location was excellent—close to plenty of restaurants, shops, and things to do in Logan Square, and easily walkable. The kitchen was also very useful and made our stay even more convenient. I’d happily stay here again.

We enjoyed our 4 night stay at David's apartment in Andersonville as a family of 3. Located in a great walkable neighborhood with plenty of options for coffee/food/shops. The unit itself was spacious for us with plenty of room for my 3yo to play. Description is accurate, kitchen equipped for simple meals. My favorite part was the spacious and well equipped laundry room at the rear of the apt which is helpful for anyone with young children. The primary bed is great for 2, the second bed is perfect for 1. Bed was comfortable, medium firm. There are some stairs to enter the building's main door, then a flight of interior stairs to the upstairs unit. Street parking was a breeze (even with road construction). David is responsive and proactive. The apt was the perfect home base for our first time in Chicago.

El departamento es muy lindo y excelentemente equipado. Wonderful siempre estuvo atento y consultando como estábamos. Si estuviese algo más cerca del Metro seria excepcional. De todas formas 100% recomendable.

Chicago Hospitality Club provided a clean and safe place for us during our time in Chicago. The air bnb was in walking distance of everything we wanted to do and lobby staff were super friendly and helpful! Would Recommend!
Great stay. thank you
The place was clean, great location! We recommend it!
Above and beyond all our expectations. We will be back.

L'appartement est fidèle a la description et, bien quun peu 'impersonnelle car gérée par un central, la communication avec l'équipe était facile. Le problème majeur est que l'immeuble semble régulièrement être squatté par des jeunes pour fumer du cannabis. Impossible de dormir du fait de leurs fête improvisée dans le couloir en pleine nuit.

You will be so glad you picked Maison Magnolia! My husband and I spent five beautiful days in this immaculately clean, beautifully appointed garden apartment on a lovely tree-lined street in Andersonville, one of the best neighborhoods in Chicago. Hosts are SO kind and responsive, and when we first booked we ended up having to change dates, and they were understanding and easy to work with to make a change. You will enjoy easy access to the L, walk to great shops and restaurants, and your hosts have made recommendations you should definitely consider, they didn’t miss. We will look to come back next time we come to this magnificent city.

Wood’s place is a rare gem, nicely tucked away. Things that stood out were it looks exactly like the pictures and the color scheme is beautiful! Who knew green with beige and gold highlights would be so aesthetically pleasing?! Bonus points for the fridge stocked with water, the microwave and space heaters! I hope everyone who books his place takes good care of it. Everything about it is so thoughtful and intentional. I would always come back whenever I’m in Chicago.
The BnB was beautiful!! Exactly what we were looking for in the perfect location 🙏 we had everything we needed inside and were so comfortable! Will definitely be booking again!
رائع بس يوجد شريك بنفس الشقه وصوت الارضيه عند المشي مزعج جداً وهذا لايفضل وجود شريك خاص بنفس الشقه

We had the best stay at The Settle Inn!
While a little more than we usually pay for a vacation, when it was all said and done I feel the price accurately fit the space, the amenities, and the location, along with an awesome and VERY helpful host.
The amenities really made our week away from home so easy. Accessible and fully stocked situation for doing laundry, a fully stocked kitchen with some very nice cookware, plates, silverware etc (I’ve stayed in plenty of bnbs that claim to have all this but it’s always best up and lacking), and Carly was able to set up a great sleeping space for our 20 month old, prior to our arrival!
The space is up two flights of carpeted stairs with a sturdy railing, but be aware if you are not physically able this could be a barrier, but I was fine lugging my almost 2 year old up and down (mostly he climbed it himself and had a blast).
Neighborhood sells itself. Walkable, beautiful, 3+ parks and zoo adjacent.
Hope to stay again!
We had a great stay at Can's place. We were visiting my children who lived nearby. It was a lovely street.
Very nice place in a great location. Would stay again

I stayed at Aaron & Carrie’s apartment for five nights while attending a conference. The apartment was spacious, clean, and very conveniently located near the Lawrence Red Line stop. Check-in was a breeze with the detailed instructions provided. Aaron was kind, proactively communicative, very responsive, and provided a ton of detail about the surrounding neighborhood. The area is a nice mix of residential + commercial, but you can easily strike out anywhere in Chicago due to proximity to the CTA L and bus stops.
The apartment itself is well-appointed, filled with light, and very clean (and the water pressure is a dream!). I would absolutely book this place again.

Overall good place to stay but further away from downtown then expected.. also was somewhat difficult to get uber / Lyft drivers to come to the area. Almost like they wanted to avoid it or something. The inside was beautiful loved it I love the blue lights throughout the place.
Not the stay I expected maybe a misread situation but there will be other guest at this location (please be mindful if traveling by your). Also very noisy with lots of knocking in the morning
Perfeito! Apartamento limpo e completo. Super bem localizado. Estacionamento facil em frente a casa. Recomendo a todos.
Pretty responsive host
Convenient stay, close to the L and navigable.

It was a pleasure staying here. The location, cleanliness, and communication were all excellent. The apartment is conveniently located close to O’Hare and downtown Chicago, and the park across the street was perfect for peaceful walks. The WiFi was fast and reliable throughout the stay, and the host was incredibly friendly and made the check-in process seamless. Overall, a great experience — 10/10, I would absolutely stay here again.

Brian’s apartment is awesome. Very comfortable, clean, and well decorated with great attention to detail. Perfect for longer stays and truly felt like a home away from home. There are lots of great restaurants and cafés within walking distance, which made the location even better.
Brian was flexible, responsive, and very accommodating throughout the stay. We had a delivery arriving earlier than expected, and he made sure it was safely inside the apartment until we got there, which we really appreciated. Highly recommend staying here and would definitely come back.
Great price, convenient location, responsive host. Would book again!

A bright, spacious, super clean apartment that was a perfect landing spot for our visit to Chicago. Wonderful local restaurants and a cute, colourful residential neighbourhood that was wonderfully walkable and friendly. This is one of the best Airbnbs I have ever visited. Highly recommend.

The location and the 4 balconies were the high points. The kitchen is very nice and well stocked. Washer and dryer both worked well.
The second bathroom and the third bedroom were under-sized. The second bathroom had no towel racks and the toilet was crammed between the sink and tub so tightly as to make it very difficult to use. The third bedroom was so tiny the bed took up the whole room.
The second bedroom lighting was problematic and it had no place for a suitcase or to put clothes.
Other than the couches, the chairs were too small for adults.
Over all, this place was OK but for the price it was not very comfortable.

My husband and I stayed 2.5 days.  The home had everything we needed and more.  Beds were comfortable and it was nice to have 2 bathrooms.  Hosts were quick to answer our questions.  We would stay again.

Soggiorno fantastico!
Ho trascorso 2 settimane meravigliose in questo appartamento nel West Loop.
Era perfetto, spazioso, pulito e situato in una posizione fantastica a pochi passi da Skinner Park dove potersi rilassare o praticare attività sportiva all'aperto. Posizione ideale per esplorare Chicago e le sue aree esterne ma anche scoprire i vari caffè e ristoranti.
I proprietari sono stati eccezionali, sempre super disponibili e attenti ad ogni esigenza.
Ci tornerò sicuramente nei miei prossimi viaggi a Chicago. Consigliatissimo!!!!!

We had a fantastic time at Neel's apartment. We were in town for a convention and my group from work (who are all friends) were very pleased. The apartment is exactly like the photos. The beds were comfortable (note on the softer side but still very supportive). The place was spotless. The location is wonderful - close to the train but also walkable to most places we wanted to go. Neel was an incredible host, from being proactive in communications to special treats for the group. We will be coming back for sure. Highly recommend!
Close to many transit stops, beautiful neighborhood, authentic
Lovely host, responsive and helpful
Nice quiet and cozy stay. Instructions for check in/check out were clear. Lots of places to eat nearby that were walkable. Musa was very responsive as a host, would love to visit here again

Accurate post, clean mostly (dirt on all ledges), and train is very loud (the provide ear plugs and a white noise machine). Host was very responsive and the unit is as described. Then at checkout:
She messaged a picture of electronic bag asking if it was mine.
I said I was in the area still and could return.
She asked my eta.
I left my work event, got an uber, and then never heard from host again (more than 24 hours after checkout, an initial responses within minutes).
She stopped responding and I never heard from her. Never got my bag with all electronics. Contacted Airbnb. Nothing.
I requested refund for amount of bag an uber; which is fair. I know it’s my error to leave it, but why then message me, have me return there, and then never reply again???

The property is well maintained, clean, and comfortable. The host was extremely helpful, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout the stay. Transportation connectivity is also quite convenient.
However, there are a few aspects that families may want to consider. The apartment is located on the third floor, which may not be ideal when traveling with children, luggage, or strollers. The nearest grocery store is not within easy walking distance, and the kitchen could have been better equipped with more utensils. Additionally, the absence of a dishwasher and clothes dryer made longer family stays somewhat less convenient.
Given the overall pricing, I believe these amenities would add significant value and make the property more family-friendly. Without them, managing daily household needs can become both challenging and more expensive for families.
Sehr gute Lage. Wohnung entsprach genau den Beschreibungen.
This was a great stay. The location was pretty and everything was great. The only thing that was unclear were checkout instructions because we were sent two different sets with differing direction.
Great apartment in a fantastic area. Quiet streets, yet everything within walking distance
Increíble lugar y vista increíble
Brett’s place was incredible! We had such a fun time exploring the surrounding neighborhood and when we wanted to sit back and relax, the Tea Studio was a perfect place to unwind. Highly recommend!

What a fantastic trip this was, and what a great place to stay for it! We had a last minute cancellation and were able to secure this spot within hours. It’s sooo comfy and spacious, and the neighborhood is lovely and friendly. Hosts were very responsive and kind— gave me a late check out, which was much appreciated! Would def stay here again.

This is the cutest place!  I would stay here again.  Plenty of restaurants, shops, and nightlife within walking distance and a short ride to River North and Millennium Park.  I even made lunch and dinner one day because the kitchen is stocked with all the necessities, and there's a grocery store less than 2 blocks away.  It's clean and mostly quiet at night (the trains are white noise to me).

Pretty much a crash pad. Very basic amenities in a secure building & safe, walkable neighborhood. It’ll remind you of your 1st apartment when you lived off ramen or boxed mac & cheese.
Vintage building, window A/C, squeaky floors typical stuff. Unit itself has the potential to be really cute. The peeling paint on the ceilings & doors seems like an easy fix. Furniture is quite worn & uncomfortable. Bedroom is 1 night stand & bed. No dresser & 1 luggage rack. Provisions are very basic.
For the price ($300+ night) I think they can afford to make this a lot nicer. There’s nothing actually special about the unit that makes you think you can’t wait to come back. If you’re just looking for a place to sleep & walk back to safely at night this would work.
The best for us was the proximity to our family. It’s also close to restaurants – (decent Mexican at el Tapatio) , shopping & the L (Paulina Station 3 mins). Host is responsive, fast internet & good water pressure/temp.

Cate was a very accommodating host. Their home is spacious and in a great location. It was walkable with lots of restaurants nearby and close to all of the neighborhoods we visited. I would recommend this stay.
3rd year in a row staying here. Nuff said!

Hostess were great communicators and described place perfectly.
Had all needed for kitchen, bathroom and bedroom needs.
Great location to shop, eat, tour. No vehicle needed to get basic needs/wants.
Place was very clean/nice, cozy, and super spacious.
Overall, great Airbnb experience. No issue about what to do or what to expect.
Highly recommend, was worth every penny.

Had a great stay. The location was perfect for us, very close to family. There were several parks nearby and close to supermarket and drugstores.
Beds were comfy, place was clean, had everything we needed for cooking some meals in. Bathroom had soap, shampoo/conditioner, even some feminine products as well.
It was nice to have the guaranteed parking spot , although there often was easy parking along the side street also.
Jodee was extremely responsive to any questions I had and very helpful and friendly.
The price is very high for what the room actually offers. It is small, and the bathroom is impractical and neglected. I didn't like it.
Very homey and the host was responsive to all my questions and concerns

What a nice place to stay! Clean comfortable beautiful decor. Comfy beds, we all slept well. Only one bathroom but it worked out fine for the four of us.
Across from Mather Park, the house is set back so feels private. Beautiful park. Parking was easy and available.
Super comfy living area. Nice big table for chatting with family.
Very tasty eggs from Drea’s chickens.

The place was great for our short Chicago stay. It's in a posh shipping district and felt safe. We walked to the Michigan Ave buses daily which made sightseeing really easy, but it's also not far from the Red Line Chicago stop. Note: to get to the unit on the second floor, there are 24 wonky, steep stairs.

Both Mona & Giovanni are very attentive & proactive to any issues that need to be resolved.  The residence provides more than enough space and is located in a peaceful residential neighborhood with easy access to public transportation.  Strongly recommended, especially for a long stay.
I enjoyed my stay here, the home as clean and spacious enough for our group. I would definitely book here again in the future

Excellent service, the place matches the photos, Dominique always responded quickly, he's friendly and attentive, the room was clean and comfortable. The only thing I didn't like much was the distance from downtown and everything, the closest CTA station is about 20-minute walk away, and the area, from what I was told, is unsafe. It's in a neighborhood called Englewood, which has a reputation for being unsafe. But for the price, I'm happy with the place, and Dominique's service is very good. Totally recommended just taking care if you want to walk through, especially during night (take uber services by nights, it's the best)

Nat was an excellent host, super responsive and clear. The location was very good, close to restaurants and the city center. very walkable too.
The amenities were good and the house was very well designed and decorated in colorful pop art, very bright and cheery!

Overall, we were very happy with our stay!  It is a great location that was both quiet at night and yet only a few steps to very busy nightlife and about a million places to eat and drink.  It was also only a short uber ride to chicago landmarks as well such as Millennium Park, Miracle Mile, Field museum, Second City etc.  My one piece of advice for those renting in the summer months is you may need to empty the water collection system for the portable air conditioner - we were able to google it fairly quickly but just be aware if it fills up and you don't empty it you will get toasty!
Run, don’t walk to this place! Super stylish, particularly good bed, bathroom worthy of a hotel, and in the best location in Chicago. Can’t wait to go back.
Really nice place and a great value! Construstion was little bit rough around the edges but the charm and location more than make up for it. Everything looks just like the pictures.

Wonderful stay! The place was clean, spacious, and exactly as described. There was plenty of room for our group to spread out comfortably, and everything was well maintained. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it for larger groups.
Milan was great and making sure our stay was perfect. He did reach out daily to make sure nothing was amiss.

Everything in this charming space was thoughtful: nice touches and provisions in every room: Throw blankets, makeup wash cloths, the small desk, mirrors and light fixtures well placed.  And the location! We loved Andersonville, how easy it was to walk to stores and restaurants, the garden center right outside., 10 minutes from the train to downtown. The bathroom was tiny and off the kitchen, but well appointed (and great hot shower!)
Though i only stayed for a day, it was a great experience. Thank you!
Great location, walkable to everything, clean unit, responsive host. I only had it for a few nights but it would be perfect for a longer stay.
Great price, room is cozy, right by the train
Great stay! wonderful craftsman home in a spectacular location, and Elizabeth was great to interact with!

Great place for a family of 5 traveling to Chicago to see the city. The location is in Old Town near great restaurants and it was in walking distance to transit. The place had everything as described and was exactly what we were hoping for. Loved it!
Great spot for game day.

Great place to stay if you’re participating to a busy convention at McCormick on a low budget. Apartment was clean with respectful guests. One minute walk from T stop 😊. Sarah and Drew quickly answered to my questions.
We found the apartment just as advertised and it had everything we needed. Had a great time in Chicago.

El departamento es mucho más chico de lo esperado. Las escaleras para subir un poco incómodas, sobretodo si llevás valijas. No tiene aire acondicionado y es un poco caluroso. Por la noche pueden haber eventos en el bar de abajo. El precio es aceptable, pero no lo volvería a elegir.

Had a great stay! Quiet little area in Pilsen but still within walking distance of a couple good spots and super close to the L for anything further. Check in was easy and well explained and the apartment was very clean and well set up.  Checkout was just as easy and the host was very flexible and worked with me on checkout details since I had a flight before the scheduled check out time.
excelente Localização!

It was a true pleasure staying with such wonderful hosts as Marta and her husband, Manolo. I stayed at their home for about a week and a half and was completely satisfied with the cleanliness, comfort, and cozy atmosphere of the accommodation.
The hosts are very responsive, always available, and quick to help with any requests. The house itself is lovely, with convenient parking and located in a great neighborhood.
Thank you for your warm hospitality! I truly enjoyed my stay and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.
Very nice location, easy access to blue line
Good value stay.
Another great stay! I’m sure we’ll be back again.
this was a very nice condo in a pleasant neighborhood. The brown line is a couple of minutes away making all of Chicago accessible. I loved the neighborhood   lots of ethnic restaurants.
David was so responsive and you could tell her cared about his guests that stayed in his home. We felt at home, peaceful, great location, safe, great backyard, kitchen! Thank you soooo much!

Amy’s place was perfect! You can’t beat the location, it’s close to the main tourist attractions, with many of the city’s best spots just 20–30 minutes away. The neighborhood is very walkable, with plenty of cafés and restaurants nearby.
Amy was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay. I traveled with my wife and kids, who, by the way, loved the toys that were available.
You can’t go wrong choosing to stay here, especially if you’re traveling with children.
Thank you, Amy! We truly enjoyed our stay at your lovely place.

I can’t say enough about how much we loved this place. It had a lot to do with how great the host is. He is very, very responsive and accommodating. He was always willing to go the extra mile to help us with anything we needed. He even got us extra silverware because he was afraid we wouldn’t have enough since we had five people. But we always had plenty of everything. The backyard was so so nice to hang out in and wonderful for people with dogs. The place itself is very comfortable with very comfortable furniture and beds. The showers are awesome. There were always extra supplies to grab as needed in the laundry room and the washers and dryer are excellent. The neighborhood is also amazing. We are from Chicago so we already knew the city, but this neighborhood was new to us and we really wished we could spend more time there. If we need a place to stay again, we will definitely be contacting Vlad first!
5 Stars Plus.  Great communication with Host!
Dan’s stay was very comfortable, and Dan was a helpful host.

Great apartment on the 17th floor. Safe and secure location and easy walk, bike, or Lyft to the convention center! Short bike ride to the lake too. Not too many options around for food or coffee. But quick ride to the south loop for food restaurants.

Leila’s place is so lovely. Having the balcony to relax on really added to our enjoyment, and the washer/dryer made such a big difference in our stay since we were in the area for over a week. She is extremely easy and kind to communicate with, my husband and I loved staying here!

Would recommend this Airbnb if you’re looking to stay in Chicago. Was a great location right by Grant Park in about a 10 minute walk to the field museum. Had a really good view. Our host were very responsive. Gave great recommendations. This AirBnB was definitely the cleanest one we’ve stayed in. Next time we’re looking for a spot this will definitely be a place we book.

Victor was very responsive any time I would message! Spot if perfect for a place to stay, and parking on the street really is so easy and stress free. Good spot for if you have business in the area and next a good central place to sleep.
Lovely apartment, nicely decorated, great location in a beautiful neighborhood.  Convenient to many restaurants and downtown Chicago.

Tout s'est bien passé, mis a part que l'appartement comporte 4 chambres et nous avons eu la malchance de séjourner au même moment que des personnes totalement inadaptées à la vie en communauté (vaisselle jamais faite, bruit dans l'appartement à toute heure du jour et de la nuit)

The description of the room corresponds to reality. It is a shared room in a big apartment, with a good bathroom and kitchen.
The trip to the Loop takes around 30 minutes by public transportation. The time it took me to get to my usual destination, McCormick Place, was similar.
Communicating with Ming was easy. She answered quickly and provided accurate information about the room.
For its price range, and considering it’s not really close to downtown, it is a very good option.
Fab place, great location!!!

Good location right near the Kimball Bus & the Lincoln Bus too which will take you to the beautiful and historic  Lincoln Sq neighborhood. Also close to the CTA Brown Line and the Peterson/Ridge Metra Train Station which will get you Downtown or to Evanston within 15 minutes!
Fine stay.

This was a great find and perfect for a business trip/conference at McCormick place! It is walkable distance to the conference center which made it really convenient, and there was a bus right outside that went by conference center or straight downtown. Super convenient!
The place was also really clean and very spacious! Great views of the skyline/downtown from all the rooms.
The full kitchen was handy for morning breakfasts and coffee, and the living room was super bright and cozy. The beds were also super comfortable, I slept really well. There is also ac in the unit, which was nice. Having multiple bedrooms and bathrooms was convenient for myself and my work colleague to stay on this business trip!
Adresa was very communicative and responsive, and I really liked the ease of check in and check out, as well as the quick responses if I had any questions.
Would definitely stay here again, and highly recommend!!

cute place outside of downtown! very clean, great kitchen, full of amenities (including DVDs which we loved!). the beds and overall furniture were super comfy, the whole place felt like a home away from home. also super close to a CTA green stop which was amazing for us!

Die Unterkunft ist grosszügig, sehr sauber, gut ausgerüstet.
Super Kommunikation mit Jun. Jun war sehr hilfsbereit. Tolle Aussicht auf die Skyline.
Optimale Ausgangslage an der redline station für Aktivitäten downtown und für Ausflüge.
Ich habe mich sehr wohl gefühlt. Danke Jun

ASCO2026参加のため、昨年に続いてお世話になりました。会場まで徒歩30分かからないので、とても便利です。ASCOから紹介されるホテルの半額以下なので、とても助かります。中心街からは少し離れていますが、バスまたはRed lineで簡単に移動できます（夜はバスの方が安全かと思いました）。Heidiさんは親切でフレンドリーですし、部屋もきれいで、シーツやタオルも清潔で、今回も何の不自由もありませんでした。
来年以降も、ぜひ利用したいです。

While I didn’t get to meet her, and my travel plans took an awkward turn at the end; Danielle and her place was awesome! I felt right at home and she made it really easy to find! I will definitely recommend her to any of my friends going out to Chicago! (Lemonade is also equally as awesome 😎🐇)

Un bon séjour passé dans la maison de Jane qui ete réactive assez rapidement notamment pour régler le problème de wifi.
Petit problème concernant la salle de bain avec un problème de robinet de douche qui goutte et qui a été reparé assez rapidement.
Je conseille le logement de Jane☺️
Nice stay

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had. The place had everything I needed, including everything I requested, and the host was absolutely wonderful ( truly one of the best hosts ever!). The location was also great, close to many cool places and things to do. I personally did not get to explore them much because of other commitments, but I would definitely recommend this stay to anyone visiting the area.

We enjoyed our stay overall! Hosts were reliable, welcoming, and organized. The property was exactly as described, although parking is not always guaranteed. The location was ideal for our trip since it was near everything on our itinerary. We had a little hiccup with the missing hairdryer, but Marty took care of the issue right away. The host was easy to reach and we really appreciated the communication by the hosts before and during our stay.

We stayed here with a party of 11 while visiting Chicago for our daughter’s graduation. Finding a place that could accommodate a group our size was challenging, so we were grateful to find this listing. The house is large with enough rooms for everyone, the neighborhood is beautiful and walkable, and Chana was extremely responsive and friendly throughout our stay.
That said, for the price, we expected more. The furniture felt old and outdated, and some pieces seemed fragile. There is only one TV in the entire house, none of the bathrooms have power outlets, and the pillows were very flat. Closets contained clutter and personal belongings, and family photos were still displayed throughout the home, which made it feel less like a guest space.
Overall, the house has a lot of potential and works well for large groups, but it would benefit from updates such as new furniture, fresh paint, removal of personal items, additional TVs, and bathroom upgrades to better match the cost.
great place
Excellent and spacious 2 bed 2 bath apartment! Wonderful location, excellent lake view!
Mejor de lo que esperaba, ambiente muy tranquilo y Andreea es una excelente host. Muy recomendado.
Great experience!

This unit is an excellent location. Just one block from Broadway with lots of restaurants, grocery stores and easy walk to the beach. Apartment was very comfortable and exactly as advertised. I hope to return when next visiting in Chicago.
Todo Excelente

Honest place in a calm neighbourhood close to Chinatown. Park to run is not far, many Chinese restaurants around and - great for jet lag - a bakery (Impallaria Bakery) a few blocks away, with coffee and croissants, that opens very early in the morning.
Appreciated the iron and ironing board as well as the shampoo and conditioner, when arriving with few liquids by plane.
Communication was very easy and replies super fast.
Nice place.  Great neighborhood. Great host

Carolyn’s place was amazing! The location is super convenient, just a short walk to the main train stations and bus stops, and only 20 minutes from downtown. The space itself is quiet, clean, and very spacious. It’s absolutely perfect if you work from home—the internet is fast, and the layout is large enough for multiple people to be on video calls at the same time without an issue. I will definitely stay here again the next time I'm in Chicago!
Very responsive and hospitable.
Great stay. Would recommend to anyone who is looking for a clean and affordable place to stay.

It's a peaceful neighborhood with several restaurants close by. Our family felt right at home when we first entered. The host was also responsive and understanding, and the place was just like in the photos.
Very convenient location, inner city vibe  and very clean and tidy.

Juanita is so helpful and goes beyond her way to make sure that the guests are comfortable, and checks every morning to make sure that they have everything right and if there are any concerns. Had an amazing stay and Mount sinai is pretty close if someone needs to stay there for rotations.

Beautiful home, great hosts, and walkable to the heart of Wicker Park. Mary was so kind and generous with my schedule for checking in and out. The welcome packet also had great recommendations for nearby stores.

O local corresponde as fotos e é aconchegante. O espaço é confortável e funcional e abriga 04 pessoas tranquilamente.

No geral, atendeu as expectativas
I had a wonderful stay. Bed was cozy, sheets clean. Nice place to stay

Michael's place was easy to find and had all the amenities needed to stay comfortably. The 3rd floor was a little stuffy, but cracking the windows immediately relieved that issue. it was very rarely that I heard anyone in the home and the space is a walks distance from the green/red line and the White Sox stadium. Overall, a good crash pad in proximity to the convention center!
Great location to explore Logan Square. Close to bus lines and the train and walkable to a million restaurants.
Great location and comfortable home for the week! Thanks Don!

Milan was a great host and this place was very convenient for me to attend a work conference nearby. It made the logistics easier than staying further in the city. It also was walkable to the conference, instead of Ubers etc.
We found the apartment to be very clean and convenient and the exactly as described.

Excellent stay! I was traveling with family who wants to explore Chicago and surrounding suburb areas so having a secure parking spot for our rental car was a big plus for this home. Very clean. Well stocked kitchen with listed items. Love the location -- walking distance to lots of  restaurants, a park, community center, library, water taxi, and the McCormick convention center (for my work). It is close to the train station which one can hear the trains going by but that doesn't bother any one of us in the family. Would love to come back again next year!

Great location, short walk to wicker park Main Street, lots of good food options nearby. Right off the metro and bus lines. Clean, nice rooftop area, host was kind and responsive. It’s a good for the price. The only downside side is that the mattress and bedding aren’t great and you can’t flush toilet paper because it’s an old building.

Most importantly bathroom space is shared with 2 other rooms. The stairs need a guardrail. Stove and refrigerator need maintenance. Bathroom was not cleaned while we were there and we were there for 6 nights. There was no furniture in our room to place our things like a small dresser or a portable table. A broken coffee maker was replaced the next day. All in all I would recommend it to visitors who don't mind sharing a bathroom.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The place was perfect for our group of three, with three separate bedrooms and three bathrooms, giving everyone plenty of privacy and comfort. The location was also very convenient, with easy access to transportation and nearby attractions. The home was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.
Clean, In a safe area but needs a private lock and some privacy in the bathroom.

What a wonderful place! This lovely cottage was perfect for our family of four and had everything we needed for our vacation. The residence is nestled in a family friendly neighborhood outside the congestion of Chicago. We enjoyed going for evening walks after full days in the city. We drove our car, and while traffic is always thick in Chicago, we found the drive and parking manageable. Public transit is certainly close if you need it. I highly recommend Deena and Elliot’s place!

Die Unterkunft war perfekt und entsprach genau der Beschreibung auf Airbnb. Mein Zimmer war bestens ausgestattet und sehr sauber. Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu erreichen und die Umgebung sicher. Ich würde die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen.

Martin's place is  incredible!  there should be 6 stars for some of the rating categories.  I've stayed in Airbnb places all over, and this rates at the top. And, that would be the case for most all travelers.  If you have any interest punk, post punk or industrial music... you will be amazed. Don't even get me started on the museum located on the same property.  I can't say enough good things about the place, Martin and everyone there.  6 stars!

Hosts are really warm and welcoming:)! Entry instruction is very clear. Decorations are impressive. Gerard kindly invited me to feed these lovely fishes in the pond, which brought lots of joy. Quiet during the night. A bit far from the city center (~40min-1h 10min by train, ~25 min by car) but just one block from the station.  Neighborhood is pretty peaceful with lots of trees. Would definitely recommend living here as long as you don’t mind spending time transporting!

Steven’s place was perfect! It’s super cute and looks recently remodeled. Lots of great little touches like multiple lighting options, outlets all over, and cold filtered water at the kitchen sink. The area is great, walkable to restaurants and parks. We would definitely stay here again.

A perfect place to stay during our first visit to Chicago! The place is spotless and has everything you need to relax after a day of exploring. The host was extremely helpful and I felt we could ask for anything if we needed it.
Thank you Mimi and Paul! We will definitely be back :)
It was a perfect experience!
great place for solo travelers
amazing location! the place was squeaky clean too!

Hector is a great host and always proactive on communications with clear instructions. His house is in a great area with various food options, and our 1st time having Serbian food which was great. The house is modern with great decors which created nice vibes. We had a great time there.
Perfect for walking to McCormick.
Clean, comfy, close to great coffee and restaurants. Lovely back porch. Quick communications from host. Thank you!

La habitación y el baño es justo cómo sendescribe, es una vivienda duplex, está en el segundo piso, hay escaleras para acceder, todo en la habitación y el baño super bien, el trato es cordial, muy amable, está cómo a 25 minutos del centro en autobús, tiene muy buenas conexiónes de servicio de transporte público, muchas gracias!
Place was reasonable for what I paid. Access was easy and the location was close to the bus/train.
The unit is in a great location for walkability and exploring the neighborhood. The apartment itself was also a great place to rest / take a break from daily outings.
great stay
Grrrrreat location in Lincoln Park and Brad was super communicative and helpful! The coffee shop across the street was amazing and the restaurants were too.
Wondeful neighborhood, walkable to the trains, and a cozy second floor loft to stay in. Hoghly recommended!

We enjoyed our stay very much. Apartment is centrally located and close to so many wonderful restaurants and activities. Really appreciated the Keurig and coffee. Loved the stress-free departure as well. Well done!

Unfortunately, our stay was very disappointing. The mattress in the Queen Room was on un-lockable rollers and sank deeply in the middle, making it incredibly uncomfortable and causing back pain. When we reported it, the host offered to transfer us to the Middle Room. However, upon inspecting the alternate room, it had a severe mold odor, so we could not safely sleep there. The host then promised to send a team the next day to inspect and fix our original bed. We packed our belongings as requested to make room for them, but the host never followed through. We spent our entire trip sleeping on a broken bed. We expected better communication and basic, functional furniture.

We enjoyed our visit, this place was found at the perfect time. We had to change accommodations because our hotel didn’t meet our standard, coming from California and being accommodated so seamlessly was so appreciated. This was a trip celebrating my daughter graduating from college.

Melissa is an excellent host. She's very responsive and will try to accommodate your needs.
Home is advertised as an Airbnb to the street. While neighborhood is very safe, would prefer not to tell the world that visitors stay here.

Overall - appreciated the space and responsiveness. Grateful to have been based here for a month and having a foundation to explore the city from.
Train sounds did interrupt my sleep a number of times which is the rationale behind the 4-star rating.
Totally cost effective, clean, quiet, host is extremely good, it doesnt get much sunlight but place is probably the best for this price 👍🏻
El alojamiento es excelente la atención inmejorable su anfitrión siempre preocupado por si se necesita algo lo recomiendo al 100

The place was amazing! So homey!
Nice back porch for drinking coffee and listening to birds sing.

A stay I will NEVER forget.  Literally across the street from the University of Chicago. One of the most gorgeous campuses I've ever seen and perfect for my meetings there. Plein Air on campus is my favorite coffee shop in Chicago.  A quaint little café, best premium cold brew, food, and they even serve wine. Bennett's place is PERFECTLY located. Short walk to Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, and tons of restaurants. Roux Diner across the street — Omg, the shrimp & grits were heaven. Bus line takes you straight to Midway, just tap your debit or credit card. Only a  20 min walk to the Obama Presidential Center - so honored I was invited to an EARLY preview before opening. The room was spacious with a great closet and large shower. I got some REAL rest. As an introvert, staying with homeowners can feel awkward, but Bennett's family gave me complete privacy while being kind and respectful. Loved the no shoes rule,  same at my house! This was my first time truly exploring the city.
Good, clean and quiet nice place to stay in calm neighborhood.
Great spot! Very well located and had an excellent stay. Would stay there again!

Loved the apartment! Was shocked by how peaceful and pleasant the neighborhood was - east walk to local cafes and restaurants. The blue line was less than ten minutes to walk too as well (major plus for my group and I!). Besides the lock to the door being a little confusing at first, the rest of the apartment was clean, cozy, and a welcome sight for sore eyes at the end of our sight seeing days. The couch was super comfortable and accommodating for one person to sleep in, and the two bedrooms were cozy and private, with ac units as well. Tere the host always responded within twenty minutes when I needed her and that was helpful as well!
Great, clean and the location was awesome.
Great place & host!

Marc's place was exactly as described. Check-in was straightforward, communication was easy, and the apartment had everything needed for a comfortable stay. Overall, a good experience, and I would recommend it to other travelers.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. It was clean and comfortable. It was a short drive from many areas like Lincoln Square, Ravenswood, Andersonville, and more. I highly recommend staying here!
Good stay overall the host was very responsive or it did lack was updated furniture in the bedroom as the bed was too low and the cupboards were not too good and security for mail
O apartamento é confortável e muito bem localizado. A roupa de cama e os acessórios de cozinha são de ótima qualidade. Nathan foi sempre atencioso e gentil nas mensagens. Foi uma estadia excelente!
Very nice place to stay in Chicago, specially in large groups. Freddy was also very kind and super nice. Highly recommended!

Aside from a lackluster shower and bed, the stay was great and the location was hard to top! Additionally, the area felt safe and secure. The host was communicative and attentive. Would recommend this place, especially for the price!
This Airbnb didn’t work out for us but the host and owner were always responsive and able to help us out when we needed to cancel

Anna’s basement bungalow was perfect to stay in for a few days. About 30 min drive from most things we needed to do in Chicago, the neighborhood is cute and very quiet and peaceful and was very easy to find parking.

Kevin’s space was on a great street! Very walkable, close to restaurants, and close to the downtown area. The Airbnb was beautiful and felt very comfortable to stay in. The hot tub on the colder nights was a major bonus!
Rooms were comfortable & clean. Overall a great experience.
I loved staying here!! The area was nice and safe! The inside was very well decorated and comfortable!!
No frills rooms in great location. Good value.

Our weekend stay for this 1bdrm went very smoothly. Azam was very responsive and the space was clean/larger then we expected. The toiletries were especially appreciated while the proximity to the green line was probably the best feature of our stay as it made getting further in the city easier. Getting to and from the West Loop area was a breeze.
Great stay

We truly loved Christian’s place! Such a great location with amazing restaurants and parks Everything was so walkable. The Airbnb was very very clean and just so comfortable felt like Home after just being there for one day didn’t wanna leave! Will definitely be staying there again!

Wow! Me encantó mi estancia en su casa, todo súper limpio, sin ruido del exterior, muy bonito. La atención de ellos de otro nivel. A un minuto caminando de la parada de camión y Uber económicos.
100/10 regresamos y recomendamos sin temas
Great accommodation , responsive hosts , good location for the United Centre , short ride into town
Great location , 15 minutes walk to McCormick place. Clean and comfortable space with a kitchen, I didn’t have chance to utilize it, definitely great setting for working trips
Great apartment in center Chicago. The location is unbeatable. Everything is walkable or a short Uber drive away. The beds are comfortable, the water pressure is great.

The location was amazing. Could walk to great restaurants and shops in Pilsen. But also was short uber rides into downtown.   The house was well set up and they were very thoughtful and has everything we needed available. The hosts were also gracious enough to let us drop off our luggages since we had a very early flight getting in even though they were still cleaning when we arrived. We would stay there again !!

We had an overall nice stay in this apartment. The hosts were prompt communicators and accommodated an early check in, which we appreciated. Check in was easy, the apartment was clean and is in a good location, both walkable and close to public transportation. We had some issues with appliances - dishwasher and dryer not working consistently - and the host was responsive. There were also no curtains which made for bright early mornings! Overall decent stay but would expect a bit more attention to detail for the price.

I stay in a lot of Airbnb‘s as I travel nearly full-time. This was easily the nicest one I’ve ever had the pleasure to live in. It’s a perfect location, amazing view, and everything in the unit is first class.
Communication was easy and fast and I give this my highest recommendation.
A great airBnB spot, with a beautiful apartment layout and views!
We enjoyed our stay overall. The best part was definitely the location very convenient and easy to get around. Check in was smooth!

Great little place to stay at for a solo traveler!
Very clean and place is better irl than pictures btw!
Place was great! Communication was great, the room was really comfortable, the shared space is fantastic, location is top. I recommend!

This place was magnificent and all possible ways. Location was fantastic. Price was great easy to get in and out of the city. Great food around highly recommend this place.

This is an amazing apartment right in the middle of a very vibrant area. The place was well appointed, comfortable and very clean. Martha was very communicative and accommodating. We would definitely stay there again if the occasion arises!
nice place and great location
Great place! Floors could’ve been a touch cleaner, but otherwise a great space in a great spot!

My family and I had a great stay @ Pat's place. It was clean, bright, and comfortable. The kitchen was wonderful to make breakfast & the outdoor seating was perfect for our morning coffee.
It was convenient for visiting with family for the weekend.
We would stay here again!

I booked this for my parents. The building is in the heart of Chicago and has a lot of amenities. The suite is clean and well furnished. My parents mentioned that the bed is super comfortable. Also Andrew was very friendly and responsive to all the questions we had.

Carly's place is centrally located.  5 minutes walk to the Blue Line, 5 minutes walk to lots of restaurants and eateries.  Location was a 20 minutes ride to downtown and about 40 minutes to O'Hare Airport.  The Airbnb was very spacious and homey and had the basic neccesities  we needed for our stay.  Bed was very comfortable and the furniture was nicely arranged.  We had a nice stay.
Good value for a chill neighborhood, walking distance from the train or a quick uber downtown. Easy to check in and out and had no issues with either.

El lugar estaba muy limpio y todo estaba tal cual lo vimos en las fotos
Benny muy amable, clara y rápida en responder, y muy acertada en lo que nos informó

This was a great spot for 6 of us on a girls weekend trip. This was the cleanest place I have ever stayed! The beds and furniture were very comfortable. Bathrooms were beautiful and luxurious. The kitchen was well stocked with all the dishes and utensils you would ever need. Great spot! Didn’t get a chance to use the hot tub but it was enticing. The neighborhood was beautiful. Just a slice of Americana.

Great place! Would reccomend to others to stay!

This was a great stay. Apartment is clean, and bus stop to go downtown is around a 5 minute walk

Muy buen lugar, próximo al metro, buenos restaurantes en la zona, buena comunicación con el anfitrión.  El baño es pequeño, la cama superior es muy mala y tiene un colchón pésimo y necesitaría que las ventanas tengan cortinas blackout.

This was a great little spot for my husband and I to stay while visiting our kids who live in the area.  The set up was very comfortable, well-designed and very clean! Good deal for the price

Tian couldn’t have been more responsive and helpful when we had questions. It was an easy stay.

Highly recommend! Next time I am in Chicago I want to stay here again! Car was safe, parking was available. No complaints from me!

Great stay! Very communicative and easy to navigate. Thank you!

Would NOT recommend this Airbnb due to three reasons: safety, bugs, and the responses by the cohost.
1. Safety: While the hostel-style setup and keypad entry were disclosed, what was not mentioned is that some rooms are secured only by key or very small padlock attached to a flimsy metal latch. I did not feel secure enough to safely leave valuables in the room.
2. Cleanliness: Upon entering, I noticed what appeared to be a cockroach along with several silverfish. When I brought this up, the cohost blamed me for “opening a window,” despite no windows being opened during my stay.
3. Cohost Communication: I requested to shorten my stay due to the above concerns and offered to pay for one night instead of four. Although they refunded the remaining nights, the cohost implied being being at fault for the bugs, not forthcoming with the safety of the Airbnb, while not handling it professionally or taking responsibility.
The experience left me uncomfortable enough that I left my stay.

I had a great stay! The place was very clean, and the instructions were thorough and easy to follow. The host was communicative and helpful throughout. I appreciated that earplugs were provided, although I ended up not needing them since it wasn’t nearly as noisy as I expected. Overall, a comfortable and pleasant experience. I’d happily stay again!

Global Getaway's property is overall decent. The neighborhood is very quiet, and we had no issues finding parking on the block. We encountered some difficulty with the apartment's lock pad, but Global Getaways assisted us within minutes. The apartment itself was nice; however, it could use a little more attention to detail during cleaning. I must also be honest: the bed and pillows were not comfortable.
Very close to stuff & plenty of space.

Mary was great, super responsive and flexible with our arrival and departure time. We were able to drop Off our bags so we could start exploring the city and store them in the morning before our departure, which was greatly appreciated. She has some great local recommendations and the location is fantastic. Walkable to many restaurants, bars, shops, public transportation, and Wrigley field. Bed was extremely comfortable and Mary had everything a guest would need!

Very nice stay. The location was great for its proximity to public transportation. Only downside was the overhead noise (creaking floors and dog barking), but it did not disrupt me from enjoying my stay.

Olga’s place is very cute and thoughtfully decorated. I thought the lighted walkway with the little “welcome” signs hanging along the side fence was a nice touch. Located on a quiet residential street. My kids and I were in town for a friend’s bar mitzvah and the kids really enjoyed the city. They commented on how friendly all the neighbors were encountered were. I’m only 5’2” and the ceiling height was a non-issue for me. Didn’t use TV or kitchenette so can’t comment, but everything else was as described. All in all I think it was a good deal. It is much nicer than my basement.
Lovely home and easy to stay! Would definitely come back again.
Over all great place, listing is accurate. Convent location for wrigleyville and activities around. Easy parking & access to redline train. Very clean and well taken care of unit.

Le séjour en groupe fut un succès en grande partie grace a ce logement. Tout était super propre et confortable. Nous avons apprécié les divers lieux et le fait que plusieurs petites attentions étaient incluses comme le café, les serviettes, les chargeurs à téléphones et montres ainsi que les jeux de société. Le secteur était super calme et sécuritaire. Dépanneur, liquor store et épicerie à proximité. Arrêt de bus littéralement devant la porte.
He was  outstanding host all together

Great stay! The apartment was beautifully decorated, comfortable, and felt like home. The host was very helpful and responsive throughout our stay. It was a little noisy on Friday and Saturday nights, but overall we had a wonderful experience and would gladly stay again.
Enjoyed my stay thank you for hosting me.
The rental was great for our needs. Well equipped, strong wifi, comfortable, and a great location. Would happily stay here again!
He estat tres nits i m’he sentit com a casa. Molt recomanable. Ubicació residencial i tranquil·la

Wasn’t quite sure what to expect, but it was crunch time for me to arrive at an event. The hosts were so amazing and responsive during the booking process. I’d definitely stay here again given the budget I’d outlined for myself. Perfect place for travelers.
Valeriy was so friendly and attentive, offering local recommendations. Check in was super easy thanks to Valeriy’s clear instructions! Overall a great experience and I would stay again! :)

Had a great stay at Sukh’s place. It was clean and well kept, walkable to some parks, coffee spot, and a number of restaurants.  Parking on the street was no problem and the place had plenty of space for us to spread out and relax between heading out in the city. Also it was surprising quiet at night which was a plus!
Kim was extremely accommodating and super responsive! Location is fabulous for getting around Chicago. Instructions were also crystal clear!

Our family had a wonderful experience staying in Dave’s carriage house. The children greatly enjoyed playing basketball and pickleball in the private yard. This location was easily walkable to the red and brown lines which take you south to all the city attractions.
Adoramos a estadia! A anfitriã foi muito atenciosa e tudo estava limpo e organizado.
I couldn’t have had a better long weekend at Benjamin’s place! Everything was perfect and I will be back again next time I am in Chicago.
Lovely stay

Amazing apartment with high quality interior - very comfortable, cozy living room, fully equipped kitchen, great bathrooms, in a nice neighborhood of Pilsen, with many good Mexican restaurants in walkable distance and bus (line 21) and metro (pink line) nearby.  Cris was super responsive and very keen to help on anything we needed. We've come to Pilsen for the same conference for many years and always used AirBNB, and Chris' apartment was the best we ever had.
Great place

This house is overall clean, and well apportioned. However, the host left lots of personal items in the house. This was broadly fine except in the bathroom, where the number of half-used personal care products was kind of gross.
I would have been fine with this if my stay had been less expensive. However, for the price I paid, I expect a cleaner and more dedicated experience as a guest.
perfect location! would absolutely stay again!

From the moment we arrived, we knew we were in for a great stay. Valerie is an absolutely wonderful host — attentive, warm, and truly made us feel welcome from start to finish. Her home is just as beautiful as the photos suggest, and the location could not have been more perfect for exploring Chicago. Everything was spotless, well-appointed, and thoughtfully set up. We had zero complaints and nothing but great things to say. If you’re looking for a seamless, enjoyable stay in Chicago, look no further — we’d book with Valerie again without hesitation!
Great place. No complaints. 15 minutes to convention center. Would definitely stay again.

This was a truly horrible experience. The sheets were dirty(no additional sheets provided), there were bodily fluids splattered on the desk in the main bedroom, hair everywhere (toilet, beds, floor), leftover items from the previous guests, towels that didn't smell clean, a dirty shower, a rotten and crusty shower mat, a strong smell of marijuana from the previous tenants that made our clothes reek, sticky surfaces, and when a beetle fell on me, we knew it was time to leave. We reported this issue immediately and were refunded $100. We spent close to $800. No offer to clean the property, just that she would connect us to airbnb. We didn't spend a single night but both she and airbnb refuse to offer a full refund. We chose this place because we wanted to be in a home rather than some anonymously managed place or a hotel. We ended up having to escape to a hotel in the middle of the night and paying for both.
The place was great, the neighborhood was quiet and friendly

Comfortable flat in beautiful neighborhood. Top floor of two-story unit, perfectly quiet, no noise from neighbors or street. We enjoyed resting and relaxing in the spacious living room, dining room, and kitchen. Ample free street parking on the block. Very lovely neighborhood with beautiful trees, well landscaped front yards, and stately apartments and homes. Easy walk to N. Clark St. in Andersonville, and most places in Ravenswood and Uptown.

Overall a great place to stay if you specifically want to stay in the Logan Square neighborhood of Seattle or want quick access to both downtown and the airport.  Logan Square has plenty of restaurants and is very walkable with transit stops very close.  The downside is the number of guests in the house was not made clear in the listing.  Though we knew there would be another unit, there were several more upstairs and this could have been clearer.  Better than a hostel and a nice space but you may prefer having a place of (mostly) your own.

All the amenities of home are essentially present. Although we did not eat meals in the apartment it’s clearly equipped for breakfast lunch and dinner preparations. There are plenty of hangers in the closets which are spacious as well as ceiling fans and air conditioners in both bedrooms. The beds are quite comfortable and are as advertised being queen size. All linens and towels were clean and fresh. Unfortunately if you have limited exercise tolerance, unable to climb two flights of stairs ( a total of 40) you may miss out on this otherwise wonderful Airbnb.

The 4 of us enjoyed our stay. A very convenient and easy location, close to the N Western arterial. Easy to get to Edgewater for the events we were attending. Quiet and peaceful. An issue with linens was resolved quickly.
Had an enjoyable stay at Bernard’s place. Apartment was great and was as described, in the perfect neighborhood! Would definitely rebook when returning to Chicago.

Absolutely loved our stay! The place has great character and charm….yes squeaky floor boards, and small bathroom yet all the extra touches such as wonderful bath products made it a lovely stay! The bed was extremely comfortable too!! Thank you so much for a great stay; hope to book again!

Antonio was absolutely amazing, he sent very clear instructions a week before my stay so that I was prepared and knew how to get in.
He had a really cute pin board set up with all instructions needed with bins, WiFi, and food recommendations.
When our tv remote batteries hadn’t worked and I asked if there were spares, he kindly went out and bought some for use which I really appreciated!
The place was quite large, and definitely more than worth the price. It was very clean with endless appliances ready at hand, from pots and pans to cotton buds and an iron. Genuinely was a home all set and ready for us, with absolutely no issues.
Couldn’t be happier with my stay overall and would absolutely recommend.
We felt safe in the neighborhood, quiet and easy to access downtown

Place was very clean and cozy. Excellent accomodation for my group of 7.
Very close to public transportation and pretty safe area. We always felt great around the neighborhood.

Der Aufenthalt bein Yingjian hat und sehr
gut gefallen . Die Unterkunft ist sehr gut eingerichtet und ist sehr sauber .
Yingjian war sehr freundlich , hilfsbereit und stets schnell erreichbar.
Kurz und knapp, wir fühlten uns wie zu Hause . Sehr gerne wieder !!! J&O Becker
always a 10/10, can't wait until our next stay
Wonderful hosts, great place to stay. We will be back!

If you’re in a pickle, this is a decent stay. I give this a 3 star rating. Knocking off 2 stars because there was gross brown gooey stuff on the kitchen faucet and in the sink, dishes were dirty, and there was random plastic and dust on the bathroom floor next to the sink.
