The refuse room is at least 10 - 15 steps away from the studio but my last 2 evenings the hallway stank and I had to hold my breath every time I walked through. One evening the smell came into the studio and it was horrible.
Host is very responsive so that was a plus.
I was coming for a conference and booked this last minute because it was the only thing left in the area. It’s walking distance to McCormick place so that’s another plus. Felt safe walking in the area during day time but wouldn’t recommend at night. Not much to do in the area either
Great place. Thanks! Would definitely stay here again.

The place was great. Keeping water in the fridge for summer was great touch. Kitchen and toilet were well equipped. But beyond that, it was the host who made this stay superior. Always responsive, accommodating and helpful. Thank you Cindy for being a great host!

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was exceptionally clean and conveniently located just a 10-minute walk from the Pink Line, which gets you downtown in about 20–30 minutes. We appreciated that it was fully stocked with plenty of extra towels, linens, and blankets. The only minor area for improvement is the shower water pressure—while the water was nice and hot, the pressure was a bit low. On a sweeter note, the hosts left some snacks for us, which was a really thoughtful touch!
Muy buena comunicación muy limpio todo y buen sitio 👍🏽
The space was perfect for our needs! Very clean. Would recommend!

A nice 1 bedroom apartment that was in a convenient location. The apartment is incredibly noisy from traffic and outside noise on the street. Was very difficult to sleep and over the three nights I was in the house was woken up every night from noise outside. The windows are old single pane windows with almost no sound deadening. Recommend bringing ear plugs
Great stay. Clean and efficient. Host responsive. Would book again.

Awesome place
Good price
Clean, perfect location
Really comfortable- will book again

Not your typical Airbnb in all of the best ways. David has put a lot of thought into providing a memorable experience for his guests. From the description to the welcome message, thorough recommendations in the well-laid out guidebook, the decor, and the delightful little extras in the apartment once you check in, it's obvious David (and the team) have put their unique touch into hosting at Bustin' a Mauve and are committed to a good experience for their guests. Beyond the character infused throughout our experience, all of the other things you might look for in an Airbnb are there: We loved the walkable location and felt very safe. Transit is close by and getting into Chicago was easy. Lots of restaurants and shops close by. Check in instructions are super clear, host team was responsive, check out was a piece of cake. Five stars and hope to be back again sometime - thank you David!

My family and I enjoyed our stay at Jihad’s place! It has ground level entry which made it easy for our kids and unloading/loading of our luggage! There was also ample free parking at all times of day and night-rare for this area! The space was impeccably clean and super cozy.

Jeanie's place was quite awesome.  Lots of space in a great neighborhood with plenty of places nearby.   It was a cool dog friendly place just next door where I hung out at a couple of times.  Plus a nice dog friendly park right down the street where I meet a bunch of people closer to my age.

There were five of us for a long girls’ weekend getaway in Chicago. We found Jean’s place to be exactly as described, very clean with nice amenities, located in a great location in the Bucktown neighborhood. It was spacious and accommodated our group very well.
It was a 15” walk to the train station or a block from the bus stop. Very easy to get around. Jean communicated promptly and clearly to any inquiries.
We loved our stay there and would definitely stay there again. We all highly recommend Jean’s place!
Great stay

Very grateful to have stayed at Jessie's. As someone who is new to the country, when i first got there I felt at home immediately. Dee, the co-host, was incredibly welcoming and accommodating, genuinely a great guy. Jessie was also lovely, and so was her dog. I'd definitely recommend staying at this Airbnb! Also 10 min walk from the red line, so its handy to go downtown.

We had a wonderful stay! Our group consisted of 10 adults, 1 infant, 1 small dog and the apartment accommodated us comfortably. Two members of our group slept on the sofa, which we had discussed and agreed upon with the host before booking, so everything was exactly as expected. Garage is very perfect for 2 SUV .
The apartment was very clean, well organized, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. The location was excellent, only about 15 minutes from downtown Chicago.
Check-in and check-out were easy, and all instructions were clear.
Thank you to the host for the great hospitality.
We highly recommend this place, especially for larger groups, and would gladly stay here again.

Spencer was a wonderful host. He was very communicative and proactive with checking in about how our stay was going in. The house was lovely, extremely clean and spacious with so many beds to choose from. I'd highly recommend Spencer and this house to anyone in search of a large space in Chicago

We selected the condo b/c of convenience to a conference we were attending. It was clean, everything worked and Milan is a good/responsive communicator. Lots of restaurant options within walking distance and the L train is a few blocks away.
A real gem of an airbnb. Great neighborhood, so much great walkable food and drink, so close to Humboldt Park and easy to catch a bus. Would stay again.

My mom and I had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend Cody’s comfy getaway for your next trip to Chicago. Everything was clean, well-kept, and Cody was extremely accommodating. As soon as we arrived, Cody warmly greeted us and provided an overview of the place including showing us where to do our laundry. He also recommended local restaurants and places to visit that were easily walkable. We will certainly be back when we return to the Windy City!

La ubicación del depto es un barrio residencial muy tranquilo, que es a walking distance de todos los puntos importantes de la ciudad.
En cuanto al anfitrion, fue siemrpe super amable y contestaba muy rapido mis solicitudes. Llegamos antes del mediodia y si bien no pudimos hacer check in se nos permitio dejar el equipaje para poder salir a pasear.
En cuanto al equipamiento, el depto tiene absolutamente todo lo que se pueda necesitar, es muy completo
Tema a parte las camas, almohadas y ropa de cama, fue como dormir en las nubes. El descanso ideal después de tanta caminata.

We had a wonderful stay. The location is ideal, in a quiet and very pretty neighborhood. It’s a 7-minute walk from the subway—it’s great! There are several shops nearby.
The apartment is fantastic; we were a couple with a 2½-year-old child. The small backyard was very pleasant in the nice weather.
fue una estancia increíble!

We had a great stay in Wicker Park! The studio was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we were looking for. Ishin went above and beyond to make sure everything was in top-notch condition before we arrived, which was greatly appreciated.
Parking was a bit challenging at first, but after a few trips around the block we found a spot close by. Honestly, it gave us a chance to take in the neighborhood, do some window shopping, and explore the area a little more.
There are tons of great food options nearby, and the location makes it easy to enjoy everything Wicker Park has to offer. Overall, a fantastic stay and we would absolutely book here again.

We enjoyed our time at Sarah's house. Will stay again if we revisit the area. Great walking neighborhood w/ nice park and a variety of restaurants. Comfortably slept 5 people. Very clean home, a nice outside sitting area, easy parking. Comfortable beds and couches.
It was good to see that there were only limited steps if mobility was an issue.

Jennifer was very helpful in check-in, check-out, and questions that came up during our stay.
Her place had all the amenities of home. The kitchen was well stocked to make a breakfast before heading out for the day. The neighborhood was quiet which was helpful for a peaceful night sleep.
Lovely Airbnb and host!! Very clean and host was efficient and considerate. However, the area felt very unsafe and we did not feel very comfortable walking to the near by train
Loved this location and it was very clean and was accurately described. Hosts were extremely responsive and helpful.
Great place.. Second year staying for 5 months.. Hope to stay next year
Great place!
We really enjoyed our stay in this unit. The unit was very clean and exactly as described. We would definitely stay here again!

Pros: Location was great. Very safe and walkable. Host is very responsive.
Cons: Property itself is a little outdated and needs some work such as the floor bed at the entrance of the bathroom. I would say cleanliness can also be improved upon.

The place was very well appointed. We enjoyed the roominess and the access was great. The beds were very comfortable. I liked the seating in the living room, nice place to relax and read a good book. I would definitely recommend.
Thanks again Dave .
Juanita was super helpful and responded quickly!
easy check in. great neighborhood!

Overall, we had a good stay. The apartment was spacious, well-equipped, and the host was responsive and receptive whenever we raised concerns.
The main disappointment was that the windows only opened partially and the blinds were old and difficult to operate. Since the city view from the 25th floor was a major reason for booking this property, this significantly impacted our experience.
Another issue was the elevator outage. Having to walk down 25 floors with two young children and a stroller was extremely challenging. While I understand this was likely a building issue rather than the host's fault, it is an important consideration for guests staying on a high floor. I appreciated that the host responded promptly and provided compensation for the inconvenience.
A few smaller improvements would also help, such as newer towels and better stocking of toiletries for multi-night stays.
Overall, the apartment has great potential due to its size, location, and responsive host.

Very spacious loft - high ceiling, plenty of light, big rooms and clean bathrooms.
The parking is tricky - free parking outside is difficult to find. Downtown is a 10 min drive.
Also, early checkin and late checkout will always carry a charge, even if they have no reservations around yours. Apart from that, no complaints. Would highly recommend.
Great location with lots to do, and felt very private despite being in the middle of the city.
I was so pleased with my stay. Very friendly and welcoming hosts! The room and location was as described. They even came out to see me off and ask how I enjoyed my trip!
Easy check in with pictures to describe how to get to the specific apartment! Clean space and enough room for everyone! Great suggestions on local eats and attractions! Easy to communicate with.

Elizabeth’s place is spotless and comfortable. She goes above and beyond with little touches like eye masks, socks, and a bath sponge.
She is so nice, too. I will definitely stay here again next time I’m in Chicago.

Noel is an amazing host and the apartment was beautiful - well decorated and well organised. Getting to McCormick centre was easy too - 1 bus directly there. The surrounding neighbourhood is safe, has a lot of cool bars and restaurants and plenty to offer - highly recommend! :)
We had a great time, great location!
Awesome little spot! Right by restaurants and shops and would absolutely come back!
Definitely a decent place for a couple day stay where you just need a clean place to put your head down
Nathaly’s place was in a good location and matched the photos and descriptions! The host was very responsive and helpful. Definitely recommend staying here.

We traveled to Chicago for my child’s wedding and wanted something convenient to the venue and others who live in the area. One of the only places I could find that had convenient parking, which is a unicorn in the city. Coffee shop, CVS, and other places close by. Apartment amenities were great, especially 2 bathrooms (another unicorn). Owner is very responsive to messages and was willing to work with our arrival/departure times.

I loved the area and the unit! Everything was very clean and beautifully decorated. Vin made the entire process easy, starting with check-in and continuing throughout our stay. I would definitely stay here again!

Enjoyed my stay at Asif and Karyn’s home! They were so welcoming, and their house is beautiful, filled with unique art and curios from their travels. The bed was comfy and clean, the bathroom was modern and clean, and they have an excellent selection of teas. Location-wise, it’s not super close to Logan Square, but I found it very easy to hop on the bus that stops at the end of their street - it comes by all the time. The 606 elevated bike path is also nearby. Definitely would stay again!
Convenient 5 min drive from McCormick place, bright spacious apartment.

Ok, this is Chicago so I didnt have high expectations. Boy was I wrong. This place was great. Parking was easy. Check-in was a breeze. I travel a lot. I use airbnb a lot. This was one of the best stays I have ever had. The bed was absolutely perfect. Goldilocks perfect. The host, Cynthia, was incredible. The location was perfect. The only regret I had was leaving.  Thank you for making my weekend memorable.

Tuan’s space is great for a weekend trip. The space is on the top floor with two sets of small stairs. The bathroom sink was clogged and Tuan’s father was able to fix it quickly. Overall, good spot for the price and the Christmas tree in front of the home made it easy to find.
We had a good stay. Brad was always available & helpful.

A very comfortable place to stay in a great neighborhood. The loft is spacious, cozy, and equipped with everything you need as the description states. Incredible host who provides excellent support and professionalism and super responsive! The location is in a great area to explore the neighborhood!
Muy buen lugar y la ubicación es excelente.

i ran into a rat in this house in my original room and found it quite scary! silvia kindly moved me, although not reassuring me or believing me much. i genuinely believe this was a one off incident as the house is super clean, but it did affect my stay a little unfortunately.
Great stay for weekend in Chicago!
Amazing experience thank you Resolute Properties for adding to a great family Chicago trip. This is the place to be close to city and place was great.
nice apartment on a quiet block.
I enjoyed staying in the this amazing fort looking place. .
Phenomenal experience and host was always responsive to any questions. Will definitely stay again.

A wonderful stay in a wonderful neighborhood! We loved being so close to Sugar Moon Bakery among other many delicious and fun spots. This apartment was just right and beautiful. Thank you for the perfect place for our trip!

Enjoyed my stay at Vin’s place! Very clean home and quiet neighborhood. Cool local spots right near by. Everywhere I was looking to visit was a short drive away. Enjoyed my stay would definitely book again in the future. Thanks for being a great host!
A great space & location for a group trip to Chicago!
Very organized and easy to communicate with Silvia -- the accommodation was just as pictured and described.

We enjoyed our stay. The location was great, with Whole Foods, the lake and train steps away. The included numbered parking spot was a huge plus!  The apartment was clean and looked just like the photos. The beds were comfortable, the kitchen was great.  Communication was almost immediate, friendly and helpful.  The only thing I would recommend is to provide a few fans to help with cooling.

Love this listing would recommend definitely. Very responsive very caring host. Very proactive and very genuine and personable people. They care about what they do and it shows by their actions. I’d recommend this listing as a positive on air bnb. If you’re in the area definitely recommend staying here if you need a spot for the night or week or whatever the case.
Fantastic host, great communication. Right on the Redline. Lots of stairs but location makes it worth them.  Having a private parking garage is what really made a difference.

Daniel and Jennifer’s place were great. They were very flexible in accommodating our bags before we checked in. The location was amazing! There was so much to do, very walkable, close to a metro station. The only thing is that the train is very loud. Even with earplugs, it rattles the apartment. My partner adjusted to it but after 4 days, I was unable to get used to it.
Situated in a beautiful and walkable neighborhood with Wicker Park amenities nearby. Had the best time!

Very nice, well maintained rental- everything is like new, and amenities go above and beyond. Great location within walking distance to anything you could need. We dealt mostly with Diane, and she was very friendly and readily available for questions. Would highly recommend!!

Paul’s Cubby fan boy place is just right for cubby fans or White Sox fans, great place. Clean, very well located, fun visuals of Chicago and the Cubs memorabilia. Great walking location, we used rapid transit more here than in any other city. The red line is literally right around the corner. Takes you right to DTC and all its sights. Couldn’t recommend more. Definitely stay here again. Thanks Paul.

This apartment was great for our family weekend in Chicago. Easy to access and good location. The hosts are very responsive, friendly and accommodating. Look forward to staying here again in future visits to the city.

We had a wonderful stay!! Definitely would come back. Tracy was quick to respond to us and even gave us a late checkout. A little pricey but it is a popular location so totally understandable. Area is close to Wrigley and a bunch of restaurants/shops!
Terrific place, great host. Highly recommended.
El lugar es como se describe, muy cómodo y de fácil acceso.
Stay was great and hosts were very helpful and responsive. Would absolutely recommend

The hosts were very responsive which was very helpful. The place is cute but definitely dated. There are a few items that need to be repaired and once I notified them, they were quick to offer maintenance. We decided not to take them up on the maintenance issues because they didn’t affect our stay. But we appreciated their attentiveness and quick offering to fix it. I would recommend bringing bottled water. The tap water was not very good and the water filter didn’t work very well. Overall I’d stay here again.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Ashley's place.  She is responsive and clear in her communication.  The place was exactly as described - very clean, spacious and tucked in a quiet neighborhood.  We found the location perfect for the price.  It's a short 15 minute walk to two different blue line stops and all the businesses that line Milwaukee Ave.  We hope to make it back for another visit!
Very convenient for a UChicago-centered trip.

This was the perfect place for our five night stay in Chicago. It was a very close walking distance to Lincoln Square and very easy to get into town from the apartment. We really enjoyed getting to unwind in our own private space. We would recommend this space to anyone coming to visit Chicago.
Great!

The space was very clean and cute! We LOVED the neighborhood and it was really easy to take public transportation. The apartment has everything you will need for cooking and even had things like beach chairs and a small cooler. They really thought of everything. My only suggestion is, that if you are a light sleeper, maybe bring earplugs because I don’t think there is much insulation between floors and you can hear a lot from upstairs. Not conversations or anything, mainly just footsteps, doors, etc.
Anyways, I would highly recommend!

Great place close to McCormick center and metro.
Absolutely recommendable!
Great place, great location, excellent host!
Eric was very responsive & quickly took care of the one issue that arose (very minor issue). The space was nice and tidy, and the beds were comfortable. Thank you Eric I would definitely book again

My family had a great stay at Alberta's house with Lawrence. He was very attentive and checked in on us to make sure we were good. I've read the other reviews about the neighborhood being shady but it was not so. We felt completely comfortable, there's were no issues. Thank you, Lawrence!!!
Everything was wonderful! The host was very communicative, and the place was really clean. I would recommend! :)
It was an excellent stay. Very spacious and accessible. Easy to get to places. Owen was very accommodating and helpful.
Great, it is a basement so theres some walking around but still great
Wonderful place for a few nights. It’s probably one of the cleanest houses I’ve booked here.
Did the job! Needed a place to stay and was in a location necessary for what we came to Chicago for. Thank you!

Love the location, easy to board the blue line from the Airbnb (10 minute walk or so). Quiet, very clean and private. In a cute neighborhood. Friendly hosts that were very responsive and accommodating.

I would Highly Recommend this Airbnb.
Great Stay, Great Location, Very Clean Airbnb.😊
Thank you Roberto and Daisy For A Great Stay and Making our Family Feel Welcome! 😊

We had a great stay at TJ’s place! The home was exceptionally clean, spacious, and beautifully decorated. It was fully stocked with everything we needed, which made our stay very comfortable and convenient.
The location was fantastic just a short distance from Wrigley Field, too bad the cubs were playing away. TJ was an outstanding host: friendly, responsive, and incredibly helpful throughout our stay. Communication was quick and easy, and he went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed.
We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this property to anyone visiting Chicago!
Thank you
Jon
The house is in a very good location of Chicago. The place is small but clean and functional. The host was always communicative.
It’s a very good area and amazing stay definitely coming back

We enjoyed our stay.  The apartment was as described even if the pics were a little ‘glammed’ up.  The area was great with easy access to Michigan Avenue.  We used SpotHero to find parking as advised, which was easy.  We arrived on a Saturday and that evening someone was having what seemed like a rave on the rooftop or in a nearby room so the pulsing music made it difficult for our children to sleep.  I’m not sure if that’s the norm on a weekend but just something to be aware of.  We would return again!
Good place
Enjoyed our time in Chicago. Great location

Studio is in need of several repairs and new linen. The flooring is weak and feels like you will fall through in certain areas. The towels are thin, stained, and worn out. There was cat food on the floor upon arrival and animal and human hair on the furniture. Extremely bare bones accommodation and not worth the price in our opinion. Neighborhood was quiet, walkable and seemingly safe.

This was a funky place in a funky location. We could walk to plenty of restaurants, but we certainly weren’t in the heart of a great area.
The place itself was adequate for our needs. We loved the ping pong table, but the rest of the place felt as though it was done on the cheap. It was very noisy inside and out, and I didn’t love walking through all the garbage cans on the way to and from. That said, it delivered on its promise.
Great location within walking distance to many restaurants and the Logan Square L stop.  Clean and well stocked.

Besides Illinois AND Chicago taxes, very very reasonable.
Best part of the place was the location, and free parking was helpful!
The tv didn’t work very well (Netflix didn’t work and slow internet connection) and there were not fitted sheets for the pack n play but overall, nice stay.

We had a wonderful stay! Everything was exactly as described, and the home was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location was great, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We had everything we needed and truly enjoyed our time in Chicago. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this Airbnb to others!
Great spot. A short walk to public transport and good food options nearby made it really convenient. Comfortable space, easy to get around.

This is a beautiful and very clean apartment with lots of natural light and a large well stocked kitchen. It is located on a lovely quiet street in a wonderful area with lots of restaurants, cafes, and shops within walking distance.
The only negative to our stay was that the shower is missing its handle making it extremely difficult to operate. It was only through trial and error, and a frustratingly long time. that we were able to figure out how to make it work. We contacted Larry to tell him that the handle was missing and were surprised to find out that he was aware of the problem and yet does not make guests aware of the problem ahead of time or provide instructions for how to operate the shower in its current condition (it is not intuitive or easy to).
Great neighborhood. Very informative and accurate description

Marie was an excellent host with an amazing stay. Central to many great food and entertainment experiences and she communicated clearly and concisely the entire time . Wonderful stay and experience all around .

Wat een geweldige locatie! Als we 10 sterren konden geven, dan deden we dat! We voelden ons helemaal thuis en welkom bij Ken. Het appartement is centraal gelegen met zicht op de trail, een multi-functioneel parcour om de stad te doorkruisen. Wandelen, fietsen, hardlopen, het kan allemaal. Echt een aanrader!

We normally stay in Marriott hotels but coming in late May and early June, graduations caused Hotels to kick up rates to $400-$800 range. Jon charged a fair rate. His shower was wonderful with great water pressure. Staying 6 nights, having washer and dryer free access to use was wonderful. Walk to DeNucchi’s for wonderful Italian ( didn’t try Mario ‘s l, RH for brunch),  3 coasts  we went twice, Dairy Queen for soft serve,  tapas at BeBeRab, close to Lincoln Zoo & Oz park, Nice neighborhood with pride in landscaped gardens and beautiful flowers. It’s wonderful!

The home is beautiful! Looks like the house itself has history with a beautiful modern kitchen and bathroom upstairs. There is another bathroom downstairs that is very nice and spacious. The house is clean and the floor looks squeaky clean and beautiful. The host was very responsive and helpful when my family and I needed help or requested something from them. The hosts were very accommodating we appreciate it. Overall we enjoyed the house.
Clean and convenient!! Perfect location for our needs. Easy to access. Mera was lovely!

A fantastic location to spend some extended time and explore Chicago. An easy walk to the red line, at the foot of Wrigley field, and literally SO MUCH to do right around you! I couldn’t imagine a better spot to be. The apartment was super clean and super spacious and made for a perfect respite from the city when a rest was needed. Hope to visit again!

I had a great stay at Aitor’s place during my trip to Chicago. The apartment was exactly as described, very clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Check-in was smooth, communication was easy, and the location worked perfectly for exploring the city. Everything was well maintained, and I felt at home throughout my stay. I would definitely recommend staying here and would be happy to return in the future. Thanks again for a wonderful experience!

We had a fantastic stay at Heather’s place! The apartment is beautiful, and had everything we needed. The patio was adorable and we felt right at home. Heather was very responsive and helpful. The location was also fantastic - such a cute neighborhood! We’d definitely stay again.
Just an immaculate space. Very big. Very clean. Quiet. I enjoyed my stay

What a wonderful gem of a place to stay at! Very centrally located in Chicago nearby all kinds of lovely attractions. We came to explore the Field Museum, the Pokémon Fossil Museum in the Field Museum, Navy Piet and the Art Institute of Chicago! This lovely place is super close to the train and bus, you can get anywhere you need to go.
Everything was super cozy and comfortable. I loved the hosts provided ear plugs and a white noise sound machine. The spot had everything we needed! Thank you so much! Will come back and stay again when we are in town again!

This very clean, comfortable apartment has a superb location: close to the subway and buses, within walking distance of many shops and restaurants, the lake and zoo. The neighborhood is bustling but this building is on a surprisingly quiet side street. Ishin is very welcoming, communicates clearly, and eager to ensure a flawless stay. The kitchen is well stocked and all needed amenities provided; the bed is extremely comfortable. As other guests have mentioned, you may hear the upstairs neighbors but that is normal in older buildings. I opted to park on the street but every single day, even over a weekend, I found a space right in front. Definitely a great stay!
A charming and welcoming home in a beautiful part of Chicago! We loved it & plan to stay there again when we visit our son.

Yolanda’s place was very clean and comfortable and she’s a great host, very responsive snd friendly. The beds are comfortable and the place was spotless. Great location and garage was very helpful for us to be able to leave things in the car overnight.

The gardens are exceptionally beautiful. Loved the neighborhood.
Everything we needed.
We had a great time staying here!
Nice quiet neighborhood.  Comfy beds.
Beautiful place, plenty of room for our large group. Everything was as described and communication was perfect with the hosts. Safe, quiet and walkable.

The place is pretty accessible from downtown and worked out perfectly for us when we were visiting over a weekend to hit up touristy spots. The hosts were friendly and communicative and the check-in/check-out process was seamless. I'd recommend to anyone looking for a great value place to stay!
Hakim was very helpful and responsive. The kitchen was messy due to other tenants and with his help got a cleaner in within 2 days of request.
Dennis's place was a great find in a wonderful area! I greatly enjoyed my stay there and found his space to be cozy and exactly what I needed for my trip.
A great stay. Wilma obviously thinks about what her guests might need and works to supply it. Super neighborhood. Loved it.
Todo estuvo tal como lo describe el anuncio, la estación de metro está muy cerca y la cama es cómoda
We had a great stay. The neighborhood is lovely and quiet. The place is cute!
John is a great communicator and very hospitable.

We have stayed at Axel's Airbnbs 3 times now. Perfect for us. Very clean and comfortable. Brochures were nice touch. Instructions very clear.
Patricia

We rented the entire house for 6 days - it was perfect for our needs - the right number of bedrooms and bathrooms, overall space and proximity to our intended destinations. Also, compared to the other listings we saw, this was a great value.
We enjoyed the neighborhood and the wide variety of ethnic cuisines. On 3 occasions we walked to nearby restaurants; all were great.
I found Damien to be extremely responsive. Before our stay he was very quick to reply to any question posted by a member of our group. During our stay he was even better. Once there was a slight issue with a smoke detector. We messaged Damien, and within 30 minutes he was at the house with fresh batteries. I really enjoyed meeting Damien and learning his backstory.
This was my first airbnb rental and my expectations are now set. I hope all my future rentals live up to this high standard.
Dave's property was very nice for my first visit to Chicago. Quiet during the day/ night, I loved the laundry on site. This was a great stay!

The house was wonderful. Great location. Fully stocked kitchen. The reason I have for stars instead of fiber is because the third bed was a pull-out air mattress and as usual with air mattresses, halfway through the night it deflated and had to get off the bed and re-inflate it. So if you have more than 4 people staying there that is something to know and consider. Everything else was wonderful and I highly recommend staying here.

Will’s place was amazing. Perfect location with tons do to. Great spot to get a bunch of people together and enjoy the Windy City. Will’s place was clean when we arrived and just as shown in the pictures. Would definitely come back.
Really conveniently located location, about middle distance to all of the Wicker Park action areas.  Easy to walk but still a kind of quiet location.
They were very kind and helpful with us! We really enjoyed our stay here :)

This place was a hidden gem right near Wrigley. It was close enough for a larger group to have a private place to stay, but take a quick walk, bike or uber to the heart of Wrigley. It was clean, it was accessible, we had no issues. Host was thorough and responsive.
Very clean! Spacious. Everything you would need for a prolonged stay. She did an excellent job creating a comfortable space.
Excellent Airbnb. Very nice and clean. The street was quiet for a city apartment.
Amazing place to stay!!! Very clean, tidy and spacious!
Great stay in Lincoln Park. Easy access to train busses and all.
Kim’s space is absolutely beautiful. She has such beautiful taste and attention to detail. You cannot beat the area. I can’t wait to return.

Too
Much money was charged for the apt which was small woth constant train noise with trains passing on your head every few minutes sometimes too fast
We had a great stay in this Airbnb, bus stop is close by, McCormick place is 6 mins by cab, 20 mins by car. Very responsive host.

the home was very spacious. It was very close to the red line which was very convenient! Patricia allowed us to do an early check in which was nice. The only issue was that the handy man was there at 2 when we got there and no idea we got an early check in. The water pressure was not great but we were warned about that. overall we had a great time and my kids loved that we were close to Starbucks

Amazing to stay at Christopher’s Airbnb. His father was super kind in checking us in. You can tell they put a lot of thought into making it a comfortable place to stay— They had a keurig with coffee pods, lots of water bottles, blow dryer, etc. Very kind, flexible and great place to stay overall. <10 min walk to McCormick and close to near by buses to get to where you need to go! Great location and great job by the hosts!!
This was the perfect place for our weekend trip! The space was clean, spacious, and private! Will definitely stay again!

We had a fantastic stay in Chicago and would absolutely book this Airbnb again. The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully maintained. The location was one of the biggest highlights, making it easy to explore the neighborhood and city, whether we were grabbing food, sightseeing, or hopping on public transit.
The host was communicative, helpful, and made the entire process seamless from check-in through checkout. The accommodations had everything we needed for a comfortable stay, and it felt like a great home base for our 4-day trip.
Overall, this was a wonderful experience and a great value. We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago and looking for a convenient, comfortable place to stay. Thanks for helping make our trip so enjoyable!
Excellent stay, as described and great host.
Walkability to convention center was great. Space was clean, some cosmetic issues, the building itself needs an overhaul not the unit itself but the rest of the hallways etc. we enjoyed our stay.

We visited Chicago for a family event and stayed at Karen’s Airbnb. The home was just as described and photographed. Karen was proactive in communicating check-in and check out details, and very pleasant to communicate with. The home is in a neighborhood off from the main street. The street felt safe, peaceful and was very quiet. We would happily book Karen’s Airbnb when we visit Chicago again.
Very comfortable house in a safe neighbourhood. Easy to walk to lake and very accessible

Overall this BnB was great for the 6 of us stayed there. It’s in walking distance to McCormick Place and lots of other sites. I would say the only complaint any of us had were the outside noises from the neighbors above and Cantina Grill below.  Besides that the accommodations were great and we like the place quite well!
The host was readily available and accessible—I appreciated his clear, concise, and swift communication. The place is clean and perfectly supplied with everything necessary for a comfortable stay!

Excellent location, beautiful and lovely neighborhood. Easy check-in process and hosts are responsive. This is the perfect place to stay if you are on a budget and seeking a place to rest after spending most of the day exploring the city.
As mentioned in other reviews, please keep in mind the unit and building are older. The bathroom has low water pressure. The vertical blinds in the main room were missing some blinds.

We absolutely loved our stay here and felt right at home the moment we walked in with our group. The space was super clean, cozy, and comfortable. One of the best parts was the location. It was very convenient and just a short, easy walk to the Blue Line, which made getting into downtown Chicago a breeze.
A huge thank you to Alfredo for being such an accommodating and helpful host throughout our trip. He really made sure we had everything we needed. We highly recommend staying with him and would definitely book this place again in the future. Thanks for a great stay!

I booked Thomas’ place because my best friend and myself are traveling to Africa for two weeks and decided to spend the weekend in Chicago before flying out. His place was spacious, beautiful, extremely clean and exactly like the description.  We had a great time, and his place is a 20 minute walk from the orange line, a half a mile from the bus stop (bus 62) that will take you downtown. There are several super quaint restaurants, coffee shops, pizza (cowabunga) and Asian restaurants to eat at, grab a drink, listen to live music, and just hang out that is away from the busy Chicago  night life. I love the area that this air bnb is located and will definitely book it again when traveling through. Thank you Thomas for creating a beautiful, and peaceful rest haven for travelers.
Easy check in and check out, nice and quiet neighborhood, CTA is a 20 min walk away, residential setting, Joan communicated with us daily

We highly recommend Simon's house. It's clean, very well equipped and quiet. The host is very kind and helpful. Friendly and peaceful neighborhood. There is also a bonus: beautiful private garden and a porch!
We enjoyed our time at this clean, comfortable, and well-equipped unit.  Very safe and quiet neighborhood with easy parking. Easy walk to grocery stores and restaurants. Thank you for a great stay.

Guests should be aware that 2 of 3 bedrooms have walls that don't go all the way to the ceiling. Since this was a work trip, that made theweekend quite awkward.
Though comfortable, one of the beds is very low to the ground , which makes it difficult to get in and out of with mobility issues.
Additionally, when we first tried to book, they denied the booking until we filled out a questionnaire, then told me to rebook- at which point, someoneelse had booked the space. Luckily they had another unit available so that we were still able to book.
Overall, it was a fine stay, though in my opinion, a little pricey for the amount of space.

We were excited about this Airbnb but the experience fell short of expectations. The neighborhood is lovely with tree-lined streets and cute cafes — unfortunately the positives end there.
The property was more worn than the photos suggested, with walls overdue for repainting and visible signs of neglect throughout. The air conditioning was uneven and noisy, leaving some rooms too cold and others too warm.
What disappointed us most was the lack of attention to guest experience. We ran out of toilet paper and were told to check under the sinks and buy more ourselves — we found a nearly finished roll tossed in a cabinet. The house also sleeps three but comes with only one key, making the lockbox a recurring hassle.
At this price point, we expected a higher standard of comfort and hospitality. To the host: a little more care and preparation would go a long way.
It was fine
I had a great stay here. Very well kept and accurate to the photos. Very solid area with close bars and restaurants a short walk in any direction .
Great host

I can't recommend Jaime's BnB enough! The neighborhood is cozy, peaceful, and beautiful yet still within a short walking distance to anything you'd need!
Jaime was also so kind, friendly, and accommodating. It helped me feel much safer knowing that I had such a gracious host nearby in case I needed anything. I often travel alone, but this time had my baby brother with me, so I was even more on guard for safety concerns this trip. He helped us feel right at home and gave us great recommendations.
I highly recommend Jaime and his home to Chicago travelers - you won't be disappointed!

We had a great stay! The place was cozy, clean, and comfortable. The host was very helpful, responsive, and made the entire experience easy from check-in to check-out. The location was close to downtown Chicago and convenient for exploring the city. I would definitely recommend this stay to others and would be happy to stay here again.

Great place to stay with multigenerational family. Kids bedroom was adorable. Kids loved playing in the basement which had many games, puzzles, foosball, pool table, Barbie dream house. Walkable to Giant restaurant where wedding reception took place. Easy street parking and Palmer square park down the street.

Our stay was great and walkable distance to many places :) our host was super accommodating and helpful! I truly appreciate them being flexible with check in considering we arrived at 6 am! Thank you so much! We truly appreciate it and appreciated your beautiful place. We would definitely book again! Fresh towels, fresh linen, clean dish-ware, clean floors, and clean bathrooms! Amazing stay and definitely recommend:) thank you!
Comfortable place in a great, walkable location with many restaurants and bars nearby. Central and easy to get to many interesting neighborhoods!
I’ve stayed at J’s half a dozen times to visit family. Perfect home, perfect location, perfect experience, perfect host!
Great host!

Brandon was extremely helpful and relied without delay to all inquiries.
This is a lovely residential area with minimal noise and traffic, however easy walking distance to shopping, restaurants and other entertainment.
The beds were very comfortable and we had everything we needed for a lovely stay.

Well maintained flat. Location of the building is perfect to enjoy downtown life. Metro and Bus stations are at walkable distance. Many restaurants options are available surrounding to the building. The famous River walk is also at walkable distance. Host is very responsive and friendly. The only discomfort was car parking as the building doesn’t have any parking space and have to depend upon surrounding Pay & Park. However, I definitely would like to repeat the stay in future and also recommend to other guests.

We had a wonderful stay on Newark. The apartment was very clean with ample space and the perfect setup for our stay with a baby and toddler. The neighborhood is quiet with easy parking. There is also a small park just around the corner that provided easy entertainment.
Tara is an amazing host, welcoming, friendly, quick to respond and proactive in communication. The only slight inconvenience is there is no central AC, so we had to play temperature control to the weather. There are several fans provided throughout the unit and window AC units to keep it comfortable. We would love to stay again for our next trip to visit family!

We had a lovely stay at this Gold Coast apartment and would highly recommend it. The location is unbeatable, right in the heart of one of Chicago's most beautiful neighborhoods, with easy access to the lakefront, great dining, and shopping. The apartment itself is beautifully designed and well-furnished, making it a very comfortable place to come back to after a day of exploring. The host was responsive and attentive throughout, which made the whole experience easy and enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again.
Nice location, great stay.

Really cute place in a very good location! This spot was great for my weekend stay in Chicago and easy to get to the brown line. The bedrooms get some light and sound at night from a little alleyway right next to them, but it’s  no big deal with an eye mask
Place was great! Very home like feelings. Check in and out was easy. Felt safe during our entire stay. Michael communicated and checked up during our stay and I thought that was great! Thank you

Le logement était parfait pour notre séjour.
Le métro était à proximité.
Uriel est très réactif et compréhensif.
Je recommande à 100%.

Unfortunately this Airbnb did not meet our expectations. The exterior of the house appeared neglected and gave an unwelcoming first impression. The garage area was messy with a significant amount of leaves and debris on the flwas oor. We were also unable to use the garage door opener because it did not work.
Inside the house the floors were extremely squeaky , which was noticeable throughout our stay and made it difficult to move around quietly . While the home may have potential it would benefit from maintenance and attention to upkeep. Based on our experience the property did not match the standard we expected
Convenient location, comfortable spacious apartment. Very responsive to any concerns.
Teddy was a phenomenal host! Great location near the blue line. Everything was clean and organized. Seamless check in with great communication.
Had a really nice stay. The place was clean and comfortable, and Victor was friendly and easy to communicate with.
We really loved having the quiet,  comfortable, accessible space to ourselves. Great location and fun, responsive host. We'd love to come back!

I stayed here for my moms birthday trip. I booked it specifically for the views and closeness to the bus/subway lines. Beautiful place, easy to get to and the views were gorgeous. As soon as the sun sets, turn out the lights and enjoy!

The place was really confortable. We had a great time relaxing after long day visiting the city.
There is good division from upstairs and downstairs. So you can go to bed and the rest of the team can still hang downstairs.
Be aware that the room at the front of the house is at direct level of the highway so it's noisy. Train and traffic sounds come through.
Street parking was no issue.

Noelle was a delightful host! Always making sure we were comfortable and had what we needed without being intrusive. When we had an iron that didn’t work, Noelle was right there with a replacement.
There were fresh flowers, cookies, plenty of coffee, sparkling water and even a bottle of wine when we arrived! All 5 of us thoroughly enjoyed our stay and appreciated the lovely home, location and friendly neighbors. We definitely and highly recommend this place.

Had a great stay here! The Airbnb was very nice, clean, and comfortable. The host was extremely responsive and helpful throughout the stay. I also loved that markets, stores, and restaurants were all within walking distance, which made everything super convenient. Definitely a place I would recommend and book again!
The place was spacious and very clean. Hosts were very friendly.

Ryan was very responsive throughout our stay and usually replied within an hour. The house has a separate entrance on the right side that leads to the basement one bedroom, which is clean, comfortable, and equipped with modern amenities. You can tell a lot of effort went into making the space feel stylish and updated.
The shower was excellent, and while the bathroom isn't attached to the bedroom, it wasn't a big issue for us. I had forgotten that the unit doesn't have a dishwasher, but since we didn't do any cooking, it didn't matter. We did use the microwave to reheat some amazing Chicago deep-dish pizza, though!
Ryan also recommended a nearby coffee shop, Dark Matter Star Lounge, which was only about a 5-minute walk away. We ended up walking there every morning for great coffee and really enjoyed the neighborhood strolls.
It's about 15 minutes from downtown, and I'd recommend booking parking in advance if you're driving into the city. Overall, it was a good place to stay!
We really enjoyed this apartment. It was close to public transportation and spacious.

I hate to give this stay a lower score for the check-in, but the system specifically asked for one and Mark had his dates mixed up and hadn't given me the check-in code by the time I got there. Everything else was flawless, so I'm very confident this was a one-time glitch. Otherwise, the place is roomy and quiet and clean , the bed is super-comfortable, and the shower had hot water right away and a very soothing spray coming out of the nozzle. I love Andersonville, and the Airbnb is literally one block east of Clark, the main thoroughfare where all the restaurants, shopping and good vibes are. Plus the street parking is free and not zoned--which is a huge plus.
Super cute and we loved the area. Lots of great restaurants around and the host was super helpful!

This is a great place from which to experience Chicago. Great location, very walkable. I felt very much at home.
Mark is as a good a host as you could ever hope for. Very responsive and works hard to make sure you are comfortable.
Great back yard and porch. The street parking is not nearly as hard to deal with as other neighborhoods. Always found a spot with a block (usually less).
Do note the bedrooms are very small, but other spaces are spacious and comfortable. The office was very handy for work.
It was a great two month stay, one I will never forget.

We had a wonderful stay, with plenty of room for 6 adults and a toddler. We enjoyed walking around the beautiful neighborhood. The bathrooms are gorgeous and the kitchen was roomy and well-supplied. Both bathrooms and the kitchen were really clean, which we truly appreciated. The only (very minor) downside--The furniture had quite a lot of dust buildup, so I wish there had been supplies to clean it. Otherwise, a fabulous stay!
Place was nice and as described. Neighborhood was nice, even had a great Italian restaurant as well as a freeway entrance close by. Parking was easy. Could park right in front of the house.

My stay in this Chicago home was amazing. It was clean, well decorated, and extremely spacious. The host communicated quickly and was helpful throughout the entire trip. The home is a bit away from the places we visited but it was worth it to live comfortably.

Great location!  Beautiful neighborhood and  very close to UChicago.  Also within walking distance to shops/restaurants in the surrounding area.  Bennett was very responsive and helpful when I fumbled with the wrong lockbox.  Would definitely see if this location is available again the next time I need to be at UChicago.
The apartment was as described. Clean and in a great neighborhood. Communication was prompt and helpful. Perfect for a long reunion weekend with friends.
Alejandro was a great host. Great and safe location.

We had a good stay. The home was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was  very responsive, helpful, and made the check-in and check- out process very easy. The location was convenient, in a spot minutes away from lots of stores and the home had pretty much everything we needed for our stay. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to future guests!

La casa es muy bonita, zona tranquila y bien conectada,  me hubiera gustado conocer a tippi no contestó ni el mensaje de despedida, solo la pude ver al llegar ya que estaba confundido con mi habitación, me indicó donde era y eso fue todo
The place was wonderful. It was clean, instructions were clear, and perfect for what we needed. Proximity to downtown was not as close as I initially thought it would be, but we made it work.

We stayed here during the conference and everyone loved it! It is a beautiful house with great rooms, lots of space and a very nice garden where you could sit there for the whole day (if not for the conference). It’s also 15min drive to McCormick Place so super easy for us. Caryl is super helpful and responsive though we didn’t have any questions or issues anyway. A absolutely five star choice! Look forward to staying here again same time next year ~
The location was perfect!  Even though the airbnb is on a busy street, the apartment was very, very quiet.  Lovely little spot.  Highly recommend!
This was one of the most beautiful homes I’ve stayed in! Location, amenities, historical home and community, great walking distance to south side museums and lake access. I can’t wait to visit again!
We had a great time at this apartment. Very spacious, comfortable and a good location to walk to the parks and museums.

We were here for a convention and the place was perfect for getting to and from the convention center. Great amount of space and very comfortable. All of the instructions were clear and we felt right at home!
Great place for our group! would stay again!
Host was super responsive and helpful with any questions, wonderful location centrally located. Super spacious home if youre looking for a fun weekend with your friends or family

Loud noises and people talking loudly throughout the night made me feel uncomfortable and unable to sleep. I felt unsafe and ended up leaving the next day instead of completing my stay. I had to find alternative accommodations on short notice. Unfortunately, disappointing experience. Would not recommend for women traveling alone.

Meighan's home was the perfect place for us to stay for a weekend in Chicago. The home is thoughtfully decorated throughout, with cool eclectic art and plants that make it feel actually lived in. The yard is gorgeous, and we spent a lot of time just hanging out on the patio. Finally, Logan Square is a rad neighborhood, quiet but close to lots of cool restaurants and things to do.

India’s place was very conveniently located right by the blue line which was perfect for us. It was very clean and comfortable. We had a few issues with the keypad entry system but otherwise it was a great stay.
We had a great stay! The place is as described, clean, and well maintained. The neighborhood has lots of great restaurants within walking distance.

Sarah and Drew’s space was super chill and quiet.  It is super convenient to transit, particularly if you are attending events at Rate Field.  The instructions were excellent and easy to follow.  I would definitely consider staying there again.
I loved this Airbnb and the owner(s)! Everything was as pictured and the host(s) were so kind and friendly! I will definitely come back to Chicago just to stay at this Airbnb again honestly.

This is a large, beautiful space on a street with established trees and charming city dwellings, easy walking distance to Uptown features and to CTA transportation.
Besides the photographed amenities. Trove provided a pleasing variety of books, games and puzzles in the cabinet in the living room. The living room seating is at a height comfortable for short people, and a little challenging for the elderly (me).
They also provide white noise machines in each bedroom, and two for the large bedroom in back, next to the unit's very valuable parking place. The noise machines worked. We slept well on comfortable linens, even though this house backs directly on the clickety-clackety elevated train tracks for the Red Line, which provides service at all hours every day.
Trove needs tell prospective renters about the constant train noise, but I have not been able to come up with a way to do so while preserving the reality of this unit's tranquility. Maybe this review will serve.

Anastasia was an amazing host - she was responsive and allowed us to drop the luggage’s off before the check-in time. The Airbnb was exactly like the photos and was clean. The neighborhood was nice to walk around (with great coffee shops!) and was safe. Worth the price, considering that other options in Downtown Chicago were extremely pricey. It takes about an hour to get to the loop through public transportation but it’s very accessible and uber is always an option. The only downside is that the walls are very thin so it might be difficult to sleep in if you are a light sleeper.

Very nice, clean, newly remodeled unit in a great location for our 3-night weekend in Chicago.
The bus going into downtown was right in front of the apartment, which was extremely convenient for quick public transport. The free parking in the private garage was an added bonus.
The West Town neighborhood had a lot of restaurants and bars you could walk to.
The unit is above a barbershop, and Fabri there gave me a great haircut and shave. I recommend him if you need a cut!
I will say the walls are a little thin. During the day you can hear music from the barbershop, and at night you can hear the movement from the apartment above. This wasn’t a problem for us since we were out during the day, but it's just something to keep in mind if you are a light sleeper.
The hosts were very friendly and communicative. We had no issues during our stay, but my guess is that Andriy would’ve been very helpful if any problems had come up. I’d definitely stay here again in the future. Thanks!

Laura's place was wonderful. It was spacious and beautiful inside with modern decor and finishes – we felt right at home. She was a responsive host and provided us with everything we needed. The entry door was just a little odd at first, but was not an issue at all throughout the stay. Highly recommend Laura's place!

We had a great stay at Henok's place. Very spacious and in peaceful neighborhood. It was relatively close to public transport as well. Henok was very helpful and responsive for any questions or concerns we had during our stay!
Nicely renovated garden apartment.  Clean and well appointed.
We enjoyed and were very comfortable.
Loved our stay. Nice breakfast - more than I expected, and snacks were available 24/7. Very clean room and beautiful bathroom. Very responsive host.
The apartment is new, modern and clean. All the equipments are easy to use. The space is large - especially the beds. I enjoy my experience very much.
We had a pleasant stay, the apartment was in a great location and we really liked it for our trip!

The location cannot be beat! Edgewater is a lovely, walkable neighborhood that’s quieter and more laid back than neighborhoods closer to downtown, but which still has nearby access to great restaurants and cafes. Also being right across the street from the beach and lake trail is super convenient!
The unit itself is fine. There were a few issues as detailed below, but otherwise it was sufficient - bed was comfortable, it has a nice full kitchen, and plenty of bath towels as well as all necessary bathing essentials.
It could use some maintenance like a fresh paint job and the blinds were in disrepair, which is unfortunate as the missing blinds provide a direct view to the bed from the neighboring unit, however the host intends to fix this. The shower is pretty finicky as you have to finagle the knob to find the right spot to get anything other than freezing water, but it only gets to lukewarm, not hot.
Despite the issues, I’d stay again if the blinds were fixed as price is decent.

Vlad is easily the best host I've ever booked a space with and the space itself was perfect! I'd recommend this space to anyone.
The space was beautiful, spacious, and clean and my spouse and I loved every detail of the place. We loved the modern comforts of the space and appreciated the decor and artwork. We felt welcomed to the space immediately!
You can tell Vlad loves to host people and wants to make sure your stay is memorable. He recommended some great restaurants around Chicago and we enjoyed one of the best meals while we were there from his recommendation. We had a chance to talk with Vlad during our stay and he was the best! He's a great human being and would gladly stay at his space again.
we enjoyed our stay very much and would love to stay again when we visit.
Everything about this abnb was great. Thank you

I would stay here again in a heartbeat! This was a fantastic place to come back to after a day out in downtown. It had plenty of room for our group of friends to play board games and watch tv in the evenings. Everything was clean and well taken care of. Highly recommend!
Had a great stay, quiet neighborhood and close to downtown.
Great stay overall. Allende's home was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. Easy check-in, good communication, and a comfortable experience. Allende was very friendly and accomodating.

Absolutely recommend!!! We loved our time at Belinda’s! The home was absolutely pleasant, very clean and quiet. I made a friend… with the neighbor. That right there makes staying here so much more. Community! I wish I would’ve had time to enjoy the back patio, it was nicely situated. Location is also perfect, easy access to the highway and to Afro Joe’s for a fantastic cup of coffee and vibes.
Belinda was very responsive, even with just the little things. When it comes to a home you will always have a question, to make sure. I absolutely appreciated the immediate responses. We had everything we needed and so much more. Thank you Belinda for everything! We had a great stay and look forward to returning.

Hanna and Mark were excellent and accommodating hosts. They were quick to communicate and respond to all of our needs. Instructions for check in and check out were clear and concise, user friendly with photos. The area is also full of many great restaurants and shops, very close to the train for easy access to the rest of the city. Would highly recommend this home for anyone staying in Chicago.
A really nice stay. I wish the wifi was a bit better but that is so minor.

The apartment was such a cool spot for my work trip to Chicago.  It is at the penthouse level and has amazing views of Willis Tower and the lake.  The view from the deck is even better. The building is quiet, most tenants seem to be young professionals.  The location does not get a lot of traffic but is walkable to a lot of great restaurants, cafes, and Chicago Lanmarks. I was able to easily incorporate sightseeing on my morning walks to see Cloud Gate, Willis Tower, Solider Field, Lake  Michigan and pick up great coffee along the way! The apartment itself was clean and decorated just as the photos show. The in-house washer and dryer is a huge plus. The hostess was wonderful.  She was very on top of things, instructions were very details and organized, and extremely helpful with recommendations.  This is a hidden gem that I will come back to the next time I am in Chicago!
Clean home, very communicative host.

Gleatha’s place is classy!  She has amazing art from all over the world.  There’s also a bed, futon, and pull out couch. The red leather couch is so comfortable.  There are multiple Roku TVs and you can rent the in-home theater!  There’s a deep bathtub and plenty of coffee and drinks.  It’s a large space on the bottom floor.  And a super location to get to the Lake by walking and also to explore Bronzeville.

I had a last-minute res. after many hours of travel, arriving on the morning of the second day. Jessie and another host (I believe Shujaa) were consistently responsive and helpful before arrival, and remained attentive throughout the coordination, which I appreciate.
However, the check-in experience on-site was very disappointing. The access code provided did not work, and the co-host on arrival was rude, dismissive, and unprofessional. Communication was confusing, with conflicting explanations about the address and access details, and I was repeatedly told I “would not understand” instead of being assisted. At one point, there was also an inappropriate comment about my nationality. He introduced himself as D, or Z.
The room itself was acceptable for the price, but cleanliness needs improvement, including the bedding, bathroom condition, and missing smoke alarms. Overall, the stay was significantly impacted by the co-host’s dismissive attitude, despite good initial communication.
Great place. Just as advertised. Was worried parking would be hassle but never parked more than a block away. Didn’t try Mexican restaurant in the building but heard good reviews.
Had the best stay at Thomas and Elizabeth’s! The property is gorgeous and that rooftop is something special. Wonderful hosts, too. Can’t recommend it enough!
Lovely place to stay for a long weekend

Aaron’s rental was the perfect stay for a long weekend in Chicago! Such a unique place, essentially like staying in an immersive art gallery. Great proximity and walkability; only a couple blocks from Wrigley. I would definitely return and recommend to others. Perfect for a couple or solo traveler!
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was easy, and the host was responsive. Would definitely stay here again.

Great stay!! Easy to take transportation to everything and really comfortable area to have teens & kids in! Lots of things around you and everything is only a short train or bus ride away if you want to go further! Host was responsive to everything and gave information to make check in easy.
Would highly recommend - beautiful place and great location.
Host was very responsive and eager to help. Location is great and walkable to everything you need.
Spacious, super clean place with everything listed. Great location and responsive host.

The location of the house was very convenient for walking to a large variety of restaurants, cafes, bars, etc. The house was located in a beautiful neighborhood and we felt safe during our stay. My only recommendation would be to pay slightly more attention to the cleanliness of the house, but otherwise we loved how cozy the place felt!
By far the best Airbnb that I’ve stayed at! The bed was very cozy and that made all the difference for me.
Wonderful, family oriented place to stay. Place was beautiful, and exactly as pictured. Would stay again.
beautiful home on a peaceful street. very cozy and much larger living space than expected. located in a great spot with many things to do; great stay! do not hesitate to book. see you next time

We immensely enjoyed staying at Molly's place during our time in Chicago. It was a pleasure to be in such a beautifully curated apartment with a refreshing balcony canopied by green trees. Molly was warm, kind, and a gracious host. Her banana bread in the morning was divine and she always made sure we had everything we needed during our stay.
The location was absolutely gorgeous, situated in the historic Kenwood neighborhood amongst beautiful 19th century mansions, each with their own unique charm. The Metra station was a 5 minute walk away, allowing us to ride into the heart of downtown Chicago within minutes and we also were able to take leisurely walks to the center of the University of Chicago's campus on multiple occasions.
We hope to come back to Molly's next time we are in Chicago!

During my short stay in Chicago, I had a lovey memory staying at Paul’s place. The place is beautiful and clean. It’s also vey convenient for taking bus to downtown, doing grocery like Traderjoes and target (3 min walk). Most time the neighborhood was quiet and i slept very well there. Although the dryer was broken at the moment, totally it doesn’t affect my overall great experience!

Great place. Host exceptionally communicative. Only complaint is that the apartment was a bit messy upon arrival - leftover trash from prior reservation but nothing egregious. Would recommend staying, very convenient location!

Overall, I would not stay at this Airbnb again. The location is definitely a strong point—it's in a prime area if you're looking for a night out or planning to catch a Cubs game.
Unfortunately, the property itself did not meet our expectations. Upon arrival, I didn't find it to be particularly clean. The floors felt quite dirty, and walking around in white socks for a short period of time left them noticeably stained. The bathrooms were generally acceptable, but the bathroom I used had black dirt or mold-like stains around the window that could have used more attention. We also noticed bugs throughout the unit, which was concerning.
After staying one night, I chose to stay at my brother-in-law's Airbnb down the street for the remainder of the trip, while two members of my group stayed because they had an early flight the next morning. I would also advise future guests to manage their expectations, as the property we arrived at did not feel consistent with the photos shown online.

Great stay. Host was very responsive to us when we had a question or needed something. House looks exactly like the photos.
We had three vehicles so it was hard to find great parking in front of the house on the weekend but a spot would open every hour or so so it wasn’t a huge problem.
Other than that, the stay was comfortable and it was nice to be close to the loop without being in it all the time.
Really nice and communicative host i recommend this spot will be rebooking!

Colby and Donald are great hosts.  The place was clean, cared for and comfortable.  Great location close to stores, cafes, restaurants and the pink 'L' train.  It's in the Pilsen area, which is vibrant, fun, and busy - a great neighbourhood.  The train is only about 10 to 15 minutes to downtown.
Super convenient being so close to everything downtown. Decent neighborhood felt safe walking to get coffee every morning.

Tracy's home is absolutely gorgeous! The space is upstairs and private, though it doesn't have a private entrance. The bathroom is beautiful and the bed is one of the most comfortable I've slept on. Tracy and her family were very kind and welcoming. This place is on my list for when I'm visiting Chicago again.

I had a wonderful stay at Bob and Rachel’s duplex. The space was clean, comfortable, and well thought out, with two floors, two bathrooms, and a fully stocked kitchen that made everything very convenient. There were plenty of towels and extra blankets, which added to the comfort of the stay.
I also really appreciated their flexibility in extending checkout on short notice due to my late flight. I’d absolutely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago.

Great location within walking distance of the University of Chicago. The host was responsive, accommodating, and very helpful throughout our stay. The space was spacious, comfortable, and worked perfectly for our group of six. Thank you for a wonderful experience—we would love to come back again!

Great location and neighborhood. Regina was responsive, communicative, and incredibly friendly throughout our stay. She also checked in during our visit to make sure we had everything we needed, which was greatly appreciated. Check-in was seamless, and the instructions were clear and easy to follow.
Peacefully appointment bedroom in a great location. Thank you David!
The house was beautiful and the neighborhood was safe!
great host and great space!
Amazing place, definitely I would stay again
The host was extremely polite and communicative. The property was very nice and in a quiet neighborhood

Beautiful home nestled away in the Latin quarter of Chicago. It’s a bit further away than I had imagined from our work location but it was honestly worth it since there was always parking available in the area.

pros: Very responsive host, very friendly, nice neighborhood.
cons: Had to share bathroom with other housemates which was not ideal as they would spend a lot of time in bathroom. Once couldn't even brush my teeth. Wish this sharing of bathroom was clearly advertised.
Great place, spacious, neat… had everything we needed! The host was really nice and helpful with everything we needed.

We loved our stay at the Greenleaf! It was great for our family of five. We appreciated the large dining table, the beautiful porch, the quiet neighborhood, and the ample street parking. Take a lovely 20-min or so walk to the Lake.

Extremely good location for walkable Chicago attractions. However need to have maintain furniture and room. Example all 4 chairs of dinning table were extremely wobbly. Balcony was unclean with dust on chairs. Felt clumsy in living room with alot of furniture arranged. Overall had good stay.
The location made it easy to get to and from the Convention Center. I would definitely book again.

The apartment was perfect for what we needed. Everything was clean and Dan was quick to respond to any questions we had. The neighbourhood doesn’t feel the safest, so while the blue line is a 10 minute walk away, getting taxis and Ubers are definitely the safest option.

Had a great stay at Angelica‘s place in Chicago. The location is fantastic with walkable access to the train and lots of local amenities. Everything was in good shape, the memory foam mattresses are comfortable enough though a bit firm, it’s hard to have them to everyone’s liking. Kitchen was well appointed and super clean and easy to use. Would definitely stay here again!
Very cozy vibes! Host was very responsive and the location was great!
Michael’s home was amazing! He spared no expense on the beds, pillows and all amenities. We’ll definitely return during our next visit to Chicago!

We had a wonderful time staying at Sezgin's airbnb. The room was much larger than expected, and it was very beautiful and incredibly clean. The neighborhood was very walkable and very close to public transportation. We would highly recommend this airbnb to anyone!

Very clean with plenty of amenities.  Great free parking options (garage/uncovered).  Great neighborhood.  Not too much noise.  Cynthia was very personable and responsive.  My stay was truly a 5 star experience and would go back.
This was a clean, well laid-out apartment in an extremely walkable and safe area. If you’re fine without any charm or design details, it’ll be a good fit. The host was communicative and helpful!
Super nice. I plan on staying again.
Was very easy to communicate with host both before and after check-in. The location and place was convenient and pleasant to stay

The pictures really don’t do the justice on how great the place looks. If you’re debating on picking a place to stay this is the one! Carla was very great with communication and clear instructions in be helpful with check in and check out.

The host was so kind and worked with me when I came to help my son. I loved the place!  It was a nice respite in the busy busy!  Beautiful bathroom and kitchen. Comfortable bed and everything you need. We will stay here again. Thanks again so much.
Great place to stay - spotless, comfy and convenient. Looking forward to staying again!

Pros: Amazing location, comfortable amount of space, beautiful home. Back porch is nice, neighborhood is very walkable, public transportation is close. So much to do in the neighborhood.
Cons: The second bedroom's bed frame was broken, so we couldn't turn it into a queen/king size, which we were counting on. We made it work, and the mattresses were comfortable, but it would've been nice to know that was broken in advance.
There were a few other small weird things, but overall it was a nice spot to stay at. The pros outweighed the cons.
Solid lodging in a very nice chic neighborhood of Chicago! Host was always available and checked in with me every step of the way.
Everything was just fine! I was in town for the OPC, so this was very conveniently located for me. Clean space, quiet block, super responsive and kind host. Would stay here again!

The flat was very comfortable and David was a very kind and responsive host. I do think it's important to note that this apartment is in a building with a few other tenants that are NOT on vacation, so their routines of getting up for work and/or taking their dog out early in the morning, etc do not stop just because you are on vacation. You will very likely be woken up at 6am because the person living above this flat is awake and their floor is your ceiling. Also, the locks on the doors are pretty old... you are probably going to spend time jiggling keys around praying to a deity that the door will open. Always take both sets of keys with you when you leave the apartment! That being said, this really was a nice space and the host was very helpful when I called in desperation thinking I couldn't get in.
It is an amazing cozy and comfortable apartment. With very good access to transport to the rest of the city.
Amazing location, close to restaurants and very easy to get to Damen station. Paul's place had everything we needed and was able to check in early due to a flight change!

Gabrielle’s place was perfect for the 2 of us for our short trip. Great location right on the blue line, but very quiet. Beautiful yard. Loved the bathroom! We found everything we needed was in the unit. Gabrielle and furry assistants were great hosts!
Loved our stay here! Close to the train, incredible food options, easy walk to the lake. An amazing find! Hope to come back to Chicago soon.
Great place. Would stay again

Carolina's place was perfect for our family of 5. It was spacious enough for all of us, our luggage, and extra belongings from my Daughter, who just had moved out of her apartment.
Carolina was great to work with! She always responded, answered all of my questions, and was so generous in allowing us a late check out!
And, Carolina was so thoughtful, as we were greeted with Graduation balloons when we checked in!
I highly recommend Carolina's place. And will definitely stay here again!

I had an excellent stay at this apartment. It was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The location was convenient and quiet, and communication with the host was smooth and prompt. Everything matched the description perfectly. I highly recommend it and would gladly stay here again.

Wonderful accommodations for our large group for a long weekend.   Room for all to spread out and relax.  Photos of the space were just as we found it, whoop!! Parking access was a little tricky but we were provided more instructions at check in, which truly helped!  Folks were quick to reply, which is very  appreciated.
Nice and spacious place to stay with a larger party.

I really enjoyed staying at Min’s place! The Airbnb was clean and had everything we needed.
