The bed was comfortable and even though the neighborhood is bustling with a lot to do, the street was quiet. Public transit was easy to access and there was also street parking. I would absolutely stay here again!
We loved our stay. Clean bathrooms and bedrooms. Easy & very comfortable. Linong was super responsive and kind. We had not been to Chicago & it was perfect for us. 1 mile away from Chinatown.

This is a great little gem near Logan Square!Extremely close to the Belmont blue line station, but the neighborhood is calm and quiet, and nice to walk through. Mara’s place was easy to find and we had no issues checking in or out. Bed was comfortable, AC kept the place at a good temp, and the whole unit was nicely decorated. Mara was always kind and friendly, and I appreciated pictures of doors and walkways to assist with locating everything for check in. This was the perfect place to spend a weekend in!
would stay again. Very close to things to do.
It was a nice and clean it look like the photo it wasn’t to far from downtown.

I visited Chicago for the first time this past weekend and had a great time. My stay at Sarah's was great. She was friendly and clear with all the instructions to check in & out of the home. I appreciate the time she took to put together a list of recommendations. I didnt have enough time to check out every single spot but the ones I did, were awesome. The home was very clean, had everything I needed for my stay & included snacks, thanks! I recommend staying at Sarah's and if you need any guidance, shes one of the best!
Great view and super responsive assistance.

"The location of this Airbnb is absolute perfection. It’s just a short walk to the lakefront beach and nestled in a very safe, walkable neighborhood. You also have quick access to downtown via public transit or a rideshare. The unit itself was spotless, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly communicative. Highly recommend!"

Easily the best Airbnb I’ve ever booked! John was an awesome host who was quick to answer questions and assist when needed. Comfortable beds, clean bathrooms, organized kitchen with all utensils and plates, and easy walking distance to parks and the train. Not the quietest (street noise and thin floors/walls), but was perfect for our group of seven (four adults + three kids). Washer and dryer came in clutch after a day at the beach!
It was a little pricey, but so is everything these days. We had plenty of space and didn’t feel like we were on top of one another, and we used almost every amenity available. So all-in-all, it was worth it! Highly recommend!
Very responsive and kind host. However, the place looked a bit undone. Lamps unplugged and difficult to plug in. Fan not working - unused furniture in closest. Drawers were dirty.
強烈推薦如果要去McCormick place開會的人可以預訂！有自己獨立的衛浴設備，乾淨的房間，離會場走路只有20分鐘、開車6分鐘左右的距離。很推薦給大家：）
I’mfamiliar with the neighborhood so this was a good choice for me to meet up with old friends. Zoe’ place was just as advertised and she was super responsive for any questions or concerns!

Sandra’s place was just as described and it was a relief to arrive to a nice place after a long drive. The place had amenities and was clean and well appointed, but not cluttered. I am always grateful for a nice shower and drain that works! Some reviews said the furniture was uncomfortable. That was true of the living area, but the beds were comfortable for us, and the overall place was quite cozy after time out in the city. The price level was incredibly reasonable given the impossibility of finding that great of a space near downtown and most attractions. Having an affordable and safe space to keep our car was awesome, and allowed us to travel by Uber/Lyft, worry-free! We will absolutely stay here if we get the chance every time we come to Chicago!
Joan’s apartment was the perfect place for our needs. Very spacious, very clean, and she communicated with us very well! We would definitely stay here again! Thank you so much!
Stella was an amazing host! Great location! Great stay!
LaKesha was very responsive and we had great stay time!
Justin & Danah were great hosts! They both were attentive, had quick response times and very accommodating to our travel.
Beautiful, Spacious and meticulously kept home. Our stay was exemplary in every way!
Beautiful area with tons of things to do in walking distance, lovely place and quiet neighbors.
Loved the stay! Nicole was a great hostess.

La estancia es tal como se describe, la zona es tranquila, llegar al centro de Chicago te tomará en transporte público 50 minutos, es muy fácil llegar. El baño y las zonas públicas (cocina y sala) son compartidas. Buen lugar comparando el precio.
Very good place
Very communicative and accomodating!

Everything about this experience was perfection! The unit is gorgeous! I could live there :) We were in town for a wedding at Navy Pier so we didn't get to spend as much time in Andersonville as I would've liked. Honestly, I wish we could've stayed longer to hang out more. Kory responded faster than any host I've ever dealt with. She made our stay absolutely wonderful! I highly recommend Kory's apartment!!!
well worth it. perfect for what we needed. clean! would definitely recommend
Great location- right by El stop and close to the River Walk and Lake.  Clean, as pictured, perfect!
Great stay - the unit was as pictured, clean, and comfortable. The neighborhood was quiet and walkable. Close to transport and dining. A very enjoyable stay.
Great place and location

This was my first booking with Airbnb and I can honestly say I was satisfied. I brought in my 30th birthday with friends and we enjoyed the place. It was very roomy , clean ,exactly like the pictures. I loved that the host had a binder of the surrounding area for guest to check out any local attractions/restaurants. I would definitely book again.

My friend and I enjoyed our stay at the CozyNest Airbnb. The access to public transportation was convient and was nice to have free street parking. The accommodations were satisfactory and accurate to as listed. The sofa bed was not the most comfortable but that might to be expected. Overall we enjoyed our time and the host was very willing to help!
Truly a tranquil and restful stay. Street parking was easy to find and the location is fantastic.
Super responsive host with a clean place in a nice neighborhood restaurants liquor stores and bars all within walking distance tons of free street parking in the surrounding neighborhood
Very good place
Fantastic location easily walkable to great shops and restaurants but also very quiet.
We really enjoyed this AirBNB! It was very spacious and in a quiet neighborhood just a few minutes’ walk away from great stuff to do in Wicker.

We really enjoyed staying at Kevin's place to celebrate the engagement of our son.  Both families stayed at the Airbnb and it was a wonderful way to spend time together.   There is a lot of great common spaces (porch, living room, kitchen, and  rooftop deck).  The place was super clean, roomy, and it was in a great location in Old Town, right next to Lincoln  Park.  The beds were comfortable as well.  Kevin was always responsive when we checked in with him.

This was by far one of the worst Airbnb experiences I’ve had. FYI this listing is actually a cluttered basement. The listing was extremely misleading and did not match what was advertised (Entire home). Access to the property became an issue, and communication with the host was inconsistent and unhelpful when problems came up.
Because of this, I was forced to book a hotel last minute, which completely disrupted my plans and caused unnecessary stress. Thankfully, Airbnb had to step in and issue a full refund along with reimbursement for my hotel stay — that alone should tell you how serious the situation was.
I would strongly recommend future guests think twice before booking here. Transparency and reliability matter, and unfortunately, this host did not deliver either.
Great location! Very walkable and close to the train as well. Amazing restaurants in the West Loop area. Parth was responsive and helpful! Great space for 5 of us. Would definitely return!

I only get 1000 characters, which is NOT enough to tell potential guests how incredible this place is. Every detail is intentionally placed and thought out. The neighborhood was incredible, quiet. It’s residential, but if you don’t mind walking a bit, there are some wonderful shops, restaurants. We got a 3day CTA pass, which worked out brilliantly. The public transportation is intuitive, clean and everyone was overly friendly. Couple hiccups with the bus…. 🤷🏼‍♀️. But totally fine.
Instructions were clear and simple. Of course we cleaned up, but there are no complicated instructions to check out, etc— the hosts seem pretty chill (so I urge any guests to also be chill). Bathroom is gorgeous. Shower was lovely. Bed/bedroom is very dark; bed is comfortable and firm, kitchen is amazing. The refrigerator 😍. The kitchen floor tile, stunning. We found ourselves at the desk with some wine in the evening.
Last thing— their recs were on point. I’m out of characters, so I hope I made my point❤

Wow! What a great place to stay. The home is beautiful. The space was clean and thoughtfully put together. We were able to park the car and use public transport the entire weekend. Andris communicated at every stage of the visit. This was a perfect solution for a stay in Chicago. I would definitely book again.

if you have the opportunity to stay at PINK HOUSE, do it.  6 out of 5 stars. incredible hosts, phenomenal location in Wicker Park with a wide variety of bars/restaurants/shops. The house is beyond charming, immaculately clean and stylized beautifully. I've stayed in quite a few air bnb / vrbos and can definitely say i have never felt more welcome in a place that wasn't my own home. Next time I'm back in Chicago I will be searching for Pink House first.  Thank you so much once again to Niki and Sean, (and Curtis) we hope to see you again!
Great housing  had a smooth simple stay not far from downtown Chicago

The place was aesthetic with a beautiful indoor and outdoor space, perfect to enjoy your stay in Chicago. It was quiet and peaceful. All the areas were clean and ready to use. Would choose this place again in the future.

I liked the wide open feeling of Hector’s property and the many spaces for the seven of us to gather. The area was very walkable, with lots of restaurants and coffee shops just steps away. Hector was very responsive to our needs.
Great place and close to the metra if you need to get to the city! This was a great location for us and we would stay again!
Everything was impeccable
Alana' place felt like an extension of my home. I would definitely recommend her place if you want a nice peaceful place centrally located.
Awesome place.  Loved it!
Home away from home for our big family! The kids felt so comfortable at this home. We look forward to returning someday!
Very great experience for the family , highly recommend, would do again in a heartbeat. Carrie was very helpful with local knowledge, and helped my family feel at home the entire trip.
Great location and lots of space. We had 7 adults and a baby and it was plenty of room.
Convenient location for flying in and out of O’hare; loved the forest preserve only a mile away!

Lovely 2 bedroom close to everything you need in Chicago! Russ was super communicative and was a truly kind and thoughtful host. The best instructions and direction to getting into the place and using everything inside. He even left us a frozen pizza because our flight got super delayed. Couldn’t have asked for a better landing pad in a beautiful neighborhood!

Elegant design and ease of flow.  Excellent bed linens (best I’ve slept in ages!).  The air quality and temperatures were wonderful. The location was wonderful-favorite coffee shop is steps away, and Greektown dining a quick stroll. We’re planning to return!
Great place to stay in Chicago! Close to downtown with cute cafes and restaurants nearby. Parking was tight but great to have.
The perfect spot to stay in Chicago, very walkable with great coffee shops and restaurants right around the corner. The space was amazing.
Nice place

The inside is as described. The issues are mostly about getting inside.  Poor (actually no) instructions to find the garage which is in an alley off Fry street.  The ally is busy. Twice I had to walk down it to ask trucks to move so I could get in / out.  The garage had a couch propped up against the wall among other stuff making it hard to fit cars.  The stairs from the garage to place and from Chicago Avenue up to the place are filthy and result in tracking in dust (left a trail of footprints). The key & locks make it hard to depart from the garage & return a key to the lockbox (drive around from back to the front). They need to properly clean the entry spaces (no matter that the back one is shared with other businesses) plus put a lockbox in the back.  Also the 1st floor business has music going all night long.  While not loud, you can hear base /drum beat thumping.  Know the street can be rowdy with let’s just say “interesting” behavior.  This is Chicago after all.
We plan on staying there again
Amazing location! Super walkable and easy enough to take the blue line/uber to downtown or anywhere else in the Ukrainian village.
Thank you Habib for the great stay! Your home was very comfortable and provided everything we needed.
Cute house, easy to get to and easy to street park. The stairs are steep. There is no outlet in one of the bedrooms which wasn’t a big deal, we charged phones in the other room.
This place was very secure and spotless. The neighborhood is very quiet and the house makes you feel right at home. I would definitely book again.

The location was very convenient for me as it was only about a 10 minute walk to the pink line and the bus stop I needed. I liked the grocery stores nearby and the plentiful Mexican food. I felt safe walking at night back to the Airbnb from the bus stop.  There were never any noises when I was sleeping, the neighbors are quiet. The bed is very comfortable and the place was very clean. I would recommend staying here.

Ce logement est très bien. À moins de 20 minutes de marche de la ligne bleue (subway de l’aéroport). Aussi, À moins de 15 minutes de marche de la station Kimball (ligne brune), c’était facile de se rendre downtown et revenir. Le quartier est tranquille avec tout ce qui est nécessaire à proximité (station essence, dépanneur, pharmacie, etc.). Le logement est hyper privé. C’est un sous-sol complet, petit, mais confortable. Vous avez le droit à une mini-terrasse ainsi qu’un stationnement en prime. Puis, pour ce qui est des hôtes, ils ont été très flexibles avec notre arrivé. La communication était impeccable. Ils sont hyper gentils. Définitif que je recommande ce logement et je passerai le mot à mon entourage. Merci encore 🥰.

We stayed at this Airbnb last weekend and found it to be very spacious, with plenty of room to relax and enjoy our stay. However, the property is showing its age and could benefit from some updates and maintenance.
The kitchen light and several living room lights were not working during our visit, which made those areas feel a bit dark. Overall, the home seems a little worn and would greatly benefit from a fresh coat of paint and some general TLC.
While the space itself has a lot of potential and was comfortable in terms of size, a few improvements would make for a much better guest experience.
The location was great for us which was important for our stay. The host was responsive and offered to send someone to come look at the lights. We decided not to have them look at it as we were not around much but I wanted him to know so he could address it for the next person. It was nice to have the garage space and it is pet friendly which is a plus!
I really enjoyed being there; it was really peaceful!!!
Great Place to stay. Everything is walkable or just a few mins away in taxi!
Great spot near Wrigleyville -- not fancy but fits 7 people easily and everything works as expected. Communication great with host and check in instructions easy to follow.

Perfect host. Communicated extremely well from booking to checkout.
Would use again and recommend to others
Very quiet area and very spacious! The hosts were so friendly and helpful! Highly recommend if you want to feel at home in Chicago.
Great host. Friendly and welcoming. Lovely basement apartment with windows and light. Has all the amenities needed in a spotless apartment.

Although it wasn’t really the hosts fault, we got locked out at 3 am by another guest (they locked the storm door, so there was no way for us to unlock the front door). Host Jen happened to be awake and tried to help us over the phone. We were instructed to try to break in through the windows. After that was unsuccessful, next was to climb over landscaping, find a lock box, and try every key (none worked). She offered us to stay in a separate unit with no access to our belongings for the night as the only other option. We ended up banging on the door and windows until another guest woke up and let us in (40+ minutes). A neighbor came out and yelled at us to be quiet 🥲 We did not want to disturb anyone, but there was no other way to unlock the door. That whole experience was very upsetting and had us quite distraught. If Jen or the other guest were not awake, we would have been stranded outside with dead phones. It should not be possible for guests to lock each other out :/
Very helpful ! Very nice and cozy spot she responded very fast and was an amazing host. Check in and check out was very easy, everything on the tv was already logged in. Enjoyed my stay!!!
Communication was clear and frequent! Place was amazing for our group size!! Hardwood floors and simple furniture was beautiful!

I loved the stay!
The location was great, had a lot of good places around, and safe even at night.
The host was so nice and showed me around the house and condo in person. He was also very responsive throughout my 1 month stay.
The house was cozy, fully furnished, and I did not have to buy anything for a month. I am sorry I couldn’t stay longer here.
If I come back to Chicago, I would definitely stay here again.
Jason was easy to communicate with and we had a great stay!

This place was very clean and everything looks like the picture. It s a nice spot to stay in and is very reasonably priced. Although, when I did check out the unit upon arrival, there is a back door that was unlocked and when I opened it there was someone sitting right outside the door. It startled me, but I was able to lock the door and go about my way. Another thing was having the unit to ourselves, but still being around others, like a duplex. The walls were thin so we could hear the people above us and even people outside during the day. Last thing was location, it’s not too far from the airport but kind of far from downtown in terms of having to uber. You’d have to really plan out your whole day so that you get the most out of Chicago before coming back to the spot. Among all of that Latarsha is very nice and very helpful. We had a couple of technical difficulties with getting in touch with each other at first, but we got that fixed and everything was cool!

I would come back in a heartbeat.
The apartment is perfect. The communication with Lissette was super easy and she responded within a few minutes.
The neighborhood was super quiet and the blue line station just a few steps away.
Would recommend this place anytime.
Excellent spot for our family of five to set up camp for a long weekend. Plenty to do and easy access to transportation. Great hosts and clean. We’ll be back!

The place was nice and cute. Was confusing to get into at first but figured it out eventually. It is on the top floor of the building so if you have some heavy luggage you might need some help. Parking is street only and we didn’t have a problem the first day but the second day we couldn’t find parking at all. Especially after 7PM. The apartment overall was okay for the price and the location

We absolutely loved staying at Svaha. Margret's place was comfortable and inviting but also stylish and sophisticated. It reminded my partner and me of staying in London. The location was superb and although it can be an adventure, the blue line from O'Hare was moderately quick. There are so many good restaurants close by and the back patio provides a lovely space for eating in. I definitely recommend this Airbnb for anyone wanting to stay in Chicago.
I had a great stay! Thank you!
Enrique is a great host!   Very responsive and frequently checked in.  The home was larger than expected, very clean and comfortable and was with access of everywhere we needed to be.

Great place that has the ideal mix of being quiet, secure and “just out of the way enough” while still being conveniently located near pretty much anything you’d need or want. Big plus is the neighborhood grocery store next door, the gas stations around the block, and the coffee shop across the street. And it can’t be overstated how clean and comfortable Joe’s place is. A welcoming BnB with an equally welcoming host.

This place was not worth what we paid. I try to be chill and understanding with hosts but this company did not do a good job. Most of our group felt like we may as well have stayed at a motel or a hostel based on the terrible experience.
The space was pretty tiny overall. We even had hard time fitting our suitcases in bedrooms
There are three bedrooms. The walls aren’t floor to ceiling for two out of the three bedrooms. The third bedroom (which is the only one with a window) has paper thin blinds and made it impossible to get sleep in once the sun rose
One of the bedrooms has a bathroom and the toilet did not flush properly. We reached out to the host, they asked for a video and then didn’t hear back
The elevators are super slow and both pretty small
Gym in complex doesn’t have much equipment and the water refill station had a dirty filter. Reached out to staff and they said they would take care of it but did not do so during our stay
More to say but out of space! 0 stars!
Clean, well-stocked flat with very comfortable beds and clear check-in/out instructions. Would stay here again!
Very lovely house!

Beautiful, walkable neighborhood with a transit stop around the corner. Kathleen takes really great care of her home and yard, and her dog is a good boy. Basement apartment feels very secluded from the rest of the house and stays nice and cool. We really enjoyed being away from the hustle and noise of popular Chicago neighborhoods without sacrificing transit time or amenities. 15/10 would do again
Great location for our needs! Central and spacious for everyone. Loft was a great value for the neighborhood and accommodated a larger group well.

Rich was a great host! He was very responsive and flexible regarding check in time. We initially thought there were no trash bags at the house (later found them hidden), he came up with solutions and offered to reimburse us for our time and effort. Good price for the location.
It’s was really nice and we had, great communication

Loved our stay here! Alex was a great host and very accommodating. The place is exactly as described and the fire pit was amazing for a relaxing, chilly evening. My friends and I came to go wedding dress shopping and the location was perfect for going into the city and surrounding suburbs. Highly recommend staying here!

I appreciated many things about this spot. Really really clean. Very comfortable. A dorm size mini fridge in the room.
I was able to walk to my daughter’s apartment about a mile away easily and safely. I was also able to easily ride the train. Very, very convenient.
I was in the apartment by myself all weekend, as far as I could tell. I did communicate with the host on several occasions, and he was very helpful with my questions.
We did struggle a little bit to find the right apartment building because the signage/street number was not obvious to us. Once we knew we had the right place though it was no problem getting the key and getting in and out of the unit.
It’s a third floor walk up, so be mindful of that. Also, if you don’t have a MetroCard already, you need to make sure you find the entrance where you can buy one. Some entrances do not have an option to purchase.
I would definitely stay here again. I didn’t think it was a bargain, but I did appreciate all that it included.

Stayed here for a week before I could move into my summer apartment. Marissa's place was extremely clean, in a great and safe neighborhood walking distance to my work. There were many great food options as well and walking distance to public transport. Me and my family enjoyed staying here and I'm excited to be back in August!

Elizabeth fue muy amable siempre al pendiente de cualquier cosa que necesitáramos y flexible en permitirnos dejara las maletas para regresar después por ella ya que habíamos hecho check out. Recomiendo 100% el lugar

Amazingly close to UC, which was so convenient as we had two back to back concerts. Very kind host. Sounds from downstairs travelled on occasion, but we weren’t there often enough in the day for it to be a problem. There was a notable amount of stairs, which wasn’t a problem for us, but may be for some guests. Overall, great stay!

Super cute and affordable. Place was a little far out from downtown but it was super accessible to the buses. Inside was super clean and had our own private bathroom which was great. Good bed and provided fan and AC! Would recommend, good value!
Great apartment, well-stocked for a family with young kids. Hosts were also very helpful. Recommended.
Close to the pink line and lots of restaurants within walking distance!

Had such a great stay! It was the perfect location for the wedding we were attending. It was super comfortable and cute. Samuel was helpful and responsive. I would recommend to anyone staying in Chicago! Thanks again!

Everything was amazing staying here. Mario & Priscilla were extremely responsive and communication was easy. The place was clean, in a GREAT location, matched photos, and beds were comfortable. Parking was also easy to find available. All in all was perfect and for a very reasonable price.
Such a wonderful stay at a charming apartment - in the best neighborhood in Chicago!

Everything was well communicated and well planned out. Host was very quick to help and always available and friendly, all amenities were there to live comfortable and clean the apartment every weekend

Great place and host! Clean, spacious, and well decorated. Neighborhood is quite nice, lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance. Very convenient to have garage parking. Laundry is shared so can be busy but not too bad. Definitely recommend.

Had a great stay at Vin’s. He was very accommodating. His place is a cute little spot for two people for our short stay. Just like other reviews, there really isn’t much natural light but not a deal breaker. We enjoyed our stay, thank you Vin!
Great spot with a great host!  I had a car with me so the availability of street parking was deluxe
The stay was perfect for me and my family of 3. The dining room table was perfect for family dinners. The location was conveniently located between several CTA lines!

Hanna and Mark were great hosts. Their unit was pristine, spacious, and well stocked with everything we needed to feel at home. The space felt peaceful and private despite being on a busy street—perfect for our group of 5. We appreciated the close proximity to the highway and the ability to find street parking.
Really appreciated how communicative Tenna and Michael were. At one point even helped us get a much-needed iron on short notice. Fairly convenient drive from the McCormick convention center.

The apartments were great and the hosts were very communicative! The units were on separate floors, which was not an issue just surprising. Plenty of space between the two units, the en suite closets were big enough that an air mattress fit for a little more separate space to sleep for one of the guests in our group. Check-in/out was super easy with the key locker.

Charlie's place is in a beautiful neighborhood--quiet, shaded by big trees, many nice houses. The room, which I appreciated for its affordable price, had a comfy bed, mirror, big closet, nice amenities like a bathrobe and extra water bottles.
The only thing that didn't work well for me was the shared bathroom. I haven't tried this before at an Airbnb. The cleanliness level wasn't what I expected. Nothing major, just things like a puddle on the sink, old grime by the door handle, toilet seat left up. Not as clean as bathrooms I've shared at friends' houses or other Airbnb's. Also I expected from the description there might be more than one guest at the house and we would share the bathroom. But I never saw anyone, only heard the sound of a person briefly in the bathroom. I was only at the house in the late evening and early morning, but it felt odd not knowing who was sharing the bathroom.

Really nice place. Comfy bed. I’d actually like to know what the beds were.
Nice shower. (Could go for more pressure)
Didn’t use the kitchen but I did check it out and everything you could want or need to make a meal was there. Appliances are nice. Dishes were nice.
The location felt a bit sketchy. But with how the security was set up it felt safe. Nobody in the group felt on edge or in any danger or fear as the place itself was very secure.
I will say the garage parking situation is tight. I brought my BMW X5M on the trip and it’s a rather wide vehicle. This made for entering and exiting the parking space incredibly difficult. It’s a shared garage and the space has two concrete pillars on one side of you and another car on the other. If the other car doesn’t give you some wiggle room you’ll be stuck. Thankfully I’m a pretty skinny guy.
Very quick highway access so this made accessing downtown easier.
All in all I would recommend staying here.
Thank you so much! We had a great stay!
This place was a perfect stay for a very chill bride and bridesmaids in town for a wedding. Beautiful, spacious, and close to everything we needed!

Great, clean place to stay! Nothing fancy, but close to all the shops and restaurants. Raul was very friendly, gave us easy instructions, and gave us local recommendations for our trip which was a great bonus we weren’t expecting! We would stay here again.

I had an amazing stay and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The home was peaceful, clean, and exactly as pictured in the listing. Everything I needed was provided, including towels, toiletries, and kitchen essentials, which made the stay comfortable and stress-free. The location was also fantastic. The Pink Line station is just a short walk away, making it easy to get around Chicago without a car. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

I enjoyed my stay! First time in the city, first time staying at a shareable place and the hosts made me feel very welcomed. Fast replies, place exactly like pictures and not far away from things. I definitely recommend!!
Great space, great location, great host.  Will repeat!
No WiFi and A/c unit didn’t work

Kristin is a host who cares and goes above and beyond for her guests. We were treated with a nice bottle of wine from Kristin. Her home is immaculate, updated and modern and we will definitely be staying here again.
Good location and value - close enough to downtown yet far away enough from the traffic, super easy instructions and check in

We really enjoyed our stay. We hope to be back again!
We were there for a wedding and it was a perfect location for the venue. A little coffee shop around the corner was a fun walk. We want to come back and explore more. :-)
Thanks Mary!
Extremely responsive and helpful host! The house was in a great location, clean, and very spacious. Was perfect for our trip!

Fantastic place to stay in Chicago for the week. Easy and safe walking distance to all the great restaurant options in Fulton Market and just a quick ride share away to the downtown sights. Having the Jewel Osco grocery store a short walk away was very convenient. The balcony and view from the corner apartment were incredible and everything inside was comfortable and as described. Really glad we chose this place and loved our time there!
The apartment was beautiful and had everything we needed. For a brief moment, we were missing some towels however the owner was very quick to respond and was able to bring us towels fairly quickly.
had a wonderful stay at this adorable place. great location for asian food and near a cute park.

Tom was a very gracious host for my bachelor party. The communication was always timely and clear, the location was near most things you’d want to do in the city, the condo itself was fun and nice, and we all felt safe on the area. We had a group of 13 of us. As long as you’re ok with large couches or sharing beds there was plenty of space. It was a good experience.

Not sure I’d recommend. We were locked out when we got there bc we were given incomplete instructions to get in. They couldn’t tell us how to get in & it was 11pm so luckily we could reach around & literally break in by opening it from the inside. Place was hot when we got in so turned on the AC. Didn’t seem to work so turned on the window units which helped. Found out the next day the AC wasn’t working & we weren’t informed. So I was contacted & reminded multiple times that day to turn off the window units now that the AC was fixed. Management wanted to come in & remove them while we were away & I said no thanks. Construction started below us with music blaring at 730AM Friday morning. The Mexican restaurant next door decided to throw a rager from 12:30-5:30 AM Sunday morning. Blasting music & screaming for hours. So much for the noise restrictions supposedly in place. I know it’s an older place but water seemed questionable for drinking. Awful smell. Looks nice but missed the mark

We loved staying at Joanne's place. It was so comfortable, spacious, and a great spot close to lots of delicious restaurants. The neighborhood is quiet, and it's easy to walk to many places. We appreciated her thorough instructions, she responded quickly, and we would stay here again. We were nervous about the basement apartment, but this was a beautiful place - very clean, no basement smell - and it's been wonderfully curated with all you could need. We appreciated the snacks she had for us, and there's grocery stores very close by. Easy to pick up anything you need.

Ubytování bylo příjemné a zcela odpovídalo popisu a fotkám. Nachází se v klidné, hezké čtvrti se snadnou dostupností do centra. Bradley zodpověděl případné dotazy a vyšel nám vstříc s dřívějším ubytováním.
Bob is the GOAT
Everything is very good
Lovely place, quiet and comfortable but walkable to anything we could have wanted for a long weekend visit. Would stay again.

Gorgeous condo, well equipped and good location
Hosts were super helpful and responsive
Would definitely recommend

Natalie was very responsive - we had issues with the smoke detector and she was quick to give us a replacement. The place is spacious and convenient - walking distance to lots of food and shopping, and easy to get to the airport or downtown.
Great stay for a girls trip! We walked around for dinner, shopping, and coffee. Our group of 8 fit comfortably!
We enjoyed our stay at this home, and it was an exceptional Airbnb,  Marco and Sarah provided great accommodations, we would defiantly recommend  staying here.

Unfortunately, my experience at this Airbnb was disappointing. Communication from the host was poor throughout the stay, making it difficult to get timely responses to questions and concerns. The bathroom was not cleaned to an acceptable standard upon arrival, and there was a persistent smell of cigarette smoke coming from neighboring units that frequently drifted into the space. These issues significantly impacted the comfort and enjoyment of my stay. I believe there is considerable room for improvement in cleanliness, communication, and addressing environmental concerns that affect guests. Based on my experience, I would not choose to stay here again.
Was a great stay. Don’t judge a book by its cover.
Geo was responsive and the location was perfect for what I needed. Quiet apt close to everything I needed.

Was a fabulous location for us and a great value. Katherine was a great host and was responsive, available and friendly. Absolutely loved the fresh flower arrangement. It was beautiful!  Would highly recommend this unit.

What a find! This garden apartment was the perfect home base for our trip.  A gorgeous location right on Lincoln Park - definitely one of the nicest and safest areas of Chicago. The apartment itself was beautifully appointed, comfortable bed and couch, quality linens.  Microwave and mini fridge were all we needed. The owner lives above and definitely has rambunctious little ones running around in the morning.  If you’re going to hate the noise be warned- but to me it’s part of staying in a ground floor space and it was worth it for how lovely it was. Would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Everything completely and totally met our expectations. There were ample supplies of everything like dishes, towels, toiletries, etc. The beds were comfortable. We were always able to find street parking within very easy walking distance.

James’ place was as described. It looked like the pictures. It felt safe and a street off the main thoroughfare, which helped feel more secure. The hot tub is on the roof with an enjoyable common area. The sunrise and sunset gave amazing views and pics! We felt right at home, and we will see if it’s available next time we come to Chicago.
Just as described. Ryan was very attentive and responded quickly.
Great price and amazing location right next to the blue line. Robert was responsive and communicative throughout our stay.

The apartment is very well located, closed to public transport and the area is very peaceful and safe. Plenty of street parking and restaurants nearby
The apartment is very clean, spacious and has everything you need

A beautiful place in an incredible location! The location is really what made it for us. We had some trouble getting in but Michael was very quick to respond. We appreciated the cleanliness and loved the touches for kids (bunk bed, books, etc.) we would recommend this place to others!
It’s alright. Nothing incredible, but worth the price.
Um lugar ,uy bonito y acogedor cómo en casa
Very comfy and cozy place to stay. We loved the area and had a great weekend!
Great place! Very accessible to the 606 and restaurants/coffee shops in Logan Square. Unit had everything we needed during our stay.

It’s a nice place for a family in a fun neighborhood. Buses and trains within walking distance to take you downtown. Loads of towels and toilet paper!  Kitchen is adequately stocked. Laundry room.  We got an early check in.  Communication was just ok.  You would get an immediate reply, but the answer would be “ I’ll get back to you” but they didn’t get back to us.  More light  the living room would be great.  Mattresses weren’t great but ok. The bedrooms had big closets but no hangers.  It’s a three flat so you are going to get a bit of noise from neighbors, but they were great.  Highly recommend
Was a great place to stay!
Nice place at a reasonable price. Quiet neighborhood. Easy access to restaurants and public transport.
Clean place & comfy! Didn’t notice that there were TVs in some bedrooms so that was a plus! The garage was a great amenity to have.

This is a wonderful place to stay with a large group or family. The beds were clean and comfortable. The house in general was also clean and comfortable. The owner and property manager were extremely timely with all communication and prompt in the one issue we faced with the coffee makers. He had 2 new makers out within an hr for all us avid coffee drinkers.
We didn't cook, made a Costco run and had hot food delivered so I can't really speak to cooking but it does have 2 kitchens and lots of coffee mugs.
Parking can be a gamble for close spots but it's a safe neighborhood and with 5 cars in our party (2 large SUV's) we didn't park further than a block away.
The price point is amazing for a large group and the amenities for people not expecting tons of frills is great!
Wonderful place to stay in a fun, walkable neighborhood. Highly recommend!
Great spot right next to the pink line. Perfect place for a weekend trip to Chicago without being directly downtown. Plenty to do in the neighborhood and surroundings as well.

Good place to stay, overall. I wasn't there long enough to make full use of the amenities but there was a full kitchen and clean bath/shower. Just a keurig though, no electric kettle.
Recommended.
Enjoyed our stay, very well decorated and great location

8 of us friends loved staying at Teddy’s place in Wrigleyville. Parking was SUCH a breeze for all 5 cars. The neighborhood was so cute and so quiet. It is SO CLOSE TO THE TRAIN which made getting around the city SO EASY. Lots of cute places nearby. Teddy was super proactive with communication. They helped us get parking passes sorted out (we’re from Indy and parking passes are a daunting foreign language). The back deck was amazing. The setup was great overall. The welcome setup was amazing—eye masks and ear plugs were CLUTCH because we always have issues sleeping when on vacation. Getting in and out was a BREEZE (love the Schlage locks). Could not recommend this place enough. It was so convenient for us to bop around town, but it was also quiet and cozy and spacious and perfect for when we wanted to just chill. Plus, with most hosts going CRAZY these days with check-out processes, Teddy’s process was a DREAM.
Lovely home not far from city. Lots of families and schools surrounding

What a wonderful stay I had. Jessie is a gem and gets to you quickly! I usually don’t stay at places with a shared bathroom but she made sure to keep the space clean. Comfortable bed clutter free room I was good to go!

Lovely home in one of the best neighborhoods in the city. Very clean and cozy, walkable to restaurants and grocery stores, with a nice kitchen! A little tricky to get in at first but she has good instructions on how it works. Would stay again for sure.

Josh fue un huésped muy amable.
Una opción excelente si no quieres pagar mucho por alojarte en Chicago.
Areeba was so attentive and sure to make sure I had everything I needed.

What a great stay!
The place was absolutely beautiful, but what really stood out was the host's attention to detail. From the pleasant aroma when we walked in, to the snacks, refreshments, toiletries, and towels thoughtfully laid out for us, everything felt welcoming and intentional.
Check-in was easy thanks to the clear instructions, the neighborhood felt safe, parking was surprisingly easy for Chicago, and we loved being able to walk to nearby restaurants. Norm's Bistro down the street was a fantastic dinner spot.
The biggest surprise was checkout. I asked for instructions expecting a long list of things to do, and the host simply said, "Just leave everything, we'll take care of it." We cleaned up after ourselves anyway, but that level of hospitality was appreciated.
If I'm ever back in Chicago, I'll definitely stay here again.

we couldn’t have found a better place for our trip in chicago. the place was absolutely spotless, it had everything we needed, and was in a great area. bojan was a great host and made instructions very easy and clear. we would 110% stay here again!
Welcoming and friendly hosts.  Cozy accommodations with all the necessary amenities.  We felt like we were staying with friends as opposed to an impersonal hotel.
Anny was an incredible host! Her space provided such a special setting for our girls weekend, and it wouldn’t have been the same otherwise.
Nice place apartment in very walkable neighborhood with easy access to the brown line.
Steve's place was a great home base during my trip! The space is beautiful and clean, and the neighborhood is lovely.

Great location within walking distance to coffee shops and bars. Finding a parking spot was a bit challenging but that's to be expected. Nicely decorated and the beds were comfortable. The kitchen was well stocked. We enjoyed the special touch of having a record player.
David was an excellent host from the original booking through check out.  Gave extremely helpful tips for my first trip to Chicago. Would definitely recommend.

We enjoyed our stay here. Not too far from public transportation and close to many places in lakeview. Felt like a safe area with the gates with codes required. One item I didn’t love is the upstairs neighbors kept us up one night, but likely a one-off. Overall pleasant experience
I felt very welcomed. It was a very clean and quiet environment.
This is a beautiful wellness retreat! Very relaxing home.

We had a great time at Joe’s place! It was very clean  just like the pictures, he was very responsive whenever we reached out to him and gave us a great list of recommendations on places to visit and eat! The parking was pretty good too if we didn’t find parking in front, we were able to find some a few houses down so that was great. They have a dog who barks as you enter and leave the apartment but he’s very quiet after he’s a good boy. I would definitely stay here again if we come back to Chicago!

It was a great stay, the location was very nice and safe neighborhood. Harry is a very responsive host. We enjoyed our stay at his place.
Thanks!
everything amazing
We loved the location.  Very  close to United Center.  So spacious and tastefully decorated.  Would highly recommend!

We stayed at Reggie's place for a girls weekend with some friends from college. The place was beautiful, spacious, and clean. The outdoor patios (yes, two) were the star of the show! We skipped going to a reservation downtown because we loved hanging out up there with a view of the city. Working with Reggie was amazing as well - super responsive and so accommodating. 100% would stay again! If you're looking for a place that's quiet but has easy access to lots to do in Chicago, definitely stay here!
This place was absolutely amazing! We absolutely loved it and hope to come back soon. Responsive hosts, impeccable furnishings, we loved it all.
A good last minute traveling option.
Nice apartment in a safe neighborhood
Lesley's space was a joy to be in. My wife and I stayed two nights while in town for a concert in Logan Square. The space was clean and comfortable. Thank you!

Rida was an absolutely wonderful host! From the moment we arrived, she went above and beyond to make sure my friend and I had everything we needed for a comfortable and enjoyable stay. She checked in with us regularly, making sure we were settled in and asking if there was anything she could do to help. Her attentiveness, kindness, and genuine care made us feel truly welcomed.
Heidi’s location is near the heart of Chinatown. She is a great host and was very welcoming during my stay.
Thank you for having me as I transitioned to Chicago!

Location was easy to walk to restaurants, bars and the farmers market. Space was roomy for our party of five. The parking spot was great to have. It’s off a busy street so it was noisy at night. We enjoyed our stay here.
Would highly recommend, the accomendations and responsiveness of Kate made the stay a fantastic time. If I’m back Chicago again, I will certainly be reaching back out.

We had a wonderful stay at this charming home. It was perfect for our weekend in Chicago and accommodated our party of 5 nicely. The location was ideal for our itinerary. The house was immaculate and well appointed. Our hosts provided detailed information making our stay effortless. Would highly recommend and would definitely stay here in the future!
Kitty was such a great host! She is so sweet and very helpful. I will definitely staying with her again
Chiaka was sweet and very responsive. The apartment was very clean as well. I will say there were a lot of steps to get up to the apartment. Overall my bf and I had a great time.
This was very much a "you get what you pay for" type situation.

This stay exceeded my expectations. The house was spotless, well-organized, and thoughtfully labeled throughout, making everything easy to find and use. The hosts also provided a binder filled with helpful recommendations for the area, which was a great touch. The home was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and welcoming, and the hosts were fantastic. I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend it to others.
My family had a great stay at Andrea’s place. The place was setup well and Andrea was very helpful and responsive.

The instructions for working the front door lock appeared to be for a different property’s lock so I was initially locked out until the downstairs tenant came and opened it for us. Second, the property’s rules and instructions about smoking were very threatening with a high fee but when we got to the property, it was clear that the downstairs tenant either smokes or has guests who smoke so it felt like we could get charged for the evidence of smoking left by the other building tenant. The bed was uncomfortable, the towels were tiny, and the apartment had tons of bugs which is to be expected of an older building but it kind of added to the overall overpriced experience. Finally, the AC filter was so overdue for replacement that it would shut off. Clearly the owners don’t visit the property often outside of sending cleaners.

We selected Matt‘s place because it was steps away from the blue line. We took public transportation all around the Chicago area, and this was our perfect launching pad. Very pleased and surprised to find it also steps away from the fun funky and complete Gangnam market as well as St. John Cantius Roman Catholic Church a place of serenity and beauty.
Lot of space and ideal for big group of people! Enough beds availabile and ideal central location

Not a pleasant experience. Pictures did not match the actual space. There was a huge water stain on the wall that literally gave off a terrible moldy smell. Dirty sheets, spider webs, dusty, and hair all over the place.

The apartment was clean and private, beds were comfy, and amenities were as described. Joanna’s place was in a very lively and convenient location— it is above a bar on a busy street as mentioned in the listing, and did get a little loud during weekend nights. However, it didn’t bother us and the host provided white noise machines. Might not be a good place for those who have trouble falling asleep, but I’d highly recommend this spot for those wanting a fun city experience.
We enjoyed our stay at Kenya place, quite neighborhood and the beds were comfortable. Would definitely recommend!  Thank you for sharing your place with me and my family
We rented the unit for my mother in law.  It was perfect! The size is great, easy to find, and the hosts were great.  They live upstairs and were very friendly.
Great place to stay, and the host is very responsive!

Matt and Nicole were excellent communicators. Also, the house is located in a very walkable location which was great! I think in retrospect we should’ve looked more closely at the reviews to see that the only bathroom is located in the master bedroom so you need to walk past a pair of sleeping people to use the bathroom at night. Our only other complaint is that the upstairs neighbors were incredibly noisy at odd hours. Overall, still a nice stay for the price.

What a wonderful place to stay and explore the city of Chicago! The home’s charm and authentic accents truly enhanced our trip, and its great proximity to both the train and several bus routes made it very easy to navigate to. There was more traffic noise throughout the night than we were expecting (the home is on a corner with several stop signs) but that was easily mitigated by a new pair of earplugs. In all, a great experience!
Fantastic place and host, didn’t feel like we were on a trip at all, such a cozy place
i appreciate alina for hosting me and my homegirls while in chicago. we had soo much fun and everything was great

My boyfriend and I stayed here for a wedding and it was perfect for what we needed. Steve was very accommodating and allowed us to check in early, which made things so much easier for us. The neighborhood was beautiful and we enjoyed walking around to grab coffee and lunch. We would definitely stay here again!

I had family in the area so it was a good location! We walked about 20 minutes to the beach one day which was nice. We were able to find free parking, but sometimes had to drive around the neighborhood a bit. Nice place!
Everything was smooth and easy with our stay. We appreciated the attentive communication from Darsh during our visit.

IT IS A HIGH-END PRICE. BUT, OH MY GOODNESS, THE PLACE IS A DREAM. IT IS LOADED WITH AMENITIES. HOW CAN I START TO DESCRIBE IT - IF I WAS NOT SO EXCITED TO WRITE THIS REVIEW, I WOULD BE SPEECHLESS FROM AWE!
- My room had a lock code as a doorknob. Inside, a flat-screen television. An air filter that ensured comfort in temperature and a clean environment.
- Linens were clean - Desk with Office chair - A comfortable sitting chair to relax - A bed that was firm with deep-pocket sheets that fit - A large closet to put my three big suitcases - Space, space, and more space (I mean yoga or tai chi space) - I slept like a baby
- Shared Spaces: Modern everything - Accessible, clean, user-friendly, notices everywhere, describing expectations, two (2) fridges, and dining space on all three levels, as well as fully furnished living room space on three levels. I wondered if a large family lived there because the lay-out was still cozy. Bathrooms clean, with tissue and hand wash.

We really enjoyed staying in Chinatown and the proximity to both the park and the restaurants/shopping were a highlight. It is worth noting that this rental is adjacent to both the L and a grounded train that blows it's horn every hour to clear the train track. On our second night we modified our sleeping arrangements with more white noise and airpods but it is loud and disruptive.
With that said, we would stay again.
Very good location! Josh was also very communicative! I think best if not a lot of people, it can get crowded but we liked it!

Very clean, well decorated charming place to stay close to Lake Michigan. Blake is an excellent communicator and clearly cares for his property. I especially liked the extra touch of a few snacks and coffee. I would absolutely stay here again!

The place was very nice and clean but the neighborhood didn’t seem safe if you travel solo, also I had a couple of incidents with the roommates making noise after the quiet time :( other than that everything was good .

Moudi was a great host! He provided detailed instructions for check in and was very responsive when I had questions or issues. The location was easily accessible and it was easy to get around. The place was just as described. I will warn that the bed was not the most comfortable and made a noise with every movement. There was also a lot of light that came in at night through the glass block windows, so if you are a light sleeper, I would recommend bringing a sleep mask along.

Great boystown location. So close that you will hear street noise especially in the bedroom that butts up to the street. Walk down apartment but still gets some light. Michael was a fantastic host and very responsive. I would stay here again!

Had a great stay. Tori was an excellent host. The place was perfect, clean, and very comfortable....big kitchen, front deck, and very comfortable beds. In a very nice and walkable neighborhood. Would definitely stay here again
It was ideal for a weekend getaway. Carl was responsive and helpful. Nice place to stay if you’re wanting to save some money and explore Chicago.
We did a reunion with 13 adults in the house and it never felt too busy! The vibes are amazing- this is unlike a stay you will ever have. Phillip was an awesome host.

This home was perfect for a weekend trip. It was clean and in a good location for a short walk to excellent restaurants. The home is safe and the neighborhood is quiet. Brandon was very responsive to any needs and was an awesome host. Would happily stay again.

Ich habe das Wochenende vor einem Business-Trip bei Jane verbracht. Die Lage ist fantastisch - easy von der blueline zu Fuß erreichbar. Es ist eine sichere und angenehme Gegend. Sowohl Flughafen, als auch Downtown und andere tolle Viertel sind super erreichbar. Ich hatte ein Zimmer und konnte Bad und Küche mitbenutzen. Ich würde wiederkommen :)

Hosted 11 people for my bachelorette weekend and Gustavo’s place was absolutely perfect! The rooms and beds were even more spacious and accommodating than expected, and they have every single amenity stocked that you could need. The fridge was stocked with waters, there were snacks, it made arrival after lengthy travel all that more comfortable. He was so responsive throughout the trip and so flexible with our travel plans. Quiet and cute street that felt totally safe.  Would 100% recommend!

Overall the stay was good, maybe a little overpriced and small because it would be a bit uncomfortable to live in for a long time, but for a short stay in Chicago it was perfect.
It’s very small but it’s all you need if you’re traveling

The house was a perfect location in Hyde Park! We loved the neighborhood and walking distance to restaurants and shopping. As long as you’re smart at night, this place is safe and felt like home. Thanks for a great stay.

Quick note: google maps cant find this location for whatever reason so to future bookers, take wentworth north bound and turn left into drive way before 18th street bridge. I drove in around 11pm and was able to find my way easily but only because i knew what building to look for, not because of google maps. Interestingly i was able to call ubers no problem and drivers found me very quickly. Love this location. Such a quick and easy walk to chinatown. Felt safe. The train didnt bother us at all and fell asleep easily without issues.  Place was clean and served as a nice home base after all the food coma

The airbnb was super clean and nice. I appreciated their cleanliness more than anything. I could tell they put a lot of effort into it. The area was super close to many staple Chicago things and close to the metro. The hosts were very communicative and good at responding.

I had a fantastic stay! The house has a very calm, relaxing atmosphere, and the neighborhood felt safe and comfortable at all hours. My bedroom was spotless, looked exactly like the photos, and I really appreciated being able to lock my door while I was out. The clean bathroom was conveniently located right next door.
The Wi-Fi was fast and reliable, and the kitchen was well-equipped with a full fridge and other appliances for guest use. The location is excellent—easily walkable to nearby shopping centers and gas stations. If you're driving, street parking is simple and accessible since it’s a wide street.
A quick heads-up: the room is on the second floor right up the stairs from the entrance, which is something to consider if you have a lot of heavy luggage (I only had one bag, so it was a breeze). I had a very minor hiccup with the front door code at first, but it worked perfectly fine afterward.
Overall, a wonderful and hassle-free stay. Highly recommend!

Still in the city and also away from a lot of traffic. The place was super easy to find and getting in and out was not an issue (once we figured out the keypad- user error only because we don’t use them often). The beds were comfortable and the neighborhood was quiet at night. We would definitely recommend to people that want to come to the city and also have a place to stay a little ways from the hustle.
Great owner and place.  Place as described.

Celestes place was so cute and inviting. The apartment was larger than expected, very quiet, secure and had everything we needed. Truly a gem outside of the city. I loved the shower so much I ordered the same shower head before even checking out from my stay. I usually stay in Pilsen when I come to Chicago but had more people coming with me this time than normal, I will absolutely stay here again! We were more than pleased with our stay!

Nathan was a fantastic host and we loved staying here! The home itself is lovely and extremely comfortable to stay in, and it's located very conveniently for the city without being noisy or crowded. There's plenty of coffee and grocery options nearby and it was near public transit if you're not a driver. Parking was the easiest I've ever found in Chicago. We'd absolutely stay here again!
This place was great for our weekend trip to Chicago. It was very close to the pink line so using public transportation was easy! Bart was very responsive and easy to communicate with.
Vilma's place was great! They were very responsive and accommodating. The community was safe and everyone was nice! A quick uber to the city or walk to some local businesses.

Chris was an outstanding host. He was always responsive and quick to help, whether through Airbnb messages or text, which made communication easy throughout our stay.
The location was excellent, and Chris provided clear instructions for the property, along with helpful recommendations for things to do in the area. He even shared information about local attractions and events, which was much appreciated. He was also kind enough to accommodate an early check-in for a friend arriving from California and to provide an additional parking pass for our second vehicle.
My guest and I are active; we especially loved the location. There are fitness centers nearby, and we brought our road bikes and rode just over a mile to the Lakefront Trail for some great cycling. The neighborhood was lively, convenient, and a wonderful base for exploring Chicago.
Overall, Chris was a fantastic host and made our stay easy and enjoyable.
This pace is very well located for exploring Chicago.  It is small, but functional and works well if you plan to spend your time out and about.  Good communication with the host.
A convenient and comfortable  stay for a couple days in the city! Thanks Marjorie!

Nicole and Matt’s place was perfect for our group of 17!  We had plenty of space and everyone felt right at home. The house was very clean and orderly and was in fantastic location close to restaurants and a grocery store. Matt and Nicole were super helpful and quick to respond to any question I had and getting to downtown was quick and easy. I would happily stay here again!

First off they gave me the cutest little birthday set up! The place was spacious, clean and the best was super comfy! Kimberlie was very attentive and make sure we were taken care of the entire stay! Neighborhood was quiet! I have 0 complaints! Would definitely stay again my next visit to the Chi ❤️

It was our first time visiting Chicago, and we enjoyed staying somewhere less central but more ‘local’, as the studio is close to a couple of areas that have lots of bars, restaurants and shops. It was also super clean and Claire and Jonas were very responsive and friendly - even gave us lots of local recommendations which were great! It is quite noisy though, from both the bar across the street and cars on the road, so it might be worth bringing some ear plugs.
Alain was very attentive. The home was as described. Close to everything we wanted to do. I would stay again.
Cyan was an amazing host! She was very responsive, place was clean and she even allowed us to check in early! We enjoyed our stay.

My family & I enjoyed this stay. The apartment style rental had all that we needed & the location was nice. For the most part, communication with the team was good. I was disappointed in the lack of accurate info regarding late checkout. I requested a late checkout at the time of booking, sending reminders two weeks before check in & day before check out. I was told that late check was based on availability if there was another booking that day & to check the morning of checkout to confirm. On the morning of check out, I was told we were not able to do a late checkout even though the apartment was not booked again until 4 days later!! Due to the fact they’d already scheduled cleaning services. If I hadn’t requested late checkout 3 different times in advance, I could understand this dilemma. It was very inconvenient & frustrating knowing that there was no back to back booking, despite my advance requests, & w/ the we money paid, no extra effort was made w/scheduling prior to morning of.

Things I lived about this unit:
1 - views are just as photographed. Incredible.
2 - friendly check in. No having to pretend you're not staying in an AirBnB. And access to many amenities in the building.
3 - Probably the best equipped (in terms of tools) kitchen I've ever seen in a non-residential unit.
Minor issues:
1 - window shades are translucent so that morning sun blasts in. They do provide sleep masks. AC is noisy too, lots of knocking from ductwork expanding and contracting. They provide ear plugs.
2 - no ceiling lights in living room (just 1 floor lamp in far corner). No lights in bedrooms either except small nightstand lamps. Can get dim.
3 - queen size beds. Both rooms have room for king/2 twins. Seems more flexible.
But really these are minor quibbles. Very happy with this rental.
Nice , clean , vintage .

We enjoyed our stay. The place was clean and accurate to the listing. Leslie was easy to work with from start to end.
The neighborhood was quiet and parking on the street was never an issue. The location was also a 15 minute ride from all our destinations on the trip - Navy Pier, 360 Chicago, Riverwalk, Field Museum and more.
We even walked over to Chinatown another morning. It took about 20 mintues and we had some wonderful food before returning.
Lastly, we enjoyed all the outdoor spaces to sit and relax after a long day of sightseeing.

We stayed at David's apartment for 10 days. The location is fantastic—the West Loop is lively, and the number one hamburger in town can be found right here at "Au Cheval." The apartment itself is fantastic and spotlessly clean; the kitchen is well-equipped if you enjoy cooking—we cooked at least once a day. We never took the train because you can easily walk everywhere (provided you enjoy walking). The stroll along the riverfront is beautiful, and the Art Deco buildings are impressive. The weather was absolutely perfect for us—no wind, no rain; we couldn't have asked for anything more. We absolutely loved Chicago—it's a great city, and people everywhere treated us wonderfully. David was a great host—responsive and attentive. I truly believe this is a fantastic apartment in a superb location.

Ivan provides topnotch service and communication along with a pristine, well- appointed home and great attention to detail.  He honestly thought of everything. and provided the little touches that made this airbnb almost better than being at home. On top of that, he is friendly and exceptionally helpful.  I would consider making a trip to Chicago just to stay in this property.  Ivan's kids ended up being the same age as ours and I feel like we all made some new friends this weekend.  Thank you Ivan!
This was a great place to stay! Good location, nice and clean, and close to downtown.

My stay at Tim’s place was absolutely perfect for my needs. I was attending weekend concerts at the Vic and it was fantastic to be just a couple of blocks away. Tim was very welcoming and accommodating throughout my 3-night stay, and I appreciated the free coffee coupon as well as the great coffee machine in the apartment itself. A couple of things that could be problematic for some travelers—shared bathroom and train noise—were fully disclosed in the listing, but in fact those things did not present a problem for me at all, as the other guests in the house were quite considerate and friendly, and I sleep like a rock! I hope to book Tim’s place again the next time I visit Chicago. Thanks for a great stay, Tim!
Great location, comfortable beds, and lots of space. No problems with hot water in our big group. It was a little difficult to figure out the oven with no labels, but we managed.
Great location, very clean, responsive host.
This was an awesome place. Super easy to get inside, super clean inside and elegant.

Had a great time at Janet’s place! She was super responsive whenever I had a question, her place was easy to find, and Janet was really friendly & accommodating! The room was clean and perfect for someone travelling solo. Also, the area is SO NICE. Lincoln Park is a vibe. It’s super scenic, is close to public transit lines, & has lots of cool restaurants and cafes nearby as well. It’s also really safe. I walked around at night multiple times and felt super safe. Would def stay at Janet’s place again in the future!

Vanessa was great. We tried Roux,  a restaurant she suggested.  We enjoyed coffee on the back porch in the morning. The house was beautifully decorated yet very comfortable at the same time. Thank you!
Our stay was good at Darsh’s place the only thing I can say about the place is that we could’ve used some tv’s for m the bedrooms. Our overall experience was great.

This was such a cute, cozy, and clean space! It looked exactly like the photos. There was free street parking in front, and it was easy to access with the instructions provided. I would definitely recommend this to anyone visiting Chicago.

My friend and I stayed here while celebrating her birthday this year. It was conveniently located to shops, the Metra, and bus stops that connected to other train lines. Overall we were very pleased with the neighborhood and quaint building. Our host was very kind and responsive during the check in process, and made sure we were aware of the elevator not working. We would book here again in the future!

The communal areas were clean and the house keeper was there both days cleaning them. The other guests were quiet and we didn’t hear them at all in our room. Checking in and checking out were also super easy.
Beautiful neighborhood, very walkable. This home was comfortable with plenty of amenities. We were glad we chose this over a hotel. Hosts were very helpful and responsive! We felt safe and secure.
We had the best time at the Walton Residence for our wedding suite. Plenty of space, lighting, and amazing amenities that worked perfectly for our weekend!

Nice and spacious place with very comfortable beds! Cute quiet area, pretty walkable. Felt safe, really enjoyed being able to park in the back for a small fee, that made things easy. Responsive hosts. They had fans, which I can’t sleep without! Couldn’t figure out how to control temperature but didn’t actually ask host about so it could have been an easy fix. Perfect for 3 people girls trip.

Thaer was a great host in every aspect! The home was comfortable, cozy, clean and organized. Overall communication and condition of the home/location made the stay stress free. Special shout out to Thaer as he offered to extend our check out time due to an unforeseen circumstance.
Great stay!
Great for a short stay did the job
Stella was an excellent host.  very responsive, accommodating and pleasant to work with.  Her expectations were clear and reasonable with this property.
Great location and perfect for our needs while in town for a friend’s wedding. Would definitely stay here again. The included parking spot was a nice bonus!
We spent the weekend in Chicago for a wedding. The place was good, a bit small, but served its purpose. Hosts were responsive and helpful when we asked.
host was very responsive and accommodating, i would book with this host again

Pawan was very responsive and the location was excellent for our trip’s purpose. The home is close to many shops and restaurants in Lincoln Park. The surroundings were quiet and peaceful.
The home is tidy, and it had all amenities needed with toiletries to spare.
Getaway in Gold Coast, good bang for your buck
谢谢victor，房间很干净，周边环境很好

Dem Preis-Leistungs Verhältnis entsprechend. Klare Anweisungen vom Team, nur leider unordentliche Mitbewohner, wofür der Anbieter jedoch nichts kann. Die Wohnung ist etwas abgerockt und in die Jahre gekommen. Die Lage ist sicher und die Blue Line gut zu Fuß erreichbar.

Great location with walking distance to so much! The beach and lakefront restaurants, farmers market on Saturday, Shopping/dining in Old Town, and lunch at Cafe Brauer. Close to the zoo and a quick ride to Navy Pier.  The place is on a beautiful quiet street near historic St. Michael’s Church where the peaceful bells ring every hour…and Twin Anchors never disappoints.
David’s place was perfect for a first time visit to Chicago!
Great stay!
Exelente todo! Nos re gustó, la atención 10 puntos, y muy buen lugar! Super recomendable !
Our family with two young children had a pleasant stay. Very comfortable and relaxing place, had everything we needed.
Natalie was an excellent host and very communicative. The condo was perfect, clean, well appointed. The location was great. It was also quiet for being in River North. I would definitely stay again.

I cannot say enough about how much my 3 kids and I enjoyed our 7 night stay. The neighborhood is everything, quiet enough to feel like an oasis after a busy day of sightseeing, yet full of interesting restaurants and shops…a stroll through Lincoln Park, or the Lake, or down busy Wells. We enjoyed the walks into downtown (about 30 minutes) because there were always things to do along the way.
The kitchen, bathroom and laundry were in perfect order and made a stay with kids streamlined. I appreciated that there were plenty of supplies on hand—from paper towels and garbage bags to towels—we never had to run to the store for more.
Great back deck, lots of light, super comfy master bed. Excellent communication, safe neighborhood. We can’t wait to stay again.
* true there are steep stairs and only one real bed, but the air mattress was great for kids.
Great place if you’re looking to be in Chicago and only needing a place to sleep and shower. Great price considering the location.

Place was beautiful, host was very responsive and accommodating.
Views were very hard to beat, would book again any day! Everything was super close & there was no shortage of things to do in the area.

Fun place to host a small group of people. The backyard space was awesome to hang out in- the fireplace was a bigggg vibe. Just be cautious of the one particularly steep step on the back stairs. It tripped us up a lot over the weekend. If you’re going out in the neighborhood, definitely check out the Consignment Lounge for a few drinks. Thanks for a nice stay, Adam.
We enjoyed staying here.  It was a very comfortable, great location, very clean, quiet.  Jessica was very responsive and attentive.  We would stay here next time we visit Chicago.
Really happy with the stay!

Excellent and comfortable stay at a well located apartment that is close to great nightlife, restaurants, and transportation but also quiet and peaceful that was needed for a good sleep. Was surprised at how cool the unit was and didn't need AC. Felt super comfortable and cozy. Getting to public transportation was super easy and convenient. Willing to stay here again.

Diana’s place was the perfect place to stay near Logan Square for us to visit family! It’s also just a block from the 606 which was great for a morning walk or jog! Her kitchen / living room is a delightful space for gathering!  A heads up - There are steep stairs up to the unit so be aware if you have trouble with stairs. I was traveling with my elderly parents who were fine with the sturdy handrail.

The hotel was okay, I booked it because it was the cheapest option I could find close to where I needed to be. The rooms were relatively clean — just some chipped paint and things like that! Really my only complaint is that it’s extremely loud at night since it’s only on the 3rd floor. I could hear sirens and people talking all into the night and didn’t get the best sleep!

Jermaill is an excellent host. Friendly and communicative, he offered great recommendations for local and city stuffs.
Room is comfortable and as described. Area is easily accessible by train, allowing quick access into the city.
Highly recommend for stay when visiting Chicago, especially if solo traveling like me
Brandon was very communicative and the process was straightforward. clean linen and sheets were provided

Perfect stay near Chinatown and Rake Field. Super safe and clean area with plenty of parking. We loved the apartment. It was huge with 3 bedrooms and a large sofa. Could easily sleep way more than us. Would book again for sure!

Perfect stay!
Samuel and his team were incredibly accommodating and were always prompt and clear in their communications. They went above and beyond in making sure we had a smooth experience overall. We really appreciated the flexibility they graciously provided us after landing in town early in the morning and also allowing us to leave our luggage before our flight out at the end of our stay.
The location is perfect for access into downtown Chicago while enjoying a local walkable neighborhood that has a life of its own. The included amenities were great here and you can certainly feel at home during your stay.
Highly recommend this listing!
A great host! Very responsive and helpful with any and all questions. A great neighborhood to stay!

This is a great location in Wrigleyville. Easy to find, very walkable to restaurants and of course the stadium. We were there on a non-baseball weekend. The unit is VERY safe, no concerns at all. It’s on the 3rd level so no one above you. Most importantly the beds are comfortable!! :-)
Such a charming gem in Boystown. Super easy to access, yet feels very private and secluded.
I can’t say enough about how amazing Rob’s air b& b is!! It felt very spacious. It was a delight and we will definitely will  stay again when we come visit Chicago.

The property itself was fine, but my check-in experience was very disappointing. I arrived around 9:15 PM and was unable to access the property until approximately 10:35 PM due to a lockbox issue. Despite multiple attempts and instructions, the lockbox never worked, and someone eventually had to come open the property for me.
Spending over an hour outside late at night in an unfamiliar area was stressful and significantly affected my stay, especially since I had booked the accommodation primarily for night stays.
I appreciate that efforts were eventually made to help me gain access once the issue was reported. However, what I found most disappointing was the lack of acknowledgment of the impact the situation had on me during my stay. The host later apologized after I raised my concerns, but the delayed entry made for a difficult start to my visit.
Future guests arriving late at night may want to confirm access arrangements in advance.

We loved the place and it was exactly as described. It was clean and bright. The neighbour-hood was great and there were plenty of restaurants at walking distance.
Overall we really liked the place and enjoyed it.
Thank you.
Great!
