My friends and I traveled to Chicago for a wedding over the weekend.  We booked 2 nights, and we were not that familiar with Chicago.  Prior to arriving, the Host Serg explained all check-in information in detail... in fact the instructions included photos of the property, the garage and the lockbox/keypad sites. Almost too perfect.  The 4th floor loft home was spotless, sergically clean!  I have rented numerous Airbnbs and this apartment was meticulous.  It was sparsely decorated but just enough to make it feel cozy and warm. We had 5 travelers and there was so much room we were shocked.  Both bathrooms were huge and the showers XL.  We walked 5 minutes to the nearby upscale market and our car was safely parked in the garage.  Serg was available at a moments notice and he even coordinated a second basement parking space. (additional fee).  The check-out was a breeze, no chores for the guests!!

Awesome apartment, nice open balcony, great location, clean and accommodated
But to my taste, a bit overpriced

Located in a walkable and peaceful neighborhood , Kate’s place is very nice and convenient. Whole Foods nearby as well as many restaurants. A bonus is a quick walk to the beach and Lake Michigan and nice bike and pedestrian paths
We were able to Uber to many different destinations ( quick wait time ) even though the area is in a quiet neighborhood
Easy check in and no extra requirements for check out which is so helpful if you are trying to get to the airport for a flight
5/5 stars! Great host, very responsive and accommodative, and the place served me well for its purpose as it was quiet, clean, and near the conference center.
Kim was very quick with response. Location is good. We had pleasant stay
Beautiful building, artfully decorated, great to have off-street parking. Proximate to family and friends on the South side. We loved!

Angela and Ryan were wonderful hosts! They were very communicative throughout our stay, made check-in a breeze, and were friendly and considerate from start to finish.
The space itself was lovely. Very spacious and clean and had everything we needed. Their dog, Leroy Brown, would occasionally hang out by the front gate and was always very friendly :)
The neighborhood is beautiful with plenty of great places to explore nearby. Street parking was easy, and Angela and Ryan provided us with visitor parking permits for the duration of our stay. Public transit was also very accessible.
Overall, we had a fantastic weekend and thoroughly enjoyed staying here. We’d absolutely stay with Angela and Ryan again and would happily recommend their place to others!

Karina was the absolute best host!
She was extremely responsive and quick with any questions I had!
I needed to update my stay a few times and she accommodated me with no problem!!
Her home is beautiful and fit the 5 of us super comfortable!
The instructions she gave were so detailed, that I knew exactly where and what to do when I made it!
I will be staying here again when I visit!

El barrio donde está la casa es muy tranquilo y de fácil acceso por coche o transporte público, los espacios son muy amplios, los baños están equipados y en la casa pudimos encontrar muchas cosas que nos hicieron el viaje más sencillo, como secadora, toallas, cafetera. Todo fue maravilloso, sin duda el mejor lugar para llegar cuando vas con familia grande.
Awesome apartment close to everything in Wicker Park and an L stop. Highly recommended!

I’m so glad I was able to find a place that worked so well for my trip to help move my son out of his UChicago dorm! I had my car on this trip, but it seemed to be easy to get around by public transit from here. I never had a problem finding a parking spot which was so nice at the end of a long day! Michele showed wonderful hospitality!  I wish I had more time to visit and enjoy their lovely home. Next time!

Ideal location and place for our weekend stay in Chicago, had some family come in town and they absolutely loved the place. We’re also able to check in a little bit early thanks to Kimberly, which greatly helped us fit in all planned activities for the weekend. Very appreciative of this! Would definitely recommended.
Great place, friendly host, nice neighborhood, clean, convenient, excellent for a large group.
Brittany was great to work with and was extremely responsive and helpful. You can tell that she truly cares that you have a good stay!
The host was wonderful! Very clear on instructions and responsive.
This is a great apartment in a great location with easy parking. Everything was exactly as described in the listing. Thank you!

This was a good place to stay for my group. We just needed a spot to sleep and it provided that in a clean, fuss-free space. The surrounding area wasn't a draw, would definitely need to go somewhere further away for some food or activity. Jordan and the instructions provided were both thorough and helpful.

Maison Winona exceeded our expectations! Johanna was a wonderful host and her home was beautiful. She really thought of providing all the comforts of home which enhanced our stay. We will definitely return!
Very easy check-in and great location. It’s a Best Western hotel which is interesting. Hallways and shared areas could use some sprucing up and a deep clean. Overall it did the job.

The Airbnb has a lot of positives - nice neighborhood, comfortable beds, and does the job of having a comfortable amount of space for a large group with a big open hangout area. I was surprised though on arrival how many little things are broken or janky (windows that don’t open or have ripped screens, closet doors that fall off, one of the showers is barely usable). The pictures are also much brighter online than the place is in person. All this made the place feel a bit overpriced, but overall did the job.

Hey so i’m glad this place was so secure and very convenient since i booked this kinda last minute. But you guys definitely need to fumigate I saw a roach the first day we were there in the bathroom. I was just so disgusted by my experience, and honestly felt NASTY anytime I was there. And I get it being in the type of neighborhood it is but you guys are Airbnb so I think it’s very important to keep things clean and not so much be one with the neighborhood, especially if it’s a communal space. maybe I have someone do some daily cleaning or something, also maybe update your pictures so people aren’t given any false impressions.
Great spot on the NW side. Helpful host.
The host was incredibly responsive, kind, and accommodating throughout our stay. The coffee bar was a great touch. Would recommend for the hospitality alone.

Dream Rentals provided an amazing stay for my friends and I. The backed that up with exceptional communication throughout the whole process and were kind enough to provide many recommendations for activities and nearby restaurants. Looking forward to staying with them again!

Our stay was great! The space has an open layout and features a lot of great natural light. We had all the amenities we needed like a full kitchen, washer/dryer, iron and board, and smart TV. Staying on top of Steingold’s was a wonderful addition; the shop is beautiful and the perfect menu for grabbing a quick breakfast bite.
There were some minor notes on cleanliness, we noticed hair throughout the bathroom and living room and some questionable stains on one of the blankets. Thankfully, we were able to access the units vacuums and washer/dryer to freshen up the space. Outside of those concerns, the space was very well maintained.
Overall, the location, layout, and features of the space are great and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We would definitely book again!

A wonderful stay! Communication with David was excellent, he is very quick with responses. The home was exactly as pictured — spotless and well-equipped. The location was perfect, plenty to do in the area. We would definitely stay again!
I love my chicago stay with Nate! He went above and beyond and the air bnb was nicer than expected! Will be staying with Nate again.

My overall stay was okay . Hosts communicated fairly quickly when the front door malfunctioned at 5 am . It was a 2 bedroom but was listed as a 3 bedroom . Floor boards were very squeaky & you could hear every step & conversation & song that took place upstairs … lastly we discovered ants on the last day and we didn’t even use the kitchen … The thermostat is locked and the property is muggy .

great place to stay. i didn’t know for sure if it was close to downtown but when you get there downtown is right there and municipal park is a 30 minute walk. very clean and i had a question for the host and she responded very quickly. next time I’m in chicago I’m for sure staying here again if possible !
We had a great stay. Check-in was easy, the place was clean and comfortable. Everything was as expected, and the host was friendly and responsive. Would stay here again!
The place was nice and clean.  It does not have a place to sit outside the bedroom and does not have a dishwasher.
Freddy’s place was well described. Enjoyed the short walk to the train into the city. Good restaurants and coffee shops nearby. Freddy was very responsive and friendly. Satisfied!
Great stay, bed felt a little small, but that worth it for the location, price and general apartment.
Relaxing and super fun 😊😊. All the amenities were too notch. great sleep with the linens and super soft bed. Thank you again Chelsey!!

Good location.  Plenty of room however we needed to use the fold out couch but it was broken.  There was an inflatable bed thank goodness!  Clean.  A bit noisy….you can hear guests in the adjoining units.  All in all a good experience!
great spot. parking was easy.

Las instituciones de la publicación no están acorde a la realidad de el alojamiento la entrada es por uno de los cuartos tiene una escalera de caracol que baja al sótano donde está una de las habitaciones imposibles de encontrar estacionamiento si vas con más de un auto es una odisea el equipo de Airbnb nunca pudo comunicarse con ella así que procedieron a reembolsarme lo antes pagado ya que la publicación no está acorde con la realidad
De el alojamiento
comfortable

The allure of this place was great from the moment we walked in the door. My wife, the Realtor, was like, "Wow!" Our daughter was really feelin' it, too! From our first meal at the large dining table to our last night's sleep, this place was perfect. Comfortable beds, great wall art, and a quiet, peaceful backyard made this place a dream. There were so many subtle touches that made it even more special to me. The host was great. Very kind and responsive. We had no issues or concerns, and the property exceeded our expectations. Where I'm from, we don't have places like this. So, if you are looking to get away from your 99 problems or just get the dirt off your shoulders, this is a very cozy spot. What more can I say without making a Public Service Announcement? Next time I'm in the Chicago-land area, this is where we will stay. I am happy to spend dead presidents on a good quality property like The Carter Blue. We will be back for an encore.
Our second time staying in one of Hanna and Marks airbnbs and it was great! We would love to come back.

We loved staying here ! It was super easy to get in and anytime we had a question shakerah was very fast at responding . The place was very clean and I loved that we could see the city from the window !
Good place

We stayed at Alan’s place for a week.  The neighborhood is great - lots of good restaurants & places to go and only two blocks from the CTA.  There is a nice garden where I enjoyed sitting in the sun & reading.

Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic location with plenty of bars and food spots nearby. The host was responsive and quick to answer any questions. The free parking was a huge bonus and made everything even more convenient. Would definitely stay here again!

We stayed at Jean’s with our adult children and relatives. Having two separate units worked great as there was privacy and easy connection. We had 8 adults total. Nice quiet location near a fabulous fancy grocery store. The place was extremely clean and comfortable.

We thoroughly enjoyed the spaciousness, cleanliness, and layout of the home! Room for everyone, and lots of space to spread out! We highly recommend. Richard was easily reachable and very responsive when we had questions. Thank you!

I loved Ute's place. Very charming and homey. She was very easy to communicate with. My boys found their bed uncomfortable and squeaky unfortunately . We also would have preferred a keypad to one key, as this presented some logistical issues for us.
The location is quiet and on a beautiful and historic street that is centrally located.
The place was very spacious and comfortable. The neighborhood is walkable and quiet. Annika was kind and accommodating during my stay.
Host was very responsive. The location was great. Near restaurants and attractions. Nice safe neighborhood.
Nice place to stay, clean and clear instructions!
Great stay!  Very clean and comfortable.  Great communication throughout.

Host was friendly and responsive. Living area nice, thin walls allowing excessive exterior noise, no provided soaps. Somewhat easy to find but no number on the door causing confusion if it was our unit. Overall decent stay
great place and great host!
Beautiful home, great hospitality. Thank you.
Awesome and beautiful spot, great location and memorable stay.
Awesome quiet neighborhood and close to brown line

Place was decently dirty(vents caked in dust etc), needs some maintenance and/or upgrades(blinds are mismatched and hanging on for dear life same with the shower curtain)
Mainly just used it as a place to sleep.
Hosts are very responsive and friendly though
Great stay in Hyde Park!
Sweet apartment in a beautiful part of Chicago
everything was perfect it well worth my trip and i will be back and hopefully can rent her place again everything was on point

Margaret's place was perfect! Clean, comfortable, and spacious! It was quiet,  with lots of walkable restaurants and coffee shops. Very close to the train! Great neighborhood! Would definitely stay again.

We enjoyed our stay. Space was very nice. Sheets were amazing. Fun to walk around the neighborhood. We found a SpotHero parking spot nearby, and our adult son walked a bit further and easily found a spot on the street for free. Creaky floors were a bit annoying - we were worried about the noise for the neighbors below us, but we hardly heard the folks above us, so decided not to worry! Very nice Chicago experience.
Perfect location for our time visiting friends in Chicago. Walkable neighborhood with lots of options.
Great location and a great stay

A pleasant stay in one of my favorite neighborhoods. This location was perfect for everything that I needed to do during the weekend and the host was attentive and considerate throughout the whole process.
Great place to stay for a weekend in Chicago.  Easy to find, clean, and the listing was as described. close to bus access and a biking /walking trail.
James was a great host. The house is nicely decorated with quality finishes. The foose ball table was great. I was happy to have my family stay here.
Everything was as expected. Mario was very responsive and helpful. Had a great stay!

Very much as described.  It was within 4 blocks of a grocery store and 1.4 miles from the Field Museum so It was convenient for us.  I considered the price fairly high but was less expensive than hotels and other things downtown due to the convention that weekend.  It worked out well for us.  Two bedrooms and two baths was very good as well.  The full kitchen was nice even though we didn't have time to really use it.

Our family of three thoroughly enjoyed staying at this newly remodeled property. The spacious kitchen was equipped with brand-new appliances, including a washer and dryer, and the beds were very comfortable. Shawn, the owner, was easy to reach and communicated promptly throughout our stay. Finding street parking nearby was much easier than we expected. The bus stop is just a 2-minute walk away and provides direct access to the Logan Square Blue Line station, making it very convenient to get around the city. We would gladly stay here again.
Great place in the heart of the city
This was a very comfy basement apartment in a cute neighborhood.

This is my experience with the place, my husband booked this as a surprise anniversary trip and based on the reviews it sounded like it would have been a great place. It said it sleeps 5 so we thought there would be no problem sleeping a baby there as well. When we were looking for the house it is located behind a really sketchy red home that looks like it’s from a haunted house. I can’t say we felt safe in the neighborhood either, especially with a baby. We proceed inside to check it out and you have to go though the little alley next to the red house to get to the back of if to find this one. We go inside, the space is modern, small bedroom, but no space to have baby with us. We reached out to the host and informed them that the space would not work for us due to our baby. They offered a pak n play but that would not work because she won’t sleep in it. So we asked for a refund and left the place untouched. They said they would refund us/long story short we had to go through Airbnb…
This place can sleep a lot of people, and is walkable to Fulton Market restaurants & nightlife.

This place was gorgeous. The neighborhood is so cozy and walkable, the apartment felt just like home. The bed was so comfortable, and having the washer and dryer available to us ended up really enhancing our stay. The walk through the garden was the perfect way to start and end the day. We loved every minute here and hated to leave! Would book again.

Great location and more affordable than a hotel. It’s a decent place to rest and a bed to sleep in. We were also able to check in early, which was very convenient.
I’m not super picky, and usually not one to complain, but we found it was lacking in cleanliness and amenities. 2 pillows on the bed, and only 2 bath towels for 2 people staying 4 nights. According to a message from our host sent prior to check in, it would have been a $40 fee if we opted to ask for more towels etc. to be delivered, which I would understand if a sufficient amount was provided in the first place. It also smelled faintly of cat litter, and the WiFi was essentially useless. It just seemed a bit neglected.
Again, if you’re just looking for a place to sleep and shower, this place is in a great location and is relatively affordable compared to other options.

Everything went great until a horrible incident occurred when a guest broke into my room naked drunk and confused. Supposedly he couldn’t find his room but that no excuse because after I kicked him out he broke in again for the 2nd time until I put BTA. Overall the place is very clean and the energy is really nice here. Would have been a perfect stay without that. I would definitely come back, I hope next time it will be different. Hosts were extremely nice and communicated very well. Thanks
It was a wonderful place. Relaxing outdoor chill area. Wonderful neighborhood. Definitely will keep in mind for next time in Chicago

This place had everything you could need in a Chicago visit. It was very clean, had plenty of space and the rooftop was great. If you are a lite sleeper I do not recommend as you can hear the L train. It did not bother my group at all. Also the alley can be hard to find at night but we did not have much issue.
Overall, the place is in great location and fairly comfortable.
Somewhere quick to stay
Martha is a great host, and her house is a peaceful landing spot in the heart of Lincoln Park

Our stay was awesome.  The place was great and accommodated all 6 of us very well.  The location was perfect for the wedding we attended on Saturday.  We needed some help on the kitchen drain and it was fixed by Conor, within 60 minutes of my text to him...amazing!!  Conor was great with his communications and coordinating all of the logistics of us renting his space, including the parking (which I was totally unfamiliar with...).  Couldn't have gone better...Conor is an amazing host!
Good place in a good location. Host was helpful and responsive.
Geo was a great  host. He responded in a timely manner and answered any questions I had. The space was very nice and was in a great location. I would for sure book again!

Communication with the host was great. The place is across from two schools and a nice park. Bed and pillows were clean and comfortable. Some minor things need some attention which I shared with the host. We didn’t spend a lot of time there since we were visiting family. It was a decent place to stay for the price.
Everything was great. Place was very clean, hosts were very responsive and it was in a walkable neighborhood with a ton to do.
It made a wonderful place for my family gathering.
Beautiful apartment right across the street from our reception
Great spot to stay a weekend near Pilsen!
Pilsen was a fun neighborhood to explore.  Lots of great food and artistic vibes.  This AirBNB is about a 15 minute walk to the Pink Line, which will get you to the Loop.

This apartment was an absolute delight. Great neighborhood, walkable, and super friendly concierge/security staff!  Fabulous deck and views of Millennium Park, but it was too cold in March and April to truly enjoy the deck.  I missed out on that!  I had no issues or maintenance needs, and appreciated that I was let to just enjoy the place.  Wishing I could have extended my stay.
Great stay in Chinatown. Place was clean and host was great in communicating. would definitely return.

Richard is a fantastic host! He met us at the door and gave some history to the town. He gave great recommendations and suggestions to get around and save money. He was quick to respond to any questions and invited us to enjoy a fire pit with him.
The home is very clean. Richard does a great job of providing some amenities (soap, mouthwash, feminine products, toothbrushes, etc) in case we forgot.
Everything was perfect!

Takers place was very spacious for my family trip away from home. We all had our own personal space to rest and get ready for the day. I appreciated the private entry from the garage to the house and we weren’t worried about anything happening during the night. I would recommend this stay and if I so happen to go on another big family trip to Chicago, we’ll check with Rameez’s place first!
Space was great for a large group of women!  Everything was clean and the listing was just as it was described.  Would stay here again.  Also, kid friendly!  Outlet covers and baby gates.
Accurate listing and responsive host. Comfortable bed and one of my favorite neighborhoods in Chicago - don’t miss the National Museum of Mexican Art!
Great place.
Guadalupe was very responsive and accommodating to our needs! She was a great host.
The stay was great and everything was just as described. Unfortunately there was an upstairs neighbor that was quite noisy but other than that I had no complaints whatsoever. I would stay here again!

It's close to the station, so I could get to my room quickly even at night.
The room was spacious and clean, and the kitchen was fully equipped with all the necessary cooking utensils, so I was able to enjoy cooking during my stay.
The best part was that the bed sheets felt incredibly soft against my skin.

Arthur was very responsive and accommodating! Check in was easy and the location made it easily accessible to a variety of places. There were a couple of tech issues with kitchen appliances and fans/light switches, but it was a comfortable stay overall and Arthur was very willing to address any concerns!
Great stay in Chicago! Not too far from Logan Square and Wicker Park areas. Very cute neighborhood street.

The location was great—very close to downtown—and check-in was incredibly easy. The host was always responsive and quick to answer any questions. The place looked exactly like the pictures and was very clean. Overall, a smooth and pleasant stay!
Lovely and well appointed home with a peaceful and gorgeous yard. Hosts were terrific. We love Rogers Park and we will definitely be back!
Amy was a lovely host and everything was as described in the listing! The space was clean and offered everything we needed to have a comfortable weekend. We would definitely stay again!

Borja’s was a good place for our friend trip. The location is very central. The apartment was a little cramped for 8, but we were out doing activities most of the time so it was a non-issue. Borja was very responsive and detailed in messaging about the space.

What a great find! The space was a perfect launch pad for a long weekend that included forays into downtown Chicago as well as the Botanic Gardens and a concert at Northwestern. Some welcoming creature comforts were a pleasant and thoughtful surprise. We (shockingly) found street parking for our rental car in the neighborhood and found good food (and amazing wine!) a short walk away! The real treat? We randomly bumped into one of the hosts on the sidewalk who instigated an introduction. That was super fun! It's quite rare to be able to meet the mystery hosts of an airbnb, especially one who is pure delight. I would definitely recommend this place!

La maison de Bianca était vraiment fidèle à elle même. Il y avait tout ce dont vous pourriez avoir besoin. L’emplacement était parfait pour nous qui souhaitions faire les touristes, et c’était sécurisé. Franchement j'aimerais y rester la prochaine fois que ce serait là bas.
Perfect place to visit Chicago!

Sofia’s place was a great location and size for the 3 of us! Things were tidy and well stocked for our arrival. Brendan was extremely communicative, which was really nice as it was our first time in Chicago. The floors were a bit loud but that comes with the charm of wood floors. Overall, we’re happy we chose this place to stay!
It’s a beautiful home, in a nice area. Very comfortable. It was peaceful and quiet. No complaints.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay in Sara's Old Town apartment. It's really a great location and a wonderful neighborhood. The accommodations were exactly as pictured and described, and were a far better value than what was offered at area hotels- plus we got to feel like we lived back in Chicago again, which was fun. Super smooth check-in and out process. Thanks for being a part of our great weekend getaway, and we'll be sure to look you up again when we're making another visit.

Our stay was really good and comfortable
The location and neighborhood was really good and accurate to the pictures

Matt and Chris’s place is phenomenal. Every last detail was considered. They do everything to make the space as warm, welcoming, cozy, and peaceful as possible. Their house is a 1-2 minute walk from all of the most interesting restaurants, shops, and bars you could ask for. I loved walking down the main strip AND strolling down the beautiful tree-lined residential streets. Matt and Chris were endlessly friendly and accommodating, and they gave great local recommendations. 100/100
Great host, very responsive, helpful, and easy check in. The neighborhood was also very safe and quiet.
10/10 very clean Carl is a great host and is available always to help I 100% recommend this place
Really great place to stay in Chicago! The place was very clean, super close to many restaurants/ bars/ shops. Highly recommend staying here, Peter was an excellent host and communicator

Loved the location and the place was super clean! Well taken care of…the only drawback was that the bedroom was yours and the rest of the place was shared with other guests…that part was not clear in the ad.  This includes sharing a bathroom with others.  Everyone was clean and respectful, but it was a surprise to us is all.
Great place to stay! It was clean, comfortable, and very affordable. The host was responsive, and everything was as described. Excellent value for the price.

It was a great place! The area is nice. There is a Homeless shelter around but it didn’t bother me at all. I felt super safe in the Airbnb. People complained about noise in the other reviews but I didn’t had an issue at all. I didn’t even hear other people in the Airbnb. The room is exactly like in the picture and thats great. I love that it is that close to a Trainstation. The Host was super friendly and checked in with us a couple of times which made the whole stay even better. I can recommend that place 100% if you need an efforable place to stay in Chicago!

Hakim was kind, considerate and I had a very pleasant one month stay. Highly recommended for short and long term stay. I particularly appreciated when Hakim when out of his way to assist me on my personal matters when I just mentioned it.
The property is kept clean, restaurants in the area are spectacular.
Great place and great location!

We had a wonderful stay this weekend! The home was exceptionally clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that great care had been taken to make guests feel comfortable and welcome.
The hosts were incredibly helpful, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. They answered any questions promptly and made sure we had everything we needed.
Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I would highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable place to stay with outstanding hosts. We would definitely stay here again!
Great size for our party of 7. Perfect location. The host was great and communicated effectively & proactively.

Emanuel was a wonderful host. I had to book his unit at the last minute and he was very accomadative. The place was very clean, extremely nice and we felt right at home. I would recommend Emanuels place anytime.
Thank you..

This apartment was great for my family’s long weekend in Chicago. The neighborhood is very walkable with lots of restaurants and there is a playground nearby. The beds were comfortable and the apartment was clean. I appreciated the off street parking spot!

Junni’s place was fantastic! 12 of us stayed here for a friends graduation in Chicago and this served as a perfect landing spot for us! The house was clean and open/big enough to accommodate us all. The rooms were spacious and each couple had their own room, so that was great! Would definitely recommend this spot as there are great parks right across the street, a few restaurants/ stores at a 15-20 min walk, and it typically took us about 30 -35 minutes to get to downtown Chicago via Uber, so especially great if you want a more quiet area compared to the town. Definitely recommend!

Fortino’s apartment was perfect for our group of 6 people. The space was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed for a great stay. One of the biggest advantages was the bus stop right in front of the building, which made getting around very easy. There were also several restaurants within walking distance, giving us plenty of dining options nearby. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommended
Dorothy was a wonderful host and very responsive and helpful. Comfortable apartment with plenty of space.

Tia’s place was very nice during the time we stayed! It was very clean, the neighborhood felt safe, and my overall experience was enjoyable! Getting into the apartment was easy as well, Tia sent clear instructions with videos included in case there was any confusion. Tia was very nice to me and responded to my questions extremely quickly or within 5 min, I never had to wait a long time for a response ! I would definitely book again if i come to chicago again!
Great location! A perfect neighborhood to return to Chicago or visit for the first time.

Adamm's loft was perfect for 3 people who needed to be in the Lincoln Park neighborhood. There is a real dearth of hotels there which is surprising given DePaul University's presence. And with the insane hotel prices for some sort of oncology conference in town, Adamm's loft was was the most affordable for the space (*large*) and location. Would recommend for anyone wanting to be near Lincoln Park neighborhood in particular
awesome place would definitely stay here again two thumbs up

Bella was extremely accommodating during my long stay. She always quickly answered any questions I had and worked hard to help me with logistics like receiving packages. The place was the perfect size to feel at home at, with a nice kitchen and bathroom. It's also in a perfect location to reach surrounding neighborhoods via walking or public transit and the lake.

Great location and Andre was easy to communicate with when setting up the booking and giving me the info I needed to check in. Would recommend adding some bakeware (even just a cookie sheet or something) and a pot holder for using the oven and extra toilet paper but I truly can’t complain because it was a great deal and last minute reservation and I really enjoyed the building and unit. Bed was super comfortable with a bamboo mattress too and appreciated the ACs in both living room and bedroom since high up units like this tend to get quite hot in the evening but I was able to cool things down quickly even when it was very hot out.
Would definitely stay again. Thanks so much!

Very clean and had all the essentials.  Having a parking space included was great, but the spots were very tight.  We made it work though!  Comfortable beds, didn't watch too much tv... the couch/futon wasn't super comfy but it was fine.  Bathroom and kitchen were well stocked.  We'd definitely stay here again- great price for Chicago!

L’appartement est agréable et cozy. Il est situé dans un quartier en retrait du downtown, mais facilement accessible par transport en commun ou en voiture. Les environs sont mignons avec toutes les commodités. La terrasse a été un espace plaisant pour profiter du soleil.

Logement propre, proche de la ligne de métro, quartier calme. Bonne communication avec l’hôte. Arrivée autonome très facile. Lit très confortable, plusieurs oreillers, salle de bain équipée. Excellent rapport qualité prix !!!
2 points négatifs à soulever: chauffage et climatisation centralisés, que l’on ne peut pas régler dans notre chambre. Et mauvaise isolation: votre sommeil dépendra donc des autres voyageurs. Nous avons entendu les moindres faits et gestes des personnes au-dessus.

Jessie was super friendly and welcoming the whole time, and even offered me homemade food. The apartment was also very close to a train station which was incredibly convenient for getting around the city
Beautiful Airbnb that looks just like the photos. The space was very cute and clean. Junni was an incredible host and was super helpful before during and after the stay
It was a pleasant stay; Jaiva, Kai, and Jennifer were always kind and attentive to details; I would definitely stay with them again.

We had an amazing stay! The photos don’t do it justice, it’s even more incredible in person! We loved looking through their various collections, reading books to each other & vibing in the library. It’s in a lovely neighborhood & close to lots of cute shops and restaurants. James & Colin were amazing hosts, very communicative & gave us great recommendations! We will hopefully be back soon, the best Airbnb experience we have had!

The place was beautiful we would definitely stay again! Extremely clean, hosts were very responsive to any questions we had! Great location felt very safe and walkable to good restaurants, coffee shops etc.

This place was exactly what we expected. In a cultural neighborhood where we had absolutely no problems. We felt safe the entire 4 days! Adeoye was very helpful and called us upon arrival. We had no issues getting UBER/LYFT transportation, and the location was close to all the things we had listed on our itinerary. The beds were super comfortable, the showers were nice and hot, and the home had plenty of space for our group of 5. I would definitely stay here again on my trip back to Chicago!
Kevin was a great host and the property was exactly as advertised!

Very responsive host. The place was very clean, if a bit smaller than expected from the pics, but that’s always the case it seems. Very nice neighborhood. All in all a great stay to visit for our daughter’s graduation! Highly recommended.

Nice place for just a place to sleep and have a meal. TV is awkwardly placed and no remote was available so I had to download Roku app. Luckily we are a young couple and can figure that stuff out. No toilet paper was available upon arrival, host messaged back quickly but left toilet paper at wrong door (had to go search for it). Saw other reviews about the blinds but said they were fixed (They were not) I was not happy with the one paper blind into the bedroom when it faced the street. No duvet or comforter just a throw blanket making it cold. Small amount of towels for two people but luckily washer and dryer. Mostly booked for proximity to Rate field and got lucky finding bobble heads someone left by the trash they didn’t want from a giveaway game. The place is pretty bare bones compared to most AirBnB’s besides the coffee bar. No paper towels, or welcoming package. Spent approx 1k for two nights. Neighborhood is beautiful, filled with families and a park at the end if you have pets.

This is basically a hotel room without the amenities. It's just like in the photos.
Pros: Location. Gorgeous neighborhood. This little room is located in the worst apartment complex on the block. It's surrounded by gorgeous brownstones and homes, and is walkable to the park, restaurants, and great little neighborhoods.
The bed was great and the linens were soft. The air conditioning, though loud and annoying, worked. The shower water was hot (after about 5 minutes of warming up).
Though it's in a fairly lively apartment building (felt like a dorm, honestly), everyone quieted down around 10:30 PM.
Cons: It's right by the entry, so bring a sound machine and earplugs. You can hear people coming and going constantly. The door leaks SO much light from the hallway. I had to stick my dog's leash in the frame to block it! The tub floor is crooked (how!?) so if you have bad balance, I wouldn't bother with a shower.
The entry is awkward and filled with bugs and packages. Just a head's up.
very clean. we would have enjoyed a tv. our fault for not seeing that there is not   one
Had a great stay here! The apartment was in a perfect location and was exactly as described. Would stay here again.

Had a fantastic stay in Chicago! The place was spotless, incredibly quiet, and perfectly situated. I was able to easily Uber around to all my planned activities without any issues. I’d definitely recommend this spot!
Awesome spot.
Perfeito, é incrivel.
10/10 Great Host and Great Home. Would love to book again when in the area.
Wonderful, clean, beautiful home! Close ride to downtown. Highly recommend. Thank you for allowing us to stay!

Had a great stay at Lynette and Efrain’s place! Great location and easy street parking. Had all the essentials and more! Living room space is fantastic and had everything you need in the kitchen and bathroom as well. Would definitely recommend staying there and will request to stay again if in the Chicago area in the future!

This place had no pack n play/crib as advertised and discussed with the host. Our one year old had no safe place to sleep due to this. Host made no attempt to resolve this false advertisement when we informed them no crib was at the rental. A faulty lock wasn’t fixed during our stay. Lots of maintenance needed at this location- loose stair treads, exposed dishwasher wiring, wobbly steps, 1st floor TV doesn’t work, wobbly couches and tables throughout the house. Couches and outdoor furniture so low quality you don’t want to use them. A roof over your head and hosts reply quickly and often but not a high quality stay. I never leave reviews but this was disappointing enough that I have to.
Great space and great location near great restaurants and lots of good coffee shops very happy with this host

Robert’s place was a very nice stay. There is plenty of space and amenities. The neighborhood is quiet and walkable from several bus lines. Robert is a communicative host and made for a smooth check-in and experience overall.
Very good stay, convenient and comfortable place for a solo traveler.

We stayed for two nights while visiting family nearby.  Nate's unit was very clean, nicely decorated, and felt homey. We felt very comfortable there.  Parking can be a bit tricky, but that would not change our decision to stay there again. Close to Lincoln Square and the restaurants/shops along Rockwell.   We met Nate as we were checking out and he was very friendly.   Would stay there again.

My recent stay at Nicole's Airbnb was excellent from start to finish. The home was spacious, spotless, and exceptionally comfortable, making it easy to relax and feel at home. The neighborhood was quiet, safe, and beautifully maintained, while still being conveniently located just 10–15 minutes from Hyde Park.
Nicole was an outstanding host—responsive, communicative, and helpful throughout the entire stay. Check-in was seamless, the key-entry process was simple, and her directions were clear and easy to follow. I would absolutely stay here again and recommend this property without hesitation to anyone visiting the Chicago area.

Atlas and his wife were very friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. Their communication was excellent, and they responded quickly whenever we needed anything.
The only issue we experienced was with the hot water, but they were very understanding and worked to resolve the situation as best they could.
The Airbnb looked exactly like the pictures, and I really enjoyed the location. There were plenty of restaurants, shops, and things to do nearby. I also felt comfortable using the bus and train to get around the area.
Overall, I had a wonderful stay and would definitely book here again. Thank you for your hospitality! 😊
It was really nice!

We stayed in Jeff’s place for 2 weeks, and the location of the place cannot be beat. Everything is within easy walking distance (grocery stores, restaurants, coffee shops, and transportation). The condo is large and well appointed. Having a garage space, albeit small, was a plus since we drove. Kitchen was well stocked with appliances, dishes and cooking utensils if you wanted to cook.
Jeff is easy to get a hold of, friendly and very accommodating. The neighbors above and below can be noisy, so recommend a white noise machine when sleeping as they seem to be early risers.
Would definitely stay again!
Host was very communicative throughout the booking process and stay. Easy to find and walkable to a bunch of restaurants. Had a great time!
Lugar agradable para quedarse, buena zona y tranquila
Otto was a great host! we had a great experience booking with him!
Matricia was a wonderful host and this Airbnb was perfect for our Chicago golf trip.  She always made us feel at home and we had a great time. Thank you Matricia!
This is such a cozy space! It was a nice touch to our family trip. I highly recommend walking around the neighborhood.
Comfy spot in a convenient location.
The host was amazing!  Thank you so much!! Would book again.
Great place … great location

Aiste was absolutely wonderful about communicating and had a cleaning lady coming weekly; that was great!
A comfortable stay, though, is impacted by how respectful other guests are. In one case, I no longer felt comfortable sharing the same space as another guest. Thankfully, Aiste resolved it immediately -- I was able to move to another unit -- to the extent of my wanting to book longer.
Great Place in a good area, everything is within distance so you don’t really have to drive much. I would say it was great having everything within a walking distance. The place was nice and clean
The place was clean & looks just like the pics, the only downfall was parking and the steps on a drinking night lol.
I loved the place. Will come back ☺️

We had a great stay! The area was very quiet and walkable. We especially loved how close it was to the Orange Line(about a 10 minute walk), which made it super easy to get into town and around. Blue Frog was a couple doors down and amazing food! The place is pretty easy to get to and from the highway. If you’re coming from the East, i recommend driving past the front of the building and making your next left. Then drive down the alley until you find the Airbnb. Parking was super easy and the alley to the sidewalk was very convenient! Would recommend

Unfortunately, we had a few issues: leftover items, low ceilings and a slanted kitchen floor, unsecured rugs, unexpected noise and a malfunctioning security camera.
Overall, it was an okay stay: it was close to Radius, had easy to find and free street parking but, the co-hosts' communication and the place's cleanliness could have been better.
Second stay here. Lovely place, great location. Lots of good restaurants in the area, and lots to do.
Clean, great location, host was very responsive and easy to deal with
We loved our stay at Betsy’s place. The neighborhood was so great and comfortable to be in. The restaurants in the area were great! Would absolutely recommend staying here.
This is a pretty and quiet neighborhood in Chicago just a short Uber ride from downtown. Matthew gave lots of great neighborhood recommendations.
This was the second time we stayed at Caitlyn’s place. So comfortable for our group of seven. 10/10 recommend!

We had a great stay! Gio’s place is a quaint and classic Chicago walk up on a beautiful street. It has a clean and classic design with great natural light, crisp white linens and comfy beds. Loved the park close by and many restaurants easy to get to.
We were comfortable and felt safe.
When we come back to visit Chicago, we will definitely book here again.
My group and I had a great time. Shomari was an excellent host! Great communication, and a comfortable, spacious, clean place. We would absolutely come back if we were in the area again. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This place is perfect if you need a bit of space to rest near family or events in the suburbs. it's technically a basement (which John explained before we booked), but it has lots of light from lower windows and still feels cozy and homey. Everything was clean and easily accessible, and anytime we had a question John responded right away. Will definitely return here next time we visit family!

Great place in an excellent location. Plenty of space with comfortable beds and seating areas. Super clean and well appointed. Very close to restaurants and shops on Southport or Belmont, and easy walks to the rest of Lakeview, Wrigley and Roscoe Village. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again.
The place was great, spacious and comfortable! We enjoyed how easy it was to get to places from the location. Highly recommended!
This location is such a gem due to its convenient location near Logan Square and Humboldt Park. My husband and I loved walking to the farmers market and not worrying about where to park our car.

Andy was extremely kind and responsive and very helpful throughout the stay, and always attentive to any needs. The place itself was appropriate value and clean on my arrival. The only things I would say is that the place was a bit smaller than I expected. The lighting was okay, and the AC was a bit loud but did the job. Occasionally there were some bugs, though understandable as it is a basement. Overall however Andy was an excellent host.
Great stay, great hosts in a quiet yet convenient area.

This place was perfect! It is clean, quiet, and on a safe and quiet block with honest neighbors. You can tell they have lived there for a while. Ms. Helen is the sweetest and was extremely accommodating during the stay. She will help you with anything in her power and if I come back to Chicago, I would hate to have to book anywhere else. Thank you for a wonderful time. Until next time!
Our hosts were friendly, kind, and helpful. They provide a ton of information about the neighborhood and city as a whole. We would recommend a stay with them wholeheartedly!
It was a very enjoyable place to stay great food and atmosphere. Would recommend it to everyone.
Great place to stay. Everything was beautiful  in the apartment we loved the style. Great location as well. Amazing experience overall!
Everyone in our party loved the place conveniently located just minutes from downtown, it was clean, nicely decorated,and quiet which we all loved
Great host and good location

We had a great stay in Chicago! The home was clean, exactly as advertised, and had plenty of space for our family of six. The neighborhood was wonderful—safe, walkable, and close to everything we wanted to do. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again!

Fredrick’s place was exactly as described , the place was nice , very clean and smelled amazing . There was plenty of extra linens in the closet , everything we needed we had access to. Fredrick was very responsive and very respectful I would for sure stay here again . Ohhh and the beds and pillows were so soft and comfortable
Enjoyed the property. Space was clean and fresh. Neighborhood was quiet. And host was responsive

Kati and John were fantastic hosts. They were extremely attentive, responded promptly to any questions, and were very easy to communicate with throughout my stay. The unit was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location was excellent and made it easy to enjoy everything the area has to offer.
I would highly recommend staying here and would gladly book with Kati and John again in the future.
Great location. Clean and had all the necessary amenities. Parking on street but available near or around neighborhood. It would be helpful to get check out instructions via text or in house.
Great spot close to Oldtown and one block access to the brown line metro/subway/L station. Big comfy king size beds and plenty of space for everyone.
We had a wonderful time staying in this apartment and would recommend it to anyone in the area. It was clean and had plenty of space for 4 of us. Our host was communicative and made our stay easy.
Worked perfect for our needs!

We had a great stay here at Jane’s it’s was really clean and all other guests were respectful as well would definitely come and stay again, love that it’s right in between the airport and downtown very convenient

Loved staying here! The place looked great, (just like the photos) was very spacious, and the balcony was a great plus! Terry is a great host and was very responsive throughout the entire booking process! The location was perfect for our trip, the area is very walkable and it’s near a train station.

Was in town for the weekend with my daughters, wanted to show them the city. This apartment was perfect location for a near north side adventure. Close to great restaurants & downtown. Plus close to the lake and the running trails in Lincoln Park. Great value for the money, will definitely stay here again.
Very responsive and great host
Was lucky enough to meet the family and they are just such lovely people!
Room was nice, clean and host was very friendly and easy to communicate with.
It was close to our daughter’s apartment  and everything from fun shopping to great food was walkable.

Justin's home was just as advertised.  It was walkable to the lake (only about 2 miles) and very close to grocery store and restaurants.  Lots of space and can easily hold 7-8 people if you have a big group that you are travelling with.   Great location/quiet.  Was only there for two days and it was perfect for the time we were in town!

We have stayed at many Airbnb’s and have typically had a good experience.  This place was the best.  Quit location but close to the EL, coffee and restaurants.  Parking was easy and out front.  The place was very clean and well stocked.  It’s obvious that a lot of thought went into making this a wonderful place to stay.  Beautiful backyard to relax in too!

Hermosa casa y vecindario, cerca de restaurantes y atracciones de la ciudad, la casa limpia y juguetes para los niños, las camas muy cómodas y adecuadas para grandes y chicos, sin duda regresaríamos a hospedarnos con ellos!
We enjoyed our stay at Brian’s place. It looks exactly like the pictures and was clean. He was responsive and kind. Would absolutely recommend and stay again.
The rental was awesome, especially the patio!
Amazing stay, 10/10! Cindy and Mike were great hosts, very welcoming and easy to communicate with. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed. Would definitely stay again.

By far, oneof the best Airbnb that we've stay!
Definitely will stay at this place at our next visit to Chicago, if the place is available.
A great value and just as described!
Great location in Lincoln Square close to food, shopping, and the train station.

Spacious and clean house, great for a large family or large number of guests. Close to a lot of restaurants and close to public transportation. Dream rental are quick to respond to any questions or concerns. Bedrooms are furnished in a way to accommodate large numbers of people while remaining spacious. Theater room was a plus. Reason for limiting review to 4 star, furniture is worn out for the price point of the rental and this is the first i see an airbnb requiring a deposit and additional form to be filled outside of the airbnb site.
great stay!
Nice place perfectly comfortable for 6 guests.
Awesome place in a great neighborhood. The pinball machines were a hit with the group.
Quiet location. Easy to get to the train. Great coffee shop two blocks away!

This was our second time staying here. The unit is beautiful and in a location that’s easily walkable to transportation, restaurants, bars and music venues. Stuart is a great host. We would definitely stay here again!
We had a great stay - accessible location, great home and lots to do in the surrounding area. Lia was a wonderful host.
Great place. great location. great hosts! This place is top tier

Great place. Roger’s Park is an underrated neighborhood. Kim’s place is so convenient to the red line, it made for a great spot for us to do all that we needed to do.
Kim is a great host and always responded within minutes, if not seconds. Made things so easy on us.
Nice place. Would definitely recommend it
Great stay! Had some friends there for a wedding
The property offered plenty of space for our family, it was extremely clean and close to downtown!
This place was so cute and immaculately decorated. Nice, cozy, and clean. The hosts were super lovely and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

It was a wonderful experience and one of the prettiest airbnb’s I’ve stayed at. The house is absolutely gorgeous and looks just the picture. The area felt very safe and was quite close to downtown (20 min drive) I would definitely love to book it again!
I absolutely loved staying here. It was a peaceful, welcoming, private space in a corner of the city and close to everything I needed. Erin was a perfect host, and I would love to return.
The location was perfect for our group!
We had a great stay. Everything was clean and convenient, and Latrice was very friendly and responsive.

Wonderful space and wonderful hosts--truly a space where the soul can rest! Patrick and Christiane went our of their way to make sure I was comfortable and had everything I needed. They were proactive, thoughtful, and made me feel right at home. Their place is beautiful--sunny, quiet, filled with character, and easy access to anywhere you need to be in Chicago. Highly recommend to any one searching for a place in the city.
The host were great. The place is a hidden gym and a very peaceful area to stay. Thanks for the hospitality
We had a wonderful stay. Great views of the city.
most definitely our favorite space in Chicago yet! beautiful location, and amenities. right in the heart of downtown. can't beat it

This was the perfect stay for a large group for my bachelorette party. Lots of space and beds/couches, lots of bathrooms, two kitchens and an extra bar area downstairs - the rooftop and coach house were very cool! The neighborhood is walkable to lots of coffee shops, restaurants, and bars, and it's an easy Uber to much of the city. The hosts were responsive as well, and I'd recommend this spot to others looking for a space for a large group!

We had an amazing time at Emily’s place. Our family had more than enough space. It was a whirlwind three days but it was also relaxing.  Her home which is lovely, is located next to an awesome trail and walkable restaurants. This maybe my go to place when I visit Chicago. It was also close to downtown (15-25) minute drive based on traffic! I would highly recommend her home.

Chad’s place was conveniently located for our weekend trip to Chicago. He also accommodated our request for an early check-in with a small additional fee which was appreciated! Some surfaces could have used an extra dusting or vacuum, but overall it was clean. We enjoyed checking out a few of the nearby bars and restaurants while we were there!
Enjoyed the stay.  Location was great.
Everything I expected. Very nice, very clean, comfortable quiet place. The location was great and close to many attractions.

We had a great experience staying here and would absolutely stay again.
Sourin was an excellent host from start to finish — very responsive, communicative, and helpful throughout the entire process. He provided great details about parking, check-in, the neighborhood, and local recommendations ahead of our stay.
The location was one of the biggest highlights. It was about a 20-minute walk from the Salt Shed, with tons of restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and local spots nearby. It gave a much more authentic neighborhood Chicago experience outside of the typical tourist areas.
The house itself was comfortable, quiet, and very thoughtfully decorated with beautiful artwork and unique pieces throughout the home.
Overall, this was an amazing home base for exploring the city, and we’d absolutely stay again. Highly recommend.

Shawn’s place was great! The host was very attentive and responsive. The only complaint is that the wifi is spotty. The streaming services cut in and out, and the connection wasn’t the best. Otherwise, the place was clean, tidy, quiet, and exactly as described!

The place was nice and clean. Sharing the bathroom was not an issue. The only negative is that we could hear every little noise. Walls must be super thin. it wasn't a deal breaker. I would stay here again.

a lot more space then we had though there was, based on the pictures posted.
was easy to find an get in to very clear on how to get keys an get in.
very satisfied with the price of are weekend stay an how easy it was to get into downtown area as the L red and green lines are both with in walking distance. along with a few buss stops.

Excelente lugar para hospedarse. Todo estaba muy limpio, bonito y bien cuidado. El apartamento tiene todo lo necesario para una estancia cómoda. La comunicación fue excelente y la ubicación es muy conveniente, ya que hay una parada de autobús justo al lado del edificio. Sin duda, lo recomiendo y me volvería a hospedar aquí.
Wonderful house in a quiet neighborhood
Had a lovely stay. Clean, spacious and quiet!
Very cute place to stay in Wicker Park — relatively close to the city and walkable. Great for two people and/or a short stay!

The place is okay. The bathroom is dirty - mold in the shower, tub doesn’t drain so you stand in water, dirty floorboards, etc. Other reviews also mention the rooster, which is right next door and quite disruptive - it kept us up most early mornings.
Price is right and the location is very good - lots of excellent restaurants and shops around. Don’t miss void, don’t miss Superkhana, don’t miss Hopewell. Also close to the CTA and pretty easy parking if you have a car.
All in all it was okay and just needs a bit of maintenance to be good.
clean appartment and a very good host

Very cute and thoughtfully curated space, good size for two couples on a weekend getaway. The decor matched the photos, and there were nice touches like snacks, bathroom amenities, and a nice kitchen. Beds were comfortable, though the pillows were extremely thin.
That said, the home felt poorly maintained. The front doorknob was loose and pinched/cut several guests’ hands, the kitchen sink wasn’t secured (my husband fixed it himself), a bedroom door wouldn’t close properly, and there were holes and cosmetic issues throughout that made the space feel hastily renovated.
The biggest issue was noise. The unit above was extremely loud, with footsteps and children running causing the space to shake. Even quieter guests on the second night were easily heard through the thin floors and walls.
The location is walkable and street parking is manageable. Overall, while cute and thoughtfully stocked, the maintenance issues and noise would keep us from booking again. Not worth the cost.
Matthew’s Airbnb was perfect for our needs. It’s a great location, space is clean and as described in the pictures. Communication was great.
This house has a great location. It has an easy uber ride to downtown. It is very convenient. The house is very clean and spacious. We loved staying there. We highly recommend!

My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Gerrit’s place. He was super responsive and very flexible with our check-in and check-out times. We couldn’t have asked for a better host.
The home was perfect! It has lots of personality, and it’s extremely comfortable.
We also felt extremely safe in the neighborhood. And everything we needed was well within reach. The layout, the location, and everything else in between was amazing.
We’ll definitely be staying here for the next time we’re in Chicago.
Olga is very responsive and willing to help with everything. Very nice stay.
We were visiting Chicago for a family wedding with our adult children and their families so appreciated having two kitchens and two living rooms.
Very convenient location, spotless and comfortable. Host communicates promptly.  Fine stay.
This is a great place to stay. We had a very nice and comfortable stay. The location can't be beat as there are so many good restaurants and bars nearby. I would be happy to stay here again.
Very great place to stay and Ben was super responsive. Super clean and looked exactly like the pictures
Our host was very responsive and gave clear instructions on what we needed to do to gain access to the building. The unit itself was nice and fit the five of us very comfortably!

Absolutely beautiful Apartment and very spacious. I loved the private parking lot. Very, Very Nice Apartment and room. I would Definitely book this room again on my next visit to Chicago. Loved it. The stairs was alot but I would STILL book this location. It's in a good, peaceful,safe part of town.
We enjoyed our stay at Yadi’s place! It was clean, safe, and was easily accessible to downtown Chicago.
It was great staying at Tracy and family's place. Great location and very nice hosts!!
Olga was very kind and willing to help. Her place was clean and very conveniently located only a short walk to the station. Would definitely stay again!

The rental was great for a girl’s trip, had everything we needed. The place is in a great location walking distance to shopping and the coffee place across the street was so good! Plenty of free parking in the area and it’s close to the main highway so easy to get to the airport. Everything was clean and as described, would stay again!

We stayed at Mark & Marcelo's place for 2 nights and I have to say I've not slept so well at any AirBnb before! Their place is tranquil, comfortable, safe, quiet, and well decorated. We felt like we were at home.
The location was convenient for us to explore the North side neighborhoods; it wasn't too far to drive into the city from as well. It was very convenient having a parking spot since we drove there from out of state.
We would love to return here for our next Chicago stay and would highly recommend their place to anyone!
We’ve stayed in Josh’s properties before and recommend. You can’t beat the location! And if you love the cubs, you’re in for a treat!!

Maria’s place was great! It was spacious and peaceful! Maria provided all needed toiletries/paper products/etc that were needed for my entire stay which was a huge plus! Would definitely recommend this place, especially if you have a car, as there was a parking spot included

A great host and the location was ideal for us and our visit to Chicago.
If you’re coming for a Show at the Vic or a game at Wrigley, this is a great spot.
The only negative is its location to the train/CTA. That takes a some getting used to but welcome to Chicago.
I will return for sure. We were all very happy.

Beautiful rental that was spacious, very clean, and well-maintained. We had a wonderful stay and found everything comfortable and inviting. The host was great, and we would definitely stay here again.
It was a great little unit that had exactly what we needed. Right across from the beach and walking distance to all the fun stuff on the mag mile. Definitely would stay here again.
Great apartment for our group of 4. Near the University of Chicago. Perfect,
We really liked the apartment and the neighborhood, as well as the short walk to the nearest train station and the supermarket. The apartment was equipped with everything we needed.
Space was as advertised.  Brandon was great at responding to our questions.

My husband's family all traveled to Chicago from Ontario, Canada to visit his brother. We had 12 people and we all fit comfortably in the condo! The neighbourhood was very cute with a park and baseball diamond down the street for the kids to play at. We took an Uber to Rate Field and it was about 30 mins.
We had trouble with the lock and could not get in when we arrived, but Innocencia and her team responded quickly and had another tenant let us in. That night, there was someone there working on the lock. I was impressed with how prompt they acted. I would stay here again and recommend this place to others 😊

We chose this place because we thought it was a good value for the area since Chicago can be pricey but in the end we regretted. Initial impression was we did not get the check in code before arrival I had to ask for it myself two times and still didn’t receive it until after check in time when we had already arrived. There were a lot of people standing in front of the home and hanging out from the neighborhood so we were unsure if we should leave things in our car or not. Then the walk through of the home was ok. We noticed a lot of things were damaged and broken. Going up to the rooms upstairs we notice a drastic difference in temperature. It was very warm and we ended up having to buy a window ac and some of us even decided to stay elsewhere after the first night because we couldn’t sleep. The WiFi was also not good we couldn’t connect to our devices. Lastly we ended up getting locked out of a bedroom and it was hard to get this issue resolved we almost missed our event.

Michael’s home was by far the BEST we’ve stayed in to accommodate children. The home has everything you could need and more! And, the beds are super comfy!! On top of the amazing home, Michael went above and beyond to provide clear, detailed check-in instructions and several local recommendations. We absolutely loved our stay and will try to stay again next time we are in Chicago.
Loved the location and having parking garage access made it even better!  Very comfortable bed and peaceful courtyard. Hosts were friendly and helpful!
The house was large enough to accommodate my large family without feeling crowded. The house is charming.
Unit had everything we needed.  Area was quiet and safe.  Good value.

This place was very clean and looks exactly like the pictures , the host was very nice , well stocked with towels and toiletries, the area was close to a lot of activities to do in the CHI , highly recommended place to stay
We loved our stay at Amy’s place. The neighborhood was peaceful and charming and Amy and Dean were wonderful, accommodating hosts.

Sarah was generous in the amenities provided. The unanimous consensus of our family is to use the property again should we have the opportunity to do so. We weren’t there long before we felt at home. Proactive with information and responsive to queries, Sarah is as great a host as we could hope.

Overall, we had a great stay! The space was larger than it appeared in the photos and comfortably accommodated our group of 10 without ever feeling crowded.
One thing to note is that the upstairs AC doesn't circulate as effectively as the downstairs unit, so the upstairs was quite warm when we arrived. It did improve over time, but it's worth being aware of.
As a suggestion for future guests, it would be helpful if the host provided more utensils (forks, knives, and spoons), as we ran out fairly quickly and found ourselves washing them frequently for reuse. Additional dish towels would also be appreciated.
We also noticed that some of the closet doors were off their tracks, which occasionally made them difficult to open and close.
Aside from these minor issues, we enjoyed our stay and found the home spacious and comfortable
The apartment was great and most places, i.e. restaurants, entertainment etc. are within 20 mins walking. The car park is a few minutes walk.

Beautiful views, very comfortable, Racine stop is a block away, took the blue line in from O’Hare, easy peasy.  Target next door is super convenient, accommodated 3 couples perfectly.  Chicago is a blast!  We were there for a graduation at the Credit One Arena, the 5 min walk was a luxury.  Thanks for a lovely stay!
Excellent location to get anywhere you want to go.

Scott's place was just where we wanted to be in bustling Wicker Park, and close to so many transit options who needs to bother with street parking? The place was spotless, roomy, quiet and comfortable. Kitchen has all the quality tools, cookware and service ware you would need (bring your own seasonings if required). Scott is a great communicator and very accommodating with our arrival and departure times. Highly recommended, absolutely want to stay again.

Nice neighborhood, always somewhere to park, very nice home. Basement was nicely fixed up, great bedroom and bathroom, and very private. Hosts were communicative and very nice. Would stay there again!
Florin was a great host, plenty of space in our Airbnb and had everything we need. Clean, showers were great, and good AC. Is great for a large group!
It was in a great location for exploring Chicago, and I loved the many amenities within the stay!
Nice location, quiet and clean neighborhood. Comfortable beds, clean bathroom. Having an available Parking space was bonus.
We had a great time at Jennifer’s place!

We were overwhelmed how beautiful the place was. The pictures were great but once we stepped inside this place was even better than we thought, it was perfect! From the spacious main room and comfortable couches to the 3 bedrooms, with tons of storage and the managers  and staff were excellent, helpful, friendly and accommodating. We definitely will book another stay there.
great place. great location!

This area of Logan Square really highlights the best that Chicago has to offer - tree-lined streets, cafes and restaurants just a block or two away, bikeable, and great transit on every corner to head to Wrigley Field, Wicker Park or downtown to Millenium Park, the Art Institute and even Chinatown. Matt's place provided gracious lodging, roomy enough for all five of us - and to allow grumpy teenagers their own space. The kitchen was well stocked for cooking. There was easy access from the front and the back. And, the back patio ended up being a nice place for hanging out in the evening or the morning. We will return to Chicago and will rent Matt's place again.
Nice and clean home, me and my friend enjoyed our stay.
Very convenient location on Devon. No dedicated parking but we were able to find the street parking everyday. Place is as shown in the pictures.
Stay was great! Please was really nice and Serg + team were super communicative. If you are attending an event at the united center, the location is ideal.

This was a perfect house and location for a girls’ trip.
Rasheed was a very gracious and helpful host, we highly recommend this property!

We couldn't have been happier with our stay at Anne's place.  It was a great location for our Chicago stay, within walking distance of many great restaurants and a short Uber/Lyft to everything else.  Anne was proactive in providing instructions for how to access the space and responsive to any questions.  The space was clean and comfortable.  I would not hesitate to stay again here in the future.
The place worked well for our family reunion. Cool nieghborhood.

We stayed here for to celebrate my first cousins engagement and we had such a great time. Adam’s place looks identical to the photos, it is so so cute and very clean!! We live local but it really made us feel like we were on vacation with how beautifully decorated the home was and how secluded the backyard felt for a city yard.
I also contacted Adam about checking in a bit earlier to be able to decorate for my cousin, which he allowed us to do at no extra charge. It was overall a 10/10 experience. If i ever need to stay in an air bnb in Chicago again, I’ll go here!!
Amazing Cozy and Safe Space ❤️
We had a lovely stay at Ross’s place, the location was great and we really enjoyed the rooftop patio with its skyline view!

Loved this place. Tree-lined West Logan Blvd is gorgeous. It was a walkable distance from our daughter’s apt in Logan Sq so it worked out really nicely. The apt is a basement apt but didn’t feel like it. It was well lit and very clean. Birds chirping all around. The bed was super comfortable, firm, w memory foam type mattress, and the kitchen was stocked w everything you could possibly need. We’d go back any time. Thank you to Forest.
Perfect place to stay with a group in Chicago.

Our family of 9 enjoyed staying at Vince’s place when we were in town for a wedding.  We found the house clean and comfortable with plenty of room to spread out. The neighborhood was nice and quiet.  The area is walkable and there are restaurants within walking distance.  We attended the Portage area Hotdog Fest during our stay which was fun.   Communication with Vince was helpful and prompt.

Tamara and Tony are extremely responsive and helpful. They were super accommodating for us on a few things and our group had an excellent stay. The pool is amazing (and heated)! You can tell they put a lot of love and care into the place. I’ll be recommending to family and friends who come to town. One of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had. Get location and people!
Great location in Chicago, very walkable to the beach and restaurants.

The place was great! The stay was good for public transport. We had fun over our period of stay and downtown was pretty close too. Would definitely recommend this place which is perfect for 3-4 people!
Airbnb was beautiful. Beyond clean and quiet. Beyond met our expectations. Location was a little iffy but very quiet and we felt comfortable with leaving our rental in front of the Airbnb.

Claudia’s place was so nice, welcoming, and calm. The location’s only downside is noisy at times upstairs neighbors but any issue we had, Claudia was so quick to respond and proactive in finding solutions. She even left a handwritten note welcoming us, with some snacks!
Would highly recommend! ❤️

Hubbard Holdings was super responsive and allowed us to check-in early with no additional cost. We were also able to get an additional parking spot inside the secure garage. The location of the Airbnb was amazing on the north side and the city view from the enclosed balcony was truly breathtaking. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to spend some time and see the sights in Chicago!

Clean, welcoming, and conveniently located, Fed’s home checked every box. From the start, Fed was responsive, helpful, and even took the time to personally meet us at check-in. The home felt like a multi-level sanctuary within a gated community, with plenty of outdoor space to enjoy, including a rooftop deck and private terrace.
The linens were crisp, the design was stylish, and the space was thoughtfully maintained and free of clutter. Overall, this was a fantastic stay—Fed is a wonderful host, and his property is truly a great find.

Toby’s place met our needs well for the weekend of our son’s wedding in nearby Avondale neighborhood.  Great location, deck/yard, stocked kitchen, early check-in, fairly easy street parking for second car (first car in garage).  The only reason for 4 stars is that the 3rd bedroom description says “2 full beds” when it’s actually 2 small beds, much more appropriate for kids than our 6 ft 200 lb sons.
Great apartment!
Philip was very helpful and responsive, the place was very clean.
This place was in a great neighborhood and very easy to find. There was plenty of parking. It was extremely clean and had everything we needed. Would highly recommend!

The place was cute for a weekend trip! It is very conveniently located to the station. The only con is that the owners live upstairs and you can hear them walking around upstairs. In one of the bedrooms it’s a lot louder than the other and oftentimes woke me up. The hosts were very responsive and nice though,  I would still recommend staying here!

Amazing location in wrigley, beautiful home, clean, hosts were communicative during every part of the booking process and very kind in response to our questions. Be weary and know about noise rules prior to booking your stay!
Great spot with good food options in neighborhood.  A+

Steven is super friendly and a great host. We were able to chat about our plans for the weekend and we had a late checkout to leave outlr bags there for our evening flight. My wife and I will stay here again we we come to Chicago
Great stay! Def recommend to anyone looking for a convention location.
Great spot near our friends in Andersonville!
We had a wonderful stay in Chicago at the Magic Factory Loft 2West. The unit was immaculate and beautiful and very close to restaurants and shopping. We enjoyed it very much and highly recommend it.
I had a good stay. Host had snacks, waters, and coke available. This place is a lot bigger than expected. Very spacious and well kept.
It’s a cozy place with a comfortable bed. Quiet street. It is a pleasant 20 minute walk to the Melrose blue line stop.

Easy, comfy stay for our extended family weekend in town for a wedding. House is well put together, host is quick to respond and problem solve if needed. Easy access on foot to the relaxing Bloomingdale Trail and on bike or e-scooter to Wicker Park shops and restaurants.

We were in town for our daughter's wedding and booked the house for several days to accomodate my husband and me, our son and his fiancee, and my brother-in-law and sister-in-law.
