Everyone raved about how nice the house was and how convenient it was to everything. we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely book with Ed & Hillary again, as they were delightful to work with.

Adrian was a great host- allowed us to get into the space early and leave a little later than listed times, gave great recommendations, and was super communicative and responsive! Would absolutely book here again if we’re ever back in the area!
David is a great host. The place has no kitchen so be warned.

My only big complaint was the thermostat. It continued through the trip to change into high temps (75-85 degrees). Prudence did reply on this stating we could change it to where we wanted but it still would rise overnight or while we were gone during the day.
This wasn't enough to ruin the stay. It was unfortunate as some of us overheat easily but the home cooled quickly after changing it to be lower.
We loved this place overall! The station was so close and we had stores and restaurants we could walk to with no issues. I'm very happy this was my first airBNB experience!

The Pilsen neighborhood was nice, quiet and easy to get around.
The Airbnb was nice, cozy and very well stocked. I brought a lot of stuff I didn’t need to because it was provided. The place felt like home away from home. We will recommend it and book it on our next trip to Chicago.
Ps loved the blinds you could see out of them but couldn’t see in.

I really enjoyed my extend stay with Karen, it was very comfortable and inviting, having a private bathroom and dedicated office space all in a space that rivals most Studio apartments. The management team was very positive and great communicators. I can’t recommend them enough and would not hesitate to book a stay with them again if temporary lodging is ever needed.
Ryan is an A+ host. He made sure we had everything we needed, was flexible with check-in, and was very friendly.
Great location, perfect for a weekend trip. Space looked exactly like the photos and was very clean. Exactly what I was looking for.
It was perfect for our weekend!

Angel’s place was fantastic.
The location was excellent, very close to public transportation, including CTA buses that connect you easily throughout the city, which made getting around simple and convenient.
The apartment had everything we needed to feel at home. It was spotless, well organized, and thoughtfully equipped so we could stay comfortable throughout our visit. We especially appreciated access to laundry, reliable air conditioning, and all the cleaning supplies provided to keep the space tidy.
Angel was an outstanding host, very attentive and communicative. He made sure we had all the information we needed about the neighborhood, including helpful details like the street closures during summer. His attention to detail really made a difference and contributed to a smooth and enjoyable stay for both me and my wife.
Thank you so much, Angel, for such a pleasant experience. We would absolutely love to return in the next few months.
Hope to stay in touch
Juan & Camila.
Great location walking distance from train and the lake.

We stayed at Inez’s place for a month and overall had a very good experience. The apartment is in a great location in West Town/Ukrainian Village, in a safe and convenient neighborhood with good connections and nearby services. It was reasonably priced for Chicago and very well equipped with everything we needed for a longer stay, including access to laundry, which we really appreciated.
Inez was very attentive, kind and responsive, and quickly helped with anything that came up. A few things are worth noting: the apartment is in the basement of a larger house, with access through a narrow side passage and rear entrance, which was not completely clear from the listing. Cooking smells can linger, and there was occasional noise from upstairs, the HVAC system and the fridge.
Overall, we were happy with our stay and would recommend it. It is practical, functional and well located, and Inez was a great host.
Great place and location. Ryan was responsive, which I appreciate.
We booked this unit same day, the host was communicative and responsive. Great location but the train is very loud, wouldn't recommend for groups with children.
We had so much fun staying here!! Such friendly hosts and i would 10000% rebook!

If you’re looking for a cheap bare-bones places stay, this is definitely the spot. I wouldn’t stay longer than a night, but it gets the job done. Thermostat was locked at 75 and no AC was provided. There were also no hand towels in the bathroom and I was only provided one towel to use for three nights. Bathroom smelled pretty horrendous and was quite nasty to be honest. Absolutely no lighting was provided other than the overhead big light, which made the atmosphere quite depressing. There were no windows to open up to not only air out the smell but also to be able to keep the room less hot. No mirrors were provided in my room so you will be unable to see fully what you’re wearing if you plan on heading out somewhere. Wouldn’t come back here again unless changes are made.

Ryan and Nicole are fantastic hosts, and we were thrilled to be able to stay in their beautiful home.  They answered questions promptly and were always friendly and helpful! The house is beautiful and is in a really nice neighborhood not far from the lake.  The home has everything that you will ever need for a stay (plus more!).  I can't recommend this house and these hosts enough, and hope to stay there again in the future.

Our family stayed at Liliana’s for a long weekend in Chicago. Place was amazing. Charming, walkable neighborhood with a market nearby for essentials. We enjoyed the restaurants/coffee in the area. Having a dedicated parking spot was great as well. We would definitely stay here again.

A warm and inviting host, beautiful house, and great location make this stay hard to beat. The house's historic details and comfortable beds and living space made us feel at home. Just around the corner are restaurants, a Whole Foods, the CTA Red Line, Wrigley Field, and more.  And Nancy made us feel welcome and responded even quicker than we could. We're grateful for a nice stay.
This is a perfect little space for a quick weekend stay in Chicago. Everything in the Wicker Park area was very walkable. Maria was very kind and quick to respond if I needed anything at all!

Loved Erika’s place and will definitely stay again when I’m in Chicago. This is one of the cleanest Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed at and the bed and linens were great. The neighborhood is so cute and a two minute walk to the brown line. Don’t hesitate to book this one!

This location was perfect for a wedding being held in the neighborhood. We had three couples and it was a perfect size. The parking was simple to use. The temperature was perfect. We sat out on the patio one evening. It worked perfectly for our needs.
Good place to use as a crash pad for the weekend.  We had 2 nights of concerts and plenty we wanted to do around town so having an L stop a 15 min walk away was good enough!
This place was immaculate!!! Very nice and clean and very roomy, would definitely book with Ramone again!!! Great experience
Great stay, perfect location, nice and clean,

A cute basement spot near anything you could want.
The bed was a pull out couch and it was as comfortable as one of those can be. No complaints, but don't expect an adjustable bed mattress.
There was a smell coming from the bathroom as mentioned in other reviews. The host offered to try to fix it, but it wasn't that bad. I couldn't smell it outside the bathroom. After a couple of days it got much better.
The steps to get into the basement are very steep and the lighting isn't amazing. Here are my tips on that:
There's a little step leading to the stairs that is easy to miss at night. Watch for it.
Going down the stairs there are green lights that light the pathway. At the top of the stairs the switch on the left turns them on.
There's an overhead light that is motion-activated, but the motion sensor doesn't kick on until you get to the second step. If you're a nervous Nellie like me, you can flip the switch on the right to turn them on right away.
I'd stay there again.
I didn't hang out there.  Just slept and showered. Very clean house. Great location from Belmont stop. Good communication. Definitely recommend. No issues at all.
For the price good accommodation. No issues with other guests, noise levels or neighborhood.

The place was very clean and exactly as described. The host was very friendly, responsive, and accommodating throughout my stay. Everything was comfortable and well-maintained. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!
Sayra was a very kind, helpful and prepared host. Looking forward to my next stay!
Great place to stay. Beautiful home. Room is spacious, quiet, and comfortable.  Good location in relation to restaurants and access to the trains. Highly recommend!
We had a great stay.  Nice area  and very clean. Would definitely stay there again.
Awesome accommodations. Stay was very comfortable and everything was as subscribed.  Access was easy, very nice furniture and very spacious.  Would love to use again.
no complaints,looked exactly like the photos. In great area very peaceful.

Kevin's place was beautiful and it looks exactly as it does in the photos.  It's the perfect location as well.  Highly recommend.

We were in town for a wedding in the West Loop and Thomas’s airbnb fit exactly what we needed for our group of 4. It is easily walkable to all restaurants and bars in the West Loop and a short uber down to the water. Thomas was very responsive if we had any questions and the place was very clean and comfortable.
His place was great, very clean and comfortable with nice extras. He was also very accommodating and responsive.  I'd definitely stay there again.
It is a good space that felt homey and eclectic at the same time. It is close to public transit. The neighborhood seemed safe and walkable. Holly was a great host with tons of recommendations.
This was a super convenient option for a quick trip into the city. It is about 30 minutes uber into the city, but for us it worked out well. The house was clean and comfortable.

No complaints whatsoever. It was clean and the host was communicative. For my first time in Chicago I felt so safe and at home. It’s a little far from the downtown area but I knew that going into it. I wish I had more feedback but yes great stay and great hosts. No notes.

Great spot. Good part of town. Know that it’s 4 stories tall, so if stairs are difficult this isn’t the spot for you. Loved the balconies and the area. Airbnb was spacious and good sized for a big group!

We had a wonderful stay! The property was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and very well maintained. The host went above and beyond by leaving breakfast items for us, which was such a thoughtful touch and greatly appreciated. Everything was easy, convenient, and matched the listing perfectly.  The property is near the highway so the complimentary earplugs were very helpful! Would stay here again!

This was our second stay in Junni’s house. The dining room table was set, which was a nice touch. Plenty of seating in the living room, and plenty of storage in the bedrooms. Nice and quiet area. I had a special request that was honored, that I appreciated. We will stay again if the opportunity arises. R

pay 1/3 of the month's rent to stay 2 nights at a cramped apartment with 1-ply toilet paper, bedsheets and towels pilling with loose threads, and an infestation of some kind according to a sign in the lobby? When I showered, the water pressure was terrible and when I used a bath towel, the fibers came off on my body. When asking for parking, the owner said "use SpotHero." I got towed. There are no clear cut rules, which left me asking, do I wash the dishes and take out the trash? Will there be a cleaning fee? What will the cleaning fee be used for? I clean anyway, I look under the bed to see trash, the sponge is growing mold and there is 2 clorox wipes total for the entire apartment. You're paying hotel prices for no hospitality, the only convenience is the walkability, shops close by, and the area is safe.

I had a great time staying at Adela's place with my cats while looking for a new apartment. The neighborhood feels very safe and you're super close to Lincoln Square. The apartment was very spacious and clean, and I really enjoyed my stay.

Thanks to Demitri’s great place to stay in Chicago, our family enjoyed our time here. I appreciate Demetri’s reponsiveness, and his guidebooks help us find many interest of places and nearby restaurants easily. There’re free street parking spots available in the next block which took 2 minutes’ walk. The room is clean and spacious so we can enjoy peaceful night after long walks during the day.
I enjoyed my stay here. It is as advertised and in a nice area. Was close to everything I needed access to. Great place
Amazing house loved the pictures on the wall definitely felt like home
Great location
Lovely place to explore Chicago from. Demitri was an excellent host.

I would book Kyriako’s place over again if I’m ever in Chicago.  Unit looked more beautiful in person, and super clean and very organized just the way I like my space. It was very homely and the neighborhood was peaceful and serene.I would rate Kyriako’s place a 12/10.

Enjoyed my stay here! The space is on a quiet street but close to lots of dining options and easy transportation access. Right near a transit line so it was easy to get downtown whenever I wanted. The place was comfortable, private, cozy, and perfect for my stay in Chicago! The hosts were also very helpful and accommodating with anything I needed.
Great little place to stay in Chicago! Cute neighborhood, very good location, and super cozy.

Ho Eun’s place was spotless, I was skeptical about the parking but there are free available spots on the front street, loved the apartment and the neighborhood is safe and quiet, definitely recommend it!

this airbnb was very clean and spacious for the price. All the necessary amenities were provided, including towels, an iron, and a washing machine. The surrounding area was also quiet and felt safe. I had a bit of trouble opening the door at first, but it was easy once I followed the host’s instructions carefully. If I come back to Chicago I would love to stay at this place for a longer time.

Pasamos una estancia increíble. Desde nuestra llegada, las indicaciones fueron claras y pudimos entrar sin ningún problema. Sin duda tengo que destacar que la regadera fue un gran plus de este alojamiento, el agua caliente siempre, hicieron que todo fuera más relajante. Es un detalle que hace la diferencia. La cocina tiene lo indispensable para comer lo que requieras. Me gustó mucho hospedarme aquí, todo fue tranquilo, se sentía privado y en general el ruido fue muy poco. Lo recomendaría totalmente, ya que además es un gran precio.
Nice place to stay for a Chicago trip!
Dan is a welcoming and considerate host. The location is great for medical students!
The apartment was cute and cozy. Close to Broadway and the train station so it’s easy to find a breakfast spot and get on public transport.

I spent a whole month here and it couldn't have been better. The apartment is cozy and truly felt like a home away from home. Logan Square is an amazing neighborhood, full of life, great coffee shops, and charm. Definitely a perfect spot for long-term stays.

This place was awesome! It was just as described and the location was awesome—very walkable and lots to do nearby! The host was extremely helpful and knowledgeable, answering ALL my questions and providing great recommendations! I’d definitely stay here again. Thanks!
Ben was an amazing host. His unit exceeded our expectations! We will definitely book again!
I would recommend it to anyone

We had a wonderful stay overall. The host was incredibly communicative, kind, and thoughtful throughout our trip. They went above and beyond by leaving us cookies upon arrival and ensuring the home was stocked with plenty of amenities, which made settling in very easy and comfortable.
While the location may not have been the perfect fit for our particular itinerary, everything else exceeded our expectations. The property was well-prepared, welcoming, and exactly as described. We truly appreciated the host’s hospitality and would happily recommend this stay to future guests.

This one-bedroom open-concept apartment was a great fit for two adults and our two dogs. The space was roomy, featuring a large kitchen and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer.
The bed was a bit firmer than I prefer, but overall, we had a very enjoyable stay. Street parking worked well for our needs. Parking costs $5 for two hours between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM through the Chicago parking app, and parking is free from 10:00 PM to 7:59 AM. If you plan to sleep in, be aware that you may need to move your vehicle to the opposite side of the street after two hours, as parking along this stretch is limited. Do not park your car from 0700-0900 on tuesdays and thursdays car will be towed. I would not recommend this apartment for guests who use wheelchairs or have significant mobility limitations. The stairs and wooden walkway are quite narrow and may be difficult to navigate safely.
Overall, this was a great stay, and I would happily recommend it to friends and fam.
The parking was a huge problem. Overall, everything was very nice. Had some issues with turning on the fan, It was super hot.
Perfect little spot in a great location!

Great place to stay considering the price point. Josh was very responsive and polite before and during my stay. Decent sized room and a nice, clean bathroom. Great neighborhood as well. The only downsides were the slightly thin walls which allowed a bit of noise in and may disturb a light sleeper and the lack of power outlets next to the bed. I also like sleeping with a bit of breeze, so I brought my own portable fan (no fan in the bedroom). But my overall experience was good and met my expectation considering the price is well below average, would recommend.

This place is  gem. We felt right at home and can confidently say we’ve never stayed at such a well stocked place. Tommy really has thought of everything, down to having disposable coffee cups which came in handy on morning walks. The beds are comfortable, linen and towels nice and soft and the backyard a lovely place to hang out. Tommy is a fantastic host. 100% recommend and will book again on our next trip

From booking to checking out Shaun was extremely helpful, and attentive. We visited as a family of 4, the accommodation was ideal. Very easy to travel round Chicago; bus direct to Lincoln Park, and easy connection to blue line trains for airport and downtown. Coffee shop next door was great. A great stay in a great city. We would highly recommend this property.

If I could create the perfect place for our first visit to Chicago, this would be it! Gorgeous unit, perfect location, safe - with 24 hour security, clean and big. So many things within a few blocks - CVS, L train, restaurants, Whole Foods, coffee shops. Speaking of coffee, the adorable coffee shop on the ground floor was super convenient. We had amazing weather and saw so many sights. It was a great experience.
Wonderful stay! The host was super helpful, and amazing at responding to any concerns or questions we had! Great location and conveniences, super clean and plenty of room!

We enjoyed our stay at Susan’s Airbnb. The area is safe and quiet and close enough to downtown for us. The unit was clean and met our needs. Susan had very clear instructions which made our stay stress free. She also responded quickly to any of my questions during our stay. I would stay there again.
Stayed here for a wedding which was a ten minute walk. We had plenty of room and it was very comfortable.

Abel’s property is located centrally with easy access to downtown and places of interest in Chicago. The kitchen is well equipped with clean bathroom and fresh and clean linens. Spacious, airy and bright with natural light. Would love to stay at this property in future.

The host was very responsive and helpful.
The place is well located, there is easy access to public transportation to Chicago.
It was also clean and quiet.
Over good option for people who’d like an apartment style stay on their trip to Chicago.
The apartment was great, a good size, clean, and in a good location. Iris was very responsive with any questions, and it was a lovely place to stay. Thank you!

We really enjoyed our stay!  Everything was squeaky clean. The extra amenities are very thoughtful. It could not have been closer to Riverwalk and Mag Mile. Walkable to Pier & Financial District.  Easy & flexible check in. Above a bar, but not a noise problem- even added to the ‘city vibe’.  Hosts were proactively welcoming and helpful. I would highly recommend staying here - 5 star location and host!

This was an excellent spot to stay at! It was super easy walk to multiple train stations, and not too far from the lake front for walks/runs. We also had a small issue with the washer which they literally fixed within two hours! They were incredible hosts and I would highly recommend staying here for a Chicago trip!
Dan was able to accommodate me on short notice after my other housing fell through. He was friendly, communicative, and really goes out of his way to make you feel welcome!

Very flexible check in, clear entry instructions!

The house was beautiful and our room and amenities were just as described! Ryan was very informative, responsive, and helpful with anything we needed. Greta place to stay when visiting.
The hosts were super responsive and the area is perfect! Easy access to public transit, very safe, & quiet!
Super friendly! We had a great time :)

We had a great few days in Chicago staying in Karen’s place. Buena Park is beautiful and the easy access to the lakeside park and CTA made it ideal. Karen had everything ready and was wonderful when we met her

Ag’s place was spotless and very well-appointed. It was clear a lot of care went into furnishing and taking care of the place. Very clear instructions were provided on the location and check-in. The neighborhood is walkable with many restaurants near by.

Nice place. Clean, comfortable. Extra bedding and pillows available. Off-street free parking is the best! Trouble at check-in because keys were not available as described; had to wait for hostess to bring keys which made us late for our dinner appointment. Also know that heavy luggage with wheels might be a challenge because of stepping stones near front of property, and stairs to front door and also to the unit entrance upstairs. And no washcloths; but lots of face towels and bath towels.
Great location and bed was quite comfortable.
This was a lovely spacious place in a great neighborhood. The apartment has everything you might need and Robert was super responsive. We enjoyed sampling nearby eateries and cafes!
Nice place

My family and I had a great time at Karen’s place. The apartment is beautiful with great views of downtown. It has all of the things needed for a long term stay. We were 3 people and slept very comfortably. It is conveniently located near the redline and not too far from the brown line. There were restaurants close and it was easy to get to other parts of the city. Highly recommend!

Very easy to get to and from the airport and downtown from the property with one bus and one train for each. Just far enough where it's not too noisy but not too far to be traveling more than you need to!

Excellent stay at Charles's place.  It was a perfect location, super clean and very comfortable.  This is my 4th stay in the Bucktown/Wicker Park neighborhood, and it was by far the best.  I will definitely stay again when I'm back in town.

Talie's listing was incredibly accurate, with photos that truly reflected the home. It comfortably accommodated four adults and was conveniently located near the green line, bus stops, shops, and restaurants, all within walking distance. GPS made it easy to find, and while parking was available for those with a rental car, we chose to use Uber for trips farther into the city. The neighborhood was quiet, and the locals were friendly. Although we could hear some noise from the upper level, it didn't detract from our experience. We encountered no major issues during our stay, and Talie was quick to respond to any questions, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable visit.
A great place to stay with a welcoming host and an amazing dog! Like seriously she was so well trained. Very comfortable bed and will def stay there again if I can!

I had an excellent stay. The place was comfortable, clean, and well organized, with everything I needed during my time there. Beautiful property definitely recommend !!!!

We had a lovely time in Chicago staying at Joan’s place! It was a great neighborhood and the nearby park was perfect for running in the morning. We would absolutely stay here again! Joan was an excellent host.

Clean place and the owner is super friendly. He is all the time checking on you and making sure that everything it’s all right . The location is very convenient also . It’s definitely a place to come back to; I stayed for over a week and enjoyed the stay. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

We had a wonderful stay! Gerry was incredibly responsive, helpful, and made the entire experience seamless from check in to check out. The property was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and well maintained.

very nice loft, very nice area! would stay again!

Everything as described, everything worked. I had little conversation with Assel but simply because it was not necessary. Chicago is great, but traffic and parking is terrible, so you should walk (20-30 min), use bus or train (about 10 min to station) or Uber.

A great location that had easy access to the nearby metro station and several awesome resteraunts within a few blocks!
The host is a company, not an individual but the employees who were responsible for communicating with us were very prompt and responsive with any of the questions we had.
