If there was anything to complain about, it would be the scarcity of outlets. There aren't many located in the unit so we had to unplug several lamps for our phones and other devices.

We spent most of our time downtown, but the place is in a nice and quiet location for resting. Within 30 minutes driving to downtown and also easy access to public transportation. Market and restaurants nearby and within 25 minutes walk to a small town with more restaurants, shops, and bars.  Regina was a great host. She responded in time and was proactive.
Did not feel safe what not clear with information and lots of noise

I booked this property for an entire month and made several attempts to contact the host on the day of check-in. I reached out early in the morning to inquire about the possibility of an earlier check-in because I had a speaking engagement later that evening. I received absolutely no response.
As the day went on, I continued calling and messaging the host. By check-in time, I still had not received any communication, check-in instructions, door codes, or acknowledgment that I was even expected. I drove to the property with my family and service dog and sat outside waiting while repeatedly trying to contact the host.
At the same time, I was on the phone with Airbnb for hours attempting to get assistance because the host was completely unreachable. Being left stranded with no access to a property that was fully paid for is unacceptable. The lack of communication caused unnecessary stress, wasted time, and disrupted important plans I had in Chicago.
Hosting comes with responsibilities,
Great guest

We loved our stay in Jessica's rental! It was awesome having two entirely separate sleeping areas despite it being a studio. It's large, so cute, and a super-unique space. We really enjoyed the location and found it walkable and close to the bus. Felt safe and secure the entire time. Communication with Jessica was always friendly and prompt, and she was very accommodating (thank you!). We'd totally stay again!

A great modern apartment. The neighborhood is newly revitalized there's an easy walk to Target or to a nice jewel grocery store. super easy to get on one of the rental bikes or scooters and head downtown or walk if you would like to enjoy the weather.
Lots of restaurants around. Solid internet connection, and the desk was very useful for working remote. Great place!
Beautiful and comfortable place in the heart of Chicago. We enjoyed our stay very much. Host was friendly and responsive.

We went to Chicago for my daughter's graduation from her Masters' program. I knew nothing about the area Westtown/Ukranian Village, but it was one of the few places we could find with three bedrooms (for 6 people) that was even remotely affordable and also looked nice. So we took a chance. The neighborhood is really adorable, with a grocery store and plenty of restaurants. It's on several bus lines. And the apartment is huge and has lots of character. I would highly recommend it.
Was a very responsive host helped a lot and glad to stay there
Such a great experience!! The location was perfect t with so many things to do in the area I loved the home feel of not only the Airbnb but also the community of Humboldt! Can’t wait to return!
My husband and I stayed here while visiting family in Chicago. The location was great. The apartment is fun and cute themed. I hope to stay at one of their other locations in the future.
Great location in Lakeview and close to the restaurants and bars.  Kim is a very responsive and helpful host.  The place is exactly as advertised.

Slow to respond to messages. Ex: we had to want outside building for an hour and half for her to give code to get in. Smelling gas in apartment, she said she was going to call someone to check it out. We had to contact her after four hours of no communication from her on it being safe and after that text it took her over an hour to reply.
Check in was super easy and smooth, and the apartment was clean. Great value for the location!

My family and I had the most incredible time spent here. Ashley, your home was so cozy. I especially loved every detail- from the art work, the crystals, the libraries, the color patterns and concepts, down to the incense matches in the bathrooms. The vibes of your home were unmatched and truly stands out as your gem in your neighborhood. Thanks for all of the love you put in your home, it was truly felt! ❤️
Had a great stay! Convenient location & super cozy. The hosts were amazing as well! They were responsive & extremely kind. I would definitely stay here again!
My only complaint is one shower/bath…for a smaller party it wouldn’t have been a problem. 3 bathrooms but only one shower…Otherwise, the place was great.

Ruby was responsive and very helpful. There were a lot of thoughtful touches, including a toothbrush kit which was really helpful since I forgot toothpaste. The neighborhood is quiet and the apartment was very spacious and cozy. Thank you Ruby!

The apartment was clean comfortable and beautifully renovated.  However, when I reserved it I didn’t realize it was on the second floor.  I went back and looked at the description and couldn’t see where the description included that information.

As described, and what a gem for visiting the city! Near transit, but easy grabbing a rideshare if you’re in town for a show at the Salt Shed.
We had 3 adults for a 2-night concert at the Salt Shed and this was perfect. Ariel’s instructions on how to get in, to use the garage, etc. were easy and made getting in and settled a breeze. The linens were fresh and plenty of pillows (firm and soft!). The entire place was immaculately clean & cozy.
Having off-street parking for the price was a no-brainer. Quiet, chill, safe but also right off the highway, with some cool spots to check out on foot - less than a block from Leavitt St Inn and Tavern with a killer burger on the menu and a fantastic patio. 2 blocks the other direction is a lovely park, and not much farther is a cafe, some shops, food, drinks, etc.
All the basic amenities were there for the kitchen and bathroom. Smart TV in the living room was a bonus. This will be our spot next time we are in town!

This house was a great stay! Outside of the city so it’s quieter other than the neighborhood dogs barking lol. David was very responsive and very accommodating to our needs. Only issue was the water pressure, otherwise it was great! Would stay again!

Firstly, I would like to say the pictures don’t do justice for how amazing the view/apartment really is! The view is insane especially at night!! The place is located in a beautiful area right near the river and near walkable coffee & food spots. The host is so nice and super responsive & The staff and the amenities in the building are also amazing. I loved my Stay and would definitely recommend this place!!

Great place, huge, clean, and great price. Very convenient location. Also, Nate is super communicative and super helpful. Just to name one example, the office room monitor didn't seem to work, but Nate super quickly got a new one (thanks again for that!)

Hello
We had a great stay at this place
Great amenities and overall service and recommendations from their guidebook
Great location! The home was beautiful and the host was very friendly/helpful.
Great place. Walkable to everything. Quiet neighborhood. The house was perfect. The beds were comfortable. Tons of space.

I had a wonderful stay here and would highly recommend it. The property was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed during my 3-week stay. It was easy to get to, located in a quiet area, and provided a very comfortable place to relax and unwind.
The host was absolutely amazing—very responsive, thoughtful, and genuinely considerate of her guests. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was taken care of and that I felt welcome throughout my stay.
Another great benefit was the location. Downtown Chicago and many other attractions were just a short drive away, making it easy to enjoy the city while still having a peaceful place to come back to at the end of the day.
Overall, this was an excellent experience from start to finish. I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable stay with an outstanding host.
Great stay!
8/10 stay

Brilliant one bedroom, high floor with great views of Chicago skyline. Joshua was communicative and helpful. Building staff always pleasant and responsive. Gold Coast location is fabulous for a short or long-term stay. Great restaurants, museums and the lakefront in easy walking distance. We had a great stay--really enjoyed our time.

We had a great stay and would definitely book again. The location was convenient and made it easy to get around the city. For our group of ladies, having two en-suite bathrooms plus a third full bathroom was a huge bonus and made getting ready so much easier. The views were beautiful, and overall everything met our expectations. Highly recommend!
Exactly what I was looking for. Great location, easy to access, clean space. Would absolutely stay here again.
Gorgeous and peaceful home base to explore Chicago! Garfield Park is a beautiful area and the amenities (such as luggage storage, keurig, and multiple sitting areas) kept me satisfied.
10/10 One of the best AirBnB stays I’ve had.  Perfect location. Very warm space. Couldn’t have asked for a better spot to make home base while in Chicago for a few days.

David’s place on Lake Street is an amazing Two bedroom Two bathroom with a large kitchen and spacious outdoor balcony.  This was perfect for our family . David was helpful, gave lots of helpful information in advance and was very accommodating while we were in his place. I highly recommend this place if you ever need to be in this area of Chicago.

This was our second time staying at Marilyn’s and it met all of our needs. We stayed two nights for concerts in the city and love the quiet neighborhood — a short distance away. Everyone is very friendly and our favorite breakfast spot, Bacon & Jam, is just around the block. There are plenty of other spots that are walkable too! Highly recommended for anyone who wants a quaint spot for a terrific value.
Perfect place for those visiting  would definitely come again ✅
Great place!

Wir haben unsere Zeit in Chicago sehr genossen und diese Unterkunft hat einen großen Teil dazu beigetragen. Alles war sauber, gemütlich und liebevoll vorbereitet. Es hat uns wirklich an nichts gefehlt und wir haben uns wie zu Hause gefühlt. Vielen Dank für den schönen Aufenthalt, wir können die Unterkunft uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen.

Really wonderful stay here for several nights, accessible to many places including the Chicago Art Institute, Millennium Park, the river walk and many restaurants in River North. Reasonably close to blue line stops to and from the airport and bus lines going north up to the Lincoln Park Conservatory. The place was clean with beautiful views of the city. Some background noise from the L train, but not an issue at all for us, but earplugs were provided. Quiet neighbors and friendly concierge.
Elise was very responsive and was very kind during my stay. She checked in through out the trip to make sure I was enjoying my stay and if I needed anything.
Responsive host

This is a very nice space in a good location, at a great price. The hosts were very communicative and I had no issues. If you are looking for somewhere to stay for a short trip to Chicago, I recommend this place!

We really loved our stay here! Mark and Shaun were incredibly communicative and accommodating hosts. We really appreciated them proactively reaching out more than once to see if we needed anything, and when we needed extra towels, they were quick to provide! Really beautiful, safe neighborhood that was an easy 15 minute walk to the Blue line or a 6 minute walk to the bus that was a quick ride to the blue line, making it easy to get into the city. Ubers were always easy and quick to grab. Really great kitchen setup if you want to do some cooking or reheat your leftovers. Comfy pillows. Very quiet. Would stay here again and would recommend this place to others!

We really enjoyed our stay here. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a few days in Chicago. The location in Pilsen was fantastic and made it easy to get around, with plenty of great food and drinks nearby. We loved walking around the neighborhood. The host made everything easy, and the space was exactly as described. We’d happily stay here again the next time we’re in town for a show or just visiting Chicago.
good

Our group of six had a wonderful stay! The apartment was extremely spacious and clean, with a gorgeous well-stocked kitchen and very comfortable beds. We had a minor issue with the internet but Heather was super helpful and quick to respond which was greatly appreciated.

I had a wonderful stay at Mark’s place. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos - good looking, cozy, and very comfortable, especially the beds. The accommodation had all the essentials I needed for a pleasant stay.
The location was excellent as well. Being close to Wicker Park meant we had easy access to several subway lines, as well as plenty of shops, restaurants, and cafés nearby. Even the famous Kasama was only about a 15-minute walk away.
Mark was an outstanding host - very attentive, helpful, and easy to communicate with. He responded almost immediately whenever I had a question, which made everything smooth and stress-free.
I would highly recommend this place and would gladly stay here again.
Quiet and comfortable stay close to a lot of fun cafes/restaurants/bar. Would definitely recommend!
Small but clean. Easy access to transportation and all parts of the city.

Had a great stay. Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and helpful throughout the stay. The location was convenient and the check-in process was smooth. I would definitely recommend this place to others and would be happy to stay again.
Great place, safe neighborhood

Location, location, location!  We had easy access both to the Magnificent Mile and Lincoln Park. Beds were super comfortable, bathrooms were clean and spacious, and the kitchen perfect for breakfast and simple cooking. That said, this was not what I’d call an elegant space; it gets little natural light and the basement level — where the sitting area is sited — was dark, cool and uninviting. I missed the personal touch provided by the other AirBnbs I’ve stayed in.
Great place. Nice outside area and very spacious.
You get what you pay for. Location is absolutely amazing, the apartment itself is good enough

Prime location, extremely walkable and conveniently accessible to public transportation. The host was responsive, and the Airbnb included thoughtful touches, such as recommendations for local spots in the area. I would definitely stay here again.
I enjoyed meeting Bennett and Jo-Lin. They are conscientious hosts.
Beautiful home in a beautiful neighborhood.
Great stay and location. Not too far from downtown. Safe area. Parking available in front of house.
Very clean! We had a great stay
Great place! Great location! Great hosts!
Thoroughly enjoyed my stay and the owner was very responsive and helpful. Especially grateful they allowed me to bring my St bernard without issue!  Would definitely stay here again

What a wonderful Airbnb in such a peaceful, quiet neighborhood. The first thing we all noticed was how CLEAN everything felt.  My toddler niece especially loved staring out the huge windows and all the natural light. She spent so much time looking outside at all the trees and birds. Parking was great and generally easy to find.  There is also the comfort of knowing that if the street does fill up,  the option to park in the driveway is there. Overall, the experience was great, safe, and cozy. We had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!

This stay was wonderful! The room was very comfortable and felt like home. Having a private bathroom in the room was extremely convenient, and the bathroom was clean and comfortable. The kitchen was also very well equipped, with all the basic essentials prepared thoughtfully.
The location was excellent as well, with convenient transportation and great amenities nearby. Whether going out to eat, taking public transportation, or planning daily activities, everything was very easy. Overall, the place was quiet, clean, and well maintained, and the host was very thoughtful, which made me feel safe and at ease. I highly recommend this stay and would definitely love to come back again!

The rooms are great. The common areas acted as a great community space to cowork or chill with other guests. Walkable to many cafés and the blue line. Sezgin and his friends were true superhosts when an issue with the doorlock needed to be resolved.
One thing to bear in mind is that the lowest floor can get a bit chilly, while the upper floor can get a little warm.
fantastic. slept great

this place is a gem! first its adorable. it has everything you need from cozy throw blankets to kitchen gadgets to a great little patio to sit and have your coffee. Its on a great street in a safe neighborhood with great restaurants, great shopping, near the EL and near wrigley. Bed is so comfy. Bathroom is modern. Place is bright. Easy and wonderful stay. Cant go wrong here.
Darin’s place was amazing! Super homey! Very walkable to a lot of places. Very clean and easy access.
Great stay

Delia was very responsive. Whenever we had a question about anything her responses were very swift. The place was within easy transportation access as we used the bus system to move around. It was close to the supermarket just a short walk away and just close enough to Logan Square's exciting night life without the noise. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay there.

Traveling with family can be really stressful, but this home away from home accommadated my family of 7 quite beautifully. We cooked meals, had access to the washer and dryer, and had plenty of room to be together or alone. The home was spacious, charming, and practical, even with 1 bathroom.  7 people sharing 1 bathroom was a challenge, but we knew that going in because of David's honest description of his place. We set a bathroom schedule and it all worked out! The best part about David's place was David. He was communicative, very kind and made us feel right at home.  5 out of 5 🌟
What a wonderful host I was traveling on my own to Chicago and Deborah made me feel so welcomed and safe. I enjoyed the bed and location was perfect. I look forward to staying again!

Great 2 bed room 2 bath apartment with private outdoor patio. Great location walkable distance to most attractions. In addition, there is a bus stop outside the building for farther destinations. Updated / bathrooms. Quite area with spacious underground car garage.

This place was exactly as advertised.  Great location, walkable around Hyde Park, restaurants close by, close to transportation.  Easy to get in and out, lots of friendly people in the area.  Bed was comfortable, A/C worked great in the warm weather.  Look forward to a return stay.
Incredible location and chic design! Host was very responsive as well. Loved the vibe.

Nicole and Matt were great hosts. The home was exactly as we expected it to be. It was clean, well stocked and in a great, walkable location. We loved our visit to Chicago and loved having a comfortable place to retreat to each evening.
it felt very comfortable, no problems at all

Takisa’s home was absolutely incredible and one of the best stays we’ve had. The space was beautiful, cozy, modern, and exactly as described, but honestly even better in person. Every room felt thoughtfully designed and welcoming. The fireplace in the master bathroom made the entire experience feel luxurious and relaxing, and the bed genuinely felt like sleeping on a cloud. The bathroom was spotless, modern, and beautifully updated. The entire unit had such a warm, elevated feel while still being comfortable and homey. The kitchen was gorgeous, the outdoor area was peaceful and tucked away in a quiet private neighborhood, and every detail throughout the home felt intentional. As an art enthusiast, I especially loved all of the artwork throughout the house because it gave the space so much personality and character. Takisa was also an amazing host, sharing recommendations, local history, and things to do nearby. Highly recommend and would absolutely stay again!

My husband and I truly enjoyed our weekend in your unit and will definitely be back again when visiting Chicago. The unit had all the accommodations for a very pleasant stay. The host was amazing and very responsive. Thank you for making our weekend stay a very memorable time in the Windy City.

The Village Inn was a very nice place and good host. But there was a camera inside the house that we did not feel comfortable with.
Great location, description of house was accurate. Had everything we needed.
Great place close to everything plus el access, host was easy to communicate with, and all around nice vibe.

Kyriako's  apartment is exceptional! Well equipped for short and long term stays, and the apartment was prepared with lots of attention to detail. The apartment is also is a prime location close to multiple public transit options, restaurants, and other amenities. The apartment is also tucked away in a quiet and safe part of the neighborhood. I would recommend Kyriako's apartment to anyone visiting Chicago!
Great location for staying with my family and dog.

Location was fantastic! Can easily access blue line train and close to logan square and wicker park. Also close to Credit Union 1 where my graduation was at. Easy to find street parking for free. Very clean and responsive host! Only comment is you can hear the upstair’s footsteps but otherwise no complaints!

Very affordable, in a quiet neighborhood with fun nearby coffee shops and lots of places to eat. Very clean, easy check-in/check-out instructions, host very responsive to needs. Melissa was great about checking in with me about my stay! Not a negative but just to be aware, there are several parts of the unit with a low ceiling, probably about 6' - I am 6'5" and had to be careful not to hit my head.
Clean & great space to stay at for a good getaway
Amy was an excellent host. Very responsive, allowed us to check in early and leave our bags after check out while we waited for our flight. The place is bright and airy - comfortable bed too!
Spectacular views! Host was super responsive and gave easy to follow instructions. The apartment is comfortable, spacious and a great location.
Erik was a gracious host; answering my questions and offering suggestions. Good place for a 3 night stay. Thanks!
Super chill spot in a convenient area def recommend

Location and Lake Views alone make this apartment worth every penny!!
What I will warn anyone about is the lack of room darkening shades in those big, beautiful windows. The unit's window treatments are pretty neglected & made it very hard to sleep past 7am. If you're an early bird, no worries! If you want to sleep past 7am...bring an eye mask.
Not a deal breaker for me since I was in it for that beautiful bedroom view of the lake...but maybe it is for you?
Janet was a great host, very communicative! Loved the place.
Clean and nice, worth it
Comfortable bed, nice and quiet and convenient blue line location!

Having stayed in a couple of David's other places, The Lavender Loveshack did not disappoint. Fun, quirky and interesting decor as well as most everything one would need, including for making some food there. David and the Trove management team provide timely instructions on check-in and check-out; they responded quickly to other messages. Another highlight is the detailed "guidebook" they provide with lots of honest recommendations and entertaining, thoughtful writing.
Location was great for my visit, and it is a lively area even when the Cubs are out of town and more so on game days.
I always check David's places first when I plan a visit. And will do so next time.

Me and my family had a great stay at Tere’s place, it was clean and comfortable and we had everything we needed. Tere was friendly and always responsive, the location was also convenient and matches the description overall we enjoyed our stay and would stay again.
I stayed in Chicago for three months, commuting daily to UChicago. Sam and Jesse's apartment provided a great place to relax and feel right at home. Can't recommend enough.
Everything is very clean, and the area is very quiet; you feel safe, and it is close to the bus and train.

El departamento es tal cual se describe, está sumamente limpio y cuidado. Tiene muchos detalles la casa que hacen que la estancia sea muy agradable. El lugar es tranquilo y se presta para salir a caminar.

제이슨의 집은 너무나 편안하고 깨끗했으면 필요한 모든 것이 있습니다. 아이와 함께 일주일간 머물며 부족함이 없었습니다.
덕분에 다시 오고 싶은 곳입니다. 완벽합니다.
We flew in earlier than check in. Gave us an early check in.  Great bonus! Great location in the loop. Red line is right out front. Will definitely stay again next time we’re in Chicago.
The place was simply stupendous a lot of artwork plenty of extra amenities, like coffee, tea, food very informative, and a very interesting business women

We had a great stay at this little gem of an apartment!  Everything in the space seemed very fresh and new. The kitchen was well stocked and we really appreciated having a washer/dryer in the unit. The most pleasant surprise was how quiet the apartment was, considering it faces an extremely busy street with heavy traffic day and night. We had a lot of fun exploring the neighborhood and found a fantastic mix of bars and restaurants within walking distance.  We would definitely stay here the next time we're in Chicago!
I loved this stay, very cozy space. Would stay again!

Had a great month long stay. Brett is an exceptional host—proactive with communication, friendly, and quick to respond to any questions I had. Highly recommend!
The studio is spacious and well laid out. The kitchen has everything you need for cooking. Location is great, felt safe walking day or night. Everything you need on Belmont and Clark, plus treelined side streets for quiet neighborhood vibes. Lots of good coffee shops and restaurants in walking distance, and an easy walk to the lake. I paid for parking under the L for the month and had no issues. Would 100% stay again when in Chicago.
Ricardo is an incredible host. The place is spotless and spacious. It has everything you need and is in a great neighborhood.

Great place, prime location with easy access to public transportation. The neighborhood was quiet and the apartment was cozy. Mera is a great host, very responsive and made sure everything was ready at check in

Charie was a great host and the place was very cozy, very clean and just wonderful. I felt like at home. The bus stop was very close by and although you are not downtown it does not take long until you reach the centre of the city. Also it is not too far from O'Hare Airport and it was very easy to get to the apartment. I just had some difficulties with the WiFi connection and to close the apartment door while leaving it but Charie responded immediately via the AirBnB App Messenger and could help with everything instantly, so that all the issues were solved immediately. Everything you could possibly need to cook was there. When I might be visiting Chicago again I will definitely book that place again. 5 stars and more :)
What a fantastic place! One of the best deigned places I have ever stayed in! It had everything. Great stay and will 100% book this place again.
Great space, made for a peaceful stay

We had an amazing time on our honeymoon here. it was a very cute place in a wonderful neighborhood. We will definitely be staying here next time I come to Chicago it was very comfortable and a great location! Elizabeth was very helpful whenever we needed anything, thank you!
Pretty bare bones but also very affordable. Decent place to stay if you don't plan on spending a lot of time there. AC worked, bed was comfy enough.
Location was perfect! Would stay here again.
Nice place for the traffic

We personally did not meet the hosts but Silvia was very friendly and helpful over text. They have a very nice front yard! We felt really at peace here. Theres a bus stop super close which is a nice bonus too

I have rented so many Airbnbs in the past, and this one is a must use in the future! We will always stay here when we come to the area. The Airbnb was SOOOOOO clean and they even stocked it with coffee and water! I loved the extra locks on the back doors and the Airbnb was so spacious! We stayed in the Airbnb with 2 couples, 1 additional adult, and two children. We had plenty of space to sit together or enjoy solitude!!! 10 for rating!!! Very nice place!
Great place, parking is near..not on the street but close enough to find a spot. Responsive host. Had an odd smell in the kitchen and dirty fridge. Room was hot.

I parked my car there and used the train and bus throughout my four-day stay at the Airbnb. Even though I shared the bathroom with other guests, it was never busy, which was a pleasant surprise. The experience was amazing and far exceeded my expectations. I was very happy with the price I paid, the hospitality I received, and the overall convenience of the location. I would definitely stay there again if I visit Chicago in the future.
Felt right at home host was very nice and accommodating.

This was by far one of the best Airbnb rental experiences that I have ever have, because of the quick, attentive, proactive hosts!  Made my life so easy with clear communications and instructions. Everyone thought the place worked so well and was a hidden gem!

I stayed with Samuel for two weeks during my trip to Chicago, as I was scouting the city to move there myself. Samuel is a generous, very responsive, and welcoming host. Staying with him truly feels like staying with a friend. He will ensure you feel comfortable and right at home. I worked remotely from his place, so having the desk set up in the bedroom was important to me. The bed is super comfortable, so best believe you’ll get a good nights rest 😊 In terms of location, the neighborhood is very safe, quiet at night, and you can easily access buses and trains to get around the city. I did not have a car and was just fine. I highly recommend you book your next stay here if you’re also looking to feel like a local!
The house was stunning! Host had great communication and was very responsive. Her place was clean. Great host ! We enjoyed our stay. We will definitely use again if we are in Chicago !
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! Very charming and our hosts were very helpful! It was very easy to find and the place was spotless. We highly it!
Kennan was very accommodating, allowed for an early check-in and was friendly. He left clear instructions on how to find his place, and I felt safe in the area.
Had a great stay. The place and neighborhood was really clean.
great location. Milan was very responsive!

L’appartamento rispecchia le foto è grande, ben distribuito ed ha spazi davvero molto comodi per 4 persone. La proprietà ha sempre risposto ad ogni nostra richiesta nel giro di pochissimo tempo.
Non abbiamo usato la cucina per cucinare anche se era ben equipaggiata, ma solo le tazze per bere un pò di latte la mattina. L’ultimo giorno mi è scivolata proprio una tazza dalle mani mentre la lavavo e l’ho quindi segnalato alla proprietaria, che però alla fine non ci ha chiesto i 5 dollari che la signora delle pulizie le aveva segnalato di richiederci per ricomprarla.
La zona è tranquilla e la passeggiata nel parco per arrivare al centro è davvero molto piacevole. Ben collegata con l’aeroporto e con tutto il resto della città.
Per arrivare a piedi in centro basta comunque camminare per 20/30 minuti e per noi è stato davvero piacevole esplorare la città a piedi. Ringraziamo quindi per l’accoglienza ricevuta e se ritorneremo a Chicago ci farà piacere poter riprenotare questa casa.
Grazie!

I had a great stay, Lois and Eduardo and incredible hosts. It truly felt like I was staying with good friends. The room was spotless and extremely comfortable. The bathroom was very clean and well organized as well. Overall, I would absolutely stay here again.

Theodora’s apartment was lovely, clean, updated & had beautiful finishes. The neighborhood is very nice, walkable, & close to public trans- perfect if you don’t have a car.  Even better than the unit and neighborhood is Theodora. She was super friendly, very responsive and made sure our stay was 5 stars. Would certainly recommend booking.
Wonderful, comfortable garden apartment, close to shops and restaurants.   The host was responsive and helpful and everything in the unit was top notch.  I highly recommend!
Christi's responsiveness and willingness to work with my traveling needs was awesome. The condo was cute; if you can make a 3 bedroom, 1 bath work for you and your guests, do it.

The location was great and the apartment is just like it looks in the pictures. The bathroom was clean and the kitchen has everything you need. Check in was a bit tricky (very limited instructions and tricky key situation with multiple locks) and the Wifi did not work. When I contacted the host about the Wifi, I did not receive any reply for the rest of my stay. Not the end of the world, but unacceptable to me at this price point.
Clear self-check-in instructions, host quite responsive, clean flat and price-worthy considering Chicago prices.
Great communication and a great spot in the city!
comfortable apartment in a convenient location
Mini-walk to bus, easy walk to red line train.  Loved the porch & chair relaxing spot! Fun art! Super comfy and enjoyable.

The stay was overall acceptable, but there were a few issues that affected our comfort.
The room felt quite warm and somewhat claustrophobic during the daytime, and the ventilation was not adequate. Although the host mentioned that a fan would be provided on the second day, no fan was available during our entire two-night stay. As a result, both the room ventilation and cooling were below our expectations.
Additionally, body soap was not available when we arrived and had to be requested separately, although it was eventually provided later during the stay.
The host was responsive and tried to address concerns, but the lack of proper cooling and ventilation made the stay less comfortable than anticipated. thank you

Classic Chicago older apartment. Great neighborhood and lots of light and space. If loudly squeaky floors bother you this apartment has a lot of that feel. Besides that all great. Meets was great at communicating w me.
Loved the place. Loved the stay. Clean. Decent enough area. Gold stay five star. For an air bnb it’s been great.
Wow! What a great place! Loved the penthouse- very comfy beds and the view from the rooftop is amazing. Close to grocery and restaurants. Such a nice place- highly recommend!

I booked this Air Bnb for my grandparents because it was in Belmont Cragin. Melissa was always quick to respond and I was so grateful she accommodated to a late 2am check in. The condo itself was super clean and well maintained. My grandparents felt right at home and enjoyed their stay.
Odličan smeštaj. Lokacija je odlično povezana sa gradom. Boravio sam sa sinom u objektu tri nedelje. Bilo je odlično. Rajan je odličan domaćin.
The home is very spacious and so comfortable. Everything is super clean and I highly recommend it. There is separate dining and living area, plenary of space for a family to spend time together.

Erin's place was perfect for our trip to Chicago! It's located in a great neighborhood - we walked to so many great bars, restaurants, and shops. Instructions and check-in were clear and easy. The place was spotless and tastefully decorated. My only wish is that we could have stayed longer to enjoy the sauna and take in more of the city!

The apartment was in a pristine condition. The location itself is very good, close to many cafes and restaurants, and there’s also a train station near by if you want to go elsewhere. Very convenient.
The hosts were very accommodating and communicative. Would stay with them again for sure.

Alis's communication was spot on,  helpful, and very fast. The residence was exactly as described. Location couldn't be better! We are hoping that this place will be available for our next visit to Chicago!

Very nice (& clean!) apartment in an amazing location with tons of great restaurants in walking distance.
Super easy check in and friendly host. Would stay again!
We stayed with Joseph for 3 nights, what a place. Just as described, spotlessly clean, everything we needed and Joseph so easy and pleasant to deal with. Thanks again!

I booked Rahela’s listing for a surprise birthday trip to Chicago for my husband and I. She was friendly and provided a plethora of recommendations with fun activities, and local restaurants. The property was clean and looked absolutely stunning. We will definitely come back when we visit Chicago again. Thank you again for hosting us!
A perfect spot, great location in Logan Square, a short walk from whatever you would need. Highly recommend!
Really nice place, just as described. Modern, clean, cozy, well maintained and comfortable. The host was super kind and responsive as well. Would definitely recommend this place to stay at Chicago!

Hanna's place is lovely! I really enjoyed staying there and it's one of the best Airbnb's I have stayed at. The bed is super comfortable and the room had nice lighting and other features like a fan and air purifier and it was very nice to have my own private bathroom! The apartment is very clean and beautiful as well and in a good location in Hyde Park. Hanna was very helpful with the instructions and checked in with me to ensure things were going well.
Rob's place was perfectly located and spacious for a group of friends seeing the sights in Chicago. It's a beautiful flat and he was very responsive to any and all questions. Would stay again!

Great value if you’re centering your trip around a Cub’s game. If you’re not, I would pick somewhere else because it’s tough sharing one restroom with the other renters and finding parking (which is hard anywhere in Chicago).
Nice aesthetic and overall very clean. I booked last minute and the host was still very responsive and accommodating. I recommend for your next stay in Chicago!

Great and private place in the suburbs away from downtown Chicago. She is undergoing construction on her home so it may not be the most quiet but it’s still very private. Home is stunning and has great amenities. Gorgeous bathroom.
Ms. Ewa was a wonderful host and I felt very comfortable and safe in her home. She was a very understanding person and very flexible within appropriate means. I would love to stay here again.

It was a lovely spot, close to public transit and super easy to get around. The space was clean and quiet, and the host was great about messaging us beforehand and communicating all information. We stayed to go to a show at The Salt Shed and it was about a thirty minute bus ride to and from. Would stay here again!

Jocy was very communicative--providing very clear instructions for check-in and check-out. The unit is very cozy, located in a safe and walkable part of town. Everything about the place was as described, and we couldn't have asked for anything more during our stay. Very happy with our time at Jocy's place and highly recommend it to anyone looking to stay in Chicago!

My daughter and I loved staying at Kristen’s place! Her place felt cozy and peaceful. Check-in was very smooth. Kristen provided clear instructions. She was very responsive. Before check-in she provided great recommendations for restaurants in the area. The place was clean, thoughtfully decorated and stocked with necessities. I would definitely stay at Kristen’s place again.
Very spacious, helpful and accommodating host!  Really appreciated not having tons to do at check out.  Easy access to buses and perfect for going to Lincoln Park.

We came for my son’s graduation. So we didn’t do much around the area because of school activities.
The place was clean.
There are two bedrooms which is what we needed. The third bedroom is a futon. Didn’t try it out.
Jacob was responsive if we needed anything.
Was exactly what I needed. They were super helpful hosts and I slept great.

Stayed here with a school group of teens and had plenty of space for all of us to spread out and feel comfortable. Host was incredibly responsive and everything ran smoothly. Neighborhood feels very safe and we were more than comfortable walking around in the evenings.  Definitely recommend Brothers for breakfast as well. Highly recommended. I would book here again!
Enjoyed my stay here. House is small and intimate. Very nice for a couple weekend getaway.

Afsha is a very attentive host.  The apartment is centrally located in Logan Square and close to the city.  She was helpful upon arrival and her directions were clear on entry and parking procedures.  The apartment is clean and comfortable.  All amenities were as advertised.   If we visit Chicago again, we will stay here.   Very pleasant experience at a fair price.
This was a great place to stay!
Great stay!

Really felt at home in this space! David's compassion for his guest shows through making sure the place was set up for all our needs. Instructions left for us made sure we didn't have any issues on our trip. We would 100% love to stay here again, for its comfortable and hospitiable benefits.

Josh was easy to work with, and we are glad to have stayed here while in Chicago. It was easy to get to and from the airport, and it was so easy navigating around, because the location is so close to public transportation. The neighborhood is gorgeous and walkable. So many cafes, coffee shops, and restaurants. Lots of families and young people around. Felt safe. We loved staying here!

Joan was a wonderful and kind host. Check-in instructions were clear and straight forward. There were pictures and links to "how to" videos in case there were any confusion with checking in. Joan did check in via messages to ensure our stay was going well, and was even so sweet to drop off some goodies at the house for my birthday celebration. It was a very thoughtfu gesture, and shows the steps Joan is willing to take to ensure a great stay. The house itself had everything needed like snacks, drinks, and and items to make tea and coffee. There was even bathroom essentials like soaps, toilet paper, detergent, and feminine products if needed. Felt right at home and didn't feel the need to do an additional store run for household items. The only main thing to be cautious of was walking around. The floors are very squeaky and had to tip toe around so we didn't disturb those below. You can also hear the footsteps above on occasion, but nothing too overbearing. Overall it was a nice stay.

I enjoyed my stay. The video and written instructions were extremely helpful. I wish they would have included where the garbage bins were located so that I would have had that information ahead of time.

This was a pleasant surprise. A nice new modern apartment with 4 bedrooms and 3 baths. Clean and well equipped. We love to walk and we walked to most places of interest from the apartment. It is not far from the river and the shopping. Have a place on 12th floor where i could work. Played table tennis and pool as was with the family.  Overall a great and wonderful stay in Chicago. Will definitely come back!

I had a great stay in Christopher’s place. It was easy to find and Christopher’s father Romeo made check-in and checkout very straightforward, offered useful local recommendations and helped with parking permits, etc. The apartment was secure, quiet and comfortable, but also with easy transport access to the downtown area. I would definitely stay again, thanks for having me!

I’ve never had such a prepared and considerate host as David! Any questions I could have had were answered proactively. The place looked like a set from a tv show from how well designed it was. Highly recommend

Helper of host was responsive and they were kind enough to get a new mattress since the other one was absolutely destroyed. Just a lot of noise and strong food smell from the restaurant below I moved units and the tattoo shop below would blast music that would vibrate the floor. Luckily it usually stopped before 10pm but it was a struggle if you’re someone who wants consistent sleep. I also originally booked a long stay and I found both units not to have adequate kitchen supplies and most of what they did have was in really bad shape. The oven wasn’t functioning when I arrived and all the numbers on the oven dials were worn off so you couldn’t see the temperature. They were also kind enough to provide hangers and forks right away which I appreciated but again not done beforehand which should have been in anticipation for someone who booked a long stay. I had several issues but will say I was always treated with respect when I reached out.
Me senti em casa. Eu super recomendo

The neighborhood was amazing, and access to the train (Paulina platform is less than a block away) and downtown Chicago was perfect.  Charie's place is clean, comfortable, and a great place to rest/relax between outings.  While you could definitely stay here without a car at all, it was not difficult to find nearby street parking for the rental car we had for some other parts of our trip.  Coffee and breakfast is a block away, as well as great places for lunch and dinner.  Target is 2 blocks away if you forgot to pack something.  If we travel to Chicago in the future, I will definitely book Charie's place again!

Lovely space. I ran in the morning and it felt very safe. For a woman that visited from a different state I was very concerned about safety and that was totally perfect! The space was exactly as advertised and she communicated through the entire stay!

I stayed here for 1 month, as a solo female in my 50s.  The apartment is clean, beautiful, and has lots of storage spots.  The location is great.  It's on a quiet, leafy residential street, but it is very walkable to everything you need, including restaurants (including 2 popular ones -- Denucci's and Gemini -- right on the corner), a great grocery store called "Carnival," shops, buses, coffee shops, the Lincoln Park Zoo, and the Lakefront.  I walked every day, including at night by myself, and was always fine and felt safe. It's an easy walk to the Zoo, the park, and the Lakefront for a leisurely stroll or a run/walk/bike on the Lakefront. I did not have a car.  When I needed to go longer distances, I took an Uber or a bus.  I was very comfortable here for the entire month and would highly recommend it for a short or long stay!
It was a pleasure staying at Ray's place in Old Town Triangle.
Fabulous place to stay! Very clean and hosts were very helpful and communicative!

Overall great stay and clean home. Very responsive host. The only thing was that it was pretty hot in there which made it hard to sleep at night. I thought her description said there were a few window AC units but there weren’t any. Other than that, great place. Worth the stay
Menachem was a lovely, chatty host. He accommodated our early check in and the flat was clean and as described. Thank you for hosting us Menachem!
Decent place really close to subway host is a good communicator
We had a lovely 3-night stay at Reed's place. It was the perfect location, with shops and resturants close. The space was very comfortable, and we enjoyed the backyard space in the sunny afternoons!
Would highly recommend! Great location and easy access to public transportation. Apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Loved our stay. & will definitely book again!
Very roomy spic and span basement apartment close to transportation.

We had an excellent experience!!
The apartment itself was well supplied, nicely set up and attractively decorated. It was quiet and pleasant and we were very comfortable there.
The hosts were well organized and everything functioned smoothly.
We would definitely stay there again.
Loved the location, Milan was wonderful, workout room was great!

Three stars for two reasons, and neither are regarding the host, who was kind and responsive. Reason 1: over our four day stay we saw three large centipedes crawl from behind the living room couch and the bathtub. There were also a few spiders and multiple beetles around the place. Reason 2: the neighborhood IS NOT safe at all, just google the neighborhood. Neither of us felt safe walking around after dark. On the final night, there were two men arguing in the street until 3 AM which kept us both up. Car break ins close by, people clearly using drugs around the corners, etc. Pros didn't outweigh the cons.

Marissa’s place was beautiful and easy to find! It matched the description perfectly, and easy to walk to the bus/train stops. A few areas of concern include the pesky mosquitoes (inside and out) and the sewage smell coming from the shower. There is some mosquito repellent for outdoors, but this only solves part of the problem as they follow you indoors. The raw sewage smell emanates from the bathroom shower. Overall Marissa was easy to communicate with and quick to respond at any moment.
Great location and great accommodation

The location was great!!! Very safe area. There were so many places to grab food and drinks within walking distance. Was only a 10-15 minute uber ride to anywhere downtown (half an hour at peak stop and go traffic). Place was easy to find and accessible.
Great location and easy check-in and checkout. Fast communication.
Great place to stay, clean, clear instructions, and very responsive host
It was a great place and in a perfect area I will be back in a few

Great spot. Lively. Yet the unit is in a peaceful and quiet alcove. Easy transit access if you don't mind walking a little bit - well within reason for Chicago. But centrally located to plenty of stuff. Clean unit. Good instructions for secure entry. Very pleasant and helpful hosts.

I stayed her for about a month during my rotation at a local hospital. My stay was very pleasant and quiet. Helen was a great host and very friendly and accommodating. The other guests were nice and respectful of each others’ belongings. Overall I would recommend.
This was really luxury stay. We were 5 people and  had great time thanks!!!
Great location , very walkable with nearby transportation, more spacious then imagined overall a great deal
Loved our stay!  Great location and beautiful place.
Great location livery convenient
Nice place. We liked the place a lot!

Was warmly welcomed and enjoyed my stay. Had access to everything I needed in the shared spaces and the bedroom was clean and comfortable. Being able to check out slightly late was greatly appreciated.

Beautiful place with lots of room. Exactly like the pictures. Terrific views. It was perfect for us to be able to have everyone together in the dining room/kitchen/livingroom, but have the option to retreat to one of the bedrooms. Great water pressure. We were always greeted by the front desk, which always is not the case at places similar to this. I would come back here…we enjoyed our stay.
AJ and Hannah were amazing hosts.  They were very accommodating and made our stay great.  Their home was more than  advertised. I highly recommend staying there if you're in the area
Absolutely enjoyed my stay, perfect location with everything I needed and more.

Andy and Jessica’s place was lovely! Bedrooms were great, and the shower works excellent. Not a downside but the stairs are a little steep. Andy was a very responsive host and had answers for all of our questions. Thanks again!
The place was perfect for friends and couples meeting up for a weekend in Chicago! The host was even kind enough to drop off donuts on the morning of our check out :) highly recommend!
Very convenient location in a good price. We loved our stay
Everything was good. Really close to a lot of things to do. Downtown was really close. Looked just like the pictures. I would stay again
Great place to stay! Clean, cozy, and well located. The host was very helpful and communication was excellent. Highly recommended!
Good, clean place, I recommend
Fue muy confortable  la estadía en el espacio de Osiris todo lo que necesitábamos lo teníamos la comunicación fue excelente. Sin duda volveríamos a hospedarnos allí .
Great place! Excellent location. Wonderful host!
Buen departamento, solo muy lejos del centro
Great communication, beautiful place to rest and recharge!
I would stay here again.
This was a very nice place to stay. It was a little difficult to discern which unit was which. but it was okay. Location was central to everything I needed.
Check-in was easy. Charles communication is awesome. Beautiful and comfortable home
El lugar está muy tranquilo te puedes mover fácilmente en tren o un bus el lugar está cómodo,  limpio es un buen lugar  para pasar tus días en Chicago.

This Airbnb is in the middle of Logan square which is arguably one of the most happening neighborhood in Chicago. The Airbnb had everything you would need. The natural lighting was the most memorable part of the stay. With so much to do - thrift stores, places to eat, cafes etc you would never get bored here.
Our stay was perfect!

Wir haben uns bei Brett sehr wohl gefühlt. Das Appartment war großzügig geschnitten, und durch die Industrie Architektur sehr speziell und individuell. Es hat uns sehr gut gefallen, die Kommunikation mit dem Host Brett war perfekt. Jederzeit wieder gerne.

Es un alojamiento muy acogedor, tiene todo lo que necesitas para unas cortas vacaciones en Chicago,  lejos del ruido y con cercanía a lugares de interés. Es ideal para familias que buscan mas espacio y comodidad.

If I could give more than 5 stars in every area, I would!  This charming space had everything and more!  Hosts provide many extras like snacks, detergent, shampoo/conditioner AND cold drinks upon your arrival.  They have thought of everything. This spot is in a great location and parking was never a problem.  If you are looking for a great experience,  this is it!
Great spot in a great location. Spacious and clean. As others have noted, you are close to the train and will hear noise, so worth noting if you’re a light sleeper. Great place and would return !
Great place!

No Keys, No Access, No Help.
Terrible experience. The host never opened the door or made themselves available to help. They stated that the keys would be left in the mailbox, but when I arrived, they were not there. I had informed the host in advance that my flight would arrive late, and their response was that he was not responsible.
I spent about an hour trying to access the property without success. In the end, I had to leave and pay for a hotel for the night.
I would strongly recommend avoiding this listing if you want to be sure you will actually be able to access your accommodation.👎
EL HOST NO ABRIÓ LA PUERTA
Pésima experiencia. El anfitrión nunca abrió. Dijo que dejaría las llaves en el buzón, pero cuando llegué no estaban ahí. Le había avisado con anticipación que mi vuelo llegaría tarde, y su respuesta fue que no se hacía responsable.
Pasé 1 hora tratando de abrir a la propiedad sin éxito. Al final tuve que irme y buscar un hotel a media noche 👎
Nice place, great location, good amenities. Proximity to great restaurants, grocery store, and a nice cafe is a big plus.
The place was nice beautiful view. It’s a corner Location very clean. Just like how you see in the picture.

Apartment was clean and had everything I needed. Great AC unit that kept room cool in May. Very good access to public train and Dunkin’ Donuts for morning coffee. Great value for the price; nothing super fancy but furniture and place was modern and clean. Ample closet space for clothes. The only negatives are the ground floor smell which is stuffy and full of smoking smell and the stairway door adjacent to room slams shut so maje sure to wear ear plugs because there are a young demographic of people who sometimes come home late and allow said door to slam shut which goes boom! Overall, very good value, especially if you have a busy agenda while in Chicago.

Overall, our stay was good. We had access to everything we needed, and Brandon ordered supplies that were running low promptly. I was surprised to find damp laundry in the dryer the evening we arrived, which we then had to dry and fold before doing our own laundry. We also found the basement to be very dirty—partially filled bottles and lots of clutter. That section should be closed to guests if not cleaned up. We found lots of clutter in cabinets that could be removed if no one is living there anymore. Other things we found surprising:
No toilet paper holder in upstairs bathroom
No table lamps (only overhead lights)
Tub creaked and felt like it would break
Headboard in one of the bedrooms isn’t connected to the bed
Broken lightswitch in lower bathroom
Loose kitchen cabinet hardware (one of the drawer pulls was hanging off when we arrived)
Most if not all the white towels are stained
Bedroom with the really tall bed did not have nightstands on both side
Great location, clean unit, perfect amenities. Would 100% recommend and stay again!
The place is really bright and has all amenities you can need. Location is great. Just be aware that the apartment is above a bar.
Never been to Chicago before and will definitely be back, great way to spend my 21st birthday and super friendly hosts
Very nice place very lovely

Great location and highly professional!
We had a wonderful short stay in Chicago. The location is absolutely fantastic, and the communication was incredibly professional. The place met all of our needs perfectly, and best of all, it is pet-friendly! Highly recommended.
Super cute place to stay while visiting for work, easy to travel out of and check into. It’s perfect for a traveling professional. Hosts were great, and the area is full of things to do.
The place itself is clean and organized. She’s great at giving helpful instructions and its location is perfect for wherever you need to go. Will definitely come back whenever I come to Chicago!
Parking was easy to find and loved the room! The high ceilings made the room feel so spacious. The host was also very welcoming and kind! A lot of great amenities available! Highly recommend!
Good spot.
Exactly as expected. The dedicated instruction website with videos to explain things like parking and entry were a FANTASTIC touch!
Fue una estadia maravillosa, el lugar esta ingreiblemente comfortable y muy limpio. La zona donde esta localizado es tranquilay segura.
This was a great stay! Walkable to subway and bus stops, a very neighborhoody feel, and a quaint unit. There are window units, but our stay was very comfortable. Would stay here again.

The home was absolutely beautiful! Everything was clean and organized and had all the things we needed. Definitely recommend and honestly will probably stay here again if we ever find ourselves visiting Chicago in the future!
Great host and condo. Exactly as advertised.
We liked the place since we walk in. Perfect location to walk everywhere. Free parking is great. We would rent it again.
Overall it was a great place to stay, clean and calm just some issues with water pressure and temp of the shower but she did inform me us about them.
Was a good place. Close to the red line
Great as usual.

Unfortunately, I would not recommend this property. The home was not in the condition we expected upon arrival, with significant cleanliness issues, used items from previous guests, and missing or insufficient bed linens and towels for our group. While some concerns were addressed after we reported them, it took more than 24 hours for meaningful action to be taken, and some cleanliness issues like filthy floors and dirty dishes persisted throughout our stay. We had great difficulty communicating with the host trying to get to a resolution. We ultimately received a partial refund through Airbnb, which reflected the impact these issues had on our experience.

Vin was truly a super host and provided a great place for my urgent need for a reasonably priced stay near UChicago. I lived near this neighborhood previously and was pleasantly surprised with how excellently clean and ergonomically comfortable everything was in this small studio apartment. The building is very old so if that’s not your thing be mindful. My only struggle was with the keypad entry just once. But fortunately a kind tenant came to rescue right away.  I am a ‘luxury accommodations girl’ who was worried that I would not be satisfied with this last minute option but it worked out very well for my 2 night stay.

This spacious, bright and airy apartment was perfect for our needs. The apartment was spotless, and we appreciated having both A/C and ceiling fans for the warm nights. Located on a quiet, tree-lined street, the apartment is in walking distance to public transportation, stores, restaurants, and entertainment. Rida was very responsive and answered all our questions.
Very nice and comfortable
Great stay. Exactly as advertised. Would stay again.
Anastasia’s place was in a really cute walkable neighborhood! directions were clear and other guests were very respectful. Would recommend to anyone staying in Chicago!
Unique apartment in a wonderful location. Within walking distance to a lot of great spots in Old Town, Lincoln Park, the Red Line, and the lake. Would stay here again.

Everything was perfect with the exception of the very low sectional which gives no back support and very hard to stand up right after sitting for 5 minutes. Everyone spent most of the time on the bar stools and dining chairs.
Planning a trip next year to Chicago and really hope there are new higher lumbar couches / sectionals in height that are comfortable. Hopefully see you soon Bart.
Good location, great people. Will definitely be back if we were in Chicago again.

A great place to stop in Chicago. Not far away from metro stations and corner stores with everything necessary are nearby. It’s a relatively safe area and I was not concerned about my safety. The apartment itself was very clean, neighbors were nice people and AC works well. If a place to sleep is all you want in Chicago, it’s a good choice to stay in

The space is small but perfect for 1-2 people wanting to stay somewhere within walking distance of everything. Most things we wanted to do were about 15-45 min walk and the trains/ buses were all pretty close.
The kitchenette works great and is good for cooking small things. The front door locks are counter intuitive so you turn left to lock and right to unlock. The walls are a little thin but it’s pretty quiet so you just hear people unlocking their doors and walking by.
The host is friendly and communicative. We never met him, but we didn’t have any trouble getting in or coming and going.

Sharon’s place was great. Loved how there is a washer and dryer in unit. There are minimal pots and pans if you’re into cooking while there but I do highly recommended taking your own maybe . She does have plenty of cooking utensils. Coffee maker was good to have as well. Her place was comfy. Bed was very comfortable!parking can be a bit of a hassle but if you don’t mind paying meter to be right in front well then it’s a plus! Other than that you will definitely enjoy her place!
Wonderful experience, plan to stay there again when visiting our daughter in Chicago. Very walkable to the brown train line. Grocery nearby and lots of restaurants!  Just perfect!!

Amazing place! Beautiful decore, exceptionally comfortable and very dog friendly. Daniel and Johnny are gracious, helpful hosts. Their home is in a lovely neighborhood that is in walking distance to Lake Michigan, parks and restaurants.
The outdoor seating area was great for relaxing in the evenings. But watch out for the sprinklers in the mornings!
Would love to visit again sometime.

We had a lovely stay at this Lincoldn Park spot. There is a lot of space in the house and the location is unbeatable. If you are traveling with a baby or are someone who needs it to be dark to sleep, just know there are basically no real curtains in the bedrooms.
The apartment was very clean and felt very homey

Very beautiful apartment. Exactly as published. The only disadvantage is that is located in a second floor and there is no elevator (it was clear in the information provided). The location is very good.
Nice stay for being close to the United Center! Would recommend if you had an event to attend to at the United Center and if you wanted to visit downtown Chicago aswell.
Great place and location. Spacious and thoughtful layout. Comfortable seating areas. Close to amenities and great location if you are visiting Chicago.
Everything we needed was right there in the apartment. It was large and spacious. Very clean and welcoming. We loved to spent time in the garden. It was also super close to the bus and train station.
Location, location, location close to everything classic Chicago parking included. I will definitely stay again when I’m in town.

It was nice , and clean , met some people too lol
Nice price

¡Nos encantó! 🩷
El apartamento está en una zona muy linda y segura, puedes caminar fácilmente a muchos de los lugares turísticos de la ciudad.
Restaurantes y supermercados a pocos minutos
Tal cual como se ve en las fotos, incluso más espacioso.
Cuando volvamos, seguro lo buscaremos nuevamente.
I loved how close the condo was from the arena.
Very nice stay. Nice sweet host and cute little cozy place. Although parking was rough and terrible.

Le logement ressemble énormément aux photos. Et l'accès à l'appartement est facile. Néanmoins, pour les séjours de longues durées, il faut être prêt à s'adapter aux poils/cheveux dans la douche, la cuisine pas très propre et des allers/retours d'inconnus dans l'appartement.

Great place to stay in Wicker Park close to everything. Spacious for our group of four there was some street noise, but it wasn’t too bad at night with the sound machines. The only thing I would’ve wished is that the beds would’ve been king beds and we found them a little too soft, but otherwise the place was great.

This place was just like the pictures, a cute narrow Chicago house! We were able to find free street parking every day, which is a huge plus over downtown Chicago. I was surprised how quiet the Bronzeville neighborhood was. You can hear people in the unit above, so maybe bring ear plugs for that if it bothers you. AC worked great, which was important to me. Keurig pods were nice. I also did an order from Jewel Osco for a few breakfast items which was convenient.
Perfect halfway point between sightseeing downtown Chicago and visiting University of Chicago. It’s always fun to get a feel for different Chicago neighborhoods. Not as many restaurants within walking distance as I would have expected, but with a car we just drove to South loop and parked on the street. Just a few blocks east of the White Sox stadium, we watched a game which was fun.
We were lucky to have nice weather and all the nearby parks were super green.

Everything was great besides the wifi was alittle spotty during the day other than that I really enjoyed my stay. Instructions were clearly written and I the host would get back to me within an hour of a message. Great stay!

We had a wonderful stay here and honestly, it was one of the best parts of our trip to Chicago. The place was cozy, comfortable, and felt like a home away from home. Everything was very clean, fresh, and well cared for, and it was a great place to return to after a day of exploring the city.
We loved the neighborhood—it felt safe, charming, and was close to everything we wanted to do. We even cooked dinner and had everything we needed to feel right at home.
The host was kind, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. We couldn't have asked for a better experience. If we visit Chicago again, we would absolutely try to stay here again. Highly recommended

Had a great stay with our family of 5. Lots of room to stay comfortably with all our luggage and not be on top of each other. Location was great. Walking distance to shops, corner store for essentials, Gino's East for deep dish pizza and very close to train / subways stations to make getting around town very easy. Wrigley Field, Magnificent Mile shopping... all are easy to get to.
The rooftop area was a cool place to hangout, but with all Chicago has to offer, we didn't spend much time there.
The host of the apartment was very responsive and would reply to any questions we had within minutes.
Would definitely stay here on a return visit.

Really great space in a really mellow neighborhood with tons of food/drink options. 10/10. Parking garage was awesome to have... Would stay again!

The rental was very clean and had everything we needed. Location was great. Lots of great restaurants close by and an easy walk to the L. Would love to stay again!

This is my second time staying at Samoane’s place—it’s become my go-to for work trips to Chicago. Samoane is an exceptional and thoughtful host, the Airbnb is well-appointed, and it offers a nice refuge both inside and on the outdoor deck. I was also impressed by the proximity of public transit to get downtown. I’ll definitely book again.
Departamento cómodo y muy bien equipado.

Visiting to move my son into temporary housing for the summer and Cyndi’s place was perfect for our needs! Right in south loop and easy check in. She was very responsive. It’s spacious and met all of our needs.

We loved our stay. It was in a great neighborhood and very comfortable apartment. It was easy walking distance to the bus line which gave us access to many locations. We also found some great places to eat within easy walking distance.
Great for kids! We liked that we could enjoy a glass of wine on the patio and still watch the kiddos in the TV room in the garden apartment. .Very cute and safe street close to everything!

The stay and place were as described and I had no issues with the space. However, the property management group called me consistently. About once a day to “check in”.
