Perfect location, friendly hosts and extra accomodating! I’ll be back

Rebecca was a wonderful host: she was warm, friendly, and even offered to make me breakfast! The apartment is clean, quiet, and very homey, within walking distance of UChicago and surrounded by great amenities. The kitchen and pantry were fully stocked, and Rebecca was generously willing to share. I had an amazing stay and would highly recommend!
Would book again. :)

Joan was a super responsive host and when my flight got in early she was able to help me get a place to work from until my unit was ready.
She checked in with me often and made sure I had everything I needed for my stay. I would stay there again when in Chicago! Super walkable area and a great little suburb of Chicago. 10/10!

This was our first trip to Chicago with our child (4yo). The apartment itself was clean and comfortable. In the kitchen we found plenty to cook and eat with, which meant we didn't have to hike out for every meal. A blessing when you have a young child. Also, the location was between two bus routes that can take you either directly to the Museum Campus (Field, Shedd, Adler) or to the Zoo. The red line (Lawrence stop) was just a ten minute walk from the apartment. There was also a playground and the northern edge of Lincoln Park within a 10 minute walk.
Both beds were comfortable. We had some noise issues the first night with the unit above us, but Seun was reaponsive when we reached out and contacted the above unit's owners for us. We didn't have any issues the rest of the stay.
Great studio apartment! Has everything you need plus more. Highly recommend staying here! Hosts were great as well.
Great location, great host, clean and tidy unit
This place met my needs and was a comfortable resting spot for my stay in chicago
The place was so nice! It was quiet, peaceful, and in a nice neighborhood. Parking was very easy to find. We had a great time!

Ryan was an exceptional host and incredibly thoughtful when it came to every aspect of his condo—he truly thought of everything! He was highly responsive and proactively checked in throughout my stay to make sure everything was going smoothly. The condo was exactly as described, and honestly, even better than the photos. It was spotless, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a fantastic stay. This was, without a doubt, the best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. I will absolutely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay!
El barrio es tranquilo y tiene opciones cercanas del bus. Tal cual menciona la descripción
amazing stay, the house is very nice and very clean, the bus to the city center is at less than 10m
Really enjoyed stay Cindy’s place.. clean space in a great location!

Spotless. Stylish. Well stocked. Great location. Great tips. Excellent host!
We had a wonderful three days here.

A group old timer college friends got together at the site to jointly celebrate their 80th birthdays.  With 8 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, the site made for a comfortable place for a quiet celebration in a great part of Chicago.  With easy access to public transportation and local stores, we celebrated 8 decades with lots of laughs and loads of stories.  It would have been helpful to have the listing indicate this spacious rental is a third-floor walkup.
Ola’s place was great! It was clean and exactly as described. I would highly recommend staying here!
Great location! Close to everything we needed and in a convenient area. The place was comfortable and made for an enjoyable stay. Would definitely recommend!
Thank you for super clean and spotless house, also clear and easy instructions to get into your house.
Excelente estadía, amplia habitación, muy buen aseo, la ubicación cerca el transporte público. Muy bien habitado el sector, la playa cerca, lugar tranquilo. Respuesta rápida de los anfitriones.
Absolutely loved the place, I will definitely be back! Super clean and peaceful

Location is key in a great vacation and this was such a great location. The beds were comfortable, and very basic bedding. And the keyless entry was perfect. Because I spent almost $6000 for a week, I was expecting something bigger. We live in Los Angeles and pay a thousand less for a four bedroom free standing house monthly in a great neighborhood . But truly the “designer” home is what set me up for disappointment. The 90’s theme with slap dash wallpaper is not designer. I will include pics. Also no place to set items on shower, no where to move in upstairs bedroom. No master—it’s a house full of kids rooms. Air conditioning rain constantly.
I was just disappointed as I thought we were getting a NICE place. We entered the space and it REEKED of dank weed (turned out the neighbors were getting high). Brandon helped resolve the issue immediately and dank weed was not an issue going forth. Location great—place itself isn’t special. If beds and location main priority, this is for you.
I like the communication this place has to many restaurants close to the building %100 recommend
Beautiful place , highly recommended
Host was quick with answers to any questions. House was exactly how listed. Very beautiful and laid back. Thank you so much for a nice stay.
Great place!
It’s a very nice apartment. The sound of the elevated train is very loud and hard to ignore. I slept ok with earplugs.
LORENZO...without him, not sure whatbwe would have done!!!!! He was awesome!!

Thomas was a fantastic host, incredibly responsive and quick to answer any questions we had. The place was spotless and exactly as described. We felt right at home from the moment we arrived. Would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend!
Recommend this place for anyone attending an event at the united center.
The landlord communicates quickly and effectively, which is a very good experience.
Casa spaziosa e comoda. Pulizia un po' da migliorare. Togliere la moquette. Mancano tazze e sedie per tutti gli ospiti

Hard to beat for the price. Great location on a quiet, leafy residential street, with restaurants, bars, and grocery stores all within walking distance. Subway close by, plus easy access to Lake Shore Drive.
Brandon’s place is in my favorite Chicago neighborhood and was a great landing spot for my family. The kitchen is great, as well as the upstairs that’s a bit more private.

Great location and very close to the L. Clean shared spaces upstairs. Room looked like it did in the pictures and was spacious.
If you don’t like sharing spaces, this isn’t the place for you. The room to my right had a guest that was talking loud on the phone. Walls are thin. The upstairs didn’t have a smell but the downstairs did. Kinda mildew-y? Just smelled off. I would highly recommend wearing flip flops in the shower. Otherwise, great stay for a couple of nights.

We ended up getting screwed out of our hotel for the night because they overbooked. We texted Milan at 9:30 pm and he responded within 10 minutes. The apartment is great, the views are nothing crazy but the patio is very cute and comfortable. The apartment is stocked with lots of household items that you might find yourself needing in a pinch on a trip. Overall 10/10 I would highly recommend. The only thing that I couldn’t think to critique is that there is no full body mirror, and as two girls who were going to concerts and taking photos that was slightly bothersome to work around.

I had a great stay here with my friend! It feels very safe, walkable to the train station, parking was easy, and check in was smooth. The room can feel a bit small, but there is an open living room. Clean kitchen and fridge, dishware and utensils! Provided shampoo and body wash. Overall we had an amazing stay.
Nice place
Very responsive and had clear instructions. Very glad to have had stayed here.

Apartamento ok, tinha tudo o que eu precisava e era silencioso. Relativamente fácil de estacionar na rua. Foi difícil subir e descer até o 5o andar com malas, sem elevador. O bairro em si é bom, mas senti um pouco de insegurança nas proximidades dele.
Clean, makes you feel you're home, amazing location with lots of restaurants around. Dina is a great host who was always responsive and answered any questions quickly . would recommend
The location was amazingly decorated and great to have free parking in the rear! Soooo spacious! And the area was central to anywhere we had to go during our trip.  Definitely a winner!
great stay no complaints
I stayed three days days ay Kyriako’s airb&b. The place was wonderful—clean, comfortable, and nicely located. And my host was helpful in every way.
Good place to stay, looks like the photos
The area was beautiful and the Villa was entirely unique and well worth what was spent.

We enjoyed everything about this home immensely. From the amenities to the warm character that made us feel so at home. We enjoyed the whole home sound system, warm and inviting lighting, as well as the books, records, and oddities that kept us busy.
The bedroom was cozy, kitchen what we needed and the snacks, wine, and coffee was a touch that is so rarely seen in Airbnbs anymore.
We were grateful to have enjoyed a few days in a home so full of character and charm. We look forward to returning soon and spending more time in such a lovely home.

Our stay was wonderful!  Mark’s place was beautiful, spacious, and pristine - it really offered everything we needed for our stay. The listing is as described, with the location being perfect - close to 24 hour eats, bars, stores and green spaces. Mark and his team were responsive and helpful especially with all the tech stuff. Street parking can be a challenge in the evening but other that, there’s paid parking available nearby. I highly recommend this place.

This was such a great stay in the Chicagoland area! The location was super convenient — plenty of good restaurants nearby and easy access to public transportation that takes you straight into the city. Anything farther out was still only a quick drive away.
Juan was very responsive, accommodating, and easy to communicate with throughout the stay. The home was comfortable, clean, and thoughtfully stocked with the essentials, which made everything feel easy and relaxing.
I’d definitely stay here again next time I’m back in the area.
Great stay

Im a Hotel guy. First tine tried AirBnb.

Highly recommend this place

Was super to have the united center in such a walkable distance as well as the public transportation being accessible. Great location, easy to park, tons of amazing restaurants close by. My only issue was that you can tell this is not owned or maintained by a local so the furniture is pretty run down and no TV in the bedrooms. Otherwise, it was a good value.
Great place, very convenient and a nice space for staying in Chicago

This day was in a really nice quiet location that was a train or a bus ride from most things we wanted to see. I would recommend with future guests, if you’re traveling during the warmer months, bring fans to help with air circulation. The host were very responsive. Overall, we had a great stay.

Wow. What a beautiful, beautiful Airbnb. From the moment I walked through the door, I could feel the intention, love, and care poured into every detail of this space. It was more than a stay. It was an experience rooted in beauty, culture, and the rich spirit of Black history. Such an amazing representation of Chicago, Bronzeville, and everything we love about this city.
The home was spotless, meticulous, and so thoughtfully curated. The refreshing scent that greeted me when I arrived immediately made me feel at peace. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the little garden space was absolutely gorgeous, like a quiet pocket of healing tucked into the city.
This is the perfect place for a couple’s getaway or even a solo retreat when you need time to breathe, reflect, and restore. I recently buried my mom and came here needing space for myself, and somehow this home poured life back into me during such a difficult season.
Thank you again and I will spread the word!
We had a great stay! The location is a short walk from many great restaurants and stores. Nate was very quick to answer any questions we had, and the apartment had everything we needed!

I loved our stay at the Plymouth. It was very clean and neat. It had everything that we needed and more. It was so conveniently located to everything we had planned to do on our stay. The host was very responsive and helpful. I enjoyed the gym and even more so loved that there was a Planet Fitness a short walk away. I would definitely stay here again and tell my friends about it too! Thank you.
Great location. Modern, clean design. Bedrooms are small but well designed and functional.
Nice place and close to chinatown
Very nice place, and i think there’s everything you need. One thing, if you live in higher floors, it might be super bright in the morning but it’s no big deal
Perfect place to stay! Train was right there within walking distance which made getting to the city very cheap, easy and accessible. I loved our spot!

This apartment exceeded expectations.  It is in a charming building with intricate designs in the elevators and other areas.  The apartment was larger than expected.  The location was perfect for us - a short walk to UChicago and only about a 3 minute walk to the lakeshore.  Parking is free if you look for it - we always found a free spot nearby.  Trader Joe's and Whole Foods are a short walk, as are numerous restaurants.  I can't comment on the climate control since the weather was perfect while we were there (highs in mid 70s) and we opened the windows for nice breezes both day and night.  I would definitely stay again.
nice house, ideal for 3 people. It is in the Mexican part of the city. Just a 5 minute walk to the pink line that takes you to the loop in about 20 minutes. Great location

Sehr netter Gastgeber

Rashmi was a excellent host. The area was surrounded of amazing restaurants and near transit stations. Even far away areas like the Riverwalk was easy to get to though the transit. The place was a bit dirty but nothing that ruined the experience. Even the locals were suggesting places to eat and activities. Definitely a great place to stay!
I would definitely stay at this place again. Very comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed.
Fantastic location,  beautiful property. Perfectly clean, great bedding and furniture, huge TV, nice amenities. Thoroughly enjoyed our time here and would stay again.

Top notch service here!  The unit was very clean.  Awesome location, walkable to lots of things and quick access to public transportation.  We loved the rooftop terrace and used it every evening.  There is opportunity for the building owners to update the lobby and hallways and to keep it cleaner.  But, the unit itself was clean and modern.
amazing!!!

747 Lofts Concierge was very responsive and they were proactive when I noticed there were stains, I got them changed immediately. Place was worth the money and it was exactly like the pictures. AC and heating works great as well.

It was clean, cozy, and had everything we needed during our trip. The location was convenient, and overall we had a very positive experience. We would definitely recommend staying here and would consider booking again in the future!
As advertised, bathroom a little old but on par for the apartments in the area. Location is king, train wasn’t too loud. Beds comfortable so was couch.

Apartment was spotless.  The location cannot be beat, easy walkable access to so much. Entry was easy. Hosts gave very detailed instructions.  They were nice to accommodate us getting in early.  Apartment view is nice. The amenities floor has a lot to offer and a fantastic view.
Nice.
Was a great place to stay in Chicago.

Very responsive, AC was running constant and was set at 44 only got to 75 at lowest. Luckily there was a fan in the masters. I did have to park on the side streets because the parking gate didn’t work.. also have to go back in the alley  and there was a lot of people partying out back and was told it wasn’t super safe to be out at night.. It was a cute place and only stayed for two nights and it worked. We did get messaged about sending a tech over, but we were on vacation and didn’t want to sit at home and wait or want someone to come in while we weren’t there.. felt like this should’ve been looked at before our check in.

I was looking for a place in the old location I used to live in, this place was perfect.
The studio was spacious, it was easy to check in, host was kind and responsive. Definitely will be using again next time we go back to Chicago.

This stay was amazing. Private, quiet location within walking distance of many great restaurants. The area was beautiful, and the inside was clean and well maintained. The bathroom was probably the best we've had! This is a perfect spot for anyone looking to stay in Chicago. We would easily choose this location again if given the opportunity.

Patt was an awesome host who was always able to solve any issues I faced. She was super accommodating and supportive. Her kitchen amenities were good and I enjoyed the room I got. I loved her tastefully decorated place & the washer dryer unit that was available . My co residents were respectful and I also made friends with one of the girls staying there. The location which was Pilsen is a great place to be with tons of wonderful cafés, restaurants and shops. I’d totally visit her place if I’m in Chicago again !
Responsive host, the place was exactly as described, and posted for a reasonable price. 5/5
Great place, the designs were very interesting and the rooms were spacious. Also nice views from different rooms. Would book again 👍
fantastic stay! I will come again
Amazing location would definitely come back!

We had great time with family. The two units were very nice and close to each other. The view was beautiful. It was very convenient for us with location didn’t use the car the whole stay. One con was the furniture needed some upgrades but after all we all had a fantastic time.

Fabulous basement apartment, and really appreciated having the roof terrace to enjoy the sunshine .
It’s well equipped & everything was immaculate.
Had an issue with the locking system on exit with the front door malfunctioning, which meant the apartment wasn’t secure when we went out, but someone came to reset it - technology ! Perhaps a key safe would be simpler.

We loved our stay with Elizabeth! She was very accommodating & proactive, asking us to let her know if we need anything before we had even checked in. Her place was clean, and homey. We had a lovely time walking around town and enjoying the restraints & coffee shops!
Great host, very responsive and helpful. Would definitely stay again. Thanks!
Ben was always quick to reply to any questions we had.  Nice neighborhood.  Coffee shop is an easy walk, just a couple blocks away.

Appartamento grande e ben tenuto, comodo per due persone, io ho alloggiato da solo.
Tutto unzionale e si trova in una zona molto tranquilla e residenziale, comodo per raggiungere il centro città con la metropolitana. Host gentili e disponibili, consigliato :)
I had a wonderful time in the Gold Coast area. A fantastic vibe, so much to do, wonderful bars and restaurants. Friendly people. I was also blessed with fabulous sunshine x

What made this cozy, clean place stand out was how easy it was to feel like a local during the stay. The neighborhood is quiet and residential, but still very convenient; grocery stores, CVS, coffee shops, and the metro station are all within walking distance.
Justin was really communicative and helpful the whole time. He shared great local tips and made everything easy and smooth from check-in to check-out! Highly recommend!

Beautiful location and house! So close to the nearby L station + many restaurants and vintage shops. Joe and Shannon provided clear instructions on how to check in, responded to all my questions, and had a friendly chat with us in-person too; they are lovely. We loved the decor, especially the Mountain Goats poster ❤️ Would absolutely love to stay here again!

We were very pleased with our stay at the Sophisticated Townhome in Prestigious Lincoln Park. Great location — just a short 2–3 minute walk to the CTA train and within easy walking distance of shops, grocery stores, restaurants, and a friendly, safe neighborhood.
The house itself was spotless and thoughtfully decorated. We were genuinely charmed by the warm touches throughout, including the cozy woven blankets which reminded me of home, along with all the other little details that made the space feel so inviting. The bedrooms were very comfortable, the beds had lovely linens, and we had plenty of clean towels for our stay. The kitchen was fully stocked with everything we needed. After long days of exploring the city, it was such a relief to come back, unwind, and even find small essentials on hand when we needed them.
We loved being able to have our dog with us. Having free and convenient parking was also a plus.
We had a wonderful stay and would happily return. Highly recommended!

Good location and spacious garden level apartment. Free parking was nice perk and unit felt generally spacious for a family of 3. Host was responsive and unit was well equipped with kitchen amenities to games.
It’s worth mentioning you don’t actually have control of the AC (thermostat is in upstairs unit) so after one night of uncomfortable sleep, we had to request they keep temp lower. It was slightly better next night but that meant unnecessarily cold during the day. Traveling with an infant, we wouldn’t book this again.
pretty good and clean place, right in the heart of the city!
We had a very pleasant stay at Aisha's place, great location for walking.  The place was clean and comfortable. Would stay again.

I stayed in the cottage crafts room after I stayed in the green room and this room was so cozy! Ryan was a great host and super responsive. We had to check out of our first room but he was quick to get our second room ready for us and had it available before our check in time! It was a smaller space than our first room but we were only in this one for a night so it was okay. This room was in the basement so it was darker, so girls bring your LED mirrors for additional lighting when getting ready. This bed was so comfortable, the AC was ON, and the darkness made it hard to get out of bed. Such a cozy and comfortable room, be careful you may waste the day away and bedrot in there like we did our last day in Chicago. Loved this room and would stay again!!
Our stay was great! Perfect place for a large group, very clean and comfortable.

Vicky was far one of the best hosts. Her place is complete with everything you need, from parking garage, to washer and dryer, to kitchen needs. Her recommendations were topnotch as well. Thank you so much! We appreciate you!

Christian was very responsive from booking through checkout.  Property as described - very clean and comfortable.  Perfect location with parking for us as we were visiting family in the area.  Renovations occurring in the lower level daily took away from the ambiance but would definitely book again knowing the property, area and responsiveness of Christian.

The apartment is very well maintained and clean. The instructions are precise. The apartment is right next to the L train track, making it quite noisy. The host is very kind by providing the earplugs. But for people like me, I struggled real hard to fall asleep at night.
Staying here for the first time they was flexible and definitely happy to stay here when I come back in the future and was able to propose to my beautiful wife now
Amazing
Great location to all major attractions.  Good amount of street parking and nearby garages. The place was clean and the beds were really comfortable. Would definitely come back again!
Loved this apartment! Great location, beautiful design, and was comfortable to hang out with family in!

Ben was a great host and was always responsive. Check in was easy and the condo was really great with fantastic views of Chicago skyline. Highly recommended!!

We traveled with our family to Chicago for a family trip. For being in the city, it accommodated our large family really well. There weren’t many pots or pans or cooking utensils. The train is very close to the apartment and while it’s insulated really well, a fan or tv in the bedroom would have made it perfect. Overall would absolutely recommend.

Jeramiah is a brilliant host, very accommodating and helpful. The b&b is really clean and tidy and the location is also good and near a bustop that will take you to downtown. Had a lovely stay would definitely reccomend😌
Perfect location and walking distance to restaurants, shops, and stores.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The pictures are a great representation of the space. The king bed was very comfortable, and we used the large walk in closet for our baby’s pack n play. Lots of storage, kitchen amenities are solid, an air fryer is a helpful touch, the showers were really nice. I will say parking in the included garage is TIGHT. We drive a minivan and I couldn’t get it in the spot we were assigned. I reached out and the host was very responsive and helped me with another spot in the garage that was available that I could use. If you drive anything larger than a small SUV it can be tight! We’d definitely stay here again, one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had.
Great place to stay if you are going to the united center. Also a very clean place.
Small yet comfortable studio. Very comfortable bed! Perfect for 1/2 people. Excellent neighborhood that is quintessentially Chicago. Would definitely stay again.
Really comfortable, cosy and safe space within easy walking distance of public transport around Chicago, place as described, quiet and would throughly recommend for anyone wanting to explore Chicago
Great rooms and location

A casa é ótima, espaçosa, bem localizada. O bairro é tranquilo, é fácil parar o carro na rua e os proprietários deixam a gente com os tickets pra parar na rua. O ponto alto é a comunicação com Matt e Nicole, são muito rápidos, atenciosos e gentis.

Everything was amazing, with a beautiful view that made the experience even more special. Our pre-honeymoon trip was absolutely worth it, and we cherished every moment we created together in such a private and peaceful setting.

I enjoyed my stay. The spacious unit is perfect for large groups. The unit was so clean.  It really  felt like my home away from home. It had all the amenities I needed to make my stay comfortable. I will definitely book again!

The house was great for our family trip! Alex’s place was exactly as described, very comfortable. Walkable location close to restaurants, just a few blocks from the red line. We would definitely book again!

Excelente la ubicación, el departamento impecable limpio y prolijo. Muy bien ubicado , no necesitas tomar transporte para ir a los lugares importantes. Volvería sin dudas. Convenient, close to everything.

A very cozy and modern apartment located in a tranquil neighborhood. It is walking distance from eateries and stores.  Perfect for a couple or small family. I enjoyed my stay at this property, and I will highly recommend it. The host is very polite and respond to the message right away.
O espaço superou todas as expectativas. Ambiente limpo, organizado, confortável, bonito e com tudo que precisávamos para a nossa estadia.
Amazing value for how clean it was and how safe I felt. Lovely culturally rich neighborhood with great access to food and public transportation if necessary.
Nice place to stay in a great area. Mera was responsive and gave clear instructions to check in/out.

As others have noted, the home is right next to the L train. You can hear it, but we found it became background noise fairly quickly and was less disruptive than expected.
Everything was great, enjoyed the stay!
absolutely amazing host and amazing place to stay at.

Had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The place was great we had absolutely no problems checking in parking wasn’t terrible and we were provided detailed instructions before we checked in so that we wouldn’t be lost.
It is our 3rd time staying here and as always we love it
Great stay, great location, incredible city views.

amazing stay..so far my best Airbnb.

Stunning home - better than the photos! Felt comfortable and right at home. Highly recommend.

Marc, your home was perfect for my stay. I had to do some work, so the office space was great, especially for the virtual meetings. The meeting attendees were complimenting the decor.

Great spot for a couple or solo traveler visiting Chicago! Easy walk to the El and the Metra, plus easy walk to some great spots in the neighborhood. Has everything you need, including (paid, but reasonable) laundry in the basement. Would definitely stay here again!

Josh

The listing was exactly as advertised.  The space was very clean and worked perfectly for our group of 3 adults and 2 children. The property was conveniently located, easy to get to great dining and local attractions!
What a great location!  So close to the L, the train, Millenium park -everything we wanted was right there.  Did not need our car!  The beds were super comfy.  Perfect for our family of 5.

Vladlena’s place was great. Very convenient location with great access to Chicago’s main spots. Communication with the host was clear and professional, and I would gladly stay here again!
Thanks for the convenient location for our stay. We loved our time in Chicago!!

Really great airbnb which was within walking distance to public transport, places to eat and local shops. located close to a blue line station which runs directly from O'Hare airport to Chicago's Loop District and which can be swapped to other lines.

My only regret is that we couldn’t stay longer….. this time!! We will definitely be back. The place and view were absolutely amazing!

Fantastic flat in a great, walkable neighborhood! Sarah’s place is well stocked, clean, and lovingly decorated, a perfect homebase for our family of three. In the summer, don’t miss walking to Miko’s to get Italian ice  - amazing!

The apartment offered the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and convenience. It was spacious, beautifully furnished, spotless, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we could possibly need. Clean room and exactly as listed. Host was very accommodating and responsive.

Cons: No washer/dryer but laundry is in the building and so easy that it's barely a con.

The reality is that issues resulting from a lack of proper upkeep cannot be fully resolved in just a few hours; they require a consistent maintenance and housekeeping process.
For example, several lamps are not functioning, and the washing machine was in a very dirty condition. Given the price we paid, we expected the apartment to be presented in immaculate condition.
The apartment has tremendous potential and could provide an excellent guest experience if it were managed and maintained to a higher stand
The property was exactly as advertised, very clean and modern! The balcony view was amazing! Stephanie was great at communicating!

Book with Nika today, you won't be disappointed.
Really easy to walk to the train or use the buses from this spot if you’re coming and have no car. I had an easy time checking in and the host answered every question I asked within like 30 minutes.

I paid $1,500 for a five nights. At arrival, I found significant cleanliness issues, including caked-on dust on vents, baseboards, and trim; stains on the ceiling; dried splatter on a wall; marks on door frames; a hair stuck to the bathroom wall; and what appeared to be a booger on the wall next to the bed. The apartment was also hot, smelled musty, and guests should be aware that the host controls the AC.
I promptly notified both the host and Airbnb. While the host offered a standard cleaning, Airbnb customer support agreed the property required a deep cleaning. Due to the condition of the apartment, I no longer felt comfortable staying there and left the property.
Afterward, the host’s messages became increasingly hostile. I was accused of lying, told my photos were fake, accused of never entering the apartment, and threatened with legal action and damage claims.
Airbnb reviewed the matter, canceled the reservation, refunded my $1,500, and provided an additional $500 toward my hotel.
Great price, great location, very well kept, and Mary was a responsive and kind host.

We would stay again, particularly for the neighborhood and convenience.

awesome place thanks Kyriako

loved staying here! super convenient location and beautiful apartment

Great location, within walking distance to a lot of restaurants, stores, etc. Ben was responsive. Overall had a good stay.

Late at night my husband did notice rodents in the area and there was a sign about rats so be mindful of that. The elevator stopped working while we were there and residents says it happens quite a bit so if you’re in NEED of an elevator this may not be ideal for you. I recommend rideshare in this area because parking was VERY limited (which she cannot control).

I would definitely stay here again.
