The location was a nice neighborhood & we felt completely safe.Its a short walk 2 Logan square w restaurants 2 choose from or catch the blue line 2 downtown.
The backyard w/a beautiful garden newly built back deck was a great place 4 relaxing w/ a cup of coffee or an evening after a long day in the city.Garage was a plus although we didn’t need it ‘cause parking out front was convenient & never difficult 2 find a spot.
The home was clean & comfortable w/ no issues.The bathroom was clean w/ nice amenities.Check in - check out was smooth,easy, & without issues.
The king mattress was quite firm and appeared on the newer side.plenty of closet space 4 your belongings in bedrooms.
We would stay in their home again if we return to that area of Chicago.

My family and I loved our stay here! The unit was extremely spacious and the neighborhood was quiet at night! One thing I do feel is worth mentioning is the next door neighbors have chickens/rosters that crow early in the morning- so if you are a light sleeper I suggest sleeping in the bedroom closer to the front of the house and the noise won't bother you!
Besides that, loved how safe the neighborhood felt, we went on daily walks! There are a couple bus stops in close walking distance so utilizing public transportation was super convenient!
Overall, we had a comfortable stay and would recommend Shawn's home for future guests!

I absolutely loved Dena's place! The garage was amazing for my in-laws to park and even provided us with daily parking passes which gave us peace of mind. The home itself was amazing. We had so much room and enjoyed how close it was to the city. Definitely would stay again!!
My experience was wonderful. The host was amazing. Communicates very well and just wonderful and would highly recommend Milan to everyone. Will use the host again
Great location! Ben was a very responsive host, and overall the stay helped make our trip to Chicago a great experience!

It’s hard to find words sufficiently compelling for how amazing our stay was. Christine and Patrick were super hospitable hosts. On our way there we were having car problems and they even recommended us to a mechanic they knew. They are very friendly and very helpful. They give you breakfast every single morning which means a lot. They also gave us a bus card so we could use the public bus! Very friendly people.
Christine y Patrick son muy amables y les ayuden cuando necesitan ayuda. Son muy hospitable y te dan desayuno cada día. No hay que preocuparse con ellos. Son amigos de todos!
Great stay! Close to public transport and easy to get everywhere. Spacious, comfy apartment
Patrick was a warm and friendly host. he made checking in a pleasure. would highly recommend his place and will definitely consider his property for future trips to chicago.
Great quiet place to relax, close to all things!
Very nice and clean!! Wonderful place
Great views. Clean place. Nice rooftop pool. Great location.
Emily and Roya are super strong communicators and very responsive. The place was exactly what our group needed for a Roger’s Park wedding weekend.

Cozy place to stay in Chicago there’s lots to do outside of it. Everything was either 10 - 20 minute away which was perfect! Angelica was very responsive any questions we had anything that we didn’t have she responded quick and helped out and we appreciated a very responsive host!

The bed was very comfy. The tv in the bedroom didn’t work, which was unfortunate. Some of the dishes were dirty when we arrived but everything needed to wash was available! Great location, my partner and I had no issues getting around the city without a car. Cindy was a great host who was very responsive. A comfortable apartment, though it is a basement unit so not much sunlight. Plenty of linens and towels which was awesome.

We absolutely loved our stay here! The property was really cute, comfortable, and clean. Everything we needed was available - it was so nice to have laundry soap, dish soap, extra paper products, salt and pepper... things you don't want to buy for just a few days, but that make the stay so much more pleasant! Nathaniel was an amazing host - always responsive to questions, and very accommodating. We visited the city with our kids, and they slept great in the very nice bunk bed, and loved the available toys and games to occupy them while we were at the house. We are already looking forward to our next trip and will definitely be staying here again!!
Great views, very clean. After 70$ for parking and $75 for pet fee, it’s way over priced.

We had a wonderful week-long stay at this airbnb. The place was cozy, clean and everything was as described. The host was very friendly and always responsive. The train was indeed very close and the noise was a bit disturbing at first but we got used to it, so having earplugs would definitely help. Other than that, it was a great place to stay!
Great stay :)

Genova's place is perfect for making trips to downtown. Chicago has a great public transportation. There are 4 rooms in the apartment with shared bathroom and kitchen. Therefore, if you like to meet and talk to people from other places this is the place.

Overall, we enjoyed our stay and the location was definitely the biggest highlight. The Airbnb is in a great neighborhood with plenty of restaurants within walking distance.
That said, there were a few issues that impacted our experience. Several pieces of furniture had noticeable stains that made the space feel less clean than expected. The biggest concern was the air conditioning unit, which occasionally blew dead mosquitos onto the bed in the room. Additionally, only one towel was provided per guest for our four-day stay. With no access to a washer or dryer, it was difficult to keep towels dry and fresh throughout the trip.
The location is excellent and was the main reason we enjoyed our stay, but some improvements to cleanliness and amenities, would make for a much better overall experience.
Excellent home.  Very clean and well appointed. Great communication.
The best possible location to stay in and very spacious!
Great stay, highly recommend. Will stay there again.
This place was a great find! Sarah always checked in with me to ask if there was anything I needed. Def recommend.

The place was very nice, clean, and very spacious. The location was decent, but we still had to walk quite a bit to get to wicker park and division street, but we knew that in advance. The security deposit was a bit weird because I’ve never had to do that on Airbnb. Only other thing we didn’t like was there were no toilet paper roll hangers or no towel racks/hangers on the wall anywhere. There were 5 of us sharing the Airbnb so it made it a bit hard for us to store our towels in a clean place that was all accessible, but other than that, the Airbnb was comfy and spacious and had everything we needed!
loved it here and hope to be back

Really nice place in a good neighborhood. Can definitely walk to certain places & have convenient places around. We used street parking (free) & car was totally ok! In my opinion would definitely only go with adults since the pictures are more explicit than expected. FYI to who ever sleeps on sofa bed, will get sun as soon as it comes out since there’s no curtains/blinds on sliding doors. Place was super clean. Had more than enough towels & necessities. Overall, we don’t have any complaints.
VERY ! nice home.

Adam’s place was dope, honestly even better than expected. The space was very clean, spacious, and thoughtfully set up, and the rooms were comfortable and well organized. Everything made for a smooth and enjoyable stay. I’d definitely book this place again the next time I visit.

Very responsive. Delivered requested crib, high chair and changing table with mattress. The sheet required a second trip back but was quickly delivered after we messaged. Future renters should understand this is an urban environment so privacy and street noise are different, all of which was part of the fun. The location is outstanding for access to airport, CTA and cultural highlights of Chicago. We would return!
Perfect location!
very nice place and a great neighborhood to stay in! great walkability to train station and local restaurants. very cute cats! comfortable room and kind hosts :)

Song and Dillon's home was a sanctuary during my Chicago trip. The location was dangerously convenient for Chinese early morning treats/late night snacks, the bed was perfectly restful, and the three cats formed a welcoming committee. I appreciated the ear that Dillon lent to me, as we chatted about the world. Overall, highly recommended for cat lovers who like to eat and explore!

My husband and I had a great stay at Min's place. The location is perfect - close to train lines and easy to walk anywhere you might need to go. Plenty of restaurants a few blocks away. The apt looks just like the photos. Even though you are close to the action, the street and apt are very quiet. Slept so well! The hosts are very friendly and super responsive. Loved our stay and hope to return on a future trip to Chicago!

Beautiful clean apartment in a great location that is of walking distance to many locations like the beach! My only complaint is that since it is a ground-floor apartment, the slamming of the lobby doors might warrant ear plugs for better sleep. Otherwise, Nicholas was very heplful and responsive and the instructions were clear!

Super close to CTA and made our commute to downtown very easy. Spacious for three of us, responsive host and clear instructions. Had everything we needed, would definitely recommend!
Great deal for a fair price 💯
Worst airbnb, worst host

Perfect say in Andersonville. Easily walkable to all of the neighborhood establishments and the Red Line for trips further into the city. The place itself was larger than expected, cosy, and well stocked. We enjoyed this stay and would gladly book again.
Very convenient place to stay. Had a lot of fun in Chicago
Amazing the team was great and we felt at home thank you for hosting us

It is a cozy apartment in a quiet residential neighborhood in West Town. Very well decorated, with comfortable beds, and we found everything we needed inside the apartment. It is exactly as shown in the photographs: on the ground floor there are 3 bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, and one bathroom; in the basement there is one bedroom, two living areas (a sitting room and a TV room), and another bathroom. There is a lovely backyard with chairs and a fire pit.
There is a pub right in front, a small grocery store one block away, and some restaurants nearby. It is close to bus and subway stations that provide quick access to the Loop and North River.
Great value for money, I highly recommend it.

Unique apartment with so many thoughtful touches like drinks snacks toiletries extra towels etc
Very clean and communicative host
A/C worked super well and was nice to have laundry access. Neighborhood was quiet but some good restaurants and easy transit access.
Would definitely stay again

Was in Chicago with a large group of family and friends for memorial weekend. Bhavish’s home was a perfect fit for all of us, plenty of space and felt very comfortable. Check-in was a breeze and we had no issues whatsoever while we were there. He was very friendly and proactively checking in to see if we had any issues. This is definitely a spot we would come back to for future events.
Very good

Our stay was very nice! We loved the Irving Park neighborhood and being surrounded by families during our stay, and felt like we weren’t too far from all of the things we wanted to do on our trip!
The kitchen was also very nice and gave us all of the space we needed, especially for storing food for and feeding our baby.
The main hangup for us is that we probably wouldn’t recommend this AirBnB when traveling with a baby. There were multiple instances of heavy footsteps and dog barking between midnight and 2am that wouldn’t have bothered us if me and my husband were traveling alone, but one night it did wake up the baby. We obviously understand that other people live in the building and things happen, but it’s something to consider.
Another small note, the beds were great but the couch and other living room furniture weren’t very comfortable.
This is a great stay overall and we would recommend it to almost everyone, especially if you’re mainly exploring on your trip!

What a fantastic find. Josh is a great host, very responsive and kind. The apartment is huge, very clean, and charming. It was refreshingly easy to have kids there. He had multiple pack-n-plays in the closet, the laundry was easy to access, and the furnishings are stylish yet durable. The neighborhood is quiet and safe. We would definitely stay here again.

Gavino was extremely helpful, kind, and super responsive. He provided clear instructions and there no issues on guidance. The apartment is perfect for a small group. Found everything super clean. Trains/buses are walking distance and there are great Mexican restaurants within a 10 min walk. Walked day and night and felt extremely safe.
Just an awesome location, walkable to most everything.  And Adam was the most responsive host we have ever had.

Stayed here for work, good place but paper thin walls. You will hear everything, and the train station is an annoying an annoying 14
minute walk away, with the bus that gets you there not coming more then every 30 minutes, if that.
Fridge and kitchen were nice as well. Bathroom has a bidet!
Windows in some of the rooms, would strongly recommend against a windowless room if you are planning on longer term.

Awesome place, has everything you need. You cannot beat the area, cool restaurants/bars. Jennifer was a fantastic host. Very helpful and responded quickly to all of our communication. This was an ideal spot for our long stay. Honestly if I were to move to Chicago, this is exactly where I'd want to live. Would rebook in heart beat.
Clean apartment in a great neighborhood. Walkable and close to many things. Hot tub was private, clean, and a great addition. Bed was comfortable.
Great 2 bedroom close to all the things and people we wanted to see and do

It was a great stay for our party of 10! Great location, a walk away from Chinatown (best place for food) and easy access to public transit. Host was able to accommodate with extra towels, blankets and pillows super quick and I really appreciated the disposable toothbrushes and toothpastes a great touch. Amazing communication from the host that made it seem he truly cared to make the stay smooth. It was an amazing place and would stay here again for my next trip to Chicago!

I have been staying in Hyde Park for short trips quite often lately. I've stayed at many small places at Charie's price point. This is the best one I've stayed at. It is on one of the most beautiful streets in Hyde Park. A quiet street just off a busy street with lots of restaurants, coffee shops, etc. A beautiful park is only a block away.
Charie's place is better put together than the other ones I've stayed at recently with more of a home feel and less of an Ikea vibe.
I'll look to stay there again next time I return.

Juanita fue una gran anfitriona. muy agradable su plática.
respondía muy rápido y siempre estaba atenta.
El gato se llevó toda mi atención 😅
sin duda muy recomendable y claro que regresaria.
Charming neighborhood and pleasant accommodations.

We stayed with 2 toddlers and an infant. Loved that it was 2 floors, so we could all have privacy. We had issues with a few things: ceiling fan in upper floor bedroom didn't work, ALL of the door handles really needed to be tightened (the were sitting uneven), 1 basement bedroom had dirty and scuffed walls (we were told it was because they needed to repaint them and didn't have time) and the basement bathroom shower doesn't hold all the water (the bathroom floor was soaked) and lastly, all the bed sheets would not stay on the mattress while people slept. Other than those things, it was livable/decent. Love that the doors deadbolted themselves after someone would leave. Neighborhood was fairly quiet for it being Chicago. Parking was great. And I believe they bought us a brand new pack n play because we asked about one. That was a nice touch 👌🏻

It’s cheap. But the bathroom smells bad and is very old. The neighborhood is great but the other guests can be unfriendly. The vibes are a little off. The host seems nice but we never said hello. It feels like we aren’t given any kind of personal attention at any point. The room is nice.

Unfortunately, I would not stay here again. The host was polite and did acknowledge the inconvenience of the place not being ready upon arrival, which I appreciated. However, the overall cleanliness of the property was disappointing. The floors were very dirty, there was a strong plumbing odor throughout the stay, and we encountered multiple spiders inside the home.
The space has potential, but it did not meet the level of cleanliness and comfort we expected for our stay. I hope these issues are addressed for future guests

The stay was perfect for what we wanted.  15 mins from wrigley and guaranteed rate field . It was a great weekend trip !! Clean , and easy to get to , also off the beaten path. Just how you want it !! Thanks again!!

The home is very lovely and the hosts are awesome. It does, however, sit practically under the train tracks. The train runs day and night and it vibrates the home including your bed while trying to sleep. We were exhausted by the time our trip came to an end from lack of sleep.
Very convenient area. Host was super helpful
fun and funky space with great access to public transport and the 606! great coffee and snacks nearby too. great place to stay if you're looking for great access!

The space was great; plenty of room for our family of 3. Love the location and the house is nicely decorated.  Safe neighborhood. Justin communicated very well and helped answer a few questions we had about the house. Great hosts.
Great place!

Carmen was a fantastic host and very proactive on keeping us up to date and checking in.
The house was a good fit for our family and felt very comfortable.
We had a very comfortable stay and had everything we needed.
Great place.

This place was perfect for our family/friend vacation to Chicago! The place was clean and the host was always very responsive to any questions we had.
As mentioned in the description, parking is limited so keep that in mind if you have a vehicle.
Thank you Maya for sharing your home with us!
Really nice place in a beautiful neighborhood. Walking distance to terrific restaurants like Armitage Alehouse. We loved our stay here!

Great space for a girls trip. We had plenty of room to both hang out together and to retreat to separate spaces when needed. The decor is thoughtful and beautiful. We only had one request during our stay and it was taken care of very quickly.
We’d definitely stay again!
We had the perfect trip! Lots of great shops and food nearby. It’s a beautiful apartment!

Mary & Andrew hosted us for a bachelorette party and everyone in group absolutely loved the accommodations. There was plenty of space for 10 guests, and we felt like we could spread out and relax whenever we needed to. The location was also a huge selling point for our group, as it was within walking distance of the blue line and we could easily get to restaurants in both Wicker and Logan. Mary & Andrew were also incredibly responsive and accommodating; we had an awkward window of time between our guests' arrival and when we could check-in and Mary let us store our bags on the property site as early as 11am. This was a huge help for our group, as we could then move around without having to lug our bags all over the city.
I'd highly recommend Mary & Andrew's home to anyone looking for a comfortable yet local stay for a group event!
Loved the property, a little far from the city. Overall nice, and cozy!

It was an absolute pleasure staying at Jonathan’s place. Can’t say enough good things about my stay which was over two weeks. Here are the highlights :
- Quiet living. Felt right at home !
-Ideal location. Park and a ton of restaurants next door. Also a laundry right across the street
-Host: Jonathan is an incredible host. Super friendly and responsive. His cat George is also super friendly !
Thanks again, Jonathan ! Looking forward to coming back !

Regina is a responsive and accommodating host! We were very thankful she allowed us to check our bags in early with no charge. The place itself is a little old with creaky floors and at the top of a 3 story building, no elevator. It is in a good location, about a 5 min walk to the bus stop and 20 min walk to Lawrence station on the red line. The bus didn’t always come on time so we did have to walk, especially at night which became a hassle. Bathroom is tiny. Water pressure in the shower is terrible, feels like a few drops a second, but it was hot. Hard to adjust water temperature for the shower. One second it’s freezing, one second it’s boiling. A/C is a window unit, which if/when rain hits it, it creates a loud noise, could be distracting for sleep. No available outlets in bedroom. Bunk bed stairs are slightly broken so hard to get up top. No drinking water available and have to take out the trash. Overall, I think you get what you paid for. Not bad, but wouldn’t stay here again

Group of friends and I stayed at Cris’ spot in Pilsen. Super clean place and had a great layout that gave us our own space while allowing us to all be together when we wanted.
For those coming to Chicago for the first time, Pilsen is a short Uber away from downtown. The area is quiet but still a bit away from the main things in Chicago.
Would highly recommend Cris’ spot!
Had a great stay! The unit is spacious, clean, comfortable and conveniently located. Communication and neighborhood tips from Matthew were top notch. Would definitely stay here again!

Ian's place is honestly one of the best airbnb's we've ever stayed at. Everything was smooth and easy from check in to check out. Well stocked kitchen, comfortable bed, friendly host, this place was perfect. The location was exactly what we needed for our visit to see family nearby. My only regret is not spending more time on the lovely deck! Will definitely be back again.
It was a very comfortable and peaceful stay! Loved the apartment 👌Will surely come back.
Had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was very responsive and made check-in super easy.

Austin is the most responsive host I have ever encountered.  Messages backing minutes not hours like others I have seen.  Something is messing or broken, he has it delivered to the door in hours.  Great experience.

El alojamiento muy lindo y es como se muestra en las fotos, solo tuvimos un inconveniente al ingresar el código de la caja de seguridad para las llaves del alojamiento, lo cual recomiendo siempre confirmen un día antes, pero de resto el alojamiento estuvo perfecto
Easy check in, clean place, great location.

This was a great spot for a group of friends meeting up in Chicago for the weekend! It was in a great location for exploring the Lincoln Square and Ravenswood neighborhoods, taking transit to other parts of town, and just hanging out at the house and in the backyard.
We did have some minor issues with the dishwasher and sink that we weren't able to resolve during our stay due to the holiday weekend, but the hosts responded quickly and were able to offer some support to help with the inconvenience. Some of the rooms are small but that worked okay for a group that spent a lot of our time in common spaces or out and about.
muy buena ubicación en un buen apartamento que necesita alguna actualización

Our 3 families of 10 enjoyed our stay at Maggie's place.  The kids with us appreciated the game room, especially the air hockey table!  The variety of king beds with the bunk beds really accomodated our needs especially well. The kitchen is well appointed (but could use a couple of cookie sheets!). The kitchen has top-of-the-line appliances.  The living room and dining room is large enough for a lot of guests to hang out and visit together and eat together.  We enjoyed our stay and the little special things Maggie did to make our stay enjoyable.
Alles war wie beschrieben. Gerne wieder

Daran and Janette’s place was an ideal home base for a weekend exploring Chicago. It’s located in a quiet, charming neighborhood that was great for walking around and exploring. The space had everything we needed—nice kitchen, comfortable bed and a great set of table and chairs out front that was perfect for morning coffee or evening drinks. Daran and Janette were super friendly, eager to help, with great local recommendations. If we’re ever back in Chicago, we’ll definitely stay again.
Dawn’s place was so cute and sweet. We didn’t want for anything, as it was well stocked. We loved the location, and the ease of getting around.
Good stay for the price, location is convenient
Very nice and clean home , will come again

Super affordable and a quick walk to logan square/blue line to transport. Owners gave clear instructions on how to get inside and overall the apt felt very safe. Unfortunately we had some very noisy tenants staying above us, but overall the stay was nice. We would definitely stay here again if traveling through.
Place was definitely a vibe! Big thanks to Esmirna!
This was a clean, comfortable place to stay during a friend’s wedding weekend. Kim was responsive, but not intrusive at all!
Yuyi was a fantastic host as expected! Quick to respond and was very helpful when we needed! Thank you!
Ashley’s spot was perfect! We could easily use public transit to get around, the bed was super comfy, and there was plenty of parking. Would stay here again!!

We enjoyed our stay at this unique space in the heart of the north side. Free street parking was easy to find. Unique about this apartment is how it was absolutely stocked, in every possible way: extra towels, small electrical appliances of every kind, lots of cooking spices in the cabinet, many games & puzzles, etc. We would definitely look to stay here again on future visits.
The place was cute and the host was responsive

We had a wonderful stay in Drew’s place. Because it was in the Fulton area there were plenty of day and night time activities available. Getting into the building was also very easy. The apartment was very spacious and allowed for both couples to have their private space. I think the bedrooms could be freshened up just a bit (paint and carpets) however it didn’t take away from the overall experience. I would definitely stay here again.
We loved staying in Wrigleyville and the apartment was very comfortable for sleeping and entertaining! (We had friends over for drinks, etc.) Everything was very comfortable!
Our family enjoyed our stay
Joan's place was exactly as described. Highly recommended for any visit to Chicago!

Tiffany is a very nice, responsive, and helpful.
Place is nice, clean, and spacious.
Great neighborhood… place matched the description and pictures .. easy check in … accommodated my family perfectly.. would definitely stay again

Amy is fantastic, very attentive and communication was great. I was here on business and unsure on what the local area was like. turned out to be beautiful and easy to get around.
Thanks Amy, I will definitely be back!

Junni's house was perfect for our group!! Myself and my friends from college met up with our families - 6 adults and 6 kids all under the age of 4, and this house was the perfect home base for us. The kitchen was awesome, so well appointed. The bathrooms were so clean and there were plenty of towels for a large group. There were so many touches about the house that made it family friendly - stools for the bathroom sinks, children's plates/cups/silverware, a high chair, a pack & play, a full second kitchen which came in handy for our pumping mama. And, there is an amazing playground right across the street! It was close to our old neighborhood that we went to college in so we hit all our favorite restaurants- Tre Kronor, Noon-O-Kabob, Lou Malnatis- all super close. It was the best!! Would definitely recommend it for all your north side Chicago needs. We used public trans and the house was easily accessible by train/bus.
Place was clean and communication very clear.
5 star stay all around. From host communication, cleanliness, location, having all the necessities in the apartment everything was amazing for me and my family!

Situated basically halfway between Wicker Park and Fulton Market; it's a small, studio space with a single bed, and the only window opens onto an interior shaft--but it's good despite how compact it is, particularly if you're going to be out and about all day. Easy check-in, clear instructions, what space there is is used efficiently. Would recommend.

We had an amazing stay. The house matches the description as mentioned on the airbnb page. One of the best locations to stay if visiting Chicago.
Downtown is just few miles away and lot of food options available nearby.
Jonathan is a wonderful host and was always reachable when required.
Only challenge is parking. Lots of street parking available but best would be to park couple of blocks away in the parking garage which is not very expensive compared to some of the daily parking rates in Chicago downtown.
I would definitely like to stay again when visiting Chicago next time!

My son and I stayed here for a 3 day Chicago trip. We brought our bikes and found it very easy to get around the city from this location. The apartment had everything we could possibly need and the shower had good water pressure. Great place to stay, and I would definitely return!

Had a good time staying at Dorian’s place. He was very responsive and even provided an early check it, which was a huge help to rest before our festival!
Thank you Dorian!
The perfect place for my trip
We had a great time in the apartment, and everything was easy to access. Nikka was a great host, and was available to answer any questions.
Great  apartment, best part was walking to Division Street for restaurants and 15 minutes to Blue Line train!

One of the few places that’s actually larger and nicer than it appears in the pictures! Really spacious, nice, well stocked townhouse. Also very much appreciated Jaime letting us check in early to drop bags.
All around great stay!

We had to book an Airbnb last minute and luckily stumbled upon Abel’s Airbnb listing. The house was spacious and provided great space for the 5 of us. Abel was also responsive to me. He provided parking permits to me as well so finding parking was easily accessible.
Jasmine was very, fast and quick and answered all my questions when I had some!! Felt like a host I would rebook from with out a doubt

We loved our stay here! The property itself feels so safe and secure and the unit was so clean and well-kept when we checked in. Plus, having in-unit AC and an assigned parking space was such a nice benefit to this place as those can be hard to come by in Chicago, LOL. It’s also in a great location where there’s so much to do and see that’s walkable, and Thomas as a host was super friendly and responsive to any questions/concerns we had while we were there. I would definitely stay here again, and hope to!
very good cleaned home, really enjoyed my stay.

Our stay in Chicago was absolutely amazing. The place was spotless, comfortable, and felt like a home away from home. The location was perfect with easy access to restaurants, attractions, and everything we needed during our stay. The host was responsive, welcoming, and made the whole experience smooth from check-in to check-out. We truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again when visiting Chicago. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable stay!

Loved our stay. The location is awesome. Walking distance to food, target, and the L. The unit was as described. Kasa is very responsive and answered all my questions. We would definitely stay there again.
This apartment was perfect for 2 families with young kids. The location is perfect, walkable, has parking and close to restaurants and train / bus stops.

Place was very nice and exactly what we imagined from the pictures. The neighborhood surrounding the apartment was very peaceful, its across the street from a playground/school so it's a little noisy during the day, but definitely not a reason not to pick this place. We were able to walk to the grocery store, to coffee and the shops nearby. Theres a bus stop nearby to take you downtown, and Ubers from downtown only took around 10 minutes. Would definitely stay here again if we were to visit Chicago again!

Philip was extremely responsive to our questions, always replying right away. The unit was clean and tidy when we arrived, and the unique décor is something we’ll definitely remember. The Airbnb is currently transitioning from two units with a shared common area to one larger unit, so the current listing differed from what we originally booked. Without access to the original listing, it was a bit confusing to know which amenities were available to us. That said, the location was perfect for our needs, and we loved the neighborhood. We would happily stay here again.
Very comfortable beds, great location and surprisingly quiet for how close to restaurants and bars.

Worth the stay, mostly for the location and price! Extremely close to the L station and center of the city, which was perfect for the stay. The actual location of the place in Chinatown is also great, as it is near amazing bakeries and Chinese restaurants, and seemingly safe even at night. Though, apart from that, the place is very small, not the cleanest, and the shared common lobby and bathroom might cause issues. One fellow guest was talking loudly past midnight out in the commons (against rules), which kept me up. Someone also stole my shampoo when I accidentally left it in the shared bathroom.
Peace is exactly as pictured!

This was a beautiful, peaceful and wonderful place to stay!  It was my first AirB&B reservation and the host was very responsive, kind and friendly. The place was extremely clean and everything in its place.  After a full day of activities it was nice to come “home” to something peaceful and relaxing. Definitely a great host and will definitely book with her again!

the location of this place was incredibly convenient with a short walk to the train & a bus stop right outside the front door. the rules & check in process was extensive but seemed like all common sense things that you’d want people not to do in your own.
my only complaint about the place is the second bedroom. the blinds are broken and there is SO much daylight starting at 4am. did not get a good nights sleep the entire stay.
Loved my stay. Place was clean and had all the amenities we needed. Neighborhood was walkable and safe. Would definitely recommend!
Wonderful long weekend for nine of us!
Great and cozy place to stay in not to far from the city
So appreciate the flexibility about check in. The location was fantastic — such easy access to the Blue Line.

This is a well appointed, cozy place. It is up one flight of stairs, has great natural light, hardwood floors that creak when you walk on them which reminded me of my childhood home in Michigan.
The hosts were lovely to us and kind.
I recommend this stay.
Corrine was super friendly and always available if we had any questions! We came for a music festival and if we can book again next year, we will! Thank you so much!

We enjoyed our stay at this unit. It was clean and spacious and fairly easy to get to. Within walking distance to train station had bus stops nearby, which was nice since we didn’t have a vehicle. The apartment was very spacious and the owner very responsive. Would stay again!
Beautiful home!! Free street parking and amazing neighbors! Will definitely book again for another trip!
Great stay! Location is right by the lake, easy access to downtown as well! 10/10. Host is super responsive!

Amir's house was perfect for our stay in Chicago.  I can not overstate what a lovely neighborhood this is.  I walked five or six miles each morning and found one beautiful route after another.   The house is clean and spacious.  My 4-year-old granddaughter loved the foosball table.  We would definitely stay here again.

Our group of eight had a wonderful Memorial Day weekend at James’ listing. James was extremely attentive and responsive and the details of the home were well thought out (parking permits were provided). This is the perfect home base to explore Chicago especially if you’re renting a car. Would recommend!

The place was great. It matched the photos and everything was very clean. The check-in and parking instructions were very clear and easy to follow. Hanna and Mark were easy to reach and responded quickly.
It was a really cute, ideal location !  Well maintained and Aaron was great about communication.  It made for a great time in a really fun city.

The apartment delivered on the description. The bedrooms were quiet with a grocery store, coffee shops, bakeries, and ice cream less than a block away. It was an easy and beautiful 5-block walk to the restaurant scene on Division Street and the shops in Wicker Park.
Great stay!

Great apartment to stay with very nice views. Be prepared to read roughly 2000 words of instruction, rules, and helpful insights across several mediums. Constantly under threat of deposit being revoked. Consider bringing means of protection to fend off drug addicts who tend to gather at the lobby.
Not bad.

Steven was very helpful getting me checked in and responsive whenever I needed something. This is a great place for anyone that would like a social atmosphere and meeting people. I really enjoyed my stay.

We had the best trip to Chicago! The location to Wrigley field was amazing and it was easy to walk to the train to get around other parts of Chicago. We enjoyed the patio in the evening after exploring. We would definitely stay again!
Super kind host, super responsive, extremely understanding and helpful over phone

Great quiet place close to the city.
Thomas was an excellent host, very responsive and courteous.
Hendersons place was amazing. We felt comfortable and at home. We felt safe. We all had a very good time. Thank you for hosting.

Natalie's place was perfect for my group's trip to Chicago. The apartment was more spacious than we expected and had everything we needed. The close proximity to the blue line was also very convenient.
Great stay! Communication from host was great and everyone was impressed!
Great place and easy to access areas definitely would come back again!
Un hospedaje completo, agradable y cómodo y a 15 minutos de la ciudad.
Angela's place was great.    Very clean and spacious.   Excellent location.    Thank you.
The house was amazing and very spacious. Russell was great with communication, and both check-in and check-out were seamless. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this home to others.
Great location, clean, and the hosts were welcoming! Only complaint is that the bed is very uncomfortable.

We had a great stay here. Everything about the room was so thoughtful and there were a lot of personal touches. We had a great stay and have even sent the listing to our friends who live nearby to recommend to future visitors!
Amazing Airbnb, amazing host, and a great location! 10/10 would definitely recommend.
Great place to stay if you are going to Wrigley Field for some baseball. Also fairly close to the L (train).
Tere’s place was comfortable and just what we needed for a short stay!
Location was excellent! Very walkable, and easy to find. However, we did have issues with water pressure in the bathroom, and insufficient WiFi speed during our stay.

The room was clean, comfortable, and very well put together. The check-in process was super simple and smooth, which made everything easy from the start. The area felt a little sketchy at first, especially late at night, but I personally didn’t have any issues coming back home late. It seems like the neighborhood is up and coming, and the location worked out well since it’s not too far from the city and the train was super close by. Overall, I had a great stay — just be mindful of the location when booking.
Great location in Wicker Park!
Margo was a great host.  Very responsive and gave good suggestions.  Moving our son in and I had a truck which was Barry easy to park on the street.  Really loved the place and would rent again.
What a unique place! Absolutely loved the walkability and the surrounding area. Just what I wanted for a quick trip into town for a Cubs game and other Chicago adventures. 10/10!
Everything was okay until we arrived at the location. The photos are very broad for a reason. The shared spaces are dirty with mold, so be weary.

Great location and nice staff. Check in was easy and the views from the unit were great. Unit was a little dinged up but to be expected of a short term rental property.  We would stay here again when we come back to visit.
This place is very convenient, close to the subway, freeway, and a lot of walkable places to go to.

Our stay was exactly what we hoped for in every way. Clean, quiet, comfortable and perfectly located for our needs. Our host was extremely responsive, helpful and accommodating. We will be happy to stay here again in the future.

Absolutely adorable apartment in bucktown. Excellent location, quiet street and wonderfully decorated and squeaky clean apartment. Keith was so helpful and accommodating, and a pleasure to communicate with. Will definitely stay here again when returning to Chicago!
Marty is really welcoming and the house is really clean! Really love this place. Highly recommend!
our second time staying at Julian's place. perfect location, very safe clean and comfy.
It was a convenient place for us to stay and has a great grocery store nearby, place was clean and has a great AC.
Charla was an amazing host, very responsive and kind.
This was a great stay for us. the location was perfect, and the apartment provided what we needed. Take note that 3rd floor is really 4th since you start on G and walk up to 1, 2, and then 3.

Solid place to stay, great communication with the host and was very hospitable. Close by some stores, restaurants and easy to catch a ride with uber. Front desk was helpful and allowed us to store bags before check in. Only thing was it was a bit hot at night but that could be user error with the thermostat.
Would recommend for an easy stay.

We had such a great stay here! Beautiful place with everything we needed and even more stunning and spacious than the photos show. The location is perfect and we could walk to a lot of the touristy stuff we wanted to do. We ran into our hosts a few times and they were very kind and helpful and gave us local recommendations. The music downstairs is loud on the weekends but they were upfront about that so we packed earplugs and it was fine. It also quiets down at a reasonable hour. We had such a great time in Chicago and would definitely stay here again next time we’re in the city!

Had a great time in Chicago. The place was in a great location. a 20 min walk to Wrigley. Neighborhood was quiet and nice even just to walk around and enjoy the weather. Lots nearby. Easy to get around without a car. Redline transit was nearby and I was able to take it all the way south to check out China town and see a White Sox game. the place had everything I could ever think to need. It was a very comfortable stay and would recommend it.

Very nice apartment, clean and comfortable with a very open feeling.  A coffee shop and a grocery store within a block and several restaurants within 10-15 minutes walking. One block to the metro train which was very easy to use to get around town.  We enjoyed our stay here.

hello,
we enjoyed our stay with Ryan. the house was big and accessible.

We booked this place because it was the right size for our family (3 bedrooms) and in the specific neighborhood we needed. I liked that it also had a full kitchen, a tub in the shower, and a good sized living room with a dining table. They provided a pack and play for our baby which was very helpful, although logically there should be a high chair too (made meals very tricky for a wiggly baby without one). Claire was super responsive when I reached out and she sent clear instructions proactively.
Place was lovely, looks just like the photos. Yolanda was very accommodating!

We had a nice stay! The place was very clean and comfortable!
Joan responded to me quickly.

perfect access to southport corridor and several great neighborhoods.  easy walking community and access to train from both southport or Belmont train to the loop. close to whole foods,  jewel osco. the best feature was beautiful patio area,  highly recommend.

Visited Chicago with my family over a long weekend, if we were to come back we'd definitely see if Jihad's place is available. It is a great location for relaxed weekend, lots of food options and shops to browse. Jihad did a great job with the apartment, it was spacious, clean and all appliances brand new. 2 different coffee machine and generous with grounds. Gave us good quality sheets and towels too. Easy and free to park on the street behind and to get an Uber if needed to go downtown.

great location close to the red line and the beach and with plenty of restaurants in the area. checkin was easy, the room was clean and the Wi-Fi is good. price is reasonable but room is very basic and facilities are shared. downside is the room doors have plenty of gaps and depending on your room you are basically in the public kitchen.
Great location and super nice place!  Will stay here again.

Great spot close to transportation, easy to access. Other guests were noisy and didn’t clean up after themselves but the airbnb room was clean. Super nice hosts very sweet. Just be aware that if you add a guest is an additional $100 which I wasn’t aware of! Bed was comfy.
Excellent stay at this place. Host was very kind and hospitable. Had a great time in Chicago!

The host was very accommodating and responsive to every question that came up during our stay. The unit was very clean and adequate for what we needed. Lovely area with many restaurants and stores. Would definitely rent again if the opportunity presented itself. Thanks
Clean place with quite neighborhood. Geo was responsive and friendly.
We had a great time! The apartment is clean and centrally located
Very happy with the place. Jorge was friendly and responsive. Would def recommend!

Clean, comfortable home for a family with two kids. The full kitchen was neglected with so many delicious places to eat. Easy parking and street is quiet. Right next to 606 for a relaxing stroll too. Appreciate the peace of mind from a responsive host.
Very nice neighborhood. Apartment was clean and comfortable.
Very quick to respond!!

Stayed here with some family. The place was as described and the location felt very safe and easy to walk. Traffic in the area was a bit heavy, but it was like that everywhere we went in Chicago (holiday weekend).

The location and free parking were definite positives, and the kitchen and bathrooms appeared clean upon arrival. However, the property was not in the condition we expected based on the listing. Throughout the home there were stained carpets, marked-up walls and doors, peeling paint, and other visible signs of wear and disrepair.
Several maintenance and safety concerns also impacted our stay. The bunk beds felt very unstable, the back door in the bunk room did not feel secure, and two bedroom lights were not working. We also reported an issue with a fire detector and did not receive follow-up, which was concerning.
Overall, the location was convenient, but the condition of the property and unresolved maintenance concerns made the experience less comfortable than expected. With better upkeep and more responsive attention to guest concerns, this could be a much better rental.

Jane and Francisco were excellent. Every question was answered promptly and thoroughly. They were extremely helpful, very accommodating. The space was exactly as pictured. It was quiet and very close to public transportation, as described. 10/10

This stay was everything we were wanting for our first visit to Chicago! The home is lovely inside and out, and we came with a car so the garage parking was an absolute must for us. Everything was comfortable and very clean. The neighborhood is quiet and we were able to walk to a lot of outstanding restaurants and coffee shops, and there's a nice big park right down the street as well. Ryan's communication was great from start to finish and we couldn't have asked for anything more! We would definitely book again and highly recommend.

Description was accurate, location was great, and although it’s farther from halstead than other places I’ve stayed, Ubers are easy and you can walk the area day and night (or at least we were comfortable with that). Some comments referenced the noise but that wasn’t a problem for us. It’s a city so you’re going to hear emergency vehicles etc anywhere. The street this is on wasn’t super busy when we were there, but it is a couple of blocks up from a busy intersection. Bonus for location: there’s a big Whole Foods at that intersection. It’s an old building but that’s expected in the area, too. Would stay again.

Jay’s place was just what we needed for our long weekend in Chicago and one of the best Airbnbs we’ve stayed in. The place is spacious, clean and has all the amenities present and correct. Jay was very communicative and answered all our queries quickly. The location is great too, in a cool neighbourhood with lots of restaurants and easy transit access. Couldn’t recommend this place more.
Perfect stay definitely will be back

This is a very comfortable apartment in a perfect location for us, but also really great for getting around Chicago.  The apartment is pleasant and makes it easy to relax and enjoy your stay.  The bed is very comfortable and the apartment is quiet.  The neighborhood is lovely.  Kathleen is a thoughtful host and we found the apartment had everything we needed.

My friend and I came for a festival and stayed in the green room. Our room did have a lock which was nice but at no point did I feel worried about our belongings. All the other guests were so nice and Ryan was very welcoming. The house is so beautiful and it is exactly as described. We did have some issues with the shower being turned off for a few hours and our power went out in our room for a bit, however Ryan was quick to resolve those problems! The neighborhood wasn’t what I pictured, but I did not feel unsafe. It seemed like a close knitted community with people outside at all hours of the day/night. Everyone we did run into around there were super nice- there were no issues there. Ryan was a great host and helped me with booking another room for an additional night when I lost my car keys on the trip. He also was nice enough to let me leave my car there and come back for it luckily that didn’t happen but he was so understanding. I would stay here again!
Loved the space. Had everything we needed. Chinatown was so close which was a plus! :)

Clean, efficiently designed apartment with everything you need.
The photos are accurate and the check-in and check out were easy.
We arrived earlier than expected and our hosts were there with the key to let us in.
The home was nice, spacious and updated. Seemed like it was recently renovated. Not many dishes, towels etc
Dave was attentive and responded very quick to any questions I had regarding the stay. Overall the place was nice and clean !

Our stay was wonderful! The host was very responsive to any messages that I sent, and any and all posted/shared instructions were very clear. The unit is perfectly located with lots of great restaurants, bars and shops nearby.

Paul’s apartment was beautiful, spacious and everything we needed for a friend’s weekend in Chicago! Located centrally in a wonderful neighborhood, it was extremely walkable and close to public transportation. Communication from Paul was clear and made the entire experience so much better! Looking forward to staying there again!

Beautiful and spacious home fit for up to 8 people. We had a party of 5 and we didn’t feel crowded whatsoever. The four bathrooms were the cherry on top for us
We faced some parking issues but the hosts were kind enough to assist where they could and it was figured out. Location is perfect. We scootered downtown to get the full city experience without having to worry about moving cars and parking. Definitely recommend if this is an alternative for you.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and it was great being so close to everything.
Amazing facilities and plenty of privacy. Stephen was very kind and responsive!

We enjoyed our time at Jay’s place. He was a very attentive and responsive host. We did struggle a bit getting our heavy suitcases up the  fairly steep front stairs outside, then down another set of steep stairs inside, but Jay kindly left us a key to a back entrance with fewer stairs, so we were able to use those for the remainder of our visit. The back bedroom was never truly dark due to outdoor lights from the neighbors’ patio, which remained on all night. As a whole, though, the apartment was quiet, clean, and comfortable and suited our needs for a five night stay.

We had a great time. besides no railings on the stairs and low water pressure in a couple showers, and the parking being a little tight. over all pretty solid location aswell. Close to most things and farthest drives are only about 25.
super responsive and attentive hosts. sometimes hosts  were able to answer the texts Right away or within minutes. we would definitely come back again and thank you so much for your hospitality
Perfect location, quiet, parking spot was a bonus. Really well done kitchen. Was a great trip!
Really great stay. Well designed and comfortable. Great neighborhood and close to everything you’d need. Highly recommend!

Our hosts were great and extremely responsive. The airbnb is near UoC and walking distance from a great cafe and a bunch of food spots. Transportation is easily accessible. The airbnb also has a nice garden where you can relax. Overall, wonderful place to stay at!
Overall, it was a great experience.
Marco is an amazing host. He’s taken the time to update the place to modern times. If you’re a family or a group of friends. This place is perfect!!!!!

I loved this hotel! It was incredible. The receptionists and the greeters were all so helpful and welcoming. When we checked in, they did not have the double queen rooms available as they were overbooked. We talked through the options and they actually upgraded one of our rooms to a king suite at no charge. Everyone was so welcoming with our dog too.
The area is fantastic. It’s within walking distance to many nice restaurants and the subway. Overall I would stay here again!!

They were very communicative and accommodating to my stay. Instructions were clear to follow and room was perfect for 1-3 guests! Didn’t stay long but definitely would have because the space is very affordable for what is provided!
Gary was a great host. Very helpful and responsive. The place was perfect for a long weekend.
First time visiting Chicago, great location everything was only a few mins away. Quiet area at night. Would stay here again.

We had a wonderful time staying in Shay’s home. It’s beautiful, warm, and truly felt like a home away from home. Everything was peaceful, comfortable, and so relaxing. We really enjoyed our stay and appreciated all the thoughtful touches. 100% recommended.
Wonderful stay! Thanks so much!

Amy’s place was walkable to our DePaul University Theater events we attended plus many restaurants. We liked the college vibe yet didn’t hear loud partying at nights. The local Trader Joes was surprisingly reasonably priced for picking up supplies.

Dennis' apartment was lovely. It was exactly as described, near our reason for travel, walkable, close to the Paulina Brown line stop, and street parking was a breeze. His puppy Sadie was really cute when we met her upon check out as well ☺️

The apartment was decent. The way you enter the building was a little unorthodox but quiet. We didnt have wifi for a day and a half so it was quite boring and couldnt relax which was the purpose of the trip. I would stay here again host was pleasant.

The property was good and well located. Spacious enough with good amenities. Only downside was that there were dead mosquitos and spiders. Also, hot water was limited and the drain in one of the washrooms was clogged.
Had a great time in Chicago! Very clean and cute home. Enjoyed our stay! Yolanda was very responsive and welcoming. Thank you Yolanda for allowing us to stay in your place!

The place is located in a cozy and very quiet neighborhood, which made the stay peaceful and relaxing. Overall, it was definitely worth the money, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a calm and affordable place to stay.
We LOVE IT!!!! A great option if you are in the neighborhood!!!
Éloigné de la ville sans pour autant être très loin, tout le nécessaire aux alentours. Hôtes très réactif avec de bonne adresses à partager

Very cute place and responsive host! We had an early arrival and late departure and Marta was happy to let us keep our luggage outside of the standard check in/out times. The place is very cozy and was a great place to stay during our trip to Chicago.

Place is just like pictures and neighborhood was super cute, had an easy time parking. My only note is what others have mentioned about the stairs being a bit crazy, but got used to them.  Great for a quick stay with 1-2 people!
This is our 4th time staying here for our annual cubs game trip! It’s the perfect place to stay and so close to the stadium. The place is always clean and accommodating. We will be back again!
Good place to stay. Responsive host.
Place was nice and perfect for the weekend. Christopher was responsive and friendly! Would definitely recommend!
Great location for our stay. Attractive and clean space, just like photos. Parking space is a big plus. Host was very responsive and friendly
Joanna was very helpful and the airbnb was perfect. I would stay again!
Great place to stay! Place was very clean and hosts were super responsive whenever I had questions.
J’s place was exactly as advertised! Very tidy and communicative host!

First time in Chicago and I don’t think I want to stay anywhere else when I come back. Beautiful location. Supermarket and stores were easy to walk to. Short uber ride to downtown. The apartment was beautiful and clean . My favorite part was the rooftop to enjoy the air. I loved it and thank you for making my first trip to Chicago comfortable. You’ll be hearing from me again!
Good stay for the weekend

Jody’s place was perfect! Everything was described and more, she even let us check in a bit earlier since we got in and the space was ready. One of the best airbnb experiences I’ve had, absolutely wonderful
Angie was very responsive and friendly. Would stay again.

Patricia was a great host, and her apartment was perfect for us. Location was terrific, close to train, good local coffee and restaurants along with a CVS and Target. Apartment was clean and cozy. We will choose the apartment again in the future.
Jun was an amazing host. Very responsive and communicative. Place was clean and accommodating. Would definitely book again when I’m in town.

Such an amazing place not to expensive for my 4 nights I stayed. Sleep like a baby in the bed. Had everything you need in the kitchen. Big great bathroom didn’t have no problem at all. I would book again if I ever visit Chicago again.

Overall good. It’s 3 floors with the bedrooms on the top 2 floors. One rooftop off of the kitchen and one on the top by the bedroom with bunk beds. Host was responsive which was good, and good location and good stay. I wish some things were better (like we had to ask for some normal toiletries they didn’t provide initially, tray in the microwave doesn’t fit the microwave so can’t really use the microwave, bathroom was out of order, and a few other things). Was still fun and I’m glad we stayed here, but the Airbnb could be better (still totally doable!!).
Satisfied with our stay, host was always responsive! 10/10 would recommend!
The place is exactly as described in the booking. We found it to be extremely clean. We found parking right out front all 3 evenings.
Perfect for Hyde Park stay.  Close to shopping and public transportation.  Comfortable for a family.

Tim was very communicable throughout my stay and very flexible, allowing me to “check” my luggage in the laundry room of his apartment on my check-out day, as I had a flight home late in the day. He was a blessing, and I would absolutely stay here in the future! Highly recommend!!
Great location with free street parking. The apartment is very clean.

What a unique place! From the blue lighting to the multi-spray/rain head shower, the great back deck to the second floor porch.... it was a comfortable, unexpected adventure to stay here! (We sadly didn't have time for the jacuzzi!) It was sparkling clean, and Leslie was a great, responsive host. We had a bunch of family events in Pilsen and Chinatown over our weekend stay and the location was perfect. Street parking was easy! Huge thanks and five stars, Leslie!
Great location, plenty of space!
The place met our needs-great location, enough room-but the pictures are nicer than the flat; and door to apartment building from street doesn’t lock.

My friends and I had such a great time at Bryan’s place. He was able to accommodate an early check-in for us and wow! The place was extremely clean. We could smell the cleaning products as soon as we walked in. There were towels, wash cloths, and toiletries in each bedroom that we all appreciated. I sometimes get the heebie jeebies when staying in Airbnbs and I will bring an extra sheet from home, but I did not feel the need to use it this trip. We truly enjoyed the neighbors and the neighborhood as well. I will say that it is located on the West Side of Chicago, but we felt safe. The Airbnb has a camera on the front porch and there were plenty of locks. The place is a little far away from some parts of downtown, so I would prepare to spend money on Ubers/Lyfts or it may be best to rent a car. I think there is public transportation nearby, but we did not use it.
My friends and I had such a great weekend in Chicago at Bryan’s place and we cannot WAIT to come back!!
Great place, worked out well for what we had going on.  Easy to get to, great place for a cubs game.
Such a lovely spot! Incredible location and a beautiful apartment. Nancy was super responsive, and this was the perfect place to spend a long weekend :) Would certainly stay here again!
Great stay with a great view! Clean and easy to follow directions

Had a wonderful stay at this location, it matched the description and was the perfect home base for a weekend in Chicago. Walter was very helpful with clear instructions and quick responses to messages.
Very friendly hosts & communicates very effectively. Good stay overall

Really loved staying here. It was easy to walk to things and get on public transportation. Ceilings are a bit low in places and stairs are steep, but we personally didn’t find this an issue. Very clean and convenient place.

I stay at a new Airbnb almost weekly and I would put Sean’s in my top 5. Responsive hosts: kind, accommodating, proactive. Beautiful home: every amenity, spacious, beautiful backyard, great neighborhood. It was exactly what we needed for the 2 weeks in Chicago. You’re either a 15 min walk to the train or a short bus ride to the train to take you anywhere. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Awesome stay! Felt safe at all times, clean, and spacious.

Ewa est une personne très agréable, qui donne de bonnes adresses et aussi arrangeante. Nous avons eut beaucoup de plaisir à discuter avec Ewa. Son appartement est très bien situé, très propre et où nous avons put préparer notre petit déjeuner. Vraiment je le recommande!
Josh is a cordial and polite host that was very responsive when contacted. I would love to stay again.

This place was absolutely perfect. We had a large group and it served as a convenient meeting place for getting to Wrigley, beaches, and restaurants. The entertainment and game room was excellent! We will definitely try to stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay. There were plenty of amenities for our toddler including a high chair, pack n play, bathtub with baby soap, utensils, and toys. We loved the location and were able to walk to the zoo. The area was quiet and easily accessible. We would stay again.

“The stay was very pleasant. The place was clean, comfortable, you can take the bus from outside the office, close from China town
Host was responsive within minutes
I would definitely recommend this place
Great place , it is a my go to when I stay in Chicago !
Great place! The location was close to a lot of attractions. Descriptions matched the listing which is always appreciated. Asta and Andrew were responsive and very helpful!
Very clean and great location in a super cute neighborhood. Shanna was very responsive.
This was a great stay no issues. Upstairs neighbors were friendly and gave some recommendations.
Amazing place. Great views. Very clean and secure. Would definitely rent again.

This was a great place for visiting family members to stay, just a few blocks from our home. Very clean and comfortable space, shiny new bathrooms, and great communication with host. Will definitely book again for future family visits.
The view of the city was amazing from this place. The living room area is kind of small, but amazing big rooms and restrooms

Milan was great to work with. He was very responsive and helpful. The location is good and there is aT line 5 minutes around the corner. you do have to take the T or an Uber most everywhere you want to go, but it was easy to do so. Our only issue is the AC was locked out and it was quite warm for sleeping. Milan did get someone in to look at it, but there wasn't any change

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay with Gurunischan and Jose. They are both very kind and helpful during my time there. The apartment is lovely and original, and it's located in a quiet and beautiful area. I highly recommend it.
Great spot great location
Great place to stay! Good location, and Milan was very helpful and responsive throughout our stay!
Had a great stay
Very nice place, very spacious and accommodated us perfectly. Lots of towels available.
Ebony and Ean were super warm and welcoming!
Excellent host and a very nice place. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Safe and quiet neighborhood! Great for my family and infant to stay the weekend in Chicago. Everything was clean and communication was instant and easy. Walkable to many wonderful shops and restaurants!
Enjoyed my stay.. slept comfortably. It was actually in my old neighborhood that was very convenient for my purpose.

We enjoyed our stay in Mo & Ganna’s apartment, the walk to the train and nearby activities + its distance to the Cub’s Stadium made it a perfect place to be but just outside of the craziness of game days made it peaceful and a great place to come to end the day at.
House was very clean and comfortable, several amenities available and in nice neighborhood surrounded by things to do! Host was very friendly, helpful, and fast to respond

Coty was an amazing host. He was very responsive and helpful. He was easy to reach too if/when we needed something. The house was very cozy and the neighborhood was amazing and felt safe. My only concern was that the shower didn’t drain very well and the handle on the toilet kept getting stuck. These were all very minor in regard to the impact of our stay though. The place was very nice otherwise and we were always happy to come back to it after a long day in the city.
The place was very nice and cozy ! It was in a nice neighborhood with easy parking ( a big win in Chicago)

Only drawback is that it has minimal natural light. If you want a place with windows, this is not the place for you.
On the plus side: great location, very clean and an excellent host. Felt very safe.

We always loving coming back to Anne’s, it really feels like a home away from home. It’s quiet and away from the noise of the city, but so close to Andersonville, one of our favorite neighborhoods, and a quick drive to downtown. You couldn’t ask for better!

This is an absolutely beautiful apartment in a beautiful neighborhood in Chicago. There is a park right across the street and a great coffee shop and restaurants within walking distance. Parking is on the street, but we never had a problem finding a spot right in front of the building. The apartment is bright and the decorations are gorgeous. There are three nice sized bedrooms with plenty of closet and drawer space and very comfortable mattresses. The full kitchen makes preparing food at home, easy and we truly appreciated the spice rack! We stayed here while we were visiting family in Chicago and the lack of stairs made this a great choice for my 88-year-old father. The apartment is close to the L, although we didn't use that, and the freeway entrance is also easily accessible. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would be delighted to return here.

Great spot for a visit to Chicago and especially Wrigleyville.
Overall, we really enjoyed it. It was enough space for 2 couples to comfortably hang before exploring the walkable surroundings. We especially loved how conveniently located the place was - just a couple mins from Wrigley.
A couple other reviews call out the train proximity… and it is a bit startling when you check in and hear it come by the first time, but it didn’t bother us at all. Not loud enough to disturb our sleep, anyway.

I would stay here again. The host was very responsive and even allowed us to check in a few hours early. The home is centrally located. There are 2 train lines within walking distance. The area is very walkable with many stores and restaurants close by.

Great place to stay, it is very close to several and very good restaurants. The apartment is beautiful and cozy. The location is great, it is relatively close to everything that you might want to do in Chicago. Would definitely come again.
Very welcoming Stay, very Clean, and if we had questions regarding the place she would answer almost immediately! Very satisfied
Great stay.  There are a lot of stairs to the apartment. It wasn’t a problem for our group but it might be for some.

Pros : centrally located, good restaurants nearby, easy and quick to reach downtown, the parking garage in the back was great to park over night - always found a spot, 3 bed rooms is a good addition if traveling with a kid which is what we did.
Cons: place can use some upgrade, the back room is too lit from the parking garage flood lights, the front room shades don’t close fully so there is light in the front room too, the front room window doesn’t close - because of which there is sound from the busy street right in the house, ended up getting ear plugs, the bedding was a bit polyester resulting in sweaty kid, small modifications can fix these issues which I hope gets taken care of.
This is a fair review given our experience and have requested the host and Airbnb for a small refund given the small inconvenience. Overall good place and slight maintenance can make this a great place.
Perfect place in Old Town Chicago. Sean is a great host and you will find lots to do nearby. Recommend!

We had a wonderful long weekend stay at Anne's place.  The duplex looks just like the photos and was spacious, comfortable, and very clean. The kitchen is well stocked as is the entire apartment. The location is great - walking distance to so many restaurants and cafes. The blue CTA line is just a few minutes walk away and allows you to easily reach downtown Chicago as well as the airport.  Anne was a very responsive and friendly host.  We highly recommend staying here if you are visiting Chicago!

This spot was tastefully decorated and well appointed. David and his team were helpful and responsive. Check in and out were easy. Street parking was hard to find, but we took advantage of a nearby Spot Hero. The apartment is garden level, which can feel a bit dodgy in a city, but the location is tucked away off a residential street. It felt quite safe and homey. Ravenswood and Andersonville are fun neighborhoods with lots to explore. It was very clean and comfortable. Thanks for a great weekend!
A cozy and comfortable apartment in a perfect locations surrounded by restaurants and shops. Charles was quite communicative and helpful throughout the trip

This place can be kind of intimidating to stay at once you start reading but the host has spent a lot of time describing the house and location so that guests know exactly what they're renting. Lots of rules to follow but if you just read and are polite everything will be great. The apartment was exactly as described and very clean and was one of the cheapest options I could find for the size.

We had a great stay at this Airbnb in Chicago. The place was very clean and well-maintained, and each room had its own closet, which made it easy to stay organized during our trip. The host was easy to communicate with and very accommodating throughout our stay. We also appreciated having a comfortable living room, along with convenient amenities like the washer and dryer, full kitchen, and refrigerator. Overall, it was a comfortable and convenient place to stay, and we would definitely book again!
My family from Seattle really enjoyed the stay. Very clean, modern and aesthetic!
A very convenient spot on a quiet tree lined street!
such a great experience, will definitely be coming back!
Would definitely recommend!
Great space and location!
nice private spot
We had a great time! The host(s) were super responsive, helpful, and very kind!

I can't say enough about how perfect our rental was. The home was spotless, well equipped and the beds were very comfortable. Wilma had blankets, pillow options, coffee options. Everything we needed for a mother-son getaway. We especially loved playing games in the quiet backyard.
We're definitely coming back! Thank you, Wilma! God bless.

Great little place tucked away in the heart of Wicker Park. Perfect location to get pretty much anywhere in the city by foot or by cta. Parking was a bit of a pain, but nothing unusual for Chicago. There's only one window, but you get a surprising amount of light coming in during the day. All in all, I enjoyed my stay, and Trish was very responsive and accommodating.
Everything was great! This is my second time using their airbnbs and both were great!!!
Very cute place! iIt was great for our girls' weekend.

I would definitely stay here again, and for a longer term visit. Feels very homey and comfortable. Very much like an American hostel. Social environment to meet other guests. Well stocked kitchen. 4 minute walk to Aldi was my favorite perk - if I stayed longer, that would be so essential!!! Bed was comfortable. Area can get quite loud at night but I didn’t mind and that’s not in the hosts control. Room was spotless. House was as clean as it could be with guests staying there long term, no complaints. Shower pressure was good and host was responsive and friendly with any messages I sent. The house is RIGHT on a bus stop too, about 12 minutes from the pink line, so very convenient location. As a solo female traveler I never felt unsafe here. Great stay!
Vince was very responsive. My friends and I had a great time in Chicago, easily accommodated 8 people. Spacious and the beds were very comfortable. We were very happy with our stay.
Sarah’s place was perfect for our quick weekend trip. She was responsive and friendly, and went out of her way to be extra accommodating. Would stay here again.
Good location and the property matched the photos.  Easy check in
We had a great time - would come back!
Had a great stay at Billy’s place - wonderful spacious apartment, nice location, and very friendly and welcoming. Would recommend!
Great!
Location was great and easy to get around the city.

The place is a bit run down if they did an upgrade to it, it would definitely be nice. It looks a little sketchy at night but we didn’t have no issues. They do have security at the door at night & nobody can access the door unless you know the code. Other than that this place needs new cleaners they did not do a good job at cleaning. It was dirty. They also had some roaches in the building & in our Airbnb. I think overall this place needs to be cleaned & it would definitely be 5 star Airbnb. Lastly, I wish they would’ve full body mirrors in the rooms so you can see the fits. Overall it was a great stay just needs some upgrades & this place could be amazing.
Perfect setting for our large family gathering.  Great location and very walkable.
Appreciated staying here for an event at Burning Bush Brewery. A quiet neighborhood, loved the park for morning walks!
Had a great time with my stay! Hosts were super fun to talk to and gave us plenty of space over the course of our stay.

Audrone’s home was beautiful. She reached out in advance to provide us updates. Her place was super nice and was glad to have chosen it for being a first time Chicago visitor. Would definitely come back to stay again.
Very nice amenities, close to transit, very helpful host, easy check in, reasonable guidelines and rules, overall a wonderful experience
The location is wonderful!  Beautiful street.  Keith communicated great & it was a beautiful place.  Comfy beds😊

This place was perfect for a weekend getaway. Every detail felt thoughtfully curated, from the beautiful decor to the welcome basket and handwritten note waiting for us at check-in. The high-quality appliances and linens made the space feel especially cozy and inviting, much more like a home than a typical rental. The host was also incredibly accommodating, responsive, and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.
Unit was as described and functioned very well. Jackie is an excellent host.

Rasheed's place was perfect. We were in town for an event at Northwestern, and wanted to make the best use of a "middle" location to Chicago. His place, nailed it. Easy parking, clear directions, VERY clean - great beds. Loved being in a neighborhood, but so close to so many things. I would 100% stay here again, when I am back in Chicago.
Great location! Great space to exist! Would stay again!

One of the best stays we have ever had. Gorgeous penthouse apartment with amazing views and huge balcony. Great location with so many great sites within a comfortable walking distance. Bathrooms and closests were large and spotless. Bedrooms had comfortable beds and were nicely appointed. The whole unit had everything we needed to feel comfortable. Such an awesome place to be for a short vacation/long weekend for our family of 4.

We love this cute little quaint Airbnb! It was very close to everything and we were able to eat at a lot of the local restaurants down the street on Southport. There’s plenty of shopping as well.
