I do warn that if you have dogs that don’t do well with stairs or you do have a disability the stairs are very steep and can be hard to navigate in the front and in the back of the building.
If you do check out any of the food places, make sure you check out the little Italian place on the corner, which has all of their ingredients flown in fresh from Italy and made in house daily, which I highly recommend!! We loved our stay there and Diane was absolutely wonderful and very responsive. We never had any issues with parking in front of the building for our large vehicle.
We will definitely be back again thank you so much!!

The place of Juanita felt like home to me for five days. The room matches the description and the price is reasonable. When I needed something, Juanita was kind and supportive.
Very clean and spacious.
Great place. Super simple and easy to hop on public transit to get into the city.
This is a great space for a group trip to Chicago!

Rajeev's apartment was spacious, beautifully furnished, and extremely convenient to stores, pubs, and the el station. Lois and Eduardo were kind, communicative hosts! They made us feel right at home. The room was clean and cozy, and was a great place to land after our Chicago adventures.
Great place
Sean was very helpful and the space was beautiful. We had 5 adults and one toddler and we loved how cozy and homey it all felt. Will stay here again when we come back to Chicago!
home perfectly fit our needs. Host was proactive in providing all we needed. Made our Chicago trip stress free and allowed us to focus on all we wanted!

Great home ! Made me and my sister be close to downtown Chicago !

Angie was a very responsive host who clearly cared about us having a good stay. The space was cleaned well, had everything we needed for 5 people staying a whole weekend, and the kitchen was equipped well.
We had a lovely stay at Judy’s place. It was clean, quiet and very close to the metro station. I can’t stop thinking about the bed! One of the comfiest beds EVER. Would definitely stay here again :)
Stayed 4 days with friends, all from out of town. Amenities were great and well described. Would highly recommend the location especially for those wanting to explore northern Chicago.

We enjoyed our stay at Saurin’s rental. It was a very spacious master bedroom with a luxurious private bath. Additionally, we drove and easily found nearby street parking and left our car untouched for 3 days with no issues - Saurin was great at communicating our parking options well in advance of our reservation. Saurin also provided great recommendations on sights to see and restaurants to try. I highly recommend staying at this rental if you’re visiting Chicago.
Tara’s place was the perfect spot for going to the Cubs game. My family and I really enjoyed the apartment
Great host! Love the place and very peaceful and friendly as well. When we needed helping locking the door he came and helped us right away!
Clean, spacious, and extremely easy to find in such a busy city. Instructions were clear and simple. It’s also very secure and the parking ramp was so convenient. 10/10

We all enjoyed our stay here. We had a crew of 9 in total and it was a great place for all of us to stay together. Great stay, keep in mind that it’s in a resident building so Hubbard vets potential Airbnb guests a little through security measures. I enjoyed my time, had enough space for me and my guests. Wished the mattresses were softer.

The floors getting to the place were deceiving - made you feel dirty & maintenance.

I didn’t feel the neighborhood was as safe as I thought. My fault for not researching.
We ate brunch at brûlée next store. Delicious.
My recommendation would be to rent the electric bikes or scooters to get around town. Easy and drivers are considerate of bikers.

We truly enjoyed our stay here in Chicago at the Felixa home! The home was very clean, well-kept, and comfortable. On occasion some units are complicated or otherwise difficult to get into. If that happens at night after a long day of travel it can be very frustrating. This was certainly not the case here! Jasmine provided precise instructions with photographs. There were also some koerig coffee capsules provided which meant we didn’t have to make a late night grocery run.

Nice place for large groups, it says quiet hours start at 10pm, but area is very loud, also upstairs neighbors had kids running around after 10. We didn't really mind bcs noise doesn't really bother our group but it could future guest.  Other then that it was overall a good stay and very quick to respond all our questions.

nice place, easily able to find a parking spot. Its near the L, train sound isn't too loud, we all slept fine. Plenty of space to hang out and plenty of rooms.
would stay again.

Our family of 6 enjoyed our time in Chicago at Aly’s place. It was clean and beds comfortable, Aly was a great host! We’ll be back!

Wonderful place to stay! Clean and exactly as described. Close to restaurants and shops. Parking was easy. Well appointed with everything you need. Nice patio area to sit and enjoy, peaceful after the hustle and bustle of downtown Chicago. Highly recommend and would definitely stay there again.

The unit was as described. The designated parking space is in a lot used as a public pay lot so there was a lot of traffic in the lot and the spot was not available. Our car was boxed in at one point. Would not recommend if you will be using parking lot.
Muy hermoso y limpio todo, la ubicación está perfecta y tiene un estacionamiento justo al lado y está muy cerca del Down town

I and my family were happy to stay there.  There was plenty of space in the condo/apt.  The place may have been a little dated in appearance, but with parking arrangements being taken care of, the numerous neighborhood restaurants and stores and a nearby park, the place was good place to stay at I would recommend it for those looking to house larger groups (5-10 people).
Ledy was very flexible. We had elderly people visiting and she was willing to work with us to make it easy for them.

The Airbnb was a perfect location for our group of 6. It was a close walk to parks/playgrounds for children. We had many restaurants to choose from that were walking distance. It was also close to the L for us to hop onto the train and visit Chicago sites. Steph and Randy were very accomodating for an early check in which we so appreciated. The apartment itself was pretty standard - it had all of the necessities. There were some loud upstairs neighbors at night, which was not a fault of the Airbnb itself but just something to consider if you need quiet sleeping conditions. Thanks so much for sharing your home, Steph and Randy.

Cleaner and easier to get to than expected! The skylights were wonderful. There is only AC in the bedrooms and they are window units. The parking was a bit tricky since there isn’t a designated spot, just street parking. If you’re a light sleeper you might not like the noise that comes through from the street below. However, the hum of the ac unit blocks most of it out and the host does provide you with earplugs. They worked great and kept us cool in the evenings. Host provided a packnplay for our daughter and was very responsive. Over all it’s a great place to stay and I would recommend to a friend. I LOVED that there weren’t any check out instructions like stripping the bed or anything like that. Makes it life so much easier at check out.

I was not a fan of shared space. I was in Chicago for an event. I really needed an iron and washer and dryer. Location did not have one and I was told to drive to a laundromat. Nevertheless, clean, quiet space and location.
great communication. nice place on a quiet street. beautiful view!
Sharon is a fantastic host who went above and beyond to accommodate my group. I could not have asked for a better place to stay in Chicago!
Loved our stay here! Beautiful, clean home in a quiet neighborhood. The host was super helpful and kind. Would stay here again in a heartbeat!
Lovely place. A find.

Very nice area, safe and residential. Owners are in residence (they kindly loaned me an umbrella, and showed me where the clothes washer and dryer was). The bathroom is shared, which is just a detail with some AirBnB listings, but here I think you’ll find you will need to wait to use it at times.

The property is in a great location with lots of walkable shopping and eating options.  The building new; it is secure, has very nice gym, outdoor spaces and other amenities. This should be a 5-Star review, but for one issue:  There was a persistent pot smell throughout the apartment when we checked in which persisted throughout our stay.  We didn’t love that.  If the apartment gets properly aerated to remove the pot smell, we have no doubt that it will earn 5-Star ratings.
Host was very responsive. This Airbnb exceeded my expectations.
Place was fine and easy to get in to and easy to stay.

My family and I came for my son’s wedding and Rich made our trip one to remember. He was so flexible with us. He also was very responsive. Absolutely super cozy! They were super accommodating with our flights arriving early in the day. Super close to the metro. Very convenient to get to downtown quick. Definitely saving this place for the next Chicago visit.

Great place in a central location in Wicker Park.

Really enjoyed my stay. Collette and her team made sure that everything was well prepared and accommodated an emergency maintenance request over the weekend in between their own personal plans. My friend and I stood there for the weekend.very nice place , peaceful and very clean . Joseph was very friendly and responsive. I will gladly recommend it.
Had a great time staying at Aysins place. It was very clean, comfortable, quiet, and loved having access to a garage with free parking. Would totally recommend this place!

Amazing! Truly a beautiful space. Very open! The craftsmanship of all the modern updates was done so well.

We were two couples, a baby and a single friend who stayed on the pull out sofa. The sliding doors made it great to give him some privacy still and he said the pull out sofa was very comfortable.
Book this place! I’ve already sent the listing to friends.

The house was perfect for our stay in Chicago with friends.  The house was spacious, beds were comfortable and it was a great location.  The movie room was a big hit with the kids.  Would stay here again!
Perfect stay, great communication, and check out was just taking the garbage out and not a 19-page manual on how to clean the entire house. We'll stay there every time I'm in Chicago.

The reason I wouldn’t give this a full 5-star review is bc one of the closets had a balled-up air mattress on the floor. There were stains on some of the light switches and walls. Chairs were missing bottom supports, making it uneven, it caused someone to fall out of the chair. There were no full-length mirrors. We noticed a few bugs. The couches had crumbs in them and could have been cleaned better. We understand and respect the rules about maintaining the property and honoring quiet hours. However, the rule about not allowing guests to visit felt a bit strict, especially since another unit was having a loud house party until 4 AM on our first night. It didn’t bother us, but it made the policy feel inconsistent considering we were not planning to host a party. Other than those concerns it was still a great stay overall, we definitely got a workout in from all the stairs.

We had a wonderful stay! The place was cozy, peaceful, and very comfortable. It was the perfect spot to rest, with no noise and a relaxing atmosphere. The attention and hospitality were excellent, and the location was great. We truly enjoyed our stay and would gladly come back. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
great spot in West Loop. Safe, and great views of the city. Wonderful amenities!

I went here with some friends for Sueños festival and it was nearby and easy to check in. The host was responsive and very friendly I would definitely recommend this place and I would definitely book again 👍🏻👍🏻

I have nothing but good to say. Host was responsive even for my 1 am questions. Looks like pictures. In a good part of town. Garage was big enough for my Palisade SUV. I would definitely stay here again.

Slightly noisy in the morning but nothing to crazy.

Our stay was amazing. The house is gorgeous, the roof deck is awesome and the view is beautiful. The house has everything you need and the snacks were an unexpected and fun bonus. Alex was a great host and super accommodating. We would definitely go back again. Thank you Alex!
Awesome place! Highly recommend
Good location with a bus stop right outside the building, comfortable to host 6 people (3 couples).

This place was just what we needed. Quiet, but in a nice central location. Just as described.
Initially I was concerned about the 3rd party verification required for this booking, but it didn’t ask for too much information and I haven’t had problems with it.
Generally David was attentive but not invasive, and communicated quickly and professionally throughout the process.
Raymond and Marlo’s place was great! The Garden Suite is very spacious and all the amenities were fantastic. Quick walk over to the Blue Line. Thanks for being great hosts!

Thank you to our host.
We highly recommend this affordable location if visiting Wrigley Field and Wrigleyville. Easy to access, very clean, all that you need for a stay in Chicago. Access to a kitchen and common seating area just outside the room door. Refrigerator in the room. Private Full Bathroom inside room. Immediate communication response greatly appreciated.
Easy access to the train/subway. Lots of restaurants available. Located among beautiful homes one block from Wrigley Field, yet very quiet. No need to go anywhere else.
Highly recommend for your next visit to Chicago.
Overall really pleasant stay. The space is huge and well appointed. Incredibly convenient to everything in the West Loop and short Uber downtown.

Very pleasant stay. Johnie is a very responsive host and was flexible with an earlier check in. Ample room for a party of 6 and kitchen with lots of amenities. Surrounding area with lots of grocery stores and restaurants.
Place is like describe.
Amazing, cozy stay! Very homey and private and in a great location. John is a great host, very friendly and provided great hospitality and recommendations.

John and Emily were great hosts! The unit was very clean, comfortable, and perfect for our needs. We especially enjoyed the back porch, which was such a relaxing space to unwind. Their 3 chickens added such a fun and unique touch — it gave the home a peaceful charm that made it feel like you were far away from the busy metropolitan area. We truly enjoyed our stay and would gladly return!
Absolutely loved it! Super convenient location for our group attending a music festival just up the road! Responds almost immediately.
Buen alojamiento, fácil para llegar,cerca de tiendas, farmacia, restaurantes y paradas del bus para poder moverte al downton

This was our second time staying at Heather & Rick's beautiful home! It has been a perfect location for our family of 5 to all meet up, from various locations and enjoy quality time!  The kitchen is beautiful, and so fun to cook in as well as a large, gathering space to hang out together, with a large diningroom table positioned in front of a large set of gorgeous windows, and a cozy view/feel of the local neighborhood. There are unique, amenities offered here, that I have not had elsewhere. (*See the listing!) Although we are meeting for special events, and things to do in Chicago, we equally value just having "down time" in this home. It is well-beyond a place to sleep at night. Heather's instructions are clear, and I appreciate getting local information before our trip to apprise us of the local environment, grocery stores, entertainment, driving/walking distances, emergency medical information in case needed, and background about the beautiful neighborhood.  We plan on returning!
The apartment was clean and in a great location. Well supplied.  The lock on the apartment door is a little tricky.
The neighborhood was safe, and not super far from the city. It was very spacious and clean. Would stay again.

This isn't the most luxury place but you can't beat the location and price point. The hosts make it feel like a hotel. The bed was clean and was made like a hotel, listing said no TV but to our surprise there was one, and the host allowed me to check in 2 hours early. This place is perfect for couples who are looking to explore the city. Location is walking distance from a lot of stores/restaurants and honestly could not have been more pleased. If there is one thing, you do hear a lot of outside noise especially the CTA train, but that's what makes Chicago beautiful. I slept without any complaints. I will definitely book again, especially knowing it's hosted by incredible people!

We really enjoyed our stay at Geo’s home! He was very responsive, friendly, and made everything easy from check-in to checkout. The place was spacious, clean, and perfect for our group. The location was great for our group. Right in the middle of nightlife with lots to do nearby, and CTA/public transportation was very close.
It is a lively area so there was some noise, but we personally didn’t mind, and Geo thoughtfully provided earplugs just in case. The check-in instructions were very clear and easy to follow.
We also accidentally left something behind after checkout, and Geo was kind enough to help us retrieve it. Definitely recommend staying here if you’re looking for a fun, convenient, and spacious place in a great location!

Airbnb looked better in person than the photos!
Loved on site parking, dishwasher, washer and dryer in unit.
Airbnb was mostly clean, bathroom could’ve been better
Wish TV was in bedroom
Overall lovely home and we felt at home here
Host was friendly, responded quickly and was helpful with directions
We would recommend 10/10 and would stay again
I stayed for a 3 day weekend trip and it was perfect. The only thing is the apartment is like in a basement. It has walkable places to go to.
Short drive to downtown.
I loved this place , I look forward to maybe renting again in the future

Honestly, this is my first time in an abnb and the best experience! Everything about this place is peaceful. I love the kitchen and living room. The beds are soo comfortable, slept like a baby during night hours. The location is also quiet during day and night, very peaceful. Also, the walks to get to the bus stop is not that far, like a 5 min walk. Overall, I would definitely come back to this abnb! 😁

Andreea was so accommodating with us! She worked with us on an early check in and a place to store our luggage after check out! The location was also very close to the blue line which was super convenient. I would 100% stay here again!
Awesome experience! Place was clean, and although the townhome is shared with other guests there were absolutely no issues. Great host and place over all!
The stay was wonderful! Any questions we had, they were always responsive! Very helpful and the space was super clean 💗 thank you for a great stay!!
Outstanding stay, 10/10 would recommend

Hosts were responsive and proactive, although sometimes automated messages requested information already provided. I appreciate that they were flexible with check-in time when our flight was delayed and provided additional information to assist with check-in in advance of our stay. The neighborhood felt peaceful and safe. The space was clean. Instructions were clear. It is clear the hosts have put a lot of thought and effort into the development of the AirBNB.
The floorboards squeak loudly at times and the walls are thin, so it’s easy to hear other guests and tenants. With earplugs, this can be mostly resolved. The bed is not super supportive or comfortable, so if you have back problems it may bother you. The bedroom was hotter than the open common areas, but it was mostly resolved with an open window, fan provided, and temperature sensor relocated to another part of the room.
Overall, the stay was sufficient for our needs and I would consider staying again in a pinch.

This stay wasn’t a good value for us. Checking in was easy and the location is great, but the apartment needs a lot of TLC.
The door doesn’t open or close right and has to be pulled very hard to work. The unit didn’t smell good, there was quite a bit of dust and dirt all around the apartment. The bathrooms specifically were dirty. Stains on the walls, mold/mildew, and rusted out shower heads. Sinks without drain plugs. A lot of bugs can easily crawl in through the main door.
The vent fan in the primary bath doesn’t work, some of the light fixtures are hanging from the ceiling, and just an overall lack of cleanliness was frustrating. They use a dirty rope as a handle on the shower door.
These things can be fixed without spending a lot of money, and I think it really shows when owners don’t take care to do the little things/continue to rent out a place.
Finally, asking your guests to do a lot at checkout, but not providing a clean unit in the first place seems cheap.
Great place to stay , peaceful and quiet
Excellent place to stay in a great area.

We had a great time staying in this studio on the loop. We used the rail and bus to get some places, but were in walking distance to the majority of the places we wanted to see.
The studio was great, and we had plenty of space for 2 people. We had no issues with noise. The train makes a wooshing sound when it goes by, but it never woke me up. The only annoying thing was that the outlets were in weird spots, so we had to charge our phones in the kitchen. A lamp with a charging port or power strip by the bed would be a very convenient addition. I loved the shower, and it got nice and hot.
The area felt safe and was a lot of fun.
Good location, close to park to help get wiggles out of kids, close to a grocery store and liquor store, 12 min walk to the El. Would stay here again.
Terrific Airbnb experience! Wonderfully proactive and responsive hosts, excellent location, great space, clean, comfortable, walkable to everywhere we wanted to be.

Solid place to stay in a good location. Only downside was the shower door wouldn’t stay closed and they said no one could come to fix it. Hopefully it’s fixed now and no one else encounters that issue. Other than that, good place to stay.
This home is very spacious with tall ceilings, quiet neighbors, & and a very chill neighborhood. The home was clean and easy to be in. Would definitely come back!

Place was exactly as described and pictured.  Kitchen amenities were high end (pots, pans, coffee, etc.).  Jennifer was so responsive and very easy to communicate with.  So glad we picked this place and it will definitely be our "go to" place to stay when we visit Chicago!!  It was great for our whole family.  It's also right next to the lake - 1-2 minute walk!! We were too busy to visit the lake this time, but will do so next time.  Highly recommend!!  We'll be back.
The space was great, the host was very kind and communicative. Would recommend for anyone looking for somewhere to stay in Chicago.
Everything was perfect, great comunication with host, great location . Recomand
perfect place for when you’re out all day and just need a small space to sleep for the night!

Wonderful host. The location is great, right by transit and a pleasant walk away from great shopping and restaurants.

We absolutely loved staying at Dede's basement in Chicago and the best part about it is Dede herself. She is such a loving and caring host and keeps her guests comfort as her top priority. Dede knowing that we were travelling with our 8 month old went above and beyond in making special accomodations for us to ensure we were comfortable. We also loved the 2 comfy beds, water cooler, extra amenities and everything else about this property. I would definitely recommend her place in a heartbeat.

Super spacious Airbnb that’s been completely updated very recently. It was very comfortable and in a great, lovely neighborhood. Very close to everything and lots of great restaurants to enjoy.  I had a great day and will surely stay there again.
Great location with a clean, cozy studio apartment. This unit was walking distance to a lot of top tier attractions. Definitely recommend!
Bianca and Jason were extremely welcoming. They live in a bright and vibrating neighborhood and the accommodations were clean and peaceful.
Great stay!

Great apartment right by Logan Square. Brian was an excellent host and let me in upon arrival and made himself available if I needed anything (didn’t need anything). The place was white glove clean. The kitchen was well stocked with any anything needed to cook. Brian had done a great job remodeling the until and maintains it with pride. The neighborhood had a wonderful farmer’s market on Sunday. It’s also centrally located to many parts of the city. Brian also provided a lot of great local recommendations and clear instructions. I always felt safe any time of day in the neighborhood and would stay here again.

A little smaller than expected. Bed was comfy and couch was too. The restroom is very tiny, so if you’re a bigger person and tall, this is not for you. I’m 5’5 and struggled to shower. Location was great and close to Grant park and other places.

It’s walkable to Chinatown so easy food and study spaces! The space is super nice but was a little hard to fit 6 people despite advertising for 6 people. Would not recommend for tall people or recommend bringing an airmattress as one of our party members was unable to fit on any of the beds or couch. On the flip side, if you are sensitive to smells, also would not recommend as the hallways and elevator do strongly smell of weed. Also would not recommend if sensitive to heat. Unsure if it was the weather or the AC but the room temperatures fluctuated so one room was fine but the other was incredibly warm.
Nice place
Very accommodating and responsive!!

Place was very nice. Beds were comfortable, and kitchen and bathroom were nice. There were restaurants, coffee shops, and bars nearby which was nice. We were able to find street parking consistently.
Check-in was a bit awkward because we got there an hour and a half after check-in and the lady told us they had a late check out and she was finishing up cleaning. Communication about that would have been nice, but everything other than that was great!
good host
Great spot for a weekend get away.

We enjoyed our stay. It was peaceful and quiet. The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful as well not a single bad thing I could say about our stay here. It was clean and they even provided a little gift for our stay. Overall I would definitely stay here again if I’m back in Chicago.

Fulton House was a great place for our stay in Chicago. Located in the heart of the vibrant Fulton Market District, it’s within walking distance of many excellent restaurants and bars. You can easily walk or take the L to reach downtown, which made getting around very convenient. Andrew was incredibly friendly and helpful—especially with arranging the parking spot—which made our stay smooth and stress-free.
This was a great place to stay. A peaceful neighborhood and close to where we wanted to visit . Very spacious rooms and kitchen. Would definitely stay here again

Olivia's place was perfect for our group. It was spacious enough for two couples and a toddler. Olivia was also nice enough to let us check in early, which we really appreciated. I think the only thing I'd note is that the tv could maybe use an upgrade, it was rather slow. Other than that, everything else was great.
Beautiful home will definitely recommend it to others visiting Chicago!

Our bachelorette party group had a wonderful time at Alexandra's place for 3 nights. The location is perfect: quiet, but only 3 short blocks from everything on Wells or North Ave. The beds were comfy and the 4 bathrooms were so nice to have for a large group. The kitchen had everything we needed. I would recommend this place to anyone.
Comfy Murphy bed, amazing neighborhood, cool books. Recommend!
At check-in, keys were not in the lockbox for the unit, however, Jorge was responsive and apologized for the inconvenience. Overall comfortable stay!

We had a great girls weekend here!  Plenty of space, great vibe, excellent location with a super easy check in/check out process.   Even when we did have a concern, the host was super responsive to our messages.
stef's place was absolutely perfect. we needed a quite place to be in Chicago for a couple of days and it couldn't have been better. Great location with tons to do.
Great space in a great neighborhood. As advertised, no frills necessary. Didn’t need anything from Mark, but he was communicative throughout and the process was seamless.
Thanks for everything, we so good and nice place !!
Really enjoyed this place. Highly recommend.
Very convenient to Wrigley. Neighborhood was quiet, had great cafes.

This stay was as safe as you could have made it. The home itself was comfortable and reliable the only thing missing was a pair of scissors. We would definitely stay here again our next visit to Chicago. We were very well accommodated and the hosts were very helpful.

It’s a good place to stay but I would’ve never thought the a Airbnb would only let you get one room and there would be other people staying with you just make sure to ask questions before you book it  because it doesn’t say that you would share the place with other people and you don’t get access to the balcony

The stay was amazing, very pleased with everything that Coty’s home offered. The area was an excellent choice for our trip, especially with being walkable distance to our multiple destinations during our stay. Coty definitely is a great help during our stay he was always responsive towards any questions we had.
Great location!

Stunning space with tons of room.  Perfect for an extended family gathering.  The neighborhood is quiet and beautiful.  Hosts were excellent communicators.  Easy, available parking.  Close to shopping, restaurants, Wrigley Field and more.  We had a baby with us and there was a pack and play and high chair available which was a bonus (less to pack and carry!). Overall an excellent place to stay.

Area was very nice and lots of shops near by. The house was itself was just what we needed, we did have problems with the coffee machine not working properly and sometimes the water in the shower would stop but other than that everything was good. There are many stairs to walk up so keep in mind incase that is a struggle. There were multiple locks to get into the house providing a feeling of safety. Host responded quickly when contacted and made everything quick and seamless.

Rafael and Evonna have a wonderful space that is within walking distance to the CTA Blue Line. Within minutes, one can be in the Chicago Loop or O’Hare Airport. It really is convenient to the Harlem station. The space was very clean, spacious and comfortable. I really enjoyed my stay.
Very nice place.  Great communicators.

We stayed at this three bedroom apartment with six family members.  It felt homy, safe and friendly.  Perfect location for a city trip.  One can walk to everything or catch the L. Picture windows throughout to enjoy the view.  Rooftop patio; just comfortable and relaxing.  Security at the front door to ensure access and safety.  Great communication with all.  We had a need for TP and it was delivered in a timely fashion.  We all simply watched movies one night after a long day and just felt at home.  Thank you.
Everything was as listed. Great location. I would stay here again!

I was blown away by how incredibly spotless and comfortable the place was. It truly felt like a home away from home. Not to mention, the convenience of being near everything made my stay even more enjoyable. I will definitely be recommending this place to friends and family, and I look forward to returning in the future.

Really enjoyed our stay! The home was beautiful and so clean. Fit 4 adults, a toddler and a newborn very comfortably. The neighborhood was nice and safe. Walking distance to coffee shops and a great Italian restaurant! Hector was a great host and responded quickly, also checked in with us periodically during our stay to see if we needed anything.  Would recommend staying here when visiting Chicago!
We loved the place we will be booking again with Coty highly recommend him.
The stay was great! I had a good time
Great studio apartment in great location.

Such convenience right in the heart of old town is hard to find! A two bedroom with parking included
- hard to beat!
Milan’s place was great.  Would stay again for sho
My friends and I enjoyed staying at Milan Airbnb ! Super clean and beautiful. Milan was an amazing host !
Great location for a trip to downtown Chicago. Had plenty of space for our group.

Hillary & Ed’s place was perfect for our families holiday weekend stay. My mom, husband, and 16 month old were all extremely comfortable in our own bedrooms. Everything was clean, quiet, exactly as described! You’re off the beaten path from the city a bit, but we knew this going in and it’s what we were looking for. We’ll be back again next time we’re in Chicago.
We had a great stay, super easy check in and out process. Would definitely recommend!
Great location.  Very clean.  Comfortable and welcoming.

Beautiful place to stay, very modern, clean, spacious, comfortable and relaxing. My group definitely enjoyed the stay. Beds were very comfortable to sleep in. We were provided with everything we needed for our stay. Highly recommend.
Very clear instructions and always received answers to my questions.

What a luxurious stay at Sarah's place.  The home is spacious with the most comfortable beds.  We had 10 people, there was plenty of room for everyone, lot's of areas for people to sit and gather or spaces that were more private to have intimate conversations.  Sarah was a wonderful host, we arrived late the first evening and there were numerous bottles of water and a bowl full of snacks ready for us.  Such a thoughtful touch after a day of travel.  The place was spotless, and beautifully decorated with designer touches.  There were plenty of dishes, and two sets of washer and dryers - what more could you ask for!  We also enjoyed the rooftop patio, a really nice outdoor space to relax in the evenings.  Our family loved this home, and this will be our home away from home every time we visit Chicago.

We were a group of six friends who stayed in Reinaldo's space for 4 nights. It was a clean, cozy space with enough room for all of us, and we had a good time just hanging out at the large dining table and catching up.
Amenities - there was a laundry machine that was helpful for washing dirty travel clothes on the first day. We also bought some breakfast items and made good use of the kitchen.
Neighborhood - super walkable, lots of great stuff nearby. I liked the two local bookstores (City Lit, Skunk Cabbage) and we grabbed deep dish pizza at Giardano's. And enjoyed some karaoke at Cafe Mustache!
Transit - close to the Blue Line which we took downtown and to the airport. This was helpful because it let us be flexible with people's schedules / car usage.
Parking - we had two cars so we paid for the parking spot ($20/night). For the other car we used street parking, which wasn't too difficult to find.
Overall a great stay!

Joe’s place is wonderful. Exactly as pictured and exceeded our expectations!  The accommodations were incredible!  Top 1%!!!  Stay here if you can. Can’t be beat. Thank you Joe for everything. We greatly appreciated your hospitality!

Beautiful apartment! Very clean, spacious, and on the floor with the pool and gym. I chose the parking option and it was very easy to park and access the building. Very friendly front desk staff that helped with anything and provided local recommendations. Cloud9 themselves were excellent hosts and were very responsive online.
Highly recommended!

Our stay at David's was great - a gorgeous, cozy home, a quiet neighborhood close to everything (including public transportation), and warm, generous hosts.
Would definitely stay again.
Loved this this place it was excellent and it extremely clean. The owner was very welcoming and friendly I will definitely be booking it again in the future!!!!
Nice and cool spot for a solo vacation

My partner and I had a wonderful time here. It was everything we wanted/needed. The space is homey and comfortable. It is extremely walkable/has great access to public transit. Parking was easy to find on side streets. This is definitely a place I will look for again when I come back to Chicago! :)
What a great place! Everything was clean, and we appreciated all the information from the host. We will definitely try and stay here again.

Austin and his team went above and beyond for our stay. We are returning guest after 6yrs to celebrate our family  wedding and our stay was more incredible than the first time we stayed. I didn’t know it could get better but it did! Our family will continue to book with Austin whenever we are in Chicago because it’s our family’s château at this point😂💓✨ so I’ll be out there!!! If you’re ever un Chicago, book with Austin in Bucktown!!! You won’t regret it!

Wonderful place to stay for a long weekend! The apartment was spotless, well equipped, and had great climate control. The bed was super comfortable too. You can definitely hear the upstairs neighbors when they’re home but the rest of the building and surrounding neighborhood were lovely and calm. Easy to walk to nearby restaurants/bars and the train too. Would definitely stay here again!

Our family stayed here for a weekend in Chicago and a Cub’s game. The location is amazing… around the corner from the field. The place is stocked with anything you could possibly need. It was very clean and very comfortable!

Hands down one of the best Airbnb stays I’ve ever experienced. The home was beautiful — spotless, stylishly designed, and even better in person than in the photos. You can tell a lot of thought and care went into every detail, which made the stay feel both luxurious and incredibly comfortable.
What made the experience even more exceptional was the hosting team. They were attentive, quick to respond, professional, and truly accommodating throughout the entire stay. Their hospitality and commitment to making guests feel welcomed really stood out.
I genuinely appreciated everything and would absolutely stay here again in the future. Highly recommended!
Great, quite, comfortable space. Nice neighborhood, walkable to restaurants and metro station. Highly recommended.
Very lovely place to stay, very walkable and bus stops around every corner, very accessible area, great stay
Awesome location.  We stayed there to see a concert at Aragon Ballroom.  The condo is luxurious.  Highly recommended!
Muy bonito y muy limpio y sobre todo una estadía como en casa
Our stay was great- lovely accommodations that seemed very recently updated. Christian was a very responsive and helpful host.
Good stay for a quick trip. Clear instructions and responsive host

Extremely convenient stay, host was responsive and very detailed as to the expectations of the stay. We loved the area and felt safe. The space was spacious and perfect for our group. The pool table and amenities were a plus. Would recommend to stay here when visiting Chicago!

Loved our stay in Chicago!
Brad was very quick to respond and provide check-in/ out information.
The apartment was clean, had all listed amenities, and very close to many shops, restaurants, and public transportation.
The main building key gave us some trouble during check-in, but Brad was quickly able to help us, and we were able to figure out how to turn the key.
We would absolutely recommend this apartment for your next Chicago stay!

Perfect location, amazing place, super comfortable and extremely clean. We will return!
The place was really nice, lots of space, comfortable furniture, loved all of the Chicago baseball decorations. Brandon was friendly and great response time. Perfect location!
The place was very clean, the beds were very comfortable, everything was very modern, and I really liked the accessibility to the city center. It was a great experience and well worth it.

Amazing stay from start to finish. The host was incredibly kind and helpful — she even carried our luggage up to the third floor before check-in so we could explore without worrying about our bags. She was super responsive the whole time and very patient while we figured out some user-error issues with the keys 😅
She also gave us restaurant recommendations nearby and every single one was great. The location is perfect, super close to the train station with an easy and chill walk. The home itself is beautiful and honestly way bigger than the photos make it seem. Would definitely stay here again!
We were super grateful and thankful for your kindness and help with everything.

My friends and I had stayed over for the weekend. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay at this airbnb. It was clean and felt very homey. Jake was good at responding back in a timely manner with any questions that we had.

Nora’s place is always a treat to stay in — clean, comfortable, plenty of space, and very local to so much cool stuff around Ravenswood, Andersonville, and Lincoln Square. She’s always so responsive and kind to interact with, and our stays here have been excellent. We’ll definitely be back, no doubt!

The penthouse is perfect! Beautiful inside and out. Luxurious, clean, modern, spacious. It has everything you need on top of it being in a prime location with beautiful views of the city. The hosts are responsive yet completely respectful of privacy. It was our second time staying here and it was just as amazing, if not better, than the first. We hope to be back soon! 5 stars all the way!
The apartment is in a location close to public transport and restaurants. Quiet neighborhood.  Apartment was larger than expected. Great for what we needed.
Great stay. Private entry, super spacious,  spotless, modern, and within good distance of main Chicago attractions. A steal for the listed price and would be great for long term stays as well.
Had a great stay and was an easy process to check in and out. Great location also!

In town visiting family for some wedding planning. Very nice with true “Penthouse Views’!
Host very helpful and responsive.

Beautiful apartment. More spacious than it seems from the pictures and descriptions. Very comfortably would fit up to 4 people. One bedroom has an en suite bathroom which is great. Would definitely come back!

This spot is very nice and comfortable! The host was very responsive and helpful at all times. I have no complaints AT ALL for this place. It’s very clean and the neighborhood is quiet! Would definitely come back in the future and recommend to anyone!

The location is amazing and we’d stay again. There are no extra towels or even glasses (4 coffee mugs isn’t really cutting it),  but there was plenty of detergent and dish soap so we handled it without issue. We’d come back again just for the highlights I mentioned. Really fun to walk to bars and restaurants from the house.
Great place!  Amazing location and great little spot
Great location, great place to stay for a long weekend!
Perfect location right in the middle of Ukrainian Village.  Unit was clean, well appointed & spacious, and master bedroom was pleasantly larger than anticipated. We would definitely stay here again.

This was my first experience staying at an AirBnB. I planned it for my family, and there were 5 adults total. I had a question about using the grill during the stay and Michael helped with it that same night which was a greatly appreciated. Was very happy overall!
It was our perfect stay for the weekend, downtown was close and convenient. Her place was very clean as well. Would definitely stay here again!

everything was great!
nothing to complain about

Joan’s place was spacious, with very comfortable beds, clean bathrooms, and well-stocked kitchen. We appreciated the water and other drinks provided in the frig. We enjoyed the area restaurants and it was easy to jump on the train to downtown and to other cute neighborhoods. Recommend to others looking for a neighborhood stay but close to all that Chicago has to offer.
Very nice, clean and pleasant the instructions were very clear I really love the place.

There is someone at the front desk 24/7 and the neighborhood is very safe.
We loved our unit and will stay here again on our next trip.

My 4 friends and I stayed here during our trip to Chicago. The Airbnb was spacious, clean, and very cozy. Barry and Alpha were also very responsive when we had questions. 10/10 would recommend!
Great place to stay!
Walking distance to Wrigley and plenty of places to eat or get a coffee. Parking was fine.
Amazing place would highly recommend, it was very beautiful inside and looked exactly like the pictures.
Host was very responsive. The stay was great . Glad we book for our trip.
Very beautiful apartment in a fantastic location. Easily walkable to Unity Park and restaurants in Logan Square.
Great and comfortable place!

My family and I enjoyed our stay. The beds were very comfortable. The views were beautiful and there was enough space for all of us to spread out. We enjoyed having a supermarket very close by easily accessible via walkway. The neighborhood was extremely walkable with a lot to see and do nearby. We spent a lot of time outside on the balcony just conversation with each other. I would definitely stay here again.

We had a great stay overall. The location was excellent and made it easy to explore the area. The home was comfortable, clean, and well-maintained, and the host was very communicative and responsive throughout our stay.
The bedrooms were on the smaller side, but that seemed consistent with what you would expect for accommodations in this area and did not detract from our experience. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would recommend this property to others looking for a convenient and comfortable place to stay.
The space was so clean and so beautiful, it was also in a pretty quiet neighborhood very peaceful.
Nice place to stay at!

Beautiful condo, lots of space and well appointed! Came to Chicago for a mini family reunion over Memorial Day and had a blast! Marc was a great, responsive host. This Airbnb was in a safe neighborhood with walkable restaurants, grocery stores, and L train station nearby. The kitchen had cooking ware and utensils, and the sofa bed was set up for us when we got there. Overall great experience!

We had a great stay!  A very comfortable, quiet, and clean space with plenty of room for our group of five.  Great location with transit and restaurants nearby and our hosts were very responsive and helpful.  I'd book this place again!
This place was VERY cozy for the three of us and we would definitely stay here again!
A well-curated, lovely place to stay, quiet and peaceful, convenient to lots of cool things to do. Would definitely stay here again.
Beds were not comfortable at all!
Very comfortable place and had really good nearby restaurants.

Otto was a great host!! Our initial flights were cancelled and we had to rebook for different days. He was very accommodating and responded quickly, even to questions before I officially booked, which gave me peace of mind. There were some personal items in the fridge and laundry room, but the listing mentioned this, though some guests might prefer a more neutral space. The surrounding area looked abandoned with high grass, but I never felt unsafe, even returning by train at 2 a.m. The Green Line train is a short walk and takes you straight into the city, offering strong value compared to downtown. The only reason I wouldn’t stay again is that some décor featured Hindu imagery, which don’t align with my traditional Catholic beliefs.
This was a great place to stay. One of our favorite airbnbs. Beautiful space. Fairly quiet neighborhood.

Could be better.  My room was clean enough, but the kitchen and bathrooms could have been cleaner.  The towel racks in one bathroom have come off the wall and have not been replaced. Darius was helpful, and the apartment was very clean and comfortable which we were very appreciative of. The neighbors were very friendly when we came across them. Overall a great stay and will book again when we come back.

If you’re staying in Logan Square this is the place to stay. Exactly as described  Beautiful interior and exterior. Prefect location. Walkable to many restaurants and CTA. Liz and Martin are terrific hosts. Very responsive and friendly. Highly recommend.

This place is perfect! Quiet neighborhood but close by to a ton of sights and places to see, eat, enjoy.  The apartment has a ton of character and really provides the true old architecture experience! Would absolutely stay again
Very nice place and loved how walkable it was to nearby restaurants/stores. Would definitely book again.
Nicola’s place was perfect for my friends and I for the weekend. Lovely host that was very communicative and even accommodating! Would definitely book again.
Such a great place to stay when visiting in Chicago, will come again.

Joe really thought of everything - from snacks to water to chargers - made for a great long weekend stay. Place is in a great location, and he was proactive and responsive throughout our visit. Looking forward to a future stay

This is a great spot to stay in Chicago. You are within walking distance from wicker park and Humboldt park. Just one block over is division with plenty of restaurants available. Terrance was a great host and if we had any questions about the spot or anything local he made himself available. There is also a yard in the back which is great if you have a dog. If you are looking for a longer stay in Chicago I found myself right at home.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home. The house is beautifully designed, incredibly clean, and has such a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Every space was comfortable and put together so thoughtfully, making it the perfect place to relax and spend time with family and friends.
One of our favorite things was the location. The area was very walkable, with plenty to do, see, and explore nearby. Having restaurants, shops, and activities so close by made our stay even more enjoyable.
The hosts were fantastic, and everything we needed was provided. We truly appreciated the care and attention that went into making this home such a special place to stay.
We enjoyed every minute of our visit and were already talking about coming back before we even left. We would highly recommend this home to anyone looking for a comfortable, beautiful, and memorable stay. Thank you again for sharing your amazing home with us!
Nice clean place, great part of town.

Our stay at this Air BnB was alright. The location is not near the city center but it is close to transit and O’Hare and there is lots in the neighborhood. We also have relatives nearby. Still, the rate was high for Jefferson Park, especially since underneath the new interior decorating, the apartment is not in great condition. It’s basically a very clean, older apartment with fresh paint and newer furnishings, but other aspects haven’t been updated. For instance, the bathroom vanity is losing all its finish. The beds were oddly half made—no top sheet and no duvet cover, small holes in the sheets that were there. The host was immediately responsive when contacted but failed to provide key checkin instructions, not explaining the house number isn’t visible from the street and was incorrect on the listing. There were no exterior pictures. The WiFi speed was inconsistent. Still, all the appliances worked, the temperature was comfortable and checkout was easy. Overall, a mixed experience.
Great, quiet neighborhood. Place is as described and suited us well. The 2nd bathroom being downstairs is the only negative but worth booking nonetheless

We loved this home! The location is unreal- beautiful quiet street and a half block over and you're in a fun, vibrant area of Chicago. This house is beautiful! Rooms are large, layout was perfect for our 3 generations and it's just such a cool home! Highly recommend!
Great place a short walk from the train station. Cute coffee shops and a great backyard. There was more than enough space for our family of 6.

This place was everything we could’ve asked for to celebrate our engagement. There was more than enough to do around the Airbnb — great food, drinks, nightlife, and honestly you barely even need to drive because everything is right there.

We’re already planning on coming back next Memorial Day weekend. Easily one of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed at, with an amazing host to top it all off.

Jeannine was a stunning host. From our initial point of contact she was highly communicative and amazing at making sure I had everything I needed for my stay. Her gorgeous home was clean and close to so many amazing Chicago staples, it made it easy to get around. I also loved that it was so close to O’hare. Everything about it was perfect and I look forward to booking regularly when work brings me back to Chicago.

This Airbnb stay in Chicago was absolutely incredible. What truly sets this place apart is the attention to detail. You can tell the host genuinely cares about the experience and has thoughtfully considered every aspect of the stay, from the design and comfort to the small touches that make you feel at home immediately.
I’ve traveled to over 20 countries across 5 continents, stayed in countless hotels and Airbnbs, and I can honestly say this was one of my favorite stays anywhere in the world. The space was spotless, beautifully designed, comfortable, and exactly as advertised, if not better. The location was excellent, communication was seamless, and everything about the experience felt elevated without trying too hard.
This is the kind of Airbnb that reminds you why people choose unique stays over hotels. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.
Worth the stay, location was the best there was plenty of different things to do around the area.

Had a great stay here! The place was super clean, comfortable, and exactly like the pictures. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in really easy. The location was also perfect and close to everything we needed. Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting!
Everything was great! Toby was really nice and always responded to our messages in a timely manner. The place was quite and comfortable overall, just some minimal noise from the upstairs neighbors.

Geo was amazing from the beginning. Everytime we had a question he was very quick to respond. The instructions for check-in and check-out were very clear. Enjoyed our stay. Loved the location, decor and spacious kitchen and living areas.  Enjoyed the plush bath towels but there was only one kitchen towel and just 3 coffee mugs, otherwise kitchen was well stocked.

Great stay! Loved the private rooftop!
Matthew's home was perfect.  close to everything.  Great checkin instructions.  It was a wonderful stay.

David’s place was amazing, it is in a fantastic location and we loved staying here. Highly recommend!

Best stay I’ve had in Chicago. I wish I could have enjoyed more of the place but spent most of the time exploring. Parking is quick and easy and host is very friendly. I left my iPad behind and they’re helping get it back to me. Will definitely stay again.

very nice airbnb! we didn’t need the host much but the place was very nice with accessible parking.

Non stop barking, yelling, and vacuums. However, Demitri was very accommodating and responsive, offering a partial refund to make things right. The space itself is nice, well-designed, and clean overall. We did find a few minor maintenance issues (spoiled creamers, missing cabinet handle), but the bigger issue is the noise disclosure. If you’re sensitive to sound, this may not be the right fit, but Demitri’s willingness to work with us was appreciated.
Hosts were very communicative and we had a lovely stay!
Perfect location and will definitely stay again!

This airbnb is exactly as described but that should be taken into account when booking. It was by far the cheapest option I found so for me it was worth it but there is certainly a slightly musty smell in the bathrooms/kitchen, there is someone sleeping behind makeshift walls in the kitchen/living space, the sheets on my bed had stains, ants, and hairs when I arrived (I received new sheets the next day). Also my room didn’t have a heater, only a space heater but since I visited in May I only turned it on intermittently. The area is really nice and surrounded by great restaurants/cafes within a 20 minute walk. Also felt very safe in the neighborhood, also at night.
We loved our stay, pictures are accurate but it is even better in person.  Can't wait to come back
Had a great stay at Roberto’s location.everything was as expected. He provided good instructions.

Rashad's place was one of the comfier places I've stayed at, I slept great both nights. The place was clean and easy to get to. Also very accessible to major roads. Also easy to communicate with. Would stay again for sure
Enjoyed my stay, would stay again!
Nice, private, and way better than staying in a hotel!
Amazing communication. The spot was perfect for my quick weekend trip to Chicago.

The location is great, not too far from the CTA, about an 8–10 minute walk. My room was clean and very organized. I really recommend this place to people who are on a business trip or visiting Chicago for a short stay. The host was also welcoming and responsive. Will definitely come back again!

No frills stay in walking distance to many restaurants/bars as well as Fulton market area. Next to the Metra train tracks but surprisingly quiet. We got lucky with free parking on the street near the apartment but it’s not a guaranteed. Overall a good stay.
Great place

My significant other and I spent our very first anniversary in Amy’s wonderful space, and felt right at home with her level of care accommodating us in her space. We loved every ounce of our trip, and would continue to enjoy reserving this space in our future endeavors. I personally loved the mindfulness of her initiative to compost/recycle, and hospitality towards female guests in our time of the month. She is also super responsive, resourceful, and recommended many places to enjoy; as well as navigating the CTA/METRA to/from the BnB. Thank you for hosting us, and we hope to see you soon! Love from NYC ❤️.

We had a great stay at this 2-bedroom Airbnb. The space was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, with everything we needed for a relaxing visit. Both bedrooms were cozy and nicely set up, and the overall layout made it feel very spacious and homey.
The location was convenient and easy to get around from, and the check-in process was smooth and hassle-free. The host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Overall, it was a pleasant experience and we would definitely stay here again.
Great location!  Walking distance to a lot including the train. Patricia followed up to ensure everything was good and if we needed anything.   Will stay again

Wonderful place to stay in Chicago.  Definitely want a small car or small suv for the parking spot , which we did so no problems there.  The street is actually really quiet and had no problems with noise.  Very walkable for food nearby.  Most places we went to see were about 15-20 minute drive away so that was nice.   Would definitely recommend this place and would stay here again
Everything about the home was great! Alec was very responsive and made sure to answer any questions I had. Instructions on what was expected and how to get there was very clear. I 100% recommend!
We had a great stay! We felt safe and taken care of, will definitely stay here again when in the area!

Loved our stay here! Donald and Colby are super welcome, friendly, and flexible with visitors. They welcomed us with so much hospitality that I’ve never seen at an Airbnb before so far in my journeys and they also recommended many local spots. We arrived late due to a delayed flight, but they were extremely flexible with us. We were greeted with a brief history lesson with the local neighborhood which really gave us a deeper appreciation of the town and culture around us! During check out, they were kind enough to let us store our luggage until we were ready to go and we really appreciate their understanding! Highly recommend this location due to the kind hosts and also being super close to the trains and buses. Thank you again Donald and Colby for all your kindness! We hope to see you both again if we’re ever in town!

This was by far the best Airbnb we have ever stayed at.  It was breathtakingly beautiful inside and out. The decor was incredible and the house was spotless and just perfection. The host was very quick to respond with instructions and the directions for everything very clear to understand. Our niece lives in Chicago and attends Loyola so we will definitely be back here if available. Thank you for such a wonderful visit and comfortable place to stay with our family. Our kids thought it was “the coolest house ever”!
It was a nice stay, really felt like home
One of our favorite places to stay in Chicago. Justin is a great host and the place is great. Lots of space and amenities. Can’t wait until our next visit!
Nice stay, old building, and a noisy environment due to the train.

We really loved our stay at flex home! The area around there was peaceful, and we were able to walk to great coffee shops, along with some fun restaurants! It was convenient to get anywhere from that location and their location close to Fulton market was awesome! We would definitely be staying there again😀
Excellent location, within walking distance of everything we wanted to do on our first visit to Chicago.
Great place to stay, exactly as described/pictured. Would stay here again.
Very responsive and walkable to a few restaurants & coffee shops. Centrally located to other neighborhoods. Felt safe. Very secure.
It was nice, and clean had everything we needed to enjoy are stay!!!
Was quick and easy to check in and that’s what made the experience great for my friends and me

Great location, great space. We had 3 families staying together, this layout was perfect for this. The setup let each family have a private space as well as ample shared space in the kitchen and living room. The property manager is excellent, this our second stay with this group and they are really fantastic communicators for any issues that may crop up.
A few notes that may not be clear from the listing:
1) A city parking passes is required for the street parking and provided for only one car. There is paid parking nearby.
2) The balcony pictured was through the master bedroom, facing the back ally, so as a group we didn't use it much.
Very understanding and worth the price 💯

Beautiful Airbnb, as shown. Host was very friendly, understanding and attentive. Needed to check in sooner for a festival and he accommodated to our requests. Would definitely book here again in the near future. Only thing I’d like to add is the neighborhood isn’t the safest after hours but that’s pretty much every city. Definitely recommend host and this specific Airbnb for your travels!
Very lovely place. Excellent location, close the proximity to everything. Bathrooms had bidets which was unique. All 4 of us slept wonderfully in the firm beds. Wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.

If you're looking for a place that's very clean without a lot of bells and whistles but in a great location this is the one!!!!
I recommend it.
Wonderful location in River North! Thank you, Neel for the accommodations! Would stay again with a large group. :)
A beautiful and very comfortable space! Highly recommend!

Mary Casey’s property is perfect for a stay in Chicago with a large group. The large open living room and kitchen is perfect for gathering and it is right in the heart of old town. Easy to get anywhere in the city with plenty of public transportation options near by. Would definitely recommend!
Amazing home in a great location. Oliver was a splendid host, thank you !

Loved the location of this property: very peaceful and family friendly, with cute brownstones and plenty of walkable local restaurants/cafes. The property was clean, quiet, and had all the essentials. Larissa was a great host. She provided games for the kids to play and we regularly referenced the list of places to go/things to do she provided. Would stay again.

Azam was very communicative and flexible with a last minute day add on to my trip, the place was nice and clean. It was convenient with the train and the neighborhood seemed peaceful. I would recommend this stay for any one visiting.

This was an excellent place to stay for easy access to accessible public transit to get around the city! Very clean space and easy to check in and out of and Tim was a excellent host. I will say, it is very close to the L line and the sound can be a bit much at first but with earplugs I was used to it after two nights.
very easy to check in and out of. Milan always responded and answered all of my questions.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The place was clean, comfortable, and had a very warm and welcoming feel. The host was super friendly, kind, and very responsive throughout our stay, always quick to help with anything we needed. They made the whole experience smooth and comfortable. Would definitely recommend staying here!
Wonderful stay for my daughter’s bachelorette party. Great location
The most beautiful stay 10/10 would highly recommend.

We found this to be a good and quiet place. The neighborhood had coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance, which we appreciated. It was also very convenient for public transportation, and we felt safe walking around.

We came back to our old neighborhood with some friends for the weekend and had a great time! The space is roomy with multiple areas to accommodate people. The deck is lovely. The area is extremely walkable. Andrew and Lauren were very responsive and accommodative. We will definitely be back!

The space was beautiful and we’ll definitely be back - it’s a quick and lovely walk away from our family in the area. Everything was clean and comfortable. A few FYIs for future guests:
- Easy entry via the front door, then you’ll walk through the host’s home to get to the stairs. It felt like old-school Airbnb where you get to see the hosts (who were lovely and welcoming).
- The stairs to the space were narrow and a little steep, with a low ceiling at the top. It was tricky for our 3 and 5 year olds (they actually got a kick out of it).
- It almost feels like two separate spaces - the queen bed and living area are separated by the bathroom (which is gorgeous and bigger than it looks in the photos).
- Even though it’s a renovated attic, there is a ton of light from skylights and it feels very open.
Thanks again for having us!
Great place to stay near Wrigley!

I had a wonderful weekend with my friends and family at this airbnb. The place was beautiful, well maintained and a good location (separated from the chaos of downtown while not being too far from all of the major activity). The host was very responsive, helpful and made sure we were comfortable to ask questions and address concerns. My friends and family all enjoyed using the airbnb as well and thought it to be comfy, aesthetic and perfect for a weekend travel.
Cozy place… loved the cleanliness.
Great place to stay at

Our stay was amazing, we had no complications or complaints. House was very clean and organized, very safe and walkable area and restaurants were within walking distance. I would recommend staying here!
This is a great spot in a central location! The space was cozy and comfortable- perfect for a long weekend for two people - right in the center of Andersonville!
Budget friendly,neat, clean Easy access to public transportation.

Couldn’t have asked for a better host and accommodations during our stay in Chicago. Stayed here while visiting family and loved having a conveniently located place to come back to at night. Mike was an excellent host – proactively reaching out to see that we had everything we needed. My husband and I were able to extend our checkout on the last day for a late flight - saving ourselves from having to roll luggage around.
The setup was perfect and has classic touches of Chicago architecture: red brick, ivy-covered walls. We’re nostalgic for Logan Square and hold a special place in our hearts for this neighborhood. This spot is perfectly located within short walking distance from the California blue line stop, excellent coffee shops, restaurants, bars, and walkable green spaces. Please note this IS located in a city so there is some expected bustle from foot traffic and nearby el train; nothing earplugs can’t solve.

If you're ever in Chicago and want a quaint nice city getaway, you got to stay at Gregory's stay! Super clean and so peaceful for my friends and I. It was near so many amazing and delicious restaurants. Highly recommend to any one with a group that wants to relax and enjoy the city!
The place was extremely clean and well organized. It was mostly easy to get in and out. The place was also very cute and looked exactly like the pictures.

Jeanette was an amazingly responsive and accomodation host. The airbnb matched the description to a "T" and it was cozy, cute, and squeaky clean. It is a great location and walkable to the Division stop a few blocks away with great restaurants, shops,  and grocery store. The plus was the filtered water at the apartment!! I would definitely stay here again and recommend to others!
Innesa was quick and responsive she did a great job hosting and plan to book with her again in the future. She was accommodating and polite her Airbnb was beautiful!
Great room! Kitchen with full amenities. Beautifully decorated hall. A bit loud on a busy street but not bad if you're used to cities. Central, walkable location, and very close to public transport.
Great location for the price. Would recommend
Beautiful place, we enjoyed our stay! Had everything we needed for our little getaway weekend! Close to CTA so it made it very easy to get around town!
Great location, and Brad responded quickly to any questions we had! Would definitely stay here again!

Kristal was very accomodating and was able to fulfill all of our needs! Super quick with replying to any questions! The unit also had all the essentials needed available if needed. Definitely recommend staying here!

We had a great time in Chicago staying here! Steve was extremely responsive in helping us get parking passes and allowing us to check in an hour early. We did have some issues with the WiFi, but Steve was communicative in trying to resolve it. This is a great location for going out in Lakeview/Wrigleyville or hopping on the red line to get downtown!

Easy to find with clear instructions for all the necessary processes to ensure a trouble free stay. The apartment was in great shape, it was a low key quiet area with access to public transit/walkable distances, and was also super easy for our dogs to feel right at home.
The property was well kept and in a fantastic location. We had no issues during our stay and would highly recommend anyone visiting the area to consider this property!

Absolutely PERFECT location in Gold Coast. Beautiful street & very nice & quiet building that is steps away to all the shops & restaurants. The unit itself was clean & the perfect size for a weekend stay!
The only thing is the listing had both Air Conditioning & Bathtub listed as amenities - there were ceiling fans & radiators but no central air or thermostat, & no stopper available for the bathtub.
Didn’t have any issues with the temperature, and I would absolutely stay here again, just something to keep in mind if you are sensitive to heat!
Great location

great location. good communication.  you have to park away from the apartment but it wasn't far. we unpacked the car then went and parked in the parking garage a block away. you do have to pay for parking. apartment was clean and peaceful. no complaints.
Great location and very clean. Was perfect for a family of four. Thx Chris!

This was a perfect location and so easy to walk to Wrigley. The only reason for 4 stars is the bed was not comfortable.  The mattress made us both sink to the middle because it's just so worn out. We loved everything else about this cute little garden apartment.
Good neighborhood, easy commute to the city and very responsive host. Overall a good stay
Great place to stay!! I would definitely stay there again ;)
Had a great time in town for Slide Away fest. Walkable restaurants, stores, train station and concert venue!
Very clean !

Rachel was attentive from beginning to end of stay.  She provided locations of interests based of my descriptions of things to do.  The Ducked Off Oasis was as described, photos depicted the place, enough space for everyone and easy to get in and out of.   Rachel provided us with great information on restaurants and "things to do" around the city.  Short distance from Midway airport and to downtown where all the excitement takes place.  I would definitely stay here again!!!

Was visiting from New York for a couple days and needed something affordable for the weekend. I was genuinely surprised by the size of the living space and by all the amenities provided.  It was worth every penny, the rooms are well kept, the space is enormous, and there are many extra amenities we didn't even get to use.  Nate is also great host, very responsive and helpful. Will 100% be back when returning to Chicago. The area could be nicer, but it is still peaceful and I've seen way worse in New York.
Great location and walkable neighborhood. There is train noise but you get used to it.

The location for this place is fine for what we were looking for, but there was a very loud argument that went on in the alley for 10 minutes and the inner stairway leading to the unit always smelled strongly of weed.  The kitchen and bathroom are very small and outdated.

We had a great stay with our family at Vraj’s place! The location was perfect and accessible to everything we needed. We had the flexibility to hold our bags after check out before our travel arrangements. Some noise at night as you are surrounded by restaurants, but exactly what you’d expect in the city. We would stay again!

We did a long weekend girl's trip here and this place was good for what we needed. It was about a 20 minute ish uber ride downtown and to most other parts of the city if it was not rush hour. The one time it was rush hour, we ended up ubering to the closest station and taking a 45 min subway ride which was fine. We did not spend too much time at the airbnb but if you're planning on being there a lot, the couch is not the most comfortable for lounging just FYI. We are all ~5'3-5'4 avg women for reference. We had a small issue upon check-in (the deadbolt was on in the front so we had to go around) but the host was nice about it and provided us late checkout (1 hr) for the trouble. Lastly, I believe the listing notes this but there are STAIRS you have to use for either entrance and the front stairs are very narrow with small steps. Keep this in mind as you're lugging up your bags. Overall, good value for the location, very clean and enough space for 3 women.
Really enjoyed my stayed, would definitely recommend it
It’s a beautiful place walkable to many things. The surroundings can be noisy since: it’s on a busy street, the homes are close together, and there’s a back alley. However, ear plugs were provided.
Welcoming hosts. Bed comfy. Bathroom clean. Good communication.
Amy was super friendly and was very descriptive in her instructions. She was very responsive and was able to allow us to have a late check out everything was just like the pictures and descriptions
Nice place in a calm neighborhood with free breakfast! Left my journal behind and Joe gladly mailed it back for me.

This place was wonderful! Close to so many amenities and a quick drive to all the museums Chicago had to offer. The apartment itself was clean, spacious and had plenty of whatever we needed - they really did think of everything (umbrellas, a sewing kit and outlet plugs even!). As others have mentioned, there is a bar downstairs which is loud but with white noise generators in each room, our kids slept right through it. And the bar patrons were super nice and respectful when we had to come up or down the stairs. We really enjoyed our stay and Tatiana and Roupen were so proactive and responsive. Highly recommend this Airbnb!
Such a beautiful home & im so thankful i got to stay for my birthday, made the time just abundantly more memorable & im so thankful for it!
Fue increíble el lugar estaba igual que en las fotos, la atención fue increíble, la zona, volvería a ir

I highly recommend this place. Kendal was incredibly kind, proactive, and always easy to communicate with. The pictures accurately match the property, and everything was exactly as described. The unit was spacious, clean, and very comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.

We were very happy with our stay at Terry and John's lovely house which served as a great home base for a weekend in Chicago. They were welcoming hosts and very flexible and reactive. We could come and go as we pleased with no problem. The house is in a great neighborhood and walking distance from the beach and lots of good restaurants and shopping. This Airbnb is a great option for experiencing authentic Chicago.
Incredibly small house for how many people its described for. We had a group of 8 and the house was more meant for 4. Lack of utensils and cookware. No toilet plunger. Very small cramped bathrooms.

We stayed here because it’s close to family we were visiting, and it is also in a great, safe location.  Within walking distance of many restaurants, cafes, shops, and the train station.  Well-stocked kitchen, and comfortable beds.  Very clean and minimalist.  I only gave 4 stars instead of 5 for a few reasons.  While there were many pillows stocked in the closets, they were all the same (very thick).  There were no blankets in the apartment, which would have been nice, and bedrooms could use mirrors and bedside lamps.  Would stay here again for the location and cleanliness!
Great place to stay! And great communication skills!
Great stay exactly what you expect from description.
great place, great stay. enjoy myself very much and felt very relaxed and comfortable. will be back!
Great apartment on a nice quiet street. Terry was very accommodating and replied quickly. Walkable to the Cubs stadium and many bars, restaurants and shops.

We had a wonderful stay at Alicia and Dario's place. The location was unbeatable right in the heart of a safe, walkable neighborhood that made getting around incredibly easy. We felt comfortable at all hours, and everything we needed was just a short walk away.
