The home itself was very clean. You can tell they take real pride in maintaining a tidy, welcoming space. It made settling in effortless and really elevated the whole experience.
Overall, a fantastic stay and a place we’d happily book again.

Over all the apartment was nicely renovated and comfortable. Unlike some other reviewers, we did not find the apartment noisy and we were there on a holday weekend when the cubs were in town.
The rainfall shower was the best one I ever tried in the spotless clean bath, but the shower faucet handle was a little confusing to use. The large sectional couch was not hooked together and was not “plugged” in so we couldn’t raise/lower the foot rests. It was comfortable enough for the little time we spent on it and the TV was nice and large. The location worked for us because it was just a few minutes away from where my son was having his wedding, There is not a lot of food choices close by but a 15-20 walk will get you to many options. A few things of note; A dresser or luggage holder would be nice. In a few places you can see where someone was sloppy with the paint (a few black paint squiggles on otherwise white gloss moulding) but these are not deal breakers. Overall a nice place to stay.
Everything seems nice and clean and exactly how the photo was not a bad place.

Joanna was extremely helpful, responsive, and accommodating throughout our stay. The property was very clean, private, and spacious, making it a comfortable place to stay. Parking was convenient, and the parking passes she provided worked perfectly with no issues.
The area felt very safe, pleasant, and well-maintained. The location was excellent, with easy access to downtown, Little Italy, and the Village.
Thank you, Joanna, for your hospitality and for helping make our stay so enjoyable. We truly appreciated everything and would be happy to stay here again.
We had an incredible stay. The place was perfect for our men’s retreat.
I would give six stars! Excellent in all ways. Beautifully designed, thoughtful touches, exceptional care, and communication. Tanya is a professional!

Bon accueil de la part d'Olga. Logement très propre. Contrairement à ce qui est mentionné dans l'annonce la salle de bain n'est pas partagée mais privée, c'est une bonne surprise.
Tout ce qu'il faut pour un bon séjour. Facilité d'accès au métro.
Si vous êtes sensible au bruit, apportez des bouchons d'oreilles car la chambre 1 donne sur la rue.

Overall a good Airbnb but listing is missing critical detail. The only bathroom is accessible only through the primary bedroom. It makes things very inconvenient if someone needs to use it in the middle of the night while people are sleeping in the primary and complicates things while everyone is getting ready. Recommend only staying here if you’re very comfortable with everyone you’re traveling with.

There is no airflow in the room apart from one window so in the summers you will inevitably open the window to cool the room and depending on how cold it gets at night close it again. There was a broken pedestal fan that was offered but the room is too small to practically keep it. Be aware the room is incredibly tiny so it's just good enough to sleep in for the night and it's a full size bed so it is quite small but you don't get that perception from the photos.
Great location and the space was perfect for a weekend getaway!
very nice place and very well connected to the brown line

We loved our stay here!  Everything was easy and comfortable from start to finish.  The house felt inviting thanks to the beautiful open spaces,  natural light and excellent amenities.  Kristine is a great host who gave us helpful suggestions for exploring Chicago. Instead of an Airbnb guest,  I truly felt like a welcomed guest.  This experience was memorable.  Wish I could have stayed longer!

We had a wonderful stay! The home was absolutely beautiful, clean, and in a great location. The host was very responsive throughout our stay and made communication easy. When I had a question regarding one of the house rules, she was proactive, understanding, and quick to help resolve the issue. Overall, we really enjoyed the home and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

Vin was very proactive with instructions, I knew exactly how to find our stay without any hiccups. Parking was a little tricky, but thats just because of Chicago. Parking in front of the building is paid to park, and usually pretty full. You can easily park on a side street for free, but make sure you are confident with parallel parking, as spots are few and tight. The room was clean and well maintained. The door was a little finicky, I was worried about breaking the key. So keep in mind you need a little oomph. The building felt secure and was in a great neighborhood. The bed was comfy, memory foam I believe. The bedside lamps also have plug in ports for charging your phone. The noise was not terrible, but there are earplugs available (we didn't need them). The bathroom was clean and well lit. You have to open the window for ventilation and the tub has a slow drain. Nothing deal breaking, but worth mentioning. We were given instructions prior to our leave, so checkout was super easy!

This house was amazing. Spacious and clean. The location was perfect — close to the train station, coffee shops, restaurants, and a grocery store. Ryan kindly offered us early check in, and the digital welcome book answered all of our questions and more. This was a great house to accommodate our 8 travelers.
Informative and very clear. Clean area. Beds were comfy

Mia’s home was very inviting and was incredibly guest friendly. Mia was very attentive and responsive during our stay. It was a very pleasant stay in a wonderful part of town with many amenities and a great deal of local places to try close by.

Had a great time in Chicago because of this place located in a great neighborhood close to downtown. Check in was easy, comfortable beds, and great communication by the host. I left a few things and Wood was kind enough to ship them to MN!

Overall, we had a really great stay! From the moment we walked in, we loved the Airbnb. It was super cute, very clean, and the space itself was beautiful. The location was honestly a huge plus for us walking distance to one of my favorite brunch spots, Meli Cafe, our festival, convenience stores, and even places like Target. Having everything nearby made the trip so much easier and more enjoyable.
The only small inconvenience we experienced was with the toilet in the main bedroom restroom. The tank wasn’t filling up with water properly, so flushing was a little tricky at times. Thankfully, it was manageable and we were able to work around it, so it didn’t negatively impact our stay too much.
Other than that, everything was great. We truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely book again!

Great spot, the space was perfect for our group and the location was great.
Assel is a great host, quick to communicate and very helpful.
Great place! Plenty of room for our family of 4 and great neighborhood location.

Good location for where we needed to be during our Chicago stay. Home needed some items that your normal Airbnb has, ie. No board games, no extra towels, the layout in living area where they had the couch and the tv made no sense it didn’t provide a clear view to the tv. No additional sheets to use the oven, or much at all to be able to cook. We were trying to re heat a pizza in the oven. Needed also more blankets as their was only thin sheets. The doors inside the house didn’t close properly.

Valerie’s place was perfect for our weekend in Chicago. It had everything we needed, it was very clean, and we didn’t have any issues. There was plenty of space for the 4 of us. Valerie gave some local recommendations for restaurants and things to do, and her communication and quick responses were very appreciated. Definitely would stay there again next time we are in Chicago for our competition weekend!
good
Tara hosted the perfect apartment for us! Very walkable area, perfect if you're intown for a Cubs game!

My stay was excellent, the apartment is very good for a short stay, I stayed for four weeks there, and particularly for one or two people. It was very well equipped and comfortable. It is a low floor with sometimes not so much natural light but it has access to a backyard which is very nice and comfortable.  Colleen and William were excellent hosts, very responsive and they facilitated everything I needed in terms of information or other requests.

The cutest Air BnB I’ve had the pleasure of staying in! Not to mention a great location. We were visiting Chicago for the weekend and we really enjoyed our stay here. The home was in walking distance to a lot of shopping and restaurants, and was close to the redline to get to downtown. We almost enjoyed staying in the Air bnb as much as we did exploring. The perfect space to relax.
We loved our stay in this lovely dog-friendly location.   The quick access to the park was perfect.

The view in this apartment is spectacular. Location is a reprieve from the hustle and bustle of Magnificent Mile.
Great restaurants within walking distance.
Living area was great for visit and the bedrooms weee comfortable.
Thanks for a great place to spend time with 3 generations of women in our family.

Great location! I don’t think you can find a better spot in the area. Very spacious and roomy and very close to one of the stations that takes you straight into the heart of Chicago! Lois was a pleasure and very thorough. Loved her recommendations and explanation of the inspiration for the rooms. Would definitely rebook with her the next time I’m in town
I really loved the place and the surrounding things I was at too he is an excellent host and I would come back there anytime.The place was nice and clean and easy access to get to things
Affordable air bnb with enough space for a big group. Shomari was very responsive, kind and reliable!
Was a nice place. I love the yard next door and the window view from the bottom stay.

Anthony's place is tough to beat for Chicago. Great location, easy to get into, and plenty of updated space. Our group of four was extremely comfortable. The L goes right below the condo, but it wasn't a nuisance to us. They provide earplugs if you're a sensitive sleeper. The beds were great and the instructions were simple and clear.

A comfortable if dated home in a beautiful, peaceful neighborhood. The home has basic needs provided for and was clean. No central cooling but AC units in 2 rooms and lots of fans. Plenty to do in the area if you have a car or don’t mind a 20min walk. Jerome is a lovely man who lives upstairs but almost too attentive as a host—I received multiple phone calls making sure we had agreed on check in and out processes and times. That said, I would stay here again and was grateful for the space.

We had a great stay at the place. Very clean, well stocked, and all of the instructions were incredibly clear and fun. There were even a few extra housekeeping touches that made it clear that the place is well run. We walked to a show and to a Cubs game, which was convenient. The unit is garden level, so there is a little sidewalk noise in the morning. Parking was tough as described, but not impossible.  We’d stay again!

“Had an amazing stay! Gerry was incredibly responsive and accommodating, especially considering this was a last-minute booking. Everything was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and well-prepared. The communication was excellent from start to finish, and they made the entire process smooth and stress-free. You can tell he genuinely cared about his guests having a great experience. I’d definitely stay again and highly recommend this host to anyone looking for a reliable and welcoming Airbnb experience.”
Great area, very responsive and kind hosts

Karsten is a wonderful host.  Super proactive and really responsive.  If anything, I think they undersell how great the place is.  There is secure, gated parking for 5 vehicles, a Target & Aldi just one block away, multiple restaurants directly across the street, and it is mere blocks from the Riviera and Aragon Ballroom live music venues.  This allowed my group to walk back and forth from doing two shows at Aragon, which was key.  Highly, highly recommend this huge home for larger groups.
The place is MUCH smaller than the pictures. The beds were a bit hard and made noise every time you’d move.  It overlooks the federal prison.

I live in San Francisco and have for 15 years- I am no stranger to unconventional living situations- however Alejandro's place did not meet expectations as a place I am paying to vacation in. Two broken windows on the main floor, uncleaned bathrooms with trash still in the trashcans, and wet towels still left in the dryer. The bedrooms are also not listed as garden level bedrooms, which felt a bit disappointing as there is extremely limited sunlight in the garden level rooms. As of writing this review that is still the case.
The worst part was the smell. The entire Airbnb smelled like sewage. This was immediately noticeable upon entering, and we initially thought this was due to the wet towels in the dryer.
Alejandro was responsive and let us know we had to run the washer along with the downstairs shower in order to clear the smell, but it was unclear why he could not do this as a host in preparation for our arrival. Overall, I would not stay in this Airbnb again.

The other reviews were correct about the floors being squeaky, but that’s a very small item to worry about when the rest of the Airbnb is incredible! Beautiful and spacious, great location, and incredibly walkable area.

Great location, 5 min walk to red line and even closer to buses. Easy check and n and check out and instructions simple and clear for getting in. Apartment was quiet and clean with comfortable bed and lovely shower room. In terms of communication, we had an issue with the shower at the start and contacted Trove who came out the same day and fixed it which was amazing. Great service. Thank you
Great place to stay

This place is great for a large group. Plenty of seating at the table and lots of space to relax in various other rooms.  Sean was an excellent host that goes above and beyond for his guest. I’ll definitely be booking here again.
Place looks just like the pictures.  View is incredible and the location was perfect.

Juanita estuvo atenta a mi llegada, me sentí como en familia.
El lugar se encuentra perfectamente comunicado a tan solo dos cuadras caminando a la parada California de la línea rosa, que utilice para ir hacia el loop de la ciudad.
Soy una persona sola viajando por primera ocasión a Chicago.
Moverme en el metro rosa me ofreció seguridad y comodidad de transporte.
Descanse deliciosamente en la cama de la habitación.
Lo recomiendo ampliamente.
Everything was great but my only suggestion would be to upgrade the bed in the first room to match the quality of comfort that the second room had as well as a better couch.
Great apartment, amazing location (especially for those going to a Cubs game - the stadium is at a walkable distance), and had all the amenities we needed.

We had a fantastic stay! It was a very clean and lively space and the hostess incredibly responsive and accommodating. The are was peaceful in a quiet neighborhood. We were in town to go to the Beverly performing arts center and the location couldn’t have been better. We did have to cut our trip short which was disappointing but would absolutely stay here again.
We had a great stay! Wonderful location, and house was as described in listing.

Super dope neighborhood. The place is absolutely adequate for a spot to sleep in but don’t get too comfy. It’s a little fucky to get in to the place but so is every other Chicago apartment I’ve lived in. There is a dearth of outlets so don’t plan on plugging things in. I’d 200% stay here again on another solo trip. Thanks for letting me stay in yr digs.
Great location and very clean. Bed is very firm. Beautiful building.
Being close to the Wrigleyville bars and restaurants was great!
Staying with Danielle was like staying with a friend. I will for sure consider her next time I come to Chicago. Also bunny was extremely friendly and a sweet bonus.

Nice place. Only problem was that it was noisy. People upstairs were loud and the sound passed right through the ceiling.
Very nice plays. Comfortable bed and all the accessories we needed.
This place was perfect for a couple.

Pros:
- Spacious apartment in a great location
- delicious bakery downstairs
- comfortable beds
Cons:
- water pressure in the shower was abysmal
- towels were cheap and scratchy
- downstairs neighbors threw a big party Thursday night well into the morning
Straight forward, had what was needed
Perfect for our long weekend stay. Beds were comfy and shower was hot. Back yard was a great bonus.

Great place, very clean and comfortable. Great neighborhood with lots of folks walking their dogs which our dog absolutely loved. Some great Logan Square coffee, cocktails, and dining within a very short walk. Would certainly stay again.
Great location.
This place was a good value and accommodated our group well. The kitchen was very stocked with just about everything you could need.
Great place to stay on the Gold Coast. Within walking distance to many restaurants and other attractions.
Great place

Ron’s place was conveniently located for a few days stay in Lakeview East…close enough to all the bars and restaurants but tucked away for peace and quiet. Getting in was super easy and his garden level place was so charming. The bed in the bedroom was very comfortable with plenty of pillows and blankets. Ron’s friends who we met gave fantastic food and bar recommendations. It was a wonderful stay and I’d definitely come back the next time I’m in Chicago!

Great location, comfortable place with a well stocked kitchen for cooking. We were staying close to family so it was a perfect stop for our purposes.  This apartment is located close to the L at the California stop. Beautiful outside spaces.
What I love most about this place it was close to everything, it was clean , wasn’t loud easy to check in felt safe when I come back I would definitely book again
Had an excellent stay and the location is wonderful.
Amazing location.  Check-in was incredibly easy, apartment was immaculate, well-stocked, and exactly what I needed for a weekend in Chicago.  Would absolutely stay here again.

Nuestra estadía fue maravilloso. Desde el primer día hasta el último. La casa es preciosa, limpia, muy cómoda y con una excelente ubicación. Nos sentimos en casa desde el primer instante. Muchas gracias Priscilla por todo y hacer que nuestro viaje sea de maravilla! Millón gracias!
Ensavi was a great host - the apartment was clean and as advertised with a top location
Great location, the house is very nice and indication are very easy to follow !

Ebony and Ean were incredible hosts who were extremely kind and proactive in making sure I was comfortable throughout my stay.  The space was clean, private, and easily accessible via all forms of public transportation.  I enjoyed meeting their adorable baby girl and feline friend as well. Highly recommend!

We had such an amazing time at Naomi’s place. It was clean, comfortable, and had ample space for our group. Our one recommendation to people renting is bring ear plugs because of apartment noise. Not a big deal for us.

So easy to find and get into! Such a great space and the kitchen was so easy to use. The shower had extremely low water pressure, and the air conditioner means you'll hear every noise outside. Easy walk to the 22 on Clark and the Morse stop, we love Rogers Park!
Perfect for our trip! Would stay again

We enjoyed our four nights in this spacious apartment and wished that we could have stayed longer.  The view is fantastic and the proximity to the Red line and grocery stores is ideal. This was our third time renting this specific place and we will be back again in the future.

Hard to find a 2 bed 2 bath in Wrigleyville and this one was perfect! First floor, great outdoor area, well stocked kitchen and bathrooms. An easy walk to the ballpark.  Hope we get to come back soon!  Oh yeah, don’t miss the bakery and Italian restaurant one block away!
We had a wonderful stay at Caroline’s place. Very easy to work with and felt right at home for the long weekend.
great place in gold coast, small kitchen and poor water pressure in shower but otherwise no complaints!

This was one of the most well thought out places we have ever stayed. Johanna not only has a beautiful, well stocked home, but she also thought of every little detail to make our stay comfortable. We loved having the balcony for morning coffee and the neighborhood was surprisingly quiet considering everything we needed was a 10 min walk away. Thank you for sharing your beautiful home with us! we will for sure be back soon!

This was the perfect home for our large family gathering. Plenty of space, and 3 bathrooms! Felt so homey, comfortable, and clean. Beds were fabulous! Kitchen was perfect! Walkable to a great coffee shop & bakery. Had private parking. Having 3 floors gave everyone plenty of space & the sunroom and back deck were an added bonus! Lovely neighborhood! Junni was very responsive & provided everything we needed and more! What a great find for us to be able to comfortably stay in town for our daughter’s wedding! If I could give 6 stars, I would!
Spotless place and responsive host!

This has been hands down my favorite place to stay in Chicago area. It was so clean and he took extra steps to accommodate my fragrance allergy. I loved walking around the neighborhood and the filtered water machine in the dining room. The basement is super nice with a great bathroom. It was even better in person than the photos. Very close to the Beverly Arts Theatre! Perfection, thank you Robert.

Great spot and so easy to get to! Can take the blue line right from the airport and get dropped outside. So much good food around, right in Logan Square area. Really enjoyed the place and would recommend!

I will say, location was perfect for everything we wanted to do. Walkable to soldier field is less than 20 min, walkable to Chinatown in less than 15 min. The host was super responsive and specific on the directions for check in, but it wasn’t easy to locate upon arrival initially. The space was as expected, but the space was 57 degrees when we entered, assuming cleaning must have turned it off and forgot to turn it back on. The only thing that bugged me was that there were no rugs in the bathroom. We had to use one of the hand towels to put down when we were getting out of the shower. Other than that, parking garage was easily accessible, spot was great and worth it in this area. Area is noisy outside but expected and nothing unmanageable. Overall, great spot. I would recommend it!

Very clean and comfortable if you don't mind commuting. Neighborhood definitely quieter than downtown and very close to lake.
Great deal and closer to Hyde Park if Neighborhoods are part of your exploring. I'm glad that the inside temperature was steady.
The cold/hot water settings seemed switched around in both short and faucet.
There are neighbors but they also observe quiet hours.
The chairs at kitchen table were flimsy and closet doors were kind of rickety and off tracks.
Otherwise great place to stay!
Loved the neighborhood!
Great location and was a perfect place to stay for our trip to Chicago.

Literally Wrigley Field right outside your door!!!
Only thing I noticed was the lights are very dim, some of the hallway lights are burnt out. The big bay window in the front room looking out at Wrigley field was awesome, only downside is the shades are still broken (like someone previously mentioned in a review) we couldn’t get it down after we opened it.
We could definitely hear the people at the sports bar at night and in the alley.
As expected the L train was heard in the last two bedrooms!! We expected noise being there for game days!
Over all we had a great stay!! We enjoyed our time and would recommend this place to others!!

I’m so glad we landed here for our first stay in Chicago. Christi was so helpful and friendly, here place had very thoughtful touches and was very comfortable. I definitely recommend it and will be my first choice when looking to book a place near downtown. Thank you Christi
Overall good experience, how very friendly and responsive. Kinda far the city but only around 30 mins with no traffic

The host blamed me for being loud even though the neighbors were having a literal party and other events were going on near the home. Host was also upset that we rolled bikes through the grass to park them on the patio, and was not happy about guests who were meeting us at the home, but were not staying. The host threatened to involve bnb and kick us out, but after I explained all of this, they left us alone. Overall wasn’t a bad stay but did not appreciate being watched like a hawk, definitely more on edge than other experiences. Some of the neighbors were also not nice about sharing parking. 7/10 overall

I hosted 10 family members here for graduation including kids and pets & they all loved it! The home is beautifully decorated and we enjoyed the privacy of having an entire house to ourselves, which is hard to find for a fair price in Chicago. It even includes free garage parking which is hard to come across. The check in/out process was easy and the owners were extremely accommodating to all of our requests. Everyone had a comfortable place to sleep even with a large group. We also loved that they are pet friendly! The gorgeous decor was also a great backdrop for a few graduation photos. I would definitely host a large group here again. The owners are so quick to respond to messages and were so kind before/during/after the trip! 5/5!

In a great location and quite spacious. Love the space theme! Would make a note that the staircase down to all the beds is very narrow and spirals down, difficult to move a checked bag and larger suitcases downstairs. No problem with carry on bags!

We loved our stay here! The place is just like the photos and we felt right at home. We loved the little details like snacks and slippers. Host was quick to respond when I had a question and took care of us with no issue. Lots of cute restaurants and shops within a short walk, and the neighborhood was quiet and inviting. We were in town for a concert and a Cubs game, and it was short ride to both. Easy to get into town and the lakefront. We'd definitely stay here again!
Really unique apartment in a great area

BEAUTIFUL. GREAT SPOT. Spent 3 nights/4 days here and it was exactly what you needed. Great lil room, beautiful kitchen with everything I needed, clean apartment/bathrooms. It’s an entire apartment with about 6 rooms (for other guests). Every other guest was quiet/to them selves and dont mess with you/stuff in fridge/bathrooms.
Walkable to L train for city trips/fun.
Great food/spots nearby.
Host is responsive and great for recommendations!
The only thing I adjusted to was:
- sharing 1 full bath with other guests - BUT she mentions this and everyone is quick with bathroom use.
-No tvs present (assuming for loudness or limiting disruptions between guests). I brought laptop/projector and was fine.
-the chickens next door may wake you up in am, BUT she mentions this and it wasn’t every morning.
All and all I recommend for closeness to downtown, cleanliness and how great the spot was!!
Loved it! No disappointments!

My group of 8 had a wonderful time in this lovely apartment! It was spotlessly clean and had every amenity we needed for our stay. It was located in a lovely, quiet neighborhood, but still close enough to walk to coffee spots and grocery places. The host is super friendly and very responsive. Beds were very comfortable (if you like firm mattresses and pillows), and we had plenty of extra linens and towels for our stay. Highly recommend!
Great host great location

Overall, it was a great stay!
I had to reach out because the radiator seemed like it was always on and we were getting pretty hot even running the AC unit. The host was responsive and had someone come in and shut it off quickly.
Pretty much no matter what time I messaged somebody replied within a timely manner and that’s heavily appreciated. The area itself was beautiful, felt very safe and the perfect place for us to crash after a fun day in Chicago :)

Nossa estadia foi ótima, estava com minha folha de 18 meses, a a Veronika rapidamente conseguiu montar um berço para que ela se sentisse confortável, deixou ruído branco, fralda e brinquedos, isto fez toda diferença 🫶🏽 super recomendo
We enjoyed our stay there! Very clean, nice location. I wish the room had a mirror and trash can, but overall it was good!

We loved our stay at Celia’s place! The apartment was very nice - clean and comfortable. The location was fabulous! Very centrally located. We had a car and there was always parking available. We also found public transit very easy to navigate. Celia was a wonderful host. She was always quick to respond to any questions! Would absolutely recommend staying here if you’re looking to visit Chicago.
Patricia was very helpful and responsive. everything went smoothly
Alex's place was great for our group and close to our activities.  Great place!

Place was as advertised and perfect for family reunion weekend.   Plenty of cafes and restaurants nearby.  Short walk to Cubs game and to lakefront path. Perfect gathering spot for our family and easy Chicago area relatives to meet for dinner!

Peter's spot was a PERFECT location for Wrigley, local bars/restaurants, and hopping the train to get to other spots around Chicago. The place itself was roomy and clean with plenty of room for our group of 3. Peter was very responsive and worked with us on check in/check out to accommodate our changing flight times. I really appreciated the communication and generosity and would stay there again!
Good place for a visit to Wrigley.
Very helpful when we had trouble with the lock, not sure about the area if your concerned with safety but as long as your aware the Airbnb is well protected and nice to stay in compared to a hotel!

Joanna and Michael were truly great hosts. They were so quick to respond to our questions and had recommendations for things to do around the place. Their Airbnb was clean, tidy, and I loved their decorations throughout the place. The place had a coffee grinder which we used daily and the coffee was amazing.
They both made our stay in Chicago great, especially since it was my mom's first time going to Chicago. They made us feel welcomed and we would definitely book with them again!

If you like being in the heart of the city this is the perfect place! It is central to all the best parts of Chicago, with great sight-seeing, shopping and restaurants within a few minutes walk. The hum of city life is your background music and all the sights of city life are at your front door. It was a delightful stay!
Great location, even had sound machines in both rooms
Place was very nice and cozy! Stephanie was a terrific host and very responsive the few times we had questions! Would definitely stay here again!

Cuando llegamos no había sábanas y abrigo de cama para todos los ocupantes. La vajilla es de plástico, inclusive los vasos! Tiene faltantes de equipamiento como pava o tostadora eléctrica. Dicho esto, la respuesta de Rafael fue inmediata y nos proporcionó las sábanas faltantes, pava y tazas de loza ante nuestro reclamo. Destacó la respuesta del anfitrión pero se trata de cosas que no debiéramos haber tenido que pedirlas dado el precio del alojamiento.

Not only was Lisa’s place lovely, she was also a great host! Checked in on us multiple times and gave us awesome recommendations. As for the place it was very clean and relaxing. Wonderful experience and a wonderful person!
Very nice place, walkable to lots of food options. Great place to stay if you have a large group, lots of beds and most of them are California kings so very spacious.

Kim’s place was exactly as shown in the photos. When we arrived, it was clean and the air conditioning was already on, which made our arrival very comfortable. The apartment was conveniently located close to shops, restaurants, and bus stops. We had a great stay and would recommend it to other guests.

We were in town for my daughters wedding. The place was just as the listing was described. Best words to describe is that it was clean, spacious, and the hosts were attentive. I was even able to add 2 additional guests to attend my daughters wedding last minute. A definite place to stay when you are in Chicago with a large group. We had 8 total, and it was spacious for all of us. Would highly recommend this place!  5 stars hands down!

Very affordable AirBnB and very helpful host. They frequently checking in, make sure that everything was good for the guest. The house is close to multiple bus/train lines. Check CTA rate (ventra) out since driving in the city is painful.
Of course shared bathroom wasn’t ultimately pleasant I know. But for the rate we paid, I can’t complaint about that.
Definitely recommend if you looking for a low budget place to stay in Chicago.
Great place and an even better location. Would highly recommend to anyone looking!
Great stay with the family. It’s exactly as described and we loved the house. It was clean and lovely!
Beautiful Chicago Charm Home! We literally had 2 living spaces for the price of one! Very clean and walking distance to alot and great location to catch the bus to Wrigley Field and downtown

Stephanie is a gracious and welcoming host, and her place is terrific. The apartment is just the right size, with all the comforts of home and a fabulous view of the city. The location is great as well. It was super easy to get to everything we wanted to see and do. Highly recommend!

Victoria was an amazing host! Her Airbnb was in a perfect part of Chicago and made getting around the city super easy. She was extremely accommodating, very knowledgeable about the area, and gave us some awesome date night recommendations during our stay. The Airbnb itself was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a great getaway. Overall, it was a fantastic experience and we would absolutely stay here again!
Cute place - great location. Perfect for two!

The Nook was almost the perfect place to stay. It's a very quick 10 minute walk from Wrigley Field, if that's of course what you are there in Chicago for, as well as great access to local transportation, both Bus and the L Train, if you wish to explore other places around Chicago.
David also provides a great refrigerator stocked full of filtered water, oatmeal, and lots of soda.
I would definitely not hesitate at all and stay again at the Nook when visiting Chicago to watch the Cubs.

Place is right in the loop and a block away from Macy's.   Note, the L is right next to apartment.  Bring your earplugs and eye mask.  The place was great for us.   Easy to get in and unload our car.   Clear instructions to get in.

Great Acommadation
In the centre of the river north area lots of bars all within a short 5 mins uber or 20 mins walk
2 floors apartment, spacious bedrooms and a huge open plan living room / kitchen area downstairs
3.5 bathrooms all clean

Cynthia’s place was spacious and airy.  The decor was interesting maintaining historic elements while being very comfortably decorated.  The gardens in the back were so well maintained and beautifully planted.  There was great parking as well.  Really a find!
The Airbnb was extremely cute, clean, and such a great location to walk to restaurants.

The host was a actual doll!! The sweetest! The Airbnb was everything that was shown online, it had easy check in and check out. The Airbnb space was clean and homey creating this wonderful space for our stay !! 10 outta 10 recommend
We were very happy, it was in a convenient spot for us. Neat place.
Excellent stay.  Apartment was very clean, well apportioned and comfortable.  Communication was excellent - very responsive and clear.

It was a a clean and comfy place to stay. It is walking distance to the bus and Metra electric which makes it easy to get to downtown.  Marijes was very communicative since the beginning as we had a very late check in. Only reason I’m leaving 4 stars is due to it being an older building which is bound to have its own issues that are outside of the hosts control. During our stay the power went out and there was no hot water. Marijes was responsive as soon as we communicated the concerns and provided us with updates.
Great area for a reasonable price!

Steven was extremely kind, responsive, & his home was wonderful!! A private oasis in a quiet neighborhood with close proximity to incredible restaurants, beautiful parks & a short walk from CTA to access the city! Would recommend to friends & absolutely stay again!
Brett was a fantastic host — super easy to talk to, considerate, and kind. My girlfriend and I had a wonderful time staying with him in Chicago, and we’d highly recommend booking with him!

The place is extremely upscale and gorgeous for a small group, family in our case. The views are breathtaking, the quality of construction, furniture, layout, equipment is top notch. It's a short uber away from downtown Chicago. Great place for either work or holiday.

The hosts are wonderful. The space was clean, beautiful, and things were clearly labelled. Instructions for check in and out we're thorough and clear. Communication was quick, clear, and friendly. The neighborhood is quiet and close to so many restaurants and stores. Genuinely a 5 star stay!

I loved staying at Chris’s place. Everything was so nice, clean & just beautiful all around. Chris was very helpful, friendly & always responsive. We were given a tour of the home & neighborhood recommendations. I would definitely stay here again. 10/10 recommended !!
Close to a lot of things to do! Very clean and looked like the pictures! Host was also responsive and nice

It appears exactly as described: communal living arrangements, kind of like a hostel. The other guests were quiet, kept to themselves, which is fine. Not as close to the subway station as hoped, which made getting around town inconvenient. Noise didn’t bother me — I slept through it — but I could see how it would bother someone who is a light sleeper. Also, I understand the proactive approach to gaining income, but I recommend the hosts wait for the guest to initiate a request for extra nights. I didn’t request it, and it causes unnecessary confusion because the language suggests that we overstayed. Keep things simple. It would be nice to have extra towels, by the way. Towels and linens are thin. It was kind of cold at night. Good on a budget.
Great spot - close to the lake and walkable to Wrigley - had a great time!
Enjoyed our stay immensely. The house was cozy, comfortable and clean. Bonus that it was within walking distance or Aragon Ballroom and lots of delicious food choices.

Clean facilities and secure stay. Really neat building in a vibrant, cool area of Chicago. Parking was a bit of a pain, but that’s to be expected when staying this close to Wrigley Stadium on game day. Would absolutely recommend.
Excellent!
Great place for our large family to gather in Chicago. Host was helpful and responsive. The house had plenty of space and was very comfortable.

They are very nice polite and have safety concerns for their customers.
Willing to help you out with anything
We would certainly consider using their service again
Was a great place to stay really close to Wrigley, and the Astros got the sweep!

Had an immense blast staying at Jane’s! A stones throw from the the brown line and close to Lincoln square, not only do you have warm hosts and a cozy and comfortable space, you’ve got a great neighborhood to hang out at or easy access to the entire city. Would totally stay there again if visiting!
Enjoyed our stay, it was great!  Thank you!

Overall, this place is okay for a short stay, but I wouldn’t recommend it for a longer trip. It has true Chicago charm and character, but with that comes some quirks that may not work for everyone.
There’s very limited storage space for clothes because a lot of the apartment is filled with decor, so unpacking for an extended stay can be difficult. The location is great, parking was easy, and it was nice and quiet during the day.
A couple things to be aware of: the washing machine did not work during our stay. The host mentioned the previous guest broke it, but after looking through older reviews, it seems this has been an ongoing issue for a few months. Also, there are only two wall AC units, and they struggle a bit during muggy Chicago summer weather.
Overall, decent for a quick trip if location and charm matter most, but there are a few comfort and maintenance issues to keep in mind.
Would rent again

Had a great time at this Airbnb. The pool table was a ton of fun and it easily fit our four guys for a good weekend away in Chicago. Great location using the Blue Line from Ohare and walkable to lots of restaurants and more.

This is a basement apartment, nicely remodeled but without a kitchen sink (one must use the laundry sink and carry things back and forth). One also hears yelling from a child, and feet clomping from a child and one adult in the evening and on weekends.
The family did their laundry (in the apartment) while I was there (but I wasn't allowed to use the laundry).
The house is in Rogers park, quiet area with good access to transit.

Ryan and Elizabeth were friendly hosts who have clearly had many guests. They made sure I had all the info I needed and the room had everything you could possibly need, beyond what a typical stay provides. The room is large and the bed was very comfortable. There were occasional noises from the family or pets but nothing that wasn’t shared in the listing or that was disruptive. The location is well south of most of the tourist attractions of Chicago but the University area has some really cool spots. There was plenty of street parking and the buses and L made it easy to get into the city.

I host Married Couples Retreats in the Chicagoland area and Dan’s place was the perfect place to host our most recent one. It was spacious enough for 4 couples. Every couple had their own bathroom and bedroom and there was still extra space. The backyard with the firepit was perfect for our couple bonding discussions. It was also close by many of the activities we had planned in Chicago! Our guests loved it. Dan was also very responsive throughout the whole experience!
Nice location for baseball - Wrigley field is only a 20 minute walk and the red line stop at Sheridan is an 8 minute walk away.  The two beds were comfortable.

Our group of 3 friends had a great time in Chicago. The unit has what you need for a short stay in the city, Ewa was really responsive, and the neighborhood is nice. There's some good food options (including grocery stores) nearby which is also nice.
Perfect location. Super communicative host. It was great stay.

This air bnb was amazing! It was clean, quiet, the perfect size, and was a great price. Bedrooms were a good size, as well as the bathrooms and the living room. Perfect place for a group of six girls to hang out in. Brandon was flexible and friendly! Like some other reviews say, there weren’t very many wash rags and towels for the size of our group. We ended up bringing our own to get us through the weekend. Other than that, we had no complaints! Such a cute house. I would stay here again!
Great location; Russell is very responsive to any questions. Highly recommend!

location was good for our travels, the neighbors were very friendly and welcoming. it was city quiet, no issues. the responses from host were great. easy parking, check in and out, everything to clean up after yourself was easily located. comfortable room for guests. homey feeling with decorations, plenty of towels, washer and dryer if needed was nice. the backyard did need a little help but was still  private area to sit in the morning
Love the location with everything you need within walking distance. Easy in and out with privacy. Close to public transportation, all was a win win
Great place and area. Super responsive and a great host
Best place to stay if you are in town for Cubs’ game!!  What a great spot!  Very clean & comfy!!   Too bad Cubs were in a slump and lost both games we attended.   Ugh!
Beautiful home
Quiet room, good experience
Song’s place was convenient and easy. Was a great place for me and my friends to reunite and he was very helpful when we arrived earlier than expected!

This place was very comfortable and pleasant! Would absolutely stay here again, but hopefully the balcony area is repaired and accessible for guest use next time. Other than that small inconvenience, Jen's place is wonderful :)
Overall a good stay.
Very comfortable.  Renovated home..
Great place to stay in the city! Walkable to so many different shops, restaurants, convenience stores, etc.. Check in was very simple and the host is very responsive and helpful.
Was close to the city. Nice for if you need a place to crash if you’re fairly busy

The property was perfect for our family group attending a Chicago wedding. The manager Jerry lives close by and was friendly and helpful - and made sure that gaining entry was easy and smooth. Lots of coffee shops, bars and restaurants an easy walk from the house.
Responsive host. Nice stay. Perfect for our group. Very clean.
Very good stay
We had a great stay!  The space and neighborhood was as described.  We would stay here again if we find ourselves back in Chicago.

Excellent experience with the property and host. Had a large group all coming from out of town, and the host communicated effectively to ensure we were all prepared for the weekend. Highly recommend the property for a large gathering!
This is our second time staying in this building.  Quiet, beautiful place near our family who we visit. The location is great!

Brian was a fantastic host and issues we had or concerns he addressed them asap and did great on communicating with us during our stay . The location is a little out dated. Other tenants in the building were loud at night but Brian did his best to notify the building owners and communicated the issues. The other thing to consider is the 4th Bedroom is not a real bedroom its a small game room that would be ok if you are a child not an adult.

Tara’s place was just what we needed while we attended a wedding nearby! We stayed with our 2 little kids under the age of 4 and she had a lot of amenities on-site like a crib for our baby.
She had coffee stocked and we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Our kids loved the playground in the backyard and we were able to walk to a close by breakfast diner! Great location.

This was our first time traveling to Chicago, and this apartment was a great stay! We loved that it had it's own parking, easy to find, and located short drives from everything we were there for. All the apartments amenities were perfect! Afghan was very responsive and even sent back my son's backpack that he forgot.
There were only two downsides. The first being the trash cans were placed for pickup in front of the driveway, so we had to keep moving them. Also, people would park so close to the driveway it was sometimes hard to get out. And we couldn't find any trash bags anywhere in the apartment. We may have missed them, but that might be something to be available if they are not.
We will definitely book this apartment again the next time we are in Chicago!
great place to stay that’s not directly in the city but close enough for travel to and from
10 out of 10. Would stay again

Great place in an awesome location. Very walkable to anything you would want to do in the neighborhood. Close to blue line, so easy to get downtown if you want. Host was responsive and everything was easy. Lovely little spot.
Everything was great!

The stay was great, exactly like the photo and description. The only piece we didn’t understand was that we needed to share IDs of all 8 guests. What we read was only the primary person booking needed to provide ID.

This is probably one of the best stays I’ve ever had, the house is so beautiful even with an elevator, which is so convenient. Tim was kind enough for me to check-in a bit early, he and Barbara are both really welcoming and responsive. The room and bathroom are both super clean and cozy, the bed is really comfortable as well! There are people living in other rooms but does not feel crowded or noisy at all. Neighborhood is very quiet and safe, the nearest cta is walkable. Would definitely recommend to people who are tired of living in downtown.
We loved the apartment! We eere so shocked with how much space and the neighborhood was nice too
Great place for our group. Walkable. Rooftop was amazing!
Great place to stay! Just as described. Marcos was friendly and communicative. Lovely plants and art in the apartment too.
this was a perfect place for our weekend getaway! within walking distance to the train right into Chicago and also some nice restraunts within walking distance
Overall , great stay !!

Pleased upon arrival, place looked as described and as seen in photos. After being there a little while a few issues stood out. 1. Safety of main concern. Only one exit, front door. Windows in bedrooms don’t open enough to exit through so if something happened at main entrance would be difficult to exit basement apartment. 2. Large crack in shower/tub flooring. Floor of tub moved with each step. Made it unsteady during shower. 3. The subway being close is listed in description but the loud noise of the trains passing isn’t. Sounds like loud thunder every 5-10 mins for 22 hours a day. Makes it difficult to sleep at times. Can’t open windows to help cool down apartment at night because the train noise is even louder with windows open.

The unit was booked months in advance and up to date information was sent as the booked date came close which was reassurimg. Instructions were clear and thorough. The host was responsive and available to assist with questions regarding the unit and local area. If you are the tall type, 6" plus, the ceilings are low but the space feels very light and open. Would highly recommend if looking for Chicago accommodations for those wanting to venture north of the hustle and bustle. We walked the neighborhood and rented bicycles to get around with ease.

Good spot. Close to the airport and local stores. Hosts were very responsive and they let me park earlier than checking time. It’s a plus that the place has a parking spot designated in front of the unit. The living room area is big enough to accommodate 2 more people but the couch isn’t that comfortable. Bed is great tho.

This place had plenty of space for our large group. The kitchen was well stocked with everything we needed to prepare meals, and the A/C worked GREAT during a warm weekend. However, we did have a plumbing issue and discovered the water pressure was weak when we ran 2 showers at once--which made it a bit slower for us to get ready in the morning.

It was a nice and clean place. Very cozy. Unfortunately, the walls were a bit too thin, and we could hear people from outside since the place was on ground level and we didn’t wanna open the blinds coz then people would just see right in since the road is like right there. The water also did not get hot. Lukewarm at best. Other than that, it was a great place, with a lot of great food spots within walking distance.
Would highly recommend Carrie's place for a stay in Chicago. Was very close to Wrigley, trainsit, and was overall an awesome place to stay.

A great little spot in a quiet nook of a fun neighborhood. Exactly what we were hoping for. Close to bus stops, fun bars and restaurants, and shops. I appreciated the private side entrance and Kerena was kind enough to let us drop our bags off before check in since we had such an early flight.

Great place in an area of Chicago with great night life, food options and ability to take public transit.  The home is nice and cozy with modern amenities.  Bathrooms were nice and clean, beds were soft and comfortable.  Very relaxing stay from all the activities worth doing in Chicago.

This rental was exactly what we were looking for and John & Kyrsten were great hosts.  We really didn't need anything while we stayed- all the instructions ahead of time were clear and made the whole stay seamless.  Thanks for a comfortable place to call home for a few days while we visited Chicago!

We had a nice 3 night stay. It's a very private place, but very close to Broadway and all of the restaurants and activity. The space fit our needs of a party of 4. Fully stocked kitchen, full sized laundry and plenty of room for our family. Pleasant host that is very responsive. I would rent here again.

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great — close to amazing food, coffee shops, and everything we wanted to explore in Pilsen. The space felt welcoming and well cared for, and communication was easy throughout our stay. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!
Nice place overall and the host was very nice plus communication was top tier
I appreciate you accommodating me.

Fantastic location! You can't beat the proximity to the Aragon Ballroom and the Red Line. If you are worried about city noise, it was surprisingly peaceful. Being so close to public transit made getting around Chicago effortless. Hosts were very proactive and responsive.

Great space, neighborhood, and host! Can't get much better than this! The neighborhood was quiet, safe, and close to all gentrified hipster fun! Foodies and vintage shoppers will be in paradise. Loved the exercise trail nearby. Would love to stay here again!

Overall clean. Great Bathroom & Kitchen. A bit compact.
Furniture was not in good condition. Mattress was very Saggy.
Elevator & common areas were not clean.
Aaron was incredibly responsive and flexible! His space was clean,  and a short walk away from the station.
Jacki was great! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to stay in Chicago!
Enjoyed 2 nights at this cute clean Airbnb. Walked or took the bus everywhere with ease. Took the train in from the airport, cheap and efficient. Would definitely stay here again! Thanks.
This place is amazing. Honestly, the pictures don’t show the beauty and character of this establishment. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. Will make this spot a regular space when visiting Chicago.
Great location and beautiful apartment.

Edwin was really nice and welcoming. He was very responsive to any questions or accommodations all you have to do is just communicate. The place was clean and easy to locate and near the city the only issue I had was it being located near a train so noise wasn't amazing. But other than that, I would recommend staying here!
Cute place in a great location. I would definitely recommend to anyone and would absolutely stay again!!

Great place and excellent location! Easy access to public transportation, restaurants, and grocery stores, which made everything super convenient. The place was comfortable and exactly what we needed. We had a great time staying here and would definitely recommend it.
Perfect place for two families to stay when in town for family reunion. Comfortable sleeping arrangements. Great amenities and responsive host!
Beautiful, really well equipped apartment on a lovely green street. Close to public transport but also easy to uber to places. Would recommend!
Place was clean  and nicely set up for families! Close to coffee shops and stores. Also really great park nearby for kiddos. Loved our stay!
Great stay and a host team that communicates effectively. I am a host myself so it was great to see them doing a good job! A lot of walkable spots around here.

Very clean and very responsive host! Mostly quiet area and close to a convenience store! Plenty of places to eat nearby and close to museums and aquariums. Street parking is not easy. paid indoor and outdoor parking available and recommended! process to get remote/key card for parking was easy. industrial vibe. minor things here and there would have made the stay perfect. decent price for being so close to all the attractions of the area

The lodging was super clean and the owners thought of all the little things.  In my opinion this is one of the best places to stay when going to Wrigley! You get the full walk to the field seeing all of the restaurants and bars on your way. Easy access to a conscience store and fast food too. Knock Wrigley off your bucket list and have no worries by staying here!
I had a great and comfortable stay!
Ashley and Amanda could not have been more kind and accommodating.  The home was exactly as advertised and very comfortable.  We plan to come back for future visits.   Highly recommend.

While more costly than other properties we looked at, I have stayed in enough short-term rental to know that you get what you pay for. Isa's building and this particular apartment were incredible. The neighborhood is quiet and incredibly walkable. And, having a reserved parking spot is key.
As far as the interior, it's exactly as shown in pictures and as described. The open space between the kitchen and living room is spacious and amazing. And the view....holy crap!!!! The view is everything!
The apartment was perfect location for my family and I. Very comfortable and clean. Would stay there again and recommend.

This was an excellent place to stay. It was conveniently located near downtown and was also close to local attractions. I would definitely stay here again. The place was clean, the staff was friendly and responsive, and the overall experience was great.
It was so lovely. The nights were so quite you did not feel like you were in the city. There were plenty of towels we were a party of 11. Outside setting was more than plenty. I would book again.
The condo was a cute little space for a few nights in Chicago! The hosts were kind and provided useful responses if any questions came up. Great place for the hostel experience!

Brad’s place is spacious, clean, and conveniently located near grocery stores, public transit, restaurants, and parks. It’s an ideal spot for families. If you’re in the area, I highly recommend this place.
Fantastic place to stay.  Great location and great back yard
My family and I had an absolutely wonderful stay here and felt right at home! Highly recommend for anyone visiting the Chicago area. :)
Great stay at Song's. Great location and place was very clear. Timely communication
The place was beautiful! It was very clean and we received constant updates with our checkout rules! The host was extremely friendly.
Tom was a great host and will look forward to his place in the future the next time i am in Chicago!
I had a great time everything was close by

Nice and clean place with no problems for me during the 5 nights I stayed. Great price. Good neighborhood. An easy few minute walk to the bus stop that brought u to a train station. I would definitely stay again.
Wonderful spot in the heart of Chicago. Views were excellent and was very close to transit and local spots.
Peaceful stay in a nice neighborhood

El departamento es tal como se ve en las fotos: muy bonito, limpio y excelentemente equipado. Lo mejor de todo es el estacionamiento que está justo detrás, lo que te da mucha tranquilidad y seguridad para el coche. El único detalle en contra es el aislamiento acústico: nos quedamos dos noches y la primera fue difícil dormir porque los vecinos de arriba se levantaron de madrugada y se escuchaba absolutamente todo, especialmente el agua corriendo por las tuberías cuando se bañan. La segunda noche fue mucho más tranquila. Si tienes el sueño ligero, quizás no sea la mejor opción, pero aparte de ese detalle, todo estuvo excelente
Great location, nice amenities, responsive hosts.
10/10 would recommend
Akiko e seu marido são muito atenciosos e queridos. Foi uma excelente hospedagem.

We had an awesome stay at this Airbnb for our weekend in Chicago! Joe & Stephanie were great hosts. They were very responsive and happy to assist with any questions we had.
The location was amazing. It’s about a 30 minute walk to Wrigleyville and it’s mostly shaded and through residential area. The street was very peaceful yet just a 5 minute walk to great local taverns and restaurants.
The space was perfect for a group of 6 guys. The beds were comfortable and big enough for us to share. The living room was a spacious and a great spot to unwind. Two bathrooms is an also a huge plus.
I would recommend this spot to anyone who asks!

Very cozy space, and just down the street from the green line, so there was easy accessibility to the city. The space had a lot of amenities which was very convenient, and all the rooms were clean when I arrived. I also like easy access to the washer and dryer. Everything about my stay was perfect!

The hosts were nice and meant well, but the space was very poorly maintained. They Vacuumed the rug and cleaned the tub more upon request. Floors and outer perimeter of room was quite dirty. Very strong odors that I can best describe as musty odors from prolonged water damage.
We had a great stay at this beautiful home. It was a perfect location for everything. And couldn't have asked for a better, and proactive host!
lovely place, accommodating host, good location
Great location, very clean and easy to get in and out of.  Was a great stay and the host was very nice.
Bobbie was a wonderful communicator and had such a beautiful stay! Very close to park near by and such a cozy Chicago apartment.
Such a nostalgic feel ! Made my cousin and I feel like kids again and reminded of my grandmom’s childhood home! Thank you!

Pasamos una buena estadía! Destaco lo amable que fue Natalie y como siempre respondió rápidamente. Estaba cerca de la blue line lo que nos facilitó llegar al centro. Departamento super amplio, ideal para grupos grandes.
Nice place, good hosts

I had a long term rental and my stay was great! Evan has been incredibly kind, responsive, and accommodating throughout my trip. He made everything easy and I felt welcome from the moment I arrived. His communication is excellent, and he went above and beyond to ensure I had a great experience. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this space to others!! Thank you, Evan!!

The place looks even better in person than it does in the photos. The location was excellent and only about a 15-minute walk to Wrigley, which made getting around super easy. The space itself was huge and had more than enough room for our group of 5 to spread out comfortably. Hayk was incredibly responsive, accommodating, and flexible throughout our stay, which made everything even smoother. We had a great experience and would absolutely stay here again.
A nice place to stay, owner is responsive and very flexible with schedules. The hospitality given during me and my friend’s stay was awesome. I would recommend.

Tessa was nothing short of amazing. No complaints about her or the unit. The area was a different story. Me and my family were going out to see the Michael Jackson movie. We were just getting into our car when we were illegally searched and harassed by the police!!! We literally didn’t do anything wrong. Horrible experience. I am still traumatized. Very high crime area. You hear gun shots a lot during the night. I recommend never calling the police in that area because it can go very bad for you even if you’re a victim.

A very nicely furnished and spacious apartment. Host was very attentive and communicative. Minor inconveniences RE ceiling fan remote and lack of any laundry products did not significantly impact overall positive experience.
Exactly as advertised. Awesome weekend in an A+ location.
Beautiful townhouse in a convenient area. It was everything we expected and we will be back. Thank you!

Great stay in Chicago
We were a family of 4 people and had a wonderful stay at this place. It was spotless, well‑kept, and stocked with everything you could possibly need for a comfortable visit. The host was very responsive and made the whole experience smooth and easy. The subway was just a few minutes away, which made getting around Chicago super convenient. I’d happily stay here again.
Great place, location was awesome. Kate was very accommodating.  I’d stay here again in a heartbeat.
We had a great stay and the space was perfect and was exactly as described and pictured!

First air BNB I’ve booked personally and i couldn’t have been more please. Unbelievable experience and a very easy going host. Worth the price and i will gladly stay here again next time I’m in Chicago.

Tracy was an excellent host, very responsive and  friendly. Great location close to Wrigley Field and Southport, with multiple train stops nearby. Wonderful options for breakfast, coffee, and restaurants! Would certainly recommend to those looking for a very pleasant stay in the Chicago neighborhoods, and especially if planning to visit Wrigley!

Kate's studio was a perfect space to come back to while my husband and I toured apartments in the area. The space was spotless, had a fantastic bathroom with a rain shower, and a small kitchenette with unlimited bottled water. On top of all the amenities it was situated in a gorgeous garden on a quiet street. Would recommend to anyone!

Alexandra was extremely welcoming and made us feel at home. The birds were a fun part of the stay and we enjoyed interacting with them! I’m also now obsessed with the Bryn Mawr Breakfast Club that is just a couple minute walk around the corner! I would stay again any time I’m in Chicago.

Very nice Airbnb. Very nice and responsive host. Would absolutely stay here again even though the locals, Lyft drivers, all seemed to share the opinion of its located in a rough area. We had no issues. McDonald’s right next door is convenient.

Joseph’s studio was the perfect place to stay! The directions for check-in were simple and easy to follow.
Street parking could get busy, but we were always able to find a nearby spot, even with a larger vehicle. The school across the street was absolutely stunning and made for perfect morning and evening walks.
The neighborhood itself was beautiful, cozy, and quiet, with many people out walking and enjoying the area.
Although I didn’t use the train, the station was only a short walk away, which was very convenient. There were also plenty of parks, dog parks, and greenery nearby that made the area feel peaceful and welcoming.
I would absolutely recommend this lovely studio and would happily stay here again!
This is a hidden gem in Lincoln Square and Michael is an extremely responsive host. We loved our stay here and would definitely stay here again and recommend to others!
awesome place spacious for having your local group over while in town, really  great food all along your street too.
Great neighborhood! Amazing apartment!
We loved the location, so easy to walk to so many places. It was a great stay, comfortable beds, kitchen had everything we needed. Definitely would stay here again!
Location was great with plenty to do within walking distance. Communicated great and made sure we knew all the information and that they were there to help if needed.
Perfect place. Great communication
Very good at responses and accommodating
Amazing location and we are very comfortable with property, it’s clean.

This Airbnb was beautiful, and in an excellent location. Everything in the listing was upfront about the noise from the passing Blue Line, and nobody in our group found it impossible to sleep through. Would stay again with a larger group.
Lovely home with great location! It accommodated our family of 10 easily and we appreciated all of the attention to detail!
Jake communicated well and the bed was very comfortable
Had an amazing stay. Street parking was easy to find, check in was simple. Place was walkable to restaurants and Wrigley! Would definitely stay again.

Our first time traveling with our dog and this was the perfect place! We had great food and so many places were pet friendly and walkable! Miranda was very welcoming and always available! Such a fun Airbnb!
This place was perfect and cozy. The train station and a bus stop was so close by, it was perfect to get into the heart of the city and to travel around. The photos matched the place perfectly.
Great place to stay!
Great place to stay, easy walk to Wrigley

Unfortunately we found the place to not be that great. It was a bit dirty and smaller than the pics suggested. The worst part was there were mice in the apartment. We caught one but there was another one we saw.

We fell in love with Cindy’s home! It was beautiful, spacious, and in an incredible location. It was close to the blue line and to many cute shops and restaurants. Cindy was kind enough to offer local recommendations and we loved every spot we visited!
Excellent stay at Natasha's!  Couldn't do better location-wise.  She was also very accommodating with us...even provided a pack-n-play for our little one.  Would stay again!
A clean place with comfortable beds, and great communication. In town and convenient location, but still not noisy. Highly recommended.
The instructions were clear, checked in no problem. Very close to the transit which made exploring very accessible.
It was great! Perfect walking distance from the brown line that took us all over Chicago. And about a 20 minute walking distance from Wrigley. We loved it definitely recommend!
Stay was good.

Nofar was a great host, helpful and responsive.The apartment was clean and well furnished. Good location just a few minutes drive from Lakeview and Lincoln Park. Nice reserved parking spot behind the apartment. Really enjoyed and was comfortable during my stay.

Christina’s place was perfect for me. I highly recommend you check her out if you are staying in Chicago and need a place to stay.
Amazing spot!  Right outside is he 9 bus which was so convenient. The place was clean and super comfortable.
Angie was very responsive and accommodating. highly recommend if you are looking to explore the city sights!

Loved our stay here. Perfect, quiet neighborhood street within a 10 minute walk of greet restaurants, markets, and parks. A fantastic experience and place to stay that’s private, cozy, and easy to travel around Chicago from! Checking in and out was a breeze and we appreciated how communicative and responsive the hosts were regarding any questions we had during our stay. Definitely had a wonderful time visiting.
Would recommend staying here!

I don’t usually write reviews but for this one I have to! Don’t hesitate just book and trust me on this. Perfect for families and friends only 25 minutes from downtown without traffic and plenty of restaurants and stores near by for convenience. The host made this experience even more amazing such quick response time and they fixed any minor problem we had. Thank you guys so much I will be using this home again for my next stay! If you don’t book I know I will ;)
My partner and I had a lovely stay. Lois and Eduardo were very quick to answer any questions we had. I would recommend booking here if you’re exploring Chicago.
Everything perfect, clean, great location

Apartment is nice but not worth the hassle with a host who only cares to make a profit. My group was accused of being “reported” by residents in the building of previously renting this space out and throwing parties. However, we have NEVER stayed here before. An apology was later provided supposedly confusing us with another group - don’t believe it. Also accused of smoking weed which we did NOT do. Threatened with an undisclosed $1000 fine for smoking in unit along with “security” being called if we did not stop. My group and I were respectful and responsible of the rented space. Lack of proper communication from the host yet sent several threats and complaints to us over activities we were not a part of is shameful. Do better.

This was maybe my second or third time renting an AirBNB and I can say I’m not disappointed. The space was huge and just like in the photos. Nestor was a great host. very responsive. I would stay at this property again.

Great place, lots of space, fridge was even stocked with fresh fruit. Highly recommended!

good time nice place
The apartment was very clean with nice comfortable furniture and a well stocked kitchen. Andy was quick to respond when I had questions. Check in and check out was very easy.

However, the neighboring unit played loud music late into the night on multiple occasions, and one morning there was loud banging and commotion outside beginning around 5 AM that continued for quite some time.
To the host’s credit, communication was polite and responsive when we reached out, and the second night’s issue was addressed more quickly. However, the repeated disturbances made it difficult for our family to rest and significantly impacted the overall experience.
For the price point and expectations set by the listing, we were disappointed that the environment did not consistently reflect the quiet and upscale experience

beautiful area, my guests and i really enjoyed it. the air bnb itself was amazing and had enough space and privacy for everyone. definitely will check out again for a future chicago visit. We had a wonderful stay at Robert’s place. The location is unbeatable, the accommodations were incredibly spacious, and the property was stocked with everything we needed. Highly recommend.

Latarsha was extremely kind to my partner & I. Very friendly and Warm welcome! she was very attentive to us & very respectful as well. This place is beautifully designed & very well maintained. Exactly the type of spot we were looking for. A perfect walking distance for a Cubs weekend with the guys.

Definitely an awesome stay!

We went to Chicago for a weekend away and loved Joseph’s place. There are some things to be aware of.
1) the parking situation can be tricky. There is free street parking available, but being in a busy neighborhood there’s no guarantee you’ll have a close spot. We arrived about 10pm and had to park 3 blocks away. We had much closer parking available the next day. Not a deal breaker at all. But something to be aware of.
2) the street the apartment is located on is a BUSY street, and it could get a bit loud at times in the living room and kitchen. The bedroom isn’t as close and is much quieter. I wouldn’t call this location a peaceful location, but if that isn’t a deal breaker for you it’s a great spot. It wasn’t a deal breaker for us and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Finally, the host is very gracious. I made a big mistake and took their key with me and had to overnight it back. Joseph was a pure class act and was very understanding.
Would absolutely stay here again.

I needed a clean, no-pets place to stay for 2 nights while on attending an event in the Ravenswood neighborhood. Kareem's place in Roger's Park was as described - a clean, well-appointed room and bathroom in a spotless home. It is downtown Chicago, so it isn’t a “quiet” neighborhood- but that was totally expected.
Everything was just easy, and we would definitely stay again.
Great stay for three people, walkable to transit with good parks and food nearby, very clean interior and easy check in!
Great spot!

We really enjoyed our week here. We came with three adults and 2 children under 5 and it was plenty of room.
You are on the 3rd floor of an apartment with no elevator. Parking free is possible but at least 3-5 minute walk except when loading/unloading.
Adorable coffee shop in the building right next door. Walkable area and awesome play place/coffee within 9 minute walk. Subway was close too within 10 minutes.
The traffic is very loud in the far bedroom next to the road. Our child slept through it and they provide ear plugs but it’s helpful to know if you’re a light sleeper.
Plenty of linens provided and washer dryer. Water pressure is not great when using two faucets at once just a heads up and it takes a while for the bath to fill up. Not sure if it was an issue with the seal on the stopper or what.
Very clean place! We definitely could stay again.

We had a wonderful stay! The location is great in Uptown and the dedicated parking spot was perfect since we had driven into town for this trip. The unit was clean and as described, and had all the amenities we needed and then some!

Me and a friend stayed at this bedroom while we were in Chicago a couple of days for a concert. John was very helpful going over the AirBnb and the house as a whole. The street was pretty quiet so no issues there, and easy to park too. Would highly recommend this AirBnb.
Place was clean and functional. Neighbors were quiet. Loved the walkable neighborhood. Dogs and dog parks everywhere. Little back patio area for morning coffee.
Great location!
