its a nice place in a good location and the host was responsive and friendly. we only had one small issue and it was resolved quickly! only complaint will be that the floors are creeky but it should be expected from an old apartment. Overall a great place to stay and I will book again for my next visit!
Very helpful and welcoming!
Thank you for a nice stay! This is a clean and comfortable place to stay within walking distance of cool neighborhoods in Chicago.

Was a bit concerned when I messaged a couple of times a few days out and received no response--however, the day of arrival we received instructions on entering.  We enjoyed our stay--quiet neighborhood that felt safe, street parking by the front door, quick walk to the metro to see the sites, clean house, and fast wifi.

Was surprised by our experience after seeing all the five star reviews. Apartment suited our needs, but we would not stay there again given the state of our stay. Floor had clearly not been cleaned. We kept our shoes on because our bare feet/socks became visibly dirty after walking around the apartment. Towels need to be replaced, they were old, mismatched and thin bare. No coffee grounds provided for the drip coffee maker but there is an excellent cafe (5800 Cafe) down the street. One pro, laundry detergent was provided with the washer/dryer!
Un lugar muy limpio, bien comunicado y los anfitriones siempre atentos
Olga's place was great. It was easy to find and great for the price.

This was an amazing place! Great view of the city, and close to very good restaurants. They had a ton of outlets for your devices and a ton of towels, which was a huge plus!! The bed was extremely comfortable, and probably one of the best beds I have slept in. The check-in process was smooth and straight forward. The only issue we had was one of the showers that was close to the living room, the water pressure was inconsistent, but we were still able to wash up properly. Would recommend this place overall!!
Great host, very responsive. Will def be back. Amazing location.

Great location, generally clean place.
However:
Water temperature at the shower was either scalding hot or ice cold and very little in between. Host should also allow guests to leave their bags behind in case of a late flight… that would have been great.

Tucked away, private, and cozy little studio. The Chicago pollen gave us bad allergies (we had no idea pollen could be like that, lol!), and Marcus was quick to bring down two big air purifiers immediately when I brought it up, and he checked in to make sure we were doing OK. Friendly and so helpful! Explained everything when we arrived, too. Loved our stay.

Had a great stay at Musa’s place. I appreciated the videos explaining the parking and entry into the unit. His unit was clean, has all the amenities listed and the parking sport was worth its weight in gold. The beds were super comfy! We would definitely stay here again when we come back to town.

My sister and I took our mom for a visit back to Chicago after having left 52 years ago. A childhood friend joined us.  We had the best time possible at Nicole and Matt's wonderful apartment! The location was perfect for visiting downtown and getting anywhere in Chicago. The apartment was clean, comfortable and well-equipped. Nicole was amazing at responding immediately and very accommodating to our needs. I would highly recommend staying here. We can’t wait to return!  Robin
Very lovely to talk to and very lovely of a place to stay in. Will reccomeded to anybody who needs a quality stay and host.
Great Stay, Clean place and we were able to check in easily even though we got there late. definitely Recommend

Really enjoyed staying in Matthew's place. Super comfortable and a great vibe. Quite cozy. Very walkable area and great food.
Would definitely stay again
Great stay! In a great location in downtown Chicago.
Such a cute place! In a quiet area, walking distance to the brown line, was a perfect spot to rest between everything we did while we were in town.
Wonderful place. A great location near so many things - restaurants, Second City, Lincoln Park and the train. Clean and comfortable.
My boyfriend and I stayed here for a week and we had a great time. The place is close to the train and seems to be in a very safe neighborhood.
Beautiful getaway
Great stay, close to public transportation and good food. Would recommend.

We had a great stay at this Airbnb! Everything was exactly as described in the listing, and the area was very peaceful and relaxing. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely book again in the future. Highly recommend!

Cannot in good conscience recommend any unit with this host.
Check-in was brutal as they sent communications on how to enter via email, text and the Airbnb App, each of which contained one tiny piece of information needed to enter the unit.
They had the incorrect Wi-Fi name written down, and when I called for the correct Wi-Fi, their solution was to put me in touch with their Internet service provider as if their ISP knows the name of the in unit Wi-Fi.

Excellent stay all-around!

Our stay at Ann’s was super nice! it’s so close to the blue line which became the main artery of transport for our trip. We felt connected to the whole city. The house itself is close to the main road which makes it super easy to find.

We loved staying in Divya’s place! Very convenient to travel to (located a block away from the red line and several buses) and within 15-20 minutes walking distance to the mag mile and downtown. Her space was updated, clean, and private. She was also incredibly responsive to any questions we had about the space. Highly recommend staying here.
Enjoyed the stay! I would book again ✨
Ideal spot to stay in the city! Everything is walkable and the train is nearby. Would 100% book again.

We had a great experience at this Airbnb! And would definitely stay there again.

The place was great to stay except for maybe you could hear some noise when someone walked or went to restroom. Noise isolation could definitely be better.

Very clean accommodations in a safe neighborhood . I very much appreciated the dedicated refrigerator space, which enabled me save money on meals, and the free laundry. We had a wonderful stay! The property was in a great location, exactly as described, and the host was responsive and easy to work with throughout the process. Everything was clean, comfortable, and made for a great experience. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

El hospedaje está bien ubicado a unas cuantas estaciones de metro del centro y en mi caso que fui a unos juegos de béisbol al Wrigley Field, la misma línea roja te deja en el estadio, el barrio es tranquilo y pude descansar y dormir muy bien, cómodamente, lo recomiendo y si regresaría a hospedarme aquí.
Great place, much larger than what I thought it would be by looking at the pictures. Very relaxing and has a lovely garden. Eileen was very available, would recommend

Great place to stay! Lots of space and Sujata and Brian were super friendly. The place is bigger than the pictures look, and everything was well setup and clean. Would love to stay here again!

This space was perfect for our family. Milan was really fast with responding to our questions and accomodating. We needed to get in early and it was possible. Parking nearby was a huge bonus, and easy access to cta red and green lines.

I hope I will be able to come back there in the future. I genuinely recommend this place!

Incredible neighborhood. Ron was very accommodating. I stayed for a few months and the place was perfectly located. Inexpensive ubers to downtown, walking distance to the gym, target and the grocery store.
Beds were super comfortable, more than enough space for extra family or guests.
Highly recommended for large group.

The place was very nice, very clean. The host works great with guests. The only somewhat inconvenient thing is the surrounding area. But for the price and everything else the stay was great.

Awesome rental! It is  a basement converted to a living space. Pretty easy to get to by using public transportation. Downtown via transit is about 20 minutes.  I will definitely stay here again!!

I have nothing but good things to say about Irena’s place and would stay again! It was exactly as described/pictured. The space is small but well appointed and the kitchenette is a wonderful bonus. The water quality in Chicago is inconsistent so having the filtered fridge water was a treat.
Irena is very proactive and clear with her communication so I was never left being curious about check in or basics like the WiFi password.
The space is set back behind a house (you will need to be able to walk up/down stairs) which means it has a very private and tranquil vibe. That being said, the entire neighborhood felt very safe and walkable. There were always other people out on the streets pushing strollers and walking dogs. It’s also a five minute walk from the Western station, great coffee, nice bars, and Margie‘s candies.
For those highly susceptible to noise, you may want to bring earplugs. The unit is downstairs, so we heard footsteps but no other noise from the upstairs unit.

Would definitely stay here again!

This hotel was fine, nice clean room and very friendly staff. What stands out here is the location. Its within walking distance of great shopping and eating. Only valet parking and it cost about $80 a night. There is a public garage about a half Block away however for my single night stay I just did the valet
Our week long vacation in Chicago was a blast and Bryan’s apartment was a part of the reason for that. Spacious, pristine and centrally located, this property was perfect for us.

Great place to stay! Felt very private and cozy. Super short walk to the train which was very convenient for exploring other parts of the city.
There’s lots of places to eat and explore that are walking distance. The garden apartment was exactly what was needed for our trip. Will stay again next time we visit Chicago.

I would stay in Claude’s apt again. Comfortable bed. Great water pressure in shower.  Entire apt very clean including bathroom and kitchen. Claude is very easy to communicate with and is helpful and friendly.

The apartment is located in a beautiful area, close to bus stops, parks, and the lake. The apartment itself was nice and clean. That said, we did have some minor issues during our and one larger one. Conditioner was not provided as advertised (we purposely didn’t bring because it was listed as an amenity). The guest bathroom sink drained slowly. Previous guests’ trash left in the under-sink trash container. Blackout curtains in primary bedroom, but not secondary bedroom causing some sleep issues. The biggest issue happened our last night. The primary bedroom light, which is operated only by remote, turned on by itself around 1:30 a.m. The remote would not work, and the bulbs could not be removed without a ladder. It turned off 30 minutes later, but turned on again around 4 a.m. and stayed on, leaving us with very little sleep before departure.
Overall, it was a pleasant stay, but addressing the issues and adding a light switch in the primary bedroom would make it perfect.

The place was exactly as described. Very clean with cute decor and comfortable furniture/beds. Emily  communicated well without me even having to reach out and let us check in early. The park nearby is one of my favorites yet!  I would definitely recommend staying here!!
Great location.   Private and Clean!  We could walk everywhere … lovely stay!
We like it it was quiet and close to the bus.

We absolutely loved our stay! The home was exactly as described and the amenities were lovely.  It is perfect walking distance from Wrigley! Justin was a fantastic host and we will certainly book here again on our next trip to Chicago. 5 stars!! ⭐️
Great place to stay for going to Cubs games!
Yolanda’s home was beautifully laid out, clean, and modern. Super comfortable stay. One of the nicest Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in!

We enjoyed our stay at Elizabeth's place. The location was great and was in walking distance to restaurants and the train to get into Chicago.  We were spending time as a family here before a wedding in Wisconsin and the place was comfortable and plenty big enough for all of us.

Kim was very communicative, which I appreciated, especially regarding an issue with the second door into the building and a broken switch for a light.
The price was good for the area and an easy trip to the trains for downtown.

Kelly and her family are wonderful and we couldn’t have asked for anything more in the apartment. Close to blue line, easy parking, would stay again!

The place was as described. Street parking was available on request. Host was always responsive. Beds were comfortable. The ceiling isn’t high, so tall people might find it difficult in this space. We had plenty of dishes and silverware for all of us to enjoy our meals together. And the backyard! The backyard was so beautiful with the fire pit and gazebo area lit up. We pulled out the cornhole game a couple of nights and enjoyed after-dinner hang outs and it was the perfect ending to spending all day walking around Chicago. The beds are on the firm side, which was great for us, and there were plenty of pillows and blankets. We were only minutes from an Aldi so stocking groceries was super easy too. Highly recommend this spot!

Amazing stay, in the heart of Chicago! Plenty of room for our group of six guys. Whatever food or necessities we wanted could be doordashed or walked to within 20 minutes!  I definitely recommend her and would stay again!
Great host. Extremely convenient location. Clean and quiet.

Lovely stay! The apartment was comfortable and easy to stay in. It felt like we were guests in someone’s home. We loved being in Logan Square with the restaurants, coffee and close proximity to public transit. Highly recommend

It's a good stay for a couple of nights, especially if you plan to be out and about most of the time. The apartment is in a great location, the space is clean, and the room I was in was large with a comfortable bed. As others have mentioned, it's essentially a hostel setup with a handful of rooms, but I only briefly saw other guests in passing.
If you are a light sleeper, just beware that the walls are pretty thin and there are big gaps above and below the bedroom doors so sound travels easily. Best to bring earplugs just in case. Thankfully, the other guests were all respectful of the quiet hours.
Otherwise, Charlie was very responsive to messages and I had a good two days in Uptown.
Great location and communication by the host. A bit loud as described but I didn’t mind the music from downstairs but you also hear the traffic outside.
Great stay! Hosts are very friendly and helpful. The location is perfect.

Kelsy’s place was perfect for our three night stay! The place was cozy, clean, and had just about everything to accommodate guests. It was in a great area just a short walk from the blue line which made getting around the city super convenient and Kelsy was very quick to respond to any questions and overall welcoming as a host! Would definitely stay here again :)
Great location. Nice space, enjoyed my time here.
Our stay was smooth sailing from booking to check in and check out. Apartment is conveniently located in a busy and fun neighborhood.

What a gem of a place! The home was absolutely stunning, and it was clear that so much care and thoughtfulness had gone into preparing it for guests. Every detail was just right. It felt welcoming from the moment I walked in. I would stay here again in a heartbeat and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a special place to call home, even if just for a little while.
Truly a lovely apartment and Brett was fantastic!

I enjoyed my stay. Close to the train and close to U Chicago. There's a park across the street and then a main street that holds a lot of traffic. This was my first time in Chicago, definitely different from what I'm use to. overall very convenient and I had no problems.

Much to our disappointment, upon arrival we realized this place is more of a hostel, with 5 rooms sharing 2 bathrooms. It was described as a room being rented via AirBnb and the host living in the house. Thus, getting bathroom access in the morning was a challenge, especially when check-out time was nearing.
Having many rented rooms meant being at the mercy of other inconsiderate guests who neither cleaned up after themselves (lots of hair in the bathrooms) and also often took an excess of 20 minutes for a shower. (fine at home, but not when many people waiting their turn).
The kitchen was also a sore point, as there were no paper towels or extra towels for cleaning up the table, counter and drying up the cups and dishes. The fridge is nice and large, thankfully. The kitchen trash cans were also constantly almost full, as there are no trash cans in the individual rooms. This also means the upstairs room guests have to walk downstairs to throw something away.
Clean place and great location.
Talk about a hidden gem! Spacious, modern, clean and classic. You will not be disappointed with this outstanding property and the amazing amenities. I can't wait to come back!!!

We had an incredible stay! The apartment is really spacious and felt like a home away from home. The location is great, walkable to lots of bars and restaurants and super easy to get into central. Gina was super responsive and helpful. Would 100% recommended!
John and Terry are fantastic hosts and their house is practically situated in a cool neighbourhood. Tons of things to do and the public transport is very close by. Will definitely come back.

Great location, safe area and Jewel right across the street and lots of street parking close by. Has washer and dryer in unit.
Pictures are very misleading, unit is very small and couch or sofa couch is very uncomfortable for sitting on. Definitely only suitable for one person.
Water pressure is poor, takes four minutes for hot water to come through tap in bathroom sink and then it is only a trickle. There is no thermostat in the unit and that is quite annoying, if you want to control AC and heating you have to ask to get access to the unit owners Google home which they did give me.

This property is a 10 out of 10! It’s in a great location, close to restaurants, bars, and public transportation. The host is responsive and the apartment is high-end and thoughtfully designed. I highly recommend it.
Decent for price. Nice place

Wonderful location, truly a steal for the price we paid. Beautifully decorated, very clean and well maintained. The bathroom was nice, the kitchen was lovely, and the layout is extremely spacious with plenty of room to hang out as a group, eat a meal, or just relax. the beds were comfortable and there were fans in each room to help with summer heat. I cannot stress how convenient this location was while still being private and peaceful. Super close to buses and the Brown Line, and the ice cream shop down the way was a delightful local spot to have nearby. The door to the bedroom was very hard to open, and the bathroom door did not lock, but these are such minor problems compared to everything great about the place.
Accommodations clean & spacious.  Everything worked as expected. convenient electrical outlets, lighting, and even an HDMI connector for the large screen.

We aren’t comfortable city drivers and this home was an easy-on/easy-off the highway. Parking was accessible and the neighborhood is perfect: safe, quiet and very walkable. Excellent landing spot for our family for the week. Would definitely stay again… thank you, John!
As advertised! Clear instructions for check in. Comfortable beds. A bit loud at night from street noise but wasn’t a big problem for us. Lots to do in neighborhood.

Loved this place! It was so clean which is a HUGE plus for me. I really hate to see strings of hair left all around a place once I check in and there was absolutely no hair lingering around. I travel and stay in different properties at least 3-4 times out of the month, every month, & this was one of the only Airbnbs where I didn’t feel icky. Along with the cleanliness, it’s in a very quiet area and not far at all from the Downtown area. So if you have the chance to book this place, DO IT!!! Just don’t book it while I’m in town please? lol!

Had the most wonderful stay at Bozena’s place in Lincoln Park. She was very accommodating all throughout my stay and made sure to introduce herself and make me feel at home! A great location and a beautiful apartment, could not recommend more!

Great place to stay. This home is beautiful and is way bigger than it looks in the pictures. It is super comfortable, and the master bedroom and master bath are the gem of the home. Would definitely stay again.

This place was better than described. High ceilings, huge private master bedroom w large closet and spacious bathroom.
High quality linens and the most well equipment kitchen we’ve ever seen. Everything you could want in a home was available.
Full size washer drawer and plenty of towels, blankets, pillows, and more.
Beautiful outdoor patio w comfortable seating .
Centrally located to all that Chicago has to offer.
Excellent owner response and communication.
Definitely will stay again. Hopefully for longer than 4 nights.

Very comfortable and relaxing!! Natasha was so nice and very responsive. They also provided complimentary snacks, Prosecco, coffee creamer, fizzy waters, coffee etc. which was above and beyond!! The beds were all of different levels of firmness but all really comfy. It was clean, nicely decorated, the multiple patios and hot tub also amazing. Great place for a much needed staycation!
This was a great place and Joseph was a great host. Would definitely stay here again.

La casa es muy bonita, fue una estancia muy agradable, la cocina es genial, tiene todo lo necesario para preparar los alimentos y tener máquina y cápsulas para café es muy bueno.

The listed a/c unit was missing and it was in the 80s our first two days. We reached out to the hosts right away who said they would look into it but then we never heard back. The weather cooled off on the 3rd day but some communication would have been nice. Two minor issues, otherwise we had a nice stay.

We had a great stay at Milan’s place. It was perfect for our family of 6. Was exactly as described , clean and comfortable. Had everything we needed and walkable to lots of restaurants and small grocery stores .
We enjoyed our stay. The house was clean and we loved how close it was to Wrigleyfield.
We enjoyed the stay! Perfect spot to go to when traveling to chicago!!

We really enjoyed our stay here. The place is spacious and well-located right by the blue line train (which is underground and not audible from the apartment) and any amenities you may need. One of the best air bnb I been to it’s clean comfortable and affordable perfect stay for you and a partner and Luana was very helpful

Great place!  Great stay! Great location!  I very much enjoyed my time here. We enjoyed several home cooked meals while staying here.  Easy and free street parking in front of the place.  Thanks, Kory for a great stay.

The place was very close to the city and in a gorgeous spot, the photos matched the room perfectly but you do stay right next door to a family. I also found a lot of hair in the sheets on the bed and was able to get replacements but they also had some hair on them. Maybe I’m a bit of a germaphobe but 🤷‍♀️. If you’re looking for somewhere to stay, you can definitely find a place for a better price or the same price and be more comfortable.

The location was perfect and ability to park our car was a huge benefit. Restaurants, coffee shops, and Lincoln Park were all within a short walk away, as well as extremely safe and clean streets. We would stay here again!

This was the perfect place to stay in Chicago! Great hosts, easy directions, super cute location above a vintage store. Being on the 4th floor we didn’t hear much. As with all apartments we do hear our neighbors a bit- but that’s expected.
It’s a very trendy neighborhood, with miles of hole in the wall restaurants, bars, shops, in all directions which you can eat at.
We were able to do a little food tour of our own- where we got a sushi thing at one place, a taco at here, a pizza slice there, ect all for under $30.
Super walkable area. Busy and safe sidewalks, and the Blue line train is less than a 5min walk away. We took the blue line straight downtown to the Riverfront and then Millennium park.
Definitely scope out SpotHero for parking. You won’t need your car really, and there’s a lot of cheap spots within 5-10min walk. While there’s lots of street parking, I wouldn’t rely on it.
It was a great 11 nights stay. Well equipped kitchen and amenities. Conveniently located. Bathroom was clean and maintained. Overall I enjoyed staying there!
Lovely place! Host very helpful. Highly recommend!

We really appreciated having dedicated parking right outside (car too big for garage).  Beds were comfortable and the home is beautiful -- we'd love to go back again! Thanks for the great stay!

We had a great time here, it felt like home and being away at the same time. Tony was always easy to reach although there were no issues. Will stay again absolutely!!

Joan is an exceptional host and her place is a hidden gem to stay at while you’re in the city. It was close enough to what I needed to do while I was in town and equidistant to downtown so we could explore the city in the evenings.
The bathroom was clean and it was a cozy space to hang out in. I will definitely be staying again.
Amazing experience very clean. Will come back again.

This is a perfect location! Great walkable restaurants and easy access to the redline and busline for quick ways to get to all Chicago has to offer! So close to chinatown! Very close to museums and the bean!

Amazing location. Host was awesome. Place was beautiful. My husband, son and I stayed for a couple days and had such a great time. We went to a Cubs game and were able to walk which was so nice. 10/10 recommend.

Demetri's place has been a great starting point for my recent visit to Chicago: It was easy to find, comfy, and tastefully decorated, and all amenities etc. were fully functional; the place is in a great neighborhood that felt safe to me, and close to lots of restaurants, coffee shops, and other spots on N Lincoln Ave. and around Lincoln Square.
Connection to downtown Chicago is very convenient, with two subway stations (Rockwell and Western on the Brown Line) within a short walk. Trains can be heard crossing an overpass nearby; hence, if you are sensitive to noise, consider bringing earplugs.
Demetri is an engaged host: very responsive and also proactively providing helpful suggestions.
I really loved my stay at Demetri's place and highly recommend it.

Great find. The apartment is spacious, clean and well equipped. The CTA bus stop is a few steps away and the bus takes you right into the heart of Chicago. Covered parking is a big bonus, however you gotta maneuver your car through a tight alley. There is a supermarket less than 5 minutes walk away if you need to do groceries. Serg is a responsive host who took care of all our needs and answered any question promptly.
Clean, spacious, great location! Easy walk to public transportation, close to great restaurants, bars and grocery store.
Great Stay. Would Love to go there another time.

This Chicago Airbnb is in an ideal location and was spotless upon arrival. The host, Kattlhy, was friendly and fast in responding to messages, ensuring a smooth experience from start to finish. Our family of six enjoyed our stay. Everything was as described and Assel was great to work with. Brown Line train very nearby. Neighborhood was fairly peaceful. Would recommend and would be happy to stay again.

Awesome spot and location on a cute and quiet Ravenswood street. Easy street parking and check-in, clean house, and a very responsive host!

I’ve stayed w Lydia many times before, and her place is consistent… clean, quiet, and affordable… my go to whn visiting chicago!!.. free street parking  and a block away from transit….kitchen is well equipped, and there is even a washer and dryer… great place to stay!!…see u next time!!

Tuğba is extremely communicative and pleasant! We really enjoyed our stay overall.

Brad’s place is very well located and very clean and comfortable. Thank you!
Musa’s place was great! They are a gracious and responsive host.

The windows look out over a parking lot to a religious institution, so it was very private and quiet. One peculiarity is that it is part of John's larger home, so the unit does not control the temperature. We did lean on a space heater two chilly nights, but it worked fine. The bathroom is nice and the water was plenty hot.
I would not hesitate to stay at John's in the future.

I would only consider staying here again at a lower price point and with better cleaning. At the current rate, a hotel with standard amenities like a pool or gym would offer much better value.

the place was quite nice, comfortable and clean, jennifer was always responsive and attentive

Perfect two bedroom spot on the north side. It was a very convenient location to move around the city from. Super cozy and quaint. I would definitely stay again and refer friends. Thank you Caroline

Yolanda is a great host and runs a great AirBNB.  I highly recommend her place.  She is very responsive to our needs.  I have rented both the upstairs and downstairs from her and would rent from her again.

this place really takes care of details, from bathroom amenities, stocked coffee machine, etc. loved the attention to detail

Spencer was a nice host who was quick to respond immediately when we needed something.

Perfect place for more budget friendly Airbnb. Place is super clean when we arrived. Jennifer is super responsive on our questions even when its late. Love the Accommodation that she gives. The train is a little loud but when your on the city, your pretty much will be tired at night and not even notice. the surrounding is super safe  so no need to worry about anything dangerous happening.

Excelente ubicación del alojamiento a tan solo pocas estaciones del Chicago Loop, así como transporte público muy cercano para llegar. Totalmente recomendado si quieres tener una excelente estancia en tu visita a Chicago.

You are paying for a great location with this unit on Michigan Ave across from Grant park- walkable! Simple efficiency unit, host was friendly and responsive. Felt the building could have had better upkeep.
Overall it was an amazing experience and I really enjoyed the Airbnb it felt very homey
Everything was great - the location, the space, the check-in process. Would happily stay here again!

I honestly can give this place a B-/C+. It was hard to find the key to get in, the “A/C” was not installed and when it was, it was one old window unit that in 2 days did not drop the temperature of the apartment by 1 degree. The ice maker did not work and I asked for ice cube trays which I did not get. There wasn’t even a sponge to clean the dishes. The place looks great online. TERRIBLE LOCATION. All of our uber drivers said whatever you do don’t walk around the neighborhood. Druggies and gang are in the area.  Loud people parties and security with gun at the front door. Had to run into Ubers since felt completely unsafe.
Had such an amazing time at this Airbnb and highly recommend to anyone who wants quick access to the city but not in the middle of chaos! Steps from the beach this place is a fantastic find!

No conocí personalmente a Mo & Ganna, pero siempre pude comunicarme con fluidez. El alojamiento era tal cual lo publicado. Todo muy limpio y ordenado. A unas pocas cuadras del Wrigley Field y de la estación de metro que te lleva directamente al downtown de Chicago.

Luis was very kind, helpful with a quick response to any question. I’d recommend his place very much!

The host, Ron, is very sweet and responsive! When our code didn't work, he quickly fixed the issue within a couple of minutes.
The location and price point were also great!
The bedroom was clean, and the bed was comfortable enough. The room had what we needed.

Overall, for the price point, it was a good place to stay for a couple nights.
Airbnb was great, it had complete household amenities and the host was easy to communicate with. Place was comfortable and clean.

We stayed for five days leading up to our son’s wedding and a couple of days after as well. The kitchen was excellent with good countertop space, which allowed me to make the groom’s cake, an additional sheet cake, and 15 dozen cookies for the wedding. Senada even made her own mixers available for my use! We had a couple of issues with the door entry keypad and a blown fuse, but she was very accommodating and helpful with getting those issues resolved. We appreciated the beautiful space and made so many good memories with all of the events leading up to the wedding!
would high recommend! we enjoyed our stay very much :)

Good value for money. Chad was very responsive and the place was clean. A few things I would want future guests to know - this is a basement unit, there is no access to the external patio, and both bedrooms have queen beds. Would have preferred to know these details upfront. That said, I would recommend the place to anyone.

If you're a Cubs fan or a fan of baseball in general, there is quite possibly no better location than this. It's a 3 minute walk to Wrigley Field and under 10 minutes to great shopping and upscale restaurants on Southport as well as a Jewel market and CVS. The unit is clean and bright. The best feature is the 1200 square-foot rooftop patio without outstanding views of the Chicago skyline. The kitchen is well appointed with everything you would need, including upscale Café appliances. There is a private parking spot in the garage behind the unit. That said, in five weeks we only touched our vehicle once to pick up a friend from O'Hare. From the first time that we reached out for the booking through our entire stay, Victor was always responsive.  I would highly recommend a stay here and longer would be better than shorter. Personally, my wife and I did not want to leave.

Marjorie is kind and communicative. The apartment itself is well maintained and very comfortable, and my friend and I really enjoyed our stay.
The main downside was the condition of the building and the lack of a functioning elevator, which made arrival and carrying luggage more difficult. Overall, still a good stay, and the unit itself matched expectations.
I would recommend this stay to a friend!

Caroline was very friendly and responsive to any inquiries I made. Her home was lovely, clean, and had great amenities. Would recommend to anyone looking for a great place to stay in the Bucktown neighborhood of Chicago!

My family and I had a great stay at Leah’s place! We were in Chicago visiting family who lives nearby and needed a space for my husband and I, our two kids and my mom. Great location, easily accessible, super comfortable and Leah was a great communicator. My mom is older and has some mobility issues and Leah was very helpful in detailing number of stairs, accessibility, etc. We loved that it’s a first floor location with a short flight of stairs to access. It seems to be a very new renovation and we might have been the first guests or one of the first - so there wasn’t a lot of “extras” compared to some of the other airbnbs we’ve stayed in, but we had the basics needed to sleep comfortably, use the kitchen, and get ready. Would definitely stay again in the future!

This space was absolutely amazing! Although it was in south Chicago and away from the touristy areas, I wouldn’t have wanted to stay anywhere else. It was very spacious and the downstairs was a PLUS! We will be back and stay here again!
Fantastic host! Very helpful and informative about the local area. Checked in us prior to arrival time. Gave clear directions. Made it a very enjoyable experience

Great people and great stay. Highly recommended!

Unfortunately, I let a pretty face get the best of me in booking this property. It looks like a great find from the photos. However, I went against my rule of booking exclusively with Airbnb Superhosts, and lived to regret it. The check-in wasn't easy as there were several access codes and pads to figure out. Finally, the property manager  informed me that she has to open the door remotely the first time, something I wasn't told.  I emerged from the elevator on the floor where the unit is located to be greeted by the very pungent odors of marijuana and cigarette smoke in the hallway--the smoke never let up. Outside the door of the unit I rented, there was grime and grit in the corner of the carpet. Once inside, having driven for five hours, I couldn't wait to take a hot shower. There was no hot water and I was told once I called about the issue that it takes 15 to 20 minutes for the water to get warm. Get the picture? Keep looking as these folks obviously launched prematurely.

You can’t beat the location! You’ll be just steps away from the Red Line, restaurants, and having the grocery store in the building was super convenient. The views were incredible! The doormen were welcoming and very friendly. We stored a luggage without issue (be sure to provide a nice tip).

Upon checking in, the upstairs unit was cool but the AC in the downstairs unit was not working. Brad was quick to respond, but even after fixing the issue, the downstairs unit never got completely cool.
I also wish I did see a couple prior reviews before booking. We booked this space for a bachelorette for a group of 8 girls and did not feel comfortable. We arrived on a Saturday and were sleep deprived from an early flight and long day. There were a ton of people loitering outside drinking/smoking/playing loud music until 3:30 am and many of us did not sleep. This seems to be a regular occurrence so it's ironic there are supposedly strict "quiet hours".
This is not the hosts fault by all means and out of their control, but a warning or heads up would have been nice.
Lastly, not all the windows were closed when we came and some amenities were in one unit but not the other.

The location is convenient to most areas with a short commute. Property was clean and spacious. Kitchen is well stocked with basic small appliances. There were very few scented products used for those who are sensitive which is a plus. There is a fair amount of road noise for those staying in the bedroom closest to the road. The water pressure was acceptable in only one bathroom for showers. It would take very little effort for the property to feel welcoming. Unfortunately, it feels like a basic rental with the bare minimum spent on bedding, paper products, etc. Multiple people mentioned the water pressure issues previously and it has not been fixed. Overall a decent place to stay.

This 3 bedroom is a classic Chicago apartment layout. It was clean and looked exactly like the photos and description. Quality linens and comfortable beds. Close to buses, red line, and lots of delicious places to eat. Joan is an amazing host with quick communication and easy instructions. Great size apartment for a family. Highly recommend.
Great house which is not too far from downtown! Full of amenities and game room. Host was very responsive and friendly.

This unit was a great place to stay- we had a total of 5 people! Check in instructions were clear. The pictures were a little more polished than the actual unit. Unit is on the 2nd floor, so if you don’t mind stairs it’s not a problem. There was some wear and tear throughout the unit (furniture, walls, floor, etc) but that’s to be expected. Neighborhood was very quiet and safe! Parking was a challenge and inconvenient, but Regina made that clear in the description. If you’re looking for an affordable place close to downtown, definitely check this out! Keep in mind it’s an older building and has normal wear and tear.
Not the best experience. Great location.

The location is excellent - close and walkable to everything but on a very mellow, quiet street. The unit is spacious, quaint and has lots of character. There is a cute coffee shop right on the corner. Check in/out was very easy and the hosts were very responsive.

This was my very first airbnb stay as a guest and in shared housing. Delia’s place was available on short notice, conveniently located  and affordable. She was very attentive in making sure I got in ok and offered alternatives to my late check in. The other guests were friendly and it was very quiet and peaceful in the house which was most important to me.

Spacious cozy home with beautiful backyard.

We had a lot of fun and places previously picked out for restaurants so it was nice to come back to a calm quiet respite. Danny was a responsive host and it worked out perfectly for the 5 of us. Grateful.
Great area, great unit, and stellar communication (in general and in terms of check in specifically). Would definitely recommend for a solo traveler or couple looking for a place to stay in Chicago!
A great place to stay in a great location! Would stay here again.

When I arrived I was instantly struck by how inviting this apartment is. It's reminds you of 1997, in a good way, where there's no such thing like 'ai' and the rest of the world disappears once you turn the tv off. Peaceful, with character, and where you can just exist and appreciate the moment.
I opened the guest book for the wifi information and found myself engrossed in this apartment's world. Yep, I agreed, that's a good point, I thought. I read the whole thing, cover to cover.
The word to describe this apartment is unusual, in the best possible sense. If anything it's an indictment of what is 'usual' and one marvels that all apartments aren't like this.
David, Aaron, please take me as a new friend. Or just let me stay again. This was great.

We loved the location and the space, very clean and very comfy with high ceilings and lots of light!  The neighborhood was quiet and easy to navigate.  Thomas checked in often and made sure we had everything that we needed.
Kit & Jo were excellent hosts. They were very helpful and made sure we felt at home. We loved the place and would absolutely stay again!
Loved this bnb, would definitely book again !

Perfect location for everything we needed in Chicago. The Airbnb was clean, cozy, and very comfortable. Easy check-in, great communication, and a wonderful stay overall. Would definitely stay here again!

Great spot to stay. We were in town for the Twin Peaks show at Thalia so the location was prime! Getting to experience Pilsen was an added plus. The neighborhood is worth a trip on its own! Bianca and Jason provided awesome recommendations for local spots. Also Nanook is the sweetest dog. Definitely would stay again if I find myself in Chicago!

We stayed here with 4 adults, a toddler and a baby and it worked well for us. There is enough space in the biggest room for a crib, the second biggest room fit two adults, and the third room was a cozy size for a kiddo.
It was AWESOME having a dedicated parking spot that was the easiest to enter of the three spots for the housing block. There are really great restaurants within a mile (too many amazing Mexican places to list them all, also Pilsen Yard, Bob's Pizza, etc). Easy to catch buses to downtown or to both airports. Several playgrounds in easy walking distance!
The kitchen has all the cooking amenities you could hope for, which we really appreciated. The couch is huge and comfy. Although we could hear the rumbles and beats of the Zumba classes, they didn't affect anything about the trip, even with little ones and nap times so don't let that discourage you.
Jesus was very friendly and responsive. If we come back to Chicago, this is where we'll stay!
The location of the home is in a very scenic part of Chicago and we had a very easy time navigating around to places!

We absolutely loved this apartment. Of course it had everything you need and was spotlessly clean.  But it was beautifully decorated, had an amazing rooftop patio with great views, was in a vibrant and fun neighborhood with lots of stores, cafes and restaurants, and even had a large Walgreens next door with a full grocery to pick up all the essentials. The neighborhood is busy enough that an Uber was available within minutes. To top it all off Jacqueline, the host, was always responsive by text within minutes to answer any questions. All in all, the perfect respite a Chicago stay.

Stayed here for a conference at McCormick place. Super easy access to the conference center & train lines which was what I was looking for. Apartment was fine, a little dingy, but really only needed to sleep there.

This place is a gem! Probably the most spacious and comfortable AirBnB we have stayed in. From privacy to comfort, it had everything. The location is excellent, parking on the property, and plenty of restaurants and cafes nearby. We spent a lot of our time inside because it was so comfy. Moreover, the bedrooms are quite big and everything was super clean. Both Eduardo and Kevin were super kind to allow us some extra time to check out, allowing us to take care of a few things before we headed back to Missouri. We would love to be back and stay at this place again.

It was a great stay, the area was great, they’re were multiple things to do around the area and I would definitely stay again when I return
Great location. Lots of space. Close to McCormick. Super responsive host.
We really enjoyed our stay. The place and location worked perfectly for our needs.

Loved this spot! I live here now haha.
Genova was super easy to communicate with and very helpful!
Comfortable bed, solid wifi, lots of space in the common areas, good for teleworking. Shelving in bathroom and fridge clearly marked for each room. Well-appointed kitchen.
Obvs would depend on who's there, but the other guests were great! It's 4 rooms 1 bathroom - never had a problem but be aware. I think Genova does a great job of setting the tone and sending reminders for harmonious temp roommates.
Super convenient location - on the 60 and 21 bus, close to pink line, grocery store <5min walk, walkable area. Street parking easy to find. The only downside is the trucks get going early in the morning and they're loud.
Definitely would stay here again!

This was a great place to stay for the price point. Charming, safe, quiet neighborhood and so close to the L train it was easy to get to everything we wanted to do. Walkable to great restaurants as well.
Highly recommend !

Very nice neighborhood.
The place is small but it has everything you could ever need for a great stay.
Wonderful stay, easy to find parking on the street and love the neighborhood!

The hosts were very accommodating and always answered within the hour. Just make sure to read the full description carefully — unlike us 😅 — because this is a shared space. There is no washer or dryer, and there is only 1 shared bathroom if the other room is occupied. That was really the only downside for us.
We stayed in May, and the rooms got super hot at night since there was no air conditioning. Besides that, the neighborhood felt very safe, there were good places to eat nearby, and the bus stop was right there which made it easy to get to the train and around the city.
The home was actually better in person than in the photos. It was clean and wonderfully decorated. There were good directions and instructions
clean, walkable, friendly host. recommend to anyone visiting

We thoroughly enjoyed staying here. It was very clean, the beds were extremely comfortable, & it offers ample privacy for each guest. The location is walking distance from a Target & lots of restaurants. It’s not far from a bus stop, a little far from the blue line - but you could easily hop on a bus & get where you need to go. It’s a quiet area, it was easy for deliveries & ride pickups to find. For a group I’d recommend this home during your stay in Chicago!

Great place and location. It was perfect for our trip. No issues and the host reached out to make sure we had everything we needed :)
We will definitely stay here again!
This place was amazing and a great stay for anyone who wants to visit the Chicago area. Jerry was very responsive and provided a lot of amenities for me and my friends! Would highly recommend

Top notch place one of the best I have stayed at AirBnB or VRBO
Very responsive and helpful. Place was pristine and uncluttered. Loved it. If it’s available. Rent it.

Place was very nice and clean. Easy street parking. Close to train and airport so could definitely here planes and trains but that was as expected. Julie sent great instruction’s and had lots of great recommendations. She was very responsive to questions and GREAT at helping out when we had a minor issue arise with the booking. She made sure we were taken care of.

For a shared experience it was a ten. We pretty much had the place to ourselves. We were in and out most of the time but Tamiz was busy doing his thing.
The space is large enough and very clean so we felt very comfortable. He has two lovely cats 🐈‍⬛. We are animal people so we enjoyed them. Overall, wonderful stay! ❤️
We had a great time. Awesome location and cool neighborhood.
Very nice apartment in a great location.
We had a nice time! Nice location in a cute neighborhood, easy access to the city

This is by far one of my favorite places I’ve stayed at! My host was extremely friendly, responsive, and welcoming throughout my stay. I arrived earlier than expected, and she kindly allowed me to check in early, which I truly appreciated.
Her instructions were very clear and easy to follow, and the apartment itself was so cute, cozy, and comfortable — it genuinely felt like home. She also provided complimentary snacks and a small case of water, which was such a thoughtful touch and something I’ve never experienced at any other Airbnb.
Overall, my stay was a 10/10. The host was incredibly kind, and I would absolutely stay here again!

Danielle was a great host. She was very flexible, responsive to questions and concerns beforehand, and offered a lot of things to make the stay easier (parking passes, recommendations for restaurants). Her instructions were really clear, and I appreciated the additional instructions in the apartment for things like shower temperature and the thermostat. The apartment was clean, well-furnished, and well stocked with anything you might need while I’m traveling. We loved the neighborhood and would be happy to stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay here. It was very clean and pleasant. Perfectly set up and a lovely leafy neighbourhood. Beth and Drew were great hosts and always happy to help.
Highly recommended!
Would also recommend El Xangarrito for authentic Mexican food, but be aware that it’s BYOB.
It was absolutely perfect for what we needed! It was a great place to come back to every night, and I would definitely stay again!

I felt very safe and the check in went smoothly. However, a few things that bothered us. The bathroom was extremely small. We also had a bug issue, we woke up to wasps in our room and then the next night there were huge ants in the bathroom. That really grossed us out. Parking is inconvenient during school hours.

Such a cozy and comfortable stay! Has everything you would need and super affordable. I loved that I was able to park my car right outside the apartment as well. You do share the space with others so just be mindful of that when you are booking. 10 out of 10 chance I would book again when I come back to Chicago.
Easy to find and access. The apartment was clean. My family and I had a wonderful time being in the city and close to restaurants and shopping areas!
Host is prompt in responses and accommodating. Amenities were good.

The apartment is beautiful and was perfect for my husband, son and I while in town visiting our daughter.  We loved the open and sunlight space and the kitchen had everything we needed to cook in one night.  The beds and linens were super comfortable too.  We would definitely come back.

Very nice apartment with nice furnishings. We appreciated all the amenities, but especially loved the two spacious bathrooms and two separate bedrooms. Not once felt guilty spending time in the apartment instead of outside in the city because of how cozy and comfortable it was. Overall, great place to stay and would book again in a heartbeat!

What a lovely stay! The apartment is lovely - well decorated and laid out with comfortable furniture and is spotless. Located on a quiet, tree-lined street with easy street parking and easy access to bus lines.
Latasha was the perfect host with excellent communication and availability for questions.
I highly recommend and would love to stay here again when I return to Chicago!
Great location and really nice apartment
Great stay. The host was very communicative during our stay. Thank you!
We had a great stay, lovely little apartment that was just right for visiting friends that live nearby.
I had a wonderful time. Mary was kind and responsive. It was easy to find the location. Everything was just as described. It was my first time using Airbnb and I couldn’t have asked for better.

Cihan's place was in an excellent location in Old Town. I really loved the small balcony for relaxing and people watching. Lots of close entertainment, restaurants and bars. Be sure to bring a sleep mask if you don't like waking up early. It's nice and bright in the mornings!
The place was lovely and the hosts were very responsive and timely resolving a small issue. Only recommendation I would have is a few more dishes. I highly recommend this unit!

Regina’s place is in a great neighborhood, with excellent dining options and easy access to the CTA Red Line. It was as described, although not as bright as the photos showed. Great option for anyone planning to spend most of their time out and about and only in need of a comfortable, reliable place to shower and sleep. I recommend Regina’s place and would stay again.

Very Central and very spacious.
Excellent communication.
Highly recommended.

Would definitely stay again! Communication was great with Sean, he made sure everything was going well during our stay and suggested some local spots to check out. Very clear check-in instructions, clean and comfortable space with lots of windows and natural light, plus AC units around the building which was great for the warm weekend we stayed! Highly recommend!

My husband and I stayed a couple of nights and absolutely loved the location of the Airbnb. It was super easy to get to and in a safe area. the amount of things we can do that were walking distance was amazing. The only downside of the location was that it is right train tracks so we heard the train over the night so for light sleepers keep that in mind. Marijes's though knew this and was gracious enough to leave some ear plugs to help us with sleep which made such a big difference. outside of this, truly it was a great stay. thank you!

We had a family vacation of 8 people. The accommodations were outstanding and perfect for a large group. Kate was very responsive in answering all questions. Thanks for making our vacation special and memorable
Awesome spot

I had a great stay at this Airbnb- location was perfect for exploring locally and for hopping on the train. Apartment was comfortable and had what we needed for the weekend. Host was responsive and was nice enough to give us a list of suggestions for exploring the neighborhood.
We had a great time staying at Brandon’s place! Everything was as described and host was easy to communicate with!
This apartment was perfect for 4 people who wanted their own bed. Great restaurants:bars within walking distance as was the L. Very nice neighborhood.
A beautiful and tidy home with plenty around to enjoy. Highly recommend!

The apartment was perfect for our weekend in town.  Parking was super easy, the apartment was spacious and comfortable, and we were checked on daily via the app to make sure our needs were always met. Couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay in Chicago.

Our family stayed at Cristina's place while we were in town for a wedding at local venue. The location in the W. Loop area put us squarely in the hub of activities with only a 10-minute walk (to public transit) or a 20 minute ride to other venues as needed.
We were able to take the Green Line from the nearby California station downtown or to a transfer point to catch the Blue Line to O'Hare for our return trip.
The apartment is super-spacious, and the many conveniences were, well, convenient! Great showers/bathroom facilities, and I particularly appreciated the fast wifi.
Both Cristina and William were super-responsive and flexible, and I enjoyed my correspondence with them regarding places of interest.
One note to visitors: it may have been the time of year, but we were a bit taken aback by the traffic (highways) in CHI. I highly recommend using public transit if you can manage it. Plus, it's just the right thing to do.
Thanks to Cristina and William for a memorable stay!

Steve was a great host! He was flexible with check in and let us check in early which was greatly appreciated.  The AirBnb is located in a convenient, safe, walkable area. The location is close to Wicker Park, which we enjoyed! We liked having the bedrooms downstairs because the temperature was cool/felt like it was air conditioned.  Overall we had a great stay and I'd recommend anyone traveling to Chicago to stay at this AirBnb.  It's close enough to downtown, but away from the hustle of the city.
Great stay! Lilly was responsive right away with any concerns we had.

a very comfortable and spotless air b n b with a v comfortable
bed and living space and nice terrace to sit at..Bus was 5mins away to downtown and was a nice neighbourhood.
Everything was excellent

11/10 experience. The place was exceptionally clean, comfortable, well outfitted, and tastefully styled. It was in a great location convenient to the L and several small coffee shops and breweries. Rhett was a great host; he made us feel very welcome and offered many great local suggestions. Truly a great stay!
Nice place. Very easy to locate. Hosts were very responsive to questions I had.
Cozy Nest did a great job of communicating check-in and check-out procedures and always asked if we had any questions.  Place was very clean and in a good location for us.
Great location and responsive hosts!

This was a great stay! Beautiful views of the lake, and so close to Michigan Ave, the water tower, gold coast restaurants and shopping, and even soldier field for concerts. I had an amazing time! On top of that Nicole and Matt were fantastic and super easy to communicate with :)!

The airbnb was a bit smaller than anticipated from the photos but it was spacious enough for myself and my one other guest. The bed was comfortable, the air conditioner worked well, and the kitchen was absolutely spotless. The entire Airbnb smelled very clean when we arrived. The check out instructions are well placed in the kitchen. The large bed in the living area was very comfortable and the linens were soft.
It was in a pleasant area and was easily walkable even though I am disabled.

Angie’s home in Wicker Park was a great place to stay and experience Chicago! Very close to many cool spots and easy access to public transportation. Having a designated parking space was a huge plus.

Very cozy, chic and walkable stay in the heart of Chicago. Plenty of great restaurants within a 10 minute walk and reasonable walk to the core attractions, or just a short drive away. Owens place was very comfortable, and made out stay feel right at home.
We were shocked at how great the location was! Great surrounding restaurants and easily walkable to all of our activities. We would definitely stay again.

We had a very good stay at Cheryl’s place.  The off street parking spot made things incredibly easy.  She also provided a very clean Pack and Play for us to use (we brought appropriate sheet).  The location worked out very well for us.
It was a very spacious and pretty space!

WARNING!!! The pull out sofa that she tries to pass off as a bed has a ridiculously small, uncomfortable mattress. We didn't know that it was this bad when we booked, but she did, because she got a negative review about it that we didn't see before we booked it. Instead of addressing the problem, she tried to blame me for not knowing. Nothing can make up for paying hundreds of dollars for a bad nights sleep and a host that is not willing to do anything about it. In addition, the check in process is tedious and the directions are hard to understand. Parking is also not ideal, although she does admit that. In addition, the towel bar in the small bathroom is broken, there was a pile of trash on the floor by the front door and the coffee was really stale and not drinkable, no bottled water was offered. BTW, do NOT expect any kind of refund or compensation for your troubles.  I DO NOT RECOMMEND STAYING HERE!
really great place to stay. home was exactly what we needed and really close to a lot of nice places to eat and drink nearby
This was a nice stay for our girls trip to Chicago. The place was spacious and clean.

This penthouse is in a tall complex in the heart of Chicago's River North neighborhood. The unit is light and bright, spacious and well furnished and equipped. Loads of windows and two terraces offer spectacular views of the city and Lake Michigan. There's a subway stop at the corner and a busy grocery next door plus loads of restaurants within a few blocks. It's in the heart of the city with the normal amount of street life, foot and vehicle traffic. The apartment itself is pretty quiet (aside from the occasional sirens, which are a part of life anywhere.) Great bonus spaces - pool, library, business center, gym. Owner communication was frequent, proactive and clear. A bonus was getting to know the cute dogs riding the elevator for their morning and evening walks.

Great place, very spacious and comfortable.
Recommend to post the private parking location on the check in instructions.

we had a good time staying at Riwals place. Thank you for hosting us!
the rooms and living room was clean.
kitchen and bathroom need more atencion. especially the bathroom. if do not care so much about cleaness I recommend the place. before I book the place I read one review talking about the same issue that the bathroom was dirty. I thought I should give it a chance. I was disappointed that they do not took that review in consideration.

Amy and Brandon were as friendly as could be :) Amy's condo is so lovely, homey, spacious, and clean! My partner and I felt right at home from the start -- even though we had a late arrival, Amy was up to let us in, greet us, show us around, and make sure that everything was perfect for us. The bedroom we stayed in was private, and the condo is full of cozy spots to relax or get some work done. We were in town to do some apartment hunting, and Amy and Brandon went out of their way to tell us about Uptown, share their local faves, and treat us like we were neighbors already. I couldn't recommend this airbnb more!
Great location and the Airbnb had what we needed. Josh was helpful when we had issues with the keyless entry.

Thank you so much for a wonderful stay! The service was excellent, your responses were always quick and helpful, and the place was absolutely beautiful. Everything was comfortable, clean, and welcoming. I truly enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend your Airbnb to others!

Paul's place was perfect for me visit—right around the corner from where I was working over the weekend and less than a quarter mile from multiple coffee shops and a dozen restaurants. The bed was comfortable, the space was beautiful, and the bathroom was spotless. And then there was Abby, the canine highlight of my stay. She greeted me when I entered with her favorite toy in her mouth and loved being snuggled. I can't think of any way my stay could have been nicer. I hope to stay here again when I return for work next year!

This was the PERFECT place for my entire family for my Daughter's Wedding in Edgewater!  Plenty of space for everyone.  A great gathering place for family and friends in advance of the wedding!  CLASSY!  ELEGANT!  Well appointed!  And ABNB should make all their hosts take lessons from Sean!  Impeccably hospitable!  Solved every problem, even when we didn't know there was a problem. HUGE Elegant space. We were there 8 days and I have NO regrets. Book this space before I buy it!  Just kidding but that's how much I loved it!
Loved the welcoming atmosphere of the apartment. Bryan was an amazing host. Quickly responded to any questions I had. Highly recommend.

The Airbnb was a great stay and had everything we needed. There were lots of amenities provided, which made the place feel comfortable and convenient right away. The host was also very quick to respond whenever we had a question.
Check-out was simple and easy, which we really appreciated. The kitchen was especially useful and saved us a lot of money on takeout during our stay. Overall, it was a smooth, comfortable experience and we’d be happy to stay here again.
Nice spot in a very convenient location! Great communication from the host.
The space was impeccable, with clear and concise instructions. The host was a pleasure to communicate with and answered any and all questions. 10/10 would definitely stay again.
Otima estadia.
We love staying at David's place when we're in town. It's safe, quiet, and pristine. The neighborhood is very peaceful. Thanks for sharing with us David!
Very peaceful/quiet neighborhood, walkable to the L and restaurants. Great part of Chicago. Would recommend.
Great stay! Amy was incredible and the Airbnb was cozy and comfortable!

I felt that the neighborhood felt safe and walkable. But with asterisks because crime can happen anywhere i stayed vigilant about my surroundings. Did not have many problems at all Fransisco help me get in and this place is not a Hilton. But the price you pay for is not bad either, because you are located within walking distance of the Blue Line and a couple of cool restaurant's near by.
Stylish apartment in a great and walkable neighborhood.  Thoughtful and accommodating hosts.

It is a beautiful home that’s well kept inside and out. One of the cleanest Airbnbs I have stayed in with very comfortable bedrooms. Plenty of room for our girls trip. The stairs are steep and the basement should have a bed or air mattress in the extra room. The neighborhood is safe, quiet and close to lots of things with minimal traffic which is a good thing in Chicago.
Awesome location near china town. Worth checking it out.
Difficult to communicate with, and with unexpected rules which lead to unexpected fees. Not horrible for the price but would rather choose a hotel if given then chance.

Stayed here for a long weekend with my girlfriend and daughter. Garage space really brings peace of mind for parking. Good food spots close by. Quiet for the most part at night unless a ball game is going but even then it wasn’t that bad! We would stay here again for sure!
So easy to communicate with and always came to help when needed! Safe nice neighborhood as well

A few friends and I stayed here and had an amazing experience. The home was beautiful, roomy, and conveniently located near plenty of things to do. The host was incredibly kind, quick to respond, and made us feel very welcome throughout our stay.

Such an awesome location.  We loved the back deck area.  Easy check-in.  Amazing access to L.  Great setup with 4 bedrooms.  If we do another getaway in Chicago I’ll definitely check to see if this place is available.  Thank you!!

Das Appartement war genau wie beschrieben. Es war alles da, was man braucht, Handtücher, Bettwäsche, ...
Es ist sehr geräumig, genug Platz für 4 Personen
Durch die Nähe zur Hauptstraße kann es etwas lauter sein
Guten Verkehrsanbindung, Busse quasi direkt vorm Haus und 10 Minuten zu Fuß zur Blue line Station...
Wir werden unseren nächsten Urlaub sehr gerne wieder in diesem Appartement verbringen!
Cloud9非常棒，这次我住了他们管理的两套房子，每一套都很棒
Everything was great- the beautiful unit, the walkable neighborhood, the responsive and kind hosts, truly the entire stay. 10/10 recommend!
Great location, beautiful city scape skyline views, super cozy apartment with great amenities, rooftop is really nice, the elevated Lake street train is loud but part of the city soundtrack.
This place is in a good location.  Very quiet neighborhood with a bar around the corner.
Really nice spot. Great from where we needed to be. Would stay again.
Great stay!
Very amazing stay! Enjoyed it alot near some e bikes!

This condo is beautiful!!  From the decor to the cleanliness, it was perfectly matched with the photos and descriptions online.  The hosts were amazing and so helpful and responsive!  Check in was so easy and I can't say enough things about the beautiful space itself.  It is not conveniently walkable to anything downtown (but that is not what was listed so we weren't expecting that or surprised at all)  We took ubers everywhere and that was never an issue for us--but if you aren't sure about the Chicago area in general and are curious about the logistics, you will need to Uber or take public transportation to get to most attractions.  That being said, we had zero issues with getting Ubers--they weren't expensive to do and was easier than us trying to walk and navigate everywhere anyways.  It's about a 10 minute Uber to Wicker Park (we loved that area!) Michigan Ave, and a little further of a ride to Navy Pier but not bad at all.  We loved our stay here!  Can't wait to come back!

great place when it came to finding parking! that’s one of my biggest concerns when coming to the city but i had no issues w this location! checking in was easy, hosts were friendly, and the place was fairly clean. my room for some reason had this weird smell that didn’t go away my whole stay that was very unpleasant but other than that, no complaints ☝🏽
This was an awesome place to stay and George was a great host! We would definitely stay here again!
It’s a very nice neighborhood, and the place was pretty big inside. Peaceful!

The place was very clean, location was great for anyone looking to do a lot of things downtown Chicago. It was a 10-15 mins uber ride to downtown. They are good at getting back to you right away. Can’t complain, great experience .
Location is exactly as listed. We were pleasantly surprised with the extra snacks that were left for us. Close to the bus/blue line. Lots of good food close by & walkable!

Beautiful space with lovely neighbors! We felt very safe and right at home. Daniel was very responsive and helpful all the way through from booking to check out.  Definitely adding to my favorites for my trips to Chicago!

Excelente estancia, oso muy bien especificado.
El lugar muy limpio, y ordenado.
Nos dejó buenas recomendaciones y el lugar quedaba cerca de lo más turístico. Totalmente regresaríamos .

We stayed at Kevin’s with our family to celebrate our daughter’s college graduation. It was even more spacious and well appointed than the photos showed. Everyone was comfortable in their beds and the 2.5 baths were great. Very convenient location for restaurants, grocery and public transportation. The street was surprisingly quiet in the mornings and at night. The kitchen and outdoor spaces were perfect for gathering. Highly recommend this house!
good accommodation for the price and not far from downtown
Everything was perfect! We definitely enjoyed our stay, and will book again!

We stayed at Aminah's place for 4 nights and I'd highly recommend to anyone looking for an accommodation in Devon, Chicago.
Aminah is a great host and very responsive. the place is in great condition and I've felt right at home staying here with everything i needed. Lot of food options nearby (especially halal food) and not too difficult to find a parking in vicinity. I'd definitely want to stay here again in my future travels to Chicago

Thank you Akatar and Tugba for your hospitality. You were always very attentive to our needs, and we felt completely comfortable in your home. You were respectful and helpful with our tourism activities. The room is exactly as pictured, the bathroom is very clean, and the kitchen and laundry facilities are very well-equipped. We would definitely return.
Great spot for a weekend away in Chicago. Close to some wonderful restaurants. Quiet, respectful hosts. Great value and would stay again!

The location was great for us. The toilet was not working. It was not flushing. We were not there most of the time.
