We left a day early and the host reimbursed us 50%.
Thank you so much, it was a great stay!
Great house. This was perfect for my group in town for a convention. Will def book here again.

Maximo is an amazing host! The place is immaculate! Well decorated, clean, did not lack anything! Everything was put in place intentionally to create comfort and convenience. Highly recommend and will come back if the opportunity presents itself.
We stayed for a quick weekend in Chicago, and we had a great stay! We especially appreciated the restaurant recommendations in the area. Thanks for hosting us!
home was large enough to comfortably accommodate 7 adults

Place was great, very quaint, property was as described in listing. Beds were very comfortable.
A huge Bonus in my book is that there were more than enough kitchenware, plenty of pots,pans,plates,utensils,ect…..
location was great, easy to navigate the city from there. Neighborhood is quiet and safe. Parking took a minute to find sometimes but was never too far away.
Would definitely stay again when visiting Chicago.
was livable for the few days we visited
Had an amazing stay!

We had a great stay here for our trip to Chicago. It had everything we needed, everything was clean and well maintained, the neighborhood was charming and had plenty of walkable restaurant and coffee shop options, and it was a great location to use for our various trips around the city. Highly recommended!

If you are looking for a cheap place to stay it works. It is far from central chicago so be prepared to commute plenty. The place was shared as described not much interaction with other guests, the place was moderately clean. Be sure to check what room your in as I nearly got the wrong one and the host was ready aggressive at once threatening to charge me the other room if I didn't make it back in time... that was stressful but avoided as I had just left my bag in the room and left.
Other than that the place served its purpose as a place to rest at night.
I love how beautiful this house is. The attention to detail. It is so close to downtown town. Her beds are so comfortable especially after a day on my feet. I will be back.

Very nice condo!  Looked just like all the photos.  Kitchen was very spacious!  Nice terrace to spend time on, just remember the train is close and goes by pretty often.  Tons of restaurants to choose from and walk to.  Yolie was awesome and responsive and recommended tons of spots around Chicago.  would recommend!

I think Adamm’s place was great but would be more ideal for the 35 and under crowd. It has ample free parking, relatively walkable, and the neighborhood is FULL of hidden gems as far as food and entertainment and only a short uber away from the downtown area. Adamm provided clear and easy directions for check in and check out, was always accessible but never overbearing. I would definitely stay here again!
place was great and host was attentive
Space and comfort, good for family size
DJ was a wonderful host. Responsive to questions and needs. Lovely touches in the room- coffee maker and coffee choices- bottled water - small bowl of fresh fruit. And plenty of quiet.

the bathroom and room was very clean with soap and shampoo, the heater was excellent for those chilly days, the kicthen has everything you need to make breakfast or a basic meal. it has microwave too. Location is good because is peaceful and near a bus stop and many restaurants.
Great spot for the six of us!

This was a work stay with a business partner and I. The space was the perfect amount of space and we each had our own space.  The space was easy to get to, public transportation and taxis were easy to locate, and there were great restaurants within walking distance. Everything was clean and well stocked.
It was not clear it would be a shared home with other people and not vetting to ensure safety.

We had a very pleasant and comfortable two-week stay at this apartment while visiting family in the area.  The apartment is exactly as pictured, very spacious, extremely clean, and renovated in a style that has added nicely designed modern amenities while also retaining the charming details of an older house.  There was ample room for our belongings in the large walk in closets and in kitchen cabinets, and the kitchen was well equipped for cooking. The hosts Kelsey and Tara were prompt in communicating and responsively addressed a repair issue. The location is quiet, safe, walkable to a huge number of restaurants and shops, and easily accessible to transit ("El" subway and buses) for travel downtown and around the city.  We enjoyed feeling at home and like 'almost natives'!
Anastasia’s home was wonderful and she was a great host! Highly recommend.
House was just like pictures. Very roomy for my 4 guest. Josh responded quickly. Love the backyard area.

The host went above and beyond to accommodate us! One of the best hosts we have had on Airbnb. We made a last-minute request for a baby crib and a high chair, and the host team was on top of it right away, shipping brand-new items to us. When we had a little trouble turning on the shower (it worked differently from ours at home), the host responded immediately with clear visual instructions (I never had to step out of the bathtub).
The place is in a great neighborhood! Southport is our favorite spot in Chicago.
The only thing to keep in mind is the overground subway that runs a block away. Our toddler seemed to sleep through it, and we got used to it (when the windows were closed).

Great place! We attended a wedding in town and had multi families staying here-it was perfect! With the 2 floors there was some privacy yet proximity
In a great neighborhood and parking was so helpful.
The place was really clean and appealing and it was close to the event we were attending.
David was impressively quick in responding to any questions we had, very friendly.
Highly recommend

It’s an okay place, you get what you pay for,  the host just fails to mention in the description that you can’t flush any toilet paper down and that there is a no shoes policy in the house. I think his cleaner needs to clean better for the bathroom bc every time I would go to the bathroom after his cleaner would clean the bathroom I would find the same pieces of hair I found before the cleaner went in the bathroom
As soon as we arrive we can smell that it’s clean. We loved the place it was very spacious. Had everything we needed!
Another wonderful stay!!!!
Patrizia is very warm & welcome. Water for the room & morning coffee were both lovely touches!

Booked for my family to stay in for my wedding weekend! They enjoyed the space and mentioned how spacious and well kept it was! Hosts were responsive and flexible with check in times. No issues at all!

It was clean and spacious. Needed to have more towels even though we washed/dried towels often.
Owners were very responsive and helpful.
Great studio in an even better location! Ping was an excellent host. :)
Great location. Walkable to theaters, trains and Block 37. Apartment is spacious and very comfortable. Building has great amenities.
Atlas was a kind and gracious host, communicated well and was very responsive. Would definitely stay here again.
cost was more than original quote,  tax and insurance added.

Kareem was incredibly gracious and welcoming throughout my stay. They were attentive, responsive, and made the entire experience feel very comfortable. The house was also extremely clean, well-kept, and exactly as described. I really appreciated the care and effort put into creating such a great environment. I would definitely stay here again.
Thanks again Shaun for a really memorable stay.  We had a great time in CHI, thanks to your beautiful place.

We had a wonderful stay at Robert's apartment. The neighborhood is just wonderful - beautiful architecture and leafy neighborhood feel, and also walkable to many restaurants, coffee shops, Lincoln Park and activities.
The apartment is quiet, gets lots of natural light and is really clean. The kitchen was easy to use. We could have done with a bit more living room seating for our group of 6 but there was ample dining room seating and space in the bedrooms as well.
We are so glad we got to stay here for our Chicago long weekend!

After thoroughly reading the reviews, I got just about exactly what I expected! Evgenii's place was wonderful, clean, and very comfortable. We interacted with other guests and everyone was very kind, considerate and we felt very safe inside the home. Evgenii was very accommodating, communicative, and it was nice knowing he lived there as well. I've never been to Chicago, so we didn't know a whole lot about the neighborhoods and according to a couple of our Lyft drivers, the neighborhood wasn't the safest however we didn't have any issues and utilized the pink line or Lyft and had a positive experience with the community. The other guests of the home seem to feel content and happy with their stay as well. While accessing transportation was very easy and a straight shot, the location was a bit out of the way  and there seemed to not be much to do in the area but for needing an affordable and comfortable place to stay (staying close to downtown gets rather expensive) it was a good deal!
Excelente piso, muy cómodo y confortable. Rosa siempre estático a disposición y respondía rápido. Gracias por recibirnos

We had a two bedroom/ two bath corner unit that we shared with another couple. Plenty of room for the four of us. The view was amazing. The unit overlooked Lake Michigan with a view of Navy Pier in one direction and Soldier Field in the other.
The front desk people were very nice and attentive and gave us all necessary supplies when we asked.
Short walk to the L train and several bars and restaurants. Would definitely stay there again.

This condo is in a great location, very easy to get to and great views! I enjoyed the gym as well. The only issue was the lack of ventilation. The unit didn't seem to be able to cool off at night. No one in our group slept great because the rooms seemed to stay hot even with the doors and windows open and the ac down on 67.
Other than that we loved the place!
Great location, about 20 minutes from downtown. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, and the host was a great communicator. Would definitely stay here again. Thank you!
Very good stay. Hosts were super helpful.

Very nice old home! Nice amenities available by owner and very easy to work with and pleasant! Being an older home, the floors creak ALOT! Not conducive for sleeping children. Easy access from expressways and GREAT parking. Nice backyard! Nice peaceful neighborhood and friendly neighbors! Bedroom doors don't lock and one doesn't stay closed. Only tub and shower is upstairs. Wouldn't recommend it for older people who can't do stairs!
Great place, exactly as described in the listing. Around 10 min walk to CTA. I didn’t faced any issue during my stay. I will stay again.
Our family loved the stay. The hosts were super responsive and helpful. Its definitely easier to go around if you already have a car but overall we enjoyed it!
Had a lovely stay in Lincoln Park, we loved the accessibility to the park, the lake, and restaurants. Great central location and felt safe.

Quite possibly my best Airbnb experience.  The apartment is exactly as pictured and in excellent condition.  It is very thoughtfully appointed.  The kitchen is fully outfitted.  This would be a great place for an extended stay.  Slavyana was very responsive and helpful.
Love it here, close to everything but quiet.
Very nice very clean area is by a lot of stores very good stay

This was the perfect place for my daughter and I to stay. Wonderful, walkable location with easy access to fabulous restaurants, the train, and an easy walk to Lincoln Park Zoo and the beach.
It was also my favorite Airbnb ever - filled with character and decorated from worldwide travels, I found it inspirational! The apartment was larger than I expected and had everything we could possibly need. There was an informational book about the unit and the area, and Celia was available but not intrusive. We look forward to many more stays in her home!

As the old adage goes, you get what you pay for. This apartment was that. I did not like having to share a bathroom, The tub wasnt draining correctly,  but that was reflected in the price. I did not like that I was able to lock myself out of my room, in my P.J's without my phone. Did lydia, the host kinda warn us about that, yes, but does anyone really pay attention? If you rent this place you'd better pay attention. I locked my bedroom door behind me on a trip to the bathroom, huge mistake. Luckily I kept trying to open my door and after so many failed attempts it triggered an alarm and the caretaker on site came to help me, so I was only locked out for about 20 minutes. But know that there were 4 doors each with their own unique code to memorize or jot down. The bed was pretty much an Army cot. The accommodation were fine for the $320 I paid for the 3 nights. The down town hotels wanted between $400-500 per night. Ouch! It was the NRA show and Bruno Mars in town. My bad luck.
I really enjoyed my stayed at this airbnb. The location is a perfect distance away from the city.
excellent thoughtfully equipted place to stay.
Awesome place! Felt super safe and comfortable
Great place to stay if coming in town for a Sox game! Street parking is not a problem. Place is clean and the host is kind and responsive.
This was a great hub to explore Chicago from.  It was a girl's family trip and had everything we needed.
We had a great weekend stay! The suite was perfect for sleeping (all we needed) and the area was walkable and near fun restaurants and bars!
Mr Bentley’s place was perfect for a weekend in the city. Comfortable and stylish, easy parking and very close to the L + local bus lines.

Cozy Condo in a GREAT location. One block off Michigan Avenue and half mile directly to Lake Michigan.
Lots of great restaurants all around.
If you can handle the stairs, it’s perfect. If you can’t handle stairs this isn’t the right place for you.
The condo was clean and cozy, Tatiana and Roupen are great hosts that checked to make sure everything was ok. I really appreciated that!!

This was an awesome air bnb experience. We had everything we needed and the room felt secure with the door locks. The entire place was clean and the kitchen and bathroom were both stocked with all necessities. Host was very friendly and checked in frequently to make sure we had everything we needed.
It’s my second time visiting this place, and I must say, I’m a huge fan! I’ll definitely make it a point to book a stay here whenever I’m in Chicago.

Exactly what 2 people needed for a quick weekend stay in Chicago’s south side. If you are looking for a hotel substitute this will satisfy completely. The interior was clean and enough space for two people. While the check-in process was simple, a couple slight errors with the instruction sheet on how to get in that Brad quickly accommodated too and noted that he changed after were the only negative thing of note. Thanks again Brad for providing a great weekend getaway.
Great location. Beautiful spot.

This is a great location for my husband and I for the weekend! The amenities could be more accurately described. Great restaurants in the area, 13-15 min walk to the tram, close to Wrigley Field and several bars.
There is no washer accessible to guests, despite the listing saying so. I planned around being able to wash a few things but was unable. There are also a few windows without curtains which can be an unnerving as we were in the basement.
There is also nowhere to score store your clothes- no closet to hang items in. There is a nightstand in the bedroom but it was full of personal items.
Overall it was clean and a great location just missing a few accommodations to help things run smooth!
Great place to stay if you’re looking for a comfy bed, safe neighborhood and affordable price. I would definitely recommend this place to others

Our stay at Marty and Robs was perfect! The location was peaceful AND walkable, the garden was incredible, their little dog was so sweet and well trained! I would totally recommend it and if I’m ever in the area, will book here again!

We loved staying here!  Beautiful space and area.  There was so much to see and do right in the neighborhood.  The bar downstairs was a hit with our group. Extremely close to public transit (walk to the CTA brown line is less than a 3 minute walk) so exploring Chicago was very easy and convenient.  My only suggestion would be to add curtains especially to the front room. Lovely place, super peaceful. I had absolutely no issues. When I checked in I got a super fast response!

Perfect spot. Steps away from the El so you can be downtown in minutes but also spend some time exploring Ravenswood, one the of best neighborhoods in Chicago. Space was clean, comfortable, quiet, and spacious enough for two people. Loved staying here.

An Amazing Stay & Fantastic Host!
Our stay with Lois was absolutely great! Great stay close to good food!  The balcony was very relaxing.
It was a lovely stay. The place is very beautiful and Makana is super nice!
We loved everything about our stay.  The apartment is spacious, in a beautiful neighborhood, and very clean.  Our favorite part of our stay was relaxing on the back deck.

Perfect place for our family’s first US visit. Comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed at a great price. Loved the Bridgeport location, lots of restaurants and white sox stadium within walking distance. Highly recommend!
The house easy to find, and alway have the parking on the stress. She will give you the parking permit too! When i need something she respond very quickly event it late .

We had a great stay, in a vibrant Neighborhood, full of amazing food. It was easy to get to all the other beautiful neighborhoods of Chicago. Comfortable stay, great space and easy parking. The pullout sofa sinks in when someone is on it, but no issues otherwise! Highly recommend.
Localização perfeita, próximo de tudo, supermercados, lojas , restaurantes. O apartamento é aconchegante, espaçoso, me senti em casa. Simplesmente recomendo!

Joe is a wonderful host who is attentive to his guest needs ! The location is ideal for connections to the Brown line and nearby restaurants . The residence is clean and in a very nice quiet neighborhood . Would not hesitate to return.

Had a great stay at Victor in Chicago. The property was spacious, clean, and very comfortable. The amenities were excellent and well maintained, which made the experience even better. Great location, smooth stay, and overall a fantastic experience. Would definitely recommend!
Great location and walking distance to blue line damen and western.

What an amazing place to call home for attending my granddaughter’s graduation.  The location was perfect- great small shops and ease to blue line line train.  But the best part was the home itself. The hosts were extremely friendly and accessible and I’d definitely return for another visit.  Thank you for sharing your lively home.

Mark was wonderfully accommodating to our late flights in and out. He provided all necessities for a quick weekend stay in Chicago. The place was spotless and nicely updated. Az apartman igazi különlegesség, egy ék alakú épület keskeny végében van. A nappalinak két irányban vannak nagyon nagy ablakai, így rendkívül világos. We felt right at home! It was very walkable and the home itself was absolutely beautiful! We will recommend it to anyone thinking about staying in the area!

Great location within walking distance to many great restaurants, bars and shops.  Terri and Moe’s place was clean and spacious. There were 6 adults and 2 toddlers and place never felt crowded. 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, living/dining room, well stocked kitchen, toiletries, etc.

Tons of places around for coffee, smoothies, food, minor shopping for something you may have forgotten to pack.
Outside parking but metered during 8:30-10 pm (free on Sunday), so we were told about park hero where you “rent” out a space for your car. The one we chose was literally a five minute walk so this way we knew where care was always parked.
We would have no hesitation to stay in this air bnb again.
Because we booked late, price was a little higher than friends who had a bigger place (but they were 10 people) but that’s what happens when you procrastinate.

i absolutely loved it here! Tenna was a phenomenal host, extremely friendly and made me feel right at home. i got there alone waiting for my friends and she made me feel so comfortable almost as if i was at a family members house, made my first trip to chicago even better, helped me find places to eat, recommended things to do, answered to anything quickly, etc. everything was perfect.

I loved staying here! Angela is the best host and did such a great job creating a super cozy space and being super communicative. I felt super safe being a single woman in my 20's. It was super easy to get around Chicago being in Albany Park. Never felt disturbed or bothered during my stay, but I loved chatting with Angela and the other tenants when I would run into them. The heat and AC runs super well! I was there at the beginning of January and then till May and it worked for all types of weather.  Would 10/10 recommend this Air b'n'b to anyone wanting to stay in Chicago for a good couple of months.
Everything was wonderful. Great communication and a great space

My friends and I loved staying here! It’s so cute and very clean, and conveniently located near a rail stop. The communication was clear and the hosts were very responsive.
Great location and fun place!

Como oportunidad de mejora, notamos que en uno de los baños habia moho, por lo demás la limpieza estaba excelente.
Great place to stay, quiet and very clean

Everything was great, Christopher was responsive and considerate for my first visit to Chicago. This was a perfect place for a weekend in Chicago. Walkable to shops and restaurants. Beautiful tree lined street and felt very safe walking the neighborhood at night. Highly would stay again.

Excellent space for business trip. Great location!
cute spot in a great location. walk to shops, cafes, bars. close-ish to red line.

We came into town from Michigan to celebrate our son’s graduation from Columbia College. Our stay was brief, but the accommodations were perfect. Nice place, exactly as listed.

The second and third floors have very nice showers. There are also vanity bathrooms on the first floor and basement.
The kitchen was nice and had all you need to cook if you’d like.
Most of the graduation activities were near downtown. I drove sometimes. At other times, I used Uber. The drives back and forth could be long. I expected that, so guests should keep the location in mind.
This home is worth considering for large grou

The Airbnb was great! It was close to everything I wanted to see and do, which made getting around really easy. The place itself was nice and clean, and the neighborhood felt safe and welcoming. I had a comfortable stay and would definitely recommend it to others!

This was by far the worst Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in.
