This was my second time staying here and both were great experiences.  I will definitely stay again in the future.

May 13th - 18th 2026: responsive host, made needed adjustments and I originally was arriving the 14th but flight changed and I was able to be accommodated w/o any stress.
Place was nice, neighborhood (super quiet)…sensor lights kinda had a mind of their own LOL but it did not take away from enjoying the space for my time spent in the CHI. I’d recommend and I would too stay again.
Thanks for hosting me!

Nous étions un groupe de 12.
Logement très comode.
Déplacements très faciles de ce point avec le réseau de transport.
La communication avec l’hôte a été très facile et rapide.
Overall a perfectly serviceable place to stay in the city. Nothing particularly standout about the accommodations, bathroom could use an update, but overall perfectly fine.

The place was very clean and spacious. Some issues came up, but Jason’s team helped troubleshoot and address them right away as soon as we communicated. Pricing was also great compared to other AirBNBs in the area. Would stay again!
Ashley’s place was great. Love the neighborhood and she was an awesome host and was very helpful.
This was a great spot my wife and I stayed at. I really appreciated the parking in the back. Bed was comfy also.

The apartment is spacious and comfortable, in a quiet block but just a few minutes walk to lots of eateries. Our family was in town for a graduation so we were not in the apartment much except to sleep, shower, and eat breakfast. We appreciated the ample living space, plenty of bath towels, and all the small appliances (iron, hairdryer, etc). The only feedback/suggestion was dishtowels for the kitchen since we handwashed the cups, etc.
As for check-in, it was easy although at first I was confused because there was someone's lockbox on the gate out front so I thought that's where I put the code in to get the keys. The code is for the actual front door and the keys to the apartment were inside.
Phebian responded very quickly when I messaged about a small issue so that was appreciated. Overall a very good stay for a family group.
Noemi was a very nice and responsive host,  the home was beautiful and in a nice neighborhood with lots of things to do around the area including food and shops! 10/10
This is a great place and has a great location. Christina responds quickly and is very friendly. We really enjoyed our time here. Thanks again Christina!
Return stay. Great host, exceptionally responsive. Great location.

Amazing space regardless of the neighborhood
I enjoyed my stay and would recommend this space if you want to jus get away and enjoy yourself

Host was very responsive if I had any questions, the instructions were very clear as well. The pictures are the same as what you see in person and the building was overall quiet :)) I would recommend this stay to people.
Super responsive.  Made for an easy comfortable stay.   Great location for museums, concert, aquarium, etc.
Thank you for the stay, it was perfect for what we had going on

Very nice accommodation in the heart of Old Town. Location was fantastic, walking distance to many restaurants, bars, coffee shops and the lake. Hosts were very accommodating with all requests. The unit was clean and spacious. Would definitely stay here again.
Great location and very tidy. We really appreciated the dedicated parking spot. Alex is a great communicator and very responsive!
Absolutely a pleasure to have interactions with. Loved the place and its location in the city.

Shout out to Marty and Rob and their pup Ming!
Their cozy Home was exactly as listed. Communication was amazing. Super welcome home feel, beautiful garden, room was perfect private, bed comfortable +++ , large standing glass shower - loved— first floor room & bath was there for 4 nights for a wedding, super chill vibes— peaceful and quiet neighborhood. Zen house, zen vibes, zen neighborhood for those chill travelers. 5 min walk to bus stop +++ recommend Pauline’s breakfast diner down the road 10 min walk south. Great breakfast/ fair prices
Thanks again guys!
Conveniently-located Airbnb and great host!

Very nice space, has everything  you would need for a stay. Metro station is close by with parking if needed which was amazing! Only concern would be lack of AC in the bedroom. Would recommend to anyone looking for an affordable and comfortable space!

I don’t like to leave bad reviews but unfortunately this was a horrible experience. While it was easy to locate and clean inside, it is not in a safe neighborhood. Within an hour of our check in we heard many gunshots. When we spoke to a local police officer he said he was not surprised & that we truly needed to stay somewhere else if possible. Airbnb gave no support as “it didn’t happen IN the property so there was nothing they could do”. Additionally I could not get the host on the phone. As two young women, we were terrified the rest of our stay and could not enjoy it. Do not recommend this for anyone.
This was a beautiful apartment and we had a great host! Would definitely recommend!

Takeisa’s place is great. She went above and beyond of what a host should do. Anything you can think of if you may have forgotten about was there. She welcomed us with a beautiful card and snacks. Would definitely stay there again.
Lovely place to stay.  Keith is very responsive if anything isn't just right.  I'll book again!

I enjoyed every minute of the stay and I believe my girlfriend did too. The only issue we had was the fact we could clearly hear the upper residents at all times they were home. My girlfriend is a light sleeper so she was being woken up at 5/6 am. Other than that, everything was very tidy and welcoming. Love the digital locks

The place was beautiful inside and the host was so responsive when i had concerns for anything. you have everything you need in the kitchen as far as appliances. the hot tub was great and so peaceful the place was overall amazing and i would come back.
Very responsive, clean, walking distance to the train!
The apartment was very nice and well kept. It suited our needs nicely and was close to shops, restaurants, and public transit.

This is probably one of the nicest AirBNBs I've ever stayed in, and I've stayed in a lot. What made this the best was all the "extras" available. They had an entire drawer in the bathroom for toiletry items someone might have forgotten, they also provided mini "poof" balls (to wash your body in the shower).
My favorite was all the tea selections for a beverage choice. I prefer tea instead of coffee, and there were probably over 20 different flavors of tea to select from. The coffee set up was also great, and they provided individual dreamers. AirBNBs usually never provide creamer, so that was another plus.
It was VERY clean and decorated beautifully. Restaurants, bars and a 7-Eleven were within walking distance which was nice.
Bravo on this AirBNB. I would 100% recommend it to anyone.

**Fantastic stay!**
Kody was incredibly proactive and responded lightning-fast whenever I had a question.
The place was spotless and **exceptionally clean**. Also, a major bonus that deserves a shoutout: He was flexible with check-in, which accommodated our weekend plans! shower has **great water pressure**!
Logistics were a breeze, too. Having **free parking in the back** of the house with easy alley access made coming and going completely stress-free.
Highly recommend this spot to anyone looking for a smooth, comfortable stay!

We had a great stay overall. The location worked perfectly for where we needed to be, although it is a little further north than many of Chicago’s main attractions.
The apartment was very clean and comfortable, and all bedrooms were good. It is slightly minimalistic, but absolutely fine for a short stay. Only small note was that the towels provided were quite small.
The main issue was the AC. Although listed as an amenity, there were no AC units installed when we arrived, so our first night was uncomfortable with temperatures above 85 degrees. However, Tara handled the situation very professionally, the units were installed promptly the next day, and they kindly offered us a complimentary late checkout. Future guests who want AC should confirm it is installed before arrival.
Also, only one set of keys was provided, which can be difficult for groups, especially as the building buzzer does not work inside the apartment.
Easy check in - loved it !
En general fue un buen anfitrión , el lugar esta fácil de acceder . Me gustó la estancia ahí .

Mon fiancé et moi avons vraiment adoré cet endroit :)
Nous nous sommes sentis comme chez nous. La journée, l'endroit est baigné de lumière naturelle, et le soir, il se transforme en un lieu chaleureux grâce à un éclairage d'ambiance. Le prix en vaut vraiment la peine, et il comprenait même un petit-déjeuner léger.
Christiane and Patrick were amazing hosts. They made our trip to Chicago that much more memorable. If you have the time during your trip, sit and chat with them over some coffee and tea. They have so many stories to tell and show so much curiosity to other cultures and perspectives.
I would highly recommend this place and would love to come back. Thanks Christiane and Patrick!
Such a great condo - centrally located and lots of fun amenities!

I had an amazing time in Roger’s Park and Sara made this place feel like a home away from home. It was clean and quiet. She responded quickly and was incredibly kind! This has been the best experience I have had and if I make it back to the area I will be staying here again!
A great spot for sleeping over - peaceful, walkable and clean. Great access to bikes and the blue line. I appreciated being able to stay away from downtown with locals and small houses.

Veronica's apartment is clearly a labor of love. She has decorated with care, and her Emerald Kingdom theme is executed with restraint--nothing over the top. The place is super clean and, importantly, the bed is comfy. Bath is well stocked with the necessities, and we appreciated the treats she left for us. We chose this location because family lives nearby. We didn't rent a car, but we got around fine with the Irving Park bus and Lyft. Highly recommend Perkolator for your morning java.

The home was comfortable, cozy, and very clean. Its location was convenient, with easy access to transportation and a small convenience store just around the corner. The backyard space was beautiful, and the private parking was a great added benefit. I also appreciated that the home had multiple bathrooms, which made the stay even more convenient. One thoughtful touch I really enjoyed was the full-length mirrors throughout the home, making it easy to get a full view of outfits before heading out. Overall, it was a very pleasant stay, and I truly felt at home.

This little cottage was great! It is really well renovated with everything you would need.
We stayed as a family of three with a toddler and had an adult friend stay with us.
It was big enough that we had room to eat meals and the kitchen was spacious and well stocked.
We loved having the outside area to sit in and catch up.
The location was amazing. Parking was easy for our friend who drove in, we easily caught the train both into the city and back to the airport when we left.
We went to some great cafes and parks within walking distance.
We would stay again the next time we visit Chicago!

We loved it here. It was clean and arranged beautifully. There are so many personal touches it immediately makes you feel comfortable and relaxed. The location is great - nice neighborhood and quiet at night. Definitely and highly recommend.

It was easy to get around from here on the bus and the L, plus there is a grocery store within walking distance. The noise from the restaurant downstairs was mainly music and was not a bother. It stopped as soon as the restaurant closed at 10. The day we rented a car we found a parking place right around the corner. Neighborhood felt safe.
Beautiful home in a nice and quiet neighborhood. Everything is very clean and spacious
Great neighborhood with lots to do and the apartment was clean and comfortable!

I had a wonderful stay and couldn’t have asked for a better host! Daniel was incredibly accommodating with both our late check-in and late check-out, which made the trip so much less stressful. Communication was excellent throughout, and the place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Truly appreciated the flexibility and hospitality — highly recommend staying here!
Best host ever. Thorough tour of the apartment and gave us info about the area. No doubt the best experience.
Loved my stay, will be back !
Very clean and neat, super flexible with getting in and out of the house. Cordaro was so accommodating and responsive. This was my first time with Airbnb and checked all the boxes.
Lilian’s place was a great place for our family. Roger’s Park close to Loyola beach with parking!

Thank you so much! We had a lovely time. so incredibly thankful for you dropping off the keurig. 🙏🙏🙏
We would be happy to stay here again.

Fue una estancia agradable y cómoda , bien conectada a otros lugares sobre todo downtown . La zona era linda y con una energía hermosa. Sin duda volvería otra vez ahí ! Gracias por su atención y amabilidad
I would definitely recommend this place for someone on a budget! Me and my partner were definitely satisfied with everything. Also, good communication. I would stay here again!

Thanks Naomi and JJ!
Our group was very comfortable. This house had everything we needed.
It was clean and quiet.

A beautiful home, very clean and safe! Only a 3 minute walk from the CTA bus stop! They even had coffee K-Cups mailed to the house without even having to ask! Great spot to stay in quiet and safe neighborhood!
Very nice and convenient stay!

I had a wonderful stay here! I would highly recommend! The only issue I did have that kinda made me a little mad was that apparently there is street cleaning Friday & Monday. We were not informed about this. So one of the guests that was staying with me got a $60 parking ticket for something we did not know about. Maybe for the future if guests could be informed if there is street cleaning it could prevent someone else from getting an unwanted parking ticket.

I stayed four nights in May 2026 while visiting my daughter who lives nearby.  According to her, this is a typical carriage or coach house, which are common in Chicago. Cozy and functional. Bedroom has a wall of artistic photo portraits. Comfortable bed. Sliding doors to block off bathroom and bedroom. Not a place to prepare serious meals: no stove or oven, only a microwave, and no dining table and chairs. Two good restaurants a walkable mile away: Daisies and Cozy Corner. Good grocery store, Tony's, a block away. Pleasant neighborhood.
Joseph was very accommodating with offering an early check in/late check out, the place was perfect for our weekend trip, close to public transit and in a lovely neighborhood.
Erika’s place was very clean and looked exactly like the photos. Walking distance to coffee, restaurants and bars. The beds were so comfy!
Both ladies were very nice & welcoming !! I’d book again

For a inexpensive Airbnb within walking distance from Andersonville/Uptown activities this was the perfect spot
Definitely the type of place really only meant to be a crash pad, however the place was spotless - even the shared bathrooms were very clean.
I believe there’s 5 or so other Airbnb units in this second level living area.
My only two minor negative notes were, 1, there was no AC/fan so on hot sticky days it was hard to cool down until the evening, even with the window cracked. 2, this specific room’s window looks directly into the window of the next building. There were a group of men in the next building with the window open, so I opted to leave my curtain shut despite being hot. Obviously out of the hosts control so no biggie
Overall I would stay here again and thought it was perfect for the price, however I may try one of the other rooms (if I remember correctly I picked this one bc it was cheapest, so nbd)
Great stay, very comfortable. Great location very close to the Brown Line train which takes you right to the loop. Quite neighborhood to come back to after the hustle and bustle of downtown.

We stayed at Mark and Marcelo’s Airbnb for my daughter’s graduation weekend. The house was beautiful and there was plenty of room for my family to enjoy visiting. We would definitely stay there again.
Thanks for a clean and efficient stay! Location was PERFECT.
The place was good and clean but the host is very rude, unprofessional and disrespectful. I will not book with them again.
All around perfect in every way

We had a lovely stay — the apartment is extremely clean, well set up and quiet.  In particular, it was comfortably dark at night for sleeping and quiet.  The neighborhood is lovely (quiet tree-lined streets) yet very close to Clark Street for all sorts of stores, restaurants, activities. Our favorite place to stay in Andersonville so far!

Nicholas was a great host! His place is in very green and pretty area close to the university. The only issues were the elevator & building access - our fob did not work for the entire stay. Luckily, we were able to catch residents who were able to let us in & up so wasn’t too bad. If they aren’t there though, it would be hard to enter. The second thing was the overall climate - it seemed to get pretty warm and the AC unit isn’t strong throughout the space. There are some additional space fans, but they only circulated the hot air (not like a more modern one). Otherwise, it was very spacious and clean. Very communicative.

I stayed at Ben's place as a solo traveler this May, spending four nights in the Queen room. The room is cozy rather than large, but perfectly adequate for a solo stay. The cleaning crew had just finished when I arrived, so everything was fresh and tidy. I also appreciated that Ben was kind enough to accommodate an early check-in and a slightly later check-out, which made a real difference.
The location is a definite highlight. The Blue Line California station is within walking distance, and there are good restaurants and cafes nearby. Very convenient for getting around the city.
One suggestion for improvement: the mattress is on the softer side, which may not suit everyone, especially if you prefer firmer back support. The AC worked well throughout the stay.
Overall, I had a pleasant experience and would recommend this place to other travelers.
Beautiful place! Absolutely loved the ensuite bathroom and the balcony patio! Molly was an absolute gem, so grateful for the chance to stay here and enjoy a new to me neighborhood in Chicago.
Wonderful small apartment.  Great location and Lisa was wonderful to work with

This house was perfect for our stay! It is centrally located, easy walking distance to the stadium, to parks, to grocery stores, to restaurants. The house is nicely updated and comfortable. The rooftop patio is entertaining! Highly recommended!!

Im glad we selected this location for our stay in Chicago. Pictures usually make the rooms look bigger that what they are, but we were impressed with the size of the living room space. Everything was as described, so many good restaurants within walking distance. What sold it for us was the private parking in the back. Our daughters also loved the place, and the furnishings. I’m sure we will be back. :)

I never had such a wonderful experience, Jenny and her husband were so nice! Her husband help us out to figure out how to move around the city, and gave us good recommendations on what to do. Jenny was always very friendly and the department was very clean, very cozy, there were many blankets and she was nice enough to let us bring an extra friend with short notice. The neighborhood is really pretty and safe! This is a perfect place to stay even if is only women in the trip for how safe it is! I would love to come back!

Great location for what we needed.  Inside was delightful,  more than stocked with key items.  No problem with the 3rd floor step entry.  The only marginal issue was parking in the alley way.  Tight and congested.  But Ken provided street parking of which there we ample spaces.

One of the best places I’ve stayed, Host Marco was always responsive and helpful before during and after my stay. House was very clean and has everything you need and much more including party box games. You can always park your car in front of the house free. It has a porch which you can sit after a busy day. Also It’s nicely decorated. I recommend this place to everyone who will be at the Chicago.

Mera's place is nice and provides good value. My only issue with the place is the noise of the AC units. Especially the one in the bedroom. The days we were there were very warm and, even though the AC unit did keep the room cool, the noise was a lot for us. Ear plugs that were in the room when we got there should have been an indication (I thought there were for the street noise). Other than that, it was a good stay.

We booked it for the location and it was terrific. Easy walk to 151 bus to get to zoo and downtown, easy walk the other direction to Clark Street and lots of great stuff there.
Busy area, but also quiet place. Bedrooms being at the garden level was nice to keep them quiet and cool.
Práctico, cómodo y bien ubicado,  en una zona tranquila, segura y con transporte publico cerca. lo hemos pasado muy bien

Overall a great place. Would definitely recommend it to others as well. Only hiccup was the discomfort while using sofa bed. Rest everything was indeed accurate per description prior to booking. Thank you!
The house is so beautiful. It like straight out of a movie set. Loved staying there and will definitely come back.

Nikkole was a very friendly and responsive host! We booked the stay for six adults. The moment we booked she messaged me to make sure we would be okay with the space. The space was exactly as she described and as shown in the pictures - we were even pleasantly surprised by the kitchen being bigger than expected. She was very responsive and even dropped off extra pillows and linens while we were out when we asked her to bring more. 10/10 would recommend staying here.

If you are just looking for a place to sleep, Rida's place does provide 4 bedrooms but otherwise it's a very tight space for 7 people.  The photos made it appear to have more rooms to relax but it is not. There's only 1 small bathroom, a very tight lounge area off the tight kitchen.  The air conditioning was not working,  so it was very hot. Rida couldn't get anyone to come until the day we checked out. Most of the windows wouldn't stay up to open, we had to use something to hold it up so little air was coming in. For the price of $1400+ for 2 nights, I don't think it was worth it. I would rather book 2 rooms at   at a hotel where there were 2 bathrooms and it wasn't gso cramp like sardines.  But the place was clean.
The check in instructions were clear and they were friendly. Room looks just like the photos!
First time for me and I was alone. I felt safe, the place was clean, smelled nice and the temp was perfect. I will absolutely be back. Thank you so much!
This home was perfect, exactly as described, and Gina was so easy to deal with and very responsive to every question that we had. I would absolutely book here again.

Comfortable space in a great location! We enjoyed our stay in this garden level apartment in Logan Square. We were a short walk to bus stops, and slightly longer walk to blue line train stations, and close to restaurants and grocery stores. The apartment was easy to find, with clear instructions on how to enter the property. The space was clean and inviting, with a large living space, a well equipped kitchen, a spacious bathroom, and a comfortable bed. Thanks for a great stay!
Amazing airbnb! We had a great time in chicago! Would book again! Super clean and responsive with any needs

Beautiful remodeled space.  Very centrally located.  If you’re in town to experience a Cubs game and the very energetic vibe of the bars and restaurants on Clark, this place can’t be beat.  It gets a little rowdy at night given the proximity to the nightlife.  This would be my only words of caution to say a family with younger kids.  Otherwise, the owner did a great job on the unit!

David's place was great, it looked exactly like the pictures. There are a ton of great restaurants and bars nearby plus easy access to public transportation. David was very responsive and gave very clear directions on how to check in, which was incredibly easy.
He also had great recommendations on all of the nearby attractions. Next time I'm in Chicago I'll be sure to check and see if his AirBnB is available.

Danisha was a great host. Allowing us to have my daughter’s prom send off… I’m forever grateful and thankful for her. Place looked exactly like the pics. Felt right at home. The home itself was beautiful!!

Michele's house was set up to accommodate a guest (areas reserved for my stuff). I had everything that I needed. I felt welcome to use the common space. Michele and Marsh were helpful and easy to get along with. I drove my car to the Cottage Grove & 63rd train station for easy access to the green L train. I was able to park my car in front of the house every night.
Another great stay! Fun neighborhood, easy train from airport, good proximity to downtown Chicago.
Great place to stay, train nearby
This was a beautiful place, I had a wonderful time here.
Had a wonderful time. I’d stay at Danielle’s lovely apartment again happily!

Best host ever!!! Terry greeted us and helped us get inside. The home was just what the pictures showed. What an amazing location. Literally less than a mile from Wrigley field, the train station is right down the street and several local restaurants and shops. We would definitely stay here again and I highly recommend!!! This made our experience in Chicago more than we imagined!
Tracee’s place was great! The location was perfect and having a parking spot was so convenient. Definitely recommend!

We had a great stay at Laura's place with our 18-month-old. It's a very comfortable garden apartment with a well-equipped kitchen and within walking distance to a grocery store, bars/restaurants, playgrounds and the train. Would stay here again!
Good location, and a house with charm. I'll definitely be back!

Jerry and Amy are great host. They responded to our questions and needs right away and made our stay very pleasant. Their house is beautiful and spacious. The location is convenient. There are shops and restaurants nearby.  This  is a perfect home to stay! Thank you very much!

Christina was a great host, and the apartment was clean and well-stocked. The location is great, a short walk to the lake, red line train, grocery stores and restaurants. The only downside is that many people in the building seem to smoke inside their apartments and the stairwell, so the hallways and stairs in the building frequently smelled like cigarette and weed smoke.
we had a great time at Jim's place in Chicago. clean place, nice spot in town close to the lake. 3 bathrooms in the house really comes in clutch. Thanks again we had a wonderful time in chicago.
Very kind and very quick in responding!
We had an excellent time at the Airbnb. LaKesha was an amazing host and helped with any issues we had.
Great stay.
We were in Chicago for our son’s graduation. This was a great space for us all to gather together. The backyard area was great!!
Great neighborhood, easy access to public transportation, matched the host’s description.

This apartment is in a great location! I was a vendor for Renegade Craft Fair that took place just down the street and it was such a convenient location and the garage was a lifesaver with storing my market supplies overnight. I would note that the garage is a pretty tight squeeze getting in and out and might be tricky if you have a bigger vehicle. The layout of the apartment is very comfortable and the beds were great! The unit does have two entryway doors - one going to an interior stairwell that leads to the street the address is listed as and the other door goes to the porch with a staircase that leads to the parking lot and garage in the back.
Loved the place! Kim was very kind and helpful. Communication was superb 10/10. Would keep this place in mind next visit.

Great and affordable place to stay in Chicago. U will have ur own private room and the place matched the photos and the Host gave very detailed and organized instructions and was very responsive!! I personally loved that the shower had good running Hot water! Will definitely book again!

The place itself is hard to find at night because it’s very dark. The ceiling could use a little work on in the basement room. But overall, the room is very clean, we did not feel icky. The location is right next to a bus stop so that’s really awesome.

We love the location of the this condo. It's walkable to McCormick Center and many other restaurant and attractions. It's spacious and clean.
It's on the expensive side and for the price, I would have expected some 'small luxuries' like bath floor mats, extra face and bath towels when requested, full length mirrors, top sheets, etc. Those types of amenities are non-existent or lacking IMO. Other than that I recommend the condo.
Great Place to stay and Vince was response to all questions throughout the day. Highly recommend staying here for any large group events in Chicago!

This place was such a comfy stay. We didn't have to ask for anything because the space was proactively equipped with things and helpful guides. The neighborhood was quiet despite the train closeness and accessible to stores and amazing food. I would definitely rebook.

The duplex unit looks just like the pictures and was pretty clean. Host was very responsive throughout the whole process. I needed an earlier check-in based on our flight arrivals and was able to accommodate us for a small additional fee. The house is close to downtown.  When checking out a storm started while we were outside waiting for our ride and the host was nice enough to allow us back in the house after check out so we did not have to stand in the rain. Overall we had a really good stay here.

Gogo's place was so lovely! The space was thoughtfully decorated and very comfortable. There were toiletries and snacks stocked, board games, etc. Gogo was very responsive and greeted us when we arrived. The neighborhood was great too. We didn't have a car with us but we were able to take the train, bus, and Uber very easily. We would definitely stay here again!
Good

From the moment we booked, Anne made the entire experience seamless. Her communication was prompt, clear, and thorough — she answered every question we had and made sure we felt confident before we even arrived. While there, Anne kept checking on us asking if we needed anything. Exactly what you hope for in a host.
The property itself is exactly as advertised. No surprises, no disappointments — just a clean, well-appointed space that had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The place was neat and thoughtfully set up, making it easy to settle right in.
One of the standout features? Two full bathrooms in a one-bedroom unit. For my wife, that was great — no waiting, no rushing, just convenience. My wife noticed it immediately and appreciated it throughout the stay, especially while getting her makeup ready for the wedding reception we attended.
If we’re back in the city — and hopefully we will be — Anne’s place is our first call. Highly recommend. 👍👍👍

This is a great stay if you need a an affordable and comfortable place to sleep. It's close to plenty of things while not being in a congested part of the city. It was clean and easy to check-in and out of. The host provided all information I could need, so I never felt like I had to reach out for anything. Super nice and on top of it.
Great stay.

Viktor’s place was in a nice, quiet neighborhood and he was quickly responsive. He cares about his space and
Will continuously ask questions about it.I will say there are a few small details that he needs to update as far as the overall maintenance for the house. Other than that he was accommodating for our stay.

My partner and I stayed five nights David's apartment for 5 nights during one of our regular trips to Chicago for food, theater, museums, etc. We brought our bikes, and the basement storage room was great for securely storing them. Great location for biking to lake, Lincoln Park, Wicker Park! Also great location for getting around the city on public transportation. Big, well equipped & decorated, comfortable apartment. Many thoughtful details. David's recommendation and instruction book is very helpful and interesting. Would love to stay here again.

This was the perfect place to stay! It is so walkable and in a nice area!! I loved all the amenities nearby and James was very helpful with his instructions and the place was very spacious and easily laid out!
Great spot for a quick weekend stay - close to public transit, nice and clean, and the host provided excellent instructions

We loved our stay in Chicago! Eva was the most responsive host and provided a plethora of helpful information prior to check-in.
The Airbnb is even more spacious than the pictures! The bedrooms were private, comfortable, and clean. The location was fantastic and we were thrilled to have on-site parking in the back.
We’ll definitely keep this listing as our top pick for our next large-family gathering in Chicago. Thank you for the wonderful stay!

The location is great! close to plenty of restaurants, bars, breweries, and shopping. We rented a car and never had trouble finding street parking.
The unit is nicely decorated and includes a lot of helpful amenities, including a washer/dryer, dishwasher, dishes, coffee maker, pods, and soap. The bedrooms were spacious and comfortable, and there was also a cot available for extra sleeping space.
However, the rental could use some maintenance and updates. The gate code stopped working halfway through our stay, and the entry to the unit did not feel as secure or private as expected. The biggest issue was the bathroom, which had mold and peeling paint on the ceiling. The shower also drained slowly and bubbled when the toilet was flushed.
The host lives on the property and was responsive when contacted, but her dogs barked frequently. Overall, the location and amenities were great, but the unit would benefit from repairs and better security/privacy.
One of the better ones I stayed at. just great all the way around!

We had a good stay overall. The host was friendly and made check-in and check-out easy. The home was clean and the neighborhood was quiet and peaceful. It was also convenient to have bus stops within walking distance, with easy access to downtown via public transit.
A few things to note: the AC unit is located very close to the bedrooms and would turn on throughout the night, which was noticeably loud. We also heard heavy footsteps running back and forth in the mornings. The layout was a little unexpected, as the home is essentially one long hallway connecting the living room and kitchen with bedrooms along the way. It wasn't a problem, just different than anticipated. The kitchen was smaller with a limited selection of utensils, and the body wash was empty when we arrived. The bathroom was clean, but there is no ventilation fan, and the shower is only partially enclosed, so some water tends to splash onto the floor. Overall, the space worked well as a home base for exploring Chicago.

Benjamin was there upon arrival and even let me check my bags super early so I didn’t have to drag them around the city!
He had great recommendations for the area - restaurants, shopping, coffee, etc.
This was a girls trip with my bestie and we felt safe walking from the train to our apartment.
Such a great experience and we can’t wait to come back and visit!

The host has thought of everything. We had such a wonderful and easy stay. We stayed with 8 adults, a 4 year old, and 1 year old. We had ample space and loved the area. Overall it was a perfect setup for our family!
Great space it had everything to you need. Great for families with young kids. Alex was very communicative.
Great place to stay if you want to feel like a true Chicago local
Great host
Great place for our visit to Chicago.

Henok has a beautiful house in a quiet neighborhood. There are great food options close by, many parklets and public transportation plus free parking outside! Not only is the house beautiful, but Henok was very friendly and helpful with anything we needed and gave us recommendations.
It was great for us to be able to walk and jump on the train to wherever we needed to go. Don’t miss out on Cleo’s for the best catfish around!

This Airbnb was perfect for my needs. I was in town for The Bruno Mars concert at Solder Stadium. I picked Heidi’s because it’s conveniently located next to the bus stop and a short walk from the Red Line. I ended up walking back from the concert and it wasn’t that bad of a walk either. The space was nice, quiet and clean. Also has amazing places to eat in Chinatown.

Sarah was easy to work with and had a lovely spot!  We arrived very late and had a rambunctious weekend as our friend got married. Excellent communication, great local recommendations. We would love to stay with Sarah again!

We stayed here while celebrating our daughter’s college graduation. The apartment had plenty of beds, was clean, in a quiet walkable neighborhood and felt comfortable. Linens were clean and there were tons of towels for our use. We had issues the first day of the hot water being very low. The hosts responded very quickly and turned up the hot water heater. (It was lukewarm at best before). We appreciated the quickness of their response. The only thing g I would suggest for guests who plan on cooking would be to bring cooking utensils,  measuring cups and spoons, hot pads and oven mitts. Otherwise it’s a well furnished apartment with 5 beds, 2 bathrooms, a washing machine and dryer, comfortable seating that is in a very nice neighborhood. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this listing. Thanks for hosting us!

Gary's place was ideal for our family, with plenty space to socialize in the living room and dining room. It is accessible to the train, and we enjoyed getting to know the neighborhood--a nearby cafe, restaurants, and walkable streets. The house is comfortable, well-appointed, stocked with supplies, and super clean. We cooked breakfast there and could have easily cooked dinners if we'd have been staying longer--Gary set up a great kitchen. Thank you, Gary!
Absolutely beautiful place!! Reggie was a wonderful host and this is a hidden gem in Chicago. Would highly recommend this place to stay! And it has a gorgeous rooftop view of the city 🤩
Beautiful and comfortable apartment in a perfect location — very cozy and an ideal home base in Andersonville. David was a great host and very communicative.

I can’t express how much I enjoyed this little visit to Chicago to see friends because of this brilliant AirBnB and its host.
It suited my needs perfectly with location and amenities. The bed is so comfortable. The kitchen is spotless, the shower pressure and heat is excellent. The host is so friendly and helpful. Totally worth it.

Bennett’s place was very nice we had a good stay there. There occasionally was some footsteps that we heard but thats expected to happen. There was one time that they were in the closet that is in the shared hallway so we heard that and they had left the door unlocked. But overall we had a good stay. And they were very nice when we met them.

My spouse and I visited Chicago for their birthday and loved staying here. It was private, comfortable, clean, and in a great walkable neighborhood. The host provided awesome recommendations. Getting around the city was very easy as it’s positioned near several bus stops. All in all we had a great trip!
We had a great stay! The place was clean and comfortable. Overall, great value in an awesome neighborhood. We would definitely stay again.
Great place for a long weekend trip!

The MVP Suite was clean and well located next to Wrigley field and Lake View area. The apartment was well furnished and had all the amenities you’ll need. I’ll definitely stay here again when back in Chicago.
Cloud 9 was a great host and very communicative! Very smooth check in and the home was so beautiful and put together. Definitely will come back I loved the place and it’s a very secure building!

very good communication, prompt, went out of her way for us. Chicago is a tough parking city, but it has very good public transportation. So, I would use that next time. We rented a car in NYC and drove out for a wedding, so we needed a car. Needed extra towels, and she got them for us the very next day. I was worried about noise from the upstairs apartment, but it wasn't an issue at all.

We stayed at this townhouse for my daughter’s wedding weekend.  It was better than expected. It had every amenity imaginable and set up for a great place to gather.  We had 3 couples and a 9 month old.  We all had our private space and plenty of room to gather.  Clean, unique and beautiful.   Rey comfortable beds.  The location couldn’t be beat.  Truly close to everything, short walk or uber away from all attractions.  Walk to the beach was lovely,  the neighborhood is so beautiful with restaurants and shops a very short walk away.  Julian’s communication was top notch.  We had 0 issues.i would highly recommend and would stay here again in a heart beat.

We had a fantastic stay here for my birthday trip to Chicago. The apartment was clean, spacious and really comfortable, especially the huge king-size beds and mattresses, which made a big difference after long days exploring and jet lag!
We loved the open-plan kitchen and lounge layout, and everything was exactly as expected. Check-in was simple with the lockbox, and the hosts were always responsive and helpful with any questions.
The location is brilliant, right by the train station for easy access into town, but also perfectly placed to enjoy Lincoln Park itself, which is such a beautiful neighbourhood with great shops, restaurants and bars.
A really special stay for us, made even more memorable as we got engaged whilst we were there. Would absolutely recommend.
Great location! Super easy to every train line and walkable to restaurants and coffee shops. Would recommend to friends visiting Chicago.
better then expected. clean, comfortable, 10min walk to the train. at no point did i feel unsafe.

Steve was a great host and very responsive to questions. We had a great time being able to walk to great restaurants and the public transportation nearby. We had plenty of space to gather family to celebrate our kid's graduation.
Clean, comfy, quiet. Jose was responsive & helpful. We had the best breakfast at the bakery across the street.
This location was a 10/10! So many great things to do locally. The home was beautiful and the host communicated very well. When I am back in town I will defiantly look into booking again.

This was an amazing stay! The home was spacious and comfy at the same time. Had everything we needed and even coke in a can in the fridge, which I rarely have but I really do love! Great little treat.
We felt close enough to everything but far enough to not hear the hustle and bustle. We walked to many places nearby and the neighborhood was adorable!
Even the ride into the city was great because you get to pass the lake and see the skyline on the way on.
Highly recommend taking the train when you can. Definitely a great spot to stay.
Thanks for a great stay!!
Great hospitality! Will definitely return!
Thank you Nat. Your flat was perfect.

A great location, felt super safe and plenty of decent restaurants and coffee shops in walking distance. Lots of really good bus options to get all over the city.
Mary was a very responsive host and was very friendly. The apartment is her own, so has all of her things in it, but I had the place to myself as Mary stayed somewhere else, so that was great! The bed was comfortable and it was nice and quiet.

Fabulous! Danny’s beautiful place was perfect for our trip to visit our grandchildren. Spacious, comfortable, well-equipped, and in the best location (the LP Zoo, Oz Park, restaurants galore at your doorstep). Danny was quick to respond to my questions, too. We’ll be back!

Matthew was a fantastic host. The place was nice and the beds were very comfortable. I loved the two bathrooms with the shower/tub combo and walk in shower. I definitely recommend renting his place if you’re in Chicago. The red line CTA (Howard) isn’t too far so you have access to downtown without having to drive. Quiet and peaceful😊
Great spot to stay for Pulaski Park area, easy to navigate to many Chicago places
Always such a pleasure staying here. It’s like a small home away from home :)

Had to cancel last minute. Aaron was understanding and very helpful.
Thank you

Great hosts. They offered early check-in as soon as the place was ready, allowed a later checkout during rainy weather even though they had new guests arriving the same day, and were happy to store our bag after checkout. Communication was always prompt and helpful.
The place is spacious, well-equipped, and had everything we needed. The neighborhood is walkable, with plenty of great restaurants nearby.
Overall, a very comfortable stay and a great base for exploring the city.

Overall perfect for my trip!
Within 15 minutes from all major Chicago attractions.
Best if you are looking for just a place to sleep and store your things. Not much room to hangout in living room space if you have more than 2 people.
The apartment was very clean and in an excellent location. Robert was incredibly helpful, responsive, and friendly throughout the stay. I’d definitely recommend staying here!
great host! would stay here again

We have stayed at the Walton Res. over a half dozen times and have already booked our next stay for Sept.  That says it all. The well equipped  and exceptional space, the location, and friendly, professional, helpful staff creates a wonderful getaway for us. It is truly home away from home!!

Andriy's place is brand new, clean, and spotless! The finishes are high-end in the oversized bathroom and kitchen, and the main bedroom has an extremely comfortable king-sized bed. The dining room table was big enough to double as a workspace, and the living room had a comfortable couch. There's a hip-hop focused barbershop just below and amazing coffee shops, restaurants, and even a Mariano's grocery store two blocks away on Chicago Ave. The traffic can be a little loud in the front room, but a sound sleeper and/or children would be fine there.
Our hosts were incredibly responsive, even on a Sunday morning! If you want to stay in a brand new place and like the busy city vibe of historic Chicago Ave., you'll love Andriy's place!

We absolutely loved our stay! The tree-lined neighborhood was charming, and we enjoyed walking around and visiting the nearby coffee shops. The location was perfect. The house comfortably accommodated all 7 of us for our girls trip, and having enough bedrooms and bathrooms for everyone made such a difference. The place was nicely decorated and each room was adorable and had its own unique character. Max was great - communicative and accommodated some requests we had.
Très bon séjour chez Madame Ming ! La chambre était propre, confortable et conforme à la description. Je recommande cet Airbnb sans hésitation. Merci encore !
Great place to stay! Comfortable, easy to find, and he was very helpful and responsive with everything! Would definitely stay again
Great location, we saw the Bruno Mars concert at Soldier Field.
We enjoyed our stay. You couldn’t ask for a better location. The host was frequently checking in on us and very flexible with the check-in time.
Oscar was a wonderful host

We had such an amazing time at Roberto's place!!! It was the perfect place to chill out after a long day of exploring Chicago. We loved staying somewhere with such fun decor, and Roberto was incredibly kind and communicative! Definitely recommend.

The space itself was amazing — very clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed. The hosts were incredibly responsive, friendly, and accommodating throughout our stay. The location was awesome and neighborhood was safe and quiet. They were also upfront in advance that the space was not fully soundproof from the family living above, which we appreciated.
That said, the noise from upstairs ended up being more significant than we anticipated. We could clearly hear footsteps overhead, at times sounding like heavy “elephant footsteps,” and on Saturday night the activity continued quite late into the night. Even with earplugs, the noise still came through and unfortunately interfered greatly with our ability to rest and sleep well.
Overall, the hosts were kind and transparent, and the space itself was lovely, but guests who are sensitive to noise or light sleepers should be aware of the sound transfer from upstairs.
This place was exactly as described. The neighborhood felt safe and we had no issues checking in. Would stay here again!
Had a great time here!
Our family had a great time and would come back the next time we’re in Chicago. Much appreciated.

This home was perfect for our stay in Chicago. So much to do and see right in this neighborhood. We had so much fun and enjoyed the home and the patio after exploring all day. Everything was perfect and we would definitely stay here again!

Thomas’s apartment was great! We had a group of 5 and it was more than enough space. I loved the location - it’s in walking distance of a lot of great areas in the West Loop. Thomas was very responsive and had great communication that made finding the space, checking in and out super easy and smooth.
great stay! a little small but it’s all you need! great communication from hosts really helpful!

Very responsive host and accommodating host.  Unit was clean and updated.  Great neighbor location, felt right at home.  Made it difficult to leave to enjoy the city, preferred to stay in some days to enjoy the apartment.  Lots to do in walking distance.  Feels safe and secure.  Has gym but also lots of fitness options in the area.

Great location, so close to public transit and walkable areas - our walks to nearby restaurants and venues were beautiful. The room was very clean and made the perfect place to crash between events during our busy Chicago weekend!
It was fantastic

A great stay in a pleasant neighborhood! Angela was kind, communicative, and a great host. Space is surprisingly quite large, with lots of rooms for games and hosting. We loved the neighborhood and will definitely be back!

It was a great stay! Me and my friends had a wonderful first experience in chicago. It was just far enough out of the city to be very peaceful but close enough so we can still visit downtown. Overall 10/10!
Excellent option in Chicago, a few streets from Institute of Art, coffee shop around!  Bus and Metro one block, Just perfect to enjoy Chicago !
Always love our time in Chicago and at Nate’s place. Really comfortable and clean, easy with kids, and great, convenient neighborhood. Will always try to stay here when we’re in town!
Great apartment and near the action!

Alicia was an incredibly responsive and kind host. I booked her place for a bachelorette party with 5 ladies and it was perfect for us. Walking distance to the Red line, 25 minute walk to Montrose Beach, and tons of good places to eat around. The space was clean, modern, and had everything we needed.

Great hosts.
Incredible location.
Communicated well.

Quiet neighborhood, a lot of trees surrounding area gives you a peaceful feeling. Host with sense of urgency, brought us what we asked for. place as described, we were fourbpersons and had enough space, you can find anything around neighborhood from restaurants to liquor stores. there is also an Aldi 4 minutes away driving. 15 minutes away from Chinatown and 25 from downtown. plenty parking outside house. my personal recommendation is either rent a car or ride share.

clean space. quick Wi-Fi. good amount of utensils.
the only thing I would recommend adding a blackout curtain in the smaller bedroom to block out bright light
Would definitely stay here again.

This was great lodging, and helped me in a pinch. The co-host responded quickly and clearly to my questions, and the place was beautiful. When minor issues arose, such as the main bathroom's shower not having hot water, or the clothes dryer not drying clothes, they responded quickly.
There's a good grocery store half a mile away, along with a McDonald's and Subway. But I didn't find other food options in the immediate area - no cafes or convenient stores.
I never felt unsafe, nor saw any evidence of unsafe activity. Still, I didn't wander at night or move without purpose during the day. My two weeks there makes me feel that this neighborhood has an unfair reputation of being unsafe. It seemed fine when employing a normal degree of vigilance.
I'm truly glad I got to experience a new neighborhood and understand my city better!
Great stay! The place was exactly as described, and the location couldn't have been better. Plenty of nice restaurants nearby and easy access to everything we wanted to do. Would happily book again 👌

We had a wonderful stay at Hanna’s place. The space was spacious, cozy, and very comfortable throughout our visit. The neighborhood had such a friendly atmosphere and was conveniently located near museums, Lake Michigan, and the future Obama Presidential Center. Hanna was an excellent host and very accommodating with flexibility, which made our stay even more enjoyable. We truly enjoyed our visit and would absolutely stay again!
Truly a great place in Lincoln Park. Felt like home in the city.

This apartment was great for our weekend in Chicago. Our friends lived just a few blocks away, so the location was perfect for us. We love Wicker Park and you’re both in walking and close driving distance to so many great local staples! Check in was clear and easy. We did at first have an issue with the AC, the line to the unit was flipped off on the breaker board. Once we flipped the switch, the unit got cool without issue. Overall it was a good stay for a great price.

We had a great stay :) it’s a walkable distance from the pink line so very easy access to downtown. Very quiet neighbourhood. Lovely room as well as shares spaces. Anastasia was a pleasure to deal with and the check in/out was very smooth! Many thanks and would recommend for your stay in Chicago!
Amazing stay!

The host was quick to respond, friendly, and helpful! They sent us pictures along with clear instructions for how to enter the building to get to the apartment. The area is beautiful, close to public transportation, and the apartment has good natural light! Everything was clean and was as advertised in the listing. We really enjoyed our stay!😀
Great location near the city. The space was perfect for an sibling get-together--private bed and bath for each!

It was overall fine… but couch was nasty (didn’t use) lamps were all broken, shower curtain was gross and ripped up, no towels were out and half of them were dirty, no soaps in shower dispensers, bathroom mirror was old rusty and gross, cold water didn’t work in kitchen, only one tv remote, broken closet door, faulty wiring and no working island lights. Plenty of other spaces to rent if going to Chicago. So please let this be a last resort kind of thing, overall it was fine as I really just slept here and did nothing else. But don’t take your partner here for sure. It’s not a luxury oasis.
Great location. Near the lake. Near the train. Great restaurants near by.
The place was very clean and Adam was a great host

The property did not match the expectations set by the listing and was not suitable for 10 adults as advertised. While listed as a 4-bedroom home, two of the rooms were clearly intended for children, one only had a crib and the other a twin bed with a twin bunkbed.
The home is lived in between guests, which was not disclosed in the listing. There was a dark tone to the culture of the owners as one room had amulets and 8 calendars all turned to October hanging on the wall. Cleanliness and maintenance were concerns throughout the stay, including a dirty refrigerator/freezer, hair left in the bathroom shower and sink, an unpleasant odor upon arrival, and a leaking shower head.
Additionally, the listing should mention that there are no TVs in the home so guests can set expectations appropriately. Overall, the property lacked adequate sleeping accommodations, cleanliness, and comfort for the number of guests advertised.
Ron's place was great. Perfect location and it had comfortable beds

Great apartment with train or bus nearby if you don’t feel like walking. The apartment was perfect during our stay in the city, communication with the host was great as well. We’ll definitely booked again if we come back.
Jessica was pleasant and the process was easy. The apartment was as advertised but the train noise is real.
Karma was very nice and flexible with our stay.  It's in a beautiful location close to lots of food options, a park, and the bus station.  The couch and beds were comfy.

Place is okay, there is issues with the hot water in the shower, the bed mattress felt like an air mattress.  There were power issues with the microwave and fridge it took the host 3days to get this fixed - this should have been fixed immediately.
I had a wonderful stay
Had a great stay. Especially the communication of the host was outstanding. I needed to move my booking back two weeks on short notice outside the allowed policy and this was not an issue.
Perfect stay! Very accommodating hosts, and the space was very large for a big group.

Mriganav was so chill and accommodating, told him we would possibly arrive hours before check-in due to an early flight and he had the room ready. Sometimes looks like the street is full, but there was always a few spots for parking.
Had directions for incorrect room but was quickly resolved. Wonderful place, really enjoyed the area and my time in the city!

My 16 yr old daughter and I had a great time in Chicago. This space was simple and safe and the host was very responsive. It was only about 15 min. from downtown, without having to get on any highways. Families walking their children and dogs were in the neighborhood. We were also 5 min from at least 5 coffee shops and restaurants.
Parking on the street was pretty crowded, but we always found a spot no matter the time of day. Thanks and we may be back!
Great location as hotels and air bnbs in Lincoln Park are hard to find
Great place to stay.  Easy to walk to Lincoln square and was very easy to get street parking. Place was perfect for our family and what we needed for the weekend.
Very pleased with the house and the  listing showed exactly what I expected.
Anna was very responsive and accommodating. The Airbnb is excellent and matches the pictures! Highly recommended if you need a place within walking distance of the West Loop.

We had a great stay at this location with our group! Parking was ample and such a great location with walking trail nearby into Wicker Park. Home was spacious and very clean. Would recommend for groups looking for a large space in the city!
Worked out great for us!
this is one of the boxes airbnbs we’ve stayed in. very stylish. heated bathroom floor ! great decor.  and felt very roomy. it’s in a great neighborhood. couldn’t ask for more.

Hygge Hideaway had to have been one of the best AirBnBs in which we have ever stayed - and we've stayed at a lot! It's hard to choose where to begin...the kitchen and coffee bar were incredible. We stayed there with our two adult children and spouses and all of us prefer different styles of coffee. HH had it covered! I especially appreciated the small first aid kit in the bathroom having brought a long a new pair of shoes before testing them out. My blisters appreciated the Bandaids! The outdoor space was very much enjoyed, both the balcony seating above and the firepit and hot tub below. We even enjoyed exploring the album collection in the small sitting room. It's as though you thought of everything a guest could possibly need. Kudos to you! Expect us to return someday.
Jake’s place was great! The location was perfect to walk to dinner. Jake was very communicative at all times throughout our stay.
A good place if you want somewhere safe to sleep and convenient to getting to downtown Chicago. Easy to check in and parking was convenient and free
We appreciated the quiet neighborhood, private parking,  beds were comfortable.  Lewis was fast to respond to questions.

This location was perfect for a weekend in Chicago! The neighborhood was very nice and peaceful, and there were several restaurants and stores in walkable distance. It was only about a 15 minute walk to the nearest train station, which was really convenient for getting around. The space itself was very clean and private, and there was a lot more room than I was expecting! I would definitely stay here again in the future.
Fantastic location, quality find. Host was extremely generous despite us running a little behind with our check out time. Very clean and relaxing.
Everything was wonderful, would highly recommend!
Location was fantastic
Thank you for hosting us, great place, great location, will definitely stay there again

We loved the apartment. Very convenient location to Andersonville highlights and our son. Apartment was very clean, everything worked including the air conditioning which was needed during our stay in hot weather. Comfortable bed and chair for viewing TV.  Reserved parking space is a great amenity. No complaints.
Cozy stay in a good location, would definitely recommend and revisit
Great place to stay in Bridgeport.

Very clean and beautiful vintage 2 bedroom condo/apt in a nice neighborhood. Had a nice stay with my friends. It was quiet and peaceful and worth the price. Parking wasn't too bad during our stay. The instructions were clear and easy to follow. Overall it was great.
The place was amazing and very beautiful. Lilian was very responsive and helpful throughout the stay! Highly recommend this place.

We loved our stay as a group of 5 girls. Having all the en suite bathrooms was fabulous! The pantry was well stocked with plates, cups, and silverware for us to use, even though it was just a kitchenette. There was a bit of noise at night from a concert venue nearby, but only for one night. Train noise was not too bad, despite it being super close and convenient! Would definitely stay again.

Overall great place to stay. Large comfy beds and two full bathrooms is ideal for a group. Very walkable to restaurants and was a ~35-40 min beautiful walk to Shedd Aquarium and Soldier Field. Milan gave us a ton of instructions on how to get into the building, we thought it was overkill at first but ended up being pretty necessary LOL! Only negative thing I could say is it’s just a classic air bnb in a city … very used and picked up but not very clean. We wished there were extra pillows and sheets. But again, overall good stay!
Thankyou for the support very clean home and nice neighborhood will be staying here again
Randy was very responsive and everything was as advertised. He even helped us out when we need more towels. Awesome place and host

Location: Amazing. Two blocks from the Brown line. One block off major bus routes. Food, coffee, everything. Buy a metro pass, and you will have access to everything Chicago has to offer. We chose this location because of Moody Bible Institute, which is a block away. Access was seemless for all of our party because of the smart locks on the building & unit.
Unit: AC didn't work, which was terrible because it was hot. It says it will hold 8 - Two queens, a futon, Two roll-aways, and an air mattress. We needed all of them. The air mattress was useless, so one person slept on the floor. This host is either new to hosting, or just doesn't care - this unit is BARE BONES compared to any other Airbnb I have stayed in. It has an Iron... but no ironing board? Cheap, flimsy furniture. No books, magazines, or so much as a card game.
It's fine if you won't be there except to sleep and need to sleep a large number like we did - but don't go in with expectations.
The house was great and he was very accommodating and flexible.
Mario’s place was beautiful and the pictures matched the description.

Awesome spot and location to bounce around to restaurants and local spots. Safe and lively neighborhood with tons of people walking their dogs. Easy to park in street. Inside space was clean and neat and matched photos. Host was very responsive with communication and let us know we could check in early if needed and provided great instructions/recommendations. Place is perfect for 3-4 people. My only complaint was inability to open windows for hot temps. Rest of the place was cozy and would stay again.

Our stay at Linong’s was perfect. Plenty of space for everyone that was staying in the apartment so it didn’t feel like we were on top of each other with the separate bedrooms and multiple bathroom options. Wish there was more of a living room area that fit us all at the end of the night as we unwinded but we made it work. There is a cute Italian bakery downstairs and loved that in the morning. Easy location to get to as we were in town for a concert so it was only 15min anywhere we were looking to go. Would recommend!
Thank you for hosting us!  Cozy place in a great location!  Private entrance and bathroom!!
Perfect location in the heart of Wrigleyville.  Our host was super responsive and made check-in/out a breeze.  Very walkable to everything you'd want to eat, see or do in the area.

Dream rentals used a separate website that made communication difficult and resulted in  lengthy delays.  I waited an hour to get the dirty rooms resolved.  I finally had to ask them to call me.  Their resolution to the issue was to give me a different room but only for one night and then they wanted me to move into my original room.  That was not acceptable since I was busy the next day without any time to change rooms.  I expressed that was not a reasonable solution.  They then had to delay some more to finally agree with me.
Great location
Place was very clean and perfect for what we needed!
Marcos was very nice and accomodating. The location was great with lots of cafes and restaurants nearby, as well as being close to several bus stops. I found it super easy to get around!

Great location and value! It was very walkable to the orange line train and we could get everywhere we needed. I really appreciated also having a lot to park in since that made me feel at ease leaving my car as I was exploring the city. The room was tidy and other guests were quiet (I never saw anyone else while I was there). Olga is a great host, I recommend!

I traveled with my 8-month old and husband. We felt right at home and my son loved the high chair, pack and play and toys at David’s place. Very walkable, quiet, and right by the zoo which is perfect for a little family outing. Had a lovely time!
Great location, easy check in and friendly staff.
Thank you so much! Super responsive :]

The space was very clean, comfortable, and easy to access from check in through departure. The proximity to Chinatown was a huge plus and made it convenient to explore the area, grab food, and move around the city. The views from the space were beautiful and really added to the overall experience. Overall, this was a great stay in a great location and we would definitely consider staying again.
Mera was a great host and the space was great for our Chicago get away to see friends get married. Lovely little place and it made it a nice stay!

We had a pleasant stay at Shaun’s! Unit was clean and as described. Good location if you are looking to stay outside the downtown area but have easy access in (was about half a mile walk to the train). Shaun was very responsive!
A little pricey,other than that,perfect in every way

Karen’s place was great for our group of 3 couples. There are different levels, so a little separation if needed. Plenty of towels and soft sheets were a plus! The location is walking distance to Chinatown and the metro stop there. We had a nice dinner at Connie’s Pizza right across the street and Quin Xiang Yuan for soup dumplings was good - also had a drink at Best Bar. We were in town for a show at Soldier Field, so we took the metro one stop then walked to the stadium. Kind of a trek on the way back with all the people leaving at once, but better than sitting in traffic that wasn’t moving. We took a rideshare to and from downtown for other excursions. Highly recommend a Wendella boat tour down the river, we did the architecture one and everyone liked it. We enjoyed our stay and the location worked well for our needs, thank you Karen!
Great space, everything was immaculate and comfortable. Had some mechanical issues during the stay but the host was very responsive and courteous. Would be happy to come back anytime!
Fantastic stay
Nice location & responsive hosts
Great host and location! Overall clean space and very spacious for 3 adults and 2 kids.

The only problem with this place is that Marco did not write that the stairs to the second floor are problematic for anyone with mobility issues. They are not regular stairs. Very narrow, steep, and uncomfortable. This is important information that should have been disclosed. Everything else was fine. Relative to Chicago prices, it is probably OK.

We had a great stay here! The top floor setup felt private and cozy, and the space was very clean. It had everything we needed. We especially loved the houseplants and the little plant setup for growing cuttings, which was such a cool and unique touch.
The listing matched the photos, and the location was perfect for exploring Logan Square. It felt safe and walkable, with plenty to do nearby.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend it.
We loved the location and views! Was quiet and easy to get to everything we needed.  Nicole and Matt were very responsive and accommodating.
Loved everything about this apartment.  Clean, close to everything, and well stocked.  We will define be back.

Amazing place to stay at when you’re exploring Chicago. very clean and quiet. Would def stay there again!

While the 1st night was fine, the 2nd night was one of the scariest things I've been in close proximity to. There were 8-10 men directly outside the main downstairs door around 1-3am lurking outside with weapons, yelling about incoming cars. A squad of police came at one point and there was high tension. The police left, and it sounded like there was about to be a shootout. Thankfully, the men got spooked, yelled about leaving the area fast, then left.
I should emphasize that I really hate to even write this review, as Olivia was fantastic and even ended up refunding us for the last night, thankfully + the actual interior was great.
