We had a great time in Wicker Park and visiting Chicago! Ewa's place was clean and a great home base for our visit. We had a minor issue with the door code and it was very quickly resolved and communication was fast and efficient. We loved Big Star taco and the walkable coffee shops. Overall a great stay, thanks for having us!

We had a nice stay! The unit was clean, had enough space for the 8 of us, and was very close to The University Club where we attended a wedding. You could hear the train but we enjoyed the city atmosphere.
Security gives you two key cards when you check in- we asked if they could hold one of them for the others checking in later but they told us they couldn’t. This was an issue since we were going to be across town at the rehearsal dinner when the others were arriving (Since the apartment had 24/7 security I didn’t foresee them holding the other key card for the other guests being an issue). We also didn’t have any face towels and the air conditioning didn’t get the bedrooms very cool. Overall we enjoyed our stay and would stay here again if we all planned to check in at the same time.
Our stay was amazing! There were so many near by restaurants and fun things to do. West loop was walkable and this place is in such a perfect spot.

Had a great stay here! Roxane’s place truly felt like a home away from home. It was comfortable, welcoming and exactly as described. She was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I also appreciated the many thoughtful conversations we had about current events and different perspectives on what’s happening around the world. She genuinely cares about her guests and creates a warm and engaging environment that makes you feel at ease. Highly recommend!
Great stay. Check in to make sure everything was OK.
Had a nice stay

This was a wonderful open layout space for our group of 10. The location was fantastic; if you’re willing to walk even half a mile, you’re able to get to so much or there’s also a train stop nearby. Although you have the typical city noises, this space felt so private. Finally, the two parking spaces are great! Assel provided such clear instructions for parking and getting into the apartment that it was such a breeze.
Keep in mind that there are stairs up to the apartment that are a bit steep. The parking is tandem around the corner with one car in the garage and another behind it. We had a larger SUV that we fit into the garage and a car behind/outside; sharing because I saw other reviews about this but want to encourage others that it was no problem for us!
Only had 2 towels but, the place was clean, spacious for 2, and parking on the street was easy.

Place was the perfect size for my husband myself and my two toddlers. Lots of parks in walking location, close to down town activities:camp, navy pier,  childrens museum, ice cream museum etc. parking was tricky at times but to be expected staying in Chicago but they provided parking passes for road parking for us which was really great! Over all great stay and my family loved it !

This was very expensive for the terrible maintenance and cleaning issues.   The apartment did not match the glowing description ("exquisite this is Not").  Kitchen is unusable for more than minimal prep.   We found stains (fresh), expired food, leaks dripping on our heads in the bathroom.  All rugs gone missing.  No A/C.   No screens on windows.   Broken blinds, broken bed, dirty bedding.  The hosts were very responsive but maintenance was playing catch-up.   Check-in was after 5 pm so one would expect more.  Discount or partial refund would have been appropriate.   Not offered, no apologies given

This Airbnb was very nice on the inside. I love the openness of the living room and kitchen, and it fit my family needs. The host was very responsive and friendly. There was a lot of stores and fast food places in the area that was very convenient, but the neighborhood was not what I had expected.
convenient clean place to stay

I can’t say enough about this home! One of the very best Airbnbs we’ve stayed at. Spacious, beautifully decorated, such attention to details throughout. The private rooftop patio is wonderful and truly helps you to enjoy being in the wonderful city of Chicago. It’s a special place with a great host. Natalie was helpful and so accommodating. We absolutely recommend and absolutely can’t wait to stay here again.

A perfect stay with a couple of caveats-the bed was far too soft and the television was a Roku with a hard to operate remote. Otherwise, perfect location, a very nice one bedroom and while the entrance is a bit off putting, the apartment is great.
Amazing spot! Sean was a great host

My husband & i stayed at Latarsha’s air bnb for the first time & it was amazing! latarsha as well as her neighbors were very welcoming & accommodating from the time we checked in until check out. The neighborhood was quiet & not too far from everywhere we needed to be. When we visit Chicago again, Latarsha air bnb will definitely be our first preference

Host was very kind and responded in a timely matter when we had questions.  Not the cleanest place but not the dirtiest. Extremely hot in the summer time. Im not sure if AC is available or if they dont want you to turn it on but it was very hot and hard to sleep. Only 1 TV.  Wifi did not work well or at all. There was a ceiling fan in the up stairs master bedroom but you needed a remote to use it and that could not be found.
Great place to stay close to the city
Beautiful home. Thank you for hosting us!

We had an amazing stay,  this place was definitely a hidden gem from the moment we walked in. It was clean, with vibrant decor and a nice breeze that felt almost therapeutic. The atmosphere was very relaxing and comfortable. Overall, a great experience with a wonderful host and excellent accommodations.

Jenn was an excellent host. She checked in regularly and provided clear communication.
The location is in a great neighborhood on a quiet street, but still very walkable. The unit matched the description and photos.

The apartment was clean and spacious. The park view from the front windows in the morning while sipping a cup of coffee was great. The location is safe and walkable with a few food options to choose from. It’s an easy walk to the orange line. It worked well for my family of five.

From booking to check out everything was smooth and seamless. The house was exactly as described, Roberto was very responsive with my questions, he even had snacks and beverages waiting on arrival. The stay was 5/5, I would definitely book again!

The host was very friendly and able to accommodate an early check-in, which was greatly appreciated!
The room was not very clean. The rug was covered in hair. There was cat hair on the fitted sheet and flat sheet of the bed, and there was hair in the tub and on the bathroom floor.
Even though the host was extremely nice, I would not stay at this location again due to lack of cleanliness.
Such peaceful and beautiful neighborhood! Anna was very professional,friendly and so helpful! I can’t wait to stay here eveyetime I visit Chicago!

Stay was very nice and was in a great location.  Less than a 10 minutes walk to the blue line,  which was super convenient.  Beds were comfy and place was very clean.  Host was responsive and friendly. Would stay here again!
The staff was so friendly and the house was nice
it was clean and comfortable great location didnt have to worry about parking are good of 7 fit no problem

This is such a fantastic place and location. Everything was just as stated.
Loved being able to go to the top floor for game night right next to the pool.
Staff at the building were so friendly.
Great experience!!’

great location and place.   so much to walk around and explore the lincoln park neighborhood .   all the amenities were exactly as describe.   the inside was clean,  comfortable and neat.    lastly,  the host were very responsive and helpful.    i would highly recommend their place!!
Great place! So close to everything

This was the perfect spot for us. Right around the corner from my son’s place; easy to get to good restaurants and coffee shops; love Tony’s market close by. Joan made things very easy. Very responsive.
This is was a great place to stay, if you’re saving money, the walk to the train station wasn’t far. Will definitely come again if we’re coming to Chicago. Thank you Jennifer
Excellent place! The kitchen is beautiful and the place is easily walkable to many restaurants, bars and workout classes! Host is also very responsive. Highly recommend!
Great location in the Andersonville neighborhood of Chicago. Very walkable and short trip to the L red line. Lots of restaurants and shops. Quiet apartment in the back of the building.

Super limpio, espacios agradables y cómodos.
El barrio es residencial y silencioso, también hay comercio y restaurantes cercanos.
El apartamento es excelente.

Victor was a great host, he always responded right away. House was very spacious and enough room for 14 adults and children. House was clean. Everything we needed was right there in walking distance. About a 20 minute drive to downtown! I would definitely book again.

The house is truly beautiful and exceptionally clean. The host is wonderful always quick to reply and very helpful whenever you have a question. However, the sound insulation isn't the best; you can hear pretty much everything, from people walking around to doors opening and closing. The train is also quite loud nearby, which might get in the way of a perfectly peaceful night's sleep. Lastly, the neighborhood can feel a bit unsafe at night, but overall, the house itself is lovely."
Great spot to stay! Good location and cozy.
I would love to come again next time!!

We had a really lovely stay here, it is beautiful, clean, and comfortable! Dena is so kind and communicative, and the house is located well within the city while being on a quiet street. I really enjoyed the stay and highly recommend!
Great place to stay with an excellent location! Awesome value. Check in and check out couldn’t have been easier.
Great place for the price
Place was in very good condition and worked perfectly for my group

Absolutely terrible experience! Booked this property and left within 1 hour of being there. One of the most dangerous neighborhoods I have ever been in. Did not stay a single night and was denied refund by host because of his misleading verbiage. Airbnb looks okay but the area itself is absolutely terrible.
Host and Airbnb asked me to “provide evidence of what is making me feel unsafe” and wanted me to video tape people arguing outside and the area. I got videos of everything except the 40 minute argument outside before we left. Refund denied because host said he “did not violate Airbnb guidelines”
He used verbiage to make the area seem safe, but it was absolutely no where near that. Airbnb as well as the host after 6 hours of communication denied any refund of $1600. Terrible experience overall and did not get any refund or remorse for us getting pointed at, yelled at, and feeling super unsafe from either party. I would highly recommend not booking this place for ANYONE!

Great location in Wicker Park!  Just a couple blocks off of Division Street, this cute flat is walkable to a ton of restaurants and there's a Target close by also.  The elevated train is about a ten minute walk away to take you all over Chicago and we also took Uber several times. The apartment had a nice living room space to hang out and a well equipped kitchen with a very nice table for dining or working as well as a desk. Really enjoyed being able to stay just a couple of blocks away from our daughter's home.  A great find in a neighborhood with next to no hotels!
GOATstays were great hosts! Clear communication, no surprises.
He was a very pleasant host. Very understanding and responsive. Will recommend AND book again.

This was our first time in Chicago, and I googled the best neighborhoods in Chicago, and ended up here. and it was the best choice I could have picked. We couldn't of asked for a better place to stay for our first time. EVERYTHING you could possibly need is in walking distance. Food, coffee, shopping, pharmacy, parks....it's all there just steps away.
Parking was super easy, everything felt very safe, and at all hours of the day.
It is quite a ways from down town, about a 30 min drive, which we didn't mind. We liked seeing everything on the way to downtown.
We absolutely loved how family friendly the neighborhood was. We did not have our children with us, but after we realized how great the area was... we were already looking for places to book for a family trip.
The Air Bnb it's self was perfect for a couples trip! Very clean, simple, and has everything you could possible need! The building it's self was super easy to find, the hallways were clean, and VERY quiet.

La casa es hermosa. Las habitaciones tienen todo lo que se necesita, al igual que la cocina equipada (tiene café y todo).
La zona es tranquila de día, pero de noche hay mucho movimiento de gente en la calle. Solo sean cuidadosos al caminar.
Hay una estación de metro a media cuadra y una parada de camión en la misma.
Ryan tiene buenas recomendaciones de restaurantes y cosas qué hacer por la zona.

Raymond y su esposa son unos anfitriones increíbles. La comunicación siempre fue fluida e incluso luego del check out olvidé algo en su casa y luego el muy generoso me ayudó para recuperarla. La ubicación es buena, tienes autobús y línea azul del metro que te conecta con el centro de la ciudad o con el aeropuerto. En general, es un gran lugar para hospedarse en su visita a Chicago. Muchas gracias Raymond por acogernos en tu casa.
This was the perfect space for 3 people. It was walkable to get coffee and to the L. Our host was very responsive. We would definitely come back.

The company was very kind and responsive as well as helpful. Great location. Very noisy at night but obviously you’re in the city. Furniture had stains and pet hair. A couple beds had long pieces of hair that were not ours. (The hosts had people come change the sheets pretty much right away!) An upstairs neighbor was breaking glass, yelling and watching tv very loudly at 4-5 am. The hosts also make you very conscious about making noise and disturbing the tenants who full time occupy the building. Although the hosts were kind and helpful, I wouldn’t stay at this place again.
Great views and really nice apartment. Love the location, easy to access all the fun stuff around the city. Safe location as well
What a wonderful place to stay!  The place was beautiful and super comfortable. There were lots of great restaurants within walking distance as well. I highly recommend this Airbnb!

This location was exactly what we wanted for our stay in Chicago. The area allowed easy access to the places we needed to visit. This rental was comfortable and clean, with plenty of room for our small group. There were many restaurants and grocery stores nearby to choose from. If you need a spot in the Bridgeport area, this one is one you should consider.
Great time in Chicago. Abby was super proactive and answered all questions right away. Apartment was clean and cozy.

We enjoyed a weekend in Chicago and the home was perfect for our family.  Multiple bedrooms and 2 bathrooms were great.  Large living room and dining room as well as a large, well stocked kitchen. More than usual including milk, creamer, eggs, bread, coffee, tea and cereal! We had 2 cars, one stayed behind the home in the reserved parking spot and the other was on the street (plenty of room, never an issue). Very walkable to 2 stops on the blue line that we used extensively during our weekend stay. Also, we asked if we could check in early as we were flying/driving in from various cities and he was very accommodating.  Highly recommend this home for your Chicago visits.

広い部屋と治安の良い周辺環境のおかげで４日間のシカゴ滞在を満喫することができました!
（最寄りのバス停（Devon）に来るバスはVentraの1day、3dayの乗り放題チケットでは乗車できません。7day以上のものを購入してください。）
Great location and very clean.

Beautiful, well-appointed property with everything our family needed for a relaxing, long weekend.  We were particularly impressed with the small touches that made our stays much  easier like plentiful towels, toilet tissue, paper towels, dish soap and sponges along with two full kitchens! We loved the tea kettle in tbe lower level kitchen!  Our stay was perfect and we highly recommend Sean's property!
Very comfortable, clean and convenient to everything.  Would stay here again.  Thanks, Stanley!
Best Chicago Air BnB we’ve stayed in out of the 4 times we’ve stayed.

This location was just a described.   We had a great time. The space was clean and cute.  Easy to get in and an awesome location.   Great restaurants, shopping and coffee shops in walking distance.  We will stay here again!
Fine!
This was a great house and perfect for our bachelorette.

Very much enjoyed our stay with Nick and Melesa. Great hosts with clear communication.
The standout element is the proximity to Six Corners and the wicker park neighborhood…it couldn’t have been more convenient to hit the neighborhood hot spots and access the blue line.
Would definitely stay again!

Location was exactly what we wanted.  Basil met us early and helped us get inside and explained everything.  Unit was large and clean.  Would definitely return and recommend to others.  Thanks for a great weekend!!

Overall, we had a good stay and the host was very kind and responsive throughout the trip. The place was a decent value for the price. It could use a little TLC in some areas, especially the bathroom, but it worked well enough for our weekend in Chicago.
Great location and very spacious. Perfect for larger groups. Kelly was super friendly and responsive. We would definitely stay again.

We had so much fun staying at this property. With more than ten bedrooms, our entire group was able to be together for a wonderful weekend in the Chicago celebrating a wedding. The location was awesome. Parking was a little tricky, but we were given very specific guidelines on where we could find spots.

Pasamos una cómoda estadía de dos noches, la anfitriona siempre en comunicación y muy amable.
Volvería a reservar en el lugar de Amelia.

we had a great time and would visit again! Jorge was very kind, helpful, and had lots of recommendations for things to do and places to eat. The place was clean and matched the photographs. would recommend!

Clean, comfortable and convenient.  What more do you need?  We are a group of friends that meet every year in a different city to explore and catch up.  Matt’s place was perfect for a large group like ours.  Everyone had their own comfortable bed and there was plenty of room to hang out and visit.  The home was in walking distance to plenty of interesting restaurants, coffee shops and stores.  Matt was more than willing to help with restaurant and sightseeing questions and did so promptly.  Highly recommend!
Highly recommend Alex’s place for a fun Chicago weekend. The house is beautiful and Alex was extremely accommodating. Great location with lots to do in the area. We will stay again!
Loved the place, you could tell it was newly renovated. Very responsive when had issues locating the place.

We were there in Chicago for a jam packed weekend of events and concerts. Ryan's place was exactly what we needed. Didn't break our budget, comfortable space, less than 5 mins to the green line or bus stop, plus we never worried about our car being parked there while we were away. Ryan was a great host with plenty of instructions, recommended my favorite coffee of the trip, and the house felt loved lived in and clean! If you've never stayed in a historical home I could see some people having a set back but honestly this was great and exceeded my expectations. Thank you Ryan for a great spot to stay it's definitely in my list of airbnbs to come back to.

Brandon's home was a wonderful place to stay in Chicago! The two-floor unit was absolutely beautiful and it was very close to a train station for easy navigation around the city. Having a private garage for parking was especially helpful.

I stayed in this Air BnB for about a week, celebrating my birthday & anniversary. It was the perfect find for my trip. It’s located in an area that feels safe and familiar to me as a Chicago native (and 4/20 friendly). Upon entering the apartment it was very clean, homey and felt welcoming. It’s a little noisy due to the building sitting right off a street that intersects train tracks, but the TV or music easily drowns out outside noise. While staying here I ran into a few “problems”. It gets pretty warm/hot inside and we had trouble turning on the air (could have been user error). Although, there is a ceiling fan in the living room that helped with air flow. The second difficulty was parking. After coming back from one of our activities, all streets around the BnB were packed with cars resulting in no parking spaces. We had to wait for a block party to end in order to get a park near the building. Lastly, you cannot close the curtains. Overall, 4.9 stars and I’d pick this place again!
The photos/listing don’t do this place justice. Couldn’t recommend this stay more.
It was a nice and clean place near the city. The view is beautiful at anytime of the day.

If I didn’t arrive from a late fight I would’ve rebooked after arriving. There were stains on the bed and pillowcase, mold in the shower, and I woke up night one with multiple bug bites (not bed bugs thankfully). Great location that’s right by the blue line, but wouldn’t recommend unless you were in a pinch.

We had a great stay at Argelia’s house! The location is perfect for Bucktown/Wicker Park exploring— close to lots of great restaurants and bars. Argelia was very responsive and super flexible with the check-in time. The house is comfortable and spacious. Would definitely stay here again!
Lovely place and great hosts!

This place was great, exactly as it appears in the pictures. No surprises. The location is perfect. Very little road noise even though it’s on a busier street, and it helps that the bedrooms are in the back. Having our own parking spot and laundry in the unit was such a blessing! They were very accommodating with having a pack and play ready for us for our baby. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you!
Lovely time in Chicago! Great View with a comfortable balcony.
Great house! Great team of hosts. Loved this part of town. Thank you!

My first visit to Chicago from Texas.. Russell made my stay AMAZING! Can’t wait to return to the WINDY CITY… just so I can book with Russell
THE TEXAS GIRL,LOVED CHICAGO!

We had an amazing three night stay at Leelach’s place in Andersonville. Plenty of space, very clean, comfortable, and walkable to lots of great restaurants, coffee shops, and shops in Andersonville. It was perfect for our long weekend trip.
Our stay was wonderful! The Airbnb was very clean, cozy, and comfortable. It was also very easy to get there, and parking was convenient. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!
Great host and a great stay!
Audrone was a great host and very responsive. Went to a show at Thalia Hall and location was perfect.

We really enjoyed our stay at Casa Newport. The apartment is nicely appointed with a fully stocked kitchen. The photos don't show how big the place really is. We will definitely try to stay here again next time when we are in Chicago.
Had a great stay while at this location. Close to plenty of things around the area and if I ever needed any help host was responsive and helpful!
I've stayed in Chicago for work a few times and this is my favorite spot I've stayed. I will definitely book here again the next time I'm in Chicago.

We stayed at Nicole and Matt's lovely townhome for a week while in town for our son's wedding. Their home was perfect for our stay, close to so many great restaurants and shops. As others noted the CTA train tracks are close by but you hardly notice it after the first ten minutes, it's truly nothing to be concerned about. Having an attached garage to keep our car was a real bonus. We needed an extra bed for two out-of-town wedding guests and Nicole and Matt were completely accommodating and brought us a brand new air mattress to use! We will definitely stay here again when we need to stay in the Lincoln Park area.

Be aware about the description. The tittle states “house for rent in Chicago” it is not!
She’s renting rooms individually. I was not happy to find out 2 hrs previous to check-in.
For our safety, specially my children we will not be sharing common a house, with completely strangers.
Very disappointed, unsafe and loud neighborhood.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay at this lovely apartment!  That said, a couple things to note - the outdoor patio is on the street level, not accessible directly from the upstairs apartment. NP, but not great for coffee in your PJs.  If it's warm, check on a/c. The instructions say to use the  thermostat, but it didn't work, so we were hot the first night until someone brought a window unit. The instructions also say to enter using a keycode which didn't work (they had left a key so we still got in fine). They're not great communicators - messages ahead about parking went unanswered for weeks, messages about a/c were confusing - initially instead of responding to my msg about the a/c I got a note hoping I was having a nice stay, after we left for the day THEN hours later they told us they couldn't deliver an a/c unit b/c we'd taken the key (they only have ONE? Why didn't they ask us to leave it? etc), they never confirmed a/c had been delivered (it had) or that everything was fine.
well put together place, will serve the purpose for your chicago visit. the space is clean and thoughtful. which can be appreciated.

Our family of five enjoyed our three night stay here for a family wedding.  The location was ideal being close to the very lively Fulton Marketplace, downtown area and the wedding venues.  Catching an Uber to these areas and Midway airport was very easy.  There is a Starbucks across the street and a nice Mexican restaurant a few steps further.  There was one oversight with the lack of toilet paper in the home which was corrected the next day.

We enjoyed Carlas place. My son personally said, whoever decorated the place did a great job. The only concern was how slow the bathtub drained. While showering the water went up to my ankles. It wasn't that big of an issue as we were leaving the next day. Otherwise our stay was fantastic. I'd hope she would welcome us again!
great stay
We really enjoyed our time, thank you!
Stunning views, cool location, super close to Fulton Market.

This is our second visit to Doug's place.  We love it!  Great location, great recommendations for food and things to do in the area. Apartment is immaculate and has all the conveniences! Great stay! Will stay again!
We had a great time and would come back again. Great location overall!

Super Great Host! Loved the area!
Thanks again Ignacio.

I enjoyed my stay at Tracy and Andy’s home. The room is luxurious, and has more space and resources (snacks, tea, coffee, dishes, fridge with freezer, microwave) than your typical hotel room. You get a key to their home, which allows you to be independent. The house is on a quiet and peaceful street, noise levels are low.
Many thanks to Andy for staying up and being so patient and welcoming after a major travel delay that led me arriving to the house after 1am. Thanks to Tracy for being warm, friendly, and proactive in addressing my needs with care.
Overall, the space is a gentle and peaceful reprieve that is perfect to com back to after adventurous, tiring, or long days.
Nice play to stay on the Northwest Side and easy access to O'Hare via the Blue Line. Frank is a kind and friendly host.

My group stay here was amazing!! There was plenty of space, looks bigger than the photos! The host was incredibly responsive and sent all the info we needed before check in. The area is great, my group had SO MUCH FUN, Chicago is the best city in the world!
Bryan was an excellent host. Easy to communicate with and flexible and friendly.
Great spot. Great people. The smell of Pequod's pizza wafting at all hours of the day. What more could one want??? We'll definitely be back!
10/10 spot for Chicago with awesome hosts. Will definitely be back.
truly the best air BNB host I ever had! Patrick is SO kind and was an incredible host! I am so happy I stayed here.

Stayed for two nights while in town for a concert and was the perfect location to grab good food, head out to shop, relax for a bit at the rooftop pool, and get a drink. Would definitely book again! Used a separate app to find parking nearby.
We loved the place! Thank you Henderson.

The place is everything it was advertises as.  The neighbor hood has been brought back to life.  The locations was very convenient, not in downtown but close enough Uber wasn’t astronomical! Public transportation was available close by we did not use it.

Really enjoyed our stay and David was super helpful. The side courtyard that is not included in rental was made available all weekend to us which was amazing for our kids to play and run around. The location is great, easy to street park, and the actual home is really unique and fun to stay in.

Great spot just outside of the city. Very easy to get downtown via bus or a cheap Uber. The photos do not do this listing justice at all. It is a spacious living area with a sofa/TV area + dining table completely separate from the kitchen and bedroom. The building is secured by 3 layers of lock/key and the host was right on time to greet us with clear instructions
We loved our stay! The house was very clean & had a beautiful yard. Elba was very responsive and provided clear instructions. We really enjoyed her place and highly recommend.
Responsive and helpful host
The perfect place to stay in a beautiful area!
excellent accommodations and thoughtful host

Great place to stay in Chicago! The location in Pilsen was excellent—very chill neighborhood with lots of good food spots around. It was also super easy to get around the city thanks to the nearby public transportation. Check-in was simple and smooth, and overall it was a great base for exploring Chicago. Would definitely stay again!
Overall great stay. Clean apartment in a lively walkable part of the city

Excellent apartment in Albany Park. Nice and quiet neighborhood. Apartment itself was very accommodating and clean and looked exactly like it’s presented. Hosts were incredibly helpful and nice. 10/10 would stay here again

Everything was wonderful. Excellent place to stay in Chicago. It was cleaned and liked the description said. I loved the place and recommended 100% to stay. The parking was perfect, because it is hard to find an air bnb  with a good parking space in Chicago. My family loved it and enjoyed a night doing a fire in the patio. Good communication. Thanks for the service.

Nats place in Wicker park was so cute! The location is amazing, super walkable and safe! The only hiccup was the listing showed an air mattress that we planned for a friend to sleep on that ended up not being available, so we had to buy our own. Overall great Airbnb!

As stated it was a grandparents house. It was neat to see family photos and memorabilia from a different generation. The house actually contained enough dishes and linens to accommodate the large number of people it can accommodate. It was in a great neighborhood close to public transportation. We enjoyed the property and our stay. Thank you, Chana and Jacob for sharing your treasure with us!
Lovely apartament, clean and spacious. Afsha was helpful at all times. Definetely recommend the stay.
Really nice,clean place; exactly as described. It was easy to check in and easy to find parking. It was very walkable. Tara was super responsive and helpful.
Great neighborhood!

Host was very attentive & communicated well. House was beautiful & spacious for 7 people. I wouldn’t call it a “luxury” stay. Just nice. A few issues were acknowledged, so I’m giving a 5 star for overall great experience. I would stay again. A few things to note- Master bedroom doesn’t have darkening shades & sun woke us every day around 5:30. Bright- lots of windows. Jacuzzi is a jacuzzi tub in master bathroom- not a jacuzzi for whole household to enjoy together. Streaming services are not included, as it appears, but you can use your own log in. Master shower- very big, but not all jets worked, it seems like it’s an older shower & may need updating. However, jets & rain heads that worked were great. Shower tile old/discolored on the floor. No kitchen handtowels- inconvenient because we cook alot. Beds comfortable, but pillows were old/unusable, plus torn comforter. Comfortable, not luxury. Simple repairs needed- 2 doorknobs fell off. Master bedroom needs new paint. Walls felt dirty.
wonderful place to stay! would definitely book again
Stayed here and attended a wedding at the South Shore Cultural Center, quick walk or drive there. Easy to get in and out of. Very spacious and updated apartment!! Thank you for hosting!
We shared basically everything

The unit worked for our stay and was conveniently located near our event, and the host was communicative throughout. We were informed two days before arrival that the air conditioning was not working, so we were aware going into the stay.
Unfortunately, we still ran into several issues. Parking was a consistent problem during our stay. The host other Airbnb unit guests repeatedly parked in spaces that were not assigned to them. One day we were actually parked in because another guest had taken someone else’s spot, which caused us to be late to an event. The following day, our assigned space was taken again and we had to park several blocks away. The overhead rain shower did not work, and several light fixtures were hanging from the ceiling.
While the host communicated well, most issues were not resolved during our stay. We also did not appreciate receiving pressure through message after our stay to leave a 5-star review despite these problems.

Julian’s place was great! Would definitely recommend. We stayed my birthday weekend and Julian had balloons and a bday sign waiting for me. He’s a very sweet and responsive host! The place had great space, air conditioning, great touches like coffee, shampoo/conditioner/hair dryer etc. Great location right next to the train too!

Everything about our stay was perfect. We ended up having 6 people and Joanna & Michael were more than accomodating and helped us all feel welcome. They were also very helpful suggesting things to do nearby and local restaurants. We will definitely be staying here the next time we are in Chicago!
This was the perfect place for a getaway with two friends. The decore is beautiful, comfortable beds, loved the patio. Thank you, Johanna!
Very spacious and clean- GREAT location. Would stay again.

Overall had a nice stay at Maureen’s place. It was clean, had everything we needed and relatively close to most attractions. We had an initial issue getting through the main door but the host responded promptly to resolve and get us in. Thank you!
Great location. The owner made everything too easy for us so we could enjoy our time in the city. Perfect spot if you are wanting to explore wrigleyville and also have easy access to the train.

The house was nice and clean! The downfall was the parking! There is no parking! We had to park blocks away from where we stayed. There is street parking only on one street! The rest is permit parking. So if you don’t mind parking a good distance away from the air bnb you will love the place!
Great stay, close to the conf center - thx!
The house was very cute and cozy! Owner was nice and communicative!
Great place to stay, in the heart of everything.

We had an amazing stay with Ronaldo. He was extremely accommodating at check-in even when we ran late, and communication was really fast and friendly. The apartment is great and the neighborhood really walkable and lively-yet-quiet.

James' place was as described.  Very clean and plenty of room for our three couples.  The beds were comfortable and it was nice to have three queen beds.  The parking spot was nice and I was able to leave a car in one of the Chinatown parking lots for a very reasonable price (for Chicago). I felt safe leaving my car and walking the area.  None of my party needed to use the provided ear plugs or white noise machines (nice addition though).  The train noise was heard, but didn't bother us during the day or our sleep.  I would stay here again if the need arises.
It was in a pretty good location! the rooms were spacious/private enough for my 6 person group and think it would have worked out for more people as well!
Cozy and amazing place to stay!!
Stayed here on a girls trip and it was perfect! The apartment was a great size and it was very comfortable. Easy walking distance to most things and right on the L.
Great location, fit four guys comfortably. Host was very responsive and helpful. Definitely recommend!
very cozy apartment and walking distance from tons of places to visit. we loved the e scooters! highly recommended apartment to stay at

I had no real concerns during my time there. Common areas are shared with other guests so please keep that in mind. For the location and price, I'd recommend it if you need a clean and comfortable place to stay. The room is pretty basic. It's located not too far from a subway station and I found it to be a safe neighbourhood. Henry was prompt with instructions on check-in and check-out as well as polite in his overall communications with me.
Greta place to stay with family and kids

our stay was good we sadly had a negative experience with one of the neighbors which wasn't the hosts fault at all but definitely was a interesting interaction. everything was very clean aside from the floors i think they were not mopped as it did turn our feet dirty very fast just walking around. aside from that it was a lovely and comfortable stay very close to the convention center and afew spots to eat! really it was just the neighbors that brought the score down for us
This was a great stay! Easy, clean and spacious. It’s in a perfect area of town and made a great home base for a weekend adventure.

This was my first time renting an AirBnb and my main goal was to find a location to house our 10+ party, which can be difficult in a large city like Chicago. Thankfully we were able find such an amazing AirBnb that had everything we needed! A location that was easy for members in our party, all from various places, to meet. With great parks, local restaurants, and stores all within walking distances or a 5-10 minute car ride away. Close to downtown and other popular areas of Chicago. Last but not least the hosts were amazing to work with! Their communication throughout the renting process, check-in, and check-out was always clear, concise, and helpful. I highly recommend any group with 10 or more people looking to spend time in Chicago to consider this AirBnb!
Fantastic apartment very well located. The hosts had everything prepared and made the entire experience very convenient!
Nice and clean unit.   A short walk to the train in a beautiful neighborhood!
Great place!
My group had a great stay!! Home  was very clean and comfortable. The neighborhood gave a great welcoming vibe .

Had a great stay. Lincoln square is easily walkable for coffee in the morning and a stroll. Neighborhood seemed safe and the neighbors were even friendly! It is loud at night as the other reviews describe, but they leave plenty of earplugs for use and we had no issues sleeping with those. Getting up and down Western Ave involves a lot of stop and go at lights, especially around commute time, but everywhere we need to go was less than a 25 minute Uber. 5 stars!
The place fantastic and the hosts are extremely responsive and friendly. We highly recommend them!
Parking was easy and close. Beds were comfortable. Bathrooms were clean. Responsive host. Cheaper than a hotel. Really couldn’t ask for more.

I could live in this space- pleasant, clean, safe, uncluttered, wonderful location …
Ensavi was very patient with me and responded right away every time I reached out to him.
Everything was great and very clean loved location but the stairs almost toke me out🤭 but over all it was a great stay would stay again
Stayed here for a concert at Thalia Hall and this was the absolute perfect location! Just a quick walk from the venue and also lots of great restaurants. Beautiful space, we loved our stay!
The location was perfect, very clean and walkable to many different places. I highly recommend if you are not from the area to stay here. The location made it easy to go everywhere we wanted.
This place was great: very clean, plenty of towels, and easily walkable to the blue line. Other than an issue with check-in (which was resolved within an hour) everything was wonderful!
We enjoyed our stay in Edwin's place! It was very cozy, close to public transit, and Edwin was extremely responsive. You should stay here!!
We had a wonderful stay at your AirBNB! It was perfect for a fun girls’ trip!
Wonderful stay that was very easy to check in to. The place was spacious and clean. Everything needed was provided.

Location was great, place felt bigger than expected with the high ceilings, great water pressure, kitchen had all the basics, keurig & coffee pot were a nice touch. Bed was really comfortable. It is only a full & we’re used to a queen at home but it didn’t feel too small.
The bathroom is a little small but not a problem at all. I loved the back patio, it is a cute, peaceful spot for morning coffee or just enjoying your own oasis in a big city.
Husband and I are already planning to rebook next time we’re in the area.
My wife and I stayed here and really enjoyed it! Neighborhood is great, Paul is really nice, and the Airbnb itself was cozy. Would highly recommend!
Great spot and host! Everything was as advertised. Nice area and super close to Wrigley
Charming and cozy space- excellent location with the lakefront just a couple of blocks away! We would certainly book again!

An incredible stay! Amazing views of the city and Lake Michigan, with a large patio that wasn’t pictured but made it great for hanging out after the kids’ bedtime. No complaints, it was a wonderful spot. We felt so spoiled!

Our stay was great except that the lock was dead when we arrived. It took the owner about 20 minutes to get back to me and he was able to still get me in and directed me as to where I would find replacement batteries and a screwdriver in order to get the lock working during which he waited on the phone call to ensure it worked.

Hello,
Our stay was very pleasant. Doko was very responsive to all my questions and flexible on our check-in and check-out. The place was very easy to find and get into with the instructions. Overall a great experience!

Ayla was a wonderful host. Her spot was just what we needed for a quick weekend in Chgo. Easily accessible from major roads… not too far from the city. Nice walk to stores, coffee shops, ect. We had no issues finding parking. Would highly recommend
Lovely neighborhood near DePaul Univ, well kept property and Ishin was very helpful and communicated promptly.

Lots of space, cute, and felt homey. There was another family living on the first floor with two large dogs so if you're wary of them, it's definitely something to note before booking since they were unleashed sometimes.
Stay here! place is clean and fully stocked with EVERYTHING that you may need.  very quiet, no issues.  I'd recommend this perfect well kept place to anyone!

We've stayed at Amy's place several times and always enjoyed it. The location is great, and it's well appointed. It's become our home away from home when we visit our family in Chicago. Thanks, Trove Team.
We enjoyed our stay at Domonique’s place. Parking was easy and the home was clean. The beds however were a bit uncomfortable and due to the season we seen quite a few ants. Everything else went fine.
Ali’s apartment was in a perfect location for us, with restaurants and stores nearby when we need to eat or pick up last minute/forgotten items. The space was also very comfortable for us.

We loved the neighborhood! It was also safe and pleasant walking to our wedding destination as well as in the morning. Target and many amenities are located nearby. Public Transportation was near and easy. I would highly recommend this place!

Loved this apartment — it's cute, well-equipped with everything you need, and the top-floor location means great views. Just note it's stairs only. A 5-minute walk gets you to the nearest subway, and don't sleep on Muse Coffee nearby for your morning cup. Thank you to the lovely host for being so communicative!

Had a great long weekend stay! The neighborhood is quiet. Being able to walk to the grocery store that you can see from the front window to pickup breakfast stuff/snacks/beverages was really convenient. The neighborhood has many places to walk to to eat within 20 mins. We had a great stay!
Andy's place is exceptionally clean.  He was also very good at communicating with me and answering my questions promptly.

Valentina’s home was beautiful and had a at home feel. It was a 10 minute walk to the L train station. We got a 24 hour train pass for $5 per person. The train will take you downtown. We came back to the Airbnb on the train at 10pm and seen some questionable people, but as a rule you should not walk in unknow areas in the dark or alone. This was our first visit to Chicago and will be back again in the future.
Thank you for letting us stay in your home.

Honestly, it was a pretty bad stay. Nice place
Great price and location. First trip to Chicago and was with a group. Never felt crowded when at the b&b
The house was spotless and on a very strategic location if you want to explore Chicago.
Very friendly and responsive host. Place was clean and spacious. Area was fair and quiet
Selenas place was great, she was super communicative and everything was exactly as described

Had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago! The location was perfect. Very close to downtown and convenient for exploring the city. Loved our stay here.

This was the second time I stayed here.  Perfect house for several couples with a bedroom and bathroom on each of the three floors.  House is in great condition.  Plenty of room.  Extremely clean.  Easy parking. Centralized location for the loop, lincoln park and neighborhoods to the north.

We had an amazing time! The place was wonderful for our group reunion. Inside was clean, spacious, and comfortable. The 2nd floor living/dining room was the perfect space for us to hang out and catch up. And the location was also great - walking distance to Fulton Market and other cool spots. We'd absolutely stay here again!

Pilsen is a wonderful area of Chicago to call your home base for whatever adventures your trip to Chicago may bring!  Kyriako's home adds an great landing spot for the end of your day excitement.  We would definitely stay again!
We had a lovely stay and the airbnb was extremely well kept and clean. Very modern and comfortable. loved the neighborhood and proximity to bars and restaurants. would definitely book again.
This little house is located in a great neighborhood and there are many groceries and restaurants nearby.
The location was great for a large family to stay.  Easy access into downtown.  Quiet and safe.  Really enjoyed our stay!

We had a wonderful stay at Aaron’s place. The apartment was very clean, organized, and well maintained. Easy instructions to check in and out. The bed was extremely comfortable, and the space was very quiet, which made it very relaxing after the long day exploring the city. Nathan was an excellent host, and the host was in a beautiful location in Chicago. Highly recommend!
Incredible place, very close to blue line s well as shops and places to eat. Fantastic location. Would love to book again next time we’re in town
The place was cozy and welcoming, and was perfect for two people. It had all the necessary amenities. We enjoyed our stay and Maria was a very responsive host as well.
Perfect location! Cozy, amazing amenities!

Outstanding stay. Location is in cool neighborhood, roughly 5-6 blocks from Wrigley Field. Lakeview neighborhood on other side is great, too. Sean provided a quiet room and excellent communication. Loved this stay.

What a great find! I took my boys out to Chicago for a first-time visit and this was an all-star accommodation. Michael is an extremely attentive host with great support for us through-out our extended weekend trip. If you're looking for a stay in the heart of the Boystown neighborhood, do not look any further! Michael provided great recommendations when we didn't have anything on the agenda for the day, and he steered us in the right direction! We all fell in love with the neighborhood and the City, and are eager to book again with Michael. 10/10!

Jo and Mari know what they are doing!
I was so pleased. The space was well-appointed, comfortable, clean, and ample space to enjoy our time in Chicago.
House instructions were reasonable and logical. I appreciated that; it’s not always the case. Communication response was quick and informative.
I would stay here again without hesitation.
Thank you for an enjoyable stay!

The stay at John’s place in Chicago was far better than I would’ve imagined. He made me and my friends feel well adjusted and right at home. A gracious host that was flexible and assisted well beyond his standard duties. Because of such a wonderful experience I am very confident that if I ever wanted to visit the Windy City again John’s place would be the first place I would look for.
Stephanie was very responsive, and the house was perfect for what we needed. It was helpful to have a pack n play, high chair, and travel stroller available for our little one.
Great, comfortable stay, super close to the city center, and the place was spacious and very clean. Overall, a very nice stay, would definitely repeat.

The hosts were kind and very responsive. Certainly worth what you pay for it, but very mindful that you are signing up for a loud neighbourhood. As long as you don’t mind that, then definitely recommend

I passed on a recommendation to a local friend and hope she’ll act on it because I can’t recommend this place enough!

This was a wonderful apartment to stay in! The area is very quiet. Parking is kind of scarce if you’re not from the area and there was a small heat wave and no AC at the time. We were able to walk to stores to get items we needed. It was a very clean space and I felt very comfortable here!

The home was beautiful and pleasant. It was clean and Marco and Sarah is very communicative and friendly. The house manual is clear. I highly recommend this home because of the location and would stay again. Everything was great about this home especially the natural light in the rooms. It was spotless. I can say so many great things about it. Thank you for letting us stay.

great host! very clean

Absolutely loved my stay. Beautiful place. Comfortable. Loved the area & not far from everything amazing Chicago had to over. Host was amazing! Made me feel so welcomed. Clear check in information. We truly enjoyed staying at Kelsey’s place.  It was decorated in such a cool vibe and each room had its own charm.  Conveniently located and easy parking.  Kelsey is an excellent host and goes above and beyond for her guests.  Looking forward to staying here again.
Nate was super nice and communicated well everything, even with helping how to reverse park LOL. I definitely recommend.
Used to get ready the morning of my wedding and worked out perfectly! Great location and very clean. Couch was comfortable and bathrooms were nice!
Great home, location, proprietors!
Great spot right in the heart of Andersonville! Tons to do and a lovely apartment with lots of character. Comfortable beds!

We had a very nice stay at this Airbnb. It was very clean and the location was great!
Very helpful and accommodating host! Home was as listed and very reasonable for the price.
A very comfortable space in a great location. Cool building.

Very clean - convenient location.

Great host, Vin was super responsive whenever I needed to ask something about our airbnb he responded in less than 20 minutes. Apartment was super clean and everything nice is place. Having a jewel osco across the street and a Starbucks less than 3 minutes walk is also such a plus!!! Thank you vin for everything we had a great weekend.
We had a great experience here! The space is expansive and has great natural lighting. It’s private and the building is very clean.
Beautiful and charming upstairs apartment in a charming location.

We were a group of 9 girls. There was plenty of room for all of us, two friends even slept by themselves. It was very helpful to have 4 full bathrooms. Everything was as described, looks brand new, very clean and love all the amenities. We really enjoyed our stayed at this beautiful house.
A quaint little spot. Easy to get everywhere in the city. Very proactive communication!
Fun location for girl’s trip. Beautiful views from the roof deck, great walkable neighborhood. Host quickly answered any questions we had.
Really enjoyed our stay at Joe’s place! clear instructions for check in and check out, clean place, responsive host, close to metro transit, had everything we needed for a short stay.
Great place to stay. Very clean and great hosts. Close to downtown, peaceful and quiet. 10/10 recommend.
Very cozy place! This location was great for me and my family to explore without having to drive too long. Would recommend this spot!

We had a wonderful experience at this Airbnb - it’s incredibly walkable to Chicago Ave and a ton of restaurants and bars but the area itself is very quiet at night. The Airbnb is just as described and was incredibly clean. Simida was very responsive and flexible.
Would absolutely stay again.
Super cute place in a nice area! Well priced, super close to red line and a bunch of good food. Highly recommend!!

I am incredibly grateful for this host’s kindness and hospitality. The check-in instructions were clear and straightforward, and the room was spotless, clean, neat, and comfortable. Their kindness and professionalism made a stressful situation much easier. I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend Steve and this AirBnb to anyone looking for a welcoming and well maintained place to stay.

The place was very lovely just like the photos it was very friendly and very helpful The only thing is I wish it was on the third floor this is a little bit difficult for my parents to get up the stairs but other than that it was really nice I would recommend it.
Use this place before. very comfortable enjoyed my stay.
Great location and very nice place fo our family.
Cynthia was one of the nicest hosts I've ever met! She was very helpful, friendly and communicative. I would absolutely stay at Cynthia's house again in the future. 10/10
The space was lovely, warm and inviting! Our group had a wonderful time celebrating in Chicago for my bachelorette!
Loved my stay here!! Very affordable compared to hotels and id argue this was way better than getting a room cost aside. Having 3 doors + the front gate made me feel safe, and the space is cute!

Jennifer and Ben’s place met our expectations. The descriptions from other guests about the Chicago-esque neighborhood being quiet and safe were spot on! The home has a lot of character, and the living spaces fit our needs well. Nicely renovated with old bones! I personally loved the office area!
The entire home, including the basement, was spacious, and we enjoyed the large tables up front, which facilitated great meals and conversations for a large group. Lake Michigan beach was only about an 18-minute walk away (at a sightseeing pace), and stores and shopping were only about 5–10 minutes away.
We also found the washrooms to be very accommodating for a larger group. Ben and Jennifer were very prompt and followed up quickly on any issues. I would definitely recommend this place to friends and family!

The location is amazing -  close to the Brown line. It was helpful to have street parking w/ parking stickers available.  The exterior and interior are really beautiful w/ high-quality furnishings.  We accidentally locked ourselves out of the house and the hosts were quick to respond and help us get back in.  Having said that, the front door was really tricky in terms of getting inside. The mattress was a blow-up mattress that needed to be aired up about every hour during the night.  That was not clear in the description and not good. They did provide earplugs which were helpful b/c the hard-wood floors are really squeaky (yes, they are beautiful .... but nice to know for future guests).  The kitchen was very well stocked.  The owners had lots of personal items including paperwork in drawers and cabinets which I thought was odd.

My best vacation rental to date! Gustavo was quick to respond, very flexible and extremely accommodating. The beds are comfortable, kitchen very well equipped. The unit was spotless. Will absolutely stay again if in Chicago with a large group.
The Airbnb was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Great location, easy check-in, and the host was very responsive. Would definitely stay here again!
We enjoyed our stay here. The place was in a great location and was conveniently close to the bus stop and train station.

This was an amazing stay! Came in town to celebrate milestones with friends and the host was very hospitable. It's truly a home away from home and has great surroundings. I would definitely stay here again!
Eileen has a cozy place at an awesome neighbourhood! Close to the city but you can watch rabbits & birds from the porch!
Highly recommend staying here. I've never been so at peace in an airbnb like this. There were plenty of snacks and refreshments. The neighborhood was nice and quiet.
A friend and I stayed here and it was a perfect location, easy to find, and we were provided with excellent instructions/information!

3rd stay and always wonderful. Close to our daughter’s apartment near DePaul. Easy walk to bus stop to get to the L or an easy 20 minute walk if you don’t want to ride the bus. Apartment has been great and comfortable. Has everything you need for your time around the city.
We had a wonderful trip, perfect location!

Roberto's 3BR house was in an excellent location. It was very easy to access local buses and trains, making it convenient to explore the city. We had a great stay in Chicago and would definitely recommend Roberto’s place to others visiting the city.

Great "launching point" location in West Loop ... easy walk to downtown and Fulton Market areas.  The apartment was large, clean and well-appointed.  Host was very responsive and communicative. la casa era agradable, pero el barrio era algo peligroso en donde no es seguro caminar de noche, se ve personas de muy mal aspecto.

10 out of 10 and I would stay again! Super clean and I can’t say enough about the shower. This place has everything you need to relax and unwind. Blake is a great host and I felt at home the second I walked in the door.
Wonderful place and great host  with everything you need in the heart of Lincoln park.
Responsive and friendly host. Easy to find and get around. Comfortable stay

This was my first Airbnb that I booked on the platform, and the experience was good. I had no issues, and the location was very convenient since it is close to a train station on the pink line. Patt was responsive to messages throughout my stay and everything was thoroughly communicated.

We enjoyed our stay overall, but I wanted to share a few suggestions that could help improve the Airbnb experience for future guests:
1. Please ensure the utensils and towels are thoroughly cleaned before guest check-in.
2. It would be helpful if the listing reflected the room sizes more accurately, as the rooms felt smaller than expected. Some extra blankets would also make the stay more comfortable.
3. Please mention clearly in the listing if other people are living on the property and provide any related instructions beforehand so guests are fully informed.
Thank you!

The apartment was perfect for our stay in Chicago. It was just a couple blocks from the train station, perfect for getting to Guaranteed Rate Field. The apartment was nice and clean! If you want the best of the city and Lake Michigan for a great price, stay here!
Great place

Quite spacious as advertised. Everything is new and very clean.

My partner and I were more than comfortable in this apartment, great location that was super cozy and fun to walk around day and night also! While at times noisy, the quiet times were respected. The host was very responsive and accommodating. Highly recommend!
Perfect location for us.
We were stating for a Cubs game and this place easily accommodated 5 guys. Everything was exactly as it was described. Great location with cool restaurants just steps away. Would recommend to anyone.
Lovely place and the hosts were very communicative and organized!

This was a great find! Location was quiet, walkable, and accessible to the local transit system making it incredibly easy to get around. For families… wow! Provided a pack and play for our little one and even had wipes available. Would definitely stay here again!
Hannah and Mark’s place checked all of the boxes for a quick girl’s trip to visit my niece.  It was clean and felt spacious, and was also super close to many attractions.  Would stay again!

This was a great place in a fun neighborhood! The apartment looks exactly like the photos. There was plenty of space for the four of us to be together or have some personal time. The location great. It's in a quiet part of town but you can easily to walk to the shops and restaurants.

Apartamento pequeño en una ubicación perfecta, zona tranquila y silenciosa. Ideal para una estancia de tres días y descansar al final de la jornada. Las fotos coinciden con la estancia real. Limpio y ordenado. Fácil acceso.

We loved our stay! We were very comfortable, everything was very clean and homey. Would definitely stay again!
Great place, will book again. Easy to find, quiet neighborhood (for the city), and a great space overall. 10 out of 10 on all fronts. It’s a hidden gem 🤗
Centrally located place, with great parking!
Peaceful , clean and amazing view

Angie’s place was perfect for our girls weekend! There was more than enough space for all 8 of us to sleep comfortably, get ready in the morning, and lounge around at night. Perfect stay for my bridesmaids and I during wedding weekend! House was clean, in a great location, was perfect for 8 of us, and John was very helpful with questions we had.

From the musty smell throughout the entire house (especially in the bathroom, which was also relatively dirty and had water dripping from the ceiling) to the tiny room, which wasn't really clean. Prime location for all the fun Chicago sights and attractions. Walking distance to many shops and restaurants. Location and room as described. Everything was clean and functional. We will always check if this place is available when we return to Chicago.
Excellent!
Very nice spot for a steal of a price!
The stay was great! 5 min walk to the nearest L stop and great for a weekend get away. Bella was a great host  and allowed us to check out late! Would stay again

Meighans place was great! Very cute spot in Logan Square that was easy to walk to the L, etc. the back patio was lovely in the mornings for coffee and we loved how many plants were throughout the space

Stephanie‘s place was really lovely, and a terrific building with amazing amenities, incredible rooftop view, safe and private and exactly like the description. We had a great stay here. The apartment was just as described, and instructions for check in and entering the building were clear. Everything was clean when we arrived and we loved all the amenities. We also appreciated the local recommendations!

Nothing But Best.. Great Host & now New Family I will definitely be coming soon communication is Amazing... warm Friendly understanding & very hands-on I will definitely be Back hate we had to leave! Big Beautiful home....

Thank you Bella,
Nancy
Had a great stay for a girls’ weekend!

we had a great time visiting Chicago. This home was very quiet, and the neighborhood is peaceful and beautiful. great food all around, and the home is in a great location and easy to find/well managed. thanks for having us!
Great place, grear location near restaurants and CTA Diversey stop. Josh was responsive and flexible.
Beautiful apartment, great location, extraordinary views.
We really enjoyed our stay. Everything was very comfortable, and it was very easy to walk to some great restaurants.
Great stay. Great location
The place was exactly as described in a good location. Clean and tidy. Simple check-in and check-out.
It was clean and perfect for us for what we needed.
My stay there was great, the host was very friendly and is even going to ship my iPad that I left. Their house was very nice and there was lots of stuff to do in the area.

We had a great stay at Nancy’s. The house was very spacious and as described. We were traveling from out of town and Nancy was very flexible, allowing us to check in early and check out late to accommodate our travels. Thank you!!

We selected this spot because it was in proximity to Thalia Hall where we would be going for a few nights during our trip. Perfectly close, adorable, and spacious! There were 3 of us who stayed in the apartment- a perfect stay and we would love to rebook again!

This is my second time renting one of Cloud9's property. This property was as beautiful and comfortable as the first one I stayed in. The owners are very friendly and quick to respond.
The home has everything you need and more. My most enjoyable part was the location with many food places. I also enjoyed the full gym. My daughters enjoyed the pool areas and made new friends. Overall I would recommend this place a thousand times over.
Great stay overall and safe. The area is a bit loud sometimes but Charie provided earplugs.

My 2 girlfriends and I had a wonderful stay here at Jed’s place. The beds and couch were very comfortable, the place was super clean and even had some coffee for us! The outdoor space was a little loud because of the A/C units for building but there were a couple of chairs and we sat outside a few times. It was nice and quiet inside.  Jed was available for quick questions and even checked in to make sure all was going well. We would definitely come back!
We really enjoyed staying at The Garden.  The decoration of the house was beautiful.  Very spacious for a big group.   Over all it was great.

I will never get over this house! It was so cozy and in such a good location. Roxanna was so sweet, and left us cookies and homemade lasagna upon our arrival.
Would definitely go back to this rental!
Had a great time. place was central and big enough for 4 guys. shower could use an update but other than that it's perfect.
Great older house.  Neighborhood is not the best

So glad I found this place! I only had a few days in Chicago, but if I come back I’m checking out Cindy’s first. Wicker Park is amazing, especially if you love vintage and consignment shopping. And the blue line is around two minute walk in an area that even as a solo woman I felt safe walking alone at night. 10/10.
Terrific location with close proximity to McCormick Place, Miracle Mile, Grocery and other conveniences.  Booking again for next year!

Great place to stay. The house is very spacious, clean and well maintained. The outdoor patio had good quality furniture and on a bright and sunny day, it was very enjoyable. Will definitely recommend.

Out of all airbnbs that we have stayed at, this was the most perfectly decorated, clean place. It was exactly as advertised and was perfect for us with 6 adults and a toddler.  They kept extra stock of basic needs that were easily accessible.  Little things like body wash in the shower were already provided which was nice.  A little light on kitchen items, so you may want to plan to bring anything that you have any doubts. The place was fantastic because of the simple check-out instructions.  It was easy to communicate with the owner for any questions.   Compared to the pricing of some of the other options we looked at and the reasonable distance for the places we wanted to get to, it was absolutely perfect.  Yes, (as a couple mentioned), the neighborhood is not perfect.  But we never felt unsafe in the house.  My wife and daughter took the toddler to a local park to play and had a good time.   We would definitely pick this location again should the need arise.

I had a great stay with Jennifer and Dan while on my apartment hunting trip. It's a beautiful area, right off the Fullerton Red/Brown L stop and so easy to get around the city via transit. The room is pretty private and clean. The bathroom is shared so there are a lot of personal items from the owners but it didn't really get in the way. The cats are very friendly and adorable,  just be mindful of petting or playing with them because they can get a little rough. Very occasionally you can smell the litter box from the bathroom or hallway but I never noticed it in my room. I would stay here again for the location and hospitality of the hosts.

Perfect location for us in Lincoln Park area.  Easy to get to park and Lake.  Clare was willing to work with us for early check-in if needed.  There was only a portable AC unit for the whole place.  Wasn't too much of an issue as it did not get too warm, and we were only there at the end of the nights.  I would think in the summer it could be a problem if someone likes to keep there place on the cool side.  Would stay again, but maybe not in the summer months unless they upgraded to a window unit.  Just our preference.  Everything else was great.

Nice place, lots of space, good for multiple guests. Location generally seems safe, like any big city just have to be aware of surrounding areas. It is a bottom floor unit so there is some slight noise from the unit above, nothing overly loud, just something to consider if you're a light sleeper. Clean and nice amenities like gym  and video games

This airbnb was perfect for a family weekend in Chicago. Had room for the whole family with 4 BD 3 full baths. Area very walkable to great restaurants and stores (Whole foods right down the street for any groceries you may need)
Building has elevator which is great for taking luggage, senior members etc
Parking available on the street+ assigned spaces in building garage if you prefer safer/sure option.

Location is amazing! Anything you need is within walking distance: restaurants, bars, farmers market, grocery store, vintage shops, franchise retail! Cute little space- exactly as the photos show. 1 minute walk to the Damen Blue Line. Street parking, so with a car you'll have to be patient to find a spot. The place is easy to access and safe, with multiple cameras and a dual access door setup from the sidewalk. It is a vibrant area and the windows have leaks so no sound protection, but the AC unit served as white noise and they provided earplugs, so it wasn't a problem for us. They have darkening curtains and the bed was comfy. I shared a couple minor suggestions: broken/missing blinds (which they responded to quickly) and floor cleanliness which they'll hopefully address. No deal breakers! Would absolutely stay here again!

Absolutely one of the BEST Airbnb hosts I’ve ever experienced. From the moment we arrived, she made everything feel comfortable, peaceful, and truly like a home away from home. The house was spotless, the atmosphere was welcoming, and the communication was top tier.
What I appreciated most was not feeling like we were walking on eggshells with a million overwhelming rules. Everything was simple, respectful, and easy, which made our stay even more enjoyable. You can tell she genuinely cares about her guests having a great experience.
I would 1000% stay here again and again. Thank you for such an amazing weekend stay!

Stayed here for a girls trip to Chicago for two nights. It had everything we needed for an enjoyable weekend away, and we were very happy with our accommodations. Harry was a responsive and helpful host.
Very calm and quiet neighborhood. I like how close it is to downtown!!
Great stay as usual! It’s a perfect location and so clean and cozy. Will be back!

The host was very responsive, and the apartment is perfect for a couple or a solo traveler. It’s clean, smells great, and being on the first floor made it super convenient for managing my luggage.
Just a quick note: if you run the air conditioner while using the microwave, the power may trip. However, the instructions on the refrigerator for resetting the circuit breaker are clear and easy to follow.
I did accidentally leave a garment bag hanging in the closet. The host checked for me right away, but it was no longer there — likely picked up by the cleaning person and never returned it or mentioned it to the host. So I recommend giving the apartment a thorough check before you leave.
We had a great stay. The house is very clean and close to attractions.
The best place for a getaway!!
This is probably the best AIR BNB I've stayed at in Chicago. Everything was so modern and squeeky clean and comfortable. It made me feel right at home. I'd give this place a 12/10 if I could.
Very convenient to everything. Great restaurants, coffee shops and the blue line is a short walk away.
Loved the space! Amenities were great

Great stay in Rogers Park! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location close to restaurants, the lake, and public transit. The host was responsive and made check-in super easy. Would definitely stay here again!

Great space, clean worked well for us.

I would definitely recommend this home and location to anyone with a large group visiting Chicago!!

We had a fantastic stay at Brandon‘s house! The host were responsive, flexible and helpful. The area was perfect for our needs, easily walkable, lots to do nearby, and safe. Would definitely return for a future stay!

Dirty walls and floors. The bathroom was really dirty, with hair and body hair everywhere. The toilet had poop stains, so we had to clean it after every use. Construction work went on until 9:30 PM and left dirt and mess throughout the house. But comfortable bed.

Beautiful house great for families. Emily is very communicative and a great host. The house is on a nice street but note that a few blocks away the neighborhood (Humboldt Park area) can feel less safe.
The stay was pleasant and comfortable. I’d highly recommend it.

My husband and I stayed for two nights in the studio apartment. It was easy to locate and Ensavi gave clear instructions for check in and check out. Apartment looked exactly as pictured and had all the amenities we were expecting. AC worked great and the bed was very comfortable. It’s the perfect AirBnb for a couple coming to Chicago! We would definitely book again for our next Chicago trip!
We enjoyed our stay! The host was great & we loved the area.

Básicamente el apartamento es muy antiguo, se ve descuidado le hace falta una remodelación; se ve más bonito en las fotos, pero la realidad es otra.

Had a nice stay at this unit overall. Great location in the midst of beautiful Hyde Park. Host was very responsive to all inquiries. May not be ADA friendly however - elevator is narrow and was broken during my stay.

Huge! It had all the extras but most importantly, the host was warm friendly and fantastic to work with! The host really wanted us to have a great stay and was wonderful to work with.  Crazy good price for the amount of space and all the extras the host provided. I would 10/10 recommend!

I had a great time staying at this location! The host was super responsive.

The host did everything to make sure we were comfortable and checked in a couple of times to make sure.
I would absolutely stay here again, and plan to the next I visit Chicago!
Great communication.
We loved our stay! We could tell this was a well loved home and it felt super comfortable and clean.

Billy and Regina were responsive and answered all questions within minutes. The home was also beautiful and close enough to downtown and train station. I can’t say enough good things about this place!! From start to finish the host was extremely responsive and answered any questions we had. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!!
It was a good stay for that price!
The place was perfect for my friends bachelorette, the location was so central in Wicker Park next to four corners and the host was super responsive to messages with anything we needed.

4 couples came up from StL for a concert…perfect set up, great location

My friends and I stayed for a birthday. Assel’s place was the perfect home base for the weekend; the area feels safe and homey, all the linens were clean and beds were very comfy! Would definitely stay again :)

Kaitlynn was an amazing host! This was such an affordable place and it was very cleanly. We arrived and it exceeded our expectations. My group and I loved the tall ceilings and enjoyed our stay here.
Great open space to have a few friends together. Being above the gas station means you can buy a few quick things if neccessary and uber picks ups are easy

Classic amenities and a bonus private backyard to enjoy Chicago summer nights. Would definitely book this again for our next trip in the city!
Great place to stay while in chicago! Always an open parking spot, apartment was also very clean! Kitchen has everything you need to cook dinner or breakfast.
Bobbies place felt like home immediately! From the decor to the space in the home. Neighborhood is quiet and always spots for parking. I would definitely book again. Thanks bobbie!
The unit met all of our requirements and, more importantly, was exceptionally well-maintained and clean. Thank you Nicholas for providing the extra blanket.
Great stay, easy to get around the city with the train being a reasonable walking distance away. 10/10

This was a great place to stay! Ed was a great host, and was incredibly responsive.
