Perfect place for a decent sized group looking to stay in center city
Great place!
We had a great time here. Not close to the train station but we ubered there and it was cheap. Nice decorations and the water in the fridge was the most thoughtful detail.

Three couples and a baby had a great stay at Thomas's place! Clean, comfortable, and a great location. Thomas was very responsible and helpful with some non-standard requests. We would definitely stay here again!
This Airbnb completely fulfilled our needs. If you need a place to stay in Chicago that is affordable and you just sleep in, this is a good place. We had what we needed and felt safe.
The apartment looks just like the photos. Very clean, very quiet and a short walk to Andersonville's main street, with shops and restaurants. The garden outside was beautiful too.
Great little place to crash if you are staying in the city!
It was great.

We loved staying here. Great location by the park, coffee shop around the corner, safe, walkable, and quiet. Very clean, lots of natural light, comfy bed, washer/dryer. Would absolutely stay here again!

Perfect Chicago location! Bojan was proactive, provided the easy check in details, and our stay was seamless. His place was very clean and tidy.
We enjoyed the beautiful neighborhood and elevated ambiance of his place. Street parking was always easy to find, and Ubers were easy to get.
We would absolutely stay here again.
Proactive host. Pretty clean overall. Quiet.
I had an amazing stay it was comfortable and clean. And the host is really nice and understanding. I recommend anyone to get this Airbnb
This airbnb was very clean, spacious and organized. It was very easy to find and parking was always available. Highly recommend!
Perfect place to stay in Chicago, super easy uber rides into the city and perfect walking distances to anything near! Super close to the lake, which was a plus!

We  had a large group in town for a weekend event and needed a place with enough beds and bathrooms to accommodate all of us. This worked out really well! Multiple bedrooms downstairs let some of us sleep when the others wanted to stay up, and nobody had to wait for a bathroom or more hot water. We also appreciated the large table where we could hang out with late night snacks after very full days. This is an annual event so I’m sure we’ll check to see if this place is available again in the future.
Marcus nos are too con mucha amabilidad, tuvimos una comunicación excelente, el lugar estaba impecable, lo super recomiendo

Great property - just what we needed for a week in Chicago. Great neighborhood, walkable and easy access to train to get to other neighborhoods. Justin and Samantha were very quick to respond and went above and beyond to help us with something we needed while staying there. Would stay here again for sure!

this place did its purpose  for what exactly i needed it. the area was pretty quiet and peaceful for it being in a Englewood. this place was also close to alot of places, chipotle, us bank, save alot, aldis, Starbucks, family dollar, liquor store,  ect. I would gladly rent this place again in the near future. The host also took care of the cleaning pretty often and was helping when needed.

El departamento tiene todo lo necesario, es muy espacioso, cómodo y nuevo. Está en un primer piso por escalera.

We stayed here last year and really liked the experience. We were pleased to see it was available again for our trip dates.
Nice and clean with a well stocked kitchen setup and good utensils and such. They even had oil

I want to start by saying that the host did nothing wrong. She communicated instructions before arrival and seemed polite. We just did not feel right being there. great place for share a couple days whit your family. we loved it

This is an awesome place.  Two floors allow for plenty of space from bedrooms and tv/kitchen.  I am a cook,  and while the stove is amazing, the cooking pots and pans are minimal.  I would not, however, say this is a reason to not stay at this great property.

This place was absolutely fantastic, and the host responded quickly. It is located in a very peaceful neighborhood, surrounded by great bars and restaurants. There is so much to do, and everything seemed walkable. Elizabeth was quick to respond and always helpful. Francine was also amazing; she recommended some great places to us. Overall, our experience was wonderful, and we would definitely come back.

The apartment was fantastic and exactly as pictured. It was clean, smelled wonderful, and the beds were super comfy. The best part was the host—so friendly and quick to respond!

Alec was extremely helpful and responsive throughout our stay. The place was tidy and clean, and we really appreciated having an in-unit washer and dryer. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would absolutely love to come back again!
Amazing space and location for the price! Super responsive and helpful after I left something there and needed to get it before my flight. This will be my go-to spot when I visit again.

Our family enjoyed the stay here. It was convenient for what we needed and held our 7 people easily. It was also easy to get to the store for groceries. Everyone did enjoy the stay, and these issues were minimal. Just FYI for the host. He was VERY kind, and was very flexible with us when we had an extra request.

It was a great stay. We had requested to check in last minute and Alma was still accommodate of me my partner and our friend. It fit perfectly for my budget, and also Eric was very attentive all the time.

Comfortable, clean and in a perfect location. Definitely recommend staying here.

My friends and I were very grateful to have such a beautiful, comfortable space to spend during our stay in Chicago.  The neighborhood is lovely and close to all sorts of great restaurants and shops.  We each felt that we would for sure stay here again if the opportunity were to present itself.

Jeremiah is a kind and friendly host. He immediately made me feel comfortable and like I was home. The room is great for quick trips to explore Chicago. The bathroom and common areas were clean. I’d stay here again.

Le logement est très propre, sécurisé (3codes avant d’arriver dans notre chambre). Il y a tout ce qu’il faut dans la cuisine. C’est assez facile de se rendre en ville (à 15 minutes même pas en uber pour environ 12-15$).

La casa è spaziosa e confortevole, con tutto ciò che può servire per un alloggio sia breve sia duraturo.
John è stato sempre disponibile a rispondere a tutte le nostre necessità (ad esempio non abbiamo trovato l’asciugacapelli e la mattina dopo ce lo ha fatto prontamente recapitare da Amazon), risolvendo anche piccoli intoppi in corso di soggiorno.
Loved this basement apartment and the host was super helpful the entire trip. I would 100% recommend.
Good location, lot of food spots nearby, easy access to train and bus to go downtown. Very convenient and clean! Hosts are very friendly and reactive. I recommend!
Samuel was great and very helpful! The place was so cute and clean and in walking distance of a bus and train station.
Good for price.
It was bigger than I thought

Chiaka is truly a super host. She is so friendly and helpful, and the home was the perfect stay near the University of Chicago. The space is much larger than most homes at a similar price point and just radiates old school beauty and charm.

Worth what I paid for. The flexible check in and check out made it really easy for me as I was there for a concert for a couple days. The host was responsive. Only word of caution: if you’re a solo female traveler with a lot of luggage - pls make some arrangement to carry the suitcases up as the big staircase will be a problem. Thankfully both times I found someone within the AirB&B to help me. Close to Dunkin, a bunch of Chinese restaurants are right outside, walk a bit to the left and there are a bunch over there too. I will recommend this place for its efficiency, access, safety, necessities met, flexibility with check in and check out. The day of the concert - I could store my luggage w the host (it was checkout day) and I picked it up after the concert.

We loved this apartment! It was in such an amazing location next to the Blue Line and in walking distance from so many great Chicago staples. It was nice and clean, artsy and cool, and really felt like a private pad during our stay. Would definitely come back to stay!
Very cooperative host and room is nice.

Traveled to Chicago for a weekend trip with my wife and another couple and this was the perfect HQ for our stay. Lots of places to eat and drink and shop in the immediate area and direct access to the blue line for heading into the city/back to O'Hare. The space was clean and had everything we needed. Host was responsive and the check-in/check-out process was easy. Would 100% book this spot again.
The place was located well and all amenities inside the house were great.

El apto era tal cual muestran las fotos.Tiene toda la infraestructura de una casa a disposición de los huéspedes.
Sí bien, no está muy lejos del centro hay que caminar unas cuadras para tomar el tren. Todo muy bien

As other’s have said, Ben is an excellent communicator and host. So easy and pleasant to work with! The location was fantastic, so easy to get around and convenient. We had no trouble with street parking. The view was terrific. The condo was spacious and really comfortable. Great stay all around.

John is an excellent host and a nice guy too! Appreciate the hospitality of Terry and Katie, their dog, as well.
It’s a nice residential neighborhood, and very close to CTA red line.
I also recommend checking out Andersonville, an interesting nearby town.

Stay at Weihong’s place was great and totally worth the price. She was very friendly and responsive - the bathroom light bulb was out and she fixed it in a timely manner. If you’re looking for a space in an affordable price, this is a great spot.
Location is great considering it’s price, in the chinatown area. Had a great dim sum place 5 mins away.
Minden tökéletes volt. Ajánlom mindenkinek!

The home host were very responsive to dealing with any issue that came up. The neighborhood is fabulous close proximity to the beach to one of the best coffee shops around and two public transportation. I chose it because it was very close to my son‘s home. I came up from my home to care for my new grandson for the time I was spending in Chicago. It has all the amenities.

This is one the best Airbnb experiences we've ever had. We typically look for an entire place for ourselves, but we are glad we forgot to have that filter on while searching and finding Gerard and Ernie's home.
It's extremely rare to have such a complete experience on Airbnb for outstanding hospitality. Gerard and Ernie are a joy to talk to and had wonderful recommendations. We highly recommend their home to solo travelers and couples. It's a very safe, warm, and comfortable home to stay in, and we'd love to be back.

This place was absolutely perfect for our group of six.  We were in town for my daughter’s wedding weekend and this place allowed us to spread out and be so cozy and comfy. Beds are great, kitchen has everything you need, furniture is comfy, and we all slept so well!  The bathroom is full of nice touches, has rainfall shower and is spacious. Loved the off street parking spot as well!  I cannot say enough about how clean this place was!  Don’t hesitate to book…you won’t be disappointed!  We come to town often so we now have a new favorite spot to stay!
A casa é ampla, bem equipada e confortável.
Olga was a wonderful host. She was very responsive and helped whenever I asked. I felt very safe during my stay here.

The location worked perfectly for my visit with my nephew … right around the corner.  Great location, walkable to so many things!  The photos were accurate but I didn’t realize from the pics that there isn’t a living room, no couch or any place to comfortably sit in the evenings.  The bed is in that space.  It was totally fine for my purposes and probably most, but thought it was worth a mention.  I would likely come back if in the area again.  Thank you.
Enjoyed my stay!
The large window views are fantastic. The blue line train is a block away. A nice grocery store across the street. The place is modern, clean, and quiet. I would definitely stay here again!

This studio was our crash pad for a weekend trip to the city. Being so close to the Metro and in a local area full of life, makes you feel right at home and a native Chicago north-sider. I would definitely recommend this spot if you’re wanting that local feel at a great price

Place was nice, accurate, and clean. However Noe provided EXPIRED parking permits. Which made our stay somewhat uncomfortable. We should not have to worry about our rental car being ticketed or towed. Besides that I would book again if the parking permits aren’t expired.

This was a great apartment! Comfortable mattress & great pillows. Great water pressure and hot, hot shower. Easy check in. There was a lot of free parking around the building, my car stayed in the same spot all weekend. Great location! Highly recommend!
Andreea and Shaun’s home was great and welcoming! My partner and I enjoyed our stay and felt comfortable in the home! The house was located in a great area!  It was a great stay!
Fantastic stay in a great neighborhood
Definitely appreciated their responsiveness. That is what makes the stay a 5 star stay.
Catherine’s place was a in an excellent location for walking to shops, cafes, and the park + zoo. Nice deep closets to put a pack n play for a little one.

LOVED staying here, it was nice, cozy and comfortable. all of the labels and little notes around the home were very convenient, it was super easy to navigate everything. i would love to come and stay here again in the future!

Really enjoyed my stay here! The space exceeded my expectations — very cozy, clean, and comfortable, and it felt easy to settle into right away. The host was great and everything matched the listing well.
The only thing I noticed was some noise from the upstairs unit during the early morning hours. It didn’t ruin my stay, though. I understand this can happen when you’re staying in a downstairs unit and not all buildings are fully soundproof. Overall, I still had a positive experience and would stay again

Song and Dillon were wonderful hosts. They kindly allowed flexibility with dropping off my luggage early/picking it up late, which made my trip 10x less stressful. Very convenient location, felt safe. And the cats are adorable.
Awesome place even better than pics.  L station close by super convenient.  Not too noisy.
We had a wonderful stay! The location is very safe and quiet too

Very responsive host. Access to 606 Trail was a highlight as was garage access. As mentioned in other reviews, the back staircase is a bit precarious but doable. The space was very clean but woodwork, cabinetry need some love. Also, there are a few homeless tents pitched nearby.
Simple but perfect. Can't beat the price. Nice neighborhood.
Very good serviced apartment, we had a great time in Chicago. Thanks!

The space was great for what we needed while visiting for a few nights for a wedding! The neighborhood was cute and walkable. The apartment was cozy and a great place to come back to at the end of the day. I was working all day from the apartment one day and by the afternoon, the wifi started to get a bit spotty. Other than that, it was a great place to stay and Demitri was a proactive and responsive host.
It was truly comfortable.
Un lugar muy hermoso, el arte estuvs increíble. Me sentí muy segura allí. Sin duda volvería. Gracias por el espacio tan hermoso que has creado.
Good location for public transport to different areas of the city.  Liked the exposed brick. Very responsive and helpful host

Kody was amazing and his place was as described. We had an issue caused by us and Kody was able to help us out without any issues. He was very communicative through our trip. The place was a close commute to Chinatown which was very convenient. When I say this place was clean, it was spotless. Our infant was able to comfortably move around the home without any issues. Would definitely Kody if you are visiting Chicago.
Pristine apartment in the heart of downtown Chicago. Close to everything. You can definitely hear the train but it quickly becomes background noise. I would stay again.
Very clean!
I was there for a few nights. The place is as described, great location. The host was very responsive.

It was an amazing experience. From the check-in process to asking questions, everything was easy and very efficient. The place itself was great — perfect if you want to stay in and relax, but also in a great location if you want to go for a walk or explore nearby restaurants. Overall, we had such a great time and really enjoyed the experience.
The place was very well described and easy to find. There were accessible train and bus stations making it easy to get around without having to get a car. The place was always clean
Great, peaceful place to stay in Chicago . Super easy access to blue line and downtown Chicago. Definitely recommend to anyone.  Thank you James for letting us stay in your apartment.
We had a great time, Antonio was so nice!

I had an outstanding stay at this Airbnb! Everything was perfect from beginning to end. The service exceeded my expectations, and the staff was always available and ready to help whenever needed. The environment is peaceful, clean, and very comfortable to live in.
One of the best things about this location is the convenience — there is a beautiful park nearby where you can relax and enjoy the area, and the Orange Line train station is only about 300 meters away, making transportation very easy.
Everything was excellent and exactly as described. A special thank you and congratulations to YU for the exceptional service and professionalism. Highly recommended, and I would definitely stay here again!
Does it’s job for the price. Would stay there again.

I rarely write reviews, but this place truly deserves one. Nicholas was incredibly kind and welcoming throughout my stay, and the place was spotless, comfortable, and beautifully maintained. I’ll definitely stay here again whenever I’m back in Chicago, and I highly recommend it.
Fue increible muchas gracias lo pasamos muy bien

Absolutely incredible stay! My friends were visiting from LA and we stayed here for the duration of their trip. Such a fantastic spot! Comfortably slept 5 people (2 people in each bedroom and 1 person on the couch)
The location is FANTASTIC!! Super convenient to all the hot spots in wicker park and only a 4-5 minute walk over to the blue line station.
I absolutely will book again the next time I have folks in town that are wanting a tour of the city. Highly recommend!
I enjoyed my stay here! No complaints. Hosts was great and communicative
Nice place and super walkable area! Lots of cool vintage stores, coffee shops and bakeries all within a block or two.

Moudi’s place was perfect for our 6 night stay. The location is excellent.
Place was very nice, clean and quite roomy. Good coffee and kitchen supplies. Internet and the TV worked well. And free street parking was easy to find - a big bonus.
Great recommendations for restaurants, coffee shops and how to get around.
We had a wonderful visit and would definitely stay here again.
Very clean, modern amenities, good location. We like the two bedrooms and bathrooms.

It was my first time in Chicago and we have a wonderful stay thanks to Cody! Everything was clean, the neighborhood was beautiful and quiet, and the train station was a quick walk away. Highly recommend and hope to visit again in the future!

Really enjoyed our stay, we could relax while in the place, and the location was even better than what we expected, while walking we found several great spots, and it is super centric. Danny was always very helpful with instructions and effective communication.
Great hosts and nice location. Would stay again. Thank you!
Nice place, location was great with walkable coffee, groceries, food etc. clean comfy and the big screen projector was a plus.

Très belle maison bien équipé avec une terrasse et un barbecue très sympa
Tout était ok
Bien situé près du métro
Great place to stay for the week! Loved the location and would definitely stay again!

Our family had a fantastic visit to Chicago! This property is perfect! It's very well maintained, very clean, comfortable beds, well equipped kitchen, and location was perfect. Peter puts a lot of care into maintaining this property. Hands down, one of the best properties we have stayed in our travels.  Thank you for hosting us!!!!
Loved the place and the location. Finding parking was a little iffy but didn’t mind a little walk. Brad was quick to respond to any questions and was super helpful. I would stay again!
Amazing stay! A very cute home in a good location that was walkable to public transportation, a quiet neighborhood, and easy parking on weekend!

This has been such an awesome experience!
I stayed with Mike and Vero for 8 days. They are the sweetest hosts, friendly, considerate and helpful. We’ve had good talks and lots of laughs together.
Their cosy comfortable home is located 1 min from bus stop and 1 min to a great food store. There are also lots of small restaurants in the neighbourhood.
I loved coming hpme every day being welcomed by their sweet old dog Piper. And an extra comfort was their veranda, to be able to have meals out in the sun :)
I had a fun and beautiful stay, thank you so much!
Great location, lovely space, no notes!  Would recommend
Shemaiah was friendly and eager to make the stay a pleasant one. The home was just as described and is really nice. Would stay again if visiting.

Clemente’s place was perfect for our recent trip to Chicago. Located just a couple of blocks from the Red Line, the apartment was convenient to most everything we wanted to see and do. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We had an issue with the WiFi when we first arrived which was not Clemente’s fault, but he got us a solution right away. He was responsive, helpful and gracious during our entire stay. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting the area.
Great place and the taco shop nearby was one of our favorite meals! Great listening, clean and comfortable

Amazing stay! The house was gorgeous. We loved the brickwork walls and different mediums were so cool!! The house had everything! Super convenient to be able to park outside (for free!) without worrying about competing for spots, or parking offsite like we do at the hotels in downtown Chicago. We had several family members in town for my son’s graduation,  and one day we simply stayed at the house and played Wii games and poker at the large dining room table. Such a great place to stay. We only wish we found it sooner! The hosts were awesome! They were super responsive and they left a sweet note wishing my son a happy graduation, along with snacks to greet us upon arrival. Thank you so much for sharing your awesome home! 🙏🏼

My stay was great! Loved the process point and the location. I was in town for a concert and the venue was maybe 2 blocks away. It was also incredibly affordable considering it is right by so many things, Wrigley Field specifically. The place was very clean and easy to access. I’m a pretty easy person to please and I do t tend to stay inside much when traveling, but when I was there it had everything that I needed. Would definitely stay again.

Marv’s place was great. Very easy to get to most parts of the city, 25 mins from front door to wrigley field, 25 min to my office which is right next to the Willis tower. Marv was a great host had the place stocked and clean. Always responsive. Couldn’t recommend more

The home was very nice and the neighborhood was quiet and nice as well. Unfortunately there were several plug in type air fresheners in the house.  My wife had a severe allergic reaction to the overpowering scent and we could not stay there.  We spent our Chicago trip at a hotel, instead of a home.  Phyllis has a no refund on cancellation policy, which I totally understand, but in the end we paid for a home we couldn’t stay 5 minutes in.

Great location near my daughter. Clean, convenient to transport and local amenities.
Host was responsive and proactive for check in/out help and reminders. Morning coffee / tea in cupboard with high end machine that was easy to get a nice morning coffee. Easy access down a short staircase with a nice living space comfy sofa and streaming TV in bedroom too !
Great place!

Loved this place!! We right next to a lot of yummy bars and restaurants (shout out to Spinning J!). It was also easy to find and get in to, and we felt safe and secure. It was a close enough walk to a few different bus lines. It was a tiny bit of a hike to make it to a train line (like maybe 20 minute walk) but that wasn't a deal breaker. The place was on the older, more lived in side, but that made it feel homey and cozy. The weather changed quite a few different times throughout our stay but we were easily able to adjust the temperature inside and there were extra blankets for warmth.  I would stay again!

I love everything about my stay.  The space is clean and spacious.  The kitchen set up is more than efficient.  The location is very convenient.  Mostly, Samantha is very responsive and I will definitely stay with her again next time.
All is perfect

Had a great stay here for two weeks, the unit was very comfortable and had all ammenities, the building laundry was easy to use, wifi was good for some Zoom meetings I had. The listing is new but David clearly put a lot of work into setting up the airbnb. The neighborhood was very welcoming and quiet for a big city, some good cafes a short walk away and many good restaurants especially a really good Thai place and mediterranean place around the corner. David was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. Next time I'm in Chicago I will try to book again!
The hosts were friendly and lovely to talk to throughout my stay. The place was affordable, felt safe, and was a great overall experience. I’d definitely recommend staying here.

I had a wonderful stay here! Danielle and Lemonade made me feel right at home! Thanks for being so friendly and responsive. The place is exactly as described, close to metro stop and bus routes, which made getting around the city pretty easy. I will definitely be happy to stay here again in the future and highly recommend it to others.
The place was nice, kind of squeaky, but very homey and clean. Good air flow and lighting. The neighborhood is very walkable with various shops near by.

Cute place. Very walkable location and super easy parking. We always found a place right on the street. There are stairs to get up to the apartment, so if you have trouble carrying bags and doing a bunch of steps, this might be difficult, but we had no trouble. The kitchen isn't stocked with anything so bring what you need. This didn't bother us because we weren't really eating any meals there.

We had a great stay overall. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we expected. Communication was smooth, and everything made for an enjoyable experience. The only minor issue was that the fire pit didn’t work during our stay, which was a bit disappointing since we were looking forward to using it. Other than that, no complaints we’d be happy to stay again.

Great place, just what we needed for our few days in the area.  Many restaurants and parks to walk to nearby, which we enjoyed!  Host Tere was very helpful and responsive.  Felt safe in the area.  Would definitely stay again!
We had a lovely stay in Chicago at Tia’s Airbnb. She was responsive and very helpful.

Very simple place, exactly what you want in an apartment. The view of the Chicago skyline, around midnight on a clear night is absolutely priceless.
All the amenities are perfect, clean and really well kept. The gym was amazing, and it was very quiet.
Neighborhood, altogether was very nice as well. Couple of restaurants within walking distance. Would (and will) definitely rent again next time I’m back in Chicago.
Very spacious and nicely decorated — the photos in the listing are completely accurate. Super helpful to have parking in the garage

Stephen was super flexible with the check in time and provided a great description of how to find the location, how to get around, etc. The place was quiet, had everything we could possibly need and was central to what we had on our itinerary. id definitely stay again

Great place!! Comfort And Coziness 10/10!! Host Was Very Helpful And Make Sure To Check In And Make Sure I Was Ok During My Stay!! No Tv For Entertainment In Room Or Common Area But Everything Else Was Ok! Would Stay Again

Such a cute and cozy space! The neighborhood is wonderful. The front yard is beautiful. My only complaints are that  I could not open the blinds due to plastic over the windows, I'm guessing from winter, so sadly it was quite dark, and the bed was very creaky, although still quite comfortable. Sylvia is so welcoming, kind and helpful! Would def stay again :)

I rarely leave negative reviews and have only received 5-star ratings as a guest, but I left this stay 3 days early.
The biggest issue was the bed. I’m 6’0” and could not fit because the wooden frame extends beyond both ends of the mattress. The host acknowledged the bed is “short,” but this is not disclosed in the listing.
Other issues:
* No toilet paper at one point; and the owner responded by later placing some there and implying I had somehow missed it.
* Very poor lighting.
* Minimal storage- located on floor under the bed
* Dirty/stained walls.
* Very limited outlets.
Most disappointing was the host’s refusal to reasonably address the situation or refund unused nights, even after Airbnb contacted him. Airbnb ultimately reimbursed me after escalation.
I would recommend taller travelers or anyone expecting a responsive host look elsewhere.

Comfy stay in a rustic-feeling home. The house definitely has age to it—some creaky floors and signs of wear—but it felt more “old but not broken,” and honestly added to the charm of the place. Everything was still well-kept, functional, and thoughtfully furnished, which made it feel very hospitable and lived-in in the best way.
Although I didn’t get to meet Mary in person, she went above and beyond with communication before and throughout the stay, which made everything smooth and welcoming.
The location is a bit removed from the main action—about a 15-minute walk to the train station (which, granted, does get to the action), and there’s not much happening immediately nearby—but the surrounding area is very quiet. The neighborhood is next to a freeway, though I didn’t hear it at all at night.
The weather happened to be fantastic during my stay, so I can’t speak to how the experience might differ otherwise, but given the chance, I’d gladly stay here again.
Super cute place to stay I loved the bathroom ! As well as the tic tac toe wall. Great stay!
The place was exactly how it is in the pictures.We were so happy with the place - super clean, convenient location and very responsive hosts.The terrace is a bonus and has stunning views.

This was a perfect spot for us to stay on our Chicago girls trip. It was a cute neighborhood and Yara provided some delicious local recommendations that were very tasty! It was a quick walk to a bus or train station which was perfect since we used public transportation the whole time. Great spot outside of the hubbub of the city!

We had a very comfortable stay. There were plenty of towels, toilet paper, and blankets. The hairdryer and iron were both lifesavers. The self check-in process was so nice and the building felt very safe. It’s a little outdated, but it’s clean and functional which is all that matters. The hosts were very proactive and responsive. There is a small fee for late check out which was a great option to have!
My only suggestion would be wash cloths or small towels for the face :)
Thanks for a great stay and a smooth process.

We had a peaceful  3 night stay at Ruby's apartment. It's a really big and spacious apartment on the 2nd floor. It's well-equipped and one has everything needed even for a long-term stay. The apartment was clean and in order and Ruby let fruits and some bottles of water for us. It's located in a quiet neighborhood close to parks, lake beaches and the University of Chicago. It takes roughly 45 min to get to downtown by subway or bus. Ruby was very friendly and proactive. We can't but to recommend her unit.
The apartment was delightful and worked well for even an extended stay.
We loved our stay here! Reinitta was a great host and we couldn’t have asked for much more!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Chicago! The location was great and very walkable to shops, restaurants and tourist attractions. This place was very comfortable for our family. We felt right at home and it was very relaxing. We had everything we needed for our stay. Thank you so much for sharing your condo with us!!

Anjali was incredibly kind and accommodating and her apartment was cozy and quiet. She went out of her way to make sure that we felt right at home. We absolutely loved our stay in Little Village and would return in a heartbeat. Thanks so much for having us!

The apartment was close to the train station and easy to find. As mentioned in other reviews, you can definitely hear the trains go by, but it didn’t bother me while I was there. I don’t remember reading that it’s a basement unit, but it looks like the photos and was a well kept, comfortable space. Marijes offered suggestions for a couple nearby spots for me to try and was responsive when I had questions. Overall, I’d stay here again next time I’m in Chicago!
great place

After a minor glitch getting in that was resolved in about 5 minutes by Bianca everything was smooth . The bedrooms don’t have outside windows but two have skylights but everything was quite nice and the neighborhood was wonderful . Checkout was easy and everything worked very well once we found the coffee in the closet along the hallway . Bianca was terrific and very helpful! Thank you
Shaun was a good host and even helped me when I left a sweater at his place. Would definitely stay again

Very cute house, ideally located… everything you need in the neighbourhood.
Very quiet and clean.
Good host
It was perfect!!!
Perfect location - very responsive and communicative hosts
Veronica was very communicate and solution-oriented. the space was just right for a single person visiting for work

This is a clean city oasis.  The washer/dryer are wonderful perks for any traveler and work perfectly.  The kitchen has a full size fridge as well.  Hosts are responsive and accommodating.  I would definitely stay again.

The place was great. It had 6 rooms which accommodated our group perfectly. The location was perfect as well. Just a short drive from the city. Only issue I had is that I received 2 spam messages on Whats App regarding my reservation which was very odd. I was concerned on how they got the information about my booking. I escalated it to Airbnb. Apparently its happened to others but it doesn’t necessarily mean the info iwas leaked on the hosts side or Airbnb side. I just ignored the messages. Other than that, no concerns with our stay.
Great spot in the heart of Andersonville. Highly recommend.

Latasha was a very helpful and responsive host. We were looking for a home in Chicago for my co-founder, Kedar, and I had shared all our requirements with her in advance. She addressed all our queries clearly, shared the check-in information, and provided detailed instructions, which made the process smooth. She was also open to communicating over WA, which was very convenient.
Overall, Kedar had a good stay, and we were happy with the experience. The only small feedback we would like to share is that we received the checkout instructions one day before the actual checkout date. Since the checkout was on 16th May and the message came on 15th May, it caused a little confusion and made us wonder if checkout was expected that day. Apart from that, everything else was good, and we appreciate Latasha’s support throughout the stay.
Parking close often problematic
Loud and Eduardo's place was very cozy and warm. Both host were very kind and put a lot of love and care into their space. Would love to visit again!

Overall, the stay was decent. The room and bathroom were very clean, and management was always quick to respond and helpful whenever issues came up. The Hyde Park location was also beautiful and convenient.
That said, there were several frustrating management issues throughout the stay. We arrived around 10pm, and although they knew our arrival time, we were told another guest may have taken all the keys and that we might need to retrieve a backup key from an alley. It worked out, but it felt uncomfortable as first-time visitors to Chicago arriving late at night. Once inside, we couldn’t get into our room because the doorknob/setup was confusing and required a specific “trick” that wasn’t explained beforehand. The bathroom hand soap dispenser was also empty, and shampoo/body wash are not provided. The walls are extremely thin, and we also saw someone sleeping on the common-area couch during checkout.
Overall, responsive hosts but several avoidable operational issues.
perfect for visiting my daughter at SAIC … thank you Ping
Solid spot close to the train, nice inside and clean
Great place to stay. Close to Wrigley.

Amanda’s place was great; super clean, roomy, great kitchen, great location and a straight line bus ride to Art Institute, Grant and Millenium parks, Studebaker Theater and great restaurants. Marcos was very responsive and all in all great experience.

Stephanie's appartment location was ideal for a week exploring Chicago. Clear instructions , easy to find and great communication prior to arrival and was available during stay if required. Location steady 30 minutes walk to all the major downtown tourist attractions and approx. 7 minute walk to Red Line @ Roosevelt to get access North and South of City. Would recommend.

We enjoyed our stay! Would recommend and we would 100% stay again, the only issue and (its not even really an issue) is that we could not get the upstairs bedroom doors to lock. Did not bother us at all and would stay again if we pass through town!

Our week in Chicago, for our daughter's graduation, was made less stressful and more comfortable because of this delightful place. Location was fantastic (three blocks from our daughter), we were always able to find parking close by, the place itself was comfortable and well-appointed, and it was beautiful inside and out. We especially enjoyed the outdoor deck seating area directly outside the kitchen. We were able to relax here with coffee in the morning or a snack in the afternoon. The hosts were incredibly responsive and helpful and the communication was top-notch. We will definitely book this lovely place for our next trip to Chicago and Roscoe Village.

Sharon’s place was perfect for our first trip to Chicago! The neighborhood was close to public transit and walkable to some great restaurants, which was convenient for visiting without a car. The apartment was comfortable for 4 people and had all the listed amenities. Our only concern was the floors did not seem to be cleaned prior to our arrival, and had a noticeable amount of dust/dirt/trash scraps. But other than that, we loved our stay here and will come again if we return to the area!

From booking to checking out, Bryan was excellent. Would definitely stay again and recommend to friends and family.
Extremely accommodating and helpful.
Charie is an amazing host and the place is very nice and well-maintained. I definitely recommend her place!
Junior was a great and responsive host. Great location. No complaints whatsoever.

This was a wonderful place to stay. It’s private and has lots of restaurants and things around it. Can was a great host and he was extremely responsive. It was in a very safe location, and I think if you’re in Chicago you should stay here.
We really enjoyed our stay at the penthouse! Great option for multiple households or families with older children. Clean and very walkable to many Chicago landmarks. We’d stay again!
Absolutely worth the price! Room is clean and fully equipped even include tooth brash
Excellent location and super communication from host!
Active elders, 81 and82, found this finished basement unit just right for us. We could park the car on the concrete pad, and use public transportation to get to downtown.
Clear communication and accuracy. Would definitely stay again:)
Charming and very historic building in a super convenient location!!  Very helpful to have Parking on site, and the decor was delightful.

A very comfy place to call home for a few days.  The location is great with easy access to so many of the neighborhoods.  The beds were very comfortable. I can’t lie, I did use ear plugs. The highway is a little close, but that’s city life right!  Matthew provided lots of fluffy towels and soaps/ shampoo etc. Access to the building was easy but safe and secure.
Place was nice and easy to locate. Owner was extremely responsive and even checked in on us a couple of time just to be sure everything was okay. Great place for a short stay in Chicago!

The place was clean and quiet. Great location.
Only issues were the beds need to be updated (not comfortable) and very little furniture to put our stuff in, and no other mirrors besides the bathroom.
Outside of that, very nice place!

My family and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Such a nice place. Everything is so well thought out for the comfort of Forest's guest. Such a beautiful location too. Turns out we were just across the street from family. How perfect!

IF I COULD GIVE THIS AIRBNB NEGATIVE STARS THAT WOULD STILL BE GENEROUS! Our stay at this rental was absolutely disgusting and completely unacceptable. The property was filthy upon arrival, with grime throughout and an overwhelming feeling that it had not been properly cleaned in a very long time.
The worst part was discovering smelling salts in the sofa bed, blood-stained mattress pads on the beds, bugs throughout, beds jammed against walls, no side tables, no electrical plugs accessible, pack n plays thrown in closets making them unusable and potentially unsafe for children. Horrifying and unsanitary.
To make matters worse, the house was covered in signs everywhere listing rules and warnings about no condoms being disposed in toilets and the owners clearly put little effort into maintaining basic cleanliness or guest comfort. The entire experience felt gross, neglected, and misleading compared to the listing photos and description.
I WOULD ABSOLUTELY NOT RECOMMEND STAYING HERE!

Great location in the city and close to everything, which made getting around super convenient. The building entrance has security, so we felt safe during our stay. The space itself was very spacious and comfortable, with plenty of room for everyone. The host was also very flexible and communicated quickly whenever we had questions. Overall, a great stay and I would definitely book again!

Buena ubicación y fácil
Accesibilidad

The unit very well stocked and had anything that you needed. The apartment had the feel of being at home, not the sterile feeling of a lot of  Airbnb‘s. My hostess was always friendly and would respond to any communication in a very timely manner.

Overall a good experience, only issue I had was our neighbor. They played loud movies/music and smoked a lot of weed. Also, the bathroom was okay, but the shower probably needs to be scrubbed down a bit. The room itself was okay, just a bit run down. Could do with fixing the celling tiles and providing an extra towel or two.
Loved our stay. Clean, quiet, cool neighborhood. Would definitely stay again.
no complaints and great host
Very kind and responsive host. The property was in a good location with a lot of nearby attractions. Very clean and organized.

This quaint and comfortable room was just as described, and the self-serve breakfast each morning on the main level of the house was terrific! It's located in the heart of 'Boys Town' in north Halsted, so very active nightlife, though the house is quietly tucked back away from the main street.
Only a 10 minute walk to the train and Wrigley Field. I'd definitely stay here again!

Roberto was an amazing host. He responded to any questions that I had in a fast timely matter. I needed a parking pass and he came and dropped it off in less than 15 minutes.
The unit was very spacious and clean. I was surprised that the unit has 2 bathrooms. Most 2 bedroom Airbnbs in Chicago don't have 2 bathroom. The location is on a quiet street. The train is in walking distance. Pilsen is a great area. It's easy to get around the city from that area. I will definitely rebook again the next time my family and I are in town.

Ute's place was incredible.  It's on a super cute historic street just a couple blocks from Wrigley Field and the Red Line.  The house is full of all kinds of interesting art and figurines.  You really have to experience it for yourself.  It's got a nice little backyard and the house itself is filled with natural light.  We're grateful for our time at her place.
Great home and in a great neighborhood!
Great stay

Had a great stay overall! The TV had some issues during our visit, but the host was responsive, kind, and went out of their way to make things right — they even brought us churros, which was such a thoughtful gesture. Really appreciated the hospitality and communication throughout the stay.

I found the apartment very clean and comfortable, plenty of kitchen appliances and bathroom towels etc.
I had a lot of heavy luggage as I was in Chicago for a trade show at the convention centre- the lack of a lift made getting to the apartment a little tricky but I obviously hadn’t checked to see if there was a lift before I booked (so totally not their fault).
I enjoyed sitting on the little balcony with a coffee in the mornings.
Very clear instructions and responsive hosts.
The place was perfect for our needs. Kasa was very responsive to all inquiries I had prior to and during our stay.
The home was nice clean and peaceful this was my second time staying here and won’t be the last

Me and my family had some great days in Chicago and Nicole & Matt's place was the perfect place to stay at. Comfy beds, high standard and all we needed was to find both in the house, as well as shops and restaurants in walking distance. The sound from the train didn't bother us at all.
As we had a late flight back home, we were offered to check out a bit later, which was very much appreciated from our side.
Great place and host, just a bit dusty
I had a great time in Chicago staying at this location. It was very cozy and an easy walk to lots of great restaurants in Old Town.

This is the second week-long stay in Brandon's place in the last 9 months and we really enjoyed the place again.  Centrally located near bus and metro lines, great restaurants, the lake, and Wrigley Field. Has most things needed for week-long stay. Bring ear plugs if traffic noise keeps you awake at night.
Responsive host- great neighborhood and easy parking. Home was clean and lots of bright light. Dining area and kitchen had what we needed for our family.

What a great stay! We were looking for a place near our son that offered some privacy, was dog-friendly with outdoor space, and within walking distance to good restaurants and shops. We found exactly what we needed in Alexandra's place. Instructions for finding the unit and garage were  detailed and easy to follow. Alexandra was very welcoming (cookies!) and quick to answer any questions we had, and the home was as described and well-stocked. The instructions throughout the house for things like the heating/cooling system were very helpful and a thoughtful addition. We will be back!

We had a great stay in Chicago! The self check-in instructions were easy to follow, which made arriving stress-free. The gated parking spot was a huge bonus, and the condo itself was very clean and well maintained. The 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom layout was perfect for our stay, and the fully equipped kitchen had everything we needed. The location was excellent close to restaurants, attractions, and everything we wanted to do. Would definitely stay here again!

Overall a great stay! Very lovely apartment, has everything you need for comfort. Very clean, well appointed, quality furnishings. Good communication from host. My ideal location, close to Chicago Ave and Grand Ave and right near Ashland for the bus. Neighborhood vibes but close to everything.
A few details to note that may be helpful:
This is not a self check in process. The host lives on the 1st floor and they show you in/around the property. Not a negative just info!
The bathtub sides are very high, it’s at least 2.5’ to 3’ since it also acts as a deep soaking tub. If you have any mobility problems this will be an issue. The shower is also a design over function situation. The rainfall shower is directly over the center of a rather small tub, so if you want a shower without getting your hair wet it’s not possible.
The last thing is the apartment itself does not lock. The outer doors to the building do of course, but not the apartment. Didn’t love as a solo female traveler

The Airbnb looks old from outside but it’s well maintained from inside. The common room is spacious and has an additional bed. Rooms are little small. The only thing we didn’t like is the bad smell coming at the entryway. There was no smell upstairs.
Overall a good and comfortable stay

Spacious lower two levels of a duplex, walking distance from United center and blackhawks practice facility. The house was clean, spacious, has good natural lighting, and was a good value overall. Would stay again

Bella's place is an absolute gem! Crystal clean and lovely and comfortable. All directions and communications were prompt and thorough. The location is lovely and the building was very quiet. I will absolutely choose this location again!

Nancy’s Pad checked all our boxes and beyond.  Clean, comfortable, spacious, conveniently located and a great night’s sleep.  Many additional household amenities added towards what became our best home away from home experience. Great neighborhood with nearby carry out food, restaurants, bus, train and everything we needed.  Thank you Nancy and Mark for sharing your place which provided so much comfort on what was a very important weekend to us and our family.  Highly recommend a stay at Nancy’s Pad.
Great place to stay in the neighborhood after exploring the city.
This property was perfect for me and my guys. We came in town for a church service and felt right at home. Next time we in Chicago hopefully this spot is available.
Very, VERY budget oriented place to stay. If you like no-frills, older spaces without being kitschy, the place is great.
The unit was clean, the amenities requested were available, enough linens and towels were provided.  I would stay here again.
Eduardo was great, my family enjoyed the house and celebrating
Fantastic stay! Highly recommend.
Wonderful host!! Great location. Not one complaint, everything was great. Thanks Mosmi❤️

I absolutely loved staying at this beautiful place. My personal “cherry on top” are the washer&dryer at the apartment(what a luxury in the city apartment!), the bidet feature in the bathroom, the no-shoes policy, Ice and filtered water in the fridge(so thoughtful!), very comfortable couch, great memory foam pillows(I overslept! 😁), adjustable heat(I am always cold) and early check in and late check out options (with the charge)
You are above and beyond hosts! Thank you!

I was a little apprehensive due to the price but it was ABSOLUTELY worth every penny. Place was located in an amazing area, it was spacious, clean, plenty of fresh linens, easy instructions to get in and host was always very responsive and gave great recommendations will definitely be returning!!

We had a great experience at Sibani—the apartment is located conveniently near a good restaurant and shopping. We loved the place; the bedroom and bathroom were sufficient in size. Parking is a bit inconvenient, especially if you have luggage to carry from the Car to the room. The lobby and elevator were okay, not very clean.  Other than that, it is an excellent place.

Tim’s place was wonderful. His home is truly a gem in a beautiful neighborhood. The information he provided about things to do and where to go was extraordinary. I would not hesitate to stay there again.
Very clean, responsive communication, easy to find parking, well-stocked kitchen, great place to spend with family, good front porch for chilling with apps and drinks.

We had a great stay at George's. The home is in the perfect location to stick around and enjoy the neighborhood or take transit to explore the rest of the city. George was always responsive and helpful throughout our stay.

Had a great stay at Patrick’s place and he was a wonderful host - made us feel right at home. The neighborhood is beautiful and an easy walk to the brown line and many good restaurants nearby.  The apt itself was very comfortable and clean and had everything we needed. Patrick was a great communicator before and during our stay. We will definitely stay here again when we’re back in the area. I would love to enjoy some time in the patio/garden space that he keeps so well manicured - just didn’t have the time with this visit.

Great location, clean place, all the necessary amenities. especially appreciated the ceiling fans in 2/3 bedrooms. Parking passes available for purchase was helpful too!! only negative comment is that the bedrooms where pretty small, so much so that the doors didn't open all the way.

This is a great place if you want to visit Chicago and want to live like a local and still have access to all the fun things to do in Chicago. This is perfect for families visiting their students at Loyola. Steps from the campus and from the red line. We rented the entire unit and it was beyond perfect. Very clean. Very new. Plenty of space for everyone to spread out. James was a wonderful host!

Hanna and Mark were amazing hosts. Instructions on check-in and check-out were extremely clear and understandable, and house rules were reasonable. The apartment and amenities were very nice, and there were no issues with cleanliness upon arrival. Highly recommend booking!

I have stayed at this apartment a few times now, and will absolutely stay again anytime I go to Chicago! Neat & clean, nice neighborhood, so much to do within walking distance, and the rooftop access is fabulous!

The location is really good. Spend lots of time in Chicago and you can’t go wrong with this location. Close to Blue line and great walk to downtown. Extremely safe and pet friendly. You can find street parking relatively easy, which is a huge bonus. The rooftop patio is fantastic, they should do more with it, but whatever. I would stay there again for certain.
Brandon’s place was very nice. Nice sized rooms and the balcony’s were a plus. Close to Chicago’s hot spots as well. Definitely would recommend.

Hands down the best AirBnB we have stayed in. The place was pristine, the beds were so comfortable, the location was incredibly convenient, the kitchen was stocked with nearly everything we needed.
We are already looking forward to our next stay here!

Absolutely enjoyed our stay! The neighborhood is very walkable and close to restaurants and corner stores! I loved the closeness to the Brown Line and bus stops! The space was comfortable and had everything we needed! Would absolutely stay again!
The place was comfy and had great location as we were going to downtown frequently.

The host was incredibly responsive, and the home itself was beautifully staged and very tastefully decorated. The location is perfect—I’ll definitely be staying here again next time I’m in Chicago! Also, keep an eye out for Jose, a neighbor who helped work on the property. He is very friendly and takes great pride in making sure the house is well-maintained and respected. Be sure to say hello
Great garden level apartment- lots of space, and the coffee/tea amenities were much appreciated. Everything was clean, safe walkable neighborhood. We enjoyed our stay and recommend it!

My family stayed here when they came to Chicago for my graduation weekend. My parents loved the place! Not only is it clean and has all the amenities they need, it’s also in a very convenient location with the blue line being steps away. This made it easy for them to come downtown where I lived. 10/10 recommend!

It was a great location and Regina was responsive. It was very, very small, but I imagine that’s just how Chicago is. The beds are not comfortable at all! In fact, my daughter chose to sleep on the couch. There isn’t storage/space for things, which would have been helpful in such a tiny space. The linens are the lowest quality you can buy, but they were clean. We had to buy shampoo, conditioner and body wash bc there wasn’t conditioner and the other stuff wasn’t great. Not a big deal, but I suggest bring your own stuff and bring a hair dryer.  It’s really a nice space and location! getting higher quality linens, nice mattresses, storage solutions, and nicer bathroom items would go a LONG way.

Great location. comfortable space with everything we needed. Shower water pressure was quite low (but host promised to investigate), some windows crept closed, and a couple blinds could use repair/replacement. Convenient kitchen; good appliances; reasonably equipped; a few more dining utensils, a roll of foil, a box of bags, another dish towel or two would be ideal.
Building's common stairwell and entry: carpet's shabby, needs a good deep clean, and a lighting upgrade.
Overall: A good selection; we'd return!

Comfortable apt. Great shower!
Nice neighborhood

Khadija was a wonderful host! She was very professional, responsive, and did her best to make sure that I had a great experience from beginning to end. If I’m ever back, I would book again. I highly recommend to anyone!

The place was so dirty that we were refunded over $1000. The bathroom was particularly bad. The towels had stains and dirt on them. The bath tub mat and shower curtain were so bad, we bought and used our own. We spent an entire evening washing bed linens and towels. The kitchen floors were so dirty, we had to mop them twice. There was water dripping past an electrical box near the front entry that leaked water down the wall. The front concrete stairs to the unit are in disrepair and there is no handrail. The worst part was the constant smell of sewage.

This apartment is a little jewel, so clean and well-kept and tastefully done. It is quite small, but it had everything we needed -- a very comfortable bed, comfortable good quality pillows, great shower, fully-equipped kitchen ... And everything was so sparkling and clean ! It felt very safe and also quiet.  The location is also great -- about a 10-minute walk to the lake,  a 20 minute walk to UChicago, near public transportation and located in a good neighborhood with a lot of restaurants. Also, close  to Whole Foods and to Trader Joe's.. It was perfect for us -- quite near to our daughter's apartment. I would definitely give it 5 stars.

Brian’s place was awesome! It was very spacious, quiet, and clean. Linens and furniture were in excellent condition and the backyard was much appreciated by our pups. Garage parking was also a plus. We hope to be back!
It's a nice place in a great location.

The place was exactly how it's described. The house was easy to find and check in was easy to follow. We had a great stay for an extended weekend in the South Side. The place was clean, the hosts was extremely pleasant and quick to respond. I felt comfortable with my teenage son there. I would stay here again when I'm in town visiting family.

Aaron is an outstanding host - super communicative and responsive. We appreciated the spaciousness of this house, the garage parking, and the extremely well-appointed house. We had a comfortable, lovely stay in this cute walkable neighborhhood with coffee shops, restaurants and shopping. Highly recommend!

This place hosted 3 of us peacefully. we enjoyed the cleanliness, the safe and peaceful feeling of the neighborhood, and the coziness! They had my favorite blankets for additional comfort in the closet and it really helped me get snug.
We didn’t enjoy the horrible traffic we were hit with everytime leaving this place. No matter the time of day it was a hot mess but that’s totally out of our hosts control. We also didn’t love the neighbors upstairs, their walking was very disruptive and someone tried to open our door which was weird. We don’t know how it was but keep your door locked!

We had an amazing stay! The home was beautiful, clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very responsive, welcoming, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. The space was perfect for our family gathering and made our special weekend even more memorable. We truly appreciated all the thoughtful touches and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
The house was wonderful for a family stay in a peaceful setting. House felt very comfortable and afforded privacy for each person. Great neighborhood and friendly host!

My friends and I enjoyed our stay here. It was clean and true to the photos. The 4 bedrooms were plenty big, and we really enjoyed the large and comfortable couch in the living room for hanging out. Enrique was quick to reply and his instructions were clear. The neighborhood is small and quiet, although was kind of far from things to do. We did walk to a very good Italian cafe nearby but got rides everywhere else. There is also a very cute yard with a fire pit that we didn't really take advantage of but would be cute to spend time with kids or when the weather is nice. One thing to note is the bedrooms can be very bright in the morning, as there are blinds but no curtains, so bringing an eye mask may be helpful for anyone sensitive to light when sleeping. But overall, I would stay here again and would recommend for any groups staying in Chicago!
I loved the apartment. Quite easy to locate, looked exactly if not better than advertised. Clean and felt just like home. I enjoyed my stay.
A fantastic place to stay with a large group 😊

The hosts were excellent. Responsive, helpful, proactive and great to work with. The space was roomy with plenty of space for our large group. Tons of amenities, two big bathtubs and great showers. I should mention if you are travelling with children it can be very noisy on the weekend. It’s just a very busy street and there isn’t much to be done about that, so light sleepers beware. But you probably already know that if you know the neighorhood. Sound machines work great.
nice place, good spot for public transit :—)
Great place , walkable to certain places  host were amazing would definitely recommend to stay here if you’re coming to Chicago

Our stay at Pillowheads place was great. Looked just like photos. Great location. Allowed early check in. Very comfortable. Good local recommendations.
Only downside is weekend bar crowds on N Wells, but wasn’t much of a problem. Windows were good.
Very nice space, interesting and fun neighborhood. Lots to do. Loved the stay!
If you have a big crew of people that you’re traveling with. This is a great place to stay. Super nice and Chicago vibes. I loved it.

Dream Rentals was great and super accommodating and very responsive throughout the booking process, our stay, and even during checkout when we forgot something in the freezer. Super helpful and great to book with. Thanks so much! My family felt very well taken care of.

A few snafus: “All fees included” did not mean taxes so there was some back & forth about rate. The building & unit access codes were not provided within 72 hours of arrival as promised and then once they were, were changed. Found communication with Ben somewhat stressful. The property however was ideal for our group- convenient location near the train, buses, shops & grocery stores and very walkable. It was immaculate and the beds were a 10 for comfort and the kitchen met our needs.

This unit had really good value in terms of what I received for the price. Facilities were sufficient- no major complaints. Biggest perk of this unit is how close it is to lots of great things to do in uptown Chicago. Only minor issues were older linens (towels) and no ability to control temperature within unit. Otherwise, would highly recommend and would definitely stay again!
Roxanna was a lovely host and has a beautiful home. We felt very comfortable and had everything we needed. Roxanna left so many kind touches for us that were greatly appreciated.

The Airbnb was clean, well maintained & the aesthetics felt very updated. Nice.
Matthew anticipated all the information & details needed to make our stay seamless. Whenever I had a question, he responded immediately. I would definitely recommend staying at this Airbnb or any place Matthew manages.

We traveled to Chicago for our daughter's graduation.  Her apartment is close to the AirBnB.  We love the neighborhood.  It's close to the lake, and close to all the fun that Old Town has to offer.  We also walked to a couple of fabulous restaurants in Gold Coast.  Typically we don't have a car when we visit Chicago, but we did have one for this trip. The parking spot at Wendy and Matt's place was so helpful!  We had a minivan, which was a bit of a tight squeeze, but it worked!  And, if you're lucky, there is street parking too!  The house is beautiful!  My only regret is that we were too busy to enjoy the private deck off of the upstairs bathroom.  Next time........
Clean and good location, responsive host
Great value!

The place is great for a big group, and unlike some Airbnbs, this felt like a real home with character. Location is great in Hyde Park, and we would definitely return! Larry's responsiveness made us feel attended to as well, if any problem had arisen.

We had a wonderful stay at Patricia‘s Airbnb. It’s in a great location right by the Loyola campus and you can walk to the lake.   It is a quintessential Chicago apartment.  Make sure you use the stickers for Parking that Patricia provides. It allows you to park in the neighborhood. Parking can be a little tricky after 9 PM, but we are always able to find someplace.  We will definitely be back.
Lovely spot, convient location. Really comfy bed!!

We had a great stay here and would definitely book again! The beds were incredibly comfortable, and the views were absolutely amazing. The space was clean, cozy, and made our trip to Chicago even better.
The only downside was that the curtain in the master bedroom was broken when we arrived, so we weren’t able to put it up to enjoy the view from that window, also that room stayed pretty warm compared to the other rooms. Other than that, everything was wonderful and we really enjoyed our stay!
great location for our visit, responded to questions in a reasonable amount of time.
They were great host, any problem I had. They were quick to respond. Felt like home comfortable and quiet neighborhood.
Great place to stay , was super comfortable
Wonderful place beautifully done helpful and very compelling the best of the breed iChicago.

We had a great stay. The apartment was clean and well equipped with the essentials. It was nice to have a parking spot however it is a very tight spot. Regardless there is plenty of street parking available. Appreciate our host checking in to make sure our stay was going well. Definitely worth it!

The Views were amazing.  We sat in the dark each night and enjoyed the city lights.  We felt very safe in this neighborhood.  Many Dining options nearby and Target next door for grocery needs.   Stephanie was easy to communicate with and has a lovely home .  Beds were comfy but the views sold us on another return to Chicago.

The location just what I needed during my stay. Everything easy instructions. Only bit noisy from floor upstairs maybe with footsteps
Would be more perfect to have mirror in the bedroom as well considering just mirror in the bathroom
Otherwise very happy

Our first trip to Chicago was a success and a huge part of that was because of this cozy place we were able to stay in while visiting! Heather was very kind and responsive to any questions we had. Location was great. This truly felt like a home away from home, and I’m sure we will be back. Thanks again for having us!
Amazing place! Great view! And it’s the heart of all the bars and nearby activities

e davero un casa molto pulita  e  aloggio molto relaxante il host e davero gentile e puntuale e anche la ragaza dele pulizie e davero una dona gentile voglio solo dire che merita di prenotare questo aloggio pe avere il più grande relax
The place was close to the metro and walkable to a lot of good restaurants. Would recommend
Comfortable house with controlled access. Nice outdoor seating area. Close to concert hall and ice rink as well as many restaurants.
Our family had a great stay with Jhon.  The place was clean with lots of space for the 6 of us who were staying there.  The kitchen was very big and had everything we needed.

5 stars all across the board! Host was super friendly, responded swiftly and the apartment was very clean and comfortable. The bed is super comfortable and cozy, I did not want to get up! The only negative I had was something that isn’t the hosts fault. It’s that the building is old, walls are a bit thin and sometimes the floor makes noises when you walk on them. I’ll definitely stay in George Airbnb again. I love the Hyde Park neighborhood and there were amazing restaurants close by! Not to mention Target, Wholefoods and Akira are only a couple blocks away. The bus stop is very accessible plus the Metra train that  to other buses and CTA trains. All in all, even though the building is old I’d still stay here again

Great location, quiet neighborhood, easy walk to food stores, dry cleaners, etc.
Five minute walk to a beautiful beach that stretches for miles.

We checked in on Thursday night. On Friday, while we were at UIC graduation events, the city of Chicago turned off the gas to the house. Miguel was very responsive on Friday afternoon/evening, and seemed completely unaware of the sidewalk and curb replacement to be done on Damen, which ended up being two sides of the corner property. I don't believe the city would do that kind of work and not notify the home owner in advance. We were without hot water, heat, or cooking gas for the entire weekend. We had to have our car out of the way every morning by 6am.  Fortunately, the concrete dust and noise happened when we were away from the house. On Monday, we were trapped in the house while the city continued to work, making loading our car difficult. We had to wait for the equipment to move before exiting the house. We were offered only apologies and no other compensation. Not worth the cost to my family, but we will always remember graduation.
we loved our stay. what a great place with a great location.
I would stay here again in heartbeat! Super clean, great location and check in was seamless! Highly recommend

Andy’s place was just as described and looked just like the pictures.  Close to stores in a quiet neighborhood.  Street parking was easy to find.  May be my place of choice to stay when I’m in Chicago.

The location is extremely walkable and close to restaurants, bars, shops. The apt was as listed, easy to get into and had lots of amenities that a guest might need. Would highly recommend if you're going to be exploring Andersonville or the nearby neighborhoods. If you are a light sleeper or taller than 5'8"ish, you may find this apt uncomfortable. It's on a very busy, loud street and you can hear footsteps above. The apt is in a basement and the ceilings are low. I'm 5'4" and could easily touch the ceiling with my hand. Some areas are even lower due to ductwork and the showerhead felt low as well. Finally, there was construction being done on both corners of the sidewalk that made accessing the apt difficult. I'm sure it's temporary, but something to ask your host if you think it will be an issue for you. I understand the host cannot control these things, but I think wanted to note it so others who might be affected are aware. If none of the above are issues then I would recommend!
Great location that was close to the airport and easy access to downtown. The space was small, but worked good for three people that were out and about all day. Would definitely recommend!
This spot was super cute! Location is perfect and the host is super sweet and quick to respond!

Deceptive look when you walk in but once inside it opens up to a very large nice place. Very comfy, spacious, clean, home feeling environment. sherry was a wonderful host who responded quickly and helped with requests. Definitely recommend.
Great place central spacious and safe
Felt like home, very peaceful stay! Definitely coming back.
Todo salió como lo planeado.

We thoroughly enjoyed the apartment. I think that Maximo put a lot of thought and intention into the design of this place. I liked the bright colors and use of space. Details like the heated floors in the bathroom, backlighting at the headboards, and a guitar to play in the living room were appreciated by our family. The kitchen was good too. Comfortable beds. We like the neighborhood and found fun restaurants within walking distance. Thank you!
This place match everything in the description, but I experience loud walking noise at night from the room above us.

Emily has taken time to prepare the house and has a booklet that explains more than you would expect. We found a recommendation for a local jazz club (Rosa's) and had a great time. Neighborhood is clean, walkable, and safe. Will use this Airbnb again when visiting Chicago.
Nice stay for a great price! Convenient location and responsive hosts, would recommend!
Lovely place to stay while visiting the city for the weekend! Clean, cute, and close to a lot of things!
It’s a great experience. Everything’s excellent. I’ll stay here next time when I come Chicago again.
Nice clean place on first floor. Easy access.

The location was great & near the blue line. It had plenty of walkable options for shopping, coffee, and food.
The description feels inaccurate in it's details for the stairs leading up to the building and proximity of the train. The stairs are steep, rusty, and shake. The train is feet from the patio space. It can be heard clearly from most areas but isn't too loud when in the back bedroom.
Issues we had with the apt were the lack of towel hooks in the bathroom, no hooks in the shared space for coats/bags, and there was no closet in the back room and neither room had any shelving or dressers for storage so you couldn't unpack.
Overall it was tidy but dirty & dusty everywhere including a thick layer of dust on the ceiling fans. The chain for the bedroom fan was also missing and stuck on high. There were are no outlets near the top bunk. Wifi was unstable and kept disconnecting, we never got the AC to work, and the shared gate in the alley was left unlocked most nights.
The home was beautiful and in a great location. Hayk was nice and answered all of my questions promptly.

This was such a great place! My family and I really enjoyed staying here during our brief time in Chicago. airs located in a walkable area, close to public transit and surrounded by good food options.

Kerilyn provided a detailed list of recommended cafes and restaurants, and when I needed to make an unexpected change to my reservation, she was not only understanding but also provided additional amenities to help out. I would highly recommend staying in this lovely Logan apartment.
