There was always parking street parking and in the back as well which was closest to the entrance we needed to use. Nice bedrooms and beautiful decorations

Positives: Very spacious. Lots of natural light. Good location. Easy to walk to cool Chicago locations like the Chicago River, Old Town, etc. Host communicates promptly. Nice smart TV system. Well-stocked kitchen, except for glassware. Enough towels, TP, paper towels, dish soap, dishwasher pods provided. All kitchen appliances provided (coffee maker, toaster, microwave, dishwasher, etc.)
Negatives: All floors were dirty, even in the bathrooms. Pillows are lumpy and old. Most window shades were broken or non-existent. Furniture is worn down. Not enough glassware, but plenty of coffee mugs/plates/utensils. Shampoo/Conditioner/Soap provided, but cheap quality.
Caution: There is a train track just opposite the building/unit. This is something that does not bother me/my family, but it may be an issue for anyone looking for a quiet location.
Summary: Not luxurious, but spacious. Best if you are spending most of your time out and about. Improved cleanliness is a must.
stayed for a wedding and the property was very nice and as described. well maintenained and there were lots of amenities that were available. the host was very flexible and it was appreciated!
Loved our stay! The host was very friendly and responsive

Beautiful, stylish, clean, comfortable and luxurious. The views of the lake and Chicago skyline are absolutely amazing. The location of the building is very convenient with nearby restaurants, cafes, parking, transportation, attractions, etc. The extensive building amenities were above and beyond our expectations. The hosts (Cloud9) were very responsive and helpful. The concierge team members were also very helpful and courteous. Overall, an A+ experience. Highly recommend it.
A very cozy and great central location everything was within 15 min and near downtown.
Best host I have come across in my whole Airbnb experience. Felt just like home.

I needed a base of operations to spend a week exploring the city. This place delivered more than expected! Quiet and easy to work when I needed that. Excellent service by the red line, uber, and even line scooters and the divy bike rack one block away!
Justin was the best!! Super helpful seeing as my parents were staying not myself. Kind and understanding, clear instructions. All hiccups promptly resolved!

The building says no smoking as soon as you enter the building, you can smell smoke and it’s pungent. The water did not work. Hot water was nowhere to be found. The closet door will be walked in was off the closet the games that they had turned on and off was unable to play them, actually unable to lay in the bed because they had hair all in the bed, burner stains and on the sheets, and this is supposed to be a non-smoking unit when I was corresponding with them, they said that they needed us to go to sleep and stop responses and even the Airbnb people tried to contact them and they did not answer
We had a wonderful time! Great place to stay!

This location was perfect for a weekend in the city! Lots to do, and easily walkable. Our host was very responsive - and the listing was exactly as described. Very comfortable, and would definitely recommend!

Dave’s place was exactly what we needed! His home comfortably accommodated my family and I. It was Walkable to amazing restaurants and convenience stores - a bonus when traveling with a baby! Other people in the building always greeted you with a smile which was comforting. We would definitely book again!

Great location, very easy walkable area throughout Wigleyville and short walk to Lake View east. The place was clean with a nice open feel. Bathrooms are large with plenty of room to get ready in. The hosts were quick to respond with our questions. The only reason I would give 4 stars is there is a neighbor tenant who is very sensitive to noise, my brother is partially deaf and naturally talks loud and we did have a complaint the first night we were there, this made me a little anxious about making any noise. Other than that we enjoyed our stay.

The house was beautiful, spacious and in the best Location! Neighbors were very nice giving family vibes! Most important thing of all it is steps away from the train which is so affordable, we left our cars jumped on the train and didn’t have to worry about being stuck in traffic or parking while visiting China Town! Only about 15 minutes from the “Free Zoo” wish we had more time!
We can’t wait to visit again!

This property was great! We had 7 people and it was perfect! The hidden room is a really cool touch and the space was very clean and in a great location. The host - Caroline - was great aswell, very responsive and helpful!
This place was perfect! Teddy was so helpful and attentive. Definitely would like to book again the next time I visit!
loved it right in the middle of Chicago
Great location. Clean. Good communication with host. Five stars!

My family and I really enjoyed staying here. It is a peaceful and pleasant apartment. We all slept very well and were able to drive to our destinations in Chicago. I especially enjoyed the deep bath and the backdoor opening to a sunny garden. Also Hillary and Ed were very helpful when I needed a hand!

Darling apartment in a very well located building.  I will be happy to stay here every time I come to Chicago.  My daughter actually lives on the northside, but it's quick and easy to hop onto Lake Shore Drive and get to her in less time than it takes from other more "central" locations that are even a few blocks west.  The neighborhood is a nice mix of residential with restaurants, Whole Foods and Trader Joes within easy walking distance.  Target is walkable, but also very easy by car.  Loved our stay.
Overall the place was nice. The beds were not very comfortable, but if you are only staying for a few nights it’s manageable.
Beautiful unit and a great location with close proximity to many restaurants and entertainment spots.
We had a wonderful stay! The kitchen had everything we needed and sitting on the porch with the nice weather was a wonderful end of the evening

Had a great experience staying at Brad's Steel and Sky spot. He was extremely accommodating and very responsive to communications.
The place itself is incredibly unique. I lived in Chicago for the better part of 15 years, and I don't think I've really seen anything like it. It has great access to Humboldt Park, and is an easy stroll away from the offerings of Milwaukee Ave. The house was clean, things like lights were labelled for easy reference, and the house had almost anything you'd need or want for a stay-in night.
I would hands-down recommend a stay here. It's a great value for the space and is well-maintained by a great host.

The house and location are amazing. 20 min to either downtown or ORD. The basement game room was well setup and maintained. Parking easily for 3 big SUV’s. I would surely stay there again if I get a chance.

Came here for the weekend for my birthday and I had an amazing time the house was amazing and felt like home me and my buddy played a couple games of pool everything was clean and everything looks the same on the pictures I hope to be booking again
Beautiful place! Great location on a beautifully tree-lined street. Pleasant walk to the beach. We had a wonderful stay!
Great place to stay! Not too far from downtown and in a nice part of town.

Overall, very good. I previously stayed in the same room, so that should say a lot. I love the mini fridge, and I found the bed to be really comfortable. Small things like having good closet space and hangers were there too. The free ample street parking was fantastic, and because the Indiana border is 5 minutes away, things are generally less expensive nearby. Two minor downsides I’ll note that I’m sure the host would want prospective guests to be aware of: 1) the room can get hot as compared to the rest of the house. the house thermostat was at a very fair temperature, but there were a few days it was genuinely uncomfortable in the room. The host quickly offered a fan when notified. 2) Most days there were 1-2 other people in the house, but there were a couple nights where I came back to four separate cars outside. That’s a lot of people for one bathroom. Only one other guest was a bit obnoxious (really loud with doors, wouldn’t flush toilet, etc.) but that’s not the host’s fault.
The place was great and the hosts amazing.  Gabriel and Tina are great hosts and we would definitely stay there again when we travel to Chicago.
Awesome place and very nice host!
Well-located and comfortable.
Host is super responsive and helpful.  Nice place and very clean.  Beds are super comfortable!
Thanks for a great stay! It was perfect!
Nice apartment
The unit was as described and Sarah was very accommodating to us. We enjoyed our stay
Great location to enjoy the Logan Square neighborhood and the parking space included is an extra bonus!

Thank you for a wonderful stay. The place was very clean and accurately matched the pictures and descriptions provided. I felt really at home during my time there.
I also appreciated how responsive was the host. I highly recommend the place and will definitely consider staying here again in the future.

The Neighborhood apartment was spacious and had everything we needed and more. The location in Little Italy was perfect since we have family in that neighborhood and the nearest hotel is not very close. I would stay again.

We came to Chicago with the family to celebrate a graduation. We all had an amazing stay at Loft 8 on West North in Wicker Park. Pippa & Candice were fantastic host—super responsive. The space was spotless, inviting, and in a prime location. Perfect for walking & experiencing Chicago’s Wicker Park & surrounding neighborhoods.
Steven

Robert was incredibly responsive and helpful both before and during check‑in. We found the location easily, and the place was exactly as described. There were plenty of linens, towels, and kitchen amenities, which made our stay comfortable. Although this trip wasn’t for leisure, I’d note that the location offers a quick and easy drive to downtown Chicago if you’re visiting for fun. We would absolutely stay again. Thank you, Robert!

Had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Chicago. The apartment was on the 24th floor with floor-to-ceiling glass windows, and the view was absolutely incredible — especially at night. The place was very clean, modern, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was excellent and made it easy to enjoy the city, restaurants, and attractions nearby. The host was responsive, professional, and made the entire experience smooth from check-in to check-out. Overall, this felt like a luxury stay and I would definitely come back again. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago and looking for an amazing city view experience.

Nancy was amazing! We were in town for our son’s graduation ceremony and she even decorated the home for us. Super thoughtful and so appreciated. Great space with lots of room to spread out. Wonderful host who goes above and beyond!

Charming, spacious multi level home in a lovely neighborhood. A slight snafu on check-in with the keypad but the host had a solution immediately
We were impressed by the supply of towels and paper products which came in handy.
Very comfortable home, high ceilings and windows with natural light. Huge master space. Be prepared for lots of stairs! Wonderful place, easy stay, outstanding host

Condo was beautiful, impressive, clean, and exactly as pictured in photos.  The neighborhood was quiet and enjoyable.  Billy was friendly, provided us with plenty of clear instructions and updates, and was very responsive.  Street parking directly in front of the condo entrance was easily available.  We had a wonderful stay and would definitely book this condo again.  Billy was a great host and other properties he hosts will also be on our travel list.  Thanks for a great stay!
Nice apartment in a great neighbourhood. Very close to theatres/concert venues, restaurants, and transit.

Not too far from the loop and other places we visited in the city. Had one gated parking spot in backyard and street parking available. It's an upstairs apartment and the backyard is shared with the downstairs neighbors.

The hosts were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel right at home. Their flexibility and hospitality were truly appreciated. The place exudes a cozy, quirky, and delightful charm. The rooftop is a stunning feature, especially on a pleasant sunny day. I even took a nap there! The decor is captivating, with numerous intriguing elements to admire. It’s a fantastic spot, and my friends and I thoroughly enjoyed our time there.

The place was located in a beautiful neighborhood with walkable stores and fun places that were not far out. The place itself was extremely clean and had all the necessities we needed such as towels, shower products, and even toothbrushes. There was nothing I didn’t need because the place already had it besides food and clothes obviously. It was nice and peaceful and I would highly recommend it and if I come again I hope it’s this place.
Great
Very nice location.
Ericka was super kind and responsive will recommend stay to everyone!

Thomas's apartment was clean, comfy, and enough space for our group of four. Bathrooms were clean, beds were cozy, kitchen had utensils and bowls for us to use, and the pool and ping pong table were a nice touch to hang out in the living room. On a tree-lined street, less than five minute walk to the Blue Line subway, grocery store, ATM, restaurant, CVS, and bars. Good bus service and bike lanes too for getting in and out of the neighborhood.

Host was kind and responded quickly, which made the stay comfortable. The neighborhood was quiet and felt safe.     The home was very clean and well-kept. Parking was convenient. If you have a car, getting to downtown isn’t too far.
Very satisfying for our first time with air b and b

Loved this little place!! Clean, comfortable, super close to downtown easy to take the L on the pink line into downtown. We loved it for a three night stay!! if I come back to Chicago, we will absolutely be back
This place was perfect! Small but so cute it met every single one of our needs. Also loved the local recommendations!
They stay was amazing 10/10

Everything was nice and clean. Alle is a very good host and the communication was clear.
The ride with the train to Chicago takes about 15 minutes and the walk to the train 5 so that was easy for us

We honestly did not need one thing. Harry’s place was immaculate. One of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in thus far. Perfect for groups, quiet block, and a rare gem!!! I celebrated my birthday with a group of 6 and we felt right at home. Harry checked in every night to make sure we were comfortable. Wonderful host!
Excelente estadía gracias

I stayed at Deborah home I had a. very good pravicy its was quite area walking at neighborhood nice side walk lots of trees. I saw a 13 year old girl walking with her kitty cat he was following her well and crossed the road. it was my first time seeing a kitty following her owner. he was happy. its flat street great for running around the neighborhood. The bathroom was amazing very new. this place was great. Deborah was a great host. I definitely stay  there again.!!

Amazing property, not only was it better than expected but it exceeded all my expectations. I've stayed at multiple Airbnb's all around the country, this could be one of my favorites. It is a beautifully laid out loft with huge windows facing Milwaukee Avenue, exposed brick walls and lots of funky art. The kitchen had all the amenities we needed, and the bedroom was comfortable and relaxing.
Getting in and out of the property was easy and all we needed to do was walk downstairs and have access to all the amenities of Wicker Park. There were dozens of fantastic restaurants, bars, and plenty of things to do.
While we were staying in the loft, it was quiet and we felt at home. Perfect weekend getaway and can't wait to stay there again.

Everything about this stay was wonderful for me! I'm a Chicagoan who lives elsewhere and when I visit I love to have a space that's welcoming, near family and friends, and is close to transit and the expressway. This listing has all of that and Chelsea and Gillian are lovely hosts.
Bonus points because I always wanted to live in Beverly when I was a kid —with this listing I get to live out that dream in a beautifully done space. 😊
I will be booking again! 10/10.

Excellent place; I love waking up to a bakery next door!  The neighborhood has ample dining and is invitingly walkable.  Also, it's quite peaceful.  Wonderful kitchen, plenty of space throughout.  Great access to downtown.  Strongly recommended!

We are so glad that this place was a available for our trip! Such a good location, it's right off the Mag Mile. While you're there it feels like you have your own space, which was perfect for our group. Great communication throughout the stay. Would recommend!

Excelente estancia. Todo estuvo muy limpio, cómodo y exactamente como se describía. La comunicación fue muy buena y siempre estuvieron atentos. Disfrutamos mucho nuestra estancia y definitivamente volveríamos. ¡Muy recomendado!

Stayed here for a weekend with a friend and it was perfect. Felt like home because you can walk right into the building and get into the apartment with the door code like it’s your house! Beautiful space, great view, comfy couch & beds. Also super nice that there is a convenience store attached, and Lou Malnati’s 300ft away. Loved it!
High recommended great apartment in a great location. Easy free street parking and the apartment was clean and nicely decorated.
Great place, perfect location! We were very happy. I cannot overstate how good the location was!!!
J was awesome and helped out a lot with the questions and made the check in and check out feel easy, would recommend to friends and family wanting to visit Chicago

This was a great stay. I was only in town for one night so it was the perfect place to get some rest and wash up. Everything was quick and seamless. Paul communicated everything in a timely manner and was a great host. Would book again!

We had a great stay here. Was just right for 4 of us. Kitchen had plenty of equipment and nice big fridge.. beds very comfortable and was glad to be able to open the windows as I can’t stand Air Con. plenty of storage space and hanging area.. overall very comfortable and plenty of space . Nice hot water and fluffy towels. Thank you!!

We stayed at Geo’s place for a family celebration. We were 8 people and the apartment was spacious and comfortable for us. Plenty of room to gather or have privacy as needed. We felt right at home with the amenities. The neighborhood felt safe and walkable. We enjoyed the playground nearby and easy beach access. There is a convenience store for quick items needed and a bus stop on the corner to take us downtown. Also a turn about for ride share’s easy access. All in all a good value for the great accommodation and Geo was very responsive to any needs leading up to, through, and after check out. (Though we didn’t need much as all expectations were provided.) We will stay again if we are in town.
Very clean and spacious place for big families. Location was perfect near a lot of places to visit.
Dean's place was great! It was a little loud at times due to the location, but that's what you get for being in River North Chicago. The location was amazing and the place was very fun otherwise.
Could use a little updating but was comfortable & clean

Ryan’s place was great for 4 of us on a 4 day weekend away. The place was very clean and quiet and beds were very comfortable. Parking in the garage was a nice bonus! I’d definitely stay again. Logan Square is a fun area, lots of good restaurants and stuff going on. The heart of Logan Square, where most restaurants are is about 1 mile to 1.5 miles away- so plan on a 20-25 minute walk or short uber/Lyft ride to most things in the area. The blue line is always great to get downtown and was an easy 10 minute walk from the bnb. Thanks Ryan!

We had our previously booked airbnb cancel very last minute, and we were so so lucky to find Jennifer's place! It's surprisingly spacious for Chicago, an excellent location to walk to restaurants and shops, very clean, and comfortable. It was also perfect for my small dog. Highly recommend.
Beautiful place
Host Communicated well plus great Location. Home clean and neighborhood was peaceful definitely would recommend.

We were thrilled to find a place in this area - that was not an expensive hotel. This was our main driver, proximity to family. Additionally, coming from ORD we liked being able to get on just one train.
Yolie and team are very thorough in their communications and prompt in responsiveness.
We knew going in that two rooms would need to share a bathroom. We had hoped to have the two adjoining rooms share the master bathroom. What we discovered was this was not practical at all. It is not possible to determine from the existing photos but the sinks, the toilet, the shower (transparent glass door) all face each other without visual barriers - a major impediment to getting ready with multiple people at once.
We were also surprised and bummed to find only 4 sets of kitchen supplies not enough towels for 5 (although they corrected this later, not in time though). Dirty sheets, the EXTREMELY loud train on one side and wild street sounds (car alarms) on the other. I am sad to give 3 stars.

Good clean house, would definitely recommend 👌, just that it on 1 st floor and anyone who is handicapped or aged, will be difficult for them, other then that, great host, good location, safe neighborhood!
Amazing home and host . Will be back
The most cool Airbnb I ever stayed! Beautiful place, nice furniture, great location. Highly recommend :)
Very nice comfortable place to stay, excellent shower with heater!
Everything was great
Kristina's place was cozy and big enough to fit three adult guys. It being a basement apartment was a plus, lack of windows made sleeping in easy which was welcome after traveling.

Phoebe was very understanding of our need to change our arrival date and responded quickly to our request. The space was just as described and was clean and functional. Free street parking is a total plus. As she states in the listing, the street is very busy and can be noisy but it was not an issue for us. Restaurants, coffee and shopping less than a mile walk. We do suggest that extra blankets be made available, we couldn't find any. There were plenty of towels which was appreciated. Also, there were only 2 forks. We made dinner one night and thankfully had picked up some plastic forks at lunch.  The Keurig was much appreciated for our mornings :) All in all, we would stay here again!

The basement apartment was just what we needed: a tastefully appointed and comfortable residence in a quiet neighborhood centrally located for our visit in Chicago. Jon met us upon arrival and showed us how everything worked. The space was perfect for us (two adults and our pooch), and equipped with all possible conveniences. Within walking distance are lovely parks, shops, restaurants, and a farmer's market. A note to dog owners about the back yard: while it is fenced, it is tiny and entirely covered by a deck, so not suitable for potty breaks - but the nearby parks are great for dog walks. We appreciated Jon's flexibility with our departure time; he was always responsive to our questions and quick to accommodate any requests.

Angie’s place is wonderful. It was easy to find, the check in instructions were clear, we had no problem finding on street parking right across the street. The area is great, less than 10 minutes walk to the Damen Ventra station on the Pink Line, which provides easy access to downtown Chicago (about a 20 minute ride to the Art Institute and the Chicago Symphony on Michigan Avenue). There is a great coffee shop - Foxglove Coffee - at the corner of South Hoyne and West 21st, and a great Mexican restaurant - El Costeno - right across the street from the Damen Ventra station on Damen Avenue.
The apartment was spotless, with a full kitchen, very comfortable mattresses and pillows, great towels. Angie left a few snacks and bottles of water for us, and communicating with her was very easy and prompt. We had a great time, Angie’s place is highly recommended.

Our stay was very enjoyable! We were not far from the things that we wanted to see. The neighborhood was nice, the house was clean, private, and we felt comfortable there. The parking situation was great, we really enjoyed having our own parking spot, so that we didn’t have to worry about finding parking spots or paying for parking. The host was very responsive and good to work with.

Buen lugar para quedarte, igual que las fotos. Perfecta zona, fácil moverte por la ciudad. Creo que me volvería a quedar ahí. Solo cuidar la limpieza y olores de las cobijas y toallas.  Pero todo perfecto. Recomendado 100%
Nichole is a great host.  She responded quickly and addressed any questions or issues we had.

Great host and great spot! Maria was  responsive and very helpful, greatly appreciate the flexibility with check-in and check out times! Spacious rooms and plenty of couches, clean bathrooms, and comfortable beds!

We chose this spot for location and it did not disappoint. If you are trying to get to downtown but not be IN downtown, this is it. The lake is right there to run and walk along, and the zoo is so nice! The hosts were extremely responsive. Probably the best communication on AirBnb I've experienced. Just important things to note - The toilet is in an awkward location to the sink. We were totally fine, but something to consider if you are older or larger-bodied. There is no iron or steamer inside the airBnb. There are restrictions with iron use in the building. You can use a dry cleaner across the street and the host was very responsive to help obtain this, but this is little downside for travelers going to events.
Very helpful while checking in, we had came after 12 am and they still answered and made sure we were all set. :)
Absolutely beautiful home! Highly recommend if you don't mind the shared bathroom and kitchen space! The location is great, its a nice area and only a few minute walk to the train to down town!
Great!

This place has everything we needed. The location is only a few minutes’ walk from Michigan Avenue, the heart of Chicago shopping. The apartment also has a kitchen stocked with all the essential cookware and supplies. Everything was very clean and well maintained. I highly recommend Clemente’s place for anyone visiting Chicago.

Excelente alojamiento,
cerca de estación Cermak (línea verde y roja) que son excelentes opciones para desplazarte hacia y desde el loop, que era nuestro motivo de viaje

This is one of the nicest BnBs I have ever stayed in. Not only is it super cozy and quiet, the host is sweet enough to have coffee and treats available for free!! Also located in an amazing part of the north side. 100% recommend!!

This AirBnB is very spacious! Stayed with three adults and a toddler and we had room to stretch out. It’s also located in a great neighborhood. We spent most of our time in Wrigleyville, but it was also close enough to the Lakerfront Trail that I could jog there pretty easily.
The hosts were very accommodating and allowed us to check-in early as we had time in between our hotel stay and AirBnB stay. Was very much appreciated!
The place was also very clean. We all felt comfortable. Would stay here again!
This is our second time staying at this apartment and we would book it every time we come to Chicago! John and Kyrsten are very communicative and the location can’t be beat!
Beautiful, spacious, and clean home with great hosts! The neighborhood was very quiet, peaceful, and lovely to walk around in while not being too far from downtown Chicago.

Perfectly located in the heart of Wrigleyville! Highly recommend booking this beautiful place. Our party of 8 had plenty of space. Despite being so close to Wrigley it was a great neighborhood (safe & quiet at night). The cleanliness, decor, beds & bathrooms were all great. The 2 car garage was a bonus but street parking was also available. One tip (especially for the ladies) - if multiple people are getting ready at the same time there is only 1 bathroom downstairs so bring a makeup mirror with you so you can get ready in your room! Easy check in and Brandon was very responsive. I would definitely stay here again.

Ian was a great host. His place was well appointed and had everything we needed including late night snacks for my husband after a long plane ride.
The living area with the sectional and large tv made for a comfortable place to return to after a long day of sightseeing . This area was close to where our daughter lives so worked well for us. It is very quiet and hard to believe one is actually in the city of Chicago. We will be returning when we next need a place to stay. Thanks for a great stay, Ian!
Perfect for our stay!
Great place, easy to get to transportation but so close to many restaurants and shops. The Airbnb was cozy and clean with easy check in and check out.

We had another amazing stay in my favorite neighborhood in the city, Bronzeville. All of our favorite eateries within minutes. As for the property, it was as described. This group pays close attention to detail. We were welcomed with amenities for our infant. Quiet neighborhood, we went for walks and jogs through the neighborhood and onto MLK. We also received a complimentary late checkout (without asking) for Mother’s Day. Very thoughtful. We will definitely look for this property again on our next stay. 5 stars across the board.

Really loved staying in this place, worked great for our group of 5 guys. The West Loop is a great place to stay in Chicago and I definitely would come back. The unit was clean and served us well. We enjoyed hanging out in the living room and would come back here again.
Nicely decorated comfortable space that worked well for our plans. Parking was easy to find. Thanks Cory!

Great place to stay! Easy drive to downtown Chicago. Quiet neighborhood with no problems. Parking on street was usually available and was easy to find. Plenty of room for 6 adults to share yet not feel crowded. Well stocked with everything we needed! Plenty of towels, linens, toilet paper, paper towels, etc. Well appointed kitchen with everything needed to make meals there including coffee. They even had laundry detergent and dryer sheets available. Nice backyard where you could sit outside. Daniel and Carrie provided clear instructions to get in and were responsive to any questions we had. Overall it was a fantastic place to stay and we would definitely book again if we are ever back in the Chicago area.

Lovely stay and very responsive if we had any questions. The dishwasher and washer had issues and didn’t work but we didn’t really need them. The only issue was the floors being so dirty it turned all of our socks black. But they answered all our questions and everything efficiently. Overall a good stay, but attention to detail would make it great for the next guest! :)
Perfect for our stay in Lakeview visiting our daughter! Short walk to Southport shops and restaurants.

Beautiful place and great location. Nice to have the fitness room and parking included. There was conflicting directions on how or whether to use parking pass, but it all worked out. Use of a 3rd party background check was communicated but felt uncomfortable with concerns about personal privacy and use of personal data. I have since gotten ads from the owner, which appears to be a management company, which is odd. But overall a really great place, especially for visiting Loyola University .
Super clean and comfy

We had a great experience at this place! It is located in a cute neighborhood. We discovered locally owned restaurants that were walkable distance. The Columbian Restaurant was such an experience! the gardens out back are beautiful. Dean was quick to respond even later in the evening! We were able to park in the garage without issue which was so nice. This place is spotless, modern, comfy bed and pillows and super easy to walk or drive around!
Thank you! We loved Chicago!

Great stay while in CHI…clean and a great location for what we were in town to do
Highly recommend this townhome

The neighborhood is great, which is a plus. We booked this unit knowing that we didn’t require anything fancy and only needed a place to sleep and shower while in town visiting friends a few blocks away.
Thomas was a responsive host and quickly addressed an issue with our bedding upon arrival, which we appreciated. That said, the unit could benefit from some proactive maintenance and a refresh of its basics like sheets
Some of the provided snacks (a thoughtful amenity) were open when we arrived as were foods left in the freezer from a previous guest.
Convenient location.  Met all of our needs.
Es muy mala la atención, el trato y el espacio. No lo recomiendo en lo absoluto.
Samuel was an excellent host. His place was immaculate, and well appointed. It’s in a great neighborhood with several excellent restaurants and cafés. Highly recommended.
Andreea and Shaun were very kind, communicative, and fantastic hosts! The accommodations were clean and well kept and we felt right at home. We highly recommend this Airbnb!
Great location!!! Be cautious on the if you have deliveries. Had some food spoil. But everything else was great! Maybe just more than one key would be my suggestion.
Great spot, everything as advertised, comfortable beds and great water pressure/temperature in showers, rooftop space was awesome. Worked great for our group of 6 guys in Chicago for a weekend.

Brad’s place was the perfect spot for a weekend in Chicago. Super easy to get to, parking right in front of the building. Check in and out couldn’t be easier. The apartment is on the third floor,m and the stairs are a hike but doable. Loved the coffee shop and park just the road.

Place was nice, but not as “elegant” as it was made out to be. The front door window was covered with painters tape and notebook paper. Rooms were okay, kind of small, but fit the description of the listing. Located in a busy area, so there was more noise than expected, but that wasn’t a big deal. It is a short walk away from lots of shopping and food options, so that was a huge plus.

The apartment was very nice and clean. There was an issue with parking pass and Nathan responded promptly. It’s definitely noisy. Lots of emergency vehicles and what seemed to be drag racing on the streets below! Hard to sleep soundly. Bring earplugs and an eye mask  and that should help as the beds are very cozy and comfortable.
Excellent place in an excellent location. We would be happy to stay here again!
great place. Very clean too

The pros of this place are the location, size, & responsiveness of the host. However, there were several major issues during our stay. There was a strong kitty litter/poop smell coming from the bedroom closet/walls that seriously affected our sleep & overall experience. We tried airing out the room & using sprays, but nothing worked. When we informed the host, they insisted on sending a plumber even though we clearly explained the smell was not coming from the bathroom. Air purifiers were eventually provided upon request, but the first had a clogged filter, so it took another day to get one that actually worked. Bathroom towels were not properly cleaned, with one smelling strongly of body odor. Kitchen utensils & the fridge were dirty, including an open sandwich left by previous guests. There were also maintenance issues: a bedroom window nearly fell out when closed, a broken closet door cluttered with AC units & sheets, & a broken kitchen light that left the space very dark.

I’ve stayed in 30+ airbnbs across 12 countries. This one may be the worst.
Justin seemed like a nice guy so it’s hard to leave such a negative review. But this place was a profound disappointment. One word captures my experience of this unit: grimy. I reached out to Justin after booking to let him know my father in law is a hypochondriac. He agreed to give the place extra attention but it will still disgusting. Think hair in the sheets, dirty bathrooms, and a unit that is overall in unbelievably poor condition. One bedroom is in a closet and the other is in a freezing, damp basement. Everyone in our party had allergy symptoms.
Also, Chicago guest parking passes are $1 per pass. So Justin is just making $19 in profit off those transactions.
The one pro: the location.
My encouragement to Justin is to give up his Airbnb host aspirations and rent out to long term tenants. Or hire a property manager with attention to detail.

Sean's place was excellent! I was able to take my business calls from the room and easily explore the surrounding area on foot/train. The room itself was well equipped and comfortable for a solo traveller.

Amazing place if youre looking to stay close to the united center. Everything was clean, good parking. We’re definitely not from the chicago area, so staying on the third floor and using a lot of stairs was definitely a bit tiring. I would definitely come back again though.

Great place. Would stay again.

Easy stay at Kirsten's for work travel with a coworker, and very close to McCormick Place by car. Instructions for check-in were easy to follow. Good price, would recommend!

Great stay! Getting 3 bedrooms in that location for that price is an incredible value.

The good: This apartment has a fabulous view of the lake & fountain. It’s very close to the art institute and all the downtown sights. And the price is probably on the lower end of places downtown.

For people who are going to Cubs games, the location is perfect!  Walking distance to the games as well as lots of restaurants and bars.  The apartment is as listed. Great location!!!! And a beautiful home. Would stay again.

The apartment was neat and clean. It is close to eateries and other amenities.

Honestly, one of the best places I’ve ever stayed at. The location was in a great area. Everything was close to the home. The home itself is so clean, especially the floors. The amenities were great and the home was beautifully decorated one of my most favorite features was actually the couch in the living room. It is the most comfortable couch I have ever been on in my entire life. I cannot stress this enough. I actually need to find out where they purchased the couch.

This place was as advertised. Clean, modern, with great views overlooking  Logan Square. Overall, I had a good stay at Simon’s place. It was a great location, right off the freeway but quiet and still walkable to Bucktown. The kitchen was wonderfully stocked with fruits and beverages, and the bathroom was clean and the water pressure was excellent. That said, there are a few improvements that could really make this place shine. I was only provided a fitted sheet over the mattress and a comforter, plus the lumpy pillows didn’t make for a great night’s sleep. It was also a bit cumbersome carrying around a set of four keys (two of which I never used) instead of having a key code or something that didn’t weigh half a pound. Great host, clean place, and location accessible from public transport

The place is very convenient for walking to the convention center. The apartment is very nicely furnished and very clean, the only negatives were the kitchen is very sparse and the walls are a bit thin.

I will definitely stay here again next time I'm in Chicago!!

The apartment itself was fantastic, ample space, beautiful interior design, and an unbeatable location. Greg's place was great. The location was fantastic, the room was cozy, and Greg as a host was super kind and friendly.

I came to Chicago for a meeting at the McCormick place. It is just a short stroll from Milan’s place. The apartment was clean and had everything I needed for my stay. I had a great time staying at Adelina’s Airbnb. I was in town for contract work for around 3 months and I am incredible grateful to have found this listing. The host was extremely responsive and helpful for any questions I had. The host also supplied many amenities related to pots, pans, coffee supplies, a tea kettle, and more. She was also very flexible with the scheduling for arrival/departure. I felt right at home- it was perfect for one person, but surely the place could accommodate 1 or 2 more people. The only thing to note is that since the unit is above a bar, it can get quite noisy sometimes. I found no issue with it overall, as noise doesn’t bother me too much. If you are noise sensitive, I would probably look at different options, but Adelina does provide earplugs so the host is very proactive. The area also had many options for grocery stores and restaurants, plus it was right by the brown line! I hope to stay here again someday. Thank you so much for the amazing stay!!

Fantastic location walkable to Wrigley. great bars around there and for the price, this spot is. hard to beat. Very clear instructions from the host with bag drop options available if you need it. Would for sure book again when i return to this area

Absolutely loved our stay here! In a beautiful location - 8min walk from the blue line and walking distance to lots of cool restaurants, bars, and coffee shops. I would be happy to stay in this place whenever I come back to Chicago!
I highly recommend this accommodation!
I had a good time at Zhi's place! Area was very easy to get around the neighborhood and the rest of the city in general.
Amazing location just a six minute walk to the train station! Super cozy feel and safe quiet neighborhood. Overall recommend staying here for a great time in Chicago!
Safe location , very clean place to stay . Free parking at front of the apartment which is rare and nice for Chicago. I’ll recommend. Doni is nice guy .

The other complaint, and it’s really very small, is that the duvet cover was not properly on the duvet, so I had to fix it after a night at the bar before I could go to sleep. A big highlight for me was the shower—great water pressure and a very wide shower head. There is a well-stocked market right outside, so if you’re planning to cook, that will work out well for you. Also only a short walk from Lincoln Square, which has some awesome restaurants and shops.

Great place to stay! The location is very convenient, and the neighborhood is friendly and quiet, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, and grocery stores nearby. The room was clean and nicely decorated. The only issue was that the door lock was difficult to open, probably because it’s old. But overall, a great experience!

This Airbnb is an excellent option in Chicago. The place is exactly as shown in the app photos—clean, well-maintained, and very comfortable. David, the host, is incredibly kind and attentive, always making sure you have everything you need and taking care of every detail. Despite being close to the metro and having a restaurant downstairs, there is no noticeable noise, and you can rest without any issues. I would definitely stay here again without hesitation on another trip to Chicago. Highly recommended.

Stayed with my husband and our little 2 year old son. The place was perfect, big enough space for the 3 of us to hangout during naps or down time. nice neighborhood. bar downstairs can be a bit noisy on the weekends but doesn’t really bother me. would have liked some window curtains for more privacy but overall very cute spot. would book again.

Nicola was a great host. The place was easy to find, and even though it is a basement is was very quiet. It was clean when I arrived and Nicola kindly provided snacks and water for me. The location is a short walk from the blue line and it was easy to get around. Thanks Nicola!

The home was super clean with great amenities, check in instructions were helpful and clear, and the neighborhood was quiet and felt very safe.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the home exceeded our expectations!
This was the perfect spot and was like home away from home for us. Karina and Brian were very friendly and super responsive. We will definitely be coming back!

Chiaka is the best host: flexible, nice and very reactive. The apartment is spacious and comfortable, close to the buses taking you to town and to the university campus. I highly recommend this place.

I would highly recommend this listing and happily stay there again. It was exactly what was promised, with a great location and plenty of space. It was clean and quiet. Shanna place was very good place. It is located in an area I enjoy. The place was nice comfortable place. I will go back again if the dates match up. Thank you for a very nice place to stay for a few days.

BnB is managed by a rental company, so keep that in mind…Messages are automated and there are charges for additional asks (ex: early check in). Lacking personable factor. Also received auto-messages about keeping noise down but neighbors were very loud much later than the noted quiet hours (fine with us, but heads up).
Overall location is awesome. 10 min walk to train, 40 mins to city, lots of stuff nearby. Some tweaks and it could be great.

The location is extremely convenient with respect to proximity to public transit (metro, buses) and the convention center. The neighborhood itself is not somewhere to stay around. However, the proximity to public transit is a great spot from where to explore Chicago.

I had a wonderful stay at Leslie’s Airbnb. It is a charming place located in a lovely part of Chicago. Leslie is a great host and makes you feel right at home. I would recommend her place to anyone who wants a place to stay in Chicago!

The home was beautifully decorated and had everything we needed for a great stay. Having two bathrooms was a huge convenience, especially when getting ready to head out for dinner. Wild. Don’t do it.

Beautiful view overlooking the south loop area. Great location between downtown  and McCormick Place. The amenities were excellent. Walkable area, including only a half mile to the field museum.

Wonderful neighborhood. Host thought of extra details. Was available to communicate with, during stay. Space very comfortable for 2 people. Check in and departure were easy. Hope to come back!

The place we were going to stay at canceled on us at the last minute, so we were very thankful that this place was available. The beds are very comfortable even though they don’t look like they are. The reason I gave four stars is because the suggestions made in older reviews were never addressed. The main concern is that there is an odd musty smell in the front room when you enter the unit. Finally, there was only one towel per person.
Thank you for the nice stay.
Great, clean unit in a convenient central location. Would stay again.

Abe’s place was one of the best places we’ve stayed, thanks to his incredible hospitality as a host. He went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. Overall, the place was amazing, and we truly enjoyed ourselves. We would absolutely stay again and highly recommend Abe’s place anytime.

It's the perfect place to be!  Lovely home, walkable, everything was perfect inside.  Really enjoyed being there, enjoyed the home and enjoyed the location.   Steve was always informative and responsive.  It couldn't have been nicer or easier to have a wonderful experience.

Perfect location and has everything you’d need including an iron and iron board, dishes, and water bottles. Overall, would recommend staying here for conferences especially if you’re small!

The house is located in a peaceful surroundings. Close to a few bus line. Inside is clean and tidy, well equipped and with lots of sunlight. Host is friendly. We have a very relaxed and pleasant stay here.

Perfect location away from hustle and bustle of downtown Chicago but still very close to everything and within walking distance. Lots of great restaurants nearby. Loved the views from the unit and the rooftop terrace. Incredible amenities and easily accessible. Place was clean and as advertised. Stephanie was a great host and very responsive and accommodating - thank you! Would highly recommend rather than hotel.

First off, this place was an incredibly good deal.  So expectations should match the price; this is not a Hyatt.   The room (#1) is quite small, with doubl ebed taking up 2/3 of the space. What's the appeal?  It's 5 min walk to Chinatown and all the restaurants.  15 min walk to McCormick Place convention center.  CTA is about 12 min walk.    My only complaint was probably a miscommunication the host had with the cleaning staff.  I was already checked in my room (which the host kindly let me drop my things off early). Should not have touched my stuff but should have clarified with host.

Muy buen espacio para compartir en familia. Realmente nos sentimos muy a gusto de llegar a nuestra “casita” luego de un largo día de paseo y caminatas. Muy acogedor y cómodo. Los anfitriones estuvieron siempre al pendiente.

1- they provided an air mattress which is perfect for my 4 & 5 year old boys. The queen size and sofa bed is a bit high & I’m always scared of the boys falling off bed. So having an air mattress was perfect. I can sleep at ease knowing they are safe as well.
2- plastic bowls/plates are great for kids. I’m not worry of them breaking things.
3-this Airbnb provide fan & heater which we used.
4-the only thing it don’t have is a stove but they have oven toaster & microwave which is doable since I’m staying for 2 nights, it didn’t bother me.
5- the welcome basket filled with snacks after a long flight was much appreciated! My kids ate all of them haha
Overall, I have a great experienced with my family & highly recommend this place!

This was a great place to stay on our visit. It is well stocked and the we appreciated the attention to detail with item and/or amenities in the house.
We enjoyed our time and the peaceful space.

We had an amazing stay here at Emrah’s place! We picked it mainly for the location. We had a concert at the Salt Shed which was very walkable from this place.  All the amenities were very nice and everything was  spotless. Also the communication was very responsive and helpful. Would stay again!
could’ve been way better, the area was nice that’s about it

I loved staying here. Hosts were responsive, gave me space while also checking in. Their dog was precious, a sweet and chill cohost. I felt safe staying here as a woman by myself. The neighborhood is fantastic and has great restaurants, things to do, and a grocery store. Gotta come back here!

Am a place was as described - conveniently located between Fullerton and diversy has easy access to red brown and purple lines in addition to multiple restaurants within walking distance.
Great for a group.

We loved Steve's place.  It was incredibly clean and free of clutter.  Two characteristics I love in a place.  Plus, it was so close to all the stores on Clark Street in Andersonville while being tucked away on a quiet street.  Only 1.2 miles from Lake Michigan and 3/4 mile to the El.  I would absolutely recommend and hope to stay there again.
Sue was a great host! Responsive and hospitable and we had a couple great conversations in the kitchen. Thanks again for making this part of my trip so effortless.
Sergio was a great host during our stay in Chicago. The apartment was easy to find, a short drive to downtown and very modern.
It was a nice stay, location was safe and quiet. My only complaint is that the bathroom is located through one of the bedrooms and it can be difficult if you’re staying with a group of people.
Very nice and clean. Communication was good.
Good, solid place to stay in Chicago. Quiet and clean. (The AC doesnt turn on until a certain date, so I'd check it is operating if you want AC).
Such an amazing apartment and that neighborhood is likely the city’s greatest secret. I will definitely stay there again when I go back.

Our stay was great, and Josh was very helpful with his communication before and during our stay. Instructions were clear and the space was exactly as described. The location is great with easy access to restaurants and public transportation. The game room in the basement was amazing, I only wish we spent more time inside enjoying it!
We really enjoyed our 3 night stay visiting family in the area. Felt at home with modern furnishings and very clean apartment.

Jason hosted my tenants during an emergency bathroom rehab in this beautiful Chicago apartment. The space was perfect, and accommodated two adults and their dog, making them feel right at home during a stressful time.
Great stay! No complaints!

Dimitri’s place is in the great location of Andersonville, with lots to do nearby. I didn’t spend much time in the apartment but found that it was suitable for what I needed. Dimitri was quick to respond and helpful when I ran into a small issue. The upstairs neighbor was also very helpful in directing me to the correct parking spot
Close to a fantastic park and easily accessible to public transit!
Kimberlie es muy atenta con los huéspedes. El espacio estaba muy limpio y organizado, me volvería a hospedar sin duda.
Tracy was very helpful and nice.  Location is very convenient to beach and public transportation.  Space was clean and comfortable.  May book again and recommend to others
Exactly as described. Perfect if you need a room near U of Chicago. Plenty of free street parking. Quiet, comfortable, affordable. I'd stay again next time i need to be on campus!
Comfortable stay and conveniently located near restaurants and bars, also crazy to close to the train. 10/10 would stay again

Mara was an attentive and helpful host. She provided clear instructions with pictures which helped us enter the property and find parking. The property was clean and provided a great place to stay just outside of Downtown.

David’s place is exactly what we needed and in a great location. Just a few steps from the train and within walking distance to Fulton Market. The apartment was stocked with plenty of towels and anything needed in the kitchen. David even provided a few snacks and the coffee selection was amazing. Communication as easy and reply was quick. We had no issues at all. Thank you David for a great stay!
Shay’s place was amazing. All of the amenities were extremely useful and it was a prime location! Very accessible to everything! The place away also extremely clean!

This location is very close to Chinatown with much to do and see. Host is friendly and place is very clean!
Stairs inside to get up to room are fairly steep.
A public transit line is right outside the window which is fairly loud every time it passes.

The place was perfect for us!
Very quiet given how busy the street was. Only issue with quiet was the neighbors dog on the back side-yapped a lot bit that would not be Carmen’s fault!
Very clean, had what we needed to prepare dinner there and was spacious for 5 adults.

Extremely spacious and clean! As a girly girl I was disappointed that there was no full length mirror but that wasn’t even their fault it was apparently broken by a previous guest. I will definitely stay here again. Just as a suggestion I believe there should be more large towels there were only 4 towels for my 5 guest and and we needed to use one of those for the floor in bathroom for after showering. Luckily there was detergent, washer and dryer to wash towels so that’s just what we had to do which was fine. Troy was responsive and kind and check in was a breeze. Lastly 2 of the chairs in the dining room were broken which could’ve been dangerous had we not noticed beforehand.
Jon communicated with me and was flexible and accommodating. A good location, comfortable for my visits to see my grandson! Also, nice and warm!

It is a beautiful apartment with very nice facilities. We enjoyed the place and location. The only issue is with the iron gate used to access the property. Apparently is out of alignment and requires a lot of force to be able to open it.
Tim has a beautiful house.  The room was nice and comfortable.  It is also very convenient that the host provided a pass for parking on the street.  Overall, an excellent stay; highly recommended.

Check in was easy. Host was very responsive to a couple small issues during our week stay.
Good location with many reasonably priced restaurants serving a variety of styles.
Cleaning crew needs a little quality control. Quite a few dishes were not clean and had to rewash before use.
We had a great weekend staying in Chicago!  The place fit our needs perfectly.

We had a great stay here. The location is hard to beat—super close to venues, restaurants, and bars, which made it easy to explore the city. The beds were really comfortable, and the big open kitchen/dining area was perfect for hanging out and socializing as a group.
Coty was an excellent host—very communicative, accommodating, and helpful throughout. He made sure we had everything we needed and was very responsive and friendly.
This is the perfect spot if you’re planning to spend most of your time out enjoying the city but want a clean, comfortable place to come back to. Absolutely great for our group of 5.
Everyone was extremely helpful if we had questions or anything we were able to message and got responses right away, and any problems were solved extremely quick. 10 out of 10 would stay again.
A truly A+ walkable location. Big open spaces inside and a retro vintage energy that made us feel like we were staying at a friend’s aunts house. Would recommend for sure.

This was a great option for a group of 8 people for a long weekend. All of the beds were comfortable. The bathrooms were clean. The kitchen was well stocked. You do have to walk up a flight of stairs to get to the apartment so keep that in mind if you have a lot of luggage. Overall we enjoyed our stay.
Ragan was kind, very responsive and communicative! would love her to host us again ☺️

Ryan is a great proactive host. The house is great and close to the subway. The area is safe and quiet. The only negative aspect if that you have to anticipate if you arrive late in the neighborhood ad I did since there are barely any shops in the area that stay open late at night.
Beautiful and clean house. Made our trip to Chicago a lot more peaceful and relaxed.
Great location. Great Host. Clean facilities. Great public transit nearby.
Very proactive and responsive hosts! So close to McCormick Place!
Great location especially if you’re seeing friends/here for an event on the North Side. Easy to access building, very clean and chill!

Thank you for the wonderful stay! The apartment was as pictured. Everything you could possibly need was there! Very clean very spacious
Bedroom was comfy, lots of storage if you’re there for the long haul and TV
There were other travelers in the place and everyone was very respectful.
The neighborhood was close to public transportation and was still very quiet and peaceful!
Hosts were VERY attentive and proactive with anything that came up! Couldn’t ask for anything better! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Good place to stay. Easy check-in

Myself and 3 friends came to Chicago for a concert, The Airbnb was nice, there were some hiccups when we arrived such as dirty towels, no wash cloths, no trash bags, paper towels and there were ants EVERYWHERE. Karina was super responsive and fast when providing the things that weren’t available as well as extending check out due to the inconvenience. And a bottle of wine. I think maybe a new cleaning team would be beneficial. Overall, space was as described. The biggest annoyance were the ants!

Mera was a great host; she responded quickly and supported us in trouble shooting a few things (attempting to get the ceiling fan working, getting the appropriate amount of towels, gaining access to the laundry room in the building). The train and radiator noise are real and significantly impacted our time in the Airbnb. The building is RIGHT next to the brown, red and purple lines and the unit is the garden unit right under the track. At points I counted 20+ trains per hour. The volume of trains significantly decreases overnight; with the bathroom and bedroom door shut AND noise canceling headphones in we were able to sleep. When the train goes by you need to stop conversation and cant hear the TV. It only takes a few seconds, but it cannot be ignored and depending on time of day it was frequent. When the radiator was hissing and I was unable to watch TV in the living room. The building is old, the unit is old - it was clean.

We had an overall pleasant stay. The space itself is nice and comfortable, with a layout that works well for groups. However, there are a few important things future guests should be aware of.
There is an upstairs neighbor (on the third floor), and noise carries quite easily throughout the unit. Music was played at varying volumes and times during the week, and it could be clearly heard on both the first and second floors. If you are sensitive to noise or traveling with small children, this may be something to consider.
Additionally, the bathrooms could use more thorough cleaning. The showers appeared to have only been spot-cleaned, with noticeable red/pink spots present. In the master bathroom, the shower leaks significantly, leaving a pool of water on the floor and soaking the bathmat after use. The showerhead is also fixed in a position that doesn’t angle downward, which makes the already small shower feel even more restrictive.
Mejorar la limpieza del baño
Our stay at Caroline and Rey's place was great! It was clean and in a great location. We would stay there again!

This place was perfect for our group of 4 and was bigger than expected. We enjoyed the outdoor space in both the front and back of the apt. The location can't be beat right in the heart of boystown - we were able to walk to all the bars and restaurants and to Lincoln Park. Apartment itself is comfortable and clean but no frills. Would stay here again.
Alma was an incredible host! She was so kind and friendly and supportive. Her home is absolutely beautiful. I couldn't have asked for a better place to have stayed.
Comfortable, excellent location!
Great location for public transportation, streets aren’t very busy at night. Spacious home, would recommend!
Great stay and value! Very walkable to great restaurants and cafe. Holly was a good communicator and super helpful.

Host was very responsive and easy to work with. The apartment was clean and we appreciated that tooth brushes and tooth paste were provided. It is a very active and loud area so there was a lot of noise at night.
We had an excellent stay. Peter was very communicative and the instructions were clear. The place is very well care for. Definitely would come back.

This location was perfect for us, we were in town for cubs series. We stayed 4 nights and this Airbnb had everything we needed in kitchen, laundry, and bedrooms.
As much as I’d love to leave 5 stars we did come across a few issues: one of the closets had mold on the wall, but luckily we found some spray in the closet that we used to help mask the issue. Then there were the ants, both bedrooms had them one specifically had hundreds along the wall, but found some spray to kill them.
We had a great time in Chicago. Loved the location, our hosts were responsive. Just wished it could have been a little cleaner.
Good place to stay
The space was convenient, quiet & comfortable for me. Thanks again.
Great place to stay. Super cozy and comfy! Also Lots of restaurants around!

We had a great time at Seth’s place! It’s in a super walkable location right in the middle of Fulton market. So many great restaurants within a small radius. It was a great basecamp for our Chicago trip.

The space is beautiful. Very clean and organized. Communication is fast with the host. Only complaint is that I wish would have had access to the parking garage. Finding a parking space everyday was very inconvenient, other than that I recommend this spot
This is our second stay at David and Andrea’s Airbnb and the second visit was just as wonderful as the first!

Place was nice. Check in was a nightmare as the front desk person didn’t have much info on details of the building. Was very put offish about it. Location is in prime Fulton market. Wouldn’t consider a luxury condo but Clean for sure. There is a $1000 deposit paid upfront that you don’t get back until after 7 business days. I’d rate 7/10.

Had a great stay over the weekend for a little get away nice and quiet street very peaceful the house looks exactly like the photos. They were very helpful when needed and responded back efficiently every time. I would definitely stay again!
Highly recommend! A beautiful, spotless space made even better by the warm and welcoming hosts.

This was exactly what we needed. It had three clean beds; it was a nice place; the bathroom and kitchen were clean; and there were heaters because it was a cold May day when we arrived. It was close to where we needed to be, and it's a great location near all the amenities in Logan Square. The host was quick to respond and easy to check in and out of the place. We didn't have a car, so parking wasn't a problem. The only concern we had was the noise level from upstairs at night, and in the morning was disruptive. I would recommend this place when visiting Logan Square, Chicago.

Amazing location, super close to lots of restaurants, bars, night life, and of course, Wrigley Field. The value for money is great, you get what you pay for, and yes, the place is very basic but the location is amazing and the price is very affordable. Read the description well, because that is what you will get.

Being so close to my nephew’s apartment afforded us time to explore so much of Chicago…my first time actually in town, not just transferring at O’Hare!   He has no car, so I used CTA bus and rail to come and go…the location is perfect!  I look forward to coming back,

Steven was an awesome host, always there to answer a question or offer local recommendations. The location was literally perfect, close to a bustling neighborhood but also on a private and quiet street! The third floor walk up from the parking spot was a little tough with all our bags, but once we were settled we just used the front entrance whenever we were going out on the town and it was perfect. We never used the fire pit but we sat outside in the backyard and it was nice! My favorite hostel in Chicago closed recently so this will be my next go to space!

This was an absolutely gorgeous place to spend a long weekend in Chicago. Being so close to the Red Line was super convenient, and it was truly a wonderful space to decompress at the end of the day. Would highly recommend this to anyone looking for a space that's walkable, close to transportation and services, and truly feels like home!
Thanks to Lito and Chip for being such wonderful hosts!
They were very responsive and called me after my check out to thank me. I will book again when I’m in town if they’re available.
Great stay :) Clean and comfortable home in a quiet location. Hosts are communicative and friendly. Would recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!

This was a very nice unit in a very nice neighborhood with lots to do nearby. Going to the Lincoln Park zoo was a highlight of the trip. The garage parking space also made life much easier since we had a rental car and were out trying to visit relatives.
We could hear some footsteps and movement from the upstairs guests, but not more than you'd expect in an old house.

Todo Super bien. Creo que lo único que hay que resaltar es que son habitaciones compartidas y se escucha todo lo que hablan en las demás.

Anna’s place was absolutely incredible. Spacious and comfortable spot that just feels like home. The rooftop view is spectacular and the perfect spot to wind down after a day in the city. I never felt a bother to her and really appreciated her tips and recommendations for Chicago. Anna was truly a breath of fresh air and I’m so thankful to have rented with her. Would highly recommend 10/10.

Stayed for a weekend trip with some friends. MUCH better than staying in a hotel. The unit is a loft style, so the four of us had plenty of room to spread out and relax.
The location is right by the Harrison stop on the Red Line. It was simple to get around. The beds were not super comfortable. But the unit was clean, everything worked, and the host consistently responded within 5-10 minutes each time. If you’re traveling with a group, this is a good place to stay.
The next time my friend group goes back to Chicago, we will absolutely stay here again.
Great location.
