We enjoyed our stay at Sam’s place! It was super clean and comfortable. Also had a cool style & my boyfriend enjoyed the piano. Cute cat kept us company throughout our stay. Enjoyed taking a bath in the jacuzzi tub! We were a little sad to leave!

The property was quite average, featuring three basement bedrooms that were damp and musty. One of which had an exterior door opening to an alley.
The check-in process required stepping outside the Airbnb platform to provide a security deposit, which involved several additional steps. Having stayed at numerous Airbnb properties, I find that few require such measures. The platform is designed around a robust rating system based on previous stays and reviews. If either hosts or guests do not have confidence in this system, it may be advisable to reconsider using it.

Thank you for curating a beautiful and functional place for travelers to Chicago. Besides having comfy beds, a well appointed kitchen and bathroom, the place was stylish. The neighborhood was fun, but more importantly close to the wedding venue and activities of our son’s and partner’s  wedding.  I hope I can stay at Matt’s place again .
Thank you! Beautiful apartment!!
The place was great. Lots of space for our group of 6. Awesome views from the balconies. The gym was bigger than I expected and very close.
Clean, comfortable & walkable!
Great location with easy check in!

We had a wonderful five day  stay, location was perfect and neighborhood was nice. Walking distance to local restaurant Candlelite was delicious. We went to a Cubs game and it was about a 20 minute drive. My son and his fiancé were with us and the space was perfect for the four of us as there are two master bedrooms.  Place was clean and quiet and a parking space! Rasheed was a great communicator as well. We will be back!
Jake’s location in Chinatown is great. Very close to the L for easy transport into the city.

Pleasant experience, comfortable beds, plenty of space. Host was proactive and timely with communication. They let us know about the tricky street parking situation, which was helpful.  Check out instructions were very reasonable.
This was a perfect crash pad I spent most of the time with my daughter which was a 15-minute walk away.
Great space in a great location, perfect for a weekend away with friends!
Honestly loved my stay very helpful and friendly the area was peaceful and walkable especially for kids it’s kinda far from downtown Chicago but easy to travel via train i definitely would book again
Clear communication and instructions.   place as expected.  city life was a little noisy in the area, but still a great place to stay

My friends and I had a wonderful time at David’s place! The area was beautiful and super walkable with many food options near by! The place fit my group nicely and had everything we could need for a fun weekend!
If you’re going to Wrigley, do yourself a favor and book this place. Can’t get much closer to the action. Everything you need within walking distance. Thanks Carlos!!!!

We had a great stay overall. The place was clean, comfortable, and in a convenient location—close to plenty of restaurants and stores. Iris was also very responsive and easy to communicate with.
A couple of notes for future guests: the fridge was a bit loud at times, which might bother light sleepers. Parking in the area can also be tricky—if you’re planning to rely on street parking, just be aware and take precautions, as we had our catalytic converter stolen.

As someone who was from Chicago this is such a place great to stay you’re 10 minutes away by car from everything Chicago has to offer downtown the train and bus stops as well. Check in was smooth and it was easy to find parking nearby as well. Book this stay in Chicago the inside was just as lovely as well.

What a wonderful place!  It's bright, spacious, spikky clean, with everything we needed for our stay.  We loved the neighborhood and really loved our street.  Our hosts were friendly and helpful and we look forward to returning to Chicago and staying here soon.

We had a wonderful stay at Elliot and Deena’s place. The apartment was elegant, exceptionally clean, and offered the perfect amount of space for our large family group. Communication was seamless from start to finish. We especially appreciated how understanding and professional the hosts were when we reached out about a minor maintenance issue (our fault), they handled it with total integrity and grace. It was a beautiful home base for our trip, and we highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area

I was looking for a place to stay between downtown and Rosemont so I could explore the city while attending an event at the convention center on one day. Andreea’s home was convenient to the blue line so it was easy to get around. I felt like I had privacy and the room was very comfortable.
Thank you so much
Everything was great. The place was amazing and everything was exactly as described. The host was super responsive the whole time. Absolutely would stay there again.

Great communication . Updated kitchen and bathroom.
Amazing lovely homes just around the corner along the river. Very clean kitchen. Desk was very helpful for working. Only complaint was a dog or really musty smell.

Great host since reservation,it was the perfect place for what I needed, responsive with little to no wait, polite and proactive checking everything was going smoothly during my check-in stay and check out. Useful items in the apartment and clean the bed is comfortable and sheets were clean.Thank you would stay here again.
it was pleasant stay. Clean, easy to check in.
Awesome stay for 3 adults and one baby.

We had a wonderful stay! The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully set up with everything we needed. The host was responsive and made check-in and communication seamless. The location was perfect for getting around and exploring the area. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!

Family of 3.  Stayed Friday to Monday. Check in was easy @ 4pm and out by 10am. Location is Ashland ave., a four lane arterial road.  3 Bedrooms (memory foam) are on backside so very little penetrating noise given busy location.  2nd entrance floor starts with front door opening onto dining area, then kitchen, bedroom with queen bed, and full bathroom.  Downstairs/ basement is TV LR, full bathroom, and 2 bedrooms (queen in one and full + bunkbed in other). LR seating area has a 1990s feel to it with wall to wall carpeting. There is a fireplace – but didn’t use it.  Washer dryer is always a bonus.  Outdoor space is accessible from both floors.  We sat once in area above garage to read in the sun.  We heard the upstair neighbors a few times but never saw them.  We wake up early so the sheer window coverings were fine for us. All in all this is a practical comfortable place for the price point and we would stay here again.
Had a great stay. Clean, modern, very aesthetically pleasing and has good amenities.

The place feels like home. It has plants, stained glass, and is lovely. The steam shower is wonderful! There was an issue with the Internet and the host was super responsive, and when ATT wouldn't be able to fix it until later in the day, they bought a hot spot so my stay was not disrupted. Truly excellent hosts. Would love to return to this place again!
Affordable spot in a great location. Owners are very responsive photos are accurate and the beds are comfortable. Will definitely book again.
Wonderful is a top notch host! A beautiful place in a convenient part of town. I would gladly stay here again anytime I come back to the area!
Very convenient and comfortable place to stay. Joanna was very quick to respond to any questions I had, and the home was very clean and cozy. I will pick this home again on my next trip to Chicago.

This was the perfect choice for our weekend getaway, the location is not too far from the city and it is a nice neighborhood. Vassa had a clean home and provided clear instructions to ensure a had a great stay. She was super friendly during the booking process and gave me some great recommendations for the city.

This apartment was as listed. It was clean, cute, and well stocked. James was proactive and responsive. The location is prime as well. A quiet neighborhood with walkable restaurants and close enough to the train.
However, I would be remiss if I didn’t mention the neighbor noise. Sound travels incredibly well in this place and this is not a place to rent if you want a quiet weekend where you can sleep in. You can hear every footfall, word, and sneeze of the neighbors above. I’m not sure if it is long term tenants or another Airbnb but the people above us paced their apartment almost constantly going late into the night and beginning at 5 or 7 am. Also, the shared laundry room is on the other side of the door to the bedroom so people will be in and out of a room a few feet from the bed. Light sleepers and sound sensitive renters beware!

This is the second visit to this building. Location is walking distance to Boys Town (from what my kiddo tells us) and a 30 minute direct bus to the Loop. You’re 10 minute walk to the zoo (free) and you’re among great restaurants. The units here are clean and really functional. NOTE: no elevator. So you’ll get some exercise. :) Check in is online and the entry is by key pad. Very convenient.
Very nice relocation. Close to the north end of Chicago and very near family. walkable area and felt very safe.

Jay was great and my daughter and I loved the place. Centrally located, peaceful, and comfortable. Jay reached out before we got there and checked to see if we needed anything the next day. Perfect trip to Chicago.
The place was spotless on arrival, the instructions for entry clear and accurate.  Bennet was very responsive to all my requests.  I could not have asked for  a better host.
Place was chill

I loved staying in this unique Airbnb. It was awesome to have lush greenery and farm animals around in the middle of a city. The inside was clean and comfortable. I had a lovely stay and would book again.

Stayed here for a month with a group of flight attendants based at ORD and the location was great! Super easy to get to be blue line and easy walking to pharmacies, grocery stores, and restaurants! Having laundry and a full kitchen with appliances was also super helpful! Hosts were very responsive to any questions too.  Would definitely recommend this place to others!!

I absolutely LOVED my stay here! It is such a beautiful place and very cozy. The space was very clean and inviting. The bed was super comfortable and the sheets were so soft. Lydia and her co-host were very responsive and flexible of my check in/out times. They were also able to give me a list of local places to check out. I would 100% stay here again.
Lucien was a great host, I was mistakenly locked out of the property at about 1/2am, and he answered very quickly! The house was very nice and accommodating and right by the train!
The place was extremely clean and looked exactly as listed.

Great location and easy access to public transportation. Big beautiful windows, and welcoming staff at the building.

Stayed 3 nights with my wife and adult son.  Host was extremely responsive to ALL our questions throughout our stay.  Our flight to Chicago arrived earlier than the designated check-in time but they allowed us to arrive earlier which was most appreciated.  He provided us easy instructions, with pictures, to get into the building and apartment.  A short walk there is a main street with restaurants, CVS, Starbucks etc.  Lovely.  And only a 15 minute walk to get to Wrigley Field.
Great stay. No complaints!

Amy was very responsive and friendly! The place is on a fairly quiet residential street and walkable to bus/train lines. We were only there for a very short time but we had everything we would need. Our stay was fine, and I would readily stay here again!

I really enjoyed my stay here. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and communication was great. I also had good access to public transport, basic amenities, and nice coffee shops nearby. I definitely recommend it!
Great host nd responds quick
The trip was great the place was amazing the only thing is finding parking was a little tricky and wifi was spotty the whole trip but besides that I would definitely stay again

Amazing house, Alec was very kind and helpful. 100% recommend!

The unit is old, quirky and clean! The beds were comfortable. The kitchen has everything you need. It is a one person kitchen so if you envision cooking with others you might be disappointed. We made it work! The location was central to what we wanted. We rented a car and always found parking right outside the unit.

I cannot think of a single thing I would improve about this place. It was truly the cleanest airbnb I have ever stayed at and they made wonderful use of the space. We enjoyed being in the neighborhood where it was peaceful but still able to walk to bars and restaurants. The place was so cozy we spent more time at the airbnb then we imagined we would. We had an incredible stay!

We stayed here for an annual friend gathering so we had 7 of us staying in this pace and it was perfect! Great location and plenty within walking distance especially if you like to walk. We even walked back from Wrigley although that was about 3 miles, but a very pleasant walk.
Roof deck is large and a great place to hang out! Would definitely stay here again.
Such a great place to stay!
I had an amazing stay at Eloina’s place
2 families 5 children ages 3-8 more than enough space. Close to a grocery store, restaurants and a nice park.
Great place and very accommodating for my stay. Would revisit and highly recommend.

It was a very nice stay at Ebony and Ean’s lovely home. Checking into the Airbnb was really easy. The room was pretty comfortable and clean.
I’d definitely stay here again my next time in Chicago.
It was a great place to stay for a couple nights! Easy check in, the place was very comfy and clean. I would definitely look to stay here again on my next trip to Chicago.

We enjoyed our stay. I appreciate that Kyriako was responsive, and when we had a request, it was addressed right away. The space was a good size for our 3 adults and 1 toddler, though I imagine it could've felt tight if we had more adults. Calm street that's walkable to good spots. We had a car and always found close street parking! (I suggest you get the Chicago parking app for payment.)

Great location in the West Loop—super convenient and easy to get around. Check-in was seamless and the place was clean and simple.
The space is pretty minimal, but it worked well for our stay. The only hiccup was having just one key/fob for our group at first, which made getting in and out a bit tricky, though the host was responsive in helping us get another.

The place was clean, easy to find street parking, and easy to acess

Great stay, loved the location!

Enjoyed our stay! Very clean and comfortable unit. Convenient location and great for families. Hanna was very communicative and responsive. Would definitely recommend!
Great place, it was very clean. The host was very responsive. there’s plenty to do in a walkable distance. Navy pier and Michigan Ave are about a 15-20 min drive. Overall I had an outstanding stay.

The place was clean and the host was awesome. The only downside was the smell of weed the first night (neighbors). I had 3 small kids and the whole apartment smelled. We didn’t get the smell the rest of the stay.
We had a great stay in Chicago and will definitely use Slavyana's place in the future!
Great hosts. Any questions I had were responded to in 30 min. They had all the toiletries ready for every guest, the spot was clean. I would recommend! It’s not too far from downtown too

We had considered places in several other neighbourhoods and were so glad we stayed here. The apartment is spacious and comfortable. We used public transportation quite a bit; the L was about a 15 minute walk, which we liked. We are walkers, so this was perfect. If we were going somewhere at night, we used Uber. But the immediate neighborhood has so much to offer that we had most of our meals nearby. Danielle’s recommendations are nicely curated. She’s obviously a foodie and her taste is impeccable. She always responded to any questions very quickly. We would definitely come back!

staying here was a plus! everyone is friendly, everything is near including Wrigleyville! would recommend staying here, it's such a cozy place and you can tell this home comes from love! thanks Chicago for having me.
we were in town for my son's wedding and we could not have asked for more. This was the perfect place for us!
The decor and vibes were beautiful
This place was clean and quiet!! I love the chalkboard wall. The host responds in a timely manner. This home is kids friendly.  I would definitely book again
This is a fun and funky place in a vibrant neighborhood. An Aldi and Fresh Market are right out the front door. The entry was easy. The place was plenty big and we felt right at home.
Aitor was a great host, his place is conveniently located and the service he provides lived up to expectations. The place was clean and in a quiet neighborhood that had some great restaurants nearby.

The apartment looked exactly like the pictures and was very comfortable! The kitchen and bathroom was fully stocked and there were plenty of bath and room linens and blankets. Location was very easy to find. I would stay here again.
The house is immaculate, and Caryl is a gracious host who goes the extra mile to make the experience a great one.

Stayed with 6 people and had a great stay. The town home was spacious, pristine, and clean. Matthew was pro-active, quickly responsive prior to the trip, and made our stay flawless. Had everything you'd need like adequate glassware and toiletries. Was a great place for a short trip.

This air bnb was the comfiest place we’ve stayed in. Has almost everything you need and very clean. She’s very quick at responding and super nice. We made sure to leave an awesome review because this place definitely deserves it!

Highly recommend. the place was just as described onnyhe photos, very clean, and quiet friendly neighborhood. Train station was at walking distance for easy access to downtown and and Wrigley Stadium. The only down side is if you are a light sleeper the train runs next to the apartment. did not affect me at all because my sleep is deep. But earplugs were ready available provided by the host.

Great stay here with our host Jason. He was very friendly and responsive. The location is in sight of Wrigley, with so much to do. There are two beds and pull out for third bed, plus all your homely accommodations from air mattresses to irons, to monitors in case you need to work a bit.

Fue todo igual o mejor de lo que esperaba, el lugar es muy lindo, la casa súper cómoda, tiene todo y más de lo que uno necesita. La ubicación es excelente, cerca del tren, lugar muy bonito y tranquilo.
La casa entras y te sentis como estar en tu casa y la atención de Lynette fue excelente, siempre atenta a todas las necesidades y contestando rápidamente. Si volviera no dudo ni un instante en venir a esta misma propiedad. Muchas gracias !!!!

Our stay was perfect for a weekend get away!
Steps away from boystown. Great for a group.
Would stay at Justin’s place again!
Our stay was great. The hosts were extremely professional and proactively communicative.
Great place, very clean and spacious. Worth stay again.

We had a very pleasant stay at this property. The apartment is well renovated, with a comfortable feel throughout. The furniture was good and made the stay quite comfortable.
The bathroom was nice and came with all the necessary toiletries, and the kitchen was well equipped with appliances and crockery. The washing machine and dryer were a great addition and very convenient.
Street parking was always available, and we never had any issues finding a spot for our car.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience. A special thanks to Leah, who was very kind and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely recommend this place.

Fue muy amable, incluso nos dejó entrar un poco antes por que nuestro vuelo llegaba temprano, nos dejó bebidas en el refri y todo estaba impecable, el metro lineal verde está a 5 minutos caminando y múltiples paradas de camión cerca

This spacious apartment in uptown is wonderful for group trips or a good amount of space! A short distance from the lake and Montrose beach and a short walk from several delicious international spots.. not to mention a maximum 10 minute walk to the red line to be well connected with other neighborhoods in the city. We loved it here!

We had a really great experience staying at this cute spot for a girls weekend. The space itself was exactly what we were hoping for-clean, thoughtfully decorated, and very comfortable. The beds were very cozy, and we really appreciated having fans and AC units in each room. The host was very easy to communicate with and responsive throughout our stay, which made everything smooth and stress-free. The location ended up being a bit farther away from the city than we initially expected so we opted to use Uber instead of public transportation. We ended up loving the neighborhood itself! There were great spots within walking distance, and we enjoyed grabbing coffee and breakfast nearby each morning. There were also lots of fun shops to explore, and everyone we encountered was incredibly friendly. We will absolutely be back. 10/10 in our book!

We had a great stay. The location is in a quiet charming neighborhood and the house was very clean. We didn’t plan to do much cooking which was good because the supplies were sparse. Otherwise everything was great!
very nice and comfy stay for a weekend. Hostel like environment, private bedrooms and shared bathrooms. highly recommend if you are visiting for a weekend.

The location was perfect and the place was quite spacious, especially living room and communal area. The place was clean and quiet, didn’t have any issue during our stay! It’d be a good fit if you don’t want to stay in the loop — and want to order food and hang out within the house!
Was worth the stay, hosts were very helpful and the place has everything necessary for your stay. Would definitely stay here again!
Excelente ubicación. Greg es muy atento y amable. Lo recomiendo
Loved the place. It was shared with others and someone folded my laundry from the dryer, which was cute. LOL.

Very cute, very cozy! Equipped with great amenities. Mostly quiet neighborhood. The hosts are very clear, responsive and professional in communication. We will definitely be back next time we vacation out here!
We had a wonderful stay and spent lots of time walking from the apartment to the park!
Great location-walkable to almost anything;  Like others have said in their reviews-very noisy neighboring businesses from 3pm-5am;  more spacious than expected; very clean and free of clutter
My daughter and I had a wonderful stay. Kyriako answered every single question we had, making everything very easy for us. We truly appreciate Kyriako's help and we definitely stay again
Super cute spot! It’s small but cozy and worked perfectly for our quick Chicago trip 🤍
It was great!
Small but good
Very nice place, Kate is very fast at communicating with any questions or issues we had! Great host!
Fantastic spot. Great hosts. Highly recommend

This airbnb exceeded my expectations. It was extraordinarily nice and clean, along with a very reasonable price and an included parking spot. Easy lakeshore access as well. Will definitely stay here again
Great space and great host

As a host, these two were spot on.  Having the extras like a tub and a pack and play for our toddler made our travel much easier.   The communication was quick and helpful.  And the place was not only well stocked, but it was also extra stocked.  The location is perfect for Wrigley, but would also be perfect for getting around the city.

Randy’s place was fantastic. It was even better than described, and well worth what I paid. It was comfortable and clean and well furnished, and Randy made everything easy with his clear instructions for check in and check out. Would stay everytime I am in the city!
Great spot! Very fast customer service!
Charming and well-organized. Note that the stairs are a little narrow and steep--I was okay with them, but they could be problematic for some people. I would totally stay here again.
Genuinely such a amazing time and Jedidiah was so accommodating and a amazing host!!
Good place, and  good in relation to the price. everything was clean. Recomended
Great location, comfy bed, good communication. Highly recommend!

Bonito apartamento en una zona tranquila, con algún detalle a mejorar: por ejemplo, la ventana de la cocina no cerraba. Aparcamiento un poco complicado a partir de última hora de la tarde. Anfitrión muy atento.

We visited Chicago this past weekend for a bridal shower and a concert at The Salt Shed, and this place was an absolute win. The location couldn’t have been better—easy street parking, a great walkable neighborhood, and just a short distance to Lincoln Square.
The space itself was perfect for our stay. Having a full kitchen made everything convenient, but the real standout was the coffee bar; honestly, one of the best I’ve ever seen at an Airbnb. Whether you’re into espresso, drip, or K-cups, they’ve thought of everything.
After our drive from Wisconsin, the hot tub was exactly what we needed to unwind and relax; such a great bonus.
I even checked to see if it was available for an upcoming wedding weekend (sadly, it’s not), but I’ve already bookmarked it for my next trip to the city. It truly felt like a home away from home.
Unbelievable place to stay!
Great location!
Very responsive and the place was exactly what we needed. Close to the train and easy to access.
This property was great for 4/5 guest that was able to attend. Clean and spacious. A tad bit difficult to find parking but the home overall was great. I would book again.
Amazing location, responsive host, perfect place for a weekend visit to Chicago.
Great spacious stay in Chicago. Truly no detractors for this place, stay here!
very helpful with every concern i had and easy to communicate with! the place was very comfortable and considering its just a block from the Thorndale red line, super easy to get to transportation!

Booked this place to go to a concert and a game at Wrigley over a long weekend. Located in a peaceful neighborhood that’s in close proximity to Wrigley and Boystown. If the weather had been better we would have walked to the Cubs game honestly! It’s also super easy to get downtown from here by taking the train. If you’re driving parking is really easy as well. Host is really responsive and proactive with communication. We had everything we needed for our stay and then some, and it was super clean upon arrival. The washer/dryer are a great benefit too if you’re staying longer. The rules and cleaning expectations are incredibly reasonable! This is out of the host’s control but want to flag that it seems like there are other airbnbs in the building so you might hear people above you - not an issue if you have sleep headphones. Overall a great homebase for a long weekend in Chicago!

A great spot if you want to stay somewhere nice and quiet. Location was private with good food close by and the perfect distance from the train to get into the city. Julissa was very responsive and very easy to work with while staying. Highly recommend!

The apartment has a great location, near to the train blue line and also a bus that just has a stop right at the corner next to the Airbnb. It was clean and had everything needed to have a comfortable stay.

Our stay at the Andersonville Cabin was wonderful- it's quaint, cozy, and clean! Very walkable to bars, cafes, and restaurants. Matt was a very helpful host and provided all the information we needed for a quick and easy check-in and check-out. Thank you!

La zona es muy bonita y está súper bien ubicado. Los anfitriones siempre estuvieron pendientes de mis dudas o necesidades.
Quizá estaría bien un poquito más de flexibilidad para el ingreso y la salida, aunque entiendo que debido a otras no tan buenas experiencias han tenido que tomar ciertas medidas.
En general bien, lo recomiendo mucho.

The home was lovely! Entry and checkout were clear and easy. We loved walking around the neighborhood to delicious restaurants, exploring the cute stores close by, and taking the blue line train to explore other parts of town. We could walk to so much! The beds were comfortable and the whole experience was pleasant!
Great location, very walkable. Clean!
Marco was helpful with the information provided.  Would definitely rent from him again.
We had a great time for my bachelor party weekend. The location was perfect and filled all of our needs for going to a couple of cubs games.
Lovely place, cool area of the city, accesible price. Street parking was also very convenient. Would definitely stay here again.
Great location!
The place was beautiful and gave me some inspiration on how to decorate my owner house! Richard was very welcoming and friendly. I would definitely stay again whenever available.

Fantastic stay, extremely clean and well maintained. He is very quick with responding, especially when I needed help with last minute parking because spot hero didn’t have much around while trying to reserve space.
Even provided toothbrushes and travel toothpaste which was extremely nice.
Exactly as advertised and was the perfect place to sleep and recharge for a weekend of helping my daughter move out of her college dorm. Excellent communication from the hosts and very clean.

Cute place in great Lincoln Park location. We walked to many restaurants in the area + the zoo, and it was a short Uber ride to downtown sites. Host was very responsive on questions and would stay here again.
Great space! Great communication, helpful and prompt. Would recommend, and definitely would stay again.
Very comfortable nice prices good central air conditioning will definitely be coming back!
Great stay! Clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect for a weekend in Chicago and the host was very helpful. I would definitely recommend this place.

This place is so beautiful! It is an incredibly large space with such a warm feeling. The pictures do not do it justice! Sean is very warm and friendly. He is also very quick to respond. We had an excellent time there.

Had a great stay at Zen Chicago’s Hyde Park/Kenwood apartments. The room and the building were very comfortable and clean. Communication and check-in was seamless. It's a perfect place to stay if you are visiting UofChicago and Hyde Park area

Had a great weekend stay in Chicago at this colorful & quirky space filled with a lifetime of treasures. Josh was patient with my anxiety about opening an older gate, but luckily there were two entrances so it was easy to access.
Amazing location just down the street from the blue line, & in the mix of all the great Logan Sq restaurants, bars, shops etc. Comfy simple room (minus all the monster decor, ofc!), perfect for my weekend extension after a work trip. Would def recommend!
We really enjoyed staying in Hanna and Mark's place. It was so nice and close to everything. Good area of town and we felt very safe!

Mayfair Garden was a super cute place, if you are over 6ft tall this is not the place for you. low ceilings as it is a basement apartment but overall great! everything needed for a comfortable stay was provided and being outside the city was nice.

We really enjoyed our stay! The unit was stocked with everything we needed and the photos matched the listing. The location was perfect for our activities. We would definitely stay here again when we come back to Chicago!
Great price, great location, very beautiful house, and host is very friendly.
I stayed at Cristina’s place for a couple of weeks. Great location to access downtown and convenient to shop for groceries as well. Th place was as described.

As an older (60) married male, traveling this particular weekend solo, the neighborhood has the youthful presence of properties close to Loyola HOWEVER in a gentrified neighborhood. It is upscale enough for the college renters to respect their community.  I was always greeted as 'sir' and the youth are Christian acting and respectful.  Proximity to dining options and red line make this the greater place away from the touristy downtown options.  Bella's property is awesome, honored to have called it my base in and out of this neighborhood during my stay.
Very responsive host & accommodating to requests. The Airbnb is as listed, very spacious.

This place was great we loved our stay here. felt very at home and safe with it being a private gated complex. thomas gave us  some good recommendations On where to go, since we stayed for a bachelor party. he was very helpful and quick with responses when there was small issues that needed to be addressed. overall me and my group really enjoyed our stay here. I highly recommend it
Beautiful place! Very well located. Comfortable and clean.
Great space and location! Our group of 8 women were comfortable and impressed with how clean and well-stocked this AirBnB was. Would recommend!
I will be back!

Hannah responded super quick and was very helpful when we had questions. Instructions to enter are straightforward and the place was very clean and comfy.
Thanks Hanna!

We loved our stay at Nancy's. we were 10 adults and everyone had a comfortable place to sleep,  everything was clean,  we walked to the beach,  the subway is less than 10 minutes of walking.  we recommend it.

Fantastic amenities and a cozy place to rest after a long day of walking around Chicago! The Garretts are excellent hosts; friendly and helpful in every way possible. I would be delighted to stay here again
Wonderful stay, great host!
Our group had a great stay!  It’s a lovely home. The host is kind and helpful.

We absolutely loved Mickey’s apartment! My Dad and I visited Chicago for a long weekend and this place was perfect. Spacious, comfortable, and perfectly clean. The apartment is beautiful with stunning original trim and detailing, and it is perfectly appointed with everything you need. It was also a very easy walk to transit. Would definitely stay again!
Great place!! Spacious and well equipped.
Very responsive, clean apartment. Wish there were better parking options. Slipped on the stairs, so be careful. Overall great option to stay in Chicago.

We had a lovely stay at Tawney’s place—it’s in a great location, and the apartment is very clean, cozy, and comfortable. Tawney is super responsive, and she checked in regularly to make sure we were having a great stay.
It’s a great stay will definitely plan again and recommend for a quick comfortable stay
It was a stay for me and my friends visiting from outside Chicago. They had a wonderful time and place was very comfortable and clean.
Terrific place. Right by the train and all the sights in Logan Square. Beds were very comfortable and everything was very tidy and clean. Highly recommend!

Best in downtown, excellent, all desi’s must try , the odor is from the trash chute next door at the entry and is not felt after entering. Can fit 10 easy, got 2 air mattress that fits 4 , view was excellent, can see a ‘L’ green line every 15 min. ambience is great. 10 min to all bean and best places around. Used public parking.Sunday parkings free on road. Got security lower level. If you are executive visiting McCormick place I would recommend but not suggest. Best host I ever saw
This an awesome spot to stay near everything. Justin is super helpful and responsive to make sure you have what you need. Would stay here again without any hesitation.

Awesome affordable alternative to the drake, the Hilton, et al for accommodations for a wedding. Well appointed kitchenette, great market within walking distance. Beautiful view (from the top floor) of the lake.
Great location!

We had a great time staying at The Cardinal. The house has a lot of character and is beautiful to explore once you step inside. The backyard was a nice bonus. Mindy and Tony were excellent communicators and kindly allowed us to store our bags past checkout, which was very helpful. The stay truly exceeded our expectations; I highly recommend it.
Good location. Two of the bedrooms had partial walls that didn't go to the ceiling. Additional deposit was required outside of Airbnb after booking. Cute place.
this location was perfect for visiting our daughter at uchicago.  quick access to dining as well.
Great place to stay if you want to be in Chinatown. Great access to the Radius venue. Some good walkable eats too!
Great spot and location. highly recommend!
Loved this place! Very walkable to everything, great location!

Great spot to stay your only about 15-20 mins from all the best spots in Chicago the house was very clean and the beds were absolutely amazing! Would definitely recommend this spot to anyone looking for a fun weekend in the city! Darius is a great host responds quickly and had good recommendations for places to eat

I really enjoyed the neighborhood—great location and overall a nice area to stay in. However, I don’t feel the property matched the price we paid. For a 2-night stay totaling just under $700, I expected a higher level of comfort and upkeep.
The biggest issue was the lack of proper heating. The heat did not work during our stay, and we were provided with only one portable electric heater for a two-bedroom space, which wasn’t sufficient. There is also no central AC, just portable fans, which is something future guests should be aware of.
In terms of cleanliness and amenities, there were a few concerns. Several cooking utensils appeared burned from prior use, and some of the dishes were not clean—we had to rewash multiple items before using them. The window shades also looked like they hadn’t been dusted in some time.
Overall, while the location was a highlight, the condition of the unit and lack of essential amenities made it feel overpriced for the experience provided.
Fantastic location!

Adrian was incredibly helpful during the booking, stay, and checkout processes. The space was even more spacious than we had anticipated for our group, and we enjoyed spending time in both units. The projector was a great addition as well. Given the area and the busy Chicago weekend, it was difficult to find a better combination of price and quality for their home. The only downside was finding parking, for which Adrian provided detailed instructions. I will definitely recommend and would love to book with Adrian again.

Had a parents getaway weekend in the old neighborhood and it couldn’t have been better. Nancy’s place was PERFECT and she couldn’t have been a better host. Communicative, so helpful and kind. Big space right in the heart of everything, just a perfect place. We absolutely loved it and are sad that it’s over. When we come back to Chicago it’ll definitely be a place we want to stay at. And we got to see a Cubs win, so a nice bonus 😜
Friendly attentive host. Close to the 77 bus, and the red line. Great ital beef sandwiches at Mic Duckies right down the street. Comfy Beds.
The apartment is spotless and super cute. Lots of amenities, everything in the kitchen you need, complimentary coffee. Would recommend this place and would stay here again.
Melissa was a great host! The apartment is in a cute neighborhood, walking distance to lots of bars and restaurants. It's very spacious and stocked with everything you need during your stay.

Sylvia was super friendly and responsive. Her place was in a great area surrounded by lots of things to do and places to eat.  New location in the city for us to stay but we all enjoyed the space. Liked the lay outs of the rooms and all the small helpful items (TV and chargers) in each room.  Would definitely stay again and recommend to friends!

I imagine a lot depends on who else is staying in the apartment. In my case, I had friendly, quiet, adult apartment-mates, who I didn't see often. Overall, a good experience, and a great deal for the price. I would repeat.
Darina was easy to communicate with, had clear instructions and responsive. Highly recommend this place for a stay.
Was in town for an event at the University of Chicago and it was great to stay in a historic Hyde Park building and neighborhood.
Great location to access Wrigleyville and Southport! Very walkable and in a beautiful neighborhood. We felt safe and right at home!

The team at Cloud 9 were extremely helpful. The concierge at the apartment are very friendly and helpful. The apartment itself spacious, immaculate and the provisions left in the fridge a nice addition. Properly equipped throughout.  Definitely 5 star.
Great place! The walls are pretty thin in case you’re a light sleeper and need to know. But other than that I thought it was so worth it

We came for a long weekend and this place was perfect! Joan was proactive and responsive. Instructions were clear. The space is great! It looks like the pictures and actually feels even more spacious. We comfortably fit 4 adults and our pets. The neighborhood is really nice and there were lots of great restaurants nearby.
I would definitely recommend this space to anyone visiting Chicago.

We stayed here for two nights. This home was exactly like the pictures but better when we entered the home we were blown away! Nice, clean, and made us feel like home! I had trouble with a ceiling fan light I communicated with Ramone he answered right away and help me solve the issue. I would 100% recommend staying here it was worth the trip because we stayed here!
Great place, clean and spacious. Easy parking nearby and easy check-in. Couple hiccups but everything was handled well!
The unit was exactly as described in a quiet, walkable neighborhood. Would happily stay here again!
Absolutely great stay! Will stay again!
Zhi was very welcoming and gave clear instructions on check in and check out. The price was very good and the accommodations were of good quality as well. I would highly recommend this place.

Helen’s place was exactly what I was looking for. I needed a place to lay my head every night while I found housing as I just moved to Chicago. House was super quiet, low traffic, everyone had their own flow. Laundry on site was super helpful. Bathroom was super clean, no issues with water pressure or anything. I would definitely recommend Helen’s place.
Great location! The house is just as described/pictured and had everything we needed for a weekend stay.

Location was great and the communication from the host was also great. However please. E aware that each bedroom does not have an en-suite bathroom. 3 out of the 6 have bathrooms in the bedroom and the other 3 has the bathrooms in the hallway. Also please be aware that there are three levels for accessibility considerations. There was also an issue with parking that was resolved right away.
Excellent communication and easy to deal with. Highly recommend!
Had a great time during this stay. If you are going to Wrigley with a group, hard to beat this location as it’s literally steps away!
Space was spotless. neighborhood was safe and quiet.  would definitely stay here again.
Lots of space, pleasant and private, and had everything we needed.  Good location for visiting the University.

Great Airbnb!
It is a 15 minute drive, or a short walk to everything you need in Chicago.

Terrific place with friendly host close to UChicago and the lake. It was my first time staying in someone's home while they were there and Molly and her pets were delightful -- she even made some yummy banana bread. Lovely quiet neighborhood that was walkable to public transit, UC campus, lakefront and the Obama Presidential Center. Overall, great stay.

This premium upper level space is wonderfully refurbished and one of the most solidly built and top-notch Airbnbs I have ever stayed in. It’s apparent that Patty looked at the space through the eyes of a guest and then went beyond what guest would want and what would make them feel comfortable throughout the entire unit. There were four of us high school friends having a mini reunion and we could all hang out comfortably in the living and dining rooms and the kitchen.  It was great!
We had a lovely stay at Carla’s space. Easy to get around & street parking was available. Bonus was the great park across the street to walk our pups. We’ll definitely be back. Thank you, Carla!

Perfect spot for my son (24) and I while we visited my daughter at UChicago. Great option to a hotel - 2 bedrooms, clean, 10 minutes from Hyde Park and 15 minutes from downtown. Clean, quiet, neat and was exactly as described. And Rashad lives upstairs, so he's very communicative. I even went for a couple of morning runs along Lake Michigan, which is only half a mile away. Before you book a hotel, check out Rashad's place!

What A Find!!
From the time I booked Roberto and Zinnia's place, the lovely and friendly communication started. I immediately felt like I was being taken care of. Prior to the date, I shared my need for a pharmacy to grab some distilled water for my CPAP; THERE WAS A GALLON WAITING FOR ME!! Along with plenty of snacks and other goodies to make me feel comfortable and home. The place was plenty spacious for the 6 of us, even with a game room with a combo air hockey and pool table! Definitely one of the best Air BnB experiences I ever had. Could not recommend more and would definitely look this up if I was back in Chicago with my group.

Good location. Easy and flexible check-in and building was easy to find. However, walls are very thin. Could hear people in the room next door and in the main living space. Long-term resident was staying in the room next door and was loud after 10pm quiet time which disturbed our sleep. Three different rooms in the Airbnb all share the same bathroom so had to wait in line at times. This was an affordable place to rest for a short trip, but I would not recommend for a longer stay.

Chicago is famous for comedy; improv, comedy clubs, etc. This apartment belongs in that tradition.
Full Chicago ambiance: the El rumbling through your dreams, the world's largest pigeon overhead, and the classic radiated steam heat, conspicuously absent while temps dipped to the 40s. Cold builds character.
The key situation was inspired. No key for the back gate, no key for the front door's bottom lock, which we naively locked before bed. A 6 hour outdoor adventure followed, during which it was gently insinuated we might not understand how a keyhole works.
Got a message that evening with what he called a "generous" discount. The funniest part isn't the amount, no, it's that he thinks he's the one who gets to call it generous. Comedy gold.
Neat, yet atmospherically dingy. Every door announced your arrival like a haunted house. The peephole has tape over it. I didn't ask.
Pros:Area, transit, running water, earplugs
Cons:Hurt myself laughing
Recommended for comedy fans. 5 stars
The perfect place for a weekend with friends. The house was beautiful and in a great location. We loved the backyard and patio area for hosting guests.

El lugar era muy pequeño, muy ruidoso tanto afuera de las habitaciones como en la calle, la zona es muy insegura, hay drogadictos y habitantes de calle por doquier. Es como estar en una película de terror. 🫤
El check in es demasiado tarde y el check out es demasiado temprano.
Emily is a great host and the home was perfect. Loved its location to the 606 and many other places. Would rent again!
It was great. Parth was very helpful and made our stay great. I would recommend it for groups of people wanting a good place to stay in Chicago.

We had a great time in Chicago and this place made everything easier and smooth for us. Good location, easy to get around, very quiet neighborhood and it felt safe. We were in eight, a big family crew, and everyone thought it was a great place to stay. No issues whatsoever. Would definitely stay there again and recommend to anyone. Louis was very communicative about anything even beforehand, so once we got there, we knew everything, which made our check-in and accommodation very smooth. Five stars without a doubt.

This is such a great little find in Chicago! We had a group of 6 people share the space, and it still felt roomy. Christi is a super helpful host, and they took care of all the details we needed to have the perfect stay. Walkable to several great restaurants, shops, and public transit. Highly recommend!!
Nice place that is located in a vibrant neighborhood in Chicago.
Great place.
Great space to stay. Clean, safe, comfortable. Hosts responsive
Lovely apartment in a great neighborhood.
Had a great time at David’s place. The unit is centrally located, walkable to many shops and restaurants. It’s also spacious and light filled. I would stay here again.
We had a great experience staying at this place. The location is fantastic and there’s a ton of things to do. I’d come here again for sure!

Great stay for my Chicago “Dadchelor” trip! The location was super walkable to Wrigley and other bars and restaurants, garage parking was a big plus. The space worked really well for our larger group, and Ajay was responsive, welcoming, and hospitable throughout.
The place was easy to find, with a quick check in, clean bed/bathroom and great location. John provided great instructions. I would stay here again!
Sehr gutes Zimmer, ruhige Umgebung. Preis-Leistung überragend!

The cozy charm and eclectic atmosphere of his place made coming back feel less like a place to stay and more like an addition to our trip. Its location could not be more ideal for someone looking for a place that gives you a “feel” for Chicago and what its neighborhoods have to offer. Situated within walking distance of Lake Michigan, Wrigleyville, restaurants, bars, shops, and public transport (rail and bus lines), it’s the perfect base to explore all of this city’s unique neighborhoods. As to Gary as a host — well, you could not invent someone more insightful about the city or more helpful about your accommodations. In every way, I would highly recommend Casa de Gary… a six-star stay.

Overall, we had a great stay, and I would highly recommend this place!

James was a great host. He kept in close contact with us throughout. The offer to check in early made it very convenient for all of our incoming travelers. The place as bight and comfortable. Such a great location. Everything was as pictured we had an amazing time!

this was a super convenient spot. bering to and from downtown was always a breeze and home itself was a great stay for our home base.

Shawn was incredibly communicative and VERY accommodating; Shawn went above and beyond to make sure I felt comfortable and had a good stay! Great place to stay, everything was as advertised.

The bedroom and living room face a busy street and overlook a neighborhood bar, so if you are sensitive to noise, this might not be the place for you. The bedroom door does not close because it is blocked by the bed which means the light switch is hidden behind the door and light from the living room (which has a large window with no curtains) comes into the bedroom, so if you are sensitive to light, bring a sleep mask. Finally, while the host sent numerous messages with clear instructions, I got the sense that they were automatically generated or created by an AI agent so I'm not sure how responsive a human would actually be if there was a problem.
