We had a very comfortable and enjoyable weekend stay. The space looked exactly like the photos and was spacious enough for our family of four without ever feeling crowded. We stayed on the third floor, and it’s worth noting that Mr. Bentley also rents out the second floor as well.
Mr. Bentley was an attentive and responsive host, always available if we had any questions. Parking was easy and convenient, and the location was central to everything we needed, including shopping and dining.
Overall, a smooth and relaxing stay—we’d happily return.
Kindly,
Jack

This was my second trip to Chicago and I loved staying on the South side of the river this time at Stephanie's place. The neighborhood was so quiet and nice, making us all feel safe. The building and people that work there were so gracious and helpful. It was close to so many things, with a little grocery store across the street. Stephanie was communicative and even let us drop our bags off early since our flight landed in the morning. All in all, a great place to stay while in visiting Chicago.

The location was excellent and it was easy to navigate, and instructions for entry were clear. It was organized and good for a quick stay. There were a few minor issues that were resolved fairly quickly. I would say that the price was a bit higher than we would have wanted for the one bedroom and it would be nice to have sun blocking curtains as an option as the sun is lovely but very bright in the morning. Over all an excellent location, organized space and ease of entry and exit.

Beth’s place is a lovely apartment is an excellent location. Everything was just as described and Beth was always very responsive. This would be the perfect place for a long stay. We can’t wait to come back!
Great location with easy access to all of Lincoln Park and Lakeview. It may be too dark and noisy for some as it is a garden (basement) unit.

This property is a lovely old home offering plentiful accommodations, beautiful early 20th century home character, and comfortable surroundings. The primary suite and recently renovated bathrooms were all terrific, and the host was incredibly accommodating and communicative. Highly recommend.

Adam’s Airbnb in chicago was fantastic. He was able to accommodate us with both units so we had plenty of space for our guests.
He was responsive, nice, and very friendly throughout the entire process. Would definitely come back and stay here and recommend this spot to everybody!

Во первых не удобная лестница очень круто поднимается вверх и очень узка, во вторых при входе двери тоже не удобные, постоянно стукаются об другие двери с сумками и с чемоданом зайти очень сложно,  есть две узкие кровати и они очень скрепят, в одной из кроватей есть клопы которые покусали мужа по всему телу, и есть тараканы, не успела сфотографировать но видела лично.
Gavino's place is excellent! very well kept, location is great, and fully equipped. I look forward to staying again in the future next time I'm in Chicago.
Great communication with hosts. I would definitely book here again !!
Enjoyed our weekend stay
This was our second stay in this location. Whenever we visit the city this place will always be our go to spot.

I give the place a 5 but the host a 3. The place was lovely, spacious, quiet and clean. The bed was good; supportive but still soft. We have vision issues so we found the lighting not bright enough and we could not raise the shades for more light. I don’t think there is a thermostat in the room but it being spring we were ok. We also had issues with getting the fancy shower to work. The host had no help for us on that end but we finally figured it out. There is a large jacuzzi bathtub but the jets didn’t work. The train makes a woosh sound each time it goes by, not loud but a little noticeable at night. The shades don’t really block light so bring a mask if you like it dark at night. Overall, this is a great place to stay. Really close to the blue line (6-10 minute walk) This is a shared space with other guests. Everyone kept to themselves so it wasn’t awkward.

Bella’s apartment was a very solid stay overall. The space was clean and well-maintained, and the bed was genuinely comfortable—easy to get a good night’s sleep after a long day. The location is also a strong point: it’s in a walkable area with convenient access to the train, which made getting around Chicago simple and efficient.
There’s a great coffee spot nearby, which quickly became part of the daily routine. The only downside is that the immediate area is a bit limited when it comes to good restaurant options, so you may need to venture out a bit for better dining.
Overall, it’s a comfortable and practical place to stay, especially if you value cleanliness, transit access, and a quieter neighborhood.

Absolutely loved. Still in the city enough that you are in a happening area, but the neighborhood was sooo quiet. We went on many walks at all times of day & night & always felt very very safe. Wouldn’t be surprised if we came back again. 👀
Excelente para hospedarse, cerca del o hare
Great place to stay! Big enough for a larger group, backyard is awesome! Very responsive hosts as well! Would recommend!
Excellent stay. Jaime was helpful throughout and very responsive to all requests. We shall stay here again.
We stayed there for 10 days and everything was great! Everything was so clean and the neighborhood was nice too. We really look forward to come back when we’re back in Chicago.
It was a great stay, and it was easy to get a hold of Jevaux! I do wish there were more toiletries, so be sure to pack those, but it was a really great stay otherwise!
My wife and I loved our stay here! Tim was very accommodating and was a great host. Highly recommend. Beautiful home and neighborhood!

Second time we have stayed here and certainly plan on staying there again. Location is great, hosts are friendly and responsive, and it is a great space to relax in after a busy day. Great neighborhood.  Highly recommend it!
Great place. Recommend
We loved our stay at Milan’s place! It was the perfect space for us to relax and had everything we needed. Milan was really helpful and friendly.
A wonderful place to stay with family—spotlessly clean and very well maintained. I only wish the cooking utensils were of a better quality to match the standard of the unit.
Great apartment that fit my family of 5 which is hard to find in downtown Chicago!

The place was well kept and clean. It’s close to a lot of walking distance restaurants and shops. It is also about a mile or so walk to the nearest subway stop which was very helpful for us as we had no desire to drive in Chicago haha.
A very beautiful and spacious place for the weekend my family and I really liked the place feels like home we definitely will booked it again
Good distribution inside. Good cleaning. Comfortable beds.

El cuarto es tal cual como se ve en las fotos. Bastante limpio, con suficiente espacio para dos y además un sillón bastante cómodo. El baño estuvo muy bien y súper limpio, con todo lo que necesitábamos para nuestra estadía.
Lo que más nos gustó fue la ubicación, está a 5min de la estación del tren, hay acceso al bus y varios restaurantes cerca. Una zona bastante tranquila, iluminada y en la que incluso caminamos de madrugada sin ningún problema!
Tugba nos ayudó con un early check-in, y eso lo apreciamos bastante ya que pudimos disfrutar de la ciudad desde temprano, sin andar con nuestras maletas.
Definitivamente volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí de tener la oportunidad, ¡muy recomendado!
We truly enjoyed our stay. The apartment was cozy and quiet. The neighborhood was peaceful also. We would stay there again

We had a large out of town group for a friends wedding and everyone felt so comfortable in Jake and Andrea's space! There were plenty of bathrooms, lots of good seating in the common space, and very comfortable bedrooms. Their home is lovely and we had a great time!

Had a great stay here. Apartment looks just like the photos. I was here for 2 weeks and had everything I needed to cook. Comfortable bed. Felt very spacious. I didn’t have any issues finding  parking. Beautiful neighborhood with lots of great local restaurants. Kyriako was easy to communicate with and proactive with checkin and checkout. Highly recommend!

Really enjoyed the stay. Nice, comfortable area, and it's definitely close to downtown. The only thing I would say is the room I was in didn’t have a window that could be opened, so it got kind of stuffy and dry. A humidifier would probably help, but other than that, nice place.

Very excellent location in walking distance to great restaurants, bars, shopping, and the train so it was easy to get downtown as well. The parking spot was very helpful. All the instructions for check-in were very clear and everything in the apartment was as advertised. Perfect spot for a friend group trip. We had a really great stay!
We had a great stay! Would recommend, the location was great and the apartment was very clean! Jhon was a great host and always quick to respond.
Excelente lugar, súper céntrico, está todo cerca.

It was a pleasure staying at this apartment! It was one of our favorite we’ve ever stayed in; super clean, comfortable beds and sofa, and easy parking in the designated spot, as well as finding street parking. We found the neighborhood to be very quiet in the evening and the walk to the train wasn’t too bad at all. The owner was always super responsive and helpful and access to the apartment was really smooth. We will definitely be staying here again whenever we visit Chicago!

We had a wonderful time at Michelle’s place. We were two families with four children total and had all the room we could possibly need. We had to reach out about a couple of things and they were very responsive and quick to deal with them. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay! Samuel was an excellent host—friendly, communicative, and thoughtful—and his place was absolutely beautiful.
As cat lovers, we were especially happy with the adorable, cuddly kitties. Samuel did mention he could keep them separate if needed, which is a nice option, but for us they were a highlight of the stay.
Coming from a small town, the parking situation was a bit different than what we’re used to. There is free parking as advertised, though it may not always be right next to the property. That said, it’s still within walking distance and wouldn’t discourage us from staying again.
One small note for those sensitive to sound: the floors can be a bit creaky, so bringing headphones might help. This didn’t impact our overall experience, but it’s worth mentioning so others can plan accordingly.
Overall, we had a fantastic experience and would highly recommend Samuel and his place!

The apartment is in the china town neighbourhood, very well place in proximity to the convention center. The code for access sent in the check in instructions was wrong, and the hist took one hour to reply and give me a new code. I was lucky that another guest entered the apartment and shared the code. The bed had only a fitted sheet but no flat sheet. There was a small and thin blanket but it was not enough when the temperature dropped at night. I requested a complete set of sheets and a larger blanket, but never received a reply. Finally, I was bitten by bedbugs while in the apartment (more than 20 lesions) and reported the incident to AIrbnb support team.
A good place to stay close to downtown, place was clean and comfortable. Clear instructions for check-in and free parking is not hard to find
Great stay overall! It was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made check-in easy. Would happily book again!

Great stay in Chicago at this location. Didn't have to worry about parking since it wasn't downtown, but downtown was still fairly easy to get to when we wanted to drive in or take the subway which is a few blocks away. The Ravenwood neighborhood also had its own charm with lots of breakfast places and a grocery store just down the road. The host was very responsive and helpful. Overall, great stay!
Place fit description perfectly. It’s also conveniently located. We walked about 10 miles over the weekend just checking out different bars and shops. Would stay here again.
In Chicago for a conference, I waited too late to book a room in the conference hotel. This room was perfectly located and easy to use. It was perfect for my purposes and I would book it again.
Safe and secure, everything as described.

Great property in a great location--only a few blocks from Wrigley Field, with lots to do in the surrounding neighborhood.  Easy access to the train station, as well as the Lakefront Trail.  Check-in was smooth and the living space was very pleasant.  Only snag was a lack of communication during checkout, which is the reason for deducting one star.
This place was perfect for a weekend trip for our family of five.

I can say olga's place was easy to find on top of being comfortable.  I stayed for a weekend trip with a friend.  I will add if you're tall you will have to dunk.  Im 5'9 but I was comfortable, now a little taller that's when you'll have to dunk. Definitely would book again 🤗
Had a great week! Lovely apartment in a charming area of Chicago. Would highly recommend.

As a former Chicago resident... this is a great location for all visitors—close enough to the highway, city center, and one of the liveliest neighborhoods in Chicago. And yet, far enough from all the noise to get a nice night of rest for a proper reset. Ami was on top of communications and the stay was well worth a revisit to Chicago.

Had a great time staying here with friends. Excellent location close to many restaurants. Bedroom backs up to the complex’s rear staircase so you are often woken up to the sound of people leaving early in the morning. Had a great stay!
Enjoyed our stay here, a nice neighborhood and public transportation is very accessible and easy !
Perfect location. Walked the neighborhood for great food and drinks!
This is a super cute Airbnb! The Harry Potter theme was cool. Host was very helpful and responsive!
It was a nice place to stay. Very close to Chinatown! Jake’s place was super clean. Well taken care of and with modern amenities. Thanks Jake !

Great place if you’re a couple looking for weekend get away!!!  Very clean and cozy. Very comfortable pillows, kitchen was very full equipped, very quiet location morning and night. Host was very flexible on accommodating us  during check in and check out definitely recommend this place.
Hosts are very lovely and sweet people. They were very attentive to my needs. Will book with them again in the future.
The place met our needs perfectly.  It's in a great walking neighborhood and parking was never an issue.
awesome place.
Perfect place for a weekend getaway
Also provided a towel, toothpaste and toothbrush. It was neatly placed on bed.
Excellent stay. Home was easy to find and clean and well set up. We appreciated the loads of recommendations and excellent central location.

We loved staying here. The location was perfect! Lots of things walking distance if not then we would drive no more than 15min to a restaurant. Loved having the blue line and a Walgreens so close by! Very convenient. The overall place was clean and comfortable. We loved the cute decor in the apartment. We absolutely LOVED the shower :D the water pressure was amazing lol. We definitely will be checking to see if this place is available the next time we come back to Chicago!

We had a wonderful stay visiting for a wedding. Joseph’s place was spotless and everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The thermostat had an error code the day we checked in, and Joseph was at the unit fixing the issue within minutes! Always responsive to any questions, and efficient. Would love to book again when we return next year.

Nancy was a great host! Extremely accommodating to all questions and needs and even left a small gift as if was my birthday weekend’! If I ever need to come in town again I’ll definitely be booking with Nancy🩷 thank you for everything.!!
Love this place, super host
Great location between Albany park and Lincoln Sq. Explore both neighborhoods. Excellent communication with host
El departamento estuvo perfecto, como se ve en las fotos. La ubicación fue espectacular, muy limpio y la respuesta a las necesidades siempre fue rápida y útil

Decent space.  Shared space did not match photos on listing- actual space was better than listing photos. Bedroom did not have top sheet. Only fitted sheet and comforter. Room had strange smell. Decent stay for the price but can be improved.

I had an amazing stay at this airbnb! The place was exactly as described-clean,comfortable,and beautiful organized. The host was very welcoming,responsive,and made sure everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out.
The location was perfect and convenient,close to everything i needed.i really appreciated the small details that made the stay even more enjoyable.i felt safe and stay and at home throughout my visit.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and pleasant stay. I will gladly come back again!

This place was so lovely! It was right in walking distance of a ton of restaurants, coffee shops, etc. Clare was always so kind and very responsive if we needed anything. Would definitely stay here again!
Absolutely amazing host!

I had a fantastic stay at Sylvia's house. It was clean, quiet, and relaxing-perfect for me after coming back from a days at my medical conference. She was very responsive to my messages and let me check in early to accommodate my travel which was very kind of her to do!

The air bnb itself was nice. It was a little small, but it was comfortable. My biggest problem with this place was the parking situation. If you are driving, do not choose this air bnb. Every street requires a parking permit. Every. Single. Street. I wasn’t told about this until I got there and realized it. He offers daily parking permits, but not only did he not give me enough for the entire stay, but when I asked for an extra one I never got a reply. The parking is impossible. The permits only allow you to park on the street of the air bnb, but there is never any parking. I had to pay for a parking spot far from the air bnb.  The area itself is okay. The train station is about a 7 minute walk. The only real issues were the parking and the lack of communication.
Great host made sure all needs were handled though we had no issues. Just reached out to check on us a few times

Cheap, but nasty.
Stinky duvet cover and disgusting stained mattress.
I left 30 minutes after my arrival.
Great location, friendly host, would recommend!

Great location for the price!! However, this pretty basic and has a few quirks— No AC, train is pretty loud nearby, and you can hear the neighbors upstairs. The bed was bouncy and the couch was pretty hard. Brad was great at communicating, even tho there was a bit of a mix up with parking rules.
We enjoyed our stay at this apartment. It was close to the lake, a train, shopping, and food. My friends and I would definitely come back.

The place was lovely and it looked like the photos, if you don’t mind all the ornaments and arts pieces around then you won’t have a problem, other than that it’s a beautiful place! What I didn’t appreciate was the co-host of the building who in my opinion was unnecessarily rude to me and my partner and quite frankly didn’t need to be there at certain times, as he wasn’t helpful for anything and has a confrontational attitude about little things. The bathroom says it’s dedicated but can still be used if there are other occupants in the place. Other than that, Bernard himself was very responsive and understanding
Great home and location! Highly recommend staying here.

The good: The unit is well-kept and having two bathrooms was appreciated.
The bad: The building lobby reeks of smoke and left us feeling nauseous. The noise level from the trains, even with earplugs, is quite loud. Definitely wouldn’t recommend for light sleepers.
Wonderful second floor apartment with super attentive hosts on the first floor.  One of the best AirBNB experiences we’ve ever had.  We’ll definitely be back!
Convenient location for flight attendants. Easy access to bus and blue line (Irving Park), restaurants, chill bars and coffees shops, all in a quiet neighborhood.
Great apartment!  Comfortable and quiet.  It was the perfect location for our event right next to McCormick Place.  Will definitely be back!

Great overall stay. The condo was clean, well equipped, and had all the essentials to make us feel at home. It’s conveniently located in a nice neighborhood, within easy walking distance of cafes and restaurants. The host was quick to respond and made everything smooth from start to finish. We’d definitely stay here again!
Great

This place was an absolute gem. Everything clean and labeled. The host was very communicative. There was not a missing item from shopping bags to bath wash. Parking was never a problem. This  home had so many conveniences . We will definitely be back in the fall.
Paul’s place was a great place to stay! It was very clean and beds were very comfy! Super close to the airport. Would absolutely stay here again!
I had a comfortable two days at 747 Lofts. The location is great, right next to the Metro.
Super nice and spacious place to stay 10/10 would recommend.🤩

Carlos is an absolutely wonderful host! He is there if you need anything and super friendly. If you are going to games at Wrigley you could not ask for a more convenient location. We had a wonderful stay, it is a safe and lovely neighborhood! Living room is very comfortable to relax in when you aren't out and about. There are so many great places to walk to nearby.
Our family of 4 had a great stay at Natasha’s place. Very close to Millenium park and all the Chicago attractions.
Great place to stay
I had a great stay, Anny was very communicative and helpful throughout my visit. The room was exactly what I hoped it would be and it was a really nice location overall. Definitely recommend!
Great place! Amazing decorations and clean.

My family and I had a great stay at Kevin’s Airbnb! It’s very spacious and was clean when we got there. The location was also a selling point for us too. We were super close to public transportation, stores, and restaurants! Kevin also responded back to me quickly when I had questions. I highly recommend Kevin’s Airbnb for anyone visiting Chicago!

On the positive side, the location was great. I mostly used public transit during my trip so being right next to the brown line was a major benefit.
Unfortunately there were a few major downsides. The AC was broken and that was not communicated until I asked how to turn it on. My first night was very warm and no AC made it very hard to sleep. Having the windows open meant the noise from the street and especially the train were extra loud. The bedroom also smelled very bad for some reason. The second night I actually slept in the living room because of this. The only other downside was that there was practically no hot water in the shower.
Gogo’s place was super clean and really hit all the marks for us: cleanliness, comfort, and location. We had a great stay and would definitely come back!

I came to Chicago as a last minute trip, my friend and I decided we wanted to celebrate our birthday in Chicago and 3 days later we were packed up in the car and on the way, I unfortunately did not do extensive enough research and was denied entry to the hotel I had booked due to only being 18 turning 19, in a panic I went to Airbnb and rushed to try and find somewhere my friend and I could stay so that we weren’t turning around and driving 3 and a half hours back home. Within 15 minutes I had our Airbnb with Fabio booked, the Airbnb was cute and cozy and had a garage which made me feel more comfortable with my car, not to mention how amazing it was that they were willing to help my friend and I on such short notice with no judgment. Fabio was very friendly and helpful the entire time and made sure we were comfortable, my birthday trip truly wouldn’t have been the same without Fabio’s Airbnb!
This was a wonderful stay! Juan was a great host — responsive, helpful, and welcoming! The place was perfect — clean, comfortable, quiet, great neighborhood! 10/10 would stay here again!

747 lofts is a very convenient place to stay. It has many different bus lines and a CTA Station less than a minute from the place. It can be a bit loud at night, but ear plugs were provided. The hosts were also very responsive, which helped make the stay more enjoyable. Would highly recommend staying here!
Comfy

Outstanding stay. The home was meticulously clean with many thoughtful details. Not only well styled but comfortable with several higher end amenities, such as whole coffee beans, a lighted vanity, heated floors and plush towels. There is a lot of pride in this property. It is well situated in Pilsen with easy access to great restaurants and public transit.

This cozy basement apartment is very comfortable and Ray and Kay are great hosts! They were always responsive, helpful, and friendly. The neighborhood is great, too. I would absolutely stay again if I'm ever back in the area, and I highly recommend it to others, too!

The transition in and out was smooth. The instructions were clear and manageable. I love the fact that someone came to cut the grass and bushes. My family own two vehicles and there was always a place to park.

Jannel & Keith were amazing hosts,  and did everything to make us feel right at home. Aldo the location of the unit  is amazing. Close to the Red line, Lakeshore Dr, amazing restaurants and cafes and I am glad we picked their place.
Great location! Easy to find parking, cozy apartment with all the essentials.
This is student housing. Convenient location: target in walking distance and great coffee shop across the street.

Great location. Bedroom is clean and well supplied. Host is responsive and check-in/out was super easy.
May not be a great fit for someone who is going to spend more time in the Airbnb, working from home, etc., but if you just need a place to sleep this is perfect.

James was incredible and answered all our questions promptly. We didn’t have any problem.
The house was very clean and similar to the photos.
The only problem is that the rooms are close to the train line, so it was noisy (specially during the night).
Great location and very easy to find. I stayed here for a conference and found it just what I needed. Thanks!

Candice and Enrique’s place was perfect for us. We were looking for something close to our son who lives in Jefferson Park and this fit perfectly. It was very homey uncomfortable with everything we needed to cook. It was equipped very well. The host was flexible and met us when we arrived to provide us with information. I highly recommend this to other guests.

This listing is a two-level unit in a quiet neighborhood in Chicago. Complete with several bedrooms and bathrooms, it is a great place to stay in chicago for business. The game room and plentiful seating would also make this great for large families or gatherings. Host was great at providing instructions. I will be keeping this location in mind for the future.

Quiet, peaceful locality. Apartment was clean and linen was clean. Comfortable bed. One full fridge and one small. Apartment shows its age.  Living room floors squeak a lot. Kitchen door to the stairs is old. Front stairs carpet is also run down. Overall good value for money.  Demitri is a great host.

The place is smaller than it seems in the photos, but still managed to have everything we needed. It’s a great neighborhood with easy access to public transportation and lovely parks to walk in. I was impressed that they got a washer/dryer in that space!
Be aware: the bed is SOFT. Like, feels-like-a-waterbed soft. And, it’s a top floor Chicago apartment, which means the first person to shower will wait a long time for the water to heat up.

The apartment is located in a great spot. The building is an old building but the unit itself is renovated and was great and as described and shown on the photos.
Jorge was very responsive. Jaf issue checking in and he responded quickly.
Everything here was nice, clean and staff were very helpful
Great host very accommodating will definitely be back
Well-appointed space with snacks, beverages, and dreamy linens. Stayed here for  show at The Empty Bottle and couldn’t have been easier. Will reserve again if back in Chicago!

Great stay in a fantastic location in Chicago. Check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow, and I really appreciated the digital guidebook. It made everything simple.
The unit above was a bit noisy after 10pm, but that’s somewhat expected. Bringing ear plugs would help. Transportation options were convenient with buses, scooters, and e-bikes nearby.
Didn’t get a chance to use the jet tub, beach items, or family board games, but those were nice extras to have available. Overall, a comfortable and well-organized stay.

Gracias a Karina y a Brian por su hospitalidad y calidez, realmente no sentimos muy cómodos.
La casa es hermosa, acogedora y limpia, el vecindario muy tranquilo y seguro.
Cocina totalmente equipada y un plus los detalles que dejan para poder utilizar.
¡Muy recomendado!
Very cute area, enjoyed the home and there was lots of amenities were provided.
Loved our stay! The price was great and No issues at all - would stay again.
Everything was amazing. I had a great time in Chicago and will be back. This was a wonderful location and an incredible host. And George the cat was the perfect sweet and cute bonus.

We had a great time at Danielle’s place. She was super responsive and helpful, and had great restaurant suggestions (try Chilam Bilam!!!). The space was clean and comfortable, and was in a great location!  Tons of restaurants within 5 minutes walking, and maybe 10 minutes to walk to the Lakefront Trail. We loved getting to feel the local neighborhood vibe and would definitely stay here again!

This was a great spot to explore Chicago - close to many great neighborhoods by walking, and can easily catch many bus lines to get where you need to go.
The space is much larger than pictures convey, so that was nice. The ceilings fans and AC window units were very helpful on an unexpectedly warm day. The unit is on the third floor, which is helpful for noise, but fyi for those with lots of luggage or mobility concerns.
Small room, but clean apartment, responsive host, and sufficient place to stay, especially for the price!
Perfect location super close to everything will definitely stay again!

Such a cute and convenient Airbnb! My mom stayed here and couldn’t stop raving about it. She loved the proximity to downtown Chicago, restaurants, parks? UChicago…etc. I’m recommending this place to anyone visiting Chicago south side. Just convenient all around and the hosts are very responsive! Great great great

I stayed at Sujata’s for a few days for a conference and felt right at home! Sujata was very responsive and the place was amazing and super comfortable. It was easy to find as well and in a quiet neighborhood, making it easy to relax after a full day at a conference. Next time I’m back in Chicago, I’ll for sure look to stay here again!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb and would definitely recommend it to others. The space was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully set up with everything I needed. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with, making check-in and the overall experience smooth and stress-free.
The location was convenient
The place is great. Excellent location, amazing restaurants within walking distance. A+ host

I was a little confused at first by the color coding on the buildings, but a quick call and Brad's team sorted me out. The placement of the air unit by the head of the bed wasn't ideal, but I didn't have to use it during my stay. Maybe the bed can be rotated so the foot is near the air unit? Other than that, it's a really nice place at a great price in a great location and I wouldn't hesitate to stay again.

You are literally right next to a Blue Line station, so going places is super easy and convenient.
Super private and safe neighborhood, would stay there again!
This is the second time we have stayed at this location and it was great!
Doug made the stay very easy with his great communication. The garage is very tight and the place could use some sprucing up but overall a good rental.

Beautiful, private home in an amazing neighborhood - walkable to many spots in Wicker Park/Bucktown/Logan Square, and very close to the metro. The house had adequate space and the common areas and beds were very comfortable. The keypad code wasn't updated at my designated check in time and I had to wait for that to be reset before I could get in. The house also had very strange temperature regulation, where the guests on the bottom floor were freezing but the top floor was sweltering! I understand heat rises but the temperature different felt extreme. There was a ceiling fan on the top floor but would have appreciated another fan. Wifi was also spotty for the first two days which made it difficult to take work meetings from the house. I was happy with where we chose to stay but would have liked some fine tuning to make it more comfortable overall.
Très bonne communication et réactivité de la part de Tere. Quartier très agréable et proche de downtown accessible à pied.

This is an apartment building with about 90 units, that’s basically a large Motel 6.
The main issues were:
- The parking key card didn’t work which was a 30 minute hassle.
- Not shown in the pictures, there’s a large AC system that’s duck taped to a window and a big tube runs through the livingroom. When we arrived we noticed the whole rug in the livingroom that the AC was sitting on, was soaking wet. We couldn’t walk in the livingroom without shoes. When I contacted Milan I was instructed to empty the AC’s tube or clean out the vent. At this point I was done and left the night I arrived for a hotel. And the hotel was AMAZING.
- The bathrooms are so dirty with stains, dirt, grime, mold. I immediately knew I wouldnt be showering.

Very clear instructions for checking in and out, a guard at the front desk, a clean living space, and location very close to McCormick Place and walkable to a few corner marts and a few restaurants were pluses here. My workmates and I did a weeklong stay for an in-person intensive planning session. The house is clean and spacious with enough bathrooms + seating to accommodate our group of 7--the open kitchen even allows for several people to be preparing food simultaneously. Bring gripper socks especially if you have small children as the floors are slippery (host requests shoes off). At time of stay the basement bathroom was not stocked with soap/shampoo/etc, but all other bathrooms were and all had excellent water pressure. We were only provided with a single roll of paper towels for the week, but we were able to restock from the nearby Dollar Tree. Lastly, at time of stay the internet speed did not exceed 35 Mbps, and the hosts were unable to resolve it and told us to call Comcast ourselves, saying we would only need the location address. We declined to do so as we had already spent close to two hours attempting to fix the issue, but Sarah did grant our request for money back.
Very nice apartment, we had to leave early but enjoyed our stay a lot.

My friends and I stayed here for a conference and were ultimately disappointed. The location was great, close to the L and walkable to restaurants.
Access is only through the back alley, and the “front door” opens directly into a bedroom, which was not disclosed. This meant walking through someone’s bedroom to enter or exit. The basement stairs were very narrow and felt unsafe for children or elderly guests.

Review:

My husband and I had a wonderful time staying at Tracy’s place for nearly two months. First off, the location was perfect for us. Southport is such a cute street with plenty of nice restaurants and shops, and if you’re staying at Tracy’s for the cubs then you can literally see the stadium from the top floor bedroom window. Check-in was a breeze, and pressing a code for the front door lock makes it so you don’t have to juggle around a new set of keys. It’s also convenient that’s it’s your own unit, so you can come and go as you please. We rented Tracy’s garage too so parking was a non-issue but street parking is available with a permit. The place was full of natural light, and very clean on check-in, which is important to us, and it’s easy to maintain clean. Good water pressure in the shower, and a super quiet and safe neighborhood! Tracy was a great host, and was very responsive and helpful. We’re planning on moving to Chicago and would 100% stay here again while we look for a place.

The place was as described and seen in the photos at a very reasonable price. The neighborhood is very safe and beautiful. Assel was very clear with instructions and responsive.
Would recommend!
We loved our visit!

Отличная квартира, если знаешь, что такое старое чикагское жилье и близость к линиям метро.
Шумно, но вы должны быть готовы к этому, и цена это оправдывает.
Great host. Great place. Highly recommend.

The apartment was cozy, quiet, spotless, and in such a great area! We walked to get breakfast or lunch almost everyday, and the closest L station was only about a 10/15 minute walk as well. We loved the location and were more than comfortable during our stay.
The loft was wonderful.  Perfect for my needs.

This was absolutely perfect! One of the nicest I’ve stayed in. Matt and Nicole were beyond helpful and very quick to respond. If you are staying in Chicago this IS the best location and they are the best hosts.
Beautiful location close to the lake. Clean and comfortable. The hosts were friendly and helped me get my things inside upon arrival which was greatly appreciated. Great value for the money!
Very responsive hosts, all features as advertised. Great neighborhood, would stay here again :-)

Milan was a very attentive host. From the moment I checked in he reached out to check on me to ensure my stay was perfect. The place was very clean and the view of the skyline at night was amazing. There is also a big patio connected to the building located downstairs. I found the patio to be an extra bonus. Late check is an option if needed for a small fee and as long as there is availability. Thanks for the great stay Milan!

We booked this home for a company retreat with 20 people flying in from around the world, and it worked out really well. Everyone had their own bed, and the layout made it easy for the group to spread out comfortably.
The location in Wicker Park was great, with restaurants within walking distance, and having two onsite parking spots made logistics much easier—especially when unloading for our event.
The BANGTEL team was very helpful throughout, including assisting with arranging services for our gathering (they even helped coordinate hula dancers). Special thanks to Liz for making the process smooth. We’d happily stay here again.

Real quiet, clean, secure place with a great view.
Joe is very responsive and very attentive.
I had a good stay

The best AIRBNB I have ever stayed at. We can't find the number 4 billiards ball and the host answered at 11 pm and got a new set delivered the next day. The level of reliability and courteousness are excellent.   They also designed the place beautifully. The layout is well thought, so are the little things they added to make the stay even better like tide pods for washer drier, utensils, cooking pans, etc. The building it also very beautiful and is always clean, smells great and well located. The area is safe, convenient, and close to many things. Love love love the game room and rooftop. If you are visiting Chicago I highly recommend this place for sure
Host is amazing. I would definitely stay again, really spacious and well maintained.

Absolutely wonderful, seamless, and  peaceful stay in the apartment. the space itself was pristine and beautiful. My two other friends and I who stayed there kept marveling at the intentional an chic layout and also the thoughtful touches like the shower steamers and the laundry detergent for sensitive skin. While these may be small details they reflected such care and consideration.  I look forward to the opportunity to stay here in future visits and would highly recommend. also the location was centrally located enough that we could drive throughout the city easily  and having a reserved private parking spot was amazing.
Delia’s place was very nice! It was clean and the kitchen was amazing we loved staying here!

Perfect place to stay! Close proximity to general transportation, gorgeous views, and all the amenities of home. Had a brief issue that was dealt with very efficiently and did not affect trip overall. Definitely will be staying again any time I need to be in Chicago.

First time in Chicago, great location everything was close by. Just as pictured. Easy check in and check out instructions. Everything on the listing is accurate. There was even a folder on the table with a list of activities and restaurants near by. Would definitely book this place again.
very cozy, as advertised. quick response with difficulties, everything needed for a short stay at a cheap price
Venu was a great host, she was always very responsive, and she has a wonderful home.

El lugar es súper lindo, bastante accesible y el anfitrión responde siempre pronto los mensajes, la única observación es la limpieza del lugar “las cobijas eran sucias con muchas y las tuvimos que poner a lavar desde las sábanas y el cobertor del colchón, el colchón tenía manchas de sangre” por otro lado en la cocina encontramos algo en descomposición en un plato y debajo de eso un papel que tenía escrito algo relacionado a esoterismo
Location is great! Short walk to the blue line which takes you to downtown plus lots of bus stops near by and also great restaurants, coffee shops and breakfast spots close by too!
Mark was a perfect host and the place was lovely! I’ll return for sure!

Well located and appointed apartment. We had everything we needed for our monthly stay. I enjoyed the amenities in the building and being so close to my office in the loop, the movie theater, and Whole Foods connected to the building. The door people were friendly and attentive and the host was very responsive and amenable to booking requests. I will stay in this or other properties of this host anytime.

We visited for a concert at the Aragon Ballroom, and the Airbnb was super convenient! Just a short walk away, plenty of places to walk the pups too. Only difficulty was parking, but there is a two hour meter out front that was $5 and great for loading and unloading. Other than that I had to park a few blocks away. The actual space at the Airbnb was really nice! It has high ceilings, and my pups loved it. Definitely recommend!
This was a perfect location for proximity to the McCormick place conference center! Very clean and cute apartment! Loved access to the rooftop patio.

The neighborhood can be noisy if you aren't used to that, and two of the bedrooms are not completely closed off from the kitchen/tv room, so less than ideal for young children. The other two rooms are completely closed off.
We all liked it and are glad to have rented it.
Thanks
We simply adored our new home away from home! Welcoming, comfortable and well-appointed - it was the perfect spot for our family. We look forward to our next visit and our future stay at Steve’s.
Good 👍

We had a wonderful stay at Milan's place. It was conveniently located a short walk from the convention center. It was clean and nicely furnished, with a fully equipped kitchen plus tea. They provided a high chair and pack and play. Milan's team was very responsive and quickly addressed our concern when there were not enough towels provided initially. The only complaint is that the hot water was slow to come, and the showers turned cold part way through. However, overall we really enjoyed our stay and would book again with Milan next time!

Great space, lots of room, comfortable furnishings.  Checked a lot of boxes for us - location, comfortable beds, ample space, walkable to many things, kitchen had what we needed.  Our one complaint was the key to get in is very tricky.  Would highly recommend getting a keyless entry.  Other than that, host was great except communicating at the beginning.  Airbnb accidentally cancelled my reservation and Heather was on top of it to ensure it would be rebooked since they made a mistake.  But when I asked two questions, I didn't hear from her - one was confirming there was a hair dryer there (never responded) and then asked for specific restaurant recommendations (never responded) which was weird because her prior message said "just let me know if you'd like any specific recommendations!".  Perhaps she didn't see it because then got the final message with check out instructions.

Al final viaje solo, y reservé el P1. Lo encontré limpio y tal cual se describe en el anuncio. Me gustó que era una estancia amplia y con un candado extra. Compartí casa con algunos miembros pero todo muy tranquilo.
Respecto de la ubicación me pareció bastante accesible, cerca de tiendas, restaurantes y a 10 mins de la estación del railway para moverte hacia downtown. Había paradas de camión a unos pasos lo que facilitó explorar más allá de la calle. Lo único que pediría sería un poco de flexibilidad para entrar ya que como extranjero dependemos de las aerolíneas.
We stayed here for a family reunion. It was spacious, easy to find. The school down the street has a walkable playground which was great for our kids.
A game changer for staying in Chicago, highly recommend
We enjoyed our stay. It was very close to the wrigley field and that’s what we wanted.

We had a great visit at dons place . The location was less than 5 min from Wrigley field and the restaurants and bars. Don gave us a bunch of recommendations of places to eat. His place is super nice with a great balcony . His kitchen is fully stocked if you’re  planning on cooking. The house is very clean and the beds comfy. Plenty of towels were left to be used. Thanks for having us

Beautiful, cozy home with quiet setting, yet conveniently close to downtown.
Nicholas is friendly, responsive, and a great host.
Highly recommended!

Infelizmente por problemas da cia aérea acabei por usar somente uma diária, mas foi o suficiente para ver que a casa é ótima, muito bem cuidada e completa. Cama confortável, cozinha bem equipada, boa localização em um local bem estratégico. Recomendo fortemente a estadia!
The room was clean and felt really cozy. Plus, Gloria is so nice!
Host was very responsive and helpful

Phoebe’s place was perfect for my friend and I.  Very clean, neat, adequate supplies.  The only item I would recommend is a full view mirror or another mirror in the hallway or bedroom.   The area was so accessible, quiet, close to restaurants, coffee shops and Walgreens for some groceries.  For a basement apartment it was so well laid out and constructed.   Phoebe was in touch if we needed anything but we did not, as the unit was stocked and the door lock was easy entry and lock.  I will definitely look to stay again when I visit my son who lived a 1/2 mile away.  Chicago is such a great city and Phoebe was a great host!!

Our stay with Matricia was nothing short of amazing. She was incredibly friendly and made us feel right at home from the start. The house itself was beautiful—spacious, well-maintained, and perfect for families. We especially loved the game room, the ample number of bathrooms, and the inviting porch.
The home is located in a great area—the Beverly neighborhood—with plenty of nearby shops and restaurants. Getting around was easy, whether we were heading downtown, to Navy Pier, or exploring other parts of the city.
I truly can’t say enough about how much we appreciated Matricia as a host. Her communication was excellent throughout our stay. If you’re visiting Chicago, I highly recommend staying here. We’re already looking forward to coming back!
Great stay, 15 minute walk to convention center, very clean, great communication from host.  Would stay here again.

Beautiful and super spacious apt 2 blocks away from Michigan av and just 1 to the lake. Perfect spot to get the best of Chicago. The view was AMAZING (loved watching the sunrise) the beds were super comfortable, and we enjoyed staying here… the only bad part is we didn’t have good wifi connection, just in 1 room and we didn’t got a solution despite staying there for 5 days. Had to camp in the master bedroom to get connection.
Great place and useful location. Felt safe and good transport links.

This place was great! Mera was responsive and courteous. I will say the train near by is loud and comes often. Which would deter me from booking this location again. But, that’s not the host’s fault.
Overall good but loud! If you don’t mind the noise it’s a 10/10
Overall perfect place while going to a local conference
Great spot to stay if you’re going to a cubs game. Very walkable to a lot of stuff around the stadium.

A nice place very close to a bus stop. 10 min ride to the convention center. The apartment was very clean and comfortable . The master bathroom could be updated but overall everything was very clean so no issues. Coffee and tea station was provided . Kitchen was large , clean, and had basic dishes for simple meals
This place was great, the private garage access was amazing as well. Well kept terrace, well stocked kitchen, nice touches with books for adults and children alike.

This place has everything, really. We lucked out on getting this space and its proximity to everything we needed. The L train can get you to anywhere you need, amazing food and corner store are near by. Everyone was incredibly kind and accommodating!

The space was very clean and comfortable. It felt a little smaller than the pictures, but we were in town for an event so we were only here a couple of days and it was no big deal. The host was responsive, helpful, and kind. He allowed us to check out a little late when our train got changed unexpectedly - which we greatly appreciated!
If you plan to watch much TV, know that there didn’t seem to be anything connected, so we logged into our own Netflix account. Also not a huge deal, but I think it’s important to know if you’re staying here. The apartment also gets quite warm but we had both a fan and portable A/C available to us if we needed them.
The building is very quiet. The neighborhood is lovely. Overall, we were very pleased with our stay. The red line is close, there are lots of restaurants nearby, and also a Circle K just a couple of blocks away.

Great location in Chinatown and only 20 min walk to McCormick conference center. Overall great value and everything you need in the Airbnb. The only thing to note is it is quite close to the train, so there is some noise from that overnight. Austin was kind enough to let us check in a little earlier and was very responsive to messages.

Ryan was an excellent host—one of the best Airbnb experiences we have had.
Communication was strong from start to finish. He was proactive before arrival (welcome packet, early check-in), responsive during the stay, and very flexible as our plans evolved, balancing our needs with his schedule.
The condo was comfortable and exactly as described. We especially appreciated how thoughtfully it was set up—unlike many rentals that feel overfilled, this space had the right amount of furniture, kitchenware, and essentials, all of which were functional and not cumbersome.
A couple of cosmetic items (slightly dated carpet and some scuffed walls) could use a refresh, but nothing that impacted the experience.
Minor note—his DVD collection is… an acquired taste.
Overall, highly professional and easy to work with. Would absolutely stay again.

Place is as described. Good location, close to restaurants, bus stop/L station, and other urban amenities. Building was quiet - no major noise from the street.
Relatively new kitchen appliances - like most places, guests likely don’t cook much, but there are enough pots and pans provided if you want to use the kitchen, and cups, dishes and silverware for a meal for four people.
The building has creaky wood floors. If you are a light sleeper and someone gets up at night, it could wake you.
I would book again.
First experience at Wrigley Field was amazing besides the parking, which was expected. Having an air bnb so close made the experience even better then i coyld have imagined.

This is the second time my family has stayed there and we love love love it!
Highly recommend.
Very clean and cozy place. Bed was quite comfortable. Located in a safe area with grocery story and restaurants nearby. Excellent view.
Прекрасное место. Очень тихо, отлично для отдыха.Рекомендую
Everything was good during my stay, except the ceiling fan which didn’t work. Otherwise worth for the money

Place is fine. Unit is nice. Location is good. Parking is impossible. Building is dirty and noisy. Keys weren’t in the right lockbox. Owner unresponsive. Kitchen poorly outfitted. Owner/manager charges a cleaning fee, but cleans himself, and throws a fit if a pillow is left out of place. Next
Beautiful place and so close to the downtown area. Everything is just a walk away

Place was ok. Felt more budget than luxury. Worked for us because of the location close to the conference center. Felt like a bit of a throwback to college living.
One major issue was a very strong smell/fragrance. When we arrived, we thought it smelled like cigarette smoke/marijuana or something, but then realized that maybe it was the smell of the cleaning solution. We had to air the place out initially. It was so strong. It never quite went away.
Another issue was that there was an incomplete wall, connecting one of the bedrooms and the kitchen/living room. Which was not made clear in the listing to me. Would’ve been helpful to know in planning given that we were taking small children and my mother-in-law along. And quiet private bedroom space is a must. Could hear all kitchen noise from that bedroom.
Host was very communicative during our stay. Messaging daily to ask if we needed anything. We used the add-on parking, which was smooth.
.

Natasha’s home was lovely. Secure building, very close to the Bean and shopping street.
the linens were spotless, clean house. Natasha was responsive and alert to our needs and made sure we were comfortable.
Caryl’s place was lovely

Loved the location a short walk from Clinton station on the 'L'.  It was easy to explore all of downtown Chicago and Fulton Market.   The room is very comfortable and clean, exactly as described in the listing.
Uma experiencia impecavel! recomendo e com certeza ao retornar a chicago voltarei a me hospedar com a Kasa. Muito obrigado!!!

Great stay at Heidi's home. I stayed for a conference at McCormick Place which was around a 15 minute walk away (or there's a bus). It's in the heart of Chinatown with lots of restaurants around and a supermarket and a short walk from the metro station so easy to get to from the airport by public transport. Heidi was waiting to great me at the time I said I would arrive and gave me helpful advice on the area. Room was as described and pictured with two friendly cats in the house.
Very comfortable location! Spacious.
They were extremely friendly and accommodating , let me check in early. Place is so charming and in a great spot close to boystown
We had a great time staying here. The view was great and the neighborhood was very walkable to everywhere we were interested in going.
Deseree was very kind and responsive it was the perfect place for my boyfriend and I it felt very cozy and home like. Will definitely stay again if you partake this is also the perfect accommodation
Loved the space and location!!

This place was in a great location to attend a conference at The McCormick Center. I got a great walk in (15min) before my day really started and it was a straight shot to the convention center. The studio was as described and I was surprised by the quality of the bed and bath linens. Quite lovely. I am a big fan of the duvet and was not disappointed :)
The shower took some finesse to get the right temperature as there is a very minute difference between hot and fiery…just check the temp before you get in. By day two, I had it dialed in.
Overall a great place for a solo traveler to a conference at McCormick. I would stay again.

It was perfect, just what I needed as a cozy place for one person. However, it is roomy enough for two people. I love how Hena designed the rooms. I think she got an eclectic creative eye with the match of modern and classic.
Easy to get to local transportation and local stores in the area. Neighborhood was quiet, but the people in the area were friendly.

I was messaged 4 months after purchasing my stay about an up charge for cleaning cost, which made me weary of staying. However, we were still able to stay for the original price and we totally enjoyed ourselves! It was the perfect place for my child and I to come back to after our adventures.
Everything was great and as advertised. The host was also very responsive and helpful during the trip
Everything was really great. Definitely recommend.
We had a great time in Chicago and loved the space!

The host were very responsive and the stay was very clean and close to a lot of cool spots to hang out. They left a binder with very helpful information. If you want to go to the Cubs game or to some fun bars, it is a perfect location.
Really nice little place, great neighborhood with easy access to buses! the place is small and cute, perfect for two people!
Amazing place - beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood. Lots of great spots nearby and the L stop in easy walking distance.

En el lugar no funciona el aire acondicionado y quería repararlo estando yo ahí, muchos disparos y el carro baleado lo guardaron justo en mi parqueo, el lugar todo sucio y viejo, y la zona super insegura , las camas rotas y ruidosas y cortaban el agua a su conveniencia sin previo aviso, no hay lavadoras y el parque todo el tiempo lleno de carros ya sea lavando los o mecanizado al parecer tienen muchos clientes
Excellent stay!
Ross & Erin were excellent hosts. They were very responsive as we had some early questions as we arrived. Their condo was perfect for our needs.
The location is excellent, with numerous restaurants in the vicinity. The host was amicable, and the beds provided a high level of comfort.

It was an affordable and clean rental. Parking can be tricky which is a problem for everyone. The furnace was SO LOUD! Luckily we could turn it off.
We used it just as a place to sleep to visit nearby family so this worked just fine.
Very attentive host

This place was perfect! We were there for a conference and had littles with us. It was so walkable to the conference center, markets, restaurants, and a playground. Directions were clear to get in. Everything was clean. Milan was a great host!
Very nice apartment in a quiet neighborhood, close to the Blue Line train, easy access. Overall clean and well maintained. Excellent value for money!
The location was amazing and the space was clean! We felt very taken care of in the space!
excellent unit, all as advertised, I enjoyed my stay.
Milan was a great host. He was very communicative. Check in and check out instructions were easy. The apartment was nice and very close to the convention center.

The location is great — walkable to the best of Andersonville while also quiet and homey. Parking was easy and we didn’t need the car at all during our stay. The space is comfortable and thoughtfully furnished. For two adults and two young kids it was a solid home base and good value. Great option for visitors if you live nearby.

Had an amazing stay in Chicago! James and Jerry Lou were incredibly responsive and made the whole experience feel warm and welcoming, like a home away from home. Communication was smooth and easy throughout, which made everything stress-free. The house itself was absolutely spectacular, and I enjoyed every moment there. I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

The place was just as described and looked just like the photos. The beds and couch were very comfy, and kitchen and bathrooms had everything we needed. The location was perfect walking distance from restaurants and local transit. We would definitely stay here again!
10/10 would stay here again!!
What was advertised - good locale in particular. No issues with cleanliness and easy in and out.

Great place in a great spot. The bed is on the softer side and the bathtub was gloriously large and squeaky clean. Helpful and accommodating communication from the hosts.
As a first time visitor to Chicago, I really appreciated how close this place is to the Blue Line (Belmont station) and how walkable everything is -- I'd recommend checking out a film at the Uprising Theatre if you stay here, as it's so close!
This place was super comfy and just what we needed for our stay in Chicago … I loved everything about this location! I would definitely book again
We had a wonderful stay - the unit is in a beautiful and quiet neighborhood. Really close to coffee shops, restaurants, etc. It  was a short and safe walk to the Wrigley Field area.
Host team was extremely responsive and very friendly! Would absolutely recommend :)
Lugar muy cómodo! Tal cual la descripción. Me encantó 💗

Absolutely loved our stay here! The neighborhood is extremely walkable, from groceries, to restaurants, to clubs. The area is very clean, full of beautiful houses to look at on our nightly walks. Felt very safe. Locals were super friendly and everything is a 10-20 min walk.  The house was very clean, modern, and had everything we needed. Best stay in Chicago yet! We will definitely be back!
Great place to stay that was convenient to the convention center. Lovely morning light and enjoyed the peekaboo view of the lake.

It felt like being Kevin Flynn from Tron and living in an arcade. I was a little worried it would be that or a Jumanji situation, but it wasn't! All jokes aside this place is great, it made me feel young again and kick back surrounded by some all time classics in a generous space. Comfy accomodations, peaceful, everything in walking distance.
Video game lover paradise all around.
Stay was wonderful and peaceful. Host was very efficient with responses.
Great place to stay!  Depending on the room the road can get a bit noisy outside, but its not enough to disturb sleep. Great food around there too!
Really great place and location walking distance to everything . Had a blast !
Amazing stay. Great amenities. Perfect location near the the L

The apartment was in practice just as described on the website. It is in a good location and is comfortable with the amenities listed.
The only issue is the noise from the apartment above, mainly moving furniture etc around and TV level.
Great place for multiple people staying for a conference! Just a couple blocks from McCormick Place. It was spacious and really enjoyed the pool table.

The only negative thing I can say about our stay at Wrigley Roost was that, like all good things, it had to end! We had a five-star visit to a beautiful spot. The hosts are so hospitable, helpful, and accessible, and the neighborhood is absolutely picture-perfect. My sons and I loved walking to Starbucks every morning. Even though we were in the heart of the city and a block away from the L train, the house was pin-drop quiet at all times. It was just perfect. I cannot recommend this place highly enough. It is a total gem. We will be back, for sure!

Firstly, it’s a garden/basement unit, called “first floor” in listing, but below sidewalk level, so passersby can see in if blinds are open. And with “basementy “ vibe..always a faint ripe smell in certain areas. There’s lots of noise from footsteps (walking, running, skiipping(?)) on first floor above, early am to late pm.
Place is furnished entirely with inexpensive, generally uncomfortable furnishings, appliances & cookware…does have all the “basics”, but nothing more. And that’s too bad, because it could be quite nice if it were upgraded just a bit. There’s no comfortable reading chair, no dresser in the bedroom (a tiny little laminate desk is there instead…I guess that’s the “workplace” in the listing), and other than bright led overhead lights, no mirror light in the bathroom, and only two tiny cheap little lamps elsewhere in the whole place. Faux wood tiles are loose I’m multiple spots, and edges curling in others. And 3 rolls of TP provided for 3.5 week stay. Disappointing.
Really nice and spacious comfortable rooms
This is a really nice place and my dogs had a blast in the yard. I was also amazed how quiet the inside was even though it was on a busy street.
I had a lovely stay, thanks!

Tolle Wohnung mit vier  breiten Doppelbetten und drei Bädern. Alles neu und sauber. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Lediglich zwei kleine Pleiten könnte man verbessern:  es gibt mehr Schlaf- als bequeme Sitzmöglichkeiten, also einen weiteres Sofa wäre toll. Ebenso ein bisschen mehr Besteck beziehungsweise Geschirr. Aber das hat unserem Aufenthalt keinen Abbruch getan. Sehr zu empfehlen!
The unit was lovely! It was clean, had everything we needed, lots of free street parking, and great restaurants nearby!
Brandon’s place was awesome! So clean, such a nice area, super comfortable furniture and he had open and fast communication the entire time. Ideal for Airbnb hosts. 5/5.
Gavino's place was a great stay! It's close to the pink line and supermarket. Calm and quiet neighborhood. Will stay again!
It was an interesting place, near the bus station and also near to the McCornick place
Good place to stay for a few nights. Otherwise, I would try somewhere else.
Excellent stay - highly recommend
Visited Chicago for my birthday and Marco has been very kind and helpful! I fell in love with the place, and I didn't want to leave! Overall, I had an amazing time!

Esmirna es muy agradable y todo el tiempo estuvo pendiente de mi llegada, el alojamiento está muy cerca de la línea del metro y de varias paradas de autobús lo que lo hace muy conveniente para moverte por la ciudad

Had a great stay at David’s. The furnishings and amenities inside the loft were great (including the steam shower) and the location is excellent. You step out right into the action in West Loop but it wasn’t noisy at the apartment. David was also a responsive and communicative host. Would definitely recommend.

Centrally located Airbnb—less than 10min walk to the Red Line and only a block from the lake. Large apartment, relatively clean. Be aware that you can hear everything in the building. Not an issue for us, but could be for others.
Katie’s place was super cute! I absolutely loved staying here, super cozy and nice vibes. Walkable neighborhood, close to all the essentials. Would recommend!!

We can’t say enough great things about this apartment. It was clean and convenient to everything, yet also quiet and just off the busy streets. Our kiddos LOVED the bunk bed! Ewa and Tomasz were the best hosts - so responsive and helpful! We already can’t wait to come back and stay here for our next Chicago visit!
Jennifer’s place was really lovely. A beautiful home away from home that was clean, well kept and comfortable. I’d highly recommend!

Such a lovely apartment, the windows look over the trains passing by which creates more of a ambiance for someone tryan to experience Chicago & all it has to offer. Location is walkable to the majority landslides & scenery. Apartment is nice size, lots of windows for natural lighting, would recommend for someone looking to stay in the city for a couple of days on a wonderful deal !
Wonderful stay, lovely folks in the other rooms. A great place to rest in Chicago.
Perfect space, convenient to convention center.
was a very nice place nice and cozy
Nice place, it was our first time in Chicago and we had a great time.  Thanks
Enjoyed our stay! Close to the McCormick center which was perfect for our group who was attending a conference.

Apartment was as described and cozy. Bed, pillows, and sofa are very firm.
Great location - easy access to good restaurants and the Aragon Ballroom, plus train and bus stops.
Host was helpful and responsive.

Great place to stay! Lots of restaurants and bars to walk to. Felt safe and the hosts are very helpful/responsive.
A heads up about the construction next door would have been appreciated to plan accordingly. Or providing sufficient noise cancelling measures as there was lots of noise early in the AM.
Overall, would stay again and recommend to others. But maybe after the construction is completed.
nice area, walkable and close to the city!
Great spot

We had an amazing stay here! The location and parking were both convenient, safe & easy to access. The place has clean & bright & had great views all around, especially the rooftop. Assel was a very kind host. I would absolutely stay here again during another trip to Chicago & would recommend it for others as well!

Really good place with an amazing view. Place was very tidy and the check in was smoother than I expected. Only problem is that there were connected air vents with other houses so the restroom smelled of cannabis at some moments. Nothing to do with the stay, its just how the building is built I believe

One of the worst stays of my life. Location is the only point to consider for the price but so not worth it overall. Look for other options- you’ll save your trip from being ruined. Rude ill-mannered staff, picked up my belongings from my room and denied it until much later- refused to compensate for my things. Unhelpful staff with 0 knowledge and information, unhelpful useless hosts. Should’ve booked through a different app for better services. Dirty place- nothing works well in the room- the tv, the toilet, the AC . Old building a lot of wear and tear. A lot of noise inside and near rooms- some rooms have 0 natural light and the views from the windows are just a wall. Airbnb has been unhelpful in my case too. Will make me rethink every time I book via Airbnb again. Have been using Airbnb for many years and never faced such an issue in the past. From check in to check out it was a horrible experience. There was also an instance where the room was accessed for a non-urgent fix and the door was left open afterward in a shared home setting, which made me uncomfortable regarding privacy and security.
