Well, I have written a few of these now over the past 4 years ...  I sound like a broken record, which is good. Caryl is a great host, of a great space, in a great location! You won't find a better spot in Hyde Park.
Nice apartment to stay in, very comfy bed!

Overall, the place was okay. Paid for a 3 bathroom stay and was only able to use one due to no hot water running from the other two showers in the home. Tried to work with the host to address the issue, but was unsuccessful and the host was dishonest about fixing the water issue not once, but twice. Communication wasn't so great and untimely. Host did not follow up on addressing issues that were discussed resulting in me requesting a partial refund. Hopefully the communication and follow through gets better and they address the shower issue.

Beautiful space! It worked out so well for our weekend! The hosts were so accommodating for us and were so responsive to all of my questions since the moment that I booked. Everything was beautiful, there was so much space, the kitchen was stocked both in the main kitchen and there was more in the coach house. We LOVED sitting on the rooftop patio! Space was clean and the location was perfect! We were always able to find street parking near the home on top of the two garage spaces we had. I got so many compliments through out the weekend on my “great find”! Will definitely look to stay here again if I am ever looking to have a large group in the city again.
Great location and super helpful when I needed anything!!:)
Nice place! Julius responded really quickly to any questions I had.

PROS - Large house with several rooms and beds, we comfortably fit 7-9 people. Parking was easy to find, and neighborhood was quiet and felt safe. The pub across the street serves food & drinks, there are many restaurants within a walkable distance. Noble Thai was great for dinner and The Breakfast Club and Grill was a yummy breakfast spot. Host was responsive and entry was easy. The walk to the L train Blue Line Chicago stop is a pleasant 10 minute walk.
CONS - The layout of the main living space is tight for visiting, with a small sofa and a high top table in the nearby dining area.
Most bedrooms had no lamp (1 did upstairs but it didn't have a light bulb), I'm a big fan of 'soft lighting' so that was a struggle for me. The jets in the master bath do not work and the shower head was meh. If sensitive to animals, the house smelled strongly of cat / litter box particularly the downstairs, so we did not hang out down there apart from doing laundry.
Overall we would stay here again.

I can't say enough good things about The Dream Rental's home. It was clean, perfectly described.... and the best part... it was so much better than we even thought it was going to be! The previous reviews and descriptions left no doubt that we would be enjoying our stay, we expected that... but it truly was one of the best stays we've had. Thank you Dream Rentals!

We booked this Airbnb last minute for a Bachelorette celebration and it could not have been more perfect! The pictures don’t even do the decor and aesthetic justice! It’s even cuter in real life! Moumita was great and was very responsive prior to our stay and during. Overall, our stay was wonderful. The place itself was soooo roomy, clean, and in such a peaceful area. 10/10 would reccomend. :)
it was extremely clean and safe! the space was gorgeous and matched the description perfectly and the views were so amazing! i would absolutely recommend.
We stayed at Peter’s apartment for a long weekend of baseball and sightseeing. It was perfect for both. Immaculate and well appointed, we will definitely stay again.
5 stars all around. Condo was spotless, has everything we needed, very safe area, having parking in the same building is a plus. Will definitely stay here again and again.
Great place and the location was unbeatable.
Amazing place and great host!

We enjoyed our stay at David's place. It was comfortable,  clean and very well supplied. The neighborhood was quiet. We had an issue come up that was out of David's control, but he responded quickly and did everything possible to make sure we comfortable and taken care of. Would recommend if you're looking for a place in the Chicago area.

Angie was a great host offering flexible check in and check out per request. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed for our stay including spices for our food! Which was very appreciated! Overall a really enjoyable stay. Even the neighbors were very friendly!
Great host great location perfect place to stay to catch a cubs game and explore Chicago
Will return.
Simply put — great place in a great location with great hosts.
There was a weird smell to the place and was difficult to get inside. Host was responsive and overall stay wasn’t bad
Greg is the man. I’ll stay here next time
Nice and clean!

El lugar es muy agradable, con todo lo necesario para tener unos días placenteros  con lo necesario, organizado, sin bichos, las camas con colchones muy comodos, el baño bonito y limpio, con secadora de pelo, suficientes toallas y papel, plancha de ropa y juegos de mesa, la cocina está bien dotada, refrigeradora nueva, fogón a gas, cafetera moderna y microondas, amplia sala de estar con un televisor grande donde puedes conectar netflix, YouTube y otras plataformas de entretenimiento. Se encuentra en un barrio muy tranquilo y familiar, tienes un supermercado surtido y económico a 2 cuadras y muchos restaurantes a pocos minutos caminando. Puedes usar transporte público a pocas cuadras, en carro el downtown está a 20 minutos. Cerradura con programación numérica muy segura. Excelente experiencia, recomendado.
Amazing location around the corner from Wrigley! The large kitchen, second bathroom, and 4th bedroom made it great for a larger group with plenty of space to spread out.
We had a great stay here! The location is wonderful and the space was exactly as described. The host was very responsive and helpful with any questions.

I can’t say enough good things about the host and property. My only issue was that ride shares kept thinking it was the North version of the address. Even that was only a 2 block difference, so very easy fix. The pictures don’t do it justice! It was clean and so spacious!! The host also responded to a couple questions I had very quickly. This was a great stay for myself and friends!
The host was very responsive within minutes and very helpful. Airbnb was very clean and what I expected.
Great, clean unit and optimal location. Walter was very responsive and pleasant.

Whittfield’s place was great! It was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed. It is a nice, quiet neighborhood and a quick drive downtown. Whittfield was helpful and quick to respond. I’ll definitely consider booking this property again when visiting Chicago!
Such a beautiful space with comfortable beds and great shower pressure 😌 would highly recommend
Really enjoyed the stay and the area

The area of the Airbnb was nice. The host was very responsive when we had issues with checking in. The Airbnb was overall much less cleanly than we had expected. The hot tub was also unusable and there was no sauna as described.
Charming place on a quiet street! Stanley’s place is close to a lot of good food, great antique places, and the train.

We really enjoyed our stay here! It worked particularly well for us with the location being close to other family in the area and had just what we needed - nice bed, great bathroom, little office work-space for the morning, coffee and snacks were an awesome perk, skylight for natural light. Maurizio was a great host and was very helpful and friendly - he had great communciation. The shops and restaurants on Southport were just a short, 10min (approx) walk away - close to everything, but also has good privacy and is in a quiet neighborhood. I would highly recommend!
Great place and location.  We enjoyed our stay.  James was very responsive.

The space was roomy and generally comfortable. We did run into a couple of minor maintenance issues in the bathroom, like a slow-draining sink and a clogged shower. Hopefully these can be addressed for future guests.
Great location close to many restaurants.
We had an absolutely wonderful time here. It was the perfect location and the communication was top notch.
This place is so cute! Just what we were looking for. Totally worth it $

Our stay in chicago was wonderful and Michelle was a helpful host. She was extremely thoughtful, gracious and kind especially during a thunderstorm that ruined our night. So thankful for her kindess. I would 100% recommend staying with her.

Kiva was an excellent host. Responsive and flexible with our check time after a long travel day, it was a pleasure staying at his beautiful home. There is a puzzle of the national parks that we thoroughly enjoy as we got moving during our mornings. Thank Kiva!

Ericka was lovely to work with. Had an issue getting in the unit, but she was pretty prompt and we didn't have to wait too long. She was really surprised to hear clothes washer/dryer were too dirty to use and dishwasher didn't work. I think perhaps her cleaning crew isn't reporting things to her. Once she learned of the issues from me, she was quick to say she will have them fixed right away and was very apologetic.  Beds were very comfortable! Great having the 1/2 bath! Other tenants were very kind and welcoming! One swapped parking spots with me so my Tahoe would fit. I would stay here again.
Great place to stay!! Deborah was so sweet and helpful.
Very easy walk to and from Wrigley which was the goal. Safe & quiet neighborhood. I would recommend this spot to people looking to go to Cubs games or stay around Wrigley. Clean & as advertised.
Awesome bnb. Great communication!

We loved Roxanna's place so much. We were there on work so we didn't get to be inside a lot but we loved looking at all the beautiful art and books she has. Beds were comfortable and the place was clean and super cute. Roxanna is very friendly and responsive to communication. Would absolutely stay here again!
Great place and experience

Great stay at 422 Roslyn Place in Chicago. The location is hard to beat, right in a walkable area, close to the lake, and minutes from restaurants and shops. The home was beautiful and a perfect fit for the three of us, with well separated rooms that gave everyone their own space. The hosts were very responsive and made everything easy. Our friends could not stop talking about how great the location was
The location was able to accommodate our friend/family group as we booked the whole property. Joseph responded to concerns we had in a timely manner.

Great stay overall! The location was very convenient with everything within walking distance, which made our trip much easier. Having parking available was a big plus. Samuel was very responsive and answered all our questions quickly. The place offered good value for the money — would definitely recommend!
My wife and I stayed in the basement unit - MVP.  The location is second to none - right across the street from Wrigley Field next to the Sports Corner and super close to the Red Linde "L".
Very nice and smooth process. Alexandra was super helpful and responsive.

Beautiful apartment and looked exactly like the pictures. Everything was in working condition, and Chiara was able to provide a pack & play, and a high chair for our infant. Thanks for the wonderful stay.
Very cool place. Awesome location.
Juanita is an amazing, caring, generous host. I had an incredible experience!
Had a great stay at Amy’s place. Very clean, comfy couch, great location. Highly recommend!
Clean, well-appointed, safe neighborhood, and clear entry instructions. Good value.

The location and value of the space can't be beat. It's right downtown, walkable to Grant Park, the museum area, a bunch of great restaurants, and several CTA stations. That being said - bring earplugs and an eye-mask to ensure a good night's sleep, since you'll definitely hear the trains and have the sun streaming in at dawn!
We had a wonderful stay! The location was perfect and the space was comfortable, clean, and cozy. Tim is a great host and makes you feel right at home. Highly recommend staying here!
I wish I could give them a 0 because of the unexpected $500 deposit I was charged last minute. No parking for the crazy price they charged and place was noisy.

We had a great two nights, the apartment was huge!! Squeaky floors in the hall way as other reviews mentioned - but that is part of an older page like this - you get the charm too. The place was well stocked, clean and a great launching point for our visit to UChicago and downtown Chicago. Would definitely stay again! The address for the key was a little confusing, when you map to it, it shows a location that is gated off and you cant reach. If you just walk down the street you will eventually see it. A map would be helpful with the instructions.
Cedric was an excellent host and great communication throughout the stay.
Muy buena experiencia

Had a solid stay at Alma’s place with 5 other individuals. There were some hiccups at check-in with the codes, but Alma was swift in her response and the issue was resolved in no time. I would just recommend asking Alma for a few codes to try if you’re checking in very late. The ample number of rooms and bathrooms was perfect for all 6 of us. Bathrooms were clean and the rooms themselves were tidy. The location was great for getting around the city center. Overall, a solid stay.
Great location and perfect size for small family. Easy access to great restaurants and walking; 606 running path is only 2 blocks away; easy free street parking.

My sister and I stayed here for 4 days during our trip to Chicago! The home is located in a quiet neighborhood, which made it really easy to relax after being out during the day. The space itself was exactly what we needed—cozy, well-decorated, and very comfortable.
Everything was extremely clean and check-in was a breeze. The beds were super comfortable (I got great sleep), the water pressure was great and the place had all the amenities we needed for a smooth stay.
Charles was also amazing—very responsive, friendly, and accommodating. That level of communication really made the experience feel easy and stress-free.
Overall, this was a great spot and I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!
It was a great place! Conveniently close to everything we wanted to do downtown. It was clean and quiet and very nicely decorated. Saurin was a great host. Very responsive and helpful.
Very much enjoyed our stay.
Very clean and quiet neighborhood, quick responses and easy check in. Will definitely book again when visiting !!
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, making everything easy from check-in to check-out.
Very clean, beautiful home. Easy to get to. 5 blocks from the “L”.  I  will recommend to friends.
Absolutely perfect!
The place looked as described. Wish we had access to the front door bc it was too much climbing those steps all the time. The water got a lil cold pretty fast. Other than that everything was great!
Incredible location!!!
after booking, you’ve gotta fill out a totally separate form outside of airbnb and provide your email and consent to marketing contact in order to use the wifi. at least its fast.

Had a wonderful stay in Chicago! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect for exploring the city, and the host was very responsive and helpful throughout. Would definitely stay again!
Great place!
Thankful for this team's flexibility and making our stay easy peasy!

Kit and Jo were very accommodating. We were delayed on our flight coming in, and they were very flexible with check in. In addition, the instructions were extremely thorough. If you are looking for a more secluded stay (ie self check in, not a lot of people, etc), probably not the place for you. But if you’re looking for an amazing experience around Wrigleyville, the ballpark, and don’t mind the crowds 10/10 recommend.
Clean and spacious basement apartment , excellent response from host with any problems. Easy access to washer/dryer and parking was easily found just outside.
Very nice!

This apartment is in a vibrant neighborhood and is incredibly convenient for public transit and local dining. While the unit was clean and comfortable for lounging, I’d recommend it primarily for short weekend stays rather than longer trips.
The third-floor walk-up features very steep stairs without a railing, which was quite difficult to navigate with young children and luggage.
The unit is minimally outfitted. I wouldn't plan on doing much cooking as the kitchen did not even have a cutting board or baking sheet. A few small additions—like bathroom hooks or curtains in the living areas—would make this feel much more comfortable.
Overall this place would make a good home base in a cool area for a short weekend, but perhaps less suited for families or extended stays.
MJ was very responsive and friendly and the place is in a great location. Had everything we needed.

My family and I really enjoyed the apartment, easy check in! Street parking convenient! Lots of nearby restaurants/stores. Clean Home! We did not hear the neighbors, we did wish there were more TV’s haha but we made do! Thank you Jesus & Mayra!!

We had the best time staying here for our bachelorette weekend! The place was super clean, spacious, and had everything we needed to get ready and relax. The views were gorgeous and made the whole experience feel extra special. Perfect for a girls’ weekend!

It's a great small and tidy apartment with a short walk to the metro. Host was able to get us checked in early which was a huge help. The place had the essential amenities. The complementary water was a thoughtful touch. I especially appreciated the apartment view being on the 15th floor and the building had a nice level of privacy and security.

We did enjoy our stay and the location was very convenient for where I needed to be in Chicago for work. The apartment looks exactly like the pictures and was very nice and comfortable. Plenty of pillows, extra towels, and blankets. There is a very comfortable daybed in the living room area.
There is one step up into the lobby, then a flight of stairs with a comically steep ramp next to them, which works for suitcases if you really push!
Just be aware that it is an old building and the plumbing is old - if you need to shower before 7AM, it will be cold to lukewarm, even after letting the water run. I had to be gone by 7AM most mornings and had cold showers, but my partner had very hot showers when he showered after 8AM. The upstairs toilet needs to be flushed about 2-3 times even for toilet paper to fully flush away. For that reason I gave this place a lower value rating, but everything else was great!
They are extremely communicative and will message you every day.
Very responsive, clean and nice place
Shari was a great host and very responsive.

Our stay at this garden level unit was pleasant and easy. Clemencia was very responsive and even let us check in early and check out late to accommodate our flight schedule! The kitchen is stocked with the basics, and there are plenty of towels. A Keurig is available with mugs and creamers for the morning. It was walkable to the train. It was a great place to stay for a long weekend in Chicago.

I’ve had an Airbnb account for many years but never used it. This was the first time I used Airbnb and it was a great experience, thanks to serg. The place was in great shape & serg was just one message away when or if needed.
Great area to stay! Didn’t like the speed bumps because of how massive they were but everything else was worth the price, will be looking into booking with Johanna on my next visit!
Staying at Aminata’s was great!! The check-in instructions were clear and detailed. The space was share but very quiet. I would book again when returning.

Location was great to Old Town. However, it could have used a deeper cleaning, as there was dust, appeared countertops were wiped down entirely, and other similar cleanliness issues. Otherwise, no complaints with the place.
I stayed at Vladimir's place for a conference at the University of Chicago. It was easy to find and get into, and had newer amenities and was very clean. Thank you again!
wonderful hosts and location

This place was in the perfect location. We could walk to Murphy’s and Sons and Martyrs, where we had activities all weekend.
Beds were comfortable and the place was clean. We had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
Room was exactly as described, clean and easy check-in / check-out. Very walkable neighborhood in the heart of downtown. Would stay again!
Amazing hosts, very accommodating and communicative and appreciate that more then anything, place was clean and well kept as well can’t recommend this place enough!

Great location!
Lots of restaurants and the folks in the neighborhood are wonderful
We enjoyed our stay! Lots of supplies, easy access and comfortable beds.

I’ve now stayed here three times, and it’s consistently clean and comfortable. The location is great—close to public transit and fun restaurants and shops—and I’ll continue to visit as long as they’ll have me! You won’t regret booking this suite!

I’ve stayed with Bryan before and his place is so very welcoming! It’s within walking distance to my daughter’s apartment (8 minutes) which is why I chose it in the first place and I’m so very glad I did! Has all the amenities and is super clean! Added bonus is the garage space for parking your car! Looking forward to the next visit.
Thanks Bryan!
Fue un placer hospedarse aquí, se sintió un vibra tranquila .

This Airbnb was exactly as advertised and beautiful inside! Just one block to Wrigley field. Brandon was always quick to respond to messages and was especially helpful in arranging an earlier check in time. Can’t recommend highly enough!

I had a wonderful stay. The unit was attractive, cozy, and spotless. I really appreciated how clean it was! The bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, and laundry area were stocked with everything I needed. And the theater area on the lower level was a great touch.
Sheena was very responsive during my entire stay. She took great care of the property. She kept the snow shoveled and sidewalk salted during the winter months.
I enjoyed my time there.
Great location, quiet neighborhood. Comfortable apartment, will definitely stay here again!
Always stay at this place when in Chicago , best bnb I have stayed at.
We loved the area, the host was responsive and the recommendations were spot on. We would recommend it to friends and we would prioritize it for our next stay. Thanks!
Excellent stay, nice and cozy place. Easy instructions to access room. Made our first trip to Chicago feel right at home. 10/10

We enjoyed our stay at Rachel's place. It's a quick walk to Wrigley Field and plenty of restaurants to walk to at night.
I would 100% recommend staying here especially if you are you going to watch Cubs games. Rachel is very quick to respond with anything you need. There is also a washer and dryer which was not listed. This came in handy as we washed clothes before leaving. Thanks again Rachel!

It was a great place and very well kept. There is public streetside parking which is free as well, but given it's a busy area the spaces are limited. I was lucky to find one the second day. I didn't have a code to enter in till the time I got there, but I received it in a few minutes. The loft itself was incredible and very comfortable. The shower is in a glass enclosure and they have bodywash, shampoo and conditioner in dispensers.
Good value, quiet neighborhood. Beds were very comfortable.

The pros
The location is great
The host was kind and attentive
The price was good and
The beds were comfortable

The backyard amenities we were looking forward to were not available - the backyard sitting area. The immense about of piled up dust on the ceiling fan and
on top of the fridge and in corners was too much.
The old smell in the entrance area as soon as you walk in.
The apartment looked like a 15 year older version from the Pics on the website. Which was very disappointing.
The dishes were not clean.
The shower made a loud noise when we used it.
It was stressing to flush the toilet - not knowing if it would work or not because of the handle.
And safety issue with the tub not being level and solid on the inside, as I almost slipped three times while showering.
The couch bed has springs sticking out to hurt us.
The pillows didn't have protective covering.
The kitchen chairs were stained and broken.
Great stay and hosts

Everything was great! The only thing we did wish and struggled with was finding parking at night but Nicole and Todd had 24 hr parking tickets which also helped out! We love the space and its location truly a great experience!

Overall we had a relaxing weekend and enjoyed our stay in this clean and luxurious apartment! This BNB is secure, affordable, and very comfortable!
Host was very responsive and kind. We had an issue with the Thermostat and while we were out to dinner they asked if they could send their repairman into the apartment while we were out. We got updates that it had been fixed before you even left the restaurant. We got very cool AC from that point on!
I will say, that I wish the back staircase door to the apartment had a keypad lock. Since there was no path to the front from parking, I had to drop my wife off at the front door, drive through the back alley to park, and climb the back stairs where my wife would have to unlock the back door. It wasn’t that big of a deal, but it is a matter of convenience that would have been helpful for the first night bringing our bags up, especially since the directions take you to the alley parking.
We hope to stay again next time we are in Chicago!
very very quick to reply at all times of the day.
This was my second stay at Brett’s place and again it was fantastic. Possibly my favorite Airbnb in the world.

Our stay was great. The day we got there we had a problem with the WiFi and the host was very helpful in resolving this issue. Have a great recommendation for a deep dish pizza. All in all the stay was great, would highly recommend.

My family and I truly enjoyed our stay. From the luxurious condo itself, the stunning view and the abundance of amenities - it’s a wonderful place to be in Chicago! Also, I want to note that the building staff was some of the best and most kind in the city. Loved our weekend there!

A 3-minute walk to Thalia Hall, served the purpose of our trip. Safe neighborhood with restaurants and shops nearby. Comfortable beds and generally quiet at night. The National Museum of Mexican Art is a 20–25 minute walk and well worth visiting. Early check-in was appreciated.
Several issues affected our stay. Amelia's English was limited - they should make guests aware. Lights and power frequently surged. Internet was unreliable, watching TV was frustrating. Remote barely worked. The sound bar was broken. Floors were very slippery. Water pressure was low. Towels and bedding were extremely scented - fragrance transferred to our belongings.
Cluttered decor left little room for personal items. Bedrooms felt crowded & no bedside reading lights. Upstairs noise starts at 6:30am.
Coffee maker listed but not there. They provided one but no filters were included. Host response times were slow.
Walkable restaurant cuisine limited. Sexually oriented themes in the bedroom. Cluttered decor.

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had. The check‑in process was smooth, the space was immaculate, and every detail was clearly thought through—from the comfortable bedding to the fully stocked kitchen. The host communicated quickly and kindly, which made the entire trip stress‑free. The area was quiet but close to everything I needed. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a top‑tier stay.
A perfect stay in Logan Square! The airbnb is exactly as described/shown in photos. Would absolutely stay again!
We really enjoyed the place

My girlfriend and I had a pretty nice stay at our 1st Airbnb. Eric was a pretty good host very responsive and respectful. I did like how we're a little out of the city as well and we found some niche spots next to our Airbnb. All in all it's worth all I paid for and that's all I can ask for.

Jose’s place was mostly as described.
Received the codes but the door code was transcribed incorrectly so I had to wait for a response and correct code which was made more unfortunate by my super tired 4 year old in a very hot hallway.
The apartment reached 80 degrees and though it is listed as having an A/C unit, I was informed they are not installed until after Mothers Day. No box fans provided so we opened 1 window but were kept up all night by wailing sirens and honking. It was raining outside so we could only open the window in the bedroom, which kept the curtain coming in and out making the room bright and dark throughout the night, kind of a huge bummer! 76 degrees in the apt when we woke up.
Jose did permit us to leave 1 hour later than stated which was kind but unnecessary. Parking is great, they provide a spot for you, which is a definite perk in a city! Lots of interesting food nearby!

Can’t say enough about this location - great spot near restaurants, bars, and lots of other stuff to do. Easy walk to the L and close to Wrigley Field too.
The apartment was just as described. Bed was comfortable and the building was quiet. The unit was spotless when we arrived.
All the above said, this is an older building - no elevator, just one small bathroom, creaky floors and noisy A/C units. None of those bothered us but something to be aware of.
Great location a couple of blocks from restaurants.  Very responsive host and a nice cozy apartment.

The apartment was in a fantastic location, within walking distance of everything we wanted to explore. The host was communicative and provided clear instructions every step of the way. The parking was convenient and the apartment staff were friendly and helpful.
Very clean space , nice neighborhood , very quiet. Would stay again

We are so happy we chose Matt’s place! It is a perfect, walkable location in Logan Square. Walk to stores, restaurants, the 606. The apartment was great. Big, beautiful and well maintained. Spotless, the beds were comfortable. So much character in this home - a snapshot of authentic Chicago. Street parking was easy and also a garage space. Truly a gem.
Spacious home that had everything we needed. Sandra was very responsive and friendly.  Great location.

Great stay! Loved the view of downtown and the lake.  Enjoyed being able to walk to shopping, Chicago River, and great restaurants.  Loved the red line was right on the corner, made it very easy to get back and forth to the Cubs game +Cubs won the game. Doorman  Chris was very friendly and made checking in and out super easy. Couldn’t have had a better time celebrating my birthday!!
Loved the vibe and cleanliness of this space! Has everything you need. Great location as well, it took us no more than 15 mins to get to Riverwalk and close to Hyde park. Thanks Vlad!
I love it

This was such a fun, unique space for our group of girls! There are so many quaint feminine touches that make it feel special- like little candlestick nightlights and chandeliers. There are multiple units and rental spaces within the building so we had some confusion over what we did and did not have access to, but Phillip was super responsive in helping us figure it out. It was a perfect weekend getaway!

We had a wonderful stay! The location was absolutely fantastic—close to everything and super convenient. One of our favorite parts was the attached coffee shop… it was so good and made our mornings even better. The space itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we needed. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!
rosa was super flexible and communicative! easy check-in and a cute space.

Beautiful house!
Very clean and well stocked.
The beds were very comfortable.

Had a great time. Everyone was in awe of all the upgraded features. High tech, you can tell they have invested a lot of money into the house and features. We loved the theater room!!!! It was a nice meeting space for the family in the evening. 5 balconies. 2 full baths and 2 half baths. Walkable to bars, restaurants, the train at Division. We Uber’s a lot which was super easy. Target close by. The neighborhood was so beautiful, homes were beautiful and we felt very safe walking at night, which was important to us. Would highly recommend.
It was a good experience and a great place
We had a great stay here with friends!
Super comfortable and quiet location walking distance from the University of Chicago. Very spacious and had everything I needed. Thank you, Charla!

I loved the fact that it was very old timing and our small group of about 12 had an absolute blast getting to know each other playing some piano music feeling like we are putting the world away for a bit.
We really loved our stay here. It’s quite charming and creatively built and decorated. Unique touches for the area make it truly special.

Second time we have stayed at a Cloud9 listing. Apartment was absolutely beautiful. The view was amazing. Amenities in the building including the rooftop amenities were fantastic. Great neighborhood, lots to walk to. Restaurants, grocery store,etc. very responsive host. The apartment was absolutely pristine. Would highly recommend for anyone wanting to stay in downtown Chicago. Location unbeatable, walkable to Michigan avenue.

Very clean, quiet and comfortable. Well appointed and safe. The location is great: having easy access to local restaurants and neighborhood stuff is exactly why we get airbnbs. Thomas was very proactive and accommodating.
The unit was very clean and easy to access. Fit all of us comfortably and had a great time. I would stay here again!
No nonsense bnb - simple and to the point. Reminded me of the original spirit of AirBnB.

Incredible location, incredible communication, great places to eat, shop, get coffee, bars, etc.  All the things.  A huge plus was the location to the Blue line! Quiet neighborhood and not super busy and when we wanted to go to the busy loud spots, we just jumped the train and headed there.  28 miles walking in 4 days and always enjoyed coming back to our AirBnb at the end of night!  I highly recommend staying at Vanessa and Charlie’s and would love to stay again.
Great place to stay if you’re in the area, especially with a big group. It’s a very nice unit and Neel was a phenomenal host. Staying here again if we’re in Chicago for anything!
Terrific spot on the edge of Pilsen and within a mile of bars, restaurants, music. Great value for this place, but light sleepers be aware that it's creaky.
Our stay was great!
I loved it and would come back! great location

Great place for large group of people. Vary spacious for a group of 10 people. Convenient location with United Center and train station (blue line) about 10 min walk. Host was very responsive and helped us with a small issue. Would definitely recommend for a group vacation.
Very good location! Close to everything you want to do!
Affordable and what we needed.  Small complaints (remote volume did not work, broken mirror) but overall pretty good for the price.
Very Nice place will stay again if I ever come back to Chicago.

Wes was a great host! His proactive communication stood out from the start—he reached out with clear check-in details well before I arrived, which made the whole process seamless.
The bedroom accommodations were notably clean and comfortable, providing a perfect space to relax. It was also incredibly helpful that pets were allowed, as I was able to bring my dog along for the trip. Throughout my stay, Wes was very responsive whenever I had a question, always getting back to me quickly. I highly recommend staying at Wes's place if you're looking for a stress-free and high-quality experience!
Excelente, tal y como se ve en las fotos. el apartamento está muy cerca de una parada del tren que te lleva a todos los lugares turísticos de Chicago. encantado.

We stayed here for our annual girls trip. The place was a perfect size for our group, however the seating in the living room was limited to one couch and a chair. The beds were comfortable and clean. It’s close to the pink line train which goes to the Loop downtown. We did have some issues with the cleanliness of the place and a broken coffee pot,  but the host was very responsive and took care of things that same day.

My family and I had an absolutely peaceful stay here. We didn’t have to worry about security or any amenities. Everything was available for us to use and made us feel right at home. The only issue we ran into was the construction next door and the workers having their equipment in front of the gate door, but that was an issue outside of the control of the Airbnb. Everything else was magnificent.

We had a short but great stay while in Chicago for a wedding! The apartment looked as pictured and provided great backgrounds for some photos of us all dressed up. The host was responsive and provided even the small amenities.  The neighborhood was safe with several places within walking distance.
The hosts were extremely nice & accommodating!
Really close to the Blue line and a very quiet and clean place. Would stay here again.
This is a gorgeous place to stay. The views are breathtaking. This was also the cleanest Airbnb I have ever stayed at. We will definitely be back!
the location was so perfect to walk to wrigley field. the inside was so spacious!
Place was very clean. Andy communicated everything perfectly and helped out when i needed them. Would definitely come back

Brandy’s home was perfect for my family and I. The pics on the listing pretty much shows and tells it all. The area is ok and it’s super close to downtown and Hyde Park. There was plenty of parking out front and you get two designated spots in the back which was super convenient. The rooms were great and the amount of bathrooms make it even better when you have multiple women who all decide to get ready at the last minute. The basement is super spacious and has plenty of room for air mattresses if need be. The kitchen had all the necessary equipment we needed to do a big breakfast and dinner. All in all it was a good stay it was a good stay and I hope that when the time come I’m able to book with her again. You really get the bang for your buck when you have nice size family like I do. Thanks again.

Great property! Great
Location with parking. Perfect for our weekend in the city!

The place was clean and in a good location..felt pretty safe. We were able to walk to get coffee/breakfast. There is one allotted parking spot for the place and some pay to park options nearby for other vehicles. It was overall was a good experience!

Location! Location! Location!
You won’t find a better spot in Chicago. Also, there is a parking spot included, which is at a premium in Gold Coast/River North and is worth about $50+ per day in most garages.
Owner was super-responsive and very friendly.
Condo was very clean with a cool vibe - one thing to note - this space clearly states that it allows pets. While the condo appeared spotless, there were still enough dander and hair remnants to trigger my husband’s (very) sensitive allergies. So plan accordingly.
You won’t regret booking this space.
We had a really great stay, the place was super clean and the location was private. Would definitely stay here again.

Beautiful, sparkling clean, and amazing location! All of the little touches made a huge difference (eggs in the fridge, apples, some snacks, allergy-friendly bathroom products, etc)! The gym on the top floor was a great spot to get a workout in as well. The team was incredibly quick to respond with any questions we had. Such a nice stay!
Great condo in Chicago. Looked just like the pictures. Great TV. Beautiful bathrooms. Plenty of space, close to everything, very responsive host. Would recommend
Great location and very spacious.
Simple instructions, very responsive, I would stay again.
This a lovely house in a great neighborhood. The house is beautiful, clean, and well appointed. There are many shops, restaurants, and theaters in the area.
Very clean and comfortable! Tara was very responsive to emails.  Great location in a beautiful neighborhood.

I had a large group of friends come to Chicago for a long weekend and a Cubs game. Troves spot was perfect for this. Everyone had their own space, and the house was extremely clean. Wrigleyville is only a few minutes walk away and the R is right there, so very easy to get out to the city quickly. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying with a large group.

Mera was a wonderful host. The main, and biggest negative feedback about the place is the proximity to the train tracks — it is right next to them so you hear every train like it’s going through the bathroom. Makes it very difficult to sleep for most people. It’s nothing against the host, she was great and communicated well.
This is a fantastic place and we will definitely be back.  Completely as advertised.  Amazing neighborhood with a ton to do and easy walkable access to Wrigleyville.  Paul is a great host.
Simon was an absolutely wonderful, helpful, thoughtful and considerate host. Very responsive, very willing to help. Would absolutely book his place again. He makes you feel welcome and right at home!

Very disappointing stay. I’ve never canceled an Airbnb before, but this experience raised serious concerns. In one bedroom, we found a damaged safe that looked tampered with, which made us feel unsafe.
Cleanliness and maintenance were below expectations. There were ants in the living room, stains on the kitchen table, and the couch was worn out with what looked like pet hair.
Several items were broken or not working: bedroom blinds were damaged, corridor lights didn’t work, and a table lamp was missing a switch. The TV also had visible scratches.
None of these issues were shown in the listing photos, which felt misleading. Overall, the property did not match the expectations set by the listing and the lack of transparency was very disappointing. After confronting the host there was completely no help provided.

Great place to stay! Was close to the train as well as food, liquor store, Walgreens, etc were all within a 5 min walk.Having a coffee shop basically underneath the apartment was the perfect way to start the morning. The place was clean and has plenty of bathrooms. A great home base for exploring Chicago.

Spent the weekend and had a fantastic time.  The unit's location was super convenient, about two blocks from Wrigley Field, with little street noise during the night hours.  Unit was stocked with plenty of clean towels and linens. Jeavaux was super responsive on any requests that I had.  Need to point out that the unit is on the third floor with stairs being the only option; not a problem for me, just thought you should know.
good cost/benefit
Second stay here. Convenient, everything as expected. Great place for us.

Simply put, the listing was very accurately described by Cyndi and prior reviews. Spacious, comfortable, and pretty with lots of natural light. As mentioned by many, it can be loud, but nothing a pair of earbuds or headphones wouldn't fix for a light sleeper. The location was extremely central and we used SpotHero per Cyndi's recommendation to find affordable parking for our car for the weekend since we were in walking distance of so many attractions (or could get to further spots easily through public transportation). An additional note is that public transportation was extremely easy to use, especially if you have ApplePay or GooglePay, and Google Maps will help you find the best options and routes.
Place was beautiful! Brett was an incredible communicative host. Would totally stay again!!
Don was a great host! The home was very nice and in a perfect location for the visit to Wrigley field. Communication with Don was extremely easy. loved our stay!
It was very nice.  Very clean and we felt right at home.  We had an amazing time and felt very cozy being there.
Ty for the stay. Highly recommend this rental. clean and safe area.

Came to visit my girlfriend because she goes to Loyola and was super close for us and only 20 mins to downtown! Great spot super quite and will come again for sure ✅ Highly recommend- remote access to everything which is super convenient

Had a great stay here. Not sure why some people complain about noise, at most the train sounds had me thinking "oh, is it raining?" and street noise never bothered us at all (even on a Friday and Saturday night). The location was convenient to a lot of stuff, all of which is very walkable, plus only a short car or train ride to pretty much anywhere in the city you want to be. Place was clean and had everything we needed for our weekend stay. We did struggle with the metal door at the street level once we got the keys, but that turned out to just be me wanting to turn the handle while turning the key (don't do that, it won't open that way). Do be aware that parking in the area can be difficult at times, and don't trust 3rd party sites selling parking (expensive lesson learned). That's not a knock on the place or the host, just something to be aware of about the area. Overall though this is a great place to stay if you want to explore this neighborhood.

Great stay overall with just a few things that were a bit of a hassle compared to other Airbnb stays I’ve had. Check in and out instructions were on a separate website which was kind of a pain to navigate and share with others staying at the Airbnb. I’m always happy to tidy up after our stay just to make the place presentable or put back in order, but having chores (taking out the trash, etc) before they have a cleaning crew doesn’t make a whole lot of sense to me. With a jam packed weekend stay, you’d think what you pay would be enough to cover cleaning expenses. Overall a nice stay and a nice neighborhood. Would recommend!

Amazing hosts!  Michele and Marsh were very kind and welcoming.  Their place had everything I needed and plenty of space to be comfortable.  I would definitely stay there again if I should be coming back to the area.
Really enjoyed our stay at Jeff's comfortable, clean, and beautiful apartment.

This home was lovely.  The bedrooms, kitchen, and living room were extremely spacious.  The bedrooms had a ceiling fan which added extra comfort.  The host is responsive and helpful.  Overall it was a joy to stay here.

lovely house, beautifully decorated, and very comfortable! easy access from the expressway and plenty of street parking in a quiet neighborhood. we especially loved the patio and hammock! Nicole was great, responsive - wonderful stay from start to finish!
Great place, apartment was clean. Quick communication and helpful

This was a great place for our large group and we had a lot of space for everyone. We felt safe in the area and were only a quick uber ride from where we were going. Dario was very quick to respond. We would stay here again!
Jevaux’s place was spacious and comfortable. It was a great location for our needs. He was also very responsive to my questions
Amazing location, tucked away from the street. Great spot to explore the city.
Enjoyable, clean and comfortable location. Anny was very responsive and helpful.
We had a great stay here. everything was as described.
Beautiful old home with a lot of charm and spacious rooms. the neighborhood is quaint, and Cynthia was a lovely host! we would definitely stay here again.

Great location, amazing host, friendly accommodations, goodies in the fridge for breakfast, stocked showers as a man who doesnt travel with shampoo, conditioner, Qtips, very helpful.
Clean place, highly recommend

Great stay for a weekend trip with friends! Clean, matched the photos, and the location made it easy to get around. Smooth check-in and good communication with the host. Would definitely stay again :)

Such a great unit! Cute, clean, comfortable with a very well stocked kitchen. Loved the style and finishes. Very close to the train with a great coffee shop nearby. Hosts were super friendly and left some welcome goodies for us. We’d love to come back the next time we’re visiting Chicago.
Keenan was a wonderful host. The space was clean, comfortable, and close to lots of great shopping and restaurants!
We loved the location and found the place perfect for our needs. The outdoor patio would have been perfect if it was a bit warmer!
Don is great--very helpful and responsive.  The location could not be better.  We have stayed at Don's multiple times and hope to continue doing so going forward.
Never had a better host before on this platform. Absolutely recommend booking !
Will definitely stay again!
Great stay

The beds were comfy and clean, but the bunk bed needs tightened. The top bunk feels a little scary and wiggly. Other than that everything was perfect and I would stay here again as the communication was great!!!

Andrew is a really communicative Host. We stayed in contact the entire time.
The appartement was really clean and easy to access!
Only down side, the fridge and cabinets still contain food since Andrew lives there when the Airbnb is not occupied and we were a little surprised by that (considering the price of the night). He did mentioned that we can use anything in the kitchen, spices, …. which it is really generous.
But he offered to come back and remove it if we needed room.
He is a great host and the location is great, we were able to walk around, and find many spots to eat walking distance!
Overall it was a good experience!

Tim’s house is very cozy and the neighborhood is beautiful! It’s in the perfect location, just far away enough for the peace and quiet of a suburb but close enough to walk to anywhere. We loved our stay!
We loved the place and enjoyed our stay. It wasn't too far from all of the activities we wanted to do. The host was very nice and replied quickly. I wouldn’t mind staying again.
honestly a great place to get for the location and the price couldn’t ask for better plus you get to see the rural side of chicago great choice
Such a great spot for our girls weekend!! Close to restaurants, bars, shopping and the apartment had everything we could possibly need.

2박3일 동안 3가족(총6명)이 시카고 여행을 하게되어서 이 숙소에 묵었는데 매우 만족합니다. 사진과 거의 동일하고 청소상태도 괜찮았어요. 주방 용품도 다양하게 있고 집기들이 많아서 편리했습니다.
Sean's place was fantastic, it's great place to stay. We're totally 6, and this place met everyone's expectation. Rooms were clean and silvers & kitchen supplies were diverse and enough to use.
Great stay very friendly host couldn’t ask for more
We would stay again, and we already recommended this place to others!

The location was great, right around the corner from the train station. The area felt safe and nice. The apartment itself is very nice and comfortable, however there is a broken arm chair in the living room. We enjoyed our stay!!

I loved staying at the place! Absolutely gorgeous location, the living space was pristine, clean and well kept. Had zero issues checking in. And not to mention cute little touches like a glass full of filtered water in the fridge....would definitely 110% recommend this place.

A group of us were attending a conference at UIC. it’s a short walk, less than 20 minutes, to the relevant campus Forum. We were there quite a bit, but happy to have two bathrooms among four of us, a well stocked kitchen, and ample towels. The place is as described and pictured: the layout is a little strange to get used to, but nothing misleading at all. Thank you for the stay!
Wonderful place, location, and overall experience!
Afsha was very helpful throughout the trip and even helped ship an item we left behind after checkout. Great area for walking around and restaurants.

Great place to stay! Location is excellent and plenty of do. Only minor downside of this place is the upstairs rental. It can be very loud depending on who else is renting. Other than that, the place is great!

The place was pretty as shown in the pictures and location was great, in walking distance. However, please note these prior to booking: the rules were really strict, so make sure you read ALL; it's a 3-story steep stairways and no elevator to the penthouse; the door and frame to the balcony was impossible to open and may collapse if you try to open it; the curtains in the bedrooms had no shade; the towels were paper thin; there were zero extra towels, blankets, or pillows; barely any hand soap; the bunkbeds were unstable and squeaky (definitely cannot hold 2 ppl on a bed); there were cars parked in the alley blocking entrance to the super tight garage space. We cleaned the place!
Great instructions! Easy check in process and checked in every morning
This place was exactly what we needed. If I had to do it again I would rent it twice all I can say is we loved this place we felt at home.

Awesome spacious apartment with many amenities. Will definitely stay here again!
Mexican grocery store less than a block away with great food, definitely check out if you stay here.

The apartment is clean, tidy, and well organized. It also provides a pack and play for babies, which is very convenient. The neighborhood is great—close to parks, a lake, tennis courts, and a variety of grocery stores, including Eastern European and Indian food options. The unit is right next to a Starbucks.
There is a garage for parking, which is a very important advantage in Chicago, where street parking can be quite difficult. The host is very supportive and responsive.
Highly recommended.
great place to stay
My friends and I stayed here and felt right at home. Great food was a short walk away and this neighborhood isn't too far off the train line. Would absolutely recommend to stay here.

Such a cute place to spend the weekend. Very close to great restaurants, bars and Wrigley Field. Really comfortable for our group of 2 couples - the spaces exactly as described and we loved being able to have happy hour drinks on the back deck! We would definitely stay here again the next time we’re in Chicago!

A fabulous location for us to apartment hunt with our daughter! We parked our car in the provided ramp and didn't take it out until we left.
Extremely comfy beds and couch.
Kitchen had all we needed.
Thanks for a great stay.

Clean, easy to find, good communication. Best part - the bed was comfortable and clean up asks were minimal. All we were asked to do was to ensure dishes were washed and towels were in the hamper. Easy!

The place was very amazing, I loved every part of it. You had the whole house to yourself and everything was great. I was there to celebrate my birthday and my weekend of 4 days staying here was 10/10 experiences 😍. If I come back to Chicago I’m definitely staying here again.
Very clean hotel and was in a good area

The hosts were responsive. The beds were comfortable and it was very nice to have garage parking. It is directly next to the train and very noisy but we knew that from other reviews. The house could use some cosmetic repairs but was clean.
Great host, great location!

This Was My 1st Ever Airbnb . It was very nice and clean . Very comfortable and cozy . At night I did get a bit chilly . But I wasn’t freezing lol . The only thing I didn’t like was quiet time was after 10. at times it got a bit Loud after 10 .. . Other than that I would definitely book again .

Beautiful home which had quiet other guests. Be aware that you cant change the temperature of the home which was not an issue for me personally. Also I messaged once during my stay to ask if an iron was available to use and received no response so that was frustrating.
Great place to stay - close to the city and all attractions. I appreciated being right by the train station. Place was clean and comfy. Host is very responsive.
Easy access to McCormick place. Gym in the building. Responsive host!

I enjoyed my stay here and this place met all of my needs. The place had a few nice touches to label kitchen draws, cabinets, and stored blankets for easier navigation when only staying a few days, it saves time. I would recommend.

Asif and Karyn's place is nestled in a peaceful, tree-lined pocket of Logan Square. The location is great--a nice walk (20 minutes) or a quick car ride (5 minutes) from the restaurants/bars/other activities in the central part of Logan Square.
Both Asif and Karyn were incredibly kind, welcoming, and responsive. I enjoyed my stay!
Great place to stay for me and my husband. Enjoy the area in the heart of downtown Chicago. Exactly what I expected.

We had an amazing stay with Resolute Properties! The townhouse was in a perfect location—super close to our conference and very convenient.
The home was clean, spacious, and well-equipped. Each bedroom had plenty of space and storage, and the kitchen had everything we needed (even thoughtful extras). We also appreciated the modern appliances, TVs in every room, free parking, and secure digital access.
Safety was important to us, and this place definitely delivered—it felt comfortable and secure the entire time. Plus, the host was very responsive and easy to communicate with.
Overall, a smooth and enjoyable experience. We would absolutely stay here again! Highly recommend.

What a beautiful
Place! We had a family celebration in Chicago and this was a perfect home base for us. Carlyn was so welcoming and easy to communicate with during our stay.

Amazing place to stay! Phenomenal host as well. I stayed here with a group of friends for a weekend and couldn’t have picked a better spot. The host was extremely accommodating and kind and I couldn’t have picked a better spot to enjoy the weekend with friends. Look no further! This is the best place to stay in Chicago.
Location was perfect. Walkable to many restaurants and shops. 2 mile walk to Wrigley Field, which you should definitely take advantage of.

Jacob was extremely responsive and helpful during our stay! The house was absolutely gorgeous and has an amazing backyard set up. The neighbors are quiet. The house is very spacious and has plenty of rooms for what we needed and we were all able to spread out and feel comfortable.
Very nice place very well furnished, perfectly located and an amazing host. Would definitely go again!
It was a great clean apt, in a great location

The location in not the best, but easy to arrive. There is no air circulation and no window to open. The main concern was the cold, because there is no heater. I Enjoyed my time here! Host was responsive, reasonable and super friendly. I would return!
Incredible stay. Close to Wrigley, train stations, surrounding bars. Tons of soul, character. Cant recommend highly enough.
We had a wonderful stay. The location was great for visiting DePaul University and hopping on the L. There were great restaurants near by. Thank you for the great visit.
La ubicación es perfecta, toda las atracciones quedan cerca. Lo recomiendo…
Freddy was  a very responsive and friendly  host who immediately addressed any concerns
The place was just what we were looking for. a studio apartment with a couch that folded into a bed. Instructions were easy to follow and Bella did a great job communicating
Lots of space and sleeping arrangement options!

Great place to stay! Super conveniently located, Aldi right around the block, Ross as well 👀 Logan square’s just about a 10 minute drive away.
It had everything we needed & then some! They include tons of little extra goodies along with the essentials which we greatly appreciated. Super cute & walkable neighborhood. We’ll definitely be staying here again when we’re back in town!

Beautiful home-safe, quiet, clean, walkable, easy public transit from ORD. The price felt a bit high when I booked, but when I got to the space it all made sense. It was worth it since it met my family’s needs. Not clear from the pictures-and is a big bonus-the bedrooms do not share walls or floor/ceiling. No regrets.

I felt I was staying with family! I even went to the theater with her, as she had an extra ticket, and she outdid herself by picking me up to go! She provides full access to her groceries, which are varied and organized. Even drinks!! Rebecca is just the best host.
Our family thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! The place matched the description perfectly. It was very clean and comfortable. Would 100% stay here again and recommend to anyone coming to the area!

We had 5 of us staying at the house. We were in town for a Navy Graduation and spent a few extra days. Donald and team were incredibly helpful. The location is spectacular for a family - Fox Trot, Starbucks, Walgreens all within a block.

Nice, well supplied, clean, and fun place to stay.

Had a great time staying here for a bachelorette! Great location and close to downtown, but far enough away from the crowds.

Just as expected. I was looking for a quiet place near the UIC campus. The neighborhood was quiet and safe.
Very helpful and responsive host. The apartment is clean, and the area is safe and walkable.
Great location for a nearby conference. Room was everything I needed. Host was very responsive.

Cozy spot, responsive host, and super walkable to Bucktown and Wicker Park for shopping and dining. Slightly busy street but the noise didn't bother us. One bedroom has no windows, so great for sleepers who are light sensitive, less good for those seeking natural light. Beds were comfy.
Very responsive host, great stay. Awesome area, lots to do, and easily accessible. Would be happy to come back.

The place and host were great! Everything is in walking distance or short drive. The area itself is the roaring city of Chicago! The host is very responsive and is super knowledgeable on the city! This was a great trip and I’ll be back here again!
We had a very plesent stay here. Nice neighbor, close to public transport and the apartment is perfect.

Great location, several nice restaurants , micro breweries and shops close by.

Our first trip to Chicago for fun and not work and we sure had fun!

Nice comfortable apartment in great location. We love Albany Park. We enjoyed our stay and would highly consider staying there again.
perfect

Greta location for cubs game. Everything went well.

This was a great stay for us! We were in town for a weekend celebration and had plenty of room for a small group here. The hosts were incredible as well, super helpful and responsive.
Amazing area love this place!

Couldn’t have asked for a better location.   Walkable to tons of restaurants/bars/shopping/public transportation while being on a quiet street.   The unit itself had all the amenities we could ask for and was perfect for our weekend getaway.   Highly recommended.
Great Stay!
Great place with a great location!

Ben was responsive and helpful with our stay. The place has an amazing view of the city and when we arrived we found the Airbnb to be very clean. When something was not right, he fixed it and made it right. As for the location itself, it is in a great spot but is not as central as my group and I thought but was still awesome.
Great place and great neighborhood.

Albertos place was great. Beautiful morning light coming into the kitchen and dining room while the bedroom stayed nice and dark. Cozy, quiet, and perfect for one person or with a partner. Alberto was really friendly and gave clear check in and check out instructions. Would stay here again!

Our AirBnB was exactly as described in the listing. A perfect headquarters for our Chicago weekend. Comfortable and clean.  Walkable to a bunch of places to eat and drink.  We’ll look to stay here again when we return!

Natalie’s stay was perfect for our girls trip and night in! She was super responsive and helpful and the place was gorgeous, with so many thoughtful details throughout to make our stay great!  Definitely recommend!!

The townhouse was warm, welcoming and very nicely decorated. The only small thing I wasn’t fully aware of was the amount of stairs. Not a big deal.

Tara was an excellent host. Communicated well & in a timely manner. Instructions were clear and check in was a breeze. Perfect place to stay that’s close enough to downtown Chicago but not directly in the city. Listing is accurate to what was there.
My only complaints would be that one bedroom does not have AC. Which the listing does state that there is only 2 wall units in the building but just something to keep in mind if you have lots of guests staying with you. And the smell caused my allergies to act up a bit. Given it’s an older home I understand. Just kind of has a dusty/musty smell.
But otherwise it was a great stay. We enjoyed the location and all the amenities provided!
We would definitely stay with Tara as a host again!
Nice place, no problem parking. Would stay again.
Perfect location. Great place to have a good time with friends and family.
Incredible location being so close to the blue line - made travel from Ohare streamlined and simple. Plenty of places to walk around and felt safe in the neighborhood. Would recommend!
This place was so fun! Location was great as well. I would stay here again.
