This Airbnb is an absolute gem! The home is stunning — beautifully designed, spotless, and incredibly comfortable with a dream kitchen and relaxing outdoor space. We loved every minute there.
The location is fantastic — convenient to everything yet peaceful and charming.
The hosts were outstanding: warm, responsive, and genuinely went above and beyond. Their recommendations were perfect.
We couldn’t recommend this place enough. Book it — you won’t regret it! ❤️​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
House was clean and in a great location.
Had a nice stay here.
Great space and neighborhood!

The place is exactly what the profile is stated. I didn’t spend much time in the airbnb but it was very clean, quiet, bed was comfortable. The area was peaceful and quiet overall. I have no complaints or anything negative to write.
It was a great experience and smooth process to check in and check out. I really appreciate the convince of staying at Kanan’s place to walk around the city.

We really enjoyed our stay at this air bnb! The property was very clean, cozy, comfortable and had everything that we needed plus some extra touches such as snacks, drinks and coffee from the hosts! The Serenity Spaces team was very kind, welcoming, accommodating and showed a genuine care for our stay experience.
The only small drawback is the lack of sound barrier between the units in the building. This property is on the first floor, so the sound carried quite a bit from the upstairs tenants. Ademola of Serenity Spaces was amazing in trying to mitigate that for us, though, by promptly responding to me reaching out to her about it and contacting the tenants to request they lower the noise volume. I am just sharing for transparency but definitely want to praise the hosts for their actions in response.
It’s a great place to book when in Chicago for sure! You won’t regret it!

This place disappointed me. It's spacious, but the layout is awkward. The living room area in particular is not comfortable or well arranged. Check in was easy, but the locks seem a bit flimsy and don't feel especially safe. Noise from the upstairs apartment comes through the ceiling really easily. The location is mediocre. There isn't much to do in the neighborhood and it takes a long time to reach the main sights and attractions. The beds were okay, but some of the sheets were scratchy. Some of the rooms need more robust curtains to block out light. The only staple items in the kitchen were salt and pepper — not even sugar for coffee. Shampoo, but no conditioner. Not bad, but not great.
Great overall experience from check in to check out.

I loved the stay at Lydia’s ! It was clean for the most part and very organized. 3-5 min walk to the train station and 20-40 min uber to anything in downtown. Both the host and the co-host were amazing communicators !! The only thing that is “misleading” in their bio is that there is a “city view”  the air bnb is located far away from the city but once you get to the train station you can kinda see it. The guest that stayed with us were respectful and nice! All in all I would definitely be booking again for my next chi trip!

Ute and her townhouse were an amazing find! The price was amazing for being just 3 blocks from Wrigley Field & 2 from the Sheridan Red Line stop. The front door lock is a bit fiddley but she had explained that before we arrive and gave us tips on how to operate it more easily. The full sized bed apparently squeaks; another review said as much and my kid confirmed, but I could not hear it in the room next door. I think Ute must be an artist, or knows one very well, and has lived in the house for many years, because there as an abundance of interesting art and collectibles to behold all around her house, even out on the lovely patio! Ute was very accommodating and responsive to our messages throughout the booking process and our stay. We would defintely stay here again!
We had a great stay! The space is super clean. The neighborhood his lively and walkable. Jay and Margaret were both very responsive. We will be back!
Clean, comfortable apartment with everything you might need. Comfy bed! Very easy to get in and out of with nice location not on a busy street.
The unit was great! It had everything you would need and was fantastic for my group. Would highly recommend this listing if you’re looking for a place to stay while you’re visiting Chicago!

Matthew is the kindest host I think I've ever interacted with. He was incredibly responsive and always looked for a way to help out. The apartment is spacious, clean and wonderfully decorated. I would definitely stay there again.

Only one bedroom had an air conditioner. If it wouldn’t have had a cold spell,the other room would have been very hot to try to sleep in. I wish the doors to the place were more secure. But overall it was clean and affordable and worked good for a 2 night stay. The house was very easy to find and seemed like it was in a good neighborhood. Close to Joes restaurant.
Realmente agradable! ❤️
We enjoyed our stay at Edita’s. She was very responsive and the space was very welcoming.

Great stay in a great building. Fulton Market was right outside our door. The condo itself was spacious and clean with great views too. Loved that it had 3 separate bathrooms for each of the bedrooms as well.

Alvenna’s apartment is beautiful and spacious and my son and I felt right at home. I knew the Beverly area very well already as I had lived there a bit as a kid and my grandparents lived there most of their lives. It was so nice to feel at home in the neighborhood and in such a great place. Alvenna’s place is extremely clean, everything is there for you that you would want, and she is very responsive. We loved staying there and would recommend it highly. The next time we are in town for another event we will probably come back to her place.
Everything was exactly as advertised and Milan was an extremely proactive and communicative host.
very good
Janet was very responsive & answered any questions and requests I had, she was a great host, the house was beautiful!

Visiting our daughter and son-in-law in Evanston - we were close to them as well as the city - great home base for everything we had planned and wanted to do.  We'll definitely be back when we visit Chicago again!
Great location in Hyde Park.  Apartment was very clean and quiet.  Enjoyed our stay.

We enjoyed our stay!  The location makes it easy to get around downtown by foot and getting back to the airport was a breeze w/ a CTA stop one block away.  Millenium Park is a short walk and we made our way up to the river on Michigan Ave several times during our stay. There are multiple restaurants within a block or two of the Plymouth Building including a bagel shop within a pizza place, which was great for breakfast. CVS is also very close which came in handy. The beds were comfortable and the place was clean. The coded entrance provided a sense of security, and we felt very safe during our stay even at night.  We will be back!
I enjoyed my stay. Just wished there was control over the thermostat. But the host was able to adjust the temp.
Wonderful accommodations that were exactly as described.  Spotlessly clean.  Excellent bed and linens. The kitchen is amply stocked with cookware, dishes and spices. Next time we’ll cook.

We came in for my daughter’s bridal shower. We are not new to Chicago, three out of our four children live there. First time we rented an Airbnb in the city.  We loved it and will definitely rent again when we come back to the city. Ben was very communicative and answered all of our questions. Alicia L
Great neighborhood, I enjoyed my stay at this location. The host was really great and very helpful. Would book again for sure.

5+ Stars!  The home is easily accessible inside and out, safe, “spotlessly” clean and very well laid out.  The neighborhood is family-friendly and walkable to so many wonderful restaurants.  The house is also convenient to downtown whether you prefer to drive or take public transportation.  Matt was very responsive.  Check-in/check-out instructions were clear and detailed.  Everything was pretty perfect.  I look forward to staying here again!
My girlfriend and I loved this place. We celebrated her son’s 23rd birthday and he said he loved the city. Thanks!
Host was responsive and flexible (early check-in). It accommodated 3 generations of our family.  We enjoyed the unit and it was near our youngest daughter’s apartment.
The place was just as represented ! Wonderful layout and great for a group. Adrian was communicative and responsive to any problems. He was super flexible with checkin and checkout as well!

We had a great time in Chicago and our stay at Thomas and Cynthia's was perfect for us! The neighborhood felt safe and we enjoyed the local coffee shop, and small dive bar nearby. The unit was very clean and spacious, plenty of room for all three of us to feel comfortable. It was just a short walk from the subway stop, which was important for us to get around to both downtown Chicago and Wrigley Field. Every time we messaged Thomas and Cynthia, they responded promptly and assisted with what we needed. We would recommend to anyone looking for a place just outside the city downtown looking to explore Chicago!

This was a great place to stay for a large group! Alex was a responsive host and offered to come by to give a brief tour on the day we arrived. We had everything we needed in this house, including lots of extra blankets and towels. The living space has lots of seating, the kitchen was stocked, and the garage made parking easy. We did have some very loud neighbors until past 1 AM the first night of our stay, but the second night was peaceful so that may not be typical.

Michelle and Jared‘s place in Chicago was so wonderful. It’s in the middle of everything, walkable to Wrigley Field, and just feels like home when you walk in the door. It’s also a perfect place to bring kids. They have toys for kids, a bed for kids and they set up a pack n’ play when they found out we had a two year-old. Highly recommend and we’ll be back!

We absolutely loved our stay at Kate and Rick’s place! Location was perfect and everything was just as described. They were incredible hosts and provided temporary parking permits, five keys, high-quality toiletries, and plenty of towels!
We do this trip every year and we will definitely be at staying at Kate and Rick’s again!
Amazing home! I will definitely be back this year!
Great location and lots of space. Worked perfect as a home base for a long weekend. We were able to walk to Wrigley and enjoyed walking around to all the bars and restaurants nearby

Florin was very responsive.  Agreed til check in early and check out at Noon.  The place had 3 levels which was good for our party.  It is not at all luxurious as indicated in the posting.  Maintenance needed throughout the house.  The upstairs is warm while the downstairs is freezing.  The inside of the fridge wasn't wiped down.  Uncertain how long since the carpet was cleaned.  Old runners in the kitchen.  I am a Host our ABB home is immaculate and maintained well.  Anything needed is done as soon as seen.  Linens are 100% cotton.  For the price should be able to do the upkeep.  My nephews thought the place was fine and were happy.  Nice to have outdoor seating space.  A good pressure wash on the cushions and deck would make it nicer.  The bedroom downstairs has the ensuite.  The one on the main & upper levels have bathroom in halls.  Great location as walkable to Whole Foods, coffee shop, restaurants.
Great place, but the sheets werent fresh.  The location is close to all the tourist spots.

Beautiful Airbnb with wonderful location! Parking was rather easy and bus stops are a short walk. The place was clean and exactly as shown in the pictures. Super comfy with quiet neighbors. Overall, 10/10 experience! Would definitely book again in the future :)

This is a well equipped, comfortable, and spacious, 2-bedroom apartment. Location is great. Clemente is very responsive. The bedrooms face the street and noise level during the weekend can be challenging even with earbuds.

Great place to stay for a couple of nights. The host has their own bathroom, so you’re only sharing with the other guest, if there is one. Location is solid too. You’re  a block away from Humboldt Park!
Place was as described and we really enjoyed our stay! Being close to public transit was a major plus of this listing.

A quiet, cozy, comfortable location very close to the red line (was super easy to get downtown) + with walkable groceries and convenience stores close by (we stayed a month, so we went a lot!). Despite the room itself having no solid divider walls, the furniture arrangement worked very nicely to create individual spaces for privacy + the bathroom was a lot more spacious than we expected. Hosts were friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay again :)

This apartment was so nice. We visit Chicago so often and usually stay downtown, but with that location comes parking. So this time we decided to stay closer to Hyde park and avoid the costly parking. Excellent decision, we are still so close to downtown and historic Hyde Park. Parking was a breeze. We will definitely come back.
Isa was great and stayed in contact the entire stay. The home is wonderful and beyond comfortable. Will try to stay here on our next trip.
Great space, nicely redone. We used it for a small family gathering and painting party at nephew’s newly purchased condo nearby. Overall very spacious and comfortable.
We loved this spot, and host Anjali is super helpful and prompt with responses! Seamless way to get in and amenities were perfect!
We had a very pleasant experience. The place was clean and safe, which was important to us. The hosts were always available, whenever we had a question, they responded quickly and were very helpful.
Very cozy apartment, two bedrooms, which is great. However, we found lots of ants on the floor on day two of our stay, likely because it is a garden apartment.
Great location, easy to get to walk to places we needed to. Space was clean. Would recommend to others.
Just a place to lay your head.

Patricia’s place was really nice, clean, and easy to get to. One thing I wish I had known about ahead of time was the parking garage. It is a VERY tight squeeze, and requires a lot of maneuvering to get into the spot. For someone from the suburbs, it was a bit tricky. I drive a compact SUV (Bronco sport) and it was doable, but in anything bigger I don’t think I could’ve managed to park. Just mentioning this as a warning to those who driver larger vehicles.
The space was as expected. It is a cute apartment, though a little more decor would make it a bit cozier. The beds were comfy and the kitchen has the basic necessities (plates, mugs, silverware, and coffee maker). Split amongst four people, this was a much more affordable and comfortable option than a hotel.
Great location and space!  Bianca and team were very accommodating and quick to reply.

Sena was extremely welcoming and helpful with any request I had. She always responded promptly no matter the hour. She made sure I had every thing I needed. The apartment was clean and exactly as advertised. I would highly recommend it!

This was the perfect location for our family trip to Chicago. The parking was clutch, and the inside was so spacious. There was plenty of room for everyone. The location was also close to the Brown line- which made it super easy to get to our different events over the weekend. Check-in & check-out processes were super easy. We really enjoyed our stay here!

There were pros and cons of this apartment. The pros were that the neighborhood was safe, the apartment was functional, and it was very close to the blue line.
Cons were that the walls were so thin, you could hear the neighbors’ thoughts, the apartment wasn’t very clean, and the AC barely worked.
Good place and good host
Thanks for the stay! Nice, well maintained place in a convenient location. Can be a bit loud with hardwood floors and other guests walking up and down stairs.
Thank you!

Fantastic location!! Quaint neighborhood and walking distance to many restaurants and shops!!
Apartment was fully stocked with everything anyone would need to feel right at home.
Cody met me as I got out of my Uber, gave me a tour of the apartment and was always so responsive to any questions I had.
Highly recommend!!

Lovely neighborhood! I would definitely stay here again. It was nice being able to walk to the lake, restaurants, grocery store, etc.
AC worked well too, which I really appreciated:)

I personally wouldn’t stay here again- not because the apartment itself isn’t great because it really is a nice apartment in an amazing location. However, we were asked to pay a $500 security deposit which wasn’t mentioned anywhere in the listing prior to booking.
And to make matters even worse, the host told us to get our own toilet paper when we were provided with barely half a roll for 4 nights. Being a Superhost myself, this is completely unacceptable!

Location was great and room was cozy. Breakfast was a nice spread. We booked this place because they offered baggage check since we got in town much earlier than check in time. Come to find out we were unable to do so because we didn’t give a “24 hour notice” which was not made clear on posting or while filling out check in form. Host didn’t try to work with us and just flat out said no. Had to keep our stuff with us for hours which was frustrating. Clutter in common area.
Easy check-in process, very responsive and clean home. Thank you for having us!

Location was exceptional, public transportation was very close by.
Parking is very very limited on the street in front of the home. Yes, Matt and Nichole provided parking passes for our vehicle. However there were no spots close to the home. We were required to park 5-6 blocks away from the property. There are stairs going in and out of the kitchen and bathroom are somewhat if a safety issue. The kitchen ware needs updating. There were not enough dinnerware for seven guest. The rooftop amenities need a little attention.
Overall the place was clean and location was great.

We had such a great stay here! The space was incredibly cozy and peaceful—exactly what we needed to relax and unwind. The host went above and beyond with accommodations and communication, making everything smooth and stress-free. They were super helpful, kind, and considerate. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quiet getaway yet close enough to enjoy downtown Chicago.
Great stay. Well appointed apartment. The team at TIBO is very communicative and easy to work with. Would rent from them again the next time I’m in the area.

This place was great and exceeded our expectations. It has a classic old-Chicago vibe that gives it a lot of character, and the window view was a really nice bonus. Despite being in such a lively area, it was surprisingly quiet at night, making it easy to relax and get good night's sleep.
The location couldn't have been better, we were within walking distance of great coffee shops, restaurants, and bars, and the lake was just a short walk away. Having the Red Line nearby made getting around the city incredibly convenient.
Tere was also very responsive and quick to reply, which made the stay even smoother.
Overall, this was an amazing stay and a great value for the price. I would absolutely recommend this place and look forward to coming back.

Very beautiful apartments, a very convenient location, and a beautiful view from the window.
Thank you very much for the warm welcome!

This unit, and the hosting team were absolutely incredible.
The apartment was immaculate, comfortable, and the views! If you love Chicago you'll love the views from this corner unit. Priced perfectly for the area and amenities, close to everything.
Ben responded to any message within minutes and was super helpful. The instructions for check-in and check-out were simple and clear, easy to follow and accurate.
I've honestly never had a better AirBnB stay. Looking forward to coming back!

We had a wonderful stay. It was very clean and had had everything we needed for a family of 5. It was also beautifully decorated and very welcoming. A quiet and peaceful home away from home. Michael was very attentive and thoughtful. Thank you!
This place is amazing for 4 and it’s close to a lot of things. The host was responsive and clear. The price was affordable. I would recommend!
Great location to grab for when you want to vacation in Wicker Park. Junior was an awesome host.
Danny was extremely responsive and helpful in every way!
nice place and location. the bar below is a cool place too.

Great location. Comfy furniture. Clean and neat. Quiet neighborhood. Super accommodating host, Caleb!

Thorndale Avenue was quiet with wonderful homes and walking area is for a dog but was only 10 minutes from Clark Street where there’s so much to do. We’re thinking about moving to Chicago and this place left a really good first impression.
Great place to spend a few nights. Gives off a very comfortable man cave vibe. Lots of Star Wars stuff and a very comfortable bed.

This was our second time at this AirBnb, and it was a great experience both times. The host is responsive and flexible, and the place is really nice. Clean, great location, even free parking (in Chicago!) This is our go-to place when staying in the city.

This place was perfect for our two-night trip, amazing location between the shops on Clark and Lincoln Square Park, walked to Wrigley in 30 minutes. Busses on Clark, walkable to great food. Would recommend for short stay.

Beautifully appointed, pristine, a peaceful oasis in the city. Gorgeous garden, beautiful and creative interior. I was looking for a place to do creative work and I found Heather and JP‘s place to be restorative and inspiring. As hosts, they were highly communicative, gave plenty of recommendations, you can tell that they love their neighborhood and their city. I felt right at home.
Clean, nice place

The description and location of this place was great for what we needed and was there for. There are so many things within walking distance which was great. The only thing I would say (as a negative) was the initial check-in and having to call to be buzzed in. That was a first for us. But to each their own.
Other than that and tricky parking - it worked for us!

Everything was good, the Apartment cozy and the Kitchen well equipped.
It was quiet and there was Coffee and Netflix to unwind after a busy day. The dog was friendly, too.

We had a lovely stay at the flat, and it had everything we needed. It wasn’t too far from the Loop (around 45 mins) and the flat itself was very clean and organised. The living space was slightly smaller than we thought but enough seating for 5 people comfortably, and three bedrooms plus a sofa bed were great. Alec was extremely fast in responding to any queries we had, so overall would absolutely recommend.

Enjoyed staying for 3 nights. Cozy place. Accessible
Erik was so friendly and helpful. Calm neighbourhood. Very close to midway airport. Highly recommended
Really enjoyed our stay in a very walkable neighborhood in Chicago! A comfortable, convenient, and still affordable stay. We hope to stay again in the future!
I really enjoyed my stay, the place, the amenities, and the attention were all great. It’s a lovely space with a very thoughtfully designed interior. Thank you!

It was a pleasure staying at Tammy’s place. Everything as described. Proximity to the lake could not be beat. Red line a short walk away, bus just a few houses down. Ample privacy. Tammy was super quick when I did have a question. Met her 2 cute little dogs. Bonus: lots of birds singing in the morning and sometimes wild bunnies in the front yard.

Some dishes were a little dirty, microwave did not work, oven did not work because buttons were damaged. Provided place Pans were extremely scratched and some utensils still had grease on them, I got around that myself because I washed the utensils and had to buy my own pan.
I was dissatisfied with that, but I was extremely disappointed when I messaged Airbnb host for more paper towels and toilet paper because I was staying for a week. She did not respond and I had to go buy them myself.
The building inside the Airbnb has a heavy old smell, just to let anyone know if that bothers them.
Besides this things, everything was just fine but I was dissatisfied with the other details.
Good place to stay in chicago
Great stay loved the area!

A few of us were in town for a conference on UIC campus nearby, and the location was super convenient to campus as well as restaurants and coffee shops on Taylor St. Some of us also walked to West Loop! We love the little fruit labels in each room as well.

I am so glad I booked Lacey's place for my trip to Chicago. It was lovely inside, smelled great and looked so clean! Nice neighborhood (and it was really quiet at night for a city neighborhood!) and convenient to downtown. Lacey was a wonderful host and gave recommendations (thanks for the Revolution Brewing tip! Highly recommend!) I love the kitchen so much and the couch in the living room was so cozy. Bed was comfy and all of the amenities were just right! I will be back!
Un departamento muy bonito amplio , y cerca de todo lo turístico , caminando te queda todo cerca , o tomar Uber con distancias cortas , seguro para caminar y muy bello lo recomiendo 100%

Nice cozy place at the heart of Chicago, easy to get around to most of the city landmarks, and worth the money!

3. Place is well organized and full of amenities, found almost everything we needed in stock.

1. Place is a little small and not much of a window view, but not unreasonable given the price.
2. Neighbors can be a little noisy at night but the host took care of it once informed.
Overall, we definitely recommend!
Nice , clean and  comfy. I loved everything about this place . Walking distance to alot of stores and restaurants

Annie was a pleasure to communicate with, flexible and timely.
I love this part of the city, so close with a short walk to lots of great food as well as to the Blue line and plenty of other transport.
The room was perfectly set up – super comfortable, spacious and plenty of small details to add comfort.
I loved having a little sofa, I loved the bath shower combo, and really appreciate the little touches like some waters in the fridge (Also, that there is a bar fridge int he room – great!)
So the room feels like a self-continaed island, but you can still access the house and larger kitchen, dining area if you feel like a change of scenery. Super all round, thank you Annie!

Jackson (and the apartment!) couldn’t have been better. I ended up getting in at almost 2am after delays at ORD, but Jackson’s apartment quickly felt like home.
Although I didn’t get to spend too much time in the apartment on my weekend trip, one of the most memorable events was curling up with a book in the incredibly comfortable bed and watching and hearing the rain fall on the trees outside. The apartment is bigger than what it seems in the photos and was the perfect oasis of calm in otherwise busy Chicago.
The bed is also SO comfortable - I like a firmer mattress and the one at the place was perfect. The linens were also lovely. Thank you again, Jackson, for a wonderful stay!

everything was awesome, if I could I would give it four and a half Stars just minor issues like coffee maker but no coffee, door stuck a little so we had to figure it out, that sort of minor stuff. all of that stuff together is a half a star in my opinion otherwise the place is great and location was just perfect

We had a great stay at this place. The co‑host, Brendan, was extremely proactive and responsive throughout our visit. He consistently checked in and made sure we had everything we needed, which we really appreciated.
The location is excellent—very close to both downtown and the airport. Parking was a bit of a challenge at first, but Brendan arranged private parking for us, which was a big help and worked out perfectly.
The place was well equipped with all the extra cooking utensils we needed, along with additional blankets, making our stay very comfortable. We did receive a daily battery replacement warning from the fire alarm, but it was a minor issue.
Overall, the hospitality and convenience made this a great experience. I would highly recommend staying here and would happily choose this place again.

This place was great and perfect for us. It was extremely clean, in a nice neighborhood and the host was wonderful. Joanne was very easy to communicate with, always responding quickly. She had good suggestions and was very friendly. The bed was very comfortable with nice sheets-not scratchy ones. Lots of extra linens, pillows and blankets in the big walk in closet. The kitchen is fully stocked and the night light in the bathroom is a nice touch so you don’t have to turn on the overhead light in the middle of the night.
Will definitely stay there again.

Love the studio apartment.
Everything you need in one room, very comfy couch and bed, good shower pressure, and all the Roku you can consume. This was a great place to recharge and the value for the space is awesome.

This third floor apartment was perfect. Very spacious. Extra clean. The beds were comfortable.  We had everything we needed for cooking simple meals.  We felt welcome and at home. Including our dog.  Lots of grass by the sidewalk in front of the home.  Parking lot in the backyard was perfect.  Joan even managed to give us 2 parking spots for our 4 nights there.  The only thing I want to mention is that it is a third floor unit of a home built in 1906. The staircases are not adapted for someone who has mobility issues.  The steps in the front of the building were even harder.  It’s a beautiful unit and we felt safe in that neighborhood.

We had a great stay at the loft in downtown Chicago. The hosts were very responsive and gave great instructions on entering the building. A couple things to note, the AC was very loud and did not work that well so in the summer months it can get warm in the apartment. Also, while the sky lights are beautiful, they let in a lot of natural light so when the sun rises so do you. Overall, the stay was great and in a solid location.

The apartment is nice, clean, safe, and very convenient. You can definitely get by with walking and using the train. The host was very communicative and upfront about most things you need to know. Great location, very clean, and the host was extremely responsive
We had a great time at Brian's place. Will definitely book again when visiting Chicago.
great and very helpful and friendly

We had a great stay at Joan's Airbnb. We were looking for a place with 3 bedrooms (one with a king bed) and 2 baths for our stay in Chicago while visiting our daughter. This Airbnb was clean, well located, very well stocked with kitchen supplies, paper goods and plenty of bath essentials including multiple towels. Beds were comfortable and living area spacious and comfy. It's difficult to find units in the area with a king size bed but we had that and so much more including the rare perk of an assigned parking space behind the unit. We felt very safe in the neighborhood. The building is older which is par for the course in the city which lends to the uniqueness of Chicago stays, so expect squeaky floors and stairs. But nothing too bothersome. If I could suggest anything at all, tub mats or grab bars would be helpful. Also, Joan was quick to respond to a some questions I had even in evening hours which was reassuring and helpful. We highly recommend Joan's Airbnb.
Expensive.. but (almost) worth it - spacious and clean, at a good location.
Stanley’s place was fabulous in every way! We loved it!!!!
Great stay

Michael is such a great host! Very responsive and even allowed us to do early checkin. We vlogged the entire place to be promoted to other who will be needing a place to stay in Chicago area (YT channel: BsquadRNs) the place is very complete and organized, super clean and complete for all you will be needing. Thank you so much Michael your place will always be recommended. God bless
The airbnb was in a great location in north Chicago. Very spacious with off the street parking avaliable which was a must for us. It's perfect for small groups

Great stay! Such a great location - that was my biggest factor in choosing this Airbnb.
I went to the Cubs game on Sunday, so I checked in on Saturday and stayed until Monday. I'm originally from the area (grew up right off the Belmont red line), so it was nice to stay in the neighborhood.
They let me check in several hours early for a small fee, super helpful to get the most out of my time there.
The apartment is cozy, felt like staying with a friend.
Not perfect, but that's expected in any old Chicago building (if you want perfect, stay in a big chain hotel downtown). It's an apt, so a tiny bit of noise from the other residents but mostly very quiet actually!
The heater/AC works really well- my first night was cold, and the morning I was checking out was hot, so I got to try it on both settings 😆 - and there's also an extra fan and space heater and extra blankets.
A bit of light comes in the kitchen windows at night, but not a problem with an eye mask.
Overall 8.5/10 ⭐ 😁
Fantastic place! And great location. Loved Hamlin House!

Jasmine is a responsive and helpful host. Her place is simple, clean and tidy.
This was our second time staying there. Parking space is a definite positive. Walkable neighborhood, not far from the brown line.
Wonderful space . Very cozy and accommodating
It was a nice space and it was spacious. Beds were comfortable and nice local restaurants to eat-in. I love the easy check in and parking was convenient.

This place is a great value! It has a lot of old world Chicago charm, full kitchen, very clean. You're right in Heart of Italy, where people get engaged at those traditional fine dining restaurants. Tip for the elderly: don't grab the handle when the door's buzzing; that's how it keeps locking on you.
The apartment itself is very good. After we found our parking, we are good to come and go. However, we need some seasoning to cook with like salt, sugar, pepper...
Wonderful location just 10 minutes from most major Chicago attractions! All the appliances were super helpful, everything is brand new. Would definitely come back!

We had a wonderful stay at Beth's place - the location was great (super walkable and close to restaurants, shopping, two metro likes and a bus stop right outside the front door...). The place was beautifully furnished and well stocked with everything one could possibly need, down to umbrellas, coffee/tea w creamer, and everything else...spotlessly clean, and super thoughtfully arranged, and really cozy with a cool, modern vibe. We loved it there.
I had a wonderful stay.   The apartment was spotless, comfy bed, and great location near the Argyle RED line station.  The host was super responsive.  I'd stay again.

this was the second time within a week span we decided to stay with Ashley and it was just as amazing as the first time. we have added her to our favorites list to stay when visiting family in Chicago and look forward to more stays with her. its amazing, you get room service from the restaurant next door and they literally deliver the food to your bedroom door!! how amazing is that!? plus the free breakfast in the morning is a beautiful plus something you dont get at other air bnbs

We had a fabulous time staying at their place!! It was the perfect location for us with easy access to the city and local restaurants to order in or dine at. Upon arrival, there was this cute message on the board welcoming us into their home which we loved! Their place was exactly as described and shown in the pictures and extremely clean. They also have a large selection of games to play with in the closet if you are feelings up for it. We really enjoyed our stay here :))
Enjoyed are stay there will stay there when i come to chicago again very nice house 5 stars all the way

Neighborhood was pretty good, I wouldn’t be out at night without an uber. Can hear everything coming from other rooms. Place was as described, but could not control ac and it was a lil stuffy at times. Overall still a good value stay.

I know that it's hard to imagine a peaceful quiet place with lots to do near-by with easy access to the metros but this location had it. We were very happy with what was offered. All of the linens offered were cleaned and fresh. As our plan was to explore, we left everyday before 9 AM and had various return trips throughout multiple days. At any time the volume was quiet for the city. We opened the balcony door when we were there to enjoy the sounds and wind. You can tell that some of the flooring is starting to settle(it's an old house with wooden floors) but it's to be expected. I honestly would rent again and hope I get the chance to

Last minute booking and it was perfect!! Bart was responsive in a timely manner and the property was excellent for our needs. Location was near downtown and there were plenty of coffee/eatery/grocery stores nearby. The subway is just blocks away too. We were traveling with a person that uses a walker and the property was very spacious. Just a few small steps to enter the unit and everything on the 1st level was accommodating, especially the bedroom with a walk in shower. We'll definitely book again when visiting the Windy City.

This location was everything we hoped for and more. The space itself was so beautifully equipped for our stay. The Red Line is right out the door, making access by train/bus so effortless.  Groceries were right out the door - we never needed to venture to other possible stores. The sites and sounds of the city were fabulous. The view from the balcony is breathtaking. The front staff made us feel safe and secure. Always so helpful with getting our navigational skills oriented before heading out. I highly recommend this location. We hope to come back in the future.
Place looked very clean and hospitable upon check in, had all the required amenities to feel at home. Beats renting a hotel room. Edward was very responsive. Would definitely recommend to a friend

The location is good, and I felt relatively safe as a solo traveler. The room was exactly as described, and the bed was very comfortable.
I stayed during Easter weekend, so parking was very difficult to find. However, on weekdays during the day, parking is much easier. If you plan to come back late at night (e.g., after a concert), you may need to park a bit farther away. For solo female travelers, it might be a good idea to consider paid parking for safety.
The host was very responsive and addressed any issues promptly. Overall, I enjoyed my stay!

James was quick to respond to our trouble with the door lock. Nice spot, perfect for the three adults that stayed. SO glad we didn’t have to do a major clean up
Before we left as many airbnbs require!
Great location, clean, hospitable, loved it! Thanks
Such a cozy and clean place! Other than a party next door, very peaceful atmosphere.

I had a great time living here for the past 3 months. It is a great location with nearby cafes and gift shops, especially with the iconic Sugar Moon a block away. I enjoyed the nearby Blue Line station as well, since I had to commute to work to the loop area during the weekdays. The rental itself was spacious, and there wasn't much of a bug issue living in an upper floor. Lastly, I want to thank Vasileois for his communication, making sure I felt accommodated during my stay here.

We had to rebook a new Airbnb last minute and Rasheed’s place was just perfect. It came with valet parking. It was in a clean, safe area. Very walkable. Rasheed was very responsive. Very comfortable for our party of 5.
It was nice and cozy.
Beautiful apartment

Wonderful spot. Exactly like the photos and description. The apartment was perfect for 3 adults and very comfortable. Great design, amenities, and space.
Very great walking distance to Avondale and Logan Square.
Gatis and the other hosts/managers were responsive and the check in was very easy.
Would stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago with a group!

We loved our stay at Clemente’s place!! The location is amazing, with lots of great spots nearby in Chicago with easy access to CTA to get around the city. Our family had a wonderful weekend here in Chicago, with the ability to enjoy so much of what the city has to offer while being able to retreat and enjoy this beautiful home.

This place worked great for our three couples staying in Chicago for a long weekend. Located right along blue line and a bus line it made traveling easy. The area had great restaurants, cafes and live music. Would recommend.

Todo fue excelente, incluso le comenté que no estaba el secador de pelo y automático me respondió que nos llegaría uno al alojamiento en 30 minutos. El alojamiento es de mejor que hemos visto en dos semanas viajando por USA, en cuanto a calidad/precio.
Very clean place located in a silent neighborhood and not far from downtown.

This place was absolutely beautiful. The stores were all within walking distance, which made for a really nice stroll. And the loft itself? Amazing. It was fully equipped with everything you could possibly need, making the stay incredibly comfortable.
The host was also fantastic—very responsive, helpful, and accommodating, always making sure we had the best experience possible in Chicago. I came for my birthday, but honestly, I didn’t even feel like leaving the loft because it was just that enjoyable.
If I’m ever back in Chicago, I will definitely be staying here again!

I travel quite a bit for work. Kasa’s setup makes these business trips a comfortable excursion away from home. While simultaneously placing you in the pulse of everything worth doing in the River North area. I would definitely book with Kasa again.

Sean's place is immaculate! It was so well-stocked with everything imaginable: coffee, numerous clean linens, and pantry basics. Sean was an excellent communicator and check-in was a breeze. Everything was exactly as described.  I will certainly be booking this again as it met all of our needs and it was so conveniently located to transit and to great bars and restaurants. I really appreciated how fast the wifi was. This is a professionally and well-maintained rental. 10/10
It was a lovely apartment. All that you needed and comfortable.  Quiet at night we slept well!  We want to book it again

We absolutely loved staying here! We’re both huge animal lovers, so this was so perfect. We got to spend lots of time with the kitties that are a part of the sanctuary, and it made us really happy and felt like home. Esmirna gave us really clear instructions on how to get in, and made it easy for us to check in even at 10pm. The space is beautiful, full of color and life, and really comfortable to sleep and hang out in. Everything was super clean, and the kitchen was wonderfully stocked with so many spices and cooking utensils! The bathroom was also full of anything we could need! We met the neighbor, Coco, and he was so friendly and really helpful, offering to help or answer any questions we might have! We have ten kitties at home, so being somewhere that had lots of kitties to interact with made us feel really happy and at home. There were some really great coffee and food places nearby, and it was a short drive to the middle of the city. We will absolutely stay here next time!! 💜

We were traveling to Chicago to visit some family and to pickup my in-laws and we found Cedric's place to be perfect for our needs. we were familiar with the area so we weren't expecting luxury, but it was a quiet neighborhood and it was close to everything that we wanted to visit or see.
The hosts are great, and it's in a good location- tons of things to do within 10-15 min walk. The bedroom is of decent size and totally sufficient. Looking forward to staying again.

Garden-level unit on a quiet and safe residential street. Street parking was always available. Several restaurants, parks, and stores were within walking distance. The space was clean and comfortable. The host was friendly and quick to respond. We enjoyed our stay and will gladly stay again while visiting family in the neighborhood.
I enjoyed staying at Nancy's place, great value, perfect for my needs. Would come back anytime.

Place is decent. Horrible neighborhood but sturdy house. Don’t like having mandatory temp ranges in message after booking. Everything in the house works. Host nagged me about things his cleaners should have worried about after leaving and grossly over exaggerated how I left the property which is why I always take video walkthroughs before checking out of every Airbnb. If you don’t leave the spot crystal clean expect a nagging message. House is not bad but is old.

Overall good stay. Host very active with communicating with the guest. Loved that they had a few game options and a ps5. Location was good with the things that I came in town for. Would recommend others to stay
Attractive apartment. Clean and well-maintained. Very comfortable stay. Pleasant experience. Excellent host.

The place was perfect for a visit to Wrigley Field. Everything was within walking distance. Host was very, very responsive.
Would definitely stay here again.
Good communication and it was definitely worth it. Thanks!

The renovating job of the airbnb was bad and noticeable. The walls are very thin. Could hear conversations outside the suite. The floor was uneven. There’s no Tvs in the rooms just the living room. The pictures were way better than how it actually looked. There’s very little to no storage space , just a closet. The parking lot was behind the building which is also shared with other business so it could be a little crowed at times.
Beautiful and in a great location! We enjoyed our stay here. Thank you!
Loved the apartment!  Sarah thought of everything you need to make your stay perfect!   Great bed linens and towels!

We had a small issue at check-in with the lockbox, but Heather responded immediately and the issue was resolved inside of a minute.
Location is perfection - in the heart of Lincoln Park but so, so quiet on your individual street. Could not be better.
Unit is a bit older, but is perfect for a trip to the city as it has everything you need AND has two bedrooms.
Overall, a great stay!

Comfortable place and plenty of room for a family of six adults!!  And so nice to be close to the blue line (western stop)!  Austin was very responsive with our questions!  Would definitely stay here again!!
I personally would not stay again, other air bnb guests were noisy and disrespectful of my time and space. I was constantly up late because of cooking past 10pm.

Really comfortable and easy stay. The place is not only immaculate, but also interesting and cozy. Also, the loft space where I stayed was more private than I assumed from the photos and really felt like my own space. Marty was a great host -- present if you wanted him around, but invisible if you didn't. Location is great. Staying here felt like I was somewhere special.

Aiste a été une excellente hôte avec une incroyable communication, le logement est pratique si vous travaillez dans le loop avec la ligne de bus 20 et le United Center tout proche pour les événements sportifs. Tout s’est super bien passé le logement est confortable. La wifi peut être capricieuse de temps en temps
Simon was an amazing host! He had great recommendations for things to do in the area and the fridge was fully stocked! He truly thought of everything.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this Andersonville Airbnb! The apartment is beautifully decorated and felt like a home away from home. It was stocked with everything we could possibly need and then some, which made our stay incredibly comfortable.
Barbara, the owner who lives upstairs, was fantastic: friendly, responsive, and attentive without ever being intrusive. She struck the perfect balance and made us feel very welcome.
The neighborhood is just as great as the apartment itself—charming, safe, and very walkable, with plenty of great restaurants, cafes, and shops just steps away.
We would stay here again in a heartbeat and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!
You get what you pay for nice place very clean! Warm and welcoming host
Joan was super responsive. The neighborhood is great with lots around to do. Comfy bed, clean shower. I would stay again!
Good location, quiet and clean

Shay’s place was perfect for our group of 8 (4 couples). More than 8 would be a squeeze. Plenty of space across the three floors and the alley parking for two cars is a great bonus. Walkable from a variety of coffee shops and restaurants, and two blocks from the train. Extremely clean. The event venue next door can be loud, but shuts down at 10, which is exactly what Shay told us. If you forget toiletries, Walgreens is a 5 minute walk. We enjoyed our stay and would return!
This place is lovely and very clean. Great location. Reasonably priced and overall wonderful. Tippi was so responsive and helpful to all questions. Checking in and out was simple and easy.

The place is simple but clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for my stay. I had a private bathroom and full access to the kitchen, which was very convenient.
Jane was very kind and helpful. She assisted me with parking, shared useful local tips (including places for printing), and was always quick to respond.
I would definitely stay here again.

Joan was great. Communicated often and in a timely manner.
The unit is very nice. Well furnished and equipped. Clean & comfortable.
The location is good. Convenient to the bus and train in a quiet neighborhood. Safe and clean.
We did have a problem with the renters of the upstairs unit being unreasonably noisy to the point of significant disruption both during the day and at night. I appreciate that Joan was responsive & helpful in addressing the issue.
Amazing location to stay if visiting, close to everything. Host was great, responsive, place was spacious and clean. Definitely plan on coming back.

From the very beginning, Melissa was very friendly and helpful. The place was perfect and I had a great time. Upon checkout, I accidentally left something and she found it quickly and is going above and beyond and sending it back for me. I couldn’t recommend her enough!
Always a great place to stay!
We stayed for 11 days and it was quite nice. Wonderful views and the sounds from the water were really nice & relaxing ! Beds were super comfortable, and location was great.
Cute & clean, great location!

Plenty of room.  2 story walk up.  Fair amount of noise from folks upstairs, bar across street Saturday night and nearby elevated trains.  Inadequate water pressure in main bedroom shower, but other shower worked fine.

Great stay for our group of four couples - having a private bathroom for each couple was a huge plus. The location was perfect: easy walk to the L and tons of restaurants and bars.
The condo itself was great, with amazing city views from the floor-to-ceiling windows, a spacious common area where we could all hang out comfortably, and a kitchen that was well stocked with quality appliances and everything we needed.
We did have a small plumbing issue, but Nathan and Jack were super quick to respond and got it fixed right away. They also helped us out with luggage storage, which we really appreciated.
Would definitely stay here again!
Thanks so very much!

Centrally located in Wrigleyville, on a quiet street but short walking distance to WF and tons of restaurants and shops. The house is pristine and very easy to navigate. The host is extremely responsive, friendly, and straightforward with information. We had an excellent experience and would stay here again.
Great place for a stay. Danny was very responsive!!!

Overall the stay was good, the home was clean and the neighborhood was nice and quiet. We did have troubles getting into the home. The front door was not opening due to the knob being stuck. We notified the host and he said that someone was coming to fix it but that did not happen. We had to use the back entry everyday which was inconvenient being that there are two doors and a gate to get through and they all have different codes. Also the walls are very thin so you can hear everything that is going on in the unit upstairs including footsteps.
Lovely apartment with a great view and hangout space. Easy to make meals for groups and amenities were very useful.

Loved the place and the location.  Whenever I wrote Rafael with a question, he immediately responded.  The area is great.  We will stay here again when we come back to town if it is available.  No issues.

The location was great and we appreciated the clear check-in instructions. The apartment is cute and has a lovely kitchen and the bed was really comfortable. There was unfortunately a lingering smell of cigarette smoke in the unit, not sure of the source (could’ve been another building tenant).
We had a wonderful time and loved the property. The hosts were super cooperative. Would definitely recommend.

Nice place for the price! It was easy to find and check-in, clean, and the bed was comfy with clean linens. My only complaint was very strong smell of air freshener when I first checked in; it looked like a scent diffuser that was plugged in was leaking.
The location is great. Very walkable area with lots of great shops and restaurants nearby (don't sleep on the olive plate at the Middelbrow), and right by a stop for the L. It was possible for me to find street parking for the weekend too.
Great stay, super easy to get to and nice, clean place.
Location was great for getting around town quickly. Wound definitely recommend!

Brad's place (and his hospitality) were wonderful!  Loved the location and the large side yard as well.  Our group of friends had a great time here and loved that we were walkable to a number of coffee shops, etc. as well.

Great place to stay for easy access to Northalsted/Lakeview. The space was clean, easy to get into, and had comfy bedding. The hosts were accommodating with some changes to our reservation and also let us keep luggage stored for a few hours after check out.
Cute, private, and quiet space - only challenge was when unlocking the door the first time, which took a very forceful push to open (after that it opened fine).
Thank you!

The Bucktown House was AMAZING! We had 10 of us staying there for my roommate’s bachelorette and it could not have been more perfect. We were all comfortable and the space was so beautiful. I cannot believe how decently priced it is! We ran into Jean on our way out and she was so wonderful and friendly. The surrounding neighborhood is to die for—bars, restaurants, walking trails all so accessible while you’re still tucked away on a peaceful street. I can’t recommend more. by far a stellar Airbnb experience!
Had a great time, thank you!
Great place, in a quiet neighborhood but also just steps away from stores, restaurants, coffee, etc. Easy check-in very responsive hosts and everything was clean and spacey. Thank you!

What a perfect location for our weekend trip. We were coming in for our daughter’s wedding and wanted to stay close to her location in Ravenswood. The location had every amenity within walking distance. Parking was simple and passes were included. Everything we needed was at our fingertips and the location was comfortable and spotless. The pinball machines were an added bonus. So fun!!!  Our hosts were responsive to every question and we look forward to hopefully staying there again!
Tanya and Drew were awesome hosts. Everything was exactly how they described it. Very clean and great place to stay
The place was beautiful loved the aesthetics. Would definitely recommend again for myself when I come back to Chicago.
Great and cozy place!

Nice location, comfortable and clean beds and towels. Couches/chairs were not so clean. We’d planned to use the pull out couch but when we pulled it out there were crumbs all over it which was disappointing and impacted the quality of our stay. There were also stains all over the chair in the larger bedroom.
I had a prolonged stay at this location, and the place was perfect for what I needed! Great location, easy access to the entrance, and a good amount of amenities to live for a couple of months

Comfortable place to stay. The home was nicely decorated, clean and the beds are all very comfortable to sleep in.
The kitchen has what you need.
Naomi was a good host and very responsive and accommodating.
The area is very walkable with stores and restaurants around and only 12-18 min drive into the downtown depending on traffic.
The house is steps from a train station. You do hear the train and it does run 24 hrs. At nights it’s not as often. I was initially concerned about being able to sleep through it. But actually it never bothered anyone in our family. We all slept fine. Though if you have difficulty sleeping at night, the noise may bother you if you aren’t used to city living.
Would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Chicago.
We enjoyed our stay the home is beautiful and spacious,  we plan to make this home our go to when coming to Chicago, the host were great and responded quickly when needed.
Not worth the price per night. The area was not a very good area a homicide right up the street not a convenient location.

This is a total crash pad. I just needed a bed and a shower and Brad's place provided that. The spot is very well located for nights out in Bucktown, Logan Sq, Wicker, etc.
There was a downside or two: one, be aware of the "hostel" like situation with separate rooms available to separate guests. It wasn't an issue except for I had to wait for the bathroom for 20min one morning, which was a bit annoying. Secondly, nowhere is the bnb description did Bradley describe that he has an office in the lower floor and spends a fair amount of time there. This wasn't a big deal, but I would have appreciated the transparency so I could know what to expect.
we had a great stay! unbeatable location and very clean.
Great spot for a big group
Easy check-in, very clean, great location
Everything was beautiful and professional from the start to end 💯 I enjoyed my stay and thanks for having us
We enjoyed our stay at Tj's place. The space was clean, and as described. Great location in Old Town, very walkable and easy access to metro line. The hosts were very responsive!

Excelente estadía. Cerca del centro.
Volvería en una próxima ocasión
Great location - most things in the place were broken or stained.
Great stay

Highly recommend. Great location, right near the L and right near the water. Host was communicative and provided detailed instructions for everything. Spacious, well appointed. Would definitely stay again.
The apartment was great, located far enough from downtown to park freely but close enough to anything you wanted to walk to.
It was a great stay!
Great place awesome host. Peaceful and private. Host greeted us and made the group feel at home. Place is big and was a great amount of space. I recommend!
Nice safe spot with a great place to park!
Perfect place to land for a couple days. Quiet, clean, and comfortable. Incredibly responsive and helpful hosts who take great care of their home and the guests who stay in it!
It was a great space for my family and I!

We really enjoyed our stay.  The space was exactly as advertised and was very family friendly.  This was super helpful for traveling with our 8-yr old twins.  All the beds were comfortable and the space was very clean.  We hope to book it again in the future!
The host was nice and very understanding. The place we stayed at was easy to get to and it was comfortable to stay at. House was very clean.
I came here with all my friends for my 30th birthday and WOW what a beautiful space. It was perfect for us and fit us all with plenty of space. I loved it so much and was sad to leave it!!!

Russell’s Airbnb is lovely. Location is perfect.  We walked everywhere and a bonus, it’s  right around the corner from where my daughter lives.  The bedrooms are huge. The beds are comfortable and the bathrooms are great.   I’ve never seen so many towels. Thank you so much!!!
Beautiful home in a great location! Appreciated the comfortable beds, responsive hosts and the parking space was a big plus. Would definitely stay again!

My stay with Lois was wonderful, the space was beautiful and she had tons of history in the space itself and gave a wonderful tour when we first arrived. She was always available for questions and even had a binder with things to do and local eateries. One of the best stays I’ve had.
Melany’s place was such a cozy stay for our nice little weekend getaway! We enjoyed staying here!

Fabulous location, comfortable stay, and a seamless experience! The reserved parking space was a game-changer, and the proximity to transit made exploring easy. Thomas is an excellent, responsive host who provided a helpful visual guide that made everything clear. Would definitely stay here again!

This place was a great spot for a weekend trip in Chicago. It was definitely on the smaller side but fine for just two of us. Very nice to be in the middle of wicker park close to the blue line to get around the city. Relatively easy to park near by using third party apps like spot hero
This place was everything we were looking for for our girls trip! So cute, so comfortable, and well placed in the city
loved the location and cleanliness of the place. host was very responsive, will definitely be staying here again
Cozy little one bedroom perfect for a solo traveler who wants to explore the city.

The place was great all the rooms gad enough towels for all the guests I had attend, including the kids. The check in process was super easy. House was super clean the upstairs was beautiful I dint remember seeing photos if the second bathroom upstairs but it was cery nice. The rooms arent very spacious but they are very comfortable for sleeping. Overall 5 stars would def book again

The house was fantastic and Matricia is proud of it. You can tell by extra details and investment in the furnishings that she loves this home...and she loves being a host. The home is next to a Church and across from a school in an upscale Chicago neighborhood called Beverly. Incredibly close to restaurants and shopping. The place is spotless and there are many hidden gems like the balcony off one of the bedrooms and the front porch. Finally, I love to stay in homes that are loved by host who really enjoy being a host. That is Matricia. She communicated before we got to the home, met us at the home and showed it to us and explained potential stumbling blocks like the shower that my sister LOVED and the TV controls and when we had a question about the TV, she talked me through it...and sent over her husband to set it up for me. I can't imagine returning to Chicago and not staying at Matricia's place and I recommend it to you too!
Beautiful space in a great location. The balcony had a great view of the city. Parking was a hassle but did find free parking on Paulina st.

We loved our stay at Larry's place for our visit to the University of Chicago with our son.  His place was very clean, and I appreciated that the photos and description provided were very accurate, which is important as you want to know what to expect when travel to an unknown spot.   Thank you, Larry!

Maria and Brian were so unbelievably kind, flexible, and generous in every conversation. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and the place was so lovely and clean! My friend and I found it very endearing to hear tiny footsteps above us  in the mornings and it was delightful to be under the home of clearly so much love. Best host experience I've had thus far in all my stays. Thank you so much ❤️!

Brian’s place was clean and looked just liked the photos. He was gracious enough to allow me to have my sister’s bridal shower in his home. He was a very responsive host and even allowed us to have a later check out time. The place is located right outside of downtown so getting around was easy. I would definitely stay here again !
We enjoyed our stay! Cindy and Sandra were super responsive and the apartment was located in a great spot.
Great spot at the heart of Lincoln Square in Ravenswood. Easy to find, great location, and would definitely stay again!

Great location within walking distance to so many great places. Grab a banana oat latte from Hey Day before you hit the streets in the morning and enjoy dinner at Parlor or Elia. Brett responded almost immediately any time that I messaged him and suggested lots of great restaurants in the area. Spoiler alert: the cutlery lies within a hidden drawer inside the kitchen island. Enjoy the secret room!

Great place to stay! The location was convenient and the place was exactly as pictured and described. The host was so responsive and check-in was a breeze. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone.
great stay ! super nice spot, felt like we had our own personal spot in town !
A perfect place for a long weekend in the city! 🖤
The home was beautiful and communication was quick and easy. Would highly recommend
