We loved staying Tyler’s property. It was a perfect place for our weekend away. Cozy, clean & great communication from the host. Would stay again !

Great spot! Our group of 10 fit comfortably with plenty of space to relax. We stayed for 4 days and 3 nights, and the location was perfect—not far from the main attractions and everything we had planned.
The host was very responsive, and check-in was quick and easy. We did run into a small issue with the parking ramp, but Milan was incredibly helpful. We simply went back to the front desk and got a new keycard without any hassle.
Overall, a great experience—would definitely book again!

We had a fantastic stay! Our family of five had a blast. The check-in instructions were very clear, and the place was spotless. There’s a public parking lot conveniently located right across the street, and the area is extremely walkable. Being right on the bike path made it easy to get around by foot, bike, or train and explore all the great spots in the Loop. We would definitely return!

Great location, close to everything on Clark Street in amazing Andersonville.  Ashland is a busy street but you could not hear any street noise from inside.  The place is very convenient, has everything you need and was perfect for my visit.

This place was perfect for our stay in Chicago. The place was just like the pictures and had breathtaking views of the city from the private rooftop patio. As it mentions in the description, the unit is on the 4th floor of a walk up, so stairs are inevitable, but not unbearable! The neighborhood is walkable with restaurants and coffee shops. Overall, we had a great experience, would book again!
One of the best hosts I’ve ever had!

this is an excellent place. spacious and well-appointed. ample on street parking. friendly, caring neighbors. the host is responsive and personable. i will choose to stay here again and again. i highly recommend it.

A fantastic experience in an incredible space. I use Airbnb all the time and this is the best experience I have ever had! If you want to feel like a Rock Star stay at Martins place! Every detail is perfect from the decor, memoribillia and record collection   to the amazing coffee!!! The neighborhood is also wonderful with so many cool restaurants, record stores and coffee shops to explore. I cant wait to come back. Thanks Martin!!

The location was our primary reason for choosing this spot, as there are nearby bus and metro stops and its within walking distance to the McCormick Convention Center. The apartment itself was bright and spacious. Heating was a pain to set, because it was really hot in one room and cold in the other. Also, beware of street noise during weekends nights.
Great plays to stay in the heart of Wrigleyville!

My first bnb and I’m happy to say I had a great experience and would 100 percent recommend this spot to anyone that wants to be near downtown. Really sweet person and very helpful, great communication as well. Really nice area in Chicago too perfect walking environment:)
Great communication, very happy with our stay!
Safe and convenient location. Great restaurants nearby. We enjoyed the fireplace after chilly walks.

This place was great. Amazing location with ability to walk to Lincoln Park, the shore, and Clark St right out side your door and easy access to CTA transpo if you need it. Yet still on a quiet, peaceful street. The apartment is spacious and bigger than it even looks. Plenty of room for my family of four to spread out and relax. A great kitchen and stylish decor throughout the home. The hosts were great, super responsive and reached out throughout the trip to offer help. And the price considering the location seals the deal, a perfect value. Definitely would book it again the next time we come to Chicago without hesitation.

This is going to be a fair review. Please read prior to booking.
The building kinda hard to find. Once we were in the building the lobby smelled like MJ if you’re ok with that cool. If you have kids good luck it was very strong. The apartment itself was clean did not smell like smoke. Presented like a hotel room. We had issues with the code getting into the apartment. But owner was responsive. The neighbors were extremely loud both nights could hear music bumping until maybe 1am. We had issues again with the parking be aware it fills up in the lot and the card we were given did not work so we had to go back and get another. We had an issue again on our second day with the lock on the door and unfortunately cost us missing an even we had scheduled. The owner stated we had to wait until maintenance came to fix. We were also given the option to leave apartment unlocked until maintenance arrived with all of our belongings and that was not reasonable at all. It was inconvenient.

No toilet paper, and the shower was not easy to use. Struggled to get hot water, a note with whatever the trick is would've been nice. Overall not the experience we expected.
Location was great, with a lot to see and do close by.
Nice house - updated with lots of seating.
Great place great spot.
Great place, great spot in the city
Very nice condo in a great location. There are some great dining options within walking distance and 10 minutes from downtown - great location!

Freddys place was cozy and in a nice location. Would definitely recommend him. My kiddo and even the adults loved the arcade machine beds were also comfy place was well cleaned and Freddy is very friendly and responsive.

I went back and forth whether I should say anything or not because I am not trying to hurt anyone's business, but I also don't want anyone else to experience what I did and this isn't everything...
* Stained / Gross Furniture
* Ceiling vents caked up with dust and dirt dislodged and hanging from the ceiling.
* Plumbing Issues
* Not Properly Cleaned
* Noisy ~ Location is right across from train tracks.
* Not Pictured ~ 20 Stairs to Climb
I will say that I reached out to Eric about my stay and he stated that he will be getting different cleaners, hopefully all of these issues will be fixed and addressed if you end up booking this location.

Monica’s home was exactly as advertised.
The place is immaculately clean. It is very quiet inside the unit. There are a couple of restaurants right across the street and a fantastic coffee place two blocks away. Monica and Elizabeth communicated great and we’re very friendly. The place is close to the bus stop and a half mile from a train station very convenient. I highly recommend this cozy abode.

I really enjoyed my stay with Patricia. She was always responsive when I had a question and she always had a positive input on ideas and suggestions of places around the area! I would 10/10 recommend and will definitely stay here again!!
Great place! Easy, clean, parking, and incredibly helpful hosts! Will absolutely stay here again.

Leigh-Anne’s place was the perfect fit for our trip to Chicago. We loved being in Pilsen with easy and quick access to the rest of the city! The apartment was clean, cozy, relaxing and had everything we might need! Will definitely stay here again on our next trip to Chicago!

Denzilt and Zully are great hosts!!! The place is as described and pictured! The living area is big and spacious!! I had family come into town and opted to stay at an Airbnb versus a hotel. It was enough room for my local family and friends that stopped by to visit. Access to the building and unit was a breeze, instructions couldn’t have been clearer! The kitchen was fully stocked with all the utensils required to cook a full course meal! I recommend Denzilt’s place and will definitely stay again!

We had a great time staying at Brad’s apartment! It’s a great location in a nice neighborhood with restaurants and things to do in walking distance. Also right next to the train station which made getting around the city easy. Brad was also extremely helpful and responsive whenever we had a question. Would definitely stay here again when coming to Chicago!

I came to town to visit my son in college and Michael's place was convenient as it was clean and quiet. All of my questions received fast replies. I can't say that about all hosts! We will definitely return to stay at Michael's place, as it fits all of our needs as parents visiting their kids.

What a great stay! This beautiful 2nd floor unit was incredible. The layout is really maximized in an intelligent way which makes the home feel really comfortable. The windows have an excellent city feel that really makes it fun. Not to mention the the metal scaffolding on the side, such a dream!! Will stay here again on our next trip.
Great place, fit our needs perfectly
Convenient location with accommodating host. I would be happy to stay again when in the area!
Great place to stay! Close to the train, great restaurants, and the apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Recommend!
Fantastic stay. It’s walking distance to lots of great restaurants. We stayed there with my older mom, uncle, aunt, as well as our 2 kids. Everyone had enough space and was happy.
Host was very friendly and responsive. They allow late check out due to our train leaving later. I would recommend. Close to downtown and the place was clean and nice

This place is in a great location, especially if you're like us and you want to split your time between downtown Chicago and the Allstate Arena. It's steps away from the Harlem station on the blue line which will take you to O'hare or downtown. An uber to all-state arena was also really affordable and quick. Check in was easy - instructions were clear and there's an access code to get into the space. The space itself was clean and comfortable. Evonna was extremely friendly and quick to respond to my questions and updates.

Our family really enjoyed our stay. There was plenty of space for the three of us, and the unit was stylishly decorated as well as being stocked with everything we needed. The location was also conveniently near everywhere we needed to go in Chicago. Would highly recommend the unit to anyone looking for a relaxing stay in the city.
Thanks from my mom! Her and my daughter had a fun girls weekend.

The stay was great.  There were just a few issues.  My mother in law had trouble with the steps, so it is not for elderly.  Wash cloths were few and far between and the outside lights were out going and coming from the garage.  The unit was very well decorated, clean and almost seemed new.
The whole place was extremely clean and well kept. Paired with a great location beside the train station and multiple coffee shops, it was an amazing stay overall.
I absolutely would stay agin here and have recommended it to all of my friends and family!!
Great place for a friends trip
Very nice place and kind host!
Great house and great host
Brandon’s place was fantastic for our group of 9. The four bedrooms and four full baths was ideal for a group our size. Brandon was super responsive and helpful
Would say pictures do not justify how nice this home is location is okay neighborhood seemed quiet 10 out of 10
Great stay!
Great location. Nice big unit. Clean. Mj had good outreach and follow up.
Matthew was terrific about communication and the place was awesome.
Kelly’s place is so ideally located near our daughter in Avondale. We were able to walk and use transit the whole weekend, with no time wasted in traffic. We had a great visit.
Cozy, comfy spot great location! :)
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made everything easy. Would definitely stay again and highly recommend.

Immaculate vibes from start to finish. Johanna is a lovely host - proactive in her communication & responsive to questions. The space itself is gorgeous, with so many interesting details. It was the perfect combination of vintage, luxury, and whimsy. The neighborhood is quiet, with street parking that wasn’t difficult to find (even coming and going multiple times), and incredibly walkable. We greatly enjoyed the restaurants and shops in Andersonville, while also just being a short drive or ride to downtown. I will definitely look to book again the next time I am in town.
Great stay, perfect for our group.

We visited Chicago for a college tour and were fortunate to find David’s place a few days before. It turned out to be a perfect fit. We especially appreciated being able to bring our dogs along, which made the trip even more enjoyable.
The space was clean and cozy. Its convenient location near Loyola made getting around easy, and if our son decides to attend, we would absolutely stay at David’s place again.
A great area, very clean and a good vibe

We had a great stay! So easy to get to a lot of great restaurants and shopping, super clean and comfortable. The only issue is that the beds didn't seem to fit 2 comfortably (seemed more like fulls than queens). This was fine because we had the sofa bed, but the living room blinds don't keep out the light well in the mornings/daytime so you might be up a bit early. All in all though, we were comfortable and really enjoyed our stay!
Great location, clean house, perfect place to stay:-)
Great place to stay while in Chicago. Would recommend
Clean room and host was responsive

Their place was very comfortable and nice views. Secure setup on getting in and out so everything was protected. Good resting when we would come from our adventures. Would book again and take another trip!
Very clean place!!

The pictures do not do the space justice. The apartment is roomy and feels like home. It is walkable to great restaurants, bars, coffee shops, and public transportation that will take you across the Chicago region. It was the perfect place for our long weekend. We look forward to staying here again!
The pictures did the place no justice it was gorgeous with an amazing view I will be back very spacious and clean. Communication was very fast no issues and felt very safe and homey.

SO CLEAN. I traveled with a baby and my mother - not the lowest maintenance of ages - and this AirBNB exceeded my expectations. I loved having a garage to park in, I felt safe, the noise from outside was minimal. We could walk in the neighborhood. And I cannot say it enough: I just loved how clean it felt inside.

Here's what's important: the rental was clean, the mattress firm, & the shower had great water pressure. The rooms had a good, neat paint job. The host was extremely responsive for questions and to resolve a minor issue. The area seemed safe to us.
There is a low ceiling height (perhaps just 6') & there are exposed pipes in the bedroom and an underhang in the hallway (all visible in the photos). I got compensated by walking slightly hunched, but I did hit my head in the hallway one night.
The two real negatives were spotty Wi-Fi (so important for travelers) and the loud furnace right next to the bedroom (not something that can be avoided). Also, it would have been nice to have nightstands by the bed and a real table (instead of just a card/tray table).
All said, it was a good stay, although the lack of a sitting area (there is no living or tv room) meant the only way to lounge around is to sit in bed.
Amazing home great host could use a few pots and pans but we really loved this home

Patricia's place was a great experience for me and my friends visiting Chicago for the weekend. We were able to walk everywhere and also hop on public transportation. The apartment was very clean and the instructions to get inside were easy to understand. I recommend this to anyone looking to visit.
Great stay! Good location. Could have used more seating in the living room. If you’re 4 adults you won’t be able to comfortable relax in the living room.
Enjoyed our stay. The place was as described and had plenty of room for my roommates and I. They responded to us quickly. Would stay here again.
I had a wonderful time. I would recommend 10 times out of 10!
Perfect setup for a weekend at Wrigley Stadium!  Everything you need, nothing you don’t. The walk to the stadium is exactly what I was hoping a walk to Wrigley would be!

We had a great weekend here! The house was very charming and spacious. Everything was very clean and comfortable. The train going behind the house could be loud at times, but that's to be expected. We were able to walk around nearby easily and there was so much to do. Overall, a lovely place in the heart of Wrigleyville!

This was my second time staying in GOATstays apartments and it was great stay again. Apartment was well equip and had everything that you need for your stay. Plenty of space that allowed our big group to be there comfortable. Host is very responsive and answers to messages and concerns promptly. Two aspects to consider with this location. First, the street parking can be difficult to find close by and is not free during the days. Second, train tracks are directly behind the apartment and are very noisy as red line rans 24/7. Would stay again with GOATstays in the future and highly recommend.
Wow, best AirBnB we’ve stayed at in quite awhile. Great location, lots of space, and tons of food. Jay was a breeze to committed with and we really enjoyed our stay.

Good instructions. Easy to find.
The memory foam bed in the the front bedroom was so comfortable. But that was a brighter room and had more street noise. And the bed was very close to the ground. The back bedroom the mattress was very soft and if your partner rolls over... everything shakes. But much darker and quieter.
The living room furniture was all pretty close to the ground, might be a little difficult for some visitors.
Kitchen was well appointed.
Not a ton within walking distance, but a quick Uber where ever we wanted to go.
The place was cute. I would definitely stay here again. Yes, it can get a little noisy outside but that was to be expected staying in the city.
Good place with accessible transit

We loved staying at Rob’s apartment, we stayed with grandparents and small children for a family trip. Rob’s place is spacious and clean and Rob was very responsive and helpful. The 5 min walk to Engine Coffee was great way to start each day! Would love to stay again when I visit Chicago next time!
Perfect location and accommodations for our quick trip to Chicago! Will recommend!
Would recommend Luis’s Airbnb!! He was such a proactive host and attended to all our needs! Great location, very safe and quiet.

The place was super clean and decorated really well! It's clear the owners put a lot of care into making the place homey for guests.  The location was perfect - walkable to everything and I loved the area!  Would definitely recommend :)

I stayed at this place for a bachelor's trip and it was perfect. The place was able to sleep 9 of us comfortably. The beds were comfy and the house was spotless upon arrival. The host was super responsive to any questions we had and made the check in/out process extremely easy!
Great place to stay in a great location
Wonderful experience. The place matched the description perfectly, the host was friendly and responsive, and the check-in and check-out process was seamless.

The house is spacious and unique. Has some classic charm. The layout is somewhat awkward but feels like you can have privacy with the amount of space. There are a lack of tvs in the house. There are ample supplies in the kitchen and there is a Fresh Market close by if you are comfortable walking there. We chose to Uber. There was salt/pepper provided but the pepper was whole and there was no grinder. The weather was too cold to enjoy the back yard. Wish we would have been able to. Because the age of the house the floors are very creaky and noisy especially the stairs going to the 2nd level. There are more than one “no smoking” signs in every room. It was a bit ridiculous. Biggest downside of this home is the location. The house is in a pocket of good up kept homes but walk 5 minutes around the corner or to the train deck and it is littered with homeless and sketchy people. We heard multiple sirens in our 3 night stay.
Nice!
Great location, both the blue line and the pink/green lines were in walking distance.

We stayed here twice in a month and enjoyed our stay both times. It was as described, easy, and convenient to the UChicago events and other activities we needed to attend as well as to places like Whole Foods. We appreciate Patrice’s hospitality and would stay here again. Thank you!
This place was very nice, it was cozy but not cramped at all! It was in walking distance from a great coffee shop and it was a very nice and quiet neighborhood.

Great and comfortable stay. Host was responsive and provided accurate description on how to get in. The neighborhood and surrounding area was also a great location to walk to Wrigleyville and other surrounding neighborhoods. We were also in close proximity to the L to get into the downtown area quickly and other places. Overall a fantastic stay and we wouldn't have explored the surrounding area so much if we chose to stay in the downtown area.
Awesome location!

Great communication throughout the stay. Host checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. Place was clean and looked just as pictured. There were 6 of us and everyone appreciated having their own space.

Absolutely loved this place. It’s filled with art and character. Being able to hop on my bike and ride straight to the lake was a huge highlight. Perfect setup if you like to explore Chicago on two wheels.
The neighborhood is quiet, easy to navigate, and parking was never an issue.
Bradley and Carrie were fantastic hosts. They were super helpful with local tips that made the trip even better.
No question, I’ll be staying here again next time I’m in Chicago.
The space was so beautiful and clean! Would definitely stay again. Location was also ideal for work and enjoying time with friends at nearby restaurants. Thank you Bernard!
Such a cute apartment in a good area-everything was pretty accessible from bus, train, walking, or ride share. Definitely enough space with 3 bedrooms and very bright.

People writing bad reviews need to check their expectations. This place was perfect and exactly as described. If you want luxury, pay a premium and stay somewhere else, but if you want something that just suites your needs in a great neighborhood and walkable to everything, this is it! It is exactly as described, and a very old building so don’t expect it not to look old. If you have never been to the area, it seems a little sketchy at first when you’re entering as it is through the alley (again, exactly as described in the listing), but after spending a few days there it was clear how safe the neighborhood is. We even spoke to a lot of locals and they all said the neighborhood is one of the safest in the city. I never saw a single person in the alley the entire time we were there, and we never felt unsafe. This is just blocks away from amazing restaurants/shopping/etc. Super responsive host, and super easy checkout. Absolutely would stay again!
Joe and his place was exactly as advertised. Even better, he was so responsive and helpful as we navigated changes in our plans. I love this neighborhood too! Highly recommend.
Great stay as usual.  I’ve stayed here a number of times for lengthy stays and it’s always the same. Great🩷

Pros:
•Had basic amenities
•Ideally located with easy access to restaurants in a walkable neighborhood.
Cons:
•The 2nd bedroom was very cramped, with very little room for luggage, no nightstand, broken window shade & no access to the closet.
• The living room furniture is uncomfortable and worn and not ideal for spending any amount of time in
•The unfinished shared entryway is very dark and potentially hazardous.
We entered the apartment to the chirping of a low battery smoke detector. We messaged the host and they were quick to message us back but they did nothing to resolve it. They asked us to remove the battery (by climbing up on a rickety kitchen stool). The battery removal didn’t work as it was also hardwired. The host asked us to disconnect the wires (!!!). Instead, we opted to switch the fuse disabling it. We notified the host of this, they said they would send someone the next morning to resolve the issue but never did.
On top of the game all around.
All thing very good we are stay with family

We had a great time staying at Marc's studio in Chicago. My son and I were at the end of a tour of Midwestern colleges. We decided to take in all that Chicago had to offer from a Cubs game, tour of the parks and museums and walking around the city. We enjoyed the neighborhood from the restaurants to the coffee shops (Holy Grounds is a pretty cool coffee shop right near the church). It's also really easy to get to the train or busses.  At the end of each day, we slept very well.  Marc's recommendations of transit and things to do was great. Thanks again Marc!

Apartment was clean, host was responsive, convenient that there’s a parking lot across the street that you can pay to park daily/overnight.  Coffee, restaurants, pharmacy all within walking distance. Made our work trip fairly easy.
Fantastic spot! Incredibly close to a lot while not being in the middle of the city. The spot is exceptional, and has everything you need in order for a restful stay.
Felt right at home! Everything pictured was what we received. Wish we could have stayed longer.
Our hosts were terrific!

My family thoroughly enjoyed our stay here for a long weekend in Chicago. With my mother’s mobility issues, we did have to use public transit more than anticipated; but bus stops were a block or less away and easily accessible. The beds were very comfortable and we felt safe throughout our stay thanks to the security at the front desk.

It was very nice staying at Susan’s place for a convention which me and and two friends attended in Chicago. If you are looking for a simple place to stay in Chicago which immediately feels like home, I can very much recommend Susan’s apartment. She was also very helpful.

My husband and I had a wonderful extended stay at Matthew's lovely home in Logan Square. It is in an incredible location surrounded by restaurants, transportation and great areas to explore. We were very sad to check out!

We had a great stay at Deserees. For starters finding parking was easy (easier than other big cities if you’ve ever had to find free public parking). The fridge had free snacks inside which was very nice. The beds were very comfortable and the shower didn’t give any problems. Definitely recommend this if you are looking for a chill vacation.
Loved this place; Central location to great areas, and was walkable to restaurants/bars and more. Would recommend booking to anyone looking for a quiet spot!

The h ouse was OK. Neighborhood was nice and private. Out of all the Airbnb we have stayed in we have never have never experienced a host that didn’t give you privacy. I felt uncomfortable the next morning when I saw the host and she greeted me and said she didn’t get much sleep. Well there was no music playing only people talking and the property is a no smoking building so we went outside. Every time you leave out the host would talk tho a ring cam. That was different. We noticed boat lock’s on all the tv’s. Quite time we felt as if we needed to whisper or we would be destructive to host sleep and if you are a smoker like I am you have to go in and out which makes ring cam go off as well.
Very nice property for a large group of people to hang out and see Chicago.

I was fairly pleased with my large bachelorette groups stay at this Airbnb. This was a rare unit spacious enough to comfortably host and sleep 8 of us. The beds were great, the stock of towels, kitchen utensils, and amenities were superb. Given the location in the Chicago, parking and getting into the unit is a little cramped, but once inside there was plenty of space to move about.
I was only disappointed in the “renovations” of the unit for the price we paid. The listing advertises new renovations specifically for hosting groups on Airbnb. It was truly the “landlord special”. Everything in the unit appears done as cheaply as possible, which I am typically understanding of, but given the price we paid I don’t feel is justified. There was paint from the wall color on cabinets, floors, etc. A couple stools were a rickety. The bathrooms are in need of a serious redo, things were rusted/old/dirty in there. Not very ample shelving in there for a group of girls.
We had fun nonetheless!

Our stay at Eugene and Alex’s Chicago home was truly wonderful. From the moment we booked, they were incredibly responsive, and every instruction they provided was clear, simple, and easy to follow. The home itself is beautiful — spacious enough for our entire family to spread out comfortably, with a kitchen that had everything we needed for meals and snacks throughout our trip.
Any small concerns that came up were handled quickly and with almost no disruption to our stay, which we really appreciated. The beds were extremely comfortable, and we all slept well each night. Most importantly, we felt safe and at ease the entire time.
This was an excellent Airbnb experience from start to finish, and we would absolutely stay here again.
Such a beautiful home. Everyone was very comfortable and had their own space. It had everything we needed for a fun weekend getaway to the city.
Great spot and great host! Place was bigger than felt in the pictures, Will was always responsive, walking distance to Wrigley and local restaurants. Would recommend!
Clean place. Very helpful host
Brand new and charming apartment, very clean. The hosts were excellent and extremely fast with communication. Highly recommend.
We had a lovely time, place had plenty of space for the 6 of us! United Center was within reasonable walking distance, and many bars and restaurants nearby. Would definitely stay here again.
Great area! Would stay here again for sure

Nice location! Charming neighborhood and felt safe to walk our dog in the morning and evening. Neighbors were kind and quiet. Near several restaurants, cafes, bars and parks. Street parking was easy, outdoor top deck access from 3rd floor apartment had a nice vibe and view. We had everything we needed.
Thanks!
Great place. Very unique. It is on a busy street and the living room stays bright with the large glass windows
Strong communication, very attentive, definitely felt the host was there to meet my needs. Spot was very cozy and had all the essentials: stove, fridge, towels, etc.

I stayed here with some friends while we came to the city for the weekend. It is in a nice quiet neighborhood and the parking spot was a plus so we didn’t have to find street parking. The host was very nice and a responded quickly.
Bhavish was a fantastic host my party and I would definitely stay here again
Great location in the center of everything the city has to offer. The building is cute and it has a lot of charm. The apartment is well equipped for you to feel comfortable and like at home.

Super helpful and responsive hosts. Place was clean, easy to access and perfect for a short stay. Wood floors and doors did creek a bit so just beware if you’re sharing and need silence. Besides that, would recommend to anyone looking for a good stay in the area.
We had a great stay in Chicago! The apartment was clean and in a great location. It is close to the train, but with the ear plugs Kim provided, it didn’t disturb our sleep. Overall great stay!
We had a great time at this AirBNB. It was exactly as described, very safe and located in a quiet neighborhood. Free street parking was never a problem.  Definitely recommend!

This place was great for a weekend stay in Chicago, but place was smaller than what we anticipated, vent was loose/not secured to ceiling, mattress was soft (almost felt like you were sinking in it) and very little support from pillows. In the bathroom, no fan for ventilation, shower - glass did not go all the way to the ground, so water escaped from the bottom (had to put a towel down to soak up excess water. Also found some small bugs (unsure of what type of bugs) we found one night in the sink in the bathroom.
For the most part the place was clean, everything organized, able to find stuff within the place with ease, walkable to many places in suburbs of Chicago, and had all the amenities needed for a weekend stay where for the most part we were out exploring what Chicago had to offer.

Brad was lovely and the place fit our needs for the week with my family. There’s no restaurants or much to do around the neighborhood, other than the United center. But that’s not Brad’s fault. It was quick and easy to get on and off the interstate for our needs. The Grocery store was about a 10 min walk and it was a great grocery store!

A cozy place to stay! Julius and Oriana provided a lovely place to stay, for a great price, near downtown Chicago. Would definitely return back! Communication was always clear and they assured their support multiple times:) Incredibly thankful for their contribution to my first visit in Chicago!
Comfortable place in a fun neighborhood
this place is adorable! great walkable neighborhood, cute space, great food nearby, close to transit. you can't ask for more in Chicago!
Clean, wonderful views, great amenitiea, and just as described.  Would recommend 👌🏾.
Great spot for large groups. Thank you!
Host communicated well and was very responsive. easy check in and out. Very close to united center and West loop. everything was within walking distance. Will book again!
Lovely stay in the logan square neighborhood. Very close to all of the events we had to go to in the area. The place was very clean and comfortable. Thank you!
Loved it !

It was a great place to stay.  Super convenient, clean, had personality and character, was warm and comfortable and also had all types of touches that make it a top notch Airbnb (toothbrush in case you forgot it, not only a hair dryer but also a hair curler and a straightener which is super appreciated, simple things like a box of tissues, USB plugs on the nightstand, a bench to put your luggage on).  We've been to many Airbnbs and you could tell thought went into this one.
Very good communication.
We had a wonderful stay for the weekend :)
Great location and good communication by host. Beds do need improvement though.
It was exactly as advertised! And for those looking to be within walking distance to numerous things it was perfect
Great location! Ishin was a very good communicator. Place is as described on the basement level.
The owner was responsive and helpful and the location was great. It did seem quite pricey for the place

My family loved this home. It was perfect for our needs - visiting the city, not too far from the train, all sorts of amazing - local foods, and shockingly great views of the Chicago skyline from the rooftop deck! As we packed up our bags today our kids told us "we want to stay here everytime we come to Chicago! It's perfect!"

Will definitely stay here again if coming to visit my son at UChicago. Great location, easy to get to as well with public transport.  Had to do a little work while I was there as well and the room was equipped with a good desk to do so.  Comfortable.  Private and quiet.  John is a very nice host as well.
Good location . Close to a lot of stores. Easy free parking in front . Peaceful . Only thing that was annoying is the squeaky floors other than that no complaints
A great place to spend time in Logan Square! Thanks, Afsha!
Jocy is a sweetheart and could not have been more welcoming & responsive. One of my favorite Airbnb experiences. I hope to be back in the Chicago area. I won't even think about staying anywhere else.

Great location!! We had a problem once we checked in but Stephanie and Kevin responding very quickly and made all concessions to make our stay comfortable.  So i highly recommend them as GREAT hosts!. Our location was walkable to restaurants and some attractions. We had everything we needed in this  beautiful condo. The bedding was comfortable and a well equipped kitchen with plenty of listed amenities.  We plan to returns and I would recommend this place to family and friends.
Spot was great 👍 location was nice, there was so many shops and restaurants in walking distance.
Great place in a great part of town. Cihan was a great host and very easy to get in touch with. Awesome place to stay for a quick trip to Chicago for two!

We had a wonderful stay at Dede’s place. It was incredibly private and furnished  it felt like staying in a private house. It was so equipped with everything to make to feel like you were still at home. The bed was so comfortable and we had the best nights sleep. It was easy to communicate with Dede and she was very respectful with our privacy. Highly recommended!

Very nice apartment in a great neighborhood.
Very comfortable and homey place to stay. Parking is easy to find

Affordable price and clean environment.
The first advantage you get is convenient transportation, very close to blue line station.The kitchen is very good, with kitchen utensils, What's more perfect is that there are Japanese supermarkets around where you can buy ingredients
The place was spacious, clean, and comfortable! It was a great option for our group, and the price was well worth it.
The place was perfect for us. Comfy beds, clean, and spacious! Would definitely recommend!

Tiffany was a great host.  The neighborhood was very quiet and the house had plenty of room for 7 people.  very close to the expressway and an easy drive to downtown on the weekend.  The wife was concerned about the property being on the Southside but this is one of the best neighborhoods in that area.  We felt very comfortable here and really appreciate Tiffany opening up her home for us!

Brandon is a great host and very generous when able to accommodate my requests. The beds were comfortable and the place was clean. The best part was how close we were to so many different things to do. We had a great time!
Great house, very modern and extremely clean. Perfect for our trip. Nicole and Matt were very responsive and extremely helpful and pleasant. We would definitely stay there again.
Doors locks and parking tricky.  Place well put together except there was small bit of construction not disclosed. Didnt substantively affect us.

Great stay with my group that consisted of various ages. Loved the little selection of books and game available. Within walking distance of a nice grocery and plenty of walkable restaurants. Enjoyed back yard for some food & drink. Parking was a breeze! Would stay again.
Clean, roomy, historically beautiful, nice linens, plenty of towels
Amazing stay! Would definitely come back!

This place is a great value for the location and amenities. The updated kitchen and shower and well designed spaces make it inviting to stay in. It was very convenient to all the places and activities we planned. I’ve booked Bella before and will book another one of her places next time we come back to Chicago.
Great for a girls weekend! 2 bathrooms is always a plus with a group of girls, and that’s hard to come by in cities. Very clear instructions with pictures when arriving/checking-in.

Nothing wrong with this place. It was comfortable. Sound travels through the house pretty easily, so all the kids running around was noisy even from rooms far away from their activity. The place is not particularly beautiful and things like the TVs are very small. But we weren't there to watch TV anyway...
Super easy access to the L. If only the Blue Line wasn't a drug den... It's a truly awful experience full of teens hotboxing, smelly homeless people, and people blaring their music from speakers. If you stay here, I suggest renting a car. There are tons of street parking spots in the neighborhood. Neighborhood felt safe and clean, albeit a bit boring.

Very nice place to stay, convenient spot next to a bus stop and a short walk from the train. We had some trouble getting in the front door but the host was very responsive and everything was very clean!

Home was great ! There was a few things that could’ve been better like better cleaning, and locks need to be tighten on the front door. Better bedding for the room. Also the neighborhood is a little concerning but overall air bnb was nice
My family and I really enjoyed the space and the neighborhood. Very cute apartment.
The Host was very responsive and provided clear and quick answers to our questions. We enjoyed our stay!
I’d definitely will be staying there again. Sean made this stay so easy for us and my family members.

We enjoyed our stay in Wicker Park. The location was perfect - easy walking distance to vintage shops, restaurants, record stores and the Blue Line. The apartment had comfortable beds and was clean, and the building was quiet. However, maintenance issues, uncomfortable/dingy furniture, and a lack of basic amenities were a drawback.
The living room couch is basically a padded bench, and chairs were meant to look modern rather than be comfortable. All the other furniture was chipped and peeling. We had to move lamps around to the bedside tables to read before bed. The light over the bathroom mirror was broken and the room was very dark, which is an issue if you wear makeup. The vinyl mini blinds were falling apart, outlets were coming out of the walls, and the towel rack fell off.
Overall we enjoyed the stay, and with some easy fixes the experience could be much nicer.
Cute and clean place! Would stay again

Check-in/check-out was a breeze! All directions provided were easy to follow and there wasn’t a long list of things to do in order to check-out. Great location next to the Blue Line and also has some great restaurants around the Airbnb. Would highly recommend.

You simply cannot beat the location of Hamlin House for visiting the University of Chicago. It is situated right around the corner from the Max Palevsky dorms, making it incredibly convenient for early morning meetups or late-night drop-offs. The neighborhood is extremely walkable, with an array of great coffee shops and restaurants just steps away.
The hospitality was a standout feature of the stay. Caryl was incredibly friendly and went out of her way to introduce herself and ensure everything was going smoothly. That personal touch really elevated the experience.
If you have a student at UChicago, this is the place to stay. I am definitely planning on booking Hamlin House again for my next visit to see our son.
Very big place! Good location, clean and responsive. No issues.

I would most definitely recommend this stay to anyone looking to come to Chicago. The booking itself was very clean and comfortable. I had no issues finding the place and the check in video they provided was helpful. They were very communicative so no important details for rules and check in/out were missed and they accommodated my early arrival and I was able to check in early.  I’d definitely come back!
Nice accommodation

The apartment was so nice and comfortable. I loved it. The location is. Lose to walking distance of anything you need and close by attractions . We enjoyed our stay and loved the place . We will be back

It was an absolutely gorgeous apartment and felt very homey, having just about everything you could need! Location was perfect as well if you love to shop and eat. The host were also very responsive which I appreciate so much!
We had a great experience! House is very cute, very clean, and in a fantastic neighborhood! We were able to park on the street very nearby.
The apartment was easy to access and kept clean! It is close to University of Chicago. Highly recommend this place!
loved our stay. easy to park. quiet neighborhood. host is responsive and quick to fix any issues.
Nice place to stay. Great amenities. Would stay here again.
This is a great place to stay
This place was an amazing location, close to the train, food, and bars. Ron was extremely nice and responded to any questions I had promptly. Would be willing to stay again.

I will most definitely stay again
Definitely will refer as a great host with a beautiful stay!
Erika was so nice!  The place was just awesome.  So close to Wrigley and family.  All walkable!  Can’t wait to come back! ❤️🏟️
It was a good stay!

Overall the space was clean and great for
a weekend away, we wish the space was more well stocked with supplies as we had trouble locating things like trash bags, ziplocs etc. But the area was safe and close enough to downtown Chicago for a quick Uber.
Thomas and Cynthia's place was perfect for us and they were very responsive.

Our group had a great time the Magic Factory Loft. We were 6 friends in total so had more than enough room. The loft was very spacious - and importantly a great location. Carole and Basil were incredibly communicative and easy to work with. Would definitely recommend to other groups.

Michael's place was spacious and met all of our needs. Three bedrooms and four beds provided space for multiple family members attending a memorial nearby. The beds and furniture were comfortable and access to two full bathrooms was a plus. Extras such as condiments, snacks, complimentary beverages, and coffee were appreciated! The small balcony upstairs and deck on the main level provided pleasant space to sit outside. Michael was very responsive and accommodating of requests. Having access to a large grocery store a few blocks away was also convenient. We would be glad to stay again while visiting the city!

Victor's place was great. I needed a place to crash for a week while I handled some personal matters and waited to move, and his house was perfect for a week long stay. The neighborhood was beautiful and super safe, and while it's not technically the suburbs, that's exactly how it feels. Peaceful, quiet, separated from the city, and there are a decent amount of restaurants and shops right around the corner.
Just a heads up. This wasn't a problem for me, but the only thing I could see being a downside is that it's pretty far from any train stations, so if you're going to be working downtown and want to take public transit, do your research, check the bus routes and schedule accordingly. If you have a car, there's plenty of free street parking, and the neighborhood is super safe so I wouldn't be worried about break ins.
Thank you for everything Victor. Will definitely consider staying here again once I move back to Chicago!

Roxy is an incredible host.  She strives to make your stay as easy as possible.  She is responsive and works to find a solution.  She loves to connect and engage with you.  She has a great location and easy to get around Chicago.   I hope to stay in contact with her after my stay.  Thanks so much!

Valerie's place was wonderful. Perfect for our girls weekend. Valerie is amazing! She was helpful in finding things to do and places to go. Very responsive and just so sweet! The house and area is adorable. There is a delicious coffee shop within walking distance. Everyone was friendly.  We will definitely be back!
Great coach house in an amazing location.
The Garden Apartment was as described and a fine place to stay for a week. If you are looking to stay in Hyde Park, the location is great!

Christina’s place was beautifully designed and immaculately clean!
Great walkable area with plenty of restaurants close by.
Highly recommend it.
Stay was amazing

Marie was a good host. The airbnb was noticeably dog friendly (which we did not mind) but something to keep in mind if you would like to avoid that.  The beds were comfortable and the neighborhood was very nice!

We had such a great experience. The host was very welcoming and quick to respond anytime I had a question. They also gave great restaurant recommendations in the area, which I really appreciated. The space was clean and well-kept, and it felt like a home away from home. The neighborhood was nice and peaceful, which made it even better. Everything went smoothly, and I would absolutely book with this host again.
Great.

If I could leave more than 5 stars I would! This place was absolutely amazing and exceeded our expectations!! My Dad and I were visiting from Ohio and as soon as I saw this AirBNB listed, I knew we had to book it! It truly was like staying in a museum. The atmosphere was very comfortable as well and we greatly appreciated the freebies (wine, snacks, coffee bar, etc.). Not to mention the hosts were amazing! Very quick to answer any questions, as well as checking in to see if we needed anything. The tips for getting to the location we were going to in Downtown Chicago was very helpful too! I can’t recommend this place enough and will absolutely be staying here again. By far the coolest place I have stayed at!
Dominique was very attentive regarding the apartment's check-in needs. The apartment looks exactly as it does in the photos, and the value for money is excellent.
This was a great stay!
Abe was an amazing host. From the communication to the state of the Airbnb, everything was great. We had a great time with the 12 of us and had no issues whatsoever!
Incredible location with 2 car garage 1 block from Wrigley.  GREAT place for a group of 5 or 6.   Will rent it again the next time I'm going to Chicago.
A great airbnb in Chicago area! Spacious and homey!!
Good!
Jessica's apartment was very well done and I was surprised at how much space there was. The location was perfect as well, and there is so much to walk to in the neighborhood!

Excellent place to stay in a nice Chicago neighborhood.  Very walkable area with access to restaurants, bars and shops.  We brought our bikes and this was a great area to use as a base to explore other parts of the city.  Easy street parking and good outdoor space in front of the unit.
Great location! Easy check in and out.
Great place to stay for a bachelor party! Very walkable, great bars in the area. Would recommend!

The place was perfect for our group of 6 college friends who met for a 30 year reunion.
Lots of room. The place can easily accommate groups much larger than ours.
Beds were comfortable. Everything was clean.
We used the card table one night and enjoyed the huge TV.
We walked everywhere. Great bars, restaurants, live music all within a few minutes. Wrigley Field was an easy 20 minute walk. Neighborhood was a lot of fun and felt very safe.

We had a great stay in Chicago. The location was perfect. It was very roomy and clean. We enjoyed walking to shopping, dining and to the train. The parking was a bit tough but we were able to work it out. The host is very responsive and answered us very quickly. They even call us to make sure we received our instructions and asked if we needed anything. What a fun weekend!
As advertised. Very comfortable spot

Really really nice place.
Good service 👍
We had an excellent stay at this property. We were allowed to check in 4 hours early and the contact was very friendly. The place looked like we expected.

Great location but street parking is extremely challenging. A bit worn down with torn up couches in the living room. The host is very timely with communication and fast in bringing in essentials when requested. Overall a good experience
Excellent stay

Place was spacious enough to accommodate my family and I. Good location, fairly clean (besides towels being left behind and a super old Churro being left on top of the fridge). Good host. Had a good stay
Great place to stay in Lincoln park! Amazing host, they communicated very well and accommodated us quite nicely. Highly recommend!

Loved this place.  Two separate bedrooms with a pull out couch if needed.  Entry is through the back and requires a few steps down.  Beautifully arranged and decorated.  Full kitchen.  Great neighborhood with a ton of walkable things to do.  We will definitely stay here again.
Thank you for hosting a lovely stay.
Super clean, very good location, and very responsive host made a great stay for my friends and I.

We requested a date change about 10 days before our stay. She was communicating with us about other things and gives you the ability to cancel within 24 hours of your stay for a full refund so I assumed it was going to be changed and a day refunded. Unfortunately, I looked two days before our stay and the request was ignored and when I sent a message about the request they said they can change it but I need to pay them over $200? Our parking spot was blocked when we arrived which was a bit frustrating but she got back with us quickly and helped the situation within 15 minutes. The place was really clean and had plenty household items to make our stay comfortable. They definitely need to upgrade their TP 🧻… see through thin. Place is a bit banged up but that’s fine. Great location. Walkable to plenty of nice restaurants and a quick train ride to downtown.
Responsive hosts, unit has the basic needs. There is absolutely no street parking available at any time of day anywhere near the apartment.

The space was larger and more spacious than I anticipated. The decor was a bit utilitarian, but the space was just what we needed for a place to lay our heads at night. Also it is very close to the green line so it’s perfectly convenient to head downtown. Ample street parking but the space in back was also easy to use.
Great service and super responsive, made our trip easy and memorable.
Great short walk to Lake Michigan. Super nice hosts.
Home was nice and clean, in an area with easy access to the heart of the city. Few issues that did arise were promptly handled.
Lovely, secure, minimalist downtown apartment, close to everything.

Samuel’s place is the perfect location for a Cubs game or even a Chicago getaway without the hustle and bustle of downtown.
The apartment/condo is a 5 minute walk to the ballpark!
The place was clean, convenient and street parking was surprisingly easy.
I would highly recommend, and I would definitely stay again!

While the Airbnb itself was cute, the host was unresponsive when we ran into issues. Firstly, the garage in the back of the Airbnb is in a narrow alley that a car can barely fit down let alone turn into a garage. Secondly, the landlord entered the home with no warning from the host. The landlord said she should have told us they were coming to go into the basement to turn off the water to fix a break in a pipe. So not only did we have no water without warning, but someone entered the house without warning as well. There were also multiple plugged in air fresheners to mask a smell. When we texted and called Jennifer, she did not respond to our messages or phone calls. We had no choice but to cancel the rest of our stay and find last minute accommodations. Hopefully this was just a once time incident but we did not have a great experience.
Ray and Kay have a lovely home everything was self explanatory. They communicate timely and was proactive about anything you needed.

It was a perfect place to stay if you want a more quiet neighborhood, but also close to transit. Location was prime to get food near Logan Square, and near the blue line to go to the Loop or the airport. I came for two concerts and work, so it was perfect. The location is also near supermarkets, so you can pick up some groceries to save on eating out. I think for light sleepers, the basement units can be hard because you can hear the echoes of the blue line because it is below ground. The overall place is clean, with a few dirty dishes that past visitors didn’t really take care of, but I can’t blame the host for that. It was super spacious and had laundry! I enjoyed my time and knew exactly what I was getting.
Our family enjoyed our stay here! The layout worked well for our family and the location was great for getting around the city. Christi was kind and quick to respond whenever we reached out.
Catalin was a very responsive and communicative host.  The unit is very clean and had all the amenities that I needed.  I would stay with Catalin again.

The room and home were beautiful, immaculate and just as described. The location is rigjt next to the park, whoch was very nice for strolling in the morning and evening. Patrizia was very kind, responsive, and proactive.

Caryl's home is beautiful! It's spacious, comfortable and in a charming neighborhood. Our family was in Chicago for a few days, and our schedule was packed. Caryl's home offered everything we were looking for - and more. Communication with Caryl was very easy, and we appreciated her thoughtfulness, including great recommendations. We had a great stay and would love to return!
It is a very good experience

Great place with convenient location and very walkable. Lovely decor and home goods.
We had issues with the wifi that was addressed by host. But note without it there is little to no cell service in the apartment.
Typical for an antique building, there is building noise of pipes and radiators and what not that happens in early AM.
We had so much fun! Can’t wait to come back.
This is a lovely condo.  Everything seems very new and thoughtfully set up.  I definitely recommend to other guests.
A great corporate housing stay!

This was a really nice place as a home base for a week in Chicago. Parking was easy to find on the street at most times of the day. The neighborhood was great and within walking distance to most things that you’d need. We were able to walk to the grocery store, target, and some cool restaurants/bars. The apartment was spacious, clean and nicely decorated. It was perfect for a family of 4 and well stocked with all the essentials.  The owners were very friendly and responsive. Overall, a great place!!
Loved stepping into this beautiful art paradise. Was in Chicago for work, and was so happy to return to this air bnb daily.

747 Lofts was perfect for my sisters and I short stay for the weekend for a concert at the Salt Shed! It was close to the venue, the train, and surrounded by a lot of food shops! I’ll definitely recommend it to others! Thank you!!

I stayed here for three months and found it super comfortable. The room is nicely decorated and has a super convenient mini fridge. It was very easy to use the public transportation nearby, as well as walk on the bike trail nearby to explore the neighborhood. Paul's puppy, Winnie, is super loveable if you're a dog lover! Paul is very nice and communicative, super easy to talk to if you have any questions.
Edwin is a great host. Considerate and detail-oriented. His place is nice and homey. Would stay again.
We had a great time in Carla's nice apartment. Communication with the host was great, everything was there as needed and the place was clean and tidy. We can highly recommend staying here!

We enjoyed our stay here. Nice cozy, and comfy place to stay. We loved the patio hot tub. Easy check in/out. Great restaurants very close by and convenient to walk to great spots in the city but close to the train for even more access to the city.

Bob’s place was fantastic! It was a beautiful place with plenty of room for the two of us! Great location, close to many restaurants and access to Lake Shore Drive was a breeze! We’d love to stay here again!
Clean, comfortable, and well-appointed. Nice towels, stocked kitchen, comfortable beds. Garage parking is key! Great space and location for our family’s spring break in Chicago.
Great stay and great view!

Great stay overall! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made check-in super easy. The location was convenient and felt safe, with everything we needed nearby.
We enjoyed our stay very much. The house was beautiful, cozy and we appreciated how close it was to what we needed. Highly recommend!

My family and I had an amazing time.

pratique et agréable

We really enjoyed this corner apartment.  Lots of space for the 4 of us with 3 bedrooms and 2 baths. Awesome view of the city with great windows. Great kitchen. This space is very much as described. Would stay again in a second. 30 min walk to museum park. Easy access to train which we used to go to wrigley.

A great place to stay. Great location with lots to do within walking distance. I would reach out to stay again on my next visit to Chicago.  The host was a great communicator and responded very quickly.  Awesome stay Awesome location.
It honestly felt like home. Would 100% book again :) very conveniently close to trains as well!

Estuvo bien, es económico por estar lejos de Dawtown pero está a 3 cuadras de la parada de camión.

Compartes la casa con otras personas pero la ventaja es que tiene dos baños entonces no hay problemas.

If you’re planning on visiting the Chicago area, I recommend Vins place. Vin is an outstanding host. The climate is controlled in the apartment and we were unable to adjust the thermostat, however Vin made adjustments for us a few times to keep us comfortable and brought space heaters to us, even though it was after hours, we can’t thank him enough!
Also, the location is great as there is a Jewel Osco directly across the street, which was very convenient as well as a Starbucks just a few houses down, which my teenage kids loved.
This place also comes with a private parking spot in a garage.
Vin also allowed us to bring our fur babies which is always a plus, as they are family too and we do not travel without them.
There is a laundry room located in the basement of the building right outside your back door which was also convenient.
I honestly can’t say enough good things about Vin and his place. I will definitely keep it in mind for future stays when visiting my family in Chicago!

Great place. Accurate description. Lots of stairs and didn’t love that you couldn’t lock the main door at the top of the stairs or that you couldn’t enter through the back door where the parking spot is. However, security wasn’t an issue. Beds were comfortable, bathrooms were clean.
Nice area and well kept. Tony was great. Would recommend.
Very much enjoyed my stay! Bed was comfortable, apartment is well equipped and very clean.
Easy to find, it was comfortable and clean. hostess was responsive. Neighborhood was easy.
Nice place to stay  for a recharge

Good place to stay. In a quiet neighborhood with plenty of parking. Within walking distance of a bus stop and train station if you don’t mind a longer walk. The room was small, but if you are just looking for a place to sleep it’s perfect.

Gloria was a wonderful host, and her place was beautiful, cozy, clean, and less than ten minutes to walk to the Red Line. We found it super easy to park. Gloria also gave us great recommendations around town, made us delicious coffee each morning, and was so lovely to chat with.

My friends and I loved staying at Bel's place. It's super walkable with great restaurants and small local businesses all around. I used to live in the neighborhood and was so happy to be comfortable as a visitor. The house was very clean and has everything you could need. I would definitely stay here again when I'm back.

I had a great stay. Aminata and Luke were wonderful hosts—very kind, responsive, and welcoming. They made me feel at home, and Aminata even checked in during my stay to make sure everything was okay and see if I needed anything. I’d definitely stay here again.

Alex’s home felt very safe, the proximity to downtown, the west loop, and Chinatown felt effortless,
The house was just as described and comfortable for all 4 other ladies who accompanied me on my bachelorette. While looking for extra toilet paper in the upstairs bathroom we did realize there was trash, empty used toilet paper rolls and left over trash, on the floors. We also noticed in the kitchen some of the cups weren’t fully washed upon n using them, but beyond that - amazing!

We loved our stay here, it is a beautiful neighborhood and the places was super clean and cozy. But definitely the highlight was our amazing hosts who were so kind.
Definitely a 5 star stay

This was our second time staying at this property, and it was even better than the first time we stayed there. Kyriako is a great host and he is very responsive. He wanted to make sure we were happy. We will definitely stay at one of his properties when we return to Chicago.
Nice location. safe quiet neighborhood.
nice stay!

Great host, great location. Patricia was responsive and helpful, and the spot sits right near the Red Line and a grocery store. Perfect for exploring the city. The space is no-frills but comfortable, and the two full bathrooms was a major plus for our larger group.
Perfect stay in every way!
Great location in Logan Square. Had everything we needed for a few days!
We had a great time and it was nice to come back to the home after a day in Chicago as it felt relaxing and inviting. We would stay there again for sure. Danny was super helpful and very responsive.

My husband and I stayed here for a two-night stay while we watched a Blackhawk game at the United Center. The apartment was very clean. My husband found a fantastic pizza joint near by. Julian was very responsive to my texts. We would stay here again.

Great location in Old Town Chicago! We loved how walkable the neighborhood is and there are several good restaurants and coffeeshops just a short distance away. We were also able to easily walk to public transit to get to other parts of the city.
The owners provide parking stickers to use if you have a car, but please be aware that parking can be tough in this area of town. If you are coming home late at night, your best option is going to be La Salle, which has free parking within certain time frames. The owners provided really great instructions for parking and there's a lot of signage so it is definitely doable.
The apartment is very cute and unique. The space had everything you could want or need. The upstairs where the bed is got a little toasty during our stay but there is central AC in the unit that helped.
Overall, I love how peaceful the place was. Would stay here again!

The apartment was infested with black mold that the host refused to acknowledge. They said they would send someone out but never did.
The host also accused us of bringing an undisclosed pet and tried to charge us additional fees, but the pet was included on the initial reservation which was confirmed by the host. The host was hostile and threatening over messages and we felt very uncomfortable staying here.
Since the host refused to do anything about the mold issue and acted hostile towards us, we vacated the rental early. Neither Airbnb nor the host will provide us a refund for the days we did not stay, even though black mold issue a serious health concern.
If you value your health, do not stay here. I do not recommend staying in any property owned by this host.
Great place to stay! I would stay again. Make sure you get all the check-in instructions, and it will go smoothly.  Jake is a great host and very responsive.
Enjoyed the accomodations.   It was great having the amenities of home compare to renting multiple hotel rooms.   Will rent from again.   No disappointments.

Solo tengo buenas palabras. Pasé unos días estupendos con mi familia, es un apartamento muy amplio y acogedor. Además estaba limpísimo y contaba con todos los servicios que pudiésemos necesitar. La comunicación también fue fluida y fueron flexibles. Muchísimas gracias, si tengo ocasión repetiré seguro!
Rented the home for our daughter’s 21st birthday.  She and her friends loved the place and had a great time.  Vince was a great host.

Hillary and Ed were the perfect hosts. Helpful, friendly, checked in on us ( they live upstairs). Made great recommendations
We went to Bar Roma for great service and even better food ( make sure to try the seafood Fettuccine Isabella - amazing). Then went a few doors down to the Chicago Magic Lounge for a fun and amazing evening.

Sehr schönes und großes Airbnb in einer ruhigen Umgebung. Mit dem öffentlichen Transport ist man in 30 Minuten im Zentrum. Coole Umgebung mit hipen Second Hand Läden und süssen Restaurants. Der Kontakt zu Afsha war stets einfach, sie war immer erreichbar und hat schnell geantwortet.:)

Michelle’s place is fantastic!  It is a little bigger than the pictures suggest.  Her directions and communication were excellent.  Location is amazing—lots of places to eat within a 5-10 minute walk, nearest CTA station is a 5 minute walk…we even walked to Wrigley Field for a Cubs game (~20 minute walk).
We loved staying here for a short city trip! Great location close to the pink line, and it was so nice getting to see the chickens. Would definitely stay here again!

The unit was much smaller than expected and felt very cramped overall. The bed in particular was extremely small. if you’re an average-sized adult, you’ll likely find it extremely uncomfortable or difficult to sleep on.
The space itself also came across as fairly cheap in terms of quality and setup, which didn’t match my expectations based on the listing.
Because of these issues, I ultimately decided not to stay and had to book a hotel instead. Host was not accommodating
I think this place may only work for someone who is okay with a very small space and minimal comfort, but personally, I wouldn’t recommend it.

We had a great stay at Josh's place in Wrigleyville! The apartment was just as described, and the location could not be beat. Even though the house is about as close to Wrigley as you can get, it still feels like you're staying in a neighborhood. We would happily stay again next time we visit Wrigley.
Sara was a helpful, responsive host. Instructions for check in/check out were clear; she also provided local food recommendations and parking tips. We had a great stay!
Very quaint and roomy. Comfy beds. Loved relaxing in the 2nd bedroom which we called the sunroom. Convenient location to buses and trains.
ok

My family stayed in George’s place for spring break. It is centrally located in River North within walking distance of multiple grocers, pharmacies, world-class restaurants and Chicago classics and the L.
It is truly an oasis in the city. It is remarkably quiet for its location. For my family of five, the lynchpin feature was a dedicated free parking space. That saved us hundreds in parking fees.
We would definitely stay in George’s again.

For a group of visitors from abroad, this apartment was ideal. It's close to campus and convenient for stores and restaurants. Erick is a thoughtful host and helped our guests check in after a late-arriving flight.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt bei Liz und Martin.
Die Wohnung ist wirklich toll, und wie beschrieben. Das Wohnzimmer war sehr gemütlich, mit einem großen Fernseher und Esstisch.
Das Kingsize-Bett und im anderen Zimmer Queensize-Bett waren auch super.
Und die Küche mit Gas-Herd, riesigem Kühlschrank und Kaffee-Pad-Maschine auch hervorragend ausgestattet.
