Alles bestens!
Easy to get to, clean spaces, Tuğba’s Airbnb was a great stay for a solo traveler. Reliable access to blue line on the L, quick to get downtown to The Loop, and O’Hare airport. Would stay again!

Excelente experiencia. El apartamento estaba muy bien atendido, limpio y cómodo. Ideal para una estadía en familia por Chicago. Cerca de la ciudad . Sin duda lo recomendamos. ¡Gracias por la hospitalidad!

Lesley was a great host and responsive to any issues we had during our stay. Working the stove is a bit tricky due to the lack of immediate/attached counter space but the spot is well worth the trade off. The bathroom likewise lacks counter space and really only has room for tooth paste and tooth brushes. The location is right next to one of the main bus routes that runs downtown so you don't have to rush once you set out for the day. Overall worth the stay and would consider staying again
Very clean and is as shown in the images. Cool location, definitely would recommend for anyone going to Chicago
Perfect location! Great place. Hosts were awesome.
Safe and lovely accommodations. Fully stocked kitchen. I did not have to eat out. Quiet and clean. All you could ask for!
Beautiful neighborhood, great distance from campus, and responsive host. Would recommend to anyone staying in the Hyde Park area.
Great place! Andy is very nice! Would love to stay again in the future
Easy process and a nice home in a convenient location for exploring Chicago with a family
Was a great stay great unit great amenities

I had a wonderful stay at Chelsea’s Airbnb. The space was very clean, quiet, and peaceful which was exactly what I was looking for during my time in Chicago while visiting my mom. It provided the perfect environment to relax and recharge. I truly appreciated the comfort and care put into the space, and I would absolutely book with them again in the future. Highly recommend!

Caryl is a great host!  We stayed in their house for three nights and it was one of the best Airbnb experiences. The house is beautiful in a nice neighborhood; my son walked back in the middle of night without a problem. We will definitely come back!
The home was just like the photos. My family had ample space and we felt right at home. The hosting team was very responsive and helpful. Definitely got my money’s worth
Clean spot with good amenities close to red line!! Great host

We had a wonderful stay here with our family, including kids, and it truly felt like the perfect home base for our trip. The space was clean, beautifully designed, and had plenty of room for everyone to spread out and relax. The layout worked especially well for a group with children, and the extra amenities like the game room were a huge hit.
The location was great, making it easy to explore while still enjoying a quiet, comfortable neighborhood feel. The host was also fantastic, very responsive, welcoming, and made everything seamless from start to finish.
Overall, a great place with a great host, and we would absolutely stay here again.

We had a great stay here. It was a perfect location for us, a few blocks away from family members and a quick walk to the train. Because we were visiting family and the city, we didn't spend a whole lot of time in the unit, but it had everything we needed. Sleeping space is comfy, kitchen has with all the basic equipment, dishes, and utensils that made making breakfast easy. The ceilings are low, but I was traveling with two children and the three of us fit just fine! The neighborhood is quiet and street parking was easy. We would stay again if we come back for a visit.

We had a great stay here while our condo was being renovated. The location was ideal—close to the lake, with convenient access to everyday shopping and everything you need nearby. Getting around was easy; we had a car, but it’s also well-connected to public transportation, which is a big plus.
Nofar was a pleasure to deal with—very kind, responsive, and attentive throughout our stay, which made the whole experience seamless.
Overall, a comfortable, well-located place with a host who truly cares.
Todo Excelente...
very comfortable place to stay...Maria and Miguel are very attentive and helpful hosts..
Great stay! Easy access. Parking was great.

Exactly what we were looking for in Chicago. Spent a few years in the neighborhood a decade ago, and it was great to get back there, show the kids around, and see how things have changed (and stayed the same). Great home base for exploring both the "tourist sites" in the city and taking in what makes Chicago great...all the neighborhoods and the local bars and restaurants scattered around.
Centrally located and a short walk to many fun attractions.
Samantha’s place was perfect and so charming. The light that comes in the apartment is really stunning and the design crates a welcoming and relaxing vibe.

We stayed as a group of seven, including four kids ages 5–14, and the location, layout, and amenities were a perfect fit for our family. I'd confidently say the space works just as well for smaller groups too, and I can easily picture coming back with just my wife and friends or with the whole family again.
Naomi was a fantastic host! She was responsive, thorough, and genuinely thoughtful throughout our stay. She answered all our questions promptly and even provided parking passes for the residential parking, which was a huge help coming in from out of town.
Highly recommend! We'd stay here again without hesitation.

Robert's place was lovely! We've stayed in four Airbnb's this month and this was our favorite by far. It is a garden level unit so a little bit dark but was really well decorated and cozy. The kitchen had everything we needed and was great for cooking dinner. And a king bed!! Amazing. The space has really been intentionally designed for actual living -- not just looking pretty for photos.
Our two dogs stayed with us and loved the little tiny side yard. It was a great adjustment for them to city life to have their own little spot to sniff. It's a 15 minute walk to a dog park and the trail by the lake. We usually found street parking in front of the unit but one or twice when we came back late we parked a couple of blocks away, no big deal. I'd highly recommend this spot!
Great space with nice bathroom and kitchen space. Good location in the river West area..very walkable. Overall great stay. I’d book again.

I had a wonderful stay in Thomas' beautiful home. Thomas is a a pro - warm, welcoming, responsive, and determined to make sure I had a great trip. The house is in a lovely neighborhood and in walking distance to public transit and grocery stores. Can't wait to come back!

My stay lived up to the listing! I enjoyed the spa-like experience and the chance to pamper myself. The location is fantastic, easy walking distance to Logan Square and many shops and fantastic food. Theodora was a very responsive host, taking care of requests quickly.

This is my first time in an AirBnB, and I was not disappointed. This was an amazing experience, if you’re visiting Chicago, I highly recommend booking with Freddy- your whole stay will be worth every penny.
Friendly and responsive host, love the location, great fit for a shortie like me (tall folks should beware the low ceilings). Parking was easy, bed was comfy, I would 100% stay here again!
We had a very comfortable stay at Kath’s place. They were always responsive with any of our questions and the place was very cosy. It’s also conveniently located by the CTA Blue line.
Great chill location. Street parking was super easy and accessible. Accurate descriptions of everything and clean!

We really enjoyed our stay! The home was well maintained and even nicer in person than we expected. The only downside was a very strong marijuana odor throughout the building that occasionally drifted into our unit.
We chose to park on the street since there were no posted towing signs, and it worked out fine with no tickets or issues.
Overall, we appreciated our time here, and the host was very responsive and helpful.
Great location.  Our family of 6 enjoyed our stay there and it had everything we needed!

This house was perfect for our family of five! Neighborhood was absolutely beautiful and just a quick walk to shops, restaurants, train station, and ice cream. My kids loved having their own “loft” space upstairs and all the stuffed animals in it. The house backs up to the train tracks, so we constantly heard the train passing by. It didn’t really bother me or my children, but my husband said he got woken up a couple times each night, even with a sound machine. I truly appreciated the extra toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher pods, and laundry pods that the hosts provided. Usually, just the bare minimum is supplied and we have to go shopping for more after day one. So it was quite refreshing that that wasn’t the case with our stay here. Definitely recommend this property (unless maybe if you’re an extremely light sleeper.) I would stay again!
Excellent location, super clean apartment and fantastic communication from hosts! Highly recommend.

There were several issues during my stay that made the experience far from acceptable. The washer was down( host came in multiple times to fix), the lights went out, and the dishwasher wasn’t working properly. Maintenance had to come into the Airbnb multiple times within a short period to fix things that should have been working before I arrived.
On top of that, I raised concerns several times about the heat. It was so cold downstairs that I couldn’t even use the space comfortably, and my daughter stopped coming over after getting sick because the temperature was around 65-68 degrees. That’s not okay. I never went downstairs to sit on couch due to the temperature.
I’ve tried to be patient, but this situation doesn’t feel fair. Coming back after long 16-hour shifts to deal with issues like the master bedroom lights not working was extremely frustrating. Even when I first arrived, things like the laundry room doors were already broken. Every-time I would walk in after work, a tv is on.
This place was perfect for our needs, visiting the university for a series of events.  Convenient, quiet, pleasant.

Quiet space that was very clean but has a comfy feeling. Bed was comfortable.
The sauna was a great treat and was big enough to spread out.
Great restaurants close by.
We reached out a couple times with questions and got answers right away.
Very cozy place! I enjoyed it and would stay again!!
Great location! And beautifully decorated. The views are amazing. I will be back.
Host allowed us to book last minute late in the day which was great. Plenty of beds for our big group as well. Lots of rooms. Would stay again if needed. Perfect for our construction group.

This was our third visit to J&J Oasis, our Chicago home away from home. We can count on it to be clean and ready for our arrival. The area is safe and walkable to restaurants and grocery stores.  The home is well represented by the photos.  Juliana is a friendly and considerate host.  Highly recommend!
We enjoyed our stay. Off street parking was very convenient. Lots of places to walk to.
Excelente lugar para descansar. huele bien buena ubicación. Volvería en una próxima oportunidad.

We really enjoyed our stay. Freddy was an awesome host. Any issue I had or questions he replied promptly. The house was nice and clean and the area was peaceful. Neighbors was friendly. The beds were also so comfortable 😊 I would highly recommend
Easy and a pleasure to deal with
Really nice space to stay for a week, and a great location to explore Lincoln Square.
This property was perfect for our stay. Safe neighborhood and never had a problem finding parking nearby!

The loft was great for our family vacation. 6 adults had plenty of space over 5 days. The rooftop patio is such a treat. The living room is comfortable and spacious. The kitchen is well stocked for cooking meals and the dining table easily fit 6. The two bathrooms are clean and pleasant. The neighborhood is awesome, with many great restaurants and bars within a stone's throw, and cute shops everywhere. You can walk to two different parks within 15 minutes. Public transit is incredible here, and hopping on and off the blue line next door was very easy. The train noise did not disturb us in the bedrooms. We were very pleased with the accommodations, location, and gracious hosts.
Booked this space for a trip here to Chicago, it was a beautiful apartment with great rooms. Host was great and would love to be back.

The location was perfect! It was a walkable distance from great restaurants and fun bars. The room was just as expected from the pictures and clean. The instructions to get in were clear as well. Thank you!
Host was very responsive. Place was spacious and had nice view especially during the night. Recommended!👍
Great place and a great host!

Welcoming place in a great location. Easy to walk to the "L" to head downtown. Many many restaurants within walking distance. Parking can be a bit difficult on the street directly out front where it is free and without restrictions (other than street cleaning days/times). Otherwise, permitted parking was provided by the host along the side-streets. Oz Park was excellent for the kids only a few blocks away. The Lake Shore Path is about a mile away, perfect for biking or running along.
Everything you could possibly need was provided in the unit, including shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, travel toothpaste, extra towels/linens. Heat in the house works well and is easy to adjust. Kids loved the Ms. Packman arcade game on the lower level!
The only downside we encountered, is that it can be noisy at night/early morning. We expected this, it is very near a busy intersection in the middle of a heavily populated and popular area. We certainly appreciated the ear plugs that were provided!

We had a great overall experience staying at this Airbnb in Chicago. The check-in was easy, and I really appreciated the flexibility with check-out, which made our stay much more convenient. The location is excellent, with easy access to everything you might need, and parking was also very convenient and helpful, especially in a busy city.
Michael and Muhamme were very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We did experience an issue with the internet, which left us without TV or service for one night, but they handled it promptly and professionally, and it was fixed quickly.
That said, the unit could benefit from a deeper cleaning. There was noticeable dust accumulation on the windows, which unfortunately triggered my son’s allergies. The kitchen area could also use attention, as there were used storage bags and some dirty utensils stored away.
With a bit more attention to cleanliness, this place would easily be a top-tier stay. Overall, it was still a positive experience!

Kitty was so kind to us when we stayed, and was very proactive even before we arrived to make sure she would be available when we were ready for check in. She was a great host and her space was very cozy, can't wait to come back.
Perfect, perfect perfect I give this place a 10 out of 10

Excelente estadía! Era exactamente lo que necesitaba para mi estadía. Cómodo, independiente, limpio y con buen acceso.
Muy recomendable!
A cozy apartment in a great neighborhood!

This place is the perfect location for exploring Andersonville. The hosts are very friendly and the space is clean and has all the amenities you can need. The bed is very soft, and the shower is nice and hot. I would absolutely stay here again. You seriously can’t beat the location for the value.

We were in town for a Blackhawks game and to see the sites in Chicago. Excellent location and clean, well managed space.
Thank you for the great accommodations!

The place was absolutely amazing I truly enjoyed every moment of my stay. It was very peaceful, clean, and comfortable, making it easy to relax and feel at home. The location was perfect, with great restaurants and everything I needed just a short distance away.
Peter was an excellent host—very responsive, kind, and helpful throughout my stay. He made sure all my questions were answered and that I had everything I needed.
Thank you again for such a wonderful experience. I will definitely be booking again in the near future and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable stay!
This place was wonderful- we were only there for a night but it would also be great for a longer stay. Wonderful location and value, everything was clean and communication was easy.

we really liked the place, location and ease of working with the host. the beds were comfy and there were so many places to eat in walking distance.  and a huge perk for us was having access to the garage/parking space- we will stay here again next time!

The location is excellent; near the L, walkable to great restaurants and parks, and a fun neighborhood. We did encounter some issues with the Airbnb and amenities, including with the parking permits listed as an amenity, the cleanliness of the floors and bathrooms (floors were extremely sticky and there were bodily fluid stains on walls) and broken lamps throughout the apartment. We selected this apartment because it is listed as family friendly, however there were a few safety issues (heavy/large unsecured floor mirrors, broken floor lamps leaning on walls) that were not safe for young children. The co-host was fairly communicative and did have someone come out to clean the floors/walls the next day, but became frustrated and rude when we ran into parking permit issues and asked for support. The parking described in the listing is misleading (extremely limited free parking) but if you do not have a car, the neighborhood is great.

Second time staying at this location. Excellent proximity to blue line trains, allowing quick and easy access to the city. Back yard space is perfect for pet use. Free street parking spaces are never an issue. Clean as always. Would recommend to anyone for their next visit to Chicago.
Practical spot to crash on the south side.

I  had an fantastic stay at Josey's place! The space looks just like the ad — stylish, cozy, and incredibly comfortable. It was the perfect retreat after a long day. Josey was so attentive and friendly throughout my stay, making sure I had everything I needed and check-in was seamless. Her warm hospitality truly made this experience memorable. I highly recommend staying here and would definitely book again!
So worth the stay!
Perfect stay all around.  Immaculately kept house in a great Chicago neighborhood, Lois and Eduardo were excellent hosts.
Victor is a very proactive, gracious host and wuicly responds to any needs.

I had a really nice stay in Chicago. The views were great and something I genuinely enjoyed throughout the trip. The location made things easy, too—quick access to the freeway and a Target close by for grabbing food and anything I needed.
I’ve stayed at Cloud9's other properties and always had a good experience, and this one was no different. It made the whole stay feel convenient and comfortable.

Wendy and Matt's place is beautiful and was perfect for our trip to Chicago. It was centrally located - walking distance to restaurants, Second City, the park, and public transportation. The layout gave all of us privacy while also providing a cozy central living room for shared downtime. The kitchen was great - nice appliances and well-stocked. We will definitely stay here again.

Great place to stay to be able to get around Chicago. There’s a Redline station a 10 minute walk away and from there you can go all the way down south through Chicago and use the other train lines. There are a ton of restaurants and bars right around the area too. The place was clean and as expected, just a good place to sleep and go out and enjoy the city all day.

Kevin was very friendly and professional, we were in the area for a concert and having a very clean, welcoming space to spend the night was amazing. I would definitely recommend Kevin and this listing to others looking for a safe and clean place to stay.

The place was a little shabby and the bed wasn’t super comfortable (bunk bed room), but the location is fantastic, the host was always available,  and it’s very clean and orderly. The outdoor deck on the third floor is really cool and if you’re driving, street parking is surprisingly easy to find. Overall worth it for the price.
The place was as described. It was quiet and I enjoyed my stay.
If you like the Cubs or plan to use the red line, stay here
Everything was amazing! For a young family, this rental had everything we needed. Very nice location, close to lots! Very quiet street. Parking super easy. Would recommend and stay again.
We couldn’t have been more pleased with our stay. Everything our family needed and our hosts were so friendly and helpful. Hope to stay here again in the future.
stay was great. hosts were very responsive and helped a lit during checkin and checkout

This was not a good stay at all. The host was very dismissive and rude. I chose this place because it advertised a washer and dryer because I was gonna be there a week. Overall, this was a very disturbing and disappointing Stay. Renters Beware.

Comfortable and convenient place to stay! The bed and pillows were very cozy. Will definitely stay again. Thank you Matthew!
Near to chinatown and bus stops, kitchen with few pots/pans and no cutlery but usable to prep some insta food

I stay with Julie and Zack in their one-of-a-kind space every time I come to chicago and I can't say enough good things about it.  they are friendly and gracious hosts and   outside of the thoughtful and unique decor you're treated to comfy sleeping quarters that you'll never want to leave, a downright luxurious shower experience, and a massive tv with surround sound to unwind in front of at the end of the night.  nestled in a peaceful neighborhood, the bad manor is a hidden gem that you're a fool not to book with for your chicago stay.
Place was good

Marc was an excellent host. He communicated clearly and responded quickly, which made the stay smooth from start to finish.
The unit was clean and well stocked with everything needed. The snacks were a great touch, and the espresso machine stood out and elevated the experience.
Ground-level access made coming and going easy, especially with luggage.
I would stay here again and recommend this spot to anyone visiting Chicago.

We truly enjoyed our stay. The purpose of our trip was to celebrate Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread for a week in Chicago, which made this visit especially meaningful. This was actually my old neighborhood from the 90s, and I could see that a lot has changed over the years.
Overall, our stay was very nice—peaceful, spacious, and fully equipped with everything we needed. The house was exactly as described on the app. The beds were very comfortable, the kitchen was open and well-designed, and I especially loved the living room space.
This will definitely be a place we consider returning to during our yearly High Holy Day celebration. The host provided clear instructions and was responsive to our needs throughout our stay.
Everything was perfect !
This was a cozy stay on the top floor of an apartment in a neighborhood a felt comfortable and quiet.
Thank you so much for this amazing stay! Second time in Chicago but with family this time and it was unfortunately! Highly recommend this place for big groups :)
la casa e molto bella e pulita il host e davero una brava persona sono felice di aver dormito traquilo e rilassante
Loved the place, its central enough to downtown my husband went running every morning to downtown it was a 6 mile round trip

A charming little walk-up close to the blue line which will get you almost anywhere in Chicago. The hosts were very responsive, never taking more than an hour to respond to a message. We adored our stay and will be glad to come back the next time we're in town.
Wonderful amenities for traveling with 2 teenagers!
Recommend this place

We had a great stay at the apartment! It was clean and easy to get into from the start and having all the amenities that we wanted for our trip! Everything was in place and we'll be coming back in the future!

I was looking for a nice place near the university of Chicago and this matched the description perfectly. looked exactly like the photos, had everything I needed. The check in instructions were excellent and the communication with Vin was great

This private suite is a gem of a find — ideal for one person or a couple for its proximity to UChicago. John was extremely responsive to all my questions and even offered local, seasonal tips. Would def. consider re-booking for my next visit. Thank you!

Alma was very kind and responded to messages quickly. Her place was very nice and clean, and the kitchen was well-equipped with everything we needed. It was a great place for two people to stay. Overall, we had a very good experience and would definitely recommend it!
Great place!!

Our group of 7 had an incredible time here! It’s even better than the photos. Perfect location for walking everywhere with tons of amazing restaurants and Target (super important for traveling with kids!). Our kids loved sleeping in the bunk bed room with their cousins. And the view from the balcony is breathtaking. We can’t wait to be back!

Joseph’s place was perfect for our needs as we explored Chicago with out of town friends. Check in was easy and the apartment was just as pictured. Joseph checked with us after our arrival to make sure that all went well. We were able to board the nearby Brown line and connect with a HopOn, Hop Off  bus down town to begin our adventures. The information that Joseph provided about what was available in and around the area was very helpful. Although we did not utilize the kitchen beyond morning coffee, it seemed quite adequate for most people’s needs. As we came and went from the Airbnb, we were able to find nearby parking whenever we needed it. We were very comfortable and would stay here again.
Amazing place, nice and clean

I had another great stay at Manuel’s place. It’s always my first choice whenever I come to Chicago for work. The environment is very quiet and peaceful, which makes it perfect for resting after a long day.
The location is also very convenient, with two bus stations nearby, making it easy to get around the city. For me, it has everything I need — comfort, calm, and accessibility.
I definitely recommend it and will keep coming back!
Absolutely adore this apartment I would live in it if I could.

Super clean spacious space would stay again!

El alojamiento tiene una ubicación excelente.  En pleno centro, lo que te da acceso fácil y rápido a las principales atracciones. Incluso caminando. La vista desde una habitación y la estancia, es grandiosa, sobre todo por la noche. Las camas son cómodas. Elena respondió de manera inmediata y amable a las dudas que surgieron.
Good location in Old Town Chicago.

I stayed at Maxwell's place for about 6 months, and it was a genuinely fantastic experience. The location is right off Clark, so it's super walkable and close to the lakefront with divvy only a half block away, multiple buses nearby and redline about a 10 min walk.
Maxwell is exactly the kind of host you hope for, especially for a longer stint. He's incredibly accountable. Anytime a minor question or issue came up, he was completely on top of it and handled things right away.
I stayed over here for a solo trip and I really appreciated how accommodating and flexible they were with my check in time. I’d stay here again!!

Great place to stay! John is responsive and helpful. However, if you have a hard time climbing stairs this place is not for you. Beautiful old building but the stair case is a test of endurance. Would definitely stay here again.
Had a great time at this location. Right next to the lake and close to everything else we needed.
Excelente inmueble y todos los servicios muy buenos

What a gem of a location! We booked John’s place with our three kids for spring break and had a wonderful time! We were super excited to use the patio area but didn’t realize how cold it would be in April. This would be an awesome area to bbq in the summer/fall. The neighborhood was walkable with nearby parks, a little grocery store and really amazing restaurants. John recommended a bunch of local spots and we loved them all. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

We had a great experience staying at this Airbnb. The host was incredibly responsive, accommodating, and easy to communicate with from start to finish. Anytime we had a question or needed anything, he was quick to reply and very helpful.
He went out of his way to make sure our crew was taken care of, and that level of attentiveness really stood out. The place worked well for our needs, and the overall experience was smooth and comfortable.
We truly appreciated his hospitality and would definitely recommend staying here!
Host is responsive and helpful
This was a relaxing g and roomy place to stay.

Thank you so much for hosting us. As a traveling contractor who often stays in high-end hotels, I was looking for something different this time and am so glad I found your place.
Having someone greet us at the door was a wonderful personal touch compared to the usual self-check-in process. Your home provided the perfect sanctuary for me to relax and recover after my 12-16 hour work shifts. The atmosphere was a breath of fresh air, and the memory foam bed was excellent.
No partying here! If you're looking for a quiet, restful place to sleep, Inn & out this is definitely it! Lots of great recommendations from the Host & very helpful co-hosts. I have found my go-to spot in Illinois and will certainly book here again.

Alex's place was just perfect for getting together with our family! The home was beautiful with comfy furniture and a well equipped kitchen. The laundry and cleaning products were eco friendly and unscented so you weren't bombarded with artificial scents. The house was next to a small park and within walking distance of the beach, which the youngster loved especially. Public transit was very close by and there were walkable neighborhoods with good restaurants and interesting shops blocks away. Alex was a delight to work with. Only wish we could've stayed longer!

Jacob made it easy to check in and out. Communications were clear and easy to follow. Location was perfect. Nice to have a garage to park in overnight. Worked out really well for our stay. Would stay again.
Alec was an amazing host and everything was amazing! Good choice to stay in Chicago. Area felt safe

Fabio was very quick to respond to my request for where I might find some coffee filters upon me waking at the location our first morning. Turns out there weren't any and he responded right away and promptly ran a package of them over to us! He was there in less than 5 minutes! If I am in the area again I will definitely keep this townhouse on my saved list of options!

The actual Airbnb was nice and I had little problems while in there, but I had problems with getting in. They did not list on the listing that there was no free parking as well as the fact you have to pay an additional fee after the initial price of the booking.

Joe’s place was as described and as shown in pictures. Very clean and tidy. Location was easy to find. Perfect location for our needs. Tony’s grocery store was convenient. Nice and quiet. Joe was very attentive and did his best to accommodate our stay. Loved the provided coffee grounds touch and easy check out process.
Love the place loved the private balcony will stay there again.

Freddy place was very nice to stay at! I recommend his place when staying in Chicago. He was quick to respond and was helpful for anything I needed. I definitely would be be coming back whenever I’m back in Chicago!
I’m very grateful you let me stay so last minute! It was such a comfortable place and it was so close the United Center! Thank you so much for being a wonderful host
This place was in a great location in a quiet neighborhood close to Wrigley! Our only complaint is we never had hot water for showers.

Kyle was a great host. He was proactive, flexible with the check-in time and friendly and approachable. The set up is very nice with your own private room in a Coach house behind the main house. It’s a great neighborhood, easy to walk to Starbucks, restaurants Wrigley Field, etc. It’s great that they have easily available parking, but you will not need a car.
La comunicación fue muy buena. El departamento es muy amplio y bien equipado. Está muy cerca del metro, por lo que es genial si viajas en familia.
The place is clean and comfortable, with beautiful views and a comfy bed. I really enjoyed my stay here and would definitely come again next time I come to Chicago.
My friend and I enjoyed our stay, honestly one of the best ones so far. It was in a great area and had free parking!! Definitely coming back in the future!

Espacio agradable, fácil de comunicar con toda la ciudad.
Muy recomendable

I liked this location, it was a quiet neighborhood and very accessible to restaurants and stores. We hardly drove around since some stores were right around the corner. This location isn’t too far the train station it only took me 20 mins to walk which wasn’t a problem for me.
I appreciate the fact that Regina had some Appliances around the Airbnb such as a flat iron and a hair dryer along with some shampoo & conditioner in case you forgot to bring your own. Regina was very helpful and kind with any information we needed about the Airbnb.

Matthew was fast to reply to the heat stop working on our 2nd to last day. Besides the heat going out on us the place was good for us. If ur looking for a place near everything this is the spot ur 10-15 from cubs and white Sox, downtown is 5 minutes. A lot to do in the area.
I like that it is just situated in front of a bus stop 73. Its also very near to groceries and pharmacies.
Great location, Close to many great food and shopping options. Would return

Stayed here as a family and the location and place were perfect! Having the convenient parking in the building is a huge bonus.
Can see the Sears tower from the balcony as well!

Caitlyn’s stay was such a hit with my family! It was so cute and well decorated - but beyond that - it was so comfortable.  It’s a perfect stay for a family.  It has parking - is two blocks away from the theatre where we were going for a show.  Plus Caitlyn was a great host - answering all my questions quickly and always really friendly.  This is for sure our stay when we come back to Chicago.

Phenomenal! Simon went above and beyond in making us feel welcome and at home from beginning to end. The place is absolutely beautiful, and Simon provided so many nice amenities to make our stay even better. Cannot recommend Simon & his place enough, thank you for everything!

Had a great stay and everything the stay was perfect! Ron was really helpful and accommodating during my week stay. The location is filled with lots of nearby restaurants and bars and fun things to do. Highly recommend this Airbnb!

Amanda’s space was perfect for what we needed. Walkable to restaurants, cafes and shops. Very clean and comfortable. And Amanda was extremely helpful and prompt to respond. A wonderful witch’s castle!
A very good place to stay.
Best host ever!  Thinks of everything and very communicative.

Great air bnb and hosts were very helpful and responsive. I recommend allergy pills if you are allergic to dogs and cats like I am. The air bnb was nicely stocked with amenities and spacious. I recommend the space and would book again
Really cozy, clean, quiet place. Great vibe, and very responsive.
Great location, large space indoors and fabulous outdoor space!

The apartment is in a very central area with access to great bars and eateries within walking distance. There's also close access to public transport both rail and bus. The Uber is also reasonably cheap.

Pros: location is great as far as access to transportation, museums, and restaurants. Host responsive, mattresses were nice. Appreciated thick curtains in the rooms. Space was pretty good.
Cons: so. On booking asked to agree to an extensive list of rules and just assumed that these were standards for the building.
NOT THE CASE. None of us could sleep due to loud music, neighbors at all hours of the night. There is a gym right below the apartment and slamming medicine balls on the ground at the crack of dawn. I even had ear plugs and was hard to block out the noise/bass.
The hallway reeked of thick MJ smoke and we had to put towels at the bottom of the front door to slow the reek into the apartment. My daughters were sleeping in the front bedroom and their room reeked so bad at night they had significant nausea. Ok I did too.
I realize ad says “420 Friendly” but didn’t
think twice about it as we don’t partake in this. Had no clue the entire floor would be a cloud of MJ smoke.

Overall, we had a great stay here. Very spacious and very clean. Found a few minor issues, but nothing that we couldn’t handle Parking definitely needs to be designated or marked for the guest, but ultimately our spot was always available. Thank you again Ella and Peter for a great stay.
P.S. The throws were divine. I’ve been trying to find the exact one since night one unfortunately no luck..😩
Great location.  Very nice house.  Communication with the host was great.  Will look to stay again.

The location was good.  There is a great breakfast place in walking distance, and you can walk to the lake.  My only comment is that there was a lot of cat hair on the furniture.   We found street parking but some nights we had to walk 3 blocks to our parking spot.
Decent place and can definitely be good for a temporary stay.
Great place to have a sizeable group!

A lovely place to stay for me and my daughter for college visits- stylish, clean, good neighborhood and just a few blocks from U of Chicago. Shari and Frantz are very friendly and responsive with questions. I highly recommended this place!

I absolutely loved staying here, very central, you don’t have a view, I will be honest about that. But it didn’t bother myself or my boyfriend.
The carpet itself and the area surrounding needs a good deep clean, there were marks left on there, as soon as we arrived.
However the kitchen is fab, the bed is extremely comfy, and the washer and dryer are so handy!!!
Plus the pool and gym in the complex was such a bonus.
Great spot with lots within walking distance. Right next to a bus stop too. Incredible host!
The area was BEAUTIFUL and the suite was Amazing!! I recommend to anyone!! The host was Very helpful and responsive as well.
Great location! Clean and close to city transportation. Would definitely stay again when visiting.

La stanza è davvero piccola, la posizione è lontana da tutto, ma c'è un bus che porta in mezz'ora verso il centro. In compenso la zona è tranquilla è c'è del verde fuori. Ho detestato non poter gettare la carta nel water (ho dovuto buttarla in un bidone). In compenso ci sono due bagni belli grandi (anche se non del tutto puliti...mi dispiace dirlo ma è vero). Check in perfetto, ma nella mia stanza c'erano dei resti di cibo sulla scrivania (un biscotto credo...) dell'ospite precedente. La cucina è buona, adeguata, nulla da dire. Tornassi indietro opterei per qualcos'altro.

great location, very close to transpo, michigan ave, lots of restaurants and bars around the area. 2 beds were very comfy and one wasn't. space inside was huge, and very comfy temperature wise especially through the cold chicago nights. good base location wise.
when we checked in there was some water on the floor in one of the rooms, and we notified them about this and got a response right away and was not that worried about it anymore (possibly from an open window?). it's definitely a hike up to the bnb so just be careful if you have huge and heavy luggages.
Excelente lugar justo en el centro de todo

We enjoyed the stay and everything did feel safe and comfortable. However, the outlets in our room were both in a bit of a broken state and felt unsafe to use.
We also noticed that we had a duvet with an ironing burn in it, so we asked for a new blanket! The host was quick to respond and told us we’d have another one delivered to us, but that never occurred.
Finally, out of the 5 days of our stay, the Wifi went out specifically in our apartment for 4 of those days. Wifi was working in every place else around us but not ours.
We really wanted to enjoy this deal, but these issues did make it tough to do so. 3/5 stars from us
We really wanted to enjoy
We wanted to enjoy everything else this listing had to offer, and we did, but these

Worth it! We arrived during a torrential downpour, unloaded quickly, and looked for parking late on a weekday night. It started rough. But the minute we stepped all the way inside, absolute peace and beauty. This place is immaculate and the best landing spot after a day of sight seeing or half marathon running! The little touches really add up-from the running themed books on the coffee table to the endless toiletries and bath towels-it felt like it was personalized just for us. We definitely utilized the tub for a hot soak after our Chi Town Half Marathon (in the rain and mud). There’s plenty of room for everyone to feel like they have their own space. The kitchen is *chefs kiss* a dream. And the best part is the little sitting area off the primary bedroom. Quiet and quaint. Perfect for a little alone time.
The train station is a walkable distance and uber is always only minutes away. Plus, parking is a lot easier than we made it out to be.
lovely place to stay! comfy beds, easily accessible, good location, no complaints!
My friends and I had a wonderful time during this stay. Amazing location & perfect for a short getaway!
Great place ! very clean and safe! Thanks so much!!
great location,  everything was just like the listing!

The spot was really nice! Definitely the cherry on top was the private rooftop, which we unfortunately didn’t get to use much cause the days we went were very cold. Overall, a great bnb would come again
Excellent - a ton of room and very convenient
our stay was wonderful! wonderful hostess and great cleanliness!
The place was great, the location was amazing, and it was very quiet. I felt extremely comfortable.
We had a great trip thanks to our stay here, everything was perfect. Very easy and comfortable
It was my first  time visiting Chicago/ 30th Birthday trip and this was the perfect Airbnb for it.
We absolutely loved our stay at Bucktown house. Beautiful area and beautiful home, was very comfortable and enjoyable.
Beautiful place with a great location central to many things to do.  Really cool view of the skyline.  We had a great time in Chicago!
Super convenient for McCormick place

This place was centrally located and nicely decorated, but we did note some cleanliness issues (e.g, dirty high chair in the closet, dirt under table, dirty floors) and a musty smell, which we communicated to the hosts.

Noelle and Rob are excellent hosts. The neighborhood is very walkable and safe. Parking was never a problem.
I am a senior who was staying in town to help my daughter with her new baby. It was nice to have hosts readily available. The unit is garden level apartment below their house. You do hear them above but it didn’t bother me or my other family members when they stayed for a couple of days. The hosts were also very respectful of quiet hours if they had guests. I would definitely stay there again.
Beautiful place, incredible bed and peaceful neighborhood right beside the trail & subway….perfect!

Carlo’s place is so convenient. There is a bus stop 2 minutes away that takes you to the blue line. The location is very beautiful with lots of restaurants and grocery stores. We locked ourselves out of the apartment and Carlo’s was quick to send someone over to open the door. Thank you for a fantastic month :)

Had a great stay here. Justin was flexible when our plans changed and very responsive and professional. The place was spotless and beyond what I was expecting. The trains going by on the brown line were a little noisy, but the neighborhood is nice, lots to do, breweries literally next door.

We booked for a last minute stay so the price was very reasonable. The private (and safe) parking being included was a huge plus. The apartment is clearly set up for groups and is spacious. The kitchen wasn’t well stocked so if you’re planning on doing a lot of cooking, bring some basics. However, with so many great restaurants around it makes sense it isn’t geared towards staying in. A few minor fixes would go a long way (beds are rickety/squeaky, door knobs loose, walls are scuffed up, etc) in making the space feel more upscale. The primary shower is amazing and bathrooms are updated. Overall, it’s a great unit, especially if you’re using it as a landing pad for all the things Chicago has to offer. The unit was very clean- would suggest cleaning the hallway/stairs as well as it’s the first impression to the  space. Overall a good stay and appreciated a lot about the condo!
Safe, clean and comfortable. Host was very nice and responsive!

The place was perfect for our needs! Neighborhood was safe and walkable, with plenty to do in the area. Very close to the train station and multiple bus routes nearby. Demitri was very responsive and gave us clear instructions for everything!

This airy and spacious AirBnB is bathed in natural light and was a wonderful place for our family reunion  over the Easter holiday weekend. The location was excellent with a playground, grocery and multiple restaurants all within walking distance. The beds are uber comfortable, kitchen and bathrooms in great shape and squeaky clean.  Sarah was wonderfully responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!
We had a great time at Lenoid’s place. Parking and check-in were super easy.

Michael’s place was perfect!  The people in the building were friendly and it was easy to get to!  Beautiful views of Chicago and the El outside of the windows.  The little things made the stay perfect- a cup of mints, a welcome note, and toothbrushes and toothpaste tucked in towels- in case you had forgotten yours.  I also was impressed there was ketchup, salt and pepper among other small things one might need while on vacation.  Only thing to note were squeaky showers, but that is probably due to being in a condo with others utilizing the showers too.  It wasn’t a bother at all!  We absolutely would stay again!
This home away from home was lovely. The location is very convenient and close to places to eat as well as public transport. Clean and safe. Will recommend to others!
A great spot to stay in! Will definitely keep Nikkole's listing in mind for any future Chicago trips :) don't hesitate to book with her!
Our third time staying! It’s always so close to everything and comfy.
Great experience, nice renovations, brand new place, host was great! Will definitely be back.
Great place - loved being right next to the L. The noise wasn't bad at all!
Beautiful home in a very cool neighbourhood with a ton of amazing restaurants!
This is a very nice apartment in a great location. We love walking Clark and the food scene there is amazing!
Always replied fast when I had any questions, only thing that was a little confusing was the entrance overall it was a great place to stay at!

Michele and her husband Marsh were incredibly kind and helpful. Me and my best friend had arrived early and Michele was kind enough to allow me to check in early. Her husband Marsh, helped me with the luggage. The photos match the place. Public transportation was also easy. Everything was great about this place. They also have Taco Tuesdays, it was nice to have dinner with Michele and Marsh the night before me and my best friend left. Thank you again Michele and Marsh for having us. I definitely recommend staying with them.

We had a fantastic time at Gary’s place for our long weekend trip to Chicago. Super spacious place with plenty of room for our 6 person crew. We loved the proximity to the red line and there was a lot to love around the local area as well!!! Would highly recommend!
We had a wonderful time! Will book again when we are back in the city.
Nice and spacious
Wonderful stay, perfect location. Loved having a garage for two cars. We will definitely be back.
We had a short stay! Very clear instructions and nice and clean space!
A great spot that's close to public transportation for exploring Chicago.
Easy, comfortable, convenient! No complaints.

This apartment was lovely - beautifully furnished, spacious, a great kitchen with a ton of cookware, a washer and dryer, big bathroom, bedroom and comfortable bed. There was also a ton of storage. I love the area the apartment is in- it's walkable to the train and a ton of cool bars and restaurants in Wicker Park. We definitely felt at home here and comfortable for our month stay.

The best stocked Airbnb I’ve been to in a while! They’ve truly thought of everything, from plenty of creamer in the fridge to free snacks to great toiletry products! It felt like staying in a hotel. The shower was great, the bed was very comfortable. The neighborhood felt fine, but we used Ubers to get around whereas we used more public transit around downtown and Hyde Park. Very responsive hosts, and we will likely book this bnb again in the future.
Matt was an excellent, helpful host, and his place is beautiful -- perfectly located, spacious, well-equipped and comfortable.

Let me say  that If I could give 10 Stars I would!!!!! This place was beautiful and in a perfect location to the lake and to downtown.  Very clean and space was perfect! Kamadi was an AMAZING host!! Very responsive and easy access with parking was also a plus! I will stay again!
This was a perfect place to stay, so close to the united center for our concerts ! Thank you so much :)

The apartment was lovely. The location was excellent. There are plenty of restaurants to choose from. Everything is in walking distance. Parking isn’t the best but overall I enjoyed our stay, definitely consider booking again for our next trip to Chicago

We stayed at Jedidiah’s place for 3 nights and it couldn’t have been more convenient and perfect for our needs. Not only was it in the middle of so many great shops and restaurants, the space itself was comfortable and clean, and a great layout for two adults and two adult kids. We will certainly keep this space bookmarked for future trips!

Location could not be better. Less than a block to the best coffee (Candor) and restaurant (Tortello) we had in our whole trip. We loved having the chefs kitchen, the soaking tub and a comfy bed. We would love the chance to come back and would not look to stay anywhere else.
Great stay and very accommodating! Would stay again!

Overall great place, just what I needed in a pinch, both perfect for a couple nights AND was right next to my concert venue.
Regina was very responsive throughout and helped me with issues like the WiFi being down, and was flexible with my schedule.
The only issues I would have to note was one of the bedside reading lights being out, and some rusty appliances in the bathroom, both of which were simply impacting the overall aesthetic.
If i’m ever in Chi Town for another concert at the Aragon Ballroom, the first Airbnb i’m checking out is Regina’s!
This is my second time staying with Alls’s. Great location and very clean. I look forward to staying at your property again!
Very Homey and good for the price and perfect very affordable

The place was more than pleasant to stay at. We all had a great time with it being so close to China Town (driving distance wise).  Brian, the host, was easily reached and very responsive and proactive regarding all the questions and concerns we had before, during, and after our stay. We would definitely choose this place again if we happen to be in Chicago.

Absolutely great place to stay. It was clean and well kept. The only complaint I had was about parking. We arrived late Monday night and it was difficult finding a parking spot on the street. We were able to find one a block or two away and then move closer in the morning after people cleared out which was great. Not the hosts’ fault at all, just the neighborhood.
We had some issues figuring out the heat in the apartment as well and Marc was very quick to respond and help troubleshoot with me.
Very communicative leading up to and during our stay which I loved. This was my first time renting so I wasn’t super confident on how things worked so I’m very glad it went smoothly!

The airbnb itself was spacious and clean despite the smell of cigarettes we would get from entering. The noise was the worst part knowing that we could hear every foot step, faint voices, or furniture being moved in the space above us. At some point it just sounded like someone was running across the floor over and over again followed hy banging. It was tiring to know that if we aren't up by 08:00 then we would be woken up by noise and it was the same late into the night with not being able to get peace until 22:00. The communication with the host was alright. It does take a while for a response but any question you may have to get is answered pretty well through text. I would like to mention the times I had to call I never got an answer, but it could've been my timing of the day. A call back would've been appreciated to prevent long gaps in communication. Overall, we liked how private it felt, but the smell and if it was quieter would make this place better.

This was the perfect base for us to explore the city. Right on the brown line to the city but away from the downtown bustle. Eclectic, vibrant  neighbourhood with lots of  latino food, drink and culture. Our host Betty was responsive and accommodating and was quick to answer our questions. Would highly recommend!

The lock on the exterior gate was broken. The main level of the space was nice but one of the overhead lights in the kitchen was constantly blinking, some of the serving ware was dirty and the silverware was sitting in pools of water in the drawer. We arrived after dark and the light on the stairwell wasn’t working so it was tricky to navigate the steep and oddly angled steps. Also, there’s no railing for the staircase. Large chunks of the paint and drywall were peeling off the basement shower ceiling. Both bathrooms were almost out of toilet paper and I had to hunt for extra rolls finally finding them in a closet by the kitchen. Towels are very thin, cheap quality. Linens for the air mattress had stains. We killed multiple spiders in the unit. Parking pass was not left for me so I had to park several blocks away the first night. Communication with host was good but issues with the lights were not fixed, and issues with linens and parking pass were not addressed until the second day.

This was an amazing Airbnb for a group of friends who are couples to stay at. We spent a week with friends enjoying Chicago with easy access to the Loop but all the comforts of home. Able to relax and cook a large meal for the group of friends along with watching tv when the weather soured.
Absolutely would recommend this place.

Everything about this place was perfect for us! Location, walkability, space, layout, washer/dryer, yard, accommodating host...I could go on...Beautiful house in a beautiful neighborhood. Definitely would stay here again.
What a pleasant stay! Everything is well thought of. A super cute unit. Thank you Gogo for everything :)

Nichole was great! Proactively engaged to ensure we were okay and had clear instructions. The space is pretty baby friendly once we moved some items to a higher reach. Favorite part was how easy it was to walk to the United Center! About a 14 minute walk. I forgot to mention there is a nice grocery store right behind the place which was super convenient!
Patricia's place is in a great location in near north in Chicago. Its really well kept and in a great location with everything walkable and the metro is not far off

The place was as described, it was very walkable and had close access to public transportation. You could walk to Chinatown in only 10-15 minutes. The instructions were very clear and I personally didn't need extra communication although they seemed responsive. This is a great space for a solo or couples trip. It was very clean and they had several towels and blankets. The bathroom had shampoo, conditioner, and hand soap but no body wash so if you might want to bring that yourself. The water pressure was pretty low and was more of a rainfall type, I personally would've likes more pressure but it gets the job done. Also if you wanted to do laundry bring your own detergent. It was a great experience would recommend!
Great area.  Close to restaurants and public transportation.  Very responsive host.

Great place to stay in Chicago!
Went with our kids 6,4 and 1 and it was a great location.
Beds were super comfortable and Naomi is very responsive.

Elena's home was perfect for our family. We needed a nice, clean place with enough beds and baths. however, the REAL draw of the home is the superb location. We were about a 5 minute walk from the Cermak-Chinatown Red Line station, a 4 minute walk from the edge of Chjnatown's shops and restaurants, and less than a 20 minute drive from all the touristy areas we wanted to check out.
Elena was regularly in contact with us to ensure that we had everything we needed (we did, but it is always nice to be asked). I can't think of how our stay could have been made better, and will definitely be staying here again the next time we are in Chicago.
Thanks, Elena!

Jennifer’s place was exactly what we needed: perfect location, ground floor entrance, parking and walkability to restaurants and parks. The inside was clean and nicely decorated.  The kitchen was stocked with enough cooking utensils to cook a nice Easter meal.   We would highly recommend this  Airbnb when in Chicago.
Great place. Use the side entrance till they fix the main door locks

My stay was great! The location is 20 minutes from downtown and 20 minutes from airport. It was very convenient. I loved that the house had shampoo, conditioner and facewash already. It also had coffee and sugar. It is great not having to buy everything to go to a rental home.  Lots of rooms for our family. Two livings rooms and 3 full baths made a big difference for us.
Easy access to transit/bus routes and very quiet neighborhood
Great spot if you have a show at United center. Easy walking distance to the venue and to the L train. Thanks for sharing your space!
First time visiting the city and everything about the stay was great. It has everything you need. Everything is walking distance. Plenty of transportation too. Very well kept by the hosts.
This place very very spacious and clean
Great stay would stay again.
Pretty good space to just clear your heads.

Mike’s place here was awesome, plenty restaurants around and the interior was spectacular. Made me not feel bad to just chill inside instead of going out and doing stuff! Everything exceeded my expectations and super friendly owners as well, all around an awesome stay, no complaints at all!!
Very nice . Will book again!
great 👍
Place was clean and plenty of space. Host was communicative

We had such a great time at James’ place! The inside is beautiful, you can tell it’s thoughtfully curated with a lot of character, and you can tell James takes pride in his home. The location was probably the other best part, being so close to the L. We were able to get around very easily and felt completely safe and comfortable in the neighborhood, including leaving a parked car on the street the entire 4-night stay. It was also super easy to get to more local Pilsen attractions like the Museum of Mexican Art, which was only a 20-something minute walk.
We found some good restaurants and grocery stores nearby (walking distance) which was super helpful, especially on our first night in. James was also great at communicating with us on our check in/out and any other thing that could affect our stay.
We had a really great time on our trip, even if I didn’t get to meet the dog, but hopefully next time :) I’d definitely seek this property out again next time I head to Chicago!

The place was very clean and made me feel right at home. It looks a lot bigger than the images and is super easy to access. The host left very clear insurrections on how to access the home. The absolute atmosphere of the home was very sleek and modern. My favorite part was definitely the shower and I don’t think the pictures capture how nice the shower actually was.
My only complaint was that I booked an extra day and almost felt like I was in the blame. Cleaners walked in a day early because apparently the husband and wife never communicated. Wife apologized, but spoke to me on the phone like it was my fault. I was in the shower when this happened, no clothes, and super embarrassing. No proper apology, nothing. They somewhat apologized, but after giving me a whole rundown of what happened, making it sound like I need to leave.
Overall, I would book this stay again if communication was more proper.
Ideal location for a comfortable long weekend visiting our son at UChicago. Very clean, comfortable beds, and very functional kitchen!

George’s place was perfect for being centrally located. It was about a 10 minute walk to the Magnificent Mile and a 10 minute walk to the river. It was city living at its best with places to eat close by. His place was quiet and felt like home. It had everything you would need in a home.  The kitchen was well equipped and the bathrooms and bedrooms were amazing. Overall, it was a great place to stay- especially with the free on site parking!
Loved our stay at Cindy and Mike’s.  Great location, great hosts,  and great apartment in a quiet neighborhood close to all that Chicago has to offer.  We would definitely choose to stay again!

The apartment was clean and comfortable, in a recently renovated building. It was well located, near many restaurants and a nice Whole Foods. It was walking distance to the beach and commutable by car or public transportation to other areas. I had a very relaxing, enjoyable stay and would be glad to stay there again.

Ha sido una estancia muy agradable, el aparatamento estaba muy bien ubicado y limpio. El único inconveniente fue la alarma de incendios que se activó un día y era imposible describía apagar. Por lo demás genial

Loved Tim's place! He was able to accommodate our early check-in. Had everything we needed for a very comfortable 1 week stay, including quarters for the laundry!! Location couldn't be better. Walks into Andersonville were so easy. Great local eateries, shops, and a market. Transportation into downtown Chicago (and to Wrigleyville for a Cubs game) so easy and running often - we took buses.
Tim responded almost immediately every time we reached out! Thank you for a great stay in our favorite area!
Was a nice place and good location. Communication was great.
I had a great stay. It was a very cozy place walkable to restaurants. Definitely will stay there again

Amazing, safe and beautiful location.
Perfect if your going to United Center. Easy access to main attractions.
Loved the host. I would love to book in the future

We stayed at Brian and Amy’s place over spring break with our two teenage boys and it was perfect. The location in Wicker Park is fantastic, there was plenty of space for all four of us, and everything was spotless. Brian and Amy were also really flexible with our check-in and check-out times, which made the whole trip so much easier. Highly recommend!

Gokce's place was great. Looked just like the photos and was clean. Super close to the United Center and was the reason I booked but was more enjoyable with the convenience of a grocery store less than 10 minutes walk and super safe to catch a ride share or a bus into the city. I would love to stay again.

Third time here at Joanna's. There's a reason we keep coming back. All is clean and beautiful, ready for us, comfy beds, very easygoing. She checks in on our stay every time. Plan on being back to Chicago, and hopefully Joanna's, in September.
Good place to stay
A lovely place , beautiful backyard!
Great place to stay, family friendly and close to United Center.  Secured onsite parking.
O local é tranquilo, fácil de estacionar, perto do centro de Chicago, fácil acesso e a casa muito confortável!

We had a wonderful stay! The location was perfect and the home was very comfortable for our family. A huge thank you to Freddy for being so accommodating and for the quick responses. We truly enjoyed our time here!
Wonderful stay!!

We loved our stay!! Beautiful space, perfect for 2! The area is lovely, and has lots to offer for entertainment, food and public transit.  Amanda was absolutely amazing!  Warm welcome and made us feel at home.  We would definitely stay here again!
I loved the decor!
Everything was exactly like he described I even cooked there and everything !  It was easy to clean  everything I’ll def be staying there again !
Beautiful place with very responsive host.
Great location for what we needed.
Great apartment in a great neighborhood. Walkable with lots of great restaurants. Also easy to get to the train to visit all the popular tourists sites.
Nicholas is a wonderful host -- I highly recommend his place!

Stephanie was a great host and always responsive. Unfortunately my stay was cut a little short, but certainly enjoyed when I was there. Location is right in the loop so you can hop on the train and get anywhere in Chicago easily. I had no issues with laundry or any appliances in the kitchen. Amenities in the building were great, especially the gym and lounge. Great for someone who will be out and about in the city all day and wants a comfortable place to relax after.
