The house is incredibly clean, beds are comfortable, and everyone had room to spread out. Communication was also excellent, and everything was very clear and they always responded quickly if we had any question. As I mentioned to them, we wished there was more seating for dining and hanging out because we had a large group there, but the trade off is lots of space to move around.

WARNING: Do not stay here. Host does nothing to keep the place liveable. No TV. When I reported it, here is their response "About the TV, seems the Roku got disconnected? 🫣😭"
There was no Wifi. They had me try several networks and none worked. The following day I was able get Internet from another unit's network.
Multiple light bulbs where out.
BUT the worst part was the furnance which is so loud that it vibrates the floor when it fully kick on. Super loud. I had to turn it off and use a space heater which "conviently" was in the closet. I think other guests have complained and that is their fix.
Also all furniture is old and broken. The bed is a cot! I could go on and on.
Place is exactly as described. Host was responsive and place was clean would book again.
Great stay! We appreciated the comfort space and clear instructions. Would stay again!
Slavyana's place was wonderful and location good not be better.  We will definitely be staying here again when our travels take us back to Chicago!
Very close to Humboldt Parkand lots of restaurants.

We had an amazing relaxing time at the WABASH ESTATES! We spent five days in Chicago celebrating my sister’s engagement, and my cousins 35th birthday. The WABASH ESTATE is located in a peaceful up and coming neighborhood with great location to commute in the city. The home is like an art museum, we really enjoyed the home. The plus was the bidet, so I felt right at home. George is a great host!
Cool place. Nice neighborhood ☺️

This apartment tucked in the Southport/Wrigleyville neighborhoods of Chicago was perfect for our needs. Two perfectly sized bedrooms for my wife and I + daughter. Large living room to lounge in with coffee in the morning or after a long day. Kitchen - spotless, plenty of mugs, glassware, cutlery, and coffee (thank you!). Everything was very clean, from the floors and countertops to the bedding and towels. Great location - walking distance to nice shopping in Southport, plenty of restaurants both west and east. Southport Brown Line is a block away. Visited Wrigley (Cubs were away) - 10 minute walk. 25 minutes (no traffic!) from O'Hare. It's really in a terrific spot.
Honestly, we had zero issues whatsoever with Thomas's home - grateful for the opportunity to stay there!
Felt like home, had everything we needed and never had to reach out.

Great stay for an affordable price. Instead of keys you are given passcodes for each door as you access the building. My only hiccup was a glitch in the passcodes I was given to enter the building on my first night. I was stuck outside in the cold but I eventually got in thanks to other guests in the apartment I was staying in. The owners rectified the problem as quickly as they could and gave me new door codes.

Great location, quiet building, very responsive host (I had several questions/access needs I asked about beforehand and he was super responsive and respectful). My only issue was he only has one set of keys for guests, which was a little awkward if our schedules didn’t align. Otherwise, very easy, convenient, close to lakeshore park and public transportation.
Great place, location was convenient and made getting around easy. Host was responsive and helpful!
Nice comfy space. Highly recommend
Our stay was amazing the home was amazing! Great neighborhood. would totally stay again!
The apartment is great on our Bella is a great host and very responsive this will be a staying or totally enjoy!
Coty was a great host. The location is in a great spot. Close to everything. House was clean. Whenever I had a question, Coty was quick to respond.

was an okay stay overall. It was a short visit, but I do wish the heating system was better. The room felt quite cold, and there wasn’t a wall thermostat to adjust the temperature, which made it a bit uncomfortable, but cute place.
Orit was very good in communicating with us and throughout the weekend. The house was large enough to accommodate our group so that everyone have enough space to relax
Lovely one bed in a good area.

We thoroughly enjoyed staying at Natalie's condo.  The decor was absolutely beautiful.  I felt like I was staying in a space fully designed by and outfitted by Restoration Hardware.  I loved all the organisers in the kitchen, the simple, yet effective space, the lighting was spectacular.  The bedrooms and bathrooms were also absolutely beautiful as was the patio space with the cafe lights.  The location of the condo was perfect, with easy and quick access to everywhere we went, from Navy Pier, to Michigan Ave, to church on Easter Sunday and all the fabulous restaurants in the area too.  We will definitely consider staying here again in the future!  Thanks to Natalie for her very efficient communication as well!!! Everything was 5 Star!!

Casa Newport was perfect! It’s a great location, parking with the construction going on was a bit more difficult but not hosts fault in any way. Lovely home, great location very comfortable. We will stay again
Stay was good, place was easy to find and clean.

Our stay was just okay. When we arrived the temperature was well over 80 degrees and there was no way to control the heat. We had to open the windows. There was a lot of noise and light coming in from the nursing facility next door. The bed was extremely uncomfortable because it sags in the middle even with little to no weight on it. There was a lot of duct tape covering holes and holding things in place.

Rida é uma ótima anfitriã e foi muito atenciosa e prestativa naquilo que precisei.  Obrigada por tudo Rida !!!!!O espaço acomoda muito bem ate 6 pessoas. Sao 4 quartos com 4 camas de casal,  muito bem montados, confortáveis  e limpos porem,  como só existe um banheiro pequeno, a cozinha só tem 4 cadeiras para receiçoes e sala de estar é pequena com apenas um sofa, o apartamento  será muito mais confortável com ate 6 adultos.
Very pleasant B&B stay!
Great place only bad is all twin size beds

This condo fit our needs and the host was responsive when communicating. They could use more kitchen stuff to make meals and the grill was in poor condition. The extra kitchen also has nothing at all in it. The home seemed very corporate which we are not used too.
The host also said they were a family owned company but the person I spoke with a couple times had never been to the condo.
I felt nickel and dimed. Everything was an upcharge. Having my son in law come at the last min was an extra $10 a night. I was told he wouldnt be able to come into the building unless i paid which would not have been true. No one is there to check that.
We asked to leave our luggage there and go while they cleaned and while we walked. We couldnt do that so we spent another $60 to find somewhere to store it. I had to pay $100 to get in earlier. It just came off really greedy which was a huge turn off.
Very comfortable and convenient studio close to Loyola campus. Perfect for visiting your Rambler or enjoying the Rogers Park area. Clean and tidy - easy in & out!
Lovely place, good location, would happily stay there again.
Very good location, convenient, enjoyed the view and train station next to it

Excelente experiencia. El apartamento estaba muy bien atendido, limpio y cómodo. Ideal para una estadía en familia por Chicago. Todo lo necesario a la mano y muy buena ubicación. Sin duda lo recomendamos. ¡Gracias por la hospitalidad!
This Air bnb was a good one o definitely would stay here again, place was clean & easy to access. Only downside was the upstairs neighbors were so loud all day and night.

Indira’s place is perfect for anyone (group of friends or family) looking to explore Chicago’s Wicker Park and Bucktown neighborhoods. It is close to restaurants, walkable and with access to the metro.
We had a wonderful stay. The host was responsive and extremely helpful.
We will definitely return when we next visit Chicago.
Thank you very much for your hospitality and amazing apartment

We had a lovely stay at Kate’s. She accommodated our need to check in early. The studio is private and very quiet. It was impeccably clean, the bathroom modern, the bed very comfortable with plenty of pillows and lovely comforter. She supplies plenty of extra towels, amenities and bottled water. As a black tea drinker I especially appreciated the true English black tea bags. The neighborhood is filled with shops and cafes, plenty of options for any meal. The downtown sites are easy to get to on the red line or also by Uber or taxi. We highly recommend and look forward to staying at Kate’s in the future.

The host was super responsive and helpful. The location was great and convenient! Everything was how they looked in the photos and everything was walking distance from the location. Would definitely stay here again.

We visited Chicago for an event and this place was perfect for us family of 4 to stay with a toddler. Key highlights of this place : commute to airport less than 40 minutes; 10 minutes via Uber to downtown restaurants and event centers; and safe place to walk around and exercise. Value for money for sure.

What a fun stay. The location is great, close to parks, lots of restaurants and entertainment. Lovely, quiet neighborhood. Parking was easy with a pass which Kerilyn provided during our stay. It was a comfortable place to hang out when we not out and about. Thank you!
It was the perfect spot for the amount of people we had would definitely come back!

Amit is an exceptional host! We loved staying at this property!  It was perfect for our family. We would absolutely stay here again. The kitchen is stocked well for anyone who wants to cook their meals. The beds are very comfortable.  This property is EXACTLY as described in the listing if not better. Parking and outside living space are a plus. Felt like a home away from our home. Exactly what we were looking for. 🤗
Adrian’s place was great for our family holiday. The location is awesome and the accommodations a were spacious, updated and clean.
I was lucky to get a flexible check-in. other locations would say 5:00 p.m. check-in. I really dislike that. thank you Dominique. the place is as described I didn't have any issues. Bless you.
Would recommend bringing everything of your own since the place didn’t have towels and etc. otherwise very convenient spot
This is our third time staying with Nicole and Matt as hosts and we’ll be back again!
Amazing apartment and amazing location. Josh was so helpful from the first day I booked this til I checked out. Thank you for your hospitality. Really enjoyed our visit.
The place was conveniently located and clean.

This was the first time renting this property, and I doubt it will be the last!  Alma was a great host, she was very responsive and the place was immaculate on arrival.  There is a great food and coffee scene in the area along with plenty to do within walking distance
Great location and very relaxing. Thank you for having us.

We had such an amazing stay here! The place was exactly as described—clean, beautifully maintained, and very comfortable. The location was perfect for exploring Chicago, with easy access to great restaurants, shops, and attractions.
The host was incredibly responsive and made sure we had everything we needed, which made the entire experience smooth and stress-free. We especially appreciated the thoughtful touches throughout the home that made it feel cozy and welcoming.
I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

Demitri was incredibly communicative and helpful. As a previous Chicagoan the area is perfect for getting the neighborhood vibes and central for transportation. The building heat was still on for our stay since it was fairly cool and if you’re use to city living (like we are) then the noises of the city and radiator heat won’t bother you. The accommodations were comfortable and just what we needed to explore the city. Would absolutely stay again!
Very pleasant stay!

Spacious Airbnb. Stayes here for an event at the Epiphany Center. This is an excellent location for events there.
Amentities inside this unit met and exceeded what was in the photos. Parking in the rear alley was easy to find and use.
The inside of this unit is huge. Super high ceilings.

Our family of three had a great stay at Heather's place. We got that neighborhood experience, away from tourist hotspots, and got a sense of the west town community. The apartment itself has lots of spaces so we could work, relax, and come together. With better weather, we would have certainly enjoyed the garden too!
Me and my wife loved the place! It’s a 10 minute drive from tons of stuff to do and the room was clean and comfortable.

Clean, comfortable, easy access to Andersonville (10 minute walk) with its wonderful restaurants and shops and Broadway (2 minute walk). All kinds of public transit nearby. Has all of the amenities to feel like home. Quiet place for a noisy street. Dorothy friendly and helpful.

Mike and Juliette's place is exceptional.  We've visited Chicago a lot over the years and it's the best place we've stayed.  They've given a lot of thought to what is important to visitors and have ticked all the boxes.  Sunny and comfortable living room.  Comfy beds.  Spotless bathrooms.  Well-stocked kitchen.  Plus, it's in a great neighborhood with great restaurants for breakfast, lunch, and dinner in easy walking distance.  Lincoln Square is less than a mile away, Andersonville less than a mile and a half.  Ready access to trains to get you anywhere else in the city you want to go.  Mike and Juliette are very proactive and responsive.  We'll be back.

Overall our stay was good. We had some issues with the listing not being completely accurate, to no fault of Julian the host, but Julian was very helpful and accommodating. He was very responsive and helped us through the issue. He really went above and beyond as a host. I would definitely recommend staying at his place and would stay again once the listing gets fixed. It has a very cozy vibe and the neighborhood is great, didn't have any issues when it came to that.
Super cute place in a great neighborhood walkable to shops and places that were fun.
The location was perfect for us!!! Walkable to many neighborhood restaurants and stores.

Leigh-Anne’s place is beautiful and accommodated me well on my trip to Chicago.  The neighborhood is nice and walkable.  I walked to an Italian restaurant nearby that she recommended.  It was absolutely delicious.  It also felt extremely safe walking solo over to the Pink Line to get around the city.  The furniture was comfortable and it was nice to have everything I needed to make my coffee each morning.  Would definitely recommend staying here.
Es una excelente ubicación muy cerca de la estación de tren, se siente muy seguro, quedarte es toda una experiencia, es una casa muy original, Joshua fue muy amable y comunicativo.

The sofa overlooking the lake was the most popular spot for the kids! Great location, very safe, quiet, and just a few blocks away from Michigan Avenue, plus a convenience store 30 seconds away. Couldn't be happier, will stay here again.

This home is truly one of a kind, as are Marty & Rob. If you are looking for friendly & helpful hosts who know the area you cannot go wrong with booking the loft. It’s a unique space filled with incredible art, but also all the comforts of home. 10/10 would recommend for anyone looking for a stay in Andersonville.

Raphael was a friendly and responsive host. We loved that there was plenty of room for our group and the 2 living areas were great! The blue line train and shopping area was walkable. We would definitely stay here again

Had a great stay at this immaculately clean apartment in the heart of Lincoln Square, one of Chicago’s coolest neighborhoods. Everything was as described and had everything we needed. Parking was always available right out front which was a huge plus. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!
Everything that we needed for our stay. Neighborhood was quiet and we felt very safe. Close to downtown!
location was okay, 10-15 minute drive  to the city but parking was lacking. would have been better if there was dedicating parking. room felt like a college dorm room.
There was no heat and had to find other accommodations. Host tried to accuse us of damage that was there when we arrived after we requested a refund.
We had a wonderful stay! The host was incredibly responsive, even at late hours, and very accommodating. The property was beautiful, private, and in an amazing location.
The location is fine .. bed was fine ,
Charming apartment, convenient location, host was great, let us check in early and was very helpful and responsive. We even got free parking right out front. Would stay there again and recommend!

If you are looking for a place to stay while visiting friends or family in the Wicker Park area or just visiting Chicago, this is the place for you.  It was very accessible, close to public transportation and lots of dining options.  The space was just as described and Yolie was the perfect host.  Yes, the train runs behind the apartment but we had not trouble with noise (even in the back bedroom).  We will definitely be staying there again for our next stay in Chicago.
Such a great cozy place, walkable distance to a dollar tree, grocery store, and McDonald’s. Comfortable for up to 5. Super close to main attractions. Me and my friends enjoyed our stay!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb. The space was very clean and well-maintained, which made it feel comfortable right away. It was also very affordable compared to other options in the area, making it a great value. The location was super convenient, with easy access to everything I needed during my stay. Overall, I would definitely recommend this place and would stay here again.

My friends and I had the best time at the Airbnb and our hosts Margaret and Nico were very flexible, accommodating, and friendly when communicating any needs or questions. The place itself was clean and comfortable and in a great location with many nearby stores and walkable streets! We would definitely recommend this place and would love to stay again in the future :)
Very happy with our stay. Great location close restaurants, attractions and public transit.
Had a great time here! We love the area and the apartment was a great landing pad.

This unit was one of the better Airbnb experiences I’ve been to. Located a 5 minute walk to the CTA and Metra trains, this is perfect for those who are taking public transit around Chicago. While it does take a bit of time to get to the loop, you are only a few stops away from other hip neighborhoods (Logan Park, Wicker Park, etc)
Jefferson Park itself is quiet and safe, with all the amenities you could need within walking distance.
I’d definitely recommend Robert’s unit for travelers
Amazing place. Great location. The space was very clean. We really enjoyed our stay.

Enjoyed our stay at Maggie’s place! Very clean, easy to get in, and plenty of space for a larger group to stay. She was also very accommodating with a few personal requests which was much appreciated!
Super clean, lovely place, great neighborhood!  Hosts were very quick to respond to any questions I had.  We'd definitely stay again!
Owner was very responsive.  I left my ebook and he mailed it to me quickly and without charge.
Bev was delightful.  Would definitely visit again!
great people, great place. loved the larger kitchen counter, we fit all 9 of us in our group around so we could be together. we loved it!

Excelente localidad.
Celia y Carlos siempre me ayudaron en lo necesario y siempre pendientes a ayudar. Excelente ubicación y todo el equipo bien atento.

The location was great and having a garage available was also nice when you have kids. We enjoyed our stay as we travelled with another family. The only thing that had us a little disappointed was two of the beds were sinking in the middle one being a king bed and the other a queen bed. Felt like some support was missing. Other than that, we had a good time and this space is great for big groups and families.
Great stay! Perfect location.

Came to town for a VB tournament at McCormick with three teenagers. We usually stay @ the Marriott Marquis, but it was booked. We all love eating in Chinatown, so decided to give an Air BNB a shot!
The location was good, as described in the heart of Chinatown. It is basic no-frills, and accommodated our short term family needs nicely. Two bathrooms and three bedrooms were nice to have in the mornings
The condo is on the third floor up a set of metal stairs. This was fine for us, but would not be ideal for anyone with disability.
The water dispenser in the refrigerator filter caused it to flood, the owner was responsive and brought us a case of water to drink, which we appreciated.
Cons- the pillows (two per bed) were uncomfortable for our taste. We should have brought our own. But the beds were comfy.
Kitchen only had a few “glasses” which were mugs, and then coffee mugs. Drinking glasses or even basic stemless wine glasses would be nice. Serving bowls would also have be helpful.
Spacious and comfortable for 3-4 people. 5 minute drive to UChicago.
We enjoyed our stay at this two bedroom apartment. It was easy to find and enter. Also, very clean and Danny was very responsive to our needs.
Great apartment in Chicago! Clean, cozy, and has everything you need. Convenient location and a friendly host. Highly recommend!

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The space was exactly as described—clean, stylish, and very comfortable. Everything was well thought out, from the amenities to the overall layout, which made it feel like a home away from home. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay, making check-in and communication seamless. We especially appreciated the little details that made the experience even better. The location was also a big plus—convenient and close to everything we needed, while still being peaceful and relaxing. Overall, we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay!

The Sono was absolutely perfect for my husband and me. Our son lives in Old Town and there are not many hotel options close by. This gave us exactly what we needed. Everything was updated and very clean. The complimentary breakfast and all-day snacks were great. Parking was a huge bonus. Easy and safe walk to our son's apartment just two blocks away. Check-in and check-out were a breeze and the staff were very friendly. The outdoor spaces looked so nice - although the weather did not cooperate. Hopefully we can enjoy them next time.
Great location. Owner was very helpful and included detailed instructions.  We would like to stay here in future visits to Chicago

Thank you the house had plenty of room . They had complementary tea , coffee and the milk , and sugar . They also had shampoo in the shower . The beds were comfortable. They had plenty of towels . They had a large tv in the living room which included tv apps .

Place was as expected and the street noise was minimal with the window unit fans on. Overall very serviceable. Unfortunately just not worth the price paid, especially in the slower tourist season I visited in. After huge additional fees for late [self] check in, this was about the price of a hotel with much less charm.

Super responsive and best location and view! Three generations and we all loved our first visit to Chicago.  Walkable to Magnificent Mile and all the shopping, restaurants, riverfront and Navy Pier.  Can’t wait to return this summer and hopefully this wonderful Airbnb is available!
Nice, clean place, and in a good area to enjoy all of chicago.

Stephanie’s place is in an amazing location, very close to the Loop station. It was incredibly convenient for our family with kids, especially having UberEats drop-offs right at the door. The apartment is well-equipped with everything we needed, and there were plenty of spare towels and blankets. The only downsides were that the elevator was out of order during our stay and the noise from the nearby Loop, but these didn't stop us from recommending this place!

We loved our stay in Wicker Park! The apartment was perfect for the size of our group. Each couple got their own full, private bathroom- a rare find! The beds were actually comfortable and everything was spotless. The neighborhood is walkable and close to the train stop, many bars and restaurants. Conor is an excellent host. Thanks for having us, we'd love to come back!

First I would like to say this place was nice in the inside, However the white walls are filthy all over the house. The tub was NOT clean had blue soap dripping inside. The lock to the gate to let you on the property is NOT working properly. Host requested numerous of videos stating it was working earlier however the guest under us stated they also been having problems. We also got locked out of the property for an  hour and half at 1230am in the morning. We had to go around to the BACK  to enter the property at 1 almost 2am AFTER the code was changed for us to enter. Host again continue to request videos as if we were impaired. Communication I would give 3/10. Yes they will communicate with you however it’s DIFFICULT because it’s only through text and no one near to help. There is no private parking, you parking on the street. Someone windows were  busted out near our parking.

Dos excelentes personas, súper anfitriones, nos hicieron sentir como en casa, una casa hermosa, el cuarto muy cómodo, limpio, ordenado, excelente ubicación, fácil acceso al transporte público, sector tranquilo y seguro

We had four adults and three children and the place was perfect for our family of four adults and three children. We were visiting family members who live in the neighborhood and it was within walking distance of their home. The communication was clear and appropriate. The hosts were very accommodating.

We really appreciate the quiet and convenient location. While we seldom use our car during a stay, as most places we frequent are a brief walk, it’s nice to have the car nearby.  We will certainly stay here again.

This place was great for my family. It was super clean and comfortable. Even being a basement level apartment it was quiet, we heard no noises, and my 16 month old was able to sleep soundly in the conveniently provided pack and play. The provided off street parking space was a helpful addition. Location wise great, we didn’t use the public transit because of the extra baby stuff we had to carry on our trips into the city but we would have if it would have been the two of us. Either way it was only about a 20 minute drive into the downtown area. Would definitely stay there again!

Overall, we had a great stay here.
The host was the most responsive I've ever stayed with. Quick to reply, quick to come fix a minor problem, and they even personally arranged for an early bag drop. Incredible.
Location was great! You see Wrigley Field the field out the front door! It is easily walkable to North Halstead and the L public transit.
The place was clean and cozy. The beds were comfy, the towels were new and soft, there was a nice TV, and more. The kitchen had a few things in the freezer and fridge by the owners but was mostly empty. This place ACTUALLY has beds for 8... and I've stayed at many places where the sleeping counted a couch or pullout.
If the place has any cons... first there is only one bathroom, which for 8 is rough. Second, the L runs behind it. As a non-Chicagoan, I didn't know how loud the L is. It didn't bother some of us, but did others. Plan for light sleepers to be in the front (bunk bed) room. Overnight it only runs every 4 times per hour.
This spot is awesome! Close to many stores and whole foods.  Close to the ‘L’ red line as well.  The place was spotless and clean.  Love being on the 9th floor and having views.
Great place for a weekend stay. Clean and quiet, but close to all the shops and restaurants in Andersonville.

Great stay and wonderful host. He contacted me about an important item I left outside while bringing our bags in,
and was responsive and flexible about getting it to me the next day. The apartment was clean and comfortable and a perfect location for our Chicago visit. Would definitely stay here again!
The place was nice and clean

нам все понравилось
Nicola’s place was amazing. It was clean, comfortable, and felt just like home. She was super responsive and polite. I would love to stay here again.

Oscar was an amazing host and made our stay so comfortable from the very beginning. He was extremely kind, friendly, and welcoming. On the first night of our arrival, he even saved us a parking spot late at night, which was such a thoughtful gesture and really helped us a lot.
The Airbnb was pet-friendly, which was a huge plus for us. The place felt very safe and secure since it is in a gated house, and that gave us a lot of peace of mind during our stay. The home was also well-prepared for guests, with clean utensils, thoughtful amenities, and even fruits and meat in the fridge, which made the stay feel extra warm and generous.
The location was also very convenient , 20 to 30 minutes from Chicago city by car or bus, so it was easy to get around while still staying in a quieter and safer area.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience and truly appreciated their hospitality. He went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable. 10/10 recommended, I would definitely stay again!!

Truly enjoyed staying here, and will absolutely look to stay here again if it is available when we go back to Chicago! Loved how cozy it was, warm and inviting somehow feel like they fail to accurately describe the house, but it felt like being hugged as soon as we walked in. Very clean, and well laid out - it truly had everything we needed during our stay!
Nice, cozy place. Not far from the city.
Had a great stay! super welcoming people
Had a good stay, very convenient if the need is to go to McCormick Place.
Enjoyed my stay here. Very clean and is as depicted. Will book again in the future
Great host and nice clean apartment in the heart of China town
Home was beautiful, and in a great location.  Stephanie always responded promptly to our communications and was very reasonable to interact with.  Would stay again without a second thought.
Very conveniently located, kind & responsive hostess, easy to access surrounding area, very clean, comfortable beds and everything you need for a great visit to the Chicago area!

Our stay was amazing! The space couldn’t have been better. It was in the perfect location for visiting this neighborhood. The unit was spacious and incredibly comfortable. Plenty of surfaces and outlets, which was an unexpected bonus. The host was wonderful…helpful and responsive.
Loved it very clean fit my family perfectly. Parking was terrible

Great location, walking distance to the train station, but the parking amenity also let us explore further out. Host went above and beyond, even delivering a pack and play for us the first night. Will stay again next time we're in town.

This was a wonderful place to stay. It matched the description perfectly and was in a great location; close to restaurants and not far from downtown. Nicole and Matt were wonderful hosts with quick responses and had their place meticulous. It was a great place for the four of us.

Yakini is THE MOST GRACIOUS and ATTENTIVE host I have ever encountered.  She surprised our grandsons with a hot cocoa setup at arrival and THEN brought up a treasure chest full of snacks later on  They were in absolute heaven! The layout was great for us with a family of 2 adults and 2 kids on the upper floor and grandparents on the middle floor. The cozy kitchen and large gathering area suited us well.
It was comfortable and clean.  It's a great location near Wrigley. Most important the was that the host was helpful when needed.
Great location and pool area and game room
Said it could accommodate 8 guests but the room itself was smaller than expected.
We had a great time at the apartment. The apartment was very clean, spacious, and conveniently located in the loop. It was the perfect spot for our quick Chicago getaway!

This stay was perfect for me and my group. Was able to accommodate me to check in a few hours early also was very quick to respond. Place was squeaky clean and exactly like the photos. It was more spacious than I expected! Felt private and walkable to Logan square. I only rate it 4 stars because parking was terrible. It is street parking and by night we had to park down the street or a few blocks down that was inconvenient. Easy to check in too! Highly recommend.

We have stayed at Cynthia’s place a couple times now. She goes over the top to make us feel welcome, with pastries and fresh flowers.  It’s a nice quiet place in a very safe neighborhood, with close walking proximity to good restaurants, bars and coffee shops.  Always feel like we’re part of the neighborhood.
The space was exactly as described. The studio was neat and well appointed. The hosts were both welcoming and informative. And the urban farmette was fantastic. Bring apples!
Air bnb host was very responsive! Hair dryer was missing and one delivered really quickly next day. Amazing location!
Great Place for Stay, I enjoyed every bit of my stay and the Host was very responsive
Just as pictured and described. The place was clean and quiet. Free parking was nearby and safe. Aldi and Target just around the corner was a nice bonus too.

Such a wonderful home and matched the pictures exactly! Carolyn was very responsive, welcoming, and kind! You can tell she put lots of care into the home. Will definitely stay again when visiting Chicago!
Thank you for a wonderful place to call home during a very busy trip to Chicago! Excellent central location, safe, and clean, with a parking garage right around the corner!
Great location and wonderful space. It is located in a student housing building - which was fine, just surprising to us. There are fees for early check-in or late check-out, so plan accordingly.
Troy was very attentive and responded in timely fashion And the place felt just like home

Kelly was a great host! She is very responsive and made sure our stay was perfect. She has tons of recommendations for things to do and place to eat and entry/exit instructions are very easy and clear. The place is in a perfect location: quiet yet close to everything. Plenty of space, comfortable beds, and large kitchen, it was exactly what we needed! Would definitely stay here again
Everything was perfect, we felt like home and it’s been one of the best airbnb we’ve been.

A excellent value for the quality of the location.  Great and clear communication, beautiful space, and easy to access.  We were able to easily find great restaurants and the location was walkable to the Art Institute of Chicago.

Had a wonderful stay!  The common areas were great for group dinners and hang outs. The kitchen was well stocked with utensils and cooking supplies if we wanted to stay in and cook. Bright and sunny during the day, quiet neighborhood at night. Steve was very helpful and responsive to my questions when I had them. Lots of places to check out within walking distance. Would definitely recommend  👍

We really liked staying at Matthew's place. The location is really central and close to public transportation. The apartment has a lot of character, really spacious and had everything we needed for our stay in Chicago.

Can't say enough great things about this place - it's become my go to place when I stay in Chicago whether I'm there on business or pleasure.  Amy is truly a Super Host:  always responds quickly, the linens smell clean and fresh and she keeps the place immaculate (yes, even the bathroom!)  The neighborhood is very quiet and parking is never a big issue.  Also, Wrigley Field is within walking distance - Go Cubbies!

I had a great stay at this apartment! As someone from Chicago, I really appreciated how comfortable and well-located it was. I stayed here with my two kids while we were doing renovations in our home, and all of us absolutely loved the apartment.
The space was clean, well-maintained, and had everything we needed for a comfortable and relaxing stay. The location is fantastic—close to everything, yet still quiet and convenient, which was perfect for our family.
The host was responsive and easy to communicate with, which made the whole experience even smoother. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay!
Yay
Great location, only thing that could have been better was the parking and it didn’t have a microwave. Overall a good pick.
Adresa Stay’s was everything it stated to be. Great location for all my needs. The host was responsive and friendly.
Great place, exactly as described. The host was responsive and the area is well located.

The space has amazing views of the lake and the city w comfortable hang out space. They were a joy to communicate w and answered questions and needs immediately. This was a perfect place for our family to gather for a weekend.
Wonderful place.  Everything is thought of.  Great kitchen.  Comfortable beds.
Leszek was a great host. The apartment is cozy, well equipped and in a quiet/safe area close to public transportation. I would absolutely recommend staying here to anyone.

Im also a 60608 resident who needed a long term rental during home renovations, so I knew the best areas to stay. The apartment is very clean and bright, with plenty of linens/towels and well stocked kitchen for actual cooking. Communication with Freddy was super fast and friendly. Off street parking was so handy, even tho there’s a bus stop outside the door and a pink line station two blocks away.
It can be a busy corner on the weekends, especially in the summer, but that’s because Cermak is a fun street to be on. It’s nothing crazy, but traffic noise might be noted for a baby or super light sleeper. Otherwise if you’re looking for vibrant city culture this is it. Pilsen/Little Village is an amazing area, and the food can’t be beat anywhere. You can walk to parks, restaurants, coffee shops, museums and art galleries, and the local Cermak Market is the best in the city (adobo wings 99¢/lb).
Highly recommended 10/10 no notes
Airbnb was in a nice distance from everything. Host responds very fast and airbnb was very clean. I would book again.
Clean

The home itself is nice, clean and spacious.  Yet, the free parking was nice, but we had to park on the curb. So, it was inconvenient when it was raining and we had to walk a bit in the rain and cold because we parked two houses down. The broom that was left in order to clean was also a bit inconvenient because it was so small. It made my back hurt when I swept. There was one missing light bulb in the master bathroom. Other than that the home was amazing! Only had one tv but it worked out ok. The noise was mostly coming from upstairs and the music being played late at night was as well inconvenient but otherwise it was nice.
We loved staying here! Beautiful space; felt like home. Thank you so much for having us!
Great location and will stay here again when visiting family
Our stay was great. The location was perfect for walking to our daughter’s tournament with a small store and coffee near by.
Thanks
everything was perfect ! would definitely come back and stay! thank you!

Louis is AMAZING! Was able to pay for early check-in and late check out. A quiet nice neighborhood close to Chinatown. 10 min from downtown. Home was clean and check-in was seamless. I would def. Book again.

The property was in an amazing location, close to tons of shopping, restaurants and close to a train stop making it a super convenient stay! Had a great time, and space was more than big enough for a large group.

We're so glad we booked this location for our Wicker Park stay. The apartment was large and inviting, the two beds were comfortable, and the bathroom and kitchen were stocked with all the necessities. Dawn was very responsive and kind when we reached out with any questions.

The place is just as described— clean, convenient (bus stops nearby), shared bath and kitchen with everything you need. The mini fridge in the room with water bottles is a nice touch.
The reason I took a star away is because of the other travelers there. I had a nice, quiet stay until the last night. A couple next room had a bad argument the whole night, screaming, yelling, slamming doors, and throwing things. I couldn’t sleep. The host John responded quickly to the situation and the police came over eventually to resolve the issue. So it really depends on who you encounter during your stay.

Samuel's condo felt cozy and lived-in, with cats, two pianos, and a huge bookshelf. Samuel was friendly; I enjoyed discussing things to do in Chicago and what we were reading.
Outside, the neighborhood was quiet. Within easy walking distance, there was a bus stop (I had decided to rely on public transportation as much as possible for this trip), and I found a little Asian grocery store where I purchased two mangos for breakfast.
I had a great time and would highly recommend!

We stayed here for an event at McCormick Place.  It was a perfect location and very walkable.  Great host.  Responds almost immediately.  Checks in to make sure you have what you need. Very clean.   I would definitely stay here again.
Nejla and her partner were so welcoming and nice. The place is beautiful. Everything was comfortable. If I visit Chicago again, I’ll definitely will book this one. Thank you so much!
It’s was very clean! Easy and convenient for what we needed.
Caitlyn's place was clean, comfortable, and perfect for our weekend stay in Chicago. It's close to restaurants and public transit and was easy to get into the city.  Would definitely stay here again!
Daniel was very nice, he promptly responded when I reached out and communicated very well.
A good place for a get away in the city I would really recommend
Great location to mccormick place.  clean and well taken care of.

El apartamento está en una zona a 20 minutos del aeropuerto y 20 del centro de Chicago, lo que la hace muy cómoda. Es un vecindario familiar y tranquilo.
Está en perfecto estado y tiene todo lo necesario para pasar una estancia agradable.

Excellent spot I was able to spend for my 30th with a few buddies. Great big city feel location (if parking use SpotHero to find a deal nearby). Rooftop/common area and lobby common area were big perks! Host communicated quickly with each inquiry as well.
It was a nice room and close enough to downtown and very reasonable in price.
Had a great stay! Thank you!

We came with a group of 7 adults and we had plenty of space. I loved that they had a few sofa beds around the house that could also be turned into more beds. We loved the vintage theming and especially loved watching movies on vhs! The space itself is very clean and has so many amenities including toothbrushes, robes, slippers, and bottles of water in each room. It was also great that everything in the house had a label or instructions on how to use the devices in the house, or if anything would be an extra charge so you aren’t blindsided by extra costs. The beds were very comfortable with silk sheets, and the location was great! We did end up ubering everywhere because of how close we were to the city, but could’ve also taken the train with  a short drive over. The only thing that I would nitpick is that the shower drain in the upstairs bathroom was slow to drain, but other than that this was such a wonderful experience! Would recommend to anyone looking for a unique and clean stay!
responsive host, comfortable house, squeaky clean. 5 stars all the way!!
Awesome place and very convenient to local restaraunts, shops, and transportation. Great neighborhood! Would stay again!

Luis fue un excelente Anfitrión , en todo momento estuvo al pendiente y su trato fue muy amigable, demás se encuentra en una zona cercana al centro y con una estación del tren a dos calles; sin duda alguna elegiré el mismo lugar la próxima vez que vaya a Chicago.
100% recomendable!

We came to visit some friends around Logan square and this home was so cosy.
Really felt right at home and it felt clean.
Beds were a little soft, but that’s a personal preference. Would definitely return!

We absolutely loved staying at Kyriako’s Airbnb. We had no idea we were right next to a Michelin star restaurant either so that was an amazing surprise. The unit was secure and easy to find. Everything was clean and as pictured. Kyriako was responsive and attentive. 10/10 would stay here again.

We had a wonderful weekend in Chicago with our family and this was an ideal location for us. Everything about the apartment was as advertised and the beds were comfortable! What I really appreciated was the hosts responsiveness.  The parking access card was missing in the apartment and the hosts were quick to respond and provide a reasonable solution.

Helena is a great host and her Airbnb is in a great location. The neighborhood is safe. The home is clean, stocked, and comfortable. There is free parking,  laundry on site, and an easy walk or bus to the train. Helena is very kind and easy to get ahold of. I definitely recommend this Airbnb!

This is a fantastic place to stay in Lincoln Park, with easy access to DePaul and the red line, and close to some great restaurants. Hosts were responsive, friendly and flexible. And it's a really lovely cottage with a nice porch and tree outside, very quiet and well-appointed. Would definitely stay again!

Matt and Pam’s place exceeded every expectation we had, and then some. The property is incredibly well kept, thoughtfully maintained, and truly beautiful in person; the photos honestly don’t do it justice. From the moment we arrived, it was clear how much care and pride they put into creating a welcoming, comfortable space.
What really stood out, though, was how proactive and responsive Matt and Pam were throughout the entire process. We booked somewhat last minute, and they went out of their way to accommodate us without hesitation, making everything seamless and stress-free. Their communication was prompt, clear, and genuinely thoughtful.
They also provided fantastic recommendations for local restaurants and spots in the area, and every single one was a hit. It made our stay even more enjoyable knowing we had trusted suggestions from hosts who clearly know and care about their guests’ experience.
We would definitely stay here again!
Great

It was an fantastic experience, it’s a really nice option.
Relative close to the downtown area and the white Sox stadium.

Overall, a good Airbnb. Although the shower turned into cold water right after 1 person showered, and it wouldn't reheat for a while. A guy came by to check it out, but didn't do anything or help, but told us not to shower all at once.
Place as expected. Great price and location. Nice and responsive host
Felt like home away from home. The cleanliness of this home is what always brings me back every year!! Thanks for a wonderful experience!!

For the price, the place was great. When we first checked in, there was a very unpleasant smell that took a day to go away. We also found a cockroach in one of the bedrooms. The shower water was very cold and the bathroom sink did not drain properly. However, the owner was very responsive and was always polite. The place overall is very bright and modern and has great natural lighting and big mirrors. The location outside is a little cramped and noisy but it ended up being fine. Checkin and checkout were fairly easy

It was a great stay. Host was very helpful with everything. One thing to know is that one of the rooms is not fully a room, since the walls do not reach the ceiling. As well, I was required for both an early check in and a late check out, requesting on both cases 2 hours. I personally own an airbnb and, If i dont have guests, I dont charge either of those, so on that reason I leave a 4 star review. Everythign else was excelent. Bathrooms and showers were great

Staying here truly felt like staying at an upscale hotel. It was a rare moment where the space itself looked even better in person than the photos. The kitchen and bathroom are both gorgeous, and the rest of the apartment is well appointed with a nice sitting area and a separate sitting room with a great view of the backyard. Margret was great at communicating and left us to our own devices. There was a small plumbing issue that popped up, and she was great at communicating timelines and fixes. I have zero pieces of constructive feedback. We'd stay here again in a heartbeat.

Rob’s place was great, very tidy, clean and cozy. It had every amenity we needed and the fireplaces were a really nice touch. I highly recommend staying at Rob’s place. It was only about 15 min from downtown Chicago and the CTA blue line was very close. I had some last minute questions and Rob responded very quickly which I really appreciated.

Perfect spot for Easter weekend
Don't need a car - but if you have a car, easy to find street parking nearby. The hosts left us parking stickers for each day.
Clean, comfortable, room for 4 adults to spread out. Kitchen had everything we needed. Beds were nice and bedrooms were dark. Train is behind the building but we brought our Bose speaker and the brown noise completely neutralized the sound.
A gem in Lincoln Park!
The place is very clean, with comfortable beds, and very well appointed kitchen. Janelle was very prompt and helpful, responding immediately to any requests.
It was a nice place and I will rent again with him
Julie was a lovely host with a lovely home. It’s got everything you need for a great relaxing stay and nice close parking.
Responsive and nice host! Very clean and comfy room as well.
Perfect place for a wonderful stay. Prompt responses and tidy space! Thanks
Highly recommended for long-term stays.

Stephanie was a fantastic host! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in and communication were smooth the entire time, and she was very responsive and helpful whenever we had questions.

Location was perfect for our needs. Walkable, safe, fun, close to transit and grocery. Unfortunately there was visible mold and obvious water damage on several window sills including next to bunk bed. Glass exterior door to balcony didn’t lock or even latch. To be worth what we paid, would definitely need health & safety concerns addressed. I hate to leave a negative review for an Airbnb but after a private conversation, I don’t feel confident that they’d address these issues if not mentioned publicly, and as someone with asthma I would’ve appreciated reading a review like this so I could’ve made a different rental choice.

Matt’s place was in good proximity to public transport, there were plenty of bathroom towels, Matt was easy to communicate with and it was clean and parking was fairly easy.
We would not recommend this place however because the 4th bed was broken (hide-a-bed), the pots and pans need replaced (very scratched up non-stick surfaces) and showers back to back weren’t possible and limited to 5 minutes or less.
Good

Our stay was so lovely. Leelach’s home was in an excellent location to walk Andersonville, Clark street, and to the beech and Lakeshore Trail.
Her home was well-designed and thoughtfully stocked - it’s clear she puts great care into hosting and considering her guests’ experience.
She was very responsive and peaceful in her communication.
Will absolutely stay again.

We were visiting our daughter who lives locally in Bucktown so this accomodation was perfect for our family to be together as opposed to a hotel.  The apartment was very charming with lots of character.  Super clean bathroom and kitchen, amenities were modern and tasteful.  Steve was a good communicator and made sure we had everything that we needed. We did not have a car this trip but parking would not have been a problem on the neighborhood streets.  About a 10 minute walk to the nearest train station to head into the city or the airport.
Great stay, perfect location and the apartment was beautiful.

Stayed here for a week and loved it. The location is just steps away from the CTA Blue Line train, and there are also restaurants and a grocery store within walking distance. Alejandro's apartment was clean, spacious, and full of natural light during the day. Internet was very fast; perfect for remote work. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for somewhere cozy near the Loop whether it's just for a weekend or for a longer stay!
Amazing location right in Wicker Park and very convenient to use the blue line! Space was accurately represented in the listing, read other reviews to ensure it is a right fit for your needs!
nice place, with a nice view of the city at night.
Besides the public parking Everything was a 10/10. But being that close to downtown that was expected.

The apartment was spotless, looked just like the photos, and was very spacious. Stocked with plenty of coffee too so I could start my day right. Easy to get in, and very quiet as well. Excellent location, easy to get to transit, and lots of great places to eat. Oh and delicious coffee just a 3 minute walk away.
We really enjoyed this airbnb!

The sofa bed was surprisingly comfortable, and all of the beds were great. There were plenty of linens provided, which made our stay easy and convenient. We were in town for a volleyball tournament at McCormick Place, and the location was perfect — about 15 minutes door-to-door, even with pedestrian traffic.
There was more than enough space for our family of six. We had a small issue with the key code at check-in, but it was quickly resolved. Milan was not only responsive but proactive in checking on us and making sure everything was going well. Overall, a fantastic location and a wonderful stay.
Great spot

The apartment was well-laid out and had everything we needed for the two of us. Not being from a city, I forgot to check the location to the train. It is quite close and can be loud during the day. The frequency of trains is much less at night tho.
Great location, hosts are very responsive and flexible, place is easy to find and simple to check in which was very nice!
Recomiendo 100% este alojamiento, la habitación y el departamento estuvo muy limpio y muy bien ubicado, hay un metro cerca y un bus que te deja en la esquina y va desde downtown.

This place is so perfect! The area is amazing, so much nearby for convenience. Restaurants, coffee, grocery. The apartment is lovely, has everything you need and more. A very nice spot for couples or families. Highly recommend!
This was a very nice place, as described. I appreciate the responsiveness of the host for questions. I would certainly stay here again.

Overall really happy with the place. One of the best parts is how there’s basically nothing you have to do on checkout day - it’s was just taking the trash out and locking up.
The building is very obviously a bad flip and I think the entire building is AirBnbs, but I didn’t mind it. Things were clean and exactly like the photos. Some of its funny - the floor is super uneven, the kitchen counters weren’t level, and the coffee table was so slanted our plates would start sliding off randomly.
They did have all of the listed amenities except for pac n play sheets - they just put a flat sheet wrapped around the pac n play mattress which isn’t safe sleep for kids under 1, but I brought my own so it was fine. They accommodated two infants which I really appreciated. Some of the small details were missed, like ice or a shower mat, but all in all it was great Airbnb. Washer dryer and detergent pods provided, a real coffee pot, a smart TV, etc. were all a nice touch. Would definitely revisit
This place is the perfect location you are within minutes to great restaurants, fun bars and plenty of shopping.

Anthony was very friendly and responsive. The Airbnb was in a very nice quiet neighborhood and everything was clean and organized. The only thing that I took note of that I found odd was there was no hand soap only hand sanitizer. Other than that everything was perfect and I would recommend a stay at Anthony’s property.

The pros: it’s very quiet, Aitor is very responsive and the neighborhood is walkable and beautiful.
However I don’t think the photos or description of the place paint a totally accurate representation of the set-up. Just know that your bedroom will be sharing a wall with the other tenant’s bedroom, and you will both be sharing a very intimate living room/kitchen/bathroom. Sound carries very easily, so there’s not a ton of privacy.
Luckily, the other two guests I met during my stay were very cool and we became friends, so you may meet a new friend! Also Aitor is very responsive.
For the price, I do think it’s good value.
Place was great! I really enjoyed Ann’s Bakery in Ukranian village, we would wake up and go get a Ukranian feast!!
Denisha was very sweet and helpful. I love the area it was nice and cozy. Perfect for the weekend.

Joe was very accommodating. The Airbnb is very cute and cozy. Lots of great restaurants and shops within walking distance and conveniently located close to the subway lines. Very peaceful neighborhood. Would definitely stay here again!
It was a wonderful weekend stay, at a beautiful, upscale rental, with a perfect skyline view. Cloud 9 was very helpful and provided timely responses when needed.
Great place to stay - Milan was a great host.

Ola’s place was very nice and comfy and I felt like I was at home, the location offers a lot of different restaurants in the area as well. The room is in the basement so the noise upstairs can be disturbing at times but other than that the place was amazing and I would recommend or stay here again myself.
Overall great time!
Great place to stay while in Chicago. Host are wonderful ppl. If even in Chicago I’d would highly recommend!!
Great, large space and good location in walking distance to all amenities one would need. Place included little perks like oatmeal packets and Keurig cups

The space was good enough. It was nice to have parking, though it is tight, you definitely don't want to rent  a big car. The location was great. Just wish the space was a little warmer as far comfort goes.
Great stay for great price. Would recommend and try again in the future.
Nice place.
It was exactly what was expected, everything went to plan.
Great walkable location with parking. House was comfortable and as described. Justin provided quick and clear communication. Would definitely stay again.

It was a nice clean place and walkable to major attractions.  Minus the door to the patio not being able to lock it is a. Wet well maintained apartment.  Parking was convenient as well and the building is secure.
Great apartment in Andersonville -- will definitely return!  Parking was free public street parking, and we were able to find a spot within a block or two.

Nesha’s place is perfect..exactly as advertised & more. Host is so communicative, space is spotless, & environment is extremely welcoming. For this price & experience you can’t beat it! Would highly recommend to everyone. Absolutely no complaints this place & host exceeds every expectation. 10/10
I had an issue, and Rudia gladly helped me! He's a super host.

Barb's place is delightful. We chose her apartment because it's only a 10-minute walk from our daughter's apartment. It's also right down the street from many of our Andersonville favorites, including Lady Gregory's restaurant, Defloured Bakery and several clothing and gift shops. A Jewel-Osco and a Walgreens are also conveniently nearby.
Barb is very friendly. She lives on the second level of the home. She came right out when we arrived and introduced herself.
The apartment itself is very nice. It's tastefully decorated and comfortable. There are three bedrooms and one bath with a shower/tub combo. There is a full kitchen with a breakfast nook, plus a dining area and living room. We had plenty of room to spread out.
Our other daughter drove into Chicago to stay with us. She found street parking right in front of the house, while we parked in the dedicated space in the driveway.
We had a wonderful extended weekend visiting with our daughters, and we hope to return soon.

This is the first time I’ve ever given 3 stars. It does look like the pictures, however, what you can’t see is all that’s missing. No coffee supplies and a dirty coffee maker. No ice cubes or trays to make any. Dirty couch with missing cushion. Dirty white bedspread. No light bulbs above bathroom vanity or towel bar or hooks and one sink that wouldn’t drain.  No welcome binder with recommendations of places & restaurants.  These are basic staples at Airbnb’s. I’ve had 20 other Airbnb stays in past few years so I know what is expected.  I messaged about if coffee was normally included and received no reply.  On the positive side it is spacious, it was quiet and the mattresses were comfortable and host allowed a one hour early check in.  It was walkable to our daughter’s new apartment which is why we were there to help her with move in. It was just okay not a place I’d repeat or recommend. It just didn’t feel warm & welcoming.

This was literally the perfect place for my friends and I to stay during race weekend! Super close to the lake, cozy set up inside with a very homey feel, and very responsive host. We had an amazing time and Mark provided great flexibility and insight to help our stay.
Unlike many places that are much smaller than pictures make it seem, this apartment was bigger and fit us all comfortably for a few days.
Only note is that there are quite a few stairs which was hard on our knees after running 😂 Otherwise a wonderful place for the able bodied!
Everything was as described, our host provided easy to access extra linens, well-stocked kitchen and bathroom, and gave us plenty of clear instructions.

Betsy’s home was a perfect place to rest on a quick weekend trip to Chicago. It’s a bit further from downtown and requires a 20 min car ride though the neighborhood of Andersonville itself was highly walkable and had plenty to do, see, shop, and eat.

Wonderful condo. We’ve stayed in this neighborhood several times and this is one of the better condos we’ve booked. The condo was very clean. The kitchen is updated and has plenty of dishes and cookware. The bathroom has a great shower. The neighborhood is wonderful. The deli on the corner is great for a coffee and a sandwich and River Shannon’s is a great spot for a beer. We love the restaurants that are within walking distance in every direction. The host communicated quickly and answered all of my questions.
Our stay was fantastic!
Do recommend great place to stay
The place was bigger than expected!  Great location and Alexandra was super responsive

For the price, I hope they relocate the lock boxes from outside where you're exposed to improve that experience. Fantastic rooms. Fast communication. A few items were left over from previous tenants. Shower dripped when off. Amazing kitchen, utensils, cleaning, and kitchen needs were perfect. Location of the stay was almost perfect. It's 4 miles directly from the city. It's a bit far from safe public transportation. Personal vehicle preferred. Fantastic stay. I would recommend to people who can afford it. I wish the price was a bit more affordable. We loved all the accomodations made for us. It was a wonderful 4 day stay.

We had a great stay and the unit was very clean and matched the description well. Only reasons to deduct a star were that the beds are not comfortable, there were lots of mechanical noises like you could hear the HVAC system running loudly and water dripping in the pipes, and since there is also a unit upstairs and the ceiling is not insulated very well so you can hear every step the people upstairs are taking which wouldn’t normally wouldn’t be a problem except it was heard mostly in the middle of the night or super early in the morning which made sleeping soundly a little difficult.

Apartment was incredibly well maintained. Very clean and easy to settle into.
Host was proactive in their communication and also very responsive. Incredibly kind and helpful. Hopeful to stay here again in the future.

Felt very safe. It was definitely a walkable neighborhood.
The unit does not have much natural light. We only had 1 key to get into the walkway which created some logistical difficulties.
Josh was a responsive and helpful host.
Great house and location!

Overall the spot was amazing. Great price. Great location. Quiet. And clean.
However, during my first night of my stay the water heater died. The host had amazing communication and replied within minutes.
The host then moved me to a new unit on the property. But unfortunately the hot water at this new unit also died shortly later.
It really was unfortunate this happened, but I can’t blame the host for this problem. This is more so on the apartment complex as a whole.
Despite this, their communication was next level and they tried their best with what they had to work with. To make up for the inconvenience, the host was incredibly flexible with my checkout time, which I really appreciated.
I would still recommend this spot if you are looking for an affordable and nice stay during your time in Chicago.
Beautiful space with a nice location.  Hosts were super responsive and helpful

My family and I went to Chicago for a funeral and needed a nice place to stay. The home was comfortable, clean, and spacious nestled in a quiet neighborhood.  Rashad was a great host and provided all the information we needed prior to arriving. I would recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again. Thank you for your assistance in providing a welcoming place to stay during our time of need.
Nice location.  Great place, just as described.  They were easy to get in touch with and good hosts.  Thanks!
Great location and was spacious enough for our group. Would stay here again!
Stay here

Very nice home, very hands on if we needed their assistance or help.! Really won me over when I left my daughter’s diaper bag outside and they were able to contact neighbors to put it by our door.! First time traveling with my children and they loved and felt like home during our stay!
I enjoyed this Airbnb and had amazing time celebrating my bachelorette!
Great host

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as advertised—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was very responsive and attentive throughout our visit, which made everything seamless. We would definitely recommend staying here and would happily return!

Had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Chicago! The place was spotless, beautifully decorated, and exactly as described. The location was perfect—close to great restaurants, attractions, and easy transportation. The host was incredibly responsive and made the entire experience smooth from check-in to check-out. Everything we needed was provided, and the space felt comfortable and welcoming. I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago!

Great for family traveling with baby! We came to Chicago for spring break - two parents, baby under one, and grandparent. This space is excellent for that kind of trip, and the fact that it comes with both a pack and play and a high chair makes it phenomenal for families coming to town. Location is great. Parking you just have to deal with (there's a paid lot less than a block away). Would stay again for sure.

James was extremely responsive and his guide book was very comprehensive.  The place was perfect for our family of 4 - providing private as well as communal spaces.  Lincoln Park has a lot to offer and the place is central to many restaurants and attractions.  I would recommend the location to anyone.
Made the stay simple and was responsive. Great hospitality.
Had a wonderful stay will definitely book again.
Love the hospitality and beautiful place to stay. Helen definitely a beautiful host and love her communication and professionalism. Thank you, sincerely 🙏🏽👏🏽
Definitely a great place to stay. Would recommend and will book regularly when In Chicago.

This is a very nice spot. Very spacious and comfortable. The apartment is very clean from floors to linens to kitchen and bathroom. The neighborhood was quiet, calm, and peaceful. There was no noise! It felt very safe for me and my family. Parking was easy with lots of street parking at all times of the day. Don’t hesitate to book!

Bradley accommodated an early check in which was very helpful. The location is great, super close to the L and multiple bus stops, parks, coffee shops nearby too. The space is cozy and small, we didn’t spend much time inside since we were exploring. In hindsight, the bathroom could be cleaned and maintained more frequently since it is shared. Besides that, a good deal for what we paid! Thank you for hosting us.

Wonderful stay. It's a neighborhood in transition in terms of developing business. There are some boarded up businesses. We felt very safe and it was a great home base location for a weekend filled with concerts with my nephew. 1 room with an en suite and another bedroom with a nearby bathroom, so you don't have to feel too close to a teenager 😄 Great sized kitchen and even a workout area with a punching bag. We opted for the off street parking and Rachel was available to make sure we parked perfectly.
Just watch the first step getting inside either the front or the back entry. It's just a small step down but it surprised us walking in full of backpacks and groceries the first time. Rachel is very responsive, kind and welcoming. We will be back!
location was great and host was very communicative! we also requested more blankets and were able to get them to us quickly. would definitely stay here again if i’m ever in chicago

The space is very quiet, safe, and more spacious than it looks in pictures. Great location. The bathroom is 80% remodeled and all floors are new. However, while the place was clean, it needs updating (old linens, upholstery) and creative storage solutions - maybe that’s the plan. I hope so bc it could be dreamy with TLC. There are helpful space heaters but no central heat. Owners were very responsive when the shower head popped off- replaced it within an hour of my telling them. They also did let me check in an hour early however it coincided with an hvac maintenance visit but that’s on me since I was early and they did communicate well.

I enjoyed my short stay at the loft. Close to downtown and highways. Easy to check in & get inside. Communication was very great with the host. Only thing i would like to point out is people would wait outside to see if they could get in while people would come in/out. I didn’t really feel comfortable with that. I was following quiet hours but had to lower my music before then. We all pay to enjoy our stay and I’m big on following rules especially respecting my neighbors so was just caught off guard as it was still not quiet hours. Overall was a nice spot for my weekend trip.
Pawan’s place is in such a fantastic neighborhood for families with young children. Pawan is a terrific host and made us feel right at home! Would stay again!
Great value!

Benjamin is a lovely host and super proactive & helpful. The place makes you feel right at home, super clean & peaceful. It's also located in a beautiful community neighbourhood with great finds, library , & Cafes, - Please try Lula cafe (Benjamin had recommendated this local eats). If you are travelling alone or especially are concerned about your safety - rest assured it's totally safe & so many friendly people to help you out. One of the best part was the transit - blue line which takes you to the city is super near.
Would 10/10 visit again!

The place was very well designed to feel like a Japanese Izakaya spot. This made it a fun and unique experience. Additionally, the neighborhood was full of bars, restaurants and shopping all within walking distance.

This beautiful Airbnb was a perfect 10/10 stay! The space was spotless upon arrival, and the location was great in a quiet and easy to navigate neighborhood. Communication was seamless and fast, check-in very easy and Brian/Maria were available for anything we needed. There are quite a few amazing restaurants close by like Dirty Tiff’s and Peach’s Restaurant, we strongly recommend trying both! Definitely would book with them again if we were in the city!

Hatice was a great host, she was kind, responsive, and communicated quickly throughout the stay, which made everything easy. Overall we had a good experience and appreciated how attentive she was during our visit.
Great place! Definitely would love to come back
Great
We had a great time! Nikka was very helpful and the apartment was very comfortable.

Nice area and easy to get around Chicago! There are bus stops nearby and the surrounding area is quiet. I enjoyed the bed which was very comfy! I would have used the backyard if it wasn’t so cold, looked like a nice little area to hang out. The only things to be careful about are the steep stairs when it’s rainy/snowy out but this is normal in Chicago. Also there was no body soap left but they had shampoo and conditioner, but this wasn’t an issue as I always pack some extra in case. The home was pretty clean and had all the essentials otherwise! I enjoyed my stay and would come back. Thank you Mindy & Tony!

We arrived with a party of eight for the weekend and the accommodations fit all of us perfectly. It was nice that we had all our own private space, along with coming together for meals and a hangout in the living space. Bug benefit was that it was central to most of our sightseeing locations.
Edwin was a great host, really quick to respond to questions and requests and went out of his way to make me as comfortable as possible. :)

I was impressed with Longs customer service and fast response when communicating. The unit was easy to find and no issues with entry. The fact that there was parking available was a huge plus. I appreciate his accommodating my special requests; made my stay more comfortable.
Will use Long again.

The experience was fantastic. Our host incredibly attentive. The place was well-equipped and spotlessly clean. The location couldn’t have been better. I’m considering returning to the beautiful city of Chicago in the future and staying here again. Thanks Milan
Loved the vintage feel of the apartment and the location was great!
Beautiful location close to what we wanted to do (visit family and restaurants). When any issues arose, very quick to communicate and assist with them.

Check in was easy. The space was clean and looked like the picture. It is nicely decorated and had a fully stocked beautiful kitchen. There was a large smart TV which was really nice and easy to use. There is a convient USB plug in on the night stand which is a thoughtful touch. The bed and pillows are very comfortable.
The reason I couldn't give 5 stars is because I didn't sleep well due to the loud clanking/banging sounds the heater made randomly at night that kept waking me up. It was extremely frustrating.
In the summer time it is probably not an issue because you wouldnt need the heat on. I saw a gigantic roach and there is a cringy large hole on the side of the sink in the bathroom that fills up with water when the shower is on. Also, the room was cold upon arrival because the heat wasn't on and took several hours to get warm.

Phil was an exceptional host. He responded promptly and was very helpful. The place was so much fun. I could’ve stayed another day. I highly recommend booking this Airbnb with friends. Bathrooms and kitchen were very nice. Brand new and super clean. I’ll be back.

When traveling to Chicago to visit my family, I’m always happy to see when one of Peter’s properties is available. The units are always well appointed, pristine and comfortable. We had a wonderful Easter weekend in Chicago and having a safe, clean and relaxing place to stay makes it even better.
Nice place downtown at a reasonable rate with optional parking.
Great place outside of downtown.  Minutes from train station.

The home had enough beds and looked exactly like the photos. It was very comfortable and we were able to find parking for our car very easily. From there, we were able to use CTA and pick up nearby buses to get either down to River North, Wicker Park, or to trains to get to the other areas of the city. The only thing we'd suggest would be to hang up some curtains on the back windows. All other windows had curtains, except in the rear in the kitchen, so other tenants and neighbors could see in. Also, an internet upgrade would be nice too. We ended up just using the hotspot on my phone for any internet access as the provided wi-fi was very slow. That being said, we weren't really needing much time with internet access, as there was always something to do and we were normally taking our kids out places. I will also note, for a good burger skip the Gordon Ramsay Burger place downtown, there's a place nearby around West Town/Ukranian Village up on Chicago Ave called Fatso's Last Stand.
Truly such a wonderful experience to stay in such an impeccable time capsule.  Bello!
Can was very upfront and communicative from the beginning. The space was clean and tidy. Thank you for a lovely stay.

The space itself was nice and worked well for our stay, and the location was convenient. However, guests should be aware that the neighbors nearby are very noise-sensitive. During our stay, we were approached about noise even though we were speaking at a normal volume. The host was responsive when contacted, but it’s something to keep in mind if you’re planning a stay and expect to have conversations or multiple guests present.
Overall, just something future guests may want to be aware of when booking.
Gina's place was great. It was clean and had everything we needed. Great location and made us feel like part of the neighborhood.
We had a wonderful stay.  A great space for our large group and the beds were very comfortable!
Great place to stay the weekend. The kitchen is huge which was great because we were able to prepare a full dinner while we stayed. Could use a little more furniture but overall a nice place to stay.

I stayed at Andy's airbnb for a week. Andy was super responsive and allowed me to check in a few hours ahead of the check in time which was greatly appreciated as I had traveled across the country for work.
The bed in the master was heavenly. There was a minor issue with the front door lock and I messaged Andy and he promptly responded and had a locksmith over who rectified the problem. I couldn't figure out why the dishwasher wouldn't turn on (human error on my part) and Andy responded with the answer within mons.
Having free parking was a plus as was being near the Jewel grocery store about 2 blocks away. You are near the University of Chicago and hospital and a short drive from the soon to open Obama Library.
