Given that you are in a condo, you can sometimes hear the neighbors above but not too often and not enough to be a nuisance.
I would definitely stay there again.
Our favorite stay with Air B n B
Great place to stay! 🫡🇲🇽
This apartment was very welcoming and had great history to it. Lois was very informative and responsive!
Me and my family had a good time, nice place!
She’s very responsive and left clear instructions for everything before hand
Fue un excelente lugar para hospedarse. Muy limpio, cómodo y hermoso por dentro. Definitivamente lo recomiendo
Awesome host and great Airbnb, would come back anytime!
Me and my family really enjoyed our stay. The place was clean and very close to downtown. Would definitely stay again!

10/10!!! We will absolutely be booking here again! We loved the location and how many things there were to do just on this street! The apartment was so cute, clean, and had everything we needed. Nicholas was also very fast with responding and always answered any questions that we had. This was a very great experience!
Great place to stay and it was in a nice area

This was a great place to stay and everything was as described in the listing. No issues checking in, lots of parking available, clean and safe. I only wish there was a bigger couch in living room or additional chairs besides the ones from the dining table!

Sandra was very communicative and gave great instructions. Sandra place overall was nice and aesthetically pleasing. My only complaint would be the bathroom shower needs to be redone. Tub is worn & peeling.
Very rare to find a location w this size in the city.  Besides the only stairs to get up and down, location was perfect.

Hakim was kind enough to let us check in late after a concert which was greatly appreciated. Getting in was a little complicated and the room was really warm but other than that it’s a fine place to stay about 20 minutes from downtown Chicago. We felt safe.

Evelyn is a jewel. Her place is warm and welcoming. It always smells nice.
Evelyn has great knowledge of the local art and music scene. I only wish I was younger and could stay out late & get up early so I’d have had more time to explore the city.
Silvia was a great host, we felt like we were at home,  the place is fantastic!

Thomas and his management team were super responsive, the location with designated parking spot was super, the apartment, kitchen and bedrooms were super clean and comfy. The building and apartment safe and secure. My only disappointments were a non-working oven, which could not be fixed during my stay. Also the blinds were not room darkening. This small "city" of Lakeview is sort of noisy in the mornings, as was the neighbor above. Just so you know, that's the location.
Very nice place. Enough room to fit everyone.
Piso amplio en buena zona y con comercio . Le falta mejorar un poco la decoración: el sofá , armarios ..

Regina was a great host—very responsive and helpful throughout the stay. The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in was smooth and everything went perfectly. Would definitely stay again.

This airbnb was perfect for our long weekend in Chicago. It was right near a subway stop which made it easy to get to so many places, and was about a 15 minute walk to a ton of bars/restaurants and shops. The hosts were very responsive and helpful, and check in and out was super easy. Place was clean and had a washer and dryer which was great. Plus the views were awesome. Had an amazing stay, would highly recommend.

Kitchen had necessary space and amenities to cook a holiday dinner, dining room was spacious enough to serve holiday dinner, beds & pillows were comfortable, on-demand hot water, convenient location, and James was very responsive with any questions/needs we had.  Enjoyed our stay!
Fácil de llegar, muy limpio todo y muy cerca a la línea verde de la estación de tren
We had a wonderful stay. Everything was exactly as described! We would definitely stay here again!

BEWARE: The listing on Milwaukee says that it’s “nearby” a dog grooming place but the Airbnb space actually shares a very thin wall with it. The dog groomer was constantly cursing at the dogs, the hallway entrance to the Airbnb smelled like urine and dog defection and dogs barked constantly from 8a-5p. Not ideal if you’d like to relax or work remotely at the space. Also, the oven lacked knobs for controlling the heat and were not replaced during the duration of my stay. Otherwise, the space was nice! Would not recommend though. Thankful that I received a refund for unspent nights after cancelling early. The smells made me nauseous and constant barking gave me headaches.
It's one of the best places I've stayed at so far! Thank you Victor for the good hospitality.

This was my first time staying in an Airbnb, as I’ve always stayed in hotels before — and it turned out to be a great experience. After this trip, I’d definitely consider choosing Airbnb more often.
We were a group of 7 friends (3 couples and 1 solo traveler), and the place worked really well for all of us. There were about 5 rooms, so everyone had plenty of space. The house was clean and well-maintained, and the washrooms were also nice and clean.
The location was a big plus — only about 20 minutes from downtown Chicago, which made getting around very easy.
We came from Canada for a trip, and overall, we had a really good stay. Tian, the host, was very responsive and provided everything we needed right away.
We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend it to others.

Our stay with Steve and Loong was great! Hosts were very friendly, helpful, and accommodating. Loong greeted us at the door and showed us everything there was to know. The space was perfect for staying a few days, it’s larger than it looks in the pictures! We (three girls in our twenties) felt safe staying there. It’s in a great location, with a red line stop less than a 5 min walk away. Lots of great restaurant options in the area as well. Definitely would stay again!
Great space and wonderful location in walking distance to much of Chicago! Hosts were very communicative and responsive!
My family had a great stay and I plan to rebook in the future.
Very clean and exactly as shown in the pictures.

Ares home was a great place for us during a job we had locally. It's often hard to find a place in Chicagoland that is really a nice enjoyable place to stay but Ares's place was great. Don't be afraid to book this one, it fantastic and Ares is a top notch host.
great space clean and easy check in and out

I had a really great stay here and would absolutely book again next time I’m in Chicago. The location is hard to beat—super easy to get to restaurants, shopping, and anything else you’d want to do.
The space itself was beautiful, clean, and really well put together. It felt cute, stylish, and comfortable, and you can tell there was thought put into the details. I also loved the Malin & Goetz products—such a nice touch and definitely a step up from the usual.
Overall, it was a really great stay and I’d absolutely recommend it!
I would definitely stay there again!! Great location for the purpose of our girls trip, and plenty of space for the three of us to spread out and be comfy. Ade was a great host and very responsive!!
Are stay was very peaceful we enjoyed our stay

We stayed with 3 adult qnd 2 children, and there was plenty of room for everyone to have enough space without feeling crowded. The ping-pong table was a hit with the kids as well as the adults. The location was perfect. Never felt unsafe or uneasy. Hardly saw neighbors, but when we did they were friendly. Daniel's house is close enough to everything that if you wanted to walk to the train or drive anywhere you could easily do so. The parking was something we were worried about, but once we got there, it was exactly as the other reviews suggested. Never had a problem parking directly in front of the house. If that space had been taken, we could have easily parked close enough to the house because the house is located on a one way street. Daniel was also an amazing host. The communication was clear and straightforward. He also gave really great recommendations even though he didn't have to. We are hoping to be able to stay here any time we are back in this area.

We had a great time at Bernadette’s place! Everything was exactly as described and the apartment was much bigger than I thought it would be. Also, having a driveway and not having worry about parking was a huge plus in Chicago! (On a side note, I had read a review that parking was tight so we drove my little car as opposed to my husbands truck, but it was not necessary and I feel like the driveway/parking had plenty of room.) We will definitely stay again if we are in the area!
A great location near Logan Square - walkable to shops, restaurants and grocery. Would recommend and stay again.

La situation est parfaite, à deux pas des musées, du centre ville, du « target » (supermarché) et du Buddy Guy’ legends club (on a meme eu la chance de l’y voir chanter!)
L’appartement est très lumineux avec une belle vue, « Vertigineuse »!
En résumé parfait!

The apartment was in a great location, very close to the red line and many bus stops. The host was very responsive and helpful, we nearly ran out of toilet paper so the host had her son drop some off for us! There is a public parking lot a couple blocks from the apartment with very reasonable rates for overnight parking.
Great condo, just very noisy from the l line!
Love it! Perfect location! Great neighborhood- walked to the farmers market Saturday morning. Coffee and breakfast was a great extra. Very safe and convenient
Global getaway and the team was very welcoming to me and my family. Would definitely book them again

The space is lovely and modern. I wish the kitchen had been a little larger and the living room space a little bigger. Those two areas felt a little tight for our group, though the bedrooms were very large.

Russell Place in Chicago is a spacious and comfortable spot, exactly as described. We had a great time staying there. Even though there’s no dedicated parking, it was easy to find street parking nearby, which made things convenient.
One thing to keep in mind is that the property has quite a few stairs, so it may not be ideal for anyone with mobility issues. That said, for those who are comfortable with stairs, it’s a great place to stay and we’d happily return.

Great stay overall. The location is super central and made getting around really easy. The condo was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed.
Having a Target a block away was a huge plus for quick essentials. The Field Museum is about a 5 minute Uber or a nice 15 minute walk, which made exploring simple.
Would definitely stay here again.
Later was super communicative and helpful! Really kind host and a wonderful place.

Had a wonderful stay! The place was very clean and exactly as described. We especially appreciated the garage parking—it made everything so much easier. The host was responsive and helpful throughout our visit. The location was perfect for getting around and Would absolutely stay here again next time we’re in town. Highly recommend!
Excellent location, walkable to attractions downtown. Great host. Basic accommodation - exactly as shown and described in the listing. Good value for money!!

I had a great experience staying here. The host was incredibly responsive and made everything seamless from check-in to check-out. He also went above and beyond by recommending some really great local spots to eat, which made my trip even better. On top of that, he was genuinely kind and welcoming throughout my stay. I’d definitely recommend staying here!
nxt realty provided a really clean and well equipped home. we enjoyed our stay a lot!
Great home! Close to downtown Pilsen

This is a great place to stay. I am of course partial because I wanted to stay in Ukrainian village where my son and family is also renting while their house renovation is under way. Sukh's place is, in any case, in a perfect location, close to public transportation and close to downtown. Plenty of room, well equipped kitchen, comfortable beds. Loved having two bathrooms - a real plus for us. The grandids loved it too. Quiet area, nice outdoor space. Easy check-in and uncomplicated check-out.
I like this home

I cannot say enough about Janet and her beautiful home. The reviews got me and here I am leaving one myself.
We absolutely loved staying at her home. She is an above and beyond host. She responded right away to every message and went as far as to buy a new record player for our visit bc hers was not working and we specifically were wanting to use the record player at her home.
This is next level hospitality!!
She is so kind and thoughtful and makes her home feel like yours. It is beautifully decorated and filled with everything you need for a perfect getaway. If you love to cook you will enjoy her kitchen very much. The sweet church next door filled with life every evening was the cherry on the top of a perfect experience in Chicago.
Thank you Janet for your warmth and welcoming home.
Can’t wait to come again !!

Great stay at a home which is a welcome break from the corporate Wayfair furnished places that seem to be the norm now. The apartment looks even better than the pictures in person, and we all had a great stay.

The place matched the photos which was really nice. It was a bit hard to find, as the address takes you to a duplex? But neither door is where you’ll actually stay. Instead it’s an underground location. Reached out to host for clarification, but since I arrived later than intended the late message didn’t get a response until the next day almost 14 hours later. The bathroom was beautiful, but the shower doors were wobbly. The next day, I found that the reason it was offset is because one was upside down with the wheels on the ceiling instead of the ground. Reached out to host after the door fell on my niece. He did let us know the place was new and to be careful. The neighborhood was quiet and not far from many popular locations which is cool! Overall, I had a pretty nice stay here but would like to see some improvement in the future.

You can’t beat the location of this beautiful downtown apartment. Our family of 5 was able to comfortably spread out and everyone had their own spaces and bathrooms. We were able to walk or take public transportation anywhere we needed. The rooftop balcony is gorgeous. The parking garage was a plus for us. We parked on Thursday and didn’t need to retrieve our car again until we left on Sunday. The area felt very safe and the building was secure. It was fun to take an elevator that opened right into our apartment. Book the space and enjoy!

The place was quaint and, for the most part, comfortable.  Be warned...its not quoet.  People live upstairs.  There is no soundproofing so them walking around was easily heard.  Also, you could hear their conversations through the vent.  There is also another apartment in the basement that this one is in.  People talk loud and doors bang.  It was quiet after about 10:30 pm.

Alex’s stay was memorable and comfy. He was great with communication and made sure we felt right at home from the moment we checked in. The house was clean and tidy and had all the amenities we were looking for - only thing my that was lacking was the provision of some tea bags or coffee pods just to make it a bit more homely :)
Overall 10/10 experience and would highly recommend this Airbnb for anyone travelling to Chicago and looking to be close enough to downtown and all the things to do in the city. Keep up the good work and hosting, Alex!

This is my favorite place to stay when I visit my son in Logan Square. It’s a great location near the Blue Line, comfortable bed, quiet, and clean. Logan Square has a wealth of good restaurants. In the warmer months, the owner shares use of the back garden area.

Excellent location near Martyrs, and the Brown line.
Space was cozy and bed was very comfortable.
I’m definitely coming back!

This was one of the worst travel experiences my family and I have ever had.
We arrived after a 10-hour flight, exhausted and traveling with my wife and 6 month daughter, only to find ourselves completely unable to check in. The host did not answer any phone calls or messages at the time of check-in, and to make matters worse, the passcode provided for the padlock was incorrect.
As a result, we were left stranded outside the property with no way to enter, we were ultimately forced to leave the property and find alternative accommodation late at at night, with our family and luggage. It was incredibly stressful and unacceptable.
What made the situation even more frustrating was the complete lack of communication. The host only reached out nearly 24 hours later with a brief apology, stating she was out of town and couldn’t take the call. By then, the damage had already been done.
This level of irresponsibility and lack of care for guests is unacceptable. I would strongly not recommend

Andrew is one of the most responsive hosts I’ve had. He’s very quick and easy to talk to. His instructions are accurate and easy. Communication is top notch. I have to say that the cleanliness was the weak spot. The corridor between the first door and the second door was dusty, and it had strong cigarette smell. Under the furniture the dust could be improved as well, but fairly clean. The pictures are accurate, the amenities included are there. Props to Andrew again because we felt chilly but there was an additional room heater available, which worked out for us. The check in is easy and the location of the place is very accessible to public transportation, both train and bus stops. Overall would have been great if not for the cleanliness, but still fairly good.
I rent this place with my girlfriend for my trip and its good using the room. I love the vibe.
Excellent location. Apartment was clean and comfortable and Jon and Amy are kind and very responsive hosts.

WOW! This beautiful place is in the perfect location. For my first time in Chicago, it was incredible to have such amazing views of downtown from every room. I walked the dog to local parks, we had a date night half a block away and we were ten minutes away from everything we wanted to do. I can’t reiterate how awesome this neighborhood is enough. The bakery downstairs was also amazing to have so close. The coziest bed ever, spacious bathrooms, clean hallways and felt very secure. I can’t wait to come back. This place is so worth it! Easy to enter, parked in a garage up the street and ubered everywhere.

One of the nicest places I’ve stayed. The hosts were very responsive and very helpful, even with the tons of questions I had. The area was very calm and quiet, although I wouldn’t recommend walking around at night. Being next to the train was very convenient as well. The place was clean and check in was a breeze. My one takeaway would be to research the area before booking as we were told by our uber drivers that it isn’t the best place for 2 girls to stay by themselves.

We couldn’t find the remote to the Roku tv we had to use the Roku app and we asked and didn’t get a direct response and I feel like if an elderly couple stayed there it would have been a problem. The locking system was kinda finicky but we got the hang of it. But overall a decent place to stay. Some very good restaurants around and cool shops.
Amy was an excellent host. The location was great for easy access to U-Chicago. Highly recommended!

Place was fine, very clean and a good location.  It lacked some amenities that we have experienced at other AIRBNB locations (I.e. overall instructions, TV remote in bedroom, bath mats, etc.).  The excess requirements post booking with AIRBNB was annoying (even more information, personal identification, extra security deposit); again something we haven’t experienced with other properties.  Dealing with the property management felt very corporate; in the past it seems like we have had a more personal interaction with the owner.

Fantastic location if you plan to visit the University of Chicago. The host was responsive and the apartment was clean.
My wife and I stayed here while visiting the University of Chicago. It was a better location than almost all available hotels and was notably cheaper.
Good
I enjoyed my stay in Chicago so much. Jessica was so helpful and took no time to respond.
Good service

We really enjoyed our stay at Assel’s place! The space was clean. Parking was a big plus for us and the unit’s security with locking for both the unit and the full building was excellent. Additional cleaning supplies would be a great addition for under the sink for quick clean up during the stay.. and when we asked Assel was quick and responsive to help us get access to some supplies! We can’t wait to come stay again! :)
Would definitely recommend! Very clean. Instructions were clear which made checking in easier. Jasmine was very responsive and helpful. I’d definitely stay here again.

Place was okay for an overnight stay. Don’t book if you have kids. We had multiple complaints about footsteps being too loud for the downstairs tenants. Had issues with downstairs tenants being obnoxiously loud all night long. Back door doesn’t open to properly dispose of garbage. No plug for the bathtub. Parking was a nightmare in the cold with kids.
Awesome location and walking distance by the Chinatown complex. Host is super responsive and dedicated to fulfilling our needs. Highly recommended.
The place was perfect for our family. Everything as described and good communication throughout.

Rosa was a great host, with excellent communication and attention to detail. The space is clean and up-to-date, and the amenities are well thought out. The neighborhood is quiet and I appreciated the easy street parking.  Would stay again.
Very happy with our stay. Great host!
She is very responsive and gives clear instructions. It was a bit confusing to park inside because we have a big car. Very convenient it is close to every area we were looking for.
Stay was great! bathroom was clean and modern and the living space was a nice space to spend time.
I truly enjoyed my stay and I would come back again.

We traveled to Chicago for my daughter’s volleyball tournament. The location was perfect for walking back and forth to McCormick Place Event Center. We took an Uber twice due to rain and they were readily available. The apartment itself was very clean. The bed is a Murphy bed and I was a little skeptical but it was VERY comfortable. Milan was extremely communicative and gave very clear and detailed instructions about everything. We will definitely book again if we find ourselves back in Chicago.

We had a wonderful stay. The place had everything we needed and the proximity to the blue line is fantastic. We walked to a concert at the Salt Shed. The city noise was not bad at all. We would stay here again.
Great place to stay and good parking deal

We stayed at angela’s for couple of days. The place was conveniently located according to our needs and our check in was smooth as well. Angela was quick to respond to any of our questions and inconveniences. The beds were comfortable as well. The house is old but has character which was nice. However there were some inconveniences that we faced and have communicated with angela from the get go and although not major but these would definitely help the future guest stay better if taken care of. The key factor for me always is how willing the host is to address if issues arrive and i felt our hosts were gracious and nice with that . But this place needs some updates and work done that i will recommend angela in a private message. Overall it was a decent stay for my family.
The airbnb absolutely served the purpose of our stay; right location, right price, had essentially what we needed.
It’s a good decent place to stay and in a safe area

We had a great stay at this Airbnb right next to Wrigley Field. The location couldn’t have been better. Everything was extremely walkable, and having the train station just around the corner made getting around Chicago super convenient.
The check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free, which made the whole experience even better. The host clearly put thought into making things easy for guests.
Overall, I’d definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a comfortable stay with access to the area.
Large space and great views. Will book again.

This is a tough review for us.
This rental has two major issues. The first being the neighborhood. On 2 of the 4 nights we were there, a home two doors down had music going at an insane volume outside in their parking lot blasting from 4:30pm-9pm one night (cut short from rainstorms) 4:30pm til midnight the next. It was like being next to a club or an outside concert.
The second is the smell of the building and rental. It smelled so badly of weed. When the rental agreement states that smoking is not allowed, it was overwhelming how strong it smelled in the 4 apartment building.
I’d be concerned this will effect other rentals in the future with spring and summer weather ahead, and probably hasn’t been an issue prior as most of the reviews from this newer listing has been over the winter months.
I will say the place is very spacious, beautiful, and so close to the green line. Lumi was great at communication and helped with what she could. But these issues are out of their hands.
Thank you. Hope to use it again

Kimberly's apartment was spacious, comfortable, and had everything we needed for our visit to Chicago to visit family.  Easy parking, good location for us, great sleeping/eating/work space, and best of all we could bring our dogs along!  We didn't cook much outside of frying some eggs, but the kitchen seemed to have everything needed.  We especially appreciated the coffee options and presence of an electric kettle for tea. As it's in an older building in the city,  you will hear some noise and the footsteps of other tenants, but not unusual for that type of building.  Kimberly's instructions were very clear and she is a responsive host.  Would recommend!

Basement floods during storms (2/3 bedrooms down there). Clearly has happened before (from water damage on the baseboards and floors) so either way don’t stay here if you have mold sensitivities. We checked into a flooded basement and when their maintenance person came the following day they lied to Airbnb support about the extent of the flooding to squeeze 1 night $$ out of us. Said they would get back to us about a refund and ghosted. Still trying to get a refund for the trip even after we left 3 days sooner than we planned. Yikes.
Great house to stay with my big family. Kitchen was well stocked. Bedrooms were great with comfortable beds! The bathrooms had very hot water which was great after a cold day outside! Great stay!
Beautiful place to stay, great host!
Great spot/location for a big group! Hosted a bachelorette with 9 girls and the space was perfect! Description was accurate and Brandon was very prompt with his responses!

Good location, clean facility. Be aware that there is no management onsite. I extended my stay, and somehow the code was changed at midnight without a notice. I got locked out of my room with no phone on me in the middle of the night. A kind neighbor sent them a message in the morning, and they responded quickly with my new code and later provided a reasonable refund upon request.

This apartment was great for our weekend trip and reasonably priced for the area. Jose was very quick to respond to the couple questions we had and also reached out to make sure everything was going well for us. Overall we had a great stay.
Excellent condon great location. Be sure to have brunch at Brulee, right next door. Garage parking was a breeze.
The place was very clean and had everything we needed. Very cozy and in a great location. The hosts were also very friendly and welcoming. Definitely would recommend.

Alec provides us an excellent accommodation during our stay in Chicago. He thought of everything, and his attention to detail made all of us feel completely comfortable and at home. We truly appreciated his hospitality and the effort he put into ensuring our stay was enjoyable. It made our trip even more memorable!

The location is excellent for accessing public transportation. Although the access street is behind some restaurants, we always felt safe. It’s a great option for a family trip, especially for a family of four/five with small children, since there are two beds upstairs and one downstairs, all comfortable, though there are no private bedrooms. While they don’t offer any flexibility with check-in or check-out, their communication is clear and consistent

GREAT Location, two blocks from L train, and about as quiet as you can get for the area.  The condo itself is a bit worn out. Basic amenities, but no little extras to make your stay superb. For the amount of money paid, it felt a bit lacking.

This was my second time staying in this lovely home and it did not disappoint. Ledys has since added a new Murphy so there was even more comfortable sleeping space for my family. Ledys was also able to accommodate early check-in, which was so helpful. Great host, great home. Absolutely recommend!!
Enjoyed the stay! Everything looked as was pictured! Host was very proactive in reaching out and solving problems. The only issue was excessive hair in shower drain and on sheets.
Perfect place to stay at, everything was so close by and very quiet neighborhood

The place was beautifully designed and incredibly clean and comfortable for 6 people. We enjoyed the area as well and the walkability of the neighborhood. Additionally, as we landed in the city early, Candace helped us coordinate at least dropping off our things in the unit earlier than our designated check-in time (4pm), which we really appreciated.
There were two challenges with the place that have more to do with the building than the apartment itself: 1) the entryway was very tight and cluttered with large packages so it was difficult to get in with all our things and go up the *very* steep stairs to the unit, and 2) it was incredibly easy to hear our neighbors and especially the ones upstairs which made it somewhat difficult to sleep / tune them out after midnight on the weekend.
Overall, I would just be aware of the two points above which could have been situational / specific to that particular weekend. Otherwise, the unit itself was great!

My stay was wonderful. The place was very quiet and well maintained. Public transportation is great in the area if you want to go into the downtown area or anywhere else. A ton of places to eat and great parks in the area are walking distance. John was super nice and quick to respond to any questions. It was a bit warm the first night but if you open the windows, the place cool down quickly. I loved the bathroom, especially the shower. Overall I had a really nice experience and would return again.
Great space good location very convenient
This place was great.  Very comfortable for our group of 3.  The internet was fast, and I was able to work comfortably.  I hope to come back.
Had a great stay and Alejandro was a responsive host. Place was clean and easy to find. About a 20-25 min walk from the trains. Didn’t need to use the garage since always lots of street parking.
We have stayed here multiple times and the experience is wonderful.  Gary is so very helpful and the place is modern and clean and pretty!
Jaime was an absolutely wonderful host! Everything about our stay was exactly as described. We can’t wait to visit again!
Great place, great view, great host.
Great place overall. Downtown Chicago isn’t close but the area was great and peaceful.

Plenty of space and very clean! We stayed here 2 nights on our own and two nights with another family and plenty of space for 4 adults and 5 kids. Bathrooms and Kitchen were spotless, and the whole place was neat and clean in general.  Loved the location.  So easy to walk around the Fulton Market area or hop on the L train.  I didn’t realize how the building actually faces the train tracks/stop until we checked in.  I was worried it would affect our sleep but it wasn’t that loud and we slept fine. Auroom was a great host, he would respond very quickly with any questions we had.  Very nice stay.
Frank was great and the place was exactly as described. It’s in a great spot too.
Great stay and great host!
Great place to stay !! Very responsive host . Thanks

As always 10/10 review. There is nothing better than driving hours and hours and checking into a place that’s easy, comfortable and AFFORDABLE! Regina goes above and beyond and will always deserve 5 stars. I would note to take the parking warning seriously! Parking anytime after 5 is always challenging but not impossible! Will 100% be back!

Lana was such an awesome host super nice and friendly. Her place was super cool and new. With the cool QR code to get you in the front door was neat. Much more spacious than it may look from the outside it’s very nice. I’d recommend this place 100% and I’d stay again if ever working again in the area. Thanks Lana once again!!
We had a terrific stay.   The weather was a little soggy but the apartment was very nice.  Easy walking distance to the red line station.  Convenient location to Loyola.
Excelente propiedad.
We had a lovely stay, and it was the perfect location for a concert at the Aragon!

I stay in bb an and hotels a lot and this is one of the best I have ever stayed at! At every turn Tracee had left something intentional that I didn’t know I needed a candle, a heating pad, extra blankets. It was spotless and beautiful and the neighborhood is wonderful and felt so safe!
We enjoyed our stay. Great location!

I stayed for two weeks but honestly wish I could have booked it for the entire duration of my clinical! The location was truly perfect, close to everything I needed, yet still private and quiet. The neighborhood felt incredibly safe and was genuinely so nice, which made a big difference in my day-to-day routine with my dog. The apartment was spotless when I arrived and very well maintained throughout my stay, which I really appreciated. I also always had a reliable parking spot, which made commuting to and from classes and the hospital downtown so much easier. The amenities were exactly what I needed, and everything was thoughtfully set up to make my stay comfortable. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a peaceful, clean, and homey place to stay.

One of the biggest highlights was how conveniently located the Airbnb was—being so close to the Blue Line made getting around the city incredibly easy, whether heading downtown or to the airport.
The neighborhood also had plenty of great food options within walking distance, which made exploring local spots effortless and enjoyable. It was nice to have so many choices nearby without needing to travel far.
I really appreciated the simplicity of the Airbnb itself. It was clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully set up without feeling cluttered or overdone—just a relaxing space to come back to after a day out in the city.
One thing to note is that noise does travel from the upstairs/adjacent unit—footsteps and voices were noticeable at times, which occasionally interrupted sleep.
Overall, a smooth and enjoyable stay. I’d definitely come back.

Really nice place!!! worth the stay close to all you need in walking distance! will say more ment for 2 couples then 3 friends but thats my poor planning lol. Super clean everything is setup nice and simple and easy to use just about everything!! Me and my friends loved it!!! And they were very helpful im not much for messaging but they were messaging asking if i needed any help or any questions!!!!

Patricia was super communicative and made sure our stay was great.  It’s true as some reviews state, the furniture is pretty basic and bare bones, but everything was clean and the location was perfect.  Will stay there again !
Nice place.  Host very accommodating and provided us an extra table and chairs to host local family.  Nice sized kitchen and good shower.

1000 characters isn’t enough to describe the stay. In all honesty one of the most wonderful experiences I’ve had throughout using Airbnb. The place is absolutely stunning with AMAZING features like waterfall shower heads and heated bathroom floors. Absolutely amazing bedrooms and wonderful kitchen and living area. Views from the apartment are unlike no other capturing the beauty of the Chicago skyline. 100/10 off cleanliness alone and the simple fact that indoor parking is included with the ability to go in and out as you please is just a cherry on top. Also Jay is a wonderful host who goes above and beyond and it’s definitely reflected in his space. Wonderful wonderful wonderful experience and I am definitely going to come back here!

Andrew was so flexible and let us have early check in and late check out and was so accommodating with our changing plans. (Travel can be so unpredictable!) He always responded quickly and worth helpful info. The place was a perfect setup for people who are unfamiliar with the area.
My only note is with our very young kids, we ended up all sleeping in the larger sleeping space with the kids on the futon as it would have been hard for the kids to get to us during the night. Other than that it was very family friendly! Would stay again!
We had such a great stay at this Airbnb. Communication was excellent, location was great and the beds were super comfortable! Would definitely recommend staying here.
I would highly recommend this place for anyone looking to stay in Chicago!

Perfect size for a family of four. The teens didn't want to share a bed, so one took the bedroom and the other the sofa bed. The place was very clean and had everything we needed. Nice touch to include a Brita filter in the fridge for easy access to drinking water. It was nice not to have to buy water bottles and lug them home. Location is great, just two blocks from the train and at the south end of the park. Great views. The host was very proactively communicative the entire time.

Arman was a great host making sure we were comfortable during our stay. The place was clean, beds were comfortable, stocked with plenty of kitchen supplies, towels and soaps. The shower has good water pressure and it gets nice and warm! The location is great with lots of bars within walking distance and WrigleyVille only a mile away. There is always parking out front and the neighborhood is safe and friendly! Highly recommend!
The place was great and the host was very responsive with any questions.
Kiva was super responsive, and great with recommendations. We had a lovely stay!
Everything was as advertised. Nice stat

I had a great stay overall! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Jorge was a fantastic host! Very responsive, kind, and made the entire process smooth from start to finish. I truly appreciated the setup and the location.
Since it is a shared space, I would just recommend being mindful that experiences can vary depending on other guests, but Jorge does a great job managing the home. Overall, I had a positive stay and would definitely keep on my favorites list!
The place was amazing. Dom was a great host. Any issues I had, he was very proactive in getting them resolved.
Overall we had a great stay,the house had everything we needed,100% recomended

Loved my stay here! The apartment is exactly like the pictures. The hosts are very responsive and accommodating. It is only a couple blocks from downtown Hyde Park with many shops and delicious restaurants, and it’s about a mile walk to UChicago. I would highly recommend this place!

Great spot! We had a very peaceful stay and never had to worry about finding parking! Axel was super nice and helpful. After we accidentally locked ourselves out, Axel was very responsive and helped us get back into the apartment very quickly. I hope to stay here again when I make my way back to Chicago!

The place was spotless! My family enjoyed our spring break stay! Very easy to communicate and get things taken care of. Only negative thing was the hot water ran out fast. But they mentioned it was only a 80 gallon tank. We did wash dishes and it was three of us for showers and or baths. So that could be why. But over  all will book again! House felt like home!

I had a very pleasant stay at Kyriako's place,  the place is exactly as described and in walking distance to many shops, restaurants, and UChicago. The only problem was the heating in the building; I don't think the central heating worked for my entire stay. Luckily, there were two extra heaters in the place, which definitely saved me!
5 stars! Great family home! Would definitely stay here again!
The house is in a quite neighborhood with nice places to get breakfast nearby. The house was clean and the host was very friendly and responsive. We enjoyed our stay!
Everything was very clean and comfortable. Lina made it very easy to figure out how to get in and out of the apartment which I appreciated. I would definitely stay here again!
We enjoyed our stay, the space was nice and quiet.

El lugar NO puede ser mejor, el espacio impecable, la zona tranquila pero a la vez super bien conectada (cerca de la línea café y roja) para ir al centro o a desayunar cerca e incluso caminando al estadio de los Cubs.
Pese a que hay un bar abajo (y nos tocó en temporada de partido de los Cubs) NO es para nada un problema, no se escucha el ruido y respetan muchísimo el horario.
El lugar estaba impecable de limpio y se siente como estar en casa.
nice location. clean space and easy to access. made vacationing with 2 kids much easiee

The condo is exactly what you see in the pictures. Super clean. The building is situated in a location that is walkable to everywhere and anywhere you want to go to in the heart of the Loop area. Unfortunately, the front of the building/entrance has become a hangout to guys loitering, smoking and some homeless people hanging around specifically in front of the building, a bit sketchy.  My second time at this location and seems the loitering has increased. Otherwise, condo is great.

This place is conveniently located near the red line into Chicago and the rooms, bedding, etc are in good condition. The kitchen was lacking in spices (i.e. nothing but paprika) and didn't have a big pot. If you plan on cooking rather than eating out, I'd say this is not the best kitchen for that. My sister-in-law also noticed some things felt a bit greasy so the cleaning was not quite up to her standard. Also, the noise of upstairs neighbors even just walking across their unit, is noticeable.
On the plus, the price is right for a stay in Chicago with easy access to public transit and walking distance from the Lake Michigan shore. It was worth it for me.

El apartamento de Kyriako nos encantó,  mi hija y esposa estaban muy a gusto con la estancia. Excelente ubicación del centro de Chicago,  lo encontramos limpio y es Lu lugar muy acogedor. Recomendamos el apartamento sin duda, la pasamos súper.

En general bien pero casi diario nos despertábamos a media noche con olores incómodos que se metían por la ventilación
Las alfombras requieren una limpieza a profundidad y también el sillón
El colchón inflable lo quisimos usar pero optamos por no usarlo porque estaba bastante sucio
Milán muy atento pero el lugar no vale lo que cuesta, las fotos muestran un hospedaje diferente a la realidad

Sarah and Marco were very responsive and accommodating. They offered us a spot to park in the garage which was really nice since the weather was not great. The place looked just like the pictures. When we noticed there was no sugar for our coffee Sarah dropped off sugar, syrup and creamer just to make sure we had everything we would need. The place was cozy and in a convenient location in relation to the city. We had a great time!
very nice, clean place with decently priced parking ramp nearby. Easy check in and check out.
Neat and tidy. Very responsive hosts.
Amazing stay! Super easy host to communicate to. Clean house. I was there for a month - no problems!

This place has a great location and a single parking space which is wonderful. The place itself is very tired and was not professionally cleaned. Bathroom smelled, sheets didn’t  seem to be clean. Carpet was very dirty and definitely not vacuumed. The kitchen does not have adequate cooking utensils. Nonetheless, it did the job with its great location.

Great stay for the price! We visited with my mom, sister, and our daughters for a quick spring break trip and felt very safe and comfortable in the neighborhood. The apartment was clean, spacious, and exactly as described in the listing.
Parking was easy to manage. Like most Chicago neighborhoods, there is street parking with permits and restrictions if you don’t look carefully, but we opted to use a nearby secure lot about a 5-minute walk away, which worked out perfectly.
The only minor downside was that the walls are a bit thin, and we could hear the upstairs neighbors moving around at various times. It was no fault of the host but it was certainly noticeable for most of our stay and for my daughter while trying to sleep, so something to keep in mind if you’re traveling with light sleepers.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and appreciated the location and convenience. We would absolutely consider staying here again on our next trip to Chicago!
It was a nice place to get some rest
Third time staying at this place. Do I  need to say more?
The room was very clean and comfortable. Everything was as described, and it was definitely worth the money. I had a great stay and would recommend it!

We stayed with our two young children and had a fantastic time! We could walk to local businesses which the kids really enjoyed as it is not something we can do at home.
The actual house was perfect, the beds were comfortable and everyone had plenty of space. The garage was also very nice to have access to so we did not have to worry about street parking.
We look forward to staying here again whenever we visit Chicago again!
We loved the place. It was very comfortable and had everything we needed. Very cool older building with a modern interior.
Located conveniently next to the Brown Line, getting anywhere is a breeze. The neighbors can be a little rambunctious, but for the most part it is a quiet neighborhood.
It was a great location with plenty of room and being on the outskirts of the city we were able to see so much more. We definitely will return.
Great location - easy to access public transportation, nearby restaurants. And yet it was in a quiet neighborhood. The apartment itself was clean and well furnished.
very nice place. not far from the bus. would stay here again!

The place was a good value. Close to where we wanted to be, and accommodated our group with what we needed. The single bath may be a challenge to some groups, and the dogs downstairs, but Nikkole did disclose these in the listings. We were left some gifts from previous renters, and recommend people pack out what they pack in as a courtesy to others.

Excellent choice if you are looking to stay in Hyde Park.
Classic three-flat apartment building a short walk from Harold’s on one side; UChicago on the other. Nicely furnished. Super comfortable bed and linens. The upstairs neighbors did have a party while we were there. But hey, it was Friday night and I was young once too. When I finally decided I had enough, I asked them to quiet down and they promptly shut it down.

El lugar está súper bien cuidado, todo nuevo, limpio, con todo lo necesario.
Daniel nos atendió increíblemente bien, nos solucionó todas las dudas, nos dio excelentes recomendaciones.

Absolutely loved my stay! Staff was so friendly and they had awesome amenities. Happy hour was a plus and the design of the hotel was beautiful. I definitely recommend this to anyone looking to stay in the heart of Chicago! Just minutes away from the BEAN! 💛
Great location, very clean and perfect for what we needed. I will definitely be back!
This home was beautiful and just as pictured! Communication was great with the hosts as our plans changed unexpectedly. Will definitely stay here again and recommend this place to others!

The accommodations were lovely. Our host was very responsive every time I reached out. There was plenty of space for me, my two kids, and our extra large dog. Location was great – very easy to get to the University and to an awesome coffee café!

This was my second time booking here. Its a nice and affordable place with nearby grocery store and cafes.
All essentials were provided and super clean!

My husband and I had a great stay in the studio. Parking on the street was a bit challenging due to the residential area and limited availability, but we were able to find overnight parking and did not have any issues. Be sure to read the street signs carefully for parking rules. Overall, it was a wonderful stay! Perfectly sized for a couple or a single person. The studio is located on the top floor, just in case anyone is wondering. (:

Booked for an extended stay, with reluctance since I’m not at all an Airbnb-type. Zero interest in sharing spaces with strangers in their questionably maintained properties but decided I’d try this after spending far more on hotels while waiting out never-ending construction delays.
Only noise I ever heard came from the traffic outside, otherwise just the faint noise of the housekeeper’s vacuum in the hallways a couple times a week. I forget her name but she was lovely and helpful, same as the management (whether contacted through Airbnb or directly) they responded immediately.
There’s a convenience store and a couple restaurants right across the street. There’s a police station a few blocks away, as well, which meant their presence was noticeable (in passing) and presumably helped me from seeing or encountering anything concerning in my short walks to/from the store or my car.
Overall, it was an unexpectedly pleasant and easy place I’m glad I found.
We enjoyed our stay at Marc's place.  The house had everything we needed and was perfectly located.
La Maison Verte is a beautiful apartment---the decor is super cool and facilities are excellent. The location is fantastic too. We'd certainly keep this high on our list for a future stay.
Nice and clean

Maybe one of the nicest airbnbs I've stayed in! Hosts were extremely responsive, kind, and easy to communicate with. Beds were comfortable. You can hear the train (there are ear plugs in every room) but as someone who lives in a city this wasn't a problem for myself or my friend.
Will stay here again when in Chicago.
Hector’s place was nice and clean. It was perfect for our family of 5. He checked on us frequently to see if we need anything. Great place n host!
We enjoyed our stay
Lovely and cozy place in a great neighborhood. Steps from 606. Ami was very responsive and helpful - excellent local recommendations. Highly recommend.

The space was very clean, well maintained, and clearly cared for. The location was convenient to get around and close to everything we needed. The beds were comfortable.
One thing to be aware of is that this is a basement unit. Because of that, you can hear some noise from upstairs, including footsteps and conversations. The upstairs tenant or owner also has dogs that tend to bark for extended periods during the day. One night in particular it sounded like someone was walking around in heels or boots for about five minutes straight, and it was pretty unpleasant. That said, everything was mostly quiet during the stated quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM.
Overall, it is a good option if you are looking for a clean, cozy place in a good location and do not mind some noise.
Great stay
Great for visiting students
Valisime selle koha hea tagasiside põhjal ja ei pidanud pettuma. Rahulik piirkond, samas linnale lähedal.

Great location and was close to the Red Line. Lots of good food within a quick walk. Good location to take a break from the city. Extremely quiet and we barely heard the upstairs neighbor. Parking was nearby with SpotHero.

Overall this is a great place to stay. There are a few things I’ll mention-
1. It’s an old building which means water pressure and hot water can be touchy.
2. No elevator. I’m sure it’s in the listing and I missed it.
3. We traveled as a family with two elementary school aged kids. We book airbnbs so we can be quick in the morning with breakfast. Although the kitchen had the basics, there were a few items I’d bring with if you plan to cook there- mixing bowl, foil/parchment paper, oil spray. Don’t assume the basics you need are there.
This place was clean and we found it to be quiet even in the heart of the city. White noise machines are provided. Limited outlets in the bedrooms (again, older building).
Target and Trader Joe’s down the street. 7-11 across the street. About a 20 min walk to the red line and 15 to the zoo. Beautiful neighborhood just off of Clark.

We stayed for a week for family vacation. The place was a quick drive to lots of things to do. We had difficulty getting in the gate and the host was very responsive despite our very late check in time.
Would definitely stay here again if traveling to the Chicago area.

Good location, plenty of space for a small family, lots of transit options to easily get wherever you want to go in the city. Instructions to get in/out were clear and Ericka communicated well through the process. Would be happy to stay again, very good value.
The apartment is absolutely wonderful. The apartment is extremely clean. If there were more than five stars, I would definitely give it more.
such a charming place! Anna was extremely accommodating with an early check in, and her place is such a comfortable stay! would highly recommend staying here!
Great location! Everything you need. We needed to check in early - great responsiveness and flexibility
absolutely enjoyed our stay here. kitty was an amazing host and has a beautiful home. we felt right at home and is located in a very walkable neighborhood!
This is was an incredible stay! Absolutely peaceful and comfortable. I felt completely at home :)
Very helpful managing packages . This is a student building but very calm and quiet. Laundry Room in the same floor, need to download an app to use the appliances.

My family and I loved it here! Great location (a block away from restaurants, but quiet!) and a very unique and beautiful building. The apartment itself was very clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed. Nicole and Matt were lovely hosts and always quick to respond. Thank you for the wonderful stay!

Our family had a great long weekend at Sean’s home! The sleeping arrangements were perfect for kids and the lower level being on the ground floor eliminated any concerns about their volume while playing. In fact, we reached out before booking and Sean was quick to let us know that this space was a great fit for our 8 and 9 year olds.
Parking was seamless - very easy to access the back gated section and street parking felt safe and accessible. I was actually able to park right out front all weekend!
The home was clean and kitchen well stocked with utensils and dishes, linens were comfy, we had all the extra pillows and blankets we needed, and it really did feel like home!
We went to West Town Bakery several times during our stay and highly recommend! Damen Tavern is a fun dive bar around the corner and you have to visit Sprout Home and Paperish while you’re there!
Thank you for everything, Sean and Raquel!

Great "home" base to explore Logan Square and other parts of Chicago. Quiet residential street but easy walk to restaurants and shops. Elisabeth's place is our go-to place to stay when it's available.

Joseph was a great host, he responded timely. This place is really nice. The location is very convenient, just a 20 minutes train ride to downtown using the green line. Overall we had a great stay, I would highly recommend this house.

Our family recently had the most beautiful and memorable stay in Logan Square Park, and it truly exceeded all of our expectations.
The home was incredibly comfortable and thoughtfully arranged.
One of the highlights of our trip was how conveniently located everything was. We were able to visit several fun and engaging attractions.
This stay created memories we will cherish for years to come. I would wholeheartedly recommend this home to any family looking for comfort, convenience, and a warm, inviting place to stay while exploring the area.
With gratitude,
Elthea

cute place with basic essentials. close to downtown and lots of options for public transportation or uber/lyft. parking not included but found decent options with spot hero across the street and right next to the building. not much sound insulation as you can hear every step people take above you. older teenager (17) felt like the bunk bed was going to fall apart on her.
Amazing host and the house was excellent! I would recommend this Airbnb. And would love to come back.
Great host, very responsive and very helpful. Very friendly too!
The space was as described and just what my son and I needed as a homebase while exploring Old Town and surrounding neighborhoods.
Really great place and Ben was super helpful. Would stay there again!
the home felt welcoming clean and tidy private and quiet i would definitely book again

We loved our stay here! We kept discovering little things that made us say “they thought of everything!” The space was clean & large, the kitchen was fully stocked, the furniture was comfortable, the fireplace and bidet in one of the bathrooms were nice extra touches, and the fact that there’s a garage parking space added so much to our ease of coming & going. We loved our stay!
Fantastic location and lots of great living space! I would definitely stay here again.
Absolutely beautiful and charming house. So comfortable. A joy to stay in. We will be back! Thank you!
This place always a great spot
Great Stay! Iris was an amazing host and the Apartment was exactly as pictured. not a far walk to a near by CTA station and was conveniently placed between a shopping area and several food options.
Nice area, very clean space!
Milan was very responsive and great. He helped us for an early check in and made out travel seamless.
Jamie’s place is perfect for a quick stay in Chicago! Lots of available street parking and close to restaurants and bars. It was everything we needed. 10/10!
This was a nice place in a very convenient location. I would highly recommend it.
very easy access. loved codes instead of keys or cards, tidy and spacious. Great price. would stay again

Our stay in this wonderfully located apartment went smoothly. The hosts were quick to respond to my questions. I felt very safe here. The living room is spacious. There are a lot of stairs to get to the apartment , but honestly, we got pretty
Place was exactly what I needed.

Loved the location for my purpose. Very close to where my son lives. Close to 2 mayor bus lines, very walkable to the Grocery Stores. The apartment is above a Restaurant and that can be lively until 10:30PM. There are also about 16 stairs that need to be climbed to the Apartment door. I was able to do that, but it needs to be mentioned. Appliances were great and everything you need in the kitchen. No Washer, so that could be a problem for longer stays. I enjoyed staying there and for 3-4 people very comfortable.

Overall, the space was beautiful, clean, and well kept. The private sleeping quarters were somewhat unfinished.
All that said, it’s a great location. Just a walk away from everything .
This is a great Airbnb, the parking slips are a great plus and it’s a super cute space.

El alojamiento fue excelente, buena zona. The place was as pictured everything was spotless. It was a great space to gather with family. It was very easy to get everywhere. Chicago. Transportation is amazing.

The place was cozy with an adorable eclectic-ish vibe. Nicky was responsive when I had questions, and the neighborhood was fairly quiet. The parking is on street, (the street is not too busy,) and the check in was easy peasy! Would stay again.

Comfy and private. My host was attentive and responded quickly, ensuring my stay was taken care of. The surrounding area was walkable. Parking can be tough at times, though it can be found. Overall, I’m happy I stayed here and felt taken care of.

Small studio apartment in Hyde Park! Was in a good location and easy to find. It felt priced a little higher than it was worth- very bare bones, smelled strongly of cleaner. Serviceable kitchen, coffee and coffee maker provided.

Really enjoyed my stay here! A friend and I stayed for 4 nights and were very comfortable. It's a cozy place with lovely soft lighting. We had a great stay!  The location was perfect for our visit to see the Cubs and explore Chicago! Very close to public transportation and the parking spot was incredibly helpful. Even better than advertised. Spent three nights in this awesome apartment. Everything was perfect great location. We love this place and would go back in a second.

Our stay at the apartment was wonderful. It was a great location - we walked everywhere over the course of three days. Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly like the photos. The host was friendly and helpful. Would definitely book again!

We stayed in Chicago for two nights to catch some baseball games and the location could not be better! Only a 3-5 minute walk to Wrigley with lots to do and many places to eat. Super comfortable apartment with all the amenities you'll never need. Adam was very responsive to all our needs!

We had a great stay! Was perfect for short uber rides to the city centre! We were worried about safety but it was not an issue at all! We were right beside the United centre which was amazing for our short trip over for a NBA game. Airbnb was ideal for our stay!

We had an amazing time staying here on our quick grip to Chicago for Spring Break. Super walkable to Wrigley for a Cubs game & so many places to easily walk to! Great spot to stay when visiting downtown.  Clean, comfy, and in a perfect location. Highly recommend!

Solid location, great penthouse space, hosts who were super responsive and helpful...  made our trip as easy as we've ever had.  Next time we're headed back to Chicago you can bet I'll be booking here again!

Absolutely an amazing stay the fact that I was accommodated at a last minute decision to try and stay. There was very genuine made sure he answered any questions answered very quickly in sufficiently will definitely stay again.

loved our stay, nice place but area is a ways from downtown and was my only downside but everything went well and opeyemi was very attentive

Good location close to museum campus, parks, and public transit. Very clean and a great view as well. A true gem in Chicago. This place has everything you could need. It's spacious, clean, modern, and has everything we need for our family. It is closer to both downtown and the suburbs. Cyndi’s place was great for our family of three (2 adults and one toddler) who stayed for 5 days.

The location and the views from the unit were amazing! Although the weather was a bit stormy, the floor to ceiling windows still made it a beautiful view. Spacious and clean. Would love to stay again!

Great location! Responsive host. Would stay again. Thanks for a great stay!

Joan was very responsive and the Airbnb was so unique!!

Great unit, highly recommend! Andre was very responsive.

Great place and a great location. Milan was so responsive and kind!

There were lots of great restaurants and a grocery store within walking distance which was nice and the area felt safe to walk around.

Really great location. Enjoyed the view and amenities. Easy to get around. CTA and buses close by. Only issue we had was broken dishwasher which was annoying as I was traveling with kids so lots of dishes and the key fob fell down the elevator shaft (which happens all the time according to the building as you need to use the fob in the elevator and it’s small and slippy). Despite replacing it for cost of $75. Cloud 9 wanted to change $200. Even though building will return lost fob to them when elevator is checked later this month. Felt unreasonable and greedy to me. Also before they will accept your stay cloud 9 ask for your ID and credit card info and place a hold of a $1000. Air bnb told me that this was not allowed in their agreement with hosts and all payments etc should go through air bnb. Just passing this on.

This place was perfect!! We came here for 4 days, for my kids spring break & they loved it! The kitchen had every single thing you needed, from pots & pans to seasoning. The bathrooms had stuff for females when it’s that time of the month. The beds was so comfortable. It’s a fire pit outside, also! We used it to make s’mores! It’s games outside & inside. The house is mins away from downtown, so it took like 10-15 mins to get to the places we needed. Only downside was there was only tv’s in the living room & master room, so make sure you bring a laptop or tablet for entertainment for the other rooms.
Amazing stay, highly recommend it! Communication was clear and the BNB was clean. Nice quiet neighborhood as well.
Super airy and bright (even in the rain). The high ceilings add so much space. A family of 5 felt super comfy. Great area, great space, great host.

The location was great and the upstairs outdoor space was a fantastic end of day break. Easy to get around the area and not that far to walk over to magnificent mile, etc. The rooms were a good size and there was plenty of paper products to get our group of 8 through our stay (no starter sets thankfully).
The bunk beds were wobbly and worriesome to have anyone on which led to those not being used. There was not enough seating for the dinner table or to lounge in the living room for 8 people, so I can’t imagine if someone was at capacity with 11 guests. There were some broken items and the furniture seemed cheap (shaky table and chairs, wobbly sofa and coffee table, etc). I reached out to Assel upon seeing things and he was very responsive and willing to send maintenance over to address issues immediately but we did not want anyone coming in while we were in and out exploring the city. The price point was great, but I think more sturdy furniture is needed to make it feel like home.

The place was nice and clean , the floors are kind of slippery and the private parking wasn’t what we expected . We were not expecting to walk even though it wasn’t a far walk. The water did get cold sometimes while we were showering .

We loved our stay here! The apartment was perfect for two people. It was full of everything we needed! The neighborhood is walkable and lots to do!
Demitri is very quick to respond to requests, thorough, and clear. I would highly recommend this Airbnb!

Wonderful place to stay in Chicago. Floor to ceiling windows with GREAT views of the city. Rooftop area is beautiful. Pool for the kids was a hit. Target is a two minute walk - super convenient for grabbing groceries. The building itself feels upscale and had a ton of amenities.
Rent this place, you won’t regret it.

We had a wonderful extended stay at Casey’s charming Logan Square walk-up. Casey was incredibly responsive, thoughtful, and welcoming from the very beginning, making us feel right at home during a special and sometimes stressful time for our family.
The unit is bright, clean, comfortable, and perfectly located with free parking — ideal for our two dogs, Buddy and Sandy. The backyard was a fantastic bonus, and Casey went above and beyond with dog-safe salt, shovels, winter tips, and bootie recommendations that worked great.
Casey and Peter were exceptional hosts, offering thoughtful touches like a car window scraper, extra blankets and air mattresses, vet recommendations, and even offering to let the dogs out. We extended our stay multiple times through April 2, 2026, and never regretted it.
If you want a comfy rental in a great neighborhood with outstanding hosts, book this one. Thank you, Casey — you made our stay truly memorable!
Highly recommended. 5 stars across the board.

We will definitely be back! We are a family with 4 kids ages 10-1 month. Everyone had their own space and could relax. Great building with a nice lobby. Fantastic neighborhood! We felt super safe the whole time. Milan was quick to respond and helpful with a packnplay for the baby. This spot is perfect for anyone who loves the city vibe but wants the safety of a neighborhood.
Great place

We really loved Vinithra’s place. The apartment included everything we needed and even more. The apartment is beautiful, very well equipped kitchen, very comfy bed, and lot of storage space. A very calm neighborhood.
Vinithra was always super responsive and helped us a lot throughout our stay. This was our first time in Chicago, and I cant stress enough how much we liked this place and how welcome we felt by Vinithra.
Place was perfect, so close to the metro station easy to get around. Would def come back.

Parroting what others have said in reviews…
Decent location. Close to uptown. Walkable to restaurants and the red line.
Its decent value for a single traveler looking for a place to crash when not exploring the city.
Bed was reasonably comfortable too.
Both apartment space and the gym are very small. Box like.
But I guess thats the big city for you.
Place gets less stars tho from me because I cant give a place 5 stars when it posts pristine photos & then once inside, the place is completely different looking from photos.
Also, there is no filtered water option. Nothing from the fridge or a water pitcher with a filter. Forced to drink from the tap sink or buy bottled water.
I brought this up to the host when she asked if I needed anything, but she never responded.
Good location and clean space. Clear instructions on getting access to the property. Would stay here again

Was as a described, just wasn't 100 percent ready for a longer than 3-4 day stay.  We had to restock on bathroom toiletries and bring kitchen items that we needed to fully use the kitchen.  Yard was great!

Cute, cozy room with a very comfortable bed! Great location in residential area close to the Fulton Market. Parking was very easy and free!! Own private entry and pretty quiet area. There is a train close by but the noise wasn’t that bad. Jaimie was a great host and responded quickly if I had a question. Would stay here again!

We had a wonderful time at Margret's home! Every little detail was so thoughtful - it felt like we were staying at the home of a friend who had taken care of everything. She was very responsive and helpful - we would absolutely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay at Heather’s place! The location and neighborhood were perfect, and the apartment was spacious and exactly as described. The information booklet was very helpful, and the kitchen was well-equipped for everything we needed. We arrived a bit early and Heather allowed us to drop our luggage which was super helpful. We did run into a minor Wi-Fi issue at the start, but Heather was incredibly responsive and resolved it immediately. There are a few minor maintenance items that need attention (like a dripping sink), but they didn't take away from our overall experience. We would definitely stay here again!
Loved our time here! Cihan was very responsive and kind. The area was perfect, right next to a bus line that connects with the rest of the city. Would come back!

Nice stay- few things tho- no pillow cases on pillows and 3 bath towels for 10 guest plus 2 little ones. Also-do not believe the security at desk about after hours parking- yep came out to move vehicle at 8 am (like sign said and security assured) and yep $300/later towed car. Over all fast response and decent stay that felt safe. Thank you for hosting
Great as always
Good sized apartment and comfortable beds. Enjoyable stay!

Thoroughly enjoyed my stay in Chicago, so much so I chose to stay an extra night. Unfortunately Milan’s place was already booked for the extra night, so had to find somewhere else (which was a definite downgrade).
Milan was very helpful throughout the stay
Great place. Hosts responded quickly always to communications
Fantastic property. Very comfortable, very clean and conveniently located. 10/10, would love to stay here again.
Very good location and easy to find the train and do lots of things around since transportation is close and very cute and good stores around .
We had a great time

Great location! Convenient to downtown, public transit, and way to hop on the freeway. Beds were comfortable and the place was stocked with everything you might need. Off street parking is a great amenity!

I had a wonderful stay at Patt’s place in Pilsen! The location is perfect. It is extremely close to the CTA station, which made getting around the city incredibly easy. The neighborhood itself is lovely, with plenty of great restaurants and bakeries nearby.
The room was very spacious, and having a washer and dryer inside the house was a huge plus. While the kitchen is a shared space, everyone was very respectful; my fellow guests kept everything tidy and clean. I even made some great friends with the other girls staying there! Patt is a friendly, communicative host who responds to messages quickly. Overall, a great experience!
Perfect location for visiting the lakefront museums and Michigan Ave/downtown without needing to drive. Communication about the apartment and the stay was always helpful and friendly.
Todo muy bien, cómodo, limpio y tranquilo
Location met all our needs. Cozy and quiet in a great quiet neighborhood.

I booked this spot while attending a journalism conference a block over at the Hilton. I later learned the building had some cool journalism history as the former offices of Ebony magazine.
It was a perfect location. Very easy to get to on public transit and I was able to walk to a game at Soldier Field nearby and the big Bean, and ran to the Chicago Riverwalk.
The gym was a wonderful amenity to have, as was the rooftop patio, and the host was great at communicating.
Very spacious and comfortable apartment. The kitchen had the necessary gadgets and dishware to cook and serve basic meals.
Ella es una gran anfitriona, siempre estaba pendiente de cualquier situación y presta a ayudar, un gran lugar y muy cómodo, gracias
Wonderful Host Very Helpful Very Kind & Respectful, very professional Very proactive, very helpful, very informative just a all around phenomenal host and person

This place looked exactly like the pictures!! Everything was right at your feet. Grocery shopping was next door, top rated dining was within walking distance, and shopping was only a few blocks away! James was the absolute best! He was very accommodating, easy to communicate with, and he gave clear instructions on how to care for his beautiful home and check out. This place was affordable and didn’t have the ridiculous deposit I saw on other listings. If you are on the fence and this home is available here is where you should be!
Clean, easy, great stay

If you are looking to explore Rogers Park neighborhood, you can’t ask for a better location!
If you’re looking for a cheap place to stay in Chicago, you are going to be thrilled by these accommodations!
If you’re looking for a responsive host, you will be so happy to chat with Demitri!

Wasn’t happy there was BED BUGS! We came from 5 hours away and were there for a few hours didn’t unpack anything we came back from dinner and sat on the bed and seen bed bugs crawling. I left immediately i will never be booking through them again i am digusted and it’s almost impossible to get rid of them. also the house smells like sewer when we first walked in and couch has crumbs and was dirty
Enjoyed this space, loved the patio, clean, good price
Great location, amenities, and very clean. Will definitely stay again!
Very clean, the host was wonderful and kind. Clear instructions on how to check in and check out. Beautiful home. Will definitely book again .
Great place, 100% recommended.

Hanna and Mark’s place was very nice. Great location, very clean, had what we needed. We were a little anxious going into the reservation as we got notified of house rules including quiet hours, and we have three little kids. But Hanna answered our questions quickly, and it all worked out. It is a quiet building, so if you have busy young kids, just something to keep in mind 😊 But the apartment was beautiful, and was a great distance from everything we wanted to do in Chicago. Our bigger kids loved the bunk beds, and the flexible sleeping options were helpful with our toddler. The views were lovely, and our youngest enjoyed watching the cars from the big windows and balcony. Thanks for a lovely stay!
