We had a wonderful stay at this high-rise apartment in River North! I traveled with my husband and our 7-year-old daughter, and it was a great fit for our family, with more than enough room. The balcony was definitely a highlight — the views were beautiful, especially in the evening.
We were within easy walking distance of so many restaurants and shops, which made exploring the area really convenient and fun.
Overall, we had a great experience and would happily stay here again!
we wanted to give our children the Chicago skyline experience and cloud 9 delivered!! loved it!!
Amazing location! Amazing property! Highly recommend.
Great location, beautiful home, responsive host! Close to shopping, restaurants and entertainment, this home was perfect for our family trip!

My family and I had a great stay. We had ages ranging from 2 years to 70+ and it had everything we needed. Everything was very clean, centrally located to lots of good restaurants, and in a quiet neighborhood. I’d definitely stay here again!

We had such a great stay here during our trip to Chicago. The location was perfect, close to everything we wanted to see and do, which made it easy to pack our days with activities without worrying about getting around. What we loved most was coming back to the condo after a busy day, it felt like a little oasis in the middle of the city. It was calm, comfortable, and exactly what we needed to relax and recharge. The space itself was beautifully done with a clean, modern aesthetic, and everything felt cared for. We also appreciated the use of clean products, which made the stay feel even more thoughtful and elevated. We would stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago. Thank you for a great experience!

Our family of five (4 adults + 1 teen) had a comfortable stay at this Chicago apartment over spring break.
Pros:
Convenient parking, which is a huge plus in the city. 2 of the 3 bedrooms offered great views. Beds were comfortable with plenty of closet space. The living room had ample seating for everyone to relax together. The location offered short walks to coffee shops, CVS & quick, casual dining options. The building amenities included nice spaces for a quick workout or relaxing, but also had an Artist room for sketching or painting, which was a unique touch. Although the indoor pool was closed, there were large hammocks that looked inviting.
Cons:
Repairs are needed in several areas. Portable AC units in the bedrooms were loud making it hard to hear TV. The HVAC system struggled to keep the apartment comfortable. The view in upstairs queen bedroom is of roof equip & ladders (which disappointed our teen). The unit is on the top floor (with 6+ others).

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The space was incredibly spacious and very clean, which made it perfect for our group to relax and feel comfortable.
The location really couldn’t be better. It’s just steps from the Brown Line, making it easy to get around the city, and right by the Southport shopping district with plenty of great restaurants and stores. It’s also less than a 15-minute walk to Wrigley Field, so there was always something fun to do nearby. The neighborhood felt safe and welcoming throughout our stay.
The hosts were also very responsive and easy to communicate with, which made everything smooth from check-in to check-out.
Overall, we had a fantastic experience and would absolutely recommend this place to others visiting Chicago.

Bob's place was a very clean, quite spacious and well presented place in a very handy part of Chicago. The kitchen was particularly well equipped compared to other properties. Decent bed, bedding and towels and adequate storage for longer stays.
The off-street allocated parking is a big bonus and you can access Andersonville, Edgewater, the lakeshore area and central Chicago easily.
Communication was great. Just the job!
Many thanks.

My Host Nicky Was Extremely Friendly and Made Me Feel Welcome Right From The Start. She Is Easy to Communicate With, Responsive & Genuinely Cares About Her Guests. The Moment i Arrived Everything Felt Welcoming, Clean & Prepared. The Space Was Exactly as Described & is Comfortable & Well Maintained. The Location was Also Very Convenient Making It Easy to Get Around and Enjoy the Surrounding Area. Overall it Was a Genuinely Pleasant and Stress-Free Experience.

Our stay was amazing. Everything was fantastic . For the people that need an elevator to get up this wouldn’t be for you because it’s only stairs but it’s only on the 2nd floor so it’s not bad.
Everything else amazing. Do wish there was a Tv in the master bedroom but yeah
If I’m in Chicago again I will book again !
Excellent Airbnb, I had a great stay!! I recommend it.
Vicky is a great host!! She was very helpful and responsive!
Nice cozy place!!! My family enjoyed & would definitely book again!

Location was great. Walking distance to Wrigley Field. There was an issue with the code for the door, but Josh was quick to respond and provided a solution.
All in all it was a great trip.

It was a great stay started with a little confusion with the time difference driving in from Michigan but Milan immediately responded with a solution that fit my family even better .  The place was clean and had everything we could need during our stay. Overall 10 out 10 experience
Always a great stay here.
Everything was beyond perfect, host has excellent communication, house was spotless, and it also has everything you need in it. I just totally recommend!
I love the place I booked. They respond very quickly the place was nice and clean all the rooms have TVs in them. I definitely will book with them again
Great responding, attentive host excellent place to stay in Chicago

We really enjoyed our stay! I had two young children with me and the space was great for families. The place was very clean and looked just like the photos. Tracee was a great host and made sure we had everything we needed and ensured we were comfortable! Parking was very convenient! There’s also lots of street parking.
Amazing stay, the apartment was near every restaurant and also was near great places to shop at. I highly recommend staying here if you’re coming to downtown
Great place to stay in the heart of Lincoln Park. Felt very safe and when I locked myself out, Doni came to the rescue. Darling cottage and perfect for a single or couple. Highly recommend!

My husband and I stayed here for just under six months and had an overall positive experience! The host was responsive, attentive, patient, and very understanding of our situation.
The location is great, with easy access to public transportation. It’s not too far from the Brown Line and Red Line, with a bus stop also being just a 2–3 minute walk away. All of which made getting around very convenient.
The neighborhood itself is quiet and comfortable, we loved to walk around, even at night with no issues.
In conclusion it was a good place to stay for an extended period while we got settled in our new city!
Great place to stay and very helpful host

Great views and location! All of the attractions we went to were a quick car ride away. Our kids loved the pool and basketball court! Having Target so close was very convenient. Stephanie was very responsive and helpful. We highly recommend staying here!
The apartment was very spacious and well appointed. Chris and Ana were the perfect hosts and thought of everything one might need in a home awy from home.
Great stay.
Thank you

From the first question I asked she was right there to answer. Let us drop off our luggage early so we didn’t have to carry it around for hours. Checked in on us with text to make sure we had everything we needed great host

The room was exactly as listed and matched the photos. Victor was pleasant and responsive. Because there are multiple rentals that share the main house, it also felt a bit like having flatmates back in college for a few days,  which was nice.
Excellent stay.

You could not ask for a better location. It was next to the Magnificent Mile and we were able to walk to Navy Pier and so many great restaurants around.
Even though the apartment was in such a prime location with restaurants all around the bedrooms were in the back and we could not hear anything when we went to sleep.
Great place, would stay here again.

Such a fabulous place to stay! Everything was just wonderful. The host responded to all of my questions so quickly. The condo seemed brand new - clean with very comfortable beds! The view was incredible - we could see from the Navy Pier all the way to Soldier Field. And the sunrise was worth while to be up early!
We traveled with our kids, and it was helpful that they had all the kitchen items we would need. The amenities alone were worth the stay. The kids were able to use the pool, the many game rooms, and the basketball court. I was able to use the gym, which was fully equipt and 2 levels.
I highly recommend!
Great location,nice and quiet neighborhood.

Unfortunately, our plane was delayed and we weren’t able to arrive until 4:30 am. But this place is close to Wrigley and great if you just need a bed and hot shower. There aren’t any extras, like coffee or Kleenex, but it has the basics and is convenient. We were able to get a later checkout for a fee.
Looking for an interim place to stay while I moved and it was a perfect space for just that. Comfortable homey and accessible

Freddys place is in a nice walkable area. It is hard to locate so i recommend getting there during the day. The house was clean and looks just like the pictures. Freddy was very responsive and accommodating during my travel delays
We had a great stay here! Very cozy living room for movie nights! Lots of stairs to get up to the place, but worth it. Thanks Brendan!
Great little basement pad to explore Chicago’s best neighborhoods!

The unit was really nice and in a walkable distance from the downtown area. There was a target directly down the street so it was easy for me to buy food and water for the week. Unit was just like the pictures and had a great view of downtown.
GREAT I FOUND THIS PLACE
Thank you for having us!
What a nice studio! And everything was so close on a walking distance! Would stay here again

If u drive a big suv, barely fits in garage get the street pass. Neighborhood seemed safe. House closets were very unorganized, the lamps in several of the spaces need updated. Overall, our stay was nice.  getting to our destinations wasn’t too bad. We tried the bus and the train station.
Great location and the perfect spot for us to stay with our 3 boys.

Tracee is AMAZING!! The best host I’ve ever had. The place was spotless and decorated beautifully. We had no issues whatsoever but she answered any questions I had. Very lovely stay would definitely book again
The house is beautiful and worth the price. It was in an excellent location and had plenty of amenities.
Perfect spot for 3 adults (each with own room).  Has only 2 chairs for eating which is a bit of a problem.
Highly recommend this place, the home owners were extremely responsive and respectful. The room was extremely clean, its roomy, and walkable from main attractions in the city.

Tony's place was perfect for catching a couple of games at Wrigley. It was cozy and comfy. Everything seemed fresh and new. Beds were comfy and cozy. Very walkable to Wrigley. Wrigley is literally your backyard. Instructions and communication go above and beyond!
Loved this place! The place was easy to find and so was the parking. I loved how it was close to the city and had lots of activities that were walking distance. I will definitely stay here again.

This listing was perfect for our family of 4. Parking was a breeze which is the hardest thing to find in the city. So close to the train which was very convenient. Beautiful part of the city and highly recommend this stay!

Amazing response time, good location, not far from everything perfect distance! Good for the price and perfect size! Easy to check in!
We enjoyed staying here while seeing tourist attractions in downtown Chicago with our family. The space is welcoming, clean, and beautifully decorated. Hosts are incredibly responsive.

To start, my boyfriend sliced his finger open on a screw sticking out of the front door. The door has an automated lock with some sort of tamper guard/security plate blocking part of the lock. The heads on the screws holding it in place are uneven and jagged.
The parking spot is in an alley, next to several dumpsters. Our car smelled like garbage after parking there overnight, and still smelled like garbage slightly a day after we left Chicago.

The brown couch had many strange, discolored/white-ish stains on it.

Final Verdict: Never again.

This was a great location and very quiet. Convenient and walkable to local attractions like Lincoln Park Zoo (free) and walking trails. Go in the other direction and you’ve got tons of food and drink options. Felt like home.

Second time staying at one of TIBO Venture’s units and they always create a lovely, clean, minimal space…still with all the necessities and well worth the reasonable price! The in-unit washer/dryer is very slow to dry but it was still convenient, and there are larger ones elsewhere in the building if needed. Make sure to pack your own detergent. The bed at this unit was especially comfortable :)

We had a great stay!  The two apartments on the same floor were perfect for our multi-generational family. The location can’t be beat - walkable to shopping, restaurants and the lake. Wendy and Matt were very responsive and helpful!

Milan was an incredibly responsive host. We had a little trouble finding the parking garage but thanks to Milan getting back to us right away the rest of the stay was a breeze. The place was as described. The space was clean and stocked with the described items. The entrance faces a bus  stop and the train line entrance is a 5 minute walk. It made the stay that much more convenient. We would stay again and are looking into booking again before summer!

I loved this BnB! It was adorable and perfect for us as a couple of gals visiting the city. The location was fantastic— far enough from downtown that I could sleep well, but close enough to easily catch public transportation or drive if needed. Luana was responsive, extremely kind, and very helpful throughout our stay. The parking space was a huge perk, and I would absolutely stay here every time I visit the city! 💜

Absolutely charming, charming home plus the inside was as entertaining as the outside!  The beds were great (three proper beds), kitchen and comfy living room and large dining table.  The area was very pleasant and felt very safe with lots of restaurants and a Trader Joe's and Whole Foods within walking distance.  We parked our rental in their garage for ease (although would definitely research buses if we go again because the parking in Chicago for events/museums was quite expensive).  The owners were very helpful and friendly and responded quickly to any questions we had.  Would definitely stay again if we are ever back in Chicago.   Many thanks!
Wonderful location! Very quiet, but still super close to the city. Beautiful home that i would definitely book again.

Was a good home base while I worked from the loop. Fairly basic but has all the amenities you need and is in a great spot with stores, markets, and restaurants nearby. Quiet, safe area. Easy transport to the loop nearby as well.
Excellent location. Comfortable, homey space. Dedicated parking spot is so convenient, and access to Wrigley Field and the surrounding area is 100% convenient and perfect.

Bella was a very friendly and responsive host. The location is super convenient and in a quiet part of Rogers Park. I only marked it down because the floors were dirty on arrival, some furniture had cigarette burns, the toilet wobbled when sitting on it, and the shower did not get warm/hot even though the sinks did. Bella was very good at communicating and answered my questions quickly and in a friendly manner. Altogether not a bad stay.

Mark was very communicative and checked in on us. We had about a twenty minute drive to downtown, where we spent our days (museums and miracle mile). The apartment was quiet at night, and the downstairs tenants were so kind. We loved meeting their very well behaved dog, Bowie.
Very comfortable stay good communication Great location !!
Very nice home in the middle of everything downtown Chicago. I will be staying here everytime I go!

The Greater Grand Crossing is a vibe! This spot is better than the pics. I stayed here for 5 nights with my husband and teenager. We were in town for a family wedding and also a city visit. This location was perfectly centered so that we could easily get both to family homes and downtown. It was very comfortable and with lots of thoughtful and homey touches. I would say that Charles is an excellent host and very responsive. He left us yummy snacks (my teenager was very appreciative of these), a selection of waters and plenty of coffee. The beds were comfortable and the closet/drawers space was plentiful. I would absolutely stay here again for my next visit to Chicago!

Lilian is an extraordinary host who has curated a space that is lovely, warm, comfortable & feels like home. Her eye for beauty, details & excellence makes this apartment the best we’ve stayed in! Lilian promptly helped when we needed it & showed kindness all along, going above & beyond as a host. We would stay with her again in a heartbeat. We cannot recommend her & her home highly enough!

Wonderful new building in a very traditional area. Close to everything! Walk to stores, restaurants and walking distance to the lake shore. The host was very responsive to all our requests and provided immediate assistance to any issues that we experienced! Highly recommended this condo!

My stay was good overall you honestly get what you pay for it was simple check in, good food spots in walking distance plus your close to downtown. Our host was responsive and helpful. Also wish it was a washing & dryer here we could use but it’s laundry mats near so i guess that helps. The cleaning lady is also great. Overall I would stay again nothing that was outrageous. :)
Martin was a great host and this was a great spot. The apartment had everything I needed and had everything I needed within walking distance. It was a nice neighborhood. Overall great experience!

We really enjoyed our stay! From check-in to check-out, everything was quick and smooth. The view…amazing! The location was close to everything we did in the city. The front desk staff was very helpful. Communication with the host was extremely fast. Parking on the street was hard to find so we opted to pay to park at the last minute which worked out great for us. We will definitely choose this pace again!
Great stay, thanks so much!
Great location near Logan square. Close to metro. The home was clean and quiet.
A great space in a busy, vibrant corner of the neighborhood, walkable to a lot of fun restaurants and pubs. Unit was great. Very cozy. The window air/heat combo in each room was fantastic.
Absolutely loved our stay! The house is very comfortable and beautiful. The neighborhood is quiet and lovely. I highly recommend!!

My daughter and I truly enjoyed having this lovely apartment as our home base during a few day's exploration of Humboldt Park, Wicker Park, and Logan Square.
Everything we needed was thoughtfully in reach and of great quality. What a wonderful bed in the main bedroom! I don't know when I've slept so well while travelling.
Excellent communication and clarity. We would love to have another chance to return.

We had a family group of six in the home. The three bedrooms are upstairs with comfortable beds and a ceiling fan in each bedroom.  The home had two full baths(one upstairs and one downstairs) and one half bath on the main floor.  There were plenty of big fluffy towels, shampoo, and a blow dryer for us.  The kitchen was fully stocked with dishes and all we needed. Robert was a good host with quick and clear communication. The home is in a safe area with parking at the curb right in front. We were able to get to downtown Chicago in about 20-30 minutes.  At the end of our sightseeing in busy downtown, it was wonderful to return to a quiet and comfortable home.  We hope to return to this home!
Everything was alright!
The stay was fantastic. Thank you!
The hosts were responsive but the people who live above the airbnb are noisy. You can hear them tromping around above the bedroom in the evening. Also, there's no TV in the airbnb.
Love it! Great place and great location

This was the perfect home base for exploring Chicago! The apartment was much more spacious than a typical hotel room, featuring a separate bedroom, a cozy living area, and a full kitchen which was a huge plus. We took the South Shore Line into Millennium Station and found the location to be unbeatable—so many great restaurants and activities were just a short walk away. For anything further out, catching a train or an Uber was incredibly easy. Our host was also fantastic—very communicative and provided thorough details that made check-in a breeze. Highly recommend for anyone looking to experience the city without having to worry about a vehicle or parking.

The location was perfect, and the rooms and amenities were exactly what we needed. The train is super close, which our young boys loved and worked well for traveling with young kids. There were ear plugs and noise machines provided if the sound was bothersome at night. Parking was super easy, and the location is easily walkable to great restaurants and parks. Definitely would stay here again.
April was an amazing host. She was always quick to answer any questions I had. The neighborhood was lovely and felt very safe.  I would definitely stay here again!
Had a great time taking my family to Chicago for the first time and Josh’s help made planning for it a whole lot easier! Would definitely come back!

We had 10 people and it slept all of us perfectly. The main room is so big, perfect for gathering! I wish there were more seating in the main room but overall extremely satisfied. Perfect location with so many restaurants/bars around!

Great location. Clean and spotless , felt comfortable and everything I needed was there . Beds comfortable and big. Shower pressure was nice and strong. Walkable area and no issues with finding parking . Would definitely stay at this place again ! 5 stars

I stayed here for a month and a half trying to get on my feet here in the city. Could not have picked a better place to do so. It’s in a great area close to everything you need and everyone I came across was so kind! The host was very accommodating and understand of my situation, I’m very grateful to have stayed here!

Really enjoyed my stay! The Airbnb was well cared for and felt very safe as there are many long term residents around. Parking on the street was nearly impossible, but the parking garage around the corner- about a block down was very helpful and safe to leave your car for a few days at $27 a day. My only suggestion would be to swap out the air conditioner filters since they were giving a little bit of a weird odor when the fan on the air unit was turned on.  But it wasn’t noticeable unless very close to it! Easy fix. Overall I really enjoyed my stay and would stay here again! Thanks!!

Great space! The location was fantastic if you’re bringing young children with you. Close to parks, public transit, and dining.
The L is incredibly close & you can hear the sound of the train, but it is not bothersome and did not wake our kiddos.
Parking spot fit a large SUV comfortably!
Very good short rental in the heart of Chicago downtown. Close to the Grand Park. Walkable to lots of places and public transportation. Definitely recommend to  everyone and will come back next time.
Great place!

My family and I needed a quite, clean and safe place to stay during our home renovation.  Freddy's listening was perfect for our needs. I recommend a stay with this company.  They treat they're guest very well.
I loved the place—very comfortable, beautiful, and peaceful. The photos are exactly as the place is in reality. I truly loved it and would definitely come back again.
Great place to stay short term or long term. Patt is responsive, caring, and a great person to have conversation with. Great amenities, clean space, and beautiful neighborhood.
Great place to stay!

This is a very nice and affordable place to stay in Chicago.  You can walk to the El or a bus in under 5 minutes, and to Loyola's Lakefront Campus in under 15 minutes.  There are many restaurants and stores within walking distance, as well.  Sara is a very responsive host, and provided us with personalized recommendations based on our interests.
Este lugar es muy tranquilo y privado. Ideal par personas que tienen problemas de sueño y les gusta estar en lugares limpios y libres de mascotas.
Highly recommend! Wish we could've stayed longer but we will definitely return.

This is a stunning apartment and was perfect for my family during my partner's long stay at Northwestern Hospital. The location is especially convenient if you need to spend time at Northwestern, and it's well positioned for business travel too. I highly recommend it if you're looking for extended-stay downtown lodging.
Amazing location! Amazing Value! We loved our stay here. Easily slept our family of 7 with 5 teenagers.
Milan’s place was great, and as advertised. The neighborhood is close to restaurants and a couple of markets. The space was clean and big enough to host our group of 8.
Amazing stay! Everything was clean and had great amenities.

Nous avons passé 3 nuits au logement et c’était vraiment fantastique.
L’appartement est très propre et décoré avec beaucoup de goût !
Le parking payant juste en face était très pratique (attention si vous payez le temps du séjour, veillez à prendre l’option in&out, si vous avez l’intention de sortir la voiture, sinon votre accès sera annulé).
L’appartement était très pratique et idéalement situé par rapport à tout ce que nous souhaitions visiter (millenium Park, les canaux, le loop, musée de l’art…).
Nous reviendrons avec plaisir.
Encore merci !
We had a great stay! Very much enjoyed the view and the amenities! Easy to get to many points in the city.

The place is exactly like the picture. I was surprised how cleaned the area was . Everything was good . Thomas is awesome when we came one of the bathroom couldn’t flush as soon as we notified Thomas he sent someone to fix the issue. We didn’t have to think about the parking because he provided us with the parking pass for each days. My family and I had such a wonderful time there .Thomas is a really good host and i will definitely come back to his place if I go again to chicago.
Beatiful, spotless apartment. Nice amenities. Modern. Great view! Very convenient to get in and out.

For $100 a night this stay wasn’t at all what me and my partner expected our Chicago get away to look like. Upon arrival the maintenance man had to help us inside of the building since we had to reserve our stay through a third party website that not only sent my confirmation and check in details to my spam, but none of the info was given through Airbnb communications… The room made me uneasy from the jump being greeted to scuffs on the walls, dust in the ceiling, and odd stains in the fridge… What really set me off was the difference in appearance! Unit had only Medium and Large sized towels we weren’t supplied any washcloths and there was no attendant or physical on site help in order to be accommodated at the front desk! The kicker was the double decker windows, the one next to the bed got stuck and locked in place while myself and my lady were out, we came back and tried to close it to no avail. Not only did we have to deal with outside noise but fight the shade inside… TERRIBLE
Everything was as advertised.  Worked well for me.

Overall our family of 4 had a great stay. The place was very clean and comfortable. We had some very minor issues with fixtures and Matt was very responsive and offered immediate help even though not needed. These issues did not have a negative impact on our stay. I am mentioning this as a positive because it was good to know that the owner was very responsive and wanted to help solve any concern I had. The neighborhood overall was quiet. We were able to park our vehicle there as well.
She’s constantly watching and listening which made us feel very uncomfortable. Was not allowed access to the backyard, and she has cockroaches. Wish I could post the pictures!
Great place. 👍

We had a lovely stay in Alex’s place! The apartment is tastefully decorated and the beds were comfy, making us feel right at home. We loved the neighbourhood with lots of great restaurants, shops and family friendly activities right on our doorstep. Alex was a responsive and helpful host when we had questions.
Host is kind, friendly, and responded quickly each time I reached out! Thanks

Recently just spent a few days in Chicago with 5 adults, and 5 children (ages 10-8months). We felt completely safe, the neighborhood was quiet and private. Plenty of space for the kids to play and private rooms for the babies to nap. Anytime I reached out to the host, I got a response almost immediately (maybe a couple minutes max). We had a lot of convenience stores nearby, and local restaurants within walking distance. Never had an issue finding a parking spot on the street either. 10/10 cleanliness, and service. Would definitely stay again!
This was a great stay. Its very peaceful older community, and not too far from things. I would definitely recommend this space.
Everything was good overall, but there were some stains on the chair, and one side of the bed frame was broken.
Thank you for sharing your home with us.

David is a lovely host with a great studio. The hot tub was wonderful after walking the city of Chicago all day. The place was clean and comfortable. The studio is within walking distance of the L train and that made it super nice.
I would come here again, if I needed a place to stay in Chicago. Thanks David!

Pros: Location close to a Latin grocery store and great coffee at Damn Fine on Armitage. Several parks nearby, including Palmer Square. The neighborhood is quiet, and we slept well. The double bed is firm and comfortable, and extra pillows and blankets are stored in the closet. The heating worked well with the cold weather. Plenty of bath towels were provided. The apartment was clean.
The walk from the Logan Square Metro is just under one mile: nice in good weather. The square has terrific shops, bistros, Library and a seasonal outdoor farmer's market.
Cons: Small amenities missing, such as tissues, face and hand towels, hooks, and working lamps: one bedroom lamp failed to work altogether, and several light bulbs were dead. We could not find the switch for the overhead fan lights. The Keurig coffee maker had one coffee pod. We found a pound of coffee beans with no grinder, and one tea bag. A kindness would be to say the furnishings are ecclectic: the cane is ripped on kitchen chairs.

We had a great stay! I was attending a conference in the area which was only a 10 minute walk away. I was a little nervous about sleep because the train is so close but with earplugs I was able to sleep just fine. The apartment was very clean and as described! Ashley was very responsive.
Spacious and beautiful apartment in a great part of Chicago. Super clean. The hosts are very nice. Would definitely stay again!
Excellent overall

Great accommodation, super clean, and comfortable beds and pillows. Perfect for 2-4 people max. kitchen living room combo was a great space for quality family time. Edgewater neighborhood was extremely walkable. Ethnic restaurants of all sorts all in walking distance. Loyola university campus area made my wife and feel like we were back in college again minus the frat parties. Felt very safe walking around at night with all the campus security. 5 out of 5. Will stay again

Apartment was fresh and clean, well appointed, with everything in good working order. Host provided clear details about getting inside. There is a dog who lives upstairs, so there were some scurrying sounds, but barking was rare. Nice dark curtains in the bedroom ensured a good night's sleep. Located in a friendly neighborhood where people say "hello" on the sidewalk. There was a nice sense of community with neighbors helping each other out. Felt safe walking alone during the day. Public transit and a well stocked grocery store both within walking distance. Stayed several days with a friend and we were very comfortable. Bedrooms are on opposite ends of the apartment, so we each had some privacy.
We had a great stay here! Very walkable area, and close to the Red Line. Many good food options nearby.
We had an easy, comfortable stay!

great place to stay. room T1 is great with a mini kitchen and private patio which was my favorite spot to catch some sun.
walkable neighborhood. Pete's supermarket and Costco few minutes away.
We had a great stay here.  Street parking was plentiful and Florin was immediately responsive when a quick question popped up.  Would happily stay here again.

This was a great stay for the cost! You do have to share one bathroom with sometimes more than 2 residents at a time but it was never a problem. Room was very heated well and AC units were also functional.

We had a great stay! Sourabh was very responsive and easy to communicate with, which made everything smooth from start to finish. The location was excellent—convenient and close to everything including the blue line. The house itself was very clean and well-maintained, and looked like listed pictures, making it a comfortable place to relax. I would definitely stay here again.

Great spot - clean and private, and the garage parking space was awesome. Nice size for our family of 4 (with two young ones). Lots of shops and restaurants within an easy walk and less than 10 minutes to the Damen station. Hosts were very helpful, clear, and communicative. Would definitely stay here again.

This is a nice place in a walkable neighborhood. Kitchen is well-equipped. Desk is good for working. Clean and quiet for the most part. There is a school across the street. Easy access to Jewel, CVS, restaurants.  Laundry in unit.  Very nice bathroom.  The listing should be updated.  Wes is not the host.  A property management company hosts and they were very responsive.  I recommend this apartment for short stays.
We had a fantastic stay - the most well-appointed and clean AirBnB we have stayed in.
Had a great stay here! Check-in and check-out were super easy, the host was very responsive and helpful, and the location couldn’t have been better. Would definitely stay here again.
My friends and I were staying here to explore Chicago, and Hanna ans Mark’s place was an amazing space to come back to after long, busy days.
Todo perfecto y cómodo, y la personas muy amable . De verdad muy agradable lugar.
We enjoyed our time in Chicago.  The house is spacious and decorated beautifully. Great place to stay if you’re traveling with multiple people.  I look forward to booking again in the future!
Great place and location.  If your coming in for a conference, highly recommend
Thanks!
Amazing and very responsive !
the airbnb was nice, and comfortable for 5 guests! we enjoyed our stay. Abia was very responsive, and kind.
facil de llegar, con buenas conexiones de metro y bus, muy amables, siempre pendientes de que necesitaba
Aarón es amable, creo que el espacio para guardar equipaje es algo pequeño pero creo que va acorde al precio que es muy bueno. La casa está muy bien implementada.

I chose this place because it is about a quarter mile from my sister's home. We will definitely stay there again. About the cost of the SpringHill Suites several miles away, but a much nicer place to stay! Veronika was friendly, and I don't think any message from me went two minutes without a reply. Highly recommended!!

THis is the second time I have stayed here for a trade show at McCormick Place. ITs a nice walk tothe center and there are many restaurants and a Starbucks along the way. Comfortable beds and great place overall. Two nice bathrooms and amenitites. A cool automated coffee machine in the lobby!
Very nice place for my family to spend Spring Break!!! Enjoy the Cubs game!!!! Walking Distance of Wrigley Stadium!!!

I’ve stayed at Joe’s place many times when I’ve come to Chicago for work and it’s always a great experience. Great location with easy parking and close to public transportation, clean and comfortable space, easy check in and check out, and Joe was very quick to respond and help when I had a small issue with the toilet not flushing. I’m sure I’ll be staying here again, and highly recommend Joe’s place to others!
Great option for anyone participating in a conference at the McCormick Place.    Stayed with 4 coworkers instead of hotel rooms.   Very comfortable and had everything we needed.
Worth for the money . I will be coming back if I needed again

Nice place, clean, and great location.
Beds are a bit firm so that wasn't the best but the overall experience was good.

The apartment was perfect. It was exactly as described and pictured. There were many excellent small touches that showed the host had prepared the apartment with attention to detail. All instructions were 100% accurate and easy to follow. The location is amazing in terms of being walkable and very close to bus and train. Communication was proactive and helpful. It was a superb experience. I would enthusiastically recommend.

It was better than staying in a hotel for the most part. Louis is very kind and a good communicator. The condo was clean, but not pristine. There is no cooling or airflow, so if it’s hot you are going to sweat. There are ceiling fans, but they are so loud it’s not worth it to turn them on. The beds are really comfortable and the bedding was like new.
Great location. Host great at communicating.

My family and I felt completely comfortable. The beds and pillows were AMAZING. We honestly felt right at home. I forgot to buy tea, not only did Robert's place have tea, but there was a kettle as well as a teapot . I was very impressed. Robert I'm truly grateful
Everything was great. Alejandro was a great host, and responded to all my messages in a very timely manner. The place is nice and clean, and we liked the location a lot too!

We wanted to take our kids to Chicago for spring break. We found this apartment to be easy walking (as described) to the train and fairly quiet (obvious city road noise but building was extremely quiet) We enjoyed that there was a table in the kitchen for food and a table in dinning room where we all could sit to eat. Host was responsive and helpful. Parking was easy and our car was safe (knew enough not to leave purses or electronics in view). We wanted to be up and seeing the city so we didn’t mind but the curtains are thin thin cotton and did not block any light and the towels and pillows were one per person which was a little thin for us. Over all I thought it was quiet, safe, clean, and an easy walk to the L. I would recommend this to friends and family.
ok stay 👍

Well furnished and designed space. Everything was great except for Internet if you require a lot of bandwidth during peak hours. A really great Airbnb that I would recommend for anyone looking for a nice quiet space.
The location is nice, some communication and complications with the host upon check out, but overall a good stay. Recommend taking very intensive before and after photos upon check in.

Alex was so great leading up the trip. Very understanding, helpful, and flexible. The house is just as pictured with plenty of space and comfortable beds. Location felt safe. 0.5 mi from Orange line, 0.9 mi from Red line. Would recommend and definitely stay here again.

This place was lovely and in a great location. Rogers Park is a lovely Chicago neighborhood which I really enjoyed staying in.
My one gripe about this stay was that it was advertised as being 'great for long term stays' which mine was - I was there for about three months, but it was NOT well equipped for long-term stays. Most of the amenities that should have been restocked between stays were not restocked, so I had to buy myself new trash bags, new laundry detergent, and new body wash since all of those things had not been restocked to be full before my stay.
I also didn't love that there was no way as far as I could tell to change the temperature of the space. I believe the thermostat was controlled in the lower unit, so I just had to live with the temperature set by the people below me. Which was mostly fine, but there were days when I was cold and also days when I was hot and I couldn't adjust the temperature myself.
All in all, a nice place.
The stay was amazing, great communication.
A nice place to stay when visiting Chicago! Host is very friendly!

Veronica was the perfect host, warm, inviting; she made me feel right at home. She was generous, encouraging me to serve myself in her kitchen. Her senior dog, Piper, is very well-behaved, a real gentleman. Her place is super clean and had everything that a guest could want. Her place is very well located, right near shops, a grocery store, and more. In sum, I very higly recommend her place. Muchas gracias, Veronica!
I stayed at this place for a month. This place was so clean, safe and cozy. Highly recommended! :)
Room was mot prepared

Wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others.

Great place to stay. Comfortable. Affordable. Within walking distance to Metro, cafes, convenience stores and places to eat.
The host was always responsive, within minutes.
Great place to stay! Easy to find just as he said. Looked exactly like the pictures. He even gave a list of things to do. I would recommend this place to anyone!
They hosted my church leadership team. We all fit very comfortably. Everyone enjoyed themselves.

Mary’s place is very nice and clean. The windows has sound insulation layer so I barley heard the noise from the street at night. It’s convenient for move around since the train is only 10 mins walking. Also the neighborhood is very quiet and safe to walk.
Great stay. Downstairs basement bedrooms needed a heater. Too cold in winter.
Great location

The location is fantastic, right in the heart of Gold Coast, close to shops and restaurants, and within walking distance of the lake.
While the building is a bit older, the apartment itself is very well maintained. The kitchen is on the smaller side, but perfectly functional for everyday cooking.
Jorge was incredibly responsive and resolved any minor issues within minutes. I would definitely stay here again!
Amazing space and location. Great communication.

Great price and conveniently located to all that Chicago has to offer! Jorge was accommodating and responsive. I would stay here again and would recommend it to anyone who doesn’t mind having roommates/shared living spaces.
This Airbnb was definitely worth staying at and it being 420 friendly was a plus too. I enjoyed my stay here and I definitely wouldn’t mind returning!!!

the house was nice I like the neighborhood but the jacuzzi outside could have been clean and set up,the lights outside need new bulbs only half of them work....overall I like it I'll book it again for a lesser price unless everything is up and going it just needs a few updates....My children loved it....
We had a great day. It felt like home and George was a great host.

Had a great stay at Nicole and Vince’s place- it’s beautifully clean, well-stocked, and felt right at home. It’s in a great location, lots of trails, restaurants, and easy to commute. Fast internet and work desk were super for working from home days. Thanks again for hosting us!

We took an extended weekend trip to Chicago with the grandkids and Demitri’s place was exactly what we needed.  The place is close to many restaurants and a short drive to the museums we planned to visit.  We also enjoyed a walk to a close-by park and to the lake with the kids.  It was a great place to stay.

I stayed at William's place for the month of March and was very pleased with the accomodations.  It is not luxurious, but very serviceable and a good value for the price.  The location is fabulous -within easy walking distance of a Whole Foods, lots of retail, restaurants, and public transportation (several busses stop almost at the front door and there is a red line stop almost across the street).  William is incredibly responsive.  The unit was very clean and nicely stocked with some of the basics (toilet paper, paper towels, laundry detergenet, etc.).  And for those who want to work while in Chicago, there is a nice set up of a desk and printer.  I would definitely stay here again.
Definitely the perfect place for a short solo stay. Close to bus routes and a train stop, with restaurants near by. A clean, no fuss, utilitarian space that gets the job done!

There are issues with the apartment as soon as we arrived. One bathroom sink was clogged, filled with dirty water a plunger and dirty gloves. We went 24 hours before someone came to fix it. The upstairs apartment had a very loud group that stomped and bounced late into the night, although when we asked Assal to address it, it did stop. Location was great and, granted the building was very old. There were other issues, like the strong, continuous smell of are gas and the downstairs bed was very wobbly.

This place was awsome! Though parking was a little difficult the area felt safe and nice to walk through. The room had a tad oder but honestly it wasn't bad. Close and drivable to the city and it was a very nice place to stay for a few nights while visiting! I would definitely visit again and recommend this place!
Nice place

10/10 Stay!! Free parking, affordable, and the host was not only friendly and flexible, but responded to messages very quickly. Everything was nice, easy to use, and comfortable. More than enough towels and toilet paper. Even had a pull out couch and the shower was really nice!:)
And the cherry on top was they happened to have an iron and ironing board which saved me in a pinch!! Highly recommend booking
I Will absolutely be staying here again :):)!!

We were visiting Loyola for admitted students day and Nikki's place couldn't have been more perfect! The unit was comfortable, clean, and spacious. We cooked most of our meals at home and this place had everything we needed. Just a short walk to the Loyola campus, Starbucks, Target, Insomnia Cookies, and the red line for easy access the city - the location was perfect! We took the red line to see a Cubs game and walk the Magnificent Mile while we were there. The included parking space was really nice to come home to after trips to the grocery store, and day trips to visit the University of Chicago, and the Chicago Botanic Gardens. Highly recommend this place!
Great place. Ideal for somebody wanting close to university of Chicago
Florin was an excellent host. The property was perfect for our group. Highly recommend and would ho back.

This is my second time staying at Meghan's place. It's very comfortable, clean, and has easy access to the bus and blue line to get to the airport. She is always available for any questions or requests. I hope to return soon.

We stayed a month there had a very pleasant stay. Clean place with the appliances you might need. Free of clutter and too much technology. Easy to get in and out and between a car, the blue line and walking, it’s a very easy location.
Özlem’s place was fantastic! The location was perfect, everything went smoothly during my stay. I'd definitely stay there again.
I stayed at Leah's place for almost 2 months. It was a very cozy spot. Her communication was prompt and the price I paid monthly was well worth this day. Highly recommend
As described. Very nice. Responsive and helpful host/s.
This was a nice apartment and spacious for the 3 of us.  Quiet neighbourhood with parking available in front of the house. We enjoyed the stay.
Great place, great neighborhood and great host.

I stayed here for about a month and the space itself was clean, private, well-equipped, and in a wonderful walkable neighborhood. There were a few minor things– a clogged kitchen sink, laundry left in the machines, a non-working fireplace, and parking being less straightforward (permits required) The more significant issues were a persistent weed smell noticeable on arrival and intermittently throughout, along with substantial noise from the upstairs unit. You could hear nearly every sound, furniture movement, barking dogs, and at times what sounded like children running and screaming, often very early in the morning, during working hours, and sometimes late into the night. Since I was working remotely, the noise was especially disruptive, and unfortunately it never meaningfully improved over the course of the stay. Communication was ok albeit delayed, and I appreciated the host’s efforts to make up for some issues, but overall the smell and noise significantly dampened the experience.
Loved this Airbnb! Excellent location! Beautiful, clean, comfortable & spacious! Would stay here again in a heartbeat

Victor's place was a great home base for our stay in Chicago. Close to many restaurants and the Red Line which made it easy for our college visits and sightseeing. Plenty of room for our family of four.
I would definitely plan on staying here whenever I travel back to Chicago. It was peaceful and the place felt so homey. She was an amazing host.
Just what we needed for a short time.

We needed a place to stay as a family of four while we had some construction done on our home. John’s place was absolutely perfect and had everything we needed to feel at home. Beds are super comfy, the house is very spacious, the kitchen is well-stocked, and it’s in a great location. John was so easy to communicate with and made sure we had everything we needed. We are so grateful we could stay in his space and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to stay in Chicago—especially if you have kids!
Instructions were partly wrong and host would only message, not call. very small space, okay for short stays. otherwise everything was good.

This airbnb is in a prime location in hyde park, only a 10 min walk to the lake, and a short distance from downtown. The home is fully equipped, clean and hosts were very responsive.
However, I think it is great for short term stays but overpriced for long term stays given the overall aging condition of the building, lack of central heating or air conditioning, and a few other items I raised with the host - but depends on your level of comfortability.
Brads place was a great home base for two first-time visitors. Easy to find, great access to restaurants, coffee shops, and buses and trains.

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago! The apartment was exactly as described—clean, modern, and very comfortable. The location was perfect, with easy access to downtown, restaurants, and public transportation. We especially loved how safe the neighborhood felt, even at night.
The host, Mando was very responsive and provided clear instructions for check-in, parking the car and local recommendations Everything from the amenities to the cleanliness exceeded our expectations.
Would definitely stay here again on our next trip to Chicago!

I’m sorry to leave a 2-star review. The location is convenient, and the apartment is new and well-equipped, which may suit short stays, but it was not ideal for a longer stay. The main issue was ongoing construction in the building. Our stay, from January through the end of March, was affected by construction for roughly half the duration. It began after mid-February and created noise as early as 7:15–7:30 AM, including weekends. We were not informed in advance. Although we were told it would follow business hours and finish within a few days, the work continued throughout our stay, often outside those hours, disrupting our rest. Noise from upstairs neighbors, especially on weekends, was also noticeable. Communication was inconsistent, and we did not receive the promised cleaning equipment or monthly cleaning service. We had a very nice stay at this Airbnb. It was just like the photos and a great value. Andersonville is a very cute neighborhood with lots to do. We greatly enjoyed our stay and would come back again.
I’ve stayed in the other listing before, and again I had an excellent stay. Great location, clean space, and super walkable to archer and the grocery store. Would stay here again!
Perfect stay for my work trip, will definitely book again whenever I’m in the area!

Highly recommend this  place for families visiting downtown Chicago! You feel extremely safe in the building, especially with having the parking lot garage in the same building. Beautiful views from the 17th floor! Would book again in the future

Excellent accommodation, great location, and very clean. Ikechi is a very kind and attentive person; he made sure we had everything we needed and help us every time I contacted him.   I stayed with my family and we felt safe all the time.
Great as always
Great location very clean. Only complaint is that the building is older and shows some wear.
Great stay! Just could hear the people in the upstairs apartment walking around.

I would start out by saying a basement is not a bugalo. You can't have pets yet there is dog poop in the backyard from the above people in the house. When coming down around the house it's not well lit, and when you turn to go under the stairs the light points out so you can't see the door code or the 2.5 stairs either.  You don't have control of the heat you have to message the host to turn it up/down. The outlets are exposed and when you plug in the space heater sparks fly. The couch is like plywood when you sit down be careful. The entrance to the bathroom is uneven and the door doesn't close properly, the ceiling is low. You can hear them walking around above you. Some things to consider for future guests are:
1) Accessibility - our family is fully able but if there were guests with mobility problems it would be a tough place to stay. The access to the unit is along side the house on a narrow sidewalk with tight turns, and the basement stairs and access to the apartment are steep and tight with multiple places to trip.
2) There is free street parking but it’s not reliable. Loading and unloading was a challenge (though there is an alley that might have made or simpler) and we often had to park a few blocks away.
3) it’s a basement apartment. There are some small egress type windows but there isn’t much in the way of natural light. It worked fine for our group since we were not there much during the day, but it can be a little chilly and damp. They did an excellent job with the space though!
We’d stay again!

On the positive side, the basement room was clean and tidy upon arrival, the sofas are genuinely comfortable, and the host is very responsive. The kitchen feels cluttered due to a buildup of expired items left by previous guests, and dishes left on the drying rack make the space feel slightly unkempt. The bathroom is functional but dated and in need of renovation. Similarly, the TV is an older model, though you can connect a laptop via HDMI.
