Would stay here again if back in the area!
We had an excellent time at Phill's place! A beautiful, quiet retreat that felt like home after long days at our event. I would definitely stay with Phill again!

This is a perfect spot for a solo traveler or a couple spending some time in Chicago. Straight west a couple miles from downtown. Very easy to get there or the United Center. Kimberlie stayed in contact and was very easy to reach if needed.

Great place!  The apartment had everything we needed and felt very clean and modern.  This place is perfect for families with kids (especially babies) with the provided Pack 'n Play, high chair, kids dishes, and more.  It would also work well for a group of friends, comfortably fitting up to 3 couples.  Nice walkable neighborhood too!

This place is great! If you are planning on attending an event at McCormick Place, it is perfectly walkable. It was exactly as the pictures show. I would have appreciated knowing that parking at the property costs extra because I had to move my vehicle daily. Other than that it’s fantastic and Adressa Stay is super helpful

Tosin’s place was amazing! It was so clean and beautiful. Everything was as advertised. He was very responsive and I had no issues whatsoever. I would definitely return and recommend! It’s a beautiful home located in a historically black neighborhood. The location was clean and quiet.
Great place to stay.. very nice view of the city.. everything was nice and clean..
Great spot if you’re going to the convention center! Lots of food options nearby, and the apartment had a great view
Very good friendly houst
Great experience! It was nice clean & big enough for my guest.
This was a great place to stay! Warm community, walkable, easy to get into, and a great host

This location was SO nice!!! The hosts are extremely kind and got back to me fast when I had questions! I would recommend this place to anyone looking for somewhere to stay in Chicago! We were so close to the convention center for our con that made travel to and from a breeze! Thank you again!!!!! :)

this flat was wonderful. nicely decorated, clean and comfortable. stay was so intentional with a hand written card and cookies and other necessities provided. communication was great and made for an easy and relaxing stay.

Great property and would
Definitely stay again
Loved everything about the place and the area! Just all the flights of stairs got really exhausting.
We had a great stay from check in to check out. The house met our expectations from the descriptions. Anthony was very responsive when we had questions and we never had any major problems.

We had a great stay. The directions for getting in were very clear. The neighborhood is great. There's a lot of restaurants and cafes within walking distance and it's very convenient for the Belmont el stop and the bus. Also an easy 15 minute walk to Wrigley Field. The apartment was clean and comfortable. It's an older building and a very typical Chicago apartment, exactly like the photos. Having a parking space was also very welcomed, so that we could come and go as we wished and not have to worry about finding parking at night. Communication with hosts was frequent and clear. All-in-all a great place and I'd definitely stay there again.
Had a great stay — will definitely be back!

Zhi Guang's place was perfect for solo travellers on a weekend trip- especially for those travelling in for a convention at McCormick Convention Center. It was so easy to find incredible food in the area.
The place itself corresponds to the pricing. Basic ammenities provided but overall cleanliness can be improved.
Zhi Guang is very responsive and will tend to any requests however :)
We had a great time staying here! Place was clean and had everything we needed for our trip!

Louis’ place reminded me of Rocky Balboas house in Philly!!! It was nostalgic and had great scenery. The house has “creeky”  wood floors which gave it a really neat atmosphere. The beds were great and Louis was quick to reply when we needed direction. We come to Chicago annually and will def stay again!!
Awesome location. So close to a cute downtown but felt more neighborhood vs urban. Well apportioned and very clean.

Hi  👋🏿 , I’m CeCe from the DC, Maryland, Northern Virginia area.  I extended my stay in Chicago so I booked last minute. And it was a reasonable price. I like the location it felt very safe. And not too far of a drive from downtown and the places I wanted to go . I walked to get coffee ☕️ in the mornings . And got Chinese food 🍱 for take the first night , I was there. I loved that the highway 🛣️ was accessible/ close to the Airbnb ! It made driving easier and faster without having to go through stop lights 🚦 and stop 🛑 signs all the time Lol. I loved that there is a washer and dryer in the Airbnb , because I hate having to wash 🧼 after a trip/ vacation. And I love that my clothes can be clean ! I like that there was a library 📚 right next door to the Airbnb. Overall I would book again ! 😊

Toy was extremely accommodating and responsive! I had to adjust my reservation last second and had no issues. The location is a short walk away from a lot of really nice restaurants. The room was comfortable and the bathroom pristine.
Great location with great amenities.
Great location and good communication from the owners.

The AirBnB is in a great, walkable location that was also near public transit. I didn’t make use of all amenities (like the kitchen, for example) due to being out of the apartment for most of the days I stayed here, but the room was well equipped, host was very responsive and helpful, and the overall stay was peaceful. Just be aware that there may or may not be another guest staying in the other room who you will be sharing the space with.
Very Nice Apartment in a good location. Easy directions to access apartment. Plan on bringing your own toilet paper and Dish Towels.
Excellent host, very responsive and friendly. Spot on description, second time we have stayed there. Off street parking spot in the city a big plus. Clean, quiet, great location.
Great place to stay! I wish all the rooms had TV's.

My husband and I loved our stay! Super convenient check in, and the whole place was spotless and neat and we felt right at home! We had no problems sharing a bathroom, and the other guests were quiet, respectful, and kept to themselves. Our bed was a bit stiff and uncomfortable, uncomfortable enough to be worth mentioning, but not enough to make me regret the stay entirely. 10/10 would recommend, host was super great at responding, and overall an amazing stay for the price!!
Loved this space!  And great location right on the brown line.

Airbnb is perfect. One of the cleanest AirBNB bathrooms I have had. The apartment is more more spacious than pictures. I felt safe in the neighborhood. Walked to local cafe in daytime with small kids and felt fine. Close drive to all attractions and designated parking spot! So clean!!!

The apartment was very well kept and exceptionally clean, which made for a comfortable and relaxing stay. The hosts were incredibly accommodating and always quick to respond to any questions or needs. The location was perfect just a short distance to downtown, making it easy to explore everything downtown.
Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely rebook in the future.

We got into town fairly late and struggled to open the lock box and enter the right code. That was more on our end though and the host was very responsive and gave clearer instructions and pictures. Place was clean and had seasoning to cook with. Knives where dull but only an issue becomes my brothers a chef and enjoys cooking. He sharpened the knives lol really our only complaint and it’s not even a complaint. Would absolutely book again in the future.
A nice, roomy place with a great kitchen. I also likes the decor, it was Chicago themed.
The stay was lovely! I would book again :)

The apartment was very spacious and comfortably accommodated our group. Overall, it worked well for everyone staying there.
However, there was a lingering smell of weed throughout our stay, and we did notice some loose tobacco on the rug upon arrival. Additionally, it’s a fourth-floor walk-up, which can be a bit challenging—especially after long days of walking around the city.
Aside from those points, the space itself was great for a group stay.
Bueno alojamiento y cerca del centro

We loved our stay at Carolyn’s! There was plenty of space that we did not feel on top of each other. The place is close to the Redline train station and not far from the city. Ubers usually costed us about $20 from the city. I would recommend staying here and would definitely go back.
Moudi was such a kind host! We absolutely loved the place and would like to come back next time we’re in Chicago. It was cozy and cool, such a good vibe. And Moudi had amazing recommendations!
A great little stay that was an easy drive to most places. Would recommend for a chill vacay
Easy check-in, great location. Walkable to lots of restaurants and shops. Fairly close to the Blue Line.

Beautiful apartment in an excellent location. We enjoyed our stay at this lovely place and it couldn’t have been in a better location with tons to do near by. The apartment is clean and looks exactly like the photos. We will definitely return on our future trips to Chicago.

We spent almost three weeks in this nice apartment to visit our daughter who is living in the Ukrainian Village. It was super clean and very quiet. Beds are excellent. All appliances are new and work perfectly. The bathroom is nice and convenient. We would come back without any hesitation!

Amazing experience, responsive hosts and the unit itself was even better in-person. The location is fantastic, access to public transportation, plenty of places to walk to including a parking space with easy in and out access. We would definitely stay here again just for the views alone.
Nice house and good location
Nos encantó ! Todo súper limpio, ordenado y acogedor, Sean en todo momento atento a nuestras necesidades un vecindario muy amigable ! Sin duda volveríamos a regresar . Gracias 🙏🏻
Batteries were missing from some remotes, could’ve also used pans for the oven as it is a nice kitchen that I would’ve liked to use! Otherwise, a nice comfortable stay near McCormick

Great location right by the highway and near different restaurants. The neighborhood is beautiful, quiet and family friendly. We felt safe at all times. The apartment looked just like the pictures and spacious. I would definitely book with Sylvia again.
The Airbnb was very beautiful and spacious. We only occupied 2 of the 4 bedrooms, but they were all very cute and the king bed was comfortable. The bathroom was nice and big.
Spacious, clean, and stylish place in a great location. Jaime was responsive and helpful when needed. I recommend it!

L'appartement proposé avec une belle vue sur le parc ne reflète pas la réalité . L'appartement est très sombre avec à l'arrière la vue sur une cour très sombre et coté rue face à l'immeuble d'en face tout proche .
L'appartement est très vieux et dans son jus au confort très précaire . Une quantité de prises et de rallonges électriques dans tous les sens .
Des couchages tous mous .
Un appartement ou l'on a pas envi de passer du temps .
Nous l'avions choisi car prés de chez notre fils mais aurions du aller à l'hôtel .
Un vrai travail de modernisation est nécessaire à minima .
Tout cela n'enlève rien à la disponibilité de notre hôte qui s'est toujours rendue disponible si nécessaire .
A very cozy apartment in Heart of Chicago. Really enjoyed my stay here and was clean with plenty amenities. Would love to stay again.
Super cute and homey with a great location!  Everything you could possible need is just a short walk away. What more could you ask for?? Would definitely stay again next time we’re in town!

Carlyn was a great host, extremely responsive. The home was exactly as advertised - had all the essentials covered. Very clean, very nice, etc. The street parking wasn't available as described but we were there during spring break so perhaps that is why; I circled the neighborhood for 30 min till something opened up a street over. The neighborhood is quite lovely! Sunday morning we heard a baby crying and a dog barking a few times from the floor below. Was quiet otherwise.
Would like to return again 😊
Such a lovely home. Joan was very responsive with any inquiry I had. The home was just as described. Enjoyed the stay very much.
This was an awesome experience.  Everything I need for my stay in Chicago.

We enjoyed our stay here. The apartment was perfect for us, the area feels safe. There’s plenty of restaurants both within walking distance and a short uber ride if you want to go to the Loop, we were close to McCormick Place, a 4 minute uber ride which is handy if you’re visiting for an event there. The apartment itself was clean and had everything we needed, it felt very comfortable.

Julian was a great host! His place was very clean, comfortable, and located in a safe area, which made our stay even more enjoyable. We did have a little trouble finding the apartment at first because Apple Maps wasn’t very accurate, but Julian responded quickly when we called and guided us without any issues. He made the check-in process smooth and stress-free. Overall, we had a great experience and would definitely stay here again!
Lots of bed space and fully stocked with anything you need! We arrived 30 min early and he let us in early, so we didn’t have to wait!
thank you for the stay! great place.

Nous remercions chaleureusement Mary pour sa disponibilité, sa réactivité et son accueil. Le logement était au delà de nos attentes, et parfait pour séjourner un mois à Chicago. Également près de l’arrêt de bus pour se rendre directement dans le centre ville. Nous pouvons que recommander à 100% ce logement pour un court ou long séjour. Encore merci mille fois à Mary pour sa bienveillance et son aide lorsque nous avions besoin !!! Nous gardons un merveilleux souvenir de notre séjour ici !☺️

Location was phenomenal, just blocks from commercial area and easy walking to magnificent mile! Booked a guys trip and enjoyed our stay. A couple things to be aware of with the house:
- not a traditional layout, more long and narrow
- older so some things you would expect (e.g., wood floors are a bit uneven, not a lot of wall plugs)
- 3 floors and stairs are slightly steeper
No issues for us and just letting people know since this may not work for everyone.
Thanks to Jackie who was very responsive and provided helpful information.
Stayed for about a month and they were really nice and the space was clean

Patricia's listing was a bit hard to find at first but after we found it, it was great! We had a parking spot, it was easy to get into the place, and it was really clean! It was a small space but had enough room for us! When we had issues with parking and the door code, Patricia was super quick and reliable about responding. Would definitely rent from her again! Highly recommend!
The place was relaxing and comfortable.  Lots of places to eat around town and close to downtown.
Todo fue perfecto buena comunicacion y buen alojamiento!
We had a great time! Everything was clean and it was a good area that was safe and accessible to a lot of locations.

Todo cue excelente, ya tengo este sitio fijado para mis viajes a Chicago, está en excelente zona, cerca de todo y lo más importante para mí es que contaba con parqueadero gratis, en otros sitios me querían cobrar hasta 75$/noche extra al hospedaje para dejar el carro allí.
Gracias 🙏🏻

The location is perfect! The host sent a lot of messages immediately after the booking and required pictures of ID which I was skeptical of but they eased off after a day or two in and everything worked out. Also, you're right next to the hospital so anticipate sirens. I set my phone to play white noise and that helped. The apartment is well appointed with coffee, nice shampoo, conditioner and body soap, and able comforts like blankets and linens. I'd stay again based on the value and location.
Very nice apartment close to the McCormick Place. Would recommend!

Great new AirBNB spot - very centrally located with the L just downstairs. Rooftop is amazing with a great view. Rooms are on the smaller side - not much space to walk around, but the trade off is you get a nice living area. Good for 2 people, would be harder to fit 4. All amenities worked well, stocked kitchen. Kitchen taps never got cold & the windows were not very noise proof were the only complaints.
awesome as always!! love this place!!

The place match tbr description. Felt safe.
Jim communicated well.
This was a great location for events at the United Center. The El is a block away, and it's easy to jump onto the interstate from here. Lots of space and some nice updates in the bathrooms.
House was clean and felt cozy. Host was friendly and responsive. The location was a bit on the shady side, but most nights were quiet. It was a good value.

It was clean and easy to access via subway/bus. Don’t expect what you see in the pictures, a lot of the furniture was different than what is listed, including the couch. I wish the couch they had was bigger, and that their living room could accommodate and actually be comfortable for the allowed amount of 9 guest. Our group of 5 still had a hard time spending time in the living room because the lack of seating. They did not have a first aid kit or tide pods as mentioned, but the host responded decent to the request and got it for us the next day. The place was also missing a remote for the TV, which also had to be delivered the next day. Other wise the place is clean, the air conditioning was loud, but nothing we couldn’t handle.
Amazing and comfortable place. Very clean and good location. Host was very helpful, proactive, and accommodating.

Estuvimos muy agusto en la estancia..Esta super bien equipada. La comunicación fue muy buena, siempre estuvieron atentos a todo lo que necesitabamos y nos respodian muy rápido.
La ubicación del lugar es muy buena porque la ruta de autobus conecta muy directo con el centro.
Lo recomendamos mucho. Gracias!
Couple minor kinks but did the job.

We loved our stay at Thomas'.  The location was perfect for our family weekend.  Walkable to everything you need as well as so close to the Blue Line.  We had a couple issues with the parking spot being taken, but Thomas was very responsive.  We will definitely be back!

This place was amazing and a definite visit again in the future. It was peaceful and quiet and close to everything we needed. Hosts were very proactive and responsive- did not have to reach out as everything was as they stated and well prepared and set up. Great hosts!!

Both Wes and Darius were incredible Hosts!
Very responsive, very helpful, very flexible and very informative - before, during, and even after our 3 night stay!
The information they provided was spot-on and made me feel well-prepared for my stay.
The home was clean and very much true to the description.
They even gave great suggestions on places to go (with a “star” next to the ones they recommended) when I explained who was on the trip.
I would definitely stay with them again.
Great stay!

Facility was well maintained and very clean! Has a large bathroom and shower (hard to find in Chicago). Peter was very responsive. Off street parking greatly appreciated especially on game days. We will be back and recommend to anyone looking near Wrigglyville
Beautiful home absolutely cozy, Carmen was an amazing host great communication. I would stay again absolutely!
Nice place

We had a great time and the location was amazing. Walking distance to many restaurants, coffee shops and bars (not to mention Second City). There were 7 of us and we were very comfortable in the unit (we rented the second and third floors).
This stay was excellent! The amenities were truly game changing and the space was clean and upgraded. I visited Chicago 2-3x a year and will be staying there again!

There are not enough characters in this box to write a review with full feedback. The apartment has been recently “flipped” and there are many small issues that detract from the overall enjoyment of the stay. Not enough hangars or tables to unpack a suitcase. Towel hooks or bars to dry towels after showers.
If you are coming for a convention, you’ll have to catch up with friends elsewhere as extra guests are not permitted to visit, not that any of the furniture in the apartment is very comfortable.
We had originally booked a larger apartment since we had a larger group coming, but when we cancelled we received no refund even though we booked with the same host with a smaller apartment. We spent more on Airbnb than a hotel. The building is a walkable distance to McCormick place, and there are plenty of other places within walkable distance too. We were grateful to have somewhere to stay for the weekend where we were all together.
The greatest cost ever! This location even has a hammam in the shower!
Great place to stay.
Very kind, great for kids & spacey.

The bnb was just a few steps from a grocery store. We found lots of great food there. There were also two restaurants that served amazing food — one Dominican and one Mexican — the mole sauce was perfect and the prices were fantastic. Since this bnb is situated on North Ave. it was easy to get downtown.
The bnb itself was charming and well-eqipped; if we had been so inclined we could have whipped up and amazing meal. As it was, we were always short on time to get to our destinations. The kitchen was spotless and the Keurig coffeemaker was a godsend. New range and refrigerator were very much appreciated, as well.
We walked around the neighborhood, as well, and felt safe. Underrated neighborhood, to be sure.
Thank you for providing this. It was a pleasure staying there.
This place was just like the photos. Very clean, cozy, and well put together. Would definitely book again.
Safe location, Marco is a great host.
Great place to stay all around! Good location near Wrigleyville.
Great place for multiple guests. Host was great and the house was great and clean.

It was our first experience with Airbnb and I couldn’t have picked a better host to stay with. Gloria is friendly, approachable, and made us feel very comfortable even though we had a pretty stressful business trip! Beautiful, clean, and stylish home, and a cutie patootie pup bouncing around the place. 🩷
This place looked definitely like the pictures.. loved every detail put into the place to be comfortable.. The host was magnificent with responding .. I will most definitely book this place again
Perfect location to access downtown Chicago.

It’s a nice stay! Parking is only hard depending on the times that you are looking for parking, similar to any neighborhood in a big city. If you are trying to park when everyone in the neighborhood has come back from work it will be hard but you can always find a spot on the Main Street. The host is very helpful, the apartment is nice! It’s in a neighborhood.

We had a nice stay at Rob's townhouse. It met all of my family's needs for a long weekend coming to see basketball games at the United Center. The townhouse was clean and spacious, the neighborhood was comfortable, and the parking was really nice to have.
Parking in the garage is ample for one car but very tight for two. (This was fully disclosed in advance.)
The reason I could not give it five stars is because it feels a bit worn and the building's layout is odd with no street-facing windows. I'm nitpicking because of the premium pricing.
Overall, the communication was excellent and the townhouse was great.
Lovely place, host is very accommodating. Next time I am in Chicago I’d love to stay again
5 Stars on all levels! I highly recommend.

Unit was as described and clean. Tara was responsive to provide parking passes even when listing indicated street did not require parking permit (it does). Mattress had usual indentation and Tara was responsive to acknowledge. Overall, a comfortable stay.
Had a great experience! Beautiful view!
No issues. Will Airbnb again.
Thank you! Wouldn’t have wanted to stay anywhere else! Communication was top tier! Wonderful neighborhood felt extremely safe and peaceful!
My stay was great. Jennifer was very helpful and very easy to communicate with. She was a great host!

The place was very clean and the beds were comfortable. Host was very responsive! Appreciated the garage parking option so we did not have to worry about street parking. Neighborhood felt safe. Great visit with the family!

This place was incredible! I loved staying here and would 100% stay here again for future conventions at McCormick Place. I enjoyed the view as well as how perfectly sized the Airbnb was. It was perfect for 1 person. Thank you so much!
Convenient location to convention center and spacious space.

Freddy was a VERY great host , responded within minutes due to us being scammed and helped out IMMEDIATELY !! I highly recommend Freddy’s place for a stay if your visiting chicago , very clean , very safe and simple rules to follow .. BOOK freddy for your stays !!

Condo is as described. Private 3 bd, 2 bath with great kitchen plenty of seating   Loved the option for parking in the garage - huge perk for me!  Walkable to drug store, bank and restaurants   Very convenient for highway access. Would stay again
Everything was great amazing home amazing stay🥹will book again!
had a great stay ! felt right at home very clean & nice definitely would book again !

The place was not as expected. Place had a small smell of gas that went away shortly after arrival. Window in bedroom was left unlocked & did not have a screen door. Smelled cigarette smoke the entire time from other people in building. Bedroom closet is very creepy to the point it made my gf a little uncomfortable. Furnace is really loud when starting up and it blows directly over the bed. You also have no control to thermostat in bedroom. Toilet stopped flushing shortly after check & had to manually flush everytime after. Shower is uncomfortably small. Sink does not drain well in bathroom. Would not recommend for longer stays.

Nate was so incredibly welcoming, accommodating, and communicative.  He made sure I had everything I needed for my stay and went above and beyond when I left my headphones.  He is a gracious host, and I will definitely stay at his Airbnb on my next trip to Chicago!
We had an incredible time and very much look forward to staying again in the future if this place is available for a game!!!

This is a no frills studio, but it was clean and had everything we needed. It is in a good location, walking distance from north Halsted and the train. I had issues connecting to the WiFi initially but hosts responded promptly and were eager to help me solve the problem.

The stay was great and if you are visiting Buena Park for specific reasons it’s a great spot. There are restaurants outside the immediate neighborhood but felt a little limited compared to other parts of the north side of Chicago.
That said, the apartment was clean, well-appointed, and fit for purpose.
The honest was very responsive and helpful. I can highly recommend.
goated

Very easy location to find. Free parking on the street was clutch for people that stayed in the AirBnb that were not from town. All of the linens, furniture, and kitchen supplies were clean and easily findable. I would recommend this Airbnb no matter the occasion.

Quiet residential street; we wanted to be as close to family nearby as possible, so it was the most convenient location for us. Super comfortable mattresses! Wifi was out all weekend and that was disappointing. Lora responded immediately but just suggested we try unplugging, which of course I did many times, but it never did work and likely needed a hard reset? (Which wipes passwords, etc. and I didn't want to do that and cause a bigger problem, so I gave up.) Also I respect not stocking paper towels as a rule, but there were no napkins whatsoever and Lora's answer was just that there are usually napkins in the pantry. Part of the appeal of Airbnb over a hotel is having a kitchen, but not easy to have a family meal with just two microfiber kitchen towels! Appreciated the Keurig with plenty of pods on hand.

Overall, the place was nice because it was new.  Access to the train to go downtown was great as well as to LCU which was the main reason for our visit.  Also, it was a bonus to have Whole Foods walking distance from the unit. The residents/neighbors were all also friendly. The gym, although small, was surprisingly great. Enough equipment to get the workout done.  The best part was how responsive the host was before and during the visit.  We felt the kitchen could have been adequately stocked with pots and pans and cleaning materials as well as having a workable coffee maker.  However, we will stay there again provided the unit we are assigned does not have these issues.
Great location and a perfect space for our friendship reunion. Josh communicated promptly with any questions we had. Thank you for sharing your home with us!

Our stay at this Airbnb was absolutely incredible from start to finish. The property itself was beautiful, clean, thoughtfully designed, and even better than the photos. Every detail felt intentional, and it truly created a relaxing and comfortable atmosphere for our trip.
What really made the experience stand out, though, were the hosts. They were so attentive, responsive, and genuinely caring throughout our entire stay. They went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and made us feel completely welcome. Their level of accommodation and hospitality made a huge difference and did not go unnoticed.
I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a seamless and enjoyable getaway. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience, and I will definitely be staying here again in the future!
Good stay, would recommend!
Wir waren sehr zufrieden!

This place was amazing!  The unit is a corner unit on the 24th floor. The views of the city are really outstanding and unique for an Airbnb. The building is top notch with plenty of co-working space and a great gym. Whole Foods is almost across the street which was very convenient. There is free street parking, and we were able to find spots easily, some right outside the front and at other times a block away. The unit was very clean and the beds were comfortable. We definitely would stay here again!
Second time here and we will definitely be back again!
Our second stay here - always  the first place I check for availability when we go to Chicago and we got lucky this time! This is a great space and lovely neighborhood. Thanks, Axel!
Really comfy spot with a kitchen and everything you need—easy check-in and great location!
Great place!

They were very helpful from telling us about parking where we were going to suggesting alternative transportation options.
I was injured and they helped bring things does the stairs when I could barely walk.
They were really friendly and I would definitely go back there again.
It was a perfect location for our weekend get away.  Everything was as pictured and we enjoyed our stay!
Great location
Rosa’s place was in a nice, quiet, and peaceful neighborhood. I felt right at home!
This place is Amazing…..great place, great location!

Sherry was a great host! She was very nice and extremely helpful. She responded quickly when we had questions and was very approachable. She made sure to check in to ensure that everything was going smoothly during our visit. The apartment was very spacious, clean, and comfortable. I would definitely recommend to anyone staying in the area.

1ヶ月間滞在させていただきました。立地はとても良く、部屋のトラブルを除けば快適に生活を送ることができました。
ただ、入居時に水漏れや掃除不足、シャワーヘッドの不具合などが散見された点は少し残念でした。連絡後のご対応には感謝しておりますが、事前に確認して気付ける問題かと思いますので、レンタル期間が始まる前に対処を済ませておいていただけるとより良かったです。
お世話になり、ありがとうございました。
Great place!

Brandy’s place looked just like the photos. Brandy was very nice and responded quickly. Check in instructions were very clear. Location was very good for the things we had planned for the weekend very close to all the places we were going. Plenty of space but the place just needs a good deep cleaning. We needed a later check out and Brandy allowed that which was very kind of her.
We had such an amazing stay. Everything was as described and we had no problem finding the place. Hanna and Mark were very responsive and sweet! I highly recommend this place!

I had a few discomforts with my stay. The bed only had a fitted sheet under the quilt (no flat sheet), so I could not tell if the quilt was washed or reused between guests. Additionally, my bath towel had someone else’s hair on it. There was a heater in the room, but it was difficult to control and I found it too hot when on and too cool when off. That being said, the photos are honest and the price fair. I ended up moving to a hotel for my second night because of the cleanliness and temperature discomfort.
Great place within walking distance to Wrigley and surrounding area. Great spot if catching a cubs game
Kristy’s place is awesome.  It’s in a great location with easy access to the Metra line.  They have 2 super friendly dogs that are a lot of fun. This was a great place to stay at for C2E2.

Convenient location in the heart of Chicago. Unit was clean and easy to access. Quick walk to the train to get all over town.

Super clean inside.  I loved the oversized beanbag!
Great location in the city and easily accessible. Great host who responded quickly. Ideal for large groups who want a common place to stay.

While this was larger than I needed as a solo traveler I took advantage of every rooms except 2nd br. The space and location were perfect for my 1st time in Chicago to unwind after the work week downtown. Logan Square had so much to offer. Great area if you like to thrift or vintage shops.
Close enough to walk to the train for a short trip downtown, the airport, and other neighborhoods.

Easy check in and out.

I would 100% recommend Katherine’s place! We really appreciated the flexible check in, cleanliness, amenities (espresso maker, curling iron, etc), and communication. It was even nicer than the pictures portrayed and the neighborhood was lovely.

Amazing find! Great renovated rooms and place. The place was so cozy and convenient, especially with parking included. They had all the essentials that we needed to make our stay truly comfortable and enjoyable.

The place was a wonderful stay! The only thing that we had issues with was finding parking, sometimes it would take 30-40 minutes driving around in circles finding parking. Amazing stay and super responsive and proactive host! We loved the place so much and had plenty of space for our young daughter to play. Would highly recommend and would stay anytime we’re in Chicago!
Absolutely Loved This Place , Looks Exactly like the pictures and it was more spacious than I thought . Would definitely stay here again !

The perfect place to stay for a weekend visit! Perfect location and very walkable. Ceasar was super friendly, communicative and took care of everything for us. Clean, up to date, exactly as pictured. Miriam was extremely communicative - especially when I had trouble with the lock box.

We were in Chicago for a family wedding weekend with our kids (8 adults in total) and this place was perfect! We will definitely rent again next time we’re in Chicago.

Great stay at Brett’s place! He was incredibly responsive and went out of his way to accommodate our needs. The house was spotless and the location made it easy to commute to various parts of the city. Highly recommended
Great place for a Cubs weekend.  Everything was walkable and accessible.  Perfect for larger groups.
Great place!!

The Air BNB was amazing!

This is a great space to be in near the Wrigleyville area! It feels like a small little neighborhood and just a few blocks away all of the activities you can imagine! It was actually the second time staying there for one of our party. Thanks for helping us have a great weekend for Cubs opening day and our annual fantasy baseball trip amongst friends!

Great location! Walkable to Wrigley and the waterfront. The apartment was even more spacious than expected. The only downside was sharing one bathroom. Otherwise it was the perfect spot. Would definitely stay here again and would highly recommend. Our host Terry was awesome.

Kody did a great job with communicating, we had a small hiccup when we got there and were dumb and couldn’t figure out how to use the codes he provided us so I sent him a quick message and he responded in less than a minute, the place was clean and very peaceful. Everything I needed was provided and the host was very responsive in addressing some minor issues when I arrived. Overall would definitely recommend!

Solid stay.
I slept in my clothes though both nights.

Also, just throw away stained towels and bedding, why are we keeping those?

Mixed feelings—you get what you pay for given the low price. Carla and her husband are incredibly kind, responsive, and have clearly put thought into the space. That said, it felt just okay overall. The futon is very uncomfortable (deep pits) and the bed is awkwardly positioned so pillows ALWAYS fall off. The bedroom is extremely dark due to boarded windows, and noise from upstairs is noticeable. The main issue is the bathroom: mildew in the grout, an uneven, constantly wet shower floor, a loose toilet seat (suspiciously yellow under when we arrived), and peeling paint.
I didn’t raise these during my stay since they couldn’t be fixed then, and it still served its purpose. With upgrades or clearer listing details, this could be a 5-star stay.

Great apartment for our family. Layout was great and kitchen had everything to make dinner. We loved the neighborhood and it was within walking distance of Loyola. Some train noise, but we did not find it to be too loud or disruptive. It was great to have a designated parking spot too!
Very nice large place conveniently located next to a grocery store and walking distance to L.
The place was great, very comfy and the deck was so cute. So many things nearby to do and the bus stop was right around the corner which was a plus👍👍
Very nice home. Not to far from downtown and other tourists spots. It is very clean and the images fit the description of the home perfectly.
Easy check in, great view, and convenient location to our daughters apartment. Would definitely stay again the next time we visit her.

I’d plan on bringing a lot of your own things if you stay here. It’s a great location in the city, but we’ll probably find somewhere else next time we visit Chicago.
