The only down fall to this property is the parking there was nowhere to park. I had to circle the block most of the time to find a parking spot that was very inconvenient. Also it’s an apartment building so the neighbors up stairs had a baby that was constantly running across the floor and making loud noises that was also an inconvenience especially on the early morning side when your trying to sleep. Besides that I have no complaints.
The place was very clean and we were provided with all the essentials we could’ve needed. John was an excellent host who communicated effectively.

This is the perfect spot for a group attending an event at the United Center. You are literally just steps away. Parking was private/convenient. The beds were comfortable, kitchen & living room very spacious. If you really wanted to walk, there are a few things to do nearby, otherwise West Loop is just a short ride away.

This location was amazing and the place itself was perfect. Mera was so helpful. So many great shops and restaurants in the walkable vicinity, and a Red-Line stop nearby for any other areas you want to visit within the city.
The place was great, very clean and we had everything we needed. There were a few board games in the living area to play & I thought that was a nice touch. We had no issues and overall a great stay!
This was such an amazing stay! Very walkable area and cleanliness to the home!!
Amazing! Will be back!

The Airbnb is in a perfect location in Wrigley and felt super safe throughout our stay. The only issue we had was the heating, all of us woke up in the middle of the night sweating. Iris was super easy to communicate with though and she helped solve the issue.
Cosy space. The host was very helpful when I was checking in. It offers free water and drinks which was great as well. The neighborhood was quiet and I had no issues

Perfect location for students or interns intending to stay in Chicago for a medium to long duration. Well connected to bus system and not too far from the subway. There is also a large grocery store just around the corner.
Maria is an absolutely delightful host, is amazing for conversations, always ready to help, and a very kind person. I would come back anytime.
The rooms are regularly cleaned and fresh towels/sheets are always available. The house is shared with other tenants with whom I got along with well, but one just hast make sure to time ones cooking well :)
All in all an excellent experience!
Very Coxy & beautiful! Would stay again !
The place was clean and included what we needed for our short stay. all was as described.

Very clean and well-maintained place with comfortable beds and tasteful decor. The area was quiet, yet conveniently located near restaurants and public transportation. I had a great stay and would definitely come back.
Kim was a very responsive and friendly host. Apartment was very clean and it matched the photos and description. We enjoyed our weekend stay.

Joan’s place was very clean, peaceful felt like home. Joan responded very quickly. I didn’t need much every step was organized perfectly! I will most definitely stay again whenever I come back to Chicago.

My fiancée and I were both really impressed by the place with it’s atmosphere and location. While we were there it felt more like a home than an airbnb and I would absolutely recommend it to anybody looking to take a trip up here.

My girlfriend and I had a great stay at Julian’s place. It’s in a beautiful neighborhood with plenty to do within walking distance. The unit was clean and spacious with helpful amenities in each room. We would recommend this unit to anyone who is looking to explore Chicago!

Marry and Rob have such a beautiful, warm, and inviting home, couldn’t have asked for a better place to relax after dancing all night. Not only were they amazing hosts, but they were super friendly. I loved learning about how much work they put into the decor of the house especially the koi pond and garden, you can tell they really love this space and want others to feel welcomed. If you’re looking for a quiet, clean spacious stay I wouldn’t hesitate to book !
Very nice place

Our stay could not have been better. The apartment was very welcoming and was fully stocked with everything you could need (e.g. snacks, kitchenware, some toiletries). The beds and furniture were also very comfortable.
The surrounding neighborhood has a plethora of cool dining and bar options. With the blue line a short walk away, the other areas of the city were very accessible (including the airport!).
Me and my friends unanimously agreed we would stay here again if we are back in town!
Awesome place!

This rental is a great one. The place is comfortable and nice. The location is excellent - both quiet and convenient.
We will hope to stay here again for sure.
Bernadette was very communicative and fast to respond. There was a nice little grassy area in front of the house, great if you have pets.
Emily’s place was great! Clean, cozy atmosphere, great location where we could walk places, close to transit, would definitely recommend!
Nice and cozy place. Comfortable stay. Excellent communication from host.
Love the views ,would book again ! The best hotel I’ve stayed at so far!

Good place, solid amenities, close and convenient and walkable to many things, including CTA/buses, so you can get anywhere in the city. Kitchen and living room have most anything you need for a quick or extended stay, bed is comfortable. I would recommend bringing quarters and pods/dryer sheets if you intend on doing laundry as it's offered at the place, but you'll pay a pretty heavy premium. Parking passes are at a premium too considering they're only $1 through the city. All in all, a solid place to stay though. Thank you!

Great stay! Super clean place. The hosts were very responsive and helpful. The room had plenty of space. The apartment was very peaceful and quiet even with other people staying there as well! The airbnb was super secure which we loved. Our only complaint would be parking is a little scarce, but that’s just Chicago in general. We stay here again for sure! I hope we are able to book it for our next trip. It’s two blocks from UoC and only 20-30 minutes from the downtown area!

The apartment unit was comfortable, cozy, and safe. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with.
Overall, we had a pleasant stay at this Airbnb!
Great location in a wonderful neighborhood. Very spacious, perfect for large groups.

Had a fantastic stay and really enjoyed our time in Chicago. The house was excellent, perfect for large groups. Felt like a very high end property in a safe, quiet area. The owner is responsive and very helpful. Would definitely recommend this property to anyone visiting Chicago with a larger group.

This was a very cool place to stay. A definite must for someone who is a big Harry Potter fan... especially if you are not very tall. I really enjoyed staying here, but there were a few things to consider. The street parking was not the best. The spaces are very limited, and you need to be good at parallel parking on both sides. And if you decide to go out for any evening activities you may find that there are no legal spaces left to park in. Also, while it was made very clear that the ceiling is short, what wasn't made clear is it isn't uniform. The air duct between the kitchen and dining area drops a couple inches down, which I had a hard time noticing and hit my head hard a few times, so beware if that.  Even if you're under 6 foot tall like me this could be an issue. Otherwise, the place was very cozy, really did feel like the theme they were going for, and included a bunch of nice touches including lots of Harry Potter themed games that my kids appreciated.

Mary’s place was a perfect landing spot for my daughter and myself. We appreciated the space and felt like we were in a grandma’s loft space. She was the best host we’ve had, without ever meeting in person. We will be back when we are in need of an easy stay when we want to spend as much of our budget on experiences in Chicago.

We had a nice weekend at Nick's place.  We loved the retro charm.  Easy walk to Mariano's, restaurants and bars.  Neighborhood is quiet and felt safe. Easy street parking.  Very convenient location for attending a wedding at Fairlie.  Everything worked out great!
Peaceful, felt right at home
Tiffany is an amazing host! She’s extremely lenient and willing to cooperate with anything! One of the best experiences i’ve had for sure!
Had a great time
Great spot to stay in Chicago!
I enjoyed my stay, the house was clean. It’s a good place.

My partner and I rented this Airbnb for our anniversary and it was perfect for our weekend getaway. We weren’t far from downtown and there are plenty of great restaurants nearby. Kim did a great job at communicating and gave us great recommendations for dinner! If you are considering this stay I recommend going for it!

We really enjoyed staying here.  Daniel was responsive and had great communication leading up to and throughout our stay.  The apartment was clean and had enough space for all of us.  Our favorite part was that it is in a great location.  It was easy to get around, and we have tons of great food options nearby.
Great stay and awesome hospitality!

Apartments was amazing. Street parking was very hard to find. On my first night there, I found street parking and I had my catalytic converter stolen off my vehicle. SO I HIGHLY recommend going to the parking garage, that’s 2 blocks away.

We had a god time staying at WFHome
The house was very nice in a quiet neighborhood.
They had some disposable toothbrushes and toothpaste which was great, and also hairdryer and hot tools to style the hair.
The house was clean and very organized.
We’d definitely recommend it.

Very clean place and easy to find and enter.  We travel to Chicago a couple of times a year to visit family, and we believe this neighborhood to be very safe and easy to get around.  Thanks Alma for providing a good place to stay.

Location was great. Pretty quiet neighborhood. Lots of stairs, but nothing we didn’t already know. Didn’t hear much of the neighbors downstairs. Easy check-in and check-out. Building felt secure. Plenty of parking space in the street in front of the building. Bathroom floors could use a little bit of a deeper cleaning, but overall place was clean. Host checked up on us to ask how our stay was going. Would definitely recommend.
The home was cozy and the neighborhood was quiet throughout my stay! I really enjoyed the patio area as well.
very nice and very easy find felt like I was at a hotel
Had a very comfy stay during the weekend!
house was as described in loading Vince was very responsive a good host.  the bar/ pay room in the basement was #1 had s great time. would rent again in thr future
The property was in the perfect location!! Close to everything we wanted to do.  It was very clean and parking was easy!! Can't wait to go back!!:)

Overall, our stay was decent, but there were a few things that could be improved. The bedding didn’t quite match the photos and the beds were fairly firm. The bathroom was nice, though there was a noticeable sewage smell after showers - which lingered. After returning from one of our outings, we noticed a cigarette odor in the building which also made our unit smell.
There was also some early morning noise, it sounded like construction upstairs. A few maintenance details stood out as well (loose handles, minor stains, and some amenities not fully usable). We also had to rewash a few dishes before using them.
That said, the location is a big plus. Very walkable with great food nearby, and the parking spot was convenient. With a bit more attention to detail and upkeep, this place could be a much better stay.
Everything about Cans place was perfect. Super clean. Perfect location - quiet and safe. Street parking is a huge bonus as well! Would stay here again if coming back to Chicago.
Everything was great, clean space and lots to do nearby !

This was actually the second time we've rented this spot, and will most likely rent again if it's available next year too! It's easy to find, cozy, and has great places to eat and shop nearby! Thomas is great, and clear with instructions, and very helpful and attentive.

We enjoyed our stay at this modern, beautiful and quiet condo. Loved the two living spaces, the comfortable beds, and the walkability, while the rooftop space and the parking pass were fabulous bonuses. The communication with the owners was so responsive, helpful and appreciated! We definitely recommend this rental!
Nine of us comfortably stayed here -- plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms. Good value, and we had a lovely stay.
Great place in a great location.  Lots of options close by, coffee shops, restaurants, parks that are in 5-10 minute walking distance

We had a great long weekend in Chicago and really appreciated how convenient the location was of this property. There was plenty of room for our group. We did have trouble with some of the locks and were concerned about the outer doors that never felt securely closed. But a handyman did come and at least change the code of a couple of the doors. The space was mostly clean and neat, however we did find used dirty towels shoved in a drawer and the area rugs in bedrooms were not very clean (dust and someone’s old contact lenses were found on one of them). I found a water bottle and tissues under one of the beds. So overall, our stay was good but we felt the security of the doors and attention to detail in cleaning could be improved- which would make it an excellent place to stay.
Richard’s place was great!
Would stay again
Great place in a great area! We loved our stay!
Place matched expectations. Plenty of space for our group. Responsive hosts were great.
Nice place
Very good stay overall! Had some electrical difficulties but Josh communicated very well and quickly helped us to get it fixed. Walkable, safe area.

Dorian was responsive and attentive. Really loved the location and being able to walk 10 minutes to Chiu Quon every morning for breakfast and other great places in the evening for dinner. It was clean, quiet, and a perfect place to crash while I worked at C2E2. Highly recommend!
Everything was just as promised.  A real pleasure - and we will stay there agin.
Had a great experience! A very nice and new condo. Host was responsive with all needs. We will stay here again if we are wanting to stay outside the city to save 💰

Convenient, private space and very clean. Good city location.  Felt safe.  Having 2 bathrooms was nice.  Very frequent and clear communication. Stairs are old school and steep so not easy for those with mobility issues or small children.  Very accommodating host.
The location was perfect and easy to access.
The location of this listing is great if you need easy access to downtown. The only drawback was the comfort of the bed in the unit.
Everything was great!
Great stay ! Would def recommend!
I've stayed at Sezgin's place several times now, and it's always a pleasant experience. Would highly recommend for anyone traveling to Chicago for work or pleasure.
beautiful place
Liked the place, good communication and great location to go places
Great stay! Thanks!
We loved it! Great place to recharge and watch the Lake Michigan waves roll i. We would stay again, loved to location and views!

This was our first time visiting Chicago, and I’m so glad we chose to stay here. The beds were so comfortable, the place is very spacious for the city and there’s a big balcony accessible privately right from the Airbnb. It felt very safe and was quiet at night. We didn’t cook but you could easily cook meals there and have everything you need. The towels were big and soft, it was very clean and could accommodate 4 people easily and comfortably. We made comments multiple times about how this this place truly made our stay in Chicago immensely better, and if I came back to the city I’d absolutely stay here again.
Fue muy buena la ubicacion y todo muy limpio
Perfect location! Walkable to everything. Host was extremely responsive and flexible with our check in. Instructions for getting into the garage and place were very clear.

This is the best Airbnb we’ve ever stayed in. Beautiful, super clean, with all the extras - extra towels and blankets, books, legos, bath toys, cooking supplies, coffee (ground and pods), tea, easy entry, and amazing local parking.  Great neighborhood with lots on restaurants with walking distance. We will stay here again!
The place looked better than the photos.  It was nice and clean with plenty of walkable food options in the area.
I would say the place needed some maintenance it’s and more natural cleaning supplies should be used so that it does not smell like chemicals - good location gym was good so that’s a plus
Comfortable & cozy I’ll definitely be booking again

Excellent stay. The place is comfortable with high ceilings and no street noise.
The host is responsive and professional and will do what they can to make your stay comfortable.
I will be staying with Cloud9 again in the future.

This was my first time doing an extended stay at an Airbnb, and Nathaniel was very helpful and responsive from the beginning. He was proactive when I reached out with questions, but also didn't over-communicate throughout my stay - it was very low key and helped me get into a good routine at the place. The cleaning services for my 2-month stint were efficient and extremely high quality, which was a nice benefit - there was an extra cost associated, but it felt like a fair deal. I would definitely book here again to be a part of the neighborhood and get a taste of Chicago that's a bit more removed from the hustle.
Great place close to the city. Very stylish apartment.

Rachel’s place was very comfortable and the cleanliness was top tier.   Her instructions and description prior to check-in made the experience seamless and no need to contact throughout the stay even though she was clear that she’s available if needed.  I would definitely recommend her place.
Exactly as described. Perfect for a short stay in Chicago with friends. We loved Wicker Park and the surrounding area, and Kiva’s place was a perfect home base. Thank you!
Perfect location for staying in the city. Central to most other neighborhoods for traveling around.
Beautiful place and great host
Great apartment. It was clean and had everything we needed. The host took a long time to respond, and booking the parking was not easy. The thing to open the garage never worked.

Beautiful room, so close to the lake, walkable to fun restaurants. Best was the very welcoming hosts— extremely kind and hospitable. Thank you so much! Regret that had to leave early due to emergency at home.
Great unit.
Muy limpio, bien ubicado, bonito y bien decorado y Ben muy pendiente de contestar muy rápido. El tener estacionamiento fue de gran ayuda
Great place to stay at the beds were really comfortable and the apartment was really clean
Check-in, stay, and check-out all went smoothly! Good amount of space as well

During our recent stay, my group and I thoroughly enjoyed our experience. The location was convenient, providing easy access to shopping, restaurants, and other amenities. The host was accommodating, allowing us to check in early and facilitating clear communication and concise instructions. The accommodations met our expectations and were suitable for our brief stay. Parking was also hassle-free, and we felt comfortable leaving our vehicle in the designated location, which was situated in a nearby neighborhood. Overall, we would consider staying again if the pricing was reasonable and felt comfortable with the decision.
This is a listing that matches its pictures. For what you can control it lives up to what’s described and found online.
Very nice! We highly recommend it.

Stayed here for four nights as a visiting student at UChicago.
Very convenient location, close to the lake.
The room was very tidy and clean.
Manuel is very supportive and nice.
Recommended to all similar short-term visitors.
Jake was very responsive to all questions and inquires.  Great location and having parking on site made our stay so comfortable.  The whole family gives it a thumbs up.
Very nice place and great location. Will for sure book Jackie’s place again next time in town!
Great location, very safe building, host is very friendly and communicative
great place to stay
Humma’s place was nice. She was friendly and had quick responses. Would stay there again.

Great place. Was in town for UChicago admitted student day, it was a straight 7-10 min to the campus. Finding parking at night was a bit difficult but the local parking garage was great. The place was clean and Brad was really responsive and accommodating. Definitely recommend to stay here for a weekend.
Excellent apartment. Very clean and safe.

It IS a garden apartment, soi did get a bit off that “closed in” feeling after a while, but it is a nice little space, decently furnished, and in a very nice residential neighborhood…a short drive or less than 1 mile walk to a really nice commercial area…lots to do, daily.  Plenty of nice restaurants, too. Host was great, responsive & helpful.

The place was great.  Two king bedrooms were ideal for two families.  Our kids had the upstairs and a downstairs bedroom.  The master bathroom featured many upscale amenities.  Places to eat nearby and train access 10 minutes away. Safe neighborhood.   We would definitely stay here again.

Lovely space with free parking available. It’s unfortunately not the ideal space if you’d like some peace and quiet. Kids were constantly running even till 10 pm and at some point till midnight. It’s a basement apartment so you can hear every sound and movement happening upstairs. Other than that, it’s a nice place.

Absolutely love this listing. So close to everything.
Only downside is that There are 3 flight of stairs, so be weary with luggage. Other than that, 5 stars.
Amazing spot to stay at private great kitchen
The location was walking distance from work and Gangam Market kept me fed. Will stay here again!

The hosts was great communicators, and friendly people I wish I would’ve met them. Hopefully, next time I’m in town an the Airbnb is available. And the host left a gift at the door what I thought was awesome.

Our stay at Leigh’s home was fantastic from start to finish. The house truly had everything we needed to feel right at home—thoughtfully equipped, comfortable, and welcoming in every way. It was exceptionally clean and well-maintained, which made settling in effortless. All the natural from the front windows made morning coffee perfect!
The location was also perfect, making it easy to get around and enjoy the area. Leigh was a great host and made sure everything went smoothly. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and convenient stay, and I’d gladly stay here again!
Easy spot, easy parking, house was clean and well stocked - highly recommend

Loved the neighborhood and the space itself. The staff was easy to get a hold of and communicate with. My biggest issue is the fire alarm was very very sensitive and it went off from me just preheating the oven. I loved the idea of having a full kitchen but not being able to use the oven or stovetop due to a sensitive smoke alarm was a real bummer.
Great place to stay in Chicago! Everything was nice, and felt very comfortable.
I enjoyed my stay at Charles Airbnb.  It was cosy, warm and welcoming.  Charles was very helpful, friendly and responsive to messages.  A great location too.

This was my first time to Chicago to watch Cubs opener! The location is so close to everything, lovely inside and Ashton was very responsive and helpful to all our concerns prior to and during stay! We will continue to use this location in the future! Thanks again Ashton :)
Wonderfully spacious apartment in the heart of downtown.
Really amazing place to stay and amazing hosts. I’ll definitely stay again.

I stayed for 6 weeks and it was a great overall experience. I needed it to be close to hospital as I didn’t have a car. There’s public transport nearby and Mt Sinai is a short walk away. I felt safe always. Beautiful home and completely stocked with what you may need for an extended stay. They were wonderful host who always responded. Worth your money for your location. Especially if you have a car everything you may want to explore is nearby!
My only complaint is the noise. You are on a bottom unit. The neighbor’s dog has 3 legs and you can hear him. They are not up late at night. But if you work weird shifts or are here for a long stay I recommend ear plugs. At night there are little noises coming from the air vents and walls. Like settling noises so again if that’s something that can bother you.
But I 100% recommend! For vacation or long stay. Great host!

This was one of the worst Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had.
After booking and payment were accepted, the host began asking multiple intrusive questions, including what we would be doing during our trip, which felt unnecessary and inappropriate. I had already clearly stated the number of guests, yet I was repeatedly questioned about who was “staying” versus who was simply assisting.
Upon arrival, the property was completely unclean. There were dirty dishes, trash (including bottles), unmade beds with unclean linens, pills left out, and even what appeared to be bodily fluids. The entire home smelled strongly of weed and tobacco, which created a serious health concern—especially since I was traveling with children, including one with asthma.
To make matters worse, the host appeared to be closely monitoring our arrival via exterior cameras, yet the property had clearly not been cleaned prior to check-in. Instead of ensuring the home was properly prepared, the focus was placed on surveil

Steve was a great host and was very responsive when we had questions. The pool table and pong long table were a great to have available! Beds were very comfortable and the steam shower was a great perk! Wrigley and restaurant were walkable or Ubers were quick rides!
Clean, great location with free onsite parking and a responsive host.
great Host and Home
Communicative host and great location!  Included a parking spot.

This loft was absolutely stunning! Her attention to detail was amazing. Waking up under skylights was so picturesque.  I traveled with 3 teenagers and there was ample room and comfort to go around.  If you are going to the windy city for this beautiful city you would be remiss not to stay in this equally beautiful if not more gorgeous loft.  AND the shower I don't think ever ran out of hot water and on a cold Chi-town day exploring with 5 people that was a necessity.  I will definitely seek this loft out when I'm back in town.
Thanks so much for a great stay! Everything was just perfect for our needs for the month plus! Safe area - easy to walk everywhere we needed - loved not using our car!

Our family enjoyed our stay and all the amenities of the home. Plenty of space to spread out and a perfect main level for hanging out. Loved the proximity to great restaurants and shopping, the Red Line (just 4 stops to Wrigley Field), and the beach. Very walkable neighborhood with grocery stores nearby as well. Host was great to work with and very responsive!

Roberto was an outstanding host—friendly, attentive, and full of great local tips. He even recommended an amazing spot just around the corner that we loved! His place was comfortable and welcoming, making our stay even better. We would absolutely recommend staying with him.

We booked this condo to have space for our infant and grandparents to have room to spend time together. The condo could have been great, but at midnight on the first night we woke up fire alarms going off and water dripping out of light sockets. We quickly discovered theupstairs bathroom flooding (poop was on the floor) from the condo above. The owner of the Airbnb was not helpful with the situation at all, only offering "sorry for the inconvenience" and "we have contacted our people". We had to leave and book a hotel for the night, which Airbnb would only cover $200 off the cost, and get another condo through VRBO for the rest of the weekend. Neither the owner or Airbnb offered to cover the increased cost.

This rental is very nice and clean. The neighbor above us was noisy and the CTA train runs right behind the building 24/7.  I did not mind the train sound..my husband however was awakened. We did not have a car and used the train often so did not need to walk far when we did use it. The apartment was across the street from Whole Foods, Walgreens and LA Fitness which happened to be our gym! There were quite a few homeless people to wade through in the neighborhood.

The place is huge and lovely. The bed is super comfortable. We also used the sofa as a bed, and there is a curtain so it's like a little room. Kitchen is well equipped.  Location is very quiet. Off the bedroom is a cute little office with a nice window where I was able to work without disturbing my travel partner.  Neighborhood walking EAST is amazing- shops and restaurants just walking about two blocks. Love ANNAs Polish/Ukrainian Deli!!
Julio’s place was perfect for me visiting friends. Walkable to shops, train, restaurants. Julio is easy to get ahold of and always responsive
Very responsive host. Gave clear instructions for checking in & out . I was forewarned about hectic parking which I appreciated . Clean and spacious apartment I would stay there again.
This was a lovely stay, all amenities listed and then some! Safe, quiet neighborhood and a gorgeous home, it was perfect for my group’s stay in Chicago.

Our stay at Johnie’s was perfect.  We had a very comfortable stay and there was a great supply of accessories and snacks.  We walked to a great Jamaican restaurant.  Parking worked out too.  Drove to the city a couple times too, easy 20 minutes drive.  Definitely would book again!
It’s a really nice stay while visiting Chicago, Joan is friendly and really responsive with messages

Rudia gave great instructions with check-in that made for a smooth process. The room was exactly as pictured. Great evening sun with windows to a private backyard. Everything was clearly marked as far as cabinet and refrigerator space so shopping was easy. Neighborhood was safe with stores nearby. Would recommend.
The staff was absolutely 5 star and if you end up eating at the restaurant I recommend the margarita flat bread 10/10!!!

We had a wonderful stay at Candace’s place! The apartment was spotless, and even more beautiful than in the pictures. We really appreciated the thoughtful design and all the lovely finishes. The beds were super-comfortable! Our only small complaint was that the upstairs neighbors were loud at times, but it wasn’t too disruptive. All in all it was a great experience and we would stay there again.

I think the location is wonderful for anyone interested in spending time in boystown. That being said, the house itself is up a flight of stairs making getting luggage in/out difficult. Parking is city parking - highly recommend getting the parking passes from Justin rather than chancing the garages.
The kitchen was great, and the bathrooms were well maintained. Lots of cute dogs in the area, and nice neighbors. It is important to note that the neighborhood is very quiet, and anyone saying here is asked to adhere to quiet hours starting at 9pm. There are other asks, like keeping all belongings in our rooms (we rented the whole house?) that we felt were a little much.
Overall, it was a fun weekend and we are all very grateful to our wonderful host!!
We had a great stay at Kate’s place! Super spacious and near great food & coffee spots. Would stay again!
Good place to stay; I am staying for the 2nd time.

I don’t understand the reviews under 5 stars. The listing was accurate, the room was peaceful, the neighborhood is fantastic. It’s pretty cut and dry. Junior was responsive and easy to deal with. It’s a private room, with a private bathroom, in a great neighborhood.

Light, bright, clean, and spacious 5th floor apartment. Building has a common area with a pool table, work space,  outdoor grill and fitness room. There is also a great rooftop deck. Great Logan Square location! Walking distance to restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and yoga. All in all we would stay there again! The main issue we had was the temperature regulation in the the unit. The few days before we arrived had been unseasonably warm and the building's cooling system was activated. However, being spring in Chicago, the temperatures dropped to the 30's, and the system never switched back to heat or even off of cooling.  This seemed to be out of the host's control. The only solution was to turn off the blower and use extra blankets at night. Although communication was prompt, it was a bit cumbersome going through Guesty for registration, check-in, etc. FYI there was an additional $500 refundable damage deposit outside of AirBnb required.
I loved it! So pretty and nice will book again

Good location for what we needed, I appreciated the extra off-street parking. This was a place that was clearly bought and renovated as quickly and cheaply as possible. The upstairs bathroom door was hung wrong, it couldn’t close leaving a 6 inch gap looking in. Drafty windows, gaps in the flooring, moldy shower steamers, no towel racks in the upstairs bathroom, an iron but no ironing board, and the back of the couch wouldn’t stay up, it was broken when we arrived. Reasonably priced, but not quality.

This was an egregious failure and one of the worst travel experiences we’ve ever had. We fulfilled every requirement prior to arrival, including completing the pre-check-in survey and clearly communicating our arrival time. Despite this, when we arrived, neither the garage nor apartment access codes worked—meaning we were completely locked out of a property we had fully paid for.
We made repeated, urgent attempts to contact the host via phone and through the Airbnb platform. There was no response. No acknowledgment, no instructions, no backup plan—nothing. As a direct result, my family was left stranded on the streets of Chicago with our luggage and no access to shelter.What is even more unacceptable is that the host remained entirely unresponsive even after Airbnb corporate made multiple attempts to contact them on our behalf. Ignoring paying guests is bad enough—ignoring Airbnb itself demonstrates a complete abandonment of responsibility and a blatant disregard for guest safety.
Wonderful stay for my family
Did not match photos, but the location and price were right.

Excellent listing . Place was as described . Clean and tidy and amenities were more than adequate. Host was extremely responsive and timely with conversation. Nice neighborhood, within walking distance of so many things . Excellent choice for being close to everything in Chicago . We had a great time , would recommend!

Close to University of Chicago and near shuttle and bus stops. Lots of restaurants and stores nearby. Encountered an issue with noise levels and hosts tried to help with providing a sound machine (obviously not their fault), but difficult to get good sleep in the apartment. Smaller than photos provided.

Very nice place. Plenty of room for my family. Host responded fast. Next time I’m in Chicago I’ll be staying at Patrica’s place.
Thanks for everything
We had a wonderful stay! Clean and exactly as pictured. Perfect for our group of 6.
This is a very spacious apartment in a perfect location.
Great location we’ve stayed twice and it’s always a great time
It's very well located and the studio is very nice and well organized. If I return to Chicago, I would definitely stay here again.

Had such a great stay here! The location was super close to downtown, which made getting around and exploring really easy. I also felt very safe throughout my entire stay, both inside the space and in the surrounding neighborhood. The host was incredibly helpful. Definitely would stay here again and would recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!
Amazing host

Jesus has a nice place in a nice quiet area.  Unfortunately the oven was not working and we had brought meals to bake in the oven to cut down on costs. Jesus was apologetic and ordered a new oven however it wouldn't be corrected until after our stay.  Zumba class next door daily at 8:30am and 6pm, didn't really bother us but is something to note. We also had a surprising unexpected/unwanted guest during our stay that hopefully Jesus will take care of also.  Another minor note: there was 5 of us and only 4 towels.  Overall the place was nice,  I just wish we didn't have the issues we had.

If you think you cannot cover the entire city in a couple of days this place is for you. This has end to end views of the skyline and makes you feel like you have seen the entire city while staying at home. The hosts were fantastic and proactively asked about our needs. Definitely would recommend.
This was a great place to house my work crew.
I was in need of a local spot during a home renovation and I stayed with Chicago Hospitality. They were great and made our stay enjoyable.
Thanks for the stay!

I can’t say enough great things about our stay! From the minute we were even considering the rental unit, Cloud 9 was immediately responsive, friendly and answered ALL my questions! It’s rare to find a rental that exceeds the description and pictures, but this one sure did! The unit was sparkling clean and every attention to detail was made! The kitchen was stocked with quality cookware, bathrooms had  toiletries and the bedding was very comfortable. We were greeted at the front desk when we arrived and security is top notch. We were able to drop our bags and start enjoying the city! We loved being able to sit outside at night and enjoy soaking in all the lights and sounds of the city. The space on the 20th floor was awesome! Plenty of seating indoors and out on the balcony. We enjoyed some family time playing pool. Well equipped gym too! The location was perfect! We were walking distance to all the hot spots and landmarks in Downtown Chicago. Super impressed with Cloud9!!

This was such a Fun stay! From the tub & amazing shower to the pool table & dart board, as well as large tvs with Roku & comfortable couches. You genuinely get the feel for living in a historic downtown unit - updated with beautiful modern amenities. The full sized kitchen was so nice & had everything we needed. Easy to walk & Park. The host was very helpful & responsive. I was especially pleased to find a smaller unit with a pool table (rare). I really appreciate that the bedroom is essentially noise & light proof for great sleeping. We will visit again! And still have plenty to see & do. Very worth the price.

What a unique and special place! I loved the location - it was close to everything and parking was easy. The bed was so comfortable and the kitchen was thoughtfully stocked with everything I needed. I’d definitely stay here again.
Thank you so much Mr. Ed for everything!
We felt like at home. Peacefull neighborhood. Plenty of parking spots. Easy to teach by public transport or car. I recommend.
Great stay! Would gladly stay here again.
I had a great stay at Ahmeena’s place! She was an excellent host—very kind, responsive, and helpful throughout my trip.

the apartment is in a very quiet and peaceful neighborhood. couldn't of asked for a better location. it was very clean and easy to get in the doors. the beds were very comfortable in my opinion.  I would definitely recommend this place.

Wendy & Matt place was the perfect spot for our Chicago get away.  Easy access and close to all the things we wanted to see and do in downtown Chicago.  We added the parking space which  was very convenient to get in and out if needed.

The location of this place is great and one of the things we loved best about it along with the quiet and peaceful neighborhood. The host was very responsive and even came to the location when we had a problem with the lock. Although everything did match the pictures; this place is in need of some serious maintenance. We had some troubles with the stay so I don’t think it was worth the amount we paid, but overall our stay was decent. They do have a book where you could leave reviews which was cool. I would suggest having an additional book where guest can write any problems they have upon arrival so you guys won’t try and charge for someone for what they didn’t do. I would be interested in booking again but only if all the problems are fixed.

The place is very nice, Jen does a good job of taking care of you. When the fridge stopped working it was replaced with a new one within 1-2 days. The only complaint is that the ceiling is a little low. As someone who is 6'3 I had to bend down to enter my room, but otherwise it was a great experience!

My family and I had a wonderful staycation in the city, and this Airbnb was the perfect home base. The views were absolutely stunning, the kids could barely pull themselves away from the window! The space was spotless, and the location couldn’t have been better for exploring the neighborhood on foot.
We did run into a minor parking hiccup, but the host team handled it quickly and graciously. All in all, a fantastic stay, highly recommend!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
Decent place to stay, if you have to. Close to public transportation.
We had a wonderful stay at Kirsten's place.  Was exactly how it was described and was even cuter in person.  I would definitely stay here again.

My husband has been in the area for work the last month or so and week to week we will always choose Regina’s place! Aside from clear instructions, and a comfortable place, any place of hers is WELL worth it. Anything we have needed, she has supplied and I’m forever grateful! Will continue to stay in Regina’s places for the remainder of the summer!  10/10 recommend!
I’ll do it again

The place itself was decent for the price but it was not stocked and ready for us. They gave us TWO body towels and TWO hand towels and ZERO washcloths for our 7 day stay with THREE guests. There were two TV’s with zero remotes and not connected to WIFI. No laundry soap/pods to wash the only two towels we had. The bedroom lamps had no light bulbs in them. We contacted them about every single issue we had and got automated AI responses saying “we’re sorry, this is not our standards, we’ll get in touch with our team” and not a single thing was fixed or corrected. They sent a Roku TV remote via Walmart delivery for a VIZIO  tv and argued with us that it was a universal remote and should work even after we sent proof that it would not. We ended up going to target and buying our own remote on day 4 so our son could watch TV before bed (because we never heard from them again after the Roku debacle) We also had to go buy washcloths and laundry detergent. Do not recommend this place or company
Very nice home in a good location. Aly was very responsive and helpful getting us checked in and out. Would definitely stay here again.
great place and environment
Nice, clean apartment in a great location.

I had a nice 2 night stay. The accommodations were exactly as how they were described. Every room was clean, nicely furnished and tastefully decorated. I appreciated the amenities such as the coffee, shampoo, and hairdryer! As mentioned by others, it’s a short walk to the blue line so transportation to the airport and the city were extremely easy. My daughter just moved to the area and this location is just around the corner from her. I’m sure I’ll be booking this home again in the future.
Codes weren’t right for us to get in. The contact numbers I was given were in salt lake city. No one was very helpful for me. Even the master keys didn’t work to access the unit.

Quiet dead end street quaint little restaurants & shops. Tiny, basic kitchen with no seating for eating, but adorable loft for kids sleeping area with lots of storage. I might suggest a good cleaning for the living area rug, kids books in the loft space, and games in the living area tv cabinet. Easy & close street parking!
Amazing location and very nice inside.  Would love to stay again.

This was a great place to stay and the host was very responsive and accommodating. They were even able to accommodate me for a second stay with ease and quick responsiveness. The place was very clean and easy to get into. It felt safe to stay here and to walk around the area. Many good coffee shops within walking distance and a grocery store across the street. The parking was SO convenient for me. I recommend using this host for your accommodations whether it’s here or  one of their other locations. 🤍
Beautiful place. Responsive host. Understanding and patient. Great place to stay
Excellent stay!   The home was beautiful, spacious, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.  Excellent location and beautiful furnishings. Would love to stay here again!
Cute place and easy check in.

Honestly this is the nicest Airbnb I’ve stayed in. The hosts were incredibly helpful and responsive. The place itself was immaculate, beautifully designed (truly a feast for the eyes), every amenity you could possibly think of, truly, and in a great area in proximity to so much to do. I would love to stay again, do not hesitate to book! Thanks for a fantastic experience.

We had a wonderful stay here for a little over two weeks. The location was incredibly convenient, especially being so close to the University of Chicago. It was also an easy, roughly 20-minute drive to Shirley Ryan AbilityLab, which made transitions between locations smooth and manageable.
We really enjoyed the surrounding area and felt safe throughout our stay. Street parking was also very manageable, which made coming and going easy.
The space truly felt like a home away from home. We were able to cook several meals comfortably, which made a big difference during a longer stay. The beds were exceptionally comfortable, and the showers were amazing—such a nice way to unwind at the end of the day.
It’s clear the host put a lot of thought into the details throughout the home, and that extra care really shows. Everything felt welcoming, well-prepared, and thoughtfully arranged.
We would absolutely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable home away from hom

This Airbnb was so beautiful! It was beautifully decorated, clean, on a high floor with a wonderful view. We enjoyed our stay so much we took our time leaving for activities each day. You can hear the train passing but we were used to the sound pretty quickly. We had a 3 year old with us and she slept just fine. My family has not stopped talking about this place since leaving - we will definitely be returning!

Beautiful condo in the heart of West Loop where all the happenings are. Catalina was very responsive and check in was a breeze. The condo itself was thoughtfully furnished and we especially loved the welcome snacks and goodies in the fridge. The best was checkout - just turn off the lights and drop keys to concierge. Always feels good to not have to worry about long checkout lists. Highly recommend! 🤍🤍🤍
It’s my first time ever visiting Chicago the place was great The housekeeper was very professional and very easy to get along with

We rent this for work purposes when we have conferences at McCormick Place. Much more economical than five hotel rooms. Milan is a great host and the apartment is exactly like pictures. We have stayed there multiple times and will be back. FIVE STARS!

Excelente lugar, limpo, bem organizado e localizado. Apenas recomendaria aumentar/melhorar o Wi-Fi, e por conta disso também não conseguimos usar a TV. Apesar de tudo, excelente estadia e anfitrião Caleb sempre solícito.
Great stay! Thanks again :-)
Great location. Great value for the money
One of the best places I have been too in a very long time! Communication was very good and excellent. Highly recommend

The apartment itself was acceptable, but I did not like the area. It was poorly equipped, very, very basic. The kitchen, in particular, was quite dirty (especially the air fryer and the few utensils available).
There were very few towels, sheets, and blankets for such a large apartment, and no extras were provided.
Although the host knew I was staying with two infants, the apartment was not prepared at all to accommodate them. For this reason, we decided to leave before the check-out date.
Overall, it felt overpriced for what we received.

The home itself was nice and clean, but the locality felt very unsafe. I had a frightening experience while walking from the nearby subway to the property two individuals nearly grabbed me. Thankfully, I was not alone; the situation could have been much worse otherwise.
This place might be manageable if you have your own vehicle, but I would strongly advise against staying here if you plan to rely on public transport. Safety should be the top priority.
We had to cancel our booking after just one day due to these concerns. Although we requested a refund after deducting taxes and cleaning fees for the remaining days, the host declined. However, I appreciate Airbnb’s support in ultimately processing the refund.
Great people

We can’t say enough about our stay. It’s sometimes the little things like the coffee machine and the waters and snacks left for us that made. Us feel right-at Home. The bed and the furniture were also comfortable. The luxury of having the washer dryer was terrific for our two weeks day.
We look forward to being able to rent this beautiful space again on our next visit to Chicago.

My family really enjoyed our stay at this condo. Climate control was a bit challenging, but owner had useful tips and was responsive. Would I stay again, absolutely! This is a wonderful and convenient space and a great host experience.

We loved this property.  Incredibly clean, comfortable beds, and beautiful plants inside. Central location for our busy vacation agenda. Host was very responsive as well. Would stay here again.
Cozy, clean, amazing view. I spent spring break here with my 2 children and we loved it. Everything is within walking distance. The view, especially at night, is beautiful!

Caleb’s place was absolutely fantastic—easily one of the best Airbnbs my family and I have stayed in throughout Chicago. The space was spacious yet warm, cozy, and truly felt like a home away from home.
The beds were very comfortable, and the living room was beautiful. We loved all the windows, which brought in tons of natural light. Each bedroom had its own unique charm and elegance, and the large dining table was perfect for enjoying meals together.
The location was also great—everything we needed was within walking distance in a cute, beautiful neighborhood. Overall, one of my favorite Airbnb stays. I’d definitely love to stay here again—10/10!

This Airbnb was good for what we needed it for. The hosts were very responsive and on top of it. Plus the ceiling was leaking water which was apparently happening before we got there and they acted like they weren’t aware. The bed were very very hard… end of day wish I stayed at a hotel but oh well. It was decent for the quick trip and it was nice to feel safe in this building with security. I will note it was very clean and they were super easy at check out!

This is the best accommodation we have ever rented on Airbnb. Everything has been thought out down to the smallest detail—the room even has a radio for relaxation. It is as clean and tidy as our own home! 😍 We had a wonderful time here; the University of Chicago and the Japanese Garden are within walking distance, and all entertainment options are just a 15–20 minute drive away. Thank you to the host. We would happily stay here again. Highly recommended!

Enjoyed my stay here!  I liked the house and my large room.  It felt peaceful here and my room and the house was quite nicely appointed : ). I would stay here longer, but need to get to my next destination.  My housemates were nice and the hosts were friendly and ready to help me with any requests.  The location is easily accessible to the the University of Chicaho, the highway, the center of the city, and good restaurants in the area.  I would definitely stay here again.
We went for Opening Day. A block from the stadium and the players lot was next door. It was neat seeing Cubs fans getting autographs and getting excited to see their heroes.
Great location, easy to access and the place was as described. I would for sure stay there again.

Jame's place was excellent for our Opening Day weekend trip. The place had more than enough space for all of us, it was very accurate to what was described in the listing, and easily walkable to Wrigley Field. I will definitely consider trying Jame's place again in the future.

Silvia’s place really exceeded my expectations. It’s pretty great value for what you get. The space felt very cozy and well put together, and everything I needed was there. Overall a very comfortable and easy stay.

I had a fine stay here, with no major problems. It was clean, reasonably comfortable, and safe, which are the main things. I want to lead with that, because I do have some notes.
Lots of airbnbs are a bit janky, for lack of a better word, and this one is no exception — a few things ranged from odd and inconvenient to just downright weird. For example, the light switch in the main bedroom was located on the wrong side of the door, so it's hidden behind the door itself when it's open, which is quite awkward, and non-standard for a reason.
The couch in the living room looks nice, until you realize the seat is all of 9 inches off the floor. I really don't know how to explain this one. When I sat on it, my knees were up in my chest. I didn't really need it, since I was basically only there to sleep, but it's odd.
There was also some unrepaired water damage in the hall wall, and weak water pressure and hot water. Overall, I would probably prefer not to stay here again, but it wasn't bad.

Do yourself a favor and STAY AWAY. I booked this for a month and it was a disaster from day one. First, the "room" is a total scam—it has zero walls and is just a makeshift space separated from the kitchen by a thin curtain. You have zero privacy and zero security, especially since the front door lock was broken when I arrived.
The living conditions are pathetic. There is a hole in the ceiling that leaked rain directly onto the mattress and floor, forcing me to use towels just to keep the bed from being soaked. On top of that, there was no hot water the entire time. The host repeatedly lied about fixing it, pushing the date back over and over while I was forced to take freezing showers.
To make it worse, the host has zero respect for guests. He sat right outside the curtain watching TV at max volume until midnight and constantly had loud friends over. This isn't a "room," it’s a construction zone with a host who doesn't care about basic human decency or safety. DO NOT BOOK.

Fantastic place for a Chicago stay!  Great space, very roomy and fun for families.  We hosted our local family for a game night and had a wonderful time!  Great location - it is walkable to Lincoln Square, a great neighborhood for restaurants, shops and entertainment.  The space is located on a busy street and can be a little noisy early in the morning.  However, the hosts do all they can to mitigate the noise.  Parking was super easy.  We were able to get a free space on the street right in front of the property.  Loved the space - we will be back!

Great communication. we always had our answers on time. She also helped us pointing to a nice, safe and seriously affordable parking in the next block.
overall great location & nice accommodation.
The ceiling height was super tall :) which i liked very much..

Anna included a very detailed binder with instructions as well as locat attractions and points of interest!
Perfect location, really enjoyed our stay! Caleb was a fantastic host, absolutely no complaints!
Mara's place was perfect for my short stay. Just a short walk to the L and provided some good recommendations for local music venues.

Very clean and modern apartment in a very nice neighborhood! Enjoyed the space and two big bathrooms. We walked all around the neighborhood and felt very safe. We would definitely stay again!
Great apartment in a cute neighborhood! Perfect for my stay to catch a concert at Schubas Tavern. Rock on!

Fantastic spot! They were also supper accommodating as my father needed a last minute stay. Great communication and check was super easy. The spot is very cozy and in a great neighborhood with multiple food options.
Excellent accommodations, friendly and responsive host. Hope to visit again!

What a great find in the South Loop! The host is friendly and responsive.  The building is absolutely fabulous and the unit has amazing views all the way around.  We generally cook when we travel, but there are just too many good restaurants in Chicago!  Had we wanted to the kitchen would have had everything we needed for a nice meal eaten at the bar where there is room for three.  We appreciated the gold filter in the coffee maker and the electric gooseneck kettle. The bedrooms were super comfortable for us.  The amenities in the building are really fantastic and Target is right next door which is handy.  The gym, pool and outdoor track rivals anything like Planet Fitness.   If the weather were just a bit nicer we definitely would have used the outdoor rooftop area more.  There's even an indoor pickle ball court!  We can't wait to plan another trip to Chicago and hope this place will be available.
This was a cozy and well laid out Airbnb.  The kitchen had everything we needed or cooking meals at home.  Washer and dryer we so helpful as we had been traveling for a while.

Great place. Safe. Convenient public transport, nearby Traders Joe, and plenty of restaurants nearby. Stayed for a conference at McCormick place which was 22 minutes' walk, or 3 minutes of uber ride. Park is few minutes' walk. Would stay again if back in Chicago area.

We had a wonderful experience staying at this apartment! The space was clean, thoughtfully furnished, and had all the essentials we needed in the kitchen. The only hiccup was that the crib, which was mentioned as available upon request, wasn’t provided. We did request it a couple of days before our arrival, so it might have been due to the last-minute booking. However, this didn't take away from our overall experience.

Great place to stay!

That said, the host was consistently responsive and genuinely considerate, which made all the difference. A comfortable, well-located spot with all the essentials covered.

Ryan’s apartment in Chicago was perfect! I was there for several weeks for work it had everything I needed to feel right at home. Having a washer and dryer and a full kitchen was a huge bonus since I was there for several weeks.

10/10 recommend and I will be booking with Ryan for my future work trips.

Had a great stay for a night. Exactly what I wanted for a very affordable price.
Very near the Hilton where our conference was. Good restaurants nearby, comfortable and quiet. Thanks for a great place to stay.
Great location in the heart of Lincoln Park. Close to restaurants and shops, but on a quiet street. Great place to go on walks, with the park nearby.
Great location

Lina’s place was as described and pictured.  It was very clean, spacious and roomy. Great working kitchen. It had all the amenities needed for a long term stay.  Also, it was nice to have welcome baskets with coffee and toiletries when we arrived.  Towels and sheets were in great shape and a shout out to the bed. Very comfortable!   Great location for fun and transportation Loved our stay.

Very good location for Milwaukee street shopping and restaurants.  Very clean and descriptions were accurate. There was free parking on Wood and Haddon. Pack light cause you will need to get luggage from your car and then up a spiral staircase.
The apartment is pristine. You will feel right at home. There is ample free parking.

The location is 2 blocks from the waterfront and hotels (if you're attending a conference like I was) and the museums are also close by.  It's also an easy walk from the CTA blue line at Jackson if you're flying in and out from Chicago O'Hare airport.  It should be mentioned that the L (elevated train) runs immediately adjacent to the property, and you can hear it in the apartment, which is a studio/efficiency unit.  The bed was comfortable, the heater worked well and the bathroom was clean.  The conference hotel I was attending had rooms that began at 2.5x the cost of this Airbnb!
The house was astonishing, looked just like the pictures. This was a very beautiful home.
Wonderful and fast responsive host clearing up my confusion overall wonderful experience.
Excellent stay. Highly recommend if you are in the South Shore/Hyde Park area.
Great space and great hosts !
good

This was a great spot for a solo traveler working with the university. Close to so many things and great food, quiet and easy to access (exactly as the instructions said), and very responsive communication! Loved the desk and kitchen table - it’s a nice layout for a studio. Not fancy and the window shades didn’t go all the way down (but that might have been user error and still felt very private), but it is a great find.

If you like downtown Chicago this apartment is spectacular. It's far enough away to have a great view and close enough to be super convenient. You'll have views of the city to the east, north and west.
The apartment is clean. It's a little rough around the edges but not bad. The furniture is....basic. I get that you don't want to put RH furniture in an AirBnB but the seating is mismatched, the sofa tired, and the beds were both doubles, not the advertised king & queen. The kitchen itself is great, the balcony is spectacular, and the building amenities are great.
The bathrooms were spotless as was the kitchen. The kitchen sink disposal was inoperable and we had to use a plunger to clear it after a meal. I never got a response about it, but we weren't doing a lot of cooking there anyway.
I do wish it had at least one parking spot available. The nearest public parking is blocks away. That said, the L is right around the corner and there's a Target right there.
We'd stay again.

Excellent location with close proximity to Lake Michigan and walking distance to magnificent mile , Chicago river and historical downtown. There was so much to explore but had limited time. Accommodation was easy to get into, clean and comfortable bed and chairs. Very tastefully decorated and clean. Will love to return.
homely place, free breakfast is a nice touch
Worked very well for our trip to Hyde Park for work in the area.
Home was perfect for our business trip!

A wonderful home in a great location. Everything was clean and prepared for my arrival. Instructions were clear and the entertainment options in the home were very convenient.
Many options for food and is a short walk to the L train to access anything else in the city.
The bathrooms are very cool and one of them even has a heated floor!
Would absolutely stay here again when I return. Great spot!

The stay was perfect. Very clean place. The building was located right next to plenty of places to eat and next to the train station which helped get around easier. The people were really great at communicating whenever I needed help.
However, There is a damage deposit fee of 125 that wasn’t mentioned.
Water and towels/soap/washcloths were provided. Definitely a place I’d recommend for 1-2 people. Was very cozy and overall the experience was just perfect in general. If you’re a smoker or vape this place isn’t for you because they do not allow smoking. Also there is a rule where you can’t be loud past 10pm.
I’d definitely recommend this place and for a solo or duo trip in Chicago definitely an amazing stay with amazing fast communicating host.

Book it!!!! You won’t want to leave! PERFECT! It was 5 of us and perfect! Having the 3 bathrooms was perfect! The place is a home away from home and my next time in Chicago I would def book this home! Felt amazing!

Well appointed, full kitchen, large space, quiet and comfy, like a home away from home.  My host was proactive with communication and responded quickly to my questions.  I was very happy with my stay and look forward to returning again.

We enjoyed this beautiful home for 4 days/3 nights for our family spring break trip! This house was perfect size for us. Everything was exactly how we expected. Jacuzzi wasn’t available during our stay but the owner made accommodations & was very reasonable & responded very fastly!

Home sweet home! I have to say, this is where I want to live. Well designed space, nice appliances & good location. Safe, quiet, close to Highway & Resturant’s, modest view, private rooftop. I really enjoyed my stay

We really enjoyed our stay! The location is perfect—close to everything we needed. Assel was very responsive and made us feel welcome, and we always felt safe.
The place is bright and spacious, though the beds (especially the bunk beds), pillows, and towels could use a little updating, and the kitchen is pretty simple. With a few small improvements, this would be a five-star stay. We’d happily come back!
nice place

Overall had a wonderful stay! Was in a great location, check in and checkout were easy, and having a spot for parking was a bonus. I also really enjoyed that they provided box fans for the rooms! Only minor downsides were, a few of the towels had staining on them and you can hear the upstairs neighbors walking pretty loudly. We also had issues getting the outlets in the bathrooms working. Overall, we would stay here again!
Loved here anytime I book a Airbnb in a this this property
It was very warm staying there. Place was very good and clean.

A comfortable and easy-going settlement for a temporary-casual getaway. Especially with the inviting neighboring roommates and other well-provided amenities! It’s a decent location if you are open to experiencing the true wonders of Chicago’s local areas.
Good place.

This was on of my favorite Airbnbs I have ever stayed in. I loved the location, the building. I loved how secure the place is. It’s in a great area, lots of restaurants near by and not far from downtown at all about a 10 minute drive from the bean. It was great and comfortable. Only thing I would have changed is how long I was able to stay. I would have extended my stay for more days but the price did go up due to it being busier. I highly recommend booking for extra nights if you think that’s something you might do so you can get it for the original listing price. But overall my husband and I loved this place and will definitely be back and staying again. We work out of Chicago so I will be booking with Milan again in the near future!
Loved everything about this stay, i just wish more blankets were provided and more kitchen towels! communicated great the stay was overall a great place to be!

Everything went very smoothly during my stay. Check-in was easy and hassle-free, and I felt safe and comfortable the entire time. The Airbnb looked just like the photos, which I really appreciated. Overall, it was a great experience and I would definitely stay here again!
Wonderful stay! Would definitely stay here again when we come to Chicago! 😸
Great bnb. Would recommend for Chicago stays
the apartamento is very old,very bad smell very noise  from the train

Tian is an incredible host. She's very pro active. The place is great with lots of rooms and comfy beds, the description matched the reality. She accommodated us hassle free. We would like to extend longer but our time is limited. Would love to do it again in the future.
Great staffs throughout the stay and unbeatable views for the city, the lake, and the pier. Will recommend to others 100%

I stayed here for several days during a longer trip. The location was convenient, and the check-in process was smooth.
The space itself is quite compact, which may be best suited for lighter packers, as there isn’t much room to open multiple suitcases or store belongings beyond a small closet.
The windows face the street; while the coverings provide privacy, they don’t fully block out outside light. Combined with some street noise, this made sleep a bit challenging for me, though others may find it manageable.
Overall, this could be a good option for short stays or travelers who pack light and are less sensitive to light and noise.
Alojamiento muy limpio y ordenado, muy buena ubicación, zona tranquila.

This space was clean, great location, mattresses were comfortable and there was ample blankets and towels. Check in and check out was easy and Regina was great to message to check in on us. We would stay in one of Regina's Airbnbs again.
Overall clean, great neighborhood and great communication

Mera's place was exactly as described. It was clean, spacious, and in a perfect location to hop onto the Brown Line to get anywhere around town. The only drawback was exactly how noisy it was. I was prepared for noise from the train going by (based on reviews, etc.), but it was far more disruptive than I thought. The radiator was also especially noisy, which made it tough to watch any television from the living room at times (I'm sure this won't be a problem in the warmer months). This is no knock to the experience I had with Mera she was awesome), it is just a fact of the location/building, so you can be prepared in case you have any remote meetings/calls planned!

Great place! We went with our family of 4 and mother in law. Super nice comfortable beds and linens and same with the bathrooms. 3 stories so lots of privacy. Very quiet neighborhood. super close to the lake and lots of restaurants, shopping, everything. plus it's a beautiful  house especially if you love architecture. The house is from 1880 and has had additions over the years, but mostly super cool original.  Fantastic location. Only thing I'd say is you have to climb a lot of stairs to the bedrooms as two are on the 2nd floor and 2 on the third. No problem for us but my mother in law's knees were having a bit of trouble.  staircase is absolutely gorgeous btw.  We'd  stay there again  for sure

had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago. The location was excellent—close to major attractions, restaurants, and public transportation, which made getting around the city really easy. The neighborhood felt safe and vibrant.
The space itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The bed was cozy, and all the amenities I needed were provided. I especially appreciated the little touches like fresh towels and clear instructions for check-in and check-out.
The host was responsive and helpful, answering any questions quickly and making sure everything went smoothly.
Overall, I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago and would happily stay here again!

All in all a great place to spend your time in Chicago
This is the second time I've brought a large group to Chicago and stayed at Jordan's place. Definitely perfect for a large group and walkable to public transportation.

Localisation dans le Loop parfaite pour de nombreuses visites à pied. Proximité du métro (L) qui permet également de sillonner les zones plus lointaines. Chambre et accueil très satisfaisant. Nous y retournerons avec plaisir si nous retournons à Chicago !

We enjoyed stayed at Dovids’s apartment. Location and layout were ideal for our large family with young children. Since this is in the city, parking options were sometimes limited, so the residential parking permit and loading space were appreciated. Easy walking to public transportation and restaurants. We had a great Chicago experience and plan to keep his apartment in mind for our next trip.
Perfect spot for a Wicker Park/Bucktown get away. Coded entry into the building and the apartment gives you a little extra feeling of security. Will 100% book again next time we are in Chicago.

Great space and fantastic location in the west loop. Walkable to restaurants and pretty central for things requiring an uber. Very responsive host. Only caveat is needing a second person to open the garage door for both entering and exiting as it does start to close semi quickly. But once you get the timing, it isn’t an issue

Thomas and the Pavilion concierge team were exceptionally friendly and responsive, addressing every query promptly. When my toddler accidentally left a marker stain on the sofa, the host handled the situation with remarkable grace. The Lakeview location is ideal, with a wonderful variety of restaurants within easy reach. I would highly recommend this property to anyone.

It’s a pretty straight forward rental. Nothing overly styled or fancy;  just the required necessities for an Airbnb.  That totally works.  I say it’s a great place for younger travelers or families on a budget.

loved the place!
would stay there again, only if I am not driving... parking is a major challenge

Daniel's apartment is cute. Decorated with a blue theme. Coffee maker, toaster, art, walls, books on the shelf, bedding and furniture all have the blue theme. I nice big screen TV. Nice new dishes and glassware. I did not cook while there, though coffee pods are provided for the blue coffee maker. Each morning I enjoyed sitting at the kitchen table with coffee to watch the birds and squirrels in the trees from the 3rd floor window. The bathroom is new and has a nice tub/shower combination. Nice white towels and bathmat. I did not realize the unit was on the 3rd floor of a Chicago row type house. The only issue I had was with the stairway to navigate with luggage when moving in and out. Which for me as an older person was a bit tricky. I did have a nice time staying there. The neighborhood is friendly and I felt save in the unit at night. The Blue Line Belmont train stop is very close. Plus there are buses and you can walk places. Especially to TJ Maxx where I went shopping.

Amazing location: 20 minute walk to Michigan Ave, 40 minute walk to Navy Pier, 2 blocks away from L/subway. Included garage parking spot was very convenient- the Honda Pilot we parked was a tight squeeze and we lucked out that there wasn’t a vehicle in the spot next to us. Other reviews were helpful to know about the stairs which weren’t an issue for our group. Value was amazing and Assel is very kind!

We had a great stay here and really enjoyed our time in the apartment. The location was very convenient for us, especially because it was close to the subway and McCormick Place, which was perfect for our congress/conference.
The apartment was clean, nicely decorated, and looked just like in the pictures. Check-in and check-out were both very easy and uncomplicated, which made everything even more comfortable.
The only small downside was a smoky smell in the apartment. However, since the host clearly listed the place as smoking-friendly, this is more of a heads-up for future guests than a complaint.
Overall, we had a very good experience and would recommend this place to others, especially if they are attending an event nearby.
Extremely clean and very easy check in/out! Milan responds promptly to any messages!
Will always book with Milan!! Everything was easily accessible and responds very quickly! Will always get 5 stars from me :)
It was a great experience. I don’t regret it at all. Everything matched the description, it was clean, and they provided everything you need for the stay.
loved it so much we will be back

The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was very responsive and made check-in super easy, which I really appreciated. The location was convenient and close to everything I needed.
The apartment was very cute, clean, and located in a great area. Our stay was wonderful, and everything in the house was easily accessible. Highly recommended!

Really great stay. The place was clean, exactly like the pictures, and had everything we needed. Check-in was easy and the host was super responsive, which made everything smooth.

Great location! Easily walkable to restaurants, pubs and coffee shops. Only negative is that it is on a very busy street on a weekend. Lots of noise and fun outside!

We were so lucky to have found this place and will definitely consider staying here again and have already recommended to friends!

We had a great stay! The space was beautiful! We had a few minor requests to make our stay more comfortable and they were taken care of within 24 hours! Definitely recommend for a unique and fun downtown experience!!

Attending a conference in McCormick Place with a colleague. Two bedroom two bathroom apartment was much more economical option than most of the local hotels.
