Rooms and bathroom are functional and the kitchen has plenty of options if want to eat in.
Check process was simple (once you locate the main entrance door (some numbers had come off the door) as was check out. The apartment wa well temperature controlled.
All in all suited our needs nicely
Stayed here for a conference. Was a perfect location to the conference venue. An 8 minute walk. A 5 minute walk to the green line. The area felt safe

We got this place for nine people. We all felt very comfortable with plenty of space for all nine of us. It helped having two bathrooms. I love that there are two common areas; a very spacious living room with multiple so fast futons and the table and a dining room, large enough for all of us to sit down to have meals. The beds were very comfortable and rooms were spacious.
The area is beautiful and very safe. We all felt very comfortable coming and going at different times and never felt unsafe at any point. Although we rented a car in Houston a few times several of us used transit to get around. Everything we needed with within walking distance this is definitely a gem and wall absolutely consider this for our next stay.
The cleaning crew came in as we were checking out and they were extremely friendly and accommodating. They came in to do what they needed to do without making us feel uncomfortable. They were amazing.

Had a wonderful, easy stay at Christopher's place. Came to town for a show at Thalia Hall and the location was perfect. And the neighborhood is great. Lots of great food options and places to explore, but the apartment is also nice and cozy to just stay in and relax. Would happily stay here again. Thanks Christopher!
super clean and so close to the train and 10 min driving distance to all the cool attractions would definitely recommend

I’m a former Chicagoan, so I knew the exact neighborhood I wanted. David’s place is a lovely urban oasis. One full floor of living the Chicago experience. Great for two couples. A short walk to commerce on Chicago Avenue.  They even provided a new humidifier upon request!
We have stayed here a few times and always have a great experience and we have come to really enjoy the area around it. Great place to stay in Chicago.

It felt cheap, despite being in a very nice building. The host could have taken a few minutes to make it look more like a home than an airbnb that he flips for as little cost as possible. The cabinets had bike locks on them, which felt like we were intruding and clearly not at home. The soaps and shampoos etc. were the cheapest possible versions, and in their original packaging.

Great stay and cozy, comfy home for our visit in Chicago!
Our travel was made easier with this choice!
No trouble with neighborhood or neighbors. Quiet area.
Great location to be able to get in or away from the city.

My Mom and I really enjoyed our stay in the Apartment in Logan Square. The apartment was clean, the bed was comfortable, the location was great and there was a grocery store a few feet down the road. Our host Jim was most helpful and I can definitely recommend this apartment and would stay there again.
Perfect!! We just suggest blackout curtains.

Turquoise Wonder was a  great place to stay. It is located in a vibrant neighborhood close to restaurants and bars and there is a cute park a few blocks away. I was able to sleep, cook and get some work done during my stay.  Its also right by a main bus line. The host was responsive and made sure I had what I needed.  The place was clean and comfortable. I would stay here again.
Great place! We had a little scare after we lost an important ring but Alma helped us get back inside. Great host!
Amazing views, responsive host when I had trouble following instructions on the check-in and did I say amazing view!  The place was comfortable and I nice option for my family.
Charming home was as pictured and described in the listing. Robert was proactive and communicative. We had a lovely stay and would recommend.

I had an easy and relaxing few days at Saf and Megan's Airbnb. Check-in was simple, and the apartment was extremely clean, tidy, and comfortable. The hosts are friendly and communicative. The neighborhood is beautiful and close to the lake, with great restaurants and shops to check out. 10/10!

This place is a little gem. Walking distance to many restaurants and stores. The on-site full gym was the best feature in my opinion. Ridiculously clean. Loved the old elevator, and the location was excellent! Will definitely be back. Thanks, Tere!

Responsive host.

The stay was as described, you get what you pay for. I would stay again, however there is a roach issue as mentioned in another interview. Dead roaches found in the corner of bedrooms and live cockroach nymph found on pillow. Bedding and pillows were comfortable, but limited kitchen supplies.
Had a great time with two young kids. We love Andersonville and would happily stay here again!

We had a great stay. The apartment was in an excellent location, very clean, and comfortable. Milan was a wonderful host, and everything was just as pictured. We were attending a conference at McCormick Place, and the apartment was only about a 5-minute walk away, which made it incredibly convenient. It was the perfect place to stay, and we would definitely recommend it.

This is located in a perfect spot off the Argyle corridor, Lawrence L and 81 bus.
A personal anecdote is that I loved the vintage gate elevator!
The check in instructions are very clear and I was able to get inside easily.
The unit is on the top floor so no upstairs neighbors to interrupt your stay.
Parking was not difficult since I’m from the area and know where to park, but I understand how it could be difficult for those not used to the city. Download spot angels to find free non-zoned parking.
One area for improvement is cleanliness. A better wipe down of the kitchen area and baseboard would help a lot. I did inform the host about this post stay, but it did not affect my ability to have a comfortable and pleasant stay.
It was a lovely place, the kitchen was nice and the beds were cozy. Assel was also so proactive with instructions and was fast with reply’s! Overall great stay with my friends!!

Such a beautiful, luxurious, yet cozy Airbnb with the prettiest view of downtown Chicago and areas sorrounding. Also an amazing 360 view of Chicago from the rooftop! So gorgeous, such an amazing experience here, 10/10, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND! P.s. conviently located, everything you need is a small drive or walk away!

The location was great. Plenty of spots to eat or get groceries nearby. 30 min walk to the Hancock building. The space was very functional. Fantastic appliances in the kitchen, but the cookware was typical AirBnB quality- it got the job done.
Cozy & convenient.

This stay was very conveniently located for me. It is near the Garfield Red Line CTA station and also close to several bus routes that run frequently, which made getting around the city easy. The property is on the South Side but not too far in, so the location felt well balanced and accessible.
The house layout was very nice, spacious, comfortable, and clean. Everything felt well maintained and welcoming.
Nicholas was very informative, responsive, and kind throughout the stay, which made the experience smooth and stress-free.
I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others looking for a comfortable and conveniently located place in Chicago.
We loved our stay at the coach house. What a cute place! What a great location!! Jaime was a gracious & helpful host. Would definitely recommend.
Great location and great host!! Nothing negative about this place!
Milan was super responsive to several issues and questions that popped up over our 4 day stay. Price and proximity to McCormick Center were main reasons we chose this place.

We had a wonderful stay in the property! It was the perfect amount of space for our group of 16. All the furniture was very comfortable and clean. The property included everything we needed like towels and soap. It is a fantastic location, we were able to walk to the blue line each day. Most importantly, Assel responded instantly to every one of my messages. Highly recommend!
Great view from inside the room and from the public rooftop. Very comfortable and quiet.

Thank for the stay… The place was so close to the Univ of Chicago medical center and just a stone throw away from Jewel Osco. The housemates were friendly and helpful too. I had no worries leaving my daughter there for 3 weeks.
5 ☆ property.  couldn't fault anything. location i would say was hard to beat.
If you are considering staying here think no longer. The place is absolutely beautiful. The hosts are very attentive and really quick to respond

As a solo traveller this was perfect. The bed was cozy & the heater worked great! The shower was hot & had great pressure. I appreciated the bonus toiletries in the medicine cabinet. Lovely neighborhood, great access to bus stops. Such a lovely stay, I’d book again for sure!
We have to travel to Chicago often on business and will definitely stay with Bethany!

Great little place in a good location.  My only piece of advice to people thinking about booking this place is to know that the mattresses are probably the firmest memory foam I’ve ever laid on in my life.  But a great stay nonetheless.
Connie was great.  Very helpful with any questions and she checked in to make sure we were ok.  The room was as she described and we enjoyed our stay.

Great location and convenient for where I needed to be.  Walkable to the convention center.
Great stay! No complaints!
Great stay! Less than a 10 minute walk to the blue line, and 20 minute train ride to the loop! The unit was spacious and the furniture was comfortable! Loved the garage parking and washer/dryer too!!

Loved my stay here! Perfect location with tons of great food spots nearby, but still super quiet and peaceful. The space was comfy, relaxing, and exactly what I needed. Would 100% stay again—highly recommend!
Wonderful stay! No negatives!
Great place to stay in Chicagoland. Sean was  also a great host. I would recommend a stay here.

Stayed here recently and overall had a really great experience. The place was clean, spacious, and exactly what you want from an Airbnb—comfortable beds, plenty of room to relax, and everything worked as expected. Check-in was smooth and the host was responsive, which made the whole stay easy.
The location was convenient and the neighborhood felt safe and quiet. It’s the kind of spot where you can actually unwind without any issues.
Only downside: someone stole my baby Tyrone during the stay. Still not sure how that happened, but besides that minor inconvenience, everything else was fantastic.
Would definitely recommend and would stay again.

This place was great—plenty of bathrooms and bedrooms, which made it really comfortable for a group. I would absolutely stay here again with friends if I were just visiting and exploring the city.
In our case, we live in Park Ridge and are in the process of moving, so we needed a place nearby for a few nights while our family said their goodbyes. Traveling with my wife, two kids, and extended family, this home fit our needs perfectly
The place is simply wonderful.The place is silent.Although the subway is a bit far, I managed to complete all my activities.The place is always clean.I hope to return soon. 5/5 stars.

Place was great because it was centrally located to bus routes that takes you straight to downtown. Super clean as well and Erica promptly answered her questions  and allowed us early check-in as well🤗

Spent about 10 days here while recording an album at a nearby recording studio. The place is simple but has the basics of what you need for 4 people to stay comfortably. Nothing but great food in the area, and a nice quiet little park right across the street. For being this close to downtown, I was a little worried about the parking situation, but never once was I not able to find a spot on the same block. All-in-all a 10/10 stay!
This was a perfect place for my trip and I would be so fortunate to be able to  stay again for future needs. Amazingly helpful hosts, cozy rooms, and great access to a vibrant neighborhood!

Good location for commercial avenue, restaurants... Area seemed safe and clean, next to Hospital. Building was a bit old and lockbox for keys was in alley, but apartment was very spacious, comfy, and had full kitchen! Would stay again!

Nice little place. Had everything we needed. Garage was a huge plus as it was storming rain and snow and the garage made that so much easier to deal with. Having a fenced yard made me feel more secure about taking my dogs out. The bed and pillows in the main bedroom were very comfortable. Had all the basics we needed for our stay. Was a little dusty and drafty and it would have been nice to have Kleenex and garbage cans in the bedrooms but definitely not a deal breaker. I think a new shower head would certainly boost the experience, as well as a way to plug the tub for a bath. Otherwise for the price and location we were happy with our stay and would stay again if in the area.. Served it's purpose well.
Had a great experience at the residence. Plenty of space. Great sized tv! Perfect little porch on the 2nd floor. Would definitely stay here again!

I had a terrible experience at my stay at iris apartment. On our last day here we discovered cockroaches in the apartment and felt very uncomfortable to continue our stay there. I was understanding that things can happen (even though this was a very disgusting situation) and reached out to the host to see if they had another unit we can stay at. What angered me was a lack of response despite having been extremely responsive up until then. I have yet to hear from her even now, and had to go through air bnb for help. We ended up having to cut our trip short by the one night and drove back 10 hours home without any sleep due to the roaches and lack of help. Aside from that, the hot water and heater went out one night while it was snowing out and was freezing in the apartment.
This is the second time we have stayed here.  Well located and such a beautiful view!  Plenty of room for my family of 5.
Great place to stay! Especially with large groups. Plenty of bedrooms- all with TVs! And big open living space to peacefully visit as a group.

I knew I wanted to book a place in or near Logan Square, so I was lucky to have come across Benjamin's listing. The apartment is beautiful and spacious (I enjoyed lounging in the living room), and the bedroom with the queen bed had all we needed (we weren't looking for many amenities but mainly a comfortable place to rest after spending the day out and about). The place is around a 10-15 minute walk from the Blue Line and there were plenty of restaurants in the area (on Milwaukee Ave). This is a smaller detail, but I was pleasantly surprised by the framed LED bathroom mirror (which was awesome for doing makeup lol). I didn't mind sharing the bathroom with other travelers (there was a little bit of waiting), but that is something to consider if you plan to reserve a room here! Overall, this was a good place to crash and I'd consider staying there again when I'm back in Chicago.

Had a little hiccup getting the key out of the box because there had been a snow storm and temperatures dropped so the lock box had frozen & we were unable to open it. Even though we didn't check in until 8pm, Hugh was very prompt and responding and came immediately and got us in. Didn't have luck streaming TV, but we weren't there to watch TV, anyhow. It was walking distance to the train & we ubered to a few spots to lock in on a decent parking spot. I would definitely stay again! The place was really nice and loved the natural light and plants there. Great stay!

Great place to stay. Location is unbeatable, everything within walking distance or a short ride.
It has everything for a comfortable stay.
Minor cosmetic flaws that can be easily overlook for the great value that you get.
Most importantly the hosts really care about their customers, accommodating and welcoming
I will rebook for city events
Great place with plenty of space and location was on point. Clean, good amenities, and easy to access.

Lots of space for a family group of 9. 5 adults and 4 kids ( preteen to teen)
Beds provided in 4 rooms with 3 full baths and a large kitchen worked great.
Appreciated the snow removal right after it snowed. Location was great, too.

Great for a family gathering for our six children and their significant others. Large kitchen. Remodeled bathrooms. Ample off street parking. Extras in kitchen including coffee, tea, spices etc. Lots of toys and books for kids which our grandbabies took advantage of. We had a wonderful time!

Thomas was excellent. we had some issues in the beginning checking in and thomas was very proactive and responded with a solution extremely quickly. I wouldn't hesitate to rent from Thomas in the future.
Awesome home, beautiful and clean. TVs can be placed in the rooms, but overall beautiful and spacious
Terrific!
This place was great. The apt looks exactly like the pictures. If you are looking for a clean 2bd/ba place with plenty of room this is the place for you.

Yolanda’s place was our first short term rental in the city and it was perfect. She was so helpful and kinda and the space was the best place to land for our first few months in the city—quiet, comfortable, homey, easy to get to.
Great!
Beautiful place to stay. Dorian was super helpful and resourceful!
Would stay again - great location

Overall, everything is good. Yes, the building needs improvement and renovation — it hasn’t been updated in a long time and everything is quite old. There’s a slight odor, most likely from animals, so it’s better without pets. Overall, the location is excellent and the price is great. The price-to-quality ratio is fair.

The location was perfect. It’s literally a one minute walk from the Western Blue Line stop and the Bloomingdale trail.  It was comfortable, clean, and super convenient for everything we needed to get to.  Kath was a great host
Couldn't have asked for a better place!! It really felt like I got to live the city experience like a true local.
great place. close to entertainment and food. very comfortable.

Perfect stay for myself and husband and 3 kids (10,8,6).  We felt very safe! Loved being able to take the bus and brown line to downtown!   The home is very clean and host is very responsive to any needs and questions we had!
Comfortable place to call home base while we explored Chicago.  Would definitely stay here again!
Billy’s place was great for our trip to Chicago! Close and walkable to the United Center.
10/10, really great place and excellent host. Had a great stay and would love to come back!
Fantastic location, gorgeous views, great recommendations for local eateries, easy access to public transportation. I would love to come back!
We had a great stay. Parked in a garage around the corner and were able to walk 30 mins up Michigan Ave to the river as well as great restaurants and attractions along the way. Very safe area.
Nice easy place to stay…
Nice place to stay. Perfect for the family. Michael was responsive and the area was nice. The only downside was low water pressure in shower and kitchen, but other than that, no complaints!
I had a great stay! The host was very responsive and easy to get in touch with.
It was a cute home. I liked the location and it was quiet.
Rachel’s place was an amazing stay for me and my bestie!! We loved the workout area and the kitchen! The 10 minute walk to the train station and other stores were very accessible with the location!
X
This was such a great stay! We had a 10 month with us and the apartment was stocked with a crib, high chair, toys, and books! It was walkable to our wedding venue and was overall a great stay!

The location of this Airbnb is great! You are close to great bars, restaurants, and cool local shops. The price of the Airbnb is reasonable for the unit. Only minor things that  needs changed is there was no remote for the TV, and the broken blinds in the bedroom.

This was a beautiful place to stay. We really enjoyed it. The bunk beds and game table were super for our kids, and we appreciated having a garage parking spot. It was easy to get into the apartment and down to the garage. Any questions we had were promptly answered. The building was very quiet. The kitchen had a good assortment of cookware. A few notes for guests: Parking on the street isn't a big deal in the evenings (the permit spots aren't in effect after 5pm). Bring any edible items you might need if you plan to cook (spices, oil, etc). The spot in the garage requires a right angle turn, which is possible but tight with a large vehicle. The windows in the apartment face many other apartments' windows, so it doesn't feel super private unless you close the blinds.
Nice clean space, gave clear instructions on how to find the place, responded quickly to any of our concerns.

The space was exactly how it looked in the photos online. Very clean and well decorated space. We had a very small issue on arrival and the team was very friendly and quick to respond to resolve the issue. The security measures in place were great and made us feel safe. The location is a very short walking distance of the train station which was great. I can see how some people may not like it because of the noise, but we really didn’t notice it much, it was more like white noise of the city. I would recommend this place and go back again if I was in the city. There is private parking so you don’t have to worry about street or parking lots as well.

The place was spotless with plenty of room to stretch out and feel at home. The place looks and feels newly remodeled and the decor and furniture look to be for hosting. Hakim is wonderfully responsive and walked me through an issue I had with the coffee machine. it took a while and he was diligent to make sure I was able to use it. I would stay here again in a heartbeat. the location is perfect for someone who wants to enjoy the local flavors of Chicago's Albany Park neighborhood. easy to get downtown, but I didn't bother because there was too much to explore just on Lawrence ave.
Nice quiet space just outside of the city. Nice accessible amenities and the hosts were very responsive!
Love it. Loved her. Very nice and accommodating. 10/10
The description fit the house. Public transportation was easy to access; however, it was on a busy high traffic street.

Jerry hosts a nicely maintained home which feels a part of the very fabric of Chicago it was quiet while right near many many places to eat or shop. Offered spacious rooms and all the amenities one might need. Jerry made checking in clear and easy and was very responsive to all questions we would happily stay at Jerry’s again on a future visit.
I liked the easy access to public transportation. Quiet neighborhood. Far from the chaos.
nice place , great hosts and neighbors

Marty and Rob were very kind and made the trip very easy to navigate. Their place is very close to the Metra, and still easy to access the bus route to get elsewhere. I would definitely recommend staying with them if you find yourself in Andersonville.

My son and I stayed here for the Big Ten men’s basketball tournament at United Center. The short walk across the parking lot was convenient. And when we had to stay another day because of a snowstorm, we were able to work this out with minimal effort. Response times and overall attention to detail was top-notch.
Great Central location to S. Michigan Ave. Grant Park and a number of museums.  Great views from living room.

We had a fantastic stay and was thoroughly impressed with the quality of everything in the space. It is beautifully renovated and thoughtfully furnished. One of the best perks was having the park right across the street, it was convenient for getting some steps in the evening. Monica was a wonderful, responsive host, and would love to stay here again. Highly recommended!
Surrounding area was peaceful and quiet. Place was big enough to accommodate our group of seven. Thank you!

Had board of directors retreat here...space was adequate for our needs. Milan's communications were prompt.  Problems with uneven heating and kitchen not adequately equipped for meal prep.  Checkout time is early and cut short our meeting time.  Tried to negotiate one extra hour for our meeting if not being rented the next day so no inconvenience for cleaning staff.  Even though that was the case, still insisted on charging a late checkout fee.

This stay was unexpectedly good. And i say unexpectedly because upon getting there i found out that the building was a SHARED unit...so be sure to read thee FULL description of a place before booking so there wouldn't be any surprises🤦🏿‍♀️. The room was clean neat and tidy. There were a couple appliances that needed attention to but didn't interfere with my stay. I made the host aware of that and the host was very responsive with other concerns and help that i needed. If ur looking for a place to stay with parking and dont mind sharing the kitchen with other guest i definitely would recommend this listing.
Everything about this house was amazing!!! Definitely my go to home when I’m in the city moving forward thank you!!
Great host! Perfect location! Everything was in walking distance and so much to do! We will definitely be back!!
Great location. Building staff was friendly and helpful.

The property was just as advertised—clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The hosts were incredibly responsive and proactive, making everything seamless from check-in to check-out. Would definitely stay here again!

This place was a good find, all the things we needed were here. Its location is were you can walk to your destination. Jean was to accommodate us an extra day because of weather conditions instead packing up and moving to a hotel. We will stay again

Very responsive and respectful host! Decently close to the city and fun activities, can reach Wicker Park without taking the highway! Comfy space, felt right at home. Don’t forget it is a “basement getaway” so the ceiling can be quite low for someone of a certain height!

Overall a pretty good place to stay, only complaint we had is that we tried to message the host a few days early a question so we could get our check in times aligned and no response until a few hours before check in. :(

This space was the perfect quiet back drop for our st. patty's weekend celebration! As long time college friends we reconnected and made new memories in your lovely neighborhood and city. Although the snow and wind were a bit much for us west coasters, the culture, history, and art of Chicago is what really blew us away! Thank you for being amazing hosts, we hope to visit uptown again!

We had a very nice stay! The house was 2 blocks away from a train station. From there, it took 15-20 minutes to get to the loop. The bathroom and the kitchen were kept very clean all the time. The neighborhood area felt a bit sketchy during the night, but it was fine in the end.

The first thing I’ll mention is the most major and disgusting that happened while we were there. The host had her mother live with her and every morning and night we would hear someone excavating something from the depths of their throat. We come to find out her mother is brushing her teeth in the kitchen sink where everybody washes their dishes. She does it upstairs as well at night so in the morning she decides to come downstairs and do that. my friend had a package delivered and the mom picked it up and instead of communicating and asking who’s this could be just kept it cause she didn’t know who’s it was. Also on our leaving day we are asked to put the trash in the bin outside and I couldn’t open it cause it was crusted shut with ice it was not budging, so I tell her that the whole trash can was coming up from the bottom the host responds very sarcastically to me. “Well that’s how a normal trash can works”
This stay was not ideal, don’t stay here

I had some issues during my stay that made it difficult to be comfortable in the apartment. The bedroom was quite cold at night in winter, and using the heater in the living room made it too noisy to sleep. Either the door was open and it was slightly warmer or the door was closed and it was closed. Not sufficient blankets.
The overall condition of the unit felt more worn than expected from the listing. There were visible marks on the walls and signs of wear, and some areas, including the couch and floors, did not feel as clean or well maintained on arrival.
The host was responsive and offered solutions, including a space heater and the option to cancel the remaining nights, which I appreciated. However, the apartment did not fully match my expectations based on the listing.
The neighborhood is not super dense, and while there are amenities nearby, a car is a necessity.
Connie was GREAT! Location was perfect!
Close to the Blue Line, which is handy coming from the airport. Great bakery and coffee place across the street, Allez.
The very friendly guests
Bella was super responsive to my many questions and very kind each time :)

Freddy's place is worth the money. Close to everything you need. Host was very responsive,amenities within the apartment is toprated. The heater was on for our entire 14days stay. Thats increddible!.
I give the host a five star.

Rashad's place was immaculate, had absolutely everything I needed. He was accommodating and super easy to communicate with. It was 15 minutes to downtown and amazing walkable restaurants nearby. Would def stay again!

Place needs maintenance. Kettle is missing a handle, some cupboards are not opening/closing. Light in the wardrobe upstairs not working. Window kept falling out in the stormy night - was repaired next day but at the least convenient time. A/c in the main room is very noisy. Electricity stops working when toaster, coffee machine and stove are working at the same time. Carpet needs cleaning. I would not recommend the place for a family, but on the opposite side - location is great, kitchen is equipped, beds/kitchen/washroom clean.

Perfect place to stay if you want to experience the city! Super close to the train that takes you directly downtown and nice neighborhood. Host was also very helpful and friendly! Will definitely be returning.

Wonderful stay! We stayed for a long weekend and cannot recommend this spot enough. An incredibly short walk to the Brown Line gets you where ever you need to go in the City. The coffee shop on the corner is great and the neighborhood incredibly charming. The space is exactly what it says— a clean and lovely studio that gets the job done. Exactly like the photos! Would stay again :)
Super responsive host! Great location, it was a 5 minute walk to the subway which was very convenient!

The place was clean and as pictured. It is very noisy In the early mornings, view of a large parking garage with early garbage pickup in alley that was very noisy. The host required check in steps that took place outside of the airbnb app which is less than ideal, including not even allowing check in until out of Airbnb app “security deposit” was paid outside externally, which I hope to get back. All in all, central location, but the steps outside of Airbnb were extremely frustrating.
Nigam & Wendys accommodation was warm and inviting. Hosts were great with communication and suggestions. Premium and positive experience overall.

We had a great stay in Daniel’s place! It was in a nice walkable area near to everything, and was such a quaint a beautiful coach house. I loved sitting in the living room watching the snow fall in the courtyard. Would stay again!

Great stay in Chicago! Check-in was easy, the space was super clean, comfortable, and more spacious than expected. The area was quiet and felt safe which made it easy for us to relax after being out exploring the city. Our host was amazing. He was very responsive & truly went above and beyond (even surprised us with doughnuts one morning). Perfect location, about 7-10 minutes to major attractions with a food delivery hall right across the street. I’d definitely stay again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago!
Super nice location at a pretty affordable cost, it actually is bigger than the photos display which was a plus and they had everything we needed

The apartment was clean and was advertised accurately according to the photos and descriptions. It’s not in a walkable location to the centre of Chicago. The lock to the apartment is a flimsy coded lock would be very easy to break into if someone wanted to.

We had a mixed experience. The host was responsive and polite while trying to coordinate fixes.
However, there were several issues on arrival. The bedding was not fully prepared. Some beds lacked bedspreads/comforters, and there was hair on the pillows, raising cleanliness concerns. We were told this was due to the housekeeper’s first time cleaning without an audit and because they were rushing for our early check-in, though we checked in only about an hour early (2pm vs 3pm). We had to follow up and wait for replacements. There was also a toilet leak during the stay, which added inconvenience.
Access was also confusing. We were told there were two sets of keys, but the second only opened the back door. Since it was deadbolted, friends arriving later had trouble getting in.
The walls are thin. We could hear upstairs neighbors around 1am.
Overall, the stay did not meet expectations for cleanliness and readiness.
Very quick to respond. Great location. Highly recommend and would stay here again

Very nice stay. The place was large and well appointed. Very responsive host. It’s a nice private area in Chicago and walkable to downtown areas if you want to walk. We really liked this property. Great host with very clear instructions
Thomas is a gracious and kind host. He was communicative and helpful throughout our entire stay, even when the lock on the gate door had frozen shut! My friend and I can't recommend his home enough.

Great location, great value, really good vibes. The listing is as described and very comfortable. Hosts are friendly and responsive and exactly what youre hoping for w an airbnb. Only note is that the place has a bit if a fungal smell and I'd wake up feeling like something (besides a hangover) was affecting me. Overall, would rent again and recommend.
Great stay in a great location!

Host was very communicative, place was tidy and there were thoughtful touches throughout that made the stay feel luxurious.
The blue line was about a ten minute walk from the unit.
There was a learning curve to using electronic controls, but the most tech savvy person in our group had things down by the second day.
The amount of flights of stairs were accurately described in the listing. They were steep and very slippery to navigate in only socks.

The main complaint is that the space is not advertised correctly at all. It is not just a “comfortable room in wicker park,” but instead a private room in a very busy hostel. If you’re okay with a hostel where you may be sharing the space with 12 or more people, this space is good, but that is not how it is listed. There is also an employee, Pete, that stays up and cleans, cooks, or yells at other guests loudly in the kitchen right outside the bedroom after midnight. We stayed 4 nights and there wasn’t a single night where he wasn’t banging around the kitchen past midnight. I also think there are people living here that are up at like 5 AM getting ready for work. There is very little time where there are actual “quiet hours” being observed. On the last night the front bathroom was flooded and the back bathroom didn’t have a working shower. And again, the major complaint here is that the host failed to mention that the space was a hostel.
Marcos is a warm and friendly host. I found him  welcoming and easy to talk to. He has deep and interesting knowledge about his neighborhood and city.
Overall good place to stay.

Beth was a lovely host! Very easy to communicate with and clear check-in and out instructions. I stayed there with a few friends of mine and we had a wonderful time. It’s very open and cozy and has a great kitchen. We would return!
excellent stay would def recommend...just wish we could get the unit a lil warmer
Our stay was great! everyone onsite was nice and friendly the doorman Lucas was extremely friendly and always greeted us helped us with loading and unloading our vehicle. We will definitely be back!
Angela’s place is beautiful and warm. Great location and super responsive host. Highly recommend!
Very comfortable, affordable, and nearby many local commodities! Relaxing home and we really appreciate the responsiveness and care that was provided!

Thank you for allowing a last minute booking!  #1 thing that stood out was how extremely safe we felt at this location.  Once inside, the property looked just like the photos.  The shower was amazing and the bed and pillows were so comfy.  There was definitely enough space to sprawl out your purchases from an amazing shopping experience to nearby stores. Also, great restaurant suggestions from the host. Doni was extremely kind and made the experience even better.  He was very responsive to questions.  We decided we could just move on in and live in this space for a while. We would definitely stay here again.  Thank you for your hospitality.
It was an excellent spot with easy access to CTA buses and the L a few blocks away.
Great spot—very convenient and peaceful.
Great location! Pretty quiet and new appliances and furniture.
This air bnb was great for a mini trip. The space was very clean and well kept. The listing was exactly as described, and looked just like the photos. And the location was peaceful.

Great location, just 2 minutes from the CTA and 15–20 minutes to downtown. The bedroom is clean and comfortable, and the shared space has everything you need. The host is super friendly and always responsive. I highly recommend this place for anyone on a business trip to Chicago.
Great spot, with a responsive host. Overall a great place to stay

Tara was a gracious host and was always responsive, even at inconvenient times; near instantaneous responses! Had a clear and concise answer for every question we had and was always willing and helpful. Would stay again.

Absolutely loved staying here for our Chicago, it was beautiful, so spacious, and clean. We are very picky of cleanliness too and it met all of our families standards. Host was very responsive and helpful. The kitchen had everything we needed and the decor was gorgeous, made the home feel happy and welcoming. We felt right at home. The beds are a bit more on the firm side but that’s how I prefer it. We will book again next time we are in Chicago.

This Airbnb was a lovely stay for Sam and Kesha. A beautiful home. We also appreciated the host’s responsiveness about things that arose due to the weather (a big wind storm)/electricity.
5/5 - would recommend.

We were a group of 3 adults and 6 kids and everyone loved this Airbnb. The house was exactly as described.  Location in Wicker Park was perfect. The beds were all king sized and super comfortable.  Thanks, Sourabh!

Great place ! Amazing art and history throughout the house , quiet neighborhood , easy parking , friendly neighbors , super close to downtown and accessible to plenty fast food and fine dining restaurants, would recommend this place for family’s traveling to Chicago !
I had a great stay at this house it was very cozy, and the area was peaceful. I highly recommend it.

Everything was great! The place was clean, cozy and comfortable to stay in. The neighbors were quiet. The place was walking distance from a station which was nice. Overall, great place and we all had a great time!
The place is well located and well equipped for a stay and for larger family travel and the host is very responsive
Good communication and great host also great place to stay
Our family had a great time. The host was always responsive. We felt right at home. We look to return in the future.

Located in an ideal location close to Chinatown and public transit in a quiet neighborhood and had all the amenities we needed. The host was very responsive and the place was just like the photos. There were a few things that weren’t ideal. The front gate lock wouldn’t open and we had to reach over it to open it from the other side, one of the windows had a broken lever so we couldn’t fully shut it and it would get really cold at night, and the wifi stopped working the last night we were there. But overall, its a good deal for the price, Id recommend it for short weekend trips.
Good
Very clean, beautiful space inside and out to spend time with my family over our spring break.  I couldn’t have asked for a better location and place to stay!! Thank you so much, it was lovely.
Very nice place to stay in Chicago, a short drive to the city!
great host

We had a great stay at Sergio’s place. It was well connected to the city and it was relatively cheap for being in Chicago at St. Patrick’s Day. The living room and kitchen area was big and it had everything that you needed. Sergio responded very quickly. Every time I texted him about some thing on Airbnb.
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Will definitely be booking again !
It wasn’t a bad stay, due to me not reading fully I wasn’t aware the host would be staying too, and with that I wasn’t comfortable with that I’ve decided to cancel and leave 3 days into the stay.

stayed here for a few days this past spring. it was very clean and the host was very responsive when we had trouble checking in. the place was very close to the train station, and it was in a safe area. the apartment itself was more spacious than in the pictures, so it was a bonus! had a good time here :)
Spacious space in a very cute safe neighborhood. Would definitely stay here again!
Very clean and nice place and it felt like home.

Ewa’s place is incredibly nice! The style, furniture and decoration, everything is perfect. Ewa is really nice and she has some great book recommendations! Overall really great experience. I would love to stay there again!
Cute place, everything is well taken care off. Parking is easy to find. Walkable to restaurants and some stores. Great place for a couple of days for a couple. Micha is very responsive.
Good place. Clean and spacious for one person. It was the kind of place i needed !
Very kind and helpful hosts. Clean and comfortable space. Quick drive to great restaurants and local train stations.
Not bad, this price is very cheap.
Convenient location. The hosts were very communicative and open to feedback.
Great home and host was mist helpful. Clean and had all the items we needed. Lots of nearby shopping and restaurants.

I loved this airbnb!! Very close to the main roads and lots of restaurants. The host was very responsive and I loved that they had google docs with everything I needed. If you’re ever in Chicago, stay here!!

Noel is a great host, he lives close by and actually had a chance to meet him in person. Very nice, checked in with me every so often. Beautiful garden suite, fit exactly what I needed for my stay in Chicago. Pilsen has been one of my favorite neighborhoods by far, so highly recommend staying with Noel. Thanks again, my friend!
Great stay in Wrigleyville!
Great little mid-century home in a convenient location with everything required for a family trip. Property pics are accurate. Carmen was an accommodating host and quick to respond to messages.

The feel of a boutique hotel, in a cozy home that's all to yourself!  Thomas & Cynthia did a fab job of creating a modern, trendy space that's functional and comfortable.  Especially loved the well stocked kitchen, the whimsical wallpaper/paint decor, and the arcade space in the lower level.  For nighttime - excellent linens on top of mattresses that favor those who love a firm+supportive sleeping experience.  Nice little outdoor space in the backyard in the backyard, too!   This great space is an easy walk to Andersonville's main drag for great dining and shopping.  Combine it all with hosts who were easy to communicate with and you've got a real nice stay ahead of you.  Thanks, Thomas & Cynthia!
Lovely responsive host, and a great deal. Very easy airbnb experience, thank you :)
Cyndi was such a great host and super helpful! Would recommend this stay to anyone visiting Chicago - the L train being super accessible is another huge positive to this listing.
Great location. Great price. Easy access. Clean. Great amenities

Excelente departamento muy limpio y muy bien equipado, hay una linea de bus muy cerca que conecta con la Orange line del metro. El depto cuenta con muy buena calefacción y fácil acceso con instrucciones
everything was great.

Vin was very accommodating.  Due to bad weather, we had to stay another night.  When I inquired about extending our stay, he quickly responded to my message and extended our stay.  We've stayed at other rentals in Chicago and we would definitely stay here again.

Staying at Angie's AirBnb for our trip was an absolute highlight! Angie was a generous, courteous, and immediately responsive host; the apartment was beautiful and exactly suited our needs. The location is also spectacular - less than a 10 min walk from the pink line which can virtually take you anywhere in the city. The neighborhood the AirBnb is located in is also just so quintessentially Chicago! Our trip was fantastic and this AirBnb was a highlight. Really can't recommend it enough! We'll be coming back here next time we're in the city! Thank you Angie!
The place was nice and our host Tuan was very flexible. The neighborhood is nice, quiet, and easy to walk to catch a bus anywhere you want.
Everything as described

Magda was very responsive. Her place is in old building so you have to have those expectations. Water is warm, but the pressure is low. It was a great location, easy to get places. We had a great stay.

Josh was incredibly accommodating from the moment we arrived. The place was spectacular—spotless, well-maintained, and thoughtfully prepared. He provided an abundance of essentials that most hosts don’t even think about, which made our stay even more comfortable.
The bedding was high quality and very comfortable, and there were plenty of towels, pillows, and blankets available. Josh even generously offered us any wine in the cabinet to enjoy during our stay, which was such a thoughtful touch.
He was truly gracious and welcoming throughout. The location was perfect—right by Lincoln Park Zoo—with plenty of great places to eat and things to do nearby.
We will absolutely be rebooking in the future.
Very spacious and clean. The pool table was a great distraction for the kids. Definitely would rebook.

Overall, we had a good stay and would rate it 4 stars. The beds were comfortable, and all of the other listed essentials were provided.
A couple of things could be improved. There were not enough towels available for guests, and there was no iron. The living room couch also sat very low and had feathers coming out, which ended up scattered across the floor.
Aside from those issues, everything else was as expected and we had a comfortable stay.
Great stay. Gatis was extremely responsive and helpful. No complaints at all

Very accommodating, great location, had an amazing time at Chicago!
Great location, place had everything we needed. Jon had instructions as well everything else for our stay.
Wonderful place to stay! Clean, spacious apartment in a quiet neighborhood with easy access to public transit that can get you anywhere in Chicago. Highly recommend!
Very easy check in for solo travelers. Quiet at night time. Not much complaints about it.

I’ve stayed in several airbnbs before, but this is the first disappointing experience I have had. I clearly and professionally told Brandon that there were large yellow stains on the cots, breast milk found in the fridge, the upstairs toilet was truly broken (I had to keep temporarily fixing it) and no parking permits despite having confirmed with him twice. It was truly inconvenient and negatively affected our stay. The only reason we still had fun was because we had a good attitude about the situation. What bothered me the most was that Brandon didn’t acknowledge my list of complaints. Instead, he dismissed me and told me that “the CDC states breast milk can be stored in the fridge”; which is completely missing the point that there was breast milk in the fridge, clearly the Airbnb was not cleaned! He was unresponsive and distant during our stay, stating afterward my messages were “odd and concerning”. The quality of the Airbnb and his role in the process was odd and concerning.

Eduardo and Zully were amazing hosts! They were incredibly accommodating and made our stay so easy from start to finish. They kindly allowed us an early check-in and late checkout, which we really appreciated with such a big group. The beds were super comfortable and the house was stocked with great products and everything we needed. Overall, a wonderful stay and we’d definitely recommend this place to larger groups visiting the area!

Connor and Julia’s place was great! They were very communicative and helpful where needed and provided a wonderful weekend in Chicago for us. Check-in and -out process was a breeze and the added garage was a great bonus. All bedrooms were comfortable and bathrooms were clean. Would recommend to all.
Great space in a beautiful location! Very clean, private, and stocked with essentials, would recommend!
Good stay for the price but hard to regulate temperature inside with the radiator heaters. Not the easiest to get into as well.

Ed was a fantastic host! He was very responsive and provided clear instructions for both check-in and check-out. The place is cozy and comfortable. While there was a lingering smoke smell when we arrived, Ed had already set up an air purifier and odor absorbers, which made it acceptable. We especially appreciated the extra blankets in the closet. They were a lifesaver when the weather suddenly turned cold! Thanks for a great stay.
Such a great place here in the Windy City!!

Overall, the stay itself was fine, but it felt very nickel-and-dime and more focused on fees than guest experience.

Very nice place. The images don’t sell it well enough. Very spacious, lots of essentials and more in the home.

Good location and set up for a family weekend to celebrate a birthday and enabled us to be all under one roof.

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb on Berteau Ave in Chicago. The location was one of the best parts. The neighborhood is beautiful, quiet, and feels very safe. It’s the kind of area where you actually enjoy walking around and exploring.

The train station is also an easy walk from the house, making it simple to get into downtown Chicago or explore other parts of the city.
Inside, the place was extremely clean and very comfortable. Everything was well maintained and made for a relaxing stay after a day of exploring.

stay was amazing!
