Loved staying at Telly’s. It’s beautiful, cozy, and close to all the main stuff to do in the city.
The Airbnb was in the perfect location! Very close to Wrigleyville and a bunch of great bars and restaurants. James was very communicative and the check in process was easy. Would recommend!
Phenomenal stay for our trip. Wouldn’t hesitate to book again
Cerca al tren que te lleva al centro de chicago , lugar tranquilo, habitación limpia, ordenada , lo necesario para estar cómodo, baño limpio , ordenado , agua caliente. lo recomiendo 100%
Great stay! Was close to downtown, everything was walkable. Check instructions were spot on, had no issues getting in or out. Would definitely stay here again
Clean place, and nice host, the Chicago heater system was something to get used to but it was comfortable
We had a great stay!
Great apartment!

Amazing walkable neighborhood with a ton of restaurants and night life! Hosts left us with a few snacks, a few drinks, ear plugs to tune out the nightlife (that really wasn’t all that loud with us being on the 3rd floor), and plenty of recommendations! I would definitely stay here again next time I come to Chicago if it’s available!!

This was a good place for 2 for the weekend. Close to public transit and walkable to a lot of good restaurants. Also parking was easy to find if you’re bringing a car.
I will say this place is noticeably old, it does have the charm of an older building but also some of the issues. There was an off smell when we first arrived that seemed to dissipate after a day (or we got used to it lol). The bathroom is where you see a lot of the wear and tear. The bed was clean but the sheets and pillowcase had visible yellowing. Overall we still felt comfortable staying here and for the price, just don’t expect too much.
Great place enjoyed my stay

Great stay for our weekend trip. Enjoyed the many food options in the area, and proximity to bus/train stops. Home base with everything we need plus extra from the host, thank you for the coffee, wine, and water! Access to washer and dryer a plus. Huge tv and comfy couch. Highly recommend.
It was a great place for all of us to stay for the weekend. Location is very convenient to everything. Great building.
We were just there for a quick two night stay. The space was great for what we needed. We thoroughly enjoyed the space.
Very nice traditional Chicago apartment. Very convenient location. I would definitely stay there again when visiting home!

Listing is very accurate to real life. The kitchen had all the stuff we wanted or needed and a little more.
The area is very nice.
I particularly liked the host. Good communication, and check-out was super pain free.
A spacious apartment with plenty of room for 6 people.  A good location with lots to do nearby.  Would stay again when coming to Chicago!
Was very clean and just as listed. Host was helpful with very clear instructions.
Clean and spacious place! It was worth the price and would stay again. Thank you!
Kristal was very responsive and the place was very clean. I’d highly recommend this Airbnb for other visitors

This is a great place. We were able to easily accommodate our party of 11. It was clean and lovely. The location was as fabulous with restaurants, groceries and the train all within walking distance.
Host was responsive and communication was clear.
Being dog friendly was a major bonus.
Would happily stay here again.
Great location and value and the host was clear and communicative. Highly recommended.

Emily's place was terrific. she made it easy for us to get in and out. I loved that the check out process was easy: leave! she made it simple and the house was super clean and ready to go. lovely home with lots of charm.  she was amazing!
Great stay!! House was perfect for a large group!! Would definitely book again, and highly recommend to any big groups.

Truely a one-of-a-kind home.  So enjoyable we wish we could have extended our stay for a week.  My daughter in law said there was no reason to leave this spacious abode because everything was there at our fingertips…two kitchens, foosball, ping pong, large dining table for our 13 members of the family AND several spaces for the kids to chill out separate from the parents. This place is priceless !

Great place and it was perfect for our group of 12.  Location was perfect, safe and very close to a variety of restaurants, bars and grocery stores.  I highly recommend this property and my thanks to Mary for her help!

This unit itself was pretty great. The fact that they don't mention that this unit is the fourth floor and the only way to get there is stairs seems poor form. It didn't matter to my able bodied husband and his buddies other than being an irritant but I feel like that would matter a lot to most people. It should be disclosed in the listing for sure. I can only imagine showing up there are not being able to stay (older folks, someone with little kids, so many people). Clean, nice, the rules messages are a bit threatening but seems like maybe it is a language barrier? IDK.

Super cute and well appointed condo on the south side of Chicago.  Condo looked just like the pictures and everything was clean and comfortable.  Host was super responsive,  communicated well and even sent me a map and recommendation for a great running route in the neighborhood. 5 star experience for sure. Thanks for a great stay for us!
Tian’s place was great! Exactly what we needed for our large group. She was very communicative and answered quickly. Definitely recommend and plan on staying here again.
We had a great stay here! The pictures are quite different from the inside of the apartment, but nothing that made it too difficult.

We stayed at Laura and Dan’s place for 6 weeks while our home was under construction and it was great. They were extremely communicative hosts which was amazing. The condo itself was fully stocked and the elevator made it very easy to navigate with a baby. Additionally, the high chair and pack n play were great additions for us. The neighborhood was very nice and we enjoyed many walks and there was even a small park nearby. The garage parking spot was nice and street parking was also easy. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend their condo!
We enjoyed our stay so much! Such an adorable place. When I visit Andersonville again, I’ll be staying there!

The apartment was very clean and there is a small, but lovely view of Lake Michigan sunrises. There is no hammock swing. The ceiling leaked during a rainstorm, waking us up. We were only told of the possible leak after we had checked in on line. We were told repairs were underway.

Iris’ apartment is fantastic! Great location close to downtown Hyde Park. Close to restaurants, grocery stores, bars etc. also very walkable to the university. I stayed for two weeks and I felt very comfortable in the apartment.
Iris was also a great host, very responsive and dedicated to making sure my stay went smoothly. I would definitely stay here again and suggest it to anyone I know looking for a stay in Hyde Park!
Great location

It was a nice spot. Very loud being directly next to the train, but we quickly got used to it. The only things that were not to our liking was the toilet needing two pumps of the handle to actually flush, and the remote control light turning on randomly in the middle of the night. Other than that it was very comfortable and a great spot.
We loved getting to stay! We felt right at home. Sonya was quick to help us when we had an issue. 10/10!
Super nice place! Max is very nice and quick to respond. Bed is super comfy.

Host was very responsive during our stay!
We had a decent stay as a group of 10 (adults and kids). The kitchen had the necessities we required to cook a few meals during our stay. The apartment wasn't exactly as pictured, but we were comfortable enough and didn't have issues.
Our only complaint is the noise. During our stay we constantly heard, who we assumed were neighbors all throughout the night (voices, shouting and music). Ear plugs may be a good idea for light sleepers! The railway is also right behind the building, so you can also hear it throughout the day and night.

Great place and excellent host.
The only bad thing I have to say is that it was to hot or cold at times.
Loved staying at Randy’s place in Chicago as always! He’s an excellent host as well.
Great location in the heart of the city. Very close to the Red Line. Very safe and friendly building staff.
Andy was so friendly and made our stay comfortable and pleasant . I would come back here again!

Pro’s- Location was great close to public transportation, plenty of places to eat with in walking distance, wasn’t far from downtown, building is definitely secure, Rooftop was great with great views especially at night, check-in was easy with clear instructions, and the unit was clean!
Con’s (from my perspective) the pictures definitely made the place look bigger than it actually is, bedrooms are very very small wasn’t really even room to fulling open up our suitcase on the floor, towels weren’t great or what I expected for the price, the strict rules about no guest seem a bit excessive while I understand the host wanting to ensure there aren’t any types of parties I think not being allowed to have a guest or two over for a couple of hours is a bit excessive. We had a friend coming to pick us up to go out and had to have them wait in the car because of the strict rules and didn’t want our stay canceled. We paid 850+ for 2 night (fees & taxes included in that total) I expected more!
Fantastic experience in the Cardinal unit at the iKlektik House. In a great part of the city so made navigating our weekend a breeze.

Loved our stay in Hyde Park! The location is great, close to many shops, restaurants, and just a 15 minute ride on the Metra train to downtown. The neighborhood and building is rather quiet and enjoyable. The listing also accurately portrays the space. The only con is the apartment is close to the entryway for the building, so you hear people as they come and go.

Milan was wonderful—an excellent host. He was very responsive and his communication was always clear. I would definitely recommend this place and location. I only wish I could have stayed longer! Unfortunately, it’s very popular and was already booked for the dates I needed. Milan even tried to help me find other accommodations in the building that might work, but the dates didn’t quite align. Overall, it was a great experience.
James place helped make for a great family trip to Chicago. It was walkable to fun spots in Lincoln park and old town and close to bus lines. The rooftop deck provided a nice skyline view.

Can’t speak highly enough about the place. Was perfect for what I needed. Easy access to blue line, laundry on site, parking!!!. Truly a solid place and great folks managing it. Andris is an excellent host. Great to communicate with and on top of everything. Was there for months while my wife and I (recent transplants from Philly) acclimate ourselves to the area. This place exceeded expectations. Even surprised us with a mid point complimentary cleaning! The place is a gem and if you’re looking for a short term place to stay with easy walking to some of Chicago’s finest spots (20-30 mins). This place is it.
I had a great stay! I appreciate that Hugh was flexible with early check-in especially. The place was clean, spacious, and comfortable. Would love to stay here again!
Fue un gran hospedaje :)
The stay was nice in a pinch, the bed was comfy, I just wish the bathroom was cleaner, and I wish the bedroom floor was clean other than that everything was cool

Milan was a very responsive host and always made sure we had what we needed! The room originally didn't have an air matress, but I let Milan know, and a matress was brought to our room within the next hour. Milan always responds very fast. Check in and out was easy and complimentary bag check before check in is provided, very convenient. The room itself was very nice and the bathrooms were clean. There were times where the water would go cold in the showers however. Overall a good experience and would recommend!
We had a great stay! Close to the train, Shedd Aquarium and museums, quiet neighborhood. Host was extremely helpful and quick to respond. We will definitely stay again!
Great host! The place was spotless and Jocy was super helpful with every step. I highly recommend!
Beautiful place very clean. Host was always quick to response to any questions I had. Great area, will definitely stay here again in the future!

The Airbnb was bigger than it looks in the photos, which was a really nice surprise. It’s located in a relatively safe neighborhood, and we felt comfortable during our stay. Another big plus was that it was only a short drive to downtown, so getting around was easy and convenient. Overall, it was a great place to stay and I’d recommend it to others.

I have nothing but positive things to say about my stay here. The Airbnb was as pictured, the location was convenient and close to public transportation, and Walter was very quick to respond to any messages. I would definitely stay here again!

Ewa was truly wonderful. She was incredibly kind, always helpful, and went out of her way to make sure I had everything I needed. She really took great care of me and made me feel completely at home throughout my stay.
The apartment itself was amazing. The room was very spacious, spotless, and comfortable, and the bathroom was just as lovely. The kitchen was also very well equipped, which made it easy to cook and feel settled in.
The location is good overall. While there isn’t much immediately nearby and you may need to take a train or Uber to reach the city center, the neighborhood is quiet, safe, and very pleasant. There are also a few stores around, which is convenient.
I would absolutely recommend staying here!

Everything about this 2 bedroom apartment was perfect?  Very clean,  comfortable accommodations. Great  location. Along with the convenience of restaurants and grocery stores within walking distance...downtown was minutes away by Uber or train. If you plan to drive, there is free parking in front of the apartment. Jedidiah was an excellent host! We would definitely go back!
It’s a really easy way to get from Blue line station which can take you easily to the airport or downtown.

Spacious, clean upholstery, great deal of sunlight, easy check-in / checkout procedures, good quality kitchen equipment, next to whole foods for most of your needs, decent eateries / salon etc., 2 blocks walk from lake, therapeutic view of trains crawling with nice white noise (not bothersome at all), modern no-nuisance apartment complex not far from downtown and 20 min ride to navy pier / architectural skyline and river. Would recommend who wants to stay in vicinity of downtown
Our family really enjoyed this home, it was exactly like the pictures. Loved the area, would definitely look into renting again if we were to visit again! Would recommend to friends and family.

Pete’s was very nice place to say at in Chicago and the only thing was there a few stains on the beds but other than that I was able to relax and have good time. Pete and host were really good communicating if there something going on or clarifying things.
Great location! Comfortable space. Communicative hosts. And bonus: we were excited to read that the owners had installed solar power and gone electric.
Close to pink line train.  Fit our group well.
Very nice place in a very convenient location. Clean, tidy, and easy to check in. Perfect for group of 2 or 3.

The value is just not here. The place is absolutely worse for wear-- the furniture is all quite ragged (tables and nightstands are all warped and damaged), the mattress is absolutely destroyed and is nearly impossible to sleep on. The place had not been well cleaned (specifically the floors) and had an odor. The place just really needs some love and attention. I also found it odd that I could never contact the host, I was always put in touch with someone random who was nice and responsive, but it just felt a bit weird or misleading.

Had a great stay! The place was exactly as advertised, and Sezgin and the other hosts were very responsive and helpful throughout. The room was clean and the location was a convenient short walk to the train and restaurants.
Worked well for our family of six.  Thank you!

This home is beautifully appointed & in a great location on a quiet street. It is within walking distance to restaurants, entertainment & public transportation. Don was responsive to communications & sent information in a timely manner. Parking is difficult as streets surrounding the area are by permit only. This wasn’t a problem for us as my sister lives close by & I left my car there. We enjoyed our visit & would recommend it for anyone wanting to stay near Wrigleyville!

They were so quick to respond to every message I’ve sent! The location was great, walkable to many great places but not in the overcrowded area (but a very easy uber ride to get there, or even walk)! I would recommend this place to anyone who goes to Chicago

Andre was a super responsive and accommodating host.
It’s not unusual with the nature of life and traveling that sometimes things don’t go 100% according to plan. We had one such episode and Andre was beyond accommodating! He initiated an accommodation which helped our situation out tremendously.
We had everything we needed in the unit, and if we didn’t, he didn’t hesitate to provide it. The kids loved the upstairs area and there were plenty of bedrooms to choose from. There was a park within walking distance for the kids and convenience stores as well. The unit was located close enough to the highways so much of our time spent in Hyde Park was really accessible.
Overall, we had a great stay! We’ll look his unit up whenever we’re in Chicago next.

This place is ONE OF A KIND- such a beautiful and unique place to stay in Chicago. Loved the neighborhood and how close it was to vintage shops, cool restaurants, and local businesses. As an LGBTQIA+ traveler, I felt super safe (and it's a few blocks from a queer bar, Dorothy). Everything was wonderful, highly recommend for a staycation or travelers looking for a local, unique Chicago experience!!
this place is in a great neighborhood walkable to many restaurants and bars. The airbnb is really nice and street parking is available and Bradley is a great host.

We appreciated Rasheed’s beautiful two bedroom two bathroom home. It was the perfect accommodation for our visit to Chicago. The neighborhood was very safe. The accommodations were exactly what I expected from the photos. When I was in need of guidance or had any issues, Rasheed quickly responded With simple clear instructions.

I need to take one quarter class at UChicago. So this location is a huge plus to me. Walkable distance to the university and closes to everything. Room is very clean. Neighborhood is quiet and safe. The kitchen is nice with all the equipment you need,although I don’t cook.
Co-host Rachel is super nice.she is proactive and communicate well. She responses right away every time I have any questions.
Definitely will recommend this place
Edward was a very flexible and understanding hose with a beautiful place! Thanks for a good stay!
Excelente anfitrión muy amable y cordial, nos sentimos como en casa.

I had a great stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well located. The host was helpful and communication was easy. There was a bit of noise from the upstairs neighbor during the last two days, but overall the stay was very good.
It was a great place, very helpful hosts

Everything was as described and more. I appreciated how clean her home was and the privacy I received. My host often responded to my messages within 30 minutes. There were also clean linens. My bedroom was extremely comfortable and spacious. I will definitely stay with her in the future.

Afsha was an incredible host, extremely responsive, gracious, and helpful. We felt immediately at home in her beautifully decorated space which was perfect for our family.  She thought of everything needed to make our stay comfortable and inviting. Having a private parking space was a huge plus! We were especially grateful for her understanding and grace at our mistake about the checkout date. I highly recommend her place and know you'll enjoy it as much as we did!

My wife and I flew into Chicago from Phoenix. The apartment was so comfortable, so relaxing, and so beautiful. Whenever I reached out with any questions they responded promptly. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone visiting Chicago.
Great location. Parking not easy if you have a big truck.

Spent a week with a few colleagues working out of our office based in Fulton Market and hotels are a drag after a few nights. This property was the perfect choice. It was well appointed for everything my colleagues and I needed, the hosts were incredibly responsive and gave great detailed information about the property, and the location was ideal. I'll stay here again in a heartbeat.

Perfect place for price, despite reviews I never felt unsafe. It was incredibly easy / cheap to travel to downtown by scooter / lyft. Walked around area at night and didn't have any issues. The hosts were also very accessible and kept the place clean.
Overall a great deal, you just see many homeless (there's a homeless shelter). They minded their business, you smile and walk past. Great stay if you aren't afraid of the reality of the world. :)

We had a great stay! The room was super clean and the sheets were really soft. Breakfast was great especially the waffles :) The shared bathroom didn't end up being an issue at all. The neighborhood was LGBTQ+ friendly and had many cool spots to check out. Overall we would definitely recommend staying here!

I really enjoyed my stay in John's place! I was in Chicago for a 9 week internship, so having a great place to be my "home" during that time was very important to me. The apartment was amazing for that! The couch and beds were extremely comfortable, and John was very responsive when I had questions. The location could not have been better; it is within walking distance to many great restuarants/coffee shops/shopping, and my commute downtown for work was very easy with a Brown Line stop being very close by, along with several bus stops. The area felt very safe and quiet as well. I would definitely stay here again!

Ideal location in downtown Chicago between River North and West Loop. The host was very helpful throughout the process and quick to communicate to a few questions. Overall, fantastic place! Very clean and spacious for a group of people and the building amenitites are top notch!

Stayed here with my family during spring break , & we all loved it . Quiet neighborhood, everything was perfect  & looked exactly like the pictures. Brandon was very easy to communicate with and quick to respond when I had questions about  something . Loved how clean everything was. I would definitely recommend Brandon’s place
Beautiful place and perfect layout. Easy to get to downtown and had plenty to do within walking distance

Our airbnb in the app said unit #322 but upon entering the code and entering the apartment someone else was staying in the unit. Double checking messages, we were told to go to a different unit, however our given code opened someone else’s unit? Upon entering the new unit which was unlocked and had no key, it was not clean or ready for check in despite us arriving after check in hours. The host said they thought we would drop our bags off at 2pm (which we asked for) and leave and that’s why the unit was not clean. Doesn’t make any sense since check in was at 4pm. Also if we had left our bags at original location, would another stayer have access to our stuff? Overall, does not seem like an organised system and the fact that two units may have the same code is unsafe. We were given a refund and communication was great, but overall would not recommend.

We stayed at Joanna and Michael’s place for several months and had an excellent experience. Because of our situation, we had to extend our stay multiple times, often on short notice, and they were incredibly flexible and accommodating, which made our temporary time in Chicago much easier.
They were outstanding hosts: kind, responsive, and thoughtful. Communication was easy, instructions were clear, and they helped with practical day-to-day logistics. The place was clean, well-maintained, and very comfortable even for long-term living.
The home is also thoughtfully curated, with art/posters reflecting history, nature, and movements for justice and liberation. Great location too: a short walk to the bus (easy to reach UChicago/downtown) and to the lakefront for walks.
Highly recommend; we’d happily stay again.
Beautiful, comfortable and well appointed unit. Very convenient location.
Jenny is an amazing host who takes incredible care to make sure you feel right at home. We had a great stay!!
Great spot, quiet, very pleased

Lush, layered, green in all the right ways: it walks that joyful line between old-world charm and something quietly modern. The natural light, the interior design, the obvious care in how it all came together. A few images hang slightly askew, not everything is perfectly placed — but honestly? The overall composition is breathtaking.
In all my years on Airbnb, this was the least I've ever heard from a host. Also, I was asked if I'd mind checking out at 8 a.m. to accommodate their photographer and the next guest. *Huh?* On an $800+ two-night booking?
The washer and dryer didn't work, and that wasn't mentioned before I arrived. Parking wasn't clear. Every appliance clock was wrong. The furniture wasn't spotless.
None of it is unforgivable. But it added up. Because our interaction was so sparse, I genuinely can't tell you what their hosting style is, only what I experienced, which was mostly silence where there could have been care.
Dorian is a really nice person
Amazing space. Very clean and comfortable.
Great stay in a perfect location!

Very nice place to stay. Comfy bed in the full room. Communal kitchen was very nice and clean. Great location!!! Logan Square is an awesome neighborhood, so much to do nearby. Very close to two CTA stations. Only comments are that sometimes the toilet had problems flushing.
My first stay at a garden unit and it turned out great!
I absolutely loved this place. I felt right at home. The amenities were amazing and the host was super flexible and responsive.  Location was perfectly located to everything.
Everyone enjoyed their stay!
We had a great stay definitely would book again😊
Decent place in a great location, just have to be mindful of noise for neighbors & the radiator for the heat is pretty loud depending on how open it is but overall I would come back!

This is my second time in a row .
Excellent rate quality-price

We had a fantastic multi-month stay here while our home had to undergo significant, unexpected repairs and construction. The house was clean, comfortable for my family with two young children. It had everything we needed to feel "like home" during an unanticipated long stay. The location was fantastic too, and the home was exactly as pictured. Easy to walk or drive to all the wonderful things in Bucktown/Wicker Park and beyond! Easy street parking too, for yourself or visiting guests.
The host was wonderful to work with—very responsive, action-oriented, thoughtful and so kind throughout our entire stay. We truly appreciated having such a welcoming and reliable place, and supportive host, during a challenging time for our family. We would absolutely recommend this home to future guests for either a few days or an extended-stay.
Beautiful inside, definitely worth the money. I had gone for a weekend get away and I would recommend anyone to come here. It’s close to everything and almost everyday you can walk somewhere new.
Great place to stay, beautiful house, close to everything, totally recommended. Hosts were flexible for check in and despite of our mistake for timing on checking out they were nice to help us
Fabio's place was just as pictured. It was clean and practical. A guaranteed parking spot in the back of the building allowed for easy parking, and a stress free stay.
Jamie was a fantastic host. She’s both friendly and helpful! Her place was very clean and organized.
这是我第二次住这个民宿，非常喜欢
Great place, easy check in and out. Bella is super responsive!

We had a fantastic stay. The location is hard to beat, right in the heart of everything, yet the property itself is incredibly quiet and relaxing. The place was spotless when we arrived and clearly very well cared for. The hosts were also extremely responsive and easy to communicate with, which made the entire experience smooth from start to finish. We truly enjoyed our time here and would absolutely stay again. Looking forward to many more visits in the future.
Nice place

I had a wonderful stay at this unit. The location is fantastic and I especially appreciated how accessible the space was for someone with limited mobility.
I did run into a minor issue with the thermostat during the stay, but it was a building issue. Patricia was incredibly responsive (even late into evening) and communicated promptly to help resolve the situation. Despite that small hiccup, I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

My partner and I had a great peaceful experience. Although bed and TV are tinier than expected, the huge kitchen made up for it as we like to cook. Great neighborhood and AMAZING host. I truly appreciate how I could count on them to respond. Communication and Hospitality: A1. Thanks Lofts 747!

Zhi's place was great for a short term stay! The place had everything I needed. Room was nice and clean, had a portable heater also in case you get cold. Bath slippers, shampoo, and body wash were provided as well! I would definitely stay here again!
Excelente ubicación! Teníamos todo súper accesible, súper cerca del millenium park. Tenía excelente vista. Nos encantó! Seguro lo volveríamos a rentar

This apartment is truly a hidden gem in the city. The place was very clean, beautiful, and well equipped, making our stay extremely comfortable.
Parking was never an issue—we were always able to find street parking right in front of the apartment, which is a big plus in Chicago.
My coworker and I stayed here for three weeks due to work, and we were very happy the entire time. Roberto, the host, was always in constant communication, very responsive, and quick to help with anything we needed.
The neighborhood is very safe and quiet, which made our stay even better.
Highly recommended for anyone visiting Chicago, whether for a short or extended stay!

Assel was a very kind host who was highly responsive and easy to communicate with. The apartment was in a great area between downtown Chicago and surrounding neighborhoods. It is also walking distance from multiple L and bus stops. This is a great place to stay for large groups!
Amazing stay !!!
My stay felt like home away from home. Very comfy and cozy. Thank you for everything.
Thank you for the great stay.

We stayed here for a university trip and it was plenty of space for nine adults!! We all had an incredible time and this place was perfect walking and transit distance sp we could always come back for a rest during the day if needed. The skyline views and balcony space are absolutely breathtaking and we would happily stay here again in the future!!
Lovely stay at Anny's-- exactly as pictured, with a very roomy bathroom and common area! Anny was very warm and responsive throughout the stay. Really enjoyed our time here!

Mom here traveling with teens. This was perfect for our spring break adventure. Comfortable with nice view. 3 bedrooms - all with its own TV. Living room on too. Location was just out of the busy city yet just minutes away. All of us slept great, beds and pillows are very comfortable. Nice little community, everyone was very friendly.
Host was always available to answer our questions and made great food recommendations for our evening outings.
2 things to note - no microwave which was a bummer as my girls never eat a full meal at restaurants.
Parking wasn’t too bad but when we went out in the evening we had to park a bit far away upon return.
Knowing all this if I had to return to Chicago I would definitely stay here again.

I very much enjoyed my stay. The host eas incredibly responsive and kind and gave very clear directions on check in and check out. Neighborhood was very safe and welcoming and there are great local restaurants to check out. Would definetly recommend.
Great place! Would stay again. Great for a dog

My friends and I really enjoyed our stay here! The space was pretty clean and spacious and Assel was always readily accessible and responded quickly to my messages.  So glad we found this place. Would recommend!!

This beautiful home exceeded my expectations, and the location with easy access to the Blue Line was very convenient .
The modern chic en suite bathroom felt like a little luxury retreat after a day of exploring.
The hosts were responsive, and seemed to genuinely care about their guests’ experience. I’d highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area and would love to stay again!

This was a great place to stay and worth the price in my opinion. If traveling with a family/group it’s very cozy yet spacious, quiet and private with nice views from the windows and roof. It feels lived in with several amenities. I was confused at first about the washer and dryer as they’re not in the unit itself but are still inside the building for guest use. The building is also close to the train for easy transportation with several places of interest not far from that. The hosts are helpful, respectful and responsive in a timely manner. If you’re looking for a great deal of a stay I highly recommend this location!

Wonderful experience overall. The host was incredibly responsive and clear in communication, making the entire stay smooth and stress-free. The home was very stylish, and the architecture of the space added a lot of character and personality, making it feel both welcoming and thoughtfully put together. Would absolutely stay again and highly recommend.

We loved being so close to everything in Hyde Park and we had an excellent stay. The apartment was exactly what we were looking for and we'd be happy to stay here again if we are back in Chicago and Hyde Park. Thank you!

Um bom custo benefício. Otima opcao para casais.
Agradeco a estadia.

Absolutely perfect. Place was easy to get into. Everything is in walking distance. Parking is tricky, but there is a public lot you can park in and pay a small amount just down the block. Would absolutely visit again !!

This stay was exactly what I needed! The space is exactly as pictured & the finishes give it a luxury feel. It was easy to check in and the host is very responsive. If you’re looking for a bit of peace and quiet while feeling like you’re at home, this is the place for you. I would book again!
Incredible house and location! Can’t wait to stay again
Super cute & cozy with so much space! Kerena was friendly and great to work with. This last minute find turned into a treasure!
Good place to stay

I politely said uhh no, you can’t charge unstated fees after a guest reserves. It had the essentials for a solo adventure in Chicago. neighborhood is very walkable with lots of coffee shops and restaurants nearby to really feel like a local in the city. travel to and from downtown and major sites was very easy with a metro station close by. overall good stay for what you need to visit a city. wifi worked great and felt safe the whole time. it is an older building but for light sleepers, Brad provided ear plugs. enjoyed experiencing Chicago via this quaint apartment.
Rain’s place was perfect for my stay in Chicago. Awesome location — highly recommend!
Was as shown and described perfect location for us would recommend having a photo of the parking space so can find from the rear of the building easier otherwise very good experience

This was our second stay at Erika’s place.  We really like staying here because it is so clean, well-stocked, quiet and very convenient to our daughter’s place in Lincoln Park and it’s close to shopping and nice restaurants.  Erika is always quick to respond to questions. We will definitely stay here again.

Loved staying in this place hosted by Demitri. Prior to check-in, he was very responsive and answered all of the questions we had. Once we arrived, we enjoyed the space and the pristine location, just next to the Brown line station. While it was a lengthy train ride (45-50 minutes), it dropped us off right where we needed to be. In terms of the place, it was quite clean and organized. The temperature of the space was quite warm, which would get slightly uncomfortable at night. We had a slight issue with the refrigerator, however Demitri was prompt with answering our concerns. Overall I would recommend this place for a solo traveler or a couple.

We have stayed at countless rental properties around the world, and this was the best experience we have had.
From the accurate listing and photos, notes about parking spot size and number of stairs in the unit, cleanliness and privacy of the unit, to his rapid response time, Fed has - for us, at least - set the bar high above the rest.
We cannot wait to get back to Chicago, and Fed’s place, asap.
Stayed 5 nights, worked great for our purposes. Enjoyed Bronzeville location, easy commute to downtown.
Everything was perfect, would stay here again.

What a wonderful place to stay in downtown Chicago! The location is amazing with so much to do within walking distance. Chicago Hospitality Club was very responsive and helpful, answering all our questions and even anticipating points of confusion in advance! The home itself is very quiet and well appointed.
Great stay, parking is a little tight but this is a beautiful home!

We checked out around 9.30 and thank you. Except a bit of street noise it served our purpose. You may want to consider changing blinds on street side and the curtain in bedroom to cover sunlight fully. Sounds there is not much you can do unless you want to spend a lot to get sound proof windows and get the back doors sealed. Adding another strong dead bolt on the front may make people feel more secure since it is right on the street? Overall it is okay! Thanks.

Great Value for a No-Frills Stay
The Highlights:
• Reliable Basics: The essentials are well-covered—hot water was consistent, and the linens and towels were perfectly clean.
• Climate Control: Both the AC and heat worked effectively, keeping the room comfortable.
Things to Note:
• Sound Sensitivity: The walls and ceiling are quite thin. I could clearly hear conversations and coughing from the unit above; at one point, it was loud enough that I thought someone had entered my room.
• Simple Amenities: This is a budget-friendly, "no-frills" choice. You won't find extra perks or "homey" touches, but it handles the basics well.
Overall: You get what you pay for. It’s a solid, economic choice if you just need a functional place to crash.

We had an amazing stay. The place is stunning — honestly even better than the photos. Watching the sunrise from the living room was a highlight for all of us. The apartment is spacious, beautifully designed, and very comfortable. Wendy and Matt were incredibly responsive and friendly throughout. Would absolutely stay here again.

Great location and very spacious house. We enjoyed our stay. The only reason for losing one star for the listing being accurate is due to the pool being shut down during our stay. It was an amenity my kids were excited about and one of the main reasons for booking this place because it’s an indoor pool in March. When I booked, the listing showed the pool and a picture. After booking, we were not alerted ahead of time that it would actually be down during our stay. The listing was updated recently but again, no notification directly to us so we had no way of knowing. The hosts were very responsive and made sure they tried to help us however they could during our stay. We had a great trip and really enjoyed the space this place gave us for our kids. Thanks for hosting us!!

I have never been to an Airbnb this dirty and unclean. I was shocked when I arrived because the bathroom was extremely dirty. The toilet seat had so many pee marks, worse than any public toilet I’ve seen. There was hair everywhere, and it felt like a neglected public space. The bed sheet had many marks, stains, and hairs, as if someone had stayed there for days. The kitchen stove had dried food stuck on it, the cups were not cleaned, the carpet had leaves and dust, and the sofa had food scraps. I had to call the host to clean the apartment again. He only manages the place, and someone came to clean who did not seem professional and asked me where to clean. I had to direct him myself. He only cleaned the areas I pointed out instead of the whole space. We had to wait two hours while he cleaned. Even after the bedsheet was replaced, the new one was not properly clean either. The neighborhood is not noisy, but not so safe.
Perfect place to stay! Easy access to the Metra. Would absolutely stay here again if back in Chicago

Nos sentimos muy bien en ere alojamiento, nos encantó que estábamos muy cerca de las estaciones de bus.
Además muy amables todos, y un pinto muy muy importante es que todo estaba muy limpio. Muchas gracias
Greta price for what you’re getting. Perfect for solo travelers or couples. Will be back!!

Had a great stay, host was responsive and understanding. The shower was a little janky, when turning on the shower there was barely any pressure and the handle needs to be fixed. Everything was fairly clean besides some stains on the walls in the bedroom. The bathroom vanity did have some prior damage and the fan in the bigger bedroom was unable to turn on, host said there was a remote for it but we couldn't find it and there was no switch. The kitchen was stocked with utensils and dishes to use. At first parking was a little difficult to figure out but once figured out it was easy to find the garage and it was nice being able to park inside. Overall, our stay was great! The location of the apartment was around 20-30min from downtown depending on traffic, and there was a grocery store across the street and a Starbucks just a block down the street. If you are looking for a peaceful place to stay at with a responsive host, I would recommend.
Had such a great stay here. Host was super friendly and hospitable. There were a lot of cafes and restaurants nearby. 10/10 would stay here again

We had a great stay at Tatiana & Roupen’s place. The location is fantastic with easy walking access to many places. The place was quaint and clean. Kitchen was well stocked and we did make a meal there.  The beds were comfortable. They do disclose that the hot water takes a long time to reach the apt so you just need to turn it on for 5-10min beforehand- it was not an issue for us. They also left nice welcoming snacks and water for us which was appreciated. Thanks for having us!

There is a lot of good at this location and a two watch-outs.
Positives
1. The location is in a great part of Northern Chicago. It's a peaceful neighborhood with a lot to do within a short distance.
2. Having 8 bedrooms in one place is a rarity. We had enough for our family to stay together which was greatly appreciated.
3. The host is quick to respond and accommodate.
4. Beds were comfortable.
5. There were board games, video games, foosball, and a pool table to help entertain a group.
Issues
1. No dishwasher. When having a lot of people in one place, a dishwasher is more than a luxury. I also was concerned about how well everything was washed before us.
2. The downstairs bathroom window could not close, and two of the three bedrooms had windows that had didn't insulate. The one I stayed in had glass block around the outside, but only a thin piece of metal in the center that let in a lot of cold air. If it was colder outside, these rooms wouldn't have been inhabitable.
Matthew was so kind and understanding I was really looking forward to our stay, but we had to cancel due to some transportation issues from our side, but I will definitely book with him in the future
Very comfortable and clean stay. Felt right at home. Loved that it was a secluded stay but still close to everything. Missed my flight but the stay made it better and I am happy that I did.
Stayed for two months, and loved the place. Super convenient access to the CTA, and right to some amazing restaurants, Mister Tiger and D’Amatos!

Kennan's place was exactly as described and he provided a wonderful stay. From the flexible (early) check-in to check out, he was always responsive. The apartment is in a great location with so much to do within walking distance. We've stayed in Chicago many times and love the Andersonville area quite a bit. It's nice to find a place to stay so close to everything that we love about it.
My stay was comfortable and spacious
Patricia’s place was the perfect place for a girls trip to Chicago!

We had a great stay at this Airbnb and would absolutely stay here again. The space was very clean, spacious, and beautifully updated. The design felt modern and stylish, and it created a comfortable place to relax after a long day exploring the city.
The kitchen was stocked with all dishes & cookware needed to cook a meal, which made the stay easy and convenient. The host put care into making sure guests had what they needed.
A couple things to know ahead of time. The walls are a bit thin so you can hear noise in the building and the street noise from outside, so it may not be the quietest option if you are a very light sleeper.
There is also a staircase leading up to the unit with uneven steps that curve to the right, so just take your time going up.
Overall, it was a great place to stay. Clean, spacious, & thoughtfully set up for guests. We had a wonderful visit & would recommend it to others looking for a stylish and comfortable spot with lots of space.
We enjoyed our stay

Great location but needs more updating. Host was unresponsive when we were contacting them with problems. The front door was not working at some point and the kitchen door’s keypad didn’t work as well so we couldn’t leave without the fear of being locked out.
Great place to stay, only negative was my car getting broken into but I could’ve been more careful by not leaving valuables in the car. Other than that great place great location

The perfect place for an artist’s city adventure! Beautiful location with a classic ‘big city view’ with friendly people that make it feel safe. My teenagers and I loved it 🥰 The hosts were always responsive and helpful! I highly recommend it!
Place was nice a clean and Host were very polite and helpful !
Always great  communication! My family and I loved the location. We always feel at home when we stay! We will be back! Home is always clean and beds are comfortable! Close to everything.

Although the apartment was in a nice neighborhood and had modern furnishings and furniture, I unfortunately had to leave because of the outdated and unclean floor air vents. At the time , there was a large amount of dust, hair, mold, debris and drywall in the vents, which I am highly allergic, and forced me to leave a couple of days in to my stay due to a severe reaction. Noted, I would have stayed in the apartment if the air was clear of debris.

I enjoyed the space. The neighbor downstairs was extremely welcoming and helpful. The keyless check in really helped. The price for the space and the neighborhood was great. I also had no problems parking (even late at night). If you know Chicago, that’s a HUGE deal! I will stay again.
Quick and responsive communication👍
This was our 2nd stay here with a large group & we would gladly visit a 3rd time, thank you again!
The apartment was perfectly located on the Damen St CTA. instructions for check in and entry were very clear. We enjoyed this space and hope to return again soon.
It was a very comfortable stay in a great neighborhood

Overall a good stay! Had a few minor issues (like the stove not working) and Sezgin responded quickly. The kitchen is well stocked and I felt very welcome.
My only big complaint is that there is no window in the bedroom which makes the room a bit stuffy, and the lack of sunlight was difficult.
Thanks for everything))

We had a very good experience staying here! The place is definitely small, but the location was great, the bed was comfortable, and the water gets nice and hot. Pictures and description are accurate.
The hosts were very communicative and polite. They gave us lots of clear information before check in and check out. They also checked in multiple times during our stay. They were responsive when I reached out.
Bedsheets and towels were provided and clean. The unit was also clean and tidy.
There are a few bus lines and a Metra station (Brown Line) close by. Lincoln Park and the Second City comedy club are within walking distance. There are a ton of restaurants, cafes, bars, and small shops nearby too. The neighborhood is lively and safe to walk through. We loved the connectivity!
(Re: a previous review, we never ran into an issue with dripping water, and it rained a LOT!)
Thank you Hatice and Özlem!
Great location, super easy check-in, super responsive host!

Looks and feels exactly how it is described and photographed. The space is comfortable and exactly what is needed for home base while exploring restaurants and activities in the area.
Heading downtown is only a 15 minute Uber ride, but there are plenty of great spots within a 15 minute walk.

Some reviews had me hesitant, but I’m glad I booked! Clean and just like described. Continental breakfast with several options. One shared bathroom but I didn’t run into any issues. I used to live in the area and I love it, close to several bus lines and wonderful restaurants and cafes.
Great location! Perfect for a lovely Chicago stay.

We had an incredible stay. There was one small hiccup, but it was resolved within minutes. I actually chose this space because it was near our wedding venue! The host was gracious enough to allow my girls to get ready here the morning of and then my husband, dog and I stayed for the remainder of our time. The place was clean, super local to all the places that we wanted to be by; and they even helped with recommendations for breakfast the morning of our wedding! It was an amazing space. Small touches really added to the artsy ambiance, the projector screen was nice to use the day after our wedding for a cozy night in to watch movies. I was worried about parking but honestly, we had no issues finding spots near our Airbnb and we just ubered locally! The beds were comfy, there were fans in the Airbnb and the bathrooms and kitchen were super clean. The patio was also a beautiful touch considering it was 70 degrees on Monday! Thank you again!
Great stay! Everything was smooth and the place was clean and comfortable.

We had a great stay at this duplex. Our group of 5 turned into 4 last minute, but even if we had 6 or 7 there is plenty of space! A few large rooms, one slightly smaller, and only one bathroom. For our party of 4 it was perfect. A block from the 606. Near Armitage for shops and restaurants. Overall a very pleasant stay. Thanks!

The house was clean, comfortable and spacious. It was easy to walk to grocery stores, restaurants, and public transit.
Samuel was very accommodating and responsive host and we hope to stay at his place again when we're in town.

Mere steps from the lakefront, this is a wonderful apartment for anyone who wants a quiet place in a great part of the city. Kenan and Alma are very responsive and kind hosts. I look forward to returning!
Everything was perfect we enjoyed our stay.
One of the best Airbnb locations I've ever been apart of.  Host was super nice and very responsive. Beautiful property. Keep up the great work!
Bella’s place was just as described.  It was really nice to have off-street parking in a very walkable area.  Great restaurants and coffee shops within a 10 minute walk on Broadway.
Was a great place to stay in Chicago! Michael was very kind and responsive, the amenities were great, and the location was perfect for what we wanted!

Great place! Would stay here again for sure! Highly recommend!
Place was very clean and felt like it was home.

Jasmine was a great host. She responded quickly to any questions I had and even provided extra photos. The photos accurately depict the apartment, which was very clean. Basic supplies like dish soap , etc. were on hand. The free parking spot is a plus! The neighborhood is safe and walkable. It was a perfect location for our visit with family.

The place was really wonderful with a comfortable interior and a cozy den like atmosphere. It is a great studio feeling with a historic energy with exposed brick and steel beams. It was a 10 minute drive from busier parts of town but is a nice distance if you don’t want to be in the heart of things. Kimberlie was attentive, kind and always made sure I had everything I needed. Not the best place if you’re out late and need a place to crash after but a great destination if you need a quiet night or are in the city for work like me.
We had a great time, perfect for what we were doing visiting my daughter in Chicago. Very comfortable, quiet and extremely responsive host.

We really enjoyed our stay. It was a very walkable location. The amenities matched out to what was listed as well as the photos matched felt very safe in this area and we had a great trip. David is a great communicator. Will definitely recommend.
Host was very responsive and kind! She gave very detailed check in info which was very appreciated. Thank you!!

Deseree had very clear instructions on how to get in and the house manual was very detailed. She even provided free snacks and breakfast! I absolutely loved this AirBnb and will definitely be staying again.
The hotel room was spotless! Front desk was friendly and fast!
Quick to respond, accommodating and trustworthy

The place looks exactly like on the pictures. Very clean and tidy. Has everything you would need and it’s spacious. Mayra was great from the beginning, super responsive and helpful. Only thing I would say is the neighborhood can look sketchy at night, so be aware of your surroundings. Would recommend for sure.
Incredible apartment. High-end appliances. Everything you could ever need in the kitchen. It was a great spot for us to figure out where we wanted to live. Parking was fantastic.

Cozy place, felt right at home. Carla left many thoughtful items, like kitchen supplies, seasonings, the tea selection was excellent and highly appreciated. Plenty of warm blankets, bed was comfortable. Convenient location just minutes from way and many great local spots to eat, there’s a list of suggested restaurants on a wall board, just another thoughtful gesture. The fresh eggs from their chickens was best surprise of all.
Beth was an excellent host. We rented the place for my mother and brother to come visit Chicago and say hi to my son, and Beth was very easy to work with and very accommodating.
Spacious studio! Very bright and open. Had everything needed to make our stay comfortable. Roomy bathroom and shower. Dedicated parking space a real bonus!
Very safe area and perfect for a small get away! Very close to downtown as well.
Joanna’s place was so nice! Quiet neighborhood and friendly neighbors. Close to gas stations and a grocery store, walking distance or a very short drive.

My first Airbnb experience was a great experience! JW & Mary were great hosts. Very responsive and helpful. The space was exactly like the pictures and extremely clean.  This space feels like home.  Was pleasantly surprised with the parking situation,  parking garage was close  as well other paid parking space near the location. I definitely plan to return.
Very clean bnb in a quiet neighborhood! Close to the highway and stores. More space than we expected and host was very accommodating when needed

Great location! In the midst of downtown right across from the Chicago River and the riverwalk. Plenty of restaurants and museums in walking distance. Also everyone was nice and friendly and the room was very comfortable.

The condo was just as described and looked even better than the pictures. The city views were spectacular and loved the 2 balconies! Check-in was the easiest we have ever had and the lobby concierge staff super friendly and helpful with local tips! The Cloud 9 communication was a 10!! They were responsive and friendly.
We will stay here again when visiting Chicago. Scott & Chuck
This was a great place to stay, free parking if you can find a spot near the building, & 15 minutes to all of the attractions
Great location, right on the blue line. Trains can be loud but the continence is worth it. The second kitchen and patio  was also nice.

We enjoyed our stay at Joseph’s place, it is spacious, clean and had everything we needed. It is also really close to a red line station and in a walkable neighborhood, check in and check out was easy and hosts had good communication, we will book again next time we’re in Chicago!
Great place to stay

Highly recommend this place for a long-term stay. The home is very comfortable and well-equipped. We were grateful to have access to the washer and dryer. The host is very responsive and helpful. The location is perfect for families: quiet, safe, and close to parks, libraries, and all the necessary amenities.

We had a great stay overall. The views were amazing and really made the experience special. The response time, professionalism, and kindness from the staff were top tier. Both the front desk team and the Cloud 9 staff were incredibly helpful and welcoming throughout our stay.
When we arrived there was a noticeable smell that lingered during the stay, but we were able to work around it and still had an amazing time. Aside from that, everything else was very enjoyable.
We appreciated the great service and hospitality, and I would definitely recommend the property to friends. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

WARNING!!! READ THIS!!! These hosts are absolute FAILURES at communicating. In March of 2026 when I arrived for my two night stay, the code the hosts gave me to get into the lockbox was incorrect. I was literally unable to get into the building. This, I understand… people are human and make mistakes. They might’ve had the code wrong in the message. The unacceptable part came when I messaged them when this happened. They refused to communicate with me. I was forced to sit outside in the Chicago cold for AN HOUR while I waited for these hosts to respond to my message. I called multiple times, pleading for them to help me get into their property. Absolutely no response from them at all. I was forced to cancel and rebook with a separate Airbnb that same night. This kind of behavior from a host is unacceptable and they should be removed from the platform!!! if you were going to Chicago, DO NOT STAY HERE. THEY WILL LOCK YOU OUT AND REFUSE TO COMMUNICATE.
Good host

Where I’m from, we have a suburb that has homes like Chicago, everywhere one turns or drives, all the homes new or old have have the same concept of architecture two stories with basement. My grandparents lived in a home like that, so it was like a dream come true, stayed in a home just like the one I was raised as a child.
This home is amazing, three levels, plenty of beds to accommodate three couples, or one couple with four children. Everything was clean, a tv in each bedroom and in the living room. No guests will ever regret staying here and to come back again to stay. Highly recommend this beautiful home and to top it off or make things better, it’s on garage to park one’s vehicle. Thanks!
Great location

This place was exactly as presented , parking was a lil scarce but it was very nice quiet and comfortable. All food places was in close proximity easy to walk . Easy access to the L train so It’s good to keep your car parked and take the L to any destinations needed . I would definitely stay again .
Very clean very responsive overall great host
great location near an aldi, restaurants, and CTA lines. great space, would recommend
Enjoyed making this my temporary home. Lumi and her team were very responsive and helped with everything I needed.
Host Nat is very thorough with her instructions. She always checks up to see if everything is going great which is greatly appreciated!

We were within walking distance of a few restaurants in a fun part of town. The weather was nice, so we walked to the lake. The Green line is just a few blocks away, so we had easy train access into the city. The neighborhood is quiet, and the apartment is clean and adorable. Highly recommend.
Location is first and foremost for us.  Amenities and space as well.  Just overall perfect for us.

Super sweet host. Was attentive about my safety before I even stepped into the residence & as a solo traveler that is always appreciated. Answered within minutes of asking about things via text & the housekeeper was fairly quiet my entire stay.
An amazing experience. Close to everything. About 10-15 min away from every major downtown attraction. Will visit here again.

Location was excellent, close to lake and lots of restaurants and shops. We were happy to be 10 min from our daughter's condo. Also felt safe. Quiet building and neighborhood, despite being in an urban location.  Host needs to make sure checking-in instructions are accurate. We were given two different building numbers for the address, and therefore, we weren't sure which number to buzz to get in the outside gate.
Great place easy to access
this place was very spacious and comfortable. a heater was even provided for the cold very nice! and host is very helpful and responds very quickly
Great place to stay with a few friends and it was clean ! Theres lots to do around the area which was great.
Great host, clean, has all the information you need.
Place was great. It was just what we needed. The place was exactly as the hosts described. They were very responsive.
muy buena y agradable
Good straight forward host

Everything was as described, really appreciated Christian's clear instructions and fast response times. The place was clean and spacious and loved how walkable it was from everything we wanted to explore!
Beautiful apt on top of Train which runs 24/7.  Hosts provide ear plugs but it is not effective. Train ran till 1:30, started again at 4:30. Also noisy neighbors Sat night till 2:00.

My partner and I really enjoyed our stay with Billy! This airbnb offers it all, and is 100% worth the price. Billy offers towels, toilet paper, paper towels, kitchenware, a washer and dryer, a fireplace, and so much more. The rooftop deck was amazing, a remarkable scenery for sure ~ I seriously loved it! The surrounding area is walkable, and a few minutes down the road there’s tons of popular streets. This airbnb happened to be in the heart of everything, every where i wanted to go was less than a 30 minute drive! Billy was responsive, and gave us helpful information on the area! Thank you Billy for the amazing stay !
Place was good a little smaller than I thought and there was still dust and crumbs around but overall good.

Friends and I (plus our dogs) had the pleasure of staying at Victor’s property during a long weekend visit to Chicago. The place was great — extremely accommodating of our two dogs, in a fantastic area with easy access to restaurants, cafes, and trains — while being clean and well maintained. Victor’s response time was probably the fastest I’ve ever seen, and his instructions were clear and helpful. I look forward to a future visit!
The place smells awful and is very dingy. I notified host and their response was they’d come by to bring air freshener. After they stopped responding. Do not stay here

We enjoyed our stay here. Unit is equipped with full kitchen and washer/dryer. Easy check in and out. Representatives were super responsive and staff were friendly. Walls are thin but it’s not too much of a distraction. Would stay here again.

Great place to stay even if you aren’t a Loyola student. Building is quiet and clean, love that there’s a mini gym in the lobby. Bella was on top of any concern I had and immediately took care of it! Great location, so close to the el, parking isn’t too bad. Highly recommend! Way better than staying in a hotel because I have my own kitchen and can bring my cat :)
Brad’s a great host. Very responsive and great at communicating. Would definitely stay here again.

We had a fabulous time! Our plane was delayed putting us at a very late night arrival! The house and path to our door was softly lit to guide us. The door’s security was solid and we had very good instructions for entry. Awaiting our tired selves was an extremely clean, quiet apartment and cozy beds! The beautiful neighborhood was located just a quick walk to shopping and a wide variety of restaurants. There was ample room for small gatherings and conversations with our family. Jacki checked in with us a couple of times to make sure we had everything we needed. Check out was also simple with good instructions. Would DEFINITELY stay at this fun and funky place again! Thanks, Jacki!

Great space for large groups with ideal location in the city. The two units are down the hall from each other with one unit being a 3 bed/2 bath and the other being a 2 bed/3 bath. Both units were perfectly clean with clear instructions on checking in and out. I would stay here again

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had a great stay at this beautiful 4-bedroom home in the Gold Coast. The place was very clean, spacious, and extremely comfortable. The beds and pillows were great, and the couches were perfect for relaxing after being out during the day.
The kitchen was well set up and the large dining table made it easy for everyone to sit down and enjoy meals together. We also appreciated the thoughtful extras like recommendations for in-house chefs and other local services.
The location is fantastic — in a great neighborhood and close to excellent restaurants, shopping, and even quick food options when needed. The rooftop was a highlight with a wonderful view and a great place to unwind.
Check-in and check-out were very easy and smooth. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago.

Had a wonderful time! Caesar was quick to respond kindly to our questions. It’s a very nice walkable area with lots of restaurants and bars. Absolutely no noise from the bar downstairs, though! Looking forward to staying again on another visit!
Great location, clean and comfortable unit.  Optional parking is excellent in the neighborhood.  Will stay again.
This was a wonderful place to stay for our family. It was especially nice to have somewhere with on site parking!
Great stay.  Communication was clear.  The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.  The neighborhood was quiet, yet close to great restaurants, shopping, and public transportation.
Excellent location and price!!  We enjoyed our stay greatly!!!

Nice place to stay especially if you have a smaller group/ by yourself. The rooms had some architectural issues like the bathroom door being very hard to close or the closet door being detached before I even touched anything, but for the value I cannot complain. Nothing was detrimentally wrong or terrible overall. I would recommend this place especially if you need easy access to CTA / a cheaper place to be in the city.

We’ve stayed here several times. Great location. Kasa remotely manages a couple floors of this apartment building, which is fine when everything runs smoothly. However, we went to leave one afternoon at 4:30 and were stuck INSIDE (13th floor) because previously repaired door handle used incompatible parts and fell into the jamb. No amount of pulling on door got it to open. Calls to their provided immediate response number (after waiting for hold for 5 minutes to leave a message) were not returned for 20 minutes. Texts sent at the same time were not answered immediately, but we received “maintenance on the way” after 10 minutes. At 5p, AMLI guy heard us and said he was notified Kasa rep was coming. He forced the door open from his side, and noted that this had happened before! At my request he completely removed the handle mechanism to prevent this.
Kasa sent “resolved” text. They later came into the apartment WITHOUT PERMISSION to verify our keycards, one which never worked. BAD!
Fantastic spot in a really great location. Patricia was also quick to respond if i ever had a question or needed anything.

Patrick was a great host. He met us when we arrived and showed us around and how to work things. Very chatty and friendly. The apartment was sparkling clean and tidy. Location was very convenient for us less than one block from our daughter and grandson. We look forward to our next visit!!

We had a wonderful stay! This apartment was spacious and well stocked, we appreciated the snacks and beverages left for us. It really felt like home. As a former Andersonville regular it felt great to be back in Chicago in my old stomping grounds. Close to the train and all the restaurants and stores on Clark st. We had a minor incident and the hosts were responsive right away! I’ve already recommended this BnB to other friends and family.

Hi Micha. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and the location was ideal for us personally. If you want to make any improvements we would suggest thought be given to providing at least a 4 slice toaster and decent electric kettle for those who don’t drink coffee. While we can live without a tv it was also a noticeable absence…. but none of these would prevent us from checking out your availability next time we plan on visiting our family!
Tony is a very nice host… very responsive and took care of us!
No hassle, great host, would stay again!
Wonderful,  inviting home in a great location.  We'll look to return on future trips.
Very clean, looked exactly like the pictures. Joan is very responsive! Great stay, would recommend!

Great location in Chicago, close to the lake, restaurants, and Michigan Avenue. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and check-in was easy. The building amenities and rooftop area were nice, and it was convenient to get around the city. Overall a good place to stay when visiting Chicago.
