This one bedroom apartment, on the 2nd floor, had everything that you would need for a short or long stay [towels, shampoos, paper products, coffee pods, trash bags, sponges, dishwasher, in unit washer and dryer, pillows, extra bedding]. The kitchen was stocked with various useful tools and good quality pots, pans, plates, cups]. You can see and hear trains through all of the windows, so it's truly a city experience! They did not bother us at night. Cyndi is an excellent communicator who is kind, sincere and tries to help! Excellent private apartment! There's also a 24 hour gym on the 8th floor and it's in different building, but you don't have to go outside to access it.
Note: The entrance to the unit in the building is actually a back alley that has been turned into a street and taxis have difficult time finding it. You can also use the main entrance on an actual big street, but then you have to go through concierge each time.

The apartment was great. Quiet location. Foot and car traffic minimal. Close to L line and shops. The only minus was the noisy radiator. It did keep the apartment warm and cozy in cold January weather.

Big enough for 6 as advertised but not enough furnishings for 6. Not enough cups/glasses and no bakeware. Upstairs neighbor very noisy late at night and early morning. Broken blinds let in too much light. No dressers or hangers for clothes. Definitely needs more seating.

My family and I spent two weeks in Irena's place and it never failed us. The kitchen had the right equipment for cooking, and grocery stores were within easy walking distance. Water pressure in the shower was excellent. Beds were comfortable, and there were plenty of towels. The location can't be beat--a ten-minute walk to the Blue Line, easy access to bus lines, and within walking distance of restaurants and bars.
I would stay here again, no problem.
Needed to clean the doors and light switches.  They were dirty.  I cleaned them for her.
Stayed here to visit my sister, who is attending UChicago. Great location, walkable.

We had a great stay! The space was very clean and modern, and the neighborhood was quiet and peaceful. It’s about a 30 minute drive from downtown, which was convenient for our plans. The host was very attentive, checking in to make sure everything was going well and responding quickly whenever we had questions. Overall, a comfortable and pleasant experience.
Real nice stay and close to everything we needed
Great place. We loved it

Estuve en el lugar de Ying por 5 noches. Está ubicado en un zona tranquila, cerca hay algunas opciones de comida, tambien está cerca la estación de tren de la linea naranja lo que nos permitia movernos a otros zonas facilmente. Es un poco dificil el acceso debido a que cuando estás dentro de la propiedad tienes que abrir un puerta y luego otra que es complicado el acceso sobretodo si tiene mochila o maletas. Las escaleras son un poco empinadas ya que la "suite" está en la parte superior. al entrar el lugar la habitación se encuentra despues de pasar por un cuarto donde es como un closet y comedor. Las camas y almohadas dejan mucho que desear. El retrete tiene un ubicación un poco extraña porque tienes que subir un par de escalones poderte sentar, si orinas parado no será lo mejor. La climatización central no llega hasta la habitación y hay un calefactor portatil. Si tuviera la oportunidad de regresar a Chicago no sería en este lugar, buscaría algo un poco más comodo.
Great space, great location.
This was the perfect stay for my friends and I for New Years! Super close to train stops, Michigan Ave, and great coffee shops, we will definitely be coming back!
Everything was perfect in my eyes

the host was nice & responded pretty quickly
if your wanting something aesthetically pleasing or around things to do id keep looking. the neighborhood is ok & there’s lots of murals & niche cultural food spots all around. i was immediately disappointed only when i walked into my room and seen how bad the floors looked. I didn’t even want to walk around with socks on I felt like i had to keep shoes on the whole night unless I was going to bed. everything else had to do with the other person who was living in a another room in the same suite very pervy & weird. had a great time but definitely will be choosing a different location in the future.

Allan’s home was extremely clean and well appointed. I’m very impressed with the design and decor, as well as how well prepared the place is. We had everything we needed for our stay. We were last minute switching from another Airbnb location that didn’t work out for us and Allan had the place prepared for us in a pinch and even offered to let us check in early for our comfort and convenience. I thought that was so sweet. He also left a bottle of prosecco on ice for us when we arrived. We were in desperate need of a nice place to stay and Allan pulled through for us. I will absolutely book with Allan again in the future.

Had a really great stay here, Ishin is a great host! Just a heads up, this unit is a walk up (with fairly steep stairs). If you have any accessibility concerns, just be aware of that - otherwise, this was a lovely accommodation and a fantastic location (super close to public transit!)

While we did enjoy the house, Patty and her team were hard to get in contact with to answer basic questions. It was hard to enter the house initially and had to call the help desk to get help. We asked for help from Patty and received no response from her or her team until checkout. It should be noted that we had issues a couple of other times coming and going on and eventually the outside gate was left unlocked by other people in the vicinity posing a safety issue.
Great location, right next to collectivo - a great coffee shop.
Lovely stay for New Year’s! Clean, fun space super close to the blue line.
Milan’s place was exactly how it was presented.  Great location.  Great service.  Would certainly stay again.

Absolutely amazing experience! The place was incredibly clean and organized, and the host went above and beyond to ensure everything was clearly communicated. They were friendly, professional, and very responsive. Parking was easy and convenient, which is always a huge plus. This was one of the best Airbnb stays I’ve had—highly recommend!
The home was very nice it has an older vibe to it but also modern at same time. Very spacious for group trip.
I really enjoyed my stay, from check into departure. It really felt like I was at home. I have nothing negative to say, and I will book this place again in the near future.
Great area easy access to Lakeshore Drive. Easy drive to downtown Chicago if you want to check out museums, The Shedd Aquarium, Millenium Park, Navy Pier, and other attractions.

The distance of this airbnb from the Red and Green lines is walkable and close to restaurants and stores.
The only things that would've made the price of my stay more reasonable are:
1. The floors and bathroom could've been cleaner.
2. More kitchen utensils. Especially a can opener, dish sponge, and kitchen towels.
3. Batteries for the T.V. remote to have been provided when Mr. Guang said they would be. They never were.
4. A bathtub mat.
5. A flat sheet on the bed (not just two fitted sheets.
Also, it would of been helpful if Mr. Guang took pictures of all four bedrooms, because walking into a bedroom that wasn't the bedroom in the pic was disappointing.
I do appreciate that house slippers were provided and my room had its own keypad lock. Check in was easy. If I ever need a airbnb in Chicago again, would give this one another chance, if available.
The home was very warm and inviting. Well stocked kitchen too! would rebook anytime it’s available.

My stay at 747 was “okay.” The location is centrally located in Chicago, close to the Blue Line, and near several businesses.
Besides that, the building itself is outdated.
The “Cabin” I stayed in, was also in need of renovations.

This is the second best airbnb unit I've stayed at. Very convenient. You have all you need for a comfortable stay. Actually our vacation felt better after switching to this unit. Location is great and efficient. Calm and neat neighborhood and close to public transport with lots of parking spaces. Clean, and big space in the unit. Everything was great and perfect. Kash was very helpful and responsive. He also allowed us to check in earlier.

This downtown location made walking around Chicago a breeze and just a quick car ride anywhere when it was too cold to walk.
Everything was new in the place.

Charie’s place was great, comfy and cozy for the time me and my partner spent there for New Years. Everything is as described, we had a blast and felt right at home. Highly recommend if you need a place to stay in the area.
Le logement est spacieux et Jack Paul a été très réactif et compréhensif. Je reviendrais.

Mary was the best host I have ever had on this app. She welcomed me with a 12pk of IPAs and doughnuts. The place was clean homely and anytime I needed something or had minor issue,She took care of it right away. The price for monthly stay rivals monthly rent all over Chicago. It’s the best Airbnb property I have ever stayed at in over 10 states and 4 countries. Highly recommend. Well done just well done!
Great stay! I will definitely be back!
Excelente estadía, buen anfitrión, muy buena ubicación. Volvería hospedarme allí!

Carrie is a wonderful host!   Extremely fast responses to any questions and super helpful.  The space is SO CUTE and very well remodeled.  In fact, I think it's better than the pictures show.   Comfy bed, adjustable lighting, nice bathroom linens.  the entrance is private and well secured, as is the room.   I'd love to stay here again in the future!
We stayed here for New Year’s Eve weekend with a group of 4 and it was lovely! The location was close to everything in Lincoln Park. The decor was cute and homey. Also very affordable.

I had no problems with checking in at the unit, it was easy to find and easy to find. The check in instructions were clear to understand same with the check out instructions. I’m grateful for the homey feel the unit gave and would recommend staying.
Great stay
A total gem! Location is fantastic, the place was super cute and clean, and Kimberly was so friendly and accommodating! I especially adored the claw foot bath tub. We would love to come back!
We had an amazing time and the units were so lovely!

This place is a great place to stay, and it lived up to its description. Everything was clean, and there were plenty of amenities like towels and kitchen utensils. The location has a corner store and a couple of restaurants that came in handy a few times during our stay. However, I was with a party of four guests, and the living areas started to get crowded. I think three people is the best number for this property. The parking was a bit confusing. You needed to get the controller from another location, which would have been a logistical nightmare if I hadn’t been with multiple people. Since parking is a paid option, I think it should be a bit smoother system for pick-up and drop-off of the gate controller. Despite the parking issue, my car felt secure in the parking lot during my stay. Overall, this place was great for the price, and I would stay again if I decide to visit the area.
Great place to stay - wonderful view, lots to do and eat nearby, amenities and apartment are just as pictured, with a responsive host. Would certainly return.
Beautiful place, great neighborhood, very comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay and Barbara was a gracious host.

Anna was so so accommodating to our situation - I was worried we wouldn’t be able to find a place last minute and she came through for us. The home feels like a home, my husband even commented that he hopes our house feels like Anna’s to others. Everything we needed was provided. Parking was super easy even during the busy holidays. It’s a little far from downtown if you’re not familiar with Chicago but we were visiting family close by. Neighborhood is safe. Coming and going was super easy
it was in a great place walkable to wrigley field which has a lot of food places, bars, and club.

The photos and the reality are not very similar ( missing items ) . In my opinion, the host is nice, but several rugs are missing, as well as a mop or something to clean after coming back from a snowy day. The two rugs that are there are pretty dirty, the sheets are of poor quality, and it is very difficult to rest properly. The back entrance is messy, and all that mess ends up being brought inside the house. The neighborhood is very quiet and you have a park in front is you travel with your dog.
The place was just as described and fit our need perfectly. Only concern for some may be the noise from the nearby train. We would book this place again.

Everything was perfect even the smallest details. The place is amazing and the rooms are everything anyone can wish for. The kitchen had anything you could think off. I really recommend this place for anyone who is visiting Chicago you will feel like your home. Thank you Ag and Kristie and God bless you.
Great location and nice place for me and family to spend a few days downtown chicago.
5 stars! Enjoyed everything about the space. Cozy and had all amenities one could need. Highly recommend this to anyone! Great location and was easy to check in and out.
Very nice stay, professionally run Airbnb yet cozy and homey. Be warned if you are afraid of dolls there are a lot of them watching over the bed as you sleep :)
Great place, easy private access, comfortable beds, and easy walk to the red line for access to the rest of the city. parking was also extremely easy.
Steve and his place was great! Very intimate, very comfortable space, with a beautiful Chicago view
Great an warm stay for my New Year trip!! Loved the area!!
Absolutely great place and perfect instructions for check in and check out
Cool little spot to stay if you ever just in the city and don’t wanna be in crowded space…other than 🅿️ you won’t have any trouble
Very quality smooth stay!!!

Hatice was a wonderful host, she was very communicative and responsive, but I will say you get what you pay for. It’s located in a beautiful neighborhood and right across from a jewel osco. There were a few unexpected issues that made our stay a little uncomfortable. First being the smell, there is a strong must in the house but was easily fixed with an air freshener. Secondly, it was a little dirty. Stains on the couch, hairs on the beds and lack of maintenance throughout the home. Lastly you are not able to control the temperature of the home but Hatice was very receptive and was able to fix this issue on her end. I feel most of this would have been preventable with a little more research on this place but for the price it was a decent stay.
Bojan was an amazing host, incredibly friendly and helpful, and the place was absolutely beautiful even better than the pictures (which were already amazing)! 100/10 would stay again

Anna and husband were kind and did their best. However, their place isnt completely as advertised. Sqeaky floors can be heard above while sleeping, old furnace that stopped working at times, minimal upgrades and coined laundry shared with clothes Left overnight. Not worth the price in my opinion… because the intent wasnt malicious i gave it a 4. But yeah, if ‘ good enough’ was a place this would be it.
Great location and good communication

She was a great host very responsive, kind, and easy to communicate with. The place was exactly as described, clean, spacious and very comfortable. So much was provided for us as guests. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and she made the whole stay stress-free. I would definitely stay here again and recommend her place to others.
Beautiful apartment and amenities. The apartment had everything we needed. The city view was spectacular  b

The air bnb was very nice. It was private and clean. It had everything that is needed for an amazing stay. The host was responsive and helpful. Check in and check out Instructions were very clear and helpful as well. Definitely a must stay for a big group or any kind of stay.
This was a great location and me and my family enjoyed our stay.

¡Una experiencia increíble! Desde el primer momento Tracy y su esposo fueron súper amables y atentos, contestaba súper rápido los mensajes. La casa está hermosa increíblemente hermosa la decoración que tenía, impecable y muy cómoda, mejor de lo que esperábamos. El lugar es perfecto y el estacionamiento privado fue un gran plus que hizo todo mucho más fácil ya que llevaba un carro y a la hora que quisiera yo llegar estaba el estacionamiento disponible para mi unidad. Sin duda alguna volveríamos a hospedarnos aquí y lo recomendamos al 100%. ¡Gracias por todo!

The place is cheap, really convenient for 4 people. The host replies consistently. There were some inconveniences like there were no electricity at some parts and needed to go down for the breaker, we already raised the concern of the smoke detector making annoying noises and we heard it all throughout our stay. Hope these concerns will be fixed soon.
Amazing place

This was beautiful, i got engaged here. It was clean and the view was spectacular. It was really easy to get to other places. We walked to Millenium park. Short uber trips to the touristy places. The host was so kind and responsive always making sure I didn’t need anything. Kept regular communication.
Everything was great, she even left us bottle of champagne. Definitely worth it. It was just a little bit noisy in the mornings.
Easy to access.  Clean.  Lots of foot traffic in the lobby.  There weren’t any loud noises in the hallway.  Security is in place.

This place is great for a comfy stay. Gerry was very responsive and helpful during check in. The apartment is nicely designed with decent furniture and comfy beds. This location is nearby all the interesting destinations I needed. The only thing I was missing is that there's no much natural light because it's first floor and most windows not getting any sun or natural lights but not a big deal because the apartment has a nice balcony/porch.
My only issue was the it took some time to find the building and check in because we arrived in the evening and we had to use the back door.
Great value and the host was very responsive.
Ari was very helpful during our stay and made sure we got what we needed. We also felt very safe at this location.
Amazing location Steel and Sky was everything it set out to be.  Our daughter even drew a picture of the kitchen to the tee. Love to share it with you guys.

Jennifer's place worked perfectly for our family of four (2 adults, 2 kids) visiting from out of town.  Our family felt comfortable and appreciated the brightness, cleanliness, and the spaciousness of the apartment. It was also convenient that the building offers a parking on the lot. We would definitely recommend - especially to out of towners who would enjoy staying in a quiet neighborhood in Chicago rather than the hustle and bustle of downtown with little parking and ease.
I would stay here again. Great location!

Can't complain much given how cheap this place is. It's hostel style so you'll deal with other people in the kitchen/bathroom. But the room itself had clean sheets and a comfortable bed, better than other Airbnbs in this price range.

While the photos and descriptions were accurate in the listing and we appreciated the fun and funky decor, we did not expect the adjacent petcare to be as loud as it was. It is located in the basement and we could hear dogs barking at all hours, pretty incessantly. And any movement or noise we made in the unit would trigger barking below. Granted we did stay over new years and I'm sure they were boarding more dogs than usual, so I cannot speak to their normal capacity, but that is something to keep in mind if you are sensitive to noise or bringing a pet that is.

Wonderful ground unit that was comfortable, warm, and clean during our New Years trip to Chicago. The free, fully enclosed garage parking spot was a huge bonus, especially when street parking can be tough in Chicago during the winter months. I would highly recommend staying here.

Mushka and Binyomin were great hosts, very responsive. Anything that we needed they were right on it and willing to assist. They let us know of things to do within the city and notified us of anything we needed. Very friendly and personable, I was consistently asked how things are going. The space was easy to find, very homey, clean and looks just as described and shown in the photos. Overall great experience. My family would definitely consider staying again if we make our way back to Chicago. We were fortunate enough to catch the snow while there as well.

Overall nothing to complain. Everything was as desbribed. Location was convenient. The bed is a bit small, butI consider that as my own bias.
One minor suggestion for the host, that is, to provide a kettle for the guests. A kettle is sure, not expensive but may help a lot of guests.
Responsive host
Had fun!

Lovely spot I used to host my mother during her visit to Chicago as my own apartment is too small.
My mom made the most of her private bedroom and shared bathroom.
Great place for our family of four to visit family in Logan's Square. The free street parking in the area was very helpful.
This was a great place out of the way but close to everything very quiet. Will definitely book again
Peter’s place was amazing for our trip. Thoughtful extra touches and a comfortable space made this a great family vacation.
Nice place! Host nice and respond quickly!
Loved staying here! It felt like we were right at home! Would definitely book with them again!!
This place is awesome the host is very attentive.

Great place to stay and very responsive and accommodating :)

Great stay in Chicago! The place was clean, in a great location, and the king beds were very comfortable. The only things to note are the deposit requirement and the need to download an app for access—nothing major, just good to know. We love Chicago, and this place made our stay comfortable.
Great place! Excellent location

We enjoyed a fantastic 12-night stay at this property! The attention to detail throughout the condo is impressive. The kitchen features high-end appliances like SubZero, Wolf, and Bosch, and is fully stocked with everything from dishes to utensils and seasonings.The living area is bright, boasting high ceilings and elegant crown molding. The master bathroom is a standout, complete with a spacious shower and double sinks. Everything was spotless, including the linens.
We appreciated the tranquility of the property—no sirens or loud noises to disturb us. Don, the owner, was incredibly responsive and professional. The location is also a major highlight. The neighborhood is picturesque, lined with large trees and beautifully decorated homes for the holidays. It’s a short walk to Wrigley Field, a variety of bars and restaurants, and Southport. We even took a pleasant stroll to the lake one day! Plus, you’re just a quick drive to Lake Shore Drive, making downtown accessible in 20 minutes.

The perfect location to go exploring, the neighborhood is vibrant and fun. Beautiful home tucked away in the middle of the bustling city, it’s really so cute. If you’re looking for a casual place to stay, especially if it’s only for a night or two (shared bathroom, not sure if I’d actually shower). Other than that, I had a great time. Bed was super comfortable, house had everything you could need.

Amazing stay from start to finish. The place was spotless, cozy.
Ana went above and beyond to ensure comfort and smooth communication.
best experiences I’ve had highly recommended.
Nicholas's home was in a nice location. The building was secured. Clean and had plenty of toiletries. I would def book this home again next time I visit Chicago.

The apartment is quite lovely. The kitchen is beautiful and well stocked with equipment (toaster oven, coffee maker, stove, fridge etc. there is even a mat for making sushi in a closet). The master bath has a great shower. The location is great (near Humbolt park).
Most importantly the host was very responsive; when we could not find a corkscrew, he had one delivered in less than five minutes. When we had trouble with the gate (it froze), they buzzed us in less than a minute (after we reported it).
Great Host! Easy check-in! Beautiful stay and amazing views!

Cute enough place but there was hair in the bathtub and mold in the tile grout. There were also various stains on the walls and throw pillows.
We stayed in the second level apartment, and there was very loud neighbors below both nights.
Good enough place to stay if you’re there for a short time. We checked out a day early.

This was such a beautiful stay. The additional garage parking for our car was a huge plus as we didn’t have to find street parking and didn’t have to brush snow off the car. The room was clean, and the amenities including the breakfast were great. Will stay again!
My stay was wonderful!! Justin was very responsive and made me feel right at home. Comfortable amenities and great location!
We had a great stay, we could hear the upstairs neighbors but it wasn’t to loud. Overall it was a great place will definitely stay here again
Great place. Would stay again!!
We enjoyed our stay!!
The neighborhood was not safe. Faced problems with the entrance lock.

Fantastic spot, walking distance from several good places to eat, easy to get to events at the pier, and easy to get in an out with no fuss. Surprisingly easy to find nearby street parking as well. Highly recommend!

This place is a gem! The apartment is cozy but very spacious and has great Chicago character. I loved getting Cuban coffee at the restaurant downstairs in the morning without having to leave the building. The location is perfect, easy walk to anywhere downtown. Cute Italian restaurant and an excellent lunch spot on the same block. The apartment had all the amenities and an especially comfortable bed! Hope to stay here again next summer and enjoy the easy beach access too.
This place was great for our group. Everyone was very comfortable.

The space was clean, well-lit and comfortable - great for our 5-person family. The  neighborhood also has great restaurants and is close to downtown. Jake was a kind and responsive host, we highly recommend!

We had a great stay with Tippi. Room was comfortable, the shared spaces were incredibly clean, and Tippi was very responsive and helpful. Neighborhood felt safe and has a few fun local spots in walking distance that are worth checking out.
EXCELLENT SERVICE, IMPECCABLE CLEANLINESS, KITCHEN, LIVING ROOM, AND BEDROOMS ARE ALL A GOOD SIZE. COMFORTABLE AND LUXURIOUS, I WOULD DEFINITELY STAY HERE AGAIN.

This was a wonderful stay for me and my family on New Year’s Eve! We were a little surprised that it was in the basement of the home but it was not a problem! Would definitely love to book again

The views are phenomenal. The gas fireplace was a delight to have!
I would love to be hosted by these awesome people again. Highly recommend! *****

We loved staying here! It was central to most everything we wanted to do and it was very reasonably priced. Rosa was very responsive and helpful with any issues we had. Had everything you could need!! Thank you:)

We were extremely happy with our stay! For six adults and two kids the apartment was the perfect size. Everything was well stocked (fresh towels, kitchen basics, etc.). Beds were comfy, bathrooms clean and nice, kitchen very easy to stock and use.  Would definitely recommend!
Great host and stay! Will be back!
Easy flexible checkin . Great safe neighborhood.  Free on premise parking.

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Chicago! The space was incredibly cosy and comfortable — it truly felt like a home away from home. It’s conveniently close to the airport, but also has easy transport links into downtown, which made getting around so simple. Jackeline was fantastic to deal with, always quick to respond and so helpful throughout our stay. We were visiting family and wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again on future trips. Highly recommend!
Enjoyed my stay!

Great stay overall. The place was very clean. Everything felt new and comfortable, which made it easy to relax.
The location was convenient for getting around Chicago and to downtown, right off the highway, and the place itself was quiet. Beds were comfortable and the bathrooms were spotless.
Wonderful was responsive and made check-in simple. No issues at all.
Would stay here again and would recommend it.
perfect location, clean. hosts are very responsive. rooms were tight for a family of four, but doable for a short stay.

The location and layout were perfect for what I wanted--a pet-free space to hang out with our Chicago-based kids and their partners. The common area was great for playing games, watching movies, talking, eating and just being together. While it's true that you can hear street noise and the mood lighting is a little dark, these things did not interfere with our enjoyment of the space, which has a very cool vibe and is nicely decorated. The kitchen was large and fairly well stocked which was good because we ate most of our meals in. It could have been a little better maintained and cleaned to get a 5 star rating, but on the other hand when we reported the TV in the main bedroom was broken, the hosts quickly replaced it with a brand new one and hung it--on New Year's Day!

Great AirBnB! The hosts were very helpful in providing clear instructions for check in and check out. We had everything we needed in the place, and it was very clean. Good transit access but also lots within walking distance as well. I’d stay again!
Perfect place for 4-5 people.
Thank you for hosting me and my family, Sharon!

Anny was very helpful and friendly. She sent helpful tips and reminders. This made chek-in and checkout very easy. The location is close to a bus stop and train service and there are lots to do close by.
Great place to stay.

I stayed for 3 days and 2 nights. The place was just as described and looked like the photos. Great place for peaceful relaxation and nice neighborhood. As well as Wicker park, filled with restaurant and shops, is less than a 30 minute walk. Gina had very clear instructions, which made for a smooth check in and check out. Overall, would recommend!

This was a great stay for my family of 7. 2 adults and 5 kids all under 10 and well was more than enough space. You are 20-25 minutes from anywhere you’d like to go in downtown Chicago. Host is responsive and was able to assist me with a check out issue and acted quickly saving a bunch of time. Great stay!

Absolutely the perfect location to do anything in downtown Chicago! Plenty of space for my group of 6. Accommodations were comfy and cozy, with everything we needed just minutes away. Easy check in and out. Host was super responsive too. Would book again in a heart beat.

We stayed for the holidays at Aysin and Ishin’s listing in Wicker Park. It was super comfortable in a great location with nice amenities that made us feel right at home during our holiday break. Increíble lugar, sin duda volveremos, a 18 min en carro del centro de Chicago, éramos 5 personas y estuvimos muy cómodas en el departamento, importante considerar que solo tiene un baño, está en un tercer piso y no cuenta con lavadora. Very nice and clean place. easy check in and out and felt very luxurious.

A beautiful and spacious 2 bed/2 bath apartment. Only 30 minutes from O’Hare and a 2 minute walk from a CTA train line that connects through downtown. Will stay again if I am ever back to the windy city!

It was a good stay!!!!

Unit is very clean.

Beautiful clean stay with amazing balcony views and tall windows.  Fresh new feel and everything you need.  I hope to be back!
Very nice home, very clean & parking was very easy at all times. Had everything available for us, no complaints or problems, would definitely book again!

My group of friends stayed here for a New Year's trip and had a fabulous time. Great stay! Very spacious and clean.
We had a great time in Chicago! We felt right at home visiting with our family in the neighborhood. Our kids (10 and 8) wanted to hangout at the apartment as much as they wanted to explore the city 🤣

Place is really conveniently located since it’s close to downtown, but definitely looks a bit off from the pictures and could be more taken care of. I enjoyed my stay at Brad place walking distance to all the restaurants, bars and stores very quit and peaceful neighborhood and property will definitely be back in the near future thank you Brad 😊👍

My husband and I stayed at Scott’s place for four nights and really enjoyed our stay. We travel to Chicago frequently and would definitely stay here again. I was very comfortable my whole stay I appreciate the shower essentials that were given and loved how warm i was and how peaceful and welcoming everyone was I would definitely come back thank you so much for everything

Karla was an exceptional host who truly went above and beyond. From the start, her communication was warm, clear, and incredibly responsive—she resolved anything that came up immediately and made me feel genuinely comfortable and safe throughout my stay.

Very nice place and a responsive host.
It is close to the train and the avenue, but quiet inside. Located in a pretty and peaceful neighborhood. Parking on the street was okay; it was a bit difficult at night, but I was still able to find a spot on the same block.
The location is not far from downtown—around 15/20 minutes by car via the scenic Lakeshore Drive.
The internal layout works well for four people, featuring two small tables and a comfortable sofa. Great stay!

The location was great, but overall this stay was disappointing and I would not book this unit again.
We were asked to pay a $2,500 security deposit outside of the Airbnb platform, which created immediate concern since it removes transparency and guest protections. After checkout, the host messaged us thanking us for taking good care of the unit and stating the deposit was being released. Then, close to the end of the review window, the host changed their story and claimed they were keeping the entire deposit based on an allegation that we had a dog in the unit.
To be completely clear: we did not have a dog or any animals in the unit at any point. The host claims they received complaints about barking, but never contacted us even once during the stay to address it or give us a chance to resolve any concern. Their “proof” was a few short hairs found on one bed, which we believe came from a jacket with a furry hood—not an animal.
In addition, the unit itself had issues.

Great location, clean and all the amenities you need for your stay. Kitchen was fully stocked and plenty of bedding for the space. Recommend sound machines, which we always travel with, as the walls are thin and it is a multi-unit building. Overall, good location for a family visit!

Very clean and cozy. All appeared new.
Place was as advertised in the images.

We loved all the windows and incredible natural light. And the heated floors were like magic with the freezing temps outside. It was a wonderful trip and I highly recommend Matt's home to make your Chicago trip the best it could be.

I enjoyed my stay here. The apartment was very clean with a great view of the train passing by an ample amount of space for 2 people. Great stay overall! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive and made the check-in process easy. The location was convenient and worked perfectly for our trip. I would definitely consider staying here again.
Great location, convenient to stores and the Lake front, can’t wait to book in the summer to enjoy the outdoors as much as the inside.
The place was clean and tidy. It was just an old building other than that everything was on point. The host was very responsive

very nice apartment

good place to stay

I enjoyed my stay. Chinatown is very vibrant and always lots to do!

The place was very clean and spotless, the neighborhood is walkable and very safe. It has 3 rooms but the walls are quite thin so you can hear voices everytime. However, the place was goood and has all the amenities you would expect in an bnb
