Awesome place! Host was very responsive and welcoming, felt right at home. Place very clean and location very convenient. Definitely we recommend it !
The places was really nice and comfortable, the bus stop is close to the house and the place is calm, we feel like really great, like home

We had an awesome time in Patricia’s place, its location is very convenient and the apartment has everything you need for a stay in Chicago.
Patricia was always responsive to our questions and requests.
Looking forward to stay here again!

Well, I would give it a high 4 star or 5 star if we were here for the summer. The place is pretty clean, fits the description, just a bit smaller than expected (mirror made it look bigger than it is), but it’s nice. The only and biggest issue is that we visited during winter and it was COLD. The main issue is that the window AC is not sealed properly and cold air keeps leaking inside, and it overwhelms the heater and makes the room cold. We all got kinda sick after a few days :( We tried a few ways to warm up the room, as our host Regina suggested, such as tucking a towel underneath the AC, but it didn’t really solve the problem, and we gotta wear winter coat inside and hoodie at night. Regina is nice though, she brought us extra comforters and made it a bit better at night…
In short, it’s a nice little place for summer visit, but you might want to reconsider visiting during the coldest time.
the ambassador was great. I would have booked another night.

Love it here! Super kind hosts as they communicated well and were very friendly. Our room was very spacious and comfortable. The location was perfect! Not in the middle of downtown (very peaceful) but VERY easy to get to tourist sites. Would definitely rebook. A minor thing would be newer towel as some looked stained.
In a decent neighborhood. House was a bit old but matched the photos. Free parking behind the building made it easy to get in and out.

Todo estuvo bien, me gustaría que las toallas y la ropa de cama fueran claras porque al ser grises y negras no se ve si están limpias.
La respuesta siempre fue rápida, amigable y de mucha utilidad.
Gracias por todo!!! La pasamos muy bien.
Second time staying here! Always a great place to stay.
VERY NICE AND CLEAN LIVING SPACE… WAS VERY HELPFUL WHEN I REACHED OUT WITH ANY ISSUE

Would definitely stay here again. Very clean and lots of room! Plenty of linens, lots of kitchen space to cook, parking is always available. Quiet neighborhood with lots of stuff near by.  This is a basement unit so you can hear the people above but it was never an issue. Safe neighborhood, great to walk in if you’re into that.
Great location, comfortable stay, and attentive hosts!

This space was nice however when I got to the hotel I was charged for the price of the room, the security deposit (which were both listed) and an additional $125 (which was not disclosed in the listing). The hotel insisted that I pay the additional fee of $125 before I could receive my keys. When I sought help from the host they were incredibly unhelpful. After some discussion on the phone the host agreed that those were fees added on by the hotel and they were not in the listing. He then said he would contact the hotel and figure it out. After hanging up the phone he ceased responding. I then contacted Airbnb who failed to reach the host as well. I wait 2 hours but it was New Years Eve and I had to attend a work event that I was hosting and was forced to pay the extra $125 just to receive access to my room. Airbnb has so far failed to reimburse this charge. Being that it was New Years Eve it would’ve been very difficult to find a new room that last minute. I’m very disappointed
10-15 minutes away from river north, great deal in my opinion, beautiful apartment, tall ceilings, would love to come back and use this Airbnb again

This was my husband and I's second time staying with Kasa and we had a great experience. The location is close to public transit, great restaurants, and downtown while maintaining a quiet and peaceful location. We've never felt unsafe in the area and appreciate how responsive the host is. The unit offers great views, a comfortable bed, an in-unit washer and dryer, and a nice kitchen. We would (and will) definitely stay with Kasa for a third time.
We have stayed at this property several times.    Great spot in Chicago Lincoln Park area, grocery store around the corner and an enclosed garage.  Hard to beat!

We stayed for NYE and enjoyed the location. We were close to the river, the L trains and had amazing views from 30th floor! Clean, warm and cozy. There is definitely noise from the trains but it was perfectly fine with our sound machines! We enjoyed hearing them.
Having a few things in the fridge was an added bonus by the owners. Would definitely recommend this location as it is completely safe, 24 hour security and parking on property was 100% secure with no worries which was awesome!
Thanks for allowing us to stay.
The place was quite and right for me to rest for work

If you like high end and a luxury feel then you should definitely stay here. The home is so dope and has endless features. Steam room in master bath was my absolute favorite. Will definitely be coming back here. Kay was great with communication and accommodations. Thank you!

Perfect location.  Easy parking.  The world's best shower in the Master Bath-- seriously--2 shower heads, a waterfall and 4 sprinklers--heaven on earth.  Do the temp adjustment outside the shower as it gets scalding if you're not careful.  Nice to have a washer/dryer in the unit.  Comfortable beds.

Espacio es suficientemente grande para la cantidad de personas! El host responde super rápido . Esta cercas de la ciudad . La localización no es la mejor … hubo unos ruidos de tiroteo el día que llegamos a pocos metros de distancia , un vecino fue grosero .. pero el host fue muy amable … y respondía pronto . Check in fue alas 3 pm
Host nos aviso q no había wifi y llego alas 9 arreglarlo . El portón no funcionaba donde estacionas el carro ( heads up ) … pero en conclusión muy buen espacio, cercas de la ciudad , limpio y buen host! 👍🏻:)
It’s very safe and convenient place
Great location and lots of space. Thomas made check in very easy
Nice place
This unit is about a five-minute walk to the Cermak-McCormack green subway stop. So that was pretty convenient. There’s also some deli shops and grocery stores nearby. These conveniences were great.

Jennifer was an excellent host.  Very responsive and accommodating to all requests.  She did a great job keeping an eye on her place and even left little gifts for my daughter while she stayed.  The area was great.  It is highly safe and always a place to park.  The room was very private, and the TV already had streaming services installed. The place had a weekly cleaning service come in to keep the place extremely well-kept.  The other guests and my daughter became great friends during their time together.  I would highly recommend this room and will plan for my daughter to stay next year during the holiday time.   Thank you!!!!

Muchas gracias a Milan por ser tan buen anfitrión!
El departamento es ideal para familias que visitan Chicago, todo limpio, en orden y acogedor
Muy recomendable!!
Really enjoyed our stay and Milan was a great host.
Didn’t even get to stay there cancelled the reservation no explanation no communication the day of my trip i was already otw and still hasnt said anything
Great place with very good security protocols. Host was very responsive and the unit was spacious and clean. Located in a very accessible area as well.
I enjoyed my stay for the most part but I most llkely won’t book again. Beautiful home
Nice and clean place, was super responsive and gracious. Great spot!
Amazing host and amazing place she is very helpful
The place was very nice and clean. We had no complaints. Would recommend!
Awesome place! Great stay and great neighborhood, recommended highly!

Clean, cozy environment with easy check-in and very communicative hosts. The layout is unique and gives the feel of having a little more space/privacy with multiple guests and the beds are VERY comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!

This was either the third or fourth time that my family of four stayed at Jamie‘s place over New Year’s. We love her location in portage Park, a fun neighborhood with not very many hotel options. Her attic apartment is well appointed and perfect for our family. We always feel so welcome and secure! This time Jamie had some problems with her heat, that we completely understand that this can happen in an older home in Chicago in the middle of winter. Jamie went above and beyond to get the problem rectified and made sure that we were comfortable in the process. Highly recommend Jamie’s place as always!

While visiting my daughter, I have stayed in 4 different Airbnb’s in the Rogers Park area over the past couple of years. For me, this was by far the best! Chip and Lito were very responsive and had everything ready for an earlier check in on Christmas Day. From the beautifully furnished garden level home, decorated Christmas tree, chilled bottle of my favorite wine and other amenities, I felt such a warm welcome on a cold Chicago day. I wish I could have stayed longer than a week, but will definitely be back. Excellent and very responsive hosts!
The place was comforting, warm and quiet for a very windy city. I enjoyed the amenities he provided as well as the recommendations.

Everything went well and beyond .
Couldn’t get parking at sometimes apart from that it’s worth the money .

Jared was a very helpful and responsive host. As for the place itself, it had enough room for our group of 8, it was in a really good location and the parking was convenient. Overall, it was a good place to say. I will say that it definitely looks like a place that's been used as an Airbnb for a long time and could use a few updates (broken picture frames, stained furniture, etc). The photos in the listing were definitely taken a long time ago.

Beautiful stay in a great neighborhood! Felt like the perfect home away from home. Super clean and Angela supplied us with parking passes, which we greatly appreciated. Looking forward to staying again in the future!

This was the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at, largely because of the outstanding communication and hospitality. We were able to speak with someone in person upon arrival, and they were very helpful with general questions such as parking and directions. The host was always responsive to any questions or concerns and even checked in during our stay to make sure everything was going well.

Très bon séjour à Chicago, le logement est dans un quartier calme avec quelques restaurants. Nos déplacements ont essentiellement été fait en uber ou à pieds (30mn à pieds du centre ville)
Le logement était propre mais il y avait une odeur persistante de canabis que nous n’avons pas réussi à évacuer.
Roseanna est réactive et flexible avec les horaires d’arrivée.

Benjamin is a a great host! The check in was very easy and the location is easy to find. Initially we experienced some noise from other guests since the rooms are very close to the hang out area, but Benjamin was responsive and helped us to communicate with them. Ultimately we were able to rest comfortably.
Enjoyable stay. Water stayed hot to fill the jacuzzi. Very relaxing. Place was clean and inviting. Bed was comfy. Only con I noted was the cold floors, but that was disclosed.
A super nice place with outstanding hosting. We greatly appreciated everything, particularly his suggestions, clear communication, and kindness.

The place was great to come to sleep after exploring Chicago. However there was one night that some cars were racing in front the street for an hour or so and then the police came. However, everything else was fine, the rooms and the kitchen had everything we need.

We had such a fantastic stay here. The place was big and it had multiple areas to hang out so it was great for our larger group. The chefs in the group had a good time cooking in the kitchen which was fully stocked. Everything was clean, the bathroom was nice, and the beds were very comfortable.  Also, we absolutely LOVED the massage chair, 10/10 from our group.
Loved that it had 4 rooms for all my kids as well as myself for new years.

Cute lil spot in a cute lil neighborhood. Grocery store across the street was really convenient. If you have a chance you should check out the Breakfast House it’s so close. The place was clean with more than enough appliances and basic necessities. The bed was nice and comfy. Would definitely stay again.
Great location on the river!

We had a very nice stay here. The apartment matched the description exactly, and the neighborhood was peaceful. Sarah was very friendly and responsive. I would definitely consider staying here again on future trips to Chicago.

The location was very convenient, and the house matched the listing photos and description. Overall, we had a good stay and the home worked well for our trip.
A few things future guests may want to be aware of. The host requires an in-person check-in, which was clearly communicated in advance. While we appreciated the transparency, it was somewhat inconvenient given our flexible travel plans and early arrival to the city. Coordinating arrival timing added some stress, and we would have preferred the option for independent self check-in, which is more typical for similar rentals.
The home is older, which adds character but also comes with limitations. The heating was inconsistent, with some rooms noticeably warmer than others. Additionally, there are fewer outlets than expected, and they aren’t always located where you’d naturally need them, making device charging slightly challenging at times.

We enjoyed our stay at the Village Inn. It is located in a quiet and convenient neighborhood with a lot of restaurants and stores within walking distance. Julie Ann was very clear and responsive. We would definitely stay here again!
Really good, pretty big room and had a small fridge in it as well. Amazing stuff, would recommend.

My experience was bad since I arrived nothing compared to the photos, the doors nothing safe, entrance door, bedroom door and bathroom door, unfortunately the first night I didn’t sleep there the day sgte I told him I was leaving he didn’t want to charge me for two nights, he didn’t want to reimburse me, for something fair that unfortunately changed the stay, nothing understanding with the customers in this case it was me, I wouldn’t go back.
Excellent location and spotless apartment

Alma’s place was exactly as described in the pictures. It was close to restaurants and downtown. I thought the ear plugs were a nice touch due to the noise from the train. I am definitely going to book this space again! Thanks Alma

Our stay was less than ideal. After our first Airbnb reservation was cancelled the day of our trip we were able to rebook to Maximillian's place with Airbnb support. We waited for check in information and never received it. 7 minutes before check-in and after being on hold with his property team, we were told our stay was cancelled without explanation. After pushing he said there was a power issue (electricity) at the Airbnb. However we drove past the Airbnb that had lights on with people inside. The host did not explain the situation further and left our out of town group stranded without a place to stay for the night and ruined our plans. Extremely disappointing, especially when we were told "my property is professionally managed by an excellent team who assists with all communication." We spoke to three different team members, all of which had no information for us. Would not recommend.

The “King” room was very nice with a private bathroom and a nice and comfortable bed.
Rebecca was very attentive with great communications, checking in periodically and providing notice for any needed/scheduled cleaning’s. As well as providing notifications of new guest and departing guest. The pride in her property is shown by the cleanliness and uncluttered look was relaxing. Rebecca, Super Host…yes of course.
Ben was an excellent host. The unit had a small issue with the dishwasher but it was fixed promptly and Ben was super responsive throughout.
Good location, close to public transport and shops/restaurants, clean space

The apartment was conveniently located for our family's stay in Chicago. It was easy to walk or take public transportation where we needed/wanted to go. The space itself is laid out nicely. We had 4 adults and 3 kids and there was plenty of room for everyone to eat together or spend time together in the living room. Access was easy and straightforward as well. The only issues was that we had hoped to cook meals in the apartment, which proved difficult. There were limited pans and basic kitchen supplies available for cooking and just preheating the oven set off the smoke detectors on multiple occasions. We reached out to the host and they were very responsive, sending someone out to look at it within a few hours. However, the issue was not fixed and if we wanted to turn on the oven, we still had to open windows to avoid setting off the smoke detector. Based on this experience, I would happily recommend this unit as long as you are not planning to use the oven.

Kerilyn's place was perfect for our group of 4. We had 3 adults and one toddler, and the futon in the spare room was the perfect place for the toddler to have their own room, although we had to borrow bedding from a local friend as there was no extra bedding provided.
The house is older and creaky when walking around, classic old Chicago apartment. It had what we needed, no frills but a well-kept and cute place.
Bonus was tons of games and puzzles, and some random fun toys for my toddler to enjoy :)

We really enjoyed our stay at Maria's house.  We met our kids at the house so we had 6 people and it would accommodate 8 easily.  The home is refinished and updated, located just outside of Roscoe Village.  There is a garage space to park one car and there were always parking spots available on the street.  The neighborhood is quiet, we walked around the surrounding blocks looking at holiday lights at night.  There are two main bus lines that can take you down to the blue line train station on California or one that takes you close to Wrigley and the red line train.  There are a few grocery stores less than a mile drive away and plenty of places to eat and drink.  The house has 4 bedrooms upstairs with 2 full baths and another bedroom in the basement with another full bath.  There is also a full bath on the main floor.  The main floor has two big sofa's and some chairs, along with a large dining room table.  We thought it was a great space and a great location!
I had a good time :)

Rida siempre estuvo al pendiente, contestaba rápido los mensajes. La zona era tranquila y agradable. El único inconveniente fue que no tuvimos internet porque el módem estaba fallando pero como casi no estábamos en el departamento porque fuimos a conocer Chicago, no fue un problema, literal solo llegábamos a dormir. En si las instalaciones del lugar súper cómodas, agua calientita siempre, los lugares turísticos en carro quedan cerca, lo recomiendo.
We had a great stay here! The building had very nice amenities and the unit itself everything we needed for a short stay. Check in was flexible. Thank you again!
We’ve stayed at Angelika & Zibi’s many times now. The place is always clean and communication is quick and easy. We love staying here!
Susan’s place is in a great location. Lots of pubs and restaurants within walking distance. Very quiet area. Comfortable beds and stocked kitchen.

Excelente lugar, muy cercano al centro y a destinos turísticos, el departamento está muy bonito, tiene todo para pasar unas vacaciones agradables, súper súper recomendado y a Patricia súper amable, me respondía muy rápido, dejé unas cosas olvidadas y hubo buena comunicación para ir por ellas, de verdad excelente!
Great place to stay at. The host was very kind and helpful. I recommend 10/10 👌
Great location, apartment is pretty drafty, but it was cold outside. Had good coffee on site. It's probably better when it's not super cold outside.
Great stay! Matthew was very helpful. The apartment was exactly what we were looking for.

Jonathan's place is exactly as advertised: High end unit - all the ammenties - and perfectly clean. As a host - he accommodated our last minute reservation, it was easy and well communicated how to access the unit. The in unit washer/dryer was so helpful. We also had to change our checkout - and he was understanding and made that easy as well!
We were in Chicago to visit our colledge age kids - and we will for sure stay here again (for the next 4 to 6 years). Very professional host.
Spacious, simple, clean.   Interesting neighborhood.   Parking can be a challenge.
wonderful.
Great place in a great location with a super responsive and accommodating host. 5 stars. Will stay again
A stylishly furnished and clean space that looks exactly as advertised. The host was helpful, respectful and provided every necessity, even offering refreshments upon checking in.

I stayed in the apartment for two weeks. It was very quiet in the building, and nobody bothered me. The area itself is very quiet and safe. A microwave, kettle, and dishes were available. I even had coffee and spices for cooking at my disposal.
Entry to the building and the apartment was via a code. There was no need to contact the host with any questions or needs – everything was fine without it. I was completely satisfied. If needed, I would gladly stay there again!

La estancia con Ron fue de varios días, estuvo siempre atento a mis dudas, ya que fue mi primera vez en Chicago, las instrucciones de la llegada son muy claras, el cuarto tiene un buen tamaño para dos huéspedes,  el vecindario tiene muchas opciones de comida, es muy tranquilo. Están cerca las paradas de autobús y metro que te llevan al centro. Ron es muy amable y divertido, y a la salida nos permitió dejar las maletas por más tiempo. Recomendable al 100%.
excellent spot to stay
It was a beautiful place clean. She was very helpful. I will stay there anytime again thank you Monika for your help.
It is a beautiful home. 3 floors works great for our 3 families. We love the kitchen with multiple dishwasher. Plenty of linens and great laundry.
Great place! Plenty of parking. Easy to find. Very quiet!

Nosa’s place in the West Loop was a good location for us because we were going to a hockey game at the United Center. It was literally a two minute walk which was so nice!
If the weather had been better, we also could’ve walked other places, but ended up mostly taking an Uber (or the train) because of how cold it was. There are lots of great restaurants in the West Loop and the green line train is very close too.
Nosa’s place had a lot of room, but there were a couple of minor maintenance issues. I have messaged Nosa directly about those and hopefully they will be taken care of soon.
Très bon séjour chez Patty !
Very Accomandating

Jose’s stay was conveniently placed in city. Only 5 minutes from Target. I enjoy my stay here because the room was clean, the kitchen as easy to access, and the bathroom was in close proximity. Thank you for the warm stay!

Perfect place in a great, up-and-coming neighborhood. My only quibble is that it is described as  being close to the blue line — it’s a 20-minute walk away. Belmont (77) bus  is a fine way to get from the place to the Belmont blue line el stop and back, however. Would add tat to the listing. Otherwise, great place and very tastefully designed. The neighborhood is awesome.
The room was warm and comfortable, and the host was very kind and replied to messages quickly. Just across the street was a park, so the location was excellent. I really enjoyed my stay.

A great location situated pretty much on the cusp between Bucktown and Logan Square, even if it claims the latter. Close enough to the Blue Line for folks coming in from O’Hare. One of those properties that perfectly encapsulates the local living experience; tons of walkable options for food and drink, but also serves as a great hub to venture out on public transit or rideshares. Immaculately clean, with photos that accurately represent the space. Pet-friendly, and balancing all of the above is no small feat. Would definitely stay again.
Nice and peaceful area. And it’s closer to my where my daughter lives.
Beautiful home, clean, in a safe neighborhood, and great communication with the owners.

We loved our stay at Logan's place and look forward to our next visit.
Without a doubt, we will be back. It was a great neighborhood with good restaurants close by. We took Logan's recommendation on Angelo's - wonderful pizza! The house was spotless and it was nice to have the option of washer and dryer. The kitchen was very well stocked with pots and pans, etc needed for cooking along with a full size refrigerator. We loved having a drip coffee maker. The linens, bedding, soft blankets were top notch. This time of year, we especially loved walking in the neighborhood with all of the Christmas lights.
Great place and great host!
Great place to stay
This is the spot for bringing your crew to Chicago. Lots of space for everyone in your group and somewhere to relax outside. It even has two kitchens. And the free parking outside is hard to beat.

This place was beautiful and very clean. It had everything you needed. Nilka and Carlos were beyond gracious. She had gifts for us when we arrived and even made a special drink , that my family enjoyed during the Holidays.  Location was great for us and I liked that Tony’s store was close by. We enjoyed our stay. Thank you so much.
Good location!  Lots of restaurants and conveniences close by.
Thanks, will stay again!!

This location and home was perfect for visiting family and friends and having our pups along with us. It's across from a university campus and a park, both good dog walking options. There's a nature preserve close by, too, for even longer walks. The neighborhood was also good for potty walks, plenty of grassy areas. The back yard was paved, good for throwing a ball or creating more space, but not a yard for pottying.
Kitchen had everything we could need to cook. There was coffee and tea, so helpful. Huge comfy couch with blankets. Spacious bathrooms, well decorated, very functional for multiple guests. Beds were quite comfy. You'll possibly want earplugs (lots were available from the host) and eye-masks. The neighborhood isn't loud at night, but the front bedroom is right on the street, so there is light traffic noise and streetlight coming in. The other bedroom has skylights overhead.
Kim was a kind, responsive host. This place is on our list for future visits!

On voulait vous remercier pour tout, nous avons passer un séjour génial ! L’appartement est vraiment magnifique, spacieux et merci pour les petites attentions tels que les serviettes en plus, la lessive, le café etc… Ce n’est pas toujours le cas. Nous reviendrons avec GRAND plaisir !
En vous souhaitant de bonne fêtes, que votre année soit rempli d’amour et de bonheur !
This was an amazing place to stay the host was also amazing and responsive throughout our stay, overall beautiful house!
We had a great stay. Everything was very clean and the host was very responsive.

Perfect stay, the only things i'd like to improve are: the washing machine and dryer are not free of charge, and I wish the owner were a little quicker at responding, besides that i highly recommend this stay

The house was great. Plenty of room to host large groups. Actually can sleep up to 20. Nice big beds. Very clean. Plenty of dishes, silverware, and pots/pans for large family meals. Will repeat again.

This was a wonderful place to stay that I would recommend to anybody! Our host was amazing. She was communicative, responsive, and flexible to accomodate any of our needs. The home was extremely well kept and very comfortable. The house was well stocked and everything we needed for our stay. Our check-in was extremely easy which was great after a long day of travel. Plus, there were a lot of extra care put in to making our stay at the home feel like home. There was a wonderful sign custom made to welcome us to the house. There were snacks and drinks available to make us feel comfortable until we could go shopping for our own food. There were extra supplies for laundry. The shampoo, conditioner, and soap provided were excellent. The neighborhood was extremely quiet and safe. It was great to have dedicated parking so we never had to look for a spot on the street. For sure a 5 star stay. We will definitely be staying here on all trips to Chicago!!!
Love the area and the host addressed any issues promptly.

Muy buena estancia, cómoda en general, lo único que nos hubiera gustado es tener la lavadora dentro del departamento y no que fuera publica para varios huéspedes, no resultaba cómodo ir y venir cargando ropa…

Can’t beat the location and the double car garage. It was a great space for our two families and 5 young kids. Place had two pack and plays, a high chair, laundry and lots of games. Kitchen was well stocked for cooking needs. Biggest downside was the noise from the rented unit above us.
Great experience! Nice accommodations!

I felt very safe in the area the Airbnb was located. Everything matched the descriptions, and there was easy access to nearby metro and bus stations, as described. Plenty of space and definitely worth the price!

Overall a great stay and I would likely stay again.
Pros: perfect location, spacious unit, well-equipped kitchen and bath, host checked in constantly and responded immediately.
Things to be aware of: a lot of very steep stairs to get to the unit, the heater is incredibly loud when it turns on in the living room, the bed is super soft and the couch/futon is super hard. None of those are a deal breaker for us but good to know going in!
Loved the apartment wished there was a tv in the bedroom and the couch wasn’t very comfortable. Other than that it was an amazing stay
Súper anfitrión Jacob, muy claras sus instrucciones y atento a los mensajes a la llegada y salida, sin duda volvería, es un vecindario tranquilo.
I recommend. Very communicative and friendly!
Great place, extremely comfortable, great location and Sarah was a great host - super responsive and extremely helpful.

This unit#3 was an excellent choice. I loved the location and it felt like home. Lots of light in the living room. Super comfortable furniture. Always responsive hosts! I would definitely stay there again. The pictures match the actual accommodations. Book here if you want to be close to the action.
Ample free and convenient parking right outside the apartment.  It was easy to walk our dogs around the neighborhood to enjoy Christmas lights.  Jennifer is a warm and caring hostess.

Not only was Russell’s property immaculate, he was frequent in checking in to ensure that my stay was as pleasant and enjoyable as possible. When I had questions, they were responded to in <10 minutes (even early in the morning). I highly recommend this property (or any of Russell’s)!
Thank you for making my stay enjoyable!

Lili and team were great!! Their place is great, sleek, modern, and homey! They were very responsive and accommodating. My family and I needed a place last minute and they were able to work it out and we are very appreciative.
This place is also a great location 10 minutes from superdawg, 15 minutes from downtown (non traffics times). Centrally located to enjoy really enjoy Chicago!

My wife and I stayed at the Lakeview apartment during our holiday trip. The location of the apartment is fantastic, it is very safe and there are many good restaurants nearby. The area is walkable and there is no noise. In this apartment, you share bathrooms with three other rooms but you do have a private lock for your room. We also shared the kitchen which had many amenities. The place was clean too.
We stayed for two weeks and the hosts were very responsive if we requested any information.
We look forward to booking again on our next trip!

Our family really enjoyed the apartment. It matched the photos perfectly, and the location was convenient with lots to do nearby. Jim and his team communicated excellently, always getting back to us quickly. They were very accommodating and offered multiple ways to stay in touch with their team. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. We’d definitely recommend it and would love to book again in the future!

My family and I had a lovely stay at Guirlaine’s place! It was just as described, easy to locate, and had great amenities and kitchen items (coffee, tea, hot chocolate, and basic pantry items). We really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend to others!

Loved the stay! We were there for 10 days during Christmas. We are local and needed a larger space for visiting family. This house was perfect! It felt like being really at home. Our out of town guests got to experience being in the heart of Chicago’s Southside along with being close to our actual residence. We explored different parts of the city because it’s in a central location. The 2 car garage was nice for parking. Really enjoyed this space and will definitely be using again for more family stays! (Also saved me so much stress and anxiety from hosting my man’s mom for the first time IYKYK. She really loved the space also and felt so at home) Oh last thing, I LOVED the linen!!! If you’re into comfy beds and just good bedding, this place was so good.

Communication with Hanna was excellent; she was always very attentive! The problem was that the place had a very unpleasant smell, the refrigerator wasn't working properly, there was no toilet paper, and the toilet was clogged!
We loved staying here and it was convenient with 3 dogs. Good neighborhood and spacious. Would definitely stay here again.

This Airbnb listing claimed it is in an apartment, but it's actually a converted basement. The location is very close to downtown Chicago, and the neighborhood seemed safe, which was suitable for my conference. However, the basement is very old and in need of updates. The ceiling fans constantly creaked, and there’s a small, locked cabinet in the living area that sounded like it was recycling bathroom water. The air conditioner was very loud, making it difficult to sleep. The second shower is very small and hard to use properly. The floor is uneven with many dips. The living space is quite cramped, and the dining table in the kitchen isn’t practical because it feels unstable and like you might fall. I understand it’s a basement business unit, but it definitely needs renovation. There’s no ice or boiling kettle for tea, and I personally disagree with the color of the bed sheets.

Peter's place is on a lovely, quiet street and only half a block in either direction from shops, bars, and great restaurants!  The location couldn't be better.  The apartment was spotless, the cleanest airbnb I've stayed in.  Everything about the place was comfortable and thoughtful; comfortable beds, nice linens, comfortable furniture. Communication was clear and prompt, and included great restaurant recommendations.   It is clear that Peter cares that his guests have a nice stay in his place.
My family and I enjoyed our stay.  The place is in a terrific location. It met our needs perfectly.
Overall, a very spacious well equipped place in the  heart of Chicago. The property management company responded to request in a timely fashion.

Overall, this was a great stay. We were there for 30 nights. The host was super responsive to any and all questions throughout the extended stay. Building is modern/new, bathrooms are clean, bedrooms are comfortable, kitchen has most common appliances/pots/pans (although a bit cheap), and the common workspace was convenient for days we did not go to the office. Convenient location to grocery stores, Red line, a few local bars, but mostly a lot of chain restaurants and retail shops. Walkable-ish to the more well-known areas of Chicago but expect to drive / Uber.
Two areas of improvement: seating is very uncomfortable. If you plan to spend any time inside the unit, know that the couch and chairs are not meant for lounging around or working. Parking is very expensive for Chicago prices, and the garage door cannot be opened with the app that opens all other building door. You have to park the car, walk to a side door, open manually, and then go back to your car to park.

This place was amazing and it’s close to a lot of things. It’s a little smaller than it looks in the pictures but it was an amazing stay regardless and it felt like home. The host provided great recommendations for what to do while being quick to respond to questions. Will definitely be visiting again.

We stayed with 6 adults for a family get away.  The place had plenty of space for everyone and was bright and comfortable.  The location was awesome.  Close to public transportation if you wanted to go check out Chicago, but a ton to do right outside your door!  The place was clean and host was extremely friendly.  We had a great time.

Beautiful, spacious, well-stocked apartment in a perfect location. Comfortable mattresses and pillows. Pippa, Kendall, and Steve were very helpful and communicative. Our family of 4 (kids 9 and 11 yo) wouldn't hesitate to stay here again, if you'll have us!
Great location in Wicker park! Walkable to shopping, restaurants and grocery store. Roof hot tub was fun! Easy to park and responsive host.

The place was beautiful just like the pictures indicated. Easy to get in. No problems with parking. Quiet neighbors. Quick access to the freeway. Very comfortable and had everything we needed and more. Thomas was very available and accessible. Will stay again and recommend.

My husband and I stayed with our 4 kids and there was plenty of room. The Spanish kitchen, living and master suite was perfect for our 3 day vacation to Chicago. It was clean and very nice with lots of amenities. Walking distance to Mag Mile, several restaurants and other stores. Definitely recommend!

Great place with a fantastic host! We rented both the upper and lower apartment and there was more than enough space. The house was stocked with pretty much everything we needed to stay for a few days. The location is perfect and there was great outdoor space available, even though it was much too cold to enjoy.
I’d love to come and stay here with in the warmer months with friends! The only potential downside is the number of bathrooms, but that is obviously something you know going in to it.

Place was exactly as advertised.  Clean, spacious and completely met my needs.  Could not really hear the bar below the apartment but could hear people outside on the sidewalks but that is  no different than any other location near by.
We stayed with Mayra and Ronaldo and the stay was great. The place was very clean and they were responsive and present for any questions or issues we had!

This a great and affordable place for a larger group. We had three couples in our party, and the layout was perfect; with two nice bathrooms in the hallway to share amongst all of us. It was nice to have a big sofa and a large kitchen table that could easily seat all of us - with room to spare. (A note to future renters is that the space is on the first floor. You need to walk into the patio through a low and unlocked fence/gate. The main door is under the stairs. We made the mistake of going up up the stairs to a different apartment when we tried to check in.)
The apartment is about a 15 minute walk to the heart of Chinatown, and an easy 10-15 minute drive to the museum area (e.g. Shed, Adler, Field, etc.).
I would definitely go back the next time we need a space for six or more people.
loved the location, close to the red line and restaurants and parking included was great

This was our second stay with Darius.  The apartment was just as clean and comfortable as last year. I seemed to have had more questions for Darius about minor things than last year, and he responded promptly and positively. After our arrival, I couldn't find the remote for one of the TVs.  I sent him a message and he brought over a new one in a few hours. The temperature dropped down into the 20s, but the central heating kept us comfortable at all times.  An excellent experience once again. Thank you, Darius.

Great place to stay! Ben was a great host as well. Very responsive and fast. There is plenty of space on this unit and our family had a great time. Clean and spotless. You will have everything you need within walk distance. Definitely will be staying there again when I’m back to Chicago.
Convenient location close to midway and shops only downside was the parking

It's clear this unit is never lived in by the host because it feels like a motel rather than an apartment. The furniture is cheap, dusty, and wobbly. The listing photos are edited to airbrush out the peeling paint on the baseboards and general look of uncleanliness. There's a huge water stain on the kitchen ceiling. Other reviews have mentioned water stains in all rooms for at least the past year, and the host always responds saying that they're addressing them - at this point, probably don't believe him. If you're thinking of staying during the winter be aware - the heater is LOUD. Also the AC units were left in the windows and are poorly sealed so there is cold air constantly pouring into the apartment. This wasn't addressed during our stay because apparently we - the renters - have the only set of keys so Maintainace couldn't get in. Overall, the apartment felt uncared for, which would be fine if the price was cheap, but it was actually fairly expensive. I would not recommend.
The apartment is excellent and comfortable, it has a good location in addition the owner is very amble and responds immediately

Pictures don't capture how massive this place is! The bedrooms are fantastic--comfy mattresses and linens. Bathrooms were great, especially the washer/dryer. Check-in and check-out was very smooth/minimal hassle. Excellent for larger gatherings!
I loved staying in this beautiful place. would def stay here again and it’s perfect for family and friends!

Unfortunately this listing says it allows 10 people, we had 10 people and the shower was freezing cold and only 1 person got a hot shower the whole trip for 5 minutes each day. Absolutely horrible, maintenance came in 4 times and each time they did the same thing, said the water was perfectly fine and went on with their day. We were celebrating our friend’s birthday and we went smelling of Body odor, yes that’s normal, and no we couldn’t shower and enjoy the party.
Wonderful location, comfortable, clean, host responsive to questions. Would definitely stay here again.

We had a very enjoyable stay at Kate’s studio apartment.  It had everything we needed, including a fully functional kitchenette with oven and induction cooktop.   Comfy bed and nicely decorated.   Perfect location for the Edgewater/Andersonville neighborhoods.  Also close to the el and various bus lines if you want to go into the city.

The space was clean and sparse, plenty comfy, and nicely warm during a true cold spell during our visit. I mentioned one drafty bedroom window, which hopefully got fixed after we left.
The bathroom is great. The two beds are very comfy, and the third in our party slept soundly on the sofa, having no complaints.
The largest downside was the kitchen--nicely equipped, but with a clumsy, unergonomic layout. The counter barstools block access through the unit when pulled out to use. The choice to furnish the kitchen with a bar-height table results in an unpleasant effort for short people to sit, and one of its chairs is missing a footrest bar, so one's feet dangle uncomfortably. I would recommend that the host replace that table with a normal-height one.
Mala comunicacion

The apartment was clean, cozy, and modern. It was lovely. We had a  little issue getting in, but was corrected quickly.  They had a Keurig for individual  cups or a full pot.  The street is busy, loud,  and lively, especially on weekends.  My dog enjoyed people watching in the window. We suggested blackout curtains for the bedroom.   Most of the parking in the area is meter parking, loading the parking meter app was helpful.
I was in a pinch and the owner was very accommodating, especially to my ESA pets. good restaurants around there also.
It was a great place for my family to get together for the holidays, very nice house, it was also the perfect location close to train and busses
Nice place to stay in Avondale/Logan Square area. The dedicated parking space was very helpful. The neighborhood is super-walkable, with grocery & other stores close by.
Beautiful home. Very spacious and comfortable. Would stay again in a heartbeat. Thanks Gary.

Stay here if you want to be poisoned with black mold. After many days of feeling mysteriously sick, we discovered the mold in the second and third bedrooms upstairs after staying for a week and a half (because we were not using those rooms so we did not spend time in them enough to see it growing all around the ac/heating vents). We reported it immediately and the owner wanted to only discount one night and wanted to send in his incompetent handyman to “clean it”. First of all, black mold needs remediation by a professional and cannot be done in a day. Also, It is not safe to occupy a home that is going through remediation making it unsafe for us to continue to occupy the home. Making his solution unsafe and unsuitable. We are seeking full reimbursement for our heath and safety being put at risk and making us sick in addition to the headache of having to move airbnbs in the middle of our stay. I have also brought to his attention the many other safety hazards of the home.
Exactly as advertised! More than enough room for our family of 8. Location is perfect, quiet neighborhood. Would definitely stay again.
Not too bad of a stay. Although valet was slow, this isn’t too bad of a pick.

Great apartment in a great location. Incredibly walkable, so many awesome restaurants around and very spacious apartment overall. As you’ll see in other reviews, this is on the fourth floor of a walk up / no elevator. So you will definitely get your steps / cardio in when coming and going. Definitely not an issue as we knew what we were getting into but something to be aware of. Highly recommend this apartment. If this isn’t available you can also book other units on their website!
Bonito alojamiento , limpio y agradable, privacidad y cerca de varias tiendas

I would stay at Cloud9 places again but never this one. The loudness of the neighbors for a Sunday and Monday night was a shocker. I appreciate the earplugs but I am not sure we got much sleep before 1 am on non weekend nights. I have lived in the city, this was unreasonable. The amenities were crowded with unfriendly people. You can see 2 sets of people here, the AIRBNB people and grown single men. All the rooms with TVs were full, loud, an uninviting for a family with children.
Cloud 9 did a great job communicating and the place is beautiful. The workers at the condo were great.
Good

I really enjoyed my stay here. This home is beautiful, clean & affordable. I love the kitchen wear for cooking your own food. Also, there's a mini fridge & a personal heater in the rooms. What a surprise!! I was also excited about linen being provided. This rental was very accommodating. Thank you!! I definitely hope to stay again in the future.
Great host as always

A very pleasant stay. Extremely suitable for friends who travel together but need individual space. The community is safe and quiet and you can find good breakfasts around. We met some problems checking in but Tara solved very well.
His place is very neat and well taken care of.
Enjoyed are stay, great location!

El apartamento es acogedor y tenía lo necesario para nuestra estancia, las camas estaban cómodas. la ubicación es estupenda,  cerca de todo y de la estación de tren hacia el aerepuerto. Elena nos resolvió algunos inconvenientes de una forma muy diligente. Seguramente me volvería a alojar en este apartamento. Nis sentimos como en casa.

シカゴを観光する際に2泊3日で利用しました。とても清潔で快適、おしゃれはアパートです。シカゴ市街地にアクセスするバスの乗り場に徒歩でアクセス可能、付近に飲食店もあり便利なロケーションです。
メッセージの返答が早く丁寧でした。
とても満足な宿泊でした。
Great location. Beds were uncomfortable and some places were a bit dusty. However check-in was super easy and the host was responsive.

We were a family of 8 ranging from 13 years old to 50+. We had an amazing stay! The accommodations were perfect! The neighborhood was cute and peaceful. Host was very responsive and the place was beautiful. The location to downtown Chicago was great and we were within a 20 minute drive to everything we wanted to do. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone wanting to stay close to Chicago. Side note- bring slippers or socks for indoors as shoes are not to be worn around the house.
great place

Great location, easy walk to California blue line and Milwaukee Avenue for shopping, restaurants. Typical to older buildings room at the front of the unit was noticeably colder than other parts of the apartment. Low water pressure in shower and one of the bathroom sinks.
Always great. Thanks!

Beautiful condo 5 minutes from the red line. Nathan was an exceptional host and even though he wasn't around during our stay, he went out of his way to help any way he could. One of our nicest stays and didnt even feel like it wasn't our own place because it definitely felt that way. we would for sure come back if ever in Chicago.
"Cozy" is the perfect word to describe this apartment. Very efficient and functional floor plan ans probably the most comfortable bed that I have ever slept in
Great place and location.  Amy went above and beyond to ensure an excellent experience. Would stay here again
Very great host! Lots of places in the area to visit & love the atmosphere! Thank you!!

I had a great time at Carmen's place with my family this past Christmas.  I was very pleased with the cleanliness,  location and accessibility.  I would recommend this place to anyone, and I look forward to returning at some point in the future.

Thank You So Much, Mr Shaun
It was really amazing 22 days in Chicago Peaceful place .
Secure and clean .
Neighbors was friendly
Neighborhood was clean and peaceful
Location was amazing, close to downtown and restaurants.
Thank You So Much Mr . Shaun
It was an exceptional place.

Alec's place was perfect for our family of 5 from FL. On our last day we played with his dogs and they're friendly. We enjoy the place very much. If we come back to Chicago again, we will surely book his place again.

The space worked perfectly for our needs (love having the extra space (compared to a hotel). Also, the gym was super convenient. My son was also able to get in quick workouts and keep on track with his basketball training without interfering with our other activities.

The rental was in a great location for our planned activities.  Close to the Brown Line which took us to Wrigleyville and Downtown Chicago.  It was great to have 4 bathrooms, which allowed each of our "family units" to have their own and no one had to share.  The bunk rooms were terrific for our younger family members.  The kitchen was well stock with the necessary items for cooking meals.  Our family of 12 fit in nicely.
Easy and cheap
trés bel appartement, prés des stations de bus, quartier calme

This was a very easy place for our whole family to to feel comfortable. Our teenagers enjoyed the foosball table and smore kits as soon as we arrived. It was a very cozy place to hunker down through the rain, snow and cold of our visit. Thank you to Teddy and Amy for being so responsive and available, even when we asked to drop our bags off a bit early. You really know how to make guests feel welcome!
Great location and great host! Fresh flowers and cream and sugar and coffee.

We had a very comfortable stay from the moment we arrived. The apartment is tucked away in a quiet neighborhood, which made it easy to find parking and enjoy a peaceful evening. A short, pleasant walk led us straight to Logan Square, where we could explore the local cafés and shops. Being just steps from the 606 elevated walkway was a real perk, offering convenient access to a scenic trail for a quick run or a leisurely stroll. For the two of us working from home, the space was ideal—quiet, well‑lit, and equipped with reliable Wi‑Fi. The kitchen was well stocked, allowing us to cook meals without needing to shop elsewhere. Overall, a great blend of comfort, convenience, and a charming location.
Great stay.
Great place! Lots of space for family of 6. Close to all Chicago things! Secure parking also a plus!

I really enjoyed the home overall; it was very peaceful and comfortable. However, the house rules regarding visitors were not clearly explained. I understand and respect a no-party policy, but when traveling from out of town, it is common to want to spend some time with family or friends. Being able to have one or two guests visit for a few hours without violating the rules would have made the experience more accommodating and convenient, especially to avoid excessive driving. Aside from this concern, I truly loved the home.

We had a pleasant stay overall. The townhouse is spacious, well laid out across multiple levels, and the neighborhood felt safe and quiet, which we really appreciated.
Communication with the host was good, and they were responsive when an unexpected issue came up due to heavy rain. While the basement area was affected, the host addressed the situation and offered a solution, which we appreciated.
Aside from that, the stay was comfortable and we enjoyed our time here. We would recommend the place, especially for groups looking for space in a calm area of the city.
Me and my friends had a really good time it was cozy and felt like a home 10/10 experience everything was perfect!!
Amazing place for affordable price, thank you

La estadía en general fue buena. El alojamiento es cómodo y cumple con lo descrito en el anuncio. No obstante, el tema del parqueo puede resultar inconveniente: aunque el hospedaje indica que cuenta con parqueo, en la práctica este es únicamente sobre la calle y no siempre hay espacio disponible, lo cual puede generar dificultades. Considero importante aclarar este punto para futuros huéspedes. Fuera de ese detalle, todo estuvo bien.
Great place, enjoyed my stay, amazing host!

I wanted to “get away” in the heart of the city for a few days.  Couldn’t have been more pleased with the accommodations.  Everything was as described. Views were top notch. Amenities were fantastic. Host was great. I will definitely return in the near future. You will have to deal with the noise of the Chicago “L” below, but for us, it turned into a kind of “white noise” after a while. Parking was a God send for the price. All in all, a GREAT experience.

This was a great place for our family holiday gathering of 12. It met our expectations, as pictured and described. It was nice to be across from a park. Public transportation to the center of town took 30-40 minutes. Unfortunately, the basement rooms were cold (no independent temperature controls), and there were no shades on those windows either. Otherwise it was very comfortable. The fancy toilets were a nice surprise. Great communication.
Location great,house beautiful Ishin very responsive. I will come again and stay here.

If I could rate this place and Nate 6 stars, I'd give it and him a 10! Nate was extremely hospitable, responsive, and accommodating. This will be the only Airbnb that I stay in when I come back home to Chicago.  It is a hidden gem!
Anfitriões nota 10. Acomodação impecável. Passamos ótimos dias de Natal lá.

Kelsey's place is a beautiful home! We especially appreciated the fully fenced backyard - the fence was very secure and all gates closed well, which made it feel very safe for the dogs. The beds were extremely comfortable, as were the couches. Lots of really good restaurants close by was really nice too. Kelsey is a great host, always responded very quickly to any questions that came up, and she really thought of everything you might need during the stay!

We had a great stay!  Talie was a wonderful host. Very responsive and helpful. The rooms were comfortable for our party of 8. We didn’t cook but kitchen looked like it had all the basics. Plenty of street parking.

This is a lovely, spacious home that is near the University of Chicago and walking distance to shops and restaurants. My extended family and I rented the place for the Christmas holidays and it worked out well. Caryl was very accommodating and even put up a Christmas tree for us. The kitchen is well stocked, bed was comfortable, and the house had everything we needed. Highly recommend!

The place was clean and easy to find, but I would have been happier with fewer and much briefer email communication. Each email sent was excessively long which
becomes disruptive especially when I had to scroll past multiple pages and emails to get to the information I actually needed. each email also included a request for a 5 star review, which should be (quietly) earned.
However, the place itself was clean and nicely located and matched the description.
A great place that fit our large family. Super communicative and answered all questions super quickly. Overall the the place was great and the location was perfect for us.
Loved everything about this place— great location, comfy beds, spacious, cozy, clean, and super easy to check in and communicate with host. Highly recommend!

Wow, what a spot! The pictures truly don’t do this place justice. It was spacious, beautiful, thoughtfully decorated, impeccably clean. And the view! Absolutely incredible. The hosts were very responsive and were able to accommodate early check in for us. It’s pricey but it was well worth it! Highly recommend and would stay again.

The apartment is on the 23rd floor with three other penthouses. It is very clean, well taken care of, with everything you need. Spacious for a group of 5 including a 7 year old. The views of the city are a 10/10 and you can even see Lake Michigan to the very east. The building has extra amenities on the 5th and 11th floors which was great for us since one day it was raining. There is also a little coffee shop with food in the lobby area. If you aren't able to check-in early, the staff is able to hold your luggage in a secure area, which they did for us and it was perfect. We went out to explore the city early afternoon and came back to check-in.
I previously lived in the area, and knew it is where I wanted to stay. If you know it, there are great restaurants around, or just a short Uber ride, and the place is right off the blue line. Will definitely be staying here again!
Everything was great.  We loved the trip!  The staff at condo were wonderful.

A clean, well-maintained, and comfortable apartment, equipped with all essential amenities. The view is exceptional, the host was highly professional, and the check-in process was smooth and efficient.
Convention center few minutes away.  Very Convenient

Apartamento muy limpio. Excelente ubicación en carro, metro o bus. Barrio muy seguro. Supermercados y tiendas cercanas.
Fui a Chicago por turismo y me pareció un buen punto para conocer los lugares turísticos de esa ciudad.
David un excelente anfitrión.

The location was great and check-in was easy. The host was responsive, and the place was as described. However, cleanliness could be improved—we noticed stains on the sheets as well as hair and dirt on the floor. The hosts were receptive to the feedback and agreed to look into it immediately, which we appreciated. Additionally, having extra sheets and blankets would have made things easier, especially given the issue with the bedding.
Overall, we recommend this place for the location and the hosts, but we do recommend ensuring and improving the cleanliness bar.

Last minute switched from a downtown hotel for a couple days in the city with the kids to this AirBnB and it did not disappoint.
5 minute walk to the United Center for the games we went to which was worth it alone.
Great location overall, very clean and described accurately. Host was very communicative.
Thanks for a great stay!

We stayed here with a group of friends for a few days. The place was very spacious and cozy. The house was dated but in a nice way with plenty of character. We enjoyed finding all of the little quirks about the property. It was pretty conveniently located and on-street parking wasn't an issue at all. It definitely felt worth what we paid and we would definitely stay here again.

Perfect location for us in the heart of Rodgers Park. Very quiet street in a very large corner building with just the two rental units. Walkable to several main streets. Building is 100 years old, but has been updated. Rooms are good size and the living area/dining is very functional. No on-suite of course because of the age. Kitchen is recently updated and very nice. Owners were super responsive, usually within a few minutes. Will definitely stay there again when visiting family.
Würden jederzeit wiederkommen und tolle Lage direkt an der „Magnificent Mile“ !

It was an extravagance I’m glad I spent the extra money on. We travel to Chicago often as our youngest went to school, graduated and stayed in the city. My wife, son and I usually stay at one of the Embassy Suites in the area while our oldest daughter stays with her sister. On this trip, we all stayed together, 5 adults.
The views are awesome, location perfect. The redline is a 30 second walk, the Jewel Osco store, even shorter. Bars, restaurants, theater, and shopping all within walking distance.
Chris, the doorman, very nice, accommodating and helpful. Jeri-Lou and Richard, couldn’t have communicated any better. It was lovely all being under the same roof again, best Christmas ever.
PS, if you are a “Friend of Bill’s” numerous very close and solid meetings nearby.😎
Great spot to have the family with and real close to the city with great restaurants near.
We had a nice weekend at Joan's place. It was a great size for a couple, a teenager, and a small dog. The neighborhood was peaceful and within a short distance of everything.
Great location with a nice river view

We loved staying here while visiting family for the holidays. The apartment is beautiful, spacious, clean, and stocked with everything you need to be comfortable. Lee was an incredible host who is both communicative and kind.

This was the perfect location for a visit with my daughter who lives in Lincoln Park. It was in walking distance of everything you need, including a bus line to downtown. Alex was a great host; super responsive and helpful, and the place was beautiful! We will definitely stay again!
Close to the McCormick place for the conference. They have good gym.
great
Great location and lots of space for our group
A quiet gem on the south side. Will rebook
The place looks just like the photos. I was traveling alone and felt more comfortable being somewhere with other people. This place has everything you need. 💯 recommend.
Buen lugar para ospedarse, con lo necesario para pasarla cómodos, Claudia muy amable y muy pendiente de alguna necesidad que pudiéramos tener, respecto al servicio ofrecido.
Very nice apartment, clean, and with all amenities. One suggestion is to put slide resistance pads/carpet on the stairs, which were slippery.

Nikkole was a very accommodating host! We needed to adjust our arrival/departure dates due to getting the stomach bug and she couldn’t have been more accommodating. The place fit our needs perfectly. Although was definitely a little cold - but that’s on us for booking a basement unit during a Chicago winter! Otherwise very practical apartment in a walkable neighborhood.
The only thing was the couches was to low for me it was bad on my back.  I enjoyed the apartment I would rent it again😃
Enjoyed our stay. Eliza’s place was just as advertised. Thanks for hosting us!
I really enjoyed my house away from home. At least that what it felt like. Thank you!

I had a very concerning experience at this property and cannot recommend it, especially for families. Check-in was delayed significantly; I did not receive confirmation until 8:30 PM. Because of this late arrival, I had to navigate a very unsafe environment outside the building with my children where people were openly selling and using drugs.
Additionally, there was no available parking, forcing me to park in an area where I felt physically unsafe. The host also required a security deposit and verification through a third-party site (Enso Connect) outside of the Airbnb app, which was confusing and felt insecure given the circumstances. I ultimately felt so unsafe that I had to leave the property.
Even though I canceled the reservation around 8:45 PM that same night because of these safety issues, I was told I had to pay the full price for all 3 days. To make matters worse, Airbnb support was not helpful at all; they kept transferring me from agent to agent without providing a resolu.

Monica’s place was nice and cozy, but the walk up to the space was very unsettling at first. Monica gave us extra heaters but when I asked if she had more there was no response at all. The heater in the space would sometimes blow cold air at random.
The place was crowded with parking and the street was very small. We stayed out of the room most of our trip so the spaces quality wasn’t such a big deal.

If you walk around the neighborhoods of Chicago, you see the most beautiful old homes and buildings.  This location is a great representative of a two bedroom apartment in a well preserved building in a great neighborhood. It feels like home.  Great feelings of space with large kitchen, DR and LR.  Good water pressure and amenities.  Hope this is available again on our next trip.

This place was an absolute gem. Beautiful, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed—everything felt easy the moment we arrived. The home is spotless, the beds are incredibly comfortable, and the kitchen is a dream. The neighborhood is charming and walkable, with great food, coffee, and transit nearby. The hosts were warm, responsive, and clearly care about the guest experience. We felt truly at home here and would return in a heartbeat. Highly recommend.
Overall, we liked staying there. It was clean and the description was accurate.

Great place, I liked it. Accessible to public transport stops, and it's cozy with a comfy design. It has all the appliances you need.
The reservation must be processed through a rental management company, and you will be required to pay an additional deposit, which will be refunded upon return. I don't like this generally in Airbnb because you use external links to have a boarding pass and get the check-in instructions.
Best,equipped,kitchen I've seen!  Grocery store 3 mins away.

We loved this apartment! It’s in a great location—we walked to restaurants, coffee shops, Target, and Whole Foods. Free street parking was easy to find, and the area felt safe. Brad was super responsive and helpful. We would definitely stay here again when visiting Chicago.

We had a pleasant stay at this Airbnb. The host was very accommodating, friendly, and made us feel welcome throughout our visit. He lives in the other room which I wasn’t expecting. He respected my space and offered to cook Nigerian food. Kareem was available if we needed anything, which we appreciated. Parking is very limited and there’s no elevator. So that’s something to be aware of when booking, but overall the experience was comfortable and enjoyable. We would recommend this place to anyone looking for a shared, cozy stay with a kind host.
It was a very good stay. He was always aware of anything we needed. It is a very quiet and beautiful place in addition to being accessible to take the bus and go to the different trains in the city.
