I have nothing bad to say about this place. I read everybody reviews before booking and everybody have their own opinion so I book and didn’t see no issues whatsoever. Hatice replied back every time I texted her and even texted me to make sure I didn’t need anything.
We were in town for a family emergency and Bel was able to accommodate us for a last minute stay. The place was clean and was great for our needs.
The place was spacious and lovely, perfect for many adults for a holiday week. It was extremely clean and safe. Very happy with this airbnb!
My family had a wonderful stay with Barbara. It was spacious, the beds were comfortable, and she had all of the necessary kitchen amenities.
Such a great space. The host was great, responsive, and helpful. Will definitely book this place again.
Easy and clean place close to my mom’s house. It was a pleasant stay. We also met the owners and they were very nice.
washroom door could not be locked up. others were superb.
It was worth so whoever decides to go to Chicago make sure you try this place out it's real comfortable
Jennifer’s place was wonderful.  Extremely clean with very comfy beds.  It was surprisingly quiet!  We would definitely book again.

We had an amazing stay at Rich’s place! The space was beautifully and thoughtfully decorated—it felt both stylish and comfortable from the moment we arrived. The location was fantastic and made getting around super easy. Rich was an outstanding host: very down to earth, friendly, and always prompt in responding to any questions or requests we had. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Pictures were accurate easy street parking was available which is free. Host was kind and responsive

We traveled to the area to spend Christmas with my adult daughter and her fiancé. Our group were my husband and myself, my 85 yr old father (still very capable of climbing stairs!) and our very tall 25 yr old son. The bedrooms worked great for our group, plenty of room, stylish, and comfy. And we were able to cook and serve a festive Christmas dinner at the unit (made sure it was okay to invite daughter and fiancé over!) and exchange gifts. A very special Christmas! Plus very easy to use the L to get downtown as well as used an Uber with no trouble. Plus a really walkable neighborhood! Loved the whole experience!
It was a great trip! Made a lot of memories with the family. The host was very responsive and flexible. Overall great experience!
Great location for our visit with easy parking.  The space was cozy and perfect for us to celebrate our Christmas away from home.
Lovely, spacious townhouse in River North. Excellent location on a quiet street. We would come again. Everything was very guest friendly.
great place!    Will book again
Josh is always quickly available if you need anything or have any questions.
Amazing home.
We stayed here with our 7 week old baby and it was perfect! They even provided a pack n play for us to use. Definitely stay here if you’re looking for a comfortable spot in a great location!

My family had a wonderful stay here. The studio was very inviting and comfortable with many amenities ( coffee maker, dishes, pans, etc).
The hosts were friendly and responsive. My family would definitely stay again.

Other than small details we found the place enjoyable.
Walking distancie from the Chicago Bears Stadium.
Bus rides takes you to down Town Chicago in few minutes.
CTA train station close by!
Check in was confusing and the form to checking was lil annoying since I thought it was a scam for sometime. I do not think I should put my card details anywhere besides this platform.
Great location and food unit
Great location.  Clean, spacious unit.
I really enjoyed staying at Thomas’s condo! I loved how central the location was and the parking spot was so nice to have. Will definitely book again when I come back to visit friends!
Great spot to stay in Chicago! Just a short walk away from boystown and plenty of restaurants. Nearby a bus station as well which was nice to travel longer distances and get to/from the airport.

My grown son and I spent christmas week at this lovely home...It was very close to everything one might need for a week. Grocery store (with my trusty wagon) was a breeze.  Because it was warmer than usual, the outside area was so appreciated.  The street was all decked out in it's Christmas finest...which was an added bonus. Lara and her husband were so great to work with, I would highly recommend this home to anyone!
It was a great stay gives you the peace and quiet time building pretty chill after you’ve explored the city you get private and quiet would be booking again great hosts!
Clean, comfortable and helpful host.
Milan was very responsive to our questions and needs. The space was very clean and easy to use. We enjoyed our stay.
Will stay again! Cute, clean and cozy.
Nice place
Nice clean place! I will be booking again next time I visit.

We came for Christmas to visit family who live locally. It was super close to them and to the local park. There were a lot of people out with children and walking their dogs. Very safe neighborhood. The parking spot was convenient. The house was very nice and well equipped.
Good stay and good host. Great location.
enjoyed pete’s place to the fullest. will most definitely be back if the occasion occurs!

Wonderful walkable location, with permit parking passes included, plus easy access to the CTA. Literally 2 blocks from Wrigley. The unit itself was quiet and spacious, exactly what we needed as a group of 8. Would definitely love to stay here again!

Great stay!! The place was very clean, very well stocked especially in the kitchen and bathrooms, and felt very accurate to the listing. The location is great, just down the street from West Loop shopping and restaurants. We walked to dinner from here and to Fulton Market during the day. Checking in was very easy because of the 24 hour front desk, which was great. You can definitely hear the train but the host provided ear plugs and as Chicago natives it wasn’t a surprise. The registration process the host requires was a bit more admin than typical. Once that was completed it was smooth and the host was always responsive. They also helped coordinate an early check-in. Quality support throughout and would definitely stay at any of their properties again!
Great location
Excellent home with an excellent host! I wild recommended this property 10/10 times to anyone who is looking to visit Chicago! Loved it and will be booking again!
Very helpful in accommodating me.  Very good in getting back with me.  The price is very good.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The host was very welcoming and responsive, making check-in smooth and easy and also let me check in early which was really helpful. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. It was located in a great neighborhood with easy access to downtown, local attractions and amenities. I felt right at home and would definitely recommend this spot to anyone looking for a relaxing and hassle-free stay. Thank you for a great experience!

Tameka was very responsive and friendly! There was a great amount of space to stretch out and plenty of beds. There was ample parking on the side of the house. The home definitely needs some updates, but they weren't deal breakers. Some functionality touches are missing: i.e. towel bars/hooks in the bathrooms, missing slats in blinds, laundry detergent, towels vs sponges for washing dishes, mop and broom accessible to guests. I was able to puck up those things from local family or dollar tree. I would stay again for the holidays.

This place was perfect for my family and relatives which was a group of 10. We had to gather for an unfortunate circumstance, and are so glad we were able to stay at Garret’s place. The place had everything we needed—basic kitchen supplies like salt, pepper, olive oil, toiletries, and plenty of towels—and there was a grocery store  (Tony’s) about an 8 min walk away. There was also garage parking, but we chose to Uber/Lyft. Garret was super responsive with all my questions. The location was great, and I would’ve liked the opportunity to explore more for a future visit. The home was pristine and had the right touch of feeling homey but also not feeling like you are staying in someone else’s home. Would recommend this place!

The location is incredible with access to shopping, dining and transit steps away. The building itself has lot of great amenities and both the host and building staff were very helpful, communicative and a pleasure to deal with. I would definitely stay here again the next time I'm in Chicago.
Highly recommended!

Basement ,garden dwelling . Very comfortable .  Not for those that mind someone living above. We were very comfortable w/ the well appointed spaces and furniture . So appreciated the parking tags to allow neighborhood parking .
This place is conveniently located, making it easy to get around, and the host responds quickly.
This is a nice, simple studio for a quick stay in the city. Close to public transit.

The location is great! The pics aren’t accurate. There’s multiple units and showing pics of more than one. It’s freezing in unit. I literally bought a space heater and returned it to sleep comfortably as the bed is against a floor to ceiling window. There’s air coming in through all the doors and windows. Needs maintenance throughout the place. Just unnecessary things need to be fixed or painted everywhere. You hear everything from the upstairs unit and water leaks into the floor when you shower. It wasn’t a bad experience I was just disappointed with what I paid vs. what I got. I’ve stayed in airbnbs all over and never really left a review like this. Property managers should consider the aesthetics and what people are paying for.
This was our second time staying at this airbnb and was perfect for our holiday stay.  Dustin was very quick in all communications which was very helpful.  Will for sure stay again.

I loved this home. It was perfect. There was so much consideration put into decor/setup, the amenities, and instructions. It felt like a home away from home. It was affordable and 15 minutes away from my family. Cordaro was also accommodating and it was deeply appreciated. This opportunity took the guess work out of traveling for the holidays. As a final note, we arrived pretty late on the holiday and the clear directions and self-check in made the experience all the better.

We had a great stay! Host was responsive and always responded very quickly. The home was great and met our needs. It’s very spacious and slept 10 easily. Had many toiletries for use in the bathrooms. Also many good amenities including Keurig, Nespresso, fans/space heaters in the rooms, and a computer. Home was clean and as described. Back yard balcony and yard were also very nice. One thing to note is, only one bedroom has a TV, the others did not. This was not an issue for us. Very cozy home with great layout and everything we needed for our stay. 10/10 would recommend.
Always a pleasure to stay at Cindy and Mike’s place.
Satisfecha con su alojamiento, todo estaba como lo mostró. El lugar es accesible al bus y tren , supermercado y restaurantes
We had a great stay at Christmas. Will hope to rent your place again!

I love staying at Fabiana's Airbnb.  The temperature is individually controllable and convenient.  There's a hairdryer,  basic toiletries if needed, and some light snacks included. The location is quiet and easily walkable to Lincoln Square. Check-in and check-out are very easy.  It's a cozy and affordable place to stay.

Great stay for my husband, my two teen sons and myself. I am from the neighborhood and so felt comfortable. The place was quiet and you can't hear the sirens and nearby expressways.  Its location is perfect. You can get on 55 or 90/94 easily.  We walked to Chinatown for dinner and were easily able to get to family for Christmas day.  The only negative was that the wi-fi code had not been updated, but it was a holiday and we didn't need to be on the wi-fi.
Good place. Neighbors were quiet. House was clean. got 4/5 stars because the mattresses for the 2 larger beds were not very comfy. Otherwise, great stay!
My family enjoyed their annual trip to Gary's to visit me for Christmas! It's like a home away from home. Thanks so much!!

This location is in the ideal spot  for all the downtown activities. We were less than 10 mins away from the United Center and no more than 30 mins from every other location we wanted to visit. We thought parking was going to be a challenge but Jason provided a full sheet of parking options. Just a heads up that if you have a lot of luggage there are 2 sets of stairways and I do wish the bedroom had some blackout curtains. But other than that the space was perfect and we’d definitely book again.

The owners of this Airbnb couldn't have been nicer to deal with. The apartment was well appointed without clutter. It was very clean and smell free. Our bedroom was along the street side of the building and we had very little noise.
The only critique would be a few more cookware options would have been nice.
Id stay there again for sure.

The home was beautiful! The home was spotless and so inviting. Everything was as described and the location made everything easy to get to. Harold’s chicken?? 5 minutes. Downtown is about 20 and so is Chinatown. Melvin was such a great host! 10 out of 10, I 100% recommend!

It was a wonderful stay , clean and peaceful. A very safe and good neighbourhood. Everything was exactly as the picture describes , we went in during a chilly chicago weather and the room was cozy enough after a good trip outside. Kitchen and bathroom were clean and spotless. Basic appliances and amenities were provided which made stay easy and comfortable. A must book stay if you are planning a trip to Chicago - easily accessible to downtown Chicago (barely 10 mins drive to navy pier and others) , even close to major city attractions. (Bonus : door-dash delivers almost anything under 30 mins)

La estancia fue muy agradable, la zona está muy tranquila y quedan cerca zonas para comer, está céntrico y sin problemas de estacionamiento. Muy tranquilo el edificio.
Estaba limpio y tenía todo lo necesario para habitarlo.

This was our second stay at Samantha’s place. It is large enough for family time and private space. The beds are comfortable. Thank you Samantha for the Christmas tree and decorations. It really added to our stay and helped Santa find the little ones!
I would definitely recommend this property.
Shirley K

Me and my family had the best time at ever @Anthony apartment, we stayed for 10 days over the Christmas holidays, the space was great, I’m the most fussy person when it comes to beds and sleeping and the beds were by far the most comfortably to date, deep sleep every night, blackouts blinds perfect as I like total darkness, nice big shower, kitchen had everything you needed, all beds are a great size, this is a top floor apartment so you do get some lovely views of an evening, also has a spacious lift almost straight to your front door, so ideal if you have lots of luggage as we did, very quiet area and building no noise at all for us, there is a gym which is on the same floor, we used this every day, which was great, the location was ideal for us, there’s a cafe less than 2mins away which did a nice breakfast and fantastic little Japanese across the street, the main restaurant and shopping is all within 15-20mins walk, the host was very accommodating and efficient, we would stay again
Matched the photos

Comfy and functional one bedroom. Works well for the price point.
Due to heavy rains and then freezing temperatures the keys were frozen in a block of ice in the lockbox when I arrived but I carved them out and getting inside was easy after that.
So hopefully they get a new water tight lockbox soon but other than that the stay was pleasant.
Over night Street parking can be a bit tricky but it’s manageable.

Rob's space was an excellent retreat for my family. We needed a change of scenery for Christmas at the last minute, and we could not have found a place more suited to our needs! The space is in a gated community with one indoor parking space on a quiet street that feels very private and safe.
It is a townhome that consists of four very nicely decorated floors, including two bedrooms with full bathrooms (one with a jacuzzi) that can serve as private spaces for couples or for older parents. There is a "family room" on the fourth floor where you can watch movies or play games, and is generally a wonderful gathering spot. For my kids, however, the piano was the highlight of the stay, and they really enjoyed playing everyday. (There is a refundable fee to use the piano, but it is worth it!) Overall, a warm and cozy space with an attentive host - we will definitely stay here again if the space is available.

We were really excited about this stay but cancelled it upon finding a number of windows that wouldn’t lock. I was a little uneasy about the seemingly universal entry code but that is an easy fix. It will be a great spot with a few repairs.

When i say pictures did no justice, the air bnb look so much nicer in person and the host was so kind and nice and communicated fast, the only thing was the bathroom was not so clean but not overly to bad other then that air bnb was beautiful and location was perfect
A nice stay, was close to where we needed to be.

My week at this place was amazing. I got a much needed break and the space made that extremely easy. Diane was amazing at communicating with me, this was my first Airbnb so I was nervous but that communication made a world of difference. I'm very grateful I got to stay here.
Great location and friendly staff. Will stay at this apartment again.
John was very helpful ensuring we checked in successfully, understood how appliances/TV operated and provided local restaurant recommendations. Kitchen had ample amenities. Great host!

There was no WiFi at the place and the place is extremely small compared to the photos. The place had a laundry room that seems to have mold? It’s very unclean in there and smells a bit. There was no way to adjust the heat either. It took about three days for the space to get warm. It was very cold and very small. Definitely need more towels and amenities.

We really enjoyed our stay! Your spacious four-bedroom, three-bath place in Old Town was perfect, with a walkable location to everything. Spacious, clean, and cozy. It was perfect for hosting our families over Christmas!

Overall we had a great stay during our week at this property. The apartment was very clean, well-equipped, and largely as described. The building staff were all super friendly, and we loved the location. Easy to get around and close to any necessities you may need. The stay was generally a good value except for the exorbitant pet fee, which added close to $400 to the cost of the week's stay.
Oscar’s place was amazing. Very clean, smelt great and very spacious. Very comfy bed. I would recommend!

While the place was immaculate and nicely decorated, I feel it's a stretch to say this place is an "oak park gem." You have to walk through rough neighborhoods to either the Austin or Central green line train to head towards downtown Oak Park, which is where most folks wanting to stay in Oak Park are looking to be. One night we had trouble ordering through UberEats because the drivers did not want to come to the neighborhood. We also had Uber drivers point out that the neighborhood was questionable, which is was disconcerting. Nothing happened and we felt safe indoors but it's not a neighborhood you want to explore on foot. I also agree with one review that the bedrooms need blackout curtains. The sideway light is very bright. The neighborhood concerns aside, it really is a very nice condo and Roxy was responsive.

地點非常方便，到千禧公園只需5分鐘。
因為在軌道旁邊，列車經過時的聲音非常明顯，對聲音敏感的人最好準備耳塞
總體來說還是很不錯的，廁所及廚房都很乾淨，床也很舒適。
Great location
This place is definitely a great bang for your buck and drivable distance to the city! Be prepared to share the space!
Really nice clean place, extended my stay, great location. Only thing is that it was slightly pricey but overall pretty amazing

House is big and spacious. I have spent there few days with my family. The place is clean and host is very attentive and helpful. Apart from the sounds in the house from the wooden floor and thin walls there is nothing to complain about.
Vicky’s place was exactly as described. Clean, beautifully decorated for the holidays, everything you need! Would definitely stay there again!! Oh, also, comfortable beds!!

We spent a wonderful Christmas week in Chicago. Angela’s place was a perfect meet-up for our family coming in from various places. We felt at home right away. We had plenty of room to host 14 of us for Christmas Eve brunch. The location was perfect for us! The 7 of us staying there had plenty of space to relax and our granddaughters loved having their own space upstairs. Thank you Angela!
Loved the spot - great for a large group of people
We would for sure stay here again! So close to the park and very comfy couch and cozy beds!
Our favorite place to stay in Chicago!  Beautiful and peaceful.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in West Loop. Walking distance to United Center for Bulls, Blackhawks, and concerts. Surprisingly quiet neighborhood. Will definitely rebook.

Great location for exploring Chicago, everything you need for the stay is within a block or 2. The apartment was super clean. We experienced a water and rattling noise from the HVAC in bedroom and TV area basically the entire stay that kept us awake through the night. We were advised it was fixed but it continued for the rest of the  stay. To be fair we were offered cancel the stay and refund for the last of 3 nights but it was inconvenient for us with other plans during the day.
Great place for an extended family gathering.  Will has a great place and is a great host.

Great place in old town, you could easily walk to restaurants and the brown line for the el was about a block away.
We went to a Blackhawks game and the bus we needed to take had a stop right in front of the house (note it only runs on weekdays).
Very comfortable and Elizabeth was always responsive when questions were asked.

We stayed for four days over Christmas.  We enjoyed Chicago, the theater and dining.   I do wish we had taken some time to enjoy the local neighborhood.  There were cute shops, antiques and small restaurants.  The steps were a bit of a challenge for us but only because we were tired and brought too much luggage.  We would love to rebook, perhaps in the summer or fall.

We were lucky to find such a well priced and convenient location to stay at for a few nights. The train station next door did not bother us..  We walked to the Shedd Aquarium, which was the main reason for our trip. Ashley was a super responsive host! (:

Lovely multi-floor place in the heart of Chicago. Brad’s place had plenty of room for our group and we all felt very comfortable. Brad was very responsive when we reached out over our stay. The cleaning man (Esteban) came over on Christmas Day just to drop off more garbage bags for us! He was incredibly friendly and helpful when we met. Above and beyond service!
This place is in a great neighborhood with Old Town and River North amenities all within walking distance. The kitchen was a joy to cook in with a professional stove/range set up, too! We would definitely stay here again. Thank you Brad for hosting our family for Christmas and ensuring we had a lovely time!

We had a wonderful stay and even picked up some great home décor inspiration along the way. The home was beautiful and looked exactly like the pictures. It was very well equipped, with smart TVs in all the bedrooms and the living room, making it easy to use our own streaming app logins. The appliances were in great condition and worked perfectly. The location was excellent, with convenient parking and easy access to grocery stores, shops, restaurants, and pharmacies nearby. Being close to downtown Chicago and the airports made getting around very easy. The host was responsive and helpful throughout our stay, which made everything seamless. We truly enjoyed our time here and would absolutely stay again.

Shawn’s place was the perfect fit for my family to celebrate Christmas in Chicago! It had a warm, at-home feel with plenty of space for everyone to spread out and enjoy time together. The basement was great for watching football and playing group games, and we loved having the fire pit out back for making s’mores.
Parking was easy, the neighborhood was quiet, and the location was convenient—close to museums and other local attractions. We had a wonderful stay and would absolutely love to book this home again in the future.

Stayed here for 8 days. Easy access and entry. Clear instructions. Really appreciate Milan’s prompt and friendly responses. A few things that I did not care about was as follow: walking into the building the lobby was not the neatest, front desk security was a plus to see although they were not always there, hallways upon entrance at first appearance was neat and nice however there was this puddle of water outside our door the enter time, walking into the room there was a very strong smoke smell, it lingered a while.
I did express this to Milan he was quick and responsive and helpful, the place was a little smaller than I thought but was clean and appropriate for my family, there was a loud siren or alarm that persisted every night (outside on a nearby block) and it was very annoying - it rang for so long that I stopped hearing it. One another note, Indoor parking was a plus, close to a lot of stores and restaurants.

first of all, Bertrell was a wonderful host, after a long day and flight, he responded to me to ease my check in process.  made sure I got straight with anything I couldn't find " yes, I was lazy because I was on vacation ". and made my checkout even more easier than the check in. " Super host" I say.

We had a perfect time in the apartment.
Great location, everything was super clean and organized.
We will definitely come back when we have the opportunity

We booked this space for Xmas so more family could fit comfortably, & overall it worked. The split upper & lower levels together provided enough space.
Unfortunately, we had a rough start with host Robert. We missed the ask to disclose being local residents before booking. Once he realized we’re Chicago locals, his tone became rude & threatening—warning us about extra visitors, sending screenshots referencing surveillance, & saying it would be a shame to get evicted on Xmas. I said, “Cool. Understood,” & he replied, “It needs to be better than cool.” I’ve never been spoken to by a host this way & couldn't help but feel targeted, despite my strong Airbnb rating.
We attempted to cancel but would’ve only received a 25% refund. We requested the max guest count; he declined. After contacting Airbnb, he accepted it & the stay was fine—we followed all rules & he thanked us for leaving it tidy.
The stressful & unprofessional start made this a poor experience. I wouldn’t stay again.

Hermosa casa para una familia grande, con varios cuartos independientes lo que permitía tener privacidad.
Casa en excelentes condiciones tal y como se ve en las fotos.
Se encuentra ubicado cerca de varias paradas de buses y de una estación de tren que pasa la línea que va desde y hacia el aeropuerto.
En resumen, es una excelente opción para alojarse en Chicago a un buen precio.
Loved the location, so many shops and restaurants to chose from. The hots are very responsive and made my stay easy and comfortable. Thanks!
Great stay and friendly host
Overall, it was a good experience. The location is not the nicest part of town, but the price was reasonable for Chicago. Some of the furniture is a bit old.
Fantastic place!  Really nice kitchen and dining room. Great location.

Great location right in the middle of Andersonville!  The apartment was vibrant and clean with everything we needed for our stay.  Jacki was a wonderful host and very responsive with our inquiries.  We will stay here again if we are ever back in the area.

The bnb was clean and almost just like the pictures! It was a little smaller than what I expected but still really nice, I thought there was a living room area since one was shown on the pictures but it’s really just the front lobby area. Also parking is limited so I would suggest getting back to the bnb early and not too late or you will have to walk. Other than those minor things me and my significant other enjoyed our stay and the host was very nice and responsive and if you have any problems they definitely will help you.
Neighborhood is fine, great communication and very easy to get in. Will definitely be staying again when I come work in chicago
Nice convenient spot in a safe neighborhood with friendly neighbors and good parking. Affordable and very clean as well.

Comfortable and convenient! Access to the gym and semi-private deck were a great added bonus. Personal quirk - REALLY appreciated the multiple options for lighting. Not something that is often considered, but makes a difference when done.
Location is perfect! Absolutely walkable. Quiet street but "around the corner" from most everything you need or want. Consider parking logistics if traveling with a vehicle. There are multiple paid parking options right outside the building, including on-street (4.75/hr). We visited during the Christmas holiday. Street parking was always available, fee hours were adjusted because of the holiday. We only had to pay for 1 hour of parking during our 3-day stay. Parking would not deter from future reservations, but would definitely plan for it.
Hosts were communicative prior to check-in and during our stay. No issues arose that required assistance, but we felt comfortable reaching out if needed.
Will consider for future stays!
Everything was as described, met my needs for a quick trip to see my daughter.
Our stay during Christmas was absolutely wonderful! Such a cozy beautiful home! Thank you Brandon and team for opening the place to us, we’ve got memories there to last a lifetime!

This house was perfect for our family with small kids over Christmas. It’s very spacious, updated, clean and kid friendly with toys in the basement. It is located on a busy road, making it not very walkable but it’s a short uber ride to Wrigley, Lakeview, Lincoln Park. It’s a convenient place to stay with a large group if you are visiting Chicago!
Yadi’s place was clean, nicely decorated, and Yadi was polite and responsive!

One of the best Airbnbs I've stayed at. Divya's place is beautifully decorated and offers all the amenities you would need. The location is also unbeatable and only a few minutes walk away from the metro which takes you anywhere in the city. I highly recommend!

Everything was wonderful at Allan’s place- such a fun neighborhood, and the home is beautifully furnished with lots of windows and outdoor space. Extremely clean. Great hosts! We had a wonderful time with family over Christmas here- Christmas tree by the fireplace felt warm and inviting. Also a very dog-friendly area. We will be back.

I would say that this house is a great stay overall, the house was in fact very big and spacious. Rooms are moderately big and warm during winter. Bathrooms have considerate amenities and is very clean. The house lightings and some locks were on renovation when we arrived but the host already told us on advanced. However the luggages are quite hard to move through 3 doors so I recommend not much luggage would be ideal. Living room is spacious and the house located in a very quiet area. Beds are the most comfortable bed i have laid on in my cross country trip. The host also helped me a lot with the washing machine at the basement too. House was build in the 1900s but renovated to look like new, the water source for shower and everything else is good. I recommend this place for family or group who not party.
This was a great place to stay,lot of views around and good location

Jennifer's place is super cute! They had tons of fun things for my kids to play with and look at plus being across from koz park is wonderful! it's a garden unit so the ceilings are low which may be an issue for taller people, but otherwise an awesome spot!

This was our first time booking an Airbnb and it couldn’t have gone any better! We had a wonderful time at Emily’s townhome. The booking went smoothly, the home was really clean, all the amenities we needed were included, and it was in a great location. Emily communicated extremely clearly from the start and was very responsive any time I had a question before or during the stay.

This apartment is very large for Chicago standards and in an area of town that we like to stay in as it's convenient to visiting family, Andersonville, and close to museums and such if we decide to go that way.
It has access to a garage, which is also very convenient.
Unfortunately, the apartment is not very well soundproofed, and the neighbors upstairs played TV or loud music most of the day and pretty late at night. This is not the fault of the host, but it was bothersome enough that we couldn't use one of the bedrooms where the noise was loudest, and ended up using the living room as a third bedroom.
Wonderful place across from Wrigley Field!

Brad’s place was a cozy home away from home in the city! The bed is very comfortable and provided restful sleep. The space was even more spacious than the photos made it look! We also loved that it was pet friendly, so we could bring our dog with us! Perfect spot to crash while visiting family nearby for the holidays. Thank you so much for having us!
super nice and convenient - great host & very responsive. Can kind of hear neighbors through the walls, but not a big deal! good stay :)

The house was amazing and everything looked new, but when we arrived it was very dirty. I had to clean the freezer, the bathroom was extremely dirty, and the floors as well.
About two hours before checkout, the owner stopped in front of the house and also on the side of the house. There were two different people in two different cars. This was very inconvenient for us, and we felt uncomfortable and unsafe, especially because one woman was the last person to leave.
The place easy to find and great location. Cate also is very responsive. We had a pleasant stay.

Fantastic location. Clean. Spacious. Well stocked. Our family was very satisfied with our short stay.
The stay was calm and peaceful, both Elizabeth and little Theo were welcoming and kind. Great neighbor, very walkable, safe and full of charm!
The place was impeccably, clean and very spacious for our family. A great place to spend a week in Chicago!

all and all this is a nice space and the host was great and accommodating

Beautiful place to stay for my first time in Chicago. The host was amazing and very responsive! Location was great! I would definitely book again; especially room T1! Only suggestion would be to add a television with streaming options. And this would be the perfect Airbnb.
Amazing accommodation in a great location! Close to many great restaurants and bars, Michican Ave and Navy Pier!

Jennifer è fantastica, disponibile, amichevole e molto educata. La stanza e la casa corrispondono perfettamente alle foto, sono ambienti confortevoli puliti e dotati di tutto ciò che è necessario. Additionally, the host was very communicative and offered reasonable options for early and late checkouts, as well as trip extensions. Then we were told we had to pay another $1400 with ~$1k of it being management fees. The communication with both Airbnb and the Host was quite concerning. Neither could clarify what to expect to pay upon arrival. In the end, we paid $200 per room for security deposits and $26/day per room in hotel fees.

The unit itself is as advertised—spacious, modern, and nicely furnished. The managers at The Lux were very helpful with any issues Landing couldn't resolve. However, we'd rate Landing's communication, responsiveness, and check-in process 1-star. During check-in, we weren't properly registered in their app, so we couldn't access the building, gym, stairwell, or anywhere requiring a digital code. Fortunately, The Lux staff fixed the issue while Landing offered little help.
They also have a strange process for accessing the mail room to receive packages. We were supposed to wait for Landing to send us an access code for each time we get a package, but we only received an automated AI message. We didn't get access until we followed up days later. Once again, the Lux staff helped us by setting up manual code entry to the mail room.

Really enjoyed our stay. Great location , lovely appt. Even had a guest bedroom when a friend came to stay. Very responsive host. Would not hesitate to return.

A casa do Vince é excelente, muito melhor do que as fotos, é uma casa com muita super prática, até o vaso sanitário é cheio de tecnologia☺️

We can't say enough. We loved this place. Great location, roomy apartment, clean, well equipped. Olesya was a wonderful host. Highly recommend!

Great location and plenty of room for family and friends! One bathroom was tough at times but it didn’t dampen our trip at all. Very close to all the action and had everything we needed for a long wkend in Chicago! We would stay there again for sure :)

Dawn's place was everything we were looking for to travel with our toddler and grandma. It's a cozy, clean and thoughtful space that is well described in her descriptions. The host was easy to communicate with and thoughtful about our needs traveling with children. Highly recommend!

The host is extremely responsive and gracious. We loved our stay!
Great place, very spacious and fancy, with a fully stocked kitchen.  Kimberly was very responsive

Alexis was extremely respectful and hospitable. Very responsible to any questions we had. The place was pristine. If I’m in Chicago again with my family, I’d happily reserve again.
Andre has been a fantastic host — always accommodating and quick to respond. The space is quiet and comfortable with a beautiful view.
Great place to stay, close to where I needed and very clean.

Otto’s home was beautiful and had everything I needed to host a Thanksgiving for me and my daughter. The house had so much space — it truly felt like a home away from home. I loved the beautiful plants throughout the home, and the meditation and travel books on the bookcase were an awesome touch.

Otto was extremely responsive, polite, and friendly from start to finish. The neighborhood felt very safe, and the sweet, welcoming neighbor even suggested things to do in the area, which was greatly appreciated.
The location was convenient with plenty of parking. We didn’t use the train, but the station is only about 5 minutes away for anyone who prefers public transit.
I would absolutely recommend Otto’s home!!
This accommodations were very nice.  Exactly what was described.  Very clean and comfortable.

Fantastic accommodations for our family holiday in Chicago! Matt and Doug’s space has everything you need! Great stay! Able to have a fabulous Thanksgiving in a lovely home  and be near many great spots for eating, shopping and walking!

We booked this apartment for three nights and, on arrival, found it was 59–60°F inside in late November. The thermostat was locked in “cool-only” mode, so there was no way to turn on the heat. The host told us maintenance would come twice, but no one ever showed, and the heat wasn’t restored until the third and final night via a remote reset that could have been done on Night 1. Spent two nights wearing coats, wrapping in blankets, and trying to sleep in an unheated unit. A single space heater was left in the closet — which makes me wonder how often this happens. When we sought resolution, the host also did not respond to Airbnb Support’s attempts to resolve the issue. The location is good, but guests deserve a warm, habitable space and timely support when essential systems fail. As someone who also owns vacation rentals & is an Airbnb Superhost, this was deeply disappointing: failure to meet basic standards of habitability is unacceptable & I cannot recommend this place for a stay.

We had a great stay at Nat's place it was exactly as described very safe, quiet and had lots of parking space. We also had everything we needed and Nat was great at responding every question I had.

Beautiful spot in a great bustling neighborhood. The views of downtown are stunning! The space is luxurious but cozy. Great spot!

Conveniently located near the United Center and a short drive downtown. The apartment was comfortable and parking was easy.

Used this rental last minute because oven went out and needed place to cook Thanksgiving meal. Grateful to have a wonderful kitchen to cook in and dinner area to eat in. Patio also looked like it would have been fun if weather was nice.

There's only one small bathroom that's shared between all of the guests(maximum 5-6people).
Overall, a great place to live with short travel days.

We had a wonderful Thanksgiving week staying in Lincoln Park. This is ideally located, quiet, and convenient base. This is a charming, well-lit garden apartment, which we actually loved. It reminded me of a flat I used to own in San Francisco, and in the late fall/early winter, it was wonderfully cozy and heated up incredibly fast! Despite being in such a fun, busy neighborhood with so much going on, the unit itself was incredibly quiet, providing a perfect retreat after a long day of exploring. The location is unbeatable. We walked everywhere, including trips to Lincoln Park Zoo (during the day & Zoo Lights in evening!). We spent time playing in Oz Park & enjoyed a fantastic dinner at the legendary neighborhood spot, RJ Grunt's. We had a lovely walkable lunch at Blue Door. Public transportation was a breeze, and we easily took buses to other areas of the city.  The garage parking was an absolute game-changer. We arrived, parked the car, and didn't have to drive again! Stress free.

We've stayed at quite a few AirBnBs in this area, and this is definitely one of the better homes.  Parking is relatively easy, ORD is close, and there's a great park along the river within easy walking distance.

Nice place! My family had a great stay here over Thanksgiving. It was easy to get around on foot or CTA. The apartment is updated (nice kitchens and bathrooms). And the host is super responsive and friendly.
Nice stay in a very unique room.

Cheryl was incredible! She helped us right away with parking and gave great restaurant recommendations. And we got to meet sweet little Fiona! We will definitely book with her again!

Stayed at Erick’s place and it was good. The apartment is spacious and worked fine for two people, and the kitchen is nice for cooking. Great Place 10/10 recommend :)

We stayed here over Thanksgiving  to visit family in Chicago and made good use of the kitchen, cooking a full Thanksgiving meal for 6 people. Great appliances, all modern and clean, and the fridge has an ice maker and water dispenser. Kitchen had plenty of dishes, utensils, pots and pans.  Nice back porch off the kitchen, 3 good size bedrooms and large bathroom, full dining room table and large living room with comfortable furniture made it an enjoyable 3 day stay to just hang out with family, cook and eat! Each bedroom has a large TV. Host was very responsive - quickly answered when we had questions about the Wi-Fi and sent us several messages to check in. Plenty of street parking. Beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood. Super clean and well stocked with everything you need. Thank you!
We had a wonderful, very comfortable stay. Beautiful views, well-appointed space, fantastic location. Would absolutely stay here again!

We stayed at Dean’s place for four nights over the Thanksgiving holiday. The apartment was spacious and well decorated, but with a few caveats.
There are 2 restaurants downstairs that play loud music one until 10ish pm and the other until 2 am. We encountered this 3 of the 4 nights we stayed (Mon thru Wed), so I can only imagine what the weekends are like. Sleep was impossible for us.
The windows in the living area let cold air in continuously, making it hard to enjoy the space. The sectional has lived past its prime and is in need of replacement as well as the decorative pillows and throw blanket.
The water pressure in the shower is far from adequate, but there is a Dry Bar right across the street, so that was a bonus.
We wanted to love this place, but for the price we paid, we felt like it was overpriced. Dean was responsive any time we had a question and we appreciated that.
Also, this apt. is accessible via a VERY old, steep staircase that might be a problem for some.

Paul's place was clean, quiet, cozy, and very walkable to downtown! It was only a 3 minute walk to the train station and to the mall, there were lots of restaurants, shops, and parks nearby as well. Overall, I had an amazing stay, and would love to stay there again when I return to Chicago.

Overall, a lovely stay in a prime location with a beautiful unit. Highly recommend!

This was a great location and apartment! We came with 3 adult kids for Thanksgiving and had a wonderful visit. During our stay, we noticed a smoke detector beeping and the bedroom TV remote batteries were dead. We reached out to the host, and they responded immediately, bringing new batteries and addressing everything quickly. The home itself was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed.
We ended up leaving a day early due to the Chicago weather, and the host was kind enough to refund us for the unused night, which we really appreciated. The block was quiet, the neighbors were no issue at all, and we felt safe thanks to the secure entry code and alarm system.
Overall, we would definitely recommend this home to anyone looking for a comfortable and reliable stay.

I actually stayed here for one month, left for five days because someone else already had it booked, and when I got back the apartment smelled like the inside of a Lysol can. It was SO clean. I think my favorite part was the porch in the bad. I could sit there all day and watch the trains pass by. The only suggestion I have for the hosts is to change the code on the door locks in between guests for added safety. Overall, this was a marvelous stay and I will be back!

Brads place is a lovely spot close to many great shops and restaurants.

Condition of the apartment is not what we expected based on the listing and its advertised level of cleanliness and upkeep. We were really looking forward to staying here, especially given the cost and the strong reviews, so we want to give you transparent feedback right away.
Upon check in, we immediately noticed:
• Visible stains and marks on the walls
• Dirty/stained sheets, including the master bedroom set
• Semen Stains/marks on the couch and rugs
• Crumbs and residue on the white dining chairs
• A baking tray/pan that appeared to have been used recently and not cleaned
• A strong odor upon entry in both units - we’ve had to open windows to air it out and it still did not clear it up.
This doesn’t appear to reflect “very clean/newly renovated” .

My husband and I stayed in Jackie’s lovely apartment. The apartment offered everything you would need for a week’s stay! Very very nice! And oh so clean! Having been in the rental business ourselves, we were very impressed with Jackie’s place. We will highly recommend it to all our family and friends.
Ken and Robin Klatt

This is a renovated walk-up 2nd-story apartment. It has all the amenities, including a washer and dryer for long-term stays. The Wifi was great for working remotely, which I did during my stay. It was spotlessly cleaned and organized.
It's in the Pilsen/Near-West Side neighborhood, which for me, as a city-girl, felt walkable and safe.
It's close to larger grocery stores, and a short walk to the Pink Line CTA, great for moving around the city. It does offer a parking spot which I didn't need to use at the time.
Marc was extremely helpful in ordering necessary supplies, and making the stay more comfortable. He was very communicative, proactive, and prompt in addressing my inquiries. Suzy also assisted many times.
I found this a good landing place while in Chicago
Really nice and clean. nobody bothers you lol

I was staying at one of the places hosted by Sleepy Suites for my work purposes. The hosts gave clear check-in instructions and were very responsive in case of any issues. Only thing this place is missing a laundry for guests like me who want to stay for couple of weeks or a month. Other than that everything great, very peaceful neighborhood, I totally recommend this place if someone is visiting Chicago for a couple of days or looking for short term stays.
Great place to stay! Highly recommend!
Loved this airbnb! The host was extremely flexible and communicative when we had questions/needed help! Such a beautiful place and the location is extremely nice and a good middle point.

We had  a great stay and really enjoyed the space and location. The neighborhood is very peaceful, safe, and walkable. As a solo female digital nomad, Nofar’s Airbnb was the perfect place for my month-long stay in Chicago. I felt very safe staying there, as the unit is surrounded by a locked gate, you must know a code to get in, and there is an alarm system. The Airbnb is on a cul-de-sac, so it’s very quiet for a city. Close to lots of bus stops, the CTA, and a 10-minute drive to downtown since the unit is so close to Lake Shore Drive. I loved that it’s a 10-minute walk to Lake Michigan, so I often ran along the lake. Nofar was very hospitable, responsive, and gave me lots of recommendations. Would stay here again.

We had a great stay here. It was close to a few good places to get a coffee or some food, and a quick walk to the Blue Line which got us to/from the airport and downtown easily. The area was cute and quiet. The only negative that we noticed is that we didn’t see any carbon monoxide detectors in the apartment. We could see places in the ceiling where they would probably connect, but none were connected. Since the heat was on and it seemed to be a gas furnace, we went ahead and bought a small one from Home Depot just to be safe and did not have any problems. Overall we liked the apartment and would recommend it to someone looking for a conveniently located place to stay for their trip to Chicago!
Anya's listing was accurate and true to life. would recommend 👌🏻
Quiet and clean ,the space was perfect for my team and I traveling to Chicago for work.

Excellent experience all around. Look forward to staying there again!

Very nice place.  In a quiet neighborhood.  It is close to public transit for easy access.  It was easily walkable to the concert I went to at the United Center.    Zed communicated well with me.  This will be my go-to place to stay when attending any event at the United Center.

The photos of this stunning penthouse truly do not capture its full beauty. This property exceeded my expectations in every way. It was impeccably clean, modern, and elegantly designed. Very welcoming and good communication with the host; Always on time with the guests.
The staff was amazing. We didn’t need a lot but when we did they were all over it.

The place is very nice and spacious! Everything was so neat and clean too, would stay here again when coming back to Chicago!

Sara's place is wonderful, we completely enjoyed our time in her Wicker Park building! The townhouse was nice enough and the beds were comfortable enough for a 2 night stay. Overall it served its purpose and was an easy walk to many restaurants; just needs a little TLC.

This has been a blessing of an Air BnB! I have felt right at home since I moved to Chicago. Ms. Helen is responsive, makes great recommendations, and has even helped with my apartment search! The location is perfect for public transportation use and a quick ride the highway. I loved my stay!
Great area and the place is very nice.

Great place to stay in Chicago,  great views from rooftop deck!

On warmer days there’s a courtyard overlooking Lake Michigan that has tables and chairs to sit at while enjoying the evenings with a glass of wine. We definitely see ourselves coming back and staying in this beautiful home.

Adorable,  spacious house. there were 5 of us and we had plenty of room. Comfortable beds for sure! Large closets for luggage, and we were happy for the extra fan. Enjoyed our stay

Items were easy to find and instructions were great.  I would strongly recommend if you need room to spread out with a few people and want to be close to the University of Chicago.
Great location. Great apartment. Mattress wasn’t the best and only a queen. Building has nice amenities. It’s definitely worth it.
Great clean place in a nice neighborhood!

This is my second time staying with Dede.   Her space is wonderful!!!!  She is an excellent host!!!!  She has everything you need!!  The bed is so comfortable!!  I loved all the pillows and linens.  I was sad to leave.   I will definitely be back again!!!!

We were in town for a concert at The Salt Shed and the location of Nikkole’s place was perfect! With bus and train stops near-by we were only a short ride from anywhere we wanted to go. Beautiful place and wonderful stay! Everything was just perfect! Perfect walking distance to nearest train, lots of good little food/coffee/and stores nearby in walking distance! Place was spacious, clean, and perfect for me and my 2 friends! Definetly would stay again next time I come!
Sena was incredibly kind and easy to work with. Cannot recommend highly enough. The place was beautiful and the experience was seamless.
Just amazing 👏

Highly recommend if you’re going to shows at Thalia Hall or something else in the area. Walkable to great restaurants, art, etc. The place is really cool and very comfortable for our 3 night stay. Designated parking was especially appreciated. Host was friendly and flexible.

This place is not only lovely but has so much space. The family game room is a blast! My family had so much fun and really bonded over it. We were there for a short stay, we attended a family baby shower. But we would definitely stay again. Wish we could have stayed longer. Definitely recommend this home.

Awesome place to stay!

Rearrange the place and add a FULL size bed.

This place met our needs to be close to family in the area.

Perfect location, clean and very organised b&b.
