Shower leeks water all over the floor and no bath mat means you end up using the towels to keep from slipping. Kitchen was okay but another diy job poorly done. This place has huge potential but really needs some upkeep! If this were a hotel I would have checked out immediately!

I really enjoyed my weeklong. Stay with Roxane and Michael. It was a lovely welcoming experience. The bed was comfortable and the amenities and the bedroom were super useful for a longer stay. There are so many extra touches, including the opportunity to share a glass of wine with the hosts. That really made me feel welcome.
Also, the location is convenient for those who need to travel into the city or in my case up to Evanston. I took the CTA both the buses and the red line almost every day. I definitely hope to be able to return next summer when I’m visiting Chicago.

Good value, clear instructions - pretty much exactly as advertised. Clean, great bed/pillows. Coffee for the morning. Host company was very communicative an on top of things. I like the area (used to live nearby).
It was so spacious and comfortable

Clean place in a convenient location. Super close to 2 bus stops and 8 minute walk to the closest Orange line. Area seems a little desolate, but not unsafe. The apartment was equipped with plenty of kitchenware and the washer and dryer were super nice to have. Everything was clean and the fall decorations gave it a homey feel. Heard footsteps from the tenant above every once in a while, but not constant and not at unreasonable hours. Be aware that the heat source is a furnace in the living area, so bedrooms/bathroom are not directly heated. The heater would audibly kick on, but seemed to not actually be heating to the set temperature (78°F). I addressed this with the owner and it should be resolved soon.
everything was great, the service (wifi) was just a lil iffy

Pros , This Airbnb was exactly like the pictures, very clean we loved the beds very comfortable the house felt like home. We loved the area close by restaurants to eat walking distance along with convinevnt store close by was a plus. We did not need to rent a car we were so close to all the places we went too uber was what we used when needed. Security was friendly! We felt safe in this area.
Cons, The lobby area when walking in had a really really bad smell that was not pleasant that lasted our whole stay. The lighting in the bedroom by the front door could be better it was just too dark in there.
I’d definitely rent and stay here again in my future stays back to Chicago.

Private and quiet space with lots of room. Perfect for relaxing after a morning or evening spent in downtown Chicago. It would be frankly a sin if I didn't mention the incredible shower in this space. The bed can fit two of course but the shower can fit an Amish family. There is no stove or range in this space but there is a mini fridge and microwave. Besides, why would you want to cook when you could go out in the greatest foodie city in America?
Micha was very helpful and proactive to help us get into the Airbnb, and we loved staying in this neighborhood.

I needed only a small space for myself while in Chicago for the weekend.  I knew I would be out all day so I did not need a full apartment.  My room was clean, quiet and comfortable.  There are restaurants and groceries within walking distance.  I woke up early and took a 20 minute walk to see the lake.  The location of Charlie's place is very convenient.  I did not have a car so I did not need to park a car.
Excelente ubicación, departamento muy agradable y cómodo
Great spot

Loved the area first time in Chicago the area was really quite didn’t have to worry about my rental the neighbors was nice and welcoming I had a fun time in Chicago other then WiFi issues my stay was perfect

A couple of friendly suggestions: for a small investment there could be a nice set of tableware, a nice set of (stainless steel) pots and pans, basic kitchen storage containers, etc. The place is not conducive to cooking for oneself, resulting in a lot of delivery/take out/unsatisfying and expensive alternatives. Could be more homelike and cozy if the kitchen was conducive.
There was an issue with the smell of gas, from under the sink especially. When I insisted, the gas to that apartment was turned off.
Great place to stay

We had an amazing time staying here! It was so fun to wake up to the animals everyday while still having a city vibe! The place was cozy and welcoming and they were amazing hosts! We will definitely be coming back!

perfect for my needs. very clean comfortable with a good location.
Very good value compared to Chicago hotels. Will rebook next time I travel to Chicago

Incredible stay in a massive home. Everything was first class from the beautiful kitchen and living rooms to the great bedrooms and top bedding and mattresses. The master bedroom is massive with en suite luxury bath.
Walkable to grocery store and restaurants. And a quick uber ride downtown and to the airport.
Would definitely stay here again.
This was such a great place to stay! Easy to get in and out of. Grocery store next door for your needs.
We loved staying here for our first trip to Chicago! It was very spacious, clean, and felt very safe. The kitchen was wonderful and you NEED to check out Cermak Fresh Market down the street!

Thanks for having us. We had a great time and enjoyed our stay at your place and the city. I love the neighborhood, and all the neighbors and shop owners were super friendly. We got to appreciate the beautiful leaves changing colors in the front yard and your neighbors house was superbly decorated for the holidays! All the feels - thanks so much!
Lauren
The place was nice and clean, more than enough towels and they had everything you needed. I will definitely stay again! I love the projector downstairs and plenty of space all over the home.
Muy bonito y muy limpio todo, zona tranquila nada de ruido . El anfitrión siempre pendiente .

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Chicago. Das AirBnB hat eine perfekte Lage, sowohl zum Flughafen als auch nach Downtown und in die Innenstadt sind wir schnell und einfach mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gekommen. Auch im AirBnB haben wir uns wohl gefühlt. Das Zusammenleben mit den anderen Gästen hat gut funktioniert. Die einzigen Mängel, die wir hatten waren, dass man das Fenster nicht öffnen konnte, und die Klimaanlage dauerhaft lief, leider auch nachts, sonst waren wir sehr zufrieden, und würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

I am originally from Chicago  and when I come to visit family I usually stay at an Airbnb, but this was the best one I have stayed at so far. I was initially concerned about the area since I was staying by myself this time, but I felt very safe. The place looked exactly like the pictures and it was very clean. Also, I appreciated having a TV in the bedroom to watch. I was grateful for the water and snacks Michelle provided.  When I visit again either alone or with my husband and/or daughter, I will definitely check availability for this place first. Michelle is a great host.

Connor was a great host that withstood any question any question I had. He was very flexible for the requests we had as far as guests. Great property, with an even better host! Thank you for hosting us!
Amazing and very communicative, will be booking again!
Very clean and well appointed. Hosts were helpful and quick to respond to questions.

Extraordinary response speed and super helpful.  Absolutely no noise from adjacent units.  Is next to main street so do get street traffic.  It did not bother me.  Great heating kept the place warm.  Shower has very good flow and gets hot immediately.  Washer and dryer worked very well (remember to let washer sit about 5 minutes after spin stops to let the lid unlock).
Nice clean, new space.
Brad has great communication!
Everything was as described and perfect. Host was super responsive for all my questions. Very good place for families.
Clean and comfortable! Great location for my needs in Chicago. Would not hesitate to stay here again (and will probably do so). Thanks much! :)
I just didn't like the check in process it was a little shady but the place was really nice I'd definitely stay again
100% recommended
Lovely apartment

Great place to stay. There was a dog day care next door so there was some barking but nothing we couldn’t handle! Would stay again! I would say this place is perfect for two people. Any more it would get hectic.
Great stay.
such an amazing home and a great host. we are a family of five adults and we had such a great stay.  great location, super comfortable, every amenity and very responsive host
I am grateful for Ana’s place. I felt right at home.
David’s place is perfect get away , very clean and spacious looks better in person great host. 10/10 highly recommend

I loved this place. It was the kind of home that really made you want to live there. Just the right touch of everything you were looking for in a stay.  Ample space to spread out or come together as a family.  The cinema room in the basement ROCKED! I grew up in the area so to be back after all these years and see the area still well kept was wonderful to see. I was worried because it was a neighborhood home but you rarely even see anyone. The neighbors are quiet and to themselves and the ones we did see were friendly and welcoming.  This home is perfect.
Great location near Wrigley! Not the most modern or the cleanest spot but it’s a decent price for the location and it includes all the accommodations you would need for a game day weekend.
Cute, cozy, great location! We will be back!!!

The best thing about this rental was its close proximity to where our son and his wife live. Ukrainian Village is a safe, walkable location, with great restaurants. The rental was as described, and the host was very responsive. Check-in instructions were clear. The kitchen was well-appointed and clean. There were plenty of towels and linens. It is important that guests consider that the space is above a restaurant, and there is definitely related noise from below. It is also a rather busy street, so there is street noise as well. The blinds in the front bedroom were effective at blocking street light. I always travel with a sound machine, so this was effective for me to mask the other sounds and sleep just fine. The bed itself was comfortable. We only used the front bedroom, but I am guessing the second bed was similar. We will definitely return to this rental in future visits. Thank you!

Milan’s place was okay, but our experience overall was disappointing. Our flight landed around noon, and a few weeks before arrival I asked Milan if he could allow us to check in about two hours early at no extra cost. He told me to reach back out 24 hours before arrival, which I did. Instead of confirming, he sent a message promoting specials he was offering.
We arrived at the Airbnb around 3 p.m., and he still wouldn’t accommodate even a one-hour early check-in without charging a $30 fee. This felt very inconsiderate, especially since we were traveling from out of state.
Additionally, the building entrance was extremely outdated and had a terrible smell. Overall, this was the worst Airbnb experience I’ve had.
A great spot if you’re looking to bop around on the Northside. So many nice walkable options, including a grocery store.   The place was immaculate and cozy. We would have loved to stay longer!
Everything was great even the host. She went above & beyond to make me feel at home highly recommend

Hey, the place wasn’t bad at all. I wish I had a private bathroom. I practically got what I paid for but it wasn’t all bad. The only thing I was concerned about was the area. If you’re not familiar with urban areas then I would say book elsewhere. I grew up in these environments but I was a little uneasy about the safety of my truck. Luckily nothing happened! Overall it was nice stay!
Kevin’s place was spectacular. Looks exactly like the pictures but in person it’s way bigger. Home was clean & very comfortable. Recommend to All.
Great location and great place for a large group.
It’s a decent weekend spot wouldn’t consider multiple days, it is shared but accommodating.

I absolutely loved my stay at Aaron’s Airbnb! The space was beautiful, cozy, and instantly felt like home. One of my favorite parts was the projector, it made watching Netflix at night feel like a full movie-theater experience. The kitchen was great, and having a crock pot available was such an unexpected bonus for my meal prep. Aaron was a great host, and the space exceeded every expectation. I’d definitely stay here again!
Very nice clean place with all the amenities and comfortable beds!

I HIGHLY recommend this apartment for your future Chicago visit!  Location is incredible for Wrigley Field (less than a 1/2 mile walk) as well as many other attractions.  Having 2 parking spots is absolutely a luxury as well!  Brandon in particular was a wonderful host & was extremely gracious in allowing an early check in.  I look forward to staying here again in the future!!!
My husband and I enjoyed our stay at Bella’s studio apartment. It was cozy and inviting. There were a few areas of dust that could be cleaned up. Other than that we loved our stay!
Erica’s place was an awesome home away from home. The area around was nice, plus there were great options for food and activities. The stay looks exactly like the pictures. Erica was an awesome host!

Apartment was as described. Check in was accurate and front desk was very helpful. Rooms were clean and we had everything we needed to enjoy a stay. Was not far from anything we wanted to do and explore. Would make a return to this stay no problem.
Home just as described and location was perfect for everything we wanted to do
It was great! Just out of the way for what I wanted to do but I would book again in a heartbeat

The two beds in the bedrooms were very comfortable for a rental. The flip couch "futon" in the living room was NOT! We had 2 couples and my 16 year old daughter and that couch was not comfortable. Also, if you have a coffee maker, it would be nice to leave a couple filters. We own a coffee business and brought our own ground coffee but did not think to bring filters. It's something very small but appreciated.
Leaving a few more bathroom towels for 5 people would've been appreciated as well.
The house is the back carriage of another house. It is NOT well lit to be walking up 3 flights of stairs in the dark. However, the Lincoln park area is beautiful and very walkable. It was super convenient to walk places and close to our sons place.
Outstanding accommodations and location

This place was great! The neighborhood was nice and public transportation was easily accessible! We were able to find free street parking as well which was great. David was very helpful and responsive which made the stay very worry-free!
You can't beat this location.  It was cozy.
Great location
Amazing apartment!

This place is an absolute gem.  It costs a little more than other comparable rooms in the neighborhood but not unreasonably so and it is well worth it regardless, especially with the private bathroom and king size bed.  The house and room are tastefully appointed, and it was impeccably clean, in fact it was the cleanest Airbnb I've ever rented.  Rebecca is awesome -- she's very meticulous and real people.  I would rent this or any place from Rebecca for me or my whole family next time we're in Chicago any day.

It was a nice place. Very clean and easy to get into! There was sort of a strong smell on the bedding, not bad, just very intense. Also it was in a bit of a rougher area which I didn’t realize but it was fine.
Darren’s place was ideal for my trip to Chicago! Everything was as advertised, and the place is in a quiet and safe neighborhood. Host answered all questions in a timely manner. Would stay again!

Out of all of the times I’ve been to Chicago, this was by far my favorite place to stay! The penthouse was spacious and comfortably fit all 10 of us. The location was perfect. There were several things to keep us busy in the area. THE VIEWS WERE EVERYTHING!!! I couldn’t stay off of the patio. Shawn & Fraz were both awesome & quick to respond! Super cute & fun! Cant wait to stay here again! O

Matthew is a great host, very responsive and helpful with questions. The Airbnb itself definitely does not fit 6 adults comfortably with two queen beds and a twin bed, so one of the people in our group had to sleep on the couch. It did the job for the short stay we had in Chicago, but likely wouldn’t rebook with that size group.

The condo was clean, bright, and well located. Julie was incredibly accommodating and responsive. We stayed almost three months with our toddler which isn’t an easy feat, we were lucky to land here.
Parking was easy, the bakery downstairs was delicious, lots to walk to in Logan square.

Considering I am a very much a bottom line guy this was a great stay for my son and I. We were attending an event at Wrigley Field so Joseph’s place offered a great location at prices lower than local hotels. It easily had the amenities that a couple low maintenance guys would need (maybe a few extra mugs & drinking glasses?). It does have one bedroom so my son brought an air mattress but that worked out just fine. Had no problem finding parking on the street. Bottom line it’s not the Ritz but it is clean, comfortable and cost efficient.
Great location. Had one more bedroom than advertised. Has a light out at check-in and they came and fixed that within a few minutes.  Everything else was great
This was a  Nice house it was spacious and clean. I definitely enjoy the pac man game!
Wes was a great host, and the location was centrally located, making it easy to get downtown and to the surrounding city.
Lewis’s home was an incredible experience! Perfect location, walkable to many shops, restaurants and the train. It’s exactly as described and I couldn’t ask for a better time!
Comfortable spot close to the Orange Line, great for a longer term stay. Kurtis was a very responsive host. We would stay again!

Our stay here was wonderful. The space felt incredibly cozy, and the large windows let in just the right amount of natural light, making the whole place feel warm and inviting. The hosts were extremely responsive and genuinely friendly, which made everything even better. Staying here with my partner felt like being at home — comfortable, peaceful, and just what we needed. Highly recommend!

My stay at this Airbnb in Chicago was excellent. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. Check-in was simple, and the host communicated clearly, making everything smooth from start to finish. The location was a plus.
Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely book here again the next time I’m in Chicago. Highly recommend!
Highly recommended
Walters place was close to the red line which was great!
Great place!

We had a great stay in this apartment- it was very clean and spacious and the building had really nice amenities. The views are beautiful and the location was great. We would definitely stay again next time we are in Chicago with a group.
Otto was an awesome, respectful , and responsive host. He communicated clear and well. Spot was clean and full of amenities mentioned in the description. I recommend Otto spot! 1000/10
We had a great time. Thanks for hosting us!
Nice place, a bit roomier than other spots in the same area. Clean, accurate description.

L’arrête de bus qui mène au centre est à 4 minutes à pied, ce qui est pratique si on veux éviter la voiture. Cependant, il faut être conscient que ce n’est pas un quartier où on pourrait se sentir à l’aise.
L’emplacement est facile à trouver, la chambre correspondait aux images. Dommage qu’il n’y est pas plus de photos du logement en description.
this spot was perfect for our weekend, had all the things you might have forgotten or would need, very welcoming and convenient to transportation!
Good and as advertised
Great location in the West Loop. The common area on the 20th floor was a great bonus!

It's a very nice place to stay, only about a 7 minute walk to two different train stations and in walking distance of DePaul University as well as various coffee shops and other places to explore. It's quiet and safe and clean. When we come to Chicago we always stay here because it's three blocks from our daughter who is in school here. The kitchen has most (but not all) of anything you'd need to cook easily. What's missing are an adequate number of utensils as well as plates, bowls, etc...but it's manageable! Overall we're always very happy to stay here.

Had an excellent stay at The Drake! Darius had great communication and check-in was easy. The space is very roomy, especially nice was the ample seating spacious bathroom, and the kitchen is huge. Something unexpected, but a pleasant surprise, was how nice of a block it is on. Most homes have garages or off-street parking pads that are accessed via the back alley and only a few driveways on the street itself, so this really opens up ample street parking. We parked right out front. The two houses across the street are being restored and are absolutely beautiful, so don't rely on outdated Google maps for your street view. Beautiful and well cared for homes on the block. The back balcony was nice and private to sit out on for us night owls. During the day we could see them working on a building across the back alley. I'm a big fan of Chicago homes & architecture in general. Can't wait to go back and see what they do. Thanks for the stay and the snacks!
Great appt. Very convenient and safe.
We loved the location and ability to walk to great restaurants and bars. The building is beautiful, the gym was nicely sized and equipped, and the rooms were clean and spacious. We had a great stay!
Cozy place and clean!
I enjoyed my stay at this Airbnb And the host is so very nice,everything was tidy and clean Host response time was very good overall 10/10.and I love that it’s 420 !
We had a good stay
Great spot amazing communication would definitely will book again
Thank you Jessica for accommodating us at your wonderful loft! Our first time in Chicago was great. Jessica was very responsive and helpful!

We had a great stay at Joseph's rental! For the price, it's an amazing deal. It's located fairly close to everywhere we wanted to visit, and there is a really good cafe attached to the apartment building that offered delicious breakfast and coffee.
Host was communicative, and responded quickly to all inquiries. Check in/out was easy, and we were allowed to do a late check out with a small fee.
My only downside was that the radiators were very loud and noisy - but honestly after the first night, you get used to it somewhat.
TLDR; Great place to stay, if you're not a picky person and don't need your rental to feel like a hotel room, stay here and you won't regret it. Especially for the price and location.

Muy buen lugar para hospedarse y recorrer la ciudad. Buena ubicación sobre avenida donde pasa el transporte. Tienda básica al frente.
Es una casa algo vieja pero cumple con las necesidades.

Laura’s place was the perfect place for the event we attended at wrigley field. The location is walkable to so many bars and restaurants. The description of the apartment was very accurate. Laura was proactive with information prior to check in and helpful with recommendations. We would highly recommend.

Here’s a polished Airbnb review based on everything you shared:
We had an amazing stay! Our group of seven fit comfortably in the apartment with plenty of space for everyone. The hosts were incredibly accommodating and communicated quickly and clearly throughout our stay.
What really set this place apart were the amenities—it felt like a cozy Airbnb with the perks of a hotel. We were pleasantly surprised to find vanity kits, shampoo/conditioner/body wash, kitchen cleaning supplies, plenty of towels, extra trash bags, large closeted with amble hanging space. These thoughtful touches made the stay convenient and comfortable.
The location was also unbeatable. Everything in the West Loop—bars, restaurants, and shopping—was just a short walk away. We never needed to call a ride share.
We were very comfortable, well taken care of, and thoroughly enjoyed our time here. Highly recommend!

Great location and fast responses to questions via text. Entering is a bit tricky but virtual agent was quick to respond.  Clean and stocked with the basics - soap, dish soap, shampoo, paper products.  Plenty of towels and pillows.  Close to food options. Staff maintenance person was excellent.  I managed to drop a pair of brand new, pricey earrings down the bathroom sink before a wedding.  Maintenance came and retrieved the earrings!!  He saved the day and was so courteous.  That alone  is worth the 5 star review!
We had such a great time in Chicago! This place is such a great location. Walk to everything!
We were in town for an event at Wrigley. Loved the neighborhood. Very convenient and walkable. We would return without hesitation!
Great stay but parking is bad

Really enjoyed our stay. Perfect location for us. About 10-15 minute walk to brown line train and Southport shopping and restaurants. The 7 eleven on the corner was really convenient for snacks, water, etc…
The house was as advertised. Clean, comfortable beds, and plenty of hot water available with multiple people taking showers at the same time. The garage door height will definitely be an issue if you have any vehicle larger than a mid size SUV, but our Pathfinder fit with a couple inches to spare. Overall we were happy with our stay and would definitely recommend this house and location.

I’ll start with the good: the location is fantastic. Super cute neighborhood, very close to points of interest and public transit. The neighborhood felt safe as well. Check in was easy and we had all the information we needed.
We had a maintenance issue with a broken shower head. I reported it and the shower head was replaced that day. Assel was quick to respond and fix the problem.
However, the broken shower head not being noticed before we arrived made us question the cleaning process. If someone is cleaning a shower, which we would hope would happen between guests, a broken shower head should be easily noticed. There were also noticeable liquid stains on the kitchen counter and snack crumbs (including a Cheeto) left on the floor.
Additionally, the bunk bed was very unstable and we did not feel safe using the top bunk at all. We had four in our group so made do, but the place would not sleep 8 safely as advertised. A lot of the furniture was in general disrepair.
We were in Chicago to meet up with friends & family in the Lincoln Park area. Jacqueline was very responsive! The condo was comfortable and in a great location.
We enjoyed our stay very much. The 4 of us slept really well. The description was very accurate. It’s nice and quiet even though it’s only a block or so from the main drag.

This place was exactly as listed and had everything I needed. Every aspect of my stay was easy, all instructions were clearly explained and there are printed details for everything in the unit. The location is perfect, close enough to restaurants and things to do, but also far enough from the main streets that its not loud. The parking permits were a huge bonus and it was pretty easy to find a spot, even on the weekend. I'm saving this listing and will definitely look to stay here again next time I come to Chicago.

Our stay at Will’s could not have been better. We were a group of 7 adults and the space was able to easily accommodate all of us comfortably. The rest of our group (7 more adults) stayed in the apartment directly below us, which was ideal! The kitchen was very well stocked with dishes, pots and pans. Beds were comfortable and everything was clean. Plenty of towels in each bathroom. Quiet street in a tree lined neighborhood. We loved the history of the house! Easily walkable to stores and restaurants. We walked to Wrigley Field for a sporting event in under 30 minutes. We would highly recommend staying in this beautiful apartment. We will definitely come back, should we need such a spacious place in the future!
I enjoyed my stay—the home was comfortable and Bosede was responsive and easy to communicate with.

Clean apartment, clear instructions, and street parking wasn’t difficult even with our 12 passenger van! Had some issues with loud neighbors but the host addressed it as soon as we reached out about it, which was great! Loved the bunk beds
Holly was great to communicate with and the apartment was wonderful! Perfect for our family and great location off of Southport.
It is a very nice space. Lots to do in the area, very close to many bars restaurants and the metro for concerts.
Great location! Many activities available via walking or transit. Walking distance to transit. Place was very clean and the bed is so comfortable! We loved staying here! :)
Nice place to stay. Great location.
This was a great place to stay! Very clean and the host was responsive and friendly.
Easy check in, and a short walk to Fulton Market and the EL.
Great stay, no complaints! Nice location, clean and modern apartment, even the security at the building was so nice! Host was extremely responsive and friendly, would definitely stay again!

We were in town to visit the University of Chicago and do some shopping. The location was great to access the campus and downtown by car. The Red Line and the Green Line were also both close by if we had chosen that route. The property was exactly how it was described and the host and co-host were very proactive in their communication.
I would definitely recommend this home, it was clean, spacious, affordable, as well as excellent host service!
This was a beautiful AirBnb. I wish we could have stayed longer. Very well decorated with beautiful lighting. Clean and smelled very nice!
Great stay!

We had a perfect stay. Very clean, great location, responsive host, comfortable beds, pillows, and couch.
Check-in was easy, and i especially appreciated the easy check out instructions (in stark contrast with the hosts who charge guests exhoborant cleaning fees and yet still require a 12-point chore list to complete before exiting). 10/10 would recommend to my closest friends and family, and will look for this place again next time.
Very nice location and easily accessible to Wrigley Field and Wrigleyville.   Thank you!

the location was quite, even with a lot of restaurants and shops nearby.
we will definitely check this place first when we come back
As a repeat visitor to this apartment, it never disappoints. Clean, good location and with all the amenities.

We really enjoyed our stay! The apartment was exactly as described and we felt safe in the area. Great spot in Mag Mile, easy communication
This was one of my best experiences. Jerob was so helpful and accommodating. The house was beautiful and spacious. The next time I return to Chicago I want this listing again!!
Great stay , helped us with everything we needed ! Nice and clean place , easy to find parking
Great communication from the host. This is a perfect spot to stay for a long weekend in Chicago.
Perfect place for a weekend getaway in the heart of Chicago’s north side.   Could not ask for a better location and Michelle is such a great host!
Super clean and neat when we got there and overall a great location if you are trying to be close to the city but not directly in the downtown area.
It was cozy and very convenient to restaurants and shops. We enjoyed our stay and would stay there again.

Highly recommend Tommy's place. It is very central in Wrigleyville; near restaurants and bars, but on a quiet, tree lined street. It was spacious enough for four of us for a long weekend to catch a game at Wrigley Field. Would definitely stay again! Thanks Tommy.

Came in town for the Michigan/Northwestern game at Wrigley. Oscar’s place was a great location easy to walk and bike! I also had my dogs with me and Oscar’s place was perfect if you’re traveling with fur friends. Outdoor space and easy to walk to dog parks.
Gracias por la atención y por la gran comunicación. Fue un placer quedarme en tu casa y espero volver pronto.

Beautiful place and excellent location.  Very walkable to Wrigley and lots of things to do nearby!
Beautiful place to stay! Felt right at home. Would definitely stay here again!

My family loved our stay here, and we’d definitely return if we have another trip to Chicago! The apartment is even nicer and larger than the photos. The kitchen is beyond equipped! Awesome neighborhood and an easy walk to public transit. Communication was great too.
Nice bedroom and bathroom with a mini fridge, snacks, and water bottles. Shared living room/kitchen but nice family and no disturbances!

Thank you for my stay, which went wonderfully well. You were always attentive and responsive to my requests and I appreciated. I felt comfortable in your place and your availability and kindness made a real difference.
The location is perfect and the house is beautiful. Hosts are wonderful
Great spot and exactly what we were looking for. Cozy furniture, super cute, safe location, walkable area, great communication from owners, easy parking. Thank you to the hosts!
He was very nice and answered any questions that I had I will stay again

Marta & Tony were wonderful hosts and very responsive. The place was cozy, comfortable and had everything I needed. I would recommend this spot to anyone traveling solo as there was a feeling of security with the hosts living upstairs. It can certainly comfortably accommodate two people as well.

Celeste was a very responsive and helpful host! During check in we weren’t able to find the correct door (our own fault) but she was very helpful. The bnb was nice, clean, and cozy. When there was an issue we had, Celeste responded right away. Overall we had a pleasant stay in the home. The master bedrooms sheets were super cozy, we slept well, and the bathroom’s mirrors made it easy for my sister and I to get ready.

This was one of the best places I have ever stayed. Snacks, water, and wine were all complimentary. The host went above and beyond, and this house was immaculate—so clean, with nothing out of place. It was absolutely perfect.
Thank you for extending your home to me and my family. My son even proposed during our stay, and all of my sons participated in the Hyrox fitness event. It was an amazing experience and a vacation I will never forget.
Thank you again! I strongly recommend this place — you will not be disappointed.

City living at its best! Great apartment close to Wrigley Field and so many bars and restaurants. The deck off the back was awesome as weather was beautiful. I will definitely stay here again when we come back to Wrigleyville.

Great stay.. perfect place with Uchicago steps away and plenty of parking. Place was clean, and bed was comfortable.
Charla was very communicative and checked in to ensure I was enjoying my stay.
The only small issue I experienced was the WiFi seemed intermittent so it was challenging to hold work Zoom calls.

Samantha’s loft is perfect for a weekend getaway! It’s a 20 minute walk to the blue line and on a bus line, so it’s extremely easy to go to all parts of Chicago. There are good restaurants and bars nearby.
The neighborhood itself is residential and very quiet! The loft is clean, easy to find, and comfortable. If you have an issue with stairs, this won’t be the place for you. Otherwise, don’t hesitate to book! You won’t regret it.

Nice place in a nice neighborhood. It felt a little sketchy when first checking in because we had to walk through an alley at night. There isn't an assigned parking spot like I thought there would be. You have to find a spot anywhere on one of the streets to park, which was frustrating at first but ended up not being that big of a deal. It was clean and a nice place to stay.
Best place right by wrigley field
We enjoyed staying at Roseanna's place. Great little area with great food and coffee. We walked to Thalia Hall. Plenty of on street parking.
Great location in the city, really clean airbnb and really helpful / responsive host.
I enjoyed my stay here, very peaceful and I like how Jen is attentive to her guests 🧘🏾‍♂️
Great place for a Wrigley event.   Dugout bar is 2 stories below.

Overall good Airbnb, safe neighborhood. As in prior reviews there is a family that lives above the unit and you can hear the baby crying, consider ear plugs or a sound machine; during our stay the baby was sick and cried throughout the night, no fault of anyone but good to be prepared.
Nice and clean space.

This was a great stay for our group of 5 friends.  The place was easy to find in the big city, parking is close by, and the location was perfect!!  Everywhere we went was walkable or a short uber ride.  Close to so many fun activities!  We packed in a lot over 3 days: Navy Pier, Millenium Park, Michigan Mile, River Cruise, amazing restaurants including coffee and bagels very close by.  The hosts were extremely responsive and helpful for any questions or issues.
Cloud9 was an excellent host for my trip/stay. Very helpful and the place was perfect for the area, very easy to access.
good place right next to bus stop and train station

Location and Nostalgia. This place has it all. Just a few minutes from anything you could possibly want and a gem of a location to Wrigley. The house brought me back to my childhood in the Midwest with a warm feeling.
The home was perfect for our trip to Chicago! Spacious and plenty of bed options. Located a mile from Wrigley allowed for easy walking/unerring to and from the stadium. We loved our trip!
The place was super convenient and can accomodate a large group.  MJ was proactive in reaching out to me and always responsive.  I will rent the place again next time I'm in Wrigleyville for sure.

Nancy's place was comfortable,  clean, and cozy. It was perfect for my traveling companion and me for a couple of nights in Chicago. While not downtown, the L train was a short walk and make a quick journey to Wrigley Field, and a later return journey from Navy Pier.
The condo was beautiful from the inside. Everything was clean and very cozy. Any questions I had lili was able to answer in a timely matter. Definitely would stay at Lili’s place again.
Great stay!
Well stocked air bnb for a large group and very responsive host. The house is a little loud (can hear the train and neighbors) but overall great spot for a large group!
Great spot to stay.
Lou and Paul are great hosts. Super clean and spacious - walkable neighborhood- great place.

The host is VERY kind and accommodating to our flight issues. My issue is this place was filthy. Like so filthy there was pieces of paper and like paper letters in the bed and stains on every layer of bedding. The bathroom had mold on all the walls and was truly disgusting. My boyfriend and I had flip flops THANK GOD to wear in the shower. When I first turned the water on in the shower a wad of hair was floating around on the shower floor and then you learn the water doesn't drain because of the uneven floors so it just pools up so your feet soak in nasty water. There is a water filter canister in the fridge. It had floating bits and fungus/mold inside. We spent one night because we had to and then left. Paid for the whole thing but couldn't stomach staying another night.

This place looked exactly like the photos and looked even better in real life! The walls are pretty thick and the ceilings are at a good height. I loved my stay the neighbors were friendly and minded their business staying out the way, which I appreciate! Me and my guest loved the space they had everything we needed even doe to laundry soap which came in handy! Overall very clean place and for a good price too! ;)
We had a great time and enjoyed the convenance of the location we needed to be. Very responsive to our needs. Highly recommended.
Florin was a great host and the space was perfect for a long weekend in Chicago.  This is on the list for future trips!
I had a great visit at Jaime's place. The apartment was clean, quiet, and not too far from both the blue and brown lines. Would stay again!

This is our second time staying at one of Joe’s apartments. I felt that the price was a little high for what we wanted to spend, but the location was perfect.
The apartment was spacious, clean and comfortable.
Joe - and Stephanie - were very responsive via text. Would stay again for convenience factor.
Place was clean and conveniently located to parks, restaurants and local attractions.   Easy to find and close to Chicago attractions.

The cleaning crew took the time to leave an envelope soliciting tips but didn’t take the time to leave us bath towels nor remove all the hair from the bathtub. Stains on one couch.  Our 2 other guests decided not to stay with us because the only bathroom and living room were next to our bed. Trying to find parking in the neighborhood is an adventure and you could easily end up parked blocks away from the place and are constantly risking a parking ticket if you don’t keep up with the 2 hour check ins. Support had to inform us that parking could’ve been arranged 7 days in advance. I must’ve missed that when reading the rules...  it took 40 minutes to find a parking spot. This needs to be communicated better in the location description. We asked the host on 2 different occasions through the AirBnB app about parking with no replies. The TV is 7 feet high and unwatchable. The neighborhood itself is great, beautiful dwellings. We were able to walk to Wrigley which is what mattered most.
Great for a staycation in the city makes you feel right at home.

I spent a month at Joe's place in Lincoln Park. The neighborhood was fantastic - very walkable to lots of restaurants and coffee shops. The apartment was very clean and had all necessary amenities. Joe and his property manager were very helpful with any questions or issues I had.

What a beautiful home! The proximity to the L and access to downtown were even closer than expected. This home was extremely clean, warm and inviting. Ample street parking made the stay even easier. Can’t wait to go back and enjoy the large outdoor living area.

Ron was an amazing host. The fact that you were a five minute walk to Wrigley Field and to all the bars and restaurants downtown was incredible. Any time that we need to visit the area again, we will definitely be using Ron’s.  Ron even provided us with a list of places to eat, drink, and see.
Zed’s place was just like the photos.  Street parking was easy, free and in abundance.  Walkable to the train station and united center easily accessible to other areas of town
Our stay was spectacular! The price and location were perfect! The hosts were kind and friendly! They even set up a pack n play and set out books and toys for our son! Highly recommend!

Kari as our host was spot on in all aspects of our stay!
Every experience and expectation was met with this condo and host. Any questions we had were answered promptly and it was minimal because everything with this stay was top notch.
Excellent location for our needs but just a great place for a complete Chicago experience on every level.
I wish we could have stayed a few more months and will definitely be booking again whenever Chicago is our destination.
Thanks again Kari.
Happy Holidays,
Dan B
She was great and the place is amazing
Nini's place was great.  My son's place was so close and made it great. Nini was great in communicating and answering any questions.  I will plan to stay here again.
Beautiful stay. Will be back.
Great conversation! Don’t worry about the cute dog when he barks, he just wants to be petted.
Great place for the weekend, very cute neighborhood. Had everything I needed.
We had a great time here!
Beautiful place!

Had a great stay. Great location in easy walking distance to lots of amazing restaurants and shopping. The place was extremely clean and cozy. Jeannette was very kind and responsive for any questions. Highly recommend!

We enjoyed our stay, it was a great location and spacious apartment. There was an unpleasant smell throughout the apartment with some dust and dead bugs on around, otherwise the apartment was clean enough.
Cute place! Quick walk to Wrigley. Easy check in and check out, was very accommodating for us to check in early and check out late.
The best airbnb experience I have ever had!!
Nice place in a good location
The location and neighborhood were exceptional for our trip to Chicago. The bed was super comfortable. The space was relaxing and exactly what we needed. I would definitely stay there again.
Unique urban industrial loft space that was perfect for our group of families with plenty of space for everyone while still feeling cozy and comfortable
This was our 2nd time staying in Pilsen at Daniel's place and it was equally fantastic!
Steven was really good responding to us.Definitely recommended. This place is in the heart of Chicago. Highly recommend.

This place is so nice -- easy to find, and easy to feel at home! We found some great restaurants nearby (Everything Bar, Mart Anthony) and it was a super easy walk to catch the Green Line at Ashland or a nice 50-minite walk down Grand to access the Michigan Ave shopping district.
Natasha was a great host and everything felt so homey! Just a beautiful home, from the ground floor hot tub to the rooftop patio! Beautiful kitchen, cozy living room. The beds were comfy with lots of pillows! It felt very private, even in the middle of a bustling neighborhood!
Highly recommend this place, especially for families! We were 3 adults and 2 kids age 11 and it could not have been more perfect for us! It's really a very special space.
Great spot close to the train stop!

This is our second stay at Dorothy’s place and we will definitely be back.  She has nice little touches like biscotti and coffee pods on arrival.  Lots of towels and you don’t need to feel you have who buy toilet paper or garbage bags.  Check out is simple.  One of my favorite places to stay.
Great value, exactly as described. Comfortable, well-located, and convenient to downtown, Bucktown and Wicker Park, and buses to explore Chicago.

This place was perfect for a small group of 4 guys. Everything is clean and well-kept. Parking was easy, and Brandon was great in accommodating not only that, but also an early check-in. Check-in and check-out were effortless (check-out especially - they don't ask you to do much upon leaving). So much is within walking distance, including access to public transit. Tons of coffee shops, cafes, and restaurants. A really nice Whole Foods is within walking distance. If I came back to Chicago with my family, I'd feel safe staying here.

We loved the apartment. Easy street parking. Great restaurant and coffee options, all an easy walk.
Absolutely love Roscoe Village!

This was my second time staying at one of Victor's properties and I can say that my experiences have been very positively consistent. He is very generous when a little additional assistance is needed, and his response time is very good. The apartment itself is very cute and nostalgic! I look forward to being able to stay with him again.

I stayed at James’s place for a number of weeks and really enjoyed my stay. The neighborhood was walkable and the apartment felt safe. James was a wonderful communicator and fast responder and flexible with me as my travel plans changed. I would come back again.
We loved this place! So clean, modern and well equipped. The neighborhood was perfect for us. Jonathan was very responsive to my questions! Now I want to try his other locations.
Great place to stay in Chicago if you're familiar with the neighborhood. Pink line is a 5-minute walk away.

Had a great month-long stay in this unit! Jennifer and her team really went above and beyond to make sure I had a pleasant stay and accommodate every request. I wouldn't hesitate a second to book again!
The unit was wondrful. Clean, comfortable, and stocked with everything I needed to feel at home. The building is really great too! Awesome gym, hot tub, and other gorgeous amenities. And the location can't be beat, whether you're in town on vacation or for business. You have both Whole Foods and Target a block away.
Five stars all the way!

We recently stayed here for a race weekend, and here are a few pros and cons from our experience.
Pros: The location was great, the host was very responsive, and parking was convenient. We felt safe throughout our stay, and they were very accommodating with air mattresses. Ubers were easy to get, so we never had to wait. Just be sure to ask for extra towels. Price was very affordable compared to others.
Cons: We failed to read that all of the beds are singles (our own fault). You’ll also want to coordinate parking with the host ahead of time; there are indoor and exterior options, but there is a refundable deposit for the remotes. It was also a bit noisy outside at night.

As someone who is new to Chicago, I truly could not have asked for a better place/host. Patt is so incredibly kind, welcoming and helpful. I needed a lot of support when I got here and Patt was never shy to offer a hand.
The street is absolutely adorable, it’s super quiet, safe and walkable to everything nearby. 10/10 would stay again! thank you Patt!

A Truly Wonderful Family Stay in Chicago!
​We had such a wonderful experience staying at Michael's place in Chicago. We were traveling as a family and truly enjoyed every moment of our stay.
​The apartment itself was incredibly clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. It felt like a home away from home, which made our family trip so much easier and more relaxing.
​Michael and his brother were exceptional hosts—very kind, welcoming, and responsive. The check-in and check-out process was seamless, and their hospitality really stood out.
​We highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago and are already looking forward to staying here again on our next trip!
​Thank you, Michael, for making our Chicago visit so memorable!
It's a great place to stay with family or friends. You will have everything you need while you travel, it's a home away from home! Ben and team are doing a good job!
Great experience! Awesome location, Thomas was super responsive, and the Airbnb was perfect for an extended stay.

Victor’s place was clean, well-kept, and located in a good neighborhood. Everything matched with the description in AirBnB.
The Peterson/Ridge train station is 6 minutes Uber/ car drive and the Bus stop is also 12 minutes walking distance, which is very nice and convenient to visit different places if you don’t have a car/vehicle.
Victor communicated clearly, and check-in was smooth.
Overall, the space provided me a great room to sleep in and other amenities for a 7-days stay and worked well for my needs. Thank you Victor.
We have stayed here a couple times always great

If you’re considering this beautiful penthouse, consider no more and just do it. I’ve traveled all around the world and stayed at some of the finest hotels but THIS place by far is one of the most beautiful & breathtaking places I’ve ever stayed in. The nearly panoramic view is a big WOW ! The penthouse was very clean, not a spec anywhere, and provided the essentials like coffee, tea, creamer, and a water purifier in the refrigerator. A chefs kitchen meant you needed nothing to be comfortable. It felt like an extension of home- with better views. I stayed here with 3 children and my ex-husband (haha) and we had a blast. Easy to commute everywhere via uber and easily walkable, if that’s your vibe. Wonderful coffee/sandwich shop off the lobby which was perfect for slow mornings. Uber Eats delivered right to your penthouse door for late night snacks. Love this place- I will only ever stay here when visiting Chicago. And the host was A+ with communication.

As others have said in previous reviews, this is a nice condo in a great location in a comfortable neighborhood to walk around and check out. Lots of different restaurant choices, near Second City, seven minute walk to the L station, etc. Easy and secure access with the door code. Clean linens and towels, a comfortable bed, adequate kitchen equipment for our needs, and a nice supply of coffee to brew every morning. The bathroom is indeed small and tight, but all very clean and functional with a good shower. The deck out the back looks great, but it was too chilly during our visit to enjoy sitting out. We’ll use it when we return!
Great place to stay. Awesome house, parking wasnt the greatest, alot of stuff to do in the area

This stay was pretty easy and right in the best neighborhood adjacent to our work meetings. The beds were comfy and although we didn’t get to stay there  much due to work demands, we felt safe and were able to visit nearby breakfast spots etc.
The home was very clean and well put together

Kati is an incredible host and their place is ideal for long term stays! The place is fully stocked with everything you may need, and the place itself is beautiful w ample sunlight and a balcony. Would definitely come back!
fantastic stay in Chicago

It’s a very nice spot, prime location, good value for the price. Would stay here again for a short trip!
You have your own room but you stay with potentially two other guests (or couples) and share one bathroom. The common areas are quite spacious and clean, but I did have a small issue with the shower not draining due to a big buildup of hair and some other gunk in the shower drain that I took care of myself.
Benjamin did reach out initially to see how my check in was and to make sure everything was okay, which I appreciated very much! However, when I explained I would be leaving the trip early due to a family emergency, I was only able to get one message back from him in a 48 hour plus window during the weekdays. I was constantly on the phone with Airbnb support regarding leaving early and they couldn’t reach him either when they tried. I know leaving mid trip inconveniences the host, but I wish the communication could’ve been better with him as it truly was a family emergency.
Beautiful place, great hostess, very clean...  Would book again!
Beautiful place! Felt super safe and comfortable. Thank you highly recommended

Needed a last minute place to stay near the medical center and this was perfect. The photos don’t do it justice in a good way, it was larger than expected. Was also stocked with everything we needed from plenty of washcloths to a hair dryer to a surprise of some drinks in the fridge. Nate gave clear instructions that were easy to follow. About a twenty minute walk to the medical center. Felt very safe during walks during the day. Ubered around at night but would’ve done that anywhere.

Lugar de fácil acceso y cerca del metro, lo que facilita el movimiento por la ciudad. La habitación estaba limpia, ordenada y era cómoda. La instrucciones de llegada y salida fueron claras y fáciles de seguir.
Marc is a great host—friendly, responsive, and welcoming. The apartment was wonderful, and I’d gladly stay again.

Loved staying in Mary and Andrew’s home. The atmosphere of the place was so peaceful and calm that I decided to extend my stay as well as rebook the same room a week later. Mary was super responsive and gave me transportation advice, which I appreciated. Great place and good vibes all around! Highly recommend booking a stay in their home.

I wasn’t able to make it to my reservation because I ended up staying at my brother’s house, but DJ’s place looked incredible—perfect location and great communication throughout. I’m looking forward to my next visit to Chicago and staying at his place!
It was absolutely lovely, clean and they were attentive to all needs.
Great place to be
Spacious, clean and quiet apartment in a great neighborhood close to shops and restaurants. Convenient to transit and close to CTA Blue line which goes straight to O'Hare.
Comfortable place and attentive host
Convenient location. Spacious and clean stay.
Just the right size with the location and accommodations we were looking for. Hosts were lovely and very helpful.

A clean beautiful place. We were able to be there for hours! The neighbor is okay and the steps were steep, but it was great. The beds were comfy, the couch was clean. There was towels and kitchen things. The buses where near by. Overall Good Place

Otherwise the hosts are super friendly, and were nothing but kind people. They gave plenty of recommendations and answers to the questions I asked. The location is nice too, never felt unsafe when walking back. Would highly recommend, just don’t be silly like myself…

Overall the Airbnb was nice and cozy inside. Wash and dryer was very convenient and host would respond in a timely manner. Initially i had a hard time adapting due to the safety of the surrounding environment but just stay aware of your surroundings when leaving. Neighbors were nice and friendly.  Overall, I enjoyed my stay.
My stay was great. The host were very communicative. Anything I needed they responded within minutes. The home is exactly like the pictures. Definitely a gem.
I was grateful that they let us checkout and check in early
Great stay!

Matt was a terrific host.  He was not only helpful but both proactive and empathetic to our special needs.  He really went out his way to make us comfortable throughout our 1 month stay.   The place is very cute and comfortable and well designed.  We loved the neighborhood as it offers so many different things from restaurants to grocery stores and a great wine store 3 blocks away.   Easy walk to Lincoln Park and the zoo.   Would highly recommend staying here.
Overpriced and hidden fees. 400 was added after we communicated if all fees were included in the price.
Perfect location in Lincoln park next to zoo and nice restaurants. Thanks!
Loved our stay! So easy and fun. Very cute place and very easy to check in.  Perfect location near all the things we needed. I would definitely come back and stay here!
Excellent host, nice space overall, & great value.

The hostel room was nice and clean. The bed was quite comfortable. The room is right next to the hostel kitchen and you can hear everything happening in there from your room…..thin walls. But this place is in a very safe and desirable location and it is inexpensive. Good stay!
Paz is a great host. Would definitely recommend!
Great host and a perfect place for me! Very grateful for their hospitality and reliability. Totally recommend!
Milan place was exactly as described. Home was clean and the location was easy to access.

Mirela's place was incredibly clean and as described. She left us snacks, coffee, a filtered water pitcher and very clear instructions. There was a fun stack of games, a couple dozen books and a small stack of DVDs. She also left us parking stickers for each day which was a huge help. There was laundry option and supplies in the basement was so helpful. Beds were comfy and the neighborhood peaceful. She was a great host. We are so grateful! Thank you!!

Spacious rental. Owner responsive to guests needs, such as replaced washing machine when it was broken. Responsive to communication from guests. Although I think the rental could be priced a bit lower, overall it is a good place to stay, WiFi has worked reliably, and conveniently located near CTA station, Lake Michigan/beach, parks, and a nice parking garage.
pics and descriptions were parking sports was a little confusing but manageable. overall the stay was good no regrets great pricing as well, cant go wrong.

Murtaza and Rachael were extremely accomodating and helpful whenever we had any questions or issues
Lovely people and would definitely stay here again

Josh is responsive, and very friendly…. The room is great and clean …. Close to train stops and busses and good part of town….
Next time I get away will deff be booking again!!!
Oh I’d definitely stay at this excellent flat again. It’s in a great location. Super walkable to great Pilsen spots. The lodging had everything I needed and is uniquely stylish.

Great stay. It matches the description. An older but well maintained house, a few bathrooms. I used the laundry, and the kitchen. Both clean and well kept. I’d stay again, feels like a home. Brian was responsive as well when I messaged. Not an overall fan of Roger’s Park but that is not on the host at all. Did walk to the lake one day with the dog and he enjoyed it.

Pleasant location, the apartment is beautiful and clean, we felt right at home! Bella and her team were always there to assist us and very responsive. It made our trip to Chicago 100 times better, thank you to all the team!

This was the second stay for us at Mark & Marcelo's place. It is an easy walking distance to my daughter's apartment.  The home is beautifully decorated and has a well stocked kitchen.  We even used the laundry this time, which was so nice and convenient. The home is a peaceful and quiet place to spend time. Mark & Marcelo are top notch hosts  replying promptly to any questions or concerns you may have. I would highly recommend staying here!
Perfect spot!

So grateful I came across this stay last minute. As a solo traveler I’ve never stayed at someone’s home or booked shared spaces because I’ve always been anxious running into strangers(which never even happened once while staying here). This was my first time doing so & it wouldn’t be my last. Check in was smooth & Nicholas was able to provide me with instructions before I got to the Airbnb. I flew in from O’Hare airport & it’s a 30-40mins drive from the airport to this place, but if you’re someone with enough patience & love to travel on a budget then I’d recommend using public transportation which takes about 1hr 18mins. I used the public transportation everywhere I went & it was very convenient & save me a lot. The buses & train lines through this route runs 24/7 so that’s a plus. It’s a 2 minute walk to the bus stop & I’d say 10 minute bus ride to the train station. There’s also 2 gas station nearby and a fast food place to buy food. Nicholas is a great host & good at communicating.
Very good !
Really friendly neighborhood, walkable, dog loved it and so did we!

Tara is a fantastic host, really hospitable and goes out of her way to make sure you get settled nicely.

Walking distance to the blue line, grocery store, and lots of bars and restaurants nearby too, or even more options a stop or two on the blue line.
Overall, Tara's place was a lovely stay
Great stay and host. Parking was a huge plus, especially in Chicago.
Fantastic location, surprisingly quiet. Stayed here for a month and was overall very pleased with my stay
Fue una estancia bien tranquila , el lugar estaba justo como las fotos era seguro y su host fue muy amable !! Les recomiendo este apartamento!

My adult daughter and I spent a few days chilling and relaxing. The unit is large, airy and very well stocked. Larry was super responsive, and kindly let us have a late checkout to make our last day easier. The neighborhood is great, with plenty of good restaurants, and a grocery store a few blocks away.
So glad that I was able to stay at Carrie's place for a few nights. It was super easy and a very comfortable stay.
The place was amazing, cos cozy and had everything you need. The host was super kind and responsive. Definitely recommend

We definitely enjoyed our stay here. It was close to public transportation to get to the city. The instructions to check in were pretty clear and the unit is well maintained. We would definitely go back if we ever return to Chicago.

I really enjoyed my time! They were amazing hosts. I will definitely be returning when I’m back in town! Very responsive, and a very clean and safe location.
The location is great too for people from out of town or without a car because it is literally one block from the green line, which goes straight to the city within 15 min. Excellent!
We had a nice time at this location. We were very close to everything we needed. Check-in and out was easy. Nice view.
非常推荐，路边容易停车。shawn的回复很及时，很有帮助

Milan’s place was perfect for our three night stay in the South Loop. We greatly appreciated how responsive Milan was before and during our stay. The apartment is large and we enjoyed the patio Thank you!
Great place, exactly the same as deacribed. walkable from CTA

I had a fantastic stay at this four-story home in Chicago and ended up extending multiple times—each extension was handled quickly and seamlessly by the hosts. The house is spotless, well-equipped, and exactly as described. Reliable Wi‑Fi, comfortable beds, strong heating/AC, and a full kitchen made it perfect for both work and relaxing. The layout offers plenty of space and privacy across floors, and the laundry setup was a huge plus for a longer stay.
Location-wise, it’s convenient to public transit, groceries, and great neighborhood spots, yet the street felt safe and quiet at night. Communication was consistently fast, friendly, and helpful—check‑in was a breeze, and any small requests were addressed right away.
Note: it’s a true four-story property, so there are a fair number of stairs—totally fine for me, but worth keeping in mind if mobility is a concern.
Overall, a five‑star experience. I’d happily stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking

Nice place and Tanya was super kind. The neighbourhood was super cool, but I felt a bit unsafe walking from nearby transit to the place later at night (I say this as a tall guy who has lived in cities before). All said, I'd recommend the place overall, just be careful.
This place has really good location. It is easily accessible to blue line and buses. Everything was good for a short stay.
Nice space, soaring roofs, great location amidst lots of bars/restaurants/amenities, a bit noisy from the upstairs neighbors but not bad
Nice place in the heart of Chicago. Marco at the rooftop bar was fantastic and the breakfast buffet was one of the better ones that I’ve had in a long time.

We had a great trip to Chicago. The apartment was perfect for our family - the layout gave us plenty of space, the amenities were well thought out and we liked that we were close to the blue line and the 606.

Rebecca was a gracious, hospitable host. Her instructions for finding the place and checking in were clear, easy to follow, and so helpful. The location is perfect for getting to Metra, Hyde Park, U Chicago, and is rather quiet, cozy, and peaceful. She had the pantry and fridge well stocked, offered me food, drinks, and a feeling I could make myself at home. We had lovely conversation but could also do our own things we needed to. She know the neighborhood and city well, and is a wealth of great information and history about the area and city. Great value and care, highly recommend!

What a great place to stay while visiting the Uchicago Campus!!  Clean and lots of room.  If your just using the place to sleep, it was great!!!  If you plan to use it for cooking it Was lacking amenities in the kitchen, glassware, sliverware was sparce. Absolutely no seasonings for cooking. We had an early Thanksgiving dinner with our family that was all in town visiting the grand daughter for college family weekend. So that was kinda hard to put together.   All in all we really like the place and will definitely be back!  Hopefully some things can change where it can actually be your home away from home, with all the things necessary!  Jim is a great host and very responsive and easy to get a hold of when needed!!

Elizabeth's place is amazing, the best Airbnb we've ever stayed in. There were 5 adults in our group and each had their own private space--no sleeping on a pullout couch in the living room. I give it my highest recommendation!

We really enjoyed our stay. Lots of good local restaurants with diverse cultures. Great location and close everything. Snowed we were their- but street kept very. Clean and drivable. Temps dropped to 25 degrees but apartment warm and cozy. Recommend!!!!!

Unbeatable location, setup, and host. Barbara gave us a warm welcome and even brushed the snow from our car after an unexpected storm after agreeing to lend us a shovel- so kind! The loft had strong WiFi, the kitchen was very handy (I would bring your own spices and cooking oil), the ability to do laundry was great, and most things worked the way they should. I would definitely book again.
Recommendations - try to book one of the top floors, and bring special ear plugs etc if you are noise-sensitive - location is across the street from a fire engine house. There are ramps to all entrances and I noticed a room on the bottom floor just after check in which may suite ADA needs.

We really enjoyed our stay at Ajibade's place. It was exactly as advertised and extremely convenient as it was a few minutes walk from a CTA stop with easy access to UChicago (which we were visiting) and downtown.
Ajibade and the team were very responsive and attended very promptly to any issues we raised. Their communication was prompt, clear and very friendly.
I will definitely be staying there again in future and highly recommend it.
Nancy and Jenny were very kind and helpful. The place was clean, warm, and cozy. The nearby access to public transit was great.
muy bonito el apartamento de alec, limpio, ordenado y alec muy pendiente de todo , nos encantó nuestra estadía , sin duda siempre será una opción para alojarnos en próximas vacaciones :)
Family had a great time on their first visit to Chicago.

We enjoyed our stay. The area was quiet and was not far from restaurants. It snowed while we were there and the front walkway was shoveled for our safety. We will be back for sure. We even talked about possibly moving to Chicago! Thank you for allowing us to stay!
Great neighborhood and very walkable. Communication was excellent. We used spot hero to find parking which was convenient.
This was comfortable, easy to stay in and felt really safe and peaceful. The neighbourhood is full of life. The beds were super comfortable and had great linen.
Very helpful, very responsive, everything you could ask for in a host. 10/10
Great location and ample room.
Clean and spacious with a beautiful view. Milan was quick to respond to any questions. Highly recommended!

We really enjoyed our stay.  Even with 4 of us (2 adults, 2 kids, age 8 and 10), we felt like we had enough space. Having 2 bathrooms was great. Perfect location and we did not have trouble finding a parking spot. We appreciated being able to extend our stay another day at the last minute when a snowstorm hit. Definitely recommend.
Great place for a family to stay while visiting friends in the neighborhood - lots of games, books, kid-friendly dishes, etc.

First and foremost, the unit matched the pictures, which is a very important part of booking any Airbnb. The host is always responsive and amazing. Making sure that all of our questions was answered at a reasonable time frame. The location is safe, quiet and you have local spots nearby just in case you want to go to the city and just have a nice warm night at the airbnb. Overall, my experience with the Airbnb and the host is amazing. I would highly recommend anybody to book this property or any of the other ones they have listed. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Beautiful house, great hosts!
Great host that was responsive, offered free early check in, and came thru to help fix a maintenance issue. Lovely location was a dope view and comfortable furniture.

I enjoyed a great stay for a month in a Chicago and would highly recommend. Exactly as pictured and very comfortable home away from home. Nicely furnished with all the amenties for a home away from home  (nice kitchen, comfotable beds, newer furnishing, washer/dryer, workspace, TVs, etc).  The large private balcony was a nice bonus during good weather and the garage parking and location made it super easy to get around if you are using a car daily, as I was. McCormick Place is also an easy walk and public transit if you are on foot. The host was super easy to work with and very responsive when questions came up.  Only thing to know going in is that with the convenience to getting on/off 55, 90 and Lakeshore Drive, there was a bit of road noise from highway, but it was dull hum and not disruptive or an issue for me.

Our stay at this Airbnb in Chicago was overall positive, but there are a few details worth mentioning for future guests.
The apartment was clean, tidy, and relatively close to downtown, which was convenient. However, the 4 p.m. check-in felt very late. We had to walk around Chicago all day with our backpacks because leaving our luggage earlier came with an extra fee of $75.
When we arrived, we noticed there were no blankets, even though we were told they would be in the closet. On top of that, the windows didn’t close properly, so it was quite cold. The host responded quickly when we mentioned it, which we appreciated.
The listing also mentioned that there was detergent for the washing machine, but there wasn’t any, so we couldn’t do laundry.
The kitchen was generally well equipped, though missing basics like oil, salt, or spices. These weren’t listed as included, so it’s not really a complaint—just something to keep in mind.
Overall, the place is nice and has potential!
The host was very responsive and nice I enjoyed my stay !
We had a great time! The hosts were very clean, responsive, and accommodating. It’s a great location to stay in the heart of Wicker Park.
Felt like Home!

This is an amazing place to stay in the city. Let's start with being about 50 steps from the Red metro line at State and Grand. Just pop up on the Northwest corner and you are steps from the front door. This place is way up with a great view. Fortunately, the windows shut tightly and mostly keep out the fire engine sirens from the nearby station. They did include a fan that dampens any residual noise.
Overall, a fantastic stay, and the location was perfect for exploring the city.
Nice place with full amenities.  Good location.  Very helpful and responsive hosts.
Has everything that matters: excellent and comfortable beds, spacious, excellent location, quiet, private.
Robert was wonderful. I’m very understanding.

The house has full potential to be a high end boutique hotel if all rooms were provided with private bathrooms, anyway, the bed in my room was comfortable despite what other people stated in their feedbacks, Brian was right, the bed is comfortable only the pillows were a bit hard to deal with but the care for the cleaning makes everything flaws less. Yess, I will recommend Brian’s place!

And with that one week flew by ... I had a really nice stay, lots of good conversations and I just felt like I moved in with friends for the holidays, right at home.
The two cats are also easy goong and friendly and public transport is just around the corner.
Much recommended and if I end up in Chicago again I'd drop by again :-)

Loved this apartment in a renovated historic building!  Great great location for public transit - multiple bus stops steps from the front door, and less than a block to the red line! Cosy space with a HUGE walk in closet, and everything was spotlessly clean.  Would definitely stay here again! Keyless access made getting in and out a breeze.

Tram’s place was as pictured.  The living space was lovely with lots of windows making it a treat watching the snow fall.  The rooms were well kept with plenty of pillows.  Tram was very responsive to any questions we had and very sweet.  We would stay again!

Had a little hiccup getting in to the house—the assigned door code didn't work and it took around an hour for the host to respond and amend the error. It was an honest mistake that could happen to anyone, but was frustrating to be waiting in the cold. Once I got in to the house though, it was great and worth the price paid.

Milagros was an excellent host and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The apartment was spacious yet cozy and the location was perfect for exploring the city. If you’re looking for a home away from home while in Chicago, this is it!
pricing was amazing, great place, great location, very responsive host

Place was exactly as described! Absolutely perfect for our concert across the street at the Aragon Ballroom, which is why I chose this spot. Metro and bus stops very close! Would definitely stay here again! Loved the rooftop area! Host was very responsive and gave recommendations on restaurants as well as getting around the area!

Overall, we had a wonderful stay at this location. It was very clean, aside from the microwave, and very close to Little India and other delicious restaurants. It was very easy to find and easy to get into. We had groceries and DoorDash delivered with no complications. Saravanan answered any questions we had quickly. Bathrooms were clean and we never ran out of hot water with 5 people in the house.
Beyond easy.   The property is great and amenities are wonderful

My partner and I were in Chicago to attend a concert at Thalia Hall just at the end of the block. Perfect location.
Amy was very communicative and always responded promptly.
The accommodations were perfect for 1 or 2 people. Everything was immaculate.

My gratitude and apologies!
I would highly recommend! ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Located in the historic Bronzeville district of South Chicago, 1 block from bus number 4, which takes you directly downtown.  Perfect for 1 or 2 guests.

Location was as described and it was easy to check in. Bar was a bit noisy downstairs, especially on the weekend, but it was expected. Overall the place was cozy and had everything we needed, host was very kind and responsive if we had any questions as well!

Amazing location and exceptionally appointed unit. There are important emails to read prior to arrival, which made it very easy to checkin. Door staff were warm and helpful. Unit was fantastic! Such a great location too. Would highly recommend.
Great stay

Great spot for a girls weekend. Very close to downtown area but also has restaurants and bars in walking distance.  There was the sound of the train but found it soothing. Ear plugs were a nice touch. Beautiful views of the city !!

This is a Gem of a place. Location is unbeatable. Love, Courtney and Garrett are amazing hosts and very quick at responding and answering any questions. Very clean and comfortable with free street parking available. Can’t go wrong with this one!
Everything was exactly as described and the host was more than helpful and responded rapidly!
Exactly as advertised. Great place to stay when visiting UIC or close by.

We had a few small hiccups at the beginning of the stay, but Jared was responsive and everything was settled. The location was great - convenient to a bus stop and the blue line. Our group of 15 ladies absolutely loved our stay here. The unit was clean and comfortable, and had plenty of space for us all to spread out and have our own beds. The house was in a great location in Old Town - close to grocery stores, restaurants, coffee shops, and Second City! - but also quiet and removed from too much hubbub. We appreciated the proximity to everything we wanted to do in Chicago.  Would stay again.

Great host, had a plumbing issue and responded quickly.  Very nice, communicative, and helpful.  Would book again!  Are is great as well if you want a slower pace while feeling like you're in the city.
