Made money off me even though I was never able to stay at the house due to flight cancellations by the government shutdown. He did not care that he was taking my money anyway. This home was perfect for our family weekend!   So cozy and comfortable and spacious! Highly recommend!
Romana was an excellent host! Accommodating, kind, and very considerate. The house was lovely and equipped with everything we could possibly need. Thank you so much, Romana!
Everything went perfectly. I would definitely stay at Bella's place again!

Absolutely loved staying here. The place was walking distance to lots of nearby restaurants and music venues. The neighborhood was safe and peaceful.  Whether it's with friends or a solo trip, I'd recommend this place anytime!

It's exactly what I expected, a little spartan but I was at a conference at Loyola and it was super close and cheaper than the conference hotel and that's really all I needed. Shout out to them for letting me extend my stay an extra night when my flight got cancelled at the last minute! Thank you!

No need to look any further - this is the place! Want lots of beds plus a large gathering space for lots of people? The game tables (ping pong and foosball), large TV's, and cool decor really made our weekend so much fun. Definitely a place where everyone wanted to hang out. We had some time to explore the parks, coffee shops, book stores, and thrift shops nearby and really enjoyed the area.
From start to finish, Bob and his team were fantastic communicators and even checked in on our group when there was threat of bad weather on our departure day.
John was a very responsive host.  the property was very well equipped. he really thought of everything.  beds were super comfortable.
Great stay. Easy walk to most everything

One morning I went for a run to the park down the street, and the neighborhood felt very safe, calm, and relaxing. I would absolutely stay here again. The bed was super comfortable too.
Great stay, thanks, Alonzo

Aime and Diana were great hosts. Great communication throughout the trip. They also offered great options for early checkin/late checkout. The place was a great space for our party of 7 people. Aime went above and beyond with great food/coffee/drink recommendations. She was very responsive and answered all of our questions. Great place to stay when in chicago. Thanks for a nice stay.
Awesome time in Chicago!  Josh and Amy were great hosts and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.   We hope to stay again in the spring on our next visit to the windy city.

We have stayed numerous times at beautiful Serenity Spaces. Everything is pristine and so comfortable! Looking forward to our next visit!

The way a person recovers from a mistake is often the most real indicator of quality. Despite a few minor oversights, Aime and the owner of the property managed to blow me away with their recovery. Good place to stay little expensive but I get it. Last minute booking

We had such a great time enjoying Brian’s place.  We were staying there while work was being done on our home.  He was great to work with and we felt incredibly comfortable.  We plan to have friends enjoy it too!!
This is and always will be my go-to spot in Chicago. Anything and everything you want in an Airbnb is here and Devon is the ultimate host.
Definitely a place I would recommend staying again!

We had a great stay! Place was clean and easy to check in. It’s close to Downtown so it was easy for us to move around. Parking is available as well.
We will definitely stay again when visiting Chicago!

The neighborhood is very cool and you can walk just a few minutes to great coffee spots like Loaf Lounge, as well as unique store fronts like The Insect Asylum. I would stay here again.

looks exactly like pictures! great host & great stay! thank you so much, we had a great time in Chicago!
Nicola’s place was so cozy, clean, and had excellent amenities. We enjoyed our time there and would stay again/recommend it to anyone else.
Short stay.  very comfy.  thanks so much.

I wouldn’t recommend walking, especially at night, as there are some hard blocks around these parts if you get lost but the street we were on was quiet and nice. University was close too and the area there is very nice to be around.
Great communication, extremely helpful and friendly host, safe and convenient location with comfortable accommodations. Would definitely stay here again!
The house was large and easy to share with other guests! Fed is a great host. I enjoyed my time.
This was the perfect Airbnb for family to stay in that flew in from out of town for my wedding. Clean and spacious. Betty was great and was very responsive. Highly recommend!
Chiaka was absolutely wonderful and the home was lovely that made our visit to Hyde Park a fantastic experience.
Great place to stay
beautiful and easy to find !!
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!
I like that the host included toothbrush and toothpaste and provided shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. Bus stop is across the street which was convenient.

Great place to stay for its walkability. Plenty of shops, restaurants, and bars just a short walk away. A nice cozy stay in the basement unit attached to the main house. Perfect for what we were looking for.

Very much enjoyed our stay . Communication was great and location and apartment were perfect for us! Thank you for sharing your home with us.
Great place! Thanks again!
Nico was very responsive and helpful, he went out of his way to ensure a smooth check in.
Arman is an awesome host. He is very responsive and flexible. He is very quick to get back. The apartment was well stocked and comfortable. Street parking is free and easy to find.
great space, clean, and prompt, helpful communication. no real issues and any minor ones were addressed easily
Returning guess - 5 Star stay every time!

Great Location, Secured Location. Clear access to public Transportation or there is free street parking on weekends, just verify at parking meter it will tell you. We definitely enjoyed the stay!
Great location near Wilson Metro (Red Line) and lots of quick food options. Price was great.  Thank you!

Staying at this Airbnb was an absolute delight! The space was not only sparkling clean but also incredibly spacious, allowing for a comfortable and relaxing stay. The hospitality was outstanding, making sure every need was met and going above and beyond to ensure a memorable experience. Without a doubt, I'll be booking this spot again for future trips.

The apartment offered an excellent standard of accommodation, with impressive cleanliness, modern amenities, and welcoming atmosphere that greatly enhanced our vacation experience.
Karen was very responsive.

Initially I was concerned that we would have issues parking, but we had no issues as there is plenty of parking around the corner if you can’t find any directly out front. It’s a great area and you can find pretty much anything you need within a 10 minute drive. I highly recommend this home!
Loved this place! Spacious and clean. Everything was new. Host was very accommodating and was responsive when we did need anything. Will definitely book here next time!

The place was nice, didn't feel like a total cookie cutter airbnb. The showers and beds were really great! Nice and spacious. Loved all the dimmer switches and little touches. Very walkable area.

Also, the parking instructions need to be updated, be sure to check street signs.
Great little apartment and it was very clean. Wonderful coffee shop, Sip and Savor, around the corner.

It was a great stay!  The place was a comfortable size for the three of us.  Very clean and cozy.  It was a short Uber ride to the places we went for visits.  Highly recommend if you are  in Chicago area!

I don’t usually write reviews but our experience was over the top fantastic.  The house was beautiful and the location was perfect. If you have a large group, this is the place to stay in the area.
Me and my friends enjoyed this place ! perfect!

My stay was very pleasant. The place has a cozy atmosphere and is beautifully decorated with great taste. Everything was clean, well-equipped, and in an excellent location.

I totally recommend it — it’s the perfect place to rest and feel at home. 💫
Excellent stay at Suite Homes Chicago (Jacob). Excellent service and atmosphere. Clean rooms, cozy place, and top-notch amenities. We will definitely be back, thanks Jacob !!!👍🏼

This appartment is lovely and homely ,we really enjoyed our stay, it's in a fabulous area , only a few mins walk to shop & restaurants.

Super cool place in a nice neighborhood. Lots of restaurants and bars on Chicago Ave. Also super close to the metro station + a Divvy electric bike station.
Overall I totally recommend, the patio was perfect and I would stay here again. We were in town for a concert at the United Center and it was great for that, rode the electric bikes over there and it was perfect.

Tanya was a great host, and I loved staying at hers. Her husband and herself were a great help and helped me with reinstalling batteries on the smoke detector - one example of how helpful they were.
A great space for a short stay
Really convenient for my sons tournament at the McCormick Place Convention Center and I had the blessing of sharing unit with very nice people!

Very clean apartment. Listed as sleeping 8 but has a sectional couch, not a sofa bed. Blow up mattress had a hole/leak in it but they replaced with a new one very quickly which worked well. Kitchen had less than 8 utensils, and plates, bowls, glasses, etc. So if you truly have 8 in your group, will need to purchase or bring own reusables. No oven supplies too. Holding your luggage is a weird storage closet and staff is not always present at check in but very quick to respond on app..

Christina's place is really spectacular - it feels like a secluded, cozy treehouse yet has easy access to great coffee shops, shopping and dining experiences within a five minute walk. Also a fast commute to the Loop and the rest of downtown Chicago for whatever actives you have planned. Would highly recommend for a solo traveler or couple. The bonus/office space downstairs also makes it an easy setup for one or two people as a co-working space during the day.
GREAT LOCATION!   the place was  nice cozy and extremely clean.

Le'Dia was a fantastic host. Had a great stay—the location was convenient, and check-in was seamless. She was super responsive and answered all of our questions. She was very communicative during the stay. She let us check in early, which was super helpful, as we were traveling with a bunch of teenage boys for a volleyball tournament. The place was just as described, and had plenty of room for hanging out. Having 2 kitchens was great for the amount of food we had to prepare. There was also plenty of parking on the street.
The only concern we had was the area it is located in. It is not the nicest neighborhood, but it looks like they are making improvements, and we did not have any problems. Overall, this is a great place to stay, and we would definitely recommend it.

The place was very clean and you can tell is well taken care of.  I had numerous questions before coming and the responses were very prompt, complete and friendly. We were able to get to all places we wanted to visit by public transportation - only a 10 minute walk to the Addison metro station.  We didn't use the buses but saw numerous ones running near by.  As stated in the description it is on the 3rd floor which isn't a problem, but just note that the stairs are circular so may not be easy if you have large suitcases - we had carry on luggage which wasn't a problem.  Alex did offer to help if necessary with our bags, but we did not find it necessary.  Place had plenty of pillows, comfortable bed with enough covers!  A few nice additions such as small throw blankets,  instant oatmeal, yogurt, coffee, fresh fruit & soda making it very welcoming.

Great place!
Nice roommates, close to the CTA/buses, and it's well kept.
Even though the residence has long-term tenants, the team (host(s)) always made sure the common areas were taken care of and restocked.
It's a great place to rest and be a tourist. It's also a great place to stay put and go about your business.

Mayra was an amazing host. When traveling, it's impossible to prevent all troubles from happening but what's really important is the host being responsive to help resolve the problems. Mayra just did that. On the first day the door lock was causing a problem and when I asked her, she almost immediately responded and resolved the problem remotely. And then there was an issue with washing machine and when I sent her a video of the issue, she quickly gave me a simple instruction and I was able to resolve. She was very kind and super responsive and helpful.
The whole place is very clean, and every door is installed with smart autolock so the whole place is very secured. I was highly satisfied with the stay.
Thank you again Mayra :)
Good neighborhood, nice house, fun trip.

Christals house is beautiful and so clean and spacious. We had a great time and the kitchen has every amenity you could ask for. TV’s in all the rooms so the kids had a great time and only a few minutes walk from a huge park. If we are going back to Chicago we will definitely look to stay here again.
Very clan and cozy home. My stay was very enjoyable knowing I was laying here to rest at the end of each day.

Location was great and walkable to restaurants and sights, too bad we were not able to maximize our stay and become tourists because we were there for a volleyball tournament. Parking was great and the elevator leading to the unit was awesome! I wouldstay here again!
Great location for McCormick Place and plenty of space for our group.  Easy access and host was extremely communitive.

As a sole traveller to Chicago, I was apprehensive about visiting but was looking forward to some warm hospitality, based on the previously published reviews,of Ewa's place. However it is very disappointing to report that my stay was not at all pleasant and I made the decision to leave in the early morning of my first night.
Despite Ewa advertising amongst her house rules 'quiet time' between 20-00 and 07.00, sadly this was not the case. First evening I was awoken at 23.30 hrs, only to be woken again at 04.00 hrs by loud talking and crashing around in the kitchen and bathroom, both of which were directly opposite the room I was staying in. The coffee percolator at 04.00am was not at all welcome and the subsequent loud conversations. The subject of the conversations was particularly concerning, to a point where I felt apprehensive and concerned, hence the decision to pack my suitcase and leave at 05.30am

Thank you so much for the hospitality. Your home is absolutely beautiful.
Perfectly surrounded by all the major stores for all your needs. minutes from the airport.
10 out of 10 would highly recommend

We really enjoyed our stay in Tim & Barbara’s beautiful, historic home.  They were excellent hosts, providing a comfortable, clean space, great recommendations for activities and restaurants within walking distance and well-organized amenities for our stay. Highly recommend!

This is a diamond in the rough. Such a lovely place. It’s bigger than the pictures do justice. Latasha was an amazing host. Responded quickly and even left a beautiful note to celebrate our stay. If we return to Chicago we will definitely come back here. The kitchen net is perfect. Just enough if you want to heat up left overs or cool some drinks. Chicago has such great food so you won’t be cooking anyhow. It was the perfect stay for our mini-moon. Close to the water to pick up an e-bike and cruise the lake side. Right around the corner from bus stops and train station. Definitely worth the book if you’re coming to Chicago.
Nice host, close to our family in Bucktown.  Well stocked kitchen and fridge. Would stay there again.
Our stay was perfect. We had no issues and David was very responsive with any questions we had. Very clean and made us feel right at home. I would strongly recommend his Airbnb!!!
Comfortable stay! Everything went smoothly! Check-in was easy, the space was clean and just as described. A great experience overall!

Probably the nicest Airbnb I have ever stayed in…with high ceilings and drenched in southern-exposure sunlight, it’s the type of place that’s so nice and relaxing to exist in that you’re hesitant to leave at all. Chicago stretches before you from no fewer than two balconies and an incomparable roof deck that make you feel like lord of all you survey. My friend and I enjoyed our three-night stay to the utmost. You can’t beat the beautiful and peaceful Lincoln Park location, a super short walk from the Brown line “L” train to the west, the Red line “L” train to the north and Lake Michigan and Lincoln Park proper just a few blocks to the east. Well-worth the price.

Talie was so incredibly gracious. He was very easy to communicate with and very responsive to our needs.    He let us check in early and check out late. We had a minor problem and he more than made up for it. We would totally stay here again! You better book it before someone else does. :)
Excellent spot to stay! Clean, plenty of linens, and really close to what we wanted to do!

We loved this condo! A great place right in the middle of everything Chicago has to offer. Very friendly building, the doormen were so helpful and other occupants too.
Condo has everything you need to be comfy and beautiful views of the sunsets from the 35th floor. Outdoor pool, fitness room, movie room, business room, pool table, large outdoor bbq area, its all there.
Jennifer was extremely kind and responsive, she even let us extend our stay by another week because we were having so much fun. (45 days total stay). We plan on returning next year, will definitely stay here again.
Patricia was a wonderful host and her place is perfectly located in Downtown Chicago.

Laura was very responsive and we were able to check in earlier.  The house was clean, just needed a few upgrades, especially in the bathrooms.   Door to bathrooms doesn’t lock and sliding door in Jack and Jill bathroom did not close properly.  Shower water temperature  was a bit too hot and we weren’t able to adjust due to the old fixtures.  Overall, it was a decent stay and is about 10 minutes drive to McCormick Place without traffic.

Easy to find delightful places to eat, only a close walk away. Excellent location. Clean space. Clothes washer essential for packing less. Had a blast, easy to walk and catch a ride from this place to all around town. I’d be back. Easy to get in and out. Nice quiet crash pad.
Beautiful neighborhood, private stay :)

We had an amazing stay. It was so nice to have our dogs with us for the long weekend. Arturo was always available to answer questions. The master bathroom was amazing. Steam shower was a bonus.
He also sent my phone and watch charger to Michigan, bc dummy me forgot it.
Totally recommend renting his place for a trip to Chicago.
Thanks again Arturo
This place was amazing. It was clean, looked just like the pictures. Area was quiet and very convenient. I hope to be back again soon

Great location. Division stop on the Blue line is about a 15-20 minute straight shot. Really cute space.
Only real nitpicky thing is that the wifi could be a bit spotty/slow, but Nat was very responsive. She does however need to travel to personally reset it. Otherwise, really nice space.

Denisha's home was in a very friendly neighborhood. There was a particular issue that arose at the house and Denisha was quick to respond and extremely considerate. We felt blessed to stay in this home and I highly recommend booking with this fabulous host.

Nat was very prompt and helpful when needed. My friend also liked the place and bedrooms also beds were very comfortable. Generally was clear. We enjoyed our stay. I would consider staying here again if I come back to Chicago.
Incredible flat in a great neighborhood. Was walkable to a lot of restaurants and stores as well as being close to bus stops. Would definitely stay here again. Beautiful area
Can’t wait to go back! Blake’s place was lovely and so was Blake!
The photos don't do the place justice... nicer than the photos. Had everything we needed!

Carrie’s place is so cozy and comfortable. The hosts kept to themselves but were very responsive. The bed was incredible!
It is a basement apartment with not much natural light but if you’re out and about during the day that shouldn’t bother you.

great location
very responsive

This was the perfect location for where we needed to be. The instructions were clear, the host was incredibly friendly and responsive.
The beds were very comfortable and the property is spacious!
Loved staying here felt super safe, great communication with our host, Spot was cute clean, parking was easy to navigate etc. Would 100% stay here again.

What a lovely home! I will seriously be staying here each time I visit Chicago. The neighborhood is beautiful and the neighbors are friendly. The hosts did a wonderful job of making sure I got settled in easily without being overbearing. 10/10!
Very kind and helpful host! Clean rooms and lots of amenities.

Juanita was cordial, communicative and graceful. She was also understanding about a mishap where I accidentally went into in someone else’s room out of my own misunderstanding. She was understanding and accommodated accordingly. Juanita was a great host. I would just comment that I think the cleanliness of the room I stayed in does need some upkeep. But for the price, you get what you pay for and this place would seem like a good place to stay if you’re in a pinch and need a roof over your head for a night.

Best Airbnb hands down! I live in Chicago and sometimes need to move around neighborhoods and this place was a godsend. It’s clean, cozy, the decor is so perfect (I’m picky with interior design lol) doesn’t feel like an Airbnb, feels like home. Plus the linen smells so incredibly clean! Cleaner than any hotel I’ve stayed at and I travel a lot !!! The host is responsive and super friendly. Will be coming back again and again and will recommend to everyone.
Nice location, clean and extremely helpful host. only suggestion would be to have a TV in all bedrooms.
Enjoyed my stay
Just in general need of maintenance. Also, pretty sure responses were monitored by a chatbot. 😬. Shower is also super weak. Apt gets BOILING at night.

Great place for a brisk visit to Chicago. I felt very comfortable the whole time, I had everything I needed at my disposal, and it was the cleanest place I've ever stayed.
Devon was very cordial and amiable, and was available if I had any questions. Should I ever return, I know I can expect another great stay.
Host was always responsive when I had questions about location or anything in general. Very friendly and the place was exactly as picture. Very clean and private. Will return for sure!
Great apartment in one of the better areas of the city

Beautiful place, clean, all the amenities, free street parking, close to public transit and easy access to the sights of Chicago.
Would definitely stay here again.

What an incredible stay at Jonathan’s! I spent three weeks in Chicago for a research stay and was amazed by how knowledgeable and cultured he is. He’s a great host with great conversations and nice recommendations about things to do in Chicago. And George...Such a gentle and playful cat! I highly recommend Jonathan’s place for short or long stays in Chicago. It’s located in the Puerto Rican neighborhood, about a 30–40 minute bus ride to downtown and roughly the same to most of Chicago’s hotspots.
Great experience!

Our stay at this Chicago Airbnb over Halloween weekend was absolutely amazing! The place was cozy, beautifully decorated, and had everything we needed to feel right at home. The location was perfect—close to all the fun but still peaceful for a good night’s rest.
The place was great. My friends and I had a great time. Jim was really good replying in a timely manner. I will definitely be coming back here.

Enjoyed our stay in Chicago at Keeva’s. Clean kitchen & bathrooms. Comfortable bed. Nice surround sound TV. Novel massage chair. Relaxing deep tub. High ceilings. Pretty autumn front window view from the 3rd story. And a complimentary bottle of wine & snacks were very kind! A good location near our event at the McCormick Place.
I had a great stay here!

This Airbnb was wonderful! It’s not often that the Airbnb looks better in real life than the photos, but this one did.
Overall:
-Apartment was bright, spacious, spotless, and full of windows.
-Cozy living room with fireplace, comfy seating, and huge TV.
-Plenty of storage, hooks, and hangers (even in the bathroom)!
-Easy 5 min walk to Jewel Osco and 15–20 min to most of UChicago campus, perfect for us.
-Heating worked great once adjusted; loved the keypads on every door (no keys).
-Host was gracious, left snacks, quickly replaced a air mattress that was stolen by a previous guest, and allowed early check-in.
Notes (these aspects were fine by us, but we just want to relay the information):
-3rd floor walk-up and no elevator.
-Sleeping options: king bed, queen pull-out, queen air mattress, toddler bed, crib.
-Bathroom has hand soap, body wash, and lotion, but you need to bring your own other toiletries.
**We would happily stay here again!
Great place to stay at while in Chicago. I would recommend it to anyone that wants to stay in a clean and local area. I will definitely be booking here again when visiting Chicago.
It’s nice and cozy
We had a rest time staying at their home and it made for an even better experience to be within the local neighborhoods of chicago! They were extremely kind and helpful to us, i definitely recommend!

Booked with them last minute and they were quick to respond. If I had questions they were fast on the response. This was a great place to stay and will definitely be staying again next time I travel to Chicago.

My stay here was absolutely amazing! The place was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect close to everything but still quiet and relaxing. The host went above and beyond to make sure I felt at home, responding quickly and offering great local recommendations. I really appreciated the attention to detail and how welcoming the space felt. I’d definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a great Airbnb experience!
Fabulous apartment in a great location.

3 miles or 10 minutes from McCormick convention center, with Mariano's grocery store within blocks.
Nice basement place. Upstairs tenants can be heard, though.

Mirela was a great host, she was friendly and responded quickly to any questions we had. Her place was close to all the places we visited during our stay. Her check in/check out instructions were clear and easy.  The Airbnb was cozy and had everything we needed. Thank you for having us!
Great place to stay in the heart of Wrigleyville! Walking distance from the ballpark and all the surroundings. Clean and was to access and find parking.

El
Departamento es muy bonito, acogedor, todo muy limpio, tal cual como en la descripción, podíamos estacionarnos en frente,sin duda alguna regresaríamos, muchas gracias.
The host was great! Responded on time, checked and made sure everything was ok. The place was really nice and clean as well. Will definitely come back.

Neighborhood not safe to say the least next door to project buildings, was woke up to loud construction I guess they’re rebuilding the unit next door was very inconvenient. Also the hot water was not working I ended up having to take a ice cold shower the hose mentioned that the hot water goes out from time to time so u guess we booked at the wrong time.
I will definitely return. Loved every bit of my stay. Host was very friendly and flexible. Beautiful home!
We stayed at Leigh's place for the second time. Perfect, as was our first stay. Spacious home, very sunny, easy access to the city and to the L. Nothing to complain about. We'll come back
Henok is an amazing caring and thoughtful host.

Had a great stay at Rachel and John's place! Unit was exactly as described, clean, and in a great location - just a 10 min walk away from the nearest train station. Rachel and John were both responsive, friendly, and helpful. It could be a bit loud when people would walk up and down the stairs at night (unit is in the basement), but I think that's to be expected in an older building. Other than that the apartment was excellent, and a good value compared to some of the hotels in Wicker Park. We had a nice time in Chicago, and would definitely stay here again!
Great space, great location. Close to public transportation and walkable to a lot of great restaurants and activities.
Great location, nobleman pub around the corner great for food and a pint!
Valerie was the best host! I had special needs and she met and surpassed my expectations. Out of the 5 star rating, I'd give her 6 - a GOLD star!

Beautiful! The floor to ceiling windows are everything. The front desk employees are great. We felt cozy and safe. I recommend this place, 10/10, and I’d love to come back and stay again. It’s noisy in the city, so I really appreciated the complimentary ear plugs and sleep mask. The espresso machine was a hit, and again… those windows! Thanks Cloud9!

This is our second stay with  Edward because his guest apartment is extremely nice and within walking distance of our family that lives in Portage Park.  the nearest comparable hotel would be 30 minutes away.
Milan’s time to respond to questions was very fast, check in and check out was seamless, indoor parking was a great feature.

We have stayed at Vairrun’s place a few times now.
It has everything we need, and the neighborhood is good for walking our dogs. The first time we stayed, we thought the stairs might be a problem, but it was fine.
The location is also excellent - close to Hyde Park.
Mitesh is a great host.  Very accommodating and responsive.  This is my "go to" Airbnb unit whenever we come to town to visit our son and family.

The space was fair for the cost. When we booked, we didn’t realize there was an upstairs tenant, but it wasn’t a major issue. The area was good, and the drive downtown didn't take long. Also, there’s a great golf course nearby. There was plenty of room for our group, too. If you’re looking for a large, affordable place to stay in Chicago, this spot will do the job.
This place was absolutely perfect for what we needed. Very close to McCormick Place for my son's volleyball tournament and plenty of things to do around here as well.

Great location for attending volleyball tournament at McCormick Place. Quick 5-10 minute drive without any traffic congestion. Train noise did not bother us at all and is mostly heard in the kitchen not in the bedrooms.
Host left a bottle of wine a freshly ground coffee for us. Regular communication throughout the stay to check-in.
We left an item behind and host agreed to ship it to us.

The places is pretty, clean, great layout and views even better than pictures.  You can see lake Michigan in the distance and it's quite special.   Location is away from the buzzing downtown but walkable or easy bus or uber ride.  Great steakhouse just next door, and across an excellent Japanese, a good Italian pub, and a convenience store!  It gets a 4 star for me for three reasons: 1) the fob key - needed for the elevator to go up doesn't work - the doorman and doorwomen were always super friendly and willing to press the elevator to go up for us, but the instructions is not to ask anything from the doorman, we always had to as I got no response from host about getting a working fob key; 2) the beds have a memory foam mattress - I felt my side of the bed would sink in the middle, my son felt the same on his bed - my husband was fine, so might be personal preference, 3) two of the dinning chairs were very ripped - doesn't match the luxury (and price) proposition of the place.

Great location for our weekend tournament at McCormick Place.  Very easy to get to/from with an Uber.  Always found parking in front of home when we needed it.  Brian was a super nice guy - helpful and anticipatory.  Highly recommend a stay at his place!

Our long weekend stay was everything we hoped for.  Very clean, very spacious and perfect location in Logan Square.  Incredibly easy access to the blue line L train, which provided great transit located between OHare and downtown.

My wife and I wanted to explore Wicker Park for the weekend, and this was a great and affordable option to do so while still being in walking distance.
Overall, it was a good spot, and we’d book again. However two things were slightly disappointing:
1. There was only tap water to drink. There wasn’t a Brita or similar. There was just a pitcher of water with no lid in the fridge. The tap was decent but a brita or similar would have been nice.
2. The sheet was not big enough for the bed. They got an extra tall mattress which was super comfortable, but the sheet was designed for a regular height mattress. It kept coming off while sleeping and we’d wake up on the mattress itself. Which is kind of gross.
But these were two minor things and I expect them to fix them. It was clean, comfortable, and a great location. They were also great to communicate with for a flexible check in option.

Its a very nice spot to stay, there was a noise later at night that sounded like moving furniture but we still eventually fell asleep. The actual neighbor doesn’t feel the safest if you were by yourself but besides that everything was great!

We have stayed here before - it is a convenient location in Edgewater. Walkable to lake front parks, L
Station, local stores and restaurants.
Easy to get in and out. We did not need a car - took L from OHare to the apartment. And took L down to the loop for game at Soldier Field and museums.
An amazing stay with the most amazing host! The location is lovely and the space is so cozy. Wish I had more time to stay longer, 10/10 recommend.

This BnB was even more beautiful than the pics and loved the vibes and decor. Everything you need in the kitchen and bathroom. Cozy and clean and love those catssss. Almost took one home with me. Esmirna was extremely hospitable, sweet and communicative. Highly recommend. Homey, vibey, comfy and cat-tastic!
I really enjoyed being there with my family! I highly recommend it

this is a fantastic place to stay well visiting in Chicago. very spacious and clean and well appointed.
Light and cheery, despite being a basement apartment. The outdoor area was a plus, since we had nice weather.
Lugar espacioso. Cómodo. Barrio tranquilo. Recomendable.
Ben is a gracious host who responds to concerns quickly and professionally even in the wee hours.
It’s okay for the price. The house is clean and calm. The neighborhood is Slightly dangerous.

What they mean by sunny is that no windows have curtains, multiple windows have nothing at all. You will need earplugs and an eye mask - I can not street this enuf
-mildewy towels
-blankets missing from beds
-clean towels and blankets not brought to the apartment until the second day
-at one point the owner disabled my key code and I was locked out of the rental
-upstairs “room”: full bed but slanted ceiling makes it a bed for 1
-great location
-good communication
-cute place
Doesn’t seem to be able to keep up with basic quality control
We had a great stay, house was very comfortable and close to all things Lincoln Park. We will be back!

The place was very cute. Has a little back porch area off the back. The bedrooms are spacious, the kitchen was well stocked with appliances. The shower had good pressure and the home heating worked very well.
If you forget anything there is a CVS and a target within walking distance, and several cafés. I recommend Scarfuri bakery. Excellent coffee and pastries.
The host is extremely responsive and proactive when messaging.
I feel like the neighborhood is clean and usually quite safe. Though we had the unfortunate experience of there being a drive by shooting two blocks down while we were walking near there. This is just the nature of a lot of people in a city, not the fault of the location. So just be mindful when out and about. We did walk all the way to Thalia hall at 9 pm and back at 3 am and we're not bothered by anyone.
It is a nice little apartment, with double set of locking doors, and we felt safe and cozy.
We have stayed with Milan previously and once again, his property did not disappoint. Clean and spacious. Great location if you need to be by McCormick. Highly recommend
Great location and easy check in. Lovely staff

The entire building appears to be rental units. The units were nice. I wish there were some more horizontal storage for our things. An extra shelf or cabinet to put my things on or in as opposed to living out of my suitcase. Milan reached out multiple times and was very helpful addressing issues and in and out of the building.
Overall well maintained and clean units that were perfect for our needs traveling to McCormick center but also easy access to Navy Pier.
Nice and easy stay with good access to the BLUE line to get in and out of downtown.

Cons-not many towels, blankets were minimal, no dishes, no cups, no silverware, TV but not hooked up to anything(I bought a Roku and used it), the beds are extremely uncomfortable (hard as a rock)
Pro-felt safe, many bedrooms, not a lot of clutter, quick responses, got to park in a garage
Very clean house and great communication from hosts. Would definitely stay there again!

Beautiful 2-story apartment in a quiet location. Apartment is lovely and like pictures on listing. Easy walk to great bars, shops and restaurants locally or 15 min walk to train station to get downtown or to the airport. Aaron is an extremely helpful and responsive host. Highly recommend.
The stay was great and Lois was very kind and knowledgeable. Would love to book with her again!

My stay at Irena's place was fantastic! It's a charming, clean, private space—had everything I needed, including in the kitchen for cooking and food prep for my work week on site in Chicago. The neighborhood is lovely, walkable, and very close to public transit. I enjoyed a run each morning on the 606/Bloomingdale trail a block away. Highly recommended, especially if you'll be out and about alot in Chicago and need a cozy space with all the basics, and a responsive host.
5 Stars, great for a family group, plenty of room, well presented, clean. Would stay at this property again.
The home was beautiful and comfortable. It was well furnished and very spacious. Definitely a plus having a garage to park in.

My stay was absolutely wonderful! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in super easy. I especially appreciated the small touches—fresh towels, local recommendations, and how quiet and comfortable the space felt. It was the perfect home away from home. I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Le logement etait propre avec toutes les commodités, une station de velo proche permet de louer un velo electrique facilement, les lignes de bus sont proches...
Le quartier etait tranquille.

This was our second visit to Paul's airbnb. It is on charming and tree lined street in Chicago. The neighborhood is very quiet. Great restaurants are only 3-4 blocks away. The airbnb is listed  as "charming and cozy" and it is! It has more bath towels then in other airbnb we have stayed in. We enjoyed the vanilla macadamia flavored coffee offered  along with regular coffee. Will definitely consider another stay.
Everything was great with our stay. We appreciate being about to walk to watch our volleyball tournaments.

The place was amazing — spacious, comfortable, and the beds were perfect! The directions and accessibility were super easy, which made check-in a breeze. The only small downside was that the shower could use a bit of maintenance, and it can be a little noisy due to the location. Overall, I’d definitely stay here again!
Very welcoming home ! Thank you for everything!
Fed's place was so beautiful and convenient to lots to do around the loop.  It's very walkable to my things around Chicago.  Hope to visit again very soon.

I traveled with two friends age 67 and 80 for a once in a lifetime chance to watch rugby in Chicago. We found this Airbnb perfect for our stay. This Airbnb is a standard apartment with no fancy bells and whistles but was very clean and has a beautiful kitchen and nice sitting area.
It is relatively quiet for a city because it is pushed back from the street, and had several bars and restaurants in an easily walkable distance. The Belmont bus picks up directly in front of the apartment which makes travel very easy by public transit.
Art was quick, polite and responsive to all inquiries. Thanks Art!

Milan has excellent customer service skills.
He is very quick to respond to your questions and concerns.
Ann was super responsive, the place was great and an awesome location for walking to town! Would love to stay again our next time in Chicago!

Tejal’s place was perfect for the weekend stay and she was super friendly. She was very responsive and accommodating for the things we needed. Check in and check out instructions were very clear. She provided a lot of information up front which helped us set expectations before arriving. The only downfall was that my mom was older and had a little trouble with the stairs leading to her place but Tejal warned us about them before check in.

Angela’s space was exactly as it was listed, actually better. The space itself is beautiful, roomy and nestled in a really great neighborhood.
The space is lovely. Décor is great, tv if you wanna watch something, amazing kitchen with farmhouse sink and butchers island in the middle. Nice comfy bed and if you have children a room with a crib.
Angela was a perfect host. Let me know up front about the quiet hours, which was no problem for us. Also, super communicative and accommodating - quick to message back and assist us.
Definitely would recommend, and would love to stay here whenever I’m visiting chicago. Top tier listing and host.

Jason was the perfect the host, responsive at all points and genuinely lovely when we met in person. Highly recommend the neighbourhood where his place is, many great restaurants and bars. Away from the main city but so accessible via the L Train that’s less than 5 minute walk away. Would highly recommend staying here.

Excellent host! Directions to get in were very informative and easy and host was quick to respond and very helpful. The place was great for our little group! Diana was also a gracious host who helped us feel at home, offering local recommendations and coordinating with the neihhbors for us to make sure our dogs would not be a problem. We would love to come back for a longer stay the next time we're in Chicago!
Beautiful space! The area is also quiet and calm! Good location, lots of restaurants in the area. It’s more spacious in person versus seeing photos! Would definitely come back!
Great stay and Hatice responded to my questions/request very quickly!
Solid stay, easy check-in, great location. Plenty within walking distance. Bare bones room, but was as advertised with all the necessary amenities. Definitely a comfortable stay.
Enjoyed our experience! Very clean, spacious and great views - very walkable to metro and grocery stories/food. Would recommend!
This was a convenient location for our stay. It was a cozy space, just enough for two.

We were in a pinch! The king bed downstairs was not very comfortable to me and my back hurt every morning but I still was able to sleep. The floors are creaky so beware. We were a family of 6 and we never felt crowded. Never heard anything outside when I was inside other than creaky floors. I’d stay again and thank you for saving my weekend with the wedding!!

My stay was wonderful! This was my second time staying with Tracy, and she was just as friendly and helpful as last time. The space is wonderful, very clean and comfortable. I highly recommend staying here if you are looking for a place near Chicago in Roger’s Park!

I sent Alonzo a separate note.  Some small, inexpensive tweaks would easily make this home a 5 star stay.  I felt safe the entire time, and the neighborhood was VERY quiet.  I slept like a log. Thank you for the hospitality, Alonzo.  I would recommend this home to anyone looking for a place that is convenient to Un. of Chicago Medical Center, the University, Museum of Science and Industry of O'Bama Library.  Parking on the street was free, safe and easy, which is difficult to find in any big city.  Thanks again.
I had a goood stay and I found myself very comfortable with the setting and it is in a nice location that is walkable to thinsg someone might need if you staying for an extended period of time.

My girlfriend and I had a great stay at Maria's airbnb. She was very responsive to any questions we had.  We did have a small request that she went above and beyond to satisfy. It was just what I needed and everything was very clearly communicated. Had a great stay!

Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and had all the essentials we needed. It’s in a quiet neighborhood within walking distance of the metro, which made getting around easy. Roberto was very accommodating with our early check-in and communication was smooth. Highly recommend staying here!
Place was looked great! Extremely spacious and looked clean. Only on one of our days was a bit noisy at night but other than that great stay! This place is at a great location!

Cedric is a great host and I appreciate how easy he was to communicate with during my stay. The place was clean, quiet and I was very grateful for the private parking. Another big plus was being close to downtown. Would definitely consider staying here again!

Very safe and comfortable apartment. Charles and Erin provided clear instructions and helpful neighborhood advice. We have family nearby making the location perfect for us. We wouldn’t hesitate to return.

We had a great stay here in a great city.  The flat is located in a gentrifying neighborhood not far from the downtown area with easy access to freeways. Overall, I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking to explore or stay in the Chicago area.

This place was exactly what we needed. A hidden gem of a location. The room was just like the pictures and had even more amenities than you could ask for. Charles was a perfect host. He was attentive without ever being in the way. He was accommodating when we arrived earlier than check-in and he still allowed us to get in before our scheduled time. It was exactly what I needed for the weekend !

Eric
We really enjoyed the house. Great layout for a small group with the three bedrooms. We got lucky and were able to enjoy the rooftop deck even though it is getting late in the fall. Great location with coffee shops and restaurants within walking distance. I would add that the Salt Shed is close either a 15 minute walk or quick uber. I always enjoy a stay here. Great neighborhood! Quiet!

We have stayed in more than a few AirBnbs and sometimes, the product over promises and under delivers. This one did not! The pictures were absolutely accurate. Tea kettle with a variety of teas? Check! Washer and dryer readily available? Check!  And, clean! We have never stayed in a cleaner AirBnb! The variety of restaurants is terrific; the neighborhood is very walkable (a PLUS) anad Chicago's Redline (the EL) is less than 3/4 mile away - so you can go virtually ANYWHERE in Chi-town. My only hesitancy in rating 5-stars is that this location will become so popular, we have a difficult time getting a future reservation!

The Broasis was a good spot for our group. Enough bedrooms for folks. Location was good if you want to be north of downtown. The pictures were accurate. I will say you if you are downstairs you can hear every single step people take upstairs. For us that was fine. We had ear plugs and such. It is luxurious and it is comfortable and functional.

This is a great airbnb, however do note that the neighborhood can be very noisy and somewhat unsafe. Everything else was great.

Angelica’s stay was everything we had hoped for and she was very quick and responsive. We also appreciated how close it was to the CTA blue line. It made traveling to and from the city so easy. We’d love to stay here again if we’re ever back in the Chicago area.

Great location, host and just vibe. It’s located in a beautiful area with thriving culture and it bleeds into the Airbnb itself. It’s an easy 30 minute bus ride to Navy Pier, it’s just the perfect spot

Cynthia’s place was a wonderful spot for us to stay for a reunion weekend. She was very sweet the place looks just like the pictures would definitely stay again.
Alex is a great host. The property is very well maintained. We had a great weekend in Chicago thanks to Alex too.

I was in town for an induction ceremony.  The location stay was literally in walking distance.  Parking was on the street and easily accessible various times of the day. The fridge was stocked with light bites, coffee etc.  The neighborhood was walkable with parks in walking distance.  Downtown was 8 minutes by car.  I'm looking forward to returning next year.

Overall our group had a great stay here! It’s definitely a bang for your buck in terms of large group housing in the area, this unit was much more affordable than others. The unit itself has its quirks but it slept our group of 6-7 comfortably, was very clean, and had a nice back porch area.
Pros:
- Host was very responsive, friendly, and understanding
- They don’t require you to clean the unit or do any chores before leaving (many Airbnbs now ask for cleaning fee and expect you to do light cleaning)
- Super fun area
Cons
- it’s hard to tell exactly what the room arrangements look like based on the listing (one room is a large closet with a bed - no windows. One room had a medium-sized hole in the wall - maybe a previous vent?)
- The thermostat in the unit controls the entire building, so they asked us to keep it at 74°, which got very hot in most rooms with no way to open windows. **MJ was flexible when we asked to keep it at 71°!
- Shoes off rule, but understandable

Amy's place was great! The location was perfect and close to a lot of the things we were in Pilsen for. The room was exactly as pictured/described and very clean.  Amy was very responsive with any questions we had and a great communicator. We would stay here again!
This was a great Airbnb and Otto is an amazing host. We enjoyed our time in his place and would recommend for anyone who is staying in Chicago for the weekend or a few days!

Jamie was always available and provided me with excellent support.

Great home base for visiting a friend in the neighborhood. Had everything I needed to feel right at home. Would be happy to stay here again next time I’m in town!
Cie's home was as described, very spacious and peaceful.  The deck and fire table were very nice. My family and I would stay there again when visiting Chicago.

Please note that the two beds are doubles (full size) and not Queens like I thought. The description is right, so that was my bad. The room is walkable to various locations downtown and there are some great restaurants nearby as well. The room was older and some of the reading lights didn't work, but for a quick stay, this is an adequate hotel and location.
Great place and host

Nice clean apartment and walkable place to salvage one, but not great for kids.
There were lots of safety hazards for our two girls. The stairs leading up to the apartment are uneven and tight without proper railings, making it a struggle even for fit adults to carry up a toddler, luggage, and a stroller. The bunk bed set has a mattress on the top bunk that is much too thick, making it so there is no railing, a huge safety problem even for our older daughter. Several of the pieces of furniture were tipping hazards, we had a few very close calls with our toddler.
We struggled to sleep in the upstairs bedroom, as it was very bright and loud since it faced Ashland Ave. It also got very hot every time the heat came on. Some fiddling with the thermostat didn’t really help as it made the downstairs too chilly for our girls. Also the stairs up to the bedroom are slippery and very very steep. This bedroom would benefit from light blocking shades and a window ac unit or fan.
This is a lovely flat in what seemed like a safe neighborhood. My favorite part was the porch/deck in the back. I wish we had had more time to enjoy it!
It was a good stay, comfortable arrival and stay, responds quickly and addresses any problems

The only thing I didn't like was the 10AM checkout, which seems early, especially for the area, but that's the hosts' call! Overall a great home base for exploring the neighborhood!

Our overall experience was great. The neighborhood was very walkable and close to public transit. There were plenty of parking options, including a private lot that we coordinated through the host. The only downside was some street noise -- there was as concert at WinTrust Arena on the Saturday night we stayed which resulted in a lot of street/pedestrian traffic. The rest of the time it was typical neighborhood noise. Thanks for a great stay, Milan!
Great host, easy communication and proactive information. Thanks!

Rains space was nice. Location is walkable to restaurants and shopping. It’s a very comfortable space and the steam shower was great at the end of the day. Bed and bedding were so comfortable. Will definitely stay again.

The host was very responsive. However, the place was located across the street from a club. There would be people screaming, cars revving, and police presence from ~2-5am Friday and Saturday which made it really difficult to sleep. It would be perfect if we went to the club!

Stay with Ann to be in the midst of wonderful neighborhoods with remarkably easy access via the Blue Line. Want to hit Fulton Market or downtown? You can see the Western stop from the front door - 3 minute walk and you're on your way! Like to jog? The 606 is right outside of your door! It's truly a great location!
The property itself is clean, spacious, comfortable, and cute! While we didn't have time to enjoy the back decks, there were amazing space! Sleeping was comfy - just light traffic noise and every so often a soft, little woosh of the L (it's the heartbeat of Chicago - you can't not love it).
Ann was an amazing host, helping us before the visit with questions, and following up both during and after. She was incredibly accommodating & sweet!
& grab brekkie @ Le Cafe Station Grill! Yummy!

Place looked just like the pictures. Very clean and comfortable. Hosts made sure to provide a list of useful recommendation. Felt very comfortable and private.

The outside entrance is very neat and clean with a brand new pleasant sidewalk along the side of the house leading to the lower level entrance door. We love nature and really enjoyed walking to the nature area just across the road, and walking on some lovely woodsy trails. We would definitely stay here again!
Great location, nice place, helpful host!

Clean and quiet! Great stay!

Everything positive. But one thing which I would suggest Ron is to look at the usage of the cookware which are present and seem to be very dated and needs replacement. But the crockery was good and no complains.
Great stay and responsive host! Really helpful throughout the stay and wonderful place. Would definitely visit again :)

Easy access, quiet. Milan was very responsive. I had lots of questions and he answered all my questions in a timely manner. My kids were delighted with our stay. It's at a walking distance from all the stores.

Lee was always quick to respond to any questions and the place was super cute and clean. Perfect for myself and girlfriends for a quick weekend visit.

The surrounding area is very safe, with few pedestrians wandering around. As a girl, when I come back from campus at night, I can take the school’s RideSmart service directly to the door— it’s really safe.​
