Overall, the stay was fine, but there were several important issues future guests should be aware of.
The space is not a full private home as the listing suggests — it’s actually a duplex, with the owner or another tenant living upstairs. This setup creates a non-private experience, which should be clearly stated in the listing.
I reached out to the host before check-in and again during the stay but never received a response, which made it difficult to address concerns in real time.
Inside, some outlets and lights flicker or appear to charge below standard 110V, and overall, the finishes are of lower quality than expected for the price. The backyard had noticeable trash, and the neighborhood unfortunately feels unsafe, with visible crime and poor upkeep in the surrounding area.
The host experience itself wasn’t bad, but communication and listing accuracy need major improvement. The property should be clearly identified as a duplex and the location expectations set honestly so guest
Would definitely recommend! Host was amazing and very responsive

Michelle was an amazing host, very nice and helpful. The location wasn’t the best, a little far south for our liking but other than that the stay was great! Street parking available. Neighborhood was quiet, no issues during our stay.

Family and I had a wonderful stay! The home was very clean, cozy, and had everything I needed. It’s in a great location — just a short walk to the train and close to a nice coffee shop. The host was extremely responsive and made sure I felt comfortable throughout my stay. I truly felt at home and safe here. Would definitely stay again!

We had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a really convenient location — close to both the family we were visiting and downtown Chicago, which made it easy to get around and explore. Having a parking spot right in the driveway was a huge plus and made coming and going super easy. Check-in and communication were smooth, and everything went as expected. Would definitely recommend!

We very much enjoyed our stay. The location is perfect. Walkable to a lot and close to public transit if needed. The place was clean and as described. Worked perfectly for our family’s visit. Pratik was great at communicating and kindly checked in on us after we arrived via a message. Highly recommend staying here!
Honestly the only complain I have is about the noise in the morning, but everything about the stay was lovely.
I will love to rent this place again we love it. Everything was great you no complaint.

Tuve una buena experiencia en este alojamiento. El anfitrión fue muy proactivo y siempre estuvo disponible para resolver cualquier inconveniente rápidamente, lo cual agradezco mucho. La comunicación fue clara, ágil y constante, lo que hizo que todo el proceso fuera muy fácil.
El lugar es tranquilo, ideal para descansar, se encontraba impecablemente limpio a mi llegada. Bastante accesible, tanto en ubicación como en comodidades.
The place was amazing!! Very kind hosts and clean rooms!!!!

This was a fantastic stay in an awesome neighborhood. There was plenty of room to accommodate our larger party and we had a wonderful time. Huge shoutout to Josh and his cohosts! We will certainly be returning to Chicago
Flora was a great host and I will definitely be back next time I’m in the area. Good spot suitable for short to medium stay. Plenty of common space to stretch out a bit and fast wifi everywhere.
Great accommodation, fantastic support, easy access, highly recommended.
Lovely gem in Chicago. Quaint and private, beautiful neighborhood. 15-25 minutes away from all the neighborhoods in downtown Chicago. Would return here again.

This apartment was very nice and located next to a few cool neighborhoods of Chicago outside of the expected downtown. It’s next to a street of Vietnamese stores and restaurants, and within a 10 minute walk from Andersonville. The apartment itself was comfortable, in an old building with decent renovations. It was in a very large building and in front of the building homeless people would occasionally set up shop, and in one case I saw someone urinating at 10am! So that made it a bit scary to come inside especially for a single woman, which required the use of a few keys. The apartment had kitchen things like spices but no tea or coffee which would have been nice. The shower was good but it leaked a lot onto the floor so you have to be careful to put down extra towels and mat in that area.
Suggestions to improve - leave some tea or coffee for guests, call police to try to dissuade the homeless from the stoop of the building, provide extra shower towels and warn guests about shower.

This was a great stay for a couple nights! It is perfect for a weekend trip to the city.
Pros: Clean, soft and comfortable bed and comforter, towels available, secure and peaceful neighborhood and building, water pitcher and ice in the fridge/freezer, basic kitchen necessities for cooking, and nearby parking lots you can rent. I had some trouble unlocking the door, however host responded fast and with clear instructions!
Cons: Wifi listed was not found, no microwave, and was stated that late check out at 3pm instead of 11am was a $50 fee but I was charged $133 - was resolved by Airbnb Support.
Albeit the cons, I would still recommend to anyone who is looking for a short comfortable stay!
amazing , thank you bella!

Jacqueline was a wonderful hostess! She had so many great recommendations in and around town, we just wish we had more than a long weekend to explore more of her options. We really lucked out with the weather and even though rain was expected daily, each day cleared up for us. The apartment is a true gem, friendly neighbors and we all felt like we could live here! It is a very spacious place yet ultra cozy at the same time. The kitchen is amazing as well as the views from the rooftop! We hope to visit again and this place will be at the top of our list! Five Stars Plus in hospitality and amenities! Thank you for a fantastic time!
Great place in a perfect location
I wish it was more reasonable.

Maybe I'm just not an air bnb girly, but our sheets weren't hotel standard clean. There were some stains on them as well as the washcloths. There's nothing to do in the location of the air bnb but it is 4 minute walk away from the cta which is great. Also, some guest did not clean up after themselves and there was hair in the shower. Other than that the place was ok.
I enjoyed my stay here, nice neighborhood and beautiful home!
Very enjoyable and relaxing place for myself and my fellow guests. Owner was friendly, responsive, and flexible. Will recommend this Airbnb to others.

We really enjoyed our stay here. Quick and easy walk to the red line. Space was perfect for my husband and myself.  We liked having two nice TVs also.  Would definitely stay here again on future trips.
Lovely apartment. Very nice and neat
Great place to stay!
Easy to find and access, clear instructions and prompt communication. Very clean and the beds are comfortable.
Great location, quality place (very high quality furnishing…like the owners lived in the place themselves), and very responsive hosts.  Will stay there again when we get back to Chicago!
Great stay !
Go cubs
Everything was great and as advertised.  I issues checking in. Would highly recommend for a peaceful stay.
I absolutely loved staying here! The home was so clean, it smelled amazing and the natural lighting coming in from the kitchen is so beautiful and calming. David was very responsive and kind!
Great Hosts ! Easy check in, good location which had access to Subway, Chocolate for Guests and Other good drinks for guest like coffee, Clean bathroom

Overall, the condo was very nice, the building was great, and the location was fabulous—we walked everywhere. Check‑in was easy once we got the instructions. The only downside was confusing communication, almost as if the host was referencing another unit. The host kept reminding us to take a picture of the key when we checked out, but there was no key. The fridge had leftover items and the freezer contained meat and an onion. We were asked to remove the food but we couldn't because the chicken was stuck by the nasty chicken juices. Then we were even asked to unplug the fridge so the freezer would defrost. This felt like an odd request and we were not comfortable doing that. Despite that, the unit itself and the location made for a great stay.
House was clean, great location. Tameka was a wonderful host.
We had a lovely stay here, great location, and a very spacious and inviting place to stay in. Hosts are very responsive and nice.

The space was comfortable and what I expected based on the description. The hosts were helpful and responsive. The shower head pressure was low. We let the hosts know and they are planning on addressing the issue. Overall, we enjoyed our stay

Great location in a wonderful neighborhood!
Comfortable bedroom. Kitchen and bathrooms were well equipped. Guest Netflix account is a nice touch!
Cozy, spacious, and perfectly located - this was the perfect place for a solo retreat to Chicago!
2nd time staying and will definitely stay again
Darren's place is great for a short stay in Logan Square. Comfortable and very conveniently located!

Our stay at Tori's place was excellent!
You can tell she put a lot of work into the remodel and everything was so cute & cozy! Exactly what I want from an Airbnb. Everything was very clean and well taken care of. The beds were very comfortable as was the living room furniture. We brought our dog and it worked out great with the fenced in grassy space to the side of the house. There is a big park with a smaller dog park just a couple blocks away. While we didn't do any cooking, Tori had the kitchen well stocked with everything you need to do so. The kitchen was spacious & functional. We enjoyed the front balcony/deck as well - a great place to enjoy coffee in the morning! The neighborhood felt very safe and friendly, there were always lots of folks out walking their dogs and parking was always available.
Tori was very responsive and ready to help with anything and everything we needed. We did run into some chilly/rainyweather and she even reached out offering items to keep us warm!
The stay was pleasant and had a great time. Everything was clean and as described in the pictures.

Our stay at Daniel’s condo was fantastic!
From the moment we arrived, Daniel was incredibly kind and attentive. He even left some water and fresh fruit to welcome us, and made everything easy — from check-in to great recommendations for local restaurants. The condo had everything we needed, was spotless, and located in a quiet, safe area.
The location is perfect: easy to walk to many places or get anywhere quickly by public transportation, and there’s also a supermarket just around the corner.
Daniel was always quick to reply and very kind whenever we messaged him, and he even had another thoughtful gesture when we left. We truly appreciated all his attention and care during our stay. We’d definitely love to come back if it’s available next time we’re in Chicago!

The place was gorgeous overall. Bedroom 1, kitchen, bathrooms and common space were exceptional. The linens however for bed 2 & 3 did not fit. Bed 2 and futon sofa weren’t comfortable. Inflatable provided but suitable linens not provided. Very nice welcome basket provided.
Issue with HVAC system.
We had a great time at Alma’s place. It was as advertised and had plenty of space for the 6 of us. Alma gave us a restaurant recommendation that was wonderful! We had a great time!
Fantastic place to stay near UChicago, beautiful home and very helpful and responsive hosts.

Nicole was a wonderful and responsive host, even letting us check in early. The house was spotless and spacious, with plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms for everyone to feel comfortable. The kitchen and backyard were perfect for gathering, and my grandsons loved the swings, slide, and basketball court. The neighborhood was peaceful but close to everything we needed, incluing the beach. It truly felt like a home away from home! And I would rent from her again.

Beautiful space, as described. If you don’t need to be in the city, this is a great location next to the lake - you can’t beat that. Tammy was helpful and friendly. Although short, I really enjoyed my stay.
Good stay. The place was quiet and clean. Would definitely book again
Everything was superb! Would definitely make it my first choice for any future visit.

Fue una estancia agradable, el lugar es muy acogedor y se siente uno como en casa. Hay opciones cercanas para comer y transporte accesible. Pasé unos días maravillosos antes de llevar al aeropuerto a mi mamá 😊
Great location and neighborhood, The space was just like described. Would definitely book again when visiting Chicago.
Shontes place was awesome for our group of 5.  Easy getting in and out and never had any issues with parking.  Plus its close to green line station to get back and forth to downtown.

Tram is an absolute joy! First day of traveling it was difficult to find a good place and thankfully was able to book after 7pm. She was so sweet she even offered pizza! Any time she was needed she was respectful and responsive. So appreciate the warmth that she gives effortlessly!! Will always keep Grace Stay in mind for future visits! Thanks Tram
Great, convenient spot! Walkable. Easy access to lots of yummy treats like Boba teas, and a variety of Asian cuisines.

When I was looking for a space, I wanted it to accolade 5 adults and be close to downtown and Chinatown. This bnb hit all the criteria. It was a bit tricky sharing 1 bathroom, but it wasn’t too bad. The host is very kind and responds quickly. We had no issue checking in or out. I’d definitely stay here again when I’m in Chicago !

Very nice stay! Host was very communicative. Answered all of our questions. Kitchen was very stocked with everything that you need to cook. Decor is just like the pictures. Neighborhood is nice. really convenient to a lot of of stuff Walmart only four minutes away. Restaurants nearby. The bed was very comfortable. Would definitely stay again. 🙂

Place was clean and airy but a bit dark for my taste. Lots of interesting artwork and music. Well equipped kitchen. Nice view and access to 606 trail. There's a 4 story climb in open air staircase to apartment.  Barking dogs nearby. Not enough space to park 1 car let alone 2. But Ken supplies street parking passes.
Nice quiet neighborhood and this place was very much as described!  We enjoyed our stay!
Great location, spacious apartment in the heart of downtown, perfect for families.  You can par in Millennium garage (50% discount when booked online).
Very convenient location, perfect amount of space for a group of 4
Our group had a great time at a Bears game, our stay was a short walk away, easy to get to, and the host was very responsive.
Very good apartment with great location, Rain was very friendly in her responses. Excellent place.

The area was very quite and calm. CTA buses run very frequently, the stop is located 50 meters from the porch of the house. I had everything I needed in the house: a bedroom, a bathroom, a kitchen. Myrtle and her family are very kind and good people. My first experience with Chicago was wonderful and I hope to come back!

We had a wonderful time; super comfortable beds, and quiet surroundings so we got a good night sleep and were walking distance from great coffee shops, restaurants and public transportation. Would definitely stay here again!
great price
Asif was great, nice place
The place was very clean and really nice overall
The room was as described. Hosts were very gentle. A quiet place. Excellent location, walking distance to the Metro station.
súper recomendado para los que vayan a correr la maratón , excelente acceso a la línea azul , privacidad , lugar acogedor y el anfitrión siempre dispuesto a atender los requerimientos que tuvimos .

We had a nice stay at Tejal's place. Tejal was always very responsive. The condo is clean and beatiful with large windows to see the sky and the highway. There are nice restaurants and an Italian baker near by. 10 minutes walk to Blue train. If you drive from out of town, parking around the apartment is challenging.

Stay here a lot.  It is always good value for money.  They do a good job keeping things clean and making sure stuff works and responding to questions.  If the location works for you, it is recommended.
10/10 stay!! Loved it for us and our dogs. Large space, well accommodating, and very much felt safe the entire trip. Guaranteed we will stay again on our next trip!
Andy was a great host! He was always available when needed and responded to my questions quickly.
Perfect location, great host, great place. Thank you!

Rida was very efficient in receiving and confirming all of the proper information for my reservation in time. Prior to arrival she was in touch with me every step to ensure I got access to the place and even when I had trouble late at night with my arrival she was immediately responsive in making sure I got in safe (helps feel safe when you are traveling alone) the apartment is very cute and cozy within walking distance of many restaurants and stores, no need to drive everywhere. The place was clean with large windows and made me feel right at home. Would book again!
When I come back to Chicago this is the only place I want to stay

Colleen and William are truly Super hosts. Prompt and responsive to any questions or asks. The suite was just as pictured, a cozy place to rest your head. The location couldn't have been better, 5 minutes to the train, 10 minutes to the lake with plenty of restaurants within a 20 minute walk. The next time I'm in Chicago I know where to stay.

Nate’s home was lovely! He was clear with instructions, plenty of parking while also being extremely responsive when needed. He also provided coffee and refreshments as well that was well needed after my late flight! Will definitely be booking in the future
Mitesh was an excellent host. Very responsive to our questions and needs. Would definitely stay at their property again. Highly recommend!

John's Airbnb was perfect for our group of 8 adults. Easy check in and easy checkout with no long list of chores required. Parking was always available right out front. John communicated prior to the arrival and right after check in to ask how check in went. And while we had no issues or reasons to reach out to him, I have no doubt he would have been quick to reply.
The house was clean and well stocked. The bed we slept in was probably the best we've slept in away from home. The primary bedroom is huge, the pictures don't show how spacious that room really is. It includes a fireplace, TV, two walk in closets, and a large bathroom. We all had a perfect stay and there were no complaints from anyone!

Jake’s place was extremely clean, beds were comfortable and the location was great for our needs. Right down the block from Chinatown Square, Walgreen’s across the street for quick shopping needs, Red line within walking distance and a beautiful park nearby with access to the Water Taxi as well. Parking space was a major bonus when driving into Chicago from out of town. Jake was very detailed in his instructions and very responsive

Great place for a couple friends and I to stay for a weekend while we were in town. We met Rachel and their dogs, all were wonderful. We come to Chicago every year, and we'll definitely keep this place in mind next year!

Jeremiah has been an amazing host, with bunch of great suggestions specially for music, street food's staples and neighborhoods to visit. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to experiment a real Chicago-ish authentic holiday. Thanks for everything it was a journey that i'm not about to forget :)
3 separate bedrooms with large beds and a comfortable couch was a great place to stay and super close to public transit

Kinda far from downtown, and the bathroom fan made an awful noise, but the space was clean. The host was very responsive to my questions and it was a nice little spot to stay. It was also reasonably priced for an airbnb in chicago.
Couldn’t have been more pleased with our stay! Perfect living conditions
The Apartment was nice and calm. Communication with the Host was great.
We had a great time fellowshipping in the residence. If you have a large group, I would recommend this place.
I thought the place was good though the instructions were unclear on how to check out

Muy buen apartamento nadie molesta , todos los vecinos que vi muy amables solo el wii fi es un poco lento , para gente que va a trabajar y necesita mucho sus laptop pero para estar en familia me agradó mucho
We loved the location to downtown and we visited Indiana… the 3 full bathrooms were very helpful and the shower upstairs in the primary room is off the hook!

We stayed at Ivan’s place while in Chicago for a wedding, and it was perfect. The place was clean, well-stocked, and exactly as described. Ivan was friendly and responsive—he even came by personally when I had a few questions, which was much appreciated. Parking instructions were clear and easy to follow, making arrival smooth. Close to grocery store and close to many parks. Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting the city!

We had a great time and loved the space! Everything you could possibly need and the beds were so comfy! It’s definitely loud above the Empty Bottle but if you are there for the show, it’s perfect especially with the free entry to the music. We will be back!

My family (3 of us including our dog) really enjoyed our stay. The place itself was beautiful and cozy. Plus it’s perfectly located near the Lincoln park zoo with a gorgeous surrounding nature path, as well as great restaurants/bars, all of which a very walkable. Emily was also very responsive which made the whole check in/out process very easy.

This was the perfect Airbnb for our girls trip!! Very roomy and had plenty of bathrooms for 6 of us! The views from the living room were amazing and it was a great location, very safe and quiet. You have to go up one small flight of stairs to get in but it wasn’t bad so be mindful if you have a lot of luggage. Would stay here again.

This was our second time staying at Junni's place. We had a great experience the first time and this trip was no different. Junni is very responsive and helpful and the house is great! We hope to stay there again and highly recommend it!

Great location and fair accommodations for the price.  The host was communicative and check-in was easy.  There were other guests in the unit at the same time, but I didn't need to interact with them and they were not noisy. The main issue was cleanliness of the unit.  Despite many signs that said "No Smoking" it definitely smelled like smoke.  All the rooms need a deep cleaning from the walls to the floor, especially the bathroom.  The bedrooms have individual padlocks on the doors, which is somewhat safe to lock your items when you're not in the room - but doesn't feel safe when you're in the room alone.  It would be better/safer if there were key pads on each room instead. I would stay again if it was cleaner!
Beautiful space, Very Clean, Comfortable, New, Short drive to Northwestern, available parking. Tracy was a great host, proactive, Friendly, easy to communicate with. Would stay again

While the place is clean, organized and fairly quiet for the location, the description and photos were significantly different from the real space.
The photos showed a space with two armchairs, a couch and a bed.
The reality - one armchair, NO COUCH, and a bed.
I would not have paid the money if I knew I am getting this space. Practice borders on deceptive.

This place was perfect for our needs. The layout is great with the living/dining areas on one end and the sleeping spaces separate. The whole place was clean and very comfortable. At first I was hesitant there would not be a lot of light but it was more than adequate. Great location, lots of restaurants, bars, grocery store, and an L stop in super close proximity. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!

Besides a small hiccup at check-in (we had a miscommunication about the unit number), we had a great experience staying here! The room was spacious, clean, and comfortable. Bella was responsive and easy to contact. The location was perfect for our needs. We were attending a concert at Vic Theatre and we rented scooters to get there and then just walked back afterward (~30 min walk). Street parking was a little tricky, but we always managed to find a space within a couple blocks of the unit. I would definitely consider staying here again.
Great spot and a great stay. Perfect for the light traveler that needs a comfy spot to land in the evenings. Would stay again.

Mr Melvin is an awesome host. Very responsive, super friendly and easy to communicate with. The house is in a nice quiet neighborhood. The pictures truly represent the house 100%. The house was super clean very spacious and is equipped with anything you would need to feel like you’re at your own home. Would highly recommend. But to me the best thing is it’s located a few min from the Harold’s Chicken on 87th.

Beautiful area close to the lake. Perfect for a couple’s getaway. Gary was super flexible with check in and check out and very quick to answer any questions I had. He has an incredible collection of literature, especially from leftist philosophers and political revolutionaries which was refreshing to see. The place was very clean and organized. Heated floors in bathroom was very nice. Will be back when we visit the city again. Thanks Gary!

Checking in to the Airbnb was quite literally a scavenger hunt that lasted up to an hour long. The check-in instructions were not up to date and were extremely misleading as the majority of the instructions were not coherent with what was at hand. We basically had to figure out our way inside the home because the instructions were not reliable/correct. If you follow the check in instructions, you will not make it inside the home. The lock in which the keys were in was not functional and did not open like a regular functioning lock would. The lock was also misplaced and not in the spot where the instructions said it would be so we had to go around trying different locks since this was not the only airbnb lock in the area. The digital lock in the back of the home also does not work so we had to figure out another way inside. Much of the information on the Airbnb posting is not updated, such as the WiFi info and the entire checking in instructions which created a major inconvenience.
Thank you so much Peter and Gwen for this experience! Cute little spot right in the middle of everything! Hosts were SUPER responsive and helpful, and I really appreciate the quick communication.

Milan as a host was very responsive and typically responded within 5-10 mins. The Airbnb was nice, provided a lot of space for the recommend amount of people. However, the elevators in the building were dirty with leaves and other debris. The hallway leading to the door of the Airbnb that had a long stain that was a very good length down the hallway. However, I did communicate to Milan that there were two very loud groups on both sides of us on Saturday night. The walls of the Airbnb seemed to be thin even across rooms in the Airbnb. I communicate about Saturday night to Milan and he was going to tell security I the building.
Milan was super responsive, Airbnb as described in the pictures but for the amount of the Airbnb I would’ve not expected the building to be more clean and for the walls to not be “paper thin.”

Eight family members and I have started an annual tradition of flying to Chicago each October to hang out for a weekend and attend a Chicago Bears game. This is our third year and counting - and each year we’ve stayed at Brian’s condo. It’s perfect for us! Soldier Field is only 2.7 miles away so we can easily walk to and from the game if we choose to. The condo is just as advertised - very clean and spacious with anything we could want for a weekend. This includes plenty of bedding, towels, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, dishes, paper towels, napkins, etc. The open kitchen/living room area is great for our family gatherings and the bedrooms are comfortable and quiet. Brian provides excellent instructions and accessing the condo is simple. There are parking accommodations if needed and plenty of restaurants within walking distance. (We really enjoy Tuscany on Taylor for great Italian food!)
We highly recommend this rental!
I enjoyed my stay here! It is a light filled space, updated and walkable to so many shops and restaurants. Thanks Tracy!
We loved it they were wonderful to work with would definitely stay here again 10 out of 10

The images in the listing are out of both date and perspective. Despite weekly cleaning of common areas (sort of), the roommates do not maintain those areas well - stuff splashed in kitchen counter/floor/sink, much hair in bath sink, trash not emptied. They also took some of my things in the fridge/freezer. The house rules clearly do not apply to these two.
The laundromat across the street is pretty good. (use the Laundrycat app to pay for the washers) The internet is good - fridge is pretty gross - bed is comfortable - you'll have to put the sheets on yourself. Nevertheless, I needed to extend and the response was "Currently, we're prioritizing 12-month commitments, so unfortunately..."
If something needs doing, the host will ask you to do it first.
Two days before checking out, someone left a skillet on the stove on high heat for over an hour. I finally turned it off and notified the hosts. The pan is completely burned, the house smells of it. That's dangerous, and glad I'm leaving
Location is great. Looks like the photos. Typical older building in Chicago, you will hear the upstairs neighbor walking around.

We had a great stay! Gregory and Hannah were very helpful and responsive. The place was great! Very good location and close to restaurants and services . The beds were comfortable and we had everything we needed. I would stay there again! Thank you!
The condo was great!  It's a little far from downtown but for the price,  it's worth the commute.

Benjamin is a very nice man. Very responsive and helpful. Went out of his way for us.
The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful. Safe. If looking for hip/young nightlife maybe not your area. However, close to all transportation to get anywhere. Enjoyed our stay , his hosting and the area.

Jorge Airbnb was wonderful not only is place is great spot not to far from downtown Chicago but the host was extremely friendly. We will definitely be booking again; my friends and I have already planned to come back in the summer. The Airbnb is so clean and very secure too, the host leaves a binder of the information for Airbnb and suggests restaurants in the area which is lovely and really enjoy.

7 porch steps to entrance with no handrail. 3 keys needed to get in, none of them labeled. Light switches on stair to 2nd floor missing cover plates - be careful feeling around for them. Uncomfortable modular sofa with no end or coffee tables. Cramped bedroom, queen bed with headboard along side, thin poly/cotton sheets and twin sized blanket. 2 child's beds in second bedroom with 3" thick mattresses. Water lukewarm in second bath shower. Apt is def not 2200 sq ft.
Window A/C blasting at check-in, indoor temp in 60's. Host never responded to questions about heat thermostat. Indoor temps in 60's again third morning, no heat. Host provided wrong WiFi info at check-in, wasting about ten minutes of my time. Host provided one full and about 1/8 roll of toilet paper for two guests and two bathrooms, never sent more when notified. Dollar signs in WiFi password may be all this host is about - cost for two guests exceeded $400/night. For that price I expect the basics of a hotel quality stay.

I would avoid this place. For $200+/night, it has these problems:
• No hot water. Every time I showered the water went cold after about 3 minutes.
• Broken pullout bed. There were instructions saying not to use it. The listing says 4 beds, there are really only 2.
• Doors that don't properly lock. The deadbolt for the unit doesn't line up. The exterior building door gets stuck.
• No furniture or decor. No night stands in the bedroom, so all your stuff is on the floor. There aren't even toilet paper holders in the bathroom.
• No curtains over the back door. Anyone outside can see right into your bedroom unless you close the door.
• Body wash in the shower had been refilled with water. How cheap can you possibly be?
I messaged Patricia about these issues and she was apologetic, but it was clear she had no idea what the condition of the unit was. She has 27 listings on Airbnb. This place is a cheap flip and it shows. She sent me a refund of only $100 after we paid $1,200+ to stay there.

We will stay here again. Can’t beat the location. Close to buses, el. Ravenswood neighborhood on the edge of Lincoln Square neighborhood, so lots of cafes, restaurants, shops. Groceries at Genes in Lincoln Square (10 min walk) and Mariano’s on Lawrence (20 min walk)
Large apt, big kitchen with good quality cookware. Good flow in shower and plenty of hot water. Very homey, comfortable furniture, lots of books for kids and adults. Good wifi signal.
We did not drive on this trip but I noticed there was always plenty of street parking close by (I’ve lived in Chicago and it’s a much better parking sitch than in other neighborhoods).
The Borellis are excellent hosts. Check out their pizza place on Lawrence ! Good pizza, live music.

Excelente lugar para hospedarse, la ubicación perfecta, muy cerca de paradas de autobús y la blue line del metro, la casa estaba limpia, tuvimos otros compañeros durante la estancia, pero todos fueron amables y respetuosos, no tuvimos ningún problema con la organización de la cocina o el baño.
Bares y restaurantes cerca, el ambiente en la zona se siente muy tranquilo incluso de noche.
Las instrucciones de Roseanna fueron claras y precisas, y aunque no tuvimos que comunicarnos por ninguna razón siempre estuvo al pendiente.

Larissa has created a personal sanctuary in Lincoln Park, which she shares with her guests. The guest room is comfortable and I slept well every night. She provides light fare for breakfast, should you need it, including peanut butter, jam, bread, teas, coffee, and filtered+purified water. There are also plenty of stores, restaurants, coffee shops, and bars within walking distance — some even just around the corner. Get ready for bird song, sunrise contemplation on the back deck, and tail wags from Amy, her shy but sweet rescue doggo.
Beautiful windows and light in this apartment. Very responsive host!

We missed a few things on the room, like proper blinds (we had an improvised curtain that didn't block all the light and we preferred not to move much to not make it fall) and a light that could reach all the room, as we only had a small nightstand for the room and it was dark at night.
For the bathroom, there were some stains on the bathtub.
Overall, the smell in the house was strong .
i had a smooth time and everything was comfortable!
I recommend here

The hosts are super responsive and helpful. This included responding to a few issues we had on our first day. They shared great advice about great local places to visit and were thoughtful about our reason for staying which was the Chicago marathon.
The Airbnb is close to a road, however, we were pleasantly surprised at how quiet it is in the bedroom at night.
If we visit Chicago again we’d definitely stay again.

This house has a great location. It is situated in a peaceful neighborhood and it is close to cafes, restaurants, shops and grocery stores - all within walking distance. Mike is a great host who is very responsive and communicates promptly. The house is very comfortable and we enjoyed our stay
Was very comfortable, clean, amenities all included in the apartment and location was great. It was a pleasure to stay in Maria’s Airbnb and would stay there again!

We had a lovely time at Rochelle’s hideaway, the place was huge and had everything we needed. The location was good in terms of driving, little more difficult to get into the city with the frequency of trains but the drive is only 20 mins so for the price more than doable
Great apartment and location, and lovely host! :)

Jason was an incredible host — so kind, responsive, and thoughtful throughout our stay. His apartment was in a perfect location, close to so many great restaurants and shops. He went above and beyond to make my family feel comfortable, especially while my sister was recovering from eye surgery. We truly appreciated his kindness and hospitality. I’d absolutely recommend staying at his place!

Não temos palavras o suficiente para descrever esse casal maravilhoso. Michele e o marido nos acolheram em sua casa como amigos!! A casa é completa com tudo que precisamos, limpa, cheirosa, além de ser linda e acolhedora. Michele fez jantares deliciosos várias vezes, em que desfrutamos de sua companhia e de seu marido, que por sinal nos ajudaram muito com o idioma. Fomos para Chicago por causa da Maratona, a princípio fiquei preocupada por causa da distancia da casa da Michele até o centro, mas o transporte público é muito bom e fácil de usar. Enfim recomendo essa estadia e se puder voltar com certeza ficaremos em sua casa!!

Lovely apartment in a fantastic neighbourhood. Very well stocked with everything you need - a great spot to stay if you’re running Chicago Marathon! Host was proactive and communicative, really enjoyed his recommendations
This unit is in a convenient location and exactly as described. Worked out well for my short trip.
Great location and spacious top level walk up town house. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend to others. Thanks John!

Loved the area - was very quiet and secure. The space was perfect for our weekend getaway, super spacious and very neat! Finding parking was never an issue! The location is close to everything! Would definitely recommend this space for anyone driving to/around Chicago. The price was very reasonable for how much space you have and the free parking! Would absolutely stay here again :)

D. Vincent provided such a comfortable, clean, and peaceful home. Check-in was a breeze and Vincent was very responsive. Parking was also easy to get on the street. I highly recommend this home and I’ll definitely stay again! Thank you for a great stay!

Excelente lugar! tal y como está en las fotos. Muy cómodo, limpio y agradable. Queda cerca de una estación de bus y también hay algunos supermercados cerca!
Obinna es muy atento y siempre está disponible!

Truly a home away from home! I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Kareem’s home! As a femme solo traveler, visiting Chicago for the first time, felt safe and comfortable. Kareem is not only a great host but an amazing human. It was like I knew this guy for years. He invited me to partake in an evening dinner with him… it was soooo delicious! Learned a new dish! 😁
During my stay I was able to get my daily walk/run in and found peace at the lake, which is only a three minute jog away. Also, if you want to check out art and the downtown area of Chicago, the red line is literally a three minute walk from this Airbnb.
If you’re like me, cleanliness and comfort of home is what you want to feel and experience wherever you travel… let me be the one to inspire you to book your next amazing stay with Kareem!
I will definitely be back!
I absolutely loved Cristina’s place. Very modern, exquisitely decorated and has everything you need while away from home. Very cozy and relaxing!!

Our stay at Thomas’s home was wonderful. The house is spacious, comfortable, and exactly as described in the photos. The location is great — close to shops, restaurants, and the metro, which made getting around the city very easy.
Thomas is an exceptionally kind and helpful host. He was always available and attentive during our stay, and his hospitality really made a difference in our trip to Chicago.
Everything was great overall. If anything, maybe a bit more attention to cleaning in the kitchen area could make the stay even better — nothing major, just a small detail.
We truly enjoyed our time here and would 100% recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago.

Apartment is just as described and fit what we needed for our stay. Check in was easy and they arranged for an early check-in for us. Lots of places to eat and grab coffee within walking distance. Only windows ac units and the one in the back room is very loud. We opted for fans and leaving the room door open.

Clara was a warm host and her place is very clean and well organized. Spacious well equipped kitchen and bedroom. Serene neighborhood and a park around the corner for a great walk or a jog. I felt right at home.
Jane

We had a fantastic stay at Troy’s place! The apartment was spotlessly clean and exactly as described. We especially appreciated how easy the check-in process was—the host's instructions were clear and made arrival totally seamless.
The only thing to note is that the area can get a little noisy on the weekends, which might be something for light sleepers to be aware of. However, this didn't significantly impact our stay.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we highly recommend this host!

Mesh’s place was perfect for our trip and plenty of space for us to relax, rest and do some remote work as the WiFi was great! The seating was exceptional and bedrooms and bathrooms well appointed. Appreciated all the communication and ease of check in and checkout.
Also parking was a plus with street and the paid lot next to the home. Will definitely book again!
Great place to stay in Chicago, close to local transport and the area has loads of cool spots to eat and drink out at

Thank you

Nuestra estancia en Chicago fue excepcional. El apartamento fue un lugar que nos llenaba de tranquilidad y confort todos los días tras llegar de recorrer toda la ciudad. Muy buenas combinaciones con el bus. Un 10 en todos los sentidos.

Unser 11 tägiger Aufenthalt war rundum perfekt! Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber, gepflegt und mit allem ausgestattet, was man braucht – man merkt sofort, dass hier mit Liebe zum Detail gearbeitet wird. Die Gastgeberin war ausgesprochen freundlich, hilfsbereit und jederzeit ansprechbar. Wir haben uns sofort wohlgefühlt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen. Absolut empfehlenswert!
Andy a été exceptionnel ! Logement clean, centre ville à 35min en bus
un espacio acogedor, bonito con lo adecuado para una linda estancia
Janet’s place is beautiful and big! She is the sweetest.
Mijn verblijf bij Heidi was heel aangenaam. Ze is heel communicatief en de ruimten zijn heel schoon. Verder was het een heel cenytrale locatie voor de marathon en om Chicago te zien.
Flexible self check in and easy access to station by short bus trip(3 stops) There is a big supermarket opens early morning till late.
This place was exactly what we were looking for! Safe, quiet, clean and spacious! Close to the train and some great food! Highly recommended!!!
great location, comfy beds, sweet patio with view of Sears tower

One of the best host I've ever had.
Very kind, warm and attentive.
The place is very nice, close to the bus and train stations and there are many restaurants/bars.
Definitely a very good place to stay!
I'll come back soon.

Gary, el anfitrión, muy comunicativo, responde al instante. Instrucciones claras y precisas, tanto para la llegada autónoma como a la hora de salir del apartamento. El apartamento es tal y como se describe, en el bajo de la vivienda, es amplio, ordenado y limpio. Dispone de microondas, cafetera y hervidor de agua, además de platos, vasos y tazas. La cama es cómoda, yo estuve sólo, pero se puede convivir hasta 3 personas sin agobios. El baño es amplio y con todo lo necesario, toallas, productos de higiene etc. El barrio es muy bonito, tranquilo y seguro, con restaurantes cercanos, supermercado muy cerca y lineas de metro Roja y Marrón (Red Line and Brown Line) a escaso 10-12 minutos andando. Ambas lineas te llevan al centro de Chicago en unos 20-22 minutos.
Very clean and great location! Martha was so easy to communicate and followed up quickly on any needs we had.

Helen muy amable, nos ayudó con la habitación antes del tiempo de check in, estuvo pendiente de nuestra estadía, la descripción del alojamiento es tal cual lo que ofrece, el barrio es más tranquilo de lo que parece.

My daughters and granddaughter had a wonderful time! Place was easy to find. Check in was a breeze.
Very close to their concert venue they walked.
Would definitely stay again!
Alojamiento en zona agradable y tranquila. Coincide con la descripción y fotos. Es acogedor y te hace sentir como en casa
My friend and I had a good stay! It was perfect for us in terms of bedrooms and the bathroom was nice too. The only issue was I had trouble opening the door but otherwise everything was good.
Had a great stay with the family at Victor's place!
A charming, cozy, and well-appointed garden unit situated perfectly in the heart of Bucktown. Argelia is a gracious host and I'd gladly recommend this space to any visitors.
Loved our stay! Great location and beautiful apartment!

I will absolutely be saving Sarah's house for future stays. You can tell when a person takes so much pride and effort to create a beautiful home. There is so much space and it really feels like a home built for friends and families to stay.
There is just about a bathroom for each room in the house so it makes it feel like each guest can have their own little hotel room in the house. It is so spacious, cozy and located in such a beautiful area. We see ourselves booking here many more times in the future!
I really loved the place and the neighborhood. I would not change anything. Really recommend the stay - 5 stars ⭐️
Prettig contact. Schoon appartement,  paar metro haltes van centrum
The best Airbnb we have stayed in. The apartment was super clean. It is a huge apartment. Great host too. Top marks.

One of the best airbnb we have been to! Really nice room, nice rooftop patio, close to the city. Also ideal for runners!
Besides all that Enki and Nejla are one of the nicest hosts we ever had!
10/10 would recommend!
Hopefully see you again :)
Todo excelente buena comunicación , lugar como se describe

Staying with Laura was one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had! She’s incredibly kind and generous and made sure I had everything I needed throughout my month long stay. Laura frequently went out of her way to make me feel at home and her house is absolutely lovely! All areas are clean, cozy, and really well maintained and the neighborhood is also quiet and peaceful. She also has the sweetest and very well-behaved pets that made my stay even better!
I had a great time getting to know Laura and she treated me like family. By the end of my stay, I felt like I’d made a new friend and I'm grateful I chose her as my host ultimately. If you get the chance to stay with her, please do so!

Don’t worry about the area, it’s good of what you paid for. Near the red line, the stop of the red line is kind of wear cause there are a lots of polices but don’t freakin out it’s safe. The bedroom was ok, just one small pillow was awful smell but the house was clean and had everything you need. You can order your things by Amazon and you will get it without problems. You can use the kitchen.!

Place is a great value a couple miles to Fulton Market and short trip to the Loop and River North. The unit is about 10 min walk away from a blue line station. Unit is easy to find and enter using a door code.

la atención de John fue excelente, nos ayudo a resolver cualquier inquietud que tuvimos. el lugar es exactamente como lo describe y hay de todo como para sentirse en casa. Ubicación excelente para usar la linea del metro y la parada de autobus. restaurantes cercanos y sobre todo supermercados. Sin duda volveria a alojarme en el lugar de John!
Great location.

We really enjoyed staying at the Avondale loft. Uriel’s place was perfect to stay at for a few days while in town for Chicago marathon.
10 min walk to the CTA Blue Line, with a great coffee shop, bars and supermarkets a similar distance away, the spot and the area had everything we needed. Would recommend and stay there again.

Jamie's home was an excellent find and location for a Chicago stay. The home itself is spacious and equipped with everything needed to enjoy and relax while being so close to the action of the city. We enjoyed the ability to use the kitchen, relax on the back patio, and break up our day with some relaxing on the couch. I certainly recommend a stay at Jamie's home

Fui a correr la maratón de Chicago y la ubicación era buena y a buen precio. Nathaly deja todo para que te sientas como en casa, todo lo necesario. La cama es muy cómoda y la zona tranquila con lo que pudimos descansar perfectamente. Además coincidimos con gente maja que también corría la maratón. En definitiva ha sido un buen fin de semana en una gran ubicación. Totalmente recomendable!

This place was amazing! I stayed here for  the Chicago Marathon. The place was super cozy and had all the amenities you could ask for. I especially loved the big kitchen and the comfy bed and pillows. The place was very peaceful in a safe neighborhood with plenty of restaurants close by. I also love that it’s close to North Clarke Street and the red line. I would definitely recommend this place to friends and would stay here again 😊

Definitivamente me volvería a hospedar en casa de Paul, su departamento es muy bonito e impecable.
Todo está muy limpio y ordenado.
Paul es muy buen anfitrión y te hace sentir como en casa.
Recomiendo ampliamente el lugar.
La zona en la que está es una muy buena zona y tiene muchos restaurantes cerca, la línea del metro está cerca.

In terms of the location the neighborhood is very quiet and cute. It is far from downtown which was fine - it made for a nice neighborhood. But nothing was walking distance and it’s wasn’t accessible by public transport. Had to uber to everywhere.
The apartment is very bare bones. A lot of the furniture and decor that feature in the listing’s photos are not there i.e. chairs in front of the of the window and rugs. Because of this it felt very cold and like an unlived in place. I had hoped the charm of being in a neighborhood would reflect the space but it sadly did not.
I appreciate the hosts flexibly with check in and check outs but overall I was scared to reach out to her for anything as she came across as quite rude.

We had an amazing stay at Caryl’s place while in town for the Chicago Marathon! Everything is even more beautiful than the photos, and the neighborhood is lovely with easy access to bus stops that connect to the metro lines. Caryl was very kind and helpful, and a special mention goes to the breakfast, it was better than any 5 star hotel. Everything is truly amazing! We’d definitely stay here again.

Great stay! The room and the apartment were very clean, and Genova was extremely responsive and helpful. The location is excellent, with great access to public transportation, and the value for money is outstanding for Chicago. Highly recommended!
Thank you Asif and Karyn! Etienne and I really enjoyed our stay this past weekend! We appreciated how hospitable you both were, and we loved the art tour you gave us😊 all the best!

Milan was friendly and responsive from initial booking request and there were security guards / building staff in the lobby the majority of the time. In terms of location convenience, there are bus stops right out front and the L station is only about a block or two away. There are a few restaurants/coffee shops/markets in a very short walk, with many more a little further down the main road. It is a short walk from McCormick Place. I came to run the Chicago marathon with my husband and this was a perfect location- my friend was able to go right out front to see us run since this building is currently along the route. Also, laundry room was right down the hall and uses an app or quarters for payment, which was great for sweaty running clothes. A great stay overall!
Es un excelente hospedaje, la atención fue muy buena, el lugar muy limpio, tal cual como en las fotos y la comunicación con Guillermo fue excelente.

The place was beautiful and spacious, perfect for our group of eight. We all fit comfortably, and the images and description matched exactly what we found. The house was clean and fully stocked with towels, sheets, and everything we needed. The neighborhood isn’t the safest, but the house itself felt very secure. Lola was an amazing host ,super responsive and helpful with everything. Thank you so much!
Host even sent us donuts! Had a great time
Terrific location! Very quiet neighborhood but a 5 minute walk to bars & restaurants.
Perfect place to stay to explore Chicago.

I couldn’t wish for a better stay in Chicago. Evelyn’s apartment is located a short distance (5-10 min walk) from Jarvis CTA station on red line so I could get into centre of Chicago in under an hour. It is also a short walk away (20 mins ish?) from the lake which is beautiful.
Evelyn’s whole apartment is beautiful, clean and a really nice place to be. My room was a really good size and the bed was so comfortable.
Evelyn was such a warm, kind and friendly host. I felt like I was staying with a lovely friend. She is very knowledgeable and passionate about Chicago and was happy to suggest things for me to visit and interested in how I spent my day.
Amplio piso, tal cual la descripción. Vecindario muy tranquilo y a 10 minutos de la estación de la Blue Line que conecta con O'hare y el centro de Chicago.

The place was very clean, located close to a subway station and very spacious. Sujata and Bryan were amazing hosts and always left treats available, including “good luck” cookies before the Chicago Marathon which I thought was the sweetest thing.

I had a really pleasant stay at Wonderful’s place. It was clean and exactly what I needed. Really easy to get into Chicago too on the train. I also had the pleasure of meeting Wonderful and his team and they were all so lovely. Would stay again. Thanks!
La casa es tal cual como la ofertan, muy bien ubicada, fácil acceso y buen transporte hacia el centro de Chicago y otras ubicaciones.
Great location right next to Wrigley field! Had a great stay

Great stay, and the location worked out well for us. Ginneh's place was very well stocked and the layout was excellent for us. Ginneh was an excellent host and communicated well before, during and after our stay.
Highly recommend!

This was my third time staying at Nicole’s place, and just like before, it didn’t disappoint. The space is always clean and comfortable and everything works well. Her space is my Chicago home.
The location is perfect for exploring Lincoln Square, the lakefront and the city. Check-in has always been seamless. I really appreciate the consistency and hospitality here—it’s why I keep coming back. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable and enjoyable stay!

We stayed here for the Chicago marathon. Whilst it was a little out of the city, it was lovely place to stay. 20 minute walk to the metro line which got you downtown in about 20 minutes. Flat was very clean and well decorated. The hosts were extremely responsive and got back to us almost immediately.
Place was clean and spacious. Larry provided easy instructions, and was responsive.

conforme aux photos, Tara a été extrêmement réactive lorsque nous avons eu besoin d'elle.
le petit bémol serait le métro aérien qui passe à côté mais tout le monde n'est pas dérangé par celà.

Lydia and Mayra were such great proactive hosts. All their messages were clear and timed well. When I had questions and some asks, they were prompt in answering and sending over help if needed.
The house was great! Such a big plus that it’s so close to the train station. It was very homey, the bathrooms were clean and nice to use. The kitchen was also a complete one so preparing my meals was easy as well. I liked how everywhere on the place had labels to properly show which is your own space such as a compartment in the fridge or your own drawer in the bathroom. I also got to do laundry easily which was a big help. The codes on the gates and doors made self-check in so easy.
Stayed here for the Chicago marathon and it was great. Close to the city and lots of great restaurants. Place was clean and host let us check in early which was appreciated! Definitely recommend!

Adamm was very helpful and clear with check-in & check-out instructions. Place was just what we needed. Very spacious, good location for easy public transportation with local shopping & eateries. Kitchen amenities and appliances worked well for us. Only improvements would have been: firmer mattress and higher water pressure shower.
I’d highly recommend for people who will tour the city and not need to cook much.

Beautiful apartment in a really nice, safe neighbourhood with good transport links. Would highly recommend. Casper was a great, responsive host and made sure we had everything we needed. Thank you! And if coming back to Chicago would definitely stay again.

The apartment itself was very clean and looked like the pictures posted. The instructions provided to access the apartment were spot on. The host was accommodating with changing our check in time. This place was a five minute walk to the train station which was convenient although we did not feel comfortable walking back from the train when it was dark outside. This place is not walkable to downtown. Only real complaint about this place was the noise level from the upstairs neighbors- there was almost constant stomping around. Also the neighborhood to the back of the house was noisy at times. I would recommend this place to others!
The stay was perfect, exactly what we needed for this short weekend getaway!

We had a great stay at Nancy’s place. It was clean and comfortable and stocked with supplies and snacks. Nancy was very responsive and the location is the best. It’s very close to so many restaurants and a brown line stop. I highly recommend staying here.

L'appartement est bien situé à 800m de la nouvelle station de train sur Hollywood pour la ligne rouge. Épiceries, cafés et restaurants à proximité si vous êtes prêts à marcher un peu. Il est vrai que l'appartement peut être un peu bruyant avec la rue passante en face, mais nous avons bien dormi quand même. La promenade et le lac à environ un kilomètre c'était parfait pour la course matinale. Ce fut un séjour bien agréable et la communication de l'hôte était bonne.
Muy céntrico el departamento, fui para el maratón de Chicago y la verdad está muy buen ubicado, gracias por recibirnos !

We loved our stay at Alicia's apartment. Alicia was so helpful, answering questions, providing extra bed linen and very quickly addressed some minor things we had noticed the day after we arrived - sound from speaker system, dish clothes etc. The apartment was spotless, beds super comfy, kitchen stocked with basic items and the showers were GREAT!
There is road noise but nothing a few drinks the night before didn't dampen ;-)
Alicia was also super thoughtful, leaving us a hand-tied bunch of home-grown flowers to wish two of our party good luck in the marathon which was our reason for visiting.
Great links to the City on the L or via Uber which weren't super expensive. Supermarket a walk away (or again uber!) but we loved taking in the atmosphere and surroundings of where we were staying.
A great place to stay with a super lovely host and if ever we're back in Chicago, we're booking again straight away! Thank you Alicia for making our stay just perfect xx
The location worked well for us--mass transit to the Chicago marathon was within walking distance. The amenities were perfect for our foursome. Hosts were lovely as well.
Lo recomiendo ampliamente, Justo afuera teníamos una parada del camión y nos facilitó mucho los traslados.

10/10 stay and a 10/10 host. We used this Airbnb for the Chicago marathon and the location was perfect. Downtown is just a short journey in on the Blue line.
Leonides was a perfect host and was incredibly responsive and helpful. Couldn’t recommend this place more!

Very pleasant experience! Lyle was very attentive upon arrival and quick to answer any questions I had. The stay was very comfortable — the facilities were clean, the rooms spacious, and the beds extremely comfortable.
There are just a couple of things I would improve. First, the stove knobs were arranged a bit differently than I expected, which caused me a bit of stress at first, but once I started using it, everything worked perfectly fine.
Also, it would have been helpful to receive earlier notice that the place couldn’t accommodate five guests, since the sofa bed was out of order.
The California metro station is just a couple of blocks away, about 40 minutes from downtown Chicago. Although the street leading to the station doesn’t look very nice, I never felt unsafe, even late at night.
Roberto went above and beyond as a host, offering clear instructions, flexible checkin and checkout timing, and sharing many helpful recommendations for things to do in Chicago.
离机场近，到机场方便。
Great location, lots of space, very quiet. Would definitely book again

Judy fue muy amable en todo momento, mantiene una comunicación ágil y oportuna siempre. La casa es tal como se describe todo. Está muy limpio y ordenado. Es una casa muy linda y tiene todo lo necesario para tener una buena estancia. La estación del metro línea azulestá a 15 minutos caminando y la zona es muy segura.

Bonito departamento, fiel a la publicación. Todos muy amables desde la reserva hasta la salida.
Tuvimos un contratiempo con el check in pero el anfitrión buscó compensar el incidente.
La zona es tranquila y de fácil acceso caminado y también hay una parada de metro cerca.
El departamento estaba súper limpio, ordenado y con espacios cómodos.
Las áreas comunes súper bonitas aunque no hicimos uso de ellas por el poco tiempo que nos quedamos, nos quedamos con ganas de ir porque se veían muy cómodas y completas.
En general fue una buena experiencia. Esperamos volver pronto.

Beautiful place in a great area of the city.
Lots of great food spots, bars and shops within walking distance.
Logan square CTA stop is walkable to take you to anywhere in the city.
Apartment is spacious, beds are very comfortable, great kitchen and bathroom !
Won’t be my last stay in this apartment hopefully :)

J’y suis allée pour le marathon avec ma famille. Emplacement parfait! Transport à 5 min de marche et 30 min du centre-ville. Épicerie au coin de la rue. Logement très douillet et complet… on s’y sent chez nous 🫶🏻
Je recommande!
Excellent location for staying in Chicago! The neighborhood is really special and the closeness to the train station is a real plus for popping around the city.

This was the worst Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. The toilet was clogged when I checked in, there was no toilet paper, and the only seating was a small loveseat, and three benches at the counter when there was plenty of room for a table and chairs or more seating. There were very few utensils or kitchen implements, and there was no laundry detergent even though they described a washer dryer.
I had to clear the clogged toilet with a toilet brush because the response was slow. When the host did respond they did not provide a plunger, toilet paper, or detergent until the next day, and when I asked to be refunded a small amount for buying toilet paper and unclogging the toilet my request was ignored.

What a gem! Couldn’t have loved our stay more. Amy is a great hostess, very helpful. And we loved the loft: it’s huge, well laid-out and had everything we needed. It’s in a super spot above a very delicious restaurant. Surrounded by delicious restaurants and fun things to see/do. And getting into the heart of downtown Chicago couldn’t have been easier (via the blue line).
We’re picky about a comfy bed and could not have been happier. We’d happily stay again.

We had a wonderful stay! The host was incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. The room was spotless, spacious, and very comfortable — exactly as described (if not better!). The place was well-maintained and had everything we needed for a relaxing stay. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean and cozy stay with a great host!

Dan was a great host and was responsive at all times. Even got to meet him on the last day and we chatted a while. He's definitely my definition of a superhost and I would definitely recommend his place to future Chicago Marathon runners.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement. Le logement est très propre, moderne et conforme aux photos. Le propriétaire est réactif et répond rapidement aux messages, ce qui facilite vraiment l’organisation.
L’emplacement est idéal : l’épicerie est accessible à pied, le métro est tout près, et il y a un grand stationnement, ce qui est très pratique pour ceux qui voyagent en voiture. Nous nous sommes sentis en sécurité tout au long du séjour, autant dans le logement que dans le quartier.
Bref, une adresse que nous recommandons sans hésitation !

The house was perfect and so peaceful. It was well-furnished and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay to make this place feel like home for the weekend. It’s about a 10 minute walk from the bus stop and there are some delicious restaurants nearby. I would definitely stay here again! Nicole was very responsive and made sure we could easily check in despite the multiple flight delays we dealt with on our way there.
Todo excelente

Wouldn't have wanted to stay anywhere else for Marathon weekend 😊 Meghan's apartment was nestled just far enough from the city for quite, yet close enough to access all the highlights of the Windy City! Very spacious 2 bed/1 bath apartment that is well maintained and comfortable. Super easy check-in and felt right at home! Totally recommend
Buen alojamiento, limpio y seguro.

We appreciated Chris being so communicative and how he gave helpful instructions. The place was really close to Target which was helpful and very walkable to the CTA. We were all happy with it and would stay here again!

We really enjoyed staying in Murtaza’s home! It was clean, quiet, peaceful and a short train ride or uber  away from other popular areas like Lincoln Square or Logan Square. He also provided some great local recommendations that really helped as first time visitors!
Over for the marathon. 3 minute walk to the California L station. Very convenient.
Le logement est spacieux, idéal pour une famille ou un groupe. Il se situe à 5 minutes à pied du métro.
Christal was a fantastic host! Smooth check-in and check-out. Wonderful and perfectly accommodating. Great communication and always prompt responses. Great experience!

En el lugar Juan fue muy hospitalario y atento. Nos ayudó en absolutamente todo, un 10 para él.
Lo único que tuvo un poco de falencias es que por la zona hay varios homeless.
Melissa’s home was so cute and welcoming. Can’t recommend it enough, also very close to public transport and in a quiet neighborhood.
Perfect stay! Thank you for such a lovely fall Chicago experience!!!

O apartamento está muitíssimo bem localizado, a poucos passos de uma estação do metrô que dá acesso a toda a cidade em poucas estações. O imóvel em si é bem decorado, limpo nos mínimos detalhes. A comunicação com Jake é praticamente instantânea, o que nos deu muita segurança. Não vemos a hora de voltar a Chicago.
It felt like home

Excelente lugar para alojarse, descripción tal cual lo indicado, muy buena ubicación cerca de la línea de metro lo que permite movilizarse con facilidad al centro para hacer turismo.

집이 깨끗하고, 4인 쓰기 딱 좋았다.
