My family and I were in town for the marathon and had a perfect stay at Valerie's place. Very clean, very cozy and with the character and touch many bnb 's lack. Plenty of towels/blankets/pillows and very comfy beds. Parking off street for 2 vehicles was a breeze and the area was amazing and a short drive to the city. Valerie was very gracious and the neighbors we met were friendly.

I enjoyed the stay at the place. It is clean and pristine. I slept well thanks to the quiet nights. Although the bathrooms are shared, I have always found them readily available.
The place is very near to the subway station and this makes getting to the start point of the Chicago Marathon easy in the morning. However, lugging my luggage up and down the stairs of the subway station is a little challenging.
Last but not least, I am grateful for the host’s quick responses to my questions.
Thank you for making my stay in Chicago pleasant. I greatly appreciate the hospitality.
很舒适的入住体验

This place is really spacious and has lots of natural light which was amazing. It is a beautiful apartment and was clean and tidy. It is located in a quiet neighbourhood, approximately a 12 minute walk from the blue line. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely stay here again.

It's an incredible and cozy place, you feel like you're truly visiting someone's home. It's very pleasant.
The location is great; you can walk to the blue line and quickly reach the city center. It met my needs since I was in town for the marathon. I highly recommend it.

It was so nice to stay at Jeannine’s place. There are lots of great restaurants, bars, and cafés nearby, and it’s only a 12–15 minute walk to the Blue Line at California Station, which connects you to everywhere in the city. The flat itself was very clean and spacious, and I felt really comfortable throughout my stay. Highly recommended!
Great!!!
Amazing stay! Good location and great host.

Beth’s pad v boho, comfortable and a lovely feel of home.  Great neighbourhood … v appreciative of Beth’s restaurant and marathon tips.  Loved the vibe of the race and engagement of the local community.

This place was an awesome stay. Fed was a great host who was ultra responsive. We stayed there for the race and the location was perfect. I out friends got to go to the rooftop and watch near the last mile and we were a short walk to the start/finish line. I’m sure it’s great for bears game as well. Great location. Very clean. Very safe. And Fed was a great host.

Samantha helped make our first trip to Chicago and first time using Airbnb a truly great and memorable experience.
The apartment was beautiful and spotless and had everything we needed. It was also in a great location, walkable to the blue line and bus if you don't have a car.
Samantha and Ryan were very friendly and wonderful hosts. She checked in with us to make sure we were all set and they responded within minutes with a list of restaurant recommendations when messaged.
We would definitely stay here again!

It’s a beautiful little place. Great to have a kitchen and washing facilities as well as parking was a bonus. The beds in both rooms however were not the most comfortable especially in the 2nd room, so if planning to use that I would note that you may not have the best nights sleep. Also the noise from upstairs during the night can also be a little noisy but other than that the stay was good.

Lisa was a great host. Super responsive and checked in on us several times. She also met us upon arrival to walk through her space answering any questions. We had an amazing meal and drinks at a local winery about a block away and loved taking the e-bikes (stationed right outside her building) along Lake Michigan to downtown Chicago. I would definitely go back in the future. Thanks, Lisa!

Very nice space, very true to the photos and it was spotless when we got in. I always appreciate a host who doesn’t expect you to do all cleaning and work for them, Simida was very professional and the place was perfect. Great location, tons of great food nearby and the Damen bus can get you pretty much anywhere you need to go. Would definitely stay again
Second time staying with Victor, I’ll most likely be back again.
Great place was construction on Ashland so a bit messy but that’s not the the hosts fault
The host was incredibly thoughtful and accommodating. I stayed here while recovering from surgery, and they went above and beyond by providing amenities specifically to support my recovery needs.
The place was very large and comfortable. Easy to Uber to all the locations we wanted to visit. We had a great stay!

The space is wonderful and very well situated in my opinion. Easy street parking, short walks to public transit (train & bus), plus short walks to grocery and restaurants. Perfect place to get a proper Chicago experience.

We enjoyed a nice stay at Aaron’s place. Lots of space for the 3 of us, and an easy walk to the train into downtown Chicago. Excellent, well equipped kitchen for making meals and nice comfortable dining area to enjoy them. All questions answered very quickly.

This was a great place to stay. I was in town for the marathon and it was just close enough that getting around was easy, but was a peaceful escape after race day with less crowds at the restaurants and bars!
Très bel appartement propre, il y a tout ce qu’il faut à l’intérieur, on ne manque de rien… Seul bémol, l’appartement est un peu loin du centre

위치가 도심과 떨어져있어 1시간 10분씩 이동해야한다는 점, 계단에서 살짝 안좋은 냄새가 난다는점 등의 단점이 있었지만 그 모든 걸 커버할만큼 가성비가 좋은 숙소입니다. 호스트가 연락이 굉장히 잘되며 친절합니다. 규칙을 엄격하게 정해주셔서 타인과 함께 사용함에도 큰 불편은 겪지 않았습니다. 다만 여성이 혼자 이 숙소를 예약할 예정이라면 무조건 공유하는 거실의 침대가 아닌 방을 예약하시기 바랍니다. 전반적으로 가격 대비 만족도가 높은 숙소였습니다.

Place was found as advertised. Clear checkin and out instructions. Beautiful neighborhood around. Walking distance from markets and grocery stores. Easy access to downtown via bus, trains and subways. I recommend this place for people looking for a good cost-benefit option.

We spent four days in Chicago as a couple to enjoy an extended weekend and run the Chicago Marathon. We really enjoyed the place; it was quiet and nice, and the living room with a TV set was very cozy for watching movies. Lake Michigan is nearby, as is the subway / train stations. Highly recommend this as a place to stay!
Great location! 15 mins to downtown. Lots of local spots as well to walk to. Easy entry no issues.

Great room for my Chicago stay! Bus stop just outside the place and the Orange line is a convenient walk. Room was great with provided amenities and the private bathroom, and the common shared area was kept clean. The fridge and kitchen space was helpful to use as well. There were two other guests in adjacent rooms but we enjoyed our privacy. There is a bit of a walk up the stairs to the 3rd floor. There is a bit of a  learning curve to the lock system, but once Jose explains it all, it makes sense.

Stayed here with my family for the Chicago Marathon. 5 minute drive to the train station which was nice to get downtown! Adrienne gave great check-in instructions and the house was exactly as described. Very clean and clutter-free for being their primary residence :). The neighborhood is quiet and we loved having the fenced in backyard for our pups and to hang out in the evenings! Having the garage spot was super nice so that we didn't have to find multiple street parking spots. Lots of space to hang in the kitchen or dining room and having 3 bathrooms was a huge plus! Close to lots of markets, restaurants, and stores. Would definitely recommend to someone to wants to be close enough to downtown Chicago without all the traffic and hustle and bustle!
Really beautiful home in a perfect location. Conor was also super communicative

Phill's home was very spacious, clean and had most of the amenities we needed. It was near enough transport links and a supermarket, and a short distance from Lake Michigan. We stayed for the Chicago marathon and was very convenient for both runners and spectators to get to the starting line and viewing points.

Stayed here because we ran in the Chicago marathon and extended our stay to visit with family. The place is very comfortable, super clean, spacious and clutter-free. Location-wise, Sauganash has a lot to offer all within walking distance. We checked out Alarmist Brewing, The Sauganash Grill (2x), Starbucks, some local running/walking trails and even the nail salon - All a short walk from the apartment. (20 min Uber to downtown Chicago) The neighborhood was safe, clean and quiet with plenty of free parking. Our host, John, was very responsive and checked in with us  to make sure our stay went well.
Mr jerome is kind and welcoming. The location is good and the place has everything you need.

A estadia da Carrie foi ótima. A comunicação foi clara desde o começo e não tive dificuldades para encontrar o local.
A localização é boa, um pouco afastado do centro mas é um local bem tranquilo. O transporte por ônibus + metrô funciona muito bem, o centro fica a menos de 1 hora da hospedagem.
Estive na cidade para a Maratona de Chicago e não tive problemas para chegar no Grant Park com antecedência.
O espaço é exatamente conforme descrito, ótimo quarto, o banheiro estava muito limpo e a cozinha é espaçosa.
Considero um ótimo custo benefício para quem precisa ficar alguns dias na cidade, recomendo muito!
Great stay.

Oscars place is pristine, beautiful and all the amenities are all new.
Place is close to public transport, and if you’re like me who likes to run it’s only 25minutes run then you’ll be in the downtown area.
Really lovely apartment and easy to get into Chicago city. Would definitely stay here again ☺️
Mr. Marcus is a wonderful host, very friendly and helpful. He responds to every concern as quickly as possible. The house was neat and clean. Overall, it was a wonderful stay.

If you are looking for a place near Midway, Garfield, or Forest View, this place is for you. If you plan to do touristy activities in the city, you may want your book somewhere closer to the Loop.
Pros: Four bedrooms so plenty of space, two living areas and the basement has a pool table so if you are hanging out at the house you have space to spread out, the beds are pretty comfortable
Cons: The steps to get into the house are steep and the landing is uneven, very sparsely stocked with common items like a toaster were missing, additional fees for almost everything that were not stated until booking was confirmed, relatively clean but dust on light fixtures, stains on carpets, and cobwebs in corners, also did not feel comfortable sending pictures of Government IDs to secure booking - should be done by a third party vendor, even though the beds were comfortable two of them were on box springs on the floor like a frat house. Didn’t feel the cost equated to the value of the rental.

Genesys y Carmen son las mejores. Nos sentimos todo el tiempo como en casa. Volveríamos una y mil veces. La casa preciosa, la compañía, las conversaciones, la comida, sus mascotas, todo maravilloso. Muy bien conectado con todo el sistema de transporte de la ciudad. Seguro. Tranquilo. Esperamos volver muy pronto. Gracias por todo, fue la mejor experiencia para hacer la primera maratón de las majors!!!

Leah’s place was very convenient to our week long trip in Chicago! It was very easy to find parking on the street even at night. Will call out that the apartment is the basement unit, a few steps below the garden, so it does stay cooler. However Leah provided space heaters for our stay.
Overall, this is a good central place to spend a few nights in.
Buen lugar para quedarse , todo estuvo muy bien , limpio, amplio , en general concuerda con descripción , la estadía fue muy buena . Volvería
el precio por el servicio no es razonable, la zona no es agradable ,pero es muy cercana al metro.

Nicolas place is an exceptional Air B&B, her attention to detail is brilliant and she has done a superb job with the apartment. Whilst Nicola does live ‘on site’, she offers a private stay and is only seen if required with secure private access to your space. The apartment itself was clean, tidy and exceptionally furnished. She provided everything we might have needed.. and more! Big up the snacks!
I would have no issues in recommending this place to anyone else. Chicago can be reached via bus/metro in approx 40 minutes or an uber in 20. It’s very well located for transport although there is lots to do in the local area. Thanks for a great stay

Suzanne è un host perfetto.
La casa è super confortevole, dotata di tutto il necessario.
E’ molto spaziosa e ben arredata.
Il quartiere non è proprio centralissimo ma ci sono tante opzioni di mezzi vicino casa.
Bisogna stare attenti perché non è frequentato benissimo anche se non abbiamo mai vissuto sensazioni di pericolo.

communicated well right up until 5 minutes before he was to give us instructions on how to open the door and then sent us a form for a background check and then immediately told us we did not meet his standards after traveling from Florida and arranging this unit well ahead of our stay for business in Chicago. extremely unprofessional and inaccurate way to run a business.

We really enjoyed our stay at this modern garden studio in Hyde Park! The location was perfect—quiet, safe, and conveniently close to public transportation, shops, and downtown Chicago. The host was very communicative, responded quickly, and was kind enough to accommodate our unexpected extra guest.
As a minimalist, I loved the simplicity and cleanliness of the space. The studio looked exactly like the photos and even included some extra kitchen amenities, which were a pleasant surprise.
The only challenge was having no designated place to store luggage or clothes, as the house rules ask not to place bags on the beds or carpets—and the unit is fully carpeted. My suggestion would be to provide a luggage rack or small stand for guests living out of their suitcases.
Overall, we had a wonderful experience!!
Great apartment, large and spacious! Host and manager were very welcoming, responsive and helpful. Location was convenient and the neighborhood is quiet. Would stay here again!

We stayed here with a group of seven for the Chicago Marathon and couldn’t have asked for a better spot! The apartment was spacious, plenty of room for everyone, with high ceilings, great lighting, and everything spotless and comfortable. The location was perfect, right near Mile 25, and easily walkable to the train. The listing was exactly as described and Milan was proactive, responsive and easy to communicate with. Highly recommend!

Pros: Responsive host/good communication, about 20 minute drive to downtown, quiet/safe neighborhood, looked like photos.
Cons: Missing comfort (cheap linens, hard mattresses, 1 thin pillow per person, hard/uncomfortable sofas). No extra supplies (1 towel per person for 3 night stay, no extra towels, no hand towels for bathroom or kitchen). The small trash can in the kitchen filled up quickly and there were no extra trash bags; no detergent for the dishwasher. Shower curtain liner had a lot of mildew.
TODO ESTUVO EXCELENTE, ESTA SUPER BIEN UBICADO Y DE FACIL ACCESO. MUY LIMPIO TODO Y AMPLIO.
el mejor hostal para runners
The place was excellent and a perfect location for our trip. Great stay.
Loved this place! Viktor is a great host and I would recommend his place to anyone looking for somewhere to stay around Chicago

Excelente departamento, nos quedamos durante la maratón de Chicago 2025 y el lugar cómodo, funcional, y limpio tal como en la descripción. Ademas el anfitrión siempre respondió rápido y estuvo atento a todas nuestras necesidades. Recomendado 100%
Lugar muy agradable, tal cual está publicado, cercano a comercios. La comunicación siempre fue rápida y agradable
Good stay! Second bedroom a little dim
It’s a great place

We stayed here for the weekend of the Chicago Marathon, and it was absolutely perfect. The hosts were incredibly helpful and super responsive — they made everything smooth from start to finish. The house itself was spotless and really well put together; you can tell they take great care of the place. Every little detail was thought of, and it felt super comfortable and welcoming. Plus, the location couldn’t be better — it’s just outside the city, so you get peace and quiet without being far from all the action. Definitely a great spot to stay for a Chicago weekend!

la estancia me ha encantado,el alojamiento no le faltaba de nada.

El alojamiento es inmejorable, visitamos Chicago por el maratón y la estancia fue excelente, el alojamiento es céntrico y amplio ideal si viajan varias personas. Muy espacioso y la atención y flexibilidad del anfitrión fue muy buena.
Good location, easy access for metro by bus. Room is more like basement level, then garden. Can be a little bit noisy, as there is a dryer behind of the wall of the unit.

Great location, parking easy and accessible. Pictures are definitely better than reality. Home has potential, but seems to be a DIY type remodel. Additionally, the space was not clean. Window seals, floorboards, walls, vents all dirty and dusty. Doors not painted, no lock on bathroom door.
The place has potential, as location is great and the space is sufficient. However the price is definitely high and it shouldn’t be listed as top tier until the quality is increased.

Fue un buen precio, considerando que fue el fin de semana del maratón, la ubicación es buena, el barrio es relativamente tranquilo, está cerca el metro, el cuarto es extremadamente pequeño, la limpieza de la habitación es muy mejorable, pero por lo que se paga está bien.
Best place

Andy’s place was exceptionally clean. Not only the room, but also the bathroom and kitchen were always well-maintained, and all the necessary amenities were provided, so I had a very comfortable stay. Whenever I had questions or requests, Andy responded quickly and kindly addressed everything. The neighborhood was quiet and peaceful, and the location was convenient — it was easy to get downtown by Uber or bus.
Would recommend
Great location and very spacious. Eliza was super helpful!
L’appartement est très bien situé, très propre et bien équipé
Gran lugar para hospedarse en Chicago

Siddharth is a very friendly, communicative, and helpful host.
From the very beginning, I felt comfortable and safe at his place.
I stayed for four days during the Chicago Marathon. The apartment is well connected to public transportation, and you can reach downtown in less than an hour, which was very convenient for me. The neighborhood is calm and safe.
I can highly recommend Siddharth as a host and his place for a stay.

I stayed six days in that Airbnb. The hosts are kind, attentive, and help you resolve any questions. They make sure you feel comfortable, and the overall atmosphere is great. The accommodation is just as described in the photos and a comfortable and pleasant bed, a room perfect for resting before going out to do what you came to Chicago for. The neighborhood is traditional, with restaurants, cafés, and shops nearby; it’s very walkable. If I returned to Chicago, I would stay there again.
Amazing place to stay at the heart of the downtown. The location is perfect, close to the main attractions, public transport and many restaurants.

Valerie is a good hostess and always answered our questions.
The place is very good as described.

Very quiet neighbourhood for a great short stay over the marathon weekend. Very convenient to get to places with train station (Green Line) & bus stops stones throw. Place was clean & host provided lots of beverages & some muffins/ cookies for us. Nice & pleasant stay!

If you have a crowd, then this is your place. It comfortably sleeps 8.  There's a very long hallway so you never feel like you are top of each other.  The response is quick and all questions answered.

We had a fantastic stay! The host was exceptionally kind and welcoming, offering great local tips and even thoughtful complimentary items for our marathon visit. The home was exactly as described—clean, cozy, and comfortable. Its location is perfect, close to a fitness center and within walking distance of the train station. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a calm neighborhood with easy access to public transport and great hospitality.
Esperienza positiva. Se dovessi tornare a Chicago contatterò ancora l’host
The apartment was very clean and the location was perfect for exploring the city

We were in town for the marathon, so rental properties and hotels were at a premium.  Bandon's place was one of the more affordable options and was close enough to everything we wanted to do to not be too far out of the way.  Brandon was very,  very responsive and accommodating.  Our flight was arriving in the early morning, but he managed to get us checked-in as soon as we arrived around 9AM, even though normally check-in is 3PM.  The house was clean and as described.

House was great. Very clean, very cozy felt like home. The house was close to everything we came to Chicago for. Train and busses are close by. Neighborhood around was ok, little noisy at night with loud music from houses but nothing too crazy. Once you’re inside the residence you feel very secure. I would highly recommend this house for multiple people
Traveling with you. The rooms were all nice and there were plenty of bathrooms. The house is also provided with many amenities. Great place to stay.
Location was great. Easy to get to and the place was very comfortable for our group. We all had plenty of space. Neighborhood is very nice.

A estadia foi impecável. A Jade respondia rapido, nos deu dicas de lugares para ir, sempre atenciosa.
Casa limpa, com itens de cozinha, banheiros arrumados e completos.
Bairro lindo, tranquilo, super bonitinho.
Perto da estação de metro, supermercado, café.
Custo x beneficio excelente.
Indicaria para amigos.

Nos quedamos aquí para la Maratón de Chicago 2025, la maratón pasaba frente al hospedaje lo cual fue excelente para mis papás. A 20 minutos del centro en metro muy bien ubicado. Hay restaurantes cerca a unos 8minutos a pie y el United Center cerquisima a 12 minutos a pie. El sector muy tranquilo con árboles hermosos y ardillas amigables. El lugar queda en la parte de abajo de la casa principal, puede escucharse el ruido de quien está arriba pero no es molesto, ni afecta la tranquilidad. Tiene todo lo que uno necesita, incluso nos dejaron snacks y botellas de agua como en un hotel. Lavadora y secadora y nos regalaron jabón. Un lugar muy bello a donde regresaríamos sin dudarlo.

El lugar tenía acceso al CTA, sin embargo, el lugar olía a guardado, y el cuarto olía mal, la esponja para lavar los platos olía mal también, todas las puertas rechinaban, era imposible salir del hospedaje sin hacer un ruido tremendo. Jeremiah estuvo muy atento, sin embargo, hubo problemas con la lavadora, nos dio solución para lavar la ropa cerca en un negocio pero no contábamos con el tiempo para hacerlo, por otro lado, se escuchaba mucho ruido desde el piso de arriba desde muy temprano hasta tarde en la noche. Y el precio que pague no justifica lo que recibí, es un buen lugar si el precio fuera menor. El barrio se sintió seguro y habian espacios para hacer deporte.

I was here for the marathon, Allyn was very helpful, responsive and friendly. Place is big and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Location is a bit far from downtown, but everything is reachable by the blue line and the bus, would highly recommend!

My stay was ok. For others consider, make sure you read the "About this place" information in the listing in detail.
You will get a ton of messages from the hosts about your stay, though the actual checkin details, even if requested earlier, will not arrive until checkin time of 4pm. I imagine that's so that no-one checks in or even tries to go into the house early.
Looking at this room photo in particular, you'll notice the diagonal ceiling next to the bed. You'll hit your head on it as you get out of bed, and during the night you'll hear the neighbors going up and down the stairs at all hours. As the listing did say, "You are a light sleeper or sensitive to noises: as you’ll hear everything," yeap, 100%
You'll also get a reservation request on the day before you checkout for staying an extra day, IF you don't strictly checkout at 10am.
Last, after you do check out, you'll receive a message strongly suggesting to leave a 5-star rating, or none at all, else Airbnb will block

Всё очень понравилось.Patrizia отзывчивый, дружелюбный человек. Расположение дома удобное в хорошем районе, в пешей доступности остановки общественного транспорта, рестораны, магазины. Огромное спасибо за завтраки.Ощушал себя как дома.Обязательно остановлюсь здесь,если опять приеду в Чикаго.

Beautiful home super close to the Brown line. The kitchen was fully stocked and I loved enjoying my morning coffee by the front windows in the living room. Great showers too! looking forward to our next visit!
Great stay for young families!  There is a playground almost directly across the street and a bus stop close for easy access into the city.  The apartment is clearn and has everything you need!

Nice and clean apartment with soft towels. The room was just as described and offered enough space for one person.
I used public transport and found my way to the city center easily (approx 40 mins all in all). Always waited for the bus less than 10 minutes (most of the times less than 5) and transfered to the well connected and fast red line. Had no problems with it even in the later evenings.
The location was calm, peaceful and I felt safe.
The owners were quick in communication and very friendly and helpful.
Can highly recommend this place and would love to come back again!

Had a good experience staying at Ying’s apartment. The place was clean when we arrived ad basic amenities were provided, like bath towels, toiletries, coffee, water, etc. The only problem which I believed some have mentioned in their reviews were the steep and high steps. Other than that, all is good!

I travelled to Chicago for the 2025 marathon and had an amazing time staying at Trayce’s place before and after the event. She’s an excellent host who went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable and pleasant. While neighborhood may feel lonely, it is a nice, clean, safe and well connected to the public transport. Trayce was extremely kind and responsive  to all my messages. I would highly recommend her place anytime.
Great stay - thank you Yanko.
Gracias por tu hospitalidad.
Cute place, had everything we needed.

Fantastic location. Perfect distance to trains and Divvy rental bikes. We had family from out of state for the day because my wife was running the marathon. They were very impressed with the neighborhood (when you are from a small town, you get nervous when you hear Chicago and that it’s south of downtown). We will definitely be back. Super easy train ride downtown.

Rachel’s place was a great spot for Chicago marathon weekend. It was in a great location, easily accessible by train and lots to do nearby. Check-in was easy and Rachel was super responsive. I would definitely recommend this spot for a trip to Chicago!

Wspaniali gospodarze z wielkim sercem dla zwierząt :)
Dziękujemy za wspaniały pobyt. Blisko do metra. Spokojna okolica.
Super wygodne łóżko które pomogło się regenerować po maratonie w Chicago.
Dziękuję :)

Overall not a good experience within the residence. Pictures make it look better than it is. Cleanliness and maintenance issues throughout. Bedding in upstairs bedroom had blood stains on linens and large blood stain on pillow. Dining chairs (peeling material) and family room furniture in need of repair and uncomfortable/very small for group of six. We had to mostly sit on floor or stools. Garbage disposal not working and backed up when ran dishwasher. We reported this during our stay and no maintenance materialized. Not enough toilet paper and towels for three bathrooms and six people. Trash and debris in patio area upon arrival. Live wires/electrical in bedroom. No railing on steep staircase going downstairs. Patio door would not lock properly. Location was great and surrounding neighborhood lovely. Walkable to local restaurants. Train noise is challenging for light sleepers. (Trains run right next to this building around the clock.) We’ve never had an experience like this before.

Is it located in a safe neighborhood? No, can you go walking at night safely? No. Host was very particular about our noise level, mind you I was with my parents and our daughter, so we weren’t having parties or in my opinion being loud. The host paid us a visit while we were having dinner before 8pm because we were being" loud". We made a decision to get hotel rooms and leave a day earlier so we would be more comfortable to just relax and not worry if we were stepping too hard or speaking too loud, didn’t want the host to be uncomfortable.  We learned this part of town is called the wild hundreds by our uber drivers.  The apt is spacious and nice, but it is def not the safest neighborhood. Don’t recommend staying here with kids, or if you walk with a hard step because you’ll disturb the host. Public transport is near but I would recommend to uber/lyft instead.

Had a wonderful stay at J&J’s oasis! They provide a lot of amenities and very clear instructions. Super communicative (even during a small check in hiccup) and we greatly appreciated them checking in throughout our stay.
Beds were comfortable and the towels were super plush. Parking was always convenient to find and it was a nice neighborhood.
Great stay. Loved the local food in the neighborhood and close proximity to Brown Line to downtown. Super easy! Super comfortable!
Gracias Manuel, el airbnb estuvo muy  comodo, limpio y tranquilo. Esta en una buena ubicacion para utilizar el transporte publico CTA. gracias p todo, exitos!!
Wonderful little Airbnb to rest and relax in after a day of exploring Chicago. The Airbnb is close to several bus routes that take you into the downtown core of Chicago. Very clean and tidy space!

Muy espacioso, cómodo y buena atención de parte de tysheena
Lo único es que si está retirado del downtown está cerca una estación de cta pero si no traes carro los ubers si están un poco costosos
Pero todo lo demás fue bueno

Shawn was a great host and very friendly. I really appreciate how detailed the instructions were for check in/check out so it made the process very easy. I loved how the home had other amenities included such as board games and a pool table. The living room sofa is very comfortable. Also being on a dead end street was nice and made it more quiet and peaceful.
The main downside during the stay was unfortunately the alarm system kept occasionally beeping very loud throughout our trip. The screen was saying WiFi fault when this happened and we weren’t able to fix it. At first it was a mild annoyance but after a couple days it started to get much more bothersome. I’m not holding this against Shawn though as this clearly wasn’t intentional it was just a technical problem and I’m guessing it’s an isolated incident but I still figured I would make note.
Constructive criticism: The tips of a couple of the pool sticks are in rough shape and repairing or replacing would be great.
Thank you 🙂.

I would recommend.
Great location and really accessible from downtown and from the airport as direct blue line train is nearby.
Very safe neighbourhood, no issue leaving very early in the morning nor coming back late evening.
Host very nice and available. Blind rooms which isn't an issue if you are not planning to stay a lot in the room.
Small inconvenience concerning the noise, walls are thin in the unit and also you hear everything that happens in the street. No bring some earplugs.
Great spot for Chicago marathon's runner.

Really loved our stay. The apartment was spacious and well equipped and the location was great. It was easy to get to Downtown Chicago and the Logan Square area but there were also a good range of bars, supermarkets etc very close to the apartment.
Gregory was an excellent host and we always had prompt responses to the few questions we asked.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Julie's home in Chicago! The residential setting of the property was peaceful and quiet, despite being so close to the rail and roads. The location of the property was perfect, and we felt very safe walking to and from the blue line station that we used at all times of the day. The amenities were as described, and Julie's place felt like a home away from home. The beds were all comfortable, and the whole space was super clean. The heated floor in the main floor bathroom was an unexpected bonus. Julie was a fantastic host - she provided great recommendations for local grocery stores and places to eat, and was very responsive. I would highly recommended!
perfect place for our long weekend in chicago! would stay again!
VERY spacious and clean! Lovely little efficiency with an easy commute if using public transit.
Organized e clean,  host give us total support,  offered candy, coffee, popcorn, water. It really was a perfect experience in AirBNB.
Drea was responsive and her place was very clean. Beds were made and towels and extra amenities were provided. Would definitely stay there again!

Sitio estupendo a 25 minutos del centro, puedes cocinar y cerca hay un supermercado, el barrio seguro y fácil de llegar y cerca del metro,
Juanita muy atenta a todo y muy muy amable,
Recomiendo ir, si visitas Chicago,

Such a good location. Perfect for the marathon. So close to Chicago Ave in a section that has killer restaurants and places to get coffee. You can walk easily to Kasama to grab morning pastries or dinner at Lao Peng You just to name a few. The Division blue line & Damen green line is about a 15 minute walk each. Beautiful neighborhood. This Airbnb is cute and very nice. Tons of character. I know we’ll be back to stay again. Top 3 best stays since using Airbnb for what feels like a decade plus.
Peter and Nancy were very great hosts. They were very helpful and responsive.
Our stay was amazing! Matthew was a gracious host... very helpful with timely and informative responses. The property was nice and the neighborhood was peaceful! I would definitely stay here again!

Me pareció genial el apartamento, camada muy cómoda y muy silencioso.
Barrio muy seguro incluso de noche.
Andreea fue súper amable y siempre respondió rápido, incluso me proporcionó desayuno y café todos los días.
Muy fácil la conexión directa al centro de Chicago con la linea azul que está a escasos 10 minutos.
Una estancia de 10!
Love this place, and the landlord/managers are fantastic to work with!
Joe was really helpful with check in, I would definitely stay again! Even provided me earplugs to help with my snoring roommate :)

Very comfortable accommodations. The suite was spotless and well appointed. A grocery store was conveniently located across the street. Great restaurants and trains were a short walk away. Fitness center was fantastic. We loved the 31st floor lounge for viewing the city lights at night. The accommodations and helpfulness of staff exceeded our expectations.

The space was nice and the location was in a nice area. If windows are open the bar below can be a little loud on weekends, but if you close the windows it was fine. If you have a full size suitcase it could be a bit tough to get up the spiral staircase, but we managed fine with our carry-ons. Lots of closet space and lots of room in the apartment in general. Overall we enjoyed our stay thoroughly.
I had a great time staying with Ewa and her lovely dog Bruno! Everything was perfect, and I’d definitely stay with her again next time I’m in Chicago.
入住很舒服，房间很大，24小时热水，空调系统很好，如果厨房里再多一些可以做饭的电锅就更完美了，特别感谢房东的延迟退房的关照，期待下次入住

We had a great time there. Everybody was extremely polite and welcoming to us. Instructions were very clear. The apartment looked just like the photos. It was in a fantastic location in regards to running the marathon. All in all an excellent place  to stay.
Great place to stay in a cool  neighbourhood, room was cosy and comfortable and thenhot tub was an added bonus. Steven was very helpful and responsive, would stay again

Mary's place is in a prime location: walkable to a lot of local restaurants, bars, theatres, and the Movement climbing gym, and CTA stations, but the house itself is very quiet. Very spacious, having a huge living room, and quiet to stay in. Mary is also a great host, very responsive and flexible for my check in time. Highly recommended!
High price but well located.
Nicole was very helpful leading up to and during our stay. She was response when we needed her, and her home was easy to get into!

Joe is an excellent, proactive and clear communicator hosting a hard-working property. Surprises were few, minor and immediately addressed. Helpful to realize some rentals on the property are in non-private spaces without doors, leaving the acoustic experience of all visitors up to the self-awareness and discretion of those occupying the open spaces, regardless of what otherwise are very well advertised house policies.
Eine sehr empfehlenswerte Unterkunft für Familien oder Gruppen. Bereits mein zweites Mal. Jederzeit wieder!
Clean and comfortable. Oyindamola was very kind and quick to respond.
Excelente estadía!
Very happy with the space overall. Very close to the train which made things very convenient.
We had a great stay! The apartment had everything we needed and the neighborhood is very walkable and well-connected by train.
Liz was kind and helpful. The place was in a great location and easy to access. The train passes by the apartment and it’s pretty loud so sleeping is a bit tough.

We felt at home in Michelle’s place! We stayed for a weekend and it looked exactly like the photos! I booked this place because of the amazing reviews and was not disappointed. Everything was extremely clean (one of the cleanest airbnb’s I have ever stayed in!!), the couch and bed were both comfortable! The walls are so thick we did not hear any outside noise. Michelle had snacks, kcups, water, and even energy drinks readily available which was truly above and beyond and much appreciated!
Fortino was fantastic and the place was very nice - could easily accommodate five different people each with individual rooms!

This place was perfect for a long weekend. My boyfriend and I visited Chicago for the Chicago Marathon and were easily able to walk to the start. Was close to lots of restaurants. View was great. Would recommend.

This was a super cool place and perfect for our group. Easy walking distance to the blue line and in a nice quiet neighborhood. Rafal was flexible with our morning check-in and was super responsive to any questions. Would 100% recommend staying here!

Lovely place to stay! It was clean and convenient! There’s plenty of restaurants located and you can walk to them. The view of the city was so pretty if you catch the sun rising! I would definitely book this place if your visit Chicago!

What an extraordinary place!
We highly recommend this place! It’s great location, VERY clean, warm and perfectly prepared. It has everything you need to feel like at home. We loved places Veronica recommended us and cute (and very helpful) notes left at the house.
Veronica- You made a wonderful place, Your mom would be proud.

Enrico’s place was clean and had all the things you would need. Not only stocked on toilet paper & shampoo but also pots and pans for all meals. The location was convenient for all the places we traveled to and great to come back to after a long day. If ever traveling this way again we hope to get the same place!

I stayed here for the Chicago Marathon along with two friends, and it was well worth it. It’s a relatively short cab ride to downtown, so location was fairly good. Place was great, plenty of room, clean. There was damage on one of the pieces of furniture, and she was completely upfront about it and offered an Uber Eats meal, which was very kind.

This was a great Airbnb stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The location was convenient, and check-in was super smooth. The host was friendly and responsive, which made everything even easier. I’d definitely recommend this spot and would stay again!

Staying with Yakinie was an absolute pleasure. We came to Chicago for the marathon, and she went above and beyond to make our trip easy and enjoyable. On race day, Yakinie even drove us to the start line early in the morning — such a kind and thoughtful gesture that meant so much to us.
Throughout our stay, Yakinie was friendly, welcoming, and always willing to help with anything we needed. After we left, she went out of her way to mail us our missing AirPods — a true reflection of her care and generosity. The home was spotless, comfortable, and in a great location.
We couldn’t have asked for a better host or experience. We’d recommend Yakinie’s place to anyone visiting Chicago and would absolutely stay here again!

Loved the stay! Was here for the marathon weekend and was a nice and quiet place and easy walk to metro station and supermarket.
Very friendly and responsive host!
Small detail but a very nice plus, the towels! So soft, better than you find in any hotel!

Was visiting Chicago for the Chicago marathon. The location of the BnB was within walking distance to a bus stop, and there weren’t any issues with the safety aspect of the location. The place was very spacious and clean. The apartment accommodation was for 6 people and it was more than enough room. Each section and room of the house was very spacious. Only draw back I would have would be that it was a bit noisy. The neighboring downstairs apartment was a bit loud during the day and night time hours which made it a bit hard to fall asleep at night. Overall this place was true to the photos and description and it was safe.
Amazing location and well appointed home. Would love to return!
非常新淨，一塵不染，地方寬敞，床鋪非常舒服，回應快速，100分！

Spacious house with all the amenities you need (would be great to have a washing machine though). Was easy to make myself at home and prepare for Chicago Marathon.
However, the host was very slow to respond to my queries resulting in us having to call him to get my questions answered. I also did not receive a response acknowledging my check-out.
Important to note that the Airbnb is 18mins away from the nearest train station which may not be ideal for some people. However, there is a bus stop 12mins away that gets you downtown conveniently in less than 20mins.

First and foremost Armando was very friendly and quick to get us anything we requested! He was a superior host and very deserving of a 5 🌟 review! I've stayed in many places and this by far tops the list. I came to Chicago to run the "Chicago Marathon" with 7 other family and friends and we loved the arrangements! The back covered deck and well manicured lawn was by far the best morning coffee spot and evening gathering area! The house is secure and safe with cameras to watch your vehicles and surrounding area. Picture perfect match to what's posted online! A/C worked great, ceilings fans were a great added bonus! Thank You for an amazing stay, we felt very at home 🏡!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Great stay and would reserve again!

The owner was very responsive and answered all my queries quickly. The accommodation was exactly as described and was very convenient for our stay, just a short walk from the bus. It was quiet and the owner was very open about the need to be quieter later at night which suited us.
It was a great stay in a fantastic location!
We had a great stay.  The house was as exactly described.  Rhett was very responsive and a great host.
Thank you! Great place! Close to a train station - very close! Up three flights of stairs so a little challenging there if you were not ready for it, but otherwise great and beautiful!

I’ve stayed at dozens of airbnbs, the Chicago penthouses are among my best stays. Gorgeous views, perfect location, very easy to enter, free parking, Nespresso machine, very welcoming set up, comfy beds. Every rental has small nits, but our group certainly got what we paid for.
Great space with everything I needed as a solo traveler. I stayed here in mid October and the Halloween decorations were really impressive!

We had a wonderful stay! Magdalena was so kind and thoughtful — we were greeted with cookies and a sweet card upon arrival. The house was very clean, fully stocked with everything we needed, and a great value overall. The space is really cool with multiple stories and gives you a glimpse of real Chi living—super cool. It’s a bit of a distance from downtown but it’s accessible by train. Perfect spot for a big group — would definitely stay again!

El lugar coincide con las fotos y la descripción. Es ideal para llegar a dormir, la ubicación no es céntrica pero hay paradas de bus muy cerca. Tomar en cuenta que los ruidos de los huéspedes de arriba y del piso se escuchaban bastante.
Good location, dirty floors, rude host

A Gina sempre foi muito atenciosa, respondendo super rápido e sendo solícita em tudo.
A casa é confortável e apresenta uma boa estrutura para 4 pessoas ficarem.
Em relação a largada da Chicago Marathon é longe, necessário ter atenção na logística, o metrô mais próximo fica afastado, por ônibus fica mais fácil de locomover.
Obrigado por tudo Gina!

We were there during the Chicago marathon so the price felt high but that’s poor timing on our part.
The place was great. I was a little confused because Airbnb listed the address followed by a 2 which made me wonder if we were in the 2nd floor.
It would be great if the app reiterated the listing to show the unit was on the first floor. You have to go to the confirmation email which is a nuisance. That’s on Airbnb.
Brian was great. His place is very nice and it felt like a very nice home. I loved the backyard the most- private, nice table and chairs and blooming plants and lovely outdoor seating. It’s unusual for an Airbnb in that area.
I would gladly stay again. Good proximity to Fresh Market and Trader Joe, pharmacies and restaurants. It’s in a very nice neighborhood too.
Loved the place + area. Anne was a great host! Would 100% recommend

It's located within a walking or running distance from Chicago Marathon Expo Area and in the very quiet and peaceful neighborhood. Guests are all the friendly marathoners from Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Thailand and my Korea, and it's perfect to share two toilets and kitchen area. I highly recommend the place for those who participate in Chicago Marathon and conventions in McCormick Place. Thanks Zhih. I really enjoyed my stay.

The place was perfect! The hosts were so kind and full of valuable information about the area. I arrived later than planned so while the evening of arrival did not go as expected - I was still so pleased with the stay and would absolutely recommend ANYONE to stay here. It’s a perfect place location. Clean, clean, clean!!! Comfy bed! Would absolutely stay here again!!!!

Karen was very flexible with us for check in and very helpful! She was close to transit so you could easily get around the city. Her home was spacious and the kitchen was very functional. Would stay there again and recommend her to a friend!
Jonathan was an amazing host and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay during the Chicago Marathon. I would highly recommend choosing this rental for anytime when visiting the area.

Le logement correspondait à la description, mais au bout de 2 jours une personne  a dormi sur un lit de camp derrière 2 canapés dans le salon et face à notre chambre !! Dérangeant. Les toilettes dans la salle de bains,  c'est un peu juste pour 7 ou 8 personnes.

The place feels great with a true home-like feeling, plenty of space, great kitchen and nice patio. It’s in a nice residential neighborhood with walk + bus + L access to the city so as long as you can plan. Some shops around the neighborhood too for getting food etc.
Bardzo miły i komunikatywny gospodarz. Nie mieliśmy żadnych problemów. Jeśli chodzi o nieruchomość to bardzo przestronna, duże sypialnie i bardzo ładna kuchnia. Czysto i przyjemnie. Polecamy!

I had a great stay at Manuel’s place! The apartment was clean, well-equipped, and exactly as described. It’s a great value for the price — affordable but still only about 20 minutes by Uber from downtown Chicago. I was traveling alone, and everything was perfect for my needs. Definitely a good option if you’re looking for something simple, clean, and convenient.

Great place to stay in Chicago!  Would definitely book again.  Spacious.  I had a car and was worried about parking but I managed to find a space in front of apartment every time.  Enjoyed neighborhood.
Great neighborhood and home! Lara and Ron were very responsive! Would definitely stay there again!

We had a fabulous time. The home was perfect for our group. Unfortunately, our family wedding was the same weekend as the Chicago Marathon and, for that reason, it appears that the cost was over twice as much as it would have been another weekend. That was our bad luck. Would we rent from Kate and Rick again? Absolutely!

Jeffrey was very helpful and responsive to my numerous questions. His place is a short walk to the Montrose train station. I felt very safe walking there even at 6 AM, by myself, in the dark. Quiet neighborhood and room. Well equipped kitchen and bathroom.

Thanks Hakim, we had a great stay.
The neighborhood is very safe and just a 10 min walk from the CTA train that drops you off in the center of the city.

Everything was as described. The hosts were very friendly and communicated proactively. The neighborhood is quiet but close to the metro station to get to downtown really easy and fast. We had a very good time here and would recommend it and come again!

We had a great time staying at Carrie's place for Chicago Marathon weekend. It was well located near the Irving Park station on the brown line and was very comfortable for the price we paid. It had plenty of nice touches and was clean. Carrie communicated quickly and made it easy to check in and access the unit. Thank you for a great stay!
The condo location is walking distance from green line, super markets and the university,  the apartment is very spacious, We were two families it was very convenient

This was the perfect place to stay. We were here for the Chicago Marathon and it was an awesome location. The place was spotless and had everything we needed. It was walkable to everything. The neighborhood was safe and had everything right there. It also had a Dunkin and Starbucks that were very close, which was a huge plus. I would definitely stay here again.

Very clean and great location in a nice quiet neighborhood, plenty of street parking. Disappointed the only furniture in the living room was a sofa for 3 people for 6 adults staying there. There was no seating for the lovely backyard, no coffee maker (though it was not listed as an amenity we’d never stayed in an Airbnb without one). Only one blanket on each bed, extra bedding would have been appreciated. Overall a positive experience, our host was super responsive.

I wish it had been made extremely clear that it was a basement apartment with extremely low ceilings and not great air.  If you are taller than 5'8" you would hit your head on the ceiling. The ceiling height wasn't firmly mentioned until we were arriving from the flight. We were there for a marathon run and the air quality was compromised with unpleasant air fresheners and strongly scented laundry detergents. Unfortunately, I am highly allergic to scents and cleaning products.  The lock box was really hard to open - I had to crouch down and use a flashlight to unlock it.  I had to remove the scented auto spray device that caused severe headaches while there.   We made the best of it but I think that Airbnb (and other rental agencies) should make it clear that people renting out their units should understand that MANY people are HIGHLY allergic to synthetic scents.

Estadia muito boa, bairro bem tranquilo, a 4 quadras da linha verde de trem.
Leva 30 minutos para chegar ao Grand Central indo de trem.
Não há redes de mercado ao redor para ir andando, há apenas um pequeno mercadinho com produtos essenciais.
Se estiver sem carro, tudo precisa ser feito de trem pois não há comércios em volta, apenas pequenos prédios residenciais.
Os cômodos são ótimos, cozinha muito boa, televisão com netflix disponível.
Great apartment in a perfect location for a family visit to Lincoln Square.
Great location.  Very comfortable accommodation. Spotless!   Highly recommend !!

Ken’s charming apartment was perfect for our weekend stay. It is on a quiet street, walkable to U Chicago and to public transit. We did not bring a car, but noticed that on-street parking would have been easy to find had we needed it. The apartment is filled with books and personal touches. It is evident that Ken is taking thoughtful care to restore the home.
Ken was a gracious host, sending detailed, personalized recommendations about the neighborhood, the University, and Chicago in general. He was responsive to all questions both before and during our visit, and flexible when we needed a tad extra time upon checkout. We will be seeking out this rental for future visits.
Amazing stay at Delia's place ! Thank you for your hospitality !

My and my girlfriend came for the Chicago Marathon and loved this spot! It’s not in the city but it’s right next to the blue line which takes you straight in, so the location was great and super convenient. I was left with a super nice welcome note, wishing me luck on the marathon, the hosts were responsive, the place had everything we needed!

Friendly and responsive host and co hosts. I was being instructed every bit that is needed. Tracks accessible about 10-15 min walk. I stayed for my marathon weekend and my stay couldn’t be better. Thank you!!
Was perfect stay where I didn’t mind sharing common spaces with two other guests. Would stay for ease to Chicago CBD
Extremely clean and well equipped unit. Juan went out of his way to make us feel right at home.

We had a wonderful stay and would recommend this place to others. Our hosts were superb and the room was very comfortable. There are a lot of stairs and parking can be a bit tricky at times, but that is just part of the Chicago experience! We’d definitely hear again!

Place was great, very clean and updated, lots of space for our group. A lot of stairs, which was detailed in the description so we knew what to expect, was fine for our group. A little confusing getting in, not sure which door was the correct one once we were inside the building, but they were there when we were getting in and helped us get in immediately. Very helpful and responsive, would definitely stay again!
Super calm cute neighborhood close enough to a train station and main roads to get into the city or the airport easily.
Excelente disponibilidad. Lugar muy recomendable
Excellent location, easy access to El Train, great neighborhood restaurants, grocery store within walking distance. Overall an excellent place to stay with a group! Thanks for a great stay!
Merci!
We enjoyed our stay. It’s a great location.

We booked this place for a quiet stay during the marathon, but it turned out to be incredibly unsafe and stressful. The kitchen set off the fire alarm repeatedly, and when we checked, we found six cords plugged into one outlet! including the washer, which is a 220V appliance plugged into an extension cord and power block, into a 120V outlet with no surge protector. This is a serious fire hazard and completely unsafe. Even worse, the emergency exit was blocked, a huge safety violation. My friend had an asthma attack during our stay and we had to rush to a pharmacy. The setup of the space, the clutter, and the dangerous conditions were shocking, especially from a Superhost listing. We documented everything with photos. This stay caused way more stress than the race itself.
Had a great experience! Good location/distance from the airport and downtown Chicago. Would stay here again!

Allyn’s place is great and I really enjoyed my stay in Allyn’s house.
Great location not in downtown but very easy to access - 5 minutes to a Bus Stop in 10 minutes to Jefferson Park Station/ CTA Blue line and Metra. Also, easy walkable distance in 23 minutes to Jefferson Park Station. Blue line Jefferson Park to downtown in 40-45 minutes.
Allyn’s place is very safe in residential area, the house is very clean and she is very lovely person.
The kitchen, bathroom and bedroom are very clean with a double king size bed very comfortable. The room is big enough.
Allyn was very quick in responding to my queries and she did check on me for any questions.
Allyn’s place is a great location from 10 minutes to ORD Airport and close to the blue line straight to downtown. It really did not bother me walking 23 minutes to station even though Buses are every 5 minutes.
On my checking out, Allyn brought me couple cakes.
I definitely recommend Allyn’s place to others visitors.
Thank you Allyn.
Great location for the marathon, everything you need perfect stay no complaints hoping to stay there next year
Beautiful apartment with a spectacular view. Very easy to access CTA. Great kitchen setup and the host was very helpful and responsive. Highly recommend!

Everything met and exceeded expectations. It was easy to find, easy to get in, and was beautiful inside.
When I look for a place, I rate it based on the what is listed, and this place looked just as good as the listing.
I would gladly stay here again

Kyle was a very friendly and welcoming host! He made sure I had all the information I needed upon arriving, gave me some great local recommendations, and checked in with me throughout my stay to ensure everything was going well and to my liking.

Excelente alojamiento en Chicago, cerca de las paradas de buses para conectar con la línea azul del metro. instrucciones muy fáciles y el apartamento perfecto para la estadía, lo recomiendo totalmente.

Alojamiento con Coty fue increíble, desde el inicio mostro iniciativa en comunicación y dio las instrucciones claras y atento a preguntas y dudas.
La ubicación es muy padre al sur oeste del downtown. El departamento es ideal para 2 personas y muy limpio, ordenado y tranquilo el barrio.
Gran lugar para hospedarse en Chicago
Great accommodations, very convenient and comfortable!

Best house in town!
Extremely clean and very nice

The space was clean, comfortable, and well appointed. The host was responsive and went out of their way to ensure we had everything we needed. The location offered both convenience and charm where everything from restaurants to local sights was easily accessible.
Great place to stay in Chicago! Just outside of the city but in a great neighborhood. Kitchen was well stocked and had everything we needed.
Thank you for having us! Great location.
Great house! We had everything we needed for our stay! It was everything we were looking for and more!
Great spot in a fun neighborhood! Very comfortable

Wonderful apartment in downtown Chicago!  Views were spectacular.  Typical city hum and sounds.  Easy to walk everywhere.  Grocery stores nearby and lots of restaurants.  Place was comfortable and well equipped.  We walked our dogs at night and felt very comfortable.  Keri was very responsive and helpful.  We enjoyed our stay very much!

We have been at Caryl’s house for almost one week, for the Chicago Marathon. I think we couldn’t find a better place to stay. The neighbourhood is simply fantastic, close to the University Campus and very quiet and safe. From Caryl’s house you can reach either the red and green stns lines with 55 bus that stops few meters away, on 55th street or the MeTRA train, in a walking distance, to Chicago Center.
And Caryl! What a host! She is so nice, always ready to give tips about restaurants, visits and experiences in Chicago. And her breakfasts! Absolutely amazing, tasting, rich! We had a wonderful stay over there, in such a comfortable room, in a house so warm that we really felt at home. Thank you so much, Caryl!

The place is excellent. Clean, beautiful, and very comfortable. The local is near the University of Chicago, and it is inviting to walk. There are good restaurants in the neighborhood, and Caryl was attentive to clarify all our doubts.

This is a very family-friendly place located in a quiet Jewish neighborhood. The home has its own parking lot, which is very convenient, and I recommend renting a car since most places aren’t within walking distance. It’s a basement unit, so the ceilings are quite low, especially in the bathroom - taller guests (over 5’6”) may find the shower a bit tight and won’t fit. The space was perfect for our family of four, and the host was very kind and accommodating. The only downside was that the queen bed could use better support, as it felt a bit worn. Overall, a great stay and a good value.

Great location however we felt pictures did not accurately reflect the unit.
