What a wonderful place to stay!
We stayed for a few nights as I was running the Chicago Marathon, and whilst I was initally concerned about its distance from Downtown, I really needn't have worried. The location is brilliant, within walking distance to the blue line which took us straight into Chicago. After a busy day in the hustle and bustle of the city it was actually perfect to come back to a lovely quiet neighbour hood to get some rest!
Yadi's place is SPOTLESS and absolutely stunning. My husband and I commented that we'd quite like to live here (and we have very high standards!!) It's so roomy and beautifully decorated, easy to find and a very handy code system so you aren't carrying keys atound all day.
The only thing to note is i couldnt find a hairdryer - not a problem at all but just a note to furture guests to bring one if needed!
Thank you once again Yadi, we will be back in future years. We are SO glad we booked this instead of a hotel.

Like the place, it's about 10 min walk to pink line. Also, bus stops are really close.
It's green and peaceful there, apartments are big enough. Coffee is provided. We did not spend a lot of time inside but had comfortable rest before/after the marathon.
Host is friendly, all necessary instruction been sent, everything been explained. Easy check-in and easy check-out
Super clean and in a fantastic location and just a stones throw away from Logan Square. I couldn’t recommend highly enough.
great place, perfect for stays in chicago. just two streets from the favorite breakfat coffee of obama
Met our needs! Flexible and convenient to transportation. We enjoyed our stay.

Beautifully decorated and spacious. The beds were decorated and comfy. Kitchen also was clean and the common spaces were lovely.
Only complaints were about the bathroom (no fan) and the walls were overall so thin. You could easily hear when people used the bathroom, and the people upstairs were quite noisy at late hours of the evening, making it hard to rest as early as we needed to.
Small detail, but we didn't know there wouldn't be laundry detergent so had to buy our own but otherwise had appropriate amenities

Para empezar la atención de Bree es extraordinaria, siempre estuvo al pendiente desde nuestra llegada hasta el día que salimos, ella es muy amigable, y muy flexible, en cuanto al alojamiento es excelente, tiene todas las comodidades, la cama super rica para dormir, la cocina bastante equipada, en general tiene todo lo que se necesita y mas, quedamos muy contentos de habernos hospedado con Bree, esperamos regresar muy pronto.

Jed is an amazing host. He is extremely accommodating, helpful, and great at communicating. The apartment was also perfect - extremely spacious, very clean, and just a short walk to the blue line to get everywhere we needed to go. Would happily stay again and recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay while in Chicago! Thank you again Jed for such a great stay!!
Great location, walking distance to a lot of great places in downtown. Stayed for the Chicago Marathon and was an easy walk to the start and finish. Hosts were very responsive.

Lily's place was beautiful! The house is exactly as pictured! It fit all 9 of my family members perfectly, whom all came to watch me run The Chicago Marathon. Easy Uber ride to Downtown for all the attractions Chicago has to offer. Neighborhood is still up-and-coming and it's very close to the river walkway along Lake Michigan, which is pristine and has wonderful views of the city just North of you. Lily was very proactive with happens in her area and very helpful with any questions I had about anything!
Wicker Park location is close to many restaurants on Division Street, close to the L, and felt very safe.
Comfortable place and friendly
A great AirBnB, with accommodating host, plenty of space and good transport into Chicago. I’ll be returning on my next visit to the area
Perfect location, accommodations were wonderful!
Très bon emplacement pour le marathon, à un excellent prix. À 10 minutes du Metra Train et 12 minutes en train de la ligne de départ. Lucas est très serviable et répond rapidement à nos questions.

O apartamento de Bobbie é muito agradável e nos surpreendeu com sua limpeza e aconchego. A cozinha muito bem equipada nos atendeu em todos os sentidos, com louças e utensílios completos (sem falar na torradeira, na chaleira elétrica, que facilitam no preparo do café da manhã). Os mimos de boas-vindas também nos agradaram em cheio, acompanhados de um cartão simpático. As camas são extremamente confortáveis e um convite a excelentes noites de sono.
Gostei da rapidez com que Bobbie me respondia e se colocava à disposição. Em resumo, ela é uma anfitriã perfeita, nota 10!
Close walk to the subway, bars, restaurants, etc. being close to subway made it easy to get downtown.
great value, good transport links and friendly and communicable hosts!
Ideal location right in the hear of Chicago. Great base when visiting for the marathon, and we could cook our own meals.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The home was beautiful, very clean, and exactly as described by the host. It was in a quiet area, which made it perfect for relaxing after busy days exploring Chicago. The host was always quick to respond and helpful whenever I needed anything. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago — it’s everything you could hope for in a stay!

Es una casa muy bonita y sobretodo muy muy limpia, yo fui para correr la Marathon de Chicago y me resultó bastante buena la ubicación para movilizarme en la ciudad, tiene una parada de tren a un par de cuadras.
Lugar muy cómodo, amplio y limpio con un acceso fantásticos al metro que comenta rápido al centro
Nice stay! Feel cosy

I absolutely loved staying with Suzanne! The location was fantastic- It’s close to the L and buses every street around it! There’s so many different places to try and the environment from Wrigley and the surrounding residences were so comfortable! The space itself was clean and roomy! Suzanne ensures you feel comfortable and welcome in her home! It was always so nice to be able to catch up with her in the morning or afternoon, just to check in and share what’s going on in Chicago/get new recommendations! Also her dog Lola is such a cutie!! Highly recommend staying here!

I had a truly wonderful and comfortable stay at Princess Quarters. The house was superb clean, and the description provided was perfectly accurate. k especially appreciated how well the common areas were maintained by the other roommates. I made lifelong running mates here.
Helen, was exceptional—she was incredibly proactive and responsive and provided clear, easy-to-follow instructions that made check-in and the entire stay seamless. She constantly ensured I was comfortable. Her family is also great.
The location was good, offering convenient access to the CTA Green Line Central station, which made getting around easy. While the immediate locality offered limited activities but we could find a lot of good restaurants a few blocks away near Oak Park. The neighborhood was peaceful and serene.
Highly recommend this home and Helen as a host!

House was clean and very homey! Me and my family were very comfortable and loved being back home enjoying each other while feeling secure in the area with our own gated parking. Appreciate the great hospitality and easy check in and out process.

The home looked quite new, it was clean, smelt great, and the host provided some welcome treats. Good base for when you don’t want to be living in the busy parts of Chicago. There’s an Aldi that’s a short bus ride away.
Very responsive, looked just like the pictures, close parking, and a walkable area.
Great stay. Clean, comfortable, spacious, quiet. Well set up, including little details for travellers needs. Would definitely recommend!

This airbnb was awesome!!! We were out quite a bit but so we didn't get to use the kitchen to the fullest extent, but the kitchen had a lot of space and amenities to use. Bedrooms were nice and quiet at night. Cate, the host, was very helpful with recommendations and all around communications. The location felt safe and also private. It was within walking distance to bus stops to take into the city and/or train stations so that was awesome. Very cute part of Chicago. Would highly recommend staying here.

We stayed here for a few days over marathon weekend; it was the perfect location, set behind a town house, within 5 minutes walk of the metro station which takes you downtown within 15 minutes. The place was clean and had a fully stocked kitchen and bathroom. We were expecting the bed to be uncomfortable (Murphy beds normally aren't great), but it was very comfortable indeed and we slept well.
A couple of very small improvement suggestions: it would be nice to have climate control in the room - it is currently controlled externally by Irena and while she offered to change it for us, we like warmth during the day and cold during the night! Not a big deal, just a thought! Also, a house number on the gate would be helpful when arriving; we arrived in the dark and accidentally went into the yard of the neighbours. Definitely our fault, but perhaps could be clearer.
All in all this was a five star find and we will definitely book again when we come back for another Chicago Marathon!
Very clean place and espacious... not too far from downtown.
Great place to stay in Pilsen when visiting Chicago.

Really enjoyed our stay with 6 people when in town to watch our daughter run the marathon.
The place was clean and comfortable with lots of room for us all to spread out for downtime.
I highly recommend this place if you are a large group wanting to explore Chicago!
zona muy tranquila, el lugar muy limpio y tal cual lo que describe en la publicación. mungiato mucho, recomendado

The house was perfect for my family! The location was great (close to public transportation and restaurants), it had everything we needed and more (all kitchen items, kids cups/plates, soaps, kids toys, etc.), and the beds were very comfy! The private backyard was great to have as well. There’s nothing I would change about the house! The owners were responsive and friendly. Would recommend for sure!

I would 100% recommend this airbnb to anyone. Great location, about a 10-15 minute walk to the near train stop, and Ryan was a phenomenal host. Incredibly responsive and kind. If there is an opportunity to stay here again in the future, I definitely will.
great communication, great price, clean and organized

El alojamiento coincide con la descripción. Todo en orden, facil llegada, fácil acceso, siempre hubo comunicación y no tuve ningún contratiempo.
El lugar esta limpio y ordenado.

Great place to stay! Place was super clean, had everything we needed, easy to get to where we needed to go from there, smooth check in and any issues we had were promptly taken care of. Charlie was great, highly recommend!
Lovely hosts and so many personal touches!  Very responsive, friendly and made sure we had everything we needed!  Thank you for a great stay!!

Dora's place is in a lovely neighborhood very close to parks, the shore, restaurants, grocery stores and the train station.  The space is beautiful and clean and her back garden area is lovely.  A bonus is free and easy parking!  We appreciated her recommendations and friendliness.  Highly recommended!

I was there for the Chicago marathon and with the downtown prices practically unaffordable, relatively this place is a steal. it's so close to the station and three stops ( 11 min ) to downtown ( Washington library), which is like 100 m to Michigan Avenue and the entry gates for the marathon .
Everything else didn't matter but the apartment itself was fantastic. The only hitch is it's not an attached bathroom and its common for others. But the apt is very big and gives full privacy.
Sure, we have tons of stairs to climb and post marathon -thats enough to make you cry 😭 but I chose to exit right after to lessen that nightmare... overall, for the reasons I was there , it was very well worth it.
Thank you.
Great spot to stay if you need 2 bedrooms, an affordable option for marathon weekend, park nearby for running. Phyllis was available to help with things we needed.

This was an incredible stay! Everything about the place made you feel like you were at home. It was safe, comfortable, and cozy.
From booking to checking out, Joseph made the entire experience great. He is the type host that I prefer to book with. When I come back to Chicago, I will 100% book with him again.
Jasmines place was great and cozy for my family and I short stay for the Chicago Marathon. She was very helpful with our needs and very responsive.

Zenobia had her relative as the go-to-contact. Lisa was beyond wonderful. She came with the keys and because my flight was delayed in arriving to Chicago, the restaurants were closed. Lisa took me to get dinner and other basics like fruit, oatmeal etc. for breakfast.  Found this place by searching around for affordable stay for the Chicago marathon and this worked out very well - esp since there was nothing much available and super expensive at that.  Only one comment - there was no coffee pods - which would've been great for the 2 mornings I was there.

Thomas and Elizabeth were incredibly responsive and have a beautiful apartment in Chicago. The instructions for the apartment were clear, concise, and easy to follow. The apartment itself is in a great location - the street itself is quiet, but it's a short walk to multiple bus lines and just a bit further into the heart of Wicker Park itself with its many restaurants, stores, and L access into downtown. Would definitely recommend.
Nice place, very comfortable and with loads of amenities. Charles was always very responsive and eager to help out. Thanks Charles!!

The stay was great me and my friends enjoyed our stay. We weren’t aware of the racial tension in the area but we had absolutely no problems. I only mention that because many uber drivers were saying so. But we had no incidents no complaints about anything of that sort. The location is far from the downtown upscale area so if you don’t mind being out the way it’s fine
Great location and value, thank you!

We had an amazing stay at Serenity Spaces! Our host Ademola was awesome, the communication with us was so pleasant and helpful. We got in late and no problem. I will share, the Airbnb was spectacular, the personal touches the cleanliness, comfort and the Nespresso pods were on point (if you’re a fan) look no more.
The rooms were great, spacious and had everything you need, a TV in each room is a bonus. Parking was a breeze and getting around was super easy. I will share you should eat at the suggested spot in the welcome book, the food is so delicious.
We look forward to returning.
l hote fut très accueillante, le logement etait très fonctionnel et calme.

Peter’s place was extremely clean and updated. The stay was perfect for my family and had everything that we needed. Having a washer and dryer was a game changer as well. We loved staying and would be grateful to come again.

Unit was very clean and matched exactly what was listed and we had more than enough supplies. Was about a 10 minute walk from the train, but area didn’t feel safe to walk around at night. Host was slow to communicate. We had problems with the AC, it was too cold when we got there because the host left the windows open, and then the host turned up the temp when we left for the day. When we came back at night the radiators had overheated and were sizzling/leaking water. When I notified the host, they responded slowly and then finally said they’d check “tomorrow” then never did. While we took care of the heat by opening the windows, it was inconvenient and felt unsafe since the radiators were old. Ok stay and unit was good overall, but host wasn’t very helpful
Spacious space for sure but very little comfortable seating in living room, definitely not a « fully stocked » kitchen low quality towels and not enough pillows in each bedroom.
Overall, the location of the house was perfect - the neighborhood reminded me of my own. I felt completely safe walking around, and getting into downtown Chicago was easy.

Very few times have I come back from a getaway and thought, “I could actually live there.” That’s exactly how I felt leaving John’s condo in Chicago.
From the moment we walked in, it just felt right bright, cozy, stylish, and stocked with everything you could possibly need. Every detail was thoughtfully done, and it was exactly as described in the listing (and even better). And let’s talk about Nemo and Dory the sweetest little fish that totally added to the charm. It’s those small, unexpected touches that make a place feel personal and welcoming. The neighborhood was diverse, safe, and had such good energy. We could easily hop on the subway or grab transit downtown, but honestly? I would’ve been perfectly happy just staying in and pretending I lived there.
John’s communication? 10/10. Fast, friendly, and genuinely kind.
If you’re heading to Chicago and want a space that feels like home (with better lighting, better energy, and better fish friends), this is it. Can’t wait to go back!

Nicely redone historic house with lots of room and essentials.  We stayed for the Chicago marathon. Public train was relatively easy to get to once we figured out the schedule and the water and trail were just blocks away.  Tarek has done such a nice job with this place. Some of the other historic buildings nearby could use the same attention.  Thanks!
Excelente lugar y muy buena ubicación, rápido llegar a dónde sea
Had a great stay at Argelias place. Safe neighborhood with a convenient walk to the blue line station. Would definitely book again!

Michelle’s place was perfect for a long weekend trip! My friend and I loved the location, and the space was great! Both of us were able to have our own separate spaces! I definitely plan on booking again next time I have to come to Chicago!

Mary was an incredible host! This place is exactly what an AirBnB should be! Stayed here for the marathon, and Mary and her husband were so great in helping us navigate parking, etc. She was also incredibly kind and gracious!

Beatrice and Stefan are friendly, kind, down-to-earth hosts. I stayed a month and they were consistently responsive to my needs. Given the setting amidst an urban farmette, this isn’t a fancy Loop AirBnb—it’s a little rustic! The animals are absolutely delightful and were a much-needed balm on my soul after long days downtown. Overall (minus trains) the neighborhood is pretty quiet and the neighbors are engaged in looking out for each other, creating community gardens, and other offerings. The Garfield Conservatory is right down the street.
Comfortable, nice, good location, excellent host and communication

Martha's place is beatiful, great location it is pretty easy to move using the CTA blue line train and bus, there are many places to dinner in the surroundings, tha place has everything, the kitchen has everything you need as well, all the electronics, AC, and appliances are perfectly working.
definitely is a great place to stay near the downtown, for any marathon runner is the perfect place to stay.
Lastly Martha was very kind and communicative, my family and I had a great time.
The place was great! And Garret was a great host!

We were in town for the Chicago Marathon, and this was the perfect spot!  Walkable to the course and also to the restaurants for a surprise engagement dinner!!  The house was exactly as described and even cuter!  Cesar & Maria also had several thoughtful touches of hospitality.  We've stayed in many rental properties, and this one was a great place to stay. Water pressure was fabulous!  We will be back.
Great spot to stay! Apartment was very clean and tidy. Everything was very comfortable. Check in was easy and host was very helpful and responsive.

Brian's place was perfect for our family! We had plenty of room for us all to feel like we had privacy in addition to welcoming common spaces for us to spend time together. The neighborhood is very walkable and close to some great restaurants in Little Italy. There is a ~.5 mile walk to the nearest blue line station, but public transit is straightforward to find and the neighborhood feels very safe. Brian was very communicative and gave us some great local recommendations. This was the perfect home base for our trip and would highly recommend staying here!

Les clés sont facilement trouvables dans une boîte à clés,instructions données à 16h00 pile, pas avant. l’appartement se trouve dans un quartier correct à 2,5km de la plage. L’appartement est propre. La cuisine et salle de bain propres, l’émail est taché et vieillot. Le rideau de douche piqué. la chambre donne sur l’autoroute à 7 × 2 voies, soit 14 voies de voitures camions qui passent sans arrêt. La chambre est équipée d’une climatisation qui est insérée dans une fenêtre simple vitrage. Donc le bruit des 14 voies de voitures se répercute très très bien dans la chambre. On peut parler de cauchemar à ce niveau-là. bouchons d’oreilles obligatoire. il n’y a pas de rideau donc la lumière de l’autoroute se voit très très bien depuis la chambre, masque de sommeil obligatoire. L’appartement comporte 4 chambres louées et une salle de bain avec toilettes, il faut être patient pour aller aux toilettes. Je ne recommande pas. 5 nuits de CAUCHEMAR. Essayez chinatown plus sûr pour le même budget.
Jane y su esposo Luis fueron excelentes anfitriones, siempre muy atentos y empáticos. Nos fuimos muy agradecidos esperando volver!!!
Very good experience! Nice house!

Alex was a great host - very communicative and welcoming. The location of her AirBNB is fantastic. Lots of great restaurants and activities including the Lincoln Park Zoo within walking distance and a short drive to almost anything else you’d like to do. Despite being surrounded by so much to do, the home was quiet and relaxing after the long days of sight seeing. Would absolutely stay at this locale again.

Host and House- 5⭐️
I spent 4.5 days there it was a peaceful experience. I arrived there pretty late than expected and couldn't find the right street due to exhaustion and on Googlemap it was showing on the other way. Joe actually track me down from the next street and was very helpful. Place was really cool and nerdy small starwar figures in common room I really like it. Bed was super comfortable and my roommate was good we didn't interacted much but she didn't bothered me at all and I guess same about me. Washrooms were clean except for two incident there was one guy who didn't flush this happened twice. Yea but everyone else were hygienic and overall everything else was nice and clean and comfortable. They also provide complementary breakfast- 3.5 to 4⭐️ Tea, coffee, cereals and some non-veg items. last 3 days no milk I guess it's not complementary but then I u drink tea and coffee? It's odd for me as Indian to drink tea or coffee without milk. Overall good place to stay.
Es un buen alojamiento pensado en gente que va de paso por Chicago o pocos días, está un poco alejado del centro pero tiene atractivos cerca

The home itself was absolutely beautiful! Totally spotless, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed with every detail in mind. It’s clear that the host takes great pride in maintaining the property and creating a welcoming environment for guests.
I feel it’s important to mention that the surrounding neighborhood was rough. We were told by all taxi drivers to go instantly inside the house and not walk around. While taking the CTA during our stay, we unfortunately witnessed the worst physical fight I’ve ever seen between two strangers. It was a horrible experience and left me feeling unsafe. My brother also had an issue on the bus with his family with strangers.
For that reason, I would not recommend this property for guests who plan to rely on the train, or bus particularly if traveling with children. That said, for those who will have their own transportation and plan to spend most of their time at the house, the home itself truly is exceptional and a wonderful place to stay.

This was a fantastic stay for my family and Lois was such a sweet host. She met me there upon arrival and gave me a full rundown of the property and made sure we had everything we needed. There was plenty of space for my group - five adults and two kids - without feeling cramped whatsoever. Also - this property is only a few minutes away from some INCREDIBLE food... there's a lot of Italian history in that neighborhood, so if you like Italian food (or if you are carb-loading for a marathon like I was), this is a great place to be!
Had a great stay at Kelly’s place! They were super communicative and helpful.
We had a great stay at Matthew’s place in Wicker Park! The area is very nice and the apartment spacious enough for a group of 5.

此次芝加哥马拉松之旅非常值得纪念，同一屋檐下，五个国家，九个跑者朋友，不一样的体验，非常感谢非常棒，去领物和市区J14非常方便，去起点Mtrea也非常方便！
就是挤了一点，但有利于世界和平和团结，哈哈！房东非常爱干净，这点非常好哦！
附近有个公共高尔夫球场，价格便宜实在，值得体验！球场旁的湖边跑道非常美丽漂亮，可以远观芝加哥天际线风景！
这里的居民也非常的友善热情，爱于助人！
只是有一点提醒，附近有个超市有个不太安全风险点，需要小心点，快速直接通过就可以了，白天都有警察在巡逻的
最后总结一下，芝加哥马拉松值得推荐的一个家，特别的体验

Minha estadia foi ótima! O apartamento é como nas fotos e a localização fica numa área de subúrbio, bem tranquila, perto do metrô que leva direto ao loop. Há vários restaurantes perto e uma Target. O apartamento é bem equipado e conta com vários utensílios. Laura e Alex foram super receptivos, responderam com prontidão, inclusive recomendando restaurantes.

Absolute perfection
We cannot say enough wonderful things about our time at Bob’s house - it was so clean, cozy, and absolutely filled with amazing games for the six young kids we brought with us
We had plenty of space for four families and sincerely appreciated Bobs warmth during our stay
Our children all keep asking when we are going back to Chicago since they “like it there the most”

We loved our stay. We were in town for the Chicago Marathon and it was a great location for our extended family of 9 people.
Jerry met us when we checked in and was extremely helpful with letting us know about the apartment, the area, and was flexible on check-in and check-out.
Apartment was clean and spacious. The rooftop had great view of the city.
Blue line subway was about a mile away but the bus was only a block away. Both were very convenient to getting downtown or anywhere else we wanted to go.

My husband stayed here for a week and really enjoyed his time. The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and very close to public transportation, which made getting around easy. The host was wonderful—kind, helpful, and always quick to respond. Thanks for everything, Helen.
Espaço excelente, bem localizado, amplo! Recomendo!
Great location, easy to get around the city and hosts were very communicative. Perfect space for 4 people and as described.
Great place. Good communication.
Follows through with communications. The neighborhood was very nice. Walkable restaurants and bars/pubs.
If you're coming in for a Cubs game, this place can't be beat. And Tony was awesome and super responsive.
We had a great stay! Thank you!

This place is awesome. The pictures don’t do it justice, and having private parking on site is a huge plus. It was so clean, and they provided to many things around the condo that stood out! It was great for Wrigley, and easy to get downtown to watch the marathon! I plan to stay again when the Cubs come back! ❤️
Mattresses were extremely uncomfortable.  Smoke detector in hallway was beeping the entire weekend.  Hot water took 10 minutes to heat up in the shower.

We loved our stay in Lakeview. Wes did a great job of giving us all the info we needed ahead of time. Everything was super easy to figure out and the accommodations were clean and comfortable. We loved our visit to Chicago!
Great place!  Very comfortable,clean and well equipped! Great location
Solid spot in a great location. Was pricier than normal due to marathon weekend , overall would stay again

Thank you for a wonderful stay. We loved walking around the neighborhood (amazing art murals everywhere!). Had a great dinner and breakfast at Beatnik West Town which we walked to because we lucked out on beautiful weather. The rooftop was wonderful to sit and see the city skyline. Driving to and from this location was easy to get to our destinations within the city as well as the airport.
Great spot, awesome space and peaceful neighborhood. Easy to find, very responsive host.
Bethany’s place was very nice, extremely clean and very accommodating.  Parking was convenient.  Bethany was very responsive, a great host and we really enjoyed our stay.

단연코 시카고 최고의 숙소라고 말할 수 있습니다
친절하고 따뜻한 호스트분들, 아늑한 분위기, 깨끗함 더할나위 없이 좋습니다
Anny was great with communication. The place was in a great spot for getting around the city. Lots of walkable restaurants as well. Will stay here again for sure.
La ubicación nos agradó mucho, está cerca de la línea verde del tren lo que facilita la llegada al centro
Great place to stay, safe, great neighborhood, easy access to the subway or bus.

Great spot, wonderfully designed and modern house. Water takes a minute to heat up for the showers but that is literally my only complaint. Melvin was extremely responsive and helpful. The house is in south Chicago so know your surroundings and you’ll be fine. I’d 100% stay here again, get out and enjoy the area, it’s a 15min uber to magnificent mile in Chicago. 5 ⭐️ spot.

Junni is such a helpful & responsive host. All of my Qs were answered quickly and thoroughly before checkin.
We decided to add a night on the front end and she was again responsive and accommodating.
We were in Chicago for our daughter’s wedding and needed a space that could handle my wife and I, 4 kids, three spouses and three grandchildren (two toddlers, one infant).
The accommodations were perfect…especially having four full baths.
Junni’s gift of hospitality was evident as soon as we arrived and found a beautifully appointed and clean home.
The location was perfect for our needs…daughter lives in uptown, rehearsal & wedding in Evanston and pictures in Loyola Park
Great Host, Home & Location…highly recommend.🥰
Was a lovely stay at Sayra's place. Would reccomend for anyone who wants to visit Chicago.
Nice toilets!
Very kind and loved our stay!
Such a great stay easy walk to the train
staying in Chicago is expensive and this place was a good place to be to see the area.
We had a lovely stay! Lots of great places to eat nearby and an easy walk to the El. Highly recommend!

We were so lucky to find Reiss's place kind of last minute the weekend of the Chicago Marathon. The home was clean comfortable and close to everything we wanted to do and where we wanted to go. We love Bucktown!

I booked this last minute has accommodations were limited during my stay due to the Chicago marathon. Everything was as described and aligned with the ratings of others (I.e. look, feel, and location). One thing I wished I had known sooner: how thin the walls are. From my room, I could hear everyone who is in the house, including the unit upstairs. Overall, decent temporary stay, probably wouldn’t be my first choice in the future.
Host was very responsive and easy to communicate with. Instructions were clear on how to get in and out.
I enjoyed staying here. It was a clean and quiet apartment, reasonable value, and a short walk to the CTA blue line, nearby restaurants, and coffee shops.
Great location and very convenient service

Kai's home was absolutely beautiful.  It was well maintained and clean.  It was more than enough room for our large family.  She met the group at the home and gave us a tour.  Throughout our stay, she was in constant contact to ensure our needs were met.  We will definitely come back to Chicago and book this home.   Thanks to Kai and her team!

It was a nice, photogenic apartment for my fiancé with his groomsmen to get ready in before our wedding!
It also came without the standard laundry list of rules, complex steps, and excessive chores for checkout.

We had a wonderful stay at Holly’s place!  It is in a safe, walkable historic neighborhood with lots of beautiful old trees and tiny gardens.  It is easy to get to the lakefront and the train station.  There are lots of great restaurants and things to do.  The rental is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you will need.  There’s even a rooftop deck!  Holly is helpful and easy to communicate with.  Highly recommended!  We would definitely stay here again in the future.
Great location. Quiet neighborhood. Comfy cozy. What more could you want? Would stay again.
Cute apartment in a very nice neighborhood.  We loved being able to walk to bars & restaurants that were only a few minutes away.  We would stay here again!

This space was perfect!! The location was close to the brown line which takes you straight into the Loop. The neighborhood was idyllic and decorated for Halloween, which always makes me happy. :) We were able to walk to restaurants easily. While we didn’t drive, there was PLENTY of parking around the neighborhood that would have been perfect for anyone driving. The amenities in the house were wonderful as well. Beware of the comfiest couch and coziest blanket…it will make you quickly take a nap after all your walking :)
Thank you for sharing your space!!

Nice quiet neighborhood with lots of parking. Good restaurants within 10 minute walk.
Host was very responsive and friendly.
Nice shared community area, as well as, kitchen appliances (refrigerator, stove, microwave).
Extremely clean with every amenity you could need.  Easy check in and clear instructions.  The host was very responsive. Highly recommend
The stay was good! The surroundings were a bit loud but it’s Chicago so that’s to be expected

I was in Chicago to run the Chicago Marathon, and Neel and Kevin's unit was perfect! It was close to the L and the Brown Line to help myself and my family navigate around the city. The condo was perfect for my entire family that came with me! Plenty of space, games, and accommodations. The check-in instructions were so helpful, and it was so nice to have a gated parking area. Neel and Kevin were so helpful and accommodating. They even brought us donuts and welcomed us to the city. When we come back to Chicago I will be looking to stay here again!

Roberto’s spacious apartment is located on a quiet, tree-lined street, a walkable mile from the Lakefront Trail. Access to the apartment is easy. The space is comfortable, clean, and well-appointed with modern amenities, including a large TV screen and a great shower. It worked well for us while we were in town attending a wedding.
Enjoyable and well located place!
Good calm stay
Richard was very responsive. The place was nice and clean. Me and my friends slept comfortably. The location was not far from all the activities we had planned

I really enjoy my stay at Victoria's. The neighborhood itself was safe and quiet, and easy to get to/from downtown. The bed is also comfortable and Victoria went out of her way to help us with our travels.

My partner and I had a wonderful stay! The hosts were really kind and welcoming.  We were greeted at the front and then got a tour around the home along with some history about the building and city. We loved their vibes and their cats were very sweet! There's a beautiful far view of downtown on the roof and the neighborhood was very pretty and quiet. The Airbnb was walking distance from the CTA which was a plus for this location since we mainly hung out downtown Chicago. Our favorite pastry shop walking distance was Floriole and coffee at Klein's! I would highly recommend checking out this beautiful and chill place!
Kristina’s place was a nice stay for a large group not too far from Downtown Chicago. Helped save some money and came with a clean interior and nice amenities included as well
Communication was amazing with Milan!  Noisy neighbors as the walls were thin and they had parties every night.  But at least they usually ended around midnight or so.

We chose this place for several good reasons. Conveniently located in a great neighborhood not far from downtown.
Easy and convenient parking. Great patios and outdoor spaces to enjoy a beautiful fall Chicago experience. It scored on all those needs.
Our only complaint was the cost and level of hospitality details. As a top of the line expenditure, the interiors were of minimal quality and the lacked the fine details we have experienced other place of this value.
We appreciated their effort and service, just disappointed by the interior experience.

Highly recommend, especially for a large group that plans to eat out for most meals. We had no issues finding or entering the bnb. The rental is split between the upstairs and downstairs, which we didn't realize but also had no problem with. The plethora of provided earplugs were much appreciated because of the train, but we quickly got used to the sound and didnt end up needing them. Thanks for a great stay, and we hope to return!
Great place overall! Pretty clean and was perfect for our group's needs.
Brett and Caroline were wonderful hosts. They were very responsive to any requests we had. We would definitely stay with them again.
Beautiful little home with a wonderful host! Very spacious rooms with so much character to admire!

Hello Ayla,
We really enjoyed stay at your place. Very clean, new appliances, excellent location walking distance to many restaurants.
We will definitely stay again when we visit Chicago.
I’m thankful with the host since he was super attentive to my visit and anything I needed.

Very safe and quiet neighborhood. Home was very large and accommodating for my family. Tameka was very responsive and laid out all the details. The home included anything that you could need and is located near the expressway for easy travel. Highly recommend will be using again in the future.
The hosts were very nice and quick to respond to any messages. It was a great location and a nice place to relax for a couple of days
Great, thanks!
Sehr schöne Wohnung, relativ nah zu Downtown und gute Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin.
Great spacious place to stay at. Very clean. Close to public commute. Would definitely stay here again! Thank you Marc for being an awesome host!
Chris and his family were so welcoming, kind, and incredibly responsive! The space was perfect for our group and had everything we needed. We would absolutely stay here again!
A good place to stay. i  recommend it

We have a good stay at Andre's place, and it was exactly what we needed for the Chicago Marathon weekend. Andre was super responsive and even gracious enough to allow us a late check-out, so we could clean up after the marathon before heading out. It is a bit of an older house, but homie and perfect for a place to stay not too far from the city and all of the sites/activities Chicago has to offer.
This space was perfect for a family of 4. Lot’s of great local restaurants. Easy drive into downtown to enjoy museums.
Great location! Robin was a very communicative and helpful!! Would highly recommend this house!

Larissa is a friendly and nice host. Her condo is a clean, quiet, cute place to stay at. I also love the neighborhood (Lincoln Park) a lot, where you can find many decent options of food and feel safe to walk around. Would definitely recommend this amazing host and the beautiful place in Chicago!
Argelia was very kind and communicative. Location is convenient and very well maintained!

If you’re just looking for a bed close to the metro, then this is it. But don’t expect comfort - the bedroom is right off the kitchen, so there was noise throughout the night from other guests clanking around. The bathrooms aren’t that clean. The bedroom itself didn’t feel clean either. To be honest, I would’ve rather been in a hostel with the common areas more taken care of. And especially for the price, this room was not worth it.
Mark was an excellent host and so responsive with an questions I had.  He also accommodated a late check out which I really appreciated.

Great place, clean and modern. However it is a “hostel” type situation where the house is divided into six Airbnb rooms. This is definitely a commercialised endeavour without a “homely” feel. There is only whole-house HVAC (set by the host) and my room did not have a fan/AC. This meant the room could end up feeling stuffy and warm.
Very close walking distance to the pink line (2 minute walk).
Overall this was a pretty good stay given the price and location (30 mins from downtown). I would definitely stay here again.
We had such a wonderful visit to Chicago! Jasmine was such an accommodating host!
Nardo’s place is cozy and super tidy. He is an excellent host, he always responds and is really helpful and friendly. I would hesitate to come back
Comfy place, train is relatively close to a train.

Michael was very responsive whenever we asked for directions or had any questions. The place is beautiful, quiet, and offered a lot of privacy. Every request we made was promptly attended to—great experience overall!
Great place to stay in Chicago’s Little Italy neighborhood.
Quartier très beau logement fonctionnel et propre il faut prendre les transports en commun pour aller au centre ville mais très bien desservi par les bus

Carla was an excellent host, even checked in to see if we needed anything else. The house was nicely decorated and the massage chairs in the master suite were a nice touch for relaxation after a day of walking and touring. We would definitely stay again.  Thank you Carla!!

I would absolutely stay at Alberto’s again on my next trip to Chicago. Easy to find, quiet area of the city but safe/walkable. You’re a bit far from downtown but public transit is very close. Alberto was proactive in communicating with us and gave us everything we needed.

This place was amazing! The pictures did not do it enough justice. This location is only 20 minutes from the city and extremely quiet. The apartment overall was pristine. Robert was kind enough to leave us water bottles in the fridge. The comfort of the beds were better than any hotel that I’ve ever stayed at. I definitely would stay here again when I’m back in town!!
Location was great and host was responsive.     Had a great stay.

The home is absolutely lovely, charming, and Chicago characteristic. Well appointed space with everything we needed- well stocked kitchen and bathroom, comfy cozy bed and bedrooms, great game and book cupboard, gorgeous front garden space, and all within a 15 minute walk to blue line and Logan Square. Excellent hosts, helpful and communicative
Very good neighborhood its near a school and walking distance to a lot of stores and some restaurants in the area.

Toy's place was in a great location. We had been in the car for about 4 hours. As soon as we got there we took a walk around neighborhood which was very safe. Found a few hidden gems pizza at and the Impallaria Bakery around the corner.
Great place to stay. Really clean really communicative and very friendly. Would highly recommend staying here

We really enjoyed our stay here. It was very clean and the location was close to restaurants, grocery stores and a safe area. We came with our baby and they had many baby items we could use, which was so helpful! Would gladly stay here again.
I enjoyed my stay and will be back when next l am in Chicago
I liked the clear bright white light that made it look even cleaner, and the clear colors used everywhere inside to also note it was clean, that was my main concern and wasn't when I got there.
Great place to stay and great host.
Place looked just like the pictures, really clean and pretty! Well put together, she was very communicative and helpful! Super nice, great stay.
Great Location, quiet neighborhood & street parking!
Thanks for the great stay!
Great location and communicative owner. Not too much street noice despite being very close to the nightlife action of wicker park, although the building feels older with thin walls/floors.

I stayed at Juanita’s place while running the Chicago Marathon, and it was an incredible experience! The neighborhood felt very safe, which made it easy to relax and focus before the race. The house was absolutely immaculate — spotless, comfortable, and well cared for. They were a great host, and everything about the stay exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend staying here, especially for anyone visiting for the marathon or exploring the city!
Great place to stay
Great stay! Everything was as pictured and described. Host was very responsive and helpful for a minor issue we experienced. Would stay again and recommend!
I would recommend this as a place to stay, it is comfortable for 5 people and is close to many great food options.

My parents were visiting me in Chicago, and since I live in a studio, we needed a comfortable two-bedroom place for their extended stay. This apartment turned out to be perfect for us. It’s spacious, bright, and well-suited for 3–4 people. There’s a cozy dining and living area, a nice breakfast table in the kitchen, and even a small den that works great as a home office.
The host has thought of literally everything — the apartment is stocked with all the essentials (and more!) that make a long stay feel super convenient. It’s clear that a lot of care went into making guests feel at home. We really enjoyed our month and a half here — it felt like our own home away from home. Highly recommend!

Great place. Quiet neighborhood in South Chicago. Very cute house with plenty of beds and would highly recommend as long as you can get past every lock and faucet being somehow upside down or backwards. Overall a great place to stay!

Nae was such a great host! Super easy to reach and always quick to respond, which made everything so smooth. She’s really friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. Definitely recommend staying here — she made the whole experience awesome! Beautiful home!

This place is in shockingly bad shape, with extremely shoddy workmanship throughout. In addition, there was mold embedded in bathroom caulk and inside washing machine and stains in shower and on floor tiles that will not come out with scrubbing, according to co-host. The listing's photos are tremendously deceptive, making it look sparkling and remodeled when it is really not like that at all.
One positive was the good communication by the co-host and sincere attempts to make it right when we brought this to their attention.
Really nice place.  Location is solid.  Super clean.  Milan was always very responsive.  Would def stay here again.
As I recall, we are not adding anything to all of the other guest’s reviews.  This place and Patrick are a delight.

I'm not sure that staying in an RV in a neighborhood alley would work for everyone, but it worked perfectly for us! The location is in a vibrant neighborhood filled with amazing Mexican and Cuban eats. It's close to bus lines, where it was a short ride to the L. We slept great with no real alley noise or dog barks until after 9am. Mimi was incredibly responsive and really worked hard to set our expectations. Overall, it was a unique and fun budget-minded stay in a nice location!

Bella
Thank you for your hosting! This location is great. It is quiet and close to the lake.
Have a great week !
Zhiping
Nice place to stay!  Great area, comfortable apartment.
Do not recommend. Boarded up house next door. Inside grimy and not well maintained.
This place was just what we needed. We didn’t spend much time at the house, but it had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. It was right by a bus stop to take you into the city or elsewhere.

The apartment in Roscoe Village was perfect for our family stay! There are different stores that are 15-20min away by walk. Andrei was very responsive and easy to solve anything that arose during our stay.
Noel has an amazing place and was an awesome host! Would recommend.

My partner and I stayed here because it was so expensive downtown, we loved being further out though! It was easy to get onto the bus to the train. Getting in and out of Chicago from Langston's place was a breeze, and the neighborhood was rather peaceful. The Garden unit was very clean, and we loved being on a lower level because it was a bit cooler. The ample fans in the unit were a pleasant touch as well for sleeping.
My best ever stay fell like in my own home both are so cooperative and responsible everything is soo clean i love this place and visit again whenever come here!
We had a great stay here! It was as described and comfortable. We were out and about most of the time but it was perfect for what we needed!
the loveliest space, neighborhood & host (seriously, edward is so wonderful) - truly made for a perfect chicago weekend !!

We loved this place! We spent a long weekend here visiting our son who lives in Chicago. We were able to get around easily on the blue line train. The station is just a quick walk down the street. (There’s also a grocery store right across the street, which is handy.) The apartment was nicely decorated and was very spacious. The bed and pillows were like snuggling into a dream after a day of walking around town. :) Lina was super responsive and sweet. We would stay here again. This apartment is on a second floor, just above a train line. We loved the sound of the frequent passing trains (kind of soothing, like waves), but if that would bother you, just be aware. This was a lovely home base for adventuring around Chicago.

Absolutely amazing stay! The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in effortless. The place was spotless, beautifully decorated, and stocked with everything we needed from kitchen essentials to thoughtful extras like snacks and coffee. The bed was super comfortable, and every detail made it feel like home. The location was perfect: quiet, safe, and close to great restaurants and attractions. We loved relaxing on the patio in the mornings and winding down at night. Truly one of the best Airbnbs I’ve stayed in.
I’d 100% book again and recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, cozy, and well-run place to stay!

This place was absolutely amazing! It was like stepping back in time! Kendra was responsive and flexible when we showed up earlier for check-in. The neighborhood is quiet and beautiful. We happened to be in town for the annual Pullman Neighborhood House Tours, and that was a great experience to attend. I would book this place again and recommend it to others!
Victor was a great host, the flexibility and support was very well received. It help us a lot to make our marathon trip. thank you very much Victor!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Wonderful stay!
The place was spotless, stylish, and exactly as described. The beds were super comfortable, and the kitchen had everything we needed. The location was perfect, close to great restaurants and attractions, yet quiet at night. Our host was amazing-friendly, responsive, and made sure we had everything for a great stay. We’d definitely come back!
We had a wonderful time in Chicago staying at this apartment. No issues at all and the host was very responsive. Great places to eat and drink all within walking distance. Would stay here again.
We had a great stay with my sister and her family. There was good space for the kids and adults. It is located on a fairly quite street
Very nicely furnished

The place was very nice and comfortable. Great location for us. Loved the walking path right beside us.
But the price was much more than we wanted to spend.

Naisha's place was more than expected. it was be
beautiful 💜. it had everything we needed. I love the lights outside,

Excellent location for people coming for rotations at jackson park hospital. Room was very clean and Mrs. Caroline insures the entire home is  very clean on regular basis. Location is very quiet for people who want to study or get work done. Access to CTA is very easy. Overall highly recommended it.

Lovely host, very responsive.  Gods value for the money.  Lots of amenities in walking distance.  Neighborhood surprisingly quiet for being in town.  She personally met us for check in and was very attentive.
Excellent accommodation, excellent host, excellent location, excellent views. I could not fault Milan for anything, he is doing a perfect job! Would come and stay again any time!

The Wrigleyvilla was great!!!!  Cannot beat the location.  Parked the car and didn’t get back in until we left.  The home was very clean and comfortable.  Kit and her friend Scott we very friendly and easy to communicate with.  I highly recommend this place.  Would love to stay there again next time we’re in town!
Everything was great. Nini was an excellent host.
Place is great!
John’s place was fantastic and in a great, quiet location! I’d highly recommend this for anyone wanting a short and long term stay at a dog friendly spot. 10/10 hosts.
Great stay in Bucktown
Such a cute and cozy little apartment! In a great spot in uptown, lots of shopping and amazing places to eat! Great location for walking to a lot of shops/ places!

Martha was a great host, she was so helpful and accommodating since my partner was running in the Chicago Marathon. It was very peaceful and quite, a great place to relax after a long day in the city. Would definitely recommend! :)
Belinda's place was very clean very nice place for what we paid for definitely worth the price also Belinda was very kind and patient me and my friend had a great stay
Lovely place to stay, great location and so easy and convenient to get around the area!  Todd was a great host, helpful and responsive, I will definitely here again!

Definitely recommend staying here. David was very communicative and was able to go step and above to make our stay as comfortable as possible! We didn’t know how to turn the heater on but he was very kind and explained us how to turned it on, he even brought a portable heater in case we needed more heat. Thank you David!
Great host made sure I had everything i needed
I had a great stay here. The house is clean, quiet and Jeff makes you feel right at home. Thanks again!
The place is very cozy, spacious! Comfortable and clean, thank you so much

Junior's private suite had everything we needed — comfortable, quiet, and very private. The location was perfect, easy to access, and within walking distance of great coffee shops, restaurants, and stores.
We usually rent entire homes and were a little hesitant about booking a private suite for the first time, but it turned out to be ideal since we really only needed our own room and bathroom. It felt completely private and convenient.
Junior was super responsive and accommodating — he even let us store our bags after checkout, which made our travel day much easier. Getting around was simple, with both the Damen and Western Blue Line stations nearby to get into Chicago Downtown as well as making it really convenient to get to and from O’Hare Airport.
Overall, we had a great experience!

We would stay again.
We had a group of 13 staying for a wedding and were very happy to find a space that could accommodate us. Dario was an excellent host and provided very good communication regarding check in and checkout.
Only Cons:
Older property
Strong unpleasant odor in basement.
We were informed on the eve of our visit that the neighbor was doing construction and had removed the fence on one side in the backyard, and it did indeed look like a construction zone. While this wasn’t our hosts fault, we were disappointed as we had been excited to have a private space outside to hang out - especially for the money we paid (which may have been higher than usual due to the marathon weekend).
I did not raise these issues with Dario during our stay.
Despite the cons, we would stay again (especially when fence is fixed).
Overall a great stay! Literally 15-20 min from downtown Chicago which was a major plus!! The host was very helpful and always responded right away!! If ever inviting Chicago I recommend!!
My friends and I had a very nice stay. The home was only a 10 min drive into the main downtown area. So we loved that. And the house was very modern and clean. We like the outlay of it a lot.

There were a fair amount of pros about Patricia’s place! The location was great, shower was luxe, it was well-appointed, modern and functional, and Patricia was very friendly, accommodating, and responsive.
Cons: it seemed like the cleaner did not quite finish, with some piles of debris remaining and the half bath toilet not being clean. It’s hard to tell from the listing whether the second floor is the top- it’s not. There is an apartment above and activity up there makes it quite disruptive for sleeping, but that’s not an issue for everyone. I believe all units are Airbnbs so when the people above are rapidly trying to pack and clean up, it makes for a noisy morning on floor 2. Finally, the decor was sparse making it feel a bit sterile. Some end tables, lamps and wall adornments could go a long way in making the apartment cozier.
Because we paid quite a bit to stay (marathon weekend), I did not feel it was worth the rate. However, maybe without surge prices, it’d do the trick.
Everything was seamless for the rental of this Airbnb space and perfect for our group. Plenty of walking options and neighborhood was very peaceful.
Space was perfect! We were so excited to get such a good deal on such a nice spot for our stay in the city. Right next to the L and super walkable area, we loved it!

Holly was the best! Every question was quickly answered, and local restaurants were constantly provided, which was much appreciated. The place is in a great location, walkable to Wrigley Field and its surroundings.
Recommend to anyone and will be back!
We enjoyed our stay everyone in the neighborhood we meet was very friendly would definitely recommend 😀

Hosted our bridal party at this location for getting ready! The Chicago marathon was the same weekend so securing enough hotel rooms was impossible! It was exactly what we needed with several living spaces. Easy check in & check out
Wonderful location. Easy and comfortable.
The hosts were communicative but unfortunately the unit was not cleaned properly before check in.
👍 nice

This place ruled. The accommodations were great, plenty of space and room for activities. Being right above the Empty Bottle was the highlight. One of the coolest bars I’ve ever been to. If you’re a music person/night owl, there’s nowhere better!

Jaiva and Kai were wonderful hosts and so helpful in anyway they could be before and during our stay. My family and I really enjoyed our stay at the En Bronze. We came to Chicago to get married and their place was a great place with a wonderful backdrop for doing just that.  It is quite spacious and was able to accomodate my family nicely. Kai and Jaiva gave great local recommendations and it's a short walk to the L Train. The En Bronze is also a really quick uber ride to downtown. We plan to visit Chicago again and wouldn't hesitate to book their place again :)

The apartment was just as described, clean and very comfortable. Debra was responsive, helpful and over all just a lovely person! I'll definitely book this apartment again when I come back to Chicago. Thank you again Debra!
everything was great!!!!!
It was an impossibly lovely stay at the Hamden House: I feel so grateful for the extraordinary quality of absolutely everything about this Airbnb experience!
Roberto was welcoming, accommodating, and responsive! Great host with good energy. Thank you! Will come back again someday!
Joe’s place was clean and spacious. Great location. Safe neighborhood for walking to restaurants, pubs and Wrigleyville. I would definitely recommend this place.

Excellent location, 2 mins walk to the closest subway station. House is historic and well-maintained. The host is responsive to my needs and purchased a new hair-dryer for the house! Excited to come back again as the host said the kitchen will be renovated this Summer.

The apartment was clean and as described, but the experience was extremely disappointing. Shortly after check-in, the host told us he could not accommodate two guests — even though it’s listed as a two-bedroom, entire apartment — and asked us to leave right away. My husband and I had to find a hotel at 8 pm, which was stressful and inconvenient. A refund was later offered, but this situation should never have happened. Clearer communication and accurate listing details are urgently needed.
House and neighborhood were great.  Quiet, peaceful.  A farther walk than expected for the blue line according to our tracking.  Brad was very responsive and helpful.  Highly recommend.
Excelente lugar, 15 minutos caminando llegas al metro,  que también por pocos minutos te deja en el centro de Chicago
Great location. Brett was responsive and helpful. The house was not cleaned properly after the previous guests.

Excellent location -felt very safe -very walkable!
Host was a great communicator and wanted to make sure we were comfortable and happy!
Exactly as advertised.  Josh was hyper responsive if anything came up.   Much appreciated

Ned a second step when entering. semi basement location. clean but need floor covering, bare concrete. nice bathroom but need mats l, stepping out onto bare concrete floor. side entrance. need a chair or love seat. no parking. overall good value and clean.

STAY AWAY AT ALL COST. Very Dishonest host. Dirty and hazardous place. We booked a 32 day stay. We were shocked by how inaccurate and dirty the place was - see the reasons below. After paying the full amount, we stayed ZERO nights due to the horrible conditions.
- overpowering odor of cigarettes (acknowledged by host as a problem)
- Windows did not lock (apartment is on ground floor of a major Chicago street)
- Main door lock was also broken
- Bed sheets were stained
- Broken mirror in the closet
- Bathroom tub was unstable, propped up only by a piece of wood
- Bug infestation in most of the light fixtures
We tried to negotiate a refund with host (difficult person) who offered less than 5% back. We tried to involve Airbnb, which indicated there is nothing to be done if host is unwilling to cooperate. In the end, Host received full payment for services never rendered.
I hope the host takes more pride in her property but mostly want to warn renters to find any other property.
Matt and Steven were great hosts! They were incredibly responsive anytime we reached out with a question, and were super accommodating. We had a great experience and would definitely recommend.

Thanks for a great stay! I had stayed at a different Airbnb the nights prior to my stay at Ben’s.  I slept better than I had in over a week when I arrived at Ben’s! The bed and bed sheets were so comfy! It was a great location and clean and fresh! Thank you!

Overall, this Airbnb is clean, in a good location, nice amenities in the apartment building, and the host was very attentive. The rooms and common area look much bigger in the pictures than they are in person and the fee for early check-in and late check-out are steep ($149). We were thankful to have a place to stay during Chicago Marathon weekend after our first Airbnb cancelled on us. Thank you!!

The place was in a great location and had lots of space for multiple people. Building was easy to access and secure. Only note is Google maps does bring you into an alley when trying to get into the building-make sure you go to the main street for the front entrance. Mo & Ganna were communicative and helpful when needed, good experience overall.

Dustin was a super rsponsive host. The unit is on a lovely, quiet street but very centrally located. The queen and king bedrooms were comfortable with ample closet space. We shared the unit with friends, so having the two bedrooms on separate levels enabled us all to have privacy. We highly recommend the Maplewood Brewery and Boulevard Bistro, both within walking distance

I stayed at Casey’s place for a little over five weeks and honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The apartment was spotless, super comfortable, and exactly as pictured. Check-in was a breeze, and everything worked perfectly the whole time.
The location is fantastic — the neighborhood is super walkable, with a grocery store nearby and tons of great restaurants, coffee shops, and bars in both Logan Square and Wicker Park. It’s also just about a 15-minute walk to the Logan Square Blue Line station, which makes it really easy to get downtown or to O’Hare.
Casey and her husband were awesome — really friendly, quick to respond whenever I had a question, and full of great local tips. As someone new to the area, that was super helpful.
All in all, it was an easy, cozy, and welcoming place to stay. I’d absolutely recommend it for anyone visiting Chicago!

Beautiful home in a quiet neighborhood! The rooms were spacious, clean, and comfortable, perfect for our family trip. The location was super convenient and close to everything we needed. James and Jasmine were great hosts, very responsive and made check-in easy. Definitely recommend staying here!
Stayed here for the weekend, location was convenient and the house was clean and looked like the photos! Great host as well, would definitely recommend!
Very nice area close to restaurants. The neighborhood was peaceful. Loved the backyard. The place was clean and spacious. Great Host!

It was a great stay. Nice, quiet and safe neighborhood. About an hour to get to downtown Chicago with the L train but there is everything you need nearby. Place was clean and Charlie was really nice, helpful and responsive.

Ok so this is a basement unit in a really old house, so you need to set your expectations based on that. However, amenities and extra touches make it worthwhile staying at Andy’s place. He was also very responsive and always willing to help. That’s why I think the stay deserved a five star. Thanks Andy!

Everything went really well! A little hiccup trying to check in but Martin was quick to respond and help us out with it! Overall very clean place and the area was very peaceful, just hard to find parking at night if you come back from exploring late.
The house was so clean, cozy and in a nice neighborhood. Would definitely stay here again.

This place is very comfortable.
It is walkable or very close to wonderful neighborhood restaurants, bars, coffee shops and music venues. There initially was a glitch getting into the place with it’s 3 levels of security, but it was resolved quickly was no problem the remainder of the stay.

I booked this place for work stay.. was a little skeptical cause such a good deal!! But once I got there family came to visit!! YES perfect for vacation or work.. if booked up MY BAD.. my co workers might have snatched it up… if not enjoy your new home away from home .. did I mention 🏡 $7 Ubers to town

I had an excellent month long stay here! It's the best place I've stayed at in the city. If you like the intimate, hostel vibe, this place is definitely for you. This is an unbeatable value with one of the most chill, helpful and responsive hosts I've ever had the pleasure of dealing with. 10/10 would stay again.
This place is a hidden gem. Very homely and spacious with all the necessities. Entrance steps are steep if any mobility issues . Overall great place to stay and effort put in all rooms .

Google Maps sends you to the alley behind their home. Trust the address and look for the wooden fence on Cermak. This place is AMAZING! Incredible decor. I'm definitely going back! 5 minute walk to the L and 25 minutes to downtown.

Sadia was extremely responsive. The apartment is in a great spot - you can walk to many restaurants and shopping on Michigan avenue. The views of the city were incredible from the apartment. I stayed for 5 weeks and miss the apartment!

Greg's place was a good stay. It is around the Lincoln Park / Depaul University area, and there are a lot of decent to nice places for food, clothing, coffee, you name it. I had a great time spending my time here. It was very clean and the host was responsive. I would for sure stay here again!

Our party of six adults stayed at Moumita’s place for a few days to attend a near-by event. The location was perfect. Alan's place is super clean, comfortable and spacious. Great for either a solo traveler looking for a set up extra room, or for a whole family. Conveniently located to good coffee shops and restaurants within a five-minute walk.
Amazing neighborhood, super cute space, and a very helpful host. We had a great time in Chicago!

Great deal for the price paid it was about a 10 minute walk from the orange train. If you’re not from a city this may be different but being from a city this was nothing crazy. Enjoyable stay! Anny was so easy to communicate with and she is very detail oriented, very good instructions for house entry and little details like water and snacks provided in the room. Felt right at home. Thanks Anny!!

Hope we can do it a third time before too long.
great place short stay
Perfect for my work trip downtown!

Street parking not guaranteed, and does require a permit (not provided). Very happy to have had access to laundry machines, however. Appliances were new and nice, and adequate cooking utensils were provided in the kitchen. A few adjustments to cleaning and communication would make this place a great stay.
Nice place. Good for its price

Great location and super close to the red line on the L making getting around easy

The neighborhood felt safe and peaceful. The house is as described in the pictures. We rented a car so having a garage was a big plus as street parking is a little tricky in the evening. All in all, we had a comfortable stay and had a great family reunion!

I had a great time, I was there for a month and it felt like home eventually, the access to fridge and kitchen really made it easy. Helen always had everything stocked up so we never have to run out to grab stuff which was great. She also always responded immediately.
Nos gustó mucho!
Great place

As a last minute find for a mini girls trip, this place was perfect. It felt very clean and safe. Instructions for arrival and departure were very clear and super simple. Good Location, nice walk to McCormick Place, also the Metro Market located near is a great shopping place, particularly for Indian food and groceries. Quiet surroundings. A big park is nearby if you wish to run in the morning. Also, not far from the metro station (Sox-35) and the IIT campus.

What a great place to stay.  Fantastic place with everything you need.  Supermarket, liquor store and so many places to eat within walking distance.  We were 4 adults and 1 child and it suited our needs perfectly.  I would 100% stay here again

Nice amd Cozy place to stay at Logan square

Our stay in Chicago has been amazing! The house was great and very welcoming it actually started to feel like home. Sam and Jesse are very hospitable and very responsive. You won’t regret booking this airbnb, it’s worth it and has everything you would need stocked and ready to go.

We had a pleasant stay. The rooms were nice and provided what we needed. The only gripe is that only one of the bedrooms had a tv. Overall the hosts were very nice and welcoming! I like the interior design and even the refrigerator magnets were a nice touch.

I have stayed in the area several times and even in the same complex. This was my first with Bella. I will definitely book again with Bella. Check in and check out instructions were very clear. Until next time!

Overall this is a great place, it's a shame the host is too set in their ways.
The pictures are representative, though not exact. There are multiple similar units with similar furnishings. Overall comfortable but there were a slew of minor problems not worth complaining about (blinds broken, toilet flusher came off - I fixed it with a twist tie, cosmetic damage to walls and doors, only a trickle of hot water in the bathroom sink). I sent a message and Bella responded "Oh that’s because the cold season has not started yet and still the building has not set up the heater in the building:(". Like that's okay. No offer to drop off a space heater or blankets or anything.

I loved staying at Dina's coach house! I will gladly stay there again. I have no complaints at all.

Solid spot in a great part of town.

This place was perfect! Plenty of space, clean, and functional. It’s tough to find a decent four bedroom apartment in the city and this one can even seat all guests at the dining table! Amazing! Ben was friendly and responsive. I’d definitely stay here again.

This was a great location for enjoying Andersonville and the rest of the city. It's in easy walking distance of good coffee shops and restaurants. Overall a beautiful, pleasant neighborhood to walk around.

Sehr ruhige Gegend und trotzdem gute Restaurants zu Fuß zu erreichen. Wir haben uns in dieser Gegend immer sicher gefühlt. Das Badezimmer könnte ein bisschen mehr Stauraum vertragen. The apartment was well maintained and came with great working amenities, the additional security provided at all levels was appreciated, and overall access to the roads and other parts of the city made it great value for money!

Walter's unit served the purpose of my few days of trip to Uptown.  Located right in all the convevience of good food and easy public transportation. Walter was responsive and his uncle who owns a shop near by was very kind and helpful. Thank you for letting me stay in your place!

Overall, the cleanliness of the room was disappointing and gave a neglected impression.  The bathroom was dirty and there were flies present.
